It's just... Her life had been filled with so much stress, all related to what her future would hold...

That's when an eerie voice reached out to her...

Why don't we take a look and see what you should do with your life!
I'm the one who will lead you into the darkness...

And that's when all the strange things around Misa began to happen...

Key Features
Over Our Dead Bodies – School Ghost Stories, Urban Legends, the Other Realm, and the Spirit World. Get spirited away to an alternate reality or uncover tragic and thrilling truths in the real world, offering a unique mix of horror and romance with 8 romance options to explore.

Nightmare on Otome Street – For those wanting something a little spookier in their Otome, the School Ghost Stories route sees you trapped in a school where you hear whispers of gruesome murders having occurred. The presence of ghosts won't make this any easier. Can you survive, and maybe even find romance in the face of horror?

Insane in the Membrane – Being in a realm filled with ghosts and evil spirits will have an effect on you. Throughout the game, your choices will impact not only your affection with the characters you meet with the Love Catch system, but your psyche as well. Making the wrong choices can lead to insanity and even change you into something else entirely.

Drop Dead Gorgeous – Witness rich environments and alluring characters designs. Beloved character artist from Cupid Parasite, Yuuya, stuns again with gorgeous visuals.

70010000080500.name: Blood Lines : Magicians' Chase2
70010000080500.intro:
Enter the enchanted Mysterious Castle inhabited by zombies, maids, and vampire!
Witness legacy unfold in 2D PIXEL ACTION ADVENTURE!
70010000080500.description:
Layka Graves and her allies take on the vampire's Mysterious Castle!

Inheriting the mantle of her Vampire Hunter father, Layka accepts a mission to investigate the Mysterious Castle, alongside her maid Shijo Sakura. Along the way, they encounter Miretta, a priest from the Church, and Geed, a mysterious boy with vampire powers. Will they be able to defeat the Vampire Lord and restore peace?

◆ System
It's an action game where you switch between allies to progress.
Each character has unique MAIN-WEAPON and SUB-WEAPONS to master and conquer the castle!
As you advance through the stages, more allies become available.

All pixel art in the game is exclusively created by Type [X] Studio!
Enjoy the retro charm of pixel art and the crisp difficulty that offers a thrilling experience. Don't miss out on this adventure!

◆ Features
•  A brand-new game challenging the Vampire Lord's castle!
•  Switch between numerous allies with the L/R buttons to advance!
•  Crisp difficulty level for everyone to enjoy!
•  Beginner-friendly with a tutorial included!
•  Use SUB-WEAPONS to defeat formidable foes!

70010000080515.name: Candy Puzzles
70010000080515.description:
Indulge in a delicious puzzle adventure! Combine and stack cookies to create bigger and better treats in this easy-to-learn, endlessly fun game. With colorful graphics and simple controls, it’s a perfect recipe for hours of entertainment!

Enjoy solo play or double the fun with a friend in exciting 2-player mode!

70010000080520.name: 3 minutes Mystery 2
70010000080520.intro:
Unravel the New Mystery!
You are the one to uncover the truth behind the crime scene by finding hidden evidence.
70010000080520.description:
This detective game allows anyone to feel like a sleuth with its simple gameplay.

It's you who will find the hidden clues within the illustrations and lead tough cases to resolution. The mysteries awaiting you are not as straightforward as they seem, with every enigma contained in a single illustration...

The game is packed with hint features for beginners in puzzle-solving and deduction! Enjoyable for players of any level.

The highly anticipated sequel to "3 minutes Mystery" All stories are short, so there's no problem even if you haven't played "3 minutes Mystery" before!

70010000080522.name: GINKA
70010000080522.intro: Return to that summer with you...
70010000080522.description:
The GINKA visual novel has come to Nintendo Switch™!

■Story

Five years ago, Aoba Ryusei's childhood friend, Shinomiya Ginka, disappeared without a trace on the night of the summer festival. The superstitious islanders believed this to be an act of God, saying that she was ""spirited away."" 

Now in high school, Ryusei decides to visit the island over summer break. He needs to know: Did Ginka ever come back? Could she be living a normal high school life?

Sadly, his faint hopes are crushed when he learns that Ginka was never seen again after that night. He dejectedly prepares to depart, but then he meets a young girl who looks exactly like his missing childhood friend― Ginka.

""Welcome back, Ryusei.""

The girl doesn't know her own name. All she knows is that she loves Ryusei.

Where has she been? Why hasn't she aged? Finally reunited with his long lost friend, Ryusei vows to have the best summer vacation ever on the tranquil little island of his childhood.

70010000080527.name: Pixel Game Maker Series The Willow Man
70010000080527.intro: Beware The Willow Man as he lurks throughout the halls, in your dreams, and into your soul. Can you survive the night in this horror adventure.
70010000080527.description:
---About This Game
Beware The Willow Man as he lurks throughout the halls, in your dreams, and into your soul.


---The Willow Man
 is a survival horror game where you take on the shoes of Rin.
Rin and her friends decide one day to explore a house on the hill. Rumours have spread
about that place. Some say evil dwells there. Unfazed by this they enter and
what awaits them is not what they expected. Survive, hide, find a way out before
The Willow Man finds you.

---Key Features
Frantic Chases
Sanity Meter
Boss Fights
Multiple Endings
Survive, Fight, or Hide to survive the night

70010000080532.name: Rise Eterna War
70010000080532.intro: Rise Eterna War tells the bloody tale of Arthbane, a great general who led the last stand to reclaim his homeland Ars Rare from foreign invaders.
70010000080532.description:
Play as Arthbane, 10 years before the events of Rise Eterna, rallying loyalists in a desperate bid to seize the capital Gaiacus.

Guide Arthbane's campaign against the occupying Athracian army, balancing strategy and resources to defeat cunning rival generals. Recruit up to 16 units, visit the Chuckwagon to feed your troops, rally 11 legendary heroes - both new and returning favorites - to command in battle, and fight through 40+ missions in a race to turn the tide of invasion.

With an emphasis on innovative fused gameplay, Rise Eterna War mixes real-time strategy, deck-building mechanics, and resource management. Immerse yourself in a dramatic, character-driven prequel revealing the inner demons of a complex antihero mourning the fall of his nation. Experience the precursor to a fabled resistance movement over hours of dark and emotionally charged storytelling.
• Play as Arthbane - Take control of the tragic antihero faction from the original Rise Eterna as he leads a desperate last stand 10 years prior.

• Innovative Gameplay - Fuses real-time strategy with deck building and resource management in over 40 story-driven missions.

• Rally your Troops - Collect 16 diverse units and 11 legendary heroes, including returning favorites to march on to victory!

• Upgrade and Evolve – Multiple levels of upgrades for your units and mounted ballista bolts to gain an advantage on the battlefield!

• Manage Resources – Buy meals and collect coins to feed and strengthen your forces.

• Emotional Storytelling - Experience the dramatic, character-focused backstory to the original rebellion over hours of dark and brooding narrative.

70010000080535.name: Easter Bunny: Bubble Shooter
70010000080535.intro: Easter Bunny: Bubble Shooter is a new exciting game with the Easter Bunny in the main video.
70010000080535.description:
Immerse yourself in a fascinating world of colored bubbles and puzzles in every level. Use the solar laser to aim and shoot to make the game convenient for people of all ages.

At each level, new surprises and challenges await you. You can use fireballs to break through all obstacles, and rainbows will help you explode large clusters of bubbles.

Get bonuses like plus 5 to get more balls and complete the level.

This game will help improve your child's cognitive skills and give you a lot of fun.

70010000080542.name: Crab Digger TROPICAL ISLAND
70010000080542.intro: Break, Build, Compete: Unleash Your Inner Crab in a Tropical Adventure!
70010000080542.description:
Crab Digger - an exciting arcade game with RPG elements that takes you to the center of a tropical island, where you control a funny crab. Your task is to break all the blocks on the level and move on to set new records.

The game offers you the opportunity to compete with other players, track your place in the online high score table. And don't forget to collect coins, because thanks to them you can improve the damage and durability of your pickaxe!
Personalize your crab by purchasing hats from the store. Unlock new locations where you will find new types of blocks and decorations.

Crab Digger is a game that promises to captivate you with its enjoyable gameplay, exciting moments and the unique atmosphere of a tropical island. Spend time with pleasure pumping your crab and reaching new heights!

70010000080547.name: Solomon Snow: First Contact
70010000080547.intro: Defend your office, save the day—battle alien invaders and conquer the chaos!
70010000080547.description:
Save your colleagues, planet and workplace!
You are the first line of defense. If you try your best, you might not be the last. Rescue the survivors, fight your way to the roof and EXTERMINATE ALIEN SCUM!
      No one said it's going to be easy—and it won't. Be smart, be quick, and be on your guard. Oh, and we hope you brought your puzzle-solving skills with you—you just might need them.
     Therefore, Mr Snow, we sincerely hope you're up for some alien murdering, maze exploring, team building and enemy portal closing-related activities today.
  -  Take on the role of an ordinary office guard
However, Solomon Snow was born a long time ago, this is where his life really starts to count: this very morning, at the gates of the Futuresalt Corp building.  The world could really use a hero right now, but apparently he's all that we've got.
 - Shoot, rescue, lead the way!
The people you are about to meet on your way come equipped with some exclusive skills and tools: scientists open locked doors, engineers help put with environmental hazards, security officers bring firepower, office workers… well, we're sure they're very warm and interesting people anyway. Who knows: if you manage to use their talents wisely, you might even live a little bit longer.
- An arsenal of weapons is waiting to be used
Shovels, fire extinguishers, crowbars, assault rifles - some of this stuff might come really handy during an alien invasion. On the other hand, doesn't equipping an alien blaster sound like fun?
 - Explore 38 floors of the building
The corridors are narrow, the rooms are dark. Danger might be lurking everywhere: in the hallways, deserted open office spaces and server rooms. Fortunately, you're not alone. If you help the survivors, they help you.
 - Develop your character
15 varied skills divided into 5 skill trees: Soldier, Specialist, Commander, Agility and Vitality.
 - Defeat the bosses
There's no defeating a beast without decapitating it. Locate the ranking enemy officers, have a chat with them, and deliver the ultimate message of peace: a bullet to the head.
  Once war has started, there's no stopping it—only winning
This is it. We are NOT alone—however, God only knows we'd prefer to.

70010000080552.name: DARE TO SPREAD: ARMY TURN BASED STRATEGY
70010000080552.intro: Reforge the world. Your revolution starts now.
70010000080552.description:
Dare To Spread; It is a turn-based strategy game in which we shape the course of the war by making important choices. In this strategy game you control rebel armies. We occupy enemy countries with our armies. We do illegal work to finance the army.

As in every war, there is a commander who leads the armies in this alternative history game. Our command must survive so we can continue the battle. In this way, it can enable us to prevail by putting the war strategy in the middle. We can help him survive by using food and water.

In order to form an army, we need to control at least 1 state. We also need to have financial strength. In order to earn money in the game, days need to pass. In this way, we will earn very little money. In war, we can earn more money by doing illegal activities such as kidnapping people, drug trafficking, arms smuggling, and demanding ransom to earn money faster.drug dealing, kidnapping, arms smuggling, and racketeering.

In this strategy game, we will try to make 6 capitalist countries communist by war, that is, by force. Right economy, together with the administration we will control communist rebel armies. We will try to destroy the enemy armies by purchasing poison gas, aircraft, artillery and paratrooper units. When we defeat 1 enemy country, we will try to defeat the next enemy country and make it communist.

We may have captured 1 province in the war. The important thing is that the province we occupy does not revolt against us. For this, we can increase the loyalty rate of the province we occupy by making propaganda. For this, it is important to explain the communist ideology and give the infrastructure and health system to the people.

We earn 1 diplomacy point per turn. With the 1 diplomacy point we earn, we increase our relations with other communist countries. In this way, we can get money and military aid.

70010000080557.name: A Lost Note
70010000080557.intro: Journey through diverse landscapes and collect the pieces of a lost love story in A Lost Note.
70010000080557.description:
Experience a powerful tale of love and loss from the perspective of a cat, who bears witness to the most intimate moments of a couple's life. A Lost Note takes players on a journey through a variety of immersive environments, each with its unique visual style and atmosphere. Players will explore a winter environment with cherry blossoms blooming in the snow, a fall environment during golden hour, a mystical forest with strange and fantastical creatures, and a dark forest with tall and twisted trees. These environments provide a diverse range of moods, from peaceful and serene to mysterious and foreboding, creating a rich and engaging world for players to explore.
A Lost Note's soundtrack is designed to enhance the player's emotional experience and immerse them in the game's world fully. The music shifts seamlessly to match the mood and atmosphere of the different environments, from peaceful and serene to mysterious and eerie. The piano is a prominent instrument in the game's soundtrack, providing a melancholic and reflective tone to the game's emotional journey.
Features:
	•	Exploring diverse locations: Players will navigate through a variety of environments, in search of clues and secrets. Each location is uniquely designed with beautiful visuals and atmospheric soundscapes.
	•	Collecting Pages: Throughout the game, players will collect pages that reveal more about the lost love story. These pages are scattered throughout the game's world and must be found to progress the story.
	•	Uncovering Mysterious Landmarks: The game's landmarks have a deeper meaning and significance to the lost love story.
	•	Emotive Storyline: A Lost Note is a heartwarming tale of love, loss, and rediscovery. The story is told from the perspectives of both the cat and the lost love, providing a deeper and more meaningful narrative experience.

70010000080562.name: Toon Toon Racing
70010000080562.intro: Ignite your passion, feel the roar of the engines the vibrations of the road and race to victory!
70010000080562.description:
Are you looking for a stylized scenario, cool musics and an incredible car physics? Welcome to Toon Toon Racing game!

Features:
	•	Feel the engines sounds:
Nothing better than realistic engines sounds! Select your favorite car and starts listening the true engine power!
	•	Smart AI:
The AI will always be competitive, try to not out of the track because the AI is ready to take make our players eats dust.
	•	Stylized Art:
Everything in the Toon Toon Racing is stylized! The shaders of the game are inspired in anime shaders to bring a special experience for our players.
	•	Amazing experience:
You are the driver now. Show your best in this beautiful racing experience!

70010000080567.name: Spy Guy Memory
70010000080567.intro: Spy Guy Memory improves on the classic memory game formula. It gives you the ability to increase the difficulty level at your own speed and customize the challenges.
70010000080567.description:
Spy Guy is a detective and looks for hidden clues. To help him even better practice your memory and concentration with Spy Guy Memory, where memory challenges await you!

Test yourself on multiple difficulty levels, discover colorful pictures familiar from the Spy Guy series and try your hand at the toughest challenge - connecting 75 pairs!

70010000080572.name: Ninja Shadow Quest
70010000080572.intro: Are you ready to embrace the way of the ninja and embark on a quest that will test your skill, courage, and cunning?
70010000080572.description:
Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey through the ancient world of martial arts mastery in "Ninja Shadow Quest," a thrilling 2D platformer that puts players in the swift and stealthy shoes of a legendary ninja. With the fate of the world hanging in the balance, it's up to you to harness your skills, face off against formidable foes, and emerge victorious to restore peace.

Features:

Masterful Ninja Combat: Harness the art of ninjutsu as you engage in lightning-fast combat against a variety of enemies, from cunning bandits to monstrous creatures. Utilize an array of deadly weapons and nimble maneuvers to outwit and outmaneuver your adversaries.

Epic Boss Battles: Test your skills against powerful bosses that stand in your path to victory. Each boss presents a unique challenge requiring strategy, reflexes, and mastery of your ninja abilities. Only by overcoming these formidable foes can you progress on your quest.

Dynamic Environments: Traverse beautifully crafted landscapes inspired by ancient Japanese mythology and folklore. From tranquil bamboo forests to treacherous mountain peaks, each environment is rich with detail and teeming with hidden secrets and dangers.

Engaging Storyline: Immerse yourself in a captivating narrative that unfolds as you journey across the land, uncovering the mysteries of the shadowy forces threatening the world. Discover hidden lore and interact with colorful characters that will aid you on your quest.

Stunning Visuals and Sound: Experience the world of "Ninja Shadow Quest" in stunning detail, with vibrant pixel art graphics that bring each scene to life. Immerse yourself further with a dynamic soundtrack that sets the mood for each stage of your adventure.

Are you ready to embrace the way of the ninja and embark on a quest that will test your skill, courage, and cunning? The fate of the world rests in your hands. Enter the shadows and become a legend in "Ninja Shadow Quest"!

70010000080577.name: Alchemy: Origins
70010000080577.intro: Alchemy: Origins is a classic alchemy game that starts you with 4 basic elements and allows to connect them to create more and more elaborate items - all the way to reaching the stars.
70010000080577.description:
Alchemy: Origins is a classic alchemy game that starts you with 4 basic elements and allows to connect them to create more and more elaborate items - all the way to reaching the stars.

Discover over 400 unique elements that can be combined in multiple ways. Can you find them all?

70010000080582.name: Farewell North
70010000080582.intro: Restore color to the desolate islands of Farewell North, an atmospheric journey where you play as a border collie on an adventure with your human.
70010000080582.description:
Explore the islands and uncover memories in order to restore color to the archipelago, unlocking new paths, extinguishing hazards and revealing hidden objects. Explore the hand crafted, atmospheric islands while evading the creatures that would hold you back.

Discover and activate frozen wildlife to temporarily bring color back to the world, revealing hidden objects and paths, and distracting the monsters who would harm you.

Solve puzzles based on perspective and coloring to reveal hidden objects and paths in the environment. Find the perfect vantage point to reveal the secrets of the islands.

Journey at your own pace, running through lush grassy fields, hiking steep cliffs, and canoeing the ocean between an open world chain of islands inspired by the Scottish archipelagos of St. Kilda and Orkney. Discover new islands and challenges throughout the world as you work to restore color.

Unravel a unique story about saying farewell as memories reveal a glimpse into the life of the characters. Discover the events in the past which have led the characters to the archipelago, and caused all color to leave the world.

70010000080587.name: Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid
70010000080587.intro: Explore the wonder of the Japanese countryside!
70010000080587.description:
A circus troupe comes to Yomogi Town, a rural town in Japan situated between mountains and the ocean. As the son of the circus ringmaster, enjoy a special summer filled with adventures!

All of Yomogi Town and the nature surrounding it are an open world where you can enjoy summer to its fullest. Immerse yourself in nostalgic scenery filled with towering clouds, beautiful sunsets, and the sound of cicadas.

Summer days are always filled with activities like fishing at the river or catching rare bugs in a field. Help the circus succeed and interact with the townspeople if you'd like. Enjoy a night at the summer festival, dancing and watching fireworks. There's even a train so you can visit a neighboring town.

Your own special summer vacation filled with unique experiences awaits you on Nintendo Switch™!

70010000080589.name: Neptunia Riders VS Dogoos Digital Soundtrack
70010000080589.description:
Need a tune up? With the Neptunia Riders VS Dogoos Digital Soundtrack, you'll be back on the road in no time!

Tracklist:
• Dreamy Bike!
• Chased!
• Bike Battle Theme
• The Endless Plains
• Cave Where Treasure Lies
• Desert like Dessert
• The Land of Sweets
• Enemy Bike Battle
• VS Gigodtic Dogoo
• The Rider Keeps Going

70010000080591.name: Pixel Game Maker Series NYANxTECH
70010000080591.intro:
Simple yet challenging!
An action puzzle game that will wreak havoc on your brain and fingertips!
70010000080591.description:
---Game Features
Simple character control + stage gimmicks to be unlocked at the same time
This is a finger-tip confusing action puzzle.
Challenge yourself with numerous difficult puzzles!

There are more than 60 stages! Play slowly or compete for time.
It's up to you how you enjoy it!

---Story
In a place unknown...
a lost traveler appears
the cat-like young girl
with goal that lies in another place
She seeks a way out!

---7 “NYAN Medals” scattered throughout the stages.
Get them all and complete the gallery!

---Is it too hard?
You can play all the stages from the beginning by selecting a stage.

70010000080603.name: UFO Robot Grendizer - The Feast of the Wolves
70010000080603.intro: Climb aboard Grendizer the Legendary Robot and fight the forces of evil!
70010000080603.description:
Get ready to experience an unforgettable adventure with Grendizer, the famous giant robot. This action/adventure game adapted from the cult animated series will immerse you in the heart of the universe of its creator, Go Nagai, and will give you the chance to pilot the most powerful robot and fight the forces of evil.

After Planet Fleed is destroyed by the Empire of Vega, Daisuke takes refuge on our planet. Taken in and adopted by Genzo Umon, he lives at the Shirakaba Farm. While Vega's invasion of Earth is imminent, Daisuke will defend the planet Earth with the help of Grendizer, the titanic robot hidden deep inside Genzo Umon's observatory. With the help of Kôji Kabuto, the prince of Planet Fleed will constantly repel Vegas' attacks and fight his terrible robots, the Monstronefs, which were sent to destroy him.

Play as Umon Daisuke and his colossal robot while fighting in epic battles with multiple gameplays: Piloting the Spazer (flying module where Grendizer is housed), vertical shoot-them-up in the Kôji Kabuto’s TFO, and 3rd person action/combat by controlling Grendizer. Use his iconic and devastating attacks to destroy the terrifying Monstronefs and save the earth.  

- For the very first time, play as Grendizer and Umon Daisuke in this action/adventure game, which is all about the metal colossus. 
- Execute and improve the famous must-have attacks of the giant robot.
- Find all the characters, iconic places, and enemies of the TV series.
- A new gaming experience is offered to you in multiple game phases: Action/Brawler, 3rd person Shooter, Shoot Them Up and Exploration.
- The iconic music of the series has been remastered, and you will be able to enjoy it throughout the game.

70010000080615.name: Puss in Boots: Purrfect Adventures
70010000080615.intro: Join Puss in Boots on this purrfectly thrilling escapade and become the hero the world needs!
70010000080615.description:
Embark on a feline-fueled journey in "Puss in Boots: Purrfect Adventures"! This thrilling 2D platformer game invites players into a whimsical world where our daring hero, Puss in Boots, sets out on a daring quest to save the day.

As Puss in Boots, players must traverse through enchanting landscapes, leaping across platforms and collecting coins to unlock a treasure trove of upgrades. Gather enough coins to customize your adventure with powerful bullets and fortify your health, arming yourself for the challenges ahead.

But beware! Along the way, formidable foes stand in your path, each more powerful than the last. Engage in thrilling battles against these nefarious adversaries, utilizing your cunning and agility to emerge victorious.

With each level presenting new obstacles and adversaries, "Puss in Boots: Purrfect Adventures" promises an exhilarating experience for players of all ages. Join Puss in Boots on this purrfectly thrilling escapade and become the hero the world needs!

70010000080625.name: Stray
70010000080625.intro: A stray cat must untangle an ancient mystery to escape a cybercity.
70010000080625.description:
Lost, alone and separated from family, a stray cat must untangle an ancient mystery to escape a long-forgotten city.  

Stray is a third-person cat adventure game set amidst the detailed, neon-lit alleys of a decaying cybercity and the murky environments of its seedy underbelly. Roam surroundings high and low, defend against unforeseen threats and solve the mysteries of this unwelcoming place inhabited by curious droids and dangerous creatures. 

See the world through the eyes of a cat and interact with the environment in playful ways. Be stealthy, nimble, silly, and sometimes as annoying as possible with the strange inhabitants of this mysterious world. 

Along the way, the cat befriends a small flying drone, known only as B-12. With the help of this newfound companion, the duo must find a way out. 

Stray is developed by BlueTwelve Studio, a small team from the south of France mostly made up of cats and a handful of humans.

70010000080633.name: Ultra Mission™
70010000080633.intro: Embark on a dangerous investigation in Ultra Mission™. As an agent of the Stellar Exchange Commission, you must traverse the 20 dizzying levels within Otto Labs.
70010000080633.description:
The date: January 12, 2081
The location: Otto Labs headquarters
The objective: Find out what the heck is going on!

Embark on a dangerous investigation in Ultra Mission™, the latest arcade-inspired shooter from Gumbo Machine™. As an agent of the Stellar Exchange Commission, you must traverse the labyrinthine maze that is Otto Labs. Each of Ultra Mission's 20 levels is littered with powerful automatons and questionable experiments.

One thing is certain: this is going to be a blast!

70010000080638.name: Anime Girls: Gorgeous Girlfriend
70010000080638.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000080638.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000080640.name: Terror Mansion
70010000080640.intro: Fight your fears and escape the Terror Mansion !
70010000080640.description:
Terror Mansion is an exciting first person Horror video game that catapults you into a  frightening Mansion. 
Your main objective is to escape the infested Mansion, finding objects and challenging riddles while exploring incredible scenarios.

70010000080650.name: Cook 'Til Escape～Nyanzou&Kumakichi: Escape Game～
70010000080650.intro:
1200 kinds of dishes in total
Combine various tools and materials
70010000080650.description:
Day in and day out, Nyanzou always looks like he’s up to something. Sure enough, this time he tells Kumakichi that he wants to open a restaurant. Kumakichi, thinking it’s the same old same old, shuts the idea down all cold and distant. Just when Nyanzou is taking a walk in a field at a loss of what to do, a shady shadow appears…

This time, Nyanzou & Kumakichi will run a restaurant! Kumakichi runs around cleaning up Nyanzou's mess. Will Nyanzou actually learn how to cook?!

This fresh new take on escape games is a hybrid of classic escape & cooking games.

70010000080653.name: SlidePuzzle
70010000080653.intro: A new type of falling object puzzle in which you slide and erase blocks by aligning them.
70010000080653.description:
The puzzle consists of grabbing blocks, sliding them sideways, and dropping them into a line.

Three difficulty levels are available: EASY mode, which allows you to think carefully, NOMAL mode, in which blocks keep increasing in time, and HARD mode, in which there are no items to help you.

Ranking board is available.
Ranking for each difficulty level is available.

70010000080658.name: Arcade Tanks World: Tank Battle Simulator
70010000080658.intro: Welcome to the arcade world of battle tanks! Get into the tank, go to the battlefield and complete all combat missions!

70010000080664.name: Nintendo World Championships: NES™ Edition
70010000080664.intro: Bring the Nintendo World Championships to your living room
70010000080664.description:
Bring the Nintendo World Championships to your living room

Test your speedrunning skill in over 150 challenges! Each one relives a memorable moment from one of 13 NES™ games*, including classics like Super Mario Bros.™ 3, The Legend of Zelda™, Donkey Kong™, and Metroid™. Start small by seeing how quickly you can blaze through the first level of Super Mario Bros., and work your way up to defeating Meta-Knight in a one-on-one sword fight in Kirby’s Adventure™ Hone your skills in practice and see if you have what it takes to be a champion—the tougher challenges may truly test your limits!

Compete against players around the world online**

Jump into the World Championship Mode with a Nintendo Switch Online membership and aim for a spot on the leaderboards in five challenges that rotate each week. At the end of each week, compare your times against players of varying skill levels, or sit back and watch a replay of the world’s best time to learn how to improve. With “byte-sized” challenges, you don’t need to master entire games to feel like a Nintendo World Champion!
 
Challenge your friends on the couch

Gather up to 8 players*** in the local Party Mode to take on challenges individually or in themed challenge packs. With an automatic rewind feature to undo mistakes, even completely new players can compete.

Face off against the best times of players of different skill levels in Survival Mode

Choose your division—Silver for easy, Gold for hard—and match up against the ghost data of players from around the world in this elimination mode. Can you outlast all seven of your rivals in the three challenges of the week?

Put your skills to the ultimate test in Legend Challenges

When you feel ready, take on these longer and more difficult challenges from 13 NES games*. Play through Super Mario Bros. using warp pipes, the entire first dungeon of The Legend of Zelda, and more in the ultimate test of speed and endurance. Check out the Classified Information for tips and tricks if you need a little help!

You can play with Nintendo Entertainment System Controllers**** as well (sold separately).

70010000080670.name: Tractor Farming Simulator 3D
70010000080670.intro: Are you ready to till the soil, sow the seeds, and reap the rewards?
70010000080670.description:
Experience the true essence of rural life in Tractor Farming Simulator 3D! Dive into the immersive world of agriculture as you take on the role of a skilled farmer tasked with managing your own farm. From plowing and planting to harvesting and selling crops, every step of the farming process is in your hands.

In Tractor Farming Simulator 3D, players embark on a journey to build their farming empire. Complete a variety of tasks and challenges to earn money, then reinvest your earnings to upgrade to more powerful tractors and equipment. With each upgrade, you'll unlock new opportunities to increase your productivity and profitability.

With stunning 3D graphics and realistic gameplay mechanics, Tractor Farming Simulator 3D offers an authentic farming experience like never before. 

Are you ready to till the soil, sow the seeds, and reap the rewards? Step into the driver's seat and become the master of your own agricultural destiny in Tractor Farming Simulator 3D!

70010000080678.name: Pirates Golden Quest
70010000080678.intro: Are you ready to become the ultimate pirate legend?
70010000080678.description:
Embark on a swashbuckling adventure in "Pirates Golden Quest," a thrilling 2D platformer that puts you in the boots of a daring pirate on a mission to save the world from sinister foes!

Set sail across treacherous seas and explore vibrant, handcrafted levels filled with danger and excitement. As you navigate through each challenging environment, you'll encounter a variety of enemies standing in your way. From cunning pirates to fearsome sea monsters, every encounter will test your skills and courage.

But fear not, for you wield both sword and pistol in your quest for victory! Engage in fast-paced combat as you slash, shoot, and dodge your way through hordes of adversaries. With each defeated foe, you'll earn valuable loot and riches that can be used to enhance your abilities.

Manage your resources wisely, for every coin you collect brings you closer to victory. Spend your hard-earned plunder to bolster your health, upgrade your arsenal, and unlock powerful abilities that will aid you in your quest.

Whether you're battling through dense jungles, stormy seas, or ancient ruins, "Pirates Golden Quest" offers a thrilling adventure like no other. So hoist the Jolly Roger, sharpen your cutlass, and prepare to chart a course for fortune and glory!

Are you ready to become the ultimate pirate legend?

70010000080683.name: Pixel Game Maker Series Moon Viewing Jump Rabbit
70010000080683.intro: Find the best view to enjoy your snack!
70010000080683.description:
■About the Game
Eat your Moon-gazing Dumpling anywhere!
Choose whatever view you like,
but the game ends after your snack!
Head for dizzying heights in your quest for the best spot!

■Story
One day, two of Rabbit's friends came to him.
They presented Rabbit with a lovely Moon-gazing Dumpling!
"Well, there's nothing to be done. I must simply find a nice, high spot to enjoy such a treat!"

Rabbit is always having a good time jumping everywhere, especially when there's food to enjoy too!

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.

70010000080689.name: Ruthless Carnage Hotline
70010000080689.intro: Ruthless Carnage Hotline : Fight, Survive, Dominate!  Are You Ready?
70010000080689.description:
Step into the neon-lit, crime-ridden streets of Ruthless Carnage Hotline. As a lone vigilante, you'll embark on a relentless rampage through 13 challenging levels, each more intense than the last. Choose from 5 unique playable characters, each with their own distinct arsenal of weapons and combat styles, and wreak havoc on the criminal underworld.

Key Features:
- Intense top-down action: Master the art of close-quarters combat as you dodge, weave, and blast your way through hordes of enemies.
- Unique character abilities: Experiment with 5 distinct playable characters, each offering a different style of play and specialized skills.
- Diverse weapons arsenal: Unleash a variety of deadly weapons, including pistols, shotguns, and melee weapons, to decimate your foes.
- Stylish cyberpunk aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a gritty, neon-drenched cyberpunk world with a retro-futuristic vibe.
- Challenging level design: Push your skills to the limit as you navigate increasingly complex and demanding levels.
- Non-stop adrenaline rush: Experience the thrill of relentless action from start to finish.

70010000080694.name: Yori's Journey: Forgotten Origins
70010000080694.intro: Unleash your skills and face your foes, go to the end and survive the experiment.
70010000080694.description:
Yori's Journey: Forgotten Origins is an immersive third-person combat experience set in a post-apocalyptic world where survival is paramount. Player step into the shoes of the main character, thrust into a virtual experiment against your will. With the sole objective of surviving and reaching the end, players must navigate through a linear narrative fraught with challenges and dangers.
Key Features:
	•	Intense Combat: Experience adrenaline-pumping third-person combat with diverse challenges and tactics.
	•	Evolving Techniques: Unlock and upgrade a variety of fighting skills to adapt to increasingly formidable foes.
	•	Dynamic Enemies: Encounter 5-6 distinct enemy types, each with unique strengths and weaknesses.
	•	Combo Mastery: Utilize precise timing and strategic planning to execute devastating combo shots with a repertoire of 10 unique moves.
Are you ready to prove your worth and conquer the experiment's ultimate challenge?

70010000080702.name: Supermarket Shopping Simulator
70010000080702.description:
Supermarket Shopping Simulator offers an exhilarating journey through the aisles of various supermarkets, each with its own unique layout and challenges. In this vibrant and engaging simulation game, players embark on a quest across 27 distinct levels, racing against time to gather a specific list of items ranging from everyday groceries to exotic delicacies.

Armed with a shopping cart, you'll navigate through bustling supermarket environments, dodging obstacles and making strategic decisions to fill your cart with the required products before the clock runs out. Each level increases in complexity and urgency, testing your speed, precision, and planning skills.

Features:

Dynamic Levels: Experience the thrill of shopping in 27 uniquely designed supermarkets, each offering a new layout and a different set of items to collect.
Time-Based Challenges: Sharpen your time management skills as you race against the clock to complete shopping lists in record time.
Varied Obstacles: Overcome dynamic obstacles like crowded aisles, out-of-stock items, and more, that add a layer of strategy and unpredictability to your shopping spree.
Vivid Graphics and Immersive Soundtracks: Dive into beautifully crafted environments with lively characters and catchy music that enhance your shopping adventure.
Whether you're a casual gamer looking for some quick fun or a strategy enthusiast eager to optimize each run, Supermarket Shopping Simulator delivers a captivating blend of speed, strategy, and shopping. Prepare to unleash your inner shopper and dominate the supermarket aisles!

70010000080713.name: Sunsoft is Back! Retro Game Selection
70010000080713.intro: Three Famicom classics officially playable in English for the very first time!
70010000080713.description:
SUNSOFT is back and it’s bringing some of its 8-bit classics to the West for the very first time!

In SUNSOFT is Back! Retro Game Selection, discover three of the legendary Japanese publisher’s Famicom games and play them in English for the first time ever!

The three games included are: The Wing of Madoola, Firework Thrower Kantaro’s 53 Stations of the Tokaido and Ripple Island.

Dive into SUNSOFT’s rich history by playing those Action and Adventure gems from the 1980s!


About the games included:

The Wing of Madoola: Help fierce warrior Lucia retrieve the powerful Wing of Madoola from the evil King Daltos.

Firework Thrower Kantaro’s 53 Stations of the Tokaido: As fireworks maker Kantaro, prevent evil merchants from turning his creations into weapons!

Ripple Island: Play as Kyle, a young boy dreaming of a better life, who answers King Dotella’s call for help against the nefarious Emperor Groaker.


In addition to giving brand new localizations to all three titles, multiple quality of life features have also been added to make the gameplay experience more pleasant, and less unforgiving, to modern gamers.


Features:
-English localization created for all three games
-Save States
-Rewind
-CRT Filter
-Multiple aspect ratios and borders
-Gallery Mode showcasing art and promotional material
-3D models of the original game cartridges

70010000080720.name: Sportitions’24
70010000080720.intro: Sportitions’24 is a game with cool graphics to entertain the whole family and friends, encouraging self-improvement and competitiveness in fun athletic events.
70010000080720.description:
• We will find various high-level sporting events held in an Olympic stadium: high jump, javelin throw, 400-meter hurdles, pole vault, hammer or discus throw and many more.

• Each event has its own mechanics when it comes to achieving its objective: balance, speed, timing and reflexes with the quicktime event system (QTE).

• Unlock no less than 60 bizarre and unusual athletes. With them you can have a laugh…imagine controlling Santa Claus or the vampire trying to do a pole vault, also a diver with fins, a superhero with a cape, a pink bunny costume and many more.

• Various game modes including One Vs One to challenge your best friend or family member. With a world ranking and friends ranking for each event (leaderboard), and with an Olympic podium to celebrate your great achievements and Olympic medals.

70010000080722.name: FROGUE
70010000080722.intro: Embark in a procedurally generated journey in FROGUE, a Roguelike Bullet Hell Platformer.
70010000080722.description:
Frogue is a stylish turn-based action platformer with bits of roguelite, bullet hell and time manipulation. Dash through your enemies, freeze time and throw your sword to solve every situation in YOUR way.

- Dash to avoid bullet and kill your enemies!
- Throw knifes to kill them at a distance.
- Out of options? No problem, freeze time and make your own solution!

70010000080730.name: SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS: Art Book with Mini Soundtrack

70010000080732.name: Demon Go!
70010000080732.intro: The story of a little demon escaping hell because it's so hellish! Will the little one be able to overcome fearsome obstacles and arrive safely in kitty heaven?
70010000080732.description:
Demon Go! is a side-scrolling runner action game where players use simple controls to quickly maneuver through various stages.

The road to cat heaven, filled with all the world's kitties, is a rough one. Help the little demon reach the utopia he has longed for!

<Game intro>

▶ Quickly and eagerly, go forward and forward some more!
Use only Jump and Dash to charge forward nonstop! Use these two actions to run away from or defeat the demons to reach kitty heaven!

▶ Action-packed escape featuring a host of gimmicks!
Take advantage of the gimmicks featured on each stage! Jump through the air, blow your enemies away, and more as you use the simple controls to navigate all that action!

▶ Use items to clear stages easier!
Gather all the gold on each stage to unlock a host of items! The hell store sells items with a variety of different abilities. Form your own combination of items to combat each stage!

▶ To utopia with the kitties!
Escape hell with the scattered kitties that have lost their way! Rescued cats follow the little demon to the end of the stage. During your flight through hell, maybe you'll even find a few peculiar ones.

70010000080737.name: WitchSpring R
70010000080737.intro: The story of a young witch who seeks power to survive a brutal witch hunt.
70010000080737.description:
WitchSpring R is a story-driven RPG with a unique gaming system blending elements of simulation, item collection, and adventure. Discover the perfect combination of fairytale-like graphics and deep worldbuilding!
Accompany Pieberry, a young witch running from a Witch Hunt, as she embarks on a grand adventure!

70010000080750.name: Rec Room
70010000080750.intro: Rec Room is the best place to build and play games together.
70010000080750.description:
Party up with friends from all around the world to chat, hang out, explore player-created rooms, or build something new and amazing to share with us all.

- Customize and dress up your cute Rec Room avatar to express your style
- Discover challenging, fun or straight up weird games made by creators just like you
- Try your skill with the Maker Pen, the tool used by Rec Room creators to build everything from puppies to helicopters to entire worlds!
- Join the best community - Rec Room is a fun and welcoming place for people from all walks of life! Let us help you find people you’ll LOVE to hang out with.

70010000080755.name: The Eerie Surroundings
70010000080755.intro: You are trying to find the exit but you are stuck in a loop. To find the exit, observe your surroundings and get familiar with it.
70010000080755.description:
The timer will start once you are ready to play. The correct decision will move you up a floor and the incorrect decision will reset you back to the beginning. Observation is key.

If you don't find anomalies, choose the elevator that states no anomalies otherwise choose the elevator that states confirm anomalies.

70010000080760.name: Aeruta
70010000080760.intro: A bread revolution across the world now begins!
70010000080760.description:
***The aroma of bread in memories... In this moment, let's start anew!***

This is a world where bread is gradually being forgotten.

Until one day, in the corner of the world, an accidental explosion triggered by the main character Chaya, who was forced to stay in a rundown town where she is unfamiliar with the little store owner Effie to rebulid her bakery.

And the good smell from the insignificant oven is - the almost lost delicious food, **BREAD**!

## Collect materials in areas with your style!

Use your weapon and skills to create a path!

There're multiple weapons to choose from,

They all have a unique skilltree to make your own playstyle!

* Multiple areas with different theme and challenges!
* The locals are cute but also dangerous!
* Rare materials! What bread can they make?

## Delicious bread for the bakery!

Sell breads in your own bakery!

* Set up the rack of breads for most outcome!
* Customers are in need! Help them or lose the opportunity!
* Make sure there're breads to sell!
* Clean up that floor, or you might lose some money!

## Develop deserted town, meet new friends!

With power of bread, new possibilities are opened!

* New friends will join the town with your progress!
* Research and upgrade the recipes to become top rated shop!
* Make deserted town great by developing new buldings!

70010000080767.name: Path to Purge
70010000080767.intro: Rogue-like Shooter! If the demon is a lovely little girl, will you still give her a wide berth? You are the Demon to purge the Human beings that corrupted by the Holy Spirit.
70010000080767.description:
- Accumulate demonic energy and you will be able to transform into a demon and gain powerful power!
- Choose from different random skills to build your combat style.
- Challenge the powerful BOSS and save fallen humanity!

In modern society, people are increasingly focusing on entertainment, immersing themselves in the joy brought by material things and losing themselves. These fallen humans are punished by the Holy Spirit, turning into emotionless beings of obsession.
The devil survives by absorbing the corrupted faith of humans, but if humanity falls to the point of having no emotions, this will also affect the devil's intentions. Without a choice, as a demon, you must destroy the Holy Spirit behind the curse to save humanity.

70010000080772.name: Knight Sim Life
70010000080772.intro: "Knight Sim Life" offers a compelling blend of city-building, farming simulation, and strategic combat.
70010000080772.description:
Embark on a journey to build and defend your own medieval kingdom in "Knight Sim Life," a captivating 3D farming and city-building simulation game. Set in a vibrant low-poly world, players assume the role of a valiant knight tasked with cultivating the land, constructing magnificent structures, and safeguarding their burgeoning realm from looming threats.

Features:

Dynamic City Building: Construct and customize your medieval city from the ground up. Erect majestic castles, bustling markets, quaint cottages, and essential infrastructure to support your growing population.

Lavish Farming Mechanics: Delve into the art of agriculture as you cultivate vast fields of crops, orchards, and livestock. Harvest resources, manage livestock, and master the seasons to ensure prosperity for your people.

Thriving Economy: Establish trade routes, negotiate with merchants, and manage your kingdom's economy to foster prosperity and growth. Trade resources, goods, and artifacts with neighboring realms to strengthen alliances and expand your influence.

Rich Narrative: Immerse yourself in a captivating storyline filled with quests, challenges, and unexpected encounters. Unravel the mysteries of the realm, forge alliances with other knights, and shape the fate of your kingdom through your actions.
Immersive Visuals: Experience the charm of a medieval fantasy world brought to life with stunning low-poly graphics, vibrant environments, and intricate details that capture the essence of a bygone era.

Endless Exploration: Venture beyond the walls of your city to discover hidden treasures, ancient ruins, and untamed wilderness teeming with adventure. Explore diverse biomes, encounter mythical creatures, and uncover the secrets of the land.

"Knight Sim Life" offers a compelling blend of city-building, farming simulation, and strategic combat, inviting players to embark on an epic journey of discovery, conquest, and heroism in a richly detailed medieval world.

70010000080778.name: Epyx Rogue
70010000080778.description:
Epyx Rogue
The original ever-changing dungeon crawler.

In the 1980s a computer game emerged that changed the world of fantasy gaming forever. Randomly generated rooms meant that each journey into the infamous Dungeons of Doom was unique. The potent combination of random generation with perma-death proved to be intoxicating, and the game was so influential it spawned an entire genre: "Rogue-likes".

Now you too can experience the thrill of dungeon crawling for the fabled Amulet of Yendor in this pioneering game. Delve deep into this recreation of the original graphical port of Rogue by strategy game giants Epyx, that replaced the earlier text-based interface with pixel-art for the first time.

• Battle dozens of unique and powerful enemies.
• Gather armor, weapons, food and other items to help you on your quest.
• Scour rooms for secret hidden doors and traps.
• Discover strange magical spells and potions, which have different wonderous effects every time you play the game.
• Survive through 26 randomly generated levels, each more tricky and dangerous than the last, to find the Amulet, then escape... if you can!

This modern version allows you to play this classic game with many modern features, including:
• Display filters, including an 80s-style CRT filter
• Play modes - A standard mode that allows for saving games, and an Iron Rogue mode for the original perma-death experience
• An intuative and comprehensive control scheme - access common tasks with a single button press, and more complex or less-used functions via on-screen control wheels
• A virtual full instruction manual
• Choose from several atmospheric soundtracks
• Dozens of unlockable achievements
• Global Hall-of-Fame leaderboards

70010000080785.name: Love Elysium: Secret of the Goddess
70010000080785.intro: Fall in love… with a goddess?! In this visual novel divinely beautiful girls will steal your heart!
70010000080785.description:
Take part in the lottery and embark on the vacation of your life alongside your best friend: Yuina, where you'll also be a judge in a beauty contest. On the island you will be joined by the competitors – the artistic Eimiko, serious and elegant Haru, commanding Tomoe, and flirty Aimi. Get your flirt game on, the competition starts now!


WHAT IS THEIR SECRET?
While spending time with the girls, you'll notice their weird behavior. Are they hiding something from you? Why did you specifically win the competition? Does it have to do with your memory loss?


LET THEM CHARM YOU
During your stay on the island, you'll have the opportunity to spend time with each of the girls. Get to know their stories and personalities better during various activities such as jogging or swimming. They might try to bribe you and play unfairly… but that can stay just between you and them. Will you keep their secrets?


ONLY ONE WINNER
Despite the beauty and charm of all the girls, only one will be able to win the competition. Which one of them will impress you enough to award her the golden apple? Are you going to go with your heart or will you play fair?

And most importantly: will you find love in Love Elysium?

KEY FEATURES:
- An amazing story waiting for you
- 5 endings to discover = 5x more gameplay
- Unique personalities and temperaments of the girls
- Many dialogue options you can choose from
- Breathtaking island full of magical places
- Different reactions of girls depending on what you say

70010000080790.name: Hentai Dating Stories: Brazil
70010000080790.intro: Travel to Rio de Janeiro with Touji to meet his date – Tainara. Solve puzzles to unlock the story and discover what outcome awaits.
70010000080790.description:
Embark on a romantic adventure across the colorful landscapes of Rio de Janeiro in Hentai Dating Stories: Brazil. Play as Touji Ishikawa, a young heir to a prestigious family business in Japan, as he ventures into the vibrant streets of Rio de Janeiro in search of true love.

In this visual novel with puzzle mechanics, immerse yourself in Touji's quest to break free from the expectations of his family and discover his path in life.

Meet Tainara Alves, a spirited Brazilian beauty whose passion for dance and zest for life will ignite a spark within Touji's heart. Explore the bustling streets of Rio de Janeiro, from the dazzling lights of Carnival to the tranquil shores of Copacabana Beach, as you uncover the secrets of Tainara's world.

But the path to true love is never easy, and Touji and Tainara will face their fair share of challenges along the way. Join them as they unravel mysteries and solve puzzles to see what’s waiting for you next.

KEY FEATURES:
– Pocket love story
– Over 19 puzzles to solve along the way – the difficulty level rises going forward
– Beautiful anime-style characters
– Not the last Touji journey

70010000080803.name: Utah Games Presents
70010000080803.intro: Explore a variety of student-made games from the University of Utah's Masters of Entertainment Arts and Engineering Program!
70010000080803.description: Utah Games Presents combines a number of student-made games into a single fantastic, portable experience for the Nintendo Switch™.  Vault through the parkour apocalypse of Urban Nightmares, take a jaunt of wit and whimsy through the world of Cardboard Chronicles,  turn the tides of battle in My Little RPG Shop, or roll through the puzzles and adventures of Utah Games Presents! Each of these games was made by graduate students in the University of Utah's Masters of Entertainment Arts and Engineering, so playing helps our students to make better games, and helps support future students in achieving their game-making goals!

70010000080807.name: World War: Battle of the Bulge
70010000080807.intro: A reality FPS game set in WWII! This time a ground battle with tanks in a snowy winter! Get weapons and tanks to complete your mission on the battlefield!
70010000080807.description:
The Battle of the Bulge, one of the most famous battles in history, begins. Following the historic D-Day landings in Normandy (Operation Overlord), you can play a series of battles that took place during the winter months of December 16, 1944 to January 25, 1945 on the Western Front during World War II, the last major German offensive. It is a solo single player / FPS game set in World War II, favored by military enthusiasts. Be a hero on a battlefield full of gunfire and blood!

・An interesting mission based on historical facts will take place.
・During missions, you can actually control the tank to fight.
・At each stage, you have a mission based on the story. You can enjoy an exciting game.
・You can collect and use various weapons used in World War II.
・With 3D sound and 3D physics engines, you can enjoy realistic and exciting game.
・This game offers a variety of 3D effects and graphics where you can feel the world war.
・You can fight in cooperation with AI allies on the battlefield.
・You can hide/cover your body to surrounding objects during a battle and fight like a real gun battle.
・【EPISODE】mode aims to complete the mission according to the story.
・【TANK BATTLE】mode, you survive with the goal of clearing 25 WAVE.  
・Please enjoy an exciting FPS game using various weapons of allies and enemies you acquire during the battle.

A touching ending awaits you when you get rid of your enemies and complete all episodes and 25 waves in the historical scenes of the Second World War.

Synopsis
In June 1944, the Allied forces successfully landed in Normandy and full entry to the European front.
From Falaise, France, Paris will be rebuilt in no time.
Everyone was hopeful that the war would be over before Christmas.
However, the failure of Operation Market Garden and Belgium - heavily damaged in the Battle of Hürtgen Forest.
Even the supply ship was delayed and stalled.
The Allies were in a difficult situation and Hitler gathered his troops on the Eastern Front and prepared a general offensive against the Allies.
The German soldiers remember their glorious past and look to the Ardennes on the Western Front.

70010000080817.name: Darts Fever
70010000080817.intro: Step Up to the toe line!
70010000080817.description:
Get ready to test your aim and precision in Darts Fever, the ultimate darts game experience!

Take on classic and exciting game modes like 201, 301, 501, Cricket, and Around the Clock. Whether you're sharpening your solo skills or challenging up to 3 friends in local multiplayer, Darts Fever delivers non-stop dart-throwing fun. 

An innovative aim mechanic and stunning 3D graphics make every game an authentic dart-throwing experience. And with motion-controlled Joy-Con™ support, you can truly feel the action as you throw your darts with realistic movement, just like you’re playing in a real-life pub match!

Grab your darts, take aim, and hit the bullseye!

6 unique board designs
10 custom dart styles
5 game modes
Single-player or up to 4 players multi-player
Motion control Joy-Con support
Realistic 3d Graphics and throwing mechanic

70010000080819.name: Things Too Ugly
70010000080819.intro: Unearth the secrets. Solve the mystery. Beware the consequences.
70010000080819.description:
Clock in for the night shift at TEREBRO INC., 1986. As a newly promoted Risk Assessment Data Processor, your job is simple: safeguard the company’s future. But the deeper you dig into the archives, the stranger and more unsettling the details become.

Using vintage tools like a GPS and encoder device, you’ll sift through cryptic documents, unravel hidden codes, and piece together fragments of the company’s dark history. The glow of your desk lamp and the hum of a radio accompany you as tension mounts and eerie discoveries unfold.

As the night deepens, so does the mystery. What truths lay buried within TEREBRO INC.'s past, and what will you choose to do with them? The fate of the company reputation hangs in balance.

Will you be its guardian or its destroyer?

70010000080821.name: Yacht Haven Tycoon: Marina Port Parking Simulator
70010000080821.intro: Anchor Your Dreams, Build Your Empire. Navigate the Waves of Success in Yacht Haven Tycoon: Marina Port Parking Simulator!
70010000080821.description:
Experience the Thrills of Coastal Entrepreneurship in "Yacht Haven Tycoon: Marina Port Parking Simulator"!
Dive into the captivating world of maritime management, begin your journey from a humble dock and transform it into a luxurious haven for elite yachts. As the captain of your destiny, embrace the challenges and triumphs of building and running a thriving port empire.

Key Features:
- Manage Your Port: Take charge of every aspect of your port's operations, from cleaning beaches to servicing vessels, ensuring smooth sailing for your clients.
- Expand and Upgrade: Build new docks, enhance port infrastructure, and create inviting leisure areas to attract discerning clientele.
- Technical Expertise: Provide meticulous maintenance and repair services to ships, ensuring they're always in top condition for their voyages.
- Security Measures: Implement robust security systems, hire vigilant guards, and thwart thieves to maintain order and safeguard your investments.
- Market Mastery: Analyze market trends, adjust service prices, and maximize profits to fuel your port's growth and success.
- Skill Development: Level up your own expertise and that of your staff to handle a diverse range of vessels and challenges.

Immerse yourself in the intricacies of maritime entrepreneurship and chart your course to prosperity in "Yacht Haven Tycoon: Marina Port Parking Simulator"! Are you ready to embark on this exciting voyage? Set sail now and make waves in the world of port management.

70010000080825.name: Robo Rescue
70010000080825.description:
Dive into an electrifying retro arcade adventure with Robo Rescue! Set in a pixelated cyber world, players control a courageous ship tasked with saving the hapless robo-citizens scattered across grid-like mazes. Navigate through challenging levels filled with traps, hostile foes, and other threats as you work to collect, protect, and transport the robots to safety.

With its nostalgic graphics reminiscent of the classic 80s arcade era and fast-paced, strategic gameplay, Robo Rescue offers a thrilling mix of precision, timing, and quick thinking. Whether you’re playing solo or teaming up with a friend in two-player co-op mode, you'll need to master the ship's controls, avoid perilous hazards, and outmaneuver the enemy for a chance to set high scores and become the ultimate Robo Rescuer!

Features:

Arcade-Style Gameplay: Easy to pick up, difficult to master. Perfect for both casual play and high-score chasers.

Multiple Levels: Progress through increasingly challenging levels that test your skills and reflexes.

2-Player Co-op Mode: Join forces with a friend for a cooperative rescue mission or see who can score the highest.

Retro Graphics & Sounds: Enjoy the nostalgia of pixel art and chiptune music inspired by classic arcade games.

Leaderboards & High Scores: Compete against others and climb the ranks on the leaderboard.

Get ready to rescue, survive, and score big in Robo Rescue!

70010000080829.name: Treasure Guardian: Collector Shift Defender's Saga
70010000080829.intro: Defend, Collect, Prevail: Safeguard the Fortune, Secure Your Honor!
70010000080829.description:
Embark on an exhilarating journey as a seasoned collector in "Treasure Guardian: Collector Shift Defender's Saga." Your mission is clear: safeguard valuable treasures and funds from the clutches of cunning thieves across diverse and perilous locations.
As a skilled collector, you'll engage in strategic shifts, traversing through various settings to gather funds while fending off relentless thieves. Your expertise will be put to the test as you navigate through increasingly challenging shifts, each presenting unique obstacles and escalating levels of danger.
Utilize your quick reflexes and sharp wit to interact with objects effectively, securing the treasures before the thieves strike. With each successful shift, you'll ascend in ranks, unlocking access to powerful weapons and new abilities crucial for defending yourself against the evolving tactics of your adversaries.
Formulate clever strategies, adapt to changing circumstances, and outmaneuver your foes to emerge victorious in your quest to protect the riches entrusted to your care. Your dedication and skill will determine the outcome as you strive to maintain order in the face of chaos.
Will you prove yourself as the ultimate Treasure Guardian, or will the thieves succeed in their relentless pursuit? The fate of the treasures rests in your hands. Prepare to defend, strategize, and conquer in "Treasure Guardian: Collector Shift Defender's Saga".

70010000080833.name: The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition
70010000080833.intro: Form Your Own Fellowship. It’s Time for War!
70010000080833.description:
A Shadow rises in the North. Step into a darker, grittier Middle-earth where war rages beyond the Fellowship’s path. The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition expands Tolkien’s epic legendarium, delving into the brutal, untold story of Agandaûr, a Black Númenórean and servant of Sauron who has rallied an immense force in the ruins of Fornost. While Frodo and Samwise embark on their journey to Mount Doom, a new Fellowship must rise and defend the North. Let this be the hour when we draw swords together!

Choose Your Orc-Bane – Seamlessly hot-swap between three uniquely skilled characters.
Eradan: Dúnedain Ranger–Stealth and precision with bows and swords
Andriel: Elven Loremaster–Magical support with healing and area-of-effect spells
Farin: Dwarven Champion–Tank-like durability and devastating melee attacks

Co-op Fellowship – Play with up to 2 friends online. The survival of your Fellowship and all of Middle-earth depends upon your uniquely skilled heroes working together. Fight together or die alone!

Deep RPG Progression – Customize your hero with unique skills, abilities, and gear. Collect powerful weapons and armor to shape your playstyle.

Command a Great Eagle – Call upon Beleram, a mighty Great Eagle, to strike from the skies and turn the tide of battle.

Iconic Cameos & Locations – Encounter familiar faces like Aragorn, Gandalf, and Elrond as you journey through lore-rich locations including the Elven sanctuaries of Rivendell and Lórien, the daunting heights of The Lonely Mountain, and the fog-laden paths of Mirkwood.

Darker, Grittier Middle-earth – Experience the brutal reality of war with mature storytelling, blood-soaked battlefields, and the desperate fight to defend the North against Sauron’s advancing armies.

A World Full of Peril – The world is gnawed by nameless things. Face ruthless Orcs, monstrous Trolls, deadly Wargs, spectral Barrow-wights, and the dark sorcery of Agandaûr’s forces in epic battles across Middle-earth. Don’t be hasty—Agandaûr commands even greater terrors, summoning Fell Beasts and Creatures of Shadow to his aid.

Forth, and Fear No Darkness! What Say You?!

70010000080837.name: Stellarons Superstars: Detectives of the Scarlet Horizons
70010000080837.intro: Learn about this epic story of a world full of mysteries, where the enigmatic "Stellarons" are your allies in the fight against an evil sorceress who threatens to unbalance the universe.
70010000080837.description:
Embark on an exciting story through a world full of wonders and dangers in this adventure, battle and fantasy game! Join a group of brave adventurers and their mysterious companion creatures, the enigmatic Stellarons, on an epic quest to save the universe from the threat of Lady Vorunn, an evil sorceress determined to upset cosmic harmony.

In this graphic novel, you will delve into the story of children who go from being in a simple summer camp to living an exciting adventure, exploring unknown lands, solving captivating enigmas and facing challenging battles in their search for the truth behind the legendary powers of the Stellarons. With each battle you fight, you will come closer to discovering the secrets that surround these magical creatures and the darkness that threatens to plunge the world into chaos.

Do you have what it takes to save the world from the coming darkness?

Featured Features:

· 80 full color backgrounds.

· Meet more than 20 different Stellarons.

· Interactive map with 14 locations, where you can choose which adventure to discover.

· A great story with more than 13,000 words full of exciting chapters.

· Discover a variety of Stellarons, each with unique abilities and personalities.

·Explore a vibrant and detailed world, full of secrets to discover and places to explore.

Immerse yourself in an exciting story full of unexpected twists, intrigues and memorable character

70010000080839.name: Trust No One
70010000080839.intro: The game only tells half the story.
70010000080839.description: You'll need to think outside more than just the box. In "Trust No One,” a point-and-click detective adventure, you play as a journalist who tries to unravel a web of secrets about a mysterious AI-company. Explore the nooks and alleyways of Kyiv to discover the identity of your informant. "Trust No One" beckons you to embrace curiosity. The game's narrative unfolds beyond the ordinary, urging you to think outside conventional boundaries. “Trust No One” is the latest from the Ukrainian game studio Triomatica, following the success of “Boxville,” the winner of DevGamm's Best Mobile Game award in 2022 and GDWC Best Mobile Game award in 2023.

70010000080874.name: Boing Boing
70010000080874.intro: An exciting bouncy experience! Combine delights to create bigger and sweeter ones. Aim for the pudding!
70010000080874.description: Pair up desserts into larger ones, while preventing them from overflowing the bowl.

70010000080890.name: Cape's Escape Game 9th Room
70010000080890.intro: Escape game with cute but quirky characters
70010000080890.description:
After blowing some money on his favorite sweet soy sauce dumplings at the neighborhood dumpling shop, Cape gets a free shopping district lottery ticket. When he turns the tombola in hopes of winning the 3rd prize of “a ticket to slap condescending bourgeois”…

This time, the spotlight is on Cow who takes this opportunity to go wild. The Main Character and Cape are finally off to space!

70010000080893.name: Neon Noir
70010000080893.intro: Monochrome Mysteries, Neon Dreams, Explore the Contrasts of Crime in the city of the future
70010000080893.description:
Neon Noir is a sci-fi thriller visual novel with a set of interactive mechanics that allow the player to be more immersed in the story. It is set in New Devon in the year 2169, a futuristic city in the hands of large corporations.	To maintain power over the city and its population, corporations heavily rely on gathering and stealing data that can give them the edge over their competitors. Snatchers are the perfect agents for the job. One of these corporations, the Zora, has a very talented Snatcher named Colden, the main character that the player will follow throughout Neon Noir.
Features:
	•	Unique art style with a monochromatic palette. '50s Noir films black and white colliding with cyberpunk's brights neons
	•	Compelling crime stories involving new technologies and moral dilemmas
	•	Neuralink mode which allows the player to retrieve data
	•	Investigation mode which challenges the player to find clues in a crime scene
	•	Shooting mode which puts the player in the middle of gun fights against humans or AI

70010000080902.name: Matsutake Game
70010000080902.intro:
Aim for a high score by creating large matsutake mushrooms!
Stick mushrooms together to evolve them!
70010000080902.description:
Stick the same mushrooms together to evolve! 
Aim for a high score by changing mushrooms to prevent them from overflowing the basket!
If the basket overflows, the game is over.
Aim for a high score by creating large matsutake mushrooms!

Mode
There are two modes: "Normal Mode" and "Shiitake Mode" with only Shiitake mushrooms!

70010000080907.name: Wild West Tycoon Empire
70010000080907.intro: In "Wild West Tycoon Empire," you are tasked with transforming the rugged Wild West into a thriving economic powerhouse.
70010000080907.description:
Welcome to the untamed frontier! In "Wild West Tycoon Empire," you are tasked with transforming the rugged Wild West into a thriving economic powerhouse. This low-poly style simulation game invites you to master the art of frontier entrepreneurship where every decision counts and every enterprise takes you one step closer to building a legendary empire.

Features:
Frontier Agriculture: Cultivate a variety of Wild West crops such as Prairie Corn, Frontier Beans, and Pioneer Pumpkins. Each plant has unique requirements and benefits, challenging you to adapt and innovate farming techniques suitable for the Wild West.

Town Building: Design and develop your own Wild West town from the ground up. Construct essential structures like saloons, general stores, and stables to ensure your town's growth and prosperity.

Resource Management: Carefully manage limited resources such as water, timber, and gold. Make critical decisions to balance resource consumption with town expansion and efficiency.

Research and Development: Unlock advanced technologies through research to improve your farming and building capabilities. Experiment with innovative irrigation systems and durable building materials to thrive in the harsh conditions of the Wild West.

Survival Challenges: Face the realities of Wild West life, including droughts, dust storms, and bandit raids, which can threaten your crops and town's survival. Dynamic weather and event systems require quick thinking and robust contingency planning.

Stunning Low-Poly Graphics: Enjoy a visually striking low-poly art style that brings the beauty and roughness of the Wild West to life. The simplistic yet captivating graphics make building your empire a truly enchanting experience.

Embark on a unique entrepreneurial journey with "Wild West Tycoon Empire." Can you tame the wild frontier and build a new home for settlers?

70010000080912.name: Roman Empire Farming
70010000080912.intro: Can you cultivate the lands of the ancient world and forge a prosperous legacy for generations to come?
70010000080912.description:
Welcome to the fertile lands of the Roman Empire! In "Roman Empire Farming," you are entrusted with the monumental task of transforming the rugged terrain of ancient Rome into a flourishing agricultural paradise. This simulation game, inspired by the grandeur of ancient Rome, beckons you to master the art of farming within the heart of one of history's greatest civilizations.

Features:

Agricultural Mastery: Cultivate a diverse array of crops reminiscent of ancient Roman agriculture, such as Tuscan Grains, Tiberius Olives, and Colosseum Corn. Each crop presents unique challenges and rewards, requiring you to employ traditional Roman farming techniques and ingenuity.

City Building: Erect and expand your own Roman farming estate, meticulously planning the layout of fields, aqueducts, and villas. Construct essential infrastructure like granaries, irrigation systems, and amphitheaters to ensure the prosperity of your estate and the satisfaction of its citizens.

Resource Management: Strategically allocate limited resources including water, fertile soil, and labor. Make judicious decisions to balance the needs of your growing estate with the demands of the Roman Empire, ensuring both prosperity and stability.

Technological Advancements: Unlock the secrets of ancient Roman agriculture through research and innovation. Experiment with new cultivation methods, irrigation techniques, and hybrid crop varieties to maximize yields and thrive amidst the challenges of antiquity.

Survival Trials: Navigate the unpredictable elements of nature, from droughts and floods to pest infestations and barbarian raids. Adapt to the ever-changing conditions of ancient Rome, demonstrating resilience and resourcefulness in the face of adversity.

Stunning Ancient Artistry: Immerse yourself in the beauty and splendor of ancient Rome with breathtaking visuals inspired by classical art and architecture. The timeless elegance of Roman design transports you to an era of grandeur and majesty, enriching your farming experience with historical authenticity.

Embark on an epic agricultural odyssey with "Roman Empire Farming." Can you cultivate the lands of the ancient world and forge a prosperous legacy for generations to come?

70010000080917.name: Highway Zombie Survival - Car Apocalypse
70010000080917.intro: The Road to Survival is Paved with Zombies, accept the challenge, to reach the end!
70010000080917.description:
Step into the ultimate road warrior experience with Highway Zombie Survival - Car Apocalypse! In this adrenaline-pumping single-player game, your mission is simple yet deadly: survive. Navigate through a treacherous highway teeming with relentless zombies and perilous obstacles. Prove your driving skills, upgrade your arsenal, and unlock powerful cars to stay ahead of the undead threat.
Key Features:
	•	Intense Zombie Combat: Shoot down zombies before they overturn your car.
	•	Challenging Obstacles: Dodge a variety of road hazards to survive.
	•	Upgradable Arsenal: Upgrade your weapons for more firepower.
	•	Collect and Customize: Unlock and purchase 10 unique cars, that can be bought with the money collected during the race.
	•	Immersive Atmosphere: Experience high-tension, dynamic gameplay.
Rev up your engine and take on the ultimate survival challenge!

70010000080922.name: Hatch Tales: A Heroic Hookshot Adventure
70010000080922.intro: Hookshot your way through a unique platforming adventure
70010000080922.description:
Embark on an action-packed platforming quest across the mystical lands of Talonreach. Join Hatch, a flightless hawk mountaineer equipped with a powerful hookshot, on a perilous journey to confront the evil Nazar, and save the kingdom from his icy grip.

The many tales of Hatch's saga will take him from the comfort of his homeland to the far, untamed edges of the kingdom. Encountering powerful foes and dangerous hazards.
