70010000085065.intro: A tricky puzzle game about strategy, snacking, and survival. Guide adorable animals as they munch on fruit, and sometimes each other, to squeeze into their hiding spots!
70010000085065.description:
Munchy Mammals is a tricky puzzle game about strategy, snacking, and survival. Guide adorable animals of various lengths as they munch on fruit—and sometimes each other—to squeeze into their hiding spots!

As the player, you'll need to plan their moves carefully. Each mammal has unique skills and diets, from gentle herbivores to meat-loving carnivores, adding a delicious twist to every puzzle.

With over 60 challenging levels, evolving creatures, and a level editor for endless new challenges, Munchy Mammals will keep you thinking and munching. Ready to outsmart the food chain?

Level Editor:
Think you’ve mastered all 60+ levels? Test your skills with endless player-made puzzles, and collect more gold medals than any muncher before! With fresh levels added regularly, the challenges never end.

Unleash your creativity and design your own levels to share with the world.

Features:
- 60+ mind-bending puzzles with increasing difficulty
- 5 different areas with unique art
- Minimalist design; no keys, boxes, or doors to distract from the puzzles
- Move tracker & medals for the perfectionists
- Fully-featured Level Editor to create and share your own puzzles
- Endless new levels from players around the world in the level browser

70010000085070.name: Trio Adventures
70010000085070.intro: In a space travel, a accident makes Billy D. and your friends fall into this obcure planet. Now the adventures starts and only you can save tham.
70010000085070.description:
The objectives are clear, find his friends, recover the items and to escape from scary beings that inhabit the darkest places.

You will be a fugitive, avoid direct contact with the monsters to succeed in each level.
Run, jump, have accurancy in your movements to collect items.

Trio Adventures are one of the most beautiful 2D platform games. All the characters are fun and each level has a unique look and are part of the story of the game.

70010000085080.name: Moonless Moon
70010000085080.intro: When night falls, she wanders into another world...
70010000085080.description:
Moonless Moon is a text-based adventure game following a girl as she travels through a variety of different worlds.
Night brings her to a desert on the moon, a coffee shop inside of a tunnel, an island in the sky, and many more worlds beyond the realm of reason.

[The Plot]
Yomichi is a normal girl living an average student's life—except for one thing: sometimes, after sunset, she finds herself transported into a different world.
Be it a desert on the moon, a coffee shop inside of a tunnel, or an island in the sky, she enjoys her time in these new places, making friends each time.
However, this leaves her with some questions.
Do I really have to live in my daytime world? Is that life, the one where I go to school each day, the real one?
In this story, she tries to find out more about the worlds surrounding her and what they mean for her.

[What makes it unique]
- Moonless Moon feels like a music video that you can play through, full of unforgettable art and music.
- During the "riddle" parts of the game, you will have to complete the story yourself to go forward. These are fun, intuitive puzzles where you look for keywords and place them in the text.
- Moonless Moon features several original tracks with animated music videos to go along with them. Dive into this unique world and its who's who of musical talent.
- Depending on your choices, the story will progress toward different endings.

70010000085088.name: Spindle
70010000085088.intro: SPINDLE is an old-school action-adventure about death and how we choose to deal with it. Accompanied by a trusty pig, you embark on a quest to learn what it truly means to be death.
70010000085088.description:
On a fateful day, you awaken... in a world that feels utterly foreign to you.

This is where you make a surprising realization: You are... Death?
Why you of all people? And what even happened in the first place?
A talking sword? A wise mentor? Think again!
Only a Pig stands by your side! 

You set off together - but soon a horrible conundrum arises: No one is able to die anymore?!
How long will a world without death be able to last? 

To find answers, you make your way through perilous dungeons. But not every problem can be solved with a scythe! Only those who pay close attention will find a path to the deepest parts of the dungeon and closer to evil's root. 

Mysterious creatures lurk in the depths, scheming to obstruct your path. Do they keep guard over the lost souls? Or are they indeed the reason that nobody may ever die again? 

Features: 
- Don the Grim Reaper's cape and find out what it truly means to be Death.
- You can pet the Pig ... and play as it!
- Explore a beautiful world filled with secrets and discover its truly unique landscapes! 
- Delve into five challenging dungeons and face their riddles, traps and secrets! 
- From tiny creatures to giant bosses - every battle will challenge you in new ways!
- Every character you meet will develop and change throughout the story.
- Experience a gripping tale about death and the many ways we choose to deal with it.

70010000085096.name: Ultimate Puzzle Adventure: Robots
70010000085096.intro: Dive into Ultimate Puzzle Adventure: Robots with 60 playable images and three game modes. Customize your puzzle piece count and enjoy unlocked levels from the start.
70010000085096.description:
Ultimate Puzzle Adventure: Robots is a captivating puzzle game featuring 60 adorable robot images. With three different game modes, you can choose the number of pieces for each puzzle and enjoy all levels unlocked from the beginning, allowing you to play at your own pace.

· Select from three different game modes.
· Choose the number of pieces for each puzzle.
· All levels are unlocked from the start for flexible gameplay.
· Enjoy 60 unique and adorable robot images.

70010000085120.name: Jonah Lomu Rugby Challenge 4
70010000085120.description:
READY FOR THE CROSS-KICK?
-	Catch your rivals off guard using set plays with 10 different moves, including cross-kick!
-	Women's & Men's Sevens Rugby with 16 international teams.
-	Make the ultimate rugby player with both the kit creator and the enhanced player creator!
-	AI formations and strategic positioning of players making the game realistic and challenging for the experienced rugby heads.
-	Side-line camera angle and drop goal camera allowing a closer simulation to real broadcast view.
-	Enjoy over 12 stock standard competitions or create your own.
RE-RELEASE Arguably the best rugby computer game, now re-released as a tribute to the great legend of Jonah Lomu.
No licensed teams, just pure fun with the thrills and spills of Rugby Challenge 4! 
CROSS-PLATFORM FANHUB Share, download and rate players and teams using our famous Fanhub across all platforms!
THE DEFINITIVE RUGBY EXPERIENCE Multiple Game Modes including: Single Match, Multi-team Competition, extensive multi-year Career Mode, Be a Pro Mode and Online 8 player mode.

70010000085125.name: Neon Beats
70010000085125.intro: Beat your best scores in Neon Beats, a 2D platformer game with rhythm based levels!
70010000085125.description:
Neon Beats is a 2D side view platformer game in which the player will evolve in different levels that are rhythmed by catchy musics.

Complete levels as quickly as possible!
Gather several hidden collectibles!
Brave different challenging obstacles!

In Neon Beats, you will find :
• 8 different levels with it's own music
• Rhythm based gameplay
• A character with smooth and responsive controls
• Simple and elegant neon ambiance
• Several challenging level elements
• Hidden collectibles adding instruments to the music
• A score system based on your time, collectibles and deaths

70010000085145.name: Miss Rosen's Wowtastic! Marching Band
70010000085145.intro: The band is in town, and it’s time for some fun!
70010000085145.description:
Join Miss Rosen, a clockwork majorette escaped from her music box, as she travels the world solving mind-bending puzzles that’ll test your luggage-packing skills to the max!

• Story-driven puzzle adventure.
• Over 60 colorful puzzles across 12 magical lands.
• Encounter new, fantastical friends, and help them overcome unique situations.
• Fight an assortment of supervillains hellbent on conquering the world.

70010000085147.name: AMEDAMA
70010000085147.intro: Side-scrolling, soul-shifting sandbox action adventure brought to life with a striking new 2D style!
70010000085147.description:
STORY:
Aihama, Japan. The final years of the Edo period. One rain-drenched evening, a group of men burst into the town’s brother and sister-run umbrella shop. Yushin is cut down in front of his sister Yui, leaving her alone in the world. The next thing he knows, he is looking down at his own stricken corpse—a soul without a body. The grim incident shatters the peace in this quiet backwater. Lurking beneath the surface is an intricate, deep-rooted plot, shrouded in mystery. Until Yui is safe, not even death is enough to extinguish Yushin’s soul. He'll stop at nothing on his quest, shifting from body to body, possessing anyone and anything to rescue his sister. But with just seven days before his soul departs this world—can he save Yui in time? 
This is a tale of rain, reincarnation, and revenge.

GAME FEATURES:
Soul-Shifting Showdowns: Lacking a physical form, you'll need to shift your soul to other bodies on the quest to find your sister. Possession puts you in complete control of whoever and whatever you inhabit, giving you access to a variety of weapons and fighting styles. Depending on your current body, you'll face different foes and encounter new faces on your incorporeal journey.

Inclement Intrigue: This human drama plays out against the rain-soaked backdrop of mid 19th century Japan, rendered in an evocative pixel style. In the sombre world of AMEDAMA, beauty and darkness are two sides of the same coin.

Reincarnation, Repercussions: As you relive the same seven day period over and over again, your choices will impact the story unfolding around you. Who will you speak to? How will you intervene? The decisions, and the outcomes, are all up to you.

Counteraction using the sword technique of Usetsu Tensei sword style: Where Yushin, having mastered the key to battles, employs the technique known as 'Misty Riposte.' By countering the opponent's attacks, significant damage is dealt in a counteraction.


Development / Marketing: IzanagiGames
Planning: ACQUIRE
Character design: lack (Fate/Grand Order, Touken Ranbu)
Soundtrack: Yuko Komiyama (Monster Hunter series)

70010000085152.name: PICROSS Records of The Shield Hero
70010000085152.description:
The Rising of the Shield Hero anime series is now available as a puzzle game!

Picross and The Rising of the Shield Hero anime series are collaborating.

The game features an Episode mode for fans of The Rising of the Shield Hero.
You can relive the adventures of Naofumi, Raphtalia, Filo and friends while solving puzzles.

Not only can you play the usual Picross, Mega Picross, and Color Picross from the Picross S series, but Clip Picross and Extra also recreate famous scenes with large puzzles.

The number of puzzles is 166 each for Picross and Mega Picross, four for Clip Picross, and more than 40 piece puzzles each for a total of 175 puzzles, 47 puzzles for Color Picross and eight for Extra.

Picross is a picture crossword puzzle game where you follow hint number to complete a picture.
With simple, easy-to-follow rules, it's a game anyone can play!

70010000085165.name: Stella of The End
70010000085165.intro:
An android girl who yearns to be human...
What awaits her at the end of this journey?
70010000085165.description:
Key's sci-fi visual novel "Stella of The End" is now available on the Nintendo Switch™!
In the distant future, follow a courier and an android girl as they journey across an Earth that is no longer hospitable to humankind.

Story
Mankind’s sovereignty over Earth has been lost to machines following the rapid development of autonomous AI.
In this bleak future, the courier Jude receives a request to transport an android girl named Philia.
Though Philia's naivety has Jude's patience wearing thin, he does what he must to complete the request—a request that takes them through dangerous territory swarming with bandits and machines.
Philia says she wants to go to a place where she can become human, but what awaits them at the end of their journey...?

Playable in three languages!
The text can be set to English, Simplified Chinese, or Japanese (audio is in Japanese only). This includes in-game text, options, and the digital manual. Language settings can be changed at any time.

Includes full versions of the game's songs!
Full versions of the opening theme, ending theme, and the insert song are included!
Each song can be listened to from the MUSIC tab in the EXTRAS menu on the Title Screen once certain conditions have been met.

*There are no choice-based story branching elements in this game.

*Press the X button while playing to open the "System Menu." You can do things like save, load, view the manual, and change settings from this menu.

Staff
Scenario: Romeo Tanaka
Illustration / Art Supervision: SWAV

Cast
Philia  VA: Maria Sashide
Jude Gray  VA: Ryohei Kimura
Willem Grosvenor  VA: Hozumi Goda
Delilah  VA: Yumiri Hanamori
*Fully voiced (including the protagonist)

70010000085172.name: Platform 8
70010000085172.intro: You are trapped on a train that runs forever. Keep an eye out for anomalies and find a way out.
70010000085172.description:
Please be aware of any train anomalies...
Platform 8 is a sequel to The Exit 8. You will enjoy it more if you have played the previous title.

Platform 8 is a short walking simulator inspired by Japanese subways and liminal spaces, and the Backrooms.

70010000085177.name: Stick Combat - Fighting Platformer
70010000085177.intro: Defeat Enemies and Overcome Obstacles—Master the Platform with Precision and Parkour!
70010000085177.description:
As a stickman warrior, use your skills and wits to survive attacks, unlock doors, and conquer increasingly difficult levels. Master combat, utilize weapons, and navigate hazards using environmental objects. Embark on an epic adventure through diverse environments and uncover the world's secrets.

Key Features: 
	•	Freedom of Movement: Jump on walls, use vines and trampolines, form barricades with boxes, navigate portals, and swim through flooded rooms.
	•	Tactical Combat: Use a range of weapons to defeat enemies and progress through levels.
	•	Objective: Overcome obstacles, collect stars, and defeat enemies with precision, speed, and strategy.
	•	Target Audience: Ideal for action platformer fans, parkour enthusiasts, and puzzle solvers seeking a challenging adventure.

70010000085182.name: Ghost Assassin - Stealth Strike
70010000085182.intro: Embark on a stealthy adventure—eliminate foes, remain invisible.
70010000085182.description:
Ghost Assassin - Stealth Strike is an engaging and challenging game that tests your cunning and precise timing as you navigate through treacherous levels.

In Ghost Assassin - Stealth Strike, you'll take on the role of a skilled assassin tasked with infiltrating various levels filled with enemies and obstacles. Your mission is to eliminate all foes on each stage without being detected or killed.

The gameplay emphasizes strategy, stealth, and quick reflexes. You'll need to carefully maneuver through levels, avoiding detection and overcoming obstacles, all while utilizing a range of weapons that you unlock as you progress. Each weapon comes with its own set of strengths and weaknesses, adding depth to your tactical choices.

Levels are designed to challenge you with enemies that exhibit different behaviors and abilities. Some enemies may spot you from a distance, while others might engage you in close quarters. You'll need to adapt your approach to tackle each type of foe effectively.

Collect various bonuses scattered throughout the game to aid in your mission, but be prepared for the game to test your endurance as you advance. Ghost Assassin - Stealth Strike offers a gripping experience with its blend of stealth mechanics and strategic gameplay, making it a must-play for fans of the genre.

70010000085187.name: Thief Puzzle
70010000085187.intro: Steal your way to the top and become the king of thieves!
70010000085187.description:
Do you have what it takes to steal the treasure without leaving a trace? Put your skills to the test and claim your prize!

Achieve your goal by any means necessary, whether through stealth, speed, or diversion. Use whatever tactics you can to avoid detection and always stay out of sight, or you'll regret it. 

Features:
- Complete over 250 unique levels!
- Avoid tricky obstacles and don't get caught!
- Use your hand to steal the riches!
- Equip awesome themes and skins!
- Enjoy funny sounds and visuals!

What are you waiting for? Start your journey and become a master thief today!

70010000085189.name: Wizards Owl: Magic Delivery
70010000085189.intro: Soar Through Magic and Become the Ultimate Hero!
70010000085189.description:
Embark on a Magical Adventure with Wizard's Owl! 
Wizard's Owl invites you into a captivating world of wizards, owls, and a quest to save the magical realm. In this adventure, you take on the role of a determined owl working for a prestigious mail and parcel delivery service. Your aspiration is to become a personal owl for the main wizard. 

Key Features: 
	•	Unleash Your Inner Hero: Step into the wings of a determined and ambitious owl, eager to fulfill her dream of becoming a personal owl for a powerful wizard. Only the strongest and most skillful owls can attain this coveted position, and it's up to you to prove your worth.
	•	A World in Peril: The once harmonious land of wizards has been thrown into chaos by the wicked witch Mara. With her insatiable thirst for power, Mara has wreaked havoc upon innocent lives, leaving destruction and despair in her wake. It's time for you to rise to the occasion and put an end to her reign of darkness.
	•	Thrilling Challenges: Prepare yourself for a series of exciting challenges and obstacles as you navigate treacherous weather conditions, evade dangerous creatures, and outsmart rival owls who share your aspirations. With every hurdle you overcome, you grow closer to fulfilling your destiny and saving the magical realm.
	•	The Quest for Redemption: Join forces with the order of wizards as they seek to find and destroy the shattered pieces of Mara's amulet, the source of her dark powers. The fate of the world rests in your wings, and only by collecting and safeguarding each fragment can you ensure that Mara remains imprisoned forever.
	•	Immerse Yourself in a Magical World: Featuring stunning visuals, captivating storytelling, and immersive gameplay, Wizard's Owl transports you to a world where magic and adventure go hand in hand. Explore breathtaking landscapes, unravel the mysteries of the magical realm, and uncover secrets that will change the course of history.
Don't miss your chance to become the hero you were destined to be! Embark on an extraordinary journey filled with danger, friendship, and the triumph of light over darkness. Your wings await!

70010000085197.name: QuietMansion1
70010000085197.intro: Experience the ultimate in immersive terror.
70010000085197.description:
【Introduction】
The story is set in a world two years after a major bioterrorist attack that killed 170,000 people.
The story's protagonist, a journalist, miraculously survived that atrocity and has since devoted himself to solving the mystery of the attacks.
As our story begins, he receives a phone call. The caller tells him they wish to reveal the truth behind the virus used in the attacks two years ago...
Skeptical, he nevertheless follows the directions he has been given and finds himself arriving at a deserted mansion.
What he encounters there is beyond belief...

【Game Play】
The aim of the game is to use a range of weapons, including handguns, shotguns, and rocket launchers, to defeat terrifying monsters and escape from the mansion and laboratory.
This survival-action horror game is a classic FPS. The player is constantly forced to choose to either fight against their enemies or flee to safety. This management of the limited items available creates gameplay imbued with a sense of palpable tension.
The game also features multiple endings, meaning that the game's conclusion changes dramatically based on the player's actions.

【Audio】
The first game to feature the independently developed Enhanced Real Sound Effect (ERSE) audio system.
The atmosphere generated by the 3D audio effects creates a brand-new horror experience unlike anything seen before.

【Game Overview】
Title: QuietMansion1
Genre: FPS survival action horror
Hashtag: #QuietMansion

70010000085205.name: Neon Noodles
70010000085205.intro: Design and program cooking machines in a dystopian future where food controls society!
70010000085205.description:
In a dark and dystopian cyberpunk future, food is the ultimate symbol of wealth and status. Using a revolutionary invention called Neon Noodles, the Aristocracy indulges their every culinary whim. Everyone else begs for scraps. With no memory and no name, you are just a cog in this machine. But when a mysterious message unlocks your forgotten past, it thrusts you into a daring, clandestine heist to seize control of Neon Noodles and reclaim your legacy.

Neon Noodles is an open-ended culinary themed machine-building puzzle game where you program robotic chefs to cook 250 recipes from around the world, consisting of 400 unique ingredients. Take on challenging assignments from a cast of intriguing clients and design complex and beautiful automations to uncover the truth behind the Neon Noodles. Do you have what it takes to pry humanity's future from the clutches of corporate greed?

Features:

• Design cooking machines using an intuitive record-and-replay system!
• Program robotic chefs to use 400 unique ingredients.
• Cook 250 recipes inspired by global cuisine!
• Tackle challenging assignments from a cast of memorable clients.
• Enjoy a dystopian narrative where food is both a valuable resource and status symbol!

70010000085222.name: Crime Opera Fandisk: The Caterpillar Candids
70010000085222.intro: Experience a special chapter in the ongoing mafia tale surrounding the infamous Gallos family!
70010000085222.description:
In this new anthology release of Crime Opera, explore a variety of short stories that take place before, during and after the events of the original visual novel, all presented in beautifully crafted hand-drawn style to convey the drama, emotion and gritty truth surrounding characters’ lives in the criminal underworld.

“A Day in the Strife” spotlights the daily life of Terry Childers, a side character from The Butterfly Effect. In the “Recollections” chapter, Molly and Alice get together to reminisce about the past, revisiting critical moments from both their histories. Finally, “Aftermath” serves as an epilogue exploring the immediate fallout of The Butterfly Effect and the impact it has on many intertwined lives.

• Navigate multiple side stories within the Crime Opera chronology!
• Discover the many ways lives are intertwined in the criminal underworld.
• Gain new insight into the personalities and circumstances of key characters!
• Unlock scenes and view them anytime in gallery mode.
• Enjoy vibrant and detailed visuals presented in hand-drawn style!

70010000085226.name: Crime Opera II: The Floodgate Effect
70010000085226.intro: Experience a new chapter in the dark tale of mafia life, death and the bloody bonds of family!
70010000085226.description:
Experience a new chapter in the mafia tale surrounding the Gallos family! This story begins 9 years after the original. Xander Gallo is now bitter, alone and out of control. He’s causing problems for not only other families within the syndicate but also for younger Gallo members as well. Those who remained behind to continue the family legacy are soon forced to take sides with or against Xander Gallo, while others who have seemingly moved on with their lives are pulled back in against their will.

This is a tale of loyalty and deceit, murder and survival, as well as the strength or frailty of familial bonds. As a visual novel, Crime Opera II: The Floodgate Effect allows players the option of witnessing events in linear “kinetic” fashion or to affect how the narrative progresses by making key decisions along the way, all depicted with meticulously hand-drawn character portraits, a wide variety of scenes and scenarios to explore, original backgrounds and a soundtrack to fit the brooding and dangerous atmosphere.

• Explore a complex tale of life in the mafia!
• Choose from multiple narrative styles, either linear or dynamic where you make key decisions.
• Meet a colorful cast of characters with their own secrets and motivations!
• Follow the story of the Gallos family from multiple characters’ perspectives.
• Enjoy vibrant and detailed visuals presented in hand-drawn style!

70010000085232.name: Medieval Fantasy: Jigsaw Puzzle
70010000085232.intro: A magical jigsaw puzzle that will immerse you in the atmosphere of medieval fantasy.
70010000085232.description:
The intuitive interface and relaxing music will create ideal conditions for you to focus on the exciting task of composing magnificent, colorful images in the style of medieval fantasy. You will find a variety of stories: from graceful ladies in luxurious outfits and brave warriors to majestic dragons, medieval castles and powerful wizards.

Drag and drop elements, combine them into groups or sort them by color - everything, just like in real life. Collect puzzles, opening increasingly complex images.

Features:
• Realistic imitation of assembling a real puzzle
• The ability to examine the image in detail after assembly
• Simple and exciting game mechanics
• Gradually increasing difficulty of puzzles
• Music conveying the atmosphere of the Middle Ages

70010000085237.name: Captain Blood
70010000085237.description:
Captain Blood is a pirate-themed action game set on the Spanish Main in the 17th century, where you step into the boots of a fearsome pirate on a quest for gold and glory. Expect wild adventures with cannon firing, pistol shooting, swashbuckling sword fights, and plenty of pirate shenanigans. This action-packed hack'n'slash features fierce hand-to-hand combat, hordes of enemies, and a classic fighting system with flashy combos and epic finishers.

Prepare for intense deck battles where you can fire the ship's cannons and fend off blood-thirsty boarding crews. Collect gold to upgrade your fighting skills, buy new weapons, and become the most feared buccaneer on the high seas. Fight for wealth and glory!

Epic Pirate Shenanigans 
As Captain Blood, live the life of the bravest and most fearsome pirate on the Spanish Main (or at least fake it convincingly).

Intense Action
Dive into fiery hand-to-hand combat and show enemy pirates and landlubbers alike who's the boss with various slick combat techniques.

Ship Deck Brawls
Fight off enemy pirates trying to board your ship with unique moves, combos, and executions while blasting enemy ships to pieces with your cannons!

Arsenal of Awesomeness: 
Arm yourself with cutlasses, pistols, muskets, throwing knives, and hand bombs. Don’t forget those sneaky pirate tricks!

Graphic Novel Vibes
Enjoy a unique art style that feels like you're flipping through a pirate comic book.

70010000085242.name: Tetris® Forever
70010000085242.intro: Celebrate 40 years of Tetris® with 15+ games, a new game, and documentary videos
70010000085242.description:
2025 BAFTA Games Awards Nominee - 'Game Beyond Entertainment'

• Celebrating 40 captivating years of Tetris®!
• Includes more than 15 playable classic Tetris games, and an all-new Tetris game – Tetris Time Warp.

Unrivaled after four decades, Tetris Forever celebrates the original, genre-inspiring puzzle game that escaped from behind the Iron Curtain, onto the world stage, and into our cultural consciousness!

More than 15 playable classic games from the series' history are featured, including many being released for the first time outside Japan. Battle your friends in the multiplayer cult favorite Tetris Battle Gaiden, create massive explosions to clear lines in Super Bombliss, and see where it all began in 1984 with an accurate recreation of the first version of Tetris on the Electronika 60 computer.

As the next release in Digital Eclipse's acclaimed Gold Master Series, Tetris Forever includes more than an hour of all-new documentary featurettes exploring the lifelong friendship and creative partnership between Tetris creator Alexey Pajitnov and The Tetris Company founder Henk Rogers, as they share the extraordinary but true story about Tetris that you never knew.

And as this celebration wouldn’t be complete without an all-new Tetris experience, prepare to enter the… Tetris Time Warp! Up to four players will "warp" between different eras of Tetris in real time to experience a variety of classic graphic styles and play mechanics! 

In a world where games come and go – Tetris is Forever!

70010000085247.name: Backrooms
70010000085247.intro: A journey chronicling 7 days... Can Terrence escape this liminar horror phenomenon? Or will he be trapped within this place forever?
70010000085247.description:
After having a normal day at the office, Terrence while traveling home inexplicably falls down to The Backrooms. A journey chronicling 7 days... Can Terrence escape this liminar horror phenomenon? Or will he be trapped within this place forever?

Backrooms is a horror adventure game where you explore the liminal space of the Backrooms while you interact with strange and creepy characters. Explore the Backrooms, find the unexpected as you go into impossible spaces and see things you shouldn't have seen. 

Backrooms brings the liminal horror phenomenon from obscure corners of the internet to console players looking for exploration based atmospheric horror from Puppet Combo.

Features: 

-Encounter strange and creepy characters with nefarious motives
-Low poly retro graphics
-Inspired by Japanese 1990s visual novels
-A big liminal space to explore.

70010000085257.name: LOST BALLOONS: Airy mates
70010000085257.intro: A challenging floating game that brings back memories of the days when you played with balloons!
70010000085257.description:
I inflated a balloon with air and released the mouth of the balloon, which I had blocked with my finger, and it flew away. I remember those days when I used to play like that, "If only I could fly freely in that sky..." This is a hard-action adventure game that should be played while holding on to the memories of those days of floating balloons with such thoughts in your mind.

It is relatively easy among the LOST series of KIMIDORI SOFT's high-difficulty platformers, and is recommended for first-time players.

Game goals:
The objective is to manipulate the balloons and use floating and moving to reach the cactus and crack it open in spectacular fashion. However, when levitating, you use the air filled in the balloon. When the air runs out, the game is over.

Feature:
Online multiplayer: there are quick matches and friend matches, both of which you can enter and leave at any time. In Quick Match, balloons from all over the world are going for the cactus at their own pace. In Friend Match, you can easily play only with specific friends by using a single keyword. Up to 10 players can play together. Of course, you can also play alone.

Continuation Flag: If you place a flag, you can revive from the flag location as many times as you want. Yes, as many times as you want.

Beautiful stages: We sincerely hope that you will relax and have adventures on the stages of our graceful world.

Collection Item: A floating balloon needs a party hat, right? The party hat is placed somewhere on the stage.

Growth system: The more you move, the more the maximum air volume of the balloon increases. (The amount of air you can float at one time does not increase.) Let's float more and more.

70010000085265.name: DORONKO WANKO
70010000085265.intro:
Be a playful pup and make a big mess at home!
"Will mom get mad at me?"
Don't worry — you're just a sweet little doggie!
70010000085265.description:
『DORONKO WANKO』 is a DORONKO Action Game.
In this game, you can become a cute, innocent pup and make a big mess inside the house.
Choose your favorite from six dog breeds — Pomeranian, Shiba-Inu, Bulldog, Toy Poodle, Jack Russell Terrier, and Corgi.
Let's explore this beautiful house and make it dirty and muddy at will!

◆ Rub! Splash! Muddy Action
A cute pup can get muddy by “rubbing” against the mud spread on the floor.
Then release it all with a “splash” and make the whole area muddy and messy!

◆ Sometimes you can find "hidden pome" when you are spreading mud all over the house.
When you find all the "hidden pome", the "Good Smell Room" 's door will open.
(Let's go inside quietly before others notice!)

◆ More mud, more damage!
You can check the total amount of damage you have caused from the ending “Receipt”.

◆ Dirty all and get plenty of gifts!
When you cause enough damage, you will receive a “gift”?!
They will help the pups’ exploration (and cuteness!)  by making it easier to splash mud and obtain key items.

70010000085272.name: Cats and Seek : Osaka
70010000085272.intro: Got some free time to spare? Come find 300+ cats in Osaka!
70010000085272.description:
A hidden object game with plenty of meowing loaves of joy to discover!

Look around – up, down, left, right… Because you’ll never know where you might find a friendly cat face :3

Features:
- 300+ cats to find
- Customizable game colours
- Three levels
- Two game modes – play normally or race against the clock!

70010000085287.name: Laika: Aged Through Blood
70010000085287.intro: Laika: Aged Through Blood is a thrilling action-adventure Metroidvania set in a dystopian, post-apocalyptic western world.
70010000085287.description:
Take on the role of Laika, a coyote mother and relentless warrior on a quest to avenge her fallen people from the tyrannical Birds, who have claimed superiority and conquered the land.

Fueled by vengeance, Laika rides out on her motorbike on a perilous and emotional journey. Carve and shred through rugged, hand-painted landscapes as you uncover the dark secrets of a fractured world ravaged by power, betrayal, and loss.

Engage in breakneck vehicular combat mechanics that demand precision, strategy, and skill. Utilize a variety of weapons, master close-range tactics, and unlock deadly abilities to defeat your enemies, upgrade your gear, and take back what your people have lost.

Key Features:
- Fast-paced 2D motorbike combat in the first ever “Motorvania”.
- Challenging gameplay that rewards precision and strategic thinking.
- Emotional and thought-provoking narrative about vengeance and loss.
- Striking hand-drawn landscapes teeming with danger and hidden secrets to explore.
- A hauntingly beautiful ambient soundtrack.

70010000085307.name: Flick Erasers Battle Royale
70010000085307.intro:
It's a classwide eraser battle!
Be the last one surviving!
Get ready for a battle royale right on your desk!
70010000085307.description:
Flick Erasers has become a battle royale!
Cross from desk to desk in a bid to survive!
Victory is within your grasp!!

[Battle]
Choose your favorite map and play alone or with friends!

[Online]
Connect with faraway friends from around the world in a battle royale!
Queue up for a Quick Match to increase your rating and victory count!

[Eraser Shop]
Accumulate points and collect over 100 eraser types!

[Mission]
Complete difficult challenges and earn special erasers!

70010000085312.name: Crash Puzzle Hammer-San
70010000085312.intro:
A full-fledged action puzzle game with simple controls!
A massive 300 stages!
Includes an edit feature to create your own stages!
70010000085312.description:
The basic controls are just the D-pad and A button.
A tutorial that teaches you how to play in 5 minutes is included.
Create your own stages with the edit feature, upload them, and let people from around the world play them.
You can also download and play stages created by other users.

70010000085317.name: MOTTAINAI GHOST
70010000085317.intro: Don't waste food! A horror-flavored, exploration adventure to escape the apartment from the MOTTAINAI GHOST.
70010000085317.description:
Standing in your way as you attempt to escape the apartment building is none other than "leftover food."
By eating leftovers, your stomach level increases, allowing you to consume even larger portions.
Efficiently raising your stomach level is the key to escape.

Can you escape this harsh apartment building alone?

[Game Features]
A ghost story rooted in Japanese culture:
With the theme of MOTTAINAI (a sense of regret over waste), this game reimagines Japanese folklore as modern horror.
Experience the fear that lurks just beyond daily life.

Exploration-based horror:
Investigate each room of the apartment, uncovering hidden items and notes that bring you closer to the truth.

Game Over if caught by the MOTTAINAI GHOST:
The MOTTAINAI GHOST roams the building.
Your actions will determine your fate.

For those who are sensitive to horror:
While it includes some light jump scares, there is no grotesque imagery or violent content.

Still, it delivers a gloomy and unsettling atmosphere true to the horror genre.

Recommended as a “beginner-friendly horror” for those curious but easily frightened, and safe for children—designed for solo play.

70010000085337.name: Infinite Seek and Find
70010000085337.intro: Customize your own hidden object experience - as easy or hard as you want it! Every game is different - combine over 30 different rules or use one of the 3 preset difficulty levels.
70010000085337.description:
Welcome to your ultimate hidden object challenge. Infinite Seek and Find offers a wide selection of image sets and customizable difficulty level - from basic level where only the size matters to the most hardcore challenge, where the colors can trick you.

- Over 10 image sets with different themes
- 3 preset difficulty modes and a possibility to set your own custom difficulty
- Images differing by size, rotation, reflection, and colors

70010000085354.name: Dokyusei: Bangin' Summer™ - Home Edition
70010000085354.intro: It’s the ’90s. Summer’s back! Dōkyūsei: Bangin’ Summer brings the heat—a Japanese adventure classic, all decked out in HD graphics.
70010000085354.description:
With mere months left before graduation, one young man has got a plan. He's spent the first half of his summer making bank, and now he's out to break it—and break some hearts in the bargain!

But over the course of just three weeks, you'll come to love and understand these girls and pick one to be with in this comedic coming-of-age drama.

Dōkyūsei is a seminal classic of the dating sim genre that first blew Japan's mind in 1992.
This updated remake adds HD art, optional modern features, and for the first time ever, a global release.

Features
Classic dating sim gameplay
Modern quality-of-life features
More than a dozen eligible babes to romance

70010000085358.name: MFC - Midnight Fight Club
70010000085358.intro: Step into the ring and prepare for the ultimate fighting experience!
70010000085358.description:
MFC - Midnight Fight Club brings the raw intensity and excitement of professional mixed martial arts fighting right to your fingertips. With unparalleled graphics, a diverse roster of fighters, and realistic physics, this is the fighting game you've been waiting for.
 Features:
         Dynamic Combat System
Choose from two types of attacks—weak and heavy—to outwit your opponents. Nail the timing, and you could land a devastating blow. But be careful, timing is everything!
         Defensive Maneuvers
Tired of button mashing? Our game rewards strategic fighting. Block incoming attacks, dodge out of the way, or use your custom stats to outclass your opponent.
         Stun Mechanism
Land a special combo to stun your opponent. A stunned enemy can't defend or counterattack, giving you a precious window to unleash your most powerful moves.
         League Progression
Begin your career in the Rookie Rumble and fight your way through 10 challenging leagues, each more difficult than the last. Do you have what it takes to conquer the Ultimate Titan League?
          Epic Boss Fights
Each league culminates in an epic boss battle. These bosses are not your typical fighters; they have unique abilities and patterns. Strategy is key!
          Customizable Characters
Personalize your fighter's stats—Speed, Health, Stamina, Power, and Defense—to match your fighting style. Adapt and evolve to climb the ranks.
        AI That Challenges You
Our AI learns from your fighting style. It dodges, blocks, and counterattacks like a pro. Adapt your strategy to conquer challenging opponents.


Why You'll Love MFC - Midnight Fight Club:
• Realistic Physics: Experience lifelike combat with our state-of-the-art physics engine.
• High-End Graphics: Our top-notch graphics make every punch, kick, and block feel incredibly real.
• Player Rewards: Earn rewards as you progress through leagues.

70010000085363.name: Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business
70010000085363.intro: From Tiny Store to Retail Empire Build Your Supermarket Dream
70010000085363.description:
Welcome to Supermarket Simulator: Business, the ultimate supermarket management experience! Step into the shoes of a budding supermarket manager and embark on an exciting journey to build and manage your supermarket empire. Your adventure begins with the opportunity to design and customize your supermarket from the ground up. From choosing the perfect layout to picking the products that will fly off the shelves, every decision you make will shape the success of your store.

Features:
	•	- Design & Customization: Craft your dream supermarket! Choose the layout, personalize the shopping experience, and decide what products to stock.
	•	- In-Depth Management: Oversee every aspect of your supermarket's operation. From keeping shelves stocked and managing inventory to supervising staff and ensuring customer satisfaction, you're in control.
	•	- Inventory Mastery: Master the art of inventory management. Predict customer demand, adjust your orders accordingly, and avoid empty shelves that hurt your bottom line.
	•	- Competitive Landscape: Navigate the competitive world of retail. Outsmart your rivals, adapt your strategies, and stay ahead of the curve.
	•	- Market Savvy: Be prepared to adapt to changing consumer trends. Adjust your product selection and promotions to cater to what customers crave.
	•	- Expansion Opportunities: Grow your initial supermarket into a thriving chain. Expand your reach, introduce new product lines, and watch your profits soar.
	•	- Marketing Campaigns: Invest in strategic marketing campaigns to attract new customers, boost brand loyalty, and build a loyal following.

Supermarket Simulator: Business offers a challenging and rewarding experience that will test your business skills and supermarket know-how. Are you ready to build a grocery empire?

70010000085371.name: Ein's Sword3
70010000085371.intro: Collect the particles of light and move on
70010000085371.description:
During the reign of Sword Saint, Ein, a sword collector, and Sola, a sword spirit, travel in search of legendary swords.
Along the way, guided by a mysterious voice, the two search for particles of light.

You can move two characters at the same time, or one by one, to overcome hills and steep paths and defeat monsters.
It is a 3D action game where you progress while listening to the voice of the character.

70010000085373.name: Resope!
70010000085373.intro: Rescue the sushi stuck in the wall! A full-fledged puzzle game that requires a lot of careful thought.  All you have to do is ignite the blocks.
70010000085373.description:
Once a block is ignited, fire spreads quickly, burning and destroying the surrounding blocks. 
Blocks and sushi will then fall into the burnt-out space from above.

Your mission is to make the most of this basic rule, making the sushi fall to the bottom to rescue them.

Along the way, you'll also need to make use of meticulous strategies, such as detonating bombs to destroy walls in one fell swoop or creating and using items to control your firepower.

Rescue the sushi in succession to form combos and get a large number of points!

This is a casual, easy-to-play game that allows you to enjoy a sense of accomplishment and exercise your mind to just the right degree.

There are 10 kinds of sushi in total. Clear all 11 levels to collect them.

In addition to the standard single-player mode, the game also includes a timer mode with a time limit and a VS mode that allows two players to compete against each other offline.

70010000085379.name: Chase
70010000085379.description:
You are being hunted! Escape the chase!

Take out the chasing crowds and make it to the safe house

Enjoy immersive gameplay and stylish graphics in this addictive shooter

70010000085381.name: Final Zone
70010000085381.intro: Memory of the God of War...
70010000085381.description:
In the future of the 2000’s, war is no longer fought with missiles weapons or nuclear bombs. With the high technology of militarysatellite, enable to monitor any large scaled forces. It was the beginning of new ear of small scaled land warfare weapons. At that time, new weapon called NAP (New Age Powered-Suits) was unveiled. 
	
Howard Bowie, the soldier of the El Sharia Military Nation's foreign legion was received an order.

Now, go to the battlefield to fulfill the mission even though it would be like a death sentence…

Features:
* 7 different stages full of action
* Fight against powerful bosses that will push your combat skills to the limit
* Use a wide variety of weapons that allow for many different attack strategies
* Gallery: view images from the original game’s illustrations, posters, box design, etc.
* Jukebox: listen to any of the game music tracks any time you want.
* Rewind/Turbo function: repeat something until you achieve perfection, or speed things up
* Cheats function: activate cheats that will make your mission a lot easier (infinite lives, invulnerability, etc.)
* Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point
* Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.)

* This game is re-release of “Final Zone” which the first launched in 1990s for home consoles.

70010000085383.name: Keeper's Toll
70010000085383.intro: An action-packed roguelite brimming with challenge and despair. Survive against an onslaught of relentless hordes and grueling bosses with skill-based ARPG gameplay.
70010000085383.description:
Arise, fallen hero! Enter Keeper's Toll, an action-packed roguelite set within a retro-infused dark fantasy world that demands skill and courage. Every moment could be your last, but with each setback, you grow stronger. Seize the challenge, overcome daunting foes, and purge a callous world through a methodical genre-bending experience.

Keeper’s Toll places a heavy focus on slow-paced, skill-based gameplay with ARPG elements. Each run allows you to study your enemies and hone your skills while progressing through the main quest. Once you have mastered the basics, Keeper’s Toll introduces unique enemy archetypes, intricate bosses, and fresh mechanics that will challenge any worthy hero.

Keeper's Toll features 6 unique risen heroes: the Shadow Monk, Pyromancer, Blood Maiden, Necromancer, Ranger, and Bogatyr. Each hero has their own specialized game-defining mechanics, as well as completely unique abilities and progression trees.

Ferocious bosses and cutthroat invaders lie at the heart of Keeper’s Toll and its perilous lands. All of the bosses, mini bosses, and invaders you will encounter feature their own unique battle mechanics and twists on the core gameplay. Overcoming the bosses requires a keen sense of strategy, so strengthen your character with purpose or suffer a swift end to your journey.

Key Features:
- Unique genre blend between horde survival and ARPG with a touch of souls-like
- Skill-based gameplay designed to be approached methodically
- Custom character classes featuring their own progression trees, unique abilities and playstyles
- Destructive boss encounters with intricate designs, mechanics, and gameplay twists

70010000085385.name: STAR RUSH -STACK & JUMP-
70010000085385.intro: Just stack boxes, jump, and collect stars! Easy, right?
70010000085385.description:
Simple yet challenging! A hectic side-scrolling action game!  
Use boxes and bubbles skillfully to overcome obstacles!  

▼ **How to Play**  
Can’t reach certain spots or dangerous spikes? Stack boxes to get past them.  
You can also use bubbles to jump far and high! Switch between them wisely.  
The key is quick decision-making and perfect timing to place the boxes!  
How many stars can you collect? Aim to become the ultimate Star Collector Master!  

Grand Prize Winners of Edia x Springin "Your work may be playable on a game console! Game Development Contest"

70010000085390.name: InorStreet
70010000085390.intro: A short shooting RPG where you destroy non-aggressive enemies called "Inorganic"
70010000085390.description:
In a certain world, "inorganic" suddenly started appearing everywhere, causing trouble for the residents.  
Embark on a journey through this world while helping to destroy the inorganic.  

**InorStreet** is a short shooting RPG that incorporates physics-based mechanics.  
Although the inorganic don't attack, they reflect your shots back at you. Skillfully dodge or time your attacks to avoid the reflections and take them down!

Grand Prize Winners of Edia x Springin "Your work may be playable on a game console! Game Development Contest"

70010000085408.name: Hentai Paradise Vol. 2
70010000085408.intro: Discover the charming and naughty girls in Hentai Paradise.
70010000085408.description:
Dive into stunning anime art and solve puzzles to enjoy images of lovely girls posing exclusively for you! The visual component of the game is designed in such a way as to convey the feeling of assembling a real puzzle as much as possible. As the difficulty level increases, the images become more piquant. Take your time, enjoy the process and collect all the puzzles.

Features:
• Puzzles with images of lovely girls in seductive outfits
• Simple and addictive game mechanics
• Increasing puzzle difficulty
• Relaxing and atmospheric music

70010000085412.name: Gallop Glory: Obstacle Racing & Horse Simulator
70010000085412.intro: Ride, Bond, Conquer Your equestrian adventure awaits.
70010000085412.description:
Get ready to immerse yourself in the exhilarating world of equestrian sports with "Gallop Glory: Obstacle Racing & Horse Simulator." Experience the thrill of riding majestic horses and compete in thrilling obstacle races in this captivating horse simulation game. Are you prepared to embark on a journey to become the ultimate equestrian champion?

Game features:
1. Master Horse Riding: Conquer courses, forge bonds with unique horses, and win with precision, speed, and agility.
2. Explore Diverse Disciplines: From show jumping to cross-country races, test your skills in thrilling competitions against AI or friends. Train your horses to excel and unlock new challenges!
3. Build Your Dream Stable: Design the perfect environment with spacious pastures, cozy stables, and advanced training facilities. Care for your horses and watch them thrive under your care.
4. Unravel a Captivating Story: Embark on a journey to uncover equestrian secrets, forge connections with your horses, and immerse yourself in stunning environments with memorable characters.
5. Overcome Challenges and Achieve Greatness: Navigate treacherous terrain, overcome obstacles, and outmaneuver rivals to claim victory and earn prestigious awards. Rise to the top in the world of equestrian sports!

70010000085417.name: Hentai Paradise Vol. 3
70010000085417.intro: Discover the charming and naughty girls in Hentai Paradise.
70010000085417.description:
Dive into stunning anime art and solve puzzles to enjoy images of lovely girls posing exclusively for you! The visual component of the game is designed in such a way as to convey the feeling of assembling a real puzzle as much as possible. As the difficulty level increases, the images become more piquant. Take your time, enjoy the process and collect all the puzzles.

Features:
• Puzzles with images of lovely girls in seductive outfits
• Simple and addictive game mechanics
• Increasing puzzle difficulty
• Relaxing and atmospheric music

70010000085421.name: Theme Park Jam
70010000085421.intro: Match 3 and ride the roller coaster
70010000085421.description:
Sort the queue of theme park customers by matching their colour to the ride. 

Fill the roller coaster let them have some fun!

Unlock new rides and features as you pass each stage.

A fun addictive puzzle game with a fun colorful theme.

70010000085423.name: Marble Flow
70010000085423.intro: Solve the puzzle and make the marbles flow
70010000085423.description:
A fun simple puzzle game for all ages.
Rotate the track sections to create a path.
Release the marbles and watch them flow.
Enjoy stylish graphics in this relaxing puzzler.

70010000085428.name: MR. ELEVATOR
70010000085428.intro:
"I am Mr. Elevator. Are you looking for something?"
Guided by a talking elevator, the door to a mysterious world of riddles opens...
70010000085428.description:
This is an adventure game where five protagonists—men and women who boarded the enigmatic talking elevator, "Mr. Elevator"—solve puzzles in a mysterious otherworld they are lost in, searching for what each of them seeks.

Freely explore the unique world, drawn in the style of early Windows Paint software, and thoroughly enjoy the puzzles that appear before you.

70010000085445.name: MIYAMOTO
70010000085445.intro:
Open the board game, place your pieces, and get ready!
A casual deck-building x Japanese-themed card game!
70010000085445.description:
MIYAMOTO is a beautifully styled Japanese-themed card game. Build your deck with cards earned after each battle, and strategically place unique pieces to claim victory.

Masters like Yoichi, Hanzo, and the Yakuza can be unlocked by collecting battle coins. Pick from a randomly dealt hand and build your deck for each battle. Use your pieces' abilities wisely, such as the Kabuki, who can attack two spaces, the Shiba Inu, who buffs nearby allies, and the Princess, whose power grows with the number of allies.

Construct a powerful deck and defeat Miyamoto, who awaits at the final challenge!

70010000085450.name: KAMITSUBAKI CITY REGENERATE
70010000085450.intro: Answer the summons to the parallel world of "Kamitsubaki City" and meet a cast of colorful characters as you set out on a quest to save this city from the brink
70010000085450.description:
In a world parallel to our own resides the city of Kamitsubaki.

One day, the player, an "Observer," is summoned to this ill-fated world.

There, they meet a girl named Kafu, and set out on a quest with her to save the world from its impending doom.



—Features

"KAMITSUBAKI CITY REGENERATE" is a dark-fantasy science fiction visual novel taking place in "Kamitsubaki City."

The city is brought to life with stunning illustrations and fully-voiced characters, each with their own unique sprites.

The game possesses the most extensive story in the series that cuts straight to the heart of Kamitsubaki City, featuring numerous popular songs from Kamitsubaki's vocal artists that link to the plot and expand the scale of the world's lore.



The player's choices in Kamitsubaki City weave the story in vastly different directions.

Observe the tale unfold as you harmonize with the characters and music and bear witness to the city's ultimate fate.



*This game and "KAMITSUBAKI CITY VIRTUAL REALITY" share the same basic story. Furthermore, the story is standalone, meaning those unfamiliar with the series can play these games with no worries.



—What is the "Kamitsubaki City Under Construction." series?

An original IP project by KAMITSUBAKI STUDIO in development since 2019.

One of multiple story projects whose lore is linked to the studio's vocal artists, starting with tales centered around the parallel world of Kamitsubaki City.



—Cast

Kafu Morisaki: KAF

Rime Tanioki: RIM

Haru Asanushi: Harusaruhi

Sekai Yorukawa: Isekaijoucho

Koko Rinne: KOKO

70010000085455.name: Star Galaxy Academy: Princess Legacy
70010000085455.intro: In a distant galaxy, a young alien named Lira is accepted into the prestigious Star Academy. Lira and her friends must join forces to protect their school and peace in the galaxy.
70010000085455.description:
Immerse yourself in the exciting world of "Star Galaxy Academy: Princess Legacy ", a visual novel that will transport you to a distant galaxy and involve you in a story full of mystery, friendship and heroism.

In a remote galaxy, Lira, a young alien with exceptional talent, receives an acceptance letter to attend the prestigious Stellar Academy. This institution is known for bringing together the brightest minds and bravest warriors from across the galaxy, where advanced sciences, sublime arts, and space combat tactics are taught.

As Lira adjusts to her new life at the Academy, she forms an inseparable group of friends who share her aspirations and dreams. However, the harmony of the school and the peace of the galaxy are threatened when they discover a sinister plot that aims to wreak havoc across the known universe.

Characteristics
·Impressive graphics: Immerse yourself in a visually dazzling universe with full-color images.
·Immersive narrative: Enjoy a story rich in details, with unexpected twists and memorable characters.
·Epic soundtrack: Immersive music that will accompany you in every moment of the adventure.

Are you ready to join the Star Academy and be part of this epic adventure?

70010000085461.name: Kemono Heroes
70010000085461.intro: Run and gun fast arcade action with dashes and slashes and fluffy characters
70010000085461.description:
Kemono Heroes combines elements of run and gun, fast arcade action with dashes and slashes, with cool and fluffy characters. It can be experienced alone, choosing between 3 difficulties to enjoy a real challenge. Up to 4 friends can also join forces in cooperative mode, fighting and helping each other to overcome any obstacles in their way.


Features:
 - Run 'n Slash 'n Gun.
 - Local cooperative 1-4 players.
 - Amazing 16 bit graphics.
 - 4 main characters, each of them with special skills.
 - 4 worlds with 3 stages each.
 - Unlockable weapons and powers.
 - Lots of fun and action!

70010000085469.name: Montezuma's Revenge - The 40th Anniversary Edition
70010000085469.intro: Experience a timeless classic adventure now fully evolved and complete for the first time!
70010000085469.description:
The 1983 classic multi-room platformer Montezuma’s Revenge returns in 2.5D glory, and now Pedro’s adventure is bigger than ever with 100 tricky rooms to explore! For its 40th anniversary, what was once an unfinished game is now resurrected to match the full vision of creator Robert Jaeger. This time you can choose between male and female explorers, Pedro or his sister Rosita, to delve deep into the dangerous ruins and hunt for treasures untold!

Montezuma’s Revenge: The 40th Anniversary Edition is remade from the ground up with vibrant 3D visuals while preserving the 1983 original’s 2D gameplay style. Run, jump and climb your way through tricky chambers to collect valuable artifacts, avoid perilous traps and fiendish enemies, find keys to progress and survive a final showdown to escape with your riches… and your life!

• Choose between adventurous male and female protagonists!
• Explore 100 tricky chambers filled with traps, treasures and roving baddies.
• Collect valuable artifacts as you solve the ruins’ many mysteries!
• Enjoy retro aesthetics reimagined in vibrant 2.5D style.
• Relive a timeless video game classic in its most complete form ever!

70010000085474.name: EGGCONSOLE UNDEADLINE MSX2
70010000085474.intro: A fantasy-themed action shooting game with a high level of difficulty, but it's a well-crafted title that offers a satisfying and challenging experience.
70010000085474.description:
This is a vertical-scrolling action shooting game released in Japan by T&E SOFT in 1989.

The story is set in the Kingdom of Zidane, where the forces of the underworld have advanced to the castle gates after continuous victories. Three young heroes rise up and embark on a journey to reclaim the "Spirit of Roshufa."

Players can choose and tackle any of the six stages in any order. The objective is to clear all the stages, unlock the final stage, and defeat the final boss.


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000085477.name: Supermarket Manager 2024
70010000085477.intro: Can you transform your modest store into a thriving retail giant?
70010000085477.description:
Step into the shoes of a supermarket owner in Supermarket Manager 2024, a dynamic 3D supermarket simulator where your business acumen will be put to the test! As the proud proprietor, your goal is to grow your supermarket empire by making smart purchasing decisions and optimizing your sales strategies.

Key Features:
Business Growth: Purchase a variety of products from different providers and strategically price them to attract more customers and maximize profits.

Financial Management: Handle transactions with ease as customers pay with cash or credit cards. Use your earnings to invest back into your supermarket.

Upgrades and Expansion: Reinvent your supermarket with upgrades and expansions. Enhance your store's layout, stock more products, and improve customer satisfaction to become the leading supermarket in town.

Strategic Gameplay: Balance supply and demand, manage stock levels, and respond to customer preferences to keep your business thriving.

Immersive 3D Environment: Experience the bustling atmosphere of a supermarket with stunning 3D graphics and detailed animations.

Can you transform your modest store into a thriving retail giant? Find out in Supermarket Manager 2024, where every decision counts towards building your supermarket success story!

70010000085483.name: Supermarket Manager Empire 2024
70010000085483.intro: Are you ready to create your retail empire?
70010000085483.description:
Dive into the fast-paced world of retail with Supermarket Manager Empire 2024, an exciting and immersive 3D market simulation game. As the ambitious owner of a supermarket, your goal is to elevate your modest store into a sprawling retail empire!

In this vibrant and cartoon-styled adventure, you have complete control to upgrade and customize every element of your supermarket. Expand your aisles, enhance your product displays, and curate a wide array of goods to keep your customers delighted and your profits climbing. From fresh produce to cutting-edge electronics, the selection is vast, and the decisions are yours.

Key Features:

Comprehensive Upgrades: Continuously enhance your supermarket with powerful upgrades that draw in more customers and increase your revenue.

Extensive Product Variety: Stock and sell an extensive range of products, each offering unique appeal and profitability.

Charming Visuals: Immerse yourself in a whimsical, cartoon-styled world that makes managing your supermarket both fun and visually captivating.

Strategic Gameplay: Make smart business decisions, effectively manage your finances, and outmaneuver competitors to build the ultimate retail empire.

Whether you're a strategic thinker or simply love the energy of a busy marketplace, Supermarket Manager Empire 2024 provides endless hours of engaging gameplay. Are you ready to create your retail empire?

70010000085489.name: CAFE 0 ~The Sleeping Beast~ REMASTERED
70010000085489.intro: A mystery where past and present intertwine. What fate awaits at the end of the truth?
70010000085489.description:
◆STORY
・The Present
The story starts in a village with an atmosphere akin to Europe in the 19th century.
There is a big noble villa where Corliss Green is working.

One day she wakes up and finds herself in front of a weird café.

Noir, the waiter, tells her that she has already died, but failed to go to heaven and, as a lost spirit, she ended up at the entrance to Café 0.
He later gave Corliss a chance to return to a week before she died.
But does she really need to go to heaven?

And what is the truth behind her untimely death?

・The Past
Sophie Evans works as a midwife.
She is a cheerful woman and everybody likes her.

What is her relation to the missing incident 15 years ago?

◆FEATURES
- Captivating Japanese voice acting.
- Your decisions shape the narrative, leading to multiple endings: 4 main routes, 2 true finales, and 2 bad outcomes.
- Day Selection feature is added to start the game from the chapter you want.
- Experience the interwoven mysteries of the Present and Past arcs.
- Beautifully hand-drawn anime art and animated effects that enhances the game's atmosphere.
- Original theme song and BGMs.
- Witness the transformation of the main character from an emotionless doll to a fully realized human being.

◆CAST
Corliss - Ayano
Nathan - Mayuki Sawae
Ethan - Tarou Yamada
Barclay - Nyoibou 
Noir - Shinya
Sophie - Aonoi
Ed - Kyou Tsukikage
Eva/Emma - Remi Tamaki
MOB - Aonoi, Ayano, Kon, Kouto Saionji, Shiwasun, Komugi Tachibana, Hiko Morikawa, Nyoibou

70010000085495.name: Helix Fruit Jump
70010000085495.intro: Helix Fruit Jump is a casual arcade game where you control a ball that bounces through a platform made of fruit and cake slices.
70010000085495.description: The goal is to reach the bottom of the platform without falling into the gaps or touching the blue areas.

70010000085507.name: Lone Fungus
70010000085507.intro: A handcrafted Metroidvania in an open world built by mushrooms!
70010000085507.description:
Lone Fungus is a true Metroidvania set in a world built by mushrooms where you play as the last mushroom alive. Explore an ancient world, acquire new abilities and discover secrets!

Explore ten distinct areas, each with its own unique set of challenges. Uncover secrets and well deserved rewards in the form of Relics, Emblems and Upgrades. You will need all the attacks skills, Emblem powers and magic you can get your fungi hands on as you fight and parry your way through tons of enemies including 33 boss fights!

Features 
• Explore a huge interconnected world gated with true Metroidvania progression.
• Fast and responsive combat, play as an acrobatic mushroom!
• A spell system based on how you strike spells with your sword, giving spells multiple uses and a creative approach to combat.
• Unique and challenging platforming gameplay reminiscent of modern platformers but set in a fully open world. 
• Play the game how you want! Pick between four difficulty modes or use the accessible Assist Mode!

70010000085515.name: Wizard of Legend 2
70010000085515.description:
In an age of myth and magic, ambitious wizards from around the world have assembled to undertake the perilous Trials of Legend in the Floating Lands. Many will try. Most will fail. Only those who have truly mastered the chaotic, shifting elemental forces of Arcana will become a Wizard of Legend!

Prepare to face an all-new series of unpredictably perilous trials in Wizard of Legend 2—the action-packed follow-up to the acclaimed dungeon-delving original, featuring vibrant new 3D visuals and fast-paced 4-player online co-op. Wield familiar and new Arcana, experiment with devious new spell combinations, and seek immortality as you return again and again (and again) to master ever-changing rogue-lite challenges.

Journey Back to an Era of Legendary Trials

Put your spellcraft skills to the test in the Floating Lands—a shifting sorcerous gauntlet conjured forth by Hieronymus, Lanova’s wizard supreme to find a wizard worthy of legend. Get to know the peculiar and powerful members of the wizarding council as they oversee, guide, or throw a twist into your trials.

Unleash your Arcana

Harness the power of familiar and new Arcana—attacks that tame the land’s magical chaotic forces into the form of fiery projectiles, magical melee strikes, swirling tempests, and more. Discover powers during your trial that change your Arcana (and your play) in unexpected ways. Mix, match, experiment, and master your favorite combinations…until you find a new favorite on your next run.

Master the Elements

Command the raw aspects of fire, water, earth, lightning, air, and chaos. Upgrade your Arcana and equip fortune-changing Relics, adding new layers of possibility and potential. Focus on the raw damage of fire or the unbreakability of earth. Move quicker, sling Arcana faster, or seek balance as each trial demands.

Persevere and prevail

Each treacherous trial is unlike the last, and the odds are not in your favor. Learn from your predecessors’ failures through a persistent rogue-lite progression system that grants more arcane options to your next initiate. Each trial takes you one step closer to becoming the Wizard of Legend!

70010000085520.name: Argol - Kronoss' Castle
70010000085520.intro: Platformer action game, mixing gothic and mythological atmospheres.
70010000085520.description: Argol - Kronoss' Castle is a platformer action game largely inspired by 90s hits. Between gothic universe and mythological legends, it is decorated as it deserves with a rich and epic soundtrack to make you live an adventure in the purest arcade style.

70010000085535.name: Before Exit: Supermarket
70010000085535.intro: Before Exit: Supermarket combines features from roguelike with walking simulator
70010000085535.description:
In Before Exit: Supermarket, as a supermarket employee, your job is to close the store at night. With everyone gone, your supervisor has given you the responsibility to lock up. Can you handle it? 

The game combines roguelike features with logical riddles and a walking simulator genre to create a unique experience. Play day by day to find all the assignments, and remember every task before coming back home.

Make sure you turn off all the lights, close all the refrigerators, and clean the questionably clean floor. But wait - is that expired yogurt? Is one letter in a neon sign not lit? Did someone leave a piece of paper behind the store counter?

Your boss is extremely strict, so if even one condition is not met, you will face the harsh reality of being fired. The pressure is on. Can you handle it? The fate of your virtual job is in your hands.

70010000085542.name: 3 Minutes to Midnight®
70010000085542.intro: In a race against time, Betty embarks on a thrilling, comedy-packed adventure to crack a conspiracy that starts with a bang and ends at 3 Minutes to Midnight.
70010000085542.description:
Somewhere, in the middle of nowhere, an explosion shatters the night. Everyone wakes up with a jolt. Where are they? Who are they? It turns out that whatever blew up in the desert seems to have done more than just wipe their memories clean.

Embark on an adventure with Betty as she delves into a town where danger lurks at every turn, and characters are as deceiving and bizarre as they come, featuring a power-hungry mayor, a potbelly pig with a vendetta, a sheriff obsessed with the supernatural, and believe it or not, a kraken who doesn’t read fine print.

Oh, and there’s also this itsy-bitsy thing about a doomsday plot to eradicate everyone’s very existence. But hey, let’s worry about that later, shall we?

Key Features:

• Classic Adventure Gameplay: Immerse yourself in a timeless point-and-click adventure game paired with striking HD cartoon art and playful humor.

• Two Perspectives, One Mystery: Join forces with Betty Anderson and Mayor Eliza Barret—two characters with contrasting traits—as they piece together a mystery that holds more than meets the eye.

• Not Just Neighbors: In a town where strangers and secrets intertwine, navigate a dense web of deceit to unravel a catastrophic scheme that binds them all.

• Puzzles up the Wazoo: Put on your thinking cap, because 3 Minutes to Midnight will keep your brain working on overclock! With a multitude of unique objects at your disposal, you’ll crack every puzzle that stands in your way.

• Different Solutions: A puzzle-packed adventure where every twist and turn shapes your journey. Think outside the box because there might be more than one way to connect the dots.

• Multiple Endings: Experience the consequences of your actions. Every choice you make carves your path through intricate branching narratives, leading you to an ending as unique as your journey. 

• The Journey Never Ends: Each replay is a gateway to uncovering thrilling mysteries, hidden Easter eggs and references, and even the possibility of encountering new characters.

• Hear the Adventure: With complete English voiceovers, each character vividly comes to life, enriching the 1940s setting and taking the story to new heights.

3 Minutes to Midnight pays homage to the golden era of gaming while forging its own path with innovative gameplay and storytelling. Whether you're a fan of brain-teasing puzzles, compelling narratives, or just a good laugh, this game is your ticket to an unforgettable experience.

70010000085547.name: Miniatures
70010000085547.intro: Miniatures is a collection of four strange tales. Explore a vast seascape, build odd furniture, feed a lizard and play with sand castles.
70010000085547.description:
Inside an old wooden box lies four curious items: a toy lizard, a captured moth, a screwdriver and a seashell. Each one has its own story to tell…

Step into four hand-drawn memories and discover the mysteries lurking beneath the seemingly calm surface. Explore one story at a time, or play them in a single sitting, in this solo-play adventure about the stories we tell ourselves and how they shape our world. 

Average playtime is 45 minutes.

Each story has a distinct gameplay and art style and can be played in any order:

* Familiar: Experience the challenges of a family assembling a flat-pack cabinet.
* The Paludarium: Immerse yourself in a world where a boy, home alone, navigates nature's invasion.
* The Last Sand Castle: Interact with the music-loving inhabitants of a sand castle.
* The House of the Moon: Join Alma on a journey as she searches for her lost mother in a mysterious seascape.

70010000085554.name: The Little Mermaid: Ariel and the Star Festival
70010000085554.intro: In this new adventure, Ariel must activate the Star Festival with the help of her friends, while Morgana tries to stop them. A story full of magic, friendship and challenges under the sea!
70010000085554.description:
In this exciting new adventure, Ariel returns to her ocean friends for a crucial mission: activate the legendary Star Festival. This magical event, which occurs once every century, is vital to maintaining balance and harmony in the underwater kingdom. To achieve this, Ariel has the help of the guardian mermaids, a group of mystical protectors in charge of guarding the secrets of the festival.

The battle for the future of the ocean is about to begin, and only together can they ensure that the Star Festival shines once again, lighting the seas with hope and magic.

■ 130 full-color backgrounds: Enjoy a rich visual palette with 130 unique and vibrant backgrounds, designed to fully immerse you in every scene.

■ 10 unique and endearing characters. Ariel and her friends, but also Morgana and her henchmen.

■ Soundtrack with 20 exceptional songs: Live the adventure with an immersive soundtrack, composed of 20 musical pieces that capture the essence of underwater worlds.

■ A new story of The Little Mermaid: Immerse yourself in a fresh and original narrative, continuing the adventures of Ariel.

70010000085556.name: Cooking
70010000085556.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70010000085556.description:
Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes and traditional drinks. Take orders, prepare meals, decorate your restaurant and develop your cooking skills each day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your restaurant in Cooking. After each order you will earn enough money to either upgrade your equipment or purchase new decorations. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.


Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Mix ingredients with passion and follow each step with maximum precision to become a master of Cooking!


KEY FEATURES:
- Upgrades that will help you prepare meals faster
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out 
- Many decorations to choose from!
- Step-by-step recipes
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea

70010000085561.name: The Super Robot Bros
70010000085561.intro: Learn about this inspiring story of hope and the power of effort to revive a lost world. Join ECHO on their journey to discover if the Earth can be saved and if humanity can return home.
70010000085561.description:
In this visual novel, a future where Earth has been abandoned by humanity due to climate disasters and social collapse, ECHO, an autonomous robot, continues the mission to clean up and preserve the remains of human civilization. For centuries, ECHO has worked tirelessly in a desolate landscape, holding out hope that one day humans will return.

One day, ECHO discovers an unexpected sign of life in the form of a small plant growing among the rubble. This discovery awakens in him a renewed sense of purpose and hope.

With determination and courage, ECHO embarks on a mission that could change the fate of the Earth forever.

70010000085568.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Jeju Island-1
70010000085568.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage! You can enjoy the actual beautiful natural scenery in high definition
70010000085568.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage captured by an actual flying drone.
There is no up, down, left, or right direction manipulation, only manipulation to speed up/slow down the drone's speed.

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Jeju Island, Korea, in a ""Real"" video!
This production takes place on Jeju Island, Korea's largest island.
There are 6 flight courses, and the total operating time for all courses is more than 30 minutes.
