1080P high-definition video faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real life and provides a strong sense of immersion in the game.
You can feel like you are a real drone pilot with smooth, realistic video playback.
Huge volume! You can fly to 6 locations showing the beautiful scenery of Jeju Island!
Two play modes are supported: section-by-section driving mode and view mode driving.
Visit Korea’s Jeju Island anytime from home! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience as well as the scenery of Korea's Jeju Island region.

70010000085576.name: Cabernet
70010000085576.intro: Cabernet is a 2D narrative RPG set in a 19th century Eastern European inspired world, with a modern twist. Guide Liza, a young vampire in her new unlife among the unsuspecting town.
70010000085576.description:
Cabernet is a 2D narrative RPG set in a 19th century Eastern European inspired world, with a modern twist. Guide Liza, a young vampire struggling with her morality and the supernatural world she has been pulled into. Will you retain your humanity or descend further into the horror you have become? Prepare to explore a hidden world of political intrigue, class conflict, and decadent corruption.

Use the moonlit sky to plan your next feast and explore. Mingle among vampiric society and the humans who feed them. Uncover who can aid your new kin and whose only purpose is to be drained.  

Vampirism isn't just an unholy transformation of your body-- it also threatens to transform your mind. Will you choose to indulge your empathetic humanity or embrace your newfound nihilism?

But to lure your next meal somewhere safe and secluded, you'll need to understand who they are and what they desire. A kind-hearted, alcoholic coachman? A fraying newlywed couple? A greedy, yet charming charlatan? Their lives are yours to aid or unravel.

Art, literature, history, science, these are the skills you'll require to succeed. Your knowledge will be your greatest weapon in a world where the cunning drain the brutal of life.

70010000085581.name: Run & Jump Guy
70010000085581.intro: Embark on an epic pixelated adventure in "Run & Jump Guy," a classic platformer featuring three unique locations: Island, Snowy Forest, and Castle.
70010000085581.description: Embark on an epic pixelated adventure in "Run & Jump Guy," a classic platformer featuring three unique locations: Island, Snowy Forest, and Castle. Face diverse enemies and conquer challenging obstacles as you journey through each level. Prepare for an epic showdown against a formidable boss awaiting at the end.

70010000085595.name: Idle Devils
70010000085595.intro: Summon your devils to form the ultimate devil squad! Watch your power grow every moment, even when you're away! Are you ready to become the new Devil King?
70010000085595.description:
Game Features:
+ 10 characters, 220 skills, 180 talents, over 400 equipments, and more than 200 equipment affixes. Plus, endless stage challenges that never stop!

+ Idle Gameplay: Enjoy a laid-back, stress-free experience where the game truly helps you unwind and relax. Even when you're taking a break, your devils will keep fighting, ensuring you continue to grow stronger.

+ Rich Loot and Equipment System:
During battles, every enemy you defeat has a chance to drop equipment. The equipment quality is determined by the stage level and treasure rank, with higher-quality equipment offering more diverse affixes. There’s even a chance to obtain exclusive, rare affixes to supercharge your power in combat!

70010000085601.name: Make it! Crepe
70010000085601.intro:
It's time for a delicious crepe-making challenge!
Make as many as you can and watch your food cart prosper!
70010000085601.description:
Let's make crepes on the Nintendo Switch™!
Cook with finesse, place the right toppings, and make as many crepes as you can!
Share Joy-Con™ and play with up to 4 players!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Cook the batter and choose toppings to match the order!
Work quickly and accurately for maximum points, and don't let your batter burn!
Keep making crepes until time runs out!

《How to Play》
1. Pour the batter and spread it out!

2. When the batter cooks, start adding the toppings listed in the order!

3. Add whipped cream or choco cream!

4. Add strawberries, kiwi, banana, or mango!

5. Add strawberry, kiwi, chocolate, or mango sauce!

6. When your crepe is finished cooking, wrap it up! Your crepe is complete!

【Score Attack】
Make as many crepes as you can, and aim for a high spot on the leaderboards!

【Battle】
Compete with others and test your crepe-making skills!

70010000085606.name: DreadOut Remastered Collection
70010000085606.intro: Where the world of Dread begins!!
70010000085606.description:
A collectors dream !! A compilation consisting of the original DreadOut and DreadOut : Keepers of the Dark

About DreadOut:

DreadOut is a third person supernatural horror game where you play as Linda, a high school student trapped in an old abandoned town. Equipped with her trusty smart-phone and an SLR camera, she will battle against terrifying encounters and solve mysterious puzzles which will ultimately determine her fate.

Help her overcome the challenges that will stand before her. Survive the Dread!

When a group of high school students went astray from a field trip, they came across something totally unexpected. A town long forgotten trapped in a peaceful state of slumber. What they did not realize was what lurks within. And what seemed like an innocent stroll turns into disaster as the secluded town reveals its dark and terrible secrets. The presence of sinister forces from beyond their realm of existence.

It all comes down to Linda. She will experience stirrings of unfamiliar powers, emerging from within her. These new found abilities might just be the only way she can save her own life and those of her friends.

About DreadOut: Keepers of the Dark

DreadOut: Keepers of the Dark is a new standalone horror game that takes place in the DreadOut universe. In this missing chapter, you will help Linda face the challenges of the DreadOut world with even more dangers lurking within.

Follow the event in which Linda was transported by The Mysterious Lady in Red into The Mirror Realm. A portal of worlds that connects it to 8 haunted dominions where 13+ horrific ghosts are ready to greet her in the most terrifying way possible. They will stop at nothing to thwart your main objective: To survive!

So, get your smart phone and SLR camera ready and choose your path wisely. The doors you open will decide the outcome of Linda’s fate.

70010000085611.name: The Sun Shines Over Us
70010000085611.intro: Explore the social, mental and emotional issues affecting the modern day teenagers
70010000085611.description:
In The Sun Shines Over Us, a narrative driven visual novel,you play as Mentari, a victim of bullying who just transferred schools and is trying to recover from her traumatic past. Help her make choices through her school life and experience life-changing events that will affect her future.
In school, there are many unique students, each with their own different characters and neuroses. There are three main characters and each different platonic route depends on your choices throughout the story.
Playing as Mentari, you will be facing different characters with a different understanding and challenges of mental health. Through the game, you will discover other characters’ problems and you can also help each other through these perilous times!
You can always replay the game and discover new scenes you previously missed - what you missed the first time, you might find the second time! Choosing different options will open the different scenes and unlock deeper conversations with different characters
Explore stories based on learning and empathy. Let your emotions take over in this strong narrative with unique characters each with their own perspective
 Story with 15 chapters, spanning over 100.000-word count
6 different endings (no sad ending!)
15 Animated characters with 2 fashion styles
Over 25 beautifully rendered backgrounds

70010000085642.name: Comic Store Arcade
70010000085642.description:
Grow your comic book store business from the ground up 

Stack comics, unlock table games, arcade machines and upgrades 

Entertain the customers and build a successful franchise

70010000085645.name: MINI FOOTBALL CUP
70010000085645.intro: Join the Mini Football Cup! Upgrade your team, refine your tactics, and become a champion!
70010000085645.description: Welcome to the Mini Football Cup, the ultimate test of skill and strategy! Compete in 4 competitive leagues and take on 3 exciting tournaments to prove your dominance on the field. Customize your tactics, upgrade your team in the shop, and refine your formations to outplay your opponents. Every match brings new challenges—do you have what it takes to rise to the top and claim the championship? Step onto the pitch and show the world your football skills!

70010000085647.name: Air Hunter
70010000085647.description:
Take control of a chopper as you hunt for criminals!

Chase down the criminals and take them out!

Leave a trail of destruction as you try to beat each stage!

70010000085671.name: Cowboy Duel: Red Wild West Massacre
70010000085671.description:
The Wild West, where revolvers rule and duels decide destiny. In Cowboy Duel: Red Wild West Massacre, take on the ruthless world of outlaws, grit, and glory as you fight for fame and fortune.
	•	Choose Your Gunslinger
Step into the boots of a charismatic cowboy and face off against dangerous criminals in high-stakes duels where only one survives.
	•	Engage in Epic Battles
Navigate various towns filled with fresh challenges, intense battles, and risky opportunities. Calculate every move, timing your shots and using the environment to dodge bullets. Hide behind buildings, poles, and barrels to gain the upper hand.
	•	Upgrade Your Arsenal
Earn bounty money from each duel, then use it to buy upgraded weapons and powerful ammunition. As the enemies get stronger, adapt your strategies and arm yourself with the best tools to survive.
	•	Explore the Wild West
Travel through scenic towns, meet colorful characters, and complete challenging missions. Each town introduces new adversaries and rewards, pushing you closer to legendary status.
Prove Your Superiority! Step into the Wild West and take on its most dangerous outlaws. Cowboy Duel: Red Wild West Massacre is where only the bravest and fastest can rise to legend. Accept the challenge and show that your revolver is quicker than your shadow!

70010000085676.name: Banana Tap
70010000085676.intro: fun and addictive game, your goal is to tap on various unique and advanced types of bananas
70010000085676.description:
Welcome to Banana Tap! In this fun and addictive game, your goal is to tap on various unique and advanced types of bananas. Each level introduces a new type of banana, and you'll enjoy the colorful world of the game. Here are the different banana types and their features:

Banana Types and Features
Basic Banana: A standard banana at the beginner level. It has no special features.
Improved Banana: Slightly bigger and brighter than the basic banana. It has a small leafy crown and some sparkles.
Enhanced Banana: Bigger and golden-colored. It has a gentle glow and a more detailed leafy crown.
Advanced Banana: Very large and bright golden, with a strong aura. The crown features precious stones.
Ultimate Banana: Extremely large and dazzling golden. It has a magnificent leafy crown adorned with large gemstones.
Elemental Banana: Represents the four elements (fire, water, earth, air) with segments in different colors and patterns.
Cosmic Banana: Decorated with deep blue and purple cosmic patterns, featuring stars, galaxies, and nebulae.
Enchanted Banana: Covered in magical runes and symbols, surrounded by magical light decorations and sparkles.
Crystal Banana: Crystalized structure reflecting light with a sparkling effect.
Mechanical Banana: Made of gears, metal plates, and wires, featuring a steampunk appearance.
Mystic Banana: Covered in softly glowing ancient symbols and mystical patterns.
Electric Banana: Neon colors with electric sparks running along the peel.
Floral Banana: Decorated with colorful floral patterns and blooming flowers.
Ice Banana: Frosty blue and white with ice crystals.
Fire Banana: Vibrant red and orange with flame patterns.
Shadow Banana: Dark purple and black with shadowy patterns.
Rainbow Banana: Vibrant rainbow colors blending smoothly into each other.
Phantom Banana: Ghostly, semi-transparent with ethereal blue and white colors.
Solar Banana: Bright golden and yellow with sun patterns.
Lunar Banana: Silvery and blue with moon patterns.
Oceanic Banana: Deep blue and turquoise with wave patterns.
Jungle Banana: Green and brown with leaves and vines patterns.
Galactic Banana: Dark blue and purple with stars and galaxies patterns.
Divine Banana: Bright white and gold with divine symbols and patterns.
Legendary Banana: Extremely large, dazzling golden with intricate, ornate patterns and a magnificent leafy crown adorned with gemstones.
Gameplay
In Banana Tap, all you need to do is tap on the bananas! Each tap introduces you to a new type of banana, and you'll progress through the game. This simple yet fun game offers a delightful experience for players of all ages.

Features
Easy Gameplay: Just tap the bananas to progress.
Colorful Graphics: Different and eye-catching banana designs at each level.
Addictive: The excitement of discovering new banana types at each level.
Suitable for All Ages: Simple and fun gameplay that everyone can enjoy.
Join the fun in Banana Tap and discover the different types of bananas!

70010000085681.name: Legend of the Hunter: House of Dragons
70010000085681.intro: In a remote dragon-hunting village, a boy establishes an unlikely friendship with a small dragon, challenging the traditions and prejudices of his community.
70010000085681.description:
In a picturesque village known for its ancient tradition of hunting dragons, a brave boy discovers Pyro, a small and friendly dragon. Despite the strict rules and prejudices of his community, the boy decides to protect Pyro, forging a friendship that defies all conventions. 

Together, they embark on an exciting adventure, facing dangers and revealing ancient secrets, hoping to prove that humans and dragons can coexist in harmony. This visual novel promises to captivate with its mix of action, emotion, and a powerful message about friendship and acceptance.

70010000085683.name: Mika and the Witch's Mountain
70010000085683.intro: Mika and the Witch’s Mountain is a fantasy adventure about an aspiring witch who delivers packages to the townspeople of a small island.
70010000085683.description:
This coming-of-age journey will take us to the top of the mountain through a story of effort, friendship, and community; and will let our hearts fly free.

Take your magic broom and discover all the secrets hidden in the mountain while getting to know its charming inhabitants. Work hard and get a magic broom good enough to achieve your goal: to go to the top of the mountain.

The heart of the game is a pleasant and fulfilling fly sensation. Mika will soar the skies while exploring the beautiful landscapes of Mont Gaun in her journey to the top of the mountain.

Mika will deliver packages to the villagers all over the island and they will rate her service. That way she will earn money to get new brooms with unique flying capabilities.

70010000085685.name: Drift Legends 2
70010000085685.intro: The Next Level Drift Racing Simulator

70010000085690.name: STEAMBOAT RESCUE
70010000085690.intro: Operate a steamboat and save drowning animals in the river!
70010000085690.description:
“Steamboat Rescue” is an action game where players take on the role of a steamboat captain, rescuing drowning animals while competing for high scores.
You can control the steamboat by turning the Joy-Con™ like a steering wheel, or by rotating the stick—choose the control method that suits you best.
Hitting floating logs or rocks in the river counts as a mistake.

You can choose from three difficulty levels:

	•	EASY: You can make up to 5 mistakes. Steering is easier.
	•	NORMAL: You can make up to 3 mistakes. Steering is a bit harder.
	•	HARD: Game over after 1 mistake. Steering is very difficult, requiring lots of turns.

Aim for a high score on each difficulty level!

70010000085695.name: Quick, Quack!
70010000085695.description:
Oh no! Mother duck got yeeted out of their storybook and lost her babies!! Help her fly, hop, and hustle across the sky!

Lend her a hand and jump to infinite heights, in this quacktastic offline, single-player, endless platformer!

- Rescue mother duck’s lost ducklings!
- Watch out for traps and tricky platforms!
- Keep your energy high by eating yummy food!
- Give mother duck a boost with power ups!
- Test your endurance and get that high score! 
- Storybook-style visuals — the cherry on top! 

Quack, Couac, Kwak!

70010000085703.name: Hidden Cats in Spooky Town
70010000085703.intro: MeoooOoow! It’s spooky time in Spooky Town, so trick or treat with spooky cats!
70010000085703.description:
The spooky Halloween season is upon us, so our ever-travelling cat troupe decided to make an appearance in a particularly Spooky Town….
Come a bit closer… And don’t be scared of monsters! The ones found in Spooky Town are quite friendly, and besides, you’d be here looking for cats, not monsters… mostly.

Find cats, colour in the scenery, and don’t get spooked!

Features:
- Nearly a thousand cats and other things to find
- Two main modes, six bonus levels, and a massive after party to attend!
- Special cat cards to collect
- Tons of meows :3

70010000085708.name: Jelly Troops
70010000085708.intro:
Jelly Troops is a bouncy flag-capturing battle with slimes!
Enjoy thrilling, chaotic, and exciting battles with your
friends, family, and slime masters all over the world!
70010000085708.description:
*About This Game

Out-think the Enemy in Chaotic Capture-the-Flag Battles
Amass an army of slimes and compete to capture more flags than your opponent in hyper-fast, best-of-3 RTS battles!

- Command your Slimes
Each slime can harvest "Magic Fruits" that can grow more slimes, attack enemy slimes, or capture flags. 
The more slimes allocated to a task, the faster it completes! Will you grow your army first for a surprise early-game attack, or sneak in an early flag-capture?

- Watch Out for Guardians
Gargantuan Guardians linger throughout the map, eager to crush both you and your slimes with a single blow. Guide them away by getting inside their attack range (but not too close!), then strategically draw Guardians away so slimes can continue their duties. Try luring Guardians into enemy range to create near-impassable choke points!

- Raise Walls to Redirect Enemy Movement
Force the opponent to take the long route back to their base with well-placed walls.

- Cast Spells to Turn the Tides of Battle
Search through the map for power-ups, like lightning strikes that instantly turn enemy armies into mush, ticking bombs, meteor showers, and more. Summon a trio of friendly Guardians to do your bidding, activate a speed boost, or go invisible for sneaky maneuvering across the map.

*Multiple Game Modes

- Random Battle:
Compete against players from all over the world online!

- Private Battle: 
Play online with friends using a shared password!

- Split-Screen Battle: 
Compete against friends and family on a single screen!

- Solo Missions: 
Master your skills in a dedicated single-player mode by completing various challenges!

70010000085713.name: Spiritfall
70010000085713.description:
A PLATFORM FIGHTER ROGUELIKE
Spiritfall combines tight Platform Fighter combat, smooth movement, and Roguelite mechanics into one! Trek across dangerous lands, string together deadly combos to fend off swarms of enemies, and harness an ever-changing set of powers through a randomly generated map.

DIVINE SYNERGIES AWAIT
The divine spirits offer powerful blessings that enhance your abilities in combat. Discover your favorite abilities, and experiment with different builds. With over 150+ blessings to choose from, these gifts allow for a range of tactical approaches that encourage you to find synergies that fit your playstyle.

GROW STRONGER FROM DEFEAT
Death is but a temporary setback. Reawaken stronger than before at the Sanctum and continue your adventure. Use the resources you gathered to upgrade your skills, unlock unique powers, and awaken mighty weapons with unique movesets.

70010000085718.name: Maki: Paw of Fury
70010000085718.intro: Beat ‘em up and Retro Arcade game enjoyers – welcome to the world of Pangea!
70010000085718.description:
When a friend gets captured, Maki comes to her rescue! Fight your way through five diverse locations with funky fresh minigames, and conquer the dangerous opponents that stand in your way!


FEEL THE 90S IN AN ANIMAL STYLE — Maki: Paw of Fury’s combat elements are inspired by the hit beat ‘em up arcade games from the 90s, while the story of Maki takes place in the original world of Pangea. Animals rule here, and they’re passionate about sports, technology, and lifelong friendships. Speaking of, one is about to be on the brink of breaking!


A FRIEND IN NEED, A FIGHT INDEED — Maki gets a pleading call for help and realizes that his dear friend - Mapu - has betrayed him. Here starts the road of Maki: The Paw of Fury! He might look adorable, but don’t mistake his fox cuteness for weakness - he has studied the martial art of Tsume no Ken and can wield a tuna like a professional.


MAKI ISN’T ALONE — You can choose to play Maki the fox, but you can also choose Tincho, the muscular capybara, and Maka, the colorful otter who will show your enemies the power of music. Each of these characters is unique when it comes to looks, strength, and fighting style!


VIBE WITH THE MUSIC AND THE WONDERFUL WORLD OF PANGEA — While all the fighting’s going on it’s hard to appreciate the visuals. But if you stand down just for a moment you’ll be able to appreciate the stunning views of Pangea’s world! You’’ travel through dark ninja forests, icy planes, and desert dunes in the tune of energetic and fighting-ready tracks.

70010000085725.name: BallZ DX
70010000085725.intro: Ultimate block breaker with all the bells and whistles
70010000085725.description:
BallZ Deluxe: The Ultimate Brick Breaker Experience!

Get ready to break bricks like never before! Your mission is simple: smash as many bricks as you can before they reach the bottom. Collect extra balls along the way to boost your firepower, and earn bonus coins and gems to unlock even more powerful balls!

- Endless fun: Keep playing as long as you can keep the bricks at bay.
- Online leaderboard: Show off your high scores and see how you stack up against players worldwide.
- 27 unique balls: Unlock and choose from a variety of cool balls.
- Multilingual support: Play in your preferred language.
- Immersive audio: Enjoy professional sound effects and music that enhance your gameplay.

70010000085733.name: Synaxarion Christian Stories: Holy Martyr Neophytos
70010000085733.intro: A young boy who fought for the Kingdom of God
70010000085733.description:
Active around 290 A.D., a twelve-year-old during the fierce government of Maximos in Nicaea, Saint Neophytos the Holy Martyr worked many wonders and underwent a brutal martyrdom, putting his torturers to shame. This is his story.

This Synaxarion includes:
1 Story Level: Nicaea - The story is uncovered as you play through the experience.
1 Mini Dungeon
1 Story of the life of a Saint (Neophytos the Holy Martyr)

After an introduction to the saint and the time period surrounding him, play as a witness to his life in Nicaea, a city of present-day Turkey. Complete Quests, collect items, and follow the Saint's trail to hear his story.

These stories are short and are not intended to take up much time to play through. Expect to play for 40-60 minutes to complete this experience.

The Synaxarion is a collection of Saints’ lives, which are celebrated each day of the year. They are a light that leads us to Christ in every generation, a living Gospel. The ministry and very life of Christ is worked out in the lives of the Saints, His faithful servants. They are the glory of the Church, the God-bearers on earth and in heaven. Most of the saints were unknown to the world, but the Grace of God made them known to the whole universe and to all the ages. Amen.

70010000085738.name: Dog Man: Mission Impawsible
70010000085738.intro: Dog Man: Mission Impawsible brings the beloved book series to life! Dive into this action-packed, humor-filled adventure.
70010000085738.description:
The key to the city has fallen into the hands of a supa bad guy, unlocking all the prison doors and releasing many evildoers. Help Dog Man and his friends chase down the supa bad guys in their most impawsible mission yet! Switch between Dog Man and his Supa Buddies, each with their own special abilities and gadgets such as Rockets Boots, Retractable Claws and Dirt Proof Pants. Together you can overcome challenging obstacles and defeat powerful bosses.

Game Features:
* 50 Exciting Levels: Explore iconic locations from the Dog Man universe, including the City Hall, Giant Marshmallow Factory, and the Police Station. Each location offers platforming and puzzle-solving challenges.
* Teamwork: Switch between Dog Man and his Supa Buddies, each with their own special abilities, to overcome obstacles and defeat bosses.
* Fun Gadgets: Unlock new gadgets and abilities as you progress, like a grappling hook, rocket shoes and power gloves to navigate through the levels.
* Puzzles and Bosses: Use your brain to solve puzzles and defeat unique bosses. Each boss fight requires clever use of your team’s abilities.
* Humor and Action: Enjoy funny dialogue, amusing interactions, and non-stop action that keeps you engaged in Dog Man’s world.
* Rewards and Collectibles: Revisit levels with new gadgets to find secret areas, and rescue the missing Comic Club members
* Art Style: Great animations inspired by the books, with comic-style sound effects that add a fun, cartoonish touch to the action.

70010000085748.name: V-HUNTER PUZZLER DX
70010000085748.intro: Defeat the monsters with your best weapon: your brain.
70010000085748.description:
Hunt hordes of sinister monsters by outsmarting them with strategy and critical thinking in this engaging turn-based grid puzzler. Complete the levels in as few turns as possible and help V-Hunter defeat the evil vampire Alric!

Do you have what it takes to defeat those foes and save the day?

Features:
- 60 levels spread across 5 adventurous episodes
- 6 unique items, including dynamite, a revolver, and holy water, to aid in crafting different strategies.
- 7 collectible unlockable costumes
- Casual game mode: No rush, solve it at your own pace
- Hard game mode: For players craving a serious challenge!
- Retro pixel-art visuals

Prepare for an epic journey where your wits and bravery are your greatest weapons!

70010000085753.name: Unsolved Case: Murderous Script CE
70010000085753.intro: Danger lurks around every shadowy corner!
70010000085753.description:
The life of a detective is unpredictable and dangerous. You never know what awaits you, and what secrets you need to unravel. But you knew what you were getting into, there's no turning back!

You and your detective partner have a lot of work ahead! Cases full of family drama, betrayal, and double-crosses lay within these case files...

First, There is the case of the famous city attorney, Richard Errikson, who turns out to have shady dealings. But most puzzling of all, he was murdered in the middle of a train journey… and seemingly, all the other passengers are innocent. Tackle this closed-room murder, and track down the suspect if it’s the last thing you do!

Your hard work on the job aren’t done, because soon, your buddy calls you to solve the disappearance of his sister’s boyfriend. Even without official orders from the department, you’ll have to figure out what’s at the root of this mystery.

People in the media can also have dramatic lives, with all the abductions and a whole chandelier falling on a TV host’s brother. You are left with just a few clues, if any…. But this can’t be anything besides a murder. The Hollywood drama continues in the Collector’s Edition bonus chapter, as a famous actress disappears next...

Do you have the courage, and curiosity, to uncover the truth? Can you outsmart all worthy opponents? 

The Collector’s Edition game includes:
• Excellent graphics and voice overs
• 3 different chapters, plus a 4th bonus chapter!
• 16 hidden object puzzle scenes and 17 mini-games
• Collect 14 pieces of morphing evidence, and 14 vinyl records
• Customizable difficulty levels
• Behind-the-scenes collection of beautiful concept art

70010000085755.name: Royal Romances: Endless Winter CE
70010000085755.intro: Can you melt the ice in people's hearts?
70010000085755.description:
Eternal winter has descended upon the magnificent kingdom once filled with vitality and adventure. But now, cold and hunger have divided families and heroes, calling out their ugliest traits and draining their last strength… 

Meanwhile, dragons have returned to dwell among the people. Once more, the kind dragons help those end their misfortunes. Although some seek to profit from this, for others this is a cause for bringing back old grudges. And after decades of mistreatment, the patience of the dragons themselves is wearing thin. 

Who can restore balance to the lands? A guardian of the forest, an elf, or an inept witch?

Traverse through a frozen kingdom once brimming with life and now covered in an eternal winter. Discover breathtaking sceneries and meet unexpected heroes including fauns, elves, and even dragons!

Make critical decisions that influence the fate of characters and kingdoms. Each puzzle solved brings you closer to uncovering the secrets of this mystical world! 

Your choices determine the future of the eternal winter – will you be its savior, or its perpetual harbinger?


The Collector’s Edition game includes:

• 6 chapters, plus a bonus chapter
• 4 difficulty levels, including a customizable version
• 17 replayable hidden object scenes and mini-games
• Varied stories with fantastic graphics
• Unlock challenging achievement and find morphing objects

70010000085778.name: Ultimate Fishing Supermarket Simulator 3D
70010000085778.intro: Start your journey as a fishing market tycoon and reel in the profits today!
70010000085778.description:
Dive into the immersive world of retail management with Ultimate Fishing Supermarket Simulator 3D! Step into the shoes of a savvy entrepreneur and become the proud owner of a bustling fishing shop. Cater to the needs of passionate anglers as you stock your store with an extensive array of fishing gear, equipment, and accessories.

Key Features:
Manage Your Store: Run your very own fishing supermarket, buying goods at competitive prices and selling them for a profit.

Upgrade and Expand: Use your profits to upgrade your store, expand your inventory, and attract more customers.

Realistic 3D Environment: Experience a detailed and immersive 3D world that brings your fishing supermarket to life.

Strategic Planning: Balance supply and demand to maximize your profits and grow your business empire.

Customer Satisfaction: Keep your customers happy with a diverse range of high-quality products and exceptional service.

Whether you're a fan of fishing or just love business simulation games, Ultimate Fishing Supermarket Simulator 3D offers a unique and engaging experience that will keep you hooked for hours. Start your journey as a fishing market tycoon and reel in the profits today!

70010000085785.name: Just 1 Minute! Memory Test with Masterpieces
70010000085785.intro:
Which Hand Was on Top in the Mona Lisa’s Lap?
Test Your Memory with Famous Paintings in Just One Minute!
70010000085785.description:
This game lets you enjoy classic masterpieces while sharpening your observation and memory skills.

How to Play:
・Memorize every detail of a famous painting within a 1-minute time limit.
・Answer questions about hidden details with four multiple-choice options.
・Even if you get it wrong, you won’t get a second look at the painting!

The quiz features some of the most iconic paintings everyone has seen:

・The Scream
・The Creation of Adam
・The Birth of Venus
・Girl with a Pearl Earring
・The Gleaners

…Think you know these masterpieces? You might be surprised at what you can’t remember!

Whether you’re playing solo, enjoying it with family and friends, or sharing it with your streaming audience, this game offers tons of fun.

For those who manage to get every question right, the title of Memory Master awaits you!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.

70010000085789.name: Planetiles
70010000085789.intro: Dive into Planetiles, where strategy and creativity converge. Build and transform barren planets into flourishing worlds.
70010000085789.description:
Planetiles is a serene city builder with roguelike elements. Create natural habitats on remote planets as you satisfy quests and earn bonuses with strategically placed ecosystems.

Craft habitats on varying planets sizes with strategic tile placement that earns you bonuses and unlockables, such as tile skins and customization options. Shaping a forest consisting of a specified number of fields or constructing a distinct feature like an oasis will give you different benefits depending on your quests and game progression.
As the biomes you cultivate grow, so do your resources to build! Increase your reserve of tiles by completing missions that replenish your supplies so you can continue to expand across the worlds you shape through your choices.
The landscape reacts to your choices. Turn a few scraggly trees into a lush forest and create distinct biomes by placing tiles to satisfy quests and activate power ups. Three different planet sizes and no endgame mean you can move between planets and build and manipulate biomes to your heart’s desire.
Uncover special structures through your tile placement choices. These unique features allow for special actions, such as shuffling the next shapes or placing a unique object on the planet.

70010000085799.name: NBA BOUNCE
70010000085799.intro: Pick up and play with your favorite NBA team!
70010000085799.description:
Ready to step onto the court with your favorite team? 

Choose from 30 NBA teams like the Boston Celtics, Chicago Bulls, New York Knicks, Golden State Warriors, Los Angeles Lakers, Denver Nuggets, and more as you dribble, and dunk to victory. 

Play on team-themed courts with energetic mascots and crowds. Can you beat the buzzer? 

Go from rookie to pro unlocking cool jerseys, sneakers, and mascots. Play solo or in co-op, with easy controls and game modes like Training, Full Season and Party Mode. 

Pick and play to experience basketball in a fun, new way. The ball’s in your court!

FUN & EASY HOOP PLAY: Players of any age and level can learn the basics and play in style as they shoot, dunk, and block.

CO-OP ON THE COURTS: Shoot hoops with family and friends and amp up the challenge with up to 4 players.

PRACTICE YOUR MOVES: Choose your game mode and work on your lay-ups in Training, compete in a Full Season or Party playing Ball Pop and more. 

MASCOT MAYHEM: Jump into the shenanigans with your favorite team mascot in Party Mode. 

BUILD YOUR PERFECT LINEUP: Choose an Eastern or Western Conference.

70010000085804.name: JankenUp!
70010000085804.description:
Welcome to JanKenUP!, an exciting combat game that breaks with traditional schemes. Instead of the typical punches and combos, strategy boils down to three buttons: rock, paper, and scissors. Get ready for a cerebral challenge where your quick thinking and mental agility are key!

Hop on the elevator of fun and prepare to act swiftly! Face all kinds of rivals and prove that you can outshine everyone in the arena. Become the undisputed champion!

Key Features:

•	 Unlock 25 unique characters: Each with their own style and abilities.
•	Single Player Mode: Beat your own records and complete all available achievements to showcase your skills.
•	Multiplayer Mode: Challenge up to 4 friends in exciting duels and prove who the true master is.

Don't wait any longer; the battle is about to begin in JanKenUP!

70010000085806.name: Tobla - Divine Path
70010000085806.intro: MASTER CREATIVE PUZZLES AND FIND YOUR WAY HOME!
70010000085806.description:
Tobla - Divine Path combines creative gameplay, an exciting story, and enchanting visual design into a unique puzzle adventure.

You play as Mort, a mortal chosen by the enigmatic goddess Tobla. Your goal is to solve a collection of challenging puzzles to find your way home. However, Tobla doesn't seem entirely honest, and you try to stop her cunning plans. Be ready for a unique mix of logic, creativity, and humor!

•Solve exciting, PHYSICS-BASED PUZZLES by swapping cubes, rolling spheres, and using bombs to overcome tricky obstacles and pass Tobla's trials.

•Face off against the CHEEKY GODDESS Tobla and tackle her condescending remarks while mastering the challenging puzzle creations.

•Experience a COMPACT ADVENTURE, perfect for an afternoon or evening filled with challenging puzzles and exciting scenarios.

•Enjoy a humorous story marked by clever puzzles and a MANIPULATIVE NARRATOR.

•Discover FOCUSED PUZZLE MECHANICS in an indie game that concentrates on the essentials and impresses with well-thought-out puzzle elements.

70010000085811.name: Forestrike
70010000085811.description:
Forestrike is a martial arts roguelite inspired by classic martial arts movies, where every fight is unique, and every death brings you closer to victory.

A martial artist, named Yu, embarks on a journey across the country to free the Emperor from an evil Admiral’s influence. As the odds become more and more overwhelming, it’s clear Yu will need more than his fists to overcome the Admiral’s vicious followers.

Enter ‘Foresight’, a mysterious technique allowing Yu to rehearse each encounter within the fortress of his mind. Mastering the fight before it begins won't guarantee victory in reality, but it will give Yu a fighting chance. Every single move matters when death comes at a price - beginning his journey all over again.

Winning won’t always mean Yu will emerge from each encounter unscathed, so careful planning will be required to navigate each randomly generated world map, making use of Inns for rest and the wisdom of wise Masters he’ll meet along the way.

The further he travels, the stronger Yu will become, eventually learning new techniques from five eccentric Masters that provide permanent upgrades. Combine and experiment with these techniques to achieve Yu’s ultimate goal - victory without ‘Foresight’.

Forewarned is Forearmed
The ‘Foresight’, a distinctive game mechanic that lets players experiment without consequences before fighting for real - and win or die trying. Forestrike’s roguelite game loop generates unique runs and encounters every time, so adaptation and improvisation are crucial to progress and earn the ultimate victory - winning without ‘Foresight’.

Visceral Kung Fu Combat
Always outnumbered, learn to dispatch mobs of brutal enemies with poise and efficiency using everything at your disposal. Upgrade and customize your movesets with techniques from your chosen Masters to help you outwit your opponents in fierce, puzzle-like battles.

Handcrafted Fantasy
Journey through a visually striking fantasy world inhabited by unique characters, vicious enemies and magical revelations. Intricate pixel art landscapes form an atmospheric backdrop to handcrafted animation and characters.

70010000085816.name: John The Zombie
70010000085816.intro: In this open-world game, eat brains to gain skills from them like biking, driving, horseback riding, fishing, climbing, shooting hoops, and running.
70010000085816.description:
Welcome to Johnwood, the wackiest, weirdest place where scientists accidentally turn into zombies, hardware stores sell frozen brains, people get run over, and everyone swears they’ve seen flying horses!

If you're looking for a serious game, this ain’t it. But if deep down in your poor soul you're itching to chase down the world's most bizarre civilians and chow down on their brains without mercy, stop wasting time: Come to Johnwood and feast on the dumbest citizens you'll ever find!

What awaits you:

* Bugs
* The chance to kickstart the zombie apocalypse
* Brains rich in protein, iron, and calcium
* Interdimensional horses that defy this universe's physics
* The least realistic zombie simulator in existence
* The option to embark on a completely nonsensical journey for the zombie cure

70010000085821.name: Table Flip Simulator
70010000085821.intro: Flip tables, smash stress, and unleash chaos in absurd physics fun.
70010000085821.description:
This physics-based puzzler turns everyday frustration into cathartic destruction as you throw, smash, and flip tables through levels inspired by modern life. Your adventure begins with a bad day at work, when your boss demands you work overtime on your birthday, and escalates into a heroic journey to become the President of the most powerful nation on Earth: Antarctica.

Wreck the world to unlock dozens of costumes and new playable levels. Make coffee as a barista, survive teaching a class of high school students, and prove your throwing mastery in ridiculous boss battles where you can tussle with a college professor. Each imaginative level encourages experimentation, creative destruction to rack up points, all alongside a cast of quirky characters.

Want to crank the chaos even higher? Build your own fully destructible stages with the in-game level editor. Turn real-life frustrations into unhinged playgrounds of destruction! Then share your masterpieces online for other players to play.

Features:
● Flip tables, throw objects, and enjoy the consequences.
● Unlock costumes to create your own custom flipper.
● Battle memorable bosses that are both silly and epic.
● Chase high scores across a huge variety of stages.
● Solve optional objectives to unlock bonus levels.
● Explore retro-cool visuals and knock out over 200 characters.
● Build fully destructible levels with the in-game editor.
● Share your creations online and play levels made by other players.
● Did we mention smashing things?

70010000085830.name: Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage
70010000085830.intro: One day, the soul-starved Youkai escape from the depths of hell. Now, the story of the Grim Reaper and the girl who has fallen into this land begins!
70010000085830.description:
《 ABOUT THE GAME 》
▶ Continuing the long line of shoot'em up classics!
Boasts unique and charming protagonists, a variety of bosses with bizarre and fantastical designs, and waves upon waves of enemies to keep players on their toes!

▶ The charm of Eastern fantasy!
In reimagining the Youkai from Korean folktales and historical records from a new perspective, the game features inventive original characters drawn in an elegant fashion and a gripping story fully-voiced by professional voice actresses.

▶ Soul collection system
Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage features a unique system called 'Soul Collect', where players can charge their 'Soul Gauge' as they avoid enemy bullets. It's perilous, but the closer players stay to bullets, the faster their gauges charge!

Then, players can use their dodge to evade bullets for a moment! Nullify enemy attacks and shoot for a new high score!

▶ Various game modes!
Play through the main story in Arcade mode, focus down the bosses in Boss Rush mode, or get double souls but lose in a single hit in Hardcore mode. 

Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage also features a new Dual mode, a strategic single-player mode that allows switching between the two protagonists to match the circumstances players face!

In addition, the game has been reworked, adding new optional features and even a new stage!


《 CHARACTER INFO 》
▶ The Girl ( Voiced by: Ikumi Hasegawa )
One day, the girl falls into this world, losing even the memory of her own name.
She begins her harrowing journey to fight the youkai in search of her memories, her hometown, and her family.

▶ Grim Reaper ( Voiced by: Saku Mizuno )
Death's emissary who must face the begrudged souls-turned-Youkai and perform her given duties.
She happens upon the girl, teaming up to help her.

70010000085835.name: Crazy Traffic: City Parking Simulator
70010000085835.intro: A realistic parking simulator where you take on the role of an experienced police transport driver!

70010000085843.name: Ultimate Holidays
70010000085843.intro: Let’s start the Ultimate Holidays wherever you are!
70010000085843.description:
Just lay down and chill with the cozy vibe of the Ultimate Holidays sandbox game, where you can begin whenever you are with your beloved console and start creating your own special place as your ultimate holiday goal.


ENDLESS HOLIDAYS
Focus on a place that you're dreaming and use all your imagination to create this perfect spot. You have 90 different objects that you can use to build a sunny californian town or cheerful amusement park. Or maybe an empty beach to wind down. Skies have a limit, but there's a lot of it.

The sea, canions, lovely hills or just a exotic beach. Find your landscape and start this cozy journey through a sandbox chillout.


TAKE YOUR MEMORIES WITH YOU
Ultimate Holidays without ultimate memories? Hell no. You can go to camera mode and take beautiful photos of your creations in a postcard style. Choose from 15 different hand drawing stamps with cute and funny things. 


MAIN FEATURES:
- Camera mode with a postcard vibe
- Space as big as your imagination
- Sandbox game with cozy and chillout vibe
- Four different landscapes
- 90 different objects to build from

70010000085856.name: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions
70010000085856.description:
Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions is a fast-paced racing game for the whole family that brings the famous Europa-Park mascots Ed & Edda to life for the first time in a video game to coincide with the worldwide release of the animated feature film ‘GRAND PRIX OF EUROPE’!

You can race with the two heroes or six other colourful characters that fans of the film will recognise! The races take players to various well-known locations across Europe to compete in Free Races, the Points Chase, Time trial or the Grand Prix!

Each character not only has their very own racing car, but also individual strengths and weaknesses, which means that each race can be driven very differently depending on which character you take to the track!

But Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions is not just a game that is great fun to play alone: in a race with two, three or even four players, every family and every group of friends can create their very own memories in the world of the Racing Champions - because with Ed & Edda, too, it's true: a shared game is often twice the fun!

 
Key features of Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions:

Race over exciting tracks in many world-famous European locations

Choose between eight well-known characters, including Ed & Edda, the legendary Europa-Park mascots

Unleash unique driving skills, master power-ups and customise your race car to make every race feel unique

Long-term modifications to the racing car and unlockable improvements keep the replay value high

A split-screen mode for local multiplayer races of 2 to 4 players invites families to have fun together and create their very own memories in the world of Ed & Edda.

70010000085858.name: Tales From The Arcade: Fartmania
70010000085858.intro: Bounce, fart, jump, and explore your way up into the very stratosphere to rescue your friends from the clutches of their alien kidnappers.
70010000085858.description:
FART YOUR WAY TO VICTORY!
Aliens have busted into your backyard and kidnapped your friends and family. The only edge you have is you’re a pig with a serious case of flatulence.

THEY ONCE LAUGHED...
The other pigs laugh at how smelly you are. They often call you ‘Stinky’. Stinky? Well… Who's laughing now? Too stinky for the aliens to take! You’re now the only one who can save them before the dangerous starborn creatures steal all your friends away.

AFTER THEM!
Using your powerful farts, rocket your way to victory! No alien craft can escape your fart filled might!

FEATURES:
- Precision platforming with a very musical gimmick! (Toot toot!)
- Finally, a game with infinite double jumps! (Just don’t light a match!)
- Show them all they’re wrong… (Prove your disability is a boon!)
At least two epic showdowns against the alien menace! (maybe even three?!)
- The highest FPS (Farts Per Second) of any game ever released!

ONLY YOU CAN SAVE THEM...
There is no one else, just you, a bad case of IBS, and a family of fellow swine to save. Bounce, fart, jump, and explore your way up into the very stratosphere to rescue your friends from the clutches of their alien kidnappers. Heroes come in small packages, but sometimes they have big smells.

70010000085862.name: Aidan In Danger
70010000085862.description:
Aidan in Danger is an exciting platform game where the player takes on the role of Aidan, a young red-haired elf whose main weapon is a slingshot. Tasked with protecting Drakor, the last dragon on Earth, Aidan must navigate challenging levels, face dangerous monsters, travel to the future, and thwart the plans of an interdimensional villain aiming to dominate the world. With immersive gameplay, impressive graphics, and a compelling story, the player embarks on an epic journey filled with danger, courage, and heroism. Join Aidan on his mission to save Drakor and restore peace to the land!


-An epic journey filled with challenges that test the player's skills.
-Retro visual style with careful details.
-Chiptune music in 8-bit style.
-Face intense and epic battles with powerful bosses, testing your agility, strategy, and determination in memorable fights.
-Simple controls with intuitive commands to jump, roll, and dash; the player can easily navigate through challenges and face enemies with fluidity and precision.

70010000085884.name: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 4
70010000085884.description:
Brace yourself for the darkest chapter yet in the epic Poppy Playtime saga.

You are pushed deeper into the undiscovered depths of the Playtime Co. factory, far below anything the world knew. Here, you’ll encounter terrifying new threats and discover shocking revelations. Can you outwit the unnatural new creations lurking in the shadows? Can you survive here long enough to eventually unravel the mysteries behind the experiments? Every step will test your courage, every puzzle will challenge your mind, and every corner may be your last.

Features:

New Characters (and Allies): New extraordinary characters guide your way, and haunt your nightmares.

Expanded Lore: Discover more about the dark secrets of Playtime Co. and its twisted past.

Mind-Bending Puzzles: Solve intricate puzzles that could mean the difference between life and death.

Heart-Pounding Atmosphere: With haunting visuals and immersive sound design, the terror never lets up.

Will you escape the horrors hidden within Playtime Co., or will you succumb to the terror?

70010000085900.name: Strike Mission
70010000085900.intro: Strike Mission is a top-down aerial action game where you play as pilot Jake Walker on a mission to stop a global terrorist threat.
70010000085900.description:
Get ready for an intense aerial military campaign in Strike Mission, a top-down action game where you take control of elite pilot Jake Walker on a critical mission to save the world from a global tech threat.
With immersive gameplay, a tactical radar system, multiple mission objectives, and cinematic cutscenes, Strike Mission blends fast-paced action with strategy and storytelling.
Unlock achievements and prove you're the hero the world needs.

70010000085905.name: Macho Shot
70010000085905.intro:
Macho Shot!
Raise your Machos and grow them as big as possible!
70010000085905.description:
Merge Machos of the same type and they'll grow!
Be careful not to let them overflow off the field!
Reach for a new high score!
Share Joy-Con™ to play with up to 4 players!

[Score Attack]
Increase your score and aim for the top of the world leaderboards!

[Battle]
Compete with up to 4 players, block each other out, and survive until the end!

70010000085922.name: Rope Hope
70010000085922.description:
Play as a red ball that swings from pin to pin using a rope. Perfect your timing and momentum to gain speed and overcome obstacles.

CHALLENGING LEVELS!
Navigate through 50 unique levels that become progressively more difficult. Each level introduces new obstacles and requires refined skills to master.

MASTER THE ART OF SWINGING!
Learn and improve your swinging techniques as you advance through the game. Precision and strategy are key to conquering the toughest challenges. Push your skills to the limit and become the ultimate Rope Hope champion.

CHALLENGE YOURSELF AND SEE IF YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES!

70010000085935.name: Ice World: The Frozen Age
70010000085935.intro: In this visual novel, a group of prehistoric creatures embark on an epic journey to find the legendary Warm Valley.
70010000085935.description:
In a world plunged into ice and snow, where a catastrophe has turned the Earth into a new ice age, an eclectic group of prehistoric creatures embark on an epic journey in search of survival and warmth. Led by Glacier, a majestic woolly rhinoceros, the group faces countless challenges and dangers on their way to the legendary Warm Valley.

Accompanied by Rockslide, a sturdy armadillo, Blizzard, an agile cave lion, Flicker, a curious jerboa, and Glimmer, a prehistoric dragonfly with iridescent wings, these brave travelers must join forces and overcome their fears to reach their destination.


Why would you like it?

·Loving and friendly characters: Glacier, the woolly rhinoceros; Rockslide, the sturdy armadillo; Blizzard, the agile cave lion; Flicker, the curious jerboa; and Glimmer, the prehistoric dragonfly with iridescent wings.

·Full-color backgrounds: Immerse yourself in a vibrant and detailed world of ice and snow, filled with stunning landscapes.

·Immersive story of more than an hour: An epic journey to the legendary Warm Valley, full of adventure and excitement.

·Captivating music: A soundtrack that accompanies every moment, making the experience even more magical.

·Inspiring values: Lessons about friendship, teamwork and overcoming fears to achieve a common goal

70010000085940.name: LUMbA: REDUX
70010000085940.intro: LUMbA: REDUX Is a challenging, fast-paced, bullet hell shooter. Take control of LUMBA and cleanse this world of the monsters that have consumed it.
70010000085940.description:
Cleanse this earth. It is infected, you must save it.

LUMbA: REDUX is the enhanced version of LUMbA, a game you definitely haven't played. Follow the orders of Pal, your leader. Together you will take back what was lost and save the world from its destined downfall.

Take a deep dive into the twisted minds of Lumba and Pal as they embark on their crusade, both with the shared goal of uprooting the evil that has plagued their world for too long.

Features

•8 Chapters Packed with Tons of Levels
•A Sinister Storyline That Reveals Itself The More You Play
•10+ Unique Monster Types, All With Distinct Weapons and Behaviors
•8 Boss fights That Will Test Your Skill and Break You As A Person
•An Original Soundtrack That Includes Haunting Ambient Tracks, •As Well As Fast-Paced Breakcore
•A Minimalistic Pixel Art Style That Leaves Much to The Interpretation

70010000085945.name: Fortune's Favor
70010000085945.intro: Left for dead on Mutiny Island by a traitorous first mate, you must survive and reclaim your lost ship, the Red Dawn. In this 3D open‑world pirate adventure.
70010000085945.description:
Left for dead. Ship stolen. Your legend awaits.
Escape Mutiny Island, build Fame or Infamy, and reclaim your ship.

Marooned on Mutiny Island by your traitorous first mate, you've been left to die with nothing but the clothes on your back. The Red Dawn – YOUR ship – sails without you. Now, you must survive, build your skills, and reclaim what is rightfully yours in this open-world pirate adventure.

KEY FEATURES

Open-World Exploration: Discover diverse islands at your own pace, from sandy shores to rocky cliffs with no loading screens between land and sea.

Freedom of Choice: Chart your own course! Tackle quests for townsfolk, hunt for treasure, or challenge rival captains in naval combat.

Adventure: Explore, gather resources, and craft simple rafts, but why stop there? Any ship you spot can be captured and claimed as your own.

Real-Time Ship Battles: Command captured vessels in intense naval combat, board enemy ships, and clash with rivals in cutlass duels.

Reputation System: Your actions influence how characters respond to you. Become famous or infamous across the Arbor!

70010000085950.name: Fruit Attack!!
70010000085950.intro: Merge the funny fruits and get the giant cherry!
70010000085950.description:
Fruit Attack!!! is all about ... funny fruits. Your mission: Aim and shoot delicious fruits at each other. If two of the same type meet, they transform into an even bigger fruit. Master spectacular combos by transforming several of the treats with one throw. Can you reach the giant cherry - the ultimate fruit? Show what you're made of!

2-player mode for double the fun

Compete against a friend in 2-player mode and fight for the highest score.  Either against the clock or in the exciting attack mode. In the latter, collect as many combos as possible to teleport nasty marble balls into your opponent's playing field and thwart his plans. Total party fun!

Features:

• Fascinating gameplay thanks to the ingenious physics system
• Easy to learn, hard to quit
• Hall of fame to immortalize your name
• Groovy soundtrack that invites you to tap along
• Various 2-player modes for ultimate party fun
• Colorful graphics that catch the eye

Are you ready for the fruity adventure? Fruit Attack!!! awaits you!

70010000085953.name: Population Quiz
70010000085953.intro: Which country has the largest population?
70010000085953.description:
Welcome to Population Quiz, the ultimate test of your global knowledge! Do you have what it takes to guess which country or region has a larger population? Put your skills to the test in this fun and educational game that will challenge your understanding of the world's demographics.

Gameplay:
- Simple Mechanics: Each round presents you with two options – two countries or regions. Your task is to choose the one with the larger population. Sounds easy? Think again!

Features:
- Educational Fun: Learn fascinating facts about different countries and regions. Enhance your geographical knowledge while having fun.
- Beautiful Interface: Enjoy a visually appealing and user-friendly interface that makes playing a breeze.
- Nice soundtrack

Are you ready to test your knowledge and learn more about the world's population? :)

70010000085965.name: Trap Yuri Garden
70010000085965.intro:
Cute girls (male) in motion at long last!
A girl's love visual novel game with a cross-dressing twist made to shatter the reader's current worldview to pieces.
70010000085965.description:
A new iteration of a long beloved cross-dressing series boasting 10+ years makes its Nintendo Switch™ debut!
Witness the most gorgeous cross-dressing girl's love story ever made in thoroughly animated glory!

[Story]
Our story takes place in a private school known as Ayanohara Academy.

A secluded flower garden where affluent young gentlemen dress and act as ladies to become "he-iresses", form sisterly bonds with one another, and allow their quasi-romantic relationships to flourish...
New transfer student Iori however, our non-affluent background having protagonist, rejects these ways in an effort to stay true to himself, then quickly finds himself at odds with Mikage, the tyrannical student council president and cross-dressing purist.
The strong willed rebel Iori, and the zealous cross-dressing loyalist Mikage. Their fateful meeting soon unleashes upon them a new forbidden world of cross-dressing girl's love!

[Characters]
- Iori Kido CV: Yuika
The Protagonist surprised by how well women's clothes suit him. Referred to by some students as "The Goddess of Black Camellia", he stumbles into becoming the beautiful envy of his peers.

-Mikage Ayanohara CV:Ren Sagami
The elegant looking yet black-hearted wealthy he-iress. A powerful presence even among the many affluent students around her, she is a member of the elite family that owns the school. Her beauty and elegance as a cross-dressing he-iress earned her the second name, "The White Lily Fairy".
*The main heroine of this game!

- Reona Murasaki CV:Kagome Shiotani
Due to his refined appearance, charisma, and noble background, he is specially permitted to play a male prince-like role at the school. Having quickly become close friends with Iori, he looks out for him and helps him out in every way he can.

- Mahiro Senjuin CV: Ryouko Tezuka
The delinquent gyaru he-iress who rejects the established traditions of her strict buttoned-up family. Doesn't particularly want to dress as a woman, so she chooses to dress as a delinquent one as a form of passive protest.

- Asuka Senjuin CV: Suzuna
The gorgeous he-iress in ringlets. Referred to as "Empress of the Rose Garden", her immense pride in her own family lineage frequently becomes a point of contention between her and Mikage.

- Shizuka Kiriyama CV: Marina Ohno
Iori and Reona's childlike homeroom teacher. She is highly popular among students for her extremely cute un-teacher-like appearance and utterances.

70010000085975.name: pureya
70010000085975.description:
Simple arcade games are great, but they can get boring quickly. What if they changed every 10 seconds?

Pureya is a collection of arcade minigames that play with just 2 buttons. Every 10 seconds, the game will jump from one random minigame to another.

Avoid obstacles and collect as many marbles as you can, then use them in the pachinko machine to unlock new mini games, music and skins.

Enjoy a varied collection of 30+ minigames 10 seconds at a time or challenge them individually to aim for a high score.

Features:
- 30+ minigames
- Switch to a different minigame every 10 seconds
- Collect marbles and use them in the pachinko to unlock new minigames, music and skins
- Quick and easy: plays with just 2 buttons
- Dynamic difficulty for all skill levels
- Dynamic original music with linked 10 seconds tracks

70010000085980.name: Anime Girls: Lady Liberty
70010000085980.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000085980.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000085982.name: Anime Girls: Beautiful Bride
70010000085982.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000085982.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000085984.name: Anime Girls: Natty Nurse
70010000085984.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000085984.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000085986.name: Anime Girls: Busty Baseball
70010000085986.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000085986.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000085988.name: Anime Girls: Graceful Goddess
70010000085988.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000085988.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000085991.name: Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land
70010000085991.intro: Walk the forbidden path, no matter where it leads.
70010000085991.description:
People gather memories as they live their lives, thus developing their souls. This is the story of a young woman traveling across a ruined continent to find the path toward the future.

The theme of this game is "memory." There are moments when everyone must confront the past and their own memories. All memories, including both successes and failures, become nourishment for the future and help shape people. "Atelier Yumia" tells the story of Yumia and her companions as they follow the path they believe in while being confronted by the memories they discover along the way.

Story:
In a world where alchemy is deemed "taboo," the alchemist Yumia yearns for the truth the lies hidden in a ruined continent. The time has come for her to take the first step on her grand adventure across the continent.

Main features:
- Freely traverse the vast open field in all directions
The continent is an unexplored land where the player can use a wide range of items and actions to forge their path forward.

- Game cycle
Explore the field and gather ingredients in order to synthesize items. The items you create are key to advancing the story and can be used for combat and further exploration. You can also use "Simple Synthesis" to create items while you are out in the field and construct bases using the "Building" feature.

- Create items while out in the field and customize bases however you like!
You can use Simple Synthesis to create exploration tools for opening the path forward, as well as items that will benefit you during combat and synthesis. You can also use the Building feature to construct bases and then decorate them with furniture to your liking.

Note: Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details. Please be aware that other editions containing this product exist. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

70010000086002.name: GhostlyRyokan
70010000086002.intro: An abandoned inn where lost souls wander, your decision will determine its outcome.
70010000086002.description:
The truth about the horror and tragedy hidden in an abandoned ryokan. You step into an abandoned ryokan where ghosts wander about, and you will discover the mystery of a terrible tragedy that occurred in the past. The ghost of a maid who once worked there still wanders the inn and drags visitors into the depths of fear.

Players will be forced to make the ultimate choice: to search through the horror-filled inn and collect hidden clues, or to release the spirit or release the grudge. Will you be able to escape the inn safely?

In this horror adventure game with multiple endings, the choices you make will greatly affect the outcome of the story. In the beautiful and eerie Japanese-style world of the inn, your decisions will determine the fate of the inn.

Will you survive the horror of the inn - or will you be trapped forever?

70010000086005.name: The Little Mermaid: Wonder Puzzles
70010000086005.intro: With over 100 images and three game modes, it's perfect for kids and juniors. Have fun solving all the puzzles. Ideal for little explorers!
70010000086005.description:
"The Little Mermaid: Wonder Puzzles" is a captivating puzzle game featuring 100 adorable mermaid world puzzles. With three different game modes, you can choose the number of pieces for each puzzle and enjoy all levels unlocked from the start, allowing you to play at your own pace.

-Select from three different game modes.
-Choose the number of pieces for each puzzle.
-A gallery with over 100 seascapes
-Enjoy 100 puzzles featuring adorable sea creatures and characters.

Can you complete all the puzzles and unlock all the backgrounds?

70010000086012.name: The Nightmare Journey
70010000086012.intro: Solve puzzles and uncover mysteries to escape the darkness that consumes souls.
70010000086012.description:
In a peculiar and macabre universe, little Arthur faces his greatest fears, nightfall is what scares him the most, in this brief period of darkness his syndromes transcend the limits of the psychic, monsters are always on the prowl, will this time he escape ?
     Millennia of years ago, the Elders wrote an ancient ancient legend on the stones: 'Every night the wandering souls of darkness disturb the dreams of energetic beings, at nightfall a pure-blooded creature is chosen and the boundaries of reality between the worlds are broken. .'
As it all indicates Arthur was chosen this time, and his journey through the nightmare will not be easy, the dark creatures in a parallel universe want to consume his soul.
    The Nightmare Journey is a stylized game with unique graphics set in a 2D universe, in which Arthur is the main character, he must overcome different challenges and puzzles, mysteries are not lacking in this game.

70010000086027.name: Urban Skater - Skateboard Delivery City Challenge
70010000086027.intro: Deliver fast, skate faster Become the citys coolest delivery rider.
70010000086027.description:
Welcome to Urban Skater - Skateboard Delivery City Challenge, an adrenaline-fueled adventure that puts you on wheels – or rather, a board – like never before! Strap on your helmet, grab your skateboard, and prepare to become the fastest (and coolest) food delivery person in town. Race against time, weave through bustling city streets, and deliver piping hot meals to hungry customers in this fast-paced and exhilarating experience.

Key Features:
- Become a Delivery Pro: Step into the shoes of a dedicated delivery rider, tasked with navigating the urban jungle. Dodge pedestrians, cyclists, and car traffic as you race against the clock to deliver delicious food across a vibrant metropolis.
- Dynamic Urban Playground: The city is your playground! Encounter unique challenges with every delivery. Master the ever-changing traffic patterns and unpredictable pedestrians that populate the streets.
- Intuitive Skateboarding: Hone your skills with easy-to-learn controls that allow you to carve, grind, and ollie your way through the city. Perform sick tricks and maneuvers to avoid obstacles and maintain momentum.
- Beat the Clock: The pressure is on! Test your speed and agility as you race against the clock to deliver before the food gets cold. Can you satisfy those hungry customers and become the delivery champion?
- Challenge Accepted: Take on a variety of delivery missions, from navigating narrow alleyways to dodging oncoming traffic and conquering steep inclines. As you level up, new challenges will test your skills and push you to the limit.
- Express Yourself: Personalize your delivery rider with unique outfits and accessories. Don't forget to customize your skateboard deck to truly stand out in the crowded streets!

70010000086032.name: Mimi the Cat: New Friends
70010000086032.intro: Join Mimi in 'Mimi the Cat: New Friends' - A Heartwarming Sokoban Puzzle Adventure!
70010000086032.description:
Join Mimi in 'Mimi the Cat: New Friends' - A Heartwarming Sokoban Puzzle Adventure!

Welcome to Mimi's world!
In "Mimi the Cat: New Friends," you'll embark on a charming journey with Mimi, a delightful cat who loves puzzles and making new friends. Your mission is to help Mimi navigate through a variety of fun and challenging levels, moving, climbing, and stacking boxes to find her way to new friends and cozy spots.

Help Mimi move, climb, or carry boxes to reach her bed and rest.
Guide Mimi through 50 engaging levels where each puzzle brings new surprises and challenges. Use your strategic thinking to position boxes perfectly, allowing Mimi to progress and meet new friends along the way. It's a delightful blend of puzzle-solving and exploration!

Intuitive and easy-to-learn controls for everyone.
With simple tap and swipe controls, "Mimi the Cat: New Friends" is accessible and enjoyable for players of all ages. Whether you're moving boxes, climbing them, or figuring out how to stack them, the intuitive controls make it a breeze to help Mimi.

Relax and enjoy the journey with no time limits.
Take your time to solve each puzzle at your own pace. There’s no rush in Mimi’s world, just the joy of solving puzzles and helping Mimi make new friends. It's the perfect game to unwind and relax with, offering a peaceful and stress-free experience.

Explore 50 charming and unique levels.
Each level in "Mimi the Cat: New Friends" presents a new challenge and a chance to discover something special. With a variety of puzzles and adorable settings, this game offers endless fun and heartwarming moments. Join Mimi and her new friends in this enchanting puzzle adventure!

70010000086051.name: Puzzle Master: The Ultimate Challenge of Wits
70010000086051.intro: Puzzle Master: Unleash Your Genius, Piece by Piece!
70010000086051.description:
Dive into a mesmerizing world of brain-bending puzzles and intricate mosaics with Puzzle Master. This game is designed to test your intellect and creativity through a series of captivating challenges. Piece together stunning mosaics, solve complex riddles, and unlock new levels of cerebral excitement.

Featuring:

Diverse Puzzles: Enjoy a wide variety of puzzles, from classic jigsaws to innovative new formats, each designed to push your problem-solving skills to the limit.
Beautiful Mosaics: Create breathtaking mosaic art as you progress, revealing stunning visuals with every piece you place correctly.
Challenging Levels: Overcome increasingly difficult levels that will keep you engaged and thinking critically.
Relaxing Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in a soothing soundtrack that enhances your puzzle-solving experience.
Intuitive Controls: Easy-to-learn controls make the game accessible for all ages, while the depth of puzzles ensures it remains challenging for seasoned players.
Are you ready to become the ultimate Puzzle Master? Sharpen your wits, piece by piece, and embark on an unforgettable journey of logic and creativity!

70010000086056.name: EGGCONSOLE SILVER GHOST PC-8801mkIISR
70010000086056.intro: A masterpiece that brilliantly merges simulation and RPG genres with a medieval backdrop. Will the prince be able to reclaim Camelot Castle!?
70010000086056.description:
This game, released in 1988 in Japan, is a simulation game. The player takes on the role of Prince Lancelot, who rises to reclaim Camelot Castle.

The game uses a strategy map to move troops, and when engaging enemy forces on the map, it switches to a real-time battle system where soldiers fight in real-time. Although it may initially seem like an RTS, each character has a defined personality, with injured characters choosing to leave the battlefield to rest, and archers trying to maintain distance from the enemy. Some units are stubborn and refuse to retreat, adding a layer of individuality to the battlefield. This personality system leads to diverse and dynamic combat scenarios. Additionally, characters can level up and become stronger through repeated battles, adding an element of character progression.

The game also features a narrative aspect, with scenarios where traveling across various battlefields and regions can increase allies and obtain new equipment. Occasionally, boss battles occur, offering dramatic and engaging adventures. This game successfully combines the best elements of simulation and RPG systems.

As the first title in the Gochakara series, it continues to be supported by retro game fans. It's a highly recommended title for players who enjoy both simulation and narrative-driven RPG elements.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000086059.name: Anime Girls: Lovely Lolita
70010000086059.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000086059.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000086061.name: Raiden NOVA
70010000086061.intro: "Raiden" unites! Get ready to blast into a thrilling new dimension like never before!
70010000086061.description:
The legendary vertical scrolling shooter "Raiden" is reborn as a thrilling twin-stick 2D shooter! Freely aim and shoot with dual sticks, dodging bullets from every direction.
Level up to unlock a variety of weapons and enhancements, and upgrade your ship to fight your way through epic battles.
 
Features:
 
•	Navigate your ship with the left analog stick and aim your shots with the right analog stick. Dodge attacks from all directions at 360 degrees, and strike back!

•	Craft your ultimate build by various weapons and ship upgrades as you progress. Conquer the intense, unrelenting battles ahead.

•	Take control of all Raiden aircraft from Raiden to Raiden V and test your skills in the ultimate challenge mode!

70010000086065.name: Rolling Football Player
70010000086065.intro: Rolling Football Player is a bizarre athletic game where an eternally rolling soccer player takes on athletic challenges! Push your limits in single-player mode!
70010000086065.description:
Rolling Football Player is an action game where a soccer player, heavily influenced by parody, rolls through athletic challenges! Clear five stages set in various city locations, including houses, parks, warehouses, and more!

Estimated playtime:
30 minutes to 240 minutes

Game description:
The game includes five stages, each with a unique theme. After selecting a stage, you can choose between "Easy Mode" with checkpoints and "Normal Mode" without checkpoints, making it accessible even for beginners.
Each stage contains three hidden soccer balls, and collecting them will unlock new stages. Additionally, the game tracks your completion time, so aim for a new record with each challenge!
Enjoy this game, created with the free imagination of students!

70010000086070.name: Girls of The Tower
70010000086070.intro: 'Girls of The Tower' is a Rogue-like game with a combination of JRPG, auto chess, and galgame elements.
70010000086070.description:
Game Introduction
This is a Rogue-like game with a combination of JRPG, auto chess, and galgame elements. Players can choose from two different female protagonists to embark on a unique adventure. Additionally, players can recruit followers, strategize their formations, and develop their town! 

Background
After centuries since the last war, Geoffrey of the Black God Cult, who was defeated in the previous events, did not die. However, the power of the demons was weakened, and they all lurked within the human world. Geoffrey and the demon clan began to execute new plans to break the seal, and a conspiracy was brewing in the shadows...

Features
