The game features dozens of minion cards, each with unique skills and effects, showcasing their individual characteristics. Every minion possesses distinct racial effects that, when activated, enhance different racial attributes, making battles significantly more manageable.

There are four main female protagonists in the game, each forming diverse and engaging storylines. Try starting the game with different protagonists for varied experiences.

The game incorporates mild Rogue elements, including diverse combinations of minions, equipment, and artifacts. Additionally, players can explore various random events within the game.

Towns play a crucial role in the game. By interacting with NPCs and upgrading the town, players can significantly enhance the freshness of gameplay.

70010000086075.name: Magic Cats Pots
70010000086075.description:
Step into a cozy world where fixing broken porcelain is full of surprises! In this fun puzzle game, you’ll put together teapots, cups, and plates—and sometimes, you’ll find a magical moving porcelain cat hidden inside!


Features:
- Fun Puzzle Gameplay: Fit pieces together to fix up broken porcelain items like teapots, cups, and plates.
- 126 Different Puzzles: Tons of unique pieces to restore, each with its own charm.
- Hidden Magical Cats: Sometimes a piece will surprise you with a cute, moving porcelain cat inside!
- Choose Your Challenge: Play at your own pace with three difficulty levels—from easy to tricky.
- Never the Same Puzzle: Each puzzle is different, so you’ll always get a fresh challenge every time you play.
- Replay for More Fun: After completing a level, replay it for a new twist!


Fix, discover, and enjoy the magic of cats—one puzzle at a time!

70010000086080.name: Skater Bunny Simulator
70010000086080.intro: Unleash your skate skills and hop to new heights with Skater Bunny Simulator!
70010000086080.description:
Skater Bunny Simulator is a vibrant and thrilling skateboarding simulator where you control not just any character, but a stylish and daring bunny. With intuitive dual stick controls, you'll feel like a real skateboarder. Practice managing the bunny's movements and weight to master the nuances of virtual skateboarding, while realistic and smooth physics make the riding process engaging and believable.
In the game, you'll encounter unforgettable missions that require performing complex tricks and combinations. Beautiful and varied locations immerse you in the world of street extreme sports, and a progressive tutorial system helps you quickly grasp the basics of control so you can enjoy every trick you land.
Show off your individuality with deep customization options. In the game, you can customize your skateboard's appearance, including wheels, deck, and trucks, and choose stylish outfits for your bunny character. Earn money, complete quests, and spend it in shops to upgrade your gear and add even more uniqueness to your character.
Skater Bunny Simulator offers you not just a game, but a whole world of exciting skateboarding adventures, where every trick and every location becomes a personal achievement.

70010000086085.name: HEAVEN SEEKER ――The Savior of This Cruel World
70010000086085.intro: "HEAVEN SEEKER ――The Savior of This Cruel World" is a twin-stick rogue-lite shooter where you take your own shot at the castle in the sky!
70010000086085.description:
・Explore a dungeon that changes each time you enter.
In this title, you move with the left stick and aim with the right stick.
This is a bullet hell shooting game where you freely control your character and explore random dungeons.
When your HP reaches 0, you will lose all the items you have gained during this exploration.
The player gains experience by exploring many times and learning the patterns of the rooms and the nature of the enemies.

・Create your own "Magic Shot!"
The shot fired by the player character can be modified by freely combining over 20 customizable items to change its properties.
Since items are randomly acquired during each quest, players will fight with a different "personalized shot" each time they dive into a dungeon.

70010000086090.name: Fetch Quest Remastered
70010000086090.intro: Did you bring your character sheet this time? We can’t start the game if you don’t know who your character is…anyway…we have an item to retrieve, do you accept this quest?
70010000086090.description:
Fetch Quest Remastered is a visual novel that expands the hit game Fetch Quest with more content, upgraded graphics and unlockable extras through different story routes.

Would-be adventurer Flora accepts a job to retrieve a stolen item for a shady bartender. To retrieve the item, she'll have to infiltrate a group of notorious bandits by posing as a new recruit.

Fortunately, she has the help of two other adventurers…
…unfortunately, they are completely useless without her!

According to the strangely vocal narrator, this would have gone more smoothly if everyone had remembered to make their characters beforehand...

Join Flora and her (poorly-prepared) companions Connor and Todd on their role-playing (mis)adventure and help them complete the quest that their resourceful Dungeon Master has planned for them. 

Features:
- Discover multiple endings depending on your choices in-game
- Enjoy the game remastered with HD graphics and illustrations
- Follow your heart and choose between two love interests
- Unlock additional content through your choices
- A new True Ending that leads into a sequel
- ~2 hours of reading time
- 1 internet meme

70010000086104.name: CULT VS GAL
70010000086104.intro: This gal doesn't mess around when it comes to cults...
70010000086104.description:
Imperial year 248.

The empire is in the midst of deteriorating security, hopeless diplomatic relations, and endless war. The oppressed people of the devastated society believe in the apocalypse, and soon a huge armed organization rises up.

People were kidnapped by the organization and disappeared one by one. The empire sent its own troops to the organization, but they were all destroyed.

The imperial army, unable to devote its strength to the country due to the worsening war situation with neighboring countries, transferred one gal to an armed organization, Galwoya.

Her name? Saki “Hell Smasher” Daigokuin. And she is the empire’s last hope.

CULT VS GAL is a fast-paced, old-school FPS packed with high-octane action. Your job? To step into the shoes of Saki “Hell Smasher” Daigokuin and annihilate the cult that threatens the empire. Complete with seven different versions of the ending theme song!

70010000086109.name: Brain training!! Hiragana＆Katakana Search
70010000086109.intro:
Find the indicated letters among many letters!
This is a brain training game to train your quick thinking skills!
70010000086109.description:
Among many colorful letters,
Find the indicated letters within the time limit.
It is a brain training game.

It is easy to play.
・Look at the problem image carefully.
・When you find the indicated letter, touch it within the time limit!
The part that seems easy to understand if you look at the image carefully but it is surprisingly difficult when you have a time limit!

When you are not sure how to solve a puzzle, you can try to solve it by touching the letters! When you can't figure it out!
Try pressing the “Hint” button.
(I'll tell you approximately where it is.)

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000086114.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3
70010000086114.intro: The dramatic RPG Fuga: Melodies of Steel series is now complete!
70010000086114.description:
Unveil the Source of the World's Despair!
 
Malt has vanished without a trace! The children are led by a mysterious voice into the forbidden cave, where they discover the Taranis—the powerful tank thought lost in the sea of clouds. Determined to save Malt, the children reboard the Taranis and set off on a daring mission to infiltrate the heart of the Berman Empire. However, the Crimson Knights stand in their way, strongest of the Berman!
 
Brand-New Battle System
The battle system has undergone substantial changes. Weakness combos allow you to exploit enemy weaknesses and deal escalating damage with every hit, and assist attacks allow erstwhile enemies and a legendary warrior from past games to join forces and turn the tide of battle!
 
Upgraded Intermission
Intermission now features an upgraded system to evolve the Taranis to its ultimate form! Unlock its hidden powers with the Omega Terminal and master new Taranis Skills to aid your journey!
 
Strategic Route Progression and Event Battles
Explore new strategic features like Power Spots to unlock the Taranis's hidden abilities and Assist Transmissions that allow you to interact with supporting characters. Discover secret events through the Akasha Panel, which lets you navigate a timeline to change your fate!
 
Step beyond despair, anger, and tragedy in Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3, where heart-wrenching decisions lead to the series' most emotional and shocking story yet!

*It's not necessary to play Fuga: Melodies of Steel or Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2 to enjoy Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3.

70010000086124.name: Real Cake Maker
70010000086124.intro: Grab your mixer and let the cake-making fun begin!
70010000086124.description:
Become the best cake baker in town and create the yummiest cakes in this delicious cooking adventure!

What kind of cake do you love? Whatever it is, you can bake it! From dreamy frosting to delightful decorations, design cakes that look as good as they taste. Show off your creations to friends, throw a fabulous cake party, or compete in exciting baking contests for the chance to be crowned the cake champ!

Features:
● learn how to bake the most delicious cakes!
● use professional baker tools for baking, designing and decorating!
● decorate your cakes with lots of frostings, decorations, and toppers to make it look special!
● throw cake parties with your adorable animal friends and make each celebration memorable
● join baking contests, vote for your favorite cakes, and win the first prize!
● dress up like the true baker you are! Put on a pretty chef’s hat and a cute apron
● enjoy a collection of fun coloring pages to inspire your artistic side

Bake up some joy and sweeten your day with fun creations!

70010000086126.name: Buffet Boss
70010000086126.intro: Cook your way to the top and rule the restaurant scene!
70010000086126.description:
Step into the fast-paced world of Buffet Boss, where you’re not just cooking - you’re building a culinary empire! 

Start as a humble entrepreneur and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate chef, bartender, and manager.

As your restaurant grows, so do the challenges. Keep your customers happy, manage overcrowded dining rooms, and make sure your team is always at their best. The more successful you become, the more obstacles you’ll face, but with the right strategy, you’ll dominate the industry!

Features:
● Whip up a variety of mouth-watering dishes and refreshing drinks!
● Serve your guests quickly and keep your restaurant spotless!
● Train your staff to perfection and upgrade your kitchen equipment
● Expand your restaurant to become the biggest and best in town!

Prove your skills, overcome every challenge, and rise to the top as the Buffet Boss!

70010000086128.name: Fly Fly
70010000086128.intro: Fly Fly is an endless game where players take flight as an eagle, collecting feathers while navigating through randomly generated hoops at varying distances.
70010000086128.description: Missing a hoop costs the player a life, as does colliding with obstacles. Feathers can be used to purchase different eagles with unique attributes such as speed, extra lives, or better maneuverability.

70010000086133.name: Pearls of Atlantis: The Cove
70010000086133.intro: Match 3 pearls to collect charms, beat tricky physics levels, and solve puzzles!
70010000086133.description:
Magic pearls to match and pop, a treasure cove to uncover, and an underwater paradise… Pearls of Atlantis awaits—now, you can color match in a whole new way!

Dive in and find the lost city of mermaids and mystery! Match 3 pearls of the same color to collect the magic charms inside. Then, use the charms to restore a once-beautiful part of Atlantis, the underwater city, and protect the mermaids!

But getting the most magic charms won’t be easy. You’ll need to face tricky underwater physics and solve over 1,500 upside down bubble shooter levels! Navigate bumpers, wheels, platforms, locked pearls and more as you solve these puzzles. Don’t forget your favorite power-ups, like the explosive hammer, the friendly charm grabbing jellyfish, and Triton’s frightful lightning to smash all the obstacles in your way! It takes strategy and precision to beat these unique bubble shooter puzzles.

As you venture into the depths of the sea, you’ll discover the Cove of Memories, a once-glorious part of the hidden city, Atlantis. Now, it lies in ruins… but you’re not alone in your quest to uncover its secrets and turn it back into a paradise!

You’ll meet Kaia, a bubbly mermaid who will guide you on your journey. She’s the first one to introduce you to these colorful marbles… that turn out to be magic  pearls!

Along with Kaia’s sidekick Nauty, a comical companion who’s always up for some fun, there will be more mermaids and fish to meet. Don’t forget to watch out for the villains who lurk in the shadows, waiting to sabotage your every move!

Customize and decorate the Cove of Atlantis to make it your own. Maybe some new colorful coral here, or beautiful statues there… it’s your choice. The more puzzles you solve and magic you gather, the more of the cove you’ll uncover, explore, and decorate! With your help, the mermaids can build a whole new Atlantis!

Enjoy counting pearls as you drop and match hundreds of pearls in this exciting physics based, upside down bubble shooter.

With daily challenges and special events like the Zen Mode, Treasure Run and Bottomless Trench, you’ll play any way you want. Whether you’re pop matching every single pearl to clear the screen with infinite turns, or racing against the counter, there’s a way for you to enjoy your time underwater.

Every day is a new adventure in Pearls of Atlantis! So what are you waiting for? Dive into the deep blue sea and start your journey today with PEARLS OF ATLANTIS: a free mermaid match bubble shooter, with an all new twist!

70010000086135.name: Unsolved Case: The Scarlet Hyacinth CE
70010000086135.intro: Chase down the suspect behind a serial killing!
70010000086135.description:
A whole series of crimes happens right before your eyes: a murder in an alley, abductions in broad daylight, not to mention your boss being shot… Are you a seasoned enough detective to  deal with it all?

Step into your first case, in which a man was murdered with a blooming red hyacinth left on his body – the sign of a notorious serial killer from many years ago. But this particular killer has been dormant for a long time… is it a copycat? Or has the killer come back from beyond?

The story only gets more complicated… and more personal. With the involvement of your psychologist, Mark Coleman, and the killing of your boss, you have no choice but to get the culprit behind bars as soon as possible. 

But there is another urgent matter: people are disappearing from their cars. Then, the journalist Noah Hall, famous for covering the Red Hyacinth’s serial killings, is murdered as well. How is it all connected?

Can you stop this wave of crime? Are you ready to apply your brilliant detective mind to do that? 

The Collector’s Edition game includes:
• Excellent graphics and voice overs
• 7 crime-filled chapters
• 8th Collector’s Edition bonus chapter
• 18 hidden object puzzle scenes and 22 mini-games
• Customizable difficulty levels
• Behind-the-scenes collection of beautiful concept art

70010000086137.name: Royal Romances: Forbidden Magic Collector's Edition
70010000086137.intro: What can a human do in a desperate situation, all for the chance of love… or power?
70010000086137.description:
Is it possible to overcome obstacles through hope or faith in love? Lead your valiant heroes through the thorny path to their most cherished desires and find out!

The murky air becomes heavier and harder to breathe, monsters roam the forest, and dark magic taint smothers everything within its reach. Ida and Illeon are about to strike, fulfilling their devious plan…  

Face battles with your people, find love and endure loss as you get ready to defend the lands from mortal threat! Do your best to catch your enemy… all while struggling against curses and magic to remain human! And… is there any chance of a happy ending for the evil witch? 

With unique riddles, intricate puzzles, and relaxing mini-games, tons of brave adventure awaits you. Solve brain teasers and find hidden objects to earn numerous achievements and highlight your success on your journey!

Can a simple bard defeat a monstrous werewolf? Can a villain change its nature? It’s up to you to find out!


The Collector’s Edition game includes:

•  Explore a fabulous fantasy world full of unexpected heroes and spectacular sceneries
• Make hard choices to influence people’s fates and even entire kingdoms
• Play intricate puzzles and relaxing mini-games to earn a variety of achievements
• Keep an eye out for many different collectible items
• 3 magical chapters chapters, plus a Collector’s Edition bonus chapter
• Behind-the-scenes collection of beautiful concept art
• Customizable difficulty levels
• Useful fast-travel map to keep your adventure on track

70010000086139.name: Unsolved Case: Above the Law CE
70010000086139.intro: Nothing brings people together as well as a common grief... or crime!
70010000086139.description:
A powerful villain has no fear of the law. After the high-profile murder of the mayor, it becomes clear that anyone could be a target. Do not let him escape justice! 

To track down this criminal, you’ll need to dive into the murky depths of the underworld. The first step is going undercover and bluffing your way into a private billiards club… that’s where damning, crucial evidence lays! But if only an investigation could be so simple...

To make matters even more complicated, your new partner is too young and immature to understand how dangerous the game you’re involved in is… And not only him, but you also must understand that sometimes even justice goes over to the dark side. 

Can you defeat the bad guys together with your scattered allies, or at least... stay alive?

There are tons of new cases to tackle in this installment of the Unsolved Case series. Track down evidence, speak to suspects, crack complex puzzles, and make choices that determine the outcomes… for better or for worse!

This Collector's Edition includes:
• Excellent graphics and voice overs
• 4 full chapters, with a new mystery in each
• A special Collector’s Edition bonus chapter!
• 32 hidden object puzzle scenes and 35 mini-games
• Collectibles and morphing objects to find
• Customizable difficulty levels
• Behind-the-scenes collection of beautiful concept art

70010000086141.name: Royal Romances: Power of the Chosen One Collector's Edition
70010000086141.intro: With the power to command the dragons, the Chosen One could be a great hero… or foe!
70010000086141.description:
After werewolves, witches, and evil magic, you finally have a chance to catch your breath. Or do you…? Don’t get too comfortable, because Ida and all her witchery is on your trail, ready to seize the untethered power of the Chosen One and become invincible. She is ever closer to her goals, and the final battle is coming…

The situation may seem grim, but there is hope on the horizon… the very prophecy of a Chosen One that Ida is after! Once the Chosen One returns, they will be able to command the dragons.  In Ida’s search for the mystery hero, she took Glissando, but failed while trying to kidnap Princess Amelia… who might just be the real Chosen One. But beware: the witch won’t give up so easily! 

Not to mention, Ida isn’t the only one stirring up trouble. There is also the matter of King Illeon preparing a final assault on the forest, and he has a story of his own, too… 

The wise Great Ent knows you don't give up quite that easily. The fate of the forest and the love of your life are upon your shoulders!

Old friends, a settlement of fairies, and many ancient creatures will come to your aid as you explore the magic forest and search for hidden objects in your quest to restore splendor and tranquility to the kingdom. See all there is to uncover in this magical world and be the force to tip the scale of fate!


The Collector’s Edition game includes:

• Enjoy an exciting new story in the bonus chapter for 7 chapters total!
• Revisit favorite minigames and hidden-object scenes whenever you want!
• Challenging achievements to unlock!
• Watch for hidden collectibles and morphing objects: Dragon Eggs, Dragon Scales, and Magic Potions!
• Exciting puzzles, including jigsaws, stained glass hidden object puzzles, and weapon matching
• 10 extra mini-games included with this special Collector’s Edition

70010000086143.name: ARIDA: Backland's Awakening
70010000086143.intro: Face the drought to explore and meet the stories of the Brazilian backlands!
70010000086143.description:
A historical single player game with elements of adventure and survival.

Explore the aridest regions, collect resources and discover clues about the destiny of the young Cícera, a girl that faces the drought to explore the 19th-century Brazilian backlands to find her parents again.

FEATURE LIST:

Equipped to venture out
To survive in ÁRIDA you will need some equipment. Use the machete and hoe for essential actions such as getting water, opening paths, or cutting a corn crop. But do not forget to have a handful of grindstones because blunt equipment is of no use!

Get ready with recipes
To live in the backlands you need to be wise. The fauna and flora are unusual, so try to learn the recipes available for crafting with the typical items of the region. Maybe one day you need to cross the backlands ...

Interact to survive
Hunger and thirst can be very cruel in the backlands during the drought. Ask for help for the elders of your village and solve their quests to get some water and food.

Explore to know
Explore the aridest regions to learn more about the backlands and find the resources you need to stay on your way. A full inventory is always a good idea!

Stories to learn
The Brazilian backlands is a special place, with many stories that would only happen there. Venture out to search for the collectible lost objects and find out more about the legends of the backlands.

70010000086149.name: Shujinkou Digital Artbook
70010000086149.description:
The Shujinkou Digital Artbook contains over 35 wide pages of sketches and renders for character art, enemy art, backgrounds, environments, UI, minigame art, story illustrations, and more.

Take a look through a custom Table of Contents system and a selection of seven different songs to listen to as you peruse the artbook.

70010000086153.name: Spinning Puzzle　Compare the Universe
70010000086153.intro: Let's learn about space in a fun way with a quiz that rotates images! By comparing photos, you can get to know the universe even better!
70010000086153.description:
Simply arrange the images in the correct order for various space rankings and press the OK button!
This educational puzzle game allows you to relax with mesmerizing space images while also gaining cool trivia knowledge that makes you look smart.

How to Play is Simple:
・Read the question carefully.
・Slide the panels to arrange the three images in the correct order.
・If you get it right, you can read an explanation.

★ Arrange the planets in order of the fewest to most moons!
☆ Arrange the order of successful moon landings!
★ Arrange the components of the Earth in order of abundance!
And more!

Why not challenge yourself with brain-training quizzes on various space-related topics, from planets and constellations to historical events?
If you clear them all, you might just become a space expert starting today!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000086155.name: Supermarket 3D Tycoon Buisness Simulator
70010000086155.intro: Manage your resources wisely, expand your business strategically, and watch your empire grow!
70010000086155.description:
Step into the shoes of a budding entrepreneur in Supermarket 3D Tycoon Buisness Simulator, a 3D open-world simulation game that brings the excitement of building a retail empire to life. Begin your journey by purchasing an old, run-down market and transform it into a bustling hypermarket.

Key Features:

Realistic Business Growth: Start small and work your way up by buying a variety of products and selling them at competitive prices. Use your profits to upgrade your supermarket, improve facilities, and enhance your inventory.

Open World Exploration: Navigate a detailed open world that mirrors real-life business activities. Visit the bank to secure loans for expanding your business, and drop by the town hall to acquire essential licenses.

Personal Management: Balance your personal life and business responsibilities. Stop by the local burger store to refuel your energy, and head home to rest and prepare meals.

Security Challenges: Protect your store from thieves aiming to steal your products. Defend your market, retrieve stolen goods, and keep your business safe.

Maintenance Duties: Keep your supermarket clean and well-maintained to attract more customers and ensure smooth operations.

Experience the thrill of entrepreneurship and turn your small market into a hypermarket empire in Supermarket 3D Tycoon Buisness Simulator. Manage your resources wisely, expand your business strategically, and watch your empire grow!

70010000086160.name: The Phantom
70010000086160.intro: Comics’ very first costumed hero has arrived on Nintendo Switch™ with only his physical strength, skill with weapons and fearsome reputation to fight crime!
70010000086160.description: The Phantom is an arcade-style beat-em-up coming to PC and consoles. Play as The Phantom or his partner, Diana Palmer, in this 14-level adventure. The feared pirates of the Singh Brotherhood are battling for power and threatening The Phantom’s legacy, and it’s up to you to stop them. Use your hand-to-hand fighting skills and trusty weapons to dispatch this evil, and call in assistance from your animal friends Fraka the falcon and Devil the wolf. The Phantom features a brand-new story approved by King Features. Experience this canon addition through full-screen cut scenes and captivating in-game visuals, hand-illustrated and animated frame-by-frame by seasoned comic book artists and Art Of Play’s dedicated in-house 2D creative team.

70010000086164.name: Shujinkou Select Soundtrack
70010000086164.description: The Shujinkou Select Soundtrack contains 22 handpicked music tracks from the game, including special battle, labyrinth, minigame, character themes, and more!

70010000086171.name: Animal Zoo: The Forgotten Land
70010000086171.intro: Dive into this exciting visual novel. Join Luna, the wise owl, and Max, the brave tiger, along with their friends: Roco the mouse, Pepe the penguin, and Nina the giraffe.
70010000086171.description:
As our protagonists explore the zoo, they discover secret tunnels, ancient inscriptions, and intriguing clues that lead them to hidden places full of surprises.

On their journey, the animals face challenges, deactivate traps, and find artifacts that reveal the zoo's history and secrets.

Each step they take brings them closer to solving the puzzle, while learning valuable lessons about friendship, courage, and teamwork.

Luna and her friends not only seek to restore peace to their home, but also to protect the zoo's legacy for future generations.

The story is filled with moments of collaboration, ingenuity, and bravery, accompanied by beautiful full-color illustrations and plenty of friendly animals.

70010000086174.name: Necro Story
70010000086174.intro: A creature-collection RPG where you play as a powerful necromancer. Summon hordes of undead and upgrade your necromancy spells to defeat your enemies.
70010000086174.description:
Necro Story is a light-hearted creature collection RPG where you play as a powerful and (kind of) evil Necromancer. Helped by the ghost of a playful white mage, you must sneak into the Underworld to save humanity.
Over 20 necromancy spells are available, spread across 5 schools of magic: Affliction, Darkness, Life Stealing, Summoning and Dark Pacts. Each spell has its own dedicated skill tree. Upgrade them wisely to carve out your own path learning Necromancy.
Capture your enemies' sousl! Don’t let them fly away! Take control of them and turn your enemies into powerful allies. Choose which teammates to bring into battle, manage their equipment and their skills to get the most out of them. Don’t forget to summon zombies and skeletons to further fill out your ranks.

70010000086179.name: Firebat - Revolution
70010000086179.intro: Break every brick in this retro pixel art adventure!
70010000086179.description:
Firebat - Revolution is a brick-breaker game with retro graphics and music reminiscent of the demo-scene era. Follow the game's story, upgrade the ball and the pad, progress on the islands step by step, break down obstacles brick by brick.

The Firebats live under the oppression of Morningstar and his Lieutenants. Hope returns to their nation as one heroine starts to explore the Underworld, after finding the Sphera Artificium and the Machina. These ancient, technological relics from their forgotten past will help you to break all bricks, to defeat the oppressors, to reveal the past of the Firebats and to find a way out of this cursed place. Test your skills on challenge and hidden levels, collect Fire Pearls to upgrade the Sphera and the Machina (ball and pad). Meet the denizens of the Underworld, like Charon, who collects your Golden Credits, or other Firebats who can join your struggle.

70010000086191.name: Mission: Mars
70010000086191.intro: Defend humanity on the Red Planet — survive, shoot, and conquer the Martian invasion.
70010000086191.description:
The battle for survival has reached Mars.
In Mission: Mars, you are the last line of defense for Earth’s colonies on the Red Planet. Armed with customizable weapons, explosives, and survival gear, you must face endless waves of hostile alien creatures determined to wipe out humanity.

Set up mines, unleash devastating explosives, and fight through intense Martian landscapes. Every wave pushes your skills to the limit — can you survive the chaos and bring peace to Mars?

With fast-paced FPS action, explosive gameplay, and an atmosphere inspired by sci-fi survival shooters, Mission: Mars delivers an adrenaline-fueled fight for the future of mankind

70010000086198.name: Death Elevator
70010000086198.intro: Reach the Top or Die Trying!
70010000086198.description:
Enter the relentless world of Death Elevator, a sleek, low-poly FPS where every decision matters and every encounter could be your last. With a one-hit death mechanic and dynamic slow-motion, each battle demands precision and quick reflexes. Ascend through randomized floors, battling waves of enemies with ever-changing weapons, as you unravel the mystery behind the elevator.

Stripped of upgrades, skill trees, and progression systems, Death Elevator focuses purely on your skill. Compete for the highest scores and see how you stack up against others on the global leaderboard. Can you conquer the climb and claim your place at the top?

Features:

- Fast-paced movement and precision shooting
- Slow-motion triggers for intense combat moments
- Randomized rooms and weapon drops for varied gameplay
- Global leaderboard to compete with players worldwide

70010000086203.name: Vampire Hunters
70010000086203.intro: To hunt vampires, you'll need guns. Lots of guns. Mow down hordes of undead creatures by stacking your guns into absurd, over-the-top builds in this Roguelite Survivors FPS.
70010000086203.description:
Shoot, stack – and slay!
Vampire Hunters is a unique FPS that combines the adrenaline-pumping action of classic shooters with the innovative mechanics of the beloved Roguelite Survivors-likes.

Unleash your firepower as you stack up to 14 different weapons and craft absurd, impossibly awesome builds to mow down legions of vampires, demons, and other supernatural foes.

Control unique hunters — each with different abilities - and choose insane-yet-useful upgrades as you survive through the onslaught in this retro-inspired Bullet Heaven FPS.

- Lots of Guns: Stack up to 14 weapons to amass earth-shattering firepower.
- Mind-Blowing Builds: Collect every firearm – from the classic revolver to a high-pressure holy water hose.
- Upgrade, upgrade, upgrade! Explore unique playstyles with an addicting “just one more try” Roguelite gameplay.
- Infinite Mayhem: Slay vampires, demons, and everything undead by the thousands through steampunk-inspired imaginative levels.
- Unlike Anything Else: Enjoy this novel mix of old-school FPS with the unique Survivors-like gameplay.
- Absurd, Cheesy, and Fun: Experience a lighthearted tone with exciting electronic disco vibes that make every session a blast!

The undead are about to learn the meaning of bullet hell.

70010000086208.name: Extinction Rifts
70010000086208.intro: Extinction Rifts is a fast-paced FPS where you get stronger as your combo increases!
70010000086208.description:
As the Ancient Monoliths appeared and the wrong people took them over, the operation “Last Breath” started!

It’s just a matter of time until our extinction… Unless we can stop them!

Equip yourself by selecting between 8 different weapons and 5 unique skills, fight enemies on secret headquarters and make sure to destroy the Ancient Monoliths!

An absurd amount of power is required to destroy them! Luckily you’ve got the Extinction Gauntlet, a punching gadget that is connected to your adrenaline, making combos raises your adrenaline making your punches more destructive, only a truly powerful punch can obliterate a Monolith!

Can you destroy them all and avoid our extinction?

Features:
- Fast-paced combat and arcade gameplay
- Combo-based FPS where making combos makes you stronger
- Several secrets spread among the levels
- Varied special skills and weapons for different play styles
- Super high combo count allows the player to unleash the “Extinction Punch”, clearing the level at once
- High replayability with Several Ranks to achieve, unlocking new weapons and skills
- Multiple endings

70010000086225.name: EGGCONSOLE STAR CRUISER PC-8801mkIISR
70010000086225.intro: Become a bounty hunter and traverse the galaxy in your space fighter "STAR CRUISER" in this epic sci-fi adventure. Experience an  space opera in the space!
70010000086225.description:
With the construction of the interstellar warp device "Gravity Catapult" for space exploration, humanity ventured into three neighboring star systems. However, due to the rapid and extensive nature of this colonization, law enforcement from the Federal Patrol couldn't keep up, leading to deteriorating security in some regions. To counter this situation, the federal headquarters put bounties on notorious criminals and began recruiting individuals to become hunters to take them down... Ten years later, one day, A-class hunter Brian Wright infiltrated a criminal organization's secret base alone but found himself in a dire situation when his starship was destroyed.

"Star Cruiser" is an action RPG released by Arsys Software in 1988 in Japan. The game's most notable feature is its use of polygons to represent everything from vast outer space to dungeons, the player's ship, people, and trees. This use of polygons to depict the universe was a significant technical achievement that impressed users at a time when polygons were not yet widespread in the gaming industry.

In addition to its polygonal graphics, the game is known for its unique system that combines 3D action and RPG elements, a storyline that pleasantly surprises players, and characters with charmingly smug dialogues. Even 36 years after its release, the game remains an enjoyable experience.


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.
*There are scenes with flashing screens, so if you feel any discomfort, please stop playing the game. Also, those who have experienced such symptoms should refrain from playing it.

70010000086228.name: EGGCONSOLE MURDER CLUB PC-8801
70010000086228.intro: Detective J.B. Harold rushes to solve a mysterious murder case that occurred in the outskirts of Liberty Town. Uncover the truth of the case!
70010000086228.description:
Released by Riverhill Soft in 1986 in Japan, "Murder Club" is a command-based adventure game where players take on the role of Detective J.B. Harold to solve a case.

The game's most notable feature is that it is an adventure game tailored for adults. Unlike typical games designed for children, it lacks flashy developments and instead progresses through careful information gathering and extensive reasoning. While this may seem somewhat understated, this style of gameplay and presentation has been well-received by many fans, earning it recognition as a pioneer in the mystery adventure genre, with its name still widely known today.

As indicated by the tagline at the time, "The Case Files of Detective J.B. Harold," this is just one of the many cases solved by Detective J.B. Harold, and numerous sequels have since been released.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000086231.name: EGGCONSOLE TEMPLO DEL SOL: ASTEKA II PC-8801
70010000086231.intro: Embark on an adventure set in the ancient ruins of Chichen Itza, where you'll explore the Temple of the Sun and search for the Solar Key.
70010000086231.description:
This game, released in 1986 in Japan, is an adventure game and a sequel to the previous year's "Azteca." Players embark on an adventure set in the ancient ruins of Chichen Itza in Mexico, searching for the Temple of the Sun and the Sun Key. The game is divided into two parts: a field part with RPG-like controls for movement, and an adventure part where the screen switches at specific locations. In the adventure part, various actions can be performed by selecting different icons.

One of the main features of this game is its high difficulty level. While many adventure games can be solved by trying all possible commands, this game makes that approach impossible. Furthermore, it's possible to find yourself stuck without realizing it, and the game does not necessarily end with a game over when you're stuck. This creates a challenging and engaging experience. If you find that the game isn't progressing, rather than persisting in frustration, it may be necessary to start over and try a different approach.


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000086235.name: Shanghai Mahjong Solitaire Deluxe
70010000086235.intro: Embark on a Zen Puzzle Adventure – Over 900 Levels of Mindful Strategy and Endless Fun!
70010000086235.description:
Shanghai Mahjong Solitaire Deluxe: Card Game is a fun and easy-to-learn, addicting puzzle game! Rediscover the classic Mahjong Solitaire and embark on a brain-boosting adventure!
This game will challenge your mind with hundreds of puzzles for hours of endless fun. Each puzzle takes only 2-10 minutes to complete, offering quick and enjoyable gameplay. Whether you're seeking relaxation or a mental workout, our game strikes the perfect balance between zen and puzzle-solving excitement. Download Mahjong Solitaire today and rejuvenate your mind and soul.
Step into the enchanting world of Mahjong Solitaire: Classic, where strategy meets relaxation. This game combines the timeless charm of classic Mahjong with the strategic depth of chess, all set against peaceful, serene landscapes. With over 900 exciting levels, you'll face a variety of challenges to sharpen your puzzle-solving skills.
Perfect for both beginners and advanced players, Mahjong Solitaire will captivate you with its simple yet rewarding gameplay. It's ideal for filling your free time!

Features:
•	990 unique boards for months of fun.
•	Hints, Shuffle, and Zoom options to enhance gameplay.
•	Coins rewarded for each completed board.
•	Earn stars for every board cleared.
•	Compete globally with an online leaderboard.
•	Touch control ONLY.
•	Climb the global leaderboard with your best scores and compete with friends.

70010000086237.name: 1000 Questions Quiz! national flag
70010000086237.intro:
Let's memorize flags by solving 1000 questions!
If you solve all of them, you will be a flag master!
70010000086237.description:
Among the flags displayed on the screen,
The game is to look for the indicated flag among the flags displayed on the screen!

It is easy to play!
・Look at the flags to be displayed on the screen.
・Look at the question text
・Select the correct flag
It is easy to enjoy, so it is a great way to pass the time in your spare time!

If you can solve all the questions, you will be a flag master!

70010000086242.name: Water Blast Shooter - Wet Gun
70010000086242.intro: Get ready for non-stop action in epic water battles!
70010000086242.description:
Get ready to make a splash with Water Blast Shooter - Wet Gun! Dive into an exhilarating water gun showdown across multiple unique environments, from bustling poolside arenas to hidden water parks. Equipped with powerful water blasters, you’ll face off against rivals in a refreshing FPS adventure where quick reflexes and strategy are key.
Key Features:
- Diverse Battlegrounds: Battle across various maps, each with distinct layouts and vibrant settings to keep the action fresh.
- Immersive Water Combat: Soak your opponents with powerful blasts, dodge incoming sprays, and conquer each map with skill.
- Smooth Controls and Realistic Physics: Enjoy intuitive controls and lifelike water effects for a splash-worthy experience.
Dive into the ultimate water gun battle across a world of wet and wild arenas!

70010000086252.name: Ecchi Memories
70010000086252.intro: Let the bras hit the floor
70010000086252.description:
Why don't we play a little game to jog your memory? Impress the girls, and they might show you a bit of their "personality" ;)

Match the cards within the time limit in this bra-dropping memory game. It gets harder the further you get... If you can do it in time, you'll see something your eyes will never forget.

Features:
- 5 beautiful girls (clothes optional)
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Enjoy an unforgettable experience and make some ecchi memories.

70010000086254.name: Snow Bros. Wonderland
70010000086254.intro: Winter is coming. Snow Bros. is back in this brand-new adventure by Tatsujin!
70010000086254.description:
ICE PELLETS AND SNOWBALLS
The legendary Snow Bros. series began over 30 years ago. Snow Bros. Wonderland is the newest chapter—and boy, has a lot changed in the last couple of decades! For starters, the graphics aren’t two-dimensional anymore; the new game offers a gorgeous 3D isometric style. Armed with an endless supply of ice pellets, gamers can turn monsters into snowballs, which can be kicked to destroy whole hordes of foes! Attacks can be chained to take down multiple enemies at once, and your snowball skills will be put to the ultimate test against some truly massive bosses. Are you (snow)man enough to defend Snow Land from evil King Atchich?

FOUR TIMES THE FUN
Previously, Snow Bros. was always a two-player game (which makes perfect sense given the name), but this time, the number of players has doubled! Now, you can have up to four players at once, making the adventure even more fun to experience. After all, shared joy is double the joy, and quadrupled joy is even better! Oh, and did you know that you can also customize your snowy avatar with hats, goggles, scarves, and all kinds of fun stuff? Find your own style!

THE HISTORY OF SNOW BROS
The first game in the chilly, snowy Snow Bros. saga was released in 1990, featuring two snowman brothers, Nick and Tom, who rolled snowballs, jumped on platforms, and defeated enemies in a quest to rescue the princesses Puripuri and Puchipuchi. Four years later, the sequel, Snow Bros. 2: With New Elves—a game as quirky and bizarre as it was wonderfully entertaining—was released. But despite the love for the first two Snow Bros. games, we haven’t had a true third entry in the series. Until now.

So, what are you waiting for? Let’s grab some friends and dive into the snowy fun!

70010000086268.name: Traysia
70010000086268.intro: Enjoy the nostalgia of classic RPGs!
70010000086268.description:
Dreaming of becoming a world-traveling adventurer, a young boy named Roy left his hometown. Having known neither travel nor battle, the boy’s adventure now begins.

After behind the hometown, he traveled through many mountains and forests. Roy finally arrived at a small county called Kingdom of Salon.

Traysia is a girl waiting for Roy to come back in their hometown, Johanna, a port town. 

“Traysia” is a full-scale role-playing game made up of five scenarios, offering a definitive fantasy romance of love and adventure.


Features: 
* Rewind/Turbo function: repeat something until you achieve perfection, or speed things up 
* Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point 
* Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.) 
* Gallery: view images from the original game’s manual and box design 
* Cheats function: activate cheats that will make your mission a lot easier (infinite lives, invulnerability, etc.) 
* Jukebox: listen to the 21 music tracks included in the game whenever you want 
* This game is re-release of “Traysia” which the first launched in 1992s for home consoles.

70010000086276.name: Girlfriend from Hell
70010000086276.intro: He didn't want to marry me! I'll spice up his life!
70010000086276.description:
Miya loved Haruto more than life and would do anything for him!
She waited a long time for him to propose marriage to her.

Miya decided to ask Haruto to be her husband, but he refused her. Video games were more important to him than love!

She was very angry!

Miya decided to make her boyfriend's life a living hell!

Girlfriend From Hell is an addictive and funny arcade 2D puzzle game. The main goal of the game is the revenge of a girl - to her lover. The heroine needs to find items and use them to turn her boyfriend's life into hell.

You need to collect various items to make a trap with their help. For example: on the shelf there are toy balls. The girlfriend scatters them on the floor on which her boyfriend walks. When her boyfriend walks over these balls, he falls to the floor. Or the girlfriend can saw the chair her boyfriend is sitting on with a saw, and when the boyfriend sits on it, he falls.

70010000086288.name: PAWfect Cat Mansion
70010000086288.intro: Create a feline paradise and turn an old mansion into a house full of adorable cats! Everyone loves cute little kittens!
70010000086288.description:
Do you love cats? Then "PAWfect Cat Mansion" is the perfect game for you! Design your dream home and watch as adorable cats appear, exploring and lounging in your beautifully decorated rooms. Create unique spaces tailored to different professions by choosing furniture and decorations that match each character's interests.

Your main goal is to transform an old mansion into a cozy kitty paradise. Invite even more cute cats to join the fun, and pick your favorites to stay with you forever!

Features:
• Design themed rooms for various characters to unlock new decorations.
• Decorate your mansion with a wide range of furniture and accessories.
• Attract a variety of cats with your cozy spaces.
• Choose your favorite cats to stay in your home forever!

70010000086293.name: Telebbit
70010000086293.intro: The rabbit has commenced its revenge on humanity! A fast-paced action platformer where teleportation is key.
70010000086293.description:
Take the teleporter and escape the lab!
A simple device, it teleports the user to the location at which it's fired, but the possibilities become endless when combined with in-stage gimmicks! At the end of each stage, a boss stands ready to fight.

The year is 3023.

Constant war, environmental destruction, and deadly pandemics have forced humanity underground, where they have been working hard to develop a new personal transportation known as a "Teleporter" to provide a safer and cheaper means of transportation that minimizes contact with the polluted ground and atmosphere.

To ensure the safety of the teleporter, tests were conducted using animals. During one such test, a glitch in the teleporter resulted in a rabbit's head being fitted with a high-performance CPU. With its new-found intelligence, the rabbit vowed to take revenge on the humans who subjected it to painful experimentation.

- A fast-paced platformer utilizing teleportation
- A game that is easy to learn but hard to master, requiring lots of effort and determination
- Eight different underground areas presented in charming pixel art
- Complete time trial in the Speedrun Mode

70010000086302.name: Prison Escape Simulator: Breakout Master
70010000086302.intro: Outsmart, escape, survive: break free or be caught.
70010000086302.description:
Immerse yourself in the intense world of 'Prison Escape Simulator: Breakout Master,' a cutting-edge experience where you take on the role of a cunning inmate trapped within the confines of a maximum-security prison. In this adrenaline-fueled adventure, players must navigate a web of intricate missions and challenges, each pivotal in their quest for freedom. From stealthy reconnaissance to bold confrontations, every decision shapes your path to liberation.

Harness your ingenuity to craft elaborate escape plans, utilizing a spectrum of tactics and tools at your disposal. Upgrade your physical prowess and tactical acumen as you earn rewards and accumulate wealth through successful missions. Customize your strategy by purchasing advanced weaponry and essential gear, each item enhancing your ability to outwit vigilant guards and navigate treacherous terrain.

Explore a richly detailed prison environment, from claustrophobic cell blocks to sprawling yards teeming with danger and opportunity. Engage in dynamic interactions with a diverse cast of inmates and guards, each encounter a potential ally or adversary in your quest for freedom. With each daring breakout, you inch closer to unlocking the mysteries of your incarceration and achieving ultimate liberation.

Will you defy the odds, orchestrate a flawless escape, and reclaim your freedom against all odds? 'Prison Escape Simulator: Breakout Master' challenges you to test your limits, strategize with precision, and mastermind the ultimate prison break in this gripping tale of survival and cunning.

70010000086307.name: Heroine Anthem Zero 2 : Scalescars Oath
70010000086307.intro: ZERO 2 is an ARPG with intriguing storytelling, an unpredictable battle system, and endless heartfelt adventure.
70010000086307.description:
STORY DESCRIPTION
The Twin Virgin Saints started the circle of the seven doomsday. On the sixth doomsday, God has not forgiven the world, and ichthyopagion still continues to grow. People must continue on with sin and punishment. Shama, who is with SinScars under her happy smile, holds dark secrets deep within, hoping someone will pull her out of her shadow. ZERO 2 is an ARPG with intriguing storytelling, an unpredictable battle system, and endless heartfelt adventure. The story includes multiple subtle metaphors for the relationship between God and humans.

ABOUT THE GAME
Heroine Anthem ZERO 2 : Scalescars Oath is a real time 2D mixed with 3D side-scrolling story-based ARPG.
The game combines legends of mermaids as well as Serbian and East Asian tribal culture to create its cultural world. Created over many years, it features nearly 400,000 words of dialogue, over 500 stories CG, 300 stages, and over 500 story performances. It has genuinely been brought to life a like a long TV series but as an adventure game. The soundtrack includes many songs from multiple music producers, which takes your experience to a whole new level!

GAME FEATURES 
●Vivid storytelling
With more than 100s of CGs and 2D animation, each scene is carefully aligned with both visual and audio. More than 100 stages and 400,000 words, players can truly immerse in the world of Heroine Anthem Zero.

●Unlocks different skills
As the character levels up, players have a range of skills to unlock including dodge, perry, triple jump, jump attack, and more. With the desired combination, players can have their own style of combat.

●Combat companion 
There is a combat companion system in Heroine Anthem Zero 2. Combat companion levels up as the story progresses, thus unlocking more skills to activate during combat.

●Puzzle solving
There are puzzles to solve in each map. Not only are they essential for stage completion, but also hidden treasures for players to explore. Some of the hidden treasures will considerably assist the players.  

●Crafting and cooking system
Players can collect loot throughout the game and craft different equipment, upgrade the weapons, or make them into a variety of food to enhance the character. 

●Equipment passive skills  
Weapons and armors have different passive skills. Players can choose any type of weapon depending on their combat style.

●Special event
There are different options for players to choose during conversations. Sometimes by making a different choice, there might be a special event in the game.

● Expedition System 
Don’t miss any suspicious areas in a stage! Crouching and exploring gives you a chance to pick up good stuff. In dangerous travel situations, use Cuckoo’s ability to look for suspicious exploration sites and command Cuckoo to further explore the area for a chance to obtain special loot.

●Cooking and Crafting System
   Using materials gained from exploring to cook or craft can create useful weapons, gear, and meal boxes. These can be used to increase the stats of weapon and gear.

●Other Items and Gear 
Character progress, weapons, and gear have a tight connection. Many weapons, armor, projectiles, runes, seals, food ingredients, and cuisine benefits not only provide atk/def to gear, weapons, armor, and rune effects but also adds a different attack move effect.

● Easter Egg Questline and Multi-option Conversation System
Story progresses through dialogue. To enable certain story lines, choosing different dialogue options are needed. Don’t forget to choose every option even if it may lead to death, as a different interpretation of the story may lead to unexpected events.

70010000086312.name: Screensaver BATTLE
70010000086312.intro: A new-sensation on-screen screensaver battle game "ScreenSaver Battle" where a special move is unleashed when you hit the corner!!
70010000086312.description:
Clash with bouncing video logos!
"ScreenSaver Battle" is a new-sensation on-screen screensaver battle game where a special move is unleashed upon hitting a corner!!
That screensaver, which felt so satisfying the moment it hit the corner, now makes its appearance as a battle game for even greater pleasure!! Aim for the corners today, tomorrow, and the day after, and clash to your heart’s content!!

Game Description
Have you ever seen a video logo that just bounces around?
A screensaver so captivating that there’s even a meme celebrating the moment it bounces off a corner—this game is a parody-style screensaver battle game that allows you to fully savor that exhilarating corner-bumping moment.

You control a VIDEO logo. If you collide with a logo labeled "BOSS," you’ll take damage.

When the VIDEO logo hits the very corner, a special move is activated, allowing you to defeat the BOSS logo in a single hit!

The controls are simple: just point the arrow in the direction you want to launch the logo and click.
After that, you just watch the outcome unfold, much like observing a spinning top or a simulation game. Feel free to hold some popcorn in one hand as if you’re watching a movie.

It’s simple, yet the exhilaration is fantastic!!

70010000086322.name: Hide 'N Seek!
70010000086322.intro: ...8, 9, 10. Ready or not, here I come!
70010000086322.description:
Remember the good old game of hide and seek? Prepare for something a little more extreme!

Dive into classic gameplay where you can hide or seek. Count down before setting off to find the Hiders, or blend into the environment, stay silent, and outsmart the Seeker to win!

Features:
- Hide and run away from the seekers
- Find and capture all the hiders
- Enjoy multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
- Use powerups to gain an advantage
- Collect coins to buy skins and pets!

Simple, fun, and dynamic—Hide 'N Seek brings the joy of this beloved childhood game to life!

70010000086324.name: Mars Survivor
70010000086324.intro: Conquer Mars, fend off alien threats, and secure your path to survival!
70010000086324.description:
After an asteroid catastrophe, your rocket ship crash-lands in the wilderness of Mars. Explore the planet's mysteries, strategize your escape, and build a shelter to protect yourself!

Go on dangerous expeditions to gather intel and resources. Fight off hordes of alien creatures and save other survivors. Use their skills and knowledge to defend your base from a huge enemy attack!

Features:
- Navigate Mars's challenges
- Explore the planet's secrets and discover hidden materials 
- Build a shelter and protect yourself from the harsh Martian environment!
- Defend against alien invasions and uncover secrets of the creatures of Mars!
- Gather oxygen and essential materials from old rocket ships to survive
- Strategize your escape mission and secure your passage back to Earth!
- Open epic loot boxes to swap or upgrade your gear

Become the last man standing on Mars, navigate through the wilderness, and prove your survival skills!

70010000086326.name: Care Bears: To The Rescue
70010000086326.intro: Care Bears: To The Rescue is a brand-new action-platformer set in the world-renowned Care Bears universe,
70010000086326.description:
Drawing direct inspiration from the original animated show “Care Bears: Unlock the Magic”!

Funshine Bear, Grumpy Bear, Share Bear, Cheer Bear and Good Luck Bear are on a mission to save the Silver Lining from Bluster’s most devious and daring plan so far! A ginormous, uncontrollable Bad Seed is wreaking havoc across the Silver Lining. If it isn’t stopped soon, the entire land and its inhabitants will be in big trouble!

Equipped with their Belly Badge Powers, the Care Bears will need to travel to 5 different areas to collect Caring Energy in order to fill up “Heart Cannons” and defeat the evil creations of the Bad Seed. They might even meet some familiar faces along the way...

Care Bears: To The Rescue lets you choose between 7 different characters. Select your favorite one and jump into the action by:

• Casting your Belly Badge Power beam to restore Caring and Happiness
• Running, jumping and interacting with your surroundings to progress through the Silver Lining
• Cooperating with fellow Care Bears to help each other overcome the giant Bad Seed’s continuous attempts at stopping your progression

Additional content awaits you with gripping flying levels and 5 minigames that will put various skills to the test; from quickly serving your friends their favorite meal to restoring an electric current by connecting various parts.

Care Bears: To The Rescue’s full content is playable with up to 4 players in local mode and available in 8 different languages!

So now, more than ever, is the time to cooperate and play with your close ones to share valuable and caring memories!

70010000086332.name: Hentai Paradise Vol. 4
70010000086332.intro: Discover the charming and naughty girls in Hentai Paradise.
70010000086332.description:
Dive into stunning anime art and solve puzzles to enjoy images of lovely girls posing exclusively for you! The visual component of the game is designed in such a way as to convey the feeling of assembling a real puzzle as much as possible. As the difficulty level increases, the images become more piquant. Take your time, enjoy the process and collect all the puzzles.

Features:
• Puzzles with images of lovely girls in seductive outfits
• Simple and addictive game mechanics
• Increasing puzzle difficulty
• Relaxing and atmospheric music

70010000086341.name: Highway Legends: Traffic Speed Racer
70010000086341.intro: Hit the gas, defy the limits: rule the roads in Highway Legends!
70010000086341.description:
Experience the rush of the open road like never before in Highway Legends! Feel the roar of your engine and the thrill of blistering speed as you tear through stunning, hyper-realistic landscapes. Every stretch of asphalt is a canvas for your driving prowess, and every turn is a test of your nerve.

Master the art of high-speed racing as you dodge relentless traffic and weave through intricate urban sprawls and sweeping highways. Customize and upgrade a fleet of cutting-edge vehicles, each designed for maximum performance and style. The stakes are high and the competition fierce, but only the most daring will rise to become a true Highway Legend.

With jaw-dropping visuals and an epic soundtrack that pumps up the adrenaline, every race is a heart-pounding spectacle. Are you ready to seize your destiny and dominate the road? Gear up, hit the gas, and conquer the asphalt in the ultimate racing odyssey!

70010000086348.name: Easy Cute Clean Up Lesson
70010000086348.intro: Let's put the scattered items back where they belong! Practice tidying up with a fun game, and soon you'll be able to tidy up your own room too!
70010000086348.description:
Let's tidy up the messy room by placing the specified items in their correct spots. 
As you gradually clean up the room in the game, you might even feel inspired to tidy up your own room too! 
This is a game designed to encourage kids to develop a habit of organization while having fun.

How to Play:
・Remember the item in the problem.
・Look for a place where it can be put away.
・When you find the perfect spot, select it with the cursor.
 Help the owner clean up the messy room!

・Clothes shouldn't be on the bed, right? Let's hang them here!
・There's a spot in the crayon case, but where are the crayons?
・How about putting this accessory next to that one?
...and many more! 
Choose the right spot from the cute illustrations and become a tidying-up master!

70010000086352.name: Big City Driver: Truck Parking Simulator
70010000086352.intro: An exciting parking simulator in which you become a driver of a powerful and huge truck!

70010000086358.name: Desktop Dodgeball 2
70010000086358.intro:
Throw, Dodge, Catch! Grab victory with all your might!
Engage in intense battles in this new and improved dodgeball game!
70010000086358.description:
It's dodgeball on your desk!
Share Joy-Con™ and enjoy the game with up to 4 players!
With simple controls, make quick decisions and strategic moves!

Create a unique player with style settings!
Build your own player with a wide variety of customization options!

Many special rules and courts are available!
Acquire formations and uniforms, and aim for the ultimate original team!


[Practice Match]
Enjoy casual single-player matches where you can set various balls and rules.

[Friendly Match]
Play with up to 4 players!
Freely combine teams and enjoy dodgeball with everyone!

[Team Selection]
Freely set player names, uniforms, and styles, and create your own original team!

[Tournament]
Defeat formidable opponents and aim to win the World Championship!

[Capsule Shoot]
Use the points earned in each mode to acquire new uniforms and formations!
Obtain rare items to strengthen your team!

[Mini Game]
Dodge the balls to earn points!
The golden ball is a chance for even more points!

70010000086363.name: Prison Guard: Warden Simulator
70010000086363.intro: Face the challenge. Keep the peace. Survive the pressure.
70010000086363.description:
Prison Guard Simulator lets you step into the shoes of a prison guard in a high-security facility. Maintain order, discipline, and security while making decisions that shape your reputation and the stability of the prison.
Patrol cell blocks, resolve conflicts, manage contraband, and face unexpected challenges like riots and escape attempts. Your decisions—whether handling conflicts with authority or empathy—will affect the prison’s operations and inmate behavior.

Features:
	•	Realistic Prison Environment: Explore detailed areas like cell blocks, the yard, mess hall, and more.
	•	Dynamic Daily Tasks: Handle roll calls, inspections, patrolling, and emergency situations.
	•	Decision-Making That Matters: Shape prison dynamics through your choices in handling conflicts and crises.
	•	Inmate Management System: Monitor inmates’ behavior and prevent chaos before it begins.
	•	Career Progression: Climb the ranks, unlock new challenges, and access advanced duties.

Will you rise through the ranks and maintain order, or let chaos take over? The choice is yours.

70010000086383.name: Chicken Party: Animal Farm
70010000086383.intro: Enjoy this charming graphic novel set on a magical and lively farm.The story follows the exciting adventures of Clara, a curious and intelligent hen, and her brave friends.
70010000086383.description:
Meet Clara and her brave friends: Pepe, the proud rooster; Lola, the enthusiastic chick; and Tico, the imaginative little chick.

One morning, Clara discovers a golden egg in her nest, an object as fascinating as it is mysterious. The egg's appearance sets off a series of events that lead our heroes to embark on a quest full of surprises, dangers, and discoveries.

In this adventure, Clara and her friends will learn valuable lessons about friendship, courage, and unity. The novel is full of exciting moments, endearing characters, and magical settings.

70010000086385.name: Arcade Archives VS. The Quest of Ki
70010000086385.intro:
Let's take back the BLUE CRYSTAL ROD, 
a symbol of love and peace!
70010000086385.description:
" VS. The Quest of Ki " is an action game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1988.
The objective of the game is to recover the BLUE CRYSTAL ROD that has been stolen by DRUAGA.
The main character, KI, is controlled to reach the top of the tower where monsters are roaming around.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*This game uses the Japanese ROM for the main part of the game.
*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000086395.name: Alice in Wonderland - Magical Labyrinth
70010000086395.intro: Embark on a magical journey with Alice through the Wonderland labyrinths. Solve challenging mazes, explore unimaginable worlds
70010000086395.description:
Alice in Wonderland - Magical Labyrinth takes players on an unforgettable journey through the fantastical world of Wonderland. Inspired by the classic tale, this game combines mazes and puzzles with exciting challenges, all enhanced by stunning 3D graphics.

Join Alice on her mission to uncover the hidden secrets of this surreal world while encountering memorable characters like the Cheshire Cat, the Queen of Hearts, the Spade Knights, and many more. Each level is designed with unique environments, innovative mechanics, and missions that will test your wit and skill.

Key Features:
• Immersive 3D Environments: Experience every corner of Wonderland like never before, with vibrant details and captivating landscapes.

• Mazes and Challenges: Solve puzzles, escape traps, and use logic to overcome obstacles along the way.

• Memorable Encounters: Interact with iconic characters and face special challenges in levels dedicated to each of them.

• Varied Game Modes: From time trials to strategic face-offs, every stage offers a unique experience.

• Family-Friendly Adventures: Fun and challenges for players of all ages.

Dive into a magical story filled with unexpected twists, secrets, and moments of wonder. Get ready to explore, discover, and become part of the legend of Alice in Wonderland in this new and exciting experience.

70010000086401.name: Dreamland Farm
70010000086401.intro: After living in a big city your dreams come true – today you start your new life on a peaceful pixel farm!
70010000086401.description:
Your grandma has taught you everything about farming and foraging – from taking care of crops to knowing which berries and mushrooms are edible. Your time has come to become her successor!


A NEW START
You came from the big city to take over your grandma’s farm – a pretty brave move for a city dweller! It’s a good thing that this place has everything you need. With a few decent tools in your pocket, you can start making it your own. Plant crops, take care of cute animals, and don’t forget to explore this vast green expanse.

Make sure to take good care of yourself, during all this as your energy has its limits!


YOU ARE NOT ALONE
There is a small and peaceful town near the farm where you will find many hardworking people – like the local cook, smith, and the mayor. Getting to know them and helping them will expand your dreamland world bit by bit. Not to mention they will help you with upgrading your tools via blueprints… for a favor or two.

Are you ready to uncover the secrets of Dreamland Farm and fall in love with it, just like your grandma did?


KEY FEATURES:
- A pixel world with a cozy aesthetic
- Your own pixelated plot of land.
- To balance out the cute and round animals, we put them in a square barn!
- The world grows with you - as you upgrade your gear, the tiers of materials spawning in the world will go up!
- Learn new recipes the same way you get blueprints - but through more delicious means.
- No taxes!

70010000086406.name: Sinister Mansion
70010000086406.intro: Prepare to face your deepest fears in Sinister Mansion, a bone-chilling horror experience that will haunt your every step.
70010000086406.description:
Kidnapped and left to awaken in the heart of a desolate woods, you must navigate through the twisted corridors of a decrepit mansion. Solve puzzles, find keys, and unravel the sinister horrors you keep seeing.

Terrifying Atmosphere: 
Immerse yourself in the chilling ambiance of Sinister Mansion, where every sound is filled with terror.

Puzzles:
Test your courage and intellect with a series of sinister puzzles scattered throughout the mansion.

Heart-Pounding Horror: 
Brace yourself for relentless scares, spine-tingling encounters, and moments of pure dread that will leave you paralyzed with fear.

70010000086408.name: Stickin' the Landing
70010000086408.intro: Puzzles, Stickers and a universe to explore! The gravity will be your guide in this unique adventure!
70010000086408.description: Stickin’ the Landing is a relaxing puzzle game where you use stickers and their gravitational properties to guide a spaceship adrift around outlandish worlds until you reach your destination. Travel through the home’s nooks and crannies and discover everything this marvelous universe has to offer!

70010000086416.name: Bumblebee - Search for Happiness
70010000086416.intro: This game is a story-driven, narrative 3D flight exploration game in which you control a little bee on its journey to find a new home.
70010000086416.description:
On your quest to find a beautiful new home you will discovers distant places, friendly and calm animals, and amazing and dangerously habitats.

You are a tiny bee in a giant environment and move continuously forward. You are free to fly wherever you want and explore the level to your heart’s desire. 
After you have played around a little and enjoyed the sensation of flying you start to discover the nearby areas and hidden secrets and find a couple of different items. 

For once there are energy potions which fill your energy meter to continuously fly faster until you run out of energy. 
Secondly there are golden flowers hidden everywhere in the levels that you can collect as a reward for exploring even the more hidden parts of the levels – collecting all of them unlocks an extra achievement in each level.

Last but not least there are the bright shining knowledge shards that show you the way into the next area. Whenever you collect one the next one will spawn ahead of you and show you the right way.

Once you have found a certain amount of knowledge shards you will be able to enter the next area and the story continues. Each area is another part of a world that a bee could experience and a little step further to find a new home.  Therefore, each level has a different color theme, general setting, mood and story. 

At the beginning of each area is a short break in which in which a part of poem is read to you. The poem talks about the bee and it’s journey to find a new home and explains a little bit about the level that lies ahead.

70010000086419.name: Bumblebee - Storm of Friendship
70010000086419.intro: This game is a story-driven, narrative 3D flight exploration game in which you control a little bee on its journey to find a new home.
70010000086419.description:
On your quest to find a beautiful new home you will discovers distant places, friendly and calm animals, and amazing and dangerously habitats.

You are a tiny bee in a giant environment and move continuously forward. You are free to fly wherever you want and explore the level to your heart’s desire. 
After you have played around a little and enjoyed the sensation of flying you start to discover the nearby areas and hidden secrets and find a couple of different items. 

For once there are energy potions which fill your energy meter to continuously fly faster until you run out of energy. 
Secondly there are golden flowers hidden everywhere in the levels that you can collect as a reward for exploring even the more hidden parts of the levels – collecting all of them unlocks an extra achievement in each level.

Last but not least there are the bright shining knowledge shards that show you the way into the next area. Whenever you collect one the next one will spawn ahead of you and show you the right way.

Once you have found a certain amount of knowledge shards you will be able to enter the next area and the story continues. Each area is another part of a world that a bee could experience and a little step further to find a new home.  Therefore, each level has a different color theme, general setting, mood and story. 

At the beginning of each area is a short break in which in which a part of poem is read to you. The poem talks about the bee and it’s journey to find a new home and explains a little bit about the level that lies ahead.

70010000086423.name: Buildest
70010000086423.intro: Explore various designs, craft elaborate building elements and CREATE!
70010000086423.description:
In short, the game is similar to other co-op action games, except this one is about architecture. Explore the level, craft the necessary building materials, and order workers to build. You can play alone or with friends up to 4 players.

Being architect is easy: examine the design plan, gather resources, give the order to build, and repeat. It is that easy! Once you get familiar with the basics, be ready to learn more about the craft of architecture.

You will visit construction sites of 7 different eras:
Ancient Egypt
Ancient Greece and Ancient Rome
Ancient Asia
European Middle Ages
European Baroque
European Art Nouveau
American Art Deco

Each era contains a multitude of new architectural elements for construction. You can build unique historical buildings by combining them. Besides that, each era opens other game mechanics as well. Discover all the architectural secrets!

Features:
- Unlock new crafting recipes to create your own designs. Experiment and combine architectural elements of different styles
- Travel through different eras and explore their cultural features through architecture
- Use the flexible system for assessing the level progression. Find your own building style
- Play with friends!

70010000086428.name: 100 in 1 Game Collection
70010000086428.intro: 100 in 1 Game Collection is a gigantic compilation of 100 arcade games that blend classic arcade games with fresh concepts.
70010000086428.description:
Meet Magrat the witch, Harvey the weird fish, Stephanie the green cow and all their beloved friends, and embark on an epic journey through 100 arcade games that blend classic gameplay from your favorite retro titles with new concepts that are reinventing the arcade genre! Score as much as you can, then improve and challenge yourself to get all stars in solo or with your friends! 

Key Features 
•	100 different games for a long and diverse journey : Experience a perfect mix of beloved classic gameplay and fresh, innovative challenges that will keep you hooked for a while! 
•	Follow the snake: Follow Tutorial Snake and his friends and improve your scores to unlock new minigames as long as you’re playing! 
•	Always better with friends: Train yourself alone and fight for the best score in multiplayer mode against your friends and family! 
•	Experience them all: From puzzle-solving and strategy games to fast-paced action and arcade classics, there's something for everyone in 100 in 1 Game Collection.
•	A game compilation like never before: 100 in 1 Game Collection includes all your favorites minigames from the acclaimed “30 in 1 Game Collection Volume 1 & 2” and adds 40 new games to the bill!

70010000086433.name: Wizardry: The Five Ordeals
70010000086433.intro: Wizardry: The Five Ordeals has arrived!
70010000086433.description:
Classic hardcore gameplay. Experience a deep dungeon crawling RPG. This game was created by the main staff that worked on the popular RPG series back in 2006. In this game, players can experience many different dungeon crawler RPGs using the same base system. Available with enhancements to the UI and much more. Official scenarios seen for the first time each with dozens of hours of gameplay.

Gameplay that is easy to get into. Players will create their own character - much like a traditional tabletop RPG - and venture into a grid based dungeon with a party of up to 6 members. The turn based combat mixes the simplicity of JRPGs with the difficulty of tabletop RPGs. (Our internal dice is not rigged!) Your character can be lost forever and saves will be overwritten.
