Get ready to dive into the ultimate driving experience! In Car Parking Legends, you'll not only master the art of parking but also unleash your creativity with extensive car and character customization options. 

Features:
-Car Customization: Upgrade performance and aesthetics with countless modifications, from paint jobs to rims and decals.
-Diverse Vehicle Selection: Explore a wide variety of cars, each with unique handling and characteristics, ensuring every drive feels fresh.
-Character Customization: Personalize your driver with a selection of outfits and accessories to match your style.

Multiple Game Modes:
-Career Mode: Progress through simple to complex levels, perfecting your parking skills while completing exciting challenges.
-Parking Attendant Mode: Take on the role of a parking attendant and navigate a bustling lot, expertly parking different vehicles.
-Free Ride Mode: Experience the freedom of cruising through a beautifully designed city, brimming with intensive traffic, allowing you to practice and explore at your own pace.

Join the ranks of parking legends and embark on an adventure filled with fun, skill, and creativity! Are you ready to park your way to glory?

70010000086812.name: A Good Gardener
70010000086812.description:
You are charged with growing plants for your nation's war-effort. As the days pass and your plants grow, remember to remember who you are.
A Good Gardener is a short story game and can be completed in one or two sittings.

---

Originally released in 2017 by Turnfollow

Programming and Writing by Ian Endsley
Art and Sound by Carter Lodwick
Music by Scott Archer
Additional 3D Modeling by Dan Anthony Kelly

70010000086814.name: Factory Islands
70010000086814.intro: Relax and organize the blocks on each island to correctly complete the factory, and ensure all the ore reach their destinations.
70010000086814.description:
Factory Islands is a minimalist and relaxing experience where you must ensure the blocks in a way that they form a complete factory capable of transporting and refining ores before they reach their destination. Use conveyors, splitters, filters and tunnels to transport the ores correctly, but don't forget to use the furnaces and presses when it is necessary to refine and press the ores so that they arrive in the right form at your destination.

- 6 resources to use in your factory
- 50 unique islands
- 4 environment variations
- Calm and relaxing bBackground music
- Unique puzzles
- A minimalist and relaxing experience

70010000086819.name: MahjongPuzzle 8
70010000086819.intro:
Mahjong meets puzzles — a brand-new challenge awaits!
Learn the hands as you play and sharpen your skills.
Take on Score Attack and prove your mastery in style!
70010000086819.description:
Mahjong Puzzle “Eight” is a simple yet profound puzzle game that uses beautifully designed mahjong tiles.

Conquer the various stages prepared in the “Dragon Road” There are many elements to master, so aim for the ultimate score.

Multiple mahjong tile skins are available, expanding the game’s world.

70010000086827.name: Robot vs Monsters
70010000086827.intro: Robot vs Monsters pits you against relentless waves of foes as you control a powerful robot in a top-down world.
70010000086827.description: Defend yourself at the center, earning points for each monster vanquished. Collect falling items for strategic advantages. The goal? Rack up as many points as possible in this endless battle for supremacy!

70010000086832.name: Forgotten Fields
70010000086832.intro: A cozy narrative game about nostalgia and the passage of time.
70010000086832.description:
Sid is a writer struggling with writer's block, attempting to recapture the feelings of inspiration he felt when he was younger. In order to pay the bills, he needs to think up a story and apply for a grant - the deadline is today - a lazy Sunday in the middle of summer.

On this Sunday, his struggle is disturbed by an invitation to attend an unavoidable family obligation - the place Sid grew up in is about to be sold, and his mother wants him to come home for a small party so he can say goodbye to it. With the deadline approaching and his creative juices having frozen, this is not something he's looking forward to.

Talk to old friends, run through the fields, swim in the ocean, and solve relaxing puzzles in this warm, slice-of-life narrative about nostalgia and the passage of time by the developer that brought you Rainswept.

FEATURES
- Take part in Sid's creative process as you play through a parallel story set in a fantasy world - right out of the book that Sid is attempting to write.

- Simple, relaxing puzzles that keep gameplay interesting without slowing down the story.

- A friendly and supportive cast of characters with deep histories and fleshed-out personalities.

- Cinematic presentation accompanied by a beautiful soundtrack by micAmic (Rainswept, The Cat Lady, Lorelai, Downfall)

- An atmospheric, warm, and cozy world to lose yourself in as you get immersed in Sid's journey back home.

70010000086837.name: Sol Dorado Heist
70010000086837.intro: Choose your path and solve the mystery of the Sol Dorado Heist!
70010000086837.description:
After waking up with amnesia, Alex Thorn finds herself lost and confused in a room she doesn’t recognize. A weird flashback tells her that she somehow has been robbing casinos with a mysterious criminal known as The Silent Ace.

The police are now on her tracks, and The Silent Ace is about to rob the biggest casino in town: The Sol Dorado. Can Alex discover the truth about her past? Will she find the criminal before the police do? Choose your own path and solve this mystery!

Features:
- An intriguing story about a casino heist, filled with funny dialogue, charming characters and lots of choices!
- And those choices matter! Think carefully who you trust, or you may end up in a lot of trouble.
- Stunning and unique art-style! With a whole gallery for you to enjoy it!
- Four main endings depending on the path you choose. Replay the game to uncover the whole truth about The Sol Dorado!

70010000086843.name: Slime Heroes
70010000086843.intro: A tale where slimes are actually the heroes.
70010000086843.description:
Journey with your fellow slimes to save the ancient guardians from a mysterious corruption taking over the land. Explore a whimsical world filled with secret passageways, challenging puzzle dungeons, and forgotten treasures. Consume special gems and dynamically combine them to create unique magical skills. Level up and fight back against the corrupted minions to restore the land.

Dynamic Abilities
-Collect an arsenal of skill gems consumed from defeated corrupted creatures.
-Dynamically mix skill gems to craft unique skill sets at any time.
-Discover all the different types of enemies to complete your gem collection.

Co-Op
-Jump into your friends' game at any time and drop right into the action.
-The entire game can be played with a friend.
-All loot is shared; no fighting over that one pretty gem.
-Create different magical abilities that complement each other when playing with a friend.

Expansive World
-Discover secret passageways and challenging puzzle dungeons in a whimsical open world.
-Find the six gods of the realm and defeat the corrupted version of each. Once freed they will aid you on your quest!

70010000086847.name: Overheat: Kitchen Chaos
70010000086847.intro: Master the chaos or get burned in this kitchen showdown, Only the fastest and smartest chefs survive this madness.
70010000086847.description:
Get ready for a fast-paced culinary frenzy in Overheat: Kitchen Chaos! Up to four players team up in this unpredictable cooking showdown where speed, surprise, and strategy are essential. Prepare for chaotic kitchen challenges as random power-ups either help or hinder your progress. The game's standout features include:

Key Features:
	•	Random Power-Ups: Unpredictable gifts appear during gameplay, offering powerful abilities like freezing opponents or speeding up cooking—though some may backfire!
	•	Co-op Gameplay: Team up with friends in local two-player co-op, for a shared experience full of teamwork and competition.
	•	Dynamic, Ever-Changing Levels: Each kitchen level presents new obstacles and hazards, ensuring no two rounds are ever the same.
	•	Easy to Learn, Tough to Master: Simple controls let anyone dive in, but mastering the chaotic kitchens requires sharp strategy and coordination.
	•	High-Pressure Time Management: Race against the clock to serve dishes while managing the chaos around you, testing both speed and precision.

Can you handle the pressure and conquer the kitchen?

70010000086852.name: Shark Simulator : Ocean Predator Survival
70010000086852.intro: Hunt, Grow, and Reign Over the Ocean!
70010000086852.description:
Become the Ultimate Ocean Predator!

Take control of a powerful shark and dominate the ocean. As you evolve and grow, new challenges and enemies await you in an ever-changing underwater world. 

Here's what to expect:

- Evolve and Transform: Progress through 7 unique shark skins, each unlocking new abilities and making you stronger as you devour your way through the ocean.

- Explore Dynamic Environments: Discover 4 distinct underwater locations that evolve with your shark, offering new threats, prey, and secrets at each stage.

- Find Power-Ups: Scattered across the ocean, find spheres containing 4 types of power-ups that boost speed, strength, damage resistance, and experience gain.

- Hunt for Special Rewards: Track down hidden white spheres that contain water vortexes, granting you extra experience and rewards to level up faster.

- Battle Giant Boss Sharks: Confront massive boss sharks in each location and defeat them to gain significant experience and advance more quickly.

Every bite brings you closer to becoming the ocean's most feared predator. Will you rise to the top and claim your place as the ultimate apex predator?

70010000086856.name: Gradiently 2
70010000086856.intro: Beautiful relaxing puzzles, 500+ gradients will challenge your color perception!
70010000086856.description:
Gradiently 2 - casual color puzzle game for everyone. 
Reorder tiles in a way they will form perfect gradient.

• 500 beautiful hand-tuned gradient puzzles
• Infinite random mode
• Minimal art style
• Full touch screen support
• Relaxing lofi soundtrack

70010000086861.name: HYNPYTOL
70010000086861.intro:
They're coming. There's no hope.
Still, you're a HYNPYTOL.
70010000086861.description:
HYNPYTOL (meaning "white blood cell" in Korean) is a retro-themed puzzle action adventure game. Embark on a journey to save a crumbling immune system as a chosen "Killer T", guided by a rather grumpy "Dendritic". 

◆ A simple yet versatile "high-five" action
In this perilous world, all that the "Killer T" can do is "high-five". Learn to use your hand for everything: from moving around and talking to other cells, to overcoming obstacles and taking care of infection!

◆ A reimagniation of the 90's visuals and sounds
HYNPYTOL is inspired by the pixel graphics and sounds of 90's games, and reimagines them with a modern touch for a unique charm. Immerse yourself in this nostalgic world; you may also find some easter eggs along the way!

◆ The immune system: separating "you" from "us"
Explore the human body and the various mechanisms of the immune system! The Immunopedia will guide you through the story and its settings. Also, don't miss the achievements! Maybe there's more hiding...?

70010000086866.name: Space Bouncer
70010000086866.intro: Upon hitting a wall, the character bounces off and changes direction.
70010000086866.description: The goal is to avoid obstacles and collect as many points as possible. As player accumulates higher scores, the game speeds up, increasing the difficulty. Navigate through the challenging environment and aim for the highest score while avoiding hazards.

70010000086871.name: Beardbarians
70010000086871.description: Use your beard to attack, smack and knock back anyone who dares oppose you in Beardbarians! Pick from a colourful cast of characters and stages to duke it out with friends, locally or online, or work together to protect your gem from goblins by upgrading your abilities in the tower defence mode!

70010000086873.name: Idol Hell
70010000086873.publisher: Rochester Institute of Technology MAGIC Spell Studios
70010000086873.intro:
Idol Hell is the beginner friendly bullet hell game! 
Play as Medli and fight through hoards of enemies and meet vibrant cute bosses through 4 different difficulties!
70010000086873.description:
What is Idol Hell?
Idol Hell is a 2D, Touhou-like, Shoot 'em up, bullet hell game taking inspiration from Japanese school idols and anime tropes.

In Idol Hell, you play as Medli, a robot schoolgirl idol set on a warpath to free her closest friend.
Fight through hordes of enemies and other cutesy robot idols in this vibrant, precision-based game.

The Full Game Includes:
4 Difficulty Levels!
4 Different Game Modes to Play!
6 Chapters!
7 Cute Robot Idols!
14 Songs Filled With Variety!
Hundreds Of Bullet Patterns!

70010000086877.name: Santa's Spot It
70010000086877.intro: Get ready to dive into the magic of Christmas with Santa’s Spot It, the ultimate holiday themed puzzle game that’s perfect for all ages!
70010000086877.description:
Embrace Christmas villages. Your mission? To spot the differences between two seemingly identical scenes to progress.

Santa’s Spot It offers a delightful blend of challenge and charm, with multiple levels that increase in difficulty as you progress. Every scene is packed with festive details that will keep you on your toes. Whether you’re a seasoned spot-the-difference pro or a first-time player, the game’s intuitive design ensures fun for the whole family.

70010000086882.name: Jewel Fever 3
70010000086882.description:
"Jewel Fever 3" is the much improved successor to the highly succesful "Jewel Fever 2" which is played by millions of people. 
It adds new gamemodes, better graphics and finally local and online multiplayer!

It features:
- Classic gamemodes Normal, Quick and Infinite!
- Mission mode with 30 missions to solve!
- AI-mode with 4 different AI-Opponents in 2 game modes! 
- Local and online multiplayer!
- 15 Achievements

70010000086889.name: Duck Run
70010000086889.intro: Can you overcome the traps and lead the duck to its goal?
70010000086889.description: Join the daring duck in Duck Run, an exciting adventure filled with dangerous traps and thrilling challenges across 40 action-packed levels. Your mission is to guide the brave duck safely through each obstacle while keeping track of your time. Jump, dash, and outsmart tricky hazards as the pace and difficulty increase, testing your reflexes and strategy. With simple and intuitive controls, Duck Run is easy to pick up but hard to master. Track your progress using the in-game timer and challenge yourself to improve your times. Can you guide the duck to safety in record time? Sharpen your skills and face tougher traps as you advance through this fast-paced, high-stakes adventure!

70010000086894.name: ISLANDERS: New Shores
70010000086894.intro: Welcome to ISLANDERS: New Shores. Build your island retreat in a calm, minimalist world with exciting new features that keep the classic charm while inspiring fresh creativity.
70010000086894.description:
The next chapter in the beloved minimalist city-building franchise is here. ISLANDERS: New Shores invites you back to a world of tranquil creativity, now reimagined with expanded gameplay, stunning visuals, and a host of fresh features that build on the charm of the original. 

Whether you're a longtime fan or a newcomer, prepare to explore, build, and strategise like never before.

Build Your Dream Cities Across 50 Unique Levels
Explore over 44 building types across 6 diverse biomes, each available in 4 vibrant colour variations, letting you customise your strategy and create truly unique cities.

Choose your mode of play; High Score Mode for those who love a competitive twist, or Sandbox Mode to let your creativity run wild.

Experience a World of New Features

Photo Mode - Capture and share your stunning island creations with customisable filters and a turntable camera.

Expanded Soundtrack - Enjoy 75 minutes of original music that sets the perfect mood for your building adventures.

Dynamic Scoring Systems - Master innovative scoring methods - such as line of sight, distance bonuses, and inter-island strategies - to enhance your gameplay.

Boons - Unlock single-use power-ups that give you unique tactical advantages as you progress.

Twitch Integration  - Streamers can now engage their audiences directly with interactive features built into the game.

A Visual Overhaul That Elevates the Experience
With a complete reimagining of the minimalist aesthetic, ISLANDERS: New Shores delivers a visual feast that complements its deep, strategic gameplay. Whether you’re here to relax or to challenge your building skills, every new shore offers a fresh canvas for creativity.

Key Features
- Two modes: High Score and Sandbox (with separate saves)
- 44 unique building types and 7 island properties
- 50 dynamic island generators offering endless variety
- Photo Mode with filters and a turntable camera
- 75 minutes of original, immersive music
- Boons: new one-time power-ups for strategic gameplay
- Advanced scoring systems that reward clever tactics
- Twitch integration for an interactive streaming experience

ISLANDERS: New Shores - where every island is a new adventure, and every build is a chance to create something extraordinary.

70010000086899.name: MasterChef: Learn to Cook!
70010000086899.intro: Do you have what it takes to be the number one chef? Show your cooking abilities in MasterChef: Learn to Cook!
70010000086899.description:
Choose your ingredients, slice, prepare, plate and serve delicious dishes with style in fun mini-games! 

The MasterChef judges will evaluate your dish based on your performance and speed. Complete and unlock new recipes, challenges, and mini-games along your cooking journey!

LEARN TO COOK WITH MORE THAN 120 RECIPES!
Make signature recipes from all over the world. Find your favorite dish and make it your speciality. From a Margherita Pizza to Sushi, what do you want to cook today?

CHALLENGE MINI-GAMES
Play dozens of mini-games with a twist! Challenges will take you to cook recipes with extra added difficulty. Will you be able to complete all of them?

MOTION CONTROLS
Become a true number one chef with immersive motion controls. Grab your Joy-Con™ and start cooking for real!

COOK WITH STYLE
Create an avatar and customize its features as you want! Become the coolest chef and stand out by changing your outfit from a wide range of clothes, accessories, and aprons!

UPGRADE YOUR COOKING GEAR
By completing mini-games, events and challenges, you will be able to collect different cooking gear such as pots, utensils, plates amongst others, and upgrade them! Cooking utensils are a chef’s best friend!

It is time to prove that you are a top chef!

70010000086907.name: BAD END THEATER
70010000086907.intro: Select your protagonist and explore a variety of terrible fates!
70010000086907.description:
Welcome to BAD END THEATER!

Select your protagonist and explore a variety of terrible fates!

The decisions you make in one story will affect the others. You can toggle these behaviors to open up new paths! Unfortunately, every path leads to a bad ending...

Can you find a way to save this unlucky cast?

70010000086912.name: Mech Wars
70010000086912.description:
Long ago, the Stenian race lived in harmony on the planet Xelarvis, aided by their mechas. However, everything changed when the Kaxeder race arrived. They invaded the world with the intent to destroy and conquer it. The Stenian army was defeated, forcing them to flee and take refuge in an ancient settlement in the frozen region. Hope seemed lost when the adversary began occupying the frozen area—lost, that is, except for a single Stenian pilot who fought back, even if he was alone.

Despite being on his own, the Stenian pilot repelled the Kaxeder army and destroyed the technology's generators responsible for depleting the planet's life. Upon discovering the pilot's location, Kaxeder Headquarters is now acting swiftly to halt his rampage.

After several months, the Stenian pilot reached the Kaxeder settlement in the frost region. The settlement was heavily guarded in an attempt to thwart the arrival of the last Titan Mecha of the Stenian race.

Now, all Stenian hope rests on this pilot.
This pilot is you!

You'll have to destroy enemy mechas and objectives like fuel tanks, generators, atomic reactors, and enemy cores in intense 3D battles with deep sci-fi atmospheres and immersive soundscapes. To aid you, you'll be able to select different mechas and tune their equipment.

Save your race, Captain!

70010000086931.name: TRIZEAL Remix
70010000086931.intro:
A classic vertical shmup TRIZEAL,
originally released in arcades in 2004.
Includes a commentary by the developer!
70010000086931.description:
Three buttons (Shot/Transform/Bomb) and three weapons (Wide/Laser/Missile)—use them all to conquer unique stages!
This is an ambitious work that aims to revive elements of earlier arcade shooters—such as secret characters hidden in each stage—in the polygon era.

Newly recorded developer commentary talks about:
-	How did the programmer who was bad at math cope with 3D game development?
-	Behind-the-scenes stories that help you learn more about the arcade shmup scene around the year 2000!

70010000086934.name: Offroad Quest Simulator
70010000086934.intro: Dive into the world of Offroad Quest Simulator and prove your skills!
70010000086934.description:
Get ready to embark on the ultimate off-road adventure in Offroad Quest Simulator! This 3D simulation game challenges you to navigate rugged terrains and conquer a variety of tasks. As you drive through diverse and challenging environments, you'll earn money for your achievements. Use your earnings to upgrade to powerful off-road vehicles, unlocking new environments and tackling even tougher levels.

With each mission, you'll face unique obstacles and terrain challenges that test your driving skills. From dense forests to rocky mountains, every environment presents new challenges and opportunities for exploration. Upgrade your vehicles with advanced features and enhancements to improve performance and take on the most demanding trails.

Key Features:
Realistic 3D Environments: Explore detailed off-road landscapes with dynamic weather and terrain.

Vehicle Upgrades: Earn money to purchase and upgrade a variety of off-road vehicles, each with unique capabilities.

Challenging Missions: Complete diverse tasks and face various obstacles to earn rewards and progress through the game.

Unlock New Levels: Advance through increasingly difficult levels and discover new environments.

Dive into the world of Offroad Quest Simulator and prove your skills as the ultimate off-road adventurer!

70010000086946.name: Colorizing: Good Times
70010000086946.intro: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation
70010000086946.description:
This coloring book is a guarantee of good mood.
In it you can find all kinds of pictures for every taste.
Coloring by numbers with Colorizing is a calming and easy activity for people of all ages. 
This drawing game is suitable for children and adults, everyone can enjoy pixel coloring.
You will definitely love coloring with this beautiful coloring book!

70010000086956.name: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2
70010000086956.intro:
Destroy demons with the power of forged bonds!
Tanjiro Kamado's battle will once again unfold...
70010000086956.description:
Please note this is the Standard Edition. Be aware there is also a Deluxe Edition available, so please ensure your selection before purchasing.

Destroy demons with the power of forged bonds!
Tanjiro Kamado's battle will once again unfold...

Single Player: Story Mode
Play as Tanjiro and relive the Entertainment District Arc, the Swordsmith Village Arc, and the Hashira Training Arc from the TV anime, Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba!
Battle Upper Rank demons with your allies!

VS Mode: The Hashira unite!
The game features over 40 characters, including the nine Hashira, the highest-ranking swordsmen of the Demon Slayer Corps!
New elements, such as Dual Ultimates and Gear, have been added!
Take on new challenges both online and offline!

Standard Edition Content:
- Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2 Main Game
- Digital Version Bonus - Character Unlock Keys: Academy Rengoku and Academy Uzui 

Bonus for linking save data:
The following bonuses will be available for players with save data from Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles or Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- Sweep The Board!
- Bonus for Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles save data:
Character Unlock Keys: Academy Tanjiro, Academy Nezuko, Academy Zenitsu, Academy Inosuke, Academy Giyu. Academy Shinobu
- Bonus for Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- Sweep The Board! save data:
Character Unlock Key: Hinatsuru, Makio and Suma
Battle Attire: Hinatsuru, Makio and Suma Kimono (Meal Prep)

*Character Unlock Keys are bonuses that allow you to play the specified character in VS Mode at the very start.
*Battle Attire can be used in VS Mode.
*Bonuses for linking save data are only applicable for games on the same platform.
*Online play in VS Mode requires a Nintendo Switch Online membership (paid).
*The latest patch must be installed in order to use online features.
*Contents and specifications are subject to change without notice.
*The digital version bonuses are permanent.
*Bonuses may be distributed at a later date.

70010000086960.name: TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC
70010000086960.intro: Solve cases by analyzing evidence and consulting with specialists. Enter a world that artfully blends 2D illustration and real-life visuals!
70010000086960.description:
Use forensic science to investigate "unsolvable cases"

A new viral outbreak has forced Tokyo to go into an extended lockdown. Finally coming out of the bleak, three year epidemic it seems life has finally returned to normal... until a string of paranormal incidents begin to occur. It's up to you and your colleagues to solve these cases once and for all!


Realistic forensic tools

Use the resources at your disposal such as images and surveillance footage to perform a careful analysis and determine items, persons, and other points of interest. Be sure to review security camera footage thoroughly, as it can allow you to gather specific details of victims' behavior at the moment of the incident, and even review what happened before or after.


Organize your evidence board

Determine answers by collecting and organizing evidence on the evidence board. Proper use will allow you clearly to see how items in your case interrelate. The outcome of each case will be determined by the degree to which you were able to resolve the case. Can you solve all of the difficult cases that lie ahead?

70010000086966.name: 4x4 Adventure: Rocky Pathways
70010000086966.intro: Can you conquer the toughest terrains?
70010000086966.description:
Embark on a thrilling off-road journey in 4x4 Adventure: Rocky Pathways, the ultimate 3D off-road experience that puts your driving skills to the test. Navigate through rugged terrains, tackle challenging missions, and conquer diverse environments in your quest for adventure.

In 4x4 Adventure: Rocky Pathways, you’ll take on a variety of exciting tasks across four distinct environments, each brimming with obstacles and opportunities. Complete missions to earn money, which you can use to purchase and upgrade an array of powerful vehicles, enhancing your off-road capabilities.

From rocky hills to muddy trails, the game offers a dynamic and immersive driving experience. Will you rise to the challenge and become a master of the rugged path? The adventure awaits!

70010000086971.name: Cyberpunk Speed Assassin
70010000086971.intro: Control time, strike fast, or don’t survive.
70010000086971.description:
In New Eden, 2099, you are the Phantom, the last human assassin in a city ruled by AI and corrupt corporations. Navigate from towering skyscrapers to grimy slums, armed with cybernetic enhancements and an arsenal of high-tech weapons. Strike fast and disappear without a trace.

Key Features:
- Lightning-Fast Gameplay: Wall-running, time manipulation, and acrobatic moves for fluid movement.
- Stylish Assassinations: Complete contracts on high-profile targets across New Eden.
- Cybernetic Arsenal: Customize your weapons and gadgets for each mission.
- Time Manipulation: Control time to gain an advantage—but be careful, the clock is always ticking.
- Neon-Soaked Open World: Explore a vast, vertical city filled with opportunities for creative kills.
- Trust No One: Navigate betrayal and power struggles in a city that’s out to get you.
- Challenge Mode: Test your skills in time trials and assassination challenges.

In Cyberpunk Speed Assassin, every second matters. Will you rise as the apex predator of New Eden, or fall victim to its deadly pace?

70010000086976.name: Light - Die to Survive
70010000086976.intro: Light - Die to Survive is a trial-and-error horror game with no hints. Use your flashlight to navigate through a road, forest, and haunted house. Observe, die, and retry
70010000086976.description:
Light - Die to Survive offers a chilling and unique horror experience that will push your survival instincts to the limit. 
In this game, there are no hand-holding hints or easy escapes.
Your only hope lies in your ability to carefully observe your surroundings and uncover the mysteries that lie within.

The game unfolds across three distinct stages—each more terrifying than the last.
You will begin on a dark, desolate road, where every step forward feels like a dangerous gamble.
Your journey will lead you into a menacing forest, where every rustle of leaves and snapping of twigs could be a sign of something sinister lurking nearby.
Finally, you will find yourself trapped inside a haunted house, filled with eerie whispers and ghostly figures watching your every move.

What sets Light - Die to Survive apart is its minimalist yet highly atmospheric design.
There are no complicated mazes to navigate, but that doesn't mean it’s easy.
The simplicity of the game’s design heightens the tension—you’ll just need to reach your destination or escape from a specific area, but doing so requires vigilance and an understanding of the environment around you.
Every location is shrouded in darkness, and your only tool for survival is your flashlight.
With its limited range, it forces you to explore cautiously, knowing that danger could be waiting just beyond the edges of the light.

The night surrounds you, creating a constant feeling of vulnerability.
Whether it's the shadows in the distance or the eerie silence, the atmosphere will keep you on edge. But be warned: this is a game of trial and error.
Each time you meet your demise, the clock rewinds, allowing you to attempt the challenge again.
It’s a cycle of death and rebirth—each failure offering a chance to learn and adapt.
Sometimes, you will need to die to uncover a new clue, other times, it will be your persistence that unravels the mystery.
This trial-and-error approach tests both your patience and problem-solving skills, making each success all the more rewarding.

With its intense atmosphere, challenging gameplay, and an emphasis on observation and survival, Light - Die to Survive will keep players on their toes from start to finish.
The experience becomes more than just a game; it’s a psychological challenge where every death counts and every moment is crucial. The haunting environments, coupled with the thrill of constant danger, will make it impossible to look away.

If you're a fan of horror games that challenge your wits and demand perseverance, then Light - Die to Survive is a must-play.
Prepare yourself for an unforgettable journey into the dark, where your only guide is your flashlight, and your only goal is to survive.
Will you be able to unravel the mysteries hidden in the night, or will the shadows consume you?

70010000086979.name: Tower Hover
70010000086979.intro: Tower Hover is an endless building game where players stack sections of a skyscraper to create the tallest structure possible.
70010000086979.description: The goal is to align each new section perfectly on top of the previous one. If the placement isn't accurate, the misaligned part gets cut off, making subsequent placements more challenging. The game ends when a section completely misses the tower. How high can you build before it all comes crashing down?

70010000086984.name: Synaxarion Christian Stories: Great Martyr Christina of Tyre
70010000086984.intro: Locked in a tower from a young age, Christina sought the Architect of Creation
70010000086984.description:
In Tyre, 200 A.D., the young Christina was locked in a tower by her father. Gazing out at the magnificent world outside, she sought the True Creator of the Universe, and He revealed Himself to her. This is her story.

In this Synaxarion installment, explore Tyre to complete quests, find lost items, and watch the story of Christina the Great Martyr unfold.

These stories are short and are not intended to take up much time to play through. Expect to play for 40-60 minutes to complete this experience.

The Synaxarion is a collection of Saints’ lives, which are celebrated each day of the year. They are a light that leads us to Christ in every generation, a living Gospel. The ministry and very life of Christ is worked out in the lives of the Saints, His faithful servants. They are the glory of the Church, the God-bearers on earth and in heaven. Most of the saints were unknown to the world, but the Grace of God made them known to the whole universe and to all the ages. Amen.

70010000086990.name: The Nameless City
70010000086990.intro: Narrative-driven first person horror adventure inspired by Lovecraft's short novel "The Nameless City" (1921).
70010000086990.description:
Explore the ruins of a city that some say they are older than humanity itself. While you delve deeper into the ancient buildings, reality and visions blend into an indistinct haze.

“There were myriads of good reasons for shunning the nameless city, one for each strange tale passed from generation to generation.

Tales averted people from entering the city, even from getting closer to its walls, and legends say that it was older than the eldest of the pyramids; few say it was older than humanity itself. But there was no legend so old as to give it a name.”

The game has some light puzzle elements, but the main focus of the game is exploring the ruins of the ancient city. You can save your progress and continue later, but it's recommended to play it in one sitting.

70010000086995.name: Pixel Game Maker Series Chrotopia
70010000086995.intro:
A world where only black and white exist.
“Kuro”searches for his sister in various places.
70010000086995.description:
■Story
In a world of black and white, the reclusive girl “Kuro” sets out on an adventure to find her missing sister.
Will Kuro be able to overcome her interactions and conflicts with the various inhabitants of the world, including soldiers, wizards and dragon children?

■System
The “action part” with easy controls and simple puzzles
There are lots of dangers outside the town!
Use your jumping, attacking and special moves to drive away the various enemies.
There's no need for complicated controls. Enjoy the simple, pop-style battles!
Sometimes you'll have to use your head to progress...

Immerse yourself in the world of the story
The town where Kuro lives is home to a rich variety of unique characters.
If you become friends with them, you can go on picnics with them or play together at their houses!

Through interacting with his friends, Kuro grows up and faces the great mystery that envelops this world.
Find out for yourself how this story ends!

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.

70010000087000.name: Symmetrical logic puzzles 1000
70010000087000.intro: A luxurious puzzle game where you separate scattered gems into different rooms. However, the rooms must be point-symmetric with the gems at the center.
70010000087000.description:
This is a puzzle game where you create rooms by dividing grid spaces with colors to form point-symmetric shapes centered around the gems.
You clear the stage once all the gems are separated into different rooms.

There are 1,000 stages in total. 
It’s a challenging puzzle game that tests your powers of insight.

70010000087003.name: Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business
70010000087003.intro: Lead the Skies and Build Your Aviation Empire!
70010000087003.description:
Immerse yourself in the thrilling world of air transportation as the inheritor of a small airline company left to you by a distant relative. From humble beginnings at a small airport to building a global aviation logistics empire — incredible adventures, challenges, and opportunities await to shape your destiny.
Rise to the heights of a professional pilot managing both your aircraft and business in "Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business". From a simple crop duster to an aviation tycoon, your journey is filled with dangers and thrilling moments. Manage wisely as you make critical decisions, upgrade your resources, and prove your worth to join the elite ranks of cargo transport service. With 12 aircraft and 2 hangars offering upgrade capabilities for both, and 10 airports awaiting your exploration and conquest across the globe, the sky's the limit in this exhilarating adventure.

Features:
- Vast Open World: Explore diverse locations, from small regional airports to bustling metropolitan hubs, each offering unique challenges and opportunities.
- Hangar Purchase and Upgrades: Expand your airline company by enhancing infrastructure and increasing capacity for more aircraft and cargo.
- Aircraft Purchase and Upgrades: Choose and upgrade from small single-engine planes to powerful sky freighters for optimal performance and reliability.
- Dozens of Airports: Discover over 10 unique airports worldwide, each with distinct architecture, technical features, and business development potential.
- Variety of Cargo Types: From routine mail deliveries to rare and precious cargo, the diversity of tasks and opportunities will challenge you in various ways.
- Weather Conditions: Navigate through variable weather conditions, from clear skies to dense fog and severe storms that can influence your decisions and flight safety.
- Day and Night Cycle: Embark on night flights and face new challenges and conditions that demand your expertise and experience.

Are you ready to transform a single-engine plane into a global aviation powerhouse?

70010000087008.name: Viking City Tycoon
70010000087008.intro: Build, raid, conquer – lead your Viking empire to glory!
70010000087008.description:
Forge your Viking legacy in Viking City Tycoon, a strategic city-building game that challenges you to lead a Norse settlement to greatness. From humble beginnings, you’ll grow your village into a sprawling Viking stronghold, balancing resource management, trade, and conquest in the unforgiving world of the North.

Take charge as the chief of your village and:
- Build legendary Norse structures, longhouses and majestic feasting halls
- Carefully manage vital resources like wood, iron, and food to ensure your people thrive
- Train an army of fearless Viking warriors, ready to set sail and raid distant lands
- Defend your settlement from rival clans and mythical creatures lurking in the shadows
- Engage in trade to acquire rare goods and powerful technologies
- Expand your empire by founding new outposts and extending your influence across the region

As you lead, you’ll face the harsh realities of Viking life—deciding whether to cultivate a thriving trade network or create a feared society of battle-hardened raiders. Every decision shapes the future of your village.

Will you create a peaceful trading hub, or lead your Viking warriors to become the fiercest conquerors the world has ever seen? The choices you make will shape the future of your empire.

70010000087018.name: Zero Hour: Kill Zone
70010000087018.intro: Nintendo Switch™ exclusive! High-quality graphics show battlefield reality. Team-based tactical gameplay with comrades. FPS with excitement and precise gun control!
70010000087018.description:
Experience the ultimate battle on a photorealistic battlefield and witness the emotional ending firsthand!
Utilize the unique characteristics of weapons categorized as Assault, Support, and Sniper, Aim your firearms and use more precise controls,
Understand the missions for each game mode and participate in combat to complete special missions.

・Enter the battlefield as a member of a world-class special forces unit and complete special missions.
・Experience thrilling battlefields rendered with photo-realistic graphics.
・Enjoy strategic gameplay utilizing the characteristics of 3 characters (Assault, Support, Sniper).
・Engage in the Deathmatch Mode where you can prove your superior combat skills in direct confrontation with enemies.
・Play the Domination Mode where you capture battle zones to secure tactically advantageous positions.
・Experience the Search and Destroy mode where you plant explosives in designated locations and defend against defusing attempts.
・Achieve victory by maximizing gun control with precise aiming and tilt systems.
・Feel the exhilaration of thrilling victories through teamwork.

The reality of combat that excites military fans!
Precise gun control that shines through the tension!
Be sure to enjoy [Zero Hour], the ultimate team-based single player FPS game where you fight alongside your comrades!

Synopsis
International conflicts are intensifying over a rare energy source discovered in an unknown land.
Each country has deployed their elite special agents to secure this resource.
You are an agent at the forefront of this fierce competition.
Infiltrate deep into enemy territory to dominate strategic points, destroy enemy facilities, and steal crucial information.
Breathtaking engagements in bullet-ridden cities and treacherous terrains, covert infiltration operations,
and destructive demolition missions await you.
The fate of your nation rests in your hands. 
Enter the battlefield now!

70010000087023.name: Zombie Slaughter: Dead Zone
70010000087023.intro: Survive the zombie apocalypse! Kill zombies to stay alive in this thrilling game. Experience 2-player arcade-style gameplay and cooperate to defeat approaching zombies.
70010000087023.description:
Escape the relentless hordes of zombies! This quarter-view action game features a cinematic storyline where the protagonists from the previous installment once again fight for survival.
Use various weapons and items to survive in the zombie world! There are several cooperative modes for 1 to 2 players.
By passing a "Joy-Con™" to another player to "share," you can start a two-player game anywhere.

・Enjoy thrilling action as you defeat countless hordes of zombies with a variety of weapons.
・Clear increasingly difficult WAVES while fending off approaching zombies.
・Collect and upgrade unique weapons.
・Various items appear as you clear WAVES to help you win.
・Face various zombies of different sizes with unique attacks, adding to the fun of the battle.
・Collect all the special and varied weapons that fit the zombie apocalypse theme.
・Complete stages by surviving to the end of WAVES with 1-2 players working together.
・Enjoy a satisfying gameplay and reach the grand finale by surviving and completing the final stage! What kind of ending awaits you?

Share one "Joy-Con™" with another player for "sharing"!
Cooperative play anywhere by sharing controllers.
Enjoy arcade-style gameplay with up to 2-player cooperative mode!
Team up with a friend to survive the zombie world and experience the touching ending together!

Prologue
One day, the skies above the city were shrouded in darkness, and the once peaceful town was thrown into chaos by a sudden zombie attack. People, gripped by fear, were scrambling to flee, and the city quickly turned to rubble. Many fled for safety, but two people remained in the heart of the city.

MIKE is a streamer known for broadcasting live horror games. Despite his soft voice, he has excellent shooting skills. One day during a live broadcast, he witnessed zombies taking over the city and used his platform to broadcast the situation and send messages of hope to the survivors. As his fans cheered him on in real time, MIKE realized he had to become a survivor, not just an observer.
Meanwhile, KELLEY, a high school physical education teacher, is an avid fan and subscriber of MIKE. She enjoys various sports, especially biking and hiking, and led the survivors with her vibrant personality and strong leadership skills. She took responsibility for the safety of the students remaining in the gym and sought a safe place for them.

The two happened to meet in a corner of town. MIKE was gathering his broadcasting equipment while KELLEY was looking for weapons to protect the students. Recognizing each other's abilities, they decide to work together to overcome the zombie threat and plan their escape from the city.
Amidst the chaos of the city, they manage to contact a government rescue helicopter. They must survive the relentless onslaught of zombies until the helicopter arrives. Now begins the journey of survival for these two protagonists.

70010000087028.name: Gun Fire: AI Rebellion
70010000087028.intro: The futuristic Human City has been plunged into crisis by an invasion of AI robots. You are the only hope to take back the city! Fight against AI domination in exciting FPS!
70010000087028.description:
Experience intense battles against state-of-the-art AI drones and giant robots! Exhilarating action awaits as you use a variety of weapons to blast your enemies in spectacular fashion! We invite you to join the pulse-pounding battles that unfold on dynamic battlefields!

・ An evolutionary weapon system worthy of the Gunfire title allows for a unique weapon experience where performance improves and new features are added the more you use them!
・ There is an auto-fire assist system for FPS beginners! However, it reduces DPS compared to manual firing, so use it strategically!
・ Evolving AI enemies appear! Experience intelligent combat against AI enemies that learn and adapt.
・ Craft your own firearms using loot materials.
・ Collect and upgrade various weapons to build your own powerful arsenal!
・ Strategically choose the optimal weapons and equipment for each mission to grasp the key to victory.
・ Feel the excitement of growth as you upgrade your character and weapons.
・ A story mode with huge maps and varied stages for hours of enjoyment!
・ Multiple story branches that change based on your choices.
・ Fight on a variety of battlefields, from city streets to underground bunkers and skyscrapers.
・ Customize your character with skill trees!
・ Experience more immersive battlefield action with the AI companion system, which allows you to fight cooperatively with AI teammates!
・ Enjoy a multiplayer-like feel as you fight alongside AI companions using support equipment.

You are humanity's last hope! Can you suppress the AI rebellion and reclaim Human City? Download [Gunfire: AI Rebellion] now and take back the city from the AIs!

Prologue
As the mayor of Human City, you have fallen victim to the cunning schemes of the AI Robot City, and lost half of your city. Stripped of everything and exiled due to riots by enraged citizens, you now have only one way to restore your honor and reclaim the city: destroy the AI base. Your choices will determine the fate of humanity. Liberate Human City from AI domination and regain your lost honor.

70010000087033.name: Anime Puzzle Quest: The Magical Girls Adventure
70010000087033.intro: Join the Magical Girls on a Heartwarming Adventure – where every puzzle brings new bonds and discoveries.
70010000087033.description:
Embark on a heartwarming journey with a group of magical girls in Anime Puzzle Quest: The Magical Girls Adventure. In this enchanting game, you'll explore a beautifully crafted world where friendship, love and bravery lead the way. Solve engaging puzzles and uncover the secrets of a mystical realm, all while building deep connections with your companions.

Each level presents a unique challenge that encourages creative thinking and problem-solving. As you progress, you'll unlock new characters and stories, each adding a personal touch to your adventure.

Whether you're a puzzle enthusiast or new to the genre, Anime Puzzle Quest offers a gentle and immersive experience, inviting you to enjoy the magic of discovery and the joy of camaraderie.

70010000087038.name: Pharaoh's Riches
70010000087038.intro:
Toss coins and explore the mysteries of Ancient Egypt!
The pharaoh's golden riches await you!
70010000087038.description:
Knock down coins one after another and obtain the treasures of the gods.
Don't miss out when gold rains down!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 family members or friends can join in!

[Score Attack]
Earn as many coins as possible within the time limit and aim for a high spot on the leaderboards!
Play solo or multiplayer!

[Endless]
Play for as long as you like without a time limit!
Your coin count will persist between tries!

[Ranking]
Earn a rank for both Score Attack and Endless modes!
Compete for the highest coin count with players worldwide!

[Online]
Score Attack is also available in Online Mode!
Work together, and the treasure will be yours!

Play together with up to 4 players!
Alone or together, aim for your next high score!

70010000087046.name: Block Blaster DX!
70010000087046.intro: New block puzzle game, offering a relaxing yet challenging experience for all ages.
70010000087046.description:
Block Blaster DX! is a block puzzle game with an exciting twist—you have full control of where the blocks go! It’s a popular choice for casual play while providing a fun mental challenge.

The goal is simple yet engaging: match and clear as many colored blocks as possible on the board. Mastering the skill of filling rows or columns makes the game easier, while creating multiple combos helps you climb the leaderboards.

Block Blaster DX! offers a relaxing and cozy puzzle experience that also keeps your mind active and sharp.

Four Addictive Game Modes:
★ Classic Block Puzzle: Drag, drop, and rotate blocks to clear lines.  
★ Time Block Puzzle: Start with 60 seconds and earn additional time for every line cleared.  
★ Blast Block Puzzle: Clear lines to defuse bombs.  
★ Advanced Block Puzzle: Navigate complex shapes for a greater challenge.

Whether you’re tackling the endless challenges of Classic mode, unleashing powerful Block Blasts, or strategically placing pieces for maximum impact, the excitement never ends. Enjoy intuitive gameplay and captivating visuals.

Features:
★ Nintendo Switch™ online leaderboards for each mode.
★ Unlock and choose from 8 unique themes.  
★ Option for static or dynamic wallpapers.  
★ Toggle sound and music on/off.  
★ 8 professionally crafted background tracks.  
★ Multiple language support.  
★ Rescue games using coins (excluding Bomb mode).  


With simple controls, fantastic sound effects, and a great rhythm, Block Blaster DX! is a game you’ll keep coming back to!

Block Blaster DX! provides a truly immersive experience for puzzle lovers of all ages. Are you ready to tackle the ultimate block challenge and aim for the world championship?

70010000087052.name: SankakkuDoku
70010000087052.intro: S.O.S! Astronaut Aki-chan needs your help urgently....
70010000087052.description:
Background: In the near future, mankind has conquered the universe. The shields of a Mars-orbiting space station have been damaged by asteroids, and the A.I. repair bots have malfunctioned. Help astronaut Aki-chan repair the shields by placing triangle blocks to form lines vertically, horizontally, and diagonally.

SankakkuDoku! is a fun, exciting, and engaging block-matching puzzle game. Your goal is to place and combine groups of triangle blocks to create and clear lines in all directions; vertically, horizontally, and diagonally. Clear multiple lines at once to earn combo scores!

Connect, combine, and match triangle-shaped blocks to test your skills in this addicting and challenging puzzle game. SankakkuDoku! is the ultimate brain teaser designed to test and train your mind.

Four different game modes
★ Integrated daily rewards.
★ Professional sound effects and background music.
★ Rotate and flip groups of triangle blocks.
★ Nintendo Switch™ online leaderboard.

70010000087058.name: Float Survival Simulator - Ocean Survivor
70010000087058.intro: Survive the waves, outsmart the predators.
70010000087058.description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey in Float Survival Simulator: Ocean Survivor, where each wave can bring new adventures or deadly threats. Stranded on a fragile raft with only a hook, you must gather resources, battle fierce predators, and transform your raft into a secure floating haven. Survive alone or with friends on this treacherous ocean quest!
Key Features:
	•	Survive Shark Attacks: Defend yourself against relentless shark threats. Fortify your raft and stay one step ahead!
	•	Resource Crafting: Collect resources to build essential tools and upgrade your raft into a secure oasis.
	•	Hook Mastery: Use your hook to snag drifting debris and vital supplies—each catch is a step toward survival.
	•	Raft Expansion: Upgrade and personalize your floating base with new sections and decorative touches.
	•	Fishing & Cooking: Catch fish and cook meals to stay energized on your journey.
	•	Water Filtration: Convert seawater into drinkable fresh water to keep hydrated.
	•	Island Exploration: Discover new islands, unearth civilization remnants, and gather valuable resources.
Will you survive the dangers of the ocean and build a thriving sanctuary, or will the waves claim your fate? The ocean adventure of a lifetime awaits in Float Survival Simulator: Ocean Survivor!

70010000087064.name: Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions
70010000087064.intro: Become an elite operative, rescue hostages, win glory.Intense rescue missions await!
70010000087064.description:
Prepare for an adrenaline-pumping experience as you step into the shoes of an elite SWAT operative in "Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions". Immerse yourself in heart-pounding first-person action and lead your squad to victory in intense hostage rescue scenarios. Are you ready to become the ultimate savior in this thrilling shooter game?

Features:
1. Command a diverse team: Lead a squad with unique specialists like assault troops, medics, demolitions experts, and snipers.
2. Strategic planning: Analyze enemy positions, plan your approach, and adapt to dynamic situations in high-risk environments.
3. Intense firefights: Master a variety of weapons and equipment to eliminate threats with precision in fast-paced gunfights.
4. Gripping narrative: Unravel a web of intrigue as you uncover the truth behind the missions through immersive cutscenes.
5. Conquer challenges: Overcome unexpected setbacks, environmental hazards, and enemy reinforcements through quick thinking and decisive action.
6. Test your courage: Lead your team into dangerous situations, demonstrate bravery under fire, and emerge victorious against all odds.

Your courage and tactical prowess will be put to the ultimate test in the fight against injustice. Are you ready to answer the call of duty and become the ultimate hero?

70010000087069.name: Bulbs 2.0
70010000087069.intro: Mix colors and light in Bulbs 2.0, a challenging puzzle game where your logic skills are key to turning the entire board white.
70010000087069.description:
Bulbs 2.0 offers a unique twist on logic puzzles, combining the art of color mixing with strategic gameplay. Your board is filled with colored bulbs that affect their own light and its neighbors. Turn a red into a purple, a blue into a green, and much more—all with a single move. But every action causes a reaction: swap a bulb's color, and neighboring bulbs will shift too.

Your goal is to turn the whole board white within a limited number of steps. With over 100 levels, Bulbs 2.0 challenges you to think ahead and strategize each move carefully. From small grids to large, complex boards, every level offers a fresh puzzle that tests your logic and color-mixing skills.

Key Features
- 100+ levels of color-based logic puzzles
- Challenging gameplay with a limited number of moves
- Puzzles that vary in difficulty by board size
- Simple, intuitive interface designed for maximum puzzle-solving satisfaction

Dive into Bulbs 2.0 and see if you can light up the entire board!

70010000087074.name: Zombie Derby: Pixel Survival
70010000087074.intro: Get into the driver’s seat and put the pedal to the metal! The next part in the legendary Zombie Derby series is already here!
70010000087074.description:
Smash your way through hordes of zombies and countless obstacles in a rip-roaring racing arcade. Experience the zombie apocalypse like you’ve never seen it before. Eradicating zombies has never been so colorful, exciting, and engaging before.

Key features

• Crush zombies and blow through obstacles!
• Buy and upgrade cars!
• Explore levels!
• Complete tasks!

Don’t let any zombies snack on your brain!

70010000087079.name: Love Anime Boys Club: Language and Date Zodiac Signs
70010000087079.intro: Discover this seductive adventure through the city, where your mission is to win over the 12 most irresistible guys, each with a unique personality guided by their zodiac sign.
70010000087079.description:
In this exciting game of romance and wit, you’ll dive into flirtatious conversations, challenging your ability to read the signs and win each guy's heart. The clock is ticking: you only have 30 days to make them all fall in love.


Game features:

-12 guys, 12 zodiac signs, 12 challenges: Each guy has a personality influenced by his sign. Can you figure out what makes them fall in love and how to connect with them?

-Seductive conversations: Talk to them, get their number, send messages, and plan the perfect date.

-Love meter: Watch your love meter rise or fall based on your choices. Will you be able to fill their hearts before time runs out?

-Different endings: Depending on your decisions, each guy will react uniquely, unlocking passionate or challenging endings.

-Zodiac rituals: As the game progresses, you’ll uncover secret questions and unique challenges tied to their zodiac sign, allowing you to get to know them on a deeper, more personal level.

-30 days for love: The challenge is to win over the 12 guys in just one month! Every conversation, every date matters.


Do you have what it takes to seduce all 12 zodiac guys and become the master of romance?

Find out in this adventure full of passion, humor, and unexpected twists. Love is written in the stars!

70010000087082.name: Recall: Empty Wishes
70010000087082.intro: Echoes of the past linger—will you dare to listen?
70010000087082.description:
Recall: Empty Wishes is a psychological thriller set in Taiwan during the 2010s. Follow Yonny, a sister determined to uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of her brother, Tommy. As she delves deeper, she confronts unsettling secrets, blurring the lines between reality and illusion.

What led to the sudden disappearance of Tommy Lin, a smart and considerate boy? One day, Yonny discovers an old toy phone receiver she and Tommy used as children. This mysterious device connects Yonny and her friend to a surreal realm where they can enter the memory echoes of certain individuals linked to Tommy. Using the receiver, they tap into these people’s deepest desires, ultimately seeking to uncover the truth behind Tommy’s disappearance.

Step into the roles of Yonny and Phoebe as they relive the memories of crucial characters linked to Tommy's fate. Each chapter delves into one character’s past, unveiling their innermost wishes and secrets. In this captivating 2D side-scrolling adventure, players interact with a full cast of characters, collect key items, make pivotal choices, and investigate detailed scenes to unravel the mystery of Tommy's disappearance.

Features:
- Immersive adventure based on the culture of Taiwanese students in the 2010s
- Non-linear storytelling that combines elements of fantasy, mystery, and horror
- Multiple character perspectives with alternate points of view and narration
- Choices that affect other characters and endings
2D side-scrolling gameplay with interactive elements and puzzle-solving
- Pixel-art graphics combined with hand-drawn portraits of characters
- Multiple language support, including English, Chinese and Japanese

70010000087087.name: Lost and Hound
70010000087087.intro: Sniff. Track. Hunt criminals. Find and rescue victims.
70010000087087.description: Solve mysteries, find the lost, help people in trouble, track down criminals and save lives as Biscuit, the one-and-only doggo detective! User her superpowered hearing and scent tracking skills to catch criminals, solve crimes, track the lost and rescue people in mortal danger! As Biscuit, your kindness is a weapon against suffering. Use it.

70010000087091.name: School Paranormal Laboratory
70010000087091.intro: Our institute conducts research on mysterious phenomena and grudges that occur in schools.
70010000087091.description:
As an investigator, you will carry out field surveys, but it is a simple job that even those with no experience can perform.


[Purpose of the field research]
Find an object imbued with a grudge at the site, place it in a wooden chest, and bring it back. There is a target total amount of curse points for the investigation, so if possible, please achieve the target.

[Observation of Paranormal Phenomena]
At the site, actual paranormal phenomena can sometimes be observed. If you encounter a paranormal phenomenon, the smart glasses will automatically collect data, so please try to keep it in the center of your field of vision as much as possible. Since paranormal phenomena are more likely to be observed at late hours, the investigation will be conducted at night.

[Regarding the Supplies]
Investigators will be provided with helmet-type headgear and smart glasses. Installing an IC chip in the headgear enables useful effects for the investigation. Smart glasses will display necessary information at all times.

[Expansion IC Chip]
IC chips have levels, and their value increases with the level. Effects of multiple chips of the same type are cumulative. However, there is a maximum limit to the effects based on the type.

[Regarding Sanity]
Please keep the headgear light on to maintain brightness. Sanity decreases faster in the dark. Also, holding objects with accumulated grudges makes sanity drop more easily, depending on the amount of grudge.

[About the Research Team]
A research team can be formed with up to four investigators. Please assemble a research team as needed.

[Advice from a Senior]
It's a very safe job as long as you keep your sanity. Until you get used to it, don't push yourself too hard, and even if you haven't reached your goals, return to the laboratory early while you still have plenty of battery life and sanity left.

70010000087094.name: NO MOSAIC GIRLS with SESS-AI 2.0
70010000087094.intro:
Break Mosaic to Save the Girls!
Simulation RPG by Great Think Program!
70010000087094.description:
***** Story *****
You are the game player. Now favorite game is "Angelic Manager", there are many pretty girls in it. But, the pictures have been covered with Mosaic suddenly! Amd you heard a mysterious voice.

"Help... Help me, this world!"

Then you were drawn into the game, and your adventure is started.

***** Overview *****
This is team's turn-based Simulation RPG. Rules are simple and reasonable, but never easy. To win the battle, you must use "Cheer Magic" and "Mosaic Break" well. The most important thing is your inspiration.

***** SESS-AI 2.0 *****
We made the Thinking Program "SESS-AI 2.0". By it, enemy acts so various that you will be amazed. This experience exists only in our game.

***** Language *****
English and Japanese are available.

70010000087100.name: Hakkakudoku
70010000087100.description:
In a world where honey production is key to survival, the queen bee has tasked you, the most creative and skilled worker bee, with maintaining and expanding the hive’s honeycombs. But there’s a twist each honeycomb is a complex hexagonal puzzle, and only by arranging the honeycomb cells in perfect alignment can the nectar flow smoothly.

As you rotate, flip, and split the honey-filled hexagonal cells, your mission is to clear pathways (lines) to store honey efficiently. The more honeycombs you align at once, the greater your rewards in the form of golden nectar.

In the Classic Mode, maintain the hive's structure at your own pace, carefully planning each move. But in Time Trial Mode, race against the clock to ensure enough honey is collected before the day ends. Watch out in Bomb Mode, where rogue honey-bombs threaten to destroy your careful work. And if you're up for a real challenge, the Advance Mode will test your ultimate puzzle-solving skills with complex honeycomb arrangements.

With daily rewards for consistent work and global competition among bees, can you become the top worker and rise to the top of the Nintendo Switch™ global leaderboard?

70010000087104.name: Piczle Cross: Rune Factory
70010000087104.intro: Solve fun Piczle logic puzzles created from the world of Rune Factory!
70010000087104.description:
Based on the world and characters of Rune Factory 3 Special, 4 Special and 5, work your way through hundreds of puzzles.
Complete puzzles to unlock the real-world counterparts and use them to customise your farm, plant vegetables, recruit monsters, and choose your farm location to create your own unique Rune Factory 3D scene!

Select your weapon and go head-to-head in puzzle battles with the monsters from Rune Factory. A right move will deal damage on the monster, but a wrong move will inflict damage on you. Can you solve the puzzle before your time is up?

As you complete the puzzles and capture monsters, a compendium of characters and bestiary of monsters unlocks, where you can view everybody's likes and dislikes, as well as view all monsters in 3D.

There is also a journal to track your progress and a music player to listen to the 60+ included tracks from Rune Factory 3 Special, 4 Special and 5. 

You can even choose a marriage partner from the bachelors you uncover.

Choose if you’d like to solve a puzzle as either black & white, colour, or both, in challenge mode or play at your own pace!

Features
* Gorgeous 3D art from Rune Factory 3 Special, Rune Factory 4 Special, and Rune Factory 5.
* 450 puzzles you can play as either black & white or colour nonograms!
* 20 collage puzzles, made up of many smaller puzzles, both in classic and colour variations!
* Fight and capture monsters!
* Uncover villagers and bachelors!
* Unlock entries in the in-game Bestiary and learn more about the monsters of Rigbarth!
* Detailed play statistics for the most ardent nonogram fanatics!
* Play how you want: laid-back and relaxed or challenging!
* Controller and touch-screen input
* A wealth of puzzle options to tweak the experience to your exact liking!
* Accessibility options, including dyslexia font, colour vision support and left or right-handed touch screen interface.
* 40 special achievements to unlock!

70010000087122.name: Bridge Race
70010000087122.intro: Build your way to victory, one brick at a time!
70010000087122.description:
Grab your bricks, get building, and race to the finish line before your rivals even lay their first stone! Collect bricks of your color and build your bridge to the next level. Got some extra bricks? Use them to expand your castle and unlock quirky new brick designs!

Want to slow the competition down? No problem! Trip them up and zoom ahead to claim first place. Crush those bonus levels to stack up coins, and then use them to unlock new skins and colors to show off your style!

NEW VERSUS MODE FOR UP TO 4 PLAYERS!
Compete with your friends in an exciting head-to-head split-screen showdown. Choose your custom color and unique skin, set the number of rounds, and let your building skills shine. Earn points each round based on your finish, and see who rises to the top of the leaderboard. Ready to show off your skills and claim victory? 

Features:
- Build across endless levels of fun!
- Local multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
- Customize your bricks and character for a unique look!
- Expand your castle with extra bricks!
- Challenge yourself in epic bonus and boss stages!

Outbuild, outsmart, and outlast the competition—who knew building bridges could be this much fun?

70010000087124.name: Eraser VS Ruler
70010000087124.intro:
Which side will you choose?!
Eraser Army VS Ruler Army
The ultimate desktop showdown is about to begin!
70010000087124.description:
The duel you've only dreamed of is finally a reality!
Battle it out with advanced original machines and stages, and claim victory for your team!

[Battle]
Select an army and defeat opponent after opponent!
Use your special move when in a jam to turn the tides of battle!

[Online]
Fight against the other side's forces and lead your army to victory!
You can also compete with your allies in the army participation ranking!
Enter a Room Match to battle with up to 4 friends!

[Customization]
With new additional parts, the combinations are limitless!
Create original erasers and rulers unique to you!

70010000087129.name: Skater's Solstice
70010000087129.intro: Become a master of the ice by skating your way through increasingly challenging sliding puzzles!
70010000087129.description:
Slide across frozen lakes and gather stars in a chill puzzle adventure where you take the role of a young ice skater! Skater’s Solstice is a top-down brainteasing game with a wintry theme and crisp HD visuals where you’ll need to overcome 50 stages of gradually increasing complexity to achieve ice skating mastery. Each stage contains 3 stars and a glimmering exit.

Can you put it all together and gather all the stars?

Features:

• Take the role of an ice skater in top-down adventuring style!
• Master 50 brainteasing levels of sliding puzzle action.
• Collect stars and make your way to the exit to progress!
• Slide along the ice in straight lines and use the environment to your advantage.
• Enjoy gradually increasing challenge as new gameplay elements are introduced!

70010000087135.name: Moving Houses
70010000087135.intro: Pack it all up as you move furniture, house plants and more in whimsical first-person style!
70010000087135.description:
There comes a time in everyone’s life when they must leave their home behind and find another. Now in Moving Houses, it's your turn… whether you really want to leave or not. Enjoy a silly physics-based game about moving on as you box up your life while immersed in casual comfy gameplay and the instant gratification of task-based gamification of packing chores. Be neat, be careful or be a chaos goblin. The choice is yours!

As you navigate in first-person, you’ll pick up furniture, plants, paintings and more, loading them carefully (or not so carefully) into the moving truck, completing checklists of important tasks to progress. Run, jump, kick, drop, throw, rotate objects and more! But be warned, not all is as it seems in this quiet little house. An eerie mystery could lie beneath the mundane monotony of the task at hand.

Features:

• Run, jump, kick, drop, throw and rotate objects!
• Load items into the moving truck and complete lists of packing chores to progress.
• Create your own fun through silly physics-based chaos!
• Freely explore your house in first-person perspective.
• Uncover an underlying mystery that may or may not be the reason for leaving this place!

70010000087141.name: Hot&Hentai
70010000087141.intro: Step into the brand new version of the enchanting world of Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70010000087141.description:
Those captivating girls will invite you to take part in the most alluring puzzle experience available on Nintendo Switch™.


ANIME AS AN ART FORM
Immerse yourself in the beautiful anime-inspired art of Hentai Girls, where you'll get to know these stunning and intriguing women. Solve their puzzles to advance through their stories, all while enjoying their charming company.


CHALLENGING PROGRESSION
While the gameplay starts off simple, the challenges grow as you move forward. Stay focused – their enticing outfits might be distracting.


KEY FEATURES:
- Stunning hand-drawn Hentai illustrations
- Soothing background music
- Easy-to-learn gameplay with increasing difficulty
- A unique and special concept

70010000087146.name: WARRIORS: Abyss
70010000087146.intro: Through victory and defeat, traverse the merciless trials of hell.
70010000087146.description:
Take command of historic and masterful warriors by challenging countless swarms of enemies. Through victory and defeat, traverse the merciless trials of hell.

• A new type of battles fought alongside combinations of 100 and more heroes.
There are 100 and more heroes for players to ally with, allowing them to combine the unique traits of multiple heroes and create their own powerful parties who will help them fight their way through the dead souls of Hell.

• A new form of "WARRIORS" where heroes can be summoned to help eliminate enemies.
By summoning heroes, the player can engage in impressive battles where they daringly rout endless hordes of enemies. This feature will offer players a new form of exhilaration never before experienced in the "WARRIORS" series.

Note: This product is included in both "WARRIORS: Abyss - Hack'n'Dash Edition" and "WARRIORS: Abyss - Hack'n'Dash Ultimate Edition." Please confirm that you have selected the correct product before making your purchase.

70010000087152.name: Great God Grove
70010000087152.intro: Suck up and launch speech bubbles to SAVE DA WORLD FROM A-POCKY-LIPS!
70010000087152.description:
THE WORLD IS ENDING AND THE GODS ARE SQUABBLING! Suck up and launch speech bubbles in a wacky world of puzzles, puppets, and weird gods… or THE RIFT WILL CONSUME US ALL!!

Once in a generation, the gods come together to postpone the apocalypse. But this time, the god of communication started a bunch of heavenly fights and then went awol.

With the sky splitting and the gods in disarray, who’s gonna join the Bizzyboys to help SAVE DA WORLD FROM A-POCKY-LIPS???

• SUCK UP AND LAUNCH DIALOGUE! As the gods’ new mail-carrier, you can suck up speech bubbles and fire them at anyone to communicate! Solve puzzles! Flirt! HURT GODS’ FEELINGS! Aww…
• DISCOVER BIZARRE GODS: The god of teamwork? The god of LOVE SONGS? Drain it, who’s in charge around here…?
• Experience talking scarecrows! Cooking puppets!! THE END OF THE WORLD AS WE KNOW IT!!!

70010000087157.name: American Arcadia
70010000087157.description:
Arcadia. A 70’s retro-futuristic metropolis where all its citizens enjoy a life of luxury and comfort… unaware that they’re being broadcast live 24/7! Arcadia is not an ordinary city, but the most watched reality show on the planet - where a drop in popularity ratings comes at the highest cost: death.

For an average man with an uninteresting life like Trevor Hills, this could mean serious trouble - but luckily Trevor is being helped by a mysterious voice who will guide him through American Arcadia's backstage to his freedom. But is this all real, or just another show gimmick to raise audience ratings?

American Arcadia combines two gameplay styles, a 2.5D platformer and a first-person puzzle game, to reveal a unique story in a thrilling single player experience.

Uncover the truth and escape with your life in American Arcadia! 
 
ESCAPE FROM A 70'S TELEVISED UTOPIA
The gripping story will be presented as a documentary with interviews and police interrogations of the characters as you progress through the game.

TWO EXPERIENCES, ONE GAME
American Arcadia gives you control over two characters in completely different environments and unique playstyles: A 2.5D action side-scroller including challenging platform action, breath-taking chases, stealth and puzzles. As well as a full 3D first-person game, with hacking, exploration, stealth elements, and more puzzles to solve.

IMPRESSIVE VOICE CAST
Yuri Lowenthal (Spider-Man 1 & 2, Prince of Persia The Sands of Time, Call of the Sea), Krizia Bajos (Cyberpunk 2077, League of Legends) and Cissy Jones (Firewatch, Life is Strange, Call of the Sea), among others, breathe life into the characters in American Arcadia.

70010000087162.name: Arcade Archives VS. BATTLE CITY
70010000087162.intro:
Take down the enemy tank corps 
and hold your HQ to the end!
70010000087162.description:
"VS. BATTLE CITY" is a shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1985.
Take control of a tank and face down your enemies while defending your own HQ!
The key to victory is to break down walls, create your own routes, lead enemies to fight where you have the advantage, and use the terrain tactically.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000087167.name: Ice Cream Wars
70010000087167.intro: A madcap arcade driving game in the unexpectedly cut-throat world of the frozen confectionary distribution industry.
70010000087167.description:
For too long Gelatoni's had the run of this town. With his monopoly over ice cream delivery enforced by thugs in souped-up trucks, and generous bribes making sure the law turns a blind eye, he's been able to force the innocent hard-working people of Rippleton to pay over the odds for their gelato fix for decades.

Well no more, it's high time someone stood up to this injustice! Your buddy has borrowed money from an unsavoury character and bought a battered old van, and the pair of you are going to take the fight to the streets and show these punks there are new kids in town and you're hungry for success.

And look, if you happen to make yourselves a load of lovely cash in the process, well that's just win/win isn't it?

Time to show some scumbags it's your way or the sorbet!

Features
∙ High octane ice cream delivery thrills (and spills) with a score based challenge. How much can you sell?
∙ Speed your way around three districts of Rippleton - the suburbs (easy: loads of kids out playing, perfect selling location), beach (medium: hot, but everyone's too busy concentrating on their tan), and downtown (hard: don't want to risk dripping all over their fancy suits).
∙ Loads of weird power ups to help take down your your rivals.
