Choose your favorite and play right away!

[Online Mode]
Connect with players from around the world to compete in Sugoroku or your favorite minigames!

<Skin Edit>
Create your own original style with customizable player pieces!
Design unique skins and play with them in-game!

70010000087498.name: Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+
70010000087498.intro: Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+ is coming to Nintendo Switch™!
70010000087498.description:
This new and improved version of Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S includes a variety of new features!
Work alongside Miku and other Piapro characters to solve these unique puzzles!

Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+ New Features
Multiple new puzzles have been added to the previous title!
In addition to the Normal Puzzles and all-new illustration-based Special Puzzles,
you can also update the appearance of each Piapro character, and even customize your room to your liking.

◇Immerse yourself in the puzzle-solving action with more than twice the content of the previous game, including more than 1,000 new puzzles!
Try your hand at 10x10, 15x15, and even 20x20 puzzles!
Complete stages with each character to unlock new costumes, room items, and even more gorgeous artwork!
In addition to the 75x75 Special Puzzles from the previous game, this updated version includes even more challenging 100x100 puzzles as well!
There are also more than 30 illustrations from popular illustrators to enjoy!

◇New Features! Change your characters' costumes and freely customize your room as you take on these puzzles with your favorite characters!
Just like the last game, Miku and the other Piapro characters will cheer you on as you solve these challenging puzzles!
Best of all, this game has added all-new costume and room editing features!
Dress up the characters in various outfits and rearrange your room in order to better enjoy your puzzle-solving adventures!

◇Includes special fan-made songs officially chosen by Piapro!
The game includes 30 songs that were specially selected from fan submissions!
Complete the puzzle missions and collect “stars” along the way!
Collect enough stars to unlock new songs! ♪
You can enjoy your puzzles while listening to your favorite songs on the home and puzzle screens!

◇What is Hatsune Miku Logic Paint?
Use the numbers above and to the left of the puzzles as hints to color in the appropriate squares and complete the illustration to solve them!
The handy "X" feature lets you block out squares to keep track of those that shouldn't be colored in.
You can always review the basic rules within the game if you ever need a refresher course!

70010000087506.name: The Cheese Chase: Pizza Madness
70010000087506.intro: Become the best pizza delivery guy in town!
70010000087506.description:
Do you love pizza as much as we do? Take on the role of a crazy delivery man and supply city residents with hot pizzas. However, be careful! There are gluttons lurking around the corner who will want to pick up and eat your orders and interrupt your route! Become the supplier of the year!

Key words:

10+ characters to choose from
50+ difficulty levels
10+ cities to visit
Challenges, side quests and puzzles
Trophy system with collector's album

70010000087511.name: Wolf Pack - Howling Spirits
70010000087511.intro: Embark on a mystical journey in Wolf Pack – Howling Spirits, where you play as a young wolf destined to awaken ancient guardians.
70010000087511.description:
In Wolf Pack - Howling Spirits, you step into the paws of a young wolf, chosen by the ancient guardian to embark on a profound journey. Your mission is to explore a breathtaking, open-world environment filled with towering forests, shimmering lakes, ancient ruins, and quiet human villages. In this serene yet mysterious landscape, your goal is to locate your slumbering kin—other wolves scattered across the land—and awaken them to form a powerful pack.
But awakening these wolves isn’t as simple as nudging them awake. To awake them from their ancient slumber, you must delve into their dreams, each one a unique world shaped by that wolf’s past experiences and emotions. These dreamscapes offer a variety of gameplay challenges, from navigating perilous platforming sections and solving intricate puzzles to facing intense chase sequences and uncovering hidden spirits. Every dream is a test of your skills and understanding, requiring you to help each wolf confront and overcome the issues that haunt them in their sleep.
As you progress, each awakened wolf joins your pack, bringing new strengths and abilities that allow you to explore deeper into the world. 
Wolf Pack - Howling Spirits offers an immersive experience that blends exploration, action, and emotional storytelling. It’s a game about unity, growth, and the powerful bonds that can form between those who journey together. As you explore this rich world, you’ll uncover ancient secrets, confront challenges, and prepare your pack for an epic destiny, all while experiencing the world through the eyes of a wolf.

70010000087514.name: House of Horror - 7 Psychos
70010000087514.intro: Face seven deadly psychopaths, each guarding a terrifying floor. Solve puzzles, avoid traps, and exploit their weaknesses to escape the nightmare.
70010000087514.description:
Where a simple visit to a fairground becomes a nightmarish fight for survival. You’ve heard the legends of the haunted mansion and its seven deranged psychopaths, each guarding a floor of the house, but you dismiss the warnings. As soon as you step inside, the door locks behind you. There’s no way out—except through all seven floors.

Gameplay: This is a first-person, single-player horror experience. It begins at an eerie fairground, where an omniscient narrator introduces you to its unsettling attractions. As you explore, you’re drawn to the infamous haunted house. Outside, disturbing exhibits and surreal art hint at the horrors to come. Once inside, your terrifying journey begins. The mansion has seven deadly floors, each ruled by a different psychopath representing one of the seven deadly sins. Each level is a labyrinth filled with traps, puzzles, and unique enemy mechanics. Your goal is to reach the elevator to escape, but first, you must outsmart the psychopaths. The narrator will provide hints about each killer’s weaknesses, but solving the mystery and surviving is up to you. Every floor presents a different challenge, where you’ll need to use strategy and quick thinking to avoid the killer, solve hidden puzzles, and navigate the deadly maze. As you progress, the tension rises, and the puzzles grow more complex, mixing horror, suspense, and puzzle-solving in a chilling game of cat and mouse. Can you survive the madness, outsmart all seven psychos, and escape the haunted mansion? Or will you become just another victim of the mansion’s twisted legacy?

70010000087517.name: The Last Light
70010000087517.intro: Rediscover a log lost love in a heartfelt journey through life's stages.
70010000087517.description:
In The Last Light, set off on a moving journey through the memories of a man reflecting on his life, love, and loss. This narrative exploration game invites players to experience how love and vision are deeply connected as you move through the protagonist’s life, encountering moments of joy, sorrow, and introspection.

The story unfolds in the vibrant days of the protagonist's youth, where you relive his childhood memories alongside Emily, the love of his life. Emily isn’t just a companion—she’s his guiding light, illuminating memories and experiences as they journey through life together. But over time, the protagonist’s eyesight begins to fade, altering his world and the gameplay profoundly.

As his vision deteriorates, colors begin to drain from the environment, making it harder to navigate. Yet, Emily’s presence brings light and clarity, representing how love can brighten even the darkest moments.

Experience the stages of life, from the dreams of youth to the bittersweet reality of growing old together. The Last Light is a powerful narrative about love, memory, and time—a touching exploration of how relationships guide us through life’s most challenging passages.

70010000087520.name: Sinvers on Wheels
70010000087520.intro: Crazy racing game where the tracks change every game.
70010000087520.description:
The craziest race is about to start!

Get in your kart and race through a bunch of levels full of obstacles and other crazy surprises. In this amazing racing game, each new game generates a different track. 

Can you conquer the world podium?

70010000087531.name: Hyper Team Recon
70010000087531.intro: Hyper Team Recon is an adorable 3D platformer about three aliens and their adventure across Earth!
70010000087531.description:
Hyper Team Recon is an adorable 3D platformer about three aliens and their adventure across Earth! Three energetic alien slimes, Ember, Penny and Lite, are tasked to travel to Earth in order to learn more about the lifeforms inhabiting the planet, using their species' unique morphing abilities to disguise themselves as girls in order to keep a low profile!

But after their ship crashes after a non-specific captain falls asleep at the wheel - *cough* Ember *cough* - The trio get split up and stranded on Earth, leading them to each traverse through a variety of locations full of platforming, puzzles and combat, meeting a lively cast of friends and foes along the way!

Tracking the slime's progress every step of the way is H.E.R.B, a helpful slime A.I who keeps up-to-date with what's happening on Earth, while using the foil collected to fill out his scrapbook, a special book to fill with foil to unlock goodies, like new outfits, bite-size challenge zones, extra cutscenes, and more!

Features:
Transform into anyone you meet - As shapeshifting alien slimes, morph into friends and foes alike to copy their forms and gain unique abilities!
Mechanics - From platforming, to puzzles, to combat, use the morphing mechanic to gain new abilities to help you in each of these fields!
Travel the world - As the slimes travel across the planet, jump, solve, and fight through various platforming challenges, puzzles and combat encounters in a variety of locations!
Collectables - Pick up foil scattered throughout the levels in order to fill out the scrapbook, as well as break open objects for even more foil! Be on the lookout for rarer collectables too, such as the 5 souvenirs hidden throughout each level!
Charming visuals - Cutesy paper inspired visuals during gameplay are paired up with expressive, animated anime models of the characters during visual novel-style cutscenes to add a further level of charm to the game's world and storytelling!
Lively cast - Meet all sorts of cute and colourful characters on your journey across Earth, from a soda-addicted teen to a jellyfish mage, all with their own forms and abilities to copy!
Unlockable extras - Complete optional goals or spend foil to fill out the scrapbook to unlock different outfits for the slimes, as well as special scenes to watch!
Replayability - Replay old levels and push your abilities to their limits to find hidden routes and collectables to clear optional objectives!

70010000087534.name: BURGER RACE
70010000087534.intro:
Get ready to race at top speed in Burger Race!
Which machine will be the first to cross the finish line?
70010000087534.description:
Burger Race is a simple and fun game that anyone can enjoy!
Up to 4 players can race together in local multiplayer by sharing Joy-Con™!

Every machine has a unique set of characteristics!
Will you go with raw speed? Smooth handling? The choice is yours!

Drift and dash to zip around every corner!
Use items to make your opponents slip up and crash!

Expect the unexpected as events occur during the race!
The lights could suddenly go out, or nuggets could fall onto the track!

【Time Attack】
Choose a course and record your best time!
Compete with players from around the world on the online leaderboards!

【Free Race】
Choose a course to run with friends and CPUs!
With items and special events, the racing experience is totally different from Time Attack!

【Grand Prix】
Run through several courses of your choice in order!
Accumulate wins and become the grand champion!

Enjoy playing with up to 4 players!
Challenge friends and family for 1st place and have fun!

70010000087542.name: PINEAPPLE: A Bittersweet Revenge
70010000087542.intro: Become the hero of the school by pulling clever pranks on the class bully — but as the tables turn, you might discover she's not the only one learning a lesson.
70010000087542.description:
PINEAPPLE spins the tale of a sweet, yet biting, revenge. You’ll devise clever pranks, placing pineapples in the most unexpected and personal spaces of the bully, driving her to the brink. But be warned: she’s not the only one who’ll learn a thing or two.

This unique prank simulator blends a humorous storyline with fun challenges, unraveling a revenge story centered on the quirks of bullying. It’s short and mischievous, but packed with meaning.

In PINEAPPLE, you’ll...
- Investigate the witch and uncover her secrets.
- Use what you’ve learned to prank her by... hiding pineapples everywhere!
- But it won’t be a walk in the park—you’ll face some hurdles if you want to become the school’s ultimate hero.

Features:
- Handcrafted illustrations: Realistic in the way that they mirror the doodles we all scribbled in our teenage notebooks.
- Humor: Bullying is no joke, but PINEAPPLE uses humor to make its message hit home, transcending boundaries.
- Music: A catchy, original soundtrack with lyrics that will have you humming along. Could this be the next summer hit?

Become the ultimate prankster by cleverly stashing pineapples in the most unexpected places until the bully loses her cool!

70010000087547.name: Picross™ : Juufuutei Raden™'s Guide for Pixel Museum
70010000087547.description:
Solve the puzzle and complete the art!
"Pixel Puzzle" that lets you experience art and culture with Juufuutei Raden.

A VTuber from hololive DEV_IS, "Juufuutei Raden" from ReGLOSS, will guide you through the museum as the curator!
The entire game world, including Curator Raden and the museum, is depicted in "pixel art".
Join her as you tour the museum, solve puzzles, and work towards completing the "Dot Art" throughout the museum.

●You can enjoy Dot Art & Curator Raden's commentary!
The puzzle is a "Pixel Puzzle" where the illustration is completed by solving it.
The main puzzles are based on themes related to arts, crafts, and culture.
In addition to enjoying the completed "Dot Art", you can also enjoy explanations of artworks with voice commentary by Curator Raden.

●Play at your own pace with "Pixel Puzzle"
This is a puzzle with simple rules that can be solved by using the vertical and horizontal numbers as clues.
With a detailed tutorial, even beginners can easily enjoy the puzzles.
Various assist functions are implemented to ensure smooth gameplay.
*The assist function can also be turned off.

●Types and number of puzzles
In addition to arts and crafts, it will also includes many puzzles related to Juufuutei Raden!
You can also enjoy the illustrated puzzles, reimagined from previous streamed content.
A wide range of puzzle sizes are available, from "5x5" to "40x30".
150 standard pixel puzzles, where each puzzle completes a single illustration.
10 special puzzles, where multiple puzzles come together to create a large illustration.
The total number of puzzles is over 300, offering a generous volume!

70010000087552.name: Lofi Chill Sessions: Relax Island
70010000087552.intro: Escape to serenity with every beat.
70010000087552.description:
Welcome to Lofi Chill Sessions: Relax Island, your serene retreat where relaxation meets productivity. Set against a soothing lofi soundtrack, this gamified focus tool is designed to help you unwind, enhance concentration, and manage your real-life tasks effortlessly.

Features:
* Soothing Lofi Soundtrack: Enjoy a calming lofi soundtrack that creates a peaceful atmosphere, ideal for relaxation and improving focus as you go about your tasks.
* Pets Discovery: Explore the tranquil world of Relax Island and discover charming Pets hat add a touch of magic and serenity to your virtual environment.
* Customizable Virtual Space: Personalize your cozy island room with a range of décor options and furnishings. Create a calming and inspiring space that supports your relaxation and productivity needs.
* Task Management Tools: Utilize practical features like to-do lists and timers to help organize and streamline your real-life tasks, enhancing your overall efficiency.
* Stress Relief Features: Engage in activities designed to ease stress and promote mindfulness, helping you maintain a balanced and focused state of mind.
* Gentle Gamification: Experience a smooth and unobtrusive gamified approach that integrates seamlessly with your relaxation and focus goals.
* Beautiful Characters: Meet and interact with charming, beautifully designed characters who add personality and warmth to your virtual island, enhancing your overall experience.

Whether you’re seeking a peaceful escape or a tool to boost your productivity, Lofi Chill Sessions: Relax Island offers the perfect blend of tranquility and functionality. Immerse yourself in a soothing lofi world, customize your island room retreat, and let the calming sounds and features guide you to a more focused and relaxed life.

70010000087557.name: O.W.L Projekt
70010000087557.intro: Guide a young being’s daring escape as you puzzle your way through isometric landscapes!
70010000087557.description:
Get ready for an enigmatic and challenging adventure with O.W.L Projekt, a 3D isometric puzzle game that will test your mind and logic skills. Controlling Elysion, a young being created in a mysterious experiment, you will face the enigmatic Watchers in a journey to escape and uncover secrets.

Armed with the powerful Sanctum Staff, Elysion can move objects and overcome obstacles, offering a unique and immersive gaming experience. Challenge yourself through 50 meticulously designed levels as you manipulate blocks, drag platforms, discover secret passages and climb ladders in rotating dioramas, with new mechanics introduced as difficulty gradually ramps up!

Features:

• Help guide a young experimental being as he is pursued by his mysterious creators!
• Overcome 50 environmental puzzles of increasing complexity and difficulty.
• Clear a path for Elysion using the power of his Sanctum Staff!
• Manipulate platforms, climb ladders and more in rotatable isometric dioramas.
• Enjoy a minimalistic narrative through organic storytelling!

70010000087562.name: Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor
70010000087562.intro: Survive the Past! Unleash prehistoric power evolve, explore, conquer!
70010000087562.description:
Step into the prehistoric era of dinosaurs and embark on a thrilling evolutionary journey! Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor offers a unique blend of survival, exploration, and RPG elements, all set in lush, dynamic biomes waiting to be explored.

 Here’s what you can expect:

• Evolutionary Gameplay: Experience 10 immersive chapters, each representing a different dinosaur's life. From the nimble Compsognathus to the mighty Tyrannosaurus Rex, relive the awe-inspiring life cycles of iconic dinosaurs.

• Dynamic Biomes: Navigate through dense forests, scorching deserts, roaring waterfalls, and volcanic terrains. Each biome offers distinctive challenges, resources, and secrets.

• Customization & Growth: Upgrade and personalize your dinosaurs! Enhance their speed, strength, and skills. Plus, with unique skins and roars, make your mark in the Dino Survival Simulator.

• Missions & Challenges: Overcome 50+ missions! Hunt, forage, defend territories, and engage in epic duels. Each mission is tailored to test your survival instincts and strategic prowess.

• Community & Trade: Form clans, communicate with players worldwide, and engage in resource trading. Together, dominate the prehistoric lands!

• Authentic Experience: Dive into accurate dino depictions. From their looks to sounds, experience realism like never before!

Unearth the mysteries, face ancient challenges, and rise as the ultimate dinosaur in Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor.

70010000087568.name: SNOW BROS. 2 SPECIAL
70010000087568.description:
SNOW BROS. 2 SPECIAL is a remake of TOAPLAN's 1994 release Snow Bros. 2. The IP license has now passed to TATSUJIN, who will continue its legacy. Enjoy the original storyline of rescuing a princess from the Demon King, but now with four protagonists whose character designs and graphics have been upgraded to fit the remake's new modern style while retaining their unique qualities.

Support for four-player multiplayer has been added, providing a variety of fun along with a number of new modes such as Original Mode, Survival Mode, Time Attack Mode and Sky Run. Players can also experience a new kind of fun by completing the game's stage as one of the many monster enemies in the new Monster Challenge mode. Last but not least, the quality of the game has been improved across the board with the addition of several new stages!

Game Features
- Experience the game in its original 1994 arcade style, or the new remake style
- Improved and modernized graphics
- Local and online co-op play for up to four players
- Exciting challenge modes including Survival, Time Attack, Sky Run.
- Take it to the next level with new stages, monsters, bosses, and more!
- Walk a mile in their shoes! Play as a variety of monster enemies in the Monster Challenge mode!

70010000087573.name: Felinea Tales
70010000087573.intro: In this thrilling adventure, help Bill, a humanoid cat, restore peace to his village after a devastating attack.
70010000087573.description:
Felinea Tales is a captivating 2.5D platformer where players step into the paws of Bill, a brave and agile cat. After the peaceful village of Felinea falls victim to the sinister experiments of the wizard Abyssius, Bill sets out on an epic journey to restore order and save his home.

Jump, fight enemies, and dodge dangers as you help Bill seek justice. Explore diverse worlds filled with challenges, secrets, and exciting adventures.

Designed to appeal to players of all ages, Felinea Tales offers an unforgettable adventure with nostalgic charm and a modern twist, making it a perfect choice for fans of adventure games and immersive storytelling. 

Are you ready to help Bill bring justice to Felinea?

70010000087576.name: Zombies Crusher
70010000087576.description: Zombies Crusher is an endless runner game set in a post apocalyptic world. Drive your car forward, crush zombies, and avoid obstacles. Earn money and score points to upgrade your vehicle. Can you achieve the highest score? Join the action and find out!

70010000087581.name: Cell Scientist: Beyond
70010000087581.intro: An exciting puzzle game with 50 levels story mode and easy to pick gameplay mechanics. Embark on an adventure to destroy viruses using futuristics nano ships and help the patients!
70010000087581.description: Save a sci-fi world from the dangerous Chaga virus in Cell Scientists: Beyond, an exciting puzzle game with 50 levels story mode and easy to pick gameplay mechanics. Embark on an adventure to destroy viruses using futuristics nano ships and help the patients.  Save the day using your puzzle-solving skills!

70010000087583.name: Deads On The Road: Shoot Zombie Hunting 2024
70010000087583.intro:
Survive the zombie apocalypse in "Deads on the Road"!
Scavenge for supplies, battle hordes of the undead, and uncover hidden secrets.
70010000087583.description:
Survive the apocalypse in "Deads on the Road: Shoot Zombie Hunting 2024" an intense action-adventure game. Navigate a post-apocalyptic world overrun by the undead as you fight for survival. Armed with an arsenal of weapons and your wits, you must explore abandoned cities, scavenge for supplies, and fend off hordes of zombies that lurk around every corner.

Features:

Thrilling Combat: Engage in heart-pounding battles against various types of zombies, each with unique behaviors and weaknesses.
Immersive Exploration: Drive through desolate landscapes, search abandoned buildings, and uncover the secrets of a world fallen into chaos.
Survival Mechanics: Manage your health, ammo, and resources wisely. Every decision could mean the difference between life and death.
Engaging Storyline: Follow a gripping narrative that unfolds as you progress, revealing the truth behind the outbreak.
Customizable Gameplay: Choose from different difficulty levels to match your playstyle, from casual exploration to hardcore survival.

70010000087592.name: Wukong's Child: Monkey King Myth
70010000087592.intro: Embark on an epic journey as Wukong's child. Face mythical creatures, solve ancient puzzles, and uncover the secrets of the Monkey King. Are you ready for the adventure of a lifetime?
70010000087592.description:
Prepare for New Challenges in Wukong's Child: Monkey King Myth!

Delve into three brand-new levels that will push your skills to the limit.

Ironclad Dungeon: Navigate through this fortified dungeon filled with deadly traps and powerful foes lurking in the shadows.
Lakeside Grove: Explore a tranquil yet treacherous forest grove where beauty hides lurking dangers.
Graveyard of Echoes: Enter the haunted grounds where restless spirits guard their secrets.
Each level offers unique experiences and challenges—are you ready to face them?

70010000087597.name: Puzzle & Summoner
70010000087597.intro: A competitive puzzle game in which players summon monsters to fight!
70010000087597.description:
Puzzle & Summoner is a competitive puzzle game.
Try to erase blocks by swapping blocks and aligning blocks of the same color.
When you erase a block, a monster is summoned and starts attacking.
The more you chain the monsters together, the higher their level and the more powerful their attacks will be.
Summon monsters with various abilities to win the battle.

70010000087602.name: EGGCONSOLE GUARDIC MSX
70010000087602.intro: A shooting game from COMPILE that requires mapping. Explore the maze and destroy the enemy mothership at the deepest level!
70010000087602.description:
This is a shooting game released in 1986 in Japan. Players control their ship, battling waves of enemies, with the goal of finding and destroying the enemy's mothership.

The game features a top-down view. Players maneuver their ship, defeating enemies to progress to the next stage. Along the way, strategic elements like route selection and power allocation make this game stand out from typical shooters. Power distribution is particularly important, as players need to carefully manage their resources ― such as speed and shot power ― to avoid running out of energy at crucial moments.

Though a shooter, mapping is required, giving this game a unique twist. It's highly recommended for players looking for a different type of shooting experience.


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000087605.name: Sudoku Classic2
70010000087605.intro:
Customizable Sudoku with the feel
of writing with a pen on paper
and the ease of playing a video game.
70010000087605.description:
It's a video game, but you can play it as if you were writing with a pen on paper.
You can customize the assist functions to your liking.


● Customize the assist functions and play with the settings you like.

Customize the assist functions to play with the settings you like.
We wanted to retain the feel of playing with pen and paper, but make it easier to play...!

・Automatically check for incorrect numbers
・Highlight squares with the same number as the selected number
・Highlight squares in the vertical and horizontal columns as the cursor
・Display an effect when the numbers are in order
・Change the design of the lettering
・Display or hide the timer

...and other assist functions you can turn on/off any way you like.


●The game can be played anytime, anywhere, even if it takes a long time.

●Touch controls are supported.
Touch controls make it easy to play casually.

●There are a total of 300 problems in EASY, NORMAL, and HARD difficulty levels.
There are 300 problems in three difficulty levels: EASY, NORMAL, and HARD.

70010000087611.name: Together We Live
70010000087611.intro: To atone for the sins of humanity, the girl continues to die
70010000087611.description:
This is a visual novel game without player selections.

Story:
"Awakening"
Kyoya awakens in a dimly lit room.
According to the girl who happened to pass by, the world has perished.
Reluctant to believe, Kyoya sets off with the girl to search for other living beings,
journeying through the ruined world together.

However, the girl had a purpose.

"The Girl's Purpose"
To atone for the sins of humanity,
she must continue to die.
Again and again, dozens of times, hundreds of times, thousands of times, tens of thousands of times.

She dies and then comes back to life.
As he watches her, who knows only suffering,
Kyoya starts to desire to teach her about happiness.

70010000087618.name: EGGCONSOLE Ys MSX2
70010000087618.intro: The landmark first game of an ongoing popular title. Master the 'half-character shift' and embark on an adventure in the land of Esteria!
70010000087618.description:
This is an action RPG released by Nihon Falcom in 1987 in Japan. Players take on the role of Adol Christin, a red-haired adventurer, as he embarks on a journey to seek the six Books of Ys.

At the time of its release, the PC gaming industry was saturated with challenging RPGs. However, Nihon Falcom took a different approach with this game, releasing it with the concept of "Now, it's the era to bring kindness in RPGs," aiming to create an RPG that everyone could enjoy.

The game features clever level-up settings that eliminate the hassle of grinding for experience points, the removal of unreasonable traps, and agile characters that move smoothly. With numerous thoughtful design choices, the game can be enjoyed comfortably, and it is not an exaggeration to say that it is filled with "kindness," as the tagline suggests.

The MSX2 version differs from the original in several ways, including modified graphics for shops and changes to boss attacks (such as the number of scythes wielded by Pictimos). Additionally, the BGM uses PSG sound, with some tracks replaced by PSG-exclusive compositions. By paying attention to these differences, you might discover new aspects of Ys that add to its charm.


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000087623.name: Mystery Lover 2: Forgotten Truth
70010000087623.intro: A love and suspense story set in a city by the Yangtze River, where players must uncover the truth behind Mystery and make choices between two girls.
70010000087623.description:
Features:
1.Exquisite character illustrations and CG artwork
2.Four different endings
3.Full voice acting for dialogues, with a total listening time of approximately 14 hours
4.The prototype of the story's setting is in China.
5.Overwhelmingly Positive reviews in China

Story:
Upon arriving in Riverville, Leed must find the truth within the chaos and deception, and he must also make a choice between two girls.
As autumn gives way to winter, what secrets lie beneath the thick layer of snow covering the city...?

70010000087627.name: Next of Kin: Fidelity
70010000087627.intro: Do you remember your worst nightmare?
70010000087627.description:
In Next of Kin: Fidelity, you follow Bjorn, a man haunted by a past that refuses to let go. A single event from his childhood still clings to him like a shadow.

Every night, he wakes up drenched in sweat, trapped in the same nightmare over and over again. But what is it that's haunting him – and how, or who, can set him free?

As a player, you’re encouraged to explore every corner of the world. The more you interact with your surroundings, the more pieces of the story you'll uncover.

Next of Kin: Fidelity is a deeply emotional journey lasting 2-4 hours, featuring pixel art, atmospheric music, and a strong focus on storytelling.

Key Features:

* A bittersweet story with a mix of comedy and mature subjects
* Features several endings depending on your choices
* Find clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth about Bjorn's past
* An original soundtrack that enhances the story beats
* Designed to be a short but sweet experience

70010000087629.name: Grand Gardens
70010000087629.intro: Welcome to the Great Gardens, the serene beauty of an ancient and sacred Japanese garden.
70010000087629.description:
Embark on a journey back in time, traversing this picturesque landscape, where each step reveals the secrets of a bygone era.

Stunning Japanese Garden Setting: 
Immerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of a meticulously crafted Japanese garden. Admire the intricate details of ancient architecture, tranquil ponds, and vibrant flora that paint a vivid picture of a long-forgotten era.

Day & Night Exploration: 
Experience the garden's transformation as you explore its wonders both under the radiant sunlight and beneath the soothing moonlight. The landscape comes alive with a different charm during the day and a mystical aura at night.

Crossing Bridges and Ravines: 
Challenge yourself to cross elegant bridges that span giant ravines, providing both breathtaking views and a sense of adventure. Each step brings you closer to discovering the hidden treasures within the garden.

Discover Old Statues and Shrines: 
Uncover the secrets of the past as you encounter ancient statues and sacred shrines scattered throughout the garden. Each structure tells a tale of a time long gone, waiting for an intrepid explorer to unveil its mysteries.

Find the Sacred Cherry Blossom Tree: 
Your ultimate quest awaits – locate the revered Sacred Cherry Blossom Tree. Its delicate petals whisper tales of ancient wisdom and untold beauty. Can you unlock the secrets it holds?
Embark on a meditative journey, where the only limits are your curiosity and the vastness of the Grand Gardens. Will you uncover the garden's ancient secrets and bask in its timeless beauty? Prepare for an exploration like no other, where each step is a discovery and every moment is a serene adventure.

Dive into the tranquility of Grand Gardens – your sanctuary of peace and exploration awaits.

70010000087631.name: 7'scarlet
70010000087631.description:
The remote town of Okunezato is shaped like a crescent moon and shrouded in dark myths and legends. 

Take on the role of a brave young woman journeying into the unknown to uncover dangerous truths and locate her missing brother with her childhood friend. 

They find the area rife with mystery and populated by intriguing characters, each harboring their own hidden motivations. 

Encounter heart-racing twists and turns as you dig deeper into the story.

70010000087633.name: Bright Side: Quiz
70010000087633.intro: Compete with family and friends to uncover the ultimate quiz champion!
70010000087633.description:
How well do you know your planet and the universe beyond? Let’s put your knowledge to the test! Embark on an exciting journey filled with captivating trivia, stunning visuals, and surprising discoveries!

Whether you're exploring Earth's wonders, unlocking secrets of the cosmos, or challenging friends and family, this game offers endless opportunities to learn and have fun. Are you ready to prove your skills and claim the title of ultimate quiz champion?

Challenge yourself with 4 unique modes:
• Watch & Learn - More of a visual learner? Put your memory to the test with questions about the video you just watched!
• Campaign - Explore the regions of our planet, complete exciting chapters, and earn well-deserved medals!
• Quick Play - Select the difficulty, take your time, and enjoy an awesome quiz on any topic you choose!
• Tournament - Want to showcase what you learned? Compete with your friends or family for the title of Quiz Master!
 
Features:
- Over 2000 questions to test your knowledge!
- Local multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
- 4 diverse gameplay modes!
- Quizpedia with all the information you need
- Engaging educational videos!
- Eye-catching visuals

Discover new facts about the world and the vast universe beyond!

70010000087636.name: Amber Isle
70010000087636.intro: Welcome... to Amber Isle! A shop management/social sim set in a quaint, friendly world of prehistoric animal islanders called Paleofolk!
70010000087636.description:
You’re tasked with running Amber Isle’s only shop. Gather, craft and sell items to meet the needs of your diverse Paleofolk customers. Does your brachiosaur buddy need a canvas as long as his neck? Maybe your microraptor amigo needs a mini-sized chair? Perhaps even some water-proof paper for a plesiosaur in peril? Different customers also have different needs, behaviours and preferences to learn. Haggle, pawn, and counter-offer your way to the top of the Shop Rankings! It’s up to you to run a successful shop to bring Amber Isle back from the brink of fossilisation! 

**Name and decorate your very own shop!**

Name, customise and run your shop your way! Use your profits to unlock new shop decor, walls, floors and more. As your shop gains popularity, plan your layout wisely, expand your floorspace and make your shop more efficient.

**Rebuild the island!**

You can also use your shop profits to help rebuild the island and unlock new areas. Decorate with paths, foliage, and amenities to make Amber Isle an attractive destination. Only then will our Paleofolk pals consider packing up and moving in permanently!

**Meet the Paleofolk!**

Paleofolk come in a wide variety of shapes, sizes and species-  it’s not just dinosaurs! There’s Ice Age mammals, Permian amphibians, marine life, invertebrates, and more! Amber Isle has 48 different Paleofolk to befriend, all with unique personalities, preferences, dialogue, and quests.  

Get closer to Paleofolk by hanging out with them and fulfilling their requests. As your friendship grows, Paleofolk will share new upgrades and recipes with you. With your help, they can even build their own stalls, cafes, gardens, and communal areas on Amber Isle!

**Create your own Paleofolk!**

Express your penchant for the prehistoric by designing your very own Paleofolk! Change your clothes, crests, colours, and more in our character customiser! Pick from 5 body pre-sets; Small Herbivore, Large Herbivore, Raptor, Large Theropod and Mammal. What type of Paleofolk will you be?

**The Story So Far…**

Amber Isle is down to its last remaining residents; the grumpy iguanodon Mayor Clawsworth, the peppy Pteranodon courier Maple, and the mega-keen Megalosaurus intern Adi. In a last-ditch attempt to revitalise Amber Isle, Mayor Clawsworth reluctantly agrees to let you open a shop. During your adventure, you’ll learn more about your new friends, the history of the island and how exactly it fell into disrepair…

**So, what are you waiting for!?**

Let's stock the shelves and dust the displays, because it's almost opening time for your brand new adventure on Amber Isle!

70010000087639.name: Spot The Difference Christmas
70010000087639.description:
Celebrate the holiday season with Spot The Difference: Christmas Edition, brought to you by the original creators of the globally beloved Spot The Difference amusement machine game! Experience the festive thrill of head-to-head competition in an exciting two-player mode where you'll race to find all the differences first.

Immerse yourself in a winter wonderland, where the classic gameplay you love is wrapped in a holiday twist. Whether you're competing with a friend or racing against the clock in single-player mode, this edition will test your observation skills as you search for hidden details in cheerful Christmas scenes. Can you spot them all before time runs out?

70010000087647.name: Block & Shot
70010000087647.intro: Dive into the fascinating world of logic puzzles, where you have to control various weapons.
70010000087647.description: Block & Shot is a puzzle game in which you have to control various weapons. In the game you will see more than 50 interesting levels and many different locations. Overcome obstacles and find ways to solve puzzles on your way to get to the main goal - the golden cartridge case.

70010000087652.name: Snaky Snakes
70010000087652.intro: Slither through challenges, grow longer, and unlock exciting worlds!
70010000087652.description: Snaky Snakes is an exhilarating game where player control a snake through randomly generated obstacles while collecting cherries. Each cherry increases the snake's length and score. Additionally, player can use cherries to purchase new environments such as Desert, Asia, and Ballroom from the in-game shop. The objective is to achieve the highest score possible and unlock all environments.

70010000087657.name: GEORGIE-YOLKIE
70010000087657.intro: Georgie-Yolkie is an all-new purrfect open-world platformer and collectathon! With huge, beautiful world and meet an unforgettable cast of silly characters.
70010000087657.description:
The lovable duo, Georgie and Yolkie star in this purrfect return to the collectathon platforming genre!

The Worlds of Felina have been overrun by King Rattie’s minions and have stolen all the valuable golden fishies. Now atop his giant keep, Georgie and Yolkie must work together with quirky characters along the way to unlock the vast worlds and bring peace back to the Kingdom.

With a giant open world and no less than ten other worlds full of bright colorful and weird characters, jump, swim, bounce and defy gravity as the worlds of Felina unravel around you, with a fun musical score and excellent replay value.

Key Features

Jump, run, spin, go upside down, glide, swim and more as you progress through the massive and detailed worlds and combat challenging quirky bosses and meet with silly characters in a humorous story, a love letter to classic platformers of the ninetees!

Ten worlds with different challenges and collect those shiny objects to progress through the worlds of Felina.

A purrfect catchy soundtrack and natural effects that bring the game to life and make it an unforgettable adventure

And a load more- play challenging mini-games and mix-it-up after beating the game!

70010000087661.name: Arcade Room Simulator
70010000087661.description:
Immerse yourself in a vibrant 3D pub filled with retro arcade machines. Relive the golden age of gaming with a variety of classic titles and interactive elements that evoke nostalgia.

TETRIS MACHINE
Challenge your spatial awareness and reflexes with the timeless puzzle game. Rotate and drop blocks to create and clear lines, aiming for the highest score possible. Tetris offers endless entertainment and a test of strategy as the speed increases with every level.

SNAKE MACHINE
Relive the classic fun of Snake! Navigate the screen to collect food and grow your snake longer and longer. Maneuver carefully to avoid crashing into yourself, and see how long you can survive. Simple yet addictive, Snake is a true retro delight.

INTERACTIVE ENVIRONMENT
Change the atmosphere with the jukebox, selecting your favorite tunes to enhance your gaming experience. Explore and interact with various elements around the pub for a fully immersive arcade adventure.

NOSTALGIC EXPERIENCE
Dive into a world where the charm of classic games meets modern 3D graphics. Whether you're revisiting childhood favorites or discovering them for the first time, Arcade Room Simulator offers a nostalgic escape for all ages.

CHALLENGE YOUR SKILLS AND ENJOY THE ULTIMATE ARCADE EXPERIENCE!

70010000087666.name: Glitch Hero
70010000087666.intro: Help Ada debug Codeland in this thrilling action puzzle adventure!
70010000087666.description:
Ada is a young yet bright girl who, after visiting her father’s laboratory, decides to 
dive without his permission into Codeland, a virtual world being developed by him, just for fun but...
A fatal error, Codeland filled with bugs, an unfriendly bunny as a guide, her father and his colleagues are trapped and unresponsive, there are enemies and errors all around! Only someone worthy to wield the hammer.exe can debug it all! 

Show your logical skills and quick mind to help Ada save Codeland by defeating enemies and clear dungeons in this fun and thrilling action adventure full of logical puzzles, loops, and fun visual algorithms suited for players of all ages.

FEATURES AND CONTENT

EXPLORE AND BEAT ENEMIES WITH THE HAMMER.EXE
• Run, dash, avoid traps and fly over cliffs to explore Codeland. 
• Use the hammer.exe to defeat enemies, activate switches and open new paths
• 5 upgradeable skills (Glitch Dash, Super Strength, Glitch Bolt, Cyberspin & Glitch Trap) 
• Different enemies, each with their own unique attack patterns! 
• Thrilling battles against warped bosses. Show off your skills and clean the errors on their programming!

SOLVE FUN CODING ALGORITHMS AND SAVE THE DAY
• Use blocks to design easy algorithms and learn about loops, functions and other coding concepts in an easy and fun way.
• Learn programming jargon thanks to amusing dialogues between charismatic characters.
• All coding puzzles are adapted to age so everyone can enjoy and learn!

A DIGITAL WORLD FULL OF DANGERS AND PUZZLES!
• Three worlds to explore: Order, Candy and Music worlds!
• A digital world with bright 2D cartoon art style and visuals
• +10 levels with careful design and mechanics inside each world. 
• Interact with the environment to collect bits, find more hearts and energy and improve Ada’s power!
• Know hilarious, charismatic and compelling characters in a story about friendship, courage and wits!

JOIN ADA AND SHOW YOUR SKILLS TO UNLOCK CODES AND DEFEAT ENEMIES!
Codeland is in your hands. Do you have what it takes to save it before it's too late? The fate of this digital world relies on you!

70010000087676.name: Popotinho's Adventures
70010000087676.intro: Guide a mischievous kid back to his parents in a vibrant side-scrolling adventure!
70010000087676.description:
Guide Popotinho safely back to his home as you run, hop and double-jump your way through side-scrolling platformer stages inspired by genre classics. Collect fruit to earn extra lives, grab hearts to replenish health and more as you traverse 50 tricky landscapes, from grasslands and forests to the dark of falling night. 

Use springboards to reach new heights and touch flagpoles to set checkpoints along the way. Avoid spike traps and hop on enemies’ heads to keep Popotinho safe. Can you reunite him with his parents and restore happiness to Popotinho’s holiday?

Features:

• Guide an adventurous young boy back to his family!
• Navigate 50 tricky levels in retro side-scrolling style.
• Avoid traps and roving enemies!
• Touch flagpoles to set checkpoints.
• Enjoy a lighthearted story with colorful visuals!

70010000087681.name: Cats Hidden in Spooky Places
70010000087681.intro: Cats Hidden in Spooky Places takes you on a spooky adventure! Explore 11 eerie scenes filled with witches, ghosts, and more. Find all 440 hidden cats and complete your collection!
70010000087681.description:
Cats Hidden in Spooky Places takes you on a thrilling mysterious adventure where cats have concealed themselves in eerie, haunted settings. With 11 panoramic masterpieces and 40 hidden cats to find in each one, you’ll encounter witches, vampires, ghosts, zombies, banshees, skeletons, and many more spooky creatures. Your task is simple: find all the cleverly hidden cats in these spooky environments.

From haunted houses to eerie graveyards, each scene is filled with Halloween-themed surprises. Sharpen your eyes, explore every corner, and uncover all the cats lurking in the shadows. Can you complete the collection before the night ends? Dive into this captivating challenge and test your skills in Cats Hidden in Spooky Places!

70010000087687.name: The Treasure of Neverland
70010000087687.intro: In this visual novel set in the magical world of Neverland, Peter Pan and the Lost Boys embark on a quest to discover a treasure hidden deep within the island.
70010000087687.description:
Guided by an ancient map and the light of a magical orb, the group ventures into unknown places, facing challenges and dangers that will test their courage and friendship.

Captain Hook, always seeking power, has discovered Peter's plans and will not rest until he obtains the treasure for himself. The pirates are more determined than ever, and the race between both sides to reach the heart of Neverland is full of surprises, traps and magic.

Can Peter Pan and his friends find the treasure?

Find out in "The Treasure of Neverland"

70010000087689.name: Real Hentai
70010000087689.intro: Charming girls in Real Hentai are waiting for your touch.
70010000087689.description:
Immerse yourself in a world of high-quality images, where charming girls are waiting for you, demonstrating their seductive forms in the most intriguing poses! The game is created with an emphasis on visual details, conveying the feeling of assembling a real puzzle. As the difficulty increases, the images become more and more piquant. Relax and enjoy every moment of assembling the puzzle.

Features:
• Beautiful girls in provocative outfits
• The ability to examine each image in detail after assembly
• Simple but exciting mechanics that are hard to tear yourself away from
• Gradually increasing puzzle difficulty
• Gentle, relaxing music for complete immersion

70010000087693.name: Draw li
70010000087693.intro: Draw, connect, and master the art of physics in 40 thrilling levels!
70010000087693.description:
Draw li

DRAW AND CONNECT!
Play in a 2D window where your mission is to connect a yellow ball with a purple ball. Draw lines that obey the laws of physics to bounce the ball or create a pathway.

CHALLENGING LEVELS!
Navigate through 40 unique levels, each presenting different obstacles and requiring new strategies to overcome. Every level offers a fresh and exciting challenge.

MASTER THE ART OF DRAWING!
Improve your drawing skills as you advance through the game. Precision and creativity are essential to successfully connect the balls and complete each level.

CAN YOU COMPLETE ALL THE LEVELS AND BECOME A DRAW LI MASTER?

70010000087699.name: JALECOlle Famicom Ver. Saiyuuki World
70010000087699.intro:
The project "JALECOlle Famicom Ver." continues to release Jaleco's Famicom titles one after another!
The 4th release is "Saiyuuki World"!
70010000087699.description:
★ Defeat the Ox Demon King and bring peace back to Chang'an!
An action RPG featuring a grand adventure that begins after the epilogue of Saiyuuki.
Now with in-game English translations!
Enjoy the entire "Saiyuuki World," originally released in Japan, fully in English.

【Game Story】
Son Wukong returns from Tianzhu, and peace has come to Chang'an.
However, the Demon Bull King, who was thought to have been defeated, reappears and steals the monk Sanzang and the sacred scriptures.
Under the command of Shakyamuni Buddha, Wukong rises once again. As you gather powerful weapons and items, defeat the yokai scattered across the land of Tang.
There are also puzzle-solving elements that require a bit of brainpower. Rely on the help of former companions and the hints you receive from the people you assist during your journey, as you head for the Demon Bull King's residence at Banana Leaf Cave.

 -Saiyuuki World ＜New Features＞ -
Visualize the hints you’ve gathered during your adventure, as well as the information you want to check in-game! Your adventure will become even more fulfilling and enjoyable.
★ World Information
Allows you to see which world you are currently in.
★ Gold
Check your funds anytime, whether on the road or at a shop.
★ Trade Items
Displays the items you currently hold for trading.
★ Boss Information
Shows the boss's name and health.
★ Weapon Status
The power of each weapon is visualized, The power of each weapon and armor is visualized, allowing you to check Goku's strength at any time.
★ Power-Up Items
The remaining uses or time for power-up items are visualized, allowing you to know how much longer you can use them.
★ Magic Items
The quantity, order, and the items you're holding are visualized. You can also see which magic will be used next when one runs out.
★ Life Timer
An internal timer is now visualized. When it reaches zero, *you will lose one Life Heart.
★ Life Extend
You can view your current score and the points needed to earn a "Life Heart" (up to 5 times).
★ Hint Archive
●Prophecy of the Disciple
You can always check the message from the disciple you helped.
● Informant
You can check the details of purchased amulets and talismans from the menu.

JALECOlle Common <New Features>
★Beginner-friendly rescue features
Now includes "Rewind" to quickly undo mistakes and "Quick Save & Load" to save and resume the game at any time.
★Convenient Subtitle Guide
You can see detailed effects of weapons and items when purchasing at the shop. Now, no more hesitation!?
◎ Additional helpful messages for your adventure are also available.
★Record your best time
Now includes a "Simple Timer" to record the time from the beginning of the adventure to the defeat of the final boss. 
You can aim for your best time while using Quick Save. Take on the challenge seriously without any rescue features. 
Record your best time!
★Packed with many more enjoyable features and options!
- Now includes new achievements to challenge various in-game objectives.
- Explore the gallery page to view package designs, manuals, flyers and more from the original releases.
- Screen edge options to reduce screen distortion.
- Screen Filter option.
- Wallpaper options.
- Upon completing the main game, you'll unlock a special bonus feature as a reward.

70010000087704.name: JALECOlle Famicom Ver. PIZZA POP!
70010000087704.intro: The project "JALECOlle Famicom Ver.," releasing consecutive Famicom titles from Jaleco, is here! The fifth release is " PIZZA POP!"
70010000087704.description:
★ With a pizza in hand, he dashes through the city once again! 
A pizza delivery action game filled with the love and energy of youth.

【Game Story】
The protagonist is Kid, a pizza shop employee. 
He must deliver pizzas within the set time in order to be able to give a lovely ring to his girlfriend. 
However, the road to love isn’t easy—his rival, Nick, keeps getting in the way at every turn. 
Despite Nick's interference, Kid strives to bring smiles to his customers and happiness to his girlfriend. 
The game offers seven stages filled with the flavors of pizza and energy of youth, plus two bonus stages where Kid catches pizza dough tossed by the manager.

 - PIZZA POP! ＜New Features＞ -
★ Includes a 2-in-1 with an extended version
You can play an expanded hitbox version created by "Omake Games," founded by Florent, a prominent figure in Japanese gaming known for his writing and editing expertise. 
This enhanced "Pizza Pop" version is even more enjoyable and user-friendly! Plus, it includes full English localization.
From the title screen, you can choose between the original and extended versions.

JALECOlle Common <New Features>
★Beginner-friendly rescue features
Now includes "Rewind" to quickly undo mistakes and "Quick Save & Load" to save and resume the game at any time.
★Convenient Subtitle Guide
Assist with bonus stage controls explanation.
★Record your best time
Now includes a "Simple Timer" to record the time from the beginning of the adventure to the defeat of the final boss. 
You can aim for your best time while using Quick Save. Take on the challenge seriously without any rescue features. 
Record your best time!
★Packed with many more enjoyable features and options!
- Now includes new achievements to challenge various in-game objectives.
- Explore the gallery page to view package designs, manuals, flyers and more from the original releases.
*This time, over 50 pages of development materials are included! Get to know the world of Pizza Pop in greater detail.
- Screen edge options to reduce screen distortion.
- Screen Filter option.
- Wallpaper options.
- Upon completing the main game, you'll unlock a special bonus feature as a reward.

70010000087709.name: JALECOlle Famicom Ver. Magic John & Totally RAD
70010000087709.intro: The project 'JALECOlle Famicom Ver.' is a series of consecutive releases of JALECO Famicom titles! The 6th release is 'Magic John & Totally RAD'!
70010000087709.description:
★A grand adventure where magic and action collide. Use the power of the great magician Zebediah to uncover the secrets of the underground world!

【Game Story】
Jake is just an ordinary boy who is in love with a very righteous girl, Allison.
Together, they meet the very unique old magician, Zebediah, who was exiled from the underground world.
Zebediah's magic isn't some fake trick. He can perform truly amazing magic.
He can transform into a lion or a fish, move huge rocks and more.
Jake and Allison are greatly impressed by his magic.
Zebediah feels a special connection with Jake and decides to teach him all his magic.
One day, Allison is kidnapped by a mysterious monster.
Jake transforms from an ordinary boy into a special boy with incredible skateboarding skills and he can now use Zebediah's magic.
Now is the time to show the results of his training!

★ The 2 in 1 version includes the original Magic John.
You can play the original Magic John in English.
Enjoy the different characters and nuances of the story compared to Totally RAD.

- Magic John & Totally RAD ＜New Features＞ -
1. Magic Shortcuts
Switch and select magic with the L button and R button!
You can use magic without opening the menu.
2.Magic Info
A list showing the effects of each magic is always available for quick reference.
3.Mid-boss Life Display
The remaining life of the mid-boss, which was not displayed before, will now be shown.

- JALECOlle Common <New Features> -
★Beginner-friendly rescue features
Now includes "Rewind" to quickly undo mistakes and "Quick Save & Load" to save and resume the game at any time.
★Convenient Subtitle Guide
Assisting with the English localization of Magic John.
★Record your best time
Now includes a "Simple Timer" to record the time from the beginning of the adventure to the defeat of the final boss. 
You can aim for your best time while using Quick Save. Take on the challenge seriously without any rescue features. 
Record your best time!
★Packed with many more enjoyable features and options!
- Now includes new achievements to challenge various in-game objectives.
- Explore the gallery page to view package designs, manuals, flyers and more from the original releases.
- Screen edge options to reduce screen distortion.
- Screen Filter option.
- Wallpaper options.
- Upon completing the main game, you'll unlock a special bonus feature as a reward.

70010000087714.name: Bambi: A Life in the Woods
70010000087714.intro: This visual novel follows Bambi, now an adult and respected leader in the forest, alongside his longtime friends and new children, Geno and Gurr.
70010000087714.description:
In this new story, the tranquility of the forest is threatened when the spring, which is the source of life for the entire environment, mysteriously begins to dry up. This endangers all the creatures that depend on its water.

Throughout the story, themes of leadership, the legacy of ancestors, and the importance of teamwork to overcome obstacles and maintain balance in nature are explored.

70010000087716.name: Cloudy Valley
70010000087716.intro: Prepare your bag for a peaceful adventure
70010000087716.description:
Go on a summer vacation to the Cloudy Valley archipelago!

Take your time to explore the archipelago, dive into the blue sea among the fish, find treasures, and climb to the heights to appreciate the landscapes. 

Key Features:

- Explore the archipelago without constraints: run, climb, swim to discover new islands

- Meet the inhabitants of Cloudy Valley and the life of the archipelago, pet the wild sheep and farm moles, and take part in token hunting contests

- Be the first to catch a rainbow trout, or catch some fish for the archipelago's inhabitants

- Participate in keeping the archipelago clean by picking up the garbage you find

- Collect a variety of hats and choose the one that suits you best!

- Go at your own pace and enjoy a cozy summer atmosphere. Expect a 2 to 4 hours adventure.

- Relax in a peaceful atmosphere by listening to the gentle melodies composed by Gregor Hadjiganev, whether by the water, in a forest, or atop a cliff…

Prepare your bag for a peaceful adventure in Cloudy Valley. Rest for a few hours in a calm and soothing atmosphere...

70010000087720.name: Extremely Powerful Capybaras
70010000087720.description:
Brave the chaos solo or with up to 3 of your friends in local and online multiplayer, forge your path through hordes of enemies, gather capy-powering weapons & skills and embrace your inner capybara in this action-packed bullet heaven frenzy!

Extremely Powerful Capybaras features multiple exciting stages, hilarious (and deadly) foes, and the action will keep you busy for a long time with epic difficulty challenges and modifiers to make each run a thrill!

- Unleash the capy-power with a diverse range of capybara heroes, including the mighty Warrior, melodious Bard and more!
- Just move, dodge and choose your power-ups carefully!
- Take on the challenge solo or team up with up to three friends locally or in online multiplayer!
- Each run is unique with randomized skills and passives, master the combos to become Extremely Powerful!
- Earn Capy-Coins from runs, spend them on ability upgrades that'll enhance the capy-chaos!
- It's not all frantic action, chill in the hot springs before runs and savor the calm before the storm!

70010000087725.name: Farming Harvester Simulator 2025 Deluxe Edition
70010000087725.intro: Harvest the Future: Master the Fields in Farming Harvester Simulator 2025 Deluxe Edition!
70010000087725.description: Experience the ultimate farming adventure in Farming Harvester Simulator 2025 Deluxe Edition! With stunning high-quality graphics, immerse yourself in the life of a professional combine harvester driver. Switch between multiple camera modes to get the perfect view as you navigate through challenging levels, park your harvester with precision, and expertly unload your crops. Test your skills and tackle each task in this realistic farming simulator. Are you ready to prove yourself on the fields? Get behind the wheel and find out!

70010000087752.name: Terminator 2D: NO FATE
70010000087752.intro: Experience the thrill of T2 with arcade action & pixel-perfect graphics!
70010000087752.description:
About The Game:

Experience the events of ‘Terminator 2: Judgment Day’ brought to life through glorious pixel artwork and action-packed arcade gameplay! Play as Sarah Connor and the T-800 through a variety of thrilling missions as they take on the T-1000 and try to put a stop to Skynet’s plans before the human race is annihilated. Lead the Resistance as John Connor in the future, fighting on the front lines as mankind’s only hope in the War Against the Machines. In this unique story blending iconic scenes from ‘Terminator 2: Judgment Day’ with original scenarios and multiple endings, humanity’s fate is yours to decide.

KEY FEATURES

Step into a classic arcade experience that pays homage to the Terminator universe with authentic arcade gameplay, music and visuals built from the ground up.

Relive iconic moments and forge new paths as Sarah, John and the T-800 in a narrative featuring a mix of classic Terminator 2: Judgment Day scenes and untold Terminator stories.

Shoot, sneak and escape the T-1000’s blades in a wide array of levels, and lead the Resistance as John Connor in critical Future War missions.

Battle against the full force of Cyberdyne and Skynet’s arsenal, with multiple enemy types and adrenaline-pumping boss fights to take on.

See the world of Terminator 2: Judgment Day like never before with detailed 2D sprite artwork of your favourite characters and scenes.

Enjoy a cinematic soundtrack featuring recrafted music from the legendary Terminator 2: Judgment Day score and all-new compositions.

Aim for the highest rank in each level to reign supreme on your high score table and achieve arcade immortality.

Mix things up with multiple different game modes to choose from: Story Mode, Arcade Mode, Infinite Mode, Boss Rush, Mother of the Future and Level Training!

70010000087758.name: EGGCONSOLE DINOSAUR PC-8801mkIISR
70010000087758.intro: A hardcore story-driven, command-based RPG. Become the Ash and embark on an adventure through the world of Dinosaur alongside your traveling companions.
70010000087758.description:
"Dinosaur" is a role-playing game released in 1990 in Japan, featuring a rare 3D perspective for Nihon Falcom. With its dark and serious storyline, unique world-building—including spell names like "I Witness the Death-Dancing Maiden"—the game captivates players with its distinct atmosphere. But its gameplay mechanics are just as noteworthy.

One of the defining features of this game is the use of "Techniques," which consume TP (Technical Points) to activate various special abilities. These abilities, including sword skills, magic, and songs, are learned through experience in their respective fields. The more they are used, the more they improve—making for a highly immersive and realistic progression system. Additionally, the game includes a "Technique Transmission" event, allowing party members to share skills with each other. How players refine these skills and incorporate them into their adventure is entirely up to their strategy.

Rather than relying on unfair tricks, the game offers carefully designed maps tailored to each scene, creating a serious and immersive RPG experience. For those who enjoy deep, well-structured RPGs, this is a highly recommended title.


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000087761.name: Perfect Klondike Solitaire
70010000087761.intro: Prepare to test your strategic solitaire abilities!
70010000087761.description:
Embark on daily quests and return for fresh challenges every day! 
Tailor your gaming experience with customizable themes and backgrounds. 
Create your perfect solitaire setup with various options and enjoy a personalized gaming experience. 
Perfect Klondike Solitaire guarantees endless hours of entertainment, making it ideal for quick breaks and extended gameplay sessions!

- Explore nine variations of Klondike Solitaire!
- Embark on a captivating adventure to restore a magnificent palace!
- Customize your experience with multiple card decks!

70010000087765.name: Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift
70010000087765.intro: Fire Up Your Engines, Because Garfield Is Waiting for You at the Starting Line!
70010000087765.description:
Ready to race against a real heavyweight? Garfield, Odie, Nermal, and the whole crew are at the starting line, raring to go!

Play as one of the eight cult characters from the Garfield universe, fill up your karts, customize your look, and race away at breakneck speeds. 
Take a wild ride through an unhinged universe, where there’s a surprise waiting around every turn. Pirate, western, or detective: Garfield speeds through brightly colored worlds to prove that, even in his dreams, he’s the king! 
Use shortcuts or bonus items to change the course of races and create unforgettable moments with friends through local and online multiplayer modes.

Mysteries, Treasures, and Rodeos!
Pit yourself against your friends on wacky circuits from three unique universes! Find your way through mysterious detective scenes, brave the pirate seas, or kick up dust along old cowboy trails.

Meet Garfield and His Gang
Play as Garfield, Odie, Jon, and many more iconic characters from the cartoon! Each driver has their own personality, making each race a unique and immersive experience.

Lasagna-esque Races with Friends!
Play against up to eight players online worldwide, or enjoy multiplayer mode for up to four players with split-screen mode! Perfect for frenzied competitions between friends or on family game nights.

Customizable Karts
Pimp your ride and create a kart that is perfectly aligned with your driving style! Choose your own bumpers, wheels, and spoilers, as well as style and color for a unique touch. Strut your stuff on the track and show them who really is the king of the circuit!

70010000087770.name: No Heroes Here 2
70010000087770.intro: A group of non-adventurers is the last hope in defending the castle in this chaotic co-op tower defense game with roguelike features.
70010000087770.description:
RALLY YOUR FRIENDS AND HOLD YOUR GROUND!!!

A group of non-adventurers is the last hope in defending the castle in this chaotic co-op tower defense game with roguelike features. With up to 4 players, your party must organize the castle, work as a team to craft ammo, and shoot at enemies to protect your kingdom!

PLAN, CRAFT AND DEFEND THE CASTLE!

Use the power of teamwork to prosper through 15 rounds against hordes of brute invaders by preparing the castle stations, reinforcing your defenses each day and choosing the best curveballs for each scenario.

NO HEROES? NO PROBLEM, SAVE THE DAY ANYWAY!

As you journey through this medieval realm, recruit more Non-Heroes to your ragtag band of castle defenders, including familiar faces like the Jester and the Princess, and non-heroic newcomers like the Alchemist and the Doctor. Just because you’re not a hero doesn’t mean that you can’t save the day!

THE KINGDOMS’ FATE IN YOUR HANDS!

Protect three different kingdoms with each their own mechanics, enemies, and quirks. Defend your typical medieval kingdom Noobland, the freezing lands of Trollmeria and the castles overrun by ever-growing mushrooms at Fungaria.

A MEDIEVAL ARSENAL AT YOUR DISPOSAL!

Play in 30 different castles, separated between easy, normal and hard difficulties. Select the kingdom and choose your weapon from cannons, slingshots and even a baby dragon ready to set hordes of enemies on fire!

70010000087775.name: Ball-it Hell
70010000087775.intro: dodge the enemy's bullets or strike them back. Use the enemy's attacks to destroy them!
70010000087775.description: Dodge! Strike back! This is a fast-paced barrage arcade game. Move the character to dodge bullets. Pick the right time to strike bullets back and destroy enemies to get gold coins. Unlock more characters and powerful skills. Keep challenging yourself to get higher scores and rankings.

70010000087781.name: Arcade Archives FANTASTIC NIGHT DREAMS COTTOn
70010000087781.intro:
Fans are satisfied with the orthodox shooter! 
Cute characters expand the fan base!
70010000087781.description:
" FANTASTIC NIGHT DREAMS COTTOn " is a shooter released by SUCCESS in 1991.
Control the main character, COTTON, and use shots, bombs, and magic to exterminate the beast hearts that rule the fairy world with fear.
This shooter boasts gameplay that can be enjoyed by both enthusiasts and beginners.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000087791.name: Pod Jam
70010000087791.intro: Assist alien pods to land safely, solve retro puzzles that come with unique mechanics in this ambient sci-fi adventure.
70010000087791.description:
Pod Jam is a retro-inspired puzzle game where you guide alien pods to safe landings through strategic planning. Each level presents unique challenges with arrows that interact differently with the environment, requiring careful sequencing to prevent pods from getting stuck.

Offering 100 increasingly challenging levels, Pod Jam offers a blend of challenge and satisfaction. The ambient sci-fi soundtrack and minimalist retro visuals create an immersive experience. Easy to learn but hard to master, the game is a perfect title for logic puzzle and brain-teaser lovers.

Key Features:

-100 challenging levels
-Unique game mechanics with strategic depth
-Immersive sci-fi ambient soundtrack
-Retro visuals with modern gameplay elements

Enjoy a nostalgic yet innovative puzzle experience in Pod Jam.

70010000087796.name: Toucan Adventure: Rio de Janeiro
70010000087796.intro: In a vibrant rainforest, Tito, a young toucan, feels different and apart from the rest of the animals.
70010000087796.description:
One day, Tito and his friends embark on an exciting adventure to save their home when an unexpected threat endangers the life of the jungle. Along the journey, Tito discovers new skills and forges stronger bonds with his companions: Lina, a fast and agile squirrel; Rico, a cunning raccoon; and Flora, a butterfly with impressive wings.

While facing great challenges, the group must learn to trust their differences, overcome their fears, and work together to protect the jungle. 

With determination, ingenuity, and the power of friendship, Tito and his friends discover that even the biggest differences can become a source of strength.

70010000087801.name: Say Cheese!
70010000087801.intro: Guide the mouse through tricky mazes and collect trophies on a cheesy adventure!
70010000087801.description:
Say Cheese! is a delightful puzzle adventure where strategic thinking meets fun challenges. Help our mischievous mouse reach the cheese while navigating tricky mazes and collecting trophies!

Welcome to the whimsical world of Say Cheese!
In a land filled with traps, blocks, and obstacles, only the sharpest minds will guide our hungry hero to the ultimate prize – a mouthwatering piece of cheese!
Join the adventure across 40 handcrafted levels, packed with surprises, trophies, and puzzles that will test your wits and patience. Can you help the mouse overcome each challenge?

Featuring:

- 40 handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty.
- A variety of obstacles to solve and overcome.
- Collectible trophies scattered throughout the mazes.
- Charming Pixel Art-style mechanics that are easy to learn but hard to master.

Hop, push, and think fast in this cheese-filled quest!

70010000087806.name: Check and Slash
70010000087806.intro: Are you ready to slash your way through chess-inspired challenges?
70010000087806.description:
Check and Slash is an action-packed roguelite where chess meets fast-paced combat. You play as the Black King, wielding a sword to fight your way through waves of White enemies in a single epic level, all while seeking to free your army from the enemy’s grasp.
Welcome to the world of Check and Slash!
In this chess-inspired battlefield, you’ll slash through White enemy pieces, using your strategic mind and swift combat skills. With every enemy you defeat, you move closer to reclaiming your throne. But beware—the challenge grows with each encounter, and only the strongest will survive. Can you conquer the board, defeat the final boss, and free the Black pieces?

•  1 handcrafted level with increasing difficulty.
•  A variety of obstacles to solve and overcome.
•  Chess pieces to rescue scattered throughout the mazes.
•  Charming chess-inspired mechanics that are easy to learn but hard to master.

70010000087814.name: Shanghai Mahjong Solitaire Premium II
70010000087814.intro: 1,100+ Levels of Strategic Zen and Global Challenge!
70010000087814.description:
Shanghai Mahjong Solitaire Premium II is a captivating, easy-to-learn puzzle game offering over 1,100 levels of brain-boosting challenges. Each puzzle takes 5-10 minutes, making it perfect for quick, enjoyable sessions. The game strikes the perfect balance between relaxation and strategy, combining the timeless charm of Mahjong with the strategic depth of chess, all set against peaceful landscapes. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced player, this game provides a mentally rejuvenating experience.

Features:
• Over 1,100 hand-crafted Premium and Daily boards for endless fun, including 9 Premium Packs and 12 months of daily challenges.
• Gameplay-enhancing options like Hints, Shuffle, and Zoom.
• Earn coins for each completed board.
• Collect stars as you clear boards.
• Global competition with online leaderboards—challenge friends and players worldwide.
• Exclusive touch controls for a seamless experience.
• Beautifully hand-crafted tiles and backgrounds.
• Relaxing lo-fi ambient background music for a calming atmosphere.

70010000087825.name: Bamboo Retro Run
70010000087825.intro: Run, jump, and slash your way through endless retro action!
70010000087825.description: Bamboo Retro Run is a captivating 2D pixel art game set in a bamboo forest. The player must run endlessly and face the approaching monsters, which they must eliminate by either jumping on them or slashing them. The game’s difficulty and speed increase as you progress, adding to the challenge. Embracing a retro style, player uses a vintage console interface where visible buttons mimic the gameplay controls. How far can you go? What's the highest score you can achieve?

70010000087836.name: EGGCONSOLE Xak II PC-8801mkIISR
70010000087836.intro: This game not only enhances the visual beauty but also improves the action elements. Embark on an adventure in the world of Xak as the brave warrior Latok!
70010000087836.description:
In 1990, Micro Cabin released the action RPG Xak II in Japan, set three years after the battle with Badu from the previous game. The story begins with Latok Kart, who lives with his mother, setting out on a journey to the town of Banuwa after hearing rumors of someone resembling his missing father.

This installment stands out for its emphasis on higher action gameplay compared to its predecessor. While the previous game's attack method relied on body slams, this time, players can swing swords, shoot force shots, and the introduction of jumping adds a sense of depth to the field.

Another noteworthy feature is the new "Karma" parameter. This parameter increases when you defeat monsters, and if it gets too high, it's considered excessive killing, and you won’t gain any experience points. However, there’s a way to reduce karma by visiting a church, so don’t forget to stop by after your adventures.

The "VR System," which was praised in the previous game for its beautiful, deep visuals, is still present. The multi-directional scrolling and visual effects, like clouds drifting across water surfaces, surpass the previous game's achievements. The game also includes features like displaying characters as semi-transparent when they’re hidden behind buildings and more refined parameter displays. Xak II is a meticulously crafted game, recommended for those who want to enjoy high-action gameplay and the well-developed world of Xak.


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000087841.name: PUNYAN
70010000087841.intro: Easy! Cute! But deep! A fun puzzle game with the cats of Nyanten Island, “PUNYAN”!
70010000087841.description:
PUNNYAN is a falling puzzle and merge game to enjoy together with cute cats living on the Nyanten Island!
