The game is easy to play with simple controls, but with the addition of original rules, a new puzzle experience awaits you, requiring a deep strategy!
The game features an online ranking system that allows you to compete with players from around the world, as well as offline competitions for up to four players!
You can enjoy the game in your favorite style, whether you want to master the game by yourself or have a lot of fun playing against other players!
Game Mode Descriptions
PUNYAN by yourself!
　This is a mode in which you can aim for a high score by yourself. Compete with players from all over the world in the online ranking!
■Single Play
　This is an offline-only mode where up to 4 players can enjoy cooperative or competitive play!
　Simple Battle
　　Send “Obstacle Bone” to your opponent by erasing “PUNYAN”! The winner is the one who doesn't spill any “PUNYAN” or “Obstacle Bone” until the end.
　Rotation Battle
　　The winner is the one who takes turns and does not spill any “PUNYAN” until the end of the game.
　Coop Play
　　Each player fires a “PUNYAN”! Players can cooperate with each other and aim for a high score.
　NonStop Battle
　　The winner is the one who does not spill any “PUNYAN” until the end of the game.
　Speed Battle
　　The first player to create the largest “PUNYAN” on the island, “TENOU”, the fastest wins.
PICTURE BOOK
　This is an illustrated book function that provides information on the 10 attractive PUNYAN characters that live on Nyanten Island.
We hope that the time you spend with the PUNYAN will be a new pleasure for you!

70010000087846.name: Public Transport Simulator 2
70010000087846.description: Get ready to hit the road in Public Transport Simulator 2! Take the driver's seat and experience the thrill of navigating through bustling city streets, challenging routes, and diverse buses. From picking up passengers at designated stops to mastering tricky maneuvers, this immersive simulation game offers a realistic and exciting journey into the world of bus transportation. Can you navigate through traffic, manage your schedule, and become the ultimate bus driver?

70010000087857.name: Survive Undead Rush
70010000087857.intro: Outrun, upgrade, and survive the relentless zombie onslaught!
70010000087857.description:
SURVIVE UNDEAD RUSH!

FIGHT OR FLIGHT!
Outrun and annihilate relentless waves of zombies that spawn continuously. Survive as the number and variety of zombies grow with each passing moment.

FACE THE BOSS!
After enduring waves of enemies, prepare yourself for the ultimate challenge—a powerful boss zombie. Defeat it to claim victory over the map.

LEVEL UP AND GEAR UP!
Collect XP from fallen zombies to upgrade your stats, boosting Health, Speed, Damage, and Rapid Fire. Gather money to unlock new characters with unique weapons like flamethrowers, submachine guns, and shotguns.

SURVIVE AND CONQUER!
Test your skills and strategy to survive the undead onslaught. Eliminate all zombies, including the formidable boss, to emerge victorious!

70010000087862.name: EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS
70010000087862.intro: Anyone can master the perfect shot!
70010000087862.description:
Everybody’s favorite golf game series finally returns to the fairway!

Hit the green with a variety of unique characters and courses in online and offline AND single and multiplayer modes!

• The Classic Gameplay You Love!
The controls are as simple and intuitive as ever. Just aim and press the button 3 times at the right moment to master the perfect shot!

• Play Solo or With Friends!
- Climb the ranks in Challenge Mode by completing rounds and facing off against colorful characters.
- Sharpen your skills and focus on beating your personal bests in Solo Rounds.
- Enjoy local Multiplayer Mode with up to 4 players on a single controller, or compete online against golfers worldwide.
- For even more excitement, try Wacky Golf - a unique twist on golf that everybody can enjoy together.

Grab your clubs and hit the green with EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS. Let's PAR-TEE!

70010000087866.name: Homecoming -KITAKU-
70010000087866.intro: Uncover the truth hidden in the darkness with your own hands.
70010000087866.description:
Homecoming -KITAKU-” is a first-person horror game in which players search their own home. Players explore an empty home, finding hidden items and texts as they unravel a complex mystery. The eerie past that lives in the house and the truth about the missing family members quietly await you. Your decisions will determine the outcome of the story and illuminate the hidden secrets.

The serene environment and tense storyline will challenge the boundaries between reality and fiction. It is up to you to overcome the challenges that await you in this eerie house and recover the lost truth. No amount of darkness can keep secrets from being revealed.

70010000087876.name: Penguin Helper
70010000087876.intro: Penguin Helper is your chance to go to the South Pole, become a hero for penguins and enjoy a peaceful atmosphere.
70010000087876.description:
Welcome to the South Pole, where you will have to lift penguins!

Penguin Helper is a fun 3D first-person game in which you become a real hero to these funny creatures.

Take a walk among the snowy open spaces and watch the southern lights. But be careful! Penguins lose coordination as soon as a plane flies over them. Your task is to put them on their feet.

Explore frosty landscapes, enjoy the beauty of vast expanses and skies, and enjoy the calm and tranquility of the South Pole.

Key Features:

- The breathtaking expanses of the South Pole
- Interaction with penguins
- Raising penguins as the main mechanic of the game
- Meditative atmosphere with pleasant sound
- Counter of raised penguins

Are you ready to become a real hero of the South Pole? Put on warm clothes, stock up on tea and start your Penguin Helper adventure!

70010000087881.name: Arcade Archives ESCAPE KIDS
70010000087881.description:
" ESCAPE KIDS " is a sports-action game released by KONAMI in 1987.
ESCAPE KIDS has only one rule: run faster than everyone else.
Use the “RUN” and “SUPER JUMP” buttons to win the future superhero race.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000087893.name: Mia and me – Magic Friends
70010000087893.description:
Take your unicorn for a ride through enchanting tracks. Discover the Rainbow Island, Crystal Cave, Heart Valley, Blackwood Forest, and many more magical locations. Help Mia, Yuko and Mo protect Centopia - take on exciting quests, search for magical items, and then, with the help of Phuddle, banish Gargona and the other villains! And then there's the cute little ponycorns you're sure to fall in love with too!

• Choose your favourite unicorn from the many on offer
• Collect unicorn dust and make Centopia bloom
• Use magic to strengthen the unicorns in the Birth Grotto and maintain their magical glow
• Preserve your memories in a great album

70010000087895.name: DreamWorks Gabby’s Dollhouse: Ready to Party
70010000087895.intro: Throw a party with Gabby and the Gabby Cats. Explore magical worlds – enjoy fun activities, minigames and rewards playing solo or with a friend.
70010000087895.description:
Inspired by DreamWorks Animation’s Gabby’s Dollhouse, fans can throw the greatest party ever with Gabby and Pandy Paws! 

Start in Crafting World with Mama and Baby Box, then join Kitty Fairy in the magical Fairy Tail Garden. Blast off to Caturn and groove with DJ Catnip. Whip up something tasty with Cakey in Sweet Treat Mountain, dive into Mermaid-lantis for treasure with MerCat, and race through the Playroom with Carlita.  

Enjoy challenges and minigames solo or with a friend in local co-op mode to find items for the party and cute outfits to customize Gabby.  

Learn, play, and create. Everyone’s invited!

GET TINY WITH GABBY & PANDY PAWS: Play solo or with friends in local co-op for pawsome fun. 

EXPLORE THE WAY YOU WANT: Start in the Craft Room, then hop in the catavator and go anywhere in the Dollhouse. 

PARTY WITH THE GABBY CATS: Pandy Paws, Cakey, DJ Catnip, and the rest of the kitten crew are invited.  

GO WHERE YOUR IMAGINATION TAKES YOU: Leap into fun activities and minigames. 

LEARN & GROW WITH GABBY: Get creative, try new hobbies and enjoy easy controls. 

CELEBRATE IN STYLE:  Personalize Gabby’s look with cat-tastic costume for every room.

70010000087897.name: Sociable Soccer 25
70010000087897.description:
Embrace the excitement of the world's favorite sport in Sociable Soccer 25.

With its vast array of features, extensive real-world player roster and intuitive gameplay, the game sets the stage for a footballing adventure like no other.

Created by legendary game designer Jon Hare, Sociable Soccer 25 features his signature fast-paced, arcade-style and intuitive gameplay, enriched with multiplayer head-to-head matches and collectible player cards.

Get your adrenaline pumping with the game's lightning-fast and intuitive gameplay. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a casual player, Sociable Soccer 25's user-friendly controls ensure that everyone can enjoy the excitement.

Experience the authenticity of the beautiful game as Sociable Soccer 25 features an extensive roster of more than 13,000 licensed professional footballers. Each player's unique skills and attributes are faithfully replicated, allowing you to assemble your dream team from real-world talent.

Immerse yourself in the current football landscape with up-to-date leagues and squad rosters.

Create your own football legacy by building a formidable squad and representing the club you love as you collect and upgrade licensed players from all over the world.

Join the passionate community of football fans, compete for glory, and celebrate the true spirit of the beautiful game in this remarkable gaming franchise.

70010000087902.name: Coloring Pixels: Collection 5
70010000087902.intro: A relaxing coloring-by-numbers game. Enjoy completing a variety of images with differing themes, complexity, and sizes.
70010000087902.description:
The objective is quite simple: each level contains numerous uncoloured pixels and it is your job to colour them in. Each pixel is numbered; this number corresponds with a colour in your palette. Select a colour from the palette and paint each of its corresponding pixels. Correctly colour all pixels in a level to finish it!

Coloring Pixels is a great way to wind down, you can just sit back and relax. With 180 levels, you can have hours of fun. This collection contains 8 themed books:

Autumn Book - Experience the cold but beautiful scenery that Autumn brings from the comfort of your home! Crunch leaves, watch the wildlife and keep yourself cosy and warm!

Tarot Book -  Unlock the secrets to your future with this book, each image is a stylised Tarot card! All images are the same size, 100-171px, in order to keep the feeling of a deck of cards. Get coloring to reveal your prophecy!

Monsters Book - Inspired by monsters in all shapes and sizes; expect mythical creatures, giant monsters, creatures from the bottom of the ocean, and creatures from space.

5 Halloween Books - The creepy, the kooky, the mysterious and the spooky. 5 whole books to celebrate the occult and macabre, the mythological and frightening.

70010000087930.name: Mahjong Cascade: Bamboo and Dragons／おちどり索子
70010000087930.intro: Mahjong Tile Battle! A Simple Yet Deep Falling Puzzle Game!
70010000087930.description:
Clear rows by forming sequences and triplets to rack up your score!
Earn even higher points if your tiles form a winning hand!
Clear rows in succession to trigger the "Renchan Bonus" and aim for a high score.

Score Ranking:
Compete with players worldwide and climb the leaderboard!

Two-Player Mode:
Split the screen and challenge your friends or family for exciting head-to-head matches!

Realistic Sounds:
Enjoy an immersive experience with authentic Mahjong tile and point stick sounds, recorded from real gameplay!

70010000087935.name: Supermarket Grocery Simulator
70010000087935.description:
Supermarket Simulator: Manage Your Own Market!
Are you ready to dive into the world of retail and manage your own supermarket? With Supermarket Simulator, you can create, expand, and lead your dream market to ultimate success! From stocking shelves with the best products to managing checkout lines, every decision is in your hands. Can you build the best supermarket in town?

Build and Expand:
Start with a small, humble market and transform it into a bustling supermarket empire. Buy new shelves, hire employees, and expand your floor space to accommodate more products and customers.

Customer Satisfaction:
Keep your customers happy by ensuring your shelves are always stocked, your prices are competitive, and your service is top-notch. Handle customer complaints, manage queues, and make sure everyone leaves with a smile.

Product Management:
Choose from a wide variety of products to keep your shelves full. From fresh produce to household items, ensure you have what your customers need. Monitor sales trends and adjust your inventory to maximize profits.

Upgrade and Customize:
Upgrade your equipment and customize your store to make it stand out. Invest in better checkout counters, faster restocking shelves, and even decorate your market with unique themes to attract more customers.

Daily Challenges and Rewards:
Complete daily challenges to earn rewards and improve your market. Special events and seasonal sales offer unique opportunities to boost your revenue and customer satisfaction.

Realistic Simulation:
Experience a realistic supermarket environment with detailed graphics and dynamic gameplay. Manage everything from employee schedules to special promotions and seasonal sales.

Strategic Decisions:
Make strategic decisions to optimize your market’s performance. Decide on pricing strategies, marketing campaigns, and even how to handle competitors.

Why You'll Love Supermarket Simulator:
Supermarket Simulator offers an engaging and immersive experience that allows you to build and manage your own supermarket. Whether you enjoy strategy games, management simulations, or simply love the idea of running a store, this game offers endless fun and challenges. With its realistic mechanics, detailed graphics, and a wide range of customization options, Supermarket Simulator is the ultimate retail management game.

70010000087939.name: Animal Kung Fu
70010000087939.intro: Lin, a young and clumsy red panda with big dreams of being a guardian, embarks on a dangerous mission to save his valley.
70010000087939.description:
In a peaceful valley surrounded by majestic mountains, the Golden Flame has been the source of protection and balance for generations. This mystical flame is guarded by the Valley Guardians, warriors who have dedicated themselves to preserving peace and harmony.

However, when a cunning and evil villain steals the Golden Flame, the entire valley is plunged into chaos and danger.

Can Lin and her friends recover the Golden Flame and save their home?

Find out in Animal Kung Fu!

70010000087944.name: Wings of Njord
70010000087944.intro: Soar through a medieval world of mystery and serenity as a raven on a journey to uncover hidden wonders.
70010000087944.description:
Take flight on a tranquil adventure in Wings of Njord, where you soar as a majestic raven in a beautifully crafted medieval world. Discover ancient landmarks, forgotten ruins, and hidden secrets scattered across breathtaking landscapes. Glide effortlessly through forests, mountains, and skies as you explore the wonders of a land inspired by Norse mythology.

With soothing music and stunning visuals, Wings of Njord offers a relaxing open-world experience perfect for casual players. Embark on a peaceful journey through time, guided only by the wind and your curiosity.

70010000087946.name: Jupiter & Mars: Definitive Edition
70010000087946.intro: Explore a breathtaking underwater world as dolphins Jupiter and Mars.
70010000087946.description:
Experience Jupiter & Mars like never before in the Definitive Edition, newly reimagined for Nintendo Switch™.

Take the plunge with Jupiter and Mars, two dolphins on the adventure of a lifetime through a vibrant underwater world. This new Definitive Edition introduces an all-new third-person perspective that brings both dolphins on screen together, putting their relationship at the heart of the adventure.

Swim through stunning ocean environments, encounter incredible marine life, and uncover hidden secrets beneath the waves. Use echolocation to reveal the world around you, interact with sea creatures, solve environmental puzzles, and journey alongside your dolphin companion as you venture deeper into the unknown.

The oceans need help, and Jupiter and Mars may be their only hope.

Enhanced and expanded for Nintendo Switch™, Jupiter & Mars: Definitive Edition is the ultimate way to experience their unforgettable ocean adventure.

70010000087949.name: Boxville 2
70010000087949.intro: Boxville 2 continues the adventure of cans living in a box city. Two friends were setting up fireworks for the city celebration, but a mistake caused chaos and one friend went missing. Now o
70010000087949.description:
Boxville 2, from Triomatica Games, is the next part of an adventure game about cans living in a box city.
Two can friends had an important job from the mayor to set up fireworks for the city's celebration. But due to a mistake, the fireworks went off wrong, causing chaos in the city. Worse, one of the friends went missing. Now, the main character, a red can, has to explore different areas and secret spots in Boxville and even travel outside the city to fix everything and find his friend.

What you can expect to see and hear in Boxville:
- Hand-drawn graphics — all backgrounds and characters are carefully drawn by our artists.
- Every animation and sound is created especially for each interaction.
- Unique music track was created for every scene to accomplish the atmosphere of the game.
- Tens of logical puzzles and mini-games are tightly incorporated into the story of the game.
- There are no words in the game — all characters communicate via cartoony sketches.

70010000087954.name: Bridges & Docks
70010000087954.intro:
Create the island of your dreams!
Paint the landscape by hand-placing tiles, trees, and more...or use the procedural generation tools!
70010000087954.description:
Create cozy islands while completing objectives to unlock new items & tools. Adjust the quantity of bridges, the maximum height of the terrain, and meticulously tweak configurations to create unique island worlds!

• Build your island
• Complete objectives
• Unlock new tools and items

Experience the feeling of painting the landscape, adjusting the island’s size and coastline with meticulous detail. Add trees, houses, bridges, rocks, animals, and much more!

The procedural toolset allows for detailed adjustments to be made for all facets of the island’s development. Adjust the quantity of bridges, the maximum height of the terrain, and even the proximity of trees to one another.

You’ll spend hours tweaking all the configurations to generate uniquely enthralling island worlds!

70010000087956.name: Battlefield Waltz
70010000087956.intro: Grief-stricken, Lan joins Nirvana, a prestigious military academy. Will she find love amidst the chaos of war?
70010000087956.description:
About the Game
A girl loses everything, all in one day. Her village, and even worse—her father...

In their place, she acquires a new power.
When she takes up a sword to protect herself and her loved ones, she discovers that it is "cursed" and holds immense power.

Having obtained something that could shake the very foundations of the nation, the girl has no choice but to live on the battlefield.

The ultra-nationalistic military academy, Nirvana, becomes her new home. There, young men and women who excel in combat gather to compete and sharpen their skills, regardless of their background.

She meets new people, forges strong bonds, and finds what she thought she'd lost: a place to belong.

This is the story of the girl and the talking cursed sword by her side.

Key Features
Love Blooms on the Battlefield on the Go! – Previously released in Japan in 2014, Western fans can finally experience this hidden otome gem and witness Lan's journey as the Maiden of the Cursed Sword on the Nintendo Switch™.

Explore New Frontiers and Nirvana! – With Map Exploration, players can freely explore two maps: the Royal Capital Frontier and the Nirvana School, where Lan can interact with characters. Learn information about characters only available during Map Exploration.

Chronicles of the Maiden of the Cursed Sword – Chronicle mode helps you keep track of your current route, note missing paths, backtrack to find all the endings, or just replay your favorite scenes! In Chronicle mode, you can select previously played scenes to start the game from any point you've played through in your current route!

Ancient Memories Shine like a Gem! – After meeting certain in-game conditions, you gain access to Ancient Memories, which displays a book encrusted with gems that light up with each good ending achieved. Unlock all the good endings to experience the ancient memories hidden in the magic sword!

70010000087957.name: Spy Drops
70010000087957.intro: 3D stealth action with modern effects, randomly generated missions, modern equipment, and local multiplayer!
70010000087957.description:
As a member of the counter terrorist Spy Drops team, you are tasked with neutralizing a threat that could plunge the world into digital darkness, while you unknowingly get tangled in a deeper conspiracy.

Dropped behind enemy lines, your covert ops are to infiltrate infrastructure and undertake secret ops. While onsite you also need to make use of the Dream Catcher to extract intel from the minds of soldiers to discover the location of the next targets.

Missions are randomly generated producing a tense gameplay experience as you never know what is around the next corner. Everyone's game will be different.

You'll explore enemy bases room-by-room, choosing how to tackle each one, navigating past enemies who can see your shadow and hear your footsteps. You can dodge, hack or shoot cameras, sneak past or knock out guards, scout the area with a drone, hide in lockers, or even wear sponge boots to move around quieter. 

You're free to choose which equipment to take on each mission, choosing from drones, hacking devices, explosives, night vision googles and many more. Varying times of day and weather conditions can be a hindrance or provide cover, so you'll need to equip accordingly. New equipment and weapons become available as the game progresses.

Take on a friend in local head-to-head multiplayer with Spy against Spy!

70010000087962.name: Final Formation
70010000087962.intro:
Equipped with the Fusion × Transformation “PELL” System
Free Map Side-Scrolling Shooter
70010000087962.description:
★ A New Evolution of Transformable Sci-Fi Action Shooting
Unified Calendar year 3005, the gene-mutated beasts from space—known as "Gene Beasts"—have evolved through a prolonged battle with humanity into highly advanced mechanical lifeforms called "Termination Bots".
To face this new threat, the Earth Allied Forces deploy the transformable and combinable combat mecha EX-PELL to the frontlines.
Join forces with the autonomous battle unit PELL, equipped with SUPER AI, and engage in fierce battles against the Termination Bots!

★ "Free Map" for Strategic Exploration Across Vast Battlefields
Each stage is a freely explorable horizontal map, allowing players to choose their route and tactics.
Encounter enemy ambushes, resupply and defend scattered bases, and take on a variety of missions.
Dash through diverse terrain—land, air, and sea—and complete your objectives with precision.

★ Adapt to the Battlefield with the “PELL Chain System”

1. EX Fighter Mode
The player's base form: a high-speed fighter aircraft. In addition to rapid-fire shots, it can unleash a powerful charged attack called "Big Bang".

2. Armed Unit “PELL”
Autonomous combat units stationed at various bases. Equipped with SUPER AI, they operate independently and can merge with the EX Fighter when approached.

3. Fusion Form with PELL
Merging EX Fighter with a PELL unit transforms it into a humanoid robot. The form and performance vary depending on the PELL unit used.
This form supports multi-directional shooting, angled Big Bang shots, and powerful "PELL Shots" unique to each unit (limited use per mission).

4. Tactical Flexibility via Separation and Recombination
Except in certain scenarios, you can freely separate from the fusion form and return to EX Fighter mode.
Withstand enemy barrages in fusion mode, and utilize high mobility in fighter mode.
Master the art of combining and separating on demand to dominate with hit-and-run tactics.

★ Feature-Rich Options to Enhance Gameplay

• Language Support
Supports both Japanese and English. Switching to English also changes in-game comic demos to English text.

• Volume Controls
Individually adjust the volume of BGM, sound effects, and overall master volume.

★ What Is Formation Z?
Originally released in arcades by Jaleco in 1984, Formation Z is a classic shooting game featuring a transformable mecha.
Advance across the ground in humanoid robot form and transform mid-jump into a fighter jet, delivering fast-paced, exhilarating action.
The game became a hit and was ported to numerous home consoles, becoming one of Jaleco’s most iconic titles.
This new title carries on the spirit of Formation Z as the second entry in the “Final Series”, reimagined with a fresh interpretation and worldview.
Co-developed by City Connection and Happy Meal, and featuring an intense comic story by manga artist U-Watari,
The thrill is reborn—now with evolved gameplay and visuals!

70010000087967.name: Summer Tri-Peaks Solitaire
70010000087967.intro: Amazing Tri-Peaks Solitaire fun for whole family!
70010000087967.description:
Experience the classic card game with new beautiful animations and solve the puzzles by moving the cards into the right piles. 
Anyone who knows the game from their computer will love this app and even if you have never played Solitaire before, the game is very easy to learn. 

Features:
- Fast and intuitive gameplay
- Beautiful animations and effects
- Easy to learn and to control
- Big cards for the best visibility
- Left-handed mode
- Free hint function
- Daily Challenge

If you are a fan of card and puzzle games you will enjoy this game.

70010000087971.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion
70010000087971.intro: A cosmic battle awaits in this Marvel frenetic action beat ‘em up!
70010000087971.description:
Tribute Games and Dotemu are teaming up again, in collaboration with Marvel Games, to craft an original, fresh beat 'em up. Featuring dynamic combat combos and dazzling pixel art, this planet-hopping adventure stands as a love letter to the Marvel Universe.


“THE COSMOS MUST FALL SO THAT I MIGHT LIVE!!”

So swears Annihilus, the living death that walks!
After an unprecedented attack is launched across the galaxy, all life hangs in the balance.
From New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone, the future of the Universe will be fought for across the stars in MARVEL Cosmic Invasion!


15 PLAYABLE SUPER HEROES

Spider-Man, Wolverine, She-Hulk, Captain America, Phoenix, Black Panther, Storm and Iron Man, some of the most powerful earth-born Marvel Super Heroes, are ready to face the threat.
But they won't be alone! Galactic Super Heroes Rocket Raccoon, Beta Ray Bill, Venom, Cosmic Ghost Rider, Nova, Phyla-Vell and the Silver Surfer enter the battle as well to complete the relentless line-up.
All will join forces in a star-spanning brawling adventure against the deadly Annihilation Wave.

Whether you’re an old-school expert or a first-time fan, you’ll find familiar faces and discover new favorites in a captivating roster of characters from across the Marvel Universe!


MASTER THE COSMIC SWAP TAG-TEAM SYSTEM

With the Cosmic Swap tag-team system, choose two Super Heroes for each level and switch between them instantly. Create unique combos and powerful special attacks. Each character’s abilities encourage creative team-ups and a more tactical approach to the action.


AMAZING RETRO ART DIRECTION

MARVEL Cosmic Invasion is a tribute to one of Marvel’s most iconic eras, with stunning full-color pixel art designs.


INTUITIVE, FUN MULTIPLAYER FOR EVERYONE

Whether you're teaming up with friends or family, MARVEL Cosmic Invasion has you covered with local/online play and a drop-in/drop-out adaptive system. 


A cosmic battle awaits!

70010000087983.name: The Genie of the Wonderful Lamp
70010000087983.intro: The story focuses on the further adventures of Aladdin, the young adventurer from Agrabah, after his first encounter with the magic lamp.
70010000087983.description:
The story begins when Aladdin discovers an ancient manuscript that takes him to a hidden kingdom in the stars.

Together with his inseparable friends, the genie and the cunning monkey Abu, Aladdin meets a group of guardian genies who protect the kingdom, but also discovers the presence of a sinister sorcerer who seeks to take advantage of the power of the lamps to unleash unimaginable evil.

70010000087989.name: Call of Sentinels
70010000087989.intro: An innovative blend of Bullet Hell and Survival elements, high dynamics, variable builds, arena competition with players from around the world.
70010000087989.description:
Prepare to enter a world of epic battles, diverse characters, and an endless flow of action in Call of Sentinels! This fast-paced bullet hell arena shooter will test your reflexes and strategic skills as you fight your way through hordes of enemies and powerful bosses. 

Game features:
- Diverse builds. Experiment with different builds to find the one that suits you best and become a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield.
- Powerful bosses. Prepare to face off against challenging bosses, each with their own unique mechanics and attacks.
- Epic characters and weapons. Unleash the power of a stunning arsenal of weapons and equip yourself with unique characters that bring their own flavor to the battlefield.
- Story mode.Embark on an epic journey through six beautifully crafted locations, each connected by a compelling story told through cutscenes and in-game dialogue.
- Trials of sentinels. During your battles, you'll encounter special challenging tasks that, once completed, will give you the opportunity to choose from a variety of additional upgrades!
- Hunders of skills. Master hundreds of skills and unlock powerful upgrades to craft your own unique build. Experiment with different combinations and build your character to dominate the battlefield!

70010000087996.name: Giant Rush
70010000087996.intro: Rush into a battle of giants!
70010000087996.description:
Run and collect stickmen of your color to grow bigger and more powerful! Outsmart traps, avoid danger, and smash everything in your path. The bigger you grow, the more unstoppable you become!

Face giant bosses in epic battles. Dodge their powerful attacks, strike back, and defeat them! Show your strength as you take down the biggest giants and prove you’re the best!

Unlock amazing rewards as you play. Upgrade your town to earn more money, customize your character with cool accessories, and unlock epic finishing animations!

Features:
- Collect stickmen of your color to grow larger and more powerful!
- Grow stronger and defeat huge giants in intense fights!
- Upgrade your town to earn passive income
- Fight through a series of enemies in survival mode and show your skills!
- Choose battle upgrades like extra health, a chance to dodge, critical hits, and more!
- Unlock awesome outfits and accessories to customize your character
- Buy new and epic finishing animations!

Your decisions will make the difference between victory and defeat!

70010000087998.name: Arcade Archives MARCHEN MAZE
70010000087998.description:
"MARCHEN MAZE" is an action game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1988.
Control the main character, Alice, and take back the Mirror Country, which has been conquered by the evil queen.
Use soap bubble attacks and jumps to advance through the area and defeat the boss waiting at the end.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*This game uses the Japanese ROM for the main part of the game.
*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000088008.name: Mine & Slash
70010000088008.intro: Enter the dungeon, defeat enemies and mine for gold!
70010000088008.description:
Embark on an epic RPG quest, as you dig and explore your way through a rougelite 3D world filled with magic and adventure. Take on mini-quests, fight off feverish enemies, and survive the rush of adrenaline as you smash through obstacles and obstacles.

Features:
- Explore multiple mines
- Upgrade your equipment to get more deadly and effective
- Fight and defeat imposing bosses
- Use a friendly, easy to use control scheme
- Discover new content and surprises in many upcoming updates

As a miner, you have the unique opportunity to collect gold and valuable resources as you dig deeper and deeper into the dungeon. But be warned, the deeper you go, the harder the challenges become, and the more powerful the enemies you will face.

Thankfully, you are not alone on this adventure. You have the help of your trusty hero, equipped with the latest technology and magic spells to aid you in your journey. Together, you will face the unknown, discover hidden treasures, and emerge victorious.

Visit a museum to marvel at the epic artifacts you’ve collected during your magical adventure. Customize your hero with powerful loot & equipment that will aid you in future quests. Unlock powerful skills to become even stronger!

So what are you waiting for? Join the adventure and start your quest today!

70010000088010.name: Bookshop Wonderland: Supermarket Simulator
70010000088010.intro: Bookshop Wonderland: Supermarket Simulator – Where Every Aisle Tells a Story!
70010000088010.description:
Bookshop Wonderland: Supermarket Simulator invites you to manage a magical supermarket where books and groceries combine in a whimsical world of retail adventure. As the new shop owner, you'll stock shelves, manage inventory, and cater to a variety of quirky customers, from book lovers to grocery shoppers. Grow your store, unlock unique sections, and discover rare book-themed items that bring the wonderland to life.

Key Features:

Unique Gameplay: A charming mix of supermarket management and bookshop magic.
Upgrade & Expand: Unlock new aisles and upgrade your store to offer more products and attract diverse customers.
Customer Requests: Fulfill quirky demands, from bestselling novels to rare food items.
Bookish Items: Discover rare book-themed products to enhance your store’s charm and appeal.
Strategic Planning: Manage your inventory, plan sales, and optimize your store layout for success.
Cozy Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a vibrant world where every aisle tells a story.

Create the ultimate shopping experience in Bookshop Wonderland!

70010000088016.name: Farm
70010000088016.description: Chaos has taken over the pasture! Take on this addictive challenge where you need to help the farm animals find their pairs and escape the pen. Move cows, piglets, sheep, and more, organising them to free up space and ensure everyone gets out happy. But keep an eye on the unpaired animals, if any of them can’t find their way home, it’s game over! With puzzles growing more challenging, you’ll need strategy and agility to keep the farm in order. Can you solve these puzzles before chaos takes over?

70010000088019.name: Kakureza Library
70010000088019.intro: Become a Librarian in a Visual Novel Set in a Single Scene.
70010000088019.description:
You Are an Apprentice Librarian:
Step into the shoes of a new library staff member and work entirely at the front desk. Lend out materials, assist patrons with their inquiries, and more. Complete your one-month probation period to finish the game.

260 Fictional Books:
Each book includes a cover, title, author, publisher, and summary. Enjoy the collection as a fictional book gallery.

Your Daily Tasks Matter:
Each book you lend becomes a turning point in someone’s story. Who returns, what they borrow next, and how their lives unfold — it all depends on your choices behind the desk.

Multiple Endings:
The game features several bad endings, plus one normal ending and one true ending.

Endless Mode:
A bonus mode where patrons arrive one by one with reference requests.*
Search quickly and accurately to find what they need. Try to beat your personal best.

*In this app, "reference requests" refer to using the search system to locate materials requested by patrons.

Important: This game is available in English and Japanese only. The interface, dialogue, and subtitles are not offered in French or Spanish.

70010000088024.name: No Sleep For Kaname Date - From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES
70010000088024.intro: Open Your Third Eye To Seek A Way Out!
70010000088024.description:
Iris the internet idol has been abducted by aliens?!
Finding herself on board a mysterious UFO and tasked with completing a bizarre escape game, Iris knows there's one person who she can always count on for help: Kaname Date, Psyncer! 
As Date, conduct investigations, solve escape game puzzles, and Psync into the dreams of potential suspects to help Iris escape and unravel the mystery behind The Third Eye Game!

・ Investigation: Use the special functions in Date's left eye to gather information that will lead to Iris's whereabouts! Familiar and new characters will also appear!
・Somnium: Explore the eccentric dream world of potential suspects to uncover clues and secret memories!
・ Escape: Solve thrilling mysteries while exploring a locked environment. When you find the true answer beyond the surface level of logic, the door to escape will open!

70010000088026.name: Brothers in Hell
70010000088026.intro: After you die, Death gives you the chance to come back to the world of the living to fulfill your deepest desire. Take the chance and claim your revenge
70010000088026.description:
Fulfill Your Wish
You’ve been brought back with a single purpose: revenge. Attack the villages ravaged by the sinister and enslaving “Apocalypse Bringers”, who have plunged the world into chaos, and liberate them from their tyranny.

Stealthy Action and Multiple Tools
Use your bow and arrow to eliminate enemies from a distance. You can distract foes with an arrow and attack them from behind, or wait and confront them head-on with lethal axe strikes.

Confront the “Apocalypse Bringers”
Liberate villages from their control and face their bosses. Each boss has unique mechanics that will alter your gameplay. Who knows? Maybe you can even save some of them.

Immersive Open World
Explore the desert’s stories, complete missions for upgrades, and uncover the darkest secrets, shrouded in blood and sand.

70010000088032.name: Duckweed
70010000088032.description:
Be a little rubber duck and eat the duckweed in this fun collecting game!

Collect duckweed and unlock achievements to unlock more ducks! 50 ducks to collect!

Listen to a relaxing soundtrack.

70010000088037.name: Arcade Archives VS. FAMILY TENNIS
70010000088037.intro:
Use a variety of shots to confuse your opponent 
and seize victory!
70010000088037.description:
" VS. FAMILY TENNIS " is a sports game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1987.
Choose yourself and your opponent from 16 unique characters and start the match.
Toy with your opponent by hitting shots of different speeds and heights.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*This game uses the Japanese ROM for the main part of the game.
*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000088059.name: The Escape Room Chronicles ep3:The Southern Resort
70010000088059.intro:
Discover items and use your wits to solve puzzles in this mystery!
Episode 3: Escape from The Southern Resort!
70010000088059.description:
For some mysterious reason, the protagonist finds himself in sealed rooms wherever he goes.
Seemingly simple at first, solving the puzzles delivers an unmatched sense of satisfaction.

    Episode 3
This adventure takes place in everyone's dream destination—a tropical island resort!
The protagonist arrives for a getaway with their uncle, ready to soak up the sun. But on the way to the hotel shuttle, something goes wrong and he finds himself locked in his room, unable to leave!
Far from home in a secluded corner of paradise, this escape drama is about to unfold.

Featuring fully refined graphics, immersive interactive elements, and various play modes with multiple endings, this game promises a unique experience for every player. With memo and camera functions at your fingertips, it’s designed to be easy for beginners and exciting for veterans alike. Dive into the world of simple yet addictive puzzle-solving with this thrilling escape game!

70010000088064.name: The Escape Room Chronicles ep4:The 24-Hour TV Station
70010000088064.intro:
Discover items and use your wits to solve puzzles in this mystery!
Episode 4: Escape from the TV station!
70010000088064.description:
For some mysterious reason, the protagonist finds himself in sealed rooms wherever he goes.
Seemingly simple at first, solving the puzzles delivers an unmatched sense of satisfaction.

    Episode 4
The stage is set in an actual TV studio!
The protagonist is working as an assistant on a variety show featuring a famous host. After filming wraps up and the cast heads to the green room, our protagonist finishes packing up only to find that the studio doors won’t open!
An unexpected escape adventure begins from a world of lights, cameras, and live audiences.

Featuring fully refined graphics, immersive interactive elements, and various play modes with multiple endings, this game promises a unique experience for every player. With memo and camera functions at your fingertips, it’s designed to be easy for beginners and exciting for veterans alike. Dive into the world of simple yet addictive puzzle-solving with this thrilling escape game!

70010000088071.name: How to meditate: A beginner's guide
70010000088071.intro: Immerse yourself in a world of calm and well-being! Learn to meditate interactively while you relax and reduce stress - start today!
70010000088071.description:
Discover an innovative way to relax and improve your well-being with this interactive game designed to guide you in the art of meditation in an easy and accessible manner. Ideal for both beginners and those looking to deepen their practice, it will help you reduce stress and find personal balance through simple and effective techniques.

Key features:

-Step-by-step guide: learn to meditate from scratch with clear and easy-to-follow instructions.
-Relaxing environments: immerse yourself in tranquil and immersive virtual landscapes, designed to help you disconnect from daily stress.
-Variety of meditation techniques: explore different breathing exercises, visualization, and relaxation methods tailored to your needs.
-Reduce stress and enhance your well-being: each session is aimed at calming your mind, relaxing your body, and increasing your overall sense of well-being.

This game offers a unique opportunity to relax, unwind, and recharge your energy while learning to meditate. It will help you find mental and physical balance, giving you a space to recharge and improve your quality of life.

Start meditating today!

70010000088074.name: How to speed read: Techniques for rapid learning
70010000088074.intro: Learn advanced techniques to increase your reading speed, improve comprehension and accelerate your learning process effectively.
70010000088074.description:
Can you imagine being able to read faster and retain information better? With this game you can make it happen! Here you will not only improve your reading speed, but also learn key techniques to acquire knowledge more efficiently.

With a series of fun and challenging exercises, you'll train your brain to process words faster than you ever imagined. From dynamic reading tests to strategies for improving comprehension, each level takes you one step closer to mastering speed reading. And the best part is that you can progress at your own pace, without pressure.

The atmosphere is fun and motivating, making learning feel more like an exciting challenge than a chore. As you overcome the challenges, you'll notice your speed and retention of information improve rapidly.

Turn reading into an agile and powerful skill - are you ready to take your learning to the next level? Start today and be amazed at what you can achieve!

70010000088078.name: Mourning Tide
70010000088078.description: A guilt-ridden fisherman ventures into unknown waters. Each catch reveals haunting reminders of his past sins. Unravel the mystery and seek redemption, or be consumed by the mourning tide...

70010000088083.name: Don't let him in
70010000088083.intro: Some roads are better left untraveled.
70010000088083.description:
In this psychological horror experience you'll join three friends who are excited to see their favourite band, only to encounter a hitchhiker on a desolate highway. As the miles pass by, the hitchhiker's unsettling presence becomes sinister, and their true identity is shrouded in darkness.
Will you be able to make it to the end of the road and survive?

The soundtrack compliments and that heightens the suspense during the unsettling gameplay sections, this game is sure to keep you on the edge of your seat. So turn off the lights, put on your headphones, and prepare for a truly memorable horror adventure.

Whether you're a supporter of indie horror developers or enjoy streaming spine-chilling games online, DON'T LET HIM IN is a perfect addition to your collection. Don't miss out on this immersive horror experience that will keep you guessing until the very end.

Please be aware that Don't Let Him In explores themes of horror, suspense, and psychological terror. The game features graphic imagery, violent scenes, and unsettling content that may be disturbing or distressing to some players.


-Get ready for a heart-pounding third person horror experience, best played at night.
-Choose from four vintage retro styles to customize the game's atmosphere
-Encounter survival horror elements, jump scares, and psychological twists
-Perfect for fans of retro indie horror and those seeking a haunting and immersive gaming experience.

70010000088085.name: Bear Simulator - Ragnarok's Rise Survival
70010000088085.intro: Become the bear hero in Bear Simulator: Ragnarok’s Rise – prepare for mythic chaos!
70010000088085.description:
Immerse yourself in the mythical world of Bear Simulator: Ragnarok’s Rise, a thrilling bear simulation within the Norse mythology realm. With Ragnarok on the horizon, take on the role of a powerful bear ready for the impending chaos.

Key Features:
- Bear Simulation in Norse Setting: Experience life as a bear in a captivating Norse world, where even bears prepare for Ragnarok.

-Yggdrasil Worlds: Explore five unique locations, from Midgard to the mystical realms of Svartalfheim, Alfheim, Jotunheim, and Jarnvid. Each offers unique challenges and rewards for your bear’s growth.

- Hunt, Gather, Upgrade: Engage in thrilling hunts, collect gold and statues to unlock powerful armor upgrades, boosting your bear's strength and survival.

- Totems: Uncover totem fragments across realms. Complete them to enhance your bear's stats and unlock its full potential.

- Quest System: Undertake exciting quests, earning rewards as your bear overcomes challenges and triumphs leading up to Ragnarok.

- Discover Chests: Locate hidden chests filled with valuable resources and random armor pieces, unlocking new strategies for your bear's journey.

- Armor Pieces: Gather armor from Subscriptions, Chests, or purchase them with in-game currency to make your bear stronger and ready for the toughest battles.

Bear Simulator: Ragnarok’s Rise offers a unique blend of simulation, strategy, and multiplayer action, creating a memorable adventure as your bear faces the rise of Ragnarok. Ready to roar into battle and confront the apocalypse?

70010000088098.name: Mythwrecked: Ambrosia Island
70010000088098.intro: THE GODS ARE REAL, THEY’VE JUST BEEN ON VACATION
70010000088098.description:
You’re Alex, a rookie backpacker taking a much needed break from modern life. Your trip is interrupted when you are suddenly shipwrecked on Ambrosia Island; a beautiful long-forgotten place of myth and sunshine. It’s home to the gods of Greek mythology. They’re real after all, even if they are having an identity crisis. 

Can you discover the secrets of Ambrosia Island in this sun-drenched 'Friend Em Up' adventure.

70010000088105.name: Blackout: The Darkest Night
70010000088105.intro: You have been part of something terrible, something so unspeakable that caused you to blackout and forget all the events from the past few days.
70010000088105.description:
In Blackout, you are faced with the choice of going after the truth, facing the shadows that hide within our world, or trying to forget and leave all this behind.

Blackout is a non-linear interactive fiction game set in a dark modern universe, nfluenced by White Wolf’s World of Darkness, H.P. Lovecraft and weird shows like Twin Peaks. Walk the main character through his journey on trying to recollect his memories by making choices. Will you dig deeper into his past and unveil this whole new world hiding beneath the shadows? Or will you leave it all behind?

The path you take inside each chapter varies greatly, and the effect of your choices could ripple across all chapters, leading to completely different experiences on each new playthrough. Which of the endings will you reach?

70010000088112.name: Griffin
70010000088112.description:
The Griffin, battle tank has been developed as countermeasure against powerful neighbor countries. However, its designer was captured by the enemy country…
		
Now, his granddaughter got into the Griffin and take on her solo mission to rescue her grandfather!


Features:
* Rewind/Fast-forward: The player can use the rewind or fast-forward functions to complete the mission perfectly. 
* Saving Option: The player can save its progress anytime/anywhere and restart the game.
* Optional Screen Filter: Retro, Black-White, and more filtering functions.
* Art Gallery: Manuals and package design for the original version are available.
* Cheat Mode: Make the gameplay easier with cheat mode (infinity life, invincible etc.)
* Jukebox: You can play the in-game music (5 tracks) at any time.

70010000088114.name: Pokettohiro
70010000088114.intro: The biggest adventures come in small packages!
70010000088114.description:
A group of brave heroes must gather the fragments of the Magic Crystal to face the evil Black Knight and thus prevent the destruction of the kingdom.

Be prepared to discover a huge open world to explore, with secrets and surprises in every corner. Embark on hidden dungeons, forge bonds with villagers and help them solve their problems, discover useful items to progress in your adventure, release imprisoned heroes, and unite them to your cause.
Will these little heroes be able to restore peace to the kingdom?


Features:
Six distinct playable characters, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles.
A vast and diverse world, teeming with challenges and secrets to uncover.
Hidden dungeons featuring epic boss battles that will test your skills.
Engaging side quests to assist the villagers and deepen your adventure.
A multitude of collectibles hidden throughout the map, rewarding keen explorers.

70010000088119.name: Kaimyou Maker
70010000088119.intro: This is a tool that automatically generates, manages, and edits Kaimyou. It can also issue Kaimyou certificates and save them in an album, and it can be used as an Ihai.
70010000088119.description:
Kaimyou is ...

Kaimyou is a posthumous name given to a deceased person in Buddhist tradition, particularly in Japan. It is used during memorial services and placed on the Ihai (memorial tablet) in honor of the deceased. The Kaimyou represents the individual’s spiritual journey and is usually bestowed by a Buddhist priest. The name often reflects the person’s virtues or spiritual aspirations, and its creation follows specific religious customs. The use of Kaimyou is common in rituals surrounding death, mourning, and the afterlife, and it plays a significant role in the commemoration of ancestors.

This software automatically generates Kaimyou (posthumous Buddhist names).
*Please note that while the term 'Kaimyou' is used as a general reference, in the software, the name may be referred to as 'Houmyou,' 'Hougou,' 'Myougou,' 'Okurina,' or other terms depending on the Buddhist sect.

This comprehensive Kaimyou editing tool is suitable not only for those who wish to receive a Kaimyou for themselves or their family members, but also for use by Buddhist priests. Additionally, since Japanese religions are tolerant, the software can be used by individuals from other religions without any issue. Even if you simply want a cool Kanji alias, you are welcome to use it.



Main Features

■ Automatic Kaimyou Generation
By simply answering questions and inputting the following profile information—name, gender, age, sect, level of faith, occupation, hobbies, skills, and motto—the Kaimyou will be automatically generated.

■ Flexible Editing
You can freely modify the automatically generated Kaimyou. Changes can be made at the Kanji level while checking their meanings, allowing you to receive a Kaimyou that meets your preferences.

■ Kaimyou Certificate Issuance
Once you have your favorite Kaimyou, you can issue a certificate. The certificate can be saved in an album, enabling you to transfer it to other devices or print it for use.

■ As an Ihai
By switching your Nintendo Switch™ to tabletop mode, it can be used as an Ihai. The Ihai is a memorial tablet that represents the deceased.

■ Temple Member Management
The software includes a temple member management feature, allowing you to manage multiple individuals’ names, ages, sects, and more. This makes it highly recommended for clergy who need to manage Kaimyou for multiple people.

■ Supported Sects
・Jōdo-shū / SeizanJōdo-shū / JōdoShin-shū / ShinshūTakada-Ha
・Nichiren-shū / NichirenSei-shū
・Sōtō-shū / Rinzai-shū / Ōbaku-shū
・Shingon-shū / Tendai-shū / YūzūNembutsu-shū
・Ji-shū
・Ritsu-shū
・Shinto
・No religion / Unknown

70010000088134.name: ONE BTN BOSSES
70010000088134.intro: It's One Button Bosses, it's all in the name. You have one button. There are big bosses to beat. Push, tap, and bash in the handcrafted campaign or in the roguelike rifts.
70010000088134.description:
ONE BUTTON BOSSES
Push. Tap. Bash:A 4 hour campaign, a concise roguelike game mode and just one button.
Heart-pumping Strategy: It’s harder than it looks; pilots better be ready for a fight! Unlock upgrades and customize your ship to win.
The Grind: Brag to your friends, laugh at enemies, and compete for the best times on the leaderboard.
Get in The Zone: A legendary synth-wave soundtrack accompanies pilots' many, many losses.
Rise up and Resist: Follow the story of Ace, an unpaid assistant, as they resist the big bosses for a fair paycheck.
Play Your Way: Each of the bosses needs to be beaten in a best of 3, 5, 7 … meaning you will never be hard stuck on a boss fight as there is always a different level to try.

THE SHIP
You pilot a ship that orbits the BOSS automatically. PRESS the button to change the ship’s direction. But the less you change directions, the faster the ship goes. The faster you go, the faster you shoot. The faster you shoot, the faster you WIN! Make sure to WIN before the BOSS gets too angry and wipes you out!

CUSTOMIZE ATTACKS
There's depth to the simple controls! You can customize the ship, mixing ATTACK and MOVEMENT upgrades to find the best builds to beat bosses. DASH instead of changing directions, fire a LASER instead of bullets. There’s over 100 different combinations you can try out to suit your playstyle!

A MEAN STORY
ACE THE ASSISTANT will loop you into the 50 handcrafted levels of bullet hell action. The bosses will taunt you as you lose, but if you persist you will rise up the ranks, progress the story, earn GRIND POINTS and unlock new ways to play! Are you ready?

ROGUELITE R&D (RIFTS & DEVELOPMENTS)
Fly your ship into the R&D (RIFTS & DISCOVERIES) department. Where you will face insanely challenging RANDOMLY GENERATED BOSSES and earn new upgrades and power-ups after every fight.

70010000088140.name: W.A.N.D. Project
70010000088140.intro: Fast-paced, roguelike bullet hell with deep, unique spellcrafting.
70010000088140.description:
Concoct game-shattering, spells as a magic-wielding Japanese sorceress. Dodge and decimate waves of alien monstrosities as you defend a futuristic Tokyo.

BE A SPELLCRAFTING ALCHEMIST
Prefer firing off quick, constant streams of sonic barrage arrows? Or would you rather create a slower, more powerful fireball that spreads into lightning strikes? With over 100 different magical elements to combine, the combos and choices are nearly infinite.
Experiment, learn, and adapt with each run. Unlock new wands and sorceresses along the way to tackle each changing map.

FEATURES
-A unique spell-crafting system to create near-unlimited spell combinations
-Multiple magical elements and variants to craft spells from, making no two runs feel the same
-Unlock and play as various new sorceresses, each with their own unique stats and abilities
-Discover and equip powerful new wands, each with their own special powers and enhancements
-Choose between auto-fire or manual aim and fire modes
-Every map changes the gameplay with a different look, enemy types, and objectives
-Super fast and addictive runs

70010000088145.name: Internet Cafe Simulator 2025
70010000088145.intro: Build a hub for digital wanderers, gamers, and everyone in between!
70010000088145.description:
Open and run your own internet café! 

In this immersive first-person simulation, you’ll manage every aspect of your café to create the 
ultimate hangout spot. 

Start with the essentials, from cleaning and setting up your café space to welcoming customers who 
seek a cozy, cutting-edge environment. As your business grows, reinvest in top-tier equipment, design 
custom interiors, and attract a loyal customer base.

 Curate a unique vibe with full customization options – transform the café’s look and layout, choose 
stylish decor, and craft a comfortable atmosphere where customers love to gather. 

Whether upgrading PCs, optimizing space, or offering high-end gaming setups, every choice impacts 
your café's popularity and success. Make it a hub for digital wanderers, gamers, and everyone in 
between!

 Get ready to dive into the world of internet café management, where the hustle to stay ahead is real, 
customer satisfaction is key, and the ambiance is yours to build.

70010000088152.name: Acre Crisis
70010000088152.intro: Brazilian Military Police. Amazon jungle. Hungry dinosaurs.
70010000088152.description:
In 1992, following a series of mysterious deaths caused by wild animals, as well as strange sightings of cryptids in the sparsely populated and underdeveloped Amazon region of Acre, a special operations brigade from the Brazilian Military Police was sent to the area to gather intelligence. However, the situation took an unexpected turn for the soldiers, who soon found themselves cornered in the midst of a jungle infested with hungry dinosaurs.

During this odyssey, Sublieutenant Tais D. Oliveira must strive to survive in this scenario, uncovering, in the process, dark secrets surrounding that region of Acre. In that same place, during the 60s and 70s, the Brazilian Military Dictatorship carried out a secret program to develop biological weapons.

Will the soldiers escape alive from Acre? What kind of experiments were conducted in that region? What was the government's role?

Features:
- Short Length: The story mode can be completed in 1-3 hours, depending on the player's skill
- Replayability: The game features an Arcade mode where quick survival matches can be played
- Point System: You can collect points that you can later redeem for better weapons or cosmetics for your character
- Atmospheric: Explore the Amazon jungle with a wide variety of visual and sound effects, weather, and a day-night system that will completely immerse you in the game

70010000088157.name: Gunlocked
70010000088157.intro: Hell is other Spaceships in this Shoot'em up and survive game!
70010000088157.description:
A twin stick shooter without the twin stick, Gunlocked is a sci-fi action roguelike about careful positioning and upgrade selection. Manage unique targeting systems across multiple weapons and upgrades, as you battle legions of alien ships.  Simple enough to play with one hand, frantic enough to make you hold on with both!

You only control movement, but every weapon has its own unique targeting system that you can influence.

- Includes all content from the 2nd Gunning DLC
- 14 unique pilots to choose from
- 100+ powerful upgrades
- 38 unlockable augments to customize your pilot's abilities
- 7 bosses with evolving abilites. They get stronger as you do!
- Endless Mode

70010000088159.name: Super Onion Boy+
70010000088159.intro: Rescue the princess from the magical bubble
70010000088159.description:
Your mission is to rescue the princess, who has been imprisoned in a magical bubble by a terrible monster.

Super Onion Boy+ offers an exhilarating journey in a 2D platformer filled with action and adventure, in the nostalgic retro style. Your mission is to rescue the princess, who has been imprisoned in a magical bubble by a terrible monster.
As you traverse pixel art environments teeming with enemies, get ready to face epic challenges. Collect coins and stars to secure extra lives and discover chests containing magical potions that grant superpowers. These abilities are essential to overcome obstacles and defeat the dreadful monsters and bosses that will cross your path.

Game features
* Retro-style action-adventure gameplay, crafted in pixel art
* Platform game with stunning pixel art graphics
* Epic boss battles
* Magical potions with superpowers
* 8-bit chiptune-style music

70010000088162.name: Westild's Law
70010000088162.intro: Challenge the gang of Wild Joe to free your hometown from their iron grip!
70010000088162.description:
Westild's Law offers dynamic shootouts where you must cleverly use every element of your arsenal to achieve victory. Throw dynamite to clear your path or send enemies flying, you can throw your weapon at your enemies to stun them when ammo runs low and then take their weapons. Also when the situation gets critical, activate "ultra-sense", slow-down time and enhance your abilities to showcase the true power of the hero. 

Embark on adventures through 48 levels, each offering unique challenges. Prepare for epic battles where every step and every shot writes history in Westild's Law. Become a Wild West legend, restore peace and order in your town.

Are you ready to take on the challenge?

Features:
* Exciting Missions: Dynamic shootouts, horse races, rescuing trains and hostages, defending dynamite wagons, and boss fights! 
* Character Development: Upgrade your heroes using trophies and money earned in battles to buy new skills and weapons. 
* Weapons: From simple revolvers to powerful rifles and machine guns – choose the weapons that suit your playstyle, and when ammo runs out, use your weapon as a projectile to stun enemies. 
* Musical Accompaniment: Enjoy music that creates a unique Wild West atmosphere.

70010000088165.name: Little Droid
70010000088165.intro: Little Droid is an adventure platformer that takes you to a world of mysteries, tough enemies, and hidden dangers.
70010000088165.description: Little Droid is an adventure platformer that takes you to a world of mysteries, tough enemies, and hidden dangers. The journey is packed with challenges, requiring careful battery management to keep the droid energized at crucial moments. Explore a richly detailed environment, collect weapons to overcome various obstacles, and uncover secrets as you pursue the source of a mysterious signal.

70010000088170.name: Echoes of the Plum Grove
70010000088170.intro:
A new life awaits in Honeywood! 
Build a thriving community that will last generations.
Farm, socialize, and uncover the secrets of the island!
70010000088170.description:
After washing onto the island's shores, you'll find yourself the newly minted owner of a humble plot of land. Pull up your sleeves, grab your tools, and get to work building a farm that will last not only a lifetime but span generations!

Echoes of Plum Grove is a casual, cozy farm simulator where your decisions have consequences. What to plant, what to stock for the winter, and who to befriend will shape not only the town of Honeywood but the island itself.

Winter brings new levels of danger to players. With your very survival at stake, you'll have to work your land, fish the sea, cook meals, craft, forage, and more to ensure you make it through the cold season. Should you neglect to prepare, your lineage could end before anyone can uncover the island's secrets. While your main focus should be on survival, the town of Honeywood puts its best festive foot forward with many celebrations taking place.

Honeywood may be a cozy hamlet, where the people are the heart of the town. Everyone who lives on the island has their own schedules, jobs, traits, hobbies, and children. Work together with your fellow townsfolk to forge an even greater community—or just get them out of the way with harsh words and drastic measures.

Building relationships is at the core of Echoes of the Plum Grove. As you grow your family tree and your original character perishes, you'll find yourself playing as someone else within your family. While building relationships is crucial to your experience, take time to explore the island. There are many mysteries to uncover. Some say there's a witch that lives on the island and brings to town strange items. Others swear they've heard something coming from the bay. A few wonder what exists at the bottom of the mines. Adventure to the edges of the island to see what Echoes of Plum Grove has in store for you!

70010000088175.name: Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian
70010000088175.intro: Journey under the stars, behold the future beyond.
70010000088175.description:
Two young adults return to their lost hometown in search of truth and to bring back what they hold dear.

Story:
The town of Hallfein was once situated at the border of three provinces, and thrived due to mining and trade. However, a mysterious disaster struck the town, causing most of its residents to disappear and leading to it becoming a restricted area.

As time passed, restrictions on the town were lifted, and a plan to restore it was initiated. Seizing this opportunity, a young woman and a young man, having come of age after being driven from Hallfein long ago, now return to the land they once called home.

After meeting in their hometown, the two embark on a journey together to seek the truth, unaware of the encounters and revelations that await them...

Field:
This adventure is set on the Lantarna mainland. There are multi-level dungeons known as "Dimensional Paths," where the map changes with each visit and rarer ingredients can be obtained as the difficulty level increases. Explore the dimensional paths in search of high-quality synthesis ingredients!

Combat:
Combat takes place in highly strategic timeline command battles. Up to three party members can be placed on both the front and back rows. Utilize new elements such as Multi-Actions, Item Mix, and Unite Attacks to add even more excitement to battles!

Synthesis:
Create items through "Gift Color Synthesis" by linking the Gift Colors of ingredients. In addition to the required ingredients for each recipe, up to three additional ingredients can be added when synthesizing in order to transfer traits, allowing for both simple and in-depth synthesis! Make use of "Recipe Morph," which can change the kind of item being created, as well as "Catalyst Ingredients," which can change the Gift Colors of ingredients and the categories of ingredients that can be added, in order to create the best items possible!

Town Development and Shop Management:
Sell the items you synthesize in your shop to develop the town! As the town develops, you'll obtain new synthesis recipes and unlock new parts of the main story.

Note:
- Please check the official site for details.
- Please be aware that other editions containing this product exist. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

70010000088177.name: Despera Drops
70010000088177.description:
On the run!

Mika Amamine, visits Rome to celebrate the end of exams only for her trip to turn upside down when she witnesses a murder and is arrested as a suspect. During transport, the police van overturns in an accident, freeing her and six other criminals, becoming fugitives.

Mysterious attackers appear, targeting her unique ability, and begin to pursue the group. Will the team unravel the clues and reclaim their normal lives?

70010000088191.name: LIMP HEROES+
70010000088191.description:
"LIMP HEROES+" is an action game in which you control a hero who moves with physical behavior and fights against an army of evil villains.
Using attractive characters with a taste of American Comics, players can challenge fierce battles with simple controls that require only jumping and special attacks.
Enjoy the HOT and COOL physical action game "LIMP HEROES+".

70010000088196.name: Escape from Nightmare: Horror Tales
70010000088196.intro: A dark and terrifying horror full of secrets and mysteries will make you feel the whole atmosphere of escaping from an abandoned labyrinth.

70010000088206.name: Hidden Cats in Santa's Realm
70010000088206.intro: Mew-rry Christmas, everyone – come look for cats in a festive little town!
70010000088206.description:
It’s Christmas time, and following the annual tradition, it’s time for Santa's Icy Realm to be in full steam!

Join the festive fun and search for all the Hidden Cats - one by one among the elves to colour the town, piece by piece!

Play through different modes, find special cats, and unlock bonus levels!

Features:
- 900+ hidden cats... and other things to find!
- Two main game modes – normal and advanced
- Six unlockable bonus levels
- A massive snowball fight at the end!

70010000088211.name: The Harmony Chronicles: Chaos Realm Collector's Edition
70010000088211.intro: Join Mona on her quest and experience the ultimate hidden object adventure!
70010000088211.description:
For eons, Harmony has maintained order and prosperity across all realms. 
However, a mysterious decline in her powers culminated in her disappearance, leaving the entire universe teetering on the brink of catastrophe! 
Initially convinced that this surreal experience can only be a dream, our hero, Mona, resolves to aid in the search for the missing goddess. 
Venturing through portals, Mona will encounter werewolves, mermaids, dragons, and other fantastical beings on her way to face off against an unseen malevolent menace! 
With stunning visuals, captivating storytelling, humorous dialogues, and challenging puzzles, The Harmony Chronicles promises endless hours of immersive gameplay.

70010000088215.name: SONOKUNI
70010000088215.intro: Japanese hip hop x biopunk action
70010000088215.description:
Battle your way through a biopunk and Japanese mythology-inspired landscape filled with over-the-top, hip hop-infused 2D action. A single hit means death, but use your time-bending skills to take down your oppressors and you might yet save your dying nation.

***

Become a harbinger of vengeance

Engage in up-close-and-personal combat against bizarre genetically mutated enemies. Attack, parry and bend time to your will to make it out clean on the other side. Fail and gain the wisdom needed to refine your strategy.

***

A mind-bending take on Japanese mythology

Take on the role of Takeru, a lone assassin tasked with raiding a surreal superpower empowered by biotechnology. Join in her struggle to balance the morality of extreme violence against the defence of her own people, in a story inspired by real-life Japanese mythology.

***

Immerse yourself in neon-drenched hip hop

Let the intense hip hop soundscape and neon-soaked visuals assault your senses until they are raw. Every moment is punctuated with a visceral soundtrack from Japanese developer and hip hop group, DON YASA CREW.

70010000088220.name: Detail Hunter
70010000088220.intro: Can you spot every detail? Step into the challenge with Detail Hunter!
70010000088220.description: Dive into Detail Hunter, the premier spot-the-difference game that will put your attention to detail to the test! Experience a world of vivid, cartoon-style visuals and challenging puzzles. Explore a variety of dynamic environments, select your difficulty level, and use hints wisely as you race against the clock. Reveal hidden secrets and sharpen your detective skills to become the ultimate detail hunter. Whether you’re aiming to unwind or challenge yourself, this game offers an immersive and exciting experience for keen observers everywhere.

70010000088225.name: Jigsaw Puzzle Utopia
70010000088225.intro: Find peace, one piece at a time
70010000088225.description:
Immerse yourself in the serene and satisfying world of Jigsaw Puzzle Utopia, a game designed for relaxation and mental engagement. This virtual jigsaw experience offers thousands of stunning puzzles with themes ranging from scenic landscapes and vibrant wildlife to intricate abstract art. 

Choose your difficulty by adjusting the number of pieces, from beginner-friendly sets to expert-level challenges. The game’s intuitive interface makes placing pieces seamless, with features like automatic sorting, hints, and progress tracking. Enjoy soothing background music and customize your workspace for an even more immersive experience. 

Jigsaw Puzzle Utopia caters to all puzzle lovers, providing endless hours of calm and joy.

70010000088230.name: Ramp Bike Racing
70010000088230.intro: Can you master the ramps and become the ultimate racing champion?
70010000088230.description:
Get ready for an adrenaline-charged adventure with Ramp Bike Racing! Hop on your bike and navigate towering mega ramps that challenge your skill and push your limits. Perform daring stunts as you tackle impossible tracks and gravity-defying jumps. Conquer a range of obstacles, from zig-zag paths to blazing fire-lit tracks, all while experiencing addictive, edge-of-your-seat gameplay.

Unlock powerful bikes and race through exhilarating loops and complex puzzle tracks that test your racing and problem-solving abilities. Take on uniquely crafted courses that demand precision and boldness. 

Are you prepared to defy the odds, master the ramps, and claim your title as the ultimate race champion?

70010000088235.name: Food Truck Kingdom
70010000088235.intro: Are you ready to cook your way through time and prove your culinary mastery?
70010000088235.description:
Step into the shoes of a talented young chef who, after accidentally touching a mysterious time vortex, finds himself transported back to an ancient village! With only his cooking skills to rely on, he must serve legendary dishes, impress fierce warriors, and unlock the secrets that will guide him back to his modern life.

In this fast-paced and flavorful adventure, you’ll:

- Cook dozens of unique dishes using exotic ingredients.
- Race against time to satisfy hungry villagers, warriors, and chieftains.
- Master combos and special recipes to earn higher rewards and fame.
- Explore a rich world filled with history, culture, and culinary surprises.
- Strategize your kitchen to balance speed, creativity, and resource management.

Every meal you serve brings you closer to discovering the path home—but only the best chef can rise to the challenge.

70010000088240.name: Jungle Adventure
70010000088240.intro: Conquer the jungle, one pixel at a time
70010000088240.description: Dive into Jungle Adventure, a pixel platformer where you explore vibrant jungle landscapes, dodge obstacles, and face off against quirky creatures. Overcome challenging obstacles, battle quirky jungle creatures, and uncover hidden treasures as you progress through vibrant levels. With intuitive controls, retro-style pixel art, and a dynamic soundtrack, each stage offers unique platforming challenges and hidden secrets to discover.

70010000088246.name: Doodle Hunt: Halloween Rush
70010000088246.intro: Doodle Hunt: Halloween Rush is a thrilling seek-and-find game set in haunted, hand-drawn Halloween scenes. Explore eerie maps, uncover hidden spooky items, and bring them to life.
70010000088246.description:
Doodle Hunt: Halloween Rush – a Halloween-themed adventure where haunted hand-drawn maps come to life with a spooky twist! Dive into eerie, intricately sketched scenes filled with hidden items just waiting to be discovered. Your mission? Uncover and bring to life the ghoulish objects lurking within these hauntingly beautiful doodles. As you find the hidden treasures, watch them magically burst into eerie, glowing color, transforming once-shadowy sketches into vibrant Halloween scenes.
Key Features:
 - Halloween-Themed Hand-Drawn Maps: Wander through creepy, yet charming, illustrated maps filled with pumpkins, ghosts, bats, and other Halloween favorites.
 - Spooky Seek-and-Find Gameplay: Sharpen your observation skills as you search for haunted items hidden within the intricate doodles.
 - Magical Colorization: Witness a thrilling transformation as you discover each object, making the dark and spooky world come to life with glowing colors.
 - Explore Spooky Locations: Visit haunted houses, eerie graveyards, and spooky forests, each offering unique challenges and surprises.
 - Chillingly Relaxing Atmosphere: Enjoy the thrill of discovery with no time limits or penalties, allowing for a relaxing yet spooky gameplay experience.
