Doodle Hunt: Halloween Rush offers a fun, festive twist on the classic seek-and-find genre, combining Halloween-themed visuals with engaging gameplay. Whether you're in the mood for some casual haunted fun or a challenge for your sharp eyes, this doodle-filled Halloween world promises an enchanting and eerie experience for players of all ages.
Ready to uncover the magic and mystery within the haunted doodles? Begin your Halloween Rush today!

70010000088252.name: Coffee Pack
70010000088252.intro: Sort, pack and deliver while it's hot!
70010000088252.description:
Your job is to sort and organize colorful coffee packs by dragging and dropping them onto the board. Match the same types of coffee together, and when you get six of the same kind, they are ready to be delivered to happy customers!

With every level, new surprises and fun challenges await! Complete the objectives, deliver the coffee, and move on to the next exciting stage. It’s all about strategy, fun, and satisfying puzzle-solving!

Features:
- Play through 40 fun levels!
- Boost your brain with puzzles that start easy but get trickier as you go!
- Use helpful power-ups like hammer, rocket, and reroll to make sorting easier
- Earn coins to upgrade your café!
- Complete quests to unlock amazing rewards!

Go ahead, drop it like it’s hot, and watch your café come to life!

70010000088254.name: Let's Sing 2026
70010000088254.intro: The global karaoke party returns with Let’s Sing 2026, your ultimate ticket to fun-filled nights and unforgettable performances.
70010000088254.description:
Whether you're warming up your vocal cords solo, teaming up in duets, or competing with friends, Let’s Sing 2026 delivers an unbeatable playlist, and endless entertainment!

Featuring 35 chart-topping songs there's something for everyone—from modern hits to timeless classics.

- Billie Eilish – BIRDS OF A FEATHER
- Chappell Roan – HOT TO GO !
- Gracie Abrams – I Love You, I'm Sorry
- Selena Gomez – Single Soon
- Lizzo – 2 Be Loved (Am I ready)
- Shaboozey – Good News
- Ed Sheeran feat Lil Baby – 2step
...And many more!

Key Features:
* Sing along to official music videos for an authentic experience
* 4 exciting game modes for solo players and groups
* Up to 4-player support – perfect for parties and family gatherings
* Use your smartphone as a mic with the free companion app
* 1-month FREE VIP Pass included – unlock 180+ additional songs
* Whether you're a first-time performer or a karaoke king or queen, Let’s Sing 2026 invites you to step into the spotlight.

Get ready to take the stage!

This product is not sold on its own.

70010000088262.name: Vengeance Hunters
70010000088262.intro:
Three heroes. Countless enemies. Endless mayhem. 
Vengeance is calling!
70010000088262.description:
Welcome to VENGEANCE HUNTERS!!! 

Pick your fighter: The robot, GOLEM. The brawler, CANDY. The mad scientist, LOONY. 

And adventure from the Last Woods to the desolate Wastelands and to the mean streets of the Megalopolis and beyond! 

Play solo or with a friend as you battle a strange array of enemies, aliens, monsters, and thugs. 

Collect secrets, increase your score, and challenge yourself across increased difficulty. 

VENGEANCE HUNTERS is an original NeoGeo title created for modern gamers. 

Its combat systems and gameplay are designed to celebrate the fun of classic arcade Beat-Em-Ups with an added flare, attention to detail, and complexity that dares players prove their skill and best FIVE unique Boss encounters. 

Happy HUNTING!!!

70010000088267.name: Fast Striker EX
70010000088267.intro:
Fast Striker EX is a 2D CGI arcade shooting game with emphasis on scoring. 
You can choose between 4 game modes with different scoring s
70010000088267.description:
Short facts:

- 6 Stages
- 4 Game modes: Novice/Original/Maniac/Omake
- Elaborate scoring systems
- 40+ Fully animated CGI enemies
- 7+ Huge fully animated boss enemies
- 3D scrolling CGI backgrounds
- Constant 60 fps
- Difficulty rank system

EX Version specific changes:

- First port based on the arcade original with all graphics and animations intact.
- Added stage and boss select for training
- Added full autofire
- Normalized diagonal player movement
- Improved button priority between shot modes (FRONT,LASER,BACK,AUTO)
- Increased player fast strike shield endurance
- Improved background contrasts
- Added additional background layer graphics
- 32 bit like graphic updates
- hundreds of small fixes

70010000088269.name: Justice Ninja Casey
70010000088269.intro: The 16-bit classic comes to the West for the very first time!
70010000088269.description:
An unremarkable princess in an unremarkable castle has been kidnapped by a group of mysterious ninjas. Luckily for her, a young ninja named Casey is aware of the situation, and embarks on a mission to save her because... he is the Ninja of Justice!

Join Casey and learn the art of ninjutsu as he explores a land full of secrets and dangerous enemies! 


Features:
* Available in English for the first time!
* 2 game modes: choose between a Quest Mode that includes light RPG elements such as branching stages, a level-up system, equipment and secondary quests, or an Action Mode that focuses on classic brawler action
* Local co-op 2-player mode
* Rewind/Turbo function: repeat something until you achieve perfection, or speed things up
* Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point
* Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.)
* Gallery: view images from the original game’s manual and box design
* Cheats function: activate cheats that will make your mission a lot easier (infinite lives, invulnerability, etc.)
* Jukebox: listen to the 30 music tracks included in the game whenever you want

70010000088271.name: Feudal Bros - Tonosama #1
70010000088271.intro: The 16-bit classic comes to the West for the very first time!
70010000088271.description:
Japan. The Edo period. After many years of violent wars, peace has returned to the land, but it doesn’t seem like it will last for long. A new danger lurks in the shadows, and only two noblemen can stop it: Lord Baka, a Japanese feudal lord, and Prince Bouffon, a prince from the faraway land of France.

After they both receive a message from their deceased fathers, they set out on an adventure that will take them across Japan and beyond totrack down and stop the mysterious threat. The only problem is that their bravery is matched only by their stupidity...


Features:
* Available in English for the first time!
* Select from 2 playable characters, each with their own unique skills
* Local co-op 2-player mode
* Rewind/Turbo function: repeat something until you achieve perfection, or speed things up
* Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point
* Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.)
* Gallery: view images from the original game’s manual and box design
* Cheats function: activate cheats that will make your mission a lot easier (infinite lives, invulnerability, etc.)
* Jukebox: listen to the 36 music tracks included in the game whenever you want

70010000088276.name: Cats Hidden in Bali
70010000088276.intro: Find and discover 100 cute cats hidden across Bali in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?
70010000088276.description:
Cats Hidden in Bali is a cute hidden object game set in Bali, Indonesia.

100 cats are waiting for you to be discovered within a hand-drawn background. Relax, thanks to the chill soundtrack.

Found a cat? Press on it!

Features
1 Level, 100 cats
Easter Eggs
Hint System
Timer mode with leaderboard
In-game Settings

70010000088281.name: EGGCONSOLE AQUA POLIS SOS MSX
70010000088281.intro: A shooting game depicting a rescue drama set in an underwater city. Avoid obstacles and missile interference as you save the people of the underwater city!
70010000088281.description:
Thrills and Speed for Ultimate Excitement! Oh no! A few people have been left behind in an underwater city. If they aren’t rescued quickly, they’ll be blown up by mines or missiles. You must lift them to the surface on the rescue ship and reach the waiting mothership as fast as possible. 

This is a shooting game released in 1983 in Japan. The player controls a rescue ship to embark on a mission to save lives from the underwater city.

Between the mothership and the underwater city, obstacles are placed, and occasionally, missiles will be launched towards the underwater city. To make matters worse, you can only transport one person at a time, making the rescue operation anything but easy.

Skillfully avoid obstacles, counter missile attacks with your barrier, and don't forget to keep an eye on the remaining fuel for your rescue ship. If you manage to bring five survivors back to the mothership, you clear the stage. Despite its simple rules, this game offers a fast-paced and thrilling experience that keeps you on your toes.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000088284.name: Paint By Pixel 2
70010000088284.description:
Unleash your inner artist with Paint by Pixel 2! With 95 levels of fun and beautiful art, you'll have hours of creative enjoyment ahead of you. 
Choose from a wide range of beautiful art to create your masterpiece.
Paint by Pixel 2 is perfect for anyone who loves to be creative and wants to try their hand at pixel art. 
Even if you're not an experienced artist, you'll find the game easy to learn and fun to play.

-Choose from 95 beautiful works of art!
-Pick and play any level!
-Customizable colors!
-Beautiful soundtrack!
-Zoom and magnify for easy play!

With simple controls and intuitive gameplay, you'll be creating beautiful pixel paintings in no time.

70010000088289.name: Project 13: Taxidermy Trails
70010000088289.description:
Welcome to Project 13: Taxidermy Trails, a Walking Simulator set in a mesmerizing Taxidermy Museum. In this immersive experience, you assume the role of an kidnapped Probant forced to find a way to escape. Complete all 13 Walks to get out of this Nightmare.

Your mission is clear: report any anomalies you encounter during your walks. But beware, a single misstep means starting over. Only by consistently reporting accurately will lead to the real Exit.

Features:
- Repeating Museum Corridor: Explore a hauntingly repetitive environment, where each step could lead to discovery or deception amidst the eerie displays of taxidermy.
- Over 35 Anomalies: Uncover the secrets hidden within the museum as you encounter over 35 unique anomalies. Stay very vigilant, as every detail holds significance.
- Confirmation After Each Walk: After each walk, confirm whether you experienced any anomalies. Your precision determines your progress.
- Escape on the 13th Walk: Success lies in your ability to navigate the corridors and accurately report anomalies. Reach the 13th walk unscathed, and you may find the exit.

70010000088300.name: Touch and Reveal
70010000088300.intro: Dive into a beauty puzzles through the world of three extraordinary girls - Akari, Miyuki and Yoko.
70010000088300.description:
Akari –  a red-haired elegant girl from the elite, who loves social events and is a frequent attendee of balls. Green-haired, shy doctor Miyuki devotes herself entirely to work, even at the expense of her  sleep. And rebellious blue-haired Yoko, a lover of nightlife who enjoys extreme sensations, rooftop walks and artistic graffiti.


TOUCH AND REVEAL… THEIR SECRETS
Girls with characters as different as the colors of their hair invite you on a journey into their unique world. Solve puzzles with three heroines, in stunning hand-drawn illustrations, accompanying the delightful girls in their daily activities. 


DIFFICULTY INCREASES AS THE STAKES RISE
With your progress, the difficulty of the puzzles will increase. But as you know, nothing good comes easy.


KEY FEATURES:
- Delightful, anime-inspired, hand-drawn illustrations,
- Three completely different, yet so interesting and gorgeous girls,
- Easy-to-learn and relaxing gameplay with increasing difficulty,
- Tranquilizing background music.

70010000088306.name: Ninja 1987
70010000088306.intro: Save the city like a ninja!
70010000088306.description:
Ninja 1987 is an action platformer in the classic 8-bit style, paying homage to the great ninja games of the past. 

Take a nostalgic dive into the 80s with pixel art graphics and chiptune music that captures the vintage sound. Ninja 1987 features 7 levels filled with enemies and traps. Our hero can wield shurikens and unleash powerful ninjitsu attacks. 

Encounter challenging end-level bosses and in-game screens that unfold the story while remaining true to the totally arcade gameplay of the 80s.

Features: 
- 7 levels with 7 powerful bosses!
- Graphics and Music in full 8-bit style!
Devastating Ninja techniques to use!
- 80s B-movie style story!
- Side-scrolling action-platformer

70010000088310.name: The Pane Puzzle
70010000088310.intro: Layer and match colored tiles to restore pictures in The Pane Puzzle. Simple at first, but it gets tricky as you progress!
70010000088310.description:
The Pane Puzzle challenges you in restoring pictures by means of stacking up colored tiles. Rotate and reflect each tile to fit, but be aware you can only use each one once.

The game offers 100 different puzzles and 20 tiles to master, ensuring that interesting challenges never run out. Puzzle enthusiasts looking for a calm yet stimulating experience will love the tranquil soundtrack, which adds to the relaxing atmosphere.

Key Features:

- 100 unique puzzles
- 20 colorful tiles to manipulate
- Relaxing, tranquil soundtrack

Will you be able to solve the intricate tile puzzles of The Pane Puzzle?

70010000088316.name: Cycle Chaser H-5
70010000088316.intro: Pierce the sky in this stylish space shoot-em-up
70010000088316.description:
Cycle Chaser H-5 is a horizontal arcade-style shoot-em-up. Defeat foes to harvest their energy for maximum power and defense!

Mysterious aliens, led by a brainwashed soldier, have occupied a scorched Earth. 400 years later, a lone pilot seeks to rescue him from this cycle of destruction. Do you have what it takes to defeat the rampaging alien forces? Burn through waves of impenetrable foes with a sleek arsenal of weapons.


Features:
* Stylish hand-drawn and vector-rendered 2D graphics
* Grungy FM soundtrack, produced with the YM2612 sound chip
* 3 Weapon styles w/ 3 Attack types each: Specialize in your favorite, or go hybrid
* 4 difficulty modes, featuring unique enemy patterns and behaviors
* Accessible for all experience levels with Free Run mode
* Track your scores and discover the truth behind your foes in My Chronicle mode

70010000088319.name: My Night Job
70010000088319.intro: Endless Horror in a world of Nostalgia!!
70010000088319.description:
Black night, an abandoned mansion and a bunch of monsters. Sounds like the perfect job. Players will have to use a a variety of weapons to save their skin and master the challenge of leading survivors to safety, while also defending the building from invaders. They can use more than 60 weapons, from vases and floor lamps to chainsaws, shotguns and ginormous hammers. If the monsters thrash too many rooms or the player's health bar runs out, only an entry in the highscore list will remain of you.
Fast-paced, challenging action, hunting for the top spot in the highscore list, and an 80s horror movie setting - tons of fun and bizarre humor!
Carefully designed abandoned mansion looked so inviting for explorers.
Old School feel: The way it used to be, but better.
Not just decoration: Your Achievements become actual in-game bonuses.
Endless horror: A total of 11 types of monsters are waiting to be defeated with more than 60 unique weapons or your bare hands.

70010000088324.name: Poker Solitaire
70010000088324.intro:
A fresh fusion of Poker and Puzzle! 
Arrange cards and complete poker hands!
70010000088324.description:
A challenge for the solitary player!
Poker Solitaire - a new game that adds puzzle elements to creating poker hands.
Make hands, clear them, and aim for high scores! Your strategic options are limitless.
Clear the same hand consecutively to earn combo bonus points!
In online mode, you can participate in rankings and compete with players worldwide!
Simple yet profound, experience the world of this new brain game!

70010000088329.name: Meow Mission
70010000088329.intro:
Will You Become My Purrsonal Butler?
Meow Mission is a cat puzzle adventure set in an outer dimension!
70010000088329.description:
Solve various puzzles in Meow Mission to rescue cats trapped in alien dimensions! The quirky cats you rescue will move to Tomcat House, where they can create memories with Tomcat.

■ Diverse Puzzles
●	Solve based puzzles to search for the cats!
●	Explore puzzles with familiar mechanics and uniquely modified rules in a multi-dimensional space.
●	Each stage brings new challenges to stimulate your problem-solving skills.

■ Housing
●	Rescued cats live safely in Tomcat House, where they can spend special time with Tomcat.
●	Play with the cats in Tomcat House, but be careful—they might be a bit prickly!
●	Decorate Tomcat House with slabs discovered throughout the dimensions and discover the diverse charms of Tomcat.

■ Cat Collection
●	Collect cat friends with various personalities!
●	Spend time with rescued cats to build affection, unlocking special interactions and events.

■ Stories Beyond Dimensions
●	As you grow closer to the cats, hidden stories are unlocked, allowing you to enjoy the unique stories of each cat through comic strips.
●	Experience the charm of diverse stories through bonding with the cats.

Shall we go save these adorable cats?

70010000088334.name: LISTEN UP! WE TRIED TO MAKE “THOSE GAMES” EVEN MORE EXTREME! SOME THINGS HAVE TO BE LEARNED THE HARD WAY!
70010000088334.intro: Play upgraded, more difficult versions of familiar minigames to your heart's content! Are you up to the challenge? Are you ready...for THOSE GAMES EXTREME?!
70010000088334.description:
THOSE GAMES are now more challenging and more fun than ever!
Play upgraded, harder versions of minigames from THOSE GAMES 1 and 2!
Take on the minigames you know and love, now with a whole new layer of hardcore challenge and replayability!

THOSE GAMES EXTREME is a new, more challenging THOSE GAMES experience. Enjoy flashier attacks, animations, and stage gimmicks for more excitement and drama than ever!

Featuring new versions of THOSE GAMES staples, all with updated visuals, including Pin Pull, Number Tower, Color Lab, Knock-Back Shooter, Draw & Guard, and Spellbinding Scroll (now upgraded to Survival Scroll!).

Are you ready for the hardest instalment in the THOSE GAMES series yet? Are you ready...for THOSE GAMES EXTREME?!

Key Features
・A new instalment in the THOSE GAMES series, with a focus on higher difficulty.
・Features familiar minigames with updated visuals for a fresh new look.
・Enjoy bite-sized gaming challenges to your hearts' content, with 155 stages across six different minigames!
・Compete against other players from around the world in Rank-Up Challenges.
・Use the coins you earn in-game to get plates and titles from the Gotcha! machine.
・Combine plates and titles to create and customize your own Title Plate.
・View global leaderboards updated every month in Latest Rankings.
・Complete a variety of different missions to earn rewards.

70010000088339.name: Forbidden Love
70010000088339.intro: Guide two souls in an impossible love story. Your decisions will lead them to happiness or tragedy. Their fate is in your hands!
70010000088339.description:
Enter a story of impossible love, where circumstances conspire to keep two souls apart, but desire and passion push them to defy everything they know. You will be the one to guide the protagonists as they fight against the forces that try to keep them apart, facing difficult decisions that will put not only their relationship, but their very lives at risk.

In this interactive visual novel, each choice you make will open up new possibilities, leading to one of four different endings. The fate of the characters is in your hands: will you opt for forbidden love, despite the consequences, or will you choose the path of reason and duty? Emotions will run high as you face moral dilemmas, family intrigues and hidden secrets.

With a plot inspired by the great tales of tragic love, this visual novel will allow you to explore the deep emotional ties that bind the characters and the complexities of their world. 

Every decision you make will be crucial, guiding the protagonists towards happiness, tragedy, or something completely unexpected. Will you dare to defy the rules and fight for love? The future of this story and its protagonists depends on you!

70010000088342.name: Glowpop
70010000088342.intro: Glowpop is a Precision Platformer starring a little alien explorer, The Yellow Punnu. Face danger and big bosses on alien worlds with your only help: A Glowing Heart.
70010000088342.description:
You are Yellow Punnu, a radiant explorer in search of the missing Green Punnu. Traverse four intriguing planets with five enigmatic maps each, facing haunting challenges armed only with a glowing heart.

Ready to really test your skills on a cute, but brutally challenging platformer game?

Fast-paced, challenging platformer adventure with beautiful environments, incredible soundtrack and mind-blowing storyline
Easy to learn and accessible mechanics, your bouncing and your light are all you need
Four planets, each with five different maps to explore, providing an increasing challenge for even the greatest adventurers
A brutal Terror Mode to test your skills, your nerves and your patience

Face peril and take your skills to the limit:
Bounce away from the many dangers of these alien planets. The Yellow Punnu might be small, but its flip jumps are epic!

Discover unique worlds and artstyle:
You can find some pretty locations to pop your round butt on a spike!

Enjoy the juicy Rainbow Glitter Splatter:
On a slight miscalculation of a jump, the cheerful little Punnu pops in all the colors of a rainbow. Like a balloon!

In a visually stunning universe, beware of dangers like spikes, acid, and more. Join Yellow Punnu and companions Blue and Red Punnu as they piece together the puzzle of Green's disappearance, revealing an epic danger threatening the entire universe.

70010000088347.name: Personal style: Discover and define your unique look
70010000088347.intro: Ready to revamp your style and bring out the best version of yourself? This is the perfect game to explore and have fun while doing it!
70010000088347.description:
Dare to find your own style! This interactive game will guide you in a practical and fun way through the universe of fashion, showing you which clothes really suit you according to your body, how to get the colors right and how to put together a closet full of key pieces that speak of your style and personality.

Key features:

-Identify your body type: learn how to bring out the best in you. Discover which styles and cuts are ideal for you and how to get the most out of them.
-Select clothes that flatter you: from dresses to jackets, learn how to choose pieces that make you feel comfortable and confident, while enhancing your figure.
-Explore color palettes: create color combinations that suit your skin tone and style. Learn to wear shades that flatter any occasion.
-Accessories that make a difference: become a master of details and discover how the right accessories can transform your look.
Discover essentials: build a timeless closet with key must-haves in your collection, from the classic black dress to the perfect pair of jeans.
Constant experimentation: Try different looks and styles while having fun - each decision will bring you closer to defining your personal style!

In addition to improving your style, this game will help you increase your confidence and creativity. With a mix of learning and entertainment, it will guide you to dress in a way that reflects the real you. 

Ready to revamp your style and bring out the best version of yourself? This is the perfect game to explore, learn and have fun while doing it!

70010000088352.name: Interior design: Transform your space with style
70010000088352.intro: Design the home of your dreams with creativity! Choose colours, furniture and practical solutions to create functional spaces full of personality.
70010000088352.description:
Get ready to turn your home into a space full of style and creativity! This interior design game lets you design every room in a fun and entertaining way, whether you're a beginner or a design lover - it's your chance to add a unique touch to every corner and make your home reflect your personality 100%!

Start by learning how to balance colours, textures and shapes to give your home a style all your own. Not sure where to start? Don't worry! Create a detailed plan, choose a colour palette that reflects your personality, select the ideal furniture and organise each space to optimise its functionality. You'll even learn how to light and decorate with art and accessories to give it a personal touch!

Featured Features:

-Create your perfect plan: design each space to your liking, arranging furniture and objects strategically to make your home as functional as it is beautiful.
-Play with colours: explore a wide range of colours and textures, learn vibrant and soft tones to achieve combinations that will make each room stand out.
Unique furniture and accessories: choose from a huge variety of furniture and decorations - everything is at your fingertips to create the home of your dreams!
-Magical lighting: learn how to use light like an expert to give every space the perfect atmosphere, whether it's warm and cosy or modern and vibrant.
-Styles that suit you: do you like modern, vintage or minimalist? Explore different decorating styles and find the one that suits you best.
-Ingenious solutions: no more chaos! Organise your home with clever storage solutions that will keep everything tidy without losing the stylish touch.
-Sustainable design: discover eco-friendly materials and textiles to make your home look great and be kind to the planet too.
-Interactive chapters: experience decorating step by step with fun interactive challenges where you will see your ideas come to life in real time.

This game invites you to unleash your creativity and design a unique and original home - every decision counts and every room is a new adventure! Ready to start decorating and bringing your home to life?

70010000088355.name: World of Movies: Puzzle Game Challenge
70010000088355.intro: Relive iconic movie moments with 60 puzzles inspired by legendary films. Challenge your wits and immerse yourself in the magic of the seventh art!
70010000088355.description:
Delve into the magic of cinema with 60 mesmerising puzzles inspired by iconic films that have marked generations. Each of these digital puzzles will transport you to unforgettable scenes, recreated with dazzling graphics and a level of detail that will immerse you completely in the world of cinema. From epic battles to poignant moments of drama, each puzzle invites you to relive the excitement of your favourite characters, explore every minute detail and complete stunning cinematic landscapes piece by piece.

Test your skill and dexterity as you fit each piece together, gradually revealing scenes that come to life before your eyes. These puzzles allow you to rediscover the essence of cinema in an interactive and captivating way. Each challenge is a unique experience that combines nostalgia, creativity and the thrill of remembering legendary moments. With each piece you fit together, you'll feel like you're part of the magic that only great films can offer.

Start your movie adventure today and test your skills with these epic puzzles!

70010000088357.name: Arcade Archives KITTEN KABOODLE
70010000088357.intro: The fun accelerates and the enthusiasm is at full throttle!
70010000088357.description:
"KITTEN KABOODLE" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1988.
The main character is a cute cat! The objective is to defeat enemies, collect keys, and advance to the next stage.
Sometimes you can find the entrance to the secret stages. You may find various ways to play, such as shopping at secret stores or getting rich at the casino!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000088362.name: Drone World Tour: Flight Simulator
70010000088362.intro: Take part in extreme drone racing and fly around the world in a new realistic drone simulator!
70010000088362.description:
You become the operator of a high-tech drone that will have to go through exciting challenges and complete many tasks! Your main goal is to reach the specified point on time and without damage, avoiding various obstacles that threaten your drone.

EXCITING MISSIONS AND UNIQUE LOCATIONS
Complete unique missions in various locations around the world. Each mission brings its own challenges and demanding conditions. Explore a variety of urban and natural landscapes around the world, each of which requires an individual approach and tactics.

VARIOUS AND DANGERS OBSTACLES 
Be prepared for collisions! You will have to maneuver between static buildings, pass through narrow alleys and avoid moving structures that may suddenly appear in your path.

REALISTIC CONTROLS
Master the intricacies of drone control using various flight modes. Effectively respond to changing conditions and adapt your strategy to successfully complete each mission.

Get ready for exciting flights full of adrenaline and strategic planning!

70010000088374.name: MotoX Madness 2025
70010000088374.intro:
Race, stunt, and dominate in the ultimate dirt bike challenge!
Master extreme parkour-inspired tracks and become the champion.
70010000088374.description:
Gear up for an adrenaline-pumping adventure in MotoX Madness 2025! Take on the role of a fearless motocross rider as you race through jaw-dropping courses filled with crazy stunts, insane jumps, and death-defying obstacles. Navigate through dangerous terrains, perform flips, tricks, and parkour-inspired moves while mastering your bike’s control in high-speed action.

Challenge yourself across multiple levels with increasingly difficult tracks, each packed with ramps, gaps, loops, and other extreme elements that test your skills and reflexes. Upgrade your dirt bike, unlocking new gear and upgrades as you push the limits to conquer the ultimate parkour tracks. Whether you're racing against the clock or trying to land the perfect stunt, every moment in MotoX Madness 2025 delivers non-stop action and thrill.

Are you ready to become the ultimate parkour biker?

70010000088379.name: Care Bears : Unlock The Magic
70010000088379.intro: Dive into a world of fun and adventure with the Care Bears in  "Care Bears: Unlock the Magic" Play as Cheer Bear as and his friends in a variety of arcade games!
70010000088379.description:
"Dive into a world of fun and adventure with the Care Bears in  ""Care Bears: Unlock the Magic"" Play as Cheer Bear as and his friends in a variety of arcade games!

Meet the Beloved Bears: Play alongside Cheer Bear, Bedtime Bear, Tenderheart Bear and all the lovely bears from Care A-Lot!

Go on a Journey: Explore over 200 levels across a dozen unique minigames in the whimsical universe of Care Bears! Get Star Power to remove the Storm Clouds from the Silver Lining, meet the funny Whiffles and reach the end of the magical road for a lovely surprise.

Classic Arcade Fun: Enjoy a variety of themed mini-games inspired by classic arcade favorites: Care Bubbles, Cross The Rainbow, Lost Whiffle and many more!

Fill the Art Book: As you progress, earn unique stickers featuring art and bears from the ""Care Bears : Unlock The Magic"" tv show. Collect them all!"

70010000088384.name: Tri Breaker: A Sacred Symbols Odyssey
70010000088384.intro: Explore 40 brand new stages spread across four periods of galactic history, and obliterate the brick-breaking formulas that you've never seen before in the genre.
70010000088384.description: A decade has passed since the events of Twin Breaker: A Sacred Symbols Adventure. After successfully unraveling the mystery behind NASA’s disappearing generation ships, heroic pilots Colin and Chris have entered quiet lives of retirement. But the copious data they brought back from their remarkable journey has been fully studied, and shadowy government figures are keen on exploiting new discoveries to achieve potentially sinister ends. Can a third hero -- the brave government liaison Dustin -- convince the boys to put a stop to the renewed madness? If Twin Breaker was a brick breaker about space, Tri Breaker is a brick breaker on steroids, and this go-around, it’s all about time. Explore 40 brand new stages spread across four periods of galactic history, and obliterate the brick-breaking formula with new action-oriented gameplay quirks and formulas that you’ve never seen before in the genre. With boss fights, tons of story and dialogue, a retro-fueled soundtrack, and much more, Tri Breaker: A Sacred Symbols Odyssey is inspired by the one of the most popular video game podcasts on Earth, Sacred Symbols, is written by long-time gaming personality Colin Moriarty, and is the sixth title from Lillymo Games.

70010000088389.name: PATAPON 1+2 REPLAY
70010000088389.intro: Bang Your Drums!! And Catch the Fever!!!
70010000088389.description:
PATAPON is an action adventure where players use the rhythm of 4 Mystical Drums to command cute and mysterious eyeball-like creatures known as Patapons.

All Patapons have unique characteristics and classes (jobs) such as the Hatapon who stands in the center of the squadron waving its flag and leading its allies, the Tatepon who protects others with its large shield, and the Yumipon who attacks by shooting arrows. The role of each Patapon during battle varies with their class, allowing you to create a unique and well-rounded army to take on the various challenges that await!
As the player, you are the God of the Patapons and lead them on a grand adventure to Earthend!

1) PATAPON and PATAPON 2 are now a packaged set!
The two games, released in 2007 and 2008, are back as a remastered set!

2) The game involves 2 elements: simple controls and strategic combat!
The controls are incredibly simple, comprised of the rhythmic beating of four drums [Pata(Y), Pon(A), Don(B), Chaka(X)].

At the same time, there are many strategic elements, such as using the right battle commands during the right situation, and creating an army comprised of the classes (jobs) of Patapons, creating a game that is easy to understand while still offering a challenge!

3) A Game full of Challenges and Variety!
Patapons can be made or enhanced using various items. On top of that, even stronger Patapons can be created by gathering materials from stages and minigames. The game contains 400 weapons and equipment to enhance and upgrade your Patapons!
Customize your army to your heart’s content and create a one-of-a-kind squadron to take on the various enemies and challenges this game has to offer!

4) New support features!
While the original game elements remain unchanged, new support features have been added for a more enjoyable gaming experience!
Newly implemented features found in this version allow players to adjust the standard difficulty between Easy, Normal, and Hard, adjust the timing of button presses, and keep the drum icon displayed at all times!
Enjoy the original PATAPON, made better with all-new features!

70010000088394.name: Rage Swarm
70010000088394.intro: Step into the swarm and rise as the ultimate survivor!
70010000088394.description:
Armed with powerful weapons, blast through waves of fierce enemies to reach the ultimate boss. Collect upgrades along the way to power up and make every shot count!

Unleash a diverse arsenal – from classic firearms to devastating rocket launchers – each with unique abilities for unstoppable action. Gear up with special outfits, each boosting your strength and making every battle more dynamic.

Features:
- Navigate through various landscapes
- Defend yourself from the fierce invaders
- Pick up upgrades to get stronger
- Level up and buy awesome talents
- Complete quests for useful loot
- Open epic loot boxes and enhance your gear

Dodge, shoot, and strategize your moves. Are you ready to conquer the swarm?

70010000088396.name: Best Served Cold
70010000088396.intro: Can you mix a cocktail while facing a criminal? Find out in Best Served Cold, a murder mystery set in a lively speakeasy where you serve drinks, make allies and foes, and solve crimes.
70010000088396.description:
In an alternate history Europe, “The Nightcap” is the last speakeasy in town, and you’re pouring the drinks… while your customers spill their secrets. Mix and serve cocktails with a twist, as you become a detective while trying to save your bar.

Listen to your clienteles’ stories and learn about their lives as you unravel a mystery that touches every layer of Bukovie society, from the drunken dandies splashing cash on cocktails, to the crooked cops and seedy lowlifes who try to rope you into their shady schemes.

A good bartender knows the art of conversation is just as important as the ability to pour libations, so listen carefully and keep your wits about you as you delight, charm or even threaten your patrons to get the information you need. With a cast of 22 unique and engaging characters it’s up to you to choose who you can trust, who will have your back… and who will stab you in it!

Over the course of five cases, you’ll have to explore every clue and question every suspect to save lives… and save your business.

It’s time to flip that sign to open, turn up the jazz and welcome your first customers of the night.

Bukovie may be a city in strife, with labour strikes, rationing, unrest and the shadow of war looming, but instead of cowering in fear, the citizens flock to dance halls and speakeasies. Crumbling grandeur might inspire melancholy, but that’s nothing a stiff drink won’t cure.

In a world of dwindling light, your speakeasy is a bonfire in the night. Though the city may soon burn, cocktails are always…

Best Served Cold.

70010000088401.name: Paint By Pixel 3
70010000088401.description:
Play Paint by Pixel 3 and unleash your creativity across 95 levels of pixel art creations! 
This game provides helpful features like autofill and hints to smooth your artistic journey. 
Choose from a wide range of beautiful, unique canvases for your imagination. 
Explore the endless possibilities of pixel art and bring your artistic vision to life, one pixel at a time!

- Choose from 95 marvelous works of art!
- Use the handy zoom and magnify tools to never miss a pixel!
- Pick and play any level from the beginning!

70010000088405.name: FREEDOM WARS Remastered - Digital Art Book
70010000088405.description:
A Digital Art Book containing the art works that construct the world of FREEDOM WARS Remastered.

Includes art work created for the original FREEDOM WARS and new visuals created for the Remastered version.

70010000088415.name: I Love Finding Wild Friends Collector's Edition
70010000088415.intro: Discover lovable wild animals in this thrilling hidden object game!
70010000088415.description:
Explore to adopt and collect diverse wild animals! 
Enjoy new mini-games, crack engaging puzzles, and gather an array of exotic creatures!

- Discover diverse wild animals!
- Search stunning hidden object landscapes.
- Enjoy 20+ captivating mini-games!
- Collect and adopt a menagerie of exotic creatures!

70010000088445.name: Rookie Boxing
70010000088445.description:
Get ready to enter the ring with Rookie Boxing, the most immersive boxing game for console! Play solo or challenge a friend in local multiplayer, or take on the Tournament Mode to fight your way to the top.

With stunning visuals and realistic sound, the game recreates the intense atmosphere of a live boxing event. Fluid, lifelike animations and responsive controls make every punch feel real. Whether you’re dodging or landing a knockout, the game captures the raw excitement of boxing at its best.

Key Features:

Single-Player & Local Multiplayer: Fight against AI or face off with friends.

Tournament Mode: Battle through a series of matches to claim victory.

Immersive Graphics & Sound: Realistic visuals and dynamic audio bring the crowd and venue to life.

Realistic Animations: Experience smooth, true-to-life boxing action with every punch and move.


Take your shot in the ring and prove you’re the champ!

70010000088450.name: ZXC
70010000088450.intro:
A new adventure drawn atop a small notebook!
A protagonist trapped in a page of scribbled obstacles.
Avoid the doodled obstructions to escape the notebook!
70010000088450.description:
One boring day in class, the mindless scribbles on one page of a notebook become the beginnings of an epic journey!

Our protagonist, drawn alone into one small page, decides to escape the notebook. However, the obstacles scribbled along his path make escape look like no easy task...

Join our protagonist's adventure through this scribbled chaos!

[ Gameplay ]

- A mighty challenge in one small notebook
In this page filled with scribbled doodles, there's only one objective: muster every ounce of strength to avoid obstacles and traps, test your patience, and keep moving upward!

- Various obstacles littering the map!
The obstacles continue as you climb ever upward. Drop, pull, push, throw, bump, and climb! Avoid the strategically placed traps to escape each stage.

- Careful with the landing
Even when you do take a break, don't let your guard down!
Find a sturdy shelter to avoid unfortunate slip-ups!

- Unique graphics fashioned as pencil sketches
Art feeling like it was hand-drawn on paper! Freely explore each stage uniquely designed around a specific concept!

70010000088455.name: Uragun
70010000088455.intro: Play as a charming Mech unit to discover a world overrun by corrupted AI!
70010000088455.description:
Choose your path and rewards allowing you to research new skills, mod your Mech and its weapons and grow stronger. And yes, you can also play with your Mech looks!

The search for your missing pilot friend will bring you to different spectacular locations where the impact of the AI upraise changed the world as we know it.

Every fight will take place in a selected location of this beautiful and devastated world. 
Your quest will bring you to places like a deserted Barcelona, Industrialized Nairobi, the mines hidden in the snowy mountain rifts of North America or an overgrown and futuristic Hong Kong.

As you play, new weapons will unlock, ranging from shotguns and auto-rifles to plasma boomerangs and rocket launchers. Each weapon can handle different situations and enemies better: some are devastating against big swarms of enemies while others are better suited for heavily armored foes. You can equip them in pairs and experiment to find your favorite combination for every occasion.

70010000088471.name: Bullets & Brains
70010000088471.description:
In Bullets & Brains, you'll find yourself immersed in a sprawling post-apocalyptic environment, teeming with engaging atmosphere and danger at every turn. As one of the last survivors, it's up to you to navigate through the desolate streets, abandoned buildings, grimy alleyways, but also forests, sewers and even snowy mountains, fighting off waves of relentless zombies.
But fear not, for you possess a powerful advantage. Collect brains and energy and keep on leveling up! These items will boost your character's abilities, enabling you to unleash devastating attacks and turn the tide of battle in your favor.
● Choose between many distinctive characters, each with their own starting weapon.
● Explore a sprawling post-apocalyptic environment, filled with atmospheric locations and hidden secrets.
● Engage in intense top-down 3D shooter combat against never-ending hordes of brain-hungry zombies.
● Group with last survivors to protect each other in mayhem battles - Bullets
and Brains offers a co-op mode!
● Collect brains in order to level up and energy that grants powerful abilities, allowing you to unleash devastating attacks.
● Experience the game with your preferred control scheme, supporting both mouse and keyboard as well as gamepad.
● Test your survival skills against endless waves of undead
● Enjoy the fast-paced action and dynamic gameplay that keeps you on the edge of your seat.
● Unleash your strategic thinking and skillful aim to overcome the relentless zombie onslaught.
● Adapt your tactics and loadouts to suit different enemy types and encounter two new challenging foes.
● Uncover hidden collectibles and unlock bonus content as you progress through the game.
● Engage in thrilling and satisfying gunplay, with a wide range of weapons and explosives at your disposal.

70010000088476.name: The Fine Art of Murder
70010000088476.intro:
Unravel the mystery, where every choice shapes your fate.
A supernatural gamebook brought to life, with multiple endings to discover. Fully accessible – with or without the screen.
70010000088476.description:
After receiving a cryptic message from a distant relative just before his death, you're pulled into a chilling investigation that leads you down a dark and twisted path.

Step into a world where you control the unfolding narrative in this supernatural murder-mystery, inspired by the timeless gamebooks of the past. In this reimagined, interactive adventure, every choice you make shifts the story’s direction, leading to a variety of surprising and unpredictable endings. Delve deep into a haunting, fog-laden town as you uncover its sinister history, piecing together clues that keep you on edge at every turn.

Unlock hidden "Story Moments"—exclusive scenes and key revelations that can only be uncovered by making the right choices. These special moments offer crucial insights that can help you solve the mystery and lead you closer to the truth.

Crafted with full accessibility in mind, the game features full Narration and a robust Voice Guidance system, allowing you to enjoy the entire experience without ever needing to look at the screen. Whether you engage through visuals or sound, the immersive mystery is tailored for everyone, ensuring no one is left behind on this supernatural journey.

70010000088479.name: The Rocky Horror Show Video Game
70010000088479.description:
I WOULD LIKE, IF I MAY, TO TAKE YOU ON A STRANGE JOURNEY
Experience the strange journey of Brad and Janet like never before in this wild and wacky retro platform game adaptation of Richard O'Brien's legendary rock'n'roll musical.


IT'S JUST A JUMP TO THE LEFT
Run and jump through Frank-N-Furter's mansion of madness with authentic classic sidescrolling platform gameplay.

MADNESS TAKES ITS TOLL
Take on the mansion's tricks and traps in challenging classic platforming action, and with infinite retries, you'll never see a "game over" screen... good for relieving your tension, but it may drive you insane!

LET ME PLAY YOU A SOUND
Dance along with 8-bit chiptune renditions of Rocky Horror's legendary songs.

70010000088484.name: bounce
70010000088484.intro:
Play the ball with simple rules and controls!
Just pull the ball like a slingshot!
Aim ifor the same color target and give a GREAT shoot.
70010000088484.description: You may find something you have seen in Q...!

70010000088487.name: Shadows Bounce Once
70010000088487.intro:
The most exciting puzzle & stealth action game is here for you!
Control Ninja and assassinate all the white enemies.
70010000088487.description:
The most exciting puzzle & stealth action game that presented by『Q』series staff is coming to Nintendo Switch™! 

Here are some tips to enjoy this game.

- Ninja always bounces once.
- Don't say that the ninja and the floor are hard to see.
　Darkness is your ally.
- Just move from dark to dark.
- Red objects are dangerous. Both for the enemy and for you.
- Some light sources can be destroyed.
- In some cases, cutting the rope can open the path.
- Watch out for places without walls or floors.

70010000088490.name: Life or Reach
70010000088490.description:
A fighting game where you can control your reach!?
During a match, you can extend the reach of your weapon in exchange for your own stamina!
Extending your reach makes you more likely to be defeated, but it allows you to instantly overcome situations where you are at a disadvantage in distance!
You can also shorten your extended reach, so use it appropriately depending on the situation!
"Should I extend my reach, even though it makes me more likely to die?"
"Should I conserve my stamina, even though I am at a disadvantage in distance?"
The fun is in being caught between two choices that both seem likely to lead to victory!
The thrill of making a decision after much deliberation that leads directly to victory is exceptional!
Adjust your reach flexibly according to your opponent's actions and seize a new kind of victory!

70010000088492.name: Zombie Blitz
70010000088492.intro: This ruined Earth sees movement once more?! In the midst of waves of robots waking once more, the zombies' solo struggle begins in this action roguelike!
70010000088492.description:
[ Story ]
In this world ruined by the unstoppable forces of climate change, the senseless, emotionless zombies roam without purpose—until one day.

Combat robots, long since deactivated, somehow become operational, and the zombies are forced to flee from their indiscriminate attacks.

In the midst of fighting, fleeing, and broken robot parts, something long dormant awakens in the hearts of the zombies...

[ Gameplay ]
Zombie Blitz is a quarter-view survival roguelike bullet hell. With all its cool action rendered in adorable 3D graphics, it embodies the dynamic battles and fight for survival between the zombies roaming the world after the fall of humankind and the ruthless combat robots.

[ Features ]
- Refreshing action with easy-to-use controls!
Overwhelming waves of robots press in on all sides! As you start relatively vulnerable, understanding enemy numbers, positions, and wave duration is key to controlling the map. Make use of your trouble-free auto-targeting system and stay on the move to collect coins on the map for upgrading various skills that increase firepower!

- Survive persistent waves with your personalized build!
Freely combine characters, skills, and even items! Will you be aggressive by strengthening firepower and attack speed or prioritize survival by increasing movement speed and HP? Find your favorite amongst dozens of build combinations to wipe out your enemies!

- Together once more! Cooperate with a partner to blitz in!
Zombie Blitz features 2-player co-op! Overcome the waves of combat robots constantly pushing in with your strong AI companion! By correctly allocating skills, perhaps the battle will go in your favor? In addition, the game supports local 2-player co-op! Exterminate the combat robots in turn with the help of your partner!

70010000088497.name: Dinkum
70010000088497.description:
* Download the Nintendo Switch™ version and get a Battlegrounds Costume you can use in-game!

G'Day! Grab your tools, gather resources, and build your town while hanging out with friends and enjoying the charm of Dinkum.

■ A Survival Life Sim with Endless Possibilities
Plant crops, raise animals, and build your dream farm, or roam the island catching fish and bugs at your own pace.
With changing seasons and weather affecting how your crops grow, every day brings a new challenge. Slip on your flip-flops to hunt for rare fish, bugs, or ores. Every moment becomes a special adventure.

■ Explore and Survive the Wild
From red deserts and lush forests to hidden mines, Dinkum is full of wild places to explore. Hunt wild animals, gather resources, and learn how to survive in the great outdoors.
The creatures might look cute, but don't let your guard down! You'll need tools, weapons, and a solid strategy to make it out in one piece. Will you go head-to-head, or set traps and play it smart? The choice is yours.

■ Build Your Town Your Way
What starts as a simple campfire and a sleeping bag can grow into a thriving town with shops, fountains, flower beds, and windmills.
Craft furniture and decorations to personalize your home, reshape the island to design your ideal town layout, and customize your character's look from head to toe. Invite friends over to show off your one-of-a-kind creation!

■ The Joy of Growing Together
Sell your harvest and foraged goods to earn Dinks, and reinvest them to help your town flourish.
As your town grows, new shops will open, visitors will stop by—and some might even decide to stay for good. Celebrate with festivals and build a vibrant, lively town, whether you're playing solo or with friends.

70010000088507.name: Ecchi Oppai
70010000088507.intro: Think you've got an eye for oppai?
70010000088507.description:
Meet cute girls who need your help finding their hearts. Think fast and don't get distracted, or you'll lose them forever.

Choose from a selection of pictures and help these girls find what they're looking for. If you're good enough, you'll even get a reward.

Features:
- Over 130 pictures of girls who need your help
- Local multiplayer mode for you and your friends
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Can you find your way into their hearts?

70010000088509.name: Drag Racing Professionals: Dirt Mechanic Simulator
70010000088509.intro: Grip the wheel, push the limits, and leave your rivals in the dust.
70010000088509.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of adrenaline, speed, and drag racing mechanics on the quarter-mile with "Drag Racing Professionals: Dirt Mechanic Simulator." Become a master of drag racing, working in the atmosphere of gritty tracks and thrilling competitions.

Game Features:
- Dragster Control: Feel the power and speed as you control specialized quarter-mile dragsters, ready to surge ahead with incredible acceleration.
- Dirty Tracks: Experience the atmosphere of drag racing, competing on thrilling dirty tracks that add unpredictability and challenges to your races.
- Career Mode: Build your career in the world of drag racing, overcoming obstacles, developing your skills, and earning championship titles.
- Realistic Graphics and Physics: Immerse yourself in the exciting world of drag racing thanks to realistic graphics and physics that make you feel every moment of the race.

Become a drag racing legend and prove your mastery in "Drag Racing Professionals: Dirt Mechanic Simulator." Optimize your dragster, overcome opponents, and reach the pinnacle in the world of long-distance racing!

70010000088514.name: Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator
70010000088514.intro: Rev Up and Rule the Roads – Conquer City Traffic with Speed and Skill!
70010000088514.description:
Strap yourself in and get ready for an adrenaline-pumping ride in Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator! This immersive racing game throws you right into the heart of bustling city traffic, where you'll need to navigate your way to victory.
Features:
- Gear Up and Go: Choose from a variety of cars, from sleek city cruisers to high-octane supercars. Find the perfect ride that matches your driving style!
- Master the Streets: Feel the rush of high-speed racing as you weave through traffic. Precise maneuvering and quick reflexes are key to avoiding collisions and dominating the road.
- Realistic the Ride: Experience the thrill of the race with realistic car physics that make every turn and drift feel authentic. Stunning graphics bring the world to life, immersing you in the white-knuckled action.
- Challenge Accepted: Dive into various game modes that offer unique experiences to test your skills. Race your way to the top of the leaderboards and become the ultimate traffic racer.
- Precision is Key: Remember, control is king in Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator. One wrong move can send you spinning out of control. Can you maintain your focus and precision under pressure?
Prepare to push your limits and become a legend of the road!

70010000088524.name: Once Again
70010000088524.intro: "Once Again” is a story about parting. One summer, a boy growing up crosses time and space to meet a certain person. The moment they meet, the boy's summer turns
70010000088524.description:
If you could cross time and space, who would you like to see the most?

In the usual boring summer, when the boy Natsu blows out the candles on his birthday cake, something unexpected happens. He crosses time and space and meets the person he has most wanted to meet in his life, but has never met. In that time-space, not only did Natsu meet “that person,” but “that person” taught him how to take photographs and capture lost time in the frame. Which “that person” made Natsu want to stay here the most? What was the process that Natsu and “that person” followed?

Is “Once Again” a promise to meet again, or does it mean that they will never see each other again? The final meaning can only be known by taking part in this journey.

Game Features
- A birthday is the time each year that Natsu gets to spend with “the one”. It is a time of love and eternal memory.

- The encounter between Natsu and “that person” that transcends time and space. The most moving story of this summer.

- The story is advanced through interactive methods such as screen swiping, controlling the main character, etc.

- Various hand-drawn animations and sketch-like scenes of time and space that make the story more beautiful and moving.

- The game teaches camera skills, such as how to adjust the light and focus.

70010000088529.name: Axe Champ Shoot Out
70010000088529.intro: Can you be the Axe Champ?
70010000088529.description:
Compete in Axe Champ Shoot Out to reach the finish line first!
Smash all the targets and move back closer to the winning line!
Beat the competition to be the true Axe Champion!
Or try your skills in Solo Mode as you smash your way through the levels and take on the bosses.

70010000088544.name: Deep Deep Deep Nightmare
70010000088544.intro: Survive by facing monsters in the nightmare of a little boy who didn’t heed his mother’s warnings that eating too much before bed can cause nightmares.
70010000088544.description:
Deep Deep Deep Nightmare is a 2D Top Down Shooter. A little boy didn’t listen to his mother’s warnings that eating too much at night would cause nightmares. Now, he must face hordes of monsters and defeat the nightmare bosses to escape.

DEFEAT THE NIGHTMARE BOSSES
Face mini-bosses and nightmare bosses. Use your weapons and skills to win each battle.

SURVIVE THE HORDES OF MONSTERS AND TRAPS
Withstand waves of monsters and deadly traps. Test your skills in increasingly difficult levels.

CHOOSE YOUR ARSENAL
Build your arsenal with a variety of weapons and spells. Personalize your strategy and always be ready for the next enemy.

MAIN FEATURES
- Survive hordes of monsters and traps
- Multiple boss battles
- Collect souls to acquire weapons and spells in the shop
- Weapons and spells with unique effects
- Equip up to 4 weapons to defeat your enemies
- Equip a magic spell to help in your battles

70010000088557.name: Grit and Valor - 1949
70010000088557.description:
IT'S 1949; WORLD WAR II RAGES ON
Europe is on its knees. Deadly Axis Mechs patrol the landscape, intimidating the populace and flushing out rebels. Survivors are few, but have regrouped under the new flag of The Resistance.

You are the free world’s last hope. Your deadly mission; deliver a devastating EMP weapon into heart of enemy territory to turn the tide of the war.

KEY FEATURES

EVOLVED REAL-TIME TACTICS GAMEPLAY
Deploy your Mech Squad and command them in real time to fend off waves of enemies.  Each new battlefield presents a new challenge with unique combinations of adversaries and terrain. Think fast to use higher ground and cover, exploit enemy weaknesses, and utilise tactical advantages to withstand the assault, while defending your Command Vehicle.

DEVASTATING REGION BOSSES
Your tactics may be sound, but if you reach the end of your run, you’ll need to make one last stand against a menacing Axis General. These end of Region boss battles will have you facing overwhelming odds, wave upon wave of elite enemies, new hazards, and Kaiju-sized Boss Mechs.

BUILD THE ULTIMATE MECH SQUAD
You have the freedom to customise and configure your squad of Mechs and Pilots to adapt your tactics for each new mission. 

Earn Valor to level up your Pilot’s unique abilities and Scrap to upgrade your Mechs before to gain the advantage on the battlefield.

REGROUP. REBUILD. REDEPLOY.
If your Command Vehicle is destroyed, your Mission is over. Regroup at the Resistance Base, rebuild and upgrade your squad, and redeploy!

The Scrap and Valor you earn in the field can be used to upgrade Mechs and level up Pilot abilities. But prepare for the unexpected; the battlefields, enemies you face, and any rewards you receive, will never be the same twice.

Take a stand, liberate Europe and free the world. Make this your finest hour!

70010000088567.name: Square Logic
70010000088567.intro: A minimalist puzzler - color the grid with squares and rectangles
70010000088567.description:
Square Logic is a logic puzzle game where the goal is to fill the entire grid by drawing squares and rectangles. Each piece you place must contain exactly one number, which indicates how many tiles the piece must cover. The rules are simple, but finding all the solutions will challenge your mind.

Develop strategies to figure out how to solve more and more puzzles! Try and solve all 200!

Contents Include:
* 200 levels to complete
* Four grid sizes, ranging from 5x5 to 15x15
* Easy levels for newcomers, as well as challenging levels for puzzle lovers
* A minimalist design, with no score or timer to create pressure
* Choose your aesthetic with 3 different color palettes as well as dark mode

70010000088570.name: Unpacking Universe Dreams
70010000088570.intro: Unpack, Arrange, Create - Shape your world
70010000088570.description:
Unpacking Universe Dreams invites you to explore a whimsical world where each box holds new adventures. Unpack and arrange items in vibrant locations, each with its own unique atmosphere. Discover hidden treasures and delightful surprises as you create your perfect space!

Four Engaging Game Modes:
-Classic Mode: Unpack and place objects without mistakes for the highest score.
-Timed Challenge: Race against the clock to arrange items before time runs out.
-Sandbox Mode: Enjoy unlimited creativity as you unpack and arrange at your own pace.
-Speed Run Mode: Test your skills in a fast-paced environment, focusing on quick unpacking and efficient placement.
-Diverse Levels: Navigate through various rooms and environments, each offering fresh challenges and aesthetics.

Discover Something New: Each level reveals unique items and surprises that enhance your unpacking experience, encouraging exploration and creativity.

Transform every space into a reflection of your imagination in Unpacking Dreams!

70010000088575.name: Fighter Aces: Sky Dominance
70010000088575.intro: Your Sky, Your Rules: Experience the Ultimate Aerial Combat!
70010000088575.description:
Get ready to soar into high-octane aircraft combat, where fast-paced flight simulation meets strategic warfare. As a skilled pilot, you’ll navigate various combat zones, engage in intense air battles, and take on high-stakes missions to become the ultimate ace. Whether you're racing against the clock, battling waves of enemies, or customizing your aircraft for optimal performance, each mode offers unique challenges and action-packed gameplay. The game’s dynamic environments, from bustling cities to vast open skies, will test your reflexes and tactical skills.

Key Features:

- Campaign Mode: Engage in high-stakes missions, facing diverse enemy forces and unlocking special rewards.

- Time Assault: Take down as many enemies as possible within a time limit, with bonuses based on your speed and precision.

- Survival Mode: Stay airborne, evade attacks, and outlast foes to rack up a high score.

- Customizable Aircraft: Equip and upgrade three advanced planes to tailor your playstyle for the ultimate experience.

- Diverse Weapons: Arm your aircraft with a variety of weapons, including air-to-air missiles, air-to-ship rockets, and air-to-ground bombs, each designed for specific combat scenarios.

- Diverse Environments: Conquer various battlefields, each offering unique terrains, weather conditions, and strategic challenges.

Master the skies and prove your aerial prowess in this exhilarating flight experience. Join the fight and elevate your gaming adventure to new heights!

70010000088586.name: Archery Legend
70010000088586.description:
Unleash your archery skills! Step into the world of precision and strategy with Archery Legend. With 5 unique bows and arrows at your disposal, conquer 50 thrilling levels spread across 5 beautifully themed stages. Unlock new bows and arrows as you progress through increasingly challenging levels, each offering fresh obstacles and targets that will test your accuracy and reflexes. Whether you're taking aim in the enchanted forest, the frozen tundra, or a medieval battlefield, every shot counts!

Key Features:

5 Unique Bows & Arrows: Each bow has its own strengths and challenges, offering a new gameplay experience as you unlock them through your journey.

50 Thrilling Levels: Battle your way through 5 diverse, beautifully designed stages, each with 10 levels full of obstacles, moving targets, and unique environments.

Progressive Unlocks: Master each stage to unlock new bows, arrows, and customization options.

Challenge & Fun: Perfect for casual players looking for quick fun, as well as competitive archers ready for a challenge!

Are you ready to become the ultimate bow master? Grab your bow, take aim, and let your arrows fly!

70010000088591.name: ZOE Begone!
70010000088591.intro: A frenetic and unique hand-drawn bullet hell shooter!
70010000088591.description:
ZOE Begone! blends run-and-gun mechanics with classic shmup action in looping arenas. Inspired by drawn-on-film animation of the 1930's - shoot, dash and pound your way through the Animator's creations.

All Zoe wants is some peace and quiet, but she's gonna have to deal with the pesky animator before she'll be able to get some rest.

Destroy the animator's tools, blast their creations to bits, collect Apples to spend on Power Ups, rack up your multiplier, and reclaim your serene surroundings to help Zoe get back to normality as fast as you can (and bag yourself a high score in the process)!

Features:
- 3 amazing game modes to explore!
- Difficulty options to suit all players.
- Master the mechanics and top the Online Leaderboards!
- Power-ups and Upgrades to give ZOE an edge!
- Incredible hand-drawn visuals and a Boogie soundtrack!

70010000088596.name: Ever 17 - The Out of Infinity
70010000088596.intro: To the promise we once made and the place we must return
70010000088596.description:
Takeshi Kuranari, an ordinary college student, visits the underwater theme park LeMU. An accident occurs, trapping Takeshi and 6 other individuals inside LeMU, 51 meters below the surface. With no hope of rescue, Takeshi explores LeMU along with the mysterious girl Tsugumi and part-time employee You, searching for a way to escape to the surface. 
A theme park of dreams and hopes sunk in the depths of the mysterious blue ocean.
Can dreams and hopes still be found there? Or is there some other mystery lurking?
Overcoming one crisis after another, they search for a way to escape!

A masterpiece written by Kotaro Uchikoshi comes to Nintendo Switch™, 22 years after the initial Japanese release!

70010000088598.name: Never 7 - The End of Infinity
70010000088598.intro: Save me from this cage of infinity
70010000088598.description:
The protagonist, Makoto Ishihara, had the worst possible awakening. He had a dream in which a girl died a tragic death right in front of his eyes. The seminar training camp was supposed to go off without a hitch...or so Makoto believed.
April 6th.. The day everything changed. 
The uneasiness turned in to despair, and the premonition turned into calamity...
Will Makoto be able to stop the tragedy and see the light of the morning on Day 7?

A classic Sci-fi visual novel written by Kotaro Uchikoshi comes to Nintendo Switch™, 24 years after the initial Japanese release!

70010000088600.name: Nurse Call 恋のナースコール
70010000088600.intro:
Everyone wants to experience it at least once! 
Being showered with attentive care and love surrounded by beautiful nurses!
70010000088600.description:
"恋のナースコール Nurse Call" is a visual novel game where the protagonist, Masatoshi, who is hospitalized after a traffic accident, falls in love while being cared for by two beautiful nurses.


The protagonist, Masatoshi Fujii, was rushed to a certain hospital due to an unfortunate accident.
When I woke up to the view of an unfamiliar ceiling.
But more importantly, two beautiful unfamiliar nurses!?

Due to a mistake by the head nurse, Masatoshi ends up being admitted to a VIP room,
and romantic feelings begin to develop during his treatment.
However, Masatoshi is not the only one who has started to crave something beyond a professional relationship.

Everyone's fantasy affair with a beautiful nurse!
And their dreams and goals are...
 As they go through nursing and rehabilitation together, what will become of Masatoshi's relationship with these women?


・Aki Manabe
A rookie nurse at the hospital where Masatoshi was admitted.
Shee is clumsy and, when flustered, sometimes takes unexpected actions at the spur of the moment.

・Kotomi Honjou
Aki's senior, and another nurse in charge of Masatoshi's care.
She is dedicated and has a great reputation among the patients. She is fond of her junior, Aki.

・Masatoshi Fujii
A medical equipment salesman.
He was traveling to various hospitals for work but ended up being hospitalized himself after being injured in an accident.

70010000088610.name: How to Organize Your Home: A Practical Guide
70010000088610.intro: Interior design and organization enthusiast? Turn any space into a functional home while exploring styles and optimizing every corner!
70010000088610.description:
Are you a fan of interior design and home organization? This is the ultimate game for you! Learn how to turn any space into a functional and cozy home that reflects your personal style. Explore different decor styles, efficiently organize every corner of your house, and make the most out of every square foot.

Key Features:

-Personalized Interior Design: Discover unique spaces by combining a wide range of furniture, decorations, and colors. From a modern living room to a rustic kitchen, choose the atmosphere that suits you best.
-Space Optimization: Small rooms? Learn how to intelligently distribute the space and maximize functionality without sacrificing style.
-Organization and Storage: Keep clutter under control with smart storage solutions. Install shelves, cabinets, and more to utilize every corner while maintaining aesthetics.
-Smart Lighting: Play with different types of lighting to change the mood of your rooms. Create relaxing or modern atmospheres with warm or cool lighting.
-Space Distribution: Design areas tailored to various needs. Organize a workspace that boosts productivity or a bedroom that invites rest.
-Themed Decoration: Experiment with decor styles like minimalism, industrial, or Scandinavian. Mix textures, colors, and materials to create the perfect ambiance.
-Creative Solutions: Turn forgotten spaces into useful areas with creative storage and decoration ideas that make your home more functional.


As you progress, you'll unlock new tools and customization options. This game offers a fun and relaxing experience while teaching you how to keep your home organized and create the space of your dreams.

70010000088613.name: Personal Development: A Journey to Growth
70010000088613.intro: Begin a journey of self-growth! Discover tools to boost resilience, mindfulness, and focus, unlocking your full potential every day.
70010000088613.description:
Embark on an inspiring journey of self-growth with this interactive guide, crafted to help you unlock your full potential. Each chapter delves into essential areas of personal development, from self-discovery and resilience to adaptability and mindfulness. You’ll learn how to set meaningful goals, develop positive habits, and embrace change with practical insights that make each day a new opportunity for growth.

The guide encourages you to refine your focus, boost your confidence, and cultivate a growth mindset that prepares you to handle life’s challenges with strength. Discover how mindfulness and gratitude practices enhance well-being, and explore the power of resilience in overcoming obstacles. Each section provides unique perspectives that help you connect deeply with your values and motivations.

Perfect for those eager to strengthen their skills and mindset, this experience offers more than just theory, it invites you into a thoughtful journey of self-improvement, where personal growth becomes a truly rewarding adventure.

70010000088616.name: Bubble Riders
70010000088616.intro: Fast inflatable balloon races on fun tracks
70010000088616.description: Try to race around a winding track on an inflatable balloon. Overtake your rivals and push them off the track. Your goal is to be the first to cross the finish line! Upgrade your bubble to make it faster and stronger. Open new locations and new challenging tracks.

70010000088619.name: House Painting - Simulator
70010000088619.intro: Enjoy the most realistic and fun house painting simulator you’ve ever seen!
70010000088619.description:
Relax with this house painter simulator, where you have the power to paint various houses just the way you like. Make sure every corner has a smooth, high-quality finish. Unlock upgrades and new tools as you progress, and become the best painter around, a true pro.

Kick back and enjoy – this is an stress-free game, or rather, a game against life’s stress!

70010000088624.name: EGGCONSOLE THE SCHEME PC-8801mkIISR
70010000088624.intro: Unleash your Force and take down the Hellstone Cult! A side-scrolling action RPG with captivating BGM.
70010000088624.description:
This game is an action RPG released in 1988. Players take on the role of Mars as they embark on a journey to defeat the Hellstones cult. The game is presented in a side-view perspective, and players will battle enemies by using jumps and force blasts emitted from Mars' arms. Various items are scattered across the map, and collecting these can power up Mars in many ways, such as enabling rapid fire for the force, increasing jump height, halving damage, or making the force pulse in a wave-like pattern.

While the game offers fun and fluid gameplay, one of its highlights is the soundtrack. The BGM was composed by Yuzo Koshiro, a name well-known to retro game fans, and was his first work after going freelance. It made extensive use of sampling, supported by the Sound Board II, filled with features sure to impress fans. Cranking up the volume during gameplay might just immerse you even deeper into the world.


*Please note that some save data is included in the initial state.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000088627.name: Sled Riders
70010000088627.intro: Discover incredible winter sled races on exciting tracks against other racers!
70010000088627.description:
Jump into the most fun sled race game! Get ready for snowy tracks, each one special and full of surprises. Race through Snowflake City or over Frost Mountain - every race is an adventure!
Make your Racer look cool with fun outfits and hats. Pick a bright suit or a cute snowman costume to stand out in the snow.
Choose your sled! From old-school wood sleds to super-fast future ones, find your favorite. Make it shine with cool colors and effects.
Race with friends in exciting races that are easy to play but hard to win. Do big jumps, take sharp turns, and find shortcuts to beat everyone. You'll get new outfits and sleighs the more you race.
It is all about having a great time racing in the snow. So grab your controller, pick your sled, and let's race!

70010000088632.name: Skyline Bowling
70010000088632.intro: Strike out the competition and become the ultimate bowling champ! Ready to roll?
70010000088632.description:
Get ready for an action-packed challenge where every strike brings you closer to victory! Join friends or family in up to four-player matches, compete in thrilling tournaments against top bowlers from across the lanes, and bowl in amazing alleys with cool views. Only the best players make it to the final rounds – will you be the one holding the trophy?

Skyline Bowling isn’t just about throwing the ball; it’s about using the right gear and clever strategies! Boost your skills with special gear like gloves that give your ball extra spin or shoes that make it roll faster. Choose from different bowling balls, and earn experience to unlock new tournaments and amazing bowling alleys with fun surprises! Collect skills to help you get even more strikes. Are you ready to bowl your way to the top?

Features:
• Local multiplayer - Compete against your friends and family in matches for up to 4 players!
• Motion Controls - Feel like you're truly bowling with motion controls that respond to every move!
• Exciting Tournaments - Compete in rounds and aim for the finals, where only the best bowlers make it.
• Customize Your Character - Personalize your bowler with cool gear, such as gloves and shoes.
• Challenging Arenas - Unlock amazing new alleys with fun twists as you level up.
• Powerful Skills - Use active and passive skills to boost your chances of winning!

Get ready to roll, aim, and strike your way to victory in Skyline Bowling!

70010000088634.name: Crimson Asylum
70010000088634.intro: As a paranormal investigator fueled by curiosity and a thirst for the unknown, you've been dared to enter the abandoned halls of Crimson Asylum.
70010000088634.description:
Equipped with your trusty video camera and unwavering resolve, you set on a mission to document the whispers of the past and capture evidence of the restless spirits wandering inside.

The deeper you venture, the more the asylum twists and contorts around you. The escape route you meticulously documented vanishes, replaced by an endless maze of despair. The playful curiosity that led you to Crimson Asylum has morphed into a desperate struggle for survival.

Investigate: 
Utilize your video camera to capture paranormal activity and uncover the secrets of Crimson Asylum.

Terrifying Atmosphere:
