Immerse yourself in the chilling ambiance of the Asylum, where every sound is filled with terror.

Overcome Puzzles: 
To proceed within the Crimson Asylum, you need to complete various puzzles to get through the many floors.

Enter the Crimson Asylum with the means to explore and document it's secrets, only to get lost and trapped with the horrors that lie within..

70010000088646.name: Trading Card Shop Simulator
70010000088646.intro: Turn your card collecting dream into a real business!
70010000088646.description:
Who cares about the ordinary cards? And only the chosen few know that they can be a real treasure! Your collecting dreams can come true. 

Open a trading card shop in your town and expand across the world. Let the passionate come to you and find something special. Create an iconic place for your friends to gather! 

Expand and upgrade your store. Become a true perfectionist and turn this boring space into a stylish home for collectors. 

Organize the space - add new features so everyone can find what they are looking for. Open new zones for customers to buy, trade or play in. 

Search for rare collections and sell them in your store. Find the diamonds for you and your special collections!    

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Make your store and card collection the best in the world!

70010000088649.name: Tombs Of Myra
70010000088649.intro: Descend into the cursed tombs of Myra and free the souls of ancient warriors.
70010000088649.description: Tombs of Myra is a turn-based puzzle dungeon crawler game.

70010000088652.name: Bioweaver
70010000088652.intro: An RPG game with the main content of treasure hunting and character building.
70010000088652.description:
In a mysterious underground laboratory, dangerous creatures have escaped. The road to the surface is blocked by many obstacles, but top scientists never complain about the environment. The organs and genes of unknown creatures can be your power. Make good use of them and create yourself a path of flesh and blood.

You can use basic programming logic to deeply customize your skill sets, and you can also create organs with different attributes and functions with the special crafting system.

Use simple programming logic to build organ links. The skill building process is highly visualized and can be easily debugged.

The game includes hundreds of organs with different functions. Each organ can also be mutated to obtain additional affixes which can further generate more unpredictable changes.

The difficulty of the game can be automatically adjusted to the progress of the game. After completing the main acts, there are still more difficult challenges, more modes and content to explore.

70010000088669.name: Sparking Beam Strike 1000
70010000088669.intro:
Puzzle Your Way by Controlling the Light!
Reflect the beams and hit the targets right!
70010000088669.description:
This game is a puzzle where you reflect beams and guide the light to the goal.
Move the blocks that can reflect beams skillfully, and clear the stage by hitting all the beams to the goal.

The game offers 1,000 puzzles, plus Extra Stages with even greater difficulty.

It’s a challenge that will put your calculation skills to the test as you figure out complex reflections.

70010000088674.name: Vanity Fair: The Pursuit
70010000088674.intro: Either stop early and return to calm, or go all out and transform into a demon
70010000088674.description:
"Vanity Fair: The Pursuit" is a fictional real-life interactive narrative product with the theme of life "choices" and "survival in the entertainment industry".

The background of the story takes place between 2004 and 2024 in an imaginary world view. The gambling agreement you signed in order to realize your movie dream will be gradually involved in the whirlpool of "Vanity Fair". When you are in a dilemma, what should you do? How to "choose"? When facing difficult "choices", should you protect yourself or help others? You will return to that golden age, become a "director", and experience the life of luxury and wealth firsthand.

Choice drives life: 
The core of the game is the choices made by the player, each choice will bring different story development and results. At the crossroads of fame and fortune, every choice is your script.

Multiple branch plot: 
The game is designed with multiple story lines and more than a dozen completely different endings. Players' choices will lead to different plot branches and endings.

Movie audio-visual enjoyment:
Immerse yourself in the character's life. Life is like a play, it all depends on your acting skills! Every choice you make will affect the direction of your life. Once you enter Vanity Fair, you will experience what it means to be "involuntarily"

Deep emotional resonance: 
The game focuses on creating emotionally profound stories and characters, providing players with in-depth emotional participation and experiencing the ups and downs of life stories, and immersing themselves in the joyful and contemporary golden decade of being a "director"

70010000088679.name: KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It
70010000088679.intro:
One 4 All, All 4 One,
This is a game that checks your ability to be considerate to make the world a little more peaceful.
70010000088679.description:
Why do humans “read the air“?
The answer lies in this “KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It”.

This game puts the spotlight on the childhood of the main character “You”,
Let's Consider It with innocence while looking back on various events that everyone must have experienced in their childhood.

The basic rule of deciding what to do in situations by moving the red object on the screen is the same.

Please consider the situation and read the atmosphere according to the various scenes that will be asked.


"KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It" is equipped with the following game modes.

・"Consider It" mode
A total of 100 situations will be asked.
After playing all the questions, your "ability to read the atmosphere" will be diagnosed.

・“Consider It Together” mode.
Play together with your friends and family.
10 questions will be asked out of a total of 30 questions.
After playing, the compatibility between the two people will be diagnosed.

・“Fun Minigames” mode
Contains 3 mini games.
Aim for the highest score with Score Attack.

70010000088686.name: Food Truck Business Simulator
70010000088686.intro: Cook, drive, and compete—build your food truck business from the ground up.
70010000088686.description:
In Food Truck Business Simulator, you’ll start your culinary business on wheels by building a food truck from scratch. Renovate and customize the truck to transform it into an efficient and attractive space that will draw customers from all over the city. Create delicious recipes, diversify your menu, and experiment with new ingredients to satisfy the tastes of a dynamic audience.

The challenges don’t stop at cooking. You’ll need to navigate through traffic, avoid obstacles, and adapt to the busy city schedule to reach your locations and serve customers on time. With every success, you’ll be able to expand your business and participate in food events to increase your visibility.

Key Features:
• Renovation and Customization: Upgrade your truck to improve efficiency and attract more customers.
 • Unique Recipes: Create an innovative and diverse menu tailored to customer demands.
 • Road Challenges: Face traffic and obstacles to avoid delays in deliveries.
 • Expansion: Open new locations and participate in festivals to grow your business.

Every decision will bring you closer to your dream of becoming the leader in the food truck market. How will you face the challenges of every day? Culinary adventures await you!

70010000088701.name: Bunny Zoo - Animal Battle Royale
70010000088701.intro: Choose your champion, master your skills, and conquer the animal kingdom—are you ready for the ultimate battle?
70010000088701.description:
Get ready for an exciting adventure! In this fun game, you’ll choose from three cute characters—Hamster, Mouse, or Bunny—each with special skills that can help you win.

Game Features:

- Diverse Battle Arenas: Engage in epic fights across various dynamic environments, each presenting unique challenges and opportunities for strategy.

- 11 Animal Opponents: You’ll face off against 11 different animals on the map. Your mission is clear: defeat them all to prove your skills and become the champion!

- Find Weapons and Gear: Search the map for cool weapons and items. Use quick seeds or powerful acorn bombs to gain an edge. Look for hidden power-ups that boost your speed, strength, or 
protection.

- Customize Your Character: Earn coins from your victories and use them to upgrade your character. Unlock fun skins and special abilities to make your animal unique.

- Skill and Strategy: Every choice you make is important. Use your character’s abilities wisely, and come up with clever plans to outsmart your opponents.


Jump into the fun and show everyone what you’ve got! Can you defeat all the animals and take your place at the top? The battle is waiting—join in and play!

70010000088706.name: Trash Punk & Food Truck Tycoon Black Friday Pack
70010000088706.intro:
Jump into your food truck and business will bump up!
Rock the apocalypse in punk style!
70010000088706.description:
Get double the excitement and value with this Trash Punk bundle! Each game offers its own unique experience, and together, they provide hours of fun across different genres. 

This bundle includes:

1)Trash Punk: Dive into a post-apocalyptic world filled with danger, where you'll scavenge weapons and fight your way to survival in a wild, chaotic environment.

2)Food Truck Tycoon: Satisfy hungry customers and upgrade your food truck in this fun time-management game where every meal counts.

70010000088711.name: Trash Punk & Knights and Guns Black Friday Pack
70010000088711.intro:
Rock the apocalypse in punk style!
Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70010000088711.description:
Get double the excitement and value with this Trash Punk bundle! Each game offers its own unique experience, and together, they provide hours of fun across different genres. 

This bundle includes:

1)Trash Punk: Dive into a post-apocalyptic world filled with danger, where you'll scavenge weapons and fight your way to survival in a wild, chaotic environment.

2)Knights & Guns: Take on waves of enemies in this arcade-inspired shooter, combining medieval knights with powerful guns in an exciting hand crafted fantasy world.

70010000088721.name: Mounted Knights Battle : Medieval Warrior Honor Simulator
70010000088721.intro: In the world of knights, your courage is your greatest weapon.
70010000088721.description:
Experience the thrill of medieval chivalry in Mounted Knights Battle, where you'll embark on a captivating journey as a courageous knight vying for honor and romance. Craft your own legendary warrior, proudly wave your chosen flag, and fortify your armor, spear, and steed to triumph in prestigious tournaments held across a multitude of vibrant cities.

Key Features:
1. Create your unique knight, sculpted to your vision of valor.
2. Hoist your emblematic flag high, marking your presence on the battlefield.
3. Forge formidable armor, a stalwart defense against your adversaries' blows.
4. Acquire powerful spears, honed to pierce through the toughest of opponents.
5. Commandeer swift horses, ensuring unmatched agility in the heat of combat.
6. Engage in thrilling knightly tournaments, testing your mettle against the finest warriors.
7. Roam the land, attending diverse tournaments in bustling cities ripe with opportunity and challenge.

Prepare to immerse yourself in the grandeur of medieval life, where each decision shapes your destiny and every victory brings you closer to eternal renown. Are you ready to don your armor, hoist your lance, and ride into the fray? Mounted Knights Battle awaits, where destiny awaits those bold enough to seize it!

70010000088726.name: Heaven Impact
70010000088726.intro: Find your way to escape the vengeance of Heaven!
70010000088726.description: Heaven is not as safe a place as we have always been told. Angels aren't as kind as we expected. But there is a way to escape and go home. It's going to be a hard way! Not everyone will be able to do it, but you can do it! Don't look back and get to work as fast as you can. Remember that behind you is an Angel who needs your soul. Time's up.

70010000088729.name: Princess Rapunzel: The Kingdom's Legacy
70010000088729.intro: This novel follows Rapunzel, who, after restoring peace to her kingdom, discovers that her legacy holds even more secrets
70010000088729.description:
As she adjusts to her role as queen of the Forgotten Realm, a kingdom that has been hidden and shrouded in darkness for centuries, new threats emerge. A mysterious map guides her into uncharted territories, where ancient powers and dark forces intertwine.

Together with her faithful friends, Flynn, Maximus, and Pascal, Rapunzel must face new challenges, find an ancient artifact and save not only her kingdom, but also other nearby kingdoms that face a similar danger.

70010000088734.name: Rattle Royale
70010000088734.description:
Rattle your tails and get ready to do battle with your friends!

Up to 4 player can compete in an addictive and super fun snake battle!

Eat the dots to grow longer and longer, see how long you can get!

Enjoy a challenging 1 play level mode with many tricky turns and moving parts to stop you eating all the dots!

70010000088736.name: Fridge Escape
70010000088736.intro: Don't let anyone eat you. Run to save your life!
70010000088736.description:
Everyone wants to eat you! Open the refrigerator door and run away. Avoid obstacles so you don't lose speed. 
Jump over stools, slip under chairs and run onto tables.   
Remember that a very hungry person is running after you and you can't stop. 
Collect coins and choose fun skins for each new run. Make big jumps, take sharp turns and find shortcuts. The main thing is not to stop and run!

70010000088739.name: Rogue Flight
70010000088739.intro: A breathtaking arcade space combat game inspired by prestige anime.
70010000088739.description:
Rogue Flight is a breathtaking arcade space combat game inspired by the landmark style of 80's and 90's prestige anime. Traverse the Sol system and join a flight force voiced by a veteran cast, featuring Japanese talent from Sailor Moon, Neon Genesis Evangelion, Gundam, Naruto & One Piece, and English voice talent featured in Overwatch and Fallout 76, League of Legends and Marvel's Avengers. Jump into true stylish arcade action with a huge host of spacecraft upgrades, game modes and multiple narrative paths.

It's been 3 years since the world burned. It was ARGUS; the interstellar watchman system given control of the Solar Defense Force.

In a secret facility deep beneath the surface of the Earth, the last vestiges of humanity prepare to launch a daring counterattack.

Take control of an advanced light space fighter and face hordes of enemies in a last-ditch effort to destroy ARGUS and restore peace to the Sol system.

>> Featuring a retro 80's-90's analogue-video art style inspired by the golden age of prestige anime.
>> Stylish high-speed arcade action set across 9 unique stages spanning the Sol system.
>> Utilize incredible aerial acrobatic manoeuvres coupled with a dizzying array of weapon types.
>> Experience a branching narrative path with multiple endings.
>> Choose from standard arcade and unlockable roguelite game modes which offer greater risks and even greater rewards.
>> Personalize your aircraft from over 100 unlockable liveries, as well as 24 badges with multiple color and style combinations.
>> Customize your loadout from over 40 unlockable aero designs and 40 unlockable weapons from multiple classes with upgradable attributes.
>> Featuring an original soundtrack featuring renowned video game sound design duo Fat Bard, additional music by Rinn, and an original opening theme with stunning vocals by J-Pop artist Itoki Hana.
>> Fully voiced in English and Japanese by veteran casts, including English talent from Fallout 76, Overwatch, League of Legends & Marvel’s Avengers, and Japanese talent from Neon Genesis Evangelion, Gundam, Sailor Moon, Naruto & One Piece.
>> Unlockable extras, accolades and more.
>> Multiple difficulty levels for every player skill.

70010000088753.name: Trident's Tale
70010000088753.intro: Dive Into a World of Pirates, Magic, and Epic Battles – Let’s Go!
70010000088753.description:
Set sail for an epic action-packed adventure in Trident’s Tale, where you’ll become Ocean, a bold young captain on a quest to reclaim the legendary Storm Trident—a mythical artifact that grants power over the seas. But beware the ocean is vast, treacherous, and crawling with danger at every turn! So ready the cannons, hoist the sails, and immerse yourself in a gripping tale filled with eccentric characters, cunning dungeons, and adrenaline-pumping battles. You will need to master your magic and embrace your swashbuckling spirit to become the ruler of the seas!

Command Your Ship, Rule the Seas: Take the helm in dynamic naval battles, where every cannon shot and maneuver counts. Upgrade and customise your ship to suit your playstyle, and engage in epic cannon duels against rival pirates, sea monsters, and more!
Explore a Vast, Living World: Discover a sprawling ocean filled with diverse islands, each with its own secrets, treasures, and challenges. Uncover hidden dungeons, solve cunning riddles, and loot rare treasures to power up your crew.
Build Your Legendary Pirate Crew: Recruit a colorful cast of characters, each with unique abilities, and personalities. Level up your crew, unlock powerful skills, and create the ultimate pirate team.
Fight for survival: Use your blade, magic, and firearms in exhilarating land combat, complete with special abilities and thrilling boss encounters.

Ready to Claim Your Place in Pirate History?

70010000088758.name: Formula Legends
70010000088758.intro: From the golden age to today, race through time in Formula Legends. Master legendary cars, reimagined circuits, and the pursuit of glory in this love letter to Formula racing.
70010000088758.description:
A love letter to Formula racing, Formula Legends takes you on a journey through the sport’s most iconic eras. From the roaring machines of the ‘60s to the cutting-edge technology of today, experience the evolution of open-wheel racing in a beautifully stylized world.
Drive Through Time - Slide into the cockpit of legendary cars spanning decades of motorsport history. 16 unique models, each with 7 liveries, bring 112 vehicles to life.
Iconic Circuits, Reimagined - Race across 14 circuits inspired by historic racing locations, each evolving through the years. From sun-soaked yacht docks to sweeping elevations, these tracks blend nostalgia with a fresh twist.
Master the Elements - Rain-soaked asphalt, strategic pit stops, and changing eras demand more than just speed. Fine-tune your racecraft, from battery management to slipstreaming, and chase the perfect lap.
Legends Behind the Wheel - Every era has its heroes. Fictional drivers, inspired by real-life icons, come with custom helmets and skill perks: tire whisperers, wet-weather masters, and pit-stop strategists. Their strengths might just be the key to victory.
A Journey Through Racing History - Story Mode invites you to relive the defining moments of Formula racing. Compete in era-based championships, master legendary cars, and carve your name into history.

70010000088763.name: RollerCoaster Tycoon® Classic
70010000088763.intro: Create incredible parks in the original rollercoaster sim from Chris Sawyer.
70010000088763.description:
RollerCoaster Tycoon® Classic™ is a new RCT experience, remastered in 2017 by franchise creator Chris Sawyer to combine the best features from two of the most successful and beloved RCT games in the series’ history – RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2. Roller Coaster Tycoon Classic also comes complete with the Toolkit, Wacky Worlds, and Time Twister expansion packs!  Create and run amazing parks filled with the most outrageous rides imaginable.  RCT Classic includes a mixture of authentic playability, depth of gameplay and unique graphical style of Chris Sawyer’s original best-selling RollerCoaster Tycoon® Games. Packed with content, players can enjoy designing and building roller coasters and rides, landscaping parks and managing the staff and finances to keep their guests happy and the money flowing in. Can you become the next RollerCoaster Tycoon?

Key Features:

The Original RollerCoaster Sim: Experience all the fun from the original RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2 games, with a new sim that combines the best elements of both classic titles.

Coaster Construction: Create incredible roller coasters – Quickly build a pre-made design or use the intuitive piece-by-piece building tools to design and theme your own unique rides.

Park Designer: Keep your guests happy by building gentle or wild rides, food and drink stalls, water rides, and even transport rides to take them around the park; Customize your park by building scenery, fine-tuning the landscape, and routing the footpaths.

Park Management: Run your park’s marketing and finances to make a profit while attracting more guests; Organize your staff to keep the park running well and looking its best.

Exciting Environments: Build the ultimate theme park in a variety of challenging environments, from the tranquility of Forest Frontiers to the bustling commerce of Megaworld Park.

Park Scenarios: Progress through 95 classic park scenarios from RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2.

Authentic Gameplay: Classic-style isometric graphics and original amusement park music and sound effects.

Packed with Content: Includes hundreds of types of roller coasters and rides, and dozens of different shops, stalls, and facilities.

70010000088768.name: Om Nom: Run 2
70010000088768.intro: Ready, set, dash! Join the omtastic Om Nom Run 2 challenge and prove you’re the speedster champion.
70010000088768.description:
Om Nom: Run 2 is the exciting sequel to the popular arcade action game, where your main goals are simple: run, avoid obstacles, and race to the finish line!

How to Om Nom run:
• Race through exciting locations - dash through thrilling and challenging maps full of traps and setbacks that will test your skills to the limit!
• Avoid and dodge obstacles - navigate through the course with lightning speed, skillfully avoiding and dodging obstacles that stand between you and victory. Show off your reflexes and maneuver your way to success!
• Be the first to complete the race - feel the adrenaline rush as you outpace your opponents and emerge victorious. It’s not just a race; it’s a quest for glory!
• Find the fastest routes to victory - strategize and discover the fastest routes to secure your place at the top. Unleash your inner speed demon and leave your competition in the dust!

Have you got what it takes to dodge all the obstacles and outpace the competition? Time to find out!

70010000088770.name: Vampire Waifu Puzzles
70010000088770.intro: Create stunning anime vampire waifu art through puzzles!
70010000088770.description:
Vampire Waifu Puzzle invites you to piece together stunning anime vampire waifus in this thrilling jigsaw puzzle game!

Select from 6 different puzzle sizes and immerse yourself in a collection of beautifully illustrated anime vampire characters. Whether you’re a casual puzzler or a seasoned pro, there’s a challenge waiting for you.

70010000088772.name: Dark Passion - Anime Match Puzzles
70010000088772.intro: Discover Dark Passion - Anime Match Puzzles! Match tiles to reveal stunning anime art and immerse yourself in mystery.
70010000088772.description:
Enter the captivating world of Dark Passion - Anime Match Puzzles! This thrilling game combines the challenge of tile matching with the beauty of anime-inspired artwork.

Match tiles to unveil breathtaking images and immerse yourself in a dark yet enchanting atmosphere. With multiple levels, adjustable difficulties, and mesmerizing visuals, the game offers an experience perfect for both casual players and puzzle enthusiasts.
Discover the passion, embrace the mystery, and let the stunning anime art guide your journey!

70010000088774.name: Mystic Beauty - Anime Shift Puzzles
70010000088774.intro: Explore the charm of Mystic Beauty - Anime Shift Puzzles! Shift pieces to reveal stunning anime art in a relaxing and captivating puzzle experience.
70010000088774.description:
Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Mystic Beauty - Anime Shift Puzzles! This unique puzzle game combines the joy of problem-solving with the charm of beautifully crafted anime-inspired artwork. Shift pieces across the board to complete stunning illustrations, each telling its own story of elegance and creativity.

With a wide variety of levels and puzzles, ranging from simple challenges to complex masterpieces, the game offers something for everyone. Adjustable difficulty settings ensure that both beginners and seasoned puzzle enthusiasts can find the perfect balance of relaxation and challenge.

The serene atmosphere, paired with captivating visuals and gentle music, creates an immersive experience perfect for unwinding after a busy day. Whether playing for fun or testing your skills, Mystic Beauty - Anime Shift Puzzles promises hours of engaging gameplay.

Discover the magic in every completed puzzle, explore vibrant anime art styles, and embark on a journey through a world where beauty and strategy unite. Let the challenge of shifting pieces bring you closer to uncovering the breathtaking stories hidden within each puzzle!

70010000088778.name: Beautiful Anime Puzzles - Rainy Days
70010000088778.intro: Relax and solve beautiful anime puzzles in Beautiful Anime Puzzles – Rainy Days, where rainy day vibes meet stunning art!
70010000088778.description:
Step into a peaceful, rainy world with Beautiful Anime Puzzles – Rainy Days! This calming puzzle game invites players to solve gorgeous anime-inspired images while immersing themselves in the serene atmosphere of a rainy day. Every puzzle provides a relaxing escape, as the soothing rain and tranquil ambiance create the perfect environment to unwind.

With a wide selection of puzzles ranging from simple to more complex, Beautiful Anime Puzzles – Rainy Days offers an engaging challenge for puzzle lovers of all skill levels. The adjustable difficulty settings ensure that whether you're a beginner or an experienced puzzler, the game provides just the right amount of challenge. As each puzzle piece clicks into place, you reveal stunning, anime-inspired artwork that ranges from soft pastel illustrations to dramatic, intricately detailed scenes.

The game is designed to provide more than just a puzzle-solving experience; it’s a journey into a world of beauty and calm. The relaxing background music, coupled with the sound of gentle rain, creates a peaceful atmosphere that allows players to escape into a world of anime art and reflection. As each puzzle is completed, a sense of accomplishment and satisfaction washes over, making every solved image a reward for both the mind and soul.

Whether you're looking for a moment of tranquility during a busy day, or seeking a mental challenge to engage your mind, Beautiful Anime Puzzles – Rainy Days offers something for everyone. Immerse yourself in stunning art, embrace the calming effect of rainy day vibes, and enjoy hours of puzzle-solving fun that lets you unwind and reconnect with the peaceful side of life. Each puzzle you complete brings you closer to a world of serenity and beauty, offering a peaceful retreat anytime you need a break from the world.

70010000088780.name: Wet Whispers - Anime Shift Puzzles
70010000088780.intro: Solve captivating anime puzzles with Wet Whispers – Anime Shift Puzzles, where every piece unlocks beautiful, moody art!
70010000088780.description:
Step into a world of mystery, beauty, and emotion with Wet Whispers – Anime Shift Puzzles! This immersive and atmospheric puzzle game invites players to piece together stunning, anime-inspired artworks, each brimming with intricate details and evocative themes. As each puzzle piece falls into place, a captivating image is revealed, creating a sense of accomplishment and wonder.

Set in a world where whispers of the rain and soft, melancholic tones fill the atmosphere, Wet Whispers offers more than just a traditional puzzle experience. The game’s soothing ambiance, combined with beautiful anime art, immerses players in a deeply emotional journey. Every puzzle solved unveils artwork that tells its own story—whether it’s a calm, serene scene or a dark, mysterious moment, each piece you fit together pulls you deeper into its narrative.

The game features a wide range of beautifully crafted anime illustrations, each designed to challenge the mind and engage the player with varying levels of complexity. From simple puzzles for a relaxing experience to intricate ones that push puzzle-solving skills to the limit, Wet Whispers ensures there's something for every type of player. Players can adjust difficulty settings to match their skill level, allowing the game to be enjoyed by both casual gamers and seasoned puzzle enthusiasts.

The blend of atmospheric sounds, including the subtle backdrop of raindrops, adds to the immersive experience, making Wet Whispers not only a game but a sensory escape. As each puzzle unfolds, the sense of accomplishment is accompanied by the satisfaction of uncovering beautiful artwork that was hidden beneath the scattered pieces.

Whether seeking relaxation after a long day or desiring a mental challenge to test puzzle-solving abilities, Wet Whispers – Anime Shift Puzzles provides a soothing yet engaging experience that leaves players captivated. Each puzzle tells a unique story, and with every piece that fits, the beauty of the anime art grows clearer. The game’s combination of serene art, captivating themes, and tranquil atmosphere offers a perfect escape into a world where every shift of the pieces brings players closer to unlocking the secrets of the art and its emotional depth.

Perfect for those who appreciate the calming effects of puzzles, Wet Whispers invites players to explore a mesmerizing collection of artwork, solve challenges, and enjoy a peaceful yet intriguing experience. Dive into the world of Wet Whispers—where every puzzle piece is a whisper of beauty waiting to be revealed.

70010000088782.name: Hentai Waifu 2
70010000088782.intro: A puzzle with charming girls drawn in anime style!
70010000088782.description:
Get ready to meet charming girls posing in seductive and stylish outfits that emphasize their unique appeal! Every detail in the game is carefully designed so that you can feel the realism of assembling a real puzzle. With each new level, you will see more and more candid and intriguing images. Relax and enjoy every step on the way to completing the masterpiece!

Features:
• Delightful girls in daring and sophisticated outfits
• Fascinating and simple gameplay that captivates you from the first minutes
• The ability to study each image in detail after assembly
• Different puzzle difficulty
• Atmospheric music
• More than 40 puzzles

70010000088789.name: Destino Indomable
70010000088789.intro: Step into the drama and stardom of Destino Indomable!
70010000088789.description:
Lights, camera, action! In Destino Indomable, you're the rising star cast as the lead in a telenovela! Dive into a wild visual novel inspired by the most dramatic Latin soap operas, complete with humor, drama, romance, and more! Customize your character and play through 5 thrilling episodes where your choices impact the story, your relationships, and the show's ratings. Discover gossip, unravel mysteries, and captivate the audience with an unforgettable performance!

Features:

- A telenovela-themed visual novel that brings Latin drama to life.
- Character popularity system that changes screen time based on your choices.
- Customizable lead actress with clothes, hairstyles, and accessories.
- Five romance paths with unique storylines and mysteries.
- Multiple endings, with heroes becoming villains, and wild plot twists.
- Over 15 hours of story, packed with secrets to uncover on each playthrough!

70010000088795.name: Santa's Christmas Adventure
70010000088795.intro: Santa's Christmas Adventure – Collect the gifts, defeat the enemies, and save Christmas in a festive, toon-filled world!
70010000088795.description: Santa's Christmas Adventure is a charming 3D platformer where you step into the boots of Santa as he embarks on a festive journey to collect gifts scattered across enchanting levels. Smash enemies with powerful dash attacks or mid-air strikes, and use balloons to float gently down from great heights. Santa can also swim, adding a layer of exploration to watery areas. Set in a beautifully atmospheric toon world, this game brings holiday magic to life with vibrant visuals and joyful gameplay, perfect for players of all ages looking for a festive adventure!

70010000088800.name: Hentai Girls: Pretty Christmas
70010000088800.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000088800.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000088802.name: FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles
70010000088802.intro: The groundbreaking tactical RPG makes its long-awaited return.
70010000088802.description:
*This product can be upgraded to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version after purchase at no additional cost.
To upgrade, download the upgrade pack available from the Nintendo eShop onto your Nintendo Switch 2.

- Story
Ivalice—a kingdom blessed by the light of the gods and ruled by the Two-headed Lion. A year after her defeat to Ordallia in the Fifty Years' War, the king succumbed to malady, leaving a mere boy of two to ascend the throne.

Whoever was named regent would rule in truth, and thus emerged two rival candidates: dukes Goltanna and Larg, whose deeds during the war had earned them great renown. Goltanna the Black Lion and Larg the White Lion were destined to clash, and the resulting conflict would come to be known as the War of the Lions.

Against this backdrop appear Ramza, third son of House Beoulve, one of Ivalice's leading military families, and his childhood companion Delita, a commoner raised amongst nobles. As they endeavor to chart a course through this tumultuous age, a mighty current draws them ever closer to the abyss.

- Combat
Lead your party in exhilarating encounters where strategic positioning and forward planning determine the outcome. Use the varied terrain of 3D battlefields to your advantage, skillfully manipulate the turn order, and victory will be yours for the taking.

- Character Growth and Customization
Combine a wide variety of jobs and abilities to craft your very own strategies.

As your party members grow, they will gain access to more jobs, each with its own unique abilities. Once learned, abilities can be used even after changing to another job. With over 20 jobs to master—including white mage, black mage, dragoon, and many others from the FINAL FANTASY series—and hundreds of abilities to learn, you have the freedom to experiment and discover the combinations that best suit your party. Chocobos and other creatures can also be tamed and led into battle.

- Two Versions: Enhanced and Classic
With improved graphics, fully voiced dialogue, and refined gameplay, the enhanced version provides the perfect way to immerse yourself in the world of Ivalice. Along with the fine-tuning of several features and battle mechanics, the inclusion of the more accessible "Squire" difficulty setting makes the enhanced version an excellent starting point for first-time players.

The classic version unites the graphics and gameplay of the original 1997 version with the renowned War of the Lions translation for a unique way to experience this beloved title.

70010000088805.name: Star Trek: Legends
70010000088805.intro: Captain - The fate of the universe is in your hands!
70010000088805.description:
Step into the role of your favorite heroes and villains from across the history of Star Trek and embark on an epic space adventure to control the mysterious Nexus. Battle to save all of existence in Star Trek’s official strategy-based RPG! 

PREPARE FOR ADVENTURE 
Dive into the action with characters spanning the entire Star Trek universe! Take command of the U.S.S. Artemis and recruit a team of legendary Star Trek characters as you embark on daring missions, experience epic turn-based combat, and make choices that influence the game’s entire story. 

ASSEMBLE YOUR TEAM
Ever wanted to master Spock’s Vulcan nerve pinch or battle with Worf’s deadly bat’leth? Now is your chance! Recruit and command over 70 iconic characters from the Star Trek universe including Kirk, Spock, Picard, Janeway, Data, Burnham, Pike, and many more! Send your Star Trek team on critical missions that will test your crew’s skills and ingenuity. Earn special rewards by completing collections of characters based on the Star Trek shows they appeared in or the traits they possess. Plus, you can earn combat bonuses by using multiple Star Trek characters from the same collection in battle. 

TAKE COMMAND OF THE U.S.S. ARTEMIS
Captain the U.S.S. Artemis and shape the fate of the cosmos! Choose your crew strategically. Each Star Trek character has their own specific skills and abilities to help you outwit, overpower and overcome your enemies. Every decision you make could be the difference between triumph and defeat. Take command, Captain – the galaxy awaits your leadership!

NAVIGATE AN IMMERSIVE UNIVERSE
Dive into the exquisitely crafted 3D world of Star Trek Legends! Explore beautifully rendered 3D worlds and interact with fully realized animated characters in this epic Star Trek RPG. 

Get ready to boldly go where no one has gone before in Star Trek: Legends. Your interstellar adventure awaits!

70010000088809.name: Sleeping Beauty: The Kingdom of Lost Dreams
70010000088809.intro: Queen Aurora has known many years of peace in her kingdom, but everything has to change when strange nightmares affect the inhabitants of the place.
70010000088809.description:
People fall into deep sleeps from which they cannot wake up, and Aurora soon finds herself involved in a new adventure to save her people.

Together with her faithful friends, the fairies Flora, Fauna and Merryweather, and with the help of Felipe, Aurora discovers the existence of a hidden kingdom: The Kingdom of Lost Dreams, a mysterious and dangerous place where an ancient curse has unleashed chaos.

As they delve deeper into this dreamlike realm, Aurora will face challenges that will test her courage and her ability to overcome her own fears.

70010000088811.name: Block Jam
70010000088811.intro: Plan, match, and clear the board in Block Jam, where every move counts and every block needs the perfect match!
70010000088811.description:
Match three blocks of the same color to clear levels and build amazing structures for your blocks. Sounds easy? Think again! – you only have so much room on your bench, and if you overfill it, it's game over!

Every level gives you new challenges to solve, but don't worry – you have power-ups to help! Undo a move, reshuffle blocks, or add extra bench space when you're in a tough spot. Earn coins along the way to customize your blocks and make your diorama totally unique!

For an extra challenge, try "Bus Mode" – the classic Block Jam experience with a colorful twist! Match blocks to fill color-coded buses and watch them roll out. Complete all buses in a level, and you'll earn even more power-ups and coins to help you on your journey!

Features:
- Match and Win: Match three blocks of the same color to clear levels and avoid overfilling your bench.
- Limited Bench: Use your bench wisely – a full bench means game over!
- Bus Mode: Fill color-matched buses to clear levels and earn extra power-ups and coins!
- Fun Power-Ups: Use undo, magnet, reshuffle, or expand your bench to escape tricky situations.
- Build Your Diorama: Collect bricks to create unique structures in your very own block-populated diorama.
- Customize Your Blocks: Use coins earned in-game to give your diorama blocks unique and fun looks.

Jump into Block Jam – where every move is a step closer to clearing the board, personalizing your world, and mastering each challenge!

70010000088813.name: Bloons TD 6
70010000088813.description:
Craft your perfect defense from a combination of powerful Monkey Towers and awesome Heroes, then pop every last invading Bloon!

Over a decade of tower defense pedigree and regular massive updates makes Bloons TD 6 a favorite game for millions of players. Enjoy endless hours of strategy gaming with Bloons TD 6!

HUGE CONTENT!
* Regular updates! We release several updates every year with new characters, features, and gameplay.
* Boss Events! Fearsome Boss Bloons will challenge even the strongest defenses.
* Odysseys! Battle through a series of maps connected by their theme, rules, and rewards.
* Contested Territory! Join forces with other players and battle for territory against five other teams. Capture tiles on a shared map and compete on the leaderboards.
* Quests! Delve into what makes the Monkeys tick with Quests, crafted to tell tales and share knowledge.
* Trophy Store! Earn Trophies to unlock dozens of cosmetic items that let you customize your Monkeys, Bloons, animations, music, and more.
* Content Browser! Create your own Challenges and Odysseys, then share them with other players and check out the most liked and played community content.

EPIC MONKEY TOWERS & HEROES!
* 25 powerful Monkey Towers, each with 3 upgrade paths and unique activated abilities.
* Paragons! Explore the incredible power of the newest Paragon upgrades.
* 17 diverse Heroes, with 20 signature upgrades and 2 special abilities. Plus, unlockable skins and voiceovers!

ENDLESS AWESOMENESS!
* 4-Player Co-Op! Play every map and mode with up to 3 other players in public or private games.
* Play anywhere - single player offline works even when your WiFi doesn’t!
* 70+ handcrafted maps, with more added every update.
* Monkey Knowledge! Over 100 meta-upgrades to add power where you need it.
* Powers and Insta Monkeys! Earned through gameplay, events, and achievements. Instantly add power for tricky maps and modes.

We pack as much content and polish into each update as possible, and we’ll continue to add new features, content, and challenges in regular updates.

Now those Bloons aren't going to pop themselves... sharpen your darts and go play Bloons TD 6!

70010000088815.name: Accolade Sports Collection (QUByte Classics)
70010000088815.intro: Relive retro sports glory! Five classic games. One epic collection!
70010000088815.description:
Step back into the golden age of sports gaming with the Accolade Sports Collection! Featuring five legendary titles—Hardball!, Hardball II, Hoops Shut Up and Jam!, Winter Challenge, and Summer Challenge—this collection delivers nostalgic thrills with modern enhancements. 

Compete in everything from baseball to basketball, winter to summer sports, all with original gameplay preserved. 

Choose your favorite, enjoy local multiplayer, save your progress, and master the retro vibes. Whether you're a veteran player or new to retro gaming, it’s time to prove your skills and make history!

70010000088820.name: Football Stars: Head Ball Soccer Co-op Battle
70010000088820.intro:
Team up with friends for epic co-op battles.
Jump, kick, and unleash special moves.
Score big and become the ultimate champion!
70010000088820.description:
Get ready for the ultimate soccer showdown!
Step onto the field and experience the thrill of intense soccer battles!
In solo mode, take on a fierce rival AI in action-packed matches, or challenge your friend in exciting 1v1 local multiplayer. Use your skills to jump, kick, and unleash powerful special moves to outplay your opponent and score goals.

Choose your favorite character and dive into tournaments where every match brings new challenges. Compete for glory, climb the ranks, and prove you’re the ultimate soccer star.

With simple controls, fast-paced gameplay, and nonstop excitement, this game is perfect for casual players and die-hard soccer fans alike. Are you ready to rule the pitch?

70010000088825.name: EGGCONSOLE RIGLAS PC-8801
70010000088825.intro: Seeking the secret of Beljuna, May Osborn set out from the village. What he saw, guided by the crystal, was..
70010000088825.description:
Released by Random House in 1985 in Japan, Riglas is a side-view RPG. Players take on the role of a young Osborne tribe boy named May, as he unravels the secrets of Beljuna.

While the game system involves moving with directional buttons and attacking with the A button, making it seem like a standard action RPG at first glance, the importance of key items related to conversations and the scenario gives the game a strong adventure game flavor.

Noteworthy features for its time include side-view graphics with a sense of depth, beautiful scrolling, a grand world setting, and NPCs who don't repeat the same dialogue—earning the game high praise.

This title is a culmination of the creator's techniques. It's a must-play for retro RPG fans.


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000088828.name: EGGCONSOLE Dragon Slayer: The Legend of Heroes II PC-8801mkIISR
70010000088828.intro: An RPG set in a world 20 years after the previous installment. Take on the role of Prince Atlas and confront a new darkness threatening the peace of Eselhasa. Crush
70010000088828.description:
This title is a role-playing game released in 1992. Set 20 years after the events of its predecessor, Dragon Slayer: The Legend of Heroes, players take on the role of Prince Atlas, embarking on an adventure in Eselhasa following a massive earthquake.

The game retains the top-view movement scenes and command-selection battle system from the previous game. While preserving familiar functions and aesthetics, new features such as a revamped magic system and enhanced enemy graphics have been added, making the game even more engaging.

Though 20 years have passed within the storyline, the geography of Iseruhasa remains mostly unchanged. One of the game’s charms lies in the appearances of beloved characters like Runnan, Sonia, Row, Aron, and Gail I, whose stories continue as players journey across the land. Observing the differences in Eselhasa from the perspectives of Celios in the previous game and Atlas in this one adds an interesting layer to the experience.

The Legend of Heroes I and II are known as the Eselhasa series. For those who haven’t yet played these titles, this is a great chance to experience both games. This series is a showcase of the essence of Japanese RPGs, packed with charm. RPG fans, be sure to give it a try!


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000088832.name: Xenoblade Chronicles™ X: Definitive Edition
70010000088832.intro: Rebuild humanity on the mysterious planet Mira in this action RPG
70010000088832.description:
The year is 2054. Earth has been destroyed by an intergalactic war between two alien races, and humanity is on the brink of annihilation. A small number of survivors, aboard the USS White Whale, crash land on the vast and untamed planet Mira—and now it falls to you, as a member of BLADE, to help bring humanity back from the edge of extinction…with the aid of powerful giant robots called Skells!

The visually enhanced edition of this open-world RPG contains newly added story elements and more.

The Xenoblade Chronicles™ X: Definitive Edition game is coming to the Nintendo Switch™ system on March 20, 2025!

Take on tough foes in a robust combat system, and pilot powerful giant robots called Skells

Choose from a huge variety of special attacks, skills, and classes in a combat system that’s as deep as you want it to be. Once you’ve proven yourself to BLADE, you’ll earn the right to pilot and personalize your very own Skell—a powerful machine that can fly, transform into a vehicle for fast overland travel, and wield immense strength in combat with customizable weapons and armor.

Gather resources and take on missions to build the community of New Los Angeles

As you go about the reconstruction effort, getting to know the people of New Los Angeles (NLA), you’ll build affinity with your party members and unlock quests for gear and other rewards. Join your choice of military organization within BLADE to take on even more missions—or even team up with up to 32 players from near and far online* in Squad Tasks, Online Missions, and extra-challenging Global Nemesis Battles!

70010000088836.name: Pro Wrestler Story
70010000088836.intro: Pro Wrestling Team Management Sim, Face off with fearsome foes!
70010000088836.description:
Take control of your very own pro wrestling team, building up your members to seize the title of undisputed industry best! Diet, training, even the occasional R&R—every facet counts when you're going for gold!

With your own team comes your own gym. Furnish it with a bench press, heavy bag, and other equipment of your choice, as you'll need your wrestlers in tip-top condition come fight day. On that note, a colorful host of wrestling rivals await your challenge. Prep sufficiently and you just might get your hand raised! So fight hard, fight well, but also—fight with style!
...And crack some crass quips at the pre-fight press conference too!

As for the in-ring action, weather thrilling exchanges amidst cheers from a capacity crowd, sinking a finisher at the right moment to nab the three-count!

The more popularity your team amasses, the more visitors will flock to your gym—and the more merch you'll ultimately move. You can even erect an arcade, karaoke room, batting cage and much, much more for some welcome added revenue!

Lastly, any team worth its salt needs more than a few members. Should a particularly talented wrestler catch your eye, see if you can't bring him or her onboard! This will grant you access to a whole new world of 2v2 and 3v3 tag matches—meaning more tussling territory for you to terrorize!

Well? What are you waiting for? Mask up and get in the ring! This is the business of bash, brother!

70010000088843.name: Pick My Heart Chapter 1
70010000088843.intro: Fall in love… with a goddess? Uncover their secrets and follow your heart!
70010000088843.description:
The Adventure Begins
Pick My Heart Chapter 1 is the first part of a captivating series that blends romance and mystery. You and your best friend Yuina have won a dream trip to a tropical island—and you’re also judging a beauty contest! Meet the charming contestants: artistic Eimiko, elegant Haru, confident Tomoe, and playful Aimi. 


What’s the Mystery?
Something doesn’t add up. Why did you win the contest? And what’s behind your memory loss? Each girl has her secrets—will you uncover them?


Your Choices, Your Story
Spend time with the contestants, explore the island, and make decisions that shape the outcome. But remember—only one girl can win the golden apple… and your heart. 


Features: 
- The first chapter of an exciting series 
- 5 unique endings to discover 
- A stunning tropical island setting 
- Choices that impact the story and characters’ reactions 
- Begin your journey and find love in Pick My Heart Chapter 1!

70010000088848.name: Pick My Heart Chapter 2
70010000088848.intro: Pick My Heart: Chapter 2 continues the romantic adventures of Sota and his encounters with goddesses and mortal friends.
70010000088848.description:
Heartfelt Connections
Pick My Heart: Chapter 2 continues the romantic adventures of Sota and his encounters with goddesses and mortal friends. This anime-inspired visual novel unfolds in a vibrant modern world where myth and reality blend, leading to humorous, heartfelt, and sometimes challenging moments.


Moments of Magic
In Chapter 2, Sota deepens his bonds with various characters, each carrying unique secrets and personalities. Whether it's Aphrodite, Hera, Athena, or Eris, Sota finds himself navigating through surprises, emotional revelations, and intense encounters that test his loyalty and affection.


Trials of Affection
Each goddess brings a new perspective to Sota’s life. Whether meeting at a cozy karaoke club or exploring a quiet, romantic setting, Sota’s choices shape his journey, and each encounter brings him closer to understanding the complexities of love.


Key Features:
- A modern love story with a touch of mythology
- Choices that matter and shape the story
- Four beautiful Greek goddesses, each with their own story and mystery
- A vibrant blend of modern life and ancient myth as gods and mortals co-exist
- Many unique locations and events, such as a date at a karaoke club
- The complex divine-earthly trials of love

70010000088853.name: MotoGP™25
70010000088853.description:
Get ready to take part in MotoGP™25!

FEEL EVERY DETAIL OF THE 2025 SEASON
Join the official Championship and step into the boots of your favorite riders to master the most iconic bikes and tracks of the season. Live the most realistic race thrills ever thanks to Unreal Engine 5, MotoGP™ Stewards ensuring fair battles, and an overhauled sound design, recorded on-site from official bikes.

FORGE YOUR RACING LEGACY
Your path to becoming a MotoGP™ Legend starts here! Deep dive into your bike's evolution, choose your own career Turning Points during the season and develop social relationships off track, then watch how these choices evolve over the weekend. Master the Riders Market dynamics to make your journey always unique.

MASTER YOUR CRAFT
Train like a champion with the new Race Off disciplines available in Career and Quick Modes. Ride Motard, Flat Track and Minibikes bikes on 4 dedicated tracks across 2 original environments. Take on exciting challenges, boost your rider's fitness, unlock accessories and sharpen your skills to dominate the track!

RACE YOUR OWN WAY
Maximum playability or full-sim challenge? Jump right into the action with the new Arcade Experience for immediate adrenaline-pumping fun. Or master every detail of the track, fuel consumption, and electronics in the Pro Experience, for an authentic MotoGP™ realism!
Take full control of your bike with an improved Adaptive Difficulty Mode, Neural Aid System and new Tutorial.

70010000088863.name: Dora™: Rainforest Rescue
70010000088863.intro: Stop Swiper, fix the Duplicator and rescue the Rainforest with Dora and friends.
70010000088863.description:
Oh no! Swiper got his paws on the Super-Duper Duplicator, and now his clones are causing chaos everywhere. Dora and Boots must fix the Duplicator and restore the vibrant Alebrije Tree.

Join them and their amigos, Tico, Isa, Benny, Big Red Chicken, and Ale. Run, jump, and swing through five locations, collecting Magic Leaves and pods. Unlock new places and objects. Solve riddles, use clues from friends, and use Map to guide you! Qué Aventura! Stop Swiper from swiping while playing solo or team-up in local co-op mode.

Ready for an interactive adventure with Dora?

!Vámonos! Let’s go!

JOIN YOUR AMIGOS: Play as Dora and Boots in solo or local co-op mode in an interactive adventure.

SAVE THE ALEBRIJE TREE: Search for the lost leaves and pods and return the magic.

EXPLORE THE RAINFOREST: Jump, run, bounce, and swing through five locations.

WORK, LAUGH & DANCE: Complete challenges with Ale, Tico, Isa, Benny, and Big Red Chicken.

DISCOVER, COLLECT & EARN: Follow secret paths to unlock new 
areas and skills, collect items and earn crystals.

STOP SWIPER FROM SWIPING: Find Swiper’s pesky clones and stop them from causing chaos all over the Rainforest.

70010000088865.name: Magical Christmas Tales: Ten Stories to Warm the Heart
70010000088865.intro: Experience the magic of Christmas with 10 enchanting tales that celebrate love, kindness, and joy. Bring home this heartwarming collection today!
70010000088865.description:
Celebrate the magic of Christmas with this charming collection of 10 stories that capture the true spirit of the season! Each tale, accompanied by beautiful images, will transport you to a world where generosity, friendship, and hope shine brightly.

In this collection, each story is designed to convey fundamental values that lie at the heart of the Christmas celebration. Through captivating narratives, we are reminded that Christmas is a special time to share, love, and create unforgettable memories with our loved ones. You will find stories that highlight the importance of family unity, the power of dreams, the magic of giving and receiving, and how a single act of kindness can have a lasting impact on others’ lives.

Each story, in addition to entertaining, will inspire you and foster the spirit of Christmas, teaching little ones valuable lessons about gratitude, solidarity, and love. With endearing characters and engaging plots, readers will be immersed in tales that resonate with the authentic meaning of Christmas.

With each page, relive the essence of this special season and let its message resonate in your heart. Allow the joy of Christmas to fill your home, turning each story into an opportunity to reflect on the values that unite us. Dive into this holiday experience and share the magic with those you love!

70010000088869.name: Car Mechanic Shop Simulator
70010000088869.description:
Car Mechanic Shop Simulator is a simulation game that offers a comprehensive, in-depth experience combining strategic business management with the technical nuances of car maintenance, making it a must download for enthusiasts and novices alike.

Build your auto parts kingdom:
Start your journey with a modest store and strategically grow it to become a leading destination for auto parts and accessories. Car Mechanic Shop Simulator lets you deal with everyday items such as oil filters, tires and brake pads, as well as high-performance components such as V8 OHV engine parts, advanced suspension systems and sophisticated electronics. Your decisions not only shape the operational aspect of your business, but also affect its financial health and reputation in the marketplace.

Master inventory management:
Develop your inventory management skills by handling a wide range of automotive parts, including alternators, clutch kits, radiators, exhaust systems and advanced electronic systems essential to modern vehicles. Learn to master the art of inventory control, optimize pricing strategies and respond to market demand. Watch your auto repair shop become a local industry leader known for efficiency and reliability.

Customize and grow your store:
As your business grows, you'll be tasked with expanding the physical space of your store to accommodate your growing inventory and expand the range of services you offer, from routine maintenance to specialized repairs and custom modifications.

Unlock new automotive parts and technologies:
Earn licenses to sell and install advanced parts that meet the diverse needs of car enthusiasts and professional repair shops. This feature ensures that your store stays at the forefront of innovation, offering the latest innovations in automotive technology, from hybrid engine components to autonomous vehicle systems.

Ensure customer satisfaction:
Excellent customer service is key to building a solid customer base that relies on your store for all their automotive needs, from simple oil changes to complex engine rebuilds.

70010000088871.name: Neko Bento
70010000088871.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70010000088871.description:
Bored with the food you take to work every day? Do you wish it was more… meowtastic?


Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.


To prepare you to pack as much food as you can in the tiniest space possible, you’ll have to put your thinking cap on. Onigiri snacks, plumpy tomatoes, and adorable octopus sausages - you’ll be able to pack these and so many more into your bento. They’re all in a cute visual style, too - hopefully, no one will feel bad about eating them!


With every level, your lunchbox’s size and its supposed contents will change. You can expect more (or less) space, different snacks (hello tofu!), and new obstacles in the form of rice pulps or balls. This is one filling meal!


No worries about the amount of lunchbox levels, they will last you for a while. Each new level will be just a bit harder - but that’s no issue for a professional bento packer! After all, no one wants to leave a tasty meal in the fridge and wait for them to get home.


Key Features:
- Over 90 different bento levels to conquer!
- 29 different pawsome snacks to pack!
- Music that ranges from relaxing lofi hip hop to more energetic funk!
- Cute and sweet-looking graphics that will conquer your heart… and your tastebuds!
- An adorable and skilled cat chef - the cook of these snacks!

70010000088876.name: Relaxation Techniques: How to Find Calm
70010000088876.intro: Unwind and de-stress with this experience. Explore peaceful environments, practice relaxation techniques, and discover a deep sense of inner calm!
70010000088876.description:
Enjoy a soothing, interactive experience designed to help you unwind and de-stress. In this peaceful game, you’ll explore calming environments, learn various relaxation techniques, and engage in mindful activities that promote mental clarity and emotional balance. Whether you’re practicing deep breathing exercises, guided meditation, or simple yoga routines,this game is tailored to create a sense of calm and tranquility, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the present moment and let go of everyday stressors.

Explore a variety of calming environments while you engage lessons that cover everything from deep breathing exercises to guided meditations and mindfulness practices. You’ll learn how to manage stress, improve focus, and cultivate a sense of inner peace—skills you can apply to your everyday life.

Perfect for both beginners and those experienced in mindfulness, this experience offers a personalized, stress-free escape that you can turn to anytime. Discover how to achieve inner peace in just a few minutes a day, improve focus, and develop healthier mental habits.

Take a break from the chaos, disconnect from the noise, and enjoy the journey to a more relaxed and centered you!

70010000088879.name: Golf Up
70010000088879.intro: Enjoy Golf Up with friends and family!
70010000088879.description:
Golf Up is a fun-loaded golf game you can play with up to 4 friends in several game modes. In Tournament mode, you can pick between the Classic or Points options, in which you earn points by getting good results in the Holes and making quick decisions for bigger bonuses.

You will also be able to play solo in Arcade mode and compare your score in the online ranking with that of your friends and players from around the world. 

Features:
-A variety of holes and game modes.
-Take the wind into account when hitting the ball with effects.
-Easy to play, hard to master.
-Online Ranking.

70010000088881.name: Flight Attendant Simulator: Onboard Tasks
70010000088881.intro: Welcome Aboard! Fasten Your Seatbelt—It’s Going to Be a Thrilling Ride!
70010000088881.description:
Become a rookie flight attendant and embark on a thrilling career soaring through the skies! Ensure passenger safety and comfort on exciting global journeys. Navigate diverse situations – manage demanding passengers, respond to unforeseen emergencies, or maintain cabin order with grace. Your ability to adapt and excel under pressure will determine your success.

Features:
- Immersive Flight Experience: Experience the intricacies of cabin crew duties with detailed aircraft interiors and realistic flight mechanics, offering an immersive simulation of the aviation world.
- Dynamic Gameplay: Confront a variety of challenges, from managing passenger needs to handling in-flight emergencies, in a dynamic simulation that tests your skills and decision-making abilities.
- Career Progression: Advance through the ranks of the aviation industry as your performance on each flight influences your reputation and unlocks new opportunities and responsibilities.
- Customization Options: Personalize your character and uniform to showcase your individual style, allowing you to leave a lasting impression on passengers and colleagues alike.
- Realistic Simulation: Engage in the day-to-day responsibilities of a flight attendant, from conducting safety procedures to attending to passenger requests, in a true-to-life simulation of the profession.

70010000088886.name: Ultimate Rock Climbing Challenge
70010000088886.intro: Experience risk in truly wild conditions - become a rock climber!
70010000088886.description:
Challenge yourself to new heights in Ultimate Rock Climbing Challenge! This immersive game puts you in the shoes of a daring climber, scaling breathtaking cliffs and conquering challenging routes. Master the art of climbing, explore diverse locations, and customize your climber to become a legend of the rocks!
Features:
- Diverse Ascents: Conquer 5 unique climbing locations, each offering stunning visuals and distinct challenges.
- Master Every Climb: Progress through a variety of routes, from beginner-friendly tutorials to heart-pounding expert levels.
- Time is Money (Stars): Push your limits and earn more stars with faster climbs, fueling your progression.
- Rock Your Style: Personalize your climber's look with earnable in-game currency.
- Unlock the Climb: Collect stars to unlock new locations and expand your climbing horizons.
Ultimate Rock Climbing Challenge delivers a captivating and rewarding experience. With stunning visuals, immersive gameplay, and extensive customization options, this game will have you scaling new heights in no time!

70010000088891.name: Pizza Maker
70010000088891.description: Prepare delicious pizzas with the right ingredients, bake them for the perfect amount of time, and improve your pizzeria while meeting charming characters in person or through delivery orders in Pizza Maker.

70010000088894.name: EGGCONSOLE BABYLON PC-8801mkIISR
70010000088894.intro: A traveler guided by spirits rises to save Babylon. A side-view action RPG where players use body slams and jumps to fight.
70010000088894.description:
This is an action RPG released in 1986 in Japan. As a chosen traveler, the player's goal is to defeat the beasts and restore peace to Babylon.

The game features a side-view action RPG style. Players attack enemies by dashing into them while utilizing various items (magic) to fight. Depending on your positioning, it's even possible to attack enemies directly above you. Mastering this technique can make battles more efficient. Additionally, the game allows you to adjust the speed across four levels, so if fast-paced action isn't your strong suit, you can play at your preferred pace.

There's no money or shop system, and players progress by collecting scattered items and magic across the wide map, offering a simple and accessible gameplay experience. However, weapons and shields are automatically equipped upon discovery, so be sure to compare new items with your current gear before picking them up. If you do accidentally equip the wrong item, you can re-enter the room to re-equip your previous gear, so no worries!

In this game, you’ll explore the field, power up with hidden items and magic, and defeat beasts. Despite its simplicity, the smooth action makes for an enjoyable experience.

For a nostalgic touch, the game manual even includes plenty of monster illustrations. Looking at these vintage-style images before playing is sure to get you in the right mood!


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000088905.name: Photography Guide: Mastering the Art of Capturing Moments
70010000088905.intro: Discover the art of photography! Learn techniques, complete challenges and capture amazing moments while perfecting your style and creativity.
70010000088905.description:
Discover the art of capturing moments! Become an expert behind the lens as you explore techniques and secrets that will make every photo tell a story. Ideal for beginners and photography enthusiasts alike, this game is a complete step-by-step guide to improve your ability to capture stunning images.

Key features:

-Explore unique scenarios: from natural landscapes to urban environments, you'll learn how to handle light, angle and composition in different contexts.
-Unique lessons: Master key photographic techniques, such as using the rule of thirds, depth of field and selective focus, through hands-on exercises.
-Photo editing: after capturing your images, learn how to edit your photos with simple but powerful tools to help you add the perfect finishing touch.
-Expert tips: Learn tricks of the trade with tips from professional photographers, helping you to hone your skills.
-Progress: each level and challenge will allow you to track your progress, gradually becoming a more confident, professional and creative photographer.

Whether you want to capture the beauty of the world around you or improve your skills for travel, portrait or landscape photos, this game will take you beyond theory, offering you a fun, hands-on experience to improve your photography skills.

Unlock your creativity and start seeing the world through a new lens!

70010000088910.name: Indoor Gardening Create your own Home Garden
70010000088910.intro: Dive into a creative guide to indoor gardening and transform your space into a lush sanctuary - learn unique experiences and design your green paradise!
70010000088910.description:
Discover how to turn your space into a green, relaxing sanctuary with practical and creative ideas! This engaging and creative guide will you make the most of any area, from small apartments to spacious rooms.

You’ll learn to transform your home into a green sanctuary that enhances your quality of life, adds style, and reduces stress. Start your indoor gardening journey today and enjoy a natural space right at home!

70010000088913.name: Car Detailing & Wash Simulator : Luxury Car Cleaner
70010000088913.intro: Luxury Cars, Flawless Shine – Master the Art of Detailing!
70010000088913.description:
Step into the world of high-end car care in Car Detailing & Wash Simulator : Luxury Car Cleaner!
This is not your average car wash—here, you’ll be entrusted with the most rare, expensive, and exotic cars in a vibrant and upscale neighborhood. 
Your mission is to provide premium detailing services to these luxury vehicles, ensuring they look and feel like new.
In this game, you’ll use state-of-the-art tools and techniques to pamper a variety of high-performance cars, sports cars,
 and rare collector’s models. Each vehicle requires a meticulous approach, from delicate hand washes and paint protection to deep interior cleaning and tire detailing. The environment around you is just as polished as the cars you care for—beautiful, high-end neighborhoods and well-designed garages give you the perfect setting to work on these automotive masterpieces.
Key Features:

• Luxury and Exotic Cars: Work on high-end sports cars, rare classic models, and limited-edition supercars. Each car comes with unique detailing challenges and luxury features.

• Realistic Detailing Tools: Use professional-grade tools like high-pressure washers, foam guns, microfiber cloths, polishers, and vacuums to deliver perfect results.

• Stunning Environments: Care for cars in beautiful, upscale neighborhoods, premium garages, and scenic locations with dynamic weather effects and day-night cycles.

• Deep Customization: Unlock upgrades for your tools, shop, and vehicles as you progress. Offer customers personalized services to meet their exacting standards.

• Time Management & Customer Satisfaction: Manage your schedule, prioritize jobs, and ensure each car gets the attention it deserves, all while keeping your customers happy and your reputation spotless.

•Satisfying Progression: As you level up, gain access to more expensive cars, exclusive detailing services, and higher-end equipment, transforming your business into a top-tier luxury care service.
   Whether you’ve always dreamed of working with rare cars or simply enjoy the art of vehicle restoration, Car Detailing & Wash Simulator:Luxury Car Cleaner offers the perfect blend of challenge and satisfaction. 
Take your skills to the next level, and become the go-to detailer for the elite clientele of the city!

70010000088918.name: Drum Pad
70010000088918.intro: Make music to the beat of your own drum with Drum Pad!
70010000088918.description:
With Drum Pad you have the world of music at your fingertip.  Start mixing instruments and drums together to create a tasty beat or the perfect base for your own music. Musicians and wannabe DJs - it’s your time to shine!


CHOOSE THE VIBE
You can start your adventure with the 16-step sequencer panel. Here, you’ll be able to choose the vibe of your drum track. Jazzy or heavy, you will definitely find something that suits your need for a beat in Drum Pad!


MAKE THE BEAT
Snare drums, toms, cymbals – mix and match percussion elements to create the perfect beat. Switch between different genres and experiment with what you have on your hands. Whether this is your first adventure with music or you’re an experienced DJ, Drum Pad offers many possibilities and roads you can take in your search for the perfect tune.


KEY FEATURES:
- 8 different musical genres with instrument sets,
- Mixing and matching styles - jazzy rock? So be it!
- Play your beats in real time or arrange them with a 16-step sequencer,
- Tempo/playback speed control,
- Clean DJ UI

70010000088923.name: BODYCAM Shooter
70010000088923.intro: Can you handle the pressure of real-life police duties?
70010000088923.description:
Step into the ultra-realistic world of BODYCAM Shooter, a first-person simulation that thrusts you into the demanding role of a police officer. Experience the adrenaline and responsibility of law enforcement where every decision is critical and every action scrutinized.

Immerse yourself in stunningly photorealistic environments where every detail matters. From bustling city streets to dimly lit alleyways, the game's advanced graphics engine brings each scenario to life with unprecedented clarity and authenticity.

Key Features:
- Ultra-Realistic Visuals: Experience next-gen graphics that blur the line between game and reality.
- Authentic Police Scenarios: Respond to a variety of calls, from routine checks to high-risk situations.
- Dynamic Decision Making: Every choice impacts the outcome. De-escalate tensions or use force when necessary.
- Tactical Planning: Analyze situations, strategize your approach, and execute with precision.

In BODYCAM Shooter, your actions define the thin blue line between order and chaos. Each decision can escalate or defuse situations, impacting both your career and the community. Are you prepared to face the pressures of policing in an environment where every second and every choice counts?

70010000088928.name: Once Upon a Puppet
70010000088928.intro: Control the strings of fate and embark on a grand adventure in the theatrical-inspired world of Drev & Nieve in Once Upon a Puppet.
70010000088928.description:
The Grand Opening:
Welcome to Once Upon a Puppet, a 2.5D puzzle-platformer that unfolds within a vibrant world of theater. Take part in a magical tale that combines classic platforming with puppet-inspired gameplay, in a captivating story of friendship, self-discovery, and redemption.

Wear the glove of Nieve, a Stagehand exiled to the Understage, and wield control over Drev’s strings, a Puppet magically bound to her. As they journey to return to the Frontstage above, they will retell forgotten stories, uncover shadowy secrets, and learn their fate is interwoven with the kingdom of theater itself.

Highlights:
Become Puppet and Puppeteer: Pull the strings and master the art of puppetry in this unique approach to action, movement, and creative puzzle-solving. 
A Troupe of Characters: Meet an ensemble cast of dozens of Major and supporting characters, featuring hundreds of lines of handcrafted dialogue. 
Deadly Shadows: Face a horde of villainous creatures who will do all they can to snuff out the lights and bring the show to an untimely end. 
A Meticulously Crafted World: Marvel at the stylized and detailed graphics that reinforce the magic of theater, with stages that fluctuate between past and present. 
Set The Scene: Arrange and move props, backdrops and characters to rebuild theatrical stages, and re-enact scenes to unveil what befell the once proud World Stage. 
Enchanting Soundscapes: Be captivated by a rich, theatrical soundtrack and immersive sound effects that bring the world of Once Upon a Puppet to life...


The Leading Actors:
Unwittingly bound together by spool and thread, Drev and Nieve reluctantly embark on a quest to reclaim their place in the theater, against a heartbroken King.

Nieve, a talented Weaver beset by self doubt, builds a strong bond with Drev, a naive yet ambitious Actor. With Drev's unbridled theatrics and Nieve's brilliance, they will conquer their deepest held fears to reveal the truth of the void harbored in their hearts.

70010000088932.name: Save Christmas With Santa
70010000088932.description:
COLLECT THE GIFTS AND SAVE CHRISTMAS!
Santa's in trouble! It's Christmas Eve, and the presents are missing. Help Santa recover the gifts and save the day, so he can deliver them to children all over the world just in time for Christmas morning!

EXPLORE 20 UNIQUE LEVELS!
Travel across 20 distinct levels, each filled with fun challenges and hidden surprises. To complete a level, gather every last gift and unlock the magic portal that will take you to the next location! Can you find them all out?

HELP SANTA SAVE CHRISTMAS!
Play as Santa Claus in this exciting 3D platformer adventure. Navigate through festive environments, collecting all the gifts scattered across the North Pole and beyond! Join Santa on his Christmas adventure and help him deliver all the presents!

70010000088937.name: Angry Neighbor Simulator
70010000088937.intro: Silence the chaos, one swing at a time!
70010000088937.description:
Angry Neighbor Simulator puts you in the shoes of a sleep-deprived guy who just wants some peace and quiet! After countless sleepless nights, you’re fed up with the loud, obnoxious noises coming from your neighbors. It’s time to take matters into your own hands. Choose from your arsenal of unconventional weapons – from a golf club to a katana – and pay them a visit to teach them a lesson.

In each level, you’ll face off against different neighbors, each more annoying than the last. Whether it's deafening music, a rowdy parking lot party, or a dog that won’t stop barking, you’ll stop at nothing to restore peace. Use your weapons to deal with these noisy troublemakers in chaotic combat scenarios.
