Once you’ve cleared out the noise, head back home to finally enjoy that peaceful, uninterrupted sleep you’ve been craving.

Featuring detailed 3D graphics, a humorous storyline, and multiple levels with new challenges and locations, Angry Neighbor Simulator offers a unique mix of action, strategy, and satire. Will you manage to shut them all up, or will the neighborhood’s relentless noise drive you mad? Find out in this hilarious, stress-relieving simulator where sleep is the ultimate reward!

70010000088942.name: Hot Wheels Let's Race™: Ultimate Speed
70010000088942.description:
Get ready to hit the track with Hot Wheels Let’s Race™: Ultimate Speed! 

It’s a high-octane arcade racer packed with iconic cars, epic tracks, and action-fueled gameplay inspired by the hit Netflix animated series Hot Wheels Let’s Race. Drift through wild courses, take on giant boss battles, and unlock a garage full of fan-favorite rides. With track building, local multiplayer, and non-stop speed, the race is always on!

Key Game Features:

• ICONIC HOT WHEELS VEHICLES & TRACKS
Choose from a full garage of iconic Hot Wheels vehicles, like the GT-Scorcher, Super Twin Mill™, Roger Dodger™ and Duck N’ Roll, each with their own unique handling, abilities, and style. Zoom through 12 wild, over-the-top tracks based on the series.

• MEET THE RACERS
Play as your favorite Hot Wheels Let’s Race characters including Coop, Spark, Mac, Brights, Axle, and Cruise. 

• MORE MODES, MORE FUN
There are five thrilling gameplay modes including Racing Camp, Cup Champ, Speed Trials, Track Builder, and Free Races. In Track Builder mode, you can create your dream course with all your own twists and turns! 

• BOSS SHOWDOWNS
Face off against massive bosses like Professor Rearview’s giant cobra and his fire breathing dragon in fast-paced, action-packed battles on the track. Each showdown brings high-speed thrills and epic moments.

• ULTIMATE CUSTOMIZATION
Earn flame badges to unlock new cars, decals, and track parts in the Ultimate Garage. Customize your own Hot Wheels car and show it off on the track.

• COMPETE SOLO OR RACE IN MULTIPLAYER
Play through a thrilling solo campaign with fun challenges or compete with friends in 4-player split-screen racing!

• FAMILY FRIENDLY RACING
Experience fast, fluid, and family-friendly controls with drift-focused gameplay designed for thrilling head-to-head competition.

70010000088959.name: Anime Boys Dating: The night before Christmas and the tree
70010000088959.intro: Discover the magic of Christmas as you embark on a journey to win the heart of the boy of your dreams... A night full of charm and holiday spirit!
70010000088959.description:
Immerse yourself in a unique experience where every answer will not only reveal his personality but also fascinating traits tied to the magical world of Christmas.

In this exciting game, each question is designed to uncover the mysteries of the holiday season, allowing you to get to know these boys in a completely new way.


Features:

-Unlock images of the boys in a festive Christmas setting and discover their most charming traits as they embrace the holiday magic.

-As you progress, the questions will become more personal and will relate to the warm and sweet side of the celebration.

-Different endings depending on how many questions you answer and how you interpret the festive signals.

-Uncover the hidden secrets of each boy, from their Christmas dreams to their most special moments.

-Discover the secret and heartwarming question the boys will ask you at question 150, tied to their Christmas wishes.


Will you be able to uncover the secrets of Christmas and win their trust? Find out in this exciting new adventure!

70010000088964.name: Anime Girls Dating: The Night Before Christmas and the Tree
70010000088964.intro: Discover the magic of Christmas as you embark on a journey to win the heart of the girl of your dreams... A night full of charm and holiday spirit!
70010000088964.description:
Immerse yourself in a unique experience where every answer will not only reveal her personality but also fascinating traits tied to the magical world of Christmas.

In this exciting game, each question is designed to uncover the mysteries of the holiday season, allowing you to get to know these girls in a completely new way.

Features:

-Unlock images of the girls in a festive Christmas setting and discover their most charming traits as they embrace the holiday magic.

-As you progress, the questions will become more personal and will relate to the warm and sweet side of the celebration.

-Different endings depending on how many questions you answer and how you interpret the festive signals.

-Uncover the hidden secrets of each girl, from their Christmas dreams to their most special moments.

-Discover the secret and heartwarming question the girls will ask you at question 150, tied to their Christmas wishes.


Will you be able to uncover the secrets of Christmas and win their trust? Find out in this exciting new adventure!

70010000088969.name: Faye Falling
70010000088969.intro: Guide your recently passed spirit through an afterlife in turmoil!
70010000088969.description:
Take the role of a recently passed soul, unable to recall who you are or how you died. After a chance encounter with a powerful entity, you begin an epic journey to defeat a growing darkness, while recovering your memories along the way. Engage in fast-paced turn-based battles against a wide variety of enemies, evade damage by dodging enemy attacks in snappy minigames and cast powerful spells to fend off your opponents.

Faye Falling is an artistic, emotional experience that explores death, suffering and meaning through top-down action RPG gameplay inspired by genre classics. Immerse yourself in a diverse, ethereal world filled with puzzles and secrets presented in luminous pixel art style.

• Immerse yourself in an atmospheric journey through the afterlife!
• Navigate mazelike environments and solve brainteasing puzzles.
• Engage in real-time minigames to determine success in combat or other obstacles!
• Explore multiple endings and evolving forms based on your actions and choices!
• Discovery even more secrets and tougher challenges in New Game+ mode.
• Enjoy fluid animation in top-down pixel art style!

70010000088974.name: Agent Fall
70010000088974.intro: Infiltrate and destroy in side-scrolling shooter style!
70010000088974.description:
Strange enemy activity has been detected at a secret military base in the desert, and it’s up to you to investigate! Agent Fall is a retro side-scrolling shooter across sprawling platformer stages, from the desert sands and jet hangars of the surface to mysterious underground labs and waterways. Choose from 4 agents and infiltrate the base in a search-and-destroy operation where you’ve got the ultimate license to kill.

Face off against roving enemy soldiers, run, jump, climb ladders and use the environment to your advantage. Strategically scale platforms to gain higher ground, fire in any direction, throw grenades or detonate fuel barrels to neutralize foes, then check in with your team as the tale of espionage unfolds in dialogue with memorable characters. Tackle missions solo or team up with a friend for local co-op play!

Features:

• Run, jump, climb, shoot and look good doing it!
• Choose from 4 agents, each with their own strengths and weaknesses.
• Infiltrate the enemy base and investigate strange activities of a super-secret kind!
• Take on missions solo or team up for co-op play.
• Use the environment to gain a strategic advantage!

70010000088982.name: Pro Flight Simulator Deluxe
70010000088982.intro: Take Off Into the Ultimate Flying Adventure!
70010000088982.description:
Are you ready to soar through the skies like never before? 'Pro Flight Simulator Deluxe' delivers the most thrilling and realistic flight experience out there! Choose from five incredible aircraft, including two agile hydroplanes perfect for water landings, a powerful army jet for heart-pounding high-speed missions, and a mighty jumbo jet built for epic journeys.

With stunningly realistic exterior and cockpit views, you’ll feel like a true pilot as you switch between multiple camera angles to find that perfect perspective. Fly through 40 challenging levels, each set in one of 10 beautifully crafted sceneries, from snow-covered mountain ranges to the vast deserts of North Africa. Every mission brings new challenges, and changing wind conditions will keep you on your toes as you navigate through turbulent skies.

Your mission? Collect valuable goods hanging beneath vibrant balloons while you masterfully steer your aircraft through ever-changing skies. Think you’ve mastered the challenge? Take on the 'World Tour', an epic journey that will take you around the globe, pushing your skills to the limit as you conquer familiar landscapes with new, unpredictable weather patterns.

Strap in, take the controls, and make every flight an adventure with 'Pro Flight Simulator Deluxe'! The sky's the limit—are you ready to reach for it?

70010000088990.name: Supermarket Simulator 2024
70010000088990.intro: From empty shelves to a booming grocery empire!
70010000088990.description:
Start with a humble corner store and turn it into the ultimate grocery shopping hotspot! Stock fresh produce, fill shelves with everyday essentials, and create the perfect shopping experience for your customers. Keep prices competitive, launch special promotions, and ensure your store stays clean and organized to keep shoppers coming back for more.

Manage every detail of your supermarket, from hiring the perfect staff to optimizing checkout speed and preventing shoplifters from sneaking off with your best goods. Expand your business by upgrading equipment, securing exclusive brand deals, and transforming your store into a grocery empire.

With every decision shaping your store’s success, will you become the neighborhood’s go-to market or struggle to keep up with demand? Step behind the counter, roll up your sleeves, and make your supermarket the best in town!

70010000088995.name: Backrooms Horror Escape
70010000088995.intro: Are you ready to face your fears?
70010000088995.description:
Embark on a terrifying journey in Backrooms Horror Escape, a horror game that traps you in a nightmarish maze where reality warps and sanity crumbles. Lost in the Backrooms, a claustrophobic labyrinth of decaying office spaces and flickering fluorescent lights, you must navigate through endless corridors and damp, stained carpets, all while battling the creeping fear of the unknown.

Armed only with a camera, your goal is to document eerie sights and sounds as you move deeper into the maze. The camera not only serves as a recording device but as a tool to uncover clues and reveal the sinister entities that stalk you. Each photo or video clip may hold vital information—sometimes even exposing the true horrors lurking in the shadows.

As you venture further into the twisted maze, the Backrooms begin to warp your perception of time and space, with every corner leading to new, unsettling dangers. Solve intricate puzzles, avoid terrifying creatures, and keep your sanity intact as you race against time to find the elusive exit.

The deeper you go, the more the maze changes. Will you escape before your mind unravels, or will you become another lost soul trapped forever in the endless void of the Backrooms?

70010000089000.name: BodyRec Assault Shooter
70010000089000.intro: The fight for survival starts now!
70010000089000.description:
Step into the intense world of BodyRec Assault Shooter, a gripping 3D shooter game where your skills are put to the ultimate test! Navigate through a series of challenging levels, each featuring unique locations and maps.

As you battle through enemy lines, collect coins to enhance your firepower. Use your earnings to unlock a wide selection of powerful guns and weapons, allowing you to customize your arsenal for maximum impact.

With every level, you’ll encounter new terrains and strategic quests that demand quick reflexes and tactical thinking. Whether you’re storming an urban battlefield or traversing remote landscapes, each mission offers an adrenaline-pumping experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Gear up, take aim, and prepare for battle in BodyRec Assault Shooter! The fight for survival starts now!

70010000089005.name: Racing Champions
70010000089005.intro: Hone your racing skills, sharpen your strategy, and aim for the podium in the ultimate racing challenge!
70010000089005.description:
Experience the rush of motorsport in a unique blend of simulation and arcade racing, crafted with passion by true racing enthusiasts. With gameplay that’s easy to jump into but rewards precision and mastery, this game invites you to chase that flawless lap again and again.

Feel the tires grip the track as you zoom past the start/finish line and tackle each hairpin turn, brakes screeching as you navigate every curve with intensity. 

Take on 18 dynamic tracks and command 32 distinct cars, each with a unique handling style to master.

Test your skills against a range of AI difficulties in single-player mode, or bring the competition home with local multiplayer to race head-to-head with friends.

70010000089010.name: Floral Arrangements: How to Create Beautiful Displays
70010000089010.intro: Master floral design with this guide! Create stunning arrangements for every occasion, and space while exploring inspiring techniques and trends
70010000089010.description:
Embark on a captivating journey into floral design with this immersive guide, perfect for beginners and enthusiasts alike. Discover the essentials of selecting fresh flowers and complementary materials, and learn to create stunning arrangements for special occasions like birthdays and weddings.

Capture the essence of each season with vibrant displays, from the lively blooms of spring and summer to the warm tones of autumn and winter. Transform any space with elegant floral accents, whether it’s a cozy living room or a commercial area like a hotel lobby.

Dive into advanced techniques for prolonging freshness and adapting designs to various environments. With inspiration from renowned floral designers and insights into the latest trends, this guide equips you with the tools to turn flowers into beautiful, meaningful displays, bringing elegance and joy to every occasion. Embrace your creativity and let your floral arrangements shine!

70010000089013.name: Pet Kawaii Shop
70010000089013.intro: Create the cutest pet paradise and win customers’ hearts!
70010000089013.description:
Welcome to Pet Kawaii Shop, the most adorable pet management game in the anime universe!

This delightful simulation game invites players to create, customize, and manage their very own pet shop in a vibrant kawaii-style universe.

Key Features:
- Adopt a Variety of Pets: From fluffy kittens to playful puppies and more exotic critters, each pet comes with its own needs and adorable behaviors.
- Customize Your Shop: Design a welcoming haven for pets and customers alike! Choose from a range of decorations, layout designs, and themes to reflect your personal style.
- Engage with Customers: Build relationships with a diverse cast of characters as they visit your shop. Satisfy their needs and watch your popularity soar!
- Expand and Upgrade: Grow your shop from a quaint corner store to a luxurious pet paradise. Unlock new accessories, toys, and areas to keep both pets and patrons happy.

As your shop grows, unlock new pet species, expand your store, and become the talk of the town! Can you create the ultimate kawaii pet paradise and become the most successful pet shop owner in the anime world?

70010000089018.name: A Guide to Personal Finance: How to Manage Your Money
70010000089018.intro: Take charge of your finances! Master budgeting, smart saving, debt management, and plan purchases for a secure, stable future.
70010000089018.description:
Take control of your financial future with this interactive guide to personal finance! Covering everything from crafting a solid budget to preparing for big purchases like homes and cars, this guide equips you with practical strategies for every financial goal. Learn to save smartly, manage debt effectively, and make the most of your credit.

The guide goes further by helping you plan for retirement, protect valuable assets with the right insurance, and navigate unexpected financial challenges with ease. It also includes strategies for rebuilding after setbacks and maintaining a healthy money mindset, ensuring you're empowered to make wise financial choices. With clear steps and tools, this resource is a valuable companion for anyone seeking to build a stable future, achieve ambitious goals, and achieve lasting financial stability.

70010000089021.name: Dirt Bike Extreme 3D
70010000089021.intro: Ride, stunt, and soar: become the ultimate dirt bike champion!
70010000089021.description:
Dirt Bike Extreme 3D invites you to unleash your inner daredevil in an exhilarating motorbike adventure! Immerse yourself in the action as you tackle diverse terrains and thrilling experiences in the role of a fearless biker.

Navigate through multiple levels, each featuring its own unique map—whether you’re tearing through urban landscapes, wild western terrains, sun-soaked beaches, and lush jungle trails. With strategically placed checkpoints, every second counts as you strive to complete each level with style and precision.

Your mission? Pull off jaw-dropping tricks and stunts on your motorcycle to win points and beat the clock, earning a maximum number of stars. Collect money with every stunt and invest in new motorcycles that enhance your speed, agility and accuracy.

Get ready to rev your engines and experience the thrill of high-speed action, impressive tricks, and fierce competition. Will you rise to the occasion and become the ultimate biker champion in Dirt Bike Extreme 3D? The race for glory begins now!

70010000089026.name: Flight Simulator Pro 2024
70010000089026.intro: Take off, explore, and conquer the skies!
70010000089026.description:
Flight Simulator Pro 2024 puts you in the pilot’s seat for the most immersive flying experience yet. Whether you're cruising in a jumbo jet, tackling stormy skies in a private plane, or just enjoying a smooth sunset flight, every moment feels real and exciting.

With realistic flight physics, every takeoff and landing is a test of skill. Explore a massive open world with stunning cities, remote islands, and ever-changing weather that keeps you on your toes. From turbulence to shifting winds, no two flights are the same. Plus, you can tweak controls and settings to match your skill level—whether you're a pro pilot or just starting out.

So, strap in, push the throttle, and get ready to explore the skies in Flight Simulator Pro 2024!

70010000089031.name: Shop Simulator: Supermarket
70010000089031.intro: Will your small shop become a successful supermarket? It's in your hands.
70010000089031.description:
YOUR SUCCESS IS IN YOUR HANDS.
Put your entrepreneurial skills to the test in Shop Simulator: Supermarket. Immerse yourself in the world of retail and start your own business today! Will your small shop become a successful supermarket? It's in your hands.

DIFFERENT BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES
Decide what kind of shop you want to build. From a classic supermarket to a cereal shop with countless variations, or even a shop for animal food -- the choice is yours.
 
DESIGN YOUR SHOP
Design your store exactly the way you want it. Choose from various shelves and decorations, place products as you like, and set their prices. Build the shop of your dreams!
 
MAXIMIZE YOUR PROFITS
Monitor stock levels, analyze sales data, and optimize your inventory to meet your customers' needs. Keep an eye on market prices and order strategically to maximize your profits.
 
EXPAND AND GROW
Expand your shop and diversify your inventory to bring even more variety to your business. Hire employees to be able to focus on the critical aspects of your shop.
 
MONEY MAKES THE WORLD GO 'ROUND
Scan products, charge the correct amount, and ensure that customers leave your store happy and satisfied. If too many customers come in, you can open a second checkout and staff it with an AI employee or a fellow player.
 
CLICK & COLLECT ORDERS
Move with the times and also accept online orders to reduce your customers' waiting time and make additional profits. But be careful: you need to prepare the right products to satisfy the customer and complete the order successfully.

70010000089034.name: Shop Simulator: Pet Shop
70010000089034.intro: In SHOP SIMULATOR: PET SHOP, you can fulfill your dream of running a pet store.
70010000089034.description:
"SHOP SIMULATOR: PET SHOP" -- BUILD THE PET STORE OF YOUR DREAMS. 

In "SHOP SIMULATOR: PET SHOP", you can fulfill your dream of running a pet store. Immerse yourself in the fascinating world of retail and keep your customers happy. Only happy customers are happy to spend more money and keep coming back to your pet shop.Let's go: open your own PET SHOP.

DESIGN YOUR SHOP 
Design your store exactly the way you want it. Choose from a variety of shelves and decorations, place products as you see fit, and set their prices. Build the store of your dreams!

MAXIMIZE YOUR PROFIT 
Monitor stock levels, analyze sales data, and optimize inventory to meet customer needs.

EXPAND AND GROW 
Expand your store and diversify your products to bring even more variety to your store. Hire employees so that they can take over some of your tasks.

MONEY MAKES THE WORLD GO ROUND 
Scan products, charge the correct amount, and make sure that customers leave your store happy and satisfied.

70010000089042.name: Cookulo
70010000089042.intro: Cookulo: An experimental cooking game where your mission is to complete your Recipe Book!
70010000089042.description:
Mix and match ingredients to cook delicious dishes in this chill and laid-back game. Unlock new ingredients as you discover recipes worthy of your recipe book. Use your recipe ideas or experiment with unique flavor combinations to unleash your creativity in the kitchen!

Burnt a dish? No problem! Cooking is all about trial and error. With over 200 cute, hand-drawn dishes to unlock, the fun never ends!

70010000089047.name: Little Strays
70010000089047.intro: In the shadows of abandoned warehouses, tiny kittens await a feline hero to rescue them and scavenge for food.
70010000089047.description:
• Search abandoned warehouses for food and rescue lost kittens.
• Avoid obstacles and complete timed objectives.
• Play through 16 challenging levels.
• Compete in two-player split-screen mode.

In a desolate world where only the fittest survive, you step into the paws of a courageous cat determined to make a difference. As the city whispers of danger and abandonment, you listen closely, navigating through deserted warehouses in search of stranded and frightened kittens. Your mission is clear: find food, aid the helpless, and guide the lost to safety. Every corner holds a new challenge, but with a strong will and compassionate spirit, you’ll do whatever it takes to protect those who need it most!

The game also features a split-screen mode, allowing two players to compete head-to-head in their quest to rescue as many kittens as possible. Team up or face off for an added layer of excitement in this survival adventure!

70010000089053.name: Cats Defense Robots: Meow Legends
70010000089053.intro: Unleash the purrfect power: defend, conquer, and rule with Meow Legends!
70010000089053.description:
Join forces with up to 3 friends in this epic offline tower defense game! As the fearless defenders of the Milk Base, you’ll take on waves of ruthless robot invaders, all while strategizing and placing powerful towers to protect your precious supply.

With teamwork and tactical genius, you and your friends must stand strong against the mechanical horde. Upgrade your towers, unlock new abilities, and harness the might of legendary feline heroes to keep the milk flowing and the robots at bay!

Can you and your squad protect the most valuable resource in the world? The fate of the Milk Base is in your paws!

70010000089058.name: Vagrus - The Riven Realms
70010000089058.intro: Embark on a perilous journey across a realm forsaken by the gods and devastated by an arcane cataclysm.
70010000089058.description:
Accompanied by a hardy crew, you must trade, fight, and explore your way to success as the leader of a traveling company in Vagrus, an award-winning turn-based post-apocalyptic fantasy RPG.

Vagrus is a roleplaying game with a narrative focus, open-world exploration, and strong elements of strategy. The player takes the role of a vagrus - a caravan leader who strives to survive in a strange and perilous dark fantasy world by leading a traveling company on all kinds of ventures.

A Dark Realm

A vast realm is yours to explore, filled with unique locations, strange factions, and a colorful cast of characters. In order to punish the Empire for its sins, the Elder Gods unleashed their power a thousand years ago that resulted in the devastation of the realms. The continent is now a wasteland, riddled with arcane anomalies, swarming with twisted monsters, and haunted by roaming undead even after long centuries of rebuilding.

Branching Narrative

A large selection of stories make up the game’s narrative in the form of events, encounters, and quests. The choices you make in these often affect your companions as well as the world around you. Pick your background from trader, mercenary, or explorer; work for factions, pursue rumors and trading opportunities; acquire wealth, gain fame, and discover hidden knowledge.

Turn-based Combat

Engage in turn-based, tactical combat that involves your companions and a large variety of enemies, both humanoid and monstrous. Use a wide range of character skills as well as your own leadership-related abilities to succeed. Positioning and support skills are of paramount importance in these challenging engagements.

Resource Management

Journeys have to be planned and prepared for carefully, lest they end in disaster. Manage your supplies, morale, and your crew’s vigor effectively to survive. Haul cargo and valuables across the wasteland or take it from others. Your crew of workers, fighters, scouts, and slaves have to be supervised closely to optimize their effectiveness.

Unique Companions

A wide variety of companions can work for you in versatile caravan roles, such as scoutmaster, guard captain, treasure hunter, or beast handler. Each companion comes with unique combat skills, background stories, and personal quest lines that can upgrade them further when you complete them.

Powerful Factions

Ally yourself with mighty factions that shape the Riven Realms with their influence on commerce, brutal wars, and their constant intrigue. From prosperous Trading Houses to criminal syndicates and religious organizations, these groups offer powerful rewards and boons to those loyal to their cause. But take heed - befriending a faction will more than likely antagonize some of the others.

70010000089070.name: The Mansion of The Macabre
70010000089070.intro: Explore the Crowley Manor and unravel the secrets of the Occult. Inspired by the Works of HP Lovecraft and a love letter to classic 90’s survival horror games.
70010000089070.description:
Michael Praise and Diana Eden investigate the paranormal in this return to classic survival horror. Explore the Crowley Manor and unravel the secrets of the Occult. Inspired by the Works of HP Lovecraft and a love letter to classic 90’s survival horror games.

Featuring an ancient evil and occult conspiracy, Cthlulu and his macabre creatures have their grip on the estate in 1920’s Florida Wetlands. You go in freely, but will you leave the same way?

The mansion is entombed by the creature on the threshold. Only by defeating an old evil will it release it’s grasp and allow you to escape, but perhaps without your sanity intact…

Featuring two characters to choose from with an intricately written story, platform elements, puzzle solving and classic 90’s survival horror tropes, explore the mansion of the Crowley Family and find and defeat the underbelly of true evil.

70010000089073.name: Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer
70010000089073.intro: A workout that fits your lifestyle
70010000089073.description:
Punch and dodge* to the beat in the latest entry of the Fitness Boxing series! Pair up with your choice of eight fully voiced virtual instructors with customizable outfits and hairstyles (software update required)—and then get your groove on in 30 instrumental songs, some of which are inspired by catchy pop tunes.

Jump into a single Quick Workout, or build an exercise routine that fits your life. Additions to the series include Mitt Drills to practice combos with your instructor and Sit Fit Boxing to work up a sweat without leaving your seat. Whether you’re after a serious burn or just a bit of stretching, the intensity of your workout is up to you!

70010000089074.name: Dark Light
70010000089074.intro: Dark Light is a riveting action platformer featuring fast-paced combat in a post-apocalyptic world.
70010000089074.description:
In the aftermath of the apocalypse, the world is shrouded in an impenetrable darkness, a realm now home to creatures birthed from the Dark Void. As the last of the Dark Hunters, an elite cadre of human warriors, you are entrusted with a daunting task: to seal the Dark Void and rescue humanity from an impending doom.
Venture into the heart of this darkness, into the mysterious and perilous zones now claimed by the night. Augment your abilities with cyberwares, face the supernatural entities that lurk in the shadows, and engage in brutal combat against hordes of ferocious creatures. Collect their energy shards, join a faction, unlock skills, and face epic bosses in your relentless pursuit to halt the cycle of eternal darkness.

70010000089079.name: Cursed Feed
70010000089079.intro: Cursed Feed is a short, first-person horror game where you hunt down ghost sightings using your tools.
70010000089079.description:
In first-person horror game "Cursed Feed," players embark on a chilling journey with the Thornvale family as they confront a malevolent force unleashed by their own patriarch's archaeological discoveries. 

Richard Thornvale, a renowned archaeologist, returns from a harrowing expedition in the Middle East with cryptic artifacts in tow, he unwittingly invites an ancient curse into their tranquil home. Soon, inexplicable phenomena plague the household, and Emily, their young daughter, becomes the focal point of the sinister presence. 

With each passing night, the family is tormented by terrifying apparitions and escalating paranormal activity, leading them to unravel dark secrets buried within the walls of their own home. 

As they delve deeper into the mystery, they must confront their own fears and uncover the truth behind the curse before it consumes them all. Will they break free from the grip of the past, or will they become mere echoes in the haunted halls of their own history?

*As a paranormal investigator, Thornval residence is at your disposal. Place your camera recording equipment at strategic locations around the deserted house.
*Use your camera set-up at the back of your van to monitor camera feeds, observe and investigate any ghostly happenings.
*Use your spirit box to unearth  the horrifying mysteries in the cryptic dungeons beneath the Thornval residence.

70010000089096.name: Assoluto Racing
70010000089096.intro: Premium Launch Edition includes full game, bonus currency and select vehicles. Race licensed cars on real tracks with realistic physics. Tune your car and compete.
70010000089096.description:
Premium Launch Edition includes the full game, bonus currency, and curated vehicles to start your racing journey.

AUTHENTIC RACING EXPERIENCE
Experience realistic physics and handling with authentic licensed vehicles and real-world tracks. Master technical circuits where precision and skill determine victory.

LICENSED VEHICLES & TRACKS
Race genuine licensed cars with accurate performance characteristics. Challenge yourself on faithfully recreated tracks that demand perfect racing lines and expert car control.

DEEP CUSTOMIZATION
Fine-tune suspension, differential, tire pressure, and gear ratios to match your driving style. Every adjustment affects handling and performance on track.

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Compete against players worldwide in real-time races. Test your skills in time attack leaderboards and ranked events.

PREMIUM LAUNCH EDITION CONTENTS
- Full game access
- Bonus currency for vehicle purchases
- Curated vehicle selection to begin racing immediately

Master the art of racing simulation where physics, precision, and skill matter most.

70010000089101.name: Food Courier: Bike Adventure
70010000089101.intro: Race the clock and become the ultimate food courier!
70010000089101.description:
Food Courier: Bike Adventure is an exciting 3D bike simulation game that puts you in the fast-paced world of food delivery. As a courier, your mission is to navigate the bustling city streets, delivering food to hungry customers in record time. But it’s not just about speed—you’ll need precision and skill to dodge traffic, avoid obstacles, and reach your destination before the clock runs out.

With each successful delivery, you’ll earn money that can be used to upgrade your bike or buy entirely new models. These upgrades can improve your bike's speed, handling, and durability, allowing you to take on even more challenging deliveries. Whether you're weaving through narrow alleyways or zipping across highways, every level brings a new test of your courier skills.

The game offers a variety of bikes to choose from, ranging from classic road bikes to high-performance models, each with its own unique advantages. As you progress through the game, you’ll face increasingly difficult tasks and deliveries that will push your abilities to the limit.

Key Features:
- Challenging Missions: Complete food deliveries against the clock and navigate dynamic environments filled with obstacles and traffic.

- Bike Upgrades: Use your earnings to upgrade your bike’s performance or purchase new, more powerful models.

- Immersive 3D Environments: Explore a beautifully rendered city with realistic streets, traffic patterns, and customers waiting for their orders.

- Realistic Physics: Experience the thrill of biking with realistic handling and mechanics that require precision and strategy.

- Progression System: Earn rewards for completing levels, allowing you to unlock better bikes and harder challenges.

Can you rise through the ranks and become the city’s top food courier? The road to success is filled with twists, turns, and plenty of deliveries—so hop on your bike and start your adventure!

70010000089106.name: PicoMix by NuSan
70010000089106.intro: Platform, puzzle, crafting, or base building, this compilation of 20 modern retro games will provide hours of various experiences and challenges
70010000089106.description:
PicoMix by NuSan features games made by creator NuSan over a 8 years period of time. It’s a compilation of works in multiple genres, like platform, puzzle, crafting, or base building for a total of about 20 fun games and experiments, some will provide hours of interesting challenges while others can be completed in a few minutes.

This game is a compilation of 20 games. The main 9 games are : 
· Combo Pool: A snooker game where you combine balls by color 
· Flooded caves: A digging game where you need to save people from a flooding cave system 
· P.Craft Deluxe: A 2d survival simulation where you need to craft your way out of an island infested by zombies 
· Lost in pico: A spooky 3d adventure in a scary manor 
· Defacto: A factory management simulation 
· Cyclo8: a 2d biking acrobatic puzzle adventure 
· Dami & Flo: A delivery train management game where you can couch co-op 
· Zebulon A Lost Cat: A metroidvania infused 2D platformer with a cat
· Path of Aratron: A demon summoning puzzle game 

The other games are smaller scoped games and experiments that can be played over and over or just appreciated as technical or artistic experiences. 

All of the games were made using “fantasy console” Pico 8 with its recognizable 16-color palette, crunchy sweet 128x128 resolution pixel art and 4-channel chiptune

Thanks to the use of Zepto 8 emulator, an optional wide mode is included in some of the games to go beyond Pico 8’s usual square screen, as well as visual filters to tweak your experience (scanlines, CRT, toon, minit...)

70010000089108.name: Christmas Puzzle Story
70010000089108.description:
Celebrate the magic of the holiday season with Christmas Puzzle Story, a cozy and addictive puzzle game where festive fruits and Christmas treats collide in delightful combos! Merge identical items to create bigger, more festive surprises, progressing through stages filled with holiday cheer.

Each level offers a challenge—strategically slide, match, and merge to unlock gingerbread cookies, candy canes, ornaments, and other holiday symbols. With each merge, experience the warmth of the holiday spirit as the board lights up with wintry colors and Christmas magic!

Perfect for holiday relaxation or a quick break, Christmas Puzzle Story offers a soothing yet engaging gameplay experience. With charming visuals, merry sound effects, and satisfying combos, this is the ultimate Christmas puzzle to brighten your day and bring you into the festive spirit.

Get ready to deck the halls, match your way to high scores, and uncover hidden surprises in this fun, family-friendly holiday puzzle game!

70010000089120.name: 911: Prey
70010000089120.intro: Scary hide & seek horror game with puzzle elements.
70010000089120.description:
In this part of the horror game, you will once again feel like a kidnapped teenager. Maniac - cannibal brought you back to his creepy house. Hide and search for items that can help you find a way out of the scary place and survive the nightmare. Solve puzzles to get to inaccessible places. And do not forget about attentiveness - you need to carefully cover up your tracks so that the maniac does not suspect anything.

Can you hide and outsmart the cannibal and survive without missing a single detail? Or will he catch you in the very first minutes and the evening you will find yourself on his plate? In this horror, survival depends only on your ingenuity, attentiveness, and memory.

Explore the scary house and look for notes to learn more about Minnesota's scariest maniac. In this part of the game, there are many endings, of which only one will turn out to be good. Try to cope with the horror that gripped the main character and complete all the hidden tasks to survive.

Game features:

- Multiple endings - it all depends on your actions
- Branching detective story
- Interesting puzzles
- Fascinating story and investigation
- Horror elements, hide and seek, and survival
- Quality sound and detailed environment

70010000089125.name: Love Furry Girls: Zodiac Dating App
70010000089125.intro: Discover a world of charming Furries and win over 12 unique characters influenced by their zodiac signs and species.
70010000089125.description:
In this game of romance and self-discovery, you’ll dive into deep conversations, exploring their inner worlds and challenging your ability to connect with them on a deeper level.

Can you find true love before time runs out?


Game Features:

-12 Furries, 12 signs, 12 challenges: Each character has a unique personality shaped by their zodiac sign and species. From a mysterious she-wolf to a flirty vixen, discover what makes them fall in love and how to earn their trust.

-Captivating conversations: Talk to them, gain their attention, send messages, and plan special moments that leave a lasting impression on their hearts.

-Connection meter: Watch your bond grow or weaken based on your choices. Can you build a genuine relationship and fill their hearts before time runs out?

-Emotional and unique endings: Depending on your decisions, each character will react in their own way, unlocking heartfelt, romantic, or challenging endings that reflect the depth of your relationship.

-Zodiac rituals and secrets: As you progress, uncover unique challenges and intimate secrets tied to their zodiac sign and personality, deepening your connection even further.

-30 days for true love: The challenge is to win their hearts and find your soulmate in just one month! Every choice and every interaction counts.


Are you ready to immerse yourself in this vibrant world filled with passion, humor, and unexpected twists?

Meet the charming Furries, experience intense romances, and discover if you can find true love.

Your destiny is written in the stars!

70010000089133.name: Love Furry Boys: Zodiac Dating App
70010000089133.intro: Discover a world of charming Furries and win over 12 unique characters influenced by their zodiac signs and species.
70010000089133.description:
In this game of romance and self-discovery, you’ll dive into deep conversations, exploring their inner worlds and challenging your ability to connect with them on a deeper level. Can you find true love before time runs out?


Game Features:

-12 Furries, 12 signs, 12 challenges: Each character has a unique personality shaped by their zodiac sign and species. From a mysterious wolf to a flirty fox, discover what wins their hearts and how to earn their trust.

-Captivating conversations: Talk to them, gain their attention, send messages, and plan special moments that leave a lasting impression on their hearts.

-Connection meter: Watch your bond grow or weaken based on your choices. Can you build a genuine relationship and fill their hearts before time runs out?

-Emotional and unique endings: Depending on your decisions, each character will react in their own way, unlocking heartfelt, romantic, or challenging endings that reflect the depth of your relationship.

-Zodiac rituals and secrets: As you progress, uncover unique challenges and intimate secrets tied to their zodiac sign and personality, deepening your connection even further.

-30 days for true love: The challenge is to win their hearts and find your soulmate in just one month! Every choice, every interaction counts.

Are you ready to immerse yourself in this vibrant world filled with passion, humor, and unexpected twists? 

Meet the enchanting Furries, experience intense romances, and discover if you can find true love. 

Your destiny is written in the stars!

70010000089138.name: Sweet Survivors
70010000089138.intro: The purr-fect storm is coming! Can you protect your café from fluffy chaos?
70010000089138.description:
It looks like a normal day at the café… but suddenly, swarms of love-craving cats are storming in, and only you stand between them and total feline chaos! Armed with laser pointers, yarn balls, and even the dreaded pickle of doom, you’ll have to keep these fluffballs at bay while serving your customers their precious coffee. No big deal, right?

Get ready for waves of fur and whiskers as you protect two cozy cafés. Upgrade your toys and special skills to become the best cat-fighting waiter around! With each shift, you’ll unlock new waiters, fun toys, and even more cat-tastrophes!

Features:
- Face down hordes of fluffy invaders
- Unlock quirky toys and heroic waiters
- Conquer shifts in different café battlegrounds
- Power up and become the ultimate cat-wrangler
- Upgrade your waiters and toys to become the strongest cat-wrangler
- Enjoy purr-fectly fun gameplay and cute visuals

Can you save your café before the cats take over?

70010000089140.name: Mind Loop
70010000089140.intro: Enter the endless hall where reality distorts. Spot anomalies, correct them, and uncover the dark truth—miss one, and you may be lost forever.
70010000089140.description:
Enter the hall, where the mind unravels and reality distorts.
You're lost in the sterile halls of a psychiatric hospital. The corridor seems endless, but something is wrong—objects shift, things are not as they should be, and the deeper you go, the more unsettling the anomalies become. With every step, you feel an unsettling presence growing closer, as if the hospital itself is hiding something from you.

RULES:
- Don't overlook any anomalies.
- Turn back immediately if you notice one.
- Go forward if you don't notice any anomaly.
- Go out of the hall.

Pay close attention to every shift in the corridor. The smallest change might unlock a piece of a forgotten past, leading you deeper into a dark and twisted story. What seems like a harmless difference could be the key to uncovering the truth you’ve buried. Miss it, and you might remain lost in the madness forever.

70010000089145.name: A Dance of Fire and Ice
70010000089145.intro: Use rhythm to guide planets along a winding path, alone or in 4-player co-op!
70010000089145.description:
A Dance of Fire and Ice is a deceptively simple rhythm game: press the button along to the beat to keep your orbiting planets on the path.

But the path isn't always so simple. Before long, you'll travel across different twisting shapes and patterns, representing different rhythms spread across all sorts of genres.

This version includes the base game "A Dance of Fire and Ice", the expansion "Neo Cosmos", and all-new 4-player local multiplayer.

EXPLORE THE COSMOS
Soar through each genre of music in a variety of colorful fantasy landscapes in over 30 different worlds.

PREDICT EVERY MOVEMENT
With a track that shows you every rhythm ahead of time, you’ll learn to sight-read levels as they come. No tricks, and nothing is reaction-based.

TEAM UP WITH FRIENDS
Play in a group of up to four friends in local co-operative play! When a friend misses a beat, keep pushing onward to revive them and pull them back into the song.

CHALLENGE THE OVERSEER IN NEO COSMOS
When you're ready for a challenge, jump into the "Neo Cosmos" story expansion. Directed by TaroNuke (creator of NotITG and UKSRT), it includes plenty of surprises, new characters, and whole new game mechanics to mix things up.

CALIBRATE YOUR EXPERIENCE
Manually adjust your calibration on-the-fly, or use our auto-calibration method. We're musicians, and it hurts us to play off-sync games.

70010000089150.name: Mechanic Supermarket 2024
70010000089150.intro: Master the art of running a supermarket and tuning cars!
70010000089150.description:
Welcome to Mechanic Supermarket 2024, a unique simulation where you don’t just run a supermarket—you're also the top mechanic in town, tuning and testing cars in a bustling city. Whether it’s managing stock and customer satisfaction or customizing engines and exploring dynamic city streets, every choice drives your success.

Key Features:
- Dual Gameplay: Optimize product lines and tweak engines to maximize both customer and car performance.
- Deep Customization: Dive deep into car customization with a garage system that lets you modify everything from engines to aesthetics. Make your car and your business truly your own.
- Dynamic City Driving: Test your customized cars in a living city environment.
- Strategic Expansion: Use your earnings to expand your business operations. More space means more products and bigger garages.
- Player Progression: Unlock new abilities, advanced technology, and innovative supermarket and car upgrades as you grow your business empire.

Mechanic Supermarket 2024 offers a unique blend of strategy, customization, and action, all rolled into one groundbreaking simulation. Manage, modify, and master the art of commerce and cars in a game that challenges you to think, tweak, and thrive. The road ahead is full of opportunities—are you ready to take the wheel?

70010000089157.name: Pet Clinic Simulator
70010000089157.intro: Build your dream vet clinic and heal pets with love!
70010000089157.description:
Welcome to Pet Clinic Simulator, where your love for animals meets your management skills! Build and run your very own veterinary clinic in this charming, customizable arcade idle game.

Key Features:
- Diverse Pet Care: Treat a wide range of animals including dogs, cats, birds, and exotic reptiles, each with their own health challenges.
- Customizable Clinic: Expand and personalize your clinic with treatment rooms and cozy waiting areas.
- Hire and Manage Staff: Recruit skilled assistants to help manage daily operations.
- Upgrade Tools: Invest in the latest veterinary technology to improve the quality of care and increase client satisfaction.
- Interactive Mini-Games: Perform treatments through fun and instructive mini-games that simulate real-life pet treatments.
- Idle Progress: Earn income and grow your clinic even while offline, ensuring your clinic thrives at all times.

Balance hands-on medical work with effective management to keep your clinic bustling and your furry patients wagging and purring. Whether you have a few minutes or several hours, "Pet Clinic Simulator" provides a fulfilling escape into the world of veterinary medicine.

70010000089162.name: Bodycam Rescue Shooter
70010000089162.intro: Unleash chaos in a battle of reality, aliens, and delusions!
70010000089162.description:
When his wife mysteriously dies, an old man becomes consumed with the belief that aliens are behind her disappearance. His obsession lands him in a psychiatric hospital, but his determination to uncover the truth leads him to escape. Armed with a newfound weapon, he fights his way out of the hospital and into a world that’s turning against him.

In Bodycam Rescue Shooter, you’ll experience intense action as you face a growing array of enemies—including policemen, hospital staff, and extraterrestrial invaders summoned from strange portals in the sky. As the old man’s mind fractures, his hallucinations blur the line between reality and madness, escalating the danger at every turn.

Explore a series of immersive locations—from a chaotic hospital to a haunted cemetery, and a remote village. Each area offers missions where you’ll hunt for weapons, destroy key targets, and confront powerful bosses in gripping quests. As you progress, the old man’s enemies become more diverse and his delusions more dangerous.

Are the aliens real, or is it all in his head? The truth lies at the end of the destruction.

70010000089172.name: Backrooms: Spirits of the Forgotten
70010000089172.intro: Escape the nightmare of the Backrooms—if you dare.
70010000089172.description:
Backrooms: Spirits of the Forgotten is a spine-chilling 3D horror game that plunges players into an endless maze of dread. Trapped within the eerie and labyrinthine Backrooms, you must navigate through unsettlingly familiar yet nightmarish environments to find your way out.

As you venture deeper into this supernatural realm, you'll encounter a series of shocking and terrifying moments designed to test your nerves. The Backrooms are fraught with unseen dangers and malevolent entities that lurk in the shadows, waiting to pounce. Your survival hinges on your ability to solve intricate puzzles, manage scarce resources, and evade the lurking spirits that haunt these forsaken halls.

Immerse yourself in a world where the walls seem to close in on you, and every corner could hide a new horror. Can you maintain your sanity long enough to escape, or will you become another lost soul within the Backrooms?

Prepare for an unforgettable horror experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat, as you uncover the dark secrets of the Backrooms and confront the spirits of the forgotten.

70010000089177.name: Car Cops
70010000089177.intro: From traffic stops to high-speed chases – think you’ve got what it takes to keep the streets safe?
70010000089177.description:
In Car Cops, you’re more than just a regular cop – you’re the sharp-eyed officer who never misses a clue! Patrol the streets, pull over suspicious drivers, and dive into the action-packed life of a police officer. Each stop could lead to a dangerous criminal, a desperate chase, or someone in need of urgent help.

Check IDs, inspect faces, and scan every detail to decide if the driver is innocent or up to no good. From cutting open seat cushions, to defusing bombs in car trunks, you’ll need to stay alert and rely on your instincts and gear. And when a wanted criminal crosses your path, prepare for a heart-pounding chase – and don’t hesitate to take action when it’s time to draw your weapon!

But it’s not just about the bad guys – you’re there for the people, too. Some drivers might need CPR, others may have a car fire or a breakdown that only you can handle!

Features:
- Detailed Vehicle Inspections: Check IDs, match faces, and look for suspicious items in cars.
- Intense Car Chases: Follow criminals on the run in fast-paced pursuits across town.
- Showdowns with Criminals: Be ready for action when criminals fight back – take cover and return fire to stay safe.
- Professional Police Tools: Use x-rays, slice through seat fabric, and explore every corner of the car for hidden surprises.
- Deliver Justice: Bring suspects to court, where you decide if they’re guilty or innocent.
- Emergency Responder Role: Jump into action, offering CPR, putting out car fires, or helping with breakdowns on the road.

Think you can spot a criminal at first glance? Put your instincts to the test!

70010000089188.name: BeatBlast: Rhythm Rampage
70010000089188.intro: Ride the Rhythm, Blast the Beats, Save the Universe!
70010000089188.description:
Dive into the electrifying world of BeatBlast: Rhythm Rampage, where music and mayhem collide in a heart-pounding symphony of destruction!

As Tempo, a music-powered supersoldier, you're on a mission to take down DisKord, the malevolent AI threatening to silence the universe. Blast through procedurally generated levels, synchronizing your every move and shot to the beat of the music.

Key Features:

Rhythm-Based Combat: Unleash devastating attacks by shooting in sync with the beat. The better your timing, the more powerful your assault!
Arsenal of Melodic Weapons: Wield an array of music-themed weapons, from bass cannons to treble launchers. Each weapon has its own rhythm and style.
Dynamic Environments: Watch as the world around you reacts to the music, creating a living, breathing battleground that changes with every beat.
Roguelike Progression: No two runs are the same! Unlock new abilities, weapons, and power-ups as you fight your way through DisKord's minions.
Parkour to the Beat: Wall-run, slide, and double-jump your way through levels, all in time with the music. Master fluid movements to outmaneuver your foes.
Boss Battles: Face off against DisKord's lieutenant AIs, each with their own musical theme and rhythm patterns to decipher and destroy.

BeatBlast: Rhythm Rampage isn't just a game—it's a pulsating, adrenaline-fueled experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Can you find the right rhythm to save the universe from eternal silence?

Sync up, lock and load, and prepare for a musical massacre like no other. The symphony of chaos awaits in BeatBlast: Rhythm Rampage!

70010000089193.name: SCP-087 THE STAIRWELL HORROR
70010000089193.description:
Item: SCP-087
Object Class: Euclid

Special Containment Procedures:
Access to SCP-087 is restricted to authorized personnel with Level 3 security clearance. Exploration sessions within SCP-08 are limited to a maximum duration of 60 minutes and are to be conducted using D-Class personnel for exploration purposes.

Details:
SCP-087 refers to an anomalous structure that appears to resemble a stairwell. Attempts to reach the end of the stairwell have been unsuccessful, with subjects reporting an oppressive atmosphere upon entering the structure. Auditory hallucinations, specifically the sound of distant and distressed voices, are frequently reported by those who explore SCP-087. Light sources do not function effectively beyond a few meters within the structure, as the surrounding darkness appears to absorb any illumination.

Document 087-0:
This document details the initial efforts to investigate SCP-087 using D-Class personnel.

70010000089198.name: Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival
70010000089198.intro: Show your ability to survive! Be a part of a wild world with unlimited borders!
70010000089198.description:
Step into the untamed wilderness of Isolation Instinct, a captivating open-world survival game where you are the architect of your own destiny. Carve a path through a vast forest teeming with life, danger, and opportunity. Every decision you make will impact your journey as you fight to survive and build a haven in the heart of nature.
Features:
- Explore Diverse Environments: Uncover unique landscapes, climates, and inhabitants across four distinct regions.
- Master Survival: Gather resources, hunt, fish, and build shelter to thrive in the wild.
- Deep Crafting: Craft tools, weapons, clothes, and more to customize your experience.
- Build Your Civilization: Erect defenses and establish your own haven in the wilderness.
- Skill Development: Sharpen your survival skills to become a master of the wild.
- Immersive Experience: Your success depends on your wit and determination.
Embrace the challenge. The forest awaits.

70010000089203.name: Aquatic Life: Fish Simulator RPG
70010000089203.intro: Join the ultimate aquatic journey where survival is just the beginning!
70010000089203.description:
Dive deep into a vibrant underwater world in Aquatic Life: Fish Simulator RPG! Embark on an epic adventure as a small fish with a big destiny. Explore stunning coral reefs, vast oceans, and winding rivers as you evolve into a powerful and majestic creature.
Features:
- Evolve & Adapt: Transform from minnow to legend, unlocking powerful abilities. Choose your playstyle: predator or survivor.
- Build Your Community: Rescue fish, forge alliances, and create a thriving underwater society.
- Explore Diverse Biomes: Dive into stunning Coral Reefs, vast Oceans, and winding Rivers. Each with unique challenges and secrets.
- Race for Glory: Test your speed and agility in thrilling underwater races!
- Stunning Visuals: Immerse yourself in a captivating underwater world brought to life.
- Endless Discovery: Uncover secrets, encounter fascinating creatures, and forge your own path.
   With Aquatic Life: Fish Simulator RPG , you’re not just playing a game; you’re diving into a captivating journey where you can explore, survive, and thrive in an extraordinary underwater universe. Are you ready to take the plunge? The ocean is calling—your adventure awaits!

70010000089208.name: Pool Fever
70010000089208.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70010000089208.description:
Pool Fever brings the classic game right to your Nintendo Switch™, perfect for beginners and pool sharks alike! 

Pool Fever offers a fun, accessible, and realistic billiards experience. With stunning 3D graphics and intuitive gameplay, you’ll feel like you’re playing in your favorite bar or pool hall. Whether you want to play in solo mode or challenge a friend in 2-player local multiplayer – either way, the table is set for hours of entertainment.

Choose from 10 different table designs, 15 unique cues, and 5 custom cue balls to create your perfect game setup. With three difficulty levels, you'll always have a challenge no matter your skill level.

So, chalk your cue, line up your shot, and sink the 8-ball - it’s game time!

Features:

10 different table designs 
15 unique cues sticks
5 custom cue balls 
3 difficulty levels
Play solo or in 2-player local multiplayer
Realistic 3D graphics

70010000089213.name: D.C. Re:tune
70010000089213.intro: On a spring day where cherry blossoms gently dance, a love story that will create butterflies in your stomach begins, begins—
70010000089213.description:
The pinnacle of school romance adventures, "D.C.~Da Capo~" returns in full force with a complete remake!

■ Highlights

・New storylines unfold with the addition of new heroines

・Filled with vivid portrayals of the psychological distance between the heroines

・A grandeur performance inspired by gorgeous illustrations from a team of highly acclaimed creators including Natsuki Tanihara and Yuki Takano

・Available with full voice acting (except the main character)

・Enjoy stunning computer graphics

■ STAFF

Character Design: Natsuki Tanihara, Yuki Takano

Original Art: Natsuki Tanihara, Yuki Takano, Haru Azuma, Shayuri

Scenario Director: Aibane

Planning & Production: CIRCUS

Publisher: Bushiroad

■ CAST

Asakura Nemu: Kaede Hondo

Sakura Yoshino: Chiharu

Kotori Shirakawa: Kana Ichinose

Miharu Amakase: Miku Ito

Moe Mizukoshi: Sayumi Suzushiro

Mako Mizukoshi: Yurie Igoma

Yoriko Sagisawa: Kaori Ishihara

Fuuki: Hikaru Tono

■The Story

Hatsunejima, an island where the "everlasting cherry blossoms" bloom all year round, regardless of the season.

At Kazami Gakuen located on Hatsunejima,

there's a boy who can magically create Japanese sweets out of thin air,

and has the somewhat fantasical ability to be shown others’ dreams.

This boy, whose catchphrase is "what a drag",  is Junichi Asakura, a student there.

He has a naggy and clingy stepsister, Nemu Asakura.

Junichi had been living his school life with graduation approaching, alongside talented singer and school idol, Kotori Shirakawa, and friends.


Then one day...

Sakura Yoshino, his childhood friend who went abroad six years ago, returns.

And she looks exactly the same as she did six years ago.

On a spring day with cherry blossoms quietly dancing in the air, an endearing love story begins—

70010000089218.name: 2 in 1: Trash Punk & S.N.I.P.E.R - Hunter Scope
70010000089218.description:
Get double the excitement and value with this Trash Punk bundle! Each game offers its own unique experience, and together, they provide hours of fun across different genres. 

This bundle includes:

1)Trash Punk: Dive into a post-apocalyptic world filled with danger, where you'll scavenge weapons and fight your way to survival in a wild, chaotic environment.

2)S.N.I.P.E.R. Hunter Scope: Step into the shoes of a sniper as you take on intense precision-shooting missions across hostile environments.

70010000089223.name: 2 in 1: Trash Punk & Moto Rush GT
70010000089223.intro:
Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
Rock the apocalypse in punk style!
70010000089223.description:
Get double the excitement and value with this Trash Punk bundle! Each game offers its own unique experience, and together, they provide hours of fun across different genres. 

This bundle includes:

1)Trash Punk: Dive into a post-apocalyptic world filled with danger, where you'll scavenge weapons and fight your way to survival in a wild, chaotic environment.

2)Moto Rush GT: Speed through traffic and chaos in high-octane motorbike runner where reflexes and tricks are your key to victory!

70010000089228.name: 2 in 1: Trash Punk & Urban Flow
70010000089228.intro:
Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
Rock the apocalypse in punk style!
70010000089228.description:
Get double the excitement and value with this Trash Punk bundle! Each game offers its own unique experience, and together, they provide hours of fun across different genres. 

This bundle includes:

1)Trash Punk: Dive into a post-apocalyptic world filled with danger, where you'll scavenge weapons and fight your way to survival in a wild, chaotic environment.

2)Urban Flow: Keep the cars moving in this traffic strategy game, where you'll manage traffic lights and ensure smooth flow on the roads.

70010000089233.name: Scurge: Hive
70010000089233.intro: Only you can save the world from the deadly virus known as Scurge
70010000089233.description:
Take on the role of acclaimed bounty hunter Jenosa Arma on a shocking and dangerous mission. Our heroine has been contracted by the Military to recover a top-secret science laboratory on an obscure distant planet. 

To her surprise, the cause of the disaster is a notorious virus known as “Scurge”, which has the ability to enslave all things to its destructive will. Powered by bio-protective armor, Jenosa is able to resist but not destroy “Scurge”. 

She must use her agility, her weapons, and her wits to contain and ultimately defeat the cruel virus before it spreads. 


Features:
* Iconic hardware action-adventure classic
* Isometric platforming, combat and puzzles
* Epic science-fiction narrative
* Upgrade your arsenal
* Unique “infection meter” mechanic
* Rewind/Turbo function: repeat something until you achieve perfection, or speed things up 
* Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point 
* Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.) 
* Gallery: view images from the original game’s manual and box design 
* Cheats function: activate cheats that will make your mission a lot easier (infinite lives, invulnerability, etc.)

70010000089235.name: Cop Officers: Police Simulator of NYPD City
70010000089235.intro: Be the Hero Who Protects: Your City Needs You!
70010000089235.description:
Embrace the thrill of the chase and become a dedicated officer in "Police Simulator" a captivating simulation game that places you in the heart of a bustling metropolis.
Key Features:
1. Become a Guardian of the City: Choose your character and embark on a challenging yet rewarding career in law enforcement.
2. Patrol the Streets: Cruise the city in iconic police cars or navigate tight spaces on a Segway, ensuring no corner escapes your vigilance.
3. Enforce the Law: Make arrests, issue fines for parking violations, and maintain order on the roads, upholding justice and safety.
4. Conduct Thorough Investigations: Search individuals, uncover illegal items, and contribute to a safer environment for all citizens.
5. Embrace the Hero Within: Be the frontline defender against crime, protecting the city from harm and becoming a symbol of hope for the community.
6. Test Your Skills: Step into the shoes of an NYPD officer and put your determination and professionalism to the test in diverse situations.
"Police Simulator" provides you with a unique experience in the world of police service, where your determination and professionalism will be front and center. Are you ready to answer the call of duty and become an unwavering guardian of order in NYPD City?

70010000089240.name: Warfront Tactics: Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator
70010000089240.intro: Master Every Battle: Every Tactic, Every Troop, Every Triumph!
70010000089240.description:
Unleash the commander within Warfront Tactics - Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator, a captivating physics-based strategy game that thrusts you into the heart of epic warfare. Strategically allocate your resources, craft a formidable army, and outmaneuver your opponents in intense battles governed by realistic physics. Witness the chaos and spectacle of combat as your meticulously planned strategies unfold on the battlefield. Every decision carries weight, every encounter presents a challenge, and every victory is hard-won.

Features:
   1. Strategic Depth: Craft cunning tactics and deploy your forces with precision to overcome formidable adversaries. Limited resources demand careful planning, ensuring every decision has a consequence.
   2. Realistic Physics: Witness the raw power of war as realistic physics bring battles to life. Troops collide, formations crumble, and projectiles hurtle through the air in a dynamic and immersive simulation of combat.
   3. Diverse Challenges: From defending against relentless waves of enemies to launching decisive offensives, conquer a multitude of scenarios that demand unique strategic approaches.
   4. Dynamic Battlefields: Immerse yourself in the heart of the action as battles unfold in real-time. Adapt to the ever-shifting tides of combat, exploit opportunities, and lead your troops to glorious victory.
   5. Unmatched Customization: Experiment with a vast array of units, formations, and strategies to personalize your army and discover the tactics that dominate the battlefield. No two battles are ever the same.

       Are you ready to claim your place as a legendary commander?

70010000089245.name: Little Nightmares III - Free Trial & Friend's Pass
70010000089245.description:
Step into the Spiral with the Free Trial & Friend’s Pass of Little Nightmares III. 

This special offer lets you experience the beginning of the adventure at no cost - solo or with a friend in online co-op on the same platform. It also allows you to play the full adventure for free in online co-op if your partner owns a copy of the game on the same platform as yours.

- One or two players can experience the beginning of Little Nightmares III for free, even without owning the game. Each player simply needs to download the Free Trial & Friend’s Pass. If they choose to play together, both must be on the same platform and invite each other online. Should one player purchase the full game, progress made during the Free Trial will carry over, allowing both to continue seamlessly. With one unlocked copy, the entire campaign can be completed in online co-op on the same platform.

- The Free Trial & Friend’s Pass also lets you play the full game together online on the same platform: one player owns the full version, while the other just needs to download the Free Trial & Friend’s Pass to join.


Take on the roles of Low and Alone, two best friends trapped in the eerie lands of the Spiral. Work side by side to solve puzzles, survive terrifying encounters, and uncover the secrets hidden in the shadows.

Try it today, invite a friend, and discover how far you can go together.

70010000089250.name: Please, Touch The Artwork 2
70010000089250.intro: ‘Where’s Waldo’ meets Modern Art in this cozy hidden-object adventure.
70010000089250.description:
◆ Award winning franchise (winner Google Play Indie Festival 22)◆ 

You are a dandy, suit-wearing, art-loving skeleton, recently risen from the grave, with the ability to travel into and through paintings. Using this ability, you help repair rips in the paintings and find missing items for the people living inside of them. 

A slow paced relaxing experience filled with humor, surprising characters and beautiful hand painted art, carefully crafted from works by James Ensor, a Belgian Modern Art pioneer.

The game was created with the support of the Flemish Government on the occasion of the Belgian EU Presidency 2024.

◆ Features ◆
+ Hidden-object adventure
+ 5 unique worlds
+ Hints when stuck
+ Casual point & click gameplay
+ Zoom-in for extra details
+ Real hand painted art
+ Atmospheric relaxing sound
+ Slow-paced & relaxing
+ Funny and playful, great for ages 12+

70010000089255.name: TRON: Catalyst
70010000089255.description:
TRON: Catalyst pulls you back into the world of Disney’s TRON with an original new story. Explore stunning and diverse environments across the Arq Grid as you discover the rich backstory of this crumbling society. Interact with flawed, yet fascinating characters, face off against rival factions, ride Light Cycles, and keep one step ahead of the ruthless ‘peacekeepers’ as you unlock the mysteries of this Grid and learn what kind of hero it needs you to become. Try to survive as you’re relentlessly pursued by Conn, a malevolent program with an agenda of his own, and learn the truth about the glitches that threaten the stability of this world.

Features

IMMERSIVE NEW STORY
Lose yourself in an original TRON storyline. Meet the programs of the Arq Grid, uncover their secrets, and fight to survive in a chase across the city and outlands. Playing as Exo, a courier working in this Grid’s capital city, your life is turned upside down when a mysterious package explodes, granting you powers beyond any program’s normal function.

AUTHENTIC TRON SETTING
Walk the neon-lit streets of the Arq Grid, or travel by Light Cycle, and discover a diverse Grid filled with intriguing stories revolving around a budding revolution. Enjoy an atmospheric electronic soundtrack by composer Dan Le Sac, returning from TRON: Identity, as you explore this unique Grid to recruit powerful allies, forge meaningful alliances and prepare to face the coming storm!

EXPLOIT THE GLITCH
The Arq Grid is losing stability and chaos is gripping the server. Glitches roll back the clock, catching the world in a series of system-level time loops that only you can see. Use Exo’s unique ability to restart a loop with retained knowledge, unlock time-saving shortcuts, and influence the factions jostling for control over the Grid.

DYNAMIC COMBAT SYSTEM
Fight for the Grid! Battle a legion of fearsome enemy programs in melee and ranged combat, both on-foot and while riding Light Cycles. Master advanced techniques like parrying and Disc kicks to gain the upper hand, while exploring the Arq Grid and collecting Data Shards to upgrade your code base and grow stronger.

70010000089259.name: Kingdom Rush Vengeance
70010000089259.intro: It's payback time! Lead your powerful dark army and make the Kingdom tremble with each step! Build mighty towers and find the most deadly combinations.
70010000089259.description:
The most acclaimed tower defense franchise is back with a fresh new twist!
Vez’nan the powerful almighty wizard has returned! Embark on an epic journey as you gather his army and fulfill his devious plans. Get ready to show the Kingdom who the real boss is! Fight your way as you conquer the new and the good old realms. Face empires of mighty enemies and clash against supreme bosses in this classic tower defense full of humor and epicness!

Game Features
- 20 towers, each with unique abilities and special powers.
- Choose your arsenal of towers and make devastating combinations to stop your enemies!
- 32 challenging stages across 8 lands ripe for the taking!
- 15 powerful heroes who will follow your command without hesitation.
- Over 60+ deadly enemies that will put all of your wit and tactical skills to the test.
- Rush the Kingdom as you bring down 6 mighty Kings in the most legendary of boss fights!
- New powers and reinforcements to vanquish your foes.
- 10+ trinkets and artifacts for that extra edge in battle.
- 30 upgrades to train your army to their best form.
- 60+ Achievements, hidden secrets and fun stuff for you to play and discover!
- In-game encyclopedia! Learn all about your enemies and you will be able to plan the best strategy to defeat them. Study up!

70010000089264.name: Cho Aniki Collection
70010000089264.intro:
Have you been hitting the gym?
The intensely muscular shooter is back!
70010000089264.description:
The first game in the legendary Cho Aniki series of shooting games created by Masaya, Cho Aniki (PC Engine), and the second game in the series, Ai Cho Aniki (PC Engine), have been fully ported for the Nintendo Switch™.
The ports of these classics boast a number of additional features, such as Sound Mode, Visual Mode, and Rewind.
These titles are an absolute must for retro game and shooting game fans alike.

Cho Aniki (Released 12/25/1992)
The Emperor of Planet Builder, who has won the Galactic Bodybuilding Contest for 10 consecutive years, is worried that his planet's protein is running low.
The Emperor, believing that "muscle is the greatest of virtues," has begun indiscriminately invading neighboring planets and building protein mining plants on them.
Sensing an impending crisis, Idaten and Benten of the Heavenly World set out on a mission to achieve peace by destroying the Builder Army...


Ai Cho Aniki (Released 2/24/1995)
Two years have passed since Idaten and Benten last fought.
After the death of Emperor Roid, peace was restored to the galaxy, and people returned to lives of peace...
Meanwhile, Idaten sensed disturbances again in the Builder Star System and went alone to investigate.
His last known location was on Planet Builder! Upon hearing this, Benten dispatched two heroes, Adon and Samson, to search for Idaten and investigate the strange happenings on Planet Builder.

70010000089272.name: First aid essentials: How to be prepared for emergencies
70010000089272.intro: Complete first aid guide: CPR, burns, fractures, and more. Respond with confidence to emergencies and accidents of all kinds.
70010000089272.description:
Take charge in emergencies with this all-encompassing first aid guide! Covering essentials like CPR, treating burns and fractures, and organizing a complete first aid kit, this guide gives you practical tools to handle unexpected situations safely.

From workplace emergencies to outdoor incidents, learn effective responses to falls, chemical exposure, and wilderness injuries. You’ll get detailed insights into managing heart attacks, breathing emergencies, and helping children in accidents, plus guidance on psychological first aid for stress and trauma.

Specialized chapters on first aid in traffic accidents and natural disasters prepare you for diverse scenarios, while checklists throughout make critical steps easy to follow. This guide empowers you to act confidently in any situation, fostering a proactive, calm mindset in the face of emergencies.

70010000089275.name: How to plan events: A step-by-step guide
70010000089275.intro: Create unforgettable events! Plan, budget, design, and coordinate every detail seamlessly with this comprehensive guide.
70010000089275.description:
Discover how to design unforgettable events with this interactive planning and management guide. You'll learn to set clear objectives, create detailed budgets, choose the perfect venue, and craft a unique atmosphere that leaves a lasting impression on your attendees. From formal corporate events to charming social celebrations, gain key strategies to ensure flawless organization and captivate every participant.

Explore techniques for coordinating activities, working effectively with vendors, and confidently handling any emergency situation. Delve into design and decoration, ensuring every detail aligns with your creative vision and theme. Master the process of setup and execution, while maintaining the flexibility needed to adapt to changes and unexpected challenges. With practical tools and helpful insights, this guide is your ultimate resource for taking your event planning to the next level.

70010000089278.name: MONPIC -The Hatchling Meets a Girl-
70010000089278.intro:
A heartwarming tale of the bond between a dragon hatchling and a girl transforming into a dragon!
"It would be wonderful if we could meet again someday."
70010000089278.description:
'Humans' and 'Monsters' inhabit this world.

Yuzuki, a student studying 'Monsters,' gets lost in the forest for a school project.
Overcome with hunger, she eats an apple she finds.
However, that apple was intended for a 'Monster' she encounters in the forest—a dragon hatchling named 'Piko'....

"Gyao! Gya, gya. Gyu, gyao!"
"...Come again?"

And then, after eating the apple, a change began to manifest in Yuzuki...
"Huh?! H-Horns?!
Wha... What the heck?!
Why do I have horns?!
What's happening to me?!"

Will Yuzuki ever be able to return to her 'Human' form?

MONPIC is a short fantasy adventure game where you can experience a captivating story of 'Monsters' and 'Humans' while enjoying a point-and-click exploration game. 

Guide Yuzuki and Piko on their journey.

70010000089280.name: Doll Style: Underground Design and Dress
70010000089280.intro: Create unique styles for your girls with casual urban looks! Combine clothes, hairstyles and accessories to shine on the streets.
