70010000089280.description:
Are you ready to create the coolest and most urban looks? Design unique and comfortable outfits that will make your girls shine in their everyday life. Explore a wide variety of clothes, hairstyles and accessories to mix and match in original ways. Unleash your creativity and become the most trendsetting stylist on the street!

Featured Features:

-Infinite combinations: Create unique urban styles by combining clothes, hairstyles and accessories - the possibilities are endless!
-Photo mode: Save your favourite looks with photo mode and share them with your friends.
-For all styles: Perfect for fashion experts or beginners.
-Customise hairstyles and accessories: Change hair colour and style and add accessories to make each look even more unique.

Start styling your most casual and urban looks right now and show off your streetstyle!

70010000089282.name: Servonauts
70010000089282.intro: Servonauts is an absurd couch co-op gas station builder for 1-4 players!
70010000089282.description:
You are the Servonauts - a team of dedicated, enthusiastic and utterly replaceable service station attendants. Work together with your friends to refine fuel, build pipelines and manage mayhem in many exotic locations throughout the galaxy.

Refine Fuel
When cars pull into your servo, they’ll request specific kinds of fuels. Build machines to refine this fuel, and combine fuels to make advanced recipes! But be careful - pumping the wrong fuel can have *explosive* consequences.
Astroil does not offer compensation for injuries related to employee mishaps.

Build a Pipeline
To pump these cars, you’ll need Astroil’s patent-pending pipe technology! These wobbly, physically-simulated pipes can bend and stretch to get fuel where you need it. They’re even partially lava-resistant (unlike the Servonauts)!

Up to Four Player Co-op
Play in single-player with in-game support or grab your mates to jam it out as a duo, trio, or chaotic 4 player quartet. Work with your team and optimise your logistics as you aim to collect all three Gold Stars. Will this mean the Servonauts finally get a vacation? (Don’t be ridiculous…)

Game supports local couch coop. 

Are you Astroil's next Employee of the Month? Then get ready to launch!

70010000089287.name: Cubic Run
70010000089287.description: Navigate, Survive, Score! In Cubic Run, you control a vibrant blue cube speeding through an endless corridor filled with geometric obstacles. Your objective is simple: avoid the obstacles, stay on course, and rack up points as the speed increases. But don’t be fooled—this game is far from easy. Each level introduces new challenges, pushing your reflexes to the limit. Turn left or right with the joystick, find the perfect rhythm, and brace yourself for the ever-increasing pace!

70010000089292.name: tiny Cats
70010000089292.intro: In tiny Cats, play as a magic girl exploring a mysterious house. Find, save, and purify hidden cat while uncovering secrets. Each chapter brings new surprises and more cats to collect.
70010000089292.description:
In tiny Cats, step into a world of magic and mystery as a young magic girl exploring your late aunt's enigmatic mansion. This isn't just any old house—it's a place where spirits of cats are scattered, hiding in the shadows and waiting to be found. Each cat you save brings you closer to uncovering the mansion's secrets, as every spirit has a story to tell and a bond to form.

But the mansion isn't just a home to lost spirits; it holds darker secrets and sinister forces that want the mysteries kept hidden forever. As you search every room and uncover clues, you'll confront these dark forces determined to keep the truth buried. Do you have what it takes to save the cats and unravel the mansion's mysteries before it’s too late?

Tiny Cats isn't just a game; it's a journey of exploration, puzzle-solving, and magical discovery. With each chapter, encounter new surprises, challenging puzzles, and more cats to collect and purify. Find, save, and bond with these spirits, and uncover the truth that will set them free.

Are you ready to reveal the secrets and become the hero these tiny cats desperately need?

70010000089302.name: The Messenger
70010000089302.description: As a demon army besieges his village, a young ninja ventures through a cursed world, to deliver a scroll paramount to his clan’s survival. What begins as a classic action platformer soon unravels into an expansive time-traveling adventure full of thrills, surprises, and humor.

70010000089308.name: Spot The Difference: Classic Finding Puzzle
70010000089308.intro: Classic puzzle with finding differences - show all your attentiveness and ingenuity to find all the differences in the pictures!
70010000089308.description:
An exciting challenge awaits you, where attentiveness and observation will become your best allies!

You are given two similar images, and you have to find 10 differences between them. Discover a variety of pictures from a variety of topics: nature, cities, animals, fantasy worlds and much more.

Various images
The game offers a variety of unique and bright pictures, which will allow you to enjoy the game without repeating yourself. Each new image gives a fresh challenge!

Exciting levels
As you progress through the game, the difficulty level gradually increases. The further you go, the more attentive and focused you need to be.

Development of attention
The game is not only entertaining, but also helps develop attention, concentration and observation skills - an ideal workout for the mind!

Are you ready to test your observation skills and solve exciting visual riddles? Dive into the world of riddles and become a master of spotting the differences!

70010000089319.name: Jet Combat: Cats VS Dogs Military Simulator
70010000089319.intro: Choose your side and rule the skies!
70010000089319.description:
Soar into the skies with Jet Combat: Cats VS Dogs Military Simulator, where the age-old rivalry between cats and dogs takes flight in this high-octane aerial combat game. Choose your side in this epic battle as either a daring dog or a cunning cat pilot, and dive into action-packed missions that will test your skills in the clouds.

Key Features:

- Choose Your Faction: Fly as a fearless canine or a stealthy feline pilot, each with unique aircraft and abilities.
- Dynamic Combat: Engage in thrilling dogfights using a diverse arsenal of aircraft, from agile fighters to powerful bombers.
- Multiple Game Modes: Master the solo campaign or challenge other players in explosive multiplayer arenas.
- Rich Progression System: Earn ranks and medals to unlock new aircraft, skins, and special maneuvers.
- Stylized Worlds: Battle across beautifully rendered skies and landscapes that offer both visual splendor and strategic depth.
- Customization Options: Give your pilot a personal touch with custom skins, upgrades, and abilities.
- Interactive Soundtrack: Enjoy a soundtrack that captures the spirit of this wild cat vs. dog rivalry.

Prepare for take-off in Jet Combat: Cats VS Dogs Military Simulator and claim the skies in the furriest flight combat game ever. Download now and unleash your inner ace in this ultimate battle of paws and claws!

70010000089324.name: Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator
70010000089324.intro: Drive your parking empire to success! Be the top manager in the city.
70010000089324.description:
Ready to dive into the exciting world of car parking management? Take charge and become the ultimate Parking Lot Tycoon in this thrilling first-person simulation game! Get behind the wheel and drive your success to new heights.
    Unleash Your Business Acumen
As a first-person simulation game, " Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator" puts you in the driver's seat of a car parking manager. Your objective is simple but challenging: build and manage parking lots to maximize your revenue and establish yourself as the top tycoon in the industry.
    Strategic Planning and Upgrades
Every decision counts in your quest for success. Strategically develop and upgrade your parking facilities, ensuring they are attractive, secure, and equipped with the latest technology. Expand your empire by acquiring new properties, optimizing space utilization, and providing exceptional customer service. The sky's the limit!
    Uncover an Engaging Story
Beyond the exciting gameplay, " Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator" delivers an intriguing narrative experience. Unravel the mysteries of the land you own as you progress through the game. Discover the history behind its affordability and uncover the truth behind the legendary curse that has haunted previous owners. Cutscenes triggered by milestones will immerse you in a captivating storyline, adding depth and excitement to your entrepreneurial journey.
    Face Challenges Head-On
Building a parking empire is not without its obstacles. Prepare to tackle unforeseen setbacks and overcome them with your wit and ingenuity. As you develop the land, you may encounter equipment malfunctions, unexplained accidents, or strange weather phenomena. Find innovative solutions, debunk superstitions, and turn setbacks into opportunities.
     Master the Art of Revenue Maximization
Your success as a Parking Lot Tycoon hinges on your ability to keep your hourly rates competitive and attract a steady stream of customers. Balance pricing strategies with customer satisfaction to create a thriving business. Prevent criminal activities, maintain the safety of parked vehicles, and provide exceptional service to keep customers coming back for more.
      Are you ready to build your parking empire and rewrite the history of the land? Embark now on an exhilarating journey of entrepreneurship. Your destiny as the ultimate Parking Lot Tycoon awaits!

70010000089333.name: World War II City Rebirth Tycoon
70010000089333.intro: Lead a war-torn city to prosperity in a post-WWII rebuilding adventure.
70010000089333.description:
Rise from the ashes of conflict in 'World War II City Rebirth Tycoon,' where you take the helm as mayor to rebuild a devastated European city. This low-poly city builder challenges you to navigate the intricacies of post-war recovery. Harness strategic planning and resource management to transform ruins into a flourishing metropolis.

Key Features:

- Strategic City Building: Construct residential, commercial, and industrial zones. Revitalize infrastructure and manage the city’s layout to encourage growth and stability.
- Resource Allocation: Make critical decisions on resource distribution to optimize construction, city services, and resident satisfaction.
- Historical Challenges: Face unique post-WWII scenarios that affect your city’s path to recovery, from economic hardships to political upheavals.
- Dynamic Population Management: Ensure your citizens’ needs are met to improve their quality of life and attract more residents.
- Authentic Atmosphere: Dive into a stylized low-poly world that beautifully mimics the - European landscapes of the post-war era, enhanced by a period-inspired soundtrack.

'World War II City Rebirth Tycoon' offers a deep, engaging experience for strategy and simulation enthusiasts alike. Rebuild history, shape the future, and lead your city into a new era of prosperity. Can you turn the tides of devastation into an anthem of revival?

70010000089338.name: Catching Spirits
70010000089338.intro: Hunt your prey, escape your predator - the 1v1v1 party brawler. Pick from 12 shamans with unique abilities and special attacks. Three forces, one fight - who will prevail?
70010000089338.description:
Catching Spirits is a wild and explosive party game for everyone: easy to learn, hard to master!
This triangular brawler-platformer will push friendships to their limits.
Only one rule: catch or be caught!
Three elements, one winner, who will prevail?

Experience a fresh take on multiplayer battles with a unique triangular combat system: hunt your prey while escaping your predator in a nonstop cycle of attack, dodge, and strategy.

Step into the magical world of Yoshin Müllen, where three tribes - Earth, Water, and Fire - clash in an ancient rivalry.
Fight as a shaman across mythical arenas, from the Smoky Swamps to the Deadly Jungles and the hidden Crypt beneath the Shaman Temple.
It’s a world of secrets where only the most agile survive.

With its original multiplayer gameplay, colorful cartoon art style, and dynamic soundtrack, Catching Spirits is the perfect choice for your next game night!

• Local multiplayer for up to 3 players: fast, chaotic, and fun!
• Innovative “rock-paper-scissors”-inspired system: a unique 1 vs 1 vs 1 format.
• Easy to play, tough to master: deep mechanics with high skill potential.
• Short, intense matches (around 3 minutes).
• High competitive potential for fierce duels.
• 9 interactive and vibrant environments.
• 12 playable shamans, each with unique powers.
• Over 50 trophies to unlock and secrets to uncover.
• Fully customizable game rules.
• 4 bot levels and 3 AI behaviors to sharpen your skills.

70010000089343.name: Buried Alive: Breathless Rescue
70010000089343.intro: Face Your Worst Nightmare: Can You Survive Being Buried Alive?
70010000089343.description:
Are you ready to embark on a spine-chilling adventure? Step into the shoes of the protagonist and experience the terror of being "Buried Alive" in a crypt. Your mission is clear: Escape the confines of your coffin, find the key to unlock the door, and unveil the dark secrets that lie within.
  Your mission: escape the suffocating grip of the coffin and find your way to freedom!
 Unlock the Secrets:
    As you claw your way out of the coffin, you awaken in a desolate crypt, shrouded in darkness. The eerie silence is broken only by the soft drip of water and the faint echoes of your own footsteps. A blood-stained old bat and a cryptic note lay before you, beckoning you to uncover the mysteries that lie ahead.
 Unearth Hidden Clues:
    Explore the crypt's chilling depths and unravel its secrets. Search every nook and cranny, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover hidden clues that will lead you closer to your escape. But be warned, every step you take brings you closer to the lurking dangers that lie within.
 Test Your Ingenuity:
    Your survival hinges on your ability to think on your feet and solve intricate puzzles. Piece together the fragmented clues, decipher cryptic riddles, and unlock the crypt's hidden passages. Your ingenuity will be your greatest ally in this race against time.
 Uncover the Dark Tale:
    As you venture deeper into the crypt's unforgiving chambers, a haunting tale of despair and tragedy unfolds. Unveil the story behind the blood-stained bat and the cryptic note, and uncover the chilling secrets that bind this place.
 Escape or Succumb:
   Every decision you make will determine your fate. Will you conquer your fears and escape the clutches of the crypt, or will you succumb to the darkness that seeks to consume you? The choice is yours, but remember, time is running out.
 Dare to Escape "Buried Alive":
Let the adrenaline rush through your veins. Face your darkest fears, challenge your intellect, and fight for your survival. "Buried Alive" awaits the brave. Will you escape the tomb and see the light of day once more? The crypt awaits your arrival!

70010000089348.name: English Sensei: Teaching in Japan
70010000089348.intro: Take control of a young teacher's destiny! Each decision will influence her relationships and lead her to discover unique endings. Which will you choose?
70010000089348.description:
Meet a young English teacher who, despite facing difficult situations with some students, struggles to maintain her professionalism.

In this experience, every decision you make will affect the relationships and events within the classroom.

Will you choose a firm and ethical path, or will you let your emotions get the better of you? Every decision counts and every ending will be unique!

With multiple outcomes depending on your choices, invites you to discover fascinating possibilities - make your story unforgettable!

70010000089350.name: Mr. Sensei: Life as a Foreign Teacher in Japan
70010000089350.intro: Decide the fate of a teacher! Every decision influences his relationships and leads to unique endings. Which will you choose?
70010000089350.description:
Immerse yourself and decide the course of the story! Meet a young English teacher who, although he is attracted to some of his students, strives to maintain his professionalism at all times. In this novel, the choices you make will have a direct impact on how relationships and situations develop in the classroom.
 
Will you follow a path of discipline and respect, or will you give in to the advances of the students? Full of twists and turns and exciting moments that are completely up to you - every choice counts and every ending will be different!
 
With multiple endings based on your decisions. Explore different paths. Make your story unique and discover what outcome awaits you!

70010000089357.name: Whittingham Asylum: The Investigation
70010000089357.intro: Will you expose the secrets, or become one of them?
70010000089357.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in a bone-chilling adventure. Unravel the truth, face your fears, and expose the hidden darkness that lies within Whittingham Asylum. The answers await you, brave investigator!

Calling all brave investigators! 
Prepare to embark on a chilling journey as you step into the shoes of John Simmons, a determined journalist, in search of the truth. Uncover the mysteries that shroud the local Whittingham Psychiatric Hospital and face the horrors that await within.

Follow the Trail of Fear
As the investigation intensifies, you stumble upon an intriguing interview with a former employee of the asylum, shedding light on the eerie happenings within its walls. But the real breakthrough comes when a voice message from the asylum's deputy warden, Mrs. Bexley, offers you an invitation to visit the notorious institution. A chance to see firsthand if the rumors and whispers hold any truth.

A Sinister Boat Ride
Your journey begins as you board a boat at Heemsley Harbour, bound for the isolated island that houses Whittingham Asylum. The setting sun casts an ominous glow, foretelling the terrors that await you. Mrs. Bexley beckons you to witness for yourself the state of the asylum and write your exposé. Brace yourself for an unforgettable exploration of dark corridors, abandoned wards, and the horrors that lurk within.

Uncover the Truth, if You Dare
As you navigate the twisted corridors of Whittingham Asylum, you'll encounter unimaginable horrors and confront the chilling presence that haunts its halls. Will you maintain your sanity and piece together the puzzle of the disappearances, or will you fall victim to the asylum's sinister secrets?

70010000089362.name: 2weistein in Rongerland
70010000089362.intro: Action Adventure and practicing maths basics: „2weistein“ combines lots of fun with a modern way of training maths. Often one also has to solve puzzles.
70010000089362.description:
This is the German version of "2weistein - Ronger Pirates".

The Story
All was peace and quiet in Asban and the whole land of Trillion – until that day on which the gates remained closed, as if by ghostly hand, and other strange things happened. The mean magician Godron has stolen the book „Mathematica“ from the creator of Trillion, and has cast an evil spell over the city: a ban on mathematics. Godron wants to gain power over the whole land and transform the world according to his will. But there are the brave heroes Bernard and Celestine with their friend 2weistein who want to put a stop to Godron to keep Trillion peaceful and beautiful, and no one is ever to be afraid again!
 
About the 2weistein games
The unique and fantastic idea behind the series of 2weistein games is to train maths in a real 3D action adventure. Embedded in the tantalizing story the player has to solve maths quests or puzzles to get ahead in the game. It was developed by game specialists in cooperation with teachers and psychologists and won several prices and awards.
 
Features
Language: German
Puzzles and maths quests in a real game and great story
Action adventure game with maths quests
High quality 3D graphics and fully animated 3D characters
Fondly designed characters and varying 3D-animations
Atmospheric soundtrack and native speakers
6 level, playing time about 6 hours, high replay value
Playable character: Bernard
Written and spoken instructions with lots of encouragement
Tasks seamlessly integrated into the gameplay, thereby high exercise and learning effect
Choice between number range: 1-100, 100-1000, 1000-10.000
Training maths: Basic arithmetic operations
Puzzles
Helps to control impulsiveness, concentration, attention
Action planning and skill exercises
Lots of fun

„2weistein in Rongerland“ is a self-contained episode from the Action Adventure  „2weistein – Das Geheimnis des roten Drachen“.

70010000089364.name: Banana-Clicker
70010000089364.intro: Unlock rare banana treasures with every click!
70010000089364.description:
Get ready to dive into the zany world of Banana-Clicker, where clicking is the name of the game and bananas are your golden ticket to fun! This wildly entertaining experience invites you to embrace the absurdity and thrill of collecting, and conquering the banana kingdom.
Why You’ll Go Bananas?
- Satisfying Clicks: There’s nothing like the rush of clicking your way to glory! The addictive gameplay keeps you glued to the screen as you boost your banana count with every satisfying tap.
- Unique Banana Collectibles: As you click, special bananas with outrageous designs pop up. From funky patterns to whimsical shapes, these treasures add a layer of excitement to your collection. The rare ones can be worth a small fortune!
    Absolutely! Banana-Clicker is all about letting loose and having a blast. Perfect for both casual players and hardcore clicker enthusiasts, it delivers endless fun without any pressure. Whether you’re in it for the clicks or the collectible frenzy, this game is sure to keep you entertained.  The world of clicking awaits—are you ready to go bananas?

70010000089369.name: How to master social Media Marketing
70010000089369.intro: Master social media marketing with this comprehensive guide! Learn how to create engaging content, strategise and maximise your impact.
70010000089369.description:
Master the art of social media marketing with this guide that covers everything from the basics to advanced strategies and emerging trends. You will learn how to define clear strategies, set measurable goals and schedule posts to maintain a consistent presence.

Discover how to create engaging visual content using graphic design tools and storytelling techniques that captivate your followers. Boost your reach by collaborating with relevant influencers and optimise your advertising campaigns with key metrics such as ROI and CPC.

Explore how to leverage current trends and technology tools to maximise your impact, integrating social media marketing with SEO and content marketing strategies to create robust and effective campaigns. This guide will prepare you to face the future, adapt to change and maximise your impact on every social network. Become a leader in the digital world!

70010000089372.name: Meditation and mindfulness: How to live in the moment
70010000089372.intro: Master mindfulness & meditation to boost calm, creativity & focus. Reduce stress, improve sleep & enrich daily life with this guide.
70010000089372.description:
Explore a path to calm, clarity, and well-being with this comprehensive meditation guide. You'll learn the fundamentals of this ancient practice, from basic mindfulness techniques to advanced methods for achieving deeper inner connection. Discover how meditation can improve your sleep, reduce stress, and boost creativity.

Integrate mindfulness into your daily activities, work, and personal relationships to foster a more conscious and connected life. Master techniques to overcome insomnia, engage in empathetic conversations, and strengthen your relationships. Plus, find strategies to stay motivated, overcome common obstacles, and take your practice to the next level with advanced techniques.

This guide also shows you how to apply mindfulness in your creative process and incorporate meditation into your lifestyle, achieving a healthy balance between work and personal life. Become more present, centered, and capable of facing any challenge with serenity.

70010000089375.name: Kvark
70010000089375.intro: Kvark is an retro FPS game set in a fictional version of the 80s Czech Republic. The player finds themselves in an underground facility that is falling apart as they travel through it.
70010000089375.description:
Get ready for an unforgettable journey into the heart of the 80s Czech Republic in Kvark, a gritty FPS experience where the stakes are life and death. You’ll find yourself trapped in a decaying underground facility, its halls crumbling and riddled with danger. Navigate dark, labyrinthine tunnels, fight off deadly enemies, and survive the many challenges this dystopian world throws your way. Kvark is not just a game, it’s a test of skill, endurance, and nerve.

Why Kvark?

- Unique 80s Czech Setting: Immerse yourself in a reimagined 1980s Czechoslovakia, filled with eerie atmosphere and Cold War-era tension.
- Intense Combat: Face off against relentless enemies in tight, claustrophobic spaces that demand precision and quick thinking.
- Challenging Environment: The facility is falling apart, and you'll have to adapt to unexpected threats, from malfunctioning machinery to toxic hazards.
- Compelling Story: Unravel the mysteries of the facility and uncover secrets that will keep you on edge.

Features:

-  FPS Mechanics: Experience intense gunplay with diverse weapons and tactical choices.
- Survival Challenges: Limited resources mean every decision counts.
- Dark Atmosphere: Explore a deteriorating underground world that feels alive with danger.
- Intriguing Lore: Discover the hidden history of Kvark and the twisted experiments conducted within its walls.

Prepare to survive. Kvark is a test of your resolve—do you have what it takes to escape the horrors lurking below?

70010000089380.name: Leo & Mia : Animal Rescue
70010000089380.intro: Become a valiant animal rescuer as either Leo or Mia! Save wildlife in the savannah from poachers and other dangers in over 15 exciting missions!
70010000089380.description:
Set out on an adventure to save wildlife from poachers and other dangers! Embark on exciting missions to help elephants, giraffes, lions and many more species survive the dangers of the savannah! 

Leo is Back! - Our valiant cat from Leo: The Firefighter Cat is back for a brand-new mission! Helped by Mia, Leo is now a courageous animal rescuer! 

A Brand New Leo Adventure - Play as Leo or Mia and explore various terrains, including the savannah, mangrove forests and mountains with your “Beegun” and your hand-glider. Take care of endangered animals in your rescue center.

Save & Collect - Fight against poachers and save animals in danger in over 15 unique missions. Don’t forget your camera to take pictures of the cutest animals for your personal photo gallery!

King Of Animals - Unlock new skins for your heroes while serving as a loyal wildlife rescuer.

70010000089401.name: Class of Heroes 3 Remaster
70010000089401.intro: The wait is over! Class of Heroes 3 finally leaves Japan after 15 years!
70010000089401.description:
Class is back in session! After a 15 year wait Class of Heroes 3, the revered school-themed dungeon RPG series, is finally here!

Enrol in one of three distinct schools and join your fellow students on an epic dungeon crawling adventure.

Enjoy school life on campus and meet brand new friends for a huge range of characters and classes.

Choose your party to suit your play style and then take to the sprawling 3D dungeons to take down enemies and acquire loot to see your party get ever stronger.

With hundreds of combinations of Race, Classes, armours, weapons and Items, you can create a wild array of party compositions to take on the challenges ahead!

Remastered for an all new generation, Class of Heroes 3 is the pinnacle of this much loved series!


Enter the dungeon: Class of Heroes 3 takes 3D dungeon-crawling RPGs to a new level - with more characters and bigger dungeons than ever before!

Back to School: Choose from one of three distinct schools - each will change your uniform, difficulty and story!

Make new friends: The new relationship system will allow you to forge (or break!) bonds with the fellow students in your party. The stronger the bond, the greater the benefit!

Let’s party: Team up with fellow students from a huge range of races and classes to build the best possible party of heroes to explore dungeons with.

Plunder the dungeons: Take your party into colossal, labyrinthine dungeons - fight off enemies and plunder the loot to make yourself stronger on each run!

Build it your way: With hundreds of weapons, armour and items - along with  even more combinations of races and classes. Customise your team to suit your playing style!

New and improved: As the third iteration in the series, every aspect of the original games has been enhanced and improved to make this the most enjoyable in the series yet!

70010000089419.name: There's No Aliens
70010000089419.intro: There's absolutely no aliens! We all know they are a myth and nobody ever seen one!
70010000089419.description:
There's No Aliens is a hidden object game with a selection of 9 locations and random aliens to find for each of them. 

- 9 Different Levels 
- 3 Difficulty Settings 
- replayable with 20 aliens out of 60 selected for each play 
- hint system 
- zoom

70010000089433.name: Thought Experiment Simulator
70010000089433.intro: This is a stupid game that might include Trolley Problem, Ship of Theseus, Brain in a Vat, Infinite Monkey, Sisyphus, Prisoner's Dilemma, Schrodinger's Cat, etc.
70010000089433.description:
Engage in a quirky, voice-acted exploration of philosophical dilemmas, where humor meets profound thought. It takes about 2 hours to finish.

Interactive Philosophy: Step into the shoes of history's greatest thinkers, engaging with dilemmas like the Trolley Problem and Schrödinger’s Cat.

Dynamic Gameplay Modes: Choose from Sim Mode for open-ended exploration, Challenge Mode for timed tests, or Story Mode for narrative-driven insights.

Stylish Presentation: Experience the conundrums in a simple yet expressive black-and-white art style, highlighting the abstract and absurd nature of philosophical inquiry.

Voice Acting with a Twist: Enjoy a dynamic narration that might break the fourth wall, adding character and levity to each philosophical puzzle.

Educational Yet Entertaining: Not just for philosophy buffs; it's an accessible way to ponder life's big questions while having a laugh.

This game promises to make you think, laugh, and question—often all at once. Perfect for those looking to scratch both the comedic and cerebral itch.

70010000089438.name: Bubble Wizard Saga
70010000089438.description:
Evil forces are threatening to overrun OZ Wizard Country as the Dark Sorcerer and her wicked minions spread chaos. But there’s a new wizard in town, and she’s ready to fight back with powerful new magic! Join the battle against the Dark Sorcerer and help reclaim OZ Wizard Country, one piece at a time.

Your magic is crucial to driving out the dark spirits plaguing the land. Travel across the realm, bursting as many bubbles as you can in this thrilling adventure. Win levels, free OZ Wizard Country piece by piece, and rise to the challenge in this epic saga. Share your best scores on the global leaderboard and prove your mastery!

Features:
★ Over 200 magical levels filled with excitement!
★ Special boosters & magic potions to help you conquer tricky challenges.
★ Easy to play but progressively challenging to master!
★ Daily rewards—earn more coins every day!
★ Enchanting graphics and spellbinding sound effects.
★ Nintendo Switch™ online leaderboards—compete with friends and players worldwide! (Optional)
★ Supports multiple languages.
★ Compatible with Joy-Con™, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller, and touchscreen controls.

70010000089448.name: Bad Cheese
70010000089448.intro: Bad Cheese is a psychological horror game inspired by the eerie charm of 1920s animation.
70010000089448.description:
Step into the tiny paws of a mouse spending the weekend at home with a dysfunctional Dad while Mom's away. Be on your best behavior and KEEP DADDY HAPPY.

Complete tasks, eat snacks, find toys, and navigate the "complicated family dynamic." 
Experience the gruesome reality of a child-mouse trying to maintain a sense of normalcy in a not-so-normal household. 
Every family has a corpse in the closet and in this house, there are many closets.

Hand-drawn art combined with a 16mm film-inspired aesthetic will make you feel like you're watching a scary cartoon from the golden era of animation.

Additional languages:
- Polish (PL/POLSKI),
- Turkish (TUR/TÜRKÇE).

70010000089453.name: Makis Adventure
70010000089453.intro: Embark on a shape-shifting adventure with a bite as you morph between the forms of human and shark!
70010000089453.description:
Take the role of Maki as you explore a world of unique islands, meeting new friends and dashing through the waters using 3 different shark forms. Makis Adventure is a side-scrolling action platformer that lets you decide how to tackle its unique challenges. Whether you prefer to fight or focus on exploring, there’s plenty to discover and decide your play style.

Run, wall jump, swim and bite your way through dungeons and use momentum as a shark to power through levels in blistering 2D pixel art style, defeat mini bosses and end bosses along the way, then use the 3D hub world to fly between uncharted lands, complete ring mini games and more!

• Traverse wild and deadly islands in the form of a human or shark!
• Run, jump, swim and bite your way through side-scrolling stages.
• Shift into 3D as you roam the hub world of uncharted islands!
• Focus on combat or exploration.
• Play mini games, find hidden treasures and even go fishing!

70010000089458.name: Rivenaar's Grove
70010000089458.intro: Harvest ingredients for potions to prove your worth as the apprentice of a skilled magician!
70010000089458.description:
Rivenaar's Grove is a top-down fantasy adventure spin on sliding puzzles. The quick little apprentice can only move in straight lines from one border of the field to another. It’s up to you to figure out how to use these nimble movements to gather crops as quickly and efficiently as possible.

Once each field is cleared, you’ll be able to move to the next, with 50 levels in all! As you progress, new traps, obstacles and portals will be introduced, making it even trickier to harvest. To further prove your worth, you can tackle challenge modes with limited moves and time limits. Can the student truly become the master?

Features:

• Take the role of a magician’s apprentice!
• Move in straight lines to harvest crops from fields.
• Overcome obstacles, avoid hazards, use portals and more!
• Respawn and retry levels as many times as it takes.
• Put your skills to the test in special challenge modes!

70010000089463.name: FREEDOM WARS Remastered
70010000089463.description:
Born into a one-million-year prison sentence, you must survive deadly missions to earn any hope of freedom. Die in prison or live on the battlefield. The choice is yours.

CONVICTED FROM BIRTH FOR THE CRIME OF LIVING
In a distant future where all resources on earth have been depleted, being alive is a sin by itself. As a sinner sentenced to one million years in prison, you must volunteer in dangerous operations to reduce your prison sentence and fight your way to freedom.

THREE-DIMENSIONAL HIGH-SPEED COMBAT
Use your most trusted weapon, your Thorn, to dominate the battlefield. Stand alongside your allies and your warden cyborg Accessory to face off against powerful enemies.

ENHANCED GRAPHICS
Re-rendered graphics vividly portray desolate worlds, colossal prison cities, powerful enemies, and fierce battles.

New features in the remastered version:
- High-resolution textures
- Added difficulty level settings
- Overhauled weapon crafting system

*A Contribution Edition is also available. Please take care not to make duplicate purchases.

70010000089470.name: Speedway Legends: Overdrive Racing
70010000089470.intro: Burn rubber, break limits, become a Legend!
70010000089470.description:
Unleash the ultimate high-octane experience in Speedway Legends: Overdrive Racing! 
This isn’t just another racing game - it’s a full-throttle test of skill, speed, and style. With a lineup of adrenaline-pumping modes, each race is a chance to etch your name into the asphalt.

*Drift Mode – Slide, glide, and defy physics as you master the art of sideways speed. String together insane drifts, rack up points, and leave a trail of burning rubber behind!

*Circuit Mode – Strategize every turn, overtake rivals with precision.

*Time Attack Mode – The clock is your enemy. Can you push your car to the limit and shave milliseconds off your best lap? Only the fastest survive.

*Overdrive Mechanic – Charge up your Overdrive meter and unleash supercharged speed bursts that bend the laws of physics. Blow past competitors and leave them eating dust!

*Customize & Conquer – Build your ultimate racing machine and prove your dominance.

*Become a Legend – Whether you're drifting, conquering professional circuits, or fighting against time itself, only the best can claim the title of Speedway Legend.

Strap in. Grip the wheel. Overdrive awaits.

70010000089475.name: MINI HOCKEY CUP
70010000089475.intro: Lace up your skates! Your favorite ice sport is here in a new fun form—control the puck and upgrade your team!
70010000089475.description: Welcome to the Mini Hockey Cup, where only the best rise to the top! Battle your way through 4 competitive leagues and prove your skills in 3 challenging tournaments. Customize your strategy by upgrading formations and improving your team’s performance in the shop. Every match brings you closer to glory—will you lead your team to victory and claim the championship? Lace up your skates and hit the ice!

70010000089487.name: Clash of Rivals
70010000089487.intro: Clash of Rivals is a strategic card game where you build a powerful deck of warriors, archers, and mages to defeat your opponents in epic duels.
70010000089487.description: Immerse yourself in the world of Clash of Rivals, an exciting strategic card game that puts your tactical skills to the test! Choose from a variety of units—from fearless knights to powerful sorcerers—and build an unbeatable deck to conquer your rivals in thrilling battles. Play your cards wisely, use clever strategies, and become the ultimate champion. Whether you're an experienced player or a beginner, the intuitive gameplay makes it easy to learn while offering deep and lasting challenges. Enter the battle and prove your skills!

70010000089489.name: Footgun: Underground
70010000089489.intro: Roguelike with balls! Prove your ball skills and dribble your way through a randomly generated, dangerous track network full of deadly challenges!
70010000089489.description:
You wake up sometime in the future in a cryo capsule. You don't know who you are, but one thing is clear: You have a cybernetic leg, a ball and enemies to fight! Master your new weapon, explore this strange underground world and try to escape this post-apocalyptic madness.

Footgun: Underground has a very special challenge: Instead of guns, magic or swords you have only one weapon to master: your futuristic ball of death. In classic Roguelike fashion, you explore random rooms, fight different creatures and upgrade your equipment along the way. Death is part of your journey, so don't give up, learn the ball control and the synergies to successfully move forward through the dark depths of the underground. But beware, not all enemies are your normal grubs...

Just kicking the ball and hitting the enemies on the ground is pretty easy, but the true challenge lies in the precise control of your mighty weapon. Leverage the angles and layout of the rooms as well as the behavior of the different enemy types to create a barrage of violence.  With a variety of different, unlockable characters as well as a multitude of unique balls, each run you will find many builds and different playstyles to experiment with. 

Features

- Multiple characters and balls

- Glorious Pixel-Art

- Motivating upgrade system through stackable chips

- Variety of biotopes with unique enemies and bosses

- Piñatas?!

70010000089494.name: All-Star Supermarket Simulator: Vinyl Vibes
70010000089494.intro: Shop to the Beat: Vinyl Vibes is Here!
70010000089494.description:
Dive into the rhythm of retro shopping with All-Star Supermarket Simulator: Vinyl Vibes! This expansion brings a nostalgic twist to your shopping experience, filling the aisles with classic vinyl tunes as you browse, stock, and explore. 

Enjoy a curated playlist of iconic beats, exclusive vinyl decor, and a vintage-inspired ambiance that turns every supermarket run into a musical journey. 

Perfect for players who love combining gameplay with groovy vibes, Vinyl Vibes will keep you moving to the beat as you manage the ultimate supermarket!

70010000089499.name: Leo's Fortune
70010000089499.intro: Join Leo on a thrilling quest to recover his fortune! Immerse yourself in a beautifully hand-crafted world full of clever traps and puzzles.
70010000089499.description:
Once upon a fortune, there was me, Leo, a brilliant engineer with a coat of turquoise fur and an accent as thick as borscht. My gadgets were legendary whirring wonders that made me rich, amassing a mountain of gold. 

One day, my riches vanished, leaving me heartbroken and flatbroken. Now, ten years later, I am back on a whirlwind adventure to reclaim my lost fortune and find the thief.

Join me in this epic journey filled with twists, turns, and heartwarming moments as I follow the trail of gold and uncover the truth behind my stolen fortune!

•  Breathtaking Hand-Crafted Levels: Journey through meticulously designed environments, from lush mossy forests and arid deserts to bustling pirate cities and snowy mountains.
•  Challenging Physics-Based Puzzles: Engage your wits with intricate physics-based puzzles. Each challenge requires clever manipulation of the environment and precise timing, offering a satisfying test of skill and ingenuity.
•  Captivating Storyline: Follow the breadcrumb trail of gold and unravel the mystery of my stolen fortune.
•  Atmospheric Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the adventure with a beautifully composed soundtrack that perfectly complements the game's rich environments and emotional storytelling.
•  Hard-core Mode: For the ultimate challenge, try to beat the entire game without dying. This mode is designed for the bravest adventurers seeking to prove their skill and determination.
•  Character and World Rich in Detail: Experience a richly detailed world inhabited by intriguing characters, each with their backstory and connection to my quest. The game's vibrant animation and expressive art style make every interaction memorable.

Leo’s Fortune is a platform adventure game where you hunt down the cunning and mysterious thief that stole your gold. Beautifully hand-crafted levels bring the story of Leo to life in this epic adventure.

70010000089501.name: Meow Moments: Celebrating Renewal & Romance
70010000089501.intro: Join cute cats in festive scenes! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore New Year's on Copacabana beach and share sweet moments for Valentine’s Day.
70010000089501.description:
Join the Celebration! In Meow Moments: Celebrating Renewal and Romance, cats and friends come together to commemorate special occasions in two vibrant scenes that capture the warmth of new beginnings and heartfelt connections. Every corner is filled with details that spark the imagination, inspiring you to create your own stories around the lively moments you find.

Begin with the electrifying New Year’s Eve on Rio’s famous Copacabana Beach, where stunning artwork by Katia Numakura brings the festivities to life. With fireworks lighting up the sky, crowds of cats and friends enjoy the vibrant beach atmosphere. 
Then, step into a cozy Valentine's Day scene set in a beautiful, romantic square where couples and friends celebrate love and friendship.

Features:

- Cats and Friends: Find delightful characters amid two detailed scenes, each full of unique stories waiting to be uncovered.
- Balloon-Popping Fun: Enjoy relaxing gameplay as you pop balloons across the scenes—a bit of fun with every search!
- Rich Details: Explore beautifully crafted illustrations filled with festive decorations, bringing each celebration to life.
- Atmospheric Soundtrack: Get immersed in the mood with Tatyana Jacques’ exclusive soundtracks that match each scene, from beachy bossa nova to romantic melodies.
- Family-Friendly Fun: With cozy and entertaining gameplay suited for all ages, it’s an experience everyone can enjoy together. Don’t be surprised if the whole family starts pointing out the cats at once!

Join the cats and celebrate renewal and romance in this heartwarming adventure, perfect for cozy game lovers!

70010000089518.name: BODY CAM SHOOTER
70010000089518.intro: Feel the thrill of real combat, a shooter like no other!
70010000089518.description:
BODY CAM SHOOTER delivers an ultra-realistic first-person shooter experience crafted for players who crave authentic, high-stakes action. Step into the role of a tactical operator facing aggressive, armed NPCs in highly detailed environments. Equipped with two distinct weapon types and set across two unique maps, the game emphasizes strategy and adaptability in every encounter.
Key Features:
	•	Smart, Reactive NPCs – Expect a dynamic response from AI-controlled enemies, heightening the realism and challenge of every confrontation.
	•	Next-Generation Graphics – Stunningly detailed environments and smooth animations create a highly immersive atmosphere, pulling you into the action.
	•	Diverse Weaponry and Tactics – With access to two distinct weapon types, players can adjust their playstyle to fit each map and situation.
	•	Two Unique Tactical Maps – Each map presents its own challenges and multiple strategic opportunities, tailored to your approach.
Get ready for a shooter experience like no other, where every decision can mean the difference between survival and defeat!

70010000089529.name: Arcana Famiglia Rinato
70010000089529.intro: This is a story of destiny and bonds centered around Felicita, the daughter of the boss of Arcana Famiglia.
70010000089529.description:
Acrana Famiglia is an autonomous organization that protects the small island of Regalo in the Mediterranean Sea. 
Those who belong to the Famiglia have a mysterious power called Arcana, which they use to protect the island from outside enenmies. 
Felicita (main character/name can be changed), the only daughter of the organization's boss Mondo, has only just taken her first steps as a member of the family.
April 1st. It's Mondo's birthday. At a party thrown for him by the family, he makes a surprising announcement.

Mondo: "Two months from now...June 1. We'll hold the Arcana Duello!"
Mondo: "The winner of the Duello will become the leader of the organization...and as the new Papa, they will wed my daughter."

This is Felicita's story, as she fights to win the Arcana Duello in order to change her own destiny.

Felicita: "My path...is for me to decide."

・"Arcana Famiglia -La storia della Arcana Famiglia- Ancora", a game based on the concept of a Otome game × Shonen manga, originally available in 2015, will be ported to the Nintendo Switch™!

・The game progresses with a comic-like storyline that uses colorful illustrations called the Comiaru system. The game also features the unique Cocoaru System, which allows you to read the minds of other characters!

・Enjoy character designer and original artist Yomi Sarachi's beautiful CG illustrations in full HD quality!
The story is brought to life by a talented cast of voice actors including Jun Fukuyama, Tsubasa Yonaga, Hiroyuki Yoshino, Tomokazu Sugita, Yuichi Nakamura, Jurota Kosugi, and Koji Yusa.

70010000089535.name: Chained Climb Together
70010000089535.intro: Balance between you and your partner, survive together! One chain - one life, prove your ability to cooperate!
70010000089535.description:
Chained Climb Together invites you on an epic adventure. Bound by mystical chains with your companions, your goal is to ascend towering mountains by navigating treacherous terrains and overcoming obstacles. Perfect coordination is crucial as you tackle the rugged, vertical landscapes filled with unique challenges. This game is exclusively online, offering an exciting experience whether you play solo or in pairs. 

Key Features: 
	•	Vertical Challenge: Experience a unique twist on the climbing genre as you scale from the mountain base to its peak.  
	•	Chain Mechanics: Realistic chain dynamics add strategic depth to your ascent through perilous terrains. 
	•	Diverse Landscapes: Explore various mountainous environments with distinct and challenging conditions. 
	•	Conquer Heights: Claim and dominate new mountain areas as you climb higher. 
	•	Skills and Abilities: Master and upgrade powerful skills to aid your climb to the summit. 

Overcome Challenges Together! 
Navigate perilous mountain terrains while chained to your companions. This game is exclusively online, offering the chance to play solo or team up with others in multiplayer mode. Precision and coordination are key to survival. Embrace the challenge, master the strategy, and lead your team to the top!

70010000089548.name: Monument Valley
70010000089548.description:
Embark on a dreamlike adventure in the iconic Monument Valley, the award-winning puzzle game where architecture defies reality. Guide Princess Ida through surreal monuments, uncovering hidden paths and optical illusions that challenge perception.

Step into a world where the impossible becomes possible. In Monument Valley, you’ll guide the Silent Princess Ida through breathtaking landscapes, twisting staircases, and ever-shifting monuments. Each puzzle is a work of art, inspired by minimalist design, ancient architecture, and mind-bending impossible geometry.

Manipulate the environment to reveal hidden paths, outsmart the enigmatic Crow People, and uncover the secrets of the Sacred Geometry. With intuitive controls, an immersive soundtrack, and vibrant visuals, Monument Valley is an experience for every type of player. 

Features:

- Mind-Bending Puzzles: Rotate, shift, and reshape the world to reveal new paths.

- Beautiful Visuals: Inspired by optical illusions, and ancient architecture from around the world.

- Immersive Sound: A reactive, personal soundtrack that enhances every move you make.

- Complete Edition: Includes the Forgotten Shores expansion for the full journey.

Can you guide Ida on her quest for forgiveness? Discover why Monument Valley has touched the hearts of millions of players worldwide!

ustwo games are proud independent developers, best known for the award-winning Monument Valley series, Land’s End, Assemble with Care and Alba: A Wildlife Adventure.

70010000089553.name: Monument Valley 2
70010000089553.intro: A Story of Parenthood, Growth, and Discovery
70010000089553.description:
Return to the world of impossible architecture in Monument Valley 2. Guide Ro and her child through surreal monuments, uncovering hidden paths and discover the power of letting go.

Monument Valley 2 invites you on an award-winning emotional puzzle adventure where architecture transforms as you play. Join Ro and her child as they explore stunning, ever-shifting worlds, solving optical illusions that challenge perception and their lives.

Every puzzle is a beautiful work of art, blending vibrant colours and stunning designs with an emotional story and soundtrack. Monument Valley 2 is a heartfelt tale of growth and independence that all players can enjoy. 

Features:

- Touching Narrative: Experience the emotional story of parenthood and letting go

- Individually Crafted Puzzles: All new interactions to explore the changing dynamics between Ro and her Child. 

- Contemporary Art: Inspired by global architecture and contemporary art.

- Complete Journey: Every chapter is included for the most satisfying experience.

Discover the magic of Monument Valley 2 with Ro and her Child in this emotionally powerful sequel to Monument Valley.

ustwo games are proud independent developers, best known for the award-winning Monument Valley series, Land’s End, Assemble with Care and Alba: A Wildlife Adventure.

70010000089563.name: The Epyx Games – Sports Collection
70010000089563.intro: Relive over 50 different athletic and sporting events across eight of Epyx's retro classics in this remastered collection.
70010000089563.description:
In the 1980s, the gold-medal-winning name for sports games on the C64 was Epyx. Now you can relive over 50 different athletic and sporting events across eight of Epyx's retro classics in this remastered collection, including the best-seller California Games.

Take home the gold in everything from skiing to skateboarding, from wrestling to roller skating, from BMX to bobsled, and many more. Epyx games were known for their amazing animation and stunningly accurate and immersive gameplay, with some even developed in coordination with former Olympic athletes for a truely authentic experience.

Play with up to 8 players, with many events supporting two-player simultaneous play.

Featuring:
• Summer Games (1984) - The original competition
• Summer Games II (1985) - Return and go for gold
• Winter Games (1985) - Canada's slopes provide the greatest challenge
• World Games (1986) - Take on the globe
• Championship Wrestling (1986) - It's clobbering time
• California Games (1987) - The raddest, most totally tubular events ever
• The Games – Winter Edition (1988) - Take to the slopes once more
• The Games – Summer Edition (1988) - The ultimate athletic tournament

Experience these collector's classics with many modern features, including:
• Display filters (including retro CRT filters) and scaling options (including aspect-ratio-corrected and fullscreen options)
• Recreated game boxes - rotate to view from any angle
• Fully integrated game instruction manuals
• Save games - save and restore your games at any point
• Right- and left-handed control presets

70010000089568.name: Parcel Mania
70010000089568.description: Parcel Mania is a frantic online or local splitscreen party game supporting up to 4 players in a match. Your #1 goal? Collect and deliver the most parcels and become the best courier connoisseur of the match! Collect parcels from their stations, or smack ‘em out of your friends hands.

70010000089573.name: Bimfli & His Time Travels: Rome
70010000089573.intro: Bimfli and his time travels is an interactive graphic novel about the adventures of Bimfli, a young architect. It includes children's reading texts, dynamic images and ambient music.
70010000089573.description:
Bimfli and his time travels is an interactive graphic novel about the adventures of Bimfli, a young architect. The protagonist inherits from his grandfather a magical sundial with which he can travel through time and will find himself involved in different adventures, which will take place in the different capitals of the world. 

Traveling through different historical eras, the protagonist will discover the different monuments of the world and will do everything possible to protect them. The different characters that he will meet will make him learn about art history and Bimfli will be forced to solve great enigmas in his different adventures. 

In this chapter Bimfli will travel to Rome where he must help solve different architectural and artistic challenges. The protagonist will perform different feats to guarantee the preservation of some of the most important monuments and works of art in the world.

·Easy-play mode designed for kids.

·Delightful children's tales for an easy read. 

·Learn to read with fun stories in English. 

·Joyful ambient music and sounds based in the culture of each country. 

·Learn about monuments, cities, civilizations, geography and architecture. 

·Educational content about the history of art with the recreation of the best painters and architects. 

·Learn from the main capital cities as they were in ancient times. 

·Adjust accessibility settings such as font height, sound volume and image transition speed. 

·Embrace diversity and multicultural traditions by exploring the world with Bimfli.

70010000089576.name: Glimmer and the Dark Halloween Pumpkin
70010000089576.intro: In the quiet town of Hollowhill, every Halloween, lanterns not only light up the streets, but also protect the town from the dark forces that lurk.
70010000089576.description:
Glimmer, a bright little ghost, is tasked with making sure the pumpkins stay lit and the town is safe.

However, something strange happens one night: one of the key lanterns mysteriously goes out, threatening the town's safety. When shadows in the forest begin to move, Glimmer realizes she needs help. A group of brave town children—Lia, Max, and Tommy—team up with Glimmer to find out what's extinguishing the lanterns and restore Hollowhill's magical protection.

Can Glimmer and her friends save their town?

70010000089578.name: Bimfli & His Time Travels: Paris
70010000089578.intro: Bimfli and his time travels is an interactive graphic novel about the adventures of Bimfli, a young architect. It includes children's reading texts, dynamic images and ambient music.
70010000089578.description:
Bimfli and his time travels is an interactive graphic novel about the adventures of Bimfli, a young architect. The protagonist inherits from his grandfather a magical sundial with which he can travel through time and will find himself involved in different adventures, which will take place in the different capitals of the world. 

Traveling through different historical eras, the protagonist will discover the different monuments of the world and will do everything possible to protect them. The different characters that he will meet will make him learn about art history and Bimfli will be forced to solve great enigmas in his different adventures. 

In this chapter Bimfli will travel to Paris where he will discover that there have been robberies in the great Louvre museum. The protagonist will perform different feats to recover the missing paintings and save the city's monuments.

·Easy-play mode designed for kids.

·Delightful children's tales for an easy read. 

·Learn to read with fun stories in English. 

·Joyful ambient music and sounds based in the culture of each country. 

·Learn about monuments, cities, civilizations, geography and architecture. 

·Educational content about the history of art with the recreation of the best painters and architects. 

·Learn from the main capital cities as they were in ancient times. 

·Adjust accessibility settings such as font height, sound volume and image transition speed. 

·Embrace diversity and multicultural traditions by exploring the world with Bimfli.

70010000089580.name: TIMORE NARHELMA
70010000089580.intro: Timore Narhelma is a surreal experience about human mind and horrors within.
70010000089580.description:
"Are you afraid that if you wake up you won't recognize your life, but forever remember the dream you lived?"

Timore Narhelma is a surreal experience about human mind and horrors within. The text on the screen is asking you various questions, that all have a connection to your being, yet they don't seem similar on their own. You get to experience a fraction of your mind being tested, and you get to choose your answers. Probably.

This test also puts you in unique situations, asking you to show what would you do in the specific scenarios. Would you approach the horrors yourself, who would you kill, would you let go of your mind, body and your eyes? The game is a combination of a horror-test and 3D exploration of various environments, connecting the story together. You get asked various questions about the human nature, about yourself, and as the game progresses you get to know more about the character that you're controlling. Some answers are showing you what the character in the game might be thinking, even if you don't choose those answers. You're also going to meet a few known characters from Timore series. It's a unique approach to story-telling, and a surreal experience overall, leading you towards one specific goal. Choose your answers, prove them with your actions. Explore the surreal environments and characters living inside of them as you get closer to the city of Narhelma.

70010000089585.name: CatCat
70010000089585.description: Take on a journey with a brave cat! In each level of this adventure, spikes and traps demand insane precision to be overcome. You only have one chance, so if you fail, start over. Master the timing and prove your skill in this game where only the most persistent reach the end.

70010000089593.name: Tenshinouta:The Angel's Verse
70010000089593.intro:
Let These Feelings Reach the Heavens (You)
A Legendary RPG Reborn Through Timeless Music
70010000089593.description:
One of the finest RPGs on the PC Engine, distinguished by its rare use of Celtic mythology and its theme of romantic love between a man and a woman.

The game features a collection of majestic background music that perfectly matches its emotionally engaging worldview, visual scenes, and story—truly a set of must-listen masterpieces. In addition to the main storyline, the game offers plenty of depth, such as searching for rare weapons unique to each character, ensuring gameplay that never grows dull.

In a distant, ancient world, the protagonist Kael sets out on an adventurous journey to rescue Clare, a maiden of the heavenly realm and his fiancée, who has been abducted by monsters. Unbeknownst to him, however, a plot to bring about the revival of the Demon King Lucifer—and the destruction of the world itself—lies in the shadows. The game introduced groundbreaking elements such as a party system of up to five characters, while also delivering a poignant and bittersweet story centered on the relationship between Kael and Clare.

70010000089597.name: Tenshi no Uta: The Angel Verse II: The Fallen Angel
70010000089597.intro:
Let These Feelings Reach the Heavens (You)
A Legendary RPG Reborn Through Timeless Music
70010000089597.description:
The Tenshi no Uta series is widely regarded as one of the finest RPGs of its era, distinguished by its rare use of Celtic mythology and a central theme of romantic love between a man and a woman.

Its collection of majestic background music is filled with must-hear masterpieces, perfectly complementing the emotionally immersive world, visual scenes, and story. In addition to the main narrative, the game offers numerous depth-driven elements—such as searching for rare, character-specific weapons—providing engaging gameplay that keeps players invested throughout their journey.

Set in another world one hundred years after the previous title, the story follows the protagonist Fate, who encounters Riana, a young girl suffering from amnesia, and sets out on a journey to help her. In this other terrestrial realm beyond dimensions, the battle against the forces of darkness begins anew. Familiar characters, including Keal, the hero of the previous game, also return, and the weighty, continuous storyline—enhanced by iconic lines and memorable music from the original—delivers an emotionally stirring experience.

70010000089601.name: TOBOT : Action Quiz Heroes
70010000089601.description:
"Solve Quizzes to Protect Daedo with TOBOT!"

"TOBOT: Action Quiz Heroes" is an action-packed quiz game that combines thrilling battles with various trivia quizzes.

============================

▣ An exciting combination of "Quiz + Action"
▣ Defeat villainous robots with TOBOT!
▣ Various trivia quizzes on science, history, daily life, and more
▣ Climb the ranking and compete with friends by collecting points 
▣ Easy to play for people of all ages!!

============================

Fight off the villainous robots by answering quizzes, defeat them, and become a true hero!

70010000089610.name: Gunma's Ambition -You and me are Gunma- Reiwa 2nd national census edition
70010000089610.intro:
Hello.
Gunma Prefecture makes Japan Gunma Prefecture.
Everyone Gunma.
70010000089610.description:
Gunma's Ambition is now fully voiced.
Compatible with data from the Reiwa 2nd census!
Gunma Prefecture has become relatively stronger!
Everyone can play!

・Story mode
You become Gunma and collect special products.
If you get a special product, you can get G (GUNMA).

Next, select the prefecture you want to change to Gunma.
Then use G (GUNMA) to draw the gacha.

The people of the selected prefecture will change to Gunma for the population of the municipalities that came out in Gacha.
When everyone changes to Gunma, the prefecture changes to Gunma.

・Party mode
Includes 4 party games based on Gunma and Japan.
Up to 4 people can play together.

70010000089613.name: Chained Towards Heaven
70010000089613.intro: Climb from hell to paradise, bound by chains and teamwork!
70010000089613.description:
Embark on an epic journey from the fiery depths of hell to the lofty heights of paradise in “Chained Towards Heaven.” In this thrilling multiplayer co-op game, you and your friends start your adventure bound together by chains, making teamwork and precise coordination essential for survival.

The chain isn’t just a visual element—it’s governed by a dynamic physics simulation. This means it wraps around platforms and interacts with the environment in realistic ways, adding an extra layer of challenge and strategy to every move you make.

Your mission? To escape the infernal realms by ascending through a series of treacherous platforms and challenging worlds. Each leap requires perfect timing and synergy with your companions to overcome obstacles and avoid the searing heat below.

With diverse worlds offering unique trials, every climb is a test of skill and collaboration. Will you and your friends master the chains and reach the heavens?

70010000089622.name: Anne's Zombie Odyssey
70010000089622.intro: Heart-pounding 2D action returns! Play until your fingers hurt and zombie heads explode! Survive while drenched in blood. The bloody feast begins at your fingertips!
70010000089622.description:
Experience the ultimate in arcade-style thrills! Once you start, you can't stop! Use precise controls to blow zombie heads off and take down bosses. Prepare for a shocking ending!

・Intense, sweaty action awaits you
・Destroy zombies until your fingers shake! Survive in a bloody world!
・Non-stop shocking action! Blast your way through endless hordes of zombies!
・Extreme 2D side-scrolling action with flying blood!
・Brutal combat with exploding zombie heads and flying body parts
・Clear stages with precise zombie-slaying controls
・Unleash an arsenal of weapons and items to destroy zombies
・Discover hidden items and build your ultimate survival strategy
・Upgrade your character with each stage you complete
・Feel the rush of leveling up!
・Craft your unique strategy with a variety of upgrades: enhance weapons, boost health, and more!
・Develop new tactics to defeat the zombies in each stage!

Pure arcade addiction - once you start, you can't put it down!
Join Anne on her desperate journey to save her loved ones. Are you ready for this dangerous adventure?
Featuring non-stop action, a gripping story and breathtaking twists, this game delivers the authentic arcade experience right to your Switch. Get ready for a blood-soaked thrill ride you won't forget!  Defeat countless zombies and bosses, complete the final stage, and experience a heart-pounding twist ending! Download now and immerse yourself in a heart-pounding world of zombie-slaying action!

Prologue
Anne, a former member of a special forces unit, married a DJ who was also in the same unit, and they led a peaceful life after retiring from the army. Even in the midst of the zombie apocalypse, they lived a relatively peaceful life. But was it this peace that was the problem? One day, the mad scientist Dr. Crazy kidnaps DJ and Anne's life is turned upside down. To get her beloved husband back, Anne embarks on a daring rescue mission... Will she be able to rescue DJ safely?

70010000089629.name: ABYSS: BACKROOMS POOLS HORROR
70010000089629.description:
The man woke up and found himself in a strange place. 
There were huge pools of murky water all around, reflecting dim light. Every step echoed, and it felt like someone was watching you. The walls seemed to move, and it was unclear where you were. With each turn of the maze, the feeling of being watched grew stronger.

But who or what is hiding there? That was still to be found out, if we could find a way out.

70010000089634.name: Fool's Pub
70010000089634.intro: Have fun, bluff away and play a little trick on your friends!
70010000089634.description:
Welcome to Fool’s Pub - The Online Multiplayer Card Game.
This isn’t just a card game – it’s an online multiplayer battle where up to four players compete in a high-stakes game of skill, luck, and survival. Outplay your friends or strangers from around the world and prove you’ve got what it takes to be the last one standing.
- First-Person Fun: Experience the game through the eyes of your character, bringing you closer to the action with every draw, bluff, and shot fired.
- Play Your Way: Jump online to challenge others or enjoy offline mode with clever AI opponents when you’re flying solo.
- Cute and Dangerous: Meet adorable characters packing serious heat – their charm hides a fierce determination to win at any cost.
- Rough Rules, Wild Rounds: With Russian roulette-style mechanics, every turn could spell glory or disaster. Will you take the risk or play it safe?
- Only One Wins: In this pub, there’s no second place. Outwit, outplay, and outlast everyone else to claim the ultimate victory.
Get ready for the perfect mix of strategy, adrenaline, and chaos.
Fool’s Pub is calling – are you brave enough to answer?

70010000089641.name: Monstrix TCG Card Shop
70010000089641.intro: Monstrix TCG Card Shop – Where dreams become reality, and every card is a new adventure!
70010000089641.description:
Monstrix TCG Card Shop – Where dreams become reality, and every card is a new adventure!

Stock Up Your Shop
Fill your shelves with rare card packs, exclusive figurines, and collectibles that will leave your customers in awe!
Become the go-to destination for Monstrix fans by always having the latest and greatest in stock.

Customise & Design
Make your shop stand out!
From cozy nooks to flashy displays, create an inviting space that draws in collectors and players alike.
Your shop, your style!

Expand & Excel
As your business thrives, unlock bigger spaces and dedicated gaming zones for players to battle it out right in your store.
Watch your small shop grow into a legendary hub for all things TCG!

Manage Like a Pro
Balance stock, upgrades, and customer satisfaction to keep your business booming.
Make strategic decisions to outshine competitors and become the ultimate TCG tycoon.

Build Your Collection
Not just a shopkeeper, but a collector too!
Track down ultra-rare cards, assemble the perfect deck, and trade to complete your collection.

Join the fun and start your journey today!

70010000089646.name: Blast Rush LS
70010000089646.intro:
Blast your way through relentless waves in Blast Rush LS! 
Unlimited bombs, intense challenges, and explosive 
action await in this fresh take on bullet hell shooters.
70010000089646.description:
The enemy mothership has been destroyed and is about to explode. Reinforcements are coming, but your battered ship's guns are overheated and almost useless. Thankfully, you also have bombs. Lots of bombs. Blast Rush LS is a fast-paced bullet hell shooter with an endless supply of screen-clearing weapons.

It's just you, your ship, and seemingly endless amounts of drones in ever more complex waves. But hey, you got all those bombs to use! Blast your way out and rush to victory!

* A refreshing feature-packed take on shoot-em-ups that dares to ask: "What if bomb, but way too much?"
* Three distinct fighters with nine different screen-clearing bombs to try (and blow through enemies on an industrial scale) and extra techniques like destructive sideswipes or the slow-mo power of Hyperdodge!
* Take on over 40 intense levels with almost impossible amounts of drones in twisting, complex waves coming after your ship. 
* Prefer an even greater challenge? Have a go at the randomized Endurance or 2-minute styles.
* More blasting fun awaits in the “Blast Box,” a host of four challenges where you’ll beat the clock, fight enemies in the dark, wriggle through a dangerous maze, or launch a ship like it’s a sporting event.
* 16-bit-style graphics with a pulse-pounding chiptune soundtrack
* Explore the Library to check out game development notes, concept pixel art, a music player when you’re away from the action, and more!
* The full original version of Blast Rush is included as part of the package!

70010000089651.name: LunarLux
70010000089651.intro: Experience a sci-fi action-adventure RPG on the Moon in the year 30XX and save humanity from a deadly comet!
70010000089651.description:
LunarLux is an anime-inspired action-adventure RPG that takes place on the Moon! A thousand years ago, humanity lived on the now volcanic and lifeless earth-like planet known as Terra. Due to the planetary catastrophe, ASTRA, humans were forced to find a new home. Unfortunately, no habitable planet existed within a reasonable distance, so the remaining survivors made their way to Luna, the moon that orbits Terra. 

Filled with hope, dreams, and determination, Humanity continued to survive and flourish in a new home. Centuries later in the year 30XX, Luna became home to some of the most brilliant human minds in existence (and their creations). However, humanity's existence is now threatened by an oncoming antimatter comet - the same comet that wiped out the people of Terra a thousand years ago!

Join Lunar Warrior Bella as she fights her way across the Moon to find a way to destroy the comet before it wipes out life as we know it! Battle the mysterious monsters known as Murks using a hybrid turn & action-based battle system, uncover the secrets of a lost civilization, and save the Moon!

70010000089660.name: KAMiBAKO
70010000089660.description:
Mapcrafting x Puzzles x Battle x RPG!?

Repair the fragmented land through puzzles, and rid the world of darkness by defeating monsters. All resources obtained through repairing the land can then be used to design the world to your liking! The medley of genres in this RPG is surprisingly accessible to players of all types, but there's no shortage of challenging elements, too! A variety of activities and a vast world lie ahead. It's up to you to repair what has been destroyed and restore peace.


A Sprawling Overworld

Our adventure takes place in the distant continent of Noahtun, a region rich in land and sea with various seasons. As you move through the overworld, the land will materialize where you advance. What awaits in the untouched regions of the world? New encounters? Battles? Perhaps an instance of fragmentation? Find out for yourself by traveling to every corner of the land.


Puzzles

Restoration Puzzles are a mission exclusive to the Restorer. By clearing the puzzle, the fragmentation of the land is then eliminated, restoring the land to its former state.


"Map-Crafting"

If the land has not been afflicted with fragmentation, it can be developed to have farmland, buildings, and other facilities so you can harvest crops and various resources. As you develop the land, more resources can be obtained and even stores can be accessed. Once a certain number of facilities have been established and the area is enclosed by fences, walls, or gates, it will become a village or town and you can give it a unique name.


Battle

A variety of monsters may appear in the land you explore. They can harm or damage the land they occupy, so be sure to take care of them with the help of your teammates. When battle commences, your teammates will attack automatically. Your role as the Restorer will be to grant Mana to them throughout the battles duration. Through granting them Mana, the skill sets in their weapons will be charged, eventually allowing them to perform an extra powerful attack.


Story

Long ago...

Seemingly out of nowhere, the world suddenly began to fall to pieces, fragmenting into cubes. Amidst the disaster many lives were lost, and spawned from this calamity came natural disasters, decimating all land and water. 

The balance of the world was offset, and people's lives were forever changed.
The disastrous phenomenon that reduces the land to cubes, what became known as the "fragmentation", 
continued to spread throughout the world with no signs of stopping.

To restore the order of the world, the goddess Chroem selected an individual to fulfill the role of "Restorer", the one who would restore the lands. They were tasked to journey across the world and rebuild all that had been destroyed.

The tale of our Restorer, begins now.

70010000089664.name: Crowd Run
70010000089664.intro: Stop the hordes of enemies and defend your castle!
70010000089664.description:
Being a hero isn't easy. Use all your skills to protect people from the hordes. Stay alert to keep everyone safe.  

Use all available weapons to cause as much damage as possible. Find the explosives on the levels and blow up your enemies.

Clear the all levels from the danger and keep your fortress safe. Shoot. Reload. And shoot again. Repeat.   

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Clear your world from the enemies and keep everyone safe!

70010000089669.name: Slicy Flips
70010000089669.intro: Slicing is so easy and the pleasure is real
70010000089669.description:
Simple but addictive gameplay. Roll the knives and cut everything on your way.  

Each level is made for your pleasure and happiness. Feel the real ASMR every second you play. Slicing the fruit can be so satisfying. Try it for yourself.

Find the right rhythm and make the gameplay smooth and perfect!  

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Take your time and enjoy the game!

70010000089674.name: Decoration Rush
70010000089674.intro: Run and decorate! What could be stranger and more fun?
70010000089674.description:
Grab your team and start the race to become the best decorator. You can combine sport and beauty. Be careful because your opponents have the same goals!    

The gameplay is so easy and addictive that you will never want to stop. Try out all the variations and colors.

Complete all the levels and try new tactics and tricks. Surprise your opponents with unexpected moves in the arena!   

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Decorate and brighten up your world!

70010000089679.name: GROOVE COASTER FUTURE PERFORMERS
70010000089679.intro: Get Hooked on Rhythm!! Jump into a musical world on a roller coaster of sound and light!
70010000089679.description:
