■An Overwhelming Fusion of Music and Visuals
Groove Coaster is a rhythm game where you play along while racing down tracks that twist and turn to the music.

With dynamic sound and light effects, you’ll feel completely immersed—as if you’ve stepped into a world of music and are performing right inside it!

■Enhanced Visuals
For the first time in the series, the gameplay screen features a full horizontal layout, letting the world of music fill your entire view!

Visual expression has been greatly improved, and some songs even include scenes using the original music videos!

■Two Play Styles to Choose From
You can select from two different play styles to match your skill level!
Basic: Enjoy the game casually with four types of notes—perfect for beginners.
Advanced: Challenge yourself with nine types of notes—ideal for rhythm game veterans and fans of the classic series who want a deeper, more rewarding experience!

■Fully Voiced "Story Mode" Featuring a Star-Studded Cast
For the first time in the series, enjoy a luxurious, fully voiced Story Mode!

Centered around two protagonists, Sendou Kakeru and Himekawa Aria, a rich cast of characters—including classmates, teachers, and rivals from other schools—join the story.

The journey begins as they aim for victory in the "Groove Coaster" tournament, a futuristic sport where players perform while racing along the tracks...

Main Characters
- Sendou Kakeru(Voice: Kawashima Reiji/ Theme Song Artist: Somari)
- Himekawa Aria(Voice: Sakura Ayane/ Theme Song Artist: 40mP)
- Fwuff (Voice: Shirakami Fubuki / Theme Song Artist: NayutalieN)
- Sharsha (Voice: Sakura Miko / Theme Song Artist: Satsuki & Karasuyasabou)

■Includes Many Popular Songs from Anime, Vocaloid, and More!
In addition to original tracks, the game features a wide variety of popular songs from various genres!
- Idol / YOASOBI
- Bling-Bang-Bang-Born / Creepy Nuts
- Hai Yorokonde / Kocchi no Kento
- BOW AND ARROW / Yonezu Kenshi
- Demons Banquet / Tomonari Sora
- Good-Bye Declaration / Chinozo
- KING / Kanaria
- Mesmerizer / Satsuki
- God-ish / PinocchioP
- Lagtrain / inabakumori
- Override / Yoshida Yasei
- Bibbidiba / Hoshimachi Suisei
- Catcher in the Ui / Shigure Ui
- Heart Pie Dancehall / HIMEHINA
…and a total of 50 songs included!

Now, let’s ride the groove of the future!

70010000089684.name: Fear Effect
70010000089684.description:
It can recognize fear… can you?

Fear Effect, the pioneering cel-shaded cinematic action game, returns!

Days before her eighteenth birthday, the quiet, enigmatic Wee Ming Lam, disappears under mysterious circumstances. Hana, Glas, and Deke, three self-motivated and ruthless mercenaries conspire to track her down and ransom her off to her father, Mr. Lam, the most powerful Triad leader in Hong Kong, for a large sum of cold, hard cash.

What begins as a simple extortion mission to retrieve the young runaway becomes a lesson in survival against the most unimaginable of enemies.

Immerse yourself in this intense thriller featuring revolutionary Motion FX technology where you direct your cast of 3D characters within dynamic, full-motion-video worlds. Who lives? Who dies? Only you decide if you can control your fear.

70010000089686.name: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix
70010000089686.description:
Return to 2048 Hong Kong in the groundbreaking prequel that defined style and mature storytelling for a generation.



Set two years before the events of Fear Effect, dive into a sprawling adventure that takes you from futuristic cityscapes to the lost tomb of China's first emperor, and discover the origins of mercenaries Hana Tsu-Vachel, Royce Glas, Deke Decourt, and the enigmatic Rain Qin, in a story that blends high-tech espionage with ancient Chinese mythology and the supernatural.



Unforgettable Cinema

Be captivated by the iconic visual style, blending cel-shaded 3D characters with fully streaming, animated FMV backgrounds. It’s an unforgettable, graphic novel-like aesthetic that remains unique.



Survival Meets Action

Test your nerves with the innovative "Fear Effect" system, where your combat effectiveness is tied to your heart rate. Experience a world packed with intense action, strategic stealth kills, and classic survival horror puzzles.



Enhanced for Modern Platforms

Enjoy a timeless classic with enhanced quality-of-life features, including Save States, Rewind, Widescreen mode, Achievements, and CRT filters, to ensure an authentic experience.

70010000089692.name: 9th Dawn Remake
70010000089692.intro:
Venture into a massive 2.5D open world. 
Explore 45 new dungeons in single-player or online/local co-op.
Craft weapons, raise pets, play a deck-building card game!
70010000089692.description:
9th Dawn Remake is a massive open world RPG bursting with dungeon-crawling adventure. The game has been lovingly re-created based on the original 9th Dawn game released in 2012 … which spawned the 9th Dawn series you know and love! Play in single-player mode, or with a friend with Online or Local co-op modes! Experience a vast world filled with huge new dungeons, hordes of monsters, and ridiculous amounts of loot!

Following a strange disappearance of the local lighthouse keeper, you are sent on a quest to investigate an evil power stirring within the continent of Montelorne. The Castle of Maltyr calls the most powerful of monsters and poses a great threat to lands nearby. Become a champion by crafting and seeking the best gear, level up your skills and raise a mighty team of creatures to fight alongside you! - Are you the savior of Montelorne? Prove it.

Key Features:
- Massive Open World: Explore over 45 new hand-crafted dungeons, each brimming with deadly creatures and loot.
- Design your Build: Unlock spells and abilities, assign attribute points, and upgrade your equipment.
- Enjoy the full game and minigames in Single-player, Online co-op or Local co-op modes.
- Raise Monster Pets: Hatch friendly creatures from eggs and raise them into powerful allies.
- Side Quests: Aid the villages of Montelorne by partaking in a range of side quests.
- Loot and Prizes: Collect a vast amount of loot and fill your collecting journals for rewards.
- Deck Building Minigame: Collect maps, level up your card champions, create an epic deck.
- Epic Fishing Minigame: Take control of powerful worm-warriors and survive deadly waves of enemy fish.
- Side Quests: Help the villagers around Montelorne to raise prosperity and earn rare items.
- Craft the Best: Forge weapons, brew potions, and upgrade your weapons to become a champion!
- A complete remake of the original game: With a re-written updated story, new and bigger dungeons, and more action-packed content!

70010000089697.name: Shotgun Cop Man
70010000089697.intro: GO TO HELL, ARREST SATAN. Propel yourself to justice and glory on a journey through hell in this punchy, crunchy, son-of-a-gun precision platformer from the creator of My Friend Pedro.
70010000089697.description:
Blast your way through hell in Shotgun Cop Man, a precision platformer where your weapons are your wings.

Embark on a mission to arrest Satan armed with a devastating arsenal and a relentless thirst for glory. Propel yourself through hordes of irritable demons, devious traps, and thrilling challenges using the only two things you can trust: your wits and your weapons.

Firepower Propulsion
Master your movement through the twisted corners of hell as every shot propels you forward. Whether dodging enemies, scaling walls, or leaping impossible gaps, your weapons are the key to both survival and traversal.

Explosive Campaign and Challenges
Dive into an action-packed campaign in over 150 levels and face off against intense boss battles, then put yourself to the test and beat all the No Damage, Speedrun and Kill All challenges.

70010000089702.name: Snow Bros. Classic Collection
70010000089702.intro: Toaplan’s hit Snow Bros is back!
70010000089702.description:
It’s always more fun to throw a snowball than to be hit by one!


Toaplan’s hit Snow Bros is back! This arcade-style, fixed-screen platformer follows brothers Nick and Tom through epic levels in the Kingdom of Hottoda to save two trapped princesses, each possessing the magic of snow… and the only hope for the realm. As evil King Atchich seeks to take over the world, the snowmen we love must set out to storm the enemy’s fortress and rescue their princesses!



Shoot snow at your enemies, picking up items to enhance your fighting, from speed enhancements to shot powerups, becoming giant, and more. Each level features not only enemies but a boss fight, with unique characters to size up and snowball!


Whether you have loved them since the 90s or are just discovering the snowy goodness now, Snow Bros will show you exactly why it’s such a timeless game.

70010000089704.name: Escape Room Killer: Moon, flowers and the Creepy Ghost
70010000089704.intro: Wake up in an abandoned sanatorium with a single mission: escape before time runs out. A killer resides in your mind, provoking you and playing with your sanity.
70010000089704.description:
Every answer you give alters your fate, reducing or extending the time you have to escape.

Face a horror escape room where every decision matters. Explore dark passageways, solve gruesome puzzles, and overcome deadly traps. Use your wits to find resources and move forward while the voice in your head threatens to break your will.

Game Features:

-Double-edged dialogues: Communicate with the killer's voice; your responses can be your salvation or your doom.
-Immersive exploration: Discover rooms, corridors, and forgotten secrets of the sanatorium.
-Tension at every step: A suspense-filled atmosphere where every choice counts.
-Survival strategy: Find resources, solve puzzles, and stay one step ahead to extend your time.
-Multiple endings: Choose wisely and determine your final fate.

Can you escape the sanatorium and silence the voice that whispers death? The answer is in your hands.

70010000089709.name: Freddy Farmer
70010000089709.intro: Freddy Farmer is a retro arcade style game with 16-bit pixel art graphics in the style of the 80s/90s where you can test your skills as a player.
70010000089709.description:
Freddy's daughter has been kidnapped by an evil dragon that lives on top of an abandoned castle.

The only possibility to rescue her is through a magic potion that only a mysterious wizard who lives in the forest can make, but to do so, he will need to get some very specific ingredients and these in turn must be mixed in a certain order using magical cauldrons that are spread throughout the kingdom.

With the only action of jumping, Freddy must collect all these ingredients while trying to avoid all the enemies and dangers in his path until he reaches the cauldron of each of the levels having collected the ingredients in the correct order.

Features
- High-quality pixel art graphics with excellent 16-bit animations.
- 5 different Worlds with 7 levels in each of them.
- More than 25 types of enemies with their own characteristics.
- 2 different endings for the story.
- 5 different 8-bit style bonus levels that unlock mini-games.
- Galleries and unlockable extras.
- 3 game modes, each one more challenging than the last.
- Various cameos and references to cinema, literature and video games.
- Enjoy the CRT filter and 4:3 camera for a total retro experience.

70010000089724.name: Mission in Snowdriftland
70010000089724.intro: The pixel-art platformer for the winter season - also playable as an advent calendar or all year round. Cozy or challenging, it's up to you!
70010000089724.description:
STORY
Chaos at the headquarters of the video game organization, UPIXO: the villain, El Pix, has stolen some important and historically valuable artifacts of video game history from the archive.
Help Chubby retrieve all the artifacts from El Pix's icy realm of Snowdriftland!

GAME CONCEPT
Mission in Snowdriftland is unique in its concept:
Play it like a traditional Advent calendar, and select a level every day and let Chubby guide you through the cold winter days. Or play it like a classic platformer - any time you want.

SUITABLE FOR ALL
Mission in Snowdriftland offers the right gaming experience for all players: younger and less experienced gamers can get off to a quick and easy start and jump right in to start searching for the artifacts, while core gamers will face a cool challenge as they collect all 24 snowflakes per level.

CRAZY WORLDS
Prepare to confront some wacky enemies like penguins in squirrel costumes, polar bear joggers listening to music, flaming fire bumblebees and many more.

MINIBOSSES
Compete against four Minibosses, the subordinates of El Pix, who are standing in your way after every world. Defeat them to prove that you can face the big boss himself!

FEATURES
24 levels + huge bonus level + 1 end boss battle
4 different worlds
Mini boss battles in each world
Pixel art
Retro music
Full controller support
Speedrun timer 
Achievements

Chubby is on another mission… will you join him?

70010000089726.name: Sailing the winds
70010000089726.intro: Dive into an immersive fishing adventure set in a stunning archipelago!
70010000089726.description:
An exciting adventure game that combines elements of searching, fishing, and mystery-solving. You play as an adventurer who must help his friend look for his missing father. The game takes place on an archipelago once claimed by the pirates, and every island has its own story and its own mystery.
Travel the archipelago, exploring the islands, caves, and shipwrecks. Every object has a unique story and might lead to precious artifacts or solutions to various mysteries.
Fishing is one of the key gameplay elements. Apart from classic fishing, players may seek underwater treasure and ancient relics. Every fish has its own habitat. Once a certain kind of fish has been caught, its zone will be marked on your map.
The game's protagonist is helping his friend search for his father. However, the plot is a lot more complicated than it may seem at first. You will meet many unusual characters and experience an intriguing story full of twists and turns.

70010000089731.name: Sniper Jarhead
70010000089731.intro: Precision marksmanship and calm decision-making are crucial for this rescue mission. Feel the intense tension as you look through the scope and pull the trigger.
70010000089731.description:
Experience the ultimate fusion of realistic sniping and intense action in this gripping FPS! As an elite Marine Corps sniper, you'll face a dangerous rescue mission on the chaotic battlefields of the Gulf War. Break through enemy lines to save a downed Black Hawk helicopter and its crew. Your marksmanship will determine the fate of your comrades.

・Master a sophisticated sniping system that takes distance and ballistics into account.
・Immerse yourself in highly detailed environments with advanced bullet physics and lifelike audio.
・Feel the tension as you line up your shot, hold your breath, and squeeze the trigger.
・Experience realistic bullet flight and impact that puts you in the shoes of a true marksman.
・Scout for the perfect vantage point and strategize your approach.
・Take on a variety of missions in different terrains using a range of tactics.
・Adapt to unique objectives in each mission that require flexible decision-making.
・Go beyond simple sniping ・distract enemies and make crucial strategic decisions.
・Compete against sophisticated AI that reacts to your every move for intense, unpredictable combat.
・Immerse yourself in stunningly realistic graphics and sound design that transport you to the battlefield.

This thrilling FPS offers an unparalleled sniping experience full of suspense. Hone your precision shooting skills as you immerse yourself in high-stakes rescue missions. Will you become a battlefield hero or fade into the shadows of the desert? It's all up to your skill. Immerse yourself in this unprecedented sniper adventure ・rise to the challenge and become the marksman who holds the fate of your team in his hands.

Prologue
In the midst of the fierce fighting of the Gulf War, tragedy struck. During a special Marine Corps operation, a Black Hawk helicopter was shot down by enemy anti-aircraft fire. Surrounded by enemy forces, the crew is now hanging between life and death.
In this critical situation, a Marine Corps sniper is dispatched to assist in the rescue operation. Infiltrating deep behind enemy lines, the sniper must use advanced marksmanship to cover the rescue team as they approach the crash site.
In a race against time, pinpoint accuracy and calm judgment are essential. Can everyone be safely rescued? The key lies in the skill of the sniper in charge.

70010000089739.name: Pixel Game Maker Series LUNLUN SUPER HERO BABIES PLUS NEWGAMES
70010000089739.intro:
Three games in one! Volume up!
A compilation of Super Baby LUNLUN's action
! A super bargain edition!
70010000089739.description:
There are three games included!

◆Gigant Mom Buster
Your favorite Marma has grown huge and is rampaging!
Hit him with poo and get your normal Marma back! There's also a naughty option!
Easy-to-use, exhilarating action!

◆LUNLUN Poop Break
Break the oncoming horde of poo with a bullet!
Refresh yourself with a special finishing move!
A fast-paced action shooting game!

◆LUNLUN Super Hero Babys DX
The great adventure of LUNLUN, the super baby, who was eaten by the gigantic “Boss Poop”!
A side-scrolling action game with easy controls that won't result in a game over!

*Differences from the single-item version
・The stage composition has been partially changed.
・The strength of the bosses has been changed.
・A skip button has been added for the ending, etc.
・The amount of recovery from recovery items during boss battles has increased.
・Also, various other things.

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.

70010000089747.name: Connect the Circuit 1000
70010000089747.intro:
Connect the path for electric flow,
A simple and smart puzzle to know.
70010000089747.description:
"Connect the Circuit 1000" is a puzzle game where you draw paths for electricity according to specific rules to complete the circuit board.
Enjoy a full set of 1,000 puzzles, ranging from simple to challenging.

Use logic and creativity to complete every circuit!

70010000089753.name: Item Frenzy
70010000089753.intro: Experience the Joy of Discovery in Item Frenzy!
70010000089753.description:
Step into a relaxing world of exploration and discovery with Item Frenzy, a game that invites you to uncover hidden treasures across diverse and serene environments. With three enchanting levels: Town, Campsite, and Forest, each filled with unique items to find!

A Relaxing Adventure: Immerse yourself in the charm of cozy towns, peaceful campsites, and lush forests. Each setting is a haven of calm, inviting you to explore at your own pace!

Discover Countless Treasures: Search for a wide variety of hidden items tucked away in every corner. Every find is a moment of joy and satisfaction!

Your Journey, Your Way: With no timers or rigid objectives, you’re free to explore, search, and enjoy in a stress-free experience!

Soothing Atmospheres: Let the gentle soundscapes of nature and ambient music guide you as you hunt for items. Each location is designed to calm your mind and immerse you fully!

70010000089755.name: Chained Heroes
70010000089755.intro: Can you reach the top, or will the water pull you down?
70010000089755.description:
Step into the post-apocalyptic world of Chained Heroes, a thrilling 3D platformer where every jump could be your last! As a player, your mission is to leap across crumbling surfaces, dodge dangerous obstacles, and climb to new heights in a desolate, dystopian landscape. Your goal? Reach the final destination—but what awaits you there is a mystery you'll uncover as you progress through the game.

In this unforgiving world, falling into the water means starting over, so precise timing and sharp reflexes are key to survival. Team up with friends in multiplayer mode, where working together can make all the difference in reaching the top.

Choose from 4 unique skins to personalize your character as you navigate through this hostile environment. Will you conquer the ruins and emerge victorious, or will the waters claim you before you reach the end? Dive into Chained Heroes and find out!

70010000089760.name: Snezhinka
70010000089760.intro: Brave the battlefield to save your sister, the hero of the Molten Iron Squadron.
70010000089760.description:
This is the sequel to Marfusha, the second entry in the series of high-tempo shooting game with simple controls.

Play as Snezhinka, an employee of a private military company in a dystopian world depicted in beautiful 2.5D pixel art. Go to various different battlefields and defend your objectives from the enemy's onslaught.

Every day you manage to survive will net you a salary, but this goes through all sorts of tax deductions and other payments... and you'll have to use your meager earnings left over to strengthen yourself, buy new equipment, and recruit coworkers.

In Story Mode, the story changes based on which coworker you choose to fight with. Read every story to their ends over multiple playthroughs.

There are also two different Challenge Modes that both fully support online rankings, as well as a Collection where you can view all sorts of elements you obtain in-game.

The console version comes with the artbook included.

70010000089765.name: Airplane Flight Simulator : Dangerous Landings
70010000089765.intro: Handle Extreme Landing Situations in Airplane Flight Simulator : Dangerous Landings
70010000089765.description:
In Airplane Flight Simulator : Dangerous Landings, you take control of 33 unique airplanes across 15 action-packed levels and 3 free ride modes. Navigate through some of the most extreme flight emergencies, including engine fires, landing gear failures, dual engine flameouts, brake failures, flap issues and lightning strikes. Each level is set in a diverse environment, from snowy mountains to sunny beaches, vibrant towns and peaceful countryside, with both day and night scenarios to challenge your piloting skills. With realistic flight controls, immersive cockpit interiors, dynamic weather and day-night cycles, this simulator offers one of the most thrilling and authentic aviation experiences.

In Airplane Flight Simulator : Dangerous Landings, you must prove your skills as the ultimate pilot, managing to land safely under the most extreme conditions. With a global map showcasing realistic cities and airports, every landing challenges your skills to the fullest.

Features:

• Wide variety of airplane types (airliner, private jet, fighter aircraft, cargo aircraft and historic aircraft)
• A total of 33 different aircrafts included
• 15 adrenaline-filled landing scenarios
• 3 diverse free flight modes
• Detailed cockpits
• Realistic flight controls
• Dynamic weather system
• Accurate engine and failure sounds
• Challenges across day or night time

Take on the most challenging landings ever with Airplane Flight Simulator : Dangerous Landings!

70010000089770.name: No More Snow
70010000089770.intro: Team up as Santa and Mrs. Claus in a wild showdown against Krampus and his wicked crew—save Christmas and restore peace to the North Pole!
70010000089770.description:
"No More Snow" is a fast-paced, action-packed top-down shooter where Christmas itself hangs in the balance! Step into the boots of Santa Claus (or Mrs. Claus in co-op mode) and battle through 10 snowy, danger-filled levels, from the eerie depths of a graveyard to Santa’s bustling workshop. With vibrant, cartoonish low-poly graphics, No More Snow delivers a holiday adventure full of festive chaos and explosive fun.

Armed with an arsenal of holiday-themed weapons, including rifles, shotguns, and even a flamethrower, take on hordes of twisted enemies like zombie elves, vicious snowmen, and other fiendish creatures. Feeling close combat? Wield powerful melee weapons, like Santa’s axe or a candy cane club, and clear your path to victory. Face 8 epic boss battles against formidable foes, including the Snowman King, the Grim Reaper, and the ultimate villain, Krampus.

Can you survive the onslaught and save Christmas from eternal darkness? Join the fight, conquer the chaos, and bring holiday cheer back to the North Pole in No More Snow!

70010000089783.name: Jamjam
70010000089783.intro: Bounce your way to victory! Experience the thrilling blend of classic platforming action and the challenging precision.
70010000089783.description:
In Jamjam, you control a delightful character—a squishy, bouncy square of jelly. Master the art of flicking your jelly hero across intricate levels filled with diverse obstacles, ensuring every jump is perfectly timed and aimed.

Gameplay Features:
- Precision Jumping: Point, drag, and observe the trajectory to make your jelly character leap across platforms. 
- Challenging Levels: Navigate through stages packed with obstacles that test your timing and skill. Every level offers a unique challenge and an opportunity to prove your mastery.
- Collect and Perfect: Gather all the coins and stars scattered across each level to achieve a perfect score. Can you complete every stage flawlessly?
- Cosmetic Upgrades: Unlock a variety of cosmetic items like skins and bandanas. Customize your jelly character to show off your unique style!
- Special Levels and Rewards: Special level at the end of each world. Conquer them to earn exclusive rewards and advance to new, exciting worlds.

Why You'll Love Jamjam:
Jamjam brings a refreshing take on platformers, blending fun and skillful gameplay with a charming character that you'll love to control. The game's intuitive aim-to-jump mechanics make it easy to learn but challenging to master. With every level and world, you'll find yourself more engrossed in this delightful and dynamic jelly-filled adventure.

70010000089788.name: Snooker Blitz
70010000089788.intro: Just another Snooker Game - think again, Snooker Blitz is much more. Traditional Snooker meets multiplayer, themed Seasons an; d new weekly tournaments!
70010000089788.description:
Play Snooker with friends for free in Snooker Blitz. .The only online Snooker game you ever need.

The world is ready for a truly unique Snooker game! Challenge your friends, enter pool tournaments, and go head to head against other players in real-time. Shoot Snooker with ultra-realistic physics, breath-taking graphics, and have more fun than you’ve ever had in real life!

Download Snooker Blitz for free today, and enjoy a unique concept with super easy controls, and fun and intuitive gameplay!

70010000089790.name: Trench Shooter : Warfare Tactics
70010000089790.intro: Survive the Frontline: Every Step is a Battle, Every Mission a Fight for Victory!
70010000089790.description:
Enter the battlefield, where every step forward is a fight for survival. As a soldier on a high-stakes mission, you’ll traverse dangerous terrain, eliminate enemies, and navigate from point A to point B while facing a series of increasingly difficult challenges.

Game Features:

- Intense Missions: Conquer a variety of missions that demand tactical planning and precise execution. Each mission presents unique objectives, from eliminating waves of impostors to overcoming obstacles that block your path.

- Upgradeable Weapons: As you progress, you’ll earn money that can be used to upgrade your arsenal. Starting with four base weapons, you can expand to six powerful tools, each upgrade improving firepower, accuracy, and effectiveness in battle. Choose from shotguns, rifles, grenades, and more to adapt to each mission’s demands.

- Strategic Combat: The enemies you face are relentless, and you’ll need more than brute force to survive. Plan your weapon selection carefully, analyze enemy patterns, and adjust your approach to overcome powerful impostors and complex barriers. Flexibility and quick thinking are key to victory.

- Dynamic Environments: Each mission takes you through different terrains and battlefields, from war-torn streets to fortified bunkers. The changing environment will require you to adapt your tactics on the fly, using cover, positioning, and movement to gain the upper hand.

- Progressive Difficulty: As you advance through the game, each mission ramps up the difficulty, presenting tougher enemies, more complex objectives, and fiercer battles. Only those with keen reflexes and strategic minds will complete all tasks.

- Rewards and Unlocks: Completing missions not only earns you money for weapon upgrades but also unlocks new gear and abilities. Customize your character’s loadout, enhance your defenses, and unlock special abilities to gain the advantage in tougher battles.

- Immersive Combat Experience: Feel the heat of battle with realistic combat mechanics, intense firefights, and visceral sound effects. Every bullet fired and every obstacle overcome brings you one step closer to completing your mission.


Step into the trenches, where danger lurks at every turn and survival is never guaranteed. Do you have what it takes to defeat your enemies, complete the mission, and emerge victorious? The challenge awaits!

70010000089804.name: The Art of Big Helmet Heroes + Original Soundtrack
70010000089804.intro: Complete your experience with Big Helmet Heroes' Artbook & OST
70010000089804.description:
Explore The Art of Big Helmet Heroes, featuring 150 pages of exclusive concept art, 2D and 3D character and environment models.

Immerse yourself further in the atmosphere with 33 unique soundtracks! 

Please note: The artbook is available only in English.

70010000089814.name: ROBOT ANARCHY
70010000089814.intro:
The Retro 90’s FPS You’ve Been Waiting For!
The world is under siege by the ruthless robots of the MacroCyber corporation.
70010000089814.description:
Humanity is on the brink of extinction, and you are its last hope.

ROBOT ANARCHY transports you to the golden era of first-person shooters, drawing inspiration from classics like DOOM and Wolfenstein.

Prepare for heart-pounding action as you blast through waves of deadly machines across a series of diverse and gripping levels. The game offers a unique mix of intense gunfights, puzzles, and secret areas that keep you on your toes. Built using old-schoold 90's technology to deliver an authentic experience.

Get ready to lock, load, and destroy as you battle to save humanity in the ultimate showdown of man vs. machine. Are you up for the challenge?

70010000089828.name: The Town of Nie Iromusubi
70010000089828.intro: A strange tale, weaved like the petals of a flower.
70010000089828.description:
"The Town of Nie Iromusubi", a fan-disc of the strange and eerie otherworldly BL fantasy "The Town of Nie."
Weaving together extraordinary colors.

■Story
Our main character, Hisora, spent his days working his blue-collar jobs every day without a moment to rest. One day, he followed a man in mourning clothes and ended up getting lost in an eerie world.

It has been about one year of Hisora searching for a way back home while staying at the Inn - the season is now summer.

While he still has not found a way back to the real world, Hisora has come to enjoy his life together with the residents of the Inn.

In the midst of these extraordinary days, an eerie shadow begins to haunt him.

Not wanting to burden anyone, Hisora does not share this with the others, and begins to live in anxiety...

This is a tale of bright, hot summer days.

■Added Content
・BGM Listening Mode: Includes 21 songs in total, including songs from the Town of Nie - Iromusubi Mini Album.
・Supported Languages: Japanese, English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese.
・Fully-Realized System:Enjoy the game with a comfortable control system.

*This game is a boy's love visual novel game.

70010000089833.name: The Legend of Cyber Cowboy
70010000089833.intro: Liberate a town from gangs of cybernetic bandits as a steampunk gunslinger!
70010000089833.description:
The wild west gets even wilder with the development of cybernetic technology, and it’s up to you to take down the bandit gangs turning this tech against honest and hard-working locals! Step into the role of a steampunk gunslinger with a mechanical arm and loads of enhanced weaponry at your disposal. The Legend of Cyber Cowboy is a top-down twin-stick shooter presented in slick pixel art style.

Blast through waves of cyborg baddies and mechanical monsters in monocles and top hats as you explore dozens of procedurally generated rooms that change with each run to keep you on your leather booted toes. Destroy objects or use them for cover. Collect valuable energy tokens to purchase new weapons at shops. Use energy bursts to dash and dodge. Then prepare for a showdown with huge bosses in bullet hell shootouts.

Are you up to the challenge, Cowboy?

Features:

• Blast through 5 worlds of wild west mayhem as a cybernetic cowboy!
• Navigate procedurally generated saloons and wastelands.
• Collect valuable energy tokens to buy new weapons!
• Face off against big bosses in bullet hell shootouts.
• Enjoy colorful and crisp pixel art presentation!

70010000089838.name: Rodgerbints: Romance and Scandal in High Society
70010000089838.intro: Experience a story of glamour, romance and secrets. Make key decisions that will change the fate of the characters. Every choice matters!
70010000089838.description:
Step into a visual novel full of glamour, intrigue and romance. Live the life of a powerful family caught in a whirlwind of rivalries, forbidden loves and dark secrets. Meet key characters, form complex relationships and make decisions that will affect everyone's destiny. From passionate love triangles to life-changing scandals, every choice counts.

Rich in emotional detail, the story will immerse you in a plot fraught with tension, romance and unexpected twists and turns. The choices you make will influence relationships and events, leading to multiple possible endings: a happy love, a fall from grace or a secret revealed?

Explore the complexities of relationships, power and love. Make your story unique and discover how your choices can change everything!

70010000089840.name: Superheroes: Power of New Horizons Legacy
70010000089840.intro: In a world where young people with special abilities are trained to become heroes, Kai is a boy who discovers a mysterious power after an unexpected incident.
70010000089840.description:
Although he wasn't born with the abilities of his fellow Guardian Academy members, his newfound energy connects him to a danger greater than he ever imagined.

Together with his friends, Rin, a girl with control over electricity, and Zane, a reserved telekinetic, Kai must learn to master his unstable power.

·Exciting Story: An epic journey of self-discovery, bravery, and the importance of friendship, with a protagonist who must learn to master his powers and face difficult decisions.

·Diverse Characters: A host of interesting and unique characters, from fellow academy members like Rin (with electric powers) and Zane (telekinetic), to mentors like Instructor Blaze and the mysterious hero who helps Kai.

·The Villain: Lord Nebula, a dark and powerful villain, with a dangerous plan to seize the Dark Core, an artifact capable of destroying the world.

·Striking Visual Backgrounds: Detailed, full-color backgrounds show varied settings at the academy, natural landscapes, futuristic laboratories, and mysterious ruins where ancient secrets are found.

·Moments of Humor and Friendship: Funny dialogues and situations with friends that allow players to learn more about each character and strengthen their connection with them.

·Epic Battle Scenes: Strategic clashes against Nebula's minions, where the player can see how Kai uses his newly acquired powers in dangerous situations.

70010000089846.name: Chernobylite Premium Edition
70010000089846.intro: The full Chernobylite experience. Grab the base game, all updates, every DLC and extra add-ons in one package.
70010000089846.description:
Chernobylite is a Science Fiction Survival Horror RPG from developers The Farm 51. Venture into the wasteland of Chernobyl’s Exclusion Zone, as Igor, a physicist and ex-employee of the Chernobyl Power Plant. Return to Pripyat to investigate the mysterious disappearance of your fiancée, 30 years after the infamous disaster.

Battle it out with hostile military forces, other scavengers, mutated creatures, and the harsh irradiated environment. Experience an adventure of survival, conspiracy, horror, love, and obsession where your choices impact the story.

Chernobylite Premium Edition includes:
- The full base game
- All free content updates to date, including extra story missions, new locations, additional weapons, unique game modes, and more
- Digital downloads of the official Chernobylite Soundtrack and Artbook
- The Seasoned Scavenger and Irradiated Hideout DLC skin packs for your weapons and hideout

BASE BUILDING & CRAFTING
Build and customize your home base to serve all your operations and expeditions. Expand and upgrade to suit your needs and those of your companions. Use workstations to craft powerful gadgets, traps, and weapons, or fine-tune your existing gear to gain an edge in your excursions.

RESOURCE & TEAM MANAGEMENT
Recruit a diverse group of skilled companions to join you on your journey. Assign them to missions to gather resources, scout new areas, or eliminate threats. Manage your base to meet their needs and keep morale high, all while making tough story choices that will shape their loyalty to you.

STEALTH, SURVIVAL & COMBAT
Survival in The Exclusion Zone is tough, as each day brings fresh challenges and diminishing supplies. Venture out on supply runs, use stealth to evade detection, or engage in intense combat when necessary. Navigate through perilous environments and face formidable enemies, all while ensuring you extract back to base to keep your scavenged loot.

NON-LINEAR STORYTELLING & CHOICES
No playthrough is the same. Your choices and actions shape your story, but no decision will satisfy everyone. Choose carefully whom to trust, whether to prioritize resources for survival or research and when to face conflicts head-on or avoid them. Every decision carries weight and leads to different outcomes.

70010000089850.name: Ravenswatch - Legendary Edition
70010000089850.description:
Choose a side and show your support for the game with the Legendary Edition.
Includes:
* Ravenswatch game
* Ravens Skin Pack: 9 exclusive Ravenswatch-themed outfits for Scarlet, Beowulf, Snow Queen, Pied Piper, Aladdin, Geppetto, Sun Wukong, Melusine and Carmilla. Available from the hero selection menu.
* Nightmares Skin Pack: 9 exclusive Nightmare-themed outfits for the same heroes and available from the same menu.

70010000089854.name: Windborn - Journey to the South
70010000089854.intro: Guide your bird south, staying with your flock. Soar through speed boosts, embrace the skies, and don’t fall behind. Can you keep up?
70010000089854.description:
Embark on an exhilarating journey as a bird navigating the skies alongside your flock. In this beautifully crafted adventure, you will soar through 11 vibrant and diverse levels, each offering unique challenges and breathtaking landscapes. Your mission isn’t just about speed—it’s about staying connected with your flock as you all journey south together, guided by instinct and unity.
Feel the rush as you fly through speed boosts that propel you forward, but be careful! Lose track of your flock, and you risk being left behind. The world around you is full of wonder—experience the thrill of wide-open skies, the serenity of soaring with your companions, and the subtle strategy of maintaining the perfect pace to stay with your flock.
From lush forests to vast oceans and sweeping mountain ranges, every level introduces a new environment that tests your ability to adapt and stay with your group. The game combines exciting, fast-paced moments with relaxing, meditative flights, creating a balance that makes every moment enjoyable.
Will you master the skies and ensure that no one gets left behind? The freedom of the skies is yours to explore—let the journey begin!

70010000089857.name: Windborn - Concrete Jungle
70010000089857.intro: Guide your bird south, stay with the flock, and soar to the finish!
70010000089857.description:
Embark on an exhilarating journey as a bird navigating the skies alongside your flock. In this beautifully crafted adventure, you will soar through 11 vibrant and diverse levels, each offering unique challenges and breathtaking landscapes. Your mission isn’t just about speed—it’s about staying connected with your flock as you all journey south together, guided by instinct and unity.
Feel the rush as you fly through speed boosts that propel you forward, but be careful! Lose track of your flock, and you risk being left behind. The world around you is full of wonder—experience the thrill of wide-open skies, the serenity of soaring with your companions, and the subtle strategy of maintaining the perfect pace to stay with your flock.
From lush forests to vast oceans and sweeping mountain ranges, every level introduces a new environment that tests your ability to adapt and stay with your group. The game combines exciting, fast-paced moments with relaxing, meditative flights, creating a balance that makes every moment enjoyable.
Will you master the skies and ensure that no one gets left behind? The freedom of the skies is yours to explore—let the journey begin!

70010000089860.name: Windborn - Echoes of the Night
70010000089860.intro: Guide your bird south, stay with the flock, and soar to the finish!
70010000089860.description:
Embark on an exhilarating journey as a bird navigating the skies alongside your flock. In this beautifully crafted adventure, you will soar through 11 vibrant and diverse levels, each offering unique challenges and breathtaking landscapes. Your mission isn’t just about speed—it’s about staying connected with your flock as you all journey south together, guided by instinct and unity.
Feel the rush as you fly through speed boosts that propel you forward, but be careful! Lose track of your flock, and you risk being left behind. The world around you is full of wonder—experience the thrill of wide-open skies, the serenity of soaring with your companions, and the subtle strategy of maintaining the perfect pace to stay with your flock.
From lush forests to vast oceans and sweeping mountain ranges, every level introduces a new environment that tests your ability to adapt and stay with your group. The game combines exciting, fast-paced moments with relaxing, meditative flights, creating a balance that makes every moment enjoyable.
Will you master the skies and ensure that no one gets left behind? The freedom of the skies is yours to explore—let the journey begin!

70010000089863.name: Windborn - Wings of Fate
70010000089863.intro: Soar through the sky and master the wind!
70010000089863.description:
Embark on an exhilarating journey as a bird navigating the skies alongside your flock. In this beautifully crafted adventure, you will soar through 11 vibrant and diverse levels, each offering unique challenges and breathtaking landscapes. Your mission isn’t just about speed—it’s about staying connected with your flock as you all journey together, guided by instinct and unity.
Feel the rush as you fly through speed boosts that propel you forward, but be careful! Lose track of your flock, and you risk being left behind. The world around you is full of wonder—experience the thrill of wide-open skies, the serenity of soaring with your companions, and the subtle strategy of maintaining the perfect pace to stay with your flock.
From lush forests to vast oceans and sweeping mountain ranges, every level introduces a new environment that tests your ability to adapt and stay with your group. The game combines exciting, fast-paced moments with relaxing, meditative flights, creating a balance that makes every moment enjoyable.
Will you master the skies and ensure that no one gets left behind? The freedom of the skies is yours to explore—let the journey begin!

70010000089869.name: Endless Deaths
70010000089869.intro: Experience a thrilling top-down twin-stick shooter roguelike. Battle zombies, upgrade your gear, and face fresh challenges in every playthrough!
70010000089869.description:
This intense top-down twin-stick shooter roguelike immerses players in the chaos of a zombie apocalypse. As a lone survivor, your mission is to navigate procedurally generated levels filled with relentless undead, using a wide arsenal of weapons and unique character abilities to stay alive. Five distinct tilesets and procedural generation ensure that every playthrough presents a new challenge.

Progress continuously as you level up during missions, upgrading and replacing your gear to adapt to rising threats. The game offers a variety of weapons, from shotguns and rifles to explosive options, allowing for flexible combat strategies. Select from multiple characters, each with special abilities that can change the course of battle in critical moments.

With fast-paced twin-stick shooter mechanics, this roguelike demands quick reflexes and strategic thinking for survival. Each run brings upgrades and power boosts, enabling you to evolve into an unstoppable force against the growing zombie threat.

Featuring endless replayability and dynamic challenges, this game is a must-play for fans of roguelikes and zombie action. Between runs, you can upgrade passive abilities to improve your chances of making it through the next fight.

Will you conquer the relentless hordes and reach the safehouse, or succumb to the unforgiving tide of destruction?

70010000089902.name: Kiting Cat
70010000089902.intro: Organize your kitchen, fulfill orders… and serve cats?!
70010000089902.description:
In Kiting Cat, prepare delicious meals for your feline customers by moving carts, chopping, mixing, and baking ingredients to create the perfect dish. Each level requires precision and planning, as you'll need to pay close attention to the orders and ingredients before you start cooking. Serve your whiskered clients with speed and accuracy to keep them happy!

This cute pixel art game offers 40 levels packed with culinary challenges, featuring 4 unique biomes: the bustling city, a relaxing beach, a mysterious forest, and a fiery volcano. With over 10 different recipes to master, including grilled steak, sushi, pizza, and more, every level will test your cooking and puzzle-solving skills.

MAIN FEATURES IN KITING CAT:

• Navigate 40 charming, puzzle-filled levels. 
• Cook in unique environments: city, beach, forest, and volcano. 
• Gather and combine ingredients to prepare delicious dishes. 
• Serve adorable cat customers with diverse food requests. 
• Organize your kitchen, move carts, and chop, mix, and bake ingredients. 
• Create over 10 different meals: sushi, grilled fish, pizza, and more. 
• Enjoy pixel art visuals and cute gameplay with a culinary twist!

70010000089907.name: Headhunters: Bang Bang
70010000089907.description:
Embark on an adrenaline-fueled adventure with Headhunters, an action-packed 3D shooter game that will keep you on the edge of your seat! Immerse yourself in a thrilling multiplayer experience where you'll face off against opponents on dynamic maps, each brimming with unique characters boasting diverse abilities and features. With its captivating and vibrant graphics, Headhunters not only delivers an unparalleled mobile FPS experience but also transports you into a vibrant and competitive gaming universe.

In Headhunters, the power is in your hands as you customize your characters to match your preferred playstyle. Whether you prefer the lightning-fast precision of a sharpshooter or the unstoppable force of a tank, there's a character for every strategy and tactic you have in mind. Experiment with different combinations of characters and abilities to dominate the battlefield and claim victory.

Explore a plethora of meticulously crafted maps, each offering its own distinct theme and strategic opportunities. From the dense foliage of a forgotten forest to the frozen expanses of an icy valley, every map presents a new challenge to conquer and a fresh experience to enjoy. Join forces with friends to coordinate your attacks and emerge victorious as a team, or test your mettle solo as you face off against foes in intense one-on-one battles.

Dive into a variety of game modes catering to all tastes and preferences, from the fast-paced chaos of Deathmatch to the strategic depth of Objective-based missions. With a vibrant in-game world filled with exciting events, challenges, and rewards, Headhunters keeps the action flowing and the competition fierce.

Headhunters isn't just a shooter game—it's an immersive gaming experience that will keep you hooked for hours on end. Are you ready to step into the ultimate mobile shooter game and unleash your skills on the battlefield?

70010000089914.name: Mini Golf Simulator
70010000089914.intro: A Golf Game Played with the Miyazawa-Style Putter Controller!
70010000089914.description:
A new style of golf game featuring the 'Miyazawa-Style Putter Controller', where you swing by hanging the Joy-Con™!
Who will claim victory?

70010000089919.name: Learn to Play - Gravity Space Walk
70010000089919.intro: Repair your spaceship and return home!
70010000089919.description:
Gravity Space Walk is a simple platforming game, designed for young players as a first step into the exciting world of video games.

Collect all the mechanical parts scattered around the levels to repair your spaceship and finally return to your planet! Solve simple puzzles and watch out for hazards on the way. Complete all 20 levels and return home safely.

70010000089924.name: Hair care: How to maintain and style healthy hair
70010000089924.intro: Discover the ultimate guide to hair care, with tips on hydration, styling, growth, and protecting your hair for a healthy, shiny look!
70010000089924.description:
Welcome to the ultimate hair care guide! Here, you’ll find everything you need to know to keep your hair in its best condition, from basic fundamentals to advanced techniques. Did you know that identifying your hair type is essential for choosing the right products? This guide helps you recognize whether your hair is straight, wavy, curly, or afro, and how each requires special care.

From a basic routine of cleansing and hydration to tips on styling and protecting your hair, you'll learn how to avoid the most common mistakes that can cause damage. Discover how excessive heat, lack of sun protection, and using the wrong products can harm your hair, and learn how to prevent it. Plus, we explore the fascinating world of hair growth, options for combating hair loss, and how to care for your hair based on your age and life stage.

Whether you're looking for practical advice or advanced solutions, this guide provides everything you need to achieve healthy, strong, and shiny hair. Your hair deserves it!

70010000089927.name: Creative Writing: Unlock Your Inner Author
70010000089927.intro: Unlock your creativity, master storytelling, and transform your ideas into captivating tales that leave a mark. Start writing today!
70010000089927.description:
Explore the art of storytelling and unlock your full creative potential. Learn how to transform your ideas into captivating tales that will keep your readers hooked on every page. With helpful tips, you'll discover how to overcome the fear of the blank page and become a master of narrative. From building memorable characters to developing rich and detailed worlds, every step brings you closer to perfecting your craft.

Dive into techniques for understanding narrative structure, creating surprising twists, and emotionally connecting with your audience. Enhance your communication skills, unleash your imagination, and find your unique voice as an author. Whether you want to explore new genres, express emotions through words, or plan that novel you've always dreamed of writing, you'll find the tools, support, and inspiration needed to bring your stories to life. Are you ready to make your mark on the literary world? Your journey begins here!

70010000089931.name: 3D Don't Die Mr. Robot
70010000089931.intro: Survive a fruity dimension of destruction in fast-paced arcade-style collect’em up style!
70010000089931.description:
Take the role of Mr. Robot who has been trapped in a highly dangerous and rather fruity dimension called the Neon Dunjun. The only way to survive is to collect fruits which explode on contact, destroying any enemies in their blast radius, helping Mr. Robot to cheat death for a few more moments. To assist him further, exploding fruits set off a chain reaction, causing other fruit to explode - filling the screen with destruction and more importantly, POINTS!

3D Don’t Die Mr. Robot is a reboot of the 2D cult hit with a whole new dimension of delights! There's remix mode with hand-made challenges, arcade mode with its high-scoring but mind-melting purity and lime attack mode with, well... limes! Top-down arena combat has never been more juicy!

Features:

• Enjoy frantic arcade-style arena gameplay, now in colorful 3D!
• Dodge enemies and collect explosive fruits to survive.
• Use coins you’ve collected across game modes to unlock shades, hats, shoes and more!
• Master an addictive scoring system and challenge online leaderboards.
• Get into the groove with a pulse-pounding soundtrack!

70010000089939.name: EGGCONSOLE CRIMSON PC-8801mkIISR
70010000089939.intro: Carry on your late father's will and defeat the ferocious Crimson! XTAL SOFT presents a fully-fledged command-based RPG!
70010000089939.description:
This game was released in 1987 in Japan as a role-playing game. The player learns from their bedridden mother that their father, who had gone missing, actually fell in battle against Crimson, leading them to vow to defeat Crimson.

The game progresses by moving across the field map, exploring dungeons, and recruiting companions. It features a traditional system with random encounters and command-based combat. However, the game introduces its own unique tempo with features like no encounters on the field map, attacks not executing if the target is already defeated, and a lower hit accuracy in combat.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000089942.name: EGGCONSOLE SUPER ZENON GAMMA 5 PC-8801mkIISR
70010000089942.intro: Join the Earth military G Squadron, "Gamma-5," as a member and destroy the antimatter bomb detonation device located on the Devil's Star to save Earth!
70010000089942.description:
The M3 alien, who was at a disadvantage, sent a planet bomb called "Devil's Star." The team chosen to destroy the antiproton bomb's detonator located in Area 31 is the Earth military G Squadron, 5th Unit, commonly known as "Gamma-5."

'Super Xenon Gamma-5' is an action shooting game released in 1986 in Japan by Kure Software Workshop for the PC-8801.

The player becomes a warrior and progresses through interconnected stages, destroying enemy characters encountered along the way using six types of weapons. The necessary weapons, energy, and shields are hidden in each stage, so you will need to search for them while progressing through the game.

Can you conquer all 32 stages?


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000089945.name: Conquistadorio
70010000089945.intro: Explore a mysterious world filled with challenges, puzzles, and an epic story.
70010000089945.description:
The conqueror, who has gone through many trials in his life, decided to retire and become a hermit. To simply lie in his solitary cave away from people. But it seems that fate itself throws you new challenges even in such a simple endeavor. The tomb where you love to sleep has disappeared. You need to embark on a quest to find it and solve many mysteries along the way.

Story: You are tasked with searching for the missing item and finding it.

Puzzles: Clever and challenging puzzles will keep you engaged for hours with captivating logical challenges.

Graphics: A distinctive hand-drawn art style will allow you to enjoy a unique and enchanting aesthetic.

Sound: Ambient sounds, background music, and character-specific sound effects will help you immerse yourself even deeper into the game.

Dialogues: The Conquistador relies on non-verbal storytelling. Therefore, there are no long and tedious dialogues—only expressive animations of the characters and the surrounding environment.

70010000089950.name: Preserve
70010000089950.intro: Preserve is a relaxing puzzle nature-building game in which you flourish a vibrant ecosystem by cleverly placing plants and animals.
70010000089950.description:
Preserve is a puzzle nature-building game that takes players on a journey into a harmonious ecosystem. The objective is to foster and sustain a thriving and diverse biomes, where each component coexists in a symbiotic harmony. By utilizing strategic thinking and a keen eye for balance, players are granted the power to position a wide array of plants and animals, curating an environment that caters to their preferences and aspirations.

Vertical Expansion - In Preserve, you can expand the map not only horizontally, but you also posses an ability to stack layers of nature, forming a vertical network of interconnected habitats.

Diverse Biome Habitats - From alpine forests and savannas to carribean reefs, each biome will have its own unique set of plants, animals, and environmental challenges to discover and overcome.

Multiple Game Modes - Besides regular harmony and puzzle game modes, creative mode lets you build the land without limitations and photo mode allows you to capture and share your creations at the end of each session.


Natural Wonders - Nothing can beautify your map more than natural wonders like the snowy Alps, lavender fields or redwood forests, which you can acquire thanks to a unique card upcycle system

70010000089954.name: Box Chaos
70010000089954.intro: Solve the tricky puzzles to earn Bitnuts and repair the little robot
70010000089954.description:
Box Chaos – the ultimate 3D puzzle adventure awaits!

Take control of a cute, rusty little robot as you tackle a variety of physics-based challenges and solve tricky box-pushing puzzles. In Box Chaos, your wits and skills will be put to the test in creative, mind-bending ways!

Push, shove, and strategize!
Each level challenges you to move boxes to their matching colored targets. But be careful—hazards like spikes, fire traps, and exploding barrels stand in your way. Sometimes, you'll need to knock boxes down from high platforms or follow a specific sequence—mess up, and you'll be starting from scratch!

Physics meets creativity!
Use realistic physics mechanics to discover clever solutions and navigate each level. Every decision matters, and success often lies in finding the right strategy.

Customize your robot!
Your little robot starts off covered in rust, but with each puzzle you solve, you earn BitNuts, the in-game currency. Visit the lab to clean off the rust, unlock new skins, or change your robot's eye color. Personalize your robot to make it truly yours!

Unique music experience
Relax as you solve puzzles to the tune of over 50 carefully curated tracks playing in the background. With the built-in music player, you can adjust the volume or skip tracks—it's your personalized soundtrack for every adventure.

Can you master the chaos?
Each level introduces new, challenging puzzles and mechanics that keep you on your toes. Can you bring all the boxes to their destinations and fully restore your robot?

Dive into the world of Box Chaos, where strategy, physics, and fun collide!

Are you ready for the challenge?

70010000089958.name: Space Battle
70010000089958.intro: Pilot your ship through dangerous space and defend against relentless imperial attacks in Space Battle, a high-intensity round-based strategy game.
70010000089958.description:
Defend the galaxy in Space Battle, the last bastion against the imperial attack!

In this thrilling game of strategy and action, you take command of a spacecraft at the edge of the known galaxy, facing waves of enemy attacks in a desperate fight for survival. Each round is a race against time: destroy enemy stations before their fleets converge and launch a full-scale assault on your ship.

DEFEND YOUR SPACE STATION
Each round challenges you to balance defense and offense. Plan your strategy and execute your best plan to survive.

DESTROY THE EMPIRE
With each enemy station destroyed, the empire returns stronger, ensuring each round is more challenging than the last.

MINE RESOURCES
Navigate the reaches of space in search of precious minerals. Each expedition offers the chance to strengthen your ship and discover forgotten technologies.

SPACE EXPLORATION
Portals will allow you to travel between the different sectors offering new areas to explore and greater challenges.

UPGRADE SYSTEM
Utilize mineral resources from nearby asteroids to power up your ship and spacecraft fleet. Each upgrade is crucial to tipping the scales in your favor.

Space Battle not only tests your strategic skills but also your ability to make quick decisions under pressure. Are you ready to take up the challenge and defend your ship against the relentless forces of the empire?

70010000089963.name: Rendering Ranger: R2 [Rewind]
70010000089963.intro: THE LEGENDARY 16-BIT ERA CULT CLASSIC IS BACK.
70010000089963.description:
Developed by Manfred Trenz (creator of the Turrican series) and published by German software powerhouse Rainbow Arts®, this game was originally released in 1995. Originally slated to come to the West as Targa, the game ultimately ended up as a Japan-only title, with only 10,000 copies printed, making it one of the most sought-after collectibles in retro gaming.

You are the Rendering Ranger known as Double R, a special forces soldier who must defend the Earth from a devastating alien invasion. Through nine levels of action platforming as well as blisteringly fast horizontal shooter stages, Rendering Ranger: R2  is one of the greatest technological showcases ever seen in the 16-bit era!

FEATURES:
• Faithful recreation of Rendering Ranger: R² and its unreleased PAL version Targa with rewind and save features, powered by Limited Run Games Carbon Engine

•  Gut-wrenching side-scrolling action with sprawling stage design and cinematic presentation

•  Mind-blowingly fast horizontal shooting stages unlike any seen before on the hardware of its day

• Upgradable weapons, tons of enemies, dynamic on-scene mayhem at nearly every turn

•  Gigantic bosses in sprites converted from pre-rendered 3D models

• Timeless 16-bit action at its best from legendary game creator Manfred Trenz

70010000089968.name: Super Technos World: River City & Technos Arcade Classics
70010000089968.intro: A 12 Game Package, Including Rare River City Gems!
70010000089968.description:
This exciting collection brings you 12 games in one, from developer Technos Japan known for creating the legendary River City and Double Dragon series. This variety pack of titles includes some gems that haven’t been widely ported before! From arcade classics to region-exclusive titles, you’ll have plenty to explore in this collection! Get your hands on these highly exclusive games of legend!

▼ From nostalgic arcade favorites to party games!
Bask in fun memories of arcades back in the day with the arcade games from the 80’s included in this collection. There are even console party games and RPGs in the pack to satisfy fans of all genres!


▼ Featuring rare River City classics!
From the classic and beloved original River City Renegade to the series’ first falling puzzle game, Kunio’s Oden, and even the hyper rare Super Dodge Ball game, you can experience River City history!


▼ Handy new features for a smooth play experience!
The new “Suspend Save” feature allows players to save the current state mid-game at any time! Critical issues preventing game progression have also been addressed, leaving no unintended obstacles to completing the games. Online support means you can hop online to play with or against long-distance friends. Both long-time fans and new players alike will be sure to enjoy these 12 games across many genres!

▼ List of Games
River City Renegade
Kunio's Dodgeball Time, C'mon Guys!
Downtown River City Baseball Story
Kunio’s Oden
THE COMBATRIBES
SugoroQuest++ -DICENICS-
DunQuest
Super Dodge Ball
XAIN'D SLEENA
CHINA GATE
THE COMBATRIBES (Arcade)
SHADOW FORCE

*Please note that SugoroQuest++ -DICENICS- and DunQuest are only available in Japanese.

Since this is a compilation of previous titles, the number of players varies for each title.
XAIN'D SLEENA(Number of players: 1)
DunQuest(Number of players: 1)
River City Renegade(Number of players: 1-2)
Kunio's Dodgeball Time, C'mon Guys!(Number of players: 1-2)
Downtown River City Baseball Story(Number of players: 1-2)
Kunio’s Oden(Number of players: 1-2)
THE COMBATRIBES(Number of players: 1-2)
THE COMBATRIBES (Arcade)(Number of players: 1-3)
Super Dodge Ball(Number of players: 1-2)
CHINA GATE(Number of players: 1-2)
SHADOW FORCE(Number of players: 1-2)
SugoroQuest++ -DICENICS-(Number of players: 1-4)

70010000089973.name: The Hungry Lamb
70010000089973.intro: Trek across ancient China in a dark, boundary-pushing visual novel inspired by traditional Chinese art with modern animation.
70010000089973.description:
A Collapsing Empire
During Chongzhen’s Reign (A.D. 1628-1644), land annexation reached unmitigated extremes, the country faced domestic issues and foreign invasions, coinciding with the catastrophic Little Ice Age. After many years of horrid disasters in succession one after another, the Ming court continued to impose inhumane policies resulting in widespread starvation and leading to the rise of multiple rebellions against the court.

A Travelling With Desperados
Liang the bandit, and his companion are commissioned for a job from an unsavory merchant and must escort four girls to a wealthy lord in the city of Luoyang. They must pass through Huazhou, Wenxiang, Shanzhou, and finally reach their destination of Luoyang.
Liang initially believes that the girls he is escorting will be sold to the wealthy lord as adopted daughters to begin a new life. However, one of the four girls named “Sui” reveals the hidden secret of their journey to Luoyang.
The lord is a swine demon who has practiced devouring young ladies for over a thousand years. Every year on his birthday, he dispatches human traffickers to abduct girls from Shan in celebration of his special day. Sui’s sister was among the many who have fallen victim to the demon’s appetite.
Sui is hopeful that Liang will end the escort and join her in assassinating the swine demon to avenge her sister, and those who have perished in recent years. Although Liang wants to believe Sui, there are too many inconsistencies in her story. Throughout the journey, Liang will gather information, unravel the truth, and make his decisions accordingly.

70010000089978.name: Primal Fray
70010000089978.intro:
Build a team of Primals!
Enter the Rift and fight your way through enemies!
Outmaneuver your foes and surprise them with combos!
70010000089978.description:
Primal Fray is a turn-based strategy roguelite. Combat takes place on a procedurally generated hex based flying islands. You will use your units to outmaneuver and kill enemy troops.

Defeat Powerful Bosses
There are multiple bosses with unique mechanics. Will you be able to outsmart them? Or maybe build a perfect team to defeat them? Possibilities are endless but one is sure... It WON'T be easy.

Build Your Team
After each combat you will get a different reward, making you choose next primal to join your team. This means that you will be making your team on the fly, having to improvise and work with what RNG gives you.

Use Hundreds Of Abilities
Every unit has 4 different abilities in its arsenal with varying degree of strength and utility. The abilities either cost or produce mana, forcing you to manage this resource.
Primals may use those abilities to deal damage, shield allies, walk, fly, teleport, generate or exchange mana and even manipulate the battleground itself by creating or destroying hexes.

Choose Your Way
You will have to make difficult choices, deciding between adding a new primal to a roster, getting an enchantment, a team heal, currency or visiting a merchant. Plan your way through the Rift and make the most out of the choices given to you.

Recruit New Heroes
Choose between multiple heroes. Use their unique talents to conquer the Rift and learn more about their stories entangled with dark and ominous Ironclad Corp.

70010000089983.name: Sports Supermarket
70010000089983.intro: From Small Shop to Sports Empire – Are You Ready to Rise?
70010000089983.description:
Unleash your inner mogul in Sports Supermarket, the low-poly business simulator where you build a sports retail empire! Start from a small shop and grow into a multi-floor sports haven, stocked with everything from sneakers to pro gear, attracting fans and athletes alike.

Key Features:
- Build Your Empire: Expand from one room to a sprawling multi-level store.
- Market Savvy: Set prices, analyze trends, and run promotions to boost profits.
- Customize: Design your space with hundreds of items and decorations.
- Customer Focus: Serve everyone from joggers to Olympic athletes.
- Seasonal Challenges: Adapt to sports seasons and special events.
- Charming Visuals: Explore a vibrant low-poly world easy on the eyes.

Face competitors, navigate market challenges, and make strategic decisions to shape your business. Are you ready to turn your sports passion into a thriving empire? Start your journey in Sports Supermarket today!

70010000089988.name: Monkey Kong In New-York
70010000089988.description:
Get ready to explore the Big Apple like never before in Monkey Kong in New York! Step into the shoes of Monkey Kong, a daring ape on a mission to conquer New York’s most iconic locations—from the peaceful greenery of Central Park to the historic streets of Harlem, the dizzying heights of Manhattan’s skyline, and even the bustling New York Harbor.

Collect golden bananas scattered throughout each area, gaining incredible powers that make you faster, stronger, and unstoppable. But stay alert—tricky obstacles and mischievous rival monkeys stand in your way! With every banana, Monkey Kong gains new abilities.

Can you help Monkey Kong become the king of the city’s urban jungle? Traverse each unique area, dodge barrels, avoid rival monkeys, and make your mark in Monkey Kong in New York!

Key Features:

Iconic New York Locations: Adventure through Central Park’s shaded paths, Harlem’s lively streets, the skyscrapers of Manhattan, and the bustling harbor with breathtaking views.

Banana Power-Ups: Collect golden bananas to unlock powers like super strength, helping you overcome new challenges and rivals.

Challenging Obstacles & Rivals: Face off against rival monkeys and dodge obstacles like swinging cranes, slippery docks, and barrels in your path.

Beautiful City Graphics: Each location is carefully crafted to capture the spirit of New York, bringing Monkey Kong’s adventure to life with stunning detail.

70010000089998.name: SMILE SIMULATION
70010000089998.intro: Psychological-surreal-analog-survival horror game. Find the smiles and get out.
70010000089998.description:
"Proceed with extreme caution. Many dangers might be ahead. These include: creatures, demons, anomalies, ghosts, ancients, beasts, aliens, curses, malfunctions, ascendants, diseases, darkness and death. Your task is to find the smiling pictures. Desmile them. You will not be let back in until your task is complete. Begin."

SMILE SIMULATION is a surreal horror game where you are closed in a dangerous environment, with many rooms and corridors, as well as monsters and curses trying to kill you. Find the pictures on the walls that are smiling, the "Desmile" button turns them back to normal.

You'll find the previous explorer's voice logs - Brian was here some time ago, when the simulation appeared in the Lacrimosa facility. The Smile Simulation appears to have a voice of a woman named Vivian too, who's guiding you, but you're not sure where just yet.

Explore the horrors of this place, find the smiling pictures, avoid the creatures that each behave in a unique way, the game also features a blinking mechanic that elevates the tension as it affects the creatures following you, and find out the secrets and the story surrounding this threatening place.

70010000090003.name: Monster Truck Arena: Battle Royale
70010000090003.intro: Crush the competition in epic arena battles!
70010000090003.description:
In Monster Truck Arena: Battle Royale, get ready to unleash mayhem in a no-frills destruction derby! This 3D game puts you behind the wheel of a monster truck, where your mission is simple—enter the arena and destroy every opponent that comes your way. It's all about raw skill and strategy as you smash, crash, and demolish rival trucks to claim victory.

Each level takes you to a new chaotic arena, increasing in difficulty as you face off against tougher competitors. Use the power and brute force of your truck to outmaneuver opponents, launching them into devastating collisions, flipping them over, and leaving destruction in your wake.

The challenge ramps up as you advance through the levels, but so does the thrill. With only your driving abilities and aggressive tactics to rely on, it’s a true test of who can stay on top in this explosive competition—just pure, adrenaline-pumping action.

Do you have what it takes to crush the competition and emerge as the last truck standing in Monster Truck Arena: Battle Royale? Or will you just end up as scrap metal in the corner? Buckle up, because it’s going to be a bumpy ride!

70010000090011.name: Fading Star Melody
70010000090011.intro: Animation System Visual Novel "Fading Star Melody"
70010000090011.description:
The characters are brought to life using the E-mote animation system.
When they breathe, wink, or speak, it all looks very realistic.
Additionally, the game features Japanese voice acting.

In a spring of despair, with no hope for the future.  
Even in such a world, you were smiling...  

The one who spoke to me as I sat dejectedly in the park was an exchange student from England.  
Guided by her ever-cheerful and bright demeanor, I gradually began to regain my color.  
Yet, my heart remained difficult to recover...  

When the stars have completely lost their light,  
will the unfinished melody play once again at the edge of time?

70010000090016.name: Thinking of You Beyond Time
70010000090016.intro: Animation System Visual Novel "Thinking of You Beyond Time"
70010000090016.description:
The characters are brought to life using E-mote animation system.
When they breathe, wink, or speak, it all looks very realistic.
Additionally, the game features Japanese voice acting.

Time flows like a river, quietly taking away the warmth of the past, yet unable to erase the whispers deeply buried in the heart.  
Memories are like the morning mist, soft and hazy, drifting across the distant years.  
Unspoken longing, like starlight on the far side of time, never extinguished, patiently awaits the moment to be rediscovered.  

An enchanting journey through the silence of time, allowing you to experience the echoes of emotions at the end of time, and feel the eternal bond in the boundless years.

70010000090021.name: Malu the Princess
70010000090021.intro: Help Malu Reclaim Her Stolen Crown!
70010000090021.description:
Embark on an exciting journey with Malu in Malu the Princess! After her crown is stolen, Malu sets off on a thrilling adventure to reclaim her royal treasure. Traverse through 40 challenging levels in this precision platformer, where sharp reflexes and skill are your best allies. 

Each level brings new obstacles and adversaries to overcome as you inch closer to recovering the stolen crown. Can you help Malu conquer the challenges ahead and restore her rightful place as the true princess?

MAIN FEATURES IN MALU THE PRINCESS:

- Navigate through 40 challenging levels.
- Enjoy engaging mechanics with the princess.
- Journey through a medieval-themed game.

70010000090026.name: Godsvivors
70010000090026.intro: Conquer the Underworld, One Bullet at a Time!
70010000090026.description:
Prepare to descend into the depths of the Underworld in Godsvivors! As a powerful god of Olympus, your mission is to challenge the ruler of the Underworld, Hades, and restore the balance of power. Battle through waves of demonic foes in this roguelite bullet-hell adventure, where every second counts. Survive 15 intense minutes to reach the final confrontation with Hades himself!

Arm yourself with weapons and unleash your special attacks to improve your odds. Level up and choose from powerful upgrades to personalize your strategy. Each upgrade choice can make the difference between survival and defeat in this ever-evolving challenge.

Godsvivors offers an action-packed journey through hell, blending fast-paced combat with a satisfying bullet-storm experience. Will you conquer the Underworld and emerge victorious?

70010000090032.name: Hoarding Simulator 2.0
70010000090032.intro: Sleep, train, ride a bike—almost anything is possible in this game. All you need to do is collect!
70010000090032.description:
One of the best high-tech simulations ever created is here! 

Your mission is simple: collect as much as you can. A third-person adventure with one goal—grab it all! Explore a peaceful town, but beware—unexpected, chaotic events can turn your experience into a total nightmare!

Features:

• Real-life physics: Experience some of the best physics ever made.
• Strategy mode: Challenge yourself with 20 exciting levels.
• Day/Night system: Dynamic time changes for an immersive experience.
• Train in the gym: Get stronger to carry heavier items.
• Total chaos: Beware—low friendship levels can lead to unpredictable disasters!
• More than 20 collectible items: Discover and collect them all!

70010000090037.name: Cats Visiting Christmas Town
70010000090037.intro: Embark on a Christmas quest to uncover hidden cats in charming holiday scenes filled with snowmen, festive shops, and a grand tree adorned with gifts.
70010000090037.description:
Join the holiday spirit in Cats Visiting Christmas Town, where the joy of the season meets the thrill of discovery! Wander through delightful Christmas-themed scenes filled with classic decorations, snowmen, bustling shops, and even Santa himself. Immerse yourself in the cozy atmosphere of holiday festivities as you explore each festive location.

Your mission is simple yet captivating: find all the hidden cats across each artwork. Look carefully, especially for the cats in festive red hats, as you uncover everything from Christmas markets to tree-lighting festivals. Perfect for lovers of cozy puzzles, this game captures the magic of Christmas in every detail!

70010000090042.name: Make it! Oden
70010000090042.intro:
It's time for a scrumptious oden-making challenge!
