Make as much as you can and watch your food cart prosper!
70010000090042.description:
Let's make oden on the Nintendo Switch™!
Every customer has unique tastes—keep track of each order and don't mess up!
Prepare every order accurately and quickly to keep your customers satisfied!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Stew the ingredients according to your customer's order!
Watch your ingredients carefully as they simmer—if they sit too long, they'll fall apart!
Dish up as much oden as you can to your customers before time runs out!

《How to Play》
1. Add ingredients to the pots!

2. Stew the ingredients until their flavors are just right!

3. When you have all the ingredients ready for an order, serve them up!

[Score Attack]
Compete on the global leaderboards with your best score!
Cook skillfully, fill more and more orders, and achieve a new high score!

[Battle]
Have an oden-making showdown with up to 4 players!
Speed and accuracy are the keys to victory!

70010000090054.name: VARLET
70010000090054.intro:
This isn't a story about finding someone else—it's about finding yourself.
School life RPG VARLET
70010000090054.description:
To be a "leader" that guides others forward, or to be an uncompromising "ruler"...

VARLET is a school life RPG where, through encounters with troubled boys and girls who are also searching for themselves, you begin to uncover a version of yourself you never knew existed.

[STORY]
Kousei Academy: where the protagonist has recently transferred.
Whispered rumors surround this place.
 
Another world where strange creatures dwell appears within the school...
...and once you've wandered in, there's no way back out.
 
After seeing this other world—a Glitch—with his own eyes,
the protagonist realizes several people have been replaced with monsters.
 
You must fight alongside your friends
to save the academy from imminent destruction.

[GAME SYSTEM]
Embracing Your Youth in School Life
Help other students deal with their problems as a member of the Student Support Services (SSS),and then go out with friends after school to make the most of your school days.

The bond between the two of you will grow stronger with each event you experience.
Be careful, though—becoming intimate with multiple people may cause problems…!?

Battles use a simple yet exhilarating Timeline Command system.
Take the lead as a “Leader” who supports allies in combat, or dominate the battlefield as a “Ruler” with powerful skills.
Use both fighting styles to seize victory!

Your choices will reveal your true self—.Triad Stats.
Light Triad: Morality, Sympathy, Altruism
Dark Triad: Machiavellianism, Psychopathy, Narcissism
These six stats will change according to the analyses you receive and choices you make during the game.

Triad stats can increase the number of dialogue options available to you
and enhance the power of passive battle skills.
What course of events will your true self bring about?

[CREATOR]
Character Theme Song Composer: wotaku, NILFRUITS, OSTER project, Yoshida Yasei, Tadano Kaede / A4., Hitoshizuku and Yamasankakkei, KANON69, Daibakuhasin
Music: Tsukasa Masuko
Scenario: Gakuto Mikumo, Ryutaro Ito
Scenario Editing: Kazunari Suzuki

70010000090059.name: Sports Nutrition: How to fuel your body for peak performance
70010000090059.intro: Enhance your athletic performance with this nutrition guide. Master macronutrients, meal planning, hydration, and recovery for better results!
70010000090059.description:
Optimise your sport performance with this comprehensive guide to nutrition! Learn how to use the key macronutrients (carbohydrates, protein and fat) to maximise your energy, improve recovery and keep your body balanced. Discover how proper meal planning, along with adequate hydration, can improve your performance in endurance or strength sports. 

Plus, we'll show you how to adjust your nutrition according to your needs, whether you follow a vegan diet, have food allergies or are looking to improve your mental health and reduce stress. With practical advice, sample foods and tailored meal plans, this guide is ideal for all types of athletes, from beginners to advanced. 

Improve your nutrition to maximise your energy, speed up your recovery and take your athletic performance to the highest level!

70010000090062.name: How to Start Yoga: A Beginner's Guide
70010000090062.intro: Explore yoga to improve your physical and mental wellbeing, with tips on flexibility, mobility and relaxation in your everyday life.
70010000090062.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of yoga with this comprehensive guide, designed to inspire you to improve your physical, mental and emotional well-being. Learn how to increase your flexibility and mobility through a selection of postures explained in detail, from chest openings to gentle stretches. Discover simple techniques that will help you reduce stress, improve sleep quality and look after your postural health. 

With tips on how to integrate yoga into your daily routine, this guide offers an enriching view of yoga as a path to calm and inner strength. There are no complicated postures or exercises to do on the spot; you will simply learn, explore and absorb all the knowledge you need to bring the peace and energy of yoga into your everyday life. Ideal for beginners and those looking to deepen their connection to yoga, this guide is the first step towards a more balanced and conscious life. 

Begin a journey of transformation and improve your wellbeing from the inside out, connecting body and mind fully.

70010000090065.name: Formula Racing Pro 2025
70010000090065.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70010000090065.description:
Get behind the wheel in Formula Racing Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Formula racing action.  Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision.  Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

70010000090068.name: ChokoNana!
70010000090068.intro: An RPG that starts with meeting Chibi, the talking cat! ChokoNana!
70010000090068.description:
Everything in this work is made up of “little” elements.
You can enjoy a little map, a little discovery, a little story, etc. in a little time.

■Growth System
In addition to the character's level, there is also an element of growth in the weapons.
In particular, weapons will increase in lvl as well as characters if you equip them and fight, so you can enjoy more fun in battle.

■Collecting elements
Many treasure chests and animals are hidden in places that are not obvious at a glance, so you can search for them as you explore.
Also, there are materials in each map, and by collecting them, you can craft and strengthen your weapons.

■Story
In this world, the cat tribe is hated by all creatures without exception.
A silver-haired woman is searching for a way to coexist with the cat tribe.
The story is about their “little adventure to realize the world they envisioned.

70010000090071.name: Survival Gladiator: Blades of the Coliseum
70010000090071.intro: Train gladiators, conquer the arena, build your legacy!
70010000090071.description:
Step into the brutal world of ancient Rome in Survival Gladiator: Blades of the Coliseum, a 3D game of action and strategy where you manage your own gladiator empire. As a master of gladiators, your mission is to train and equip your fighters, sending them into fierce battles in the Coliseum to prove their strength and earn glory.

Key Features:
- Train and Equip Gladiators: Purchase new weapons and armours, build gladiator schools, and train your fighters based on their unique types, from agile sword wielders to trident and fishnet handlers.

- Manage Gladiator Resources: Take care of your gladiators' living conditions, ensuring they stay strong and ready for battle. Proper care increases their morale and performance in the arena.

- Buy and Train Slaves: Acquire slaves and turn them into powerful gladiators, training them to become champions in your arena. You can also put them up for auction to earn additional profits.

- Dynamic Combat and Strategy: Each gladiator type has unique abilities and fighting styles, requiring strategic preparation for each fight. Plan your tactics wisely to ensure victory in the bloody arenas.

As you progress, the stakes rise, and every decision you make influences both your fighters' fates and your legacy. Can you build an unstoppable gladiator force and conquer the arena, or will the weight of your responsibilities bring you down?

70010000090081.name: Taxi Driver Simulation 2025
70010000090081.intro: Speed, stunts, and passengers—master the urban chaos!
70010000090081.description:
Get behind the wheel in Taxi Driver Simulation 2025 and become an urban stunt master! Race against the clock in 3 timed modes or cruise freely while transporting passengers across a bustling city.

Earn cash for every trip, but the big tips come from pulling off stunts like jumps and drifts. Choose from 9 characters and cars, upgrading your ride for better speed, control, and style.

Features:

- 4 Play Modes: Timed challenges and free play.
- Earn Money & Tips: Complete trips and wow passengers with your skills.
- Unlock & Customize: Upgrade performance and style with your earnings.
- Dynamic City: Explore a detailed urban landscape full of jumps and sharp turns.

Ready to outrun the clock and make some serious cash? Hop in and see if you’ve got what it takes to be the fastest taxi in town with Taxi Driver Simulation 2025—just try not to hit too many curbs!

70010000090095.name: Cat Veterinary: Emergency Hospital Close to Me
70010000090095.intro: Get ready to care for and play in Your Kitten Veterinary!
70010000090095.description:
Welcome to a world full of cuteness where you are the veterinarian that all kittens need.

Learn how to interact with your adorable kitties that come to your clinic seeking help and lots of affection. From taking their temperature to discovering the games they love most, you are the heroine who helps them heal and purr with happiness!

As you care for them, you can grow your clinic and turn it into the most beloved place for all feline friends.

Moreover, as you progress in the game, you will learn new things about your sweet kittens: how to play with them, their favorite food, how to train them with love, and much more.

Become the star veterinarian, build your team, and welcome more kittens in search of love and care!


Game Features:

-Heal kittens with magical tools: use vaccines, bandages, and many other tools to make the kittens feel better.
-Make new furry friends: Learn how to better interact with your favorite kittens and create a special bond.
-Upgrade your clinic: Create your space and equip your clinic with the best instruments and cat care areas.
-Decorate your clinic your way: Add colors, toys, and charming details for a happy and cozy environment for all the kittens.
-Turn each visit into a game: Each kitten is a challenge; take care of them and pamper them so they recover and are happy.


Your magical veterinary adventure starts now!

70010000090100.name: S. Prysm Destroyer
70010000090100.intro: Run ’n gun action meets apocalyptic mecha anime style with a cute heroine as the pilot!
70010000090100.description:
In a future ravaged by mechanized enemies known as the Primordial, one girl named Amor might hold the only key to reclaiming civilization in S. Prysm Destroyer! Amor had fallen in love with a boy whose passion was constructing robots, but when he died, the tragedy left Amor emotionless and the mech he designed has mysteriously grown more hostile. Acting as the mech’s pilot, Amor sets out to wreak havoc on the enemy by drawing power from prysmals, a material from the same comets that seemingly brought the Primordial to Earth.

S. Prysm Destroyer is a side-scrolling 2.5D shooter inspired by run ’n gun genre classics and mecha anime. Blast through enemy hordes and collect elemental power-ups to unleash the awesome potential of Prysm Destroyer attacks. Chase high scores through skillful play and unlock loads of costumes for Amor!

Features:

• Blast through side-scrolling stages in old-school run ’n gun style!
• Immerse yourself in a world and narrative inspired by mecha action classics.
• Collect elemental power-ups to charge the Prysm Destroyer!
• Unlock special costumes to customize your pilot.
• Enjoy anime aesthetics and screen-filling special attacks!

70010000090105.name: Bubbelsche Deluxe
70010000090105.description:
In Bubbelsche Deluxe you must navigate a small bubble through a long, complicated maze without colliding on the game blocks. Manage the bubble as fast and wide as possible without bursting.
You have exactly one attempt per game to make it.

70010000090107.name: Discovery 2
70010000090107.intro: Build, share & explore! Discovery 2 is a beautiful sandbox game. Now available on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000090107.description:
Create your own world – block by block.
Build houses, villages, or entire cities. Explore underground caves, design electric circuits, and light up your creations with beautiful day & night cycles.

• Creative sandbox gameplay – Over 250 unique blocks & materials.
• Inking system – Color blocks with 16 inks for unique designs.
• Community Gallery – Share worlds & explore creations from players worldwide.
• Electric system – Use wires, switches, sensors and lights to create interactive lighting scenarios.
• Smooth performance – HDR state-of-the-art rendering & up to 60 FPS.

70010000090109.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon
70010000090109.intro: Witness the beginning of the end
70010000090109.description:
The prophesied end of the Zemurian continent draws near, and so does the launch of humanity's first foray into space. A sudden invitation from Marduk to cooperate in a high-tech training exercise sets Van Arkride, Ashen Chevalier Rean Schwarzer, and Father Kevin Graham on a collision course with the secrets at the very core of Zemuria.

Their paths may diverge, but the ultimate question remains the same: Just what lies beyond the edge of the horizon?

70010000090111.name: Dye The Bunny
70010000090111.intro: Dye The Bunny is an Easter horror game about little Ellie going on an Easter Egg Hunt down a rabbit hole.
70010000090111.description:
"Dye the Bunny. Ellie, you have to dye the Bunny."
Little Ellie goes on an Easter Egg Hunt, exploring her garden and wandering off a little too far from home, where she meets a mysterious Bunny. Her dad is calling her for dinner already, but she keeps going further into the rabbit hole.
Dye The Bunny is an Easter horror game. Play as a little girl Ellie, exploring the garden, finding Easter eggs, solving the challenges that come your way, surviving the encounters of the Bunny and going down the rabbit hole, where the Bunny lives. Ellie has a little basket to put the Easter eggs into, as well as other things she can find along the way, which is an intuitive inventory system for the player to use. But at the end of it all, Ellie has to do something. Bunny wants to ask Ellie for a favor. Dye the Bunny. Dye the Bunny, Ellie.
The game also features more endings after the game is completed for further exploration, story and a dark twist.

70010000090116.name: Dog Veterinary: Training Hospital Near Me
70010000090116.intro: Get ready to care for and play in Your Puppy Veterinary!
70010000090116.description:
Welcome to a world where you are the veterinarian that all puppies need.

Learn how to interact with your adorable pups that come to your clinic seeking help and affection. From taking their temperature to knowing how to play with them, you are the hero who helps them heal and regain their energy!

As you care for them, you can grow your veterinary clinic and turn it into the most beloved place for all four-legged friends.

Plus, as you progress in the game, you will learn new things about your furry friends, such as how to play with them, their favorite types of food, how to train them properly, and much more.

Become the star veterinarian, build your team, and welcome even more puppies in need of love and care!


Game Features:

-Heal puppies with magical tools: use vaccines, bandages, and many more tools to make the puppies feel better.
-Make new furry friends: Learn how to better interact with your favorite pets and create a special bond.
-Upgrade your veterinary clinic: Build your space and equip your clinic with the best instruments and dog care areas.
-Expand your clinic your way: Create colors, toys, and special details to make a happy environment for all the puppies.
-Turn each visit into a game: Every pup is a challenge—take care of them and treat them with love so they leave fully recovered.


Your adventure as a veterinarian begins now!

70010000090121.name: Starlair
70010000090121.intro: Enter a massive galaxy of adventures created by the players. Build your own worlds, write music, create bosses - or take on the winding dungeons created by other players.
70010000090121.description:
Starlair is a never-ending adventure game where you'll take on an entire galaxy's worth of planets. Fly your ship through an infinite galaxy finding new challenges along the way. Every planet in the galaxy was created by a player. 

When you land on a planet, the game turns into a side-scrolling adventure filled with puzzles, bosses, and power-ups. Each world houses a secret relic which can be used to unravel the mystery surrounding the ever-expanding universe.

You can play or create - or both! Build massive worlds, write music, create bosses, and share them with the world.

70010000090124.name: Aireo FlightSimulator 2025 Edition
70010000090124.intro: Are you ready for a new adventure? Fasten your seatbelt and experience what it's like to be a pilot as you dive into the most breathtaking landscapes of this planet.
70010000090124.description:
Are you ready for a new adventure? With Aireo FlightSimulator 2025 Edition, you’ll experience the world from an entirely new perspective. Take off from one of over 10,000 real airports and discover the world from above!

New Aircraft: Fly three brand-new aircraft in Aireo FlightSimulator 2025 Edition. In addition to the existing fleet of seven planes, you’ll find a high-speed jet, an airliner, and a light aircraft waiting for you in the hangar!

Global Adventure: Buckle up and lift off to explore the wonders of our planet. Step into the role of a pilot and immerse yourself in the world’s most breathtaking landscapes. From the majestic peaks of the Alps to the sparkling beaches of the Caribbean—this world is in your hands.

Over 10,000 Airports: Land at some of the world’s most iconic airports! Test your skills on short runways, massive international hubs, and remote island airstrips. Each airport offers a new adventure and a fresh chance to hone your flying abilities.

Realistic Physics Engine: Dive into a whole new flying experience with our realistic physics engine. Feel the aerodynamics of your aircraft and master the challenges of the skies.

Real Satellite Imagery: With real satellite data, Aireo FlightSimulator 2025 Edition offers a lifelike and detailed environment for your flight adventures.

Are you ready for a new adventure? Climb into the cockpit with Aireo FlightSimulator 2025 Edition and discover the boundless freedom of aviation!

70010000090126.name: Perfect Hand of Nostalpix
70010000090126.intro: Gather you cards and it's time to duel!
70010000090126.description: "Perfect Hand of Nostalpix" is a classic digital card game where players collect cards, level up, and evolve to build the perfect deck. With a unique world and strategic gameplay, the goal is to defeat enemies in search of the perfect hand, the ultimate decisive move!

70010000090135.name: Arcade Archives Juno FIRST
70010000090135.description:
"Juno FIRST" is a shooter released by KONAMI in 1983.
Operate your own aircraft to defeat countless approaching enemy UFOs and conquer the WAVE.
In an emergency, you can use warp to evade enemy attacks.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*This game uses the Japanese ROM for the main part of the game.
The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000090140.name: Arcade Archives SENKYU
70010000090140.intro: Aim for the winning SENKYU KING!!
70010000090140.description:
"SENKYU" is a puzzle game released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1995.
The game is played by connecting four or more balls of the same color and erasing them to create a chain of four or more balls of the same color, aiming for a high score.
In addition to the SKILL TESTER MODE where you can judge your own skill, you can also participate in the SENKYU tournament and aim for the victory in the NORMAL MODE, as well as engage in 2-player versus battles.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*This game uses the Japanese ROM for the main part of the game.
*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000090145.name: PIYO PUZZ - piyokoro×puzzle -
70010000090145.intro:
Piyokoro returns as a Puzzle Game!
Connect pieces by Color and Shape!
Play solo or with up to four players!
70010000090145.description:
"PIYO PUZZ" is a fun puzzle game where you aim for high scores by clearing pieces.

You can play solo or challenge friends and family in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players!

The game offers two modes:
 - Single Mode: Aim for a high score within the time limit.
 - Multiplayer Mode: Split into two teams and compete for the highest score with up to four players.

Meet a delightful cast of characters like chicks, sparrows, penguins, and more!
Each character has unique skills, so try different ones to boost your score.
Play often, and you may even unlock new characters!

[How to Play]
 - Connect puzzle pieces by "same color" or "same shape" to clear them.
 - Clear more pieces in a single move to earn a higher score.
 - Clear "Snack Pieces" to fill the snack gauge.
 - When the snack gauge reaches six, you can activate your character’s skill.
 - Special pieces like "Wild Pieces", which connect to any color or shape, and "Trick Pieces" make gameplay even more exciting.

[Single Mode]
 - Play solo to reach a high score within the time limit! Clear as many pieces as possible for a top score.

[Multiplayer Mode]
 - Compete in teams with 2 to 4 players in a race for the highest score!
 - One player from each team takes turns playing the puzzle. After five moves, it’s the next player’s turn.
 - While waiting, teammates can cheer on the current player, which might bring extra bonuses!
 Note: Each player needs a controller for multiplayer mode.

70010000090148.name: Two-Sided Runner
70010000090148.intro:
Switch Between Angel and Demon Forms!
Summon Familiars and Strike Back at Powerful Bosses!
A runner action game that tests your decision-making!
70010000090148.description:
◆ Game Features
A side-scrolling runner action game!
Dodge obstacles with jumps and color changes as you navigate enemy-filled stages packed with exciting mechanics.
Aim for the highest score as you soar through dynamic levels!

◆ Color Change System
Both your character and enemies come with White and Black attributes!
 - Same-colored objects pass through each other.
 - Opposite-colored objects collide.

Master this color-switching mechanic for the ultimate experience!
 - Play safe by slipping through hazards.
 - Go bold and defeat enemies to rack up points.

Adapt to every situation and discover the play-style that suits you best!

◆ Gameplay Highlights
・Explore the world with your favorite character:
Each character has unique skills, and their abilities also change depending on whether they’re in their White or Black form.
Use these traits to overcome challenging stages!

・Challenge yourself with rising difficulty:
After defeating three bosses, the Stage Level increases.
More enemies and tougher gimmicks will appear as the danger ramps up!

・Collect items and aim for a high score:
Pick up special items in each stage to boost your attacks.
Summon numerous familiars to unleash dazzling bullet hell-style barrages!
Support items also help with scoring and other key strategies.

◆ Additional Features
・Complete Missions & Earn Titles:
Take on various missions to earn fantastic rewards.
Collect over 100 unique titles based on your achievements, and display your favorites on the home screen!
Some special titles even grant characters extra power-ups!

・Character & Item Growth Systems:
Strengthen your characters and familiars to tackle stages more smoothly.

◆ World Setting
Since ancient times, celestial beings have used White and Black magic to maintain balance in the world below.

One day, a faction of wicked celestial beings emerged, plotting the destruction of the lower world.
They unleashed armies of familiars, throwing the balance into chaos!

The heroes valiantly confronted these villains, pushing them to the brink of defeat.

...But the villains began siphoning massive amounts of magical power from the lower world through their familiars.
Overwhelmed by this newfound strength, the heroes were defeated and cast down to the lower world.

Thus begins the heroes' journey to restore peace, battling rampaging monsters and powerful bosses in a fight to reclaim balance in the world.

70010000090174.name: Cash Guardian: Collector Operation ''Capital Defense''
70010000090174.intro: Defend your cash, outsmart the heist!
70010000090174.description:
Welcome to the high-stakes world of armored cash transportation! In Cash Guardian: Collector Operation "Capital Defense," you take on the thrilling and dangerous role of an armored car collector. Your mission: transport vast sums of money, gold, and precious valuables across the bustling metropolis, protecting them from robbers and unforeseen threats.
Features:
- Intense Armored Car Simulation: Experience the heart-pounding action of real-life cash collection. Navigate city streets, overcome obstacles, and make split-second decisions to ensure your cargo's safety.
- 100 Diverse Missions: Challenge yourself with a massive campaign featuring over 100 unique missions. Each mission offers varying difficulty levels, routes, and objectives, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting.
- Choose Your Collector: Select from six unique playable characters, each with their own look and personality. Find the collector that best suits your playstyle!
- Weaponized Defense: Master a variety of defensive tools and weaponry to deter and eliminate any threat to your precious cargo. From tactical maneuvers to powerful firearms, be prepared for anything.
- Test Your Skills: Every mission pushes your skills to the limit. Develop your courage, caution, and resourcefulness to survive as a master of capital defense.
- Dynamic City Environment: Navigate a living, breathing metropolis filled with traffic, pedestrians, and potential dangers. Stay alert and adapt your tactics to the ever-changing city environment.
Can you overcome the challenges and emerge a true master of capital protection?

70010000090179.name: My Cozy Room
70010000090179.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70010000090179.description:
Description: My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 


Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70010000090187.name: Space CleanUp: Cosmic Robot Disinfector
70010000090187.intro: Fight cosmic grime with your trusty robot disinfector!
70010000090187.description:
Welcome to the not-so-glamorous side of space exploration! In Space CleanUp: Cosmic Robot Disinfector, you take control of a high-tech android tasked with a vital but messy job: cleaning up space stations after intense alien battles.
Game Features:
- Unique First-Person Adventure: Experience a fresh perspective on space exploration as you navigate conquered stations from a first-person viewpoint.
- Become a Cosmic Janitor: Wield a powerful water jet to blast away green alien goo and debris, leaving the stations sparkling clean.
- Treasure Hunter by Day, Cleaner by Night: Use your laser to collect valuable artifacts left behind in the chaos, preparing the stations for future use.
- Unlock New Locations: As you progress through the game, your cleaning expertise will unlock access to new and exciting space stations.
- Stylish Sci-Fi Interface: Immerse yourself in a world of sleek technology and futuristic aesthetics.
- Intriguing Storyline: Unravel the mysteries behind the alien conflicts and the importance of station restoration.
- Engaging Gameplay: Combine satisfying cleaning mechanics with exploration and light puzzle-solving for a truly unique experience.
Can you rise to the challenge and turn the tide of space station sanitation?

70010000090198.name: High Cars 2
70010000090198.description:
Take Your Skills to New Heights in High Cars 2!

Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled ride in High Cars 2! Take control of a variety of unlockable cars as you tackle 40 thrilling tracks across 4 worlds—each designed to test your precision, speed, and driving skills on sky-high courses.

Game Features:

40 Challenging Tracks: Race through tight turns, steep climbs, and daring drops. Each track offers unique layouts, hazards, and moving obstacles that keep every level exciting.

Unlock New Cars: Save you rewards and unlock a range of new cars, each with its own style.

3-Star System: Achieve up to 3 stars on each level by beating the target time! Push for a perfect score by balancing speed and precision to cross the finish line in record time.

High-Altitude Thrills: Feel the rush as you navigate through tracks suspended in the sky, challenging your driving skills with great views and hair-raising turns.

Are you ready to conquer every course, unlock every car, and prove yourself as the ultimate high-altitude racer in High Cars 2?

70010000090203.name: Maniac
70010000090203.intro: Wanna bet it all on sheer mayhem and destruction? In comes Maniac, a rogue-lite crime action game in which the world goes against you, and your insanity creates chaos!
70010000090203.description:
Welcome to Maniac where chaos is just waiting to be unleashed. Maniac is a throwback to times of the Original GTA’s of the world in which mayhem reigned supreme.
With an arsenal of unlockable characters, weapons, and an ever-changing world. Try not to get Busted!

ReAdy tO gO iNSanE?!
GTA meets Vampire Survivors with a dash of Fast and the Furious thrown in to make one hell of a chaotic mess!

Don’t feel crazy enough? We got you! With an arsenal of Democracy at your fingertips from highjacking Bulldozers, Buses, Cop Cars, Tanks, and then some, destruction is all around!

Six psychopaths with a myriad of skills, unlockable gear, and vehicular upgrades all just waiting to be unleashed!

Some of the characters you get to embody:

A murderous Clown
An unemployed, inebriated Santa Claus
A coked-up Broker
A cute Little Girl


You Can’t Say Maniac without a system in place ready to deliver sheer destruction and chaos! With sick drifts from the driving physics to chain reactions ready to explode, the world is dynamic and ever-changing. All of this is backed up by an aggressive AI determined to catch you, so don't get BUSTED!

jOIn iN On tHe MaYHeM aND rEaCh tHe HiGheSt LeVeL!

70010000090208.name: Harvest Moon®: The Lost Valley
70010000090208.intro: A New Evolution of Harvest Moon!
70010000090208.description:
In Harvest Moon: The Lost Valley, you will have to discover why the Lost Valley is cursed in a perpetual winter. With the Harvest Goddess nowhere to be found, and the Harvest Sprites locked away, it's up to you – an unlikely farmer who was caught unexpectedly in one of the Lost Valley’s fierce snowstorms – to discover the source of this curse, and bring the seasons back to the Lost Valley!

Plant crops, raise cows, chickens, and sheep, foster relationships with locals, and even woo a future spouse! Marry, have a child, and unlock the full potential of all seven Harvest Sprites, along with the Harvest Goddess and Harvest God – all inside a world where the land is customized by you!

•	Grow crops and raise animals like cows, chickens, and sheep! 
•	Unleash your creativity with 3D terrain customization—dig, build, and reshape the land! 
•	Unlock the power of seven Harvest Sprites, the Harvest Goddess, and the Harvest God! 
•	Build lasting relationships with the villagers, find love, marry, and start a family! 
•	Enjoy extra outfits, buildings, crops, and characters with all DLC included!

70010000090212.name: Harvest Moon®: Skytree Village
70010000090212.intro: Revive the Land, Save a Village!
70010000090212.description:
Times have changed in the land known as the Oasis of the Harvest Goddess. Many people used to live in Skytree Village, and the land was lush and green. However, the power of the Harvest Goddess gradually began to wane, and the land became parched and dry. 

You will be challenged to restore the seven legendary Skytrees that make the town so iconic and bring power and prosperity to the land around them. Along the way, you’ll meet a new cast of characters (with a few returning familiar faces), user-friendly controls, and the ability customize your farm by terraforming the land! 

•	Meet an array of quirky characters in a bustling town!
•	Customize your terrain to your heart's content!
•	Woo your favorite bachelor or bachelorette and start a family!
•	Discover new crops, flowers, and expanded fishing mechanics!
•	Engage in deeper fishing activities by expanding waterways and catching rare fish!
•	Unlock new cosmetic items and two additional characters with all DLC included!

70010000090218.name: Wild West Shooter
70010000090218.intro: Wild West Shooter captures the essence of the Wild West, where players engage in epic shootouts against low-poly cartoon-style ragdoll bandits.
70010000090218.description: Featuring a compelling single-player campaign and optional multiplayer modes, the game provides an authentic cowboy experience. Players will navigate diverse locations, upgrade weapons, and strategise in fast-paced gun battles, ensuring an adrenaline-fueled adventure.

70010000090228.name: Cats the Commander for Nintendo Switch™
70010000090228.intro:
Too cute Cats "Bump! Bump!" adventure RPG!
"Cats the Commander", popular tower defense game,
is now available on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000090228.description:
◆Intense strategic cat RPG◆
A super casual yet intense adorable cat RPG game!

▼ Accessible for everyone and every cats
Cats the Commander is a game that has a little bit for everyone! both humans and felines!
Come join us in the world full of adorable cats and recruit them to fight in your army!

▼ Simplistic and fun battle system
Customize your team and your special attack
Simply, Strategize and summon your cats to fight
Claw down your enemies until you reach the end!

▼ A new take on tower defense-type game
When you start there is no turning back
The cats will only charge forward and will not stop until they win their battle with glory!

▼ Over 650 characters appear!
Strengthen your team with gacha rolls, no extra purchases needed!
Create your own unique team and clear the stages!

▼ Exclusive original story for the Nintendo Switch™ version
Free the imprisoned Seven Heroes!
A unique story where quirky cats save the world!

70010000090233.name: METAL SUITS: Counter-attack
70010000090233.intro: They should never have ticked him off. Begin a hot-blooded revenge as the protagonist Kevin, who has lost everything and was reborn as a cyborg!
70010000090233.description:
[Game Background]
A side-scrolling run-and-gun action game set in the future. The protagonist, Kevin, who has lost everything and was reborn as a cyborg, begins his quest for revenge against the alien Golida who took everything from him.
 
[Game Synopsis]
Year 4373. Kevin, once praised as a legendary war hero. Now an old and ailing retired soldier, he was spending a peaceful old age on a convalescent ship with his beloved dog, Andy. That is, until the alien Golida invaded, causing the ship to explode and taking away his beloved dog Andy and most of his body.
 
[Experience Various Suits and Intense Battles]
Utilize a variety of combat suits to defeat all the alien Golida! It's time to start your bloody revenge against Golida by discovering various combat suits throughout the game and leveraging the unique features each suit offers.
 
[Explore the diverse planets of Helios]
About 130 years ago, humans left the Solar System and migrated to the Helios system. Explore the nine mysterious planets in the Helios system. Uncover the secrets hidden within Helios.
 
[Discover Hidden Secrets]
Search for the secrets concealed on the nine planets of Helios. You can find various collectibles and uncover diverse stories.

70010000090238.name: The Bakery Tales
70010000090238.intro: Where every recipe tells a story, and every loaf builds a legacy.
70010000090238.description: The Bakery Tales is a delightful bakery management game where you take the reins of a cozy shop in a bustling town. Choose your menu from a selection of recipes, carefully manage stock and ingredient levels, and ensure smooth operations by hiring and managing staff. Balance creativity, strategy, reputation, finances and customer satisfaction as you grow your bakery into a beloved destination.

70010000090240.name: Gravity Escape
70010000090240.intro: Congrats on your magical gravity gun! Escape the planet now!
70010000090240.description:
+ Change gravity, pull objects, teleport, and swap positions! This magical gravity gun is so much fun.
+ Enjoy diverse level designs. There’s more than one way to clear each level—unleash your imagination!
+ Use the gravity gun and various mechanisms to defeat all kinds of bosses.

Your spaceship was forced to crash-land on an unknown planet after an unidentified attack. During your exploration, you discovered a magical gravity gun. Now, it's time to escape this strange planet!

70010000090245.name: Hunter Simulator : Wild Hunting
70010000090245.intro: Track your prey. Feel the suspense. Become a legendary hunter!
70010000090245.description:
Step into the heart of the wild with Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting, where breathtaking landscapes meet the ultimate hunting challenge. Traverse vast open worlds, from dense forests to towering mountains, as you track elusive prey in an unforgiving environment. Armed with a vast array of customizable weapons, you’ll experience the thrill of the chase like never before, as advanced animal AI and dynamic weather add new layers of strategy to every hunt.

Key Features:
       Authentic Hunting Simulation: Dive into a hyper-realistic hunting experience with cutting-edge AI, dynamic weather patterns, and meticulously designed environments that respond to your every move.
       Expansive Open World: Explore diverse ecosystems teeming with life, from serene lakes and rugged mountain ranges to thick forests and open plains.
       Customizable Gear & Progression: Tailor your hunting setup with a wide selection of weapons, scopes, camouflage, and equipment, unlocking new gear as you progress through the game.
       Dynamic Wildlife Interactions: Encounter a range of animals, each with its own unique behaviors and patterns. Track elusive prey, from majestic deer to formidable predators, and rare species in their natural habitats.
        Immersive Visuals & Sound: Stunning visuals and atmospheric audio bring the wilderness to life, enhancing the realism and intensity of every hunt.

Gather your gear, sharpen your instincts, and get ready for the hunt of a lifetime in Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting. The wild awaits.

70010000090250.name: The Wild Age
70010000090250.intro: A relaxing strategy with tower defense elements – build, protect, and rule.
70010000090250.description:
The Wild Age is a micro-management strategy game with tower defense elements, designed for relaxing and casual play. Step into the role of a ruler tasked with building new settlements on distant islands, defending them against nightly goblin attacks, and developing your strategy using the game’s only resource – coins.

Build and manage – recruit villagers, construct buildings, and grow a prosperous settlement.
Defend – goblins strike at night, so prepare your defenses to protect your people.
Different roles – builders, farmers, foresters, and archers each support the village in unique ways.
Characters and mounts – unlock new avatars, pets, and mounts, including the exclusive panda collection.
Your choices – cancel actions, change your character or mount, and even create your own islands to share with friends.

The Wild Age is inspired by the "Kingdom" series but offers its own 3D vision, new mechanics, and multiple paths to victory. Perfect for players who enjoy light strategy combined with a calm and cozy atmosphere.

70010000090266.name: Unwording
70010000090266.intro: Solve puzzles, explore neighborhood and overcome negative self-talk.
70010000090266.description:
Embark on an uplifting journey through the mind of Tom in Unwording. Solve word puzzles, explore the neighborhood through multiple perspectives, and help Tom work towards experiencing a better day by overcoming his negative self-talk and thought patterns.

Tom sees the world through a lonely, glass-half-empty lens. To him, everyday objects morph into complex word puzzles, reminding him of all that he lacks. As he solves each puzzle, the solutions spell out messages that are irrational and defeating.


Until one day, he forgets to shut his window and lets a mischievous little yellow bird into his life, turning his life upside down.

The bird's mischief causes chaos, and by solving word puzzles and exploring his neighborhood, Tom must begin to see things from a different perspective, changing his mindset and transforming his life and the world around him.


Features:
- Three distinct art styles that reflect Tom's inner world - from 2D to 2.5D to 3D.
- A heartfelt story told without uttering a single word of dialogue.
- Challenging word puzzles that change as each in-game day passes, telling their own story.
- Optional “Easy mode” if you’re here just for the story, not the challenge.
- A soothing and tender soundtrack by Trevor Kowalski that evolves with the game.

70010000090272.name: Bunker Builder & Construction Simulator
70010000090272.intro: Build your shelter and prepare for the unexpected!
70010000090272.description:
Step into the shoes of a master engineer and architect as you design, construct, and customize underground bunkers!

Prepare for every scenario—from natural disasters to apocalyptic events.
Buy resources, prepare materials, plan your layouts, and manage upgrades to build the ultimate survival shelter.

- Plan and Build: Use advanced tools to create secure, efficient bunkers.
- Upgrade and Expand: Enhance your structures with cutting-edge technology and new rooms.
- Survival Challenges: Balance resources, meet survivors' needs, and withstand environmental threats.
- Creative Freedom: Customize your bunker to suit your survival style.
- Realistic Construction: Experience a blend of strategy and simulation with dynamic building systems.

Tensions are rising in the world.

Are you ready to construct the ultimate survival shelter?

70010000090277.name: Battlefield Waltz Digital Art Book
70010000090277.description:
Learn more about the world of Battlefield Waltz and the members of the military academy Nirvana with the Digital Art Book. The 33-page Digital Art Book includes character art, rough sketches, and more!

Note: The Digital Art Book may contain spoilers, so we highly recommend playing Battlefield Waltz before viewing it.

70010000090278.name: Esophaguys
70010000090278.intro: You are the Esophaguys, old folks with elongating necks. 1-4 players in co-op, competitive, and solo modes!
70010000090278.description:
You are the Esophaguys, old folks with elongating necks! Stretch, bite, and swing yourself around in 1-4 player guttural mayhem: co-op, competitive, and solo. Progress across each mode, reuniting your lost kin!

Co-op Mode (2-4 players):
Stretch, bite, and swing together, traversing and solving puzzles as you search to reactivate the forgotten monuments of your diasporic people.

Minigame Mode (2-4 players):
In team-based sports, free-for-all arena, and traversal trials, compete, neck-to-neck, to determine who has the greatest gullet.

Story Mode (1-4 players):
Accompanied by poignant narration, embark on a mythical journey to understand the past and shape the future. Will you uncover the true nature of the neck?

Masochist Mode (1-4 players):
No land. No checkouts. Nothing but neck.  Subject yourself to grueling challenges in a hellish atmosphere ripe for speedrunning.

Hub World Progression:
Reconstruct the ancient monument of your people as you progress through each mode, reuniting and unlocking the garb of your lost lengthy kin.

Twanging Tones and Elderly Grunts:
Lose yourself in a soundscape all its own. The first video game dedicated to one of mankind's oldest instruments, the jews-harp. Experience the ancient sound from a variety of world traditions combined with bold experimentations. Reconstructing centuries old tradition from archival material, classic twangs from America, Austria, the British Isles, India, Norway, Kyrgyzstan, and Yakutia will delight your ears with every jugular jiggle. Accompanied with over 4000+ personally-recorded, mouth-originated SFX, prepare your cochleas to be tickled to the extreme.

70010000090283.name: Mysterious pet Monpay Chicory
70010000090283.intro: A pet-raising simulation that raises mysterious pet!
70010000090283.description:
Mysterious Pet Monpay Chicory is a pet-raising simulation.
Raise Monpay Chicory by feeding the food and helping pet's learn words.
Play with Monpay Chicory by jumping rope, playing with a ball, and more.
You can also change pet's clothes and decorate your room with the stuffed animals you have acquired.
Enjoy your life with Monpay Chicory.

70010000090298.name: Break the Loop
70010000090298.intro: Turn-based Rogue-like RPG: build a team, choose events, and stop the apocalypse!
70010000090298.description:
Humanity is coming to an end. An abyssal monster has awakened, determined to enslave the world. But that was without counting on the ingenuity of Friedrich, a genius Chronomancer, who, with the help of his time-traveling machine, forms a top team of the greatest heroes of the past!

Features
• Compose your team of 4 heroes from the 12 available characters
• Create your own timeline with a multitude of random events
• Face your opponents in an original turn-based combat system
• Strengthen your heroes before facing the ultimate threat

70010000090308.name: Battle Royal -  Battlegrounds Call
70010000090308.intro: Where Survival is Earned, Victory is Inherited.
70010000090308.description:
Enter a brutal battle where every moment is a test of survival. In a world where danger lurks around every corner, your instincts will be your greatest weapon. Choose your landing spot wisely, gather weapons, and prepare to face waves of opponents, all fighting for the same goal: to be the last one standing. With each passing second, the battlefield shrinks, intensifying the fight until only one victor remains. Will you rise above the chaos, or be defeated by your rivals?

Key features:

- Explosive and dynamic start: Carefully choose your landing spot, plan your every step, and begin the battle with limited resources.

- Resource gathering and management: Find and collect a wide range of weapons and equipment, including assault rifles, sniper scopes, grenades, and first aid kits, to secure your superiority on the battlefield.

- Face off against enemies: You’ll face a multitude of powerful opponents who must be defeated to claim the top spot. Be ready for an intense battle where every decision can make the difference.

- Shrinking play area: The increasing intensity forces you to move and fight strategically as the map continues to shrink.

- Customization and upgrade system: Earn points and rewards as you eliminate opponents and use them to customize your character and arsenal, giving you a unique advantage in every match.

Prepare to explore, fight, and survive in a game that tests your reflexes, strategies, and courage. Will you be able to push your limits and emerge victorious in a battle royale where only the strongest and smartest triumph? Step into the arena and prove your mastery.

70010000090318.name: Car Wash Tycoon Business Simulator
70010000090318.intro: Transform a simple wash into a car cleaning empire!
70010000090318.description:
In Car Wash Tycoon Business Simulator, bring your dream of owning a car wash business to life! Start with the basics: a simple wash station where you clean your customers' cars by hand. This is how you’ll earn your first money and gain experience. Over time, your business will expand! Attract more customers by adding convenient self-service stations so clients can wash their vehicles themselves.
But that’s not all! As you accumulate funds, you’ll be able to set up powerful tunnel car washes that can process a car from start to finish in just minutes. Grow your business, invest in technology and automation, and build a car wash complex that the entire town will be talking about!
Features:
    Gradual Expansion: Earn money and reinvest it to buy self-service washes, allowing clients to wash      their cars independently, increasing profitability and service accessibility.
    Tunnel Car Washes: Install large automated tunnel washes to speed up service and attract more       clients, helping to boost your income.
    Interior Cleaning Zone: Set up dedicated areas for interior cleaning, offering customers access to      vacuums for self-service cleaning and generating additional income.
    On-Site Shop: Open a small shop where visitors can buy items like water, cookies, or other snacks,      providing a steady stream of extra revenue.
    Business Growth: Automate operations, upgrade equipment, and turn your business into a thriving         complex that becomes the top destination in town!

70010000090325.name: Infernitos
70010000090325.intro: Cook Up Chaos in the Kitchen of Hell!
70010000090325.description:
In Infernitos, take on the role of a little imp chef serving up devilishly delightful dishes to hungry demon patrons. Move the dishes across the fiery kitchen, carefully pushing and delivering them on the table to serve your hellish clients. Every level demands sharp thinking and a strategic approach, as each dish must be assembled with precision to satisfy your picky infernal clientele!

This charming pixel art puzzle game offers 30 increasingly challenging levels across 3 unique biomes. Deliver dishes by skillfully solving puzzles with a wicked twist!

MAIN FEATURES IN INFERNITOS:

• Navigate through 30 challenging, demon-themed levels.
• Explore unique cooking environments
• Serve unique demon customers with diverse and demanding tastes.
• Plan your moves to push the  plates perfectly on the table.
• Enjoy nostalgic pixel art and devilishly fun puzzle gameplay!

70010000090330.name: Sokomonster
70010000090330.intro: Unleash chaos, strategize destruction, and conquer the city - monster style!
70010000090330.description:
Sokomonster is a thrilling puzzle game where chaos and strategy collide. You play as a powerful monster invading a city, tasked with destroying buildings by pushing cars into them. Progress through 30 uniquely designed levels, each filled with new challenges and obstacles that test your wits and destructive skills!

Welcome to the world of Sokomonster!

In this urban battlefield, you’ll navigate streets packed with cars, planning each move to maximize destruction. With every building you level, you come closer to conquering the city. But beware—levels become more complex, and only the most strategic monster will reign supreme. Can you crush the city’s defenses and complete all stages?

- 30 handcrafted levels with escalating difficulty.
- Challenging puzzles that require careful planning and strategy.
- Destruction-based gameplay—unleash your inner monster and demolish everything in your path.
- Easy to learn, master the path of destruction!

70010000090345.name: Stray Children
70010000090345.intro: If all the adults you knew were monsters who attacked on sight, what would you do?
70010000090345.description:
"The Olders are those things who don't listen to anyone and suddenly get violent, right?"

This is the story of children who live just like this, trying to survive and thrive in a world not quite like our own. This is an RPG adventure that will change the way you think about “children” and “adults”.

THE STORY

Somewhere, in a secret room, in a secret place, a curious boy flips the switch of a dusty old console. He's suddenly pulled through the screen into a very strange somewhere else: a never-released and long-forgotten retro RPG.

He blinks awake in a land where only Children live. Outside their stronghold's walls lurk The Olders: monstrous adults carrying the heavy load of their own inadequacies, self-doubt, and the many other grievances that all grown-ups gather. 

It’s here — in this funny, mysterious, and wildly dangerous domain — that your story begins.

THE GAMEPLAY

As you explore the world of Stray Children, you’ll do turn-based battle with these oddball Olders. You can choose to fight, or to use your words as weapons, and land a crushing blow with just a well-worded whisper.

Dodge the barrage of their bottled-up emotions, and discover the secrets they keep hidden deep inside. By touching their heart with your words, you might just be able to save their souls.

What other mysteries await you in this weird new world? Find out in Stray Children — an unfamiliar place, with all-too-familiar troubles.

ONE MORE THING

We hope you’ll enjoy discovering all the secrets in Stray Children, but we have one request for everyone who finishes the game: please keep the ending a secret!

70010000090347.name: Aery - Dream Land
70010000090347.intro: Escape the daily hustle, feel the freedom of flying, and immerse yourself in beautiful, peaceful landscapes
70010000090347.description:
In this interactive game experience, you step into the role of a small bird, soaring through breathtaking landscapes while collecting magical crystals that mark certain locations. The game is not about defeating enemies or overcoming dangerous obstacles, but rather about immersing yourself in a peaceful and tranquil environment. It is designed to relax your mind and soul, providing a soothing escape from the stresses of everyday life.
With no threats or enemies to worry about, you can fully focus on enjoying the beauty of the world around you and the sensation of flying freely. The game aims to give you a sense of liberation and lightness, offering the perfect retreat to unwind after a busy day and leave behind the rush of the outside world.
One of the unique features of this game is that you can select the level that best suits your desire to relax. The levels are designed to be completed quickly, so you can enjoy a short break if you're looking for a brief moment of peace. However, if you have more time and wish to explore, you can take a slower pace and dive deeper into the environment. This flexibility allows you to choose the experience that fits your needs, whether it's a short moment of calm or a longer, more immersive journey.
The game showcases a beautiful collection of some of the most stunning landscapes from the Aery franchise. These carefully crafted sceneries offer a visual oasis of tranquility, ranging from majestic mountains and vast forests to peaceful lakes and endless skies. Each scene is designed not only to delight the eyes but also to create an atmosphere of calm that invites you to relax.
We hope you enjoy the beautiful landscapes and that they help you unwind and find peace. So, sit back, take a deep breath, and let the magic of this world carry you away. It’s an invitation to give yourself a break and fully experience the present moment.

70010000090350.name: Rooftops & Alleys: The Parkour Game
70010000090350.intro: In solo or with your friends, explore in total freedom massive-parkour-ready maps. Uncover hidden spots — time trials, trick challenges, and more!
70010000090350.description:
Rooftops & Alleys is more than just a game about Parkour & Freerunning. It’s the adrenaline rush of landing an impossible trick combo, defying gravity, and feeling like you’re flying… until you crash face-first into a dark alley 30 meters below.

In solo or with your friends, explore in total freedom massive-parkour-ready maps. Reach every corner of your playground to uncover hidden spots — time trials, trick challenges, and more! In multiplayer, dive into game modes like TAG, Capture the Flag, Trick Battles, or simply freeroam with your friends!

- Explore huge, unique, vertical parkour environments
- Discover, learn, and master every trick, move, and their endless combo possibilities
- Call on your pigeon to discover new areas, fast travel, and plan your routes
- Tons of challenges and game modes — solo or with friends (TAG, Capture the Flag, Trick Battles, and more)
- Unlock over 100 customization options for yourself and your pigeon

70010000090354.name: Flower Power: The Adventures of Magical Plants
70010000090354.intro: The story follows Valentina, a brave and curious young girl who discovers a magical garden hidden near her home.
70010000090354.description:
In this enchanted garden, the flowers and plants can talk, and each has its own unique personality. However, the garden is dying because its life force, the magical melody, has been lost.

Valentina discovers that without the melody, the garden will wither, and it's up to her to find it and restore it.

70010000090356.name: Debug Girl
70010000090356.intro:
Spend a summer with an old high school classmate making games! Play and debug a 2D action RPG to 
make the best game ever.
70010000090356.description: Debug Girl is a new and exciting combination of retro pixel art action, visual novel, and debugging. You, the player, have just bumped into your old classmate, Kurumi Sakura, at a game shop, and the two of you hit it off.  You set your minds to spending your summer break creating a game together. With her in charge of debugging, the two of you aim to create the best game, all while dealing with the many bugs and glitches you so carelessly create. Can you finish the game in time, and more importantly, what will become of your relationship with one another...?

70010000090362.name: Football Mini Stars
70010000090362.intro: Take the title of the best football player in a cute cartoon world.
70010000090362.description:
Enter a colourful world that's looking for a new football star! Defeat your opponents with your amazing skills and take the cup home! 

Get through the tutorial, master the game controls and choose your team to start your football career. Defeat all your opponents while collecting achievements and have fun with the different game modes.

Become the biggest football star!

70010000090367.name: TCG Card Market Simulator
70010000090367.intro: Create a shop that every TCG fan dreams of visiting!
70010000090367.description:
Start your own card shop in TCG Card Market Simulator! Stock up on the latest booster packs, or open them yourself to grow your personal collection. Set prices, manage your stock, hire staff, and organize tournaments to attract TCG fans. In this card shop simulation, your mission is to turn your small business into a bustling hub for trading card enthusiasts, all while navigating the ups and downs of the market to maximize profits.
Manage Your Store: Customize your shop layout, keep shelves neat, and highlight rare cards to create a seamless shopping experience. Make smart business moves, track market trends, and build a loyal customer base as you grow your TCG empire!
Features:
- Shop Customization: Design and personalize your card shop’s layout, from shelves to decor, to enhance the customer experience and attract more buyers.
- Inventory Management: Stock your store with the latest booster packs, single cards, and rare finds. Balance supply and demand while avoiding overstocking or running out of hot items.
- Pricing and Strategy: Set your own prices, offering discounts or marking up rare cards to maximize profits. Adapt your strategy to market trends and customer preferences.
- Market Trends: Monitor the fluctuating TCG market, predict price changes, and make strategic investments to capitalize on the rise and fall of card values.

70010000090372.name: Vinebound: Tangled Together
70010000090372.intro: You're tied together, but with cooperation this can be your mightiest weapon!
70010000090372.description:
Vinebound is a co-op first roguelike for 1-2 players where you have to coordinate attacks with a ping-pong cooldown to defeat hordes of enemies. 

Can your friendship survive the botanical mayhem of Garden Lands? 

Features:
- True Co-op Madness – Bound together by a vine, every step is a team effort, every stretch a potential disaster—so plan wisely... or embrace the chaos!

- Flavourful Builds – Create wild combos! Pumpkin Bombs, Boomeringues, blazing Spicy Sauces, and more!

- Chaotic Arenas – Dodge shifting lava walls, slide on icy floors, and battle elite enemies in unpredictable arenas.

70010000090377.name: GOST of Time
70010000090377.intro: 42 and more ways of using your own dead body in time travel.
70010000090377.description:
GOST of Time is an absurdist top-down action and puzzle game with time-traveling mechanics.

Welcome to a distant and absurd future where even time is subject to government regulations. In this glorious era of progress, an elderly citizen requires vital medication. He acquires a government-approved Time-Clone™ device for pill delivery. The process is, as always, efficient and precise - to get the pills, he must clone himself and send the clone into the machine, where it solves puzzles, retrieves the pills, and travels through time.

You play as the clone, created to serve a greater purpose. Your job is to face challenges, bypass obstacles, and solve puzzles to retrieve the pills for the old man. Every time you go back in time, you'll encounter your past self, repeating all your actions exactly. By working with your past selves, you solve puzzles to get the pill. Remember: you're your best ally and worst enemy!

Features:
- Time-traveling mechanics: play with your past selves.
- Collect ancient artifacts from the Old Era.
- Hemoglobin, pixel violence, and dark humor.

70010000090382.name: JIGSAW CHRONICLES: Haunting Tales
70010000090382.intro: Piece together haunting tales from around the world.
70010000090382.description:
Jigsaw Chronicles: Haunted Tales takes you on a journey across the globe, where puzzles reveal eerie folklore and haunted legends from four distinct continents. With 20 unique images and meticilously written stories, this game introduces you to the mysterious and supernatural tales that have shaped cultures throughout history.

Key Features:

- Four Haunted Categories: Explore the continents and discover folklore filled with haunted stories and chilling characters. Each region brings five unique puzzles and their own tale.
- Unique Stories: Each puzzle unlocks a unique narrative, bringing the folklore behind the image to life.
- Free Play Mode: Replay each puzzle with customizable difficulty—choose from easy, medium, or hard by adjusting the piece count.
- Enhanced Gameplay: Enjoy immersive puzzle-solving with haptic feedback and controller sound effects, adding a new dimension to the experience.
- Epic Visuals & Soundtrack: Enjoy high-resolution art and a hauntingly atmospheric soundtrack that complements the theme.

Jigsaw Chronicles: Haunted Tales offers a captivating mix of puzzle-solving and storytelling, perfect for those who enjoy both folklore and a touch of the supernatural. Will you uncover the mysteries hidden in these haunted legends?

70010000090390.name: Titanigods
70010000090390.intro: Welcome to the world of Titanigods!
70010000090390.description:
Join our gods: Poseidon, Dionysius, and Aphrodite. On a journey to defeat the 12 Titans. It will be a journey of great battles. A war awaits you!

-Some elements of Titanigods:

-BD-ED system:

*Titanigods uses a system called BD-ED. Where Bosses (Titans) are defeated, but regular enemies are not (Bosses Die-Enemies Don't).

-BP System:

*Also, Bosses give prizes for their defeat: BP! Bosses Prizes! Use these items (including equipment) in your favor!

-more than 40 new songs!

* more than 40 songs made by me. Enjoy a wide selection of tracks and styles.

-Too much to search!

* Search each corner. It is not known what will be found out there!

-Fully 3D and different camera angles!

* Titanigods presents a fully 3D world! Change the camera angles and enjoy the beauty of this world. Also, there is a First-Person view (FP Mode).

-Various charismatic NPCs!

Several characters await you, in different ways, on this adventure. Titans, gods, and goddesses.

-Many items to collect!

Let's get everything!

Welcome to your battle! Titanigods!

70010000090404.name: Learn to Play - Santa's Sleigh Ride
70010000090404.description:
You are Santa Clause and it's your task to deliver all the Christmas presents, just in time for the holidays.

Hop on your sleigh, fly over a bustling town, decide who's been good or bad and deliver lots of wonderful presents to all the happy townsfolk.

Watch out for obstacles in the sky! Can you make it in time for Christmas?

70010000090409.name: Staffer Case: A Supernatural Mystery Adventure
70010000090409.description:
Staffer Case is a new sort of mystery game, asking players to find clues, arrange them into documents, and point out the contradictions between them to solve a series of murders.

The game is set in a fictional version of London in the 1960s where 10% of all residents have some sort of supernatural ability. In this city, incidents involving staffers, the people who have these abilities, are constantly occurring.

Players take the role of the Mana Affairs Division's newest detective, Notrick, in order to make sense of these incidents. Since the tricks buried within these staffer cases, at their core, revolve around the supernatural abilities of these criminals, conventional investigative methods won't be enough to solve them. Instead, players will have to rely on the documents that explain what their suspects' abilities entail in order to make sense of everything.

70010000090415.name: Cowboys vs Zombies
70010000090415.intro: Fight for survival in the Wild West!
70010000090415.description:
In a world where the undead have taken over the Wild West, it's up to you to fight back. As a brave cowboy, you'll embark on an epic adventure to survive the zombie outbreak, unlocking powerful characters, weapons, and pets along the way.

-Start your adventure as our valiant cowboy, and unlock 9 unique characters, each with their own backstory and skills.

-Create 400 unique builds based on perks that will empower your weapons, create devastating explosions, summon elemental magic like lightning, fire and ice.

-Choose a loyal pet companion to fight alongside you. Each pet has special abilities, some will empower your weapons and skills and some have unique skills of their own.

-Face hordes of zombies, unique elites and bosses that will test your shooting, dodging and strategic thinking.

-Diverse, random locations starting from abandoned towns and graveyards in the wild west and finishing with dark mines and mysterious forests. Each location has unique enemies, challenges and secrets to discover.

-Vast Weaponry, beginning from classic revolvers and rifles to unique firearms like the Tesla gun. Choose from a vast array of weapons to suit your style and complement your build.

-Collect resources and XP from each location to upgrade your characters, pets, skills, and weapons. Strengthen your arsenal to face tougher enemies.

-Stunning graphics and a captivating soundtrack that transport you straight into the heart of the Wild West zombie apocalypse.

-Complete missions and challenges to earn rewards and unlock new locations, enemies and bosses.

Cowboys vs Zombies is not just a top down western roguelike action; it's a battle for the survival of the Wild West. You are the only chance for this world. Do you have what it takes to survive the onslaught and escape the clutches of the undead?

70010000090420.name: Wukong Sun: Black Legend
70010000090420.intro:
Unleash the Legend of the Monkey King!
Battle through chaos, conquer mythical foes, and reclaim your destiny.
70010000090420.description:
Embark on an epic Journey to the West in Wukong Sun: Black Legend! Step into the role of the immortal Wukong, the legendary Monkey King, as he battles through a chaotic world teeming with powerful monsters and untold dangers. Explore a story inspired by Chinese mythology, filled with action-packed battles, stunning environments, and legendary foes.
Features:
Unleash Legendary Power: Take control of Wukong's supercharged abilities and crazy fighting skills to crush all enemies standing in your way. Use strategy and skill to emerge victorious in the heat of battle.
Conquer Four Chaos Maps: Adventure through iconic locations such as the Flower-Fruit Mountain, White Bone Cave, Accumulated Thunder Mountain, and Nibbana, each guarded by formidable bosses like the Bull Demon King, Princess Iron Fan, White Bone Demon, and even Tathagata Buddha’s hand!
Thrilling Levels: Overcome diverse challenges in a wide range of levels filled with dynamic battles, hidden secrets, and mythical lore.
Upgrade and Customize: Strengthen Wukong with powerful upgrades and unlock four distinct skins to suit your style of play.
Immersive Mythological World: Dive into the chaos of a world inspired by ancient legends, blending captivating visuals with unforgettable storytelling.

70010000090425.name: STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Digital Art Book & Soundtrack
70010000090425.intro: Build your farm in Zephyr Town and breathe new life into the once-famous bazaar
70010000090425.description:
A Digital Art Book & Soundtrack App featuring 115 pages of exclusive artwork, including illustrations of characters, animals, and development materials. Enjoy all 66 music tracks from STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar at your leisure.

Please note: The Digital Art Book & Soundtrack App is a separate application from the main game.

70010000090426.name: Jumper Jon
70010000090426.description:
Jumper Jon is a 30-second metroidvania-style platforming adventure!

Jon is a tiny devil who lives in Limbo. One day, something fell from above and caused a big impact. Jon decided to explore and found it was a girl named Jane.

Together, they will discover the source of the imbalance between good and evil on Earth and fight against it.

Explore Hell in 30-second chunks! It does not matter if you run out of time or die, you will get back and keep the items you get!

Game features
- Metroidvania adventure with a unique gameplay concept!
- Discover a great and intriguing story!
- Find special items and abilities and explore the Hell!
- Rescue Souls to get collectible trophies!
- Simple and intuitive game controls!
- Beauty cartoon-styled graphics!
- Awesome original soundtrack!

Ogre Pixel
2025

70010000090431.name: Alruna and the Necro-Industrialists
70010000090431.intro: The heart that beats, beats brutally
70010000090431.description:
Alruna is a dryad in a dying world – a spirit of life in the land of the dead. The earth is sucked dry. There is only The Sprawl. Poor, bedraggled skele-men dot the Wasteland of the Necro-Industrialists and shuffle endlessly back and forth in a toiling mockery of life. But are they the real enemy? Or do the skeletons suffer just as much as the dryads under the domination of the Necro-Industrialists?

And salvation? Is it possible? Dead men yearn for Heaven. But the dead can only dig...

70010000090433.name: Masked Devourer
70010000090433.intro: Unravel the secret of this town and that uncanny mask!
70010000090433.description: You play as young blogger, who loves filming her careless travels in forgotten and forbidden places. She doesn't believe in mysticism and all sorts of superstitions, but one day, wandering into a strange Japanese city, she completely changes her mind...

70010000090449.name: Airplane Flight Simulator : Combat Zone
70010000090449.intro: Prove Yourself as the Ultimate Pilot!
70010000090449.description:
Do you like piloting legendary fighter jets? In Airplane Flight Simulator : Combat Zone, you have open-world maps to explore, with an amazing selection of realistic airplanes. Enjoy the fully immersive experience provided by awesome flight controls, realistic interiors, sound effects and challenging weather scenarios.

In this flight simulator, you can engage in realistic combat and destroy all kinds of enemies, such as boats, ships, trucks, tanks and fighter jets. Prove yourself as the best pilot when faced with combat scenarios!

Features:

• Many planes to choose from
• Different open-world maps
• Spectacular weather
• Realistic flight controls
• Actual plane cockpits
• Challenging combat scenarios
• Accurate engine sounds
• In-flight radio communications
• Lots of customization options
• Various enemy types like boats, ships, trucks, tanks and planes

70010000090459.name: CardMart: TCG Supermarket
70010000090459.intro: Build your card shop empire and collect rare finds!
70010000090459.description:
Step into the world of CardMart: TCG Supermarket, where you're in charge of building the ultimate trading card destination. Start with a small storefront and turn it into a bustling hotspot for card collectors and fans.

- Build and Expand Your Store: Begin by customizing your shop’s layout, stocking shelves with trading cards, figures, and collectibles. As your customer base grows, you’ll need to expand your store and improve its design to attract more visitors.

- Manage Your Business: Handle the ins and outs of daily operations. Stock inventory, manage staff, and serve customers as you balance the challenges of running a store. Hire the right team and train them to make sure your business runs smoothly.

- Discover Rare Cards: Collect rare cards to build a valuable inventory. Display your best finds in dedicated showcases to draw in customers and grow your profits.

- Create Spaces for Players: Set up tables for in-store card tournaments and create a welcoming environment for the trading card community. Hosting events can boost your sales and build a loyal customer base.

Ready to be the card kingpin? In CardMart: TCG Supermarket, the only thing rarer than a legendary card is a quiet day behind the register!

70010000090464.name: TCG Card Shop Master
70010000090464.intro: What’s your strategy for becoming a top card retailer?
70010000090464.description:
Dive into TCG Card Shop Master, a 3D game where you’re in charge of your own trading card shop! Start small, expand, and create the go-to spot for TCG collectors and fans.

Customize and Grow
Stock your shelves with trading cards, rare collectibles, and cool accessories. Use your profits to expand floor space and improve your store’s layout.

Connect with Customers
Keep customers happy by listening to their needs and adjusting prices. Strike the right balance between prices and inventory, and build a strong fanbase.

Hire and Manage Staff
As business picks up, hire employees to help run the shop. Assign tasks like restocking shelves and assisting at the cash register to keep things running smoothly.

Collect Rare Cards
Search for rare cards to add to your inventory and showcase them in unique displays. These special finds will attract even more customers and boost your sales.

Create Play Areas
Add game tables for customers to enjoy card battles, boosting engagement and bringing in extra revenue.

Transform your shop into the ultimate TCG hangout, packed with rare cards, cool accessories, and lively play areas. Just be ready to give a friendly nudge when those table dwellers start treating your shop like their second home—there’s only so much free seating to go around!

70010000090469.name: Sky Aces: WWII Air Combat
70010000090469.intro: Rule the skies in epic aerial combat and change the course of history!
70010000090469.description:
Soar into history with Sky Aces: WWII Air Combat, a pulse-pounding World War II flight simulator that puts you in the cockpit of legendary warplanes. Choose from over 50 meticulously detailed aircraft and engage in intense dogfights, strategic bombing runs, and daring naval missions across iconic theaters of war. From intercepting enemy bombers to defending key ground targets, every mission will test your skill, strategy, and nerve.

Lead your own squadron of elite pilots, customize and upgrade your aircraft, and experience breathtaking 3D environments inspired by Europe, North Africa, and the Pacific. With realistic weather effects, day-night cycles, and immersive flight mechanics, every battle feels alive.

Will you rise through the ranks to become the ultimate WWII ace and change the tide of war? The skies are yours to conquer!

70010000090478.name: To the Moon: Sigmund Minisode 1 (Holiday Special)
70010000090478.description: Return to the world of To the Moon in this heartfelt spin-off that dives deeper into the lives of Dr. Eva Rosalene and Dr. Neil Watts. During a holiday season filled with both festive cheer and public protests against the Sigmund Corporation, this minisode explores the ethical dilemmas and emotional challenges behind their wish-fulfillment work.

70010000090480.name: To the Moon: Sigmund Minisode 2 (Holiday Special)
