70010000090480.description: Step into the next chapter of To the Moon with Sigmund Minisode 2, a poignant holiday-themed spin-off that offers a deeper look at the lives of Dr. Eva Rosalene and Dr. Neil Watts. This part continues to explore the personal struggles, mysterious secrets, and ethical dilemmas faced by the doctors of Sigmund Corporation.

70010000090482.name: Bimfli and His Travels In Time: Greece
70010000090482.intro: Bimfli and his travels in time is an interactive graphic novel about the adventures of Bimfli, a young architect.
70010000090482.description:
Bimfli and his travels in time is an interactive graphic novel about the adventures of Bimfli, a young architect. The protagonist inherits from his grandfather a magical sundial with which he can travel through time and will find himself involved in different adventures, which will take place in the different capitals of the world. 

In this chapter, Bimfli will travel to ancient Greece and meet such emblematic figures as the goddess Athena or the philosopher Socrates. The protagonist will overcome different challenges that will test his value as an architect.

· An easy game designed for children.

·Entertaining children's story that is easy to read. 

·Learn to read with fun stories in English. 

·Upbeat ambient music and sounds based on the culture of each country. 

·Learn about monuments, cities, civilizations, geography and architecture. 

·Educational content on art history with the recreation of the best painters and architects of each era. 

·Learn about the world's major capitals, as they were in ancient times. 

·Adjust accessibility settings such as font height, sound volume, and image transition speed. 

·Promote diversity and discover multicultural traditions, exploring the world with Bimfli.

70010000090486.name: Kosmo Skirmish
70010000090486.intro: A multiplayer space combat game. From 2 to 8 players, take on your friends on the various destructible planets.
70010000090486.description:
Kosmo Skirmish is a multiplayer space combat game. Choose your arsenal carefully to take down your opponents!

Features:
• From 2 to 8 players: on the same screen, online - or both at the same time.
• Procedurally generated destructible terrain.
• Select your equipment of 4 weapons from an arsenal of 12 weapons and tools.
• Several game modes: Each for themselves or as a team.
• Hostile environments: Lava rise, death laser, meteorites, gas balls.
• Game settings: victory points, time, placement.

70010000090491.name: Cat MeowMart: Supermarket Simulator
70010000090491.intro:
For cats, 
by cats, 
and all about cats!
70010000090491.description:
Cat MeowMart: Supermarket Simulator is the ultimate shopping experience for cats!

In this purrfectly playful simulator, you manage a feline-only supermarket filled with everything a cat could ever want - fishy treats, scratching posts, cozy beds, and more. 

Design your store, stock up on kitty essentials, and watch your fellow felines pounce on their favorite products. Whether it's toys, treats, or top-tier litter, Cat MeowMart lets you create the purrfect shopping experience for your furry customers. 

It's a cat's world, and you're in charge of running the coolest store on the block!

70010000090496.name: Christmas Store: Santa's Supermarket Simulator
70010000090496.intro: Fill your cart with Joy and Jingles!
70010000090496.description:
Step into the ultimate holiday shopping adventure with Santa's Supermarket Simulator! Experience the festive frenzy as you take on the role of manager of the jolliest store in town. Oversee aisles packed with gifts, goodies, and holiday cheer while ensuring the shop runs smoothly for all the holiday shoppers.

Enjoy exciting simulator features like:
-Shop Management: Stock shelves, organize displays, and ensure everything is ready for the busiest season of the year.
-Customer Satisfaction: Handle a steady stream of shoppers, ensuring they find everything on their wish lists.
-Inventory Control: Keep track of stock levels and reorder popular items to avoid empty shelves.
-Shop Upgrades: Unlock new sections, improve efficiency, and expand your supermarket to handle the holiday rush.

As the administrator of Santa's Supermarket, it’s up to you to create a magical shopping experience and make this the merriest season ever!

70010000090501.name: Kynseed
70010000090501.intro: A beautiful life sim sandbox RPG from veterans of the Fable series.
70010000090501.description:
Embark on a lifetime of adventure in a beautiful world of creativity and intrigue. Raise a family, customise your farm, run a business, craft items, and battle monsters!

Your actions and decisions matter in our adventurous story filled with purpose and promise. Lend a helping hand to villagers in need and discover the unique blend of creativity and choice that sets Kynseed apart. Come and join us - your legacy awaits!

• Story-driven RPG set in beautiful regions, where you’ll battle dark faery tale creatures.
• Customise your farm and farmhouse using Kynseed's customisation mode with hundreds of items and limitless design possibilities.
• Take on the role of shopkeeper and run your own blacksmith, potion shop, tavern, or bustling goods store.
• Develop relationships with villagers who will remember your deeds, actions, and pranks!
• Combat the evil Hob army as they construct powerful totems and cause the destruction of crops and buildings.
• Rebuild broken houses and buildings for your neighbours and new NPCs.
• Gather materials to create items, forge weapons or mix cures for bizarre maladies.
• Buy strange artifacts from the mysterious Mr. Fairweather — items that ease your chores, boost your combat skills, or simply let you bend the rules of the world. But beware his life tax: each one costs years from your life.
• A world where everyone ages -  raise a family then step into your children's shoes and continue your legacy.

In Kynseed, live your life the way you choose in a lovingly handcrafted 2D open world.

70010000090503.name: There's No Santa
70010000090503.intro: There's no Santa is a hidden object game with a selection of 9 locations and Christmas-themed items to find for each of them.
70010000090503.description:
Enjoy the season with There's no Santa, a delightful hidden-object game with colorful locations and Christmas-related objects to discover. Search for Christmas-themed items in a cozy, cartoony world that’s perfect for casual gamers and puzzle enthusiasts alike. 

With three levels of difficulty, it offers great replayability. Combine this with 9 festive locations, 20 items to find, and a pool of 60 items random every play which makes it a never-ending Find and Seek game. Use the hint system and zoom feature to help locate tricky objects. 

Key Features:

9 festive locations 
3 levels of difficulty 
20 out of 60 items per game 
Hint system, zoom


Enjoy a festive hidden object adventure with There's no Santa!

70010000090509.name: The Bee Hive
70010000090509.intro: Defend the insect kingdom from the spiders, in this colourful 3D action-adventure platformer, The Bee Hive! Crafted entirely by one developer, a love letter to the platformers of old.
70010000090509.description:
The Bee Hive is a colourful, hand-crafted 3D platformer inspired by the golden age of platforming classics. Built entirely by one developer over 9 years, this solo passion project is packed with charm, chaos and a surprising sting in its tail.

The insect kingdom is in danger. Mecha-Spider has sent a rogue signal, leading a full-blown spider uprising to shatter the elemental stones and destroy the natural world as we know it.

As Honeybee, you'll dash, sting, climb, zipline, and swim through 16 vibrant levels. From tropical jungles and lava gorges to frozen peaks, floating castles, cyberpunk spider cities and even outer space - on a mission to bring balance back to the insect realm and defeat Mecha-Spider.

You won’t face it alone. Alongside you are:
Dasher the Snail – your slowest but most loyal hype-man
Lovebug the Ladybird – your high-flying, brave bug bestie
Mr. Spider – a mysterious ally (or is he?) who may know more than he lets on

With fully-voiced characters, bee powers to unlock, quirky gadgets and weapons, dozens of collectibles, platforming puzzles and Lovebug’s flying missions, The Bee Hive is a nostalgic blast for fans of classic adventure.

Key Features:
16 handcrafted levels across vibrant biomes
Unlock bee powers: sting, shield, climb, zipline, swim
Gadgets and weapons to find, build, and use
Fully-voiced insect cast full of charm and secrets
Collect gems, gear, gadgets, and memories
Built solo over 9 years with love, spite, and a lot of bugs… the good kind!

If you miss the colour, character, and collectathons of the N64™ era - buzz in.

Welcome to The Bee Hive.

70010000090514.name: Motorbikes Pro 2025
70010000090514.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70010000090514.description:
Get behind the wheel in Motorbikes Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Motorbikes racing action.  Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision.  Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

70010000090516.name: Arcade Archives Othello
70010000090516.intro: Timeless gameplay that never fails to get intense!
70010000090516.description:
"Othello" is a game of Reversi released by SUCCESS in 1984.
The rules are extremely simple while still requiring widely varied strategies, for fun and depth independent of luck.
This title includes features to help players practice and learn strategies, such as to evaluate your moves or to undo moves once made.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000090521.name: Arcade Archives ASSAULT PLUS
70010000090521.intro:
The curtain rises on a new battle!
Take on two original scenarios in this release!
70010000090521.description:
"ASSAULT PLUS" is a shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1988.
Take control of a tank and do battle with enemies! Using separate controls for your left and right treads, the game has a distinctive charm once you master its controls.
This title features minor upgrades over its predecessor, "ASSAULT," offering new stages to play while retaining the fun of the original!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000090526.name: Arcade Archives PINBALL ACTION
70010000090526.intro: Video game pinball with four separate tables!
70010000090526.description:
"PINBALL ACTION" is a pinball game released by TEHKAN (KOEI TECMO GAMES) in 1985.
Try to clear all the features on all four tables, switching between them over the game!
Use tricks to shake the tables, control the ball, and seize any chance at a win!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*This game uses the Japanese ROM for the main part of the game.
The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000090536.name: Princesses Lylop: Royal Puzzle Challenge
70010000090536.intro: Assemble 60 stunning princess puzzles, from elegant portraits to fantasy scenes. Test your skills, immerse in magic, and discover them all!
70010000090536.description:
Explore a magical world with 60 captivating images of beautiful princesses! From elegant and sophisticated portraits to enchanted landscapes and fantasy scenes, each puzzle offers a unique experience as you assemble the pieces, revealing details and vibrant colours that capture the grace and charm of these regal figures. 

Whether you're a beginner or an expert puzzler, each challenge is designed to be fun and test your skills. Get ready to puzzle all kinds of princesses!

Don't miss the opportunity to immerse yourself in this visual adventure full of magic, fantasy and elegance! Will you be able to complete all the puzzles and discover all the princesses? Test your skills and enjoy an experience full of charm and endless fun!

70010000090540.name: Need For Race - Street King
70010000090540.intro: Fuel your ambition, ignite the streets, and race beyond the horizon!
70010000090540.description:
Do you have what it takes to dominate the streets and become the ultimate racing legend?

Start your journey as an ambitious street racer from a small town, chasing the dream to challenge the fiercest competitors in the bustling megapolises. Earn your reputation, customize your ride, and prove your skills on the most adrenaline-pumping tracks in the country!

Key Features:

- Explore 3 Vibrant Megacities: Race across  6x3 challenging tracks, each packed with twists, turns, and thrilling surprises.

- Rise from the Bottom: Start with a broken car and transform it into a racing beast through customizations and upgrades.

- Dual Race Modes: Take on traditional races or compete in high-stakes time trials to test your speed and precision.

- Boss Battles: Face off against powerful city bosses at the end of each location to secure your place as the street king.

- Customization & Tuning: Upgrade your car's performance and style to suit your racing strategy and show off your personal flair.

- Fast-Paced Gameplay: Experience the rush of high-speed street racing where every second counts.

- Dynamic Tracks: Navigate diverse environments, from narrow urban streets to sprawling highways, each with unique challenges.

- Compete to Win: Finish first at all costs – it’s the only way to claim your spot as the best!

Get ready to burn rubber, outrun your rivals, and make your name in the underground racing world. "NEED FOR RACE - STREET KING" isn’t just a game – it’s a race for your legacy. Are you ready to hit the streets?

70010000090545.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Chuncheon City
70010000090545.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000090545.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage captured by an actual flying drone.
There is no up, down, left, or right direction manipulation, only manipulation to speed up/slow down the drone's speed.

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Chuncheon City, Korea, in a "Real" video!
This production takes place on Chuncheon City.
There are 10 flight courses, and the total operating time for all courses is more than 60 minutes.
1080P high-definition video faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real life and provides a strong sense of immersion in the game.
You can feel like you are a real drone pilot with smooth, realistic video playback.
Huge volume! You can fly to 10 locations showing the beautiful scenery of Chuncheon City!
Two play modes are supported: section-by-section driving mode and view mode driving.
Visit Korea’s Chuncheon City anytime from home! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience as well as the scenery of Korea's Chuncheon City.

70010000090550.name: Karaoke Animal Party: Sing & Dance
70010000090550.intro: Sing, dance and have fun with 5 adorable animals in magical settings while enjoying the loudest karaoke for kids with 25 songs full of fun and joy!
70010000090550.description:
Discover the most adorable karaoke game for the whole family

A perfect game for little kids who love to sing and have fun!

In this charming karaoke, the protagonists are 5 adorable animals that sing, dance and guide the little ones through magical scenarios. Designed to provide unforgettable moments, this game combines fun, music and learning in a family environment.

Main features:
·5 adorable characters: sing along with a funny dog, a clever fox, a mischievous mouse, a cute sheep and a cheerful chicken.

·5 magical scenarios: explore and sing in the countryside, a night forest, a kitchen, a farm and much more.

·25 musical levels: each place has 5 unique levels with a special song to discover and enjoy.

·Music gallery: 20 additional songs in a beautiful musical gallery to continue singing and having fun.

·Cute and family-friendly design: perfect for parents and children to share moments full of laughter and music.

Make music and fun part of their daily life!

70010000090552.name: Ludo Party
70010000090552.intro: Classic Ludo in a modern design, enhanced with four different themes of tokens and their drastic destruction instead of kicking them.
70010000090552.description:
Destroy enemy tokens in this modern Ludo. Play it alone, or with friends and family on one device. Roll the dice and go through the entire playing field with all the tokens. Will you come to the home area first?

The main goal of the game is to take all 4 tokens inside the home area before the other opponents. Roll the dice and move forward. Watch out, don't let your opponents kick your token back to their starting position.

Let's roll the dice!

70010000090557.name: Bubble Shooter World
70010000090557.intro: Aim for bubbles of the same color and enjoy the satisfying pops when you take multiple down in one go!
70010000090557.description:
Are you looking for a fun challenge to engage your mind? Enter a colorful bubbly game, where your strategic thinking will carry you through the levels. Use your power-ups to blast through the levels  with ease!

Aim the bubble you have loaded at the moment and shoot it at a cluster of at least three bubbles to pop them! Pop all the bubbles and complete the objectives to complete the level.

Pop all bubbles!

70010000090562.name: Santa Claus and Christmas: Happy Adventures
70010000090562.intro: On a magical Christmas Eve, Santa and his young helper, Lisnowy, embark on a journey full of adventure, challenges and wonder
70010000090562.description:
Their mission is to deliver a very special gift to a young boy who has shown incredible kindness throughout the year.

However, they encounter mysterious forces that threaten to drain the magic of Christmas at the North Pole itself. 

Joined by loyal reindeer like Rudolph and Dasher, and the wise old elf Fizzle, Santa and Lisnowy must overcome dark magic, navigate through powerful snowstorms, and bring back the joy that fuels Christmas.

As they face unexpected challenges, Lisnowy learns that Christmas isn't just about presents, but about love, hope, and connection.

With courage, determination, and the strength of the true Christmas spirit, they work together to save the magic of Christmas and bring joy to those who need it most.

70010000090564.name: The Escape Room Chronicles ep2:The Old School Building
70010000090564.intro:
Discover items and use your wits to solve puzzles in this mystery!
Episode 2: Escape from The Old School Building!
70010000090564.description:
For some mysterious reason, the protagonist finds himself in sealed rooms wherever he goes.
Seemingly simple at first, solving the puzzles delivers an unmatched sense of satisfaction.

    Episode 2
The stage is set in a quiet residential area's old, abandoned school building. Sneaking in for a ghost-hunting thrill, the protagonist suddenly finds himself locked inside!
Rumored to be haunted, a thrilling escape is about to begin from this schoolhouse in a remote corner of the world.

Featuring fully refined graphics, immersive interactive elements, and various play modes with multiple endings, this game promises a unique experience for every player. With memo and camera functions at your fingertips, it’s designed to be easy for beginners and exciting for veterans alike. Dive into the world of simple yet addictive puzzle-solving with this thrilling escape game!

70010000090569.name: Chronicles of the Wolf
70010000090569.intro: Hunt the legendary Beast of Gévaudan, conquer the darkness that lies in wait, and forge your path to glory in this epic adventure.
70010000090569.description:
The Beast is real—and it’s waiting for you.

In Chronicles of the Wolf, you’ll play as Mateo Lombardo, the last apprentice of the Rose Cross Order, on a quest to hunt the infamous Beast of Gévaudan. This dark and thrilling platforming adventure blends fast-paced combat, challenging exploration, and deep storytelling, making it a must-play for fans of the genre.

Explore vast castles, treacherous forests, and mysterious ruins, all teeming with danger and secrets. Talk to locals, collect powerful weapons, solve intricate puzzles, and unlock game-changing abilities to forge your own path through this sprawling, interconnected world. Along the way, you’ll face brutal bosses that will push your skills to the limit.

Featuring a special guest appearance from Bloodless, the iconic crimson-soaked adversary from a critically acclaimed gothic action series, voiced by Kira Buckland. Immerse yourself in the haunting narration of Robert Belgrade, the legendary voice behind some of gaming’s most celebrated dark fantasy and adventure epics. Chronicles of the Wolf delivers a gripping metroidvania experience, blending fast-paced combat, rich storytelling, and deep exploration—continuing the legacy of the Migami Monsterverse.

With its stunning illustrated cutscenes and a haunting soundtrack composed by Jeffrey Montoya, Chronicles of the Wolf delivers an immersive and cinematic experience. Enhancing the game’s rich atmosphere, Oscar Araujo, renowned for his work on one of the most iconic adventures series in the history of video games, contributes a breathtaking guest track that perfectly sets the tone for this dark and sprawling journey. Combined with deep historical inspiration and intense gameplay, this is more than just a game—it’s your next obsession.

70010000090573.name: King of Tokyo - Richard Garfield
70010000090573.intro: Become the ultimate kaiju and rule over Tokyo!
70010000090573.description:
Turn into a kaiju as you destroy everything in your path in this fast-paced dice game! Roll the dice and find the best possible combinations to rule over Tokyo, whether you choose to heal yourself, attack, buy cards or win Victory Points.

Adapt your strategy to become the King of Tokyo at the right moment and attack all your opponents at the same time.

The first player to reach 20 Victory Points wins the game... and so does the last player to stay alive!

- Build your strategy 
Roll the dice and choose wisely which ones to keep. Whether you decide to keep your dice or reroll, each decision is crucial to your winning strategy. Turn into a glass canon with powerful cards to reduce your opponents' hit points to 0, play it safe and quickly collect Victory Points, or build up health to become a tank: the choice is yours. 

- Choose your kaiju
Unleash the kaiju within you and rule over Tokyo! The mighty Gigazaur, the cute Cyber Kitty or maybe the otherworldly Alienoid, choose the invader that suits you best.

- Battle over Tokyo against AI or against your friends
Test your strategies by competing against the AI in the solo mode, and find the strategy that matches you.
Challenge up to 5 of your friends in the couch multiplayer mode to prove who the mightiest kaiju is! 

- A unique recreation
(Re)discover King of Tokyo in a dynamic recreation of the critically acclaimed board game.
Immerse yourself in the ukiyo-e inspired art style (Japanese woodblock prints and painting style).

70010000090578.name: Cute Puppy Academy
70010000090578.intro: Train, Care, and Play – Build the Ultimate Puppy Academy!
70010000090578.description:
• Care for puppies of all breeds and teach them fun tricks.
• Keep your pups happy, wash, feed, and entertain them with a variety of toys.
• Take your puppies on walks through a beautiful park full of surprises and activities.
• Expand your academy with new kennels, toys, and upgraded training spaces.

Welcome to Cute Puppy Academy, the ultimate destination for puppy lovers and aspiring trainers! Your dream of creating a haven for adorable puppies has finally come true. Take in a variety of playful pups, each with their own unique personality, and embark on an exciting journey of care, training, and companionship.

Feed them, groom them, and teach them tricks that will make their tails wag with joy. Take your puppies on delightful walks through vibrant environment where fun mini-games await, testing their agility, obedience, and your training skills.

As you progress, expand and improve your academy, adding new facilities, equipment, and decorations to make it the perfect space for your furry friends. Build your reputation as the best puppy trainer in town, attract more puppies to your care, and unlock new challenges!

70010000090592.name: Sky Diving: Parachute Flight Simulator
70010000090592.description:
Sky Diving offers the ultimate adrenaline-pumping experience, bringing the thrill of freefall and precision landing to your fingertips. Dive from towering heights, maneuver through realistic wind dynamics, and master daring stunts in breathtaking locations.

Customize your gear, compete in skydiving challenges, and unlock new heights as you perfect your skills. Whether you're chasing the perfect landing or exploring the freedom of the open skies, this simulator delivers the adventure of a lifetime.

Are you ready to take the leap? The skies are waiting!

70010000090597.name: Vault of the Void
70010000090597.intro: No luck, just skill. Focus on planning and strategy in this unique, low-RNG take on deckbuilding.
70010000090597.description:
Vault of the Void is a single-player, low-RNG roguelike deckbuilder designed to put the power into your hands. Continuously build, transform and iterate on your fixed 20 card deck as you progress through your run - or even before each battle. Preview which enemies you’ll be battling before each encounter, giving you a chance to carefully plan your strategy. With no random events, your success is in your hands - and your creativity and skill define your chances of victory!

FEATURES
* Choose from 4 different classes, each one with a completely different playstyle!
* Constantly iterate on your deck with 440+ different cards!
* Battle 90+ fearsome monsters as you make your way to The Void.
* Change up your playstyle with 320+ Artifacts.
* Infuse your cards with different Void Stones - leading to endless combinations!
* A roguelike CCG where the power’s in your hands, and without RNG.

Vault of the Void features a plethora of unique mechanics and quality-of-life changes designed to alleviate the RNG of the roguelike deckbuilder experience, and encourage creative deckbuilding!

Bad Hand? No Problem!
In Vault of the Void, fast-paced combat is the name of the game. Discard your unnecessary cards to give yourself more energy, fuelling high-powered combos!

Threat: Damage Made Simple!
As creatures attack during their turn, they’ll increase your Threat level. At the end of your next turn, your Threat stack will trigger, dealing damage to your hit points equal to its total value. Play Block cards to reduce your Threat reactively, and make the hard choice between damage, or survival.

With threat, there’s no need to calculate how much damage you’re going to take at the end of your turn - it’s right there in front of you!

70010000090602.name: Sugoro Quest: Dice Heroes
70010000090602.description:
SUGORO Quest: The Quest of Dice Heroes comes to the West for the first time! This is a board game-style turn-based RPG where dice will decide your fate!

The story begins in the kingdom of Siland, where four adventurers set out to talk to the king in search of intrepid adventures. Each adventure is different, so be sure to choose the most suitable member for each journey.

A school of magic? An adventure at sea? It's up to you(and luck, of course) to make sure the adventure has a good ending! But beware of the enemies, as they won't make your path easy.
Luck will lead you to victory!


Features:
* Available in English for the first time!
* Choose from 4 different heroes, each with their own unique abilities
* Explore 6 lands full of treasures and dangerous monsters
* Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point
* Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.)
* Gallery: view images from the original game’s manual and box design
* Cheats function: activate cheats that will make your mission a lot easier (infinite lives, invulnerability, etc.)

70010000090605.name: Christmas Tree: Holiday Decorate Simulator
70010000090605.intro: Bring the magic, light the tree!
70010000090605.description:
Step into a world of festive cheer and create the perfect holiday atmosphere! 

In this game, you'll decorate your own Christmas tree with a variety of ornaments, lights, and magical decorations.

Choose from different locations to set up your tree - whether it's by a cozy fireplace, in a snowy village, or under twinkling stars. 
Each setting brings its own unique holiday vibe, helping you immerse yourself in the spirit of Christmas. 

Spread the joy, light up your tree, and experience the magic of the season, all from the comfort of your home!

70010000090610.name: Mini Madness
70010000090610.intro: Race on walls, fly across ceilings – mini cars, maximum mayhem!
70010000090610.description:
Mini Madness is a fast-paced arcade racing game.
Take control of miniature remote-controlled cars and race on wild, vertically expanded tracks set inside a suburban home and its sprawling backyard.

The gameplay revolves around mastering your afterburner. Perform aerial flips to charge your boost meter and keep the action fast and fluid.
As you progress, you can upgrade various aspects of your car, including the afterburner capacity, recharge speed, flip rotation speed, braking power, and more.

Tracks are filled with multiple routes and creative shortcuts — you're only limited by control points that must be passed in a specific order.
Special gravity panels and engine upgrades let you drive on walls and ceilings, opening up even more insane ways to race.

Each track features interactive objects that can be activated with a transmitter.
Trigger extendable bridges as shortcuts, unleash a toy robot that blasts your rivals with projectiles, or activate fans that throw racers off balance — and much more!

Features:
- The game provides single player mode and local co-op mode.
- You can upgrade your car’s visuals, parameters and abilities.
- There are multiple game modes - time race, fast race, championship, challenge.
- While racing, players can collect temporary augments such as mines, rockets, smokescreen and many more.
- Players can interact with objects on locations and influence gameplay.

70010000090615.name: Inspector Waffles: Early Days
70010000090615.intro: A top-down point-and-click detective adventure. Follow Waffles in his first days as an inspector but beware… Your worst enemy is lurking in the shadows.
70010000090615.description:
Inspector Waffles Early Days is a top-down detective adventure with point-and-click mechanics and puzzles to solve, inspired by classic games.

Follow a young Waffles, a cunning and witty cat, in his first days as an Inspector. Your partner, Pancakes, is an experienced Inspector and probably the only one at the police station that isn’t an incompetent policecat. With this top-tier team, catching bad guys could sound easy, but beware… Your future worst enemy is hiding in the shadows, waiting for you to make the first mistake.

Inspector Waffles Early Days is the prequel of Inspector Waffles. But you don't need to play the first game to enjoy this one!

The game is divided in 5 distinct chapters and 5 cases to solve. It could be theft, arson, drug traffic… you’ll still have three main actions to do:

- Find clues

Inspect crime scenes, follow culprit pawsteps, interact with decors… There will be a lot of different ways to find clues!

- Interrogate animals of interest

Suspects, witnesses, victims… you’ll meet a full cast of anthropomorphic animals who will have maybe a lot to say to you, or maybe some secrets to hide. Interrogating them will allow you to know the truth from the lies: ask the right questions, and use the right clue to prove them wrong!

- Report to your partner

At the end of each case, after that you have interrogated all suspects/witnesses, you need to report to your partner, Pancakes. He’ll ask you a couple of questions: It's up to you to prove that you have the culprit!

70010000090624.name: Little Rocket Lab
70010000090624.description:
You play as Morgan, an aspiring engineer headed home to complete your family's dream project - a rocket ship! Finding home not quite how she left it, Morgan will need to research and build clever contraptions and sprawling factories to help the locals. From simple drills and furnaces to complex assemblers, cranes and miles of conveyor belts, you'll convert local resources into useful materials and bring industry back to sleepy St. Ambroise.

- Build clever contraptions and sprawling factories to solve puzzles and help the town
- Get to know the locals, make lifelong friendships and become the heart of the community
- Research and invent new machines, energy sources and mechanical friends
- Discover a heartwarming story as Morgan, an aspiring engineer with high hopes for town!
- Finally build your family's rocket ship!

Outside of smashing together crazy contraptions, you'll need to mine out resources, explore coasts, railyards, quarries and underground areas - each part of town has its own materials to inspire you! You'll need to complete challenges, incorporate electrical elements, water, cranes, furnaces, crafting, automate through robotics, and loads more to ensure St. Ambroise returns to its former glory. Are you ready to roll up your sleeves?

70010000090626.name: House Mansion Flipper
70010000090626.intro: Rebuild, redesign and make your dream homes!
70010000090626.description:
House Mansion Flipper is an exciting renovation and design simulator where players take on the role of a skilled renovator, transforming old, neglected houses into luxurious mansions.Dive into the challenge of revitalizing run-down properties or crafting brand-new interiors from scratch.With each successful project, improve your skills and reputation in the competitive world of real estate and design.
 
Key Features:
- Detailed Renovation: Repair, remodel, and decorate houses to transform them into dream homes.
- Budget Management: Plan your expenses to maximize profit and stay within cost limits.
- Partition Installation Design new spaces by building partitions with drywall. The process involves several stages.
- Custom Design: Add furniture, wallpaper, and accessories to create unique spaces.
- Realistic Graphics: Explore a detailed environment with high-quality graphics.
- Decorating and Furnishing In the final stage, transform the house into a work of art. Arrange furniture, decorate walls with paintings, add decorative items, and choose textiles to give the interior a personal touch.
     
Turn neglected houses into architectural masterpieces by showcasing your skills and creative vision in House Mansion Flipper!

70010000090631.name: TCG Empire: Card Shop Simulator
70010000090631.intro: Unleash your entrepreneurial spirit in a world of trading cards!
70010000090631.description:
Welcome to TCG Empire: Card Shop Simulator! Dive into the exciting world of trading cards as you create, manage, and grow your very own card shop. Start from scratch and build your very own hub for collectors and enthusiasts.

Build and Customize Your Store:
Create a unique shopping experience by designing your store layout from the ground up. Expand its size and capacity, and fill shelves with a diverse array of trading cards, accessories, and figurines. 

Manage Staff and Operations:
Take charge of your store operations by stocking shelves, working at the cash register, or hiring employees to help manage the workload. Choose the best candidates, train them for success, and assign tasks to keep your shop running smoothly.

Collect and Display:
Collect cards in a binder and showcase your rare finds with specialized display furniture. The value of rare cards can significantly boost your profits, so curate your inventory wisely!

Create Play Areas:
Set up tables for customers to play card games, increasing customer engagement and driving additional profits.

Customer Management:
Keep an eye on your customers! If they linger too long without making a purchase, you can encourage them to leave, making room for new shoppers and maintaining a steady flow of business.

Dive into TCG Empire: Card Shop Simulator and grow your very own trading card shop from the ground up! Just remember, the only thing harder than getting that rare card is getting a customer to leave once they’ve started telling you about their collection!

70010000090642.name: DAMN
70010000090642.intro: The robots are your enemies, annihilate them!
70010000090642.description: DAMN! is an electrifying twin-stick shooter that propels you into a whirlwind of action and intensity. Dive into an immersive experience with lightning-fast gameplay that will keep your adrenaline pumping and your reflexes sharp. Campaign Mode: Embark on an epic journey through 25 meticulously crafted missions, each presenting unique challenges and objectives. Whether it's rescuing hostages, destroying enemy strongholds, or surviving waves of relentless foes, every mission offers a fresh and exhilarating experience. Arsenal of Destruction: Unleash your inner warrior with a diverse arsenal of weapons. From the devastating power of the Shotgun to the scorching flames of the Flamethrower, the precision of the Redirect Laser, the overwhelming force of the Chain Gun, and the strategic deployment of the Mine Layer, you'll have everything you need to annihilate your enemies. Master each weapon's unique mechanics and find the perfect combination to dominate the battlefield. Arena Mode: Test your skills in the Arena levels, where only the best can survive. Prove your worth and show the world that you have what it takes to be the ultimate champion. Gameplay Experience: DAMN! offers an 'easy to learn, hard to master' play style that ensures maximum mindless fun. The intuitive controls make it accessible to beginners, while the challenging gameplay provides seasoned players with endless hours of excitement and replayability. Perfect your strategies, hone your reflexes, and prepare for the ultimate shooting experience. Visuals and Sound: Immerse yourself in stunning visuals and an atmospheric soundtrack that complements the fast-paced action. Every explosion, every shot, and every victory is accompanied by high-quality sound effects that enhance your gaming experience.

70010000090660.name: Ketsu Battler
70010000090660.intro: Shake your butt and fight for two!
70010000090660.description:
Ketsu Butler is a hilarious action game in which players fight by shaking their butts!

When you set the Joy-Con™ on your pants and swing it, Ketsu Batller on the screen will also swing his sword in time with your movement! Hit your opponent in the head with your sword and win the game!

Each of the six Ketsu Batller players has a different personality! Charge up your power by shaking your buttocks and overwhelm your opponent with your powerful moves!

70010000090661.name: ADVANCED V.G. Saturn Tribute
70010000090661.intro: Compete for the title of the strongest fighter and claim the legendary prime real estate! A dazzling fighting game!
70010000090661.description:
◆ The return of a 2D fighting game featuring intense battles between restaurant industry heroines!  
The heroines, dressed in stylish uniforms, unleash a variety of attacks, including strikes, throws, and projectile moves. Master spacing with dashes and backsteps, and turn the tide of battle with powerful "Super Moves", which can only be executed when low on health. Use every technique at your disposal to defeat your rivals! 
Game modes include: 
"Normal Mode", where players enter a tournament with their favorite character.
"Story Mode", featuring dramatic developments through rich anime and visual scenes.
"VS Mode", allowing for 2P battles and CPU matches.

◆ Saturn Tribute enhances the experience with powerful support features! 
The game includes:
"Rewind" function, allowing players to retry past moments after mistakes.
"Save & Load" function, making it easy to revisit favorite scenes.
Additional features:  
"command list guide" displayed on the side of the screen.
"one-button Super Move system", allowing automatic input of complex commands.
*While the in-game menu supports "Japanese and English", some in-game text and voiceovers remain "Japanese only".

◆ What is "ADVANCED V.G."?  
"V.G." is a fighting game series that began with its first PC release in 1993. The game gained popularity due to its unique concept of waitress fighters, simple yet strategic controls, and visually striking heroines.  
This version is based on the 1997 home console release, with additional new features added for a modern experience.

70010000090666.name: STEAM-HEART'S Saturn Tribute
70010000090666.intro: Save the virus-ravaged planet! A frenzy-filled shooting game!
70010000090666.description:
◆ The return of a hardcore and sexy sci-fi vertical scrolling shooter!  
Players can obtain and power up two types of main shots and six types of sub-weapons. Utilize special techniques such as the "Weapon Crash", which temporarily boosts sub-weapons, and the "Boost" ability, which lets you momentarily accelerate to dodge enemy attacks. Master these skills to suppress the oncoming enemies!  
The game features multiple modes: 
"Story Mode", which unfolds with full voice and visual scenes.
"Arcade Mode", focusing purely on shooting action.
"Score Attack Mode", where players compete for high scores within a time limit.
"Boss Rush Mode", where players battle against a series of bosses.
Additionally, the original’s sensual scenes have been thoughtfully adapted for a modern revival, respecting the heroines' privacy while maintaining the essence of the classic.

◆ Saturn Tribute brings powerful new features to fully support players!  
Enjoy modern convenience with:  
The "Rewind" function, allowing players to go back and retry scenes after mistakes.
The "Save & Load" function, letting players save and revisit their favorite moments.
Additional features include:  
"guide display" for item lists on the side of the screen.
"carry-over weapon system", allowing players to keep their weapons after clearing stages (not in the original).
An "extra durability boost" for the player character.
*While the in-game menu supports both "Japanese and English", some in-game text and voiceovers remain "Japanese only".  

◆ What is "STEAM-HEART'S"?  
Originally released as a PC game in 1994, "STEAM-HEART'S" became a hit with its combination of numerous visual scenes featuring heroines and an engaging shooting gameplay experience. 
This version is based on the 1998 home console release, bringing the classic back with modern enhancements.

70010000090681.name: EGGCONSOLE Ys II MSX2
70010000090681.intro: A grand story unfolds in the ancient kingdom of Ys. The raging development that unravels the many settings inherited from the previous title is a must-see!
70010000090681.description:
"Ys II," an action RPG released by Nihon Falcom in 1988, with its catchphrase "From kindness to excitement." Known for its well-crafted storyline, user-friendly game system, and refined sound, the game became a major hit. Even today, with new releases, the name "Ys" is familiar to many gaming enthusiasts.

In this game, Adol Christin, the red-haired adventurer who collected the six Books of Ys in the previous game, is guided to the sky world by the magic of the books. Here, he delves into the mysteries of the ancient kingdom of Ys.

Retaining the simple gameplay style of physical attacks from the previous game, Ys II introduces the additional element of magic, making battles more dynamic. The inclusion of movement magic expands the narrative scale without compromising the pace of the adventure, adding excitement to the game.

Among the magical elements, the ability to "converse with monsters" stands out. This essential magic is integral to advancing in the game, offering glimpses into the daily lives of diverse and interesting monsters.


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000090685.name: Snooker Fever
70010000090685.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70010000090685.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

70010000090692.name: Expelled!
70010000090692.intro: A Prefect has been attacked. Everyone's blaming YOU. Can you find the real culprit? Mystery adventure with a wicked twist, from the creators of Overboard!
70010000090692.description:
1922. Miss Mulligatawney's School for Promising Girls is one of the best boarding schools in England. You are Verity Amersham, here on a scholarship - and today you're going to be expelled for attempted murder. 

From the creators of Overboard! and A Highland Song comes a highly replayable detective game with an wicked twist. Can you escape expulsion through fair means - or foul? Can you find the culprit - or someone else to take the blame?

GAMEPLAY

Gossip, lie, steal, manipulate - but don't get caught!

* Navigate the school day, talk to other characters, sneak around - and try not to get expelled!
* Your actions will affect other characters, who remember everything they see and hear.
* Everyone here has secrets - students and teachers alike. Remember, knowledge is power.
* Unique morality system: the more EVIL you are, the more choices you'll have...

DYNAMIC NARRATIVE CLOCKWORK

* Next-gen visual novel: go where you want, when you want, and say what you want.
* Simulated story-world: other characters move and act independently, remembering everything they see and hear - and everything you do.
* Every minute counts: you have one school day to escape punishment. The clock is always ticking!
* Who can you trust? Some characters are friendly and some are out to get you. Who will you befriend? Who will you betray?

HIGHLY REPLAYABLE

* Every run is different, with new leads and new opportunities for mayhem. 
* Avoiding expulsion is just the start. Can you rise to the position of Head Girl? 
* Mysteries abound. Why is the cellar locked? What is your best friend's dark secret? 

One play-through lasts about 30 - 45 minutes, but achieving that perfect run will take a lot longer...

SOMEONE HAS TO TAKE THE FALL

70010000090694.name: Zombie Blocks: Pixel Shooter Gun
70010000090694.intro: Zombies, guns, and blocks—prepare for an explosive survival!
70010000090694.description:
In Zombie Blocks: Pixel Shooter Gun, you will face thrilling adventures in a blocky world where pixel art meets dynamic action and survival in a zombie apocalypse. Immerse yourself in a world filled with zombies and dangers, and prove that you can survive!
Key Features:
• Zombie Combat: Defend yourself against relentless waves of zombies using a wide arsenal of weapons and unique skills. Expect intense and dynamic battles where every zombie poses a serious threat.
• World Exploration: Explore expansive blocky locations, including ruined cities, abandoned structures, and open spaces. Each area is packed with valuable resources and hazards to overcome.
• Boss Fights: Encounter fearsome bosses, each with unique abilities that require a special approach in combat. Defeat them to earn rare items and upgrades.
• Trading: Earn resources and trade items with other players or NPCs. Trading is a vital part of survival, helping you find necessary items and enhancements.
• Quests: Complete a variety of quests and missions to earn unique rewards and uncover new aspects of the game. Each quest adds new elements and challenges to your adventure.
Zombie Blocks: Pixel Shooter Gun offers a unique blend of blocky graphics and intense gameplay in a world full of zombies and challenges. Prepare for endless adventures and prove that you can survive in this dangerous world!

70010000090699.name: Meow Delivery: Fish Frenzy
70010000090699.intro: Speed, skill and whiskers - can you master the fishy rush?
70010000090699.description:
Step into the fantastical realm of “Meow Delivery: Fish Frenzy,” where adventure awaits in every level of this cooperative platformer. You’ll control one or two characters tasked with transporting fish from point A to point B through intricate landscapes filled with obstacles and traps. Each level presents a new challenge, whether you’re navigating a traditional chocolate factory, braving the icy corridors of a snow-covered confectionery, or exploring a whimsical forest where trees are edible and mushrooms resemble chocolate fly agarics.

Explore the nuances of each environment as you uncover secret pathways and cleverly hidden challenges along the way. From dodging conveyor belts in the chocolate factory to slipping through icy slides in the frozen variant, every level in “Meow Delivery: Fish Frenzy” promises unique gameplay mechanics and surprises. Coordinate with a friend or control both characters yourself to strategize the best route and tactics to ensure the safe delivery of your fish cargo.
Master each level’s intricacies, unlock achievements, and strive for the perfect delivery as you immerse yourself in this delightful cooperative platformer adventure.

Features
	•	Dynamic Cooperative Gameplay: Control one or two characters to deliver fish from point A to B through diverse and challenging environments, each with unique obstacles and traps.
	•	Varied Environments: Explore multiple settings such as a traditional chocolate factory, a frosty snow-covered version, and a whimsical forest with edible trees and chocolate mushrooms.
	•	Unique Level Challenges: Encounter secret pathways and cleverly hidden challenges in each level, requiring strategic navigation and teamwork to overcome.
	•	Engaging Gameplay Mechanics: Navigate conveyor belts, icy slides, and other environmental hazards tailored to each setting, enhancing the game’s dynamic and immersive experience.
	•	Strategic Coordination: Coordinate movements and tactics with a friend or control both characters solo to optimize your fish delivery strategy and achieve success.
	•	Visually Charming Design: Enjoy delightful visuals that bring each environment to life, filled with vibrant colors and whimsical details that enhance the game’s immersive world.
	•	Achievements and Progression: Unlock achievements as you master each level’s intricacies and strive for flawless deliveries, progressing through the game’s challenges.

70010000090704.name: Primitive Life Simulator
70010000090704.intro: Live, craft, conquer the primitive world!
70010000090704.description:
Primitive Life Simulator – Experience the adventure of survival in the prehistoric era!
In Primitive Life Simulator, you’ll travel back in time to experience life in humanity’s earliest days. From hunting and gathering to crafting tools and building shelters, you’ll need to learn how to survive in the wild and create your own community. Face the challenges of nature, discover rare resources, and adapt to environmental changes to ensure your survival and prosperity.

Key Features:
• Everyday Life in Prehistory: 
Learn basic skills like hunting, fishing, and gathering, and develop your tribe to face the dangers around you.
• Build and Upgrade: 
Construct shelters, create tools, and develop new technologies to protect your tribe and improve your quality of life.
• Explore and Discover: 
Explore a vast environment, find rare resources, and uncover the secrets of nature.
• Adapt to the Environment: 
Face climate changes and weather conditions, planning your strategy to survive.
• Survival Challenges: 
Be prepared to deal with wild animal attacks, seasonal changes, and other threats to your tribe.

In Primitive Life Simulator, you’ll learn that survival is not just about skills but also adaptability and strategy. Create your tribe, discover resources, innovate, and prove that you can take prehistoric life to the next level.

70010000090709.name: Super Spy Raccoon
70010000090709.intro: A retro arcade throwback where you hide, sneak, climb, and leap your way to victory! YOU MUST NOT BE SEEN! Do you have the skills to top score?
70010000090709.description:
Super Spy Raccoon is an imagining of a stealth game as an early 80's Arcade Classic! Your mission, if you choose to accept it, is to acquire all classified documents as you venture deeper and deeper into enemy territory. Hide, sneak, climb, and leap your way to victory! YOU MUST NOT BE SEEN! Do you have the skills to top score?

What to expect

- 5 single-screen levels that loop until a kill screen!
- Challenging yet addictive arcade style fun
- Short wait-times to get right back into the action!
- Unlockable suit colors to match your sense of style
- Local and global leaderboards for increased bragging rights!

70010000090714.name: Puzzle of Love: Building My Heart
70010000090714.intro: Assemble enchanting love and romance-themed puzzles, featuring dreamy landscapes, heartfelt moments, and passionate embraces. Challenge your skills!
70010000090714.description:
Explore a world of romance with beautiful love-themed puzzles. From heartfelt moments and dreamy landscapes to tender embraces and romantic symbols, each puzzle invites you to piece together the magic of love, revealing vibrant colors and captivating details.

Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned puzzler, every challenge is designed to entertain and test your skills. Get ready to assemble unforgettable scenes that celebrate love in all its forms!

Don't miss the chance to enjoy this visual journey filled with passion, warmth, and emotion. Can you complete all the puzzles and uncover every romantic story? Take on the challenge and experience endless fun filled with love!

70010000090717.name: Forest Ranger Life Simulator
70010000090717.intro: Step into nature’s shoes – a ranger’s journey begins!
70010000090717.description:
Reclaim the Wild: Forest Ranger Life Simulator
Step into the boots of a dedicated forest ranger and breathe life into nature’s hidden treasures. Your mission is to restore the beauty of a forgotten forest by repairing structures, feeding wildlife, cleaning up trash, and crafting tools—all while exploring a stunning natural world filled with surprises.

Key Features:
	•	Restore & Build: Repair bridges, bird feeders, benches, and more to revitalize the forest.
	•	Wildlife Care: Feed animals, remove traps, and protect their habitat.
	•	Explore & Learn: Discover plants, mushrooms, and animals while reading about real-life nature.
	•	Craft & Create: Turn everyday materials into useful tools and items.
	•	Clean & Sort: Tackle pollution by sorting and recycling trash.
	•	Immersive Gameplay: Experience the forest by day or under a starry night sky.

Shape the future of your forest with your choices. Rebuild, nurture, and protect nature awaits its hero!

70010000090724.name: Desvelado
70010000090724.intro: Turn off the lights, dodge the ghosts and go to sleep as soon as you can in this hand-crafted 2d platformer!
70010000090724.description:
Desvelado is the first Bed-Time-Vania game in history! Help our hero Vampy fight insomnia one last time by turning off every light in the castle before going to sleep in his cozy coffin.

• Immortal gameplay: Classic 2D platformer mechanics.
• Sharp controller: Slide, jump and dash to move swiftly.
• Challenging puzzles and multiple enemies to overcome
• Bloody animations: Enjoy a unique visual style, with hand-crafted animations.
• Vampiric music to get in the mood.
• 100+ Rooms to solve.
• 3 Main zones: The Castle, the Dungeon, and the Catacombs.
• 3 Final levels: What you learned in each area will be put to the test.
• Bonus Levels: Some rooms are optional, but if you'll get a reward if you manage to complete them all!

70010000090726.name: Sugoi Girls: Tribal Crush
70010000090726.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000090726.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000090728.name: Sugoi Girls: Sexy Steampunk
70010000090728.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000090728.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000090730.name: Locomoto
70010000090730.description:
Locomoto is a cosy, life-sim adventure train game where you are the conductor! Customise, manage and expand your train as well as tend to your colourful, furry passengers. Board your train and embark on a journey through beautiful landscapes, all while enjoying the  soft, lofi beats of an extensive original soundtrack.

Train Life
Ensure your passengers have the best journey possible.
Invite passengers to board your train and help them reach their destinations!
Serve your passengers to make sure they’re having a comfortable journey.
Tend to your train and prepare it for the next journey.

Customise Your Experience
Customise your train by decorating your wagons with furniture in different styles! Craft the furniture you need using resources scoured around the world. Using different resources to influence the colours of your crafted item. Expand your train by adding more wagons, allowing more passengers to ride along! Customise your look! Choose between a great variety of animal-like features and colours, then play around with an assorted collection of clothes, that you collect throughout your journey, to express yourself further!

Explore the World
Explore, interact and engage with unique characters. Help them with their requests to gain rewards of clothes, resources and crafting-blueprints. As you befriend them, learn more about their personalities and struggles within the world.

70010000090732.name: Blow it up
70010000090732.description:
Blow it up is a physics destruction game with light-puzzle elements where you shoot bombs to destroy your enemies who are hiding behind tower-like structures. 
Master seven unique bombs in a realistic physics simulation and explore over 70 levels of mayhem and destruction.

STORYLINE
An alien invasion is in full swing—mysterious, powerful creatures have descended upon BOOMTOPIA, stripping it of its natural resources and claiming dominance with their explosive superpowers. As your friends are captured one by one, you’ve had enough. Fueled by determination, you gear up to fight back. The adventure begins, but with chaos all around, can you truly survive the mayhem and rescue all your friends?

FEATURES
- 7 unique bombs to destroy your enemies.
- Advanced physics simulation where every block behaves naturally.
- Explore a world of adventure and rescue your friends!
- Over 70 levels of mayhem and destruction.
- TNT, confetti and fireworks for more spectacular explosions.

Blow it up is the ultimate explosive experience!!

70010000090739.name: Clicker Heroes
70010000090739.intro: Ever wondered what one quadrillion damage per second feels like? Wonder no more! Embark on your quest to attain it today!
70010000090739.description:
Start out by clicking on the monster to kill them, and get their gold. Spend that gold on hiring new heroes and get more damage. The more damage you deal, the more gold you will get. Feel the power as you grow exponentially and become the greatest ever! 

THE HEROES

Hire 35 unique heroes to help you do damage without having to click! Meet legendary figures from myth and legend, such as Athena, Amenhotep, King Midas, and more! They will all lend their sword to your cause, for a cost. 

These guys' damage per second makes your MMO characters look like kindergarteners. Spend your hard-earned loot on upgrading them to gain special powers to aid you in getting even more gold! 

THE MONSTER

Click your way to defeat powerful monsters. Fight over 100 different monsters, all beautifully drawn and animated.

Watch out for the bosses!

IDLE GOLD

Need to do the laundry? Give the puppy a shower? No worries! Your heroes will farm monsters and automatically collect the gold while you're gone, even when the game is closed. But don't forget to come back and spend all that sweet gold on new heroes and upgrades!

70010000090746.name: Ocean Driving: Boat Parking Simulator
70010000090746.intro: Realistic watercraft boat parking simulator - test your ship mooring skills in dangerous conditions!
70010000090746.description:
In the game, you will have to manage various ships, trying to moor them in the designated places, avoiding many obstacles and not damaging your magnificent vessel in a limited time.

REALISTIC PHYSICS
Feel what it is like to manage a yacht! The game offers realistic controls and physics, thanks to which every maneuver requires attention and precision.

DIVERSE LEVELS
With each new level, the difficulty increases! At first, you will encounter simple berths, but as you progress, moving barges, platforms and other obstacles will appear on your way, making parking a real challenge.

MARINE ATMOSPHERE
Enjoy picturesque coastlines, coastal areas and the serene atmosphere of the sea. Visual effects and sound accompaniment immerse you in the world of yachting adventures.

DIFFERENT TYPES OF BOATS
Discover different types of yachts and boats, each with its own characteristics and control features. Make your choice depending on the level and the tasks you have to complete.

Are you ready to become a master of yacht parking? Show everyone that you are a true captain of the ship!

70010000090752.name: Rainbow Islands CS
70010000090752.intro: Experience 6 different versions of the magical world of Rainbow Islands! That comical place full of dreams is back!
70010000090752.description:
Rainbow Island CS is a collection of several home ports of the arcade game Rainbow Islands.

In addition to the popular 8 and 16-bit versions, the collection includes the never-released-on-cartridge MegaDrive/Genesis version. With 24 quick-save/load slots for each version and a feature that displays the location of the diamonds, there's never been a better time to experience it. It also includes a feature that lets you start the game in a powered-up state.

The PC Engine version is based on the NES™ version and features a main theme arranged for FM sound by Yukiharu Urita, as well as an ending theme composed by Norihiro Furukawa, both Zuntata (Taito's sound team) alumni.

What is Rainbow Islands?
Rainbow Islands is an arcade action game released by Taito in 1987 where the player controls Bubby or Bobby, using their rainbow magic as both weapons and platforms to climb and reach the goal at the highest point of each stage.

[Story] 
At the end of the previous game, Bubble Bobble, the bubble dragons Bub and Bob had rescued their parents and girlfriends and returned to their human forms of Bubby and Bobby.
Several years after those events, Bubby and Bobby return to their ancestral home, Rainbow Islands, in search of treasure, but end up entangled in another devious plot!
It seems that their true nemesis, the Boss of Shadow, has since resumed his evil machinations. Bubby and Bobby's path is blocked by various enemies, but with the “rainbow magic” given to them by their parents, they bravely continue their adventurous journey.

*The story described here is based on the Mega Drive and PC Engine versions. The content differs slightly in the Family Computer, Nintendo Entertainment System™, and SEGA Master System versions.

Contents
・Rainbow Islands (Family Computer version) 
・Rainbow Islands (Nintendo Entertainment System version) 
・Rainbow Islands (Sega Master System version) 
・Rainbow Islands Extra (JP Mega Drive version) Rainbow Island Extra (US/EU Mega Drive/Genesis version) 
・Rainbow Islands (PC Engine CD-ROM² version)

*The background music for the Family Computer, Mega Drive, and PC Engine CD-ROM² versions uses the main theme based on the NES version.


Family Computer, Nintendo Entertainment System and NES are trademarks of Nintendo.
Mega Drive, Genesis and SEGA Master System are either registered trademarks or trademarks of SEGA Holdings Co., Ltd. or its affiliates.
PC Engine and PC Engine logo are trademarks of Konami Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd. and BIGLOBE Inc.

70010000090763.name: Super Jagger Bomb 2: Go East
70010000090763.intro: Disarm bombs as fast as you can to save the world in platforming superhero style!
70010000090763.description:
Get ready for explosive arcade-style platforming action as the caped bomb-collecting superhero returns in Super Jagger Bomb 2: Go East! This time, bombs have been placed at landmarks and monuments across the globe, spanning from Europe and India to China and Mongolia, and it’s up to Super Jagger to save these international treasures from certain destruction.

Run, jump, fly and dash your way across dozens of unique stages in 2.5D style as you dodge enemies and collect bombs as fast as you can. Complete levels without dying to gain extra lives and use bonus rounds to multiply your score. Collect coins, practice, earn flight licenses and even unlock new playable heroes!

Features:

• Master bite-sized platforming stages in arcade-style action!
• Avoid enemies and traps as you gather and disarm bombs as quickly as possible.
• Get extra lives by maxing out your speed and survival skills!
• Use bonus rounds to multiply your score and aim for the top.
• Save national treasures, landmarks and monuments to become the ultimate hero!
• Earn flight licenses and unlock new playable characters!

70010000090779.name: O.W.L Projekt 2
70010000090779.intro: Guide a young being’s daring adventure as you puzzle your way through diorama-style landscapes!
70010000090779.description:
Get ready for another enigmatic and challenging adventure with O.W.L Projekt 2, a 3D isometric puzzle game that will test your mind and logic skills. Once again controlling Elysion, a young being created in a mysterious experiment, you will face the enigmatic Watchers in a journey to escape and uncover secrets.

Armed with the powerful Sanctum Staff, Elysion can move objects and overcome obstacles, offering a unique and immersive gaming experience. Challenge yourself through 50 meticulously designed levels as you manipulate blocks, drag platforms, discover secret passages and climb ladders in rotating dioramas, with new mechanics introduced as difficulty gradually ramps up!

• Help guide a young experimental being as he is pursued by the mysterious Watchers!
• Overcome 50 environmental puzzles of increasing complexity and difficulty.
• Clear a path for Elysion using the power of his Sanctum Staff!
• Manipulate platforms, climb and more to traverse rotatable isometric dioramas.
• Enjoy a minimalistic narrative through organic storytelling!

70010000090784.name: Destination Paradise Collector's Edition
70010000090784.intro: Embark on a global adventure to uncover magic destinations.
70010000090784.description:
"Destination Paradise" invites players on an immersive hidden object adventure across 20 meticulously crafted chapters, each unfolding in beautiful locations around the world. 
As you progress through the game, you'll encounter three distinct scenes within each chapter, presenting a delightful array of challenges.

Engage your mind with a variety of puzzles, including traditional jigsaw, tile-swapping, and tile-rotation challenges. 
The game offers a dynamic mix of gameplay styles, including finding objects in a list, unscrambling letters to reveal hidden words, and a bonus riddle mode that adds an extra layer of intrigue.

For those seeking an extra layer of mystery, the bonus riddle mode adds an intriguing dimension to the adventure. 
With its seamless blend of exploration, puzzle-solving, and breathtaking visuals, "Destination Paradise" promises an unforgettable gaming experience for both casual players and avid puzzle enthusiasts.

- 20 immersive chapters with three unique scenes each.
- Diverse puzzle types, including jigsaw, swap, rotate tiles, find objects in a list, missing vowels, scrambled letters, and bonus riddle mode.
- Stunningly detailed locations from around the world.
- Engaging and challenging gameplay suitable for both casual and experienced players.
- Bonus riddle mode for an extra layer of mystery and excitement.

70010000090788.name: Old Coin Pusher Friends 3
70010000090788.intro: This is the 3rd in a series of online co-op coin pusher games, "Old Coin Pusher Friends," set in the Edo period. In this installment, with a Sugoroku (board game).
70010000090788.description:
Work together with other players to defeat yokai, punish corrupt officials, and aim for the jackpot. As you progress in the game, you can enhance your abilities with various upgrades.


- Sugoroku
Advance by collecting dice that appear on the board. Various events are triggered depending on the squares you land on.


- Prize Collection
Collect various Edo-period-themed prizes. The more prizes you collect, the more rewards you receive at reach the goal of the Sugoroku.


- Ability Enhancements & Avatars
There are various upgrade features such as Gatling guns, auxiliary launchers, appearance changes for pieces and launchers, attack power upgrades, and increased firing speed.


- Multiplayer
There are two types of multiplayer modes: random matchmaking and friend matchmaking. Whether you want to experience one-time encounters with random players or play with your friends, the game can be played in various styles. You can play with up to four people at once.


- Co-op Events
There are cooperative mini-games such as defeating yokai, punishing corrupt officials and evil magistrates, and dealing with volcanic eruptions. The strength of the yokai increases according to the players' strength, and the stronger the yokai, the more prizes they drop.

70010000090791.name: Real Hentai 4
70010000090791.intro: Charming girls in Real Hentai 2 are waiting for your touch.
70010000090791.description:
Immerse yourself in a world of high-quality images, where charming girls are waiting for you, demonstrating their seductive forms in the most intriguing poses! The game is created with an emphasis on visual details, conveying the feeling of assembling a real puzzle. As the difficulty increases, the images become more and more piquant. Relax and enjoy every moment of assembling the puzzle.

Features:
• Beautiful girls in provocative outfits
• The ability to examine each image in detail after assembly
• Simple but exciting mechanics that are hard to tear yourself away from
• Gradually increasing puzzle difficulty
• Gentle, relaxing music for complete immersion

70010000090795.name: Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy
70010000090795.intro: 3X THE CONTENT OF ANY PREVIOUS BIG BUCK HUNTER CONSOLE OFFERING!
70010000090795.description:
Get ready to lock, load, and dominate the wild like never before with Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy! This groundbreaking experience takes the #1 arcade hunting game to thrilling new heights, delivering over 3X the content of its hit predecessor.

Embark on 27 epic treks with 135 intense hunting sites, chasing animals ranging from Whitetail Deer and Caribou to Woolly Mammoths and Saber-Toothed Tigers. With 27 adrenaline-pumping bonus games, expanded weapon choices like the Crossbow, all-new multiplayer modes, and a reimagined trophy room, Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy sets a new standard for arcade hunting adventures. Whether you're a seasoned sharpshooter or a fresh newcomer, the hunt is on—are you ready?

Key Game Features:

EXPANDED HUNTING ADVENTURES & BONUS GAMES
• Dive into 9 animal adventures spanning stunning environments around the world.
• Explore 27 unique treks that will take you to 135 diverse hunting sites.
• Face off in 27 exciting bonus games, like Pappy’s Moonshine Factory!

ICONIC TROPHY ANIMALS & CRITTERS
• Hunt an array of trophy animals, including Grizzly Bears, Mountain Lions, Black Panthers, Cheetahs, and more.
• Score extra points by targeting over 48 small-game critters like Rabbits, Coyotes, and even Crocodiles!

ENHANCED GAMEPLAY
• Choose from expanded weapon options, including the classic Shotgun and the all-new Crossbow for added challenge.
• Experience dynamic and competitive hunting in multiplayer modes, featuring both turn-based and simultaneous play.

REIMAGINED TROPHY ROOM
Showcase your hunting achievements in a completely reimagined trophy room with customizable displays and evolving frames.

STUNNING ENVIRONMENTS & GRAPHICS
• Immerse yourself in beautifully rendered locations across the globe and fluid, on-rail camera mechanics.

70010000090797.name: Santa's Christmas Gift Quest
70010000090797.intro: Embark on a magical quest to collect Christmas gifts!
70010000090797.description:
Step into the festive world of Santa's Christmas Gift Quest, a 2D platformer bursting with holiday cheer and magical adventures! Journey through stunning, snow-covered landscapes, sparkling villages, and mysterious winter forests as you collect lost Christmas gifts. 
Watch out for mischievous NPCs determined to stop you at every turn! Dodge obstacles, outsmart enemies, and soak in the holiday spirit with every step. With its magical locations and heartwarming festive vibe, this adventure is your chance to save Christmas and spread joy to the world!

70010000090802.name: Deep, In the Forest
70010000090802.intro: Strategic card-based roguelike RPG, where you are tasked with liberating the forest kingdom from the tyranny of the Mad King.
70010000090802.description:
Welcome to a world of strategic card-based RPG, where you are tasked with liberating the forest kingdom from the tyranny of the Mad King.
Your story begins with the main character, once close to the royal family, who becomes a victim of false accusations. When the King’s daughter, the princess, mysteriously disappears, he descends into panic and starts suspecting a conspiracy among his subjects. As a result, numerous innocent people face harsh persecution and imprisonment.
You are the one accused of the princess’s disappearance. To prove your innocence and restore order to the kingdom, you must journey to the castle for an audience with the King and his advisor. But first, you must navigate the perilous forest, populated by various beings—Barons and other forest dwellers—who seek to capture you for royal favor and reward. Some of them have been misled or coerced into the hunt.
Throughout your journey, you will encounter unique forest inhabitants, explore four diverse regions, and collect powerful items and cards that will empower your hero. Your ultimate path will lead you to the royal castle, where you'll strive to reach the throne room.
Will you restore justice and bring peace back to the kingdom? What choice will you make? The outcome of this story lies solely in your hands.

70010000090807.name: Cattle Country
70010000090807.intro: Howdy partner! Welcome to Cattle Country, the Cozy Cowboy Adventure Life Sim.
70010000090807.description:
Become a determined pioneer traveling west to start a new life. Make a home in the mountains, take on bandits, discover dastardly plots, build a farm, develop your town, and make friends with fellow residents.

ABOUT THE GAME: 

Cattle Country straddles the saddle of cozy wholesome gaming and action-adventure. Serving up hours of the slice-of-life you’d expect on the frontier – including mining, fishing, crafting, and farming – along with deep-rooted Wild West Quests delivering stories of romance, cattle drives, bandits, and robberies.

GAME FEATURES:

Ranchin' and Handcraftin’
Making your home on the range is a modern departure. From sunup to sundown, you'll be rollin' up your sleeves and gettin' your hands dirty working the land and raising your cattle. Building and crafting as you go to make your own little slice of heaven under the blues skies of Cattle Country.

Swappin' stories and settlin' in with your neighbours 
Get to know the townsfolk, hear their stories, help them out. The people here are a hardy bunch- you’ve got be to survive here. But they have hearts as warm as a hearth in the wintertime if you make the effort to stoke the flames. 

Beware of Bandits
Not everyone in Cattle Country is the warm and fuzzy type, so watch out for nefarious plots and shady characters. Protect your homestead and your community.

Rodeos to Romance
Making friends is a must in the Wilderness, relying on each other through the thick and the thin. But maybe you've got a yearnin' for more? With 18 romanceable characters, take a chance and grab love by the reigns.

Buried Treasure 
Did yer hear? There's treasure in the mines, for those who are brave enough to look for it. From precious metals and minerals to bandit stashes. Grab your pickaxe and venture out into the thrill of prospecting.

Trackin' game in the wild
From bunnies to bovine, there's many a critter waiting in the woodlands for a keen adventurer. Hunting to eat or venturing out just to see all of nature’s wonders, it’s your call.

This is just a taste of the adventures on offer, so throw down roots and work the land. Become part of a story that’s as old as these hills and a part of this small community of settlers. Welcome to Cattle Country!

70010000090820.name: Cooking Companions
70010000090820.intro: Unravel the mystery in this psychological horror visual novel, set deep in the woods.
