70010000090820.description:
Deep in the woods of the Tatras Mountains, supplies dwindle and flood waters are rising. It’s up to you to keep spirits high and make the most of your survival skills. Will you butter up the right person? Or will you wind up on the chopping block?

Featuring Eastern European folklore in an unexpected package, Cooking Companions is a “dating sim” psychological horror title you won't soon forget.

Unlock 60 achievements

55+ pieces of artwork

4 vegan recipes

11 endings

WARNING:
This game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Viewer discretion is advised.

70010000090825.name: Anime Girls: Natty New Year
70010000090825.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000090825.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000090827.name: Anime Girls: Awesome Adventurer
70010000090827.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000090827.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000090829.name: Natsume's Book of Friends: Hazuki no Shirushi
70010000090829.intro:
Write this summer into your heart.
The long-awaited game adaptation of Natsume’s Book of Friends is here!
70010000090829.description:
■ Spend an unforgettable summer as Takashi Natsume
The first term is over and summer vacation has finally begun.
Natsume weaves heartwarming stories through his encounters with various people.
Unravel their stories when you complete their requests.
There are five possible endings.
Enjoy an original story unique to the game—an experience you won’t find anywhere else.

■ Strengthen Bonds Through “Gifts”
Collect a variety of items by fulfilling requests or shopping in town.
Gift these to your friends and strengthen your bonds.
You might surprise them, make them smile, or receive an unexpected response—
New requests appear as your bonds strengthen!

■ Packed with Classic Summer Events
Festivals, test of courage, fireworks displays...
Enjoy a lineup of nostalgic summer events.
Each moment is sure to become a lasting memory.

■ The Beautifully Recreated World of Natsume’s Book of Friends
Warm and gently nostalgic.
Immerse yourself in the vibrant world and live out your days as “Natsume.”

■ A Journey Through Fond Memories
Those precious encounters, those heartfelt emotions...
Some requests will bring back memorable scenes from Seasons 1 through 7 of the anime.
Relive Natsume’s journey and reflect on the path he has walked.

This product supports only Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese. Thank you for your understanding.

70010000090845.name: Throw Anything: Zombie Invaders
70010000090845.intro:
Hurl everything you can get your hands on!
A hilariously thrilling action defense
to smash the zombie hordes!
70010000090845.description:
The mad scientist, Science X, is on the brink of world domination.

Using the 'Nexus Cube'—an ancient relic capable of transcending time and space—he planned to unleash a lethal zombie virus upon the entire globe. However, his colleagues staged a desperate intervention, shattering the Cube into five fragments and scattering them across the world. Infuriated, Science X has unleashed a massive legion of zombies to reclaim the pieces, leaving cities in ruins.

Governments have fallen, and the world is paralyzed... 
But hope remains.

To the public, they are just an ordinary international shipping company.
But in reality, they are a clandestine intelligence agency: the SDA (Special Delivery Agency). 
To end this nightmare, the SDA dispatches their top secret agent.

Your mission: Locate the scattered fragments of the Nexus Cube,
thwart Science X’s twisted plans, and deliver the world from destruction!


● Easy to Play, Hard to Master
An intuitive action defense game that anyone can jump into! But don't be fooled—survival against the encroaching zombie hordes requires sharp tactics and quick thinking.

● If You Can Grab It, Throw It!
Unleash chaos on endless waves of zombies! From everyday objects to wacky, unexpected weapons—grab anything within reach and experience the pure joy of taking down zombies one toss at a time.

● Epic Chapter Finales
A formidable boss awaits at the end of every chapter. Brace yourself for high-tension, cinematic battles where every move counts. Victory has never felt this satisfying!

● Hilariously Fast-Paced Action
Casual fun meets heart-pounding intensity! If you’re looking for a perfect blend of high-speed action and quirky humor, you’ve found your next obsession.

"Throw Anything: Zombie Invades" invites you
to a world of nonstop laughter and total mayhem!

70010000090851.name: Bimfli & His Time Travels: Egypt
70010000090851.intro: Graphic novel about the adventures of a young traveling architect. Discover Bimfli and his friends in this beautiful story full of values and lessons.
70010000090851.description:
In this chapter, Bimfli will travel to Egypt, where he will face various puzzles and must confront multiple traps and challenges to unravel the hidden power of the sundial and its connection to different emblematic places and temples.

·An easy game designed for children.

·Entertaining children's story that is easy to read.

·Learn to read with fun stories in English.

·Cheerful ambient music and sounds based on the culture of each country.

·Learn about monuments, cities, civilizations, geography and architecture.

·Educational content on art history with the recreation of the best painters and architects of each era.

·Learn about the main capitals of the world, as they were in ancient times.

·Adjust accessibility settings such as font height, sound volume and image transition speed.

·Promote diversity and discover multicultural traditions by exploring the world with Bimfli.

70010000090858.name: Kawaii Girls
70010000090858.intro: A charming world of classic jigsaw puzzles, where cuteness and coziness meet exciting gameplay.
70010000090858.description:
Welcome to Kawaii Girls – a charming world of classic jigsaw puzzles, where cuteness and coziness meet exciting gameplay! 30 delightful images of charming anime girls are waiting for you, which will give you unforgettable emotions.

Each picture is made in a stylish and bright manner, radiating kawaii in every detail – from cute facial expressions to charming outfits. While collecting puzzles, you will enjoy a calm atmosphere and get real pleasure from the process, step by step revealing each scene.

Game features:

• 30 unique illustrations with cute anime girls.
• Classic jigsaw puzzle gameplay – simple and exciting.
• Cute details and kawaii aesthetics at each level.
• Different difficulty levels, suitable for both beginners and experts.
• Cute music.

Collect cute pictures, enjoy the process and dive into the world of kawaii with Kawaii Girls!

70010000090862.name: Monoquous 2
70010000090862.intro: All laws of physics are a suggestion.
70010000090862.description:
Monoquous 2 is a challenging puzzle platformer in which you can phase through walls to invert the world around you, taking the direction of gravity with it - up becomes down, black becomes white, and deadly obstacles lose and gain their threat along the way.

Switch on and off new walls and paths, scale long conveyors, and don't touch anything pointy... at least not in your own realm.

Monoquous 2 features 130 levels. Each level also contains a hidden cat, a minimum phase and jump goal, a set of time trials, and beyond that are speedrun and permadeath modes. Finishing the game is fairly accessible, 100%ing it will test you.

Unlock tints to pretend colour exists in this universe, and read an 80-line poem that unlocks as you find more and more cats.

Also features some accessibility options in which you can turn on or off things like graphical swaying and inversion.

70010000090864.name: I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream
70010000090864.description:
FIVE DAMNED SOULS
Buried deep within the center of the earth, trapped in the bowels of an insane computer for the past hundred and nine years. Gorrister the suicidal loner, Benny the mutilated brute, Ellen the hysterical phobic, Nimdok the secretive sadist, Ted the cynical paranoid.

ONE CHALLENGE
The adventure plunges you into the tortured and hidden past of the five humans. Delve into their darkest fears. Outwit the Master Computer AM in a game of psychological warfare. Disturbing, compelling. An adventure you won't easily forget!

 • Assume the roles of five different characters, each in a unique environment
 • Challenging dilemmas dealing with powerfully charged emotional issues
 • Provocative psychological and adult-oriented themes
 • Based on Harlan Ellison's short story ""I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream"", one of the ten most reprinted stories in the English language
 • Full digitized speech with over 40 different characters and state of the art animation
 • Harlan Ellison as the voice of the insane master computer, AM.

70010000090866.name: Bimfli & His Time Travels: Japan
70010000090866.intro: Bimfli and his travels in time is an interactive graphic novel about the adventures of Bimfli, a young architect.
70010000090866.description:
In this chapter, Bimfli will travel to different times in Japan. He will meet several allies throughout his adventure: a priestess concerned about the town, a samurai protector of a great castle, an enigmatic geisha, etc. All of these companions will teach Bimfli an important lesson about the balance between development and nature.

·Easy gameplay designed for kids.

·Entertaining children's story that is easy to read. 

·Learn to read with fun stories in English. 

·Upbeat ambient music and sounds based on the culture of each country. 

·Learn about monuments, cities, civilizations, geography and architecture. 

·Educational content on art history with the recreation of the best painters and architects of each era. 

·Learn about the world's major capitals, as they were in ancient times. 

·Adjust accessibility settings such as font height, sound volume, and image transition speed. 

·Promote diversity and discover multicultural traditions, exploring the world with Bimfli.

70010000090868.name: The Kingdom of Christmas: Santa's Elves
70010000090868.intro: In the magical world of Christmas, Smiley, a cheerful and brave elf, works in the North Pole toy factory.
70010000090868.description:
Everything changes when, on a day of great expectation, he discovers that Santa Claus has disappeared without a trace.

Together with his faithful friend Terry, a slightly nervous but big-hearted elf, Smiley embarks on an epic adventure through the Kingdom of Christmas.

Facing mysterious and challenging tests, and with the guidance of magical lights and enchanted characters such as ice guardians and wise gnomes, Smiley and Terry learn about the true strength of Christmas: friendship, courage and hope.

70010000090870.name: GUN BRO
70010000090870.intro: GunBro is an action-packed side-scrolling run ‘n’ gun game
70010000090870.description:
Lock and load, because GUN BRO is here to deliver explosive action with a nostalgic twist! Step into the boots of a fearless action hero and blast your way through many adrenaline-soaked levels, all presented in a retro Retro-inspired palette that oozes old-school charm.

Shoot, dodge, and demolish your enemies as you hunt for the key to complete each level. The minimalist, pixel-perfect visuals combined with relentless run-and-gun gameplay create a thrilling mix of retro vibes and modern mayhem.

Are you ready to prove you’re the ultimate GUN BRO? Grab your guns, fire up your nostalgia, and conquer the chaos!

Key Features:

 - Classic 8-bit visuals with a limited color palette that pays homage to gaming’s golden era.
 - Explosive Action: Fast-paced shooting, big explosions, and dynamic combat.
 - Many Retro-Challenging Levels: Each stage offers new challenges and tougher enemies.
-  Pure Nostalgia: A perfect blend of retro visuals and modern arcade action.

70010000090874.name: Plot of the Druid
70010000090874.intro: A mystical comedy adventure with sarcastic British wit, a cartoon-style world, and an innovative shape-shifting ability for solving puzzles.
70010000090874.description:
** IMPORTANT NOTES BEFORE PURCHASE ** 

This game is being released in a chapter-by-chapter format.
When you purchase the game, you’ll gain access to two playable parts of the story: the Prologue and Chapter 1. Additional chapters will be released as paid DLC as they become available.
Chapter 2 is currently planned for release by the end of 2025, with the remaining chapters scheduled for 2026. Please note that these dates are tentative and subject to change.

** We recommend purchasing this game only if you are comfortable with this chapter-based release approach. **

Plot of the Druid is a classic-modern point-and-click game that’s reminiscent of Simon the Sorcerer, Discworld, and Harry Potter.

The game follows the story of a disgraced druid apprentice who embarks on a quest to restore balance and prevent the world from descending into madness. Along the way, he must strengthen his powers and acquire special abilities to navigate the amusing yet challenging world he encounters.

70010000090879.name: Heretic + Hexen
70010000090879.intro: Step into the definitive re-release of two dark spell-casting shooters that shaped the genre.
70010000090879.description:
Forged by Raven Software on a modified DOOM engine, Heretic and Hexen were released in 1994 and 1995, pushing first person shooters into bold new territory.

Owners Receive
• Heretic: Shadow of the Serpent Riders
• Hexen: Beyond Heretic
• Hexen: Deathkings of the Dark Citadel
• Two all-new episodes created in collaboration between individuals at id Software + Nightdive Studios:

There are a total of 117 campaign maps and 120 deathmatch maps in Heretic + Hexen.

New Enhancements
• Online cross-platform and local split-screen deathmatch and co-op modes*
• Toggleable enhanced soundtrack from Andrew Hulshult
• In-game mod support**/***
• An array of accessibility options, quality-of-life improvements, and engine fixes

ABOUT THE INCLUDED GAMES
Heretic: Shadow of the Serpent Riders
Three brothers, known as the Serpent Riders, used their powerful magic to possess and corrupt the seven kings of the realm, plunging it into war and chaos. But a race of elves known as the Sidhe resisted and were branded heretics. On the brink of losing the war, the Sidhe elders sacrificed themselves and the elven capital city to destroy the seven kings and their armies. As one of the few surviving elves, you embark on a quest for vengeance against those who slaughtered your friends, family, and entire race.

Heretic: Faith Renewed [NEW]
Years after the planes were cleansed of D'Sparil's wretched influence, a wandering warrior in search of home arrives at a foreign land to discover the blighted stains of that old time religion seeping through the cracks of society once more. In the fortified city, zealous acolytes stand high atop a decadent cathedral and listen to the lamentations echoing from the streets as non-believers are dragged away for 'correction.' The shadow of D'Sparil lingers after death, his absence attributed to apotheosis. Once revered, now worshipped, deserving of neither. An all-too-familiar scene, and one you simply cannot stomach. Taking up the mantle of Heretic once more, you stride into the city, staff in hand, to silence the echoes of your arch-nemesis.

Hexen: Beyond Heretic
While the Sidhe elf Corvus battled the evil forces of D'Sparil, the remaining two Serpent Riders were busy sowing the seeds of destruction in other dimensions. As a Warrior, Mage, or Cleric, you must fight the undead and brave elemental dungeons and decaying wilderness to defend your realm of Cronos from Korax, the second Serpent Rider.

Hexen: Deathkings of the Dark Citadel
After defeating the evil Korax, the second Serpent Rider, and discovering the Chaos Sphere, you have been transported to the Realm of the Dead. Now your only way home is blocked by hordes of undead and the Dark Citadel. Where Hexen ends, the true nightmare begins.

Hexen: Vestiges of Grandeur [NEW]
Korax lingers between life and death, his shredded corpse left behind with no semblance of life while he clings to a fresh, if fragile, rebirth. His grip on Cronos is once more released, yet the cycle continues, proving another force is at work: an invisible hand puppeteering both Korax and you, weaving a star-crossed destiny that will never die. And if that hand tugs the threads of fate again, what surprises are yet in store for you?

70010000090882.name: Spell Disk
70010000090882.intro: Build unique synergy spell combos to destroy the hordes of monsters and bosses in this rogue-lite action game.
70010000090882.description:
Spell Disk is a rogue-lite action game with a unique synergy building mechanic so that your runs can never be the same. Strategize and create your own spell combo synergies to blast through enemies on your way! Each run is unique, so you must plan out how to build your power.

Discover combos and synergies that no one’s seen before! Maximize your power to better your chance of escaping the dungeon of Spell Disk.

Craft spells, disks, and artifacts during your run that synergies with each other in their own ways.

Unlock new weapons and powers to hack and slash through the enemies blocking your way.

70010000090887.name: GINSEI IGO: AI Teaches You How to Play Go
70010000090887.intro: Push the Limits of Strength with a Dedicated Game Console AI!
70010000090887.description:
This Go game software features a "game console-exclusive AI" optimized purely for strength and analytical power, focusing on match functionality.

● 14 Levels of Difficulty from Beginner to 4 Dan
The computer's strength is divided into 14 levels.
You can play against opponents tailored to your skill level, ranging from "Beginner" for newcomers to "4th Dan" for those seeking the ultimate challenge.

●"Analysis"  Feature that shows how the AI would play.
The AI analyzes your game and displays suggested moves to show how it would play in your position.
Select your thinking level from "1 Dan" to "4 Dan" and display [win rate display] and [good move/bad move display].
From the graph for each move, you can find out which moves led to wins and losses, and where improvements are needed.
Winning rate display: Displays the winning rate analyzed by AI in a graph for each move.
Good/bad move display: AI analyzes the moves you made and displays good/bad moves.

● "Reading Lines" Feature to View the Basis of Suggested You can view the reasoning behind the AI's suggested moves through its Reading Lines.
Select thinking levels from 1 Dan to 4 Dan and preview sequences 3, 5, 7, 9, or 11 moves ahead.
This helps clarify why the AI made certain decisions.

● Additional Features
Joseki Display: Shows common opening patterns.
Hint Function: Provides suggestions during the game.
2-Player Matches: Play against another person.
Real-Time Territory Estimation: Displays territory as the game progresses.
Game Record Save and Load: Save your game records or resume a game from a saved state.
Game Record Input: Manually input moves for review or analysis.

70010000090891.name: Beef Cat Ultra
70010000090891.intro: The epic adventure of Beef Cat and his friends begins.
70010000090891.description: In the vibrant world of Beeflandia, our hero Beef Cat and his friends always know how to celebrate the good times. But when a mysterious Big Guy shows up and stirs up trouble, everything changes. The peaceful vibes are over and it’s time for a new kind of adventure!

70010000090901.name: Musical Vibes RX
70010000090901.intro: Get ready to move with Musical Vibes RX, a new dance game you can play using Joy-Con™ controllers or your smartphone camera connected to your Nintendo Switch™ console!
70010000090901.description:
Musical Vibes RX is the new version of Musical Vibes—the first-ever dance game to let players use the camera of their smartphone connected to a console. Originally released in June 2023, the original broke new ground—and now RX takes the experience even further!

Dance Hands-Free with Incredible Moves!
Groove to fantastic music and master exciting new dance moves with full-body tracking powered by advanced AI technology. No controllers required when using your smartphone camera—just let your body move to the beat!

Track Your Progress 
Stay motivated with the built-in calorie counter that provides an estimated calorie burn during your game session.

Included Songs
The base game includes 5 tracks across a variety of styles:
"Platinum Dreams" by NARAE SOLIS — K-Pop
"Champion Sound (Remix)" by SIZZLA feat. TURBULENCE — Dancehall
"Noche de Brillo" by LINA RIKO — Reggaeton
"Embrace Your Light" by NINA RAY — Pop
"Party" by FIVEEBEATZ — Amapiano

You can expand your playlist with 3 additional songs available as downloadable content, with even more tracks planned for future updates.

Multiplayer Fun
• Up to 4 players can join the fun with Joy-Con™ controllers.
• Up to 2 players can dance together using smartphone camera tracking.

Customize Your Experience
Personalize your avatar with fun outfits and choose from a variety of vibrant venues to match your style and mood!

Enhance Your Dance Floor
Own a Philips Hue smart lighting system? Connect it to transform your space into a dazzling concert venue with lights that react to the music!

More Than Dance
Feeling less energetic? Switch to Rhythm Game Mode, where you can press the correct direction on your controller in time with the beat—perfect for playing on the go!

Exciting Updates to Come!
Stay tuned for more tracks and features coming soon.

70010000090908.name: JustAxe
70010000090908.description:
Pioneers against aliens! JustAxe is an exciting 2D platformer with puzzles, interactive environments and unusual setting! Solve riddles, combine your moves, and set out to save your hometown and possibly all of humanity... And don’t forget to take your axe with you!

About the game:

The game takes place in the distant future on planet Earth. The small town of New Soviets, hidden in the forest behind mountains, picturesque panel houses and power transmission towers, lives quietly and peacefully, trying to recreate the nearly mythical pages of communist history of the past.

But one day, the tranquillity of the citizens is disturbed by a mysterious invasion of creatures from another world. The hostile creatures have kidnapped the main heroine’s sister. Some time later, she receives a mysterious letter, the author of which seems to know how to resolve the situation... Grab your great-grandfather’s trophy axe and go on an adventure! 

Game features:

Puzzles and interaction with the environment: there’s no telling what difficulties await you behind the next tree, but the pioneer is always prepared! Use the clues and possibilities of the environment to solve riddles and overcome obstacles that stand in your way.
Varied gameplay and mechanics: find new ways to use the weapons available to you, skillfully combine your moves, create unique tactics, and gain access to unexplored areas.
Various locations: from forests, mountains and waterfalls to a dark alien dimension. Navigate through winding paths and mazes, dodge traps, or flee from pursuit and stumble upon artefacts recreated by the residents of New Soviets.
Loyal companion: discover new abilities and stashes in the most unexpected places with the help of a new friend. Don’t forget to return to previous levels, who knows where the treasure might be buried!

Funny dialogues and unexpected ending: you will travel in a colourful but dangerous world. Unlock all the secrets of this amazing universe, pass the trials and find out if a little girl with an axe can save an entire town and find the reason behind the emergence of dangerous monsters?

70010000090913.name: Internet Caffe Manager 2025
70010000090913.intro: From a dusty café to a digital empire—build the ultimate gaming hotspot!
70010000090913.description:
In Internet Caffe Manager 2025, you're not just running a café—you’re building the ultimate tech empire. Start with a tiny, outdated shop and turn it into the go-to spot for hardcore gamers, streamers, and late-night internet addicts. Set up high-performance PCs, install the latest games, and keep your customers happy with fast Wi-Fi, comfy chairs, and snacks that keep them coming back for more.

But running an internet café isn’t just about customer service—it’s about strategy. Invest in top-tier equipment, expand your shop, and make smart financial decisions to stay ahead of the competition. Want to take a few risks? Get into crypto trading, engage in underground deals, or even hire hackers to boost your café’s reputation—just be ready to handle the consequences if things go south.

Every choice you make shapes your business. Will you build a legitimate gaming paradise, or take the shady route to fast cash? The digital world is yours to control—just don’t let it crash!

70010000090921.name: Blue Wednesday
70010000090921.intro: Blue Wednesday is a relaxing and lovely adventure game focused on story, music, and characters. Explore the city, meet various characters, and have conversations.
70010000090921.description:
An interactive game where the player can move through the city and chat with various NPCs, play the piano, and interact with lots of other items through the main character, Morris. The main parts of the game are mini games and adventures, and learning more about Morris's story through vivid cutscenes that pop up at key moments in the game. There are more than 20 mini games that help the player get immersed in the game and help them follow the main character's narrative. The game also offers collectible items and NPCs' stories that enrich the gaming experience. 

Adventures and Stories
The player becomes jazz pianist Morris, of Evans City. The player navigates the city full of NPCs and objects while interacting with them. With various mini games, cutscenes, and conversations with different characters, live through jazz pianist Morris's experiences.

Mini games
Mini games help engross players by popping according to the main character's various actions.

A cast of characters, each with their own special story
With more than 10 supporting NPCs, we can hear more than 10 different stories. The story changes depending on the choices the player makes during the conversation between the main character and the NPC and will allow players to collect items.

Activities & Explore
Collect your collection by visiting various places in the city and talking to various characters.

Collect sheet music
Choose wisely! They player's choices will shape the narrative and determine the albums they can collect. Tango and bossa nova, cool jazz to modern jazz. You can play them during the rhythm games during game play.

Rare music albums
Players can collect rare music albums through various interactions throughout Evans City such as helping another player solve a problem or looking through piles of old LPs in the back of a music shop. Collect these albums from diverse musical genres and play them on the turntable in Morris's room. Listen to and enjoy the rare albums hidden around the city.


An experience filled with stories and music
See the world through the eyes of jazz pianist, Morris. takes you through a dream-like adventure through jazz and love, and failure.

70010000090926.name: Hentai Girls: Adorable Angel
70010000090926.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000090926.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000090928.name: Hentai Girls: Pissy Pirate
70010000090928.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000090928.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000090930.name: ROUNDS
70010000090930.intro: Rounds is a 1v1 rogue-lite shooter where each round gets more intense.
70010000090930.description:
Wave your noodle arms around to assert dominance! 

Experience hype-filled dueling! Shoot, block, and jump your way to victory with your shotgun-rocket-launcher-that-shoots-heat-seeking-bouncy-missiles or one of the other over 11.2 million different powerup combinations.

- 65+ Unique powerups
- 70+ Maps
- AAA Face Customizer
- Online Multiplayer
- Local Multiplayer
- 100% organic Noodle Arms

70010000090933.name: The Exit Project: Backstreets
70010000090933.intro: Don't get stuck in this loop for the rest of your life.
70010000090933.description:
Do you realize that you are in a very strange place? Everything around you seems normal and ordinary, but look closely. What do you see? 

Step by step, you're back in the same place you started. Try it again. Look carefully around you. Back again? Then you missed something. Retrace your steps and find something strange in this picture of the world. Every detail and every inconsistency is important to break out of this senseless and frightening cycle. 

It's not easy, but it's important not to give up and to keep searching. The answers are always in front of you. Stop. Relax. Someone else besides you has been in this strange place and come out. So can you. 

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Find your way out of this strange place.

70010000090938.name: Spray Paint Simulator
70010000090938.intro: Bring color to the world in Spray Paint Simulator!
70010000090938.description:
COLOR YOUR WORLD
Bring color to the world in Spray Paint Simulator! Restore worn-out surfaces with a fresh coat of paint and watch them come back to life. Use your spray tool with precision, cover every inch, and enjoy the satisfaction of a flawless finish. Step into Spatterville, where you'll build your own spray-painting business. Meet the locals as you restore, repair, mask, and spray paint everything—from kitchens and local landmarks to a giant robot. Buy new tools and equipment, unlock Free Spray mode, and transform the town.

PREP AND MASK-TERPIECE
You've got to earn your stripes before becoming the town's top spray painter. No worries, though! There's plenty to keep you busy! Mask surfaces to protect them from overspray, remove and repair objects, and fill damaged areas to create the perfect canvas.

SATISFACTION IN EVERY SPRAY
Grab your spray tools and watch worn-out objects spring back to life with fresh, snazzy colors! Feel the thrill of transformation, groove to the soothing rhythm of spraying, and enjoy the sheer joy of rejuvenating each item. It's all about making things look brand new and having a blast while doing it! Let's spray, play, and make the old new again!

BUSINESS MADE EASY
Running a spray-painting business has never been more fun! Keep an eye on your consumables like paint, masking paper, and tape, because nobody likes a half-finished job. Upgrade to cooler spray tools with more paint capacity, greater coverage, and bigger batteries. Need a boost? Choose from a variety of step ladders and scaffolding to reach those pesky high spots. Managing your supplies and equipment adds just the right amount of strategy, keeping things fun and light-hearted without getting too complicated.

UNLEASH YOUR CREATIVITY
After completing jobs for customers, dive into Free Spray mode! Return to your finished projects and let your imagination run wild. Spray the job and the surrounding environment any way you please. With a rainbow of colors at your disposal, the entire town becomes your canvas. Express yourself freely and enjoy hours of creative fun. Make Spatterville your masterpiece, one spray at a time!

70010000090943.name: Party Arcade: Enhanced Edition
70010000090943.intro: THE ULTIMATE PARTY GAME EXPERIENCE FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY!
70010000090943.description:
Party Arcade Enhance Edition is a family friendly party game set in a lively modern virtual arcade. Earn tickets, win tokens, and upgrade your equipment and game options as you battle against family and friends at home, or online around the world!

•	15 ADDICTIVE GAMES IN A MODERN ARCADE
Two great new games have been added to the arcade to bring the total number of games to fifteen.  Use your mallet to bop every critter that shows his smug little head above ground in Mash-a-Mole.  Slingshot Mania tests your skills to quickly and accurately smash targets in this carnival game classic.

•	BEEF UP YOUR ARCADE IN THE ENHANCED EDITION
Full Dynamic Lighting, higher resolution game assets, and improved menu art, and special effects have been added to give the entire game better visuals.

•	REAL GAMES – REALLY FUN CHALLENGES
Go for the record!  Practice your skills in Single Player modes and challenge your own high scores and the leaderboard to unlock additional gameplay modes and equipment.

•	GAMES INCLUDED:
Air Hockey
Billiards
Bocce Ball
Cup Pong
Hoop Shot
Ping Pong
Slots
Stop Light
Disk-O
Corn Hole
Darts
Skill Ball
Puck Bowling
Mash-a-Mole
Slingshot Mania

70010000090945.name: Arcade Archives SUPER XEVIOUS
70010000090945.intro: Experience the further evolution of XEVIOUS!!
70010000090945.description:
"SUPER XEVIOUS" is a shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1984.

Players pilot the SOLVALOU and face off with the XEVIOUS forces.
Defeat airborne enemies with the zapper, and terrestrial enemies with the blaster.
This work has various changes from the previous work, including additional characters and different placement of hidden items.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*This game uses the Japanese ROM for the main part of the game.
The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000090950.name: Arcade Archives GANGBUSTERS
70010000090950.intro: Gentlemen, this is a big deal!!
70010000090950.description:
"GANGBUSTERS" is an action shooter released by KONAMI in 1988.
Control SMITH & WESSON as they capture THE DAGRUS MOB, the gang that robbed THE GRANT BANK.
Use a limited number of bullets to catch THE RED GANG and replenish and power up your ammunition as you aim for the final stage.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000090955.name: Another World Series -Slit Mouth Woman VS AOONI-
70010000090955.intro: Legendary modern-day ghost “Slit Mouth Woman” vs. legendary horror game “AOONI”!
70010000090955.description:
The first in the “Another World Series”, in which the protagonist solves a mystery while moving between different worlds.

Akashi Asanagi, a university student, wakes up on the 10th floor of an abandoned hospital.
While exploring the hospital, he encounters a blue monster called “Aooni”, and when he touches the mask that Aooni dropped, the hospital transforms into an alley, where he encounters a mysterious woman wielding a kitchen knife called “Slit Mouth Woman”.
Akashi is attacked by the two beings, but for some reason a battle breaks out between the Slit Mouth Woman and Aooni...?

School, cemetery, house...
Explore the various different worlds on each floor and use items and gimmicks to solve the mystery of the abandoned hospital.

Multi-endings are unlocked depending on the results of your play, and each floor also has fully voiced event scenes.

Why are the Slit Mouth Moman and Aooni fighting? Who will win? Who is Akashi himself?
Conquer all 10 stages and escape from the abandoned hospital.

■Main Characters
・Akashi Asanagi
A cheerful and slightly airheaded first year university student.
He finds himself in an abandoned hospital.
He has good reflexes.

・Ray Yuyami
Despite being in the fifth grade, she has a level of thinking and knowledge that puts adults to shame.
She received a letter from her older sister, who ran away from home three years ago, and came to the abandoned hospital.
She is quiet, but loves the occult.

・Mumu Nissyoku
An enigmatic girl who is always smiling and aloof.

■Controls
A button: Examine
X button: Use selected item
Y button: Crouch
L button, R button: Select item
ZL button, ZR buttons: Look back
+ button: Open pause screen

70010000090958.name: Jumping Ninja
70010000090958.description:
Find your warpath and go all the way. Remember that true strength is not in your body, but in your mind. Every step brings you closer to your goal.

Make lightning decisions - there's no time to wait and doubt. The sharpness of your mind is also a weapon, and you must know how to use it. 

Move through levels without stopping and take out your enemies without regret. Face challenges without fear!     

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Move like a ghost and hit from the shadows!

70010000090963.name: Swarm Madness
70010000090963.intro: Protect your stronghold in these dark times!
70010000090963.description:
Your fortress is under constant attack, and you must save everyone who counts on you. Keep the walls strong and keep the mutants from getting inside.

Roll out all the powerful weapons you have and start harvesting the evil souls. No time to think. The waves of zombies can come crashing down all around you. Shoot, reload and repeat. Repeat as many times as necessary to keep everyone safe. 

Clear and protect each level you enter. It's not as easy as you think. The zombies are getting smarter and always looking for new tricks.   

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Become a true hero for your people!

70010000090968.name: Vaulting Champions
70010000090968.intro: Try your hand at fantastic pole vaulting. It's not easy at all!
70010000090968.description:
Try this incredible mix of track and field and running. Pole vaulting through the course is something very unusual and unrealistically fun! 

It is very important to choose the right direction and the right moment for the next jump. The higher the obstacle you choose, the harder the game, but also the higher the reward. 

You can defeat your opponents using different tactics. Which ones? You'll have to find out as you play. 

Complete all the levels and collect all the prizes. You can even unlock fun skins for your athletes. Have fun with this new sport!      

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Watch out for your new favorite sport!

70010000090973.name: Save The Doge
70010000090973.intro: Save the cute puppy from the evil bees!
70010000090973.description:
Solving the puzzles and saving the little puppies is the best way to spend your time.  

Draw the lines accurately, so the angry bees can't even touch our beloved dog. Each level is a new challenge for your brain and skills. Find the best solutions in every puzzle. The bees are so annoying. Keep them away as much as possible!   

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Show your love to the all the animals in the world!

70010000090978.name: Platform 4
70010000090978.intro:
The long-awaited sequel to "Nibansen Plus" and "Sanbansen Plus" is finally here!
Board the rear car when strange events occur!
70010000090978.description:
This train includes mild horror elements. Please offer your seat to all passengers, including the elderly, those with a low tolerance for fear, pregnant individuals, and those with infants or small children.

Approaching Platform 4 shortly. For horror, escape, puzzle, and mystery elements, please transfer here. Access to the airport requires escaping from the station marked "One stop to the airport."

Mind the gap between the world and the platform. Please watch your step.

[Game Description]
Escape from the endlessly looping Platform 4!

Pay attention to strange events as you play.

If you spot something unusual, board the rear car immediately and turn back.

If you find nothing strange, continue forward in the lead car.

Your goal is to escape from the loop of seven repeating stations.

[Playtime]
15 to 60 minutes

[Difficulty]
Nibansen | 2nd Platform ★★★★☆
Sanbansen | 3rd Platform ★★★★★
Platform 4 | 4th Platform ★★★☆☆

70010000090983.name: Vessels of Decay
70010000090983.intro: An overgrown world where monsters of myth and ancient folklore now reign.
70010000090983.description:
Civilization has ended, and something else awakens in its place. From the world’s decay, ancient creatures stir, rise, and roam the land.

Vessels of Decay is a post-apocalyptic action-adventure following the story of Freja and Mud. In this retro-inspired tale, you’ll confront creatures of Scandinavian myth and folklore, and explore the ruins of the civilization they inhabit.

- Dynamic Battle System: How you execute combat – and how your enemies perish – is entirely up to you!

- Unique Finishers: Every new enemy is a new opportunity for you to show your flair for combat; stagger your foes to set them up for (literally) killer animations and flourishes.

- Epic Multi-Stage Boss Encounters: The beasts of Scandinavian folklore will not let themselves be put down so easily, and you’ll have to use your wits and reflexes to pursue and slay them!

- Explore A Beautiful World of Pixels, Death, and Decay: Vessels of Decay is a completely handcrafted world, with care and thought poured into each and every scene, story beat, and environment.

- A Scandinavian Take on Classic Action-Adventure: The battered ruins of a once-modern society clash with the renewed growth of nature – and of the supernatural. Explore a uniquely Scandinavian setting through a mix of reflective melancholy, exploration, and fast-paced action.

70010000090988.name: Santa's Adventure: Christmas Gifts Rush
70010000090988.description:
Welcome to a festive 3D platformer brimming with thrilling challenges and holiday cheer! 

As Santa’s trusted helper, embark on a quest through snowy landscapes, enchanted forests, and holiday villages to recover lost gifts before time runs out. 
Jump across tricky platforms, solve clever puzzles, and overcome magical obstacles to save Christmas. 
Each gift you collect brings joy back to the world — but watch out! Surprises and challenges await at every turn. 

Are you ready to brave the holiday rush and ensure every child wakes up to a magical Christmas morning?

70010000090993.name: The Liar's Tavern
70010000090993.intro: Outwit, deceive, survive—where every lie could be your last.
70010000090993.description:
The Liar’s Tavern draws you into a shadowy pub where deception and danger collide. This immersive 3D psychological thriller pits you against three other players in a high-stakes game of dice or cards—but with deadly consequences. Bluff, accuse, and strategize carefully, as every lie or misstep could lead to a fatal drink or a game of Russian roulette.

Survival is your only goal. Each round is a nerve-wracking duel of wit and paranoia, where reading your opponents and mastering the art of deception are key. Choose one of four unique characters, each with hidden motives, and navigate the eerie atmosphere of the tavern, where every decision shapes the unfolding drama.

With unpredictable outcomes, intense mind games, and a richly dynamic setting, The Liar’s Tavern challenges you to outwit and outlast. Will you emerge as the ultimate deceiver, or will your lies catch up with you?

70010000091000.name: Shalnor: Silverwind Saga
70010000091000.intro: An epic RPG/Action Adventure game. With focus on gauntlet-style combat, traps, boss fights and beautiful pixel-art scenery.
70010000091000.description:
Rynna has arrived on one of Shalnor's most dangerous islands. Once a haven for tourism, now the island is abandoned due to the presence of the Slime Queen. To prove her worth, our young Elven hero has to overcome the challenges of the island by finding powerful weapons and items to use against the hordes of monsters in challenging gauntlet-style combat encounters.

FEATURES:
- Large variety of monsters as well as "Elite" Monsters.
- Unique dungeons with engaging boss fights.
- An arsenal of weapons and items that add variation to combat.
- Quick and swift movement that makes fighting hordes of monsters fun.
- Multiple vibrant zones each beautifully hand-crafted.
- Trick monsters by walking them into traps.
- Find Rubies and Emeralds to increase your Health and Stamina.

70010000091005.name: Baseball
70010000091005.description:
Step up to the plate in Baseball, a simple yet thrilling game where you control all the action on the field. Choose between easy, medium, or hard difficulty to match your skill level and start swinging! As the hitter, perfect your timing to send the ball flying. 

Then, switch roles to the pitcher, where you’ll need precision and skill to fill the power meter and deliver the ultimate throw. If the opposing team connects, react quickly to pass the ball between bases and tag out their runners. Accessible and fun for all, Baseball brings endless excitement to every match!

70010000091010.name: Mayhem Mail
70010000091010.intro: Take each letter to its mailbox
70010000091010.description:
The mail has been scattered! Take on the mail route from hell, recover and deliver mail to its rightful place! Mayhem Mail is a classic single screen arcade platformer with some added puzzle elements.

Deliver the mail through its 60 colorful 2D levels full with dangers and enemies.

Everything in a day’s worth of work!


Features
* Precision platforming gameplay with some puzzles mixed in
* Deliver mail through 6 themed worlds with different mechanics
* Classic 8-bit graphics and chiptune soundtrack for an authentic retro experience
* Assist Mode for added accessibility

70010000091013.name: Colorizing: Animals
70010000091013.intro: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation
70010000091013.description:
This coloring book is a guarantee of good mood.
In it you can find all kinds of pictures for every taste.
Coloring by numbers with Colorizing is a calming and easy activity for people of all ages. 
This drawing game is suitable for children and adults, everyone can enjoy pixel coloring.
You will definitely love coloring with this beautiful coloring book!

70010000091026.name: PAW Patrol™ Rescue Wheels™: Championship
70010000091026.intro: Race with the Rescue Wheels crew! Choose your Pup, unleash epic stunts, and drift to victory solo or with friends. Speed to victory!
70010000091026.description:
Va-room! 

The Rescue Wheels crew is revved up and ready to race! Join Chase, Skye, Marshall, Rubble, Zuma, Rocky, and Roxi, in epic races across Adventure Bay and beyond. You can even cause mischief with Boomer & Frank or Mayor Humdinger.

Pick your Pup Racer, each with unique skills like launching tennis balls or spinning out rivals. Master drifting, turbo boosts, and epic signature stunts to rule the dirt roads. Play solo or challenge friends in multiplayer—every racer can be a champion!

Grab your best Pup Pals and let’s Rox and roll!

RACE WITH NEW FACES: Play with the Rescue Wheels crew, including Roxi, Boomer and Mayor Humdinger. 

MONSTER TRUCK MAYHEM: Bulldozer, Hovercraft, Jet. Which one will you choose to help you win the championship?

STUNT TO THE FINISH LINE: Perform tricks mid-air to get a boost and unlock your Pup’s signature stunt. 

PUP POWER-UPS: Get ahead of the competition by collecting Pup Treats and objects.

DRIFT INTO THE ACTION TOGETHER: Speed through arenas across Adventure Bay, the Jungle, Foggy Bottom, and beyond in multiplayer

70010000091033.name: Jumble Quest
70010000091033.intro: Tap, scramble letters, and solve the clues! How many hidden words can you find?!
70010000091033.description:
Are you an English language genius and a terminology expert? If you’re looking for the perfect word game to play - you’ve found it! 

Jumble Quest is a simple and addictive word game where you tap for clues and hints and arrange the given letters to compose a word. You’ll learn how to spell tons of new words and impress all of your friends with your expanding vocabulary! If you’re looking for a new spelling game to challenge yourself with - you’ve found it!

HOW TO PLAY
On each level you will have 6-8 letters to arrange into new words. Tap on the empty word spaces for clues to each word. Connect letters to build words. Tap the question mark for a hint and reveal a letter. If you’re stuck, there are extra hints available. There will many different words for you to compose on each level! Challenge your vocabulary and see how many words you can learn and create with a set of letters!

Guess a hidden word for extra points! Can you solve every word from the hints provided? Spell the correct word with the letters provided a series of pics that combine to create a word or phrase!

Jumble Quest Top Features:
• Play with your friends in PvP mode!
• Spell hidden words for extra points!
• More than 15000 levels.
• Learn new words and build your vocabulary!
• Connect letters to memorize words and become a spelling bee champion!
------------------
How many words can you learn in this challenging word game? This learning game is perfect for all ages. Download Jumble Quest today and start connecting the letters to grow your vocabulary! Jumble Quest will help you excel in your upcoming spelling bee and mind games!

These challenging and fun word connect puzzles will enlighten your day for girls and boys and people of all ages. Play single player or with friends, super fun! Test your vocabulary and see how many words can compose with each new set of letters! The more Jumble Quest that you play, the more words that you will learn and the faster you can build your language skills. Word games are a great way to make learning fun.

• Challenging Learning Guess the Word Game.
• Amazing word guessing Mystery Challenge.
• Vocabulary Brain Exercises with Clues.
• Great Language Hint and Guess Vocabulary game.

70010000091035.name: Chained Through Hell
70010000091035.intro: Escape the underworld, but don’t break the chain—or each other.
70010000091035.description:
Bound by fate and forged in fire, Chained Through Hell takes you on a relentless journey from the depths of the underworld to the path of redemption. Whether braving the inferno solo or teaming up with friends, you’ll be physically and mentally tethered—literally—by a chain that can be both your greatest tool and deadliest obstacle.

Master the art of movement as you swing, climb, and strategize your way through nightmarish landscapes. Each hellish realm presents unique challenges, requiring teamwork, quick thinking, and perfect timing to overcome deadly traps and relentless enemies. The further you climb, the more punishing the trials become, pushing you to adapt, communicate, and make split-second decisions.

With stunning visuals, immersive audio, and evolving mechanics, Chained Through Hell isn’t just about escaping—it's about surviving together. Will you break free, or will the underworld claim you forever?

70010000091050.name: EGGCONSOLE CARMINE 88 PC-8801mkIISR
70010000091050.intro: Pilot the Armored Fighting Walker, Galleouse and destroy the bio-dolls occupying the secret research facility. A hardcore sci-fi adventure!
70010000091050.description:
This game, released in 1986 in Japan, is an adventure game where players take on the role of Lieutenant Brian=W=Kernighan. Piloting the Armored Fighting Walker, Galleouse, the player must defeat three bio-dolls lurking within the research facility.

The game progresses with a 3D RPG-like feel. In addition to moving forward, backward, left, right, and rotating left or right, the player can also perform a 180-degree turn, making for realistic, mech-like movements. When encountering enemies, battles are command-based, but with movement incorporated into the command selection, allowing for highly immersive combat. Utilizing movement-based tactics will be key to overcoming challenges in the game. 

Since this isn’t an RPG, relying on character growth or brute force to push through isn’t possible, which might be seen as challenging, potentially sparking mixed reactions. However, for users seeking a satisfying sci-fi game, this title is recommended. Additionally, interactions with over 20 unique characters and the distinct world setting are also highlights!


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000091066.name: SUMMER GIRLFRIEND なつ♡カノ
70010000091066.intro: Can the overly insensitive Yuichi find a girlfriend this summer!?
70010000091066.description:
◆Story
"Yuichi, go find yourself a wife."
With a single sentence from his grandfather, Yuuichi Yagami starts to think about romance for the first time in his life.
However, for someone like Yuuichi—who's only ever focused on his family and friends—the idea of romance is completely foreign and feels like an impossible challenge.

…Or so Yuuichi thinks!
Despite having a childhood friend who cooks him breakfast every morning and even makes his lunch,
Yuuichi’s cluelessness to her feelings leaves his younger sister and friends shaking their heads in exasperation.

As summer break begins, new challenges and adventures loom on the horizon:
Moving to a new house, trips to the pool and beach, and of course, romance.
Can Yuuichi, who always puts his family first, overcome his insensitivity and find a girlfriend by the end of summer!?


・Marina Tachibana (橘 愛理奈)
A gentle, devoted childhood friend who always puts others before herself.
She’s been helping Yuuichi manage the household chores and daily life for years.

・Hiyo Yagami (八神 姫夜)
A sweet, pure little sister who absolutely adores her big brother.
She’s extremely low-energy in the mornings and relies on Yuuichi to help her get ready for the day.

・Yuuichi Yagami (八神 悠一)
A responsible and family-oriented eldest son who takes care of his younger sister and mother.
Despite his cluelessness about love, he’s been steadily improving his cooking skills thanks to Marina’s guidance.

70010000091072.name: The Backrooms 1998
70010000091072.intro: Roam freely, mark, explore and try to unravel the story - however you are not alone. Don't scream.
70010000091072.description:
The Backrooms 1998 is a first-person found footage psychological horror survival game where it tells the story of a young teen after accidentally falling into the depths of The Backrooms in 1998. 

Roam freely, mark, explore and try to unravel the story - however you are not alone. 
Don't scream.

TRIGGER WARNING: 
This game may be disturbing to some audiences as this game contains real disturbing footage, sounds, fear nature, jump scares, gore, extreme violence, murders and intense horror that may not be for the faint of heart. Play this game at your own risk.

CAN YOU ESCAPE THE BACKROOMS?

Features:
▪ DELVE INTO THE BACKROOMS -  try to find your way in an unwelcoming maze of the backrooms
▪ STAMINA SYSTEM - don’t lose your breath and keep an eye on your stamina levels. Avoid getting too tired, unless you want the creature to get to you. 
▪ LEAVE A TRACE - use your spray gun to mark your path, helping you navigate the backrooms and keep track of the rooms you’ve already explored.
▪ STOCK UP ON GOODS - use the tools scattered around to help you escape this nightmare.
▪ LIMITED CHANCES - save yourself by saving your progress in the special ‘safe rooms’. This is your only chance to not be trapped here for eternity.

70010000091077.name: Arcade Archives PUNK SHOT
70010000091077.intro: Around here, basketball is a martial art!
70010000091077.description:
"PUNK SHOT " is a sports game released by KONAMI in 1990.
Your goal is to defeat the rival team and win in a basketball game where all sorts of interference and attacks are allowed.
There are various gimmicks set up during the game, so you need to be careful not to get too distracted by your opponent and lose the ball to them.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000091082.name: Master Of Bow
70010000091082.intro: Lock, draw, and conquer. Claim your title as the ultimate Master of Bow!
70010000091082.description:
MASTER OF BOW!
Step into the world of archery where precision and skill are your greatest allies. In Master of Bow, take on the role of a master archer and challenge yourself to hit a variety of targets—from straw big targets and wooden smaller moving targets to flying balloons and mannequins.

25 UNIQUE LEVELS!
Traverse through 25 exciting levels, each set in breathtaking environments like enchanted forests, frozen lakes, and autumnal woods. Each stage brings new challenges and types of targets that will test your aim and timing.

LIMITED ARROWS, UNLIMITED FUN!
With a set number of arrows in each level, every shot counts. Can you hit every target and pass the level before running out of arrows? Strategy and precision are key to success.

DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES TO BE THE MASTER OF BOW?
Prove your archery skills and conquer all 25 levels. The journey won’t be easy, but only the best will rise to become the ultimate Master of Bow! Will you be one of them?

70010000091087.name: Dragon Eclipse
70010000091087.intro: Dragon Eclipse is a roguelite deck-builder with a unique auto-battler twist. Choose your Tamer, team up with powerful Mystlings, and battle fierce foes.
70010000091087.description:
WELCOME TO DRAGON ECLIPSE!
In Dragon Eclipse, you collect magical Mystlings—unique creatures that enhance your deck and join you in battle. Build your team of three Mystlings with distinct stats, abilities, and special cards. Remember that your beasts grow and evolve as you play, so understanding their nature is the key to victory!
A NEW TWIST ON THE DECK-BUILDING ROGUELITE GENRE
Combine auto-battler mechanics with deck-building strategy for endless creative possibilities. Unlock new Mystlings, cards, and tougher difficulty levels with every run. Experiment with setups, craft complex combos, and elevate your playstyle to unlock tons of fun!
CHOOSE A TAMER
Each Tamer has a distinct playstyle and unique specialization. Which one of them you choose will define the shape of the whole run.
CHOOSE YOUR MYSTLINGS
Every Mystling has unique stats, abilities, and a starting card for your deck. Strategically balance your team, make them your loyal companions, and together, fight against the encroaching evil.
TRAIN AND EVOLVE YOUR MYSTLINGS
Mystlings level up and evolve during combat, gaining powerful new abilities. You’ll have to discover and harness their potential. Sweet and unassuming at first, they can transform into fearsome allies under your guidance.
CREATE YOUR DECK
Throughout your journey, you'll construct a powerful deck full of great combos. Acquire new cards from various sources, engage in battles, and encounter intriguing characters to ensure your deck is tailored to your combat preferences.
TIME IS OF THE ESSENCE
The approaching Eclipse limits your time to gather resources and cards. Not the whole map can be explored. Make decisions to secure victory before it's too late.
Are you ready to become the ultimate Tamer? Start your journey today!

70010000091089.name: Escape From Mystwood Mansion
70010000091089.intro: Experience a first-person escape room adventure in the mysterious Mystwood mansion. Solve puzzles, crack codes, and uncover hidden secrets to escape!
70010000091089.description:
EXPLORE THE MANSION
You find yourself trapped inside the mysterious Mystwood Mansion. The door behind you is locked and the only way forward is to delve deeper into the mansion. As you explore the mansion's many rooms you discover that someone has orchestrated a series of puzzles and challenges to keep you from escaping.

SOLVE PUZZLES AND DECIPHER CODES
Each room of the mansion is filled with puzzles to solve and codes to decipher. As you take on the mansion's many challenges someone seems to be watching your every move...

INTERACT WITH THE ENVIRONMENT
Poke around to find clues to help you solve the puzzles. Interact and study 3D objects to find important details.

ESCAPE!
Will you escape the mansion's grasp or are you up to the challenge to access the final room?

FEATURES
• Five puzzle-filled rooms with hidden sub-areas
• Dynamic hint system
• Beautiful and immersive environments to explore
• Many objects and secrets to find
• Multiple endings

70010000091091.name: VoidCraft Island Chronicles: Sky Survival
70010000091091.intro: Build, explore and survive on floating islands!
70010000091091.description:
In “VoidCraft Island Chronicles: Sky Survival,” you find yourself as a nomadic explorer cast into the mysterious Void, a world with its own secrets and surprises. This enigmatic realm invites you to uncover its hidden mysteries and navigate its unique landscapes, each filled with challenges and unexpected encounters.

Construct and enhance your sailing vessel to better equip yourself for the journey ahead. Starting with a simple raft, you’ll develop it into a formidable vessel complete with a ship’s hold, mast, and captain’s cabin. Customize your vessel with various objects, from storages and workbenches to decorations, making it truly your own.
As you traverse the surreal terrains of the Void, you’ll confront numerous foes and navigate through ever-changing environments.

Features:
• Uncover Hidden Mysteries: Explore the enigmatic Void, a world filled with secrets and surprises, offering unique landscapes and unexpected encounters..
• Build and Customize Your Vessel: Start with a simple raft and transform it into a formidable sailing vessel, complete with ship’s hold, mast, and captain’s cabin. Personalize your ship with storages, workbenches, and decorations.
• Challenging Exploration: Navigate through surreal and ever-changing terrains, each filled with distinct challenges and adversaries to overcome.
• Engage in Combat: Confront numerous foes as you journey through the Void, testing your survival skills and strategic thinking.
• Dynamic Environment: Immerse yourself in a richly detailed world that evolves and changes, ensuring each journey is unique.
• Strategic Upgrades: Enhance your vessel and equipment to better prepare for the adventures and dangers that lie ahead.
• Immersive Storyline: Engage with a captivating narrative that unfolds as you progress, revealing the deep lore and history of the Void.
• Customizable Experience: Tailor your gameplay with a variety of objects and enhancements, making each playthrough a personalized adventure.

Uncover unexpected twists along the way, the Void promises an unparalleled adventure waiting to be experienced, testing your survival skills and resilience.

70010000091096.name: Flames of Damnation
70010000091096.intro: The Flames of Damnation burn on your path – are you ready to face them?
70010000091096.description:
Dive into a relentless adrenaline-pumping action game with Flames of Damnation, where classic 90s shooter elements collide with modern mechanics! Inspired by legendary titles of the genre, this game offers a challenge you won’t forget.

Key Features:
	•	Fast-Paced Gameplay: Master lightning-fast strafe-jumping to dodge attacks, navigate tricky terrain, and dominate your enemies.
	•	Unique Arsenal: Discover powerful infernal weapons, each with distinct characteristics tailored to different playstyles.
	•	Exploration and Upgrades: Find keys to unlock hidden areas filled with upgrades, magical spheres, and secret opportunities.
	•	Hellish Environments: Battle hordes of demonic creatures in richly detailed, dark, and dangerous settings that immerse you in the depths of hell.
	•	Unforgiving Challenges: Every encounter demands strategy and quick reflexes as enemies grow stronger and more cunning.

Flames of Damnation is a true homage to classic shooters, designed for those who crave tough battles and intense gameplay. Face the depths of hell and prove you’re worthy of survival!

70010000091101.name: Shadowforge Chronicles
70010000091101.intro: Magic meets firepower in a battle for survival.
70010000091101.description:
Shadowforge Chronicles is a dark fantasy first-person shooter where magic and weaponry become your only allies in the fight against ancient forces of evil. Experience dynamic gameplay, an engaging storyline, and unique mechanics that make every playthrough unforgettable.

Engaging Storyline
Immerse yourself in the mysterious world where the protagonist must uncover the secrets of forgotten lands and confront the dark magic that consumed a once-thriving kingdom. Your mission is to save the remaining survivors and unveil the mystery of the Shadowforge.

Magic and Weaponry
Harness a unique blend of magical abilities and a deadly arsenal of weapons. Each spell and weapon can be customized and upgraded, allowing you to craft your personal combat style.

Relentless Battles
Face hordes of enemies, each with unique traits. Encounter giant bosses that demand strategic thinking and quick reflexes. Only the bravest will emerge victorious.

Interactive Environment
Each location is filled with secrets, hidden mechanisms, and traps. Interact with the environment to unlock new paths or use it to your advantage in battles.

Unique Visual Style
The game combines the grim atmosphere of dark fantasy with vibrant magical elements. Meticulously designed locations and a rich color palette create an unforgettable visual experience.

Thoughtful Mechanics
	•	Intuitive controls and adaptation to various playstyles.
	•	Modern mechanics: parkour, environmental interaction, and the use of physics-based objects to solve puzzles.
	•	A well-designed progression and upgrade system.

70010000091106.name: Chained Survive Together
70010000091106.intro: Chains Can't Hold You Back—Fight to Survive Together!
70010000091106.description:
Embark on an epic adventure in Chained Survive Together. Bound by mystical chains to your companions, your goal is to ascend from the depths of the ocean by navigating treacherous underwater landscapes and overcoming obstacles. Perfect coordination is crucial as you traverse the dark, submerged realms filled with unique challenges.

Key Features:
• Upward Challenge: 
Experience a unique vertical twist on the runner genre as you climb from the ocean’s depths.
• Chain Physics: 
Realistic chain dynamics add strategic depth to your journey through the underwater abyss.
• Diverse Realms: 
Explore multiple submerged worlds with distinct and challenging environments.
• Difficulty Modes: 
Choose from Beginner, Normal, and Abyss modes to match your skill level.
• Conquer Territories: 
Claim and dominate new underwater areas as you ascend.
• Quests and Missions: 
Complete quests to test your skills and unlock new abilities.
• Skills and Abilities: 
Master and upgrade powerful skills to aid your journey through the ocean’s depths.
• Conquer Challenges Together:
Navigate perilous underwater terrains while chained to your companions. 
Play solo or team up in multiplayer mode, requiring precision and coordination for survival. Embrace the challenge, master the strategy, and lead your team to victory.

70010000091111.name: Urban Car Driver Simulator: City Explorer Challenge
70010000091111.intro: Drive, explore, conquer – the city is yours!
70010000091111.description:
Get ready to experience the thrill of the open road in Urban Driver Simulator: City Explorer Challenge! Immerse yourself in the vibrant streets of Sunny Island City, a dynamic urban playground designed for drivers of all skill levels. Whether you’re a seasoned pro or a curious newcomer, this comprehensive driving simulation offers something for everyone.

Features:
	•	Explore Sunny Island City: Navigate bustling avenues, charming neighborhoods, and iconic landmarks as you explore the richly detailed world of Sunny Island City.
	•	Diverse Vehicle Fleet: Take the wheel of a wide variety of vehicles, from comfortable sedans and sporty coupes to high-performance SUVs, rugged trucks, and versatile vans. Choose the ride that matches your driving style!
	•	Realistic Physics: Experience the nuanced feel of driving thanks to the game’s advanced physics engine. Every car handles differently, accurately reflecting its real-world counterpart.
	•	Customize Your Play: Freeplay Mode lets you set the rules! Choose if you want to follow traffic regulations and enable AI collisions for a truly immersive experience, or create a relaxed environment where you can explore at your own pace.
	•	Dynamic Missions: Never get bored! Encounter random missions that pop up during free play, adding an extra layer of excitement and challenging you to adapt your driving.
	•	Sharpen Your Skills: Boost your confidence behind the wheel with dedicated training challenges designed to enhance your traffic awareness, reaction times, and overall driving behavior.
	•	Lifelike Immersion: Lose yourself in the beauty and sounds of Sunny Island City. Enjoy stunning graphics and realistic audio effects that bring the bustling streets to life.

Embrace the challenge and explore the possibilities. Urban Driver Simulator: City Explorer Challenge is your ultimate driving adventure!

70010000091116.name: The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-
70010000091116.intro: Enroll in the Last Defense Academy and save humanity from despair!
70010000091116.description:
Takumi Sumino is a totally average teenager living in the Tokyo Residential Complex, a place where every day is much like the last and nothing bad ever happens. All that changes when freakish monsters attack the town and start wreaking havoc. A strange creature calling itself Sirei appears and offers Takumi the power to protect those he holds dear... All he has to do is stab himself in the chest!

The next thing he knows, Takumi is in Last Defense Academy, a colossal school in the middle of nowhere surrounded by a wall of otherworldly flames. He and 14 other students have been drafted into the Special Defense Unit, a team tasked with keeping the school safe for the next 100 days. Initiated students transform their blood into the mysterious Hemoanima, a unique type of mutated blood which provides supernatural abilities. How much are they willing to sacrifice to take back their normal lives and save the world from the grotesque school invaders? The curtain rises on 100 days of war and despair...

Extreme Despair-Filled Endings
Takumi's choices will decide his future, but there's no telling what kinds of consequences these decisions might have...

Defensive Battles
When the invaders attack, it's up to Takumi to protect the school in tactical RPG battles. Use each student's unique Specialist Skills to turn the tide of battle in his favor!

Free Time & Exploration
Spend time with Takumi’s teammates to deepen his bonds with them, or explore the wilderness and ruins outside the school. Players can even use the items found to craft gifts and get even closer to Takumi’s allies!

70010000091122.name: Dead Estate
70010000091122.description:
Dead Estate is a gory, fast-paced, challenging, roguelike shooter with a heavy emphasis on Halloween and other horror influences. Ascend the floors of a monster-filled mansion with 10 unique characters, collecting loads of items and weapons, tackle grueling challenges, and discover secrets and unlockables along the way!

Beware of the lurking threats on every floor -- some are especially persistent...

HIGH REPLAYABILITY!

- 10 playable characters, each with distinct playstyles and 4 Costumes each
- 150 weapons and 300 items to make each run unique
- Explore the vast complexity of the Estate - discovering alternate floors & floor variants
- An isometric style with compact rooms designed for tense, close-quarters combat
- Try a looped run, or varying difficulty levels to push your skills
- Blessing & Curse run modifiers to maximize replayability
- 20 custom Challenge Runs
- A bounty of secrets to be discovered, and many more to be unlocked

ASSIGNMENT ANYA

An entirely separate campaign inspired by classic survival horror games, set prior to the events of the main game. Play as Anya, a fledgling actress who finds herself helplessly lost in the mansion after her film crew is attacked by the undead.

Abandoned by her leading man and left alone with nothing but a mask to disguise herself with, Anya must escape the increasingly warped and deadly estate all on her own.

70010000091124.name: Antipaint
70010000091124.intro: An action-packed roguelite shooter where you battle famous works of art and each level you beat becomes a painting!
70010000091124.description:
Embark on a quest to become the greatest artist in the world.
The battlefield is your canvas, the enemies are your paint. Literally. The art you make is yours to keep.

Choose from a variety of brushes and characters. From a slow and steady thick brush to a quick and nimble paint roller - we've got you covered.

Finishing a painting rewards you with versatile items. Enlist the help of a friendly painting bucket, install some paint turrets, give your enemies moustache or become a robot. Find a way to express your true self!

After the paint has settled and the brushes are cleaned, take a step back and admire your masterpieces in the gallery.

70010000091129.name: Chibi Ninja Shino-kun Treasure of Demon Tower
70010000091129.description:
A game inspired by Japanese ninja games from the 80s and 90s.

Chibi Ninja Shino-kun: Treasure of Demon Tower is a fast and smooth retro platformer in which you climb a giant tower while dodging enemies, traps and other obstacles.

Use your wall jump, hookshot and ceiling running abilities to make it past the various enemies and discover the legendary treasure of Demon Tower!


Features:
* 100+ levels of ninja mayhem
* Be a ninja: Jump off walls, run on ceilings, use your hookshot!
* Fight zombies, demons, ghosts and dudes with shields
* A time attack mode for speedy ninjas
* Obligatory lava level

70010000091132.name: Squab
70010000091132.intro: Can you rescue your father while being unable to fly?
70010000091132.description:
Squab is an exciting precision platform adventure that puts players in control of a young pigeon full of energy but unable to fly. Using the dash as his main means of locomotion, players embark on a challenging journey to rescue his missing father, Maximus. 

Prepare to overcome a variety of challenges while navigating vibrant and dangerous environments. With engaging game mechanics and thrilling gameplay, Squab offers a unique experience that will test your skills and leave you craving more.


Features:
* Over 60 levels
* 3 Biomes
* Stay alert to all challenges
* Relaxing aesthetic and cute pixel art

70010000091135.name: Runny Bunny
70010000091135.intro: Get ready for a fast and furry twist on puzzle action in side-scrolling pixel art platforming style!
70010000091135.description:
Play as a frantic little bunny as you dash between floors, walls and ceilings collecting power dots and yummy carrots. Mazelike stages will take you from grassy wilds to twisted caverns and deadly laboratories. The bunny moves in lightning quick straight lines and clings to walls and ceilings, but you’ll still need to strategically maneuver him around traps and enemies to keep him safe from harm.

Find keys to unlock doors, dodge laser beams, avoid roving robots and more! Can you survive all 100 levels?

Features:

• Navigate mazelike stages with precision platforming!
• Dash between floors and walls or even cling to the ceiling.
• Avoid traps and roving enemies as stages grow in complexity!
• Collect dots and carrots to open the portal!
• Survive 100 tricky levels!

70010000091150.name: Destind: Mr. Almost Right
70010000091150.intro: With a compatibility rating of 99%, he’s your destined match.
70010000091150.description:
The Story:
“When are you getting married?”
When you’re finding the reality
of your romantic life too bleak to bare,
you’re matched through an app to a
man with a 99% compatibility rating.

A riveting date, his eye-opening kiss…
Your love only picks up speed…
Until your 1% mismatch makes you　hit the brakes.

”I’ll prove that we’re a perfect match.”

Just 1% left…
Who could be the man of your destiny?

Characters:
Rei Rindoh "The Lone Wolf"
Araya Kuze "The Perfect Boyfriend"
Takane Momochi "The Lofty Ideal"
Ryogo Saikusa "The Shrewd Gentleman"
Haruma Tosaka "The Reliable Confidant"
Yuri Kazumoto "Your Coworker with a Girlfriend"

Contents:
Includes Main Stories from the app Love 365: Find Your Story up until "Season 3"

70010000091155.name: Christmas Stories: The adventures of Santa Claus
70010000091155.intro: Visual novels full of magic, snow and exploration where players immerse themselves in the wonderful world of the North Pole.
70010000091155.description:
Discover the secrets behind the magical elements of Christmas, which will accompany Santa and his friends on extraordinary adventures.

Learn about the importance of friendship, teamwork and the magic that makes Christmas so special.

Each story is inspired by one of the magical mini-tales about Santa, the reindeer, the elves and the North Pole.

70010000091162.name: Fables Mosaic: Rapunzel
70010000091162.intro: Experience Cinderella story through logic puzzles!
70010000091162.description:
Fables Mosaic: Rapunzel features a collection of colorful puzzles that can be solved by logic alone! 
Follow the story of Rapunzel while you solve captivating nonogram challenges!

- 100 unique nonogram levels
- Follow the story of Rapunzel
- View a gallery of completed nonograms
- Use logic to solve puzzles

70010000091171.name: The Bodycam Shooter
70010000091171.intro: Fast, tactical, and relentless—survive the fight.
70010000091171.description:
The Bodycam Shooter throws you into relentless, first-person combat where every second counts. As an elite operative, you’ll fight through intense, fast-paced battles across diverse environments, from war-torn streets to hidden enemy bases.

Earn coins in the heat of battle and upgrade your arsenal with a vast selection of powerful weapons. Adapt your tactics, master every firefight, and outgun your opponents to dominate each mission.

With immersive bodycam-style visuals and high-stakes action, The Bodycam Shooter delivers an adrenaline-fueled experience where survival is the only option. Lock, load, and step into the fight!

70010000091184.name: Fables Mosaic: Cinderella
70010000091184.intro: Experience Cinderella story through logic puzzles!
