70010000091184.description:
Fables Mosaic: Cinderella features a collection of colorful puzzles that can be solved by logic alone! 
Follow the story of Cinderella while you solve captivating nonogram challenges!

- 100 unique nonogram levels
- Follow the story of Cinderella
- View a gallery of completed nonograms
- Use logic to solve puzzles

70010000091188.name: Fables Mosaic: Little Red Riding Hood
70010000091188.intro: Experience Little Red Riding Hood story through logic puzzles!
70010000091188.description:
Fables Mosaic: Little Red Riding Hood features a collection of colorful puzzles that can be solved by logic alone! 
Follow the story of Little Red Riding Hood while you solve captivating nonogram challenges!

- 100 unique nonogram levels
- Follow the story of Little Red Riding Hood
- View a gallery of completed nonograms
- Use logic to solve puzzles

70010000091192.name: Fables Mosaic: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
70010000091192.intro: Experience Snow White story through logic puzzles!
70010000091192.description:
Fables Mosaic: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs features a collection of colorful puzzles that can be solved by logic alone! 
Follow the story of Snow White while you solve captivating nonogram challenges!

- 100 unique nonogram levels
- Follow the story of Snow White
- View a gallery of completed nonograms
- Use logic to solve puzzles

70010000091196.name: Mosa Lina
70010000091196.description:
• Raw Random
• Physics-driven-Puzzle-platforming
• Local & Online Multiplayer
• Level Editor

A hostile Interpretation of immersive sim design

This game is a response to the current trend of Immersive Sim design, where every ability is perfectly suited to solve a specific problem in the game. In order to counter this "Lock and Key" philosophy, Mosa Lina is aggressively random.

This does NOT mean that the game has proc-gen. Tools and Levels are handmade, they are just randomly selected and sometimes slightly modified!

It's literally impossible for me to check if all levels are beatable with all combinations of tools. This is what makes it so satisfying: There is no premeditated solution for you to follow. You're forced to get creative.

The game continually spits out randomised problems. It's up to YOU to solve them, because I've never seen them before.

There are no safeguards here. You might get the same item ten times in a row. You might beat the game without seeing it at all. Every playthrough contains only a fraction of the total levels. They're also selected randomly. Nobody knows what'll happen.

It's this reckless abandon of predictability that allows you to stop worrying about "winning" and frees you to enjoy the experimentation. Fun things happen more often if you don't force them.

The player, tiles, items and obstacles are all parsed through the same physics-engine. Everything interacts with everything else, allowing you to get really creative and expressive.Sure, all you do is collect fruits to open the portal, but HOW you do that is up to you entirely.

So far, every playtest has shown me that even the most straighforward design is powerless against the endless creativity of players. I sometimes discover new emergent behaviours myself, even after years of playing it

Bring a friend! Whether on the couch next to you or somewhere far away, Mosa Lina can now be enjoyed together! This opens up a lot of possibilities for crazy plays, hilarious fails and all-around creativity!

Use the built-in Level Editor to make your own Level Packs, or check out the many Level Packs made by the community! This is the place for those who have mastered the base game and are looking for an extra challenge. Good Luck!

Thanks for checking out our game! Have a nice day :)

70010000091200.name: Portal Balls
70010000091200.description:
Guide the blue and red balls to their respective portals in a race against time. Use your skill and strategy to ensure the blue ball reaches the blue portal and the red ball finds its way to the red portal!

BRAIN-BENDING LEVELS!
With 30 unique levels, Portal Balls offers a mix of puzzle-solving challenges and intense action. Some levels require sharp thinking, while others introduce enemies you must avoid at all costs. The clock is ticking—can you complete each level in time?

TEST YOUR SKILLS AND SEE IF YOU CAN CONQUER THE PORTALS!

70010000091205.name: Cats Visiting Underwater World
70010000091205.intro: Dive into a hidden-cat adventure! Explore vibrant coral reefs, sunken temples, and ancient shipwrecks to uncover cats and collect rare treasures.
70010000091205.description:
In Cats Visiting Underwater World, dive into stunning underwater scenes where hidden cats await. From shipwrecks nestled in vibrant coral reefs to the corridors of ancient, submerged temples, every location is filled with beauty, mystery, and feline friends.

Alongside finding hidden cats, each artwork holds a special collectible item. Gather these treasures to complete a unique collection, adding an exciting layer of exploration and challenge to every scene.

Get ready to dive deep, search carefully, and enjoy this magical journey. Each scene brings new secrets, surprises, and, of course, adorable cats waiting to be found!

70010000091214.name: Let's Aim! Ring Toss
70010000091214.intro:
Gear up for a carnival game classic: ring toss!
Win as many prizes as you can and become a ring toss master!
70010000091214.description:
Let's enjoy playing ring toss on the Nintendo Switch™!
Share Joy-Con™ and play with up to 4 players!
Aim for a new high score!

Toss your rings and win all sorts of prizes!

[Score Attack]
Neatly toss your rings onto every prize and aim for a high ranking on the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Face off against CPUs in single-player mode, or test your skills against friends in multiplayer battles!
Challenge ring-tossers from all over the world in online battles!

[Collection]
Step back and admire the prizes you've earned!
There are over 140 different prizes to collect!

70010000091219.name: Escape Game The Resort Facility
70010000091219.intro:
The orthodox escape game for you, staged in a resort facility.
Can you solve all the riddles and get out?
70010000091219.description:
■GAME SYSTEM
This game is an escape-the-room game (mystery-adventure game).
*Point the screen with a cursor to solve riddles, and story goes on.

■STORY
You've come to stay at a trending resort hotel
in a southern island.

Enjoying yourself in the great vacation,
The hotel manager talks to you.

He says this place has a fancy escape attraction.

I decide to try it in no time because
part of me wants some excitements in this relaxing stay.

70010000091221.name: The Fox's Way Home
70010000091221.intro:
Dancing fox shrine maiden!
A slightly sexy Apparition Find game
70010000091221.description:
The game is very simple!
First, watch the dance performed by the Fox Shrine Maiden carefully and memorize it well.
Be sure not to get distracted by her sexy allure and miss any part of the dance.

How to Play
To return to your original world, you must witness all the rituals performed by the Fox Shrine Maiden.
Sometimes, apparitions called "mononoke" will try to deceive you by taking on a form very similar to the Fox Shrine Maiden and tempt you.

Stay strong, watch the rituals carefully, and don’t get enchanted by the seductive fox dance, so you can spot the "mononoke"!

"One! If you believe it is my real self, call upon my name!"
"Two! If you think it to be an impostor, see through the deception at once!"
"Know that if you err in either, the ritual fails immediately!"

If you find a difference from the initial dance, press the "Fake".
If you don't find anything suspicious, watch the dance untill the end or press the "Real".
Light all 8 lanterns to return to the world you came from!

Apparition Encyclopedia
The various forms of the "mononoke" you have exposed can be recorded in an encyclopedia.
Repeat the rituals and create your very own captivating "Apparition Encyclopedia"!


<Cast>
The Fox Shrine Maiden (CV: Maaya Uchida)

70010000091227.name: Treasure Hunter Simulator
70010000091227.intro: Dive into the exciting world of finding long forgotten treasures. Grab your metal detector and set off to explore the countryside.
70010000091227.description:
Treasure Hunter Simulator gives you a chance to explore historically important locations worldwide and, by using your metal detectors, to discover that past by finding interesting artefacts and getting to know their historical significance.

With locations scattered all over the world, you’ll need to find something interesting and valuable in your local woods to gain the prestige and funds needed for better equipment and travel expenses to exotic, remote locations. You can decide to keep artefacts for your collection or to auction them off to travel even further or get even better gear. 

Treasure Hunter Simulator is not a hardcore metal detector simulator, but rather a mix of arcade and simulation. With streamlined detector mechanics the game is enjoyable not only for the fans of the genre, but casual gamers as well. Simple, intuitive gameplay elements combined with beautiful landscapes make for a truly enjoyable experience.

70010000091231.name: The Elf on the Shelf®: Christmas Heroes
70010000091231.intro: Santa needs you! Become a Scout Elf, gathering Christmas Spirit and dodging obstacles. Pledge to make things merry and be a Christmas Hero!
70010000091231.description:
Do you believe in Christmas magic? You’ll need every bit to help Santa save Christmas!

With Christmas Spirit running low, the North Pole isn’t so merry. Santa’s sleigh won’t fly, gifts aren’t ready, and there’s a chance that nice children might not end up on Santa’s Nice List.  

Dash, swing, and leap through training to become an “official Scout Elf”! Pick your most festive outfit and spread cheer as you explore every room, dodge obstacles, and add sparkle to each corner of the home. 

This season, pledge to make things merry and bright. Are you ready to be a Christmas Hero?

ENJOY A CHRISTMAS TRADITION: Follow the story or enjoy minigames - there’s holiday fun for everyone.  

BECOME A SCOUT ELF:  Complete training and help Santa with his Nice List. 

PLAY MINIGAMES FILLED WITH MAGIC: Solve puzzles, match cards, sort ornaments and explore enchanted mazes.  

COLLECT & SHINE: Run, jump, and swing to gather rewards. If you miss a few, dive back into the fun to collect them all. 

DESIGN YOUR SCOUT ELF HERO: Create the perfect holiday outfit with sparkling seasonal accessories.

70010000091236.name: Mini Market Design
70010000091236.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70010000091236.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!


Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70010000091241.name: Jewel Match Solitaire 2 Collectors Edition
70010000091241.intro: Return to an enchanting Solitaire wonderland!
70010000091241.description:
Travel the lands and collect resources to rebuild majestic monuments. 
Over 300 levels, plus 18 Solitaire variants including Klondike, Baker's Dozen, or Freecell! 
Loads of unique game play alternatives shake up your classic Solitaire. 
Visit the shop to explore the myriad items available for purchase to help you on your quest to restore the kingdom to its former glory.

Jewel Match Solitaire 2 Collector's Edition is the ultimate relaxing Solitaire experience!

Features
- Play 320 Solitaire Levels!
- 18 replayable Bonus Solitaire games:
- Klondike, Freecell, Spider, Lady Palk, Ali Baba, Baker's Dozen, Acme, Trusty Twelve, Giant, Lanes, Raglan, Twenty, Scarab, Spanish Patience, Diplomat, Double Line, Nestor, Thieves of Egypt.
- 8 beautiful castles to build!
- Play Hard and Relaxed modes.
- Strategy Guide with tips and tricks on how to beat the regular levels and the bonus solitaire games.
- Unlock gorgeous wallpapers.
- Dozens of Trophies to achieve.
- Choose from several Card Decks.
- Beautifully relaxing soundtrack.

70010000091245.name: Hyper Mirror Run
70010000091245.intro: Can you run fast enough to avoid defeat?
70010000091245.description:
Race head-to-head in the exciting world of HYPER MIRROR RUN. Compete locally against your friends or challenge an AI opponent. 

You can navigate through mirrored worlds, mastering precision jumps and wielding weapons to triumph over foes. Dive into this 2D platformer for fast-paced action and a lot of fun!

Will you be able to conquer every challenge, vanquish enemies, and face powerful bosses at the end of each of the 5 unique worlds?

Don’t forget to collect the gems to earn extra lives, enhancing your chances to defeat your opponent.


Features:
* 55 Engaging Levels: Traverse meticulously designed levels across 5 distinct worlds.
* Versus Mode: Compete locally against your friends in thrilling head-to-head matches.
* Single-Player Variety: Choose from 3 difficulty AI levels in single-player mode to tailor the challenge.
* Unique Retro Visuals: Immerse yourself in the captivating retro pixel art and vibrant visual style, choosing from a variety of cute character skins that allow you to express your unique style and flair.
* Precise and Enjoyable Controls: Experience controls that are both precise and enjoyable, allowing you to master every move with finesse.
* Exclusive Soundtrack: Enjoy an engaging gaming experience with an original soundtrack composed for the game, including immersive melodies.

70010000091249.name: Psycho Dream
70010000091249.intro: Rescue young Sayaka from the DMovie she’s trapped in!
70010000091249.description:
A dangerous trend has emerged among young people: they are evading reality by taking permanent refuge in a new entertainment medium known as DMovies, which allows people to immerse themselves in a world of virtual reality and become part of a movie.Some of them remain in that alternative reality for so long, their bodies ultimately give up and die. These people are known as Sinkers.

The government has created a new special division composed of agents known as Diamond Dogs, whose mission consists of entering the virtual reality worlds of the DMovies and rescuing the people trapped in them.

Join Diamond Dogs Ryo and Maria in their mission to rescue young Sayaka from the DMovie she’s trapped in before it’s too late.


Features:
* 6 stages full of action and nightmarish creatures
* Select from 2 playable characters, each with their own unique skills
* Rewind/Turbo function: repeat something until you achieve perfection, or speed things up
* Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point
* Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.)
* Gallery: view images from the original game’s manual and box design
* Cheats function: activate cheats that will make your mission a lot easier (infinite lives, invulnerability, etc.)
* Jukebox: listen to the 13 music tracks included in the game whenever you want

* This game is re-release of “Psycho Dream” which the first launched in 1990s for home consoles.

70010000091251.name: Lulu's Temple
70010000091251.intro: Can you escape this pyramid or will you perish inside?
70010000091251.description:
Lulu’s Temple challenges you to venture inside a deep horrifying pyramid, filled with dangerous foes, traps and mysteries.

Play as a curious archaeologist who foolishly traps himself inside a temple after stumbling his way in.

Use your powerful gun to blast the undead and your torch to light your path ahead.


Features:
* Horrifying Egyptian adventure filled with undead lurking in the dark.
* Interesting light mechanic that encourages player to tread carefully and make clever decisions.
* Thrilling shooting action filled with blood splatter and gore.
* Retro soundtrack with an experimental Egyptian twist.
* Mysterious golden scarab companion.
* An ominous giant deep inside, guarding the secrets of the pyramid.

70010000091266.name: Big Adventure: Trip To Europe 6 Collector's Edition
70010000091266.description:
"Trip to Europe 6" offers an exciting Christmas journey through the snowy European countries. 
Playing the game you will be able to find hidden objects in historical places in Europe and Scandinavia, play exciting mini-games and collect souvenirs.

The new part contains new exciting ways to find objects and a lot of new interesting mini-games.
This exciting trip will allow you to visit 30 beautiful places and tourist attractions. 
This fabulous trip will allow you to visit 30 new places all over Europe.
Take a walk around Christmas market in Berlin, visit Santa Claus in Finland, walk across Charles Bridge in Prague and explore many snowy Christmas locations. 
Take a ride on an ice rink and travel by train, ship and plane.

In this hidden object game you will be able to visit many both new and popular tourist places. 
To complete this game, you need to apply your skills and attention to cope with the mini-games and find all the hidden objects.

The collector 's edition includes:
- 8 additional locations - continue your journey across Europe and search for our raccoon friend!
- 8 additional new mini-games + 12 more for puzzle lovers
- Album with exclusive postage stamps
- 20 Christmas souvenirs from the trip

70010000091270.name: Big Adventure: Trip To Europe 7 Collector's Edition
70010000091270.intro: Embark on a journey through beautiful European countries!
70010000091270.description:
Take an incredible journey to some of Europe’s most inspiring tourist destinations! 
Hike through gorgeous national parks, explore European musical culture, visit ancient castles, and much more! 
This hidden-object game is full of new and popular tourist spots, so use your skills and knowledge to solve mini-games and puzzles with a distinct European flare!

In this hidden object game you will be able to visit many both new and popular tourist places. 
To complete this game, you need to apply your skills and attention to cope with the mini-games and find all the hidden objects.

The collector 's edition includes:
- 10 additional locations - continue your journey across Europe and search for our raccoon friend!
- 5 additional new mini-games + 12 more for puzzle lovers
- A collection of unique souvenirs
- 20 great  souvenirs from the journey

70010000091274.name: Blockxy Puzzle Adventure
70010000091274.intro: Fill in the missing pieces and start a puzzle adventure
70010000091274.description: Blockxy Puzzle Adventure includes two Game Modes. A classic mode and an adventure mode for varied gameplay experiences. The classic mode is a simple arcade mode where you beat the highscore and the adventure mode includes 150 levels where you have to achieve different goals like item collection or score goals. Enjoy!

70010000091276.name: Sliding Cubes 2048 Mania
70010000091276.intro: Merge, strategize, and conquer—reach 2048 in this addictive puzzle phenomenon!
70010000091276.description: Immerse yourself in this addictive puzzle game where strategy is key! Merge colorful cubes with matching numbers to create higher-value cubes, like combining two 2s to make a 4, and so on. Your goal is to score as high as possible while keeping the board clear. If more than 20 cubes fill the board, it’s game over. Can you master the art of merging, reach the coveted 2048 cube, or achieve an unbeatable score?

70010000091281.name: Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek
70010000091281.intro: Dark Secrets Await.  Unravel the Truth.
70010000091281.description:
Enter the chilling world of Goosebumps in Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek! Step into the shoes of Sloane Spencer, a young teen caught in a town of nightmares, as you unravel eerie mysteries, confront sinister monsters, and navigate haunted locations inspired by R.L. Stine’s legendary book series. Solve puzzles, evade creatures, and uncover the dark secrets lurking in the shadows—all while experiencing the Goosebumps signature blend of spooky adventure and playful twists that has captivated millions of fans both young and young at heart.

Key Game Features:

ORIGINAL GOOSEBUMPS STORY – Experience a brand-new Goosebumps mystery, crafted exclusively for the game. Encounter fresh terrors inspired by the book series while uncovering the unsettling truths hidden within the town of Little Creek.

SUSPENSEFUL EXPLORATION – Traverse the fog-filled streets of Little Creek, creep through abandoned theaters, and sneak through dark libraries teeming with secrets. Every shadow hides a new spooky surprise waiting to be uncovered.

MYSTERIOUS CHALLENGES – Test your wits with mind-bending puzzles, interactive contraptions, and clever riddles that stand between you and the truth behind Little Creek’s supernatural happenings.

STAY ONE STEP AHEAD OF LURKING THREATS! Use stealth and cunning to evade terrifying monsters or fight back using your trusty slingshot and the help of a haunted book you’ve discovered.

MONSTERS OF THE UNKNOWN – Face a dreadful roster of monsters, inspired by classic Goosebumps frights but reimagined for an all-new nightmare-filled experience. Survive their relentless pursuit and uncover their dark origins.

MULTIPLE ENDINGS – Your choices shape the fate of Sloane and her friends. Can you unearth the full truth behind Little Creek’s horrors, or will the town’s mysteries consume you?

70010000091288.name: Wéko The Mask Gatherer
70010000091288.intro: Wéko the Mask Gatherer is a 3D action-adventure game where you step into the shoes of Wéko, a mysterious adventurer on a quest to collect the seven powerful Primordial Masks.
70010000091288.description:
Embark on an extraordinary journey in Wéko The Mask Gatherer, a single-player action-adventure set in a beautifully crafted fantasy world.

As Wéko, an intrepid adventurer, you’ll explore diverse and enchanting landscapes filled with secrets, challenges, and mysteries to uncover. Utilize powerful collectible masks to gain unique abilities, solve intricate puzzles, and complete engaging missions. Whether navigating treacherous waters, uncovering hidden paths, or assisting villagers, every step brings a new discovery.

Key Features:

-Single-Player Action-Adventure Gameplay: A rich and immersive experience designed for exploration, combat, and puzzle-solving.
-Collectible Masks: Discover masks that grant unique powers and allow you to adapt your playstyle to every situation.
-Diverse and Stunning Environments: Explore vibrant villages, shadowy forests, and challenging underground areas, each brought to life with rich detail and atmosphere.
-Engaging Combat and Puzzles: Test your skills with accessible combat mechanics and puzzles that encourage creative thinking.
-Heartfelt Storyline: Experience Wéko’s journey of growth, courage, and discovery as he faces emotional and physical trials.
-8-12 Hours of Gameplay: Enjoy a captivating main storyline, complemented by side quests and hidden secrets.

70010000091293.name: Valhalla Mountain
70010000091293.intro: Ascend Yggdrasil's surreal landscapes in this Norse-inspired puzzle adventure. Solve puzzles, twist geometry, and uncover a warrior's path to Valhalla.
70010000091293.description:
Embark on a mesmerizing journey through the surreal landscapes of Yggdrasil, a puzzle-adventure inspired by Norse mythology. Navigate intricate pathways, twist impossible geometry, and experience the story of a lost warrior striving to reach Valhalla.

As a lone traveler ascending the sacred mountain, you must manipulate the environment to solve mind-bending puzzles, uncover hidden realms, and awaken the spirits of the gods. Each step brings you closer to the peak, where your ultimate destiny awaits.

Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world filled with mystical architecture, tranquil atmospheres, and an enchanting soundtrack.

Will you reach the summit and prove yourself worthy to enter Valhalla?

70010000091299.name: Sokorobot
70010000091299.intro: In this puzzle game, a robot need to clear paths to unlock new levels!
70010000091299.description:
Sokorobot is a dynamic puzzle game where you guide a resourceful robot through 30 challenging levels. Clear debris, solve intricate puzzles, and unlock new stages as you navigate a sleek futuristic world.

Think smart, act precise. Every move counts as you tackle complex layouts and interactive elements that test your strategy!

With intuitive gameplay, rewarding achievements, and stunning pixel-art visuals, Sokorobot delivers the perfect blend of challenge and fun. 

30 levels of strategic puzzles
Achievements to unlock
Futuristic pixel-art style
Clear the way, conquer the challenges—play Sokorobot!

70010000091306.name: Dino Market
70010000091306.intro: Run an idle market with your animal friends!
70010000091306.description:
Dino decided to open a new market!
Customers will ask for specific items and you have to prepare them!
Once you complete a level, you can choose to rest and chill with your desktop companions.
Use productivity tools like timers and to-do lists to help you focus!

Features:
Build carts for new friends!
Choose the layout that works best for you!
Buy upgrades and automate the process!
You can play actively or passively
Use skills to give you a boost!
Complete challenges and try to be the best market in the world!
Unlock all the achievements!
Unlock all the carts!
Watch numbers go up!

70010000091308.name: Escape Game The Painting Mansion
70010000091308.intro:
The orthodox escape game for you, staged in a rumored mansion.
Can you solve all the riddles and get out?
70010000091308.description:
■GAME SYSTEM
This game is an escape-the-room game (mystery-adventure game).
*Point the screen with a cursor to solve riddles, and story goes on.

■STORY
During a journey...
You hear of a mansion that stands on a hill.

It says nobody has made their way out of it 
once stepping in.

On a step forward to the mansion,
A door behind me closes slowly on its own.

Seems you're trapped in the mansion…
Can you make your way outー

70010000091310.name: Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree
70010000091310.description:
In this Roguelite adventure set in a far-off mystic realm, ancient forces stir, and untold dangers await. As Towa, lead the guardians of the sacred tree in forging strong relationships and powerful swords to fight Magatsu’s forces and determine the future of Shinju Village.

- ENTER A VIBRANT WORLD FILLED WITH BEAUTY AND PERILOUS DANGER
On their quest to restore peace, play as Towa and the Guardians as they explore far-off lands threatened by Magatsu’s evil influence. In a world where even splendor hides a lurking threat, courage is the only way forward. As Hitoshi Sakimoto’s melodies guide the way, a breathtaking yet untamed landscape unfolds where the fight to save Shinju Village begins.

- FIGHT AS A DUO IN THRILLING ROGUELITE COMBAT
Towa, priestess of Shinju, stands united with 8 trustworthy companions to defeat Magatsu. Fight alongside a fellow guardian and wield the power of the sacred sword (Tsurugi) and staff (Kagura). Each guardian has its own abilities and set of swords, making each combat style and guardian pair unique. Together, pave your way through colorful lands, conquer dungeons, and defeat Magatsu’s minions!

- FORGE WEAPONS AND BONDS THAT STAND THE TEST OF TIME
As the guardians pursue their quests across different timelines, the village evolves over the years. Develop unique bonds with its residents and learn more about their customs and stories that are woven into the inner workings of the village. Each visit is a chance to train at the dojo, summon powerful Graces, and craft new swords at the smithing shop.

*A Deluxe Edition is also available. Be careful of duplicate purchases.

70010000091314.name: Never Grave: The Witch and The Curse
70010000091314.intro: A Metroidvania x Roguelite where you journey with the aid of a cursed hat
70010000091314.description:
A Metroidvania x Roguelite where you journey with the aid of a cursed hat. Use a variety of magic or possess your enemies to reach the lowest levels! Bring back loot, build up in your village, make a living and strengthen yourself for the next battle! Supports up to 4-player multiplayer.

Authentic 2D action
-Never Grave is 2D action game where you journey with the aid of a cursed hat. Adventure into dungeons, fight with magic, and sometimes even use the terrain to win! Dungeons such as ruins and botanical gardens are auto-generated and change each time you play. Obstacles and puzzles waiting to block your path in the dungeons, so be careful where you step! 

Possession system
-Possess enemies using a cursed hat. Use unique abilities from your possessed enemies to gain an advantage in battle!

Rebuild a ruined village
-Use materials collected in the dungeons to clear the rubble of ruined villages, build new facilities and cultivate crops in the fields. Produce food and potions in the village to prepare for the next battle!

Multiplayer
-Multiplayer support for up to four players. Call your friends from other worlds and conquer dungeons together!

Game features
-Metroidvania x Roguelite with an emphasis on exploration.
-Sophisticated and tactilely designed player character controls.
-Possess enemies and use their unique abilities with the unique Possession system. 
-Traditional Japanese hand-drawn limited animation is used for character 2D animation.
-Hand-painted backgrounds with depth, as if you are travelling through a world of picture books and cut-out pictures.
-Learn new abilities such as double-jump from artefacts to explore new areas.
-Constantly changing play style depending on the synergy of "traits" associated with magic and items.
-Intense battles with tough bosses. It will take more than just memorizing boss patterns to defeat them without taking damage...
-Rebuild your village. Strengthen yourself through building and production to prepare for the next adventure.
-Explore different terrain each time you play through procedurally generated dungeons.
-Multiplayer support. Up to four players can delve into the dungeon together!

70010000091332.name: Casual Sport Series: Tennis
70010000091332.intro: Ready your racket, find your rhythm, and dominate the court!
70010000091332.description:
Casual Sport Series: Tennis brings the excitement of the game to life with its accessible and action-packed gameplay. 

The game features realistic court surfaces just like in real tennis—play on grass, clay, or hard courts, each offering a unique feel and gameplay experience. Plus, every shot and serve is at your disposal, from topspin and slices to powerful smashes and precision drop shots, giving you the freedom to play like a pro.

Choose from an array of vibrant characters, each with their own unique flair, and compete on beautifully designed courts. With stunning visuals, smooth animations, and colorful environments, every match is a feast for the eyes, making each rally as engaging to watch as it is to play.

Grab your racket and show the world you’re ready to smash the competition!

Features:
- Multiple Game Modes: Enjoy singles, doubles, or exciting tournaments in both single-player and multiplayer options.
- Realistic Court Surfaces: Grass, clay, and hard courts, each affecting gameplay like in real tennis.
- Comprehensive Shot Variety: Perform all the shots and serves used in professional tennis, including topspin, slices, drop shots, and more.
- Vibrant Characters: Choose from a variety of unique characters, each with their own flair.
- Beautifully Designed Courts: Compete on stunning, colorful courts that enhance every match.

70010000091338.name: Hegzis
70010000091338.intro: Master the hex grid as you puzzle through colorfully chill stages, clearing lines and strategically using tools to assist!
70010000091338.description:
Put your brain to the test across dozens of unique challenges in Hegzis, a chill hex-grid puzzle game presented in colorful 2D style! Select a stage from Serene Beach, Whispering Forest and more, then progress through multiple levels in each world, placing pieces of connected hexes to form lines in any direction.

As you rotate pieces and fill lines to connect all the way across, hexes will disappear and increase your score. But be careful not to block yourself in! Use special tools to fill gaps or clear away unwanted hexes and make room for more. The better you think things through and efficiently place your hexes, the better bonuses you will receive. Unlock new stages or return to cleared ones to improve your score!

• Enjoy colorful stages where you arrange puzzle pieces on a hex grid!
• Clear lines in multiple directions to make room for new pieces.
• Rotate pieces to fit into available hex spaces!
• Use special tools to clear unwanted hexes.
• Unlock new themed stages as you progress!

70010000091343.name: Genome Guardian
70010000091343.intro: COMBINE WEAPONS in the microscopic roguelite turret shooter with macroscopic depth. Survive using an astounding array of turrets, perks, mutations and powers.
70010000091343.description:
COMBINE WEAPONS in the microscopic roguelite turret shooter with macroscopic depth. Survive 6 modes using an astounding array of turrets, perks, mutations and power-ups on this psychedelic journey to the heart of the abyss.

Research permanent upgrades to survive a variety of microbes across 6 game modes, each with multiple "depths".

Pair DNA nucleotides Adenine (rapid fire), Cytosine (precision), Guanine (spread), Thymine (explosive) to discover wild hybrid bioweapons!
* Bomb + Shotgun combines explosives with spread to create Blast Shotgun!
* Bomb + Bomb doubles down on explosive power to make Bazooka!
* Blast Shotgun + Shotgun forms the all-powerful Flak Cannon!

* 49 Turrets with unique strengths and functions
* 96 Perks to mix and match that drastically change how you play
* 75 Weapon & Turret Mods that can turn shots into sticky laser mines or bouncing fireballs
* 64 Mutations alter the challenges you face each run
* 20-minute Runs that can be continued in Endless Mode
* 75 Bassy Electronic Tunes that adapt to the current mood & intensity
* Cosmetics like spider legs and tank tread
* Accessibility Settings for color blindness, motion sickness, and even arachnophobia!

70010000091345.name: Baki Hanma: Blood Arena
70010000091345.intro: Step into the shoes of Baki Hanma in this action-packed 2D anime fighting game.
70010000091345.description:
Enter the brutal world of Baki Hanma: Blood Arena, a thrilling 2D action game inspired by the anime phenomenon Baki.

With gameplay reminiscent of classic fighting titles, this game blends precision, timing, and shonen-style flair to deliver a high-energy combat experience.

70010000091347.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 26
70010000091347.description:
The Club is Yours in EA SPORTS FC™ 26.

Play your way with an overhauled gameplay experience powered by community feedback. The new Authentic Gameplay option delivers the most true-to-football experience ever in Career, while the Competitive Gameplay option—driven by refined fundamentals, added consistency, and enhanced responsiveness—is tailor-made for play in Football Ultimate Team™ and Clubs.

Put your dream squad to the test in Football Ultimate Team™ with new Live Events and Tournament modes, as well as a refreshed Rivals and Champs experience.

Experience Manager Career like never before with all-new Manager Live Challenges. Earn rewards throughout the new season by taking on a variety of real-world scenarios and alternative storylines – ranging from a few minutes of play to multiple seasons.

Archetypes inspired by the greats of the game introduce new classes to Clubs and Player Career, bringing more individuality to your player. Develop your abilities by upgrading attributes and unlocking Archetype Perks to give your player a distinct feel on the pitch.

Experience The World’s Game like never before in EA SPORTS FC™ 26, with match data from the world’s top leagues powering 20,000+ authentic players.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

70010000091352.name: Learn to Play - Penalty Shootout
70010000091352.description:
Penalty Shootout is a short and simple game.

Shoot the ball as hard as you can to score goals. Then switch and try to save all the shots from your opponent!

Each side will have 10 attempts. Score as many goals as possible to be victorious!

70010000091360.name: EARTH SAVER
70010000091360.intro: It's up to you to blast away the approaching meteorite and become the savior of the Earth!
70010000091360.description:
[Prologue]
In the year 20XX, an asteroid that came from outside the solar system is approaching the Earth.
Humanity responds with a nuclear attack, but the meteorite is not destroyed and splits into 50 pieces──.
The only hope left is a lone demolition specialist!

[Game Overview]
"Earth Saver" is an exhilarating action game where you demolition and dismantle a giant meteorite approaching the Earth!
Place a bomb and it will explode with a bang in three counts!
If you successfully split the meteorite into small pieces, it will burn up in the atmosphere and the Earth will be safe!
Connect and explode, split cleanly, the exhilaration is at its MAX!
But if you're not careful, the large pieces will head straight for the Earth...!
This is a highly strategic action game where the timing and placement of the explosion are key.

The controls are simple.
Just move your character and place the bomb with the button!
Earth Saver is easy for anyone to play, yet deep.
It's a game that both beginners and blasting specialists can enjoy.

Plan your route within the limited time and protect the Earth with your intuition and judgment!

[Enjoy it over and over again with 7 diverse modes!]

[Difficulty modes]
EASY: Practice mode for beginners. No enemies, so you can relax!
NORMAL: A well-balanced mode for intermediate players.
HARD: A challenge mode for advanced players with a strict time limit!
EXPERT: A serious mode with fast enemies and no time carryover!
ULTIMATE: An ultra-difficult mode where you aim to clear all stages without making any mistakes!

[Featured challenge modes]
ENDLESS: Infinite stages with no goal! Challenge yourself to see how far you can go. Online rankings are also supported!
BATTLE: A blasting showdown between two players! A battle mode that you can enjoy with your friends by sharing play!

70010000091380.name: Taiji
70010000091380.intro: Solve puzzle panels and uncover the meaning of the symbols within. Explore a dense world where secrets are hidden in plain sight.
70010000091380.description:
Taiji is an adventure puzzle-solving game set in a mysterious world full of puzzles. Unlike many adventure games, the puzzles in Taiji all use a consistent interface: a grid of tiles which can be toggled on or off.
Although this might seem simple, the consistency of the interface frees the player from guesswork or pixel hunting that happens in many adventure games. It is always clear what the player must interact with in order to solve the puzzle, but it is never entirely clear what they must do. There are many different areas in the game, each with their own visual and mechanical themes. As you explore this dense world, it is important to think hard and to pay close attention, as vital clues are sometimes hidden in plain sight.

70010000091386.name: Guns of Fury
70010000091386.intro: Guns of Fury is a retro-inspired action platformer that combines the run & gun and Metroidvania genres.
70010000091386.description:
Explore a vast interconnected world, gain new abilities and weapons, battle epic bosses and stop the plans of an evil corporation before it’s too late!

Story:
In the near future, the world is in an energy crisis. When all hope has been lost, world famous scientist Dr. Klaus makes a surprise announcement: the discovery of the "Tetra Cell". It’s incredible energy-producing properties could be used for the good of mankind. However, 24 hours later, he mysteriously disappears and his lab is destroyed in an explosion. The industrialist A. Easton, President of Easton Industries is suspected to have kidnapped Dr. Klaus and that he intends to use the Tetra Cell to create a new type of super weapon.

You assume the role of Vincent Fury, a special operative on a mission to infiltrate the top secret research facility of Easton Industries, rescue Dr. Klaus and recover the missing Tetra Cell before it’s too late!

Explore a huge world as you face the private army of evil industrialist A. Easton and his gang of top executives.
As you advance through the game, you will discover new items and abilities, as well as gain money to purchase new equipment from merchants, which will help you access new areas and battle more powerful enemies, including fearsome bosses. 

Features:
-Explore a vast interconnected world and uncover new areas using newly acquired skills and equipment
-Exhilarating run and gun action
-Beautiful hand-crafted 16-bit pixel art
-Hundreds of unique items to discover, including guns, melee weapons, bombs and accessories
-10+ bosses and tons of enemy types
-Acquire new abilities in an authentic Metroidvania experience
-Take control of a variety of different mechs, each with its own array of attacks and abilities
-Discover secrets in breakable walls and acquire loot and powerful new equipment
-Destructible environments
-Alternate endings
-Incredible soundtrack by Dominic Ninmark

70010000091393.name: Escape Game The House Under Rain
70010000091393.intro:
The classic escape game for you, staged in the friend's house under the rain.
Can you solve all the riddles and get out?
70010000091393.description:
■GAME SYSTEM
This game is an escape-the-room game (mystery-adventure game).
*Point the screen with a cursor to solve riddles, and story goes on.

■STORY
It is rainy whenever I visit one of 
my friends for some reason.

I remember the day was rainy as usual
when I visited her after her sickness.

The friend who looked better than I expected
stopped me, who was about to leave, and said...

"Why don't we do an escape game 
in this house before you go?"

It was too sudden but the suggestion sounded 
intriguing enough to say YESー

70010000091398.name: High School Love: A Visual Novel Romance
70010000091398.intro: Meet Lana in this visual novel, a shy and dreamy girl who meets Leo in the school library, a boy passionate about music, who is looking for a quiet place to play his guitar.
70010000091398.description:
Although Lana is initially uncomfortable with Leo's presence, she soon discovers that they have more in common than she thought.

As they spend more time together, the two discover a special connection, but soon Michelle, a talented singer who is interested in Leo, and Mark, a popular classmate, appear and begin to get closer to Lana.

Can Leo and Lana be happy together?

·A romantic story full of unexpected twists, emotional tension, and crucial decisions.

·Vibrant and detailed settings that immerse the player in a warm and romantic atmosphere.

·Music that accompanies each key moment of the plot, from the tender to the dramatic.

70010000091400.name: Coloring Book for Adults 2
70010000091400.intro: Color your stress away in Coloring Book for Adults 2! Dive into vibrant shades and make your mark on everything from wild creatures to famous masterpieces.
70010000091400.description:
Welcome to Coloring Book for Adults 2, where creativity meets relaxation! Dive into 17 NEW mesmerizing categories with a multitude of coloring sheets, ranging from Sea Animals, Birds, to Insects, and embrace the beauty of Mandala, Famous Paintings, and more. Whether you're coloring detailed Wild or Domestic Animals or celebrating holidays like Easter, Valentine's Day, or Christmas & New Year, you’ll find the perfect canvas to express yourself.

GAME FEATURES:

- Background music on/off
- Multiple color palettes
- My palette - create your own palette of colors
- Various shades and color nuances
- Save your masterpiece in JPG format
- My works: save your art in a private gallery
- Zoom in for detailed coloring

With Coloring Book for Adults 2, your imagination is limitless. Enjoy endless color possibilities with multiple palettes and create your own! You can even zoom in to perfect every detail while coloring different Seasons, Fictional characters, Flowers, and what not.

Ready to take a break from stress? Color your way to calmness!

70010000091405.name: Bee Simulator: The Hive
70010000091405.intro: Hive life just got bigger – dive into The Hive expansion in Bee Simulator
70010000091405.description:
See the world through the eyes of a bee! Explore a world inspired by Central Park as you gather pollen, evade threats, and build your own thriving beehive. This edition combines the original Bee Simulator with The Hive expansion, introducing new mechanics, game modes, and fresh as spring pollen content—all in one buzzing adventure, perfect for players of all ages.

EMBARK ON BIG ADVENTURES AS A LITTLE BEE
Take flight in a heartwarming single-player story where you must protect your hive from looming danger. As one of the swarm’s most diligent workers, your tiny wings will carry the fate of your entire colony.

EXPLORE A VIBRANT, WORLD-FAMOUS PARK
Fly around and explore every nook and cranny of a vast, semi-open world map inspired by New York’s famous Central Park. From ponds to picnic grounds, funfairs to the zoo, you’ll uncover secrets, mini-games, and resources throughout. Find people, animals, plants, and other insects to interact with along the way. 

BUILD YOUR OWN SPRAWLING HIVE
The Hive expansion lets you build and customize your very own beehive from the ground up. Optimize your resource-gathering to collect what you need to create a buzzing home. Use a variety of practical and decorative buildings to bring your hive to life.

MINI-GAMES GALORE
Being a bee means non-stop activity! Race through jet streams, collect pollen, perform bee dances, defend your colony from wasps, and tackle various challenges in an exciting mix of exploration and action-packed gameplay.

SPLIT SCREEN COOP
Team up with a friend or family member in two player split-screen co-op.  Play through custom-designed multiplayer maps with both cooperative and competitive game modes—fun for everyone, young and old!

A VIBRANT AND PEACEFUL SOUNDTRACK
Soar through the world with a peaceful and immersive soundtrack that captures the calmness of nature.

70010000091410.name: Bangman
70010000091410.description:
Bangman — a perfect example of what a pixel-art roguelike should be. The game gives you everything you love: hordes of monsters, tons of unique characters, countless ways to slaughter them, and many, many, many attempts to do so. Wondering what’s in short supply here? The game costs very little money! And that’s always nice.
Now, since this text has bored not only you but also the person writing it, go watch the trailer—and please buy the game!

70010000091416.name: Sky of Destruction
70010000091416.intro: A top-down shooter with explosions and total destruction awaits you!
70010000091416.description:
Sky of Destruction is a top-down shooter. Combine aircrafts in your combat fleet, which will help you during the mission. Your goal is to destroy the enemy aircraft carrier or buildings, breaking through the enemy air armada. Explosions and total destruction await you!

Before starting a mission, select a combination of three types of aircraft in your fleet, which will help you during the mission. Your goal is to destroy the enemy aircraft carrier or buildings, breaking through the enemy air armada. If your plane was hit, it’s not the end of the game, the extermination of the enemy will not stop. Just keep your aircraft carrier safe.

Upgrade your aircraft's many parameters with a large selection of items that you will receive upon successful completion of missions. Each aircraft has its own inventory of an individual shape, so place items as efficiently as possible.

Enjoy the juicy explosions of enemy buildings and their physical destruction!

70010000091426.name: Arcade Archives CRAZY BALLOON
70010000091426.intro: A thrilling balloon ride that’s not just hot air!
70010000091426.description:
"CRAZY BALLOON" is an action game released by TAITO in 1980.
Guide a swaying balloon through a thorny maze and attempt to reach the goal while avoiding traps such as moving thorns, scrolling mazes and more.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000091436.name: Heist Simulator 2025
70010000091436.intro: Plan, steal, escape – live the adrenaline of a perfect heist!
70010000091436.description:
Enter the thrilling world of “Heist Simulator 2025, ” where your dreams of flawlessly executed heists come to life. Embark on an action-packed journey as a skilled thief, turning your ambitions into reality. Plan your moves with precision, equip yourself with state-of-the-art tools, and hone your skills to rise as the ultimate mastermind of heists.
- Plan your heists: Carefully choose the necessary tools and craft a flawless strategy to ensure every detail goes according to plan. Identify the best approaches to overcome obstacles and maximize your chances of success at every stage of the mission.
- Stealth and Evasion: Outsmart the relentless law enforcement by leveraging your agility, creativity, and cunning. Use every opportunity to slip past their grasp and make a clean getaway with your loot.
- Progressive Difficulty: As you progress in the game, it adapts to offer you an increasingly challenging experience. Objectives become more complex, enemies become smarter and more dangerous, and rewards become more valuable.
- Skill and Equipment Upgrades: Unlock and personalize a wide range of skills and gear, such as advanced lockpicks, high-tech hacking devices, and stealth enhancements.

    Can you outsmart the system and become a legend in the world of heists? The stakes are high, and only the smartest and most calculated will succeed.

70010000091441.name: Call of Warzone
70010000091441.intro: Fight with strategy, dominate the battlefield, claim your victory.
70010000091441.description:
Engage in high-intensity combat, strategize with your squad, and outsmart your opponents in the ultimate test of tactical warfare.

In “Call of Warzone”, you’ll dive into fast-paced, team-based skirmishes where every decision counts. As part of a 5-person squad, your mission is to deplete the enemy’s score before they take yours down in a battle for dominance. With 1000 points on the line, the stakes are higher than ever.

Key Features:

– Team-Based Strategy: Command your team through intense combat, using smart tactics to outmaneuver the opposition.

– Score-Based Combat: Every kill impacts the score—eliminate the enemy and protect your team’s points to secure victory.

– Varied Combat Zones: Face off in five unique, dynamic environments, each offering different challenges and opportunities for strategy.

– Weapon Variety: Choose from over 20 different weapons, from rifles to explosives, and tailor your loadout to fit your playstyle.

Get ready to prove your worth in “Call of Warzone”, where skill, strategy, and teamwork determine who stands tall in the warzone. A thrilling solo-player experience that combines strategic action and immersive gameplay. 

Will you rise to the challenge and lead your squad to victory?

70010000091446.name: Truck Mechanic Sim 2025
70010000091446.intro: Repair, Profit – Become the Ultimate Truck Mechanic!
70010000091446.description:
Enter the world of truck restoration with Truck Mechanic Sim 2025! This is not your typical simulation game—it's an opportunity to transform worn-out trucks into valuable assets while building a successful business from the ground up. Every choice matters as you manage budgets, perfect your repairs, and strike deals to rise to the top of the truck mechanic industry.

Key Features:

 - Realistic Truck Reselling: Begin your journey by purchasing rundown trucks using your in-game computer. Carefully assess their condition and plan your budget for repairs and upgrades.


 - Hands-On Repairs: Replace parts, paint, and upgrade components with intuitive mechanics. Parts automatically snap into place when positioned correctly, streamlining the restoration process.


 - Three Distinct Zones:

    - Office: Browse and order trucks or parts.
    - Workshop: Repair, paint, and upgrade vehicles to increase their value.
    - Presentation Room: Showcase your completed trucks and negotiate sales with AI buyers.


 - Strategic Gameplay: Balance your investments and earnings as you manage your resources effectively. Aim to maximize profits with every sale.


 - Immersive Environment: Experience the detailed workshop setup with realistic mechanics and interactions.


Take on the challenge of transforming old trucks into profitable masterpieces. Whether you’re strategizing budgets or rolling up your sleeves in the workshop, Truck Mechanic Sim 2025 offers a deeply engaging simulation experience. Download now and start building your legacy as the ultimate truck mechanic entrepreneur!

70010000091451.name: Card Collector Trading Shop
70010000091451.description:
Play the role of a collector who has become a business owner. Open a card market and become rich. Build, manage and develop your own collectible card store where you can trade, collect and battle with the rarest and most valuable cards from the legendary Beast Lords series of unique and powerful creatures!

Run your own collectible card business:
Stock your store with booster packs and individual cards, arrange them neatly on the shelves and set competitive prices to attract customers. As your business grows, you'll need to find a balance between time to sell cards and expanding your collection.

Collect and play:
You can not only sell cards, but also collect them in your personal album. Unlock rare cards and create powerful decks to participate in exciting card battles. Whether you're opening packs to uncover hidden treasures or facing off against opponents, the excitement of the game is always at your fingertips.

Design and Develop:
Create the perfect store environment by improving and decorating your space. Attract more customers with eye-catching displays and keep them coming back with a well-stocked assortment of Beast Lords cards. Will you focus on sales, or chase the rarest cards for yourself?

Features:
- Stock your store with collectible collectible cards.
- Sell, trade or collect cards from the popular Beast Lords series.
- Customize and expand your store as your business grows.
- Take part in exciting card battles to prove your skills.

70010000091453.name: Ghoulie’s Garden
70010000091453.intro: Welcome to Ghoulie’s Garden, where Halloween magic awaits!
70010000091453.description:
Welcome to Ghoulie’s Garden, where Halloween magic awaits! Guide Ghoulie, a friendly little zombie, through haunted mazes filled with pumpkins to collect. But beware—this garden is crawling with ghosts, bats, and colorful clowns eager to make things tricky!
Your mission is simple: help Ghoulie gather every pumpkin while avoiding playful monsters at every turn. With each maze, the challenges grow trickier, adding twists and turns to keep players engaged. Perfect for young adventurers, Ghoulie’s Garden combines charming visuals and Halloween-themed fun in a delightful maze experience. Can you help Ghoulie complete the ultimate pumpkin quest?

70010000091458.name: The Golden Eagle
70010000091458.description:
Embark on a thrilling, action-packed adventure in The Golden Eagle, a roguelike experience where danger lurks around every corner. In this unforgiving world, you'll face off against terrifying ogres and navigate treacherous landscapes filled with deadly traps—all in pursuit of the legendary Golden Eagle and its ancient power.

Your journey will take you through fixed, meticulously crafted levels filled with ruthless enemies, including brutal Barbarian ogres, bloodthirsty Berserkers, heavily armored Knights, and deadly Archers. Each enemy requires a unique strategy to defeat, making every encounter a thrilling test of skill and courage. Equip yourself with a Sword, a devastating Axe, or a sturdy Shield to battle your way through these fierce foes.

The dangers are not just from enemies, but from the environment itself. Deadly water hazards will trap the unwary, while razor-sharp pendulums, nailing boards, spiked pits, moving saws, and turning blades will challenge your every move. Every step could lead to a brutal demise, but perseverance is the key to success. Each death brings valuable lessons and a chance to come back stronger, making each run an opportunity to grow.

The path to the Golden Eagle is treacherous, but those who can survive the ogres and master the deadly traps will claim the incredible power that lies within the relic. Are you brave enough to face the ultimate challenge? The Golden Eagle awaits... if you dare to conquer its trials!

70010000091465.name: There's No Monsters
70010000091465.intro: Have you checked under the bed? Or in the closet? We guarantee there's no monsters there!
70010000091465.description:
There's No Monsters is a hidden object game with a selection of 9 locations and random monsters to find for each of them.

-  9 Different Levels
 - 3 Difficulty Settings
 - replayable with 20 monsters out of 60 selected for each play
 - hint system
 - zoom

70010000091470.name: Puzzle Adventures - Forest Animals
70010000091470.intro: Easy to use puzzles for ages two and up. Featuring funny and cute animal motifs with 30 unique puzzles. 100% frustration free and child-safe.
70010000091470.description:
Welcome to the world of puzzle adventures! Today we're going on a journey to the animals of the forest!

This drag-and-drop puzzle game is extremely easy to use and has been designed with the utmost care for children of all ages.

The different levels of difficulty provide age-appropriate entertainment for all children.

70010000091472.name: The Little Gnomes: The Secret of the Magical Forest
70010000091472.intro: In this visual novel, a magical forest where every creature and plant is connected by an ancient power called the Heart of the Forest begins to crumble.
70010000091472.description:
Eryk, a young man who possesses the rare ability to hear the whispers of the forest, discovers that this imbalance has a deeper cause.

Together with his loyal companions Lyra, a brave warrior, and Nimbus, an agile and clever bird, he embarks on a journey to restore the Heart and save his home.

70010000091474.name: Little Animals: The Wild Race
70010000091474.intro: Interactive graphic novel that tells the exciting adventures of three adorable animal friends who participate in a daring race through the jungle.
70010000091474.description:
Join Ricky, Lia, and Tito on this amazing race filled with adventure, laughter, and learning, and discover that true victory isn't always crossing the finish line first, but doing so alongside those who matter most to you!

·Kid- and family-friendly reading.

·Accessible text and narrative for young readers.

·Dynamic, colorful wildlife-inspired images.

·Ambient music recreating the sounds of the jungle.

·Lessons about teamwork, respect for nature, and self-improvement.

·Accessibility options like text adjustment, volume, and image transitions.

·Educational fun with content that promotes positive values.

70010000091476.name: Marron's Day
70010000091476.intro: Save the town festival in Marron's Day, a fun pocket-sized adventure where you're a bunny!
70010000091476.description:
Play as Marron, a young bunny, and help the cute animal friends in town so that they'll sign up for stalls at the town festival! Enjoy the cosy and retro pixel art graphics as you explore the town.

Features:
- A charming town to explore and adorable animal friends to help
- Cosy minigames to go with a heartwarming story!
- Cute pixel art and beepy chiptune music
- Authentic retro gameplay

70010000091481.name: Escape Game The Nostalgic Cafe
70010000091481.intro:
The classic escape game for you, staged in the nostalgic cafe.
Can you solve all the riddles and get out?
70010000091481.description:
■GAME SYSTEM
This game is an escape-the-room game (mystery-adventure game).
*Point the screen with a cursor to solve riddles, and story goes on.

■STORY
A news comes in.
It says the old cafe in my town is closing down soon.

I never miss visiting there
when I come back to the town.

This place has been my favorite since my childhood.

The best part is its hall, which presents a nostalgic 
impression that is reminiscent of the past eras.

As I get to a table, I found myself in the uncomfortable silence.

Seems the door is locked tightly.

I'm trapped. Need to get out…

70010000091483.name: Gunso's Skateboard Run
70010000091483.intro:
Skateboard × Turtle = Exciting Run Game!
Dash at full speed to meet Koyuki-chan!
Collect coins and activate Fever Dash!
70010000091483.description:
Join Gunso, the skateboarding turtle, in a high-speed running game!
Chase after his beloved Koyuki-chan while jumping and guarding against obstacles!
Shake the controller to speed up and activate Fever Mode for an ultra-fast dash!
The more points you score, the more adorable photos of Gunso and friends you unlock!

Simple yet deep! Enjoy this addictive skateboard action game!

This should work well for an international audience! Let me know if you want any adjustments.

70010000091489.name: BACKROOMS INSIDE THE ESCAPE
70010000091489.description:
Venture through a labyrinth of seemingly endless, creepily familiar corridors based on popular Creepypasta lore. Experience the terror with high-quality graphics that bring the eerie environment to life, and envelop yourself in a soundscape of detailed 3D audio that enhances every haunting whisper and distant footstep. The atmosphere is thick with dread, filled with puzzles that challenge the mind and screamers that test your resolve, ensuring a pulse-pounding journey into the unknown.

High-Quality Graphics – Immerse yourself in an environment where every detail is crafted to enhance the horror.
Detailed 3D Audio – Every sound is designed to amplify the suspense and immerse you deeper into the game.
Creepy Atmosphere – The constant, oppressive dread is carefully maintained to keep you on edge.
Challenging Puzzles – Test your wits with intricate puzzles that integrate seamlessly into the narrative.
Effective Screamers – Prepare for heart-stopping moments that are sure to keep the adrenaline pumping.

70010000091498.name: Little Fairy Dress Up
70010000091498.intro: Create magical looks for your fairies with enchanted clothes, dreamy hairstyles and sparkly accessories. Explore and let your imagination run wild!
70010000091498.description:
Are you ready to create the most magical styles? Design unique outfits that will make your fairies sparkle more than ever. Explore a wide selection of dresses, dreamy hairstyles and sparkling accessories to match in original ways - let your imagination run wild and become the most creative stylist in the fairy kingdom!

Featured Features:

-Endless combinations: design magical looks by combining clothes, hairstyles and accessories - the possibilities are endless!
-Photo mode: Save your favourite looks with photo mode and share them with your friends.
-For all levels: ideal for fashion lovers and beginner dreamers.
-Magical customisation: change hair colour and style and add enchanted accessories to make every look unique.

Don't wait any longer! Start designing the most fantastic and magical styles right now and dazzle with your creativity.

70010000091502.name: Hentai Uni 3
70010000091502.intro: You will meet 12 enchanting beauties studying at a magical university.
70010000091502.description: In this game, you’ll meet 12 enchanting beauties studying at a magical academy. Find your way to each of their hearts in this captivating puzzle adventure!

70010000091504.name: Hook: Complete Edition
70010000091504.intro: Unwind and challenge your mind with Hook
70010000091504.description:
Experience the ultimate relaxing puzzle game collection with Hook: Complete Edition, featuring both Hook 1 and Hook 2 in one package.

Hook – A minimalist puzzle game where your goal is to remove all hooks from the board using intuitive mechanics. No timers, no scores—just pure, stress-free gameplay complemented by a calming ambient soundtrack.

Hook 2 – Expands the challenge into an extra dimension, introducing new mechanics while maintaining the same meditative experience. No text, no distractions—just immersive, minimalist puzzles.

Key Features:
- Minimalist & relaxing gameplay
- No ads, no scores, no time limits
- Dark Mode & Cloud Saves
- A soothing ambient soundtrack
- Made by a solo developer
- Unwind and challenge your mind with Hook: Complete Edition—a pure, simple, and satisfying puzzle experience. Are you ready to unhook?

70010000091509.name: Subway Sprint Girl
70010000091509.intro: Embark on the Ultimate Running Adventure!
70010000091509.description:
Dash through vibrant low-poly worlds in Subway Sprint Girl, a fast-paced endless runner with stunning visuals and intuitive controls, perfect for players of all ages.

Key Features:
- Race through 5 unique environments, from neon cities to sunny beaches and mystical forests.
- Unlock stylish outfits and accessories to customize your character.
- Complete daily challenges and earn rewards for your achievements.
- Collect coins, power-ups, and groove to an energetic soundtrack.

Equip jetpacks, magnets, and shields to enhance your run, mastering wall-running, rail-grinding, and precision jumps. Will you unleash your potential or just admire the scenery while face-planting into walls? The choice is yours—time to sprint!

70010000091514.name: Ruffy and the Riverside
70010000091514.description: In Ruffy and the Riverside, you wield the magic SWAP to Copy & Paste textures - turn ice into lava or waterfalls into vines! Explore, fight, skate on straw bales, and unleash your imagination in this quirky open-world action game. Dive into an adventure that lets you literally change the world!

70010000091517.name: Rebus Rush
70010000091517.intro: Rebus Rush is an exciting educational puzzle game where players solve word based puzzles by interpreting images. Levels presents a series of visual clues that represent an English word.
70010000091517.description:
Rebus Rush: A Fun and Engaging Puzzle Game

Rebus Rush is an exciting and challenging puzzle game where players solve word-based puzzles by interpreting images. The game presents a series of visual clues that represent an English word or phrase. Players must use their creativity and logic to figure out the correct word or phrase from the images. As the game progresses, the puzzles become more difficult, requiring players to think outside the box and solve increasingly complex rebuses.

The game is perfect for anyone looking to improve their English vocabulary and problem-solving skills. Each puzzle helps players associate words with images, making it a great way to learn new words in a fun and interactive way. Whether you're a language learner or simply someone who enjoys a good challenge, Rebus Rush provides an entertaining and educational experience.

One of the highlights of Rebus Rush is its variety of levels and difficulty settings. The early levels feature simpler puzzles, but as you advance, the challenges become more intricate and require deeper thinking. The game also features a time limit for each puzzle, adding a sense of urgency and excitement as you race to find the solution.

With its vibrant visuals, engaging gameplay, and educational value, Rebus Rush is a perfect blend of fun and learning. Whether you’re looking to test your mental agility or expand your vocabulary, this game will keep you entertained for hours.
Unleash your mind, solve the puzzle, expand your vocabulary, and discover the word!

70010000091522.name: Hood Story: Kaito Yamazaki
70010000091522.intro: Explore the thrilling life of "Kaito Yamazaki"
70010000091522.description:
Immerse yourself in "Hood Story: Kaito Yamazaki," a captivating gaming experience that blends Beat em Up, RPG, and life simulation in a vast open world full of possibilities. Explore the bustling streets of Nishinari-ku in Osaka and dive into a ruthless gang war between young delinquents from two rival neighborhoods. Take on the role of Kaito Yamazaki, a young adult from the underprivileged neighborhood of Kamagasaki, and forge your own destiny as you journey through a universe filled with side quests, mini-games, and branching dialogues.

Experience the immersive atmosphere of this game with a real-time dynamic weather system and richly detailed environments. You will have the opportunity to interact with each passerby, each with their own unique identity and character. The open world is enhanced with random events, adding unpredictability and authenticity. Your choices shape the story, leading to various outcomes, deeply enriching your immersion in this captivating world. Additionally, almost every interior can be visited and serves a purpose, further expanding the depth and realism of your experience.

Don't miss out on "Hood Story: Kaito Yamazaki," a thrilling urban adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat through varied gameplay mechanics such as combat, role-playing, exploration, and much more. Get ready to dive into a world where your choices matter and every decision can change the course of your story.

70010000091525.name: Cats and Seek : Dino Park
70010000091525.intro: Take a stroll to the Dino Park – among the dinosaurs, there’s a lot of cats!
70010000091525.description:
A trip to the Dino Park may sound awesome…
…and it is…
…but what if that trip was also full of cats to find and pet?
If you have a penchant for seeking cats… the Dino Park would be thankful for your help with spotting them all! ^^

Game features:
- 500 cats to find (and little extra details, too!)
- A bunch of special cats to collect!
- Five levels, dense with friendly-looking, handmade drawings!
- Three adorable music tracks to make your game nice and cosy!
- Adjustable game colours, brightness, and contrast!

70010000091531.name: Pixel Game Maker Series Rocket Frog
70010000091531.intro:
Charge... keep charging... and then jump!
Make inertia your friend and fly!
But not actually, as you might go too far and fall!
70010000091531.description:
■Story

One day, Chester the frog was looking at the newspaper.
There was usually nothing interesting in the news.
But there was nothing interesting in Chester's wallet either...

Suddenly, Chester spotted an ad for a good-paying job!
Just test the [Rocket Boot Prototype] and strike it rich!

■Game Overview

Hold a button to charge up and release to jump!
Calculate your height and overcome all obstacles.
Use the momentum of the bowling ball to your advantage!

■Gameplay Features
-A challenging platformer!
-Charge the rocket boots to elevate your jumps!
-Wrestle against the weight of the magnetic bowling ball!
-Each Level gets more difficult the farther you go!
-Learn you can become a patient person by finding the patience you didn't know you had!
-Between 1 and ∞ hours of frustrating gameplay!
-Collect Infrognito Outfits!
-Collect Music CDs and Dr. Toad Tokens!
-Bonus unlockables at the end!

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.

70010000091545.name: Pixel House
70010000091545.intro: Pixel House: Where color becomes Home
70010000091545.description:
In a quiet corner of your imagination, there’s a house waiting just for you. Not just any house,  but your house. The kind with sunlit windows, a crooked chimney, or maybe a door painted the exact shade of blue you’ve always loved.

It’s a slow, peaceful escape where every stroke tells a story. Mix colors like a lazy afternoon, experiment with patterns like you’re whispering secrets to the walls, and lose yourself in the quiet joy of creation.

And when the real world feels too loud? Put on the in-game soundtrack—soft piano, rain tapping against the roof, or whatever helps you breathe a little deeper.

Main features:
• Paint houses and their elements from scratch.
• Relax with music right in the game.
• Use your imagination to create your own style.
• Share your paintings with friends.

70010000091550.name: THE POOLS
70010000091550.intro: Anomalies await you in the shadows of The Pools.
70010000091550.description:
Step into The Pools, a psychological horror experience set in the hauntingly surreal “Poolrooms.” Explore an endless maze of waterlogged halls, shimmering lights, and unsettling silence. There are no monsters—only the eerie beauty of liminal spaces, where the familiar becomes alien and the peaceful turns oppressive.

Key Features
• Dynamic Water Effects: Walking slows in water, and ripples hint at unseen forces nearby.
• Immersive Soundscapes: Distorted echoes and muffled sounds adapt to your surroundings, enhancing tension.
• Surreal Architecture: Endless corridors, submerged stairs, and shadowy corners evoke mystery and unease.
• Shifting Environments: Each chapter transforms, revealing new secrets and unsettling surprises.
• Navigation Challenges: Find your way through maze-like paths with no map or guidance.

Lose yourself in The Pools—an experience where every step pulls you deeper into the unknown. Will you uncover its mysteries or succumb to its quiet terror?

70010000091555.name: Is this Game Trying to Kill Me?
70010000091555.intro: An old shack deep in a dense forest, a strange computer and a game that's trying to kill you!
70010000091555.description:
Is this Game Trying to Kill Me? - it is a mix of horror and first-person puzzle. You are trapped inside a cabin deep in the forest, and its owner offers to play a computer game in exchange for freedom. But the cabin and the game are much more connected than you might think. Traps from the game begin to appear in reality, and your actions in the cabin affect the computer game. And very soon you realize that the stake in this game is your life!

Features:
- Play the game while you're playing the game!
- A mix of horror and first-person puzzle-solving
- An old cabin deep in the forest, hiding secrets
- Multiple endings and numerous ways to die

70010000091570.name: Bambas!
70010000091570.intro: Relive your childhood and turn every crosswalk, curb, and puddle into an epic adventure with this urban walking simulator.
70010000091570.description:
Remember when the streets were your playground, where every curb, puddle, or sidewalk became part of an epic mission? Bambas! brings that magic back, offering a sandbox game that lets you relive those carefree adventures with its innovative control system. 

Explore a vibrant Mediterranean coastal city bursting with detail, where creativity knows no bounds and exploration is your ticket to endless fun. Use the controller’s sticks and triggers to move each sneaker independently, mimicking the motion of your own feet. Walking forward isn’t enough—navigate crosswalks, kick cans, balance on curbs, and pull off impossible jumps as you tackle hundreds of challenges and unlock a treasure trove of customisable sneakers. 

Bambas! isn’t just a game—it’s a celebration of urban culture. Break stereotypes with its non-linear narrative and environmental storytelling, where every corner hides tales waiting to be uncovered. Discover hidden spots packed with secrets and meet characters who’ll take you on unexpected journeys. Lace up and step up—because in this game, every stride is an adventure of its own.

70010000091572.name: An Aisling
70010000091572.intro: An Aisling is an adventure game focused on exploration, story, and character. Make friends or enemies as you try to uncover why people are dissappearing on the island of Rashinmore.
70010000091572.description:
Siobhan awakens from a dream at the highest point of the island Rashinmore. Rashinmore was once a quiet and warm community, games were played and friends were made. Nothing bad would ever happen here, but things change. In the last week a disappearance has left people lost and devastated. Everyone wants answers, but the ones in charge don't seem to have a clue. If they're not going to lift a finger to find out whats going on, who will...? 

Things feel different when the sun goes down... is there something hiding in the dark?

Key Features:

- Run, jump, talk or even punch your way through the island as you uncover the mystery on Rashinmore. 

- Choose to make friends or enemies with a colourful cast of characters and creatures. 

- Paint pictures, catch creatures, conduct choirs, run races and see stars.

- Original art and soundtrack.

- Not one but two dogs! There's maybe even a secret third...

70010000091574.name: Street Food Restaurant Owner
70010000091574.intro: Street food can be great! Prove it.
70010000091574.description:
You don't need Mishelin Star to create the best restaurant in the world. Who says street food can't be delicious?  

Open a real street food restaurant in your city and make it a legend. It's all for your beloved customers and let everyone come and find something tasty. Make this place trendy and watch your business grow!  

Take on the role of a street food entrepreneur and master the art of food preparation, customer service and efficient management. From sourcing fresh ingredients to designing workflows. You'll need strategic planning and quick decision-making to grow your business and keep your customers happy.

Street Food Restaurant Owner is a cooking game that puts you in charge of a street food cafe. Cook delicious meals, serve hungry customers, and manage your ingredients wisely to avoid waste. 

Your reputation is everything - manage your food stall, serve delicious meals and impress customers to build your brand. Every satisfied customer boosts your reputation and unlocks upgrades and new recipes. But beware - one mistake can ruin your reputation. 

Check out this fun new game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Let them taste and fall in love with your delicious street food!

70010000091579.name: District: Evolution
70010000091579.intro: Nintendo Switch™ Exclusive! Enjoy immersive battles with Ultra HD visuals! Stunning effects, weapon sounds, and team play create a captivating FPS experience!
