70010000091579.description:
With hyper-realistic environments and character modeling, along with intricate lighting effects, you'll feel like you're actually on the battlefield. Join the resistance group District to fight against the powerful CrispBio Corporation, using three characters - Assault, Support and Sniper - each with unique weapon characteristics for strategic gameplay and to showcase your exceptional combat skills in battles against enemies.

・Experience the thrill of combat on a battlefield rendered in lifelike ultra-high-definition graphics.
・A realistic gun recoil and ballistics system, powered by a sophisticated physics engine, conveys the true weight of combat.
・The distinctive sound of each weapon adds to the excitement of battle.
・Different missions are prepared for different game modes.
・In Deathmatch mode, experience the exhilaration of victory through intense battles against opponents.
・In Capture Mode, strategically seize battlefields to secure advantageous positions.
・In Demolition Mode, plant and defend explosives as you carry out tense operations.
・Maximize weapon control with precise aiming and tilting systems, and experience the thrill of victory through teamwork!

In a reality filled with heart-pounding military combat and tension, you are the protagonist destined to become a hero on the battlefield by completing special missions. Enjoy the ultimate team-based single-player FPS game [District: Evolution], where cutting-edge graphics meet heavy FPS action!

Synopsis
In 2055, advances in biotechnology are transforming human life. Many diseases are cured, and environmental issues are revolutionized. One day, however, a bioterrorist attack plunges the world into chaos. At this time, a powerful corporation called CrispBio begins to control most of the world's resources and biotechnology. They create a new type of soldier, enhanced with cybernetic technology, called NovaNell, which is used to suppress public will and maintain order. 
NovaNell is feared and respected by the public, but a resistance movement that believes CrispBio's power is excessive is growing stronger. Led by a charismatic leader, the resistance group District vows to overthrow CrispBio and restore freedom to the people. As the resistance grows, CrispBio responds with increasing brutality. They unleash their most powerful NovaNell units, including a terrifying cyborg known as Neutron. The resistance group District must fight desperately to survive CrispBio's tyranny and protect the people.

70010000091584.name: Once Upon A KATAMARI
70010000091584.description:
Once upon a time a katamari rolled through both past and present.
 
In this story across time, the adage endures: Let The Good Times Roll!

Now onward through new worlds to roll up thy heart's desires and to restore the stars!
 
• A Shiny New Katamari Damacy Adventure Awaits
Experience new stages and a fabulous new soundtrack! Behold a fresh rolling experience, with never-before-seen support tools like the magnet to draw in nearby objects! How...attractive!
 
• Roll Through the Ages
The King was so well-behaved until he mistakenly crushed the Earth, the Moon, and numerous planets while fiddling with a peculiar scroll. Now roll your katamari through the Jurassic Era, Ice Age, historic Japan, and more eras to rebuild the sky's dazzling field of stars.
 
• Keep the Family Close With Cousin Customization
Play as The Prince, or choose among his 68 cousins and kin to play as. Customize their colors and faces to create as many original Cousin designs as there are stars in the sky.
 
• Compete in Celestial 4-Player KatamariBall
Conquer the game of KatamariBall, the galactic sport of choice across the Cosmos! Compete online against cousins around the world, or hone your skills with scintillating offline play against CPU opponents.
 
*The King of All Sounds Edition is also available. Be careful of duplicate purchases.

70010000091589.name:
Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?
~Fullland of Water and Light~
70010000091589.intro: A story tracing the hero's trials and truth now unfolds...
70010000091589.description:
One fateful day, without any warning, the labyrinthine city of Orario was transformed.
In the sunken Orario, Bell and his group follow the trail of the characters as dictated in the heroic tale.
What they find there are an abundance of thoughts and feelings not depicted in "Fullland of Water and Light".

A story tracing the hero's trials and truth now unfolds...

Control Bell Cranel or Ais Wallenstein in this side-scrolling RPG, defeating monsters and advancing through stages to complete the story!

70010000091593.name: Sixtar Gate: STARGAZER
70010000091593.description:
The spotlight shines once again on Sixtar Gate, introducing STARGAZER, a vibrant blend of rhythm action and engaging storytelling!

Adventure Mode
Step into the shoes of the Captain (the protagonist) as you team up with the free-spirited guitarist Dorimi (voiced by Eunjo Lee / Kanako Nomura). Together, uncover a brand-new story set in the Sixtar Gate universe.

Immersive Rhythm Gameplay
- 4-Lane System: Perfect for rhythm game newcomers, this intuitive layout ensures a smooth and satisfying experience.
- Voltage Overdrive System: Rack up combo chains to supercharge your score and achieve record-breaking performances.

Massive Song Library
Enjoy over 40 original tracks reimagined in band style, featuring beloved Sixtar Gate songs and new favorites. Stay tuned for free and paid DLC updates, promising fresh content and challenges to keep the beat alive.

Earn, Unlock, Play
Collect in-game currency, Volts, through gameplay and unlock new tracks to expand your playlist.

Features
- Over 40 tracks with additional DLC updates planned.
- Unique Voltage Overdrive system for high-scoring combos.
- Intuitive 4-lane rhythm mechanics tailored for accessibility and fun.
- Engaging Adventure Mode with a heartfelt story.

Let the rhythm guide you as you embark on the ultimate musical adventure in Sixtar Gate: STARGAZER!

70010000091598.name: Golf Loop
70010000091598.intro: Golf Loop: The Perfect Blend of Simplicity and Fun
70010000091598.description:
Dive into the relaxing yet challenging world of Golf Loop! With its gorgeous minimalist design and addictive gameplay, this game brings the joy of golf to your fingertips. Whether you're a seasoned pro or just looking for a fun way to pass the time, Golf Loop offers endless entertainment for everyone.

Aim, shoot, and sink the ball into the hole with the fewest strokes possible. It's easy to pick up but tricky to master!
Navigate through beautiful, serene landscapes with simple and intuitive controls.

70010000091603.name: Retro Santa Run
70010000091603.intro: Ready to slide into the fun?
70010000091603.description:
Get ready for a nostalgic holiday adventure with Santa Run Retro! Join Santa as he dashes, slides, and glides through a retro-style snowy wonderland, collecting gifts for kids around the globe. Maneuver through zig-zagging paths, dodge obstacles, and enjoy the charm of a pixelated winter forest filled with surprises, hidden bonuses, and magical power-ups to enhance your journey.

Whether it’s Christmas or not, Santa Run Retro is the ultimate celebration of timeless fun, packed with exciting challenges and vibrant worlds to explore. Perfect for gamers of all ages, it’s time to relive the holiday spirit with a retro twist.

70010000091608.name: Dragon Knights Chronicle
70010000091608.intro: Nintendo Switch™ Exclusive! Alliance of the Demon Lord's daughter, vampires, elves and knights! Epic Fantasy Strategy RPG where bonds matter!
70010000091608.description:
Embark on an epic adventure where unique heroes unfold a genuine Epic Fantasy Strategy RPG world! Characters vividly brought to life through delicate and beautiful illustrations! From Tieris, the Demon Lord's daughter, to an elf who has lived for 300 years, and a knight who rose from assassin to nobility, over 300 heroes and monsters with dramatic backstories await you on the continent of Lorain. In combat, a sophisticated SRPG system that considers terrain, weather, and character affinities will challenge your strategic thinking. The intricate tactics deployed through turn-based grid combat and the spectacular skill performances created by each character's unique special abilities deliver fresh excitement with every battle. Dynamic combat animations and cinematic cutscenes demonstrate the value of a complete masterpiece that transcends simple strategy gaming.

・Intricate tactical combat through turn-based grid battles!
・Unique special abilities and cinematic cutscenes for every character!
・Deep strategic gameplay considering terrain, weather, and unit affinities!
・Diverse classes including vampires, assassins, knights, and mages!
・Infinite possibilities with new strategic combinations every battle!
・Over 100 varied missions and stages!
・Political conflicts among seven kingdoms and complex character relationships!
・The journey of the 12th Crusade to save a chaotic era!
・Endless exploration and discovery!
・Continuous character growth and collection rewards!

Experience profound strategic gameplay and the joy of collecting unique characters throughout this vast adventure. For gamers seeking deep strategic RPGs, those who wish to appreciate beautiful character illustrations, and anyone wanting to immerse themselves in moving storylines, Dragon Knights Chronicle offers an extraordinary fantasy journey.

Prologue
Darkness began to spread across the once-peaceful continent of Lorain. In the north, the ancient dragon Ramol awakened, leading chaotic legions southward, while Berend Forest grew increasingly poisoned by the Great King Slime's toxins. Each kingdom and city regarded one another with suspicion, waging conflicts over timber harvesting rights, plunging the entire continent into turmoil. In the middle of this desperate situation, Ian Randolph, the ambitious young mayor of the free city of Anor, mustered his armies with grand designs, while Vampire Duke Carsus broke his 300-year silence to weave new conspiracies.

In this desperate crisis, the Crusade was formed, and remarkable heroes gathered. Elan, hero of the Crusian War, returned from retirement, while Tieris, the Demon Lord's daughter, set aside succession disputes to save the world. Eline, an elf who had lived 300 years; Vanphon, who rose from assassin to nobleman; Sespides, who became a vampire from near-death and began anew, along with the loyal knight commander who became a vampire trying to save her. The mysterious dancer Lina, who turned to vigilante work after completing her revenge; the innocent girl Raphe, who joined to earn magic school tuition fees. Hundreds of brave heroes, each with their own dramatic tales, united under one banner.

Now begins the grand adventure of these distinctive Dragon Knights. An unprecedented alliance has formed, bringing together vampires and elves, humans and demons. They must overcome their painful pasts to become true companions, purifying corrupted forests, resolving conflicts, and standing against the forces of chaos. When the assassin's cold precision combines with the gladiator's indomitable spirit, the mage's wisdom with the dancer's elegant swordplay, what miracles might unfold? Can these heroes, bound by diverse abilities and deep friendship, restore peace to the continent of Lorain? The curtain rises now on this grand epic tale woven by heroes of unprecedented diversity and charm.

70010000091613.name: Aquarun
70010000091613.intro: Master the Dash, Defy the Impossible!
70010000091613.description:
Dive into the vibrant world of AquaRun, a fast-paced 2D pixel art platformer that tests your reflexes, precision, and determination! Inspired by the best of hardcore platforming games, AquaRun challenges you to guide a fragile yet determined character through 40 meticulously designed levels filled with relentless obstacles, devious traps, and tricky platforms.

Your mission? Reach the mystical cloud at the end of each stage to unlock new adventures, unravel secrets, and prove your mastery of the game's mechanics.

Main Features
-Precision-Based Gameplay: Navigate tight jumps, razor-sharp hazards, and intricate platforming challenges that demand pinpoint accuracy.
-Dash Mechanic: Strategically time your dashes to clear gaps, avoid traps, and reach otherwise inaccessible areas.
-Progressive Difficulty: Start with easier stages to learn the mechanics, then face a steady ramp-up in challenge as you conquer 40 levels of increasing intensity.
-Pixel Art Aesthetics: Immerse yourself in a vibrant, hand-crafted 2D pixel art world with a dynamic atmosphere and charming animations.
-Instant Respawn: Enjoy seamless retries to maintain the flow of gameplay and keep frustration at bay.
-Hardcore Platforming Excellence: Perfect for players who crave precision, challenge, and a rewarding sense of accomplishment.

Each level is a test of your skill, perseverance, and adaptability. Only the most determined will reach the final cloud and unveil the ultimate reward. Can you rise to the challenge?

70010000091618.name: Sokocrab
70010000091618.intro: Solve puzzles as a crab, pushing barrels on a beach in 40 fun levels!
70010000091618.description:
SokoCrab is a delightful puzzle game where you control a clever crab tasked with pushing barrels onto spots to unlock the path to the next level. Combining classic puzzle-style mechanics with a charming beach theme, SokoCrab challenges players to think thoroughly and plan their moves carefully to overcome increasingly complex puzzles.

Positioning is the key to success in SokoCrab. Since the crab can only push barrels, you must anticipate every step to avoid getting stuck. Each level introduces new challenges, from tight spaces to multiple barrels and buttons, testing your spatial reasoning and problem-solving skills.

The gameplay is simple yet highly engaging, offering a relaxing but rewarding experience. With each level you conquer, you’ll feel a sense of accomplishment as you navigate through the puzzles.

SokoCrab is perfect for fans of logic puzzles and strategy games, offering a blend of charm, challenge, and fun. Are you ready to step onto the beach and help the crab complete its journey?

- Exciting 40 levels to enjoy
- Unlock achievements as you play
- A pixel-art game with a fun theme

70010000091623.name: Mimi the Cat: Meow Together
70010000091623.intro: 50 meow cute puzzle levels with co-op!
70010000091623.description:
Mimi the Cat: Meow Together is the cutest puzzle adventure you'll ever play! Get ready for a purr-fect mix of strategy, laughs, and irresistible feline charm. Whether you're flying solo or teaming up with a friend in local co-op, your goal is simple (but oh-so-challenging): help Mimi and her fluffy friends solve puzzles and find their cozy beds.

Why You’ll Love Mimi
Two Ways to Play
Tackle puzzles solo like a puzzle master or grab a friend for some co-op fun where teamwork makes the dream work!

Super-Fun Mechanics
Push boxes, stack stuff, jump between platforms, and get creative with environmental objects to solve tricky puzzles. Think of it as “kitty detective” mode!

Packed with Purr-sonality

50 handcrafted levels to challenge your brain and warm your heart.
9 adorable kittens, including Mimi and her lovable squad.
18 unique outfits to dress up your cats in style (pirate cat? chef cat? Yes, please!).
Relax and Enjoy
With a simple interface, quick level restarts, and a soothing soundtrack, this game is all about fun without the stress. No timers, no resources to manage—just you, Mimi, and loads of good vibes.

Mimi the Cat: Meow Together is the ultimate feel-good game, packed with charm, clever puzzles, and enough cuteness to make anyone say “Meoww!”

70010000091631.name: Treflix: Mini Games
70010000091631.intro: Cute and sweet games for everyone!
70010000091631.description:
5 cozy mini games that will take you to the charming world of Treflix. Try your hand at:
- Memory
- Connect the dots
- Puzzle
-Find the difference

The adorable Treflix will show you their world and you'll have a great time with them!

70010000091641.name: Hill Climb on a Motorcycle
70010000091641.intro: Compete and have fun. Burn rubber and get ready for fun!
70010000091641.description:
Exciting racing gameplay
- Train to improve your skills
- Fun guaranteed
- Simple and intuitive motorcycle controls

Hill Climb on a Motorcycle is a physics-based gravity game about motorcycle racing and motorbikes. Epic motorcycle racing on mountains like in Hill Climb and Happy Wheels.

A realistic motorcycle control simulator in which you need to ride a bike to the finish line and not fall into the abyss, and also not flip over. In the garage, you can upgrade your motorcycles!

Amazing features
- Hundreds of crazy tracks and crazy worlds
- Cool tricks
- Amazing bike upgrades
- Don't miss free updates with lots of new content

Start practicing right now to become a professional motorcycle racer. It will be exciting, we guarantee fun, learn to feel the bike at your fingertips!

70010000091651.name: Croc Legend of the Gobbos
70010000091651.intro: Croc’s back and he’s still got the moves!
70010000091651.description:
Croc Legend of the Gobbos is the heartwarming journey of an endearing, humble little crocodile equipped with only his iconic backpack and a wiggly butt as he platforms his way across a series of unique worlds by running, jumping, climbing, swimming and tail 
spinning on his quest to rescue his adopted family of Gobbos from the grasp of the evil sorcerer Baron Dante and his impish Dantini hordes.

With its broad appeal and groundbreaking creativity, the original game quickly became a multi-million selling platforming classic, and while the Croc Legend of the Gobbos remaster delivers an authentic gameplay experience that transports players back to the golden age of gaming, it also introduces a roster of modern updates including 
enhanced HD graphics, modern control mechanics with an updated camera, and retro video modes to recreate the gaming experience that charmed us in the 1990s.

Dive into a beautifully recreated world filled with vibrant colors, captivating landscapes, and playful challenges which will ignite your imagination. The Croc Legend of the Gobbos remaster offers an authentic blend of nostalgia and modern gameplay, ensuring a gaming experience that pays homage to the original while inviting a new generation to discover its timeless magic.

The game features 45 levels packed with enemies and bosses, spread across 5 different worlds including volcanoes, ice glaciers, underwater caves and even more...

The Crocipedia

With the cooperation of many of the original team members, Argonaut Games spent over a year tracking down a treasure trove of long-lost development materials in order to create a painstakingly curated digital museum featuring concept character and level 
designs, animation tests, game design documents, rare promotional merchandise, pre-release mixes of the iconic Croc soundtrack, and also created a series of documentary interviews with many of the contributors to Croc’s development. The Crocipedia is the perfect way for superfans and game historians alike to take a deep dive into the creative process behind the game and uncover the stories that helped shape Croc's journey to become a gaming Legend.

70010000091653.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Danyang-gun
70010000091653.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage! You can enjoy the actual beautiful natural scenery in high definition
70010000091653.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone.
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. You can also fly while changing the drone's flight mode among three at any time.

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Danyang-gun, Korea with "real" footage!
This work takes place in Danyang-gun, Wonju-si, and Chungjuho.
There are a total of 9 flight courses.
1080P high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game.
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot.
Large capacity! You can fly to 9 locations showing the beautiful scenery of Danyang-gun, Wonju-si, and Chungjuho!
Two play modes are supported: course-specific driving mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system.
Visit Danyang-gun, Korea from home at any time!
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000091663.name: X-MAS Bubble Mania
70010000091663.description:
Get into the holiday spirit with Xmas Bubbles — a cozy and cheerful game perfect for the festive season! Match colorful bubbles, clear sparkling boards, and enjoy relaxing, themed stages filled with lights, snow and holiday charm.

With simple controls, smooth gameplay, and dozens of joyful levels, Xmas Bubbles is a perfect pick for players of all ages. Sit back, relax, and let the winter magic pop!

Features:

Dozens of relaxing levels

Christmas visuals full of charm

Easy to pick up, perfect for all ages

Ideal for a short break or a cozy evening

Bring some holiday magic!

70010000091668.name: Blackbeard's Treasure
70010000091668.intro:
Toss coins and rule the high seas!
Golden riches slumber on the treasure islands that await you!
70010000091668.description:
Knock down coins one after another and obtain the pirate's treasure.
Head for the treasure islands and defeat the enemies that stand in your way!
All the riches shall be yours!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 family members or friends can join in!

[Score Attack]
Compete to earn as many coins as possible within the time limit and aim for a high spot on the leaderboards!
Play solo or multiplayer!

[Endless]
Play for as long as you like without a time limit!
The coins you've earned will persist between tries!

[Ranking]
Earn a rank for both Score Attack and Endless modes!
Compete against players worldwide!

[Online]
Score Attack is also available in Online Mode!
Work together, and the treasure will be yours!

Play together with up to 4 players!
Alone or together, aim for your next high score!

70010000091673.name: COSMIC FANTASY3
70010000091673.intro: A new and beautiful legend of the galactic heroes - the story of the protagonist Yu's father and mother
70010000091673.description:
The story takes place before the first game and tells the story of the father and mother of the series' protagonist, Yu.
This sequel is positioned as episode 0, revealing the roots of cosmic fantasy.
Not only Yu's father and mother appear, but Yu himself also appears and they defeat the enemy together.
How do father, mother and son appear, how do they meet, and how do they part ways...
The third game in the series, the midpoint of the five titles, is a commemorative title that can be said to be the origin of cosmimic fantasy.

■ Improved graphics and visual scenes with plenty of voice acting
The visual scenes, which became the origin of game movies, were a big topic at the time for their beautiful graphics.
With the release of SUPER CD-ROM² and the increased capacity, the improved visual scenes further liven up dramatic scenes such as human drama.

70010000091677.name: COSMIC FANTASY4 Prelude to Legend
70010000091677.intro: Cosmic Saga Finale! Prologue - The protagonists from the first film, Yu and Saya, save the planet from crisis as the Algernon team.
70010000091677.description:
The prologue to the series' final chapter. Yu, the protagonist, and Saya, the heroine from the first game, are asked to rescue Princess Saria of Kazarin, who has been kidnapped.

However, this kidnapping turns into a major incident that will shake the entire galaxy...

In this game, the adventure unfolds with Yu, Saya, and the "Algernon Team" of monsters at the center.

New to this game is an adventure part, which adds depth to the puzzle solving.

In battle, you can enjoy strategy with a new system of action parameters that allow you to attack more powerfully by accumulating a gauge.

The prologue to the final chapter, which is more powerful than ever with the highest quality in the series, has begun, with visual scenes that liven up the epic story that spans the "first and second parts"!

70010000091681.name: COSMIC FANTASY4 Van's Return
70010000091681.intro:
The touching epilogue is finally revealed...
The Cosmic Team is united!
70010000091681.description:
While Yu and the Algernon team are busy on Planet Kazarin, Van and the Little Fox team are on patrol without being assigned a specific mission and rescue a small spaceship.
There they find Annie, the magician who helped Van bring peace back to Planet Idea...
The group rushes to the scene after learning that Planet Idea is once again in danger.

In this work, the Little Fox team of Van, Rim, and Pick play the leading roles in the story. At the end, the Algernon team also assembles, bringing the final chapter to a close!

70010000091690.name: Dragons vs. Balloons TD
70010000091690.intro: Defend your kingdom with powerful dragons and crush waves of balloons
70010000091690.description:
Dragons vs. Balloons TD - Game Description

Prepare yourself for an epic battle in Dragons vs. Balloons TD, where strategy, power, and mythical beasts meet in an exciting tower defense showdown! Take control of a legion of powerful dragons as you defend your territory from waves of mischievous and dangerous balloons.

### Explore Diverse Maps and Challenges
Embark on a journey across 5 uniquely designed maps, each containing over 10 challenging levels. From lush green valleys to treacherous volcanic landscapes, each map offers its own challenges and surprises. As you progress, you’ll face increasingly difficult balloon waves that require tactical thinking and adaptation.

### Command a Diverse Army of Dragons
Unlock and command a variety of 20 unique dragons, each possessing their own strengths, abilities, and elemental powers. Whether it’s the blazing Fire Dragon, the chilling Ice Dragon, or the electrifying Thunder Dragon, your army is fully equipped to burst every balloon that dares to invade. Each dragon can be strategically placed, upgraded, and enhanced to dominate the battlefield.

### Upgrade and Strengthen Your Defenses
The balloons are relentless, but so are your dragons. Upgrade your dragons' attack speed, range, and power to ensure that no balloon gets through. Balance your resources wisely to maximize your defenses and create the perfect dragon army.

### Defeat Powerful Balloon Enemies
The challenge intensifies as you encounter 10 different types of balloon enemies, each with unique abilities and resistance traits. From speedy camo balloons to tough armored ones, only the right combination of dragons and upgrades will let you overcome them all. Know your enemy, strategize accordingly, and watch as your dragons unleash their fury.

### Speed Up the Action
Want to challenge yourself and test your strategies faster? Speed up the gameplay to watch your dragons battle in real time at lightning speed. Adapt quickly, think fast, and see if your defenses can withstand the faster-paced onslaught.

### Key Features:
- 5 Unique Maps: Each with over 10 exciting levels that increase in difficulty.
- 20 Different Dragons: Choose, place, and upgrade your dragons to build the ultimate defense.
- 10 Types of Balloons: Each with its own special powers and defenses to challenge your strategy.
- Dragon Upgrades: Enhance attack speed, range, and power to optimize your defenses.
- Fast-Paced Battles: Speed up the game to test your skills and enjoy the chaos.

Dragons vs. Balloons TD offers a thrilling combination of strategic placement, quick upgrades, and epic battles that will keep you on your toes. Are you ready to command your dragon army and burst every last balloon? The skies await your defense!

70010000091695.name: Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile
70010000091695.intro: Solve a mystery as Poirot in ’70s Egypt
70010000091695.description:
In Death on the Nile, a peaceful cruise on the Nile is disrupted by a terrible crime. Thankfully, famous detective Hercule Poirot is onboard. 
Meanwhile, a private detective is tracking a murderer, leading her from London to Majorca, New York, and finally to Egypt. 
The two investigations collide at Abu Simbel. The dynamic duo will solve a complex case full of twists and turns. 
But the story doesn’t end with the book, and it still holds many mysteries and twists, even for Agatha Christie fans.

FEATURES
Dual Protagonists: Play as both Hercule Poirot and Jane Royce, each with unique perspectives and storylines that converge in an epic finale.

Innovative Setting: Immerse yourself in this story set in the 1970s, a decade of significant social change. From feminist movements and the rise of minority rights to the liberation of societal norms, this vibrant era blends disco clubs, bell-bottoms, and psychedelia, where colorful characters bring a captivating plot to life.

Extended Storyline: Dive into a brand-new investigation that continues after the events of the book, ensuring fresh surprises for fans and newcomers alike.

Diverse Locations: Explore a variety of stunning locations, from the exotic Nile cruise to the bustling cities of Majorca, London, and Cairo.

Enhanced Mindmap: Collect and connect facts in a dynamic mindmap to make deductions and advance the story.

Confrontation System: Use gathered evidence to confront suspects, expose lies, and uncover hidden truths.

Character Profiles: Complete character profiles by gathering information through dialogues and observations.

70010000091700.name: BEAST: Bio Exo Arena Suit Team
70010000091700.intro: JUMP INTO THE BEAST, SWITCH BETWEEN YOUR POWERFUL MECHA AND AGILE PET, AND DOMINATE THE BATTLEFIELD IN THIS FAST-PACED HERO SHOOTER !
70010000091700.description:
Discover the new hit game from the developers of FRAG Pro Shooter!

BEAST is a high-energy Hero Shooter delivering quick, action-packed battles. Switch seamlessly between your powerful MECHA and agile PET as you explore an epic story mode or dive into intense multiplayer matches. Choose from a wide variety of heroes and engage in explosive, strategic combat – perfect for players seeking a fast, accessible, and thrilling challenge!

- Uncover the heroes' stories in an all-new story mode. Embark on thrilling missions, explore stunning planets, meet unforgettable characters, and immerse yourself in a captivating narrative that brings the world of BEAST to life!

- Engage in a thrilling 3v3 multiplayer hero shooter where each match delivers quick and intense action with powerful Mechas! Choose your favorite character and dive into quick, action-packed games that offer easy, pick-up-and-play fun. BEAST offers a light-hearted, laid-back experience open to anyone, boasting quick matches full of excitement!

- Experience a dynamic dual gameplay system. Switch seamlessly between your powerful MECHA for brute strength and your agile PET for nimble tactics, each offering unique skills that bring versatility and depth to every match! Seamless transitions and sharp strategy will turn the tide in your favor!

- Choose from a roster of unique heroes, each with their own special abilities and playstyles. Whether you prefer heavy firepower, quick strikes, or strategic defense, there’s a hero that fits your gameplay and adds a new dimension to every battle!

- Skill matters most, not your wallet! With no microtransactions, BEAST guarantees a fair and balanced playing field for your progression where your abilities and achievements drive your success. It’s all about your skills, strategy, and teamwork!

70010000091705.name: "Run for Money": Hunter VS Runner! Which Side Will You Win With!?
70010000091705.intro:
The super popular "Run for Money" game is coming to Nintendo Switch™ !
Experience your very own "Run for Money"!!
70010000091705.description:
The hit Japanese game show “Run for Money” is coming to Nintendo Switch™!
The game retains the show’s signature runner mechanics, and for the first time in the series, this edition  introduces the all-new “Hunter Mode”!
Not only can you play as a runner escaping from hunters, you can also become a hunter and capture the runners!
This edition features five original stages: “Wonderland,” “Airport,” “Harbor,” “Fantasy,” and “Diver City.”Just like in the TV show, runners will face a variety of missions during each stage!
Clear all the mission and aim to make a successful escape!!

This latest edition also brings enhanced multiplayer features!
All 5 original stages are available for local and online multiplayer matches!
In online battles, the new "Hunter VS Runaway Mode" lets up to 12 players (4 Hunters, 8 Runaways) face off!
Let's all have a blast playing Run for Money!

"This version of the game was originally released for Nintendo Switch™.
While it can also be played on Nintendo Switch™ 2, please note that a separate version—“Run for Money: Hunter vs. Runner!
Which side will you win!?""—is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch™ 2."
Save data and additional content from previous versions are not compatible with this version.
Be sure to avoid accidental or duplicate purchases.
Additionally, this title does not offer a Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition or an upgrade pass.

70010000091710.name: Boomerang of Destruction
70010000091710.intro: Try one of the oldest weapons in the world.
70010000091710.description:
Learn to use the boomerang - one of the best and most unique weapons available. Feel the awesome experience and use it for your victories! 

Throw the boomerang at your enemies, trying to choose the best trajectory and speed to cause the most damage. You will see just how dangerous this weapon can be.      

Complete all the levels with this wonderful tool of war and become the most skilled boomerang warrior in the world. Just throw it again and again. It will return to its master each time.  

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Feel the way our ancestors fought!

70010000091715.name: Snails vs Humans
70010000091715.intro: Let the battle between snails and humans begin!
70010000091715.description:
Have you ever wondered how terrifying snails are? They stalk their prey slowly but mercilessly. You can't hide from them. They'll find you anywhere. Even years from now. 

Eat these little people and grow. Grow and eat more. They're just your food. No pity. They are a slow instrument of death!  

Or would you like to try your hand at being a human and attacking these evil slugs? At first you will have to escape, but gradually you will be able to attack these monsters and clear the levels. Everything in this world is unpredictable. Pick a side in this eternal conflict and win!      

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Choose your side in this epic confrontation!

70010000091720.name: Jump Race
70010000091720.intro: Jump high. Run fast. Win the race!
70010000091720.description:
There are different types of races and now you can try a completely new and unusual sport. Jump on the trampolines and bounce higher and higher! 

Choose the exact moment to land and the steepest springboard to jump as high as possible and find out what is hidden behind the clouds.  

Each course has several levels, and the higher you can climb, the more valuable and interesting the prizes will be! 

Win all the races, collect all the bonuses and unlock all the funky skins for your hero. Have fun with crazy jumps and heights you can reach.    

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Take part in the funniest race ever!

70010000091725.name: Star Leaping Story
70010000091725.intro: Fully voiced! Featuring stellar performances by Fairouz Ai, Yu Shimamura, Yusuke Kobayashi, Mai Goto! Enjoy this vibrant and exciting story!
70010000091725.description:
Unique Dash System: No jumping mechanics—instead, experience a unique dash system that makes gameplay more fun and challenging.

No Penalty System: Mistakes don’t matter! Retry as many times as you like without interruption, keeping the game’s rhythm smooth and engaging.

Fully Voiced by Professional Voice Actors: Enjoy full voice acting throughout the game for a more immersive experience.

Carefully Designed Levels: A variety of environments and mechanics keep the gameplay fresh and exciting.

Dynamic Music: Energetic music enhances the atmosphere and keeps the excitement going.

70010000091730.name: Wind Story
70010000091730.intro:
Pixel style simulation management RPG game
Experience farming, animal husbandry, fishing
Establish an amusement park and bring pets to fight pirates
70010000091730.description:
"Wind Story" is a pixel style simulation RPG game. Upon arriving at Wind Chime Ranch, players can immerse themselves in rural lifestyles, including farming, breeding, and fishing. During the day, they can freely roam the Ranch's flower fields, while at night, they can enjoy drinking and dancing by the lakeside bonfire. Players can attract more visitors to the ranch, gradually building their own accommodations, windmills, power houses, and restaurants. They can cultivate a variety of vegetables, flowers, and fruits, and raise diverse animals. Furthermore, they can install various amusement facilities on the ranch to earn more money and create their own recreational oasis.

The game offers extensive freedom; players can cultivate different crops, care for adorable animals, gather mushrooms and various flowers, fish, and mine. They can collect materials, prepare delectable meals, and interact with characters throughout the ranch. To draw more visitors to the ranch, players can progressively construct windmills, power houses, ranch accommodations, restaurants, hospitals, and amusement parks. These facilities, along with the diverse attractions within, transform the ranch into a resort paradise.

You can also freely explore the world, capture or cultivate your pets, and let them participate in the construction of the ranch. You can also bring your pets to fight against monsters outside and maintain the safety of the ranch. Build the ranch into a world you love.

70010000091735.name: Into the Restless Ruins
70010000091735.intro: A roguelike deckbuilder where you create the dungeon you fight through.
70010000091735.description:
Use your deck of cards, representing rooms and corridors, to grow the labyrinth of the ruins. Then auto-battle your way through them, harvesting as much Glimour as you can from the cursed residents before darkness overcomes your torch. 

Earn favours from the Harvest Maiden, find Relics to trade with the Hen Wife, Wulver and other characters from Scottish folk lore to upgrade and curate your deck, and hope you are strong enough to face The Warden when you can finally reach it. 

Features 
• Dynamic Deck and Dungeon Building: Create your dungeon as you play, using a variety of cards to place rooms, corridors, and more. Modify your deck by earning the Maiden’s favour or interacting with characters within the ruins.
• Strategic Room Synergies: Place rooms like campfires, libraries, and portals strategically to unlock powerful effects and adapt your approach to every challenge.
• Endless Replayability: Each run offers a new dungeon layout, fresh challenges, and evolving strategies. Unlock rule-changing modifiers, discover hidden echoes, and expand your card pool with every victory.
• Rooted in Scottish Folklore: Explore a world inspired by Celtic legends, from witches and faeries to the eerie Maiden and her connection to the Harvests, with the option to immerse yourself in the experience by playing in Scottish Gaelic.
• Evolving Challenges: Confront new dangers with every attempt, from procedurally generated ruins to powerful enemies and artifacts that redefine your strategy.
• Unlock Hidden Treasures: Discover rare charms, weapons, and lore fragments to shape your journey and uncover the secrets of the Restless Ruins.

70010000091743.name: Desktop GOLF
70010000091743.intro:
Play on colorful courses made of stationery!
Enjoy a refreshing game of golf right on your desk!
70010000091743.description:
Relive the nostalgia of your school desk in this golf game for Nintendo Switch™!

[Play]
Strategize to conquer your favorite courses with a variety of settings!
Play with 9 or 18 holes and compete for high scores on the online leaderboards!

[Friendly Match]
Play with up to 4 people!
Engage in serious showdowns with stroke play or match play!

[Edit]
Freely arrange and design your own original course!
Create a unique 18-hole course all your own!

[Gacha]
Use your points to obtain new clubs!
Find your ultimate favorite!

[Minigame]
Hit the ball and aim for big points!
Earn points based on where the ball lands!

70010000091748.name: Make it! Donut
70010000091748.intro:
Get ready for a delicious donut-making challenge!
Make as many as you can and watch your food cart prosper!
70010000091748.description:
Let's make donuts on the Nintendo Switch™!
Fry up donuts in a variety of shapes and add the toppings your customers crave!
An expert donut maker always leaves their customers satisfied!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Make donuts with the shapes and toppings that your customers request!
Keep a close eye on the donuts and don't let them fry too long!
Make as many donuts as you can within the time limit!

《How to Play》
1. Add donuts to the fryer!

2. Flip them over when one side is cooked!

3. When both sides are fully fried, add toppings and serve it up!

[Score Attack]
Race against the clock to fill customer orders, reach a new personal best score, and compete with others on the global leaderboard!

[Battle]
Test your donut-making skills in a battle with up to 4 players!
Speed and accuracy are the keys to victory!

70010000091754.name: Mechanita
70010000091754.intro: Puzzle your way through a steampunk world of precision platforming and roving robots!
70010000091754.description:
Get ready for a steampunk-themed adventure in Mechanita, a side-scrolling platformer packed with brainteasing pixel art stages! Take control of a goggled heroine as she carefully navigates 50 unique levels of gradually increasing complexity.

Run, jump and shoot with precision as you try to reach the airship at the far end of each stage. Avoid spike traps and roving enemies, hop on prop-driven lifts, use your blaster to stun robotic foes and jump on their heads to reach greater heights! Will you master this wonderfully mechanized world or fall victim to its clockwork creations?

• Guide a young heroine in a steampunk adventure across 50 pixel art stages!
• Run, jump and shoot with precision to reach the airship and escape.
• Use your blaster to freeze enemies in place or drop them from the sky!
• Reach greater heights by riding propeller lifts or hopping on stunned enemies.
• Avoid traps and dangerous gadgetry!
• Retry stages as many times as it takes or go back to play cleared levels to improve your skills!

70010000091759.name: Zombie Police: Christmas Dancing with Police Zombies
70010000091759.intro: Team up with the most unusual crime-fighting duo as a rookie detective and his zombie partner break all the rules to solve impossible cases!
70010000091759.description:
When rookie detective Tamura finally achieves his dream job, he discovers his new senior partner is experienced, brilliant - and literally a zombie! Together, this mismatched pair tackles cases no one else can solve.

Features:
- A Buddy Cop Adventure with a Supernatural Twist!
Combine the zombie detective's unique investigative abilities with the rookie's sharp deduction skills to crack each case. Watch as the earnest but awkward Detective Tamura works alongside his free-spirited undead mentor in this unconventional partnership!

- Mystery with a Side of Humor!
Enjoy both serious detective work and hilarious character interactions! This mystery adventure delivers laughs, surprises, and edge-of-your-seat suspense.

- Gather Evidence, Make Deductions, Catch Culprits!
Analyze clues and testimonies to unravel each mystery. Your choices affect case outcomes, with multiple endings to discover!

- Perfect Weekend Game!
Complete in 5-8 hours - ideal for busy gamers looking for a well-paced adventure.

- Zombie Content Without the Horror!
No scary or grotesque elements - just charming, comedic characters and engaging storytelling.

- Beginner-Friendly Detective Work!
Struggling with a puzzle? Use the "Reflect Before Deduction" feature for guidance, or skip to the solution if you're truly stuck.

70010000091770.name: Storm Lancers
70010000091770.description:
You and your friend just crash-landed on an alien planet harboring a secret source of powerful magic. All of reality is on the verge of collapse, and two magical creatures have chosen you as their heroes. To save the planet, you’ll fight, die, and bond with the Stormhearts to rise again — stronger, fiercer, and unstoppable.  

Designed for couch co-op, Storm Lancers is a fast-paced rogue-like, where every run means dodging death, overcoming enemies, and mastering powerful skills. The battle is on, so team up for survival. 

GAME FEATURES

ANIME ACTION
On Cryptica, no two runs are the same. In this side-scrolling rogue-like, you'll navigate shifting biomes where every leap, slash, and dash brings you one step closer to unraveling the mystery. With each playthrough, discover new items that make that run’s playstyle unique and gain permanent upgrades that make you stronger.  

SEAMLESS COUCH CO-OP 
Rogue-like action, specifically built for two. Explore Cyptica’s alien world and prepare for battle, side by side with a friend, using your combined abilities, weapons, and powerups. If your partner has to leave, no worries. Storm Lancers lets you seamlessly switch from co-op to solo, so you stay in the action.  

BOSSES & ENEMIES
From a machine race that consumes planets to alien flora and fauna that want to kill everything, fight through bosses and enemies who will force you to think faster, fight harder, and adapt quickly. This is an ever-changing battlefield where killer instincts and survival skills are everything.  

WEAPONS & ABILITIES 
Arm yourself with a variety of weapons built for every kind of playstyle and run. From flaming swords and razor-sharp Katars to rifles, crushing hammers, and grenade launchers, each weapon is designed for destruction. Choose wisely — or die quickly.

70010000091777.name: Yandere Anime Girlfriend: The Mean Waifu Sim
70010000091777.intro: Face a defense game like no other, where you must protect your heart from a siege full of seduction and danger.
70010000091777.description:
In this unique experience, your mission is not only to defend yourself from the relentless attacks of your obsessive yandere but also to resist her seductive temptations.

Each encounter will test not only your strategic skills but also the strength of your willpower!

Get ready for a challenge that blends tension, strategy, and dangerous charm:

-Defend yourself from your yandere’s attacks: Use your wit and reflexes to survive her attempts to capture you.
-Resist her charms: Keep control of your mind and heart as she tries to seduce you with her overwhelming presence.
-Unlock new images: Each level cleared reveals a more intense, enigmatic, and seductive side of your yandere.
-Strategy and resilience: Use special abilities and upgrades to stay one step ahead of her obsession.
-Increasing difficulty: With each level, your yandere's attacks and temptations become harder to resist.
-The final challenge: Hold out until the last encounter and prove you won't fall under her spell!

Do you have the strength to face her obsessive love and survive unscathed?

Discover it and dive into a game where defense has never been so exciting... or so dangerous!

70010000091782.name: Yandere Anime Boyfriend: A Day with Your Husbando Sim
70010000091782.intro: Face a defense game like no other, where you must protect your heart from a siege full of seduction and danger.
70010000091782.description:
In this unique experience, your mission will not only be to protect yourself from the relentless attacks of your obsessive yandere but also to resist his seductive temptations.

Each encounter will test not only your strategic skills but also the strength of your willpower!

Prepare for a challenge that blends tension, strategy, and dangerous charm:

-Defend yourself from your yandere’s attacks: Use your wits and reflexes to survive his attempts to capture you.
-Resist his charms: Keep control of your mind and heart as he tries to seduce you with his overwhelming presence.
-Unlock new images: Each level cleared reveals a more intense, enigmatic, and seductive side of your yandere.
-Strategy and resilience: Use special abilities and upgrades to stay one step ahead of his obsession.
-Increasing difficulty: With each level, your yandere’s attacks and temptations will become harder to resist.
-The final challenge: Hold out until the last confrontation and prove you won’t fall under his spell!

Do you have the strength to face his obsessive love and survive unscathed?

Discover it and dive into a game where defense has never been so exciting... nor so dangerous!

70010000091789.name: Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM
70010000091789.intro: See what the bodycam saw. Survive what it didn’t.
70010000091789.description:
Face pure terror in an endless maze where reality twists and death is always near. Escape the Backrooms: BODYCAM blends tactical bodycam shooting with intense psychological horror.

As an operator on a mission gone wrong, you’re trapped in the shifting Backrooms—and survival depends on your reflexes, choices, and nerve.

Key Features:
	•	Hyper-Realistic Bodycam View: Immersive visuals with screen shake, authentic motion, and eerie sound design.
	•	Lethal  Enemies: Armed, aggressive, and unpredictable enemies—every fight could be your last.
	•	Evolving Levels: The deeper you go, the more distorted and dangerous the world becomes.
	•	Survival Strategy: Scavenge, fight, or run—every action counts.
	•	Camcorder Mechanics: Record clues, track changes, and uncover the hidden truth.
	•	Dynamic Quest System: Solve cryptic quests to uncover hidden clues, weapons, and essential tools for survival. Each task brings you closer to the truth—but may also unleash unexpected dangers.

Escape the Backrooms: BODYCAM delivers brutal realism, escalating dread, and one goal: survive.

70010000091794.name: Cats Visiting Lunar New Year
70010000091794.intro: Celebrate Chinese New Year! Find 100 hidden cats in 5 festive drawings and collect all 12 zodiac animals.
70010000091794.description:
Welcome to Cats Visiting Lunar New Year, a festive and charming hidden object game celebrating the Chinese New Year!

Explore 5 Unique Drawings
Each artwork is bursting with beautiful details and festive decorations where 100 playful cats are cleverly hidden. Can you find them all?

Celebrate the Zodiac Animals
Search for all 12 Chinese zodiac animals scattered across the 5 pictures. Complete your collection and embrace the spirit of the Lunar New Year!

Challenge Yourself with Leaderboards
Test your skills and speed as you compete for the fastest times in each level.

Immerse yourself in the magic of the Chinese New Year while discovering adorable cats and collecting zodiac animals in this relaxing and festive adventure!

70010000091799.name: Calamity Angels: Special Delivery
70010000091799.intro: First-class fun in this delivery service RPG with a board game twist!
70010000091799.description:
Lead a rag-tag group of kooky carriers in this delivery service RPG as they protect and trek packages through treacherous terrain, unruly monsters, and meet other sneaky delivery service teams ready to stake their claim as the best delivery service in the Orkotris Region!

Rain or shine—a new adventure awaits with every package! 

Key Features

In the Mood for Battle? – Running a tip-top delivery service means mailing out orders AND keeping your crew in check. Watch their moods—if they’re unhappy, they might ignore your commands, but their negligence could deliver positive surprises and even victories in battle!

Out for Delivery! – Head to the Bulletin Board and see what deliveries await! Inspect the parcel, pack it tightly (no gaps allowed!), and assemble your crew with the right gear (to bonk any pesky foes) and tools for a smooth drop-off. Each successful drop-off delivers sweet rewards your way, so handle with care!

Delivery in 3-5 Business Days (Unless you Run into a Boss) – Start your adventure with a roulette spin to determine your next move. Land on shop spaces for goodies, collect special packages for rewards, and maybe tackle some sneaky bosses along the way!

Kei Nanameda… Delivers! – From the character designer of Mary Skelter and Death end re;Quest, Kei Nanameda presents a fresh delivery service world with lively dialogue, intense battles, and a quirky cast full of energy!

70010000091800.name: Calamity Angels: Special Delivery Digital Art Book
70010000091800.intro: Check out the characters, rough art + sketches, and much more in the 52 page Digital Art Book!
70010000091800.description: Kei Nanameda provides his signature touch in Calamity Angels: Special Delivery. Check out the characters, rough art + sketches, and much more in the 52 page Digital Art Book!

70010000091801.name: Calamity Angels: Special Delivery Digital Soundtrack
70010000091801.description:
While you're en route, why not play some tunes that'll keep you focused and ready to deliver packages? The digital soundtrack includes 25 tracks!

Tracklist:
1. Perfect day for deliveries.
2. A Day in the Life of a Courier
3. Welcome!
4. So, where should we go today?
5. A Breeze and a Step
6. The First Step Toward Nature
7. A heated march
8. Leaving footprints behind
9. Inside the ruins
10. Deep inside, something is writhing...
11. The Pulse of the Earth
12. Nature bares its fangs
13. Land of the End
14. A monster has appeared!
15. Battle! The Darkness That Devours Feelings
16. A formidable foe stands in our way
17. Beyond the Dark and Light
18. The concert begins!
19. Our Everyday Life, in Our Own Colors
20. Thank you very much!
21. Chaotic Tune
22. The Courage of a Courier
23. A shadow falls
24. Blunder
25. A sense of impending turmoil

70010000091802.name: Slasher: Origins
70010000091802.description:
Slasher: Origins is a chaotic, 2.5D, auto-attack survival game with rogue-lite elements and noir-anime storytelling. Unlock powerful heroes, create builds of unique abilities, and survive the escalating inferno of Mephistopheles’ underworld. 

Noir-Anime Art Style 
Immerse yourself in a striking visual experience, combining the sharp, stylized aesthetics of anime with the dark, moody tones of film noir. Every world you enter is a vivid yet ominous landscape, brought to life with meticulous detail and a haunting atmosphere.

Choose Your Heroes
Choose from a total of 10 heroes, each with a distinct backstory, abilities, and playstyle. Start with three formidable characters and unlock more as you progress. Each hero has a unique starting weapon and abilities that evolve as you level up. 

Deep Progression System
Collect Experience and Gems during your runs to empower your heroes. Unlock new skills, weapons, and abilities with every level up, creating different builds that can withstand the onslaught of demonic forces.

Challenging Dark Worlds
Conquer eight increasingly difficult worlds, each guarded by a powerful boss. These worlds grow more perilous with each step, demanding smart build tactics and precise movement timing to survive.

Hero Customisation 
Unlock and equip new skins for your heroes, personalizing your experience as you battle the forces of darkness. Unleash powerful "Animated Ultras," cinematic finishing moves that devastate your enemies in style.

Endless Play
With procedural generated levels, countless hero builds, and an ever-increasing challenge, no two runs are the same. Dive back in to unlock new characters, worlds, and abilities, and see how far you can push your limits.

70010000091804.name: Golden Rails: Valuable Package Collector's Edition
70010000091804.intro: An exciting new adventure in the world of mail delivery!
70010000091804.description:
After being chased by bandits and losing some valuable packages, postman Philip turns to his new friends, Jack and Jill, for help in delivering all the remaining packages to their rightful owners. 
But it's not just a simple delivery task - the bandits are still on the loose and willing to do whatever it takes to get their hands on the rare and valuable packages.

- Enjoy animated 2D cutscenes
- Complete 45 levels within the time limit 
- Earn dozens of achievements 
- Plan your way to victory with simple mouse clicks 
- Deliver packages to people in 5 mini-game levels

70010000091812.name: Under the Sea: A Hidden World of Wonders
70010000091812.intro: On a vibrant underwater reef, three very different friends embark on an extraordinary adventure. Learn their story in this beautiful visual novel.
70010000091812.description:
Meet
·Mira: A curious angelfish
·Beto: A cautious hermit crab
·Lio: A playful octopus

Guided by ancient stories, they discover a hidden world full of wonder, challenges and secrets that connect the entire ocean.

As they go, they brave dangerous currents, solve intriguing puzzles and explore magical landscapes filled with glowing corals and mysterious creatures.

At every step, friendship, teamwork and bravery take them further, revealing to them the importance of harmony and balance in their underwater world.

A story that celebrates exploration, connection with nature and the value of facing the unknown together, with unforgettable lessons about caring for the ocean and the strength of unity.

70010000091814.name: The Drifter
70010000091814.description:
A murdered drifter awakens- alive again, seconds before his death. Hunted and haunted, help him untangle a mad web of conspiracy in this fast-paced point 'n click thrill-ride.

FEATURES

• A Pulp Adventure Thriller from the minds that brought you Crawl.
• An engrossing roller-coaster of a story- Drawing on King, Crichton and Carpenter, with a dash of 70s Aussie grindhouse.
• Unique twin-stick controls built ground up for both handheld and couch play!
• Bursting with raw crunchy pixel art and high-impact animation.
• Professionally voice acted, with a brooding dark-synth cinematic score.
                        
SYNOPSIS

Mick Carter's been drifting a while now- moving from job to job, never staying one place long. Jumping a box-car to his old home town, he witnesses a violent murder, is pursued by hi-tech soldiers, thrown in a reservoir and drowned.

And that's just the start of Mick's problems.

His consciousness ripped away, thrust back into his own body seconds before his death...

Framed for the killing he witnessed, tormented by his own past, and haunted by the feeling that something followed him back from the other side...

Follow Mick as he's sucked headfirst into a lunatic web of shadowy corporations, murder, and the thousand-year obsession of a madman.

GAMEPLAY

The Drifter is our take on a classic 2d point and click adventure- with the brake-lines cut. The focus is on fast-paced storytelling, with puzzle-solving being the glue that ties it together. Mick's a practical guy, and so puzzles are down-to-earth too, designed to be unobtrusive, and give an investigative feel.

We're keeping the pacing quick and lean, you'll never be wandering around lost or confused- Mick is propelled through the story at a good clip, from one situation to another, with barely a moment to catch his breath. One minute you'll be crafting a Molotov cocktail from a bottle of over-proof rum, the next interrogating a crooked neurosurgeon before swinging from a high-rise window by a fraying extension lead.

70010000091825.name: YOU Game+
70010000091825.intro:
The popular "YOU Game" is upgraded!
Let’s combine "YOU" and "YOU" to create a BIG "YOU"!!
70010000091825.description:
The "YOU Game" featured in "KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It" supports multiplayer and score rankings!

You can enjoy a quick 10 to 20-minute play session and replay as many times as you like!
Of course, you can enjoy this game even if you’re not familiar with the original game it’s based on.

The game rules are simple and easy to understand!
Let’s connect the "YOU" pieces to aim for a bigger "YOU"!
If the "YOU" pieces spill out of the box, it's game over.

To get a high score, connect "YOU" pieces of the same size efficiently.

The game modes are “One Player” and “Two Players”!
"One Player" mode lets you enjoy a solo score attack.
"Two Players" mode, players take turns dropping "YOU".

Support for score rankings has been added for each game mode.
Compete in the score rankings for both “One Player” and “Two Players”!
Compete with "YOU Game" players from all over the world for your score.

Please enjoy the enhanced “YOU Game”!

70010000091830.name: 8 YOUs+
70010000091830.intro:
You are trapped on a train that runs forever. 
Find the one different 'YOU' and escape!
70010000091830.description:
The rumored '8 YOUs' has powered up!
Now with multiplayer and score rankings, it's even more fun!

This is an enhanced version of the mini-game '8 YOUs' featured in 'KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It.'

You are trapped on a train that runs forever. 
What's worse, the train is filled with countless versions of YOU, all looking exactly like YOU... 
Pay close attention and find the one different YOU among the eight, then make your way to the last car and reach the exit!


　[Guide]
　Look closely at all 8 YOUs.
　If just 1 is different, criticize them.
　If not, go forward.
　Pass through 8 cars to get out.


The game modes include 'One Player' and 'Two Players'!
In 'One Player', you can enjoy a score attack as you try to escape on your own.
In 'Two Players', you can race alongside another player to compete for the fastest escape!

Support for score rankings has been added for each game mode.
Score rankings are now available for each stage.
Challenge '8 YOUs' players from around the world based on your scores!

You can add the successfully identified YOU to your 'Collection' with the criticize action!
There are 88 different versions of YOU. 
Aim to complete all the different versions of YOU!

There are 3 stages in total.
Under certain conditions, 2 additional stages will unlock...!

'8 YOUs+' is an enhanced version of the mini-game '8 YOUs' featured in KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It.
Please be aware that there may be some overlap in game content when purchasing both titles.

70010000091835.name: Jump YOU+
70010000091835.intro:
As a lost one, you tirelessly jump toward the top!
To return to your owner!
70010000091835.description:
The rumored 'Jump YOU' has powered up!
Now with multiplayer and score rankings, it's even more fun!

This is an enhanced version of the mini-game 'Jump YOU,' featured in 'KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It.'

The game controls are simple—just jump and move left or right. However, the distance of your jump changes depending on how long you press the jump button, so be careful!

If you slip, you may fall endlessly… Challenge yourself over and over to master it!
Of course, you can enjoy this game even if you’re not familiar with the original game it’s based on.

The game modes include 'One Player' and 'Two Players'!
In 'One Player' mode, enjoy a score attack on your own as you aim for the top.
In 'Two Players' mode, the two of you, connected by a rope, will work together to reach the top.

In 'Two Players' mode, if one of you slips, the other can pull them back up!
Team up with friends or family and climb together as a pair!

Each game mode now supports score rankings.
Compete in the score rankings in 'One Player' and 'Two Players'!
Challenge 'Jump YOU+' players from around the world based on your scores!
With every jump, the tension rises, testing your perseverance and focus!

Enjoy the powered-up 'Jump YOU' now!


'Jump YOU+' is an enhanced version of the mini-game 'Jump YOU' featured in KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It.
Please be aware that there may be some overlap in game content when purchasing both titles.

70010000091840.name: Aooni The Horror of Blueberry Onsen
70010000091840.intro:
Challenge yourself while being chased by fear! A horror puzzle action adventure!
■A completely new version of the legendary horror game
70010000091840.description:
Challenge yourself while being chased by fear! A horror puzzle action adventure!
■A completely new version of the legendary horror game "Ao Oni"!

[What is the new "blue tragedy" unfolding at the abandoned hot spring?]

The once-popular hot spring inn known for its "beauty-enhancing hot spring" is now a ruin.
There was a rumor that it was haunted.
Hiroshi, Takeshi, Mika, and Takuro visit the abandoned hot spring inn to record “Mika Channel” and encounter a “suspicious man” and “Ai” there...
What is the Blueberry Hot Spring found in the abandoned inn, and what awaits them in its deepest depths...?
Can Hiroshi and the others escape safely?

■Many new systems have been added!
There are many new elements such as conversations with characters, cooperative play with friends, and a chat function.
In addition, many new species of blue demons appear! There is even a monster in the form of a humanoid dog...?

■The fastest game ever! 16x speed mode” has been added!
In “High Speed Mode” you can freely choose between 2x and 16x speed!
Can you escape from the "Ao Oni" chasing you at high speed?

■Online ranking function added!
Participate in online ranking by your score when you clear the game!
Play quickly and without mistakes, and aim for a high score!

70010000091845.name: Trade Em Up: TCG Empire Shop
70010000091845.intro: From booster packs to business stacks—build the ultimate card shop empire!
70010000091845.description:
Step into the world of trading cards and build the ultimate collector’s haven! As the proud owner of a TCG shop, you’ll stock shelves with the latest packs, price rare finds, and grow your store into a bustling empire. Will you focus on flipping high-value cards for profit, or create a welcoming space for dedicated players and collectors?

Expand your business by hosting tournaments, hiring the right staff, and making strategic upgrades to attract loyal customers. Every decision shapes your store’s future—buy, trade, and sell your way to the top. Whether you're a card game veteran or just love the thrill of the trade, the path to TCG greatness starts here!

70010000091850.name: Gun Shop Dealer Simulator
70010000091850.intro: Master the art of gunsmithing and business!
70010000091850.description:
Enter the thrilling world of firearms with Gun Shop Dealer Simulator! Build and manage your very own gun shop, offering a wide range of weapons, from pistols and rifles to shotguns and rare collector’s items. Attract customers of all kinds—hunters, law enforcement, and enthusiasts—while managing inventory, setting prices, and expanding your business.

Take your passion for firearms to the next level at the shooting range. Test and showcase your weapons, compete in target-shooting challenges, and prove your marksmanship skills. Whether you're firing a finely tuned sniper rifle or a customized pistol, the shooting range is your ultimate playground.

Expand and customize your shop as your reputation grows. Design impressive displays, upgrade facilities, and offer personalized weapon services to stand out from the competition. Build a thriving business while curating your own collection of valuable and historically significant firearms.

Are you ready to take aim and become the ultimate arms dealer?

70010000091855.name: Bad Parenthood
70010000091855.intro: Survive the nightmare born from your own stories.
70010000091855.description:
Bad Parenthood plunges you into a psychological horror where bedtime stories turn into waking nightmares. Play in a suburban home haunted by The Storyteller, a sinister entity born from parental warnings and childhood fears.

Key Features:
- Psychological horror rooted in family dynamics and childhood fears
- Survival gameplay with choices that shape the terror
- Environmental storytelling through eerie notes, drawings, and secrets
- Immersive audio to bring the horror to life

Bad Parenthood forces you to confront the monsters you create—can you protect your family from the fears you’ve awakened?

70010000091860.name: Zombie Dash
70010000091860.description: Zombie Dash is an intense action game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by hordes of bloodthirsty zombies. As one of the last survivors, you must navigate dark, abandoned streets, scavenge for supplies, and fight off relentless waves of the undead. With limited resources and mounting tension, every decision could mean the difference between life and death. Will you rise to the challenge and become humanity's last hope?

70010000091865.name: Stickman Odyssey
70010000091865.intro: Will you conquer the odyssey and emerge victorious?
70010000091865.description:
Embark on an epic journey with the nimble and fearless stickman in Stickman Odyssey! This fast-paced action platformer takes you through stunning, otherworldly landscapes filled with perilous traps, towering platforms, and menacing foes.

Leap, dodge, and fight your way through challenging levels, mastering precise movements and timing to survive. With its atmospheric visuals and intense gameplay, Stickman Odyssey offers a thrilling adventure for players of all skill levels.

Key Features:

- Dynamic Gameplay: Test your reflexes in fast-paced platforming action.
- Beautiful Worlds: Explore surreal environments filled with mystery and danger.
- Challenging Obstacles: Navigate through deadly traps, swinging chains, and relentless enemies.
- Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Perfect for casual gamers and hardcore platforming fans alike.

70010000091873.name: Neon Apex: Beyond the Limit
70010000091873.description:
“On this shattered Earth of 2124, nothing is as it seems, but out on the track the truth is laid bare…”

Welcome to the Neon Apex 

Open only to the most elite racers, both human and other, prove that you can handle breakneck speeds and perilous racecourses to win it all. 

Choose your Challenger 

Humanities finest have gathered to prove that a human mind behind the wheel will always be best. They’ll be up against cybernetically enhanced humans as well as AI driven androids.

Gear up 

Choose from a variety of cars and bikes and tune them up in the garage with your winnings. Find the vehicle that fits your style.

Feel the speed 

Get ready to be racing at over 200mph whilst managing your boost, dodging traffic and drifting your way to victory across multiple different modes.

Chase the glory 

Compete for the fastest time in global leaderboards and establish your legacy.

70010000091875.name: Hamster Cozy: Tears of Acorn Valley
70010000091875.intro: In the peaceful village of Acornville, an ancient legend tells of a treasure hidden by the town's first explorer, a secret that has intrigued generations.
70010000091875.description:
In this exciting and fun Visual Novel, a mysterious map appears during a stormy night in the village of some adorable little hamsters.

Lía, Tico, Roco and Pita decide to embark on an exciting adventure.

As they travel through unknown landscapes and face unexpected challenges, the young hamsters discover that each step of their journey holds lessons that will change the way they see the world and themselves.

70010000091877.name: Pyramids and Aliens: Escape Room
70010000091877.intro: Embark on an archaeological adventure inside an ancient pyramid built by aliens!
70010000091877.description:
Your former mentor has disappeared inside an ancient Egyptian pyramid. Will you be able to find him?

Pyramids and Aliens is an escape room game that will test your skills as an archaeologist. Solve puzzles, find clues, and reveal the secrets of the pyramid. Spoiler: it was not built by humans!

Will you be able to find your mentor and come back alive?

*The game's puzzles have been designed by expert escape room game creators.
*Explore both an ancient Egyptian pyramid and a strange alien temple!
*Find out what really happened with your mentor. It seems that he was able to reach an alien world somehow...

70010000091880.name: EGGCONSOLE ARCTIC PC-8801mkIISR
70010000091880.intro: Guide the colorful, roaming planets to the goal. A new type of puzzle game where you skillfully switch points on the rails for fun.
70010000091880.description:
It's like a roller coaster ride—just when you think you're having fun, you might find yourself in a game over before you know it! Vibrantly colored planets move around freely and unpredictably. Your goal is to skillfully switch the rail points and guide the planets back to their original positions to claim victory. This new-wave game has a pop-inspired vibe, making it easy to pick up and play. Can you guide the planets safely to the goal?

This title is a puzzle game released in 1988 by Artdink in Japan. Players observe planets (or metal spheres?) running along rails and switch points to direct them to their designated positions. With 30 stages in total, it offers plenty of gameplay value! While simple, this masterpiece delivers the best of action-puzzle fun.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000091888.name: Dragons Legacy : Monsters Lair
70010000091888.intro: The dragons have awakened—will you rise or fall?
70010000091888.description:
In Dragons Legacy: Monsters Lair, you become a powerful dragon, embarking on an epic quest to defeat monstrous foes and unlock the keys to new realms. As you explore vast, dangerous landscapes, you’ll face fierce monsters determined to defend the keys you need to escape. Take control of multiple dragons, each possessing unique abilities, and unleash your wrath on all who stand in your way. Soar through treacherous skies, unleash fiery attacks, and battle your way to victory in a world filled with danger, mystery, and boundless adventure.
Features:
- Savage Dragon Combat: Engage in intense melee battles, using your dragon’s claws and fangs to overpower enemies.
- Fireball Fury: Incinerate enemies from a distance with devastating fireball attacks, raining fiery destruction upon them.
- Soaring Flight: Experience the thrill of flight as you glide across treacherous terrains, dodging enemy attacks and exploring from above.
- Dragon Awakening: Hatch new dragons from eggs, each awakening with unique abilities and powers to aid you in your journey.
- Portal Mastery: Defeat formidable monsters, collect the keys they guard, and unlock portals to breathtaking new worlds brimming with challenges.
- Dragon Roster: Build a powerful collection of dragons, selecting which one to command as you unlock and hatch new eggs in each realm.

70010000091893.name: The Meownth
70010000091893.intro: Work, take care of the cat, and try not to let the house become a disaster for the next 30 days, your bike depends on it!
70010000091893.description:
Your parents are away, and you’re in charge. The challenge? Keep the cat, the house, and yourself in check for a whole month. Work to earn money, buy food and essential items and maintain order.

Pay attention to your energy, hunger, and health, both yours and the cat’s. If you manage to keep it all together, the bike is yours. If not… well, you might want to make a run for it before your parents get back home.

70010000091899.name: Ecchi Uncover
70010000091899.intro: Time to sweep some girls off their feet.
70010000091899.description:
Traverse through a field of mines to uncover beautiful girls hiding within. Tread carefully, and you might just stumble on a different pair of bombs.
Features:
- Over 84 enticing pictures of girls with or without clothes
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- Easy and difficult levels
- A treat for your eyes
Be careful, or you might get blown up.

70010000091902.name: SCP Foundation: Universe Horror
70010000091902.intro: Every door hides a terror. Will you open it?
70010000091902.description:
Dive into the terrifying world of the SCP Foundation: Universe Horror, where anomalous creatures and paranormal phenomena threaten reality itself. As a member of the secretive Foundation, your mission is to contain, study, and survive encounters with the unexplained.
Explore dark, eerie facilities filled with hostile SCP entities and unravel chilling mysteries hidden behind locked doors. Every step could be your last — because in this universe, horror lurks in every shadow.

Key Features:
	•	Authentic SCP Universe: Encounter iconic SCPs and new terrifying anomalies inspired by the SCP mythos.
	•	Immersive Horror Atmosphere: Navigate dimly lit corridors, unsettling sounds, and sudden scares that keep you on edge.
	•	Survival Mechanics: Manage resources, avoid detection, and make critical decisions that affect your survival chances.
	•	Dynamic AI Behavior: Face unpredictable SCP entities with unique attack patterns and strategies.

Step inside, but beware — not everything that’s contained wants to stay locked away.

70010000091920.name: Dino Land
70010000091920.intro: When Dino rolls into a ball he can knock down the mightiest dinosaurs!
70010000091920.description:
Everyone’s favorite dinosaur with a gentle heart in the Jurassic Era, “Dino.”
One day, indiscriminate slaughter by brutal dinosaurs has begun in a peaceful forest.

“Dino” sees his lovely girlfriend, “Meeshell” and his friends trying to escape, and decides to fight for them.
Curls up himself, transforms into a ball with hyper strong power, and attack the enemy dinosaurs!
“Dino” is taking a step into his epic adventure to bring peace back to the sky, sea and earth.

The stages are inspired by the Earth 200 million years ago.
This hierarchal action pinball game that you will explore on land, sea and sky, and attack the enemies.
Natural disaster and sudden weather change will bring you more excitement. Volcanic explosions, tectonic movements, seas filled by lava, sand storms and more…

Beautiful visual arts and impressive sounds and music is created by the famous composer, Ichiro Haneda.

Features: 
* Gallery: view images from the original game’s illustrations, posters, box design, etc. 
* Jukebox: listen to any of the game music tracks any time you want. 
* Rewind/Turbo function: repeat something until you achieve perfection, or speed things up 
* Cheats function: activate cheats that will make your mission a lot easier (infinite lives, invulnerability, etc.) 
* Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point 
* Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.) 
* This game is re-release of “Dino Land” which the first launched in 1990s for home consoles.

70010000091923.name: Kemono Teatime Design Works – Café Days
70010000091923.description:
An art book filled with the unique charm and kawaii style of Kemono Teatime.

Enjoy character design materials, concept art, worldbuilding documents, and more.

70010000091930.name: Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark
70010000091930.intro: Castle conquering action, resurrected. Your Evilness, it's time for your revenge.
70010000091930.description:
