A world of endless demonic civil war - the Demon Realm. The strongest among the demons known as "Demon Lords" battle day-and-night for control over the realm.

Kirika and Masha, maids who serve the Demon Lord Maxim, return to their castle to find it destroyed by a rival lord, Lyzenorg. As the only surviving vassals, Kirika and Masha must adventure together with their master Maxim, reduced to a shell of his former self, in order to restore him to glory.
 
Their story of revenge and revival begins here!

- Gal*Gun-vania: Now a full-realized metroidvania, uncover countless combos and possibilities as you explore the Demon Realm with your two upgradeable characters.

- Revive Your Allies: Each of Maxim’s vassals you find and revive will strengthen your home base, the Demon Lord’s castle! As you rebuild, unlock bonus features which assist you on your quest for revenge.

- Sister Power: Kirika and Masha, the two sister maid heroines, each bring their own unique gameplay styles. One attacks with demonic guns whilst the other covers close range attacks with her whip!

- Collect and Craft: Defeating enemies and discovering chests will earn you random drops of consumable items, sub-weapons, and even passive enhancements called “Demon Relics”. Use these items to unlock new special abilities needed to access new areas of the map.

- Choose your “Style”: Inheriting the “Style” system of its predecessor, you can choose to play “Casual”, “Veteran”, or “Legend” modes, available to switch between at any time with unified content across all modes.

70010000091935.name: Mechanic Supermarket Simulator
70010000091935.intro: Master the art of repairs and build a mechanical empire!
70010000091935.description:
Gearheads, buckle up! Mechanic Supermarket Simulator throws you headfirst into the exciting world of automotive retail. Here, you’ll call the shots, crafting a one-stop shop for car enthusiasts and building a thriving automotive empire.

Features:
- Build Your Dream Auto Oasis: Design your ideal car care haven. Customize the layout, stock shelves with everything from everyday maintenance supplies to high-performance upgrades, and become the ultimate inventory master – predict customer demand, keep shelves full, and avoid stockouts.
- Expand Your Automotive Empire: Start small and grow your reputation! Watch your local parts store blossom into a regional powerhouse, attracting customers with an ever-expanding selection of parts and the latest automotive technology.
- Unlock New Parts & Licenses: Stay ahead of the curve by offering the latest innovations in the industry. Secure licenses for cutting-edge parts, from hybrid engine components to autonomous vehicle systems.
- Master the Marketplace: Become a retail shark! Adapt your pricing strategies to stay competitive, respond to changing customer demands, and keep your customers happy with excellent service that caters to every need, from routine maintenance to complex repairs.

Mechanic Supermarket Simulator offers a unique blend of business simulation and car customization, putting you in the driver’s seat of your automotive retail destiny. Are you ready to build a one-stop shop that keeps every engine purring?

70010000091942.name: Anime Girls: JDM Car Passion Puzzle
70010000091942.intro: Match, tune, and cruise in style!
70010000091942.description: Step into a world where beauty, speed, and passion collide! In Anime Girls: JDM Car Passion Puzzle, you’ll solve fun and stylish puzzles to unlock sleek JDM cars and customize them to perfection. But the real thrill? The stunning anime girls who share your love for horsepower and high-speed dreams. Flirty, fun, and full of personality, they’ll cheer you on as you tune, race, and perfect your garage. Indulge in the excitement of collecting rare parts, personalizing your dream ride, and enjoying every moment with your gorgeous car-loving companions. Let the passion ignite - both on and off the road!

70010000091947.name: Hidden Cats on Christmas
70010000091947.intro: Discover the magic of winter in every hidden corner.
70010000091947.description:
Celebrate the holiday season with Hidden Cats on Christmas, a cozy and charming hidden object adventure!
Search through beautifully decorated rooms, snowy landscapes, and festive scenes to find adorable hidden cats.
Each discovery brings joy and adds to your Christmas spirit. Relax, explore, and enjoy the heartwarming art and music as you uncover every secret and every cat hidden among the winter magic.

Key Features:
•	Festive Hidden Object Gameplay – Spot hidden cats in colorful holiday scenes.
•	Beautiful Christmas Settings – Explore snowy villages, cozy rooms, and decorated streets.
•	Relaxing & Cozy – Enjoy calming music and charming visuals while playing.
•	Challenging Puzzles – Find tricky cats hidden in detailed environments.
•	Progression & Rewards – Unlock achievements and festive surprises.
•	Seasonal Fun – Experience the warmth and joy of Christmas in every scene.

Uncover every hidden cat, embrace the holiday spirit, and make this Christmas unforgettable.

70010000091952.name: 2weistein in Elfland
70010000091952.intro: Action Adventure and practicing maths basics: „2weistein“ combines lots of fun with a modern way of training maths. Often one also has to solve puzzles.
70010000091952.description:
This is the German version of "2weistein - The Lost Wood".

The Story
All was peace and quiet in Asban and the whole land of Trillion – until that day on which the gates remained closed, as if by ghostly hand, and other strange things happened. The mean magician Godron has stolen the book „Mathematica“ from the creator of Trillion, and has cast an evil spell over the city: a ban on mathematics. Godron wants to gain power over the whole land and transform the world according to his will. But there are the brave heroes Bernard and Celestine with their friend 2weistein who want to put a stop to Godron to keep Trillion peaceful and beautiful, and no one is ever to be afraid again!
 
About the 2weistein games
The unique and fantastic idea behind the series of 2weistein games is to train maths in a real 3D action adventure. Embedded in the tantalizing story the player has to solve maths quests or puzzles to get ahead in the game. It was developed by game specialists in cooperation with teachers and psychologists and won several prices and awards.
 
Features
Language: German
Puzzles and maths quests in a real game and great story
Action adventure game with maths quests
High quality 3D graphics and fully animated 3D characters
Fondly designed characters and varying 3D-animations
Atmospheric soundtrack and native speakers
6 level, playing time about 6 hours, high replay value
Playable character: Bernard
Written and spoken instructions with lots of encouragement
Tasks seamlessly integrated into the gameplay, thereby high exercise and learning effect
Choice between number range: 1-100, 100-1000, 1000-10.000
Training maths: Basic arithmetic operations
Puzzles
Helps to control impulsiveness, concentration, attention
Action planning and skill exercises
Lots of fun

„2weistein in Elfland“ is a self-contained episode from the Action Adventure  „2weistein – Das Geheimnis des roten Drachen“.

70010000091954.name: Puzzle Adventures - Sea Animals
70010000091954.intro: Easy to use puzzles for ages two and up. Featuring funny and cute animal motifs with 30 unique puzzles. 100% frustration free and child-safe.
70010000091954.description:
Welcome to the world of puzzle adventures! Today we're taking a dive to the animals of the sea!

This drag-and-drop puzzle game is extremely easy to use and has been designed with the utmost care for children of all ages.

The different levels of difficulty provide age-appropriate entertainment for all children.

70010000091961.name: Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition
70010000091961.intro: The Definitive Edition of the critically acclaimed action-adventure, now available on Nintendo Switch™ & Nintendo Switch™ 2!
70010000091961.description: The cinematic action-adventure that forced Lara Croft to grow from an inexperienced young woman into a hardened survivor has been re-built for next-gen consoles, featuring an obsessively detailed Lara and a stunningly lifelike world. Lara must endure high-octane combat, customize her weapons and gear, and overcome grueling environments to survive her first adventure and uncover the island’s deadly secret.

70010000091968.name: Cyber Quest
70010000091968.intro: A retro deck building game. Assemble a ragtag crew of hackers, mercenaries, and street-savvy rogues to take on the most feared crime gangs.
70010000091968.description:
Cyber Quest is a retro deck building game. Assemble a ragtag crew of hackers, mercenaries, and street-savvy rogues to take on the most feared crime gangs in the city. Each encounter is a high-stakes battle of wits and tactics as you pit your crew against rival factions in this intense card-based rpg.

- Collect and customize an arsenal of powerful cards. Build your deck to exploit enemy weaknesses, unleash devastating combos, and outmaneuver your foes.
- Level up your crew members, unlock new powers, and transform your team into an unstoppable force.
- Roguelike gamplay. Explore the sprawling cityscape, face randomized challenges, and adapt to new foes.
- Enhance your cards by changing their cost, damage, or color. Tailor your deck to suit your strategy.
- Groove to the finest fusion of funk and electronic music.
- Enjoying playing offline games? No connect required here. Play anywhere, anytime.

70010000091973.name: Great Again : 3D Shooter
70010000091973.intro: Fight the Zombies, Clear the Chaos, Become the Hero!
70010000091973.description: Great Again: 3D Shooter is an action-packed wave shooter where you must fight your way through zombie-infested locations in a stylized fantasy cartoon world. Play as a courageous hero armed with 9 versatile weapons, including a knife, katana, pistol, and sniper rifle, to eliminate the undead hordes. Upgrade your suit to enhance your abilities and survive the escalating challenges. Clear each area to bring hope back to humanity and become the ultimate zombie slayer in this thrilling, fast-paced adventure!

70010000091979.name: Osman Gazi
70010000091979.description:
Take charge of the army with Osman Gazi and witness the foundation of the Ottoman Empire.
Play the story of an epic heroism inspired by real people and events.
Lead your people! All comrades like alps, balas and chicks are fighting under your leadership. Smooth story missions are waiting for you with stunning console-quality 3D graphics. The breathless adventure is accompanied by professional music. Lead the Kayi Clan on different maps and fight for your Oba and principalities!

The action adventure game you've been looking for. Put on your armor, go on the attack! Defeat the rebels! Become the hero of the people and the army!

Action full of Conquest and Adventure
The most wonderful scenes you can see in the war game class are at Osman Gazi! Conquer the castles where rebels, fierce enemies roam! Put implacable enemies to the sword, draw your fate on the way from the Seljuks to the foundation of the Ottoman Empire. Defeat your opponents and achieve victory in order to grow the KAYI Oba, which is the relic of Ertuğrul Gazi. Build your state, fight for justice and righteousness. 

Customizable Character!
You can customize your character in the Osman Gazi Game. You can equip yourself with anything you want from various swords, shields, armor and bows. You can also get a pet loyal steppe wolf that will fight with you. You will be generously rewarded with gold in each mission. Save the gold you collect, spend it in the store as you wish! Cool Axes, bows and more powerful equipment are waiting for you.

With a user-friendly interface and various mechanics from each other, experience the Osman Foundation scenario in 3D. Explore your world with extensive maps and stunning landscapes. 

The control is completely in your hands!
Visit Bala Hatun in the market place and jungle, walk around the market to Malhun Hatun, or march on the enemy by taking Bamsi Bey, Turgut Alp, Konur Alp and more with the implacable valiant. Have the pleasure of controlling real Turkish heroes and directing your soldiers. Take a horse and gallop or swim to the enemy ship. Climb the flags to infiltrate the protected castles, sneak up behind them and fight with rival warriors.

Fight the Enemies of the Medieval!
Fight the real Mongol, Crusader, Byzantine, Vikings, Catalan soldiers who have existed in history. Eliminate your powerful opponents, the bloody alliances that have been formed, continue your struggle with those who seem friendly to you, disrupt the games that have been set up against you. Become a hero in a breathtaking story set in the Medieval and protect your people from brutal warriors. Survive the ambushes and move forward confidently. Set your goal, conquer Yenişehir and the castles!

70010000091981.name: Material Evidence
70010000091981.intro: Are you ready to rid the city of violent gang warfare?
70010000091981.description:
You’ll need strategy and precision to clear each level full of malicious hoodlums toting bats, knives, guns, and other arms.

Pick up the weapons of fallen enemies and use them to your advantage. Investigate a dangerous gang hideout, shut down an insidious drug-selling operation, and get your revenge against the notorious criminals responsible.

Can you take on this challenge and defeat all your enemies?


Features:
* Gritty storyline
* 3 playable characters
* Multiple enemies and weapons
* Skip level option to avoid blocking player progress
* Two difficulty modes
* 2D action combat

70010000091984.name: Notice Me Leena-senpai!
70010000091984.intro: The Demon Lord is attacking and it’s up to you to help Leena-senpai defend against devilish minions!
70010000091984.description:
Notice Me Leena-senpai! is a lighthearted tactical tower-defense game with visual novel storytelling. As war breaks out between demons and humans, defend the All-Girls School of Magic with 28 unique towers across 10 worlds. Strategically place and upgrade units in grid lanes, earn gold for power-ups, and survive endless waves!

With 2 survival modes and 5 difficulty settings, no two battles are the same. Can Leena and her friends protect their school—and her favorite food?

• Enjoy a unique blend of tower defense and visual novel.
• Deploy 28 types of towers against the Demon Lord’s oncoming forces.
• Upgrade units on-the-fly to strengthen your defenses!
• Earn gold in combat and spend it on powerful items.
• Customize your experience with 5 difficulty setting.

70010000091989.name: The Bad Parents
70010000091989.intro: A haunting tale of family, fear, and vengeance.
70010000091989.description:
The Bad Parents is a 3D psychological horror game blending family trauma with supernatural terror, told through low-resolution graphics.

A fictional character, created to teach kids obedience, turns into a sinister force tied to a tragic family secret. In a small apartment, players uncover the haunting story of a boy’s death at the hands of his abusive father and his ghostly quest to bring justice for his struggling mother.

The Bad Parents isn’t just a horror game; it’s a chilling tale of guilt and revenge, wrapped in an atmosphere of relentless fear. Will you unravel the mystery and break the cycle of darkness, or will the sins of the past consume you? Prepare for a night you’ll never forget.

70010000091994.name: Courageous Reasoning Nori 9 Reasoning Tournament Sticking Nori
70010000091994.description:
Courage and others will participate in the deduction competition.
Will they be able to emerge victorious?

70010000091996.name: Lou's Lagoon
70010000091996.description:
A Seaplane, a Storm, and a Missing Uncle 

Take to the skies in your trusty seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After receiving a distress call from Uncle Lou, you arrive only to find the islands in disarray and Lou nowhere to be found. Collect resources, help rebuild a community, and unravel the mystery of your uncle’s disappearance. 

Collect, Craft, Restore 

Harness the vacuum power of the Swirler! — a glorious multi-tool — to collect everything from scrap and native plants to materials dropped by Limbo’s unique wildlife. Use your finds to repair buildings, craft goods, and help the communities thrive again. 

Claim your slice of paradise at Lou’s Lagoon. Build your dream beach hut, add your personal touch, and let the island rhythm take over.  

Meet the islanders of Limbo 

Discover the archipelago’s vibrant islands, each with their own spirited communities, hidden treasures, and unique problems to solve. Get a warm welcome from the Charneys in Tangle Bloom—the archipelago's liveliest town—then head to Gleam Reef to watch the Vooi move to the music of the tides. Lastly, visit Boulderia, home to the grumpy, sugar-crystal-mining Gorplins!

Key Features: 

- Explore the Limbo archipelago, home to vibrant communities and ancient secrets. 

- Pilot your very own seaplane, master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 

- Upgrade your gadgets to expand your adventures. Scoop, build, glide and fish! 

- Personalize your seaplane with vibrant skins and custom configurations. 

- Full character customization. Make your avatar uniquely yours, from hairstyle to outfits and accessories. 

- Build your island base, decorate it, and make Lou’s Lagoon feel like home. 

- A mystery to unravel. Piece together clues, follow Lou’s trail, and uncover the truth behind his disappearance! 

Whether you’re hot on the trail to solving the mystery of Uncle Lou or just kicking back and enjoying island life, Lou’s Lagoon is your ticket to an exciting adventure.  

Ready for takeoff?

70010000092001.name: Noctuary
70010000092001.intro: Answer the call, protect the light, and forge your legend as an Arboranger in this heartfelt action RPG visual novel.
70010000092001.description:
Answer the Call. Protect the Light. Become an Arboranger.

Noctuary is a visual novel RPG that fuses rich storytelling, fast-paced action, and deep character progression. Step into the dual roles of Fancia Dream and Alina Nightsong, two bright-eyed Illuminators training to become legendary Arborangers - guardians of light in a world teetering on the edge of shadow.

Action Meets Heart
Fight back the darkness in real-time battles packed with explosive combo attacks, slick on-the-fly character switching, and game-changing Synergy skills. Master unique combat styles for both Fancia and Alina, and tailor your playstyle with strategic skill loadouts.

A World of Wonder, and Danger
Explore Inlixaland, a vibrant, fairy-tale realm teeming with magical creatures, mysterious secrets, and dangerous enemies known as the Darkritters. What begins as a lighthearted journey quickly deepens into a haunting tale as the girls uncover the truth behind a mysterious girl fallen from the sky.

Bonds That Power You
Build lasting friendships and fight alongside a cast of Illuminator companions. Your relationships matter, not just to the story, but to your survival. Equip and combine Blessing Petals, powerful relics infused with character abilities, to enhance your combat potential and personalize your approach to every fight.

Your Adventure, Your Way
With a multi-hour main storyline and over 20 side quests and branching character routes, Noctuary offers both emotional depth and high replayability. Discover personal stories, uncover hidden lore, and shape your path as a protector of light.

70010000092003.name: Penguin Flight
70010000092003.description:
Get ready to flap, dash, and soar in Penguin Flight, a delightful 2D pixel art platformer that blends charm, challenge, and creativity! Join a little penguin with big dreams as he embarks on a journey to touch the skies, navigating through 40 meticulously designed levels brimming with fun mechanics, vibrant visuals, and heartwarming adventures.

Your mission? Guide the penguin to the floating balloons at the end of each stage to inch closer to his ultimate goal of flying, while uncovering surprises, mastering new mechanics, and proving your platforming prowess!

Main Features
Accessible yet Engaging Gameplay: A lighthearted platformer that’s perfect for casual players but offers challenges for those seeking mastery.
Jump and Dash Mechanics: Use intuitive controls to avoid obstacles, clear gaps, and reach each level’s balloon.
Innovative Power-Ups: Discover bubbles for extra jumps and cyclones to teleport across tricky sections, adding depth to the gameplay.
Progressive Level Design: Start with straightforward stages, then tackle increasingly intricate levels as you master the mechanics.
Hand-Crafted Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in a colorful and whimsical world filled with charming animations and lively environments.
Seamless Flow: Enjoy smooth level transitions and instant retries to keep you in the action.
Every balloon brings the little penguin closer to his dream of flight. Are you ready to help him soar?

70010000092010.name: Potions: A Curious Tale
70010000092010.intro: An adventure-crafting game where your wits are your greatest weapons and combat is not always the answer.
70010000092010.description:
Potions: A Curious Tale is an adventure-crafting game where your wits are your greatest weapons and combat is not always the answer. Play as Luna, a young witch who overcomes obstacles with the potions she brews, as she gathers items from enchanted lands and conquers devious puzzles on her quest. 

Growing up is hard, and it’s even harder when you’re a witch! Encounter fairy tale and folklore characters as you guide Luna on her quest to become a potions master. With her sharp-tongued familiar at her side, Luna learns important coming-of-age lessons: Respect is earned, advice can be deceiving, and adults aren't always right.

Use your wits to strategize conflict resolution that goes beyond pure combat-- you’ll have to think on your feet and act quickly to sidestep danger and trick, charm, and scare your opponents into dropping valuable resources. 

As powerful as your potions are, you’ll find yourself up against monsters that can shrug off your most powerful attacks. Manage your resources carefully and use the environment and even other monsters to defeat your enemies, or you may find yourself with an empty satchel when you need your elixirs the most.

On her path to potions mastery, Luna must gather rare ingredients even before she brews her first potion. While her grandmother and friends teach her basic skills and recipes, Luna must fill her vials through experimentation and discovery. 

Explore the deep crafting system as you discover new ingredients across 7 biomes to craft over 100 unique potions with different element combinations. 

Solve devious puzzles and mysteries with your wits and your arsenal of mystical potions. With a little help from your grandmother (a powerful witch in her own right) and Helios, your cat familiar, you’ll overcome the challenges of these enchanted lands.

70010000092017.name: While Waiting
70010000092017.intro: Clear the game by doing nothing, but discover the power of acceptance and patience in numerous situations from birth to death. Learn to embrace life as you wait.
70010000092017.description:
Welcome to While Waiting. This innovative title invites players into a transformative journey through the art of patience, blending humor with profound life insights.

Numerous Life Situations: Encounter a diverse range of waiting scenarios, spanning from birth to death, providing a comprehensive exploration of life's waiting moments.

Doing Nothing is the Ultimate Strategy: Embrace the essence of the game by understanding that waiting is the key to clearing each situation. No shortcuts or actions can expedite the waiting time.

Comedic Appearance with Serious Core: Experience a unique blend of comedy reactions and a thought-provoking narrative that delves deep into the profound aspects of life.

Easter Eggs Hidden in Boringness: Uncover a multitude of hidden elements and surprises within the game's seemingly mundane waiting periods, transforming moments of boredom into engaging explorations.

Be Patient and Embrace Everyday Life: Learn the art of patience as you navigate the game, gaining valuable insights on embracing and accepting the journey of life itself.

70010000092022.name: EGGCONSOLE Burai: Jokan PC-8801mkIISR
70010000092022.intro: An RPG set in the world of Kypros, comprising the continent of Zaius and the seven islands. The story features eight heroes, including pirates, fortune tellers.
70010000092022.description:
Kypros, consisting of the continent of Zaius and the seven islands surrounding it, had long been a peaceful place under the rule of the royal family. However, the ancient seal was broken by Bido Klerant, a man desiring great power, and his subordinates, the Seven Beast Generals. As a result, the Dark God Emperor Daar was resurrected. Empowered by the evil god, Bido began to secretly move in order to control Kypros.

“Burai : Jōkan” is an RPG released by Riverhill Soft in 1989 in Japan. It features eight brave heroes, including pirates, fortune-tellers, and the leader of the dragon clan, and follows their heroic adventures. With as many as eight protagonist-level characters, it can be hard to become emotionally invested, but the game starts before the heroes meet each other. In the early stages, you’ll come to understand each hero’s background and circumstances, ensuring that you’ll grow attached to the characters.

The dramatic storyline they weave is one of the major attractions of the game. Another notable feature in the system is the “Action” command, which allows characters to improve their abilities even outside of battles, as well as the fact that each hero has weapon compatibility settings. Evaluating each hero’s strengths and deciding how to develop them is an essential element in progressing through the game.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000092025.name: THE GENERAL SAGA
70010000092025.intro:
Create your own millennium
JRPG-style survivor action
70010000092025.description:
•Survive by collecting dot characters!
This title is a survivor action game with JRPG-style dot characters.
Choose one general from a variety of professions and gather your friends to make up your party.
Strengthen your party with equipment items and special techniques to survive for the full time limit.

•Form a formation and meet the enemy!
Where should the collected characters be placed and in which direction should they attack?
Use your own unique formations to face the myriad of enemies that are closing in on you.
Formations can be freely changed at any time.

•Let's make history that spans a thousand years!
After each battle, the outcome is recorded in the history books.
Various events are recorded according to the results of the war, creating your own personal history.
It is up to you to decide how the 1000-year battle will end in a multi-ending system.

70010000092035.name: VIRTUAL GIRL @ WORLD’S END
70010000092035.intro: “VIRTUAL GIRL @ WORLD’S END” is a post-apocalyptic visual novel game that depicts girls who continue to pursue their dreams in a world coming to an end.
70010000092035.description:
[Story]
Year 2055. Tokyo.
Wars, resource depletion, and population decline.
In this place filled with despair, the bright girls perform live streams. Being evaluated and ranked in this world, their eyes become increasingly clouded.
In this colorless, dark world, a girl awakens.

“HELLO WORLD! I am Ai from Vstar!”

The girl continues to sing until the world ends, shining in the despair.

[Staff]
Original Art/Character Design:
Osamu Nobusawa (Character Design / Art Director for "BanG Dream! Girls Band Party!")

[CAST]
Ai: Azusa Tachibana
Rinka / Rin: Hina Tachibana
Maki / Mai: May Tachibana
Jammie: Aina Suzuki
Haruka: Aguri Onishi
Recycling station owner: Shuta Morishima
Information peddler: Naoya Uchida
Resistance Leader: Shuta Morishima
Sakura: Mayu Mineda
Yayoi: Fuka Izumi
Announcer: Arale Nakamachi

[THEME SONG]
「Hi-Vision」
Artist：Mugendai Mewtype

70010000092043.name: Die by Anything
70010000092043.intro: Experience a unique visual novel with decision-making and over 20 different endings! Survive an ordinary day in the life of a student
70010000092043.description:
Survive a normal day in the life of an ordinary student!
Welcome to this peculiar world where death lurks around every corner! Make the decisions that will make you have a peaceful day or die in a cruel, absurd or surprising way!
Survive in this world where nothing is what it seems and depending on the path you take, you may discover that every decision is important in life and that anything can kill you, even things you thought didn't exist!
Die by Anything features:
-More than 30 endings
-More than 20 deadly decisions
-Deaths depicted in comics
-Several artists have participated in the final scenes.
-Find all the paths to discover more about the world of Die by Anything.
-Selection of scenes to start from wherever you want (as long as you have previously unlocked it).
You'll explode, get your flesh ripped off, die in a bloody zombie apocalypse... We haven't convinced you to play yet?
This game includes disturbing content, so it is not suitable for children or sensitive or impressionable people.

70010000092053.name: Toy Tale: The Forgotten Factory
70010000092053.intro: This visual novel follows a group of toys who, after being forgotten by children, begin a journey in search of a legendary place: The Forgotten Factory.
70010000092053.description:
The protagonists are Teddy, a teddy bear with a nostalgic vision of the past; Luna, a doll who, although new to the store, has an insatiable curiosity; and Wheelie, a red toy car who dreams of speed.

During their journey, the toys face various obstacles in the human world, such as the chaos of the city streets, the dangers of crosswalks and the uncertainties of the road.

Throughout the story, the friendship between the toys grows stronger, and they discover that what keeps them together is the love for what they do and the desire to give other toys the same opportunity to be loved and appreciated.

70010000092055.name: Piggly Pagly Boom
70010000092055.intro: Save the world or get turned into roasted ham!
70010000092055.description:
Wild fireballs have gone haywire, and you must shoot them down using your special hookshot.

Shoot the hookshot straight upwards to attach it to the ceiling, where it will stay briefly, destroying any fireballs that touch the hanging rope. Gain access to various powerups, such as freezing movement, replenishing countdown time, faster shots, upgraded defenses, and more.

Can you clear each level before time runs out without getting burned?


Features
* Puzzle action shooting gameplay
* 2D bouncing fireball physics
* Gain different power-ups
* Exciting electronic dance music

70010000092058.name: Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection
70010000092058.intro: The ultimate retrospective celebration of Bubsy. What could possibly go wrong?
70010000092058.description:
Is Bubsy a celebrated icon from the mascot wars of the early 90s or a platforming punchline? The team at Limited Run Games has built a new collection to find the answer. Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection explores the franchise's troubled history and enduring popularity.

Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection is a playable history that includes games, artifacts and interviews. All of the games have been carefully updated for modern platforms using Limited Run’s proprietary Carbon Engine.

At the helm of the project is Audi Sorlie, a producer, author, Bubsy World Heavyweight Champion and arguably the world’s foremost expert on the furry franchise. Together with the team at Limited Run and Atari, he has created the ultimate retrospective celebration of Bubsy, the 3’6” tall 80 pound bobcat. What could possibly go wrong?

Included Titles:
- Bubsy in: Claws Encounters of the Furred Kind (Super Nintendo Entertainment System™, Super Famicom™, SEGA Genesis™)
- Bubsy II (Super Nintendo Entertainment System™, SEGA Genesis™, Game Boy™)
- Bubsy in: Fractured Furry Tales (Atari Jaguar™)
- Bubsy 3D (PlayStation®)

Features
- Enhanced resolution and framerate along with save states and rewind functionality for every game in the collection
- Scans of art, manuals, ads, and more, straight from the top secret Bubsy archives
- Video interviews that delve into the development history of gaming’s most infamous bobcat
- Listen to your favorite tracks in the music player

70010000092067.name: Pixel Game Maker Series Arcanion Magi Side Story
70010000092067.intro: The great adventure of the little Magi begins!
70010000092067.description:
Arcanion: Magi Side Story, takes place after the events of Tale of Magi, where Magi is on a search for her twin, Sorc. Only to uncover some strange happenings in her surroundings causing the locals to become violent, and thus Magi goes to investigate the cause, and hopefully find her twin as well.

-About the Game-
Play through six levels in a retro game styled game, with improved mechanics for Magi, making for greater control. With two additional playable modes, Sorc Mode and Boss Attack.

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.

70010000092072.name: Reverse Sound Show
70010000092072.description:
Animals, machine sounds, environmental noises, voices...
A party game where you use a USB microphone to mimic all kinds of reverse playback sounds with your voice!
Who will be crowned the Reverse Playback King tonight!?

70010000092083.name: Wine Factory Simulator
70010000092083.intro: Grow, Harvest, Create – The Art of Winemaking Awaits!
70010000092083.description:
Step into the world of Wine Factory Simulator, where passion meets precision, and every bottle tells a story. Immerse yourself in the tranquil yet rewarding life of a home winemaker, transforming simple grapes into exquisite wines that captivate connoisseurs.
Start your journey by cultivating your own vineyard, carefully selecting grape varieties that will define the character of your wines. Tend to your vines, ensuring they receive just the right balance of sunlight, water, and care. A thriving vineyard is the heart of a great winery!
As the seasons change and the grapes reach perfection, it’s time to harvest and begin the winemaking process. Crush the fruit, initiate fermentation, and patiently oversee every stage of aging, refining the flavor profile to perfection. Your expertise will determine whether your wine becomes a forgettable drink or a sought-after masterpiece.
But winemaking is more than just production—it’s about sharing your passion with the world. Open your winery’s doors, welcome guests, and establish your reputation as a true artisan. Experiment with new grape blends, refine your techniques, and watch as your small, cozy winery transforms into a renowned destination for wine lovers.

Features:
Grape Variety Selection – Choose from a range of grape types, each with unique flavors and qualities.
Vineyard Management – Use tools and machinery to care for your vineyard and ensure the highest quality harvest.
Hands-On Winemaking – Crush, ferment, age, and refine your wines with precision and care.
Sell and Expand – Bottle your creations, sell them to customers, and invest in growing your winery.
Experiment & Innovate – Discover new techniques, refine your recipes, and craft the perfect wine.

Are you ready to build your own winemaking empire? Pour your heart into every bottle and create a legacy that will stand the test of time in Wine Factory Simulator!

70010000092088.name: Nova Hearts
70010000092088.intro: A mysterious force transforms you and other highly attractive people in your area into superheroes and villains! TEXT, DATE and FIGHT your friends and enemies alike.
70010000092088.description:
Are you ready to harness your cosmic powers? Embark on an exciting summer adventure and uncover the hidden mystery as you TEXT, DATE, and FIGHT in this turn-based strategy dating sim!

| Story 

Our heroine, Luce, has returned to her hometown from the big city for the summer to escape her past, but the town of Vermillion is more than meets the eye. No worries! Nothing like a fantastic summer vacation and some wild parties to forget all your woes right?

…That is, until a mysterious cosmic force suddenly grants Luce magical powers and a sick transformation sequence to boot! With her new powers, Luce and her friends, Will and CJ, are off to fight a strange threat as the ultimate magical girl crew and uncover the mystery of their hometown! (And maybe find love along the way!)

| Cast

Enemies-to-lovers? Friends-to-lovers? Friends with benefits? Whether you want romance or friendship, there’s something for everyone! Hit up the hot singles in Vermillion and explore a variety of different relationships with friends, civilians, and even villains!

| Gameplay

Uncover an exciting visual novel story where YOU make the decisions. As you embark on Luce’s journey, choose from a variety of different responses to build your relationships with different characters whether it’s in person or through text!

Live the life of a superhero! Defend Vermillion from monsters and villains with your team through exciting strategic, turn-based combat.

Power up your cosmic powers and create powerful combos with your fellow heroes to save the day!

| Features

- Play several chapters of visual novel adventure.
- Choose between 9 diverse characters to befriend, date, or antagonize with otome-inspired gameplay.
- Fight monsters in a strategic turn-based combat system.
- Text your friends, power up, and get the latest gossip through a collection of apps in an interactive phone interface.

70010000092091.name: SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance - Digital Art Book and Soundtrack
70010000092091.description: Contains the digital art book and soundtrack featuring music by Koshiro and Tee Lopes.

70010000092096.name: Through the Nightmares
70010000092096.intro: A hardcore platformer for anyone who’s ever been jolted awake from a fright.
70010000092096.description:
Dive into the world of dreams in Through the Nightmares! This is a hardcore platformer where you play as the Sandman, a size-shifting spirit said to bring people good dreams.

Several children are lost in the kingdom of Morpheus, the mad god of dreams, who turns sleep into a prison. To bring the children back to their families, the Sandman must descend to a place where even the most secret of fears come to life…

• Size-Shifting Platformer — Change your size to squeeze through tight spaces, boost your jumps, interact with the environment, and discover hidden shortcuts.

• Challenges For Everyone — Enjoy ruthless precision gaming with instant respawns and a unique checkpoint system that lets you control where you respawn.

• Six Unique Locations — Explore 45 handcrafted levels across three chapters and six different locations based on Nordic folklore, modern-day suburbia, and medieval ruins.

• Reactive Dreamscapes — Manipulate your environment with the Sandman’s abilities to open up new pathways, discover secrets, and solve tricky challenges.

• Dream Secrets — Collect personal items from each nightmare to learn more about the children’s past, reveal the deeper story, and piece together the truth of what happened to Morpheus.

• Towering Terrors — Enormous creatures lurk deep within the dream world, hunting you down. Escape their clutches… or face a swift end.

• Immersive Visuals and Soundtrack — Nightmare dreamscapes are brought to life with striking low poly art and a haunting original soundtrack.

They’re waiting to be rescued. But the dream world already knows you’re here. And it will stop at nothing to ensure you never leave. Are you ready to defy the Dream God himself?

70010000092105.name: Genopanic
70010000092105.intro: A sci-fi pixel adventure with cute but deadly mutants, challenging puzzles, hidden secrets, and... a mysterious cat-girl!
70010000092105.description:
Explore a mysterious, abandoned space station crawling with mutated creatures and hidden dangers. Solve challenging puzzles, discover dark secrets, and uncover the truth behind genetic experiments gone wrong.

Meet bizarre but charming mutants born from failed experiments as you navigate eerie corridors and laboratories. Your journey is guided by a friendly virtual dog named Like, while the playful AI-cat Volga constantly tests your wit.

Encounter a mysterious cat-girl with her own hidden agenda. Will she become your trusted ally or lead you into greater danger?

Use a variety of futuristic weapons and gadgets, including an energy blade, plasma cutter, flamethrower, and gravity gun, to overcome obstacles and enemies. Collect hidden data disks to upgrade your gear and unlock new abilities for your combat suit.

Your choices matter! Experience a branching storyline with four unique endings, inviting multiple playthroughs and deep exploration.

With beautifully animated pixel art and atmospheric sound design, Genopanic delivers a captivating sci-fi experience that blends cute aesthetics with a chilling narrative.

Key Features:

Free Exploration: Discover secrets at your own pace within a vast space station.

Unique Characters: Interact with quirky companions Like, Volga, and the enigmatic cat-girl.

Diverse Arsenal: Equip various sci-fi weapons and gadgets to defeat mutants.

Upgradable Gear: Collect upgrades and unlock new suit abilities.

Branching Storyline: Make critical choices to unlock one of four distinct endings.

Atmospheric Pixel Art: Delight in stunning visuals and immersive retro-style audio.

Unravel the mysteries. Survive the mutations. Welcome to Genopanic!

70010000092110.name: Save The Doge 2
70010000092110.intro: New puppy rescue mission from the evil bees!
70010000092110.description:
New challenging levels are here! Solve the puzzles and save the little puppies. This is still the best way to spend your time!   

You still have to draw the lines so the angry bees can't even touch the puppy. All new levels will challenge your brain and skills. Still find the best solution in each level. The bees won't stop until they reach the goal. Keep them away as long as you can!       

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Continue to show your love for all the animals in the world!

70010000092115.name: DEDALO - Escape Room Adventure
70010000092115.intro: Uncover the secrets of a frozen world. Explore ancient Arctic ruins, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the power of a lost artifact.
70010000092115.description:
An escape room adventure set in the icy depths of the Arctic. Fresh evidence of a lost civilization has surfaced, leading you to a mysterious site buried beneath the snow. The ancient arctic ruins hold secrets of artifacts with great power, but accessing them won’t be easy.

As the story unfolds, a surprising twist propels you beyond what you ever imagined, testing your skills and ingenuity to the limit.

Perfect for fans of puzzle games, adventure gaming, and escape room challenges, Dedalo - Escape Room Adventure offers a blend of mystery, exploration, and brain-teasing puzzles. Take on a journey of discovery where every puzzle brings you closer to your journey home - or becoming lost forever.

ABOUT:
Dedalo is a first person 3d escape room puzzle adventure, similar to games you may have played in the ’90’s or similar to a virtual escape rooms you may have played. An immersive world that you explore and an inventory where you can collect and use items you find along the way to solve puzzles and escape the rooms.

Explore areas, collect hidden objects and take in your surroundings. You will need all of your puzzle solving skills to put together a plan to make your way home.

How you tackle the puzzles is down to you. Each puzzle has a logical solution, so take your time, there is no rush and enjoy the process of understanding what you have to do.

FEATURES:
+ Explore an immersive environment, solving puzzles and collecting items

+ Use the inventory to collect and use objects

+ Beautiful all original adventure 3D graphics, environments and atmosphere to explore

+ Immersive backing soundtrack and effects to pull you into the adventure

70010000092120.name: Losen Screws Puzzles
70010000092120.intro: Solve over 100 tricky screw puzzles und unsrew them all!
70010000092120.description: Solve different screw puzzles in different difficulties from easy to hard and choose from over 100 puzzles. Loosen different shapes from rings to complicated structures and loosen each screw to expose the beams. Attention, the order is crucial! But don't worry, various boosters will help you if you get stuck! Grab your screwdriver and get started!

70010000092124.name: SHUTEN ORDER
70010000092124.intro: Happy New End...Have a good end
70010000092124.description:
■Story  
“168 remaining until the end of the world...”
Humanity is approaching its end.

In a world steeped in despair and chaos, a strange religious organization called Shuten Order emerges, yearning for the end of humanity. The group rapidly gains followers, eventually forming a small nation state called Shuten.  

Tragedy strikes during the grand festival celebrating their nation’s founding—the leader of the Shuten Order is murdered. Soon after, the protagonist awakens with no memory, greeted by two self-proclaimed "angels". They reveal a shocking truth: the protagonist is the murdered Founder, revived by divine power. However, the resurrection is incomplete—their memories are gone, and their life limited to a mere four days.  

To survive, the protagonist must overcome "God's trial": identify and kill their murderer.

With the clock ticking, the protagonist, given the alias Rei, dives into the tumultuous city as a detective. The suspects? Five ministers of the Shuten Order. There's no time to investigate them all. Choices must be made, and the pursuit of truth demands sacrifice.  

Who killed the Founder? For what reason? Can the mission be fulfilled before time runs out?  
Thus begins a high-stakes, four-day hunt for the truth.  

■Gameplay & Game System:  
- Ministry of Security: Stealth Action Horror  
Flee from the legendary killer Nephilim while investigating suspect Manji Fushicho.  
----------------------
Features action-style gameplay where players solve various puzzles in 3D stages while escaping from the murderous Nephilim, all viewed from a top-down perspective.

- Ministry of Justice: Mystery Adventure  
Solve a murder tied to the wealthy Kukuri family and expose the true killer linked to suspect Kishiru Inugami. 
----------------------
Investigate cases as a detective by interviewing key figures and examining crime scenes to uncover hidden truths.
In the visual novel-style investigation segments, use the "Snapping" feature to closely analyze suspicious statements and intriguing objects.
During the case analysis meetings, piece together evidence collected during investigations to reveal what took place and draw closer to solving the mystery.

- Ministry of Science: Multi-Perspective Visual Novel  
Navigate a deadly terrorist attack at a research lab while shifting between characters to avoid fatal outcomes, targeting suspect Teko Ion.  
----------------------
Features multi-perspective storytelling through visual novel-style gameplay where you switch between the viewpoints of multiple characters to discover survival routes.
One person's actions can impact another person's fate.

- Ministry of Education: Romance Adventure (?!)  
After being poisoned, head to Shuten Academy and unmask three enigmatic girls, one of whom is suspect/poisoner Honoka Kokushikan.  
----------------------
A romance adventure-style game where the goal is to build deep connections with three heroines.
Use clues to track their locations on the school map and seek them out for interactions.
Raise their affection through dialogue choices and complete romance events to unlock the confession phase at night.
During the confession phase, choose the right words within the time limit to win them over.

- Ministry of Health: Extreme Escape Adventure  
Survive a death game orchestrated by an unknown force while interrogating suspect Yugen Ushitora.  
----------------------
Features escape room adventure gameplay where you must find the exit to a mysterious locked room by undergoing dangerous trials and puzzles, and wrong choices can lead directly to life-threatening situations.

Master each route to piece together the truth, confront the culprit, and shape the fate of the world in this gripping, multi-genre experience.

70010000092131.name: Puzzle Adventures - Serve Dishes
70010000092131.intro: Easy to use puzzles for toddlers and kids. Featuring funny and cute animal motifs with 30 unique puzzles. 100% frustration free and child-safe.
70010000092131.description:
Welcome to the world of puzzle adventures! Today we're hard-working at the kitchen and we serve some delicious and yummy food from around the world. From italian pasta over japanese ramen to american burgers and barbecue!

This drag-and-drop puzzle game is extremely easy to use and has been designed with the utmost care for children of all ages.

The different levels of difficulty provide age-appropriate entertainment for all children.

70010000092138.name: Stunt Flyer
70010000092138.intro:
Stunt Flyer is an open-world flying adventure,
led by the brother and sister team of Jimmy and
Sophie.
70010000092138.description:
Adventure full of fantastical inventions
and flying vehicles. From UFOs to gyrocopters and
jet planes, Stunt Flyer has a wide variety of
planes, and each of those planes can be equipped
with their very own equipment.

Open World:
Explore any of the 3 large open locations.


Missions:
Complete many different missions in the shortest time possible and gain experience to unlock new planes and locations


Co-op:
Play together with a friend in split screen mode, together the mission will become an even bigger adventure

70010000092140.name: Dreamless
70010000092140.intro: In a remote provincial town, teenagers mysteriously disappear every 25 years. You're a high school student about to turn 18... But what if you become the next victim?
70010000092140.description:
“When we are sure that everything develops according to our plans, we should wonder whether there is an invisible thread of the puppeteer stretched over our heads.”

Every 25 years, horrifying events occur in a lost town in the south. For one week, August 1-7, referred to as “death week,” teenagers mysteriously disappear. City officials have long ago given up on the mystery and are simply closing missing persons cases, advising residents to stock up on essential supplies and not to leave their homes. But even such measures don't save the day, and more people go missing every year. Is a serial killer, who has passed his craft from generation to generation, to blame for these terrible disappearances, or ... or ... Is it a curse?

The protagonist is John, a diligent senior year student with a passion for video blogging. On August 1, 2017, exactly one month before his coming of age, a new “week of death” arrives. The townspeople are busy going about their business and seem to have already forgotten about the curse, but John receives a tempting offer from his friend Will: to explore the long-abandoned house of a deceased old lady who once instilled terror in all the residents.

Features:

-Photo-realistic graphics
-Realistic gameplay
-High-quality audio accompaniment, creating an atmosphere of maximum fear
-Unpredictable gameplay: the abandoned house will change as the game progresses, creating new obstacles and puzzles for the player.
-Learn the ancient history of a provincial town and solve the mystery of mystical disappearances of children

Immerse yourself in this fascinating world and find out what lies behind the eerie events of the “death week”.

70010000092145.name: All in Abyss: Judge the Fake
70010000092145.intro:
…Bet your all, may victory be yours.
Win everything as a gambler
In this poker battle deduction adventure/RPG
70010000092145.description:
In this game, you adventure to become a successful gambler by challenging others at the game of Texas Hold‘em Poker.

Use various skills to achieve victory in poker, expose the hands of the witches, All-in to steal their winnings, and become the ruler of the gambling district.

ーーーーー
Poker Battles
An "anything goes" Texas Hold'em style 1v1 poker-like card game.
Become victorious by reducing the enemy chips to 0.

ACTIVATE SKILLS
The “gambling prodigy” Asuha is capable of turning the tides of battle using various skills, sourcing from her aptitude in gambling.
Limit the opponent’s play, gain insight beyond their hand, and much more… stay victorious with skills that expand the pool of decision-making.

ALL-IN
“All-In” is a command that puts all chips on the table and your life as a gambler on the line.
Use various means to put yourself in a favorable position, and use this command to slam the final nail in the coffin.

Showdown vs The Witches
A “Witch” is a Boss Character present in each chapter of the game.
All Witches excel at poker, but with enough preparation, the player can expose the Witches’ fraudulent acts and sink them to the depths of hell with a deadly All-In.

THE CITY
The scene is set in The City, where various information can be gathered.
Find sources to help unveil the secrets behind the Witches’ cheats and frauds to achieve sweet vengeance.
Additionally, you can hustle the gamblers around town to rake in quick cash, or go on a winning streak in “Poker Royale”—which rewards you after achieving a set number of victories—to earn the points needed for acquiring new skills and to obtain rare items, thereby increasing your standing as a gambler.

The only appropriate sequel to cashing out, is to spend big.
Your earnings can be spent deservingly at "club ALL OUT" to party your heart out.
Should you catch lady luck's eye, you will be treated to bonus luck for your next battle.

EXPOSE THE WITCHES’ HAND
Your finesse in poker may earn you some cash in The City, but the Witches - who rule the districts, will not allow for a fair victory. Their methods of cheating seems to be fool-proof, but the evidence you uncover will say otherwise.
Explore every inch of the city and expose the cheaters of their tricks.

STORY
Asuha Senahara, a self-proclaimed genius gambler, is a wanderer.
Amidst the tables of cards and dice, it is she alone who snatches the chips at stake.
One day, she learns of the gambling district “the city”, a special ward where gambling holds influence above all else.
In this city run by the strongest gamblers known as the “Witches”, Asuha experiences the first defeat in her life.
They exercised not luck, not skill, but dirty tricks, such that felled Asuha to the depths of the abyss.
As a self-proclaimed genius gambler, Asuha becomes determined to take down the Witches.
The Coliseum is the battlefield. The challenger is Asuha Senahara. The chips are on the table, and the Witches are ready to be exposed.

70010000092153.name: Amazing Weekend Search and Relax Collector's Edition
70010000092153.intro: Perfect journey for those who look for inspiration and adventure.
70010000092153.description:
Take a break from the daily hustle and bustle, enjoying exciting adventures with improved graphics and more detailed locations!
Spend unforgettable moments away from urban bustle, going hiking, horseback riding and boating. 
Use your skills and knowledge to find all the hidden objects and complete mini-games.

The collector's edition includes:
- 12 additional levels with hidden object and mini-games 
- 8 additional mini-games
- Souvenir shop with various trophies.

70010000092159.name: GIGASWORD
70010000092159.intro: Can he restore the world's coherency before it's too late?
70010000092159.description: Balance the weight of the GIGASWORD, battling between brain and brawn in this action-puzzle metroidvania where the might of the sword will determine all. As tensions rise in Thoenhart, a city plagued by famine and disease, the humans within set their hopes on a final solution: invade the ancient tower Nestrium, slay the Nocturne, and take the God Crystal, Gnosis, for themselves. Said to grant prosperity to those who wield it, Gnosis has been long sought after by humanity for generations. However, upon raiding its resting place, the disturbance of this ancient power awakens an evil capable of destroying the very fabric of reality. Can Ezra reach the top of the Nestrium in time to stop this cataclysm, or will humanity’s ignorance lead the world to its doom?

70010000092169.name: Foto Boy: A New Job
70010000092169.intro: Are you ready to capture the beauty and climb your way to success?
70010000092169.description:
Capture the Moment!

Embark on a thrilling journey with Kin’s dream job. You just got hired during your job interview.
Can you survive the challenges of your first day at a new job? 
Will you earn your boss’ respect or will you be fired on the spot after a mess up?

Sometimes unexpected opportunities present themselves. Embark on a quest to the top, armed with nothing but a camera!


Features:
* Photo Gallery: You can unlock the 10 different pictures and view them at any time!
* Unique Storyline: Join Kin in his quest for success as he collects pictures of all his beautiful co-workers.
* Top-Down Perspective: Explore the vibrant and dynamic world of Foto Boy through a visually engaging top-down perspective.
* Lite Puzzles: light-hearted puzzles that add an extra layer of challenge to the game. Solve them to unlock new areas and advance in the storyline.
* Character Dialogue: Discover more as Kin interacts with a diverse cast of characters.
* Take pictures: Unleash your inner photographer!

70010000092175.name: Hentai Girls: Mandarin Love
70010000092175.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000092175.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000092187.name: Peachy Derby
70010000092187.intro: 60FPS racing game where the girl Natsuki is forced to join the "Ninja Racing Tournament" to pay off her debt. 10 girls,100 dances anims, 600 voices, 16 chapters.
70010000092187.description:
[Peachy Girl's Adventure]
Experience the story of girl Natsuki joining the ""Ninja Racing Tournament"" with her friends to pay off her debt. A total of 16 chapters. 

[Humanoid Kart Racing]
Choose a girl and reach the finish line before the others.Use ninja tools to attack enemies.

[Let the Girls Dance]
In addition to racing, choose dances, outfits, and Japanese voice lines for the girls.

70010000092192.name: Bright Escape
70010000092192.intro: Embark on a magical journey in Bright Escape!
70010000092192.description:
Immerse yourself in a vibrant world filled with stunning landscapes, intricate platforms, and mysterious mechanisms. Use your skills to dodge traps, solve puzzles, and uncover treasures hidden among the clouds.

Beautiful Visuals: Handcrafted levels inspired by fantastical worlds.
Engaging Gameplay: A perfect mix of agility, strategy, and exploration.
Unique Challenges: Face dynamic traps and solve mind-bending puzzles.
Discover Secrets: Find hidden gems and unravel the mystery of the floating realms.

Designed for fans of classic platformers and those who love enchanting, magical worlds. Can you escape and reveal all the secrets? Bright Escape awaits!

70010000092197.name: Maliki : Poison of the Past
70010000092197.intro: Join Maliki and her wacky family in their epic battle against Poison, a fearsome plant creature that has colonized space-time.
70010000092197.description:
In the near future, humanity is teetering on the edge of extinction, subjugated by the fearsome Poison, a plant monster that alters the space-time continuum. Led by the enigmatic Maliki, a handful of temporal survivors have joined forces and are coordinating their efforts from the Domaine, a haven outside of time that is so far safe from the threat. 

Play as Sand as you travel through the ages to repair the continuum. Use your Chrono Pack to manipulate time, fight the monsters that have infested past worlds alongside Becky, Fang and Fenimale, a wacky and slightly magical band of characters. 

Rest and prepare in the Domaine, take care of the Thousand-Root Tree that protects it from the monster, harvest, cook, improve your equipment and send your hero into the bisections of time with every more powerful and wacky accessories.  

In Maliki: Poison of the Past, you'll find a universe full of magic, a family of endearing characters, and a story full of nuance and emotion, all of which carried by a sharp wit and satisfyingly original anime visuals. Bring harmony back in this unforgettable ecological fable!

70010000092199.name: Cardboard Town
70010000092199.intro: Cardboard Town is a city-building card game where you manage resources, earn upgrades, and draw cards to thrive. With random events, quest cards, and varied game!
70010000092199.description:
◆Cardboard Town features:
- Various building cards to build your city from the ground up
- Action cards to take care of random events and adjust your cards
- Quest cards to abide and make your people happy
- Road cards to make cars go wroom wroom
- 9 Different Games Modes to enjoy!

◆Roguelite Fun:
With different upgrades, random festivals, disasters, and quests; each run is different!
Try to beat your high score each time and unlock even more random stuff such as new building cards, festivals, cosmetics and even resources!

◆Cardboard Town features over 100+ Building and Action cards, we are not even counting Quest cards, Festivals, Upgrades and Disasters.
With this large pool of options, you’ll be able to build different cities each time!

Want some more details?
Well, since you’ve scrolled this far and want to know more (thanks, by the way) let me just explain what the game is to you;
You take city-building games, add card mechanics and roguelite elements, and it ends up being really cute.

You place Building Cards using Money and control your stats; Electricity, Water, Environment and Safety. Also, your Population determines how much Money you can have in a turn.

Not being able to handle random disasters or failing to manage your stats gets you a Red Alert, get three and you’re out!

With each run you unlock more cards, obtain better stats and options and try to beat your high score!

70010000092204.name: THE EXIT: LIMINAL ANOMALY HORROR
70010000092204.intro: Escape the unknown, survive the unseen.
70010000092204.description:
The Exit: Liminal Anomaly Horror immerses you in a chilling, endless corridor where reality itself begins to unravel. Trapped in the sterile halls of a mysterious office, you must navigate through spaces that feel increasingly alien. Objects shift, sounds echo in impossible ways, and something unseen follows your every move. The deeper you go, the more unsettling the anomalies become - each one a reminder that the rules of reality no longer apply.

To survive, you must be vigilant. If you notice an anomaly, turn back immediately; ignoring it could cost you dearly. But if nothing seems off, keep moving forward, always cautious of the subtle distortions creeping into your surroundings. Your only goal is to escape the hall before it swallows you whole, as every step you take might lead you closer to the truth or deeper into madness. The smallest shift in the environment may reveal a hidden secret, slowly uncovering the horrifying truth behind the building. 

However, missing even the slightest anomaly may leave you trapped forever, lost in a world where reality breaks down. Trust your instincts, because every decision could be your last. Will you find your way out of The Exit, or will you become another lost soul in the endless maze?

70010000092209.name: Car Dealership Business Simulator
70010000092209.intro: Build, sell, and drive your way to success!
70010000092209.description:
Start from a small showroom and build your way up to a thriving car dealership empire! Buy, sell, and trade a variety of vehicles, from everyday rides to luxury sports cars, while managing inventory, pricing, and customer satisfaction. 

Expand your lot, customize your showroom, and unlock exclusive car brands to attract high-paying buyers. 
Negotiate the best deals, offer special promotions, and create the ultimate car-buying experience. 

Every decision shapes your success - can you rise to the top and become the ultimate car dealer?

70010000092214.name: Light Guardian
70010000092214.intro: Retrieve all the light shards back and see where your journey ends.
70010000092214.description: Help the guardian of the light to retrieve and collect all light shards before the world fall into darkness! You are the light guardian which goes on a quest to find the stolen light shards across the country. On your journey you have to overcome different obstacles to collect them all and finally meet the light itself.

70010000092216.name: Bee Flowers
70010000092216.intro: Relax and Puzzle with Buzzing Bees!
70010000092216.description:
Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Bee Flowers, a delightful puzzle game where you guide busy bees through hexagonal grids to pollinate vibrant fields of flowers. With its relaxing mechanics and progressively challenging puzzles, the game offers the perfect blend of strategy and serenity.

Connect the dots by rotating and arranging paths, strategizing your way through increasingly intricate levels. The minimalist visuals and soothing soundtrack create a cozy atmosphere, making it an ideal escape for both casual gamers and puzzle enthusiasts.

Whether you're solving a quick puzzle or mastering a tricky challenge, Bee Flowers promises a satisfying, mentally stimulating experience wrapped in nature's charm.

Main Features:
Relaxing Puzzle Gameplay:
Rotate and arrange hexagonal pieces to guide bees and pollinate flowers.

Dynamic Challenges:
30 progressively challenging levels with new mechanics introduced as you advance.

Cozy Atmosphere:
Minimalist visuals and a soothing soundtrack create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Take a break from the buzz of daily life and let Bee Flowers whisk you away to a world of logic and beauty. Are you ready to help the bees and bring flowers to life?

70010000092221.name: Shopping Fever
70010000092221.intro: Let the shopping fever get the best of you!
70010000092221.description:
Enter the world of shopping. Don't miss out on the best deals. Your appearance depends on how well you shop!  

The road to the top of the fashion heap isn't easy. Many obstacles await you. But don't be afraid and keep going! Avoid obstacles, collect shopping bags and diamonds to change your outfit and impress your friends. 

Reach the finish line with your hands full of amazing things. Try to collect as many branded goods as possible. Shock everyone around you with your bright and expensive look.  

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Hurry up to get the best deals!

70010000092226.name: Merge Numbers
70010000092226.intro: Merge the numbers and smash the blocks!
70010000092226.description:
Choose the direction, throw the first ball and watch the beauty of the explosive gameplay. Each move creates multiple possibilities for you to choose from. Really simple and very addictive gameplay in your hands. Play again and again.

Try to find the best possible trajectory and let the mayhem begin! Just one correct move can create an amazing chain of explosions and block destruction. Search for the best choices and opportunities. It's up to you how and for how long you want to play! 

You can play endlessly if you can find the gameplay patterns. Collect bonuses, multiply the power, open hidden chests and unlock the ultimate possibilities as you break through the levels. 

Check out this fun new game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Smash them all!

70010000092231.name: Dance Mania
70010000092231.intro: Get your dance team together and let the partying begin!
70010000092231.description:
Get some talented dancers on your team and put on a show as you race to the finish line. Fun music, cool moves and colourful costumes are the secret to victory!    

Avoid the obstacles in your way, but you must avoid them to keep your team safe and not lose anyone along the way. Choose the best dance moves and your dance team will be the biggest and funniest at the finish line.   

Unlock new costumes for your dancers. Learn new dance moves. Each level will be unique and fun! Open all options to see all the dances and unusual costumes for your team. 

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Let the party begin!

70010000092236.name: Discolored 2
70010000092236.description:
All the colors have gone missing from the world. While on a mission to bring them back you discover you are being hunted by those who would see the colors banished. Your only hope is a woman in red who may be holding the key to preventing the world from becoming discolored.

Discolored 2 is a first-person puzzle horror filled with mystery and suspense. Taking place in a world where color is power, your task is to use your puzzle-solving skills to protect it from a sinister organization.

Set after the events of the first Discolored, this sequel places the stakes higher and makes the dangers even greater. As you attempt to restore color to the rest of the world that’s been thrust into darkness, you’ll need to evade the clutches of a shadowy organization. These mysterious figures who use the power of color for their own demented purposes will do anything to stop you from achieving your aim.

Explore and uncover the mysteries of the world. Employ logic and observation to solve mind-bending puzzles. Take in visuals with a simple yet striking aesthetic through a first-person lens. Immerse yourself in an atmospherically surreal audio and visual experience. Unravel an engrossing narrative by exploring every nook and cranny of your surroundings.

Only you can overcome the forces that threaten the balance and have the world once again be restored to its full spectrum of color.

Key Features: 
● Unravel the mystery - Piece together a dark and uncanny narrative to uncover the secrets of the colors and their meaning.
● Inventive, mind-bending puzzles - Use your keen observation and logical thinking to overcome challenging puzzles and restore color to the world.
● Surreal and otherworldly atmosphere - Experience an unreal and bizarre world ambiance that seamlessly melds surprise with eeriness.
● Haunting soundtrack - Engross yourself in the experience with tracks that deliver unearthly undertones.

70010000092241.name: Robot Boxing: Real Fighting Steel Battle
70010000092241.intro:
Clash of Titans, Built for Battle!
Unleash Steel Fury, Rule the Arena.
Robot Boxing: Where Legends are Forged!
70010000092241.description:
Unleash the power of steel in Robot Boxing: Real Fighting Steel Battle! Take on the challenge in Career Mode with 20 action-packed levels or jump into Battle Mode to pick your opponents and dominate the arena.

Build and upgrade your robots, unlock powerful abilities, and master epic combos in this thrilling 3D fighting game. With dynamic arenas, intense combat, and endless excitement, Robot Boxing is the ultimate showdown of strength and strategy.

70010000092246.name: Diner Simulator - Horror Story
70010000092246.description: Take on the role of a night shift worker at a small fast food kiosk, where mystery awaits. Your predecessor has vanished under eerie circumstances, and it’s now your job to uncover the truth. As you juggle late-night orders, unsettling occurrences start to unravel. Can you gather the clues and solve the enigma behind their disappearance?

70010000092250.name: Detective Instinct: Farewell, My Beloved
70010000092250.intro: A woman vanishes without a trace on a cross-country train, and nobody on board remembers her ever existing - except for you. Uncover the story in this mystery adventure game!
70010000092250.description:
Detective Instinct: Farewell, My Beloved is a brand new mystery ADV/Visual Novel, in the style of classic adventure games from Japan. Investigate areas and interrogate witnesses on the path towards solving the mystery and uncovering a sinister conspiracy!

KEY FEATURES:
- A dramatic and moving story, inspired by hard-boiled crime fiction, classic cinema, and other classic adventure (ADV) games

- Classic command-select gameplay, designed to maximize player experimentation and deduction

- A unique mixed-media art style, combining highly expressive 2D pixel art portraits, old-school pre-rendered 3D backgrounds, and traditional illustrations

- A colorful cast of characters with which to converse, with many unique interactions and optional dialogue that rewards exploration and curiosity

- Lavish original soundtrack in various musical styles, featuring many live instrument performances

70010000092255.name: Meteorfall: Krumit's Tale
70010000092255.description: Krumit's Tale, a deckbuilding roguelike game in the Meteorfall universe. Use your cards to clear dungeons, then upgrade your deck with new cards and perks to press forward. The fate of the world is in your hands.

70010000092262.name: Summer Love
70010000092262.intro: Experience a summer love story where your choices shape the outcome. Will it be a forever love or just a memory? Your unforgettable journey begins!
70010000092262.description:
Get ready to experience a summer that will change your life! Imagine meeting someone who will transform your world forever. One summer, a shy and reserved boy crosses paths with an outgoing, genuine, and energetic girl. Could this encounter be the start of something unforgettable?

This game invites you to be part of a summer love story where your decisions change everything. Will you dare to help the boy step out of his comfort zone? Would you risk it all for a love that might end when summer does? Live romantic moments, overcome misunderstandings, face unexpected twists, and decide if this bond deserves a “forever” or a nostalgic goodbye.

With visuals that capture the vibrant colors of summer, music that awakens cherished memories, and a narrative that will make you dream, this is more than just a game, it’s your own love story. Are you ready to take control and write the ending to this unforgettable summer?

70010000092268.name: Stellar Docks
70010000092268.description:
Embark on an interstellar puzzle adventure in Stellar Docks, a Sokoban-inspired game with charming 2D pixel art. Guide an astronaut as they maneuver drones to their recharging docks across grid-based maps filled with logical challenges. With a top-down view and intuitive controls, the game offers a satisfying progression of puzzles, designed to challenge your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. From the interiors of a spaceship to the icy terrains of Neptune, explore diverse environments and unravel intricate puzzles that will test your mastery of every mechanic.

Whether you're a casual gamer or a puzzle enthusiast, Stellar Docks is your ticket to a cosmic brain-teasing journey.

Main Features
Engaging Sokoban-Style Gameplay: Push drones to their designated docks using logical, grid-based movement.
Infinite Undo and Level Restarts: Experiment fearlessly and refine your strategies with these forgiving mechanics.
40 Challenging Levels: Explore four unique environments (Spaceship Interior, The Moon, Mars, and Neptune), each introducing new puzzle elements and escalating difficulty.
Immersive Pixel Art: Experience the charm of handcrafted 2D pixel art in a sci-fi setting.
Prepare to dock your skills and master the cosmos in Stellar Docks!

70010000092276.name: Zombie Strike Force
70010000092276.intro: The undead have taken over—gear up, survive, and fight back!
70010000092276.description: Step into the boots of an elite soldier on a mission to eliminate hordes of mutated zombies in a post-apocalyptic world. Navigate through high-tech underground facilities and eerie wastelands, using advanced weaponry and tactical skills to outsmart the undead. Face off against relentless enemies, dodge deadly traps, and uncover dark secrets hidden beneath the ruins. Only the strongest will make it out alive—are you ready to lead the resistance?

70010000092281.name: The Harmony Chronicles: Demon of the Void Collector's Edition
70010000092281.intro: Saga continues, Mona is about to travel through dimensions!
70010000092281.description:
After her incredible adventures, Mona, the warrior of Goddess Harmony, 
prepares to meet her divine protector before a magic portal transports her to a world on the brink of collapse. 
Mona discovers she has arrived at the once-thriving Interdimensional University of Magic, which has become a shadow of its former self.

As the fate of the universe hangs in the balance, Mona embarks on a perilous journey through shattered dimensions, 
chasing clues that lead to a terrifying entity devouring everything in its path. 

To stop it, she must venture across awe-inspiring worlds, each filled with unique challenges, fantastical creatures, and powerful allies!

70010000092285.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Gangneung City
70010000092285.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000092285.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Gangneung-si, Korea with "Real" footage! 
This work takes place in Gangneung-si, Samcheok-si, etc. 
There are a total of 11 flight courses. 
1080P high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to 11 locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Gangneung-si, Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000092290.name: Ball Blast
70010000092290.intro: Dodge falling rocks and blast them all!
70010000092290.description:
A wild rain of bouncing rocks crashes down - move fast, blast faster! 

Every rock has a number - hit it that many times and boom! it splits into two rocks with half the number and double the speed, turning the field into fast-moving chaos!

Play solo or with a friend for double firepower. Beat hundreds of levels, survive endless waves, and climb the world leaderboard!

Pick up coins and unlock new cannons: a wide-spread shotgun, a boomerang that swings back and spinning saw blades that slice through rocks as they fall. Upgrade power-ups like a piercing laser beam, explosive drones, and huge shockwaves to wipe out waves in a flash!

Features:
