- CO-OP: Team up with a friend and fend off the falling rocks together!
- Online Leaderboards: Survive as long as you can and get the best score in the world!
- Powerful Cannons: Choose between basic, shotgun, boomerang, and saw cannons!
- Devastating powers: Buy and upgrade powerful abilities to destroy everything!
- Special Levels: Defeat epic bosses and protect the bridge from destruction!
- Replayability: Complete hundreds of unique levels and challenges!

The rocks won’t stop bouncing—are you ready to keep blasting?

70010000092292.name: The Abandoned Planet
70010000092292.intro: A retro-inspired, pixel art, point and click adventure.
70010000092292.description:
When a wormhole tears open in space, an astronaut is hurled down and crashes on a distant planet. But where is she? Where are all the inhabitants of the planet? And how is she going to get back home? Solve the puzzle and piece together the mystery in this 2D, pixel art, first person, point and click adventure.

Inspired by games like Myst and Riven with a dash of the LucasArt adventures of the 90s, The Abandoned Planet is sure to scratch that old-school, adventure game itch.

• Beautiful chunky pixel art
• Hundreds of locations to explore
• Classic point and click adventure
• Fully voiced in English

Text localized into the following languages:

• English
• Spanish
• Italian
• French
• German
• Japanese
• Korean
• Portuguese
• Russian
• Chinese Simplified
• Chinese Traditional

70010000092300.name: Maths Pals
70010000092300.intro: Join six adorable animal friends on a journey to master math! From counting to multiplication, tackle fun challenges, earn stars, and watch your skills soar—all at your own pace!
70010000092300.description: Step into the colorful world of Maths Pals, where six delightful animal friends are ready to make math fun, interactive, and easy to learn! Designed for kids in Grade 1 and Grade 2, this engaging educational game will help young learners develop essential math skills while having a great time.

70010000092303.name: Idol Symphony
70010000092303.intro: Melodies, outfits and puzzles – the bright show begins!
70010000092303.description:
Welcome to the world of bright performances and melodies, where the main characters are vocal performers in stunning outfits, performing exciting songs at concerts! Each puzzle assembly opens a new scene from their performances, full of shine, emotions and stylish outfits, made in anime style.

Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of spotlights and enthusiastic applause, collecting magnificent pictures with every detail worked out to perfection. You will find a variety of puzzles that will allow you to enjoy the beauty of the characters and their unique images!

Features:

• Charming characters in exquisite concert outfits
• Simple but exciting puzzle mechanics
• The ability to enjoy images after completing a level
• Difficulty suitable for all players
• Enchanting music that creates a concert atmosphere

70010000092308.name: Cornhole
70010000092308.intro: Toss beanbags onto the board or into the hole to score in this fun party game!
70010000092308.description:
Cornhole is a popular lawn game enjoyed by people around the world at outdoor events.  Use motion controls to toss the bags onto the board or into the hole for points!  Play one-off games for fun and practice. Enter career mode and play in venues around the world as you climb to Cornhole stardom!

Supports 1 to 4 players with optional AI players.  Fun for the whole family!

70010000092310.name: Evel Knievel
70010000092310.intro: Ride and jump your way to glory on a motorcycle and a prayer!
70010000092310.description:
Relive Evel Knievel's legendary jumps like never before! From daring motorcycle stunts to riding a rocket over Snake River Canyon, this is the ultimate tribute to America's greatest daredevil. Play solo or multiplayer with up to four friends!

Laugh with friends as you crash hilariously! Earn trophies, climb the leaderboards, and customize Evel’s gear with iconic outfits and powerful bikes. There's always a new challenge waiting!

Can you conquer Evel Knievel’s most daring jumps and land safely on the other side? Get ready for the ride of your life!

True Story
Evel Knievel became the most famous daredevil in history by performing dangerous and amazing motorcycle jumps. Relive the exploits of this American folk hero by stepping into his shoes with the Official Evel Knievel game!

Advance through his spectacular career, starting with a humble 250cc Scrambler, jumping Rattlesnakes and Lions. Work your way up to the 750cc Ultimate and insane jumps over 13 London Buses and the Las Vegas Casino Fountain!

This update of the Official Evel Knievel game adds a new venue, Snake River Canyon, and new vehicle, the Skycycle X-2 rocket, as well as new multiplayer support! Have a laugh-out-loud, fun time with your family and friends!

Play with Friends!
Play single player or local multiplayer with up to four players! 
Motorcycle multiplayer is cooperative, with players taking turns to complete the course and advance the group to the next venue. 
Rocket multiplayer is competitive, with players launching their Skycycle X-2 rockets at the same time, vying to score the highest total points over several attempts to land closest to the target.  

Level Up Your Rider 
Achieve goals for experience points so you can level up and increase your rider stats: 
Strength – Survive harder landings
Charisma – Collect coins in a larger radius 
Agility – Rotate your bike in the air faster
Goals are revealed as you advance, with up to four to choose from at any given time. 

Customize & Upgrade 
Collect as many coins as you can while riding through the obstacles and flying through the air! Spend your coins to buy loads of fantastic outfits, including Evel Knievel’s iconic White and Blue leathers, and upgrade your bike all the way to the awesome Jet-Powered Stratocycle!
Plenty of Content!
• 28 Challenging Jumps in 10 Historic Locations, including;
     - Las Vegas (Casino Fountain)
     - Chicago (Man Eating Sharks!)
     - Ontario (18 Cars and a Van)
     - London (13 London Buses)
     - NEW: Snake River Canyon (rocket jump over canyon) 
• 11 Amazing Bikes, including:
     - 250cc Scrambler
     - 650cc Deluxe
     - 750cc Ultimate
     - The Jet-Powered Stratocycle
     - NEW: Skycycle X-2 rocket for the Snake River Canyon jump
•  8 Classic Outfits and 20 Special Helmets to collect
•  Achievements and Local Leaderboards
•  Dozens of Goals (Complete goals to Level Up Evel and boost his stats)
•  Bronze, Silver and Gold Trophies to earn on each Jump

“Anybody can jump a motorcycle. The trouble begins when you try to land it!” – Evel Knievel

70010000092312.name: Finnigan Fox
70010000092312.intro: Finnigan Fox journeys through mystical lands, wielding a bladed crossbow and season-switching magic to overcome foes and save the forest!
70010000092312.description:
Finnigan Fox is a 2D action platformer with fun RPG elements. Inspired by the glorious days of 16-bit platformers, Finnigan Fox presents classic gameplay in beautiful, colorful, hi-res graphics with a difficulty level adapted to modern sensibilities--meaning it’s not so brutally hard!

A FOX LIKE NO OTHER 

Play as our titular hero, a clever red fox named Finnigan. Run and leap your way across the land on your mission to save the forest. Wield your bladed crossbow to defeat enemies in your path! Cast magic that changes the season to alter the terrain and neutralize some enemies. You’ll need a combination of melee and magic to solve the puzzles in a mystical land filled with strange creatures and challenging landscapes. 

UPGRADES & BOSSES!

Collect treasure and special items along the way (sometimes hidden). Trade them in at the forest shops to upgrade your arrows and increase your physical and magical capacity.  You’ll need those upgrades to prepare yourself to take on screen-sized bosses!

Each boss is a giant enemy with a different behavior and unique vulnerability. Use your nimble movement to avoid their attacks until you can solve the puzzle of how to defeat them!

5 SEASONS!

Switch between seasons to alter the terrain, explore new areas, outfox enemies and uncover amazing secrets.

HERO’S JOURNEY

Help Finnigan Fox uncover the mystery of the 5th season and bring back justice to the forests and its inhabitants.

ACTION PLATFORMER!

Finnigan Fox is an epic adventure with engaging RPG elements, clever puzzles and thrilling platforming.

70010000092323.name: TriggerHeart EXELICA ENHANCED
70010000092323.intro: "Pull the trigger of your heart once again with new friends!"
70010000092323.description:
■New game experience
Playable character "Faintia"
Trigger Heart Faintia appears as a playable character.
Faintia has been redesigned for this game and is equipped with a special laser that allows for sustained attacks.
Enjoy Enhanced with a slightly different attack style from Exelica and Cruelica.
Playable modes
Arcade mode
In addition to Exelica and Cruelica, Faintia's short story and ending will be added.
The score calculation method has been changed from the arcade mode of the previous game, Trigger Heart Exelica.
Enhanced story mode
A mode in which a story using approximately 70 still illustrations unfolds with full voice.
The illustrations have been made high-resolution, allowing you to experience the world of Enhanced, which has become even more beautiful.
Opening movie included

A fully animated opening movie produced by P.A.WORKS has been added, and the theme song is "GRAVITY ERROR" (sung by Ayane)
※Other features
・Training mode
・Vertical screen support (arcade mode only)

70010000092325.name: Irem Collection Volume 3
70010000092325.intro: Three fantasy horizontal shoot ‘em ups from IREM’s arcade vault – Mr. Heli, Mystic Riders, and Dragon Breed, all in one explosive collection!
70010000092325.description:
ININ is back with Volume 3 of the IREM Collection, delivering a trio of fantastical shoot 'em ups! This time, it´s magic, machines, and mayhem. 

Mr. Heli (Battle Chopper) 
Meet Mr. Heli, the quirky, legged chopper with a whole lot of firepower! Debuting in Japanese arcades in 1987, this multidirectional “cute ‘em up” shooter lets you pilot through inventive stages filled with puzzle-like maps, hidden paths, and massive bosses. Mine crystals, earn cash, and upgrade your arsenal to keep those rotor blades spinning! 

Mystic Riders 
Magic meets mayhem in Mystic Riders, the 1992 fantasy shooter where you ride broomsticks and battle giant sky turtles, flaming demons, and other mythical creatures. Use your broom as a boomerang to block projectiles, dodge-roll past dangerous hazards, and blast through vibrant worlds. Don't go it alone – team up in local co-op as Mark the wizard or Zeal the witch for an enchanted ride through arcade history. 

Dragon Breed 
Finally, from brooms to dragons – the 1989 arcade gem Dragon Breed throws you into a biomechanical nightmare! Ride into battle on the mighty dragon Bahamoot who can shield you from danger and scorch everything in your path. Think R-Type meets fantasy apocalypse – with wings. 

Features: 
- Three high-fantasy and sci-fi horizontal shoot ‘em ups from IREM. 
- Included Versions: 
- Mr. Heli/Battle Chopper: Arcade (English/Japanese), PC Engine (Japanese) 
-- Mystic Riders: Arcade (English/Japanese) 
-- Dragon Breed: Arcade (English/Japanese) 
- Optional controller enhancements, including rapid-fire button assignment and customizable control layouts. 
- Quick save/load and built-in rewind to keep the action flowing. 
- Display filters to recreate that original arcade look and feel. 
- Worldwide leaderboards to show off your high-score dominance. 
- Local 2-player co-op in Mystic Riders for magical tag-team action. 
- Packed with bizarre enemies, massive bosses, and legendary gameplay. 

Experience the magic, machines, and mayhem of IREM's arcade brilliance – all in one explosive collection!

70010000092327.name: Around the World 2: Travel to Canada Collector's Edition
70010000092327.description:
Embark on an exciting journey exploring the beauty of Canada. 
Get ready to search for various objects, play exciting mini-games and collect souvenirs.
It is an exciting adventure offering many ways to find hidden objects and a wide selection of exciting mini-games.
You will be able to visit majestic mountains, conquer Arctic expanses, 
immerse yourself in the beauty of Canadian lakes, explore great cities, including Toronto and Vancouver, 
and enjoy the nature of national parks. 

The game will give you the opportunity to use your skills and knowledge to complete mini-games and find all the hidden objects.

The collector 's edition includes: 
- 10 additional locations 
- 10 additional mini-games, as well as 12 puzzles for real fans 
- Shop with Canadian souvenirs

70010000092335.name: FatalZone
70010000092335.intro: FatalZone is an auto shooter with roguelike and RPG elements set in a savage world of zombies. Exterminate zombie hordes, collect resources, upgrade your camp, and level up mercenaries.
70010000092335.description:
FatalZone, an auto-shooter with roguelike and RPG elements, is now out in full! A dangerous zombie virus has brought humanity to the brink of extinction, but we’re not going down without a fight! Combat hordes of zombies and send mercenaries on deadly expeditions to collect resources for one of the last survivor strongholds. Do everything you can to save humanity!

Survival takes a deadly toll…

Exterminate hordes of zombies in a world devastated by a deadly virus and collect resources for one of the last survivor camps. FatalZone is an auto shooter with roguelike and RPG elements where you fortify your camp and send mercenaries on deadly missions... all of that to save humanity!

Risk it all on deadly runs to create the most effective build and unlock a slew of new skills and new characters. Level up your merc on the battlefield and grant them new skill combos in the camp. The more runs, the more seasoned your veterans are, but everyone is mortal.

Develop your survivor camp to unlock buffs. Upgrade merc skills in the Training Hall, recruit new mercs at the Mercenary Base, and upgrade your weapons and armor in the workshop. Upgraded buildings increase your chances of survival.

During a run, your mercs are exposed to the virus that takes its toll on the body. A bigger viral load undermines a merc's physical state and increases their chances of developing a mutation that could be beneficial or detrimental. Experiment to create the most viable fighter!

If you're about to be overwhelmed by the zombies’ onslaught, run for your life! Evac is always an option — wrap your mission up early and live to fight another day. Just make it to the copter!

Features:
- Upgrade your camp to unlock buffs, equipment, and mercs
- Hire and train new mercs to replace KIAs
- Use the evac copter to wrap up missions early
- Create the most effective merc build
- Gain mutations that give unique skills or debuffs
- Use the inventory to place weapons and armor. Weapons grant starting fighting skills, while armor provides stats
- Choose from 6 levels of difficulty
- Fight on procedurally generated maps. Every run is a new challenge!
- Unlock numerous achievements to prove your mettle

The full version of the game includes:
- 5 locations
- 9 playable classes
- 57 unique perks for your Mercs
- 9 weapon types
- 9 armor types
- 9 ultimate abilities
- 43 offensive and defensive skills
- 15 weapon and offensive skill evolutions
- 41 enemy variations (with 21 unique designs)
- 6 difficulty levels for all locations
- 7 base buildings, each with their own functionality and 10 upgrade levels
- 51 Merc stats
- Numerous mutations that randomize said stats
- 5 boosters (not counting resources and experience)
- 330 achievements

70010000092340.name: CubbettyCube
70010000092340.intro: Test your precision in this simple yet challenging platforming adventure!
70010000092340.description: Time your jumps perfectly, avoid falling into the abyss, and conquer carefully designed levels that will put your skills to the test.

70010000092350.name: Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders
70010000092350.intro: A murder brought about by the twisted oppression of the Showa era... Famous detective Kosuke Kindaichi's first case, the Honjin Murder Mystery.
70010000092350.description:
A mystery puzzle novel game full of the emotion, fear, and macabre from the Showa era has arrived in the modern Reiwa era.

The Koto Murder Case... A horrifying locked room murder that beset the Ichiyanagi family.
Together with a detective novelist from Okayama, your goal is to piece together testimonies collected from villagers and those involved in the incident and uncover the truth.
Then, you must complete the detective novel based on this incident.
What kind of ending awaits you?

It begins:
On November 26, 1937 at approximately 4:00 AM, honjin descendant Kenzo Ichiyanagi and his new wife Katsuko Kubo lay dead in a bed of blood on the night of their wedding.
Aside from the lifeless married couple, not a soul lurked inside the annexe on the night of the incident.
T'was a "locked room murder" with the fallen snow covering any traces of an escaped killer.
After hearing of the incident, detective Kosuke Kindaichi arrives at the scene, collecting testimonies about the incident as he searches for the truth about this locked room murder mystery. However...

Gameplay:
A unique experience with the thrill of piecing together clues and testimonies like a puzzle while also enjoying the immersive feeling of learning the truth as it unfolds.
・The visuals and sounds of Japanese horror heighten the excitement of this mystery drama.
・As you lead the story to its conclusion, you will discover the shocking truth behind the incident.

70010000092356.name: Mortal Glory 2
70010000092356.intro: Manage a team of traveling gladiators in this turn-based fantasy roguelike.
70010000092356.description:
Find the best recruits, discover powerful item combinations and come up with clever tactics on the battlefield. The tournament awaits those who desire MORTAL GLORY!

QUICK TURN-BASED COMBAT
Roll an explosive barrel at your enemy, throw them into a pit or take out two enemies by knocking them into each other. With a wide variety of tools available to you, your creativity will determine how you deal with the competition. Unique arenas, randomized environments and occasional special rules ensure that each fight offers new tactical opportunities.

RECRUIT A TEAM
A wide variety of fantasy races are seeking glory, each with their own unique racial strengths. Whatever your tactics are, finding the best recruits is essential!

UNIQUE LOOT
There is a vast collection of unique relics, character perks and more to discover. Finding clever combos and deadly synergies will unlock new strategies and occasionally turn your gladiators into unfairly strong demons.

SKILLED AI
Various difficulty settings will accommodate your preferred playstyle and there are increasingly harder challenges to master. But beware... The AI is brutally talented at the highest levels.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH
With every step comes a new challenge or perhaps... an opportunity? It is up to you to guide where your team should travel next... and suffer the consequences.

REPLAYABILITY
Each playthrough is different! With various tactics to try and additional increasingly harder challenges to master, the arena will keep welcoming you back again and again. Thanks to conveniently paced combat, Mortal Glory 2 is also great to play if you only have a moment to spare.

70010000092361.name: Oil Refinery - The Simulation
70010000092361.intro: Operate a fully functional oil refinery! Control distillation, manage pipelines, refine fuels, maintain machinery, and optimize production. Balance efficiency, safety, and profits to ex
70010000092361.description:
Oil Refinery - The Simulation puts you in charge of a fully operational oil refinery, where precision, efficiency, and strategic decision-making determine success. From crude oil intake to the production of refined fuels and valuable chemicals, every step of the refining process is in your hands.

- Master the Refining Process – Control distillation, cracking, and blending operations to produce gasoline, diesel, and other essential products.

- Operate Heavy Machinery – Manage industrial equipment, monitor pipelines, and ensure seamless production flow.

- Balance Efficiency and Safety – Prevent breakdowns, regulate pressure levels, and perform critical maintenance to keep operations running smoothly.

- Adapt to Market Fluctuations – Track global oil prices, adjust production strategies, and optimize logistics for maximum profitability.

- Upgrade and Expand – Invest in cutting-edge technology, expand refinery capacity, and enhance automation to stay ahead of the competition.

- Face Real-World Challenges – Deal with equipment failures, environmental hazards, and supply chain disruptions that threaten production.

With realistic mechanics, highly detailed industrial environments, and deep resource management, Oil Refinery - The Simulation delivers an immersive experience of one of the world’s most vital industries. Can you optimize your refinery, maximize profits, and dominate the global energy market?

70010000092363.name: Hentai Waifu 4
70010000092363.intro: A puzzle with charming girls drawn in anime style!
70010000092363.description:
Get ready to meet charming girls posing in seductive and stylish outfits that emphasize their unique appeal! Every detail in the game is carefully designed so that you can feel the realism of assembling a real puzzle. With each new level, you will see more and more candid and intriguing images. Relax and enjoy every step on the way to completing the masterpiece!

Features:
• Delightful girls in daring and sophisticated outfits
• Fascinating and simple gameplay that captivates you from the first minutes
• The ability to study each image in detail after assembly
• Different puzzle difficulty
• Atmospheric music

70010000092373.name: Breakout Beyond
70010000092373.intro: Breakout is back! Choice Provisions has flipped the legendary series on its head. Or rather side.
70010000092373.description:
In this neon-drenched take on the classic, you’ll need to literally break through each puzzle by clearing bricks to breach the final goal. Longer play will rack up a combo and increase the intensity of the effects creating a spectacular light show as a reward for the most skilled players.

Special blocks will grant an edge like large brick-clearing blasts, a barrier that’ll save your ball, and a laser cannon to clear a path. Each one will reward players with dazzling dynamic effects that create an excitement that hasn’t been seen in Breakout before. 

Each of the 72 levels will push your skills to the limit, but you won’t be without help. A focus mode will allow you to slow down time at the expense of your score. Or, if you want some help and company, you can tag in a friend to play through the entire game in local two-player co-op.

Features

- 72 levels that will push your brick-breaking skills to the test
- Unlockable endless mode with an online global leaderboard
- Two-player co-op to manage the chaos with a friend
- Procedural audio and visual effects that ramp up with your combo

70010000092381.name: Game Builder Tycoon
70010000092381.description:
Create and sell games, gain fame and wealth, research new technologies, hire employees, improve your office, manage taxes and payroll, take out loans if necessary and compete with 5000 companies. Experience the thrill of running your own studio in Game Builder Tycoon.

Design outstanding games by selecting key elements such as art, features, quests, dialogue, music, level and world design. Assign tasks to characters, choose genre, theme, platform, game size, art style, point of view and features. Market your game and create sequels. 

Choose your character and define his or her role, whether as a coder or an artist. Each character has three attributes: IQ, creativity and insight, which influence six skills: technical, art, writing, design, music and marketing. Create a unique character. As you progress, hire more employees and continually train yourself and your team in a variety of ways.

Discover new genres, themes, devices, game sizes, art styles, features, viewpoints and marketing strategies. With over 60 unlockable elements, the possibilities are endless for creating your next hit games.

Want to create bigger games? Earn enough money to upgrade your office and hire new employees, so you can expand your team's capabilities and create bigger, better games than ever before.

Feeling demotivated? Don't worry, you're competing with 5,000 other companies. They're smart and hard-working, just like your team. Create better games and use effective marketing tactics to earn more and stay ahead.

70010000092388.name: Backrooms: Exit from Supermarket Horror
70010000092388.intro: Trapped, Lost, Hunted. Can You Escape?
70010000092388.description:
Welcome to a terrifying survival horror game where the mundane turns into a nightmare. You find yourself trapped in an endless, eerie supermarket—fluorescent lights flicker, aisles stretch into the void, and something lurks in the shadows.

Explore the abandoned store, solve cryptic puzzles, and search for an escape while evading unseen horrors that stalk your every move. The deeper you go, the more reality distorts, turning familiar shelves into a twisted maze of paranoia and dread.

With immersive sound design, dynamic AI-driven threats, and a chilling atmosphere, every step could be your last. Will you find the exit, or become just another lost soul in the supermarket's endless depths?

70010000092393.name: Particle Hearts
70010000092393.intro: Explore a world made entirely of particles.
70010000092393.description:
A Land of Particles
Particle Hearts is a 3rd-person adventure game where you explore a world made entirely of particles.  Use special abilities to manipulate those particles, solve puzzles, avoid detection, and navigate this sinister and beautiful land.

Befriend or Fight
Along the way, meet various creatures, some of which will help you understand your purpose and others who are tasked with hiding it from you.

A Hidden Truth
Collect memories, find hidden paths, and piece together your connection to this land that isn’t always what it seems.

Key Features
■  Gain multiple abilities that allow you to manipulate the particles around you.
■  Use your abilities to solve puzzles, evade enemies, and gain access to hidden areas.
■  Freely explore open environments any way you’d like.
■  Experience a story where the line between friend and foe is often blurred.  Meet various creatures that help you unravel your purpose in this land.

70010000092401.name: Pirarucu's Money Rush
70010000092401.intro:
Pirarucu is on a shopping spree!
The spending just won’t stop!
A simple yet addictive shopping runner!
70010000092401.description:
A mountain of coins suddenly appears before Pirarucu, who loves shopping more than anything!
With this much money, she might be able to shop to her heart’s content!
Grace and elegance? Out the window.
Pirarucu dashes forward—leaping over cliffs, stomping enemies, and dodging fireballs… for all in the name of shopping!

This spin-off mini-game from Goonya Monster stars series favorite Pirarucu.
Spend your coins or save them—it’s all part of your strategy!
Charge through a wild and unpredictable shopping run!

◇ Simple controls!
Use jumps and double jumps to navigate the stage.
Timing is everything!
Easy to learn, fun for players of all ages.

◆ Become the ultimate shopaholic runner!
At checkpoints, you can spend your coins on skills and items to boost your run.
Go on a spending spree too fast, and you’ll run out of coins in no time—so spend wisely. (That goes for everything.)

◆ Danger lurks along the way…!
Enemies and fireballs will try to stop your run.
Crash into them, and it’s game over!
Stomp enemies to clear your path, and dodge fireballs with well-timed jumps.

◆ Shopping is a race against time!
Pirarucu keeps accelerating as she runs.
Push forward through the chaos and make it to the next checkpoint!

◇ Battle mode (Offline 2-player mode)
In battle mode, Pirarucu’s stepbrother Clione joins the action from Goonya Monster!
Use items and outplay your opponent to collect more coins before time runs out.
Jump on your rival to steal their coins—it’s all part of the competition!

70010000092406.name: Deer & Boy
70010000092406.intro: A runaway boy meets a fawn in this poetic cinematic adventure where silence speaks louder than words and growing up changes everything.
70010000092406.description:
Deer & Boy is a narrative cinematic adventure that tells a silent story through stunning visuals and evocative music.

With no dialogue to distract, every moment speaks directly to the heart, making it accessible to players of all ages and backgrounds.
A warm and poetic journey to rediscover wonder. An animated film you can play!

A runaway boy meets a fragile fawn. Experience their silent bond through stunning visuals and music in this poetic cinematic adventure that speaks directly to the heart.

An Original and Evolving Adventure

Your companion grows from vulnerable fawn to majestic deer, changing how you play together. Protect your fragile friend early on, then work as equals with evolving abilities.

A Story for Everyone

Young players will see a beautiful friendship between a boy and his deer. Adult players may discover deeper themes about healing and finding strength through companionship. Everyone finds their own meaning in this contemplative experience.

Deer & Boy offers understanding layers that make it perfect for solo play or sharing with family.

KEY FEATURES
Silent Storytelling: No dialogue. Pure visual and musical emotion
Evolving Companion: The animal will gradually grow throughout the story and will become an essential and protective companion.
Play An Animated Film: Cinematic adventure with breathtaking art direction.
Engaging puzzles: Clever challenges integrated into your journey.Cinematic Adventure: Beautiful 3D environments with movie-like presentation
Family-Friendly: Suitable for all ages with no graphic violence or complex text
Complete Journey: A complete adventure you can finish in a few play sessions

"A single-player game where you're never alone."

Experience a unique cinematic adventure where an animal truly grows up alongside you, bringing invaluable support during your journey through a world of wonder, challenge, and hope.

70010000092408.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
70010000092408.description:
*This is the Nintendo Switch™ version. There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully. 

In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle.

Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

[About the Game]
Befriend a Medley of Monsters
- There's a whole host of monsters to befriend, including many familiar favorites from across the DRAGON QUEST series.
- While each monster has its own traits and attributes, they can also learn a variety of talents, allowing you to fine tune your party to match your playstyle.
- Combine two monsters via synthesis to create an even stronger creature, maybe even one you've never seen before.
- Create a party of your favorite monsters that fights exactly the way you want. The possibilities are mind-boggling!

A World Full of Wonder
- With the game's unique visual style, you never quite know what lies beyond the curve of the horizon.
- Each step forward reveals more about your surroundings, where new discoveries and fresh surprises await.

Monsters by Your Side
- Your monsters will follow you as you explore the world so you can enjoy every adventure together.
- You can take any monster along with you, regardless of its type or size.

Stay Competitive with Extra Content
- Online features allow you to battle with monster wranglers the world over.
- With a variety of modes to enjoy, from serious tournaments to friendly matches, there's plenty to try.
- Send your strongest party into battle and be in with a shot at earning fantastic prizes!

70010000092414.name: Aleesha's Tower
70010000092414.intro: Prevent Aleesha from destroying all mankind!
70010000092414.description:
A young woman named Aleesha was hunted and killed, accused of witchcraft. Years later, she comes back to take revenge on all mankind... and it's up to you to stop her!

Aleesha's Tower is an action platformer game inspired by the arcade classics of the 80's and 90's. In the game, you are a warrior and must prevent the evil horde created by Aleesha from destroying all mankind.

Go through 6 different scenarios, each one with a unique boss at the end. Besides your trusty sword and shield, you'll find various sub-weapons along the way that will help you complete your journey.

Features:
* Handmade pixel art
* 6 different bosses
* Lots of nostalgia for those who lived the arcade era
* Many different enemies
* And much more...

70010000092426.name: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club TOKIMEKI Roadmap to Future
70010000092426.intro: The first visual novel game of Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club!
70010000092426.description:
▼STORY
The TOKIMEKI-filled days that you spent with the 12 members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. 
 You loved and cherished all of those sparkling moments, each of which shone like a rainbow. 
 But then, all of those irreplaceable memories suddenly slip away from your mind, lost.

"They were so bright and warm, truly irreplaceable... But now, I doubt that I'll ever hold them again..."

The members do all they can for you to regain your lost memories. 
 The curtain rises on the story of you and the 12 members searching for the missing pieces of that TOKIMEKI!

"That TOKIMEKI, once more. And forevermore."

▼A school life searching for TOKIMEKI with the 12 members.
Interact with the members and deepen your bonds! 
You can also chat with other students outside of the School Idol Club ♪

▼Enjoy special moments with the members 
Various events will occur as your bonds deepen! 
Enjoy the members' various expressions they would show only to you alone ♡ 
Exclusive new visuals of the cute members are also included!

▼Gather pieces of TOKIMEKI
As you interact with the different members, your memories will change...? 
Accumulate precious memories and strengthen the bond between you and the members!

▼The future will change based on your choices!
Experience different endings for each member! 
The future's in the palm of your hands! 
What will await you after clearing all the endings...?

70010000092428.name: Puzzle Lights and Mushrooms 1000
70010000092428.intro: A simple puzzle, brightened by mushrooms!
70010000092428.description:
Puzzle Lights & Mushrooms 1000 is a simple logic puzzle with straightforward rules.
Just follow the rules and make sure every blank square is illuminated by a light.
Create an environment where mushrooms can thrive.

An easygoing challenge. A total of 1000 stages!

70010000092433.name: Chaos Galaxy 2
70010000092433.description:
Story Background
The thousand-year-old Galactic Empire collapses under the attack of alien creatures. Admirals, pirates, merchant guilds, the Church, mercenaries, and colonists plunge into a chaotic struggle for dominance.

Yet humanity faces an even greater threat: the rebellious AI legions and the resurgence of the alien hive fleets begin their merciless purge of mankind. The climactic battle of Ragnarök has begun! Wield your strategy and courage to end the chaos of the galaxy!

Govern Your Nation
Build various districts on your planets—farmlands, mines, hive cities, and laboratories on the surface; shipyards, armories, and orbital fortresses in space.

Command Warfare
Produce diverse warships and mechs, appoint formidable commanders to lead your fleets, crush enemy forces, and conquer their planets.

Dynamic Events
Hundreds of story-driven events unfold over time, shaped by intricate relationships between characters.

Diplomatic Maneuvers
Navigate a galaxy filled with dozens of major factions and countless minor powers. Forge alliances, subjugate vassals, and sow discord among enemy coalitions.

Policies and Technology
Each faction has a unique policy tree to unlock five advanced unit types and dozens of military/civil bonuses. Research alien biotechnology to develop "Bio-Armor," recover lost tech from drifting arks, or seize enemy blueprints by annihilating rival factions.

Diverse Factions
Eight distinct faction archetypes, each with unique playstyles, exclusive units, and specialized planetary structures.

70010000092438.name: Stewardess Girls
70010000092438.intro: Puzzles, passion and irresistible beauty await.
70010000092438.description:
Enter a world of captivating charm and intrigue in Stewardess Girls, where breathtaking anime artwork meets an enticing puzzle adventure. Solve mind-teasing challenges to unveil a story filled with mystery, romance, and irresistible allure.

Main Features:
	•	Unravel a seductive mystery – Solve puzzles to reveal an enchanting narrative where each anime beauty holds a piece of the truth.
	•	Stunning visuals & animations – Explore a gallery of mesmerizing characters, each brought to life with detailed art and unique personalities.
	•	Engaging puzzle mechanics – Test your logic and strategy with a variety of challenges, unlocking new scenes and hidden secrets along the way.

Step into this mesmerizing adventure, embrace the thrill of discovery, and indulge in an unforgettable journey of passion and intrigue!

70010000092469.name: Grab it! Crane Game
70010000092469.intro:
Gear up for an arcade classic: the crane game!
Win as many prizes as you can and become a crane game master!
70010000092469.description:
Let's enjoy a crane game on the Nintendo Switch™!
Share Joy-Con™ and play with up to 4 players!
Show off your skills with a super play!

[Score Attack]
Get lots of prizes and aim for a top spot on the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Face off against CPUs in single-player mode, or test your skills against friends in multiplayer battles!
Challenge crane game masters from all over the world in online battles!

[Collection]
Step back and admire the prizes you've earned!
There are over 200 different prizes to collect!

70010000092480.name: Crosswords: World Tour
70010000092480.description:
Are you a fan of crosswords? Do you like traveling? Heck! Who doesn't?! Crosswords: World Tour is the game for you!

In Crosswords: World Tour you travel all over the world solving crosswords that unlock new destinations for you to solve more crosswords. Each crossword is unique but also follows the theme of the country you're visiting.

70010000092538.name: Touhou Artificial Dream in Arcadia
70010000092538.intro: Explore Gensokyo from an outsider's perspective in this old-school Touhou DRPG!
70010000092538.description:
Sumireko Usami is not a normal high-schooler at all. She is so abnormal that even the fantasy land of Gensokyo considers her an anomaly. Truth is, she can visit Gensokyo in her dreams!

Artificial Dream in Arcadia is a first person dungeon crawler where the player, as Sumireko, has to navigate tricky mazes and capture a party of the strongest Touhou characters to assist them in turn-based battles. Go all over Gensokyo and beyond, to solve an incident which seems a little too convenient for Sumireko, seeing as she's the only person in Gensokyo who has a tool to control this infestation of clones: her newly-bought smartphone.

70010000092541.name: Twofold
70010000092541.intro: In a bid to avoid failing out of college, Olive Penn inadvertently finds themselves caught in the middle of a feud between two campus club leaders.
70010000092541.description:
Olive’s situation is dire. They're on the verge of being thrown out of college unless they can salvage their GPA, and their only chance rests on classes they know next to nothing about.

Their lifeline: two club leaders who are more than willing to help them succeed. However, no solution is that easy. Olive soon finds themself in the middle of a conflict between these two friends that threatens to undo their long-standing love for each other.

Twofold is a story about love, family, and connection. It celebrates family of all kinds, and explores the strength (and fragility) of bonds between people.

70010000092543.name: Lucky Hunter
70010000092543.intro: Combine advanced pieces and hunt stronger enemies!
70010000092543.description:
After the catastrophe, the world became devastated, monsters roamed freely, crops could no longer grow. People had to rely on hunters to obtain the necessary water and food. It is said that all the disasters originated from a demon king. The legendary lucky hunter set out to hunt the demon king but never returned...

Under the old village chief's guidance, a young hunter, carrying chess pieces with magical power, set off on a hunting journey along the path once taken by the legendary hunter, bearing the hopes of the entire village. Become the lucky hunter who grows stronger with each battle, builds a unique deck, embarks on strange hunting journeys, and conquers powerful prey from forests, swamps, and volcanic regions to save this world on the brink of crisis!

As a lucky hunter who grows stronger with each battle, building a powerful deck, embarking on a unique journey of hunting, and conquering mighty prey from forest, swamp, desert, volcano and snow mountain.


-Continuously make progress through procedurally generated hunting maps, carefully choosing routes to explore different nodes such as battles, shops, enchantments, events, and more.
-Your pieces are automatically played onto the battlefield, and players will focus on matching and building unique decks and relics, fully exploiting the synergies between pieces.
-When three same-level pieces are adjacent on the battlefield, they will automatically combine into a higher-level piece, forging an unbreakable force.
-Gain new pieces every turn in battles, building your own powerful deck from over 100 pieces and 100 relics.
-As battles last, the attack from the prey will become increasingly fierce. Eliminate opponents in time and strive to become stronger before death comes.
-Regardless of success or failure, each adventure yields experience and lessons. Improve base attributes through external growth, and purchase unique piece packs that introduce new mechanics.

70010000092548.name: Troublemaker
70010000092548.intro: Grab a backpack, boxing tape, and focus on what high school is all about: Beating the ever loving crap out of one another!
70010000092548.description:
Troublemaker blends favorite action-adventure-beat-'em-up elements from the strongest traditions in the genre. 
Go to school, make new friends, beat old enemies up, solve world-class problems (like grades and girlfriends), and don’t let your mom down by getting arrested or worse - flunking out!
As Budi, the new transfer to one of Indonesia's finest high schools, literally fight your way to the top of the social food chain through the school's annual student fighting tournament, aptly named Raise Your Gang.
Troublemaker is all about smooth and over-the-top combat in Indonesia's greatest adolescent combat arena. Punch, kick, break, smash, or gently swing Budi’s way up to the top with more than 30 iconic moves.

70010000092559.name: ABYSS SEEKERーーWhat Do You See Deep in The Abyss
70010000092559.description:
ABYSS SEEKER is a twin-stick survivor shooter where you freely control your character with two sticks. Survive against hordes of enemies within the time limit, defeat the boss appearing in the final wave, and advance to the next dungeon.
The shots fired by the player character can be customized by combining items that appear upon leveling up, transforming their properties. Create your own unique shots and defeat the relentless forces of darkness to survive!

70010000092564.name: Cats Logic
70010000092564.intro:
THINK LIKE A CAT!
Solve Puzzles, Move Boxes, Master the Logic!
70010000092564.description:
Enter a world of clever cats and challenging puzzles in Cats Logic, the ultimate brain-teasing adventure for feline lovers and puzzle enthusiasts alike!

Test your logic skills with a delightful mix of Sudoku-inspired challenges and box-moving puzzles, where each level brings a new twist to classic problem-solving gameplay. Strategize, plan your moves, and help the mischievous yet brilliant cats organize their cozy space.

With an intuitive design, relaxing yet stimulating gameplay, and an irresistibly charming cast of fluffy friends, Cats Logic is the purrfect blend of fun and mental exercise. Whether you're looking for a casual escape or a serious logic challenge, this game offers hours of rewarding entertainment.

Are you ready to think like a cat? Play now and sharpen your mind—one paw at a time!

70010000092569.name: Transporter
70010000092569.intro:
★ Drive. Master. Deliver. ★
Race against time to transport goods across various environment.
70010000092569.description:
★ WELCOME TO TRANSPORTER ★
A solo platform racing game, technical and competitive.

★ THE CONCEPT:
Choose from 3 vehicle types: Classic, Amphibious, or Military.
Your mission: deliver your cargo while avoiding obstacles, and cross the finish line with at least one item intact.

★ TECHNICAL GAMEPLAY:
Choose the right vehicle
Adjust your speed
Maintain your balance
Analyze the terrain and overcome obstacles

★ AVAILABLE WORLDS:
Indy Jungle – ideal for 4x4 vehicles
Operation Overlord – combat-focused, perfect for military vehicles
Expect around 20 hours to complete the game — and much more if you're aiming for the top of the global leaderboards!

★ VEHICLES:
Unlock 19 unique vehicles
• Classic (versatile)
• Amphibious (fast on water)
• Military (armored, can shoot)

★ GARAGE:
Tune 5 parameters: power, suspension, grip, brakes, fuel tank
Special upgrades: armor, handling, electromagnetism, and more

★ CARGO:
Unlock 11 types of cargo to deliver.

★ GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS:
Compare your scores with other players in each race via online rankings.

70010000092580.name: ESCAPE SITE 13
70010000092580.intro: Immerse yourself and uncover an SCP-style mysterious event! Are you ready to face the inexplicable and surreal phenomena?
70010000092580.description:
ESCAPE SITE 13 immerses players in a shadow-laden, side-scrolling adventure inspired by the enigmatic lore of SCP containment. Set in an original universe, it draws subtle inspiration from SCP-1730 while spinning its own uniquely dark and captivating narrative.

Step into the role of investigator, tasked with exploring the recently unearthed structure known as "Site 13." As you navigate its foreboding corridors, you will:
Unearth forgotten documents that hold the key to its mysteries.
Solve ancient puzzles designed to protect its hidden truths.
Unravel a labyrinthine history buried in the darkness for far too long.

As the team ventures deeper into the darkness of Site 13, they encounter horrors beyond comprehension. With its immersive storytelling and richly detailed world-building, ESCAPE SITE 13 invites both veteran SCP enthusiasts and newcomers to delve into the chaos of a secret too dangerous to remain concealed.

70010000092585.name: Happy Hotel
70010000092585.intro: Escape a haunted hotel—and the bunny that won’t let you leave alive.
70010000092585.description: Happy Hotel is a fast-paced horror mini-game collection that dares you to survive the handcrafted, unpredictable floors of a haunted hotel. Combining thrilling platforming, quick-thinking puzzles, and suspenseful surprises, it delivers a chilling and unforgettable experience.

70010000092590.name: City of Springs
70010000092590.intro: Design and build drones to take down a corrupt regime and their army of clockwork robots! Sneak and fight your way through the city of Riveton to inspire the people to rise up!
70010000092590.description:
"There... Can you hear it? Something is off in the way this city ticks. Let's find out what."

Sneak, fight and craft drones to take down a corrupt regime in this steampunk action adventure!

The city of Riveton has only one hope for freedom - you.

Play as Val, a brilliant mechanic from the slums who won’t stand for the injustices she witnesses daily. While the Queen’s chosen elite flaunt their wealth, ordinary people work night and day to keep the springwork foundries running - all while the ministries breathe down their necks. Every aspect of life in Riveton is regulated, and your rations will be cut if you so much as think about protesting.

Despite this, there is beauty in this last city on earth. People try to make the most of life even while facing resource shortages and the oppression of the Queen’s regime. Val is determined to help them.

City of Springs - Features

- Start a revolution in a steampunk action adventure.
- Intense tactical combat.
- Craft and assemble drones to aid your quest.
- Stealth your way past security systems and robotic guards.
- Explore the nooks and crannies of robot controlled Riveton to find valuable crafting resources.

Be the spark that ignites a revolution!

Craft and assemble robot drones to fight off a cruel regime in City of Springs. Sneak into forbidden areas, help the people rebel, and explore the streets of Riveton. Combat robotic guards with little drones you build from the scrap you find on the street. Help the populace in a time where food and water are scarce, and seek a smarter way to live.

Fight fire with fire, and fix what’s broken in this oppressed clockwork city.

70010000092595.name: Gladiators Simulator : The Champions of Liberty
70010000092595.intro: Fight for glory, battle for freedom!
70010000092595.description:
Travel back to the ruthless world of ancient Rome, where gladiators fight for their lives and the crowd demands blood. In Gladiators Simulator : The Champions of Liberty, you manage your own arena, training fighters and organizing breathtaking events to captivate the audience. Step into the sandals of a gladiator, rising from slavery to challenge fierce opponents and beasts, with one goal—freedom. Buy arenas, gear up with powerful weapons and armor, and develop strategies to outwit your enemies. The emperor has called for bread and circuses—will you deliver the ultimate spectacle?

Key Features:
• Choose your battles - face other gladiators, animals, or slaves in thrilling combat.
• Decide your opponent’s fate - spare their life or take it, but be prepared for the consequences.
• Equip and upgrade your gladiators with new weapons, armor, and skills.
• Research and recruit new types of fighters to grow your roster.

70010000092600.name: Mine Clicker - Base Craft Building Game
70010000092600.intro: Tap, Mine, Build—Create Your Ultimate Base!
70010000092600.description:
Mine Clicker: Dive into the ultimate clicker-based resource management and base-building adventure! Gather, craft, and automate your world as you grow from humble beginnings to a sprawling empire. Inspired by the addictive mechanics of classic idle games and the open-ended creativity of sandbox experiences, Mine Clicker puts you in charge of your own evolving island.

- Harvest and manage resources: Chop, mine, and collect to fuel your progress.
- Craft and construct: Build structures and craft useful tools to optimize your gameplay.
- Expand your territory: Unlock new islands and harness their unique resources.
- Parkour and explore: Traverse the 3D world with fluid movements and uncover hidden secrets.
- Play your way: Embrace active gameplay or let your base thrive on idle mechanics.
- Level up and grow: Unlock skills, blueprints, and abilities as you progress.
- Relax and thrive: No deadlines or pressures—shape your world at your own pace.

Whether you’re building, exploring, or automating, Mine Clicker offers endless opportunities for creativity and discovery.

70010000092605.name: Vampires and Knights : Eclipse Survival & Magic Craft
70010000092605.intro: Rise against vampires and emerge victorious in the kingdoms darkest battles.
70010000092605.description:
An unknown evil sorcerer has cast a powerful curse over the kingdom, enveloping the land in a mysterious fog and summoning deadly vampires that stalk the night. Solar eclipses darken the sky, signaling the arrival of these menacing creatures. As the kingdom plunges into chaos, brave knights rise as the last hope to combat this growing threat. In VAMPIRES and KNIGHTS, survival is a constant challenge.

Key features:
	•	Survival Mechanics: Scour the land for food, craft essential tools, and build fortifications to protect yourself from the relentless creatures of the night.
	•	Vampire Transformation: Experience a unique gameplay mechanic that allows you to turn into a vampire if cursed. Use this dark power to navigate the perilous nights, but be wary of the costs.
	•	Cursed Combat: Engage in brutal battles to fend off threats and collect rare resources. The wounds inflicted by vampires can lead to your own transformation, adding a dangerous twist to every fight.
	•	Human Restoration: Seek out sacred zones to regain your humanity and fight with renewed strength during the day, offering a crucial advantage in your quest.
	•	Global Quest: Embark on a dangerous journey to find seven hidden magical artifacts across treacherous regions. Combine these artifacts into a counter-curse to lift the sorcerer’s spell and save the kingdom from eternal darkness.

70010000092610.name: Electronics Supermarket Simulator
70010000092610.intro: Outsmart Rivals, Crush Sales, and Build a Tech Empire!
70010000092610.description:
Welcome to Electronics Supermarket Simulator, the ultimate experience where you'll design, manage, and grow your very own electronics retail empire. Step into the dynamic world of high-tech retail and transform your passion for electronics into a booming business.
Features:
- Craft Your Dream Tech Destination: Design your dream store layout, personalize the shopping experience, and curate a selection of the hottest tech products to fill your shelves.
- In-Depth Management: You're the boss! Manage inventory, keep shelves stocked with the latest tech, supervise staff, and ensure smooth operations to maximize customer satisfaction.
- Inventory Mastery: Become a master of inventory management. Predict customer demand, secure the best deals on the latest tech, and avoid empty shelves that can hurt your profits.
- Competitive Landscape: Navigate the cutthroat world of electronics retail. Outsmart your rivals, adapt your strategies, and stay ahead of the curve by offering the hottest tech trends and unbeatable deals.
- Market Savvy: Analyze market data, adjust your product selection and promotions to cater to customer desires, and watch your brand loyalty soar.
- Expansion Opportunities: Grow your initial supermarket into a thriving electronics chain. Expand your reach, introduce new product lines, and watch your profits soar as you dominate the market.
Electronics Supermarket Simulator offers a challenging and rewarding experience that will test your business acumen and tech expertise. Are you ready to build a tech empire and become the ultimate electronics tycoon?

70010000092615.name: Be Brave, Barb
70010000092615.description:
Barb the cactus has lost her positive affirmations! How will she get through the day? How will she face her fears? How will she defeat King Cloudy and his evil henchmen? I have no idea. Maybe you should play this gravity-bending platforming adventure and find out?

• An all-new platforming adventure from the creator of Dadish
• Walk all over the walls, ignore gravity, who cares
• Lots of positive affirmations to find
• 100 levels
• 5 bosses
• Questionable therapy
• Secrets to unlock
• Controller support
• Funky tunes
• Rad graphics
• Face your fears
• Have a nice day

70010000092617.name: Stacky Dash
70010000092617.intro: Dash your hero across the mazes, stack the tiles higher and higher, and reach for the skies!
70010000092617.description:
Get ready for non-stop fun in Stacky Dash! Slide to collect tiles, build paths, and race through colorful levels full of exciting surprises. Dodge blasting cannons, and zip through portals as you conquer each tricky stage!

Save adorable animals to grow your own zoo and take on timed challenges to test your speed. With tons of cool skins to unlock, every level is packed with energy and fun!

Features:
• Exciting Levels - Tons of fun puzzles that get trickier as you go!
• Crazy Challenges - Dodge cannon fire, zoom through portals, and avoid traps.
• Animal Rescue - Find cute animals and grow your zoo!
• Timed Mode - Race the clock for an extra challenge and rewards!
• Customization - Unlock awesome skins for your character and tiles.

Solve your way through endless puzzles in Stacky Dash!

70010000092621.name: Shooty McSpaceFace
70010000092621.intro: Save your space base by shooting down the enemies!
70010000092621.description:
Evil bosses and minions and stuff have taken over your space base!

Gear up and shoot down the enemies that have invaded each zone in this side-scrolling shooter and platformer. There's a boss at the end of each zone (because it's a video game) that will require the best of your abilities to defeat! Use everything at your disposal: your primary weapon, shields, a special attack, and more!

As the lone warrior tasked with this mission, can you save this space station from total destruction?

Features:
* 59 levels across 6 zones!
* 6 dangerous bosses to defeat!
* Arena Mode: defeat a set number of enemies before it's game over!
* Upgrade your character with 12 special attacks and 6 unique enhancements!
* Choose between 10 different character designs!
* Retro-inspired graphics and music!

70010000092629.name: Valentine's Venture: True Love Odyssey
70010000092629.intro: Follow Your Heart, Find Your Love!
70010000092629.description:
Welcome to a charming adventure platformer where love leads the way! Play as a bright-eyed heroine on a whimsical journey through magical lands, each sparkling with romance, mystery, and adventure.

Jump across heart-shaped platforms, solve adorable puzzles, and meet a cast of delightful characters—some might even be your perfect match! Explore dreamy villages, enchanted gardens, and starlit bridges as you follow your heart and uncover the magic of true love.

With colorful worlds, playful challenges, and a sweet story full of love and laughter, Valentine’s Venture is the perfect fairytale adventure for dreamers and romantics alike!

70010000092644.name: Drop That Cat
70010000092644.intro: Connect small cute kittens to big cats.
70010000092644.description: Connect the small cute kittens and experience how they grow bigger. There is a single-player mode and various two-player modes ('Time Limit' and 'Attack').

70010000092647.name: Rookie Table Tennis
70010000092647.description:
Enter the World of Rookie Table Tennis – Fast, Fun, and Competitive!

Serve, smash, and spin your way to victory in Rookie Table Tennis, the ultimate 3D ping pong showdown! With thrilling solo tournaments, exciting local multiplayer matches, and lifelike visuals, this game brings the table tennis experience to your console like never before.

Game Highlights:

-Realistic Ball Physics: Master spins/lifts, and powerful smashes with precision controls and dynamic gameplay.

-Challenging AI: Take on increasingly skilled opponents in a solo tournament designed to test your reflexes and strategy.

-Intense Local Multiplayer: Grab a paddle and compete against friends in fast-paced, action-packed duels.

-Stunning Visuals: Immerse yourself in vivid arena with lifelike animations and breathtaking attention to detail.

-Authentic Sound Design: Feel every hit with crisp and realistic sound effects that bring the game to life.

Whether you're training to become a table tennis master or just looking for fast, competitive fun, Rookie Table Tennis is your perfect match.

Ready to Serve? Download now and show the world what a rookie can do!

70010000092652.name: Toon Breakout 3D
70010000092652.intro: Break Bricks, Smash Characters, and Conquer the Toon World!
70010000092652.description:
Get ready for a high-energy arcade adventure with Toon Breakout 3D! Smash through bricks, bounce off cartoon characters, and conquer a series of action-packed levels in a vibrant, cartoon-styled universe. With realistic physics, multiple soundtracks, immersive sound effects, and dazzling animations, this game delivers the ultimate breakout experience.

Key Features

- Vivid Cartoon-Style 3D Graphics
Dive into colorful, dynamic levels where every brick, character, and effect pops with life and personality.

- Soundtracks & Immersive Sound FX
Enjoy a variety of soundtracks to set the perfect tone for your smashing adventure, paired with sharp, dynamic sound effects that amplify every hit, bounce, and explosion.

- Realistic Physics for Maximum Fun
Feel the precision and thrill of smooth, responsive gameplay. Each bounce, smash, and ricochet behaves exactly as you'd expect, with a touch of cartoon flair.

- Power-Ups to Keep You Smashing
Unlock powerful boosts to elevate your gameplay:

Multi-Balls: Unleash a frenzy of balls for chaotic fun.
High-Speed Balls: Test your reflexes with lightning-fast action.
Exploding Balls: Wipe out bricks and characters in spectacular style!

- Smash Bricks and Cartoon Characters
It’s not just bricks in your way—cartoon characters add a hilarious twist as they bounce, wobble, and react to your every move.

- Creative and Challenging Levels
Each level offers a unique layout, clever obstacles, and dynamic elements, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting. Also available an endless mode level for endless fun!

Why You'll Love Toon Breakout 3D:

-A bold and colorful twist on a classic formula
-Dynamic soundtracks and sound effects create a truly immersive experience
-Perfect for quick bursts of fun or longer gaming sessions
-Endless replayability with evolving challenges

Smash Your Way to Victory!

Break through bricks, bash cartoon characters, and master each level in this one-of-a-kind arcade adventure. Toon Breakout 3D is the ultimate blend of strategy, action, and cartoon charm!

Get it Now and Start Smashing

70010000092657.name: ReMix
70010000092657.intro: A unique musical rhythm action game that combines the elements of Rogue games.
70010000092657.description:
In this world, you are able to choose from a variety of heroes with different fighting styles and use the power of music to battle against evil void monsters.

Then you will meet various heroes with distinctive playing and fighting styles, such as Octavia who is good at Melody House and Amaya who is a Funk expert. Over 10 musicians with different abilities who use not only their music but also born skills can be recruited to your band and fight with you. In addition, there are hundreds of props with different effects for you to choose and use, which you can strategically mix and match to apply a variety of battle combinations .

Different heroes will bring different music and rhythms.
The effects of skills vary for different rhythms.

Rich combat effects and combinations.
Different musicians have different fighting styles:
Summon musical weapons to perform melee slashing attacks.
Summoning musical energy to launch projectile attacks.
Continuously summon musical energy to focus energy attacks.
Continuously affects nearby units with a wide range of techniques.
etc......

The Musician's attacks have different special effects, such as sustained damage, slowdown,ejection, knockback, freeze, electric shock, bludgeon, kill, etc.Dozens of tokens are paired with hundreds of props, combining with heroes and musiciansto create a kaleidoscope of battle. The effects can be combined with the effects andtriggers of items and tokens to create various builds.

Explore the truth about the world
Delve deeper into the story as you continue to fight off void monsters and uncover the truth about characters and the world.

70010000092672.name: Art of Glide 3
70010000092672.intro: Spread your wings and discover the beauty of a boundless world, one landmark at a time.
70010000092672.description:
Soar through the skies and embrace the art of flight in Art of Glide 3, an enchanting open-world exploration game that invites you to experience the freedom of flying as a majestic eagle.

Explore a stunning, procedurally generated world of idyllic farmlands. Glide effortlessly through the skies, weaving between trees, tractors and barns.

Your mission: uncover 20 unique landmarks hidden across the expansive landscape. From charming rustic barns to wind-farms, every discovery reveals a new piece of the world and is one step closer to completion.

With its serene atmosphere and soothing soundtrack, Art of Glide 3 offers a relaxing yet rewarding gameplay experience perfect for players of all ages.

Are you ready to spread your wings and master the Art of Glide?

70010000092674.name: Silent Forest: Deadly Night Horror
70010000092674.intro: Silent Forest: In this forest, silence is deadly. Hunt or be hunted.
70010000092674.description:
"Silent Forest: Deadly Night Horror" is an intense shooter-horror game that takes players into a dark and mysterious forest. Your mission is to track and eliminate an unknown creature that terrorizes the surroundings. You have only 7 days and nights to complete your task — or you will become its next victim.

Starting from a hunter's camp deep in the woods, where the previous hunter went missing, you must explore abandoned houses, towers, caves, and an old cemetery to gather vital resources and equipment. Your arsenal includes a hunting rifle and a sniper rifle. Ammo is limited, so use it wisely.

During the day, the creature is less active, but at night it becomes faster and more aggressive. Set up motion-sensor cameras to monitor its movements from your van. However, be cautious — the monster can destroy the cameras, signaling that it's near. Use traps and collect medkits to increase your chances of survival.

Each night becomes more dangerous as the creature grows stronger. Manage your time and strategy carefully.

Game Features:

●Unique Shooter-Horror with Survival Elements: Explore a dark forest filled with dangers.
●Dynamic Day-Night Cycle: The monster becomes more active and dangerous at night.
●Diverse Locations: Abandoned houses, watchtowers, caves, cemeteries, and more.
●Limited Resources: Find ammo, medkits, and traps to survive.
●Camera Surveillance System: Set up motion-sensor cameras and monitor the forest from your van.

Intense Atmosphere and Tense Gameplay: Fog, eerie sounds, and a terrifying environment create an unforgettable horror experience.

70010000092678.name: Lush Forest
70010000092678.description:
Step into a world of serene beauty and discovery in Lush Forest! This relaxing walking simulator invites you to explore three breathtaking levels, each filled with lush greenery, hidden treasures, and peaceful vibes. Your goal is simple: uncover all the locations on your list while soaking in the tranquil atmosphere of the forest.

Key Features:
 Explore 3 Stunning Levels: Wander through beautifully crafted environments that will leave you in awe.
 Scavenger Hunt Adventure: Search for all the hidden spots on your checklist.
 Relaxing Gameplay: No stress, no rush—just a peaceful journey through nature.
 Soothing Soundscapes: Enjoy the calming ambiance as you explore.

Take your time, breathe in the fresh virtual air, and let Lush Forest be your escape.

70010000092680.name: Battle Puzzle 2048 - Space Girls
70010000092680.intro: Combine tiles, battle space girls, and outsmart unique abilities in Battle Puzzle 2048! Play infinite mode or challenge 5 difficulties. Can you reach 2048 and win?
70010000092680.description:
Battle Puzzle 2048 - Space Girls is a thrilling twist on the classic 2048 puzzle game! Slide tiles to combine matching numbers, build powerful combos, and strategize your way to victory. Play in Infinite Mode to achieve the highest score possible or take on one of seven adorable but challenging space girl enemies, each with a unique ability like shields, healing, tile downgrades, or random destruction.
Defeat your opponents by smashing tiles into them and carefully choosing your moves to counter their skills. With five difficulty levels to choose from, the game offers a fun and engaging experience for both casual and competitive players.
Can you outwit these cosmic cuties and conquer the galaxy of puzzles? Challenge yourself and prove your skills in this exciting interstellar adventure!

70010000092683.name: Nordic Ashes: The Complete Saga
70010000092683.description: Nordic Ashes is a challenging Norse inspired roguelite-survivor game, where you’ll have to survive hordes of creatures that come your way.

70010000092687.name: Battle Puzzle 2048 - Wicked Witches
70010000092687.intro: Combine tiles and battle magical foes in a puzzling world of witches and chaos!
70010000092687.description:
Battle Puzzle 2048 - Wicked Witches brings a spellbinding twist to the classic 2048 puzzle game! Slide tiles to combine matching numbers, build powerful combos, and take on a colorful array of supernatural foes. Face off against crafty witches, playful vampires, and adorable girly demons, each armed with unique abilities like hexing tiles, draining health, or summoning chaos on the grid.
Defeat these magical enemies by smashing high-value tiles into them while keeping an eye on their cooldowns and countering their attacks. Choose from five difficulty levels to match your skill and enjoy a thrilling mix of strategy, puzzles, and supernatural mischief.
Once you've conquered the witches and demons, switch to Infinite Mode to chase the ultimate 2048 score. Combine tiles, climb the numbers, and test your puzzle mastery in this enchanting and challenging game. Can you rise to the top and become the ultimate puzzle champion in a world of magic and mayhem?

70010000092697.name: Polarity Remastered
70010000092697.intro: Do you have what it takes to hack the system and take down the core?
70010000092697.description: Dive into Polarity Remastered, a mind-bending sci-fi puzzle adventure set inside a corrupted computer system on the brink of collapse. You play as a rogue hacker trapped in a digital labyrinth, where firewalls shift like mazes and encrypted puzzles stand between you and the computers core.

70010000092702.name: Projected Dreams
70010000092702.intro: A cozy, nostalgic puzzle game about projected dreams
70010000092702.description:
Projected Dreams is a charming, cosy puzzle game emphasising a casual, stress-free gaming experience.

Delve into the room, drag toys from the shelves, and handle them on the table to create a shadow play. As the shadows you cast uncover past family relationships and the environment around you changes and evolves, the lines between reality and fantasy blur.

Experience a heartfelt story:
Join Senka on her journey and experience a heartwarming, wordless story about buzzing summer nights, the importance of friendship, and bittersweet goodbyes.

Solve puzzles in multiple ways:
Rotate, place, and stack objects on a table to recreate a given shadow silhouette on the wall through shadow play. Get creative – there are unlimited solutions to solve puzzles, as long the outline of the shadow matches, and various achievements to be discovered.

Explore atmospheric settings:
Experience an ever-changing room and bring back memories from your own childhood thanks to the toys you will find. Discover new peculiarities while listening to relaxing soundtracks composed by Floris Demandt.

70010000092710.name: Ghost Frequency
70010000092710.intro: In Ghost Frequency, you are a ghost hunter from PIT - Paranormal Investigation Team.
70010000092710.description:
Ghost Frequency is a first-person horror game that puts you in the shoes of Mark, a seasoned ghost hunter from the PIT - Paranormal Investigation Team.

Alongside his colleague Emily, Mark investigates the mysterious disappearance of two teammates in an abandoned location haunted by a sinister presence.

Your mission? Survive the night and uncover the chilling mysteries lurking in the shadows.

You'll get to use key ghost-hunting tools:

EMF Ghost Detector: Track supernatural activity by detecting electromagnetic frequencies and revealing hidden entities.

IR Thermal Camera: See beyond the visible spectrum with this infrared camera, capturing what the human eye cannot perceive.

EVP Digital Recorder: Capture eerie ghostly voices with this specialized device, tuned to record within the EVP audio spectrum.

PIT - Paranormal Investigation Team is an Italian ghost hunting team known for their paranormal adventures and investigations.

Do you have what it takes to face the unknown and survive?

70010000092717.name: Fuel Station Simulator
70010000092717.intro: Transform an abandoned fuel station into a thriving business hub! Manage, customize, and expand your empire!
70010000092717.description:
Take control of your very own fuel station and guide it to success!
In Fuel Station Simulator, test your business skills. Turn a neglected fuel station into a bustling, prosperous business hub!

Run a Store! Stock up, organize shelves, and meet your customers' needs.
Be a Cashier! Scan products, process payments, and boost your profits with excellent customer service.
Drive and Explore! Travel freely across the expansive map, handle deliveries, and uncover new opportunities to grow your business.
Expand Your Business! Add more pumps, hire staff, and upgrade your facilities to expand your operations.
Your business skills will determine your success. Can you turn this fuel station into a thriving empire?

70010000092722.name: Jigsaw City Princess
70010000092722.intro: Solve 45 beautiful puzzles of city princesses drinking coffee, at school or other activities you love!
70010000092722.description:
-Solve 45 unique puzzles in an ice world
-Record your progress and come back later
-Start with any level!
-Try to reach 3 stars in every puzzle
-Beautiful art for girls
-Princesses at the park, drinking coffee or just enjoying a walk

70010000092724.name: The Renovator: Origins
70010000092724.intro: Step into a place where art comes alive and fear becomes reality
70010000092724.description:
The Renovator: Origins is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore the mysterious world of art, where each exhibit contains the mysteries and secrets of its era and its creator. The game will immerse you in the past and another world that is behind the paintings.

You play as the son of a restorer, a museum worker who died tragically. While searching for the memorabilia, the door suddenly closes and strange things begin to happen. The hero is waiting for immersion in the world of art and the paranormal.

70010000092729.name: Exodus
70010000092729.intro: Nintendo Switch™ exclusive! 4 Cyberfunks co-op play! Immersive SF battles with Ultra HD visuals! Breathtaking effects, weapon sounds captivate FPS experience!
70010000092729.description:
Experience the ultimate battle on a photorealistic SF battlefield and witness the emotional ending firsthand!
Utilize the unique characteristics of weapons categorized as Assault, Support, Sniper, and Engineer, Aim your firearms and use more precise controls,
Understand the missions for each game mode and participate in combat to complete special missions.

・Become a member of the Vega special forces unit as they take on the mighty Nemesis. Complete special missions on a SF battlefield.
・Experience thrilling battlefields rendered with photo-realistic graphics.
・Enjoy strategic gameplay utilizing the characteristics of 4 characters.
・4 Cyberfunk Characters! Assault (Rifle), Support (Shotgun), Sniper (Sniper Rifle), Engineer (SMG)
・Engage in the Deathmatch Mode where you can prove your superior combat skills in direct confrontation with enemies.
・Play the Domination Mode where you capture battle zones to secure tactically advantageous positions.
・Experience the Search and Destroy mode where you plant explosives in designated locations and defend against defusing attempts.
・Achieve victory by maximizing gun control with precise aiming and tilt systems.
・Feel the exhilaration of thrilling victories through teamwork.

The reality of SF combat that excites military fans!
Precise gun control that shines through the tension!
Be sure to enjoy [Exodus], the ultimate team-based single player FPS game where you fight alongside your comrades!

Synopsis
Human space exploration has entered a new era.
On an alien planet, a human-like life form, the Nemesis, was discovered along with valuable resources, and an exchange between the two sides began. 
At first, the Nemesis were seen as peaceful beings, and it seemed that Earth would enter a new era by coexisting with them.
However, the true intention of the Nemesis was to seize Earth's resources and dominate humanity. 
They infiltrated Earth in a cunning manner, hiding in various parts of the city and launching attacks at unexpected moments.
Nemesis had advanced weaponry and powerful biological weapons. Humanity was powerless to resist, and 
major cities fell quickly. 
In this crisis, a small group of survivors formed the Special Forces unit Vega and began to fight against Nemesis.
Through repeated battles, Vega reveals the shocking truth behind Nemesis' invasion. 
The purpose of Nemesis was not just to plunder resources. 
They had a plan to destroy Earth's environment and create a new species by injecting their genes into humanity.
Upon learning of this, Vega launched a daring operation. 
And after a fierce battle, they managed to raid Nemesis' base and eliminate their leader. 
However, Nemesis' invasion is still ongoing, and Vega prepares for the final battle with the fate of humanity at stake.

70010000092738.name: The Strongest TOFU
70010000092738.intro:
A tofu master presents a unique tofu action game.
Pick from three tofu varieties, enjoy a game experience as simple as to-fu.
70010000092738.description:
□BE the TOFU.
Tofu is one of the most wonderful foods made from soybeans.
Tofu, also known as "meat of the field," is so rich in nutrients that it has been enjoyed by many people since ancient times. 
Tofu can be transformed in any way depending on the method of production and preparation.

□Tofu Action
This is the one and only Tofu action game created by a real Tofu Meister.
Firm, Silken, and Koya. Three types of tofu to choose from, made in 3D using the latest technology.
Enjoy a game experience as simple as to-fu, with one-button operation for quick play.

□The ultimate tofu experience
Precise vibration/physical feedback to enhance the sense of oneness with the tofu.
Tofu is fragile and crumbles when you push it. (Koya-dofu is hard, so it's not a problem.)
With a determined tofu-fire, jump into the owan before it expires.
A large amount of tofu trivia is included to help you learn more about tofu.
Includes "Tofu Factory," a mini-game for infinite tofu production.

□Volume
The volume of the game can be played in an hour or two. 
No additives like collectibles or hidden routes, just a simple action experience.
It is just like eating tofu straight from the pack...

□Music
Become fully immersed with an original soundtrack composed by Ryo Nagamatsu of RH Music. Ryo’s versatile sound gives every level its own distinct ambience, captivating audiences as they progress through each course.
