70010000092743.name: Sneaky All-Nighter
70010000092743.intro:
Let's stay up and play all night long!
Be stealthy, don't get caught, and play the night away!
70010000092743.description:
Enjoy the thrill of walking the fine line between hiding and getting caught!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in the fun!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

[Time Attack]
Compete for the fastest clear time and earn a top spot on the leaderboards!
Pay attention to the patrolling characters and carefully decide when to play and when to hide!

[Battle]
Compete against friends or CPU controlled opponents for the highest score!
Be bold and take risks to rack up the most points and win the game!

70010000092748.name: Make it! Okonomiyaki
70010000092748.intro:
Spread the batter, add the ingredients, then flip!
Cook as many okonomiyaki as you can and watch your food cart prosper!
70010000092748.description:
Let's make okonomiyaki on the Nintendo Switch™!
Cook your okonomiyaki well and make a bunch!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Spread the batter, add the meat, and flip once it's cooked.
Then, it's time for toppings!
Work quickly to prevent burning for the most points!
Line up your timing perfectly for an extra bonus!
Make as many okonomiyaki as you can within the time limit!

《How to Play》
1. Spread the batter and add the meat!

2. Once one side is cooked, flip it over!

3. Wait until the other side is cooked!

4. While you're waiting, add sauce, mayo, bonito flakes, and dried seaweed in that order!

5. Once it's done, top it with red ginger and serve it up!

[Score Attack]
Cook up as many okonomiyaki as possible and aim for the top spot on the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Compete with others and test your okonomiyaki-making skills!

70010000092753.name: Dreamless Girl
70010000092753.intro: Search for your sister through dreams! Experience the perfect fusion of visual novel and bullet hell shooting!
70010000092753.description:
During the day, you will experience a girl's school life. At night, you will travel through various dreamscapes. To find your missing sister, you dive into different dreams every night, searching for the clues she left behind. Along your journey, you will meet various companions and gradually uncover the truth behind your sister's disappearance.

A wealth of beautiful CGs and Live2D illustrations vividly depict the bonds between the girls. From daily interactions to key plot moments, each character comes to life, providing an immersive visual experience for players.

Pilot your mech, take on various special challenges, unlock powerful skills, and make your mech even stronger!

70010000092760.name: Spot The Difference Sports
70010000092760.description:
Introducing Spot The Difference Sports, brought to you by the original creators of the globally renowned Spot The Difference amusement machine game. Now, with an exciting new twist: a thrilling two-player mode that lets you compete head-to-head against anyone, anytime.

Embark on an action-packed journey through the world of sports in Spot The Difference. Retaining the same captivating gameplay as the beloved original, this edition challenges your sharp eyes and quick thinking to spot all the differences before your opponent does. Whether you're facing off against a friend or racing against the clock in single-player mode, get ready for an immersive experience that puts your observation skills to the test.

70010000092765.name: Little Paws: Kitty Cat Simulator
70010000092765.intro: Tiny Paws, Big Adventures – Explore, Play, Relax!
70010000092765.description: Little Paws: Kitty Cat Simulator is a relaxing and delightful adventure where players take control of adorable kitties traveling the world, exploring charming locations, and collecting fish from every corner of the globe. From bustling city streets to serene beaches and snowy mountaintops, each destination offers new challenges, hidden treasures, and playful interactions with other animals. With its cozy atmosphere, soothing gameplay, and endless opportunities for feline fun, this game is perfect for cat lovers and casual gamers alike!

70010000092773.name: Kill The Emoji
70010000092773.intro: Unleash chaos and blast endless waves of evil emojis in this wild FPS!
70010000092773.description: IF YOU EVER WANT TO SHOOT HORDES OF EMOJIS? RIGHT INTO THEIR FACES? THAN THIS IS YOUR GAME BUDDY! KILL THE EMOJI is a fast-paced, bombastic, funny and hard survival first-person shooter. Kill as much emojis as you can, try to save the world, but the waves will never end! Enjoy our game while you can let off your infinite pain over the Emoji Movie or your hate for the color yellow. But this game is so universal, basically, everyone can join the fight against the evil emojis! So what are you waiting for? Have fun playing our games you lovely silly humans!

70010000092775.name: Kill The Emoji 2
70010000092775.intro: Unleash chaos in the ultimate showdown against endless emoji hordes!
70010000092775.description:
Kill the Emoji 2 is here, and it’s bigger, louder, and more insane than ever before! Get ready to dive into the most over-the-top, emoji-blasting FPS adventure known to humanity. Face epic trials in Challenge Mode, where each level is a battle of wits, skill, and firepower. Then, plunge into the chaotic abyss of Survival Mode, where endless emoji waves crash down on you as you scavenge weapons, grab ammo, and fight for your life in a never-ending showdown.
The emojis are angrier, the battles are harder, and the weapons are even more ridiculous. Unleash pure destruction as you mow down evil emojis with explosive weapons, dodge their relentless attacks, and prove that you are the ultimate emoji destroyer. Whether you’re fueled by hate for their smug little faces or just want to revel in total carnage, this game delivers an unforgettable FPS experience.
Join the fight, save the world (or at least your sanity), and become the legend the emoji apocalypse never saw coming. Lock, load, and annihilate—because this time, it’s personal!

70010000092779.name: Dead of Darkness
70010000092779.intro: Survive the horrors of Velvet Island as one man’s past and a young woman’s duty converge to uncover a dangerous truth!
70010000092779.description:
Dead of Darkness is a 2D survival horror action-adventure presented in a mix of old-school pixel art and HD character illustrations. In 1985 England, private investigator Miles Windham follows a lead on the mysterious death of his daughter to Velvet Island. But once he arrives on the island, he soon realizes that the residents are behaving strangely and soon Miles finds himself in a struggle for his own survival.

Velvet Island comes to life in grotesque detail as Miles and newfound ally Olivia search Graham Memorial mental hospital and its surrounding facilities. Explore the island in top-down style, carefully manage ammunition, find key items and interact with dozens of unique and memorable characters, all professionally voiced by an international cast.

• Immerse yourself in an atmospheric horror presented in top-down pixel art style!
• Take the roles of Miles and Olivia, each with their own goals and motivations.
• Survive by strategically managing ammunition and other valuable resources!
• Interact with a large cast of fully voiced and memorable characters.
• Enjoy a haunting soundtrack, HD character portraits and meticulously animated sprites!

70010000092784.name: Snail's Knock Out!
70010000092784.intro:
Blast through hordes of undead—
shoot, dodge, and dash through ever-accelerating stages!
Quick reflexes are the key to victory!
70010000092784.description:
A few months after the chaos of Goonya Monster, Snail finds herself stuck in a peaceful… but boring routine without her beloved battles.
That is, until a massive horde of undead suddenly appears right before her eyes!

This spin-off mini-game from Goonya Monster puts fan-favorite character Snail in the spotlight.
Blast through waves of undead and race across stages that get faster and faster the longer you survive!

◇ Simple controls!
Move left and right to dodge obstacles and defeat incoming undead.
Easy to pick up and play, with gameplay that’s fun for everyone—from kids to adults.

◆ Lose all your life, and it’s game over!
Crashing into enemies or tripping over obstacles will reduce your life.
Once it hits zero, the game is over!

◆ The longer you last, the faster it gets!
As time passes, both Snail’s excitement and the stage speed ramp up.
Stay sharp and react quickly—don’t forget to give your eyes and brain a break!

◆ Choose your weapon and fight your way!
Laser, Gatling Gun, or Crossbow—the choice is yours.
Master each weapon’s unique traits to take down enemies efficiently!
Defeated the undead that drops "Souls". Collect them to level up and power up your weapons!

◆ Clear the way with bombs!
When your bomb gauge is full, unleash a barrage of bombs with your skill button!
Wipe out enemies and obstacles in a flashy explosion and carve your path forward!

◇ Battle mode (Offline 2-player mode)
In this mode, Pirarucu joins the battle from Goonya Monster!
Steal power-ups, tackle your opponent off the stage, and outgrow your rival before the boss fight!

70010000092789.name: Octo's Balloon Challenge
70010000092789.intro:
From "Goonya Monster" designed by Terada Tera,
a spin-off work has emerged!
This is a balance physics puzzle game featuring Octo!
70010000092789.description:
One day, for reasons unknown, Souls begin raining down from the sky…!?
To uncover the mystery, Octo and Goonyan took off to the skies... using balloons!

This spin-off mini-game from Goonya Monster stars the series’ main character, Octo.
Catch the falling Souls and keep them from spilling by using balloons to control the tilt of your container—then soar as high as you can!

◇ Simple controls!
Move left and right while launching balloons to stay afloat.
It’s easy to pick up, but your sense of balance will be put to the test!
Fun and accessible for players of all ages.

◆ Master the art of balloon control!
Choose the size and placement of your balloons to keep your container balanced.
Focus too much on one side, and it will tilt—sending your Souls tumbling down!

◆ Souls stack in sets of 10!
Collect 10 Souls to bundle them into a compact box.
Then, combine three boxes to clear them and earn a score bonus!

◆ Gotta collect them all!
Miss 7 Souls, or fall more than 500 meters, and it’s game over.
With cheers from Goonyan, keep climbing higher and gather as many Souls as you can!

◇ Co-op mode (Offline 2-player mode)
In 2-player mode, Orca joins the adventure from Goonya Monster!
With the container now constantly shifting left and right, you’ll need to work together to keep it balanced and climb higher…
…nicely, of course.

70010000092794.name: Toad's Soul Hopper
70010000092794.intro:
Ride your hopper and conquer a brutal climb!
One mistake sends you all the way back to the start.
A tense, heart-pounding hopping action game!
70010000092794.description:
A sudden nightmare strikes!
The mischievous mad scientist Anemone has turned Octo and friends into stone…!?
To save them, weapon-obsessed scientist Toad sets off on a dangerous climb using his custom-built hopping machine—the Soul Hopper.

This spin-off mini-game from Goonya Monster stars series favorite Toad.
…Putting yourself through all that for your friends isn’t so bad, right?

◇ Simple controls!
Charge your jump by pressing the button the moment you land.
Adjust your angle while charging, then release to launch yourself into a powerful leap!

◆ Two difficulty modes!
Choose between Easy and Hard modes.
Pick the challenge that suits your playstyle… or push yourself to the limit!

◆ Bounce, crash, and fall…
Every mistake can send you crashing back down—but each attempt gets you a little further.
Stay patient, learn the angles, and keep climbing.
Persistence is the only way to reach the top.

◆ A climb full of hazards
Crumbling platforms, burning footholds, and more stand in your way.
What you need is courage—and perfect timing.
Take the leap for your friends!

◇ Battle mode (Offline 2-player mode)
In Battle mode, the mastermind behind it all—Anemone—joins the fray from Goonya Monster!
Use your Soul Hopper to collect more coins than your opponent before time runs out.
Smash into your rival to steal their coins—sometimes, aggression is the best strategy!

70010000092801.name: Spellcaster University
70010000092801.intro: Open your university of mages. Build rooms, train students, slay orcs and bureaucrats, manage budgets... a director's life is not a quiet one.
70010000092801.description:
Become the director of Spellcaster University in a colorful world of heroic fantasy. Will you turn it into a black magic academy? A place in harmony with nature to train druids and shamans? Or something entirely your own?

- Explore magic
§ Build using magic decks. Each game will be unique 
§ Explore the Arcane Deck to access rooms that defy reality
§ Use the Nature Deck to welcome magic beasts
§ Yield to the Shadow Deck to teach real discipline to all those nasty students!

- Train your students
§ Manage student well-being by building refectories, dormitories, rest rooms... or a dungeon
§ Select your students: personality, alignment, wealth... each aspect is important
§ Discover your students’ future (necromancer, archimage, peasant...) and win new bonuses!

- Customize your school
§ Upgrade your rooms with powerful artifacts like the Soul Eater Bed
§ Fill your school with legendary creatures: dragons, janitors...
§ Choose the rules of your school: exemplary punishments, organic meals, paying dormitories...

- Interact with Factions
§ Negotiate with the Guild. Ask the king for help. Discuss shamanism with the orcs.
§ Threaten the Dark Lord. Pretend to listen to the staff. Lie to the witch hunters.
§ Every choice can have consequences. Be careful before saying “No” to the student delegate!

- Fight against the Darkness
§ Flee from darkness by building in isolated environments
§ Collect powerful grimoires
§ Take advantage of your students' bonuses throughout the campaign!

70010000092811.name: Golden Warden
70010000092811.intro: Pick a card each turn as you aim for the dungeon depths and attempt to claim the treasure that the Golden Warden protects as your own.
70010000092811.description:
Golden Warden is a rogue-like battle game set in a dungeon generated like the Japanese board game of sugoroku. Choose Action Cards that combine dice movement with various attacks using swords, magic, bows, bombs, and even blunderbusses. 

Conquer dungeons full of traps that change each time you enter. Get upgrades, collect gold to strengthen your weapons, take down (or avoid) enemies, and aim for the depths of the dungeon to claim the treasure that Golden Warden is said to guard.

Action Cards:
Choose one Action Card each turn that combines movement and attack. Choose wisely as it's what will get you out of your predicaments!

Dungeons of Tiles:
The dungeons are filled with tiles containing various effects. Use the effects of the tiles to your advantage and wipe out the enemy.

Varying Playstyle:
As you progress through the dungeon, you can acquire new weapons and upgrades, gradually morphing the way you play. Find the playstyle that suits you and aim for the dungeon's depths.

70010000092816.name: Ringo's Roundup
70010000092816.intro: Postbunny Ringo on duty! Mail waits for no one – let’s hit the road!
70010000092816.description:
Meet Ringo, the fluffiest postbunny this side of the mailbox! In Ringo’s Roundup, you’ll plan wild delivery routes by placing wacky Effect Tiles that twist, turn, and toss Ringo’s mail car through vibrant puzzle-packed landscapes!

Your mission? Grab every envelope and zoom to the mailbox – but Ringo won’t get far without your clever brainpower. You’re the path-planning genius here!

Use tiles to:
- Turn Ringo left or right
- Teleport him across the map
- Make him leap like a carrot-fueled rocket
- And much more!

Each level is a handcrafted brain teaser where the obvious path isn’t always the right one. Combine tiles in wild ways, discover secret shortcuts, and show those envelopes who's boss!

Can you master the mail and become the ultimate Bunny Dispatcher?

WHAT TO EXPECT IN RINGO’S ROUNDUP:
- 100+ clever and colorful puzzle levels
- Easy-to-learn mechanics, tough-to-master strategies
- Bonus objectives and multiple ways to win
- Unlock sweet car skins for Ringo’s ride
- Chill, cozy vibes – no timers, no pressure
- Cartoon-style visuals bursting with charm
- One extremely adorable postbunny with a mission!

Start your delivery adventure now – because the mail never sleeps, and neither do bunnies!

70010000092821.name: Pilo and the Holobook
70010000092821.intro: Join Pilo and Prof in a new space adventure! Use your Holobook to turn everything into stickers and create your own encyclopedia of a new world.
70010000092821.description:
Pilo and the Holobook is an exploration-based adventure game set in a colorful galaxy where you guide Pilo, an apprentice explorer, on a journey to document the universe’s wonders and solve mysteries. Using the Holobook, a powerful encyclopedia-like tool, Pilo collects stickers to record his discoveries and uncover the story behind a mysterious dark force known as the Tar.


Key Features:

- Holobook Sticker System: Collect and customize stickers that document your findings in the Holobook, creating a personalized in-game encyclopedia.
- Beautiful, Hand-Painted Planets: Immerse yourself in visually stunning environments that tell the story of each unique world. Explore Floral Asteroid, sunny SRTOM and play along Prof in Labship.
- Environmental Puzzles: Use the Holobook’s abilities to solve light environmental challenges and uncover hidden areas.
- Thematic Depth: Dive into a heartwarming story about mentorship, friendship, and confronting environmental decay through compassion and creativity.
- Evolving Holobook: As you progress, the Holobook gains new capabilities, allowing deeper interactions with the world around them.
- Engaging Story: Unravel the mystery of the Tar and its impact on the planets, with meaningful encounters and touching character moments.


Discover more about  Pilo and the Holobook


Cosmic Odyssey
Set in the mystical XOP-642 star system, players guide Pilo through vibrant, hand-painted worlds filled with strange creatures and ecosystems. Each planet is teeming with unique flora and fauna to discover. Instead of combat, Pilo uses observation and creativity to explore these planets, collecting valuable knowledge through the Holobook.


The Holobook: Your Gateway to Knowledge
The Holobook serves as your main tool throughout the journey. Players use it to interact with the environment and creatures, turning their findings into collectible stickers that populate an ever-growing encyclopedia. These stickers record your progress, unlock new abilities, and help solve environmental puzzles.


The Shadow of the Tar
An ominous, mysterious substance called the Tar has begun to spread across the galaxy, threatening the beautiful worlds Pilo explores. Along the journey, players will uncover the origins of the Tar and work to save the planets from its corruption. The Holobook can also temporarily repel the Tar, allowing deeper exploration and interaction with affected creatures.


A Heartfelt Adventure
Pilo and the Holobook emphasize creativity, kindness, and curiosity over combat. The game encourages peaceful problem-solving and compassion as Pilo helps the creatures affected by the Tar and works to restore balance to the galaxy.

70010000092826.name: Capybara Zen
70010000092826.intro: Take a deep breath and meditate with capybara!
70010000092826.description:
Capybara Zen will help you relax, clear your mind, breathe and forget about stress.

Together with the adorable capybara and her kitty friend, indulge in meditation. Listen to the music, breathe, turn off your head and focus on yourself - here and now!

- original music with a positive effect on the chakras
- cozy charming illustrations
- breathing according to the rhythm of sounds
- Tibetan bowls, bells, humming of the forest 
- simple and intuitive commands

70010000092831.name: Pets and Friends
70010000092831.intro: Create your cozy unique animal album with your ideas.
70010000092831.description:
An adorable game full of cozy animals, flowers and beautiful pastel cards. Create your sticker album, put together puzzles, memory puzzles, read trivia about animals, and spend a nice and cozy time admiring the cute little mouths of your favorite critters.

Bunnies, chinchillas, rats, hamsters or cute parrots are waiting for you in this cozy and adorable world.

KEY FEATURES:
- sticker album
- puzzle
- trivia
- memory

70010000092836.name: Run Chicken, run!
70010000092836.intro: Run away like a chicken as fast as you can!
70010000092836.description:
Take on the role of Manny, a cunning chicken who spends his days thinking about how to escape from Treflik's Chicken Coop on Uncle's Farm. Avoid obstacles, collect fruit, and score points to run as far as possible. 

Don't let anything stop you!

- You are a chicken
- Explore a farm, check machines, eat fruits
- Try yourself, beat the score!
- Relaxing game with no combat

70010000092843.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour East River
70010000092843.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000092843.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of East River, Korea with "Real" footage! 
This work takes place in East River. 
There are a total of 10 flight courses. 
1080P high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to 10 locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit East River, Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000092848.name: EGGCONSOLE The Legend of Heroes Saga PC-8801
70010000092848.intro:
Set out on a journey as a brave warrior to defeat the dragon and save Linda, a young girl!
An adventure game set in a world of swords and magic!
70010000092848.description:
A command-based adventure game inspired by Norse mythology, released by Micro Cabin in 1984 in Japan. The game gained attention at the time for its beautiful digitized images, pseudo-animation effects achieved by sliding graphics, and its uniquely thought-provoking narration.

Linda, a young girl offered as a sacrifice to appease the dragon’s wrath. Hearing the desperate plea of her sister, you set out on a journey to the sacrificial altar in the distant north.

Battle monsters in the Forest of Confusion, encounter fairies, and push through the maze-like woods. Find the sacred sword hidden in the Three-pronged Cave.

Then, defeat the dragon and rescue Linda, the girl chosen as the sacrifice.


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000092851.name: Super Engine GT Turbo SPEC
70010000092851.intro: Burn up the track in old-school arcade style as you climb through the ranks and earn new rides!
70010000092851.description:
Get ready for adrenaline-fueled racing fun as you climb your way through the motorsports ranks in pure arcade style! Super Engine GT Turbo SPEC is all about speed and pushing your driving skills to the limit. Choose from Novice, Junior, Senior and Pro event series, select from 8 unique venues and a variety of touring cars, then burn up the asphalt as you race from the back of the pack all the way to podium position!

Presented in cel-shaded 3D style, Super Engine GT Turbo SPEC blends old-school inspirations with modern visual flair to offer a fresh and infinitely replayable take on the racing genre. As you clear each event, you’ll unlock new tracks and cars, heating things up with faster opponents more advanced courses to master.

• Enjoy arcade racing in sleek cel-shaded 3D style!
• Master 8 unique venues against challenging opponents.
• Climb the rankings across 4 series of events.
• Get on the podium to advance or retry races at any time.
• Unlock new cars to fill up your garage!

70010000092856.name: Covenant of Solitude
70010000092856.intro: Defy your cursed fate as a genie in this dark fantasy RPG!
70010000092856.description:
Some are born with the power to control monsters—genies. Feared, exploited, and hunted, these gifted few walk a lonely path. In the remote village of Listy, a boy named Fort hides this curse in silence. But when war crashes through his home and blood stains the streets, Fort is forced to embrace the truth of who—and what—he is. His fate is set in motion in a story of bonds, betrayal, and the cost of power.

Command monsters with the blood of a genie! Contract with creatures from four mighty tribes—dragons, fairies, beasts, and vampires. Assign jobs, combine tribe and job traits, and build your fantastic team. Master turn-based battles and uncover the full strength of Fort's cursed legacy in this classic-style fantasy RPG!

70010000092866.name: LAPIDARY: Jewel Craft Simulator
70010000092866.intro: "LAPIDARY: Jewel Craft Simulator" is a simple and minimalistic gem crafting simulator.
70010000092866.description:
In the quiet of your workshop, process various rough stones to create gems with the ultimate sparkle.

1. Selecting Raw Stones
When you start the game, you will be presented with the color and shape of the gemstone you should create. Select an appropriate raw stone from the list provided and begin processing.

2. Gemstone Processing
Rotate the 3D model of the raw stone and carefully lower it onto the lathe. By repeating this process, you will carve the raw stone and shape the gemstone. Once it matches the shape of the gemstone you are supposed to make, press the finish button and check the results of your work!

3. Confirming the Results
Your gem crafting results will be evaluated! The more accurately you work, the better the rewards you will receive. The gems you create can be named and added to your collection!

70010000092871.name: Soccer Dash: Football Simulator
70010000092871.intro: Control the ball, conquer the game!

70010000092879.name: Relaxing Jigsaw
70010000092879.intro: Unwind and escape into a peaceful world of jigsaw puzzles! Enjoy 30 beautiful levels featuring serene nature scenes and charming little towns.
70010000092879.description:
Perfect for puzzle lovers seeking a calming experience!

30 Unique Levels: 
Stunning puzzles with nature and cozy village themes.

Charming Artwork: 
Gorgeous hand-drawn illustrations to piece together.

Varying Difficulty: 
Levels become more challenging as you progress, keeping it engaging.

70010000092881.name: Kimono Cats
70010000092881.intro: Pop bubbles, play mini-games & build a cozy cat village in a Japanese carnival adventure!
70010000092881.description:
A charming bubble-popping adventure at a cozy Japanese carnival – perfect for Nintendo Switch™!

Welcome to Kimono Cats, a delightful journey through vibrant festival streets inspired by old Japan! Together with your adorable cat companions, you'll explore festive landscapes, popping bubbles, playing lively carnival mini-games, and creating your dream village.


Key Features:
- Bubble-Popping Fun - Pop and collect surprises from over 112 unique bubble types across 18 charming levels.
- Mini-Games Galore - Try your skills at 18 festival-inspired mini-games, including goldfish scooping, ball toss, music rhythm challenges, and more!
- Village Customization - Build and personalize your own unique village with over 227 collectible items, including houses, stores, plants, terrain, and delightful decorations.  
- Friendly & Positive Community - Connect with friends, exchange gifts, and visit each other's villages. No raids or competition –just good vibes and creativity!
- Adorable Cat Companions - Select from 26 lovable cat avatars, dress them in 22 unlockable outfits, and enjoy heartwarming animations and interactions.
- Accessible Gameplay - Easy-to-learn controls and short, rewarding play sessions make Kimono Cats ideal for both casual gaming and longer relaxation sessions on your Nintendo Switch™.


Whether you’re a dedicated collector, a casual player seeking cozy fun, or just love adorable cats – Kimono Cats is ready to whisk you away to a charming festival filled with joy, friendship, and endless surprises!

Join the festival, create your village, and pop your way to happiness on Nintendo Switch™!

70010000092893.name: Strike Force Heroes
70010000092893.intro: Strike Force Heroes is an oldschool arena shooter rebuilt with modern mechanics with full co-operative and PvP online multiplayer.
70010000092893.description:
ABOUT STRIKE FORCE HEROES

Strike Force Heroes is an oldschool arena shooter rebuilt with modern mechanics with full co-operative and PvP online multiplayer. It melds over the top action with epic story-telling in this intense remake of the hit Flash game.

Fight in lush forests, on speeding trains, and atop crashing airplanes, customizing your soldiers with different weapons, skills, and upgrades! Strike Force Heroes has been completely reimagined from the ground-up featuring an expanded campaign with full voice acting, animated cutscenes, challenges, and a brand new loot system.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR HERO

Level up 4 classes with exclusive weapons, outfits, and abilities, each with their own completely unique strengths, weaknesses, and playstyle.

One-shot enemies with the glass cannon Assassin, or eat all the bullets as the unstoppable Tank, any playstyle you enjoy, the heroes have you covered.

CHOOSE YOUR LOADOUT

With hundreds of weapons, abilities, and equipment, there's something for every play style.

Go with a safe loadout, or create a clever setup that synergizes perfectly with all your equipment for risky yet deadly results.

Whether you like to get up close and personal with melee, take your enemies out silently with snipers, or just blow stuff up, there's a weapon for you!

A HAND CRAFTED EXPERIENCE

Experience an engaging storyline through fully animated cutscenes with wisecracking characters, explosive action sequences, and challenging boss fights. A routine mission goes awry and your squad finds themselves trapped on a mysterious island where nothing is as simple as it appears.

ONLINE CO-OP AND PVP

For the first time ever, invite your friends to join you throughout the entire campaign, or blast them away in fully customizable PvP custom matches!
How many friends? All of them!

ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY

Beating the campaign unlocks harder difficulties to earn better rewards, further build out your heroes, and challenge even the most seasoned of players.

Play through Missions of the Day to earn new rewards and create the most powerful hero.

Earn more rewards by completing tons of fun side-tasks such as getting headshots while airborn, defeating enemies with hero abilities, or even teabagging enemies!

Put your skills to the ultimate test with dozens of unique challenge missions that add crazy twists to the base game, requiring some strategy and clever thinking to overcome.

A REMAKE WITH LOVE

The original 2-man development team behind the hit Flash series Strike Force Heroes and Raze are back with their unique blend of high quality art, polished gameplay, and twisted sense of humor.

Strike Force Heroes' signature pulse-pounding action is brought to life across lovingly detailed environments with crystal clear audio and full voice acting.

70010000092898.name: Bridge Constructor Studio
70010000092898.intro: A must-have for fans of engineering puzzles and creative sandbox games
70010000092898.description:
Get building today!
Bridge Constructor Studio is a must-have for fans of engineering puzzles and creative sandbox games. Whether you're crafting a sturdy architectural masterpiece or experimenting with wild and unconventional designs—anything is possible!
As a bridge architect, bring your visions to life: Design your constructions in animated 3D mini-dioramas and start the simulation to watch as your creations are put to the ultimate stability test.

Back to the Roots
Bridge Constructor Studio is a classic bridge-building game where you can let your creativity run free with an intuitive building system, easy controls, no budget constraints, and optional challenges. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned bridge-building pro, there's something for everyone!

Key Features
- 70 Challenging Puzzles – Test your construction expertise with dozens of unique bridge-building puzzles across varied biomes. Seven different vehicles and multiple construction materials (wood, steel, cables, concrete pillars, and roadways) ensure each puzzle is a fresh and varied challenge.
- Limitless Creativity – With no budget or material restrictions, you can freely experiment and design without limits. For an extra challenge, earn a special reward by keeping costs within a set budget while ensuring your bridge holds up under pressure!
- Diverse Environments – Build bridges across five beautiful biomes, from skyscraper-filled cities to snowy canyons, lush green valleys, and more. The possibilities are endless with seven unique vehicles offering different physics and challenges! Construct ramps and loops for daring monster truck stunts, create sturdy steel bridges for heavy timber transporters, or use moving objects in levels to overcome obstacles with the off-road vehicle. A pizza delivery van, parcel service truck, vacation van, and city bus also join the fun!
- Sharing is Caring – Let your friends and family experience Bridge Constructor Studio without wrecking your carefully crafted masterpieces. Create up to five player profiles, each with its own campaign progress!

Are you ready to push the limits of engineering? Start building today!

70010000092909.name: Vlad Circus: Curse of Asmodeus
70010000092909.intro: Plunge into the jaws of evil in this macabre graphic adventure of horror and madness.
70010000092909.description:
Descend into the depths of madness and terror in this disturbing pixel-art graphic adventure—a simultaneous prequel and sequel to Vlad Circus: Descend into Madness (2022). Vlad Circus: Curse of Asmodeus draws you into a world of mirrors and shadows where evil lurks in every corner.

Explore a haunting universe through the eyes of Josef Petrescu, a man scarred by tragedy who awakens horribly burned, voiceless, and memoryless. As Vlad Petrescu’s brother and co-heir to Vlad Circus, Josef embarks on a harrowing journey to uncover the truth behind his past.

Innovative Gameplay

Vlad Circus: Curse of Asmodeus pushes horror game storytelling forward with its unique mechanics of navigating parallel timelines. Pass through mirrors to shift between fragmented memories. Each temporal jump uncovers new layers of the story, allowing you to piece together Josef’s life and the macabre secret hidden in the old town of San Reno. Interact with a chilling array of characters—from the bizarre inhabitants of the dime museum to the terrifying dwellers of the catacombs. Each encounter will bring you closer to the truth.

As you dive deeper into the story, you’ll face challenges that test both your wits and survival skills, presented in small doses of action.

An Immersive Narrative

At the heart of this nightmare lies Asmodeus, the biblical demon reimagined as an infernal parasite feeding on human sanity. The only way to purge the demon is through fire, torture, and the agonizing death of the body it inhabits.

As Josef recovers fragments of his memory, he documents them in his journal, weaving an intricate narrative that keeps you in suspense until the end. Each journal entry is another piece of the puzzle, drawing you closer to the truth behind Vlad Circus, the religious fanatics populating San Reno, and the fearsome Asmodeus.

An Unsettling Atmosphere

Immerse yourself in a meticulously crafted pixel-art world where dynamic lighting and sound play a crucial role in creating an oppressive, claustrophobic atmosphere. The pixel-art style combines with modern effects to create a mesmerizing audiovisual experience that amplifies the sense of terror and disorientation.

Dare You Face Your Demons?

Vlad Circus: Curse of Asmodeus is more than a game; it’s a journey into the heart of tragedy and madness. Will you have the courage to confront your own demons as you fight to uncover the truth? Can you maintain your sanity as you venture into the darkest corners of the mind?

Prepare for a macabre horror adventure that will challenge your perceptions and test your resolve.

70010000092911.name: Signed, Sealed & Delivered!
70010000092911.intro: Bark and Clap in Signed, Sealed & Delivered! A cozy puzzle game where ocean critters help you to deliver the mail.
70010000092911.description:
Take on the role of Delivery Seal and deliver letters and parcels across fantastical ocean worlds! Navigating the seas can be hard, good thing there is always someone to ask for help. Explore and interact with other sea creatures, who will help you traverse the terrain and bring the mail to your eagerly awaiting friends. You’ll learn more about the locals as they read the letters they’ve been waiting for, and then deliver new letters to their underseas relatives! Each world features increasingly complex puzzles, introducing new critters to befriend and environments to navigate to reach the next mailbox.

Who will you meet? What package will you deliver next?

Game Features:

- Simple to play: Bark and Clap at sea critters to communicate, and use their help to navigate the seas!
- Power up by learning: Understanding how the critters will respond helps you solve puzzles and find secrets!
- Face challenges at your own pace: Relax and explore handcrafted levels that reward clever thinking.
- Collect to customize: Collect the hidden stamps and customize your seal with a variety of colours and cool hats!
- A wholesome puzzle adventure where friendship is delivered straight to your doorstep.

70010000092930.name: CRUELTY
70010000092930.intro: When he awoke, he found himself in a slaughterhouse ruled by blood and madness."CRUELTY" is a survival splatter horror film where the only option is to run away.
70010000092930.description:
"CRUELTY" is a Japanese-made splatter horror game.
No one will save you. Only you can save yourself.
"CRUELTY" is a third-person perspective 3D survival horror game.
Instead of engaging in combat with enemies, players must progress through stages by solving puzzles while evading or hiding from threats.
Survival hinges on escaping or concealing oneself. The playtime typically ranges from 30 to 60 minutes.

70010000092947.name: Puzzle Adventures - Farm Animals
70010000092947.intro: Easy to use puzzles for toddlers and kids. Featuring funny and cute animal motifs with 30 unique puzzles. 100% frustration free and child-safe.
70010000092947.description:
Welcome to the world of puzzle adventures! Today we're taking a trip to the farm and visit the countryside animals!

This drag-and-drop puzzle game is extremely easy to use and has been designed with the utmost care for children of all ages.

The different levels of difficulty provide age-appropriate entertainment for all children.

70010000092952.name: Animal Strikers
70010000092952.intro: Customize your animal. Use wild powers. Score big in fast-paced 1v1 soccer!
70010000092952.description:
Step into the colorful world of Animal Striker, the ultimate 1v1 arcade soccer game for everyone!

Choose from over 30 charming animal characters and take part in fast-paced, action-packed matches. 

With over 200 visual customization options and wild power-ups like double goals or freezing your opponent, no two matches are ever the same. 

Easy to pick up and full of personality, Animal Striker delivers exciting arcade fun for all kinds of players.

70010000092957.name: Rail Route
70010000092957.intro: Build, manage and automate your rail network.
70010000092957.description:
Design, build, and automate a railway empire! Start with a few tracks and stations and grow your network into a thriving automated system of trains crisscrossing real-world-inspired city maps. Watch your creation evolve from simple manual connections into a fully automated masterpiece!

Master the Art of Automation
Experience the thrill of dispatching and transforming your small, manual network into an automated, self-sufficient marvel. 

-Plan and build with precision to keep trains running on time.
-Strategize upgrades to expand and improve operations.
-Automate and expand to watch your creation thrive.

Rail Around the Globe
Build rail networks across multiple maps inspired by real-world locations - Amsterdam, Berlin, Chicago, Glasgow, London, Osaka, Paris, Prague, Shanghai, Tokyo, New York, and more!

Play Your Way
Whether you’re a casual player or a master strategist, Rail Route offers something for everyone:
-Story Mode: Learn the game under the guidance of a fatherly veteran conductor who takes you under his wing and leads you on a journey of memories and timeless life lessons.
-Endless Mode: Build your network from scratch at your own pace in a relaxed and chill play session.
-Timetable Mode: Solve puzzle-like challenges on pre-set maps and schedules, designed for players who enjoy a strategic test.
-Rush Hour Mode: Face waves of intense dispatching challenges, ideal for those who thrive on overcoming complex obstacles.

Easy to Start, Rewarding to Master
With its intuitive design, Rail Route is accessible to new players while offering deep gameplay for automation enthusiasts. Every signal you place, every contract you take adds a new layer of complexity, reflecting the challenges of real-world rail management.

70010000092962.name: Earthion
70010000092962.intro: Return to the genesis of 16-bit gaming with Ancient's brand new shoot 'em up, Earthion!
70010000092962.description:
Yuzo Koshiro’s Earthion is a side-scrolling space shooter developed natively for 16-bit systems by legendary Japanese developer Ancient Corporation. 

Guide space fighter pilot Azusa Takanashi, through eight chaotic levels, each with their own unique environment, enemies, and boss fights, to repel the alien invaders and save planet Earth.

Instrumental in the creation of some of the 16-bit era’s most defining games, Ancient Corporation and Yuzo Koshiro return to their roots after three decades to deliver a generation-defining experience and an unforgettable fight among the stars.

Strap in and deploy a devastating arsenal as you fight your way through eight chaotic levels, each with unique environments, enemies and boss fights. Beat the game on Hotshot difficulty, up the ante in Challenge mode and become a flying ace to claim your spot in the online leaderboard.

With an original soundtrack from one of the most renowned composers of the 16-bit era, Earthion offers a truly immersive audio experience featuring 27 original tracks and incredible soundscape of effects to transport you back to a golden age of retro gaming.

Developed to run natively for 16-bit hardware, pushing the original system to its absolute limits while ported to modern platforms with meticulous care, Earthion offers great quality of life features, including highly customizable scanline configurations to give an authentic retro experience on modern displays.

70010000092964.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 11
70010000092964.intro: The Pack is back with trivia, writing, drawing, sound and deduction party games!
70010000092964.description:
The Party Pack is back!

The Jackbox Party Pack 11 catapults you and your crew into the best timeline of party game pandemonium. Whether you’re a trivia titan, a joke mastermind, or the resident undercover detective of your friend group, there’s something for everyone in this pack. No extra controllers needed - players simply join the game and play using phones, tablets or computers! 

Five brand-new games will change the way you party this holiday season and beyond:

Doominate (Writing): Take a perfectly lovely situation and destroy it in this head-to-head joke game where it feels so good to be so bad. Doominate supports 3-8 players.

Hear Say (Sound Effects): Record sound effects and dialogue directly from your phone in a foley-inspired game where laughter is the soundtrack. Then, watch your voices come to life in a series of short movie clips! Hear Say supports 2-8 players. 

Cookie Haus (Drawing): Play our coziest and kookiest drawing game yet by fulfilling cookie design orders for unusual clientele. Don’t play on an empty stomach! Cookie Haus supports 3-8 players.

Suspectives (Social Deduction): There’s been a crime, one player secretly did it, and the evidence comes from your own survey answers! Study the clues, defend your innocence (even if you’re lying), and put your friends on trial. Suspectives supports 4-8 players.

Legends of Trivia (Trivia): Assemble your team and put your trivia knowledge to the test in a fantastical world full of danger! Teamwork! Monsters! Do you dare take on one of the most challenging trivia games yet? Legends of Trivia supports 1-6 players.

70010000092966.name: Apocalypse ? No !
70010000092966.description:
In Apocalypse ? No ! you play a survivor accompanied by his faithful dog in an apocalyptic world, survive against the creatures, help the characters of this world and face the Apocalypse.


--- A world in ruins ---

Discover many varied maps: from a peaceful forest, through survivor camps to ruined cities, these maps are just waiting to be explored.


--- Complete the game's 40 quests! ---

Many non-player characters populate these lands, some of them need your help. Help them by providing them with resources, protecting them from tough enemies, and more!


--- A world divided into 4 ---

These lands are governed by 4 main factions:

- The democratic regime of the army
- The rebels of the regime
- The independent survivors
- The religious fanatics


--- What are the objectives of the game? ---

In Apocalypse? No! your main objective is to survive against the creatures that want to kill you. When you start a game, you appear with only a knife an a gun. As you progress in your game, you will unlock additional weapons as well as objects allowing you to defend yourself. During your exploration, you will meet many NPCs, some of whom will need your help. Throughout the game, you will have the opportunity to educate your dog: teach him to follow you, to defend you or to look for treasures.


--- Survive against the creatures of the region. ---

The apocalypse has caused the appearance of many creatures! Zombies, slimes, hiders, didirocks, as well as radioactive creatures like giant insects or radioactive animals. Also find passive creatures like wolves, rats, chickens, rabbits and more!

---Survive with your companion ---
You can teach your companions to defend against zombies, to search for treasures or even to defend positions!

70010000092968.name: Hentai Girls: Juicy Judo
70010000092968.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000092968.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000092970.name: Hentai Girls: Marvelous Magician
70010000092970.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000092970.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000092978.name: World Flag Master
70010000092978.intro:
How Many Flags of the World Do You Know?
A Fun Brain-Training Game to Learn Flags While Playing
70010000092978.description:
This is a fun and interactive game that helps you learn the flags of the world while playing!

How to Play：
・Look carefully at the country name.
・Find the correct flag and tap it before time runs out!

The more you play, the better you’ll remember the flags of the world.

If you’re stuck, press the hint button for help.
(It will show you roughly where the flag is!)

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000092980.name: Spot the Odd Pictogram!
70010000092980.intro:
Which Pictogram Doesn’t Belong?
A Fast-Paced Brain-Training Spot-the-Difference Game
70010000092980.description:
Can you find the odd one out? In this exciting spot-the-difference challenge, one pictogram character is moving differently from the rest.
Your mission is simple: find it before time runs out!

Easy and Fun to Play
・Look closely at the image.
・When you spot the odd one, tap it before the timer hits zero!

It may seem easy at first, but with the clock ticking, it’s more challenging than you think.

If you get stuck, don’t worry! Press the Hint button to get a clue about where to look.

This game is perfect for all ages, helping to improve focus and reaction speed while having fun.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000092982.name: Cat Spotting Challenge!
70010000092982.intro:
Which One Is the Ragdoll?
A Relaxing & Brain-Training Game That’s Fun and Educational!
70010000092982.description:
Enjoy adorable cat photos while challenging your brain in this fun and easy quiz game!

Simple and Fun to Play
・Read the question and carefully check the images.
・When you find the correct cat, tap it before time runs out!

Learn the names of rare and unique cats from around the world—just by playing!

Not sure of the answer? No worries! Tap the Hint button to get a clue about where to look.

Perfect for cat lovers, quiz fans, and anyone looking for a fun way to learn while relaxing!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000092986.name: Odd Shape Out!
70010000092986.intro:
Find the Odd Shape in an Instant!
A Brain-Training Game to Sharpen Your Quick Thinking
70010000092986.description:
This is a fast-paced brain-training game where you must find the one shape that stands out from the rest—before time runs out!

How to Play：
・Carefully examine the given image.
・Find the one shape that looks different and tap it within the time limit!

Some puzzles may seem easy at first glance, but with a ticking clock, the challenge gets real!

If you’re stuck, press the hint button for a clue.
(It’ll show you roughly where to look!)

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000092988.name: Picture the Difference!
70010000092988.intro:
Spot the Difference with Cute Illustrations!
A Brain-Training IQ Game to Sharpen Your Reflexes
70010000092988.description:
This is a fun brain-training game where you must find the one mistake hidden in an adorable illustration before time runs out!

How to Play：
・Look closely at the top image on the split screen.
・Compare it with the bottom image and find the difference.
・Once you spot the mistake, tap on it!

Some differences may seem easy to find at first, but with a time limit, the challenge gets real!
This game is perfect for a quick and fun break.

Use the hint button only when you’re really stuck!
(It will roughly show you where to look.)

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000092992.name: QUIZ 50 Ways to Read the KANJI 生
70010000092992.intro:
The Many Readings of the Japanese Kanji “生”
Learn Them Through a Fun Quiz!
70010000092992.description:
The Japanese kanji “生” has multiple readings depending on the word it appears in.

This four-choice quiz game lets you enjoy learning its various pronunciations!

・誕生（birth）
・生る（bear fruit）
・生憎（unfortunately）

…and many more!

Explore the depth of Japanese kanji and expand your knowledge while having fun!

70010000092994.name: Hungry Meem
70010000092994.intro: Together with the Meems, you can rewrite destiny and spin it into a happily ever after!
70010000092994.description:
One day, you come across a picture book about Meems, carefree little creatures that live under the World Tree. However, the book’s ending is a sad one...
Together with the Meems, you can rewrite destiny and spin it into a happily ever after!

[Help the Meems!]
Meems are adorable, food-loving creatures that live beneath the World Tree.
One day, their precious Miracle Pot, which makes any dish delicious, was destroyed—putting their very survival at risk!
Lend a hand to the remaining Meems and help them build a thriving new world!

[What are Meems?]
Meems are playful little creatures who love to eat, sleep, and have fun!
As they experience new things, they unlock new skills and even change their appearance.
By breeding different Meems, you can create endless unique variations. Find your perfect Meem!

[Grow the World Tree!]
The World Tree thrives on the light of joy released when Meems gather for feasts and enjoy special meals.
As the tree grows, it unlocks new areas for Meems to explore and expand their adventures!

[Build a Better Life for the Meems!]
From cozy Meem Houses and Love Nests to resource centers, farms, and decorative structures, you can build a variety of facilities to improve Meem life.
Gather materials on your adventures and create a happy, thriving home for your Meems!

70010000092999.name: Double Dragon Revive
70010000092999.intro: The world-famous Double Dragon roars back to life!
70010000092999.description:
The Double Dragon series has defined the belt-scroll action genre ever since it hit the arcades in 1987.
Now it returns as Double Dragon Revive, thanks to the passionate support of retro game fans over the years!

1. Renewed, stylish character graphics!
   See your favorites from the golden age of arcades recreated in modern 3D graphics.
   Powerful foes from their past return to face off against the Lee brothers.

2. The ultimate belt-scroll action experience!
   The player traverses the screen horizontally to take down enemies in this beloved genre.
   Experience the same simple and intuitive gameplay, with controls and balance refined for the modern era.
   The carefully crafted experience, supervised by staff with experience on Arc System Works fighting game titles, makes it easy for new players to get engrossed right away.

3. Thrilling, strategic action!
   The combat requires adaptation and variety, more than a simple button-masher.
   Delve into the strategy by learning enemy patterns and finding the most effective attack timings.
   Pick up weapons scattered throughout the stages and make the most of the area gimmicks to seize the upperhand in battle!

70010000093004.name: Hidden Cat Outlaws
70010000093004.intro: Become the sheriff and catch all the wanted cat outlaws!

70010000093009.name: Submarine Survivor
70010000093009.intro: Master the seas, tame what lies beneath and live to explore another day!
70010000093009.description:
Get ready to dive into the ocean's depths, face fearsome sea creatures and collect experience crystals in roguelite action game Submarine Survivor! As you face the blue unknown, you’ll have to upgrade your submarines with various combinations of weapons and chips to become the Lord of the Ocean. Submarine Survivor balances exploration with highly customizable combat across 2D maps packed with mission nodes.

Use your varied weaponry to efficiently fend off enemy mods while completing map objectives, all culminating in a blood-pumping boss fight! Adjust difficulty with modifiers that change how the game is played, earn passive upgrades with research, craft equipable items and strategize on-the-fly. As you progress, you’ll unlock new submarine models to build out your fleet.

• Fend off waves of dangerous creatures!
• Complete objectives to reach new areas.
• Adjust difficulty and customize your gameplay experience!
• Unlock and upgrade new submarine types.
• Choose new equipment, passive skills and weapons wisely!
• Take down big bosses to assert your dominance as Lord of the Ocean!

70010000093014.name: Aery - Winter Wonderland
70010000093014.intro: Explore a serene winter world in Aery – Winter Wonderland, collecting crystals and uncovering Frosty’s magical journey.
70010000093014.description: Experience the beauty of winter in Aery – Winter Wonderland, a relaxing and immersive adventure where you take flight as a graceful bird. Explore breathtaking snowy landscapes, glide through icy valleys, and uncover a heartwarming story. Your journey follows Frosty, a curious traveler searching for a legendary magical flower hidden deep within the frozen world. As you soar through the skies, you’ll collect shimmering crystals that reveal pieces of the story, guiding you through different winter-themed environments. Each level offers a unique atmosphere, from serene snow-covered forests to towering ice peaks and frozen lakes, all designed to create a peaceful and visually stunning experience. With no enemies, no time limits, and no pressure, Aery – Winter Wonderland is all about relaxation and exploration. The smooth, flowing flight mechanics allow you to feel the freedom of the skies while enjoying the calming, atmospheric soundtrack. It’s the perfect game to unwind, escape into a magical world, and experience the joy of flight. Let yourself be carried away by the beauty of winter as you uncover the secrets of Frosty’s quest. Whether you’re a fan of tranquil exploration games or simply looking for a soothing experience, Aery – Winter Wonderland offers a visually enchanting journey filled with wonder, discovery, and the magic of flight.

70010000093017.name: Aery – Viking Saga
70010000093017.intro: Enjoy a breathtaking journey in Aery Viking Saga, where you take flight as a majestic bird soaring through stunning Viking inspired landscapes.
70010000093017.description:
Aery – Viking Saga invites you on a mesmerizing journey through breathtaking Viking-inspired landscapes. As a small, graceful bird, you’ll soar through the skies, experiencing the pure joy of flight while uncovering the secrets of an ancient Norse tale. Designed for relaxation, the game offers a peaceful and immersive experience with no enemies or time limits—just the freedom to explore, enjoy the scenery, and collect glowing crystals. These crystals reveal fragments of a forgotten Viking story, encouraging deeper exploration.  

Each level presents a unique environment, from towering fjords and frozen mountains to lush forests and ancient villages. The beautifully crafted landscapes are filled with rich details and vibrant colors, immersing you in a serene and atmospheric world. Whether gliding through misty valleys or drifting above roaring waterfalls, every scene is a visual delight. With its smooth flight controls and soothing soundtrack, Aery – Viking Saga is a perfect escape, offering a truly meditative adventure.

70010000093020.name: Aery – Titans of the Future
70010000093020.intro: Soar through a futuristic world, glide past robots, and explore high-tech landscapes in Aery - Titans of the Future!
70010000093020.description: Soar through a breathtaking futuristic world in Aery - Titans of the Future, where nature and technology blend in a mesmerizing landscape. As a graceful bird, you’ll glide effortlessly through high-tech cities, towering robots, and vast mechanical structures, uncovering the mysteries hidden within this advanced world. With smooth and relaxing flight mechanics, you can explore at your own pace, immersing yourself in stunning visuals and a calming atmosphere. Experience a journey of discovery as you navigate through a world shaped by both organic beauty and artificial wonders.

70010000093023.name: Aery – Peace of Mind 3
70010000093023.intro: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.
70010000093023.description:
Aery – Piece of Mind 3 is an interactive game experience that is designed to relax your mind and soul. You jump into the role of a little bird, explore beautiful landscapes and collect magical crystals that mark certain landscapes.

Because there are no enemies or any other danger in this game you will be able to lean back and enjoy the scenery and the sensation of flying. It is a great game for relaxing and calming down after an exhausting day full of hassle.

Of course, you can always select the level that you feel helps most to relax yourself. Most levels can be finished quite quickly so that you can freely choose spend time exploring the environment but you don’t have to stay for too long if you are just looking for a short moment of peace and enjoyment.

This game features a collection of some the most beautiful sceneries from the Aery franchise. 
We hope you like them. So lean back and take a deep breath…

70010000093026.name: Aery – Peace of Mind 4
70010000093026.intro: Take a break: Explore, enjoy, relax.
70010000093026.description:
Aery – Peace of Mind 4 is an interactive game experience that is designed to relax your mind and soul. You jump into the role of a little bird, explore beautiful landscapes and collect magical crystals that mark certain landscapes.

Because there are no enemies or any other danger in this game you will be able to lean back and enjoy the scenery and the sensation of flying. It is a great game for relaxing and calming down after an exhausting day full of hassle.

Of course, you can always select the level that you feel helps most to relax yourself. Most levels can be finished quite quickly so that you can freely choose spend time exploring the environment but you don’t have to stay for too long if you are just looking for a short moment of peace and enjoyment.

This game features a collection of some the most beautiful sceneries from the Aery franchise. 
We hope you like them. So lean back and take a deep breath…

70010000093029.name: SHOGUN SOUL：LEGENDARY PUZZLE
70010000093029.intro:
Beautiful men and women in the guise of Sengoku warlords appear in abundance!
An easy puzzle game anyone can enjoy!
70010000093029.description:
Collect puzzle pieces of Sengoku warlords and complete the puzzle!
Clear stages to view high-quality images of the warlords!

70010000093034.name: Cozy Land
70010000093034.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70010000093034.description:
Have you ever tried to make your own city? in Cozy Land, doing so is a piece of cake! This sandbox game lets you choose from 9 different base templates on which you can create a cafe corner, a theatre heaven, an incredible amusement park, and many more!


Cozy Land has over 400 unique decorations for your city, which include big houses and trees, but also sprinkle in some nature like small flowers.


Every part of this city can be hand-placed by you. Whether you prefer a busy main square or a cozy little corner with horses and cows - Cozy Land’s got it all!


Features:
- 9 land templates to start your city on.
- Over 400 decorations and buildings to place.
- Adorable bouncy animals ready to populate your farm or building roofs.
- Create a cute city or a little agricultural heaven!
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

70010000093039.name: Ping Pong Up
70010000093039.intro: Feel the tension of the big match breaking through the screen.
70010000093039.description:
In Ping Pong Up, your reflexes and precision will be the key to success.

Play face to face with up to 4 friends or against the AI.
What is your longest ping pong streak? Prove it with “Challenge” mode and reach Number 1 on the online ranking. But careful with the bonuses that will appear! Some will help you improve your score but others could end your game.

Features:
- Easy to play, hard to master.
- Twin-stick controller.
- 2 or 4 player Vs-mode.
- Challenge mode with bonuses.
- Game mode against the AI.
- Online ranking.

70010000093041.name: Golf Up Tropical
70010000093041.intro: Enjoy Golf Up Tropical with friends and family!
70010000093041.description:
Golf Up Tropical is a fun-loaded golf game you can play with up to 4 friends in several game modes. In Tournament mode, you can pick between the Classic or Points options, in which you earn points by getting good results in the Holes and making quick decisions for bigger bonuses.

You will also be able to play solo in Arcade mode and compare your score in the online ranking with that of your friends and players from around the world. 

Features:
-A variety of holes and game modes.
-Take the wind into account when hitting the ball with effects.
-Easy to play, hard to master.
-Online Ranking.

70010000093043.name: Double Dangerous
70010000093043.intro: Shooting freedom—aim anywhere and unleash chaos with dual guns!
70010000093043.description:
Get ready to lock, load, and double the chaos! Double Dangerous is a high-octane third-person shooter that flips the script on traditional gameplay. Wield dual guns and unleash a storm of bullets in any direction—regardless of where your character is facing. Run forward while blasting behind you, pull off wild one-arm shots, or take down enemies mid-dive in slow motion. The choice is yours, and the fun is limitless.

Features:
Innovative Shooting Mechanics: Aim and fire freely in all directions, adding strategy and flair to every firefight.

10 Unique Worlds: Explore diverse environments, each packed with vibrant visuals and dynamic challenges.

Four Difficulty Modes: From Easy to the insane “Nuts” mode, push your skills to the limit with extra missions and escalating intensity.

Medals and Unlockables: Earn medals in every mode to unlock exclusive skins and customization options.

Arcade-Inspired Style: Enjoy a blend of cartoonish charm and sleek realism, brought to life with stunning lighting and dynamic sound effects.

Whether you’re a casual player looking for a good time or a hardcore gamer chasing the ultimate challenge, Double Dangerous delivers non-stop action, endless replayability, and the satisfaction of outgunning the odds.

70010000093045.name: Jumping Ninja Battle
70010000093045.intro: 2 Player Ninja Games Play with your friends
70010000093045.description:
Fun Ninja Games! Do you want to do it alone or with a friend?
Play a fun game with cute ninja and many other characters
Also there are many different modes
There's no time to be bored. Just start right now
+ Introducing Game Mode
  - VS Friends: You can play 1vs1 with your friends.
  - World Battle: Battle with ninja masters all over the world.
  - Survival: Be the last survivor!
  - Team Battle: Build a ninja team and play 3vs3 showdown.
  - Challenge: Pick one of the various characters and clear every step of the way

70010000093050.name: K-pop Idols Dating: Anime Love for B.SeveT
70010000093050.intro: Conquer the Hearts of Future K-pop Stars in 30 Days!
70010000093050.description:
Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of K-pop and discover 12 talented boys who dream of fame.

Each one has their own personality, aspirations, and style, but they all share one goal: to shine on stage.

Can you make them fall for you before their big debut takes them away forever?

Game Features:
-12 boys, 12 unique styles
From the shy and sweet to the charismatic leader, each aspiring idol has their own charm and challenges.
Discover what makes them tick and how to win their hearts.

-Dynamic conversations and strategic flirting
Talk to them, send messages, earn their trust, and plan the perfect date.
Will you be their number one fan or the love of their life?

-Affinity meter
Your choices will influence how they feel about you.
Can you make their hearts beat to the rhythm of your words?

-Multiple endings
Will you win over your favorite boy, or will you end up in the dreaded friend zone?
Every decision leads to a different story.

-30 days to conquer stardom (and their hearts)
Time is running out. Every interaction and every word matters.


Do you have what it takes to steal the hearts of future K-pop stars and become their inspiration?

Find out in this adventure filled with romance, music, and unexpected twists!

70010000093055.name: K-pop Idols Dating: Anime Love for PinkOrbil T.
70010000093055.intro: Conquer the Hearts of Future K-pop Stars in 30 Days!
70010000093055.description:
Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of K-pop and discover 12 talented girls who dream of fame.

Each one has her own personality, aspirations, and style, but they all share one goal: to shine on stage.

Can you make them fall for you before their big debut takes them away forever?

Game Features:
-12 girls, 12 unique styles: From the sweet and shy girl to the explosive diva, each aspiring idol has her own charm and challenges. Discover what makes them tick and how to win their hearts.

-Dynamic conversations and strategic flirting: Talk to them, send messages, earn their trust, and plan the perfect date. Will you be their number one fan or the love of their life?

-Affinity meter: Your choices will influence how they feel about you. Can you make their hearts beat to the rhythm of your words?

-Multiple endings: Will you win over your favorite girl, or will you end up in the dreaded friend zone? Every decision leads to a different story.

-30 days to conquer stardom (and their hearts): Time is running out. Every interaction and every word matters.


Do you have what it takes to steal the hearts of future K-pop queens and become their inspiration?

Find out in this adventure filled with romance, music, and unexpected twists!

70010000093060.name: Leafy Season
70010000093060.description:
Step into the tranquil world of Leafy Season, an immersive exploration walking simulator that invites you to discover the beauty of nature. Traverse three distinct and visually stunning maps, each brimming with unique points of interest and hidden stories.

Explore vibrant landscapes, from golden forests adorned with falling leaves to misty mountain paths and serene lakesides. Each map is meticulously designed to captivate your senses and encourage your curiosity.

Features:
Three unique maps, each with its own atmosphere and aesthetic.
Tons of unique locations to discover and admire.
A relaxing and meditative experience for players of all ages.

70010000093062.name: Splatterbot
70010000093062.intro: The cleaning robots have gone rogue. It's time to make mess!
70010000093062.description: The cleaning robots have gone rogue! Up to 4-players compete in local-multiplayer to make the most mess! Utilize your environment and power-ups to overwhelm your opponents with untidiness. It's about to get messy..

70010000093067.name: Jelly & Toast
70010000093067.intro: Team up with cute culinary crusaders for tasty platform adventure
70010000093067.description:
Jelly & Toast are a team of food-based heroes who are hungry to recover the stolen magical ingredients used to cook their favorite entrees.

Choose between local co-op multiplayer or solo mode, join forces, and embark on a challenging platform adventure full of puzzles and food. Run, jump, and throw projectiles (or even each other) to complete each level.

Overcome enemy chefs, hot and sharp cooking hazards, and explore 3 kitchen kingdoms full of crazy culinary challenges!


Features:
* 50 different levels
* Platform action gameplay
* Single player or co-op multiplayer
* Vibrant, colorful pixel art

70010000093070.name: Airborne Justice
70010000093070.intro: Team up and take flight in this old-school co-op aviation shooter
70010000093070.description:
Join pilot protagonists Rock and Stan for an arcade sky battle experience built for one or two players.

Control a military helicopter capable of rapid fire and maneuver through the clouds while harnessing incredible firepower. Obtain devastating weapons and bombs, shoot down imposing bosses, and unlock 3 additional modes of play.

Become an ace fighter pilot and take down five intense levels of enemy air force!


Features
* Retro-inspired pixel shooter
* Single player or co-op multiplayer
* Unlock 3 extra gameplay modes
* Battle huge bosses
* Five challenging levels

70010000093073.name: TETRA's Escape 2
70010000093073.intro: Help the tetras find the exit.
70010000093073.description:
Move the tetras around and use their special ability to transform into different shapes of tetrominoes to create platforms and save them during the 80 levels of the game.

Rediscover the mechanics of the first game (transformations, blocks of fire or ice, thin platforms...) and discover new additions such as teleportation, global gravity inversion or ghost blocks.

Don't be afraid to experiment and make mistakes, as you can now undo all your moves and transformations.

Explore 64 completely new levels mixing old and new mechanics, and enjoy 16 of the best levels from the first TETRA's Escape as a bonus.


Features:
* New gameplay mechanics (teleportation, ghost blocks, etc.)
* Improved gameplay (more intuitive tetras selection...)
* Ability to undo moves/transformations
* 64 new levels with increasing difficulty
* 16 levels from the first TETRA's Escape included

70010000093076.name: TERASLIDE
70010000093076.intro: Help Tulock reach the final hexagon
70010000093076.description:
Play as Tulock, a snow fox, and help him progress through the different levels of this puzzle game based on movement on a hexagonal grid.

Slide in a straight line to an obstacle or the edge across 100 levels and find the right path to the final hexagon, avoiding the traps.

Discover new mechanics in the various worlds of increasing difficulty without fear of getting stuck, thanks to the help included in the game.

And for those wanting extra difficulty, over 250 optional challenges spread across the levels are present.


Features:
* 100 levels spread over 12 worlds,
* Hexagonal grid requiring different thinking,
* 10 mechanics added as the game progresses,
* Increasing difficulty, with in-game help included (solutions),
* Ability to undo moves if you make a mistake,
* More than 250 optional challenges spread over 100 levels.

70010000093079.name: Karma City Police
70010000093079.description:
Karma City Police is a narrative-driven police dispatch simulator with pinball-based combat and adventure elements.

Serve the role of the new dispatcher at the Karma City Police Station. Speak to distressed callers to discover their emergency, and then allocate resources needed to save the day.

Explore a dense and vivid police station, battle enemies in a unique pinball mini-game, and enjoy a captivating story with lots of humor and eccentric characters.


Features
* Police dispatch simulator
* Top-down exploration
* Unique pinball battles
* Nostalgic pixel art and original music

70010000093082.name: The Last Hero: Journey to the Unknown
70010000093082.intro: You are The Last Hero, fight against the forces of evil!
70010000093082.description:
Voidgem, a powerful wizard, has stolen all the magical relics of the ancient world, and then created evil minions and monsters to begin a reign of terror. 

The relics of the ancient world are scattered across various parts of the world. As a lone knight armed with only a sword, a shield, and incredible courage, set out for adventure in search of the lost relics and face all enemies in your way. 

Explore over 30 diverse levels, collect powerful items, and battle menacing bosses on your quest to save this pixelated fantasy world. 


Features
* Explore the Map in different biomes with over 30 levels
* Help our hero by facing unique enemies and bosses, special wave-based stages with challenging obstacles
* Each level presents a series of challenges that you need to overcome, a sense of progress as you advance and face new challenges, adding excitement and variety to each wave
* Find and collect rare relics
* Use special potions that aid our hero in combat
* Unique elemental powers, choose the one that suits each biome best

70010000093085.name: Thrill Penguin
70010000093085.description:
You are an ambitious penguin who brandishes a stylish bandana and aspires to be a parkour master.

Run, jump, dive, and swim through different and six unique zones containing challenging levels to demonstrate your esteemed parkour prowess. Choose from multiple difficulty settings including easy, normal, and hardcore modes.

Battle menacing bosses at the end of each area. 

Thrill Penguin is a return to old-fashioned platforming fun without complications or pretense.


Features
* 54 Levels
* Battle 6 powerful bosses
* You are a penguin
* Platform action gameplay
* Hand-crafted levels
* Multiple difficulty settings

70010000093089.name: Aussie Rules Evolution 2
70010000093089.intro: No licensed teams just pure fun and great gameplay! Jam packed with the thrills and spills of the Aussie Rules game.
70010000093089.description:
CUSTOMISATION OPTIONS 
Includes Guernsey Creator along with Player and Team Management in the FanHub to create and share* your own dream team! 

INTUITIVE GAMEPLAY
Tight controls and smart AI help create a true reflection of the modern Aussie Rules Game

CHALLENGING ONLINE 
 Play head to head to make it to the top of the online leaderboard, or team up with your mates with connections of up to 8 consoles! 

EXTENSIVE CAREER 
Pursue your goals with greater depth, with improved draft, free agency and state leagues running simultaneously with the National Competition! 

COMMENTARY
AI assisted commentary.

70010000093101.name: Sniper Scope: Realistic Tactical Shooter
70010000093101.intro: Step into the shoes of an elite sniper and begin combat missions - disrupt enemy plans while remaining in the shadows. The army won't do where one perfect shot is needed.
70010000093101.description:
Each mission requires careful planning. You must analyze the terrain, find cover, calculate the trajectory of the shot and choose the best moment to attack. One wrong move and the mission will fail. Consider the distance, wind, gravity and other factors to make the perfect shot. Your sniper rifle is your only ally.

With each level, the tasks become more difficult. The enemies are smarter, the guards are more vigilant, and the mission conditions are more extreme. Use tactical thinking to remain invisible and complete missions flawlessly. Your strategy is the path to success.

This is not just a shooter, but a real test of endurance, accuracy and strategic thinking. Can you become the one who is feared even in the shadows? Take a rifle and prove that one sniper can change the course of the war.
