70010000093107.name: Elves: The Enchanted Magic Heart
70010000093107.intro: In a magical forest where every creature and plant is connected by an ancient power called the Heart of the Forest, life begins to fall apart.
70010000093107.description:
Eryk, a young man who possesses the rare ability to hear the whispers of the forest, discovers that this imbalance has a deeper cause.

Together with his loyal companions Lyra, a brave warrior, and Nimbus, an agile and clever bird, he embarks on a journey to restore the Heart and save his home.

Facing dangerous tests, mysterious guardians and their own fears, the group must prove that unity and trust are the keys to overcome the most difficult challenges.

An adventure where courage, wisdom and the bond between friends will be put to the test at every step.

70010000093109.name: Scrap Divers
70010000093109.intro: Dive into an incredibly fast-paced and beautifully crafted retro runner!
70010000093109.description: Dive into an incredibly fast-paced and beautifully crafted retro runner! Control your robot with just a finger to dodge sawblades, flames, and many other dangerous obstacles while flying through an infinite tunnel. Are you ready for the drop? Parachute not included.

70010000093114.name: The Brave Little Pigs
70010000093114.intro: This visual novel follows a group of young pigs who participate in their town's annual race for the first time.
70010000093114.description:
Get ready for a fun and exciting adventure with the most amazing little pigs in town!

Every year, the little town holds the Big Young Pig Race, and this year promises to be the most exciting one yet. Join Runi, the fastest little pig, Mia, the most cunning strategist, and Len, the brave and strong one of the group, as they compete in a race full of natural obstacles, unexpected surprises, and unforgettable lessons.

But they won't be alone: along the way, they'll meet Tito, a lonely and competitive pig whose defiant attitude will test the true strength of teamwork.

A journey full of values:

·Discover the importance of cooperation.

·Learn how to overcome fears with courage and perseverance.

·Celebrate the power of friendship, because together, we are stronger!

·With adorable characters, funny situations, and a message that will touch the hearts of the whole family, this story is a celebration of true team spirit.

·Perfect for playing or enjoying with the family: This story combines action, humour, and positive values that both children and adults will love.

Who will win the race? The answer is on the road!

70010000093116.name: Heroes of Loot: Gauntlet of Power
70010000093116.intro: Mount and upgrade your weapons into special combos in this randomly generated action RPG shooter. Mow down thousands of dungeon dwelling creatures and survive as you descend deep
70010000093116.description:
As you hold the mythical Gauntlet of Power you gain the ability to mount weapons in eight directions to protect and mow down the many dangers lurking in the dungeons. Max up your weapons, mount modifiers, combine weapons to create new weapons, or create weapon-unions for even more exotic powers as you explore the weapon tree!

All wrapped up in a fast paced, randomly generated action RPG shooter with dungeon crawling and Rogue-like elements.

You are a weathered adventurer descending the Heroes of Loot Dungeons, be it Elf, Wizard, Warrior or Valkyrie, you are on a mission to sort out this dungeon and it's creepy crawly horde of monsters. Collecting loot to power up your new found Gauntlet.

Locate mysterious items that aid you on this power trip as you go deeper into the belly of the beast: Unlocking a host of weapons, uncovering secret rooms, run into Monk's handing you quests, or purchase new gadgets from the various shops in the dungeon!

An average game run is about 20-25 minutes, a full dungeon run + final boss defeat will take up about 60 minutes. Each game is different and unique, so make sure to keep trying!

Key features:

- Randomly generated dungeons, items enemies and bosses, you never play the same game twice
- 5 base weapons and 9 special combo's and union weapons - all upgradable in strength
- Unique items that enhance your powers against the horde of enemies
- Over 14 end bosses
- 6 dungeons covering 16 levels and a final boss-of-all-bosses battle
- 2 playable and 2 unlockable classes
- Unlockable Rune-power options to support you in completing the game
- Perma unlockable Forged cards
- Secret rooms, Quests, Treasure rooms, and Shops


Learn about active, passive and special items by collecting them and using them. This information is then stored in your Codex for future games. Learn about various dungeon dwelling creatures by defeating enough of them to learn their weaknesses and open up their information in your Codex.

Try different weapon-mounting configurations to unlock combo weapons, union weapons and see if you can find the perfect balance on your Gauntlet of Power!

70010000093118.name: Hentai Girls: Sexy Sakura
70010000093118.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000093118.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000093120.name: Hentai Girls: Naughty Astronaut
70010000093120.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000093120.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000093124.name: Hentai Girls: Postal Passion
70010000093124.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000093124.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000093126.name: Hentai Girls: DJ Romance
70010000093126.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000093126.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000093128.name: Hentai Girls: Charming Chef
70010000093128.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000093128.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000093130.name: Hentai Girls: Daring Detective
70010000093130.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000093130.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000093132.name: Kara Fantasy
70010000093132.intro: Show the world that the true hero lives in each of us!
70010000093132.description:
Imagine a world where every step opens the door to unknown lands, where every breath of wind whispers ancient spells. In this world where the fate of the kingdom. Take on the role of Hiro, a young and brave bodyguard whose fate is unexpectedly intertwined with the greatest challenge of his life - the rescue of Princess Kara, kidnapped by dark forces from her royal house.

Embark on a journey, where every corner hides dangers, and every shadow can come to life. Your road will be littered with challenges: from battles with insidious monsters to solving ancient riddles that guard the secrets of passing to the next gate.

Your arsenal includes swords, bows, boomerangs, magic staffs and bombs. Visit a blacksmith to upgrade your weapons and equipment, become stronger by buying resources from a local store, and discover the ancient secrets of alchemy by creating potions from a wise witch.

Can you collect the crystals that are the key to the portals leading to Princess Kara?


Features:
* Character Development: Collect resources, upgrade weapons and armor, and create powerful potions for your journey!
* Riddles and battles: The levels are filled with a variety of puzzles and monster battles that require both strategic thinking and dexterity.
* Arsenal of weapons: At your disposal are swords, bows, boomerangs, magic staffs and bombs to fight enemies.
* Many enemies: Players will have to fight slugs, skeletons, orcs, goblins, spiders, rats, demons and other cruel monsters.
* Journey through the forest worlds: To save Princess Kara, Hiro must go through five unique forest worlds and overcome 30 levels, each with its own unique challenges and enemies.

70010000093136.name: Can I crash at your place? おしかけねーちゃん
70010000093136.intro:
Two sisters arrive, bringing trouble along!?
A thrilling life surrounded by beautiful sisters begins!
70010000093136.description:
◆Story
The protagonist Yuuki Fujino is living alone in the city after moving from the countryside.
One day, his two childhood friends suddenly show up at his door!

Minato and Akiho, his childhood friends,
reveal that they were almost forced into a marriage meeting with a pervert who insisted on "marrying them both at the same time"...
Feeling sorry for them, Yuuki decides to let them stay and starts a shared life together.

One day, Yuuki returns home from his part-time job to find a suspicious person clinging to his apartment door's peephole.
"Who’s there?!" Yuki demands. The suspicious man angrily shouts, "What’s your relationship with my women?!"
From this, Yuuki realizes the man is likely the pervert who caused the sisters to run away and attempts to detain him, but the man escapes.

Now that the sisters’ location has been exposed, Yuuki’s home is no longer safe.
Who is this mysterious stalker? And what will become of their daily life...?


◆Characters
・Minato Togano
The older sister of the Togano family is usually strong-willed and selfish, often bossing Yuuki around.
She's not good at household chores, leaving most of them to her younger sister, Akiho.
However, she occasionally shows glimpses of kindness.

・Akiho Togano
Minato's younger sister is kind, caring, and an excellent cook.
With her gentle and easygoing personality, she unwittingly soothes Yuuki.
Her style surpasses that of her older sister.

・Kaori Mikanagi
A cheerful and energetic senior at Yuuki’s part-time job.
Her playful personality often leads her to tease Yuuki for fun.
With her tomboyish nature, she’s also popular among the female customers at work.

・Yuuki Fujino
The protagonist, living alone in the city after moving from the countryside.
Surrounded mostly by older people, he naturally ends up in the "younger brother" role wherever he goes.
His life takes a turn when his older childhood friends, the Togano sisters, suddenly move in, starting an unexpected life together...

70010000093141.name: MIKO x MIKO SISTERS 神楽家の巫女と悪霊
70010000093141.intro: Akira's unlucky encounter with an evil spirit throws his life into chaos. With the help of two beautiful shrine maiden sisters, he sets out to banish the spirit but...?
70010000093141.description:
◆Story
The protagonist, Akira Yamanabe, embarks on a solo journey to mark his graduation from university.
Along the way, he stumbles upon an eerily decrepit shrine and discovers a mysterious object covered in talismans.

At that very moment, the shrine’s priestesses, Hazuki and Uzuki Kagura, appear.
Mistaking Akira for a thief, Hazuki hurls the mysterious object at him, knocking him unconscious in his escape attempt.

At the exact moment the mysterious object struck him, Akira found himself possessed by a mischievous spirit that had been sealed within it.
From that day forward, Akira begins hearing the spirit's voice, notices his right arm discoloring, and finds himself unintentionally scaring people from the shadows.

As they search for a way to perform the exorcism, can they ultimately succeed in banishing the mischievous spirit…?


◆Characters
・Hazuki Kagura
Warm-hearted and energetic, yet often prone to overdoing things, Hazuki is the older of the Kagura sisters.
She is the one responsible for throwing the mysterious object that caused the evil spirit to possess Akira.
While she possesses powerful spiritual abilities, she struggles to use them effectively.

・Uzuki Kagura
Gentle and shy, Uzuki is the younger of the Kagura sisters.
Her timid nature leads her to avoid Akira, making it difficult for her to connect with him.
Though she lacks the powerful spiritual abilities of her sister, her extensive knowledge allows her to effectively support Hazuki.

・Akira Yamanabe
Embarking on a solo journey under the guise of post-graduation exploration,
Akira Yamanabe is, in truth, seeking himself after a string of failed job applications.
Led by a stray dog, he stumbles upon a shrine, only to have the misfortune of becoming possessed by a mischievous spirit.

70010000093146.name: Station platform 42
70010000093146.intro: Horror action ADV in which you fight evil spirits on a station platform!
70010000093146.description:
Station platform 42 is a 2D horror action ADV.
Find the evil spirits lurking on the station platform and exorcise them with amulets.
Sometimes the evil spirits attack you!
Let's clean up the station ruled by evil spirits by confronting various weirdness.

70010000093151.name: Zero-Sum Heart
70010000093151.intro: To gain the love of all people, would you dedicate your own heart?
70010000093151.description:
Game Features:
A short story fusing romance, school life, thriller, and magical realism (approx. 2 hours playtime, multiple endings)
Psychedelic and vibrant neo-flat illustration art style depicting a surreal world
Dreamlike yet eerie original soundtrack with immersive sound design
Synopsis:
As an 18-year-old student at a magical boarding school, "I" made a fateful decision: to trade my heart to a witch in an occult ritual.
The witch's ritual granted all my desires – adoring crowds, unprecedented status, and a grand romance. But the crowds turned faceless, power became a viper's nest, and love... How could I possibly respond to his affection... when I had no heart left to feel?

70010000093156.name: How to Become a Coffee Master
70010000093156.intro:
Master the art of coffee, from bean to cup.
Learn barista techniques and craft perfect recipes.
Turn your coffee passion into true mastery.
70010000093156.description:
Ever dreamed of making the perfect cup of coffee? How to Become a Coffee Master is the ultimate guide to turning your passion for coffee into expertise.
From understanding different coffee beans to perfecting latte art, this comprehensive guide walks you through every step. Learn brewing techniques, espresso fundamentals, and barista secrets used by professionals. Whether you’re a coffee enthusiast or aiming to master the craft, this guide offers detailed instructions, step-by-step tutorials, and expert tips to help you refine your skills.
Discover how to choose the best beans, extract rich flavors, and create stunning coffee presentations. Explore a variety of brewing methods, from traditional espresso to modern pour-over techniques. Experiment with specialty drinks, milk frothing, and creative recipes to impress yourself and others.
Take your coffee knowledge to the next level and start your journey to becoming a true coffee master!

70010000093162.name: Luminaria: Dark Echoes
70010000093162.intro: Save the world in this steampunk roguelite full of mystery.
70010000093162.description:
Welcome to Luminaria Dark Echoes, a narrative roguelite-survivor game where you'll uncover the mysteries of a post-apocalyptic steampunk world.

Experience a fascinating story, fight off hordes of enemies, and face epic final bosses in a challenging and replayable experience.

Embark on an exciting odyssey to battle growing darkness and confront terrifying bosses. Armed with light-powered weapons, uncover dark secrets and overcome epic challenges in a steampunk world full of mystery.

Are you ready to embark on a journey filled with light and adventure?

In an alternate universe where the Industrial Revolution took a dark turn and light became a rare treasure, a world war left humanity on the brink of extinction. Amid the ruins, a few brave survivors endure. Now, a dark entity rises, corrupting souls and plunging the world into deep darkness.

Will you dare to challenge the darkness in this alternate world?

In the vast world of Luminaria, choose your path and define your destiny. Each phase is a unique chapter where light guides your steps through ever-changing steampunk darkness.

Let the light be your guide.

Evolve with powerful new abilities as you progress. Learn spells, increase your strength, stamina, and speed to become a master of light.

Develop your luminous skills!

Key Features

Narrative roguelite-survivor adventure.  
Explore a vast interconnected world, filled with shadows and excitement at every corner.  
Luminous Equipment Customization.  
Upgrade your abilities with every choice at the shop.  
Find light-powered weapons, from glowing staffs to solar flamethrowers.   
Face a wide variety of twisted enemies and ancient corrupted automatons.  
Challenge epic bosses, each with unique tactics and powerful dark abilities that will test your courage.

70010000093164.name: EGGCONSOLE XANADU MSX
70010000093164.intro: Obtain the legendary sword "Dragon Slayer" and defeat the King Dragon! The latest MSX version features UI changes and balance adjustments!
70010000093164.description:
Your adventure leads to defeating a mighty red dragon in the realm of darkness. To slay it, you must wield the legendary sword, "Dragon Slayer." The only clue to the sword's hidden location is the Crown of the King of the Spirits. Your journey must begin by finding this crown. Now, let the journey commence!

This is a side-view action RPG released in Japan by Nihon Falcom in 1987. Originally launched in 1985, it is the latest installment in its series. Players take on the role of an adventurer exploring 10 stages with the ultimate goal of defeating the King Dragon. The map features shops and roaming monsters, but monsters are finite, disappearing once they’ve been hunted down.

The game employs a symbol encounter system for battles. Contacting a monster switches to a combat scene where you can attack using weapons (by ramming) or cast spells. Defeating enemies yields treasure chests containing items or money.

In this game, the player character doesn't have a specific class. Instead, there are two types of experience points and levels—warrior and mage. Your character grows in either discipline depending on how you defeat enemies. Additionally, weapons, armor, and magic have their own experience points, allowing them to become more effective with repeated use. As monsters are finite, so is the experience you can gain. Thus, you’ll need to strategize carefully: will you use weapons or magic to defeat your foes? Managing your character’s and items’ growth effectively will be key to success.

Can you defeat colossal bosses like the giant squid Kraken, the multi-armed giant Kartikea, and the shimmering Silver Dragon, before finally vanquishing the King Dragon? This game, a Japanese PC classic, sold 400,000 copies—a record that remains unbroken. Few titles fit the term "epoch-making" as perfectly as this one!

The MSX version, now being re-released, includes minor changes, such as the addition of item icons for equipped gear, reflecting its later release. Some players prefer the MSX version, making it a notable addition for fans of Xanadu!

70010000093168.name: Young Kong: The Myth of the Magic Throne
70010000093168.intro: In a fantasy kingdom where animals rule, the balance and unity of the valley has been destroyed after the loss of its magical throne.
70010000093168.description:
Zambú, a young monkey marked by his past, sets out on a journey accompanied by brave allies: a cunning fox, a resourceful chameleon, an energetic squirrel, and a strong porcupine.

Together, they face ancient mysteries and enigmatic challenges as they travel through forgotten territories, ancient temples, and dangerous landscapes. As they uncover the secrets of the throne, they learn the true meaning of leadership, unity, and sacrifice.

On their journey, they face not only external threats, such as powerful spectral guardians and the forces of darkness, but also their own inner fears and doubts.

Each test brings them closer to restoring light and hope to the valley, proving that true strength lies in mutual trust and collaboration.

It is a story full of action, friendship, and values, perfect to inspire and excite young readers with a magical world full of unforgettable adventures.

70010000093170.name: Home Deco Builder
70010000093170.intro: Brings you the joy of building miniature interiors and create your own cozy home designs as you want. Simple, relaxing and fun!
70010000093170.description:
Home Deco Builder is a relaxing game about interior decorating and lets you freely create your dream home in seconds! Choose from different room types and decorate your room as you want. Choose from different items ranging from kitchen equipment to curtains or carpets.

Features :
- Decorate four different room sizes with a variety of different items
- Relaxing game experience
- Lets you completely free building/decorating

70010000093175.name: Ice Sisters: Princesses of the Frozen Age
70010000093175.intro: In the magical kingdom of Lunalia, where the seasons are controlled by an ancestral legacy, two sisters inherit the duty of maintaining natural balance.
70010000093175.description:
Meet this beautiful story presented in visual novel format. The story begins when a mistake in a sacred ritual unleashes uncontrollable forces, the world begins to crumble under a blanket of frost.

As they struggle to understand the extent of their powers and face the fears that divide them, they must embark on a dangerous journey to a mystical place that holds the key to restoring balance.

But the shadows lurking in the ice have other plans, and Lunalia's fate will depend not only on her ability to face the unbridled magic, but on the strength of their bond as sisters.

70010000093177.name: Mega City Force
70010000093177.intro: Retrowave Action Roguelike featuring tough agents battling crime! Choose your agent and dive into hardcore action against enemies and bosses, utilizing a vast arsenal and special abilities
70010000093177.description:
Hello, Agent. Mega City needs your services. Are you ready to uphold the law?

The crime is out of control, the streets are not clean. There are criminals and psychopaths everywhere, ready to cut anyone’s throat. A corrupt megacorporation squeezes the life out of the citizens, seeking to establish control all over the city.
Only the incorruptible agents of Mega City Task Force stand fast before the crime wave that consumed the city and threatens to overwhelm society.
Choose your agent and dive into a deadly battle against the criminals and brutal bosses to unleash the beast of justice in the darkest corners of the city.

DISCOVER THE MUSIC OF DROID BISHOP, TIMECOP1983, SUBLUNAR, AND MORE!
Defeat bosses to collect iconic synth-wave tracks on audio cassettes. Set up a special audio player within the Headquarters to immerse yourself in their mesmerizing melodies.

HARDCORE GAMEPLAY WITH TONS OF WEAPONS AND UPGRADES
Shoot, punch and use your abilities to destroy enemies at every level where you will find special boxes containing various weapons. Remember to collect money from enemies, they can be spent at the store to get new equipment and special contracts.
Each level and every enemy is designed to hone your skills by utilizing each agent’s arsenal to its fullest, ensuring you will fight crime in the most effective way possible. Quick reaction and tactical thinking will be required to succeed.

EVERY AGENT BOASTS A UNIQUE TACTICAL PLAYSTYLE
Become a brutal killing machine like a Cyborg who has three weapon slots, improved armor, and a magnetic pulse that interrupts attacks and stun enemies.
Take on the classic role of a Rookie using a tactical dodge and stun grenade.
Turn into a fast and extremely dangerous Scout with a lightweight frame and optical camouflage staying invisible to enemies and using her laser sight to inflict critical damage when the time is right.
These are just a few of the agents available from the start. Unlock more characters with unique tactical abilities as you go!

PIXEL ART VISUAL STYLE INSPIRED BY THE 80S AND THE 90S ACTION MOVIES AND VIDEO GAMES
Do you remember the good old days when tough action heroes dispatched enemies with cool moves to a banging soundtrack? The entire game is imbued with the same retro spirit. Each pixel, each gun, and each item were crafted to give you that nostalgic feeling, from retro dudes for retro dudes with true love.

HIGH REPLAYABILITY, A ROBUST PROGRESSION SYSTEM, AND PROCEDURALLY GENERATED LEVELS
What happens when crime is vanquished? It comes back with a vengeance. Completing the game for the first time unlocks a new difficulty and more loadouts with instantly recognizable legendary outfits. Uphold the law in style.

70010000093187.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
70010000093187.intro: Join your favorite Dr. Seuss characters in 18 exciting minigames and challenges. Your house is about to be full of giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.
70010000093187.description:
The Cat in the Hat once said, “It is fun to have fun, but you have to know how.” 

Everyone from the mischievous Dr. Seuss classic is here. Become smart and steady Sally, energetic wild card Johnny, cause double the trouble as Thing 1 & Thing 2 or be cheerful Little Cat A. And of course, the chaos conductor, The Cat in the Hat and anxiously wise Fish will be there to help, on this zany ride. 

Play solo or go against your friends, choosing from two trick-filled game modes. Fancy a game of chase? Then ‘Find the Cat’ will have you turning the house upside down looking for The Cat in the Hat. Or maybe you prefer getting into chaotic challenges? See how quickly you can capture penguins, decorate a cake, and who knows what else in the 18 minigames you can choose from.  

But the fun doesn’t stop there, just like The Cat’s hat, it’ll be full of tricks. With varying difficulty levels, long challenges and short, there’s something for everyone. 

Get ready for your house to be filled with giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.  

ELEVATE YOUR GAME NIGHT: Dive into the mayhem solo or race to the end with up to 4 players.  

CLASSIC DR. SEUSS CHARACTERS: Play as Sally, Johnny, Thing 1 & Thing 2 and Little Cat. 

CHOOSE YOUR MODE FOR NON-STOP FUN: Pick from 18 entertaining minigames or find The Cat across 14 rooms. 

BOUNCE, CHASE & PAINT TO WIN: Compete for rewards. Will you find all the stickers for your book? 

A PARTY FOR ALL AGES: Re-play in different ways, with easy controls and varying difficulties.

70010000093189.name: BALL x PIT
70010000093189.intro: A brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite.
70010000093189.description:
BALL x PIT is a fast-paced fantasy roguelite where heroes must find the balls to plunge deeper into a seemingly bottomless pit of monsters. Develop arcane ammunition and resources in pursuit of treasure, recruiting additional heroes to aid you in your perilous quest.

Ballbylon has fallen. After a meteoric and completely unexpected event annihilated the great city, all that remains is an ominous, yawning pit. Treasure hunters from far and wide flock to the city’s tomb to seek their fortune, plumbing the depths in search of Ballbylon’s scattered riches. Few return.

The pit plays host to armies of barbaric creatures, hellbent on ending your quest before it even begins. Armed with a growing arsenal of magic-infused projectiles, batter your way through multiple levels of increasingly challenging obstacles to claim the ultimate prizes and rebuild New Ballbylon.

Fuse Your Balls
The Ball Fusion system encourages explosive experimentation with over 60 randomized balls to equip and combine during your journey. Discover overpowered combinations and unexpected synergies from hundreds of possible outcomes.

Build New Ballbylon
Expand New Ballbylon with over 70 unique buildings that provide gameplay bonuses and unlock further power-ups, new characters, and more! As your community grows, task homebound heroes with automated tasks to keep the resources coming while you dive deeper into the pit.

Discover New Realms
Face legions of diverse enemies within the pit, battling through barren deserts, frozen caverns, savage forests and more. Each region offers its own unique set of hazards on top of hordes of increasingly challenging foes and mighty, screen-filling bosses.

Recruit Fellow Hunters
As you explore the pit you’ll encounter fellow treasure hunters eager to add their skills to your expedition. Each character has unique, upgradable mechanics that totally change the way you play the game. Experimentation and adaptation are crucial to the success of New Ballbylon!

70010000093194.name: Hope's Farm 2
70010000093194.intro: Build your dream farm in this unique blend of farming and puzzle adventure! Grow crops, raise adorable animals, and solve delightful puzzles to unlock new items and expand your farm.

70010000093204.name: MADO MONOGATARI: Fia and the Wondrous Academy
70010000093204.intro: Enroll in the Ancient Magic Academy and become a Great Mage!
70010000093204.description:
What is MADO MONOGATARI?
MADO MONOGATARI began as a series of primarily first-person dungeon-crawler RPGs created by Compile for the MSX and PC-98 during the 80's and 90's. Since then, MADO MONOGATARI has made a name for itself with its unforgettable characters and dungeon-crawling gameplay. Notably, the renowned puzzle series Puyo Puyo is a spinoff of the MADO MONOGATARI series.

MADO MONOGATARI: Fia and the Wondrous Academy Story
The Ancient Magic Academy.

An academy with a long, storied past, known as the place where The Great Mage learned and graduated. Students study here to become Mages themselves.

A girl named Fia, wanting to enroll in the Academy, makes a long arduous journey from her hometown, and manages to get in through her own luck.

She now tries her best to get through the many challenges of schoolwork, strict professors, and mysterious happenings, all in pursuit of her goal to become a Great Mage herself, while also making friends with other students in her class.

Embark on an adventure with Fia and her classmates as they explore the mysteries of the Ancient Magic Academy and uncover the legends of The Great Mage.

Key Features
Conquer Dynamic Dungeons and Help Fia Become A Great Mage! — Crawl through randomly generated dungeons and engage in real-time, turn-based battles to help Fia level up. Use Magic Artes and collect Elemental Orbs to fill up your gauge and unleash Great Magic Artes. Manage your inventory and stats as you traverse floor after floor of wondrous treasures and magical monsters—including Puyo, Skeleton T, and others!

Keep your Grimoire Handy! — Keep track of unlocked abilities with the Grimoire, which logs Fia's Magic Artes. Complete Assignments, Help Quests, and earn Learning Points that can be used to unlock nodes in the Grimoire for Fia to learn new Magic Artes. 

Fia is Mad About Town! — Take a break from dungeon crawling and explore the school grounds where Fia can check out the Bulletin Board for unlocked mini-games, interact with classmates, grow ingredients, cook curry for in-dungeon boosts, and more! Find out what other goings on await Fia along her journey!

Swords, Shields, and Shiny Armor with Synthesis in the Storage Room — In the Storage Room of the school grounds, use items found in dungeons to synthesize into new equipment for Fia. Better synthesis items can later be unlocked via the Grimoire.

70010000093205.name: Wheel of Words: Crossword
70010000093205.intro:
Solve Crosswords, Unearth Hidden Gems!
Easy to Expert—Play Your Way!
70010000093205.description:
Discover the Thrill of Word Challenges

"Wheel of Words: Crossword" is a delightful word puzzle game designed to test your vocabulary and problem-solving skills. Connect letters to form words that fit into crossword puzzles, uncover hidden bonus words, and enjoy the rewarding feeling of completing each grid. With a smooth interface and simple controls, the game ensures an engaging experience for players of all ages. Hints are available to guide you through tricky levels, so you're never stuck for long.

A Journey Through Words
The game features over 70+ levels per language, organized into difficulty tiers ranging from Very Easy to Expert. Whether you want a casual challenge or something that pushes your word mastery to the limit, there’s always a level that matches your mood and skill.

Dive into Special Categories
Expand your horizons with unique themed puzzles, including "Phrases in Japanese" and bonus categories like "Animals" and "IT." Note that these bonus categories are available only in the English and Polish versions.

Unlock your inner wordsmith and enjoy endless hours of puzzle-solving with "Wheel of Words: Crossword"!

70010000093210.name: The Rogue Prince of Persia™
70010000093210.description:
Dive into a thrilling and epic adventure, where every action pulses to the heady rhythm of an intense soundtrack. Master fluid, acrobatic, and responsive combat, paired with challenging parkour. Death after death, forge your own playstyle – through exploration and encounters, perhaps you'll find a way to right your wrongs and save the Persian kingdom envisioned by Evil Empire.

REWRITE FATE. SAVE PERSIA. DIE TRYING.
Shape the legend of a Prince spared by death, whose fatal mistake doomed his people. Try your best to right your wrongs: each failure is a new chance to explore different paths, discover secrets, meet new characters, and use the knowledge gained from past attempts to change your people's fate and prove yourself as the true Prince of Persia.

MASTER A FAST AND ACROBATIC STYLE
As the Prince of Persia, agility is your greatest weapon. Dodge traps, wall-run, chain acrobatic combos, and strike with precision. Every movement is an opportunity, and every battle will reward skill and style.

FIGHT YOUR OWN WAY
Discover, unlock, and master over 100 unique weapons and medallions. Adapt, upgrade, and customize your build with each run, crafting deadly combinations that fit your playstyle.

ONE MORE TRULY UNIQUE RUN
No run is ever the same. Dive back into this ever-evolving adventure, where narration, metaprogression, difficulty modifiers, random events, and procedurally generated levels will always leave you craving just one more unique run.

70010000093215.name: Arcade Archives Land Sea Air Squad
70010000093215.intro: Break through the frontlines by any means necessary!!
70010000093215.description:
"Land Sea Air Squad" is an action game released by TAITO in 1986.
Command this elite squad comprised of infantry, navy and air force to attack the enemy strongholds.
The player takes control of sergeant Sarge, in a stage-based game where he must blast through every obstacle using grenades, machine guns and even vehicles in the most realistic battle ever fought on a 1986 video screen!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000093223.name: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2
70010000093223.intro: Take care of destroying and recovering materials from shipwrecks.
70010000093223.description:
Dust off your torch and hammer - it's time to get back to work, you have a new job to do. Visit the new beach coast with the largest, biggest ship graveyard in the world, dismantle huge ship parts and collect tons of precious steel. Roll up your sleeves, it's time to get back to the business.

In the game, you can expect new bigger ships, new gameplay mechanics, features and improvements, but also well-known mechanics from the first game that have been significantly improved.

IT'S GOOD TO BE BACK IN THE BUSINESS! 
Ship Graveyard Simulator is back bigger than before and it doesn't matter if you're a veteran in the game or for the first time you will have a hammer and a torch in your hands there are a dozen of kilometers of wreckage on the coast, and thousands of tons of steel - you will get into this business.

DISASSEMBLE BIG SHIP PARTS
Large ship parts? Oh yes! You will need a special crane and a large container for it. Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 will have large fragments, modules and wreck components available for demolition, including engines, pumps, control panels, and much more.

HUGE SHIPS
Order new ships waiting for demolition via the computer in your home, and with the new ship, you will receive a new task! Collect all the necessary steel, aluminum, or copper parts, even a small part has its own value. There will be several types of ships available in the game, which will be divided into individual categories - some of them are real colossi.

DESTRUCTION
Your main task in the game is to dismantle ships into small parts. Some of them will be small, but a huge challenge awaits you, which will be the disassembly of real giants, and hiring workers who will be able to help you. Use the available tools - hammer, saw, torch, etc. - to disassemble individual pieces of the ship into smaller pieces, collect as many of them as possible and develop your business!

DANGERS
Remember that you are doing one of the most dangerous jobs in the world and you disarm the biggest shipwrecks in the world, so what could go wrong? In Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 there are many dangers waiting for you - gas leakage, electric shock from cable, and poisoning with toxins in unsecured rooms. Do you remember about large fragments and ship modules? You'd better have your helmet on.

This game include Warships DLC as part of the base game, included ships are:
-Chevy
-Fuso
-Wicher

70010000093226.name: Necroking
70010000093226.description:
Troubles and decay struck the cities, the villages were gripped in the vices of madness, and people began to look for a reason to fight in order to throw out their aggressors.

You are the Necroking. Put on the crown of a powerful necromancy magic and embark on a dark and twisted journey to bring chaos and destruction to settlements desecrated by life itself. Raise an army of skeletons and other vile creatures to conquer your enemies and establish your dominion!

GAME FEATURES
Become the Death Monarch. Harness the dark powers of necromancy and command an army of more than 30 types of undead minion.

Real-Time Tactical Gameplay. Engage in intense battles where strategic decision-making and quick reflexes are key.

Vast Skull Deckbuilding. Customize your playstyle by unlocking new Skulls and upgrading your units' skills.

Roguelite Elements. Every playthrough is unique, with procedurally generated levels and unpredictable challenges.

Pixel Art Visuals. Immerse yourself in a beautifully hand-crafted world brought to life through stunning pixel-art graphics.

Prepare to unleash the ultimate power of necromancy and claim your rightful place as the feared Necroking. Are you ready to embrace the darkness and reshape the world in your image? The time has come to rise and conquer!

70010000093229.name: All The Words She Wrote
70010000093229.intro: Endearing lesbian romance between writer and reader
70010000093229.description:
Takaoka Mayo is a twenty-four-year-old woman without any life plans, but she does have a passion: namely, Princess Luluna from the popular light novel series, Elf Forest.

Mayo is content to admire her favourite fictional character from afar, until she receives an incredible opportunity. Elf Forest’s mysterious writer is looking for a housekeeper! The reclusive woman is named Komikado Hijiri, and soon Mayo finds herself living under Hijiri’s roof.

Contrary to Mayo’s beliefs, Tsuchimi Rui is not a middle-aged man, but a young woman only a few years older than she is: a reclusive, awkward hermit who, despite being sub five feet tall, has a biting tongue and a needle-sharp personality.

As Mayo grows fond of Hijiri, she wonders: who does she really care about? Princess Luluna, or the author who created her?


Features
* 100,000 words of text (approx 4-6 hours of reading)
* A linear story with no choices/branches
* Detailed character and background artwork
* An original soundtrack
* One short, grumpy writer
* A cute lesbian love story
* A happy ending!

70010000093232.name: The Fairy's Secret
70010000093232.intro: The sequel to The Fairy’s Song
70010000093232.description:
Two years have passed since the events of The Fairy’s Song, and Marnie has been happily living together with her adorable girlfriend, Lisbeth. Marnie is worried about her grandmother, Iris, who lives in the small, scenic village of Fenchapel.

Iris’s health has been failing her as of late, and Marnie worries, if she does not spend more time with her grandmother, she will later regret it. It is with this thought in mind that Marnie and Lisbeth decide to pay Iris a visit during the summer holidays.

Soon events take a turn for the complicated when they run into a familiar face in Iris’s garden. Edmund, the vengeful knight, has returned seemingly from beyond the grave to deliver a grim and alarming message. 


Features
* Lesbian romance-themed kinetic novel
* Beautiful original art and music
* 85,000 words of text
* Continuation of The Fairy’s Song

70010000093240.name: With Eyes of Ice
70010000093240.intro: Follow Gréta, as she finds herself caught between the affections of three men who care for her in different ways.
70010000093240.description:
Dying of frostbite, Gréta Egilsdóttir is left to wonder how she found herself in such a dire situation. 

Perhaps it began with Steina’s baby, or with Kai agreeing to stay the night, or with that kiss she almost shared with Nataníel.

Perhaps it began when she journeyed from her home to work as a housemaid in the distant fishing village… 

Or perhaps it began three years ago, when her grandmother was still alive. For Gréta, meeting Nataníel Jóhannsson was love at first sight…

But there are some loves which cannot — or perhaps should not — be.


Features
* Dramatic linear visual novel
* 120,000 words
* Beautiful original art and music
* Emotional story with memorable characters

70010000093245.name: Kingdom Shell
70010000093245.intro: Discover the world of the Kingdom, rich in lore and atmosphere.
70010000093245.description:
The magical Shell that has protected the Kingdom for centuries has been shattered. Hordes of nightmarish creatures now overrun the Kingdom, terrorizing its inhabitants.

The White Temple, which has stood guard over the Kingdom for centuries, cannot face this threat alone. They are forced to seek help from Elias, a half-blood in whose veins flows the blood of nightmares. He may be the Kingdom's only hope.

Explore the lands of the Kingdom, fight hordes of nightmarish creatures and powerful bosses, find secrets, help inhabitants in distress and stop the impending catastrophe.

Game Features:
Discover the world of the Kingdom, rich in lore and atmosphere.
Stunning hand-drawn pixel art and animation.
Engage your foes up close, executing impressive combos, dodge attacks, and strike them with a variety of spells.
Meet the inhabitants of the Kingdom. Some of them have rumors that can be investigated.
Engage in challenging and intriguing boss fights, with over a dozen in the game, including secret bosses.
Explore the Kingdom's world, filled with hidden places and mysteries.
Find items, spells, and abilities to aid you in your journey.
Customize your playstyle with the inspiration system.

70010000093250.name: Everdeep Aurora
70010000093250.intro: An ongoing apocalyptic meteor shower has forced the world’s population to settle underground. As Shell, drill downward through a tile-based underground and discover the Everdeep.
70010000093250.description:
This narrative exploration and platform game inspired by 16-bit aesthetics will take you back to the simplicity and excitement of the classics of that era. There’s a vibrant and dynamic world to explore, and lots of peculiar characters to meet and varied puzzles to solve. Will you discover the secrets hidden in the Everdeep?

As you descend, your decisions determine Shell’s route through the depths, from secret caverns to sprawling underground dwellings.

Encounter characters along the way with unique personalities and, sometimes, optional side quests.

Revel in atmospheric pixel art and an evocative soundtrack, with palettes and musical themes shifting from one location to the next.

70010000093255.name: Jurassic Island: Little Dinosaur Park
70010000093255.intro: This graphic novel follows the adventures of a group of dinosaurs who find an island full of challenges and ancient secrets.
70010000093255.description:
In this exciting adventure, a group of dinosaurs led by the brave Rexy embark on a journey to discover the secrets of Jurassic Island, guided by an ancient map that promises legendary treasure.

Joined by the strategist Trini (Triceratops), the agile explorer Raptor (Velociraptor), the protector Stego (Stegosaurus) and the nervous but loyal Parry (Parasaurolophus), the team faces challenges that test their courage, ingenuity and unity.

·Easy game mode designed for children.

·Entertaining children's story with easy reading.

·Learn to read with fun stories in English.

·Cheerful ambient music and immersive sounds.

·Learn about Jurassic history and geography through an entertaining adventure.

·Educational content about dinosaurs with the recreation of natural places of great beauty.

·Adjust accessibility settings such as font height, sound volume, and image transition speed.

70010000093267.name: Blazing Trail
70010000093267.intro: Humanity’s fate rides with you in this vertical co-op shooter, offering accessible, action-packed gameplay.
70010000093267.description:
Blazing Trail is an isometric pixel art shooter that requires daring on-the-fly strategy. Use machine guns, missiles and laser power-ups to take down enemy soldiers, demolish buildings and watchtowers, destroy gates, shoot down aircrafts and face off against huge bosses across 7 sprawling combat zones.

Roll through checkpoints and save progress between stages. Complete your mission solo or team up with a friend for cooperative play! Can you escape the terrorists’ clutches and save the world from their maniacal plans?

• Escape with the advanced military vehicle that you helped develop!
• Blast through 7 zones with guns, missiles and lasers!
• Navigate freely from an isometric overhead perspective!
• Rescue hostages and take down big bosses along the way!
• Drive solo or team up with a friend for cooperative multiplayer.
• Enjoy retro pixel art graphics in HD widescreen style!

70010000093272.name: Secrets In Green
70010000093272.intro: If Mother Nature spoke to you, would you listen and perhaps discover a power growing inside yourself?
70010000093272.description:
Following an unfortunate episode of mental illness, Alma is sent to a cottage in the countryside where she finds peace tending to the overgrown garden. However, while admiring the large ivy growing across its fence, she discovers a leaf bearing a single written word - hello. Her father and caregiver brush it off as nothing but a hallucination, a symptom of her hysteria

But now Alma must face the very real struggle of making herself heard and respected in male-dominated Victorian England. Can you help Alma find her power and solve this dangerous mystery before it's too late?

• Enjoy beautifully illustrated backgrounds and expressive character portraits!
• Navigate a deep narrative about mental health and female empowerment.
• Discover a detailed world set in Victorian England!
• Make key choices and explore multiple endings.
• Immerse yourself in a story of 14,000 written words and an evocative original soundtrack!

70010000093287.name: Tales of Autumn
70010000093287.intro: In Tales of Autumn rebuilding your farm and animal care go hand-in-hand! Befriend chimaeras, help the town, and become the hero of this story!
70010000093287.description:
Tales of Autumn is a wild farming RPG with an emphasis on animals and terrain management. Develop the abandoned ranch, befriend the wildlife, build relationships and earn the trust of the town.

TERRA-FARMING
On your ranch, you can befriend and tame wild creatures while raising farm animals, each with their own unique needs. Shape the land to create different biomes, influencing the crops you can grow and the animals that will be drawn to your farm. Traditional livestock can be raised in barns and coops, providing valuable resources and cutesy companionship


YOU WON’T BE LONELY
Your choices impact the town—good deeds will earn you rewards, discounts, friendship, and helping hands while neglecting the community will result in your neighbours becoming distant. Build relationships with the townsfolk, learn their stories, and let them become part of your adventure - and what a fantastic journey it can be!


UNIQUE EVENTS FOR EVERY SEASON
Relax by casting your fishing rod at the docks or lake, complete with fun minigames and a variety of lures. Discover a lively festival calendar, along with unique character and creature events that unfold as you progress.


KEY FEATURES
- Creature Taming – Befriend and care for wild and farm animals, each with specific needs.
- Karma System – The town reacts to your behavior, offering rewards for kindness or keeping their distance if ignored.
- Relationships – Get to know the townsfolk, hear their stories, and invite them into your journey.
- Fishing – Engage in a fishing minigame with different lures.
- Festivals & Events – Take part in town celebrations and creature events.

70010000093292.name: The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas
70010000093292.intro: Play as the Grinch, collect ornaments, master gadgets, and tackle festive challenges to decorate the ultimate Christmas tree for the Whos.
70010000093292.description:
Every Who down in Who-ville is jingling, singing and celebrating. And guess who can’t wait to join them… the Grinch! Now, with a heart three sizes bigger, and a wish to show the Whos he’s changed, could the Grinch’s prize-winning tree be the perfect way to prove it?  

Play as the Grinch and Jumbo-Jump through snowy 3D worlds, collecting ornaments to make your tree sparkle brighter with every step. Overcome platforming challenges, explore every nook and cranny, and use the clever gadgets you find to get through each level. Unleash the Snowball Maker to freeze mischievous adversaries, launch into action with the Rocket Skates, and reach new heights with the Jetpack.  

Each level is filled with festive adventures. Hop through the Grinch’s Cave, dodging falling stalactites and zipping down watery chutes. Conquer Mt. Crumpit’s slippery ice and giant rolling snowballs. Find your way through Who-wood’s towering trees and springy mushrooms. Then explore Who-ville, leaping across hovering platforms and sneaking into the Whos’ cozy homes. Use your candy canes to break objects and release dazzling ornaments to decorate the Grinch’s Christmas tree and Who-ville Square. 

Adventure solo or team up in local co-op mode. Together with Max, you’ll have fun outsmarting pesky mice, wild forest bats and other curious creatures. Uncover hidden paths and collect every sparkly decoration you can find to make your tree shine.   

Make it a merry day in Who-ville, spread Christmas cheer, and create the most spectacular tree the Whos have ever seen! 

BRING CHEER TO THE WHOS: 
Embark on a festive journey to craft the most spectacular Christmas tree and decorate Who-ville Square. 

EXPLORE VIBRANT WORLDS: 
Swing, smash and Jumbo-Jump your way through the Grinch’s Cave, Mt. Crumpit, Who-wood and merry Who-ville. 

UNLEASH GRINCHY GADGETS: 
Take on every challenge with the help of the Rocket Skates, the Jetpack, the Snowball Maker, and more… 

CO-OP TO SAVE CHRISTMAS: 
Play solo as the Grinch, or team up with a friend as Max to help you. 

AN ADVENTURE FOR EVERYONE: 
Embark on a whimsical journey inspired by the original books, offering intuitive mechanics and challenges accessible to all.

70010000093294.name: Aero Cosmos
70010000093294.intro: Soar through the void—master the skies beyond the stars.
70010000093294.description: Take control of your spacecraft and dive into a cosmic odyssey where speed, precision, and exploration collide. Navigate surreal, gravity-defying landscapes filled with twisting asteroid rings and radiant celestial structures. With every level, push your reflexes to the limit as you dodge obstacles, collect vital energy cores, and uncover hidden mysteries of deep space. Only the sharpest pilots will survive the challenge—are you ready to conquer the cosmos?

70010000093301.name: Legend of the Kitties: Return of Echoes
70010000093301.intro: In a forest full of life, a shining river connects all the creatures that inhabit it. Three young adventurers discover that this river is not just running water.
70010000093301.description:
Discover the magic of friendship in this exciting family visual novel.

Join Luna, a brave kitten, her curious brother Leo, and their clever friend Rocky the raccoon on an unforgettable adventure.

Guided by ancient magical clues and facing a series of fun and challenging tests, this unique trio must work together to protect the mysterious lifeblood that keeps their world in harmony.

Highlights:

Magical Scenarios: Explore enchanted forests, secret ruins, and landscapes that come to life.

Loving Characters: Each with their own personality, special abilities, and a touch of humor that will delight young and old.

Valuable Lessons: Learn about unity, bravery, and respect for nature while having fun.

Family Fun: Accessible controls and a story that connects with players of all ages.

·This celebration of friendship and teamwork is perfect for playing together, discovering secrets, and enjoying magical moments as a family.

·Ideal for children and parents looking for magical adventures full of heart.

Ready to embark on this magical adventure? The world of Luna, Leo, and Rocky awaits!

70010000093303.name: Tanks, But No Tanks
70010000093303.intro:
Battle friends in a chaotic arena shooter with ricocheting bullets.
Collect coins, buy upgrades, and unleash wild weapons.
70010000093303.description:
Tanks, But No Tanks is an updated take on a classic top-down arena tank shooter. This multiplayer madhouse will keep you on your toes as you balance collecting coins on each map with shooting projectiles at your foes. Upgrade your tank’s weapons, armor, and special abilities in between rounds with the coins you accrue.

Aim your bullets and shoot your way through each level. Just be sure that you don't ricochet a bullet right back toward yourself!

Use a diverse weapon set, ranging from deployable turrets to teleportation projectiles to cause extra mayhem on the battlefield!

Features
• 15+ Unique Levels
• 15+ Weapon & Character Upgrades
• Tournament Style Play Rewards The Player Who Survives The Most Rounds
• Play With Up To 4 Local Players
• Different Game Modes Including Free-For-All & Teams
• Adjustable Bot Difficulty

70010000093305.name: Mycelium Heaven
70010000093305.intro: It's a cozy yet challenging puzzle game about a mushroom that devours zombies. You'll expand, grow and consume your way through the forest using your wit and reason.
70010000093305.description:
Enjoy a different and ingenious adventure in Mycelium Heaven where a fungus with a very peculiar diet will help save its home.
Craft your best strategy in this war and overcome levels where you'll discover new and complex mechanics that will test your logic.

70010000093310.name: Sigma Star Saga DX
70010000093310.intro: Half shoot-'em-up, half RPG! Blast through an intergalactic genre mashup!
70010000093310.description:
The classic shooter/RPG is back and better than ever! Featuring a unique mix of side-scrolling shoot-'em-up space battles and top-down planetary exploration, Sigma Star Saga DX is an explosive genre mashup that lets you take control of Allied Earth Federation pilot Ian Recker and infiltrate the alien Krill Empire as a double agent in a last-ditch effort to save mankind. 

With loyalties divided between humans and Krill, you must investigate six planets using an ever-expanding set of tools and abilities, and jump into the cockpit to engage enemy forces in intense shmup-style combat using more than 70 different Gun Data items. Gorgeous pixel-art graphics, epic boss battles, and a twist-filled story with multiple endings await. 

The new DX version adds numerous refinements over the original 2005 release, including an improved map, decreased random encounter rate, rebalanced EXP system, enhanced dialogue, additional save points, assorted bug fixes and quality-of-life updates, and more.

Key Features:
• The handheld classic returns after 20 years!
• Top-down RPG-style exploration mixed with action-packed space-shooter battles!
• Survive as a double agent for the humans and the Krill, and discover the secret of the six planets
• Stunning pixel-art graphics and fantastic soundtrack
• Explore using tools like the Scanner, Krill Boots, Wings, and more
• Customize your ship with more than 70 different Gun Data items yielding 15,000+ combinations
• Branching story with multiple endings
• The definitive DX version adds an improved map, decreased random encounter rate, rebalanced EXP system, updated script, various bug fixes, and other enhancements

70010000093312.name: 1989 After the War
70010000093312.intro: Kick butt in a radioactive post-apocalyptic world
70010000093312.description:
An atomic war has reduced the world to a toxic heap of ruins and chaos.

As an ex-agent named Sebastian Beck, you’ll face off against 7 dangerous criminals and traverse 7 levels filled with enemies and traps to overcome. The game also challenges you with a unique mechanic where the environment becomes increasingly hostile due to radiation—reach regenerating refrigerators that serve as life-saving checkpoints.

Use your blade, grenades and shotgun to fight your way through this dangerous world, in glorious 1980s arcade style.


Features:
* 2D platform action shooting
* 7 different levels each with its own boss
* 8-bit graphics and sound
* Radiation mechanic
* 1980s B-movie style story

70010000093315.name: MADO MONOGATARI: Fia and the Wondrous Academy Digital Art Book
70010000093315.description: Snag the Digital Art Book to study up on The Ancient Magic Academy with design sketches, character portraits, a gallery of CGs, and even an enchanting short story to boot! A total of 64 pages make this Digital Art Book almost as valuable as your Grimoire.

70010000093316.name: MADO MONOGATARI: Fia and the Wondrous Academy Digital Soundtrack
70010000093316.description:
Need a bit of wonder in your school life? This Digital Soundtrack has got you covered with 27 whimsical tunes to study to!

Tracklist:
・ASOVENTURE (Game Ver.)
・Magic Artes Exam Theme
・Ancient Magic Academy Theme
・Mage's Tower Theme
・Skull Prison Theme
・Pyramid Tower Theme
・Tick-Tock Tower Theme
・Dragon's Sanctuary Theme
・Spirit Village Theme
・Great Serpent's Passage Theme
・Grimoire Tower Theme
・Battle Theme
・Boss Battle Theme
・Last Boss Theme
・School Life Theme
・Class Theme
・Sad Event Theme
・Serious Event Theme
・Comical Event Theme
・Happy Event Theme
・Slapstick Theme
・Determined/Urgent Event Theme
・Fia's Theme
・Friendship Theme
・ASOVENTURE (Instrumental)
・MATOUMONOGATARI (Instrumental)
・MATOUMONOGATARI (Game Ver.)

70010000093320.name: Fate/hollow ataraxia REMASTERED
70010000093320.intro: Relive the four days of destiny...
70010000093320.description:
ABOUT THE GAME

Set half a year after the end of the Fifth Holy Grail War, the classic visual novel Fate/hollow ataraxia comes remastered to Nintendo Switch™. Building on the 2014 release, this remaster features English and Simplified Chinese localizations for the first time, in addition to full HD visuals.

Choose your own adventure in colorful scenarios unfolding day and night in the city of Fuyuki as you delve into hidden truths behind the Holy Grail War. You will also unlock a collection of feature-packed minigames as you progress through the story.

Spend your days with familiar characters and explore the world of Fate, all while fighting to survive a new Holy Grail War.

STORY

Half a year has passed since Shirou Emiya won the Fifth Holy Grail War. In the wake of the conflict, Shirou and his friends are readjusting to peaceful, everyday life. Meanwhile, in a desolate mansion on the outskirts of Fuyuki, a mage awakens: Bazett Fraga McRemitz, Seal Designation Enforcer from the Mage's Association...and former Master in the Holy Grail War.

"Come on, let's continue the Holy Grail War, Bazett Fraga McRemitz. All so we can find your wish this time," a shadow sneers at her. Its name is Avenger, Servant of an eighth class who never existed in the Fifth Holy Grail War. Their unlikely encounter signals that the battle is far from finished.

Shirou Emiya, aspiring champion of justice, steps onto the stage of the Holy Grail War once more. What fate awaits him beyond these four days of destiny?

MINIGAMES INCLUDED

* Jump! Tiger&Shorts Hanafuda Travel Journal EX (Excellion)
* Rise! Operation Super Space-Time Tiger&Shorts Hanafuda
* Jump! Super Space-Time Tiger&Shorts Hanafuda Travel Journal EX (Excellion)
* Tempest Illya's Castle ~Assault! Einzbern~
* Better Fortune Tohsaka Shrine

*Capsule Servant is not included in this release.

70010000093327.name: Kanon
70010000093327.intro:
A tale of small miracles in a snow-covered town—
Key's debut title is coming to Nintendo Switch™, fully voiced!
70010000093327.description:
Kanon is the debut work from the visual novel studio Key, known for titles such as AIR, CLANNAD, Little Busters! and many more. It received great acclaim and was even adapted into an anime series.
Enjoy this tale of small miracles that occur in a northern town, now available on the Nintendo Switch™!

Featuring retouched HD visuals and CG coloring!
This version not only offers the best HD visuals to date, but the game's CG coloring has also been adjusted to better suit the Nintendo Switch console's display colors.　Enjoy the experience with even more beautiful graphics!

Playable in three languages!
The text can be set to English, Simplified Chinese, or Japanese (audio is in Japanese only). This includes in-game text, options, and the digital manual. Language settings can be changed at any time.

Play using only the touch screen! Play with one hand!
Play in handheld mode with the Nintendo Switch Joy-Con™ controllers attached, or detach them and play with just the touch controls! While in tabletop mode or TV mode, everything can be controlled using only the Joy-Con (R), allowing you to play with only one hand!
Also available for the Nintendo Switch Lite. (A separate Joy-Con (R) is required to play with one hand.)

*Some expressions in this title will differ from those in the version of Kanon sold in Japan.

Gameplay
Gameplay in this choice-based visual novel involves reading through the story while making choices at certain key points. Different decisions may lead to different outcomes, story branches and endings.
While the prologue is the same in every playthrough, different choices begin early and lead to emotional endings with five different characters.

Story
It's a winter's day, and snow is fluttering down...
On a bench in front of the train station, I reunite with my cousin, Nayuki Minase, for the first time in seven years. Nayuki and my aunt welcomed me back to this town after I suddenly had to move. It's also home to some hazy childhood memories of mine. In this town, covered in deep snow, five girls and I will come to experience small miracles...

Staff
Scenario: Naoki Hisaya / Jun Maeda
Original Art: Itaru Hinoue
Music: Shinji Orito with Key / OdiakeS

Cast
Now available fully voiced by a stellar cast of voice talent! 
Ayu Tsukimiya    VA: Yui Horie
Nayuki Minase　　VA: Mariko Kouda
Makoto Sawatari　　VA: Mayumi Iizuka
Shiori Misaka　　　VA: Akemi Sato
Mai Kawasumi　　　VA: Yukari Tamura
Sayuri Kurata　VA: Tomoko Kawakami
Kaori Misaka　　VA: Ayako Kawasumi
Akiko Minase　　VA: Yuko Minaguchi
Mishio Amano　　VA: Maaya Sakamoto
Jun Kitagawa　　　VA: Tomokazu Seki
Kuze　　　　VA: Hiroshi Kamiya
Yuichi Aizawa (protagonist) VA: Tomokazu Sugita

*Audio is in Japanese only.
*The protagonist is only voiced in certain scenes.

70010000093329.name: West Escape
70010000093329.intro: Outrun the law, blast aliens, and fight for love in the wildest ride through the Wild West!
70010000093329.description:
West Escape throws you into a chaotic frontier where the law is on your tail and alien invaders are wreaking havoc. As a fugitive desperate to reunite with your lost love, you'll need to collect scrap, upgrade your gear, and face off against relentless extraterrestrial threats.

Fast-paced combat keeps you on your toes—dodge deadly attacks and strike back with revolvers, shotguns, and more. Every battle and upgrade brings you one step closer to freedom and the ultimate showdown in this explosive mix of Wild West grit and sci-fi action.

Features:
- High-Energy Combat: Dodge enemy attacks and blast aliens with powerful weapons like revolvers and shotguns.
- Gear Upgrades: Collect scrap and loot to upgrade weapons and gear, boosting stats like speed and damage.
- Explosive Expeditions: Venture into dangerous areas to uncover new gear, resources, and challenges.
- Wild West Meets Sci-Fi: Experience a unique fusion of classic Western adventure and alien invasion chaos.
- Fast-Paced Progression: Keep moving forward with nonstop action, upgrades, and intense encounters.

Saddle up, lock and load—freedom and love are waiting on the other side of this alien-infested frontier!

70010000093331.name: Fast Food 2025 Simulator
70010000093331.intro: Cook, expand, conquer – the ultimate fast-food challenge!
70010000093331.description:
Fast Food 2025 Simulator – Build, Cook, and Dominate the Industry!
Take charge of your own fast-food empire in Fast Food 2025 Simulator! Start with a small food stand and grow into a massive franchise. Cook, serve, and manage every aspect of your restaurant to satisfy customers and outshine the competition. Adapt to the latest trends, upgrade your kitchen, and become the ultimate fast-food tycoon!

Key Features:
	•	Run Your Own Restaurant – Manage everything from menu creation to customer service and business expansion.
	•	Cook & Serve – Prepare burgers, fries, pizzas, and more while keeping up with customer demands.
	•	Customize & Upgrade – Design your restaurant, improve equipment, and create the perfect dining experience.
	•	Handle Rush Hours & Challenges – Keep up with peak hours, special requests, and unexpected situations.
	•	Use Cutting-Edge Technology – Automate tasks and integrate futuristic innovations to stay ahead.

Can you turn your fast-food joint into a global sensation? Start cooking in Fast Food 2025 Simulator!

70010000093336.name: Shadow of the orient
70010000093336.description:
After 200 years, the dark shadow has returned wreaking havoc across the orient. Only Xiaolang, a brave warrior who possesses the elemental power of fire, has the strength to take on the shadow clan, rescue the children of the orient and restore peace to the people of the east. But, the dark shadow is stronger than ever and Xiaolang has not had to fight for two centuries. Is he up to the task? Are you?

Embark upon a perilous quest full of dangerous enemies, deadly traps and hidden secrets to hunt down the shadow and restore peace to the people of the orient in Shadow of the Orient.

Key Features:

•	3 worlds to explore across 15 maps
•	5 speed run levels
•	Unique enemies per act
•	Secret areas to explore
•	Multiple melee and ranged weapons

70010000093339.name: ONLY UP!
70010000093339.intro: No turning back. How high can you go?
70010000093339.description:
Embark on an exhilarating journey in Only Up!, where the only way is up! Test your precision, patience, and platforming skills as you navigate towering obstacles, floating platforms, and unpredictable pathways to reach the highest heights. Every step is a challenge, every jump is a risk, and one wrong move could send you tumbling back down.
With realistic physics, immersive visuals, and a thrilling sense of vertical exploration, Only Up! offers an intense and rewarding experience for those who dare to climb. How far can you go before gravity catches up with you?
Key Features:
- Climb to the Top – Conquer a massive vertical world filled with unique obstacles.
- Precision & Timing – Every movement matters. Stay focused or fall!
- Dynamic Environments – Experience a surreal world with floating islands, twisting paths, and unpredictable terrain.
- Skill-Based Gameplay – No shortcuts, just pure challenge and mastery.
-No Limits – How high can you reach before making a mistake?
Take a deep breath, take a leap, and begin your climb in Only Up! – a true test of patience and skill!

70010000093344.name: Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle
70010000093344.intro: Two Classics, One Cue – Master Pool & Snooker on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000093344.description:
Cue Up the Fun – Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle!

Get ready to master the table in Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle — the ultimate cue-sports experience on your Nintendo Switch™!

Enjoy both the fast-paced excitement of pool and the strategic precision of snooker, all in one complete and immersive game.

With intuitive controls, smooth physics, and stunning 3D visuals, Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle perfectly recreates the atmosphere of real pool and snooker halls — anytime, anywhere.

Whether you’re practicing perfect shots or enjoying friendly matches with friends, this game guarantees realistic gameplay, smooth controls, and endless entertainment.

Features:

* Two complete cue-sports games in one pack
* Realistic 3D graphics and physics
* Local multiplayer for head-to-head fun
* Multiple tables, cues, and cue balls to unlock and customize
* Smooth, accessible gameplay for beginners and pros alike

Chalk your cue, line up your shot, and rule the table!

The Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle is your all-in-one ticket to cue-sports perfection on Nintendo Switch™.

70010000093349.name: Mamorukun ReCurse!
70010000093349.intro: An arcade classic ReCursed! for modern platforms.
70010000093349.description:
CURSE THOSE BULLETS! 
Use Curse Bullets to dynamically alter the difficulty as you play. Wipe out smaller enemies and clear projectiles from the screen, or power up larger enemies, making them harder to defeat... The greater the risk the higher you’ll score, and you can even curse yourself to increase your damage to overcome more challenging enemies.  

SCROLL YOUR WAY 
In this vertical-scrolling shoot ‘em up, you control the scroll. If you don’t move forward, your character won’t advance through the stage. But be warned; the game is timed, so standing still all day isn’t an option! 

AN ARCADE CLASSIC 
Mamorukun Curse! originally debuted in Japanese arcades in mid-2008. Drawing inspiration from traditional Japanese mythology and blending it into a colorful, charming, and family-friendly world. 

COMPLETE AND ENHANCED 
The game now supports widescreen format and modern twin-stick controls. On top of that, it’s absolutely packed with content! Story Mode, Arcade Mode, Challenge Courses, previously released DLC characters, alternate costumes, Gallery Mode... There’s almost as much to discover as there are bullets...

70010000093353.name: Gnomes and Knights
70010000093353.intro: Gnome hunting reaches a new level!
70010000093353.description:
Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a gloomy medieval dark fantasy and try to find all the gnomes.
Meet various characters on your way and try to figure out what happened to this damned world that you yourself (in fact, we) created.

Game Features
- Fancy low-poly style that keeps things cool — literally
- The opportunity to explore the forest well in search of gnomes and feel like a real knight
- A specific goal of the game that you choose yourself
- Procedurally generated world and high replayability
- Five levels, five gnomes, nine story characters
- Six endings depending on your decision
- Unexpected plot twists
- A REAL opportunity to FINALLY find the gnomes
- A feeling of personal involvement in an iconic world event
- Low price matches the level of content's quality

70010000093357.name: Dead Reset
70010000093357.intro: Dead Reset is a blood-soaked interactive horror, where each death brings you closer to the truth.
70010000093357.description:
Trapped in a terrifying death-loop, surgeon Cole Mason is kidnapped and brought to an underwater facility, forced to operate on a patient to extract an evolving parasitic horror. Dead Reset is a blood-soaked interactive horror, where each death brings you closer to the truth.

Death is Inevitable 

Master the death-loop to uncover the path to escape. Death is not the end but offers a terrifying new perspective. 

Embrace the Horror 

Immerse yourself in a blood-soaked, interactive narrative with cinematic scares, bloody practical effects and high-stakes choice-driven gameplay that put you at the heart of a relentless sci-fi horror movie.

Choices Matter 

Steer Cole on a path of Redemption or Damnation in your fight to survive. There are no easy choices as your morality is tested at every turn and your decisions will result in four wildly different endings.

Pause the Terror 

Playing to an audience? Enable Streamer Mode, which removes time constraints on choices, letting your viewers guide Cole’s fate and delight in his gruesome deaths.

Who Do You Trust? 

Build trust or fracture alliances; each bond forged or broken influences your road to survival. View the in-game tracker to check your relationship with other characters, if they are still alive.

70010000093359.name: Witchroid Vania: A Magical Girl’s Fantastical Adventures
70010000093359.intro: Join mage-in-training Lily on an epic adventure! Explore a multitude of worlds, including forests, deserts, and dungeons, in hopes of becoming a full-fledged mage!
70010000093359.description:
An exploration-type action game depicting one young girl's journey to become a mage!

Freely explore huge open worlds!
Outside heroine Lily's hometown, you'll find all sorts of expansive lands. Make the leap to venture through East Village, Oak Forest, Hidden Cave, Dragon Ridge, Zalam Kingdom, and more. The order in which you proceed is up to you! Travel the world in search of new discoveries!

Battle ferocious foes!
Beware of mighty monsters and vile villains. Orc lords, assassins, sirens, and wicked dragons await you in battle. Gain experience through combat, defeating strong enemies to help Lily grow as a mage.

Power-up with magic and gear!
Use the magic and gear you acquire on your adventures to strengthen Lily!
・Master magic for each of the four elements—fire, ice, wind, and lightning—each with their own strengths and weaknesses. 
・Make full use of support magic to breathe underwater, guard against missiles, and sacrifice HP to recover MP.
・Collect gear to enhance Lily's magical powers, defense powers, and more.

Joined by a loyal companion and mini-dragon!
Magical training can be a difficult journey, but Lily has a powerful companion to help her along the way: a mini-dragon who will lend you support during travel and battle. Plus, learn a range of skills by obtaining training books.

Jump into a world of magic and adventure with Witchroid Vania!

70010000093364.name: Zooparasite
70010000093364.intro: Discover the grim secret of the sewers in this survival horror game
70010000093364.description:
As an heroic agent, you’ve been assigned to investigate the toxic sewers below the city, and to cleanse the environment of strange, dangerous chemicals.

Armed with only your wits and a flashlight, outmaneuver and outsmart grotesque mutated creatures lurking around every turn. As you progress deeper into the darkness, uncover the chilling truth behind the chemical spill and the horrifying experiments conducted in the shadows.

Beware, for the more you learn, the more sinister the truth becomes.


Features:
* Terrifying 3D atmosphere
* Exploration, survival, and strategy
* Dark and mysterious narrative
* Immersive sound design

70010000093370.name: Monstrous Lovers
70010000093370.intro: Romance hunky monsters in a classic American city
70010000093370.description:
Play as a young Christopher Wells whose job is ensuring the peaceful coexistence of monsters and humans.

Tired of feeling stuck in an unimportant bureaucratic position, he requests a transferal to Saint George, the city with the highest population of monsters in the country. Unfortunately, not everyone around is happy about having to work with a human. 

Explore themes like identity, belonging, and the lengths people are willing to go to reach their goals.


Features
* Boys’ Love visual novel
* Over 160,000 words
* 4 love interests and 8 endings
* Partial voice acting

70010000093373.name: United Assault - Final Stand
70010000093373.intro: United Assault - Final Stand is an open-world rogue-lite FPS set in 1945 Germany. Infiltrate the Führer's mountain residence, explore secret-filled bunkers, and engage in intense combat.
70010000093373.description:
United Assault - Final Stand is an open-world rogue-lite FPS set in the final days of World War II, deep in the Obersalzberg region of Germany, 1945. As the war nears its end, you are part of a daring mission to infiltrate this heavily fortified mountain stronghold, which includes the mountain residence of the Führer himself.

Explore a meticulously recreated landscape based on actual satellite data, scaled and adapted for enhanced gameplay. Navigate through authentic reconstructions of significant locations, including the Berghof—the Führer's mountain residence—along with the Kehlsteinhaus (Eagle's Nest) and an extensive network of bunker complexes. Each location is filled with hidden secrets, requiring tactical navigation and vertical exploration to uncover every detail.

Features:
- Open-world gameplay in a faithfully recreated 1945 Obersalzberg region.
- Vertical exploration with a focus on strategic elevation and tactical advantage.
- Authentic recreations of key historical sites, including the Berghof (the Führer's mountain residence), Kehlsteinhaus, and various bunker complexes.
- Rogue-lite elements with procedurally generated challenges and objectives for endless replayability.
- A vast array of secret locations and hidden areas to discover, adding depth and intrigue to every mission.
- Immersive World War II combat experience with existing weaponry and realistic enemy AI.
