Take part in a daring operation to infiltrate and dismantle the final remnants of enemy power in the Führer's mountain stronghold. Your choices and strategy will determine the outcome of this critical mission in the concluding chapter of the United Assault series.

70010000093375.name: Tenshokyo : Japan Drift
70010000093375.intro: Drift. Customize. Dominate. Become the Ultimate Drift Master.
70010000093375.description:
The ultimate drifting experience awaits in Tenshokyo : Japan Drift. Take control of legendary cars and master the streets with precision and style. Choose from 21 high-performance cars from Japan, Europe, and the USA, and customize every detail to fit your driving style. Upgrade turbo, traction, brake power, engine performance, steering angle, and max speed to dominate the competition.

Challenge Yourself in 40+ Thrilling Missions
Compete in a variety of drift challenges, earning experience points as you rack up massive drift scores. Keep your drift going without crashing or stopping to prove your skills and climb the ranks.

Real Drifting Physics & Intense Action
Feel the power of precise car control with realistic drifting mechanics. Whether on city streets or technical courses, every drift brings the thrill of pushing your limits. Become the ultimate drift master and claim your spot as a legend.

This game was previously released under other the name, but it is now available as "Tenshokyo: Japan Drift".
If you have already purchased "Japanese Drift Master", please note that this is the same game. Be careful not to buy it again by mistake.

70010000093380.name: Apple Knight 2
70010000093380.intro: Embark on an epic adventure in Apple Knight 2! An action-packed platformer across a sprawling kingdom with multiple worlds.
70010000093380.description:
Dive into intense hack-and-slash action as you battle through hordes of enemies in this exciting platformer! Explore worlds filled with dungeons, get powerful loot, and unlock a vast arsenal of weapons and skins.

Game Features:
● Extensive Arsenal & Customization
Choose from a wide variety of weapons, skins, abilities, and pets!
● Dynamic Dodging & Dashing
Master swift dashes to evade enemy melee and ranged attacks.
● Hidden Secrets
Discover multiple secret areas in every level, packed with treasures.
● Expert Combat Mechanics
Parry melee attacks with precision and deflect projectiles using your trusty sword!
● Special Abilities
Your sword is more than a weapon—unleash unique special abilities to take down enemies.
● Engaging Enemy AI
Enemies are smart enough to react to your movements but reckless enough to fall into your traps!

70010000093392.name: Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade
70010000093392.intro: In this chaotic era, a journey to exterminate demons begins.
70010000093392.description:
Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade is a Japanese-style roguelite RPG set in the Edo period. The game main features are a traditional fantasy world, and an exhilarating combo-based combat!

Long ago, a delicate balance was maintained between humans and demons. Although there were occasional small conflicts, they still coexisted in peace. However, one day, the ruler of the demons, the Nine-Tailed Fox, descended, leading an army of malevolent spirits to invade the human world. In this chaotic era, a journey to exterminate these demons begins. Restore peace through the endless cycle of reincarnation, and uncover the truth hidden behind the events that unfold!

70010000093394.name: Dagger Froggy
70010000093394.intro: Keep your heroic amphibian alive as you upgrade weapons and spells to fend off waves of fantastical foes!
70010000093394.description:
The hero is a frog? That’s right, in top-down survival action game Dagger Froggy, you’ll take the role of a plucky pixel art amphibian as you fend off waves of creatures looking to make you their prey. From grassy lawn and spooky cemetery to the desert and more, you’ll have to clear baddies from a variety of stages while collecting coins from those you slay to purchase permanent upgrades for your frog.

Strategically choose from a variety of buffs and spend coins to unlock up to 15 frogs with unique gear and armaments. Increase movement speed, max out weapon power and take advantage of other enhancements. As you earn permanent upgrades, additional challenging stages become available. Can you survival them all?

• Fend off waves of enemies in top-down pixel art arenas!
• Shop for permanent upgrades in between stages.
• Choose from a variety of instant buffs to improve your chances of survival!
• Replay cleared levels at any time to improve your skills.
• Unlock new playable characters and themed stages!

70010000093409.name: Reel it! Fishing
70010000093409.intro:
Swing your rod, reel in your catch, and fish up a big one!
Enjoy a refreshing fishing trip surrounded by nature!
70010000093409.description:
Let's go fishing on the Nintendo Switch™!
Cast your rod at different locations, each with its own unique scenery and fish to catch!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

[Score Attack]
Catch lots of fish and earn points!
Aim for the biggest fish to earn the biggest rewards!
Keep an eye out for rare creatures—there's more than just fish in this river!

[Ranking]
Compete with players from around the world for the highest score!
Show off your skills by increasing your high score and rank!

[Battle]
Face off against CPUs in single-player mode, or test your skills against friends in multiplayer battles!

[Records]
Each fish that you catch in Score Attack or Battle Mode will be recorded in your encyclopedia!
Work hard to reel in every fish and fill out every page!

70010000093414.name: Bearnard
70010000093414.intro: Retro puzzle platformer with modern turn-based combat and card battles.
70010000093414.description:
Step into the furry paws of Bearnard, a master archer and reluctant hero. He embarks on an epic adventure to begrudgingly reclaim a legendary bow and defend his woodland home. In this single-player, story-driven journey, you'll explore diverse landscapes, battle countless enemies, solve physics-based puzzles, and meet a cast of quirky characters. Collect and unleash powerful cards in turn-based battles, carefully strategizing each move to outwit and overcome your foes.

In-Depth Card Play and Strategy
Discover and wield over 60+ powerful cards, transforming every battle into a dynamic, ever-evolving puzzle. Whether it’s arrow-charging power-ups, life-saving healing, armor-stealing attacks, defensive traps, or crowd control, there's a card for every situation. Combine elemental cards to create devastating combos.

Become a Master Archer to Dish Out Your Cards
In battles, you don’t just play cards, you need to hit your foes with that perfect bullseye arrow too. Luckily Bearnard is a master of the bow and arrow. Carefully aim each shot, use physics to your advantage, and master intricate adjustments to land the right shots.

An 8-Bit Era-Inspired Platforming Adventure
Visually inspired by classic 8-bit platformers that started a gaming revolution, Bearnard takes you through lush forests, abandoned mines, snowy mountains, towering castles, and dark dungeons.. Each biome is filled with its own challenges and lurking evil.

Discover Secrets and Harness Physics to Defeat Your Foes
Bearnard’s world is filled with hidden secrets and puzzles that require both skill and thinking. Shoot arrows at levers to open hidden passages, trigger platforms to launch yourself to new heights, or use the environment to your advantage—drop chandeliers on enemies, throw crates for crushing blows, and manipulate physics to gain the upper hand in battle.

70010000093419.name: Super World War
70010000093419.intro: The world has gone mad, it's time to unleash chaos! Super World War is a turn based strategy game for up to 4 players.
70010000093419.description:
The President of the World, Theorn BrunceWald, is dead, leaving the seat he held for years up for grabs. Now’s the perfect time for the other world leaders to make their move for global domination—and so begins the Super World War!


CRUSH YOUR ENEMIES

Collect hexacoins to raise your army and win the war! Build a force that bends the terrain to your advantage and destroy your enemies in a glorious, over-the-top bloodbath!


A MADCAP STORY

Play as each of the 6 leaders in Story Mode, featuring 40 explosive missions. Command your armie and set out to conquer the world; whether it’s to make your father proud, bring peace and stability, embrace total madness, or just because you’re bored out of your mind.


SUPERPOWERFUL SUPER WEAPONS

When your units just aren’t enough, call in your Leader! Each one comes with a unique Super Weapon capable of completely turning the tide of battle.


NO CALM BEFORE THE STORM

The weather changes throughout the battle and only the smartest strategists know how to turn it to their advantage. Hide your troops in the fog, march across frozen rivers, and catch your enemies completely off guard!


MULTIPLAYER

Challenge your friends in local or online multiplayer battles for up to 4 players across 80+ maps! Free-for-all or team up, pick your leader and prove once and for all that you should be the next President of the World!

70010000093421.name: Twilight Monk
70010000093421.intro: "Twilight Monk" combines martial arts action and exploration into an exciting 2.5D action RPG experience.
70010000093421.description:
Embark on a journey through a vast land, discovering complex dungeons full of enemies to fight and skills to acquire.
Even those inexperienced with action games can enjoy the exhilerating battles and deep exploration!

- Story -
The continent of Speria has fallen into darkness,
As monsters ravage the land and invade villages, Raziel Tenza, the final Monk of Twilight, sets out on a journey to save the world.
However, in a world fallen into darkness our hero will encounter his fair share of challenges, including powerful enemies and fearsome "Darksprites".

- Game Features -
◆Free exploration x elaborate dungeons
Classic, metroidvania-style exploration that expands as you obtain new skills! Clear dungeons full of obstacles and discover treasures and secret passages.

◆Become the wielder of the Phantom Pillar
This mysterious artifact infused with ancient power can be used for platforming, battle, blocking enemy attacks, or even to activate mechanisms.

◆Overhead world maps and towns that expand the world
Explore a vast world map that connects the various dungeons!
Towns are filled with shopping, mini-games, status enhancements, and other elements to support your adventures.
Experience the nostalgia of JRPG's from back in the day!

◆A world crafted by hand
The unique visuals of Twilight Monk combine the delicate touch of ink paintings with a fusion of Eastern and Western stylistic influence. 
Immerse yourself in the beautifully hand illustrated world as you explore!

70010000093425.name: Gem Jam
70010000093425.intro: A fun gem collecting puzzle game
70010000093425.description:
Dive into the colorful and challenging world of Gem Jam. A strategy and match-3 puzzle game.

In this vibrant puzzle adventure, you’re tasked with clearing a grid of gems stacked in three columns. Your job? Guide a team of colorful characters to collect the gems they match in color.  Clearing three matching gems across the columns causes them to vanish, making way for the ones above. Plan wisely—clear all the gems to pass the stage!

Strategically choose the right characters to clear the gems and create cascading matches.

The game gets trickier with exciting new features. Rocks block your path and can only be broken by axe-holding characters. Move interconnected characters together for an added layer of strategy. Clear spaces in front of tubes to release extra characters and unlock new possibilities.

Enjoy countless levels with increasing difficulty and surprises to keep you hooked.

Whether you're a puzzle pro or new to the genre, Gem Jam promises hours of colorful, brain-teasing entertainment and will put your strategy skills to the test!

70010000093427.name: Ninja Ming
70010000093427.intro: Ninja precision platformer with a teleportation twist!
70010000093427.description:
Play as Ninja Ming and embark on the Path of Trials. Dash through 241 levels using dynamic teleportation and diverse ninjutsu skills. Conquer challenges with style—growing stronger at every turn.

Ninja Ming relies heavily on the move of teleportation. Once mastered, you’ll be commanding the air and dashing through the challenging areas.

As you progress through levels, you'll unlock even more dazzling abilities: use "ExFlash" for long-range teleportation, destroy (or build) terrain with "Fireball" and "Rock," and find creative solutions with "Replacement Dash".

While dashing forward, don’t forget to explore—each room contains collectible "scrolls"! Find different ways to unlock them!

The game does not have any form of stats growth. It'll only be you and your controls. Keep growing, and you shall master precision, speed, and style!

Game Features:
• Assist Mode: You can adjust the game speed to a minimum of 0.3x.
• Anecdotes: Keep track of your encounters and acquired ninjutsu.
• Speedrun Mode: Unlocks after completing any area. You will be timed in this mode. Welcome speedrunners! 
• Smooth Controls: Precise control over movement and skills.
• Instant Respawn: Quickly respawn and resume the challenge after failure.
• Eight Areas: Forming the ultimate trial for aspiring ninjas.
• Dynamic Electronic Music (by 4 Channels Club): Keeps your cool.
• Scroll Portal: Complete the first 4 chapters to unlock, and enter the next 4 chapters of Inner World
• Hidden Achievements, and plenty of Easter Eggs!

Ming's Story:
Three years ago, with the appearance of a time-space rift, natural disasters struck the ninja world. Ninja Mirror and the Four Ninjas sealed the rift together but were never seen again since. Three years later, a ninja named "Ming" inherits the will of the ninjas and embarks on his trial journey, searching for Mirror, and undergoing his own transformation.

70010000093432.name: Tempopo
70010000093432.intro:
Puzzle Through the Seasons
Conduct the Tempopo
Keep on Beat
70010000093432.description:
When Hana’s garden of musical flowers are scattered across a sky full of beautiful islands, she must turn to the magical Tempopo for help returning them. Chaotic and uncoordinated by nature, the Tempopo rely on Hana’s conducting skills to keep on the right track, and solve each island's puzzle.

PUZZLE THROUGH THE SEASONS 
Each island is a challenge of planning and execution. Experiment with different configurations and routes, instruct every Tempopo to play their part as they smash, block, lift and push each other through the puzzles that span all four seasons.

LET THE MUSIC PLAY 
A bright and joyful world that’s permeated with music, where every living element moves in harmony with a rhythmic heartbeat. With a soundtrack by BAFTA award-winning composer & audio director Jeff van Dyck, every note is a joy. 

SPACE TO GROW
With each puzzle you solve, the flowers you rescue become a part of your very own melodic garden. Each type of flower sings its own tune, and you can synthesize their melodies to enjoy unique musical performances.

70010000093437.name: Pirate Trails
70010000093437.intro: Arrr, hoist the sails and chart the course, for the gold won’t bury itself!
70010000093437.description:
Arrr, mateys! Ready to set sail on an adventure full of challenges and treasures?
In Pirate Trails, you are the master cartographer of the seven seas! But instead of sailing, your mission is to chart the best course for pirate ships to collect treasures and safely anchor at the final port. Rotate and swap hexagonal tiles to create the perfect route – but beware, a wrong path might lead your ship straight to the Kraken!

What awaits you on this pirate journey?
30 challenging levels across three legendary pirate islands:

Port Royal (Levels 1-10) – The starting point for every great pirate!
Tortuga (Levels 11-20) – Where challenges become more treacherous!
Nassau (Levels 21-30) – Only the most cunning captains will reach here!
Mechanics that will make you shout “ARRR!”
Rotate and swap hexagons to connect the perfect path!
Collect all treasures before docking – a pirate who doesn’t seek gold isn’t a true pirate!
New challenges and mechanics as you advance through the biomes!

Ready to prove you’re a true sea wolf? Then board Pirate Trails now and show that your brain is sharper than a cutlass!

70010000093442.name: Island Rescue
70010000093442.intro: Rescue the stranded in this addictive puzzler
70010000093442.description:
Set sail for a puzzling adventure in Island Rescue a vibrant and strategic puzzle game.

Stranded on a mysterious island, colorful characters need your help to reach their matching boats. Your mission? Clear the path and guide the right people to their boats in the correct order. Each boat requires three people of the same color to board before it can set sail. Think ahead and plan your moves carefully—only the most resourceful players will succeed in rescuing everyone!

Strategically maneuver characters across the island to match them with their boats.

Progress through increasingly complex puzzles as the game introduces exciting obstacles such as:

Stone Blockers: Clear obstacles using characters equipped with pickaxes.

Storm Clouds: Navigate around these tricky hazards that block your path.

Bridge Buttons: Activate hidden bridges to open new routes and solve the puzzle.

Expanding Challenges: Levels get bigger and more intricate, testing your logic and planning skills.

With its colorful characters, clever mechanics, and endless fun, Island Rescue is perfect for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages. Can you guide every castaway to safety and master the island's challenges?

70010000093444.name: Hannah's Day
70010000093444.intro: Hannah's Day is a puzzle adventure about Hannah, who aspires to put together her own band. Put all doubts aside, grab your skateboard and go chase your dreams!
70010000093444.description:
Hannah loves three things more than anything - singing, friends and her skateboard. But her parents are not supportive of Hannah's decision to tie her life to music.
None of this matters. Music and imagination will get Hannah through the challenges!
Overcome the obstacles, reunite with Hannah's friends, and set the stage on fire! And beware, fears and doubts can poison even the brightest dreams..…

Game features:
- Skateboarding even on the ceiling!
- Tilt the whole world and drag parts of the locations
- Solve 3D puzzles: use your brain to solve spatial puzzles
- Explore colorful levels in search of all the easter eggs
- Help the citizen of an extraordinary world, reunite with friends, and find out how Hannah's story ends

70010000093449.name: Mai: Child of Ages
70010000093449.description:
Follow Mai on her journey through a shattered world as she searches for her identity and the origin of the mysterious creatures that threaten the balance of the universe.

Travel with her through past and future thanks to the Sacred Plant that bridges time and space.

Game Features:

· Explore ancient dungeons, mastering the arcane power of the Uroboro Stone.
· Rewrite History – Bend space-time to your will and reshape the future using Mai’s unique powers.
· Play as Mai through the different stages of her life, from childhood to adolescence.
· Engage in dynamic and technical battles—dodge, defend, and strike with both melee and ranged attacks!
· Over 20 hours of gameplay, featuring ancient caves to investigate and abandoned factories to explore.
· Coop Mode - Play with your friends in the main adventure and get help from the primordial spirit. The second player will be able to take control of enemies to assist you in battles and much more!

Through countless journeys across time, you will reshape the fate of the primordial universe.

70010000093451.name: Vasilisa and Baba Yaga
70010000093451.intro: An adventure game based on the slavic folktale "Vasilisa the Beautiful". A scary story about the journey to the mistress of the forbidden forest for magical powers.
70010000093451.description:
A spooky adventure where Vasilisa's journey and service to Baba Yaga consist of a series of mini-games with a variety of gameplay mechanics.
You will go on a journey with Vasilisa to the land of the dead to obtain the power of fire, which only Baba Yaga can give. Vasilisa already has a magical helper — a doll given by her mother. But this is not enough to deal with the evil stepmother. It is necessary to pass the tests of the mistress of the forbidden forest and prove to her that Vasilisa is worthy to receive the power not only from her mother, but the mother of all mothers — Baba Yaga.

70010000093456.name: Hentai Waifu 5
70010000093456.intro: A puzzle with charming girls drawn in anime style!
70010000093456.description:
Get ready to meet charming girls posing in seductive and stylish outfits that emphasize their unique appeal! Every detail in the game is carefully designed so that you can feel the realism of assembling a real puzzle. With each new level, you will see more and more candid and intriguing images. Relax and enjoy every step on the way to completing the masterpiece!

Features:
• Delightful girls in daring and sophisticated outfits
• Fascinating and simple gameplay that captivates you from the first minutes
• The ability to study each image in detail after assembly
• Different puzzle difficulty
• Atmospheric music

70010000093460.name: Real Hentai 5
70010000093460.intro: Charming girls in Real Hentai are waiting for your touch.
70010000093460.description:
Immerse yourself in a world of high-quality images, where charming girls are waiting for you, demonstrating their seductive forms in the most intriguing poses! The game is created with an emphasis on visual details, conveying the feeling of assembling a real puzzle. As the difficulty increases, the images become more and more piquant. Relax and enjoy every moment of assembling the puzzle.

Features:
• Beautiful girls in provocative outfits
• The ability to examine each image in detail after assembly
• Simple but exciting mechanics that are hard to tear yourself away from
• Gradually increasing puzzle difficulty
• Gentle, relaxing music for complete immersion

70010000093464.name: Distant Woods
70010000093464.description:
Step into the enchanting world of Distant Woods, a relaxing walking simulator where exploration meets tranquility. Wander through magical forests, uncover hidden wonders, and lose yourself in the calming beauty of nature. With no rush or pressure, it’s a perfect way to unwind and explore at your own pace.

Features:
Two Unique Levels: Discover different enchanting environments, each with distinct locations to explore.
Relaxing Gameplay: No stress—just pure exploration.
Beautiful Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in the peaceful sounds and sights of the forest.

70010000093466.name: Scott Pilgrim EX
70010000093466.intro: Join Scott Pilgrim and Ramona Flowers in a brand-new brawling adventure across space, time, and the streets of Toronto!
70010000093466.description:
Toronto, 20XX. The city has been taken over by 3 rival gangs - the VEGANS, the ROBOTS, and the DEMONS. But who’s behind this madness? When Scott Pilgrim’s bandmates are abducted by shadowy forces, a brand-new adventure begins! 

Scott Pilgrim EX is an action-adventure game where players can fight as Scott Pilgrim, Ramona Flowers and more as they battle through the fractured time and space of Toronto. The combat gameplay is driven by instinct and improvisation - a hectic ballet of fists and flair that rewards strategy, spontaneity, and a good bit of brawling chaos. String together stylish combos, experiment with wacky weapons and unleash over-the-top special attacks. Characters can be upgraded with special badges that enhance their stats and grant special bonuses. Players will explore a whole city of interconnected levels to meet old and new faces, complete quests, and discover hidden areas. Multiplayer co-op, local or online, lets up to four players join in on the action, making it a fun, dynamic experience. 

- 7 Playable Characters
Step into the shoes of seven fan-favorite fighters, each with their own distinct combat style.

- A Brand-New Adventure 
Venture out on epic quests and battle new enemies and bosses across interconnected levels in a new story by series creator Bryan Lee O’Malley that will appeal to longtime fans and newcomers alike.

- Madcap Melee Mayhem
Master creative combos, wield wacky weapons, use your surroundings to your advantage and conquer the chaos!

- Power Up!
Spend your hard-earned coins to customize your fighter! Equip special items and upgrade your stats to create a unique build for every playthrough!

- New Anamanaguchi Music
Known for their explosive blend of 8-bit energy and hyper-melodic rock, the band returns to their roots with all new music crafted for this Toronto-hopping adventure.

- 4-Player Co-Op Mayhem
Join forces with up to three friends, locally or online, with easy drop-in/drop-out co-op. Battle solo or hit the streets together.

70010000093477.name: Steampunch
70010000093477.intro: A STEAM-POWERED ADVENTURE FULL OF ADRENALINE!
70010000093477.description:
Get ready for the electrifying journey of Steampunch, a casual and challenging 2D platformer! Overcome enemies, traps, and obstacles to reach the elevator that takes you to the next level.

FLUID MOVEMENT!
Run, jump, and wall-slide with precision. Use double jumps and air dashes to reach secret areas and overcome challenges!

SIMPLE AND INTENSE COMBAT!
Face various enemies, from patrol robots to lethal shooters. A powerful punch defeats any foe in a single hit!

DYNAMIC CHALLENGES!
With 30 progressive levels, the game features moving platforms, spikes, and mechanical traps that require adaptation and skill.

THREE UNIQUE ENVIRONMENTS!
Faroeste City (Levels 1-10) - A desert Wild West, home to the dreaded Gun-Bot, a relentless robot gunslinger!
Underwater City (Levels 11-20) - A submerged metropolis full of gravity-defying challenges and deep-sea enemies.
Factory (Levels 21-30) - The enemies’ factory, filled with gears and smoke, with lethal robots lurking!

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

70010000093482.name: Legends Aligned
70010000093482.description:
Legends Aligned is a puzzle game where strategy and organization meet in the enchanting world of RPG miniatures! Your challenge? Arrange each piece precisely within a dynamic grid, ensuring no space is wasted.

With relaxing and intuitive mechanics, the game starts simple but evolves into increasingly complex challenges, requiring strategic planning and sharp spatial awareness. Rotate, position, and fit miniatures of different classes and shapes into grids that grow in size as your journey progresses.

40 progressive levels test your skills, from small introductory boards to complex layouts that demand complete mastery of the mechanics.
Cozy pixel art and a medieval-fantasy theme create an immersive environment for RPG and puzzle fans.
Immersive soundtrack and satisfying sound effects make every placement even more enjoyable.
Intuitive mechanics with rotation and positioning of pieces to fit each miniature perfectly.

Are you ready to organize the chaos and become the master of the board? Legends Aligned challenges your logic and creativity in a world where every piece has its perfect place!

70010000093488.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Sogeumgang
70010000093488.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000093488.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Sogeumgang, Korea with ""Real"" footage! 
This work takes place in Sogeumgang. 
There are a total of 7 flight courses. 
1080P high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to 7 locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Sogeumgang, Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000093494.name: Jack Barau
70010000093494.intro: A parade of endangered baby petrels, a soft-hearted pirate… Help JACK BARAU save them before it’s too late!
70010000093494.description:
Help JACK BARAU, the pirate petrel, save his species!
Wander across the island in search of lost fledglings. Each night, artificial lights disorient the Barau’s petrels, leaving the young birds at the mercy of lurking rats and stray cats. Gather a fragile but hopeful parade, and lead them to the ocean—where they can finally take flight toward freedom.

JACK BARAU is a poetic, quirky and heartfelt 2D puzzle-platformer. Inspired by a poignant ecological reality, it puts you in the feathers of an old pirate with a tender heart, the last hope for a critically endangered species.

- Guide Jack with precision through diverse environments.
- Find and protect the fledglings in a growing line of life.
- Avoid deadly predators and nighttime hazards.
- Trigger traps and activate switches to overcome obstacles.
- Explore a stylized world full of humor, emotion, and environmental awareness.

Designed to resonate with players of all ages!

JACK BARAU is a touching adventure — a loving tribute to the real-life Barau’s petrel, a rare seabird native to the highlands of Réunion Island, and to all those working to save it.

70010000093496.name: One Step After Fall
70010000093496.intro: Immerse yourself in the thoughts of Steve Robinson, learn his story and face your fate in this narrative experience.
70010000093496.description:
One Step After Fall is a single-player, first-person walking simulator that focuses on the narrative experience that introduces Steve Robinson, a successful writer who, due to life's misfortunes, ended up losing important people, faith in his work and the meaning of life. 

The narrative leads the player to help Steve relive the episodes in his story that dragged him into depression, while getting to know the places that marked his life. 

From that moment, where Steve may or may not revisit his story, he becomes able to face his destiny and be able to make the most important decision of his life.

The game has:
- Two endings.
- Narrative and non-narrative collectibles.
- Inventory in which it will give you instructions to proceed in the story and consult the collectibles and acquired letters.
- A clean interface so the focus is on the narrative experience.

70010000093513.name: Beat 'Em Up Collection (QUByte Classics)
70010000093513.intro: A collection of seven retro beat 'em ups with enhanced features like rewind, cheats, screen filters, and more!
70010000093513.description: Beat 'Em Up Collection (QUByte Classics) brings together seven retro side-scrolling brawlers in one action-packed bundle: First Samurai, Second Samurai, Gourmet Warriors, Iron Commando, Legend, Sword of Sodan, and The Tale of Clouds and Winds. Fight through time and fantasy worlds in pure 16-bit style, now enhanced with modern features like rewind, cheats, screen filters, digital manuals, and full localization. A must-play for fans of classic beat ‘em ups!

70010000093515.name: Toaplan Arcade Collection Vol.1
70010000093515.intro: Eight legendary shmups, one explosive bundle. The Toaplan Shooting Collection Vol. 1 truly puts the blast in "blast from the past"!
70010000093515.description:
The name Toaplan is legendary. This game company is behind some of the best and most iconic shoot 'em ups in gaming history. These games were not only hugely influential, inspiring countless other developers throughout the ‘80s and ‘90s. They’re still just as great today! 
 
With The Toaplan Shooting Collection Vol. 1, you get eight of these milestones. Enjoy them as the historical classics they are, or simply as fantastic action games packed with pixel explosions and crisp 2D graphics. It's quadruple the action, a billion times the fun, and a thrill ride back in time to the neon-lit arcades of the past! 

With modern enhancements, leaderboards, screen filters, and quality-of-life extras, no threat stands between you and absolute victory. Got what it takes? Prove it on the battlefield! 
 
This collection includes: 
 
Flying Shark 
Fire Shark 
Tiger Heli 
Twin Cobra / Kyukoku Tiger 
Out Zone 
Fix Eight 
Batsugun 
Dogyuun 

There’s also a Volume 2 of this collection for those who want another eight hardcore shoot 'em ups to sink their teeth into. Now, let's blast some enemies!

70010000093516.name: Shroomtopia
70010000093516.description:
Be charmed by the cute and colorful world of Shroomtopia! Relax in this wholesome slow-paced puzzle game while exploring serene landscapes and solving diverse challenges. Manipulate the hexagonal soil and blend the colors. Only you can bring nature back to life!

Unleash your creativity with a built-in level editor Become a level designer with this intuitive but powerful tool.

And more:

• Discover 5 diverse and colorful biomes
A real 2D eye candy full of cute mushroom characters and animated weather effects.

• 75 levels packed with puzzles gradually increasing in challenge
Train your brain through logical problems - can you beat all of them?

• Relax to the soothing soundtrack made by the indie music producer Felipe Peticov Breathe in, breathe out.
What a better way to unwind than these beautiful instrumental sounds?

70010000093530.name: Sunshower
70010000093530.intro: -> hello? who are you? i'm hinata.
70010000093530.description:
Sunshower is a colorful, casual arcade action game that follows a robot's survival in a rain storm! Use the plant installed on your head to reach for the sky as you achieve high scores and stop the rain from washing away the world. Enjoy a transforming, traditionally illustrated watercolor background and fun new music that appear as you gain more points. And, as you play more, find out what the robot you're controlling, Hinata, thinks of your time playing together.

Collect, combine, and chain power-ups to stop the rainfall! Gain more strength to carry more drops, increase your speed, or use an umbrella to deflect one drop. Every playthrough is unique!

Unlock an alternate, more challenging single player mode! You can also find 8 different customization options for Hinata! Try local co-op to reach for your highest score with a friend or compete to see who comes out on top!

70010000093540.name: MOUNT QUEST: Take the Upper Hand Among Classmates
70010000093540.intro:
A comedy-style live-action movie.
Choose the options displayed in the movie to aim for the correct route!
70010000093540.description:
A comedy-style live-action movie.
Choose the options displayed in the movie to aim for the correct route!

70010000093549.name: Harvest Moon®: Home Sweet Home Special Edition
70010000093549.description:
Harvest Moon: Home Sweet Home Special Edition invites you to leave behind the hustle and bustle of city life for the charm and simplicity of Alba Village — your childhood hometown. Nestled among lush greenery and sparkling rivers, Alba is known for its fresh-caught fish, delicious homegrown veggies, and warm-hearted community.

But Alba has seen better days. With a dwindling population and an aging community, the village is in need of a fresh start. It’s up to you to breathe new life into Alba and transform it into a thriving, welcoming place once again. Reconnect with old friends, meet new faces, and help turn this quiet village into a lively haven for tourists and future residents alike!

Are you up for the challenge?

Build Meaningful Relationships - Meet a cast of lovable bachelors and bachelorettes—including two fan favorites, Ella and Nikolai from Harvest Moon: The Winds of Anthos! Fall in love and marry whoever your heart desires. Deepen friendships through daily interactions, thoughtful gifts, and story-driven heart events that reveal more about each character’s life and dreams.

Farm, Fish, and Forge a New Life - Grow a variety of seasonal crops, care for adorable animals like cows, chickens, and sheep, and unlock upgrades to expand your farm. Go fishing in serene rivers, explore hidden caves to mine rare ores, and complete requests from villagers to earn rewards and improve your reputation.

Grow Alba with Happiness - Gather and spread Happiness, a unique resource that reflects your positive impact on the village. The more Happiness you collect, the more Alba transforms—unlocking new buildings, businesses, special events, and even encouraging old residents to return or new ones to move in.

Celebrate Community - Participate in exciting seasonal festivals, fun contests, and local traditions that showcase Alba’s unique culture. Horse racing, fishing tournaments, flower festivals, and more await—each offering mini-games, prizes, and deeper connections with the community.

Explore Faster Than Ever - Zip through town with Doc Jr.’s Hoverbike 5000, a handy hover scooter perfect for completing daily chores, making deliveries, or simply taking in the scenic beauty of Alba. Travel faster, do more, and enjoy new levels of convenience!

70010000093553.name: NetherWorld
70010000093553.intro: A weird jellyfish handles marriage crisis with alcohol, drugs, sex, blows and lots of odd characters.
70010000093553.description:
NetherWorld is a 2D pixel art action-adventure narrative experience about a jinxed jellyfish handling marriage crisis with alcohol, drugs, sex and blows.

In short, an irreverent adventure in a decadent world with high doses of absurd and black humour.

STORY: Hobnob with addicted magicians, enterprising prostitutes, mobsters, sociopathic children, old perverts and more to dig yourself out of the emotional hole you're in. Or at least try it.

MINI-GAMES: Get money and items by participating in drink competitions, sexual encounters, shooting things or even controlling a tick named Joe through nasty underground rogue-like dungeons.

FINAL BOSSES: Face (or rather survive) grotesque bosses using whatever you have at hand, be it weapons, stage elements or just NOTHING. The jinx influences these circumstances.

70010000093558.name: The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- Digital Short Novel
70010000093558.intro: An intriguing short novel that serves as a prologue for one of the characters in The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-.
70010000093558.description:
An application that contains the digital short novel. This application is a digital pre-order bonus. Learn more about the character Hiruko Shizuhara, then join her and her classmates as they defend the academy from invaders in the game.

*The digital short novel is accessible through a separate application from the main game.

70010000093559.name: The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- Digital Art Book
70010000093559.intro: A gorgeous digital art book featuring art from the world of The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-!
70010000093559.description:
An application included in The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- Digital Deluxe Edition that contains the digital art book. Defend the academy from invaders, then sit back and enjoy the art at the heart of the game!

*The digital art book is accessible through a separate application from the main game.

70010000093560.name: The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- Digital Soundtrack
70010000093560.intro: An evocative digital soundtrack featuring songs from the world of The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-!
70010000093560.description:
An application included in The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- Digital Deluxe Edition that contains the digital soundtrack. Defend the academy from invaders, then sit back and enjoy the music at the heart of the game!

*The digital soundtrack is accessible through a separate application from the main game.

70010000093561.name: Sanguis Luna
70010000093561.description:
Wake up in the darkness of a cold, unfamiliar cellar, with the distant echo of footsteps that shouldn't be there. 
Sanguis Luna throws you into a living nightmare, where every shadow hides a secret and every sound fills you with growing terror. 

You are alone, with no memory of how you ended up in that cursed house, but one thing is certain: someone, or something, is watching you.

The walls of this ancient dwelling whisper stories of blood and pain, but every time you think you've found a way out, a familiar sensation chills your veins: an unsettling déjà vu that keeps dragging you back. 
The more you try to understand the nature of this dark presence, the more the line between reality and madness dissolves, pulling you into a vortex of fear and despair.

The tension is palpable, the darkness is your enemy, and time is a luxury you can't afford. 
Every corner could hide a clue to your salvation... or a horror ready to consume you. Your only hope? Find a way out before the darkness closes in on you forever.

70010000093566.name: Wonderful Monsters: The Flower Crossing
70010000093566.intro: In a meadow full of colorful flowers, lives a community of small and colorful monsters that maintain a harmonious relationship with nature.
70010000093566.description:
An adorable story full of magic, friendship and adventure

Embark on a magical read as you join Puff and his group of adorable monsters on a quest to restore balance to the natural world. The "Whispering Trees," guardians of nature's secrets, have lost their leaves, and only this brave gang can discover what has happened on the mysterious Hill of the Whispering Winds.

·Discover a world of wonderful landscapes: from enchanted forests to magical hills wrapped in whispering breezes.

·Immerse yourself in colorful and vibrant backgrounds that will make each chapter an unforgettable visual experience.

·Be enveloped by the captivating music that accompanies the story and adds excitement to each page.

·Meet a variety of adorable and unique monsters along the way: some will be unexpected allies, others will offer magical challenges, but all will leave their mark on this charming adventure.

· Explore the power of unity and friendship, as Puff and his friends work together to overcome storms, solve puzzles, and bring peace back to their home.

· A perfect story for those looking for magic, excitement, and endearing characters.

Dive into this enchanting read where every page will make you smile and dream!

70010000093568.name: Cashier Simulator
70010000093568.description:
Cashier Simulator: Manage Your Own Market!
Are you ready to dive into the world of retail and manage your own grocery store? With Cashier Simulator, you can create, expand, and lead your dream market to ultimate success! From stocking shelves with the best products to managing checkout lines, every decision is in your hands. Can you build the best grocery store in town?

Build and Expand:
Start with a small, humble market and transform it into a bustling grocery store empire. Buy new shelves, hire employees, and expand your floor space to accommodate more products and customers.

Customer Satisfaction:
Keep your customers happy by ensuring your shelves are always stocked, your prices are competitive, and your service is top-notch. Handle customer complaints, manage queues, and make sure everyone leaves with a smile.

Product Management:
Choose from a wide variety of products to keep your shelves full. From fresh produce to household items, ensure you have what your customers need. Monitor sales trends and adjust your inventory to maximize profits.

Upgrade and Customize:
Upgrade your equipment and customize your store to make it stand out. Invest in better checkout counters, faster restocking shelves, and even decorate your market with unique themes to attract more customers.

Daily Challenges and Rewards:
Complete daily challenges to earn rewards and improve your market. Special events and seasonal sales offer unique opportunities to boost your revenue and customer satisfaction.

Realistic Simulation:
Experience a realistic supermarket environment with detailed graphics and dynamic gameplay. Manage everything from employee schedules to special promotions and seasonal sales.

Strategic Decisions:
Make strategic decisions to optimize your market’s performance. Decide on pricing strategies, marketing campaigns, and even how to handle competitors.

Why You'll Love Cashier Simulator:
Cashier Simulator offers an engaging and immersive experience that allows you to build and manage your own grocery store. Whether you enjoy strategy games, management simulations, or simply love the idea of running a store, this game offers endless fun and challenges. With its realistic mechanics, detailed graphics, and a wide range of customization options, Cashier Simulator is the ultimate retail management game.

70010000093575.name: LOVE ETERNAL
70010000093575.intro: Wander a castle built of bitter memories in LOVE ETERNAL, a psychological horror platformer with devious trials and an unsettling, experimental narrative.
70010000093575.description:
Run, jump, and reverse the flow of gravity itself to escape the mind of a selfish god in this challenging precision platformer. Play as Maya, a child stolen from her family on the whim of a lonely, forsaken deity, and make your way through over 100 screens filled with spikes, lasers, switches, and traps as you unravel the horrifying secret of your new prison.

- Gorgeous hand-drawn pixel art graphics bring the god’s realm to life alongside meticulously handcrafted animations boasting many thousands of frames
- A lush, atmospheric score, equal parts unsettling and beautiful
- Responsive, snappy controls provide challenges with a sense of mastery and acrobatic accomplishment
- A psychological horror narrative contorts and unfolds to reveal choices beyond comprehension

Will you find your way home, or wander these halls carved of memory forever?

70010000093580.name: Nico Saves The State
70010000093580.intro: Nico must outsmart the evil Dr. Voo Doom’s followers and SAVE Ririland.
70010000093580.description:
Followers of the notorious Dr. Voo Doom have taken over a city, demanding his release from prison. But this is merely a diversion as they gather Power Crystals to execute their true plan: teleporting their master to freedom!

With the legendary hero Jack on vacation, the fate of Ririland now rests in the hands of Nico, the not-so-heroic lab assistant of Dr. Expo Zicion. Armed with the Statephone, one of the Doctor's eccentric inventions, Nico must rise to the challenge and SAVE the day.

The Statephone is no ordinary device. It allows Nico to SAVE different aspects of his state and LOAD them later to navigate obstacles, solve intricate puzzles, and defeat formidable enemies.

* SAVE your position to return to it later, even if the path to it has been blocked!
* SAVE your momentum while bouncing on a spring to execute a double jump later!
* SAVE your inventory and LOAD it after using an item to double it, then SAVE it again for infinite items!
* … and more!

The possibilities are endless, and the power is in your hands.

SAVE the STATE. SAVE the GAME.


Features:
* Innovative SAVE STATE mechanic inspired by popular emulator features
* Cute and colorful 2.5D pixel graphics
* Visual novel-like hand drawn story scenes
* 40 captivating levels spread across 4 different environments
* 25+ funky, catchy music tracks inspired by the 90s gaming era

70010000093587.name: Dark Receipt
70010000093587.intro: Dark Receipt is a short, intense psychological horror game featuring retro visual styles…
70010000093587.description:
In the fluorescent glow of a Tokyo convenience store, your mundane night shift becomes a descent into madness. Dragged into a twisted parallel reality by mysterious shadow figures, you must navigate a nightmarish version of modern Japan where familiar streets warp into impossible geometries and everyday people harbor dark secrets.
Featuring authentic retro low-poly visuals and haunting sound design, Dark Receipt plunges you into a psychological horror experience where every flickering light and distorted texture builds mounting dread. Solve minor yet mysterious puzzles, engage with enigmatic characters, and piece together the truth behind your abduction while evading the shadows that stalk you through this warped reality.

70010000093589.name: Alehouse Tavern Simulator
70010000093589.intro: Serve Ale, Grow Crops, and Defend Your Fantasy Tavern!
70010000093589.description:
Alehouse Tavern Simulator invites you into a vibrant fantasy world where your tavern is more than just a gathering place—it's the heart of your adventure! As the tavern keeper, you’ll manage daily life while diving into thrilling activities and exploring the magical surroundings.

Fish in nearby streams, hunt in the wilderness, tend to your small farm, raise pigs and chickens for fresh ingredients, and harvest vegetables from your own garden to craft delicious meals and brews that delight your patrons. Chop wood to fuel your kitchen and keep the tavern warm and inviting for your guests.

Enemies won’t always respect the peace of your establishment. Creatures may target your tavern, and you’ll need to defend it. Take on quests, equip yourself with weapons, and protect your patrons and livelihood from harm.

Whether you're whipping up a legendary stew, chopping wood like a lumberjack on a mission, or fending off bandits who clearly didn’t read the “no fighting in the tavern” sign, Alehouse Tavern Simulator serves up endless charm and adventure. Will you become the kingdom's most beloved tavern keeper? Or will you just end up with a lot of angry chickens and broken mugs? The choice is yours—pour yourself an ale and get to it!

70010000093594.name: 夢現しろっぷ - Dreamy Syrup -
70010000093594.intro: VTuber "Amau Syrup" stars in a heart-pounding youthful love comedy adventure where ‘Dreams’ and ‘Reality’ intertwine!
70010000093594.description:
"Whip Syrup Juuump! Bringing energy to everyone~!"
A visual novel starring VTuber "Amau Syrup" herself!
A sweet and syrupy youth story of you, Amau, and Ama!


◆Synopsis
At university, you happen to meet "Ama Sato" by chance—
a passionate fan of the same virtual idol, "Amau Syrup" just like you!

As you bond over your shared enthusiasm, you start hanging out,
chatting about your favorite idol, and gradually growing closer.

But then……

"I almost just doxxed myself."

A single remark during Amau Syrup’s livestream sparks a shocking suspicion—―
"Could Amau Syrup actually be... Ama Sato?"

Will you end up witnessing the virtual idol "Amau Syrup" getting doxxed!?

A heart-pounding romantic comedy where 'dreams' and 'reality' intertwine!


◆Characters
・Amau Syrup (CV: Amau Syrup)
"Whip-ya better keep up with Amau~~!!!"
A quirky idol streamer known for her bizarre content, including the "Electric Bill Payment RTA" and "Scorpion Eating Challenge."
In real life, she’s so determined to make friends that she even asks her viewers for "friend-making tips".
Her relatable and down-to-earth streams have earned her a loyal fanbase.

・Ama Sato（CV：Amau Syrup）
"If it's okay with you… Can we keep talking about Amau together?"
A University student who happens to be your seatmate in class.
After returning a lost item, you discover that Ama is a passionate Amau Syrup fan and become friend with her.
Her knowledge of Amau Syrup goes beyond what any normal fan would know.


◆Novel Game Brand "Rabbitfoot”
A novel game brand that delivers novel games casting active YouTubers and VTubers as game characters.
As well as using their names and nicknames, you can enjoy the different sides of your faves and feel a close connection through the novel game that you cannot experience in the usual streaming or video uploads.

70010000093599.name: Anthology of The Killer
70010000093599.intro: The complete surrealist horror-comedy series! A mysterious world of zines and blood!!
70010000093599.description:
The complete horror-comedy series!

Join protagonist BB as she collects material for her zines in a mysterious world of drinky birds, secret rooms, dream resorts, waterparks, bort dolls, immersive theater, beachfront novelty shirts, police men, serial killers, art freeports and unorthodox medical treatment. Nobody's getting out of here alive!

Voice Of The Killer

    BB joins a call center on the edge of the city, but a horrible noise can be heard from the sea. Does the voice of the Killer sound out this far...?

Hands Of The Killer

    A strange sound is heard from within the walls of the apartment block - they say the hands of the Killer are roaming around.

Drool Of The Killer

    Beneath the tiles of the swimming pool complex, a new world is striving to be born. This is the TAMMY show, coming soon to a city near you.

Eyes Of The Killer

    It's the hit of the season and applause rings out night after night. But why do all the people that come to see it disappear? What does "immersive theatre" mean... and will BB survive to tell anybody else?

Flesh Of The Killer

    BB and her friends sneak into a tax exempt freeport on the edge of the city. What kind of animal has been evolving underground in the forbidden Museum Of Moral Art?

Blood Of The Killer

    In the quiet country town the drinky birds lie dreaming and severed heads roll slowly down the street. BB must discover the terrible secret of the lost zine distro, or fall prey to its curse...

Ears Of The Killer

    A new music scene is forming - it's known as "Crime Wave" and all of the songs are about killing people. Can BB and her sister ZZ outrun the New Wave, or is it true nothing can change the shape of things to come?

Heart Of The Killer

    At the Dream Resort the days slip by quietly in the murmuring pines. At night a dreadful vision of desire stalks the halls.

Face Of The Killer

    All the dogs in town are laughing: there is talk of a new play. As fireworks burst over the city, BB finds herself looking into the face of the Killer.



Collects all nine games in the series plus additional "bonus rooms". A miracle collab by thecatamites (Space Funeral, Goblet Grotto, 10 Beautiful Postcards) and Tommy Tone (Goblet Grotto, Magic Wand, 10 Beautiful Postcards OSTs) with diorama art and posters by comics artist A. Degen (Soft X-Ray: Mindhunters, The Marchenoir LIbrary).

"History is a nightmare - - and loving it!!"

70010000093609.name: Monster Blast Infinity
70010000093609.description:
Fight your way from wave to wave and kill all the monsters. Collect coins to buy weapons, ammunition and special items like dynamite or gun turrets in the shop machine. Be quick, because the shop is only open for 30 seconds between each wave. Each level has four rounds.

Use your ammunition sparingly and use the weapons strategically, because everything is limited. Pay attention to your health too.

Let dynamite and the gun turret help you. Attract enemies and use the two things strategically to kill as many enemies as possible.

Features:
- 30 challenging levels
- Dynamite, turret, health items as support
- Masses of enemies with different strengths
- Shop system for buying weapons, ammunition and special items
- 4 randomly selected environments
- XP system for unlocking improvements (weapons, more money, health)

70010000093611.name: Only Up To Space
70010000093611.intro: Test your skill and patience in this unforgiving vertical journey.
70010000093611.description:
Only Up To Space is a casual yet heart-pounding climbing and platforming adventure that will test your skill, patience, and determination. As a stranded astronaut, you must ascend through a series of challenging, ever-ascending platforms to reach to the top after losing your shuttle. One wrong step could send you plummeting back to the start, erasing all your hard-earned progress.

In this gripping journey, precision is key. Navigate through diverse environments, from floating debris fields to alien landscapes, while avoiding traps and mastering each perilous jump. Every platform brings you one step closer to space, but be warned: with no checkpoints, a single misstep could result in a fall back to where you started. Do you have what it takes to get to the highest point to space?

Features:
■ Precision platforming: Careful jumps and smooth timing are the only way forward.
■ No safety nets: One wrong move could send you all the way down—permanently.
■ Dynamic environments: Climb through unpredictable, shifting landscapes filled with challenges.
■ Intense atmosphere: A casual but nerve-wracking experience that keeps you on the edge of your seat.
■ Cosmic soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the sound of space as you reach for the stars.

Can you keep your cool and make it all the way Only Up To Space? The stars are waiting for you — just don’t look down.

70010000093615.name: Lethal Cosmic Hunt
70010000093615.intro: Hide, survive, and outsmart terrifying creatures in a deadly hunt.
70010000093615.description:
As a lone survivor aboard this forsaken vessel, your only hope for escape lies in completing a series of perilous objectives that will unlock the path back to Earth. But beware, for you are not alone. Cosmic alien creatures, driven by insatiable hunger and unyielding hostility, stalk the planets with deadly intent.

In Lethal Cosmic Hunt, every shadow conceals a potential threat, and every creaking sound could herald your doom. To survive, you must rely on your wits and cunning, using stealth and subterfuge to evade the clutches of your pursuers. Hide in the shadows, sneak past patrolling monstrosities, and pray that your nerve holds out against the relentless onslaught of terror.

Can you survie?

70010000093619.name: Sand Legends
70010000093619.intro: Save the princess, be the hero!
70010000093619.description:
A Heroic Adventure Awaits!

Enter the sun-scorched deserts of Sand Legends, where courage, strategy, and skill collide in an epic quest to rescue the princess and defeat endless hordes of zombies. Will you rise to become the hero this world needs?

Survive Waves of Zombies:
Take on relentless waves of zombies. Each wave becomes more challenging as you progress, testing your hero's mettle.

Dig for Treasure:
Between battles, dive into a unique sand-digging quest. Carve pathways through the sands, guiding precious ores into treasure chests while navigating traps and leveraging multiplier gates to boost your rewards.

Upgrade Your Hero: Use the ore you collect to enhance your hero’s abilities, from firepower to critical hits, ensuring you're ready for the tougher battles ahead.

Unleash your inner hero in a world where only the brave can survive!

70010000093621.name: Tiny Lands - Deluxe Edition
70010000093621.intro: Relax and find the differences in beautiful 3D dioramas. With the Deluxe Edition, you can play all the new expansions for Tiny Lands.
70010000093621.description:
Tiny Lands -  Deluxe Edition is a relaxing 3D game about finding the differences between two handcrafted dioramas. If you are looking for a game that allows you to just sit back and play Tiny Lands is for you!

Tiny Lands - Deluxe Edition includes all DLC worlds:
- Desert mysteries
- City lifestyle
- Warmy christmas
- Traditional food
- Cozy interiors
- Fairy tales
- Fish tanks
- Amusement park
- Pirates

This also includes the “Final Challenge” special world for those who are ready for the ultimate Tiny Lands experience.

Over 100 additional handcrafted dioramas are waiting for you!

70010000093626.name: Minions Survivors
70010000093626.intro: Survive the hordes of minions and defeat the bosses!
70010000093626.description:
Minions are coming and you are here to survive! Defeat the challenging boss fights and level up your abilities. Choose from 36 abilities and different characters and complete all stages. Survive the minsions!

Features:
-36 Abilities
-Six Boss fights
-Two Characters

70010000093641.name: Drakkar Crew
70010000093641.description:
Hey rookie, climb aboard! We're heading for adventure across the North Sea on our reliable Viking ship! Choose from one of the charismatic characters, hire some warriors and engage in bloody battles!
Your character travels around the large world based on Scandinavian mythology. 
There are various settlements located on the map. 
Pirate and merchant ships are traveling on the seas. 
Caves and ruins of ancient civilizations hide treasures. 
Interact with the world! You can trade, employ recruits or simply plunder all and receive valuable resources by force!
The player has to employ a team which helps him fight. 
All units have their own specialization such as soldiers and others performing support functions on the ship - cooking, treatment, navigation, etc. 
Each warrior reaches new levels by receiving points from successful battles.
Warriors need a salary, food and victorious battles to support their levels of morale! 
Carefully watch over the crew members! They can be wounded, develop bad habits or catch diseases.
Dynamic battles in a beat'em'up style with tactical elements. 
You control the main hero and issue commands to your crew members.  
Your warriors have their own intelligence - they react appropriately to different situations on the battlefield.
Improve the skills of your hero to get access to additional abilities and quests.
Use various types of weapons and armor. 
Purchase different ships and equip them to your needs. 
Complete the storyline and additional side-quests.

70010000093658.name: Seedsow Lullaby
70010000093658.intro:
My mother, my daughter, and me
—three sixteen-year-olds on an extraordinary adventure.
70010000093658.description:
■Introduction
Following three women on an adventure through the Land of the Gods, Seedsow Lullaby is a visual novel that features no choices or branching paths.
*There are some scenes depicting flood trauma in the story.

■Story
Misuzu lost her mother at a young age. 
On her sixteenth birthday, in the spring of 2023, she is visited by a lone girl. 
The girl turns out to be her mother, Yoko, also aged sixteen.

Yoko explains that she has been chosen as a Maiden to conduct the Seedsow Ceremony in the dwelling place of the gods, the Eternal Realm, and has traveled from 1996 to invite Misuzu along on her journey.

The Seedsow Ceremony is a funeral for the gods, and is necessary for a new generation of immortal deities to usher in a new age. Seedsow Maidens must travel the Eternal Realm and have the ancient god elders accept their deaths before True Winter comes and defiles the land.

Accompanying her mother Yoko, Misuzu travels to the year 2050, where her own sixteen-year-old daughter, Tsumugi, joins them as they make for the Eternal Realm.

With the addition of Hiruko, who claims to be Misuzu's younger brother and acts as the group's guide, the foursome journey through lush landscapes made no less resplendent by True Winter's looming approach.

The young group has been brought together as though by a miracle, but what awaits them at the end of their journey?

70010000093669.name: Barista Simulator 2025
70010000093669.intro: Master the Art of Coffee and Build a Café Worth Savoring.
70010000093669.description:
Your journey from humble coffee cart to caffeine empire is just one espresso shot away! Step behind the counter, fire up the machines, and start crafting steamy, frothy drinks for an ever-growing crowd of quirky, caffeine-craving customers.

As your café grows, so do your responsibilities. Upgrade your equipment to unlock more advanced brews, manage your inventory to keep up with demand, and hire and train staff to help you through the busiest hours. Customize the look and layout of your café to create a space that reflects your vision and draws in loyal customers.

As your fame spreads, so does the chaos. Special orders, fussy regulars, latte art disasters—it’s all part of the charm. So roll up those sleeves, steam that milk, and remember: in Barista Simulator 2025, every cup tells a story—and hopefully, it comes with a nice tip.

70010000093674.name: Whoowasit?
70010000093674.intro: Reveal the secrets of the speaking animals and find the thief!
70010000093674.description:
Find the thief of the magical ring!

The castle is in an uproar: The king's magical ring has been stolen! Only you can talk to the speaking animals – they saw the thief. Follow their clues, make clever deductions and unmask the culprit before the time runs out. Can you save the kingdom?

• Talk to the animals and gather information
• Search the castle and discover magical items
• Make clever deductions – every clue counts!
• Play with up to 4 detectives – whether they're real friends or smart AI teammates
• Every game is a new adventure – plenty of thrills right to the end!

70010000093679.name: Bibi Blocksberg – Big Broom Race 4
70010000093679.description:
Bibi Blocksberg and her friends are taking to the air again! 
Get ready for new, turbulent tracks and lots of broomstick action. Experience hair-raising races through spooky Transylvania, the mysterious Orient, and the untamed prehistoric world. Whether solo or with 4 players – this adventure will be as wild as a witch!

• 12 exciting tracks in a new combo and 2 hidden bonus tracks
• Daredevil races through 3 magical worlds
• Unlock 8 witches and brooms – with Apple Pie too, of course
• Witch rally, single and team races for extra thrills!
• Fabulous flying fun for 1-4 young witches and would-be witches!

70010000093683.name: Yatzi 2
70010000093683.description:
Play solo, with friends or online multiplayer

The classic dice game is entering a new dimension, now with the new online multiplayer mode!
In Yatzi 2, you are no longer just the couch champion, you can now compete against other enthusiasts from all over the world. New game environments bring fresh excitement, while the popular gameplay remains as thrilling as ever: Roll the dice, enter the score, celebrate and have fun together!

• Play online with family, friends or randomly selected opponents worldwide.
• Single and multiplayer modes for up to 6 players.
• 7 diverse game worlds.
• With smart game help for beginners.
• Fun for all ages.

70010000093691.name: Orphans
70010000093691.intro: Join Victoria on her journey through a dystopian city, where the savage instincts lurk around every corner.
70010000093691.description:
Dive into this immersive game, taking on the role of Victoria, a young girl orphaned after a tragic sea accident, trapped in the enigmatic confines of a mysterious city. In a place full of traps and dangers, Victoria must rely on her dexterity to advance.
But Victoria will not be alone on this journey. She joins other orphaned children, inexplicably locked away for sinister purposes. Victoria's mission involves locating and liberating these children, each of whom has unique abilities crucial for overcoming the challenges that lie ahead.
But, the perils extend beyond traps and puzzles. Victoria is chased by humanoid creatures with the only goal of devouring her. In order to stop these creatures, Victoria uses the environment to create distractions with her slingshot, facilitating her escape.
Join the orphans on their journey to escape the city of animals. In this world, survival is a collective endeavor and no one can face it alone.

70010000093703.name: Galagi Shooter Ultimate Blast
70010000093703.intro: A fast-paced arcade space shooter with epic battles, stunning visuals, and intense boss fights!
70010000093703.description:
Galagi Shooter Ultimate Blast - The Ultimate Arcade Space Battle!

Prepare for an intergalactic showdown in Galagi Shooter Ultimate Blast! Experience classic arcade-style space combat reimagined with stunning graphics, fluid animations, and an electrifying soundtrack.

Blast through waves of relentless alien invaders across intense, action-packed levels, each culminating in epic boss battles that will test your reflexes and strategy. Upgrade your ship, master advanced maneuvers, and unleash devastating firepower to reclaim the galaxy!

Key Features:

- Fast-paced, nostalgic arcade shooting with a modern touch
- Breathtaking visuals and explosive effects
- Dynamic enemy formations and attack patterns
- Massive, challenging bosses at the end of each sector
- Pulse-pounding music and sound FX

Lock and load, pilot! The galaxy won’t save itself. Are you ready to fight back?

70010000093716.name: Chess Grandmaster: Ancient Egypt Battle
70010000093716.intro: A classic board game for fans of strategy and logic in the style of ancient Egypt! Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of ancient pyramids and prove to everyone that you are a real pharaoh!

70010000093723.name: A love story: My best friend
70010000093723.intro: A love triangle full of secrets, difficult decisions and unexpected twists and turns. True love or friendship, your choice will change everything!
70010000093723.description:
Enter a story where love, friendship and secrets are intertwined in a plot full of emotion. You're falling in love with a boy, but your best friend has a secret love for you, suffering in silence... What will you do when relationships get complicated and your decisions can change everything?

Every choice you make will affect the fate of all three characters. Will you support your best friend in confessing his love? Will you let the love between you and the boy you like move forward? Every moment is filled with tension and unexpected twists and turns, where unrequited love and inner doubts will test your loyalty and your feelings.

With beautiful graphics, immersive music and a story that will make you question your own feelings, you will live a unique experience. Face exciting dilemmas, choose wisely and find out what the future holds for these three friends - true love or foolproof friendship? The story is in your hands!

70010000093726.name: Karate Survivor
70010000093726.description:
Step into the shoes of a martial arts master in a thrilling survivor-like roguelite inspired by action movies of the ‘80s. Use the environment and improvised weapons, master new techniques, and create devastating combos to fight off relentless goons and bandits! Karate Survivor delivers intense, fast-paced combat where improvisation and creativity are key to surviving the streets.

Key Features

Improvised Combat. Use whatever you can get your hands on to defeat your enemies. From plastic flamingos to mop handles, even a child's toy hammer can be deadly in the right hands.

Environmental Warfare. Manipulate your surroundings to your advantage. Push objects at enemies, bring down scaffolding, or slam them with a microwave door.

Dynamic Combos. Dozens of different attacks allow you to create unique combinations of up to six attacks, tailored to your fighting style. Experiment and discover the most effective combos. 

Progression and Mastery. Collect experience to unlock and master new permanent techniques and skills between runs, making each playthrough more rewarding.

Diverse Locations and Boss Battles. Battle through various areas, each with its own distinct features and items for combat. Face powerful bosses in each location, testing your skills to the limit.

Fast-Paced Runs. Immerse yourself in rapid, intense street battles. Test your martial arts skills and survival instincts in action-packed showdowns that pay homage to the adrenaline-fueled scenes of action movies, ensuring you're always on the edge of your seat.

Fight fast, precisely, and without remorse.

70010000093736.name: Ale Tavern Master
70010000093736.intro: Where Every Pint Poured Starts a New Story.
70010000093736.description:
In Ale Tavern Master, you’re not just pouring pints—you’re crafting the heart of a bustling fantasy village. Adventurers, mages, and weary travelers all find their way to your cozy tavern, hungry for good food, strong drink, and a place to swap stories before the next big quest.

But running a tavern takes more than a friendly smile. Head outside and explore a world full of opportunity: fish in sparkling rivers for fresh catches, hunt wild game for tonight’s stew, or gather rare herbs to add a little magic to your menu. With every new discovery, your tavern becomes a little warmer, a little livelier, and a lot more famous.

Take on odd jobs, help out colorful townsfolk, and maybe even lend a hand to a hero or two. In Ale Tavern Master, every meal you cook and every quest you complete shapes the story of your tavern. Will your little alehouse become the legendary meeting place for the realm’s greatest adventurers? There’s only one way to find out—grab a mug, fire up the kitchen, and start your journey today!

70010000093741.name: Hentai Shop Simulator
70010000093741.intro: Build your spicy empire, one blush-worthy item at a time!
70010000093741.description:
Ever dreamt of running a shop that’s a little… spicier? In Hentai Shop Simulator, you’re the proud owner of a one-of-a-kind store catering to anime fans with a taste for the bold. Stock shelves with eye-catching magazines and cheeky merchandise, manage your inventory like a pro, and watch your profits soar. Just remember—your niche is adult content, so keep it classy...ish.

Key Features:
- Customize & Expand: Spruce up your shop, grow your floor space, and design a layout that keeps customers browsing (and blushing).
- Hire Staff: Bring in employees to handle the hard work, like restocking and managing the register, so you can focus on running the show.
- Smart Management: Set competitive prices and pick the perfect products to turn your store into a must-visit hotspot.

Turn your cheeky little store into an empire of spicy delights! Whether you're here for business or just a bit of fun, success is only a sale away. Ready to stock up and stand out? The market’s all yours!

70010000093746.name: Country Birds: Brothership of the Valley
70010000093746.intro: This visual novel follows a young falcon who, after facing a difficult setback, embarks on an epic journey to rediscover his confidence and inner strength.
70010000093746.description:
Discover a world of adventure, friendship, and courage in this charming visual novel.
With a tender and learning-filled story, you will accompany a young falcon on his path to discover his true inner power.

A Story That Inspires
After facing a great challenge, a young falcon embarks on an epic journey to regain his confidence and strength. On his journey, he will be guided by a wise owl and the company of a cheerful and energetic hummingbird.

Through exciting challenges and encounters with fascinating creatures, the falcon will learn that true strength is born in his heart, in friendship, and in self-confidence.

What Makes This Adventure Special?

·A Hero with Wings – Accompany a brave falcon on his path of self-discovery.

·A Wise Guide – Learn great life lessons from the serene owl.

· An Unrivaled Friend – Enjoy the energy and optimism of the hummingbird.

· A World Full of Magic – Explore enchanted forests, towering mountains, and endless skies.

· A Heartwarming Story – Perfect for teaching perseverance, friendship, and trust.

· Ideal for little dreamers who love stories full of excitement and adventure.

Get ready to fly high in this beautiful, choice-free visual novel and immerse yourself in an experience that will stay in children's hearts!

70010000093748.name: Evo Pop
70010000093748.description:
Take control of Evos - colorful creatures that live in colonies and grow at lightning speed! Bigger Evos devour smaller ones of different breeds. Dominate the battlefield by filling the screen with Evos or eating all your rivals!

Features:
- MULTIPLE ENEMIES: A three-way brawl for you to come on top of!
- PHYSICS-BASED GAMEPLAY: Control the creatures by using different spells on them.
- UPGRADE & EVOLVE: Each Evo breed has unique skills, such as jumping or sliding downhill. These properties can be upgraded to make your Evos even stronger.
- PLAN A STRATEGY: Evos interact with the environment and eat grass, flowers and bugs to multiply faster. Fight for strategic resources on the map to win!
- DOZENS OF WORLDS: Evo Pop features multiple worlds with unique design elements and physics, making the gameplay fresh every time.

Get ready to POP OFF and have FUN!

70010000093750.name: War Mongrels
70010000093750.intro: Make your mark in history - stand in the frontline of the second World War.
70010000093750.description:
Are you drawn to tactical games with dark, gripping narratives? War Mongrels is exactly what you’re looking for! The game blends intense adventure, stealth mechanics, and strategic depth, all set in the gritty backdrop of World War II.

Strategize carefully to ensure mission success. Use the interactive map to your advantage by creating clever diversions, setting ambushes, and maneuvering around enemy attention to slip past unnoticed.

Cover blown? Grab your weapon and fight your way out - think fast, shoot even faster, and carve an escape route through enemy lines!


KEY FEATURES:
Interactive map - take advantage of the surroundings as you navigate unknown terrains.
Unique and thoughtful gameplay - problem solving, creative thinking, and multilayer mechanics all at once.
Tactical planning mode  - that will allow you to pause and carefully plan your next move.
Dynamic action mode - fast changing environment with adaptive enemies to maneuver around.


Keep your head in the game, as every decision you make matters.

Gear up with your uniform, weapons, and tactical plans, then head straight into action!

70010000093755.name: Old Skies
70010000093755.intro: A time travel adventure spanning two hundred years. Dive into the past with time agent Fia Quinn as she embarks on seven trips through time.
70010000093755.description:
Fia Quinn is a time traveler, accompanying clients of the ChronoZen Time Travel Agency on jumps to other eras to make sure they don’t rewrite important aspects of history. Some of these people are merely curious. Others have unresolved business. As long as they can pay for the trip, their motivations don’t matter to Fia… until they do.

Jump with Fia into seven time-travel cases spanning two centuries in New York City, from the speakeasies of Prohibition to the vicious gangs of the Gilded Age to the World Trade Center on September 10, 2001. Solve temporal problems, survive paradoxes, and resolve the mistakes of the past or die trying—as many times as it takes. 

What could go wrong? It’s only time travel, after all.

70010000093759.name: Eden Survivors
70010000093759.intro: Survive, evolve, and dominate in a world overrun by chaos!
70010000093759.description:
Eden Survivors is an intense action roguelike where you must fight endless waves of enemies in a world on the brink of collapse. Choose from unique heroes, unlock devastating abilities, and create unstoppable power combos to survive.

Each run is a new opportunity to evolve your combat style, discover deadly synergies, and challenge formidable bosses. Will you survive long enough to unleash your full potential?

Key Features:
- Fast-paced battles with dynamic roguelike mechanics.
- A wide selection of heroes, weapons, and abilities to customize your strategy.
- Permanent upgrades to help you progress with every attempt.
- Challenging maps filled with secrets and dangers at every turn.
