The fate of humanity is in your hands. Survive, evolve, and dominate the chaos in Eden Survivors!

70010000093764.name: Rusty Rangers
70010000093764.intro: Rusty Rangers is an action platformer and roguelike with elements of metroidvania. Choose your ranger and explore procedurally generated dungeons!
70010000093764.description:
No one remembers what the world looked like before, except for a team of brave rangers. Now chaos and unpredictability reign everywhere - harmless creatures in the past bring destruction, and the world around is constantly changing, over and over again nullifying the familiar environment around.

COMBINATION OF CLASSIC GAMEPLAY AND MODERN MECHANICS
Take control of one of the brave rangers and go on a responsible mission - find the villains, stop the widespread madness and return peace and justice to the world!
You will meet many unique opponents that will keep you busy: run, jump and shoot to save the world! Each ranger has their own fighting style and special skills, so you can choose the hero that best suits you!

BEAUTIFUL PIXEL GRAPHICS
The universe of Rusty Rangers is full of detailed worlds, original and colorful characters, useful items and bizarre creatures. Each pixel is made with great love. Enjoy the beautiful and incredible world of Rusty Rangers!

STORY QUESTS AND CHARACTERS
Follow the story of Rusty Rangers and find out what really happened and how to fix it. With each new passage you will learn more about this world and its inhabitants. Chat with characters, complete their tasks, and get help in the fight against the cruel baron!

70010000093769.name: Content Warning: Scary Filming
70010000093769.intro: Film the fright, survive the night!
70010000093769.description:
Content Warning: Scary Filming is a co-op horror game where you and your friends embark on a spine-chilling adventure to film terrifying content and go viral. Customize your face with the quirky ASCII face customizer, then dive into the unknown with your team. Armed with only your camera, you'll explore creepy environments filled with physics-driven monsters, cursed relics, and other horrifying discoveries.

Film as many terrifying moments as you can before you run out of battery, oxygen, or—worst of all—friends. After surviving the dangers, head back to the surface and watch your chaotic footage rack up views. The more terrifying content you capture, the more famous you become. Use your earnings to upgrade your gear, buy props, and unlock sponsorships to grow your fame even further.

Can you survive the horrors and make a name for yourself, or will you become just another spooky story?

70010000093774.name: Gunspectre
70010000093774.intro: GUNSPECTRE is a twin-stick adventure game featuring a large open world and a ton of action!
70010000093774.description:
GUNSPECTRE is a twin-stick adventure game featuring a large open world and a ton of action!

In the distant future, only a wasteland remains. An ancient menace has returned forcing many people to flee the once peaceful desert. Armed with a pocket full of of miracles, it is up to you to restore peace to the wasteland people call home. 

EXPLORE a desolate world and what lies beneath.

FIGHT your way through aggressive creatures and mysterious machines.

SURVIVE the menace from below, and bring peace back to the desert.

70010000093776.name: Narcissus
70010000093776.description: Narcissus is an adrenaline-pumping, top down, action-horror game that puts you in the shoes of the last survivor on a doomed spaceship. The clock is ticking, and danger lurks around every corner.

70010000093780.name: Asterix & Obelix - Mission Babylon
70010000093780.intro: Experience a story full of humour, epic battles and unforgettable encounters in a thrilling platform game!
70010000093780.description:
This time, our heroes leave their beloved village for a long journey through the Parthian Empire, a faraway kingdom under threat from Roman invasion. Their mission? To save Monipehni, the King of the Parthians, who has fallen victim to a deadly poison brewed by Bahmbuhzeli, a treacherous sorcerer allied with Caesar.

Along the way, they will need to gather the ingredients for the antidote while fending off fierce Roman legionaries. They will also lend a hand to local villagers in exotic and enchanting landscapes.
Thanks to their courage, their legendary resourcefulness and plenty of well-placed slaps, Asterix and Obelix will push back the invaders and prove that the indomitable Gauls are unbeatable, no matter how far from home they may be!

- Embark on an unforgettable adventure with Asterix and Obelix, in local co-op or solo!
- Dive into a brand-new, action-packed story bursting with humour, twists and turns!
- Explore four stunning worlds, each with their own iconic settings and landmarks, including an exclusive new destination: the legendary city of Babylon.
- Relive the action across twenty replayable levels, featuring a wide variety of enemies.
- Face off against formidable bosses and give the Roman legionaries a thrashing they won’t soon forget in epic combat!

70010000093853.name: ONLY UP! CARS
70010000093853.intro: The higher you go, the harder it gets!
70010000093853.description:
ONLY UP! CARS – The Ultimate Vertical Driving Challenge!
Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled ride in ONLY UP! CARS, where gravity is your greatest enemy, and the road is anything but ordinary. In this thrilling driving adventure, your goal is simple – drive higher and higher! Navigate through extreme vertical tracks, jump between platforms, and push your driving skills to the limit as you climb towards the sky.
Key Features:
	•	Defy Gravity – Drive, jump, and balance on insane vertical courses. One wrong move, and it’s a long way down!
	•	Unlock & Customize – Choose from a variety of cars, from sports cars to monster trucks, and customize them with upgrades.
	•	Dynamic Challenges – Face moving platforms, unstable roads, and unpredictable obstacles.
	•	Realistic Physics – Master precise controls and adapt to each car’s unique handling.
Test your reflexes, master insane stunts, and prove you have what it takes to conquer the heights in ONLY UP! CARS. How high can you go?

70010000093860.name: Zombie Quarantine: Blackout Survival
70010000093860.intro: Survive the Darkness, Fight the Horde!
70010000093860.description:
The world has fallen into chaos. A deadly outbreak has turned the city into a quarantine zone, and now, in total blackout, the undead roam free. With no power, no safe zones, and only the weapons you can find, survival is a brutal fight against endless waves of zombies lurking in the shadows.

Every bullet counts. Every flickering light could be your last hope - or your final mistake. Scavenge, fortify, and fight back against the relentless horde in this intense low-poly action shooter. The darkness is closing in, and the infected are everywhere. Will you escape the quarantine, or become part of the undead nightmare?

70010000093865.name: Medieval Supermarket Shop Simulator
70010000093865.intro: Your adventure in medieval business starts here!
70010000093865.description:
Welcome to the captivating world of medieval commerce! In Medieval Supermarket Shop Simulator, you become the proud owner of a small shop in the age of knights and castles. Your mission? Grow your business, win the hearts of the kingdom’s residents, and become the greatest merchant of all time.
Buy and sell goods, from freshly baked bread to rare exotic treasures.
Update your store and expand your inventory.
Dive into a beautifully stylized world where every decision shapes your success. Can you turn your humble shop into a legendary trading empire? Find out now!

70010000093872.name: RememPair
70010000093872.intro: Remember the uncovered pictures and make identical pairs of 2, 3 or even 4
70010000093872.description:
RememPair – Test Your Memory, Challenge Your Mind!

Put your memory to the test with RememPair! Match pairs—or take it up a notch with groups of three or even four for an extra challenge.

- Play solo or with up to 5 friends & AI opponents (max. 6 players).
- Choose from various card sets – with more sets planned as DLC!
- Pass the controller after each turn – strategy matters!
- Enjoy 43 relaxing tracks with a built-in music player.

Whether you're playing alone or with friends, RememPair is the perfect way to train your brain and have fun!

70010000093881.name: The Running Toaster
70010000093881.intro: Run like a Toaster! Collect slices of Bread and speed up by shooting Toast at the Vegetables!
70010000093881.description:
The Running Toaster is a quick shooting game where you play as a Toaster trying to escape the Vegetable table!

- Avoid the coffee cups and shoot bread at the vegetables so they don't pass you! The longer you run the faster it gets!

- Collect bread slices to unlock new Toaster colors!

- Try your best to take on 9 achievement challenges!

70010000093884.name: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Digital Art Book and Soundtrack
70010000093884.description: A Digital Art Book and Soundtrack App featuring 134 pages of exclusive artwork, including illustrations of characters, monsters, and development materials. Enjoy all 56 music tracks from Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma at your leisure.

70010000093885.name: Escape game R00M02
70010000093885.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

70010000093889.name: Just Find It 4 Collector's Edition
70010000093889.intro: Explore hidden variations and engage with exciting new challenges in Just Find It 4!
70010000093889.description:
As you progress through the exciting new levels, you can expect many new scenes and minigames. 
Spend hours exploring the game and solving its difficult puzzles. 

As you make your way through each level, your abilities and attention to detail will be put to the test!

- Play 7 kinds of games!
- Search for bonus collectibles and extra hidden object challenges!
- Make matches, find details, memory, montage, and swap tiles, too!
- Play through the game in any order you want!
- 10 extra bonus levels!

70010000093897.name: TONGTONG
70010000093897.intro:
The legendary "TONGTONG" returns!
A fun animal matching game anyone can understand instantly!
70010000093897.description:
"TONGTONG" is a store-front arcade game developed in 1987.
Packed with adorable animal characters!
Win by matching 3 or more of your chosen animals on the screen!

Supports rankings—aim for the high score!

70010000093902.name: Choice of Life: Wild Islands
70010000093902.intro: Build your life or accept the inevitable - the choice is yours!
70010000093902.description:
You are a simple sailor caught in a storm on your first voyage. The ship is wrecked on the reef, the whole crew is dead, and only you are thrown ashore on a deserted island. Do you have any other choice but to try to survive? Find out in the sequel to the visual novel card game “Choice of Life: Wild Islands”!  

Conquer the jungle and prove that even in the most desperate situation you are the master of your destiny!  

It's up to you whether you're a hard worker or a hedonist, taking everything nature has to offer. Do you want to build a civilization in the wild forest, all alone, or face death face to face while enjoying life?  
Decide how to explore the island. Save your supplies or spend them recklessly. Fight the forest beasts in bloody battles or try to tame them and live in harmony. 
 It's up to you! Leave the island or make it your new home!  

But be careful - every choice you make could cost you your life, and maybe not only your life...  

Key Features:  
★ A non-linear story where every choice can have unpredictable consequences. Betray a friend in Act 1? Watch it haunt you 10 hours later.
★ 300+ Branching Decisions: Steal a canoe, ally with pirates, or adopt a venomous pet parrot. Every action reshapes the story.
★ A thousand events and a bottle of rum! Or rather, a multiple ways to die....

70010000093907.name: Little Red Riding Hood: Endless Zoom Tale
70010000093907.intro: Little Red Riding Hood goes through the forest to see her grandmother, but a wolf is stalking her... What will happen?
70010000093907.description:
Go into the forest with Little Red Riding Hood and experience a story full of excitement! 

Little Red Riding Hood is a cheerful and curious little girl who one day receives an important mission: to take food to her sick grandmother. With her red cape and her basket full of food, she sets off through the forest, without imagining that someone is watching her with great interest...

On her walk, she meets a cunning and talkative wolf who entertains her with questions and suggestions. What will happen when Little Red Riding Hood arrives at her grandmother's house? Will everything be as she expects it to be?

A classic tale that has captivated generations, full of teachings, surprises and a touch of suspense, find out why this story is still a favourite with young and old alike!

70010000093909.name: Plantera 2: Golden Acorn
70010000093909.intro: Build the pixelated garden of your dreams
70010000093909.description:
The round blue Mellows return to tend to the garden once more. Grow the big magical oak tree that has been rumored to have placed its seed there. Build up your garden around the tree to attract Mellows, round blue creatures that will help you pick up things and harvest your plants.

Tend to the magical tree and harvest its golden acorns. Grow your garden from a small vegetable patch into a sprawling sanctuary of plants, vegetables, bushes, trees, cute animals and creatures.

Start with nothing more than a small flat plot of land and a few vegetable crops to harvest for money. You must buy additional crops and gain experience and money to level up your garden and unlock new and more advanced crops and items.

If you want you can pluck trees and harvest plants yourself, or let your Mellows do the work for you. The Mellows will even continue to work and tend to the garden while you are not playing the game.

Adorn the garden how you see fit with a collection of decorations including a variety of flowers, mushrooms and water plants.

As you play you will unlock new items and as you continue to expand and improve your garden your magic oak tree will grow ever bigger with it, soon reaching its crown to the sky and beyond and maybe even discover its secrets.


Features
* Relaxing gardening simulator gameplay
* Grow beautiful plants
* Defend your garden from predators
* Bubbly pixel art
* Create your perfect garden
* Level up and Unlock New Crops and Animals

70010000093911.name: SPACE TRUCK SIMULATOR
70010000093911.intro: The road is gone, but the journey continues—space trucking begins now!
70010000093911.description:
Embark on an exhilarating spacefaring adventure with Space Truck Simulator! Immerse yourself in the role of an interstellar trucker, piloting your rocket-powered rig across the vast expanse of the galaxy. Haul valuable cargo, scavenge for precious salvage, and navigate the unique challenges of deep space. With a blend of sci-fi excitement and trucking simulation, this game offers a rich and engaging experience that combines the thrill of cosmic exploration with the precision of cargo management.
  In Space Truck Simulator, you'll explore diverse planetary systems, interact with a colorful array of star-hopping truckers, and tackle missions that range from routine deliveries to perilous drop-offs.
  Prepare for an adventure where every trip is a new challenge and every star system holds a new opportunity.
Key Features:
- Cruise the Galactic Highways
Take on a range of missions, from fuel-hungry long hauls to hazardous drop-offs. Earn cash and unlock new upgrades while interacting with a diverse cast of star-hopping truckers.
- Manage and Maintain Your Rig
Keep your truck running smoothly by managing essential systems. Make regular shop stops for repairs, and consider upgrading your rig to enhance performance. Proper maintenance of your gravity compensator and hull is crucial for navigating volatile sectors and ensuring timely deliveries.
- Hyperjump Through the Stars
Plan your interstellar routes using the galactic map, and make strategic warp jumps to save time and fuel.
- Immersive Space Trucking Experience
Dive into a detailed and engaging universe with complex systems and challenges. 
Space Truck Simulator delivers a rich space trucking adventure, blending realistic mechanics with sci-fi thrills for an unforgettable journey through the stars.

70010000093919.name: Sky Revolver
70010000093919.intro: Retro vertical shooter. Fight the Empire—breach waves, destroy bosses, upgrade with salvage. Strategic, skill-driven combat.
70010000093919.description:
Take control of the last remaining fighter in the war against the Empire. In this classic vertical-scroll shoot ’em up, you must break through enemy squadrons and destroy the fleet’s command to turn the tide of battle.

Key Features:
● Masterful Maneuvering – Evade relentless enemy fire using advanced piloting techniques.
● Deep Customization System – Combine salvaged components to create unique fighter builds.
● Diverse Enemy Forces – Adapt your tactics to everything from agile scouts to armored battleships.
● Epic Boss Battles – Face colossal multi-phase showdowns against giant warships, each with unique weapons and combat strategies.

Every mission tests your skill and demands strategic planning for upgrades, blending reflexes with long-term tactics.

70010000093924.name: Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver
70010000093924.intro: Your Truck, Your Style—Drive, and Conquer the Highways!
70010000093924.description:
Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver invites you to an exciting adventure on the roads of America, progressing through levels set in diverse locations — from industrial zones to quiet suburbs and the bustling city center. From hauling cargo across diverse landscapes to managing your trucking business, this game brings the thrill of the road to life. Your task is to deliver goods on time, improving your driving skills and upgrading your trucks as you go.

Features:
• Diverse levels — Explore unique locations such as industrial areas, suburbs, and a bustling city center, each offering its own challenges.
• External truck customization — Create a unique style for your truck by changing headlights, bumpers, wheels, and more.
• Interior cabin customization — Personalize the cabin’s interior by upgrading dashboards, steering wheels, GPS, and other elements.
• Detailed performance upgrades — Enhance your truck’s performance by upgrading the engine, suspension, and transmission.
• Variety of missions — Complete delivery contracts while handling challenges in different conditions and locations.

Feel like a true professional truck driver as you explore American cities and customize your truck for any challenge! Create a vehicle that reflects your style and improves performance on the road.Load up your truck and start your journey today!

70010000093929.name: Slide Defenders
70010000093929.description:
Live the life of a secret agent and feel the rush of non-stop action! Be ready to jump out of windows, grab onto wires and eliminate enemies. High-speed adventure awaits!

Be fast and don't let anyone shoot you. Be accurate and send your enemies to their grandfathers as quickly as possible. No time to look around. You are on a mission! Slide, shoot, win, repeat. The pattern is clear. Just follow the right steps. 

Clear each level you enter. It's not as easy as you think - you're moving fast and the enemies are all around you.

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

To slide and to attack!

70010000093934.name: Crowd Fighters
70010000093934.intro: Call out the heroes and defend your fortress!
70010000093934.description:
Your castle is attacked and you have to keep it safe. Face the battle, summon the bravest heroes and become the greatest defender of all time! 

Call upon all your mighty warriors to stand tall against the danger. The enemies are countless, but you are the greatest warlord. There is no time to retreat! Attack with all your might to crush the enemy armies. Choose wisely which hero to summon to the battlefield. 

Seize your chance and not only protect your home - attack and destroy the enemy's castle. Show no mercy. It was their choice to start this mess.    

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Defend at all the costs!

70010000093939.name: Race Track Maniacs
70010000093939.description:
Experience racing like never before! Feel the adrenaline as you race through the best tracks, mastering every turn and straightaway with precision. It's not just about speed - it's about control and strategy. 

Navigate sharp turns, push your limits, and feel the rush of high-speed competition. The racetrack is your playground - conquer it, own it, and become a true racing champion!

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Pedal to the metal and fear nothing!

70010000093944.name: Passion Puzzle: Hentai Maidens!
70010000093944.intro: Мove the animated polygonal pieces to collect charming girls. Solve puzzles, and enjoy high-quality animations!
70010000093944.description:
Welcome to Passion Puzzle - the best puzzle game ever made!
Get ready for an awesome time in Passion Puzzle, where you'll solve puzzles with cute girls! Are you ready to have fun?

Original Gameplay Mechanics
Unlike all other jigsaw puzzle games, Passion Puzzle features original polygonal mechanics: assemble animated hot girls from various polyhedral figures.

High-Resolution Animations to Enjoy
As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter new and more intricate puzzles that will test your skills and keep you engaged. With a variety of detailed animated artworks to discover, leave all your worries behind and immerse yourself in the beautiful world of Passion Puzzle. Enjoy stunning animations of hot girls!

Key Features:
• Vibrant Art: Enjoy stunning visuals featuring a colorful cast of characters.
• PvP Mode (Hotseat): Play with your friends! Work together to complete puzzles and enjoy a fun cooperative experience.
• Engaging Puzzles: Test your puzzle-solving skills with a wide variety of levels.
• Simple Gameplay: Passion Puzzle's intuitive gameplay ensures that even those new to the genre will feel right at home.
• Relaxing Music: Immerse yourself in the soothing soundtrack that perfectly complements the charming atmosphere of Passion Puzzle, helping you unwind and focus on solving the puzzles.

Start Your Awesome Puzzle Adventure Now!
Don't miss out on the most fun and addictive puzzle game! Jump into Passion Puzzle and start your amazing adventure today!

70010000093949.name: ROGOLF
70010000093949.intro: Play mini-golf, buy equipment and score enough points to reach the top. Each level has it’s own rules and each game is different.
70010000093949.description:
You are hired as a mini-golf level tester by the french company ROGOLF. Management will always expect big quality scores from your golfing skills... 
Thanks to the help of the Smuggler, cheat your way through the floors of this strange office building, or get fired trying to !
Bonuses you buy will grant you access to secret rooms, rule-breaking cards and make your score explode !
In need of a day off ? Try the "Team Building" multiplayer game mode, and play locally with up to 4 players.

70010000093956.name: Illusion of Itehari
70010000093956.description:
A love story from the beautiful and ephemeral world of the mechanical floating utopia.

In Itehari, the renowned and prosperous flying city, Hinagiku longs to explore the world beyond.

One day, Hinagiku, encounters an amnesiac man named Yashiro.
Their chance meeting drags her into a series of events involving the secrets and various truths hidden beneath the surface of Itehari... for this garden city in the sky is a false utopia.

70010000093964.name: Hentai Sexy Girls : Splashes and Water
70010000093964.intro: Solve the puzzle, reveal the beauty!
70010000093964.description:
Hentai Sexy Girls: Splashes and Water is an exciting and seductive puzzle game that challenges your mind while rewarding you with stunning artwork.
With 41 levels to complete, players can enjoy three distinct puzzle types:
	•	Logic Puzzles – Test your reasoning and problem-solving skills.
	•	Mosaic Puzzles – Assemble scattered pieces to reveal breathtaking images.
	•	Classic Puzzles – Rearrange fragments to form the full picture.

To cater to players of all skill levels, the game offers four difficulty modes:
	•	Elementary – A relaxed experience for beginners.
	•	Average – A moderate challenge for casual players.
	•	Advanced – A tougher test for puzzle enthusiasts.
	•	Expert – Only for the most skilled and dedicated players!

Immerse yourself in a world of beauty, challenge, and satisfaction as you unlock increasingly intricate puzzles featuring captivating artwork. Are you ready to take on the challenge?

You will meet charming and sensual girls, each with a unique appearance, style, and mood. Their striking looks create an atmosphere of temptation and elegance, motivating you to solve all the puzzles to the end.
	•	A Variety of Beauties – The game features girls with different looks: cute, femme fatales, gentle, and bold seductresses. Each one is waiting for you to unveil her image!
	•	Alluring Outfits – Enjoy girls in wet t-shirts, lace lingerie, and playful costumes.
	•	Their appearances are enhanced by water droplets, creating a stunning and sensual effect.
	•	Water and Relaxation Atmosphere – All the girls are in a refreshing setting.
	•	Seductive Poses – Each image is filled with playful, passionate, and tender moments.

Solve puzzles to enjoy alluring scenes, uncover each girl’s secrets, and dive into a true world of pleasure and beauty!

70010000093969.name: Unboxing: Cozy Home Simulator
70010000093969.intro: Unwrap the comfort of your dream home!
70010000093969.description:
Step into a world where every corner is filled with warmth and comfort. Unpack, organize, and design your dream home with soft, cozy vibes. Carefully place each piece of furniture, from fluffy couches to soft rugs, and watch your space come to life. Add personal touches like candles, plants, and blankets to create a truly inviting atmosphere. 

Relax in your peaceful sanctuary, where each room is a reflection of your style and personality. 
Whether you’re unwinding in a cozy nook or hosting a relaxed gathering, your home will feel like the ultimate retreat.

70010000093974.name: What have you done, father?
70010000093974.intro: A dark narrative thriller set in the 1940s. Sin, secrets, and shadows lurk in the halls of the rectory.
70010000093974.description:
Play as Father Mathias Marton, a revered priest trapped in a web of forbidden desires and sinister events. Uncover the mysteries of a corrupt rectory, confront your own demons, and walk the blurred line between sin and salvation.
AN ENTHRALLING MYSTERY
Who was she? Why does her presence still linger? How did it all come to this? Why did you taste the forbidden fruit? And above all: WHAT HAVE YOU DONE, FATHER?
AN IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE
Embark on a brief but deeply captivating narrative journey that blends exploration, cinematics, light puzzles, and gripping dialogue.
• EXPLORE THE ENIGMATIC RECTORY
Uncover the layers of a disturbing story as you roam the shadowed halls. Will you leave a stain, or redeem its corrupted legacy?
• MEET QUESTIONABLE CHARACTERS AND UNCOVER THEIR SECRETS
Speak with the mysterious residents of the rectory and delve into their pasts through diary entries and hidden notes.
• FACE UNHOLY MANIFESTATIONS
Brace yourself as you grapple with the tangible and the supernatural in equal measure.
• DISCOVER OPTIONAL CONTENT
Hidden throughout the rectory are titillating magazines — you'll be surprised by the secrets they hold! Uncover the turbulent history of the rectory by finding old photographs of former priests along with the stories of their lives.
Will you emerge purified, or succumb to the shadows lurking within? Explore this atmospheric tale and uncover the truth hidden beneath the collar. Your path to redemption awaits.

70010000093985.name: Higgs Boson: Puzzle Collection
70010000093985.intro: Think in angles. Solve in seconds.
70010000093985.description:
Higgs Boson Collection is a trilogy of brain-bending puzzle games where every rotation counts and every second matters. Your mission? Guide mysterious spheres through a precise network of pathways — but there's a twist: you don’t move the spheres… you rotate the world around them.

Across three distinct games, you’ll dive into increasingly mind-challenging scenarios:

Minimal Puzzle – The calm before the storm. This minimalist experience eases you into the core mechanics. Rotate shapes. Match paths. Watch spheres align. Some shapes are linked — turn one, and others follow. It’s simple… until it’s not.

Challenging Puzzle – Planning becomes essential. Here, every move is precious. Rotate too many times and the level resets. Think ahead. Visualize your solution. Be efficient. This is where the puzzle starts to fight back.

Timed Puzzle – The clock is ticking. Instead of counting moves, you’re racing against time. Some figures rotate, others slide — and if time runs out, it’s game over. Quick thinking and sharp reflexes are your best allies.

With sleek visuals, ambient gradient backgrounds, and zero distractions, the focus stays where it belongs — on the puzzle. Each level ramps up the difficulty, pushing your logic, memory, and speed to their limits. Whether you’re a casual thinker or a hardcore strategist, Higgs Boson Collection invites you to think differently.

70010000093990.name: No Sweet Looks
70010000093990.intro: Trapped on the dark, never-ending and nightmarish islands. Nothing but ocean in every direction, and monsters eyeing you down everywhere you go!
70010000093990.description:
Wake up at The Gateway, confront the mirrors, and close the 6 eyes of the demons keeping you imprisoned! This is a fast paced rouge-like shooter, with a combat system that forces every bullet and move to matter. 

In this game, shooting is based on a turn timer which you can influence. Every time you dash, or kill enemies the turn timer will move faster. Playing fast and reckless will allow you too attack very fast, but careful not to be too reckless! Missing bullets will slow down your timer. 

In order to face a demon, you will need to clear 3 randomly generated islands. Which are guarded by monsters. Survive islands with the help of perks and upgrades. These will help you become more and more powerful the further you get. With infinitely stacking perks and your own skills, the monsters will have a hard time stopping you!

70010000094001.name: SHADOWFRAME
70010000094001.intro: Freeze time. Analyze the battlefield. Then make your move. In SHADOWFRAME, reflexes alone won’t save you — you’ll need precision, patience, and planning to survive.
70010000094001.description:
Experience intense, tactical FPS action like never before in SHADOWFRAME — a unique black-and-white shooter where every movement rewrites time itself.

Whether you're dodging bullets in slow motion or plotting the perfect takedown, SHADOWFRAME turns every step into a strategic decision.

Features:
Freeze Time, Master Combat: Time stands still until you move. Think fast, move smart, and outmaneuver enemies in a world where every second counts.
Campaign Mode: Fight against the clock through 15 stylish, handcrafted levels.
Endless Survival: Face never-ending waves of enemies. How long can you survive?
Striking Visual Style: Play in a bold black-and-white world where shadows reveal danger and movement brings it to life.

SHADOWFRAME brings stylish, slow-motion combat - perfect for players who love a twist on classic FPS gameplay.

Move with purpose. Shoot with precision. Survive in the shadows.

70010000094011.name: EGGCONSOLE WANDERERS FROM Ys MSX2
70010000094011.intro: The third installment of "Ys" with even more action-packed elements! Two years after the Ys adventure. Save Dogi's hometown, Felghana, from the clutches of evil!
70010000094011.description:
This is an action RPG released in Japan by Nihon Falcom in 1989. The subtitle 'WANDERERS FROM Ys' marks this installment as an ambitious project that incorporates new elements. The perspective has shifted from a 'half-top view' to a 'side view,' and the method of attack has changed from physical collisions to swinging a sword, allowing for a variety of actions.

Furthermore, magic serves merely as a complement to combat and the outcome of battles relies on the player's skill. Adol's growth can be seen as a testament to one's own improvement.

Of course, the concept of the Ys series as "RPGs enjoyable for everyone" remains intact. Alongside its engaging storyline, the game features beautiful background visuals with "multi-scrolling" and lively music, making it a finely crafted masterpiece down to the smallest details.

*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000094017.name: World At War: Normandy
70010000094017.intro: Nintendo Switch™ Exclusive! Experience the gritty realism and overwhelming graphics of open battlefield brutality! Head to the bloody battlefield of Normandy!
70010000094017.description:
On a vast, open field, the curtain rises on a brutal history! Experience historic battlefields brought to life with stunning realism and high-definition graphics! Set in World War II, this FPS game features photo-realistic visuals that will satisfy military enthusiasts. 
Team up with allies using different weapon classes: Assault, Support and Sniper! Master precision aiming and control to complete missions in multiple game modes. Progress through the battlefields on your way to victory.
D-Day and Operation Overlord, events that changed the course of history, unfold at your fingertips amidst the brutal, bullet-ridden war zone!
Immerse yourself in the ultimate FPS that combines intense combat with fierce strategy!

・Stunning graphics bring every grain of sand and wave to life on the beaches of Normandy.
・Join the Allied forces and carry out crucial missions on D-Day.
・Immersive 3D sound and physics engine deliver unparalleled realism.
・Photorealistic visuals capture the light and shadows of intense battlefields.
・Take cover behind burning tanks and destroyed fortifications for authentic combat.
・Choose from three strategic roles: Assault, Support, or Sniper.
・Master precise aiming and streamlined mechanics for realistic gunplay.
・Collaborate with your allies for exciting cooperative action.

Lead your comrades to victory in historic World War II battles!
Experience combat realism that will thrill military enthusiasts!
Enjoy precise gunplay that shines in tense moments!
Immerse yourself in stunning graphics and rich 3D effects that bring the world war to life.
Immerse yourself in the most realistic WWII FPS "World At War: Normandy" on Nintendo Switch™!

Synopsis
On 6 June 1944, Omaha Beach witnessed the fiercest battle of the Normandy landings. This 6-mile stretch of coastline, surrounded by 100-foot cliffs, housed formidable German defences. At 6.30am, soldiers from the US 1st and 29th Infantry Divisions began their assault. They encountered fierce German resistance. Many died before leaving their landing craft, while those who reached the beach faced relentless enemy fire.

The coastline was mined and covered with barbed wire, forcing troops to cross 200-300 yards of dangerous sand. German forces decimated landing craft and armoured vehicles with 88mm anti-tank guns and 75mm field guns. Snipers in hidden cliff positions targeted American officers and radio operators, while mortar teams unleashed a constant barrage.

Still, small groups of brave soldiers tried to break through the hail of bullets. Their courage offered hope against a potentially catastrophic failure. Although heavy casualties were expected, the Allies were able to secure a crucial foothold.
A historic battle that could be the turning point of the Second World War is about to begin.

70010000094023.name: Rally Arcade Classics
70010000094023.intro: Play and enjoy this rally - now more classic, more arcade than ever!
70010000094023.description: Rev up your engines, it’s almost time to race back to the past with Rally Arcade Classics! Including 44 iconic cars from the 70’s, 80’s, 90’s and 00’s, and 48 thrilling tracks to rev up their engines to the max while drifting every close turn, you will never run out of challenges to take upon.

70010000094026.name: Attack Hole
70010000094026.intro: Swallow everything and become the biggest black hole!
70010000094026.description:
Eat whatever is in your path! Move fast, absorb everything in sight, and grow BIGGER! Grab as many weapons as you can before time runs out, then blast away your final target. The bigger your hole, the more powerful you become!

Pick a cool skin, zoom through fun levels, and see if you can swallow it all before the clock hits zero!

Features:
- Exciting levels packed with stuff to gobble up
- Animated skins to make your black hole look awesome
- Crazy power-ups to help you grow even faster
- Challenge mode where you consume a whole town
- Epic battles against huge bosses
- Easy controls so anyone can play
- Simple rules and tons of fun!

Ready, set, SWALLOW! How much can you eat before time runs out?

70010000094028.name: BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE
70010000094028.intro: Experience the EVOLUTION of Xtreme Battle!
70010000094028.description:
The BEYBLADE ACTION game that faithfully recreates the world of BEYBLADE X arrives with three powerful evolutions! Witness EVOBATTLE, EVOSTORY, and EVOCUSTOMIZE!

■ Evolution 1: EVOBATTLE
Your strategy changes dramatically depending on your Bey type. Attack Type specializes in offense, Stamina Type absorbs the opponent’s stamina, Defense Type activates shields for solid protection, and Balance Type boosts attack power through combos! Experience thrilling high-speed Battles that demand skill and precision! Challenge Bladers around the world in online matches!

■ Evolution 2: EVOSTORY
New allies await—compete, grow, and chase your dreams together in the ultimate BEY BATTLE ROYALE (BBR)!

■ Evolution 3: EVOCUSTOMIZE
Customization reaches new heights! Collect materials to coat your Beys in your favorite colors, enhance your favorite parts, and choose X Skills to create the perfect Beys for your Battle style!

70010000094032.name: So Much Stuff 4: Bits and Bobs Collector's Edition
70010000094032.intro: Uncover an abundance of new stuff in this exciting sequel!
70010000094032.description:
Unearth hidden treasures and charms amidst beautifully themed scenes like a '70s scrapbook, Street Art, Model Trains, Woodcarving, and more! 
Dive into various engaging mini-games and collect charming trinkets as you rediscover the fun of finding so much stuff! 
Relax, have fun, and sort through the delightful chaos of So Much Stuff 4: Bits and Bobs!

- Play over 100 puzzle games!
- Collector's Edition includes 8 extra themes
- Make gameplay simpler with Help and Hint functions!

70010000094036.name: Car Stunt Hero Simulator 2025
70010000094036.intro: Race, jump, and become the ultimate stunt legend!
70010000094036.description:
Car Stunt Hero Simulator 2025 puts you behind the wheel of the world’s most thrilling rides—sports cars, racing beasts, classic legends, and high-speed machines. Step into the driver’s seat and prove yourself as the ultimate stunt hero!
Perform breathtaking flips, daring jumps, and gravity-defying stunts on vertical and horizontal ramps. Conquer impossible tracks in stunning 3D environments, from urban skylines to massive stunt arenas.
Every mission is a new challenge—push your speed to the limit, master precision driving, and unlock rewards as you rise to the top of racing greatness. With smooth controls, realistic car handling, and multiple environments to explore, every race feels more intense than the last.

Key Features:
- Huge variety of cars: sports, racing, classic, and police models
- Extreme stunt tracks with vertical ramps, loops, and impossible paths
- Dynamic environments with multiple challenges
- Realistic speed, handling, and acceleration controls
- Rewards and unlockables for every victory

Download now and show the world you’re the true Car Stunt Hero!

70010000094041.name: Neko Bakery
70010000094041.intro: The ultimate cat-baker puzzle is served – fresh and purr-fectly sweet!
70010000094041.description:
Meet the fluffiest chef in town – a whiskered wonder who’s baking up a storm and needs YOU to pack up his pastry masterpieces! Sounds easy? Try cramming mountains of cupcakes, cakes, and fish-shaped treats into boxes that are waaay too small! Can your puzzle skills handle the sugar rush?

Why you’ll love it:

- 90+ brain-tickling bakery box levels!
- 29 drool-worthy treats to stack, squish, and squeeze in!
- Sweet tunes: chill lo-fi or jazzy café vibes!
- Art so cute it might make you meow.
- And of course – the pawsitively charming cat-baker!


Each box is a new paw-some puzzle that’ll twist your brain like a pretzel. Warning: side effects may include uncontrollable smiling and sudden pastry cravings!


Oh, and if you figure out how the cat didn’t eat everything before you showed up… tell us. We’re still investigating.

Get ready to puzzle, pack and purr. Just don’t eat all the pastries... yet.

70010000094046.name: Internet Club & Cafe Simulator
70010000094046.intro: The ultimate internet café simulation—grow your business, attract gamers, and get rich!
70010000094046.description:
Step into the world of Internet Club & Café Simulator where your goal is about creating a thriving, high-tech haven! From humble beginnings, build and manage the ultimate internet café by strategically upgrading everything from computers to furniture. But beware—the digital world can be a dangerous place, and you must stay vigilant against theft and hackers.
Key Features:
- Customize and Build – Start small and grow your café with state-of-the-art tech, sleek furniture, and the perfect décor. Tailor every detail to create a unique atmosphere for your customers.
- Protect Your Business – Keep your café safe from thieves and rival competitors. Build a secure network and monitor your café’s security to avoid losing valuable equipment and data.
- Upgrade and Renew – Constantly refresh your café by purchasing new computers, accessories, and furniture. Stay ahead of trends to keep your customers coming back for more!
- Tech Innovation – Offer the latest in gaming and internet technology, from powerful PCs to immersive systems. The better the tech, the more customers you’ll attract!
- Resource Management – Balance your budget carefully and invest wisely to maximize profits and keep your café running smoothly. Customer satisfaction is key—keep them happy, and they’ll bring in steady cash flow!
Can You Create the Ultimate Café?
Manage your resources, upgrade your tech, and safeguard your café from theft and sabotage. Your café's success depends on your ability to stay one step ahead—will you become the owner of the trendiest internet café in town?

70010000094051.name: Forest Cafe
70010000094051.intro: Try your hand at building and running the cutest Forest Cafe!
70010000094051.description:
It's time to take care of cute animals and build a cozy cafe for them in a forest clearing. Get everything ready for the reception. Add various tasty dishes and drinks to the menu. 

Set the work so that no one has to wait in line for too long, or the animals will get upset. Hire and train staff. Make your cafe the most popular in the forest!  

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Get ready to meet your little friends at the Forest Café.

70010000094056.name: Skull Pirates: Adventures
70010000094056.intro: Captain, set sail and explore the rough and tumble seas!
70010000094056.description:
Ahoy, buddy! Get ready for an exciting adventure! Board your pirate ship to explore mysterious islands and find hidden treasures. But beware! Dangerous torpedoes from enemy submarines and rival pirates are out to sink your ship.

You are the captain trying to find your way to new islands. Customize your ship, navigate the deep waters, and face all the challenges of the pirate life. Use your skills to stay alive as long as possible and collect trophies for your skills.

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Are you ready to become the most feared pirate on the high seas?

70010000094066.name: Angry Battalion
70010000094066.intro: Gather your angry team and attack!
70010000094066.description:
The secret of victory is teamwork. Every soldier is important in choosing the winning tactics. Only the right team will ensure your success!  

Choose when and where to land your soldiers to quickly advance on enemy defences. Control everything that happens on the battlefield and send reinforcements to the weakest points. You are in command of your battalion and the success of the battle depends on your decisions. 

Release each soldier onto the field at the right time and place. Watch carefully as the battle progresses. It may be necessary to wait and send a more powerful soldier into battle. Your decisions are very important, so don't waste your resources and manage your soldiers wisely. 

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

One for all and all for one!

70010000094071.name: Colorama Cubes
70010000094071.intro: Try your hand at a unique spatial puzzle game
70010000094071.description: Don't hurry. Just look at the board, try to find the best paths and solve each puzzle!

70010000094076.name: Colorizing: Sunrise
70010000094076.intro: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation
70010000094076.description:
This coloring book is a guarantee of good mood.
In it you can find all kinds of pictures for every taste.
Coloring by numbers with Colorizing is a calming and easy activity for people of all ages. 
This drawing game is suitable for children and adults, everyone can enjoy pixel coloring.
You will definitely love coloring with this beautiful coloring book!

70010000094079.name: WW2 Soldiers of Honor - Warzone Assault
70010000094079.intro: Honor is forged in battle—fight, survive, prevail!
70010000094079.description:
Dive into the chaos of World War II and fight for honor in WW2 Soldiers of Honor - Warzone Assault, an intense, action-packed FPS shooter!

Play as a skilled soldier and take on perilous missions against enemy forces. Sabotage enemy strongholds, dismantle vital war infrastructure, and reclaim key territories in a campaign filled with thrilling encounters.

Key Features:

– Immersive Campaign: Experience 4 challenging missions + 1 special operation, each with unique objectives and meticulously designed battlefields.

– Authentic Combat: Wield a diverse arsenal of historically accurate military weapons and tactical gear.

– Strategic Warfare: Infiltrate enemy bases, set demolitions, and utilize battlefield tactics to outmaneuver opponents.

– Dynamic Environments: Battle across war-torn cities, dense forests, and heavily fortified compounds.


– Hidden Relics: Uncover secret war artifacts that reveal untold stories from the front lines.

Prepare to engage in the ultimate World War II combat experience. Are you ready to answer the call and make history? WW2 Soldiers of Honor - Warzone Assault awaits!

70010000094086.name: MOMIBOSU
70010000094086.intro: A boy and a girl with a mysterious weapon drone in their hands embark on an adventurous journey from their small underground village to the vast world of new lands.
70010000094086.description:
〇 Simple Controls, Deep Gameplay!
The core actions are attack, jump, and air dash.
Mastering 8-directional attacks and air dashes—up, down, left, right, and diagonals—is the key to overcoming challenges!

〇 Impenetrable Dungeons
A high-difficulty platformer that can't be cleared without skillfully using the basic actions awaits your challenge!

〇 Terrifying Bosses
Powerful bosses await deep within the dungeons.
Enjoy intense parry-based combat during boss fights!
Even if you fall, rise again and keep fighting!

〇 A Boy and Girl’s Adventure
A brave boy and girl journey through a dangerous world in search of a new land.
Will there be hope at the end of the many meetings and farewells, joys and sorrows they experience?
See the answer for yourself!

We welcome all action gamers confident in their skills!

70010000094091.name: Out of Sight
70010000094091.intro: Out of Sight is a deeply atmospheric horror game that blends first and second-person perspectives with riveting voice-acting to immerse you in a chilling and emotional j
70010000094091.description:
The world from a new perspective
Having regained sight through her beloved Teddy, Sophie knows she must find a way out before it’s too late. Danger lurks around every corner—one misplaced step, a creaking floorboard, or unexpected bump could spell capture… and an uncertain fate.

Without sight, but not without hope
Rely on your wits and instincts to overcome the many challenges of the mansion. With only your courage and Teddy to guide you, survival is in your hands.

A Mansion of Secrets
Piece together the chilling story buried within the mansion’s walls. Unravel its tragic past and uncover the events that turned it into a place of nightmares.

Psychological Discomfort
Not all is as it seems. The line between reality and illusion is razor-thin, and your senses may betray you.

Survival Above All
Avoid your relentless captors and uncover the secrets of your capture. Will you discover the truth and break free, or become a lost soul trapped forever?

70010000094096.name: Warriors Waifus Mahjong
70010000094096.intro: Quick thinking and strategic skill will earn you victory.
70010000094096.description:
Mahjong meets ancient combat!

In Warriors Waifus Mahjong, you’ll face off against legendary female warriors from across time and cultures! Each level pits you against one of these fierce fighters in a unique Mahjong puzzle battle. With 60 levels of intense gameplay, your strategic skills and quick thinking will be tested as you race against the clock.

Fail to complete the puzzle before time runs out, and you’ll be the laughingstock of the ancient world…


Features:

* Matching 3 gameplay (mahjong)
* Beautiful pixel art
* HD artwork of the warriors to unlock
* 60 levels
* Image gallery
* 6 different waifus
* Orchestral Soundtrack

70010000094102.name: Solid Void - Nature Puzzles
70010000094102.intro:
Challenge your mind and creativity!
Solve beautiful puzzles!
Experience a journey of logic and design!
70010000094102.description:
Immerse yourself in Solid Void, a unique puzzle experience that merges two classic puzzle styles into one addictive journey. Start by solving intricate nonogram puzzles to complete the grid. Once your grid is complete, take the challenge to the next level by placing pentomino-like blocks to complete beautiful designs.

With its tranquil aesthetic, intuitive mechanics, and brain-bending puzzles, Solid Void offers many hours of rewarding gameplay. Whether you're a puzzle veteran or a casual gamer, this game promises to captivate your mind, spark your creativity, and leave you with breathtaking visual creations.

Can you master the Solid Void and bring nature's beauty to life?

70010000094104.name: Kart Racing Star Simulator Game
70010000094104.intro:
Race, drift, and speed past the competition.
Master every track with skill and strategy.
Become the ultimate kart racing champion.
70010000094104.description:
Get ready for the ultimate kart racing adventure in Kart Racing Star Simulator Game! Race against skilled opponents, drift through exciting tracks, and collect powerful boosts to stay ahead of the competition. Master your driving skills, avoid obstacles, and speed your way to victory in this action-packed arcade racing experience!

Why You'll Love It:
 Fast-Paced Racing – Compete in thrilling races filled with speed and excitement.
 Awesome Power-Ups – Use boosters and special items to gain the edge over your rivals.
 Unique Drivers – Choose from a variety of fun and quirky racers.
 Challenging Obstacles – Test your reflexes as you dodge tricky obstacles.
 Endless Fun – Play again and again with exciting objectives to complete.

Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate kart racing champion? Jump into the action and prove your skills now!

70010000094119.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Ganghwa-do
70010000094119.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000094119.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Ganghwa-do, Korea with "Real" footage! 
This work takes place in Ganghwa-do. 
There are a total of 5 flight courses. 
1080P high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to 5 locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Ganghwa-do, Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000094129.name: Planeta 55
70010000094129.intro: Planeta 55 is a horror-themed fast action sci-fi FPS Hordes of monsters. New weaponry. Guns. Blood. Fight.
70010000094129.description:
Planeta 55 is a horror-themed fast action sci-fi FPS.

Dalgis finds himself trapped in a prison, somewhere in the vast space of stars, planets, dangers and horrors. He only wants one thing. To fight.
Luckily, Aura finds him chained up and sets him free. Aura is from Planeta 55 and she needs help.

"Is that your wish?"
The road towards Planeta 55 begins. Hordes of monsters. New weaponry. Guns. Blood. Fight.

The fast action and story driven game features brutal first person gameplay, offering the player multiple weapons, big variety of enemies, bosses, a story of the sci-fi realm, challenge after challenge, characters, and lots of satisfying FPS bloody gun-play.

Play as Dalgis, follow your liberator Aura, explore multiple planets where you find new guns that allow you to combat anyone in your way in a variety of ways, challenge the bosses that stand against you, and save Aura with Planeta 55.

70010000094134.name: DREAMOUT
70010000094134.intro: Explore a surreal world with a cute alpaca! Solve puzzles, fish out the most unusual items from rivers, fight watermelon thugs, and uncover all the secrets of this world!
70010000094134.description:
Key Features:
- Over 40 crazy quests. Some may seem very strange; you never know what to expect.
- Find all 30 funny hats.
- Throw bombs into portals, blow up rocks, and incinerate your enemies!
- A carrot man? Drunken butterflies? Or maybe an INFERNAL CHICKEN? Meet all the inhabitants of this world.
- Fish! You can find more than just fish in the rivers.
- Our main heroine is the cutest alpaca!

70010000094148.name: LeMrosh in the Lazy Kingdom
70010000094148.intro: A humorous point-and-click adventure game, full of clever puzzles, quirky characters, and unexpected twists. Get ready for hours of fun, a long journey, a few fairies... and a little love story.
70010000094148.description:
LeMrosh in the Lazy Kingdom is a funny point-and-click adventure game set in a medieval kingdom where nothing is as it seems. What starts out as a simple quest quickly turns into a tangle of puzzles, strange items and quirky characters. Explore, experiment, and talk along the way through a kingdom where even the wrong choices can lead to unexpected (and often hilarious) results - whether you mean to or not.

FEATURES
■ Classic point-and-click adventure game inspired by 90’s legends
■ Over 12 hours of story-driven gameplay with multiple twists
■ Solve clever and unconventional puzzles
■ Explore over 200 unique locations across a strange medieval kingdom
■ Meet a large cast of quirky and memorable characters
■ Full English voiceover across the entire game
■ Unique interactions: most actions trigger custom, often humorous responses
■ Experiment freely - even wrong choices can lead to funny outcomes
■ Clean interface with intuitive actions (examine, use, talk, collect)
■ A lighthearted story with a touch of romance

As LeMrosh says: "Spin it like never before."

If you enjoy classic adventure games, witty humor, and discovering unexpected solutions, LeMrosh in the Lazy Kingdom is waiting.

70010000094152.name: Rise Eterna 2
70010000094152.intro: Strategize, fight tactical battles and shape the destiny of a war-torn kingdom.
70010000094152.description:
Improving on the tactical RPG genre at the core of the first iteration, Rise Eterna 2 places you in the middle of an ongoing war between two families coveting the kingdom’s throne and a third force plotting its last act of revenge.

Set a few years after the events of the first game, play as Jacht – a devoted Athracian soldier on a mission to reclaim the Empire’s lost glory and slay the Destroyer.

Rise Eterna 2 includes:

• 24 missions taking place across various locations and biomes combined with Strategic and Tactical combats challenging your decision-making skills.

• Terrains to use at your advantage! Depending on the type of tile units are standing on, their attacks or movement can be affected in different ways. Always try to catch the enemy at a disadvantage!

• A compelling recruitment and party organization system that lets you test various combinations and strategies at will!

• Gems customization: Choose from over 20 types of gems to enhance your heroes' abilities and weapons.

• Skill trees for each character with multiple factors including their own background affecting their skillset. 

Grow stronger, adapt to new challenges, and unleash your full potential!

70010000094155.name: EGGCONSOLE CRIMSON II PC-8801mkIISR
70010000094155.intro:
Fifty years have passed since Crimson was defeated by the Hero. 
Now, a new darkness looms over the world…
70010000094155.description:
Long ago, three brave heroes, Isabella and Arnold, defeated “Crimson,” the evil force that once ruled this world, bringing peace. Fifty years since that battle, darkness now threatens the world again.

One day, Nopoli’s elder witnessed a sinister falling star, sensing it as a sign of evil’s return. He summoned a young man possessing a mysterious orb, passed down from his father. Accepting his destiny as the Holy Hero (as legend foretold, five heroes with sacred gems would lead to peace), the young man journeyed to find the remaining four and vanquish the rising darkness.

At the same time, the four destined heroes each received their own divine revelations and awaited the arrival of the Holy Hero.

This is a role-playing game released in Japan by XTAL SOFT in 1989. Players become the “Holy Hero,” embarking on an adventure with four companions to defeat a resurrecting evil force. Before the protagonist, players experience prologue chapters for the warrior Gobas, priest Rima, wizard Marlon, and female warrior Natasha. Afterward, the protagonist joins them, forming a party and starting the full adventure.

The game features a top-down view, with encounter-based, command-selection battles. The story spans over ten chapters. While familiar players may notice hidden references, the game is fully enjoyable even without prior experience.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000094158.name: Sunseed Island
70010000094158.intro: Set sail, collect, and restore – cozy vibes, charming creatures, and endless discoveries await!
70010000094158.description:
Welcome to Sunseed Island, the perfect escape for cozy gamers who love to farm, explore, and collect! Rebuild a lost village, befriend magical creatures, grow crops, fish in tranquil waters, and upgrade your tools. Discover the secrets of a mystical tree and reconnect the scattered islands!


Key Features:
- Rebuild & Restore – Help quirky NPCs bring their village back to life.
- Explore Diverse Islands – Travel across five unique biomes full of secrets.
- Complete Themed Exhibitions – Collect insects, fossils, fish, dishes, and plushies for the town hall.
- Upgrade & Expand – Improve your tools to farm, mine, and gather resources more efficiently.
- Relax & Fish – Cast your line and reel in a variety of unique fish.
- Meet Magical NPCs – Each has an animal-like form and a symbol reflecting their role.
- Uncover a Cozy Mystery – Restore the Great Sunseed Tree and reunite the islands.


A long time ago, the islands were united by the Great Sunseed Tree, but when its power faded, the land shattered. Now, it’s up to you to restore the islands, rebuild the village, and uncover hidden magic.

Travel through five stunning biomes, each packed with wildlife, treasures, and secret challenges. Donate insects, fossils, fish, and dishes to themed exhibitions in the town hall and earn adorable plushies for completing NPC quests. Upgrade your tools to gather resources more efficiently and unlock new possibilities.

Meet quirky, magical NPCs, each inspired by real animals and marked with a symbol reflecting their role. Navigate freely, interact seamlessly, and enjoy a stress-free farming adventure!

Set sail for Sunseed Islands and let your cozy journey begin!

70010000094163.name: Missing Banban
70010000094163.intro: Life is always easier with friends. But what if one of them goes missing? Grab your weapon and jump, shoot and dodge in this action-packed side-scroller adventure.
70010000094163.description:
Your friend went missing, and a dark force is looming in this already deranged world. You, Sheriff Toadster, are the only toad that can save him in this intense action-packed side-scroller adventure! Jump around, shoot your way through and investigate the mysterious disappearance, all while exploring the land and meeting the intriguing characters of this universe!

Features:
• BEWARE OF TRAPS - avoid dangers and move with precision to get through the obstacles in your path.
• DON’T STAND STILL - dash, climb walls and jump to conquer this challenging realm.
• AROUND THE WORLD, AROUND THE WORLD - roam through beaches, forests, secret factories and other environments on your journey.
• NEVER BACK DOWN - defeat the enemies to get closer to your friend.
• TAKE YOUR PICK - choose from multiple weapons and special abilities to craft the best strategy.
• FAMILIAR, BUT DIFFERENT - defeat your old friends, now corrupted by sickness. Save them and… Maybe reconcile later?

Additional languages:
- Bulgarian (BG/БЪЛГАРСКИ),
- Czech (CZ/ČEŠTINA),
- Danish (DK/DANSK),
- Finnish (FIN/SUOMI),
- Hungarian (HU/MAGYAR),
- Indonesian (IDN/INDONESIA),
- Norwegian (NOR/NORGE),
- Polish (PL/POLSKI),
- Romanian (ROU/ROMÂNĂ),
- Swedish (SE/SVENSKA),
- Turkish (TUR/TÜRKÇE),
- Ukrainian (UA/УКРАЇНСЬКА).

70010000094168.name: LABYRINTH OF THE DEMON KING
70010000094168.intro: Venture through the Labyrinth Of The Demon King, solving puzzles and fighting fearsome monsters in an epic quest to track down the demon who betrayed your lord and end its life.
70010000094168.description:
Labyrinth of the Demon King is a challenging first-person dungeon crawler with survival horror elements, set against the backdrop of a mythical feudal Japan besieged by demons. As a lone foot soldier, embark on a quest to track down and slay the Demon King who killed your Lord. But will you have the skill, resources and stamina needed to survive through all the horrors this brutal world will throw at you?

THE WORLD IS IN CHAOS, AND HAS ENTERED THE LATTER AGE OF THE DHARMA.
SOCIETY IS CRUMBLING AND WAR HAS SPREAD THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY.
DISEASE AND FAMINE HAVE KILLED THOUSANDS, AND DEMONS WALK THE VERY EARTH ITSELF.
YOU ARE AN 'ASHIGARU', A FOOT SOLDIER IN THE SERVICE OF LORD TAKEDA NOBUMITSU.

DECEIVED BY A POWERFUL DEMON KING, YOUR LORD LED HIS ARMY INTO AN AMBUSH. ALL PERISHED EXCEPT FOR YOU. AGAINST YOUR WISHES YOUR LORD SACRIFICED HIS LIFE TO AID YOUR ESCAPE FROM THE BATTLE.

YOU HAVE MADE A VOW TO TRACK DOWN THE DEMON WHO BETRAYED YOUR LORD AND END ITS LIFE.
YOU TAKE WHAT COULD POSSIBLY BE YOUR FINAL BREATHS ON THIS MORTAL PLANE, AND PREPARE YOURSELF TO ENTER…

THE LABYRINTH OF THE DEMON KING.

---

DISCOVER A GRIM WORLD
Immerse yourself in the foreboding, dark world of the Demon King, a setting inspired by feudal Japan and brought to life in a gorgeous retro-grim art style.

PROVE YOURSELF IN COMBAT
Arm yourself with your wits and a select range of weapons, from katanas and naginatas to muskets and bows, as you engage in brutal, challenging combat. Revel in accomplishment and extreme satisfaction as you take down various Yōkai from ancient myth, and other horrific abominations that dwell in the labyrinth.

EXPLORE THE LABYRINTH
As you trudge through the dark, twisted corridors of the Labyrinth, explore every nook and cranny for limited resources. Sets of armor and talismans change your fortunes in combat, and important clues help solve puzzles laid out before you by the Demon King.

70010000094173.name: GEX Trilogy
70010000094173.intro: Everyone's favorite tail-whipping, channel-surfing, gecko is back in a collection that features all three of his best-selling adventures!
70010000094173.description:
Exploding into the modern era like a pro wrestler from the top rope—it’s Gex! The fast-talking gecko who doesn’t want to sell you insurance! That’s right, the greatest gaming hero of the 1990s has returned for the 2020s through the raw, unbridled power of the Carbon Engine. 

Gex Trilogy reproduces all three original games in exacting detail, precisely the way you remember them. Assuming you’ve gone senile and remember them having high-definition native 16:9 widescreen visuals and fully analog controls. Which they didn’t. No, this is the Gex series the way it was meant to be played. The Man didn’t think you were ready back then. He kept this version locked away. But the moment has finally arrived. Down with The Man! Up with Gex! Gex Trilogy is Gex, the next-gen version. The Gex’t-gen version. The Gexiest version of all.

And just like the tightest red carpet attire on Oscar night, the Gex Trilogy is totally stuffed… with tons of bonus features, including a music player featuring every track from each game (even the tunes that are kind of annoying), a massive museum filled with key art, a collection of classic TV commercials for the media-addled idiots in the audience, and an all-new interview with the voice of Gex. 

That’s Gould, Jerry, Gould! (Dana Gould, to be precise.)

70010000094175.name: Hike Haven
70010000094175.intro: Hike Haven – A Breathtaking Exploration Adventure!
70010000094175.description:
Embark on a serene journey through Hike Haven, a visually stunning exploration game that invites you to uncover the beauty of nature and history. Wander through two handcrafted, picturesque levels, each brimming with hidden locations to discover. From the rustic charm of a blacksmith’s forge to the towering elegance of windmills, every step brings a new story waiting to be found.

With breathtaking landscapes, relaxing gameplay, and immersive atmospheric design, Hike Haven is the perfect escape into a world of peaceful discovery. Lace up your boots and set out on an unforgettable adventure—only on Nintendo Switch™

Key Features:

Explore Two Beautiful Open-World Levels full of secrets and landmarks
Discover Unique Locations like blacksmiths, windmills, and more
Stunning Graphics & Relaxing Atmosphere for a truly immersive experience
Perfect for Exploration Lovers – no rush, just adventure at your own pace

70010000094177.name: Boat Delivery: Island Transport Simulator
70010000094177.description: Take the helm and transport essential cargo across a vast ocean village in Boat Delivery: Island Transport Simulator! Choose from various boats, manage fuel, and navigate through rocky cliffs and open waters. Upgrade your vessel and master the art of maritime delivery in this realistic transport adventure!

70010000094183.name: Arcade Archives D-DAY
70010000094183.intro:
The order has now been given to begin the operation!
Break through the enemy's encirclement 
and destroy the enemy fortress!!
70010000094183.description:
"D-DAY" is a shooter released by JALECO in 1984.
Your mission is to pilot your battleship, fending off enemy battleships and bombers, and destroy the enemy fortress.
Today is the day the operation is to take place. The longest day begins...

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000094188.name: StarLightRiders: HyperJump
70010000094188.intro: Blast swarms of enemies and charge your warp drives in retro shoot’em up style!
70010000094188.description:
Defend Earth in this fast-paced arcade shooter! Take command of the HyperJump ships and blast through swarms of alien invaders. Charge your warp engines by collecting reactors—but beware, the enemy strikes back harder the stronger you become!

Switch shot types on the fly, unleash screen-clearing bombs, and chain combos for maximum destruction. Face off against epic bosses in intense vertical-scrolling action, all driven by light narrative transmissions. StarLightRiders: HyperJump delivers classic arcade thrills with a modern edge!

• Take down enemy swarms in vertical scrolling shoot’em up action.
• Switch between multiple shot types to adapt your strategy.
• Deploy powerful screen-clearing bombs.
• Enjoy old-school pixel art aesthetics and a pumping soundtrack.
• Team up with a friend for local cooperative play!

70010000094193.name: Ogu and the Secret Forest
70010000094193.intro: Explore the wonderful world with baby Ogu!
70010000094193.description:
'Ogu and the Secret Forest' is a 2D adventure game with hand-drawn characters and various types of puzzles.

Befriend bouncy characters and defeat strange creatures to unravel the mystery of the charming world.

【EXPLORE THE WORLD】
Explore various types of areas. Each area has a unique atmosphere and story.
Solve puzzles and find hints to reveal secrets and mysteries that are undisclosed for a long time.

【PUZZLES】
From recognizable classic puzzles to unique ones, various types of puzzles are waiting for you to visit.

【CREATURES】
The power of the Great One has been shattered and lots of vicious adversaries are keen on gathering the scattered pieces of the Great One’s power.
Overcome these fearsome enemies to save the world.

【COLLECTABLES】
(Hats and Masks) Put on your explorer’s hat and go find various awesome hats and masks!
Dress Baby Ogu with these items and some of them might have some special skills attached.

(Drawings) There are many landmarks out there.
Draw fancy objects and landscapes to discover new lands and you might also find hints in them.

(Friends) Meet friends on your journey and help those in need.
They might help you with their unique skills or gifts. You’re not alone in this world!

70010000094201.name: Beach Girls 3: Zodiac Signs, Love & Horoscope Dating
70010000094201.intro: Discover the Secrets of the Zodiac While Protecting the Heart of the Girl of Your Dreams.
70010000094201.description:
Explore the fascinating world of the zodiac as you meet irresistible girls and fight to protect their hearts. Combine revealing questions with exciting defense gameplay to unlock suggestive images and unexpected endings.

Discover how each girl is deeply influenced by her astrological sign and test your intuition as you progress through this adventure.

Features:
-Unique Dual Gameplay: Alternate between answering astrological questions and defense mode, where you must protect the girl's heart from attacks to unlock new images.

-Suggestive Images and Unique Moments: Discover special scenes and personal traits as you advance through the story.

-Explore Her Zodiac Personality: Each answer reveals details about her character, desires, and secrets based on her astrological sign.

-Multiple Endings: Your fate will depend on how many questions you answer correctly, how well you defend her heart, and how you interpret the zodiac signs.

-Secret and Spicy Question: Reach question 150 to unveil a special final moment related to the zodiac.


Can you protect their hearts and unravel the astrological mysteries that connect them to you?

Dive into this adventure where strategy and romance go hand in hand!

70010000094206.name: Beach Boys 3: Zodiac Signs, Love & Horoscope Dating
70010000094206.intro: Discover the secrets of the zodiac while protecting the heart of your dream boy.
70010000094206.description:
Explore the fascinating world of the zodiac as you meet irresistible boys and fight to protect their hearts. Combine revealing questions with exciting defense gameplay to unlock suggestive images and unexpected endings.

Discover how each boy is deeply influenced by his astrological sign and test your intuition as you progress through the adventure.

Features:
-Unique dual gameplay: Switch between answering astrological questions and defense mode, where you must protect the boy’s heart from attacks to unlock new images.

-Suggestive images and unique moments: Unlock special scenes and personal traits as you move forward in the story.

-Explore his zodiac personality: Each response reveals details about his character, desires, and secrets based on his astrological sign.

-Multiple endings: Your fate depends on how many questions you answer correctly, how you defend his heart, and how you interpret the zodiac signals.

-Secret spicy question: Reach question 150 to unveil a special final moment tied to the zodiac.


Can you protect their hearts and unravel the astrological mysteries that connect them to you?

Dive into this adventure where strategy and romance come together!

70010000094211.name: Spy Guy Jigsaw Fun
70010000094211.intro: Complete the puzzles together with Spy Guy.
70010000094211.description: The first puzzle video game based on Spy Guy board game maps. Discover more than 80 frames on 3 difficulty levels. Face the puzzles on time and take a photo for an album of your creations.

70010000094218.name: Survival Zone: Craft, Build & Grow
70010000094218.intro: Build, survive, and shape your World!
70010000094218.description:
In a vast, untamed world, survival is just the beginning. 

Gather resources, craft tools, and build your own thriving village from the ground up. Construct homes, farms, and workshops to expand your settlement and ensure your people’s survival. Hunt, harvest, and trade to keep your community growing, but beware - danger lurks beyond the walls. Bandits, wild creatures, and the harsh elements will test your strength at every turn. Fortify your defenses, train warriors, and fight to protect everything you’ve built. 

Will you rise as a leader and create a legendary stronghold, or will your settlement fall to the chaos of the wild? The choice is yours - craft, build, and grow!

70010000094234.name: Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A
70010000094234.intro: Live the life of a Pokémon Trainer and help protect the peace in Lumiose City!
70010000094234.description:
Lumiose City—a home for people and Pokémon alike. Thanks to an urban redevelopment plan driven by Quasartico Inc., the lush greenery of verdant parks intermingles with facilities using the latest cutting-edge technology. A lot has changed here since the days of the Pokémon™ X and Pokémon Y games!

Choose Chikorita, Tepig, or Totodile as your first partner Pokémon, and then set off on a grand adventure! Your journey will take you to all manner of sights in the streets arrayed around Prism Tower, including shops, restaurants, and places called wild zones—where Pokémon roam free. As you catch, train, and battle Pokémon, there will be plenty of people to meet too—like AZ, the enigmatic owner of Hotel Z , and Team MZ, the crew that aims to keep Lumiose a peaceful place.

Catch, battle, and Mega Evolve—all in real time!

Step onto the battlefield and command your Pokémon directly—there are no turns! For the first time in the Pokémon RPG series, Trainers and their Pokémon can both move around in real-time battles, and your Pokémon will unleash their moves when you tell them to. Strategically swapping out your Pokémon and accounting for each move’s timing and area of effect will greatly help you in this new style of battle.

Harness the power of Mega Evolution! Unleash your Pokémon’s hidden energy to temporarily transform its appearance, enhance its capabilities, and perhaps even change its type. Use this power wisely and try to overcome your toughest challenges, like those posed by the rampaging Rogue Mega-Evolved Pokémon across Lumiose City. Investigate these dangerous incidents so you can put a stop to them—you may even encounter new Mega-Evolved Pokémon along the way!

Compete in the Z-A Royale when night falls—or battle with other players in the Z-A Battle Club

You’re invited to join the Z-A Royale, a competition for Pokémon Trainers to test their skills and determine who’s strongest. Each night, a battle zone for the competition will appear. Prepare yourself by spending the day catching and training Pokémon, then venture into the battle zone to take on other Trainers. Be strategic and complete bonus card challenges as you battle to speed up your climb from Rank Z to Rank A. Reach the top, and you might just have a wish granted.

You can also test your skills against friends or Trainers around the world in the Z-A Battle Club. Take on up to three other Trainers at once, locally* or online**, in frenetic real-time battles!

70010000094248.name: Q with VTubers
70010000094248.intro:
New 'Q REMASTERED' that physics puzzle series!
Challenge the bizarre and difficult puzzles created by over 20 VTubers who mastered Q!
70010000094248.description:
The latest installment of the physics-based puzzle sensation 'Q REMASTERED,' which took off primarily among Japanese streamers, is now on Nintendo Switch™!
It's 'Q ｗith VTubers'!!

This time, Q features challenging and quirky puzzles designed by over 20 VTubers.

We've prepared new challenges for humanity, who have already succeeded in getting a ball out of a cup and hanging a hanger.

Embracing the charm of 'Q REMASTERED,' this is a challenge from VTubers who have experienced 'Q' to all of humanity!

As always, the solutions are entirely free and up to you!
Experience the new Q – simple 'yet' difficult.

70010000094256.name: Hidden Kittens: Kingdom of Cats
70010000094256.intro: A fantasy medieval adventure… with cute cats scattered around!
70010000094256.description:
Purrr! Prepare for a delightful mission in a fantasy landscape – many cats can be found across this magical realm…
