Every corner hides a fluffy surprise just waiting to be discovered – over 350 of them, to be somewhat precise…

Pick your favourite colours for your game’s look and feel, and keep your eyes peeled for any balls of joy that wait to be pet!~

70010000094264.name: KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-
70010000094264.intro: Explore six KINGDOM HEARTS titles starting with the very first adventure.
70010000094264.description:
*Please note that a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX is also available. To avoid duplicate purchases, please check your platform before buying.
*There are currently no plans to offer an upgrade from this Nintendo Switch™ version to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version.
*Save data from this Nintendo Switch™ version CAN be transferred to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version; HOWEVER, save data from the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version CANNOT be transferred to this Nintendo Switch™ version.
*Players who own this KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- cloud version are eligible for a 50% discount for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version.

KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- is an essential collection of the first six stories in the KINGDOM HEARTS series, a collaboration between Disney and SQUARE ENIX. Wield the legendary Keyblade and unlock the true power of friendship as you explore Disney worlds and defend them from darkness.

<Featured Titles>
・KINGDOM HEARTS FINAL MIX
・KINGDOM HEARTS Re:Chain of Memories
・KINGDOM HEARTS II FINAL MIX
・KINGDOM HEARTS 358/2 Days (HD cutscene compilation)
・KINGDOM HEARTS Birth by Sleep FINAL MIX
・KINGDOM HEARTS Re:coded (HD cutscene compilation)

70010000094286.name: The Exorcist: Gravebound Horror
70010000094286.intro: Can you survive the wrath of the vengeful spirit?
70010000094286.description:
In The Exorcist: Gravebound Horror, you take on the role of an experienced exorcist called to a forsaken village plagued by mysterious disappearances. Entire families vanish overnight, leaving behind only whispers of terror. The villagers suspect the church is the source of the darkness, but their fearful glances and half-truths hint at something far more sinister.

As you investigate, you realize this haunting is unlike anything you've encountered before. This survival horror game immerses you in a chilling paranormal mystery where fear lurks around every corner. With atmospheric terror, supernatural entities, psychological horror elements, and intense exorcism mechanics, The Exorcist: Gravebound Horror delivers a truly terrifying experience for horror game fans.

70010000094296.name: My Lovely Pets 2 Collector's Edition
70010000094296.intro: Enjoy happy pastime together with your beloved pets.
70010000094296.description:
Game offers interesting ways to find funny and playful pets, as well as bright hidden objects, and a set of popular mini-games. 
Meet and make friends with these funny pets in beautiful game locations where they are always ready to hide and fool around.
Use your skills and knowledge to play mini-games and find all the hidden objects.     

Collector's edition includes:
- 8 additional locations for even more cute pets to find!
- 8 more mini-games!
- Listen to the relaxing soundtracks

70010000094300.name: Mighty Mouse Cheese Hunt
70010000094300.intro: Do you have what it takes to become the true hero of the cheese kingdom?
70010000094300.description: Mighty Mouse: Cheese Hunt is an action-adventure game where you play as a brave little mouse on an epic quest through magical lands in search of legendary cheese. Navigate treacherous cliffs, dodge traps, and battle cunning enemies to collect every precious piece. Gather upgrades, unlock new abilities, and uncover the secrets hidden in the shadow of a dark, mysterious castle.

70010000094305.name: Sprint for Survival
70010000094305.intro: Run like your life depends on it — because it does.
70010000094305.description:
In Sprint for Survival, there’s no time to ask questions. You wake up in the dark, the forest is alive, and they’re already coming. Your only option? Move forward. Don’t stop. Don’t think.

Dodge, shoot, heal, repeat. Every step is earned, every meter counts, and every shadow hides something worse than the last.

You won't survive forever — but you might just survive a little longer.

70010000094310.name: Parking Pro: Top-Down Challenge
70010000094310.intro: Can you park perfectly and become the ultimate Parking Pro?
70010000094310.description: Parking Pro: Top-Down Challenge is a precision driving game that puts your parking skills to the ultimate test. Navigate tight spaces, master tricky turns, and conquer increasingly challenging levels from a top-down perspective. With realistic physics, various car types, and dynamic obstacles, every level offers a new puzzle to solve.

70010000094315.name: Game & Console Supermarket: Business Simulator
70010000094315.intro: Build, stock, and dominate the Gaming Market!
70010000094315.description:
Step into the world of gaming retail and build your own game and console empire! In Game & Console Supermarket: Business Simulator, you’ll manage inventory, set prices, and create the ultimate shopping experience for gamers. Stock the latest consoles, best-selling games, and rare collectibles to attract customers and grow your business.

Expand your store, optimize sales, and outsmart competitors to become the ultimate gaming mogul. Will you dominate the industry or get left in the bargain bin? The choice is yours!

70010000094320.name: Monster Popper
70010000094320.intro: Can you clear the land and become the Monster Popper?
70010000094320.description:
Step into a world full of fast-paced action and mischievous monsters! Monster Popper is a dynamic action platformer where you play as a young hero armed with a powerful energy blaster. Your mission is to eliminate waves of crazy, bouncing creatures and defeat giant bosses that threaten the magical kingdom.

-Exciting gameplay – jump, shoot, and dodge traps in challenging levels
-Epic battles – face off against massive dragons and cunning enemies
-Humor and style – enjoy charming animations, quirky monsters, and vibrant fantasy visuals

70010000094325.name: Book Supermarket: Library Manager Simulator
70010000094325.intro: Build, manage, and grow the ultimate bookstore!
70010000094325.description: Step into the world of literature and business in Book Supermarket: Library Manager Simulator! Manage your own bookstore and library, stock the shelves with bestsellers and hidden gems, and create a cozy space for book lovers to explore. Organize sections, set prices, and keep up with customer demands to grow your business. Expand your store, decorate with stylish furnishings, and host special events to attract more visitors. Whether you’re a book enthusiast or a strategic entrepreneur, this game offers a relaxing yet engaging experience where every decision shapes your literary empire!

70010000094340.name: Operation: Hostage Rescue
70010000094340.intro: Gear up. Get in. Get them out!
70010000094340.description:
Operation: Hostage Rescue throws you deep behind enemy lines, where the jungle hides more than just trees. Armed to the teeth and dropped into hostile territory, you’ll navigate deadly ambushes, sweeping gunfights, and tightly guarded compounds in a top-down tactical shooter that never lets up.

Each mission is a blend of chaos and precision — dodge mines, outsmart enemy patrols, and face down heavily armored bosses, including tanks and elite units. The environment may look green and calm, but every corner hides danger, every bullet could be your last, and every rescued hostage is a step closer to surviving the war zone.

70010000094345.name: Arcane Paws
70010000094345.intro: In Arcane Paws, adventure is always within reach!
70010000094345.description: Arcane Paws is a vibrant, fast-paced platform adventure where quick thinking and agility are your greatest tools. Jump into the role of a charming little hero and set off across lively worlds filled with bouncy creatures, hidden treasures, and playful challenges. Every level delivers short, satisfying bursts of action: leap over gaps, smash mystery blocks, dodge quirky enemies, and collect shiny coins as you push toward the finish. With its cartoon visuals, expressive animations, and upbeat atmosphere, Arcane Paws offers an experience that’s lighthearted yet full of energy. Smooth controls, responsive movement, and cleverly designed obstacles make each run engaging—perfect for short sessions or longer explorations alike.

70010000094355.name: Malachite: Temple of the Sun Collector's Edition
70010000094355.intro: Embark on a journey through the depths of a lost ancient jungle temple.
70010000094355.description:
Start your journey through the depths of a forgotten jungle temple. 
Match colorful balls, unlock powerful power-ups, and construct your own temple as you progress. 
Choose between adventure and endless modes, immersing yourself in classic match 3 gameplay!

Game features:
- Fast, colorful ball-shooting fun across 45 levels.
- Make matches and clear combinations of three or more from ball chains in order to progress.
- Complete chapters to collect pieces for the grand temple.
- Catch a wide array of magical powerups.
- Play your way—enjoy a calming experience with the Zen difficulty, or turn up the heat on Challenging!
- See how long you can last with Endless Mode!
- Clear 5 bonus chapters to add structures to your temple!
- 25 bonus levels in 5 extra chapters.

70010000094359.name: Carlos the Taco
70010000094359.description:
¡Buenos días, amigo! I’m Taco Carlos, and I need your help! A gang of skeletons kidnapped my bride right from our wedding. Only you can help me save her!

Carlos is a brave taco who never gives up, even when left to die. His goal is revenge, and those skeletons will regret letting him survive!

""Carlos the Taco"" is a 2D platformer set in sunny Mexico. Fight enemies, use power-ups like flavor enhancements, and uncover the mystery of the kidnapping. Carlos is armed with ketchup and mustard tubes, as well as a stylish sombrero.

Are you ready to help Carlos save his love and bring some spicy Mexican justice to those skeletons? Let’s go, amigo!

70010000094367.name: Lovish
70010000094367.intro: The only thing more dangerous than monsters is unrequited love.
70010000094367.description:
Sir Solomon and the Saviors of Light depart Castle Cornelius to free Princess Tsuna from the grasp of the evil Devil Lord!

But the knight is worried... What if after being freed, the princess falls in love with one of his friends instead of with him?

So he does what anyone would do when blinded by love, and ditches his friends!

Solomon ventures into the Devil Lord's castle alone, vowing to steal the princess's heart.

LABS and Matt Kap present Lovish, an outrageous 8-bit-styled action-adventure game! Venture through a series of bite-sized rooms, slicing up monsters, collecting items and getting to the exit! After exiting each room, enjoy a short event scene, in which anything could happen! Will you find an item? A random encounter RPG fight? Will the world get destroyed? Find out by conquering each room of the Devil Lord's castle, one challenge at a time!

Features:

- 50+ fun levels to play through, each with multiple objectives!
- Wacky randomized event scenes between levels with hundreds of outcomes! You never know what you're gonna see next!
- Collect a variety of items to upgrade Solomon's abilities, or expand the game in meaningful (and unmeaningful) ways!
- Spend your pennies (in-game currency to be clear, no microtransactions here) in the in-game shop!
100+ characters, some of which were designed by world-famous manga artist Ryusuke Mita (Dragon Half)
- An exciting, 20+ tune soundtrack by Matt Kap (Castle In The Darkness, Astalon: Tears of the Earth)
- Beautiful human-artist-made pixel art! Even the in-game AI art is drawn by a human person!
- More secrets than ever before! (But this is the first game in this series, so that doesn't mean much, I guess.)
- Unexpected guest characters
And lots more!

So please, be a good friend, and help Solomon rescue the princess!

70010000094372.name: Lost & Found Spot It Fast!
70010000094372.intro:
Find the Target Character Within the Time Limit!
A Brain-Training Picture Hunt Game to Boost Your Reflexes
70010000094372.description:
This is a fun and easy brain-training game where you search for the target pose among many pictogram characters within the time limit.
By spotting the correct figure, you can sharpen your observation skills and train your brain in a simple and enjoyable way!

How to Play：
・Carefully check the target image.
・Look for the matching pictogram in the illustration.
・Once you find it, tap the character before time runs out!

It might seem easy if you take your time, but with a time limit, it’s surprisingly tricky!

If you ever get stuck, press the hint button for a little help.
(But be careful—it might give away the answer!)

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000094378.name: Psychiatric Prison Romance: Serial Killer Anime Boys Dating Sim
70010000094378.intro: 12 boys, 30 days, one prison… and every decision could be your last.
70010000094378.description:
Deep within an isolated prison, twelve boys await you. They are attractive, intense… and dangerously unpredictable.
Each one has a hidden story, an obsession, a secret that might make you crave their love… or fear for your life.

They want your attention.
They need your affection.
But in a place where madness and passion go hand in hand, one question looms over you:

Can you win them over before you become their next victim?

Game Features:
-12 boys, 12 disturbingly irresistible minds – From the enigmatic manipulator to the sweet psychopath with a deadly obsession, each inmate has a unique personality. Find out what drives them… and what sets them off.

-Dynamic conversations and a dangerous game of seduction – Every word you choose can bring you closer to them… or seal your fate. Will you be their confidant, their obsession… or their prey?

-A limited time to win their love (or escape alive) – Every decision matters. Will you conquer them… or realize too late that love can be a weapon?

-Multiple endings – Your fate is in your hands. Will you find romance in the darkest place… or become trapped in a love you can’t escape?


They are waiting for you. And they won’t take "no" for an answer.

Do you dare to play?

70010000094383.name: Psychiatric Prison Romance: Serial Killer Anime Girls Dating Sim
70010000094383.intro: 12 girls, 30 days, one prison… and every decision could be your last.
70010000094383.description:
Deep within an isolated prison, twelve girls await you. They are beautiful, intense… and dangerously unpredictable. Each one has a hidden story, an obsession, a secret that might make you crave their love… or fear for your life.

They want your attention. They need your affection. But in a place where madness and passion go hand in hand, one question looms over you:

Can you win them over before you become their next victim?

Game Features:
-12 girls, 12 disturbingly irresistible minds – From the enigmatic manipulator to the sweet psychopath with a deadly obsession, each inmate has a unique personality. Find out what drives them… and what sets them off.

-Dynamic conversations and a dangerous game of seduction – Every word you choose can bring you closer to them… or seal your fate. Will you be their confidant, their obsession… or their prey?

-A limited time to win their love (or escape alive) – Every decision matters. Will you conquer them… or realize too late that love can be a weapon?

-Multiple endings – Your fate is in your hands. Will you find romance in the darkest place… or become trapped in a love you can’t escape?

They are waiting for you. And they won’t take "no" for an answer.

Do you dare to play?

70010000094396.name: Death Park: Remaster
70010000094396.intro: Try to escape the furieous deadly clown in this scary horror game!
70010000094396.description:
In this scary game you should explore a huge abandoned amusement park with a creepy circus.

Are you ready to face the true evil - the scary killer clown? Will you be able to solve all the puzzles that are waiting for you on the path to escape in these horror stories? You will have to play hide and seek with that monster and go through all the hard quests in order to survive throughout the night! 

Explore a dark amusement loonar park: old abandoned buildings, a horrifying hospital, dark basements, mysterious mazes and creepy circus, all this scares goosebumps.

Feeling you’re alone there? In this terrible adventure game you won’t ever end up being alone, because It will always be at your back… Put your attention on secret quests and hidden objects in this dreadful game - the only way to stay alive is to hide first and run away after this massacure! 

Solve puzzles and search, collect and use items in order to understand the horror story and escape from haunted house and evil clown.

Do not make loud noise and be careful because the real evil neighbor killer-clown might see or hear you! It kills everyone who gets in its way! Keep your eyes open and use cover to hide from this deadly maniac to stay alive. Try to track it’s movements, otherwise it will find, scare and kill you!

If you like scary games and horror escape experiences – Death Park is the game for you!

There are multiple endings in Death Park. Your decisions and actions will affect the outcome of the story. Play again to discover the other endings and to know the clown ‘s whole story.

70010000094401.name: Absolum
70010000094401.intro: An original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu!
70010000094401.description:
AN EPIC ADVENTURE IN AN ORIGINAL FANTASY WORLD

Talamh has been shattered by a magical cataclysm caused by ambitious wizards, leaving magic mistrusted by the common folk. Sun King Azra took advantage of this panic, enslaving wizards through his Crimson Order and placing loyal princes to rule over the conquered realms.
As Azra’s forces claim more and more lands, the high enchantress Uchawi and a small group of rebels rise from the shadows, wielding forbidden magic to challenge his oppressive regime and defy his absolute magic power.

FROM THE DESTRUCTION, NEW HEROES RISE

Meet the outcast heroes of Talamh, each with their unique fighting style.
From the shadows of Yeldrim, Galandra emerges as an unstoppable force of nature. Her colossal sword strikes with deadly precision, combined with chilling, destructive necromantic powers. Her calm demeanor is a thin veil, barely concealing the furious anger brewing inside her.
Karl is the last free dwarf of Talamh. Armed with an ancestral blunderbuss and his bare fists, he’s a master of close-range brawls and explosive tactics. What he lacks in reach at mid-range, he makes up for with raw strength and quick thinking, making him a stalwart ally in the revolt against Azra's oppression.
During their ordeals, two mysterious heroes will join them on a quest to overthrow the Sun King: Brome, a wizard prodigy on a mission to preserve the future generations of his people, and the enigmatic Cider, a nimble skirmisher in search of answers among the scattered fragments of their own soul.

THE ROGUE ‘EM UP ORIGINAL BY DOTEMU

Absolum combines Dotemu and Guard Crush’s mastery in beat ‘em up gameplay with Supamonks' best-in-class art and animation. With its fast-paced action and endless replayability, Absolum will challenge you with multiple paths to explore and unpredictable encounters for a new experience each time you play.

A NEW THRILLING GAMEPLAY TO MASTER

Take down Azra’s elite guard with a mix of rapid combo chains and spellcasting powers, unleashing moves that feel as raw as they are strategic. Use magical counters and rare items to turn the tide in your favor and experience a combat system that demands skill and timing, pushing you to craft new strategies at every run to wreak havoc among the enemy ranks.

THE BEAT ‘EM UP GENRE AT ITS VERY BEST

Lead the uprising against Azra's regime as a lone hero, or team up with a friend on your couch or online. Combine your elemental powers and synchronize your attacks into incredible chained combos!

The world of Talamh is an intricate tapestry brimming with secrets, stories, and betrayals. From the majestic mines of Grandery to the lush forests of Jaroba, every step of your odyssey will be accompanied by a magnificent soundtrack by composer Gareth Coker (Ori, Halo Infinite, Prince of Persia), with collaborations from Yuka Kitamura (Dark Souls, Elden Ring), Mick Gordon (Doom Eternal, Atomic Heart), and more!

70010000094403.name: Call of Glory - Critical Warfare
70010000094403.intro: Defeat is not an option—only victory or glory.
70010000094403.description:
Your Skills, Your Mission — Fight and Overcome Every Threat!

Call of Glory – Critical Warfare puts you in the boots of an elite soldier facing intense combat scenarios against enemies. In this action-packed first-person shooter, you'll battle through diverse environments and master a wide arsenal of weapons — each with its own feel and mechanics.

Features:

• Diverse combat maps — Engage in operations across multiple environments, including dune, metropolis, and island.

• Over 20 unique weapons — Choose from a wide selection of firearms, each with distinct physics, recoil, and tactical use.

• Realistic weapon mechanics — Experience immersive gunplay with individual handling, reload speed, and firepower.

• Real-Time Decision Making: Fast reflexes and smarter tactics are your most potent weapons in this critical fight for glory.

Feel the intensity of tactical firefights, refine your aim, and lead your squad to victory against waves of powerful enemies.
Prepare your gear, lock and load, and enter the warzone — Call of Glory – Critical Warfare awaits your command!

70010000094409.name: Cat From Hell - Cat Simulator

70010000094414.name: Beyond Hanwell: Nintendo Switch™ Edition
70010000094414.intro: Explore Westminster, London on a journey to the ruins of Hanwell. Fight with whatever you can find to defend yourself against an ever increasing scourge of Anomalies.
70010000094414.description:
Beyond Hanwell comes to Nintendo Switch™. Taking you on a terrifying journey through the twisted locations of open world Westminster, London, in a world where Anomalous Entities are a fact of life. Return to Hanwell and discover the truth about yourself.

All new dual control melee combat system, land each hit and combo with satisfying intensity.

Scavenge scarce but available weapons and ammo with new shooting mechanics.

Use the environment in creative ways to take out the Anomolies. Set them on fire, electrocute them, crush them and more in frantic efforts to survive.

Follow the story in your own way, non linear open gameplay makes for a unique experience.

Immersive. All player feedback is displayed in game, with no HUD whatsoever to keep the player immersed and the tension high.

70010000094416.name: Ys Memoire: Revelations in Celceta
70010000094416.description:
Experience a timeless chapter in the storied RPG franchise making its debut on Nintendo Switch™, filled with duplicitous schemes, treacherous geography, and secretive characters. As the adventure that immediately follows the events of Ys X, and which laid the groundwork for gameplay systems that would be seen in Ys VIII and beyond, Ys Memoire: Revelations in Celceta is a special opportunity to go deeper into the series history and see the evolution that continues to drive its remarkable longevity. 

Explore and map out your way across a dangerous landscape, taking advantage of a unique tag-team party combat system that allows for creativity and strategy. Seek the truth of Adol’s past against the musical backdrop of a refreshed soundtrack. Re-awaken the spirit of adventure, exclusively on Nintendo Switch, in Ys Memoire: Revelations in Celceta.

Exhilarating Party-based Action
Strategic party battles challenge you to change your tactics on the fly, and allies can pick up new abilities in the midst of battle that can help you gain the advantage against powerful enemies.

Dynamic Exploration of a Dangerous Land
Celceta is a vast and mysterious land, filled with interesting people and thrilling adventures. Take advantage of a robust mapping system as you discover all the challenges and rewards that await.

Enhanced Musical Experience 
The sweeping score guiding Adol's journey through Celceta returns, along with a newly recorded, re-interpreted version, allowing players to choose their own auditory adventure.

70010000094417.name: King of Ping Pong: MEGAMIX
70010000094417.intro: Step into the ring for an explosive table tennis showdown that turns the 1-on-1 paddle sport into an all-out boss rush!
70010000094417.description:
Table tennis gets a fighting game twist in this action-packed journey to become the best in the world! Defeat quirky characters utilizing quick wit and precise timing in increasingly challenging matches. King of Ping Pong: MEGAMIX is a boss rush arcade fighter where table tennis warriors from across the globe gather for the ultimate tournament.

Face challengers from across the table, move left or right and strategically shoot in 3 directions, preparing for return volleys as you wear your enemy down. Outlast your adversaries, learn their strategies and drain their stamina to execute special kill shots!  Enjoy endless play in Arcade mode or take on champions in single matches to improve your skills!

• Face off against crazy opponents.
• Learn your enemy’s quirks and strategically wear them down.
• Keep your stamina high with skillful execution!
• Perform powerful kill shots.
• Immerse yourself in the fight playing from a first-person perspective!

70010000094418.name: The Operator
70010000094418.intro:
Investigate Crimes
Dig Deeper
Uncover The Truth
70010000094418.description: Welcome to the FDI. As our newest Operator, your role is to use your detective skills to assist our field agents and investigate mysterious crimes. Use cutting-edge FDI software to dig for clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth.

70010000094424.name: Black Border 2
70010000094424.intro: Black Border 2 is an intense border patrol simulator where you inspect documents and use special tools to detect forgeries and stop smugglers.
70010000094424.description:
Ready to become a Border Police Officer? Step into the world of Black Border 2 and experience the intense pressure of national security. As a Customs Officer, your duty is to protect the nation from illegal smuggling and Check the Papers, Please! 

Inspect passports, scrutinize documents, and use advanced tools to make life-or-death decisions in this gripping police simulator game.

Take on the duty of a Border Patrol Agent and protect your nation's borders. Your role is crucial and you Must Check every Papers, Please:

Document Inspection: Meticulously check passports, permits, and papers to approve or reject entrants.

Advanced Tools: Utilize X-ray scanners to reveal hidden items and weigh stations to check vehicle legitimacy.

Canine Unit: Deploy your loyal service dog to sniff out concealed contraband and uncover secrets.

Strategic Decisions: Every choice you make impacts the safety of your country.

70010000094434.name: Brain IQTopia
70010000094434.intro: Brain IQTopia is a fun and educational brain training game. Challenge your mind with 10 mini-games focused on memory, math, problem-solving, and artistic skills. Test your IQ.
70010000094434.description:
Take on a series of mind-bending challenges in Brain IQTopia! Test your mental agility across 10 fun and fast-paced mini-games that put your brain to the ultimate test. Whether you're solving tricky math puzzles, improving your memory, navigating spatial awareness tasks, or predicting colors, each activity offers something exciting. Brain IQTopia provides a fun and educational experience that will help you improve cognitive skills while keeping you entertained.

Engage in Quick Mental Fun
Each mini-game is designed to sharpen your cognitive skills while keeping you entertained. Practice to improve your speed and precision as you take on new challenges, pushing your brain to its limits.

Boost Your Brain Score
Track your Brain Score as you complete each mini-game, reflecting your mental progress. Want to improve your performance? Practice specific activities to boost your score and become faster and more accurate.

Family Fun and Friendly Competition
Brain IQTopia offers a fun and educational experience for players of all ages—perfect for family game nights!

Combine Memory, Science, and Art
Brain IQTopia uniquely combines memory challenges, scientific reasoning, and artistic expression. Test your recall, sharpen your logical thinking, and express your creativity in fun and stimulating ways. Whether you’re solving scientific puzzles or creating artistic patterns, you’ll engage both your brainpower and artistic flair!

Are you ready for the ultimate brain workout? Play Brain IQTopia and see if you have what it takes to master your mind!

70010000094439.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Jebu-do
70010000094439.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000094439.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Jebu-do, Korea with "Real" footage! 
This work takes place in Jebu-do. 
There are a total of 8 flight courses. 
1080P high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to 8 locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Jebu-do, Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000094444.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Muui-do
70010000094444.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000094444.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Muui-do, Korea with "Real" footage! 
This work takes place in Muui-do. 
There are a total of 5 flight courses. 
High-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to 5 locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Muui-do, Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery. MasCon for Nintendo Switch™ made by Zuiki of Japan is also supported.

70010000094450.name: DELTARUNE
70010000094450.intro: The next adventure in the UNDERTALE series has appeared!
70010000094450.description: Dive into the long-awaited parallel story to UNDERTALE! Fight or spare your way through action-packed battles as you explore a mysterious world alongside an endearing cast of new and familiar characters. Create your avatar, meet strange friends, and jump into the darkness: DELTARUNE is waiting!

70010000094505.name: Witching Stone
70010000094505.description: Witching Stone combines elements of puzzle games, roguelites and deckbuilders! Incrementally improve your spellbook, and find patterns on a unique puzzle grid, to battle deeper and deeper into the dungeon!

70010000094508.name: PAW Patrol™: Dino World
70010000094508.intro: Join the PAW Patrol and Rex on colossal missions across Dino Island. Create roar-some looks, play minigames with friends and more.
70010000094508.description:
ROARR! Sounds like trouble… Did that come from Dino Island? Mayor Humdinger is causing chaos, making the dinosaurs scared and run away. 

Leap into colossal rescue missions with Chase, Marshall, Rubble, Skye, Rocky, and Zuma. Explore the Dino Plains and care for dinos at the Paleo Center. Drive across the shores and jungle to discover collectibles.  

Create roar-some new looks for your pup, vehicle, and dinosaurs. Play fun minigames in solo or in two-player mode.  

Can you stop the chaos before the volcano erupts? No dino’s too big, no pup’s too small in this prehistoric adventure! 

BE STRONG, BRAVE AND ROAR: Have Rex and Timmy by your side as you play with Chase, Marshall, Rubble, Skye, Rocky, and Zuma.  

RESCUE DINOS: Help lost dinosaurs find their way back to their families and care for them at the Paleo Center. 

FOSSIL-FILLED ACTION: Activate your pup’s unique skills anytime to overcome obstacles and stop Humdinger’s chaos. 

STOMP AROUND IN STYLE: Uncover accessories, skins and decorations to upgrade your pup and dino’s look.  

EXPLORE THE WILDS: Discover the Dino Plains, shores with secret pools, jungle filled with tropical fruit, and crystal caves in the volcano.

70010000094510.name: Jumping Boy
70010000094510.intro: Jump higher and try not to fall!
70010000094510.description:
Get ready for an exciting trampoline adventure! Guide the boy as he jumps higher and higher, performing flips and tricks in the air. Each jump brings new opportunities to score big and discover surprises. The game is simple to play, but super fun. You'll want to keep coming back for more!

Aim carefully, time your jumps and watch the magic happen as you pull off amazing moves and earn bonus points. Each jump gives you a chance to unlock more fun and surprises. How high can you go?

The more you play, the more cool stuff you'll discover. Play for a few minutes or stay as long as you like - the bouncy fun never ends!

Check out this fun new game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Jump for your life!

70010000094515.name: Spin Around
70010000094515.intro: Spin around and bring on the chaos!
70010000094515.description:
Spin the ladder, choose your path, and crash into everything around you! Each swing opens up wild new possibilities, keeping the action non-stop and exciting. Simple to learn, but endlessly fun, this is a game you'll want to play again and again.

Find the best spin and let the mayhem begin! One perfect move can set off a massive chain of destruction. Spot clever options to see how far and how long you can keep smashing forward!

Play forever by uncovering patterns, grabbing rewards, boosting your power, and discovering secret treasures as you break through each level!

Check out this fun new game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Destroy everything around you!

70010000094535.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection
70010000094535.intro: Step into the arena and choose your fighter! Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection includes all the essential games from Mortal Kombat's early years.
70010000094535.description:
Experience the legendary origins of the franchise with the iconic arcade classics that started it all—alongside a curated selection of most-loved home versions and rare, fan-favorite releases—a celebration of the franchise’s groundbreaking legacy.

Digital Eclipse's interactive documentary format explores how Mortal Kombat changed the way society perceived video games. By using digitized humans as player sprites in an over-the-top, martial-arts fighter, the game thrilled players, shocked critics, and laid the foundation for a franchise that has thrived for more than 30 years. Hear firsthand from the original dev team of Ed Boon, John Tobias, John Vogel, and Dan Forden, along with other exclusive interviews, rare concept art, vintage marketing materials, and archival video footage. 

Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection also lets players explore Mortal Kombat lore, with a timeline of the original series' storyline and comprehensive character histories that offer stories, secrets, and glimpses behind the scenes at their creation. 

Features

- Multiple Iconic Editions: Experience the legendary origins of Mortal Kombat with the iconic arcade classics along with well loved home versions and rare, fan-favorite releases.

- Online Play: Engage in online battles enhanced by rollback netcode— engineered to preserve the precision of every attack, even with players across vast distances.

- No More Secrets: At the touch of a button, unlock all secret characters, change game settings, and access the buried developer menus to play the games your way. 

- Interactive Documentary: Deep behind-the-scenes content chronicles the history of the franchise, featuring exclusive new interviews with original MK developers Ed Boon, John Tobias, Dan Forden, John Vogel, and dozens more.

- The Full Story: Detailed character histories and timelines trace the epic narrative of Earthrealm, Outworld, and Edenia through the arcade era.

70010000094540.name: Escape game R00M03
70010000094540.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

70010000094543.name: Masters Tennis
70010000094543.intro: Realistic, true physics, local multiplayer, Tennis Game
70010000094543.description:
Masters Tennis – Real Tennis, Real Challenge

Step onto the court in Masters Tennis, a 1-player or local 2-player split-screen tennis game built for realism. With smooth gameplay, lifelike animations, and authentic tennis action, every matchfeels real. Compete in tournaments, refine your skills with a training ball machine, and rise to the top.

Features:
- Solo & Local Multiplayer – Play against smart AI or challenge a friend in split-screen mode.
- Tournaments & Matches – Test your skills in competitive tournaments and one-on-one matches.
- Training Ball Machine – Improve your technique with precision drills and practice sessions.
- Realistic Gameplay – Motion-captured animations, precise ball physics, and fluid controls.
- Immersive Atmosphere – Authentic racket sounds, ball bounces, and a dynamic crowd.
- Multiple Court Surfaces – Adapt your strategy to grass, clay, and hard courts.

Train, compete, and become a tennis master!

70010000094548.name: Zombie Scream
70010000094548.intro: Tsugunohi × Horror Game Scream Streamer OdaKen! The buzzworthy collaboration game
70010000094548.description:
ABOUT THIS GAME
The daily-life-invasion horror game Tsugunohi collides with streamer Odaken in the collaborative title Zombie Scream, now finally on Nintendo Switch™
Gameplay remains as simple as ever: move the protagonist to the left, advance relentlessly, and replay their everyday routine with no complex controls—just press forward and repeat
Originally when first shown in 2020 only Odaken was playable; this Nintendo Switch™ edition adds a brand-new branching ending so you can now experience two distinct conclusions
Take control of Odaken himself and feel the terror haunting this damp, oppressive town
Tsugunohi’s eerie atmosphere and Odaken’s unique personality mesh perfectly, offering thrills both to fans of the series and to Odaken supporters

STORY
Odaken, a Japanese game streamer living alone in a suburban apartment, posts videos of his gameplay day after day. Unnoticed at first, his ordinary life shifts inexorably into a nightmare—and beyond it lurks the ultimate horror

PROFILE
Tsugunohi series: a horror-invading-daily-life game in which the protagonist walks sideways along various paths, witnessing the creep of terror into ordinary scenes. A flagship indie horror creation by ImCyan
Odaken: known for his lighthearted banter, he streams horror titles and goofy games alike, and also shares piano performances—showcasing his versatile talents

70010000094553.name: Puzzle Wars
70010000094553.intro: Use your brain to win the battle!
70010000094553.description:
"Treat the battlefield like a puzzle - calculate your moves and choose the right tactics to ensure victory. Face the battle! 

Give orders and move your soldiers around the battlefield to control different directions of attack. Use your brain to face the danger. Enemies don't retreat, but you can. You can retreat to win - different tactics work in different situations.  Take the initiative and attack! 

Take your chance and not only protect your territory - attack and destroy all your enemies. Show no mercy. It was their choice to start the battle.  

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Let's go to victory! "

70010000094558.name: God Wars
70010000094558.intro: Loot and roguelike thrills await. Begin your epic action RPG adventure!
70010000094558.description:
Classic Loot-Based RPG: 9 unique classes × 9 weapon types × 600+ pieces of gear × 200+ pets × 180 relics. Mix and match freely to create your ultimate build!

Epic Adventure Awaits: Explore 6 distinct worlds and conquer 6 completely different loops. Enjoy over 50 hours of thrilling, loot-filled gameplay!

70010000094563.name: UFO Builder
70010000094563.intro: Meet the new kind of UFO!
70010000094563.description:
Take control of a new kind of UFO - the Builder! There is nothing to destroy or steal. On the contrary, you can help Earthlings build or rebuild their homes.  

Fly to construction sites and use the capabilities of your futuristic ships to help. Each house is different, and you must rebuild them piece by piece. Imagine the surprise and gratitude of the inhabitants for such help! 

Besides building - defend your buildings from enemies who want to interfere with you and try to destroy them.    

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

UFO not only destroy - they can help build!

70010000094568.name: Pixel Warrior
70010000094568.intro: Only forward - towards the enemies! Without fear!
70010000094568.description:
There are many missions ahead of you in which you will have to show your strongest sides - do not be afraid, keep moving forward and destroy all the enemies on your way! 

Go through each level and wipe out all the enemies on your way. Choose the right trajectories in advance to avoid lingering on the platforms and get rid of enemies with a single blow. Use the materials around you - it will make your job easier! 

Be careful, as your mission is also to save innocent hostages and help them return home safely. So aim carefully and don't make any mistakes.   

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Attack the enemies and don't get hit!

70010000094573.name: Hitman: Absolution
70010000094573.description:
Branded a traitor and hunted by the Agency he once served, Agent 47 returns to Nintendo Switch™ in lethal form.

Stalk your targets through elaborate environments designed to reward both quick thinking and patient planning. Strike silently from the shadows, or let your silverballers do the talking — whatever your approach, each of Absolution’s 20 missions is a contract killer’s happy hunting ground that invites exploration, experimentation and improvisation.

MORE THAN A NUMBER
The story of Absolution puts Agent 47’s character under the spotlight, where his loyalties and his conscience are both put to the test.

TAILORED TO NINTENDO SWITCH
Featuring gyro aiming for ultimate precision, Absolution is fully optimised for Nintendo Switch and tailored for play at home or on the go.

KILLER INSTINCT
Use Instinct Mode to identify targets, predict enemy movements, and highlight points of interest.

CLEAR YOUR PATH
Point Shooting lets you stop time, mark multiple enemies, and eliminate them in a heartbeat.

MASTER THE CRAFT
Find new ways to take out your marks, complete Challenges, and perfect your technique.

PLAY IT AGAIN AND AGAIN
Choose from 5 different difficulty settings, from easy to the insanely hard Purist mode.

70010000094576.name: Söldner-X 2: Final Prototype Definitive Edition
70010000094576.intro: Experience the complete version of a modern shoot’em up classic packed with intense side-scrolling bullet hell action!
70010000094576.description:
A side-scrolling shooter sensation returns, bigger and bolder than ever before! Blending traditional arcade gameplay with scorching HD visuals and rocking audio presentation, Söldner-X 2: Final Prototype Definitive Edition is laser-focused on bringing everything the genre is known for into the current generation, from its sophisticated sci-fi narrative to strategic weapon juggling and rewarding power-up mechanics inspired by genre classics.

Dynamic score-linked difficulty, a challenge mode that rewards skillful performance with bonus features, devastating limit attacks and a pumping soundtrack with 30 original music pieces are just the beginning. Online scoreboards, stunning weapon and boss effects, rebalanced difficulty and a new gallery mode are now included. This is the ultimate realization of Söldner-X 2, fully revised and reborn!

• Master 10 stages of blistering shoot’em up action!
• Choose from 3 ships, each tuned for a unique play style.
• Take down fierce and gigantic bosses!
• Unlock a variety of bonuses, some useful and others purely prestigious.
• Discover the brand new gallery mode.
• Enjoy HD presentation in 60 fps with almost no load times!

70010000094581.name: Anime Waifu Simulator: Sakura Garden
70010000094581.intro: Decorate, relax, and unwind in your perfect garden with beautiful girls~
70010000094581.description:
Immerse yourself in the tranquil beauty of Japanese style as you craft your perfect garden in Anime Waifu Simulator: Sakura Garden. Surrounded by elegant sakura trees, flowing streams, and serene ponds, you'll create a peaceful retreat where beauty and calm reign. 

Decorate your space with traditional Japanese elements like bamboo, stone lanterns, and koi fish, while spending relaxing moments with your charming waifus. 

Let the soothing atmosphere and gentle sounds of nature help you unwind, as you create a place of peace, elegance, and serenity. 

Relax, breathe, and enjoy the simple beauty of a Japanese-inspired garden.

70010000094594.name: Barista Coffee Simulator
70010000094594.intro: A Cozy Café Adventure, Brewed to Perfection.
70010000094594.description:
Welcome to Barista Coffee Simulator, where your love for coffee becomes the heart of a growing café business. Start with a simple machine and a handful of ingredients, then build your way up by crafting beautiful, flavorful drinks for every kind of customer—from early-morning regulars to curious first-timers.

As your café gains popularity, you’ll expand your menu with new recipes, upgrade your equipment for better performance, and carefully manage supplies to keep everything running smoothly. Hire and train staff to help during busy hours, and give your space a personal touch with décor and layout choices that make your café truly your own.

Whether you're steaming milk for the perfect cappuccino or juggling a dozen custom orders, Barista Coffee Simulator blends creativity, strategy, and charm. Build a cozy spot that keeps customers coming back—and maybe, just maybe, survive one more customer asking if their triple-shot macchiato was organic.

70010000094609.name: Carrier Deck
70010000094609.intro: Command the chaos on a modern aircraft carrier
70010000094609.description:
Anyone can hold the helm when the sea is calm...

But can you manage the deck of the Nimitz-class nuclear powered supercarrier, the USS Ronald Regan (CVN-76)?

Carrier Deck is a fast paced time management game where you will play as the Air Officer on board a CVN-76 in the midst of active war. You, alone, are responsible for all aspects of operations involving aircraft on the ship and you'll need to work fast to ensure everything happens in time for the highest chances of warfare success.

Load the right planes and helicopters up and ready them for the required military missions. Manage both launching and landing the planes, avoiding crashes that could spread throughout the deck wrecking multiple planes and damaging the ship.

In Carrier Deck, you'll manage a staggering array of aircrafts including the F18 Hornet and Super Hornet, Chinook and S3 Viking, through a campaign that covers the oceans all over the globe. Test your skills in a full spectrum of operations across the globe in extensive campaign mode, or just try the Skirmish mode for a quick challenge.

FEATURES

1. Full management of the flight deck incl, moving, fueling and arming of aircraft
2. Aircraft maintenance and management of the hangar deck
3. Selecting and launching of search missions to detect enemy air, surface and submarine threats
4. Tasking and launching of intercept missions
5. Special Forces deployment and Amphibious operations
6. Ground strikes and close air support missions
7. Receiving and dispatching cargo missions
8. Full range of aircraft and helicopters onboard from fighters to early warning and detection aircraft.

70010000094611.name: Lost Oasis
70010000094611.intro: Embark on a serene journey through a vast desert, uncovering forgotten oases and hidden mysteries in this relaxing walking simulator.
70010000094611.description:
Uncover Serenity in the Sands
Dive into the tranquility of the desert with Lost Oasis, a walking simulator that invites you to explore a breathtaking world of golden dunes and lush, hidden oases. Designed for relaxation and discovery, this game offers a meditative experience free of stress, enemies, or time limits.

Key Features:
 Vast Desert World: Roam freely across an expansive, open desert with dynamic lighting and soothing soundscapes.
Discover Hidden Oases: Locate vibrant oases filled with ancient ruins, exotic flora, and whispers of a forgotten world.
Fun Objectives: Embark on a casual quest to find secret landmarks, making every step meaningful.

Whether you play for 10 minutes or lose yourself for hours, Lost Oasis offers a peaceful escape into nature.

70010000094626.name: Arcade Archives FIELD DAY
70010000094626.intro: Face off across seven sporting events to become the champion!
70010000094626.description:
"FIELD DAY" is an action game released by TAITO in 1984.
Players compete in a variety of seven non-conventional sporting events from three-legged race to tug-of-war in an effort to become the sports day champion.
Each event features a qualifying score which must be met to progress. 

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000094633.name: Fantasy Jigsaw Puzzle
70010000094633.intro: Immerse yourself in a world of magic and mystery with this relaxing and engaging jigsaw puzzle game!
70010000094633.description:
Featuring 30 beautifully crafted puzzles, each depicting a unique fantasy environment, you'll journey through enchanted forests, mystical castles, celestial realms, and other breathtaking landscapes.

With varying levels of difficulty, Fantasy Jigsaw Puzzle offers a soothing yet rewarding experience for all skill levels. Whether you're looking for a casual, stress-free pastime or a challenging puzzle to test your skills, this game provides the perfect balance of fun and relaxation.

Enjoy intuitive controls, stunning artwork, and an immersive soundtrack as you piece together each magical scene. Get ready to unwind and explore a world of fantasy, one puzzle at a time!

70010000094640.name: Fruitbus
70010000094640.intro: A journey of flavors and friendships awaits you in your cozy, customisable food truck!
70010000094640.description:
Fruitbus is a cute culinary adventure, set in an open world where taste is everything. Upgrade your trusty truck and visit a whole world of new destinations together. 

Discover fresh fruits and vegetables on each island of the Gustum archipelago, learn their customs and cook meals that will make someone’s day.

Upgrade Your Fruitbus
From a giant springy banana to racing wings, customize your Fruitbus to reflect your personality. Find new ways to attract customers with music and bright colors.  

Forage In The Wilds
Treat Mother Earth well as you adventure into the wilds and gather ingredients. Find inspiration for your next top-selling dish in ancient glades, secret groves, and forgotten grottos.

Refine Your Recipes
Upgrade your kitchen to fit your play style. Make fun and original dishes for customers to try or take on the challenge of making the local delicacy.

Food For The Soul
Grow a following of loyal customers and discover their unique stories by creating dishes that evoke feelings and memories. Use the power of food to help and unlock new possibilities for you and your Fruitbus.

70010000094645.name: Special Warfare
70010000094645.intro: Nintendo Switch™ Exclusive & High Quality Graphics! Experience a Middle Eastern battlefield in a sandstorm that unfolds in gritty realism across a vast open field!
70010000094645.description:
Experience the reality of war in the Middle East on an open battlefield! Stunning, high-quality graphics bring the harrowing realities of combat to life. Use the unique weapon specializations of four different characters to cooperate and enjoy strategic gameplay. Assume the role of an elite Special Forces operative and navigate the interference of international special forces and terrorist organizations to secure or destroy Akra's advanced technology in the Special Warfare mission. Unleash your full potential in the final battle to decide the future of mankind. Amidst the deafening gunfire and flying shrapnel, it is you who will emerge a hero!

・Immersive environments and ultra-high-definition graphics bring the battlefield to life, from sand to bricks!
・Realistic graphics deliver an exhilarating battlefield experience.
・Join the ranks of an elite special forces unit and complete the Special Warfare mission.
・Unparalleled Realism! Enjoy a truly immersive experience with 3D sound and 3D physics engines.
・Stunning visuals! Realistic graphics perfectly recreate the lighting and shadows of an intense battlefield.
・Strategic gameplay is possible through the unique characteristics of four roles: Assault, Engineer, Support and Recon.
・Prove your combat skills in Deathmatch mode, where you go head-to-head with your enemies!
・Gain the tactical advantage by capturing battle zones in Domination Mode!
・Plant bombs in designated locations and defend against enemies trying to defuse them in Search and Destroy mode!
・Maximize your gun control with precise aiming and tilting systems to achieve victory.
・Experience the thrill of victory through teamwork that will keep you on the edge of your seat!

The intense, sandstorm-swept battlefield of the Middle East is reborn in photo-realistic detail! Work with four elite characters and use their unique special weapons to strategically lead to victory. Experience the thrill of a realistic battlefield that will ignite the passion of military enthusiasts! Enjoy precise gun control in the midst of tension. The game features stunning, photorealistic graphics created with a variety of 3D effects and remarkable rendering techniques. Don't miss out on Special Warfare, the ultimate team-based single player FPS where you fight alongside your comrades!

Synopsis 
In the year 2042, the desert of the Middle East becomes the new battleground! As desertification and resource depletion continue due to global warming, the Middle East is transformed into a region where the interests of the world's major powers clash over resource scarcity and political instability. In the midst of this chaos, the legendary ancient city of 'Akra' suddenly appears.

This city, Akra, harbors vast resources and extraordinarily advanced technologies left behind by ancient civilizations, and its very existence ignites the ambitions of nations. Despite the outward appearance of diplomacy, the struggle for control of Akra becomes a fierce covert battle between elite special forces. The technology that this city possesses holds the potential to bring unprecedented benefits to mankind, as well as the danger of plunging the world into destruction and chaos. Who will claim this power? And will the outcome be one of hope or despair?

Now begins the mission of Special Warfare! You will join an elite Special Forces unit and plunge into a battle of life and death. You must navigate the interference of international special forces and terrorist organizations, and face the ultimate decision of whether to secure or destroy Akra's technology. In the final battle, you will use all your skills to make a crucial decision that will shape the future of mankind.

70010000094650.name: Moorhuhn 2
70010000094650.intro: The Hunt is On: More Than Just Shooting! Uncover hidden puzzles, secrets, and interactive objects in the wildest chicken hunt of all time.
70010000094650.description:
The legendary hunt continues! Experience Moorhuhn 2, the official sequel to the cult classic, perfectly ported for the Nintendo Switch™.

Strategy is Everything:
Every chicken awards points based on its distance and flight path. But true pros know there's more to it than just the birds: hit hidden targets like balloons, frogs, or even a spider to really rack up those points.

The Goal:
The goal is simple: bag as many chickens as you can in 90 seconds. But this time, there's way more depth than just blasting away! The world of Moorhuhn 2 is an interactive playground packed with secrets. Pan across the landscape and discover tons of ways to maximize your score.

Discover the Secrets:
Don't just spray and pray! If you only focus on the chickens, you'll miss out on the real fun. The game rewards curious players. Find out what happens when you shoot the scarecrow, or how hitting specific objects grants valuable bonus time or powerful special ammo. But be careful: avoid hitting the airplane, or you'll face a point penalty!

Relive the timeless classic featuring its original graphics and iconic sound design. It's the perfect recipe to keep you coming back for just one more high-score run.

70010000094656.name: .catMilk 2
70010000094656.intro: The highly successful adventure of the cat who needs to drink milk continues, now the game .catMilk receives its return: .catMilk 2
70010000094656.description:
Get ready to test your reflexes and skills in this challenging platformer! Take control of a determined little cat who must overcome obstacles and find the right path to reach its goal.

With simple controls but increasing difficulty, each level demands precision and strategy to move forward. As you progress, new challenges arise, making the journey even more intense. Only the most skilled players will conquer every stage and prove that nothing stands between a cat and its milk!

70010000094660.name: Arcade Archives RIDGE RACER
70010000094660.description:
"RIDGE RACER" is a racing game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1993.
Experience the essence of virtual reality using the 3D CG system "System 22."
This game has four modes to choose from, including three difficulty levels - NOVICE, INTERMEDIATE, and ADVANCED - as well as T.T. (TIME TRIAL), where you compete one-on-one against a rival car to achieve the best time. Additionally, a DX version featuring support for an H-shifter and clutch is also included.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000094665.name: Arcade Archives NEBULASRAY
70010000094665.intro: Become a "Resistance Army" and defeat the "Suppression Army"!!
70010000094665.description:
"NEBULASRAY" is a shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1994.
Become a member of the Resistance Army and defeat the Suppression Army organized by the Unified Forces, which has staged a coup d'état.
The key to winning is to acquire items that appear along the way and strengthen your ship.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*This game uses the Japanese ROM for the main part of the game.
*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000094676.name: CyberCorp
70010000094676.intro: Brutal isometric co-op loot shooter in cyberpunk world. Equipment based combos, exotic weapons and armors. Easy to start, hard to master. Play solo or online multiplayer with friends
70010000094676.description:
You are a CyberCorp fighter. In your hands lies a unique and dangerous technology - the Synth, a remotely controlled combat shell. Are you ready to take your weapon and return order to the streets of the city?

Flexible progression system
Upgrade your equipment using a card-based system of weapon and armor enhancements. Build and customize to match your playstyle.

Online Multiplayer
Play story and side missions with friends or random players. Equip smart and make builds for combos.

Slums, factories, laboratories, elite residential complex
Complete missions in various locations, explore the city of the future. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of cyberpunk.

Fast paced gameplay
Defend objects, hack security systems, capture control points, and uncover hidden items.

Loot shooter
Choose your difficulty level and get the rewards. There's something for those who seek a more casual experience or a hardcore challenge.

Procedural level generation
Map, enemies, loot, encounters, weather, boss, reward are all randomized each run.

70010000094683.name: EGGCONSOLE HOW MANY ROBOT PC-8801mkIISR
70010000094683.intro: A puzzle game with simulation elements. Program the robot's behavior patterns and guide it to defuse bombs in the maze!
70010000094683.description:
Here is the robot that will be delivered to you.

This robot is the only one that can enter the mysterious land called "The Land of Mirrors." However, right now, a time bomb has been set in this strange land, and it is about to be destroyed. Please use this robot to disarm the time bomb within the time limit. To save the fantastic Land of Mirrors... (From the user manual)

This game is a puzzle game released in 1987 in Japan. The player teaches a robot, equipped with artificial intelligence, to remember action patterns and disarm bombs. The game has two main objectives: the first is the primary goal of finding the time bomb and transporting it to the bomb disposal unit within the time limit; the second is to train and educate the robot, giving it learning abilities, making it smarter, and handling the puzzles effectively. This training and development of the robot is one of the main attractions of the game.

The maze stages contain areas lit by "lamps" and "batteries," creating illuminated spaces, and areas that are in darkness. In the illuminated spaces, the robot can be freely controlled, but in the dark spaces, some of the robot's controls are restricted, and you will need to rely on the robot's autonomy to progress.

Since the robot moves using light as energy, its energy depletes in the dark spaces. If its energy reaches zero, the game is over. Effectively teaching the robot to act accurately in the dark spaces will be the key to successfully completing the game.

This game combines simulation elements of robot training with puzzle elements for disarming time bombs. It is recommended for those who want to enjoy both genres.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000094686.name: Train Plus
70010000094686.intro:
The ultimate railway driving game has arrived!
Experience mind-blowing speeds over 1000km/h or enjoy complete freedom in Free Drive!
70010000094686.description:
The fictional railway “Kowa Railway,” boasting over 500,000 views on YouTube, now comes to life as a game!
Explore a sprawling route of 11 stations in total freedom.
In the “Free Drive Mode,” there’s no scoring and no automatic stops—stop or pass stations, open and close doors, and play in-train announcements exactly as you wish.
For an adrenaline rush, switch to the “Overdrive Mode” and experience speeds exceeding 1000km/h!
Open or close doors wherever you like, use a free camera to view your train from any angle, and even run side by side with AI-controlled trains.
Sound the horn, play station arrival announcements, and enjoy carefully crafted departure melodies to immerse yourself in a truly authentic atmosphere.
Feel free to blow the whistle when closing the doors or add any detail you like.
Plus, it supports the “ZUIKI” train controller for an even more realistic operation.
Get ready for a brand-new train driving experience!

This work is in no way affiliated with any real-world railway company.

70010000094691.name: RAIDEN FIGHTERS REMIX COLLECTION
70010000094691.intro: Three score-driven classics from the Raiden Fighters series return alongside modern features and remix music!
70010000094691.description:
Three legendary arcade titles from SEIBU KAIHATSU's Raiden Fighters series return, revived from the depths of time.

Choose between the Japanese version and a hardcore International version!

Enjoy convenient features like rapid-fire button configuration, Practice Mode, and a restart function. 

Great for both first-time players and those returning to 2D shooting games after a long break!

The remix soundtrack includes 30 tracks drawn from the stage and boss music from each title.

Enjoy the music on the sound player, and assign music to each stage just as you like with a mode.

Customize the experience to your liking and discover a new world of Raiden Fighters!

Participating Artists: SOSHI HOSOI/KAZUHIRO TSURUKUBO/YUKI ARAI

Check out the wallpaper customization, an authentic arcade-style CRT filter, and Vertical Screen Mode (monitor rotation) that deliver a vivid sense of presence that goes beyond the arcade experience.

Play the reborn Raiden Fighters in its bold new form to your heart's content!

■ Contents (Choose between the Japanese/International Version)
RAIDEN FIGHTERS
RAIDEN FIGHTERS 2
RAIDEN FIGHTERS JET

70010000094696.name: RAIDEN FIGHTERS 2 REMIX
70010000094696.intro: The score-driven classic that thrilled shooters everywhere, Raiden Fighters 2, returns with modern features and remix music!
70010000094696.description:
The legendary SEIBU KAIHATSU arcade game Raiden Fighters 2 returns, revived from the depths of time.

Choose between the Japanese version and a hardcore International version!

Enjoy convenient features like rapid-fire button configuration, Practice Mode, and a restart function. 

Great for both first-time players and those returning to 2D shooting games after a long break!

The remix soundtrack includes all stage and boss music from Raiden Fighters 2.

Enjoy the music on the sound player, and assign music to each stage just as you like with a mode.

Customize the experience to your liking and discover a new world of Raiden Fighters 2!
Participating Artist: KAZUHIRO TSURUKUBO

Check out the wallpaper customization, an authentic arcade-style CRT filter, and Vertical Screen Mode (monitor rotation) that deliver a vivid sense of presence that goes beyond the arcade experience.
Play the reborn Raiden Fighters 2 in its bold new form to your heart's content!

70010000094700.description:
The legendary SEIBU KAIHATSU arcade game Raiden Fighters JET returns, revived from the depths of time.

70010000094704.name: RAIDEN FIGHTERS REMIX
70010000094704.intro: The score-driven classic that thrilled shooters everywhere, Raiden Fighters, returns with modern features and remix music!
70010000094704.description:
The legendary SEIBU KAIHATSU arcade game Raiden Fighters returns, revived from the depths of time.

70010000094708.name: Cozy Stitch Puzzle
70010000094708.intro: Relax, match, and stitch your way through 126 cuddly puzzles full of plushie charm and cozy vibes!
70010000094708.description:
Unwind with Cozy Stitch Puzzle – a heartwarming puzzle game full of cuddly fun! Match colorful plushie pairs across 126 cozy levels, each uniquely generated for endless replayability. With 9 delightful plushie categories – from animals and sea creatures to magical beings and toys – every puzzle feels like stitching together a soft and soothing story.

Choose your difficulty and play at your own pace – it’s the perfect pick for cozy gamers of all ages!

- 126 puzzles
- 3 difficulty levels
- 9 adorable plushie themes
- Infinite replay thanks to procedural generation

Get comfy and start stitching today!

70010000094723.name: Tentacle Tango
70010000094723.intro: Two octos on a precision mission! Swing through a cute but brutal world. Master the tango of teamwork solo or in local/online co-op. Can you defeat Chef Murgó?
70010000094723.description:
COORDINATE OR CRUMBLE! To survive this mission, you'll need to grab a Joy-Con™ and get ready to swing into action. Take control of the inseparable duo, Ten and Tango, as they embark on a high-stakes platforming journey to topple the villainous Chef Murgó.

Don’t let the cute art style fool you—this is a relentless test of skill where one slip-up sends both octos tumbling. Whether you’re tackling the challenge Solo (mastering the "brain-melting" art of controlling both characters at once) or syncing up in Local or Online Co-op, your coordination will be pushed to the absolute limit.

WHY YOU’LL BE TANGLED UP:
DECEPTIVELY DIFFICULT: Master the timing of two octos holding hands. It’s quirky, colorful, and punishingly hard.

TANDEM TEAMWORK: Use your physical bond to swing across massive gaps and dodge lethal traps. In this game, you literally "carry" your partner!

DIVERSE WORLDS: Navigate windy deserts, crumbling lava mountains, and intricate puzzles that demand 100% precision.

PERFECT FOR SWITCH: Play anytime, anywhere in Tabletop, Handheld, or TV mode. One Joy-Con per player is all you need for local co-op!

GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS: Think you’re the fastest on the planet? Prove it! Compete for the best times against players worldwide.

GAME MODES:
* 2-Player Online or Local Co-op: The ultimate test of friendship and physics.
* Solo Mode: A unique mental challenge where you must coordinate both octos simultaneously.

70010000094728.name: Folly of the Wizards
70010000094728.description:
Folly Of The Wizards is a comedic 2D roguelike action game that puts you in the shoes of a clumsy wizard apprentice. Join a wacky wizard cult and use unique spells to defeat enemies, explore procedurally generated dungeons, and save the world from chaos.

But beware: the fate of the world rests on your shoulders, and even the smallest decision can have a huge impact. With charming hand-drawn art, quirky characters, and unpredictable gameplay, Folly of the Wizards is the perfect adventure for anyone who loves humor, magic, and mayhem.

EXPLORE A BEAUTIFUL 2D WORLD 
Adventure yourself in a beautiful 2D world illustrated with captivating detail and charm. From the quirky wizard cults to the magical creatures that roam the land, immerse yourself in a world filled with humor and wonder. Every pixel has been crafted with love and care to bring this unique universe to life.

MAKE FRIENDS OR ENEMIES 
In Folly of the Wizards, your social skills are just as important as your wizardry abilities. Will you befriend the elite wizards and gain powerful allies, or will you stand up against them and face their wrath? With every decision and conversation, you can shape your relationships and alter the course of your adventure.

REPLAYABILITY 
Each time you adventure in Folly Of The Wizards, new experiences and relationships await you. With more than 100 items to find, more than 10 regions to explore, and new relationships to build, your experience will never be the same.

LEARN POWERFUL SPELLS 
Unleash your inner wizard and learn powerful spells in Folly of the Wizards! But be warned, your wizardly skills may not be up to par as you stumble your way through casting spells clumsily and incorrectly. To make matters worse, you can't even read the wizardry glyphs on your scrolls!

INTRIGUING STORYLINE 
While adventuring in this magic world you will uncover many secrets, and your decisions can change the wheel of events!

70010000094733.name: GIRLS MADE PUDDING
70010000094733.intro:
"When there's nobody there to see you, you disappear."
In Girls Made Pudding, two girls tour a series of towns that people have disappeared from.
70010000094733.description:
《The Gameplay》
1. Come for a Ride
In most games, the story moves forward once your reach a certain destination. In Girls Made Pudding, everything happens during the journey. Nothing will happen if you stay where you are, and by going back on the road where you came from, you'll return to the dialogue you already read once.
Keep the bike moving and the girls chatting and eventually you'll unfold this story's mysteries.

2. Branching Roads, Branching Plot
When you reach a branching road, that means that the plot is going to branch as well.
The story will move forward in different ways depending on whether you keep going straight or take a turn. You can also turn around and go check out a road you didn't choose before but the more you travel, the more the girls' "fullness" will decrease.

3. Gathering and Cooking
On the road, you'll find ingredients that you can cook with.
By eating what you cook, you can increase the girls' fullness and other parameters.
There are some branches in the road that you can only access if the girls' parameters have reached a certain level too. (But you can remove this requirement in the difficulty settings.)

《The Story》
"When there's nobody there to see you, you disappear."
It's weird, but it's been like this for a while now. Almost half a year.
The journey started with Sumibi's wish—"I want to eat that pudding again."
She and Nikomi go on a bike trip, traveling from town to town while looking for ingredients and meeting new people. Little by little, they start understanding what happened to the world.
They keep traveling and they keep looking at each other... lest they disappear.

《The Characters》
Sumibi
A bike-riding girl on a journey. She was a regular at the café where Sumibi use to work.
Nikomi
A girl traveling along with Sumibi. She used to work at a café but she's not very good at baking and cooking.

《The Staff》
Production: KAMITSUBAKI STUDIO
Scenario and development: Kazuhide Oka
Character design and concept art: Zumochi
Art and character models: Zumochi
Soundtrack: Daijiro Nakagawa
Logo art: JEFF99
English Translation: Marco Godano
Simplified/Traditional Chinese Translation: flankoi

70010000094738.name: Cave of Illusions
70010000094738.intro: A psychological indie horror game. While seeking to find the truth about the disappearances in the forest you find a lot more than you expected.
70010000094738.description:
Cave of Illusions surrounds a series of events in Looninville, New Hampshire, where an eight-year-old girl vanishes abruptly. Her name was Addie Baker, and strangely enough, she is not the first to disappear in Looninville. For Lesley Jacobson, now a private phenomenon investigator, Addie Baker was her best friend and neighbor growing up. Twenty-eight-years later, Lesley is still haunted by the night Addie disappeared, as she was the only one to witness it, or was she?

Deciding to combine her personal and professional life, Lesley returns to Looninville to close the mystery and move forward in life with her daughter. Lacking to find any concrete evidence or input from the skittish locals, Lesley returns to the one place that appears to be at the center of these strange occurrences, a cave. The uneasy problem with this, is that Lesley does not remember there ever being a cave at all.

Cave of Illusions is a psychological, atmospheric horror game that will have you questioning every step taken as the reality around you will begin to shift. Things are not always as they seem, even when witnessed with the naked eye, and one must pursue the constant battle of the mind with remembering what you think you know and understanding what you actually know. How long can one wear the mask of sanity?

70010000094743.name: Big Adventure: Trip To Europe 8 Collector's Edition
70010000094743.intro: A wonderful family vacation in Europe.
70010000094743.description:
This wonderful trip will take you through many tourist destinations in various countries. 
You will enjoy visiting famous tourist sites, exploring European musical culture, ancient castles and much more.

This hidden object game is full of new and popular tourist spots. Use your skills and knowledge to play mini-games and find all the hidden objects.

The collector's edition includes:
- play 10 additional locations 
- find even more objects and a funny raccoon!
- play 8 additional new mini-games + 12 more for puzzle lovers
- collect 20 great souvenirs from the trip

70010000094750.name: Undivine
70010000094750.description:
Undivine is a dark metroidvania with RPG elements that will challenge your courage and wits. Step into a world shrouded in mystery and desolation, where every corner hides dangers and ancient secrets. The world of Undivine is filled with relics, items, NPCs, bosses, secrets, and much more, all waiting to be discovered. It's a world ready for you to explore. 
 
Known only as the traveler, you arrive at the outskirts of a desolate village. The people there live in fear of a giant hole that has opened in the middle of the village, swallowing most of its residents. Brave warriors have attempted to venture into the chasm, but none have returned. With no other choice, you descend into the abyss, only to find a vast, interconnected world filled with mysteries and mysticism. It is up to you to uncover its secrets. Will you be able to face the one behind it all? 
 
Combat in Undivine is fast and satisfying. Use everything at your disposal to face the many enemies you will encounter. Relics, swords, armor, and accessories have unique features that will change the way you play the game. Combine sword attacks with the powers of your Relics to execute combos and escape from enemies' attacks. Find the best combination that suits your playstyle.
