70010000094757.name: Dog Spotting Challenge!
70010000094757.intro:
Which One Is the Pomeranian!?
A Fun and Relaxing Brain-Training Game
70010000094757.description:
Enjoy adorable dog photos while testing your knowledge in this fun and easy brain-training quiz game!

How to Play：
・Carefully read the question and look at the images.
・Find the correct dog breed and tap it before time runs out!

Learn the names of rare dog breeds from around the world—just like a fun way to pass the time!

If you’re stuck, press the hint button for a little help.
(It’ll roughly show you where to look!)

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000094762.name: Halloween 1985
70010000094762.intro: Face classic horror monsters and retrieve your stolen pumpkins in retro arcade style!
70010000094762.description:
Step into the arcade-era thrill of Halloween 1985!

When monsters steal Pumpkman’s pumpkins on Halloween night, it’s up to you to get them back! Dash through 5 vibrant, quirky levels, outsmarting classic foes like Dracula, The Mummy, and The Witch. Jump, dodge, and battle your way to their lairs, then take on the big boss in a final showdown!

With 3 game modes, a retro chiptune soundtrack, and high-score chasing just like the golden age, this pixel-art platformer delivers fast-paced, nostalgic fun.

Can you reclaim all the pumpkins and become a legend?

• Master 5 Halloween-themed platforming stages.
• Run, jump and dodge as Pumpkman.
• Choose from multiple difficulty settings.
• Take down monstrous bosses.
• Chase high scores in old-school arcade style.
• Enjoy retro pixel art graphics and a chiptune soundtrack.

70010000094767.name: Our Exciting Summer Camp
70010000094767.intro:
It's time for an adventure in the great outdoors!
Enjoy the wonders of nature at this exciting summer camp!
70010000094767.description:
The usual crew heads off to summer camp!
Share Joy-Con™ and play with up to 4 players!

Enjoy "Tent Pitching," "Curry Challenge,"
"Campfire Building," and more for a total of
10 different activities!

Try gathering Collection Coins for yourself,
or challenge all activities in order to become
a true Summer Camp Master!

[Tent Pitching]
Be the fastest to pitch the tent!

[Kindling Race]
Pick up kindling and deliver it to the teachers!

[Nature Watching Quiz]
Memorize plants and animals, then take a quiz!

[Bug Collecting Battle]
Look for bugs and catch them!

[Curry Challenge]
Make curry and serve it up!

[River-Crossing Face-Off!]
Cross the river and don't fall in!

[Nighttime Treasure Hunt]
Explore in the dark and hunt for treasure chests!

[Constellation Puzzle]
Connect the stars to form constellations!

[Campfire Building]
Stack firewood to build a sturdy fire!

[Folk Dance Pair]
Find your partner and dance!

70010000094773.name: Hypotheses on the Symmetry between Vision and Hands
70010000094773.intro:
A Mind-Bending Run Action Game
A bizarre game where you control the left hand with your left hand and the right hand with your right hand.
70010000094773.description:
Participation Guide for the Experiment
Thank you for your interest in the hypothesis regarding the symmetry between vision and hand movement.

This experiment aims to measure the ability to transmit information from vision to the brain and from the brain to the hands using a game, and to verify whether this ability improves through repetition.

In the game, you control the left hand with your left hand and the right hand with your right hand to reach the goal.
The hands can change movement direction, jump, and run.
Although it is a simple game, controlling two separate hands independently may cause significant stress for participants.
Please do not force yourself to continue the experiment and take breaks as needed.

70010000094778.name: Hentai Girls: Flight Crush
70010000094778.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000094778.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000094780.name: Monument Valley 3
70010000094780.intro: Set sail for adventure in MONUMENT VALLEY 3, a brand new story in the award-winning Monument Valley series.
70010000094780.description:
Guide Noor, an apprentice lightkeeper, through impossible monuments, shifting landscapes, and tranquil seascapes to uncover the Sacred Light and save her home.

Monument Valley 3 takes you beyond the monuments and into the open sea. As Noor, you’ll navigate stunning, changing environments, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover the secrets of the Sacred Light. With her village threatened by rising tides, Noor must chart her own course—and discover her own strength—in this stunning, emotional adventure.

Sail between geometry, manipulate architecture to reveal hidden paths, and let the iconic soundtrack guide you forward. With new mechanics, breathtaking visuals, and the series' signature charm, Monument Valley 3 is a voyage like no other.

Features:

- Defy Perspective: Rotate and manipulate the environment to reveal hidden paths, solve intricate puzzles

- Uncover The Mystery: Help Noor unlock the secrets of this ever-changing world.

- Beautiful Art: A stunning world inspired by modern design, global architecture and hand-crafted, personal stories.

- Every Update Included: Full Story is included, with brand new updates to come

Adventure awaits—will you uncover the light that guides the way?

ustwo games are proud independent developers, best known for the award-winning Monument Valley series, Land’s End, Assemble with Care and Alba: A Wildlife Adventure.

70010000094798.name: Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club
70010000094798.intro: There’s No Case Snoopy Can’t Solve!
70010000094798.description:
Join Snoopy and the gang in an all-new mystery adventure packed with charm, clever puzzles, and heartwarming friendships! Step into Snoopy’s paws and detective hat as you explore the town, solve challenging cases, and uncover hidden secrets—with help from the lovable Peanuts gang.

Whether you're investigating strange happenings at the school, chasing clues through the forest, each case is filled with brain-teasing challenges and unexpected surprises. Build your own team of four from familiar friends such as Peppermint Patty, Lucy, Marcie, Schroeder, Franklin and others—each bringing their own special skills to the case.
Lighthearted, witty, and full of classic Peanuts charm, this feel-good action-puzzle adventure is ideal for both the young and the young at heart!
 
KEY FEATURES:

• PLAY AS SNOOPY!: Snoopy’s on the case as you take charge of The Great Mystery Club! Build your custom squad of the lovable Peanuts gang—each with unique abilities and quirky strengths that bring fun and strategy to every puzzle.

• EXPLORE ICONIC LOCATIONS: Journey through the town as you solve mysteries and puzzles. Visit the gang’s school, the iconic music hall, Charlie Brown’s house, the baseball field, the Kite eating tree, and more as you uncover surprises and twists!

• SNOOPY’S ON THE CASE: Switch between Snoopy’s personas—Detective, Beagle Scout, Fierce Pirate, and more—to solve puzzles with clever tools like a leaf blower, a super-sleuth's magnifying glass, a trusty metal detector, and more. Each role unlocks fun new ways to crack part of the case!

• MYSTERY CLUB MINI-GAMES:  Take some swings at home plate, try kicking the football, work in the lab, play a tune, and race to the finish! Have a blast with baseball, football, crafting, memory tests, object hunts, piano playing, soapbox derbies—and take flight in the legendary Sopwith Camel to chase down the Red Baron!

• A STORY PACKED WITH HEART & HUMOR:  Enjoy humorous and delightful encounters and an emotional story that celebrates the power of friendship, teamwork, and staying true to who you are.

• INTERACTIVELY IMMERSERSE YOURSLE IN THE WORLD PEANUTS: With its charming creative direction and gameplay, enjoy a visually stunning adventure that combines modern, soft graphics with the nostalgic, adventurous tone of the beloved Peanuts brand.

70010000094800.name: Sweet Home: Look and Find 2 Collector's Edition
70010000094800.intro: Grab a warm blanket and get comfortable for more object-seeking!
70010000094800.description:
The fun first sequel in the series that proves that home is where the heart is! 
Take a nature hike, chill by the pool, and fire up the backyard grill while you hone your skills in each challenging level! 
While you're here, customize your room with decorations and furnishings, purchase items from a vast inventory, and make your space your own! Welcome home!

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- Keep the fun going with eight exclusive locations!
- Chill out with the exclusive music player!
- Eight bonus and replayable mini-games just for you!

70010000094804.name: Endoparasitic
70010000094804.intro:
Three limbs ripped off,
infected with a deadly parasite,
you must save your research!
70010000094804.description:
Endoparasitic is a tactical survival horror game where you must manually do every action from reloading to moving. Juggle movement and firing and plan room entrances to avoid getting swarmed.

Drag yourself through the corridors of a secret research lab on a remote asteroid, fight off horribly mutated monsters, inject countless syringes of vaccines, and survive at all costs.

Features:
- Guns are manually loaded one bullet at a time
- Your health bar is a parasite burrowing to your brain
- Stealth sections
- Puzzles
- Story and characters
- Various mutated monsters to fight
- Boss fights
- Four guns

70010000094810.name: Antarctica 88: Remaster
70010000094810.intro: Survive horror and very creepy action adventure in new top free scary game!
70010000094810.description:
Antarctica 88 is a terrifying action-horror experience that takes you deep into the icy wastelands of Antarctica. Immerse yourself in a chilling sci-fi story filled with monstrous creatures, powerful weapons, and thrilling adventures. This survival horror will test your courage—so get ready to scream and solve mind-bending puzzles!

Do you have what it takes to escape the horrors hidden beneath the Antarctic ice?

Can you save yourself—and humanity—from an ancient evil?

Your journey takes place at Antarctica 1, a remote research station where your father, Vladimir Efimov, and his team have spent the last six months drilling through the ice, uncovering prehistoric minerals. But six weeks ago, all communication with the expedition was lost. Now, as part of a four-person rescue squad, you must venture into the unknown, uncover the terrifying truth, and fight for your survival.

Explore the station, gather useful items, solve puzzles, and piece together the dark mystery—while battling against unimaginable horrors. But beware: Antarctica 88 features multiple endings, and the fate of the story depends entirely on your choices.

Can you unlock all the endings and uncover the full truth? Or will the ice claim you forever?

70010000094821.name: Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer
70010000094821.intro: Join in All the Reindeer Games—And Save Christmas!
70010000094821.description:
Dash into the enchanting world of Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer and embark on a holly jolly quest to save Christmas in this magical adventure inspired by the beloved 1964 animated classic! Journey through Rudolph’s winter wonderlands, including Christmastown, the Island of Misfit Toys, and more as you help Rudolph and his friends overcome challenges in their quest to save Christmas from an unexpected but certain holiday disaster. Experience joyful exploration, exciting holiday challenges, and cooperative gameplay in a fun and festive experience the whole family is sure to enjoy!

Key Game Features:

A BELOVED HOLIDAY CLASSIC – NOW INTERACTIVE: Immerse yourself in the timeless magic of Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer like never before! Step into a vibrant, interactive winter wonderland filled with festive charm, playful exploration, and engaging challenges that bring the beloved holiday tale to life in a whole new way.

MAGICAL WINTER WONDERLANDS: Journey through four enchanting holiday realms straight from the beloved classic, each bursting with holiday cheer, whimsical surprises, and heartwarming adventures!

• Christmastown – Join the Reindeer Games, learn to fly, and help Santa’s elves prepare for the big night!
• Island of Misfit Toys – Team up with quirky, lovable toys to give them a chance to shine and find their forever homes!
• Mountain Caves – Brave icy tunnels, dodge falling icicles, and outsmart the fearsome Abominable Snow Monster!
• Santa’s Castle – Work alongside Santa and the elves to gather last-minute gifts, power up the sleigh, and light the way for a Christmas miracle!

PLAY AS ICONIC CHARACTERS: Step into the hooves of Rudolph and Clarice and the boots of Hermey and Yukon Cornelius – each with their own unique charm and abilities, making every moment of the adventure a holly jolly delight!

JOYFUL CO-OP FUN: Grab a friend, play in local co-op as you shout out with glee as you  experience this cheerful holiday adventure together.

FAMILY-FRIENDLY & FULL OF HOLIDAY SPIRIT: With fun challenges, interactive storytelling, and a soundtrack with iconic Christmas favorites, this game is perfect for festive players of all ages.

Get ready for the ultimate Christmas quest—guide Rudolph, spread holiday cheer, and light up the season with festive fun for the whole family!

70010000094826.name: Pardon My French Toast
70010000094826.intro: Pardon My French Toast is a 3D platformer starring a slice of toast who covers himself in sweet spreads to get fun abilities.
70010000094826.description:
Learn a dozen abilities, each more amazing than the last!
■ STICKY HONEY - Spread honey on your face to stick to objects and climb walls
■ POWERFUL CHOCOLATE - Use hardened chocolate to break obstacles

A piece of cake?!
■ VACATIONS GONE WRONG - Welcome to the Jam Session Cruise! Lucky you, you just happened to stumble across a ticket for a lovely vacation at sea! At least, until you discover that this boat can barely float!
■ DELICIOUSLY SWEET LEVELS - Explore dozens of levels and find huge candies to fuel the boat. From fruity cakes to tropical jungles to haunted floating islands (and more!), get bready for some tasty sights!
■ FRIENDLY TOASTS EVERYWHERE - You're not alone on this cruise; lots of other toasts are along for the ride! Get to know them: they’ve all got a good reason for being there. Maybe you can help them?
■ NEO-RETRO GAMEPLAY - Got a taste for platformers? Discover this toast's original moveset: slap, aerial dash, French toast (absorb and spit out liquid!!)... No spoilers, we'll stop the list here...
■ TONS OF COLLECTIBLES - Like collecting lots of shiny little things? You’re going to loaf it! Reach for the stars with 100% completion!!!
■ CHALLENGES FOR THE BRAVE - Want to give yourself a slice of hard mode? This cruise has some nice surprises in store! But don't panic, all these challenges are optional.

70010000094831.name: Clutter's Greatest Hits Collector's Edition
70010000094831.intro: Super challenging Clutter yet, with over 2000 puzzles!
70010000094831.description:
So many new Clutter variations mixed in with old favorites for a Quest you'll never forget.
The Collector's Edition with 25% more puzzles and additional bonus materials.
As always, the Clutter levels are highly addicting and replayable.
In addition, there are Sliders, Square Jigsaws and Box Quotes with a new Variation.
And wait until you see the Plushies and Pinwheels and Totally Remastered Pop-Up Boxes.
You've never seen Clutter this fun and challenging.
And as always, the options let you play Clutter the way you want.
And Favorites are back so you can collect the puzzles you want to play again and again.

- New Object Sets and Many New Gameplay Modes
- Over 2000 levels and a very challenging 100 level Main Quest
- A Hyper Quest and a Bonus Mega-Mix + a Hidden Demo Reel!!!
- Hundreds of picture puzzles and 200 new Box Quotes puzzles
- Randomly generated levels mean endless replayability
- All New Soundtrack with a Cinematic Feel.

70010000094835.name: Clutter RefleXIVe: The Diceman Cometh Collector's Edition
70010000094835.intro: Ultra challenging Clutter yet, with over 2400 puzzles!
70010000094835.description:
With over 2400 puzzles, tons of new Clutter variations mixed in with old favorites, and a variety of clever mini-games, 
Clutter RefleXIVe: The Diceman Cometh offers a clutter quest you'll never forget! 
You'll face challenging puzzles, including Sliders, Square Jigsaws, Box Quotes, while you triumph over a huge collection of clutter puzzles! 
Gear up for a mind-bending, cluttered mess of fun!

70010000094840.name: AnimalDon!
70010000094840.intro: Save the Species! Escape Earth Before the Meteor Strikes!
70010000094840.description:
A massive meteor is hurtling toward Earth—and it’s up to you to save as many species as possible!

About the Game
Load animals onto your ship and escape in this action-packed puzzle game!
But be warned—heavy animals will rock the boat and take up precious space.
You'll need to balance species, weight, and space while aiming to rescue as many paired males and females as you can to ensure the survival of each species.

How to Play
Timing your departure is absolutely crucial—you, the captain, decide when to departure!

Once you start loading animals, the countdown begins. The more animals you add, the less time you’ll have before the meteor hits. Push it to the limit and load as many as you can—but don’t wait too long!
No matter how full your ship is, it won’t matter if you don’t escape in time. Gauge the situation, pick the right moment, and launch to survive.

It’s Not Just About the Animals!
You’ll also need to pack essentials like food, supplies—and maybe even a few priceless treasures.
But be careful: overloading your ship or upsetting its balance could spell disaster.
Stack wisely, keep the ship steady, and make a swift getaway!

Game Modes
From quick and casual in Challenge Mode, to high-stakes Hard Mode with tons of animals and leaderboard rankings, to Survival Mode where one mistake means game over—you’ll find a mode for every kind of player.
Try them all and see how many lives you can save!

70010000094845.name: Merchant In Dungeon
70010000094845.intro: This game is about managing shops.Hercules enters Dark Gate Town solo, aiming to repay his father's debt with his friends' help.
70010000094845.description: This game is about managing shops.Hercules enters Dark Gate Town solo, aiming to repay his father's debt. Starting with a store, he grows capital, hires, expands shops, and manages relationships with diverse female NPCs. Dominating the business scene? Quite a challenge!

70010000094850.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Hanam-City
70010000094850.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000094850.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Hanam City, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses. 
High-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to 2 locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Hanam City, Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000094855.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Geomdansan
70010000094855.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000094855.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Geomdansan , Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 3 flight courses. 
High-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000094860.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Bukhan River
70010000094860.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000094860.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Bukhan River, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 4 flight courses. 
High-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000094867.name: Hungry Brain Challenge!
70010000094867.intro:
Which One Is Aqua Pazza…!?
Learn About Rare Dishes From Around the World With a Fun Brain-Training Quiz!
70010000094867.description:
This is a fun trivia quiz game where you look at the name of a rare dish from around the world and quickly choose the correct photo from four options.

・Vichyssoise
・Brandade
・Fricassée

… and many more!
You might have heard of these dishes, but do you know what they look like? Enjoy learning about them as you play!

If you’re ever stuck, press the hint button!
(But be careful—it might give away the answer too easily!)

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000094877.name: EGGCONSOLE GULKAVE MSX
70010000094877.intro: A side-scrolling shooting game with a unique power-up system. Instantly assess the numbers on the items and power up skillfully!
70010000094877.description:
This game is a shooting game released in 1986. The game screen is presented in a side view, and the weapons are limited to just shots, making it a simple gameplay experience.

An essential aspect of this game is the unique power-up system. There is a gauge at the bottom of the screen, and when you collect numeric items dropped by enemies, the lamps on the gauge move to the right by the number you collect. Depending on where it stops, your shot changes. The interesting part is that moving to the right does not necessarily mean a stronger weapon, and you need to instantly assess the numbers and contents of the gauge. If you fail to power-up, you may end up weakening.

The game is also known for its high difficulty level. It's a game with some quirks, but it is undeniably satisfying to master. With 32 stages to conquer, put your skills to the test and enjoy the challenge!


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000094880.name: Hakuoki SSL ~Sweet School Life~
70010000094880.intro: Reunite with familiar faces in a light-hearted modern setting filled with fun and fluffy romance!
70010000094880.description:
The long-running Hakuoki otome visual novel series enters a new era! Hakuoki SSL ~Sweet School Life~ puts a modern spin on the Edo period romance of the main series, instead casting heroine Chizuru and the handsome warriors of the Shinsengumi as students and teachers living in modern Japan. School life antics ensue as these beloved characters hold a school festival, stress over midterms, get into watergun fights and more!

Experience a fun slice-of-life story through unlockable event scenes, engaging dialogue and beautifully illustrated character portraits, all localized in English for the first time. Explore unique endings with each character and enjoy mini-games that make this standalone entry extra special!

• Take the role of Chizuru as she’s surrounded by familiar faces in a new modern setting!
• Engage in fun mini-games with the handsome warriors of the Shinsengumi.
• Make key choices and discover unique endings with each possible love interest!
• Enjoy voiceovers in Japanese and newly localized text in English.
• Navigate scenarios with ease using a variety of UI controls and preferences!

70010000094886.name: Chickenhare and the treasure of Spiking-beard
70010000094886.intro: Embark on a thrilling 3D platformer adventure jump, climb, and swing through several worlds on the quest for the 7 crystals and become a true treasure hunter with Chickenhare & friends!
70010000094886.description:
Adventure is calling! Join Chickenhare and his friends on an epic quest to recover the 7 crystals before the dreaded Spiking-Beard and save the Kingdoms from chaos. Explore magical worlds, solve clever puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets… and who knows? You might just find the path to a real treasure.

A heart-pounding adventure for kids and parents alike—are you ready to become a true treasure hunter?

Play alongside your favorite characters and their unique abilities:

Chickenhare soars through the air, using his ears to glide past obstacles and reach new heights.

Abe might be a little bit too cautious sometimes, but you can always count on him and his shell to destroy vulnerable structures and clear your way.

Meg is the master of martial arts – she kicks, jumps, and even do both at the same time to reach higher places and even has a secret twist if she’s surrounded by a mob of enemies.

Journey across a variety of breathtaking locations, each brimming with charm, danger, and mystery. From the majestic halls of Featherbeard’s Castle to the shadowy depths of Demon’s Hole, every world is filled with secrets to uncover, treasures to claim, and surprises—both delightful and perilous—that will keep you exploring. With stunning visuals and imaginative level design, Chickenhare delivers an all-new adventure in the beloved universe of the movies and comics—brought to life for the very first time in a video game.

70010000094888.name: Birdie Up
70010000094888.intro: Flap the wings of a little bird!
70010000094888.description:
It is finally springtime! The first flowers and grasses awaken from hibernation and a cute little birdie too.
After the long winter it is hard to make the first flight attempt.
Push a button to flap!
Birdie Up is a simple but addictive game. With a pushing a button on your controller, the tiny bird makes a flap with its wings.
As faster you tap, the faster the bird flies above and you get bonus score.
Try to get as high you can to beat your own high score and don´t be so angry if you lose ;)

70010000094890.name: Cozy Meadow
70010000094890.description:
Step into the peaceful world of Cozy Meadow, a walking simulator designed for those who love to explore at their own pace. Wander through two beautifully crafted levels, each offering a unique atmosphere filled with hidden locations, stunning scenery, and quiet moments of discovery.

Explore at Your Own Pace
Take a break from the noise of everyday life and immerse yourself in a world designed for relaxation. From open meadows bathed in golden light to cool, misty forests, every path leads to something new.

Features:
Hidden Locations – Uncover secret spots tucked away in the landscape, each offering a special moment of wonder.
Atmospheric Soundtrack – A soothing mix of music and nature sounds enhances the peaceful experience.
Cozy Visuals – A warm, inviting art style brings every scene to life.

70010000094897.name: Spot the Difference with Masterpieces
70010000094897.intro:
Spot What’s Off in the Masterpiece!
A Brain-Training Art Puzzle Game
70010000094897.description:
Enjoy world-famous works of art while giving your brain a workout in this fun and thoughtful spot-the-difference game.

How to Play is Super Easy：
・Look closely at the featured masterpiece
・Compare it with the left image and find the differences in the right image
・When you find something off, tap that part in the right image!

It’s perfect for casual fun and a quick brain boost during your free time.

Stuck?
Just hit the hint button for a big clue!
(But use it wisely—it pretty much gives it away!)

70010000094904.name: ANNIE:Last Hope
70010000094904.intro: In the ruins of the apocalypse, can you find hope?
70010000094904.description:
ANNIE: Last Hope is an HD voxel top-down shooting game set in the 1990s. After a sudden invasion of unknown creatures, Annie is separated from her fiancé and embarks on a perilous journey to find him. However, what seems like a simple search soon unravels into a web of conspiracies, revealing the dark secrets hidden beneath the end of the world...

Thrilling Combat & Survival
Grab your weapon and fight through relentless waves of monsters in a world overrun by the infected. Experience intense and action-packed shooting gameplay!

Unique HD Voxel Art Style
Highly stylized voxel environments where most objects are destructible, bringing an immersive and dynamic combat experience.

Challenging & Unique Boss Fights
Face off against horrifying bosses like the mutated head chef, an infected armored truck, and a deceitful faction leader. Each battle demands skill and strategy!

Diverse & Engaging Levels
From dense forests and abandoned schools to chaotic highways and confined elevators, every location presents fresh challenges and thrilling encounters.

Immersive Story & Sound Design
From the echoes of gunfire to the eerie whispers of a dying world, every sound enhances the atmosphere. Paired with a gripping narrative, you'll find yourself fully absorbed in Annie's journey.

Love and betrayal, conspiracy and choice, humanity and survival... The truth of the apocalypse is waiting to be uncovered.

Join Annie on her journey for survival and discover the Last Hope!

70010000094931.name: Doku Girls
70010000094931.intro: Train your mind, enjoy the process and discover new facets of pleasure in the world of Sudoku!
70010000094931.description:
Welcome to Doku Girls – an exciting puzzle game that will help you develop your logic and attentiveness! For successfully completing levels, you will receive a special reward – charming images of beautiful girls. Immerse yourself in a relaxing atmosphere thanks to pleasant music and bright graphics.

Game features:
• Images of girls that are unlocked as you progress
• Unique, hand-made sudoku for any skill level
• Sensual music that creates an atmosphere of relaxation and pleasure

70010000094936.name: V’s Rage
70010000094936.intro: Trapped in a video game and armed with a frying pan.
70010000094936.description:
“Rise from your bed…”
Those are the words V, an overworked wife and mother, hears as she wakes up in her worst nightmare: she has been cursed and trapped inside a video game by a mysterious entity. To escape this chaotic low-poly world filled with odd creatures, she must crush every foe that dares cross her path. She has a frying pan. She has rage. And she will beat them all.

V’s Rage is a hand-drawn action-adventure that pays homage to classic arcade hits of the '80s and '90s, and to anime from the same era.

Switch between four distinct play styles—beat ’em up, shoot ’em up, side-scroller, and run-and-gun—as V smashes, blasts, and dashes through a kaleidoscope of bizarre stages.

70010000094941.name: Silent Mist
70010000094941.intro: The mist is alive. It sees you. It hears you. It waits.
70010000094941.description:
You awaken in a desolate, forsaken place. A thick, eerie mist surrounds you, shrouding the crumbling buildings ahead. The air is heavy with abandonment… yet an unseen presence watches you from the shadows.
With every passing moment, the unease deepens. The mist is not just a natural phenomenon—it moves, it shifts, it follows. At times, it hides you. Other times, it hides something far worse.
Your memory is fragmented, offering no answers as to how you arrived here. The only clues lie in scattered notes and the unsettling sounds that beckon you further into the unknown.

About Game:
	•	Explore a decayed, forgotten world filled with mysteries and lurking horrors.
	•	Struggle to survive in a hostile environment where resources are scarce.
	•	Rely on stealth—sometimes, escape is your only option.

Unravel the secrets of the mist and the truth behind your lost memories.
	•	Experience psychological horror with reality distortions, auditory hallucinations, and shifting environments.
	•	Dynamic Mist: More than an atmosphere—it observes, manipulates, and controls what you perceive.
	•	Unseen Threats: Not all dangers are visible—sometimes, you only feel their presence.

Silent Mist is not just a horror game. It is a descent into fear, isolation, and the secrets that should have remained lost in the fog.

70010000094947.name: Instants
70010000094947.intro: Assemble a chronological puzzle of family photos to piece together their most cherished memories.
70010000094947.description:
Welcome to "Instants," a captivating journey that blends puzzle-solving, crafting and heartfelt storytelling. Build up a collection of family photo albums piece by piece and learn their stories in a nostalgic narrative puzzle game.

● ENGAGE IN HEARTWARMING PUZZLES
Arrange the given family pictures chronologically within each album. The pictures serve as clues to their timeline, reflecting the natural evolution of a family story.

● PIECE THE STORY TOGETHER
As you solve the puzzle, a heartwarming story will gradually emerge. Explore at your own pace and put together the tale of one family throughout the generations.

● CUSTOMIZE YOUR OWN ALBUMS
Add your artistic flair and decorate the albums with backgrounds, stickers, typography, and more. Unlock new customization options as you progress and make each album an art piece in its own right!

● FRUSTRATION-FREE EXPERIENCE
Need a helping hand? Meet your adorable furry companion who offers optional assistance when facing challenging puzzles.

70010000094953.name: Prison Alone
70010000094953.intro: Feel the tension and suspense in this psychological horror game with no jumpscares
70010000094953.description:
Prison Alone is a psychological horror game set up in an empty prison. Some strange things started happening in this place, including disappearance of some people. While trying to investigate this further, the authorities ordered that all the prisoners should be transferred, but you bribed one of the guards to be left behind and use this opportunity to escape from the prison. But it won't be that easy.

Prison Alone focuses on exploration with a tense environment. you must find ways to enter places you usually wouldn't have access to, solve puzzles to unlock new areas, find access keys left behind, all while the atmosphere of suspense and tension dominate you.

The game does not contain jumpscare! But that doesn't mean that you won't feel afraid, or be scared by something while playing, everything was designed to leave you frightened and tense.

70010000094958.name: Hannah
70010000094958.intro: A surreal 3D platformer about childhood trauma, 80s-inspired horror, and broken memories.
70010000094958.description:
Hannah is a surreal 3D platformer about childhood trauma, 80s-inspired horror, and broken memories. Explore, feel, and choose your path across a VHS-styled dreamworld with multiple endings.

Hannah has lost her favorite doll and now has to face a surreal and enigmatic world shaped by her own mind and her memories of the 1980s, a world where every shadow hides a secret. 

In this atmospheric 3D puzzle-platformer, you must explore mysterious settings, solve intriguing challenges, and confront your worst childhood fears in an immersive and unforgettable experience where every decision determines the ending of the story.

- Explore the dark side of your mind
From narrow paths to vast surreal landscapes, each environment tells a visually stunning story.

- An ever-changing environment
The game adapts to player's choice, altering the environment and influencing the ending.

- Solve challenging puzzles
Use logic and creativity to overcome obstacles and unravel the path ahead bringing you closer to understanding yourself.

- A deep and interpretive narrative
Find objects that tell your story, clues that reveal fragments of your past. A story of self-discovery that unfolds as you explore.

- Soundtrack composed by a Grammy winner
The music and sound effects created especially for the game completely envelop you, creating an extraordinary, immersive, and emotional experience.

70010000094963.name: Grief like a stray dog
70010000094963.intro: «Grief like a stray dog» is a meditation on war, community and human fate
70010000094963.description:
«Grief like a stray dog» is a short interactive play about a young postwoman in a tight-knit rural community. In the outside world, WW2 rages at its apex. Nadia is thirteen. She delivers papers, letters. And death notifications to families of those killed in action.

Nadia’s character is based on the author’s grandmother. Inspired by tales of a childhood spent in a village near Rzhev, not far from one of the most brutal battlefields of the Eastern Front, most of the character arcs and plot points are based on war stories told by older relatives and locals; many letters are real.

The main visual inspirations for the game were kid’s drawings, neo-expressionism, Russian lubok art and Soviet book illustration

«Grief like a stray dog» is a meditation on war, community and human fate — part documentary, part Russian folk tale.

Features:
- A visual novel with elements of an adventure game.
- A rich and touching story based on memories and Russian folk tales.
- Author's 2D graphics.
- Disturbing and unusual soundtrack.
- Capacious and authentic dialogues.
- Duration: 60-80 minutes.
- A village populated by picturesque characters.

70010000094969.name: Pet & Dog Simulator
70010000094969.intro: Virtual Animal, Puppy Training, Animal Training
70010000094969.description:
Welcome to the world of virtual dog training! In this realistic offline dog simulator, you can experience the joys of raising, training, and playing with your favorite furry friends. Whether you're a dog lover or simply looking for fun offline animal games, this puppy care adventure will bring you hours of entertainment without needing an internet connection!

Key Features:
Train Your Puppy:
Learn how to train your virtual puppy with different commands, from sit and stay to fetch and roll over! Whether you’re an experienced dog trainer or new to puppy training, our game will guide you step-by-step as you teach your dog new tricks. Perfect for anyone interested in dog training games and animal simulators!

Puppy Hotel & Care:
Take care of your virtual puppies at the dog hotel! Feed them, groom them, and make sure they’re healthy and happy. The realistic puppy care features make you feel like you’re running your very own puppy hotel. This offline animal simulator lets you enjoy the full experience without needing to connect to the internet. No Wifi.

Offline Play – No Internet Needed!
Our offline dog simulator game is designed for uninterrupted fun. Whether you're on a long journey or in a place with no Wi-Fi, you can enjoy the game without any internet. Perfect for playing during road trips, vacations, or anywhere you want some fun on-the-go! Search no more for offline dog games—this is the best puppy training simulator available offline!

Realistic Dog Simulation:
Experience life through the eyes of a puppy in a stunning virtual world! From playing in the park to training with agility equipment, you’ll see what it’s like to be a dog. This game provides a truly immersive animal simulator experience for all ages. Dog lovers will especially enjoy the attention to detail in our virtual dog world.

Multiple Dog Breeds:
Choose from a variety of popular dog breeds! Whether you love Golden Retrievers, German Shepherds, or playful Beagles, you’ll find the perfect puppy to train and care for in this offline simulator. Each breed has unique traits, and you’ll get to know their personalities as you train and play with them.

Family-Friendly Fun:
This offline virtual dog simulator is great for kids and adults alike. Whether you want to teach your child about dog care or simply love animals yourself, our game offers an enjoyable and educational experience for everyone in the family. Perfect for fans of dog games for kids, puppy care simulators, and animal training games.

Challenges & Rewards:
Complete exciting challenges as you train your dog to unlock special rewards! The more tricks your puppy learns, the more rewards you’ll earn to customize your virtual dog's environment and accessories.

Why Choose Our Pet & Dog Simulator?
Puppy Training Games: Learn how to care for, train, and nurture your virtual puppy with fun and engaging gameplay.
Offline Animal Games: No internet required! Play wherever and whenever you want.
Realistic Puppy Care: Feed, bathe, and groom your puppy in a dog hotel setting.
Multiple Dog Breeds: Train and care for a variety of dogs, each with unique personalities.
Family-Friendly: Suitable for all ages, perfect for dog lovers and animal care enthusiasts.
Customizable: Unlock rewards to personalize your dog's accessories and living space.
Start your virtual puppy adventure today with Pet & Dog Simulator! Whether you’re training a dog for the first time or looking for an immersive animal simulator, this is the game for you. With no internet required, it's the perfect offline game for dog lovers of all ages!

70010000094972.name: Hogtie
70010000094972.intro: Wrangle piggies in this wild west puzzle adventure!
70010000094972.description:
Step into the boots of Ted, a cowboy with a mission: round up runaway piggies using only your wits – and your trusty lasso!

Hogtie is a clever and stylish puzzle game inspired by classic Sokoban mechanics, but with a twist: you can’t push – only pull.


Features:
– Lasso-based puzzle gameplay – Use your rope to pull piggies across desert sands, frosty peaks, and other wild biomes.
– No pushing allowed – Your lasso is the only way to move the pigs, turning classic logic puzzles into something fresh and challenging.
– Style your cowboy – Customize Ted (and his horse!) with a variety of fun, bold outfits – from rugged western wear to fabulous flair.
– Think before you move – Earn stars based on how efficiently you solve each level. Replay puzzles your way: aim for perfection or take your time.


With dozens of hand-crafted levels and plenty of personality, Hogtie ropes you in with charm, challenge, and a whole lot of hogs.

70010000094978.name: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping
70010000094978.intro: When spookiness strikes a luxury campsite, the one and only Duck Detective is summoned to quack the case.
70010000094978.description:
THIS IS A SHORT GAME!!

THE DETECTIVE RETURNS
The Duck Detective is back! Get ready to interview suspects, inspect evidence, and deduce the truth in another stand-alone mystery!

BREAD RED REDEMPTION
This campsite might have ghosts, but the real thing haunting Eugene McQuacklin is his failed marriage and bread addiction. Can he escape the shadows of his past?

EVERY DETECTIVE NEEDS A SIDEKICK
To the annoyance of the Duck Detective, he is joined by a new partner in (solving) crime. Work together to unravel the truth and nibble on the crumbs of justice!

FEATURES:
A 2-3 hour long cozy mystery game!
A stand-alone sequel to the acclaimed ‘Duck Detective: The Secret Salami!‘
Interview suspects, fill in the blanks and crack the case!
Fully voice-acted cast of suspiciously secretive characters!
Dive into a murky pond of delinquency and dredge up the truth!
Throw bread to the fine beak of lady justice!

70010000094987.name: Lorn's Lure
70010000094987.intro: Jump, slide & move! Lorn’s Lure is an atmospheric narrative first-person platformer with novel climb-anything mechanics and modernized retro 3D graphics.
70010000094987.description:
Leaving his home colony while tracking a mysterious glitch, an android finds himself in the midst of a vast and dangerous structure, completely hidden from his people’s knowledge. 
Unable to go back, you must keep going to find out where he is being led… 
And why he left in the first place.

Features:
▪ BACK TO THE PAST - retro ‘90s PC graphics with a modern flair,
▪ DIVE INTO THE STORY - uncover the mysterious lore as you traverse the world,
▪ CHALLENGE YOURSELF - jump, climb, slide, and scan your way around obstacles, using simple mechanics,
▪ SOAK IN THE ATMOSPHERE - discover the dark, horror, foreboding world,
▪ SKY’S THE LIMIT - with no “parkour ledges”, climb almost any vertical wall face using your pickaxes,
▪ TOUGH, BUT FAIR - your mistakes won’t be punished by redoing lengthy sections. Just keep climbing!
▪ FIND YOUR PACE - take in the sights or speedrun the game. The choice is yours.

Additional languages:
- Polish (PL/POLSKI),
- Turkish (TUR/TÜRKÇE),
- Ukrainian (UA/УКРАЇНСЬКА).

70010000094992.name: I Am Future: Cozy Apocalypse Survival
70010000094992.intro: End of the world? Time to build your dream place and make unexpected friends.
70010000094992.description:
BUILD THE COZY ROOFTOP BASE OF YOUR DREAMS

Starting from scratch on an abandoned rooftop, build, decorate and expand the coziest camp ever! Unlock new buildings and furniture, set up electrical grids, and neatly organize your new life. Relax, build, wander around – the world is literally yours! 

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER

Play as Robin or Chris, and customize the protagonist to reflect your unique idea of the last person on Earth!

SCAVENGE THE OLD-WORLD RELICS AND CRAFT NEW GADGETS

Find ancient artifacts from a bygone era, such as kettles, TVs, or microwaves, take them apart using a satisfying dismantling mechanic, and gather resources for your next crafting project!

HIRE A TEAM OF CUTE ROBOT-MINIONS

Automate chores around the camp with the help of cute robots! Build a team of robot-minions, give them commands, and let them chill in a charging bath!

EXPLORE A MYSTERIOS WORLD

Send out scouting drones on expeditions across the sunken megapolis. Discover new locations, bring something valuable back to the base, and, step by step, uncover the mystery behind the end of the world.

MAKE NEW WONDERFUL FRIENDS

The fact you’re the last human on Earth does not mean you can’t still make new friends! Meet quirky robot inhabitants of this new world, like Earl the Fridge or Bombshell Barbara, and grow your bond with them.

PROTECT YOUR BASE FROM THE PESKY PESTS

Your camp needs love and protection. Keep pesky mutant pests from destroying the crops or the electrical grid!

70010000094997.name: Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator
70010000094997.intro: Your Gateway to the Skies – Experience the Most Realistic Flight Simulator and Soar Like Never Before!
70010000094997.description:
Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator offers you an immersive, realistic flying experience like never before. Step into the cockpit and take control of a wide range of aircraft, from classic propellers to modern jets. Whether you’re a seasoned pilot or a complete beginner, this simulator provides a comprehensive training ground to perfect your flying skills.

Master every aspect of aviation, from takeoff to landing, navigating through weather conditions, and exploring diverse landscapes around the world. With its detailed aircraft models, stunning graphics, and accurate flight physics, Aircraft Legends delivers the ultimate flight experience.

Become the pilot you've always dreamed of, build your skills, and rise through the ranks at your own pace. The sky’s the limit—how high will you go?

70010000095002.name: Sakura Haven
70010000095002.intro: "Sakura Haven – A Tranquil Journey Through a World of Blooming Beauty"
70010000095002.description:
Step into a dreamlike world of pink petals and serene beauty in Sakura Haven, a breathtaking walking simulator where every path leads to wonder.

Wander through a tranquil landscape bathed in soft pink hues, where cherry blossoms dance in the wind and ancient torii gates mark the way to hidden secrets. Explore vibrant shrines, peaceful gardens, and misty hills as you immerse yourself in the soothing sights and sounds of this mesmerizing journey.

With no rush, no danger—just pure exploration—Sakura Haven is the perfect escape into a world of peace and beauty. Let the gentle soundtrack and stunning visuals transport you to a place of serenity.

Features:
Breathtaking Pink World – Walk through a landscape inspired by cherry blossoms and traditional Japanese aesthetics.
Discover Hidden Landmarks – Find ancient torii gates, mystical shrines, and other mesmerizing locations.
Relaxing Atmosphere – A peaceful journey with ambient sounds and a calming soundtrack.
Explore at Your Own Pace – No timers, no stress—just pure exploration.

70010000095004.name: Wings of Endless
70010000095004.intro: An epic 2D ARPG adventure awaits in the world of Wings of Endless!
70010000095004.description:
Discover the secret of a forgotten war in Wings of Endless, a platforming Action-RPG with a captivating Pixelart style that will draw you in from start to finish. Step into the role of Hariku, a brash bounty hunter who boasts of being the best at his craft.

Step into the role of Hariku, a brash bounty hunter who boasts of being the best at his craft. His life dramatically changes when a seemingly routine task morphs into an epic adventure, revealing the mysteries of an ancient war that was believed to have ended generations ago.

Accompanied by his enigmatic talking owl, Owly, and various unexpected allies, Hariku will explore vast varied landscapes, from arid deserts and damp marshlands to thick forests and icy snow zones. Every corner of this fascinating world is packed with secrets waiting to be uncovered.
 
Features:

- Huge and diverse world: From deserts to snowy forests.
- Gripping story: Unveil the secrets of an ancient war.
- Dynamic combat: Three unique heroes switchable in real-time.
- Numerous side missions: Discover more about the world of “Wings of Endless”.
- Consumable crafting: Create powerful potions.
- Wide variety of enemies and puzzles: Challenges and puzzles at every turn.

70010000095006.name: Taxi Chaos 2
70010000095006.intro: The streets of San Valeda are out of control. Jump back behind the wheel and show those TaxiBots who’s boss!
70010000095006.description:
Vinnie’s back, and the streets are wilder than ever! Pick up crazy passengers, pull off insane stunts, and race against the clock in the ultimate arcade taxi adventure.

Speed through heavy traffic, fly across rooftops, and find hidden shortcuts to keep the chaos going and the tips rolling. Master each ride’s handling, upgrade powerful abilities, and push your driving to the edge. Every second counts when speed, style, and destruction all collide.

Deliver fares fast, chase high scores, and prove you’re the best driver in San Valeda.

Features:
• Explore a vibrant open city full of secrets and shortcuts
• Pick up and deliver passengers with speed and flair
• Unlock and upgrade unique cars and abilities
• Perform massive jumps and wild stunts
• Earn five-star ratings and dominate the leaderboards

70010000095009.name: We Were Here
70010000095009.intro: Lost in a frozen wasteland and split up from your partner inside an abandoned castle, the only thing you have is a walkie-talkie with a voice on the other end. Can the two of you get out?
70010000095009.description:
We Were Here is the pilot episode in a series of cooperative standalone puzzle adventures. Two players are trapped inside an abandoned castle, with Player One confined to a small secluded part of the castle as Player Two roams the halls trying to find Player One. Every room challenges your wits and ability to communicate clearly, using only your voice.

Are you ready to find out how well you and your friends work together? If you like living on the edge, try playing it with a complete stranger!

- An atmospheric thriller setting that will keep you on the edge of your seat.
- Overcome challenging puzzles by working together - each player has a completely different game experience.
- Explore intriguing environments and search for clues in a fictional castle inspired by Castle Rock, Antarctica.

70010000095017.name: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced
70010000095017.intro: The Azure Striker's journey, all 3 games in one collection!
70010000095017.description:
The Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced is a collection of three traditional 2D action platformers,
“Azure Striker Gunvolt” (2014), “Azure Striker Gunvolt 2” (2016), and “Azure Striker Gunvolt 3” (2022)
together in one release, complete with all DLC.

The Gunvolt series boasts a rich story, played out with real-time dialog during missions, and an vast catalog of music, with over 37 songs performed by the games' characters.

Plus, this special Trilogy comes with exclusive features: action revisions from the series director, revised voices and songs, and once Japan-exclusive CD dramas included in the game. This collection strives to be as complete as possible!

■Included Games
Azure Striker Gunvolt:
Dash through stages at high speed and take down enemies with your "Flashfield" in this satisfying action platformer.
Players control Gunvolt, a superhuman (known as an Adept) with the power of lightning who must confront the oppressive Sumeragi Group in a battle for freedom.
The Trilogy Enhanced version adds new Skills to Gunvolt's arsenal.
Unleash overwhelming power like never before!

Azure Striker Gunvolt 2:
Gunvolt's rival, Copen, becomes a new star and playable character alongside the Azure Striker.
Copen uses his dash to tackle and lock onto enemies before unleashing a devastating homing laser barrage.
Master his aerial "Bullit Dash" to gracefully fly through stages and destroy enemies from above, unlocking new weapons from the abilities of defeated bosses.
Copen and Lola's voices have been re-recorded for the Trilogy Enhanced edition of the game.

Azure Striker Gunvolt 3:
A new style of action arrives with the new heroine "Kirin" who can swap with Gunvolt to overcome any situation.
Kirin has the power to teleport instantly to strike down enemies with her "Arc Chain" ability for melee action of unprecedented speed. Or switch to Gunvolt, whose tag and electrify style has leveled up to allow him to dash through enemies while striking them down, teleport, and unleash other new "Voltaic Arts".
The Image Pulse system brings characters from the series as buffs and attacks, with over 150 varieties to collect.

■Cast
 Gunvolt - Kaito Ishikawa
 Lumen/Joule - Megu Sakuragawa
 Nova - Ayumu Murase
 Copen - Yuma Uchida
 Lola - Mayu Mineda
 Zonda - Sho Nogami / Kaori Nazuka
 Kirin - Yu Sasahara
 ZedΩ - Shun Horie
 Layla/Luxia - Rico Sasaki

70010000095022.name: A blind spot
70010000095022.description: The plan of the dark hero Ichijo begins at the mountain lodge in the snowy mountains.

70010000095027.name: Super Waifu Ball
70010000095027.intro: Roll, collect, and dive into the waifu-filled adventure of your dreams!
70010000095027.description:
Super Waifu Ball is an arcade-style adventure where you roll through colorful, obstacle-filled worlds as a cast of adorable waifus. Complete levels, collect stars, and unlock collectible waifu figurines from the gacha machine!

Get ready for a gravity-defying, action-packed adventure in Super Waifu Ball, an arcade-style game where you roll through vibrant, obstacle-filled worlds as you control a cast of lovable waifus.
Master each level, collect stars, and navigate through increasingly tricky courses to unlock exciting rewards and surprises!

Features:
- 8 Unique Worlds: Explore 8 diverse worlds, each packed with challenging obstacles, tricky traps, and complex challenges.
- 5 Playable Waifus: Choose from 5 different waifus, each with their own charm and personality.
- Test your skills with the “Challenge Mode,” a tougher set of levels that will push your abilities to the limit.
- Collectibles: Complete levels with perfect scores to earn stars that unlock collectible waifu figurines straight from the gacha machine.

70010000095029.name: Leila
70010000095029.intro: Dive into Leila’s mind—a dreamlike puzzle adventure of memories and mystery.
70010000095029.description:
"Normally I'd dig a hole in me and then fall into it, But this time I decided that instead of falling in, I would willingly go in. Here I am, drifting on the shores of my life."

Play as Leila and traverse through all phases of her life, uncovering her pivotal life moments. By unraveling puzzles imbued with the fragments of her narrative, you'll comprehend the motives behind Leila's life decisions. As you delve deeper into her psyche and her emotional landscape, you'll discover facets of your own self mirrored in the life journey of this seemingly ordinary woman.

Step into journey through the layers of Leila, a captivating, story-driven adventure that comes alive with charming narration and stunning artwork. Every frame is a masterpiece, handcrafted with detailed traditional animation, and each moment is accentuated with an evocative original soundtrack.

Embark on Leila's journey as she grapples with the complexities of love, trust, and the shadows of her past. Navigate thought-provoking puzzles that challenge and engage, deepening the immersion in her tale.

What to expect:

♥ 4 Chapters,
♥ Story-related puzzles and mini games,
♥ Hand-drawn cinematics,
♥ 16 original soundtracks,
♥ Voice acting in English,
♥ Press and Drag Gameplay.

70010000095040.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Ungdo
70010000095040.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000095040.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Ungdo, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses. 
High-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000095045.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Garorim Bay
70010000095045.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000095045.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Garorim Bay, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 3 flight courses. 
High-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000095050.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Taean-gun
70010000095050.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000095050.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Taean-gun, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 4 flight courses. 
High-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery. MasCon for Nintendo Switch™ made by Zuiki of Japan is also supported.

70010000095060.name: Agarta
70010000095060.description:
Agarta has been designed to show you how valuable and important every decision you make in your individual life, every choice you make is. Because every choice you make is also a renunciation and you cannot undo any decision.


Have you ever woken up in the morning, while waiting in line at the bank, watching politicians lie by looking people in the eyes, or just watching all the injustices you've been through, feeling that you didn't have the strength to shout? Even if it didn't, it definitely will one day. Because as an ordinary person, all the decisions that affect your life are made by those who hold power expensive drinking tables. Nothing else remains more than the torture of waking up in the morning to go to work, or the tears you shed to fall asleep at night.
Agarta is a story written in blood by a serial killer based on this “cry for life”, shaped around our moral judgements and decisions that make us human, and who understands that “truth” and “good” can only be “gain” in the world we live in.
Cerrah, the serial killer who has committed murders in many countries of the world for thirty years, and whose name or anything else are not known other than the nickname given to him by the media, sought by Interpol with the Red Notice, reappears. Questioning the concepts of justice and law, Cerrah embarks on a struggle against those who hold power and aim to expand their personal empires that they created by protecting their personal interests.
By directing and making the choices, you will bring Cerrah to one of the 22 possible endings.
Agarta has been designed to show you the value and significance of every decision you make and every choice you make. Because every choice you make is also a renunciation and you cannot undo any decision.
Agarta's script team includes Ali Rıdvan Tekeoğlu, as well as Taha Ulukaya, the screenwriter of the web series "The Cheat", which has received awards in many international festivals.


-Cinematic FMV type Interactive thriller filmed in 4K with real actors.
-Over 100 selections leading to one of the 22 finals without pause.
-A Temperament Model consisting of the sum of the choices made.
-The cast includes artists such as Mehmet Küçük, Burak Sarımola, Berna Adıgüzel, Yaşar Aydınlıoğlu, Alper Türedi.
-For a realistic gameplay, selections cannot be undone.

70010000095062.name: Let's Freeze Some Penguins
70010000095062.description: Northern Bear is crawling with penguins! The Emperor Penguin is moving his minions north of the arctic circle, and it’s up to Walnut the Walrus and Noklas the Narwhal to freeze them in their tracks! Use Walnut’s Walrus Wind to freeze penguins into ice-blocks. Use the ice-blocks to build new paths, stairs, and bridges! This simple concept is the foundation of a whole adventure of puzzling predicaments.

70010000095064.name: Lila and the Secret Flower Jungle
70010000095064.intro: In this visual novel you will meet Lila, a young explorer, and Max, her loyal monkey friend, who embark on a great adventure guided by a mysterious map.
70010000095064.description:
Adventure in the Jungle!

Discover a world of magic, mystery and friendship in this interactive book for children.

What begins as a simple expedition soon becomes a great adventure full of riddles, dangers and amazing discoveries. But the jungle holds secrets, and only those with a brave heart will be able to discover them.

Get ready for an unforgettable story!

Features of the interactive book:

· Explore a magical jungle full of surprises through vibrant illustrations.

· Meet charming characters and mysterious creatures.

· Accompany Max, the most mischievous and loyal monkey.

· Meet Rico, a clever toucan with mysterious intentions.

· Learn values such as friendship, respect for nature and teamwork.

· An interactive story full of magicDiscover the secrets of the jungle with Lila and Max and find the true treasure: a special message that will change their way of seeing the world.

·Ideal for kids and families who love stories full of adventure, learning, and fun!

·Colorful illustrations and a charming styleThe jungle comes to life with adorable characters and vibrant settings in an unforgettable visual experience.

·Easy to enjoy and suitable for all ages

With a simple and interactive narrative, this book is perfect for young children who want to explore and enjoy a great story.

Adventure awaits! Are you ready to discover the secrets of the jungle?

70010000095066.name: Sugoi Girls: Delhi Darling
70010000095066.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000095066.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000095068.name: Sugoi Girls: Sassy Spy
70010000095068.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000095068.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000095072.name: Sugoi Girls: Dragon Love
70010000095072.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000095072.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000095074.name: Slender Threads
70010000095074.intro: In this paranormal point-and-click adventure, a traveling salesman races to stop a string of horrific deaths in a quiet seaside town—before he’s next.
70010000095074.description:
"Every night it's the same dream: my own head, mounted on a wall."

While wandering an unfamiliar town, Harvey Green follows a string of paranormal events to a grim realization: his recurring nightmare may foretell an inescapable fate.

In this point-and-click thriller adventure, guide Harvey through the peculiar streets, shops, and surroundings of Villa Ventana as he seeks to prevent his visions from becoming reality.

Features:
• A timeless point-and-click blend of exploration, dialogue, and puzzle-solving
• A curious tale that melds shocking twists with absurd humor
• Dozens of strange, memorable characters brought to life by a cast of celebrated voice actors
• Hand-drawn art that combines 2D and 3D to create striking, "diorama-like" visuals
• An original, haunting score

70010000095084.name: Bendy and the Dark Revival
70010000095084.intro: The inky sequel to the cult classic. Survive the Ink Demon.
70010000095084.description:
Bendy and the Dark Revival® is a first-person survival horror game and the much anticipated sequel to Bendy and the Ink Machine®. Play as Audrey as she explores the depths of a curiously creepy animation studio that’s gone completely mad. Combat ink-tainted enemies, solve puzzles, and evade the ever-lurking Ink Demon while seeking your way back to the real world. You never know who or what is going to be around the next corner in this dilapidated realm of shadows and ink.

Discover the truth. Escape the studio. Above all, fear the Ink Demon…and survive.

70010000095086.name: Bendy: Lone Wolf
70010000095086.description:
Step into the inky nightmare of Bendy: Lone Wolf®, a thrilling survival adventure set in the twisted, rubberhose world of Joey Drew Studios. As Boris, the lone wolf, you’ll brave endlessly shifting corridors filled with monstrous cartoon creeps, deadly traps, and the relentless pursuit of the Ink Demon. Every day brings new challenges in this heart-pounding quest for survival and truth.

• SURVIVE THE ODDS: Test your skills against ever-increasing dangers. Navigate treacherous halls where enemies and obstacles lurk around every corner. Scavenge for supplies, craft weapons, and uncover the dark secrets of the animation studio’s mysterious machine.

• FIGHT THE DARKNESS: Battle the grotesque creatures of the Dark Puddles with precise, timed attacks and clever trap strategies. Smash them back into the shadows before they overwhelm you in this unforgiving cartoon horror.

• ESCAPE THE INK DEMON: The Ink Demon stalks your every move, his inky heartbeat signaling imminent danger. Run, hide, and outsmart this unstoppable force in a tense game of cat and mouse where nowhere is safe.

• A WORLD OF ENDLESS TERROR: Explore procedurally generated environments that keep every playthrough fresh and unpredictable. From haunted studio rooms to nightmarish cartoon realms, the ever-changing world of Bendy: Lone Wolf® ensures no two journeys are the same.

• OPTIMIZED EXPERIENCE: Immerse yourself in stunning visuals and responsive controls tailored for Console. Experience smooth gameplay, chilling audio, and intuitive mechanics designed to draw you deeper into the ink-soaked horror.

Dare to uncover the secrets of Joey Drew Studios. Will you outwit the darkness, or be consumed by the ink? Play Bendy: Lone Wolf® today and face the ultimate survival challenge.

70010000095088.name: Spot It Fast! Kids’ Difference Hunt
70010000095088.intro:
Easy & Fun Spot the Difference!
A Cute Brain-Training Game to Boost Your Mind
70010000095088.description:
This is a brain-training game where you must find the one hidden difference in adorable illustrations before time runs out!

How to Play：
・Look closely at the top illustration on the split-screen.
・Compare it with the bottom illustration and find the difference.
・Once you spot the mistake, tap the correct location!

It may look simple, but with a time limit, it’s trickier than you think!
Perfect for a quick and fun break.

If you’re stuck, just press the hint button! 
(It gives you a pretty big clue, so use it wisely.)

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000095093.name: EGGCONSOLE PYRAMID WARP MSX
70010000095093.intro: Fight against scorpions, bats, and mummies as you search for the diamond among three treasures! A nostalgic early MSX action game!
70010000095093.description:
Fight against scorpions, bats, and mummies while searching for the diamond among three treasures to warp to the next stage! What awaits at stage 16!? 

This action game was released in 1983 in Japan. Players control an adventurer exploring a pyramid in search of treasure. Each room is patrolled by scorpions and bats, so use the passageways wisely, take advantage of paired warp tunnels, or hide in treasure chests to avoid them. If the adventurer comes into contact with an enemy, they will lose a life, and when all lives are lost, it's game over.

Each room contains three treasure chests, which may hold a gun to be used as a weapon, an invincible and hostile mummy, or a diamond that opens a warp tunnel to the next stage. Find the diamond as quickly as possible and advance to the next stage.

Additionally, each room has a limited amount of air, which depletes over time. As the air level decreases, enemies move faster, and once it reaches zero, the adventurer loses a life. Acting swiftly is the key to success.

Released in the same year as the MSX's launch, this game offers fast-paced gameplay that feels great and has an oddly addictive quality, making players want to keep coming back for more.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000095100.name: Rosabella: Eternal Light and Magic in Harmony
70010000095100.intro: Meet Rosabella, a young girl with a heart full of curiosity, who discovers that she is the only one who can restore the lost light to the kingdom where she lives.
70010000095100.description:
Embark on a magical adventure filled with color and friendship!

In a kingdom where magic flows through nature, colors have begun to fade. Rosabella, a brave young girl, must restore the light with the help of Magnolia, a wise magical creature, and Sunny, a bright little flower.

·Explore enchanted landscapes full of secrets.
·Meet charming and friendly characters
·Watch as Rosabella solves fun challenges and overcomes magical trials.
·Discover the power of friendship and bravery.
·Bring color back to the kingdom in this magical visual novel!

70010000095114.name: Fantasy of War
70010000095114.intro: A war Strategy RPG where you fight to reclaim the homeland!
70010000095114.description:
Fantasy of War is a Strategy RPG.
Move each unit and defeat monsters and enemy forces to advance.
As your level goes up, your status goes up. You can also learn new skills and magic.
Gather your friends, strengthen your army, and take back the homeland.

70010000095119.name: Bloom Paradise
70010000095119.intro: A fixed-screen action game offering a 2-player coop mode.
70010000095119.description:
A fixed-screen action game that allows you to play with up to two players using flower fairies Tamabo and Hanabo. Your goal: to fill the entire stage with blooming flowers.

Story:
Every nook and cranny in Bloom Paradise was once filled with flowers of every color, until one day when pesky pests came and ravaged the land, rendering it unrecognizable. Thus, flower fairies Tamabo and Hanabo have joined forces, setting off on an adventure to restore Bloom Paradise to its former glory and get rid of those irksome pests.

How to Play:
Play as either Tamabo (Player 1) or Hanabo (Player 2) and make flowers bloom. Fill all the grounds in each stage to clear it.

How you bloom flowers differs between single-player mode and two-player mode. In single-player mode, flowers bloom on the ground as Tamabo walks across. In two-player mode, however, when either Tamabo or Hanabo walks across the ground, only flower buds appear. The other character must then touch these buds to make them bloom. Work together to take back Bloom Paradise from the pests.

Both Tamabo and Hanabo can shoot water in the direction they're facing with the use of the attack button. Flowers can't bloom when the ground is covered in mud, so use water to clean up and eradicate any pests standing in your way.

70010000095125.name: Super Slime Boy
70010000095125.intro:
A fast-paced precision platformer where every jump counts!
Restore color to a world drained of life by conquering 56 challenging levels!
70010000095125.description:
Super Slime Boy – Bring Color Back to a World Drained of Life!

Step into the squishy form of Super Slime Boy, a small but determined hero, in this fast-paced, precision platformer set in a dangerous, black-and-white world where every mistake means instant death. Armed with nothing but your reflexes and skill, your mission is simple yet challenging: Survive deadly obstacles and restore the stolen colors to the world.

The once vibrant land has been drained of its colors, leaving behind a harsh, monochrome environment filled with buzzing saw blades, razor-sharp spikes, and unforgiving platforming challenges. As you guide Slime Boy through this treacherous world, each successful level breathes color back into the environment, symbolizing your progress and triumph over darkness.

Key Features:

Precision Platforming:
Navigate through 56 handcrafted levels designed to test your timing, reflexes, and patience.
Every level is a puzzle of movement, requiring pixel-perfect jumps and split-second reactions.

Race Against Time:
Every level challenges you to beat the clock and earn Bronze, Silver, or Gold trophies based on your completion time.
Master your routes and perfect your speedruns to unlock new stages and show off your skills.

Restore the World’s Colors:
With every level completed, the grayscale world slowly regains its colors.
Each success brings a visual reward, transforming the bleak environment into a place of life and energy.

7 Unique Stages, 56 Levels:
The journey spans 7 distinct stages, each with 8 progressively challenging levels.
Unlock new stages by collecting points from trophies, and open the path to the ultimate test of your platforming mastery.

Instant Restarts – No Waiting:
Failure is part of the journey.
Die, learn, and restart instantly—there’s no waiting, no loading screens, just you and the challenge ahead.


What Awaits You?

Every level is a challenge.
Every jump is a risk.
Every second counts.

Will you have the precision, patience, and determination to bring color back to this lifeless world?
Or will you fall victim to the countless traps that await?

The challenge is set—are you ready to help Super Slime Boy restore life to his world?

70010000095130.name: Bubble Wizard II Saga
70010000095130.intro: Return to OZ: The Shadow’s Revenge
70010000095130.description:
