Peace has returned to OZ Wizard Country—or so it seemed. Just as the land begins to heal, a new darkness emerges from the ruins of the Dark Sorcerer’s lair. A forgotten curse has awakened the Shadow Queen, an even greater force of evil that threatens to plunge OZ into eternal night!

But there’s still hope—you! The new wizard in town must rise once again, mastering powerful new spells and discovering enchanted artifacts to banish the shadows. Travel across mystical lands, bursting cursed bubbles to free trapped magic and restore light to OZ Wizard Country.

With each level you conquer, the darkness weakens. Take on the challenge as you battle through new enchanted realms, dangerous dungeons, and mystical forests filled with tricky puzzles and hidden treasures. The fate of OZ is in your hands!

Are you ready to cast your spells and save the realm once more?


Feature :
★ All new 250 magical levels! *
★ Special boosters & Magic portions to help you pass those tricky levels.
★ Easy to play, and progressively challenging to master!
★ Daily awards, more and more coins drop everyday.
★ Enchanting graphics and sound effects that will leave you spellbound.
★ Multiple languages support.
★ Nintendo Switch™ online Leaderboards to show off your rankings! **
★ Supports Joy-Con™, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller and touch screen.

 

Note :
* First 35 levels are unlocked tutorial levels. Follow by 215 all new unique levels.
** Optional, player can opt-out from submitting high scores to online leaderboard.

70010000095133.name: Cozy Earth: Hawaii Island Love Anime Girls
70010000095133.intro: Escape to the paradise of Hawaii and live a magical adventure surrounded by anime girls and breathtaking landscapes! Your home, your island, your story.
70010000095133.description:
A world full of sunshine, fun, and romance awaits you on the most beautiful tropical island. Explore this island paradise, rescue charming girls, and create the home of your dreams. Everything you’ve always imagined is within your reach!

Do you love decorating and designing? Here, you can build your dream home, customize it with unique furniture, and add that special touch you’ve always wanted. From cozy beachside cottages to tropical villas surrounded by exquisite gardens, your imagination is the limit!

But that's not all, you won’t be alone on this island. You’ll meet anime girls with irresistible personalities who will accompany you every step of your adventure.

Rescue them, build special connections with them, and let them help make your home an even more welcoming place. Each girl has something unique to offer you!

Features:

-Explore a paradise island full of sunshine and mysteries!
-Design your house in your style and create the perfect home in a relaxing environment.
-Collect resources to create new structures and progress through the island.
-Rescue and connect with anime girls who will help you on your adventure.
-Enjoy relaxing gameplay filled with fun, romance, and creativity.


Make Cozy Earth: Hawaii Island Love Anime Girls your refuge and start your adventure today!

70010000095138.name: Skies Above
70010000095138.intro: A fast-paced, action-packed pixel art game, where you have to help a Leviathan to reach space by defending it from an endless robot army.
70010000095138.description:
A fast-paced, 2D action game, where your goal is to destroy the endless waves of flying orb bots and fly higher with every run, until the Leviathan is saved!

FAST-PACED COMBAT
Dash swiftly from enemy to enemy while chaining together special attacks, obtaining combos, and exploiting the power of your enemies!

UPGRADES
Forge and upgrade runes in the camp to obtain special skills and make the Leviathan even more powerful, so you can ascend even further!

MINIGAMES
Complete challenges, collect fish and meet new friends to make the journey easier.

70010000095143.name: CYBERSLAYER: No Time to Regret
70010000095143.description:
CYBERSLAYER is a high-intensity first-person action slasher that thrusts you into the pulse-pounding rhythm of a cyberpunk future. The game takes place in a vast metropolis where law and order have long collapsed, and humanity’s last refuge—a towering megastructure—has become a battleground for survival.

You play as a mysterious bounty hunter, a figure shrouded in legend. No one knows his true name, his past, or even how long he has been around. According to rumors, he was once a dedicated officer of the law, until a fateful conspiracy changed everything. Stripped of his family and left gravely wounded, he was given a second chance by an enigmatic doctor seeking a subject for groundbreaking cybernetic experiments.

Enhanced with cutting-edge implants and unparalleled combat abilities, he has taken on a new mission—to rid the city of those who spread chaos and fear. Though his methods may be unorthodox, his actions speak louder than words. While those in power hesitate, he takes action, determined to bring justice where none exists.

Prepare for over 15 dynamic and visually stunning levels, where every battle is a race against time. Your weaponry is limited to melee combat, but that doesn't mean the fight will be easy—you can wield your blade in close quarters or throw it at enemies, creating your own distinct combat style. Only those with speed, skill, and determination will prevail.

All of this unfolds to the beat of an electrifying cyberpunk soundtrack, immersing you in the neon-lit chaos of a city on the edge.

You are CYBERSLAYER. The future is in your hands.

70010000095154.name: Roguematch : The Extraplanar Invasion
70010000095154.intro: A tactical turn-based roguelike where raw magic is your weapon!
70010000095154.description:
ROGUEMATCH: THE EXTRAPLANAR INVASION

When a Nekomancer's curiosity drags her friends- the Binkying Bungeoneer and the Shield-Bashing Paladinu - into a hunt for the Nekonomicon, they stumble upon an army of extraplanar monsters—and now, only the most unlikely heroes can save reality! To survive, they'll need to master improvised mana tactics, because their usual swords and spells won't cut it!

MELEE, MAGIC, MATCH, OR MANEUVER:
Directly attack your foe, cast a spell, injure enemies by matching mana next to them, or dodge deadly attacks? Every turn requires careful thinking.

FACE A CASTLE OVERRUN BY VARIOUS ELEMENTS AND ELEMENTALS!
Lava burns you in the Cryovolcanic stages, but they burn enemies too!
You can get stuck in the mud in the Electric Swamp, but that protects you from electricity!
Hide in the sandclouds in the Humid Desert to ambush an enemy!
When you face Orochill, run from the ice blasts!
If you face Cathulhu, brave her air beams!

DISCOVER DIFFERENT PLAYSTYLES
Mix six unique heroes with six mana-based powers to create wild strategies like:
Boarlock + Time Set = Stop time and take extra turns. Do you think you can finish a run in one turn?
Sowceress + Match Set = Rain down long-range destruction.
Birbarian + Bomb Set = Become a close-range melee expert.
Then, refine your build further with random spells, items, and upgrades found in the mysterious castle!

ROGUELIKE SYSTEMS
Procedurally Generated Floor maps: No two runs are the same—face different level layouts and randomised treasure drops each time.
Tough but Fair: When a run ends, the castle takes back all your items and spells you have found. You start again, with nothing.
Spells and Enemies: Use 170+ spells/items to fight against 70+ enemies and bosses, each with their own elemental weakness and strengths.

Will you outsmart the extraplanar invasion... or will your realm collapse because of one book?

70010000095169.name: Snow Squall Grip
70010000095169.description:
Your helicopter crashes in a remote, icy wilderness en route to delivering batteries to a mysterious research facility. 
Now, you must complete your delivery before you freeze to death or get eaten by a strange presence stalking you.

•	A terror simulator
•	Intuitive Physics-Based Item Interaction
•	Atmospheric Exploration

70010000095171.name: Bubble Trouble
70010000095171.description:
Embark on a thrilling bubble-popping quest in Bubble Trouble! Take control of Mr. D, a devilish hero armed with a trusty harpoon, and tackle 22 action-packed levels filled with bouncing bubbles that split and multiply. This addictive arcade classic challenges you to clear each stage by strategically shooting bubbles while dodging their chaotic rebounds. With vibrant visuals, precise controls, and endless replayability, Bubble Trouble is perfect for solo players and families alike.

Gameplay Features:
- Classic Arcade Action: Shoot and split bouncing bubbles with precision, mastering challenging patterns across 22 unique levels.

- Local Two-Player Co-Op: Team up with a friend to strategize and clear bubbles together for double the fun.

- Family-Friendly Fun: Simple controls and vibrant visuals make this adventure accessible and enjoyable for all ages.

70010000095176.name: Hyperspaced
70010000095176.intro: The Ultimate Co-Op Chaos in Space!
70010000095176.description:
The Multiverse is collapsing! Team up, jump into your spaceship, and face chaos—disasters, frantic repairs, and intense battles. Every mission in Hyperspaced is unique, and only teamwork will save the galaxy!

Pilot, Engineer, Gunner, or Janitor – Every Role Matters!
Steer the ship, man the turrets, extinguish burning consoles, patch up hull breaches, and mop up sticky space goo before everything spirals out of control. In this fast-paced co-op madness, no one gets to sit back and relax!
Mission: Retrieve the Galaxy Plugs!
Some lunatics have stolen the cosmic Galaxy Plugs, leaving the universe tangled in a mess of chaotic pipelines! Your crew must track down the thieves, recover the Plugs, and restore balance before entire galaxies vanish forever.
Friends, Foes, and… a Space Octopus?!
On your journey, you’ll encounter bizarre beings: a mysterious drone, a grumpy hermit, a talkative merchant octopus – and cats?! Help them (or don’t), but some might just join your reckless adventure!
Procedurally Generated Galaxies – Every Run is Unique!
No two adventures are the same! Explore ever-changing maps, discover new ships, and unlock crazy upgrades. Restore abandoned vessels to their former glory and experience different playstyles – from heavily armored freighters to nimble space raiders.
Don't Forget to Feed Scrappy!
Your junk-eating robot turns scrap into valuable resources mid-mission. Just make sure to pet him – he gets cranky otherwise!
So, buckle up – this is going to be a wild ride!

Key Features:
•	1–4 Player Local Co-Op – Maximum chaos guaranteed!
•	Multitasking Madness – Repair the ship inside while battling enemies outside in an innovative split-screen view
•	Infinite Replayability – Randomized maps, ships, and wacky weapons keep every run fresh
•	Build & Upgrade Your Ship – Customize your spaceship with new modules, weapons, and defenses
•	4 different ships with different layouts and gameplay mechanics to unlock
•	Boss Battles & Epic Challenges – Only the best crews will survive!

70010000095181.name: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled
70010000095181.description:
Dive into Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled, the thrilling sequel to the classic arcade hit, where you play as a stylish devil popping dangerous bubbles. Split massive bubbles into smaller ones and clear each level before time runs out or risk losing a life. With addictive gameplay and vibrant visuals, this retro-inspired adventure is perfect for solo or local co-op fun. Conquer challenging levels and aim to become the ultimate Bubble Master!

Features:  
Classic Arcade Action: Shoot and dodge bubbles in fast-paced, retro-style gameplay that’s easy to learn but tough to master.  

Local Co-Op Mode: Team up with a friend for double the bubble-popping excitement on a single Nintendo Switch™.  

Varied Levels & Power-Ups: Tackle diverse stages with ladders, pits, and power-ups like shields and extra weapons.  

Timeless Challenge: Split bubbles strategically to clear 72 unique levels and chase high scores.

70010000095186.name: Aurora Light Pony: Ponies and Horses in the Valley of Stars
70010000095186.intro: In the Valley of Shining Stars, magic lights up every corner and guides ponies in the discovery of their true destiny.
70010000095186.description:
In this visual novel, join Aurora Light, a young pony with a restless spirit, on an unforgettable adventure filled with magic and discovery. Her dream is to find her purpose, but the path is not always easy.

When an unexpected event shakes the harmony of the valley, Aurora Light and her friends will travel beyond the known, exploring amazing landscapes, facing magical challenges, and discovering ancient secrets that will change their lives.

Experience an exciting story full of friendship, bravery, and self-discovery!

What awaits you in Aurora Light:

· A great story of adventure and values.
· Many endearing and fun characters.
· Wonderful and colorful backgrounds that will transport you to a magical world.
· Beautiful music that will make every moment unforgettable.

Discover the magic of Aurora Light now!

70010000095194.name: Amanda the Adventurer 2
70010000095194.description:
ABOUT

Amanda the Adventurer 2 follows Riley Park, who, after seeing what was contained on the mysterious tapes in their attic, is greeted by a masked figure. The figure claims to have known their Aunt Kate before she died and needs their help finding something Aunt Kate left in the library. The duo travel to the Kensdale Public Library to investigate further. The masked figure also warns of a powerful entity that seems to be drawn to the tapes.

Meanwhile, Amanda is now aware of Riley's presence, and is doing everything to find a way to free herself. Suddenly, the stakes are higher than ever before, as it's not just Amanda looking for Riley now...

FEATURES

· Interactive cartoons return! Talk directly to Amanda like before, but now your input has a bigger effect on her world
· New interaction type: GET UP! Go out and explore the environment to find something Amanda asks for, or don't! See how she responds!
· New Area: Kensdale Public Library - You're not at Aunt Kate's anymore! Explore a bigger environment with even more secrets and lore to find!
· New Friends! Neither Riley or Amanda will be alone on their adventures with friends by their side!
· Dig even deeper into the story of Amanda, Riley and Aunt Kate, and the sinister production of Amanda the Adventurer to unfold a horrifying history

Get ready for an adventure!

70010000095196.name: １-２-３ ｏｒ ４-５-６
70010000095196.intro:
1-2-3 or 4-5-6 .....
Spot the outlier.
Among the many dice, there is one that stands out.
70010000095196.description:
Find it within the time limit!
Answer correctly to level up. More dice will appear, and the challenge will deepen.
A simple yet profound test of intuition and observation.
Can you reach the highest level?

70010000095203.name: Street Fighter™ 6
70010000095203.intro: The long-awaited Street Fighter™ 6 is now on Nintendo Switch™ 2!
70010000095203.description:
It’s time to hit the streets! Street Fighter™ 6 represents the next evolution of the Street Fighter™ series featuring three distinct game modes, innovative new gameplay features, and enhanced visuals for every aspect of the game.

Fight your way to the top with all new content and game modes exclusive to Nintendo Switch 2 like Local Wireless One on One and Avatar Matches. Enjoy brand new party modes that utilize the Nintendo Switch Joy-Con™ controllers like Gyro Battle, and Calorie Contest where the player who burns the most calories wins! Play on the go with Tabletop Mode and access all three control types (Classic, Modern, Dynamic) on your Joy-Con. 

Diverse Roster of 18 Fighters
Play legendary masters and new fan favorites like Ryu, Chun-Li, Luke, Jamie, Kimberly and more in this latest edition with each character featuring striking new redesigns and exhilarating cinematic specials.

Dominate the Fighting Ground
Street Fighter 6 offers a highly evolved combat system with three control types - Classic, Modern and Dynamic - allowing you to quickly play to your skill level. The new Real Time Commentary Feature adds all the hype of a competitive match as well as easy-to-understand explanations about your gameplay. The Drive Gauge is a new system to manage your resources. Use it wisely in order to claim victory.

Explore the Streets in World Tour
Discover the meaning of strength in World Tour, an immersive, single-player story mode. Take your avatar and explore Metro City and beyond. Meet Masters who will take you under their wing and teach you their style and techniques.

Seek Rivals in the Battle Hub
The Battle Hub represents a core mode of Street Fighter 6 where players can gather and communicate, and become stronger together. Use the avatar you create in World Tour to check out cabinets on the Battle Hub floor and play against other players, or head over to the Game Center to enjoy some of Capcom's classic arcade games.

Your path to becoming a World Warrior starts here.

70010000095207.name: NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening Complete Edition
70010000095207.intro: A complete edition of the game with various add-on content and new scenarios.
70010000095207.description:
"NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening," where players can truly experience the Warring States period with officers who make decisions for themselves, now has a complete edition that includes various add-on content that has been released.

The game:
Players are supported by faithful retainers who act on their own judgement. The "Dominion" system will allow players to obtain and grant territory to retainers, so they can divvy up and parcel out the beautifully detailed Warring States Japan as they like, and make it prosper!
The game will also include a large variety of high-quality features befitting of the 40th anniversary of the series, including submission, direct talks, council officials, sieges, castle roles, and province plans, allowing the lords and their retainers to progress as one.
From famous officers to beautiful princesses, over 2,200 officers will be included, the greatest number in the series. Players can now come together with highly individualistic retainers and move history!

The contents:
The complete edition includes the previously released early purchase bonus, pre-order bonus, and "Kou Shibusawa's 40th Anniversary Commemorative Officer Data Set," along with six new scenarios, such as "Birth of Nobunaga."
For more details about the complete edition contents, please see the official site.

Note:
- This content is also included in "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening Complete Edition + Collector's Set." Please be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
- The "Kou Shibusawa Secret Strategy Data & Officers Art Book," "Digital Officer Artbook," "Digital NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION 40th Anniversary Commemorative Book," "Digital Complete Soundtrack," and other limited time add-on content are not included.

- Please be aware that you cannot carry over save data to or from the Nintendo Switch™ version of "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening."

70010000095209.name: Kebab Simulator 2025
70010000095209.intro: From Skewers to Success – Build, Cook, and Rule the Kebab Scene!
70010000095209.description:
Welcome to Kebab Simulator 2025, where sizzling skewers, mouthwatering flavors, and restaurant mastery await! Start from a humble food stall and grow your dream kebab restaurant into the hottest spot in town. Design your eatery, craft the perfect menu, and serve up delicious dishes to satisfy hungry customers.

Expand your recipe book with flavors from around the world—grill succulent meats, prepare tasty appetizers, and whip up delectable desserts. Customize your space with unique decorations, stylish furniture, and a signboard that makes your shop impossible to miss.

Will your kebab joint become a legendary dining destination? Time to sharpen your knives and find out!

70010000095215.name: Yakuza 0 Director's Cut
70010000095215.intro: Discover the decadence and danger of 1988 Japan.
70010000095215.description:
Discover the decadence and danger of 1988 Japan.

Yakuza 0 Director's Cut is the definitive edition of the critically acclaimed origin story, now on Nintendo Switch™ 2.  

Fight like hell through Tokyo and Osaka entertainment districts as yakuza Kazuma Kiryu and cabaret club manager Goro Majima in an epic crime drama of intertwined fates that created legends.

Kiryu and Majima each have three unique fighting styles to dynamically switch between to creatively crack skulls with your fists, makeshift weapons and more. Anyone can enjoy exhilarating brawler action with easy-to-pick-up controls and a high skill ceiling.

Director's Cut content gives deeper insight into key incidents and character backstories with never-before-seen cutscenes. Plus, the Red Light Raid online multiplayer mode lets you join forces with friends and choose from 60 playable characters to take down hordes of enemies.

70010000095220.name: SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS
70010000095220.intro: Sonic and Shadow for a new generation
70010000095220.description:
Shadow the Hedgehog is back with Classic and Modern Sonic in SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS, an all-new collection featuring two unique experiences! 

Play as Shadow in a brand-new story campaign featuring never-before-seen abilities that prove why he’s known as the Ultimate Life Form! Speed through iconic stages from Shadow’s history, discover hidden secrets in an expansive hub world, and unlock new powers to take on Black Doom and save the world.

SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS also includes a complete remaster of the highly acclaimed SONIC GENERATIONS, a time-traveling adventure featuring a greatest-hits collection of 3D and 2D Sonic stages, now with upgraded visuals and new bonus content.

The Return of Shadow
In this new standalone campaign, Shadow’s nemesis, Black Doom, has reemerged and threatens to take over the world once again. Shadow must journey into his past, confront his painful memories, and unlock new dark powers to save the world.

Shadow Evolved
Harness Shadow’s new Doom Powers to battle hordes of enemies and tackle platforming challenges like never before. Surf on water, fly over obstacles, and stop time with the return of Chaos Control!

A Journey Through Time and Dimensions
Relive signature levels from Shadow’s previous adventures and accelerate through mind-bending stages in both 3D and 2D, warped by Black Doom’s influence as Shadow works to piece together the timeline and thwart his evil plans. 

Explore the New White Space
Stretch your legs in an all-new hub world inspired by the open-zone gameplay of Sonic Frontiers. As Shadow gains new powers, he can explore further and uncover the secrets hidden throughout!

An Epic Time-Traveling Sonic Adventure
Past meets present in SONIC GENERATIONS! When Dr. Eggman teams up with his past self and the mysterious Time Eater to erase their past defeats and rewrite history, they scatter Sonic and his friends across space and time. Now, Modern and Classic Sonic will have to team up to defeat this dastardly trio and restore their timeline to normal!

The Best of Both Worlds, Remastered
Spin dash through a greatest-hits collection of 3D and 2D versions of iconic stages from past Sonic games, now with updated visuals and reworked cinematics. 

More Collectibles, Bonus Content, and more!
Rescue Chao hiding in every level, rack up the highest pinball score in the Casino Nights Zone, and check out the museum for behind-the-scenes art, music, and more!

70010000095225.name: Love at First Sight
70010000095225.intro: A love at first sight sparks a passionate quest. Make choices and shape her destiny in this visual novel.
70010000095225.description:
Discover an unforgettable story of romance in this captivating visual novel. It all begins with a magical moment: a fleeting glance, a racing heartbeat... and a love that changes everything. Our protagonist crosses paths with a mysterious girl in a chance encounter and in that moment, he knows he must find her again.

Driven by the certainty that she is his soul mate, he will begin a search full of excitement, unexpected encounters and crucial decisions. Every choice you make will shape his destiny: will he succeed in reuniting with her and winning her heart, or will his love fade like an unattainable dream?

Immerse yourself in a moving story where destiny and romance intertwine. Experience an experience full of feelings, dilemmas and moments that will make your heart race. Are you ready to follow the signs of love?

70010000095246.name: Gun Shop Simulator
70010000095246.description:
Manage your own gun store, selling firearms from pistols to rifles. Test your collection at the shooting range, compete with others, and expand your business.

Step into the world of arms dealing as a passionate collector-turned-gunsmith in Gun Shop Simulator! This unique simulator lets you create and manage your very own gun store, where you trade, customize, and sell firearms ranging from classic handguns to high-tech, modern weapons. 

Run Your Own Gun Business: Start your journey by stocking your shop with a variety of firearms, including pistols, shotguns, rifles, and military-grade weapons. Organize your inventory with precision, ensuring that everything from handguns to assault rifles is displayed effectively to entice customers. 

Test and Compete at the Shooting Range: Beyond selling and customizing weapons, Gun Shop Simulator offers a fully equipped shooting range where players can put their weapons to the test. 

Design and Expand: Your shop is more than just a business—it’s a reflection of your style and success. As you generate more revenue, reinvest it into expanding and upgrading your shop. A well-designed shop with organized weapon racks, premium lighting, and impressive decor will draw in more traffic and increase your profit margins. 

Are you ready to become the ultimate weapon dealer? Whether you're selling to casual buyers, catering to hardcore collectors, or testing your skills at the shooting range, Gun Shop Simulator is your ticket to success in the competitive world of arms trading. Step into the role of a gunsmith and experience the excitement of building a gun shop empire!

70010000095248.name: Unicorns - The Troll Adventure
70010000095248.description:
Immerse yourself in an epic fantasy adventure full of magic, courage and unforgettable heroes!

In a magical kingdom, noble unicorns guard the powers of light - until dark trolls led by the sinister Gruclock plunge everything into chaos.

Their goal is the legendary Crystal of Dawn, the source of all magic. Only the brave unicorn brothers Troy and Sly can avert disaster. With Troy's magical attacks and Sly's flying skills, you will face dangerous opponents. Together they embark on a journey to save their kingdom and free their friends, who have been captured by the villainous Gruclock and his troll henchmen.

The game allows both solo play with the ability to switch between the two characters, as well as cooperative play where two players work together in real time.

• Four exciting worlds
• 40 exciting levels
• Dramatic boss battles in the last level of each world
• Local multiplayer mode (up to 2 players)

70010000095253.name: Retro Drive: Revamped
70010000095253.intro:
Neon-Charged Retro Racing!
Race through Retropolis to a pulsing synthwave beat!
70010000095253.description:
Burn rubber through the neon-lit streets of Retropolis in Retro Drive: Revamped, an indie arcade racer steeped in ‘80s nostalgia. Dodge deadly laser gates and outrun relentless police as you chase friends across vibrant, retro tracks. Master high-speed challenges in a thrilling time capsule of arcade fun. Packed with pop culture nods, this gem delivers pure, addictive racing action.
• Tackle tough tracks with precise, heart-pounding gameplay
• Unlock and customize cars to rule the neon roads
• Groove to a synthwave soundtrack by Fantom ‘87 and Sunglasses Kid
• Hunt for VHS collectibles packed with ‘80s movie references
• Compete for high scores in a retrofuturistic adventure

70010000095258.name: EGGCONSOLE MIRAI PC-8801mkIISR
70010000095258.intro: A shooting game depicting a rescue drama set in an underwater city. Avoid obstacles and missile interference as you save the people of the underwater city!
70010000095258.description:
Universal Century, Seven-Two-O

Human life on Earth had been wiped out, forcing humanity to migrate to space. The fate of the next migration was entrusted to the REINBOW Nebula. However, the REINBOW Nebula consisted of six planets with completely different environments, all ruled by a single governing planet—and they viewed humanity as an absolute enemy. As time flowed, a mysterious soldier raced through the unknown. When he laid eyes on an armored suit with five radiant lights, his destiny was forever changed.

Into the Future (From the Player's Manual)

This is an action RPG originally released in 1986 in Japan. Players take on the role of the aforementioned mysterious soldier and embark on an adventure across six planets.

The game features a side-view action RPG format, where each planet consists of two stages: an aerial stage with a shooting-based playstyle and an underground stage where hand-to-hand combat and action mechanics come into play. Key locations, such as underground entrances and the end of each stage, feature formidable boss battles. By uncovering their weaknesses, players can experience thrilling and tense encounters.

The game's difficulty is notably high. In aerial combat, running out of fuel causes health to gradually deplete, and when it reaches zero, it's game over. Thus, managing fuel stations as central bases for resupply is essential. On stages where refueling isn't possible, players must carefully select a low-power thruster to conserve fuel. Proper fuel management is a critical technique for survival. Additionally, some stages lack shops altogether, making it crucial to stock up on necessary items beforehand.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000095261.name: Medical Lab Science: Anime Nurse Love in the Public Hospital
70010000095261.intro: Uncover the secrets of the hospital… while healing the heart of your ideal nurse.
70010000095261.description:
Step into the halls of a hospital filled with mystery, desire, and raw emotion. Meet irresistible nurses, each with their own unique charm, and protect them—not just from outside threats, but from the wounds they carry within.

Through intimate questions and emotionally charged strategy gameplay, unlock suggestive images and endings as intense as they are unexpected.

Each nurse hides more than her uniform reveals. Can you truly understand her heart… and win it?


Features:

-Unique dual gameplay: Switch between deep, revealing questions that uncover her soul and defense mode, where you must shield her heart from emotional tension and past regrets.

-Suggestive scenes and unforgettable moments: Unlock intimate images and meaningful encounters—experiences that only unfold if you truly connect with her.

-Discover her most human side: Each response unveils pieces of her personality, hidden desires, and the secrets behind her professional smile.

-Multiple endings: What happens between you and her depends on your intuition, your choices… and how well you read between the lines.

-A secret, daring question: Reach the final moment and unlock a scene that will change everything.


Can you heal her heart… while yours races faster with every heartbeat?

Dare to live a story where romance, desire, and medicine entwine… and no one leaves untouched.

70010000095266.name: Medical Lab Science: Anime Doctor Love in the Public Hospital
70010000095266.intro: Uncover the secrets of the hospital… while healing the heart of your ideal doctor.
70010000095266.description:
Step into the halls of a hospital filled with mystery, desire, and raw emotion. Meet irresistible doctors, each with their own unique charm, and protect them—not just from outside threats, but from the wounds they carry within. 

Through intimate questions and emotionally charged strategy gameplay, unlock suggestive images and endings as intense as they are unexpected.

Each doctor hides more than his white coat reveals. Can you truly understand his heart… and win it?

Features:

-Unique dual gameplay: Switch between deep, revealing questions that uncover his soul and defense mode, where you must shield his heart from emotional tension and past regrets.

-Suggestive scenes and unforgettable moments: Unlock intimate images and meaningful encounters—experiences that only unfold if you truly connect with him.

-Discover his most human side: Each response unveils pieces of his personality, hidden desires, and the secrets behind his professional gaze.

-Multiple endings: What happens between you and him depends on your intuition, your choices… and how well you read between the lines.

-A secret, daring question: Reach the final moment and unlock a scene that will change everything.


Can you heal his heart… while yours races faster with every heartbeat?

Dare to live a story where romance, desire, and medicine entwine… and no one leaves untouched.

70010000095274.name: Stellar Docks: Deep Space
70010000095274.intro: Logic without limits, puzzles beyond the stars!
70010000095274.description:
Embark on an interstellar puzzle adventure in Stellar Docks, a grid-based logic game featuring charming 2D pixel art. Guide an astronaut as they push drones to their charging docks across challenging maps filled with strategic puzzles. With a top-down view and intuitive controls, the game offers a satisfying progression that will test your problem-solving skills. From the interiors of a spaceship to the icy landscapes of Neptune, explore diverse environments and unravel intricate challenges that push your mastery of each mechanic.

Whether you're a casual gamer or a puzzle enthusiast, Stellar Docks is your ticket to a cosmic brain-teasing journey!

Main Features

Engaging Grid-Based Logic Gameplay: Move drones to their designated docks using strategic, step-by-step movement.
Unlimited Undo and Level Restarts: Experiment freely and refine your strategies without fear.
40 Challenging Levels: Explore four unique environments (Spaceship Interior, The Moon, Mars, and Neptune), each introducing new puzzle mechanics and increasing difficulty.
Immersive Pixel Art: Experience the charm of handcrafted 2D pixel art in a sci-fi setting.
Prepare to test your skills and master the cosmos in Stellar Docks!

70010000095279.name: Chippy's Stash
70010000095279.description:
Winter is coming, and Chippy, the cleverest squirrel in the forest, needs to stash his precious acorns! In Chippy’s Stash, a charming tile-based puzzle game, you must help Chippy push acorns into hollow tree stumps, overcoming obstacles that will test your wit and strategy.

Each level introduces new mechanics to make the journey even more fun: mud tiles that make acorns slide, fallen trunks that redirect movement, and burrow tiles that teleport acorns across the map!

Explore three unique biomes, each offering increasing challenges:
Spring – Learn the basics and master the first puzzles.
Summer – New mechanics and larger maps to test your skills.
Autumn – The ultimate challenge! All mechanics combine to create complex and engaging puzzles.

With charming pixel art and puzzles ranging from relaxing to challenging, Chippy’s Stash is perfect for casual players who love smart, strategic gameplay.

The forest needs a master strategist—are you ready to help Chippy prepare for winter?

70010000095288.name: Suikoden I&II HD Remaster for Nintendo Switch™ 2 Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars
70010000095288.intro: The Legend of Suikoden I and II returns, remastered in HD!
70010000095288.description:
A hero's destiny is written in the Stars
The legendary Konami JRPGs Suikoden I and Suikoden II have now been remastered in HD!

The Story of Suikoden I
A once renowned hero turns into a violent tyrant, and an empire falls into decline.
A Liberation Army is rising up in an act of rebellion against an oppressive rule.
One by one the 108 stars of Destiny gather to shape the course of history.

The Story of Suikoden II
Our story's hero and his friend Jowy are members of the Unicorn Youth Brigade, which participated in a drawn-out border dispute between the Highland Kingdom and the City-States of Jowston .
A few months earlier, a truce agreement was signed between the two forces, both of which were happy to see an end to the fighting.
However, hidden under the momentary peace the fires of a new war continued to smolder…

Features of Suikoden I & Suikoden II HD
・All background illustrations have been upgraded to HD
・Updated effects breathe new life into the pixel art animation
・New environmental sounds effects to immerse yourself in this fantasy world
・Battle SFX are also now HD and add a new level of realism
・Newly added auto-save
・Battle Fast Forward
・Conversation Log

70010000095300.name: Parry Nightmare
70010000095300.intro:
Easy to pick up, and hard to put down! 
Parry Nightmare is a one-of-a-kind "parry heaven" action game where the best offense is a good defense!
70010000095300.description:
Team up with your "other self", Honno-chan, as you parry, pummel and pulse your way out of your darkest nightmare in this one-of-a-kind "parry heaven" action game!

Use your nightmare's strength against it with your trusty parry move! Stun foes, send away projectiles, and stop threats right in their tracks by chaining parries!

Honno-chan will defeat any foes you stun automatically. Leave them to her and focus on the defense!

Parrying grants your soul more and more courage to face the night! Heal up by continuing to parry! Spend excess soul to unleash a powerful Burst move to wipe out hordes of enemies at once!

Collect powerups from rare foes to supercharge Honno-chan! Breathe fire, deploy orbital pain, wreak havoc, and more!

Defeated enemies drop light. Collect light and the darkness of the nightmare abates, giving you a clearer view of the chaos. Max out your light meter to beat the nightmare!

Will you be able to escape the nightmare and greet a new day...?

70010000095305.name: Skating Rink Story
70010000095305.intro: Make your wildest ice dreams come true with this skating rink management game.
70010000095305.description:
Let the elegant sound of carefully sharpened metal on meticulously maintained ice ring through your ears as you manage your very own ice skating rink. Train up your eager staff and enter them into competitions.

But first things first—you're going to need a huge rink, a place where your customers can glide with glee. And you never know when a carefully placed object on the ice may lead to an impromptu photoshoot.

Make sure your skaters are warm and happy off the ice with a heated room and soup bar. Some people might even post their experiences on social media, too!

Keep customers coming back by listening to their requests, like increasing the food choices at your rink. And with the right combination, who knows what amazing dishes you may discover! You can't skate on an empty stomach, after all!

You're also going to need a capable instructor or two to teach skaters all kinds of amazing tricks and bring out their full potential! And once they master the basics, have them create a figure-skating program and enter competitions! Their success on the ice will mean more business for your rink!

Looks like even the mayor from the town over has heard about your rink and come to check it out for themselves! With this kind of popularity, it won't be long until you have people coming from all over the world!

Now, get ready to create countless wonderful memories with your skaters, and aim to turn your rink into an unforgettable, 5-star facility!

70010000095310.name: Garden of Merging Numbers
70010000095310.intro:
Protect the flower field from the forest witch!
A cute turn-based tower defense game.
70010000095310.description:
This is a tower defense game where you attack and defeat enemy frogs approaching each turn using magical flowers.
Challenge the 3-WAVE Mode with 120 turns and the ENDLESS MODE!

Use flower upgrades and helpful items to protect your flower field!

70010000095321.name: BRAVELY DEFAULT FLYING FAIRY HD Remaster
70010000095321.intro: The story of light and shadow that never fades is reborn
70010000095321.description:
BRAVELY DEFAULT, the incredible first instalment in the BRAVELY series returns, remastered in high definition.

Relive the tale of the warriors of light on their quest to awaken the crystals. Enjoy strategic battles featuring the unique Brave and Default commands and over 20 different jobs. Plus modern gameplay enhancements and all-new minigames!

• Story: Make for the distant land of Luxendarc as a warrior of light.
Without warning, the Great Chasm opened a hole in the world. Tiz is the sole survivor of a village swallowed whole by the chasm. In the depths of his despair, he encounters a young vestal named Agnès. Together they set off on a journey with the goal of closing the chasm and freeing the crystals swallowed by darkness.

They set off, entirely unaware of the significance of that goal.

• Battle: Take your time planning your strategies in turn-based battles. 
What command to choose, in what style to fight, and just how many actions to take—a variety of tactics are at your disposal in this deep and engaging battle system. Two commands bring a new dimension of enjoyment to battle: brave to expend BP and increase the number of actions taken in a turn, or default to shore up your defenses and accumulate BP for later. Annihilate the enemy with an onslaught of attack moves or recover from a sticky situation with a combination of resurrection and healing moves.

• Enhancements: Enjoy your adventure with upgraded features.
Based on the original version, this remaster features high-definition graphics, a redesigned user interface, ability to fast forward event scenes, and other modern conveniences. Networking features from the original version have been retooled for Nintendo Switch™ 2 online services. Two types of mouse-controlled minigames are also newly added.

70010000095325.name: Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess
70010000095325.intro: A new tale of the Kami awaits…
70010000095325.description:
The imaginative Japanese-inspired world of Capcom's highly acclaimed game, Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess, comes to Nintendo Switch™ 2!

Experience a mystical journey that combines a unique blend of dance-like sword action and strategic gameplay, enhanced for Nintendo Switch™ 2 with multiple ways to play including mouse controls.

70010000095330.name: Puyo Puyo™ Tetris® 2S
70010000095330.intro: The Ultimate Puzzle Match, now Enhanced
70010000095330.description:
Enter a newly enhanced dimension of puzzle challenge when world-renowned Tetris® and Japan’s beloved Puyo Puyo series blend their legendary gameplay in the ultimate puzzle match. Stack, chain, and combo your way to victory in traditional Puyo Puyo and Tetris… or mix them together in this unique crossover.

- Brand-new Puyo Tetris® Doubles Mode: Compete in 2v2 battles with pairs using a single board to pull off devastating combos.

-Experience a multi-dimensional story in the extensive Adventure mode or compete with friends and family in a bounty of competitive local and online modes featuring support for up to 4 players.

-An absolutely packed roster of 40 playable characters, including Sonic the Hedgehog, each with their own unique stats and abilities you can carry with you into the robust, RPG-inspired Skill Battle mode.

70010000095339.name: Death Park 2: Remaster
70010000095339.intro: Be the first to survive this action-packed horror game in stunning graphics and uncover the dark secret behind the murderous clown!
70010000095339.description:
Start your adventure in one of the scariest horror games, now remastered in stunning graphics ! In Death Park 2: Remaster, you will find yourself in a terrifying city full of secrets, monsters, and new visual details. Take action to save your sister from the murderous clown, uncover the mystery of Death Park, and discover the origin of the scary clown!

Explore 8 large locations, including creepy streets, abandoned hospitals, haunted cemeteries, dark sewers, and a military base, all enhanced with improved graphics and atmosphere. Move between the real world and the nightmare realm to solve updated puzzles, which now include two difficulty levels and change with every playthrough.

Your choices will shape the fate of your sister and determine which of the many endings you unlock. Can you survive the nightmare in this enhanced horror experience?

Enjoy the fear, friend!

70010000095342.name: CarGo!
70010000095342.intro: Working as a team of couriers try to collect and deliver as many goods as possible while keeping an eye out for time, traffic and roadworks!
70010000095342.description:
CarGo! is a chaotic couch co-op for up to four players. Working as a team of couriers try to collect and deliver as many goods as possible while keeping an eye out for time, traffic and roadworks!

Are you ready to start your journey in logistics? As a fresh delivery driver, you’ll take on various transportation tasks across the many islands of Carchipelago. Help the numerous warehouses get their required goods, no matter how strange the order. With chaotic gameplay and tight time limits, CarGo! will keep you on the edge of your seat!

Co-op!
Play solo or assemble a team of up to four couriers who can handle the pressure. Test your communication skills as you coordinate routes and race against the clock. Whether you’re shouting directions, planning strategies, or just laughing through the mayhem, teamwork is the key to success.

Accolades!
Do you prefer to prioritize your tasks or take it easy while others do the work for you? No matter your choice, after completing each level, you’ll receive an accolade for your performance. Now everyone will know just how lazy or reckless you are.

Arcade Controls!
Enjoy an old-school driving model that emulates fan favorites, bringing back the nostalgic thrill of classic games. Experience the most fun and engaging simulation of driving a toy car, with easy-to-learn controls and a playful, arcade-style feel.

Traffic!
Embrace the constant challenge of bustling city streets and the chaotic traffic that accompanies them. Maneuvering through the jumble of cars demands not just quick reflexes, but also strategic planning. Stay ahead of the flow of traffic, capitalizing on opportunities to weave through the congestion and reach your destination swiftly.

Vehicles!
Take control of a variety of quirky vehicles, from charming tuk-tuks to sleek race cars. Each vehicle offers a unique driving experience, adding a fun twist to your delivery missions. Embrace the challenge and enjoy the thrill of delivering with style and creativity.

Obstacles!
Navigate through the city’s intricate network of streets, carefully planning your routes to avoid roadblocks and unexpected events, ensuring timely delivery of packages to their destinations. Speed is of the essence; the quicker you deliver, the higher your score, so don’t hesitate to take daring shortcuts, even if it means jumping over bridges!

Are you ready to take the wheel and become the ultimate delivery master? Fasten your seatbelt and drive into the frenetic world of CarGo!

70010000095345.name: Arcade Archives AIR COMBAT 22
70010000095345.intro: Real-time hypersonic air battles on the System Super 22 hardware!!
70010000095345.description:
"AIR COMBAT 22" is a flight shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1995.
This title features an evolutionary step in 3D graphics and flashy animations using the "System Super 22" arcade board, an upgrade of the "System 22" architecture used for a wide range of legendary 3D games.
Take on missions for the thrill of shooting down lots of enemy crafts, white-knuckle missions that require expert techniques, and more as you conquer diverse aerial combat scenarios. Become a hero of the skies!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000095355.name: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny
70010000095355.description:
Embark on a fantastical quest with your favorite Nicktoons characters—reimagined as epic Action-RPG heroes!

Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny is a vibrant, universe-spanning mashup that brings iconic Nickelodeon heroes into a world of fantasy-style tropes and real-time RPG action. Get ready to roll the dice and dive into a wild, action-packed adventure with SpongeBob, Katara, Leonardo, and others as they swing spatulas, bend water, slice katanas, and more. Get ready for epic battles, dynamic environments, and recognizable character moments, all with an engaging gameplay experience for players of all ages.

Key Game Features:
• Play as Legendary Nickelodeon Characters—Fantasy Style
Suit up as SpongeBob SquarePants, Katara, Leonardo, Sandy Cheeks, Timmy Turner, Susie Carmichael, Danny Phantom, Jimmy Neutron, and Jenny Wakeman, each reimagined into classic RPG character classes from Spellcaster and Wizard to Barbarian and Knight, and more. Every hero comes with their own unique powers and weapons.

• Real-Time, Action-Packed Battles
Slash, cast spells, and strategize your way through fast-paced, fluid combat. Master each character’s unique style and time your combos to perfection.

• Explore Whimsical Worlds 
From Bikini Bottomshire to the Ghost Zone, journey through colorful, Nickelodeon-inspired fantasy lands with fun, reimagined twists – each filled with puzzles, secrets, side quests, and wonderful surprises.

• Conquer Epic Boss Battles
Face off against iconic enemies like Azula, Angelica, and Plankton in intense boss battles - each fight offering unique mechanics and surprises—leading up to an unforgettably climactic final encounter.

• Single Player or Local Co-Op for 1–4 Players
Team up with friends and build your party! Mix and match characters for the perfect balance of skills and chaos in your local squad.

• Level Up and Customization
Unlock new powers, upgrade your weapons, and shape your heroes’ path through this awesome adventure. 

• Built for Nick Fans and Action-RPG Lovers
Whether you're a lifelong Nickelodeon fan or a fantasy RPG adventurer, Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny blends charm, fast-paced fun, and adventure together in one unforgettable quest.

70010000095357.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Yumyeongsan
70010000095357.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000095357.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Yumyeongsan, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 1 flight course. 
High-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000095362.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Gapyeong-gun
70010000095362.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000095362.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Gapyeong-gun, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 4 flight courses. 
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000095367.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Namhan River
70010000095367.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000095367.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Namhan River, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 4 flight courses. 
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000095372.name: Lunara: Planet IX
70010000095372.intro:
A Hidden Planet. A New Hope.
Explore, build, and survive in the mysterious world of Planet IX.
70010000095372.description:
Discover a mysterious new planet that challenges everything we thought we knew about the universe. Hidden for ages behind the Sun, this twin of Earth has finally been revealed thanks to groundbreaking technology. Sharing the same habitable zone, day-night cycle, and even the same mass as Earth, Planet IX (known to its native inhabitants as Lunara) represents a bold new frontier for humanity.

While scientists were exploring this incredible world and teaching the Lunarians to speak our language, disaster struck Earth. The Moon was mysteriously destroyed. With debris threatening all life on the planet, the research team rushed back to help the survivors, leaving behind Emylia, a dedicated civil engineer. With the help of an advanced AI, Emylia takes on the mission to build a safe colony for Earth’s last remaining survivors.

  Build and Decorate
Construct essential structures such as schools, power plants, homes, and hospitals.
Design and decorate both the interior and exterior of homes any way you like.

  Mining & Crafting
Gather wood, mine materials, and craft crucial tools and items for survival and colony expansion.

  Farming
Grow food to sustain your colony and support its growth.

  Combat
Fight off monsters and explore mines and dungeons known as the Ancient Labyrinth.

  RPG System
Level up attributes such as Attack, Defense, Critical Chance, and Luck to strengthen your character.

  Technology & Theme
A unique blend of futuristic technology and medieval-inspired elements.

  Day-Night & Weather Cycle
Experience dynamic weather, seasons, and time progression throughout the game.

  Oxygen Management
Oxygen is consumed over time — fail to replenish it and you’ll lose random items and consciousness.

  Lunarian Interaction
Trade goods in the Lunarian Valley, located northwest of the colony.

  Taming System
Tame wild animals and ancient robots to assist in tasks and battle.

70010000095378.name: Leftovers KO!
70010000095378.intro: A hand-drawn animated boxing game where you fight a bunch of leftovers. After a long day at work, you come home to find that your uneaten food has come to life-it's here to beat you up
70010000095378.description:
Every leftover has a distinct fighting style, moveset, strengths, and weaknesses. 
Adapt, be quick, and turn them back into a pile of ingredients.
Learn new moves, practice them in the training room, and use them in real battle to savor the victory.

Why are leftovers all of the sudden fighting back? 
How is that even possible? 
Only one way to find out - beat' em up!

70010000095385.name: Cozy Hunt
70010000095385.intro: Find, explore, and relax in a world full of cute details!
70010000095385.description:
Cozy Hunt is a cute and relaxing hidden object game. In this game, you look for different things hidden in big, beautiful pictures. Each picture is full of funny and sweet details, so it’s always interesting to play. Some things are easy to find, and some are more tricky — but every level is full of surprises!

What’s great about this game:
-40 cute and fun levels — every picture is different!
-Play with touchscreen or with your controller
-Beautiful and happy pictures, full of funny little things

Relax, look around, and have fun in the cozy world of Cozy Hunt!

70010000095390.name: CybeRage
70010000095390.intro: Survive endless waves of alien creatures and crush the heart of the infestation!
70010000095390.description:
"Phy embarks on a secret mission to an abandoned planet infested by a hostile hivemind. With the help of her partner Lizz and General Eral, she dives into the depths of the infestation and learns the dark truth behind its origins. Help her find the heart of the hive and put an end to this evergrowing threat.

Kill hordes of nasty bugs and use the experience gained to strengthen your arsenal and body with cybernetic enchantments. The hive will adapt and send more powerful enemies to stand in your way. Shoot them down with your army of drones, or slash them to pieces with your blade and stop the hivemind from growing even stronger!

Features:
- Engaging story: Accompany Phy in her quest against the hive
- Immersive world: Experience 19 hand-crafted cyberpunk levels
- High-tech arsenal: 10 fighter drones to upgrade and evolve
- Melee weapons: 5 powerful swords with unique active abilities
- Rogue-lite progression: Unlockable permanent augments
- Contracts: Complete tasks to earn credits

Will you help Phy defeat the hive and save the cyber age from impending doom?"

70010000095392.name: Axe Champ Vs
70010000095392.intro: Aim true, throw hard, and become the champion!
70010000095392.description:
Axe Champ Vs is the ultimate test of precision and skill! 

Take turns throwing axes at spinning, shifting, and unpredictable targets in a head-to-head battle. 

Each match consists of three intense rounds—hit the targets, rack up points, and outscore your opponent to claim victory! 

As you rise through the ranks, you'll unlock new worlds and prove yourself as the ultimate Axe Champion.

Aim true, throw hard, and become the champion!

70010000095394.name: Squeakross: Home Squeak Home
70010000095394.intro: In Squeakross: Home Squeak Home, solve and transform puzzles into furniture to decorate the perfect home for your rodent friend!
70010000095394.description:
Ever dreamed of being a home owner? Welcome to the Squeakross: Home Squeak Home program!

You just got into a fresh new home for your tiny rodent friend, but… it’s empty! Solve puzzles from the Home Squeak Home Catalog and transform them into splendid furniture and accessories to dress it up!

SOLVE!
- Relaxing Puzzle Solving: Learn how to play in 5 minutes, and solve logic-numbers puzzles at your rhythm, no time pressure.
- Scared of puzzles? Worry not! Your rodent friend is here to help. Customize your game experience: Toggle hints, Solve a random cell, or use the brand new Logic-Assist system that lets you preview possible solutions! 
- No assistance needed? You can disable all those options if you prefer to be challenged.

DECORATE!
Our Home Squeak Home catalog features many different styles of interior decor, from basic housing supplies to extravagant ones to match a broad range of tastes. You will also find many accessories to dress your rodent friend.

SQUEAK!
Shape your rodent to your liking in the world's first Rodent Editor (we think??). From snout to tail, decide what kind of friend you want to have by your side!

FEATURES:
- A Nonogram game like no other.
- Relaxing puzzle-solving, with no time limit, mindful of new players.
- Logic-Assist system that lets you preview possible solutions.
- Decorate your home with hundreds of unique furniture.
- Create and customize your own rodent with accessories.
- Customize your user interface with unlockable stickers made by Eon.
- Receive tips and lore from Nini, the owner of Home Squeak Home Inc.
- "Streamer mode" to turn off Content ID tagged music

70010000095396.name: NBA 2K26
70010000095396.description:
Bragging rights are on the line in MyCAREER*, MyTEAM, MyLEAGUE, and Play Now. Showcase your bag of moves with enhanced gameplay and challenge your friends, or rivals, in NBA 2K26’s competitive modes—and leave no doubt that you wear the crown.

CONTROL THE COURT

Experience enhanced gameplay and authentic controls that allow you to orchestrate the offense and dictate the pace of play. Facilitate with free-flowing, dynamic movement, stay in rhythm with improved shooting mechanics, and separate from defenders with graceful Eurosteps. Flash your skills and play fast in single-player and multiplayer game modes.

SQUAD UP AND WIN

Create your legend in MyCAREER and build a MyPLAYER capable of leading an NBA franchise to the NBA Finals. Achieve individual and team success, raise banners, and play your way into the Hall of Fame. Squad up with friends and challenge rival squads to see who runs the court.

UNITE STARS IN MyTEAM

Collect and compete with NBA and WNBA superstars in MyTEAM. Assemble a star-studded roster, put your dream team to the test in single-player and multiplayer modes, and acquire new cards to make your MyTEAM fantasy a reality.

YOUR TEAM, YOUR STORY

Write the next chapter of an NBA franchise as a General Manager in MyLEAGUE, and add to its storied history by raising banners. Influence the future of the sport and leave an indelible mark on the league.

*Internet connection and NBA 2K Account required to redeem and use bonus content. Terms apply.

Play Now, MyNBA, The W, and MyLEAGUE are available offline. All other game modes and features require Internet connection and may require online account registration (varies 13+).

70010000095407.name: Lynked: Banner of the Spark
70010000095407.intro: Team up for an ARPG adventure!
70010000095407.description:
It’s the year 30XX, and the natural world has been overrun by an evil robot force… but all is not lost. As you rescue and join forces with a charming band of robot companions called the Unibots, you’ll form a community of fearless friends, and work together to build a new future from the ground up.

A ROGUE-LIFE RPG
Lynked: Banner of the Spark fuses the action packed fun of a roguelite with the rich progression and charm of a life sim. In this vibrant rogue-life RPG, combat and customization go hand in hand. Put your skills to the test against swarms of robot foes and tough-as-nails bosses, then use their parts and other resources to expand and upgrade your home base. Whether you’re a homebody or a hardened warrior, there are endless ways to pitch in – it’ll take a village to save the world!

LYNK UP IN CO-OP OR SOLO
Take on a variety of hack-and-slash missions either solo or with up to 3 players. But wait… your Unibot pals want a piece of the action, too! Players can power up and recruit allied bots into the fight as companions, where they have their own powers, fighting styles, and combo attacks to send your foes to the scrap pile!

WEAPONS AND THE WYRE 
Kick bolts with your trusty grapple, known as the Wyre, along with an arsenal of weapons at your disposal! Gain an edge on enemies with 10 weapon classes, 80+ variations, robust permanent progression systems, and randomized mid-mission upgrades ensuring no two runs are ever the same.  

BUILD A THRIVING TOWN 
Enlist the help of robots and up to 5 friends to work together and build a bright local community. Catch fish, collect critters, harvest crops, and craft items to make your home uniquely yours! In addition to enriching your town, use the resources you collect to upgrade your character with special powers and techniques to take to your next fight.

FINE-TUNE YOUR LOOK 
Rebuild society in style with deep character customization, featuring more options and accessories than you can shake a wrench at!

NINTENDO SWITCH™ 2 EDITION UPGRADE PACK
Lynked: Banner of the Spark can be upgraded to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition after purchase at no additional cost. To upgrade, download the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack available from Nintendo eShop onto your Nintendo Switch 2.

70010000095417.name: Hogwarts Legacy
70010000095417.description:
This edition of Hogwarts Legacy has been enhanced for Nintendo Switch™ 2, including Joy-Con™ 2 mouse sensor support, improved graphics, audio, load times, and controls.

Hogwarts Legacy is an immersive, open-world action RPG set in the world first introduced in the Harry Potter books. Take control of the action and be at the center of your own adventure in the wizarding world. 

Experience Hogwarts in the 1800s. Make allies, battle Dark wizards, and ultimately decide the fate of the wizarding world. Your legacy is what you make of it. Live the Unwritten.

EXPLORE AN OPEN WORLD

The wizarding world awaits you. Freely roam Hogwarts, Hogsmeade, the Forbidden Forest, and the surrounding Overland area. 

BE THE WITCH OR WIZARD YOU WANT TO BE

Learn spells, brew potions, grow plants, and tend to magical beasts along your journey. Get sorted into your house, forge relationships, and master skills to become the witch or wizard you want to be.

EXPERIENCE A NEW WIZARDING WORLD STORY

Experience the wizarding world in a forgotten era to uncover a hidden truth from its past. Battle against trolls, dark wizards, and more as you face a dangerous villain threatening the fate of the wizarding world.

70010000095422.name: Split Fiction - Friend's Pass
70010000095422.intro: Experience a mind-blowing co-op adventure in Split Fiction
70010000095422.description:
Download Friend's Pass* to play Split Fiction with a friend for free on any platform! Try the early stages of the game in couch co-op or online cross-platform with another owner of the Friends Pass. If a friend owns the full game, you can join them for the entire adventure for free.

HERE'S HOW IT WORKS:
1. Own Split Fiction
2. Friend Downloads Friend’s Pass on chosen platform
3. Send invite to a friend
4. Play the entire game together!

One minute you’re taming adorable dragons and the next you’re fighting as cyber ninjas, escaping terrifying trolls, or dodging hover cars thrown by a robotic parking attendant. Split Fiction is weird, wild and designed to be shared. Grab a friend and get ready to overcome any obstacle thrown your way.

Embrace a mind-blow co-op action adventure from the studio behind 2021 Game of the Year Winner, It Takes Two. Mio and Zoe are contrasting writers – one writes sci-fi and the other writes fantasy – who become trapped in their own stories after being hooked up to a machine designed to steal their creative ideas. They’ll have to rely on each other to break free with their memories in-tact, working together to master a variety of abilities and overcome diverse challenges while jumping between sci-fi and fantasy worlds in this unexpected story of friendship.

70010000095427.name: Cho Aniki: Bakuretsu Ranto Hen
70010000095427.intro: A Crazy Brotherly Airborne Fighting Game
70010000095427.description:
The third game in the legendary Cho Aniki series created by Masaya. The fighting game Cho Aniki: Bakuretsu Ranto Hen has been fully ported for the Nintendo Switch™.
Eight unique characters compete in the First World Martial Arts Tournament hosted by the planet NCS Super Masayan. Who will emerge victorious?
Additional features such as Audio, Cutscenes, and Rewind are also available to enjoy this masterpiece to the fullest.
A must-have for retro game fans and fighting game fans alike.

70010000095431.name: Mario Kart™ World
70010000095431.intro: Ready your wheels for a brand-new Mario Kart  game exclusively for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system—with a world of interconnected courses to race through
70010000095431.description:
The whole world is your racetrack in this massive evolution of the Mario Kart™ series! The courses you race on are all connected in a seamless world. Drive the paths between them to traverse mountains, forests, cities, and more. Take in the sprawling vistas as you explore at your own pace in Free Roam—or watch how a sudden shift in the weather can mix up a dead heat in a tense Grand Prix.

Ride on rails, jump off walls, skim across water, and more as you race for the finish line. Master these new maneuvers and you might cut down your time to the finish line! 

Take on a classic Grand Prix, or go the distance in the Knockout Tour elimination mode

Speed through one course and then drive to the next in a non-stop rally that stretches from one corner of the world to another in the adrenaline-packed Knockout Tour! In this fierce 24-driver mode, racers are steadily eliminated, checkpoint by checkpoint, until only one remains. With Grand Prix and VS Races also supporting up to 24 drivers, the competition has never been tighter!

Race online* across modes with up to 23 other players, or talk with friends using GameChat as you race or roam. Through CameraPlay, you can even see your friends’ faces next to their vehicles as you zoom past them, whether you’re online or on the same couch. Hop into a match of Balloon Battle or Coin Runners for even more mayhem, or get focused and strive for your personal best in Time Trials. There’s something for every kind of racer!

Go full speed with series-new drivers, vehicles, courses, outfits, items, and more!

Race on brand-new courses, as well as familiar ones that have been reimagined with additional routes and other details. Stick with your favorite driver or broaden your horizons—there are loads of drivers, many with different outfits to unlock, and plenty of vehicles to master too. Some of the new additions might surprise you! (Is that Cow?!)

70010000095432.name: Platform5 Dungeons
70010000095432.intro:
Escape a mysterious station and save the stranded uncle!
Experience the first story-driven horror adventure in the popular ‘Platform’ series!
70010000095432.description:
In this new “Strange Phenomenon Rescue” genre, uncover the secrets behind inexplicable events and a mysterious object. 
Enter “Platform 5 Dungeons,” a massive terminal called Chijuku Station under evacuation orders. 
As part of the rescue team, you must find and gain the trust of the uncle left behind, while time loops repeatedly. 
Pick up trash as weapons to fend off lurking anomalies. 
Enjoy a thrilling 1–2 hour rescue drama as you unravel the station’s hidden mysteries.

70010000095441.name: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED BATTLE DESTINY REMASTERED
70010000095441.intro:
The remastered return of the fated battle.
Fly into the battlefield, Gundam!
70010000095441.description:
Become a pilot in the world of Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, for the first time available with English localization! Engage in thrilling, action-packed Gundam battles, complete missions, and tune up your newly acquired Mobile Suits!

• Battle across turbulent times!
Relive legendary moments from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED and Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny with enhanced maps and graphics. Choose your faction from Earth Alliance Forces, ZAFT, or the Archangel, and complete missions alongside familiar pilots and Mobile Suits from the series.

• Over 100 Mobile Suits!
All Mobile Suits have been redesigned with high-resolution model textures. Unlock more Mobile Suits and missions from the main Mobile Suit Gundam SEED series, and battle into additional side stories from the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED universe.

• Tune up your suits!
Strengthen your suits and weaponry in the redesigned UI menu. Tune your suits to match your playstyle as you embark on missions and take on stronger opponents!

• Even more System Enhancements
The save system has been reworked to make replays easier. Additionally, the difficulty has been adjusted with easier conditions for obtaining Mobile Suits. New lock-on modes and controller settings have also been added for smoother gameplay.

*Product is based on Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Battle Destiny released in 2012. Some specifications may differ.

70010000095450.name: Puzzles & Colors Games for Kids Toddler Coloring Book Draw Paint
70010000095450.intro:
Coloring games and puzzles for kids!
Discover fun scenes and educational activities! A safe world that encourages logic and creativity.
70010000095450.description:
Puzzles & Colors is the perfect game for toddlers and young children aged 2 and up. An educational and relaxing adventure designed to spark creativity and guide little ones through a world full of colors, animals, and interactive fun.

In the full version, with over 500 puzzles and coloring pages, kids can explore exciting environments: mysterious jungles, deep oceans, prehistoric lands with dinosaurs, snowy landscapes, and much more. Every drawing is a new opportunity to learn, relax, and have fun in a safe and friendly space.
Two simple and intuitive control modes:

-Move the pointer by tilting the Joy-Con™ like a magic wand! Thanks to the motion sensor, children can color and solve puzzles in a natural and engaging way. Perfect for improving hand-eye coordination.

-Play using the touchscreen! Kids can tap and color with their fingers for a smooth, hands-on experience that’s ideal even for the youngest players.

Main features:

    -Dozens of different themes and settings
    -Creative tools like brushes, pencils, and stamps
    -Easy puzzles designed for young children
    -Interactive backgrounds and animal sounds
    -Constant updates with new content
    -Safe, ad-free gameplay experience
    -Designed for kids ages 2 to 7

A learning game made for early development:

    -Encourages creativity and imagination
    -Enhances fine motor skills
    -Supports sensory development
    -Promotes artistic expression
    -Encourages parent-child interaction

Included content and themes:

The free version includes 14 fun activities. You can expand the game with additional themed packs, including:

    -Farm animals
    -Sea animals
    -Jungle, forest, and savannah
    -Halloween
    -Christmas
    -Space
    -Dinosaurs
    -And many more coming soon

Puzzles & Colors is the perfect way to combine learning with play.
Give your child a safe and creative experience that grows with them.

70010000095455.name: Little Heroine: The Electric Monsters
70010000095455.intro: Lila never imagined that a storm would turn her into a heroine! One night of lightning and rain, the young girl's life suddenly changes completely!
70010000095455.description:
In this visual novel, you'll discover Lila and her new little big friends!

Lila never imagined that finding a shiny locket would change her life completely! Now, her room is filled with sparkly creatures, her desk comes to life (literally!), and a mysterious villain stalks her from the shadows.

With the help of the Sparks, mischievous and luminous beings, Lila must discover the secret of the locket before the whole city turns into electrical chaos. But… be careful! It's not easy being a heroine when even the machines have their own plan.

A magical story, full of action, humor, and friendship

Key features
· Wonderful characters:

Lila, a brave and curious protagonist.
The Sparks, adorable electric creatures with unique personalities.
The mysterious villain, a technological genius with dark intentions.

·Colorful backgrounds:

Vibrant worlds filled with magical details and interactive settings.
A city where electricity comes to life in unexpected ways.

· Immersive music:

A magical, dynamic soundtrack that reacts to the action.
Sparkling sound effects make every moment more special.

· Story with values and emotion:

An adventure about the power of friendship, courage and self-confidence.
Fun challenges that teach Lila to solve problems with ingenuity and teamwork.

· Guaranteed fun:

Comic moments and tangles full of spark.
Electrifying action scenes with dynamic combat and surprising powers.

Get ready for a burst of fun with Lila and her friends!

70010000095460.name: Forgive Me Father 2
70010000095460.intro: Lovecraftian FPS with comic-like visuals: Blast your nightmares into oblivion!
70010000095460.description:
Journey once again into a malevolent world inspired by H.P Lovecraft’s myths where madness awaits on every corner. Embark on a path to salvation as you continue the story of the Priest character from the first installment. How long can you balance on the edge of sanity? Will your sins be forgiven, or your soul consumed by madness?

HIGHLIGHTS

Distinctive dark comic-like visuals
Dark hand-drawn graphic design where every frame looks like a page from a comic book is one of the pillars of Forgive Me Father, and the sequel brings a fresh perspective to its unique style with improved sprites, models and atmospheric lighting effects. Prepare to feast your eyes on juicy blood effects and animated gibs flying everywhere!

Dive into the madness
Defeat Lovecraftian nightmares with a wide range of weapons. Fight hosts of diverse, formidable enemies and beware: each and every one of them evolves into different, ever more evil and twisted forms of themselves - this journey does not get any easier!

Gear up and fight
Define your own playstyle and assemble the deadliest arsenal with plenty of weapons to choose from, each with even more powerful variations designed to cause absolute mayhem and bring utter destruction upon your foes. Take your pick from devastating shotguns, lethally accurate rifles, explosive launchers, and unleash their full potential. 

Gain mad skills
Overwhelming madness is your best friend and worst enemy at the same time. Let it flow through you, unleash absolute mayhem on your foes and gain extraordinary powers as a reward. Embrace the insanity, use it to fuel your bizarre new abilities, and teach the horrors assaulting your senses to fear YOU!

Otherworldly soundtrack
Experience the surprisingly fitting combination of strong electric guitar riffs and energetic drums underscoring the dark Lovecraftian atmosphere. Slay hordes of deranged cultists and confront unimaginable ancient evil while listening to the original soundtrack that will make you headbang for hours on end.
