70010000095465.name: Use Your Words 2
70010000095465.intro: “The party game for funny people and their unfunny friends” is back!
70010000095465.description:
The cult hit Use Your Words has all-new prompts and twice as many mini-games where you compete to write the funniest punchline – we set ‘em up, and you knock ‘em down! Players can use their phones or tablets as controllers, so it’s easy to jump in and seamless to play. And if you can’t think of a punchline, you can use one of our sneaky "Decoy” answers to lay a trap for your opponents… all with beautiful new visuals by artist Andrew Kolb!

CUSTOMIZE WITH “MIX N’ MATCH MODE”
Create your own custom playlist of mini-games in whatever order you choose! Want to binge your favorite mini-game 6 times in a row? Go for it!

SPECTATOR MODE IS MORE FUN!
You can choose to play as a “spectator” and join an interactive meta-game that includes changing the main players’ scores, trivia questions, and even teasing players while they play! Use Your Words 2 supports up to 1,000 spectators who can play locally or remotely.

OPTIMIZED FOR STREAMERS!
Use Your Words 2 is great for streaming because your viewers can play along without having to buy a copy of the game! And if you activate our special “Streamer Mode”, the music will change to a royalty-free soundtrack that won’t get you demonetized, plus we’ll extend the timer to cancel out stream lag.

MORE RESPONSIVE
Use Your Words 2 pays attention to how you’re playing and laughs along with you… it can give you tips based on your party’s behavior and also congratulate (or dunk on) your party members as they play!

MINI-GAMES
Use Your Words 2 ships with 8 unique mini-games:

• Sub The Title: It’s back! Write your own subtitle for a weird foreign film clip and make the actors say what you want them to say! It’s a blast for fans of funny video commentaries with a variety of wacky films from the past.

• Book It!: We show you a weird blank book cover and you write the title (fans of Paperback Paradise should enjoy this one!)

• Out of the Question: What if Jeopardy was funny? In our new lightning round, answer preposterous fake trivia questions with even more preposterous answers!

• Letterheads: Come up with ridiculous product names for vintage magazine ads by filling out three predetermined product initials.

• Blank-o-Matic: Fill in the blank to complete the sentence! Instead of waiting to have *the funniest card in your hand*, write an answer that matches your sense of humor!

• Sign Me Up!: Vandalize various signs and surfaces with your own labels, scrawls, and smart*ssery!

• Extra, Extra!: Write your own caption or clickbait headline for a ridiculous photo, in a take on the classic "caption this" game!

• Survey Says: Go with your gut in this rapid-fire lightning round. Its classic game show vibe allows players to settle their “Feud” once and for all!

Whether you're a total noob or a world-famous comedian, we guarantee hours of non-stop hilarity. So, grab a few friends and get ready to laugh along with Use Your Words 2!

Note: This game is played locally, but remote players can play via stream or video conference.

70010000095467.name: LOK Digital
70010000095467.intro: Learn a cryptic language of world-changing words and master their mind-bending effects.
70010000095467.description:
Discover a cryptic language of world-changing words
Learn the rules as you go and uncover how each new word has its own special ability to change the world around you in deep and surprising ways. Expand your vocabulary through 15 distinct worlds, each one exploring a new mechanic and completely shaking up the way you solve puzzles.

Master their mind-bending effects
With approachable mechanics and mind-bending gameplay, LOK Digital invites you to return every day for new procedurally generated puzzles showcasing the breadth and depth of mechanics.

Help the LOK creatures thrive
Bring the LOK creatures to life by spelling words that shape their world. They can only live on blackened tiles, so by solving puzzles you're expanding their horizons and helping their civilization thrive.

Features:
Intuitive mechanics and many magical words to find and learn
Elegant, hand-drawn art style and meditative, entrancing soundtrack
Learn the nuances of the LOK language across the 150+ puzzle campaign
Demonstrate your mastery of the mechanics in the expertly crafted daily puzzle mode and compete on the leaderboards
Based on the critically acclaimed puzzle book, LOK
Published by the award-winning puzzle experts, Draknek & Friends, the team behind A Monster’s Expedition, Cosmic Express, Bonfire Peaks, and more

70010000095477.name: Nickelodeon Splat Pack
70010000095477.intro: Relive the 90s in this collection of classic Nickelodeon games!
70010000095477.description:
Do you have it? In GUTS, you can take part in the legendary sports-action show and compete in classic events to test your mettle before you reach the radical rock itself - the Aggro Crag!

Rocko's Modern Life: Spunky's Dangerous Day is a unique puzzle platforming game where you have to guide Spunky out of harm's way. The game takes you across sixteen hazard-filled levels and locales inspired by the show itself. You might even run into some of O-Town's most well-known residents.

Finally, in AAAHH!!! Real Monsters, you get to take direct control of everyone's favorite monsters - Ickis, Oblina, and Krumm! Both versions are included, so you can leave the console wars in the '90s and re-experience the game on your preferred 16-bit machine!

In addition to the games themselves, several extra features are included:

-Rewind: Made a mistake? Don't worry! You can rewind to try again.
-Save Anywhere: Need a break? Bring up the menu and save your game whenever you want.
-Music Player: Just want to listen to the great music in these games? We've got you covered!

70010000095479.name: QUIZ! Cat Proverbs Around the World
70010000095479.intro:
A cat cries for a 〇〇!?
Learn Unique Cat Proverbs from Around the World in a Fun Quiz!
70010000095479.description:
This is a quiz game where you can learn rare and fascinating cat-related proverbs from different cultures while enjoying adorable cat photos.

How to Play：
・Read the question carefully.
・Choose the best answer from the four options.
・If you get it right, you’ll see an explanation of what the proverb means!

Pick up some cool, little-known proverbs from around the world—perfect for fun and easy learning!

If you’re stuck, just tap the hint button!
(It gives a huge clue, so use it wisely.)

70010000095489.name: Date with Devils
70010000095489.intro: Being the Lord of Hell is hard. One minute you're judging souls, the next you're speed-dating devils and writing love poems to angels.
70010000095489.description:
You are the Lord of Hell, tasked with judging mortals who arrive for all kinds of reasons. Sometimes, you even have the power to resurrect certain individuals—changing the course of fate itself.

A variety of devilish girls each control unique resources in the underworld. To gain their support, you'll need to build strong relationships with them. Go on dates, get married, play cards, chat... and of course, enjoy all sorts of interactive minigames together to deepen your bond.

Heaven may be your enemy, but its angels don't all seem hostile. Try dining with them, giving gifts, and having heart-to-heart conversations... Can you date an angel too?

70010000095494.name: Not Not 2 - A Brain Challenge
70010000095494.intro:
Just go Up, Down, Left or Right. Easy, is it NOT?
The ultimate brain-busting challenge is back with a fully revamped version!
70010000095494.description:
Not Not 2 - A Brain Challenge that messes with your head and makes you doubt your intelligence.

Read the instructions written on the cube and run towards the correct direction. Be careful about the time limit and don't let your brain get tricked!

Features:
- Discover new game MODES and many LEVELS to challenge your brain in various ways
- Improve your brain skills everyday with the DAILY and WEEKLY CHALLENGE and reach the TOP of the leaderboard!
- Exclusive Multiplayer Versus mode for up to 4 players! Share the brain busting in NORMAL, HARD or EXTREME difficulty levels
- Classic mode. Each level raises the difficulty up with new instructions
- Challenge mode. Reach the best score in a bottomless pit of despair!
- Unlock unique SKINS to customize your experience
- MEASURE your progress with the statistics dashboard and compare them with your friends!
- Color blind accessibility mode
- Brand new GRAPHICS

This misleading expert aims at crushing your brain's ability to think properly. Can yours handle it?

70010000095496.name: Hidden Cats in Tokyo
70010000095496.intro: Tokyo’s cats need a hero - and that hero is you!
70010000095496.description:
Konichi-meow, recruit!

Tokyo needs your help—cats across the city are transforming into monsters!

Spot cats, people, items, and other things to fill the world with colour and progress the story!

The cats of Tokyo are counting on you!

Features:
- 1700+ hidden objects to find!
- Collectible cards!
- 15 vibrant levels to colour in!
- A cartoony, expressive twist on the Hidden Cats artstyle...
- ...and an epic boss fight with robots!

70010000095501.name: College Love: Secrets From the Past
70010000095501.intro: In a seemingly normal high school, a group of students find themselves involved in a series of strange events when they discover an old diary full of messages.
70010000095501.description:
In this visual novel, a mystery will grip you.

A danger you can't ignore, emotions that burn in the darkness.

What begins as a simple investigation soon turns into a nightmare that's impossible to explain. Strange symbols appear on the walls, inhuman whispers fill the air, and the feeling of being watched from the shadows becomes unbearable. Ethan, Sophia, Mia, and Lucas are about to discover that some secrets should never be revealed.

As they search for answers, they not only face supernatural dangers, but are also drawn into a whirlwind of growing emotions and tensions.

Sophia and Ethan share a connection that grows with each moment of danger. Between silences loaded with meaning and a chemistry that's impossible to ignore, they find themselves caught in a game of glances and feelings that neither dares to confess.

Lucas and Mia are the clash of two opposing forces. Arguments, sarcasm and unexpected complicity force them to confront what they really feel, even when fear and mistrust threaten to tear them apart.

But in the darkness, something is lurking. And this time, running won't be enough.

Are you ready to delve into the mystery?

70010000095503.name: Puff Up
70010000095503.intro: Grow the biggest balloon and don't POP!
70010000095503.description:
Inflate your balloon as much as you can while dodging spiky balls. Time your moves perfectly to grow bigger without popping — and watch out, the bigger you are, the harder it gets! 

Challenge your friends in the exciting Versus mode, where 2 players go head-to-head! Race to the finish line or compete to collect the most coins before time runs and win!

Unlock new balloons with unique styles and customize your experience as you play. Power up your abilities, take on exciting mini-games, and push your skills to the limit with every challenge!

Features:
- Versus mode: Battle your friends in a 1v1 challenge
- Balloons and Skins: Customize your shape and looks
- Upgrades and Power-Ups: Boost your abilities and beat the odds
- 3 Iconic Minigames: Take on extra challenges and win rewards
- Satisfying Gameplay: Enjoy smooth, thrilling action every time you play

See how big you can grow without bursting under pressure!

70010000095505.name: Shape Drop
70010000095505.intro: Jump and drop through dangerous obstacles
70010000095505.description:
Shape Drop is a fast-paced arcade game where precision and timing are everything. 

Navigate your way through a series of rotating shapes, skillfully dropping and jumping to avoid deadly spikes. 

Your goal is simple, guide the ball past tricky obstacles and into the tube to advance. 

Take on thrilling, heart-pounding jumps and daring drops as you push your reflexes to the limit. 

Unlock a variety of unique balls as you conquer endless levels filled with ever-increasing challenges.

70010000095512.name: Azure Haven
70010000095512.description:
Step into Azure Haven, a tranquil, blue-themed walking simulator designed for discovery and relaxation. Explore two stunning, handcrafted environments—each filled with hidden locations, breathtaking sights, and quiet mysteries waiting to be uncovered. Whether at home or on the go, Azure Haven transforms your journey into a peaceful escape.

Key Features:
Two Stunning Worlds to Explore – Wander through two beautifully distinct environments, from misty coastal cliffs to glowing ethereal forests, each brought to life with a dreamy blue aesthetic.

Relaxing Discovery-Based Gameplay – No timers, no stress—just pure exploration at your own pace. Uncover hidden locations and secrets that tell the story of Azure Haven.

Immersive Sound & Atmosphere – A soothing soundtrack and dynamic ambient sounds enhance the experience, making every step feel like a journey into a peaceful, otherworldly realm.

70010000095520.name: Suika Water World
70010000095520.intro: Stack and combine animals of different sizes to create larger ones! Relax, strategize, and dive deep into the enchanting world of Suika Water World! Can you master the ocean’s mysteries?
70010000095520.description:
Dive into the colorful depths of the ocean with Suika Water World, a fun and relaxing puzzle game that promises hours of engaging gameplay! This charming underwater adventure has gained popularity for its simple yet captivating mechanics, making it a hit among players seeking a light, enjoyable pastime.

In Suika Water World, marine animals appear at the top of the screen and fall randomly into the game area. When two animals of the same type touch, they merge to create a larger, more advanced sea creature. For instance, two tiny jellyfish combine to form a starfish, two starfish merge into a playful seahorse, and the process continues until you unlock rare and exotic ocean creatures.

The challenge lies in managing the growing stack of animals without letting them overflow the game area. As the game progresses, it becomes increasingly tricky to maintain control, testing your strategic thinking and quick reflexes. Each successful merge brings you closer to discovering the ocean’s most majestic creatures and hidden secrets.

Suika Water World is easy to learn but difficult to master, making it perfect for players of all ages. With soothing background music that enhances the relaxing underwater atmosphere, the game provides a stress-free escape while keeping you hooked on the addictive puzzle mechanics.

Embark on this mesmerizing underwater journey, unlock fascinating marine animals, and explore the mysteries of the deep blue sea. Will you manage to create the ultimate ocean creature and master the watery world of Suika? Dive in and find out!

70010000095525.name: Nanostorm
70010000095525.description:
They left you for dead. Now, unleash the Nanostorm.

Stranded and alone after crash-landing on a deadly alien world, you discover that death isn't the end – it's the fuel for your rebirth.

Dive into Nanostorm, a fast-paced, horizontal incremental shoot'em'up. Obliterate endless waves of vicious pixel-art monsters and harvest the vital nano essence they bleed. Pour this essence into a vast skill tree, unlocking game-changing perks that transform you into an unstoppable force.

You start weak, but soon you will evolve into the storm. Gather enough strength to finally activate your ship's emergency warp core and escape this forsaken planet!

70010000095528.name: Sakura Succubus 8
70010000095528.intro: Join Hiroki and his loyal harem of succubi
70010000095528.description:
Ogasawara Hiroki’s average life was turned upside-down the moment he became a babe magnet for a whole harem of succubi.

Hiroki’s life is a busy one, and there’s never a dull moment: something which becomes even more apparent when Yue, the ruler of the succubus realm, barges into his house and asks for his help.

The newest member of Hiroki’s harem, Alice, is a fledgling succubus who has little knowledge of the human world. Having spent most of her life in the succubus realm, Alice is naïve and unworldly, and she has no idea how to fit in.

Help Hiroki show Alice around Tokyo, introduce her to her fellow succubi, and try not to let her get too anxious. Alice’s self-esteem has always been shaky, and if things go wrong, it might just spell disaster.

Features:
* Eight installment in Sakura Succubus series
* Two different endings
* Visual novel
* Beautiful manga art
* Gorgeous women to romance

70010000095531.name: Sakura Bunny Girls
70010000095531.intro: Who is this superhuman bunny girl?
70010000095531.description:
Yori is a man on a mission. He’s a professional security guard who’ll take on any job if the price is right, and he’s been involved in a fair share of top-secret operations with high stakes and large financial rewards.

During one particular job, however, Yori receives quite a shock. While protecting an important, highly classified briefcase whose contents are a mystery, Yori is accosted by a thief—and this thief is no ordinary criminal.

This thief is, instead, a beautiful young woman. And she’s wearing a bunny suit?!

That’s pretty crazy—but what’s even crazier is her ability to stop bullets with her bare hands, her superhuman speed, and her augmented strength.

Just who is this bunny girl, and what does she want with this briefcase?

Yori is uncertain—but one thing is for sure. His life is about to be turned upside down.


Features
* Going out on dates with the 3 unique girls
* Stunning manga art
* Riveting story with many choices to make

70010000095537.name: Stars In The Trash
70010000095537.intro: Stars in the Trash brings the magic of animated movie classics into a narrative-driven platformer that combines action, exploration and puzzles.
70010000095537.description:
Tired of feeling trapped at home, Moka, a spoiled cat, decides to run away and seek adventure. His journey takes an unexpected turn when the kennelman threatens the streets. Moka needs to learn how to survive, and appreciate what he left behind, before he's going to lose his best friend and everything he had.

FEATURES

· Explore a beautiful hand drawn watercolor world.
· Feel the magic of the animated movie classics.
· Discover the power of friendship.
· Live an emotional journey.
· Be a cat..

DO YOU WANT TO KNOW IF THIS GAME IS FOR YOU?

· Did you ever want to experience life as a cat?
· Are you into handmade animated movie classics?
· Do you like to engage in emotional stories?
· Do you like short games (around 2-3 hours of game play)?
· Are you ready for intuitive manageable challenges?

Yay, awesome! Because our game offers all of that, and much more.

70010000095542.name: Tayutama:It's happy days
70010000095542.intro: This is a story that picks up after the main events... or maybe one that could’ve happened somewhere along the way.
70010000095542.description:
The wild days I spent with the Tayutai were nothing short of life-changing... So much so that I completely forgot I'd even won a hot spring trip in the shopping district raffle.
Now that things have finally settled down, I—Yuri Mito—am about to enjoy my last summer break as a student at Sohsei Academy.

Just as I hit peak exhaustion after everything that happened, I remembered it: the hot spring voucher, almost expired and totally forgotten.

This is a story that picks up after the main events... or maybe one that could’ve happened somewhere along the way.
The Tayutama Fan Disc brings you the lovey-dovey days of a couple in love!


Main Characters
● Mashiro Mito, VA: Risa Matsuda
Upon meeting, she immediately declares Yuri her husband and even shows up on the first day back to school. Her pursuit of Yuri is what many would call ""intense"", and she ends up living in the Mito household. But as a Tayutai, she's not exactly human...
Mashiro is tolerant and level-headed, but that just makes rousing her anger all the more terrifying. She may seem naive, but that's just because her understanding of the world is a few years out of date.

● Ameri Kawai, VA: Kaori Hanano
The childhood friend and classmate of the protagonist, Yuri. She's a student in the Slightly department of Sohsei Academy, where her father is also the director. Lately, her favorite pastime is teasing Yuri and Sankuro. 
She can be persistent and persuasive in drawing others into her way of handling things, but when it comes to love, she's a bit on the timid side...

● Mifuyu Kisaragi, VA: Rina Misaki
She is the Lady, the Prefect, of the Flawless Girls' Boarding Department of Sohsei Academy. As the heir to the aristocratic Kisaragi Conglomerate, Mifuyu has been raised to be both strong of character and someone others will naturally rally behind. She's well trained in many things, including swordsmanship and martial arts. But that doesn't mean she isn't without her flaws.
She's rather fond of romance novels, the kind where things are depicted a little too pure for reality. Which will certainly make things tough for a red-blooded man...

● Yumina Takanashi, VA: Yu Aoto
Yumina looks up to Yuri as an older brother. When her birth parents went bankrupt, they gave her to the Mito family to raise. Unfortunately, Mari Mito, the family matron, passes away long before the start of our story, and Yumina is ultimately adopted to the Takanashi family out of concern of a lack of mother figure.
She's one of those people who immediately fails at a task whenever someone is watching out of nervousness. But she doesn't mind working hard, and she's actually rather good at handling the household chores. She tends to get lost in her own imagination. 

● Nue, VA: Mika
One of the Three Mightiest Tayutai, dangerous beings sealed away in ancient ruins by Kikuramikami no Hime.
She transformed into a human-like form over 500 years ago, but due to some unknown incident, lost her memory and has remained that way ever since.
After Mifuyu offered to become her guardian, she quickly grew attached and now brings a cheerful, innocent energy that puts everyone at ease.

● Ouryu, VA: Taiyo Sorano
One of the Three Mightiest Tayutai, dangerous beings sealed away in ancient ruins by Kikuramikami no Hime.
Once thought to see humans as nothing more than prey, it turns out the truth is quite the opposite—he simply envisioned a different kind of coexistence from Mashiro.
Though he usually hides in the pond in the Kawai family’s garden, he often takes human form to walk among people.

70010000095547.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition
70010000095547.intro: Legends are made here. What will yours be?
70010000095547.description:
Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in Night City, a megalopolis obsessed with power, glamour, and body modification. Play as V, a cyberpunk mercenary, and take on the most powerful forces of the city in a fight for glory and survival. In the Ultimate Edition, experience the original Cyberpunk 2077 story as well as the acclaimed spy-thriller adventure in the Phantom Liberty expansion — a high-stakes tale of espionage set in the deadly district of Dogtown.

EXPLORE THE CITY OF THE FUTURE
Night City is one of the most immersive worlds in gaming, packed to the brim with things to do, places to see, and people to meet.

EXPERIENCE ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES
With so many skills, cybernetic enhancements, and weapons to choose from, you can build your legend any way you choose.

DECIDE HOW THE STORY ENDS
Your choices in the base game and the spy-thriller adventure Phantom Liberty create interweaving webs of consequences, ones that shape the fate of the characters around you — and your own.

DISCOVER NEW AND EXCITING WAYS TO PLAY
Hack and slash your foes with Joy-Con™ 2 motion controls, take down enemies thanks to intuitive gyroscope aiming, touch, tap, and swipe your way through menus, or use your Joy-Con™ 2 (R) as a mouse and experience pin-point accuracy in and out of combat.

CLAIM EXCLUSIVE ITEMS
Claim in-game swag & digital goodies inspired by CD PROJEKT RED games as part of the My Rewards program.

70010000095565.name: Charming Hearts
70010000095565.intro: Charming Hearts is a real-life interactive dating game. Players will meet, get to know, and fall in love with different types of beauty.
70010000095565.description:
Will it be love at first sight or the gradual development of affection over time? Will you feel tender affection for the adorable "her" or lean in close to the dominant "her"? Whether immersed in the gentle and intelligent whispers during handholding afternoons or lost in adventurous midnight escapades with a blushing and throbbing heart, players will meet, understand, and fall in love with women of different personalities, experiencing countless possibilities and facets of love.
Each choice leads to a different chemical reaction with "her," and every dilemma entwines the honey-like love in a captivating dance. The palpitations and excitement with them, like an endless waltz, carry an extremely soft tenderness, yet why does it come with a hint of bitterness?

—— Can an ordinary person like me also experience the blossoming of love someday?
—— Which flower of that flourishing tree will you pick?
Is it the outwardly restrained and solemn, yet internally fiery and sexy widow?
Is it the top idol star who attracts the love of many but favors only you?
Is it the seemingly domineering and proud, yet actually gentle and considerate earthly beauty?
Is it the pure and considerate, occasionally quirky, double-faced sweet girl?
Is it the intellectually charming goddess with a shared understanding and spiritual connection?
Or is it the campus moonlight, gentle like spring breeze, melancholic like spring rain?

Various beautiful women take turns to make their appearances, and you, in front of the screen, come and join this exhilarating love affair!
Product Features
■ Breathable Love Experience
"The Heartbeat of Them" adopts a first-person real-life filming approach to create a realistic and immersive romantic atmosphere, allowing players to fully experience a love story with a sense of breath.
■ Solid and Entertaining Plot, Diverse and Unconventional Storylines
Professional writers ensure smooth and cohesive storylines, avoiding fragmentation. The plot is rich in substance, with complex branching and multiple endings, providing players with a variety of choices and hidden storylines to unlock.
■ Real-life Filming, Upgraded Scenes
Professionally acted by actors, every expression and smile directly touches the player's heart. The richness of scenes is significantly enhanced compared to similar products, carefully selected and avoiding clichés, aiming to immerse players in a refined and romantic atmosphere.
■ Varied Gameplay, Higher Freedom, Extended Playtime
In addition to regular gameplay, this game introduces more interactive elements, providing innovative gaming experiences and complex plots. The combination of rich exploration and detailed character development enhances the player's immersive experience.
■ Diverse Personalities Without Labeling
Regardless of the personalities of the six girls, there is space for exploration and reversal. Each step of deepening understanding leads to unexpected developments, enriching character layers and providing a genuine sense of love.

70010000095576.name: CRYKEN part2
70010000095576.intro:
Get the crystals!!
Play in split-screen multiplayer for 1-4 players!
30 stages in total. Normal and hard difficulty options avail
70010000095576.description:
The objective is to use jumps and dashes to get the crystals on the stage.
The stage is a 3D space with vertical, horizontal and depth. Gravity exists, and players control the player by moving forward, backward, left and right, and by jumping vertically to move the player, aiming for the crystal.

Features
・Clear the stage when you get the crystal!
・30 stages in total! There are stages 31 to 60.
・You can choose the difficulty level, and normal is relatively easy to clear. Hard mode is more difficult.
・Some stages have crystals that appear by collecting coins or cutting grass.
・You can get equipment! Get a new weapon, the scythe!
・You can play split-screen with up to 4 people!
・Monsters appear!
・You can use items to use abilities!

Multiplayer
・You can cooperate or compete with everyone.
・Collect coins together,
・Cut grass together
・Clear the stage together.
・Defeat the enemy together!
・Be the first to get the crystal!

70010000095586.name: Hotel Business Simulator
70010000095586.intro: Master the art of hospitality and rise to the top.
70010000095586.description:
Welcome, Hospitality Maestros! Dive into “Hotel Business Simulator where you craft the ultimate empire. Upgrade rooms, cater to guests’ whims, set rates wisely, and maintain spotless standards. Your journey to mogul status begins now. 
Ready to build the hotel of your dreams? Game on!

Jump into the exciting world of “Hotel Business Simulator,” where you’re the brains behind the ultimate hotel empire. Transform a humble spot into the talk of the town, turning a basic bed and breakfast into a luxurious resort. Your choices, your empire!

What’s Inside Your Hotel Empire:
- Stars in Your Eyes: Your hotel’s success is all about its stars. Upgrade and embellish to go from a modest establishment to a high-end luxury resort.
- Rooms with Personality: Every room is a blank canvas. Will it be minimalist chic or opulent splendor? The more upscale the room, the more upscale the clientele.
- Guests’ Delight: Keep those guests grinning from check-in to check-out. Cater to their needs, from the basic to the extravagant, and watch your popularity rise.
- Cash Flow Management: Set your room rates wisely. Balance splendor with cost-effectiveness to maximize those profits.
- Spotless Reputation: Cleanliness is next to godliness in the hotel biz. A clean room is essential for guest satisfaction.
- Understanding Your Guests: Each guest comes with their own set of expectations. Match them with the perfect room to ensure their stay is memorable.
- Day’s End: When the sun sets, it’s time for a well-deserved rest. Prepare for the next day of bustling hotel management!

“Hotel Business Simulator” is more than a game; it’s your journey to becoming a hospitality mogul. Are you ready to create, decorate, and run the hotel of your dreams? Let the business begin!

70010000095591.name: Samu
70010000095591.intro: A lone samurai facing battles of life and death.
70010000095591.description:
Engage in intense, strategic duels against powerful bosses — each encounter demands skill, timing, and careful planning to overcome your enemies.
Sharpen your reflexes, master counterattacks against each boss’s unique abilities, and conquer brutal challenges where precision determines the thin line between defeat and victory.

Key Features:

High-quality pixel art style: detailed retro visuals with striking atmosphere.

Immersive setting: transporting players to the age of the samurai in feudal Japan.

Precise and responsive gameplay: smooth controls ensure fair and fast-paced combat.

Skill-based progression: refine your technique and rise to become a true master.

70010000095596.name: Happy Hike
70010000095596.intro: Take a Relaxing Walk Through Beautiful Trails
70010000095596.description:
Embark on a peaceful journey in Happy Hike, a walking simulator where the joy is in the journey. Lace up your boots and explore stunning landscapes at your own pace, discovering hidden spots, cozy cabins, and breathtaking vistas along the way.

Key Features
No timers, no pressure—just relax and explore
Beautiful, handcrafted environments filled with secrets
Relaxing music and immersive nature sounds

Take your time, discover every corner, and let the world of Happy Hike unfold before you.

70010000095599.name: Bosorka
70010000095599.intro: Bosorka is an exciting action roguelike where a young witch saves the world from insidious and cruel demons.
70010000095599.description:
The young witch Horpyna, with the help of the ancient Grimoire, has summoned a familiar, but owing to the lack of experience, she isn't able to cope with the magic book and the spell has remained incomplete. After the unsuccessful use, the irrepressible book returns to its author from the other world, uncontrollably summoning horrifying monsters. The only salvation is to stop the book and prevent evil forces from taking over the world.
Bosorka is an exciting action game that combines the best elements of the roguelike and shoot'em up genres with incredibly stylized top-down 3D visualization. Immerse yourself in this dark fantasy world and show the demons who's the power to be reckoned with.

Exciting journeys to various locations!
Several huge levels are generated from manually created parts. Each level is an independent biome with its own unique atmosphere, mysteries and dangerous creatures. Secret rooms, hidden passages, breathtaking landscapes, and lots of valuable things that can be encountered in unexpected places provide a real incentive to explore the environment.

Bosses from the netherworld!
At the end of each level, you will meet powerful monsters that guard the passages to the next locations, preventing you from following the book. Each monster has an exceptional set of uncanny abilities and is capable of incinerating you in an instant, so one should be well prepared for this encounter.

Companion Demons!
In the midst of a circle of evil demons, there may be renegades who have not been affected by evil spells and have no bad intentions. Lovely creatures, surprisingly loyal to those who save them. Raise an entire army of companions who will help you in the fight against the enemy. Some of them have marvelous abilities that will definitely come in handy.

Caution! Dangerous Spells!
Destroy enemy hordes of evil creatures by means of powerful spells. Burn, freeze, strike with incredible lightning bolts, or pelt everyone with slimy frogs — there're various spells to suit every taste. Mysterious mirrors hidden in different corners of these regions will reveal to you new spells to defend this world from. Find them and develop the tactics to wipe out the evil.

Amazing combinations of collected items!
Strong health, protective shell, poisonous touch or a deadly whirlwind around you, and perhaps even more. Make your own unique collection of runes. Each rune performs only one function, but the combination of several of them can significantly change the entire gameplay, turning you into a real natural calamity. And now, who is hunting who?

Exciting flight on a broomstick!
An enchanted witch's broom is not only a means of transportation. Each broom has its own specialty and is capable of a great deal more than just flying. Unblock all the brooms, master their special skills, and you will surely find your favorite to lead you to victory.

70010000095614.name: Bunny Cubed
70010000095614.intro: Hop your way through dozens of springtime puzzle stages in isometric 3D style!
70010000095614.description:
Classic block-pushing puzzles enter the third dimension with Bunny Cubed, a bright and colorful brainteasing adventure! Guide a hopping white rabbit through fields of grass and growing carrots where crates are scattered along dirt paths. Think strategically and have the bunny push those crates onto their designated squares. But be careful not to box yourself in or block the path!

Once each mazelike puzzle stage is cleared, you can move on to the next challenge, with complexity and level size gradually increasing over 60 levels, all set to a cheerful and energetic soundtrack. Can you master them all?

• Play as a cute blocky bunny in isometric 3D puzzle stages!
• Master 60 unique challenges of increasing complexity.
• Push blocks onto their designated spaces.
• Enjoy relaxing springtime visuals and a cheerful soundtrack.
• Replay levels any time to improve your skills and speed!

70010000095619.name: Exo-Calibre
70010000095619.intro: Take to the skies as a team of cute pilots and fight for peace in vertical scrolling bullet hell style!
70010000095619.description:
Meet the Ex-Calibre Knights, elite pilots in state-of-the-art exo-mechs, defending peace, justice and hope across the world! The Exo-Tech corporation is dedicated to developing advanced weapons and defenses to aid humanity, but when AI drones go haywire and start attacking the populous, it’s up to you to take control of the Ex-Calibre Knights and restore order by any means necessary!

Take flight as one of 3 pilots, each with unique shot types and melee weapons, and engage in vertical scrolling shoot’em up combat against swarms of automaton enemies. Take down screen-filling bosses and chase high scores, earning bonuses for maintaining high health and not losing lives along the way. Challenge player rankings in leaderboards for each of 4 unique play modes!

• Choose from a team of 3 unique pilots and unlock more characters as you progress!
• Blast through vertical scrolling bullet hell stages.
• Use various shot types and melee weapons to take down enemy swarms and big bosses!
• Enjoy 2D pixel art aesthetics and colorfully cute designs!
• Watch the lighthearted narrative unfold through cutscenes and comms dialogue.
• Climb the leaderboards for Story, Arcade, Boss Rush and Time Rush modes!

70010000095624.name: Undusted: Letters from the Past
70010000095624.intro: A casual game in which you clean and restore dirty items. Enjoy the satisfying audiovisuals featuring sensually designed sounds and graphics.
70010000095624.description:
In Undusted: Letters from the Past, you are tasked with cleaning long-neglected dirty objects. As you clean each belonging, you will learn the backstories behind the various objects placed in each chapter.

Adora returns home after her mother's passing. She starts to clean long ignored items within the house. As each object is restored to its pristine condition, the items start whispering memories of the past to her. As she cleans more items, she discovers forgotten and even hidden stories. What kinds of stories will she experience?

Virtual ASMR

Experience the carefully crafted audio that captures the characteristic of each tool you use. The different ambient sounds of each chapter will make you feel as if you are actually in the game.

 A Touching Story

Recall the memories within each object. Where did Adora and her mother's relationship start to fall apart? Will she be able to understand her mother after her passing?

A Charming Art Style

Appreciate the captivating art style that is uniquely expressed with pixelated textures.

Game Features
- Experience a heartfelt and emotional story about family.
- Forget about time limits and failure. Just relax and enjoy! The items won't break like they do in real life!
- Admire the beautiful artwork that elegantly expresses Adora's story.
- Listen to the sensual original background music, which complements the relaxing gameplay.
- Enjoy the oddly satisfying sensation you get in ASMR and Restoration videos in a game!

70010000095630.name: Arcade Archives Super Dimension Fortress MACROSS II
70010000095630.intro: This is a time attack shoot 'em up!
70010000095630.description:
The arcade game “Super Dimension Fortress MACROSS II” is a shooter released by BANPRESTO (Bandai Namco Entertainment inc.) in 1993.
The game follows the story of the original video animation “The Super Dimension Fortress Macross II -LOVERS AGAIN-”.
Set around 80 years after “The Super Dimension Fortress Macross,”
Earth is faced by a new threat that players must defeat - the Marduk.
Clear each stage by achieving the designated "CLEAR SCORE" within the time limit.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000095635.name: JALECOlle Famicom Ver. The Last Ninja
70010000095635.intro:
The project 'JALECOlle Famicom Ver.' is a series of consecutive releases of JALECO Famicom titles!
This time, a +α Special Ninja Mission: The Last Ninja!
70010000095635.description:
★A 9th-century ninja rampages through Manhattan!
Fueled by revenge and legacy, he crosses time and space to take on a trial-and-error style ninja action adventure!

【Game Story】
Late 20th Century — New York, Manhattan.
Once robbed of his comrades by the hand of General Kunitoki in the 9th century,
the lone ninja Armakuni finds himself hurled across time into this towering city.

From foreign city streets to underground sewers and high-security office buildings...
In a metropolis filled with traps and shadowy conspiracies, Armakuni walks alone,
driven by the pride of his discipline.

This is a trial-and-error style action adventure where you must discover hidden items and switches,
track down scattered keys, and proceed using precise control and intuition across each stage.

Spot the tricks, avoid the traps, and use your items wisely to carve out your path.
When all ninja missions are complete—
the name of the last ninja shall be etched into history.

- The Last Ninja ＜New Features＞ -
★ Weapon Shortcut
You can switch your equipped weapon with the L button.
★ Item Shortcut
You can switch your equipped item with the R button.
★ Weapon & Item List
Displays a list showing what you currently possess and what each item does.
★ Ninja’s Wisdom
While wandering within a stage for a certain amount of time, a notification will appear.
At that point, you can open “Ninja’s Wisdom” from the TIPS section in the menu
to view advice tailored to each tip that may help with your current mission.
This game features a fairly high level of difficulty.
If you find yourself stuck or unsure what to do next, it might be worth taking a look.

JALECOlle Common <New Features>
★Beginner-friendly rescue features
Now includes "Rewind" to quickly undo mistakes and "Quick Save & Load" to save and resume the game at any time.
★Record your best time
Now includes a "Simple Timer" to record the time from the beginning of the adventure to the defeat of the final boss. 
You can aim for your best time while using Quick Save. Take on the challenge seriously without any rescue features. 
Record your best time!
★Packed with many more enjoyable features and options!
- Now includes new achievements to challenge various in-game objectives.
- Explore the gallery page to view package designs, manuals, flyers and more from the original releases.
- Screen edge options to reduce screen distortion.
- Screen Filter option.
- Wallpaper options.
- Upon completing the main game, you'll unlock a special bonus feature as a reward.

70010000095640.name: JALECOlle Famicom Ver. Saiyuuki World II - The Demon God of Heaven -  & WHOMP'EM
70010000095640.intro:
JALECOlle Famicom Ver. brings back classic Jaleco titles!
Vol. 7: Saiyuuki World II - The Demon God of Heaven - & WHOMP'EM
70010000095640.description:
Seek the seven Totems and harness their power!
Strike down the creatures that stand in your way
with your spear and Totem skills!
A stage-select action adventure awaits!

【Game Story】
A young warrior from a native tribe embarks on a journey to retrieve seven lost Totems in this side-scrolling action adventure.

Players control Soaring Eagle as he explores eight distinct stages. After clearing the first stage, the remaining six can be tackled in any order via a stage-select system. Each stage is guarded by a powerful boss and defeating them grants new Totem abilities.

These Totems provide more than just offensive power—they enable new ways to move and interact with the world. Choosing which stage to conquer first can dramatically change your strategy and difficulty.

With tight platforming, intense combat and clever traps, WHOMP'EM challenges players to master both their spear and the special abilities earned along the way.

★Includes the original version: Saiyuuki World II – The Demon God of Heaven in a 2-in-1 package!
– Saiyuuki World II & WHOMP'EM <New Features> –
★Attack info
View all acquired actions and their effects anytime.
★Remaining Gourds
See how many more you need to get +1 Life.

JALECOlle Common <New Features>
★Beginner-friendly rescue features
Now includes "Rewind" to quickly undo mistakes and "Quick Save & Load" to save and resume the game at any time.
★Convenient Subtitle Guide
Assisting with the English localization of Saiyuuki WorldⅡ.
★Record your best time
Now includes a "Simple Timer" to record the time from the beginning of the adventure to the defeat of the final boss. 
You can aim for your best time while using Quick Save. Take on the challenge seriously without any rescue features. 
Record your best time!
★Packed with many more enjoyable features and options!
- Now includes new achievements to challenge various in-game objectives.
- Explore the gallery page to view package designs, manuals, flyers and more from the original releases.
- Screen edge options to reduce screen distortion.
- Screen Filter option.
- Wallpaper options.
- Upon completing the main game, you'll unlock a special bonus feature as a reward.

70010000095645.name: JALECOlle Famicom Ver. ROD LAND
70010000095645.intro:
JALECOlle Famicom revives JALECO classics!
Vol. 8: ROD LAND Includes the original Japanese version in this 2-in-1 release!
70010000095645.description:
Rescue Mama from Maboots Tower!
Grab enemies with Magic Rods and create ladders with special shoes.
A stage-clearing action game for 1 or 2 players.

◆Game Story

Tam and Rit, two fairy siblings, lived peacefully with their Mama in Fairy Village.

But one day, a huge ghost kidnapped their mother and took her away to Maboots Tower.

To save Mama, the two set off for the tower with their magical rods and special shoes.

Their main attack is to use the rods’ magic to grab enemies and slam them into the ground.

The special shoes also let them create and climb ladders.

Cross otherwise unreachable platforms, collect items placed high above, and discover new ways through each stage!

Defeated enemies can leave behind attack items, allowing you to take them down in all kinds of ways.

Collect every flower in a stage, and the remaining enemies will transform into special EXTRA GAME enemies.

Defeat them to make EXTRA items appear!

Collect EXTRA items to earn 1UPs and high-score bonuses.

Play solo or team up in 2-player co-op!

Guide Tam and Rit to the top of Maboots Tower and rescue Mama!


◆Customize Your Game with Options!

The options menu, available from the title screen,
includes settings for 2-player play with Tam and Rit.

Choose Friendly play, share points between both players,
or compete in Rival mode, where you can interfere with your opponent.

The Jump setting can also dramatically change the way you play.
Choose from No Jump, Normal Jump, or jumps that hit overhead platforms.
(Normal Jump is selected by default.)

Customize player colors, hints, music, and sound effects.
You can also choose the title screen BGM, adjust demo speed,
register player names, and more!

Set up ROD LAND your way!


◆JALECOlle Famicom Series: New Features

★Beginner-Friendly Assist Features
Use intuitive Rewind controls to instantly retry after a mistake,
or save and resume your game from anywhere
with Quick Save & Load.

★Helpful Subtitle Guide
Supports the Japanese localization.

★Record Your Best Time
Track your time from the start of your adventure
to defeating the final boss with the Simple Timer.

Use Quick Save to chase your best time,
or take on the game without any assist features at all.
Set your personal best!

★Plus, plenty of extras and options!
・Achievements to challenge a variety of goals
・An Extra Page featuring original package art, manuals, flyers, and more
・A Screen Edge option to reduce distortion at the edges of the screen
・Screen Filter options
・Wallpaper options
・Clear bonuses featuring a little extra content after completing the main game

70010000095650.name: Candy Country: Sweet Wonder
70010000095650.intro: Mattie, a curious little girl with a great love for sweets, wakes up one day in a world made entirely of candies, chocolates and cookies.
70010000095650.description:
A DELICIOUSLY DANGEROUS VISUAL NOVEL

When Mattie stumbles into the mysterious Candy Kingdom, at first everything seems like a dream come true: mountains of cotton candy, rivers of chocolate and candies everywhere. But there's a problem... if she stays too long, she'll become just another candy!

With the help of Chicly, a talking bubble gum with a lot of personality, and an enchanted sugar map, Mattie must navigate this fantasy world, solving puzzles and avoiding deliciously tricky challenges. Can she resist the temptations and find the way out before it's too late?

Get ready for a story full of fun, magic and sweet surprises!

Key Features:

Unforgettable characters
·Mattie, a brave and curious protagonist.
·Chicly, a talking bubble gum who always has something to say.
·Sweet inhabitants, some friendly… and some not so much.

A magical, sugary world
·Licorice roads, cookie mountains and milkshake lakes.
·Sugar traps and sweet puzzles that will put Mattie to the test.

Vibrant colors and immersive music
·Scenarios full of details and bright colors.
·Catchy melodies that immerse children in the adventure.

A story with values and emotion
·Ingenuity, bravery and the importance of not being carried away by first impressions.
·A lesson in balance and decision-making.

A story for those who love adventure and sweets (but don't want to become one)!

70010000095652.name: Hit Back
70010000095652.intro: Fast-paced sword rally battles. Strike, deflect, and dominate!
70010000095652.description:
Hit Back is an intense sword-fighting showdown where precision and timing are the keys to victory. Grab your sword, step into the arena, and prepare for battle! Strike the ball with perfect timing to send it hurtling toward your opponent—but stay sharp, because it’s coming right back! As the rally speeds up, land perfect hits to unleash even more power and overwhelm your enemy.

Compete in thrilling tournaments, starting from the quarterfinals and fighting your way to the ultimate championship. Earn wins and collect coins to rank up and unlock a collection of 50 unique swords. Do you have what it takes to become the Hit Back King?

70010000095654.name: Fast & Furious: Arcade Edition
70010000095654.intro: Drive Fast. Drift Hard. This is Fast & Furious: Arcade Edition
70010000095654.description:
Fast & Furious: Arcade Edition delivers high-speed racing and adrenaline-fueled action straight from the arcade to console!

Choose from licensed supercars and tear through intense, cinematic tracks packed with shortcuts, stunts, missions, and explosive surprises. Race solo or go head-to-head in thrilling 2-player split-screen. With drifting, nitro boosts, and precision driving, this is the ultimate pick-up-and-play racing experience for fans of pure, unfiltered speed!

Key Game Features:

• High-Speed, Adrenaline-Fueled Arcade Racing
Race across high-intensity tracks in licensed supercars with cinematic style, drifting, nitro boosts, and precision driving that captures the thrill of the original arcade classic.

• The Top Tier Arcade Racer, Brought to Console
Experience the full-throttle thrills of the arcade game at home, now optimized for consoles and with the same explosive action that made the original a fan favorite in arcades.

• Race Iconic Vehicles
Hit the road in 8 legendary cars including the Dodge Charger, Corvette Z06, Shelby GT500 KR, Ford GT, Bronco DR, Jeep Wrangler, and more.

• Customize Your Look, Your Way
Style your ride with custom vehicle color schemes that let you stand out on the track and represent your personality. 

• Race Together in Local Multiplayer
Grab a friend and hit the track with 2 players in split-screen local multiplayer, bringing the arcade rivalry home with side-by-side action and nonstop competition.

• Dominate Fierce High-Intensity Courses
Burn rubber through all the original tracks in bold, diverse environments that push your driving skills to the limit.

• Tackle Secret Missions Around the World
Complete bonus challenges with explosive objectives like stopping a missile in the Swiss Alps or grounding a plane in Hong Kong.

• Unleash Chaos with Hidden Shortcuts
Discover destructible environments, branching paths, and sneaky shortcuts that shake up every race and reward risk-taking drivers.

70010000095656.name: Flora & Fang: Guardians of the vampire garden
70010000095656.intro: Spray them! Trap them! Collect coins and upgrade your gear! Protect the pumpkin patch from a relentless insect invasion and giant bosses.
70010000095656.description:
Flora & Fang: Guardians of the vampire garden is a single-player or local co-op adventure that puts you in the shoes of one of two lovable vampire siblings, Flora or Fang, as they embark on a mission to safeguard their dad—the infamous Dracula's—precious pumpkin garden.

- Fight the insect invasion!
Jump, run, spray insects with bug spray, strategically place traps, and coordinate with your co-op partner to repel waves of bothersome bugs in a variety of single screen stages. The vampire gardens future depends on you!

- Play alone or with a friend!

- Place traps and upgrade your gear
Delve into the world of traps and strategy, where earning coins allows you to purchase clever, upgradeable traps that transform the game into a more defensive experience with light tower defense strategies.

- Giant insect bosses
Confront larger-than-life insect bosses in thrilling boss battles that test your skills.

70010000095661.name: Ritual of Raven
70010000095661.intro: Grab your Book of Shadows and cast some spells in Ritual of Raven!
70010000095661.description:
Ritual of Raven is a cozy, story-based farming sim - but you don’t do the farming yourself! Instead you collect and enchant Arcana Constructs to grow your magical herb garden.

In a world where different traditions of magic live side by side, ambitious plans were made to open portals between worlds, but the ritual went terribly wrong. Those involved each lost something most precious to them and the portals became unstable, randomly spitting out new arrivals into the world.

After falling through one of these mysterious portals yourself, you encounter the local witch Sage, who decides you’re the best person to help her in her quest. Taken under her wing as an apprentice, you’ll be able to help search for her missing Familiar, Flufferstoop.

With your cheeky Familiar Raven by your side, you’ll gather the knowledge and ingredients to perform powerful rituals. Fill your Book of Shadows and find the Portal Keepers to bring stability to the portals that have been causing trouble for the village.

Enchanting Arcana Constructs

Did you know, harvesting lavender with your hands completely destroys its magical properties? Fear not, that’s why Arcana Constructs are there to do all your magical gardening for you! Using a mystical deck of cards, you’ll be able to enchant them to plow, sow seeds, water and harvest them for you. Collect all 22 Constructs and create a thriving herb garden.

Meet your new neighbors

Make friends with the quirky community of outcasts and help them grow closer to each other. Get to know their unique backstories and trade with them for valuable ingredients.

Moon... Magic!

Learn how your harvest changes in each moon phase and use the moons power to charge your crystals. Discover how to command the moon phases to suit your needs at the moon shrine. There’s a lot more to the moon than meets the eye.

Decorate your world

After finding yourself in a brand-new land, it's important to make it feel as homely as possible. Take a trip to Pistachio’s and get creative with their stock of out-of-this-world furniture to decorate the village and your farm.

Complete your collections

Let your Construct extract and fuse lots of different crystals, fill the library and throw your fishing claw into the portals to pull out artifacts from different worlds!

70010000095663.name: Cats Visiting Cozy Art Studios
70010000095663.intro: Explore cozy art studios and find hidden cats in this charming seek-and-find adventure. Search detailed creative spaces, click to collect every feline, and complete each level!
70010000095663.description:
Step into the warmth of Cats Visiting Cozy Art Studios, a relaxing hidden object game where creativity and curiosity collide. Explore intricately designed art studios, filled with paints, canvases, and sculptures, as you search for cleverly hidden cats. With every click, uncover playful felines tucked away in charming artistic spaces.

Featuring multiple levels with beautifully detailed illustrations, Cats Visiting Cozy Art Studios offers a soothing and engaging experience for players of all ages. Test your observation skills, enjoy the tranquil ambiance, and see if you can find every cat hiding among the masterpieces. Will you discover them all?

70010000095668.name: Finding America: The Great Lakes Collector's Edition
70010000095668.intro: Explore the beautiful areas surrounding the Great Lakes of America!
70010000095668.description:
Welcome to the Great Lakes of the USA!
Explore stunning destinations such as St. Cloud, Niagara Falls, Chicago, Cleveland, Milkwaukee, and many more!
Along your journey, you'll encounter fascinating trivia about the iconic locations, play fun mini-games, and see the beauty of the locations surrounding the Great Lakes.

- Behold the sights of the Great Lakes, all done in a Hidden Object style.
- Play over 30 fun minigames, all connected to the Great Lakes area!
- Pick up fun facts about the region!
- Collector's Edition contains 12 more chapters and 6 exclusive Hidden Object scenes!

70010000095672.name: Hentai Puzzle: Muscular Guys
70010000095672.intro: Dive into the game, enjoy the process and discover new stunning illustrations!
70010000095672.description:
Welcome to the world of classic puzzles, where impressive images of pumped-up guys, made in anime style, are waiting for you! Feel the real process of assembling a puzzle, enjoying detailed illustrations that will give you aesthetic pleasure and immersion in the atmosphere of the game.

Each image is created with special attention to detail, and the realistic assembly mechanics make you feel like you are putting together a real paper puzzle. Relax, immerse yourself in the process and enjoy the magnificent art in high resolution.

Game features:

- More than 40 unique puzzles with muscular anime characters.
- Realistic feeling of assembling a real paper puzzle.
- High-quality images with detailed drawing.
- Relaxing music that creates a cozy atmosphere.
- Possibility to examine each image in detail after assembly.

70010000095676.name: Strange Hunting Grounds
70010000095676.intro: Nintendo Switch™ Exclusive! A survivors game that defies common sense is here! Begin an epic adventure with a group of friends in a mad world!
70010000095676.description:
A pioneer of the "Frenzied Attacks × Deep Growth" genre! Experience thrilling, unpredictable battles in roguelike dungeons that draw you into an exciting world. When the protagonist and her friends enter the "Strange Hunting Grounds," they transform into cute SD characters and battle hordes of rampaging monsters in a maddened world. Against a backdrop of swirling purple mist and multiple moons, you can enjoy the satisfaction of evolving, synthesizing runes, and upgrading equipment to defeat hordes of monsters.

・Massive content! Play for hours on end until you reach the ending. Explore meticulously designed stages and adventure through the otherworld as much as you like.
・Rescue companions to unlock the option to switch between their real-world appearance and their "Strange Hunting Grounds" form on the character select screen.
・Strategic growth system! A variety of character development systems are included, ranging from basic upgrades to transcendental evolution.
・Unlimited freedom in character development! Create your own tactics with rune synthesis, and challenge yourself to become the strongest by upgrading your equipment.
・Monster and material collection! Collect monsters and gather materials to enhance your equipment and skills.
・A convenient feature shows the coordinates of rare items, such as meat, the Magnet of Wisdom, the Giant's Bean, the Goblin Mirror, and more.
・Equip skills to gear, such as armor, shoes, and gloves.
・Two modes keep things fresh! Discover hidden mysteries and rare items in "Exploration Mode," or take on gigantic enemies in "Battle Mode."
・Have extra fun with missions to find the characters’ real bodies!
・Enjoy immersive sessions of over 30 minutes or quick, lively gameplay in short bursts.
・Engaging story scenes with character dialogue! Lose yourself in the tale of Cynthia and her companions' growth in a world where reality and madness collide.

"In the Strange Hunting Grounds, common sense is shattered! Is it chaos from the very beginning!?”
Experience thrills and excitement beyond your imagination with your unique companions. Your Nintendo Switch™ is your gateway to a "strange and madcap adventure"!

Synopsis
Welcome to a world beyond your imagination! My name is Cynthia. One day, my life as an ordinary high school student changed completely. On my way home from school one day, I found an odd, old sign. The moment I touched the sign that read "Strange Hunting Grounds," I was pulled into a strange otherworld.

It's a realm of madness where common sense doesn't apply. There are several moons in the sky, and thick fog covers the ground. Countless monsters writhe about. Surprisingly, I woke up and found that I had become the main character of this world. I held a weapon imbued with a mysterious power, and I felt the thrill of victory surge through my body with each monster I defeated.

Now, you will face powerful monsters one after another alongside unique friends you met in another world. Why don't you join us? Once you experience this thrill, you'll never want to go back! Let's embark on a journey together through this extraordinary realm where imagination becomes reality: the Strange Hunting Ground!

70010000095682.name: Hidden Capybaras with Orange: Collection
70010000095682.intro: A playful hidden object game with capybaras, oranges, cats and magical day and night levels.
70010000095682.description:
Hidden Capybaras with Orange: Collection is a hidden object game featuring capybaras as the stars. It includes both day and night levels. In the night levels, each capybara you find lights up the area around it, creating a magical nighttime landscape.

Explore the extraordinary capybara cities, visit The Whimsical Library with its vast collection of books and stunning stained glass windows, and join in the spooky Halloween fun. An adventure awaits you!

Game features: 
- 860 capybaras, 25 cats and 20 owls. Can you find them all?
- 9 unique levels, including four daytime and five night scenarios
- 47 achievements!
- Relaxing music, perfect for searching for capybaras with oranges!
- Hint system

Get ready for an exciting journey and nighttime escapades in a city full of capybaras!

70010000095695.name: DOKAPON! Sword of Fury
70010000095695.intro: Engage in playful fighting with soon-to-be ex-friends! The ultimate relationship-ruining board game x RPG returns, where the best way to succeed is to play dirty!
70010000095695.description:
Spin the wheel and set off on an exciting adventure with your friends!

Defeat monsters, purchase weapons, and level up, just like in an RPG. Once you've gathered enough strength, face off against powerful bosses in epic fashion! Your journey will take you across a wide, diverse world... Just don't forget that your true goal is to get filthy rich!

Money is everything! Anything goes, as long as it lines your pockets...and as long as you're cool with it! Will you walk the path of thievery and plunder, or will you hold firm to your morals? Will you join hands with your friends, or plot to betray them? It's dealer's choice around these parts!

Play even with faraway friends in Online Mode, and feel free to pause your adventure anytime with the Autosave function; it'll be ready and waiting for you whenever you're available again!

There's also a full range of display settings on offer, including HD and widescreen support, allowing full immersion like never before! Game too slow for you? No problem! Speed options up to 5x ensure you can always keep things moving along at your own pace. A virtually endless array of options allows you to play the game your way: you can substitute in battle BGM from earlier titles, set the number of weeks to play, adjust game balance, and more! You can even give yourself an advantage if you're new to the Dokapon experience; come one, come all, as this game's for everybody!

The Sword of Fury returns to cut through all the nonsense of the 2020s in style. Come grab its hilt and give it a swing for yourself!

70010000095702.name: Bobby Six Seven
70010000095702.intro: Traffic has never been this dangerous… or this fishy.
70010000095702.description:
Chaos has hit the city!
The villainous Zorbass—more fish than man—has turned every traffic light green. Cars are colliding, traffic is gridlocked, and the chief of police is running out of patience.

You are Detective Bobby Six Seven, the only one left to set things right. Using a mysterious time portal discovered in the station, you’ll pursue Zorbass across history, restore order, and keep your badge intact.

Travel through multiple eras, face a time-traveling nemesis, and solve the case before the city completely unravels.

Features:
- 7 unique time periods
- 3 different weapon types
- A balloon mini game
- Soundtrack by Logana
- A patient but demanding police chief
- Power-ups at the police station water cooler
- Destructible chief’s furniture

70010000095717.name: All in Abyss: Judge the Fake OFFICIAL DESIGNWORKS & MUSIC PLAYER
70010000095717.description: An application where you can enjoy the art and music of All in Abyss: Judge the Fake.

70010000095722.name: Nature Escapes 4 Collector's Edition
70010000095722.intro: Another delightful assortment of enjoyable hidden object scenes!
70010000095722.description:
Nature Escapes 4 will take you on an enchanting adventure in this captivating hidden object game!
Indulge in the untamed beauty of nature in captivating locations across the world, while you grace your garden with a mesmerizing assortment of unique plants and exotic flowers!

Features
- 24 chapters of nature fun!
- Over 70 total HO Scenes and Minigames!
- Fun facts about fun plants!
- Explore gorgeous, handcrafted nature scenes!
- Decorate your very own garden!

Collector's Edition
- includes 6 extra locations
- 12 minigames
- Additional plants and flowers
- Explore the developer's own plant children

Seach for hidden objects, play fun mini-games, and unleash your creativity as you transform your garden into a blooming paradise of plants and flowers!

70010000095726.name: Clothes & Outlet Supermarket Store Simulator
70010000095726.intro: Can you create the most successful clothing outlet?
70010000095726.description:
Clothes & Outlet Supermarket Store Simulator is a realistic simulation game where you take on the role of an entrepreneur and build your own fashion empire! Manage a clothing supermarket and outlet stores, stock up on inventory, set prices, design your store, and attract customers to grow your business.
	•	Full Management – Choose which products to sell, negotiate with suppliers, and manage your stock.
	•	Custom Design – Arrange your store layout, create eye-catching displays, and provide a unique shopping experience.
	•	Strategy & Expansion – Expand your business, open new locations, and turn your outlet into a successful retail chain.
	•	Realistic Simulation – Interact with dynamic customers, analyze fashion trends, and adapt your strategy for maximum profit.
Are you ready to become a fashion mogul? Start your business now in Clothes & Outlet Supermarket Store Simulator!

70010000095731.name: Highway Bikers: Moto Racing Simulator
70010000095731.description:
Feel the adrenaline rush in Highway Bikers: Moto Racing Simulator! 

Race through endless highways, weave through traffic, and push your bike to its limits in high-speed challenges. Master sharp turns, perform daring overtakes, and compete in thrilling modes, from time trials to intense head-to-head races. 

Customize your bike, upgrade performance, and prove your skills on the open road. Are you ready to dominate the highway?

70010000095740.name: Ambidextro
70010000095740.intro: A multi-player game for a single player. Learn to control 2 characters at the same time, one with each hand. Rescue both the prince and the princess at the same time.
70010000095740.description:
A witch has kidnapped the prince and the princess. As the royal wizard, you have been severed in half so you can go rescue both at the same time, but first you’ll need to learn to control the two halves of your body simultaneously.

With a series of quick single-screen platforming levels, Ambidextro will help you master the art of controlling two characters at once, one with each hand. Learn to split your focus and tackle increasingly challenging levels you would have thought impossible.

Features:
- A multi-player game for a single player.
- Control one character with each hand.
- Make your two halves meet before the time runs out.
- 100 levels to conquer.
- Retro dark-fantasy atmosphere with a dungeon synth soundtrack.

70010000095745.name: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine
70010000095745.intro: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine is an escape room-like puzzle game where two players need to cooperate on different devices to prevent the start of a global war.
70010000095745.description:
The unique co-op experience that made How 2 Escape a success is back with improved gameplay and new challenging puzzles!

The latest edition in the How 2 Escape series, How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine, has you and a partner work together to locate a missing submarine and prevent the start of a global war.


SAVE THE WORLD

An important allied military base has been captured by enemy forces, prompting the government to preemptively order the launch of a torpedo to reclaim it - despite the potential for countless allied deaths. 

However, after further internal discussions and negotiations with the enemy, the government has cancelled the strike that could spark a potential global war. The only problem is "The Triumphant", the submarine carrying the torpedo, is out of communication range and no one can confirm if the cancellation orders have reached the submarine. 

To prevent war, the government has tasked its two best experts, officers Haurée and Leroy, to locate "The Triumphant" before time runs out. These two strategic masterminds of the submarine fleet will face a reality they did not expect, as recent decisions have ignited a moral dilemma among the underwater sailors.


COOPERATE TO WIN

2 players, 2 ways to play!

Put your communication and puzzle-solving skills to the test as you and a partner work together to prevent the start of war! Each of you has a crucial role to play that requires logic, coordination, observation and, above all, communication!

As player one, your job is to locate and investigate the inside of the submarine, where you’ll explore and interact with the environment.

Your friend is tasked with using the dedicated free companion app* to gather additional information so you both can solve the puzzles together. 

*Get the free How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine Companion App on your smartphone.

Features: 
• Co-op puzzle solving with a friend
• Only one copy of the game is needed
• Increasingly challenging puzzles
• Simple controls

70010000095747.name: Splatter Blocks
70010000095747.intro: Aim, splash, and paint the board with colorful cubes for fun and accuracy!
70010000095747.description: Splatter Blocks is a vibrant, fun-filled game where precision meets creativity! Launch adorable cube characters from a springboard into a pool of paint, then splash onto the board to color in the picture. Aim carefully to match the correct colors and fill in the corresponding squares. The more accurate your painting, the higher your score! Master each level with perfect splashes and unlock new challenges. Simple, stylish, and bursting with character—get ready to paint the town!

70010000095749.name: Angry Video Game Nerd 8-bit
70010000095749.intro: The Nerd is back in a brand new 8-bit adventure!
70010000095749.description:
The ULTIMATE NERD RAGE is back in Angry Video Game Nerd 8-bit - an all-new action platformer set in the AVGN universe! Play as The Nerd and blast your way across a host of pixel art levels crawling with zombies, mechanical skeletons, ghoulish reapers, and more!

THE 8-BIT EXPERIENCE
We partnered with Mega Cat Studios and Programancer to make a brand new back-to-back 8-bit installment featuring the Angry Video Game Nerd!

THE AVGN UNIVERSE IN 8-BIT FORM
Journey through multiple levels inspired by the AVGN universe, and blast away at enemies themed around each level! Slide below platforms, pick up power-ups, and take alternate routes to get to the boss room!

FAMILIAR FACES, NEW FIGHTS
As The Nerd heads into the pixel-ridden fight, he must face off against familiar faces from his past! Waiting at the end of every level, bosses from the AVGN universe hope to destroy The Nerd!

70010000095754.name: Sauna of the DEAD
70010000095754.intro:
Bring the heat.
Purge the dead.
Rule the sauna.
70010000095754.description:
Step into the world's most unusual sauna game and become a legendary Aufguss Maestro.
We believe you have what it takes to be the best heat-bringer in the underworld!

Purify zombies in a sauna from hell!
You’ve taken a part-time job as an Aufguss Master in the demon realm, and it’s your job to bring the heat.
Use tools like löyly, aufguss fans, and wood stoves to turn up the temperature.
Chill in the cold bath, lie back in a relaxing chair, or go all-out heatwave mode.
Collect unique sauna gear and customize your demon-slaying wellness session.

Classic Sauna Facilities:
Zombie Bath – where the undead gather
Spa Love – chill time with succubi
Great Sauna Hell – for men who endure extreme heat

Survival Sauna for Ranking:
Endless Summer – where underworld party monsters spend the weekend

Rogue-lite Exploration Sauna:
Sauna Fairytale – a hidden fairy sanctuary stolen by a dark heat maestro.

70010000095759.name: Ellphaser
70010000095759.intro: An elephant, precise jumps, and a world that changes with every leap!
70010000095759.description:
Ellphaser throws you into a frozen world where every jump reshapes reality. In this 2D platformer with puzzle mechanics, platforms disappear and reappear with each jump, creating dynamic challenges at every move.

Control a fearless elephant and plan each jump carefully to escape traps—sharp spikes, electric orbs, and unstable platforms are waiting for a misstep.

Explore a frozen mountain, where the calm atmosphere contrasts with the growing challenge. As you progress, new obstacles emerge: elevators, keys, locked doors, and increasingly complex layouts that test your strategy and reflexes.

Each level is a puzzle, and only those who master the balance between jumping and planning will find the exit. Ready to defy gravity and logic?

70010000095764.name: Until Then
70010000095764.description:
In a world still recovering from catastrophe, Mark Borja and his friends navigate the joys and woes of another year of high school. Wake up in a typical teenage bedroom, practice piano, race to meet homework deadlines, and build (and burn) relationships, as you reminisce about the daily insecurities of high school life. 

That is, until a fateful meeting sets off a chain reaction, upending Mark's life. People disappear and memories prove unreliable. Uncover a hidden truth with Mark and his friends in this narrative adventure and race to unravel the mystery before it's too late.

Play Out Your Own Adventure
Meet a diverse and achingly familiar cast of characters to converse with in person, over text, and through email. Get to know them, build relationships, flunk group projects, and watch how their individual personal stories unfold alongside yours.

Investigate the Setting through Everyday Technology
Explore the depths of social media where your likes and comments may pose consequences. Scroll through social posts, emails, webpages, and more on your in-game smartphone, where you might discover hints and clues about the people and world around you. Chat with your friends, classmates, and even strangers. 

Explore Themes of Love, Loss, and Friendship
Tackle philosophical issues as the main character. Make mistakes and difficult choices. Will Mark stand up for his friends and be there when they need him or will he let them down? Can he heal his wounds by letting go of the past? Decide for yourself how Mark grows and strives to do better throughout the story. 

Play Addictively Mundane Minigames
Insert a flash drive—oh wait, wrong way—nope, it was right the first time. Fight your friend for more fishballs at the food stand outside. Get in the groove to pay for the jeepney. Lose yourself in little games you find yourself playing in everyday life.

Immerse Yourself in a Cinematic Visual Experience
Witness an intriguing narrative uniquely presented in eye-catching hand-drawn pixel art and immerse yourself in the warm colors and music of a world trying to move on from tragedy.  Characters, landscapes, and props blend in 3D. Shadows, reflections, and lighting set the tone in a lovingly crafted experience. 

Experience a World Inspired by Philippine Locations and Culture
Traverse Philippine-inspired landscapes in search for the truth. From the heart of the bustling capital to long bus rides past grass fields and coast towns, explore the world of Until Then set in a fictional version of the Philippines. Interior spaces are shaped by the mannerisms of the locals, setting the scene for a recent past.

70010000095769.name: Bee Flowers: Royal Garden
70010000095769.intro: Are you ready to lead the swarm and let your mind bloom?
70010000095769.description:
Step into the buzzing kingdom and become the mastermind behind the hive! In Bee Flowers Royal Garden, you’ll guide majestic queen bees across a hexagonal grid, crafting the perfect paths to lead their subjects to flowers and ensure successful pollination.

With intuitive and engaging mechanics, each level presents a new puzzle to test your logic and creativity. Rotate and rearrange pieces to connect bees and flowers, strategically planning smooth journeys through the royal garden. But be careful! As you progress through 30 thoughtfully designed levels, new challenges emerge, requiring adaptation and strategic thinking.

Immerse yourself in a visually charming experience, accompanied by a soothing soundtrack, and discover the perfect balance between relaxation and challenge.

70010000095777.name: RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army
70010000095777.description:
