Undertake the case of the century in this must-play classic from ATLUS. The studio behind Shin Megami Tensei remasters "Devil Summoner: Raidou Kuzunoha vs. The Soulless Army" with revamped visuals, QOL updates, new VO, and an overhauled battle system! 

Taisho 20, in the Capital—

A young heiress approaches the Narumi Detective Agency with a strange request...to kill her. Without any further explanation, the girl is kidnapped. Apprentice detective Raidou Kuzunoha XIV, who moonlights as a Devil Summoner assigned to protect the Capital, is on the case. Raidou investigates all across the city, which includes entering the Dark Realm—a dangerous juncture between the real world and the netherworld where demons abound. 

Become Raidou Kuzunoha and work with your allied demons to unravel the mysteries that block your path. What was once a missing persons matter soon spirals into a conspiracy that will shake not only the Capital, but the entire nation. 


KEY FEATURES

An Enhanced Yet Faithful Remaster:
The supernatural action RPG classic returns, now revamped with visual, audio, and combat enhancements for modern consoles while staying true to the original game's style. A brand-new UI, full VO, expanded 3D environments, and more invites both veterans and newcomers alike to a nostalgic and thrilling gameplay experience. 

A Supernatural Detective Mystery:
Channel your inner detective in a gripping, supernatural adventure with a charming cast of complex characters. Uncover the truth behind collusion swirling around the Capital with unexpected twists and turns ahead. Use both your mind and the might of your demons to leave no stone unturned. 

A Fantastical Taisho Era Adventure: 
Navigate the historic streets of a fantastical 1930s era in Tokyo or delve into the haunting Dark Realm where demons lie in wait. With over 120 demons to summon, choose your allies wisely to prevent humanity from being consumed by darkness.

70010000095780.name: HITMAN World of Assassination - Signature Edition
70010000095780.intro: ENTER THE WORLD OF THE ULTIMATE ASSASSIN
70010000095780.description:
HITMAN World of Assassination - Signature Edition brings together the best of HITMAN, HITMAN 2 and HITMAN 3 including the main campaign, Contracts mode, Escalation, Elusive Target arcades, featured live content, Freelancer game mode plus all HITMAN 2 Expansion Pack & HITMAN 3 Deluxe Pack content.

BECOME AGENT 47 
Suit up for a spy-thriller adventure where all your deadly abilities are put to the test across more than 20 locations. 

FREEDOM OF APPROACH 
Your deadliest weapon is creativity. Unlock new gear and up your game on highly replayable missions. 

WORLD OF ASSASSINATION 
Travel in a living, breathing world, filled with intriguing characters and lethal opportunities.

70010000095794.name: Football, Tactics & Glory – Treble Deluxe Edition
70010000095794.intro: Tactics meet passion – lead your squad to glory!
70010000095794.description:
From the modest soccer pitch to the large stadium: You'll make history in "Football, Tactics & Glory – Treble Deluxe Edition". Not only are you a coach, you're also a strategist, motivator and the architect of your career. Every decision counts, both on and off the pitch, from line-ups and transfers to the next series of moves. This is not only a question of reflexes and button-mashing, but about sophisticated tactics!

Use the integrated editor to shape your own football world: Create unique players with personality, build your own leagues and clubs, design club badges or recreate legendary rivalries. In the transfer market, you'll juggle the player budget, engage in skillful negotiations and form your dream team. The dynamic weather system with four seasons will provide additional challenges while your team plays its heart out!

Whether you corner the opponent with sophisticated defensive tactics, or the fans cheer you on with your attacking football strategy – every victory, goal and tactical decision reflects your playing style. Take a seat on the coach's bench, because in this game, football isn't merely played, it's lived, felt and celebrated!


The Treble Deluxe Edition offers:
1. The acclaimed main game including all upgrades and optimizations
2. The Football Stars expansion
3. The Manager’s Journey expansion


The highlights at a glance:
• Turn-based matches: Plan every move precisely, be proactive and outsmart your opponents!
• Tactics beat reflexes: Your far-sighted strategy will determine victory or defeat.
• Coach upgrade system: Develop your own style with numerous skills. What will you focus on; the promotion of young talent, intensive training or smart transfers? 
• From amateur club to world champion: Lead an underdog team to the top of the international game – the ultimate manager's dream!
• Diverse career paths: Accept job offers from different clubs and build up a great reputation so that the top clubs will eventually come knocking at your door.
• Brand new talent system: Invest in highly talented stars or in less expensive talent – discover a fascinating dimension in player management.
• Innovative transfer system: Send scouts out to other continents, search for specific players and negotiate lucrative deals when buying and selling.
• Detailed statistics for fans: A game world with a comprehensive history – records, legends, fascinating facts and your personal stats.
• A lively simulation with improved AI: All the clubs worldwide act independently – they play, transfer react to your tactics and motivate their teams to beat you.
• Local multiplayer (Hotseat): Whether it's a tactical duel for two or a major tournament with the whole crew, anyone can become a top coach!

70010000095796.name: Nif Nif
70010000095796.intro: Clean your friends, build your deck and save the forest from the evil goo!
70010000095796.description:
Nif Nif is a wholesome deckbuilder about helping the forest and your animal pals, designed to be easy to pick up for beginners of the genre, but with strategic depth for those who want a challenge!

BUILD THE BEST DECK!
Choose your cards with special abilities as you progress through the levels to be best prepared to face the final bosses that await you at the end of the forest. Decide what to bring on each adventure to keep things fresh, and choose between two characters, each with unique cards.

You can collect seeds, plant them and cook your own power-up potions in the form of delicious hot soups!

WHOLESOME AND CHILL
Nif Nif is a comfortable and cozy experience set in a whimsical colorful world full of friendly and quirky characters that our little piglet will meet along the way on lovely encounters.

For EVERYONE
Designed for a general audience: from fans of deck-builders or cozy games, to kids (it helps them practice mental math!) or even people with no experience in video games. Accessible and totally non-violent.

Includes…

Procedurally generated maps
Two playable characters (Nif Nif and Cat) with different decks
Gardening and cooking mini game
Unlockable hats to change abilities
Progress through levels, unlockable hats and achievements

70010000095801.name: Call of the Elder Gods
70010000095801.intro: Unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure
70010000095801.description:
All is not well at Miskatonic University. Professor Harry Everhart tries to ignore the shadows flitting at the corners of his vision, while student Evangeline Drayton is haunted with impossible dreams of an artifact uncovered a decade ago. In their search for answers, the pair will uncover revelations more ancient than anyone could have imagined.

Shocking Secrets
Call of the Sea’s object and observation-based puzzles return with new depth. Scour richly-rendered environments for clues. Swap between Harry and Evangeline to solve complex, multi-part problems across time and space. Choose your own difficulty level with toggle-able hints, icons, and journal entries. For a true challenge, dare to read the Occult Books scattered about the world and meet new, reality-warping enigmas.

Dizzying Marvels
Harry and Evangeline’s journey takes them from the firelit libraries of a New England mansion to the red sands of the Australian outback, through frozen wastelands and otherworldly cities out of time, all stunningly rendered in Unreal Engine 5 and featuring a soundtrack by multi-award-winning returning composer Eduardo De La Iglesia.

A Shadow Out of Time
Follow Harry Everhart and Evangeline Drayton as they search for the truth about their missing loved ones and come face-to-face with beings beyond their understanding. Inspired by H P Lovecraft's 'The Shadow out of Time', Call of the Elder Gods features a fully voice-acted story of grief, family, and sanity, starring returning talents Yuri Lowenthal (Spider-Man, Arcane, Final Fantasy VII Rebirth) and Cissy Jones (Firewatch, Starfield, Baldur’s Gate III).

70010000095806.name: No Sun To Worship
70010000095806.intro: A minimalist retro stealth-action game paying homage to Kojima's famed series.
70010000095806.description:
No Sun To Worship is a minimalist, stealth-action game that captures the brilliance of the first pioneers of the stealth genre and recreates their retro-aesthetic charm within an echo of a dying world.

Punishment Delivered
Each of 6 bite-sized chapters will challenge your art of infiltration and assassination by giving you freedom to approach the levels as you see fit. Sneak, crawl, disable surveillance and smash light sources to move undetected. Isolate and eliminate targets silently or start firefights on your own terms. Manage your resources wisely or be forced to get creative - The enemy doesn’t need to know the gun aimed at their head is empty.

Echo of a dying world
Discover your role and the broader canvas through environmental and non-verbal storytelling as you travel through an echo of a dying world, left in agony after a nuclear war with its inhabitants trying to stitch its broken pieces back together as the onlookers from another world observe in silence.

70010000095809.name: Mudness Offroad Car Simulator Runner
70010000095809.intro: Drive through the wild. Conquer the impossible.
70010000095809.description:
Get ready for an extreme experience on off-road trails! In Mudness Offroad Car Simulator Runner, you’ll drive the most robust 4x4 vehicles through rugged terrain, deep swamps, and dark forests. You’ll face a challenging adventure where you’ll need to use your driving skills to navigate the toughest environmental conditions.

Key Features:
	•	Realistic Off-Road Experience: Simulate driving on rugged trails and difficult terrain for an authentic off-road experience.
	•	Powerful 4x4 Vehicles: Choose from a variety of robust 4x4 vehicles, each with unique features to overcome any obstacle.
	•	Upgrades and Customization: Customize your vehicle with upgrades for performance, aesthetics, and reliability on rough terrain.
	•	Realistic Controls: Detailed driving mechanics that simulate every vehicle movement, including interaction with different types of terrain.
	•	Challenges and Missions: Complete missions and overcome challenges to earn rewards and improve your equipment.

Be mindful of the uneven terrain, avoiding mud traps and dangerous obstacles. Conquer extreme weather conditions and overcome all obstacles to get as far as you can. Choose your preferred vehicle, start the engine, and dive into the world of Mudness Offroad Car Simulator Runner to become the best driver on off-road trails! Adrenaline, performance, and challenge are waiting for you!

70010000095814.name: Missile Command Delta
70010000095814.intro: Missiles are incoming. The stakes are high. Only you can stop the destruction.
70010000095814.description:
The teams at Mighty Yell and 13AM Games have taken one of Atari’s most iconic titles and created a high-pressure, tactical turn-based game where players must manage their pool of defenses strategically to survive rounds of incoming missiles.

Missile Command Delta approaches gameplay in a completely new way, but it retains all the tension and suspense of the arcade original. You have to think strategically about every move you make because even one poor choice can have grave consequences. The turn-based strategy game is wrapped in a twisting, narrative thriller – great for mystery fans, completionists, and players that love to explore and solve puzzles.

Between inbound missile alerts, investigate the underground bunker to access locked rooms, uncover secrets, and strengthen your arsenal. Will you be able to unravel the mystery in time?

FEATURES

- Turn-Based Strategy: A totally unique strategy experience. New missile and enemy types are uncovered when you explore deeper into the bunker.

- Plan Your Defense: Every turn is critical, and one poor choice can spell disaster. Plan your next move, and map out a cascade of explosions that take out multiple enemy missiles to help conserve your resources.

- High-Stakes Mystery: The turn-based strategy game is wrapped in a high-stakes narrative puzzle. Read every document, watch your every step, and ace every puzzle if you want to [REDACTED].

- Experience the Cold War: A claustrophobic retro-future aesthetic of dusty command consoles and supercomputers place you deep into Cold War paranoia.

70010000095824.name: CATO: Buttered Cat
70010000095824.intro:
CATO = Cat + Toast = Buttered cat paradox = Anti-gravity
200+ puzzles，40+ skins
70010000095824.description:
CATO: Buttered Cat is an adorable puzzle platformer, inspired by the buttered-cat paradox meme: Cats always land on their feet, and toast always lands buttered side down. By strapping a piece of buttered toast to a cat's back, you create a paradox that results in an infinitely spinning, floating butter-cat perpetual motion machine!
The game revolves around the two main characters, "Cat" and "Buttered Toast." You'll need to use the interactions between them to solve various puzzles at each game level. The full game is featuring over 140 main levels and more than 60 side levels. There are also hidden rooms, challenging boss battles, and fun mini-games. The full version will include an outfit system, with 30+ Cat and Toast skins waiting for you to collect!

Cat and Toast Joint Adventure:
・Control the cat as it runs left and right, climbs the cat scratching broad, and even slips through pipes. Hey! cats are liquid!
・Guide the toast meanwhile with the cat, as toast jumps like projectiles. Hold down and power on, and the toast will jump farther!
・When the two combine, they can trigger the paradox, taking the cat to unreachable places!

Whimsical Contraptions:
CATO will take you to a brain-teasing adventure, exploring five different worlds, each filled with unique contraptions.
Including toaster(Toast: NO!!)to buttered trampolines and speed-boasting space pipes(Cat: Meow!!). Along the way, the two will also encounter some mysterious companions to help them with puzzles.

Boss Fights & Mini-Games:
The game is about puzzles, with a little action elements. You don't need to perform difficult platforming for most of the time; just focus on solving the puzzles. However, some pesky enemies will be standing in your way during the adventure. Your abilities will help you defeat them.
As you progress through the adventure, you'll also unlock various mini-games. Once collected, these can be installed on the gaming console in your little hideout, allowing you to play them anytime.

Easter eggs and More:
In the world of CATO: Buttered Cat, there are many hidden rooms that can only be accessed through secret passages. Here, you can find Easter eggs from other worlds and mysterious drop items.
Take them back to your cozy little hideout, put on your favourite outfit, and set off again!

What exactly is the cat and toast searching for? Pieces of these stories are scattered along the adventure, waiting for you to explore.

70010000095829.name: Monster Survivors: Hunting Wilds
70010000095829.intro: In a world where darkness reigns, survival is only for the bravest! Monster Survivors: Hunting Wilds throws you into a relentless battle against monstrous creatures lurking in the wild.
70010000095829.description:
In a world where darkness reigns, survival is only for the bravest! Monster Survivors: Hunting Wilds throws you into a relentless battle against monstrous creatures lurking in the wild. Face the horrors of the night and decide—will you be the hunter or the hunted?

Features:
Endless Battleground – Survive against relentless waves of monsters!
Legendary Abilities – Customize your combat style with 36 unique abilities.
Terrifying Enemies & Deadly Bosses – Battle 14 different creatures and 6 powerful bosses.
Challenging Maps – Adapt your strategy to survive in diverse environments.
Permanent Upgrade System – Enhance your armor, damage, health, and more.

The hunt begins! Can you and your team survive the nightmare?

70010000095839.name: We Three: A Love Story
70010000095839.intro: A love triangle where romance and obsession mingle in a story of desire, manipulation and unexpected twists and turns.
70010000095839.description:
A young university student finds himself torn between two completely opposite girls: a childhood friend, with whom he shares memories of a quiet life and unfulfilled promises, and a mysterious girl, whose arrival shakes his world with intense and unknown emotions.

What begins as a sweet romance soon turns into a psychological struggle where the line between love and obsession becomes blurred. Every decision will affect not only their relationships, but also their perception of reality and the outcome of the story.

Can you uncover the truth before it's too late?

70010000095842.name: Arcade Archives STINGER
70010000095842.intro: Destroy the enemy and infiltrate the base!
70010000095842.description:
"STINGER" is a shooter released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1983.
Take control of the "STINGER WOLF" and head to the center of an enemy base where evil life forms roam.
In an emergency, you can call on the friendly robot "BONGO" to automatically destroy the enemy.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000095847.name: Spot the Difference Detective
70010000095847.intro:
Spot the Difference in Cute Illustrations!
A Simple and Fun Brain-Training Search Game
70010000095847.description:
This is a fun and easy brain-training game where you find the one hidden mistake in a cute illustration—before time runs out!

How to Play：
・Take a close look at the top image on the split screen
・Compare it with the bottom image and find the difference
・When you spot it, tap the spot where the mistake is!

It’s perfect for quick play, brain workouts, or just a fun break in your free time.

Stuck?
Just tap the hint button!
(It’ll give you a pretty big clue to help you out.)

70010000095849.name: Without a Voice
70010000095849.intro: Guide a former princess through her life in exile as she encounters new dangers, thrills and perhaps a chance at love!
70010000095849.description:
In the depths of a dark and unforgiving forest, an exiled princess whiles her time in solitude. For a girl raised in the lap of comfort, the woods are impossibly harsh, and day-to-day survival is the most she can manage. One day, however, a mysterious, beautiful maiden appears, throwing her world out of its already delicate alignment. The princess is instantly captivated by this stranger and begins to fancy herself the heroine of a fairytale, even as the maiden proves herself to be less and less of a fantasy.

Without a Voice is a thought-provoking visual novel adventure told through detailed character portraits, scripted dialogue of more than 15,000 words, lush backdrops and a dozen unlockable event illustrations. Make key decisions to decide how the story plays out and discover 8 possible endings to this tale of love and intrigue between its leading ladies.

• Explore a fantasy world brought to life through beautiful visuals!
• Make important choices to direct the narrative.
• Engage in dialogue spanning a script of more than 15,000 words!
• Decide how the relationship unfolds.
• Unlock a dozen unique event scenes as you progress!

70010000095859.name: As I Began to Dream
70010000095859.intro: As I Began to Dream is a journey about a girl and her turtle, trapped in her dream world, dealing with past trauma. She controls this world uniquely to navigate her grief.
70010000095859.description:
After awakening to find herself trapped in a mysterious dream world, Lily is forced to face her past traumas and experiences. Harnessing a unique ability to swap, rotate, and move the environment around her, Lily progresses through the various worlds in a journey of navigating grief and finding herself.

Features:
Accompanied by her flying turtle friend, take on the challenges of the mysterious dream worlds together

Swap, rotate, and move the environment around you to solve puzzles to progress through the world

Immerse yourself in the stunning, hand-drawn visuals that span various, visually distinct worlds

While exploring the worlds of As I Began to Dream, you are accompanied by peaceful, almost melancholy music.

70010000095869.name: Cozy Earth: Hawaii Island Love Anime Boys
70010000095869.intro: Escape to the paradise of Hawaii and live a magical adventure surrounded by anime boys and breathtaking landscapes! Your home, your island, your story.
70010000095869.description:
A world full of sunshine, fun, and romance awaits you on the most beautiful tropical island. Explore this island paradise, rescue charming boys, and create the home of your dreams. Everything you’ve always imagined is within your reach!

Do you love decorating and designing? Here, you can build your dream house, customize it with unique furniture, and add that special touch you've always wanted. From cozy beachside homes to tropical villas surrounded by exquisite gardens, your imagination is the limit!

But that's not all – you won't be alone on this island. You’ll meet irresistible anime boys with unique personalities who will accompany you every step of your adventure.

Rescue them, form special connections, and let them help make your home an even more welcoming place. Each boy has something unique to offer!


Features:
-Explore a paradise island full of sunshine and mysteries!
-Design your house in your style and create the perfect home in a relaxing environment.
-Collect resources to build new structures and progress through the island.
-Rescue and connect with anime boys who will help you on your adventure.
-Enjoy relaxing gameplay filled with fun, romance, and creativity.


Make Cozy Earth: Hawaii Island Love Anime Boys your refuge and start your adventure today!

70010000095876.name: Airport Manager Simulator 2025
70010000095876.intro: Precision, efficiency, perfection – be the best airport manager!
70010000095876.description:
Airport Manager Simulator 2025 is the ultimate airport management experience, putting you in charge of overseeing every aspect of airport operations. From handling passenger logistics to coordinating ground services, you’ll ensure the smooth and efficient running of a bustling international hub.
Key Features:
	•	Full Airport Control – Manage passenger flow, baggage handling, aircraft servicing, and flight schedules.
	•	Operate Ground Equipment – Take control of boarding bridges, baggage conveyors, fuel trucks, and more to keep flights on time.
	•	Realistic Challenges – Balance efficiency, safety, and customer satisfaction in dynamic scenarios.
	•	Immersive Experience – Stunning graphics, detailed airport environments, and authentic sound design.
Step into the fast-paced world of aviation and prove your skills as an Airport Manager! Are you ready to take control of the skies?

70010000095882.name: Milano's Odd Job Collection
70010000095882.intro: For the first time outside Japan, help Milano take on an exciting summer of part-time jobs and cozy home life.
70010000095882.description:
School’s out, but 11-year-old Milano’s mom needs to go to the hospital and Milano is sent to spend the summer with her uncle. There’s one small problem – her uncle is away on vacation! Left on her own, Milano decides to make the most of her situation by taking up a variety of part-time jobs in town. Over the next 40 days, Milano goes all in – delivering pizzas, nursing sick patients, milking flying cows, and more – to make this summer unforgettable. And maybe she can spruce up her uncle’s place and have some fun while she’s at it.

Previously only available in Japan, this charming classic delivers cute Japanese nostalgia to worldwide audiences for the first time!

◆Milano Meets the World
Full English text and voiceovers bring Milano’s pixel-art adventures to a whole new audience. Fans can rest assured that the original Japanese is also available, complete with all-new English subtitles.

◆Make Your Home Away from Home
Rest and relaxation are important for work-life balance. Milano can style the house with new furniture and decor instead of going into work, and at night she can enjoy quiet time inside with her uncle’s cat, stargazing from her bedroom, and making use of items purchased with her hard-earned wages.

◆It’s Not Work if You Love to Do It
Help Milano earn money in eight unique mini games, including curing diseases as a nurse, catching falling fruits in an orchard, and more. Enrich Milano’s skill, mood, and energy in the evenings to unlock more odd jobs and higher difficulty levels. The tougher the challenge, the bigger the payday!

◆Nostalgic Gameplay, Modern Conveniences
The charm and gameplay of the original release are intact, but improved load times, save states, and a rewind feature help update this classic title for modern audiences.

70010000095888.name: ILA: A Frosty Glide
70010000095888.intro: Explore a magical island as Ila, searching for her lost kitty, Coco.
70010000095888.description:
A COZY EXPLORATION PLATFORMER ADVENTURE
Ila’s beloved kitty, Coco, has mysteriously disappeared, and she’s determined to bring him back home! Explore a whimsical small open world as Ila, a spirited young witch-in-training flying on a magic Skatebroom. Uncover hidden stories, collect valuable items, and improve your magical flying abilities.

GLIDE AROUND
Have you ever dreamed of flying on a skateboard? Feel the wind as you glide effortlessly through the crisp mountain air on Ila’s magical skatebroom as you explore the enchanting island. The core mechanic focuses on the pure joy of movement. Master and upgrade your flying skills, soar to new heights and tackle thrilling platforming challenges along the way.

DISCOVER THE STORY OF ILA AND THE ISLAND
Dive into the rich lore of the island as you uncover ancient secrets and forgotten stories. Piece together the history of the land and its connection to Ila’s past, revealing surprising ties between her dreams and the mysteries of this enchanted place.

FIND SECRET PLACES AND RELAX
Explore Ila’s magical island at your own pace and relax. Find hidden nooks and uncovered treasures flying on your skatebroom. But also indulge yourself pausing and enjoying the view from high vantage points. Savor the serene beauty and tranquil freedom of the snow-covered landscape on your magical skatebroom.

WITCHY CUSTOMIZATION
Express your creativity by personalizing Ila’s appearance! Find special items around the island or collect coins to use at the magic shop. Choose from a variety of outfits, hats, capes and skatebrooms to create a unique look that reflects your own style.

ENJOY THE IMMERSIVE SOUNDTRACK
Feel the magic of Ila’s world and enjoy the captivating original soundtrack. Each track evolves with Ila’s adventure inviting you to relax and grows alongside your journey to guide you toward Coco’s clues with every note.

70010000095893.name: Trash is Fun
70010000095893.intro: Recycle, sort, and clean up - turn trash into fun!
70010000095893.description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey around the world in an eco-adventure specially designed for 1-4 players with co-op support. You will play as different mutated animals: duck, owl, squirrel, hedgehog, etc. After the apocalypse due to global warming, the characters realized that to survive, they would have to gather in a team and sort and recycle garbage.

Trash is Fun offers exciting graphics, combining a harsh post-apocalypse theme with a bright stylized style. The soundtrack, featuring a blend of electronic beats and environmental sounds, enhances the overall experience, pulling you deeper into the post-apocalyptic universe.

Beyond entertainment, the game aims to inspire real-world action. Through in-game tips and fun facts, players learn about responsible waste management, creating a positive impact both inside and outside the gaming world.

Join the movement, and together, let's turn trash into treasures while having a blast in Trash is Fun!

70010000095898.name: Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines
70010000095898.description:
Meet Penny, a corporate grunt and serial procrastinator who spent all her time at the office doodling comics and playing phone games instead of working on her project. Now a weekend away from missing her deadline, Penny must find inspiration and overcome all sorts of distractions to finish her project on time and not disappoint her mentor (and not get fired). And maybe she'll learn something about herself in the process.

Features:
■ Explore the office and phone up friends and coworkers for ideas and inspiration
■ Avoid (or embrace) distractions from daydreams, video games, mysterious doors, and imaginary(?) friends
■ Behold the consequences of your actions through the story's multiple endings
■ Completely hand-drawn visuals
■ Luxurious OST by the esteemed Chance Thrash
■ Overtime! Penny's story continues in an extra full-length chapter, included with the game!

70010000095903.name: HUNDRED FIRES: The rising of red star -Complete Edition-
70010000095903.intro: Step into a stealth mission full of action and absurd comedy during the Cold War.
70010000095903.description:
Hundred Fires: The Rising of Red Star – Complete Edition is a stealth-action game that pays tribute to the classics of the genre, delivering a tactical infiltration experience with an over-the-top, absurdly comedic narrative.
Created by David Amado Fernández, this Complete Edition unites all three original episodes into one full adventure starring the legendary Valero Montenegro.
Set in the heart of the Cold War, you’ll face off against the Soviet army, uncover nuclear threats in Cuba, and track down a mysterious Japanese weapons engineer.
Use strategy, stealth, and a variety of tools to overcome obstacles in levels that evoke the nostalgia of old-school infiltration games.
Absurd cutscenes, unexpected twists, and pure stealth gameplay await in this indie love letter to tactical espionage.

70010000095906.name: Anime Girls: Clever Clover
70010000095906.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000095906.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000095908.name: Anime Girls: Bouncy Basketball
70010000095908.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000095908.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000095912.name: Anime Girls: Naughty Neko
70010000095912.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000095912.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000095914.name: Pool With Me
70010000095914.intro: Pool With Me – The Ultimate 8-Ball Pool Challenge!
70010000095914.description:
Grab your cue and get ready for the most exciting pool experience! Pool With Me lets you play 8-ball pool in both 3D and 2D modes—whether you want realistic physics or fast-paced arcade action.

• Play with Friends – Challenge up to 4 players locally or compete online.
• 5 Stylish Locations – From neon-lit bars to classic pool halls, each table has its own vibe.
• Championship Mode – Prove your skills and climb the ranks to become the best!
• Easy to Learn, Hard to Master – Simple controls for beginners, deep gameplay for pros.

Perfect for quick matches, parties, or intense tournaments—Pool With Me delivers fun for everyone!

Are you ready to rule the table?

70010000095919.name: Cozy Woods
70010000095919.description:
Step into Cozy Woods, a serene walking simulator where exploration and relaxation go hand in hand. Wander through lush forests, hidden groves, and scenic overlooks as you take in the beauty of a world that shifts between day and night.

Explore & Discover
Roam freely across stunning landscapes filled with charming details and hidden secrets.
Uncover unique locations, from misty lakesides to glowing firefly meadows.
Experience a world that changes with the time of day, revealing new sights under the golden sun or twinkling stars.

70010000095922.name: Ramen! Road to Mastery
70010000095922.intro:
Noodles! Soup! Toppings!
Fill ramen orders as quickly as possible and follow the road to mastery!
70010000095922.description:
Let's make ramen on the Nintendo Switch™!
Take on ramen orders, make the ramen quickly and correctly, then serve it up!
Share Joy-Con™ for exciting battles with up to 4 players!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Make and serve as much ramen as you can before time runs out!
Pour the soup, boil the noodles, then add the right toppings!
Pay attention to the firmness of the noodles and fill each order correctly!

《How to Play》
1. Check the order - Memorize the ramen type and noodle firmness!

2. Add the soup - Be careful not to mess up the flavor!

3. Boil the noodles - Once the firmness is just right, drain the water!

4. Add the toppings - Follow the recipe for each ramen type!

5. Serve it up - Get the order correct for the most points!

[Score Attack]
Compete with players from all over the world for the top spot on the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Compete with others and test your ramen-making skills!

70010000095927.name: Brain Challenge Spot the Real One!
70010000095927.intro:
Spot the Real One Among the Fakes!
A Fast-Paced Brain-Training “Find the Difference” Game
70010000095927.description:
In this brain-training game, your mission is to find the one real image hidden among many convincing lookalikes—before time runs out!

They may all look nearly identical at first glance, but if you look closely, you’ll start to spot the subtle differences.
Challenge your observation skills and sharpen your mind by spotting the real one in an instant!

Stuck? Just push the hint button!
(It’ll secretly point you to the general area of the answer.)

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000095935.name: FAIRY TAIL: DUNGEONS
70010000095935.intro: Another tale of Fairy Tail, who fought for their comrades' wishes...
70010000095935.description:
Fairy Tail: Dungeons is a deck-building roguelike where you combine magic cards and outwit your enemies to win battles.
Players control Fairy Tail characters with diverse abilities and skills, exploring dungeons within a limited number of steps. Using decks built to suit their strategy, they defeat enemies that attack them, aiming to reach the deepest part of the dungeon.

Features an All-new Story
One day, Natsu and Happy discover a mysterious door has suddenly appeared below the guild. Inside, they find a strange, expansive dungeon that saps all intruders of their powers. With no means to defend themselves, the two seem doomed until an Exceed called Labi comes to their aid. Once they hear about Labi's missing friend, Natsu and Happy decide to head for the deepest depths themselves.

Labyrinth (Solo Dungeon)
Use the cards in your deck to attack, defend, cast magic, and more. Power up your deck further with cards won in battle or found in treasure chests. Use cards in a specific order to activate Magic Chains for punishing amounts of damage.

Explore the solo dungeon and unlock powerful skills before your lantern goes out. If you're lucky, you might even run into fellow guild members who can join up with you!

Even if you fall in battle, the points you earn exploring will unlock amulets which will aid in future runs through the dungeon. Don't let defeat stop you. Try and try again!

Characters
Players can control a whopping 10 characters.
Each character has their own fighting style and fortes.
Natsu, a balanced all-rounder.
Lucy, who calls on her unique celestial spirits to wreak havoc on the battlefield.
Gray, who uses diverse molding magic to gain tactical advantage, and many more!
Discover how to use each effectively and earn the upper hand in battle.

Labyrinth Depths (Team Dungeon)
Form a team with 3 characters you've trained in the solo dungeon, and dive deep into the depths. Find tomes inside to power up your team's stats. Don't miss out on the final boss—an original character illustrated by Fairy Tail creator Hiro Mashima himself!

Music
Features a soundtrack produced by Secret of Mana composer Hiroki Kikuta. The world of Fairy Tail comes alive through Celtic-inspired sounds that add a vibrant backdrop to the battles and story scenes.

70010000095940.name: Marisa of Liartop Mountain
70010000095940.intro: "What do I want to be, Reimu?"
70010000095940.description:
Marisa of Liartop Mountain is an adventure RPG inspired by tabletop gamebooks, where dice rolls and fork-in-the-road choices determine the outcome of a branching story with multiple endings. As Reimu, step into a literary wonderland while in search of Marisa’s whereabouts. Four Touhou heroines will guide, help, and support Reimu on her journey, but which one should Reimu listen to?

■ Story

Marisa, Reimu’s close friend, has suddenly disappeared—
In her search, Reimu of Hakurei Shrine stumbles upon a mysterious book.

Inside, she finds herself in a world filled with strange inhabitants, and a hollow, empty Marisa standing before her.

"What do I want to be, Reimu?"

Can Reimu navigate the mountain of lies clouding Marisa’s heart and bring her back?

■ About This Game

・Tabletop-style RPG
You play as Reimu, exploring the dungeon within the book <Liartop Mountain> in a quest to save Marisa.

There is one main story.
Yet the path branches out in many ways according to your choices and the roll of the dice, which then converges to the ending of your journey.

Though digital in form, this RPG recreates the feel of a tabletop session, focusing on replayability and the thrill of shaping your own adventure.

・Dice Inventory
Sometimes, luck is part of your choice.

Dice rolls influence story events and combat outcomes, but it’s not just about a single six-sided die.
As you progress, you’ll acquire special dice with unique properties; High-value dice, intentionally low ones, or dice with identical faces.

Combine them wisely, and master your fate.

・Choices and Growth with Scarlet Devil Mansion Characters
Remilia, Flandre, Sakuya, and Patchouli often chime in, offering their own opinions as selectable choices.
Sometimes their advice helps, sometimes it’s meaningless, or even troublesome.
But by embracing their suggestions, you may gain access to powerful dice.

・Rerolls
By spending CP, you can reroll and overturn unlucky outcomes.
CP can be increased by leveling up, though doing so makes it harder to raise other stats.

Will you build skill through growth, or rely on luck through rerolls?
The choice is yours.

・Music by RD-Sounds
The soundtrack is composed by RD-Sounds, known for unique and evocative Touhou arrangements.
Enjoy their distinct take on Kirisame Marisa and the world of Touhou, crafted exclusively for this title.

With the DLC, you can play the game accompanied by RD-Sounds’ handpicked Touhou arrangements, an experience like no other.

■ Participating creators

Scenario Outline: Hugo Hall

Music: RD-Sounds

Theme song sung by Sarasa Toumi

Game Master: NEKI

Director: Masatoshi Tokuoka

Kirisame Marisa 
Voiced by Mariko Honda


This game is based on Touhou Project.

70010000095945.name: Super Mini World: The Legend of the Hidden Garden
70010000095945.intro: Sophie and Leo thought their garden was a safe place, until they found a shiny rock. Suddenly, they became very, very small, and the insects started talking.
70010000095945.description:
Discover the magic in this stunning visual novel!

Sophie and Leo never imagined that a simple afternoon in the garden would turn them into... ants! Now, in a world where every blade of grass is a giant tree and every drop of water a lake, they must face unexpected challenges, surprising creatures, and ancient secrets hidden beneath the leaves.

With the help of a brave dragonfly and clues left by the garden's guardians, the siblings will discover that true courage lies not in size, but in the determination to help when it's most needed.

Can they find their way back home?

Or will this magical garden hold more surprises than they imagine?

Key Features:

Loveable Characters
- Sophie and Leo, two curious and brave siblings.
- Luma, a bold dragonfly who guides them on their adventure.
- Magical creatures, some friendly... and some not so friendly.

An Incredible World
- A garden transformed into an immense forest full of mysteries.
- Insects, plants, and everyday objects transformed into epic challenges.

Vibrant music and colors
- An immersive soundtrack that draws you into the story.
- Colorful settings with charming details.

A story filled with values and emotion.
- Teamwork, courage, and the importance of friendship.
- An inspiring message about overcoming fears and building self-confidence.

Discover a hidden world beneath your feet and embark on this giant mini-adventure!

70010000095947.name: Subway Simulator 2025 - City Train
70010000095947.intro: Your train, your rules, the city awaits.
70010000095947.description:
Take your place in the operator’s seat and guide the lifeline of the city with Subway Simulator 2025 - City Trai — the most advanced and atmospheric metro driving experience on console.

Feel the rumble beneath the rails as you navigate an ever-evolving urban network. From peak-hour pressure to peaceful midnight journeys, every second demands precision, patience, and absolute control.
Designed for realism and immersion, this simulator lets you experience life as a true subway professional — complete with responsive train physics, fully interactive cabins, lifelike passenger behavior, and a living underground world waiting to be explored.

Features:
True-to-Life Controls
Operate your train with unmatched authenticity. Adjust acceleration, manage braking systems, control doors, handle signals, and react to the unpredictable — all with precision, all in real-time.

Immersive Metro World
Explore an expansive underground transit system featuring multiple interconnected lines, each with its own design, rhythm, and challenges. From modern central hubs to older, character-filled tunnels, the city breathes beneath your wheels.

Career Progression & Scheduling
Start as a rookie. Grow into a master operator. Complete missions, meet strict schedules, solve real-time issues, and earn your stripes in a career mode built for simulation fans.

Smart Passenger Simulation
Transport responsive passengers who comment on ride quality, react to service conditions, and shape your reputation. A smooth, safe journey keeps the public (and your progress) on track.

Whether you’re chasing high scores in peak-hour chaos or soaking in the quiet of a late-night line, Subway Simulator 2025 - City Trai puts the soul of the city in your hands — one station at a time.

70010000095952.name: LABYBAN
70010000095952.intro: Across 140 levels, teleporters, slippery surfaces, conveyor belts, and many more mechanics await you!
70010000095952.description:
Liuri wakes up, alone, deep inside a mine on an abandoned floating island. He doesn’t know how he got there or why. There’s only one thing to do: explore. 

A tribute to the timeless Sokoban genre, LABYBAN modernizes the puzzle game experience with an accessible, intuitive, and stimulating approach. Across more than 140 levels, each puzzle pushes the gameplay mechanics even further. 

Teleporters, slippery surfaces, conveyor belts... and many more surprises await! 

The world of LABYBAN is made up of seven distinct biomes, each with a strong visual identity and unique gameplay mechanics. Some introduce new ways to play, while others combine and transform previous challenges, ensuring a smooth and varied progression. 

Will you manage to escape the island?

70010000095962.name: Schoolboy Escape
70010000095962.description:
You're grounded again for something totally unfair, but your friends are hanging out at the arcade tonight and you CANNOT miss it! In Schoolboy Escape, you play as a clever teen with a talent for creative problem-solving who must devise the perfect plan to sneak out for an evening of fun while the house is on high alert.

Key Features:

Master the Art of Distraction: Create clever diversions using everyday household items to redirect attention away from your escape route
Navigate Dynamic Security: Family members have unique patrol patterns, areas of focus, and levels of awareness that change based on your actions
Transform Ordinary Objects: Turn remote controls, toys, household tech and more into sophisticated tools for your master escape plan
Multiple Escape Routes: Each exit presents different challenges and opportunities - from bedroom windows to basement doors
Real-time Strategy: Timing is everything! One misplaced item or poorly timed move could send you back to square one
Escalating Challenges: Progress through increasingly complex scenarios requiring multi-stage plans and perfect execution
Neighborhood Freedom: Successfully escape to meet your waiting friends and enjoy bonus arcade mini-games as your reward

From simple sneaking to elaborate multi-stage plans worthy of a Hollywood heist, Schoolboy Escape turns everyday suburban life into the ultimate puzzle-solving adventure!
Your friends are waiting, the arcade is calling - time to prove you're the mastermind of mischief!

70010000095967.name: Stratogun
70010000095967.description:
In an alternate reality you'd find Stratogun in your nearest arcade, consuming all of your hard-earned pocket change. Stratogun is a modern interpretation of the arcade classics of the 80's. It's easy to pick up, but very difficult to master. Shoot your way through of swarms of enemies, unlock weapons ships & perks to increase your chances of survival. Can you conquer the coveted top spot in the leaderboard, or will you die trying?

At its core Stratogun is an ultra-fast space shooter with tight controls. The game also includes progression as after each run your score is converted to experience points which in turn unlock new gear. Every unlocked item will increase your chances of survival, but in the end it will all boil down to your skills and reaction time. The Red Orbit is ruthless, and only the toughest space pilots will survive the increasingly difficult waves of blood-thirsty enemies.

The visuals of Stratogun draw influence from the arcade classics. Wireframe aesthetics are combined with a kick-ass soundtrack ensuring that this would indeed be something you'd find in an arcade, if those establishments would still be a thing.

Key Features:
•	Uncompromised arcade gameplay & difficulty
•	Modern, yet arcade-faithful audiovisuals
•	Progression & unlockable gear
•	Leaderboards

70010000095977.name: Paws and Whiskers
70010000095977.intro:
A Purrfect Blend of Bag Management & Auto-Battling!
Dive into a light roguelite adventure where strategic backpack management meets addictive auto-chess combat!
70010000095977.description:
Expand your pack, organize, combine, and store magical summoning stones, and build an unstoppable Legion of Cats! Your choices shape the story's ending – forge your own path!

Choose Your Hero, Forge Your Fate:
Pick your champion and power them up on your journey! Learn devastating new abilities and unlock unique upgrades as you explore diverse paths to victory. Lead your feline forces to triumph!

Master Your Backpack, Master the Game:
Your pack is EVERYTHING! Unlock 200+ unique items, but remember: No backpack, no victory! Continuously expand your storage and strategically arrange your gear. Use your stones to summon mighty cat units onto the battlefield!

Shop 'Til You Drop!
Visit the store and splurge your hard-earned coins! Fill your pack to the brim with game-changing loot!

Command a Purrfect Army:
Recruit from 15+ distinct feline unit types! Craft powerful stones using unique recipes to summon even mightier cat recruits! Experiment and build synergistic team compositions (comps) to crush challenging foes!

Unleash Arcane Power:
Collect magical spell scrolls to unleash game-changing abilities and dramatically turn the tide of battle!

70010000095982.name: Music Drive: Chase the Beat
70010000095982.intro: An action game where a couple races against time to recover stolen music, combining intense shootouts and rhythm-filled chases.
70010000095982.description:
Races to recover stolen music in action shootouts!

Music is the most valuable asset in the world, and hard drives filled with unreleased tracks have been stolen by a gang that wants to monopolize the charts. It's up to you to recover them!

You play as Tina & Tunner — she's the best getaway driver in the hood, he's a sharpshooter with perfect aim. Together, this couple uses their unique talents in high-octane missions, combining action and rhythm in a race against time to save the art that moves the world: music.

Key Features:
- Fast-paced gameplay focused on driving and shootouts
- Vibrant visuals with a strong urban identity
- Original soundtrack by rapper NP Vocal
- Missions full of action, chases, and musical challenges

70010000095987.name: Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree
70010000095987.intro: Discover a once-thriving ocean, now tainted by enigmatic dark entities. Your quest: decipher the mystery and rekindle the ocean's radiant light.
70010000095987.description:
Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree is a 2D adventure game deeply rooted in Arabian mythology. Dive into Ma'een, a stunning underwater realm. Once a thriving ocean, Ma'een is now corrupted by dark entities.
Explore the Cosmic Sea :
From vibrant, ecosystems of plants and coral, to decaying ruins of an ancient civilization, explore the vast expanse of the cosmic sea, Ma'een through smooth, seamless swimming. As you delve deeper into the depths of Ma'een, encounter more challenging environments and darker corruption.
A Light in the Darkness:
After Ma'een is corrupted, it's up to you to harness the power of the light to illuminate the dark ocean. Shield yourself from lurking dangers in the depths, and dispel dark entities to restore the ocean's radiance.
Solve Ancient Mysteries:
Decipher ancient relics and inscriptions, solve puzzles rooted in ancient ruins, and uncover the secrets of an old, forgotten kingdom.

70010000095999.name: Knight's Night!
70010000095999.intro: Free the kingdom as you master side-scrolling precision platforming stages in retro 1-bit style!
70010000095999.description:
The kingdom is in danger, and power has fallen into the hands of an evil wizard! Now it’s up to you to save the land from certain destruction. Run, jump, dash, avoid traps and hop on the heads of enemies as you explore forests, caves, perilous ruins and more. Knight’s Night! is a retro precision platformer presented in 1-bit black-and-white style, featuring fluid pixel art animation and super-tight controls.

As you make your way through 25 side-scrolling stages to reach the wizard’s castle, you’ll unlock new abilities to aid your journey. Carefully search for secret collectables, meet and converse with unique characters, use springboards to reach higher platforms and navigate mazelike underground tunnels. Can you restore peace and light to this world of darkness?

• Master 25 levels of precision platforming as a courageous knight!
• Journey to the evil wizard’s castle in hopes of saving the kingdom.
• Traverse dark forests, mazelike caverns and crumbled ruins.
• Gain new abilities like air dashes and double jumps.
• Explore to find hidden collectables and more.
• Enjoy old-school retro pixel art and fluid animation!

70010000096004.name: The Wizard of Bug
70010000096004.intro:
Unravel the labyrinth's mysteries with your wits as your weapon!
A novel and stimulating brain-bending puzzle adventure!
70010000096004.description:
In that moment you somehow are magically able to solve a seemingly impossible challenge...
A feeling of omnipotence washes over you, and you suddenly feel like you've become a great wizard!

Over 100 stages of puzzle after puzzle filled chambers that appear before you ceaselessly.
A novel puzzle game that anyone can have fun solving, but also makes anyone scratch their head and ponder!

[System]
Colored hearts rest above the heads of friends and foes alike.
Combine or push them away to defeat all the enemies and clear the stage!
Switch between our two heroines, Shirley and Ella, and use their unique skills to overcome the difficult challenges in store.

You needn't worry about difficult stages either.
The intuitive rewind system allows you to step back moves, and try them over and over again.

[Characters]
- Shirley Bancroft
A girl with an aptitude for magic. She has few emotional ups and downs and a naive side as well.
She also possesses the ability to see and manipulate the life force of her enemies.

- Ella
The 'beastfolk' warrior girl. She is bold, outspoken, and entirely fearless.
She cannot see or manipulate life force, but has the ability to change its color.

[Features]
- 100 puzzle stages in the primary game mode.
- 512 automatically generated stages that unlock after beating the game!
- Stage editor mode for making your own custom stages
- Game narrative and gameplay mechanics are cohesively integrated for an immersive story experience
- Hint system to help you clear any stages you may find tricky.
- Tons of hidden content to uncover
- Finally, the background of difficult stages are in black and white

70010000096024.name: Bag Hero
70010000096024.intro: Blast through monster hordes with crazy weapons in a wild bullet hell! It’s chaotic, casual, and seriously fun!
70010000096024.description:
Each run takes just 20–30 minutes — perfect for relaxing anytime! Whether you're unwinding after a long day or just killing time, it's a great way to de-stress.

Choose from 10 unique classes and 7 different weapons, then mix and match to create your own personalized combat style. Hidden classes and secret talents await discovery too!

Every playstyle offers a complete build path, with multiple branches and directions to explore.

Each stage comes with fully adjustable difficulty settings, so you'll always find the perfect level of challenge.

70010000096029.name: Pixel Game Maker Series GIRI Jump Extreme
70010000096029.intro:
Use Extreme Jump to get to the goal as fast as possible!
You can't afford to be off your guard for even a second in this high-speed jumping action!
70010000096029.description:
■Story
By chance, she saw information about limited edition sweets on a social networking site.
Giriko, a girl who loves sweets,

but this is a remote island, and it's the middle of nowhere!
Can she make it there before closing time with her dashing and jumping...
The battle to the very last minute has just begun.

■Game Overview
A side-scrolling jump action game with simple controls.
Your rank is determined by the time it takes you to clear each stage.
Aim for the highest rank of [S] in all stages.

You can run faster by obtaining speed-up items, but
in exchange the difficulty level will also increase.
Let's challenge the limits of speed while steadily progressing!
Can you keep up with this speed?

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.

70010000096034.name: Elemental Princesses: Super Magical Quest
70010000096034.intro: Five girls from different corners of the world discover that they possess the essence of the elements: Fire, Water, Earth, Air and Light.
70010000096034.description:
Five girls. Five elements. An unforgettable adventure.

Discover a magical visual novel filled with excitement, friendship, and a destiny to fulfill. Five girls from different parts of the world awaken to the power of the elements: Fire, Water, Earth, Air, and Light. Together, they will travel through spectacular settings filled with color and mystery, where they will meet wonderful characters and face challenges that will test their courage and unity.

· Vibrant Illustrations – Colorful backgrounds and expressive characters come to life in every scene.

· Enchanting Music – A magical soundtrack that will immerse you in this grand adventure.

· A Thrilling Story – Discover a tale filled with values, courage, and true friendship.

· Adorable Characters – Encounter many beautiful characters throughout the adventure that the girls must contend with.

· Explore, feel, and live in a magical world. The magic of the elements awaits!

70010000096036.name: The reunion: Rediscovering lost love
70010000096036.intro: A return to the past, two loves and a second chance: to rekindle love or to leave it behind? You decide the destiny.
70010000096036.description:
Returning home brings back memories, emotions and an unexpected opportunity to rewrite the past. After years away, the protagonist returns to his hometown and meets two women who marked his life. One was his first love, someone he believed was destined to be by his side forever. The other, a childhood friend, whose silent love never blossomed.

As she relives moments of yesterday, she also faces the changes that time has brought: friendships that evolved, wounds that still hurt, and feelings that never completely disappeared. Each decision will influence the course of her story.

Can lost love be reborn, or is it just an echo of the past? Discover a moving tale of nostalgia, romance and second chances, where every choice will define the future.

70010000096039.name: SUPER 56
70010000096039.intro: SUPER 56 challenges players to overcome 56 genre-bending mini-games with the press of a single button. Compete in daily challenges, earn achievements, and destroy high scores.
70010000096039.description:
WELCOME TO HELL
Eons ago, SUPER 56 was banned by the Government of Pain and all copies were buried in the Samsara Desert. Cartridges have now been spotted in independent gaming stores throughout Hell. Roommates Kronos and Brones secured their own copy of the game and challenged their neighbor to a high-scoring bet. But, it turns out they're pretty bad at video games. It’s up to you to achieve an S Rank and shut the pesky neighbor up once and for all.


2 - 8 Player COUCH MULTIPLAYER MODE
Challenge your friends in our new turn-based multiplayer mode! Configure stages and game rules, then jump into the action. hosting a party , this mode is sure to test the strength of your friendships.

WE ARE THE CHAMPIONS
Earn bragging rights as you compete for the top of the worldwide leaderboards. Even after you become a SUPER 56 legend, keep things fresh with Daily Challenges.

PUSH YOUR LIMITS
A wide range of difficulty levels designed for everyone from beginners to pros.Keep pushing your limits and striving for greatness in SUPER 56.



Key Features:
——56 genre-bending mini-games all designed around the press of a single button.
——Single player campaign.
——2-8 player couch co-op
——Easy to learn, yet hard to master gameplay.
——Unlockable Mod Stones to change the rules of each playthrough.
——Daily challenges and Trials add a new challenge to master.
——References, homages, and ridiculous humor centered around gaming history.
——Fully customizable experience with unlockable characters, voice packs, ludicrous phrases, and more.
——Awesome, genre-changing soundtrack.
——Achievements galore!

70010000096050.name: Hentai Puzzle: Cyber Girls
70010000096050.intro: Dive into the world of cyberpunk, enjoy the process and discover seductive illustrations!
70010000096050.description:
Welcome to the exciting world of classic puzzles, where charming girls in stylish, daring cyberpunk images are waiting for you! Each image is a skillful combination of futuristic surroundings, chrome details and seductive curves, drawn in a luxurious anime style.

Experience the pleasure of a realistic puzzle assembly process and step by step discover images of attractive beauties in the neon scenery of the cyberpunk world. Their bold outfits and provocative looks will not leave you indifferent.

Game features:

- More than 40 unique puzzles with charming cyberpunk girls.
- Realistic feeling of assembling a real paper puzzle.
- High-quality anime illustrations with detailed drawing.
- Relaxing, atmospheric music that enhances the immersion effect.
- Possibility to examine each image in detail after assembly.

Dive into the neon world of passion and technology, uncover the secrets of futuristic beauties and enjoy the aesthetics of cyberpunk!

70010000096054.name: Skydiving Simulator: Wingsuit Flight
70010000096054.intro: From sky to earth, the adventure never ends.
70010000096054.description:
Welcome to Skydiving Simulator: Wingsuit Flight, the ultimate adrenaline-fueled experience where every jump is a heartbeat away from glory. Strap into your wingsuit and leap from dizzying heights, carving through clouds and cliffs with unmatched precision.
Whether you’re soaring over snowy peaks, diving through urban canyons, or skimming across desert plateaus, the sky is your playground—and your challenge. 

What awaits you: 
	•	Master unique wingsuits – Each with distinct flight dynamics, designed for speed, agility, or control. 
	•	Choose your jump – Leap from hot air balloons, aircraft, or classic cliffside base jump points. 
	•	Survival challenges – Push your limits in heart-pounding situations, where your wingsuit is all you have to survive. 
	•	Daredevil gaps – Conquer narrow passages and tricky routes that will test your precision and courage. 
	•	Compete globally – Rise through the ranks as you challenge others for the top spots on leaderboards.

It’s not just a fall—it’s a flight. 
Are you ready to jump into the void and own the skies?

70010000096065.name: Monopoly: Star Wars™ Heroes vs. Villains
70010000096065.description:
Pre-order now and unlock two unique in-game dice skins inspired by iconic Star Wars characters: Jawa and Clone Trooper.

Assemble your team, build your roster of iconic Star Wars™ characters, and battle with your friends and family for control of the galaxy as you move across storied planets and locations.
Choose from a wide array of Star Wars heroes and villains, each with their own unique abilities. Whether you're teaming up with Luke Skywalker or unleashing Darth Vader, every match is packed with team strategy, surprises, and classic Star Wars moments. No two battles unfold the same way, the fate of your team is yours to shape!

STAR WARS MEETS MONOPOLY®
Step into the Star Wars galaxy with a bold new twist on MONOPOLY. Experience iconic cinematic moments while competing with family and friends across iconic locations from every era of the saga.

PLAY AS A TEAM, WIN AS A TEAM
Team up with your friends and family through online play or couch co-op and experience MONOPOLY like never before with 2v2 and 3v3 competitive game modes. With endless team compositions, the game transforms classic competition into a fun strategic showdown.

ASSEMBLE YOUR ICONIC STAR WARS TEAM
Each character brings distinct hero abilities, allowing you to shape your team’s composition and lead your team to victory. Command legends like Darth Maul and Princess Leia, each with game-changing skills that turn the tide in your favor.

COMMAND THE DICE, CONTROL THE BOARD
The game can change with every roll as properties change hands in an instant. Dynamic GO events unleash game-altering twists and shift momentum rapidly, making each turn critical and victory uncertain until the final turn.

A NEW ADVENTURE EVERY MATCH
With action-packed matches, evolving team strategies, and tons of unlockable cosmetics, no two games are exactly the same. Experiment with different heroes to assemble the perfect team. There's always a reason to jump back in for one more round.

70010000096070.name: CLAWPUNK
70010000096070.intro: Play as fierce feline heroes and battle villainous gangs to reclaim Feral City in this chaotic arcade adventure.
70010000096070.description:
Prepare yourself for the ultimate adrenaline rush with CLAWPUNK, a pulse-pounding, melee-focused 2D action game infused with roguelite elements and an array of badass cat characters. Tear through a fully destructible environment, where every smash and bash rewards your reactive and aggressive play style. Aim for the highest score possible by laying to waste everything in your path!

Embrace the non-stop, "push-forward" gameplay that CLAWPUNK thrives on. Aggressive players are handsomely rewarded with devastating abilities, and while melee combat is at the heart of the game, you'll also find an arsenal of ranged weapons to annihilate your foes and flaunt your power!

Choose from nine fierce cat characters, each boasting unique base stats, primary weapons, and powerful special attacks that recharge based on your performance (tracked by a combo counter). Roam through five distinct zones, the first four of which you can conquer in any order, each designed to challenge you with specific enemy types, from wide-open arenas for ranged combat to tight quarters for intense melee brawls.

KEY FEATURES:
SEMI-NON-LINEAR PROGRESSION: Battle through five level zones, with the freedom to tackle the first four in any order, all starting from a central hub level.

CHARACTER MANAGEMENT: Master nine unique cat characters, each with their own weapons and stats, to tailor your play style.

COLLECTABLE CARDS: Discover and collect special cards throughout your journey, permanently saving them to mutate and enhance your cats' abilities.

AGGRESSIVE GAMEPLAY: Dive into non-stop, push-forward combat that rewards daring players with powerful rage attacks for diving headfirst into the fray.

DESTRUCTIBLE ENVIRONMENT: Explore and defeat enemies creatively, or simply indulge in the sheer joy of destroying everything in sight!

CHALLENGING, YET ACCESSIBLE DIFFICULTY: Enjoy a scalable difficulty system that caters to both rookies and seasoned players seeking a formidable challenge.

80/90s RETRO THEME: Immerse yourself in a 1980/90s cyberpunk-inspired world, complete with a hard synth soundtrack, along with a pinch of metal, and gritty industrial/ambient soundscapes.

70010000096075.name: I Am Busy Digging a Hole
70010000096075.description:
"I Am Busy Digging a Hole" – and you'll be busy too! Grab your shovel and discover what treasures lie beneath the surface in this delightful digging adventure. The deeper you go, the more exciting your journey becomes.

Dig through layers of earth to find valuable ores that you can sell for upgrades. Make your shovel stronger and your backpack bigger as you continue your busy digging life. Along the way, uncover rare dragons and ancient coins hiding in the dirt.

Each dragon you rescue finds a home in your yard, creating a lively community above ground. And for those who dig deep enough, rumors of a mysterious cave dweller might lead to undiscovered worlds.

● Colorful Underground – Explore a vibrant world beneath your feet with surprises at every depth.

● Rewarding Progression – Sell ore, upgrade equipment, and watch your digging skills improve.

● Dragon Collection – Build a unique dragon sanctuary in your yard with each new discovery.

● Hidden Mysteries – Some secrets are buried deeper than others, waiting for the most determined diggers.

● Relaxing Experience – Get busy digging at your own pace in this charming underground adventure.

70010000096080.name: Backyard Baseball '97
70010000096080.description:
Relive the game that started it all! The original Backyard Baseball 1997 is now enhanced to run on Nintendo Switch™. Whether you're picking your dream team, hitting home runs, or just here for comedy, step back into the backyard and experience the game that made baseball fun for everyone!

Build your roster from the iconic cast of 30 characters stacked with charming personalities and witty banter, and get the edge on the competition with power-ups, fireball pitches, super strength, and Pablo Sanchez!

Play pick-up games, practice batting, and compete in single games or a whole season with simple, intuitive controls that anyone can master.

70010000096085.name: Viewfinder
70010000096085.intro: A mind-bending first person adventure game
70010000096085.description:
Challenge perception, redefine reality, and reshape the world around you with an instant camera. Viewfinder is a new single player game offering gamers hours of interesting and fun experiences while uncovering the mysteries left behind.

About the game

Viewfinder is a mind-bending first person adventure game in which you can bring pictures to life by placing them into the world. 

•	Reshape Reality. Beyond photographs, bring paintings, sketches, screenshots and postcards to life while reshaping the world

•	Exploration is learning, the player will learn the secrets of the world, the reason why it exists, and the freedom to create. Explore multiple hub worlds that are all cohesive and encompass similar, but complex, differences.

•	Experience as much as you want. Viewfinder’s Narrative is player driven and will be an approachable experience to someone who just wants to play and solve puzzles, and a rich well thought off world to a player who wants to learn more. 

•	Find the answer to the impossible, once you step in the world of Viewfinder.

70010000096090.name: Urban Showdown
70010000096090.intro: One city. One fighter. Too many problems.
70010000096090.description:
In Urban Showdown, fists do the talking and the streets don’t wait. Step into a pixel-punching brawl where every alley is a battlefield and every fight is personal.

No rules. No breaks. Just waves of angry dudes, trash cans full of surprises, and a city that wants you down. But you're not here to play fair — you're here to take the whole block back.

Ready to clean up the streets? Start swinging.

70010000096095.name: siMarket Cloth Store Simulator
70010000096095.intro: Build Miami’s hottest clothing store! Stock, sell & customize your shop, hire staff, and expand to fashion empire status. Will you dominate the beachside strip?
70010000096095.description:
Build Your Fashion Empire in Miami Beach!

Welcome to siMarket Cloth Store Simulator, where your journey from a small boutique to the most luxurious clothing store in Miami Beach begins! Set against the stunning backdrop of palm trees, golden sands, and a vibrant plaza, you’ll manage every aspect of your business—from stocking shelves to satisfying fashion-hungry customers.

Design, Stock & Sell
Arrange over 100+ stylish clothing items—dresses, crop tops, jackets, hats, and more—on shelves, hangers, or eye-catching mannequins. Adjust prices to maximize profits or attract more shoppers. Need space? Expand your storage to keep surplus stock and let your restocking team work efficiently.

Hire & Expand
Recruit cashiers to handle checkouts and restockers to keep your store in perfect shape. As you level up (all the way to level 50!), unlock new clothing options, expand your store, and add fitting rooms—because every customer wants to try before they buy!

Customize Your Dream Store
Make your shop stand out with wall paints, decorative flowers, couches, and stylish signs. Use mannequins to attract more buyers and create the trendiest spot on the strip.

Dynamic Miami Beach Atmosphere
Enjoy the serene yet lively Miami plaza, where the environment changes dynamically, immersing you in a beachside retail paradise.

Bonus Challenge: "Long Shift" Minigame
Test your endurance in this fast-paced minigame—how long can you keep up with the rush?

Will you build the ultimate fashion destination? Start your retail empire today!

70010000096100.name: Out of Moves
70010000096100.intro: Every step matters... Are you ready for the challenge?
70010000096100.description:
In a world of mysterious mazes, every move could mean the difference between glory and defeat. With limited moves, you must carefully plan each step to reach the jewel before time runs out. But beware! The path is filled with deadly dangers—sharp spikes, tricky arrows, and strategic teleporters that can either be your salvation or your downfall.

Each level presents a new mind-bending puzzle, testing your ability to think ahead and act fast. Can you outsmart the obstacles, master the mazes, and claim the ultimate treasure?

Think fast, strategize wisely, and conquer the challenge! Time is running out... Play now!

70010000096105.name: Mystic Pathways
70010000096105.intro: Unveil the Secrets of the Enchanted Paths
70010000096105.description:
Embark on a magical journey with Mystic Pathways, a puzzle game that challenges your logic and creativity. Manipulate enchanted trails on a beautifully designed hexagonal board to guide mystical fairies in collecting magical crystals and activating sacred altars.

Captivating Challenges: Explore intuitive mechanics that evolve in complexity, requiring strategic planning and clever solutions.

Hypnotic Environments: Discover breathtaking landscapes, from blooming meadows to enchanted forests and crystal caves, each introducing new challenges and special mechanics.

Immersive Sensory Experience: Let yourself be carried away by an ethereal soundtrack and stunning artistic design, making each level both relaxing and stimulating.

Thirty Levels to Explore: Test your skills through progressively more challenging stages, unlocking unique pieces and innovative mechanics along the way.

Whether you're a puzzle lover or a casual player looking for a magical experience, Mystic Pathways is sure to captivate your mind and soul.

Get ready to chart your path in the world of magic.

70010000096122.name: Where’s That Person?
70010000096122.intro:
Find the Right Person Before Time Runs Out!
A Fun and Cute Brain-Training Search Game
70010000096122.description:
This is a brain-training game where you look for a specific person hidden in a colorful crowd of characters—all within a time limit!

How to Play：
・Look closely at the picture of the target person.
・Search for them in the big illustration.
・Once you spot them, tap the right spot before time runs out!

It might seem easy at first, but with the timer ticking, it can get pretty tricky!
Don’t worry—you can retry as many times as you like if time runs out.

And if you get stuck, just press the hint button!
(It’ll show you the general area where the person is hiding.)

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000096130.name: Detective Girl: The Case of Immortality
70010000096130.intro: Return to Renaissance Florence and uncover an ancient secret of immortality.
70010000096130.description:
After a great war more than a decade ago, Europe lies in ruins, struggling to rebuild. In the heart of Florence, Italy, an ancient secret of immortality is buried deep within the city’s veins. A shadowy web spun over centuries, now slowly unraveling.

Is the fabled salvation a blessing... or a curse?

One day, you encounter a mysterious girl with snow-white hair and beauty eyes like a witch’s. From that moment, the gears of fate begin to turn.

70010000096138.name: Prince Of Wallachia
70010000096138.intro: Prince of Wallachia is a historical action platformer with atmospheric levels and historical characters
70010000096138.description:
On June 12, 1444, Vlad the Impaler and his brother Radu the Handsome went to the Turkish court as a guarantee of keeping peace between Wallachia and the Ottoman Empire.

The brothers made a plan to regain the throne of Wallachia and get rid of the Turks.

Radu the Handsome secretly wished to rule himself and betrayed his brother Vlad the Impaler, told everything about the plan to the Sultan of the Ottoman Empires.

The Sultan, in a rage, threw Vlad the Impaler in prison for the rest of his life.

Help Vlad the Impaler to escape from the prison, return the throne and become the Prince of Wallachia

Prince of Wallachia is a historical action platformer with atmospheric levels and historical characters

What awaits you...
- Epic Adventure
Go to on a medieval journey. Explore from the underground of Constantinople to the city and forests of Wallachia.
- Various enemies
The whole Ottoman Empire is against you with detachments of janissaries and sipahs.
- Interesting story
In the game Prince of Wallachia you will find nice and addictive gameplay , various puzzles and secret locations.
- Different ways to kill enemies

70010000096143.name: Cat&Rabbit Pizza Farming
70010000096143.intro: Welcome to your new life as the only pizza farmer-baker around!
70010000096143.description:
Key Gameplay Features:
- 50 levels of pizza-making fun (and you can keep going after that!)
- Play as a cat or a bunny – your bestie runs the market!
- Grow your own ingredients or buy them fresh
- Mix dough, chop toppings, bake pizzas, and race against the clock
- Randomly generated orders with tips, coins, and XP to earn
- Tons of upgrades: auto-watering, faster machines, more oven space, and more
- Max 4 orders at once – so stay sharp, chef!


In this cozy cooking game, you’ll grow ingredients, prep toppings, and serve up perfect pizzas. Pick your character (cat or bunny), and your fluffy friend will run the local market while you handle the hustle.


Each day starts slow – you can water crops, harvest goodies, slice toppings, or run to the market. But once the restaurant opens (whether you're ready or not), orders start rolling in fast! Mix dough, blend sauce, chop veggies, and get those pizzas in the oven before time runs out.


The more you play, the more upgrades you unlock – like faster machines, more ingredient storage, and ovens that bake three pizzas at once. Orders get bigger, days get busier, but with your upgraded kitchen, you’ll be tossing out masterpieces like a pro.

No rush though. Just don’t let the pizzas burn.

70010000096148.name: Strange Antiquities
70010000096148.description: Become the custodian of a store dealing in occult antiquities. Explore the quaint and gloomy town of Undermere, where strange goings-on and dark mysteries abound.
