Find and identify arcane artefacts, use your collection to aid the townsfolk with their unusual problems — and remember to pet your cat!

70010000096152.name: Ninja Fight
70010000096152.intro: Exciting fighting game in oriental style. Choose your character and go to fight!
70010000096152.description:
GAMEPLAY:
Ninja Fight – This is an exciting fighting game in Asian style. You alone must confront a whole crowd of villains and only your steel fists will help you win! Choose one of the available heroes and go into battle. Clear the entire street from bandits to complete the level.

FEATURES LIST:
- Spectacular combat system
- Bright oriental atmosphere
- Seven heroes to choose from
- Two levels are available in daytime, nighttime and sunset

70010000096157.name: Ascendant
70010000096157.intro: Defeat legendary abominations, build-craft unstoppable combinations of enchanted items, investigate an ancient evil, and ascend to freedom!
70010000096157.description:
Defeat legendary abominations, build-craft unstoppable combinations of enchanted items, investigate an ancient evil, and ascend to freedom!

Ascendant is a dungeon crawler with heavy Rogue-like elements. You will encounter 3 challenging biome specific enemies types as well as a new boss on every floor! Open soul chests to acquire items with magical attributes. Many of these items synergize with each other to create powerful combinations.

Key Features:
-3 Unique Biomes
-7 Bosses
-30 Enemy Types
-800+ Abilities & Items

70010000096162.name: Tales From The Arcade: Starship Murder
70010000096162.intro: Tales From The Arcade: Starship Murder is an experimental murder mystery roguelite in which the killer changes every time you play.
70010000096162.description:
Tales From The Arcade: Starship Murder is an experimental murder mystery roguelite in which the killer changes every time you play.

The astro hauler the SS Persephone is falling apart. You - the on-board AI - are being reactivated to perform the necessary repairs. The crew claims that the captain died in a mysterious accident, the same one that conveniently erased your memory banks. Who is telling the truth and who is just trying to buy time to finish the job they started? Welcome, to Starship Murder.

Features:
- Artificial Intelligence Perspective - become the AI of a starship.
- Experimental Gameplay - balance searching for the killer with repairing the ship.
- Digital Thriller - experience an atmosphere of tension and mistrust.

70010000096171.name: Off-the-Ground Survival
70010000096171.intro: Trapped on the top floor, 99 stories off the ground, you hope to reach the ground floor and escape. With limited food and supplies, find your exit and survive the apocalypse!
70010000096171.description:
“Off-the-Ground Survival” is a survival role-playing game.
One day, a lockdown was suddenly announced outside, and everyone had to return to their homes immediately. At the time, main character, Liam was busy decorating his new home on the 99th floor of the skyscraper.
What was thought to be a lockdown that would only last a few days slowly turned into full-time martial law that lasted more than a few weeks.
That the food at home had been eaten up. In addition, the building's electricity had recently started to have problems, and the broadcasting had stopped. Liam decided to go downstairs to the street to check the situation...


The player starts on the top 99/F of a high-rise building, starting with no weapon or food, and has to reach the ground floor. Unfortunately, the elevator in the building is not always available. Moreover, rooms and hallways are filled with different types of monsters. To survive, the player has to grab a weapon on the go, collect food to stay healthy, and loot items to solve different problems.

70010000096177.name: DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA
70010000096177.description:
The Dragon Ball franchise's first team-oriented battle begins!

◆ Intense 4 VS 4 team battle
Experience the world of Dragon Ball through wrecking the battlefield with your own strength, or by conquesting the enemy objective with your friends and allies.
The Hero characters you take in control will grown in strength as the round progress to give you a chance to obliterate enemy players and bosses alike.

◆ Heroes with roles
Pick heroes with unqiue abilities and skills to fulfill their roles.
- The simple but effective super aggressive damage role.
- The ever persistent tank role staying on the battlefield indefinitely.
- The technical role which excells in ally support or enemy disruption.

◆ Customization
From simple character aesthetic changes with skin items, to animation changes, express your love for the characters in your own way.
Acquire a wide variety of customization items such as entrance animations to special finisher animations.

*Internet connection required.
*This product is a multiplayer game that is played mainly through online matches between players. 
*Online matches allow you to play against players from all over the world. You will match with people whose network conditions are optimal for the region you play in.

70010000096185.name: ROAD59　-A Yakuza’s Last Stand-
70010000096185.intro: Set against a backdrop of towering skyscrapers, this visual novel weaves together the lives of 23 characters in a modern-day legend.
70010000096185.description:
Tenkai Ward, a city drenched in bloodshed. This place is home to the JINGI—yakuza warriors who wield supernatural powers.
Betrayal. And the code of honor.
Born as the heir to a crime syndicate, yet longing for an ordinary and peaceful life, the kind-hearted protagonist fights desperately to protect their loved ones.
Desire.

70010000096192.name: and Roger
70010000096192.intro: It was a morning like all others until she realized her dad wasn't home. In his place, a stranger who speaks nonsense and insists she takes her medicine. Who is he?
70010000096192.description:
Past a Trail of Delusions
and Roger is an interactive novel that lets you see through the protagonist's eyes—whether what she sees makes sense or not. It is comprised of three chapters and can be played in its entirety in about one hour.

Story
It's just another morning for this young girl. She wakes up and starts getting herself ready while shaking off the sleepiness like always. Except something, somehow, feels off.

When she steps into the living room, she expects to find her dad preparing for work. Instead, she finds a stranger sleeping on the couch.
The man wakes up, looks at the girl, and sighs. Ignoring her confusion, he mumbles to himself with a hint of sadness in his voice.

It's really time to get ready.

Scared, the girl runs. She must leave the house.
"She doesn't know who this man is or where her father has gone.

Walk alongside her on this twisting, twisted path and see where it will lead her."

70010000096202.name: Nullstar: Solus
70010000096202.description:
In the distant future, mankind has discovered volatile sources of near-infinite energy, known as Nullstars. These mysterious anomalies can power entire planets, but are ticking time bombs that can wipe out entire worlds if they go critical. To this end, mega-corporations hire teams of archivists to find traces of lost worlds, to scavenge for the valuable remains of their nullstar. You are a scav drone pilot, sent into the orbit of a crippled megastructure to retrieve the treasure buried within.

Nullstar: Solus is a precision platformer where speed is everything. Hurtle through the forgotten, overgrown chambers and corridors of a megastructure, facing perilous environments and ancient security protocols in search of priceless nullstar fragments for your corporate overlords.

70010000096207.name: WiZmans World Re;Try
70010000096207.intro: Harness your magic powers, absorb enemies, and evolve your three homunculi to triumph. It's a truly spellbinding adventure!
70010000096207.description:
ENTER THE DUNGEON
The city of Wizarest has been cut off from communication with the outside world. Those who have awakened have forgotten who they are, who their neighbors are, and live without any memories of their past. The only things they know are the dangers of the dungeons surrounding the city, the monsters that inhabit them, and the magic needed to counter them. The citizens have been trying to navigate the dungeons for years, but to no avail. Even after 100 years, no exit has been found. Now, a new wizard is heading into the dungeons to defy the monsters…

THE BATTLE SYSTEM
Welcome to WiZmans World Re;Try! This is a thrilling RPG adventure with a fantastic story that changes based on your choices, and a deep yet simple battle system. Make full use of the timeline above the screen to develop your strategy: read the enemy's HP, the attack order, everyone's status, and aim for the most effective way to win. Water is stronger than Fire, Fire is stronger than Wind, Wind is stronger than Earth, and Earth is stronger than Water. Keep this in mind and use the best attacks to counter the enemy. Don't forget to chain attacks to defeat enemies quickly!

MEET THE HOMUNCULI
At first glance, the homunculi of WiZmans World Re;Try look like fairies. They have the power to ease the souls of defeated monsters and can fuse with them through Anima Fusion. Thanks to Anima Fusion, they can inherit the stats, status effects, skills, and appearance of defeated monsters. Adopt stronger monster abilities, inherit skills, and create your own powerful guardian. With the homunculi at your side, you're never truly alone!

A CLASSIC FROM 2009
Jaleco, known for releasing games until 2000, launched this RPG classic on portable consoles in 2009. The game features well-drawn pixel graphics and a simple yet challenging difficulty level, earning high praise from RPG fans. In this remaster, the graphics have been enhanced, the BGM rearranged, new tracks added (all remade by soLi), and the UI and playability optimized. This is the ultimate version of WiZmans World, with all the charm of the original.

70010000096209.name: Hentai Puzzle: Volleyball Girls
70010000096209.intro: Dive into the game, enjoy the process and open hot illustrations of charming volleyball players!
70010000096209.description:
Welcome to the world of classic puzzles, where passionate, athletic and seductive girls fighting on the volleyball court are waiting for you! Dynamic poses and toned figures of anime beauties in tight sportswear are waiting for you.

Each image is made in a magnificent anime style, and the realistic assembly process will give you the feeling that you are assembling a real paper puzzle. With each level, you will open new images of attractive beauties!

Game features:

- More than 40 unique puzzles with charming volleyball players.
- Realistic feeling of assembling a real paper puzzle.
- High-quality anime illustrations with detailed drawing.
- Relaxing, atmospheric music that enhances the immersion effect.
- The ability to examine each image in detail after assembly.

70010000096223.name: Georgie-Yolkie 64 - The Furry Tale
70010000096223.intro: Let's tell an old tale anew, and go back to the good ol' days of gaming with a new classic, hack and slash adventure.
70010000096223.description:
Let's tell an old tale anew, and go back to the good ol' days of gaming with a new classic, hack and slash adventure. Upgrade Georgie & Yolkie's abilities and travel across 17 lovely lands and save Princess Tabitha from the clutches of the evil King Rattie! Lots of addictive swordplay and fun here!

Embark on a thrilling adventure across 17 immersive 3D levels! Battle scary Lions, Minions, Witches, Dragons, and the wicked King Rattie who has kidnapped Princess Tabitha and using her power for his own! Collect gold and fish, upgrade weapons, and use powerful items to become an unstoppable feline and bird duo!

Key Features

Dynamic Combat: Face clever, strategic enemies with fluid battle mechanics.

10+ Unique Foes: Challenge a variety of fierce opponents.

Character Customization: Personalize Georgie's gear and obtain upgrades

Bonus Challenges: Unlock all new stuff!

Replayability: Replay any level from the World Map and find alternative paths and hidden things!

Retro Style Polygons, effects, charming atmosphere and a return to great music!

Well scripted and dynamic boss fights!

Catch all the sheep that annoy you and force you to find new ways to continue on your way, push objects to make new platforms and avoid their pitfalls!

70010000096231.name: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon
70010000096231.description:
Race to victory through a mayhem-filled obstacle course of deadly traps you’ve built with friends while pulling off sick tricks!

Ultimate Sheep Raccoon is a bike-racing party game where you and your friends build a course of ramps, obstacles, and traps! Dodge hazards, do crazy tricks, and use power-ups to get ahead of the competition. Pedal to victory with up to 8 players locally, online, and cross-platform.

Bike to victory
Race to the finish on your bikes! With easy-to-pick-up and intuitive controls, everyone can play.

Power-ups
Stay ahead of the competition with power-ups! Lift off with the jetpack, glide safely over threats with the parachute, scatter opponents with bouncy mines or stop them in their tracks with honey traps.

Blocks and traps
Build the level together by adding rails, ramps, bouncy pads, speed zones, and other obstacles. Then amp up the difficulty with pendulums, spinning machinery, spikes, and laser-emitting TVs!

Sick tricks
Pull off tricks and do backflips and wheelies to rack up extra points!

Classic characters
Chicken, Horse, Sheep, and Raccoon return from Ultimate Chicken Horse! Plus a brand-new cast of barnyard buddies.

8-player support
Because 4 players weren’t enough!

Local, online and cross-platform multiplayer
Play together on all supported platforms.

Custom level editor & playlists
Build and share your own level designs. Create challenge levels where players compete for the best times, and put together level playlists for a campaign-like experience.

70010000096242.name: Arisen Force: Life Devotee
70010000096242.intro: A challenging action combat experience on Journey to the West with your companions!
70010000096242.description:
Dive into a challenging action RPG with stunning HD pixel art and stylish, fast-paced combat—experience Journey to the West like never before in a bold new reimagining of the legendary tale!

·Amazing New Content:
Meet a new playable character, master new skills, and wield a powerful new weapon—the Katana. Unlock hidden levels and items for even more diverse and dynamic battles.

·Engaging Battle: 
Experience high-octane, stylized action designed for maximum enjoyment and tactical depth. A variety of advanced combat techniques, including Evade, Charged Attacks, Block, Counter, Punish, Just Timing, Cancel, and Throw/Execute mechanics. 

·Seamless Blend of Scenery: Encounter a unique mix of classic gameplay elements and modern design, featuring challenging adversaries and ingenious level architecture.

·Intense and Challenging Boss: 
Fights Bosses feature multiple phases, counterattacks, and blocking mechanics, even perform devastating combo or fusion attacks. And be prepared—some battles involve more than one boss at a time!

70010000096250.name: EGGCONSOLE Manhattan Requiem: Angels Flying In The Dark PC-8801
70010000096250.intro:
A woman meets a mysterious death in Manhattan. 
Detective J.B. Harold begins his investigation with the help of his former partner, Jad Gregory.
70010000096250.description:
This title is a command-based adventure game originally released in Japan by Riverhill Soft in 1987.

This is a well-known mystery adventure game for PC. The standout feature is the sheer volume of data: during investigations, you can inquire about details such as names, occupations, family members, ages, blood types, and places of origin. This vast amount of information adds depth to the characters and setting, helping to build a realistic world. Even if you repeat the same command, you might trigger new developments. This combination of extensive data and mature atmosphere makes it noteworthy as one of the first truly adult-oriented games.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000096253.name: Teeny Tiny Trains
70010000096253.intro: Build, track, enjoy - be the conductor of your tiny toy world!
70010000096253.description:
Remember turning the living room into your own railway kingdom?

Experience a bit of that magic with Teeny Tiny Trains - Build tracks, flip switches, and dodge playful obstacles to guide your trains home.

Features:
- A cozy, diorama-style ambiance inspired by childhood spaces
- Thoughtful puzzles with relaxing vibes – no timers, just fun
- Unlockable toy trains to collect
- A retro-style arcade cabinet in-game with train-themed mini-games

70010000096260.name: Summer Games Challenge – Running
70010000096260.description:
Four fast-paced running disciplines, full of action!

Grab your trainers and set the track alight! Whether it's the 100-metre sprint, 400-metre endurance run, hurdle action or fast-paced relay duels – every second, every step, every jump counts here. Only those who react at lightning speed and demonstrate perfect technique will sprint to the top of the podium at the end!
Ideal for short matches, high tension and sporting fun with friends – alone or in multiplayer!

• Compete in four exciting disciplines: 100-metre run, 400-metre run, hurdle race, relay race
• Choose your favourite character and put together your team
• Play solo or locally with up to 4 people

70010000096262.name: Summer Games Challenge – Swimming
70010000096262.intro: On your blocks, get set, go!
70010000096262.description:
Exciting swimming duels for single players and teams!

Dive into fast-paced competitions! Choose your athlete, swim for the best times in freestyle or relay and challenge friends locally – or play solo against clever AI opponents. Perfect for a quick round in between!

• Choose your favourite character and put together your team
• Compete in two exciting swimming disciplines: freestyle and freestyle relay
• Play solo or locally with up to 4 people

70010000096264.name: Summer Games Challenge – Jumping & Shooting
70010000096264.intro: Four disciplines, one goal: higher, further, accuracy!
70010000096264.description:
Jumping & Shooting – Mini Sports Fun!

Throw yourself into sporting fun: In exciting competitions in the long jump, high jump, pole vault and archery, you'll need timing and precision. Whether alone or in a group of four, this game guarantees fast-paced duels and great fun in short sessions.

• Choose your favourite character and put together your team.
• Compete in four exciting sports disciplines: long jump, high jump, pole vault and archery.
• Play solo or locally with up to 4 people.

70010000096266.name: Summer Games Challenge – Throwing & Lifting
70010000096266.description:
Four disciplines, lots of muscles – and even more fun!

Grab a javelin, hammer, shot put or dumbbell and show what you're made of! Choose your favourite, put together your team and compete in action-packed mini competitions. Ideal for quick rounds – alone or with friends!

• Compete in four exciting sports disciplines: javelin, hammer throw, shot put, weightlifting
• Choose your favourite character and put together your team
• Play solo or locally with up to 4 people

70010000096268.name: Luna and the Crystal of Light
70010000096268.intro: A young fairy from Floralia, with the gift of speaking with animals, lives a tender magical adventure among forests, stars and friendship.
70010000096268.description:
What if a little fairy could save an entire kingdom?

A dark shadow wants to extinguish Aethereia's magic... but a brave fairy and her adorable friends won't let it!

In this visual novel, the protagonists will travel together through glittering forests, magical rivers, and castles filled with traps to find the powerful Light Crystal.

Help them on this grand adventure filled with music, spells, and charming characters!

Features

·An unforgettable story full of fantasy, emotion, and tenderness that will delight boys and girls.

·Magical backgrounds and immersive music transport you to a world of fairies, dragons, and spells.

·Adorable characters: a brave fairy, a wise owl, a tender dragon, and a mischievous elf.

·Discover enchanted forests, majestic mountains, and dark fortresses on a mission to save the light.

·A journey about friendship, courage, and magic that shines in every scene.

70010000096270.name: Monster Survivors
70010000096270.intro: Survive, adapt, and conquer in a world overrun by monstrous creatures!
70010000096270.description:
The world is overrun by terrifying creatures, and only the toughest will make it out alive! Battle endless waves of monsters, face massive bosses, and upgrade your survivors to become unstoppable.

Every run is a new challenge! Improve your stats, unleash devastating abilities, and buy epic artifacts as you carve your path through the apocalypse. 

Features:
- Non-Stop Action: Fight endless waves of monsters and test your survival skills
- Epic Boss Battles: Take on giant beasts and earn powerful rewards
- Survivor Upgrades: Unlock skills and level up your characters
- Ever-Changing Gameplay: No two runs are the same!
- Immersive Experience: Stunning visuals and intense sound effects

How long can you last before the monsters overwhelm you?

70010000096283.name: Mythmatch
70010000096283.intro: Merge items to build a town and challenge the Greek Gods in Mythmatch.
70010000096283.description:
Mythmatch is a narrative-rich, town-building merge game. By day, it's a cozy resource management game where Artemis works with the mortals to rebuild their town and recruit new villagers. But at night, she rises to Olympus to challenge her family in fast-paced arcade minigames to prove she deserves a place in the pantheon.

Features
- Satisfying match-3 gameplay
- Discover new items by merging and crafting
- Repair and expand a thriving community
- Challenge the gods in 4 unique minigames
- Play with a friend in Arcade Mode
- Heartfelt story about found family and belonging

70010000096290.name: Zoo Merge
70010000096290.description: Zoo Merge invites you into a vibrant animal world where combining creatures leads to wild surprises. Match identical animals to evolve them into new, adorable species – from tiny critters to majestic beasts. As your zoo grows, so does the challenge! Can you discover all the animals and build the ultimate merge-zoo paradise? With cozy visuals, catchy sounds, and a one-more-try feeling, this charming puzzle game is perfect for players of all ages who love animals and relaxing fun.

70010000096307.name: CRYKEN part3
70010000096307.intro:
Get the crystals!!
Play in split-screen multiplayer for 1-4 players!
30 stages in total. Normal and hard difficulty options avail
70010000096307.description:
The objective is to use jumps and dashes to get the crystals on the stage.
The stage is a 3D space with vertical, horizontal and depth. Gravity exists, and players control the player by moving forward, backward, left and right, and by jumping vertically to move the player, and aim for the crystal.

Features
・Clear the stage when you get the crystal!
・30 stages in total! There are stages 61 to 90.
・You can choose the difficulty level, and normal is relatively easy to clear. Hard mode is more difficult.
・Some stages have crystals that appear by collecting coins or cutting grass.
・You can get equipment! Get a new weapon, a katana!
・You can play split-screen with up to 4 people!
・Monsters appear!
・You can use items to use abilities!

Multiplayer
・You can cooperate or compete with everyone.
・Collect coins together,
・Cut grass together
・Clear the stage together.
・Defeat the enemy together!
・Be the first to get the crystal!

70010000096320.name: Date with a Serial Killer: A Love Story from a Horror Show Series
70010000096320.intro: Twelve prisoners. One single goal: seduce you, possess you… and break you.Unless you make them fall in love with you first.
70010000096320.description:
Silence swallows everything. Twelve inmates watch you from the shadows—beautiful, dangerous, and disturbingly captivating.
They are not looking for love… they are looking for control.

Their words feel like poisoned caresses, their gestures are traps disguised as desire.
Here, every glance can draw you closer… or drag you into their deadly game.

Will you become their confidant, their obsession... or their next victim?

Features
-12 dangerously irresistible minds — From the manipulator who weaves lies like silk to the sweet psychopath who loves without knowing how to stop destroying.

-Seduce or survive — Every word matters. Every silence screams. Play with their emotions… or fall into their trap.

-Limited time — The clock is ticking. Love them and you might survive… or be damned.

-Multiple endings — Romance, betrayal, death… or something far worse. Your fate is in your hands.

-Hidden secrets — Break through their masks and make them fall for you to unlock seductive illustrations revealing their most intimate—and twisted—side.


They are waiting.
And they won't give up.

Here, love is a weapon, passion is poison… and you are the perfect prey.

Dare to play.
But remember:
Sometimes, the one who swears eternal love
is the one digging your grave.

70010000096325.name: Aha! Spot the Change Brain Teaser
70010000096325.intro:
Can You Spot the Subtle Change in 20 Seconds?
A Fun Brain-Training “Aha!” Puzzle Game
70010000096325.description:
A seemingly ordinary photo from everyday life…
But look closely—something in the image will slowly change over 20 seconds.

When you spot the change, tap the spot!
This brain-training game offers simple controls and quick “Aha!” moments.

Think it’s too tricky? Don’t worry!
Just hit the hint button for a big clue that’ll help you out.

Play with your family, friends, or even your livestream viewers to see who can spot the change the fastest!
It’s perfect for a fun and lively challenge together.

Whether you’re confident in your observation skills or just starting out,
this game is a great way to casually boost your brainpower and sharpen your awareness!

70010000096330.name: Clash of Weirdos - Card Carnage
70010000096330.intro: Unleash chaos with crazy cards in epic weirdo battles!
70010000096330.description:
Step into the wonderfully weird world of Clash of Weirdos – Card Carnage, a strategic card and board game packed with chaotic fun and quirky charm! Build your dream deck from a wild cast of adorable, big-eyed weirdos—each with their own hilarious and powerful abilities. Engage in exciting tactical battles using an innovative and fun combat system that keeps every match fresh and thrilling.
Unlock booster packs filled with new heroes, and level them up by merging duplicates to unleash their full potential! From sneaky sloths to fire-breathing flamingos, your weirdos are ready to fight for victory! Explore unique worlds, each with its own arena and special gameplay twists that will test your strategy and creativity.
Whether you're a mastermind tactician or just here for the laughs, Clash of Weirdos – Card Carnage offers endless fun, strategic depth, and a colorful cast of characters you’ll fall in love with. The weirder, the better!

70010000096333.name: Gang Wars - Cards and Bullets
70010000096333.intro: Become an underworld mafia boss in fast, tactical card battles!
70010000096333.description:
Welcome to Gang Wars – Cards and Bullets, where crime, power, and strategy collide in a gritty card and board game set in the heart of a mafia-run city. Command a crew of dangerous gangsters or elite enforcers in fast-paced, tactical battles on the streets.
Choose from a deck of uniquely designed underworld characters—mob bosses, street thugs, snipers, medics, and more—each with distinct skills and directional attacks. Place them on the 3x3 grid to deal damage, heal allies, or unleash explosive effects as soon as they hit the board. Once placed, their effects activate, and they stay in play with their defense stats until taken down.
Collect new fighters from boosters, level them up by merging cards, and fine-tune your deck for maximum impact. Each new district brings a different battlefield that changes the rules and forces you to adapt your strategy. Fast, intense, and packed with gritty charm, Gang Wars – Cards and Bullets lets you rule the streets your way.

70010000096336.name: Tiny Titans - Card Rumble
70010000096336.intro: Exciting epic chibi heroes and fast, tactical card battles!
70010000096336.description:
Welcome to Tiny Titans – Card Rumble, where epic RPG battles meet adorable chibi charm! Step into a world of fast-paced strategy and build your ultimate deck of tiny heroes, each with unique powers and big personalities. Whether you prefer knights, mages, healers, or rogues—there’s a Titan for every playstyle.
Engage in exciting card-based battles on a 3x3 board, placing heroes that attack, heal, or unleash powerful effects the moment they’re played. Once activated, they stay on the field, holding the line with their defense stats as the rumble continues. Outmaneuver your foes with clever tactics, unleash combos, and turn the tide with the perfect placement.
Open boosters to collect new heroes, level up your favorites by merging, and craft the perfect strategy in the deck-building menu. Unlock new arenas across magical worlds that change how you play. Whether you're a tactical mastermind or just love cute chibi chaos, Tiny Titans – Card Rumble delivers epic fun in tiny form!

70010000096339.name: Date with a Psycho Killer Girl: A Love Story & Horror Show Series
70010000096339.intro:
Twelve prisoners. One single goal: seduce you, possess you… and break you.
Unless you make them fall in love with you first.
70010000096339.description:
Silence swallows everything.
Twelve female inmates watch you from the shadows—beautiful, dangerous, and disturbingly captivating.
They are not looking for love… they are looking for control.

Their words are poisoned caresses, their gestures, traps disguised as desire.
Here, every glance can draw you closer… or drag you into their deadly game.

Will you become their confidant, their obsession… or their next victim?

Features
-12 dangerously irresistible minds — From the manipulative temptress who spins lies like silk, to the sweet psychopath who loves without knowing how to stop destroying.

-Seduce or survive — Every word matters. Every silence screams. Play with their emotions… or fall into their trap.

-Limited time — The clock is ticking. Love them and you might survive… or be damned.

-Multiple endings — Romance, betrayal, death… or something far worse. Your fate is in your hands.

-Hidden secrets — Break through their masks and make them fall for you to unlock seductive illustrations revealing their most intimate—and twisted—side.



They are waiting.
And they won't give up.

Here, love is a weapon, passion is poison… and you are the perfect prey.

Dare to play.
But remember:
Sometimes, the one who swears eternal love
is the one digging your grave.

70010000096349.name: Mad Skills BMX 2
70010000096349.intro: Fast BMX racing, cool stunts, and fun with friends!
70010000096349.description:
Mad Skills BMX 2 is a fast side-scrolling racing game for BMX fans and arcade lovers. Race on hand-made tracks, do tricks, and beat tough bosses. Unlock bikes, customize your rider, and play with friends in local versus mode.

Key Features:

- Realistic racing with arcade-style fun
- 7 bikes to unlock and upgrade
- Customize your rider with cool gear
- Dozens of fun and challenging tracks
- Local versus mode for two players
- Boss battles with special rewards

70010000096351.name: Cosmic Arcade Tycoon
70010000096351.intro: A cozy sci-fi arcade sim where you build, customize, unlock, expand and welcome cute alien visitors!
70010000096351.description:
Build your dream arcade at your own pace. No pressure, no deadlines, just a cozy space to fill with games, decorations, warm neon lights and a bite-sized playthrough duration. 

Create
Design your arcade from the ground up, shaping its layout while choosing from a handful of structures, furniture, decoration and arcade machines.


Unlock
Use your Computer to unlock new objects, expand your land and customize your character.


Enjoy
Invite charming, randomly generated alien guests and watch them spend time in your creation.


Are you ready to bring your dream arcade to life?

70010000096356.name: Legend of Kaito - Destiny Journey
70010000096356.intro: Every legend begins with a lost soul.
70010000096356.description:
A soul divided. A destiny reborn.When Kaito, a modern-day student, awakens in feudal Japan, he must battle through a realm of demons, secrets, and forgotten gods to reclaim the fragments of his lost soul. Each fight brings him closer to the truth — and deeper into the darkness of his past.

Key Features:

- Immersive Adventure: Explore ancient villages, sacred temples, and mysterious forests filled with danger and secrets.
- Fast-Paced Combat: Combine sword strikes, ranged attacks, and elemental magic in fluid, strategic battles.
- Puzzle Exploration: Unlock hidden paths and ancient mechanisms to advance your quest.
- Skill Progression: Earn experience to develop Kaito’s abilities and discover new powers.
- Rich Narrative: Make choices that shape the outcome of Kaito’s journey and reveal the truth behind his destiny.

Lost between two worlds, Kaito, an ordinary student from the modern era, awakens in a mysterious version of feudal Japan filled with ancient spirits, cursed relics, and dark forces.
Legend of Kaito – Destiny Journey blends action, exploration, and myth into a cinematic adventure where courage defines fate.

70010000096361.name: Asfalia: The Cranky Volcano
70010000096361.intro: An eruptive journey full of wonder, magic and laughter.
70010000096361.description:
In this moving and whimsical adventure game, explore Asfalia, a magical world threatened by a volcano. Join Charlie as you meet amazing characters, solve fun puzzles, and collect beautiful stickers along the way! A captivating story-driven game suitable for all ages.

Asfalia is the perfect adventure game for children, designed to be accessible, fun and cozy. A perfect family-friendly moment to live together.

Featuring:
* A grand adventure within a world sculpted by Charlie's emotions.
* Professionally voiced English dialogues.
* Beautiful hand-painted 2D graphics.
* A grumpy volcano on the verge of blowing up.
* Over 20 memorable characters to meet and help out.
* More than 50 beautiful collectible stickers.
* A dozen locations brimming with adventure and mystery.
* Hidden mini-games and interactions.

The puzzles are fun and easy to solve, the controls are intuitive, making the game easy to pick up and play. 

Play on the television or handheld. With the Joy-Con™ controllers or with the touch screen. On the road or at home. Alone or in the company of friends and family.

In short, Asfalia is a world full of endearing and funny characters, with a captivating narrative.

A vibrant world is calling you...

Let's go to Asfalia!

70010000096363.name: Asfalia: Panic at the Mansion
70010000096363.intro: A thrilling adventure in the whimsical and wonderful wold of Asfalia.
70010000096363.description:
The sequel to Asfalia: The Cranky Volcano is out. Bigger, better and outrageously fun.

A spooky shadow is on the loose within Asfalia. Join Charlie and flamboyant sidekick Lilly in their search of four adorable missing puppies. Meet amazing characters, solve fun puzzles, and collect beautiful stickers along the way! Chase the shadows away in a captivating story-driven game suitable for all ages.

Asfalia is the perfect adventure game for children, designed to be accessible, fun and cozy. A perfect family-friendly moment to live together.

Featuring:

- A grand adventure within a world sculpted by Charlie's emotions.
- A world brimming with adventure and mystery.
- Professionally voiced English dialogues.
- Beautiful hand-painted 2D graphics.
- Four adorable puppies to rescue.
- A fiery flamboyant sidekick.
- An intriguing werewolf.
- A spooky shadow thingie.
- Dozens of memorable characters to meet and help out.
- Beautiful collectible stickers.
- Hidden mini-games and interactions.

The puzzles are fun and easy to solve, the controls are intuitive, making the game easy to pick up and play.

Play on the television or handheld. With the Joy-Con™ controllers or with the touch screen. On the road or at home. Alone or in the company of friends and family.

In short, Asfalia is a world full of endearing and funny characters, with a captivating narrative.

A vibrant world is calling you...

Let's go to Asfalia!

70010000096366.name: Terrifier: The ARTcade game
70010000096366.intro: Terrifier: The ARTcade Game, a bloody retro-style beat 'em up packed with frantic action, tons of fun, and plenty of references to the Terrifier franchise.
70010000096366.description:
Step into a world of pixelated carnage with Terrifier: The ARTcade Game, a gory retro fighting beat 'em up packed with intense action, dark humor, and tons of fun! Inspired by the classic beat 'em up games of the 80s and 90s.

RETRO-INSPIRED CARNAGE
Become Art The Clown, the sinister and unpredictable villain from the Terrifier series, as you unleash chaos across a variety of locations. Each stage is a movie set where a film about Art is being produced, but you're here to disrupt the show!

FEATURES TO DIE FOR
Gorgeous Pixel Art & Animation: The game captures the essence of the Terrifier films with bright, cartoonish pixel art and fluid animations that vividly depict the gruesome action.

Multiplayer Mayhem: Team up with up to 4 players for a chaotic local co-op experience. Work together—or against each other—in various game modes.

Bloody Arsenal of Weapons: From chainsaws to cleavers, pick up a variety of weapons to turn your enemies into bloody pulp.

Diverse Stages & Boss Battles: Travel through multiple stages, each with different paths to explore and enemies to defeat. Prepare yourself for intense boss battles that will test your skills.

Chiptune Soundtrack: Relive the golden age of gaming with a glorious chiptune soundtrack that perfectly complements the retro aesthetic.

Over-the-Top Attacks & Finishers: Enjoy hilarious and gory attacks that make every fight as entertaining as it is brutal. The finishing moves are guaranteed to leave a gory delight impression!

Multiple Game Modes: With 6 different game modes, whether you're looking for a quick beat 'em up session or an extended challenge, there's a mode that fits your style. 

Are you ready to embrace the madness and become the ultimate terror? Jump into Terrifier: The ARTcade Game, and let the carnage begin!

70010000096371.name: Debug Deadline
70010000096371.intro: The main character is hired as a debugger at the game company “Dokidoki Games”! With a time limit of one week, will he be able to find the bug safely?
70010000096371.description:
This is a first-person horror comedy game set in a Japanese debugging company.
The player takes on the role of a part-time worker at a debugging company, tasked with testing a horror game brimming with terrifying elements.
When you encounter suspicious objects or systems that don’t seem to belong in a horror game, report them as bugs immediately!
Your intuition, powers of observation, and gaming sense will be the keys to uncovering hidden bugs!

The debugging work with fate on the line begins now!

70010000096395.name: SUSHI vs BURGER Race
70010000096395.intro:
It's time for a gourmet race battle like no other!
Who will claim the top spot: Sushi or Burger?
70010000096395.description:
The worlds of SUSHI Race and BURGER Race collide!
Up to 4 players can race together in local multiplayer by sharing Joy-Con™!

Test out 22 different machines, each with its own characteristics!
Pick your favorite and enjoy high-speed racing battles!

In addition to brand-new courses, you'll also find some classic racetracks!
Aim for top speed as you race through each thrilling, action-packed course!

A brand-new game mode makes its debut: Team Battles!
Work with your teammates, use items strategically, and defeat the opposing team!

【Time Attack】
Choose a course and record your best time!
Compete with players from around the world in online rankings!

【Free Race】
Choose a course to run with friends and CPUs!
With items and special events, the racing experience is totally different from Time Attack!

【Grand Prix】
Run through several courses of your choice in order!
Accumulate wins and become the grand champion!

【Team Battle】
Choose a side: Sushi or Burger, and let the heated battle begin!
The winner is determined by each team's total points!

Enjoy playing with up to 4 players!
Challenge friends and family for 1st place and have fun!

70010000096400.name: BMX CITY RUN
70010000096400.intro: Every bike is a new Adventure. Every stunt a step to glory.
70010000096400.description:
Embark on an exciting journey where you’ll explore diverse and thrilling locations on your trusty bike, performing amazing stunts and pushing your limits. In each mission, you’ll earn points by pulling off daring tricks, which can be used to unlock new bike models with unique designs and characteristics.

Choose your character and customize their outfit to match your style. Personalize your bike as well — from colors to parts — and stand out in every ride. Whether you’re navigating an urban landscape, an amusement theme park, or even a hazardous radioactive zone, each location offers a fresh adventure filled with challenges and excitement. Expand your capabilities, show off your skills, and leave your mark in the world of extreme cycling. Are you ready to pedal your way to fame?

Key Features:
- Single Player Mode: Take on the adventure solo and enjoy exploring the wide variety of locations.
- Unique Locations: Each environment has its own design, offering a different experience — from city streets and public parks to rooftops and more unexpected terrains.
- Customization: Select your character, choose their clothes, and customize your bike to suit your preferences.
- Physics: Realistic cycling physics demand a perfect balance between speed and control to prevent falls and injuries.
- Store: Spend your stunt-earned points to unlock and try out different bikes, each with its own feel and performance.
- Missions: Every location features a set of missions that challenge you to perform, explore, and earn rewards.

70010000096405.name: There's No Easter Eggs
70010000096405.intro: There's no Easter eggs is a casual hidden object game with over 500 Easter eggs to find.
70010000096405.description:
There's No Easter eggs! Totally and absolutely! Actually, chocolate is bad for you so you definitely don't want to be looking for them eggs all around 9 unique maps!

There's No Easter eggs is a casual hidden object game with over 500 Easter eggs to find. Can you catch them all?

70010000096410.name: Animal Quest: The Battle for Green Hollow
70010000096410.intro: In a magical forest, a little deer and his friends live happily... until a strange darkness arrives to change everything. A story of love, friendship, and hope.
70010000096410.description:
Join Finn, a brave little deer, and his friends in this beautiful visual novel!

Everything was peaceful and games with his friends... until the enormous panther Suna appears, who wants to take over the forest. Finn isn't the strongest, but with the help of his friends, the magic of the forest and his big heart, he will show that even the little ones can be great heroes.

Meet Finn's best friends.
Together they make an unforgettable team on this magical adventure!

· Bounce, the bouncy and mischievous rabbit, always ready for a race or a funny prank.

· Flora, the wise and serene skunk, who knows all the secrets of the forest.

· Nutz, the fastest squirrel in Green Hollow, curious and brave as ever.

Together they make an unforgettable team on this magical adventure!

What you'll find in this charming story:

· Magical, colorful backgrounds

· Lots of adorable and playful animals

· A beautiful story about friendship and courage

· Soft, enchanting music accompanies the adventure

70010000096412.name: School Photo Transformer 美少女スナップ！メタモル写真クラブ
70010000096412.intro: Koichi, who has gained the ability to transform, creates a special graduation album as part of the photography club...!
70010000096412.description:
◆Story
Koichi, who loves taking photos, is unfortunately involved in a traffic accident on the day of his school's entrance ceremony.
When he wakes up in the hospital, he encounters a mysterious mushroom(?) that calls itself a yokai and gains the ability to transform.

After being discharged from the hospital, Koichi unknowingly gets appointed as the school photographer. He then establishes a photography club and begins capturing the school's events.

Thinking that simply taking photos would be boring, Koichi decides to use his transformation ability...
He attempts to take photos from places that would normally be impossible to access, but his transformations often wear off at the worst moments, leaving him to flee naked causing nothing but trouble.

Suspicious gazes watching his every move… and even assassins from the underground student council
Thus begins Koichi and the mischievous yokai’s ridiculous, tag-team school life!


◆Characters
・Rina Kusunoki
A responsible and caring childhood friend.
She has been taking care of Koichi, who has been full of mischievous thoughts since childhood.
She performs fairly well in both academics and sports and is dedicated to volleyball.

・Iori Mitsumine
A serious and well-behaved student, but an inflexible disciplinary committee member from the neighboring class.
She often clashes with Koichi, who is a troublemaker.
Busy with committee duties, she is not part of any club.

・Mayu Watarase
A bright, energetic, and athletically gifted second-year student.
She is a member of the student council and enjoys teasing Koichi as a hobby.
She has a strong aversion to studying and is on the verge of repeating a year.

・Yuzuha Shinomori
A calm and graceful third-year student with a traditional Japanese beauty, serving as the student council president.
She finds Koichi amusing, approving the establishment of the photography club.
However, to those close to her, like Mayu, she has a terrifying side that can silence them with a single word.

・Koichi Osaka
The protagonist, whose hobby is photography.
After being in a traffic accident, he gains the ability to see yokai and acquires transformation powers.
He has some skill in photography, having won an award in a competition.

70010000096417.name: Dungeon Slide
70010000096417.intro: "DUNGEON SLIDE" is a puzzle game where you move the protagonist in four directions to collect gems and escape the dungeon.
70010000096417.description:
While the controls are simple—just move the protagonist up, down, left, or right—the character slides in the chosen direction and won't stop until hitting an obstacle.

If you don’t plan your route carefully, you might overshoot paths and never reach the exit…

Guide the protagonist by cleverly using walls, doors, various gimmicks, traps, and even enemies to collect gems and find the exit.

Achieve perfection by collecting all the gems, defeating all enemies, and reaching the exit!

A simple yet deeply strategic dungeon exploration puzzle game—that's "DUNGEON SLIDE."

70010000096420.name: Animal Friends: The Secret Egg
70010000096420.intro: Deep in the forest, some little dragon friends discover a mysterious egg hidden among the leaves. Who could be inside?
70010000096420.description:
A magical visual novel set deep in the forest

One day, in a sparkling, hidden corner of the forest, some little dragons found something very special:
a mysterious egg, hidden among the leaves and surrounded by golden sparkles!

Intrigued, excited, and a little nervous, they decided to do something very brave:
Take care of it and protect it with all their hearts.
They knew that inside that egg could be a unique, perhaps even magical, creature!

While waiting for it to hatch, they lived an unforgettable adventure, filled with:

·Fun challenges: like building a warm nest with soft leaves and stray feathers.

·Laughable moments: when they tried to sing a lullaby to the egg, they sounded just like a frog!

·Many questions: What if what's born doesn't look like any of them? What if it doesn't love them?

But the most important thing they learned was this:

·What unites us is not how we look on the outside, but what we choose to nurture with love.

Finally, one day... the egg broke with a tiny crack!
And out came an adorable creature: a fluffy duckling!
It wasn't a dragon like them, but that didn't matter.
To them, it was already part of their family.

70010000096427.name: Airport Police Contraband Simulator - Border Patrol
70010000096427.intro: Protect the airport, stop the smugglers.
70010000096427.description:
Airport Contraband Police puts you on the front lines against illegal smuggling at an international airport. As a police officer, you ensure security and prevent contraband from crossing borders.

Missions and Challenges: Uncover illegal schemes through covert searches, passenger interrogations, and luggage checks. Solve puzzles to find hidden items. Each mission grows more difficult, requiring sharp observation and professionalism.

Diverse Equipment: Use advanced tools like X-ray scanners, night vision cameras, metal detectors, and police dogs to detect contraband and protect the airport.

Character Development: Level up to unlock new skills and gear, becoming an expert in contraband detection. Achievements grant bonuses and unlock tougher missions.

A Variety of Contraband Goods: Find drugs, weapons, smuggled animals, counterfeit documents, and more hidden in luggage compartments, clothing, containers, or even inside live couriers.

Difficulty and Dynamics: From simple inspections to complex operations, the game challenges you with timed missions demanding quick decisions and action.

Prepare yourself for an intense and immersive experience where every detail matters in keeping the airport safe.

70010000096442.name: Scott Whiskers: the Search for the Golden Cat
70010000096442.intro: Join Scott Whiskers on his new adventure and plunge into a colorful and family-friendly experience in a class of its own!
70010000096442.description:
Sun, beach and sea - sunken pirate treasures, mystical Mayan rites, a bubbling volcano - and lots of puzzles and lovable characters make for the vacation of a lifetime!

A small village deep in the Central American jungle is in need of our intrepid vacationer's help. His experience in finding missing pussycats could prove invaluable! After all, Santo Toma's sacred relic - a golden cat - has been shattered by lightning and Scott is racing against time to find its golden twin. Time that the village, now plagued by misfortune and failed harvests, barely has.

Visit all kinds of varied locations peppered with secrets. Meet interesting and multi-layered characters, complete challenging tasks and witness an exciting, tongue-in-cheek story about exotic monster fleas, sunken Mayan ruins and the question of how long you can hold your breath under water.

Around 50 lovingly drawn, high-resolution locations ensure a colorful and varied journey. Dive down to sunken pirate ships, explore the claustrophobic cave system of an active volcano and admire the beauty of a long-forgotten, ancient Mayan village.

Scott Whiskers: the Search for the Golden Cat is a classic point & click adventure game - but with an audiovisual update. As a fan of the classics of the genre, you will have just as much fun as a genre newcomer with a penchant for exciting stories.

In detail:
- The next big adventure from our missing cat specialist: Scott Whiskers
- Dozens of colorful, high-resolution HD backgrounds
- Lots of likeable characters, all with their own worries and desires
- Many, many challenging puzzles, always solvable with logical and “around the corner” thinking
- Subtitles and professional voice-over in English and German
- Hotspot display
- In-game journal

70010000096444.name: Max Cyber Shooter
70010000096444.intro: One city. One detective. No mercy.
70010000096444.description:
Step into the neon-lit shadows of a futuristic metropolis and become Kayne—a hardened detective on a mission for revenge. 

Explore the neon-lit alleys of Neon City, where violence, betrayal, and lies wait around every corner. From third-person perspective, use your sharp reflexes and bullet-time mechanics to dominate cinematic combat encounters. 
As you dig deeper, uncover a dark conspiracy that reaches the highest levels of power.

In a world where trust is rare and every decision shapes your path, Kayne must navigate a maze of manipulation, face powerful enemies, and confront a past that refuses to stay buried.

Key Features:

- Bullet-Time Combat – Execute enemies with slow-motion precision in intense, cinematic shootouts.

 - Dark Conspiracy– Uncover a network of corruption that reaches the highest levels of power.

- Futuristic Exploration – Traverse vibrant cityscapes, shadowy corridors, and high-tech hideouts.

- Cyber-Noir Atmosphere – Immerse yourself in a stylish, neon-drenched world with atmospheric soundscapes.

In Neon City, revenge isn’t just a motive—it’s a way of life. Prepare to face the truth, no matter the cost, in Max Cyber Shooter.

70010000096449.name: Trainlax
70010000096449.description:
Forget everything you know about stressful strategy games - Trainlax reinvents the transport simulation genre as a deeply relaxing yet intellectually satisfying puzzle experience. Where traditional train games bombard you with spreadsheets and micromanagement, we've created a zen garden of railway engineering that calms your mind while engaging your problem-solving skills.

Features:

- Smart Route Crafting: 120+ logic challenges that progress from soothing to delightfully complex
- Living Environments: Watch your networks spark village growth and dynamic weather
- Soundscape: A calming, instrumental soundtrack adapts to your progress, enhancing concentration
- Secret Routes: Hidden shortcuts reward patient builders.

Whether you have 5 minutes or 5 hours, Trainlax adapts to your schedule and mood, offering the perfect balance of mental stimulation and relaxation. If you're tired of reaching the heights of gaming, we've found a haven for you.

70010000096454.name: LEGO® Party!
70010000096454.intro: A party game that’s built different!
70010000096454.description:
LEGO® Party! is a 4-player party game that’s built different!

Compete against your friends in wacky Challenge Zones and 60 hilarious minigames from across your favorite LEGO sets like LEGO Pirates, LEGO Space, LEGO NINJAGO® and more.

Join your friends online no matter their platform, or get together for a LEGO Party game night. With multiple game modes and tons of minifigures to unlock, you’ll have all the bricks to build the ultimate party!

Challenge players near or far, customize your character and compete in a variety of awesome minigames to get as many Golden Bricks as you can, by any means necessary! But beware, watch out for monsters, traps and flying roast turkeys on your way to become the next star of LEGO Party!

Play your way:
Bring your friends and enjoy the mayhem in couch multiplayer or with cross-platform online multiplayer for up to 4 players. Whether it's competing for the perfect score in Rocketball, practicing against that pesky kraken in Kraken Up or boogieing down in Dance Off, you can enjoy LEGO Party! together or solo!

Go for the gold:
In LEGO Party! you have one goal: to become the player with the most Golden Bricks! Use power-ups to gain the advantage and set up traps to sabotage your opponents across a range of customizable LEGO themed Challenge Zones.

Everything is awesome:
Put your speed, wits, and LEGO expertise to the test across a variety of crazy minigames. Race to make dinner for aliens, run through collapsing tombs and skid round the track in rally races and so much more across 60 different wildly fun minigames. 

You do you:
With over 1 billion minifigure combinations from iconic LEGO sets, you can go with a classic look or design your own unique and outlandish minifigure. Show off your creation at the next party!

70010000096459.name: Puzzle Quest: Immortal Edition
70010000096459.intro: Test your match 3 skills as you battle to save the kingdom of Etheria
70010000096459.description:
The original Match-3 RPG is back! Puzzle Quest: Immortal Edition is the definitive Puzzle Quest, polished for a new era and featuring all the collected content from almost 20 years of history. Experience the original Puzzle Quest: Challenge of Warlords, Revenge of the Plague Lord, and The Legend Returns all together.

Puzzle Quest: Immortal Edition combines the classic Match-3 puzzle game with deep level role playing. Match 3 or more gems of the same color in a row to gain mana used to cast spells, battle opponents, collect items and rewards, and advance in the quests!

- Create a Hero who gains skills and spells
- Match-3 Battles with varied opponents requiring different strategies
- Complete Quests and Side Quests
- Meet Companions who will aide you
- Learn Spells and collect Items
- Build your Citadel – add buildings that grant you special powers
- Capture creatures, use them as Mounts and train them
- Capture monsters and play the research mini-game to learn their spells
- Discover hidden Runes and create magical items in your Citadel Forge
- Siege Cities around Etheria to expand your dominion

Are you up to the challenge? Test your match 3 skills as you battle against monsters and villains to save the kingdom of Etheria.

70010000096463.name: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000096463.intro: Battle corrupted monsters, rebuild seasonal farms and villages, and form bonds with the colorful locals along the way.
70010000096463.description:
Choose from one of two protagonists whose destinies are intertwined by mysterious forces. Use sacred treasures to fight against the Blight’s many forms to restore the people, and even gods, to their natural glory. Take farming further, as you’ll manage more than a plot, rebuilding entire villages and cultivating new allies and resources along the way. Explore seasonal-themed villages heavily inspired by traditional Japanese culture, each with brand-new festivals and revamped fan-favorites, as well as charming romance candidates.

Key Features

■Bold New Abilities and Weapons
As an Earth Dancer, use the power of dance, sacred treasures, and fresh weapons like the Bow and Talisman to purify the land, your farms, and undo the Blight’s damage.

■It Takes a Village
Don’t just mind the farm—rebuild entire villages! Construct and place buildings, enticing people to return to the villages and contribute. Revive the gods to bring vitality and valuable resources back to the plagued lands.

■Your Fantasy Japanese Life
Experience beautiful Japanese-inspired character designs and aesthetics—from festivals to events to monsters. Explore Azuma’s natural landscapes and its seasonal-themed locales steeped in tradition.

■Classic Romance and Relationships
Choose between male and female protagonists, then befriend or romance any of the eligible candidates in fully voiced scenarios. Recruit these new friends to aid you in battle, too!

*Those playing on Nintendo Switch™ 2 will experience the title in a higher resolution with improved frame rates, along with Joy-Con™ 2 mouse controls.
*Features and content of Nintendo Switch 2 Edition games can only be played on Nintendo Switch 2.

70010000096464.name: Power Sink
70010000096464.intro: Descend into the ruins of a submerged power plant, where flickering lights and corroded machinery guard long-buried secrets.
70010000096464.description:
Restore power, uncover the past, and navigate the depths—but beware what lurks below.

DIVE DEEP, AND POWER THROUGH

Welcome to the world of Power Sink, where life once thrived in a vibrant underwater colony—until everything went dark. As the Diver, it’s up to you to descend into the depths, restore power, and reconnect your community to the long-forgotten station below.

Navigate aging structures, repair failing platforms, and uncover what led to the sudden collapse of the world above. The deeper you go, the more the station’s past—and its purpose—begins to surface.

Explore and repair the station before your home falls into ruin.

FEATURES & MECHANICS

Logic-based Circuitry Puzzles

Every puzzle is a circuit waiting to be solved. Switch connections, complete pathways, and restore power by interacting with different components in clever ways. The deeper you go, the trickier the puzzles become.

Classic Platforming Goodness

Run, jump, and navigate the submerged ruins with fluid, satisfying movement, balancing precision platforming with puzzle-solving.

Diverse Aquatic Atmospheres

From faded steel corridors to glowing depths alive with energy, 6 biomes guide your descent. The station’s architecture grows more intricate, its colors more vibrant, and the surrounding marine life more varied as you restore power and uncover its secrets.

A Descent into Mystery

Your mission begins where the power failed. Fellow Tidekeepers instruct and guide you, their voices familiar in the depths. The station’s story begins with a blackout and ends with a choice only you can make.

Immersive Soundscape & Original Tunes

The station comes alive with creaks, groans, and echoes of the deep, accompanied by an atmospheric, handcrafted soundtrack designed to pull you further into the abyss.

70010000096466.name: NekoNeko Girls
70010000096466.intro:
Many cute NekoNekoGirls appear!
An easy puzzle game anyone can play!
70010000096466.description:
Collect pieces of the cute NekoNekoGirls and complete the puzzle!
Clear stages to see high-quality images of NekoNekoGirls!

70010000096471.name: OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0
70010000096471.intro: Start from Zero in a Tale of Restoration and Retribution
70010000096471.description:
*This is a Nintendo Switch™ version product.
*There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully. 

[Product Summary]
Start from zero and discover the newest entry in the OCTOPATH TRAVELER series. Experience a story of restoration and retribution over the divine rings—an epic saga that unfolds across the realm of Orsterra.

Embark on an adventure of your own creation.

Enjoy familiar features such as the series' HD-2D graphics, a fusion of retro pixel art and 3DCG; the player's ability to roleplay using Path Actions of their choice; and the Break and Boost system that can turn the tide of battle. Additionally, brand-new features such as character creation and town building allow you to create your own character and restore your hometown.

[Key Features]
1. You are the protagonist of the story. Choose your appearance, voice, motions, and favorite dish with the new character creation feature!

2. Restore your hometown through town building. Invite companions and allies to live in a town of your creation!

3. Engage in exhilarating and strategic command battles. Choose from over 30 allies to form a party comprised of up to eight characters!

4. Use Path Actions to invite people to your town, engage in battle, and obtain items. Where you go and what you do is entirely up to you.

5. Equip action skills with the new skill system. These skills can be learned by allies and passed on to others.

*The OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 Digital Deluxe Edition, which combines the OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 base game and paid additional content at a lower price, is also available.
*Please see the official website for details of the bonuses for each edition.

70010000096478.name: Kitten Lost Her Box
70010000096478.intro:
Cute platformer of a kitten cat
Use jump ability to get back her box!
70010000096478.description:
Help tiny Kitten get back her favorite paper box only with her agile actions.
In this tight platformer kitten brave hand-crafted challenges, meet cute creatures and finally fight with her old enemy!
this 2D platformer made in the style of handled games from the early '90s.
Play as Kitten run, jump and stomp to defeat difficult levels.
Collect fish to get high score and in the speedrun to get rank around the world.

Feature
Explore the four cute but full of challenge worlds！
Graphics and sound faithful to early '90s handled games
over 30 hand-crafted challenging levels with cute creatures the kitten like or hate!

70010000096491.name: Squirrel Madness
70010000096491.intro: Be ready for anything, because the battle’s just beginning!
70010000096491.description:
In this exciting 3D action game, you play as a brave squirrel who discovers a magical acorn and plants it right in the middle of a city street. From the acorn grows a mighty enchanted tree — a symbol of hope, nature, and home. But not everyone is happy about it: animal control squads, city maintenance crews, and urban greenery services have decided the tree is a threat to order... and now they want to cut it down.
You are the only thing standing between this magical tree and merciless saws. Arm yourself — from nut blasters to pinecone crossbows — and defend your green home from wave after wave of incoming enemies!

Game Features:
• 50 levels of intense action – each wave of enemies grows stronger, faster, and more dangerous.
 • 6 unique weapons – each with its own playstyle and special upgrades.
• Heal yourself and restore the tree between waves to keep the fight going.
• Diverse enemies – from pest control squads to advanced tree-cutting machines.
• Atmospheric locations – battle in detailed city streets, urban parks, and more.
• Your mission: survive as long as possible, repel all enemy forces, and save the magic tree from destruction!

Survive as long as possible, fight off all enemy waves, and save your magical tree from destruction.

70010000096504.name: Euro Car Parking Simulator 2025
70010000096504.intro: Get ready for the ultimate driving challenge in Euro Car Parking Simulator 2025!
70010000096504.description:
Euro Car Parking Simulator 2025

Get ready for the ultimate driving challenge in Euro Car Parking Simulator 2025!
This game brings you a huge collection of exciting parking levels in a busy city, and thrilling skill tests on special arenas, where you’ll need to drive through obstacles to reach the parking zone.

Explore a wide range of cars — from small city cars to powerful sports vehicles. Every car feels unique thanks to realistic driving physics carefully designed to give you the most lifelike experience.

Want a break from parking? Drive freely in the open-world city and enjoy smooth, realistic car handling as you cruise the streets.

Whether you're a parking pro or just love realistic car games, Euro Car Parking Simulator 2025 will keep you coming back for more.

70010000096517.name: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree
70010000096517.description:
Slay your way in this epic dark fantasy action RPG.

Battle monsters, craft powerful upgrades for your weapons and gear, and explore the secrets of an expansive, interconnected world.

DEFY YOUR FATE
You are an Inquisitor. As evil seeps into Faelduum through tears in reality, defy your purpose and embark on a path that leads to the heart of this world’s unraveling fate. From the towering majesty of Crimson City, through festering darkness, and into the horrors of Entropy... what will you become at journey’s end?

MASTER SOULSLIKE COMBAT
Choose from six unique Classes and wield blades and magic to master your craft in brutal battles. Dodge, parry, and strike with perfect timing to hunt vicious creatures and nightmarish bosses.

SUCCUMB TO A DARK FANTASY WORLD
Fall into a sinister tale featuring multiple endings, written by Brian Mitsoda and hauntingly soundtracked by Christos Antoniou (Septicflesh) and the FILMharmonic Orchestra Prague. 60 quests and 75 unique locations await your discovery across a vast, ruined world.

SLAY YOUR WAY
Create your Inquisitor and develop them through six Talent Trees. Hundreds of skill and combat upgrades are available, and you can also craft powerful weapons and gear to define your playstyle, die less, and deal death faster.

New to action RPG or Soulslike games? Tune the difficulty to your skill level in the settings.

70010000096522.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Han River
70010000096522.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Han River, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses. 
high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000096527.name: Battle Rockets™
70010000096527.intro: What happens when two genres become one? Battle Rockets™, that's what happens! In this distinctive "SHMUP Fighter", each player chooses a side–literally!
70010000096527.description:
Play as one of twelve Console-tan fighters, and battle your friends...or foes!

Face off in one of three multiplayer modes, each offering Standard and Remix game mechanics:

Duel Shock – Lower your opponent's HP! If their HP is all depleted, you win!
Short Fuse – Five rounds, five chances to get the first shot! Who will win the most rounds?
Cash Grab – Collect all the coins you can, or just zap them out of your foe's pockets, but watch out for that time limit!

Or, try your hand at one of eight single-player Challenges. These minigames expand upon the Console-tan lore, and allow players to hone their skills. Ready for something tougher? Super Challenges ramp up the difficulty of our original eight Challenges.

Are you Head-to-Heady?

70010000096537.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Donggeom-do
70010000096537.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Donggeom-do, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses. 
High-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000096542.description:

There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Hwado-myeon, Ganghwa-gun, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses. 
high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game.

70010000096547.description:

There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

70010000096552.name: Bubble Wizard III Saga
70010000096552.intro: Match, shoot, and blast through magical levels!
70010000096552.description:
A new wizard has arrived!
Join her and her magical cats in Bubble Wizard 3 Saga as they battle dark forces in a spellbinding bubble-popping adventure!

Match, shoot, and blast your way through 200 magical levels filled with enchantment, tricky puzzles, and powerful boosters.
Earn daily rewards, rise through the online leaderboards**, and play your way using Joy-Con™, Pro Controller, or touch screen.

Ready to save the realm again? Let the magic begin!

Key Features:
★ 200 handcrafted levels*
★ Boosters & potions to aid your journey
★ Daily rewards and coin drops
★ Supports Joy-Con™, Pro Controller, and touch
★ Enchanting visuals & sound
★ Online leaderboards (optional)**

* First 35 levels are unlocked tutorial stages.
** Players can opt out of leader board.

70010000096555.name: ONLY UP! REMASTER
70010000096555.intro: The sky’s the limit - climb higher than ever before!
70010000096555.description:
Prepare yourself for an exhilarating ride upwards in ONLY UP! REMASTER, the ultimate remastered version of the classic vertical adventure. Ascend through impossible heights, challenge your limits, and push your reflexes to the edge in this heart-racing, one-of-a-kind experience.

In ONLY UP! REMASTER, you’re on a quest to reach the highest point imaginable.Each jump, climb, and leap brings you closer to the sky, but with each step comes the risk of falling back down.

Key Features:
- Challenging Vertical Progression – Navigate increasingly difficult platforms, ledges, and gaps in a climb where every mistake counts.
- Immersive Environments: Explore diverse, dynamic landscapes that evolve as you climb higher.
- Precision Platforming: Every jump matters—perfect your timing and skills to reach new heights.
- Intense Replayability: Test your limits with new difficulty settings and endless vertical challenges.
- Tight Parkour Mechanics – Enjoy fluid movement and responsive controls built for intense precision platforming.

ONLY UP! REMASTER is more than just a climb—it’s a battle against gravity, doubt, and failure. How far will you go when the only way forward is up?

70010000096560.name: CASE RECORDS: Fear of Abduction
70010000096560.intro: Psychological horror, which is part of the games CASE: Animatronics and CASE 2: Animatronics Survival.
70010000096560.description:
CASE RECORDS is a psychological horror game that is part of the universe of the games CASE: Animatronics and CASE 2: Animatronics Survival..

The player has to play as a 17 year old female student and solve missing person mysteries by volunteering at the police station of Crowvale, a suburb of Aurora.

Patrol and explore the dark corners of the city to solve its terrifying mysteries.

But the most important thing during your time volunteering is not to go missing yourself....

Features:
- Mysterious atmosphere 
- System of interactive dialogs and choices which will affect the ending 
- Unique mini-games
- Interaction with surroundings which could become your escape..

Get ready for a thrilling psychological horror where one wrong step can cost you your life.

70010000096562.name: Top Cop - Police Training
70010000096562.intro: Top Cop - Police Training is a spiritual successor to Mad Bullets with new and improved tracking and centering.
70010000096562.description:
Building on the same core mechanics that made Mad Bullets the wackiest shooter with mind blowing, high-speed action. Now is the time to become the best in the police force! Prove your accuracy by shooting pop-up targets, pick up power-ups along your way to boost your performance. 

Do you think you have what it takes to face a real challenge?

● 9 Locations
● 60 Levels
● 3 Minigames
● 180+ Objectives
● Single player and local two-player multiplayer

70010000096564.name: Ghost Master: Resurrection
70010000096564.description:
The classic Ghost Master returns from the depths of the underworld, resurrected in a glorious rebirth of terror and intrigue. This faithful remake of the beloved original brings back the essence of the classic, now infused with stunning new graphics, a powerful new engine, and refined mechanics that will leave you screaming for more.

Key Features

Command an army of specters: Wield the power to summon and control a variety of grim specters, howling banshees, and sly gremlins, each with their unique abilities and strengths, now with enhanced visuals and improved AI.

Unleash terror on Gravenville: Explore 11 expansive and distinct locations, including the town's lunatic asylum, military base, sorority and frat houses, and police station, now with new environments and detailed textures.

Solve puzzles and unlock mysteries: Delve into a world of mystery and intrigue, where clever thinking and strategic planning are essential to success in unique, hair-raising adventures with multi-branching scenarios, now with new challenges and hidden secrets.

Experience a thrilling blend of strategy, adventure, and resource management: Combine the best of strategy, adventure, and resource management games in a coherent plot and complete virtual world, now with new gameplay mechanics and fresh content.

Rediscover the Terror

Relive the classic gameplay that made Ghost Master a cult classic, now with the benefits of modern technology and design. Ghost Master: Resurrection is the ultimate treat for fans of the original and newcomers alike, offering a fresh take on a timeless formula.

70010000096566.name: There's a Gun in the Office
70010000096566.description:
"You've been kidnapped and have to get out but luckily, there's a gun in the office. Unluckily, your captor comes back home every day, so you have to cover your tracks when you go out of your cell. Use each passing day to get closer to the gun until you can finally leave.
Imagine being trapped, kidnapped, and racing against the clock to escape. Locked in a room with nothing to protect you or even eat. You’re faced with a terrifying challenge: your captors return every day, so every action you take must be perfectly discreet. Each time you leave your room, you must leave everything exactly as you found it - or risk everything.

You have five days - Monday through Friday - to uncover your escape route. If you fail, you won’t survive. Every decision counts. Can you outsmart your captors and escape in time, or will you be trapped forever? Time is ticking."

70010000096571.name: Epic Empire
70010000096571.intro: Epic Battles, Legendary Heroes, Unstoppable Defense!
70010000096571.description:
Get ready for a tower defense style game in Epic Empire!
Will you answer the call to defend the kingdom and become the legendary hero it so desperately needs? Control a variety of powerful heroes and strategic towers to defeat the forces of evil and protect the throne!

Take control of heroes like the mighty ninja Kamui, the sorcerer Halani, the legendary Phoenix, and other mysterious characters. Use archers, infantry, magic towers, and stone golems to fend off waves of goblins, ogres, and other creatures.

Take on an epic journey through worlds: the Ice Kingdom, the Dark Magic Zone, underground tunnels, and a place of enchanted flowers. In each world, you will face tough challenges as you fight to regain territories captured by the enemies.
