Upgrade your heroes with an arsenal of runes and power items to reveal their true potential. Participate in tournaments to prove your tower defence skills and earn great rewards.

Epic Empire Features:
★ Pet System - level up your heroes to unlock pets that help you fight.
★ Rune System - Upgrade your heroes with runes and power-ups.
Mighty Heroes - 11 heroes with abilities to fight enemies. Control three heroes at a time to protect the kingdom and defeat enemies.
Four types of towers - upgradeable towers: Stone Golem, Archers, Infantry and Lord of Magic.
Multiple worlds and realms - explore each with different tower types and strategies.
Tournaments - prove your tower defence skills and earn the title of Titan along with rewards.
Diverse enemies - enemy abilities create exciting challenges.
★ High Quality Graphics - Stunning visual effects and character animations.
★ Boss Battles - Fight enemies like the Orc King or Gitrog. Use your strategy and lead your heroes to defeat hordes of enemies.

Prepare to defend your castle and kingdom from the forces of evil and join the global community of players by showcasing your skills in Epic Empire - Tower Defence!

70010000096581.name: Dreamscapes - The Sandman
70010000096581.intro: Defeat the Sandman and help Laura to wake up in the real world.
70010000096581.description:
As a child, father often told Laura that she is special. But Laura's father died before her full age, and Laura didn’t knew what her father had said about her speciality. In memory of her father Laura kept as remembrance an amulet “the Dream catcher” - her father gave it to Laura since she was a little girl, as Laura complained that she has nightmares.

Suddenly her favorite Dream catcher disappears, and Laura falls asleep during her concert. The doctors shrug their shoulders - she fell into a liturgical dream, and in spite of all their efforts she’s not coming back to life. There it was the Professor Sanders offered his services.

In this hidden object adventure, you play the professor's assistant—a volunteer who has agreed to participate in an experiment to bring Laura back to life.

• A modern mix of point & click adventure and hidden object
• Explore 50 exciting locations and experience a captivating storyline
• Solve a variety of hidden object scenes and mini-games
• 2 game modes (normal and advanced)
• Includes bonus chapter

70010000096586.name: Bubble Trouble 3
70010000096586.description:
Bubble Trouble 3 brings the beloved arcade classic to the Nintendo Switch™ with its signature bubble-popping chaos. Wield your harpoon to split bouncing bubbles into smaller ones until they vanish, but dodge them to stay alive! With vibrant visuals and nostalgic gameplay, this sequel offers solo challenges or thrilling local co-op. Master 47 unique levels and prove you’re the ultimate bubble buster!
Bullet Points:  
Retro Arcade Thrills: Shoot and dodge bubbles in fast-paced, addictive gameplay that’s simple yet challenging.  

Local Co-Op Action: Team up with a friend on one Nintendo Switch for cooperative bubble-popping fun.  

Diverse Levels & Weapons: Tackle 47 varied stages with four unique weapons, including harpoon, hook, laser, and mine.  

Nostalgic Challenge: Split bubbles strategically to clear levels and chase high scores in this timeless adventure.

70010000096591.name: Dreamscapes - Nightmare’s Heir
70010000096591.intro: A nightmare comes true – save Laura’s husband from the Sandman!
70010000096591.description:
Two years after waking from her coma, Laura believes she’s free from nightmares. But the Sandman, who once held her soul captive, is back for revenge. A relaxing trip to a snowy mountain resort turns tragic when Tim falls from a cliff and slips into a coma.

Bound by her vow not to use her Power for personal gain, Laura can’t save him herself. Desperate, she turns to an old friend (the player) and enters Tim’s subconscious, now under the Sandman’s dark influence.

Explore haunting dreamscapes, solve intriguing puzzles, and face the shadows before the Sandman claims his next heir.

• A modern blend of point-and-click adventure and hidden object gameplay
• Explore over 40 exciting locations and experience a thrilling sequel
• Solve a variety of hidden object scenes and mini-games
• 2 game modes (normal and advanced)
• Includes bonus chapter

70010000096598.name: Digging A Hole Simulator
70010000096598.description:
Ever wondered what secrets lie beneath the ground? In Digging A Hole Simulator, it’s just you, your shovel, and the endless depths waiting to be uncovered. Start with a simple tool, dig deeper, unearth valuable resources, and upgrade your equipment to keep the adventure going.

Every layer of earth holds hidden surprises—from rare artifacts and underground caves to forgotten mysteries buried long ago. Will you strike gold, uncover lost relics, or stumble upon something even more unexpected?

 Key Features 

 Dig & Expand – Start small and excavate your way down, revealing new layers of the underground world.

 Find & Sell – Discover valuable minerals, rare gems, and hidden treasures. Sell them to fund better tools and deeper exploration.

 Upgrade Your Gear – Enhance your shovel, unlock drilling machines, and dig faster & deeper than ever before.

Discover Secrets – Stumble upon underground caverns, strange relics, and forgotten mysteries waiting to be uncovered.

 Relax & Explore – No pressure, no time limits—just a satisfying, immersive digging experience at your own pace.

How deep can you go? What will you find hidden beneath the surface?

Put on your gloves, grab your tools, and start digging! The earth is waiting to reveal its secrets.

70010000096604.name: ESCAPE BACKROOMS: DARKNESS HORROR
70010000096604.intro: Trapped in an endless parking garage. No exits. No light. No escape—only the darkness that follows.
70010000096604.description:
Welcome to a harrowing survival horror experience where the ordinary becomes a waking nightmare.
You find yourself trapped in an endless, abandoned parking garage. Dim lights flicker overhead, concrete levels stretch into darkness, and something moves just out of sight—always watching, always waiting.

Navigate the winding corridors, uncover eerie clues, and solve twisted puzzles to search for a way out. But be warned: the deeper you go, the more reality begins to unravel. Familiar signs and barriers twist into a maze of fear and paranoia.

With haunting sound design, adaptive AI-driven threats, and a suffocating atmosphere, every step could be your last.
Will you escape the garage’s grasp, or become another lost soul echoing through its endless levels?

70010000096615.name: Fit and Fry
70010000096615.description:
Cooking here is a delicious puzzle. Each level is a new dish to prepare, and your challenge is to fit all the ingredients perfectly into the pan. But be careful: space is limited, and only the best chefs will be able to complete each recipe without wasting anything.

How does it work?
You receive different ingredients in various shapes and must move, rotate, and position them so everything fits neatly into the pan. It may seem simple at first, but as you progress, the challenges increase, and strategy becomes essential.

40 levels to test your cooking skills!

Heating the Stoves (Levels 1-10)

More Elaborate Recipes (Levels 11-30)

Master Challenges (Levels 31-40)

With engaging visuals and satisfying effects, Fit and Fry is the perfect experience for puzzle and strategy challenge lovers. Grab your wooden spoon and prove you are the master of kitchen fitting!

70010000096622.name: Gym Lifting Hero
70010000096622.intro: Level up your Hero in the Gym!
70010000096622.description:
Gym Lifting Hero: Tile Master is a game that uses Tile Match combined with fitness elements to create a special and one-of-a-kind training environment.

Rigorous training mode: By completing workouts and improving abilities, you will take control of the main character, a weak man who is just starting to work out at the gym, and help him gain muscle, strength and agility.

Challenges and exercise goals: To progress and take on new challenges, you must achieve your daily exercise goals. The tasks become more difficult as you level up, but the rewards also become greater.

You must complete Tile Match 3 levels with special features such as Shuffle or Undo to help players complete previous levels faster and earn money to improve their workouts and training tools.
In addition to training, you can also participate in other exciting mini-games such as boxing, hide and seek or even Team Up 5v5 with other opponents.

This unique gameplay, different from traditional tile games, will immerse you in an exciting and challenging world.

Features:
Relaxing and addictive gameplay
Idle gym management
Collect money even offline
Upgrades and expansions
Compete in a tournament
Simple and intuitive controls
Play at your own pace

70010000096629.name: Pixel Game Maker Series Princess Pomu and the 5 Moons
70010000096629.intro:
Paint without T is PAIN!
Princess Pomu, robbed of her kingdom and family, is now possessed!
70010000096629.description:
Paint without T is PAIN! Princess Pomu just lost her Kingdom and her family was captured, and now she's possesed by an evil spirit! Master the simple but satisfying combo system, get more abilites, pick up weapons and explore the surreal world of Illeh in this cute metroidvania with a violent twist.

Take the role of Pomulus Vongoat VII, a cute goat princess who wants to become an artist, however, she wants to escape the lands of Illeh to look for her mother.

The plan was disrupted by an invasion of mutated humans called Q-mans, killing everyone and capturing the royal family. Pomu accidentally gets demonic powers thanks to an ancient spirit sealed in a chest, and now, realizing she has lost everything, Pomu takes the opportunity to try and restore her life...

in a violent manner.

Simple but satifying combo system and weapons. Punch your enemies or take their weapons, but be careful, not every enemy can be beaten the same way!

6 unique weapons and tons of abilities to be unlocked to help you in your violent journey.

Classic 2D Metroidvania progression, collectibles and exploration, uncover more about Illeh's lore and everything behind the Qmen's invasion in a fictional world.

Hand-crafted pixel art, music and cute but VIOLENT animations.

Multiple difficulties, including a one-life mode.

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.

70010000096634.name: Brain Teaser! Spin & Build Castle
70010000096634.intro:
Spin Panels to Build Famous Castles!
A Fun Brain Puzzle to Find Your Favorite Fortress
70010000096634.description:
This is a fun and challenging puzzle game where you rotate panels to correctly assemble famous castles from around the world.

The controls are simple—just look closely at the sample image and tap the panel you want to rotate!
The faster you complete each stage, the more stars you earn—up to three per level!

If you’re stuck, don’t worry!
A hint button becomes available over time and can be used up to three times. Each hint will rotate one entire row of panels to the correct direction.

It’s simple to pick up but offers plenty of depth, making it perfect for a quick brain workout or a fun way to pass the time.
Try to clear every stage with 3 stars!

70010000096640.name: DELTARUNE
70010000096640.intro: The next adventure in the UNDERTALE series has appeared!
70010000096640.description: Dive into the long-awaited parallel story to UNDERTALE! Fight or spare your way through action-packed battles as you explore a mysterious world alongside an endearing cast of new and familiar characters. Create your avatar, meet strange friends, and jump into the darkness: DELTARUNE is waiting!

70010000096645.name: Block Party DX!
70010000096645.intro: Welcome to block party puzzle game, offering a relaxing yet challenging experience for all ages.
70010000096645.description:
Block Party DX! is a block puzzle game with an exciting twist—you have full control of where the blocks go! It’s a popular choice for casual play while providing a fun mental challenge.

The goal is simple yet engaging: match and clear as many colored blocks as possible on the board. Mastering the skill of filling rows or columns makes the game easier, while creating multiple combos helps you climb the leaderboards.

Block Party DX! offers a relaxing and cozy puzzle experience that also keeps your mind active and sharp.

Three Addictive Game Modes:
★ Party Block Puzzle: over 999 levels with varying objectives to meet, clear a level by score or color blocks (8x8 - 12x12).
★ Time Block Puzzle: Start with 300 seconds and aim for highest scores (8x8).
★ Classic Block Puzzle: Drag, drop blocks to clear lines (8x8).


Whether you’re tackling the endless challenges of Classic mode, unleashing powerful Block Blasts, or strategically placing pieces for maximum impact, the excitement never ends. Enjoy intuitive gameplay and captivating visuals.

Features:
★ Nintendo Switch™ online leaderboards for each mode. (players can opt-out)
★ 18 professionally crafted background tracks.  
★ Multiple language support.  
★ Daily free spin for gold coins.
★ Rescue games using coins.  
★ Fully controller, or touch screen support.
★ Toggle sound and music on/off.  

With simple controls, fantastic sound effects, and a great rhythm, Block Party DX! is a game you’ll keep coming back to!

Block Party DX! provides a truly immersive experience for puzzle lovers of all ages. Are you ready to tackle the ultimate block challenge and aim for the world championship?

70010000096680.name: Goodboy Galaxy
70010000096680.intro: Help Maxwell explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces.
70010000096680.description:
A vibrant sci-fi platform adventure game for the Nintendo Switch™, where you help Maxwell the dog explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces - by jumping, shooting, slicing, shrinking, warping and drilling.

Maxwell’s homeworld is nearing collapse. In a last ditch-effort to find help, he hyperjumps where no dog has gone before. Stranded, he finds himself on the edge of a hostile system - if there’s any hope of return and rescue he’ll need every friend (and every weapon) he can find.

Forced to confront this celestial expanse head on, Maxwell stays strong - determined to keep his head up and lend a helping hand to everyone he meets on his journey. Like all underdogs, the odds are stacked against him, but you can’t keep a good dog down.

Key Features
· Explore jam-packed levels with multiple routes
· Make 50+ friends & collect their friendship cards
· Upgrade your blaster with special abilities
· Find hidden areas and take on a variety of boss battles
· Local couch co-op multiplayer mode
· Bonus prequel content: Chapter Zero

70010000096695.name: Masters Bowling
70010000096695.intro: Multiplayer true-physics bowling game, up to 4 players
70010000096695.description:
Experience the thrill of bowling like never before! Step into the ultimate bowling arena designed for endless fun with friends and family. Enjoy local multiplayer action with up to 4 players, creating unforgettable moments and friendly competition.

Play single matches for quick fun or compete in exciting tournaments to prove your bowling mastery. Challenge your friends directly or take on the device with 3 distinct AI difficulty levels—ideal for both beginners and experienced bowlers. Immerse yourself in an authentic bowling atmosphere, with this true-physics simuation featuring realistic sound effects recorded in genuine bowling alleys, bringing each throw vividly to life.

Marvel at astonishing graphics, intricately detailed lanes, and dynamic visuals that elevate every round. Whether you're competing fiercely or enjoying casual play, it's the perfect way to share laughs and excitement with your favorite people.

Play solo or gather your crew, choose your favorite bowling ball, and let the good times roll!

70010000096702.name: Bunker 22
70010000096702.intro: Your mind is your weapon. Your fear is your enemy.
70010000096702.description:
You wake up in a rotting forest house, your lab coat stained with blood. The world is dead. The people you knew are now things—shambling horrors from a botched experiment. To stop the epidemic, you must descend into the underground lab where it began. But the cure won’t wait, and neither will the monsters hunting you.

Arm yourself to the teeth, because the most vicious monsters will stand in your way. Solve puzzles, look for items, manage resources, do everything possible to save the world from a terrible epidemic, because you are the chosen one.

Breathtaking adventures, an intriguing storyline, and dangerous traps await you. Are you ready to face your fears? Then nothing can stop you.

Game Features:

- Brutal Arsenal: Handguns for precision, shotguns for close-quarters carnage, and traps to surprise your enemies.
- True Survival: Limited ammo, degrading weapons, and monsters that learn your tactics.
- Changing environment: Zombies are stalking you. Hear them scratch at doors, mimic voices, and hide around corners.
- No Handholding: Solve environmental puzzles or survive. The lab’s secrets won’t reveal themselves.

In this game we have mixed the most popular game genres: story adventure, action shooter and survival horror. This is a real gift for all gamers who really like to tickle their nerves.

70010000096707.name: CTHULOOT
70010000096707.intro: A fun coop arcade adventure for up to 4 players
70010000096707.description:
THE GREAT OLD ONES ARE CALLING!

Round up your friends to form a gang of semi-competent looters in search of the relics lost by the Great Old Ones. Just be careful not to invoke them again!

COOP MULTIPLAYER GAME TO PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS

Explore mysterious realms in the liminal space between reality and madness, and collect mad loot along the way!

FIND AND COLLECT ANCESTRAL RELICS

Help Lord Morgaz'han regain his rightful place among the Great Old Ones with the power of the treasures you'll find. Draw on his collection of supernatural watches to acquire new skills! 

WILL YOU STILL BE FRIENDS WHEN IT'S ALL OVER?

Show off your skills as a looter, and don't lose anything along the way if you don't want to drag your team down!

70010000096709.name: Ganja Cartel: Warfare Shooter Simulator
70010000096709.intro: Burn the fields. Break the cartel. Survive the war
70010000096709.description: Step into the boots of a special forces operative in Ganja Cartel: Warfare Shooter Simulator. Your mission: dismantle a powerful drug empire deep in cartel territory. Burn down massive cannabis plantations, engage in brutal shootouts, and take down the cartel's warlords in this intense single-player shooter. With realistic weapons, explosive action, and a fiery atmosphere, every mission pushes you closer to justice—and deeper into chaos.

70010000096717.name: NYAZ ~ OPERATION: OCCUPY HOUSE OF KOBAYASHI ~
70010000096717.intro: Stray Cat × Dungeon = Human domination!? A heartwarming yet surprisingly challenging dungeon RPG!
70010000096717.description:
Cats—those indispensable beings that bring healing to our human lives.
But what if these symbols of comfort took over humans!?
Form a party of stray cat adventurers called ‘Adven-Nya’
and venture deep into the dungeon toward the Kobayashi household!

★Leading cats with diverse classes and personalities! Conquer dungeons with their varied skills!
　Utilize class-specific skills like Samurai, Ninja, and Bishop to conquer dungeons. Expand the fun of exploration and battle.

★Quirks galore!? A cast of eccentric companions and monsters
From a mole obsessed with collecting dolls, to a goat that sings 24hours, and even a medaka fish ghost—diverse characters and monsters color your adventure.

★Heartwarming Battles (?) with the Kobayashi Family
Battles against the Kobayashi family—your takeover targets—unfold as a new kind of battle where kittens' cuteness melts hearts!

★Collect! High Difficulty! Surprisingly Challenging Grind Elements
Satisfy hardcore players with abundant equipment and item collection, plus high-difficulty dungeons!

*Attention*
The languages included in the main game are Japanese and English only.

70010000096720.name: Aroma Love Ready!
70010000096720.intro: “Aroma Love Ready!” is a whimsical fantasy rom-com! Enjoy sweet romance wrapped in lighthearted comedy!
70010000096720.description: You run your own perfume store as the owner of a perfume store. A sudden accident has involved you in the investigation of your own resurrection from the dead. The truth gradually emerges  with three employees - a love affair about perfume.  Harvest the memories of your own heartbeat in the game!

70010000096725.name: GiLGuL
70010000096725.intro:
Why Do People Want to Die?
Why Don't People Want to Die?
70010000096725.description:
This is a story about a group of girls in a world that exists in limbo between life and death. Embark on a dramatic real-time tactical adventure.

In this world, opposites intertwine— cuteness and grotesqueness, hope and despair, life and death.

Those who yearn for death, yet cannot bring themselves to it, arrive at the Interworld suspended between life and death.

This is the story of Mitsu Mao, a girl clinging to life who gets lost in this Interworld, and those she meets there who have desired death.

The game consists of an adventure part, where you explore the Interworld, and a real-time tactical part, where you strategically defeat the monsters blocking Mao's path with her allies.
Embark on a dramatic real-time tactical adventure.

70010000096740.name: Time Treker
70010000096740.description:
Choose your pilot and build your own custom mecha with 17+ weapons and 55+ attachments, then jump to the battlefield against hundreds of enemies to save spacetime itself in this thrilling sci-fi bullet heaven! 

Features
- Surviors-like action with fast-paced, intense battles
- Six pilots, each with distinct stats and special skills
- Multiple mecha archetypes with fully customizable loadouts
- A wide variety of weapons, attachments, and items to discover
- Missions spanning exploration, defense, and total annihilation

70010000096745.name: The Red Bell's Lament
70010000096745.description:
A ruthless battle between humans and vampires is about to unfold.

■Story
The Redbell Tree scrapes the sky, standing proudly in the heart of Hemeria, a land of sunlight.
In a land ruled by a monarchy for generations, humans lived in peace and tranquility.
That is, until the dawn of the day the world was dyed red.

On that day, vampires laid waste to Hemeria.
They preyed on, devoured, and devastated its inhabitants.
A great many people would go on to mourn their loved ones, their families and friends, for the rest of their lives.
One particular town of Hemeria bore such a tragedy.
A single girl was left alone in despair and disgrace.
She vowed revenge, and grew into one of Hemeria's finest vampire hunters.

And one day, she became a member of the Elpis 7; those who inspired a light of hope in its people.
One day, she receives a letter from an unknown sender. Upon her arrival to the mansion indicated inside, she finds vampire hunters and royal knights awaiting her.
The hunters assembled receive an order from the monarch.
They are to form a squad and invade Nyx, the world of vampires.

A shiver of anticipation crackles through her at the opportunity she's been waiting for her whole life.
However, this is but the beginning of a game wherein the fate of her world is at stake.
Pawns are sent forth, discarded, hidden out of sight...

And just how many will remain when this all comes to an end?

■System

The Mission
Throughout the story, the heroine will be confronted with various decisions to make.
In order to complete each mission, she must weigh her options carefully before making her choice.
However, when she's face to face with vampires, one wrong move could lead to the worst possible outcome...

Win, even if it requires cheating
The heroine encounters a mysterious game board in a certain place.
Should she make an incorrect choice, she can move back a step to rewind time - so long as she's willing to cheat.


Features:
・Fully Voiced (excluding the heroine)
・Change the heroine's name
・Jump to story checkpoints via a flowchart
・Touch Screen controls available

■ Voice Actors
Takuya Eguchi/Daisuke Namikawa/Nobuhiko Okamoto/Kengo Kawanishi
Mariya Ise/Minori Suzuki/Masakazu Morita/Yusuke Kobayashi/Kazuhiro Yoshimura/Hiromi Igarashi/Ayaka Fukuhara/Kohsuke Toriumi/Kohei Amasaki
Kanoko Akahori/Takatora Shimada/Volcano Ota/Toya Shiraishi/Yousuke Omomo

70010000096755.name: Lost Twins 2
70010000096755.intro: Shift the world, solve puzzles, and help Abi & Ben find their way back home.
70010000096755.description:
Rearrange the world. Reunite the twins. Rediscover wonder.
Abi and Ben are lost but not alone. In Lost Twins 2, you'll shift entire pieces of the world to guide them through a beautifully handcrafted puzzle adventure full of cozy charm and clever surprises.

How it plays:
- Slide and swap tiles to reshape levels
- Solve puzzles using switches, platforms, water gates, and more
- Explore magical environments like enchanted forests and toy castles
- Play solo or team up in delightful local co-op
- Discover secrets, collectibles, and heartwarming surprises
With no enemies, no time limits, and no stress, Lost Twins 2 is a peaceful puzzle journey perfect for players of all ages.

 Key Features:
Inventive Puzzle Mechanics – Slide, swap, and shift tiles to unlock new paths and reveal clever solutions

Solo or Co-Op Play – Play alone or team up with a friend in couch co-op mode

Whimsical World – Gorgeous visuals bring every corner of the world to life

Atmospheric Soundtrack – Original music that adapts to your journey’s emotional beats

Secrets & Collectibles – Find hidden paths, unlock concept art, and gather charming curios

No Two Puzzles Alike – Every level introduces fresh ideas with zero filler

Stress-Free Play – No deaths, timers, or enemies just pure puzzling joy

70010000096756.name: SUPERSHOT: Valley Warfare Defense
70010000096756.intro: Lock. Aim. Defend the valley in style!
70010000096756.description:
Step into the heat of casual combat in SUPERSHOT: Valley Warfare Defense - a vibrant shooting simulator where precision meets pure fun. Defend your peaceful valley from waves of quirky invaders using powerful weapons, quick reflexes, and strategic upgrades.

With colorful visuals, smooth controls, and nonstop action, each battle is a satisfying challenge. Whether you're sniping from a hilltop or unleashing chaos with explosive gear, every shot counts. Perfect for quick sessions or long playthroughs, this game blends casual play with thrilling warfare vibes.

Lock, load, and protect your homeland - the valley needs its hero!

70010000096768.name: Ashwood Valley
70010000096768.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70010000096768.description:
Your sibling is a cat now. Time to fix that.

In Ashwood Valley, you’ll step into the shoes of either Luna or Draco – two magical siblings whose spell-casting mishap opens a portal to a vibrant world… and turns one of them into a cat. Now, it’s up to you to restore a ruined cottage, befriend quirky creatures, and uncover the secrets of the enchanted valley to break the curse.


Grow magical plants, explore changing seasons, complete odd quests for chocolate-loving mayors or cheese-obsessed dwarves, and pet all the wild animals you can find – even the strawberry cows!


With cozy farming, whimsical characters, and hand-animated pixel art, Ashwood Valley is a charming adventure about family, friendship, and a lot of fluff.


Key Features
- Farming with a magical twist: Grow seasonal crops, forage for rare ingredients like cinnamon, and tend a garden that changes with the seasons.
- Befriend and transform animals: Pet, feed, and discover hidden forms like mushroom chickens or beetroot cows.
- Choose your hero: Play as Draco or Luna, and try to reverse the feline curse on your sibling.
- Restore and decorate: Fix up your cozy cottage, clear out cobwebs, patch the floor, and make it feel like home again.
- Quirky characters and cozy quests: Help unique NPCs like Olaf the sailor-fisherman and Emma the chocoholic mayor with their oddball tasks.
- A living valley across seasons: Explore a colorful pixel-art world that transforms with spring blossoms, autumn leaves, and snowy winters.

70010000096774.name: Path of Legends
70010000096774.intro: Become a legend by slaying demons and collecting their souls!
70010000096774.description:
Path of Legends throws you into a brutal dark fantasy world where only the strongest can rise to mythic status. Take control of a legendary warrior—male or female—and fight your way through demon-infested realms, collecting powerful demon souls to unlock the path ahead.
Explore a mysterious hub world filled with ancient ruins and magical trails. Use soft platforming to navigate the world, follow glowing soul shards to find hidden demon portals, and recharge your mana and endurance along the way. Each portal leads to a deadly arena where three intense waves of demonic enemies await.
Use a deep, action-packed combat system featuring dashes, combo strikes, dodges, ranged magic attacks, and a powerful rage mode. Pay attention to health, stamina, and mana as you fight, and adapt your style by switching between two unique heroes. Each victory earns you a demon soul—and five are required to open the massive magic gates and push deeper into haunting new regions like the Forest of Whispers, the Frozen Wastes, or the Infernal Depths.

70010000096777.name: Demonspire
70010000096777.intro:
Climb the cursed Demonspire!
Slay demons, collect souls,
and fight to escape—if you can.
70010000096777.description:
Demonspire is a dark fantasy action-platformer that throws you into the depths of a cursed tower, where only the strongest survive. You are a warrior trapped in the Demon Spire, a towering inferno of chaos and death. Your only way out? Climb. Fight. Endure.
Each level begins with a fast-paced, deadly platforming section where you’ll leap over traps, dash across collapsing ledges, and follow glowing soul shards that replenish your mana and stamina. Survive this gauntlet, and you'll reach a floating arena where the real challenge begins—three brutal waves of demon enemies await.
Switch between two playable heroes, each with their own strengths and combat style. Unleash devastating melee combos, magic attacks, dashes, dodges, and a powerful rage mode that can turn the tide of battle. Manage your health, stamina, and mana as you defeat each wave and collect the precious demon soul within.
Only those who gather enough souls can ascend to the next floor. Are you worthy to escape the Demon Spire?

70010000096780.name: Running Fable Petite Party
70010000096780.intro: Running Fable Petite Party throws you and your friends into 16 fast-paced, friendship-testing mini-games across 3 tabletop arenas.
70010000096780.description:
Outrun your friends. Outsmart your rivals. Out-chaos them all!
From the makers of Running Fable comes Petite Party, a wild and unpredictable spin-off that cranks up the chaos. Battle through 16 competitive mini-games and dominate the tabletop party board where anything goes. In Running Fable Petite Party, there’s no holding back — every round is a chance to taunt your friends, steal victory, and cause maximum mayhem.

Key Features:
- 16 Mayhem-Fueled Mini-Games – Outsprint, outbalance, outwit, or outright sabotage your friends in quick-fire challenges designed to trigger laughs and playful rage.
- Tabletop Strategy Meets Party Madness – Roll the dice and plan across 3 competitive boards where the smallest choices lead to the biggest betrayals.
- Rivalry Ready – Perfect for 1–4 players; whether you’re teaming up or turning on each other, every match is a test of speed, reflexes, and friendship.
- Designed for Teasing – Easy controls mean anyone can join in, but only the bold (and lucky) can claim victory. Trash talk encouraged.
- From the World of Running Fable – Return to a vibrant, fabled universe full of quirky characters, ridiculous physics, and hilarious animations.

It’s not just a party — it’s a battlefield disguised in balloons.
Running Fable Petite Party is what happens when tabletop strategy meets competitive chaos. Who will stand victorious? And who will never live that loss down?

70010000096785.name: Cats Visiting Historical Times
70010000096785.intro: Time-travel with a cat! Explore ancient worlds, find hidden felines, and uncover history’s secrets in this purr-fect adventure!
70010000096785.description:
Embark on a Whisker-Twitching Time-Travel Quest!

When a mischievous portal suddenly opens, a curious cat and their bewildered owner are swept away on an extraordinary journey through history! Now, they must explore ancient civilizations, uncover hidden cats, and piece together clues to find their way back home.

Explore Legendary Eras:
Travel through Mesopotamia, Ancient Egypt, Ancient Greece, the Roman Empire, the Viking Age, the Middle Ages, and the Golden Age of Pirates—each beautifully recreated with immersive visuals and playful historical details.

Find Cats of All Kinds:
    Friendly Cats – Happy to be found, these kitties offer fun facts about their time period.
    Shy Cats – Masters of disguise, they hide cleverly but leave behind paw prints, knocked-over objects, or flickering tails.
    Historian Cats – Rare and wise, these special felines share fascinating knowledge about their era, unlocking entries in your Cat Encyclopedia.

Two Exciting Game Modes:
    Story Mode – A relaxed adventure where you explore each era, uncover secrets, and meet quirky historical characters.
    Arcade Mode – A fast-paced challenge! Race against the clock to find all the hidden cats and climb the leaderboards.

Collect, Learn, and Unlock:
    Fill your Cat Collection with adorable felines from across time.
    Discover hidden artifacts and unlock bonus mini-games (like deciphering Egyptian hieroglyphs or navigating a Viking ship!).
    Upgrade your tools with a cat whistle or time compass to make finding shy cats easier.

A Purr-fect Blend of Fun & Learning:
With its charming art style, humorous dialogue, and lighthearted take on history, Cats Visiting Historical Times is a delightful adventure for cat lovers, history buffs, and gamers of all ages. Will you help these time-traveling companions make it home—or will you stay forever lost in history?

70010000096794.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Ilsan Lake Park
70010000096794.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Ilsan Lake Park, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses. 
High-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000096799.name: Nintendo GameCube™ – Nintendo Classics
70010000096799.intro: Nintendo GameCube™ – Nintendo Classics, only available on Nintendo Switch™ 2!
70010000096799.description:
With a Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack membership, Nintendo Switch™ 2 players can now access a collection of Nintendo GameCube™ games to play anytime, anywhere! Sail the seas in The Legend of Zelda™: The Wind Waker™, race at breakneck speeds in F-Zero™ GX, and clash weapons (and souls) with fearsome fighters in SOULCALIBUR II.  

Choose between a standard screen style and a retro CRT mode that simulates the look of older screens. Suspend points make it easy to take a mid-dungeon break in The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker, while online and local wireless multiplayer make it easy to challenge your friends to SOULCALIBUR II’s VS Battle and VS Team Battle. And since you’re playing on Nintendo Switch 2, don’t forget to try out GameChat while battling it out.    

More titles will be released in the future!

70010000096803.name: CRYKEN part4
70010000096803.intro:
Get the crystals!!
Play in split-screen multiplayer for 1-4 players!
30 stages in total. Normal and hard difficulty options avail
70010000096803.description:
The objective is to use jumps and dashes to get the crystals on the stage.
The stage is a 3D space with vertical, horizontal and depth. Gravity exists, and players control the player by moving forward, backward, left and right, and by jumping vertically to move the player and aim for the crystal.

Features
・Clear the stage when you get the crystal!
・30 stages in total! There are stages 91 to 120.
・You can choose the difficulty level, and normal is relatively easy to clear. Hard mode is more difficult.
・Some stages have crystals that appear by collecting coins or cutting grass.
・You can get equipment! Get a new weapon, the scythe!
・You can play split-screen with up to 4 people!
・Monsters appear!
・You can use items to use abilities!

Multiplayer
・You can cooperate or compete with everyone.
・Collect coins together,
・Cut grass together
・Clear the stage together.
・Defeat the enemy together!
・Get the crystals first!

70010000096809.name: Donkey Kong™ Bananza
70010000096809.intro: Explore a vast underground world—by smashing your way through it!
70010000096809.description:
Bash through just about anything with the raw power of Donkey Kong! Crash through walls, carve tunnels with your fists, punch straight down into the ground, and even tear off chunks of terrain to swing around and throw in groundbreaking exploration—the more you smash, the more areas open up for you to move through.  

Join DK and his companion, Pauline, as they delve deep underground—and discover that this subterranean world is a lot more than it seems on the surface. Uncover a variety of environments such as arid canyons, lush forests, and frigid tundra as you peel back the world’s layers!

Pair up with Pauline to use powerful Bananza Transformations 

Pauline is a talented young singer looking to find her way back to the surface—and her singing can empower Donkey Kong with Bananza Transformations! Each transformation has its own signature strengths: you can smash through the toughest obstacles with the raw strength of Kong form, gallop with incredible speed as a Zebra, and more.

Team up with a friend in two-player co-op to dive into the Underground world as Donkey Kong and Pauline. The second player can blast foes and terrain alike with the power of Pauline’s voice as you explore together.

Smash your way to the Planet Core before the greedy Void Company gets there first

The Planet Core is said to have the power to grant any desire—and Void Kong, the ruthless head of the greedy Void Company, will stop at nothing to reach it and claim all the world’s riches for himself. Donkey Kong and Pauline have other ideas…but if they’re going to get their wishes granted, they’ll have to beat Void Kong to the punch.

Join DK and Pauline in an absolutely bananas action-packed journey as you smash your way to the Planet Core!

70010000096813.name: Nintendo Switch™ 2 Welcome Tour
70010000096813.intro: Get an inside look at the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system
70010000096813.description:
Take the welcome tour and discover how this system is much more than meets the eye! Walk around a virtual exhibition shaped like a giant Nintendo Switch™ 2 system and look, touch, and feel your way through the exhibits. Each area is designed to teach you about the technology that went into building the hardware, such as the sensors used for mouse controls and the mechanism that powers the HD rumble 2 feature.

Learn about basic features, like the magnetic connectors that keep the Joy-Con™ 2 controllers firmly attached, and about more advanced tech details that you might not otherwise notice. Uncover hidden facts, enjoy playful minigames and tech demos, and test your knowledge with quizzes as you explore the exhibit halls!

70010000096817.name: The Legend of Zelda™: Breath of the Wild – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000096817.intro: Step into a world of adventure—now enhanced for the Nintendo Switch 2 system!
70010000096817.description:
Travel across vast fields, through forests, and to mountain peaks as you discover what has become of the kingdom of Hyrule—and step into a world of discovery, exploration, and adventure that’s been upgraded with performance enhancements in The Legend of Zelda™: Breath of the Wild – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition! With improved framerates, faster load times, and enhanced resolution and textures, this thrilling open-air adventure has never looked better!

Use your ingenuity to survive and thrive in Hyrule

The wilds of Hyrule make for a puzzling game of survival. Climb cliffs to scope out a destination; then cross great distances with the Paraglider or the horses you’ve tamed. You’ll discover items for crafting, beasts to hunt, and plants to forage. Scavenge weapons and armor…or claim them from enemies! From hammers to helmets, items have specific stats, resistances, effects, and levels of durability. Use everything at your disposal to find and conquer more than 100 shrines. Luckily, the in-game Sheikah Slate can project Runes that manipulate objects and enemies in clever ways.

Support your journey with ZELDA NOTES on the Nintendo Switch app

Introducing ZELDA NOTES—a game-specific service found in the Nintendo Switch app* on compatible smart devices that’s exclusive to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. Streamline your adventure by using voice-assisted navigation to find elusive shrines and Koroks. Hear Voice Memories—stories from Princess Zelda that were not in the original game—as you visit certain locations around Hyrule. 

With ZELDA NOTES, you can also gain daily in-game bonuses, compare your play data to others around the world, decorate your in-game photos for social media, transfer items to other players by QR Code®**, and more!

A Nintendo Switch Online membership is not required to use ZELDA NOTES.

Already have The Legend of Zelda™: Breath of the Wild for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack! 
    
If you already own the game for Nintendo Switch, you can purchase the upgrade pack separately to enjoy all the performance enhancements of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and access to ZELDA NOTES. And if you have a paid Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack membership, you can access the upgrade pack at no additional cost!

70010000096821.name: The Legend of Zelda™: Tears of the Kingdom – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000096821.intro: Explore the land and skies of Hyrule—now enhanced for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70010000096821.description:
An epic adventure awaits in The Legend of Zelda™: Tears of the Kingdom – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition! Harness the power of Link’s abilities to fight back against the malevolent forces that threaten the kingdom—all while traveling across the sprawling landscapes of Hyrule with improved framerates, faster load times, and enhanced resolution and textures. This sequel to The Legend of Zelda™: Breath of the Wild game has never looked better!

Unleash your imagination by using your abilities in surprising and creative ways

Link must make use of powerful abilities to discover the origins of the mysterious gloom that is plaguing the kingdom. Use Ultrahand to pick up, move, and rotate objects, and even attach objects together to create bridges, vehicles, and more. Try Fuse to magically fuse objects to Link’s current weapon, shield, or arrow to increase durability, damage, or even add a new effect. Ascend and Recall give you new ways to move through the environment, allowing you to pass through solid terrain and reverse an object’s movement. Experiment with lots of different combinations to come up with surprising—and sometimes hilarious—results!

Support your journey with ZELDA NOTES on the Nintendo Switch app

Introducing ZELDA NOTES—a game-specific service found in the Nintendo Switch app* on compatible smart devices that’s exclusive to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. Streamline your adventure by using voice-assisted navigation to find elusive shrines and Koroks. Hear Voice Memories of Princess Zelda and some additional characters—stories that were not in the original game—as you visit certain locations around Hyrule. 

With ZELDA NOTES, you can also gain daily in-game bonuses, compare your play data to others around the world, decorate your in-game photos for social media, transfer items to other players by QR Code®**, and more!

A Nintendo Switch Online membership is not required to use ZELDA NOTES.

Already have The Legend of Zelda™: Tears of the Kingdom for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack! 
    
If you already own the game for Nintendo Switch, you can purchase the upgrade pack separately to enjoy all the performance enhancements of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and access to ZELDA NOTES. And if you have a paid Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack membership, you can access the upgrade pack at no additional cost!

70010000096825.name: Super Mario Party™ Jamboree – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Jamboree TV
70010000096825.intro: This jam-packed jamboree just got even bigger—only on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70010000096825.description:
Gather your friends, pick a board, and have a Mario party! Choose your character, roll some dice, and compete in an assortment of minigames to see who can get the most stars. From running through merry-go-rounds to motion-control* minigolf, the main game has seven boards and over 110 minigames to play…and the new Jamboree TV mode adds even more minigames designed to take advantage of Nintendo Switch 2 features like mouse controls!

Exclusive to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, Jamboree TV casts you and your friends as contestants in a game show hosted by Toad. Take on a variety of challenges along with Mario and friends that use the Joy-Con™ 2 controller for mouse controls, the system's built-in microphone to respond to your sounds, and more. Add a compatible USB-C® camera (sold separately) and other players’ faces will appear during gameplay—like when they’re crowned for winning minigames or surrounded by the coins they’ve won!

With 22 playable characters, Pro Rules for more serious competition, and a local single player mode, there’s something for every kind of partygoer!

Get hands-on with Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive features in Carnival Coaster and Bowser Live

Lock in and go on the co-op Carnival Coaster! Use the Joy-Con 2 controller’s mouse controls to aim at flying baddies and try to blast 'em down. There will also be a mouse-control minigame each time the coaster rolls into a pipe. You'll have to work together to improve your score!

Get on stage and become the star of the performance in Bowser Live! Compete in two teams and take on wild minigame challenges focused on sound and movement. Connect the Nintendo Switch 2 camera or a compatible USB-C® camera** (each sold separately) to project you and your buddies into the in-game venue!

Take the fun online in Koopathlon and Bowser Kaboom Squad

Race across the party board in Koopathlon, a series-first 20-player online** competition to see who can rack up the highest scores in minigames like the fast-paced Lane Change. The higher your score in each round, the faster you’ll get to the goal. If cooperative play is more your style, take on an Impostor Bowser in the 8-player online Bowser Kaboom Squad mode. 

Both online modes have worldwide rankings so you can see how you measure up against the best. You can also play the standard Mario Party mode with friends*** and family***, or others online!

Get moving in Rhythm Kitchen, Toad’s Item Factory, and Paratroopa Flight School
Motion-control games are back! Cook to the beat in the Rhythm Kitchen cooking show, help Toads piece together party items in Toad’s Item Factory, and soar through the sky in Paratroopa Flight School. There are also motion-control minigames in the standard Mario Party mode that you can toggle on or off.

70010000096829.name: Kirby™ and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
70010000096829.intro: Join Kirby in an upgraded 3D platforming adventure and uncover the mystery of the meteor—only on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70010000096829.description:
Float off as the powerful puffball, Kirby, on an adventure that’s been enhanced for the Nintendo Switch 2 system! Explore in 3D platforming stages as you discover a mysterious world with abandoned structures from a past civilization—like a shopping mall?! Copy enemies’ abilities like Drill and Ranger and use them to attack, explore your surroundings, and save the kidnapped Waddle Dees from the ferocious Beast Pack alongside the mysterious Elfilin. 

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition has faster frame rates and higher resolution, but that’s not all—there’s also an additional story in which Kirby must use his amazing abilities, including some all-new Mouthful Modes, to clear a trail through uncharted territory after the world is struck by a powerful meteor. Hope you’re hungry for an unforgettable adventure!

Get a mouthful of real-world objects for powerful transformations

Feeling hungry? Kirby can inhale real-world objects and transform using Mouthful Mode! Why get one drink from a vending machine when you can swallow the whole thing? Then, use your boxy body to shoot out cans at baddies. Consume a car to gain some wheels and slam through walls. Sit back and take it all in…literally.

Join up with a pointy partner, Bandana Waddle Dee, in co-op play

Pass a Joy-Con™ 2 controller to a buddy to play as the spear-wielding Bandana Waddle Dee and help each other explore and battle through this colorful world. While Kirby can float and inhale enemies, Bandana Waddle Dee can spin and stab with his sturdy spear. Find friendship in this Forgotten Land and save the Waddle Dees! 

Float over obstacles and fight through enemies on your way to each stage’s goal as you slash, poke, freeze, and hammer using Kirby’s Copy Abilities. The tough puff is truly put to the test in dynamic boss battles that will keep you dancing about the arena. Choose from two difficulty modes for either a light, breezy adventure or a more challenging experience.

Each themed stage you travel through will hide several friendly Waddle Dees in peril! Save them to grow the home base of your adventure, the once-deserted Waddle Dee Town. The Waddle Dees you rescue will unlock shops, leaderboards*, and the ability to evolve Copy Abilities to make them stronger. You’ll also be able to enjoy some of the townsfolk’s favorite games. Use compatible amiibo™ accessories** or Present Codes at Waddle Dee-liveries for useful in-game items. Track down cute collectibles to give Kirby’s house some extra charm either at the Gotcha Machine Alley or during your adventure.

Already have Kirby and the Forgotten Land for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack! 
    
If you already have the game for Nintendo Switch, you can purchase the upgrade pack separately to play this version on Nintendo Switch 2.

70010000096833.name: Farmyard Survivors
70010000096833.intro: Help Kitty and her friends to defend their farm!
70010000096833.description: Survive hordes of cute (but evil) animals attacking your farm in this fast-paced, lane-based roguelite. Recruit adorable heroes and unlock powerful support animals to protect your farm from relentless attackers!

70010000096835.name: We Are Busy Digging A Hole
70010000096835.description:
Grab your shovels and dig together in this delightful cooperative digging adventure. Team up with friends to uncover treasures that lie beneath the surface. The deeper you go as a team, the more exciting your journey becomes.

Coordinate with your friends to dig through layers of earth more efficiently. Find valuable ores that you can sell for shared upgrades. Make your shovels stronger and your backpacks bigger as you continue your busy digging lives together. Along the way, uncover rare dragons and ancient coins hiding in the dirt.

Each dragon you rescue as a team finds a home in your shared sanctuary, creating a lively community above ground. Divide tasks between miners and collectors to maximize efficiency. And for those who dig deep enough together, rumors of mysterious cave dwellers might lead to undiscovered worlds.

Features:
- Cooperative Gameplay – Team up with friends to dig faster and discover more treasures together.

- Colorful Underground – Explore a vibrant world beneath your feet with surprises at every depth.

- Dragon Collection – Build a unique dragon sanctuary together, with each new discovery adding to your shared world.

- Hidden Mysteries – Some secrets are buried deeper than others, waiting for the most determined digging teams.

- Relaxing Experience – Get busy digging at your own pace in this charming cooperative underground adventure.

70010000096845.name: Robinson Alchemy
70010000096845.intro: Robinson Alchemy is an alchemy game set on a deserted island where the objects you connect are the ones you first need to find and harvest.
70010000096845.description:
And here you are on a deserted island... just the ocean, the jungle, and yourself. Explore and harvest objects and then connect them to survive and maybe even get off the island back to civilization.

Robinson Alchemy is an Alchemy game where you need to first find and collect the objects you will later connect... and then use to find and harvest more objects. Start a fire, find food and water, and build a shelter. See what else the island holds for you.

70010000096855.name: Fortnite
70010000096855.description:
Play Fortnite your way. 

Be the last player standing in Battle Royale, Zero Build, Reload, and Fortnite OG, explore LEGO Fortnite experiences, blast to the finish with Rocket Racing or headline a concert with Fortnite Festival. Play thousands of free creator made islands with friends including deathruns, tycoons, racing, zombie survival and more! Join the creator community and build your own island with Unreal Editor for Fortnite (UEFN) or Fortnite Creative tools.

Each Fortnite island has an individual age rating so you can find the one that's right for you and your friends. Find it all in Fortnite!

70010000096859.name: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26
70010000096859.description:
EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26 leverages a new AI-powered machine learning system to convert thousands of plays from nearly a decade of real NFL data into more explosive gameplay—with new player-specific traits, authentic play-styles, and adaptive counters that match on-field tendencies and strategies of NFL quarterbacks and coaches.

From the Skol chant in Minnesota to the light show in Baltimore, immerse yourself in new presentation across the NFL including game-impacting weather, team traditions, and more.

Built from Sundays. Real NFL data powers the realest Madden to date.

SIGNATURE QBS
Star NFL quarterbacks move, look, and feel more like the superstars they are.

COACH DNA
Adaptive counters informed by real NFL coaching trends.

ROSTER MANAGEMENT
Modernized depth charts, new positional roles, and the Wear & Tear system add strategy and experimentation to roster management and game-planning.

FOOTBALL WEATHER
Depending on how extreme the conditions are, Football Weather can completely disrupt your original game plan. Adapt to new challenges like limited visibility downfield in heavy snow and fog, or wet conditions that will directly impact player movement, stamina, ball security, and more.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

70010000096868.name: Cyber Love Story
70010000096868.intro: Reveal the secrets and find out who you can really trust!
70010000096868.description:
Immerse yourself in the fascinating story of Sally White, a young girl whose life turns upside down when she finds herself embroiled in a conspiracy by a mysterious organization. Who can you trust, and who is just pretending to be a friend?

The main feature of the game is the ability to change the appearance and outfits of the main character, creating a unique style that will reflect her character and mood.

Make fateful decisions, choosing from a variety of answer options, and determine what Sally's path will be - full of dangers, passion or betrayal.

Are you ready to reveal all the secrets and write your own story?

Game features:

• Freedom of choice - influence the development of the plot and relationships with characters.
• Image change - choose outfits and change the appearance of the main character.
• Fascinating story – immerse yourself in a world of secrets, intrigue and unexpected twists.
• Atmospheric music – a unique soundtrack will create complete immersion.
• Colorful graphics – stylish hand-drawn illustrations.

70010000096873.name: Chicken Run: Eggstraction
70010000096873.intro: Stealth, silliness, and a whole lot of chaos! Scurry and scramble your way to freedom in this co-op adventure set in the Chicken Run universe.
70010000096873.description:
Eggs-traordinary times call for eggs-traordinary heroes.

After surviving the daring events of Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget, the gang is back in a brand-new adventure, and it turns out nuggets weren't the only thing on the menu - chickenkind is still in danger!

Take control of Molly, Rocky, Frizzle and the gang as they sneak, scurry & scramble through five tantalizingly treacherous fortified farms to liberate captured chickens.

But don’t count your chicks until they’re hatched – you’ll need to outwit bumbling security, dodge watchful CCTV, and topple an army of loopy poultry villains.

The stakes are high, the chickens are feisty and the explosions inevitable.

Are you ready?

Stealth with a Silly Twist – Hide in bins, disguise yourself as a traffic cone, or leg it in a full-blown panic. Whatever works.

High-Octane Escapes – Release those chickens and let the chaos ensue. Sure, chickens aren't meant to fly, but when the alternative is getting caught… we wing it.

Chaotic Co-op – Team up in two-player co-op to solve puzzles, cause absolute mayhem, and accidentally (or deliberately) ruin your friend's escape plan.

Avians Assemble – Build a super squad of chickens to lead each mission, combining different traits, special powers and bonkers gadgets.

100% Chicken Run – Created at Aardman Animations, expect a brand-new feather-ruffling story packed with the evil villains, unexpected twists, and plenty of clucking good silliness

70010000096880.name: Football Manager 26 Touch
70010000096880.intro: Step into the dugout and experience the future of football management on Nintendo Switch™.
70010000096880.description:
OUT NOW – PLAY TODAY
New foundations set the stage for you to define your footballing destiny. Made with Unity, FM26 Touch brings you closer to the action.
MATCH DAY DRAMA
Powered by the Unity graphics engine, matchdays feel more dramatic than ever thanks to volumetric animations from real football matches and improved on-pitch detail.
TOTAL FOOTBALL, TOTAL CONTROL
Delivering smoother navigation, an upgraded UI enables smooth, intuitive navigation through your wider game world, from squad building to match preparation.
PREMIER LEAGUE. FULLY LICENSED
Compete for glory in the Premier League, now vividly brought to life with official kits, club logos, broadcast graphics and player images.
YOUR MANAGER, YOUR WAY
Express more of your personality, style and backstory in every career with a revamped manager creation experience.
ADVANCED TACTICAL INNOVATION
Make your mark on the pitch with distinct in and out-of-possession formations and level up your gameplans with new and redefined player roles.
TRANSFORMATIVE TRANSFER TOOLS
Harness new recruitment tools, powered by football’s transfer marketplace TransferRoom, to smartly shape your title-winning squads.
INTRODUCING: WOMEN’S FOOTBALL
Break new ground as women’s football seamlessly joins FM in one footballing world with 14 playable leagues across 11 nations, including elite competitions like the WSL and NWSL.
In FM26 Touch, football belongs to you and your vision. Change the Game.

70010000096904.name: Fast Fusion
70010000096904.description:
Fast Fusion is the fastest antigrav racing game you may have ever experienced.

Race your anti-grav vehicle through brilliant tracks such as the beautiful Redwood Forest, the storm planet Tempesta or through the lofty heights of Yama Crest.

Use the exciting 'Fusion' ability! 'Fusion' lets you create hundreds of improved racing machines by fusing your favorite vehicles into new ones, with improved specifications and unique looks.

Risk it all by mastering the new antigrav hyper jump technology to get ahead of your opponents.

70010000096906.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Jangbong-do
70010000096906.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Jangbong-do island, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 4 flight courses. 
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000096916.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Yadal Dock
70010000096916.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Yadal Dock, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 2 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000096921.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Jinchon Beach
70010000096921.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Jinchon Beach, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 3 flight courses in 2 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000096926.name: Hover Runners
70010000096926.intro: High-speed reflexes. Endless challenge. Total rotation.
70010000096926.description:
Strap in and take control of a futuristic hover ship hurtling through an infinite cylindrical track. In Hover Runners, you don’t steer the ship — you rotate the world around it. Dodge deadly obstacles like blocks and laser fences, zip through glowing tunnels, and ride speed boosts as your velocity climbs to insane levels.

Collect shimmering gems along the way to unlock 7 unique ships, each with their own sleek design. Every second you survive, the pace ramps up — testing your reflexes, focus, and nerves of steel. How far can you make it before the track wins?

The gameplay is fast-paced and endlessly replayable, with a unique rotation mechanic that keeps every run intense. With dynamic obstacles, unlockables, and a simple control scheme, Hover Runners is perfect for quick bursts or extended sessions. It’ll keep you coming back for just one more run.

70010000096928.name: Void Raiders
70010000096928.description:
Void Raiders

Adventurers, unite! Dive into the exhilarating world of Void Raiders, a turn-based Sci-Fi tabletop strategy game that challenges you and your friends to battle fierce aliens and formidable robots on your quest to journey home through treacherous space stations and mysterious portals. 

Key Features:
- Engaging Turn-Based Combat: Strategically plan your moves, deploy your character’s abilities, and outsmart your opponents in tactical battles.
- Five Unique Character Classes: Choose from a diverse range of classes, each with its own strengths, abilities, and playstyles, allowing for endless combinations and strategies.
- Dynamic Card System: Effectively manage and play your cards to gain advantages in combat and resource management.

Each Session Lasts About Three Hours: Perfect for a game night, this time frame offers a sense of completion without feeling rushed.

Join the fight and immerse yourself in the action with Void Raiders — a captivating Sci-Fi tabletop experience from Gamopolis that guarantees excitement and strategy at every turn!

70010000096941.name: Dragon Detective: A Friend from the Shadows
70010000096941.intro: A thrilling detective mystery adventure set in a historical fantasy world. As a dragon detective, use your six senses to find evidence and hunt down the culprit.
70010000096941.description:
When a pair of strangers arrive at his home late one night, Detective Noxley reluctantly emerges from his self-imposed exile. What he uncovers next will put him at the center of a conflict that will change the future of his entire nation.

Solve the case and save the day as Sevyn Noxley, a private investigator living in a fantastical world of anthropomorphic animals. Help the citizens of the capital city of Rivulette in four twisting, turning cases of murder and intrigue.

Experience a story-rich visual novel detective adventure inspired by legal thrillers of the past. Inspect places of interest, question suspects, and point out contradictions by presenting evidence you've gathered during your investigation.

Use your six draconic senses on crime scenes and persons of interest to gather information.

Meet a large cast of anthropomorphic characters and enticing locations presented in hand-drawn 2D artwork.

Features both "casual" and "detective" difficulty options. Enjoy either a cozy or a more challenging experience.

70010000096945.name: EGGCONSOLE Rune Worth PC-9801
70010000096945.intro: Embark on an epic adventure set in the world of Rune Worth. This game features a unique spell system where casting spells requires time to chant before activation.
70010000096945.description:
At the boundary of light and darkness, there existed a world called Rune Worth. Once, everything was born, flourished, and perished there—even the gods were no exception, it is said. The tale of EA=Rune Worth, which is about to be told, begins with the birth of the absolute god, Eatils. Yet, even this is only a small fragment of the many stories that should be told in Rune Worth...

This action RPG was released in 1989. Players take on the role of a young traveler, journeying through the world of Rune Worth, gradually becoming entangled in a grand adventure. At first glance, it may seem like a conventional action RPG, but it is packed with unique features.

For example, level-ups occur through events and items, meaning battles with enemies can be kept to a minimum, allowing players to purely enjoy the story. Spells require casting time, and if the player is attacked during casting, the spell is interrupted. Even small actions, such as opening treasure chests or crouching, have dedicated character animations. These elements come together to create a distinctive RPG experience.


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000096952.name: Rocky the Brave Pup: Love, Friendship and a Midnight Mission
70010000096952.intro: Rocky, a brave little dog, embarks on a nighttime adventure to recover something very special. Along the way, he discovers that heroism comes in all sizes.
70010000096952.description:
Join Rocky in this visual novel, a brave and curious puppy, on an incredible nighttime adventure full of magic and excitement!

When something very special goes missing, Rocky doesn't hesitate for a second to embark on a mission to get it back. Throughout his journey, he'll discover that courage has no limits and that, although we may not always be the biggest or strongest, we can all be heroes. With unexpected friends and mysterious challenges along his way, Rocky will learn that true heroism lies in small acts of love, bravery, and dedication.

Story Features:

·Enchanting main character: Rocky, a brave and cuddly puppy, who inspires children to be brave and always do their best.

·A magical nighttime adventure: A story full of mystery, surprises, and exciting moments that capture the imagination.

·Valuable lessons: Teaches children that true heroism comes in all shapes and sizes, and that anyone can make a big difference.

·Unexpected Friends: You'll meet new friends who help Rocky on his journey, showing children the importance of friendship and collaboration.

·Guaranteed Fun: With a perfect blend of tenderness, emotion, and humor, children will be hooked on every page!

This is a perfect story to inspire little ones to be brave, kind, and never give up, no matter how big or small you are.
Because we can all be heroes; it just takes a little courage and a lot of heart.

70010000096954.name: Fantasy RPG: Raid Legends
70010000096954.intro: Step Into a World of Adventure—Your Legend Begins Now.
70010000096954.description:
Welcome to a vibrant, action-packed journey through a world teeming with magic, monsters, and mystery. Choose your hero—be it a brave warrior, clever mage, or swift archer—and step into a realm where every battle brings you closer to glory.

Explore enchanted forests, eerie dungeons, and ancient ruins as you take on fearsome beasts, mighty dragons, and twisted sorcerers. Every fight is a test of your skill, timing, and strategy—level up your character, unlock powerful abilities, and collect rare loot to grow even stronger.

With fast-paced combat and a world brimming with secrets, Raid Legends is a tale of courage, growth, and legendary adventure. Sharpen your blade, ready your spells, and get ready to carve your name into the legends of this magical land.

70010000096962.name: Dialoop -Roguelite Puzzle-
70010000096962.intro: An exciting roguelite puzzler where every playthrough is unique, now on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000096962.description:
Put your brain to the test with this slide-puzzler blending roguelite strategy, the satisfying feel of a match-3, and the freedom of a deck-builder!

In solo play, enjoy a focused experience and choose from a cast of unique characters!
Items available change each run. Adapt and advance from one stage to the next!

In online mode, compete with up to 8 players from around the world in lively multiplayer competition!
Chain those combos, and hype it up with your rivals!

After boss matches (yes there are those too!), "gruesome" fatalities await...!?

70010000096976.name: Kusan: City of Wolves
70010000096976.intro: A high-octane hardcore top-down shooter set in a brutal urban jungle.
70010000096976.description:
Welcome to Kusan: City of Wolves, a brutal top-down shooter set in a neon-drenched urban jungle consumed by violence and corruption.

Kusan delivers hardcore action where one mistake means death. Master gunplay, perfect your movement, survive the streets and combat arenas ruled by furious kingpins that demand speed, precision and flawless execution. Every moment of action is intensified by Korean hip-hop heavyweight Loptimist’s adrenaline-fuelled soundtrack drenched with head-bopping loops and deep 808s pushing you forward without mercy.

You play as Jin, a skilled ex-soldier turned gun-for-hire, living in the heart of a city where the line between predator and prey has already been crossed. This isn’t just another job though, a mysterious girl with immense but uncontrollable power is linked to a violent conspiracy that threatens to shift the balance of power. As chaos erupts, Jin must save the girl, confront his past and the betrayal of a commander he once trusted without question.

Everyone in Kusan wants something and nobody plays fair.

For Jin, there is only one way forward: flawless planning, ruthless execution and saving the girl from criminals while relying only on his wit and unrelenting will to survive the battlefield.

With the whole city at stake, Jin knows it is time to not only clean-house but restore balance.

Dive into Kusan: City of Wolves and descend into a city on the edge. It's more than just a fight, you are the last line between order and oblivion.

70010000096984.name: Sounos' Curse
70010000096984.description:
Souno’s Curse – An Emotional 2D Action-Platformer Adventure
Embark on the poignant journey of Souno’s Curse, a 2D action-platformer with a unique atmosphere, skillfully blending exploration, intense combat, and emotional storytelling. Play as a daring adventurer venturing into a cursed cave, where every corner holds forgotten secrets, deadly dangers, and a profound story about regret, loss, and the value of the present moment.
Explore beautifully hand-drawn environments, inspired by the greatest classics of the genre, and let yourself be carried away by an immersive soundtrack that enhances every moment of your journey. Souno’s Curse offers a Metroidvania experience where each discovery, unlocked ability, and battle brings you closer to the truth behind the curse.
Key Features:
Striking Artistic World: Fully hand-drawn 2D visuals that blend modernity and nostalgia.
Touching Story: A narrative about regret and redemption, inviting you to live fully in the present.
Varied Challenges: Face formidable enemies, avoid traps and obstacles, and push your limits with demanding platforming mechanics.
Dynamic Combat: Switch between melee attacks and magical powers to overcome lurking threats.
Exploration and Secrets: Unlock new areas, find hidden passages, and reveal the mysteries buried in the cursed cave.
Souno’s Curse is more than just a game: it's an emotional adventure, a tribute to classic exploration games, and an initiatory journey that will leave a lasting impression on players seeking intense sensations and memorable stories. Are you ready to break the curse and discover the truth buried in the darkness?

70010000096989.name: Crime Busters II: Havoc
70010000096989.intro: Eliminate terrorists hiding in Hong Kong's labyrinthine city! Battle from alleyways to skyscrapers on neon-lit streets. Team up in co-op to defend Hong Kong's peace!
70010000096989.description:
Thwart the ambitions of terrorists in beautiful, neon-lit Hong Kong! Experience powerful top-down action shooting gameplay with a variety of missions ranging from back alleys and skyscrapers to night markets and the Hong Kong sea. Enjoy immersive top-down gameplay with multiple game modes and a wide range of weapons unlocked as you level up. Solo or with a friend, just share a Joy-Con™ and enjoy co-op play anytime, anywhere! Supports 1 to 2 player modes. Pass a Joy-Con™ to another player to "share" and start co-op play wherever you are.

・Simple controls and addictive top-down action shooting gameplay.
・Each stage offers story-driven missions for tense and exciting gameplay.
・Complete the final stage to unlock cinematic movie scenes.
・Features a wide variety of stages.
・Enjoy even more with Story Mode and additional modes.
・Follow the story and complete missions in EPISODE mode.
・Fight off waves of enemies from enemy bases in INVADE mode.
・Defend your position from relentless enemy attacks in DEFENSE mode.
・Complete stages to gain experience and level up.
・Unlock new weapons as you level up.
・Enjoy intense battles with stunning 3D graphics.
・Collect a variety of uniquely designed weapons.
・Upgrade your characters and weapons for even more fun.

Complete the final stage to reach the long-awaited ending! What ending awaits you?
Upgrade your weapons and characters as you progress through numerous stages!
Pass a Joy-Con™ to another player to "share"!
Share and enjoy cooperative play anytime, anywhere.
Play with up to two people and thwart the ambitions of terrorists and criminal organizations!
Become a member of the special Crime Busters unit and protect the peace and future of Hong Kong!
The time has come to end the darkness in Hong Kong!

Prologue
Word has spread that Krueger, the leader of an armed gang, has escaped. He fled to Hong Kong, known as Asia's financial hub with its dazzling skyscrapers and vibrant night markets. Against the backdrop of Victoria Harbor's breathtaking nighttime view, Krueger began to build a new criminal empire by joining forces with the Triad, Hong Kong's most powerful organization.

From the narrow alleys of the Kowloon peninsula to the luxurious buildings of Central, the dangers of illegal arms, drugs, and human trafficking spread. The once-safe streets of Hong Kong now fell into a maelstrom of crime. With the Hong Kong Police helpless, the Crime Busters special unit was immediately dispatched to Hong Kong.

The Crime Busters gather intelligence in the bars of Lan Kwai Fong, pursue suspects in the bustling streets of Tsim Sha Tsui, and sometimes conduct operations while riding on Hong Kong's iconic Star Ferry. Amidst the complex terrain and cultural differences of an unfamiliar city, the Crime Busters battle the Triad and Krueger's forces, launching operations to save beautiful Hong Kong.

70010000096994.name: Cinnabunny
