70010000096994.intro: Cinnabunny is a cozy life simulator game where you play as a bunny who runs a bakery. Unlock new recipes, go birdwatching, collect mushrooms, and charm your community.
70010000096994.description:
Cinnabunny is a cute rabbit-filled game focused on running a bakery and living in a village with fellow buns. Cinnabunny is meant to be a relaxing, cozy experience designed for gamers and non-gamers alike. It can be played locally by one or two players.


Story

Oh no! Your cute, hoppy bun family is fighting a nasty drought. They'll be okay for a while, but your mother has tasked you with finding a new place for the family to live. After a long journey, you've found it! Welcome to Sugar Creek Burrows, a paradise among buns. Run your new bakery and save up so your family can move here too!


Bake It 'Til You Make It

Learn various recipes, like breads, pies, and cookies. Make them your own by adding special combinations of supplemental ingredients like berries, nuts, or spices!


Forage / Farm for Ingredients

Different recipes require different ingredients. And a true baker will find or make those ingredients themselves! Plant wheat and make flour, forage for easter eggs in the forest, or even head to the caves to mine for salt!


Charm Your Community

Sugar Creek Burrows is a quaint village bustling with fun and quirky buns. Unlock new dialogue as you progress the relationship and gift them your baked goods to discover their individual taste preferences.


Decorate Your Bakery

Your bakery doubles as your living quarters. Make your house a home by organizing your baking tools, adding furniture, and maximizing coziness.


Birdwatch

Use your birdoculars to capture pictures of the various bird species around Sugar Creek Burrows. With over thirty species of birds to discover (each with true-to-life bird calls), you'll have to scour the skies in various weather, seasons, and times of day to find them all.


Capture Recyclobots

Rowan, a scientist bun, added some robotic components to her garbage in an attempt to solve the world's littering problem. Alas, the experiment went horribly awry! Use your net gun to capture all the rogue recyclobots.


Collect Mushrooms

The village of Sugar Creek Burrows and its surrounding forest and caves are home to 40 different species of mushrooms. Become an expert mycologist!


Advance Your Skills

Your bun has four basic skills in Cinnabunny: baking, foraging, birdwatching, and recycling. Every time you perform the skill successfully, you'll get better at it, giving unique bonuses as you level up.

-----------------

This game encourages co-operative gameplay. Players share an inventory and have access to the same tools. Also, while player 2 can do everything player 1 can, you cannot enter different unique sections of the map at the same time (so if one player wants to go to the forest or the caves for example, both players must go). Buns stick together, after all!

70010000096996.name: Sheepy: A Short Adventure
70010000096996.intro: A Short Handcrafted Pixel Art Platformer that follows Sheepy, an abandoned plushy brought to life. Sheepy: A Short Adventure is the first short game from MrSuicideSheep.
70010000096996.description: Help Sheepy, an abandoned plushy brought to life, as he explores a forgotten and broken world. Sheepy: A Short Adventure is the first short game from MrSuicideSheep.

70010000097001.name: Dark Quest 4
70010000097001.description:
-Darkness Stirs Once More-
Dark Quest returns with its fourth installment - a turn-based strategy adventure inspired by the legendary HeroQuest board game. Enter a realm of perilous dungeons, cunning traps, and powerful magic as you lead your party of heroes against the forces of the Dark Sorcerer.

Gulak, the sorcerer’s puppet, commands monstrous legions that stalk the night. Villagers vanish without a trace - stolen in silence, never to be seen again. Only your band of champions can stand against this tide of darkness and end Gulak’s reign of terror.


-Build Your Party of Heroes-
Command up to 10 unique heroes, each with distinctive stats and powers. Train them in the Hero Camp, unlock new cards and abilities, and forge your perfect dungeon-delving team.

-Strategic Dungeon Adventures-
Embark on 30 handcrafted quests filled with tactical, turn-based combat and deadly surprises. Outsmart over 40 unique monsters, evade lethal traps, and wield both magic and steel to survive sprawling, multi-floored dungeons that test your wit and courage.

-Local Coop-
Team up with friends locally in couch co-op, combining your heroes’ strengths to overcome Gulak’s legions together. Coordination is key - one false move could doom you all.

-Customize Your Experience-
Play your way with custom difficulty settings, and countless strategic combinations that make every run feel unique and rewarding.

70010000097013.name: Nurilogy 1000
70010000097013.intro:
Decorate the streets with cuteness! You're a future artist!
Take on this logic puzzle with simple rules!
70010000097013.description:
You are a future artist! Solve puzzles and color the streets with your art!

Nurilogy 1000 is a logic puzzle game with simple rules.
Follow the rules below to paint the blank squares:
① Numbers on the board show how many blank squares are surrounded by paint.
 Each group of blank squares contains exactly one number.
② All painted squares must be connected.
③ Do not create painted blocks larger than 2×2.

Clear the stage by painting correctly according to the rules!

There are 1,000 stages to play! Rankings supported!

70010000097031.name: Lucy and the Talking Cat: The Secret Cat Kingdom
70010000097031.intro: Lucy always thought her cat Momo was special… but she never imagined he could talk!
70010000097031.description:
A magical visual novel where cats have much more than meows to say!

What if your cat could talk... and was part of a secret civilization?
Lucy thought Momo was just her adorable furry companion, but one night she discovers everything! Together they will travel across moonlit rooftops, mysterious tunnels, and forgotten ruins, uncovering secrets that have been hidden for centuries.

Get ready for a story full of magic, friendship, and mystery that will make you see your cat in a new light.

Highlights:
Talking cats with unique personalities: from wise guardians to mischievous felines with magical powers.

A secret world right under our noses: lost cities, enchanted rooftops, and magical tunnels.

A curious and brave heroine: Lucy is the only human capable of understanding cats... and perhaps the only one who can help them.

Mysteries to be solved: ancient riddles, prophecies, and an ancient bond in danger.

A journey filled with emotions: friendship, courage, laughter... and lots of mustaches.

70010000097033.name: Werewolf Hunter - Survive The Howl
70010000097033.intro: Terror awaits in the shadows. Will you survive?
70010000097033.description:
Step into the shoes of a fearless hunter in Werewolf Hunter - Survive the Howl, an intense survival game. Experience the chilling thrill of the hunt as you battle deadly werewolves and other lurking threats in the darkness.

Key Features:
	•	Immersive First-Person Perspective: Navigate the eerie wilderness through a first-person camera, ensuring a close and intense survival experience.
	•	Dynamic Movement and Combat: Move fluidly through the environment while switching seamlessly between shooting from the hip and aiming down sights for precise combat. Engage enemies with firearms or melee weapons for versatile gameplay.
	•	Interactive World: Explore a richly detailed environment where you can open doors, activate your flashlight, and use night vision to uncover hidden threats in the darkness.
	•	Strategic Survival Tools:
	•	Use medkits to restore health in critical moments.
	•	Set traps and bait to outwit cunning werewolves.
	•	Deploy motion sensors to detect approaching threats.
	•	Explosive Gameplay: Create powerful explosions to eliminate enemies or distract them.
	•	Engaging AI Behavior: Encounter intelligent werewolves and wildlife with realistic behaviors, making every encounter tense and unpredictable.
	•	Loot and Crafting: Scavenge for valuable items that spawn randomly. Defeat enemies to earn rare drops, enhancing your gear and arsenal.
	•	Random Events: Brace yourself for unexpected encounters and events that can change the course of your hunt.

Survive the night, hunt your prey, and become the ultimate werewolf hunter. Are you ready to endure the howl?

70010000097043.name: Bee Flowers: Save the Garden
70010000097043.intro: The bees are back for another mission
70010000097043.description:
In the third chapter of the Bee Flowers series, you’ll guide bees through stunning environments while solving logic puzzles on a hexagonal grid. The goal is simple: connect paths to deliver pollen to the flowers. The gameplay is accessible, but the challenges increase as you progress.

With 30 carefully designed levels, the game features three distinct biomes:
Green Fields: A peaceful green field, perfect for learning the mechanics and getting used to the game’s rhythm.
Autumn Grove: An autumn scene with leaves covering the paths and winds affecting the bees' movement.
Winter Hollow: A cold, serene environment where puzzles require more planning and attention.

Bee Flowers: Save the Garden combines minimalist visuals, a relaxing soundtrack, and thoughtful mechanics to offer an engaging experience, perfect for puzzle lovers with a touch of personality.

Time to save the garden — one path at a time.

70010000097048.name: Fit And Fry: Organized Chef
70010000097048.intro: Cook with logic, fry with flair!
70010000097048.description:
Fit and Fry: Organized Chef is the second game in the franchise, bringing back the delicious chaos you love—now with new ingredients, even trickier pans, and kitchen tools overflowing from the cupboard!

Your mission? Fit each ingredient snugly into the frying pan. Sounds easy? Just wait until you see the shape of those carrots! Move, rotate, and snap pieces perfectly to complete wacky dishes.

With 40 levels packed with flavor: puzzles get more complex, ingredients get bolder, and your skills as an organized chef are put to the test. Fewer pieces, bigger strategy—and no ingredient left behind!

If you love tasty puzzles, crunchy challenges, and that satisfying click of a perfect fit... welcome back to the kitchen!

70010000097068.name: Space Chef
70010000097068.intro: Hunt, cook, and deliver cosmic cuisine to become the greatest chef in the nebula!
70010000097068.description:
A three-course meal of an adventure: restaurant manager, light survival RPG, and life sim, all set in the zany universe of the Horseshoe Nebula. As the galaxy's (soon to be) premiere chef, it's up to you to seek out the finest ingredients from alien planets, cook delicious dishes, and serve them to customers in the comfort of your fully-customisable space trailer.

Explore Alien Worlds
There's a whole universe of ingredients out there... if they don't eat you first. Explore distant planets, derelict space stations, and your own basement for plants, critters, and other tasty morsels.

Along the way, you'll come across space pirates, ancient ruins, and a suspiciously high number of recently abandoned restaurants. Keep an eye out for rare resources (and bits of random junk) that you can use to upgrade your gear, kitchen equipment, and spaceship.

Cook Up Cosmic Creations
Once your fridge is stocked with ingredients that have (mostly) stopped wriggling, it's time to flip the sign and start serving!

Craft over 140 different dishes, from simple homestyle Beefle Skewers to the legendarily tricky Octoegg Surprise. Wow your customers with delicious food and speedy service, and you’ll earn the Astronomical Culinary Excellence Stars that mark your path to intergalactic culinary success.

As your reputation grows, the customers start coming to you! Keep it flexible by continuing your delivery service or open up a sit-in restaurant with a constant flow of patrons. You're free to close the kitchen whenever adventure calls.

Set a Stellar Ambiance
Your space-trailer might not look too sharp from the outside, but she's got it where it counts. Take complete control of your interior with freely placeable decorations and an in-depth coloring system to create the restaurant of your dreams. Add new floors, create themed zones, and fill it with the furniture and props you find on your travels! 

Serve the Nebula
The citizens of the Horseshoe Nebula are more than just hungry bellies (most of them, anyway). Get to know Zoe the scrap dealer, faded Space Ace Jack Bronzon, the definitely-not-alien barman Zlurka, and many more characters on your journey to interstellar culinary stardom. Unique recipes, side quests, and even romance awaits if you can satisfy your loyal customers.

With your new-found friends, you’ll uncover the truth about your missing grandma and take on the might of Galactic Burger as they try to muscle in on your space-turf.

Space Chef features:
- Over 140 delectable dishes to create from 100+ alien ingredients
- 5 alien planets to explore, from the jungle-filled Lush to aquatic Bluegoonia
- 180+ creatures and plants to hunt, harvest, and run away from
- 100+ craftable items for your character, ship, and kitchen
- 150+ furnishings and decorations to personalize your restaurant
- Freedom to create your own menu, opening times, and service style – vegetarian and vegan included!
- A zany cast of characters, including romanceable NPCs with their own favorite recipes and questlines
- A thrilling story of adventure, betrayal, and mass-produced burgers

70010000097080.name: Car Drift Racing Game PRO
70010000097080.intro:
Drift hard race fast rule the streets
Unlock pro cars master every corner
Experience drifting at its finest
70010000097080.description:
Car Drift Racing Game PRO delivers a high-speed drifting experience with realistic physics and exciting action. Learn to control your car in smooth slides as you race through city streets, mountain roads, and more.

Pick from a wide range of powerful cars that you can customize and upgrade. Each vehicle offers a unique feel and performance, giving you new ways to master every track and corner.

The game features smooth and responsive controls that make it easy to jump in and start racing. Whether you're just starting out or already a drifting pro, each race helps improve your skills and push your limits.

Key Features:

Realistic drift mechanics and smooth driving controls
Large variety of cars to unlock, customize, and upgrade
Multiple tracks and environments with increasing challenges
Single-player mode with a built-in progression system
Leaderboards and achievements to track your progress and compete globally
Playable in different screen modes for flexible gameplay
Get ready to drift, race, and rise to the top in Car Drift Racing Game PRO — where your driving skills decide who wins the road.

70010000097085.name: Candylands Journey
70010000097085.intro: Go on a journey to return the Magic Crystal and punish the evil witches!
70010000097085.description:
There is a trouble at the Magic University! The heart of magic has been stolen by Pastry Witches. Go on a journey to their lair to return the Magic Crystal and punish the witches.

Explore 15 colorful locations, look for lost puzzle pieces to open the way to the last boss. Pass through the green meadows, dark caves, deep rivers and oceans, mystic castles, ruins, islands and other colorful locations. Collect jewelry fragments to buy unique types of magic. Collect all the elements and summons. Find all the secrets, destroy all the cake towers and solve all the riddles. All this will help you to win and save the Magic University!

70010000097093.name: World Cup Soccer 2026
70010000097093.intro: Take part to the Soccer 2026 World Cup
70010000097093.description:
Get ready to experience the thrill of international soccer like never before in World Cup Soccer 2026! Whether you're battling it out in a high-stakes World Cup tournament or just enjoying a casual friendly match, this game brings all the excitement of the beautiful game to your console.

Key Features:

- World Cup 2026 Tournament: Take control of your favorite national team and guide them through the ultimate soccer challenge—the World Cup!

- Friendly Matches: Not in the mood for a tournament? Jump into a quick friendly match and choose your teams, stadium, and weather conditions.

- Dynamic Weather Conditions: Change the game with realistic weather settings! Play in the sun, navigate through dense fog, battle against pouring rain, or even face off in the snow.

- 7 Iconic Stadiums: Immerse yourself in 7 breathtaking, detailed stadiums from around the world.

- Extensive Customization: Take control over every detail of your game! Choose from a wide variety of soccer balls, each with its own feel and design, and customize your team's kits, player rosters, and tactics. Create your ideal team and strategy.

- Realistic Gameplay: World Cup Soccer 2026 offers the most authentic soccer experience with lifelike player movements, accurate ball physics, and intuitive controls.

70010000097100.name: The Palace on the Hill
70010000097100.intro: A rural adventure set in fictional 90s India. A heartfelt story of ambition, struggle, and friendship.
70010000097100.description:
Explore ancient palace ruins, set up your garden, cook Indian food, run errands for quirky characters, and learn about your history by making art.

Features:
Vibrant hand-painted watercolour graphics.
Indian Cooking and tea shop management.
A relaxing play style with an open-world exploration and questing.
Over 25 regionally & culturally diverse cast of characters to interact.
A feel-good story of achievement despite social marginalization.
15th century Indian royal palace exploration.

70010000097108.name: Pixel Game Maker Series WEAPON USER
70010000097108.intro:
Weapon-based hand-to-hand combat
A battle filled with the emotions of weapon users begins!
70010000097108.description:
Weapon User is a 2D fighting game that allows players to perform powerful combos with simple controls.
Enjoy single-player gameplay in “STORY MODE” or 1-on-2 player battles in “VERSUS MODE.”

■System
The control buttons consist of weak attack, medium attack, strong attack, special move, super special move, and close combat attack (equivalent to a throw).
Special moves and super special moves can be easily executed by combining directional buttons with the attack buttons.

〇Secret Fist System
A special attack that can be used once per round. It can be canceled from certain normal attacks, and when hit, it allows for relatively easy connections to combo moves or super special moves.

〇Game Modes
You can select from “STORY MODE,” “VERSUS MODE,” and “TRAINING” modes.

〇STORY MODE
Choose one of six characters wielding various weapons such as nunchucks, tonfas, and brass knuckles, and fight your way to victory.
Defeating seven opponents clears the game. If you lose along the way, you can continue as many times as you like.

〇VERSUS MODE
Select a character for each player (1P and 2P) and compete in a battle to determine the winner. You select your character each time you fight.

〇TRAINING
Select a character and practice their moves. You can practice from standing, crouching, and jumping positions.

〇Hidden Elements
Clear “STORY MODE” to unlock hidden elements, including hidden characters and character costumes.

■Story
Weapon Battles are one-on-one duels using specific weapons. Participants are called Weapon Users and were popular among delinquents.
One day, an excessive aggressor who inflicts unnecessary violence on losers after duels, known as the “Breaker,” appears.
Weapon Battles begin centered around the Breaker.

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.

70010000097113.name: KEJORA
70010000097113.intro: When Kejora realizes that her village has been reliving the same day over, she and her friends seek out to try and uncover the origin of the mysterious time loop cursed on her village.
70010000097113.description:
There’s a mystery hidden behind this peaceful village, unknown to its inhabitants, who carry on with their daily lives.

Kejora features hand-drawn art and animation, environmental platformer puzzles, and party-based inspired gameplay with 2 supporting characters with unique skills to help Kejora in her exploration and journey.

Key Features:

◆Beautiful visuals: Immerse yourself in the story, accompanied by stunning, hand-drawn landscapes, characters, and animation.
    
◆Party-based inspired gameplay: Kejora is accompanied by her two friends on her journey, each with their own unique abilities to help Kejora overcome obstacles and puzzles.
  
◆Puzzle platformer adventure: Explore various hand-drawn environments, and with the help of Kejora and her friends, discover items that can help you, solve puzzles, and defeat enemies.

70010000097123.name: Arcade Archives STRATEGY X
70010000097123.intro: Will you go for the aggressive approach or the cautious approach?
70010000097123.description:
"STRATEGY X" is a tank-based shooting game released by KONAMI in 1981.
Move the direction of artillery fire left and right to defeat enemies and replenish fuel while progressing through the stages. 
Aim to destroy the "IMMORTALIAN" waiting at the deepest part.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000097131.name: Hymer 2000
70010000097131.intro: Uncover the secrets of Hope Residence.
70010000097131.description:
Hymer 2000 is an interactive text-based puzzle game. You can converse freely with a computer named Hymer, without being confined to a fixed set of text options. The game features an open-ended search function that allows you to enter any keyword to locate conversational logs between Hymer and others. Throughout this process, you will uncover new keywords, gather clues, collect "faces," and ultimately unveil the secret Hymer has been guarding before shutting it down once and for all.

Game Features: 
- An open-ended conversational system free from predefined text options. 
- Enter any keyword to search for conversational logs between Hymer and others. 
- A well-rounded story connected by 80 illustrations of pareidolic "faces." 
- Interactive mini-games based on algorithms, including "Particle" and "Note." 
- An interface that simulates an operating system.

70010000097138.name: Nightshade Mysteries Eternal Moon Collector's Edition
70010000097138.intro: Archaeologist Helena Nightshade gets entangled in the mysteries surrounding an ominous eternal lunar eclipse!
70010000097138.description:
Set in 1930s Southern Europe, where technology has eclipsed magic, 
an estranged group of Moon Worshippers known as the Anaxagori resurfaces with an ominous prophecy: an eternal lunar eclipse. 
Dismissed by the public as antiquated mystics, the Anaxagori's warnings contrast sharply with the populace's enthusiasm for what is hailed as a historic celestial event. 
Fresh from an archaeological expedition, Helena Nightshade only learns of the eclipse's significance upon arriving in Istanbul.

- Follow the story of Helena Nightshade
- Solve the mystery of the Eternal Lunar Eclipse
- Travel through 1930s Southern Europe
- 35 chapters with 1-3 sub scenes
- 29 subgames relating to the story
- 6 special chapters

70010000097142.name: Tamagotchi Plaza Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000097142.intro: A shop simulator game nurturing dreams in the Tamagotchi world!
70010000097142.description:
Tamagotchi Plaza is coming to Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch™ 2!

Tamagotchi Plaza is set in Tamahiko Town on Tamagotchi Planet.

Treat cavities at the Dentist. Make the perfect pair of glasses at the Eyewear Shop. Create table settings of sweets and drinks to fulfill customer orders at the Afternoon Tea Shop. Help serve Tamagotchi at unique shops!
The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition adds three new shops with mouse controls, bringing the total number of shops to 15.

Grow your shops’ reputations, enticing new Tamagotchi to visit your shops!

You can also interact with Tamagotchi, solving their problems and making the shops thrive and the town super lively!

In addition, for the first time in the series, Offline two player mode is available for some shops!

Let's have fun with family and friends♪

*If you already own Tamagotchi Plaza for the Nintendo Switch, you do not need to purchase this item. You can upgrade to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition by purchasing the Tamagotchi Plaza - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack. Please take care to avoid duplicate purchases.

70010000097148.name: STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000097148.intro: Build your farm in Zephyr Town and breathe new life into the once-famous bazaar
70010000097148.description:
Bring the winds of change to Zephyr Town
Build your farm in Zephyr Town and breathe new life into the once-famous bazaar. Set up your stall to sell produce and goods from the crops and animals you raise on your farm, and meet charming townsfolk to befriend and romance as you help the close-knit community thrive.

Key Features

■Breathe the refreshing alpine air!
Begin your idyllic new life on a farm and enjoy the daily rhythms of rural living. Nurture a variety of crops and care for adorable animals in the picturesque mountainside settlement of Zephyr Town.

■Soar to Success in the Weekly Bazaar
Sell your farm's produce and goods at the lively weekly bazaar. Customize your stall and take charge of your sales to build buzz, power up profits and put Zephyr Town’s Grand Bazaar back on the map. 

■An Easy-Breezy New Life 
Harness the power of the wind! Catch a breeze to effortlessly drift across the town on your glider, and use windmills to gather those gusts to create new goodies to sell at the bazaar.

■Love is in the Air
Meet the cherished community of Zephyr Town with a colorful cast of characters, from friendly townsfolk to magical nature sprites. Find friendship, fall in love, and maybe even start a family with one of twelve charming individuals ready to share this new chapter with you.


*Those playing on Nintendo Switch™ 2 will experience the title in a higher resolution with improved frame rates, along with Joy-Con 2 mouse controls.
*Features and content of Nintendo Switch 2 Edition games can only be played on Nintendo Switch 2.

70010000097150.name: Don't Shoot First!
70010000097150.intro: Face off in the Wild West and prove you’ve got the reflexes to win. Draw too soon and you lose. Wait too long... it’s over.
70010000097150.description:
About This Game
Face off in Don't Shoot First, a Wild West duel where timing is everything. Draw too soon, you lose. Wait too long… it’s over. Do you have the nerves to hold back and the reflexes to strike at the perfect moment?

Put on your cowboy hat and step into the pixelated Wild West, where every duel is a nerve-wracking showdown. Don't Shoot First challenges you to outwit your opponent by waiting for that perfect, split-second opportunity. But beware—draw too soon, and you’ll lose. Wait too long, and your opponent won’t hesitate to take the shot.

Key Features:

Intense One-on-One Duels: Experience the thrill of Western standoffs with pixel-perfect timing.

Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Simple controls make it easy to jump in, but only the most patient gunslingers will dominate.

Pixel Art Western Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a retro-style Wild West, complete with detailed pixel art scenes that bring classic Western towns to life.

Quick, Addictive Gameplay: Perfect for short gaming sessions, each duel will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Are you ready to become a legend of the Wild West… or will you make the fatal mistake of shooting first?

70010000097158.name: Shadow Labyrinth Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000097158.description:
Pre-order now and get the following content:
- Original Arcade SFX DLC

Change the in-game sounds for MINI-PUCK mode to the original PAC-MAN sound effects.

*You can change this setting from the Options menu.
*The bonus may be given at a later date.

Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Includes:
• Shadow Labyrinth
• Shadow Labyrinth Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
 
Shadow Labyrinth is a 2D action platformer and a genre-twisting alternate take on the iconic PAC-MAN.

As Swordsman No. 8, awoken by a floating yellow orb, PUCK, on a mysterious planet amidst relics of wars past, you are chosen to become the instrument of its will.

To survive you will discover many secrets, consume your enemies, and grow from prey to the apex predator as you embrace your true purpose.

Discover a World of Secrets
Search the remnants of an age-old intergalactic conflict, started long before your arrival, and discover new powers and abilities. Use them to traverse an alien world as you battle dangerous creatures and evolved monstrosities.

Become the Apex Predator
Master the fluid combat and combine powerful skills to create a playstyle of your own. Use different abilities to turn the tables on your enemies as you consume them and grow from prey to apex predator.

Embrace Your True Purpose
Team up with PUCK, and dive deeper into the maze of a mysterious alien world. Find out the truth behind your presence here, what does PUCK want, and why it chose you.

*This is the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. Please note that there is also the Standard Edition and Deluxe Edition available, so please be careful of duplicate purchases.

70010000097163.name: BeatQuest - Rhythm Riders
70010000097163.intro: Hit every note. Own every stage
70010000097163.description:
The crowd’s roaring, the lights are blinding—there’s no turning back.
With your guitar in hand and every note flying toward you, it’s all or nothing. BeatQuest – Rhythm Riders throws you into a rhythm-fueled rock showdown where precision and timing electrify the stage.

Play with skill, hit flawless combos, and unlock new songs as your legend grows with every performance. This isn’t just about music—it’s about earning the spotlight.

Key Features:

* Fast-paced rhythm gameplay – Follow the beat, nail the notes, and light up the crowd.

* Progress & unlocks – Beat songs with high scores to unlock new tracks and stages.

* Epic rock soundtrack – Crank up a curated list of powerful rock songs.

* Live audience reactions – Your fans cheer louder the better you play.

* Stylized visuals – A vibrant 2D stage setup with slick feedback and effects.

Master the rhythm. Ignite the stage. Make every chord count.

70010000097168.name: The Edge of Allegoria
70010000097168.intro: Turn-based RPG, inspired by classic titles from the golden age of handheld gaming. But make no mistake: This ain't no f@#%ing kid's game.
70010000097168.description:
Do you like adventure? Are you a sucker for a world of monsters and magic?

Do you like wholesale violence peppered with coarse language, and served with a side of pixelated booty?

Then buckle up, you legend. We're going for a ride...

Get ready to travel far and wide, taking on creatures of all shapes and sizes in classic turn-based fashion, while discovering the secrets and adventures that Allegoria has in store.

Harvest the body parts of your adversaries for financial gain and personal satisfaction, level up to strike down even greater foes, and arm yourself with more weapons and equipment than any sane person could be reasonably expected to carry on their person at any given time.

There are more than 144 unique enemies to face on your adventures through Allegoria, from ferocious Canadian geese and majestic tortoises to your bog-standard fantasy staples like dragons, unicorns, and the ever-ubiquitous slimes! There are plenty of beasts and beyond to encounter, each with unique item drops that can be sold in shops for the gold you'll need to purchase weapons and equipment to aid you on your journey.

Have you ever played a game that has one weapon you just can't put down, or an armor set that makes you indestructible? It's a great feeling, isn't it?

Too bad that's not the case here.

In Allegoria, if you want to get stronger, you'll need to master as much equipment as you can if you want to increase your stats, and if you think you need new attacks or magic spells to bring with you into battle, you'd better replace that old gear with something new, and fast. With more than 80 skills to learn and almost 150 pieces of equipment to collect, you'll want to try them all to find the right move set for you!

There's no shortage of personality in Allegoria, and everyone seems to have something to say. Most of it's just fluff to fill in empty spaces and make the world seem more lifelike, but every once in a while, someone actually has something useful to say.

They may be a little rough around the edges, but the people of Allegoria are always willing to guide you on your journey, and they might even have a quest or two for you to earn gold and other helpful items.

There's a story in there somewhere... it's just buried under layers of madness and debauchery.

If you think grinding for experience and mastering weapons is tedious, try to unravel this Gordian knot of a narrative.

Does it have a deeper meaning? Absolutely!

Does it matter? No! It's a video game! Just enjoy it and stop worrying about what kind of subliminal messaging the developer is trying to inject into your subconscious...

If you're a fan of retro handheld RPGs with a 2-bit pixel art aesthetic but are tired of the same played-out, stereotypical, fantasy adventure, then be sure to pick up The Edge of Allegoria today for a refreshing take on the genre that influenced a generation!

70010000097173.name: DeadZone: Survival Ops Zombie Shooter
70010000097173.intro: The city falls, the dead rise—your survival is all that matters.
70010000097173.description:
Step into a world overrun by the undead, where survival is the ultimate challenge. In DeadZone: Survival Ops Zombie Shooter, you’ll face relentless waves of zombies in fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled combat. Every shot counts, every decision matters, and only the sharpest, fastest, and smartest will make it through the chaos.

Loot valuable chests, discover unique abilities, and unleash the Upgrade System to transform your weapons into devastating tools of destruction. Collect Survival Points from every kill and invest them in critical upgrades to suit your own playstyle, from aggressive firepower to strategic defense. Navigate multiple danger zones by helicopter—but make sure you’ve got the fuel, or it could be your last trip.

Key Features:

- Intense arcade-style FPS zombie combat
- Powerful weapon upgrades via the Upgrade system
- Tactical gadgets: traps, grenades, and fully customizable loadouts
- Survival Points for progression, skills, and abilities
- Immersive post-apocalyptic maps filled with hidden dangers and surprises

The undead are everywhere, and the city is collapsing around you. Every encounter tests your reflexes, strategy, and nerve. Gear up, fight back, and prove you have what it takes to survive the DeadZone—or be consumed by it.

70010000097178.name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
70010000097178.intro: The ultimate competitive platformer is back! Cutthroat online and local races.
70010000097178.description:
THE NEXT GENERATION OF SPEEDRUNNERS
The original multiplayer gameplay formula of SpeedRunners is timeless. With the sequel, our goal is to carefully bring this unique ‘SpeedRunners feel’ into the new era without compromising on the depth and fluidity of the movement system while still keeping it easy to grasp. On top of that, King of Speed introduces vibrant high-definition graphics and improved netcode.

GOTTA GO FAST
SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed is a fast-paced competitive platformer and a sequel to one of the most beloved indie games of the 2010s. Pick a character of your choice from a vibrant cast of eccentric superheroes, both returning and new, and face off against your rivals in frenetic running races for up to 4 players per lobby, locally or online.

BE THE LAST ONE RUNNING
Your goal is to get ahead by any means necessary and cling to the first place as your opponents get consumed, one by one, by an ever-shrinking ring of fire. Prepare to run like your life depends on it, across multiple beautiful tracks set in a retrofuturistic world inspired by the superhero utopia of the 1960s.

FAST AND FURIOUS
Knock rivals off-screen and eliminate the competition by using powerful pick-ups like missiles, traps, freezing rays, or a golden grappling hook that allows you to pull runners in front of you.  Ruin friendships, break controllers, and make split-second decisions on your way to becoming the true King of Speed!

MASTER COMPETITIVE PLATFORMING
Learn the layout of expertly crafted maps and master the intuitive yet deep movement mechanics. Memorize the locations of booster pads, pick-ups, wall jumping sections, obstacles, blue ceilings that you can grapple to, and levers to open or close pathways. Run, jump, slide, and swing to victory!

RUN AS YOU ARE
SpeedRunners 2 is a competitive game that can be enjoyed casually but has a high skill ceiling, allowing you to hone your speedrunning prowess for hundreds of hours. Join a dedicated community to participate in tournaments, create custom challenges, and climb the leaderboards, or host a private lobby with your buddies for some laid-back PvP fun.

70010000097191.name: CatTerror, the abandoned house
70010000097191.intro: Dive into this horror and survival experience.
70010000097191.description:
On a pitch-black night, screams echo from the house next door. It’s the same place where a series of mysterious murders occurred years ago. Drawn by curiosity, you step inside and descend into a living nightmare. A demonic entity lurks within, determined to consume your very soul.

Forced to explore every room in search of answers and survival, you must collect pages from an old journal that reveal ancient massacres and forbidden rituals from centuries past. As the truth unfolds, so does your fate. Gather the necessary items to complete a desperate exorcism and escape the monstrous force that hunts you.

70010000097194.name: Mystery Hotel: Hidden Objects
70010000097194.intro: Solve the riddle of the mysterious murder at the Hotel Noir
70010000097194.description:
Try out the role of a detective - solve the riddle of the Hotel Noir!
A quiet, picturesque nook, hidden in the highlands of Western Europe. Your arrival at Hotel is clouded by a mysterious murder and only you can get to the truth!
Conduct an investigation like a real detective - collect clues, talk to witnesses and most of all, remember -- don't trust anyone!

Features:
- A variety of tasks: searching for items, spotting the differences, puzzles, restoration of disassembled objects
- Build your collection. Go through scenes again to try new quests and get new rewards!
- Various modes. Play as you like, relax or challenge!

70010000097205.name: Goodnight Universe
70010000097205.description: You are Isaac, a 6-month-old baby, developing mysterious psychic powers. What you want most is to be loved and accepted by your family, but a secretive tech corporation wants you for their own.

70010000097210.name: EGGCONSOLE Revival Xanadu Easy Ver PC-9801
70010000097210.intro: Search for the legendary sword “Dragon Slayer” and defeat the dragon! Now with enhanced graphics and BGM compared to the original version.
70010000097210.description:
This is a remake of the real-time action RPG "Xanadu," originally released in Japan by Nihon Falcom in 1985, and released in Japan in 1995, ten years after the original. Players become adventurers and explore all 10 stages while battling monsters, with the ultimate goal of defeating the King Dragon.

Combat uses symbol encounters. Monster contact starts battles where players fight with weapon attacks (body slams) and magic. Defeating foes spawns treasure chests with items and money. Monsters are finite; they vanish when hunted out.

The character development system powers up weapons and magic with use. Players have warrior and mage experience/levels, growing towards either style based on attack type. Weapons, armor, and magic also gain experience, improving with use. Weapon or magic choice matters. Since monsters are finite, development and item management are key to character/item growth.

This revival version enhances various aspects of the original. Graphics are upgraded to 400 lines and 16 colors for greater vibrancy! The BGM is also improved, with different music for each level and dedicated tracks even within towers. Furthermore, this version features a map function, allowing players to check terrain and monster locations at any time, aiding their adventure.

"Revival Xanadu" retains the original's difficulty while enhancing graphics and BGM, and improves playability with the map function. This exemplary revival, a model for remakes, is highly regarded by many retro game fans.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000097213.name: Super Mining Mechs
70010000097213.intro: Dig deeper, harder and faster as you race to claim natural resources on a new world!
70010000097213.description:
Get ready for an underground adventure! Earth has run out of natural resources and it's up to you to find alternatives. Travel to another planet and explore the underground in your mining mech. Complete missions to unlock new parts or sell your loot for cold hard cash.

Super Mining Mechs is a side-scrolling action game with resource management and sim elements. As you tunnel through the earth and locate ores and other resources, you can send them back up to the surface to meet your mining objectives.

Unlock new excavation sites on the planetary map as you progress. Explore new depths, collect all the elements, complete missions and upgrade your mech to dig faster and carry more collectibles!

Includes the "Toxic Treasures" special story campaign.

• Jump into your mech and dig underground!
• Complete mining objectives to progress through the story.
• Earn money by selling ores or upgrade your machinery!
• Unlock new mechs to increase speed, power and capacity.
• Enjoy pixel art aesthetics and retro side-scrolling gameplay!

70010000097218.name: Phantom Kiosk
70010000097218.intro: Something’s Cooking… and It’s Not Just the Food.
70010000097218.description:
Welcome to Ghost Kiosk, where the grill is hot, the coffee’s warm, and something just isn’t quite right. You’ve landed the night shift at a lonely little food stand tucked away on a rainy corner—and while the hours are quiet, the atmosphere is anything but.

As you whip up late-night snacks and serve the occasional drenched customer, strange things begin to creep into your routine. A flickering light here, a whisper over the radio there… and those customers? They seem to know a little too much about you.

Keep the orders coming, keep your cool, and try not to look too long into the shadows. Behind every receipt and every soda pour, there’s a story waiting to be told. Will you crack the mystery behind the kiosk’s eerie past—or become part of it?

70010000097223.name: Supermarket Simulator 2025
70010000097223.intro: Because every empire starts with a teddy bear.
70010000097223.description:
Step into the world of retail and take charge of your very own supermarket in Supermarket Simulator 2025! Start small and work your way up, managing inventory, setting prices, and keeping customers happy. Whether it's stocking shelves with everyday essentials or the latest must-have toys, your decisions shape the success of your store.

Customize your supermarket’s layout, hire and train staff, and ensure smooth day-to-day operations. Handle online orders, make deliveries by scooter, and trade rare items to boost profits. Keep an eye on security, deal with unexpected events, and create a shopping experience that keeps customers coming back.

Can you turn a humble store into a thriving retail empire? The doors are open, and the business is in your hands!

70010000097228.name: REAL ESTATE Simulator - FROM BUM TO MILLIONAIRE
70010000097228.intro: Buy, renovate, sell — rule the real estate market.
70010000097228.description:
Embark on an exhilarating journey to build your real estate empire in "Real Estate Simulator," a deep and dynamic business simulation game. Begin as a small-time property investor and strategize your way to become a tycoon in the cutthroat world of real estate. Navigate market trends, negotiate deals, and outsmart competitors in this immersive simulation experience.
- From Broke to Rich: Embark on a journey from Broke to Rich, developing skills and overcoming challenges with unwavering determination.
Start with a tent as your first home.
- Interactive NPC Negotiations: Engage with a range of NPC clients, from cautious first-time buyers to wealthy investors. Understand their needs, negotiate terms, and close deals that shape your path to success.
- Property Development and Management: Purchase, renovate, and sell properties across the city. From cheap living areas to luxury skyscrapers, each property brings unique challenges and opportunities.
- Intuitive Controls and UI: Whether you're a seasoned tycoon or new to business sims, intuitive controls and a clear user interface make managing your empire accessible and enjoyable.
- Unique Challenges and Achievements: From market crashes to VIP clients, face unique challenges that test your strategic prowess. 
Unlock achievements and make your mark in the world of real estate.

70010000097239.name: Supermarket Anime Collector's Simulator
70010000097239.intro: From cashier to legend — in true anime style!
70010000097239.description: Step into the adorable world of Super Kawaii Market, where you run the cutest supermarket in town! Manage shelves, serve delightful customers, and keep your store stocked with charming products. From bustling checkout lines to unique customer interactions, every day brings new challenges and opportunities to grow your kawaii empire. Unlock upgrades, improve your operations, and become the ultimate shopping destination in this fun and wholesome management game!

70010000097244.name: Devil Jam
70010000097244.intro: Devil Jam is a top-down survivor roguelite where you play a rockstar wielding up to 12 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of monsters.
70010000097244.description:
Get ready to mosh in Devil Jam, a survivor-like roguelite in the fiery depths of Hell. After signing a cursed contract with the Devil, you're dragged to the underworld and forced to perform the gig of your afterlife. Armed with possessed instruments and a soul full of riffs, fight off endless waves of deranged fans, vicious mobs, and hellish rivals. Every run is a new jam session, with numerous challenges and a unique 12-slot inventory system offering near-infinite build variety. Master the combat, harness the power of metal, and rise to claim your place as the greatest metal icon, by defeating Death himself.

Key Features:
- Deep Inventory Strategy: A unique 12-slot gear system where positioning matters and synergies reign.
- Hand-Drawn Hellscapes: Stylish, animated characters and effects bring the underworld to life.
- Face the Iconic: Take on powerful bosses, including the ultimate metal singer: Death.
- Fast-Paced Runs: Immerse yourself in rapid, intense underworld battles. Test your skills and survival instincts in action-packed showdowns, ensuring you're always on the edge of your seat.

70010000097249.name: 7th Domain ： Tree of Chaos
70010000097249.intro: Fight, Die, and Rise Again！Step into a world of Roguelike × Metroidvania, where thrilling combat meets endless loot-hunting.
70010000097249.description:
Over 20 hours of non-repetitive main story: On top of that, roguelike replayability with unlockable world difficulties.

70 maps and 168 events: Explore a vast, interconnected world—from shadowy caves to crumbling castles and blazing volcanoes. Face towering bosses that stand between you and destiny.
 
Classic loot system: Randomized drops, limitless affix combinations, and rare weapons that can even alter your skills.
 
152 talents and 34 skills: Mix and match freely to craft a playstyle that’s truly your own.
 
In this world, failure fuels progress. Collect loot, die, rise, and fight again.
Will you, the child of destiny, restore balance to a shattered world?

70010000097254.name: Death Mask
70010000097254.intro: A series of murders follows a mysterious ritual dance in rural China.
70010000097254.description:
A narrative mystery game set around rural Chinese religious rituals and serial murders. When ancient beliefs and modern horror collide, can you uncover the truth behind the mask?

A rich and fully realized story unfolds like an interactive novel. Multiple choices and branching paths lead to dramatically different endings.

Investigate every clue, gather scattered pieces of information, and experience the thrill of intense cross-examinations as you piece together the truth behind the mystery—step by step!

70010000097259.name: AirJet Fighter : Sky Assault
70010000097259.description:
When the sky turns hostile, only the fastest pilots survive.

In AirJet Fighter: Sky Assault, you're at the helm of a cutting-edge jet, flying into dangerous missions where every second counts. Engage in thrilling aerial combat, lock onto enemy aircraft, dodge incoming missiles, and unleash devastating firepower across dynamic landscapes. From open seas to city skylines, each battlefield challenges your reflexes and precision.

Upgrade your aircraft, customize your arsenal, and master multiple game modes—from story-driven campaigns to survival showdowns and timed strike missions. With smooth controls, immersive visuals, and adrenaline-pumping action, this isn’t just a flight—it’s an all-out sky assault.

Main Features:

-High-speed jet combat with smooth, responsive flight mechanics

-Campaign mode with progressive challenges and rewards

-Survival and Time Attack modes to test your skills under pressure

-Realistic 3D jet models and atmospheric battle zones


Take flight, dominate the skies, and write your legacy as an elite air combat pilot.

70010000097264.name: Century of Anticipation
70010000097264.intro:
Locked away at home, time slows to a crawl.
Enjoy our gift to you, this delightful adventure with an unforgettable soundtrack by Brazilian artists.
70010000097264.description:
You are locked at home, eagerly anticipating the moment to step outside again.

Only it's....

.

.

.

.

...taking really long.



In this tiny world filled with surprising interactions awaiting to be discovered, you must find ways to pass the time by engaging with various activities around the house, as you deal with the only company you have in this adventure: yourself.

AS THE CLOCK TICKS AWAY...

Deal with the slow passage of time in a short, visually striking adventure developed by musician and game designer Gools

Explore the confines of your home and reach up to four different endings.

Experience a unique soundtrack composed by artists from Recife, Brazil.

Find and take part in a variety of activities around the house to make time pass!

Try your hand at poetry... and send it to us! Or keep it to yourself, it's your choice!

Play an instrument. Maybe get better at it?

Explore your bedroom, take a nap, make a snack...

...AND ENTER THE REALMS OF YOUR OWN THOUGHTS.

70010000097271.name: Square Brothers
70010000097271.intro: Two bandit brothers, One epic heist!
70010000097271.description:
Two sly siblings, one crazy platforming heist- ready to steal everything that shines?

Team up with two green-skinned burglar brothers on a quest for glittering gold. Switch between the tall, lanky thief to reach elevated platforms, and his short, stocky accomplice to slip under narrow gaps. Only by using their unique shapes together can you collect every shiny treasure, snag the key, and escape to the exit.

Are you cunning enough to clear 40 brain-teasing levels of puzzle-platformer mayhem?

Let the heist begin!


Features:
* Clever 2D puzzle-platforming
* Colorful pixel art style
* Tag-team between two distinct thieves
* 40 challenging stages
* 16:9 and 4:3 aspect ratio modes
* CRT Shader option

70010000097274.name: Inkventure
70010000097274.intro: A slimy dad on a gooey rescue mission!
70010000097274.description:
A lazy afternoon turns chaotic when a mysterious bucket sucks Gloop’s four mischievous kids into a vibrant, color-filled dimension. Now it's up to him—a lovable slime and single dad—to jump inside, master the art of color shifting, and rescue his quirky children!

Match Gloop’s color to the floors as you carefully navigate each stage. Watch your step, because touching the wrong color spells disaster! Shift between green, red, blue, and yellow by touching buckets filled with colorful ink to safely reach Gloop’s adorable kids and bring them back home.

Along the way, you’ll encounter tricky obstacles. Push boxes matching Gloop’s current color to climb higher platforms, and open locked doors by finding and activating levers of the correct color to advance your journey.

Ready to jump, splash, and slime your way through the ink dimension? Gloop’s family depends on you!

Features:
* Delightful 2D puzzle-platforming action
* Charming, colorful pixel-art visuals
* Color-changing mechanics
* 40 challenging levels
* Family-friendly story featuring lovable slime characters across numerous cutscenes
* Optional Time Rewind feature - fix your mistakes!
* Supports both 16:9 and 4:3 aspect ratio modes
* Optional CRT shader for retro visuals

70010000097277.name: Battle Train
70010000097277.description:
ROGUELITE ON RAILS
Battle Train brings classic roguelite design to the tracks with fast-paced duels, branching paths, and floor-based progression packed with bosses, special events, and escalating stakes.
Each run is a strategic loop of resource management, risk-reward decisions, and deck refinement as you unlock powerful cards, new characters, and upgrades in the evolving metagame.
 
LINES OF TRACK, LINES OF FIRE
In Battle Train, strategy isn't just in your hand, it’s under your wheels. 
Connect your tracks to your opponents’ outposts and blast them before they do the same to you.
Every piece of track matters: special rails boost your trains, barricades slow down enemies, and bombs can swing the tide with a single move.
Positioning is power, but so is control. Claim resource mines for turn-based income, steal enemy tracks to cut their flow, or detonate their plans with explosive abilities.

CHOOSE MAYHEM
Adapt your playstyle in every run and then push it further, with evolving card rewards and powerful upgrades that shape your strategy turn by turn.
Your train is a full-blown war machine built from swappable parts, each offering unique stat boosts, passive effects, mineral gains, or disruptive abilities.
 
JOIN THE MOST CHAOTIC GAMESHOW EVER
As a contender, you’ll face a madcap gauntlet of rival Champions, explosive challenges, and surprise rewards.
Meet eccentric hosts, unlock unexpected lore, and witness the downfall of Supreme Champion Aalvado.
Whether you're in it for the 15-hour story mode or 100+ hours of replayability, Battle Train is a tale of redemption, rivalry, and rekindling your creative passion… through destruction!

70010000097291.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Deokjeok-do
70010000097291.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Deokjeok-do Island, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 3 flight courses in 3 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000097317.name: R.E.P.O Horror
70010000097317.intro: Search the dark. Sell what you find. Survive what finds you.
70010000097317.description:
Step into the haunted remnants of forgotten facilities, where danger lurks in every shadow and profit hides in plain sight. In R.E.P.O Horror, your task is clear: locate valuable objects hidden throughout eerie, monster-infested locations and sell them to survive and advance.

But nothing is ever truly safe.
With every passing moment, the threat grows. The longer you stay, the more intense the horror becomes.

Key Features:
	•	Tense Exploration – Navigate pitch-black environments using only your flashlight. Every sound, every shadow could hide something valuable—or something deadly.
	•	Scavenge and Profit – Collect items of varying value and condition. Handle them carefully to avoid damage and maximize earnings.
	•	Escalating Danger – Hostile entities appear the longer you remain on the map. Time is against you—move quickly or face the consequences.
	•	Energy and Survival – Sprinting drains your energy. Rest is possible, but risky. Strategic stamina management is essential.
	•	High-Stakes Decisions – Risk staying longer for greater rewards, or escape early with what you’ve got? Every choice matters.
	•	Unlockable Skins – Spend your hard-earned cash to unlock new character appearances and show off your survival style.

Can you make it out with your findings? Or will the darkness claim you first?

70010000097326.name: THE LOST DINO: SURVIVAL EXPEDITION
70010000097326.intro: The jungle hides more than predators.
70010000097326.description:
THE LOST DINO: SURVIVAL EXPEDITION throws you into a deadly prehistoric jungle where survival means outsmarting nature’s fiercest predators. Explore abandoned research sites, scavenge vital supplies, and evade relentless dinosaurs using stealth, strategy, and the environment.
Use tools and weapons to create distractions or defend yourself briefly. A mysterious voice on the radio offers cryptic guidance as you uncover the island’s dark secrets.

Key Features
	•	Immersive Survival Horror: Confront deadly prehistoric creatures in a tense, jungle setting.
	•	Exploration & Discovery: Uncover secrets hidden in abandoned labs and wild terrain.
	•	Tactical Survival: Gather supplies, craft tools, and use stealth to evade predators.
	•	Smart Enemies: Study dinosaur behavior to adapt and survive evolving threats.
	•	Mystery Unfolds: Follow cryptic radio messages to unravel the island’s dark secrets.
	•	High-Stakes Encounters: Every decision counts against relentless, hunting predators.
	•	Atmospheric Tension: A moody, immersive world where danger lurks in every shadow.

Every encounter is a test of wit and courage. In a world where every shadow may hide a killer, your mind is your greatest weapon.

70010000097333.name: SHUTEN ORDER Visual Artbook and Mini Soundtrack
70010000097333.description:
SHUTEN ORDER Visual Artbook
This product is an artbook featuring character design and background sketches from the game, including many never-before-seen visuals. Through detailed illustrations, you can experience the aesthetic and explore the world of SHUTEN ORDER.

SHUTEN ORDER Mini Soundtrack
This product is a mini soundtrack featuring 12 tracks from the game's music.
Some of the track titles are related to the game's story.

*These are additional contents for SHUTEN ORDER, but they are not included in the base game.
*The contents of this product are exclusive to users who purchase the Deluxe Edition bundle.

70010000097337.name: Superation
70010000097337.intro: Fight Thor and and earn your place among the Aesir. Unlock new blessings from the gods and complete challenges to unlock the wisdom of the runes
70010000097337.description:
Superation is a challenging boxing rogue-like that combines a precise fast-paced boxing combat with the replayability and unlockables that rogue-likes offer in a 9 bosses boss-rush, all while exploring the self improvement philosophy.

Fight the Einherjar, your siblings and your own father to get your place among the Aesir

You are Thoridar, the weak bastard child of Thor and a Jotunn. He banished you into Jotunheim and forbid you to live among the Aesir because of your weakness. Prove him wrong using your fist and the blessings of the Aesir pantheon while growing stronger using the Wyrdforge

Relax on Jotunheim
Upgrade your punches with the help of Völundr, a Jotunn that can touch the wyrd using his Wyrdforge and help you shape your destiny; and discover what the runes foretold with the help of the Norns Verdandi, Urd and Skuld. And you might even get some visit in there once in a while

Unleash your rage
The Aesir consider you one of them and have your back! Get the blessings of Freyja, Baldr, Loki, the Allfather Odin and many more to enhance your punches or get you special abilities. There are thousands of combinations to discover, progress through the fights and complete challenges to unlock new blessings from them or the runes

Build for replayability
A more challenging path awaits you in The Path of the Aesir: Tune in the challenges to fit you and beware of the great power of the bosses. Use the Wyrdforge to grow permanently stronger and give yourself more chances to defeat them.

The Aesir blood flows through you
Permanent upgrades mean you don't have to be an Aesir yourself to experience the exciting and precise combat. But if you happen to be one, The Path of the Aesir awaits you

What are you waiting for, Midgardian?

70010000097339.name: Memory Rewind
70010000097339.intro: Embark on a thrilling detective visual novel with your quirky assistant, Olivina, featuring unique investigations and a diverse cast of characters.
70010000097339.description:
Step into the life of a self-proclaimed detective. Along with your quirky assistant Olivina, take on a seemingly ordinary case, until you unravel its hidden twists and turns that pull you through a thrilling, unique story. 

Game Features: 
• Unique investigation gameplay that challenges players to be observant 
• Diverse cast of characters 
• Smooth 2D animation that breathes life into the characters 
• Stylized, hand-drawn CG for players to unlock and collect

70010000097344.name: Tiny Pixels Vol. 2 - Stormy Knights
70010000097344.intro: Save the princesses at all costs as you infiltrate castles filled with treacherous foes!
70010000097344.description:
Step into the armored boots of an overzealous knight as you fight across the continent rescuing princesses from monstrous captors in Stormy Knights! Strategic real-time combat ensues as you storm the halls of each castle in side-scrolling pixel art style, from medieval Europe and mystical Persia to feudal Japan and more, all accompanied by an original retro soundtrack!

Slash, dodge, defend and overcome minions like goblins and lizardmen to reach the boss of the castle, and if you emerge victorious, you’ll win the affection of a fair maiden imprisoned within.

Collect valuable golden medals to purchase upgrades across 3 skill trees and stack the deck in your favor for subsequent runs. How long can you keep up this personal crusade as you survive against seemingly impossible odds?

• Slash, dodge and block enemy attacks using your sword and shield!
• Observe enemy tactics and strategically dispatch them in real-time encounters.
• Face off against brutal bosses in each enemy stronghold!
• Collect golden medals to purchase upgrades across 3 skill trees.
• Enjoy a blood-pumping retro soundtrack and fluid pixel art animation!

70010000097350.name: Artifact Seekers
70010000097350.description:
Take part in the new adventurous TV show! We designed unique puzzles and locations special for you. Prove yourself worthy of the love of the audience!

“Artifact Seekers” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests. 

Have you ever dreamed of fame and glory? Your time has come! Try your hand at living under the spotlight in the brand new TV show — Artifact Seekers. The whole season of adventures is ready to impress you.
Take on other players to win the love of the audience. Explore carefully designed locations, talk to the helpers, and solve challenging puzzles. Earn as many stars as possible using your intelligence, and reach the quest goals showing perseverance. The viewers of the show will love it!

- Choose a couple, that will go to the goal together. Think outside the box, show ingenuity, and the victory is in your pocket!
- Strive for excellence to take the top spot among other players.
- Explore whole worlds with each new episode, carefully collecting local curiosities.
- Enjoy stunning locations and beautiful soundtracks
- Solve dozens of puzzles and test yourself in exciting mini-games

70010000097355.name: Make it! Sushi
70010000097355.intro:
Make delicious sushi and become a sushi chef!
Work quickly and accurately to fill as many sushi orders as possible!
70010000097355.description:
Take on an authentic sushi-making challenge on the Nintendo Switch™!
Pick the right toppings for each order, pair them with vinegared rice, and serve them up!
Skill and speed make all the difference!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Make and serve as much sushi as you can within the time limit!
Earn bonus points by filling orders without any mistakes!
The key is to work efficiently! Keep an eye on which toppings and how much rice remain!

《How to Play》
1. Check the orders!

2. Slice toppings that need to be prepared ahead of time!

3. Select a topping and make sushi!

[Score Attack]
Work as fast and accurately as you can to see how many orders you can fill within the time limit!
Aim for a high score and climb to the top of the global leaderboards!

[Battle]
Battle it out in sushi showdowns with up to 4 players!
Compete in speed, accuracy, and skill to see who's the true sushi master!

70010000097360.name: NOROI KAGO the Grudged Domain
70010000097360.intro:
—A Sealed Realm of “Curses”— Can You Escape the Grudged Domain?
Team Up to Escape—A 4-Player Survival Horror Challenge
70010000097360.description:
This is a 1–4 player co-op survival horror escape game based on the Japanese anime “GeGeGe no Kitaro.”
Run, hide, and at times become a decoy for your teammates as you attempt to escape from the Grudged domain.

70010000097365.name: Card Quest
70010000097365.intro: A deeply strategic game featuring an adorable feline hero! Dive into rich elemental builds, face randomized gear upgrades and breakthroughs, and master a unique core mechanic in every cha
70010000097365.description:
-Deep Tactical Dungeon-Crawling
-A Cozy, Gothic Art Style
-Unique Core Gameplay Per Chapter
-Random Events Triggered While Exploring
-Dream Wheel: Spin for Awesome Chest Loot
-A Spicy Challenge Mode: Strategy Meets Speedrun
-Three Escalating Difficulties: Normal, Hard & Abyss, Each with New Rules

70010000097378.name: Bodycam Stray Kitty
70010000097378.intro: Furry, fun, and full of surprises.
70010000097378.description:
Get ready for the life of a stray cat where boredom doesn’t exist. Complete quirky and fun tasks: kick a ball, interact with other cats, find items, jump around, dig, and explore.

Every mission is a chance to create a bit of chaos in cozy yet unpredictable urban landscapes. How you tackle the tasks is up to you — cleverly, playfully… or just with pure cat attitude.

Be free, be curious — and show the world that even an ordinary backyard can become the stage for unforgettable adventures.

70010000097383.name: Digging A Hole 2025
70010000097383.intro: The earth holds secrets—will you find them?
70010000097383.description:
Embark on an exciting journey into the hidden depths of your backyard! Your goal is to dig deeper, discover unique artifacts, sell them, and upgrade your tools to progress further in this thrilling adventure. Each new item you find will bring you closer to an ancient secret buried beneath the earth.

There’s no rush or strict rules here — just you, your equipment, and endless possibilities for exploration. Dive into uncharted layers, collect valuable resources, trade them, and enhance your tools to uncover everything hidden deep beneath the surface.

Game Features:
• Endless Excavations: The deeper you dig, the more amazing discoveries you’ll make. Each find brings you closer to solving the mystery!
• Economy and Trade: Sell your discoveries to buy more powerful equipment that will open up access to new, unexplored areas.
• Tool Upgrades: Improve your tools and equipment to keep digging deeper and uncovering rare and unique items.
• Ancient Secrets: Every step brings you closer to unlocking the hidden secrets beneath the earth, which could change the course of your entire adventure.
• No Rush, No Limits: There are no time limits in this game. Everything depends on your desire to uncover secrets and explore the depths.

Are you ready to reveal the secret buried deep beneath the ground? Start your underground adventure and explore the endless possibilities that await you below.

70010000097387.name: Lumo 2
70010000097387.description:
The isometric icon is back in the sequel to 2016’s arcade-adventure hit, Lumo. Experience a brand-new adventure of shifting dimensions and new perspectives, with gameplay that never stops evolving.

Rewind the cassette and fall head over heels into a love letter to the trailblazing days of early ‘80s & ‘90s British videogames.
Adventure calls—grab your hat, light your staff, and leap into a world of shifting landscapes and interconnected rooms, each a meticulously designed puzzle box with dangers to doge, precision platforming and secrets to uncover.

Echoing the games from the 8bit era, you’ll have to explore and experiment to crack the challenges within.
Hunt for collectibles, and vault through portals—some even flip the script, morphing into wild genre twists that’ll keep you on your toes.

Features:
-	100 rooms to explore with platforming challenges and puzzles
-	Three mini games to master
-	25 cassettes to hunt down 
-	20 ducks to collect that require you to master the controls

70010000097391.name: Toaplan Arcade Collection Vol.2
70010000097391.intro: Eight legendary shmups, one explosive bundle. The Toaplan Arcade Collection Vol. 2 truly puts the blast in "blast from the past"!
70010000097391.description:
The name Toaplan is legendary. This game company is behind some of the best and most iconic shoot 'em ups in gaming history. These games were not only hugely influential, inspiring countless other developers throughout the ‘80s and ‘90s. They’re still just as great today! 
 
With The Toaplan Arcade Collection Vol.2, you get eight of these milestones. Enjoy them as the historical classics they are, or simply as fantastic action games packed with pixel explosions and crisp 2D graphics. It's quadruple the action, a billion times the fun, and a thrill ride back in time to the neon-lit arcades of the past! 

With modern enhancements, leaderboards, screen filters, and quality-of-life extras, no threat stands between you and absolute victory. Got what it takes? Prove it on the battlefield! 
 
This collection includes: 
 
Zero Wing
Hell Fire
Slap Fight / Alcon
Grind Stormer / V-5
Truxton / Tatsujin
Truxton 2 / Tatsujin Oh
Vimana
Twin Hawk

There’s also a Volume 1 of this collection for those who want another eight hardcore shoot 'em ups to sink their teeth into. Now, let's blast some enemies!

70010000097403.name: Cloud Roll
70010000097403.intro: Roll smart, roll fast, and conquer the skies in Cloud Roll!
70010000097403.description:
Get ready to roll into the skies! Cloud Roll is a fun, fast-paced arcade game where you guide a colorful ball through thrilling tracks high above the clouds.
Dodge tricky obstacles, balance on winding paths, and race toward the finish line while collecting shiny coins along the way. Each level brings new challenges with moving platforms, jump pads, and daring twists that will test your reflexes and precision.

With its bright visuals, smooth controls, and catchy design, Cloud Roll is easy to pick up but hard to master. Can you reach the finish and claim victory at the Torii gate?

Features:
Exciting levels set above the clouds
Simple yet responsive controls
Challenging obstacles and physics-based gameplay
Colorful, vibrant 3D graphics
Fun for all ages

70010000097411.name: Our Summer Festival 2
70010000097411.intro:
The time for Our Summer Festival has come around again!
Get ready for tons of festive fun with friends!
70010000097411.description:
The second installment in this series of exciting summer festival games is here!
Share Joy-Con™ and play with up to 4 players!

Enjoy a variety of festival-themed games and activities like
"Yo-Yo Fishing," "Yakisoba Cooking," and "Shooting Gallery!"

Play every game in order in the Festival Master Championship,
or take on each challenge solo to beat high scores and gather Collection Coins!

[Yo-Yo Fishing]
Catch yo-yo balloons!

[Shooting Gallery]
Aim at the yokai creatures and shoot!

[Yakisoba Cooking]
Cook up lots of yakisoba, and don't forget the sunny-side-up eggs!

[Daruma Drop]
Hit the blocks, but don't let the Daruma fall down!

[Goldfish Scooping]
Scoop up goldfish and watch out for special ones!

[Ramune Chugging]
Drink ramune as fast as you can, but mind the marble!

[Candy Apple Making]
Make candy apples to match customer orders!

[Lottery Game]
Test your luck! Pull strings and win prizes!

[Bon Odori]
Enjoy dancing the traditional Bon Odori!

[Danjiri Racing]
Ride your danjiri cart and race to the finish line!

70010000097419.name: WILD HEARTS S
70010000097419.intro: Hunt giant beasts using a variety of Karakuri tech, now with up to 3 teammates!
70010000097419.description:
• Fight back against giant nature-infused beasts.
As a hunter, you will face off against beasts that have endured the blazing lava, raging blizzards, and rising miasma plaguing the harsh lands of Azuma. These beasts, known as Kemono, embody the very essence of nature in all its beauty and ferocity. The key to surviving the fight lies in joining forces with comrades and wielding Karakuri technology.

• Develop your hunting grounds using Karakuri technology.
Weaving the threads of Karakuri enables you to instantly create basic items like crates and gliders. You can even combine these items to develop Karakuri like beast-piercing blades, protective shields, and traps to stop movement in real time, all of which can aid you in your battle against the Kemono. There are also some Karakuri that will remain on the field, giving you the freedom to place them in strategic locations and create your own ideal hunting grounds.

• Customize your play experience with diverse combat styles.
The game features a wide range of equipment. From general weapons like the nodachi and bow, to unconventional ones like the karakuri katana and bladed wagasa, each weapon has unique characteristics. By utilizing materials gathered from the hunts to craft new equipment, hunters can persist in their pursuit of beasts. This ongoing cycle enables hunters to grow even stronger and challenge themselves in combat against numerous fearsome Kemono.

• The story and world:
No one remembers why the Kemono began their rampage through a once-prosperous Azuma. Fueled by desperation, they wield the power of primal nature at its most destructive. For a while, it seemed that none could stand against their overwhelming might. But hope arrives in the form of a formidable hunter armed with deadly weapons and ancient technology called Karakuri that could turn the tide of battle.

70010000097429.name: 4PGP
70010000097429.intro: Enjoy the excitement of 90's arcade games anywhere and with anyone!
70010000097429.description:
Race Together!
Share the excitement with friends and family playing split-screen multiplayer.
Hop in a formula car and race on unique tracks from around the world. With its multiple difficulty settings and accessibility options such as assist mode and gyroscopic controls, 4PGP can be enjoyed by everyone from beginners to experts. 

From beginners to experts, fun for everyone!
・Singleplayer: Championship, Quick Race, and Time Attack
・Split-screen multiplayer with up to four players
・19 unique cars based on real formula cars
・14 different circuits from around the world that can also be played in reverse.
・Four difficulty levels: ROOKIE, NOVICE, VETERAN, and EXPERT
・Gyroscopic controls and Assist mode for beginners
・Learn how to play with an extensive tutorial mode!
・60FPS in TV, Handheld, and Tabletop Mode

70010000097438.name: Finding Chuchu
70010000097438.description:
"“Finding Chuchu” is a thrilling arcade shooting game that anyone can easily enjoy.
Players dodge waves of enemy bullets while using a variety of magic spells, adding a touch of strategy to the classic shoot-'em-up experience.

=== Game Features
1. Variety of Attack Magic
Use over ten types of offensive magic with simple controls.
Perform powerful “one-hit finish” casting spells through technical input for maximum efficiency.

2. Game Modes
Story Mode: The main content where you can experience an exciting and immersive storyline.
Arcade Mode: A stage-clear style mode separate from the story, perfect for quick play sessions.
Online Mode:
Check your global ranking on the scoreboards with scores saved to the cloud.
Use the Map Maker to design your own maps, upload and share them on the cloud, or play maps created by other players.

=== Recommended For
Those looking for a fun and exciting game to enjoy in short play sessions.
Players who love challenging high-score arcade experiences.
Fans of nostalgic retro arcade shooting vibes.
Anyone who enjoys creating and sharing maps to compete with friends."

70010000097443.name: Escape Game:The Kitty The Vacant Lot
70010000097443.intro:
A puzzle-solving and escape game set in a nostalgic vacant lot where you used to play as a child!
Solve the riddles in the vacant lot and try to escape.
70010000097443.description:
■Game System
This is an escape game (riddle solving adventure game).
The game progresses by selecting screens with the cursor and solving various tricks.

■Story
The time of a walk as usual
I decided to take a route that I have not taken for a long time recently.

The vacant lot where I used to play as a child should be in sight soon.

--However, the vacant lot was surrounded by a fence and a large “under construction” sign was blocking the entrance.

I was curious, so I stuck my head through the gap in the fence to take a peek inside.
Immediately I felt the ground jump up.

I picked myself up from the dirt and looked around.
