I looked around and saw that it was that vacant lot I had missed so much.

70010000097446.name: EGGCONSOLE MUGEN NO SHINZOU PC-8801
70010000097446.intro: Having blasphemed against the gods at the moment of death, the protagonist is cast into the terrifying Mugen Realm. Now, the journey to escape from the Realm begin
70010000097446.description:
This game is a role-playing game released by Crystal Soft in Japan in 1984. Players take on the role of a hero cast into the Mugen Realm—a place neither heaven nor hell—on a quest to find the "Mugen no Shinzou" and escape. The adventure has a time limit, and the game ends if you exceed 30,000 in-game days.

The game alternates between a top-down view for field exploration and a first-person perspective in dungeons, where random encounters trigger battles with monsters, played out in a turn-based command selection format.

In addition to the time limit, progress in the adventure is paused rather than saved, making it relatively challenging. At the time, this game was known as a serious RPG, and it’s a recommended pick for anyone looking for a classic, rewarding retro RPG experience.


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000097464.name: Play & Learn Kids’ Mini-Game Collection
70010000097464.intro:
Includes Three Games to Boost Thinking and Learning!
A fun and educational mini-game collection for both kids and adults!
70010000097464.description:
This educational game collection brings together three fun mini-games, perfect for helping children learn while they play.

It’s ideal for developing cognitive skills, logical thinking, and emotional awareness — and adults will find it great for keeping their minds sharp, too!


Included Games：

« Visual Perspective »
Choose the correct visual from four options based on how stacked blocks would appear from a specific angle.
Playing repeatedly helps improve spatial awareness and visual reasoning.

« Odd One Out »
Look at four illustrations and spot the one that doesn’t share a common trait with the others.
This game encourages critical thinking and analytical skills.

« Match the Season »
Guess which season — winter, spring, summer, or autumn — the object in the illustration belongs to.
This helps children become more aware of seasonal changes, nurturing emotional development and creativity.


Perfect for parent-child interaction or even as a brain workout for grown-ups, this title makes learning fun and engaging at any age.

70010000097471.name: Legends BMX
70010000097471.description:
LEGENDS BMX is an energetic and exhilarating game made for extreme sports enthusiasts! Ride your BMX through a variety of parks and scenarios designed to let you pull off incredible tricks.

Simple & Intuitive 
Enjoy easy-to-learn mechanics and intuitive controls that provide tons of fun and a wide range of experiences. Reach attainable goals while soaring over ramps and verticals, performing spectacular tricks. Explore multiple parks filled with a variety of ramps, surfaces, and verticals in semi-realistic environments. Achieve greatness and rise to the top of the competitive leaderboard! 

Ride & Challenge Yourself 
Move freely, performing countless tricks and lines to rack up massive points in diverse parks and scenarios. Attempt the wildest tricks with our one-directional analog system. After your first stunt, your Trick Line begins, recording each additional trick and combo, adding extra points until the rider wipes out or stops. The total score for the trick line is then added to your overall tally. 

Competitions & Customization 
Execute dozens of tricks, each with variations in Spin, Flips, Manuals, and Grinds. Climb the global rankings with your best scores. Choose from multiple Riders and bikes, each with their unique style and flow. 

Cartoon & Realistic 
LEGENDS BMX combines a charismatic 3D cartoon style with semi-realistic parks, immersive environments, and striking VFX. A dynamic isometric camera follows the rider seamlessly, enhancing the thrill of riding, flowing, and executing amazing tricks. 

Gameplay Feedback 
To amplify the experience, LEGENDS BMX features engaging VFX, including bike effects, grind sparks, skids, dust trails, camera effects, small particles, pump trails, and more.

70010000097478.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Buk-ri Dock
70010000097478.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Buk-ri Dock, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 2 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000097485.name: Pacify
70010000097485.intro: Have fun and get scared in this co-op horror.
70010000097485.description:
Pacify, weaken and capture supernatural monsters by yourself or with friends in this fun co-op horror.

You just got hired at Paranormal Activity Helpers Incorporated (PAH Inc). It sounds corny, but the pay is great. They just want you to check out some allegedly haunted locations. You will most likely never be in any real danger, and they have tons of work right now. They even have room for a few more, if you have any friends that need a job. Start helping with the paranormal investigations today!

•Multiple unique missions 
Each level has its own unique monsters, lore, items and gameplay. Encounter a possessed girl in an old mansion, feed an insatiable farmer on an eerie farm, gather items and perform rituals to weaken a witch in the woods or even keep PAH headquarters safe during a power outage. Each mission is exciting, fun and terrifying.  

•A variety of paranormal beings
You may encounter possessed dolls, an invisible witch, shadow monsters stealing your items, and more. Learn how to avoid, pacify, weaken and capture the paranormal creatures. Then bring them back to PAH Inc for "research purposes".

•Single Player and Online Co-op Multiplayer
Go solo and take on the unnatural entities all by yourself or team up with friends online for some fun and exciting scares.

•Are you brave enough?
Pacify is built to get your adrenaline flowing. The environments are creepy and unsettling. The creatures are roaming around freely and interacting with the environment in different ways. Some monsters may not attack, some you can only hear, and others may charge at you on sight, take a bite or even change you into a supernatural being!

Start helping PAH Inc. today!

70010000097490.name: Cozy Tides
70010000097490.intro: Discover the rhythm of island life
70010000097490.description:
Set sail for serenity in Cozy Tides, a relaxing exploration game set on a lush tropical island brimming with charm, mystery, and delightful discoveries. As a curious traveler, you'll wander through sun-drenched beaches, whispering forests, and vibrant island villages—each with stories to uncover and secrets to share.

Features:
A beautiful hand-crafted tropical island to explore
A soothing original soundtrack to accompany your journey
No combat, no stress—just pure exploration and discovery

Take your time and explore at your own pace in the Cozy Tides island!

70010000097493.name: Sea Fantasy
70010000097493.intro:
This is not a peaceful fishing game.
The end of the world is approaching...
70010000097493.description:
Save the world with fishing!?
This is the story of two young men who go on an adventure to catch the mysterious sea creatures called "Sea'Az".

”Sea'Az” a mysterious marine organism 
In the world of Sea Fantasy, marine life called “Sea'Az” inhabit the oceans and lakes. They vary in appearance, size and rarity, and all Sea'Az can be fished. 

Fishing the Sea'Az
To catch Sea'Az, perform a successful “Gauge Action”. Be careful, as there are Sea'Az with more powerful individual “gauge gimmick”.

Crafting with Sea'Az materials 
You can create equipment (fishing rods and hooks) using materials obtained from the Sea'Az you catch. By creating strong equipment, you can take advantage of the fishing action.

Explore by boat
Players can obtain a ship by advancing through the storyline.  Players can freely get on and off the ship and explore the vast pixel world.

Various 2D actions other than fishing
It is not only about fishing. You can enjoy various 2D action elements in between fishing.

70010000097502.name: Prehistoric Gal
70010000097502.intro: Experience an adventure in stone-age world full of prehistoric elements!
70010000097502.description:
Everyone’s favorite ham-loving caveman named Dude has been abducted by evil space aliens. 

In this new adventure, our heroine must go on a quest through a colorful prehistoric world to save her beloved. 

Run and jump, level up, obtain helpful items, and even ride dinosaurs while overcoming challenging enemies and dangerous traps. 

Explore 4 colorful stone-age environmentson Gal’s journey to free her ham-eating boyfriend.


Features:
* Platform action gameplay
* Colorful pixel art
* Gain levels and obtain items
* Ride dinosaurs 
* 4 worlds with branching paths

70010000097505.name: CORALINA
70010000097505.intro: Explore new paths through this harmony of ideas
70010000097505.description:
After a traumatic event, Cora, a cinema student, finds herself suddenly transported to what's known as the Limbo, or land of oblivion. 

In this land, you'll be accompanied by a crow, who claims to be a god of death, and you will help him to solve the mystery of why you are on limbo and why other deaths occurred, in a investigation through time and space, in labyrinths that connect oblivion to human emotions.


Features:
* Narrative-rich exploration
* Avant-garde pixel art
* Original music soundtrack

70010000097547.name: Fantasy Aquarium
70010000097547.intro: Raise your favorite fish and build your dream underwater world!
70010000097547.description:
It’s your very own aquarium.   Buy the fish you love, raise them from tiny fry, and watch them grow and flourish. Create your dream underwater world—calm, colorful, and completely yours.

A relaxing idle experience.  Your fish keep growing even while you’re away. Come back to see how your little world has changed and be pleasantly surprised.

Slow down time and unwind.  Let the gentle motion of the water soothe your mind as you enjoy the living world you’ve built with care.

70010000097556.name: Palland
70010000097556.intro: Craft your legacy from battle and stone.
70010000097556.description:
Step into the world of Palland, a captivating survival, building, and exploration game where everything starts with a humble base. In a vast and dangerous environment, you decide how to gather resources, expand your shelter, and deal with wild creatures that can be both threats and valuable sources of power. 

- Build bases across three distinct maps: Each environment offers unique challenges, construction styles, and local resources. 
- Explore and gather essential materials: From rare crystals to vital essences – every item counts on your path to growth. 
- Survival management: Balance your character’s health, hunger, and energy to stay alive.
- Quest-driven gameplay: Follow dynamic missions that guide your progress, offer rewards, and unlock new possibilities. 

Palland delivers a rich and immersive experience where base-building, combat, exploration, and evolution blend into one dynamic and strategic journey.

70010000097565.name: Parkour on Rooftops
70010000097565.intro: Explore, perform, dominate the urban playground.
70010000097565.description:
Experience true freedom of movement in this dynamic third-person parkour adventure!
You are a rooftop runner exploring the urban jungle of rooftops, alleys, and abandoned structures. Jump, vault, climb, and slide through a wide range of missions where precision, speed, and creativity matter most.

What awaits you:
• Courier missions – Deliver packages on time by choosing the fastest and riskiest routes.
• Trick challenges – Complete advanced parkour moves to beat specialized stunt courses.
• Checkpoint speedruns – Race through the city rooftops and alleys by hitting every marker before time runs out.
• Letter hunts – Discover hidden letters across each level to spell secret words and unlock hidden content.
• Star collection tasks – Search every corner and elevation to find stars hidden in the most challenging and clever spots.

Each mission brings a fresh challenge to your reflexes, logic, and creativity.
Master your moves, discover alternate routes, chase records, and become a legend of the streets.

70010000097577.name: Madagascar: Zoo Animals Adventures
70010000097577.intro: Rescue, sort, and settle the wild!
70010000097577.description:
The wild is in danger - the animals need you now! A mysterious disaster has scattered creatures far from their habitats, and only sharp thinking and a brave heart can bring them home.

In Madagascar: Zoo Animals Adventures, every level is a thrilling rescue mission! Sort, rotate, and fit each animal perfectly into place, saving them from being lost forever. With each puzzle solved, you rebuild a shattered world - unlocking new exotic species and stunning zoo locations.

This isn’t just a game, it’s a race against time to save the wild. Gear up, stay sharp, and become the ultimate hero for the animal kingdom!

70010000097587.name: Bunny Battle Nemesis
70010000097587.intro: Bloodthirsty bunnies, combos, and chaos. Unleash your furry rage to defend the Bunny Kingdom from certain doom!
70010000097587.description:
Sci-fi, bloodthirsty bunnies, and the powers of a goddess at your disposal. This is Bunny Battle Nemesis. Experience intense action, explosions, and chaos as you defend the Bunny Kingdom from certain doom at the hands of a vengeful demigod and her army of mercenaries.

Included Bunny Lord: Fight with Bunny Lord. Murder today for a better tomorrow.

Bunny Battle Nemesis delivers a challenging arcade-style experience filled with intense combat, local co-op, and chaos-fueled gameplay. Master the Fight System to become a true Combo Beast, and battle through waves of enemies using uniquely skilled heroes. Customize and upgrade your characters for even greater destruction.

Featuring a vibrant, over-the-top art style and an infinite mode where you can FIGHT FOR ETERNITY. Explore diverse environments across the Bunny Kingdom and uncover the mysteries of the DCF Universe.

70010000097592.name: Tomba! 2: The Evil Swine Return Special Edition
70010000097592.intro: TOMBA RETURNS IN A NEW ASTOUNDING 3D ADVENTURE!
70010000097592.description:
Tomba and his friend Zippo are in search of Tomba's girlfriend, Tabby. Was she kidnapped by the Evil Pigs? Is she safe? Tomba must use all of his agility, guile and cunning disguises to save Tabby and defeat the Evil Pigs once and for all.

• Gorgeous 3D graphics that instantly transport you to Tomba's world
• All new weapons, items and costumes to collect and use against the Evil Pigs
• A massive 137 different missions to complete
• New exclusive features such as rewind and save anywhere
• A museum filled with rare artwork and much more

70010000097595.name: Magic Valley Hike
70010000097595.description:
Step into the heart of a mystical forest in Magic Valley Hike, a peaceful exploration game set in a magical valley filled with ancient trees, glowing meadows, and hidden paths. With no rush and no danger, your only goal is to wander, discover, and soak in the beauty around you.

Cross storybook bridges, stroll through starlit clearings, and uncover quiet secrets tucked between mossy stones and winding trails. Along the way, you’ll encounter charming forest villages, and natural wonders!

70010000097598.name: EGGCONSOLE TRITORN MSX
70010000097598.intro: In this masterpiece action RPG, the brave warrior Triton rises to restore peace to Luwanda Island. The MSX version features different strategies!
70010000097598.description:
Released in Japan by SEIN SOFT in 1986, this side-scrolling action RPG casts players as the hero Triton in an adventure to defeat monsters and restore peace to Luwanda Island, controlled by "Pay-Valusa."

Tritorn primarily fights using jumps and sword strikes. By anticipating the enemy's movements, he will swing his sword, and executing a sword strike from a jump inflicts double damage, showcasing an advanced technique. Furthermore, as Tritorn grows, he learns magic, allowing him to halt enemy movements or instantly eliminate them. 

While the game is an action RPG, it's not just about defeating enemies. There are puzzle-solving elements incorporated, where defeating specific enemies in consecutively rewards players with items. Some puzzles may be challenging, but they add depth to the gameplay.

Featuring fast-paced action, skill-based combat, engaging puzzles, and three learnable magic spells as Tritorn grows, this game offers a rich experience for action RPG enthusiasts and is also recommended for newcomers.

The MSX (ROM cartridge) version features added powerful bosses and increased final boss attack patterns. Clearing later stages will likely require different procedures than other platforms.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000097607.name: Cipheur
70010000097607.intro: Cipheur is a cryptogram game allowing you to test your logic and language skills against 500 different texts.
70010000097607.description:
Can you decipher the secret messages?

- 500 texts to decipher in 5 different categories
- 4 difficulty levels
- hints

70010000097612.name: Tavern Owner Simulator
70010000097612.intro: Design. Serve. Expand. Become the ultimate tavern owner.
70010000097612.description:
Welcome to Tavern Owner Simulator, where your dream of managing a medieval pub becomes reality. Step into the shoes of a tavern proprietor and transform a modest establishment into the most popular spot in town. With a mix of strategic planning, creative design, and savvy management, you’ll turn your tiny tavern into a bustling hub of activity.

Features:
- Build and Customize: Design your dream tavern from the ground up. Choose from a variety of architectural styles, layouts, and decorations to create a unique atmosphere that attracts customers.
- Manage Your Staff: Hire and train a team of skilled workers to handle everything from serving drinks to preparing delicious meals. Ensure your staff is well-equipped and motivated to provide excellent service.
- Attract Customers: Offer a diverse menu of food and drinks to cater to the tastes of your patrons. Create a welcoming ambiance with live music, entertainment, and special events.
- Grow Your Business: Expand your tavern to accommodate more customers and offer additional services. Invest in upgrades, renovations, and new features to keep your business thriving.
- Manage Finances: Carefully track your income and expenses to ensure your tavern remains profitable. Make strategic decisions about pricing, promotions, and investments.
- Experience Medieval Life: Immerse yourself in the rich world of the Middle Ages. Interact with historical characters, participate in local events, and experience the challenges and rewards of tavern ownership.

Embark on your journey to build the ultimate tavern and make your mark in the medieval world!

70010000097626.name: PICROSS S SNK CLASSICS ＆ NEOGEO edition
70010000097626.intro: Collaboration Project Between Picross™ S and SNK Arcade/NEOGEO Games!
70010000097626.description:
Characters from SNK's arcade and NEOGEO library are coming to the Picross S series for Nintendo Switch™!

50 titles are included—from arcade heroes of the past to iconic NEOGEO characters whose "100 Mega Shock" impact can still be felt in the modern day.
Comes with the usual Picross S series puzzle modes: Picross, Mega Picross, Color Picross, and Clip Picross, as well as an Extra mode that features larger puzzles recreating famous scenes.

This entry also has a new Time Attack mode where players must try to finish puzzles within a time limit. See how good you really are at Picross by aiming for the golden crown in every one of them!
The number of puzzles is as follows: 150 each for Picross and Mega Picross; 5 for Clip Picross for a total of 200 piece puzzles of 40 each; 30 for Color Picross; and 5 for Extra.
Time Attack mode contains 30 carefully chosen Picross puzzles.

Other new features include an Art Gallery, where players can browse key visuals at their leisure, as well as grid guidelines that make it easier to select squares when sharing content via streaming or social media.

Picross is a picture crossword puzzle game where you follow hint numbers to complete a picture.
With simple, easy-to-follow rules, it's a game anyone can play!

70010000097636.name: Fiz and the Rainbow Planet
70010000097636.intro: Guide unique little dragons using only three buttons as they run around. Dive into a pixel-art 2.5D action adventure that bends the rules of dimension!
70010000097636.description:
Fiz and the Rainbow Planet is a 2.5D pixel-art action game where you switch between characters as the situation demands to overcome challenges. One of the game’s standout features is the “Dimensional Sanctuary” , which offers a unique experience of progressing through a three-dimensional space while maintaining the look and feel of classic 2D gameplay. 


Story

Somewhere in the vast universe lies Planet Longa. One night, a young dragon named Fiz had a disturbing dream. The world had turned gray, and all life stood still, frozen in time. It was a terrifying vision of a lifeless future. When Fiz wakes up, he is visited by Taonga, a mysterious and all-knowing dragon, who reveals that the dream was more than just a nightmare. It was a glimpse of a possible future. To prevent this grim fate, Fiz must join forces with Taonga and five other dragons. Together, the seven must protect the sacred orbs scattered across the world. Determined to save his world, Fiz sets off on a grand adventure to find his companions and change the future.

70010000097647.name: Fantasy Grove
70010000097647.intro: Wander Into a World of Whimsy and Wonder
70010000097647.description:
Step into Fantasy Grove, a cozy walking adventure set in a magical forest teeming with charm and mystery. Meander through enchanted woodlands, uncover forgotten ruins.

Whether you're going through lush meadows or pausing by a shimmering pond, every path invites you to slow down and enjoy the magic of the moment.

Key Features
A relaxing, exploration-focused experience—no combat, no timers
A handcrafted fantasy world filled with secrets and surprises
Calming music and ambient nature sounds to soothe the senses

Take a breath, follow your curiosity, and lose yourself in the peaceful magic of Fantasy Grove.

70010000097664.name: Escape Game:The Odd Crime Scene
70010000097664.intro:
An orthodox escape game set in a crime scene!
Solve the riddles and try to escape from this strange crime scene.
70010000097664.description:
■Game System
This is an escape game (riddle solving adventure game).
The game progresses by selecting screens with the cursor and solving various tricks.

■Story
Immediately after completing the on-site inspection of a certain theft case, you receive a phone call from the investigation headquarters of the recent murder case.

This was the beginning of a long night.

The crime scene was an apartment in the suburbs.

He arrives in front of an unpopular room, and as he suspiciously tries to open the door, he is attacked from behind and loses consciousness.

When he woke up, he was trapped inside the room he had just entered.

His phone is out of charge, the door cannot be opened from the inside, and the window is unusually sturdy and cannot be broken.

With no way to escape, I slowly looked around the room.

I must somehow find a way out of this room...

70010000097666.name: CONERU -DIMENSION GIRL-
70010000097666.intro: Share one body with CONERU, the dimension-hopping girl, and fight as one! A brand-new sensation: a “Two Hearts, One Body” 2D Platforming Action Date!
70010000097666.description:
A date you’ll never forget—

Your battle android alter-ego, Socrates, suddenly finds their body being shared by a dimensional girl named Coneru of the Subspace!?

Run, jump, punch, kick, laugh, cry, and occasionally get sidetracked—
It’s a cheerful adventure shared by two souls, as they blast away mysterious aliens invading the peaceful Shinjuku City.
This is a 2D action-packed “date” like no other!

Team up with weapons and beams!
You strike with close-range weapons while Coneru blasts enemies with her “Coneru Beam” from afar!
You pick the weapons, but her beams? Totally based on her mood!
She might even come up with new beams mid-date!?
But hey, going along with her whims—that’s what a real date’s all about!
Sync your moves and unleash tag-team combos to knock enemies into the stars!

Get ready for her overdrive—“Runrun Mode”!
When the right conditions are met and Coneru gets in an exceptionally good mood, she goes into Runrun Mode—
An explosive, rule-breaking surge of speed and power!
Can you keep up with her when she’s at full throttle!?

Endless chatter in “Coneru Talk”!
During the date, Coneru reacts to everything with nonstop chatter and lively voice lines!
After all, this is an action date!
Why fight with a scary face when you can wipe out enemies with a smile and some fun conversation?

Two souls from separate dimensions, finally overlapping through this game.
Embark on a once-in-a-lifetime 2D action date, and create unforgettable memories—just the two of you!

70010000097671.name: Gym Manager
70010000097671.description:
Gym Manager is a game where you get to manage, build, and expand your own gym, in opposition to the gym where you were previously employed. After being fired by the gym owner, you decided to get revenge and spend all your savings on opening a new gym, with the goal of making your former boss bankrupt.

As the main mechanic of the game, you will have to manage, build, and expand your gym. You can buy new equipment, upgrade existing ones and sell supplements. You can also expand your gym by demolishing walls, buying new decorations, and opening facilities like a sauna, massage salon, solarium, and locker room. Meanwhile, you must protect your gym from potential danger, keep the gym clean and manage your members.

Outside of managing your gym, you can engage in various activities in town, including flirting with girls, sabotaging the competition gym, partying, buying cheaper equipment in a second-hand store, doing illegal business with a shady guy in the backstreet and lockpicking and stealing from the town while avoiding the police.

70010000097673.name: hololive Treasure Mountain MegaPack
70010000097673.intro: Stack the Love of Captain Marine!
70010000097673.description:
hololive members transform into adorable treasures!
Stack the 3D hololive members without letting them overflow to create your very own mountain in this must-play 3D puzzle game for hololive fans!


How to Play
Just toss the treasures and stack them on the island!
Combine identical treasures to transform them into larger ones!
The game ends when a treasure falls off the island!

Create bigger treasures and make consecutive combinations to boost your score through chain reactions!
And when you create the largest treasure, something amazing happens…!?


Treasure Exchange
The treasures that appear in the game can be swapped with other members!
Customize to your liking and create your own unique mountain of favorite members!


Rankings
Compete with players from around the world and test your skills.
Aim for the high score and keep challenging yourself!


New Features for the Nintendo Switch™ Version
This version includes all three DLC packs previously released for the PC version! 
By completing newly added in-game missions, you can unlock a total of four commentators and music tracks by talents!

Additionally, a new BGM customization feature has been added!
Combine your favorite BGM with your favorite commentator to create your very own Treasure Mountain and enjoy the game even more!

70010000097679.name: Grimoire Groves
70010000097679.intro: Join the witches in their quest to restore the Grimoire Groves! Master magic, grow cute plant creatures and discover the mystery of the Rainbow Socks.
70010000097679.description:
Home to magical creatures and plants, the fabled Grimoire Groves should’ve been a haven for witches looking for a new home. But by the time they arrive, the forest spirits have disappeared and only a few plant creatures remain. But not all is lost. With a little hard work, investigation and magic, the witches might just restore the Grimoire Groves to the lush forest it once was!

Master Witch Magic
Unlock and learn new spells to complete your grimoire. Mix and match different spells to find your own brand of magic and master the balance between all four elements. 

Grow, Forage and Craft
Discover all that the groves have to offer! Collect fruits, craft new spells and items and grow plant creatures to repopulate the forest. Honor the witch tradition of foraging and learn to enhance your powers.

Befriend Mythical Creatures
Find the fabled forest spirits and give them a new home. Help them restore the balance of the groves by boosting their magical powers, as well as your own, with decorations around your cottage. 

Unravel the Mystery of the Rainbow Socks
Embark on a journey to recover the most mythical item to ever exist – the fabled Rainbow Socks – as you investigate what disturbed the careful balance of the magical forest.

70010000097683.name: ION Shift
70010000097683.intro: ION Shift delivers fast, high-stakes gameplay with precision controls and a unique sandbox-style approach to combat arenas.
70010000097683.description:
In this hardcore 2D platformer game, players take control of alien creature navigating a vast and menacing space ship. The objective is simple: survive against all odds. The ship is crawling with hostile soldiers, deadly turrets, and laser drones that are constantly on the lookout.

Stylish combat in sandbox arenas
Experience an adrenaline-fueled combat system like never before, featuring dynamic dashes, strategic throwables, and sandbox-style arenas. Dash through the battlefield with precision, unleash an array of creative throwables, and navigate a dynamic environment for tactical advantages. This is combat reimagined, where every move is a strategic choice in an ever-evolving arena.

70010000097691.name: Amber Alert Director's cut
70010000097691.description:
Step into the shoes of a policeman in "Amber Alert," a difficult survival horror game. Responding to a late-night call, you find a sinister cult of women abductors. Your mission: rescue a captive girl. Navigate perilous streets, evade cult members, and survive.

Your mission is urgent and dangerous: find and rescue a girl who is still alive, held captive by these malevolent criminals. Navigate through the perilous streets, abandoned houses, and hidden hideouts, all while evading or confronting the cult members who will stop at nothing to protect their secrets.

"Amber Alert" is not for the faint-hearted. This game will keep you on edge, demanding quick reflexes, sharp observation, and unwavering courage. Every decision matters, and every second counts. Can you outsmart the cult and save the girl, or will you become their next victim?

Prepare yourself for a relentless, heart-pounding journey in "Amber Alert." Will you save the innocent, or will the darkness claim you too?

FEATURES
•**Immersive Horror Experience**: Navigate through a dark, atmospheric neighborhood filled with hidden dangers and chilling surprises.
•**Intense Survival Gameplay**: Stay alert and react quickly to threats lurking in the shadows. Use your wits and limited resources to survive.
•**Engaging Storyline**: Unravel the mystery behind the abductions and the sinister cult as you progress through the game.
•**Engaging Storyline**: Unravel the mystery behind the abductions and the sinister cult as you progress through the game.
•**High Replayability**: Multiple paths and randomly placed items, random enemy locations, and quick events ensure that each playthrough offers a new experience.

70010000097711.name: FORMULA AUTO SPORT RACING
70010000097711.intro: From Pitstop to Podium – Dominate the Circuit.
70010000097711.description:
Step into the world of elite motorsport where speed and precision rule every lap. In Formula Auto Sport Racing, your driving skills and strategic upgrades make the difference between finishing last and reaching the podium.

Race across challenging circuits, unlock powerful Formula bolids, and fine-tune them with upgrades to dominate your rivals. Every track pushes your reflexes to the limit, rewarding those who master both speed and control.

Key Features:

- Diverse racing tracks with unique layouts
- Multiple Formula bolids to unlock
- Upgrade system for performance and handling
- Pilot skills upgrades to enhance driving abilities
- Pitstop team upgrades for faster repairs and tire changes
- Intense AI-driven competition
- Realistic driving physics and smooth controls

Victory isn’t given — it’s earned. Push your car to its limits, outsmart your opponents, and prove you have what it takes to become the champion of Formula Auto Sport Racing.

70010000097719.name: Fit and Fry: Mise En Place
70010000097719.description:
Fit and Fry: Mise en Place is a casual puzzle game set in a restaurant, where every challenge takes place inside a frying pan. The goal is to perfectly organize the ingredients on the board, fulfilling customer orders and progressing through 40 levels that mix strategy and fun.

The mechanics are easy to learn yet addictive to master: move, rotate, and position the ingredients until everything fits in the right place. As you advance, the grids become larger and more complex, demanding more and more planning.

Customer orders work as extra challenges, rewarding players with stars if they aim to complete everything. While optional, they add replayability and bring more flavor to the experience.

The game starts with introductory levels to learn the rules, moves on to intermediate stages with conveyor belts and a greater variety of ingredients, challenges players in advanced stages with nearly maximum-sized boards, and culminates in the final levels that test everything learned so far.

With a smooth difficulty curve, engaging atmosphere, and always creative challenges, Fit and Fry: Mise en Place is the perfect dish for puzzle fans and casual players.

70010000097724.name: Pirate Trails: Tentacles and Treasures
70010000097724.intro: Arrr you ready for more puzzlin', plunderin' and perilous tentacles?
70010000097724.description:
Aye, captain! The seven seas still hide secrets — and no one’s better suited to uncover them than you! In Pirate Trails 2: Tentacles & Treasures, the most beloved pirate puzzle on the high seas is back with new maps, new dangers... and a lot more tentacles!

Embark on a tropical journey where your ship must follow perfect routes through a sea of hexagons. But beware! The Kraken is watching, and its tentacles block the way to the most valuable treasures. Only gunpowder can stop your ship from becoming sushi!

Collect powder kegs, trace clever paths, gather golden treasures, and lead your ship to the final port — without becoming calamari.

Explore 30 handcrafted levels across three unique biomes:

Tortuga – Where it all begins (and where the tentacles are still shy).
Port Royal – Routes multiply, and the tentacles grow fiercer.
Nassau – The ultimate challenge, where every powder keg counts and a single wrong turn could spell victory... or shipwreck.

You don’t control the ship — you control its fate. Rotate, swap, and place puzzle tiles wisely. When the route is ready, press the button and watch the ship sail through your brilliant strategy.

70010000097729.name: Centipede Gun
70010000097729.description:
Centipede Gun is a creature-building roguelite inspired by games like SNKRX and FLERP, where you create unusual beings by combining different shapes, modules, and... weapons!?
Try out insane combinations and try to break the game with the craziest creations! Each combination offers new possibilities to defeat enemies in increasingly challenging battles. After each round, use the money you earn to buy different units in the store and further strengthen your centipede of destruction. But be careful — as you evolve, enemies also become stronger, testing the limits of your creativity and strategy.

Assemble strange and powerful centipedes whose weapons automatically attack when enemies approach. Use special modules to add extra effects to your attacks and combine modules of the same type to evolve them, unlocking secret abilities as you reach new levels of power. Survive if you can and find out how far your centipede can go!

70010000097734.name: Mortal Trap Dungeon
70010000097734.description:
Explore Dungeons and overcome challenges in Mortal Trap Dungeon!

Mortal Trap Dungeon is a precision platformer with exploration elements, with stages full of the most diverse enemies and traps! There are 16 phases with many challenges, be quick, act at the right time, run away from dozens of threats! Find the orb and be immortal! This is Mortal Trap Dungeon!

70010000097739.name: Cats Visiting Fairy Tales
70010000097739.intro: Spot clever felines tucked into fairy tale scenes! Hunt for 100 cats in each magical zone, plus discover all special hidden treasures. A purrfect puzzle adventure!
70010000097739.description:
Dive into a breathtaking adventure where 500+ mischievous cats have scampered into the most enchanting fairy-tale realms!

Explore fantasy villages with cobblestone streets and cozy cottages, magical forests glowing with fireflies and talking trees, and even a spellbinding magic school where curious kittens hide among floating books and bubbling potions.

Each location holds 100 cleverly hidden cats—some snoozing in barrels, others peeking from behind wizard hats! But the real challenge? Uncovering the 5 legendary collectibles, each tied to a secret feline legend.

With charming animations, interactive surprises, and endless purr-sonalities, this game is a treasure hunt like no other!

70010000097746.name: Zombies Overloaded
70010000097746.description:
Zombies are everywhere! Arcade-inspired shooter, where relentless waves of undead creeps shamble, sprint, and swarm at you in a cramped room! Your only chance? A wild arsenal of weapons and just enough skill (and blind LUCK!) to keep the hordes at bay. 

Strap in and embrace the chaos! Trapped in an inescapable room, you’ll take on endless waves of zombies, mowing them down by the hundreds with randomly spawning weapons. Every five waves, a boss shows up to ruin your day. Survival demands quick reflexes, clever strategy, and just a pinch of madness!

Brace yourself for the a unique boss battle in every "Overloaded" stage! Each boss battle brings a unique  challenge—from hammer-swinging behemoths to undead S.W.A.T. team nightmares. The odds? Totally stacked against you. And just when you think you've got the upper hand, these bosses get tougher, meaner, and deadlier every time they come back!

Compete with the world and prove you’re the ultimate zombie slayer!

70010000097751.name: Outlanders
70010000097751.intro: Help charming folk make their outlandish dreams come true on this town-building strategy game!
70010000097751.description:
Welcome to the Outlands! A faraway place where work is hard but rewarding, where people dream big but stay grounded, where friends become family, and settlements become cities.

You will follow the story of a cast of lovable, eccentric, and (mostly) well-intentioned town leaders, as they pursue their dreams and whims, while their paths slowly start to intertwine in surprising, often humorous, sometimes heart-warming ways. It’s up to you to use the extensive catalog of tools and buildings at your disposal to guide them towards their goals.

When challenges get too hard and the Outlanders start getting too picky, you can take a detour to the Sandbox mode, where creativity is the new leader in town. There, you can play with the full catalog of buildings and mechanics right off the bat and customize the maps and rules as you please.

The journey of Outlanders is only just beginning. As new leaders keep coming from far away to share their stories, and new ways of playing and sharing your experiences appear on the horizon, the ever-shifting landscape of possibilities gets more and more exciting.

Everybody’s coming to the Outlands!
Will you join them?

70010000097761.name: Blossom Voyage
70010000097761.intro:
Cherry blossoms fall, hearts race wild.
Fall in love – or fight for your life.
Real Japan, real danger, real romance.
70010000097761.description:
Under the fluttering cherry blossoms on the streets of Japan, your cross-cultural romance adventure begins now! The game authentically recreates famous Japanese landmarks, where four distinctively charming Japanese girls await to meet you. Amid sweet dates, a life-or-death chase suddenly erupts on Tokyo’s late-night streets, and you accidentally stumble upon the underworld’s dark dealings of power and lust – beneath the romantic surface, a surging undercurrent of life-and-death choices lies hidden. Scenes you never dared to imagine come at you one after another! Tear through the crisis with courage, lock onto true feelings with perfect chemistry.

Deadly Charm・Japanese Heroine Gallery
An energetic anime-style cosplayer, a cool goddess who practices kendo and rides a motorcycle, a millionaire female CEO, a Japanese idol with no control over her own fate… Loli girls, graceful onee-sama, pure first loves — sweet, spicy, or dark, fierce, dashing, or gentle! All the most iconic personality types from Japanese anime and dramas are gathered here. Each is a full-fledged Japanese heroine with powerful presence. At least one of them will make your heart race uncontrollably.

Desperate Run・Tokyo Survival Files
A Tokyo adventure! In a second, you’re pulled into a real J-drama world. The story twists and turns, making your emotions surge out of control. Unpredictable plot developments, challenges full of surprise and fun — skill battles, chases, kidnappings, one wrong step and you lose your life. Go head-to-head with classic J-drama villains. All the excitement from a first-person perspective. Did you really think you were just here for a date?

Real-shot Impact・Immersive Japan Pilgrimage
Over 20 real-life shots of popular Japanese photo spots — real sunlight, real nightscapes come right at you. Akihabara, Kamakura, Tokyo Tower, Yokohama Cosmoclock… famous locations from numerous anime and manga, plus spectacular Japanese festivals and cultural scenes you’ve never seen before! Without leaving home, you can feel the streets of Japan across the ocean, immerse yourself, experience firsthand just how wonderful Japanese life can be, and witness the mind-blowing collision that breaks through the dimensional wall.

70010000097776.name: GHOST TRAVELER: Adventures in Edo
70010000097776.intro: A Time loop mystery set in Japan’s Edo period!
70010000097776.description:
◆ A Supernatural Tale of a Boy Transported to Edo-Period Japan
The protagonist (the player) is a 17-year-old boy named Kotaro who lives in modern-day Japan. One day, he is caught in a supernatural phenomenon in Shibuya and loses consciousness. When he wakes up, he finds himself in a setting reminiscent of a Japanese historical drama. Eventually, Kotaro learns from a "god" that he has been transported back in time to the Edo period as a soul, and that he is now in Yoshiwara, the pleasure quarter in Edo, the capital of 19th-century Japan.

◆ A Grotesque Mystery Adventure Set in Yoshiwara
Without knowing why he has arrived in this era or how to return to the modern world, Kotaro begins to wander around Yoshiwara in search of clues to unravel the "mystery." Soon, he encounters the murder of an oiran (courtesan) and takes on the role of a "detective" to solve the case. However, he is drawn into a series of grotesque murders.

◆ A Time-Loop Narrative That Brings You Closer to the Truth
The mystery of the "oiran murder," a central part of the story, cannot be solved in a single playthrough. The scenario is interwoven with multiple settings and foreshadowing, functioning alongside a time-loop system where the protagonist, as a ghost, can go back in time and possess others to replay events. This culminates in a dramatic twist at the end.

◆ Historical Mode Explaining Edo-Period Yoshiwara
The game is set in late Edo-period Yoshiwara and includes a mode that explains the lifestyles, customs, and terminology of the era. This feature allows players to learn about Yoshiwara, even aspects that many Japanese people are unfamiliar with. Additionally, the game supports English and Simplified Chinese, enabling players from different language regions to explore and learn about Japan’s Edo period.

70010000097780.name: Kokoro Clover SUN - Prehistoric Invaders!
70010000097780.intro:
The second installment in the 2000s era styled anime-themed Kokoro Clover series!
A visual novel paired with boss battles!
70010000097780.description:
Our heroes' next adventure is in...dinosaur times?! This time the bad guys are trying to destroy the future! The only way to fight back is with dino-transformations!

This installment includes:
- 5-minute recap of the story so far
- Special feature episodes 1-4

◆Visual Novel (Story)◆
In an effort to save a mysterious dinosaur that appears before them, Treffy and her friends travel back in time to the age of dinosaurs! There they encounter a madman bent on destroying the very future they came from!

Set following the events of Season 1, this title acts as a theatrical release for an anime might.

◆Boss Battles◆
2D action designed to be playable by all.

-Gain invincibility by dancing!

◆Series Overview◆
A visual novel series designed to remind players of the joys of Saturday morning cartoons.
Packed with transformations, cards, dancing, and robots, too! The adventure goes on—forever and always!

-Story features opening, ending, and commercial interlude animations!
This installment also features an all-in-one theatrical release mode.

-The clock on the top left can be changed to 8:00, 9:00, or whatever time you wish!

-Features all original music tracks!

-Pixel art visuals serve to offer real 2000s nostalgia."

70010000097789.name: Astral Takers
70010000097789.intro: Shape your fate with the power of summoning in an immersive JRPG!
70010000097789.description:
Revyse, a young apprentice studying under his master, Volgrim, crosses paths with Aurora—a mysterious girl who has lost her memory. As their destinies intertwine, they face trials, forge bonds, and confront powerful enemies threatening their world. Awaken the ancient art of summoning, uncover hidden truths, and shape the story through your choices.

Master the summoning & arrange system by using Echostones to call forth legendary heroes from distant realms. Build your perfect team from up to 8 unique characters, each with distinct abilities and skills, and strategically form a party of 4 in tactical, turn-based command battles where enemy actions are outlined—giving you the edge to plan and adapt. Explore vast dungeons, discover or purchase powerful gear, and know when to retreat in the face of overwhelming odds!

70010000097794.name: Furi - Artbook
70010000097794.description:
This is the Digital edition of Furi's artbook.

A stunning official artbook that gathers all the concept art from the artists who brought Furi to life over two years of development. Including the jail worlds concept arts, storyboards, combat research drawings, and detailed character sketches by Takashi Okazaki, creator of Afro Samurai.

The artbook has 144 pages.

70010000097801.name: Haven - Artbook
70010000097801.description:
This artbook features original concept art, as well as never-before-seen visuals, including a whole chapter of creations that never made it into the game.

Through art, design, notes, and even scribbles, follow the creation of Yu and Kay’s journey on planet Source. Discover its creature design, world design, vegetation, architecture, iterations on the Nest, and, of course, the design of Oink!

The artbook is 194 pages long.

70010000097803.name: Biped 2
70010000097803.intro:
MASTER INNOVATIVE AND SIMPLE CONTROLS,
CONQUER TWO-OR-FOUR-PLAYER CO-OP, EXPLORE FUN ENVIRONMENTS, PAIR YOUR LOOKS.
70010000097803.description:
Biped 2 is the sequel of the exciting game about two charming bipedal robots, Aku and Sila, who rely on each other and embark on incredible adventures side by side. Dive into the groovy co-op action-adventure game, full of puzzles, friendship, support, and fun!

After brave bipeds had reactivated all the beacons on Earth, they received a strange signal from a faraway planet. This can mean only one thing - someone is calling out for help! Now, our mechanical friends are determined to prove themselves and help those in need across the Galaxy. Become a hero and save the planet in distress. After all, even the tiniest robots are capable of great deeds!

ENJOY THE CONTROLS
Meet the classic two-leg mechanics and a brand-new variety of ways to move! 

Try out new movement types that are smoothly integrated into the game process! Soar gracefully on a hang glider and leave beautiful patterns behind, or conquer ledges and breaks with a grappling hook!

And guess what? Sliding is back too! Be ready to slide a lot!

UNIQUE PAIR MECHANICS
Not only help each other to get further but act together to achieve success! Unite with your robot partner and become one to solve special puzzles. Take the role of “legs” or “arms” and coordinate your next step. And a whole bunch of pair puzzles will help you to master this technique!

EXPLORE NEW BIOMES
Unknown planets bring uncharted places! Unravel the mysteries of an alien planet and meet new characters, even elementals! Explore unfamiliar environments and be ready to face the challenges that they might bring. Have a good time, and let beautiful sceneries and wonderful music create a memorable atmosphere!

PLAY SOLO OR IN TWO-OR-FOUR-PLAYER CO-OP
To make the gameplay process even more diverse, you can choose from lots of possibilities to play:

Single-player
Become a hero of your story and test your skills in a single-player mode! 

Two-player co-op
Invite a friend to share the journey with you. Take the roles of two bipeds and make the most out of this synergy. Test your skills and assist each other in difficult situations because companionship will be essential.

Four-player co-op
Apart from familiar mods, we’ve introduced a new one - a four-player co-op! Beat the challenging levels together in a team of four!

STYLE IS A MUST
Show the new world your creativity! Dress up your bipeds for the occasion to impress your new friends - collect treasures and buy wacky hats. Be unique or choose pair looks with your partner.

70010000097821.name: No Sleep For Kaname Date - From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES
70010000097821.intro: Open Your Third Eye To Seek A Way Out!
70010000097821.description:
Iris the internet idol has been abducted by aliens?!
Finding herself on board a mysterious UFO and tasked with completing a bizarre escape game, Iris knows there's one person who she can always count on for help: Kaname Date, Psyncer! 
As Date, conduct investigations, solve escape game puzzles, and Psync into the dreams of potential suspects to help Iris escape and unravel the mystery behind The Third Eye Game!

・ Investigation: Use the special functions in Date's left eye to gather information that will lead to Iris's whereabouts! Familiar and new characters will also appear!
・Somnium: Explore the eccentric dream world of potential suspects to uncover clues and secret memories!
・ Escape: Solve thrilling mysteries while exploring a locked environment. When you find the true answer beyond the surface level of logic, the door to escape will open!

70010000097823.name: Lush Grove
70010000097823.intro: Step into Stillness. Wander Through Wonder.
70010000097823.description:
Welcome to Lush Grove, a breathtaking walking and exploration simulator that invites you to slow down and simply be.

Traverse a lovingly hand-crafted level—an enchanting forest teeming with detail, color, and life. Every step is an invitation to discover something new: the rustle of leaves, the call of distant birds, the dance of sunlight through the canopy.

Features
A Gorgeous, Living World: unforgettable level, filled with lush foliage, serene water, hidden nooks, and ambient life.

Immersive Atmosphere: Soothing soundscapes, and visual storytelling let you sink fully into the moment.

Perfect for Short Escapes: Play at your own pace. Whether for ten minutes or an hour, Lush Grove is a peaceful break from the everyday.

70010000097832.name: Paper Plane
70010000097832.intro: Thrilling paper plane piloting arcade game
70010000097832.description:
Take flight in Paper Plane, a serene yet thrilling adventure where you pilot a variety of unique paper planes through beautifully crafted circuits across multiple levels. Soar through vibrant and diverse sceneries—peaceful valleys, misty mountains, glowing night skies, and sunlit canyons—each offering a different challenge and atmosphere.

Navigate from waypoint to waypoint, mastering the art of flight while avoiding dynamic hazards like tumbling rocks, erupting geysers, zones of intense gravity, and unpredictable wind conditions. Every level presents new obstacles and opportunities to test your skills and reflexes.

All of this is set to a mesmerizing, trippy soundtrack that shifts with the environment, enhancing the dreamlike flow of your journey.

Features:

Multiple paper planes with unique handling
Day and night levels with dynamic weather and lighting
Beautiful, handcrafted environments
Challenging hazards and flight physics
Trippy, immersive music that evolves as you play
Prepare to unfold the skies.

70010000097837.name: CRAYON CLASSIC
70010000097837.intro:
Complete your child’s first masterpiece together!
Capture both your child’s imagination and your family’s memories!
70010000097837.description:
Complete your child’s first masterpiece together!
The Crayon Classic coloring game, made with parenting experience by a hands-on dad, is finally here!
The original beloved Crayon series, Crayon Classic, is a family-friendly coloring game optimized for Nintendo Switch™'s touch screen.

1. Why Crayon Classic?
Real crayon-like natural colors
We replicated the texture and colors of real crayons exactly. Your child can color naturally as if using real crayons.

The achievement of completing to the end
Our little star and badge systems help your child keep going without giving up until completion. Watching the finished work boosts your child’s confidence.

Precious family time together
Create moments to color and talk together as a whole family. Even grandparents can easily operate it, so three generations can enjoy it together.

2. Special features of Crayon Classic
Colors identical to real crayons
A natural crayon touch familiar to your child’s eyes and hands

Little star system to help color to completion
Encourages the achievement of finishing without giving up

Badge system encouraging creative coloring
A reward system encouraging creative coloring

Character image save feature
You can view your child’s precious artwork anytime

24 characters and 72 images total
No chance to get bored with the variety of characters

3. Perfect for such times!
When you need an activity to do with your child on a rainy day at home

To keep your child entertained on long trips

An activity for three generations to enjoy at grandparents’ house

When you want to hold a coloring contest with friends

4. Use with peace of mind
Safe environment – your child can use it safely

Always available offline – coloring possible without internet

Optimized for Nintendo Switch touch screen – comfortable to use

One purchase for the whole family – use continuously without extra charges

5. An game made with a dad’s sincere parenting experience
Not just a simple coloring game. Made by a dad who has experienced parenting and pondered: “What does my child really need?”

Compliment your child’s drawings and enjoy coloring and talking about the pictures as a whole family.

Catch both your child’s imagination and family memories with Crayon Classic!
Watch the precious family time created while coloring and the moments when your child’s creativity blooms.

70010000097846.name: HoloParade: Deluxe Edition
70010000097846.intro: A lively parade with hololive VTubers and mascot characters!
70010000097846.description:
Feature 1: Simple Yet Deep, Lively Battles

The basic system is a classic 2D tower defense game where you summon characters from your base and march them forward to destroy the enemy's base to win. While the controls are simple, the gameplay is profoundly deep. With over 65 characters, each possessing a variety of abilities like ally healing support and self-destruct attacks, skillful combination and flexible formation are key to enjoying the game.

Additionally, there's an element inspired by parades called the 'Symphony Effect,' where various effects are activated based on the musical instruments played by the characters in march. This adds further strategic depth to the formation of your parade squad and the order of their summoning.

Feature 2: Comprehensive Development Elements

In addition to leveling up and limit breaking, there is a 'Skill' system that allows you to add special abilities not available through regular development. Since you can add up to three types of skills to each character and select them carefully, you can enjoy a unique development process! Furthermore, since you can reset levels and get a full refund of the coins spent, it allows for more freedom in restructuring formations and character development.

Feature 3: No Gacha Purchases, No Stamina System

The scout gacha, which allows you to acquire characters, can be used by consuming tickets obtained within the game, with no additional purchases required. Also, as there is no stamina system, you are not bound by time and can play as much as you like, whenever you like.

Moreover, the scout gacha allows you to choose from two randomly selected character candidates, enabling players to make selections based on their strategy or preference rather than leaving it entirely to chance.

Feature 4: Take a Break with Various Talents and Mini-Games in the Office

When you return to the office, the home screen, you'll be greeted by newly recorded voice lines from Harusaki Nodoka, a staff member of hololive. In the office, talents from hololive may also make appearances, and you might witness some unexpected interactions.

Additionally, mini-games with gameplay entirely different from the main story have been implemented. These games allow you to collect coins necessary for character strengthening. For now, the mini-games titled "Hurry Up! Miko-Chi!" and "Dancing Subaru" are available. In "Hurry Up! Miko-Chi!", Sakura Miko (a VTuber affiliated with Hololive), who has overslept, dashes at full speed towards her destination while avoiding obstacles. 

■ New Features for the Nintendo Switch™ Version
This version includes all DLC!
Enjoy the full HoloParade experience!

70010000097851.name: Lost Lands X
70010000097851.intro: Save not the world, but a friend.
70010000097851.description: Susan Shepard has long decided that she is done with traveling to the Lost Lands and found herself in writing. However, the recent events in the Lost Lands have decided otherwise. Susan's best friend Folnur has gone crazy and killed old Maaron! What has changed in Folnur? Who or what forced these changes? This time, Susan will have to solve a problem not of universal importance, but important for herself. Susan will again go back in time to understand the reasons for what happened. On the way, she will meet old friends who will unite into a team. However, an old enemy will appear, whom Susan will never suspect to return. All the puzzles from the past and the present will come together in this story!

70010000097856.name: Stasis
70010000097856.intro: In the distant future, aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft, John Maracheck awakes from stasis. He must push himself to new limits to unravel the mysteries around him.
70010000097856.description:
The 2015 critically acclaimed sci-fi horror masterpiece is coming to Nintendo Switch™.

STASIS is an isometric, point-and-click, sci-fi horror adventure game. It intertwines a gruesome narrative with retro adventure gameplay. Combine items, interact with computers and solve puzzles while experiencing the gritty atmosphere.

In the distant future, aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft, John Maracheck awakes from stasis. He must push himself to new physical and emotional limits and unravel the mysteries around him.

FEATURES:
▪ LOSE YOURSELF IN SOUND - experience cinematic AAA music composed by the legendary Mark Morgan,
▪ A BLAST FROM THE PAST - a retro adventure gameplay mixed with a gruesome narrative,
▪ WANDER AROUND THE GROOMLAKE - click, read and interact to explore the dark corners of your surroundings. Gather items and clues that will help you solve the puzzles,
▪ THE VOICES ARE GETTING LOUDER - unfold the story with professional voice acting that brings depth to every character.

REVIEWS:
▪ “Stasis is not a game with any big ideas: it’s blessedly stripped-down, grub horror that will tear your soul apart. | 9.5/10” - FORBES
▪ “The game’s atmosphere is thick with tension, but it’s not trying to make you sweat the whole time, so the few moments it breaks things up and hits you with something shocking, it really works.” - KOTAKU
▪ “It's more than just "good for an indie game", it's a mandatory experience for fans of sci-fi horror. | 9/10 [AMAZING]” - IGN

Additional languages:
▪ Hungarian (HU/MAGYAR),
▪ Polish (PL/POLSKI),
▪ Turkish (TUR/TÜRKÇE).

70010000097861.name: Laundry Simulator 2025
70010000097861.intro: From Soap Suds to Success: Build Your Laundromat Empire!
70010000097861.description:
Step into the sudsy world of Laundry Simulator 2025, where fresh linens and crisp folds pave the way to your very own laundromat empire! Whether you’re meticulously scrubbing stains or letting high-end machines do the work, your goal is simple—turn your small shop into the hottest laundry spot in town.

- Clean Like a Pro – Load up the washers, select the perfect cycle, and give each item the care it deserves. From everyday laundry to VIP celebrity garments, every spotless result brings you closer to greatness.

- Run It Your Way – Go hands-on by washing, drying, and ironing clothes yourself, or automate the process for that sweet passive income. Hire staff to keep things running while you sit back and watch the cash roll in.

- Bigger, Better, Faster – Invest in top-tier equipment to boost efficiency, increase profits, and dominate the laundry business. The cleaner the clothes, the fatter the paycheck!

- Keep Things Spotless – Maintain your shop, fix up worn-out machines, and make sure your laundromat stays clean and inviting. Upgrade your space, decorate to your taste, and attract high-profile customers who demand only the best.

From humble beginnings to washing royalty’s robes, Laundry Simulator 2025 is your ticket to cleaning success. So grab a mop, fire up those dryers, and turn dirty laundry into piles of cash!

70010000097866.name: Skautfold: Moonless Knight
70010000097866.intro: When everything goes awry and the Moon opens, will you save the Empire or fall to Eldritch cultists?
70010000097866.description:
A Skautfold Story

Return to the Lovecraftian nightmare of the Angelic Empire of Britannia as Gray, the 2nd Knight, sent on a diplomatic mission to the Dawn Empire of Japan. The mission immediately goes horribly wrong as Lunatic cultists instigate a religious coup, putting the Japanese Emperor and Eleanor's envoys at risk. Your task? Explore the Oda Imperial Palace, negotiate with its factions, and secure the survival of the Empire!

The story follows the events of Shrouded in Sanity, Usurper, and Into the Fray, as the Skautfold series is heading to its conclusion. Knowledge of the previous games is not required to enjoy the game, but it will most certainly make it even more enjoyable.

A Tight-knit Metroidvania

Pick your path and your battles. The world's semi-open design allows you to forge your own way to your objective, learning shortcuts and loops as you piece together the dark secrets of the Imperial Family and its first God Emperor.

Take on bosses in any order you please. Safe heavens, familiars and Relics will allow you to grow your power and return to past areas. Along the way, tend to dying soldiers, collect Yth stones, discover ninja pugs hidden in plain sight, and dart around the Eldritch horrors posing as innocent treasures!


And Explosive Combat!

Fight for your life with an overhauled Guard System featuring perfect blocks and well-timed dodges. Careless actions will snowball as health damage affects your maximum guard, but it goes both ways: punish your enemies or be punished yourself!

Waltham Industry's Vitae Injections will allow you to recover or even overcharge your health, buffing your damage and allowing you to tank troublesome attacks.


When everything goes awry and the Moon looms above, will you save the Empire or fall to Eldritch cultists?

70010000097871.name: MYSIDE REALITY
70010000097871.intro: Fall in, fade out—where does the real world end?
70010000097871.description:
MYSIDE REALITY: Through the Darkness is an exciting first-person adventure where reality and the virtual world merge into one. Finding yourself inside your favorite game, you encounter a mysterious girl named Mira. She claims to be seeking companionship, but her friendliness hides something deeper. In this strange world, you must unravel her secret and understand what’s really going on.

Game Features:
- A Boundless World: Immerse yourself in a unique world where virtual reality and real reality intertwine. Every decision you make affects what happens next.
- Puzzles and Mysteries: Interact with objects and characters to uncover hidden aspects of this world. Every step brings you closer to the truth.
- Deep Storyline: Learn more about Mira, her intentions, and the nature of this enigmatic world. The further you go, the more questions arise.
- Immersive Atmosphere: Detailed locations and realistic game elements create a strong sense of presence. The world is full of secrets waiting to be uncovered.

Unraveling the Mystery: In the exploration and interaction mode with Mira, every step you take influences the development of events. Only by properly interpreting her words and actions will you be able to understand where you are and whether it’s possible to return home.

70010000097901.name: Kamla
70010000097901.intro: In this SURVIVAL HORROR, a priest, attempts to escape an old mansion by solving puzzles and completing objectives to cure a woman of her demonic possession.
70010000097901.description:
Welcome to Kamla's House:
Set in 1980's India, Kamla was recently married into a rich family with a mansion full of mysteries to uncover and stories to unfold. 
Just a year later she has lost her sanity and killed people in the family and is now waiting for help.
Kamla :
After losing her sanity because of the demonic possession, Kamla has already killed few people and now haunts the mansion walking around, you must find her and help her.
The Ritual :
You are an Indian priest with prowess in black magic, also known as a "Tantrik". You must find objects required in your recipe to exorcise Kamla near the holy fire, These recipe items have unique values and are scattered around the house in different ways. some easy to get and some hidden behind obstacles and puzzles.
- Solve puzzles to clear obstacles and unlock items.
- Evade Kamla when she is angry, find places to hide and dont lose collected items!
- Collect these items in the holy fire and say the final prayer to finish the exorcism.
Kamla provides a tense atmophospheric thrill for the ones who love a little scare, we hope you get in there and fix Kamla as soon as possible!

70010000097907.name: Rally Drive Championship Car Racing Game
70010000097907.intro:
Push the Limits.
Chase the Clock.
Own the Road.
70010000097907.description:
Rally Drive Championship: Car Racing Game
Get ready for the ultimate off-road racing challenge! In Rally Drive Championship, you'll tear through dirt tracks, icy roads, and desert trails in high-speed time-attack races. Master tight turns, drift through rugged terrain, and beat the clock to unlock powerful rally cars and new environments. With precision driving, intense weather conditions, and adrenaline-pumping checkpoints, this is rally racing at its finest.

No brakes. No mercy. Just pure rally action.

70010000097912.name: BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons
70010000097912.intro:
More Quests, More Power!
An All New Bubble Bobble Experience!
70010000097912.description:
*This product is available for purchase as part of the bundle for “BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons” and “BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Deluxe Edition”.

Bub the bubble-blowing dragon goes on an adventure through sweet dungeons that change every time!
Blow bubbles to catch bullies, use your horns and spikes to burst the bubbles and beat them!
Bubbles can be carried by the wind, and you can get to high places by riding bubbles!
Collect treasures in dungeons that change every time you step inside and conquer huge castles!
Collecting treasure will strengthen Bub's abilities and skills.
Get stronger along with Bub and explore the depths of treat-filled dungeons!

■Game features
-The first in the series to feature "dungeons" that change every time you step into them!
Each time you enter a dungeon, the shape of the stage, the platforms, the enemies that appear, and their placement change, so you can always enjoy a fresh level!
You don't necessarily have to beat all of the enemies in this game!
Simply trap them or defeat them your way, and move on to the next stage by passing through the donut-shaped gate!
In the dungeons, it is easy to get "treasures" that can be used to make Bub stronger, so dive back into dungeons repeatedly to collect treasures and build Bub's skills up!

Once you get used to the controls and familiar with leveling Bub up, we recommend challenging your limits and dive even deeper into the dungeon!

- A huge "castle" that develops the map appears for the first time in the series!
The castle is one huge stage, and you will progress through each room that is connected like a maze, sometimes getting lost, sometimes finding your way using the knowledge you have build playing.
Unique bosses are waiting, so level Bub up, equip yourself, and aim for the deepest treasures.

- Master new and returning skills!
The Water Bubble is back in a new form!
You'll also find new skills that will help you along your journey, like Rolling Attack, which wipes enemies out, as well as many other abilities.

Use your skills to break through paths that were previously inaccessible, and defeat strong enemies in one go...!

- Find the skills and strategies that suit you!
The skills you have learned become items you can use.
The number of items you can take to a dungeon or castle at once is fixed, so it's up to you to decide what kind of skill items and useful items you take and how many of them you take.

You can also decide in what order you use the treasures you collect to make Bub stronger.

■The setting

The setting of the new Bubble Bobble game is a world full of "strange" sweet treats!
Cute Candy-shaped enemies start appearing in vibrant dungeons and castles.

■The Story

When Bub wakes up... finding himself in a strange laboratory.
A mysterious person named "Dolchen" suddenly appears and asks him to take on a mission to retrieve the "treasure" that lies dormant in the dungeon and castle.
Bub loves adventure, so when he hears "treasure," you bet he's up for it!
And so begins Bub's strange and sweet adventure.

70010000097914.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Siheung-si
70010000097914.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000097914.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Siheung-si (City), Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 2 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000097929.name: Merge World Alchemist
70010000097929.intro: Merge items to develop the ultimate alchemy
70010000097929.description:
Hiiro Amami, a novice alchemist, has graduated from alchemy school and opened hers workshop today.
Hiiro's best friend Augusta Margery comes to celebrate with her.
Hiiro is motivated after receiving a new alchemy pot as a gift!
However, Augusta tells her something shocking.
She tells her that she is moving to a faraway city to treat her illness.
Knowing that she will never see her again once she moves, Hiiro aims to create an item for treatment before she moves.

・How to do alchemy
Acquire materials by requesting collection from the Adventurer's Guild or by going out and collecting them yourself.
Merge materials together to increase their level.
Combine three types of materials to start alchemy.
You can turn in the alchemy items you create in quests to the Merchant Guild.

70010000097963.name: Magibrick
70010000097963.intro: A Deckbuilding Tile Battler Like No Other!
70010000097963.description:
Draft Wacky Monster Tiles to duel eccentric foes! Flood the board, shatter enemy tiles, pop off sick combos, and paint the map your way! Welcome to Tiletopia!

Tile Takedown:
Take turns slapping down tiles. Dominate more spaces to win by points!

Monster Tiles & Arcane Shards:
Units with rad designs, sizes, and skills. Some drop fragile Arcane Shards – place with purpose!

Killer Terrain:
Leverage sweet spots, avoid nasty zones. Will landscapes be clutch or chaos?

Deckbuilding Glory:
Unlock cards by trash-talking foes or cracking puzzles. Choose paths to play safe or throw down with bosses. Cook up decks and complete your collection!

70010000097970.name: World At War: Cobra
70010000097970.intro: Nintendo Switch™ Exclusive! Take part in the historic and intense tank battles of Operation Cobra, pitting the Sherman M4A2 against the formidable Tiger II!
70010000097970.description:
Operation Cobra, the battle that changed history! Amidst a brutal battlefield filled with gunfire, explosions, blood and mud, your every move now determines the fate of the war. Engage in fierce tank battles between the Sherman and the Tiger and experience high-stakes, strategic combat. With photorealistic graphics and immersive gameplay, you will be the hero of this historic moment. Experience the fight for world peace and freedom firsthand in the ultimate FPS!

・Operation Cobra features intense battles between Sherman M4A2 and Tiger II tanks!
・Hyper-realistic environments and ultra-high-definition graphics capture every detail, from bullets to billowing smoke on the battlefield.
・Join Operation Cobra and take on special missions as part of the front line.
・Unmatched Realism! Enjoy immersive gameplay powered by a 3D soundscape and advanced physics engine.
・Stunning visuals! Realistic graphics perfectly capture the light and shadows of the battlefield for maximum immersion.
・Hide behind burning tanks or destroyed buildings and engage in tense firefights just like in real combat.
・Enjoy strategic gameplay by utilizing the unique abilities of three character classes: Assault, Support and Sniper.
・Achieve victory with precise aiming and an advanced targeting system that simulates the handling of real combat weapons!
・Experience the thrill of teamwork and cooperative play with your allies.

Lead your squad to victory in some of the most iconic moments of World War II. Military fans will be thrilled by the authentic combat, the excitement of precision marksmanship, and the stunning 3D effects and graphics that bring the global conflict to life. Don't miss World at War: Cobra, the ultimate team-based single-player FPS available exclusively on Nintendo Switch™!

Synopsis 
Summer 1944, seven weeks after the Normandy landings in France. As British and Canadian forces pinned down the Germans around Caen, General Bradley's U.S. First Army prepared for a massive breakout: Operation Cobra. The stage was set in the bocage country of Normandy and northwestern France, including places like Brécourt, Saint-Lô, and Carentan. After repeated delays due to bad weather, the operation began on July 25 with thousands of Allied bombers carpet-bombing German defenses.

The U.S. VII and VIII Corps spearheaded the advance, and the Germans, short on men and materiel, struggled to mount an effective defense. The main American tank, the highly maneuverable Sherman M4A2, leads the charge alongside infantry. The Germans counter with the formidable Tiger II, known for its powerful cannon and thick armor. The narrow streets of Brécourt, the ruins of Saint-Lô and the fields of Carentan were the scene of fierce tank battles.

On July 26, the Americans secured the Le Mesnil-Herman crossroads and reached Coutances on the 27th. Despite resistance from German 88mm anti-aircraft guns and Tiger IIs, the Allied assault quickly broke through the defenses. Sherman tanks, working closely with infantry, smashed through the German lines, forcing the enemy to retreat across the Seine.

Operation Cobra marks a turning point on the Normandy front, allowing the Allies to begin their advance to liberate the world. Now players must join the chaos, strategy, and courage of the battlefield alongside Sherman tanks and fight for the freedom of the world.

70010000097975.name: Ad SHOOt
70010000097975.intro: Shoot Down the Fictional Ads in a Vertical Bullet-Hell Shmup
70010000097975.description:
Story:
