Frustrated by unskippable video ads, the protagonist jumps into a shmup to blast them away.
Clear every stage and reclaim a smooth, ad-free internet life!

Languages:
Audio: Japanese (fully voiced)
Subtitles & UI: Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese

Charming Bosses:
Each stage boss is a marketing rep from a fictional company.
They fire bullet hell barrages purely out of a desire to promote their products—they mean no harm.
Plus, they’ve got great looks and voices. 

Beginner-Friendly Shmup:
Thanks to the HP gauge system, taking a few hits won’t end your run.
If you’ve ever thought shmups were too tough, this is the perfect one to start with.

Ads Aren’t the Enemy:
Clear stages to unlock special skills—like regenerating Lives when you stop shooting.
In fact, not shooting down the ads might work in your favor.
Use the power of ads to your advantage!

Original Soundtrack:
Every stage and boss comes with its own custom-composed theme.
With ever-changing vibes, there’s never a dull moment.

All 7 Stages:
Main Game: 6 stages × 3 difficulty levels

Extra Stage: 1 stage × 6 variations (with unique dialogues and ending illustrations)

No In-Software Ads:
No real ads are included in this software.
You’ll never be forced to watch one while playing—promise!

Japanese Voice Cast:
Kyohei Natsume / Haruki Asada / Yuki Amezawa / Daisuke Hirakawa / Masahiro Yamanaka

70010000097980.name: SQUARES
70010000097980.intro: Slide squares, fill the grid, and solve tricky puzzles!
70010000097980.description:
Squares is a challenging and addictive puzzle game that evolves as you play. Slide squares across the grid, filling empty spaces to complete each level. With each new stage, the difficulty increases, adding more squares to control and introducing new mechanics like teleportation.

The game features procedurally generated levels, meaning every playthrough is unique, offering endless puzzles to solve. The controls are simple, yet the puzzles require careful planning and strategy to navigate. As the levels progress, you’ll face more complex challenges that demand quick thinking and precision.

Whether you're a puzzle enthusiast or just looking for a casual game to pass the time, Squares offers a satisfying experience that keeps you coming back for more. With its minimalist design and ever-growing difficulty, it’s the perfect game for players who love to think outside the box.

70010000097985.name: The Perfect Pencil
70010000097985.intro: Lost in the kingdom of the white beast, will you find your way out? The Perfect Pencil is a story-driven action platformer that throws you into the innermost depths of the human mind.
70010000097985.description:
The Perfect Pencil is a surreal action platformer which tells the tale of personal development and the psychology of fear. Join protagonist John as he awakens in a bizarre hand-drawn kingdom and comes face-to-face with the terrors that dwell in the last place he'd have thought to look...

Embark on an emotional odyssey exploring the depths of an unfamiliar environment using protagonist John's innate ability to see things that others can’t. Make choices that will compel you to carve your own personal route through both light and darkness, however, beware, things might not be as they seem.

Go off the beaten path and discover numerous side quests dotted throughout the world, you never know what you might find. Both dark and comforting surreal landscapes filled with secrets, surprises and peculiar personalities are waiting to be unraveled.

John’s unique analysis ability grants you the power to uncover hidden information about NPCs, peculiar objects and elements of the environment. The Perfect Pencil is filled with additional lore and secrets for players to find. Roam beyond the beaten path, scan the world around you - Who knows... behind one of these corners you might find something that will change your perspective.

John’s fight from within, but he will also encounter tense boss battles in the form of unsettling manifestations - all symbolising unique elements of the human psyche. Some encounters may even make you question your sense of reality…but remember, in order to survive you will have to be willing to take risks.

70010000097995.name: Rogue Raccoon
70010000097995.description:
Get ready to sneak into the city's most overprotected museum... all for food! In Rogue Raccoon, you play as a fast and cheeky raccoon on a clear mission: clean out the food court, one hidden snack at a time.

Jump, wall-jump, dash in eight directions, and use your trusty boomerang to defeat enemies, trigger secret mechanisms, and make your way through wild traps and dangerous exhibits. But beware: the closer you get to the treats, the more the museum fights back with tricky hazards and challenges that’ll make any raccoon break a sweat!

There are 30 action-packed levels split between the exhibition halls and the legendary food court. Each stage is a test of agility and creativity, where mastering the boomerang is the key to surviving and gobbling up every snack in your path.

If you enjoy challenging platformers, simple yet strategic combat, and a good dose of mischief, Rogue Raccoon is the heist you’ve been waiting for. Just don’t blame the raccoon.

70010000098005.name: Y. Village - The Visitors
70010000098005.intro: Batu, tormented by nightmares, is lured to a nameless village via cryptic letter
70010000098005.description:
Our game offers you a unique experience with its structure formed by real footages featuring real actors.

Batu, plagued by recurring nightmares of an unknown village, finds his life upended by a mysterious letter left at his doorstep one day. The letter bears a chilling message: "Do you wish to be free from your nightmares? We await you..."

The next day, the mystery deepens with the arrival of a second note revealing the name of the village: "Y. Village." Unsure of who beckons him and wary of potential dangers, Batu gathers a group to venture to the village. However, as they approach its boundaries, they're confronted by an unsettling figure in a gas mask, instilling fear in the group. All but Batu are consumed by terror, for he claims he cannot see this person. Believing his friends to be hallucinating from fear, Batu presses on.

Now, only one friend remains by Batu’s side as they journey into the village. They're welcomed by Hasan, a hospitable local. Everything seems ordinary until Batu awakens in the night to a piercing siren, revealing the village's true horrifying nature. For his friend is no longer in bed and has vanished.

Can Batu locate his friend, unravel the village's mystery, and escape? What has drawn Batu to this village? What secrets await to be unveiled in the village? In this village filled with mysteries, what startling conclusion awaits Batu?

70010000098010.name: Legends of Amberland II: The Song of Trees
70010000098010.intro: A classic western dungeon crawler inspired by great 90s era RPGs. Light, fairy tale, epic, heroic, slightly humorous adventure
70010000098010.description:
Legends of Amberland II: The Song of Trees is a classic western dungeon crawler RPG. Using the classic first-person perspective, over grid movement, turn-based system to travel in an open world with fast travel options and a quick combat.

You lead a party of 7 adventurers, manually assembled or pre-made, on an epic adventure to fight the evil which lurks in Amberland. It's light, fairy tale, epic, heroic and slightly humorous. It does not take tons of hours to complete or require an endless grind to progress. Basically, it's a love letter from the 90s, the golden era of RPGs.

Notable features:
* First person perspective, 90 degree rotation, over grid movement (like in the 90s).
* Turn-based (both combat and exploration).
* Party-based (7 heroes, either predefined or manually assembled upon new game).
* Fast paced combat, especially blazing fast against much weaker enemies.
* Quick travel to reduce backtracking.
* Easy inventory management with separate personal equipment encumbrance system and an infinite magic bag of carrying for items not equipped at the moment.
* Open world with a big overworld to explore.
* Quests (including both main storyline quests and side quests).
* Rich world lore (spanning between all games of the series, but no knowledge of prior games required).

About the relation to other games in the series:
The Legends of Amberland titles can be played in any order you wish. They share the same world and lore (historical events) but each has a separate and self-contained story. There might be some mild references to events in the previous titles of the series, but more like a flavor, so it does not hinder the ability to play those in any order.

70010000098025.name: Rue Valley
70010000098025.intro: Rue Valley is a narrative RPG about a man trapped in a time loop, surrounded by a colorful cast with complex emotional stories, each hiding unexpected secrets.
70010000098025.description:
Break free from a mysterious time loop! Embark on a journey of self-discovery and resilience. Delve into the enigmatic depths of the small godforsaken town: Rue Valley.

Each day feels like an uphill battle against the shadows of your own mind. Along the way, you will encounter a captivating ensemble of characters, each wrestling with their own emotional complexities and revealing hidden depths as you get to know them.

Can you muster the courage to unravel the secrets of this temporal anomaly? Can you discover the strength within yourself to rise above adversity and forge a brighter tomorrow?

Craft your own personality in Rue Valley. You can be a cold-hearted loner who overthinks everything or a melodramatic loudmouth who always trusts their gut instinct.

Whether you reflect your true personality or role-play someone entirely different, your character will shape your dialogues and interactions in the game.

Store memories in a graph, unlocking intentions and mindsets as you progress uniquely through the story. Commit to quirky mindsets for unexpected and hilarious dialogues, and experience personality-altering Status Effects: become more outgoing when drunk, or extra sensitive when anxious.

Experiment with different answers and timelines, because the loop will restart from the beginning anyway, won't it?

70010000098031.name: Quisisana
70010000098031.intro: Will you survive and uncover the truth?
70010000098031.description:
There is a storm, and you find yourself standing in front of an old villa, shrouded in darkness. The full moon shines in the sky, the house appears abandoned, yet something compels you to enter.

As soon as you step through the door, you immediately sense that something is wrong. An unnatural silence fills the air, cold and heavy. You don’t remember how you got here, but one thing is certain: you are not alone. Something moves in the shadows… and it is watching you.

You must explore the villa, search for clues, and solve puzzles to understand what is happening and, most importantly, find a way out. But be careful: the presence haunting this place won’t let you leave so easily.

Will you survive and uncover the truth?

70010000098034.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number
70010000098034.intro: Relax and create beautiful pixel art with color-by-number and cross-stitch fun!
70010000098034.description:
Escape into a world of vibrant colors and pixelated charm with Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number. Choose from a vast collection of delightful images and bring them to life with your artistic touch. Whether you prefer the classic color-by-number approach or the textured beauty of cross-stitch, there's a style for everyone. 

Features:
•	200 Pixel Images: Discover a diverse library of captivating pixel art, from adorable animals to breathtaking landscapes. 
•	Color by Number & Cross Stitch: Choose your preferred coloring style and experience the joy of creating pixel masterpieces.
•	Colorblind Mode: An inclusive feature ensuring everyone can enjoy the game, regardless of color vision differences. 
•	Relaxing & Rewarding: Unwind with soothing gameplay and the satisfaction of seeing your creations come to life. 
•	Perfect for All Ages: Enjoy a creative outlet that's accessible and enjoyable for both kids and adults. 

Let your imagination run wild and create pixel art that sparkles with color!

70010000098036.name: Adrenaline Rampage
70010000098036.intro: Adrenaline Rampage is a platformer roguelite where you play as a soldier with up to 5 weapons to fight techno-zombies.
70010000098036.description:
Choose characters and skills to rush through the space city, kill ugly BOSSes, and survive.

Key Features:
- Combination of survivor and platformer genres
- Procedural level generation
- Unbridled progression in core gameplay
- Each character has a unique set of weapons and skills
- Weapons can usually be upgraded to a super-powerful evolution
- A hub with functionality that needs to be opened for energy. You get energy for killing techno-zombies.

70010000098048.name: Flamecraft
70010000098048.intro: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic.
70010000098048.description:
Flamecraft is a cozy, turn-based strategy board game for 1 to 5 players. Become a Flamekeeper and help artisan dragons and shopkeepers delight the townspeople with their craft. Gather and manage resources, enhance the shops by casting enchantments, and become the Master of Flamecraft.

Enter a cozy, vibrant world inhabited by dragons

Flamecraft is set in a fantasy world, in which dragons and magic are part of the ordinary. Here, you’ll meet the adorable artisan dragons, who will use their extraordinary flamecraft to help the town’s shopkeepers with their seemingly mundane tasks. 
The sweets are just waiting to be baked in Guilty Treasures, and Scale Mail Post is ready to send enchanted letters all across the town!

Master the art of resource management and create powerful combos to increase your reputation

You’ll have to strategize and outsmart other Flamekeepers if you want to come out on top. There are countless ways to victory, and it’s up to you to make the most of your skills. Your main task is to thoughtfully place dragon artisans in the town’s bustling shopping district. They will help you gather various resources from the shops, which you can later use to cast enchantments, triggering powerful ability combos. You’ll also befriend the extraordinary Fancy Dragons, with abilities allowing you to boost your reputation.
This, along with the Companion cards, which offer powerful additional scoring opportunities, will let you get the reputation points needed to win the game.

Play in a variety of gameplay modes, both single and multiplayer 

Whether you prefer playing solo, with friends, or people from around the world, Flamecraft has something in store for you. Test your skills against AI of varying difficulty or set up a relaxing custom game for your family to enjoy together.

Meet over 70 beautiful animated dragons and visit 30 unique shops while listening to a whimsical score

In Flamecraft, we’ve brought the enchanting world created by Sandara Tang to life. The beautifully illustrated dragons come to life as they use their craft in the vibrant, hand-painted town, full of animated 3D shops, booths, and laboratories. 
Paweł Górniak, the composer behind Wingspan and Quilts and Cats of Calico, is also back, with another spellbinding score.

Will you be able to claim the Master of Flamecraft title with the help of your creative little crafter friends?

70010000098061.name: 40 Sports Games in 1
70010000098061.description:
The largest collection of sports anywhere – With 40 different sports, there's something for everyone! Play against family and friends in football, bowling, volleyball, golf, horse racing, and more! Showcase your skills and take on every challenge to become the ultimate champion!

Unconventional and challenging sports – Go beyond classic sports like football and baseball by trying out obscure games such as paddling tug-of-war, or Taekwondo!

Unlock and customize – As you progress, earn and unlock new costumes to personalize your characters to stand out in every game!

New sports to added to the roster – Find all the classic sports that made 34 Sports Games in 1 a hit and discover six new games to play!

70010000098083.name: AGENT 07- SPY REVENGE
70010000098083.intro: Enter the mission and become a legend of espionage.
70010000098083.description:
Immerse yourself in a thrilling retro first-person shooter experience that captures the essence of classic console games. Step into a high-octane world filled with espionage, danger, and action as you take on the role of agent . Embark on a series of daring missions that will test your wits, reflexes, and combat skills. Navigate through captivating environments, engage in intense shootouts, and confront enemies armed with cutting-edge AI. The fate of the world rests in your hands as you uncover a global conspiracy and battle through pulse-pounding action sequences.
	•Retro FPS Action: Experience the thrill of first-person shooting, with fast-paced combat, intense firefights, and adrenaline-pumping missions.
	•Engaging Espionage Story: Uncover a global conspiracy as agent, blending stealth, strategy, and action to save the world from an impending threat.
	•Varied Missions & Objectives: Each mission offers unique challenges—hack terminals, steal secrets, rescue hostages, and eliminate enemies in diverse environments.
	•Advanced Enemy AI: Face off against AI that adapts to your every move, making each encounter unpredictable and intense.
	•Iconic Gadgets & Weapons: Use a wide range of spy gadgets and powerful weapons to overcome obstacles and take down enemies in style.

Each story mission is a self-contained environment where you must accomplish varied objectives, such as hacking terminals, stealing secret plans, rescuing civilian hostages, and much more. All the while, you’ll fight armed guards in epic shootouts.

Be the most elite agent the world has ever seen!

70010000098098.name: Food Truck Chef - Full Course Edition
70010000098098.intro: Manage and build your Food Truck! Cook global dishes, upgrade your kitchen, and serve hungry customers in this fast-paced cooking game
70010000098098.description:
Love food truck cooking games? Get ready to unleash your inner chef with Food Truck Chef! Join Emily on a global culinary journey, preparing mouthwatering recipes from tacos and sushi to pizza and beyond!
 
Food Truck Chef is an exciting, fast-paced cooking and management game where your culinary dreams come to life on wheels! Start with a humble food truck where you'll prepare meals, satisfy customers, and work your way up to transform it into the ultimate foodie hotspot! 
 
Master the kitchen
Upgrade your food truck, serve hungry customers, and become a top chef! Time management is key as you cook, serve, and manage your way to success.
 
Explore the world
Discover 19+ exciting locations, each with unique dishes to master. From the bustling food streets of Asia to the vibrant flavors of Mexico, there's always a new kitchen challenge to tackle.
 
Key features
• Endless fun: Hundreds of levels, dishes, and upgrades to keep you entertained.
• Addictive gameplay: Easy to learn, with fast-paced cooking game mechanics.
• Colorful visuals: Enjoy lively, engaging art that brings each food truck scene to life.

70010000098103.name: MISDIE: Into the Game
70010000098103.intro: A Digital Dream... or Your Worst Nightmare?
70010000098103.description:
In MISDIE: Into the Game, one wrong tap on your phone pulls you into a world you were never meant to visit. Bright colors and familiar faces quickly give way to something far stranger—and far more dangerous.

Trapped inside a digital dream that shifts into a nightmare, you’ll follow cryptic clues, encounter characters who aren’t quite what they seem, and piece together the truth hidden beneath the surface. Some will offer help. Others will play games of their own. And somewhere, something is always watching.

Blending vibrant anime visuals with a chilling atmosphere, MISDIE: Into the Game is a journey through mystery, memory, and fear. Trust carefully, move quickly, and remember: in this world, nothing stays friendly for long.

70010000098108.name: Sports Camp: A 35-Game Adventure
70010000098108.intro: Welcome to Sports Camp, the ultimate party game packed with over 35 unexpected activities.
70010000098108.description:
Welcome to Sports Camp, the ultimate party game packed with over 35 unique and unexpected
activities. Forget traditional sports—jump into sheep roping, walking roll ball, hovercraft, and more in
a vibrant summer camp adventure.

Explore a lively open-world camp full of activities, treasures, and secrets in Story Mode, or
gather friends and family for instant multiplayer fun on one console. Compete, cooperate, or just
enjoy the adventure together, as every game is a new experience.

With easy-to-learn gameplay, nonstop variety, and activities you won’t find anywhere else,
there’s something for everyone.

Sports Camp is the perfect way to share unforgettable moments with your loved ones.

70010000098133.name: Fall Up
70010000098133.intro: Leap, warp, and uncover the secrets of a lost mechanical world with the adorable Labi!
70010000098133.description:
Leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with the adorable Labi! Use a wide range of jumps and moves to traverse this colorful cartoon world, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots, and uncover its hidden secrets.

GAMEPLAY

Labi is all about powerful, precise jumps!

Installing a thruster module instead of a mobility module by mistake gave Labi the shortest yet most powerful legs of any robot. With those mighty legs, Labi can perform a Leg Launch and blast off like a cannonball, Stomp enemies with tremendous force, or spring off walls.

And it gets even better! Once Labi finds the Warp Ball, you can instantly teleport to wherever it lands. To overcome obstacles and solve puzzles, plan your route carefully and combine Running, Stomping, Dashing, and Double Jumping to find the best way forward. When danger strikes, Dash like a ninja and rely on your quick reflexes to dodge whatever comes your way.

GOALS

The core directive of Labi’s program: seek FREEDOM!

Collect Batteries scattered throughout each level. Some lie in plain sight along the main path, while others require a little extra exploration. At the end of each level, you will receive Gems based on the number of Batteries you collected. Gather enough Gems to unlock new areas.

Collect every Battery in a level to unlock its Time Trial. Complete the challenge to earn the level’s final Gem—a worthy prize for serious challengers!

FEATURES

Every being, organic or synthetic, has value—even robots. Cute ones, at least!

An enemy one moment may become your friend the next. Despite their intimidating appearance, enemies do not mind Labi bouncing on their heads. Manipulate, provoke, or even protect them, then use their abilities to complete levels in ways you never imagined.

STORY

An imaginary yet strangely realistic post-apocalyptic world.

Where did all these robots come from? Who created them? And why do those seemingly pointless assembly lines continue running forever?

Explore a fantastical world of giant fruit and adorable robots while uncovering a heartfelt story about humanity and identity. Journey through colorful, vibrant environments, interact with an intriguing cast of characters, and gradually piece together the history of this world. Help our little hero discover what truly matters, reveal everything that has been lost, and befriend a whole cast of totally huggable characters!

70010000098138.name: Sports Camp's Artbook
70010000098138.intro: Complete your experience with Sports Camp’s Artbook!
70010000098138.description:
Take a peek into The Art of Sports Camp and its 30 pages of concept art, artwork, avatars, animals, and environment.

Spoiler alert! This product contains some spoilers regarding Sports Camp's content, browse at your own risk!

70010000098143.name: We Were Here Together
70010000098143.intro: Embark on a puzzle solving adventure in which you and a partner must prove you can communicate and work together to escape the haunted Castle Rock.
70010000098143.description:
It all begins with an emergency flare lighting up the sky and a distress call waking you from uneasy dreams. Your fellow Antarctic explorers are in trouble, and the two of you left at base camp must work together to launch a rescue mission. If only you knew what you were getting into…

From the research base camp you’ll need to figure out a way to get to the source of the distress flare. Once you’re through the frozen Antarctic wastes, you'll find yourselves separated inside a medieval castle, facing puzzles, secrets, and dangers! You and your partner start out with nothing but your wits and a walkie-talkie each. Observation, smart communication and teamwork will be the only way to escape from the sinister Castle Rock.

Feature list
- Spine-tingling story: uncover a dark history, and become closer acquainted with the malevolent being known only as ‘the Jester’. Who, or what, is he?
- Walkie-talkie: you must communicate to progress – find out just how good you are at describing and explaining your surroundings
- Puzzle packed: work together to solve this captivating digital escape room
- Mysterious locales: explore the expedition base camp, frozen Antarctic valleys, and the sinister Castle Rock itself

70010000098156.name: Poly Bridge 3
70010000098156.intro: The best just got better! Rediscover your engineering creativity in this genre-defining bridge engineering and puzzle solving masterpiece.
70010000098156.description:
Poly Bridge 3 is a puzzle game where building bridges is key. Get vehicles to their destination by testing your engineering and problem solving skills. Suspension bridges, draw-bridges, multi-level bridges, crazy almost-bridges, bridges, bridges, bridges!

Explore the new Open World Campaign with a dozen worlds and 150+ new levels. Jumps, Hydraulics, ‘Normal’ Bridges, and more giving you hours of gameplay to enjoy! Take a flying leap in Vaulty Towers or flex those hydraulic muscles in Bifrost Bend!

Let your engineering creativity flow with no restrictions in Sandbox mode, allowing you to push your bridge building skills to the limit.

Challenge yourself with improving your rank on the Leaderboards and check out other player solutions in the Gallery!

Our custom physics engine gives total control, reliability, and accuracy to your bridges. Sleep easy at night knowing your bridges will perform consistently every time!

70010000098161.name: SCHEDULE I - MAFIA EMPIRE
70010000098161.intro: Every second a choice. Every choice a consequence.
70010000098161.description:
Step into the shadows and build an empire from nothing. In this underground simulator, power is earned through ambition, strategy, and risk. Start small, grow smart. Cultivate rare plants, perfect your product, and balance quality, speed, and secrecy. Find market suppliers, target high-paying buyers, and stay ahead of rivals. Demand is high—if you can deliver. Reinvest profits to upgrade gear, automate production, and expand into new, riskier ventures. Control supply, dominate demand. Run a tight operation. Earn client trust, manage your crew, and make deals that change everything—fast.

Key Features:
– Grow and refine unique high-value crops.
– Manage production, upgrades, and staff to optimize output
– Discover hidden markets and build a loyal client base
– Make tough choices with lasting consequences
– Expand your plants empire and become the kingpin of your industry.

In this world, only the clever, cautious, and bold survive. Will you play it safe—or take the risks that lead to power?
Your empire won’t build itself.

70010000098170.name: ONLY Sky Parkour: Island UP!
70010000098170.intro: Every jump is a step closer to the top!
70010000098170.description:
Start from scratch and get to the top in ONLY Sky Parkour: Island UP! A game where every jump counts.
It doesn't matter how many times you fall - it matters how many times you get back up again. Control your movement, overcome obstacles and move up, one step at a time.
You play as a brave girl who decided to conquer the sky. Unlock new images and skins to pass the way in your own style - from cute outfits to bright and daring images.
Checkpoints will help you record success, but the rest is only in your hands.
Are you ready to prove you can make it to the end?

70010000098190.name: Arcade Archives SUPER BASKETBALL
70010000098190.intro: Can you turn the situation around in this dire situation?
70010000098190.description:
"SUPER BASKETBALL" is a sports game released by KONAMI in 1984.
There are 10 competing teams. Every match starts at a disadvantage.
Use skillful dribbling and passing to turn the tide and aim to win within the time limit. 

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000098196.name: Castle of Heart: Retold
70010000098196.intro: Rescue the last Slavic priestess before the curse turns you into dust
70010000098196.description:
Castle of Heart: Retold is a massively upgraded and expanded version of the original game, featuring significant enhancements across gameplay, story, visuals, and more.

Stand against the Sorcerer—a servant of the evil god Chernobog—to rescue the last priestess of the goddess Mokosh and liberate the land from his tyrannical rule. As a Slavic warrior named Svaran, you must overcome not only magical creatures and lethal contraptions, but also a terrible curse that has turned your body to stone. You need to keep your kill streak going—otherwise your body will begin to disintegrate, eventually costing you limbs and the ability to wield weapons!

CHALLENGE WORTHY OF A KNIGHT
Travel across four distinct Slavic landscapes and prove your worth against the Sorcerer’s minions and blood-thirsty mythological creatures such as chorts, ghouls, and vodniks. Master your swordsmanship and tip the odds in your favor with dozens of melee and ranged weapons—from torches and hatchets to javelins and crossbows. Test your skills and reflexes in challenging boss battles against powerful, intimidating foes.

REMADE. REFINED. RETOLD.
Experience the definitive version of Castle of Heart, boasting a legendary number of improvements. Immerse yourself in a medieval world made more beautiful thanks to new animations, updated character models, improved lighting, remixed music, and more detailed environments. Enjoy massively enhanced gameplay with rebalanced combat and platforming, a vastly improved player interface, and more responsive controls. Thanks to much smoother gameplay, everything now comes down to your skills and tactics!

AN OLD SLAVIC LEGEND
Discover the untold legend of Svaran and Mira, who dared to defy the will of the Sorcerer and found themselves caught in the battle of good and evil. In Castle of Heart: Retold, every line of dialogue has been rewritten and every cutscene remade. Challenge yourself to collect all the Crystals of Mokosh and unlock fully reimagined endings to the story!

70010000098201.name: Find It! Brain Training Challenge
70010000098201.intro:
Spot the Difference!
A quick and easy brain game where just one thing is out of place.
70010000098201.description:
This is a game where you have to find just one hidden mistake in a photo — before the timer runs out.

How to play is super simple：
・First, look closely at the top photo — this is your reference
・Then, check the bottom photo to spot what’s different
・Move the cursor over the spot and press “OK”!

With easy controls and quick rounds, it’s perfect for brain training or a quick break anytime.

Stuck? Tap the hint button — it’ll show you the general area where the difference is hiding!

70010000098206.name: 4x4 TRUCK OFFROAD CAR DRIVER
70010000098206.intro: Where roads end, your journey begins.
70010000098206.description:
Conquer terrain. Collect parts. Build your beast.

Get behind the wheel of powerful offroad trucks and set out on a mission to recover lost car parts scattered across swamps, hills, and rugged trails. Each location brings its own challenges—from muddy bogs to steep mountain paths—and only the most skilled drivers will make it through.

Explore unique offroad maps, each with its own obstacles and secrets. Gather parts to unlock and build a variety of tough vehicles designed for extreme conditions. With every part you find, you get closer to assembling the ultimate 4x4 machine.

Core Features:

- Diverse Truck Collection: Drive and unlock a wide range of offroad vehicles.
- Unique Locations: Swamps, hills, and wild terrain with realistic physics.
- Part Scavenging: Search and collect car parts to upgrade or unlock new vehicles.
- Exploration & Survival: Navigate unforgiving landscapes and test your offroad skills.

Only the bold conquer the wild. Build your ride, master the terrain, and prove you're the king of offroad.

70010000098211.name: Jump Up 3D: Mini Basketball
70010000098211.intro: Jump higher, aim sharper, and score like a pro!
70010000098211.description:
Jump Up 3D: Mini Basketball challenges you to jump, aim, and score in spectacular style! Take control on the trampoline and enjoy a game full of energy, color, and fun. With simple and engaging gameplay, every shot becomes a new challenge. Improve your personal score or compete with friends to prove you’re the king of flying hoops.

Key Features:
 • Intuitive gameplay – simple controls, perfect for all players
 • Dynamic trampolines – jump higher, shoot farther
 • Leaderboards & scores – climb to the top and earn bragging rights
 • Unlimited playtime – play anytime, anywhere, stress-free

Get ready for epic jumps and unforgettable shots – it’s showtime in Jump Up 3D: Mini Basketball!

70010000098217.name: Street Vendor Simulator
70010000098217.intro: Buy, sell, and earn big on the city streets by selling water.
70010000098217.description: Step into the shoes of a street water vendor at a busy traffic light: buy bottles of water, set prices based on the flow of cars, and sell to drivers waiting for the light to change. Manage your inventory, observe traffic patterns, and maximize your earnings at every stop. Use your profits to buy everything you’ve always dreamed of, all while learning to analyze demand and make strategic decisions in the fast-paced chaos of city traffic.

70010000098223.name: Pet Show
70010000098223.intro: Draw a line to enclose the area and uncover the image underneath. Watch out for enemies who can catch you or cut your line!
70010000098223.description:
Take control of a brave little animal and uncover the adorable world hidden beneath the surface! 

As you move, you draw a line behind you—close the shape to reveal a piece of the cute picture underneath. From fluffy kittens to curious piglets, each level holds a surprise waiting to be uncovered.

Be careful! Flying foes and sneaky bugs are ready to interrupt your progress. If they hit your line before you close it, you’ll lose a life! Outsmart them with clever tricks like screen-edge teleporting and speed boosts to stay in the game!

Play solo or team up with a friend in co-op mode to uncover the hidden image together!

Features:
• Unique Levels - Complete 48 stages with 3 difficulty options each!
• Co-op Fun – Join forces with friends or family in local multiplayer!
• Tricky Enemies – Watch out for baddies that try to cut your line!
• Custom Looks – Choose your favorite from 12 playful animal avatars!
• Cute Pictures – Reveal a new animal picture in every level—can you find them all?

Draw, dodge, and discover!

70010000098225.name: EmyLiveShow: How To Write a Bestseller
70010000098225.intro: Become the co-author of an amazing book! All you have to do is choose which of the four lovely heroines will inspire you!
70010000098225.description:
EmyLiveShow: How To Write A Bestseller – is a visual novel using multiple routes and QTE mechanics.

- 4 stories with different aesthetics. One day you're at a fancy vampire party, the next day you're in space. It can also be just a step from modern extreme sports to medieval magic. Everything depends on which story you want to tell this time. 

- Romantic mood. How To Write A Bestseller takes the time to focus on the emotional moments. You'll find dates for every taste, from going to the movies to skydiving! 

- Captivating illustrations. The pleasant art style helps immerse you in the story. All the sprites and CGs unlocked during the game can be viewed in the gallery.

- Customizable protagonist. Choose your character's gender and skin color for the most enjoyable experience. The illustrations of the main character will also adapt to your choice! 

- Original voices of EmyLiveShow vtubers. Partial voiceovers from Emy, Nia, Uma, and Six's voice actors will highlight emotional moments and add volume to the game's characters!

70010000098230.name: There's no Dragons
70010000098230.intro: Dragons are an absolute myth! Nobody has ever seen any!
70010000098230.description:
There's No Dragons is a hidden object game with a selection of 9 locations and random dragons to find for each of them. 

 9 Different Levels 
 3 Difficulty Settings 
 customizable background colors
 replayable with 20 dragons out of 60 selected for each play 
 special hidden dragons 
 hint system 
 zoom

70010000098236.name: Blaster Force 3000
70010000098236.intro: A nostalgic first-person shooter full of action
70010000098236.description:
Dive into retro FPS action where every level brings a new challenge! 

Battle relentless aliens in dark cellars, ancient castle halls, and the vastness of space. 

You’ll need to adapt to the environment and enemies on the fly. Explore hidden areas, rack up as many points as possible, and put your reflexes and aiming skills to the test!

Experience the nostalgic feel of classic shooters, exciting levels, and increasingly tough waves of enemies.


Features:
* Nostalgic first-person shooter
* Adrenaline-pumping pixel art
* Heavy metal and hard rock music soundtrack
* 5 killer weapons and 36 brutal levels

70010000098242.name: Dream Trials
70010000098242.intro: Somehow, someway you achieved a complete balance between life and death. The universe has taken notice and now you must undergo the Dream Trials.
70010000098242.description:
Story:
Somehow, someway you achieved a complete balance between life and death. The universe has taken notice and now you must undergo the Dream Trials.  The Dream Trials will test your cognitive ability by presenting experiences that manipulate your past memories into challenges you must complete. Failure will result with your existence eradicated.   

Gameplay:
You are transformed back to being a child and trapped within the confines of your old Kindergarten. Armed with only a disposable camera you must navigate the environment searching for miniature toys. But you must be careful, If you photograph the giant ones they will not take to that kindly! Survival is dictated by your fingertips. 

B. I. N. G. O,
B. I. N. G. O,
B. I. N. G. O,
AND BINGO WAS HIS NAME-OH.

70010000098246.name: Cozy Cove
70010000098246.intro: Uncover the Secrets of a Lost Pirate Paradise
70010000098246.description:
Welcome to Cozy Cove, a peaceful pirate island full of mystery, lush jungle trails, and forgotten hideaways. Step into the boots of a curious wanderer and set off on a serene yet intriguing journey across a sun-soaked cove brimming with history and hidden wonders.

This isn't your typical pirate adventure—there are no sword fights or sea battles. Instead, you'll explore at your own pace, soaking in the atmosphere, discovering landmarks, and piecing together the island’s secrets one step at a time.

Features:
Explore a Handcrafted Pirate Island
Relaxing, Non-Linear Gameplay
Environmental Storytelling
Immersive Atmosphere

 Ready to Set Foot on the Island?

70010000098265.name: Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000098265.intro: Save Your Empire. Defend Your Legacy.
70010000098265.description:
A timeless adventure returns, Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven is now on the Nintendo Switch™ 2, featuring high definition graphics, smoother frame rates, and decreased loading times.

This is a game that can be enjoyed by existing fans of the SaGa series and by complete newcomers as well.

■Story
The Seven Heroes were once hailed as saviours, but the ancients feared their power and banished them to another dimension. Thousands of years have passed, and the heroes have become legend. It was foretold that the Seven would return to save the world once more, but what fate awaits its people now that they finally have?

■Imperial Succession
The player takes on the role of the emperors of Avalon and strives to expand their realm while battling against the Seven Heroes. To stand against the fearsome might of the Seven, successive emperors must wage an epic struggle over thousands of years, passing power and abilities down the Imperial line to future generations of rulers.

■Characters
Over 30 different classes, featuring a wide variety of races and professions.
Each class offers unique characteristics, as well as favoured weapons, abilities, and tactics. Characters of any class can become an emperor!

■Free-form scenario
A unique story structure that offers players a high degree of freedom and gives them many choices to make, from how they expand the realm to what order to defeat the Seven Heroes in.
The decisions you make and the actions you take will have a significant impact on the outcome of the story.

■Graphics
Characters have been converted into amazing 3D models, based on the original Romancing SaGa 2 sprites and the beautiful illustrations by Ms. Kobayashi Tomomi.
All the towns and dungeons are also rendered in full 3D, with re-worked terrain layouts.

■Battles
The turn-based timeline battle system has been further enhanced, while keeping all the classic gameplay mechanics from the original, such as the “Glimmer” system that lets you learn new abilities in the heat of battle and “Formations” that enhance your fighters with a variety of different effects.

■Difficulty settings
You can select from three difficulty levels: Casual, Normal and Hard (Classic).
Casual offers a more story focussed experience, while Normal is recommended for veteran RPG players and Hard is for players looking for the brutal but satisfying challenge of the original version

■Music and voices
Mr. Ito Kenji, the composer for the original Romancing SaGa 2, returns to create new arrangements of the game’s music tracks. You can even choose between the original versions and the new arrangements from the options screen.
All event scenes now feature full voice acting recorded specially for this version.

70010000098275.name: Special Strike
70010000098275.intro: Nintendo Switch™ exclusive! Survive on photorealistic gray sand dunes with tanks. Team up with allies to dominate vast battles and claim victory!
70010000098275.description:
A powerful tank unit amps up the excitement of battle! On the battlefield, allied tanks work alongside you to break through enemy lines, defend strategic locations, and deliver overwhelming firepower. Experience dynamic combat where infantry and tanks fight as one and enjoy a battlefield experience like never before. In a vast desert under the blazing sun, team up with your allies and tanks to enjoy strategic gameplay against a backdrop of hyper-realistic battlefields. Photorealistic graphics and 3D sound bring the tension of sandstorm-swept battlefields to life with stunning realism.

・Enjoy free-form tactics and exploration in a massive open field!
・Work alongside your tank unit! Allied tanks support your operations, bringing unmatched power and strategy to the battlefield.
・Ultra-high-definition graphics and 3D sound authentically recreate every detail, from grains of sand to gunshots, explosions, and the roar of tanks.
・Make use of the unique abilities and special weapons of four elite characters, as well as tank firepower, to complete missions with your team.
・With intuitive aiming and controls, both beginners and veterans can experience heart-pounding battles.
・Cooperate with AI teammates and tank units for tactical teamwork.
・Join the world’s top special forces and aim to complete the “Special Strike” mission.
・Experience overwhelming realism! 3D sound and a physics engine deliver dynamic, immersive gameplay.
・Breathtaking graphics capture the atmosphere of the battlefield with realistic lighting and shadows.
・Enjoy diverse tactics with four character classes: Assault, Engineer, Support, and Recon.
・Face off against enemies and test your skills in Deathmatch mode.
・Dominate the battlefield and secure key positions in Domination mode.
・Engage in intense psychological warfare with bomb planting and defusing in Search & Destroy mode.
・Experience the ultimate in realistic shooting with precision aiming and an advanced tilt system.
・Feel the thrill of victory with teamwork-driven, adrenaline-pumping wins!

Stunning, photorealistic graphics bring battlefields swept by sandstorms to life. Work together with tanks and four elite characters, each with their own special weapons, to strategically pursue victory. Experience unparalleled immersion with diverse 3D effects and state-of-the-art graphics technology. Don't miss the ultimate single-player FPS, "Special Strike," where you'll fight alongside teammates on the most realistic battlefield ever!

Synopsis
Endless gray sand dunes stretch beneath a blazing sun in a vast desert where an ancient silence reigns. Deep underground rests a rare mineral capable of sparking the next energy revolution. Its crystal glows as if alive, and even a single fragment could power an entire city.

This energy source, long hidden, is discovered by Chronos Industry’s secret research team. Disguised as an ordinary IT company, Chronos seeks to monopolize the resource, amass wealth, and control the global economy. To achieve this goal, Chronos forms the elite "Shadow Legion," made up of former special forces, and begins mining operations.

Chronos's suspicious actions draw the attention of international intelligence agencies. Governments send their best special forces into the desert to uncover Chronos’s true goal and stop their plans. These operatives slip into sandstorms like shadows, aiming to sabotage Chronos’s mining operations and secure the energy source as a shared global asset. The Shadow Legion counters with advanced equipment, tactics, and a web of traps and surveillance. The battle for Chronos’s hidden energy begins, and, as a special forces member, you embark on the "Special Strike" mission that will decide the fate of the world.

70010000098307.name: HYAKKI YAKO Survivors
70010000098307.intro: style of a picture scroll Rogue Survival.
70010000098307.description:
Follow the wind and destroy all the cursed torii gates.
Deploy your fellows and form a formation to fight off the onslaught of enemies.
Control many fierce warriors and challenge the "Hyakki Yako".

70010000098329.name: Death Kid
70010000098329.description:
Death Kid is an arcade-inspired arena brawler with meta progression where skill and strategy are crucial. Break through eight seals to reach the bottom of a treacherous well with the help of three souls trapped between life and death. Protect them at all costs, take out hordes of relentless enemies and fight your way to put the wheel of life and death back in motion.

Step into the role of the cryptic Death Kid – a protagonist cursed with immortality. Engage in close-quarters combat, master a variety of powerful abilities and grow stronger with each run. Stay agile, think fast and devise the right strategy to annihilate your enemies.

Let the rage fill you up and unleash the fury upon otherworldly creatures that want to see you fail.

70010000098334.name: FISHING SIMULATOR 2025
70010000098334.intro: Your Journey to the Perfect Catch Begins Here.
70010000098334.description:
Fishing Simulator 2025 is your peaceful escape into the world of authentic angling. Set in a beautifully detailed, lifelike environment, the game focuses on skillful, relaxing gameplay—not arcade speed.
Roam freely along the water’s edge as you fish from sunrise to dusk, each session offering new challenges and rewards. Choose your bait carefully, cast your line, and wait for that satisfying tug—mastery and patience are key.
From nimble trout to aggressive pike, dozens of fish species await, each with unique behavior. Customize your approach with a vast selection of rods, reels, hooks, and bait that all influence your strategy and success.

Features:
• One immersive, hyper-realistic fishing location
• A wide range of fish with distinct behaviors
• Extensive gear options for every fishing style

Whether you're a first-time caster or a veteran angler, Fishing Simulator 2025 delivers a calm, rewarding fishing experience like no other.

70010000098339.name: Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4
70010000098339.intro: Get hyped for the legendary franchise to return with Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4.
70010000098339.description:
Get hyped for the legendary franchise to return with Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4. Everything you loved is back, but revamped with more skaters, new parks, gnarlier tricks, eardrum shattering music, plus a whole lot more.

- Reunite the crew with cross-platform online Multiplayer* for up to 8 skaters in new and returning game modes.
- Drop in to new parks or tear it up across the timeless parks from both Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 & Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 4, authentically remade in jaw dropping HD resolution with streamlined goals and the epic 2-minute format.
- Hit ‘em with some drip in the expanded Create-A-Skater and Create-A-Park modes, including the ability to create custom goals to share with friends for the first time ever.
- Shred harder than ever with more challenging goals and an enhanced New Game+ mode.
- Whether you’re a total casual or a grungy pro, the same smooth handling and simple-to-learn controls from Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 1 + 2 will have you shredding like a Pro.
- The Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of the game will feature higher resolution, improved frame rates and HDR support.

Alert the neighborhood watch and grab your skate buddies because the shred’s not dead. It’s back and better than ever.

70010000098344.name: Old School Rally
70010000098344.intro: A nostalgic racing game that combines the charm of classic retro style visuals with the thrill of international rally competitions.
70010000098344.description:
Old School Rally features fast-paced, arcade-style gameplay, with emphasis on driving skill and high-speed maneuvers.

RETRO STYLE VISUALS

Carefully crafted retro style visuals, reminiscent of the late '90s rally games full of nostalgia and charm, making it a must-play for everyone.

RACE THE WORLD

With a variety of rally tracks from around the globe, race across different surfaces such as dirt, tarmac and snow and challenge your driving skills.

RALLY CARS

Choose from a diverse lineup of rally cars inspired by the legends of the past, each with unique characteristics and features.

USER FEEDBACK

The game will evolve over time so your feedback is very important. Feel free to submit your comments in the game's community page.

Developed by a solo developer with passion about the classic 3D rally games, trying to fill a gap that is missing from modern rally games.

70010000098349.name: Dunjungle
70010000098349.description:
Overview

Dunjungle is an action-packed roguelite about a monkey hero, adventuring into a jungle under the menace of a corruptive power that is transforming its peaceful creatures and destroying everything on its way.

You'll explore continuously changing dungeons, temples, crypts, and other mysterious places, where you'll find all sort of weird enemies and an arsenal of weapons, spells, and relics, granting you a different experience every time you play.

Features
Lots of weapons, spells and relics with unique effects.
Equipment can also be merged with several elements, to create new and powerful versions.
Burn monsters with fire, use ice to slow them down, shock them with thunder, or just get them off you using wind to blow them away!

Classes to customize your runs
You will unlock several classes with a variety of strengths and weaknesses. You can choose the class before starting the run and play in your preferred style!

Dungeons are procedurally generated, made from big collection of hand-crafted rooms. 
These rooms are filled with all sort of weird creatures, valuable treasures, dangerous traps, and of course, challenging bosses! 

Fast Game Loop
There are no checkpoints in Dunjungle. You die, you start over. Die again, try again!
But don't worry too much. Several things will remain for your next run.  
Maybe you unlocked a new weapon? Maybe a new spell? Maybe you saved a trapped character, who will now lend you a hand.  
Along your way, you may find characters who are lost, trapped, or maybe just chilling in there. Help them out, and you might become friends! 

More importantly, each time you die, you'll know more about Dunjungle's world, so don't despair, and use what you've learned to get further on your next adventure.

70010000098354.name: Bubblegum Galaxy
70010000098354.description:
From the creators of Teacup, Bubblegum Galaxy is a cozy narrative building game about rebuilding the galaxy by designing planets. Relax as you create colorful planets or spend hours trying to get a perfect score!

BECOME A PLANET ARCHITECT
Your small but trusty computer will allow you to design planets by placing tiles. To create efficient planets, the software will suggest missions such as connecting similarly colored tiles or a specific number of trees. Each planet has its own quirks and special rules you will have to master to do your best work yet!

BEFRIEND YOUR CO-WORKERS
In-between planet designing sessions, you'll be free to roam the office, inspect your surroundings and chat with your co-workers. Encounter hundreds of unique story events as you get to know this quirky cast of characters.

DISCOVER WHO DELETED THE GALAXY
The day you started your internship the inter-dimensional universe server crashed for "unknown reasons", deleting the entirety of the Bubblegum galaxy. If you prove your skill as a planet architect you just might find out the truth behind why the galaxy was deleted...

70010000098368.name: Plants vs. Zombies™: Replanted
70010000098368.description:
The classic Plants vs. Zombies returns in glorious HD! DANG! After years in Crazy Dave’s attic, the original battle between Plants and Zombies is back - bigger, brighter, and crazier than ever before! Experience the game that started it all, now remastered with upscaled HD graphics and packed with new secrets to uncover.

Revisit the epic backyard standoffs you remember, but this time with new levels, fresh twists, and 15 years of never-before-seen franchise history at your fingertips. Relive the glory days of pea shooters, sunflowers, and brain-hungry chaos! Rejoin the ultimate garden defense and experience the backyard brawl that started a phenomenon - now back for a new era!

KEY FEATURES:

- Experience the original Plants vs. Zombies game fully remastered in stunning HD graphics
- Fend off waves of Zombies in the original lane-based defense mode, now with added bonus levels and new content!
- Team up with a friend in local co-op mode to defend the backyard together, now with 100% more BUTTER!
- Battle head-to-head in local PvP mode by taking control of the Zombies
- Unlock visual options through the Tree of Wisdom, updated with convenient on/off toggles
- Relive classic minigames like Wall-Nut Bowling - now with HD polish and even more chaotic fun!
- Test your skills in Cloudy Day Mode, a brand new game feature where sunlight is limited and planting becomes a tactical challenge!
- Survive in our brand new hardcore mode, Rest In Peace, a permadeath option for Adventure where one mistake could send you right back to the beginning
- Explore a new Art and Concept Library featuring never-before-seen pre-production sketches and game history

70010000098373.name: Candle Making: Enhance Your Space with Fragrance
70010000098373.description:
You don’t need to be a craft genius to make candles that wow.
You just need the right guide. This one.
It’s the ultimate step-by-step manual to take you from “never touched wax” to “check out what I made!”
You’ll learn exactly what to buy, how to blend irresistible scents, and how to create candles that light up any room—and maybe even your bank account.
This isn’t a boring tutorial. It’s the beginning of something beautiful (and it smells amazing).
Let’s make your space unforgettable.

70010000098379.name: Cat Tricks
70010000098379.description:
A fun and practical guide to help you bond with your cat through 20 easy and entertaining tricks.
Whether your cat is shy, playful or just curious, this book will show you step-by-step how to teach commands, cool behaviors and even fun games that will make your feline friend shine.
Perfect for cat lovers who want to turn training into quality time!

70010000098382.name: Cocktail & Bartender Guide
70010000098382.description:
"Your cocktail journey starts here
This digital guide teaches you how to craft 20 delicious cocktails, from timeless classics to modern twists. Easy-to-follow instructions, tools you need, and pro tips make it perfect for beginners who want to mix, shake, and impress.
Ready to pour your first drink?"

70010000098385.name: Daily Relaxation & Mindfulness
70010000098385.description:
Bring a moment of calm to your everyday life.
This guidebook teaches you how to integrate relaxation and mindfulness into your daily routine. With 20 simple steps—including breathing techniques, easy meditations, and mental focus exercises—you’ll discover how to reconnect with your body and mind.
Even on the busiest days, give yourself the gift of peace.

70010000098388.name: Become the Smartest in the Room! Brain Power Boost Plan
70010000098388.description:
Have you ever wanted to become smarter?
This guide shows you how to unlock the full potential of your brain and enhance your thinking, decision-making, and focus.
Step by step, you’ll learn powerful habits and practical strategies to sharpen your mind and build the intelligence that sets you apart.
Start your journey toward becoming a highly intelligent person—today.

70010000098391.name: Home Pilates: Transform Your Body from Home
70010000098391.description:
Want to feel stronger, more balanced, and confident—without leaving home?
This guide introduces you to Pilates you can easily practice at home, from beginner moves to more advanced flows.
Improve your posture, tone your body, and bring calm into your daily routine—all at your own pace.
Start your transformation today with Home Pilates.

70010000098394.name: The World of Japanese Tea Through the Way of Tea
70010000098394.description:
"In every quiet cup, a deep tradition lives on.
This guide explores the world of Japanese tea—from its varieties and flavors to the rich cultural practice of the tea ceremony.
You’ll learn the basics of sadō (the Way of Tea), the art of preparation, and the spirit of hospitality that lies within each movement.
Perfect for beginners, this book invites you to discover the beauty of Japanese tea culture in your everyday life."

70010000098397.name: Better Listening, Better Connections
70010000098397.description:
Think you're not a good listener? You're not alone.
Many people find listening uncomfortable or difficult—but with just a few simple techniques, it can become enjoyable, meaningful, and even empowering.
This guide will show you how to build better relationships by changing the way you listen, and how to create a space where both you and others feel heard and understood.
Listening is the key to moving forward—gently and confidently.

70010000098402.name: Ollie-Oop
70010000098402.intro: A game about a skateboarding dog named Ollie, who goes on the adventure of his dreams! Play with your pup friends and wreak havoc in all kinds of fantastical environments.
70010000098402.description:
Ollie-Oop is a 3D Platformer featuring a skateboarding dog named Ollie.

Explore many different levels and hang out with your dog friends and do dog stuff, including collecting bones and sticks, chasing each other, scaring birds, and more!

Ollie is your friendly neighborhood skateboarding dog with big dreams! Romp through many different increasingly zany levels. Where might you end up? The park? The Skate Park? SPACE?

Includes:
- Intricate 3D environments, custom tailored for fun exploration, rad jumps, and maximum shenanigans
- Lots of adorable dogs to talk to. Don't worry, they don't bite! (some are kinda grumpy though)
- Original music by Robert Frost III (Joggernauts, Pinbrawl)
- Collectibles!!
- 100+ customizables
- SECRETS

70010000098404.name: Bumblebee - Spooky Nights
70010000098404.intro: A story-driven 3D exploration game where you guide a little bee in search of a new home.
70010000098404.description:
On your quest to find a beautiful new home you will discovers distant places, friendly and calm animals, and amazing and dangerously habitats.

You are a tiny bee in a giant environment and move continuously forward. You are free to fly wherever you want and explore the level to your heart’s desire. 
After you have played around a little and enjoyed the sensation of flying you start to discover the nearby areas and hidden secrets and find a couple of different items. 

For once there are energy potions which fill your energy meter to continuously fly faster until you run out of energy. 
Secondly there are golden flowers hidden everywhere in the levels that you can collect as a reward for exploring even the more hidden parts of the levels – collecting all of them unlocks an extra achievement in each level.

Last but not least there are the bright shining knowledge shards that show you the way into the next area. Whenever you collect one the next one will spawn ahead of you and show you the right way.

Once you have found a certain amount of knowledge shards you will be able to enter the next area and the story continues. Each area is another part of a world that a bee could experience and a little step further to find a new home.  Therefore, each level has a different color theme, general setting, mood and story. 

At the beginning of each area is a short break in which in which a part of poem is read to you. The poem talks about the bee and it’s journey to find a new home and explains a little bit about the level that lies ahead.

70010000098407.name: Winter Burrow
70010000098407.intro: Winter Burrow is a cozy woodland survival game about a mouse returning home to restore their childhood burrow.
70010000098407.description:
Explore, gather resources, craft tools, knit warm sweaters, bake pies and meet the locals!

In Winter Burrow, you play a mouse who returns from the big city to find their childhood home in ruins. To make matters worse, your Aunt (who was supposed to be looking after it) has gone missing. Restore your broken-down childhood burrow to its former glory so you can relax in front of the fireplace. 

Brave the elements and journey out into the frozen wilderness to collect vital resources for both yourself and your new home. Beware of the insect wildlife and remember that nobody survives on their own; find new friends, expand your survival handbook and solve the mystery of what happened to your Aunt. 

Winter Burrow is a survival game you play at your own pace. Customize your character, decorate your burrow and choose a path that fits your play style. This story is yours to tell.

70010000098417.name: Golden Tee Arcade Classics
70010000098417.intro: Tee up the old-school fun with six classic Golden Tee arcade games, plus more!
70010000098417.description:
Tee up the old-school fun! Golden Tee Arcade Classics brings eight legendary arcade classics home – no quarters required.

HIT THE LINKS

Enjoy Golden Tee 3D Golf, Golden Tee 97, Golden Tee 98, Golden Tee 99, Golden Tee 2K, and Golden Tee Classic exactly as you remember them from your days at the arcade (or, more likely, your local watering hole).

WAIT… THERE ARE OTHER GAMES BESIDES GOLF?

Need a break? Play the two bonus games – Shuffleshot and World Class Bowling!.

IMPROVED CONTROLS

An on-screen virtual trackball lets you set up the perfect shot, adjusting your swing strength and shot direction just as you would on an arcade cabinet. You can also choose to play using a gamepad, or touchscreen.

PRACTICE MAKES PERFECT

Need to brush up on your skills? The all-new practice mode gives you unlimited drives, chips, and putts. And the new Mulligan feature means that one bad shot doesn't have to be the end of a great round.

70010000098422.name: UFO 50
70010000098422.intro: UFO 50 is a collection of 50 games.
70010000098422.description: Explore a collection of 50 single and multiplayer games that span a variety of genres, from platformers and shoot 'em ups to puzzle games, roguelites, and RPGs! As you journey through the library, make connections and learn more about UFO Soft, the fictional 80s company behind the games, as well as their expansive shared universe that includes sequels and recurring characters.

70010000098427.name: CRAYON DINO
70010000098427.intro:
A creative coloring experience for everyone from children to adults.
Show off your completed masterpieces to your family.
70010000098427.description:
Crayon Dino: Dinosaur Coloring
Crayon Dino is a newly released version that features only dinosaurs from the popular app 'Crayon Crayon'.

Selected as a recommended app on, it delivers the same fun experience that made 'Crayon Crayon' hugely popular in Russia and the Middle East. Enjoy playing!

Introducing ""Crayon Dino,"" a creative coloring experience for everyone from children to adults! Breathe life into various dinosaur friends using the Nintendo Switch™ touchscreen and the intuitive controls of the Joy-Con™. From prehistoric jungles to volcanic zones, a variety of unique dinosaur templates await you, including Tyrannosaurus, Triceratops, Pteranodon, and more.

Special Features:

A natural coloring experience that feels like using real crayons
Realistic textures where colors blend and layer
Educational elements to learn fun facts about dinosaurs

Immerse yourself quietly in creation alone, or color together with family and friends to challenge for the gold medal.

Start a colorful journey back to prehistoric times and unleash your creativity with "Crayon Dino."

70010000098444.name: Supermarket Simulator 2025
70010000098444.intro: Manage your supermarket! Purchase products, stock shelves, serve customers, hire staff, and expand your store. Can you turn your small shop into a retail empire?
70010000098444.description:
Step into the bustling world of retail management with Supermarket Simulator 2025!!!

The ultimate supermarket simulator! in this immersive game, you are the mastermind behind every aspect of your very own supermarket. From stocking shelves to managing customer transactions, every decision is in your hands.

Gameplay Overview

Product Management: Purchase a variety of products and have them delivered to your store. Unbox these items and strategically place them on the shelves to maximize sales. Efficient shelf organization and timely restocking are key to keeping your customers satisfied and coming back for more.

Customer Interaction: Once your shelves are stocked, open your shop to attract a steady stream of customers eager to buy your goods. Ensure a smooth shopping experience by efficiently handling customer transactions, managing queues, and collecting payments accurately.

Daily Operations: Your supermarket operates from morning until 6 PM. At the end of the day, close your market, review your sales, and prepare for the next day by replenishing stock and planning new strategies. Keep an eye on market trends to stock up on high-demand items and outpace your competitors.

Expansion and Customization: Use your profits to buy new product licenses, expand your shop's space, and add decorative elements to enhance the shopping environment. Personalize your supermarket's look to create a welcoming atmosphere that attracts more customers and boosts sales.

Staff Management: As your supermarket grows, hire a cashier to assist with customer transactions, allowing you to focus on higher-level management tasks and further expansion. Train your staff to improve their efficiency and customer service skills, ensuring your supermarket runs smoothly even during peak hours.

Take on the Challenge

Balance inventory, customer satisfaction, and store aesthetics to create the ultimate shopping experience. Can you turn your small shop into a bustling retail empire? Test your management skills and strategic planning in siMarket and watch your business flourish!

70010000098449.name: Hole Digging Master
70010000098449.intro: No time to explain. Just start digging!
70010000098449.description:
The rules are as simple as possible - dig the hole. Dig deep. Deeper than you can even imagine.

Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty, because there's real treasure waiting for you in the ground. Start digging and miracles will happen. You have no idea what could be under your lawn.

Everything you find can be sold and used to upgrade your tools or buy new equipment to help you dig faster and find more.

8 SECRET MINES
Uncover hidden tunnels and exclusive areas throughout the game.

20 TYPES OF ORE
Discover a wide variety of ores, each offering unique value and potential for upgrades.

3 TYPES OF DIG TOOLS
Upgrade your tool from Shovel to Drill and up to a Vacuum Cleaner.

CONSUMABLES
Utilize Dynamite for explosive power and a Lamp for enhanced visibility in dark areas.

4 BIOMES
Explore diverse environments that impact your digging experience and resource availability.

69 UPGRADES
Enhance all your equipment with a nice and robust upgrade system, including special upgrades for rare minerals.

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team.

Can you reach the true depths?

70010000098454.name: The Aquarium does not dance
70010000098454.intro:
Now on the Nintendo Switch™!
The new and improved hit game from 
the horror-hating horror game creator!
70010000098454.description:
Navigate your way through an aquarium overrun by gruesome creatures known as creepies and unravel its hidden mysteries. With each riddle you solve, you’ll find yourself one step closer to uncovering the chilling truth of Bianca Aquarium. Your choices affect the outcome of the game, so choose wisely.

This revamped version of The Aquarium does not dance includes the following updates:

- All five heroines are now fully voiced!
- A brand-new scenario titled "The Aquarium will always hunger"
- An updated and brand-new UI design plus event CG
- Full English localization!

CAST
Suze: Tomoyo Kurosawa
Retro: Yumiri Hanamori
Lulu: Satomi Sato
Kitty: Rie Kugimiya
Chrissy: Tomoe Tamiyasu

SUPPORTED LANGUAGES
- Japanese
- English
- Korean
- Chinese (Traditional)
- Chinese (Simplified)
*Note: Character voicing is only available in Japanese.

SYNOPSIS
Having been gifted a premium pass to Bianca Aquarium, Suze and her best friend, Lulu, receive a guided tour led by the aquarium director’s charming wife, Chrissy. However, when Lulu suddenly goes missing, Suze goes looking for her and inexplicably finds herself in a strange and terrifying world that looks nothing like the aquarium she was at just moments ago. Can Suze find her best friend and escape from the nightmarish aquarium before it’s too late? Beware, for a traitor lurks in their midst...

70010000098469.name: PBA Pro Bowling 2026
70010000098469.intro: PBA Pro Bowling is back, and PBA Pro Bowling 2026 is the best bowling game ever. This isn’t just an update - it’s a totally new game, reimagined and rebuilt from the ground up.
70010000098469.description:
PBA Pro Bowling 2026 is a skill driven bowling simulation with authentic ball motion, real oil patterns, and evolving lane conditions. From your first local leagues to competing with the pros, every throw comes down to strategy and execution.

Real World Ball and Oil Physics That Reward Skill
•	Realistic ball motion shaped by oil patterns, lane friction, and simulation grade physics
•	Oil pattern breakdown and carrydown change ball reaction over time
•	Adjust line, speed, rev rate, and ball choice as conditions evolve

From Local Leagues to the PBA Tour
•	Progress through a full single player career, starting in local leagues and advancing to the PBA Tour
•	Build your ball arsenal from 270+ officially licensed bowling balls
•	Customize your bowler with a full character creator and 120+ apparel items to collect

Improve Your Skills Across Multiple Modes
•	Traditional Tenpin bowling alongside Candlepin and Duckpin bowling
•	Skill focused challenges like Strike Derbies, Spare Pickup Challenges, No Tap, and Oil Pattern Roulette
•	Designed for practice, competition, and mastery

Bowl Against Licensed PBA Pros in Authentic Venues
•	Compete against over 30 licensed PBA professionals
•	Bowl across 13 unique venues inspired by real and imaginative locations
•	Broadcast style presentation and commentary from the TV broadcast team of Rob Stone and Hall of Famer Randy Pedersen enhances the professional atmosphere

Designed for both newcomers and experienced bowlers, PBA Pro Bowling 2026 balances approachable gameplay with rewarding depth and long term progression. Do you have what it takes to bowl with the greats?

70010000098504.name: Hotel Simulator
70010000098504.description:
Welcome to Hotel Simulator – Build and Manage Your Dream Hotel!

Step into the exciting world of hotel management with Hotel Simulator! Start with a small hotel and transform it into a luxurious five-star resort. Take control of every detail—design and furnish rooms, manage daily operations, and ensure your guests have an unforgettable stay. This immersive simulation game combines creativity and strategy, making it the perfect choice for fans of management games.

Furnish and Decorate Rooms
Create cozy and stylish rooms to meet the needs of your guests. Choose from a wide range of furniture, decor, and layouts to give each room a unique look. Whether your hotel’s theme is modern, classic, or tropical, your creativity will shine through. Satisfied guests will leave glowing reviews, boosting your reputation and attracting more visitors.

Run a Mini Shop for Guests
Enhance your hotel services with an on-site mini shop where guests can purchase snacks, toiletries, and souvenirs. Stock popular items, set competitive prices, and keep your shop well-organized. Balancing inventory and pricing adds a fun strategic element that will keep you engaged as you grow your business.

Keep Everything Spotless
Cleanliness is the foundation of a great hotel experience. Regularly tidy up rooms, restock supplies, and maintain common areas to keep your guests happy. A clean and welcoming environment boosts your hotel’s ratings and ensures repeat bookings.

Expand and Upgrade Your Hotel
Reinvest your earnings to unlock exciting upgrades and expand your hotel. Add more rooms, improve existing facilities, and introduce new amenities like a spa or gym. Each upgrade enhances the guest experience and increases your revenue.

Customize Your Hotel’s Style
Make your hotel stand out with personalized decor and design. Add stylish furniture, vibrant colors, and unique signage to create an atmosphere that leaves a lasting impression. From the lobby to the exterior, every detail is yours to customize.

70010000098507.name: The Lab - Escape Room
70010000098507.intro: Walk through a futuristic complex while solving puzzles and discover how you got there. What are these mysterious creatures? Why everything looks abandoned?
70010000098507.description:
Could you escape from The Lab?

The Lab is an Escape Room where you have to make your way through intelligence and lateral thinking. You will solve a huge amount of puzzles while you discover an interesting story and move around a facility full of sci-fi equipment. Search for clues, find objects and secrets and keep a cool head, because only then you will be able to get out alive from The Lab.

Features
- Dozens of puzzles that will challenge your mind
- Large complex with different themed rooms
- A story that will keep you hooked
- From escape room lovers to escape room lovers

70010000098517.name: The King is Watching
70010000098517.intro: Build, defend, and rule your kingdom by your gaze. A hit on PC, now on Nintendo Switch™
70010000098517.description:
The King's watchful gaze.

Peasants toil, miners dig, and knights train... but only when I look at them! Wherever my eyes fall, progress follows. But the moment I glance elsewhere?
Laziness! Chaos! I must choose wisely between the fields, the mines, or the barracks, expanding my gaze so no one slacks off!

Command the kingdom's lifeblood
Water, wheat, stone, coal, silver, every resource fuels my empire! Farms feed my people, mines fund my ambitions, and workshops forge mighty defenses. Every decision shapes my reign, and only a well-managed kingdom will survive the storm.

A roguelite kingdom
Each land presents new trials, from cursed cemeteries to infernal depths. Enemies are led by unexpected Generals, demanding unique tactics to defeat. As a true roguelite, my efforts grant permanent upgrades for my next reign. With my royal council of cavalry masters, arcane sages, and cunning strategists, victory is inevitable!

Ever-Expanding Kingdom!
Regularly updated with new free content, the console version comes packed from day one with the Volcano update, adding a fiery new biome, new bosses, and new ways to expand your realm.

70010000098526.name: Drill Core
70010000098526.intro: Corporate greed meets planet-mining in this roguelite strategy.
70010000098526.description:
Welcome to Drill Core, where corporate greed meets strategic planet-mining! By day, lead an elite crew of miners, carriers, and guards as they carve a path through hostile alien worlds. Build advanced facilities, upgrade deadly turrets, and prepare for relentless nightly assaults from alien lifeforms. Will you chase maximum efficiency at any cost, or play it safe and fight to survive?
Drill Core is a strategy roguelike that will push your decision-making to the limit. Every run is a fresh challenge during which you will:
- Manage resources across procedurally generated maps, where no two expeditions ever play the same.
- Explore three distinct biomes, each packed with unique enemies, blocks, and bosses: Caves, Frozen Worlds, and Jungle.
- Command one of three unique platforms:
- Humans — adaptable, well-equipped, and armed with reliable machine guns.
- Dwarves — hardy demolition specialists who blast through rock and enemies alike with brutal efficiency.
- Swarnids — led by a ruthless Queen who spawns endless loyal workers to devour everything in their path.
