In search of a sign of life from your roommate, you'll have to learn to find your bearings in this enclosed space with its strange and lonely atmosphere. Advance room by room, decipher the clues left behind, and embark on the adventure that has transformed your apartment into a surreal maze.

But be careful: as you progress through this maze, you will be led to question the very nature of reality. Will you be able to connect the clues and piece together the puzzle left behind by Fael?


An immersive and nostalgic escape game

To find Fael, your wits will be your only ally. Each apartment is a puzzle in its own right, with its own logic behind a multitude of puzzles. But don't expect to find a comfort zone: the messages left by your roommate have been designed to confuse you...

However, this maze has a common thread that connects each apartment to the others: your actions in one place can have repercussions elsewhere, sometimes with unexpected consequences. All kinds of machines, created by Fael's genius, will be at your disposal to help you progress, such as the Game Leaf, a strange game console that is essential to your progress.

Activate mysterious mechanisms and impact your environment to solve puzzles and continue your exploration. From a simple living room to a room overgrown with vegetation, a cinema, a laboratory, and many other rooms, everything is connected, everything is one.


GAME FEATURES:
A kaleidoscope of apartments and atmospheres. 
Explore a variety of environments from the imagination of comic book author Benoît “Beloup” Leloup. From one apartment to another, discover a world full of cultural references and colors, reflecting Fael's dreamy personality.

The Game Leaf: a tribute to the 90s. 
Use your Game Leaf, a mysterious console straight out of the 90s. Solve puzzles in the form of nostalgic mini-games and unlock new areas to explore. Each apartment is a piece of the puzzle that will lead you to the truth about Fael's disappearance.

A cabinet of curiosities. 
The apartments are filled with oddities that will challenge your imagination and logic. Manipulate strange machines, let your natural curiosity run wild, experiment with solutions, and observe the fruits of your efforts.

70010000098952.name: OpsCam - Body Cam Shooter
70010000098952.intro: Equip weapons and dominate every fight.
70010000098952.description:
Step into the world of OpsCam - Body Cam Shooter – Total realism in combat action!
Get ready for an unimaginable experience with an innovative bodycam simulator that brings stunning realism and highly engaging gameplay. Every detail of the fight is recreated with precision, and the game mechanics put you right in the heart of the action, giving you the feeling of truly being on the ground. Plan your strategy, equip yourself with the latest technologies, and showcase your combat skills in this groundbreaking game.

Key Features:
• Multiplayer Support: Enjoy intense multiplayer battles with friends and players from around the world. Team up or face off in thrilling combat scenarios.
• Tactical Gear & Explosives: Equip yourself with flashbangs, grenades, stun and high-tech devices like night vision goggles and spotter scopes.
• Realistic Weapon Handling: Experience free-flowing gun mechanics where hand and weapon movements are not locked to the camera, giving you an ultra-authentic feel.
• Dynamic Bodycam Effects: Watch your bodycam crack under fire, and replace it in real-time to stay in the action.
• Customize Your Look: Stand out with the skins for both your weapons and characters, adding a personal touch to your loadout.

This is not just a shooter – it’s the future of warfare. Gear up. Get tactical. Dominate the battlefield.

70010000098958.name: Cozy Fields
70010000098958.description:
Welcome to Cozy Fields — a serene, exploration-based walking sim set in a charming open world filled with secrets, surprises, and sthe largest map we have done! There are no combat systems, no time limits, and no stress. Just you, your curiosity, and a beautiful world waiting to be discovered.

Explore at Your Own Pace!
Roam freely across vast, lush fields where towering houses dot the horizon, goblin mines whisper old legends, and cool rivers wind through forested paths. Each area has its own personality, music, and atmosphere. From floating islands in the sky to mysterious ruins hidden beneath the hills, every corner hides something unique.

Discover secret groves and forgotten cabins!

Cross sparkling rivers and reach tiny islands!

Stumble upon enormous houses and ancient goblin-built mines!

70010000098961.name: Saborus
70010000098961.intro: Saborus is a thrilling horror adventure in which you guide a brave chicken through a deadly slaughterhouse where everything wants to kill you!
70010000098961.description:
Saborus is a thrilling horror adventure in which you guide a brave chicken through a deadly slaughterhouse where everything wants to kill you! You, as the chicken, will solve puzzles and face the relentless pursuit of the Saborus slaughterhouse workers.

Make your way through the sinister surroundings of a creepy slaughterhouse, full of suspense and surprises! Can you survive?

Saborus promises an immersive and spine-chilling horror game experience, inviting you to confront the depths within the confines of a sinister slaughterhouse. Will you be able to navigate the haunting horrors and get out of the slaughterhouse for good?

70010000098968.name: Masters Pool
70010000098968.description:
Enter the sleek, modern hall of Masters Pool - the ultimate 8-ball billiards experience for console players. Whether you're a casual player or a seasoned cue master, this game will bring precision, style and competitiveness to your fingertips.

Game modes :

- Single player - Take on three distinct levels of AI difficulty, from beginner to professional. Perfect your strokes, hone your strategy and move up the ranks.
- Tournament mode - Take on a series of AI opponents in high-level competition. Each match becomes increasingly difficult as you strive to become the undisputed Masters champion.
- Local multiplayer - Share the fun with a friend in classic 1 vs 1 matches on the same console. No lag, no waiting, just pure, unadulterated action.

Features:

- Modern, atmospheric billiards site with clean graphics and immersive sound design
- Realistic physics and intuitive controls for an authentic 8-ball experience
- Sharp AI that adapts to your playing style, offering a new challenge with every game.

Whether you're lining up your first shot or chasing the last black ball to win, Masters Pool is your table, your rules. Are you ready to break?

70010000098980.name: Wizordum
70010000098980.intro: The Ancient Seal of Terrabruma has shattered, unleashing the forces of Chaos once more.
70010000098980.description:
As one of the last Mages of Wizordum sanctuary, you must embark on a quest to find the source of this corruption and push the Chaos back before they consume the kingdom in a speedrun-friendly fantasy FPS tearing a page from the spellbooks of ‘90s fantasy FPS classics like Hexen and Heretic.

KEY FEATURES

- A vast arsenal of magic weapons & items

- Search for secret places filled with treasures

- Solve puzzles and avoid traps

- Embark on a single-player campaign to find the source of Chaos, traveling from the Town of Grimbrook through swamps over the snowy mountains and beyond.

- Collect bonus items and beat the hardest difficulty levels to climb to the top of the leaderboards

- Beat challenges at each level

- Compete online for the best time

70010000099007.name: EGGCONSOLE Mado Monogatari 1-2-3 MSX2
70010000099007.intro: A comical 3D RPG featuring a unique worldview and system. Join Arle Nadja, a girl aspiring to become a sorceress, as she adventures through three scenarios!
70010000099007.description:
This RPG was released in Japan by COMPILE in 1990, the story follows a young girl aspiring to become a sorceress. It features three episodes depicting her graduation exam from Mado Kindergarten and her entrance into a magic school.

The game is a 3D dungeon exploration RPG, with random encounter battles using a command-based system. You’ll use spells like Fire and Ice to attack enemies, and can even hear voice lines like “You did it!” or “DiaCute!”, adding excitement to the gameplay.

Featuring comical characters such as Puyo Puyo, Draco Centauros, and Zoh Daimaoh, and unique phrase-based stats like “Super energetic!”, it's the classic origin of the Mado Monogatari series.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000099010.name: Anime Warriors Clash
70010000099010.intro: From shadows to victory – become the ultimate warrior!
70010000099010.description:
A professional fighter, whose name is lost in the shadows, has been kidnapped by a mercenary and imprisoned in a dark basement. But nothing will break her will! Escaping captivity, she sets out on a relentless path toward the mastermind behind her assassination – a powerful boss hiding deep within his lair. To reach him, she must battle an entire army of elite fighters, just as skilled as she is.

Immerse yourself in dynamic combat. Wield a vast arsenal of melee weapons – from swords and katanas to nunchaku and other deadly tools. This is a game where your combat experience, agility, and weapon mastery will be the key to victory.

70010000099015.name: Arcade Archives ACE DRIVER
70010000099015.intro: The high-speed battle is about to begin!
70010000099015.description:
"ACE DRIVER" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1994.
Experience the essence of racing with breathtaking race tracks and authentic handling.
Choose a class based on your player level and charge through the game! Who is the true ACE DRIVER!?

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000099028.name: Arcade Archives AQUA JET
70010000099028.intro: Aqua jet racing: Feel the rhythm of the waves!
70010000099028.description:
"AQUA JET" is a marine sports game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1996.
This game stood out at arcades at the time thanks to its large jet ski-style cabinet. 
Savor the thrill of racing across shimmering waves under the blazing sun in a stunning, resort-like setting brought to life by the "System Super 22" hardware!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000099033.name: Operation Night Strikers
70010000099033.description:
Four milestones of the 80s arcade movement in one action-packed compilation! Relieve all the high-speed arcade thrills and explosive spills!

Title lineup:
Operation Wolf
Operation Thunderbolt
Night Striker
Space Gun

Operation Wolf
Using only a machine gun and rocket-propelled grenades, you alone must infiltrate enemy territory, secure the hostages, then get them safely to the extraction point! Your mission code name is Operation Wolf. Do not fail!

Operation Thunderbolt
A hostage rescue mission in Africa and only one man can help! Roy Adams, hero of Operation Wolf is back, and this time his former green beret team-mate, Hardy Jones joins the fight. Your mission code is Operation Thunderbolt. Impossible odds are nothing to these men!

Night Striker
Become a member of the United Nations Special Action Force, a.k.a. Night Striker, and destroy the enemy terrorist organization with in your high-speed combat hovercraft: Intergray!

Space Gun
2039 AD: an age of space exploration. On their way to investigate an unexplained incident on a space station, a team of space marines receive a distress call from a cargo ship, but what could prepare them for the horrors onboard?! Use your multi-purpose rifle to slay the monsters and rescue the hostages!

Four faithful ports, complete with various gadgets, replay functions, and other useful features to enhance the originals!

Features
• Apply filters to simulate actual arcade monitors
• Gadgets display various useful information to either side of the play area
• Includes multiple arcade versions of each title
• Save/load anywhere during play
• Upload your own play data, or download and view top ranking players' data

70010000099036.name: Anime Girls - Fantasy Desire
70010000099036.description:
Unleash the power of charm and combat in a breathtaking anime RPG where desire fuels destiny.

Step into a magical world on the brink of collapse in Anime Girls - Fantasy Desire, an epic action RPG where beauty meets bravery. As the realm’s guardian, you’ll assemble a team of extraordinary anime heroines to battle colossal golems, explore stunning landscapes, and uncover the mysteries behind the ancient magic of Desire.

With each fight, forge deeper bonds with your team, unlocking powerful synergies and heartfelt stories. Customize your heroines with dazzling outfits, legendary weapons, and unique abilities to suit your playstyle. Whether you’re striking down towering foes in cinematic combat or unraveling the secrets of a vibrant, anime-inspired world, every decision you make shapes the fate of the realm—and the hearts of those who fight by your side.

Key Features:

Dynamic Combat: Engage in real-time, combo-driven battles against towering golems and their minions. Switch between heroines to unleash devastating team attacks and magical “Desire Arts.”
Character Customization: Design your dream team with unlockable outfits, weapons, and skill trees. Tailor their powers to match your strategy and style.
Epic Boss Battles: Take on massive golems with unique attack patterns, weak points, and environmental hazards. Use strategy and teamwork to bring these titanic foes to their knees.
Deep Relationship System: Build emotional connections with your heroines through dialogue, gifting, and special missions. Unlock exclusive cutscenes, abilities, and storylines as bonds grow stronger.
Exploration and Discovery: Traverse lush forests, shimmering deserts, and ancient ruins filled with hidden treasures, puzzles, and lore. Each region offers stunning visuals and unique challenges.
Branching Narrative: Your choices matter. Shape the story, forge alliances, and decide the fate of your heroines and the magical kingdom.

Are you ready to lead your team of heroines, conquer towering golems, and uncover the truth behind the magic of Desire? The fate of the realm is in your hands.

70010000099051.name: Silver Bullet
70010000099051.intro: Silver Bullet is a gothic arcade shooter: blast your way through creepy environments and macabre mini-games as Van Helsing.
70010000099051.description:
Reggie the vampire is kidnapping puppies and he must be stopped! As Van Helsing, embark on a journey around the world to rescue the puppies: from haunted mansions and museums to macabre cemeteries, each level is filled with unique challenges to overcome and secrets to uncover.

Man's Best Friend: Van Helsing's trusty bloodhound, Silver, can be summoned during levels to attack enemies and even drive vehicles! Any enemies hit by Silver will drop delicious bonus items that will boost your score, so make the most of your canine friend's help.

Unlock and Upgrade: Collect gold coins hidden throughout the levels to purchase power-ups that will aid you on your mission. Collect enough coins to unlock the additional puzzle game mode, Blocks of Terror! Collected bonus items, completed challenges, and discovered secret items count toward your progress and allow you to unlock additional weapons, from a zombie-smashing shotgun to the devastating rocket launcher.

Top Dog: Both Arcade Mode and Terror Blocks feature online leaderboards, allowing you to track your progress and compete for the best score. And for those who prefer to show off their skills live, the game's low memory footprint ensures smooth streaming.

Control and Conquer: With gameplay based on Cabal shooters like Wild Guns Reloaded, Silver Bullet offers extensive control and customization options. Play with modern aim with twin sticks or with a classic single stick using a gamepad, go retro with an arcade stick, or focus on precision with a keyboard and mouse.

Old-Fashioned Awesome: With personality-filled pixel art, customizable retro screen filters, and chilling synth-pop beats from the legendary YM2612 chip, Silver Bullet looks and sounds like a lost 16-bit classic.

70010000099062.name: PRITTO PRISONER
70010000099062.intro: Escape or capture in this cute and chaotic 4v2 action party game! Play as mischievous animal prisoners using peepee, poopie, and special skills to escape.
70010000099062.description:
About This Game
Unleash the mayhem in Pritto Prisoner, the cute and chaotic 4v2 asymmetrical party game where animal inmates lay poopie traps, spray peepee, and use special skills to outwit robot guards. 

Inside a notorious island prison, the world’s cutest criminals, including a gangster rabbit, an influencer cat, and even a penguin chef, are locked in maximum security under 24/7 robot surveillance. 

Will you scramble to freedom as a poopie-dropping prisoner, or hunt them down as a custom-built robot warden? Choose your side and jump into unpredictable escapes, chaotic chases, and laugh-out-loud clashes where no two matches ever play out the same!

ANIMAL TEAM

・Complete funny and unique objectives around the prison to open the escape gates.
・Eat bread and drink water to fuel your potty powers: poopie and peepee.
・Poopie: dropping your load in toilets powers you up and brings you one step closer to freedom！
・Peepee: unleash your bladder on robots and cameras to short-circuit them, giving your team a chance to escape.
・Whether you’re slicing through robots as a lion sword master or dropping explosive decoy art as an elephant fraudster, every animal packs unique skills and passives that unlock outrageous new playstyles!
・Captured animals go to the Nap Room, where counting sheep can bring them back. Get tucked in too many times and it’s Deep Sleep for good!

ROBOT TEAM

・Build your robot from mix-and-match parts, combining upper and lower bodies with gadgets and boosts that let you capture in your own way.
・Uppers: shape your offense with weapons like the Stun Gun for shocking captures or the Lasso for long-range takedowns.
・Lowers: change the way you move with options like legs, wheels, or tank treads to chase down escapees.
・Equip gadgets and boosts like the Magic Hand to trap animals, the Wormhole to slip through walls, the Motion Sensor to track their moves, and the Shield to block enemy peepee.
・Collect poopie left behind during the match to unlock stronger upgrades and supercharge your robot.
・Coordinate with your robot partner to turn every escape attempt into a chaotic back-and-forth of counters, traps, and mayhem.

KEY FEATURES

・Asymmetrical 4v2 multiplayer with animals on the run and robots on the hunt
・Quick 10-minute matches perfect for party play
・A hilarious yet strategic peepee-and-poopie gameplay loop
・Kanahei’s adorable art style and TeddyLoid’s energetic soundtrack
・Cross-platform play
・Single-player campaign to uncover the secrets of Prison Island
・Complete Pritto Challenges to earn Pritto Coins and unlock decorations
・Customize your animals and robots with a variety of fun decorations
・Host private matches with your friends using custom settings

70010000099079.name: EmyLiveShow: King of Desires
70010000099079.intro: Take on the girls, beat them at their own game, and score the chance to have your innermost wishes granted.
70010000099079.description:
EmyLiveShow: King of Desires is a puzzle game centered around the legendary King of Desires tournament. Take on Emy, Nia, Uma, and Six — popular LudeTubers — defeat them, and earn the right to make your most innermost wishes come true.

Club Fun – Challenge the girls in a vibrant club where they'll greet you in both their signature and casual looks!

Palace Round – Enter a classy royal reception and persuade the girls to slip out of their elegant ball gowns just for you!

Dungeon Finale – Seal your victory as the girls embrace their most exotic looks!

Victory awaits!

70010000099095.name: A Game About Digging A Hole™
70010000099095.description:
Dig deep, sell what you find, update your equiptment to continue your journey further and further. With every spadeful you dig, you get closer to the truth. There's no rush, no rules - just you and the adventure underground.

Costs as much as a coffee, but is fun for longer!

70010000099100.name: The Cabin Factory
70010000099100.intro: Your job is simple: inspect the cabins and decide on whether they’re haunted or not. If you do find any anomalies, get out…immediately.
70010000099100.description:
Welcome to The Cabin Factory!
You're now a newly hired Cabin Inspector - congratulations!
Your job is simple - inspect the cabins and determine whether or not they are haunted. 

Stressed on your first day? 
No worries - here’s a quick introduction:
Step 1: Inspect the entire cabin. Don’t miss a detail and trust your instincts.
Step 2: If the cabin is safe, press ‘CLEAR’ and move on.
But if it’s haunted - quickly turn back and press ‘DANGER’.

FEATURES:
▪ Atmospheric horror awaits - step into the anomaly-hunting experience, inspired by liminal spaces and psychological horror walking simulators, 
▪ Compact story - tired of long games? Experience the full narrative in one evening,
▪ Thirteen supported languages - choose to fully immerse yourself in the game. 

Additional languages:
- Catalan (CAT/CATALÀ),
- Turkish (TUR/TÜRKÇE).

70010000099107.name: Myst House
70010000099107.description: After your car breaks down near your late grandfather’s abandoned house, you step inside searching for help. But your search quickly turns into a nightmare — the house is no longer empty, and a violent lunatic is on the loose. Your only chance of survival is to explore every shadowy corner, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden items as you fight to stay alive… before it’s too late.

70010000099139.name: Tiny Racing
70010000099139.intro: Race tiny vehicles on tiny tracks!
70010000099139.description:
Gear up for a thrilling ride in Tiny Racing! Dive into an exciting world of pixel art where you control a variety of vehicles across contrasting and challenging tracks. With intuitive arcade controls, master each turn, drift, and boost to outpace your rivals.

From time trials to full tournaments, every race is a test of skill and strategy. Win virtual cash to purchase new vehicles and become the undisputed champion! Get ready for high-speed excitement and a nostalgic gaming experience in Tiny Racing!

- Get behind the wheel of trucks, drift cars and  formula cars!
- Quick race, time trials and 12-race tournaments await you
- Local multiplayer competition with 2-4 players
- 18 unique tracks over 3 settings both day and night
- Earn virtual currency winning races to purchase cool new vehicles
- Easy to pick-up controls means you dive right in!
- Out-drive computer opponents over 4 difficulty modes

70010000099148.name: Dark Scrolls
70010000099148.intro: Dark Scrolls is a fantasy-themed action platformer that fuses shmup-style chaos with roguelite progression and is packed with charm, challenge, and secrets.
70010000099148.description:
Set forth on your quest to [INSERT GOAL HERE] with one of the worthy yet quirky heroes in solo or cooperative play, local and online. Hack, slash, and dodge through hordes of enemies and deadly traps in procedurally generated runs of hand-crafted rooms and levels using each hero's unique attacks and abilities to your advantage.

Sharp reflexes and split-second decisions are crucial to survival as the intensity ratchets up as each run delivers new surprises, branching paths, and unrelenting bosses to conquer. Gobble up coins to spend at Bruce & Goose's Shoppe as you take a breath from the action to gain new perks, devastating attacks and summoned allies. Stack them right, and you'll unleash screen-filling destruction of arcade legend.

Keep an eye out for secrets among the chaos as this land holds many mysteries with new paths and locations, new heroes to rescue and add to your roster, and more…

Double Trouble
Charge forth alone or bring a co-op buddy to tackle dungeons together, combine powerful attacks and revive one another if you fall in battle.

Choose Your Own Adventure
Each run offers hand-crafted screens, unique bosses, and evolving routes shaped by player choices and quests.

Rogue's Gallery
Unlock nine distinctive heroes with unique skills, side objectives, and customizable trinkets that alter gameplay.

Arcade Alchemy
Chain perks and elemental powers through combat performance for explosive, high-reward playstyles.

70010000099165.name: Samurai Academy: Paws of Fury
70010000099165.intro: Protect your village from evil ninja cats and save the day, samurai-style
70010000099165.description:
The village of Kakamucho is under attack by the Shogun’s cat armies! Join Hank, a dog samurai in a world of cats, and his friends as they reveal a sinister plot and save the day, samurai-style. Slash, dash, and laugh through this wacky third-person action adventure.

The Story
Just when they thought the fighting was over, Hank and Jimbo are thrown back into combat, this time pitting against the mighty Shogun himself. That’s right—the leader of the Paws of Fury world has had a mysterious change of heart. He aims to crush the blazing duo and the villages under their protection with his cat armies. It’s up to you to master samurai skills, protect Kakamucho, rescue Hank’s friends, and discover who is behind this evil plot.

Become a True Samurai
• Prove your skills and hone your lightning reflexes in progressively difficult samurai trials 
• Learn mystical skills to quickly traverse the scenery or ambush unsuspecting hordes
• Wield an arsenal of gadgets and weapons to put an end to ever-rising enemy waves

Protect the Humble Settlements
• Defend the temples of Kakamucho, Dookiehill, and Pippishore against raids of powerful enemies, including Ninja ambushers, Viking warriors, and Jetpack elites
• Use creative traps to cause massive damage and bring the fight to the shogun’s minions
• Team up with beloved Paws of Fury characters and use their unique powers to assist in grandiose battles

Explore a Wacky, Colorful World
• Adventure to villages beyond Kakamucho in a vibrant, animated world packed with surprises
• Unlock new areas, items, and playable characters to expand the realm as you progress
• Discover and complete sidequests from quirky locals and friends both old and new, gaining fame, awards, and treasure

Uncover the Evil Plot
• Play through a lengthy story campaign, following the events of Paws of Fury: The Legend of Hank
• Follow the tale through animated cutscenes, featuring both old pals and new characters
• Rescue your friends, unite the villages, and rally your allies to put an end to an evil conspiracy that threatens the empire and become a legendary hero!

Samurai Shenanigans for All
• Fun and accessible gameplay for players of all ages 
• Challenging Samurai Trials to compete with your friends

70010000099167.name: Craft Your Way
70010000099167.intro:
Build. Solve. Triumph.
The ultimate sandbox puzzle adventure
Where every creation opens new paths
70010000099167.description:
Craft Your Way is a revolutionary 3D puzzle adventure where you manipulate blocks to create paths, bypass obstacles, and outsmart intricate level designs. Unlike anything you've played before:

True 3D Gameplay: Rotate the camera, stack blocks, and exploit depth to solve puzzles.
80+ Handcrafted Levels: From beginner-friendly to mind-bending challenges.
Level Editor: Design and share your own 3D puzzles.
Leaderboards: Climb global leaderboards for speedrun glory.


"A fresh take on spatial reasoning .

70010000099172.name: Bad Cat
70010000099172.intro: Wreak havoc as the naughtiest cat in town!
70010000099172.description:
Welcome to Cat Simulator 3D and cat life with granny! Cat and granny live in one house — it’s the ultimate revenge of cat vs granny. Take on the role of the most mischievous kitty in this animal simulator game. 

In this hilarious prankster game, you’re up to no good as you cause chaos in granny's house. You are a little bad kitten from hell. Your mission is to prank grandmother and her dog in every way possible. 

Create chaos, steal sausages, break the TV, play VR games, and mess around like the boss cat you are. Collect your fishes in the aquarium, catch them! You can even turn on the TV to distract grandmother. The goal is to make granny and her dog angry. Will you be able to pull off all your pranks and cause enough prankster chaos to win the day in this 3D pet simulator game?

While you start as an average pet, you will earn the title of a naughty kitty — then the fun begins. In this game, you will play as a cute prankster determined to keep grandmother on her toes.

Your goal is to create as much havoc as possible throughout the house by completing various tasks. There’s always another prank to pull: hide in cupboards, jump on tables, send vases crashing to the floor, or push the dog around. Misbehavior is always rewarded here — no punishments, just pure cat anarchy.

You can even unlock different cat styles and colors to match your mischievous mood. Whether you’re a fluffy orange tabby or a sleek Siamese, you’re always the star.

Features of the game:

• Explore a granny house with destructible items
• Unique quests like collecting fishes, pushing the dog, and many mischievous activities
• Control a naughty cat that causes chaos in the house
• Fun challenges and tasks
• Explore a big city
• Spin the wheel and get bonuses to make the game even better!
• 3D cat simulator from a first-person controller
• Dynamic reactions from granny and her dog

70010000099185.name: Yarn Guardians
70010000099185.intro: Yarn Guardians is a 2D Action-Adventure in which you play as cute flying cats that fight enemies with powerful Yarn Balls!
70010000099185.description:
Rudy's peaceful life changes abruptly when his home is attacked. He decides to protect his grandmother, unaware that he is following in the footsteps of the legendary Yarn Guardians. His grandmother told him stories of the heroes who once restored and maintained peace with the powerful Yarn Balls.
On his journey, the adventurous cat encounters power-hungry villains and shady characters. But on his mission to recover all of the lost Yarn Balls, he also finds allies and makes friends. Can they join forces to save their world from a new war?

Help Rudy and his friends to restore the balance in a fragmented world.
Immerse yourself in the world of winged cats and use the Yarn Balls to defeat cunning enemies.
Yarn Guardians is a 2D action-adventure that combines elements of shoot'em up games with the open level structure of Metroidvania games in a cute twin-stick shooter.
Play the main campaign with a friend or challenge up to three friends in Versus mode.

Features
- Twin-stick shooter-like combat controls
- Fight with five unique Yarn Balls to defeat adorable foes
- Meet numerous hand-animated protagonists, enemies and NPCs
- Fly and fight your way through colorful hand-drawn environments
- Enjoy a light-hearted, humorous story

70010000099193.name: Seer's Gambit
70010000099193.intro: A strategic, hero-drafting roguelite RPG that rewards smart positioning, player agency, and synergies-building within your party.
70010000099193.description:
Dive into a strategic, tactical semi-auto battler with player agency through positioning and powerful activated ultimate abilities. Each hero comes with their own unique ability. Use it at the right time to turn the tide of battle, waste it, and risk a soul-crushing defeat.

Seer's Gambit is all about discovering the best group composition. Every character in the game can shine when combined with the right co-heroes. Unlock powerful combos by picking the perfect adventurers for your party and demolish your enemies with the power of teamwork.

Explore and upgrade the captivating, yet dangerous world of Emalon to unlock new heroes or powerful group buffs for meta progression. Earn resources during your adventures and predict the right upgrades to invest in for your heroes to stand a chance against the lurking evil.
As you explore, progress and shape your future, the world will change around you.

70010000099199.name: Digging a Hole: Gold Fever
70010000099199.intro: Gold, secrets, and a lot of dirt.
70010000099199.description:
In Digging a Hole: Gold Fever, you’re not just digging—you’re chasing fortune, mystery, and whatever else is buried beneath your backyard. Armed with simple tools and a growing curiosity, it’s time to see how far you’ll go for a little gold… and a lot of answers.

Mine through layers of dirt, rock, and forgotten history. Sell what you find, upgrade your gear, and keep going deeper. There’s no rush—just you, the shovel, and the occasional surprise glint of treasure.

It’s a quiet obsession. A little strange. Weirdly satisfying.
Just be careful—once the fever hits, there’s no going back to the surface.

70010000099204.name: THIEF LIFE SIMULATOR
70010000099204.description:
Thief Life Simulator throws you into the shadows of a living, breathing city where every decision matters. In a world full of surveillance, locked doors, and tight schedules, your job is simple: get in, steal everything you can, and get out—without leaving a trace. Choose your targets, plan carefully, use cutting-edge tech or classic methods to break in, steal, and vanish without a trace.

Key Features:
	•	Start small with pickpocketing and garages, rise to luxury mansion break-ins.
	•	Every action has consequences. Be fast or get caught.
	•	Advanced mechanics for lockpicking, stealth, and infiltration.
	•	From rookie to professional thief, every step is a risky choice.
	•	Get in, clean out, disappear. No trace left behind.

Will you climb the criminal ladder or end up behind bars?
Thief Life Simulator – Where every hit matters.

70010000099207.name: TUNGROOMS: Escape Sahur
70010000099207.intro: Can you escape Sahur? Beware the Tung Tung Tung...
70010000099207.description:
TUNGROOMS: Escape Sahur is a terrifying survival horror game where you find yourself trapped in an eerie backrooms environment. Unlike any ordinary maze, this nightmare is haunted by Tung Tung Tung Sahur, a terrifying creature that once lived within these walls but now seeks to escape its own twisted existence. As you journey through this horrifying labyrinth, you’ll uncover notes and eerie drawings scattered throughout the levels—hints left by the creature itself.

Your only hope for survival is to locate and collect five hidden images in each level. These images contain clues that might be the key to escaping this nightmare. But be warned: the deeper you venture into the backrooms, the more sinister the surroundings become. Realistic walking mechanics create an immersive, tense atmosphere, where every step is filled with dread. The ever-present terror of Tung Tung Tung Sahur will leave you on edge as you race to solve the mystery and escape.

Prepare yourself for terrifying jump scares, psychological horrors, and an atmosphere that will chill you to the core. Can you escape the madness before it consumes you?

70010000099211.name: Stuff it!
70010000099211.intro: Shove it, stack it, sort it out!
70010000099211.description:
Welcome to a world of crazy organizers, explosive makeup bags, and kitchen shelves barely holding on under the weight of random stuff! In Stuff It, there’s only one rule: everything has to fit... somewhere!


Your mission? To cram the most absurd combinations of items into tight spaces. Hairbrushes, colorful hairdryers, giant ladles, way too many trinkets, and even rubber duckies - all waiting for your master-level packing skills!


Each level throws you into a totally new challenge - bizarre shapes, unruly objects, and sometimes things you don’t even remember ever owning. But don’t panic! Use your superpower of organizing, make some room, and... stuff it!


What’s in store?
- Over 105 levels of chaos to conquer!
- Special modes (Easy, Medium, Hard) unlocked after completing the game - for those who  love a challenge!
- Dozens of colorful items - from kitchen gear to beauty products!
- Relaxing, feel-good music to help you focus… even when everything is falling out!
- Wacky graphics that bring every drawer item to life!
- Funny effects and reactions - because every win deserves a fanfare (and confetti)!

Don’t ask where that giant spoon came from - just find a spot for it!

Stuff It - because who said cleaning can't be epic?

70010000099217.name: No Man's Sky – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000099217.intro: No Man's Sky is a game about exploration and survival in an infinite procedurally generated universe.
70010000099217.description:
Inspired by the adventure and imagination that we love from classic science-fiction, No Man's Sky presents you with a galaxy to explore, filled with unique planets and lifeforms, and constant danger and action.

In No Man's Sky, every star is the light of a distant sun, each orbited by planets filled with life, and you can go to any of them you choose. Fly smoothly from deep space to planetary surfaces, with no loading screens, and no limits. In this infinite procedurally generated universe, you'll discover places and creatures that no other players have seen before - and perhaps never will again.

Embark on an epic voyage
At the centre of the galaxy lies a irresistible pulse which draws you on a journey towards it to learn the true nature of the cosmos. But, facing hostile creatures and fierce pirates, you'll know that death comes at a cost, and survival will be down to the choices you make over how you upgrade your ship, your weapon and suit.

Find your own destiny
Your voyage through No Man's Sky is up to you. Will you be a fighter, preying on the weak and taking their riches, or taking out pirates for their bounties? Power is yours if you upgrade your ship for speed and weaponry.

Or a trader? Find rich resources on forgotten worlds and exploit them for the highest prices. Invest in more cargo space and you'll reap huge rewards.

Or perhaps an explorer? Go beyond the known frontier and discover places and things that no one has ever seen before. Upgrade your engines to jump ever farther, and strengthen your suit for survival in toxic environments that would kill the unwary.

Share your journey
The galaxy is a living, breathing place. Trade convoys travel between stars, factions vie for territory, pirates hunt the unwary, and the police are ever watching. Every other player lives in the same galaxy, and you can choose to share your discoveries with them on a map that spans known space. Perhaps you will see the results of their actions as well as your own...

70010000099220.name: Be A Bee
70010000099220.intro: Get a taste of the sweet life of a hardworking bee!
70010000099220.description:
Honey isn't just a sweet treat. It's a whole new world, and you can be a part of the delicious bee life. Build your hive. Explore new green zones to gather resources and produce honey. It's not as easy as it seems at first. But it's worth a try!

Add more hives for the families of bees to keep them comfortable. Expand your apiary and discover new crops to make different kinds of honey.

This is the right way to grow your bee empire and reach new worlds! Enjoy the rewards of your hard work. 

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Explore the world in search of the sweetest honey!

70010000099225.name: Giant Flee
70010000099225.intro: Run for your life and never look back!
70010000099225.description:
There's no time to think! You just have to run for your life! Every second counts, so it's important to keep up the pace.

Stay alert and wait for the right moment to change direction, so you can keep running. Use your brain to avoid the danger. The Giant never stops - it's his goal to smash you! You can win — use different tactics for the various situations you encounter. Take the risk and escape the Giant! 

Seize your opportunity and try to survive this deadly race — run fast and avoid the obstacles. Show no fear! Running is the only option. 

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Run, boy, run! You can do it!

70010000099230.name: Star Jumper: Cosmic Adventure
70010000099230.intro: Blast into the stars, bounce through galaxies!
70010000099230.description:
Get ready for an out-of-this-world journey!
In Star Jumper: Cosmic Adventure, you play as an energetic young astronaut leaping across planets, collecting glowing energy capsules, and unlocking cosmic secrets. Perfect for kids and families, this colorful and action-packed platformer offers easy-to-learn controls, vibrant space environments, and charming characters. Whether you're dodging aliens or racing across floating rocks, every level is a new celestial playground!

70010000099235.name: DUSK INDEX: GION
70010000099235.intro: A new visual novel game co-created by Cherrymochi of “Tokyo Dark”!
70010000099235.description:
【STORY】
Can the past rewrite the future?

The Meiji era, a turbulent age.
A series of murders shook Kyoto.
Mysterious patterns drawn in the victim's blood.
The case went unsolved, casting a long shadow over history.

A hundred years later in Kyoto, Detective Daiki Katsuki was investigating a brutal murder case.
The case bore a striking resemblance to the one that had shaken Meiji-era Kyoto.
The key to the investigation lay in the immersive AR experience ‘Echoes of Kyoto.’
The developer was the brilliant young engineer Quinn Rio.
The two entered the recreated Kyoto of 100 years ago to solve the case.

‘Echoes of Kyoto’
Through state-of-the-art AR contact lenses,
this augmented reality experience transports people into a breathtaking recreation of the Kyoto of 100 years ago.
The reconstructed city captivated many people with its nostalgia.
However, as the truth behind the incident draws near, ‘Echoes of Kyoto’ begins to transcend mere history.
The boundary between recreation and reality begins to blur, and a question emerges—

Is this the work of a copycat killer?
Or is the past truly invading the future?

A future held hostage by the past.
A past bound to the future.

When past and future intersect, the world begins to tremble.


【POINT】
◆ AR × Time-Travel Mystery
Experience a multi-layered story that shifts between the present and the Meiji era—faithfully recreated in AR Kyoto.

◆ Two Timelines, Two Detective Duos
Two eras. Two pairs of investigators. One truth that connects them across time.

◆ Beauty and Shadows of Kyoto
A unique visual and sound experience that blends traditional elegance with cutting-edge technology.


【CAST】
Daiki Katsuki（CV.Yohei Azakami）
Rio Quinn（CV.Yuuki Temma）
Masayoshi Nagahama（CV.Ryotaro Okiayu）
Saki（CV.Yoko Hikasa）
Hikari（CV.Hikaru Tono）
Dee（CV.Shuta Morishima）
Galaxy（CV.Yuzuki Watase）
Togawa（CV.Wataru Urata）
Suburi-Chan（CV.Haruna Fukushima）

70010000099240.name: Super Chipflake Ü: Quest for the Uncooked Schnitzel
70010000099240.intro: Explore, Merge, Collect, get that Schnitzel!
70010000099240.description:
Some rescue princesses, others save the whole world. But here, you save your rumbling stomach

So don’t wait until hunger takes over. Embark on a quirky journey full of adventures, unexpected encounters, platforming challenges, and a fun combination mechanic. Explore a world packed with mysteries, eccentric characters, and bizarre problems. Dig, swing, and sprint through a lovingly crafted world where surprises await you around every corner!

- Explore Schländ, a compact but densely filled land brimming with exciting discoveries and adventures
- Meet and help the locals, from clueless cats and helpless creatures to a potential lover: they’re all counting on you in their challenges!
- Merge and create! Creatively merge items to overcome obstacles and craft brand-new tools
- Use your tools! Dig up hidden treasures with your shovel, uncover secret spots with the grappling hook, or dash through Schländ at lightning speed with your running shoes.
- Create the PERFECT schnitzel! If you do everything just right, you’ll be rewarded with an irresistible schnitzel from Schnitzelville’s very own chef!

70010000099245.name: Tamashika
70010000099245.description:
TAMASHIKA is a fast-paced arcade-style corridor shooter focused on flow, precision, and survival.

Move through shifting environments, react quickly, and stay locked in. Each run is about control, timing, and keeping your mind in one place.

Patterns in the world create a sense of continuity, but everything is in motion. Focus is what keeps you alive.

Features:
TAMASHIKA is a fast-paced arcade-style corridor shooter with hand-drawn animations, precision sound effects, and upbeat background music.

You get:
One weapon: a semi-automatic pistol
One side-arm: a tanto blade

70010000099255.name: BAROQUE SHOOTING: REVERSED
70010000099255.intro:
The spin-off of the dark fantasy RPG “BAROQUE”,
BAROQUE SHOOTING, is now available on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000099255.description:
A shoot ’em up set in the world of the RPG “BAROQUE”
returns as “REVERSED”, now available on Nintendo Switch™.

The story takes place in the Neuro Tower,
a mysterious structure overrun by countless enemies.
You must fight through them using the items you acquire along the way
to reach the final boss that awaits in the deepest depths.

This release adds a variety of new features.
It offers plenty to enjoy for both newcomers
and those who played the original extensively.

■ Game Features
・Strategic Player Tuning
Items can alter your attack power, attack pattern, and speed.
Depending on the order in which you collect them and their attributes,
you can fine-tune your setup with great precision.

・Multiple Ways to Play
The game features both Standard Mode and Score Attack Mode,
along with five difficulty levels to match your preferred play style.

■ New Features
・Revamped Status Display
The status display has been completely redesigned.
You can also switch back to the original version if you prefer.

・Great Heat Gallery
A special gallery featuring wallpapers from past “Great Heat Memorial Days.”
Unlock conditions must be met to view them.

・Title Wallpaper Switch Feature
Allows you to set gallery images as the background of the title screen.

・Continue Feature
Lets you restart even after a game over.

・Additional BGM
Includes several background tracks from previous BAROQUE titles,
newly remastered for this release.

70010000099258.name: Bubble Wizard IV Saga
70010000099258.intro: The magic returns in Bubble Wizard IV Saga!
70010000099258.description:
Darkness stirs once more, and this time, it’s spreading beyond the enchanted woods. Join the young wizard and her mystical cats as they journey across floating isles, ancient ruins, and forgotten realms in a brand-new bubble-blasting quest!

Match, pop, and cast your way through 200 spellbinding levels packed with clever puzzles, elemental challenges, and powerful new boosters. Unlock hidden secrets, complete daily quests, and climb the global leaderboard to prove your magical mastery.

New magic. New enemies. More bubbles.
The realm needs you once more—are you ready to rise again?

Key Features:
★ All new 200 handcrafted levels*/***
★ Boosters & potions to aid your journey
★ Daily rewards and coin drops
★ Supports Joy-Con™, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller, and touch
★ Enchanting visuals, sound effects, professional background music.
★ Online leaderboards (optional)**

* First 35 levels are unlocked tutorial stages.
** Players can opt out of leaderboard.
*** WARNING! recommend to skill up with Bubble Wizard I/II/III Saga for beginners.

70010000099260.name: Formula Racing GP: Apex Overtaking
70010000099260.intro: You don’t chase victory — you overtake it.
70010000099260.description:
Formula Racing GP: Apex Overtaking throws you into the white-knuckle world of high-stakes motorsport, where every corner is a test of courage and every straight is a sprint toward glory.

Feel the intensity as engines scream around you, rivals breathe down your neck, and the smallest mistake can cost everything. This isn’t just a race — it’s a proving ground for champions.

Your name isn’t earned at the finish line — it’s forged in every bold move, every fearless overtake, and every moment you refuse to back down.

The race never ends. The pressure never fades. Will you take the apex — or watch it disappear in your rearview?

70010000099268.name: SUPER BOMBERMAN COLLECTION
70010000099268.intro: Hit party battle game series ‘SUPER BOMBERMAN’ now available as a collection!
70010000099268.description:
Party battle game "SUPER BOMBERMAN" is now available as a collection featuring a total of 7 titles with 12 versions across JP, EUR and USA, including the long-awaited localised versions of the unreleased SUPER BOMBERMAN 4 and 5!
Including Boss Rush mode to time attack against all the bosses in each title, support functions, libraries and more!

【Included Titles】

① SUPER BOMBERMAN [Japanese Version / US Version / European Version]
Mr. Karat, the evil power-hungry tyrant, and scientist Dr.Mukk! Defeat the robot army they command and thwart their ambitions!

② SUPER BOMBERMAN 2 [Japanese Version / US Version / European Version]
Our Bomberman has been captured by the sudden appearance of the vicious Bomber Quintet. For the sake of Earth's peace and his own destiny, he must confront them!

③ SUPER BOMBERMAN 3 [Japanese Version / European Version]
The evil Professor Bugler has revived the vicious Five Dastardly Bombers, once defeated by Bomberman, and has begun his march towards cosmic conquest.

④ SUPER BOMBERMAN 4 [Japanese Version (English localised version available)]
Bomberman has been transported to different eras by the Four Bomber Kings. What is their purpose? And what is the mysterious entity lurking in the shadows?

⑤ SUPER BOMBERMAN 5 [Japanese Version (English localised version available)]
A mysterious man calling himself the Emperor of another world, ‘Terrorin’. He has freed eight ‘Vicious Bombers’ from prison and begun an invasion with them as his subordinates.

⑥ Bomberman [Japanese Version]
The commemorative work that laid the foundation for the series. Conquer all 50 stages!

⑦ Bomberman II [Japanese Version]
The sequel to Bomberman. The work that implemented versus play.

【Support Features, Helpful Functions and New Modes】

‘Boss Rush’
A challenge mode where you battle bosses from each game consecutively in a time attack!

‘Save/Load Anytime’
Save or load your game at any point during gameplay

‘Rewind Function’
A handy feature allowing you to rewind and retry at any point

‘Screen Filtering Function’
Adjust resolution or apply screen filters to play with your preferred visual settings

‘BOMB Radio’
Listen to original soundtracks from each title. You can also create your own playlists

‘Gallery’
Browse art works and development materials. Over 200 items in total!

70010000099273.name: Rocket Strike: Deep Space
70010000099273.description:
Rocket Strike: Deep Space is a fast-paced challenge where you pilot a sleek rocket through treacherous tunnels packed with spinning traps, moving walls, and unexpected surprises. Each level brings new patterns, tighter spaces, and faster speeds. 
Your mission: fly with precision, dodge every obstacle, and survive the chaos. With retro visuals, smooth controls, and unforgiving gameplay, every run is a test of skill and focus. 
One hit means explosion.
One perfect flight means glory.
No second chances. 
Just pure reflex and adrenaline.
Master the rhythm of motion, and find the flow to survive.
Only the sharpest pilots will reach the final sector.

70010000099284.name: Avian Knights
70010000099284.intro: Battle it out with your friends or compete for the title of Grand World Champion in Avian Knights
70010000099284.description:
"Avian Knights" is an exhilarating, feather-fuelled experience that combines classic arcade-style gameplay with vibrant modern-day design. The game harks back to the golden era of cooperative gaming, revitalizing the nostalgia of couch co-op with the ability to engage in 4-player local multiplayer battles.

Each player becomes a valorous knight soaring through fantastical landscapes atop their trusty avian steed. Whether engaged in swift solo flight or hectic multiplayer skirmishes, the air will ripple with the thrilling whoosh of wings and the clatter of clashing weapons.

The gameplay of "Avian Knights" offers an abundance of variety. Knights can wield an array of weapons, each with unique mechanics and strategic opportunities. Mighty swords, agile bows, powerful magic staves, and more are at your disposal. Collecting power-ups in mid-flight will add an extra layer of strategy and unpredictability, offering boosts that could turn the tide of any battle.

The integration of the Major League eSports app brings an innovative layer to "Avian Knights," enabling cross-platform leaderboard tracking and achievement gathering. Compete for the title of the most formidable Avian Knight, or strive to unlock the most prestigious achievements, and watch as your feats echo across all gaming platforms.

Whether you're looking for a casual gaming session with friends or a heated competitive battle against fellow knights, "Avian Knights" is sure to provide an addictive, fun-filled gaming experience.

This game promises to keep you and your friends coming back for more, seeking to perfect your flight skills, master your weaponry, and ascend to the top of the leaderboards. "Avian Knights" is more than a game – it's an invitation to a world of aerial knightly battles, where bravery, strategy, and skill determine the victors. So, gather your friends, choose your birds, arm your knights, and let the battle of the skies commence!
Features

1–4 Player Arena Mode
Test your mettle against your friends in the chaotic arena mode! Boasting game modes such as Last Team Standing, Deathmatch, Jailbreak, and more, there are plenty of ways to play! Feathered Frenzy supports up to 4 player multiplayer, so no one is left out of the action!

1-2 Player Co-op Arcade Mode
Looking for a real challenge? Hop into Arcade mode to battle against wave after wave of enemies while competing for the World High Score! Bring a friend along and battle against enemy knights and bosses while avoiding the hazards of each level! Get through all 256 waves of enemies and be crowned the Jousting Heroes Champion!

Major League eSports App
Expand your experience by creating an Alan-1 account and downloading the MLES (Major League eSports) app! Track your high scores, accumulate league points, make friends, form teams, compete in tournaments and more! Each Alan-1 game released will be eligible for competition in the Alan-1 league with great prizes available for those who perform best!

High Scores
Experience the classic arcade experience of competing for prestige on the high score leaderboard! With an integrated global high score leaderboard linked to your Alan-1 account, your best scores will be automatically tracked and updated to show your standing amongst other players around the world.

70010000099288.name: Turbo Circuit: Sports Car Racing
70010000099288.intro: Feel the Grip. Master the Track. Own the Circuit
70010000099288.description: Turbo Circuit: Sports Car Racing delivers pure high-speed action for racing enthusiasts. Take the wheel of precision-tuned sports machines and dominate tight turns, long straights, and challenging chicanes on a series of realistic closed circuits. Whether you're chasing lap records or battling opponents for glory, this is the ultimate test of driving skill.

70010000099299.name: Platypus Reclayed
70010000099299.description:
Reclaimed. Remade. Reclayed. The Legendary Platypus Returns!

22 years after its first appearance, the iconic indie shoot ‘em up Platypus is coming back, better than ever! Led by the original creator Anthony Flack, alongside the talented Claymatic team, we're embarking on a journey to bring the beloved classic into the present.

Platypus Reclayed isn't just a simple remaster—it's a complete revamp. Reprogrammed from scratch and updated for modern hardware, with all-new models and artwork photographed in 4k widescreen, featuring updated gameplay, new weapons and additional content. Get ready to dive into the heart-pounding action of this fast, frantic, and incredibly fun arcade-style shoot-em-up!

Collosatropolis: A City in Chaos

The once-thriving metropolis of Collosatropolis is now bursting at the seams. Towering skyscrapers dominate the skyline, while pollution chokes the air - and parking is a nightmare. Desperate times call for desperate measures, and Collosatropolis sets its sights on neighbouring Mungola for expansion. But little do they know, Mungola isn't going down without a fight...

The Legendary F-27 "Platypus" Takes Flight

In the heart of Mungola, a single squadron of fighter planes stands as the last line of defence—the legendary F-27 "Platypus". Despite their age, these antique aircraft are the Mungolan people's last hope for freedom. Are you ready to pilot the Platypus and take on the mighty Collosatropolan battle fleet?

Features That Will Keep You Coming Back for More
- Two-Player Simultaneous Action: Team up with a friend for double the fun!
- Stunning Claymation Graphics: Experience the beauty of claymation like never before with all-new high definition artwork.
- Addictive, Exciting Gameplay: Get ready for heart-pounding action that will keep you on the edge of your seat.
- The original Platypus soundtrack is back with even more officially licensed remixes of classic 1980s game tunes from our friends at C64audio.
- Adjustable Difficulty Settings: Whether you're a novice or a seasoned pro, Platypus has a challenge for everyone.

About Claymatic
We are a small indie studio with a love for stop-motion animation. We have a passion for straightforward, honest games with uncomplicated and effective mechanics that deliver fun gameplay and can be played over and over without ever feeling old. Our community means everything to us; we play, bounce ideas and chat very openly about everything we do and work on. We are firm believers in open development and transparency.

70010000099304.name: Ozymandias
70010000099304.intro: Build an empire in a single sitting. All the strategy of a classic 4X in a faster format.
70010000099304.description: At the dawn of history, Bronze Age kings built the first empires. Strategize their rise to power in a uniquely streamlined 4X. Expand your borders, build cities in tactical locations then raise armies to defend them. Each turn, you receive opportunities but must choose only one, complete the objective to earn the reward. Random victory conditions make every game different; custom victory conditions support different styles of play.

70010000099314.name: Wildkeepers Rising
70010000099314.intro: Tame monsters! Slay waves of enemy hordes! Explore fantasy lands!
70010000099314.description:
Wildkeepers Rising is a whimsical action-RPG roguelite set in a beautiful hand-drawn world that combines the power curve of bullet heaven games with the compulsive fun of a creature collector.

FEATURES
* Bullet Heaven: Shred thousands of monsters in bullet heaven runs
* Creature Collector: Discover, tame, and train magical beasts
* Runs & Builds: Create team synergies with different Guardians
* Roguelike Runs: Take runs with different Wildkeepers wielding different weapons
* Progression: Unlock new Guardians and items and make them stronger between runs
* RPG Elements: Discover a rich world of fantasy heroes and magical monsters

70010000099316.name: Racing Rebels Mud Clash
70010000099316.intro: Get Dirty. Drive Fast. Win Big!
70010000099316.description: Racing Rebels Mud Clash is a muddy, high-speed racing challenge where players unlock new maps and buy better cars by winning races. Earn cash based on your finishing position, upgrade your garage, and blast past rivals with powerful nitro boosts.

70010000099322.name: System Shock
70010000099322.description:
System Shock is the fully fledged remake of the ground breaking original from 1994, combining cult gameplay with all-new HD visuals, updated controls, an overhauled interface and all-new sounds & music; it even has the original voice actor of SHODAN, one of gaming’s most iconic villains. Witness the rebirth of one of the greatest and most influential games ever created.

A first-person fight to the death in the depths of space! 

SHE IS SELF-AWARE AND AWARE OF YOU
Meet SHODAN: The psychotic AI has taken control of Citadel Station and turned the crew into an army of cyborgs and mutants; She now plans to do the same to Earth. You must explore and battle your way through the depths of a space station gone to hell. Stop SHODAN and avert humanity’s destruction.

HER TERMINATION IS OUR SALVATION

70010000099327.name: Chess Quest: From Pawn to Master
70010000099327.description:
"Learn chess from scratch and become a master!
Chess Quest is a step-by-step adventure that makes chess fun and accessible for everyone—from complete beginners to future grandmasters. With engaging lessons, smart puzzles, and exciting challenges, you'll grow from a humble pawn into a powerful piece on the board. Start your chess journey today!"

70010000099333.name: Nail Design & DIY Nail Masterclass: How to Get Cute Fingertips
70010000099333.description: Perfect for beginners and beauty lovers! This app teaches you step-by-step how to create trendy nail designs and do your own nails at home. Learn with video tutorials, seasonal trends, and easy techniques to express your personal style. Turn your fingertips into art — anytime, anywhere.

70010000099339.name: Breathe Free: Quit Smoking Journey
70010000099339.description: Take control of your life and break free from smoking. With expert-backed methods, daily challenges, and motivational tracking tools, this app guides you step-by-step toward a healthier, smoke-free future. Your journey to freedom starts today.

70010000099342.name: Become a Love Expert!
70010000099342.description: Unlock the secrets of attraction and master your romantic skills! This app guides you step-by-step through real-life scenarios, expert tips, and interactive challenges to become a true master in love and relationships.

70010000099348.name: My First Kawaii Drawing
70010000099348.description:
Want to draw cute things but don’t know where to start?
It will guide you from absolute beginner to kawaii pro with step-by-step lessons that grow with you.
Learn to draw popular kawaii themes like animals, sweets, and characters, and unlock the tools to create your own adorable originals.
Whether you're just starting out or already confident, it's perfect for improving your skills in a fun way.

70010000099351.name: All About Dog Training
70010000099351.description:
Barking, biting, not listening... all those behavior issues? This guide has you covered!
Learn step-by-step dog training methods that are gentle, effective, and beginner-friendly.
From positive reinforcement to everyday care and understanding your dog’s body language—
everything you need to enjoy a better life with your furry friend is right here.

70010000099354.name: Daily Skincare Routine
70010000099354.description:
Not sure if you're taking good care of your skin?
It will gently guide you through your daily routine, morning and night.
Discover tips for your skin type, a simple step-by-step guide and little tricks to achieve radiant skin.
A perfect daily companion for beginners and skin care enthusiasts alike.

70010000099357.name: Make it! Choco Banana
70010000099357.intro:
It's time for a cute choco banana-making challenge!
Make as many as you can, and watch your food cart prosper!
70010000099357.description:
Let's make choco bananas on the Nintendo Switch™!
Dip each banana in chocolate and add a topping, making choco bananas to order!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Make choco bananas to order!
Dip bananas in chocolate, decorate them with tasty toppings, and serve them up!
Make as many as you can before time runs out!

《How to Play》
1. Prepare a banana and skewer it on a stick!

2. Dip the banana in chocolate! Choose from choco, matcha, strawberry and mint flavors!

3. When the chocolate has set, add a topping! Choose from sprinkles, sugar balls, and choco sauce!

4. When the chocolate has hardened, serve the choco banana!

[Score Attack]
Whip up as many choco bananas as possible and aim for the top spot on the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Compete with others and test your choco banana-making skills!

70010000099362.name: EGGCONSOLE Diable de Laplace PC-8801mkIISR
70010000099362.intro: Take on the role of a ghost hunter and challenge a mysterious haunted mansion. A high-difficulty 3D dungeon RPG that once puzzled players of its time.
70010000099362.description:
This is a role-playing game released in Japan by Humming Bird Soft in 1987. This first-person 3D RPG has players form a party of unique characters—detective, journalist, scientist, psychic, and dilettante—to challenge the haunted Weather Top Mansion. It features turn-based combat with physical and mental attack elements, some enemies vulnerable only to the latter.

At the start, you find yourself suddenly trapped inside the mansion, and your first challenge is figuring out how to escape. The mansion is full of traps that can drive you insane, and you can take photos of monsters and sell them in town. With its strong horror elements and puzzle-solving game, this title offers a rewarding challenge for those looking for a deep and atmospheric 3D RPG experience.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000099365.name: Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000099365.intro: Live as a Pokémon Trainer and help protect the peace in Lumiose City—enhanced for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70010000099365.description:
Lumiose City—a home for people and Pokémon alike. Thanks to an urban redevelopment plan driven by Quasartico Inc., the lush greenery of verdant parks intermingles with facilities using the latest cutting-edge technology. A lot has changed here since the days of the Pokémon™ X and Pokémon Y games!

Choose Chikorita, Tepig, or Totodile as your first partner Pokémon, and then set off on a grand adventure! Your journey will take you to all manner of sights in the streets arrayed around Prism Tower, including shops, restaurants, and places called wild zones—where Pokémon roam free. As you catch, train, and battle Pokémon, there will be plenty of people to meet too—like AZ, the enigmatic owner of Hotel Z, and Team MZ, the crew that aims to keep Lumiose a peaceful place.

And with performance upgrades for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system, you’ll experience Lumiose City like never before: with enhanced resolution and frame rates!

Catch, battle, and Mega Evolve—all in real time!

Step onto the battlefield and command your Pokémon directly—there are no turns! For the first time in the Pokémon RPG series, Trainers and their Pokémon can both move around in real-time battles, and your Pokémon will unleash their moves when you tell them to. Strategically swapping out your Pokémon and accounting for each move’s timing and area of effect will greatly help you in this new style of battle.

Harness the power of Mega Evolution! Unleash your Pokémon’s hidden energy to temporarily transform its appearance, enhance its capabilities, and perhaps even change its type. Use this power wisely to try to overcome your toughest challenges, like those posed by the rampaging Rogue Mega-Evolved Pokémon across Lumiose City. Investigate these dangerous incidents so you can put a stop to them—you may even encounter new Mega-Evolved Pokémon along the way! 

Compete in the Z-A Royale when night falls—or battle with other players in the Z-A Battle Club

You’re invited to join the Z-A Royale, a competition for Pokémon Trainers to test their skills and determine who’s strongest. Each night, a battle zone for the competition will appear. Prepare yourself by spending the day catching and training Pokémon, then venture into the battle zone to take on other Trainers. Be strategic and complete bonus card challenges as you battle to speed up your climb from Rank Z to Rank A. Reach the top, and you might just have a wish granted.

You can also test your skills against friends or Trainers around the world in the Z-A Battle Club. Take on up to three other Trainers at once, locally* or online**, in frenetic real-time battles!

Already have Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack for your Nintendo Switch 2 system!

If you already have the game for Nintendo Switch, you can purchase the upgrade pack separately to enjoy the improved performance, enhanced resolution, and higher frame rate of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

70010000099369.name: CYCLIA JOURNEY
70010000099369.intro: This title, CYCLIA JOURNEY, is a 2D puzzle action game set in a geometric world where everything is governed by the “The Law of Replication & Re-creation”
70010000099369.description:
That spark of inspiration changes the shape of the world.

This title, CYCLIA JOURNEY, is a 2D puzzle action game set in a geometric world where everything is governed by the “The Law of Replication & Re-creation”

Players act as a spirit of this world, but the space they can move through is extremely limited. With the power to replicate, connect and rebuild, players can create new areas, reach places they couldn’t access before, obtains keys, and progresses through the stages.

Our vision is to build a unique game where, by immersing themselves in a world built on cycles, players awaken to the hidden patterns that quietly exist in reality.

The beauty of hidden order lies beneath familiar scenery. A journey full of the joy of discovery awaits you.

70010000099381.name: Dark Dolls
70010000099381.intro:
Many slightly dark and troubled, yet cute idols appear!
An easy puzzle game anyone can play!
70010000099381.description:
Collect pieces of the cute idols and complete the puzzle!
Clear stages to see high-quality images of the idols!

70010000099386.name: EGGCONSOLE HYDLIDE3 S.V. PC-9801
70010000099386.intro:
Set off on an adventure to protect Fairyland, where humans and fairies coexist!
A powered-up version of Hydlide3 with new maps added.
70010000099386.description:
This is an action RPG released in Japan by T&E SOFT in 1989, and it is a powered-up version of “Hydlide 3” released in 1987. Players take on the role of an adventurer embarking on a journey to save Fairyland from crisis.

At the start, players create their own character through a character-making system, where they can choose from classes such as swordsman or priest. Each class has unique parameter characteristics. Repeating the character creation process until you’re satisfied can give you an advantage and is considered the first step to success—and part of the fun.

“3” inherits the graphics and sound from “2” but also improves the action elements—replacing body-check attacks with an attack button. Also, the game introduces new features such as class selection, the time, eating, and item weight, making it a well-balanced. This version includes added visual scenes, new maps, and new characters, offering more enjoyable experience. A classic loved by action RPG fans—give it a try.


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000099389.name: BAROQUE Become a Meta-Being Revive
70010000099389.intro:
Become a Meta-Being and head for the Neuro Tower…
The protagonist is a Meta-Being!
A jumping action game set in the world of BAROQUE.
70010000099389.description:
"BAROQUE Become a Meta-Being" Returns—Powered Up for Nintendo Switch™!

■ Game Overview
In this game, you play as Grue, one of the minor enemies that appear in BAROQUE.
Use jumps and quick movements in all directions to see how far you can progress through the dungeon known as the Neuro Tower.
Will you take cautious steps forward, or leap boldly ahead? With simple controls, anyone can enjoy the challenge.
You’ll also encounter many familiar characters from the original game, such as Moon and Kato.

By using the rewards you earn based on the distance you travel, you can obtain various types of Grue, such as the "Muscle Grue" and the "Jellyfish Grue." You can also change your appearance to the Grue you’ve obtained and play as them.


■ New Features
In addition to the Original Mode, where you test how far you can go without making a mistake, a brand-new Countdown Mode has been added.
In this mode, the challenge is to see how far you can go within 60 seconds. You can revive as many times as you want during the time limit, and the rewards you earn differ from those in Original Mode.

A new camera option, Another View, has also been added—switch from the top-down Normal View to a dynamic, close-up perspective from behind Grue for a more immersive experience.

Other improvements include interface adjustments and the ability to restart instantly with a single button press, making the game smoother and more enjoyable to play.

70010000099394.name: Dreaming in Cherry Blossoms, I Fall in Love with You
70010000099394.intro: A journey to the ever-blooming cherry tree of a forgotten promise…
70010000099394.description:
After a small twist of fate, the main character returns to the town where he once lived.
Each time he wakes, he remembers a long-forgotten promise—made with someone, somewhere, in the distant past.
And just like those memories, strange dreams begin to visit him, as if gently guiding him forward.
A quiet townscape. A peaceful life that seems unchanged yet slowly shifting with time.
Moments spent with the girls he meets there begin to slowly melt the walls around his heart.
When he finds the courage to face the emotions he had long forgotten—
Whose hand will he take? And what future will he choose?
Beyond each choice lies more than just one ending of the heart.

Dreaming in Cherry Blossoms, I Fall in Love with You
A bittersweet yet tender story where past and present, memory and feeling, intertwine—
And now, the tale begins.

◆ Highlights of the Game ◆

・A heartfelt story that blends tenderness and sorrow, sure to leave a deep impression.

・A tale that walks the line between love and something more—perfect for all visual novel fans.

・Brought to life by an all-star voice cast, adding rich emotion to every scene.

・Don’t miss the theme song “Melody of the Night Sky” sung by Rin Kurusu, the voice actor of Cherry!

・Every scene is fully voiced—including side characters!

・Beautiful artwork and soothing music that gently resonate with your heart.

◆Character Introduction◆

・Cherry（CV. Rin Kurusu）
A spirit of the cherry tree who suddenly appears before the main character.
She longs for the main character to live a peaceful, happy life.
As a third-class high ranked spirit from the spirit world, her voice has the power to stir hearts—and even create miracles.

・Wathy（CV. Saku Mizuno）
A spirit born from nature itself, who has protected the main character’s town for centuries.
As a second-class high ranked spirit, she keeps a close eye on Cherry to make sure nothing goes wrong.
Though serious about her role, she’s curious about human culture… and secretly loves ketchup.

・Yuri Takai（CV. Yurina Uchiyama）
The main character’s childhood friend—smart, athletic, and the class rep.
She’s dependable and always looking out for the main character, even if she can be a bit bossy.
She cared for the main character since they were kids, but as Cherry grows closer with him, her feelings start to get complicated.

・Shoko Ina（CV. Non Harusaki）
The main character’s landlady and homeroom teacher.
She’s calm, sharp-tongued, and has a mature air, but always keeps an on the main character.
Like an older sister, she knows when to push—and when to playfully tease.

・Yua Orihara（CV. Manatsu Murakami）
Classmate and another childhood friend of the main character.
Soft-spoken and kind, but quietly strong at heart.
She naturally cares for others and supports the main character in her own way.

・Hayato Kusanagi（CV. Kakeru Hatano）
A cheerful, sporty classmate who lights up the room.
He’s a basketball ace, but also a true friend who’s always got the main character’s back.
Loyal, energetic, and full of heart.

70010000099404.name: Recycling Center Simulator
70010000099404.description:
Recycling Center Simulator is a business simulator game with a first person view. Make money from garbage, collect raw materials for your recycling center from different locations, recycle them, make money by producing new products and improve your factory.

Deal with customers to get raw materials:
Use the computer to bargain with people in the city who sell their waste to buy products cheap.

Collect Waste From The Places You Buy:
Collect the wastes, to gather raw matterials.

Sort Raw Materials for Recycling:
Bring the harvested wastes to your factory and sort them by type in the sorting machine

Production:
Put Raw Material Back into Production to Make More Valuable Products

Expand Factory:
Sell New and More Valuable Products and Expand Your Factory

70010000099406.name: GLITCH: Dead Loop Horror
70010000099406.intro: Code the game. Survive the night.
70010000099406.description:
GLITCH: Dead Loop Horror is a first-person psychological horror game where you play as a lone programmer staying late at the office to finish your project. But as night falls, reality begins to unravel. Solve cryptic puzzles, debug eerie anomalies, and survive the unknown force stalking the dark halls.
The atmosphere becomes more mysterious. Familiar places begin to feel alien. The deeper you go, the more unstable everything becomes.
Walls seem to shift when you're not looking. The boundaries between game and reality blur into one twisted loop. Each solution leads to deeper uncertainty.
Some code isn’t meant to be fixed…

70010000099412.name: Sherlock Spot DX
70010000099412.description:
Sharpen your eyes and challenge your brain with Sherlock Spot DX – the classic puzzle game reimagined for endless fun! Each level presents two seemingly identical pictures, but hidden within are clever differences waiting to be found. With carefully designed images, stunning visuals, and a variety of difficulty levels, the game keeps players engaged whether they’re casual puzzlers or seasoned spotters.

Not only is it fun, but playing Sherlock Spot DX also helps improve focus, attention to detail, and memory skills.
