It’s the perfect mix of relaxation and mental exercise, making it ideal for quick breaks or long play sessions. Compete with friends, test your observation speed, and enjoy the satisfying rush of spotting every last detail – this is more than just a game, it’s a brain-boosting adventure!

Features:
★ 99 challenging levels.
★ Nintendo Switch™ online leaderboards for each mode (opt-out available).
★ 5 professionally composed background tracks.
★ Multi-language support.
★ Play with Joy-Con™, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller™  or touchscreen.
★ Quick-start help system – perfect for beginners!
★ Settings to adjust pointer speed, sound on/off, background music on/off.

Sherlock Spot DX offers an immersive experience for puzzle lovers of all ages. 
Are you ready to take on the challenge and rise to the top of the world leaderboard?

70010000099419.name: EGGCONSOLE FRAY PC-9801
70010000099419.intro: An action RPG featuring Fray, a popular character from the “Xak” series! Enjoy a comical, lighthearted story full of excitement!
70010000099419.description:
This action RPG, released in Japan by Micro Cabin in 1991, is a spin-off starring Fray, a popular character from “Xak.” Unlike the serious tone of the Xak titles, this features a lighthearted and fun adventure.

The game is a top-down action RPG where you can freely explore towns, but in adventure stages, the screen scrolls only upward. You’ll need to use charged attacks and jumping to push forward. Note that the scrolling in adventure scenes is not forced like in shooting games— it scrolls upward only as you move, allowing for a more relaxed play style.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000099437.name: Secret Paws - Cozy Offices
70010000099437.intro: Solve feline-themed hidden object challenges in cute cube-shaped isometric offices!
70010000099437.description:
Find the hidden kitties around the office! Secret Paws - Cozy Offices is an isometric hidden object game themed around cats and colorful workspaces. Explore unique, adorably decorated cube-shaped rooms as you search for dozens of cleverly obscured felines lying around each stage.

Rotate the room to get a better view between obstacles, move the cursor and click on each cat that you discover, gradually reducing the counter in the top-left of the screen. Secret Paws - Cozy Offices is calm, casual and therapeutic with a soothing soundtrack to match, making it the perfect “anytime” experience!

• Find the cats hidden in colorful isometric office cubes!
• Unlock new rooms of gradually increasing complexity.
• Rotate the office cubes to change your viewpoint and avoid obstructions!
• Click on the cleverly placed felines to reduce the cat counter to zero.

70010000099442.name: The Guardians of the Secret Garden
70010000099442.intro: A journey through a magical garden, which needs help. An adventurous girl and her dog will seek to restore peace with the help of new friends.
70010000099442.description:
Meet Ana in this visual novel, an 8-year-old girl with a deep curiosity about nature. One day, while playing in her grandmother's garden, she discovers a secret door that leads her to a magical garden filled with talking animals.

With the help of her dog Rocco, a mischievous and always energetic dog, Nina, a colorful and cheerful hummingbird, and Max, a cheerful and brave fox, Ana must help the animals remember what makes this place special: friendship, teamwork, and a love of nature.

Kid- and family-friendly gameplay.

Accessible text and narrative for young readers.

Dynamic and colorful images inspired by fantasy worlds.

Ambient music creates a magical and immersive atmosphere.

Lessons about teamwork, courage, and the power of stories.

Accessibility options such as adjusting text, volume, and image transitions.

·Educational fun with content that promotes positive values.

70010000099445.name: Ice Princess Crystals
70010000099445.intro: Solve 100 levels in this match 3 game with a beautiful princess in a magical ice world
70010000099445.description:
-Solve 100 unique levels in an ice world
-Match 3 identical princess crystals to break them and generate combos
-Collect coins, unlock incredible bonuses and use them like chocolate bombs, candy explosions and more!
-Beautiful art for princesses
-No in-app-purchases or ads!

70010000099447.name: Ayala: Forgotten Realms
70010000099447.intro: Awakened by a mysterious light, Yang sets out on a relentless journey through enigmatic realms. Face monstrous enemies and colossal bosses in this thrilling hack-and-slash adventure
70010000099447.description:
On an ordinary night, Yang, a young creature, is caught off guard by a burst of light that floods his room and transports him to a completely different reality. As he surveys his surroundings, two magical doors appear before him, each leading to a hostile and unknown world: a scorching desert filled with danger, and a living forest where countless enemies lurk. Isolated from his reality, Yang must traverse these worlds, face colossal monsters, and uncover the mysteries behind his journey — and the purpose of the force that pulled him from home.

Dynamic Hack-and-Slash – Engage in fast-paced combat that rewards quick reflexes and precision.

Two Distinct Worlds – Choose your path between unique realms, each with exclusive enemies and challenges.

Dark Fairytale Aesthetic – Explore stylized environments filled with dramatic contrasts of light and shadow.

70010000099463.name: Robot girl's dream -RobotBattleChampionship-
70010000099463.intro:
This game is an RPG game that follows the growth of
a robot girl who has lost her memories.
70010000099463.description:
■ Game Content
This game is a 2D RPG game featuring a robot girl who has lost her memories.

You can choose actions such as going out, working, and participating in tournaments, and enjoy encounters with unique humans and robots.

The ending varies based on the actions you take, the choices you make, and the outcomes of your battles.

■ STORY
The story takes place in the near future, where AI technology has advanced and robots are beginning to develop consciousness, thinking and living like humans.

In this age of constant technological advancement, the city of "Astromere" contributes significantly to this progress.

In this city, a robot girl wakes up.

Having lost her memory in a junkyard, she finds herself drawn to a robot battle she sees on TV upon awakening...?

70010000099468.name: House Renovator Simulator
70010000099468.intro: Every broken house deserves a second chance – build your dream home.
70010000099468.description:
House Renovator Simulator offers a realistic renovation experience where you transform old houses into modern, welcoming homes. From tearing down walls to customizing interiors with furniture and finishes, every detail counts.

With a wide range of tools and materials, you have full control to create spaces in modern, rustic, or classic styles. Realistic mechanics and endless customization let you bring forgotten homes back to life using your skill and creativity.

Key features:
	•	Complete renovation experience from demolition to final decoration.
	•	A wide variety of high-quality tools and materials for customization and upgrades.
	•	Realistic mechanics for painting, flooring, plumbing, and electrical work.
	•	Efficient management of budget, time, and resources for successful projects.

Every house has a story, and you are the one who can rewrite it. Embark on this journey and turn forgotten spaces into dream homes with House Renovator Simulator!

70010000099473.name: Mind & Sight Spot the Difference Workout
70010000099473.intro:
Challenge your eyes and brain
with a slightly tricky spot-the-difference game!
70010000099473.description:
Train your eyes and brain by finding the one hidden difference in each photo pair.
It’s a simple and fun way to sharpen your focus and thinking.

How to play is easy：
・Take a close look at the photo at the top of the screen
・Compare it with the photo below and find what’s different
・When you spot the difference, move the cursor over it and hit “OK”!

The puzzles are a bit challenging,
but the easy controls make it perfect for a casual play session.
Great for killing time or giving your brain a quick workout.

Totally stuck?
Try pressing the hint button –
it’ll give you a clue about where the difference is hiding!

70010000099478.name: Pimp Up Dungeon
70010000099478.intro: Pack the Treasure and Master the Challenge!
70010000099478.description:
Have you ever wanted to travel back to the Middle Ages? 
A possibility might have just arisen!


Medieval storages weren’t always known for their proper organization, and this is about to change. While embracing the Medieval era, a challenge is always welcomed in the world of Pimp Up Dungeon. Arrange your weapons, potions and gold to fit everything and find their righteous space!

Dungeons can be dangerous so watch out for traps and other inconveniences. Don’t threaten, if you make a mistake, just try again!

Completing a level grants you gems but be careful because they are awarded for clearing a level without any help. Gems can be used to obtain tips - in case the dungeon gets tricky.


What awaits you:
- 100 challenging levels!
- Leaderboard for those who take gaming seriously.
- Daily scored mission.
- 12 unique items like swords, coins, or potions to place .

Keep in mind that the more precise and careful you are, the higher the rewards so it’s time to sharpen your organizing skills.

Go ahead and start organizing the treasure!

70010000099488.name: Ants Empire Colony
70010000099488.intro: Think like an ant. Rebuild what was lost and protect what remains.
70010000099488.description:
Step into the shoes of a brave ant in a unique sandbox-style adventure, where nature becomes your battlefield and rebuilding your colony is the ultimate goal. After a devastating enemy attack, the anthill lies in ruins—and you are its only hope for restoration.

 One map, countless challenges.
Explore a rich natural environment, gather resources, and rebuild the anthill step by step. Every collected item matters.

 Enemies around every corner.
The foes guard essential resources. Will you sneak past or face them head-on?

 Quests with purpose.
Take on 11 carefully designed missions that guide your journey and give rhythm to your exploration. Each objective brings you closer to restoring the colony and mastering your surroundings.

 A world that reacts to you.
Every action you take—collecting, building, or fighting—shapes the environment around you. Progress is visible, step by step, as the anthill comes back to life.

Build your ant empire—one leaf, one stone, one battle at a time.
Are you ready to become the savior of the colony?

70010000099504.name: A Storied Life: Tabitha
70010000099504.intro: A Storied Life: Tabitha is a cosy narrative game about memory, legacy, discovery, and joy.
70010000099504.description:
An elderly loved one has died, leaving you their estate and a letter encouraging you to sell any valuables. But when a mishap spoils their soon-to-be-published memoirs, you set out to repair the damage, piecing together their hidden past using the items you inherit. 

House clearing with care 

Explore a picturesque country house and pack away its contents, room by room. Move furniture, lift rugs, and open cupboards to uncover hidden and forgotten objects. 

What separates cherished items from rubbish? Slowly sift through fragments of someone's past and decide whether to keep, auction, or discard each object. 

Relaxing packing puzzles 

You can't keep everything. Move and rotate items to fit them into boxes. Limited space and weight considerations mean you must let some things go. 

Strengthen boxes with tape and vacuum pack soft goods to fit more in. Don't forget to bubble wrap fragile objects or they may break. 

Restore your loved one's memoirs 

Every item you save unlocks a set of associated words. Use these to mend the gaps in the damaged memoirs, completing the sentences to reveal a storied life. 

You determine how the past is recorded. Uplifting, silly, shocking, funny, sombre... the memoirs have many potential branches, and every decision is yours.  

Key Features 

Authentic Yorkshire setting: An intricately branching story rooted in North Yorkshire, UK 

Soothing, painterly world: 17 delicately animated, hand-painted levels, enhanced by ambient weather and time of day effects 

Multiple endings: The memoirs you write directly impact the final room's puzzles and how your benefactor is remembered 

Item encyclopaedia: Your journal automatically logs all collected items and the words they unlock, and tracks the funds you raise at auction 

Adaptive word puzzles: Forget to safely pack your items? Broken and pristine versions of the same object unlock unique words for the memoirs 

Secrets and surprises: Uncover unexpected treats by replaying levels and experimenting

70010000099509.name: KLETKA
70010000099509.intro: KLETKA is a co-op (up to 6 players) horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you.
70010000099509.description:
INTO THE ABYSS
The most dangerous criminals are convicted and sent to Kletka. Your sentence is to descend into the depths of the Gigastructure while maintaining a living and hungry elevator. Never forget to feed it if you don't want to end up being eaten alive. Kletka is omnivorous, be ready to feed it both fuel and flesh.

GIGASTRUCTURE
The Gigastructure is an endlessly expanding building. Traps and anomalies fill the corridors. Any stop you make could be your last.

SAMOSBOR
Samosbor is a mysterious anomaly that kills anything in its path. This terrifying phenomenon is feared by all inhabitants as no one has ever survived it. When you hear the siren, it's time to drop everything and run to the elevator as fast as you can. Kletka is the only thing that can protect you from this anomaly.

TOGETHER
Form a team of up to six people and descend in the elevator. Friends tend to survive when they work together, but friends also make for good fuel.

70010000099513.name: Clothing Boutique Simulator : Store Manager
70010000099513.intro: Run your own fashion boutique! Manage, design, sell trendy outfits & grow your stylish clothing store empire.
70010000099513.description:
Step into the glamorous world of fashion and run your very own clothing boutique! In this immersive simulator, you’ll design, stock, and manage a stylish store where every detail counts.

Gameplay:
- Manage Your Boutique: Arrange clothing displays, track sales, and keep your store running smoothly.
- Style & Customize: Choose trendy outfits, accessories, and décor to create a unique shopping experience.
- Serve Customers: Help shoppers find the perfect look and keep them coming back for more.
- Grow Your Business: Expand your boutique, unlock new fashion collections.

Build your dream boutique and show the world your style!

70010000099518.name: Tiny Bookshop
70010000099518.intro: Leave everything behind and open a tiny bookshop by the sea in this cozy narrative management game.
70010000099518.description:
Leave everything behind and open a tiny bookshop by the sea in this cozy narrative management game.

Stock your Tiny Bookshop with different books and items, set up shop in scenic locations, and run your cozy second-hand bookshop while getting to know the locals.

Decorate your Tiny Bookshop with the items you collect. Are you into absolutely plastering it with plants? Maybe a spooky candle-lit atmosphere is more your style? Every item also has an effect on your customers and can introduce new mechanics.

Recommend the right book to the right person ~ or try to expand their literary horizon? Sometimes they just need a little help finding a book they will love!

Befriend Bookstonbury's quirky cast of characters and help each other out! They're friendly, promise :)

Stock books of different genres to satisfy the locals’ reading habits and watch your customers trickle in. Every place around town attracts a slightly different crowd, so get to know your audience and become a master bookseller!

Explore the scenic places of charming Bookstonbury-by-the-Sea and learn the ins and outs of the town. Discover its long history ~ what happened at Bookston Burgh? And who really was St. Bookston?

Discover secrets, collect items and grow your stamp collection as you explore the nooks and crannies of Bookstonbury. Who knows what else you'll find?

70010000099523.name: Ren & Stimpy Happy, Happy, Joy, Joy, Collection
70010000099523.intro: Hello, boys and girls. This is your old pal Stinky Wizzleteats. This is a game about a whale. No! This is a game about being happy! That’s right! It’s the Happy, Happy, Joy, Joy Collection!
70010000099523.description:
Hey, man! Ren & Stimpy are back in a collection of games that will satisfy even the sickest little monkeys. Don’t be an eediot – add this to your game library today, you filthy swine!

About This Game
This collection includes the following games:
•	Buckeroo$! (1993, 8-bit & 16-bit)
•	Space Cadet Adventures (1992, handheld)
•	Veediots! (1993, 8-bit & handheld)
•	Fire Dogs (1994, 16-bit)
•	Time Warp (1994, 16-bit)

Hey kids - start jumping up and down like idiots, because look what's new in this collection:
•	Save any where and any time - this helpful feature will allow you to take a litter box break and return right where you left off!
•	Rewind - If you're sucked into the hideous vortex of a black hole, don't fear - you can rewind and try again!
•	Museum Viewer - Nothing could be more fun than viewing original packaging and manuals for each of the included games!
Yes, when it's this much fun - it must be the Ren & Stimpy Happy, Happy, Joy, Joy Collection, from Blammo!

70010000099526.name: Just Yoga
70010000099526.description:
No fancy poses. No equipment. No pressure.
This app offers simple, approachable yoga that fits naturally into your daily routine.
Perfect for beginners or anyone who just wants to feel better.
Just Yoga. That’s all.

70010000099535.name: Sands of Aura
70010000099535.intro: Sail across the sandseas to return life to a dying world in an unforgettable experience that is equal parts engaging story and unrelenting, souls-like combat.
70010000099535.description:
A ruinous cataclysm unleashed by a tormented god descended the world of Talamhel into perpetual night. The hourglass of time was shattered and its essence poured across the land, creating an endless sea of sand. The once-flourishing world of Talamhel became a putrid lesion of its former glory and those who called it home are now husks of corruption--violent, undying, unyielding soldiers of death. 

But Talamhel is not lost--not yet. 

For generations, the righteous few have endured. You are one of those few. On the eve of your induction into the Order of Remnant Knights, the last protectors of man, Talamhel is once-again wracked by calamity. The corruptive nature of the Night Plague has mutated, and the realm of man needs the Remnant Knights more than ever. 

Track down the emergent evil and destroy it. Protect the realm of man. 

From the helm of your nimble grainwake, carve across the perilous sandseas to confront the source of this newfound terror, but don’t expect a guiding light or a red X on a map. You’ll chart your own course forward--behold the open seas, and choose the heading you best see fit. 

But familiarity is a far-flung concept aboard the grainwake--the shifting sands are always changing, revealing secrets, dangers, and paths unseen. Things are not as they seem… 
-Talamhel is an open world, free to explore and discover as you please. 
-Every island is a unique, colorful encounter of combat, lore, and plunder. 
-With tiered levels of difficulty, locations offer challenges that will reward those who overcome. 
-With a trusted (undead) companion rested in the crow’s nest, you’ll never sail the seas alone. 

The corruption that plagues Talamhel has created a horde comprised of both man and other Talamhelic natives: The venerable Ferrum and the insectoid, hive-minded Hashara. Once warring nations have become an abominable army of undying malice. 

From doomsday cultists to fallen kings, the foes that guard the answers you seek are determined to see your end. Prepare for an unrelenting, unforgiving combat experience not to be taken lightly. Swing true, dear knight, swing true. 

With hundreds of weapon components to be reclaimed from the crumbled remains of civilization, there are thousands of unique weapons to be forged. Find the hilt that fits just right. 
-Cleave through the corruption with 7 distinct fighting styles. 
-Bolster yourself with dozens of armor sets, each with their own unique defenses. 
-Combine and modify your devastation with magical augments, creating a personalized build.

70010000099540.name: Comedy Training: Become the Funny One!
70010000099540.description:
Become the person everyone laughs with!
This app helps you master the art of humor through funny stories, quick gags, and clever introductions.
Want to make your friends laugh? Boost your social confidence?
Start your comedy training today and unlock your inner funny!

70010000099546.name: Mind Over Magnet
70010000099546.description:
An attractive puzzle platformer where you use magnetism to escape a factory. Meet a cast of magnet characters and work together to solve logical conundrums.

Created by Mark Brown, owner of the popular YouTube channel Game Maker’s Toolkit (GMTK), Mind Over Magnet is a blast for players of all ages and skill levels!

Escape a dangerous factory using the power of magnetism. You must team up with three different magnet friends and use their unique abilities to solve more than 50 tricky single-screen puzzles.

70010000099551.name: The Paper Time Travelers
70010000099551.intro: Embark on a magical journey through enchanted worlds! Help Lina and Theo stop an evil force threatening to erase all the stories
70010000099551.description:
Join Lina and Theo in this visual novel, as they discover a brilliant and mysterious tale… one that takes them to incredible magical worlds! From enchanted forests with fantastic creatures to pirate islands full of adventure.

But beware! The evil Narris wants to erase all stories forever.

Are you ready to help them solve puzzles, overcome challenges, and discover secrets? Imagination is your best tool!

Why you'll love Paper Time Travelers?
·Travel to magical worlds: From dragon mountains to beaches filled with pirate treasure.

·Meet fantastic creatures and gain the trust of the guardian dragons.

·Learn the value of friendship as Lina and Theo work together to save the tales.

·Discover hidden secrets in each chapter and unlock the power of imagination.

Get ready for an adventure full of magic, excitement, and friendship! Can Lina and Theo stop Narris and save all the stories?

The journey is about to begin!

70010000099553.name: BURGER Shot
70010000099553.intro:
Aim your burgers and shoot!
Raise the level of your burgers and create the ultimate King Burger!
70010000099553.description:
BURGER Shot is a deliciously delightful burger puzzle game!
Merge burgers of the same type and watch them level up!
Be careful not to let them overflow off the counter!

Save a burger you want for later in your reserves,
cleverly rotate each burger to hit the perfect angle,
and make the best use of your limited space to reach the highest score possible!

[Score Attack]
Keep leveling up your burgers until they overflow off the counter!
Increase your score and aim for the top of the world leaderboards!

[Time Attack]
Race to make the highest-level burger, the King Burger, as fast as possible!
Show off your fastest clear time and reach the top world rank!

[Battle]
Raise your burger levels while sending disruptive drinks to your opponents!
Strategize your way to victory as the last one standing!
Share Joy-Con™ to play with up to 4 players!

70010000099571.name: Cozy Gardener Simulator
70010000099571.intro: Plant, water, and grow – fun at every step.
70010000099571.description:
Cozy Gardener Simulator is a heartwarming game where you become a caring gardener and the keeper of coziness in a small town. Grow vegetables and flowers in your very
own garden, take care of flower beds, tend to your plants, and beautify the streets. Keep lawns neat and tidy using your trusty lawnmower to trim overgrown grass.

Features:
-Grow and nurture your garden with seeds, water, and fertilizer.
-Care for the town by mowing lawns, tending flower beds, and cleaning up litter.
-Meet and help townsfolk with their small requests, building friendships along the way.
-Enjoy relaxing, slow-paced gameplay with no pressure or time limits.
-Collect tools, unlock seeds and decorations to expand your garden and keep the town
charming.
Discover the stories of the townspeople, complete wholesome quests, and fill your days with simple joys. In Cozy Gardener Simulator, every small task brings warmth and beauty to the town—and to your heart.

70010000099576.name: Cats Visiting Wild West
70010000099576.intro: Explore charming Wild West scenes and find hidden cats hiding in saloons, canyons, and steam trains. Relax, search, and collect them all!
70010000099576.description:
Saddle up and get ready for a paw-some adventure in Cats Visiting Wild West! Explore charming hand-drawn scenes filled with saloons, dusty towns, steam trains, and desert canyons — all packed with mischievous hidden cats waiting to be found.

Search every corner of these nostalgic Wild West illustrations and test your observation skills. From sneaky cats hiding in barrels to ones peeking out of cowboy hats, can you find them all?

Each scene also hides a special collectible object — gather them all to complete your Wild West collection!

Features:
     5 beautifully illustrated Wild West scenes
     80 hidden cats to find in each level
     A collectible item hidden in every scene
     Relaxing gameplay perfect for casual players
     Timer and leaderboard for competitive cat hunters

Grab your hat, partner — those kitties won’t find themselves!

70010000099586.name: Infinite Lives
70010000099586.intro: Explore infinite possibilities with INFINITE LIVES - where superhumans and subhumans fight for control of the ultimate shared universe!
70010000099586.description:
Bursting into the 3rd dimension brings new powers with unprecedented freedom, as a combat system perfected by wrestling is taken to new heights. An ambitious control system supercharges EVERY button, creating a spectrum of abilities that are easy to enjoy yet difficult to master.

Create your own origin story, as you try to survive in a city dominated by supernatural violence and discover who you really are. Develop powers that make you MORE than human, or lose the spirit that makes you LESS than human - in a vicious cycle that never ends! Find your place among hundreds of other heroes and villains, each trying to rule the world with their own unique powers. Fight over every corner of the map to secure it for your chosen cause, as allegiances change as often as your costume! The city's dozens of locations are filled with hundreds of fully interactive weapons and destructible scenery to add to the action.

Upon discovering every character's secret identity, you can make the world you own by saving your changes in the editor. You can then blow off steam in "Fight Scenes" - where you decide WHO fights WHERE and with WHAT! And when it's time to roam back into the city, you'll have the privilege to start each new life fine-tuned to your liking with more and more options unlocking infinite possibilities.

70010000099598.name: Cozy Cooking: Tiny Tastes
70010000099598.intro: Run your own restaurant for many hungry customers!
70010000099598.description:
Handling a restaurant has never been easier. In Cozy Cooking: Tiny Tastes you can welcome customers and cook them the most delicious dishes they have ever tasted without breaking a sweat!


It’s high time you showed your culinary skills and prepared amazing meals for your guests who came to finally eat something tasty.

Mix the right ingredients, add a dash of creativity, and voilà, culinary magic right before your eyes! But remember to read the customers’ orders carefully, they can be picky.

Throughout your adventure you will be able to unluck more components and recipes, once you level up from receiving positive feedback from your customers.


What you can find inside your restaurant:
- 172 wonderful recipes.
- 24 unique ingredients.
- 4 different cooking options - blender, pan, pot, or oven

The hardest part of this job is not eating the dish before it comes out of the kitchen, they are that delightful!

Take your culinary tools and open the best restaurant in town right away!

70010000099610.name: Sleepy Meadow
70010000099610.intro: Wander, unwind, and let the meadow carry you away.
70010000099610.description:
Welcome to Sleepy Meadow, a relaxing exploration game set in a peaceful valley where time seems to slow down. Nestled between gently rolling hills, lush forests, a sparkling lake, and a cascading waterfall, this cozy meadow is your sanctuary.

Wander at your own pace through the vibrant landscape, discovering hidden paths, tranquil spots, and charming surprises tucked away in nature. Your only goal is to explore everything the cozy meadow has hidden within.

There are no enemies, no time limits, and no pressure—just a beautiful world waiting for you to explore.

Features:
A serene open world to explore at your own pace
Peaceful soundtrack and ambient sounds of nature
Ideal for all ages and fans of cozy, non-violent games
No Rush, Just Peace: There’s no stress.

70010000099613.name: Voxelgram 2
70010000099613.intro: Voxelgram 2 is a 3D nonogram logic game, where you solve puzzles by sculpting voxel models and uncovering dioramas made from them.
70010000099613.description:
Voxelgram 2 features 250 new puzzles and a fresh set of rules, now with two colors in play. The puzzles are organized into 20 handcrafted dioramas.

If you own the previous Voxelgram game, you'll also get access to the original puzzles, reworked to fit the new two-color rules. That means an extra 250 puzzles to solve!

For endless replayability, the game features procedurally generated puzzles with different sizes, shapes, and features.

70010000099638.name: PICROSS S CAPCOM CLASSICS edition
70010000099638.intro: Collaboration Project Between Picross™ S and memorable CAPCOM games!
70010000099638.description:
Characters from retro CAPCOM console games are making an appearance in Nintendo Switch™'s Picross S series!

More than 40 titles are included!
Numerous nostalgic scenes from CAPCOM games, from 8-bit action and shooting games to 16-bit beat-'em-ups and THE original fighting game are available for discovery as pixel art illustrations.

Comes with the usual Picross S series puzzle modes: Picross, Mega Picross, Color Picross, and Clip Picross, as well as an Extra mode that features larger puzzles recreating famous scenes.

This entry also has a new Time Attack mode where players must try to finish puzzles within a time limit.
Test and see how good you really are at Picross by aiming for the golden crown in every one of them!

The number of puzzles is 150 each for Picross and Mega Picross and 5 for Clip Picross for a total of 200 piece puzzles of 40 each, 30 for Color Picross and 5 for Extra.
Time Attack mode contains 30 carefully chosen Picross puzzles.

Other new features include an Art Gallery, where players can browse key visuals at leisure, as well as grid guidelines that make it easier to select squares when sharing content via streaming or social media.

Picross is a picture crossword puzzle game where you follow hint number to complete a picture.
With simple, easy-to-follow rules, it's a game anyone can play!

70010000099643.name: Criminal Cleaner Simulator
70010000099643.intro: You’re not a criminal… just criminally good at cleaning.
70010000099643.description:
Step into the dark world of organized crime with Criminal Cleaner Simulator. As a crime scene cleaner, your job is to tidy up after the city’s most notorious criminals. When the crime lords call, it’s time to roll up your sleeves and erase any evidence of their dirty deeds.

Key Features:
- Deep Clean: Use your skills to scrub away bloodstains, hide evidence, and dispose of bodies. Each crime scene presents new challenges that test your ability to clean thoroughly and quickly.
- Upgrade Your Arsenal: Equip yourself with the latest cleaning tools, from industrial disinfectants to high-powered vacuums. As you progress, unlock more advanced equipment to tackle tougher jobs.
- Challenging Scenarios: Navigate various crime zones, each with unique obstacles and dangers. Stay one step ahead of the law while managing your resources and completing your tasks.
- Stealth and Strategy: Avoid detection by the authorities while you clean up. Every decision matters, as one mistake can blow your cover and jeopardize your mission.
- Compelling Story: Uncover the stories behind each crime scene and explore the motivations of the criminals you work for. Your journey is driven by the need to complete each mission without leaving a trace.

In Criminal Cleaner Simulator, the stakes are high, and the pressure is on. Will you rise to the challenge and become the ultimate crime scene cleaner, or will the dark underworld consume you? The choice is yours. Embrace your role, clean up the evidence, and navigate the treacherous path of crime scene cleaning.

70010000099648.name: Tung Tung Tung Sahur REPORT
70010000099648.description:
They said it was just a meme. A shout that echoed through the pre-dawn streets: “Tung tung tung… SAHUR!” Legend says if you hear the call three times and don’t respond… it will come for you.

Welcome to Tung Tung Tung Sahur REPORT, an online horror game where the cheerful call to eat before sunrise has become a haunting reminder of what was lost. You’re a scavenger, dropped into the cursed remains of a forgotten world, tasked with recovering valuable relics using your trusty physics-grabbing tool. Just one problem: you’re not alone.

Echoes follow you. Shadows move when they shouldn’t. And somewhere in the darkness, the tung tung tung is getting louder.

Search. Grab. Extract. Survive. The deeper you go, the weirder it gets—and the more the line blurs between meme and myth. Will you collect the lost pieces of civilization, or will you end up another late sleeper who didn’t answer the call?

70010000099656.name: Alien Breakout
70010000099656.intro: Guide an extraterrestrial escapee to freedom in pixelated side-scrolling precision platforming style!
70010000099656.description:
Step into the green-skinned role of an extraterrestrial as he attempts to escape from a human lab! Alien Breakout is a side-scrolling precision platformer presented in retro pixel art style. Run, leap and wall jump through 100 puzzling stages of increased complexity as you try to reach the door at the far end of each level.

Grab a ray gun to blast enemy guards and ricochet shots into switches! Avoid spikes, spinning saws, fan blades and other traps. Wall slide using ooze pads to slow your descent and do whatever it takes to avoid being killed or recaptured!

• Take control of an alien test subject as he makes a break for it!
• Master side-scrolling platforming challenges.
• Run, jump, wall slide and use your ray gun to blast enemy guards!
• Solve environmental puzzles and avoid traps.
• Enjoy retro pixel art aesthetics across 100 levels!

70010000099661.name: Tokyo Racer X
70010000099661.intro: Become the king of Tokyo’s underground races!
70010000099661.description:
Welcome to Tokyo Racer X — the heart-pounding underground street racing scene where every corner you drift and every second you shave off your time brings you one step closer to becoming a legend. Dive into the glowing nightlife of Tokyo as you grip the wheel of finely tuned performance beasts and race through the city’s iconic streets. Whether you’re sliding sideways through tight corners, blasting down the expressway at breakneck speeds, or going head-to-head with the fiercest racers in the city, the road to glory is anything but easy. 

Key Features: 
- Blisterig Speed & Precision Drifting 
Test your reflexes and driving skill in races that demand full control. Pull off flawless drifts, time your nitrous boosts perfectly, and leave your rivals in the dust. 
- Rivalries with Real Stakes 
Meet a cast of rival racers, each with their own style, backstory, and attitude. Win races, earn respect, and challenge the city’s most feared crews in a story-driven campaign. 
- Build Your Dream Machine 
Customize your ride down to the smallest detail — body kits, performance parts, paint jobs, decals, and more. Whether you’re chasing speed, style, or both, your car reflects who you are on the street. 

Put the pedal to the metal. Own the streets. Think you’ve got what it takes to rise to the top?

70010000099666.name: Zumba - Treasure of the Marble Sea
70010000099666.intro: Set sail on a marble-blasting adventure! In Zumba – Treasure of the Marble Sea, shoot and match marbles before they reach the end. Unlock upgrades, earn stars, and explore pirate worlds!
70010000099666.description:
Zumba – Treasure of the Marble Sea throws you into a fast-paced marble shooter set in a colorful pirate world! Help your cheeky pirate survive the marble madness by shooting, matching, and destroying endless waves of rolling marbles.
Choose a level, aim carefully, and fire your marbles to create chains of three or more matching colors. Time is against you—don’t let the marbles reach the end of the path! Master explosive combos, clear levels quickly, and earn high scores and star ratings.
Unlock powerful upgrades like Explosive Marbles, Time Freeze, Repaint, Slow Motion, and Destruction Shots to stay ahead of the madness. Each world brings a new theme—Island Beaches, Pirate Ships, Underwater Ruins, and Treasure Caves—with new challenges and surprises every ten levels.
Easy to play, hard to master, and endlessly fun—can you conquer the Marble Sea?

70010000099669.name: Zumba - Dragon's Marble Trial
70010000099669.intro: Unleash your dragon’s fire—match, blast, and master the marble trial!
70010000099669.description:
Zumba – The Dragon’s Marble Trial invites you into an enchanting world where a charming dragon wields colorful marbles in mouth and tail! Pick a stage, aim your dragon-launched marbles at winding paths, and match three or more identical colors to trigger explosive combos before they invade your lair. Rack up high scores and up to three stars per level by clearing waves quickly and precisely.
Between stages, spend your hoard of coins to unlock mythical upgrades: Flame Blast scorches entire clusters, Time Warp slows advancing marbles, Repaint transmutes your next marble to any hue you need, Meteor Shower rains down a barrage of matches, Destruction Shot targets a single stubborn marble, and Time Revert undoes your last shot for a second chance.
Journey through four fantastical realms—Emerald Forest Glades, Crystal Mountain Pass, Twilight Sky Islands, and the Obsidian Dragon’s Keep—each unveiled every ten levels with unique paths, new marble colors, moving obstacles, and escalating speeds.
Addictive and easy to pick up yet challenging to master, Zumba – The Dragon’s Marble Trial delivers fiery arcade fun for players of all ages.

70010000099672.name: Zumba World - The Lost Marble Island
70010000099672.intro: Dash across the islands—match, blast, and reclaim the lost marble treasures!
70010000099672.description:
Zumba World – The Lost Marble Island combines classic marble-shooter action with an interactive island adventure! You play as a masked tiki warrior, mouth brimming with vibrant marbles. Dash through a top-down tiki hub—sprinkled with hidden treasure chests and level portals—to choose your next challenge.
Once you select a stage, position your warrior at the center of winding jungle paths and launch marbles to match three or more identical orbs. Trigger dazzling chain reactions, clear waves swiftly, and earn up to three stars by preventing any marble from slipping past the ruins’ thresholds.
Every ten levels, dash back into the hub world and venture deeper into one of four exotic island realms—Sunlit Beach Temples, Overgrown Canopy Ruins, Steamy Volcano Springs, and the Sacred Moonlit Lagoon—each with new marble colors, winding vine-carved paths, moving tribal barriers, and ever-quickening speeds.
No two expeditions are alike: discover secret shortcuts in the hub, unlock bonus mini-stages, and collect ancient tiki tokens that reveal the Lost Marble Island’s hidden lore. Addictive and richly themed, Zumba World – The Lost Marble Island invites you to master marble magic and become the ultimate tiki champion!

70010000099678.name: Zumba - Soccer Marble League
70010000099678.intro:
Get ready for kick-off in Zumba – Soccer Marble League!
Match and blast marbles before they reach the goal!
Unlock power plays and climb the league ladder!
70010000099678.description:
Zumba – Soccer Marble League kicks off a thrilling twist on marble shooters—packed with stadium lights, roaring crowds, and nonstop soccer action! Step into the cleats of your marble-blasting captain and stop the rush before the marbles hit the goal.
Select your match, aim with precision, and shoot to create chains of three or more matching marbles. Timing is key—don’t let the ball-line score! Master skill shots, combo explosions, and rapid clears to earn high scores and climb through the leagues.
Unlock powerful soccer-style power-ups like Power Shot, Time-Out, Formation Reset, Turbo Boost, and Precision Kick to control the pace and turn the match in your favor. Every ten levels unlocks a new stadium: from Rookie Fields and Urban Arenas to International Domes and the Finals of Fame—each with its own unique challenge.

70010000099681.name: The Order of the Snake Scale
70010000099681.intro: Death, secrets, and cosmic dread await
70010000099681.description:
Indie Retro Horror
Step into a chilling old-school horror game with handcrafted 3D models and classic puzzle mechanics.

Discover a surreal world inspired by Lovecraft
Explore a dystopian reality that closely mirrors current global events.
This universe represents one possible path humanity could follow. Every decision has consequences. In this world, power over humanity is wielded by Unions of States and Corporations.
The prohibition of religion, mass sterilization, property seizure, eugenics, and the subjugation of people under the NML Corporation, this is the new world order.
Are you ready to experience it?

A suspenseful story
Throughout the game, you’ll uncover the history of the Universe and the heroes who inhabit it.
With every step, you’ll explore a semi-open world, reveal its secrets, and receive clues to help you solve the case of Happy Rock.

First, SURVIVE!
A mysterious murder, terrifying monsters, unsafe rooms, and corpses everywhere.
It’s easy to die in this world... especially when you least expect it.
Manage your inventory, collect clues, fight, make critical decisions and survive.

Explore and solve puzzles
Roam the atmospheric and unique corners of Happy Rock. Dive into the mystery of this place and its doomed world.
Solve logic-based puzzles, connect the dots to uncover the truth behind the murder, and prove your skills in arcade-style challenges.
A dark world is waiting to consume you maybe forever.

70010000099683.name: Glory to the Heroes
70010000099683.description:
Enter the fight. Earn your glory. Survive the war.

Step onto the battlefield where two rival forces clash in brutal, fast-paced firefights. In Glory to the Heroes, every bullet counts and every second tests your skill. Push forward under fire, eliminate threats, and complete critical objectives to lead your side to victory. It’s not just about survival—it’s about proving you have what it takes to be the last one standing.

Key Features:

- Upgrade System – Earn cash, unlock weapons, and enhance your combat power.

- Challenging Missions – Tackle diverse objectives with rising difficulty.

- Varied Terrain – Navigate realistic environments that affect strategy.

- Tactical Action – Choose the right weapons and approach for every situation.

Stand your ground, lead with courage, and carve your name into the battlefield. The fight awaits—will you answer the call?

70010000099688.name: Sudoku Mania
70010000099688.intro: Fill the grid with numbers 1–9 without repeating rows or columns. Compete in daily challenges and climb global leaderboards.
70010000099688.description:
Put your logic skills to the test in this classic number puzzle experience. Your objective is simple yet addictive: fill the grid with the numbers 1–9, making sure no number is repeated in any row or column. Each puzzle offers a fresh challenge, rewarding careful thought and smart planning.

Move around the grid, select empty cells, and choose the correct number to place. Play continues until the board is completely filled and the puzzle is solved.

If you find yourself stuck, an optional Hint system is available to help guide you in the right direction without giving away the entire solution.

Helpful Tools
The game includes several tools designed to make solving puzzles intuitive and enjoyable:

• Pencil Tool – Make pencil marks in a cell to jot down possible numbers and narrow your options. Pencil marks are not counted as final answers.
• Eraser Tool – Remove a number if you later realise it’s incorrect.
• Undo Function – Undo one or more moves at any time. The game timer will continue running, keeping the challenge intact.


Difficulty Settings
Choose from four difficulty levels to match your skill level:
• Easy
• Medium
• Hard
• Extreme

Beginner Mode allows unlimited mistakes, making it perfect for newcomers or relaxed play. In Normal Mode, only a limited number of errors are allowed—make too many, and it’s Game Over!

Daily Challenges
Take on the Daily Challenge and compete against players from around the world. Solve the same puzzle as everyone else and race to achieve the fastest completion time.

Progression
Each difficulty level contains a set number of puzzles. Complete them all to conquer that difficulty and prove your mastery.

Leaderboards
Track your performance and climb the rankings with global and friend leaderboards, based on both progression and completion times.

A perfect blend of relaxation and challenge, this number puzzle game is ideal for short sessions or long stretches of focused play—anytime, anywhere.

70010000099690.name: Maze: Path of Light
70010000099690.intro: Discover a universe of mazes in one mesmerizing game.
70010000099690.description:
Embark on a relaxing yet mind-bending journey through thousands of uniquely designed mazes. From classic square puzzles to complex circular, triangular, and even hexagonal labyrinths—experience a truly diverse and enchanting experience.

Choose your path through combinations of maze shapes, sizes, and game modes. Whether you're looking for a calming puzzle break or a strategic challenge, there's something here for every mood.

Features:
- Creative Level Design: Conquer 4 maze types—square, circular, triangular, and hexagonal
- 5 Unique Challenges: Classic, Portal, Token, Limited Moves, Timed and Dark Mazes!
- Power-ups: 3 helpful powers to help you find your way
- Satisfying puzzles: Enjoy a peaceful session with small mazes, or test your skills on advanced ones
- Unique Shapes: Explore mazes shaped like fish, guitars, trees, and more!
- Beautiful Design: Vivid colors and soothing music create a visually and emotionally engaging experience

Unlock constellations of puzzles, discover secret paths, and lose yourself in the ultimate maze adventure.

70010000099692.name: Knight Quest: Goblins Raid
70010000099692.intro: An epic adventure that will test your courage
70010000099692.description:
Put on your armor, grab your sword, and get ready to face what no sane knight would dare: noisy goblins, deadly traps, and platforms that seem to have a mind of their own. In Knight Quest, you are the hero the kingdom definitely needs – even if no one warned you how complicated this mission would be.

Explore dense forests, dark caves, and desperate situations, all in beautiful 2D settings full of action and danger. Jump, roll, fight, and scream internally as you try to survive sharp spikes, falling rocks, and goblins that look like they do crossfit.

Collect coins
Defeat goblins
Fall into traps (or not, if you're skilled)

Each level brings new challenges and nervous laughter. Ready to face it? Only the fastest, bravest, and most stubborn will be able to restore peace and return home as true heroes – or at least with all limbs intact.

70010000099697.name: CARD SHOP GAME STORE - TCG SIMULATOR
70010000099697.intro: Buy, sell, and become the leader in the TCG business empire !
70010000099697.description:
Welcome to CARD SHOP GAME STORE - TCG SIMULATOR, a unique trading card shop simulator where you can build a successful business by selling collectible cards! Buy rare packs, open boosters, negotiate with customers, and develop your store into a paradise for collectors and trading card game enthusiasts.
Key Features:
-Buying and selling cards – Find great deals, stock up on new inventory, and sell cards to customers while choosing your pricing strategy.
-Opening collectible packs – Experience the excitement of unboxing boosters filled with rare and valuable cards.
-Store management – Upgrade the interior, organize displays, and create a welcoming atmosphere to attract more customers.
-Financial strategy – Monitor price trends, determine the best times to buy and sell, and maximize your profits.
-Realistic gameplay – Open and close your store, handle transactions at the register, and work your way up to becoming the best card dealer in town.
Are you ready to build your own trading card empire? Open your shop’s doors and start your journey in the world of collectible cards today!

70010000099702.name: Dungeons of Paint
70010000099702.intro: Can you color the entire world with a gun?
70010000099702.description:
Dungeons Of Paint is a classic top-down shooter inspired by paintball.

Explore dark dungeons, blast baddies, and leave a trail of colorful paint in your artistic path of destruction. Grab different guns, and take down waves of enemies with ricochets of bouncy paint projectiles.

Featuring 5 different dungeons, and 20 different challenges, Dungeons Of Paint is a radiant paintball action-adventure! 


Features
* Top-down shooter gameplay
* 20 challenges to beat
* 5 different dungeons
* Colorful paintball pixel art
* Relaxing electronic music

70010000099712.name: Hit! Spin! Watermelon Party
70010000099712.intro:
Hit! Whack! Bam! It's watermelon-smashing time!
Play solo or with friends! Watermelon fun for everyone!
70010000099712.description:
Get ready for a watermelon-themed party game where the controls are simple and easy to learn!
Share Joy-Con™ and up to 6 players can join in the fun!
Have a party with friends and family, or play each game by yourself!

[Free Mode]
Pick a game and play! Practice solo, or battle against your friends!

[Party Mode]
Play a series of games and compete for the title of champion! Win or lose, you're sure to have a blast!

[Online Mode]
Watermelon-battle with players from around the world!
Hop into a Quick Match for some speedy multiplayer fun!

70010000099719.name: Ash Pines: The Motel
70010000099719.intro: Something is watching you, can you escape?
70010000099719.description:
Welcome to Ash Pines – a peaceful vacation spot nestled deep among whispering pine trees… or so it seems.

What begins as an ordinary night soon unravels into a terrifying mystery beyond imagination. Stranded at the eerie Ash Pines Motel, you’ll explore abandoned rooms, uncover cryptic clues, and slowly piece together the haunting secrets buried within the motel’s forgotten past.

But beware…
You’re not alone...
Something is watching.

It could appear anytime… anywhere.
Will you be ready when it does?


Features:
* Atmospheric exploration through the haunting Ash Pines Motel
* Unravel a dark, slow-burning mystery
* Discover clues and hidden secrets
* Stay alert—danger could be lurking just out of sight
* A chilling experience perfect for horror fans

70010000099724.name: Solitaire Dreamscapes
70010000099724.intro: Drift away into a world of cards and dreams.
70010000099724.description:
It's time to escape reality with a magical game of Solitaire! 
Travel through surreal landscapes and explore more than 200 levels, 
restoring 5 breathtaking dreamlike locations! 

Choose from 4 different game modes: Normal, Hard, Relaxed, and Timed. 
Activate 120 brand new Supersize and Challenge levels for a unique gameplay experience. 
Unlock 18 Solitaire variants including classics like Klondike, and new favorites such as Siegecraft or Lady Maria. 
Dozens of gameplay variations enrich the classic Solitaire formula – including obstacles, power-ups, frozen cards, locks, ribbons, seals, bonus cards, and more! 

Search every last level for gems and coins to unlock upgrades for each dream scene, and aim for the elusive “Perfect” rating. 
Complete quests to release beautiful butterflies and birds that bring each world to life. 
Immerse yourself in Solitaire Dreamscapes – where fantasy and Solitaire meet.

Features:
- 200 Solitaire levels!
- 120 brand new supersize and challenge levels.
- Play 4 different game modes, Normal, Hard, Relaxed, and Timed.
- 6 classical Solitaire games such as Klondike, Spider, or Freecell.
- 12 additional Solitaire variants
- 60 replayable bonus Mahjong levels!
- Restore 5 breathtaking dream realms!
- Solve 12 quests.

70010000099737.name: Tralalero Tralala Simulator
70010000099737.intro: Run wild. Destroy freely. Fear nothing.
70010000099737.description:
Become the ultimate predator in Tralalero Tralala Simulator! Free your inner shark and dive into a city bursting with destruction, adventure, and utter madness. Unleash your super abilities and tear through the urban jungle with unparalleled power. Your shark form knows no boundaries—run through the streets, abduct characters, and create chaos everywhere you go.

In this massive metropolis, nothing is safe. Use your unique abilities to tail-slap, jump over obstacles, unleash powerful attacks, and destroy anything in your path. But be warned—the city won’t give up without a fight. Face off against tough NPCs, battle wild bosses, and prove you’re the top predator capable of bringing the world to its knees.

Key Features:
	•	Unleash Super Shark Powers: Run, jump, tail-whip, and destroy everything in your way with your unstoppable shark abilities.
	•	Massive City Destruction: Create total chaos in a sprawling, destructible city. No building is safe.
	•	Epic Boss Fights & Crazy NPCs: Encounter wild characters with unique powers and crazy personalities, each with their own challenges.
	•	Action-Packed Chaos: From supercharged attacks to bizarre power-ups, experience heart-pounding action as you fight for dominance.
	•	Complete Freedom: Run rampant through streets, parks, and skyscrapers, making every corner your hunting ground.

Are you ready to prove you’re the ultimate predator?
Step into Tralalero Tralala Simulator, where chaos reigns and you’re the one causing it. Turn the city into your playground!

70010000099742.name: LumenTale: Memories of Trey
70010000099742.intro: Join Trey on an adventure to regain his lost memories and uncover the lost secrets in the land of Talea!
70010000099742.description:
Embark on an unforgettable adventure with LumenTale: Memories of Trey, a captivating Monster Collector RPG set in a beautiful and enchanting world. 
Discover an emotional tale of self-discovery, adventure through captivating regions each as unique as their people. Join Trey as he navigates his way through a land full of mystical creatures to reveal the mystery behind his lost memories.

STORY
Long ago, in the golden era of Talea, the Emperor kept the lands peaceful, and the people prospered. After passing away without naming a successor between his twin sons, a civil war raged between the North, Logos and the South, Mythos - fighting for who would take control of the throne. The townsfolk lived in fear from the atrocities being carried out in the conflict. In a bid to stop the destruction, a part of the empire’s military became Talea’s dedicated protectors. 
From the everlasting darkness of war, these people were the beacon of light that brought people hope. The Lumen were born, and as guardians in their provinces, they ensure the safety of the residents of Talea, both the people and the Animon. 

Since ancient times, people have long studied the Animon. Not much is known of their nature to this day. They’re made of Anivis, an energy that flows through the whole world, and they possess the ability to affect emotions and interact with the very soul of every living being. Catch the Animon and become inseparable partners as you harness their elemental powers and battle alongside each other with your Holoken.

Catching Animon
Test your skills with the Holoken and catch Animon in the field to recruit them to your party or initiate an incredible and exciting battle against them to prove your mettle! Every Animon can perform their own abilities and skills, and victory is achieved through using the best strategy with your team. There are around 140 known species with 13 elemental types, which are categorized with attributes depending on the emotion they're able to evoke in people. 

Battles
Engage in thrilling 1v1 duels or team up for epic 4v4 showdowns with your party in battle. Level up your Animons and outsmart your opponents by using the best strategy to win.  Each Animon has strengths and weaknesses for you to uncover, so use them to your advantage. 

Trading 
With up to 3 different ways to trade your Animon, you can effortlessly  complete your collection and build the perfect battle team. Connect to the Animon Trade Station to seek the Animon you need, trade directly with friends, or the community. 

Cook and craft
While on your adventure, be sure to take a rest at the Fountain, where you’ll be able to craft useful items and cook delicious food! If you’re feeling adventurous, you’ll be able to experiment with ingredients to help nurture your Animon. 

The Anispace 
The Anispace is a place that exists and doesn’t exist at the same time. A space detached from the world as we know it. Here is where you’ll find your Animon after you capture them and where you’ll be able to train your Animon for battle. Customise their space when they’re not in your battle party and create stronger bonds with them!

70010000099744.name: Cyber Car Seller Simulator
70010000099744.intro: Outsmart dealers and dominate the cyber market.
70010000099744.description:
Cyber Car Seller Simulator – Enter the Future of Automotive Trade!In a neon-lit world where technology reigns, uncover hidden gems in the cyber car market and build a thriving dealership. Scout futuristic vehicles, negotiate the best deals, enhance them with cutting-edge modifications, and sell them for a massive profit. Will you become the ultimate cyber car mogul, or will the digital underworld outmaneuver you?

Key Features:
	•	Buy, Modify & Sell – Hunt for undervalued cyber cars, upgrade them with high-tech features, and turn them into premium rides.
	•	Advanced Repairs & Enhancements – Restore, repaint, and install next-gen modifications, from AI-assisted autopilots to neon underglows.
	•	Cyberpunk-Inspired World – Immerse yourself in a neon-drenched city where technology, crime, and commerce collide.
	•	Build Your Dealership – Expand your showroom, hire expert mechanics, and craft the ultimate car-selling empire.

The future of cyber car commerce is in your hands. Will you conquer the market or get lost in the neon haze?

70010000099749.name: Zumba - Marble Candy Rush
70010000099749.intro: Indulge your sweet tooth—match, blast, and reign in the candy rush!
70010000099749.description:
Zumba – Marble Candy Rush invites you into a delectable marble-shooter kingdom ruled by the Candy King! Select a level, aim your candy-cannon mouth, and fire to match three or more identical candy marbles before they spill past the sugar gate. Create explosive combos, clear waves swiftly, and earn up to three stars per level.
Spend your sweet coins between levels to unlock delicious upgrades: Sweet Storm sweeps away clusters, Time Freeze pauses advancing candies, Color Swap turns your next marble into any flavor, Sugar Shower rains down perfect matches, Single Scoop removes one stubborn candy, and Time Revert undoes your last shot for a second chance.
Explore four mouthwatering dessert realms—Gummy Grove, Chocolate Fountain Falls, Lollipop Gardens, and the Sugar Palace Keep—each unlocked every ten levels with new candy colors, winding paths, moving obstacles, and faster speeds.
Addictive and family-friendly, Zumba – Marble Candy Rush delivers endless sweet arcade fun for players of all ages.

70010000099752.name: Zumba - Marble Zombie Invasion
70010000099752.intro: Chomp and blast marbles in a cute zombie invasion!
70010000099752.description:
Zumba – Zombie Marble Invasion plunges you into a charmingly creepy marble-shooter world! Play as a cute zombie captain, mouth brimming with marbles, and fend off endless rolling waves before they breach your defenses. Aim your chomping cannon, fire to match three or more identical marbles, and watch them shatter into ghoulish confetti.
Race against the tide—clear the path quickly to earn up to three stars per level. Between hordes, spend your collected coins on powerful undead upgrades: Explosive Marbles (detonate clusters), Brain Freeze (stop marbles in their tracks), Repaint (change the next marble’s color), Slow Motion (dial back the speed), Destruction Shots (zap single rogue marbles), and Time Revert (undo your last bite).
Explore four zombie-themed worlds every ten levels: eerie Graveyard Gardens, haunted Manor Halls, shadowy Crypt Caverns, and bone-chilling Catacomb Chambers—each with unique paths, new marble colors, tricky obstacles, and faster waves.
Cute, spooky, and endlessly addictive—can you survive the Zombie Marble Invasion and become the ultimate undead marble-master?

70010000099755.name: Zumba - Marble Jungle Adventure
70010000099755.intro: Awaken the jungle spirits—match, blast, and conquer the marble wilds!
70010000099755.description:
This game whisks you deep into a verdant, mystical jungle, where you—an enigmatic masked tiki god—must defend sacred temples from rolling marble invaders. Select a level, aim your marble-loaded staff, and fire to link three or more matching orbs before they breach the temple gates. Trigger dazzling chain reactions, clear each wave with precision, and earn up to three stars per stage by keeping the marbles at bay.

Between stages, call upon powerful tiki blessings: Explosive Marbles to obliterate entire clusters, Time Freeze to halt marbles in their tracks, Repaint to transform your next marble into any desired color, Slow Motion to decelerate the onslaught, Destruction Shots to zap a lone rogue marble, and Time Revert to undo your last throw for a second chance.

Every ten levels, journey through four lush jungle realms—Emerald Canopy Ruins, Whispering Vines Gorge, Moonlit Waterfall Shrine, and the Lost Temple Apex—each introducing new marble hues, winding vine-carved paths, moving tribal barriers, and ever-increasing speeds.

Addictive and richly themed, this game combines classic marble-shooter thrills with vibrant tribal magic and exotic environments.

70010000099758.name: Zumba - Jurassic Marble Quest
70010000099758.intro: Roar, match, and blast through prehistoric marble mayhem!
70010000099758.description:
Zumba – Jurassic Marble Quest blasts you back to the age of dinosaurs! Play as an adventurous baby dino equipped with a marble-firing snout. Select your stage, aim down a winding stone path, and launch colorful marbles to create chains of three or more before they tumble off the cliff. Trigger spectacular combos, clear each wave swiftly, and claim up to three stars by keeping the marbles at bay.
Between levels, call upon prehistoric power-ups: Explosive Marbles to blow away clusters, Time Freeze to halt advancing marbles, Repaint to change your next marble’s hue, Slow Motion to decelerate the line, Destruction Shots to remove a single stray marble, and Time Revert to undo a misfire for a second chance.
Every ten levels, you stomp into a new Jurassic realm—lush Fern Forest Valleys, sizzling Volcanic Badlands, misty Swamp Marshes, and glittering Crystal Caves—each introducing fresh marble colors, winding paths, moving obstacles, and ever-increasing speeds.
Addictive and family-friendly, Zumba – Jurassic Marble Quest combines classic marble-shooter thrills with adorable dinos and prehistoric charm.

70010000099761.name: Zumba – Treasures of Marble Island
70010000099761.intro: Invoke the tiki spirits—match, blast, and unearth marble island treasures!
70010000099761.description:
Zumba – Treasures of Marble Island transports you to a lush tiki paradise ruled by an enigmatic masked god. Select a level, aim your marble-shooting staff, and fire to match three or more identical orbs before they snake past the sacred ruins. Trigger spectacular chain reactions, clear waves swiftly, and earn up to three stars per stage by preventing any marble from breaching the ancient thresholds.
Harness powerful island blessings between levels: Explosive Marbles to obliterate clusters, Time Freeze to halt the rolling tide, Repaint to transform your next marble into any spirit color, Slow Motion to decelerate the onslaught, Destruction Shots to remove lone rogue marbles, and Time Revert to undo your last throw for a second chance.
Journey through four exotic realms—Sun-Kissed Beaches, Jungle Ruins, Volcanic Lava Fields, and the Hidden Temple Sanctum—each unlocked every ten levels with new marble hues, winding vine paths, moving tribal barriers, and ever-quickening speeds.
Addictive and vibrant, Zumba – Treasures of Marble Island invites you to master the tiki arts, unleash island magic, and claim legendary treasures from the heart of the marble isles.

70010000099764.name: Zumba - Galactic Marble Blast
70010000099764.intro: Leap across the cosmos—match, blast, and save the galaxy in marble style!
70010000099764.description:
Zumba – Galactic Marble Blast propels you into a vibrant sci-fi universe where you, a brave spacefrog, must fend off waves of rolling marbles—and occasionally rogue planets—before they vanish into the void. Select a star system, position your frog-powered cannon at the screen’s center, and launch colorful marbles or planets along winding orbital paths. Match three or more identical spheres to trigger spectacular explosions, pause the advance, and rack up combos for massive scores.
Earn up to three stars on each level by clearing all spheres before they cross the event horizon. Every ten levels, you warp into a new galaxy with unique challenges: the glowing Nebula Gardens, the rocky Asteroid Belts, the swirling Quantum Vortex, and the perilous Black Hole Citadel. Each galaxy introduces new marble colors, curved gravitational paths, floating obstacles, and ever-increasing speeds—keeping the cosmic challenge fresh and exhilarating.

70010000099767.name: Zumba World - The Crazy Marble Dimension
70010000099767.intro: Enter Zumba World – The Crazy Marble Dimension! Dash through Soccer, Candy, Space & Dino realms, blasting marbles before they reach the goal!
70010000099767.description:
Zumba World – The Crazy Marble Dimension marries classic marble-shooter thrills with an explorable hub world! Dash your marble-loaded avatar across a vibrant central plaza dotted with portals to four zany realms:
•	Soccer Stadium Fields – Defend the goal-line against rolling soccer marbles.
•	Candy Kingdom – Halt candy spheres before they flood the sugar gate.
•	Galactic Orbit – Stop cosmic marbles and rogue planets from drifting into the void.
•	Jurassic Ridge – Prevent prehistoric marbles from tumbling off the volcanic cliff.
Select any level portal, then position yourself at the center of winding paths and launch marbles to match three or more identical orbs. Trigger spectacular combos, clear each wave before it crosses your boundary, and earn up to three stars per stage.
Every ten cleared levels, dash back to the hub and advance into the next area. Discover hidden shortcuts, unlock bonus challenges, and collect special tokens that reveal the Crazy Marble Dimension’s secrets. With each realm offering unique marble colors, path shapes, moving obstacles, and escalating speeds, no two expeditions are the same!
Addictive, family-friendly, and endlessly replayable, Zumba World – The Crazy Marble Dimension challenges you to master marble magic across four wildly different themes.

70010000099770.name: Zumba World - The Marble Monster Adventure
70010000099770.intro: Match, blast, and survive marble mayhem!
70010000099770.description:
Zumba World – The Monster Marble Adventure fuses classic marble-shooter action with an explorable hub world! You play as a fearless dinosaur hero carrying colorful marbles in your snout. Dash across a central plaza strewn with glowing portals to four monstrous realms:
•	Halloween Haunt – Match eerie ghost-marbles before they vanish through spectral gates.
•	Jurassic Ridge – Stop prehistoric marbles tumbling off volcanic cliffs.
•	Dragon’s Keep – Halt fiery dragon-scaled marbles before they scorch your lair.
•	Zombie Crypt – Prevent undead marbles from escaping the graveyard walls.
Select any portal, then take your place at the center of winding thematic paths. Launch marbles to match three or more identical orbs, trigger spectacular chain reactions, and clear each wave before it crosses your boundary to earn up to three stars per level.
Every ten levels, dash back to the hub world and venture into the next realm. Discover hidden shortcuts, unlock bonus mini-challenges, and collect special relics that reveal the Monster Marble Adventure’s secrets. Each realm introduces unique marble colors, path shapes, moving obstacles, and accelerating speeds—keeping the marble mayhem fresh and exhilarating!
Addictive and family-friendly, Zumba World – The Monster Marble Adventure challenges you to master marble matching across four thrilling monster worlds.

70010000099783.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Anyang-si
70010000099783.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Anyang-si, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 2 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000099788.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Tomb of Prince Imyeong
70010000099788.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game.

Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000099793.description:

70010000099798.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Ongnam Lake Park, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 2 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000099803.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Paldang Water Fog Park
70010000099803.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Paldang Water Fog Park, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 2 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000099808.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Deulkkoch Arboretum
70010000099808.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Deulkkoch Arboretum, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 2 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000099823.name: Machine Gun Fury
70010000099823.intro: Dive into a bold arcade-inspired shooter with explosive 2D action!
70010000099823.description:
When tyranny takes control… someone has to pull the trigger. Machine Gun Fury is a bold revival of the classic arcade military shooter — no cover systems, no moral debates, just pure reflex-driven carnage. It’s you, your trigger finger, and a limited supply of grenades against entire armies. If you grew up blasting through classic arcade games, welcome back to the frontline, soldier.

Blast your way through enemy armies with nothing but sharp reflexes, heavy firepower, and a limited supply of grenades. Liberate 8 explosive regions packed with screen-filling bosses, relentless waves of enemies, and high-intensity run-and-gun action. 

Step into the boots of three unstoppable soldiers armed to the teeth and ready to bring tyranny to its knees:

- Gunner Jimbo – A walking assault division. Built for suppressive fire and zero compromise. If he stops shooting, something big is about to explode.
- Suzi Uzi – Fast, tactical, and merciless. She doesn’t waste bullets. She doesn’t miss. She doesn’t stop moving.
- Mini-Gun Floyd – The embodiment of sustained fire. When those barrels spin up, the battlefield becomes a memory.

Three warriors. One impossible mission. Infinite enemies.

Fight on foot or take control of heavily armed vehicles including tanks, boats, and combat buggies. Unleash a full arsenal of military-grade weaponry and trigger explosive chain reactions that turn enemy strongholds into rubble. If it moves — eliminate it.

- Fast-paced top-down and side-scrolling run-and-gun gameplay
- Full range of combat weaponry delivering large-scale destruction and huge body counts
- Authentic 8-bit pixel art powered by modern enhancements
- Destructible elements, screen shake, particle effects, and layered parallax backgrounds
- Explosive SID-inspired soundtrack that hits like an arcade cabinet turned up to max

Press Start. Pull the trigger. Feel the Fury.

70010000099830.name: Dungeon Minesweeper
70010000099830.intro: Minesweeper puzzle with RPG elements, magic combat, quests, and pixel art in mysterious dungeons.
70010000099830.description:
A mystical adventure in the depths of dungeons awaits you!
An engaging puzzle based on classic Minesweeper, enhanced with RPG elements in stylish pixel art graphics.
The game offers captivating gameplay where numerical clues on dungeon floors help you navigate safely and avoid deadly traps. Tactical combat allows you to engage enemies with magic and weapons or choose strategic retreat depending on the situation.
Compelling quests lead you through mission completion to uncover the secrets of dark depths. Two game modes provide a choice between story campaign and free play mode.
You'll face tests of wit, survival in dangerous dungeons, and discovery of secrets hidden in the darkness!

70010000099838.name: Heroic Songs: the Remix!
70010000099838.intro:
Build a Sanctuary for Idols Across Fantasy Worlds!
A City-Building × Idol Simulation Game
70010000099838.description:
■■ About the Game ■■

Heroic Songs: the Remix! is an Idol × City-Building Simulation Game where you help develop a land known as the Void while guiding the main heroine, Akari Sunohara, on her journey to become an idol. Build roads and facilities, attract new residents, and transform this desolate world into a vibrant Fanctuary worthy of the spotlight!

● A Diverse Lineup of Buildings
With over 50 unique buildings, you'll have plenty of ways to shape your city!
- Basic Facilities such as houses to attract Fans, and roads to connect your buildings
- Production Facilities, placed around resource tiles and visited by Fans to gather materials
- Processing Facilities, which convert one type of resource into another as a result of Fan visits
- Recreational Facilities, where resources are spent to generate Likes, a key progression resource
You can also earn Likes through Tours, or the rhythm-based Concerts described below.

● Idol Stages
