By constructing personal stages, idols will perform for their Fans by singing and dancing in town! Idols with stages become available for Concerts and Tours, and will boost the surrounding buildings whenever they’re present. 

As idols gain experience from performances, their levels rise—enhancing those building effects even further! You can also assign skill points to customize how their influence spreads across your city. ;)

● Concerts
Concerts are short, 30-second rhythm games. Keep in time with the music to hit the target score and clear the stage! Successful Concerts will unlock new story content, boost idol and Fan experiences, and provide rewards. Some idols will also unlock alternate stage outfits as you progress through the game.

● A Wild Yet Heartfelt Story Unfolds!
Progress through successful concerts, construction projects, and city development to unlock new chapters in the story.
Follow Akari Sunohara—an ordinary girl with a love for idols—as she discovers her true calling. Dive deeper into each of the five main heroines in dedicated Character Stories, and experience each idol’s unique charm!

■ Characters ■
● Protagonist (You)
You’re the one who was transported to the Void alongside Akari. As the central figure in this world, your role is to support Akari and the other idols on their journey.

● Akari Sunohara / voiced by: Seika Hirose
An ordinary girl with an extraordinary love for idols. She possesses the innate potential to become one herself, and must step into the spotlight to find a way home.
At first, she struggles with doubt and frustration, but grows through her encounters with veteran idols and her fans in the fantasy worlds.

● Ruri Tsukuyomi / voiced by: Risae Matsuda
The Ultimate Idol, reigning at the top with an overwhelming presence and voice. Her legacy echoes throughout the various fantasy worlds Akari explores.

● Lynalelle Singulant / voiced by: Hitomi Sekine
The idol of Seven Falls, a fantasy-themed world. She’s a king, an idol, and a passionate idol superfan all in one!

● Haru / voiced by Yuka Amemiya
The idol of Discordia, a sci-fi-themed world. She’s a trusted senior to Akari, but seems to be hiding some complicated circumstances.

● Kaguya / voiced by Risae Matsuda
The idol of Karan Ashihara, a world with a traditional Japanese aesthetic. As the wild and fearsome Behemoth of Befoulment, she stands in Akari’s path as a powerful rival.

70010000099843.name: Noah's Dilemma
70010000099843.description:
Noah's Dilemma is a crew-building strategy roguelike set in a reinvented mythology of Noah's Ark inspired by Magical Realism, featuring unique placement-centric gameplay inspired by sudoku and autochess.

■ Playtime
A successful run typically takes around 2 to 5 hours to complete, with 5 to 10 attempts expected before beating the game for the first time.

■ Build Your Animal Crew
Embark on a journey to gather animals who will also serve as your sailors. Harness their abilities, ignite synergies, and turn your ark into a swift vessel.

■ Explore Wild Islands
Sail through a procedurally generated map, venturing to untamed islands filled with hidden treasures, hot springs, altars, villages, and more.

■ Battle the Coral-Born
The Coral-Born are hostile creatures that emerged after the Great Flood. Command your animal crew to defend the ark from their relentless assaults.

■ Conquer the Four Seas
Each of the Four Seas is ruled by a formidable boss. Defeat them all, bring every animal onboard to the promised land, and claim your title as the conqueror of the Four Seas.

■ More Challenges Await
After victory, unlock 2 new playable characters, face 6 tougher quests, and activate a 10-level challenge mode designed for veteran players.

■ Play First, Lore Later
Noah’s Dilemma emphasizes gameplay first, presenting its story in a minimalist style. Still, every element in the game is carefully crafted to fit into a rich, coherent world, leaving room for lore-seekers to uncover its deeper mysteries.

■ Features
- Four sea areas to conquer, each with its own traits and governing boss.
- Three playable characters, each with their own strengths and weaknesses.
- 50+ creatures, ranging from familiar mammals to deep-sea inhabitants.
- 50+ encounters and events randomly woven into your adventure.
- 50+ animal natures and abnormalities to trigger risks and thrills.
- 50+ animal effects with abundant variations and synergies.
- 150+ items and relics designed for strategic play.
- 1 core mission, 6 extra quests and a 10-level challenge mode.
- A fresh and engaging 10-hour experience for all players, with many more hours for those looking to complete the game and master every detail.

70010000099848.name: The Nameless: Slay Dragon
70010000099848.intro:
The Nameless: Slay Dragon is like a mix of CRPG and JRPG.
In short - how to slay the immensely powerful and cunning evil dragon?
70010000099848.description:
Exploration is as important as combat. 
Observe, listen, think, communicate, act, you need to use all possible skills to find your own path. Adventures are not only full of choices, but often require a bit of luck.

Classic turn-based + meaningful choices. 
Every action you take is meaningful, including knocking down enemies and using skills that will enhance your talents and allow you to learn new skills faster.

Free progression system. 
There are more than twenty classes with different mechanisms in the game, and the classescan co-exist. You can mix and match skills and traits to create unexpected chemical reactions.

Abundant skill customization. 
Sparks of inspiration can be obtained while fighting, exploring, cooking, even dreaming. Infuse the spark into a skill and eventually make it your own, creating a unique skill and renaming it.

Rich craft system. 
You can simple raw materials to build anything you want. Whether it's a precious potion, a great invention, legendary equipment or overnight leftovers.

Real choices and multiple endings. 
Choices are very important in the game, some may have less impact and some may change the entire story.

Optional challenges to face. 
The game is full of overpowered enemies who don't care if you're still a newbie, they only care about one thing - crushing you. But you can always find a way to evade or defeat them.

Well-designed characters. 
Each character has a past behind him or her that he or she doesn't want to talk about, and you can learn about their past, get close to them or break with them in the game.

Respect your time. 
No random battle, no forced grinding, no endless maze,  all ending available in the first run.

70010000099853.name: 3 Card Poker
70010000099853.description:
Step into the exciting world of high-stakes poker with 3 Card Poker, a thrilling single-player card game experience, exclusively on Nintendo Switch! Enjoy the fast-paced action of one of the most popular casino games, now beautifully reimagined with brilliant graphics and immersive sound design.

Test your luck and strategy against the dealer in this classic poker variant. Whether you're a poker pro or just learning the ropes, touch-screen controls and smooth gameplay make it easy to jump in and enjoy.

Key Features:

Stunning visuals and lifelike casino atmosphere

Authentic sound effects for a fully immersive experience

Play with virtual currency — no real money or in-app purchases required

Perfect for quick sessions or long play sessions alike


Deal yourself into the action—3 Card Poker is your ticket to poker fun anytime you want, with no strings attached!

70010000099868.name: EGGCONSOLE ARAMO MSX
70010000099868.intro: Escape from a planet of a perished ultra-advanced civilization. A survival action RPG unfolds on a quarter-view planet!
70010000099868.description:
This is an action RPG released in Japan by Zainsoft in 1986. The player is a lone man who has crash-landed on a planet and explore this world of a long-dead ultra-advanced civilization, seeking a way to escape.

The game uses a quarter-view perspective with block-built terrain, creating a fairly vast world. Its block-based design can make many areas look similar, so you might get lost. Mapping your surroundings, checking landmarks and item locations during exploration is recommended. In dungeons, the perspective switches to top-down for better visibility, but they feature complex mazes and turret attacks, offering a fairly challenging adventure.

Combat uses the familiar body-check mechanic of action RPGs. Firearms can be used with a key. Defeating enemies fills your experience gauge, and if it’s full, you level up. This intuitive gameplay makes for an accessible system. The vertical gauge represents HP—if it runs out, it’s game over (but resting on the surface restores health, so watch it closely).

In this game, you explore a planet built of cubes. What secrets lie deep within this world of a long-lost ultra-advanced.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000099876.name: Supermarket CEO Simulator
70010000099876.description:
Supermarket CEO Simulator – Build your retail empire and become the market leader!
Take charge of your own business and turn a small store into a thriving supermarket chain! 

In Supermarket CEO Simulator, you have full control over every aspect of supermarket management – from stocking shelves and hiring staff to marketing and expanding your business. The competition is fierce, and customers have high expectations – do you have what it takes to become a retail mogul?

Key Features:
-Strategy and profit battles – Adjust prices based on supply and demand, offer attractive discounts, and launch promotions to boost sales. Every decision matters – will you go for low prices and high volume, or focus on premium products?
-Hire and manage your team – Recruit staff for every department, from cashiers and shelf stockers to store managers. Offer competitive salaries, motivate your team, and ensure top-notch service to keep customers satisfied.
-Expansion and smart investments – Grow your business into new cities, invest in technology, and enhance the customer experience. Upgrade equipment, optimize sales processes, and build a trusted brand.

Do you have the courage to build a supermarket empire and become the most powerful CEO in the industry? In Supermarket CEO Simulator, success is in your hands!

70010000099881.name: Cat Needs
70010000099881.intro: The perfect game for cat lovers everywhere!
70010000099881.description:
Cats are beautiful creatures, but they can certainly be fickle and temperamental as well.

Your mission in Cat Needs is to organize all the cats so that each animal has its wants fulfilled, whether it be food, sleep, or something more. Rearrange the order of the cats, and avoid cat fights to keep each pet purring and contented.

Get ready for 50 levels of increasing challenge along with an increasing array of unique and wonderful cats!


Features:
* Cat-themed puzzle game
* Many adorable cats to attend
* Gradually increasing difficulty

70010000099894.name: A Bibelot: Y-Break
70010000099894.description:
No joke this time, I'll describe the game for what it is:
- 10 levels, 3 difficulties, playable in 2 players Coop!
- A Versus mode, against your enemy or friend, or against ???
- Unlock skins and musics as you play the game (that's why there's only one new music this time)
- 247

70010000099899.name: Shopkeeper Simulator
70010000099899.description:
Take on the role of a manager in the most addictive simulation game - open the doors to your supermarket and build it from scratch, transforming a small shop into the ultimate supermarket! Become a great manager and make your store outstanding.

Manage your own supermarket!
Expand your store, make it bigger and provide the best possible service. Create promotions and set competitive prices so that the goods sell quickly. Handle cash and card payments. Have fun and don't go broke. Achieve real success.

Expand your product range
Unlock new products, activities and services that will satisfy even the most demanding customers.

Customise your supermarket
Prepare your store appropriately for your goods - choose from racks, cabinets, refrigerators or freezers.

Shopkeeper Simulator is not just a game - it is a challenge that will test your management and strategy skills. Try it today and show how a real supermarket is run!

70010000099901.name: Deadliest Deep Sea Catch Fishing Simulator
70010000099901.intro: Gear up and survive the deadliest fishing grounds.
70010000099901.description:
Step into the world of commercial deep-sea fishing in Deadliest Deep Sea Catch Fishing Simulator. Buy your crab or lobster fishing license, prepare your boat with bait, traps, and fuel, then set sail to the open sea. Choose your fishing spot, deploy traps, and bring back a lucrative catch to sell.

Features:
• Purchase required fishing licenses for crabs and lobsters.
• Upgrade your boat’s performance technically to improve efficiency.
• Explore the marketplace to buy boats with different cargo capacities and stats.
• Strategically select your spawn point on the sea map before each trip.
• Manage resources: fuel, bait, traps, and licenses must be bought before each outing.
• Set traps from your boat, catch crustaceans, and sell your haul to earn money.

Master the art of deep-sea crustacean fishing, optimize your gear and boat, and build a thriving business on the open waters. Can you become the ultimate deep-sea fishing legend?

70010000099906.name: Finding America: New England Collector's Edition
70010000099906.intro: Explore scenic landscapes and rich history of this iconic region.
70010000099906.description:
Unearth the wonders of New England in a game that combines history, adventure, and hidden object challenges. 
'Finding America: New England' takes you on an unforgettable journey. 
Seek out hidden objects amidst stunning scenery and unlock the stories of America's colonial past.

Along your journey, you'll encounter fascinating trivia about the iconic locations, play fun mini-games, and see the beauty of the New England.

- Behold the sights of New England, all done in a Hidden Object style.
- Play over 30 fun minigames, all connected to the Great Lakes area!
- Pick up fun facts about the region!
- Collector's Edition contains 12 more chapters and 6 exclusive Hidden Object scenes!

70010000099910.name: Laysara: Summit Kingdom
70010000099910.intro: Build and expand your very own settlements in high mountains!
70010000099910.description:
Laysara: Summit Kingdom is a challenging city builder which tasks you with creating a new home for your people forced out of the lowlands. During a campaign or sandbox playthrough, you will establish multiple towns, each on a unique mountain with its own traits. All your towns co-exist in symbiosis, creating a trading network, which you can then adjust to your needs by revisiting already developed settlements. The Kingdom of Laysara has to be rebuilt!

BUILD ON A MOUNTAIN
Each mountain comes with a new set of challenges. Mounts differ in shapes, vegetation zone layouts, resource availability and weather conditions. Sometimes you will have plenty of room for farming in green lowlands, sometimes you will need to rely on breeding and extracting valuable minerals from regions dangerously close to peak glaciers. If you find yourself in dire need of a certain resource, you can always try to establish a trading route with another town.

DEAL WITH AVALANCHES
One of the ever-present dangers you will have to deal with are mighty avalanches. You can’t stop them, but you can take precautions and be prepared. Afforest the key areas to create natural barriers, build artificial ones to redirect rushing masses of snow, or trigger the avalanche early, while it’s still manageable. Create a deliberate and reliable strategy and you might even be able to use the power of snow to your advantage; fail to do so and find your city buried and devastated!

CRAFT A TRANSPORT NETWORK
So, transporting goods is easy, right? Well, not if your destination lies on the other side of the mountain, a few hundred meters higher, behind cliffs, ridges, canyons and rivers. You will need to create a vast, complex transport network consisting of roads, bridges and shafts to ensure reliable delivery chains. As demand for resources will grow alongside the town’s population, always look for opportunities to optimise your transportation network, be it by building paved roads, using more advanced lifting constructions, or aiding your carriers with glamorous yaks.

RAISE A SUMMIT TEMPLE
If you manage to endure all mountain dangers, build a network of efficient production chains and satisfy all needs of your people, there is only one more thing to be done: conquering the mountain peak! To succeed in this great endeavour you’ll need to reach the summit and establish safe routes for your carriers to bring in enormous amounts of building resources, but beware! Weather at this height is as deadly as ever. The final effect is well worth the effort though, as raising the summit temple is an act of total triumph of human courage (and your logistics skills!) over the elements.

Final note: the game is a pure city building experience solely focused on the economy, resource management and surviving despite the inhospitable environment. Therefore, the game doesn’t feature combat or any other military aspects.

70010000099925.name: Hashiriya Drifter-Car Racing,Drift,Drag REMASTER
70010000099925.intro: Unleash the ultimate drift legacy on the streets.
70010000099925.description:
Step into the remastered world of Japanese car culture from the late ’80s and ’90s! This edition delivers a fully enhanced experience for fans of speed, drifting, and intense racing action.

Enjoy:
- Upgraded graphics and performance for an authentic street racing vibe.
- Spectacular drifting and thrilling drag races, where every second matters.
- Over 100 tuning parts for each car, letting you build and customize your ride exactly how you want.
- Dozens of challenging levels and tracks, each designed to push your drifting skills to the limit.

Hashiriya Drifter-Car Racing,Drift,Drag REMASTER is the ultimate game for true fans of Japanese car 
culture, authentic drifting, and high-octane street racing adrenaline. Burn rubber, own the streets, and become a drifting legend!

70010000099930.name: Cup Heroes
70010000099930.intro: Join the adventure of a lifetime!
70010000099930.description:
Step into the whimsical world of Cup Heroes, where everyday cups turn into mighty heroes on an epic quest to save their beloved Queen! 

How to Play: 
- Control Your Heroes: Navigate your heroes through various obstacles and puzzles. 
- Save the Queen: Your ultimate goal is to rescue the Queen who has been captured by evil forces. 
- Unlock and Upgrade Characters: Collect coins and gems to unlock a diverse cast of characters, each with unique abilities. Upgrade their skills to make them even more powerful and adaptable to different challenges. 

Features: 
- Unique Characters: Meet a colourful cast of cup heroes, from the brave Knight Cup to the cunning Ninja Cup. Each character brings their own special skills and personality to the team. 
- Epic Adventures: Explore various enchanting worlds, from mystical forests to fiery volcanoes. Every level is a new adventure filled with hidden secrets and dangerous foes. 
- Challenging Puzzles: Test your brain with mind-bending puzzles that require clever solutions. Use your heroes’ abilities to overcome obstacles and progress through the game. 
- Exciting Battles: Engage in thrilling combat with evil minions and powerful bosses. Use your heroes’ special moves and teamwork to defeat enemies and save the Queen. 
- Beautiful Graphics: Enjoy stunning, colourful graphics that bring the world of Cup Heroes to life. Each scene is meticulously designed to enhance your gaming experience. 
- Daily Quests: Log in every day to participate in limited-time quests to earn multiple resources
- Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn but hard to master

Your Cup Heroes are waiting for you to lead them to victory!

70010000099932.name: Boost Zero
70010000099932.intro: Boost Zero is a vibrant homage to classic anti-gravity arcade racing games, where excitement and speed merge in adrenaline-fueled futuristic competitions.
70010000099932.description:
In this dystopian universe, gravity is reinvented: what is normally vertical becomes horizontal, and the notion of "up" is transformed. Each competition challenges you with unique objectives, whether it's beating time trials, competing against more than 22 other drivers, or taking on the demanding challenge of the "hare game," which will test your reflexes and skills to the limit.

Throughout your races, you can unlock 24 unique ships, each with a special personality and characteristics. Learn to master the turbo boost, but use it with caution, as it consumes a considerable amount of energy. The tracks are also dotted with special zones: the Yellow Zone gives you extra super acceleration, while the Blue Zone repairs and maximizes your energy. And for those critical moments, unlock the devastating "Whirlwind Destroyer System," which, when activated near your rivals, allows you to spin 360° and thus eliminate them from the competition.

Features:
   * Compete with more than 22 rivals.
   * Turbo Boost and Whirlwind Destroyer System.
   * 8 different worlds.
   * Two competition modes.
   * Choose from 24 unique ships.
   * Hyperdrive.

70010000099934.name: Duck Side of the Moon
70010000099934.intro: Waddle and fly as a duck in space! Explore the galaxy and find curious creatures and materials along the way. Craft gadgets, upgrade your spaceship, and get cozy in this relaxing adventure.
70010000099934.description:
Fly around as Doug, an overworked duck astronaut looking for a new homeworld. Crashed on a strange side of the galaxy, maybe this break is exactly what he needs! Whether you’re exploring or just soaking in the stars, this galaxy is yours to enjoy at your own pace.

Explore & Discover
Dive into a world filled with secrets! Find rare minerals in glowing caves, win outfits at the funfair, or see what’s bubbling inside the volcano... Whether it’s the highest stars or the deepest mines, every path has something to discover!

Meet & Help
Lucky for you, this side of the galaxy is filled with curious creatures who welcome you. Build a party, solve the town's mysteries, win an ice cream, and much more! In this world doing a little good goes a long way.

Collect & Craft
Make your spaceship a home among the stars! Build a comfy couch, a gardening room, or maybe even a basketball hoop. Fill your backpack with rare materials and return home to craft gadgets and stylish outfits! No rush, your ship isn’t going anywhere without you!

70010000099939.name: MLB® The Show™ 26
70010000099939.intro: Make your mark. Become a Legend. Own The Show™.
70010000099939.description:
Pre-order to get the Gold Choice pack. 

This edition of MLB The Show 26 includes:
 • 5 The Show Packs

Step up and take control of how you leave your mark in the most immersive MLB® The Show™ yet. 

Discover new Road To The Show mechanics, deeper Franchise experiences, enhanced customization options, and true-to-life on-field action.

Road To The Show
NEW – Road to Cooperstown & Expanded Amateur Years Career
Your journey to greatness starts here, which path will you choose?
Earn a coveted spot at the MLB Draft Combine® or catch the eye of one of 11 additional new colleges as you advance through chapters of your career.
Compete in the officially licensed Men’s NCAA® College World Series® as you rise from a promising high school talent to one of the all-time MLB® greats – immortalized in the National Baseball Hall of Fame and maybe even a place on the first ballot.

Diamond Dynasty¹
Unmissable Updates
Build your ultimate fantasy team with a new Red Diamond rarity tier and World Baseball Classic player cards featuring elite game-changing players.
Play revamped Mini-Seasons campaigns as you level up your stars with an upgraded PXP system, customize their skills with Parallel Mods, and hit Parallel V faster through special challenges.

Franchise 
NEW – Revamped Front Office Experience
Play the nail-biting key matches and moments of your Franchise GM career with streamlined seasons and Custom Game Entry. Track rumours and strike big deals in the ultimate all-in-one Trade HUB, where a new Trade Logic System delivers real depth, immersion, and high-stakes decision-making. Smarter lineups and improved player regression now mirror the real decisions and realities that shape your organization’s future.

Storyline¹
The Negro Leagues Season 4
The award-winning game mode returns with all-new legends, uniforms, and stadiums – celebrating the stories of some of the most important yet often forgotten ballplayers in history.

Gameplay Updates – More Control Than Ever
Bear Down Pitching: exert total control over your pitches by earning a limited supply of elite focus to deploy in the most critical moments.

Big Zone Hitting: rack up the home runs with more control over your swing placement, giving you a better chance to nail that sweet spot.

¹Internet connection required.

If you are interested in Early Access and playing 4 days early on March 13th 2026, do not purchase this version and instead purchase the Digital Deluxe Edition.

70010000099944.name: Tsugunohi -The Chamber of Phantom Name-
70010000099944.intro: The "Tsugunohi" series — a creeping everyday horror game with over 150M gameplay views! A sparkling new grad's fresh start is slowly consumed by terror―
70010000099944.description:
ABOUT THIS GAME
The daily-life horror series Tsugunohi, known for its simple “move left” gameplay, arrives on Nintendo Switch™ as
Tsugunohi -The Chamber of Phantom Name-!
The core gameplay remains the same: simply press the left key "←" to move the protagonist.
With no complex controls, you can fully immerse yourself in the eerie, realistic story crafted by ImCyan.
In this installment, you will wander between reality and illusion in a world both beautiful and bizarre.
Can you endure an even more refined level of horror?
Experience the evolved terror of Tsugunohi, brought to you by ImCyan.

STORY
A young office worker, Kana Sakuragi, begins her new life in the renovated old house Akembara House.
At first glance, it seems like a perfect home, but each night, strange phenomena begin to occur.
A suspicious manager, mysterious phantom character, and eerie origami—
Is this reality… or something else?

PROFILE
■ Tsugunohi Series
ImCyan is an indie game creator who has continuously developed numerous horror titles.
His most notable work is the Tsugunohi series.
The defining feature of the Tsugunohi series is its unique horror experience.
As you repeatedly walk “to the left” along familiar routes such as your way home or workplace, everyday life gradually distorts, and a deep sense of fear begins to envelop you—
Please enjoy the unsettling horror of everyday life slowly turning ominous.

70010000099960.name: BLOKES on BLOCKS!
70010000099960.description:
『BLOKES on BLOCKS!』 is a fast-paced action party game for up to 6 players that anyone can jump into with simple controls!
Choose your favorite bloke and knock the other blokes flying!

【Game Features】
▼ Simple Controls
Movement is all you need—up, down, left, and right.
Crash into other players to knock them down,
then crash into them again to send them flying.
It’s a simple, straight-up competitive game built entirely around moving and crashing into your opponents.

▼ Chaotic Multiplayer Fun
Pick up items to crank up the chaos in battle—press the A button to use them!
Bombs, missiles, beams, and more send matches into total mayhem.
Fast, chaotic matches make it easy to jump in anytime—even if you only have a few minutes to play.

【Game Modes】
▼ Last Stand
Survive to the very end!
A life-based battle mode where you respawn quickly, even after getting knocked out.
Lose all your lives, and you can still attack from outside to mess with the action.
a loud, chaotic mode that stays exciting until the very last moment.

▼ Chip Rush
Collect chips and claim victory!
Gather chips scattered across the stage or steal them from other players to compete for the win.
Near the end of the match, the Piggy Bank appears, opening up a huge chance for a last-second comeback!

▼ Sudden Smash
Get knocked down, and it’s instant KO!?
A high-risk, round-based battle where every smash is a one-hit finisher.
Send your opponents flying, rack up points, and aim for first place!

70010000099965.name: Court of Darkness: Temptation's Kiss
70010000099965.intro:
A vibrant, stylish isekai fantasy.
In this world of magic, your kiss is an irresistible temptati
70010000099965.description:
■Story
The night of a crimson crescent moon,
you find yourself transported
to a realm called Saligia.

Far removed from your everyday life,
you're in a world where magic is commonplace.

In the midst of your confusion,
before you appear 
five beautiful princes.

They crave the power 
your kiss can bestow, 
and will scheme to get it.

But what they seek 
is not just your power.
They want your heart as well...

■Characters
Guy Avari　"The Haughty Aristocrat"
Lynt Akedia　"The Somnolent Darling"
Fenn Luxure　"The Devious Libertine"
Toa Qelsum　"The Immaculate Adept"
Roy Invidia　"The Consummate Prince"

■Contents
From the romance game app Court of Darkness: Princes’ Path Prologue to Book 2, plus Book 1 Consorts’ Paths for Guy, Lynt, Fenn, Toa and Roy. 
*Does not contain voice or avatar features.

70010000099975.name: Simon the Sorcerer Origins
70010000099975.intro: Experience the Magical World like never before in Simon the Sorcerer Origins
70010000099975.description:
In this new adventure, Simon, the most sarcastic wizard in video game history, returns to reveal secrets and stories from his past! 

A New Journey Begins! 

Thirty years after his first appearance on the screen, Simon is drawn into a foreign world by an ancient prophecy, that will tell his origins. This world is populated by powerful yet mostly useless wizards and strange creatures. On his journey, Simon must solve a series of tricky puzzles, operate alchemical devices, and learn powerful spells. And yes, he also has to taste a few disgusting stews! 

Puzzles, Magic, and Simon’s Humor 

Whether you're visiting the Magical World for the first time or returning once again – Simon is back, along with his unique sense of humor and a completely new graphic style. Simon the Sorcerer Origins brings the charm of the original saga back in a completely hand-drawn graphic style, blending classic gameplay mechanics with a fresh, new world of magic. 

Your Adventure, Your Puzzles 

Solve loads of tricky puzzles, test your wits, and face a variety of absurd situations and quirky characters. Combine items and clues to unravel the big mystery and become the legendary wizard you were always meant to be.   

Features:

-	Official prequel to the cult series: Find out what Simon was up to just before his first magical misstep into the fantasy world, long before he started insulting talking doors. 

-	A story with heart, humour, and a hat: Between motherly love, a forced move, and a healthy dose of chaos, Simon’s journey to becoming an (unwilling) hero begins. 

-	Hand-drawn art style & iconic voice: Featuring lovingly hand-drawn graphics and Simon’s original voice, performed by British voice actor Chris Barrie, this feels like a trip back to the ’90s, just with far better resolution. 

-	Between magic spells and cogs: Classic point-and-click gameplay meets modern mechanics. Solve quirky puzzles, crack ancient mechanisms, and collect (as always) way too many items. 

-	Sarcasm, slapstick, and eccentric wizards: Encounter bizarre characters, delight in even odder conversations, and revel in Simon’s unmistakable wit: equal parts cheeky banter and “very British” humour. 

-	Alchemy, magic & other mishaps: Tinker with spells, fiddle with alchemical contraptions, and dabble in questionable recipes. With a sprinkle of luck, the thing you were trying to do could very well happen.

70010000099984.name: BOULDER DASH® 40th Anniversary
70010000099984.intro: Immerse yourself in 40 years of video game history and experience the classic BOULDER DASH® in an epic anniversary edition!
70010000099984.description:
A legend returns! Join Rockford on his hunt for diamonds in dangerous caves – more faithful to the original than ever before, yet more modern than ever!

Celebrate 40 years of retro action with a game that made history!

Since its initial release in 1984, BOULDER DASH® has thrilled generations of players. Now, the iconic title returns with a completely new, faithful game engine. A treat for long-time fans and newcomers alike. Your task: Collect enough diamonds in a cave filled with treacherous enemies and falling rocks to open the door to the exit. Here, you not only have to be skillful and quick to react, but also develop a suitable strategy more than once in order to survive. And once you've completed all 180 levels, you can use an editor to not only design new levels, but also download and play content from the worldwide Boulder Dash community for free. Never before has BOULDER DASH® looked better or sounded more spectacular!

Highlights of the 40th Anniversary Edition:
• 60 classic levels from BOULDER DASH® I, II & III – remastered!
• 180 brand new levels full of excitement, strategy, and diamond fever!
• 6 completely new worlds and 3 exclusive fan worlds from real Boulder Dash legends
• New game elements: Vertically growing walls, acid eating rocks and diamonds, enemy generators, surprise eggs and much!
• Level editor & community content: Build your own caves or play countless creations from other players
• Choose your hero: Play with one of three unique characters – inspired by the original design
• Powerful sound: Accompanied by an epic soundtrack from Germany's most famous video game composer, Chris Huelsbeck 
• Experience the ultimate BOULDER DASH® – for retro fans, puzzle pros, and newcomers alike.
Time travel doesn't exist? Yes, it does! With BOULDER DASH® 40th Anniversary, you can travel back to the golden age of video games – and bring the best of it into the present. Be there when Rockford makes history again!

Download now and relive the legend!

70010000099989.name: Pro Roulette
70010000099989.intro: Spin the Wheel. Feel the Thrill.
70010000099989.description:
Step into the glitzy world of high-stakes roulette with Pro Roulette, the ultimate single-player casino experience on Nintendo Switch. Whether you're a seasoned strategist or a newcomer chasing your first jackpot, Pro Roulette brings the timeless casino classic to life like never before.

– Two classic variants: play both American Roulette with its double zero layout and European Roulette for a more strategic edge
– Great graphics, smooth animations, and immersive sound design capture the real casino feel
– Easy-to-use touch screen controls optimized for handheld mode
– Practice strategies, test your luck, and aim for big virtual payouts with every spin

Whether you're at home or on the go, Pro Roulette gives you a premium roulette experience—anytime, anywhere.

Are you ready to spin and win?

70010000099993.name: Animal Kingdom 3
70010000099993.intro: Amazing hidden objects quest in world of animals!
70010000099993.description:
Welcome to Animal Kingdom 3, a hidden animal game where you collect pawprints and cameras while searching for animals in fantastic locations! 
With 3 game modes and trivias, jigsaw, and swap puzzles between the chapters, 
Animal Kingdom 3 will provide hours of fun for hidden object fans in colorful jungles and other natural scenes even underwater! 
Animal Kingdom 3 is waiting for you in this unique hidden object game!

- Replayable hidden animal scenes!
- Animal puzzles along the way!
- Collect photos and curiosities

70010000100002.name: The Long Desert Drive
70010000100002.intro: You don’t escape the desert—you become part of it.
70010000100002.description:
In The Long Desert Drive, you wake in an abandoned house with no answers—only your
instincts and a dusty old car. With supplies gathered from the garage, you set off into a
vast, unpredictable desert. Your car becomes your only companion in a world that feels
hauntingly empty.
Scavenge for resources, upgrade your vehicle, and survive against all odds. Every stop
brings new risks, strange encounters, and a growing mystery behind the silence that
surrounds you.
Features:
• Explore the Unknown: Travel an open, unpredictable desert full of strange stops and
hidden secrets.
• Scavenge and Survive: Collect vital supplies and upgrade your car to stay alive on the
endless road.
• Unexpected Dangers: Face enemies, breakdowns, and the unknown at every turn.
• Your Car Is Everything: It’s your shelter, your weapon, and your only ally.
• Lonely but Alive: Uncover the mystery of a world gone silent—one mile at a time.
This isn’t just a trip through the desert—it’s a test of your will, instincts, and endurance.
In a world that has forgotten you, will you keep going… or fade into the dust?

70010000100011.name: CarsWheels
70010000100011.intro: Wreck the room in a wild racing rampage!
70010000100011.description:
You’re actually racing tiny toy cars across a giant bedroom, with tracks built from pencils, books, pencil cases, and random stuff all over the floor. Everything around you becomes part of the track. Jump over slippers, smash through bananas, overtake your friend at the backpack corner — and constantly try to shove them off the road!

Play together on one screen — one Joy-Con™ each. Sit on the couch and go! Who’s faster? Who crashes first? Who pulls off the win? It’s pure chaos and full-on fun.

There are tons of tracks, all colorful and full of surprises — it’s like the toys came to life. Controls are easy, but every car handles differently. Drift, jump, crash, knock stuff over — you can even dive into the bathtub.

Winning is great, but having fun messing around is what it’s all about. Though finishing first still feels pretty awesome.

Smash everything, unlock new cars and wild locations. More stunts, more speed, more fun!

70010000100037.name: OPUS: Prism Peak
70010000100037.intro: Capture the moment, then learn to let go.
70010000100037.description:
OPUS: Prism Peak is a narrative adventure where you play as a weary photographer stranded in the Dusklands, traveling with a girl who's lost her memories. Together, you'll uncover the mysteries of this land through your camera and find your way home.

■Photography 
Use your old analog camera to capture the perfect shot through framing, timing, exposure, focus, and filters. Photography in this game reflects how closely you look at the world. Take in your surroundings, understand the desires of each spirit you meet, and uncover the world's secrets through your lens.

■Sacred Firebowl 
These shrines bearing aperture symbols connect different worlds and hold the secrets of the Dusklands. Figure out and capture the photos each fire demands to receive items and upgrades for your camera.

■A Mysterious Companion 
The girl you meet in the Dusklands has no memory, only a faint sense that she must reach the distant Dusk Mountain. Together you'll journey through this strange land, but why is she even here? And can you bring her home?

■Wistful Magical Realism 
This world mirrors reality yet bears no trace of humanity, only spirits in the form of animals call this place home. Through careful observation, you'll uncover the reason humans no longer exist, and the realm's true purpose.

■Dusklands Field Notes 
A mysterious journal filled with photos and stories from the Dusklands' past. Photograph clues along your journey and add them to the journal to identify spirits, piece together myths, and decode ancient runes, as you unravel the hidden mysteries of this world.

■Spiritual Bonds 
The spirits you encounter throughout the game may grow closer to you depending on your choices, quietly shaping what awaits at your destination.

70010000100047.name: Love Blossoms News／愛の花だより
70010000100047.intro: A gentle and sweet otome game with the theme of "flowers" × "fairy tale picture book."
70010000100047.description:
Why not step into a gentle, softly drawn, hand-painted fairy tale world?

Liel is a gardener in the Kingdom of Amestaria, the city of flowers.
This story follows her romantic journey with Mios, the first prince of Amestaria.
There are no character sprites, and the game progresses in a single, linear path—like a picture-story show.

70010000100052.name: Ninjam!
70010000100052.intro: A competitive action game for up to 4 players! Survive with a variety of weapons and flashy ninjutsu to aim for the title of “God of Ninja”!
70010000100052.description:
A High-Octane Action Battle for Up to 4 Players!
Earn points by surviving each stage. The first player to reach the target score wins it all!
Rise to the top using a vast arsenal of weapons and flashy Ninjutsu!

◆ Switch Up Weapons and Ninjutsu to Dominate!
Smash boxes scattered across the stage to find random weapons and items!
Every weapon has its own unique traits—switching your strategy on the fly is the key to victory.
Use a mix of skill and a little bit of luck to take down your rivals!

◆ Over 15 Unique and Thrilling Stages!
Your opponents aren't the only threat!
Stay alert and watch out for stage hazards like falling floors, hidden bamboo spears, and rushing rivers.
Master the environment and use these gimmicks to your advantage to be the last one standing!

◆ Aim for the Title: God of Ninja!
Our ninja heroes are locked in a fierce battle to reach the ultimate peak: the "God of Ninja."
Master your weapons, unleash your Ninjutsu, and stack up those points.
Only the one who reaches the goal will claim the legendary title of "God of Ninja"!

Streaming and Gameplay Videos
No special permission or prior notice is required to stream or upload gameplay videos of this title.
Please feel free to share and enjoy the game with your audience!

70010000100062.name: Duo Games
70010000100062.intro: Fun, fast, and fiercely competitive – perfect for two players on one Nintendo Switch™!
70010000100062.description:
Looking for instant fun with a friend? Whether you're traveling, relaxing at home, or just want a quick challenge, Duo Games delivers a collection of 9 exciting mini-games designed for 2 players on a single console.


Test your reflexes, timing, and strategy in a variety of head-to-head challenges:
- Knives – Aim true and hit the target with perfect precision.
- Hockey – Score goals and defend your net in a fast-paced match.
- Volleyball – Bounce the ball onto your opponent’s side to win.
- Ships – Reflect enemy shots and turn their attacks against them.
- Sushi – Collect sashimi faster than your opponent!
- Sumo – Push your rival out of the ring by mashing the button.
- Spinners – Clash spinners and knock your foe off the arena.
- Pizza – React fast to grab the final slice!
- Bees – Catch pollen quickly and accurately before your opponent does.


With clean, minimalistic visuals and easy-to-learn controls, Duo Games keeps the focus on pure, competitive fun. Great for kids, families, or friends looking for quick matches and big laughs.

Warning: May cause sudden outbursts of laughter and intense rivalries!

70010000100077.name: Canine
70010000100077.description:
Dive into a terrifying first-person survival horror experience inspired by 32-bit retro-style games. You play as a boy searching for his dog Tomy, who has been kidnapped by an evil corporation conducting twisted experiments on pets.

If you enjoy pure horror games, tension without weapons, and a retro atmosphere filled with stealth and suspense, CANINE delivers a claustrophobic, emotional, and highly replayable journey thanks to its multiple endings and hardcore mode. Try to save Tomy — without losing yourself along the way!

FEATURES
- 32-bit retro-style visuals & B-movie atmosphere – Explore dark hallways and experience chilling visual effects.

- No weapons — only your wits and a ball – Throw Tomy's tennis ball to distract enemies or hide using stealth.

- Two different endings – Your choices and performance determine Tomy's fate.

- Unlockable HARDCORE mode – Earn 4 stars in a timed run to unlock a brutally intense version of the game.

- Scoring and timing system – Compete against yourself for the best performance.

- Inspired by classics – Tension and environments reminiscent of classics.

70010000100079.name: Well Dweller
70010000100079.intro: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer, a tiny bird armed with a matchstick.
70010000100079.description:
Deep within the forest, at the bottom of a well, lives the only creature brave enough to kill the queen... 

  Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick- who must burn the wicked queen to save his family. Explore a dark fairy-tale landscape and befriend the charming characters who reside in the kingdom’s underbelly. Battle terrifying beasts and gain new abilities to expand your map. Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and unravel the mysteries that lie in this rotted kingdom.

Among the rotting ruins are a charming cast of characters just trying to get by.  Go camping with Ilda, a tiny mouse who is on the run from the queens grasp. Explore an abandoned castle with Looter, a mysterious scavenger who searches the kingdom for the best wares to steal. And find and reunite with all of your sheltered siblings who were snatched up one night by a crazed hunter.

Light up your matchstick to illuminate the world and aid in combat. Collect trinkets to upgrade your abilities, and mix-and-match them to customize your game play. Solve puzzles, defeat vicious bosses, and forge your path to the queens quarters to save your family.

70010000100087.name: Find Sort Match
70010000100087.intro: Develop your mental skills and have fun.
70010000100087.description:
Challenge your mind and sharpen your logic skills with Find Sort Match, a relaxing puzzle game designed to boost attentiveness, creativity, and clever thinking. Each unique level presents a different scenario, keeping gameplay fresh and engaging. Whether you're unpacking boxes, filling the fridge, matching colors, or neatly organizing household objects, every puzzle offers a satisfying way to unwind.

Perfect for anyone who loves precision and order, the game features sorting tasks ranging from simple arrangements by color and shape to intricate sequencing and matching. Pay close attention to detail as you tackle various challenges like aligning floppy disks, organizing beauty products, sorting cakes, and more.

Enjoy diverse activities:

★ Organize bottles, stickers, spoons, and stationery
★ Correctly position bulbs and objects
★ Complete detailed drawings
★ Arrange colorful tiles and block puzzles
★ Match goods and items perfectly

Find Sort Match caters to both casual puzzle lovers and serious brain-teasers, offering levels ranging from easygoing to delightfully challenging. Improve your focus, memory, and problem-solving skills while relaxing in a cozy, stress-free environment. A puzzle universe made for thoughtful, enjoyable gameplay.

70010000100130.name: Brain Workout! Find the Difference in Classic Art
70010000100130.intro:
Spot the Differences in Famous Masterpieces!
Train Your Brain and Eyes While Enjoying Art
70010000100130.description:
Enjoy the world’s most iconic paintings while giving your brain and eyes a fun workout in this artistic game.

How to play is simple:
・Look carefully at the pair of paintings displayed side by side
・Find the differences between the left painting and the right one
・When you spot a difference, tap or click on that part of the right painting!

It’s perfect for a quick break or a bit of casual brain training.

Feeling stuck?
The hint button will gently point you in the right direction
(by showing you roughly where to look)!

70010000100135.name: Spire Blast
70010000100135.intro: A dragon, endless towers, and spectacular blasts!
70010000100135.description:
Dive into the vibrant world of Spire Blast! Team up with your ever-hungry dragon companion to collapse mysterious spires using colourful, physics-based puzzle mechanics. Launch matching coloured projectiles, trigger chain reactions, and master strategic planning to bring each tower tumbling down.

With hundreds of levels spanning breathtaking environments, powerful boosters like rockets, paint grenades, and Rubik’s cube bombs are unlocked to turn the tide in your favour. Easy to pick up but rich in tactical depth, Spire Blast promises a relaxing yet addictive experience for players of all ages.

70010000100137.name: Gruniożerca Trilogy
70010000100137.intro: Three absurd retro puzzle games starring Grunio the food-loving guinea pig!
70010000100137.description:
Gruniożerca Trilogy is a remastered compilation of three independently developed retro puzzle games that originally launched on the NES™. Take control of Grunio – a hungry guinea pig on a mission – and dive into creative challenges packed with charm, humor, and pixel-perfect nostalgia.
 
 Originally created by Łukasz ""dizzy9"" Kur and M-Tee, the games have now been faithfully brought to modern platforms by Take IT Studio!, preserving their distinct style while ensuring smooth performance on today's systems.
 
 Whether you're new to the world of Grunio or a long-time fan, this trilogy offers a delightful journey through the golden age of 8-bit fun.
 
 Includes:
 - Gruniożerca – classic puzzling with a tasty twist
 - Gruniożerca 2 – more challenges, more food, more Grunio
 - Gruniożerca 3: The Great Cavy Clean-Up! – brand new mechanics and outlandish scenarios
 
 Features:
 - 8-bit inspired visuals and music
 - Three distinct gameplay styles in one package
 - Retro vibes with modern polish
 - A lovable guinea pig hero like no other
 - Mlem!

70010000100142.name: Pro Blackjack
70010000100142.intro: Master the table. Beat the dealer. Play like a pro.
70010000100142.description:
Step into the world of high-stakes card play with Pro Blackjack, the ultimate single-player blackjack experience for the Nintendo Switch™.

Enjoy smooth, immersive gameplay that captures the thrill of the casino. Whether you're new to blackjack or a seasoned player, Pro Blackjack offers a clean, focused experience designed for quick sessions or long play.

Play against a smart AI dealer using standard blackjack rules. Make strategic decisions—hit, stand, double down, or split—and aim to get as close to 21 as possible without going bust. With responsive controls and a sleek interface, every hand feels sharp and satisfying.

No pressure, no distractions—just you, the cards, and the strategy it takes to win. Ready to beat the dealer?

Play smart. Play sharp. Become the Pro.

70010000100146.name: Colorizing: Satisfaction
70010000100146.intro: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation
70010000100146.description:
This coloring book is a guarantee of good mood.
In it you can find all kinds of pictures for every taste.
Coloring by numbers with Colorizing is a calming and easy activity for people of all ages. 
This drawing game is suitable for children and adults, everyone can enjoy pixel coloring.
You will definitely love coloring with this beautiful coloring book!

70010000100154.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
70010000100154.intro: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.
70010000100154.description:
What is Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure?
A single-player, tilt-based platformer game for everyone. A heartwarming physics-based adventure for all ages. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

Why do we need Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure?
Marupoyo is a charismatic, simple alternative to complex heroes, featuring a clean art style perfect for all ages. It offers the ideal mix of relaxing vibes and fun challenges. It's a unique game for everyone to enjoy alone or with the family.

What kind of players can enjoy the game?
The game is designed for everyone, having an easy  accessibility in the controls (just need to tilt the controller to play!) and with only one action: brake. Also, the Family Mode adds elements to avoid players dying, allowing players that like cozy games to play and have fun. However, the gamer mode brings more speed, deathly elements and adds lots of challenges to the game, such as beating the clock, getting the badge for not losing lives or the Pro player badge for not using brakes.

Story Summary
Marupoyo is a unique chick born so round he can’t walk — he can only roll! Though initially mocked for his clumsiness, he becomes the village’s only hope when a massive tornado scatters his family across the kingdom.

Guided by the Queen of Nature, Marupoyo rolls through forests, icy mountains, sandy deserts and volcanoes to stop an exiled Alchemist whose experiments are destroying the world. Along the way, he rescues his siblings and proves that his unique way of moving is actually a superpower - always rolling forward! Without fear, he will restore peace and become the kingdom's greatest hero.

Gameplay Elements
★ Physics Movements: tilt the board to move game elements.
★ Walls and floors: Colliding, Movable, walk-through and Bumpy.
★ Adversaries: Path Followers that may bump or defeat you.
★ Dangers: Cliffs, Holes, Water, Lava and Corruption will be hazardous.
★ Natural Hurdles: such as Water streams, Ice, Grass and Bumpy Mushrooms.
★ Family Mode: Cotton Clouds will cover most of the dangers in the levels.
★ Gamer Mode: Normal gameplay with all the challenges available.

Collectables and Challenges
★ Rescue all the family members during your trip. Once saved, you can visit them in your hometown and improve bonds with corn.
★ Win against the clock in Time Attack challenges in every level and earn extra Corn prizes (and a badge to be proud of!)
★ Collect all the Corn within a level and win an extra Corn prize (and again, medals for you!)
★ Find all the music tracks hidden in the game.

Family game mode
★ This mode is a bit slower, takes deathly stuff and adds clouds to avoid falling, reducing frustration.
★ Clouds will be bouncy, to keep it fun.
★ This mode eliminates the visual fear of younger players. (I don’t want to fall into lava)

Accessibility
★ Motion Sick toggle, to quit floor movement on screen and reduce dizziness. 
★ Sound volume split with Music, VO and Sound Effects.

70010000100159.name: Pro Baccarat
70010000100159.intro: Feeling lucky? Shuffle up and see!
70010000100159.description:
Pro Baccarat delivers a focused, single-player experience of the classic casino game. Step into a virtual baccarat table where strategy, timing, and intuition are key. With smooth controls and fast gameplay, this title is perfect for both new players and seasoned card game fans.

Choose your bet—Player, Banker, or Tie—and see if your decision pays off. The game offers realistic odds and a true-to-casino experience without unnecessary distractions.

Key Features:
– Single-player baccarat with authentic casino mechanics
– Adjustable game speed and bet limits
– Hand history and session tracking tools
– Optional multi-deck play
– No online requirement, no ads, no microtransactions

Pro Baccarat is a pure, streamlined card game designed for players who enjoy the quiet focus of one-on-one play against the house. Perfect for practice, casual play, or developing your betting strategy.

Just you, the cards, and the game.

70010000100163.name: Sacrifice For Sale
70010000100163.intro: A spooky Visual Novel where you try to convince cultists not to sacrifice you.
70010000100163.description:
Experience interaction in a new and engaging way. Choose to respond to what the characters have to say… directly! Deal with your own hostage situation, negotiate for more than just your freedom. Learn about the people who hold you captive, deconstruct the cult, manipulate them- all to not end up as their next sacrifice.

Learn the value of silence! You will never speak a word unless you actively choose to. The entire game can be played as a silent protagonist. Let others speak without interrupting them, give meaningful silent looks and get caught up in your own inner dialogue to reveal new options. Or you could always give in to apathy, accept your faith and be willingly sacrificed!

Features:
- A short but immersive story
- Play as an ordinary Salesman just trying to get by
- Argue why the cultists shouldn’t sacrifice you
- 30 minutes for most single playthroughs
- 30'000+ words!
- 500+ choices! There's a choice around every corner!
- 15+ Unique Endings!

70010000100168.name: The Last Shot Arcades
70010000100168.intro: Arcade machines in the universe of The Last Shot!
70010000100168.description:
In this collection, you can drive a bus, fly a fighter jet, shoot a bow and slingshot, tickle some dinosaurs, robots, and zombies, and defend your base from waves of enemies. A wild mix of arcades, strategy, shoot-’em-ups, physics-based games, and awesome music from street performers.

Key Features:
- Nine arcade machines with a variety of games
- Original hand-drawn art in the style of vintage cartoons
- A chance to return to the familiar streets of a massive dieselpunk city
- Original music performed by street musicians
- A warm reunion with old friends

70010000100173.name: Tale of Dark Lands
70010000100173.intro: Magical fantasy action RPG with an elegant low-poly style and the charm of a timeless fairy tale.
70010000100173.description:
Tale of Dark Lands - a magical fantasy action RPG with an elegant low-poly style and the charm of a timeless fairy tale. Immerse yourself in a world of mysteries, perils, and glorious adventures!

A story full of secrets and challenges.
The main hero is a brave mercenary hired by the residents of a small village to defend them against fierce goblin raids. But what begins as a simple job turns into something far greater. Soon, the hero becomes entwined in an ancient dark tale that threatens the entire land, and only he can stop the encroaching darkness.

Create the hero of your dreams.
A flexible character editor lets you craft a hero with a unique appearance.
Develop your character: earn experience, acquire new skills, and grow stronger with every battle!

Immerse yourself in thrilling gameplay.
Gear and customization: Find or buy unique items – from shining swords to sturdy armor, bows, and magical helmets.
Crafting and upgrades: Gather resources, forge powerful equipment at the village blacksmith, and enhance your gear using runes in the Runic Forge.
Unique skill system: Learn new abilities from the experienced skill trader.
A variety of items: Equipment, artifacts for trade, runes, crafting materials – just make sure everything fits in your grid-based inventory.

Game features:
- Story-driven adventure: A rich yet concise gameplay experience.
- Visual style: Beautiful low-poly design that creates a magical fantasy atmosphere.
- Thoughtful inventory system: A convenient grid-based item storage system.
- Crafting and upgrades: Collect resources and craft gear at the blacksmith.
- Trading and economy: Buy equipment, sell unwanted items, and discover rare finds.
- Hero equipment: A vast selection of gear for your character.
- Character customization: Use the editor to create your unique hero.

Tale of Dark Lands is an epic journey filled with secrets, dangerous foes, and incredible rewards. Become the hero who will face the ancient evil and etch your name into legend!

70010000100186.name: Arcade Archives SCRAMBLED EGG
70010000100186.intro: Kick, launch, and get chased! It's a scramble emergency!!!
70010000100186.description:
"SCRAMBLED EGG" is an action game released by Technos Japan in 1983.
Kick the eggs to crack them open and hatch chicks. Then launch all the new chicks into the sky!
Red chicks and chickens will help you take down enemies. Be sure to take good care of them!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000100196.name: Command Under Fire RTS
70010000100196.intro: Take Command. Build Power. Conquer Islands.
70010000100196.description:
War has erupted across a chain of strategic islands. As the sole commander of allied forces, it's your mission to establish forward bases, mobilize your arsenal, and lead a full-scale campaign to eliminate entrenched enemy forces.

In Command Under Fire RTS, you’ll execute real-time tactics across hostile terrain. Construct military camps, secure supply lines, and deploy a wide range of combat assets under your direct command.

Features:

– Strategic Base Building – Establish outposts, reinforce defenses, and expand your military infrastructure to sustain combat operations.
– Diverse Combat Units – Assemble and lead an army of infantry, light and heavy tanks, mobile artillery, combat helicopters, and tactical strike jets. Each unit plays a vital role in the battlefield dynamic.
– Island Campaigns – Launch operations across multiple islands, each with its own terrain, tactical challenges, and enemy resistance. Adapt your strategy to overcome jungle ambushes, mountainous chokepoints, and fortified zones.
– Solo Command. As the lone decision-maker, your leadership determines success or failure in every mission.

Lead from the front. Adapt under fire. Conquer without compromise.
Command Under Fire RTS delivers raw tactical warfare for players who thrive under pressure and lead without hesitation.

70010000100201.name: Coffee Shop Simulator
70010000100201.description:
Open your own coffee shop and serve the best coffee in the world. Sell delicious cakes, desserts, croissants, muffins and ice cream. Expand your cafe, add tables, cabinets, chairs and decorate it with paintings and plants. Fulfill orders and earn money.

In Coffee Shop Simulator, you will run your own café and create a place with a unique atmosphere, where everyone will want to come, relax and drink freshly ground and brewed coffee. Give people the best before the coffee gets cold. Offer increasingly better desserts, squeeze fresh fruit juice, make smoothies and prepare ice cream desserts. Sell your own products, place large orders, carry boxes and arrange goods on shelves.

Your cafe can become one of the most beautiful in the world, offer people a bit of luxury, nice music and fast service. Accept card and cash payments, add cabinets, shelves, tables and refrigerators. Make lots of money. A wonderful, realistic simulation game, a cafe and shop simulator that sells fresh, delicious products.

70010000100205.name: Trasmoz Legends
70010000100205.intro: The final arcade battle in the cursed lands of Trasmoz begins. Are you ready?
70010000100205.description:
Trasmoz Legends is the explosive finale to the Trasmoz trilogy: a retro arcade platformer built like a lost 1980s cabinet. Featuring ultra-crisp pixel art limited to 16 colors and an authentic YM2203 chiptune soundtrack, it’s a love letter to the golden age of coin-op gaming.

Choose from 4 modes — Family, Classic, Speedrun, and Endless — and face a relentless final boss that hunts you through cursed villages, cryptic forests, and decaying catacombs. Play solo or team up with a friend in the local co-op mode.

With its emergent gameplay, brutal pacing, and deep challenge, Trasmoz Legends is made for both hardcore veterans and curious newcomers.

Features:

– 4 game modes: Family, Classic, Speedrun & Endless  
– True 8-bit style: 16-color sprites & YM2203 chiptune  
– Local co-op for 2 players  
– Leaderboards & achievements  

No filler. Just pure arcade energy.

70010000100208.name: Knowledge, or know Lady
70010000100208.intro: Oops… I'm the only guy in an all-girls university.
70010000100208.description:
Knowledge, or Know Lady is a live-action romance simulation where you, by some ridiculous twist of fate, become the only guy at an all-girls university! Step into this first-person love comedy adventure, where sweetness and chaos await on campus.

Under relentless charm offensives from a group of gorgeous girls, will you stay loyal to the one you love? Or enjoy the attention from everyone? Or maybe… resist temptation and proudly shout, “Ladies! Stop distracting me from studying!” — The legend of your time at the girls' university is yours to write.

First-Person Perspective — Total Immersion
Filmed entirely from a first-person view to boost immersion, putting you right in the middle of the action and romance.

Multiple Routes, Endless Endings
Say goodbye to predictable love stories! Besides classic single-heroine endings, explore double routes, multiple love stories, or defy human limits with the ultimate "Lone Wolf at a Girls' School" ending.

Innovative Gameplay, Unpredictable Plot
Beyond standard dialogue choices, collect quirky items hidden around campus. These will play a crucial role in unlocking secret scenes and shaping your destiny.

Stunning Cast, Ultimate Romance
Get swept away in the youthful atmosphere of campus life, as six charming heroines — each with their own distinct personality — bring you a truly unforgettable romantic adventure.

70010000100216.name: Birthday of Horrors
70010000100216.intro: It’s your party, you’ll scream if you want to.
70010000100216.description:
Birthday of Horrors turns your special day into a nightmare you won’t forget. No guests, no cake—just you, a dark house, and something that really wasn’t on the invite list.

Explore a spooky, retro-style home filled with strange noises, flickering lights, and eerie surprises around every corner. It’s part horror, part comedy, and all chaos as you try to survive the weirdest birthday ever.

Search for clues, solve odd puzzles, and avoid whatever’s stalking the halls. You're not just blowing out candles—you’re trying to stay alive long enough to open a single present.
And hey, if the monster doesn’t get you, the party playlist on loop just might.

70010000100221.name: MechCrisis
70010000100221.description: Is there any way we can protect ourselves from intelligent machines? Choose your weapon, choose your exclusive character, upgrade your skills, and enjoy 15 minutes of pigeon experience.

70010000100229.name: ROPOKO for Nintendo Switch
70010000100229.intro:
What made the MZ-700, which couldn't even display graphics, a national computer? 
Only the MZ-700 knows the answer...
70010000100229.description:
ROPOKO for Nintendo Switch™ is an interactive fiction-style adventure game. Players become the robot Ropoko and must escape from a maze-like laboratory with the help of "Doctor." Learn words through conversations and use the vocabulary you've acquired to solve various puzzles!

The Nintendo Switch version is an enhanced adaptation of the original MZ-700 version, improving playability with features like word selection, auto-mapping, hint functions, and gamepad support, making it easy to enjoy in any play environment.


- Gameplay
Though interactive fiction games are generally considered high difficulty, we've designed ROPOKO to be accessible even for those unfamiliar with the genre.

Movement is handled entirely with the Joy-Con™, providing smooth navigation similar to action games or RPGs.

In traditional text adventure games, players input commands as keywords to direct the character's actions. In ROPOKO, only one noun is needed to issue commands. You don't need to input verbs or objects as in conventional games; just type a noun while in contact with the target to ask questions or use items.

Examples: "ropoko," "laboratory," "door," "wire."
Only words encountered in previous conversations can be used, so increasing your vocabulary through repeated dialogue is key to progression. Commands can be entered either by typing directly on the keyboard or selecting words using a cursor.

The game includes various puzzles, mini-games, and complex dungeons to keep players entertained. After completing the game, you can aim for the shortest completion time or the highest vocabulary score.


- About the MZ-700
The MZ-700 is an 8-bit computer released by SHARP in 1982. The original version was on this machine, which lacked graphic capabilities, so the game screen is entirely represented with character graphics (pseudo-graphics made from text). Large characters, which occupy two-thirds of the screen, move smoothly thanks to machine language programming. Although the sound source can only produce single-tone beeps, ROPOKO offers 12 background music tracks and 20 types of sound effects.

70010000100234.name: Dinosaurs and Animal Friends to the Rescue
70010000100234.intro: A magical adventure where a curious turtle, a clumsy dinosaur, and an inventive hummingbird travel through enchanted lands to restore harmony to their home.
70010000100234.description:
Embark with Tula the turtle, Riko the absent-minded velociraptor, and Luzia the inventor hummingbird on a magical and colorful audio visual novel, where every page comes to life with 3D animations and voice-overs.

Guided by a map, the three friends navigate through walkable forests, bubble showers, and crystalline silk bridges to restore harmony to time.

Inspired by the style of top-rated interactive stories, this adventure combines reading, tactile play, and immersive music to turn every play session into a moment of learning and family bonding.

Highlights
· Full-color 3D illustrations that amaze with every touch.

· Full narration with voices and fun music.

· Touch interactivity: tap the screen to turn the page or view fun images in the gallery.

· Simple controls: perfect for first-time digital readers as a family.

· An upbeat story that celebrates curiosity, ingenuity, and the importance of growing by remembering the best of each moment.

· Short games, autosave, and auto-read mode: ideal for bedtime stories or road trips.

70010000100236.name: Supermarket Manager 2025
70010000100236.description:
Supermarket Manager 2025 hands you the keys to your very own grocery store—and it's up to you to turn it into the neighborhood’s favorite place to shop.

Start with a modest setup and build your way up. Stock shelves, organize the layout, and fine-tune prices to keep customers coming back. As foot traffic grows, expand your space, upgrade your equipment, and keep everything running smoothly.

Hire the right staff, assign roles, and manage the day-to-day chaos of retail life. From clean aisles to long checkout lines, every decision counts.

It’s your store, your strategy, and your shot at building a retail empire—just be ready to answer, “Where’s the bathroom?” at least 47 times a day.

70010000100241.name: Bring You Home
70010000100241.intro: A puzzle adventure where you don't control the hero, but the level ITSELF!
70010000100241.description:
Change and rearrange pieces of every level to find the right path! All to guide Polo through crazy worlds and rescue his kidnapped alien pet...

With this innovative mechanic, even failing can be fun! If poor Polo finds a deadly but hilarious fate, just go back in time and rewind the level.

Venture into oodles of worlds stuffed with magical characters, bizarre surprises, and many treacherous dangers – all to catch the captors of your missing pet. Will you get to the bottom of this mystery?

INVENTIVE
Explore a mind-boggling game mechanic that allows you to control the environment around you!

UNEXPECTED
Jump from world to world in dozens of levels all around the universe. You never know what’s gonna happen next!

SILLY
Discover all the wacky pitfalls in every level – you don’t want to miss them!

ADORABLE
Find and collect nostalgic pictures you took with your lovely pet! Oh, sweet memories…

70010000100246.name: All Hands on Deck
70010000100246.intro: All Hands on Deck is a 2-player cooperative puzzle platformer game. Use Rock, Paper, Scissors, and a variety of items to solve puzzles, explore fun worlds, and rescue plush toys together.
70010000100246.description:
Play Together as Lefty and Righty!
In this fun and heartwarming adventure, all the plushies at the daycare have gone missing! You’ll play as the hands of each child, searching for their fuzzy friends in their own imaginative worlds. Can you discover who or what is behind this strange event? Jump, Cut, Grab, Punch, and High-five your way through three worlds filled with puzzles, secrets, and challenges!

All Hands on Deck!
Experience a playful 2-player co-op adventure where you and a friend lend each other a hand. Whether you play on- or offline, you can enjoy All Hands on Deck without split-screen!

Handy Interaction!
Your appearance changes how you can interact within these imaginative worlds. Rock can Punch obstacles in your way or become Paper to Grab items and High Five! The trio is not complete without Scissors to Cut your way further!

Co-op Tools!
Various tools can be found across the playful worlds, like an Extendable Arm to reach higher places. A Rubber Band to become a slingshot together or mix and match Paint to traverse through paint splotches. Most tools can even be combined with others! Use them to save all the missing plushies!

Customization at Your Fingertips!
Each world is packed with secrets and extra challenges. Buy cosmetics and jump on paint tubes to change your look. Can you find them all?

70010000100251.name: Unrailed 2: Back on Track
70010000100251.intro: Unrailed is back on track with more co-op railroad construction chaos than ever!
70010000100251.description:
Unrailed 2: Back on Track brings chaotic local and online multiplayer track-building action to the next level – band together with friends to collaborate and build your track across new procedurally generated worlds - WHILST the train is running! So think fast, with more freedom than ever before, and conquer new obstacles in your way - before your trains becomes… a trainwreck! 

CHOOSE YOUR TRACK 
Now featuring a story spread across new environments, on branching paths for you to choose, so no two runs will feel the same. In these biomes you’ll now be able encounter new points of interests, side quests, daunting bosses and as well as other random encounters, so adapt quickly on your feet! New unlockable cosmetics also let you add your personal touch to your characters’ story. 

YOUR JOURNEY GETS BETTER AND BETTER 
Every excursion your crew undertakes feels increasingly meaningful, with new rewards and permanent upgrades granting you character with gameplay-modifying abilities, as well as new train engines, wagons and extensions to unlock, giving you the tools to build a multitude of train configurations to play and experiment with. Each locomotive loss is an opportunity to rebuild and get… back on track! 

CREATE, SHARE AND PLAY WITH THE COMMUNITY 
The all-new Terrain Conductor mode allows you unleash your imagination to create your very own custom maps and share these with the Unrailed community – with highlights being featured by the developers. Or if creating isn’t your thing, browse the limitless creations other players have built, so the frantic fun never ends! 

CO-OPERATE TO COMPETE 
Fulfill your burning competitive urge – manically duke it out in against another team in the new 8-player Vs Mode. Test your team’s prowess in online leaderboards with action replays and see who can achieve the highest scores.

70010000100256.name: Curse Rounds
70010000100256.intro: Survive random rounds and kill enemies with your pistolflash while choosing a curse card for yourself!
70010000100256.description:
Curse Rounds is a frantic game where you must try to survive random rounds, accumulating a curse with each room from the 60+ available cards in the game, while killing enemies with your pistolflash and a variety of amazing shots. No two attempts are ever the same! 

- Bosses big, huge, giants and powerful!
- Kill all your enemies with a variety of amazing shots!
- 30 enemies with unique characteristics

70010000100261.name: Reus 2
70010000100261.intro: Design symbiotic worlds with godly titans and watch humanity flourish.
70010000100261.description:
Become a God once again in Reus 2 by taking control of mighty giants whose command over their elements allows you to shape worlds, create an ecosystem of resources and enable human civilizations to thrive. Your choices will determine the fates of these fragile human beings, whose autonomy may lead them to great heights.

Shape worlds with Giants
Utilize a roster of 6 powerful Giants, each with their own unique abilities over plants, animals and minerals that will allow you to create new biomes for humans to settle their villages. As you progress, gain inspiration to unlock more skills for your Giants, providing you with a diversity of choices.

Relationships and disasters
With the !New Cataclysm update!, you can choose to take on more optional challenges. Leaders can now form relationships with Giants and each other based on their personality, become allies through trade or go to war. Humanity can also turn against your giants, sending out Giant Hunters to destroy them! Punish them with disastrous new powers, using the elements to teach them to respect the gods.

Create thriving ecosystems
Terraform a variety of biomes, strategically build up different combinations of flora, fauna and materials specific to those environments. By experimenting, discover which combinations create the best synergies for the inhabitants' needs and goals, leading you into exciting new eras of their existence.

Lead humanity into the future
Shape the development of humanity with your choices as they evolve from early human societies to modern civilizations. Whether it's travelling to the stars as space explorers, starting a cult or wishing to cultivate nature, they will all have their goals. No matter the outcome, remember, you can always start a new humanity.

Fill a galaxy with life
Each playthrough leaves a lasting legacy in the stars by generating a new planet for you to experiment with. Fill the galaxy with endless variations of life and be inspired to take a new path with your next creation.

70010000100277.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds – Open Network Test
70010000100277.description:
The Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds – Open Network Test is available now!

Race with players from around the world during this limited free-to-play period!

Open Network Test:
United States (PST) Thurs, Aug. 28, 9:00 p.m. to Mon, Sept. 1, 9:00 p.m.
United Kingdom (UTC) Fri, Aug. 29, 4:00 a.m. to Tues, Sept. 2, 4:00 a.m.
Japan (JST) Fri, Aug. 29, 1:00 p.m. to Tues, Sept. 2, 1:00 p.m.

Content included in the Open Network Test

• World Match – Online Mode (Days 1-2, 4): Compete against 11 other players and rank up! Squads will also be available during this period.
• Festival – Online Mode (Day 3): Try racing as Joker during the Joker Festival Event, where players are split into teams of 3 to compete for points. The team with the most points at the end of the Festival earns rewards!
• Grand Prix – Offline Mode: Go for gold in the Donpa Grand Prix!
