• Time Trial – Offline Mode: Race for the best time in 1 of 3 tracks from the Donpa Grand Prix!

All players who participate in the Open Network Test will receive an exclusive Decal and Title for their vehicles when the full game launches.

Please note:
• Local split-screen multiplayer is not supported on the Open Network Test.
• Save data will not carry over to the full game.

For more information, please see: https://RaceCrossWorlds.com/

70010000100285.name: Veins of DARKNESS Horror
70010000100285.intro: The truth lives in the darkness...
70010000100285.description:
Veins of DARKNESS Horror is a first-person horror experience where you play as an ordinary shift worker sent on a routine business trip. Your company rents you a house on the outskirts of town — quiet, isolated, and seemingly perfect for a short stay. But soon it becomes clear that something about this place is deeply wrong.

The atmosphere grows heavier with every passing moment. The deeper you explore, the more unsettling secrets begin to surface.

Along the way, you will encounter a variety of challenging and unusual puzzles that must be solved to uncover the truth and move forward. Each discovery pulls you further into the mystery hidden within the house.

Prepare for an intense horror experience where every step feels uncertain and every new corner may reveal something you wish you had never found.

70010000100290.name: Call of the Sea
70010000100290.intro: An otherworldly tale of mystery and love
70010000100290.description:
It is 1934, in the far reaches of the South Pacific. Norah has crossed the ocean following the trail of her missing husband’s expedition and finds herself on a lush island paradise - a nameless, forgotten place, dotted with the remnants of a lost civilization.
What strange secrets does it hold, and what might Norah unearth in her quest for the truth?

•	Explore and investigate a stunning tropical island, brimming with fantastic sights, lost ruins, and occult mysteries.
•	Investigate the clues left by a previous voyage, piece together what happened, and solve a variety of clever puzzles.
•	Experience a charming character study of a woman on her quest to discover the truth of the disappearance of her husband and to find out who she really is. Norah is fully voiced by Cissy Jones (Firewatch, The Walking Dead: Season 1, Baldur’s Gate III).
•	Immerse yourself in a story-driven adventure full of emotion, suspense, and surreal surprises.

70010000100299.name: Dollmare
70010000100299.intro: You were desperate for money and accepted a shady job at a doll factory. What seemed like an easy way to make a quick buck turned out to be something much more sinister.
70010000100299.description:
INSPECT ANOMALOUS DOLLS
Carefully inspect each doll for strange defects or eerie behavior. Spot every anomaly, from subtle flaws to unsettling movements, and ensure that only the ‘safe’ dolls make it through.

CREEPY WITHOUT SCREAMERS
Not in the mood to be chased and screamed at by monsters? Tired of jumpscares and endless fights for survival? Dollmare is just for you.
It’s still a horror game - you'll get scared, feel uneasy and constantly sense that something is watching you. There's no telling what might happen… but something definitely will. 

UNIQUE PLAYTHROUGHS
Every playthrough is slightly different. Many events in the game are not scripted, meaning that what you encounter is shaped by the moment.
No two players will share the exact same experience - your journey is distinctly your own. Explore and uncover the factory’s secrets, where each moment keeps you from guessing what will happen next.

What can you do on your shift?
▪ Inspect the dolls for irregularities,
▪ Explore the dark corners of the factory,
▪ Maintain production equipment,
▪ Follow strange protocols (just do - for your own safety),
▪ Uncover the mystery behind the dolls and the factory,
▪ Try not to lose your sanity… and your life.

70010000100309.name: Tristia: Legacy
70010000100309.description:
Dive into the story of Nanoca Flanka's revitalization of Tristia! 

The beautiful city of Tristia, nicknamed the "Jewel of the Sea," once bustled with maritime trade until recent dragon attacks stripped the city of its charm, and the people have resigned to its state of decay.

Tristia: Legacy is a city building simulation game where you play as crafter-inventor Nanoca Flanka, who has been challenged to restore the city within a year. Research and create new items for vendors, fulfill invention requests and build new facilities to help revitalize the city's economy. Enjoy a passionate story that unfolds based on your actions on your journey to bring back Tristia's luster.

70010000100332.name: The Final Payphone
70010000100332.intro: A terrifying experience inside a phone booth… Can you make it out alive?
70010000100332.description:
You find yourself inside an old, weathered phone booth.
After successfully making a call, you realize you can no longer get out...
Take on the role of the esteemed Professor Gojo and find a way to escape the phone booth.
Simple choices await you — and multiple endings lie ahead.

70010000100343.name: Overpowered 1 - Mars Infestation
70010000100343.intro: Exterminate hordes of menacing creatures in twin-stick shoot’em up style so your fellow humans can settle on a new planet!
70010000100343.description:
The year is 2050. Humans have been forced to flee Earth and colonize Mars! Now it’s up to you to exterminate hordes of aggressive local creatures so your kind can settle on the planet.

Overpowered 1 - Mars Infestation is an action-packed survival shooter presented in fluidly animated pixel art style! Step into the boots of a spacefaring soldier as you tackle 4 intense story missions, each with multiple objectives and levels to master.

Use intuitive twin-stick controls to move around top-down environments with determination and speed while gunning down all incoming threats. Collect power-ups to upgrade your weapons on the fly! The faster you take down enemies, the higher your score will climb, allowing you to challenge leaderboards in survival mode. How long can you stay in the fight?

• Exterminate waves of incoming enemies.
• Run, evade, aim and fire with intuitive twin-stick controls.
• Take on 4 story missions, each with multiple objectives!
• Challenge online leaderboards in survival mode.
• Enjoy retro pixel art aesthetics and a pumping soundtrack!

70010000100348.name: Deathless. The Hero Quest
70010000100348.intro: A collectible card game, roguelike, and turn-based strategy seamlessly combined.
70010000100348.description:
In Deathless, elements of a collectible card game, roguelike, and turn-based strategy combine seamlessly. Build a unique deck of cards, discover unusual relics, and defeat legendary bosses. Embark on the journey of each of the four heroes, unravel a web of intrigue, and protect the beautiful world of Belosvet. 

MEET THE HEROES
In Deathless, you’ll play as four different heroes, each with their own playstyle:
• Varvara the Fair - a cunning and clever treasure hunter who excels at manipulating enemy positions on the battlefield.
• Vasilisa the Wise - a powerful elemental sorceress who can summon and dismiss Nursemaids at will to assist her in combat.
• Dobrynya Nikitich - the famous hero, equipped with high health and solid defense, making him a master of defensive combat.
• Alyosha - a warrior from Kitezh. He always carries a sword forged from unique star-steel and the spellbane, a mysterious enchanted wand.

EXPERIMENT IN EVERY RUN
Hundreds of card combinations alongside relics provide endless opportunities for creativity - find the most powerful combos to defeat all the bosses and save Belosvet.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH
After each battle, you’ll decide where to go next. A swamp with a weak enemy or a clearing with a serious foe? The harder the path, the more valuable the reward.
Each run will offer its own paths.

DISCOVER THE STORY
Complete each hero’s quest chain to learn more about the world and the magical creatures that inhabit it.

70010000100350.name: Mini Wheels Racers - Turbo Toy Playground
70010000100350.intro: Every playground is a racetrack where toys race like champions!
70010000100350.description:
Get ready for a thrilling adventure in the colorful world of toy cars! Race through vibrant playgrounds packed with loops, ramps, and daring obstacles. Choose from a variety of charming cars, each with unique traits, and master dynamic tracks to outpace AI opponents.

Earn coins, upgrade your vehicles, and unlock new playgrounds like sandy beaches, lush gardens, and bustling cityscapes. Easy-to-learn controls and exciting challenges ensure fun for players of all ages.

Key Features:
• Breathtaking tracks: Explore unique circuits inspired by rooms, gardens, and other familiar places, all reimagined in a grand and playful style.
• Dynamic racing: Speed through thrilling loops, daring jumps, and alternate routes that keep the excitement alive.
• Complete customization: Choose and personalize your mini car with a variety of colors, decals, and upgrades that showcase your style.
• Spectacular power-ups: Collect unique power-ups that give you a strategic edge on the track, whether it’s a speed boost or a trap for your rivals.

Get ready for an explosive racing experience full of fun and competition in “Mini Wheels Racers: Turbo Toy Playground”! It’s time to test your skills and become the champion of this high-energy universe.

70010000100355.name: Pro Craps
70010000100355.description:
Pro Craps – Real Casino Action at Your Fingertips

Experience the excitement of the craps table with Pro Craps, a fully interactive game built for touchscreen play. Featuring real-time dice physics, full craps rules, and high-end 3D visuals, this game brings the energy and strategy of a real casino into the palm of your hand.

Features:
– Realistic dice physics for authentic roll outcomes
– Full implementation of standard craps rules and bet types
– High-quality 3D assets for tables, dice, chips, and more
– Dynamic win animations and smooth visual feedback
– Immersive music and sound effects that react to the action

Whether you're a longtime player or just learning the ropes, Pro Craps delivers a polished, responsive, and deeply engaging craps experience designed specifically for touchscreen consoles.

Roll the dice, manage your bets, and chase the thrill—just like the real thing

70010000100360.name: Arcade Archives CHOPPER 1
70010000100360.description:
CHOPPER 1" is a shooter released by SNK in 1988.
Pilot a combat helicopter deep into enemy territory in a mission to restore peace to your homeland.
Wielding overwhelming power far beyond what’s needed to simply protect one's family, what will these men discover at the end of their path of destruction?

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000100366.name: Camper Van: Make it Home
70010000100366.intro: Decorate and organize the camper van of your dreams!
70010000100366.description:
Embark on a journey of self-discovery as you build your own home-on-wheels, using a combination of creative block organization puzzles and relaxing interior design. Make your heart feel at ease and your camper van feel like home.
Make space in yourself for both your belongings and your own journey of discovery, all in one cozy van. In Camper Van: Make It Home, you’ll use block organization puzzles and interior design to customize your camper van into a dream home-on-wheels. Play around with each of your decoration items to discover their surprises and possibilities as you discover your own.
FEATURES
Zen Puzzles: 
Feel the satisfaction of organizing all the items in your luggage. Find the ideal place where each object fits perfectly or experiment with them at random. Play at your own pace, without pressure; this is meant to be a meditative and creative experience.
Progression and Outside Decoration: 
Obtain new vans to decorate as you progress in your journey. In addition to the interior, you can design the van’s outside area and make it as comfortable as possible.
Various Destinations: 
Adapt the van to the different destinations you’ll reach. Travel to the beach, visit a snowy plain, settle in the forest, and stop by cliffs during the different stages of your journey.
Perfect Pet:
Interact with a very special fellow traveller to keep you company on a journey of self-discovery.

70010000100371.name: CORE.SYS
70010000100371.intro: Break in, retrieve highly protected data and get out clean in a fast-paced hacking simulation!
70010000100371.description:
Get ready to hack your way through increasingly complex computer systems in retro arcade style! CORE.SYS is a brainteasing action puzzler where you’ll need to break through layers of digital security with quick-thinking strategy. Move your cursor around a 5x5 grid of alphanumeric key panels, use your scanning ability to identify the next piece of code needed and select that panel to complete the code sequence, thus bypassing security and gaining access to the next layer.

Be careful, though! The deeper you hack, you’ll have to contend with more intense firewall sweeps. Can you locate the data you need to extract and get out clean?

• Hack your way into high-security computer systems!
• Move your cursor around a 5x5 grid in each system layer.
• Detect the next piece of code needed to complete the sequence!
• Avoid firewalls and security sweep.

70010000100376.name: Cottonville
70010000100376.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70010000100376.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.


Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!


Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70010000100385.name: Ad Aquilonem - Seto’s Journey -
70010000100385.intro:
Slash, jump, pet, and run.
Guided by the wind, a heartfelt journey through ancient ruins.
70010000100385.description:
—What lies beyond this wind?
Legends, treasures, answers… but that’s not the goal.
It’s the wind blowing north—so we go, once more today.
Seto, a young adventurer with ears and a tail,
travels by his own will, without orders or destination.
Even he doesn’t know what awaits beyond the horizon.
He simply follows the wind—
and that is his “adventure.”
Ad Aquilonem: Seto and the Ruins of the Wind
is a score-based action game with simple controls.
Jump, slash, and overcome shifting terrain and foes
to push forward and rack up points.
Sometimes, you’ll soar skyward on the wind
into the bonus “Sky Stage.”
There, gather shining coins in a dreamy landscape
and aim for a high score.
Between stages, unwind with
the gentle “Petting Mode,” where you soothe Seto.
Moments of tension give way to quiet connection.
As you pet him, he slowly opens his heart to you—
a warm and tender bond.
You’re not just a player—you’re Seto’s partner.
Run with him. Fight with him.
Feel the wind, and let the journey begin.

70010000100395.name: Viking Colony Builder Valhalla
70010000100395.intro: Build a Viking empire that echoes through time.
70010000100395.description:
Embark on a grand adventure in "Viking Colony Builder Valhalla," a captivating strategy and simulation game where you lead your Viking clan to glory and prosperity. This game combines thrilling exploration with intricate management and combat systems.

Key Features:
	•	Settlement Building: Construct and expand your Viking village with diverse buildings, resources, and infrastructure to ensure prosperity.
	•	Trade & Economy: Trade resources, negotiate with other clans, and grow a powerful economy to sustain your people.
	•	Defenses & Fortifications: Protect your colony with strategic defenses against rival clans and mythical threats.
	•	Epic Combat: Command warriors in tactical battles, master weapons, and devise strategies to defeat enemies.
	•	Hunting & Gathering: Hunt wildlife and gather resources to keep your settlement supplied and thriving.
	•	Dynamic Events: Face unique challenges, participate in special events, and seize new opportunities.
	•	Colonist Progression: Train and upgrade your people’s skills, guiding them to specialize and boost efficiency.
	•	Raids & Conquests: Lead daring raids, plunder resources, and expand your influence across new territories.

Immerse yourself in the epic saga of Viking expansion and survival in "Viking Colony Builder Valhalla." Forge your destiny, build your legacy, and lead your people to greatness.

70010000100400.name: EGGCONSOLE LORD MONARCH PC-9801
70010000100400.intro: Take the throne as ruler of your nation, govern your lands, and read the ever-changing tides of battle to conquer all enemy nations!
70010000100400.description:
This is a real-time simulation game released in Japan by Nihon Falcom in 1991. It is the seventh installment in the Dragon Slayer series, but since it is not an RPG—unlike most of the series—it is known among fans as a unique title.

The player becomes the king and governs their country, with the goal of defeating all other nations. You issue commands to units to cultivate land, build houses, construct fences for defense, or build bridges to strengthen your base, while combining units to create armies. The stage is cleared by capturing the enemy’s castle. After clearing a stage, stats rate are shown, so you can replay to aim for higher scores.

There are a total of 53 stages included. As the game progresses, the difficulty naturally increases, and visual elements like characters and themes change as well, allowing players to enjoy a fresh experience each time without getting bored.

With its fast pace and intense territorial battles, this game is a superb simulation title that can be recommended to a wide range of players.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000100403.name: Death Howl
70010000100403.intro: Master the grid, defy death. Enter a grim Spirit Realm in this open-world deck builder.
70010000100403.description:
Step into the myth-shrouded lands where the hunter Ro begins her journey to bring her son back from the dead. Immerse yourself in the depths of the Spirit World, fractured into 4 realms and scarred with 13 distinct regions. Confront over 30 enemy types and harness the potential of more than 160 cards, forging unique archetypes and a multitude of powerful combinations. A dark journey awaits you, spanning 25+ hours of gameplay, with numerous enthralling side quests and grim boss battles.

Master Your Deck-Building Skills
Craft over 160 cards and fashion synergistic decks that focus on poison, strength, sacrifice, retaliation, backstabbing, blocking, movement, and more. Discover shamanic totems with unique effects to enhance your deck. Each new element allows you to tailor your tactical style as you prepare for your next deadly encounter.

Engage in Grid-Based Combat
Face a host of restless spirits - Skulldogs, Crackle Bursts, Woeful Seashrooms and more - in grid-based battles where each move is crucial. Test your wit by fighting unique enemy types, powerful bosses, and mini-bosses, all while taking into account environmental hazards and boons. Grow stronger, adapt your deck, and choose your battles as you explore a vast world filled with dangerous challenges.

Journey to the spirit realm
In forgotten lands shrouded by myth, Ro - a hunter from a small tribe - is overcome by grief following the death of her beloved son. Guided by voices from another world, she transcends into the realm of spirits, in hopes of bringing him back. Meet strange spirits and help them with quests and challenges that affect your deck – although not all of them may have your best interests at heart. Discover a mysterious world of forgotten lore, where darkness whispers secrets and invites you to unearth buried memories.

70010000100408.name: Releaseburg
70010000100408.intro:
The purge is over. The nightmare begins.
Every bullet counts. Every mistake kills.
Welcome to Releaseburg.
70010000100408.description:
Enter the relentless world of Releaseburg, a rogue-like survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic city consumed by chaos. The streets run red as hordes of grotesque zombies rise from the ruins, turning every encounter into a brutal test of skill, precision, and nerve.

Master the unique release-based shooting system that rewards timing, focus, and control. From quick pistol bursts to devastating rifle shots, every weapon demands mastery. Adapt your strategy, navigate procedurally generated cityscapes, and face wave after wave of merciless enemies eager to drag you into the abyss.

Each run offers new challenges, weapons, and paths to survival — no two journeys through Releaseburg are ever the same. In this world of blood and decay, your aim is your lifeline… and hesitation is death.

- Rogue-Like Intensity: No two runs are alike – each playthrough delivers fresh layouts, enemies, and challenges.
- Release-Based Shooting: Master precision timing to unleash powerful attacks and control every battle.
- Diverse Arsenal: Choose from pistols, rifles, and burst-fire weapons to suit your combat style.
- Adaptive Combat: Face a variety of enemy types, each demanding unique tactics and quick thinking.
-Brutal Atmosphere: Experience a blood-soaked urban wasteland brought to life with visceral visuals and sound.
-Endless Replayability: Procedural levels and evolving encounters ensure constant tension and discovery.

70010000100414.name: Titi Drop
70010000100414.intro: Merge the right way… and watch her smile.
70010000100414.description:
Every move matters. Drop suggestive emojis and merge them to create bigger, juicier combos. It’s simple, keep it smooth, aim just right, and let things grow.

She’s watching — and the better you play, the more you’ll please her. Satisfy her with every perfect drop.

Features:
- 3 levels with unique shapes.
- A stunning woman to please.
- Awesome, game-changing power-ups.
- Beautiful backgrounds and relaxing music.

Can you handle the pressure?

70010000100416.name: Horror Tale: Remaster
70010000100416.intro: Start a scary adventure and be the first to solve all the mysteries of this horror game!
70010000100416.description:
In this horror game, you'll have to immerse yourself in a thrilling and exciting adventure together with the main characters! Children have been missing for a long time in Lakewitch, and you are destined to solve this creepy mystery. Who is the kidnapper, and why is he doing it? Where are the children disappearing to, and how to save them? You can solve all the puzzles and find out the answers...if you don't get scared! 
 In the first episode of this horror, you will meet your friend Harry, who has come up with a plan to save you from the kidnapper of children while you're waiting for the return of your parents. Together with him, you will try to fortify the tree house, so that the scary kidnapper will not get to you. On the way to your goal, puzzles, moments of fear, unexpected twists and turns, and lots of fun await you! 
 The story will develop rapidly and very unpredictably. This horror game is an exciting, fun, and scary adventure to America of the '90s!

70010000100419.name: Horror Tale 2: Remaster
70010000100419.intro: Dive into the mysterious story of Lakewich. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the missing children before the kidnapper finds you.
70010000100419.description: Start a scary adventure and be the first to solve all the mysteries of this horror game! You'll have to immerse yourself in a thrilling and exciting adventure together with the main characters! Children have been missing for a long time in Lakewitch, and you are destined to solve this creepy mystery. Who is the kidnapper, and why is he doing it? Where are the children disappearing to, and how to save them? You can solve all the puzzles and find out the answers...if you don't get scared! In this part of our horror, you will meet Samantha and try to get out of prison with her. You will get to know new secrets of the terrible kidnapper, which will lead you to new frightening discoveries. On the way to your goal, puzzles, icey moments of fear, unexpected twists and turns, and lots of fun await you! The story will develop rapidly and very unpredictably. This horror game is an exciting, fun, and scary adventure to America of the '90s!

70010000100422.name: Horror Tale 3: The Witch
70010000100422.intro: Face the witch. Unravel the mystery. Survive the nightmare.
70010000100422.description:
The nightmare continues… and the witch is watching.
In Horror Tale 3, the darkest secrets of a cursed neighborhood come to light. As children keep disappearing without a trace, Tom’s search for the truth brings him face-to-face with Wanda—the terrifying witch behind the horror. But she’s not the only surprise waiting in the shadows. New friends, strange allies, and buried secrets emerge as you step into the most intense chapter yet.
Explore five eerie, handcrafted locations that reveal the haunting past of a disturbed child kidnapper. Use your mind to solve chilling puzzles, find hidden objects, and piece together clues that will uncover what really happened in this quiet, snowy town. But danger is everywhere—and Wanda will do whatever it takes to stop you.
This is more than just a game—it’s a psychological puzzle wrapped in horror and mystery, set in the eerie glow of 1990s America. With atmospheric visuals, a haunting original soundtrack, and an unforgettable villain, Horror Tale 3 pulls you into a suspenseful world where every step forward might be your last.
Can you survive the truth? Or will you become her next victim?

70010000100425.name: Mist
70010000100425.intro:
After a crash in the mist, your daughter vanishes—
you evolve, fight alien horrors,
and uncover the fate of a dying Earth.
70010000100425.description:
Your daughter is missing. The world is gone. Only the Mist remains.
In Mist, a devastating crash marks the beginning of your descent into a world lost to alien terror. As a father, you search desperately for your child—but what you find instead is a crumbling world buried in fog, crawling with monsters beyond comprehension.
This is no ordinary RPG. Mist fuses idle progression, visceral real-time combat, and an evolving horror narrative into a genre-defying experience. As you explore the ruins of civilization, you’ll form a pact with a mysterious alien being that grants you strength—at a cost. Level up, mutate, and unlock terrifying new abilities as you battle grotesque creatures and uncover long-buried truths.
But the world isn’t empty. Survivors remain—scarred, strange, and not always trustworthy. Your decisions in branching dialogue shape who lives, who dies, and what kind of person you become. Upgrade your idle harvesting machines, forge new weapons, and evolve into something far greater… or far more monstrous.
With each step, you draw closer to your daughter—and deeper into the Mist. Eight haunting regions await, filled with side quests, riddles, powerful enemies, and moral dilemmas. Can you hold on to your humanity when everything else is lost?
Mist is a bold mix of action, survival, and storytelling in a world where hope flickers like a dying light. Step into the fog—and face what waits within.

70010000100428.name: THE EXIT: LIMINAL SUPERMARKET HORROR
70010000100428.description:
Welcome to the supermarket where reality breaks down.
THE EXIT: LIMINAL SUPERMARKET HORROR takes you into a familiar yet deeply unsettling environment — a brightly lit store with endless aisles, looping layouts, and exits that never lead out.

At first, it feels empty. But the silence carries weight. The signs shift when you're not looking. The deeper you go, the more the space changes — and so does your understanding of what’s real.

This is not just a store. It’s a place caught between worlds — and you’re not alone in it.

70010000100435.name: The Great Rebellion: Edition 2084
70010000100435.intro: Immerse yourself in the dystopian Europe of the year 2084, where the Lucis Lux Mega-Corporation owns everything and the people own nothing.
70010000100435.description:
The Great Rebellion: 2084 Edition is a cyberpunk 2D sidescrolling run'n'gun roguelite using mouse/twinstick-shooter controls. It features randomly generated levels, multiple difficulty modes (including optional permadeath), a dynamic soundtrack and an upgradeable player character.

In this Cyberpunk-inspired run'n'gun-roguelite the world is controlled by technocratic elites who seek digital immortality and transcend their human bodies and they will stop at nothing to achieve their goal.

Fight through levels in glorious 16bit-style retro pixel art and listen to an awesome dynamic soundtrack while you blast away robots using one of 60+ weapons. Upgrade your character, find items, unlock allies that will help you and find the spirits of  mythical heroes that will give you special powers. Now it is your turn to join the Great Rebellion!

70010000100470.name: Yabai Girls: Saucy Police
70010000100470.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000100470.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000100472.name: Yabai Girls: Elegant Egyptian
70010000100472.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000100472.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000100474.name: Yabai Girls: Hot Hiker
70010000100474.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000100474.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000100476.name: Yabai Girls: Enchanted Exorcist
70010000100476.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000100476.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000100478.name: Yabai Girls: Amazing Accountant
70010000100478.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000100478.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000100480.name: Yabai Girls: Heavenly Homemaker
70010000100480.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000100480.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000100487.name: Gunner-chan!
70010000100487.intro: A 2.5D top-down, roguelike shooter set in a base that has been taken over by a revolt of robots.
70010000100487.description:
<Features>
1. Roguelike gameplay, with a different map with each playthrough.
2. Various guns can be picked up in the base. Make use of their features and plan your strategy.
3. There is no reloading or refilling ammunition. Even if you don't have a gun, you can utilize a beam knife for close quarter combat.
4. Unlike twin-stick shooters, your weapon automatically aims at the enemy when within range.
5. You're invincible while dashing. Use this to dodge enemy bullets.
6. Acquire random gear to upgrade the protagonist.
7. Save up money to buy guns and gear at the store.
8. Once you fight a boss, you can unlock a practice mode for them.
9. There are unlockable elements that can be carried over in easy and normal game modes.
10. In expert mode, there are no carry over elements at all. Use only your skills as a player to break your enemies.

70010000100492.name: EVA
70010000100492.intro: Minimal input, maximum tension — return to the blue planet.
70010000100492.description:
The astronaut awakens aboard a space station—then a fragmented SOS from Earth cuts through the silence.
With the ultra-high-performance planetary defense AI GAIA (Global Autonomous Intelligence Assistant), undertake a mission to return to Earth.
Your only tools are the skills honed in training: “Jump” and “Move.”
Countless space debris, electromagnetic rings, and rampaging drones—one misstep in zero-gravity is instant failure.
Push through the pressure and uncover what happened to Earth.

70010000100497.name: Paranormal Watcher
70010000100497.intro: Spot, report, and survive. Paranormal anomalies await your sharp eye.
70010000100497.description:
Paranormal Watcher invites you into the eerie world of paranormal hunting from a safe distance but don’t let the safety of the screen fool you. As a remote paranormal investigator, you’re tasked with monitoring haunted locations through surveillance cameras. Your mission: detect and report every unsettling anomaly that creeps into view, from flickering lights to ghostly apparitions.

paranormal activity you capture isn’t always obvious objects might move, shadows could shift, and figures may emerge from the darkness. Only your sharp eye and quick reflexes can catch the disturbances in real time and fix the scene by filing accurate anomaly reports. But beware: the ghosts might be watching you, too.

5 levels to complete.

70010000100504.name: Miko Girls
70010000100504.intro:
Many mysterious and cute shrine maidens appear!
An easy puzzle game that anyone can play!
70010000100504.description:
Collect pieces of the cute shrine maidens and complete the puzzle!
Clear stages to see high-quality images of the maidens who serve the gods!

70010000100510.name: Pixel Game Maker Series HacoPiyo
70010000100510.intro: Stretch, fall, and jump over obstacles in this action puzzle game! Join the mysterious HacoPiyo on his big adventure as he stretches and jumps!
70010000100510.description:
■Game Description
Control Hakopiyo and aim for the goal in each stage!

Press 《B》 to jump!
Jump over slightly higher areas or gaps!

Press 《A》 to stretch out!
Stretch out as long as you can and fall over to clear the stage!

Press the 《R》 button to bring up the menu.
You can restart or change settings here.

■Save Points
Save your progress on the title screen.
Return to the title screen and press the home button to exit.

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.

70010000100523.name: Dawnfolk
70010000100523.intro: In Dawnfolk, you will explore an uncharted medieval fantasy world, manage resources, build cities, and survive against many dangers.
70010000100523.description:
In a world of darkness, you are the ruler of a kingdom lost to shadows. On a quest to save your people, you have found the mythical creature called “Lueur,” a fiery companion who will light your way. But what kind of ruler will you be?

Every choice matters as you explore different strategies and play styles in Dawnfolk.

Minigames add a unique challenge to supporting your people. The better you are at the minigames, the more resources you get and the more likely your community will weather the darkness. 

Not everyone has time to invest hundreds of hours into learning how to play a grand strategy game. You can dive right in and start building your settlement immediately, going from a handful of tents to a big city in less than an hour. 

Decades ago, titanic obsidian monoliths rained down from the sky. A raging tempest of unfathomable darkness gathered around them, slowly crawling across the world and consuming all in its path. You are the ruler of this land, once mighty and resolute, now broken and wounded. But not defeated! You intend to reclaim the realm and bring back light to the world.

After years of wandering, your story begins as you finally find the Lueur, a mythical creature able to radiate a powerful enough brightness to dissipate darkness. It is time to explore the shadows and rebuild your realm.

Your choices determine the fate of your realm and its inhabitants.

Will you turn a blind eye to impending disasters, or will you face them head-on? How will you handle the tough moral choices that define your legacy? Can you grow and optimize your cities not just survive, but to thrive as a shining beacon for future settlers?

Will you succeed in bringing light back to the world?

70010000100536.name: Pharma Dealer Simulator
70010000100536.intro: Build your pharmaceutical empire from the ground up.
70010000100536.description:
Step into the role of an ambitious dealer and turn the city streets into a profitable business territory. Buy medicines from doctors, sell them to clients, and gradually build a solid distribution network. Your goal is clear: create your own commercial “empire,” but be careful – the police watch the city closely, and every deal can attract suspicion. 

Choose your clients wisely and find smart ways to avoid trouble.
You have several distinct locations at your disposal: relaxed areas, the bustling city center, or dangerous neighborhoods where the rules are completely different. Each area offers new opportunities but also challenges that force you to think strategically.

Key Features:
-Trading and strategy: buy, sell, and grow your own network.
-Varied locations: explore areas with unique challenges and advantages.
-Constant tension: avoid patrols and stay safe.
-Continuous progression: invest your earnings to expand your business.
-Risky choices: balance caution and fast profit.

Success depends on how you plan and manage your risks.

70010000100550.name: Cozy Adventures
70010000100550.intro: Relax, explore, and uncover hidden beauty.
70010000100550.description:
Step into the gentle world of Cozy Adventures, a relaxing low-poly exploration game where curiosity is your compass and discovery is your reward.

Wander through a whimsical medieval kingdom, complete with sleepy villages, misty forests, and forgotten ruins. Then set sail to a vibrant tropical island, where sun-drenched beaches, mysterious caves, and lush jungles await.

Features:

Two handcrafted open-world levels: a medieval kingdom and a tropical island

Relaxing gameplay with no combat or time limits

Low-poly inspired art style with soothing colors and ambient soundscapes

Hidden locations to uncover at your leisure

Ideal for winding down, mindful play, or cozy exploration sessions

70010000100553.name: GET TO WORK SIMULATOR
70010000100553.intro: Avoid the boss, dodge traps, and skate your way to the desk!
70010000100553.description:
Welcome to GET TO WORK SIMULATOR – a chaotic and hilarious adventure where every office day turns into a real challenge! Your task is simple – get to your workplace... but it won’t be easy!
Move through the office building on roller skates, overcome crazy obstacles, use ramps, avoid traps, and make sure the strict boss doesn’t catch you in an embarrassing situation.
Features:
-Roller skating in the office – forget about elevators and stairs, race your way through the building!
-Humorous commentary – your attempts to reach your desk won’t go unnoticed!
-Ramps, traps, and chaos – navigate through the office mayhem to prove you’re the ultimate employee!
-Quick reflexes and skill – dodge obstacles and show off your agility!
Are you ready for the most unpredictable workday of your life? Strap on your skates – it’s time to get to work!

70010000100558.name: ShapeHero Factory
70010000100558.intro: Run an ever-evolving, paint-fuelled factory and create magical, shape-based warriors! Send them into battle, then build an even better factory on your next run.
70010000100558.description:
Welcome to the world’s weirdest factory. You don’t swing swords or cast spells, instead you build tiny heroes out of shapes, and hope for the best as they come up against endless swarms of increasingly brutal enemies. All in a day’s work!

*BUILD IT WEIRED. BUILD IT STRONG.
•Drop shapes onto conveyor belts to craft self-operation heroes.
•Want a soldier? Try a circle and a triangle.
•Want a tank? Try circle and square.
•Heroes fight on their own, you’re just there to make the decisions.

*EVERY WAVE IS A TEST
•Enemies get weirder, stronger and ruder as you progress 
•Defend your Portal from swarming pests and brute squads 
•Earn magical artifacts and upgrade your factory like there's no tomorrow.

*DIFFERENT MASTER DIFFERENT RUN
•Different playable characters - ‘Masters’ - have different hero types and build strategies
•Experiment with different characters to unlock their Arcane Knowledge (permanent upgrades) 
•Find a playstyle that suits you best

*YOUR FACTORY IS THE REAL HERO
You can’t control your troops, but you can outsmart the darkness waiting to gobble up your kingdom, one conveyor belt at a time.

70010000100563.name: Bokeh Adventure
70010000100563.intro: Solve creative challenges with your camera in this puzzle platformer game.
70010000100563.description:
Randy dreams of becoming a great photographer. To help him, his grandfather lends him his camera, promising that he can keep it if he proves he’s ready.

Explore a world full of challenges that you can overcome by using your camera in creative ways. Earn photographer badges by collecting film rolls in each level and show that you have what it takes to succeed.

But remember, the camera is just a tool, what truly matters is your creativity!

Features
• Travel across diverse thematic worlds, from lush green fields to a food world, and even outer space.
• Use your camera to capture and move objects, eliminate them to reset their positions, and use your creativity to overcome challenges.
• Collect as many film rolls as possible to earn badges and prove your photography skills.
• Unlock and wear fun costumes while exploring the worlds.

70010000100571.name: Garten of Banban 8: Anti Devil
70010000100571.intro: Explore the most obscure levels of Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the new deceives and mysteries that await you. Uncover the truth behind the place, and find your missing child…
70010000100571.description:
You were tricked by your friends. After the latest events, you’ll need to delve deeper into the mysterious establishment of Banban’s Kindergarten.

Now, you’re completely on your own - your friends are either dead or against you…
From now on, you’ll only meet new enemies, who will make sure you never feel alone. Be careful - in Banban’s Kindergarten, they are lurking in every corner, waiting for you.

The future of everything depends on you. Survive the most obscure levels of Banban’s Kindergarten and get closer to the truth!

Additional languages:
- Arabic (AR),
- Bulgarian (BG/БЪЛГАРСКИ),
- Czech (CZ/ČEŠTINA),
- Danish (DK/DANSK),
- Finnish (FIN/SUOMI),
- Hungarian (HU/MAGYAR),
- Indonesian (IDN/INDONESIA),
- Norwegian (NOR/NORGE),
- Polish (PL/POLSKI),
- Romanian (ROU/ROMÂNĂ),
- Russian (RUS/РУССКИЙ),
- Swedish (SE/SVENSKA),
- Turkish (TUR/TÜRKÇE),
- Ukrainian (UA/УКРАЇНСЬКА).

70010000100578.name: Master Lemon: The Quest for Iceland
70010000100578.intro: A magical adventure game created as a tribute to the life of my friend Lemon, a young polyglot who died in a car accident while chasing his dream of living in Iceland.
70010000100578.description:
When Lemon discovers the Icelandic word "RATLJÓST" (meaning "enough light to illuminate your path"), he gains the magical ability to dispel darkness and is transported to a mysterious dimension inhabited by the Bashirs - confused beings slowly recovering their memories.

Armed with words as spells, Lemon must:

“RATLJÓST” -  Dispel layers of darkness
"GAMBIARRA" - Master the art of creative problem-solving by combining objects
"VEGVISIR" - Learn the ability to read maps in scattered stones
Discover untranslatable words that unlock new magical abilities

Each word Lemon learns opens new dialogue options, reveals hidden items, and grants unique powers. From creating objects with "KOPFKINO" to teleporting between islands, language becomes your greatest tool.

Navigate through:
The Garden of Untranslatable Words - where lost Bashires reconnect with their identities
The Desert of Wonders - featuring humanity's greatest inventions
The Temple of Meaning - a place where memories come alive
The Island of Destiny - where fate itself can be challenged

In Master Lemon, every word matters and the power of language can literally change worlds.

Experience a unique blend of adventure, linguistic discovery, and emotional storytelling in this tribute to the beauty of human language and the courage to follow your dreams.

70010000100583.name: EGGCONSOLE Brandish Renewal PC-9801
70010000100583.intro: Play as the bounty target Ares, battle various enemies, overcome numerous traps, and escape from the underground labyrinth!
70010000100583.description:
This is an action RPG released in Japan by Nihon Falcom in 1995 and is a renewed version of Brandish (1991). The player takes on the role of the bounty head Ares, fighting various enemies, overcoming jumps and traps, and aiming to escape from the underground labyrinth.

The game’s screen layout appears orthodox, but it uses a head-up view similar to car navigation, where the character always moves toward the top, and turning changes the orientation of the terrain. This rotating map allows players to view the terrain from multiple angles, but it also means that switches are sometimes placed in blind spots. If you get stuck, try rotating the map; you might discover an unexpected way forward.

Compared to the original version, this remake features enhanced sound, changes to the BGM, more visibility of pitfalls, and adjustments for monsters recovering health—making this Brandish even more enjoyable.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000100591.name: SUPER ROBOT WARS Y
70010000100591.description:
Super Robot Wars is a grid-based tactical combat RPG that brings units and pilots from a variety of anime together to battle their mutual foes.

Place your units strategically and command them to defeat your enemies!

Upgrade your units and train your pilots with credits and resources you earn after every mission. Super Robot Wars Y introduces the new Assist Link system, which brings your favorite sidekick characters into action, allowing them to participate in missions and enhance their abilities and effects. Strengthen your heroes to overcome the next challenge!

Enjoy the impossible epic battles where units and pilots from all the series clash together! Embark on a journey into lore-rich, new saga of Super Robot Wars!

Featured series include:
Reideen the Brave
COMBATTLER V
Aura Battler Dunbine
New Story of AURA BATTLER Dunbine
Heavy Metal L-Gaim
Mobile Suit Z Gundam
Mobile Suit Gundam Char's Counterattack
M-MSV
Mobile Fighter G Gundam
Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny
Mobile Suit Gundam the Witch from Mercury Season 1
Mazinkaiser VS the Great General of Darkness
Getter Robo Arc
Majestic Prince
MACROSS Delta
Macross Delta: Passionate Walküre
Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion III Glorification
Code Geass Lelouch of the Re;surrection
Godzilla Singular Point
SSSS.DYNAZENON

*Deluxe Edition and Ultimate Edition products are also available. Be careful of duplicate purchases.

70010000100608.name: Arcade Archives STEEL WORKER
70010000100608.description:
"STEEL WORKER" is a puzzle game released by TAITO in 1980.
In this game, your objective is to connect a path to the destination by placing scaffolding for a workman performing high-altitude work on a construction site, ensuring he does not fall.
To prevent the workman from having an accident, it is sometimes necessary to strategically place the scaffolding so that he takes a detour or reverses his path. Remember to value your workers! Stay safe out there!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000100613.name: Maid Cafe on Electric Street
70010000100613.intro:
Fuwa Fuwa, a maid cafe on its last legs.
By a twist of fate, you've become the boss.
Now turn things around with four adorable maids!
70010000100613.description:
“Um, please be the new manager of the cafe!”
 Fuwa Fuwa Cafe—a maid cafe tucked away in a quiet part of Nipponbashi, and where a wonderful encounter is about to take place...
 You, the protagonist, quit your job at an extremely toxic workplace and find yourself at a run-down maid cafe, where a cute maid named Shiro works.
 At first, you only agree to become the new manager because it conveniently met all your urgent needs, but soon the colorful maids Miyu, Favna, and Honoka join in. And as you spend time with them and meet the people of Electric Street, both you and the cafe will gradually liven up once more.

 Maid Cafe on Electric Street is a game set in Nipponbashi, the heart of Osaka’s otaku culture. This is a story-focused adventure game where you enjoy daily life at Fuwa Fuwa Cafe. Make yourself a cup of coffee, relax, and immerse yourself in a heartwarming story.

 ■4 Cute, Memorable Heroines
Enjoy voice-acted conversations with the four maids, all with distinct personalities.
 ♥Shiro (VA: Ikumi Hasegawa)
 A maid who loves Fuwa Fuwa Cafe. A huge otaku for anime and video games, she talks really fast when she’s gushing about the things she loves, and often splurges on merch without thinking whenever she visits an anime shop. A little clumsy, but works hard every day to become the cute maid she’s always wanted to be.

 ♥Miyu (VA: Ayasa Itou)
 A game otaku and gyaru with a big appetite. Loves both eating and cooking, and apparently really enjoys serving her cooking to customers at Fuwa Fuwa Cafe. Is actually Shiro's friend on the online game Magic Angel, so they knew each other before actually meeting in real life.

 ♥Favna (VA: Sayumi Suzushiro)
 A mysterious girl dressed in gothic Lolita fashion. Speaks in riddles and demands the protagonist become her familiar. She sometimes accidentally drops the edgy act when she's taken by surprise though, so maybe she's just got a serious case of chuunibyou...?

 ♥Honoka (VA: Yui Ishikawa)
 A girl with a Kansaiben dialect who works as a shrine maiden at her family shrine. Practically in charge of the shrine, she is reliable and very good at handling money! Is actually a doujin author...?

 ■The Daily Life with the Four Maids of Fuwa Fuwa Cafe
 As the manager of Fuwa Fuwa, you’ll live in Nipponbashi, Osaka and spend time with your favorite maid... or maids. Go shopping, watch a movie, go for karaoke, buy a present for a special someone... What you choose to do, and with whom, will affect the ending of the story.

 ■Make Fuwa Fuwa Cafe Famous!
As the manager, it's your job to run the cafe. Improve the maids' work skills, optimize their roles, and drive up profits. The money you earn can be spent on shopping, food, capsule toys and more!

 ■The Stunning Sights of Nipponbashi
 Visit stores you can find in the real Nipponbashi, such as Surugaya, Sofmap, Dragon Star, Super Potato, and Karaoke Rainbow, among the many others we've collaborated with.
 Go shopping by yourself or go on dates with the maids and enjoy life in otaku heaven. But don't stay out too late; you still have a cafe to run!

 ■Collectable Capsule Toys
 In this game, you can try to collect your favorite capsule toy series and experience that unique gacha thrill of not knowing what you're getting. Keep cranking those machines until you've collected them all!

 Other than capsule toys, there's more merch for you to collect, like video games, books, and figures. You can also decorate your room and watch as your collections reach completion!

70010000100629.name: We Were Here Too
70010000100629.intro: We Were Here Too is all about cooperative discovery, immersion and teamwork. You and a partner must solve puzzles through smart communication and observation.
70010000100629.description:
As your final hour approaches, a large structure looms up in the distance - towering above the relentless storm. With nowhere else to go, you decide to enter this mysterious place, only to find yourself trapped inside… Will you be able to find a way out?

Cooperative – Your voice will have to lead the way. Placed in the shoes of explorers with only walkie-talkies in hand, you are lost in a castle frozen in time.  

Immersive – The warmth of life abandoned the halls of Castle Rock long ago Immerse yourself in a thrilling experience as you and your partner puzzle your way through this abandoned fortress. Lose yourself in brand new environments and an original soundtrack.

Mysterious – We were not alone... Darkness took over these once magnificent halls. Can you discover the truth behind the grim fate of Castle Rock?

We Were Here Too features:
- Communication-based teamwork – Act as each other’s eyes and ears, work together to find a way out of the castle
- Asymmetrical roles – Both players experience different locations and storylines as part of a shared adventure
- Brainteasing puzzles and environments - Multiple puzzle solutions ensure no playthrough will be the same! 
- Ancient secrets – There are many hidden corners to be discovered within Castle Rock
- A dark, twisted mystery - What are you willing to sacrifice to gain your freedom… or uncover the truth?

70010000100634.name: Detective Dotson
70010000100634.intro: Become Detective Doston and solve a series of cases in a vibrant city in India.
70010000100634.description:
I'm Dotson. I used to be an actor, but now I'm a detective. One day, I stumbled upon a mysterious case related to my father's sudden death. At first, it was a simple investigation, but as I followed the clues, I realized everything was connected.

Explore a vibrant modern-day city in India, where 2D and 3D art styles blend seamlessly. Stroll past food carts, dance stages, and busy bazaars, soaking up the sights, sounds, and spirit of India. Every street corner holds a potential lead, a valuable item, or an unexpected encounter.

Trade, bargain, and uncover hidden clues from a cast of over 50 characters — each with their own secrets, needs, and personalities.

Haggle like a pro to get what you need. Buy incense sticks, street food, Bollywood memorabilia and more, and trade them smartly to open up new conversations, gather intel, and move closer to solving each case.

Fit the clues you collect on an Evidence Board. By placing items, people, and other items in slots, you'll get closer to the truth.

Jump into fun mini-games scattered around the city, including street cricket and Bollywood dance-offs. Winning games means better bargaining power — and sometimes, vital clues.

Detective Dotson is a charming indie game made in India!

70010000100639.name: Cash Laundry Simulator
70010000100639.intro: Turn stacks of chaos into spotless profit. Count it, clean it, cash it out.
70010000100639.description:
Ever wondered what it takes to clean and move dirty money? In Cash Laundry Simulator, you step into a high-risk, hands-on world where precision and speed decide your success. From detecting counterfeits to packaging stacks for delivery, every detail matters. Will you master the art of laundering and build a reputation for flawless work?

Key Features:
- Money Mechanics – Carry, collect, and bundle bills with tape, then slice them open with a knife when needed.
-  Authenticity Check – Use counting machines to sort bills by denomination and UV scanners to expose fakes or duplicates.
-  Wash & Dry – Run cash through washing machines and dryers to clean and restore it before shipping.
- Order System – Track assignments on your tablet, sort bills into three different box types, and send them off via conveyor.
- Collectible Bills – Rare notes can be pinned to your collection board, unlocking trophies and bragging rights.
- Dynamic Drops – Watch bills rain down from pipes, falling as singles or filling up boxes for you to process.
 
Money may be dirty, but in Cash Laundry Simulator it’s your job to make it shine. Take on orders, outsmart counterfeits, and rise as the ultimate money-cleaning expert. Are you ready to roll up your sleeves and keep the cash flowing?

70010000100646.name: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker
70010000100646.intro: In this D&D-inspired visual novel you will run a cozy seaside tavern, meet adventurers, gather rumours and mix fate-altering drinks to stop dreams from twisting into nightmares.
70010000100646.description:
- D&D-inspired visual novel with 8 unique characters. 
- Immersive reading experience of at least 6 hours on your first play-through. 
- Branching narrative with 3 unique endings.
- Casual drink mixing and quest building with a dash of challenge – a refinement of the original game’s mechanics.
- LGBTQ+ positive representation. 
- Content warning: mentions of death, grief, and violence.
- A new standalone game in the Tavern Talk universe!

Once Upon A Time...
...you find yourself in a little, bleary portside town in the south-east of Phesoa. There, 36 years before the events of Tavern Talk, you dive into the role of the Tavernkeep, the owner of The Drowsy Dragon, a small quayside bar on the coast of Borkam. 

You have a special ability, gifted by one of the Great Dragon Gods or acquired through wizardly hubris: Mixing magic drinks that can alter the fate of your guests—be it mean mercenaries, savvy sailors or ambitious adventurers. Every guest, no matter who they are, has a place in your warm tavern by the seaside. 

In The Drowsy Dragon, fate is not written in the stars, it is written in the menu! Mix unique drinks from a wide ensemble of magical potions—but be aware: There is more than one solution! 

As you listen to stories brimming with the spirit of adventure, you sit within the cozy walls of your tavern and pick up rumors to turn them into quests. Some of them are old sailor’s yarn, so sort them thoroughly before sticking them up the wall! 

As you meet new and familiar faces, all seems well. Your establishment is flourishing and friendships are made. All until something starts brewing on the horizon, something that’s going to twist your brightest dreams into your darkest nightmares. 

Content Warning
Like in every good Pen & Paper campaign, Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker touches topics that may hit right in the feels. Please be aware that there will be mentions of death, grief and violence.

70010000100648.name: INDIKA
70010000100648.intro: Play a third-person, story-driven game set in alternative Russia at the turn of the XIX century where religious visions clash with harsh reality.
70010000100648.description:
FEATURES:
•	Play a TPP adventure game that combines an imaginative story with a dark sense of humor
•	Join a young nun Indika on her journey of self-discovery
•	Meet the devil himself as Indika’s unlikely travel companion
•	Explore the hidden depths of Indika’s soul while tackling unique puzzle elements
•	Travel through surreal landscapes of Russia seen in a distorted mirror
•	Uncover Indika's troubled past in the form of 2D pixel art mini-games

MEET A NOT-SO-ORDINARY NUN

INDIKA is a third-person, story-driven game set in a strange world where religious visions clash with harsh reality. It tells the story of a young nun who sets off on a journey of self-discovery with the most unusual, horn-headed companion by her side.

On the outside, Indika seems to be a typical nun attempting to adjust to a difficult and monotonous monastery life. Humble and innocent in her appearance, do not be deceived as this young girl has also made a highly unlikely acquaintance—as she speaks with the devil himself.

Indika’s unusual connection with the Evil One leads her on an errand beyond the safe walls of the monastery. The world she discovers can only be described as a wild combination of comedy and tragedy straight out of the novels by Dostoyevski and Bulhakov.

ENJOY AN INDIE GAME WHERE EVERYTHING GOES

The subjects of religion and authority are prevalent throughout Indika’s journey and she’ll be faced with many questions along the way. Guide her to find the answers one by one before she can finish her life-defining odyssey.

Odd Meter is a small, independent studio formerly based in Moscow and now operating out of Kazakhstan. Its members put aesthetics at the forefront and aren’t afraid to tread the fine line of ethical norms. Their game is a great testament to that, as INDIKA constitutes an open challenge to the industry's established approach to creating video games.

70010000100653.name: Recycling Station Simulator
70010000100653.intro: The ultimate recycling business challenge awaits you.
70010000100653.description:
In Recycling Station Simulator, one man's trash is your golden ticket. Start your journey as a lone junk scavenger and transform your humble beginnings into a full-scale recycling empire. Scour abandoned lots and city streets for plastic, metal, glass, wood, and paper — then sort, process, and sell it for profit. Upgrade your gear, hire workers, strike deals, and take control of an ever-growing operation.

But success doesn’t come easy. You'll need to negotiate contracts, hack into locked buildings for hidden cash, manage your finances carefully — and even grab a few hours of sleep to stay on your feet. Every penny counts, and every decision shapes your future.

Key Features:
- Collect & Recycle: Explore different areas to gather materials and process them into sellable cubes.
- Run the Base: Sort waste, operate machines, improve your equipment, and automate your systems.
- Trade & Negotiate: Master the art of the deal. Sell to clients or sign lucrative contracts for bigger profits.
- Upgrade & Expand: Hire helpers, boost efficiency, and expand your base into an industrial powerhouse.
- Explore & Hack: Buy lockpicks, break into forgotten places, and uncover stashes of cash.
- Financial Survival: Take loans, manage expenses, and make sure to pay your debts on time.
- Rest & Recharge: Don’t burn out — sleep to regain energy and keep the business running.

Can you rise from rags to riches and build a world-class recycling operation?
The trash pile is waiting. Dive in.

70010000100658.name: X-Force Genesis - Definitive Edition
70010000100658.intro: In this thrilling vertical scrolling game, you will revisit the great classics from the golden age of 8-bit and 16-bit games.
70010000100658.description: In this thrilling vertical scrolling game, you will revisit the great classics from the golden age of 8-bit and 16-bit games.

70010000100663.name: (Dis)Assemble
70010000100663.intro: Explore, think, and move with precision
70010000100663.description:
In (Dis)Assemble, moving blocks has never been so challenging or so satisfying. You control two geometric shapes at once, one with each hand. Sounds simple? Wait until obstacles enter the scene.

With clean, minimalist 3D visuals, each level reveals a new architectural surprise. One pushes, the other dodges, and you must think in perfect sync. Master the controls, master the space, and guide your duo of shapes to the finish line.

If you enjoy games that test your coordination, logic, and patience, sometimes all at once, (Dis)Assemble was made just for you.

Highlights:

Challenging, rewarding puzzles
Unique dual control assembly mechanic
Colorful, high contrast visuals

Get ready to assemble, disassemble, and literally rack your brain.

70010000100668.name: Journey to the Void
70010000100668.intro: Journey to the Void places you at the edge of a corrupted world. It’s up to you to venture toward the centre and uncover the mystery at the heart of it all.
70010000100668.description:
In this hybrid strategy roguelite deck builder, you must protect your hero from hordes of enemies in a grid-based combat system. Prepare to fend off attacks from all directions as you remain stationary at the centre of the battlefield. Use your action cards wisely, strategically combining energy, cards, effects, and knowledge of your enemies to overcome the odds.

Stand Your Ground
What do you get when an unstoppable force meets an unmovable object? Chaos, and lots of it. With 100+ different cards, items and weapons with unique effect combinations, you’ll craft the ultimate stalwart against the forces of corruption. Build deck synergies and choose key skills upgrades as you set out to save the world. 

Dust Yourself Off
Decide your character’s journey. Trade with merchants, be faced with moral decisions along the way, and shape your hero’s adventure. Unlock unique hero backgrounds that alter your starting deck and can impact the strategy of your run each time you play. 

Brave A New World
The world, divided into eight elemental regions, will permanently react to the multitude of choices you make. Each time you play, experience completely unique runs within an overarching story, with over 100 enemies, 9 bosses, different starting decks and 25 arenas to discover.

70010000100700.name: Sugoi Girls: Pretty Patriot
70010000100700.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000100700.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000100702.name: Sugoi Girls: Firefighter Love
70010000100702.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000100702.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000100704.name: Sugoi Girls: Attractive Archer
70010000100704.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000100704.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000100706.name: Sugoi Girls: Wolf Romance
70010000100706.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000100706.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000100708.name: Sugoi Girls: Madame Fantasy
70010000100708.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000100708.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000100710.name: Sugoi Girls: Victoria Vogue
70010000100710.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000100710.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000100726.name: Tristia: Restore
70010000100726.description:
Nanoca Flanka's battle to revitalize the floundering city of Tristia begins! 

The beautiful city of Tristia, nicknamed the "Jewel of the Sea," once bustled with maritime trade until recent dragon attacks stripped the city of its charm, and the people have resigned to its state of decay.

Tristia: Restore takes place alongside the story of Tristia: Legacy, but focuses on the day-to-day running of Nanoca’s shop. She has some major crafting projects to complete, but while she works to finish them, a constant barrage of requests pour in. Quickness counts as you gather materials, choose the right equipment, and deliver the necessary items for each level. Can you accomplish everything before time runs out?

70010000100728.name: RUGBY LEAGUE RAW
70010000100728.intro: PLAY YOUR STORY. STEP INTO THE GRIND WITH RUGBY LEAGUE RAW!
70010000100728.description:
THE FIRST RUGBY LEAGUE GAME ON NINTENDO SWITCH! TOUGH HITS, RAW SPEED, AND NO LIMITS… THIS IS FOOTY AT FULL THROTTLE.

SWITCH FIRST: Take hard-hitting Rugby League anywhere, anytime.
CAREER MODE: Build a powerhouse squad, rise through the ranks, fight for glory every season.
BE A PRO: Strap on the boots and carve your own brutal path to greatness.
FANHUB: Create and customise players and teams, then unleash them online.
GAME MODES: From quick clashes to full comps, or go head-to-head in fierce 8-player online battles.
COMMENTARY: AI-driven commentary that hits as hard as the tackles.

70010000100733.name: Reel it! Ocean Fishing
70010000100733.intro:
Get ready for a powered-up fishing trip to the vast ocean!
With stunning scenery and a wide variety of fish, the fishing is more thrilling and content-packed than ever!
70010000100733.description:
Let's go fishing on the Nintendo Switch™!
Travel to 4 unique fishing spots—including a rocky coast, seawall, fishing boat, and tropical pier—where the fish you encounter change depending on the location and time of day!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in!
Aim for a new high score!

[Score Attack]
Catch as many fish as you can within the time limit!
Look out for big fish to boost your score!
Look for the best lure and rod combo for each location!

[Endless]
Sit back, relax, and enjoy endless fishing!
Watch the scenery shift from day to night!
Change your gear when the situation calls and keep an eye out for big fish!

[Ranking]
Compete against players around the world in Score Attack and Endless modes!
Show off your skills by increasing your high score and rank!

[Battle]
Face off against CPUs in single-player mode, or test your skills against friends in multiplayer battles!

[Shop]
Spend the points you've earned from fishing to buy new lures and rods!
Find your favorite lure/rod combination!

[Records]
Every fish you catch will be recorded in your personal encyclopedia!
Can you reel in every species and complete the collection?

70010000100740.name: Make it! Pancakes
70010000100740.intro:
Get ready for a delicious pancake-making challenge!
Make tons of pancakes and watch your food cart prosper!
70010000100740.description:
Let's make pancakes on the Nintendo Switch™!
Cook pancakes without burning them, then add fruits and sauces on top!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Make pancakes to order!
Stack them up high, then add scrumptious toppings!
Keep cooking until time runs out!

《How to Play》
1. Spread the batter on the pan and start cooking!

2. Once one side is cooked, flip it over!

3. Flip fully cooked pancakes onto a plate and start adding toppings!

4. Add fruit on top! Choose from strawberries, nuts, bananas, blueberries, kiwi, and mango!

5. Drizzle on a sauce! Choose from chocolate sauce, cream, and honey!

6. Once the pancakes are done, it's time to serve! The closer they match the order, the more points you get!

[Score Attack]
Cook up as many pancakes as possible and aim for the top spot on the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Compete with others and test your pancake-making skills!

70010000100745.name: Chained Up Together
70010000100745.intro: The chain binds you… but can it save you?
70010000100745.description:
You are not alone—but you are not free. An unbreakable chain binds you to your partner, forcing you to fight, solve, and survive as one. Every move matters, every misstep is costly, and every challenge demands absolute coordination. The world is relentless, filled with deadly enemies, ruthless traps, and puzzles that twist your mind as much as your fate. Only those who embrace the chain will endure.

FEATURES:
-A Co-Op Experience Like No Other :
You can’t run ahead, and you can’t fall behind. Every movement, attack, and escape depends on perfect teamwork.
-Brutal Combat and Clever Puzzles:
Face relentless enemies and mind-bending challenges that demand both skill and strategy. One mistake could be your last.
-A World That Fights Back:
Traps spring from the shadows, landscapes shift beneath your feet, and enemies strike when you least expect. Stay in sync, or be dragged into the abyss.
-The Chain is Your Lifeline—and Your Burden:
Swing across deadly chasms, pull each other from danger, or use the chain as a weapon. But remember—what connects you can just as easily become your downfall.

You don’t just need skill to survive. You need trust. Can you and your partner master the chain, or will it pull you both into oblivion?

70010000100750.name: Castle Crumble
70010000100750.intro: Bring castles to ruins in the most spectacular way!
70010000100750.description:
Unleash chaos and creativity in Castle Crumble! Journey through colourful worlds, from lush jungles to mysterious islands, and destroy mighty fortresses with explosive power. Every castle is a unique puzzle, built to challenge your tactics and imagination.

Use cannons, bombs, magical rays and devastating boosters like meteors or shockwaves to bring down walls in glorious chain reactions. With over 300 levels across six worlds, Castle Crumble offers endless fun for players who love strategy, destruction, and spectacular physics.

Easy to pick up, satisfying to master – every demolition feels like a victory. Are you ready to crumble them all?

70010000100754.name: FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000100754.intro: The groundbreaking tactical RPG makes its long-awaited return.
70010000100754.description:
- Story
Ivalice—a kingdom blessed by the light of the gods and ruled by the Two-headed Lion. A year after her defeat to Ordallia in the Fifty Years' War, the king succumbed to malady, leaving a mere boy of two to ascend the throne.

Whoever was named regent would rule in truth, and thus emerged two rival candidates: dukes Goltanna and Larg, whose deeds during the war had earned them great renown. Goltanna the Black Lion and Larg the White Lion were destined to clash, and the resulting conflict would come to be known as the War of the Lions.

Against this backdrop appear Ramza, third son of House Beoulve, one of Ivalice's leading military families, and his childhood companion Delita, a commoner raised amongst nobles. As they endeavor to chart a course through this tumultuous age, a mighty current draws them ever closer to the abyss.

- Combat
Lead your party in exhilarating encounters where strategic positioning and forward planning determine the outcome. Use the varied terrain of 3D battlefields to your advantage, skillfully manipulate the turn order, and victory will be yours for the taking.

- Character Growth and Customization
Combine a wide variety of jobs and abilities to craft your very own strategies.

As your party members grow, they will gain access to more jobs, each with its own unique abilities. Once learned, abilities can be used even after changing to another job. With over 20 jobs to master—including white mage, black mage, dragoon, and many others from the FINAL FANTASY series—and hundreds of abilities to learn, you have the freedom to experiment and discover the combinations that best suit your party. Chocobos and other creatures can also be tamed and led into battle.

- Two Versions: Enhanced and Classic
With improved graphics, fully voiced dialogue, and refined gameplay, the enhanced version provides the perfect way to immerse yourself in the world of Ivalice. Along with the fine-tuning of several features and battle mechanics, the inclusion of the more accessible "Squire" difficulty setting makes the enhanced version an excellent starting point for first-time players.

The classic version unites the graphics and gameplay of the original 1997 version with the renowned War of the Lions translation for a unique way to experience this beloved title.

70010000100758.name: Jurassic Island: Little Dinosaur Park Musical AudioBook
70010000100758.intro: Travel to a world of dinosaurs where you'll sing, explore, and make Jurassic friends. An adventure filled with rhythm, excitement, and giant creatures.
70010000100758.description:
An adventure full of dinosaurs, music, and fun.

When two siblings discover a mysterious portal, they arrive on a magical island inhabited by singing, dancing dinosaurs! They'll meet dozens of species, make new friends, and experience an unforgettable musical experience.

What you'll find in this audiobook:

· Original songs and karaoke to sing with the family
· A dinosaur gallery with unique voices and fun facts
· Dubbed voices for all the characters
· A musical gallery to relive your favorite songs
· Adventures, humor, and learning about the prehistoric world

A story to listen to, imagine, sing along to... and roar with excitement!

70010000100765.name: KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000100765.intro:
One 4 All, All 4 One,
This is a game that checks your ability to be considerate to make the world a little more peaceful.
70010000100765.description:
Why do humans “read the air“?
