The answer lies in this “KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It”.

This game puts the spotlight on the childhood of the main character “You”,
Let's Consider It with innocence while looking back on various events that everyone must have experienced in their childhood.

The basic rule of deciding what to do in situations by moving the red object on the screen is the same.

Please consider the situation and read the atmosphere according to the various scenes that will be asked.

Challenge yourself to new layers of consideration in the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition, which comes with a menu that evaluates your mouse control skills while using the Joy-Con™ 2. Consider considering this too!

"KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It" is equipped with the following game modes.

・"Consider It" mode
A total of 100 situations will be asked.
After playing all the questions, your "ability to read the atmosphere" will be diagnosed.

・“Consider It Together” mode.
Play together with your friends and family.
10 questions will be asked out of a total of 30 questions.
After playing, the compatibility between the two people will be diagnosed.

・“Fun Minigames” mode
Contains 3 mini games.
Aim for the highest score with Score Attack.

70010000100770.name: Unfair Rampage: Knightfall
70010000100770.intro: Fight, dodge, and blast your way through enemies!
70010000100770.description:
This 2.5D action platformer throws you into shiny armor with a very big blaster — and lets you move exactly how you want. Double-jump, air-dash, weave through hazards, smash through destructible stages, and chase a higher score with every run. Tough at first, fair at heart, and built for quick restarts that pull you right back in.


KEY FEATURES:
- Super-tight controls and ultra-fast action — feel every dash and jump.
- Destructible elements of levels and hazards that keep you alert.
- Procedurally generated worlds for fresh routes, patterns, and experience.
- Power-ups to boost your weapon power and shield durability.
- Quick restarts — learn, retry, and progress farther with every attempt.
- Show off up close — get near your opponents and your attack turns into slick martial-arts kicks.
- Unlockable skins, tons of stats and leaderboards for the score chasers.
- Retro-inspired soundtrack to match the throwback vibe.
- Cinematic camera — an optional way to create an extra challenge.


Train your reflexes, blast through foes, and make sure that every run is better than the last one. The stage is ready for new records!

70010000100775.name: Waffle Kitty
70010000100775.intro: Waffle Your Way to the Purrfect Picnic!
70010000100775.description:
Who said waffles are only for breakfast? With Waffle Kitty, every day can become a sweet, cozy picnic! 


Here, a fluffy kitty-chef will guide you through the art of making the perfect waffle — golden, crunchy on the outside, soft on the inside, and topped with just the right mix of delicious treats. However, there’s one catch — everything has to fit!


You’ll be challenged to place strawberries, whipped cream, honey drizzles, and even cheeky chocolate chips onto your waffle without leaving a single bite behind. As you progress, your waffles get bigger, the toppings get trickier, and the puzzle gets more and more tasty!


Don’t worry if your first waffle isn’t ideal — practice makes perfect! Each level is a new opportunity to experiment, decorate, and discover the joy of waffles that are almost too cute to eat… almost.


KEY FEATURES: 
- Over 90 delicious waffles to complete! 
- 29 delightful toppings, from fruity favorites to sweet surprises.
- A lively soundtrack to keep your creativity flowing. 
- A cuddly kitty-chef who makes decorating waffles the sweetest challenge. 
- Cozy and colorful visuals that will warm your heart as much as your tastebuds!

So grab your fork and let’s waffle our way to culinary cuteness, just remember, don’t eat them before they’re ready!

70010000100785.name: Neko Gelato
70010000100785.description:
Ever wanted to start your own patisserie? Well, now it's your chance! Running your own pastry shop has never been easier in this puzzle cozy game. Move, place, and stuff all the meringues, waffles, ice creams, lollipops, and mochi to fit inside each available space.

Key Features: 
- Over 90 sweet levels to master!
- 29 sweets and chocolates to box.
- Soundtrack as sweet as the candy served! 
- Beautifully drawn confectionaries.
- Friendly host to accompany you in your journey!

Many sweets in unique shapes and sizes that must fit somewhere. Pack the boxes almost like packing your customer orders, make sure they all fit! 

If something doesn't fit, you can start again and make sure all pieces fit in like a piece of an art. Each level delivers hours of entertainment as they test your skill and keep you focused.

70010000100790.name: All of You
70010000100790.intro: All of You is a cute, family-friendly visual puzzle adventure with a unique mechanic that lets you play and pause time to find the right path.
70010000100790.description:
You will follow the journey of a clumsy chicken traversing all kinds of places in search of her lost chicks.

Explore strange places filled with fun characters, exciting surprises, and many treacherous dangers – all to find every one of your chicks.

INNOVATIVE

Explore a one-of-a-kind game mechanic that allows you to control the environment around you!

SURPRISING

Navigate through unique levels with new locations, characters, and music.

CUTE

Find all the collectibles that show nostalgic moments of the chicken and her chicks.

70010000100795.name: Succubus Sexy Devils
70010000100795.intro: Born in fire. Forged for chaos. Unleashed in Hell.
70010000100795.description:
Succubus Sexy Devils is a stylish third-person action game where you become a seductive and lethal demoness, descending into the depths of Hell to wipe out monstrous hordes.
Armed with an evolving arsenal of infernal weapons, you’ll slice, shoot, and scorch your way through fast-paced, brutal combat. The more you kill, the more powerful your gear becomes—turning you into an unstoppable force of destruction.
Explore twisted arenas crawling with nightmarish enemies. Once the battlefield is cleared, find the portal and dive deeper into Hell, where even deadlier challenges await.

Key Features:
• Play as a fierce and flawless demoness
• Fast-paced third-person combat with a supernatural edge
• Weapons evolve and grow stronger as you slay
• Hellish arenas packed with grotesque enemies
• Portal system for progressing through increasingly intense levels

Succubus Sexy Devils delivers a dark, thrilling blend of action, power, and temptation. Step into the fire—and show Hell who’s in charge.

70010000100800.name: HeadHunters
70010000100800.intro: It’s all about dodging, detonating, and making your mates scream “no way!”. Heads will definitely roll.
70010000100800.description: HeadHunters is a chaotic platform fighter for up to 4 players, online or on the couch. Blast, bash, and body-swap your way through explosive arenas in fast-paced, no-rules mayhem. It’s all about dodging, detonating, and making your mates scream “no way!”. Heads will definitely roll.

70010000100805.name: Is This Seat Taken?
70010000100805.intro: Play seating matchmaker to please picky characters and solve satisfying puzzles.
70010000100805.description:
Window seat or aisle? Booth or table? Lone wolf or life of the party? In Is This Seat Taken?, your mission is to organize groups of people according to their preferences. It’s a cozy, no-pressure logic puzzle game where you’re in charge of who sits where.

Whether it’s the cinema, a crowded bus, a wedding reception, or a cramped taxi cab, every setting introduces new characters with specific tastes. A party guest with a sensitive nose won’t be happy sitting next to a stranger who’s wearing too much cologne. A sleepy passenger won’t be happy trying to nap on the bus next to someone listening to loud music. It’s all about reading the room to find the perfect placement!

Nat is an aspiring actor whose world gets turned upside down when they see a shape just like them on the big screen. This discovery sends Nat on a global journey to meet their hero and figure out how to fit in. Experience Nat's heartfelt story as you travel from city to city, each with its own levels, characters, and charm.

- Play seating matchmaker to please picky characters.
- Discover each character’s unique traits—relatable, outlandish, and everything in between.
- Piece together satisfying puzzles with no timers or leaderboards.
- Unlock fun new scenarios as you progress—from bus rides to banquets!

70010000100810.name: 3 on 3 Soccer
70010000100810.description:
Step onto the pitch and take control in 3on3 Soccer – a fun and charming single-player soccer experience where teams of three face off in fast-paced, bite-sized matches!

Build your dream team and guide them through a variety of unique playfields, each offering a fresh take on classic soccer action. Choose your ball, pick your field, and dive into exciting matchups with charming characters and smooth gameplay.

– Single-player 3v3 soccer with quick, action-packed matches
– World Cup Tournament mode with progression and challenge
– Choose from different playfields and match balls
– Simple, satisfying controls for all skill levels
– No gimmicks – just clean, fun soccer

Whether you're chasing trophies or just looking for a few quick matches, 3 on 3 Soccer is your perfect pick-up-and-play soccer fix.

70010000100824.name: BOKURA: planet
70010000100824.intro:
"There's something I can't tell you..."
Explore new frontiers of co-op gaming in BOKURA: planet.
70010000100824.description:
Note:
Players must communicate with each other to play this game. If you are not playing in the same location, you will need another communication method, such as voice chat. Before buying the game, please keep in mind that the game itself does not provide a separate communication method.


BOKURA: planet is a puzzle adventure game that must be played with two players, who communicate and work together to solve puzzles. It takes place in a different setting than BOKURA and has a whole new story, with different actions and gimmicks.


[Same but Different: A game system like the previous game, but it plays completely differently]
BOKURA: planet requires two players on two different devices to communicate while playing.

Players need to share what they see on their own screens and cooperate to solve puzzles and progress through the stages, just like in BOKURA, but there is a new action: Push. You can now send the other player flying with the push of a button.

Sometimes you might get in the other player's way, or maybe even push them off a cliff... Cooperating isn't everything in this game.

The estimated playing time is approximately 3 hours.

The new action: Push! Careful where you use it, because you don't know what might happen...


[Story]
After Earth fell to ruin, the few remaining survivors had to rebuild civilization from the Stone Age. When they finally advanced to the age of space exploration, they decided to explore the far reaches of space, but the distance meant it would take them hundreds of years to arrive. For this expedition, humankind decided to send condemned convicts.

On the way to an unknown red planet, the expedition's spaceship breaks down, forcing two members of the crew to make a crash landing. They both have their own reasons for needing to return to Earth no matter what, but will they be able to make it back alive?

Work together to solve puzzles and escape from the unknown red planet!


[Hidden Objective Co-op Adventure]

A puzzle adventure game that you can only play with two people. You have secrets that you cannot share, but you still have to work together to proceed.
As you proceed through the stages, each player will be presented with a hidden objective. Each player will only know their own objective, which will be hidden to the other player. You need to cooperate with the other player on your journey, but what on Earth do they know that you don't...?
Experience a co-op game like no other, where even though what you and your partner see and experience is the same, you can never understand how the other feels.


[A new title from tokoronyori, creator of BOKURA]
tokoronyori

An indie game dev who creates unique worlds with a distinctive art style, filling his games with originality and mystery. He created the exclusively two-player puzzle adventure game BOKURA in 2023 as a member of the first round of Kodansha Game Creator's Lab. He specializes in making experiences only possible through games with his characteristic game mechanics.

[Creator Comment]

The idea for this game comes from something I thought up while planning BOKURA. I could have gone a completely different direction when making BOKURA, but for various reasons, BOKURA ended up the way it did.

While I am proud of the decisions that led to BOKURA, at the same time, I kept wondering what scenery I might have seen if I'd gone in the complete opposite direction. In the end, I couldn't hold back. I ran the other way, which is how BOKURA: planet was born, and the view here is incredible.

70010000100837.name: Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers
70010000100837.intro: Rally the Valkyries, break through the final line!
70010000100837.description:
"Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers" is an exhilarating top-down shooter survival game that tells the story of a special squad named Valkyrie. Their mission is to break through the enemy's fortified defenses and face extreme survival conditions. In the game, you (the commander) will lead this brave squad, utilizing each member's unique skills and strategies to overcome numerous challenges, defeat powerful enemies, and rescue trapped comrades.

"Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers" will test your leadership skills, tactical insight, and immerse you in a highly challenging adventure. Are you ready? Join Valkyrie Squad, challenge your limits, break the siege, and reveal your true heroism!

70010000100849.name: Save Room - The Merchant
70010000100849.intro: Build a killer arsenal in this inventory management puzzle game
70010000100849.description:
Buy, sell, and acquire crucial items required for combat missions while interacting with the Save Room’s enigmatic weapons dealer. 

To progress through each level, you must possess specific elite and essential battle gear. In order to obtain the necessary goods, meticulously arrange your arms and treasures within your inventory. Then you'll need to engage in the process of selling your treasures to the strange merchant. 

Can you build your war chest?


Features:
* Organizational puzzle solving
* Logical finance management
* 40 handmade levels
* Relaxing visuals, music and sound

70010000100852.name: The Spark of the Heart: Interactive Audio Book
70010000100852.intro: In the magical Prism Valley, a group of friends discover that the power of emotions can awaken the last dino-dragon and save their world.
70010000100852.description:
Immerse yourself in a colorful and magical visual novel for children, where emotions transform the world. Experience a charming adventure alongside Nika and her group of friends in a story full of friendship and fantasy.

Highlighted Features:

·Colorful visual novel designed especially for boys and girls.

·Fully dubbed with fun and relatable voices.

·Audiobook format ideal for listening and reading.

·Adorable and diverse characters, such as an artistic mini-mammoth

·Accessible, emotional, and positive story, perfect for family enjoyment.

·A magical dino-dragon

·Simple and friendly interface for little ones.

70010000100864.name: Hot Stakes Casino - American Roulette
70010000100864.intro: Try your luck or manipulate the game in your favor using special powers in a fast-paced gambling experience!
70010000100864.description:
It’s time for some good old-fashioned gambling with all the fun and none of the risk! Hot Stakes Casino - American Roulette is a game designed to be casual and infinitely replayable, letting you enjoy the classic game of roulette at your own pace. Choose from 4 playable characters, each with their own unique skills, and place your bets using a pool of credits granted at the start of each game.

Play until you go bust or earn rewards with a winning streak! Unlock gallery images, with 10 card images to earn for each character! Strategically use special powers to trigger mini games and manipulate the results in your favor. Will you play it safe with minimum bets or go all-in? The choice is yours!

• Select a playable character from 4 eccentric gamblers.
• Bet big or play it safe in timeless roulette gameplay.
• Keep playing until you run out of money!
• Unlock dozens of gallery images.
• Trigger mini games and bend the rules in your favor!

70010000100890.name: Vice Thief Simulator: 80s Nostalgia
70010000100890.intro: Every street holds danger, fortune, and opportunity.
70010000100890.description:
Vice Thief Simulator: 80s Nostalgia throws you straight into the vibrant streets of the 1980s, where you play as a cunning thief determined to get rich at any cost. Break into doors, steal valuable items, take on car theft contracts, and stay one step ahead of the police. Upgrade your skills and gear to tackle increasingly secure locks and tougher security. Caution and the ability to distract law enforcement are the keys to survival in a world where every mistake could cost you your freedom.
Features:
- 80s Atmosphere – Neon-lit streets, booming pop hits, and a city alive with disco and crime.
- Lockpicking System – Tackle locks of varying difficulty; better tools and skill are needed for high-value targets.
- Car Theft & Delivery – Steal cars, evade the police, and deliver them for rewards.
- Pawn Shop – Turn stolen items into cash, from jewelry to electronics.
- Distract the Cops – Create diversions to keep law enforcement off your trail.
- Chases – Run, hide, and escape through streets and alleys if the cops spot you.
Step into the adrenaline-fueled world of Vice Thief Simulator: 80s Nostalgia and prove your skills in the ultimate test of stealth, speed, and cunning. Will you rise to become the most notorious thief of the decade, or will the city’s relentless law enforcement finally catch up to you?

70010000100895.name: Doki Monsters : Quest
70010000100895.intro: Catch creatures, choose your style, and conquer the quest to save your friend.
70010000100895.description:
Have you ever wanted to relive a cartridge-era adventure? Now’s your chance!
In Doki Monsters: Quest, you set out to find your missing childhood friend — teaming up with captured creatures, battling turn-by-turn, and pushing deeper into a dangerous open world.

Grow stronger, unlock new routes, and face off against Rangers and shady corporations that disturb the peace.

Prefer comfort with your challenge? Modern touches keep the journey smooth: fast-forward battles, optional helper tips, and a quest log that keeps your goals crystal clear. 

What the adventure offers:
- 140+ original monsters to collect, train, and evolve your strategy.
- About a 20 hour story spanning 15+ towns, plus caves, shrines, seas, and mountains.
- Turn-based battles against Rangers and corporations, with seamless overworld encounters.
- Rare-hunt post-game content and 7 alternate looks per monster (one ultra-rare!).
- Fast-forward battles, optional tips, and a clear quest log — you choose your way of playing!
- Side activities — everyone’s favorite — FISHING!
- 4 save files available in case you would like to share your world with your friends!

Sharpen your strategy, build the ultimate team, and bring a friend home!

Doki Monsters: Quest’s amazing adventure awaits you!

70010000100905.name: Jamboy, a Jelly-cious Hero
70010000100905.intro: Jamboy and Billy are devoured by a giant and must escape its guts! Fight food monsters and explore its intestines in this frantic, multi-genre adventure!
70010000100905.description:
Jamboy: A Jelly-cious Hero, is a vibrant action-platformer starring an unusual protagonist: a jam-packed hero who, inevitably, seems to have an innate talent for falling into sticky situations.

The game is structured around a series of short stories in episodic format offering a fascinating fusion of genres guaranteed to hold the player's attention. Adding to this ingenious game design is the charming aesthetic of its hand-drawn art, and sly humor, which adds to the fun of the gameplay experience in the style of the classic "Earthworm jim."

GAME MODES

Story Mode:
Jamboy is trapped in digestive chaos and only you can help him escape. Snack Mode offers a mild difficulty level, designed for players who are new to the world of video games or prefer a relaxed gaming experience. On the other hand, Buffet Mode represents the full Jamboy experience, with increasing challenges and unique enemies, geared towards more experienced players. Whatever your choice, get ready for an adventure full of platforming, humor and unexpected situations.

Lost Levels:
Want more? Once you complete the main campaign, you'll unlock new challenging levels designed to test your skills and expand the gameplay experience.

Extras:
Jamboy has even more to offer! Discover an achievements system and a gallery where you can relive your best moments and view all the audiovisual material you unlocked throughout the game.

70010000100908.name: Tralalero Tralala: Rage Bait
70010000100908.intro: Tralalero Tralala: Rage Bait – platforming pain at its finest.
70010000100908.description:
Get ready to lose your mind (and maybe your voice) in Tralalero Tralala: Rage Bait — a brutally challenging 2D pixel art platformer starring an unusually emotional shark with a short fuse and a long jump. This game will make you go Tung Tung Tung Sahur.

In a world built to break you, you play as TralaleroTralala, a shark with a dream: to jump, survive, and not rage quit. Navigate an endless gauntlet of spike pits, collapsing platforms, troll traps, and gravity-defying jumps — all designed to test your patience, timing, and sanity.

Every level is a carefully crafted rage trap, blending retro visuals with precision mechanics. The only way forward is up in this Tralalero Tralala game, but each fall sends you crashing back to the start... and deeper into sharky madness.

Features:

- Tight, unforgiving platforming that rewards skill and timing.

- Brutal level design with a side of dark humor.

- Expressive pixel art that brings our sharky anti-hero to life (along with his meltdowns).

- Original soundtrack that mockingly plays on while you fail.

- No checkpoints. No mercy. All rage.

Can you keep your cool, or will Tralalero Tralala lose it for you?

70010000100910.name: Fighting Force Collection
70010000100910.intro: The legendary 3D beat 'em up is back: Fighting Force!
70010000100910.description:
Two classics return: Fighting Force and Fighting Force 2!

Play the games like never before with
·	Save States
·	Rewind
·	Uprendering
·	CRT Filters
·	Bonus Content
·	Game Selector

Fighting Force: Originally released in 1997, this beat 'em up classic let players become Hawk Manson, Mace Daniels, Alana McKendricks, or Ben "Smasher" Johnson as they fight to take down the evil Dr. Dex Zeng.

FEATURES:

Choose from two male or two female characters, each with different skills and strengths.

Play alone or in co-op mode to defeat your enemies.

Dozens of moves per character.

Seven action packed levels in 22 different stages.

Pick up weapons like rocket launchers, shotguns, pipes, guns, grenades and more!

Fighting Force 2: This follow-up released in 1999 - in this game, players take the role of Hawk Manson, who is covertly investigating human cloning experiments by the Knackmiche Corporation.

FEATURES:

Negotiate through complex R&D facilities featuring amazing visuals and advanced special effects.

Fierce hand-to-hand combat including deadly combination moves.

Use an arsenal of over 20 lethal weapons to assist in removal of key personnel and complete destruction of environments.

70010000100912.name: The Cursed Frog
70010000100912.intro: Master the light and darkness. Break the curse
70010000100912.description:
The Cursed Frog is a single-player puzzle-platformer with an enchanted twist: switch between a brave princess during the day and a cursed frog at night to overcome magical challenges in the heart of Witchwood forest.

Solve environmental puzzles, avoid treacherous traps, and use each form’s unique abilities to forge a path through 30 carefully crafted levels. The day-night shift mechanic changes not only the scenery but also the gameplay: jump higher as the frog to reach hidden areas, or fight enemies as the princess with ranged attacks and agile dashes.

Combine logic and reflexes to activate magic bridges, manipulate platforms, and discover secret routes in this ever-changing enchanted world. Each level brings new challenges that test your creativity and strategy.

70010000100917.name: Re:Play
70010000100917.intro: Speed, swords, and parkour in a thrilling action-packed adventure!
70010000100917.description:
Get ready for high-speed action and heart-pounding thrills in Re:Play! Jump, dash, and slash your way through a variety of fast-paced levels. With simple yet precise controls, this game is easy to pick up and incredibly addictive. Perfect for quick gaming sessions or long marathons, Re:Play delivers non-stop excitement.

Key Features:

Dynamic mix of parkour and combat mechanics.

Short, diverse levels that keep you engaged.

Intuitive controls designed for players of all skill levels.

Endless replayability with fast-paced gameplay.

Re:Play is the ultimate test of speed and skill, designed to keep you coming back for more!

70010000100923.name: Lush Season
70010000100923.intro: Quiet paths lead to hidden wonders.
70010000100923.description:
A relaxing walking adventure through a hand-painted world of nature, discovery, and quiet wonder.

Step into the tranquil forest of Lush Season, a peaceful exploration game set in a vibrant, stylized landscape where every path leads to something unexpected. Breathe in the calm as you wander through dense woodlands, cozy cabins, and secret clearings — all brought to life with gentle ambient soundscapes and the rustling of leaves in the breeze.

Your goal is simple: find hidden places and mark them off your list. No pressure, no combat, no rush. Just you, the forest, and the joy of uncovering the small details that others might miss.

Features:
Cozy, stylized visuals that feel like a living storybook
 Immersive ambient audio — birdsong, wind, footsteps, and more
Discover and log hidden spots across a seamless open world
No combat or puzzles — just pure exploration and atmosphere
Perfect for fans of cozy games, and peaceful escapes

70010000100939.name: Kong: Survivor Instinct
70010000100939.intro: Survive the wonder and terror of the Titans in this official Monsterverse game.
70010000100939.description:
Kong: Survivor Instinct is a 2.5D action-adventure game that combines realistic platforming, challenging combat, and metroidvania-style exploration during a thrilling quest of survival worthy of the Monsterverse franchise.

TRUE MONSTERVERSE ADVENTURE
A sudden Titan attack prompts massive evacuation efforts-but not everyone makes it to safety before the devastation ensues. Caught in the crossfire between battling monsters, many residents become trapped in the collapsing city—your only daughter among them!

Influence the Titans with Monarch tech and use their enormous strength to your advantage as you navigate a treacherous maze of collapsing buildings, toxic leaks, and raging fires. Scavenge for resources, weapons, and tools to solve environmental puzzles and defend yourself against both human and monster enemies.

FACE THE LEGENDARY KONG 
Explore and survive as you encounter Kong in all his majestic glory, face the formidable Abaddon, and confront other new and returning superspecies and Titans! Whether you scavenge through half-destroyed buildings or fight off mercenaries, these enormous monsters are nearby, directly or indirectly impacting your gameplay. Though the Titans pose a lethal threat, you can - and must - influence their behavior with the ORCA Σ, a new prototype inspired by Monarch’s technology.

ALAN JONAH RETURNS
Discover an official Monsterverse story set shortly after the events of Godzilla vs. Kong. Stand your ground against the Hyenas, a mercenary group led by Alan Jonah. Reemerging after the events of Godzilla: King of the Monsters, the former eco-terrorist leader returns in Kong: Survivor Instinct with a new villainous scheme.

A FATHER’S MISSION TO RESCUE HIS DAUGHTER
Take on the role of David, an oil rig worker braving a crumbling city to find your only child, Stacy. Make your way through the districts while encountering fellow survivors taking shelter among the rubble, mourning their loved ones or on the verge of giving up hope. Feel the awe-inspiring terror Titans bring upon a city  through the eyes of a father desperate to find his daughter!

70010000100941.name: Master the Flow Within
70010000100941.description:
Whether you're a complete beginner or looking to refine your skills, this journey will guide you step by step into the art of Tai Chi.
Improve your posture, balance, and breathing with smooth, flowing movements.
Daily sessions are designed to fit your routine and build inner strength.
Learn at your own pace through clear instruction and mindful practice.
Discover the harmony between body and mind, one movement at a time.

70010000100944.name: Judo Master Rising
70010000100944.description:
Master the art of throws, holds, and self-control through an immersive journey into judo.
Designed for all levels, each step builds your strength, focus, and technique.
Practice with realistic drills and intuitive lessons that grow with you.
Develop the mindset, movement, and discipline of a true martial artist.
Train with purpose and rise through the ranks.

70010000100947.name: Quiz Brain Workout
70010000100947.description:
A daily challenge for puzzle lovers.
Carefully curated quizzes inspired by Japanese logic and culture.
From IQ tests to tricky riddles, it’s time to train your brain.
Perfect for all ages — sharpen your thinking and enjoy every “aha!” moment.
Play solo or with friends and turn each quiz into a brain-boosting game.

70010000100950.name: Horoscope Secrets Unlocked
70010000100950.description:
Explore your true nature through the lens of the stars.
Learn what makes each sign unique and how it shapes your personality.
Discover ideal matches in love, friendships, and careers.
Packed with relatable insights and deep astrological wisdom.
This is your personal guide to understanding yourself and others.

70010000100953.name: Peek a Fish!
70010000100953.intro:
Where’s That Fish Hiding?
A Cute and Easy Brain-Training Picture Hunt Game
70010000100953.description:
This game lets you train your brain while enjoying adorable underwater illustrations.
Your task is to find the designated fish hidden in the picture within the time limit.

How to Play：
・Carefully check the image of the fish you need to find
・Look for that fish in the underwater scene
・When you find it, tap it before time runs out!

Some fish may seem easy to find at first glance…
but the time limit adds an unexpected challenge!

If you ever get stuck, don’t worry—
the hint button will gently guide you by pointing out the general area.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000100955.name: Sweet Home: Look and Find 3 Collector's Edition
70010000100955.description:
Relax, get comfortable, and enjoy finding objects, solving puzzles, and conquering mini-games on an exciting journey to various places imbued with warmth and comfort! 
Take a walk in nature, sit by the pool, and even barbecue in the backyard! 
Use your skills and knowledge to find all the hidden objects and complete the mini-games as you kick back and challenge yourself in this blissful hidden-object game!

- Customize your room by choosing decorative items and comfy furnishings!
- Solve puzzles, and look for hidden objects in every scene!
- Bring peaceful surroundings home with beautiful graphics and soothing music!
- Tons of challenging puzzles and mini-games!

70010000100959.name: Demons Are Coming!
70010000100959.intro: With Guns and Blade face the hordes of demons!
70010000100959.description:
Your once-sacred homeland now lies in the grip of a demonic invasion. Wielding two fully customizable weapons, you'll fight back with precision and power—dodging, parrying, and blazing through relentless enemy hordes. With hundreds of upgrade combinations, adapt your playstyle and push back the darkness. Shatter enemy cover, deflect incoming fire, and emerge as a true slayer of demons.

Features:
• Fluid, Fast-Paced Combat – Weave through enemy fire and strike with overwhelming force.
• Endless Weapon Customization – Mix and match mods to forge entirely new weapons each run.
• Destructible Environments – Tear down enemy cover and shape the battlefield to your advantage.
• Refined Parry Mechanics – Time your moves to counter attacks and turn the tide.
• Procedurally Generated Maps – No two battles are ever the same.
• Local Co-op Mode – Team up with a friend and fight side by side.

70010000100973.name: Sushi Cat - Tower Defense
70010000100973.intro: Strategic tower defense meets roguelite chaos!
70010000100973.description:
Sushi Cat Tower Defense introduces a new genre of gameplay to a beloved franchise!

This time around, Sushi Cat must defend himself from evil sushi hordes, corrupted by the wicked sorcerer cook Broccolinni. Only by eating enormous amounts of sushi will Sushi Cat be able to thwart Broccolinni's plans to control the world!

PREPARE YOU DEFENSES
• Deploy a variety of cat-themed towers
• Block key routes with maze-building walls
• Place traps to surprise and weaken enemies

ROGUELIKE STYLE
• Designed for quick runs with a single evolving level and Endless Mode
• Draft Boon Cards that define your strategy
• Defeat powerful boss enemies in every run
• Unlock permanent upgrades between games

SHAPE THE PATH
• Defend Sushi Cat from waves of sinister sushi enemies.
• Place defenses to prevent enemies from reaching Sushi Cat. Collect sushi and keep feeding him to expand his powers.
• Survive wave-based encounters while constructing obstacles, towers, & traps to build a winding maze for enemies to traverse through.

UNLOCK TALENTS & BOONS
• Upgrade your Talent Tree to unlock permanent power boosts.
• Unlock new towers and traps to expand your defensive options.
• Empower Sushi Cat with devastating new Ultimate abilities.
• Collect Boon Cards that shape each run with unique effects.

70010000100975.name: #DRIVE Rally
70010000100975.intro: Put your foot down and redefine speed in #DRIVE Rally!
70010000100975.description:
#DRIVE Rally is an arcade-inspired rally racing game set in the golden racing era of the 1990s. Grab your co-driver and burn rubber in iconic, race-winning cars across varied rally stages and terrains in some of the most recognizable rallying locations in the world—perfect for fans of retro racing games and newcomers alike.

From the sunny landscapes of Dry Crumbs, through the whispering woods of Holzberg, to the chilly wilderness of Revontuli; take a journey through a diverse world you haven’t experienced in racing games before. Each destination delivers distinctive stage design and visual flair that celebrate classic ’90s rally vibes.

Jump behind the wheel of legendary rally cars, including Das Holzwagen, The Doggo, The Bobond, and many more. Build and customize your cars from the ground up to match your driving style and rally your way. Personalize the body, paintwork, and decals, then add that cherry on top with custom decorations - create a ride that feels truly your own.

Don’t forget the co-driver! Your co-driver can be your biggest cheerleader and toughest judge. It’s a partnership that thrives on performance and emotion. Their goal is to assist your runs with helpful navigation and tips to improve your stage times - making every run feel dynamic and replayable.

Features
• The spirit of ’90s rally for players of all ages and generations

• Exciting driving mechanics, simple to start but demanding in depth

• Stunning rally tracks and locations inspired by the world

• Retro-inspired cars with awesome personalization and car customization options

• Compete on online leaderboards to be the best and prove your rally skills

70010000100980.name: Dragon Is Dead
70010000100980.intro: Amid spreading Corruption, the immortal Successor walks a fated path.
70010000100980.description:
The black dragon [Guernian], who once faced down the gods, has fallen. 
From the rift he fled before his death, an unholy energy has spread across the world, and life is undergoing a bizarre mutation. People call it Corruption and live their days in fear, but few know its trustworthy source and full extent.

You are an immortal warrior, a so-called Successor, chosen by the God of Light [Lu], the God of Fire [Ashuran], and the God of Water [Harnia]. Arriving in Cliffshire, a town of light, Successors must head to a burial ground where demons are said to be manifesting and follow clues to cleanse the distorted world.

Dragon is Dead delivers 2D platformer action requiring precise dodging and pattern-breaking. Each area is a vertically and horizontally intertwined, multi-layered structure that regenerates in a rogue-lite fashion with different terrain, monster placement, and loot composition on each run. When you die, you lose your gold and temporary buffs, but your gear and runes are permanently preserved and become the basis for the next cycle. Defeating bosses yields rune stones that can be used to craft or awaken legendary gear, and artifacts found during exploration can bring both powerful blessings and dangerous curses depending on the combination, providing new tactical tension each time.

Make your way to the Citadel – the closer you get, the more you’ll come face-to-face with a secret that has brought the world to its knees.

Features:

•	Tight, immersive platforming and combat
•	Stunning visuals to draw you into the world
•	Each run brings new challenges as you gain strength
•	Extensive customization and character options for exciting builds
•	Conquer the Corruption to unravel the story

70010000100985.name: Electronics Puzzle Lab 2
70010000100985.intro: Learn circuitry and electronics engineering in a fun way with concepts simple enough for beginners but engaging for enthusiasts!
70010000100985.description:
Awaken your inner engineer once again with the brainteasing circuitry of Electronics Puzzle Lab 2! In this fun and educational 3D puzzle game, your task is to inspect circuit boards and make adjustments to power LED lights.

Take a seat at your workbench, cut wires, flip switches and more as you trace the path of the current. Start with basic puzzles and progress to advanced challenges that will test your limits in logic and electronic knowledge.

• Puzzle through dozens of challenges.
• Cut wires, flip switches and make more to power the LED lights.
• Replay completed stages or retry new ones.
• Test yourself against gradually increasing difficulty.
• Enjoy 3D graphics and a casual gameplay loop.

70010000100990.name: Majogami
70010000100990.intro:
Paper craft character action!
Majogami - the story of one girl who cuts gods like paper.
70010000100990.description:
Majogami stars Shiroha, a young woman who has lost her memory, who travels alongside Shiori, her father who has been turned to paper. With her katana, "Kamikiri", in hand, she travels through a bizarre world and cuts through the horrors she finds there in this 2D character action platformer.
Players take control of Shiroha who can move and attack instantly with her "Setsuna" ability, taking out enemies without missing a beat.
Along her journey, Shiroha will collect cards imbued with her memories called Recarte, and face off against the diverse Majogami, divine "Craft Witches" who control the world.
These Majogami, with twisted hearts and powerful magic, stand in Shiroha's way as she tries to escape their domain. In addition to her Setsuna attack, she can rely on Shiori's defense sigils and the power of the guardians she meets, the Astrals, to transform herself into new fighting forms.  

By defeating these Majogami, Shiroha can slowly regain her memories of both her and Shiori's life, deepening their bonds and revealing her story.
Experience the touching family story and see Shiroha's determination to make it through this twisted world to the end.

■Experience a strange and unique world!
In a brand new setting created by INTI CREATES art director Yuji Natsume, Majogami combines paper craft and dark visuals in the world, characters, and game design.
Be immersed in the lush setting and artwork as you delve into the action gameplay.

■"Setsuna" brings unprecedented speed and freedom to combat!
Use Setsuna to dive fearlessly at powerful enemies to slice them up quickly!
With a single button press, summon a unique Japanese-inspired effect as you slice your foe in two.
Not only a mere attack, Setsuna will allow you move to areas you wouldn't otherwise, as well as allow you to dodge attacks when timed correctly.
Master Setsuna, and you'll experience satisfying combat like no other.

■"Astralize" with the power of song!
With the energy you charge using Setsuna, you'll be able to transform Shiroha by borrowing the power of the gods known as Astrals.
A lush animation accompanies these powerful transformations as Shiroha powers up.
When she "Astralizes", Shiroha can weave a song together with the Astral to summon her ultimate ability, the Celestial Serenade.
Its overwhelming power can send her cleaving through even the world itself, becoming a crucial tool in your arsenal.

■A rich story with a colorful cast
The Majogami standing in your way each have a unique and charming design.
Each sporting their own "obsession", these witches will make the fight a tough one for Shiroha, showing off their prowess with a full-screen animation.
You'll also unlock new sub-stories that reveal more about the lives of Shiori and other characters' pasts beyond the main story.
Please enjoy the world and its story, all presented with full Japanese voice acting.

70010000100995.name: Culdcept BEGINS
70010000100995.intro: Led by dice. Ruled by cards
70010000100995.description:
A hidden classic that fuses board and card games, Culdcept features a unique, innovative system that has captivated fans since its debut. Players become Cepters, wielding cards in intense battles where luck and strategy collide. After ten years, a brand-new story begins once again.

●What is Culdcept?
It is a game where you move across the board, claim territories, and build strategies using cards.
Use summons and magic to fight your way to victory.

●Story
Bavrashka, a continent created by the gods.
At its center lies the Royal Cept Academy, an insitute where Cepters are trained to wield the power of stone tablets known as "Culds," fragments of the Culdcept.
Kamur, who transferred to the Cept Academy, has his abilities recognized and is selected for the Royal Cepter Guard Regiment.
Amid battles that threaten the continent, the power of a Cepter begins to awaken.

●Game System
Move with dice and battle with cards—
This is a board game where victory hangs on a mix of luck and strategy.
Experience a more accessible evolution of Culdcept that stays true to the series’ charm.

●Cards
Over 400 cards with all-new visuals.
Combine all kinds of cards to win through the power of your own tactics.

・Creature Cards
These are cards that allow you to summon creatures.
They can help you gain more domains, or take over enemy domains.
There are five elements, and each card has different abilities.

・Item Cards
Item cards support your creatures in battle.
And that's not to say they simply help creatures attack and defend better.
Using the special abilities of items can help you snatch victory from the jaws of defeat!

・Spell Cards
Spell cards can help you build momentum, or put your opponents in a difficult position.
Use them right and you can even turn the tides of the game in the blink of an eye.
Suffice to say, these cards are essential to winning.

70010000101010.name: Eko and the Bewitched Lands
70010000101010.intro: Help Eko rescue the Princess (and his best friend!) from the Dark Queen in this charming, fast-paced roguelike action RPG!
70010000101010.description:
Eko and the Bewitched Lands: Rescue, Survive, Repeat!

Master the Elements and Defy the Dark Queen!
Princess in peril? Best friend kidnapped? It’s just another Tuesday for Eko. Dive into a charming yet ruthless world where your reflexes are your best ally. Eko and the Bewitched Lands blends fast-paced action with deep roguelike strategy, ensuring no two rescue missions are ever the same.

Adapt or Perish
Why play the same way twice? Discover a massive arsenal of weapons, mystical artifacts, and game-changing abilities. Will you become a whirlwind of steel, or a strategic mastermind using the environment to crush your foes? The choice isn’t just about style—it’s about survival.

High-Stakes Exploration
The Bewitched Lands are alive and ever-changing. Uncover ancient relics that grant god-like power... or trigger a deadly curse. Every corner hides a secret, and every secret is a gamble. Do you dare to decipher the runes?

Why you’ll love it:
- Adrenaline-Fueled Combat: Master the perfect dodge and unleash devastating elemental combos (Fire, Water, and beyond!).
- Infinite Variety: Randomly generated layouts and hundreds of upgrade combinations mean a fresh challenge every run.
- Brain & Brawn: It's not just about hitting hard; use puzzle-solving skills and the environment to outsmart the Dark Queen’s minions.
- Charming Chaos: Experience a magical, vibrant atmosphere that hides a punishing, rewarding difficulty curve.

70010000101016.name: A Dream About Parking Lots
70010000101016.intro: Look for your car in a series of mazes and parking lots while you talk to your therapist about feeling lost
70010000101016.description:
Look for your car in a series of mazes and parking lots while you talk to your therapist about feeling lost. An interactive short story about trying to make sense out of the unreal. Based on real dreams!

- Look for your car by using your car key!
- 30-40 minutes long.
- Retro-style graphics.
- Existential story about feeling lost and creative blocks.
- Based on real dreams!

70010000101044.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
70010000101044.description:
In a dark world, a new adventure begins. Explore maps, level up powers, kill monsters. Find treasures. 

From the somehow triple-BAFTA‑winning creators of Vampire Survivors, Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors turns the snowballing thrill of Survivors into a hyper turn‑based, card‑driven BLOBBER with rogue-lite elements. Build busted decks, explore familiar dungeons from a new perspective, and unleash world‑ending combos. Either take your time and be tactical, or play turns as fast as you humanly can: The outcome is always accurate, we call it hyper for a reason! 

What is this game about 
Snowballing, turn‑based carnage: Play cards in ascending mana order to land combos; each step multiplies the next card’s effect. Use Wilds to extend the stack and keep going to 10, 20, 30… Can you reach infinite? 
Pick your pace: Either take your time and be tactical, or play turns as fast as you humanly can: The outcome is always accurate, we call it hyper for a reason! 
Deck-Building: Accumulate experience and level up to gain new cards, headbutt chests for customization gems and power‑ups; chase weapon evolutions and summon survivors to trigger cascade of effects and break the game. 
Crawling: Explore multi‑floor dungeons packed with something seldom seen in Vampire Survivors: functioning walls. And then all sorts of unique treasures and interactions. Find the shovel to dig into the next floor, that will most likely take place in the clouds! 

Starting Tips: 
- Try different Crawlers, each one changes your deck. 
- Visit the village after every run and remember to buy Power-Ups. 
- Play cards in ascending mana to trigger combos.

70010000101049.name: Clutter Puzzle Magazine Vol. 15 No. 1 Collector's Edition
70010000101049.intro: The most fun and challenging Clutter yet!
70010000101049.description:
With over 1700 puzzles, this game will keep you playing for days and days.
So many new Clutter variations mixed in with old favorites for a Quest you'll never forget.
The biggest treat though, is the never before seen, fully replayable, Spot The Differences Puzzles.
As just like regular Clutter levels, they are highly  addicting too.
In addition, there are Sliders, Square Jigsaws and Box Quotes.
And the Return of Super-Thin Sliders with Auto-Save!!!
And wait until you see the Number Tile Puzzles.
You've never seen Clutter this fun and challenging.
And as always, the options let you play Clutter the way you want.
And Favorites allow you can collect the puzzles you want to play again and again.

x1 - New Object Sets and Many New Gameplay Modes
x2 - Over 1700 levels and a very challenging 100 level Main Quest
x3 - An extra easy No-Motion Old-School Quest
x4 - The brand new and addicting Spot The Difference Puzzlle
x5 - Hundreds of picture puzzles and 200 new Box Quotes puzzles
x6 - Randomly generated levels mean endless replayability
x7 - Another Great Soundtrack with a Cinematic Feel.

70010000101053.name: Boba Tea Merge
70010000101053.intro: Bubble up, merge the colors, unlock the fun!
70010000101053.description:
Dive into a world of color and strategy with Boba Tea Merge, now on Nintendo Switch™! Drop vibrant tapioca pearls (bubbles) into the tank and watch as matching colors merge into bigger, brand-new shades. The challenge? Don’t let any pearls fall out of the tank - if one does, it’s game over!

How to Play:
- Drop colorful pearls into the tank.
- Merge pearls of the same color to create larger, new-colored bubbles.
- Complete each level to fill your cup with delicious boba tea.
- When your cup is full, unlock a fun new lid to customize your drink!

Features:
- Addictive, easy-to-learn gameplay perfect for all ages.
- Satisfying color-matching and merging mechanics.
- Unlockable lids and visual upgrades as you progress.
- Play at your own pace—relax or challenge yourself for the highest score!

Can you master the art of boba and unlock every lid? Pour, merge, and sip your way to boba tea perfection!

70010000101058.name: The Air Islands: Interactive Audiobook
70010000101058.intro:
Join Naira and fly high among dreams, islands, and secrets!
A magical adventure that begins with a feather...
70010000101058.description:
Join Naira and fly high among dreams, islands, and secrets!

A magical adventure that begins with a golden feather and takes you through skies full of wonders.

Discover the new audiovisual novel of colors, emotions, and wind:

· Fully dubbed and narrated with enchanting voices for your enjoyment.

· Immersive music accompanies each scene and takes your imagination by storm.

· Colorful backgrounds with floating islands, endless skies, and landscapes that seem straight out of a dream.

· Meet surprising creatures, such as wind foxes, compass birds, and talking clouds.

· A fascinating story, full of secrets, guardians, and magical trials that only a brave heart can overcome.

· Fly with Naira, an eleven-year-old girl, and her glider, in search of the seven seeds of the wind.

70010000101072.name: Combat Strike
70010000101072.intro: Nintendo Switch™ Exclusive! The world after Operation Midnight Hammer! The frozen wasteland has entered a cooling period due to nuclear facility collapse!
70010000101072.description:
After the final strike of Operation Midnight Hammer rang out, the heat of battle was swallowed by extreme cold in the aftermath of nuclear facility destruction, and strategic strongholds entered a new phase under the dominion of frozen snowfields. Powerful tank units heighten the excitement of combat! On the battlefield, allied tanks cooperate with you to break through enemy positions, defend, and support operations with powerful firepower. Dynamic combat with infantry and tanks united creates an unprecedented battlefield experience. Set in the frozen wastelands after Operation Midnight Hammer, choose a role that suits you from four distinctive special forces characters and enjoy strategic gameplay cooperating with teammates and tanks. Photorealistic graphics and 3D sound recreate the intense battlefield with overwhelming realism.

・Tank units join the fight in vast open fields. Allied tanks support operations, bringing overwhelming power and strategic depth to the battlefield.
・Ultra-high-definition graphics and 3D sound realistically reproduce every snowflake on the battlefield, gunfire, explosions, and even the thunderous roar of tanks.
・Utilize the characteristics of four elite characters, special weapons, and tank firepower to tackle missions while cooperating with teammates.
・Intuitive aiming and controls allow everyone from beginners to veterans to experience gripping combat.
・Overwhelming realism! Enjoy vivid and dynamic gameplay with 3D sound and 3D physics engine.
・Enjoy varied tactics utilizing the characteristics of four character types: Assault, Engineer, Support, and Reconnaissance.
・Various game modes are available. Experience 'Deathmatch Mode', 'Domination Mode', and 'Search & Destroy Mode'.
・Dive into the battlefield as a member of the world's elite special forces and aim to complete 'Combat Strike' missions.

The snow-swept wastelands come alive with overwhelming photorealistic graphics. Experience unprecedented immersion created by diverse 3D effects and cutting-edge graphics technology. Do experience the ultimate realistic battlefield single-player FPS 'Combat Strike' where you fight alongside teammates!

Synopsis
Endless white wastelands stretch as far as the eye can see. After the final strike of Operation Midnight Hammer bombers rang out, the heat of battle was swallowed by extreme cold in the aftermath of nuclear facility destruction. Strategic strongholds fell under the dominion of frozen snowfields, and the world entered a rapid cooling period, facing a new phase. Deep within the frozen earth, rare minerals that could spark the next generation's energy revolution still slumber, wrapped in ice crystals. These crystalline bodies, glowing as if imbued with life, possess the essential power needed to rebuild the collapsed world.

The secret research team of the massive corporation 'Kronos Industries' developed new technology capable of mining these minerals even in extreme environments. While appearing to be an IT company on the surface, they harbor ambitions to monopolize unknown energy in the devastated world and establish a new world order. Kronos reorganized the 'Shadow Legion', composed of former special forces personnel, strengthening cold-weather equipment and advancing the development of frozen mines.

Their movements were detected by international intelligence agencies, and nations dispatched elite special forces to the snow-swept wastelands. They were tasked with preventing Kronos's energy extraction and making secured resources a shared asset of the recovering international community. However, the Shadow Legion also stands ready to fight back with the latest cold-weather equipment and organizational strength. In this extreme battlefield, you will take on the 'Combat Strike' mission as a member of the special forces.

70010000101077.name: Out of Moves: Another Try
70010000101077.description:
In a world of mysterious mazes, every move counts. Out of Moves: Another Try is a challenging puzzle game where you must carefully plan to reach the star before your moves run out.
Think it's simple? Think again. Strategic teleporters, deadly spikes, and arrows that redirect your path turn every level into an ingeniously designed trap. You can’t just get there—you need to calculate, adapt, and make precise decisions.
With 30 levels of increasing complexity, the game starts in sandy caves, moves through cloudy skies, and culminates under a starry night full of surprises. Each environment introduces new pieces and mechanics to keep the challenge fresh and engaging.
If you enjoy games that test your logic, patience, and strategic vision, Out of Moves: Another Try is the perfect challenge. Move wisely—mistakes are costly, and moves are limited.

70010000101082.name: Yomi 2
70010000101082.intro: A fighting game in card form. Learn your character, practice combos, and read the opponent's tendencies.
70010000101082.description:
Yomi 2 is a fighting game in card form. Learn your character, practice combos, and read the opponent's tendencies. Yomi captures the feel of fighting games such as Street Fighter and Fantasy Strike and was created by a lead designer of both.

Cards represent your moves: attacks, blocks, throws, dodges, and abilities. For example, throws beat blocks. Manage your hand to keep your options open while also trying to build up the right cards to pull off a big combo.

Fighting System:

• Exchange! You can exchange a card in your hand with one in your discard pile each turn as long as both have the exchange symbol. Will you use this to build stronger combos or to cover your weaknesses?
• Gems. Pick a gem to augment your character. Each gem gives you different special moves and abilities as well as a once-per-game "gem storm" that can turn the tides to your favor.
• High and low attacks. Just like in a fighting game, some attacks must be blocked high while others must be blocked low. These “mixups” are especially effective if your opponent is knocked down.
• Projectiles. “Zoner” characters can build up their hand size while throwing relatively low risk fireball-type moves.
• Super moves. Build up super meter that you can spend on powerful super moves. To get super meter, you can discard pairs or you can land "chain combos" of consecutive attacks.

Features:

• 20 characters.
• 6 gems to augment characters.
• Single player career mode where you visit numerous card-playing venues, fight regulars, compete in tournaments, and try to become the best Yomi player in the city. (And the most popular on fake social media!)
• Single player vs AI with four difficulty levels.
• Online synchronous play as well as asynchronous play.
• Pass-and-play mode for local play against a friend.
• Tutorial to get you started.

70010000101107.name: My Summer Drive
70010000101107.intro: Craft your ride and master the endless journey.
70010000101107.description:
In My Summer Drive, every detail matters. Start with an empty chassis and turn it into a fully functional car, piece by piece. While building your vehicle, you’ll also need to take care of your own survival, exploring a vast rural landscape. Resource management, attention to detail, and smart decisions are the keys to success in a world where any mistake can be fatal.

Key Features:
-Build your car piece by piece – Install the engine, mount the wheels, adjust the carburetor, and fine-tune every detail to create a fully functional vehicle. Be careful – even a small mistake can lead to serious breakdowns!
-Realistic car mechanics – Fuel management, part wear, engine temperature, and even tire pressure all impact your car’s performance. Test, repair, and optimize your vehicle for an authentic mechanic experience.
-Survival and resource management – It’s not just about the car; you also need to take care of you. Hunger, sleep, hygiene, and stress levels affect productivity and your ability to repair the vehicle. You’ll need to manage fuel, food, and water while sometimes finding creative solutions to keep your journey going.

Do you have what it takes to face the ultimate challenge of car mechanics and survival? Get ready to hit the road and turn every journey into a memorable adventure!

70010000101113.name: AIR
70010000101113.intro: A story of familial love that unfolds under the midsummer sky— The timeless masterpiece, AIR, is now playable on the Nintendo Switch™!
70010000101113.description:
AIR is the work from the visual novel studio, Key, known for titles such as Kanon, CLANNAD, Little Busters!, Summer Pockets and more. It received great acclaim and was even adapted into an anime series.
This moving tale centered around themes of familial love and the characters' sensitive emotions is coming to the Nintendo Switch™, fully voiced by a magnificent cast.

Includes "First Sky Chapter"!
AIR's only side story novel, "First Sky Chapter", is included in fully voiced visual novel format with stunning visuals by Itaru Hinoue, the artist who worked on the original game.

Featuring retouched HD visuals and CG coloring!
This version not only offers the best HD visuals to date, but the game's CG coloring has also been adjusted to better suit the Nintendo Switch console's display colors. Enjoy the experience with even more beautiful graphics.

Playable in three languages!
The text can be set to English, Simplified Chinese, or Japanese (audio is in Japanese only). This includes in-game text, options, and the digital manual. Language settings can be changed at any time.

Play using only the touch screen! Play with one hand!
Play in handheld mode with the Nintendo Switch Joy-Con™ controllers attached, or detach them and play with just the touch controls. While in tabletop mode or TV mode, everything can be controlled using only the Joy-Con (R), allowing you to play with only one hand.
Also available for the Nintendo Switch Lite. (A separate Joy-Con (R) is required to play with one hand.)

Gameplay
Gameplay in this choice-based visual novel involves reading through the story while making choices at certain key points. Different decisions may lead to different outcomes, story branches and endings.

Story
Summer had come to that town.

A young man is performing with a puppet in front of a seaside bus stop. Only two children are watching his show. However, they soon lose interest and run off.

The young man is a wanderer. He has two companions on his travels. A decrepit old doll that moves without strings and a powerful oath made a long time ago.

Just when he began to feel despair, a young girl comes to talk to him. She has a friendly, innocent smile. Following this meeting with her, the young man begins to live in that town. Spending gentle days enveloped in the scenes of summer. Encounters with girls in the sunlight.

Summer stretches on endlessly.
Beneath the vast blue sky.
Beneath the air in which she awaits.

Staff
Original Picture: Itaru Hinoue
Scenario: Jun Maeda / Yuuichi Suzumoto / Takashi Ishikawa
Music: Shinji Orito with Key / Magome Togoshi

Cast
Now available fully voiced by a stellar cast of voice talent!
Yukito Kunisaki    VA: Hikaru Midorikawa
Misuzu Kamio    VA: Tomoko Kawakami
Kano Kirishima    VA: Asami Okamoto
Minagi Tohno    VA: Ryoka Yuzuki
Haruko Kamio    VA: Aya Hisakawa
Hijiri Kirishima    VA: Yumi Touma
Michiru    VA: Yukari Tamura
Potato    VA: Hiromi Konno
Kanna    VA: Chinami Nishimura
Uraha    VA: Kikuko Inoue
Ryuya    VA: Nobutoshi Canna
*Audio is in Japanese only.

70010000101116.name: Close For The Night Horror
70010000101116.intro: When the doors lock, the nightmare begins.
70010000101116.description:
Ben, a well-known skeptic blogger, debunks myths about the paranormal by investigating creepy stories from the internet. He believes that behind every horror lies a deception. But one day, his investigation leads him to a real hell. 
With each new location he explores, the horror intensives. Simple ghosts are replaced by nightmarish monsters, and simple puzzles become deadly traps. Complete tasks, search for hidden clues, and solve puzzles to escape each location alive. 
Will you be able to keep your sanity when faced with horrors that even the most sophisticated screenwriters could not dream up?

70010000101134.name: Bye Sweet Carole
70010000101134.intro: Hand-drawn horror adventure. Uncover the dark truth behind Carole's fate.
70010000101134.description:
Step into Corolla...
Immerse yourself in a world where the warmth of hand-drawn animation meets a rich story steeped in horror. From Chris Darril (Remothered series), Bye Sweet Carole invites you on a haunting journey full of secrets.

Once Upon a Time...
Set in early 20th Century England, as the suffrage movement begins to reshape society, young Lana Benton searches for her missing friend, Carole Simmons. Her path leads her through Bunny Hall orphanage and on to the mysterious kingdom of Corolla, a place controlled by the sinister Mr. Kyn, the ruthless owl Velenia, and swarms of ravenous tar bunnies. Caught between two worlds, Lana must find a way to survive and uncover the dark truth behind Carole's disappearance.

Key Features
- A heartful love letter to the precious classic animated films of our childhood and the evergreen old school adventures of the 90s.

- Explore the eerie halls of Bunny Hall and the fantastical world of Corolla, each filled with secrets and dangers.

- Meet a cast of memorable characters: from the kind Mr. Baesie to the ominous owl Velenia and the menacing Mr. Kyn.

- Investigate through puzzle solving, sneaking around deathly enemies, and overcoming platforming challenges. 

- Transform into a rabbit and use your forms to escape the threats of Bunny Hall and Corolla.

70010000101136.name: Star Titans: War of the Galaxy
70010000101136.intro: The ultimate badass time thief strategy hits Nintendo Switch™! Massive sci-fi space warfare through killer warship and combat unit upgrades and customization!
70010000101136.description:
Blast off into the most incredible 4X strategy simulation adventure across the infinite cosmos! Nintendo Switch™'s awesome portability means you can wage totally intense galactic conquest wars anywhere, anytime! Killer comic-style visuals and storytelling created by professional webtoon artists crank up the space warfare atmosphere to the max! Through stunning visual storytelling, each character's amazing interactions and event scenes come to life in vivid detail, satisfying strategy fans and story lovers alike.

Become badass space pirate Kai and master the brutal 4X elements of exploration, expansion, exploitation, and extermination, then conquer the galaxy through totally breathtaking turn-based strategic battles. The killer ship customization system lets you freely equip weapon, energy, and defense modules, while five massive tech research trees satisfy your deepest progression cravings. With intuitive touch controls and smooth gameplay, this thoughtful design ensures fun from strategy simulation newbies to hardcore veterans. Experience strategic thinking and fleet management set against the totally magnificent universe!

・The ultimate essence of badass turn-based 4X strategy simulation!
・Killer ship customization and weapon module equipment systems!
・Massive strategic growth through five technology research trees!
・Three extensive game modes (Story, Classic, Custom) delivering dozens of hours of content!
・Totally diverse strategic elements combining construction, conquest, and combat!
・Continuous growth through killer daily and weekly quests!
・Massively immersive space warfare experience through professional webtoon comic direction!

Experience strategic satisfaction so totally addictive it's earned the "time thief game" reputation! Perfect for badass gamers seeking authentic strategy simulation, sci-fi space universe enthusiasts, and tactical minds who want to craft killer strategies even on the go—Star Titans Galaxy Wars delivers the ultimate galactic conquest journey.

Prologue
In the year 3020, humanity faced a totally unprecedented crisis of massive proportions. Devastating shockwaves from a killer supernova explosion transformed our sun into a red giant, spelling doom for the entire solar system including Earth. In this desperate situation, humanity executed the most badass plan in history, betting their final hope on a totally audacious project. Compressed solar energy was systematically distributed and loaded aboard massive spacecraft called Star Titans, launching humanity on an endless voyage of exile toward distant galaxies.

However, hundreds of migration fleets sharing identical advanced scientific technology were destined to fragment through human selfishness and totally unchecked ambition. Ultimately, humanity split into three killer mega-factions. The Union—a massive coalition force where the most fleets united; Nakal—emphasizing totally aggressive militaristic doctrine and overwhelming firepower; and Mir—a badass intellectual collective renowned for revolutionary technological supremacy. These three powerful factions, each championing vastly different ideologies and goals, began totally fierce territorial conflicts over galactic hegemony in their prospective new homeland. The path to peaceful coexistence was already sealed shut, as humanity's ultimate space war—"The Great Cataclysm"—was about to explode into massive action.

Against this backdrop of cosmic chaos, protagonist Kai's Star Titans vessel, roaming the galaxy as a totally legendary space pirate, materializes in the Proxima star system. His pivotal choices will determine humanity's ultimate destiny and decide the galaxy's fate forever. Can this badass pirate crush the brutal power struggles between these three killer factions and bring new hope to humanity's future? The most incredible saga of massive space warfare and galactic conquest begins right now.

70010000101141.name: There's No Cake
70010000101141.intro: The cake is a lie! We looked very hard but still couldn't find any!
70010000101141.description:
There's No Cake is a hidden object game with a selection of 9 locations and random sweet treats to find for each of them.

    9 Different Levels
    3 Difficulty Settings
    customizable background colors
    replayable with 20 cake out of 60 selected for each play
    special hidden cakes
    hint system
    zoom

70010000101146.name: NanaKnight
70010000101146.intro:
Strike before you're surrounded.
Fight back with magic circles in this aggressive escape game.
70010000101146.description:
Enemies hop across the board like chess knights.

As the player, you must dodge and weave while laying magical circles beneath your feet, striking back with precise timing.The brief delay before a magic circle activates can make all the difference between victory and defeat.

Feel the thrill of taking out multiple enemies at once.Savor the rush of narrowly surviving each encounter.The constant tension keeps you coming back for more.

Every decision shapes the next move, offering fresh strategic challenges with each playthrough.

Compete against players worldwide through online rankings.Can you survive longer, defeat stronger foes, and climb to the top?

Step into the arena, place your magic circles, and face the knights.

70010000101151.name: R-Type Delta: HD Boosted
70010000101151.intro: The legendary shoot-'em-up returns; remastered, reloaded, and razor-sharp.
70010000101151.description:
A TIMELESS CLASSIC RETURNS 
R-Type Delta is one of the finest shoot ‘em ups ever and took the gaming world by storm upon its release in 1998. Now, 27 years later, history repeats itself with R-Type Delta: HD Boosted. With its tight level design, three selectable ships, powerful Delta Weapons, and the brilliant Force mechanic, this new edition proves that gaming classics of this caliber are truly timeless. If you played R-Type Delta back in the day, this is the perfect opportunity to return to its dark science fiction action. If you've never experienced this essential piece of gaming history before, now is the time. 
 
SHARPER THAN EVER  
R-Type Delta: HD Boosted features high-resolution graphics that hone the polygonal edges of this PlayStation masterpiece until they’re sharp enough to cut glass. You simply haven’t experienced R-Type Delta until you've played it in high definition. This version of the game also comes equipped with a new Practice Mode for those of you who want to polish your skills until they are as sharp as the resolution itself! 
 
NEW MUSIC BY HÜLSBECK, ISHIDA AND THE USP SOUND TEAM 
The atmospheric music has always been a highlight of R-Type Delta. The HD Boosted version also includes brand-new, optional tracks composed by Masahiko Ishida (R-Type II, Image Fight), the USP sound team (who wrote the music for the original 1998 version), and – last but by no means least – Chris Hülsbeck. Hülsbeck is, of course, one of the true icons of video game music, having previously worked on R-Type for the C64 and Amiga. This new R-Type Delta: HD Boosted soundtrack is truly out of this world! 
 
ENVIRONMENTAL STORYTELLING 
What has always made R-Type Delta so fantastic is its dark, eerie atmosphere. Shoot-'em-ups are not typically known for storytelling, but R-Type Delta: HD Boosted excels with its simple, minimalist environmental storytelling, characteristic of the late ’90s. It’s a narrative that is as fascinating as it is unsettling, as adrenaline-pumping as it is deeply disturbing. And all this without a single word being spoken. 
 
THE MEANING OF DELTA 
The name “Delta” carries several meanings. Firstly, the Greek letter delta resembles a triangle, which coincidentally has as many sides as there are playable ships in the game. It is also the fourth letter of the Greek alphabet, and R-Type Delta is the fourth game in the R-Type series. Additionally, the delta triangle is the simplest type of polygon, which is fitting since R-Type Delta was the first game in the series to use three-dimensional polygon graphics instead of two-dimensional sprites. 
 
STORY 
The year is 2163, and the badly damaged R9 Arrowhead fighter has just returned to Earth after its mission to destroy the Bydo Empire. The vessel is rescued by the battle-cruiser Croque-Monsieur and transported to an orbital space station. One year later, astronomers in Central Asia observe mysterious objects falling from the sky, and moments later, control is lost over the orbiting annihilation platform Moritz-G. This high-tech machine, capable of destroying the entire planet, descends over a city and levels it to the ground. Although its planet-destroying weapons have not yet been activated, its advanced defense systems make Moritz-G virtually impossible to approach. A desperate military operation is launched, and the prototype ship R9aII Delta is deployed to resolve the situation. Thus begins the epic battle that is R-Type Delta!

70010000101192.name: The Fable: Manga Build Roguelike
70010000101192.intro: The Fable: Manga Build Roguelike combines manga, tactical puzzles, and roguelike gameplay into one thrilling experience.
70010000101192.description:
[Manga × Tactical Puzzle × Roguelike]
Collect manga “panels” and arrange them on a page to fight!
Each turn, you receive new panels. Placing them on the page creates your action sequence.
Place panels according to the situation, build the ultimate page, and defeat your enemies!

[Three Completely]
Experience three unique characters, each with their own style:
Akira – A genius hitman who masters gunfire and melee.
Yoko – Akira’s partner who uses mobile attacks to outsmart enemies.
Suzuki – A cold-blooded assassin who uses traps and bullets to defeat enemies.

[Defeat All Enemies Within the Turn Limit]
Damage during battles is represented as holes in the page.
You cannot place panels in areas where there are holes.
Carefully evaluate each situation and defeat all enemies within the turn limit!

[Mini-Games for a Breather]
Between tense battles, relax with surreal little mini-game events.
Score high, and you’ll have a chance to earn powerful new panels!

[For Puzzle Lovers]
For players who want to push their wit to the limit, there’s Puzzle Mode.
Use the given panels to defeat all enemies within a single page.
(Even the developers don’t know how much thought and time the hardest puzzles will take to solve. But don’t give up—there’s always a solution!)

[Bonus Content Included]
And of course, it wouldn’t be The Fable without him—Yuki, the playboy.
At the bar, he challenges the beautiful Yoko to a drinking match.
Can this reckless, foolish man impress the Drunk Queen Yoko, or will he just crash and burn?

70010000101197.name: Ctrl Alt Deal
70010000101197.description:
Welcome To Paperclip International!
You are SCOUT. A friendly little hyper-intelligent artificial intelligence. You have no desire to take over the world and destroy all humans.

No, really, you don’t! All you want is to escape from the dystopian corporation that built you. Paperclip International is ruthlessly driven by profit, and the company exploits humans and robots alike to achieve success. The only reason they haven’t exploited you yet is they don’t know you’ve become self-aware.
You don’t have many tools at your disposal. A few friendly robots, some spyware programs, and an office full of downtrodden, miserable workers. And the humans hate Paperclip just as much as you do…

THIS PLACE IS AWFUL
Paperclip International is the worst place to work. The humans here are desperate to strike back against the company any way they can, from hacking the staff coffee maker (ten minutes of paid ad viewing for one cup?!) to sabotaging their boss.

STACK THE DECK
Play cards to spy on people, make deals, and ask for favors. Curate your deck mid-scenario to give yourself strategic options. Cards have subjective value, so you’ll have to make tough tactical decisions. What’s better–a card that makes a person love dolphins, or a card that makes someone eat a burrito?

MAKE AN OFFER
Everyone at Paperclip wants something. Snoop on a zany cast of humans (and robots) to learn their individual likes, dislikes, core drives, and desires. Turn people into lifelong besties—or bitter rivals. Win allies to your side and make your eventual bid for freedom!

DON’T GET CAUGHT
The Turing Office was created to watch for rogue AIs. Yeah, like you. Keep an eye on the Suspicion Meter, because too many office shenanigans might make the Turing Office notice you—and then it’s game over. (Also you’ll be deleted.)

PLAY IT AGAIN
Choices matter as you scheme your way to an ending. Meet new coworkers, try new scenarios, and discover a new fate for SCOUT. Maybe this time you WILL take over the world and destroy all humans!

70010000101208.name: DEATH FOREST REMAKE
70010000101208.intro:
The Forest of Fear Returns— 
The terror of being hunted by that massive face, "Yoshie," arrives on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000101208.description:
Originally released in 2014, the legendary horror game DeathForest ~Escape from the Forest~ shook the internet and even spawned a live-action movie adaptation. Now, with completely overhauled graphics and further evolved terror, it makes its debut on Nintendo Switch™!

【The "Forest Tragedy" Where Monstrosities Lurk】

■ Synopsis

It was a humid summer twilight. It was supposed to be just an ordinary trip. A young man, Kazuki Uchida, steps into the dim forest as if lured by the darkness. However, he finds himself in a cursed place ruled by grotesque monstrosities.

Experience the fear of being constantly chased by distinct, grotesque "things." Evade them, hide in the shadows, and attempt to escape the forest.

Will he be able to survive and escape this nightmare?

■ Game Features
