There are no "Safe Zones" in this game. From the very moment the game begins, that giant face, "Yoshie," will chase you relentlessly.

Additionally, high-difficulty content has been implemented, including "Double Speed Mode" and "Max Terror Mode."

■ New Mode Added: "Death Forest: ANOTHER"

In the Mirror World, the terror of "that face" does not end with just one. It is a proliferation of nightmares, an evolution of despair.

The protagonist of this mode is Toka Hiiragi, a high school girl investigating local folklore. An original story unfolds from a perspective different from the main game, closing in on the mysteries hidden within "that forest."

Furthermore, this mode features "Multi-Endings" where your choices greatly alter your fate!

Will she be able to escape the Mirror World alive?

■ Recommended For:

Fans of first-person horror games.

Those who aren't great with horror but still want a thrill.

Streamers looking for a game that will hype up their audience.

70010000101213.name: Queen's Garden: French Splendor Collector's Edition
70010000101213.intro: Aid Marigold and Florian in their efforts to bring these plants to life!
70010000101213.description:
Welcome to Queen's Garden: French Splendor, where your green thumb meets your Match 3 puzzle-solving brain! 
Step into a world where gardens don't just need water – they need YOUR help! 
Surrounded by gorgeous French scenery, grow and expand your garden, complete Match 3 levels, and make this puzzling paradise truly your own!

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- 110 bonus levels to explore!
- A whole new garden to decorate!
- Power-ups that make your average garden gnome look boring!

70010000101217.name: Psychopathy Assessment
70010000101217.description:
Psychopathy Assessment is a retro-90s V.H.S style analog horror game that blurs the line between reality and delusion. Step into a universe where you're not just playing a game; you're taking a psychopathy test, but the stakes are considerably higher than a straightforward diagnosis.

Answer a series of questions designed to probe your deepest thoughts and impulses.

Every choice has consequences, each more unsettling than the last, as the screen flickers and the tape warps under the weight of your decisions.

Are you ready to find out if you're truly a psychopath? Or will the test itself drive you to madness? The only way to know is to press play.

Features:

-Psychopathy Test: Respond to a series of frightening and penetrating questions intended to delve into your psyche. Will the results show something sinister, or is this just a game?

-Dynamic Consequences: Each decision has an impact on the atmosphere and your final ending, guaranteeing that no two playthroughs are identical.

-Immersive VHS Filter: Play via a distorted lens, complete with realistic VHS effects, tape errors, and visual distortions that worsen as you advance.

-Psychological Horror: A story that plays with your mind, questioning your perspective of reality and blurring the borders between fiction and truth.

-Multiple Endings: Discover various outcomes based on your decisions throughout the assessment. Each ending provides a fresh viewpoint on your results.

70010000101219.name: Village Supermarket Simulator - Old Times Edition Market Sim
70010000101219.intro: Build and run your very own old-fashioned village supermarket! Sell products, expand your store and become a legendary trading manager!
70010000101219.description:
Step back in time and manage your very own village supermarket! In Village Supermarket Simulator – Old Times Edition, experience the charm of a traditional marketplace while building your business from the ground up.

Key Features:
* Run Your Village Market: Stock shelves, serve customers, and manage daily operations in a cozy, old-timey village setting.
* Upgrade and Expand: Improve your store, unlock new products, and attract more villagers to boost your profits.
* Decorate Your Shop: Customize your market with rustic decorations and create a welcoming environment for your customers.

Manage, trade, and thrive—can you turn your small village market into a legendary old-time supermarket empire?

70010000101223.name: Rise of Rana
70010000101223.intro: Cause chaos, master wild skills, and explore massive cities in this hilarious open-world sandbox.
70010000101223.description:
Rise of Rana is a single-player open-world action-adventure filled with humor, destruction, and complete freedom of movement. 
Play as two main characters (with dozens of costumes and
accessories) and explore massive cities where you can fight, complete missions, cause chaos, or just
have fun.

Key Features:

• Explore two massive open cities – packed with life, vehicles, and interactable objects
• Complete 200+ fully-voiced quests – in any order you choose
• Wield 112 weapons – including inflatable guns, mechanical fists, and the hilarious piggy gun
• Drive 700+ vehicles – cars, tanks, boats, planes, and robots that morph into mechanical animals
• Discover hilarious vehicles – like a giant clown vacuum truck that shoots people from a cannon
• Unlock 63+ skills and abilities – from tornados and black holes to fun teleportation portals and voodoo
• Master 150+ fighting moves – inspired by MMA and fast-paced action games
• Enjoy wild minigames – including garbage truck jobs, ambulance runs, police chases, hairstyling, dancing, ATM hacking, food selling, mining and selling precious metals, skateboarding, and more.
• Experience vehicle destruction – with full mesh deformation and realistic physics
• Battle city bosses – alien-like monsters you can challenge in epic fights
• Glide from rooftops – using wingsuit-style aerial movement
• Raise battle-ready dogs – loyal pets you can level up and use in combat
• Climb buildings and use ropes – to reach high or hidden areas
• Enjoy realistic voxel lighting and day-night cycles – for a dynamic atmosphere

A must-play for anyone who loves explosive gameplay, hilarious moments, and limitless exploration..

70010000101234.name: FPS Bullet Storm
70010000101234.description:
Step into the action with a high-intensity first-person shooter built for fast, competitive matches.

Choose your class, enter one of several epic battlegrounds, and unleash your full potential. Precision is everything — miss no shot, leave no enemy standing.

With adrenaline-pumping gunfights, tactical decision-making, and razor-sharp reflexes, dominate the battlefield your way and prove you're a true elite combatant.

70010000101239.name: Yosei Wars
70010000101239.intro: Defeat the Junk Food and Rescue the Tooth Fairies!
70010000101239.description:
Jump, dodge and grab every tooth in a level to unleash a powerful lightning blast and save the captured fairy!

Join Hanoka, a brave fairy on a mission to rescue kidnapped tooth fairies from the clutches of mischievous junk food monsters in this fast-paced platformer inspired by many arcade classics.

Features:
- True Arcade feel with 36 levels and 6 bosses.
- Sweet But Deadly Foes
- Cute pixel art and beepy chiptune music
- Packed with extras! An Art Gallery, a Music Player, a Bestiary and even the game's prototypes.

9 out of 10 dentists recommend this game!

70010000101246.name: Shinobi Samurai
70010000101246.intro: The item that was passed around the pawn shop is a "Time Capsule" that travels to the present day...!
70010000101246.description:
Konoe Kino, a town pawnbroker's daughter, catches a cold and tries to take medicine, but...
the medicine she takes is a "time capsule" that was being sold at pawn shops.
When she drinks it, she travels back in time to the present day!
There she meets a wonderful man named Kazama, but the story ends up as a dream at the best part of the story.
Then two ninja who are after the "time capsule" appear, along with a samurai who helps her...
This is a story of friendship and love between a ninja and a samurai!

There are 15 illustrations!

70010000101253.name: VARLET Digital Deluxe Special App
70010000101253.description:
The "VARLET Digital Deluxe Bonus: Art & Sound App" is available as a free bonus download.

This application is a viewer app that includes the following:

Digital Creative Artbook (80 pages)
Digital Special Album (53 tracks)

70010000101259.name: INAZUMA ELEVEN: Victory Road Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000101259.intro: A new era of hyperdimensional football will see online battles ignite the world!
70010000101259.description:
O smoldering clouds, let INAZUMA's lightning split the sky!

The newest title in the hyperdimensional football RPG series "Inazuma Eleven" is finally here!
A new story featuring a new protagonist, over 5,400 characters to collect and train, as well as an intense competitive mode; there is no shortage of activities to enjoy!

■ Story Mode
This new story takes place 25 years after the first Inazuma Eleven.
In search of a world without football, protagonist Destin Billows enrolls at South Cirrus Junior High. Meanwhile, within the prestigious Raimon Junior High - renowned as the top team in the nationals - rises a Football Monster named Harper Evans.
When these two cross paths, a tale begins to unfold...

■ Chronicle Mode
A roster spanning over 5,400 characters from previous entries in the series!
Relive past Inazuma Eleven matches with Victorio, the boy who came from the future.
Take on various teams, collect and train characters, and build your ultimate dream team!

■ Bond Station (Kizuna Station)
Freely arrange nostalgic objects from the Inazuma Eleven series to create your own "Bond Town"!
Customize your avatar, invite friends over and enjoy socializing and playing matches together!
Your custom made avatar can also be used in matches!

■ The Ultimate Anime Experience Brought to Life by MAPPA
In-game anime cutscenes were made in cooperation with animation studio MAPPA!
With the longest anime runtime in the series' history, the story's intensity will reach new heights.

70010000101268.name: Cats and Seek : Kyoto
70010000101268.intro: Play hide-and-seek with 200 adorable cats in the heart of Kyoto!
70010000101268.description:
Cats and Seek: Kyoto is the third cozy adventure in this beloved series. 

Explore a charming scene set in the heart of Kyoto and play hide-and-seek with adorable cats! 

With soothing sounds, cute visuals, and relaxing gameplay, it’s the perfect way to chill out - solo or with friends.

Features:
- 200+ hidden cats to discover
- New! Photo and Paint Mode to capture and color your scene
- Free hints to help you along the way
- Save system to track your progress
- Adjustable game colours, brightness, and contrast!

70010000101278.name: Alphadia III
70010000101278.intro: Fight the Energi War and find your path in a fantasy RPG!
70010000101278.description:
Before Alphadia I, the world was torn by the Energi War—fueled by humanity's lust for life energy. In the midst of it, an energi clone named Alfonso begins to question everything. With nothing but his doubts and determination, he sets off on a journey to uncover meaning in a world consumed by power. What truth awaits at the end of his path?

Alphadia III returns with deep turn-based combat, SP Skills to shift the tide of battle, and new mechanics like Arrays and the Energi Crock system. Upgrade your ship into a seaplane, trade Energi Elements, and dive into missions, arenas, and more—all wrapped in charming pixel graphics and a beautiful fantasy RPG adventure.

70010000101283.name: Monster City
70010000101283.intro: Blupi and his monster friends embark on a brave mission to make human friends!
70010000101283.description:
A heartwarming visual novel where monsters prove they're not so scary.

Enter the world of Monster City, a fully illustrated visual story designed especially for young readers.

Meet Blupi and her adorable monster friends: Speedy Sisi, Shapeshifter Mimi, Snack Lover Bombo, and many more.
When they discover that humans think all monsters are scary, they embark on an adventure to prove them wrong.

With bravery, kindness, and some hilarious mishaps, the monsters try to show the world who they really are: friendly, fun, and full of heart.
Each chapter is filled with laughter, surprises, and unforgettable moments.

Will the children of Sunnyville accept them?

Will the adults run away in terror?

Or can a group of brave monsters teach an entire town about friendship?

Highlights
· 5 colorful chapters with over 20 illustrated scenes

· Hilarious monster dialogue and wacky situations

· A positive message about inclusion, courage, and teamwork

· No scary content: just laughter, learning, and lighthearted adventures

· Whether read alone or with an adult, Monster City is a delightful experience that feels like a picture book... with extra monster laughs!

Reading has never been so monstrously fun.

70010000101285.name: Knightica
70010000101285.intro:
Recruit, position, and synergize in this roguelike autobattler!
Lead your warband through strategic battles to free the Kingdoms.
70010000101285.description: Knightica is a turn-based roguelike auto-battler where you lead an army of powerful units to free the Kingdoms. Recruit warriors, position them wisely, and discover powerful synergies to overcome waves of monsters and bosses. Your choices—from commanders and units to shops and encounters—shape every run. Upgrade your troops, experiment with demonic souls, and uncover game-breaking enchants. Will you master your army and bring peace back to the realm?

70010000101599.name: SUPERMARKET SIMULATOR 25
70010000101599.intro: Transform a tiny shop into a bustling supermarket empire.
70010000101599.description:
SUPERMARKET SIMULATOR 25 puts you in the shoes of an ambitious entrepreneur aiming to turn a small shop into a thriving supermarket empire! Plan your strategy, organize shelves, hire staff, and meet customer demands to grow your profits and reputation.

Start with a small store and watch your business expand into a fully equipped supermarket, featuring diverse sections, special promotions, and unique products. Every decision counts—from pricing and stock management to marketing and interior design.

Key Features:
- Build and manage your own supermarket from scratch.
- Hire and coordinate staff to ensure customer satisfaction.
- Optimize shelves and inventory to boost sales.
- Design and customize your store to attract more customers.

Turn your supermarket into a retail empire and become a true business tycoon!

70010000101604.name: Big Adventure: Trip To Europe 9 Collector's Edition
70010000101604.intro: Another wonderful family vacation in Europe.
70010000101604.description:
Take an amazing trip through some of Europe's most inspiring locations, including ancient castles, culture centers, charming villages, and more! 
Get the most out of every stop along the way by finding dozens of hidden objects and solving clever mini-games on an incredible vacation packed with fun and adventure!

This hidden object game is full of new and popular tourist spots. 
Use your skills and knowledge to play mini-games and find all the hidden objects.

The collector's edition includes:
- Ten additional locations to explore!
- Find even more objects, but keep your eye out for a funny raccoon friend!
- Eight bonus mini-games and twelve more challenging puzzles!

70010000101614.name: Monza Legends: Classic Grand Prix 1950
70010000101614.intro: Relive the roar of history. Race like it's 1950
70010000101614.description:
Monza Legends: Classic Grand Prix 1950 takes you back to the golden era of motorsport. Get behind the wheel of legendary open-wheel racers and compete in adrenaline-fueled grand prix battles on historic circuits. Feel every gear shift, hear every engine roar, and master every turn in a beautifully recreated post-war racing world.

From the narrow straights of early Monza to the grit of wheel-to-wheel combat, every race captures the raw essence of 1950s motorsport. Compete against rival drivers in career mode, perfect your time trial skills, or simply enjoy the nostalgia of vintage speed.

Are you ready to become a legend?

70010000101623.name: Bodycam Record Shooter
70010000101623.intro:
Experience raw combat through a bodycam view.
Four unique maps, a vast arsenal,
The most realistic firefights yet.
70010000101623.description:
Step into the action with Bodycam Record Shooter, a tense and unforgiving single-player FPS that pushes realism to the limit. Viewed through the lens of a tactical body camera, every encounter feels raw, unpredictable, and dangerously close to reality.

This isn’t just about pulling the trigger—it’s about adapting under pressure. Move through four distinct maps, each designed with unique layouts, hazards, and combat scenarios.
Arm yourself with a wide range of weapons, from handguns to assault rifles, each recreated with lifelike handling and precision. Enemies are unpredictable and aggressive, forcing you to rely on strategy, aim, and quick decision-making to survive.

Features:
Bodycam Perspective – Heightened tension and immersion through a raw first-person view.
Four Unique Maps – Varied environments that challenge you to adapt your tactics.
Extensive Weapon Arsenal – Dozens of firearms with realistic recoil, reload, and handling.
Smart AI Opponents – Enemies react and adapt to your playstyle, keeping battles intense.
High-Fidelity Visuals – Crisp graphics and detailed effects for maximum realism.
Every mission is a fight for survival—where hesitation costs lives, and only precision keeps you alive.

70010000101628.name: Clutter Puzzle Magazine Vol. 16 No. 2 Collector's Edition
70010000101628.intro: The most fun and challenging Clutter yet!
70010000101628.description:
With over 1800 puzzles to keep you playing for days and days.
So many new Clutter variations mixed in with old favorites for a Quest you'll never forget.
The biggest treat though, is the much improved, Spot The Differences Puzzles.
There is also a new style of Clutter Gaps Puzzles.
As just like regular Clutter levels, they are highly  addicting too.
In addition, there are Sliders, Square Jigsaws and Box Quotes.
And wait until you see the Abstract Squares and Circle Puzzles.
You've never seen Clutter this fun and challenging.
And as always, the options let you play Clutter the way you want.
And Favorites allow you to collect the puzzles you want to play again and again.

x1 - New Object Sets and Many New Gameplay Modes
x2 - Over 1800 levels and a very challenging 100 level Main Quest
x3 - An extra easy No-Motion Old-School Quest
x4 - The much improved and addicting Spot The Difference Puzzlle
x5 - Hundreds of picture puzzles and 200 new Box Quotes puzzles
x6 - Randomly generated levels mean endless replayability
x7 - Another Great Soundtrack with a Cinematic Feel.

70010000101632.name: Chromacell
70010000101632.intro: Chromacell is a horizontal scrolling retro style 2D shoot 'em up with colourful pixel-art graphics.
70010000101632.description:
Select one of four difficulty modes and take on the enemy hoards!

- Engage enemies on land and in the air
- 10 uniquely themed stages to conquer
- 'No bullet mode' for beginners
- Power-up your weapons and thrusters
- Play with keyboard or gamepad
- Survive dangerous boss battles
- Find secrets for extra points

70010000101635.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Anmyeon Temple
70010000101635.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Anmyeon Temple, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 2 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000101660.name: EGGCONSOLE Xak Precious Package: The Tower of Gazzel PC-8801mkIISR
70010000101660.intro:
Will Latok be able to conquer the Tower of Gazel?
Make full use of your support members to overcome formidable foes and tricky puzzles!
70010000101660.description:
"Xak: The Tower of Gazzel," released by MicroCabin in 1991 in Japan, is a top-view action RPG. As indicated by the lack of a numbered title, it is officially considered a side story. However, it still features Latok as the protagonist, along with familiar characters like Frey and Pixie, and is set one year after "II." In that sense, playing the first game beforehand might enhance the experience.  

This time, Latok sets out to conquer the mysterious and monster-infested Tower of Gazzel. As a side story, the game introduces a slightly unique system within the series. Notably, there is no level-up system, meaning players don’t need to spend time grinding for experience points and can focus purely on progressing through the game. Instead, character power-ups are obtained through items.  

Another standout feature is the support member system, where players can choose an adventure companion. There are five support members, each with unique abilities—Pixie excels in healing and trap disarmament, while Frey specializes in magic. Strategically switching members based on the situation is key to success. If you find yourself stuck, trying a different companion might be the key to progressing.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000101670.name: Learn to Play - Drift Moto
70010000101670.description:
Start your engines, it's time to go racing. In Drift Moto you race across 15 futuristic racetracks.

Make sure at least one wheel stays on the road at all times and finish each course without any mistakes.

Can you complete all 15 tracks?

70010000101679.name: Picture Treasure Hunt
70010000101679.intro:
Hunt for hidden treasures in each picture!
A fun and brain-boosting item search game for all ages
70010000101679.description:
Sharpen your mind as you search for hidden gems and treasure chests tucked away in everyday scenes.
This picture puzzle game is both relaxing and brain-stimulating — perfect for all ages!

Easy to play：
・Read the clue carefully to see what you're looking for
・Scan the photo to spot the hidden item
・Tap the item before time runs out!

Some objects might seem easy to find at first glance…
but with the clock ticking, it’s more of a challenge than you’d think!

No worries if time runs out — you can try as many times as you like.

Need a hand?
Tap the hint button to get a subtle clue about where to look!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000101684.name: 鞭空翔～Whip/Sky/Fly～
70010000101684.intro: Use your whip to fly through the sky and defeat your enemies
70010000101684.description:
An action game where you attack enemies with whips and magic!

In addition to attacks, players can also place magic balls (wind pins) in the air.

Twist a whip around the wind pin and use the recoil like a pendulum to jump high!

Fire more wind pins while jumping and use the whip to rise higher and higher.

There are enemies that you can't defeat unless you practice well, so try your best and practice.

70010000101693.name: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! ~Black-Winged Survivor~
70010000101693.description:
■The first-ever game adaptation of a hugely popular IP
"A Wild Last Boss Appeared!" is a massively popular dark fantasy isekai series with over 1.4 million copies sold, based on the original work by Ento, with original illustrations and character designs by YahaKo (published by Earth Star Novel, an imprint of Earth Star Entertainment), and a manga adaptation by Hazuki Tsubasa.
An anime adaptation is also set to begin airing in October 2025!
This is the first-ever game adaptation of "A Wild Last Boss Appeared!"

■An aggressive arena shooter game system.
The most distinctive feature is the "aggressive" playstyle.
The greatest opportunities arise when a large number of enemies appear.
You can lock on to and snipe the summoner to defeat entire groups of enemies at once.
Experience the thrill of crushing dozens of monsters all at once.


■Active skills to wipe out swarming enemies.
The characters of "A Wild Last Boss Appeared!" all possess powerful skills.
In this game, these can be activated as active skills.
"Winter of Swords" - Forge and project numerous swords at your enemies.

"Brachium" - Inflict massive damage on enemies with a huge explosion.

"Rainbow Sheep" - Transform into a giant monster and crush your foes.

Wipe out the swarming enemies with the unique ultimate skills of the five characters.

■Story
This game features a completely original story made exclusively for the game.

There will also be sub-scenarios for each character and special graphics.

Enjoy the exploits of the characters, unique to this game and presented in full voice.
<Synopsis>
The game is set in the idyllic town of Mimir.
In the center of the town stood a giant tower called Mystletine Tower.
On their way to Blutgang, Lufas and her party stop in this town and meet a person named Maia.
Guided by Maia into the tower, they find themselves in a mysterious space where their levels are forcibly decreased.
Curious about Maia's true identity, Lufas decides to challenge the tower.

70010000101703.name: Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River
70010000101703.intro: Uncover the dark truth behind a luxury space station orbiting Mars.
70010000101703.description:
Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River is a classic-style graphic adventure about a person adrift in space who is rescued by a luxurious space station orbiting Mars. Playing as River, you'll immerse yourself in a world of comfort and pleasure—until you realize the station hides a dark secret.

In Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River, you'll navigate the station's lavish leisure facilities, using your wits to solve puzzles and move forward. As the story unfolds, you’ll begin to uncover the sinister side of the station and must choose whether to ignore it or take action.

The choices you make in Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River will challenge your ethics and test your morality. Will you do whatever it takes to protect yourself and survive, or risk everything to expose the truth and stop what's happening on board?

The game's pixel art style creates a stunning, immersive world that captures the spirit of classic adventure games. From the luxurious amenities to the station’s shadowy corners, every location in Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River is full of character and ready to be explored. Its gripping story will keep you on the edge of your seat. With multiple endings to discover, this is a game you'll want to replay.

Are you ready to embark on a journey of self-discovery and uncover the dark secrets of the space station orbiting Mars?

70010000101706.name: So Much Stuff 5 Mix-Knacks Collector's Edition
70010000101706.intro: Rediscover the thrill of finding "So Much Stuff" in this fifth installment!
70010000101706.description:
Explore beautifully crafted levels, clear diverse scenes, and relish in a multitude of engaging mini-games. 
Collect charming trinkets to adorn a fresh room in "So Much Stuff 5: Mix-Knacks."
Get ready for another delightful sorting adventure!

Collector's Edition brings:
- interesting sorting puzzles!
- 8 more chapters of fun!
- visit your collection room!

70010000101710.name: Little Cozy Home
70010000101710.intro: Create, decorate, and make your dream home come true!
70010000101710.description:
Design Your Dream Home!

Step into your cozy virtual house and unleash your creativity!

Decorate seven beautifully crafted rooms — living room, kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, office, hallway, and veranda — each ready to reflect your unique style.

Pick your favorite wall colors, wallpapers, floors, rugs, and furniture to make each room truly your own. Experiment, mix styles, and see your dream home come to life!

Keep your favorite designs and return to them anytime.
Take a picture of your creation without menus or buttons in the way!

Outside your window, the world changes with four beautiful seasons – from sunny spring and summer, through colorful autumn, to snowy winter.

Easy to play, relaxing, and full of creativity – perfect for young decorators with big imaginations!

Decorate, play, and make your home the coziest place ever!

70010000101716.name: Amazing Weekend 2 Search and Relaxed Collector's Edition
70010000101716.intro: Return to fun and tranquility with Amazing Weekend Search and Relax 2!
70010000101716.description:
Take a break from the daily hustle and bustle and enjoy all-new adventures with improved graphics and more detailed locations! 
Spend unforgettable moments in nature while hiking, horse riding, and boating. 
Use your skills and knowledge to find all the hidden objects and complete mini-games. 
Everyone deserves a break, and you’ll find the perfect one here in Amazing Weekend Search and Relax 2!

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- Twelve additional levels just for you!
- Eight additional mini-games to test your skills!
- Visit the souvenir shop to show off your collection!

70010000101725.name: Fetch Re;Quest
70010000101725.intro: Flora gives herself a one-week deadline to raise her stats high enough to ask her crush out on a date.
70010000101725.description:
After successfully leading her friends through a one-shot TTRPG campaign, part-time barista and full-time gamer Flora now faces a new challenge… How can she possibly muster up the courage to tell her DM that she likes him?!

In this sequel to the comedy/otome visual novel Fetch Quest, Flora gives herself a one-week deadline to raise her stats high enough to ask her crush out on a date. Is it silly and arbitrary? Yes! Will it work? Who knows!

Features:
- ~50k word story, and ~8k words of extras.
- Light stat-raising.
- A romance story with a trans man love interest.
- 4 different "Date" endings depending on Flora's stats.
- An otome game within an otome game.

Each day, choose one of four games for Flora to play with her friends and level up her stats. But be careful–Flora has been known to get a little too into her hobbies. If she doesn't strike the right balance, she might completely forget what her original goal was in the first place.

Acumen: If Flora chooses to play the 4X board game Techno-opolis, she'll increase her Acumen stat. This is a measure of her strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.

Charm: If Flora chooses to play the social deduction game Of Fiends and Fangs, She'll increase her Charm. This indicates her ability to control and manipulate others with the power of her words. 

Gud: In the action role-playing video game Clockwork Mercenaries, Flora will increase her Gud stat. This is not only a measure of her skill, but her grit and perseverance as well.

Moxie: If Flora plays the indie ghost hunting videogame Ghost Factory 2, her Moxie will increase. This determines how brave she is.

70010000101727.name: Cozy Monsters: The Mischievous Trabus
70010000101727.intro:
An adorable adventure full of mischief, laughter, and bubbles!
Join the Trabus family and meet magical creatures, enjoying their humor and friendship.
70010000101727.description:
A magical and mischievous story where four furry friends accidentally save the world!

The Trabus just wanted to play their annual prank, but... something's happening in Lunaria.
The magical animals are disappearing!
Now the Trabus must rescue them, make new friends, and, of course, get into mischief.

An interactive graphic audio novel ideal for children, full of humor, color, and music.

Highlights:

·Fully narrated interactive visual novel.

·Full-color illustrations in a charming 3D animated style.

·Four adorable protagonists: Pinkbu, Greenbu, Yellowbu, and Bluebu, mischievous little furry friends with unique personalities.

·Unforgettable magical characters like Mopi, Triki, Ronronius, Spindleboo, and many more.

·A fun, tender, and mischievous story, structured by chapters.

·Cheerful and charming music accompanies each scene, just like in an animated film.

·Music gallery with an original song for each Trabu and, of course, for Mopi.

·Perfect for encouraging reading, imagination, and empathy through laughter.

·Designed for girls and boys who enjoy magical worlds and endearing characters.

70010000101729.name: Animal Party Puzzles: Meet All the Friends
70010000101729.intro: A relaxing and engaging puzzle game designed for boys and girls. It includes three modes: Classic, Logic, and Mosaic. Perfect for fun and calm mental stimulation.
70010000101729.description:
Relax, think, and enjoy solving adorable puzzles.

This puzzle game is designed to offer a cozy and relaxing experience, perfect for disconnecting from everyday life or for training your little ones' minds. With three unique modes to choose from, each game is a new way to relax while stimulating your brain:

· Classic: Traditional puzzles with pieces that fit together precisely.

· Logic: Mental challenges that encourage calm and strategic thinking.

· Mosaic: Complete the images by placing each piece in its place.

With soft music, charming images, and slow gameplay, it's the ideal game to enjoy alone or with the family, at your own pace.

70010000101738.name: Heart of Ice by Dave Morris
70010000101738.intro:
A unique adventure, where every choice shapes your fate.
A classic gamebook brought to life, with countless paths to discover.
70010000101738.description:
A CLASSIC SCI-FI STORY

The end of the 23rd century. Earth lies in the grip of a new Ice Age. Famine, cold and fanatic cults threaten what is left of civilization. Humanity is on the brink of extinction.

Nine of the strongest heroes of the age come seeking the ultimate prize: the Heart of Volent, an object with the power to reshape reality. All are ruthless, powerful, determined. To succeed they must work together. But only one can have the Heart.

Choose your alliances with care. Weigh up who to trust. Be ready for betrayal. When the moment comes, the future of mankind will rest on your judgement.

A REIMAGINED ADVENTURE

Step into a world where you control the unfolding narrative. In this interactive adventure, every choice you make shifts the story’s direction.

Unlock hidden "Story Moments"—exclusive scenes and key revelations that can only be uncovered by making the right choices.

70010000101746.name: Marisa of Liartop Mountain Digital Artwork & Sound Player
70010000101746.description: This is an application that lets you view the artwork and listen to the music of Marisa of Liartop Mountain.

70010000101753.name: Suika Game Planet
70010000101753.intro:
A new Suika Game is here from a new setting in space!
Turn, target, and aim for the watermelon!
70010000101753.description:
Drop the fruits freely from any direction as "Poppy" flies 360° around the planet. Make fruits of the same type collide to make them "evolve" and aim to create watermelons for a high score!
 Make a lot of fruits "evolve" to enter the new "Super Evolution Time" mode! Special background music, dramatic effects, and a bonus score bring the excitement to a peak!
The "Suika Game Planet" has evolved in many ways, including with a customization function that allows you to freely decorate the game screen (skin), and a collection function that allows you to collect stickers for completing missions and use them to create your original name tag. Try playing it now!

70010000101765.name: TRALALERO TRALALA ELEPHANT RUNNER
70010000101765.intro: Run wild, break free - help the elephant escape the circus in a nonstop city dash!
70010000101765.description:
The circus can’t hold him anymore! In this action-packed 3D endless runner, you take control of a runaway elephant on a chaotic dash for freedom. Smash through obstacles, dodge traps, and use your trunk to clear the path as the city turns into your playground. Every step brings new challenges, and every move could mean escape or capture.

Collect peanuts along the way to unlock upgrades, power-ups, and hilarious new skins for your elephant. From speed boosts to protective shields and giant-sized rampages, every run offers wild new ways to crush, crash, and outsmart the keepers chasing you. The game unfolds in a single endless level that constantly evolves — with speed increasing, obstacles changing, and chaos reaching new heights the longer you survive.

Key Features:

- Dynamic 3D endless runner gameplay full of humor and chaos
- Continuous evolving world that grows harder the further you run
- Wide range of power-ups: speed bursts, shields, giant elephant mode, peanut magnets and more
- Upgrade system with peanuts: enhance abilities and unlock fun skins
- Interactive world: destroy cars, kiosks, trees, fences, and open secret paths
- Unique abilities for strategic play — smash, jump, slide, and rampage

Freedom won’t come easy — only the smartest, fastest, and most destructive elephants will break free. Run wild, cause mayhem, and prove that nothing can stop you in TRALALERO TRALALA ELEPHANT RUNNER!

70010000101771.name: DRONE DELIVERY - FPV SIMULATOR
70010000101771.description:
Take to the skies and experience the future of food delivery!

In Drone Delivery – FPV Simulator, you pilot a high-tech delivery drone through a living, breathing city. Pick up meals, packages, documents, electronics, and even urgent medical supplies from bustling restaurants, markets, stores, offices, and warehouses — then deliver them swiftly and safely to their destinations. Every mission tests your precision, reflexes, and strategy as you dodge traffic, navigate narrow alleys, and race against time to keep your clients happy.

Master realistic drone controls, manage your battery life, and adapt to changing weather conditions — from sunny days to stormy skies. Earn rewards for speed and accuracy, then invest them in powerful upgrades: faster engines, stronger frames, longer-lasting batteries, and advanced delivery systems. With each new district unlocked, the challenges grow harder, the routes more complex, and the city more alive.

Key Features:
- Realistic FPV drone controls and immersive flight physics
- Expansive city with unique districts and missions
- Dynamic environments with traffic, pedestrians, and weather effects
- Upgradeable drones: engines, batteries, hulls, and delivery modules
- Hidden shortcuts, side challenges, and bonus items to discover
- Story mode: save your family’s small delivery business from a mega-corporation
 
Sharpen your piloting, perfect your timing, and prove you’re the fastest, smartest pilot in Drone Delivery – FPV Simulator. The sky is yours — make every second count.

70010000101778.name: MELON PARKER -We are Whatever Club!-
70010000101778.intro: The super-popular singing group “Melon Parker” is now in a visual novel game!
70010000101778.description:
We are the Whatever Club!
The super-popular singing group “Melon Parker” is now in a visual novel game!
This is the youthful story you’ll experience together with MELON PARKER -We are Whatever Club!-

◆Synopsis
We are the Whatever Club!

You and your five childhood friends,
Naroya, Samurai Sho, Soraneko, KAITO, and Kamome,
are members of the private Melonpan High School’s “Whatever Club”!

While cheerfully solving the incidents that happen at school and enjoying your high school life,
you suddenly get the chance to perform at a music festival!?

Can the “Whatever Club” succeed at
the big stage of the music festival?

And where will your youthful story with the five of them lead...

◆Characters
・Naroya (cv. Naroya)
A reliable member who supports you in the Whatever Club.
Uses sharp reasoning skills to solve the mysteries that happen at school.

・Samurai Sho (cv. Samurai Sho)
The Whatever Club’s quick-witted man.
Sometimes ends up in unfortunate situations because of the other members’ wild ideas.

・Soraneko (cv. Soraneko)
Easygoing by nature, and sometimes ends up pulling the others along.
Loves snacks and games, and often invites you to join in.

・KAITO (cv. KAITO)
The self-proclaimed dark hero of the Whatever Club with a eighth-grader syndrome.
Has a kind heart and will always stand by friends and those in trouble.

・Kamome (cv. Kamome)
A gourmet who, like KAITO, also has eighth-grader syndrome tendencies.
Has a mature way of thinking and so the other members often rely on him.

70010000101789.name: Gnomdom
70010000101789.intro: Cozy puzzle game where you help tiny gnomes find their way home.
70010000101789.description:
In a little gnomey village, in a whimsical forest… A Gnome Grandpa awaits his family to gather ‘round for his 100th birthday.

Explore the forest’s lush greenery and find his tiny gnome kin trapped in curious places. 

Solve puzzles, collect family pictures, enjoy the hand-drawn artwork, and help each gnome find their way back home.

Features:
- Charming, hand-drawn visuals
- Natural, fairytale environments with atmospheric soundscapes
- Humorous, wholesome challenges
- Simple controls – perfect for all ages
- A very happy ending!

70010000101794.name: BRAINROT: FIGHTING
70010000101794.intro: This ain’t eSports. This is memeSports
70010000101794.description:
Welcome to Brainrot Fighting — the fighting game where logic takes a vacation and Italian memes step into the arena!
This isn’t just combat — it’s a visual overload, iconic catchphrases, unexpected finishers, and screams of "MAMMA MIA!" at max volume.
Every character is a living masterpiece of internet absurdity and cultural parody, filtered through pure brainrot energy.

70010000101802.name: Hentai Photo: Sakura
70010000101802.intro: We will collect all the details and reveal the most interesting secrets!
70010000101802.description:
Welcome to Hentai Photo: Sakura, a classic puzzle game where you unlock vivid and sensual illustrations step by step! The game focuses on attractive girls in glamorous and daring outfits. They are all ready to charm you with their looks.

All images are created with love for the smallest details, and their expressive poses, stylish outfits and bright emotions give each illustration a special atmosphere. The realistic assembly mechanics will make you feel like you are assembling a real paper puzzle. Relaxing music will help you to fully immerse yourself in the game.

Game Features:
- 40+ passionate puzzles featuring seductive anime girls
- High-quality and sensual illustrations
- Realistic assembly process with smooth animations
- Atmospheric music accompaniment
- Ability to view collected images in detail

70010000101804.name: Scribed castle
70010000101804.intro: Scribed castle is a city builder where you scribe whimsical towns, cozy villages, and gothic cathedrals in the medieval illustration art style.
70010000101804.description:
Scribed castle is a relaxing building game with a unique art style. Dive into relaxing scribing during the day and protecting your town at night. 
Explore orders. The Scribed castle has a special mechanic to help you scribe. It is pre-assembled structures that can give you interesting rewards.
Take care of your peasants, who are in need of protection from numerous dangers of the scribed world. 
Earn gold to scribe more buildings and get new items to scribe.

70010000101818.name: Missing Owner!
70010000101818.intro:
Find the target character hidden in the illustration!
A picture puzzle game to boost your brain
70010000101818.description:
Train your brain as you search for specific characters hidden in charming city-themed illustrations!

This casual picture puzzle game is perfect for players of all ages who enjoy a light mental challenge.

How to play is simple：
・Take a good look at the target character
・Find them in the illustrated scene
・Tap the spot before time runs out!

It might seem easy if you take your time…
but with a ticking clock, things get trickier than they look!

Don’t worry if you run out of time — you can try again as many times as you like.

Stuck?
Tap the hint button for a clue about where the character might be hiding!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000101827.name: Camp Life: Wilderness Survival 2025
70010000101827.intro: Survive the wild, enjoy the quiet, fear the squirrels.
70010000101827.description:
Camp Life: Wilderness Survival 2025 drops you off in the great outdoors and lets you figure it out from there. No hand-holding, no shortcuts—just nature, your gear, and whatever you make of it.

Set up camp, cook over open flames, explore dense forests, and brave unexpected weather. Whether you're hunting for food, gathering supplies, or just trying to keep your fire from going out, survival is in your hands.

Customize your camper, craft tools, and adapt to changing conditions. Some days are peaceful, others are unpredictable—but every moment feels earned.

Forget the Wi-Fi. Learn to pitch a tent.
And if the raccoons steal your food… well, that’s on you.

70010000101832.name: Bunny Girls
70010000101832.intro:
Many cute girls with bunny ears appear!
An easy puzzle game that anyone can play!
70010000101832.description:
Collect pieces of the adorable bunny girls and complete the puzzle!
Clear stages to see high-quality images of cute bunny girls!

70010000101837.name: The Organized Capy God
70010000101837.intro: Help Capy God reunite with his family. Sort, organize and group items in this relaxing and chill game!
70010000101837.description:
The Organized Capy God is a relaxing game in which you help a friendly capybara organize all his items while trying to reunite with his family!

Once everything is in order, Capy God will ask you for certain items to fill the world he was creating.

But don't worry! There are no timers, meters or scores. You can take as much time as you like to group items in the way you prefer.

There’s something strangely peaceful about sorting items, give it a try!

FEATURES
-Sort, stack, group and organize!
-Relaxing gameplay.
-Combine certain items to unlock achievements.
-Customize your capy with cute accessories!
-Heartfelt story
-No way to lose, no time pressure.
-Ideal for playing after a long day of work or school to slow your brain down.
-Intuitive drag and drop controls.
-No long dialogues or intense situations that require a lots of skills.
-Satisfaction from a well organized space :)
-More than 200 items to discover!
-Can be played in bite-size sessions.
-Great for all ages.
-Perfect to play while listening to audiobooks or watching videos
-Chill original music.

70010000101841.name: R-TYPE DX: Music Encore
70010000101841.intro: Bydo Missions in Your Pocket — Beyond Dimensions, the Melody of Two “R”s.
70010000101841.description:
In the year 220X, humanity encountered a lifeform from another dimension — the Bydo.

Survival or extinction.

The R-9 fighter, equipped with the ultimate weapon known as the Force, is deployed.
Though seemingly defeated after a fierce battle, the Bydo return from beyond the dimensional rift.
The war continues from the First Bydo Mission (R-TYPE) to the Second Bydo Mission (R-TYPE II).

R-TYPE DX: Music Encore features the ultimate mode, Ultimate Challenge, allowing players to battle through both titles seamlessly.
For the first time, this mode includes a full soundtrack.
Arcade-accurate stage themes have been newly implemented — including dedicated tracks for areas that originally shared music — enabling every stage to be played with the same musical structure as the arcade versions.
Experience newly reconstructed sound created using authentic handheld hardware audio.

The original R-TYPE and R-TYPE II are also included.
In Classic mode, players can choose between monochrome and color versions, preserving the feel of the original release.

Modern support features include:
• Rewind
• Quick Save & Load
• Full Power-Up Start
• Rapid Fire

In addition, a rich collection of original packaging and manuals is included.
Relive the deadly war against the Bydo — now with newly realized sound.

70010000101847.name: Money Skills
70010000101847.description:
Learn the five core money powers: save, grow, earn, protect, and spend.
Get clear answers to everyday financial questions—insurance, housing, side hustles, investments.
Understand your fixed costs, build smart habits, and make confident choices.
Simple lessons, practical steps, lasting impact.
Your future starts with one good decision.

70010000101852.name: Find the Text!
70010000101852.intro:
Spot the odd one out among a sea of characters!
A brain-training puzzle game that sharpens both your eyes and your mind
70010000101852.description:
Train your eyes and mind by spotting the one character that doesn't belong!
This picture puzzle game offers a fun way to sharpen your focus and challenge your brain.

How to play is simple：
・Look closely at the image
・Find the one kanji character that's different from the rest
・Tap it before the timer runs out!

The time limit is tight,
but spotting the answer is surprisingly satisfying!
Perfect for a quick break or a light brain workout.

Stuck?
Tap the hint button to get a clue about where the odd character is hiding!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000101861.name: Money Wash Tycoon
70010000101861.description:
Money Wash Tycoon puts you in the business of cleaning money—literally. You’re the go-to expert when shady cash needs a fresh start. No guns, no car chases—just rubber gloves, industrial dryers, and a lot of questionable banknotes.

Pick up dirty deliveries in all forms—bags, boxes, even furniture. Sort through the mess, spot the fakes, scrub off the bloodstains (yes, really), and get the bills back to your clients looking spotless. Or, you know, keep a little extra for yourself. No one’s watching.

Upgrade your gear, unlock faster tools, and expand your underground operation. Between jobs, decorate your hideout, explore strange secrets, or throw some bills into the furnace just because you can.

It’s not glamorous, but it pays.
And at the end of the day, nothing smells quite as sweet as freshly laundered money.

70010000101866.name: Monster Salon Manager
70010000101866.description:
Monster Salon Manager — where fangs, fur, and facials go hand in hand.

You’ve just opened your very own care center for monsters, and they’re lining up with sore wings, muddy scales, and a whole lot of stress. It’s your job to pamper, heal, and spoil every creature that crawls, slithers, or stomps through your doors.

Start with a modest setup and grow into a legendary monster wellness empire. Treat quirky clients, hatch rare eggs, and train your own lovable beasties into majestic companions. Whether you're giving a hydra a hot stone massage or playing fetch with a fire-breathing pup, every monster needs a little tender loving care.

Upgrade your salon, hire a loyal crew, decorate your own cozy upstairs pad, and create a relaxing haven—because even chaos gremlins deserve a day off.

It’s cute, it’s chaotic, and yes—someone’s probably shedding on the carpet again.

70010000101871.name: Monster Legacy: Cozy Puzzle Crossing
70010000101871.intro: Relax and train your mind in this adorable puzzle game set in the world of Monster Legacy: New Horizons. Three game modes with 100 puzzles to solve.
70010000101871.description:
Immerse yourself in a relaxing puzzle game set in the colorful world of Monster Legacy: New Horizons.
 Enjoy three unique modes for the whole family:

·Classic Mode: Drag and drop pieces to complete images.

·Mosaic Mode: Rebuild illustrations by placing each piece in its place.

·Brain Mode: Solve logic puzzles designed to train your mind.

Meet 100 different monsters, each with their own unique style and personality. With an adorable visual style, touch controls, and challenges for all levels, this game is ideal for developing attention, logic, and creativity while having fun.

70010000101891.name: Cat Clinic Simulator: Vet Hospital
70010000101891.intro: Love and care for every pet.
70010000101891.description: Take on the role of the owner and manager of a veterinary clinic for cats. Accept furry patients, take care of their health and develop your animal care center. Treat, help and do everything so that every tail goes home healthy and happy. Expand the clinic to serve more visitors, hire qualified assistants and improve equipment. Increase the number of tables for receiving patients and optimize work to cope with the flow of cats requiring attention. The higher your efficiency, the more satisfied owners and grateful purrs will return to your clinic. Build a successful veterinary center that all cat lovers will know about.

70010000101897.name: Declutter Guide
70010000101897.description:
Declutter your life with small daily steps.
Organize your items, memories, and space with ease.
Photo-based sorting helps you decide what to keep or let go.
Includes mindful tips to reduce stress and live simpler.
Turn overwhelming mess into calm and clarity, starting today.

70010000101900.name: Budget Recipes Daily
70010000101900.description:
Eat well without breaking the bank.
Discover quick and tasty budget-friendly recipes for every day.
Perfect for meal planning, batch cooking, and grocery savings.
Includes calorie info, simple steps, and low-cost ingredients.
Start saving money while enjoying every bite.

70010000101903.name: Resume Hero
70010000101903.description:
Build your resume step by step with smart templates and real examples.
From work history to personal achievements, everything is covered.
No writing skills? No problem — follow the prompts and you're done.
Polish your motivation statements and highlight your strengths.
Ideal for career changers, job seekers, and anyone updating their resume.

70010000101906.name: Daily Japanese Breakfast Ideas
70010000101906.description:
Not sure what to eat for breakfast? Discover a collection of quick and delicious Japanese breakfast ideas.
From rice balls to tamagoyaki and modern twists, enjoy healthy meals every morning.
Perfect for beginners, kids, or anyone curious about authentic and balanced breakfasts.
Get new recipes every day, keep track of ingredients, and build better morning habits.
Start every day with flavor and ease!

70010000101909.name: Cyber AI Defense
70010000101909.description:
An all-powerful AI has nearly wiped out humanity, taking control of everything... even people. But the last resistance still stands.
Take command of unhackable turrets, troops, and old-school tanks to defend your base against relentless waves of cyber-enemies.
You are Earth's last chance!

70010000101914.name: Synth Riders
70010000101914.intro: Ride the rhythm through a cyberpunk future with 28 amazing songs!
70010000101914.description:
BECOME A SYNTH RIDER IN A FUTURISTIC MUSICAL WORLD: 
Experience a high-octane cyberpunk musical adventure where you catch notes, weave through obstacles, and ride neon rails in perfect sync with the beat.  Grab your hoverboard and perform epic air stunts in retro futuristic cityscapes!

MULTIPLAYER MUSICAL MAYHEM:
Up to FOUR PLAYERS can throw down in VERSUS or jump into a COUCH CO-OP mode where all players must work together and share the beat!  Whether you’re score chasing or rhythm riding as a group, all skill levels are welcome in Synth Riders.

BROAD LIBRARY OF MUSIC OPTIONS:
Based on its synthwave roots, the soundtrack features 28 songs from amazing artists, including Sunset Neon, Dance with the Dead, Jamie Berry…and many more!

THE PARTY DOESN’T STOP: 
Crave more epic sessions? Explore DLC artist packs featuring Lady Gaga, Gorillaz, Monstercat artists and more – each bringing new beats and movements to take on!
THE FATE OF THE CITY IS IN YOUR HANDS IN CAMPAIGN MODE! 
Rebels are racing against time to stop ruthless AI from seizing control in this adrenaline-fueled musical battleground. Can you defeat XANDER?

70010000101919.name: Cladun X3
70010000101919.intro: Three times the customization, three times the fun!
70010000101919.description:
Villains from near and far have been summoned to Arcanus Cella to participate in a death game in the name of achieving world peace. You are one of those villains. Choose from six different weapon types and 10 different jobs to conquer dungeons teeming with ferocious monsters and deadly traps. Use the customization functions to create evil allies to aid in your journey with the Magic Circle System, a unique system to the Cladun series.

Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate evil? Test your might and mettle in this highly customizable action RPG!

70010000101938.name: Noir Mafia Simulator: 1960s American Crime
70010000101938.description:
Step into the shadows of America’s criminal underworld in the turbulent 1960s. As a rising mobster, you’ll orchestrate daring heists—banks, museums, police stations, and mafia houses—each one a test of cunning, skill, and nerve.
Plan your approach: slip in quietly with forged papers and lockpicks, or storm the place with guns blazing. Negotiate with hostages, outsmart the police, and vanish before the city clamps down. Every job is a high-stakes dance between precision and chaos.

Key Features:
-Multiple heist locations with unique challenges
-Stealth or aggressive approaches to every job
-Hostage and negotiation mechanics
-Police waves and tactical escapes
-Authentic 1960s noir atmosphere and soundtrack

Rise through the ranks, build your reputation, and navigate a world where every choice could mean survival—or your downfall. In Noir Mafia Simulator, the shadows hide both opportunity and danger. Are you ready to make your mark?

70010000101954.name: Zashiki-mawashi／座敷廻
70010000101954.intro: A heartwarming, cheerful, and delightfully spooky horror-comedy about a fan yokai (spirit) and a zashiki-warashi who bring unexpected  to a new household.
70010000101954.description: A heartwarming, cheerful, and comically spooky story about a family considering buying a standalone house to escape homelessness—only to discover it's haunted by a zashiki-warashi (a protective child spirit of Japanese folklore) and an old electric fan that seems to have a will of its own.

70010000101959.name: ROLLING STAR
70010000101959.intro: Get ready for round two of side-splitting banter, comical encounters, and thrilling, action-packed gameplay!
70010000101959.description:
In the year 2301...
The world has suddenly been attacked by space aliens.

They strike with simultaneous invasions across all lands, dragging down the space colonies that wrap around the planet, and plunging everything into war.

Meanwhile, in a corner of the universe far from this chaos, a girl lives in solitude within her space pod.
Her name is Laurie, a 21-year-old out-of-touch shut-in with an affinity for mecha arms. Sensitive to the judgment of others, she has lived her life alone in space.

However, these peaceful days come to an abrupt end when Laurie's space pod is destroyed in the aliens' attacks.
The destroyed pod somehow crash lands on Colony 102, where a secret weapon intended to repel the enemy aliens is stashed away. Now, the fate of all humanity rests in the hands of one eccentric girl.


Exploration-Based Action:
Run through the expansive colony while mastering new skills, obtaining gear, and exploring unknown areas. 

Before long, the story expands outside the colony into outer space! Experience a vast world like never before in this all-new Metroidvania experience.

Face Off Against Gigantic Bosses:
Face off with bosses so colossal they fill up the screen. Laurie must single-handedly face off with these giants, whose attacks pack a powerful punch. But if you play your cards right, you'll taste the sweet glory of victory!

Craft Your Very Own Gear:
Use the materials you gain from defeating foes to craft powerful gear, and combine them with your skills for strategic battles. Take on even stronger enemies with new gear, evolving Laurie along the way.

Into the Final Frontier:
Hop into a vehicle and venture beyond the colony into the zero-gravity expanse of space, where a whole new style of combat awaits—free from the pull of gravity. Out here, hidden treasures and surprising discoveries may be lurking. Vehicles aren't just for space travel, either—they can be used right inside the colony!

70010000101964.name: Twilight Parade: Moonlit Mononoke
70010000101964.intro: Crash the yokai party as vengeful oni twins and their colorfully mischievous friends!
70010000101964.description:
Crash the yokai party in Twilight Parade: Moonlit Mononoke! Play as the uninvited oni twins and their friends in this bullet-hell shooter with vibrant pixel art.

Choose from four unique characters, each with distinct abilities and assistants, then blast through 5 chaotic stages across Japan. Dodge enemy swarms, battle massive bosses, and get revenge in style!

• Fly, shoot and dodge strategically in bullet hell style!
• Choose from 4 unique characters.
• Blast through 5 stages inspired by Japanese culture.
• Upgrade your weapons amd defend against enemy swarms.
• Battle against screen-filling bosses.

70010000101969.name: Guchio Rising Mountain
70010000101969.intro: "Guchio-kun, Year 3, Class G" 3D Puzzle Game is Here!
70010000101969.description:
Guchio's face transforms into various motifs like animals! Connect and merge matching "Guchio pieces" (faces)  to create the biggest, most important entity. Be careful not to let them fall off the plate as you aim for a high score!

Easy to Play
Gameplay is simple: just choose a direction and press a button. When you press the button, A Guchio piece will be thrown onto the plate in that direction.
Connect matching Guchio pieces to merge them and transform them into larger ones! If a piece falls off the plate, it's game over, and your score is recorded. Create large pieces and achieve combos to earn a high score.

Unlock New Motifs as You Play
Achieve goals to unlock new Guchio pieces! Play repeatedly to get all the new ones.

Online Score Ranking
Compete with your recorded scores on the online leaderboards. Challenge players worldwide and aim for the top spot!

70010000101975.name: Touhou: Scarlet Curiosity
70010000101975.intro:
Touhou: Scarlet Curiosity is now on Nintendo Switch™!
Explore Gensokyo and uncover the incident’s mystery.
70010000101975.description:
Vampire young lady Remilia Scarlet and her servant Sakuya Izayoi set out on an adventure across Gensokyo to investigate rumours of a colossal monster…
Fast-paced action and a wide array of skills let you blast through enemies in this thrilling 3D bullet-hell action RPG.


●About This Game

The vampire young lady Remilia Scarlet and her servant Sakuya Izayoi reside in the Scarlet Devil Mansion.

Bored of her mundane life, Remilia becomes intrigued by rumours of a mysterious colossal monster, whose appearance is unknown, appearing among humans.

When they learn the creature has even been spotted near the Misty Lake, they immediately begin the search. But at that very moment, a major incident unfolds inside the Scarlet Devil Mansion…

This is a fan-made game based on Touhou Project, featuring simple, responsive controls in a 3D bullet-hell action RPG.


●Features of This Game

・A story woven by the two protagonists, Remilia and Sakuya
Choose either Remilia or Sakuya to start the game.
Remilia is a power-type character with strong single-hit attacks,while Sakuya is a technical-type character who can rack up many hits with frequent attacks.

・Controls are simple, with only 5 buttons: Attack, Jump, and three Skills
As you level up, you’ll learn a variety of skills—assign your favorites to the buttons!

・Rack up hits to gain an advantage in battle
Continuously hitting enemies increases your hit count, granting bonuses to attack power and experience points. However, the hit count resets if a certain amount of time passes or you take damage.

・Collect equipment to strengthen your character
Even equipment with the same name can have different stats.
Keep collecting and switching to more powerful gear!
Some equipment may even grant access to special skills…?


The game is accompanied by numerous Touhou arranged BGM tracks from the circle “Hachimitsu Lemon”
All 35 tracks of Touhou arrangements enhance the excitement of the game.

70010000101980.name: Farming Pro Simulator 25
70010000101980.intro: Build machines, grow crops, and grow your farming empire.
70010000101980.description:
Step into the role of a modern farmer and experience the rewarding life of agriculture. Drive powerful tractors and combine harvesters, plow the fields, sow and protect your crops, then gather a rich harvest. Sell your produce, earn money, and expand your farm with new machines and opportunities.

Features:
- Operate realistic farming machines – Control tractors, trailers, and harvesters with authentic physics.
- Prepare your fields – Use plows and tools to cultivate the land before sowing.
- Plant and grow diverse crops – Each seed type requires care and brings different rewards.
- Protect your harvest – Defend fields from pests and diseases with the right equipment.
- Reap your rewards – Gather crops efficiently using specialized machinery.
- Expand and upgrade – Invest profits into new fields, better machines, and bigger opportunities.

Turn hard work into success—transform your small plot into a flourishing farm and build your agricultural empire!

70010000101985.name: Neffy –Moonlight Labyrinth X–
70010000101985.intro: Join Neffy—a girl who can transform into a cat—and embark on a magical journey through a mysterious labyrinth to rescue the sealed Moon Goddess!
70010000101985.description:
“Neffy –Moonlight Labyrinth X–” is an action‑puzzle game where you team up with the cat‑eared Neffy to explore enchanting maze environments. Originally developed for VR, this version has been optimized for the Nintendo Switch so that even more players can enjoy the experience.

◆ Conquer the Labyrinth with Dual Perspectives
Switch between the apprentice shrine maiden “Neffy” and the legendary hero “Novalis” she summons. In Novalis’s view, manipulate massive mechanisms and harness the power of the moon to open paths. In Neffy’s view, explore narrow passages and transform into a cat to reach higher places. Use both perspectives to uncover the secrets of the labyrinth.

◆ Touch‑based Bonding with Neffy
A signature feature of the game is the “bonding action.” By touching Neffy, you can heal her or trigger her cat transformation to boost her jump. Neffy will respond with adorable, full voice acting, making every moment feel like you're adventuring together.

◆ A Heartwarming Tale in a Mystic World
Set in a labyrinth sealed by the power of the Blue Moon Goddess, your adventure begins as you and Neffy unite to save a shattered world caused by the rebellion of the Red Moon Goddess. Experience the gentle yet poignant story as your bond grows stronger.

A cute, slightly mysterious maze adventure that will warm your heart.
Neffy is curled up somewhere, waiting for you like a cat…and she can’t wait to meet you.

70010000101993.name: Trucking School: Truck Simulator Driving 2025
70010000101993.intro: Improve your skills and become the ultimate truck driver.
70010000101993.description:
Step into the driver’s seat and master the art of heavy vehicle control in Trucking School: Truck Simulator Driving 2025! Learn how to maneuver massive trucks with precision, tackle challenging courses, and handle real-world driving scenarios in a safe, immersive simulation environment. Whether you’re training for logistics, construction, or just love big rigs, this simulator puts you in full control.

- Realistic Truck Handling: Experience authentic physics and controls that make every turn, brake, and gear shift feel lifelike.
- Comprehensive Driving Lessons: Learn basic maneuvers, advanced driving techniques, and professional truck handling skills.
- Challenging Courses: Navigate through urban streets, tight parking lots, highways, and obstacle-filled training grounds.
- Customizable Trucks: Choose from a variety of vehicles and customize them for performance and style.
- Progressive Training System: Complete lessons, earn certifications, and unlock new challenges as you improve your skills.

Become a master truck driver, conquer every course, and prove you have what it takes to handle the biggest rigs on the road!

70010000102000.name: CONTRABAND BORDER POLICE SIMULATOR
70010000102000.description:
Step into the shoes of a rookie border officer in a tense world where every decision counts. Inspect documents, cross-check IDs, and search vehicles with UV scanners to uncover cleverly hidden contraband. Examine suspicious belongings, decide who to arrest, and ensure no smuggler slips past your watch.
But the job isn’t just about catching criminals—it’s about integrity. Every mistake costs you money, and every compromise puts your career on the line. Will you uphold the honor of the uniform, or give in to temptation and look the other way?

Key Features:
	•	Realistic Inspections – Check passports, IDs, and travel documents with care.
	•	UV Vehicle Scanning – Uncover hidden stashes of contraband in cars and trucks.
	•	Personal Belongings Search – Investigate luggage, bags, and items on the inspection table.
	•	Arrest & Detain – Apprehend suspects and send criminals to prison.
	•	Financial System – Accuracy pays off; mistakes lower your earnings.
	•	Moral Dilemmas – Face constant tension between duty, pressure, and personal gain.

It’s time to take your place at the border. Can you withstand the pressure—or will corruption creep in?

70010000102010.name: Lost in Loss
70010000102010.intro: Rebuild what was forgotten. Reveal what was hidden. Can you solve it, Detective?
70010000102010.description:
Hey, Detective! Ready for a strange case?

Citizens are forgetting who they are —  their true selves are slipping away. Will you help bring them back?

Explore beautiful hand-drawn locations, search for unusual hidden objects, and uncover the secrets behind each person’s story.
What will you discover inside an old suitcase? Or behind a forgotten bookshelf?

Solve puzzles, meet charming characters, and dive into a world full of mystery and surprises.

Every person has a past. Every item has a clue. Are you paying attention?

Lost in Loss isn’t just a game — it’s a journey through memories, emotions, and wonderful places you'll love exploring.

So… are you ready to begin?

70010000102013.name: Seashell Isle
70010000102013.intro: The island is waiting. What will you discover?
70010000102013.description:
Welcome to Seashell Isle, a vibrant and mysterious adventure where every corner of the island holds secrets waiting to be uncovered. Set foot on a forgotten, sacred land rich with history, magic, and untold treasures. Once a thriving sanctuary of ancient guardians, the island now calls to brave explorers seeking wonder and glory.

Venture through lush jungles, windswept beaches, and mist-covered cliffs as you uncover hidden vaults, forgotten passageways, and long-lost relics. Each location on Seashell Isle tells a story.

Features:
Explore a handcrafted island full of secrets
Discover hidden vaults, passageways, and ruins
Piece together the island’s mysterious history

70010000102017.name: Dogs Organized Neatly
70010000102017.intro: WOOF ~ In this 2D puzzle game you have the responsibility to arrange lovely doggos in a way that fits the grid.
70010000102017.description:
“A true friend leaves paw prints on your heart.”
And we have 30 friends just waiting for you to pet them! Our good boys and girls come in all shapes and sizes.

However, they are way too energetic for us to handle alone so we need YOUR help to organize all these doggos!
Just pick them up and place them on the grid over there.
And don’t worry if you rotate them a bit, they may bark, but they never bite.

KEY FEATURES

• Dogs
30 brand-new & unique hand-drawn dogs for you to befriend, collect, and organize (neatly).

• Handcrafted Levels
80 brand-new handcrafted levels, which will tickle your brain.

• Relaxing Music
Dogs Organized Neatly has relaxing background music! Pretend you're dog-sitting your favourite puppers or spending a relaxed afternoon with your best furry friend.

70010000102022.name: Crowded Mysteries 2: Winter Romance
70010000102022.intro: Justice never sleeps, even in the coldest nights.
70010000102022.description:
Winter’s chill has settled over the city, turning love into obsession and passion into crime. As a dedicated detective, you’ll uncover secrets buried beneath the snow — investigating shocking murders, robberies, and betrayals that test both your logic and your heart.

KEY FEATURES
- Solve Chilling Crimes – Examine clues, interrogate suspects, and piece together evidence to crack complex cases.
- Work with Your Team – Team up with your chief and quirky colleagues to restore order to the city.
- Explore a Frozen Cityscape – Discover cozy cafés, dark alleys, and snow-covered streets full of hidden clues.
- Unmask the Villain – Follow a trail of lies and uncover the mastermind behind the chaos.
- Beautiful Minimalistic Art – Experience a sleek, winter-inspired visual style that brings Mystery City to life.

Crowded Mysteries 2: Winter Romance is a heartfelt detective story where every clue melts the ice — or freezes your fate.
Enter the cold. Unravel the truth. Feel the chill of winter romance.

70010000102027.name: Truck Simulator 25: Euro Driver
70010000102027.intro: Drive Europe’s vast highways, master every challenging road.
70010000102027.description:
Prepare yourself for an unforgettable journey behind the wheel with “Truck Simulator 25: Euro Driver”! Take on the role of a professional long-haul trucker and discover the breathtaking landscapes across Europe. This game offers a deeply immersive and realistic experience that puts the exciting world of freight transportation right at your fingertips.
Why choose Truck Simulator 25?
	•	Authentic Simulation: Drive through a variety of environments—from bustling city streets to tranquil countryside roads. Every detail is crafted with precision for true realism!
	•	Variety of Trucks: Select and customize from a wide range of trucks, from timeless classics to cutting-edge models, mastering the art of long-distance haulage.
	•	Scenic Routes: Journey along iconic European highways, explore new cities and cultures, and turn each delivery into a thrilling adventure.
	•	Challenging Missions: Take on diverse tasks, plan your routes strategically, and sharpen your driving skills with every haul.
Truck Simulator 25: Euro Driver isn’t just a game—it’s your gateway into the thrilling world of freight transport, where freedom meets the open road. Join the ranks and become a true trucking expert!

70010000102032.name: Blippo+
70010000102032.intro: Blippo+ is a live-action, new wave, off-cable TV simulator.
70010000102032.description:
Congratulations! Blippo+ is now available in your area.

Blippo+ is a live-action, new wave, off-cable TV simulator. Channel-surf the stars and discover the staticky, radical world of Planet Blip through its soaps, sitcoms, news, weather, and talk shows. But don’t touch that remote—because everything’s about to get bent.

Planet Blip is brought to life through a cast of lovable characters, vibrant costumes and makeup, original music, extensive lore, and writing that pays homage to the offbeat, idiosyncratic, and often-forgotten margins of TV history, from pirate television and cable access to public broadcasting and video art. Whether you’re a punk, new waver, sproinger or a bender: there’s something for you on Blippo+.

Features:
- Channel-surf your way through a wide variety of funny, freaky, and wholly original live-action programs on the Blippo+ Electronic Program Guide!
Fall in love with a diverse cast of alien TV personalities, from cloned soap opera stars and spooky raconteurs to mad professors, quizmasters, scientists, and action sheroes. 
- Immersive yourself in Blippo+ to unlock data packettes, update the Electronic Program Guide with new episodes and messages, and piece together the planet-shaking story unfolding between the channels.
- Expand your knowledge of Blippian culture by lurking the Femtofax “videotext” forums.
- Fiddle with extensive TV settings to personalize your Blippo+ experience.
- Enjoy a genre-spanning original soundtrack by Grammy-nominated composers Rob Kieswetter and Jona Bechtolt of YACHT.

70010000102037.name: VIDEOVERSE
70010000102037.intro: Take a trip back to the days of the early internet and fan forums…
70010000102037.description:
Relive the days of past social gaming networks in VIDEOVERSE, a decision-based narrative adventure focusing on character development, friendship and love.

As Emmett, a young video game fan and aspiring artist, dive into this fictional video game era, where the Kinmoku Shark gaming system and its online social network, Videoverse, were still popular. Strengthen Emmett’s friendships, share fan art and browse the lively gaming communities. Make decisions that will change how Emmett grows, his approach to Videoverse and, ultimately, the final outcome!

Will your actions help Videoverse thrive, or will you get caught up in teenage drama, video game fandoms and corporate conspiracies?


***Relive the Days of Retro Gaming

VIDEOVERSE is inspired by 00’s technology and the early internet. The chill soundscape of the Kinmoku Sharkwill uncover memories of your favourite retro gaming consoles.

***Browse Videoverse

Meet a huge cast of characters, unlock multiple side stories, enjoy the pixel doodles, and seek out the truth behind the troubled social gaming network! Personalise your Videoverse experience by choosing your avatar, personal quote and favourite theme.

***Join Feudal Fantasy Fans

Accompany Emmett as he plays the Kinmoku’s Shark’s most popular JRPG, Feudal Fantasy. Swap theories and discover tips from other fans in its exclusive Videoverse community…and find out whether or not Hanzo will be able to stop the evil Nobunaga!


VIDEOVERSE contains several accessibility options:

* Closed Captions
* Clear Font
* Colourblind Friendly Themes
* Sound, Music and Voice Volumes
* Trigger Warnings
* Tip Button

70010000102040.name: Tropicalia
70010000102040.intro: Are You Ready for This Tropical Adventure?
70010000102040.description:
You will play as Kaique, a brave Guarani warrior whose girlfriend, Kerana, is kidnapped by an evil god named Tau.

Collect materials to craft new items, grind through fast-paced battles, and test your strategy against challenging bosses.

Hunt, fish, swim, dive, jump, and explore the jungle!

In this fantasy game you wont find Dragons and Elves. But you will face Curupiras and Boitatas.


Features:
* It’s a classic turn-based RPG, but designed for a modern audience
* Interactive battle system (Quick-Time Events)
* Multiple map exploration abilities
* Playground Mode with no battles, just to enjoy the story

70010000102043.name: SF3RA
