70010000102043.intro: Eliminate the out of control robots.
70010000102043.description:
SF3RA is an Action platformer, mix of 3D and retro 2D graphics.

SFERA is an intergalactic association of assassins, operating under the cover of the robot union. You are an assassin hired by them. You are tasked to eliminate out of control robots in the A7FA-3T system.

Destroy enemies, collect items and buy new weapons. Your drone assistant can attack enemies if you upgrade it.

Explore unusual planets and the space base of A7FA-3T system with secret rooms. 

The transition between planets is made on an intergalactic ship. You need to fly through the stars smashing asteroids and collecting elements.


Features:
* Classic 2D pixel platformer with 3D gameplay
* Beautiful backgrounds with parallax effect
* Five different areas with hidden rooms
* Five different bosses
* The game provides a full map overview of each level
* Vibrant pixel graphics
* Original music

70010000102052.name: Pokémon™ Friends
70010000102052.intro: Cozy up with a variety of bite-sized puzzles—and collect virtual Pokémon plush!
70010000102052.description:
Unwind with puzzles in the Pokémon™ Friends game! Solve sets of three random puzzles to help untangle your mind—then place the yarn you obtain into the Plush-O-Matic: a special machine that creates in-game Pokémon plush! As you try to make them all, you can track your crafted plush in the catalog. You can also mark your calendar with a stamp each day you play, and then go back and practice the puzzles you played on those days.

Complete friend quests and get furniture to decorate your plush rooms

Folks around town will ask you to bring them specific plush. Finish these friend quests to give each plush a forever home and increase your friendship level with the townspeople. Grateful townspeople will give rewards, including furniture, which you can use to decorate your in-game plush rooms—along with all the plush you like too much to give away!

This Basic Pack includes 30 puzzles, 70 craftable plush, and all 11 yarn types

Expand your puzzle and plush variety with paid DLC

If you enjoy expanding your catalog of plush, you can buy DLC*. There are several DLC options available for purchase, including the Puzzle On! Pack #1 and Puzzle On! Pack #2.

70010000102062.name: Dragon Ruins
70010000102062.intro: Explore ancient ruins and defeat the dragon in a dungeon crawler RPG!
70010000102062.description:
Brave the depths of an ancient ruin discovered in the capital of Isigwere, where no soul has ever returned—and where a legendary dragon awaits. In this retro-style dungeon crawler RPG, become the hero who conquers the maze and slays the beast lurking in the shadows.

- Choose from 12 unique classes like Knight and Archer to build your perfect 4 member party.
- Dive into classic 3D dungeon exploration with auto-mapping and fast-paced auto battles.
- With every run, enemies grow fiercer—level up, upgrade your gear, and take on the ever-evolving final boss.
- A single-player dungeon RPG experience full of pixel art charm, relaxing exploration and combat, and endless replayability.
- Through many challenges, become the Legendary Heroes!

70010000102067.name: The Harmony Chronicles: Cat Out Of The Bag Collector's Edition
70010000102067.intro: Help Mona save the kingdom old kingdom!
70010000102067.description:
Mona, the chosen warrior of Goddess Harmony, has faced many trials journeying across magical realms, but nothing could prepare her for what comes next. 
As she attempts to teleport into Goddess Harmony’s castle, an unseen force blocks her path. 
The castle is sealed—protected by ancient barriers that only activate in times of dire peril. 
The Goddess is in grave danger, and the fabric of existence itself is unraveling.

With time running out, Mona embarks on a daring mission to uncover the truth behind the failing cosmic balance. 
Accompanied by her loyal mentor, Professor Kadabrius, 
and her ever-bickering companions—the Good Book and the Evil Book—she must unravel the mystery behind the castle’s seal, 
repair the broken mechanisms of existence, and uncover the dark force threatening Harmony’s very essence. 

Along the way, she encounters extraordinary beings: the all-seeing Star Owl, the elusive Mirror Bird, 
the enigmatic underwater master Nereide, the fiery blacksmith Ignis, and the mischievous yet powerful Cat-Witch, whose secrets may hold the key to saving everything.

70010000102074.name: Torched
70010000102074.intro: Guide your torch across towns, solve clever grid-based challenges, and rise through the ranks as a paladin aspirant
70010000102074.description:
In TORCHED, darkness has spread across the land, and only the light of your torch can bring hope back to the towns. As a young paladin aspirant, your mission is to illuminate the path, overcoming obstacles, creatures, and puzzles that stand in your way.

Master grid-based movement to navigate intricate challenges and progress through your sacred ranks. Each level tests your logic, timing, and creativity as you carry the flame of light against the growing shadows.

With 60 handcrafted levels spread across 4 distinct zones, TORCHED offers a steadily evolving challenge where new mechanics keep the experience fresh and engaging.

Features
• 60 puzzle levels across 4 thematic zones.
• Grid-based movement with 5 unique mechanics to master.
• Avoid creatures, bypass obstacles, and outwit darkness.
• Progress through the ranks of a paladin aspirant.
• Charming pixel art visuals with a warm yet challenging atmosphere.

70010000102079.name: Supermarket Simulator Store
70010000102079.intro:
Experience the life of a shop manager
Keep shelves full and customers happy
Build your dream supermarket!
70010000102079.description:
Supermarket Simulator Store

Step into the world of retail and experience what it’s like to manage your very own supermarket!
In Supermarket Simulator, you’ll take control of every part of the store — from stocking shelves to serving customers — all in a realistic and fun 3D environment.

Order products, restock inventory, and organize shelves to keep your store running smoothly. Greet your customers, handle checkout transactions, and make sure everyone leaves happy. As your business grows, you’ll earn money to expand your store, upgrade equipment, and unlock new products.

Whether you love management games or just want to relax and build your dream shop, Supermarket Simulator offers a satisfying experience for all ages.

Features:

• Realistic 3D supermarket environment
• Stock shelves, scan items, and serve customers
• Manage inventory and balance your profits
• Upgrade your store and unlock new products
• Enjoy casual, relaxing gameplay suitable for all players

Are you ready to open the doors and become the best shop manager in town?
Your supermarket adventure starts now!

70010000102090.name: Poolside Girls Kiss: Passion Fruits Hotel Dating Sim
70010000102090.intro:
Flirt at the pool and unlock exclusive images.
Jump in and play now!
70010000102090.description:
Explore the hottest summer as you try to flirt with irresistible girls at the pool… and protect their hearts from any emotional splash.

Combine daring questions with dynamic aquatic defense gameplay to unlock suggestive images and unexpected endings.

Discover how each girl reacts to your answers, your moves, and your tactics under the sun. Do you have the charm (and the reflexes) to rule the pool?


Features:

● Refreshing dual gameplay: Switch between flirty Q&A and defense mode, where you must block “attacks” (splashes, pesky floaties, intruders) to unlock new scenes.

● Suggestive images and unique moments: Earn their trust and uncover special situations as you advance through each route.

● Get to know their personality: Every answer reveals each girl’s tastes, limits, and secrets—from the shy mermaid to the selfie queen.

● Multiple endings: It all depends on how many questions you get right, how well you protect her heart, and how you read her signals.

● A secret, spicy question: Reach question 150 to reveal a special final moment by the pool.


Can you keep your cool, dodge the splashes, and win their hearts under the sun?

Dive into this adventure where strategy, humor, and romance go hand in hand!

70010000102095.name: Knights of the Round Peg
70010000102095.intro: Journey through round peg's magical world!
70010000102095.description:
Step into the enchanting world of Knights of the Round Peg, where players embark on a musical journey alongside a brave knight through 80 captivating levels.
Equipped with a lute and a quiver of musical notes, the knight bravely embarks on a journey, encountering peg-filled challenges along the way.
Players must strategically clear pegs at each level using a limited number of balls.
As you progress, you will have the opportunity to explore the beautifully hand-drawn map of the kingdom. 
Each level backdrop is filled with interactive elements to discover.

- go on a music filled journey
- 80 interactive hand-drawn levels
- addictive peg-breaking gameplay

70010000102099.name: The Blogger: Pumpkins and Witches
70010000102099.intro: One photo could change your fate forever.
70010000102099.description:
Kanary is not just a forgotten village—it’s a trap woven from curses, secrets, and fear. As Charlie, a desperate photographer chasing the ultimate horror story, you arrive with only your camera… and quickly realize something sinister is watching you.
Every creak in the darkness, every flicker of light could be your last. Solve twisted puzzles, uncover forbidden rituals, and confront a priest whose soul is bound to the shadows. Take the perfect shot for your blog—but beware, each photo might be the last thing you see.

Features:
	•	Survive the Fear – Face a living nightmare filled with jumpscares, psychological dread, and cinematic terror.
	•	Capture the Horror – Use your camera to document eerie evidence and uncover Kanary’s darkest truths.
	•	Outsmart the Priest – Evade, confront, and survive against a malevolent force haunting the village.
	•	Solve the Curse – Unravel ancient puzzles, hidden passages, and cryptic rituals tied to witch trials.
	•	Choice of Fate – Reveal Kanary’s story to the world… or disappear as one of its forgotten victims.

Kanary isn’t abandoned. It’s waiting. The question is—for you.

70010000102105.name: Robot Warfare War Game
70010000102105.intro:
Pilot upgrade and conquer in the ultimate sci fi mech warfare experience
Fight on Mars and the Moon.
70010000102105.description:
Robot Warfare: War Game puts you in command of powerful combat mechs in intense sci-fi battles across diverse arenas. Built on a mech combat system, the game expands with brand-new maps including a futuristic base, the surface of Mars, the Moon, and other science-fiction battlefields.

Players can choose from a roster of unique robot characters, each customizable and upgradeable with different weapons and abilities. As you progress through missions on each map, you’ll unlock new upgrades, challenges, and progression paths that reward both strategy and skill.

With fast-paced mech battles, deep customization, and a variety of environments, Robot Warfare: War Game delivers an action-packed experience for fans of robot combat and futuristic warfare.

70010000102110.name: Draw Shooter
70010000102110.description:
Draw Your Bullets and Knock Them Down!
Unleash your creativity in this action-packed shooter!
Draw any shape in the designated area your creation becomes your bullet.
Battle across a variety of unique islands, face off against bosses, and see how far you can go.
How many stages can you conquer?

70010000102112.name: Tiny Witch
70010000102112.description:
In Tiny Witch, you are a little witch left in charge of a magic wizard store located in a town full of dungeon masters. Activate your spells, unlock new recipes, and prepare the best minions in time to avoid upsetting your customers.

Features: 

- Mixing and Manufacturing Minions: Create resources by mixing them in the pounder or boiling them in the cauldron, then manufacture minions by mixing magical resources on your alchemy table!

- Customers and Consequences: Deliver the requested minions to the customers or suffer the consequences! Different kinds of customers have varying tempers and willingness to give you tips. Serving them is key to the longevity of your humble witchy establishment

- Expansion and Experience: Purchase new resources, pounder, and more to improve your store! There are different stages, such as a wrapping stage where you can buy decorations, pets, and add new work tables. Operate your minion-crafting store throughout the days and nights in a forest, a cave, and a desert – this big world is your tiny witch’s oyster.

70010000102127.name: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO
70010000102127.description:
DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Become a super warrior and experience the earth-shaking, limit-breaking power of Dragon Ball battles!

THE BIGGEST ROSTER IN HISTORY
Unleash the strength of over 180 fighters from Dragon Ball Z, Dragon Ball Super, Dragon Ball GT, and selected Dragon Ball movies, all in the base game! Each character comes with their own signature abilities, transformations, and techniques.

Make the destructive power of the strongest fighters ever to appear in Dragon Ball yours!

BREATHTAKING 3D FIGHTS
Engage in heart-pounding, high-speed 3D battles that stay true to the anime and video game series, with breathtaking visuals and authentic combat moves like beam clashes, rush attacks, movements too quick for the eyes to see, and planet-razing ultimate attacks.

RIVALS MAKE YOU STRONGER
Challenge players online to test your skills, enjoy local multiplayer with up to six players on a single console, or connect multiple consoles for wireless play. Experience intense battles and become a Super Warrior with immersive motion controls using the Joy-Con™ controllers.

BLAZE A NEW PATH
Conquer the action-packed battles from the beloved original story, or discover and unlock new encounters for your favorite Z-Fighters and more. Relive your favorite moments from the series through cutscenes you can experience from the perspectives of eight characters!

CREATE, PLAY, AND SHARE
Recreate your favorite battles from throughout the Dragon Ball story, or set up your dream story battle with your favorite characters! Share your creations with other fans and experience the battles brought to life by imaginations around the world.

*In addition to this edition, Deluxe Edition and Ultimate Edition are also available. Please be careful not to purchase the same content twice.

70010000102129.name: Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling
70010000102129.intro: Run the docks. Master the cargo. Rule the port.
70010000102129.description:
Welcome to Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling – a realistic port operations simulator where every detail plays a crucial role in maintaining an efficient cargo terminal. Operate heavy machinery, complete critical tasks, and ensure the smooth functioning of the port both day and night.

Key Features:
-Crane Operations – load and unload containers from ships using powerful port cranes. Precision and speed are essential.
-Forklifts – handle cargo and containers in the warehouse, using forklifts and reach stackers to transport goods efficiently.
-Tugboat Operations – assist ships in docking and maneuvering safely with powerful tugboats.
-Maintaining Order – keep the port organized and clean to prevent delays and avoid hazardous situations.
-Technical Inspections – regularly check equipment, identify malfunctions, and ensure all machinery is in optimal condition.
-Day and Night Cycle – work under dynamic conditions where lighting and visibility change, adding new challenges to port operations.
-Lamp Repair – ensure proper illumination by repairing broken lights for safe night-time operations.

Take control of key port logistics and prove you can handle the toughest challenges in Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling!

70010000102134.name: Arcade Archives VIDEO HUSTLER
70010000102134.intro: Experience the thrill of the pocket!
70010000102134.description:
"VIDEO HUSTLER" is a sports game released by KONAMI in 1981.
This game is a simplified version of pool (pocket billiards). You strike the white cue ball to roll it, hit six balls, and sink them into the pockets.
The game’s most distinctive feature is that the score can vary greatly depending on the numbers on the balls and the different multipliers assigned to each pocket.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000102141.name: Galaxy Roll
70010000102141.intro: Roll through the stars. React, survive, repeat.
70010000102141.description: Galaxy Roll drops you into a sleek, cosmic world where your reflexes are the only thing standing between survival and the void. Controlling a rolling cube on a floating isometric track, you’ll dodge deadly gaps and lethal spikes using nothing more than the triggers on your controller. With every run, the challenge ramps up—collect coins, activate unpredictable power-ups, and try to outdo your last distance. The controls are tight and simple, but the tension is real. One wrong move, and it's over. Surrounded by minimalist sci-fi visuals and ambient space vibes, you’ll find yourself in a focused rhythm, chasing that next high score or unlocking new cube skins with every coin you gather. Whether you're in it for a quick session or a long leaderboard climb, Galaxy Roll is all about flow, precision, and pushing a little farther through the stars.

70010000102143.name: K-Pop Puzzle Idols: Music Festival
70010000102143.intro: Enjoy this puzzle game featuring K-POP-inspired characters! Unlock idols and relax with a music gallery full of K-POP songs. Rhythm, style, and fun!
70010000102143.description:
Get ready to combine rhythm and style in this K-POP puzzle game! 

Unlock your favorite idols and enjoy a small musical gallery with authentic K-POP hits. Swipe, dance, and solve while the stage shines!

Key Features:

·Easy-to-learn puzzles with surprising twists!

·Characters inspired by K-POP stars, each with their own unique style.

·Musical gallery with K-POP songs to enjoy between levels.

·Bright graphics, adorable animations, and tons of idol energy.

·Perfect for fans of Korean pop and casual games with rhythm and personality.

Puzzle Types:

·Classic: Traditional puzzles with pieces that fit together precisely.

·Logic: Mental challenges that encourage calm and strategic thinking.

·Mosaic: Complete the images by placing each piece in its place.

70010000102153.name: OCEAN RAFT SIMULATOR & SURVIVAL
70010000102153.intro: Discover islands, craft tools, and battle the deep.
70010000102153.description:
Stranded in the middle of the endless ocean, you have nothing but a fragile raft and a rusty hook. The waves are unforgiving, the sharks never rest, and your only chance is to survive one day at a time.
Gather floating debris, expand your raft, and turn it into a shelter strong enough to withstand storms and predators. Explore hidden islands, uncover the secrets of the deep, and craft tools that will keep you alive against all odds.

Features:
	•	Build, repair, and upgrade your raft
	•	Craft weapons, tools, and survival gear
	•	Explore mysterious tropical islands and dive beneath the waves
	•	Face relentless sharks and other ocean threats

Will you transform a handful of planks into a fortress of survival, or will the ocean claim you?

70010000102158.name: Smashy Cannon
70010000102158.intro: Aim sharp. Fire fast. Smash everything.
70010000102158.description: Smashy Cannon is a fast-paced endless challenge where precision and timing are everything. Control the angle of your cannon and fire bullets to smash targets that rise from the ocean across scattered islands. Each wave gives you a limited number of shots to clear all targets before facing off in a boss stage—an intense sequence of targets that will test your aim under pressure. Chain together successful hits to trigger Frenzy mode, where your cannon fires nonstop for a short burst, letting you tear through targets at lightning speed. But be careful—outside of Frenzy, hitting a bad target means instant game over. As you progress, some targets begin to move, adding an extra layer of difficulty. Simple to pick up but hard to master, Smashy Cannon is all about rhythm, accuracy, and staying cool under fire.

70010000102161.name: Hyper Dots
70010000102161.intro: Connect, pop, and push your score higher.
70010000102161.description: Hyper Dots is a fast-paced, endlessly replayable puzzle-style game that challenges you to beat your best score with each run. Colored balls drop into the game zone, and your goal is to pop them by connecting two or more of the same color. Each time you make a match, you earn points and create space for more dots to fall. A locked gate with a points requirement blocks access to the next area—burst it open by scoring enough before you run out of moves. Make it through, and you’ll gain an extra move to keep going. Connect five or more dots at once to clear every dot of that color on the board, opening up new opportunities and boosting your score. When you run out of moves, your run ends and it’s time to try again. With its bright visuals, simple rules, and satisfying chain reactions, Hyper Dots offers a laid-back yet addictive challenge for casual puzzle fans.

70010000102166.name: Those I hate -1-／嫌いな彼ら-1-
70010000102166.intro:
"Falling in Love with the Man You Dislike?!
Experience a thrilling office romance in this exciting Love game!"
70010000102166.description:
A Dark Past, Trauma... and an Unexpected Love?
The heroine is struggling with mental health issues caused by painful memories and a troubled past. She regularly visits the hospital for treatment.

While working alongside a clumsy junior colleague, Makoto Minase, she tries to navigate her difficult workplace... but the pressure from both him and her surroundings becomes too much. She finally decides to confront the company president — only to discover that it’s none other than Raiki Kiryuu, the very same boy who used to bully her in the past.

As if things couldn't get any worse, her parents suddenly push her into an arranged marriage. Reluctantly agreeing to meet the suitor, she’s shocked to see Selene Irie, a wealthy heir who used to stalk her as a child...

A Thrilling Office Romance Otome Game
Part of a larger series, but can be enjoyed as a standalone!

18 unique love interests await you!

This title features 3 main characters to pursue in this chapter.

Includes a CG Gallery and Sound Room

All original BGM

Fully voiced in Japanese

Features 15 CGs (5 per character) in a visual novel slideshow format — no character sprites.

The opening and ending themes are sung by the voice actors!

70010000102191.name: WINDSWEPT
70010000102191.intro: Marbles and Checkers need your help finding their way home after being swept away in a storm. In this 90s buddy-platformer there's a ton of stuff to do and even more to collect!
70010000102191.description:
Don't be fooled by its cute charm! The journey home won't be an easy one!

Windswept is a love letter to a period of gaming where collectathon platformers reigned supreme, trying again was the norm, and players only had a game manual to guide them.

There are over 40 stages to explore, each with their own set of hidden collectibles, bonus challenges and quirky obstacles to overcome... or fall victim to!

You'll learn every ability in the first stage of the game, after that you're on your own!

Changing your leader gives you an entirely new set of actions to use and master - remember to take your time and things will click eventually...

Making your way home will be tough, and you'll need to keep trying until you get the hang of things - but for those who find it a walk in the park, there's plenty of hidden challenges along the way to test you!

There's no wrong way to play Windswept.
Marbles and Checkers each have unique abilities, but that won't always be enough to overcome specialised challenges... Mix 'n' match different techniques to play your own way.

You may surprise yourself with what you're capable of!
The journey home is a long one - live for the moments as they happen.

After that, they're only a memory!
How far will you go?
Where will your journey end?
Let's get swept away - together!

70010000102199.name: Moonlight in Garland
70010000102199.intro:
Move to a new* apartment in the bustling city of Garland! Make friends, find work, and decorate your new home.
*Apartment quality may vary...
70010000102199.description:
Work with your neighbours and the city council to improve your local community while you settle in to city life. Welcome to Garland, you're gonna love it here!**
**Loving it not guaranteed.

70010000102208.name: Logical reasoning of Ritsu
70010000102208.description: Ritsuko, who came from the countryside, fights against AI together with Yuki.

70010000102213.name: Boxes: Lost Fragment
70010000102213.intro: Escape a mystery mansion full of mechanical puzzle boxes and hidden objects.
70010000102213.description:
As a legendary thief, your next assignment lures you into a grand and lavish mansion. There you find a series of puzzle boxes, designed for an unknown purpose.

Suddenly, you realize that this is no ordinary building and that you are no longer in control of what is unfolding, and perhaps never were. What should have been a quick in-and-out, turns into your own harrowing struggle for freedom and answers.

Inspired by the cryptic atmosphere, intricate machinery, and smooth controls of the best room escape games, we have created a diverse set of original puzzle levels that will test your resolve and skills to navigate this mysterious and compelling journey. Each level is beautiful, unique, and a true delight to explore and figure out.

70010000102218.name: Arcade Archives TOKYO WARS
70010000102218.intro: The battle for Tokyo! Which side will you join: the Green force or the White force?
70010000102218.description:
"TOKYO WARS" is an action shooter released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1996.
Join the tank unit of the Green force or the White force and engage in battle through realistic city streets.
Destroy or be destroyed—the war for Tokyo begins now!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000102223.name: Alfie Atkins Game Collection
70010000102223.intro: Play smart, stay kind — the Alfie Atkins way!
70010000102223.description:
Discover the gentle, clever world of Alfie Atkins, the beloved Scandinavian character loved by children and parents around the globe!
Now Alfie invites you to join him for five classic logic games — perfect for curious minds and calm moments of play.
 
Train your memory, sharpen your strategy, and enjoy screen time that’s wholesome, friendly, and full of quiet joy.
Play alone or together on one console, share the fun with your friends!
 
Includes:
 
• Tic-Tac-Toe
• Checkers
• Memory Game
• Sweeper
• Gomoku
 
With warm visuals inspired by Gunilla Bergström’s timeless stories, Alfie Atkins Game Collection combines learning, imagination, and play — the Scandinavian way.

Everyday life wrapped in magic!

70010000102234.name: Poolside Boys Kiss: Passion Fruits Hotel Dating Sim
70010000102234.intro:
Flirt at the pool and unlock exclusive images.
Jump in and play now!
70010000102234.description:
Experience the hottest summer as you try to flirt with irresistible guys at the pool… and protect their hearts from any emotional splash.

Combine daring questions with dynamic aquatic defense gameplay to unlock suggestive images and unexpected endings.

Discover how each guy reacts to your answers, your moves, and your tactics under the sun. Do you have the charm (and the reflexes) to rule the pool?


Features:

● Refreshing dual gameplay: Switch between flirty Q&A and defense mode, where you must block “attacks” (splashes, pesky floaties, intruders) to unlock new scenes.

● Suggestive images and unique moments: Earn their trust and uncover special situations as you advance through each route.

● Get to know their personality: Every answer reveals each guy’s tastes, limits, and secrets—from the shy bookworm to the confident heartthrob.

● Multiple endings: It all depends on how many questions you get right, how well you protect his heart, and how you read his signals.

● A secret, spicy question: Reach question 150 to reveal a special final moment by the pool.


Can you keep your cool, dodge the splashes, and win their hearts under the sun?

Dive into this adventure where strategy, humor, and romance go hand in hand!

70010000102244.name: My Vet Clinic: Pet Doctor Days
70010000102244.intro: Welcome to an anime world of care and fluffy patients!
70010000102244.description:
Step into the shoes of a young and talented veterinary doctor and open the doors to your very own cat clinic! Together with your loyal nurse assistants, you'll treat purring patients, diagnose rare illnesses, care for kittens, and bring comfort to those who need it most.

Heal, grow, and build your dream!
Expand your clinic, upgrade equipment, unlock new rooms, and attract more and more clients. Sell medicine and cute accessories, manage your inventory, and earn the reputation of the best cat doctor in town.

Different cat breeds and heartwarming patient stories

Fun and engaging treatment procedures

Clinic management, upgrades, and decoration

Adorable characters and charming anime style

Management, upgrades, and compassion — all in one game!

Become the heroine of a world where every "meow" means "thank you"!

70010000102262.name: Caves of Qud
70010000102262.intro: A Hugo Award-winning science fantasy roguelike epic steeped in retrofuturism, deep simulation, and swathes of sentient plants. Chisel through layers of thousand-year-old civilizations.
70010000102262.description:
Decide: is it a dying earth, or is it on the verge of rebirth? 

Do anything and everything. Caves of Qud is a deeply simulated, biologically diverse, richly cultured world.

DEEP PHYSICAL SIMULATION — Don’t like the wall blocking your way? Dig through it with a pickaxe, or eat through it with your corrosive gas mutation, or melt it to lava. Yes, every wall has a melting point.

FULLY SIMULATED CREATURES — Every monster and NPC is as fully simulated as the player. That means they have levels, skills, equipment, faction allegiances, and body parts. So if you have a mutation that lets you, say, psionically dominate a spider, you can traipse through the world as a spider, laying webs and eating things.

DYNAMIC FACTION SYSTEM — Pursue allegiances with over 70 factions: apes, crabs, trees, robots, and highly entropic beings, just to name a few.

RICHLY DETAILED SCIENCE FANTASY SETTING — Over fifteen years of worldbuilding have led to a rich, weird, labyrinthine, one-of-a-kind storyworld, layered on top of the simulation, all for you to explore. Live and drink, friend.

TACTICAL GAMEPLAY — Turn-based, sandbox exploration and combat offers as many solutions as you and your mutations, implants, artifacts, and skills are creative enough to invent.

RPG ELEMENTS — Quests, NPCs, villages, historic sites; some dynamic and some handwritten, interwoven to produce a transportative RPG experience.

ATMOSPHERIC ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK — Over two hours of otherworldly music to delve to.

Caves of Qud has one of the most expressive character creators of all time.

Play the role of a mutant indigenous to the salt-spangled dunes and jungles of Qud, or play a true kin descendant from one of the few remaining eco-domes — the toxic arboreta of Ekuemekiyye, the ice-sheathed arcology of Ibul, or the crustal mortars of Yawningmoon.

Build your character out of:

- Over 70 mutations — outfit yourself with wings, two heads, four arms, flaming hands, teleportation, the power to clone yourself…

- Dozens of cybernetic implants (and more to find as treasure) — night vision, translucent skin, carbide fists, spring-loaded ankle tendons…

 - 24 castes and kits from across the social order of Qud and beyond Moghra’yi, the Great Salt Desert

 - Too overwhelmed to build a character from scratch? Choose one of 9 preset characters and start your adventure right away. Then return to character creation when you are ready.

Play one of four modes:

CLASSIC — Like other traditional roguelikes, this mode has permadeath, meaning you lose your character when you die. Extremely challenging even for experts.

ROLEPLAY — Play it like an RPG. Save your progress at checkpoints located in settlements.

WANDER — Focus on exploration. Most creatures will not attack you, you don’t gain experience by killing, but you DO gain experience by discovering new locations and treating with legendary creatures.

DAILY — One chance with a fixed character and world seed. How long will you survive?

70010000102264.name: Grow Your Self-Esteem
70010000102264.description:
Build your self-esteem, one day at a time.
Simple daily exercises to help you feel good about who you are.
From positive affirmations to quick reflections, it’s all about you.
Rediscover your strengths, celebrate your progress.
Confidence starts with kindness—to yourself.

70010000102267.name: Mindfulness Moments
70010000102267.description:
Breathe. Focus. Reset.
Take a moment every day to calm your mind.
With guided sessions and natural sounds, it’s easy to begin.
Improve your focus, reduce anxiety, and enjoy the present.
No pressure, just peace—one breath at a time.

70010000102270.name: Diet Recipes Every Day
70010000102270.description:
Healthy meals that actually taste amazing.
Discover new low-calorie recipes every day.
Quick to make, easy to follow, and 100% satisfying.
Stay full, feel great, and lose weight without stress.
Your diet just got a delicious upgrade.

70010000102273.name: Decluttering Journey
70010000102273.description:
Let go of what you don’t need—mentally and physically.
Track your daily progress as you simplify your space and mind.
Visual tools help you stay motivated while decluttering.
From clothes to emotions, clean up what no longer serves you.
Make minimalism a joyful, rewarding habit.

70010000102276.name: Work From Home
70010000102276.description:
Turn your home into your productivity zone.
This helps you stay focused, beat procrastination, and organize your tasks.
Gamified tools keep your motivation high throughout the day.
Perfect for freelancers, students, and remote workers alike.
Level up your work-from-home routine—your new daily habit starts here.

70010000102279.name: SUMMERHOUSE
70010000102279.intro: SUMMERHOUSE is a small-scale building game and a love letter to the feeling of long lost summer afternoons.
70010000102279.description:
SUMMERHOUSE is a small-scale building game and a love letter to the feeling of long lost summer afternoons.

Craft a neighbourhood of tiny, beautiful lived-in homes in a variety of settings: the sea, the city, or the mountains. While there are some little secrets to uncover, there are no rules, and you can’t win or lose. Just chill out, build to your heart’s content and soak up the atmosphere.

If relaxation and creation are your thing, this is a game for you :)

Please keep in mind that this is a small game with no goals or challenges, created by a single person

70010000102284.name: DeviLevel: Try Again
70010000102284.description:
A trial of patience even hell would give up on!

Are you ready to survive a dark world filled with demonic traps and deadly platforms? In this 2D hellish platformer, every step tests your reflexes, memory, and will. One wrong move... and it’s all over. But every death makes you stronger!

Key Features:

Brutally clever trap placement

15+ nightmare levels with hundreds of stages

Instant retry, zero loading – die, learn, and go again!

Minimalist, demonic art style with a dark atmosphere

A true challenge only the most patient players can beat

Every death makes you better. Every attempt brings you closer.
There is no mercy here.
Only the will to try again.

DeviLevel: Try Again – If you dare, press start.

70010000102289.name: Ecchi Breaker
70010000102289.intro: Break the blocks or break her heart.
70010000102289.description:
Grab your paddle and get ready to aim, bounce, and break your way to a gorgeous reveal. Every hit brings you closer to what’s hidden behind and the satisfaction of a perfect clear has never looked this good.

Keep your focus, control your shots, and watch as the tension builds with every block you destroy. But be careful… miss too many, and the moment might slip away.

Features:
- 32 stunning girls waiting to be revealed
- Sensual music and satisfying effects
- Addictive arcade-style gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Keep your balls in play, and break through to your reward.

70010000102291.name: Kawaii Girls: Cute Cheerleader
70010000102291.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000102291.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000102308.name: Pattern Thinking Puzzle Build It Before 10
70010000102308.intro:
★☆★★☆[?]★ ←What symbol goes in the [?]?
Train your programming brain with a fun puzzle game!
70010000102308.description:
A logic quiz game that helps you naturally develop programming-style thinking—
the ability to understand “systems” and “sequences” in everyday things—while having fun!

How to play is super easy：
・Look carefully at the puzzle image
・Find the pattern in the shapes or symbols
・Choose the correct answer from the options

It’s great for kids who want to build critical thinking skills in a fun way,
and for seniors who want a light brain workout through play.

Stuck on a question?
Don’t worry—use the hint button for a gentle nudge.
Perfect for casual brain training during your free time!

70010000102310.name: Mistonia's Hope -The Lost Delight-
70010000102310.description:
Pursue your quest for revenge... or romance.

Conceal your identity as you seek to punish those who have taken your family and home. 

Are the nobles you meet protecting the kingdom of fairies, or do they have ulterior motives? 

Choose from multiple story paths and complex love triangles. 

Enter a vibrant, living world created by illustrator Karin Suzushiro.

70010000102312.name: Focus and Find STEREOGRAM TRAINING
70010000102312.intro:
Stare closely and a hidden image will pop out!
Train your eyes and brain with mysterious stereograms
70010000102312.description:
When you cross your eyes and stare at the screen, a 3D image will pop out!
This is a fun brain-training game that uses mysterious stereograms.

How to play is simple：
・Read the question carefully
・Stare at the stereogram until the hidden image appears
・When you find the part that matches the answer, tap it!

Since it uses a lot of eye muscles, it’s a great way to train your vision effectively.

〜How to view stereograms〜
・Start by crossing your eyes
・When the two dots above the image appear as three, the hidden picture will emerge
・If you're not good at crossing your eyes, hold a finger in front of your eyes and focus on it
・Don't force it—just relax and let your eyes softly focus

※On the ""Setting"" screen at the start of the game, you can choose how to hold the device.
(In Table Mode or Handheld Mode, holding the device vertically makes the image easier to see.)

70010000102322.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Odong-do Dragon Cave
70010000102322.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Odong-do Dragon Cave, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 2 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000102327.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Sang-jog-am
70010000102327.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Sang-jog-am, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 2 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000102332.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Byeongpung Bawi
70010000102332.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Byeongpung Bawi, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 2 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000102348.name: Rabbiman Adventures: Secret Room
70010000102348.intro: A curious boy, cool puzzles, and a forest that needs you to restore harmony
70010000102348.description:
Ready for a true adventure?
Imagine you're traveling through time and space, where there's always something new and amazing waiting for you. There are colorful locations, hidden routes, devious villains, magical items, and exciting puzzles to solve at each level. Your wits and ingenuity will be your best allies in unravelling the mysteries of this magical world and reaching the end.

It's all about the hat
The hero's hat is more than just a pretty accessory. It's got some pretty amazing abilities hidden up its sleeve. You can use it to teleport, solve puzzles, activate mechanisms, and open new locations. As you progress in the game, you'll be able to perform more and more acrobatic tricks. Plus, the built-in store lets you customize your hero.

Love challenges? We've got something special for you.
If you find the standard tasks too easy, you'll definitely enjoy the additional puzzle levels. They'll help you hone your skills and discover new superpowers. This is where you'll set new personal records and show what you're capable of.

Music that set the rhythm
The main melodies and leitmotifs are culturally inspired, arranged in the hip-hop genre and adapted to the style of the game. The game's music is a blend of old-school beats, scratches, and the author's loops, which come together to create a unified concept, the perfect rhythm, and the ideal atmosphere. The sound is full of great musical experiments and discoveries.

Why is it worth a shot?
Rabbiman Adventures is an exciting journey where you can explore new things at every step. You can learn about different time travels, places, traditions, and cultures. The plot develops with you, and each step brings new interesting tasks. How far are you willing to go to uncover all the secrets?

70010000102357.name: Warrior Survivor
70010000102357.description:
Choose your fighter — warrior or mage — and jump into action-packed roguelike battles against endless waves of monsters!
Each run rewards you with powerful upgrade chests that can completely transform your strategy as you take on tougher enemies and massive bosses.
Score big, power up your hero, and push your limits to go further with every run!

70010000102367.name: Sunberry Valley
70010000102367.description:
Welcome to Sunberry Valley – a peaceful experience where nature tells the story & the wind blows.

Step into the golden sunlight of Sunberry Valley, a tranquil open-world experience designed for quiet exploration and gentle discovery. Stroll through sun-drenched meadows, whispering forests, and crumbling ruins as you uncover the secrets of a place untouched by time.

There are no enemies. No quests. No urgency.
Just you, the valley, and the slow, immersive art of exploring.

Key Features:

Explore a hand-crafted valley filled with picturesque trails, hidden groves, old cabins, and forgotten paths.

Ambient Storytelling
Discover subtle environmental clues that piece together the valley’s past.

An Evocative Soundscape
Let a gentle, atmospheric soundtrack and immersive nature sounds guide your journey. Headphones recommended.

70010000102370.name: TetroMosaic, RacY: AutomatA
70010000102370.intro: TetroMosaic: A mental challenge that combines tetrominoes of different geometric shapes with the textures and colors typical of a mosaic.
70010000102370.description:
Throw blocks to fit them together precisely and discover the secret and spectacular hidden illustrations.
Play at your own pace: pause each block to place it precisely or throw them quickly to chain combos, fill the bar, and earn stars.

Test your ingenuity and train your mind!

Boost your working memory by retaining shapes and patterns while creating impressive mosaics.

Enhance your ability to understand positions, proportions, and relationships between objects.

Develop problem-solving skills and adapt to new challenges.

Train your careful observation of colors, edges, and textures to fit each block together correctly.

Features:
 - Difficulty: 7 to 10 mosaic lines.
 - Immerse yourself in the full-screen gallery and enjoy all the unlocked illustrations.
 - CO-OP and VS modes to challenge friends and family. Will you be the fastest?

70010000102372.name: Toree Saturn
70010000102372.description:
Toree Saturn is a speed-based 3D platformer featuring a round bird with sunglasses and a backpack!

Run through linear levels from point A to B with a double jumping bird while avoiding enemies, collecting stars (if desired), and getting all kinds of little speed boosts along the way. 

- Simple to understand gameplay: Just run around and jump and you already set to get the highest rankings in each level
- A variety of levels with different retro and colorful themes
- Cool tunes inspired by late 90s as well as early Y2K styles.
- A bird with sunglasses and a backpack!
- Toree has two new moves! The player can now use a grounddash in mid air to descend faster and get a speedboost when impacting on the ground, as well as homing in on special stars to get a height and movement boost.

- New Looks! Toree Saturns artstyle tries to be a combination of late 90s 3D with some of the more crazy looks of the early Y2K era. It's like a natural evolution of the artstyle of the previous games... I hope.

- Controlling Toree got way easier!
- Most actions (except for the trigger for the ground dash) only use the Jump button.
- Ground Dash is performed by the now freed ZR Button

70010000102374.name: Cricket Captain 2025
70010000102374.description:
Build your dream team with Cricket Captain 2025. In a packed international season, Test cricket takes centre stage with Australia taking on South Africa in the World Test Championship final, followed by India’s tour of England and England’s tour of Australia. 
Cricket Captain has a completely new look, with a beautifully designed, clean-look interface, reducing distractions and helping take gameplay to a new immersive experience.  Taking feedback from our fans, we have updated the match engine and player generation to bring more balance to scoring rates and wicket chances in 20 Over games. We have also improved the speed of the game engine allowing faster progression through seasons and matches. 

The new in-game Player Editor feature allows for editing player abilities, including batting, bowling, fielding, aggression, and opener type. For the first time, you can adjust your players as you want without sacrificing the core player-selection game play.
Cricket Captain 2025 expands our database once again, including individual most wicket and runs season stats for international teams. Improved interface and options allowing faster access to the vast database at the heart of the game. 
All domestic systems have been updated to include the latest developments around the world. 

Key features for 2025 include:
    • New Interface: completely re-designed with fresh look.
    • Player Editor: adjust player’s abilities to reflect real-world performance. 
    • Match Engine: improved 20 over engine following user suggestions.
    • Improved Player Generation: rebalanced with focus on 20 over skill.
    • Commentary: additional commentary from Daniel Norcross. 
    • Score Predictor: faster score predictor for more immediate feedback.
    • Updated International Team Rankings: calculated from last 4 years results.
    • International Player Rankings: updated with historical data.
    • International Trophies: play in ODI and 20 Over International tournaments.
    • Updated Pakistan Domestic System:  18 new teams playing all three match types.
    • Domestic System Updates: all systems updated to latest rules and formats.
    • Test Championship: updated for the 2025 season.
    • Tournament Modes: play in stand-alone One Day, Asia Trophy or 20 Over World Cups. Create your own World XIs, All-Time Great and Custom Match Series.

Complete Stats Update for the 2025 Season:
    • Updated player database with over 8,000 players.
    • Updated stats for all match types.
    • Added international individual season batting and bowling records.
    • Updated domestic squads for all 156 playable domestic teams.
    • Updated recent series stats for all players.

70010000102379.name: DUCK: Dangerous Ultimate Cartridge Kidnapper
70010000102379.intro: A group of ducklings finds a mysterious 100-in-1 cartridge and are now forced to play all the games to escape the insidious cartridge spirit!
70010000102379.description:
100 microgames, fun and increasing difficulty—what more do you need for an interesting adventure?

DUCK: Dangerous Ultimate Cartridge Kidnapper is a compilation of 100 very different microgames lasting less than a minute! Cowboy duel, house building, tomato sorting, barrel ride, sea battles, jungle adventures, typical daily life of a mad scientist and more!

STORY.
A group of ducklings finds a mysterious 100-in-1 cartridge that turns out to be a trap for an evil spirit who calls himself D.U.C.K. Now the ducklings will have to show all their gamer skills, or else the villain will fulfill the curse and make them characters in his games. Being two-dimensional and pixelated, constantly dying and being reborn, is an inenvitable fate!

FEATURES
- Variety.
15 categories of 5-10 microgames each with three difficulty levels, plus a separate category for boss games. Different styles of pixel graphics, lots of unique tunes and sounds. And even the playthrough can be interesting, because you never know what's going to happen! And finally—as you progress through the story mode, play through the games and fulfill special conditions, you can unlock all 16 decorative panels—arcade, Greek, comic, summer, brick and more!
- Game Modes.
In story mode, the ducklings will definitely get through all 100 games with your help, 5 ducklings are 5 main chapters. Open games appear in the vault, where you can choose any of them and practice, pass on all difficulties. And finally, there is a survival mode—try to get the highest score! However… No one prevents you from plunging into the unknown with your friends by activating one of the party modes!
- The warm atmosphere of childhood.
The spirit has locked the ducklings in a room in the house of a typical duckling of the time. Small cozy room, the rays of the setting sun streaming through the window, you and your friends gathered in front of the screen of a tubby TV, and in the console—a cartridge with a bunch of interesting games!

Note: Cooperative are implemented in the form of a hotseat mode. This means that players must play in sequence, one after another.

70010000102384.name: Learn to Play - Jungle Frog
70010000102384.intro: Protect the frog from the bees!
70010000102384.description:
You are a little frog living peacefully in your jungle home — until one day, a swarm of bees invades and won’t leave you alone!

Fend off the unwanted guests and protect your home! Avoid their stings and bites as you drive them away.

Complete 15 fun and easy levels to reclaim your peace and enjoy some well-deserved rest!

70010000102389.name: CLIMB
70010000102389.intro: Chase the treasure, reach the peak
70010000102389.description:
CLIMB is a thrilling mountain expedition where danger and discovery go hand in hand.
A legendary treasure rests at the summit of an ancient, uncharted peak. Legends speak of lost relics and forgotten riches buried beneath the snow, waiting for the one bold enough to reach them.

The ascent is unforgiving. Jagged cliffs, unstable ledges, and unpredictable weather will challenge every move. As the altitude rises, oxygen thins, temperatures plummet, and blizzards sweep across the path, turning each step into a battle for survival.

Careful planning, precise timing, and quick reactions are key to overcoming natural hazards—falling rocks, shifting ice, and sudden storms. Along the way, remnants of past explorers tell silent stories of ambition and failure, warning that not everyone who climbs returns.

Forge your own story and carve a unique path to the summit. Every route offers different challenges, secrets, and rewards. The mountain stands tall, its peak hidden in the clouds.

The treasure is real.

The risk is greater. And only the most determined can conquer both.

70010000102394.name: The Echo
70010000102394.intro: The Echo is a retro-themed First-Person Horror/Mystery...
70010000102394.description: You are the neuro-salvager...You dive into deep, dangerous neural networks...And your rent is due...You need this job badly but you have a feeling this can be...different...in a bad way...This time, will you be able to silence the echo in your mind?

70010000102407.name: Escape game R00M05
70010000102407.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

70010000102422.name: The Keys to the Imagination
70010000102422.intro: With a little imagination and a kitten by your side, any world is possible. Discover it in this beautiful, adorable, and fantastical visual novel.
70010000102422.description:
Imagination, sweetness, and adventures beyond the realm of possibility

Join a curious and brave girl on an incredible journey through magical worlds where anything you imagine can become reality. With the help of Puffy, an adorable kitten with big, bright eyes and lots to say, you'll discover kingdoms of candy, secrets of enchanted chocolate, and surprising versions of yourself.

An interactive story full of color, tenderness, and unforgettable characters that inspire daydreaming.

Highlights:

· Puffy, the most adorable kitten, guides every step with wisdom and tenderness.

· Colorful and cinematic 3D visual style, like an animated film.

· Fantastical worlds: candy castles, chocolate parlors, and much more.

· Positive message about imagination, identity, and personal worth.

· Perfect for enjoying with family or alone, as an interactive adventure.

70010000102424.name: Speed Legacy: Ultimate Drive
70010000102424.description:
Step into the fast lane with Speed Legacy: Ultimate Drive, where adrenaline, precision, and speed define your every move. Take on a variety of high-octane missions — from intense drag races and precision drifting to daring escapes from relentless pursuers. Every route is a challenge, every second counts, and every turn could be the difference between victory and defeat.
Push your skills to the limit as you race against time, master every maneuver, and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate driver. Can you handle the thrill, the chaos, and the ultimate rush of the streets?

70010000102429.name: ULTRASHOT: Kill Protocol
70010000102429.intro: When the system fails, the protocol begins.
70010000102429.description:
ULTRASHOT: Kill Protocol plunges you into a collapsing world where each mission takes you deeper into chaos. As a lone operative, you're deployed to eliminate growing threats spreading across hostile zones.

Every level challenges you to push forward, clearing out waves of enemies that become increasingly aggressive and unpredictable. But the real test comes at the end—where a powerful adversary awaits, guarding the path to what’s next.

No one is coming to help. You are the last defense against a force that multiplies with every hour. As the enemy evolves, so must you—adapting, enduring, and executing the mission at all costs.

The protocol has been activated. There’s no turning back.

70010000102439.name: Sneaky Claws
70010000102439.intro: Blend in, hunt your friends, and become the sneakiest animal at the party!
70010000102439.description:
Have a blast hiding, deceiving, and hunting your friends!
Sneaky Claws is a local multiplayer game for 2 to 8 players where you blend in with AI characters to find and eliminate your friends… before they catch you!
Enjoy quick rounds full of fun tension, visual trickery, laughter, and sneaky cartoon animals.
Perfect for all ages, with simple controls, short matches, and loads of humour.

70010000102441.name: BODYCAM SHOOTER 2025
70010000102441.intro: Enter the combat zone and survive every mission.
70010000102441.description:
Gear up and enter the intense world of modern combat in BBODYCAM SHOOTER 2025. Experience missions from a first-person perspective, as if you are wearing a real body camera. Patrol dangerous areas, engage in high-stakes firefights, and complete critical objectives while capturing every moment of the action. Every decision counts — one wrong move can change the outcome of the mission.

Game Features:
- Realistic Bodycam Perspective: Experience combat through the eyes of an operative, with authentic bodycam visuals and immersive gameplay.
- High-Stakes Missions: Complete tactical operations, secure zones, rescue hostages, and eliminate threats with precision.
- Advanced Weaponry: Access an arsenal of modern firearms, gadgets, and tactical gear to handle any situation.
- Strategic Gameplay: Make quick decisions under pressure, coordinate with AI teammates, and adapt to evolving threats.

Step into the boots of an elite operative, capture every moment on your bodycam, and prove your skills in BODYCAM SHOOTER 2025. Are you ready for the ultimate combat simulation?

70010000102458.name: Sunrest Oasis
70010000102458.intro: Follow the light. Discover the oasis
70010000102458.description:
Journey into the endless sands of Sunrest Oasis, a vast and mysterious desert where ruins rise from the dunes and secrets lie buried beneath the scorching sun. As a lone traveler, you must explore colossal ancient structures and uncover the path forward!

Each level is a challenge of discovery: find the next hidden entrance, navigate cryptic halls, and push deeper toward the heart of the desert. Legend speaks of a sacred oasis hidden within the depths of a sprawling, sunlit temple. Do you have what it takes to find it?


Features:
~ Wander through a peaceful, sunlit desert at your own pace
~Discover paths leading deeper into ancient temples
~Soak in the warm, golden atmosphere and tranquil music
~Uncover a quiet story through symbols, ruins, and whispers of the past

70010000102466.name: Find the Cats: Japan Journey
70010000102466.intro:
Spot the sneaky cats hidden across beautiful Japan!
Relax, explore, and test your sharp eyes.
Can you find them all?
70010000102466.description:
Find the Cats: Japan Journey
Pack your bags and get ready for a relaxing yet challenging adventure through the beautiful sights of Japan – and the most adorable scavenger hunt you’ve ever played!
From bustling Tokyo streets to tranquil Kyoto gardens, your mission is simple… or so it seems: find all the hidden cats cleverly tucked away in each detailed scene. Some are easy to spot, while others are masters of disguise!
Features:
Search for dozens of hidden cats in charming Japanese-themed levels
Explore stunning hand-drawn locations from cities to temples and countryside
Relaxed gameplay perfect for all ages – play at your own pace
Zoom and pan to uncover every sneaky feline
Unlock new scenes and challenges as you progress
Enjoy the cozy soundtrack and calming atmosphere

Whether you’re a casual player looking for something soothing or a puzzle lover seeking the ultimate hidden object challenge, Find the Cats: Japan Journey will keep you purring with joy.

Can you find them all?

70010000102470.name: Neon Inferno
70010000102470.intro: Blaze through the streets of a future NYC in this 2D run-and-gun, in 1P or 2P!
70010000102470.description:
NEON INFERNO is a hybrid side-scroller and gallery-shooter where the action takes place in both the foreground and the background. As warring factions battle for control of a dystopian New York City, you enter the fray as an assassin for the Family -- a notorious crime syndicate determined to eliminate its rivals and dominate the metropolitan battlefield. Rendered in beautiful pixel art and backed by an evocative soundtrack, Neon Inferno delivers a stylish, modern 2D action experience with cyberpunk flair.

SELECT YOUR KILLER 
Take control of Angelo Morano or Mariana Vitti and battle through the streets, blasting, deflecting, and slicing your way through your enemies! With multiple upgrades and weapon options to choose from, you'll be well-equipped to shift this city-wide conflict in your favor.

SHOOT CLOSE, AIM FAR 
Along with traditional run-and-gun action, you'll be able to attack your enemies in both the foreground and the background, deflect their projectiles back at them using "Bullet Time", and commandeer vehicles to chase down your targets! Choose your level of difficulty or challenge yourself in the 1-credit-clear Arcade Mode!

A JOINT OPERATION 
Grab a friend and expand The Family's reign across the city together! With double the characters and double the firepower, there's no limit to the carnage you can cause!

TARGETS ACQUIRED 
Go up against a rogue's gallery of unruly bosses, one at the end of every mission. Each boss is totally unique, featuring many attacks and multiple phases that will truly put your skills to the test!

70010000102480.name: Super Darling Panic／スパダリ★パニック
70010000102480.intro:
What if she had a Cinderella-like experience?
She panics after being courted by these superstars!
70010000102480.description:
Misora, our heroine, is a refined young lady working as an office lady. But her life takes a sudden turn after the passing of her beloved mother. Her father, Manabu Tsukaji, remarries a graduate student named Michiko—who soon begins to treat Misora like Cinderella.

What begins as a tale of hardship slowly transforms into an unbelievably heartwarming Cinderella story. As the plot unfolds, no one is left unhappy, and Misora ends up so blissfully happy, she almost panics!

4 Love Interests!
With a simple structure and only one character choice at the final branching ending, this game is perfect for otome game beginners. No tricky routes—just sweet, romantic moments with your very own Super Darling (aka Supa-Dari)!

Features:

12 stunning CG stills!

Enjoy both a CG Gallery and a Sound Room featuring original music tracks!

Prepare to fall in love in this sugar-sweet romantic adventure!

70010000102485.name: Montabi
70010000102485.intro:
Tame, collect, and evolve unique Montabi!
Assemble unstoppable decks for your synergistic team.
Master tactical grid-based combat to save the city!
70010000102485.description:
A Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilding Game.

Assemble your team of Montabi to outsmart the bad guys and save the city!

If you're going to be the big hero and save the city, you've gotta get some Montabi! Each Montabi has a unique set of skills, giving you endless combinations for team synergies. Collect equipment and charms and utilize them to chart the path to victory!  

Train your Montabi to grow stronger, unlocking new moves to enhance your team's strategy. As they level up, your Montabi evolve into more powerful forms, gaining new card abilities and expanding your tactical options. If you work together, there's nothing you and your Montabi can't achieve!

Deploy your best strategies to beat up the bad guys in a unique 3x3 grid-based system. With every Montabi's unique abilities, you'll have endless options to outthink the competition and win the day. Just make sure you rest up at a cafe every now and then to recover those hit points!

Select from diverse trainers, each with a unique playstyle. Do you wanna put your team in the perfect position, get right up in their faces and duke it out, or buff up your Montabi with a hearty meal? When the city's at stake, everyone pitches in! Just make sure to stay safe! Like the king in chess, if your trainer is defeated, the game ends.

Feature List
• Build your Montabi Team - Collect and Fight with over 60 Montabi!
• Evolve and Draft Skills - Each time you Montabi evolves, draft a legendary ability!
• Outsmart your Opponents - Strategize on the 3x3 tactical battlemap!
• Choose your Trainer - The student, fighter or chef will lead your synergistic team!

70010000102501.name: 文字遊戲 Word Game
70010000102501.description:
Word game is literally a game of words.

Words are not only composing narratives and interfaces, but also representing objects, characters and scenes.

Player controls "I" to challenge puzzles composed of words.

When "I" appears a secret room, in-game narrative clearly tells "I" that "there is no door”. However, in the world of word game, “I" can walk through the "door” because there is a “door”.

“I" should find clues between lines, delete words to change the meaning of sentences, or shift words to rewrite facts. “I” must be wise and brave enough complete the mission of words.

May the best "I” win!

70010000102517.name: Gensou -Yumegokochi- Illusion -Dreamlike-
70010000102517.intro: Free the Yōkai captured by the Supreme Leader!
70010000102517.description:
This game offers a completely new experience by blending nostalgic arcade territory control gameplay with modern Japanese art and new elements. 
In it, you must prevent the revival of the Supreme Leader and free the Yōkai that have been sealed away.

＜About Illusion- Dreamlike-＞
This game is an homage to the popular territorial game genre that took the world by storm in the 1980s.

Long ago, in the Tohoku region of Japan, people were tormented by malevolent spirits, Yōkais.
However, through people's unity and after a long battle, they managed to trap the Supreme Leader deep in the earth and built a shrine on top of it.
Time passed...
One day, the Supreme Leader who was imprisoned underground resurfaces, putting the Tohoku region in danger once again. 
As the master of the shrine, you must cleanse each area and free the Yōkais captured by the Supreme Leader.

＜Gameplay＞
Draw lines to enclose areas while avoiding collisions with enemies and boss attacks in each stage. 
The area enclosed by the line will be unsealed. 
Continue unsealing areas to release the characters trapped in the background.

<Clear Conditions>
To clear the stage, enclose the character's silhouette and meet the stage-specific quota (%). 
Even if your health reaches "0", you will still clear the stage if the quota is achieved.
After clearing a stage, you will receive a lovely "reward" from the freed Yōkais.

<Stage Variations>
There are 46 different types. 
So every time you play, the stage size may be different.

<Game Over>
The game will end if time runs out or if you run out of health.

＜Unrivaled Barrier＞
This barrier can block enemy attacks. 
It can be activated as long as you hold down the button, but it gradually depletes.
Once the remaining amount reaches "0," you will no longer be able to block attacks.

＜Transcendence Orbs＞
Collect three Transcendence Orbs on the stage to enter the "Transcendence" state for a limited time. 
In this invincible state, you can freely in the occupied areas.

70010000102528.name: Cats Visiting the Cinema
70010000102528.intro:
It’s movie night, and the cats are out!
Find all the hidden kitties in lively cinema settings — from popcorn stands to cozy theater seats and movies with cats.
70010000102528.description:
It’s movie night — and guess who showed up at the cinema? Cats!
In Cats Visiting the Cinema, you’ll explore five hand-crafted, cinema-themed scenes packed with hidden cats. From the grand entrance in Chicago to the buzzing popcorn stands, and finally, the magical movie screening room — every location hides 80 cats waiting to be found.

Along the way, you’ll collect five unique Action Cats, each hidden in a different level to complete your collection.

Play at your own pace in classic mode, or turn up the excitement in Arcade Mode, where you’ll race against the clock to spot every kitty. Whether you're a casual gamer or a completionist, there's a little something for everyone.

Get ready for a cozy, lighthearted game filled with charm, cats, and movie magic!

70010000102544.name: Greedland
70010000102544.intro: "Greedland” is a roguelike game mixed with survivor-like elements.
70010000102544.description:
By using the unreal engine 5, your journey of conquest will be more than ordinary. You will fully experience and immerse yourself in the violent beauty of blood and fire.

Hordes of monsters crash down on you, exploding into crimson mist with every shot. Missiles rain, cannons roar, and lasers paint the sky! Unleash extreme firepower to incinerate every enemy in your path. Millions of monstrosities across dozens of levels eye you hungrily. Retreat? Never! Blast right through them! Forge your throne of victory with blood and fire! Powered by Unreal Engine 5, the stunning visual fidelity delivers a symphony of gunfire and an unforgettable feast for your eyes.

Surrounded by monsters? Running low on ammo? Your Titan Mechas are always on standby, ready to deploy. With a brutal aesthetic and overwhelming firepower, they'll crush everything in their path. Bosses or elite foes? They're just minor speed bumps on your rampage. The collision of steel and flesh is always exhilarating! Auxiliary gear combined with mech upgrades transforms you into a mobile meat grinder, making the monsters remember the terror of humanity's wrath!

Welcome to the Armory, warrior! Here, your firepower will undergo radical evolution! Each Power Armor boasts unique upgrades—there's always one to suit your playstyle. A vast arsenal of chips will supercharge your combat, combining with over 300 upgrades to maximize the adrenaline rush of every encounter. Mix and match diverse auxiliary equipment to create unique experiences each run, and even synthesize ultimate gear to utterly dominate the battlefield!

70010000102557.name: Cross Pix
70010000102557.description:
Cross Pix is a NEW NONOGRAM Logic Puzzle Game! where you follow number clues to solve a hidden image. It’s also known by other similar games like Griddlers, or Paint by Numbers.

With simple and easy-to-understand rules, it's a game anyone can enjoy! A perfect choice for casual play, while still offering a satisfying mental challenge.

Cross Pix delivers a relaxing and cozy puzzle experience that keeps your mind sharp and engaged.

Cross Pix features 100 hand-crafted puzzles and intuitive gameplay with gradually increasing difficulty.

Features:
★ Nintendo Switch™ online leaderboards for each mode (opt-out available).
★ 5 professionally composed background tracks.
★ Multi-language support.
★ Play with Joy-Con™, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller or touchscreen.
★ Quick-start help system – perfect for beginners!
★ Settings to adjust pointer speed, sound on/off, background music on/off.
★ Four sizes 5x5, 10x10, 15x15, 20x15 board, from easy to challenging.

Cross Pix offers an immersive experience for puzzle lovers of all ages. 

Are you ready to take on the ultimate nonogram challenge and rise to the top of the world leaderboard? 


Note : Controller Mappings:
[A] Select/Mark
[B] Check board complete
[X] Toggle X or block marker
[Y] Centre puzzle board

70010000102562.name: Wrap Shop Simulator
70010000102562.intro: Serve fast, cook smart, and rise as a culinary legend.
70010000102562.description:
Join the ultimate culinary adventure on wheels!
You’re the chef of a food truck: buy fresh ingredients, cook delicious recipes, and delight your customers. Each dish earns you money, reputation, and the chance to impress demanding critics. Your final goal? Prove you’re the best chef in town!

Key Features
	•	Preparation: shop for ingredients, manage equipment, and set up your kitchen.
	•	Cooking: follow recipes, create dishes, and experiment with flavors.
	•	Service: handle customer orders and impress critics with unique tastes.
	•	Progression: unlock upgrades, new recipes, and rare ingredients to expand your food truck empire.

Every day brings a new challenge – can you rise from street chef to culinary legend?

70010000102567.name: Hentai Photo: Momo
70010000102567.intro: We will collect all the details and reveal the most interesting secrets!
70010000102567.description:
Welcome to Hentai Photo: Momo, a classic puzzle game where you unlock vivid and sensual illustrations step by step! The game focuses on attractive girls in glamorous and daring outfits. They are all ready to charm you with their looks.

All images are created with love for the smallest details, and their expressive poses, stylish outfits and bright emotions give each illustration a special atmosphere. The realistic assembly mechanics will make you feel like you are assembling a real paper puzzle. Relaxing music will help you to fully immerse yourself in the game.

Game Features:
- 40+ passionate puzzles featuring seductive anime girls
- High-quality and sensual illustrations
- Realistic assembly process with smooth animations
- Atmospheric music accompaniment
- Ability to view collected images in detail

70010000102569.name: Candy Trail
70010000102569.description:
In Candy Trail, your mission is to guide smiling ice creams along the sweet trails of an enchanted kingdom to the most delicious celebrations of the year! Get ready to solve puzzles on a hexagonal map, where every tile you rotate or swap can mean the difference between a flavor explosion... or a sugar disaster.
With charming visuals, heart-melting sounds, and mechanics that are easy to learn but strategic to master, the game evolves quickly. Rotate, swap, and connect the paths so each ice cream reaches the correct party—and with the right flavor!
Across 30 levels spanning the Confectionery, Candy, and Cookie Kingdoms, new characters, split-paths, and even tri-path tiles appear to amp up the challenge. And beware: if flavors get mixed wrong, culinary chaos may ensue.
If you love creative puzzles, thoughtful planning, and desserts with personality, Candy Trail is the perfect treat to satisfy your hunger for fun—one scoop of logic at a time.

70010000102574.name: Little Helper Cafe
70010000102574.intro: A hedgehog, sugar, and lots of logic on the table!
70010000102574.description:
In Little Helper Cafe, you control a friendly pet hedgehog who loves helping in the café by pushing sugar cubes into coffee cups, filling holes with macarons, and sliding across honey-covered tiles. After all, every café needs a spiky little helper!
Featuring block-pushing gameplay and clever path-solving, the game offers puzzles that are easy to pick up but have surprising depth, wrapped in charming 2D pixel art. Each table is a thoughtfully arranged puzzle where spatial thinking and planning matter as much as sugar in the coffee.
With 30 levels across two themed tabletops—cozy picnic outdoors and an elegant marble table—the complexity ramps up gently, introducing creative combinations that will challenge even the most skillful baristas.
If you enjoy games that blend cuteness, logic, and a touch of sweetness, Little Helper Cafe will sweeten your mind with every push. Grab a cup of coffee… and start pushing!

70010000102579.name: Steampunch: Lost Tombs
70010000102579.description:
Steampunch: Lost Tombs is the second game in the franchise, and it takes the action to a whole new level with simplified combat, mysterious levers, and precision-based platforming. Run, jump, and dash in eight directions as you explore dangerous tombs, collect relics, and unlock portals to the next challenge.
You control a determined adventurer set on uncovering the secrets of lost civilizations—but the path is full of clever enemies, deadly traps, and puzzles that demand creativity and skill. Each lever opens a new path, and each enemy can be defeated with a single hit… if you’re fast enough.
With 30 levels spread across three distinct biomes—Incan and Aztec-inspired ruins, underwater temples, and a desert ruled by forgotten robots—the difficulty builds gradually, combining past mechanics with new threats.
