If you love fast-paced platformers, smart level design, and a good sense of discovery, Steampunch: Lost Tombs is your ticket back into the steam-powered world of the series. The tombs await—are you ready?

70010000102584.name: Temari Trials
70010000102584.description:
Step into the sharp mind (and quick paws) of a samurai cat in training! In Temari Trials, you'll solve logic-based block-pushing puzzles, pushing temaris to unlock chests and prove you're ready for the warrior's path.
With pixel art visuals and grid-based gameplay, it's easy to learn but hard to master. Each level challenges your thinking — and if you make a mistake, don't worry: you can undo as many times as you like. Precision is part of the training!
The game features 30 levels across two charming settings: the calm of a traditional Japanese forest and the disciplined atmosphere of the region's grand Dojo. As you advance, the puzzles become increasingly complex, demanding attention and strategy.
If you love classic puzzle mechanics, cozy environments, and a feline hero perfecting the art of the perfect push, Temari Trials will capture your mind — and your heart.

70010000102589.name: Kawaii Girls: Pretty Mermaid
70010000102589.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000102589.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000102591.name: Kawaii Girls: Rural Romance
70010000102591.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000102591.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000102593.name: Kawaii Girls: Venice Crush
70010000102593.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000102593.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000102595.name: Kawaii Girls: Spicy Scientist
70010000102595.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000102595.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000102597.name: Kawaii Girls: Mighty Mongolian
70010000102597.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000102597.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000102614.name: Sumorbit
70010000102614.intro: A physics based fighting game where planets sumo wrestle. Grab with your moon and bounce with your planet to launch opponents out of the solar system.
70010000102614.description:
Planets sumo wrestle on a variety of maps with hazards like black holes and wormholes.
- Easy to pick up for casual players
- Depth for competitive players

Game Modes
- Local multiplayer (up to 8 players)
- Single player campaign
- Team battles
- Single player vs AI
- Tutorials & practice

Single Player Campaign
Complete a variety of missions from planets gaining sentience to the end of the universe.
- Sumo: Combat with other planets for survival.
- Cargo: Solve puzzles to deliver cargo between planets.
- Cleanup: Destroy all asteroids on the map and use movement to beat goal times.
- Safezone: Survive and save allies from hazards.

Planet Customization
- Select your favourite of the 8 planets
- Modify 8 stat values including speed, range, grip & more
- Over 1 million combinations

70010000102627.name: Rookie Basketball Shoots
70010000102627.intro: Step Up. Lock In. Shoot to Win.
70010000102627.description:
Step up to the free throw line and prove your skills in Rookie Basketball Shoots. Whether you're playing solo against the device or challenging a friend in local multiplayer, it's all about precision, timing, and mastering the court.

Game Modes
– Single Player – Practice your shots or compete against AI opponents in a tense free shoot battle.
– Local Multiplayer (2 Players) – Face off head-to-head and see who can land the most shots under pressure.

Play Across Unique Venues
– Compete in a variety of beautifully designed indoor and outdoor locations – from high school gyms to city courts under the lights.

6 Distinct Basketballs
– Each ball brings its own weight, bounce, and feel. Learn their physics and find your perfect match.

Realistic Physics, Simple Controls
– Easy to pick up, tough to master. Every shot counts.

70010000102648.name: Lil Gator Game: Gator of the Year Edition
70010000102648.intro: The complete Lil Gator adventure, all bundled up in one heartwarming package.
70010000102648.description:
Embark on an adorable adventure, discover new friends and uncover everything the island has to offer.
Climb, Swim, Glide and slide your way into the hearts of the many different characters you meet on your travels!

The island is your playground
There’s a buddy atop every hill in this open-world, movement-focused adventure and they all seem to need help! Bop cardboard baddies, brave serene hills and forests, and scale sheer rocks that only a kid would dare!

Joyful Exporation
Explore a lovingly crafted island full to the brim with areas to discover, friends to make and joy to be had. Each area of the island brings unique quests and characters to meet. Glide through the mountain tops and drop in on the Theatre Troupe kids, swing your stick sword through the forest with the Prep schoolers or find the ‘Cool Kids’ down in the Creaklands. With plenty more areas to discover, there's no knowing who you might run into!

Make Friends
The world is big when you’re a lil gator... Good thing it’s also full of friends! Make new friends and invite them to play in the islands playground. Each new friend you make will add to your adventure, but making new friends isn’t always easy, You might have to complete a quest or two!

Crafty Customization
Collect arts & crafts supplies all over the island! Use them to make yourself all kinds of goodies and bring the playground to life! Craft new abilities - use your ragdoll teddy to ragdoll lil gator from mountain top to the valleys below! Skim pebbles into hard to reach cardboard baddies!

Bop Baddies
A no-pressure adventure game! Lil Gator game focuses on adventure and play, don't let a health bar hold you back from reaching your goal!

Lil Gator Game: In the Dark

Make way for Lil Gator Game: In the Dark. Lil Gator is back with an all new BIG Expansion, doubling the size of Lil Gator Game.

In this charming expansion, you’ll find that new adventures and friends are just beneath the surface—literally! Get ready to “cave in” to the fun and find that you’re stalag-right where you belong!

This BIG adventure is filled to the brim with all the charm and humour you loved in Lil Gator Game. There is a buddy in every cave and crevasse in this NEW, BIG, UNDERGROUND ADVENTURE!

70010000102653.name: Thief Simulator Mastermind Edition
70010000102653.intro: Step into the world of high-stakes burglary in Thief Simulator Mastermind Edition - the ultimate version of the hit stealth sandbox! Now bigger, smarter, and packed with new heists.
70010000102653.description:
Plan your every move and pull off daring thefts across five fully explorable districts, from upscale suburbs to the newly added Agricultural District, where barns hide more than just haystacks. Mansions, safes, luxury cars, and high-end tech - if you can see it, you can steal it!

This enhanced edition nearly doubles the content of the original game and includes the integrated Luxury Houses DLC, bringing new depth and challenge to your criminal career.

New Features & Content:

• Luxury Houses DLC included:
- 4 extravagant new homes with unique architecture and advanced security

• Two new massive maps

• Overhauled and expanded sandbox world - now featuring 5 total districts

• 4 powerful new tools:
- Deciphering Device
- Under-Door Camera
- Keycard Duplicator
- Universal Window Remote

• 3 brand-new luxury vehicles to steal

• New heist missions and loot types

Key Features:
• Explore open-world neighborhoods full of opportunities (and risks)
• Scout your targets, study routines, and plan the perfect break-in
• Buy high-tech burglary tools and develop your thief skills
• Fence your stolen goods on the black market or at the pawn shop
• Take on high-level contracts and side missions with valuable rewards
• Visit new locations like the farm estate and Sunvalley St., where homes introduce fresh tactical challenges.

70010000102658.name: Ad Fundum
70010000102658.intro: Take control of a giant mech and dive into an exciting underground adventure!
70010000102658.description:
Dig deep, collect valuable minerals, upgrade wisely, explore diverse locations, uncover ancient secrets, and try not to explode! Will you save the world or vanish in the depths below?

ABOUT THIS GAME
The Great War is over, and the Age of Diesel has come. While many believe this is an era of harmony and prosperity, you know that peace is more fragile than ever. You embark on a journey into the depths of Earth to find the means to avert future conflict. But what awaits you in the darkness below? Is it a boon or doom for humanity?

Take control of a colossal mech, capable of drilling through hundreds of meters of rock in a matter of seconds. Collect valuable resources, then fly back to your base to sell minerals for immense profit. Keep a close eye on your control panel: in a dangerous environment, your mech may overheat or overcool, and, most importantly, it doesn’t run on air – it needs fuel to operate. And beware of falling stones - your machine's hull won't withstand too much damage.

Rebuild your base
Your base has seen better days, but with enough amount of money you will restore it to its former glory and beyond to enhance your mining performance and unlock special abilities.
Upgrade your gear
Upgrade every part of your mech individually to transform an outdated prototype into a technological marvel. Experiment with different builds to create the ultimate mining machine best suited for your playstyle.

Find hidden secrets
Discover artifacts to unravel the history of the first human civilization on Earth, or search for the remnants of the previous underground expedition to unlock special upgrades with unique effects for your mech.
Explore 8 diverse locations
The deeper you go, the more locations you will discover. Each has its own visual style, atmosphere, gameplay mechanics, and threats to deal with.

Survive earthquakes
The ground you dig does not stand still – it shifts, changing its terrain. An earthquake is a dangerous time to collect resources, but when it’s raining minerals, how can you resist not grabbing some ore?

70010000102663.name: Color Valley: The Lost Balloon Adventure
70010000102663.intro: Lila's balloon has escaped! Help her and her friends find it on a journey filled with games, clues, and lots of friendship.
70010000102663.description:
Lila's golden balloon has flown far away!
Join Lila the Llama and her fun friends on a colorful adventure through whispering forests, singing rivers, and starry skies. This charming visual novel is designed for the little ones in your life, with soft drawings, adorable characters, and storybook-like settings.

Through clues and little surprises, they'll discover that friendship and teamwork are the best parts of the journey.

Features:

· Interactive story designed for young children

· Adorable protagonists like Lila the Llama, Max the Monkey, and Paco the Parrot

· Beautiful illustrations and magical settings

· Adventures with clues, surprises, and lots of heart

· Soft, friendly music accompanies each scene

· Ideal for family reading or before bedtime

· Easy-to-use interface, perfect for first-time video game users

A calm, magical adventure full of smiles... perfect for little ones!

70010000102672.name: Becastled
70010000102672.intro: Build a castle by day and defend it by night. Becastled combines cozy city-building with thrilling tower defense strategy. Lead the Sun Kingdom in its final stand against the Moon beasts!
70010000102672.description:
Build a castle by day and defend it by night. Becastled combines cozy city-building with thrilling tower defense strategy. Lead the Sun Kingdom in its final stand against the Moon beasts and bring an end to the ancient conflict between light and darkness!
Rule over your own fantasy realm. Build a mighty keep, lay roads, gather resources, and grow a thriving settlement that will feed and shelter your people. Keep your subjects happy with taverns and decorations, and your economy strong with markets and workshops — all to support an army ready to fight at your command.
The countdown to war begins at dawn. There's not a moment to waste. Raise walls, station archers on the battlements, and mount ballistas and trebuchets atop your towers. Shape the terrain to your advantage, crafting layered defenses to withstand any assault.
The siege horns blare at sunset. How long will your fortress endure the night?
BUILD A CASTLE BY DAY
Transform a humble village into a thriving medieval city. Build farms and markets to keep your people fed and prosperous, and secure a steady flow of wood and iron. Raise walls and watchtowers, fortify the gates, and prepare your defenses for the siege to come. Adorn the streets with decorations to lift morale before the night falls. Develop a fantasy bastion where life flourishes under the sun!
KEEP YOUR PEOPLE HAPPY
Satisfied subjects work harder and fight with greater courage. Sawmills may sour the air, but lively taverns lift every spirit. Strike the right balance between comfort and function to keep your kingdom strong through each long night.
DEFEND AGAINST A SIEGE AT NIGHT
As daylight fades, the Moon beasts grow bolder. They’ll strike with battering rams, siege towers, and raging dragons. Defy their might with layered walls and iron gates. Rain fire upon them with catapults and disciplined archers. Hold the line until dawn — no matter the cost.
TRAIN AN UNSTOPPABLE ARMY
Forge sturdy weapons and armor to ready your warriors for the siege. Advance from simple infantry to powerful siege engines — mount ballistas and trebuchets atop your towers. Archers, swordsmen, and pikemen will fight to their last breath if trained and equipped well. But if the walls fall, every villager must rise to defend their home.
SHAPE THE LAND TO YOUR ADVANTAGE
Hills, rivers, and forests are your natural defenses. Choose your keep’s location wisely — it can set you on the path to an unbreakable stronghold. But be aware, as seasons change, these allies can betray you. A river may serve as a moat in summer, only to freeze in winter and become a bridge for your enemies. Each season brings unique weather effects that affect both defense and production. To survive the winter, you’ll need to stockpile enough supplies while the sun still shines.
BUILD, DEFEND, EXPAND, REPEAT
A thriving economy powers a stronger army. Expand your domain, claim new lands, and mine precious Sunstone to build and protect your people. But beware — stretch your borders too thin, and you’ll leave your realm exposed.
As your settlement grows, you will push back the forces of the night. But will you have the strength to end the ancient war between the Sunfolk and the creatures of the Moon?

70010000102677.name: Horror Night with Tung Tung Tung Sahur
70010000102677.intro: Tung Tung Tung Tung Tung Tung Tung Tung Tung Sahur
70010000102677.description:
Your car broke down. Middle of the forest. No signal. You spot a creepy mansion up the hill. You knock. No answer. Just as you turn to leave—CREAK—the door opens by itself.

- You step in.
- Bad idea.

Now you’re trapped. No windows open. No doors unlock. But something is inside. And it’s not happy.

From the shadows, you hear it:
- “TUNG. TUNG. TUNG. SAHUR.”

He’s coming. He’s got games. And you’re the main player.

Meet Tung Tung Tung Sahur, a drum-beating nightmare with a twisted sense of fun. He doesn't want to kill you right away—he wants to play. If you want to survive, you’ll need to solve every cursed puzzle, dodge every jumpscare, and outsmart his chaotic friends, including the one and only Tralalero Tralala, who might be your only hope… if he stops spinning in circles for five seconds.

FEATURES:
- Explore a Haunted Mansion full of traps, cursed hallways, and basements.
- Solve Deadly Puzzles before the next round of TUNG TUNG begins.
- Snap Creepy Photos to reveal secrets
- Use a Pistol to slow Tung Tung down when he gets too close for comfort.

Survive Brainrot Mayhem featuring a cast of cursed icons like Ballerina Cappuccina, Tralalero Tralala, and the caffeinated specter known as Assassino Cappuccino

There’s only one rule in this mansion: Play the game, or the game plays you.

And remember…

TUNG.
TUNG.
TUNG. SAHUR.

You knocked. Now you’re stuck.

Good luck.

70010000102689.name: Where is the Culprit?
70010000102689.intro:
Find the hidden character in the illustration!
A timed picture puzzle game that sharpens your eyes and challenges your brain
70010000102689.description:
Train your eyes and mind as you search for a specific person hidden in a lively city scene!
This fun and fast-paced picture puzzle game offers a great way to boost your focus and visual skills.

How to play is simple：
・Take a close look at the character indicated by the arrow in the question image
・Search for that person in the busy illustration
・Once you’ve found them, tap the spot before time runs out!

It might seem easy when you’re not in a rush...
but the countdown adds an extra layer of challenge!

Stuck?
Tap the hint button for a clue about where the character is hiding!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000102702.name: Wheretheskyis
70010000102702.description:
Soft and impressive characters expand the world view of the sky.

□STORY
The girl's name is Shuri.
The people of the sky live in the world of the sky.
She can fly freely.
Liefael, the god of grace who will give you eternal blessings if you meet him.
Shuri searches for Leafael in order to fill the world with happiness.
"If you meet the King of the Sky, he will tell you something, won't he?"
Shuri heard that from her sister.
Shuri made her way to the sanctuary of the sky.
A sanctuary in the sky where a cataclysmic wind blows.
Will Shuri be able to meet the King of the Sky?

□GAME
- Easy operation, simple jumping and flying
- Ability to create a foothold in front of you, create
- Scramble experience riding or being disturbed by the blowing wind
- Unbelievable on top of the dragons in the sky
- Freely move through the sky world with your control and Shuri's power
- A gentle world that immediately revives even if it falls under the sky
- Control Shuri and go out to play in the best sky!

□SOUND
High-quality background music of a quiet piano flowing leisurely in the world of the sky
Quietness and serenity to provide a calming gaming experience

70010000102716.name: Kotenok
70010000102716.intro: Pounce with precision as a pixel art kitty in retro platforming style!
70010000102716.description:
Play as a lost kitten in a dangerous forest! Master tight platforming controls, sprint, pounce, and double-jump through 50 tricky stages filled with spikes, enemies, and clever puzzles.

Explore vibrant pixel-art worlds, bounce on mushrooms, outsmart foes, and hunt for hidden collectibles. Can you guide this frisky feline home? A charming love letter to classic platformers!

• Help a lost cat survive the perils of the forest!
• Run, leap and double-jump your way across 50 stages.
• Avoid traps and pounce on enemies!
• Push crates and use stage gimmicks to reach higher platforms.
• Enjoy colorful pixel art aesthetics and a retro soundtrack!

70010000102721.name: Yatsuakari
70010000102721.intro: Light the candles and find your way out of this place.
70010000102721.description:
There is only one rule:
Light all eight candles.

Explore a maze-like area and find all eight candles to light them.

Each time you return to the title screen, the candle locations will be randomized, offering a new challenge.

This game contains horror elements and jump scares.
Some events require audio cues, playing with speakers or headphones is recommended.

70010000102736.name: Hashire HEBEREKE: EX
70010000102736.intro: Hashire HEBEREKE: EX is a modern remake of the 1994 Hashire HEBEREKE by SUNSOFT.
70010000102736.description:
Players can choose from a cast of quirky and adorable characters to race through item-filled, obstacle-packed courses. Local multiplayer supports up to 4 players, while online multiplayer supports up to 8 players, ensuring fun and frantic competition.

■ Story: The story unfolds differently depending on the character you choose. Defeat all opponents across 10 stages to clear the game.
※ Even if you lose, don’t be discouraged—you can always try again.

■ Battle Run: Enjoy competitive races with 1 to 4 players by splitting the screen into 1 or 4 sections. The player who reaches the finish line first wins.

■ Time Attack: A single-player mode where the goal is to reach the finish line as quickly as possible. Challenge your limits by breaking your own records. You can also race against a ghost of your previous record to motivate yourself to improve.

■ Engacho (Chasing game): The character with the "poop" on their head becomes the chaser. You win by chasing down and touching other players. Supports 1 to 4 players.

■ Online Battle: Up to 8 players can enjoy either “Battle Run” or “Pofun Battle” together. Each game room can hold up to 8 players, and stages are chosen at random.

■ Rhythm Game: Hit the corresponding inputs for each colored Pofun as they align with the judgment line. Depending on your accuracy, the text, effects, and character reactions will change. Combos and accuracy are displayed on the screen, and Fever Mode triggers special effects. Enjoy the rhythm game with colorful and exciting music!

■ High Scoreboard: A mode where you can check players’ top scores in ranking order.

■ Game Settings: Choose the language and screen mode, adjust sound volume and control style. You can also enable shadow silhouettes when objects obscure characters, or turn on vibration feedback.

70010000102741.name: Grill it! Sanma
70010000102741.intro:
When it comes to fall flavors, sanma is a must!
Fan the flames and grill up some delicious fish!
70010000102741.description:
Experience the fun of grilling sanma on Nintendo Switch™!
Grill them to perfection, but be careful not to let them burn!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in the fun!
Grill with skill and aim for a new high score!

《Rules》
Fan the flames and grill the sanma!
Be sure to cook both sides thoroughly, then pack the sanma up!
Don't forget to swap out the grill net and grate a supply of daikon radish!
See how many sanma you can cook before time runs out!

《How to Play》
1. Place the sanma on the grill!

2. Move the cursor and fan the flames!

3. When one side is done, flip it over and grill the other!

4. When both sides are done, pack it up!
* Grill each part perfectly to earn more points!

[Score Attack]
Aim for a top spot on the global leaderboards!
Grill quickly and precisely to earn the highest score!

[Battle]
Test your skills in battles with up to 4 players!
Grilling quickly and precisely is the key to victory!

70010000102746.name: Prison Life Sim 2025 - Survival
70010000102746.intro: Adapt, fight, and outsmart rivals to earn respect behind bars.
70010000102746.description:
Immerse yourself in the harsh reality of prison life in Prison Life Sim 2025 - Survival, a gripping simulator where every decision can be the key to survival. In this world of strict rules, hidden threats, and unexpected opportunities, you must not only adapt to life behind bars but also find your own path to freedom.

Key Features:
-Realistic first-person perspective – experience prison life firsthand, control the camera, observe your surroundings, and interact with objects.
-Inventory and resource management system – collect, store, and use essential items to survive and complete tasks.
-Dialogue and quest system – interact with inmates and guards, choose whom to trust, and decide which missions to take on.
-Stealth and sneaking mechanics – avoid guard attention, sneak into restricted areas, and find ways to acquire contraband.
-Combat system and fights – engage in prison brawls, defend yourself, and earn respect through strength.
-Mini-games and tournaments – test your skills in various activities, compete in tournaments, and earn rewards.
-Object interactions – arrange books, move boxes, search for hidden documents, and complete assignments to stay out of solitary confinement.
-Stamina and health system – manage endurance and health levels, as exhaustion and injuries can have serious consequences.
-Punishment system – break the rules carefully, or face solitary confinement, stricter conditions, and loss of privileges.

Will you survive, find your place in this brutal system, and perhaps even escape? Your choices will determine your fate in Prison Life Sim 2025 - Survival.

70010000102777.name: BooBooBooster
70010000102777.intro: Fly with Farts! Defeat 'em with Farts! An Exhilarating Action Shooter!
70010000102777.description:
Get ready for an innovative side-scrolling action shooter where you fly through the air powered by farts and take down enemies!

The controls are super simple, with just two buttons that combine attack and jump. This creates an intuitive yet addictive gameplay experience. Don't let the cute, poppy visuals fool you—this game offers a surprisingly tough challenge.

Across 25 stages, you'll face a formidable "Butt Army" and tons of clever environmental puzzles. You might need to try, try again to clear each one!

Each stage also features three missions. Completing them earns you points to power up your player, so aim to conquer all missions and clear every stage!

And for all you speedrunners out there, we've included Real-Time Attack (RTA) elements! We're looking forward to your heated challenges to achieve the fastest clear times!

70010000102782.name: WEB FISHING – Relax and Fish
70010000102782.intro: Cast your line and enjoy peaceful fishing adventures.
70010000102782.description:
WEB FISHING – Relax and Fish lets you escape into a serene and immersive fishing experience. Discover the joy of casting your line in beautiful waters while enjoying a relaxing, stress-free environment. Explore diverse locations, encounter a variety of fish species, and upgrade your gear as you progress. Whether you’re seeking a quiet moment of relaxation or the thrill of landing a rare catch, every fishing trip offers new surprises and challenges to enjoy.

	•	Relax and Explore: Travel through diverse and scenic fishing spots, from peaceful lakes and flowing rivers to hidden ponds and coastal shores. Each location offers unique challenges, surprises, and opportunities to catch rare fish.
	•	Catch and Upgrade: Hook a wide variety of fish species, earn rewards, and improve your fishing gear. Upgrade rods, reels, and equipment to increase your chances of landing bigger and rarer catches.
	•	Challenge Yourself: Take part in daily quests, timed challenges, and special events to test your angling skills. Track your progress, aim for record-breaking catches, and unlock achievements along the way.

Cast your line, enjoy the calming waters, and become the ultimate master angler!

70010000102787.name: Wukong Black Legend
70010000102787.intro: Face the unknown, fight with courage, and uncover hidden secrets.
70010000102787.description:
Step into a world full of mysteries, dangers, and challenges — only the brave will make it to the end. This action-adventure game blends intense combat with clever exploration, delivering a captivating experience at every level.

Main Features:
- Dynamic Combat: Wield your sword for close-range attacks or use your bow for precise long-distance shots; every battle demands strategy and quick reflexes.
- Projectile Capture: Catch incoming arrows and fireballs from enemies and turn them to your advantage — transform defense into offense.
- Exploration & Rewards: Discover hidden chests, resources, and vital clues scattered across the maps.
- Clues & Puzzles: Each level contains subtle hints and smart puzzles; attention to detail is the key to progress.

Every step brings you closer to the secrets hidden in the shadows. Are you ready to prove your courage, unravel the mysteries, and become a legend? The adventure starts now!

70010000102797.name: SEA POWER NAVAL BATTLE COMBAT
70010000102797.intro: Build your fleet, face your rivals, survive the battle.
70010000102797.description:
Command your fleet and dominate the high seas in SEA POWER NAVAL BATTLE COMBAT. Engage in intense naval warfare where strategy, precision, and firepower decide victory. Upgrade your ships, customize your fleet, and unleash devastating attacks against enemy vessels. Navigate treacherous waters, outmaneuver opponents, and prove your skills in epic sea battles.

Game Features:
- Command a variety of warships, from destroyers to aircraft carriers
- Engage in realistic naval combat with strategic depth
- Upgrade weapons, armor, and fleet capabilities
- Explore dynamic ocean environments and tactical battlefields

Will your fleet rise to supremacy, or will the waves claim your ships?

70010000102803.name: Hentai Photo: Kaneshon
70010000102803.intro: We will collect all the details and reveal the most interesting secrets!
70010000102803.description:
Welcome to Hentai Photo: Kaneshon, a classic puzzle game where you unlock vivid and sensual illustrations step by step! The game focuses on attractive girls in glamorous and daring outfits. They are all ready to charm you with their looks.

All images are created with love for the smallest details, and their expressive poses, stylish outfits and bright emotions give each illustration a special atmosphere. The realistic assembly mechanics will make you feel like you are assembling a real paper puzzle. Relaxing music will help you to fully immerse yourself in the game.

Game Features:
- 40+ passionate puzzles featuring seductive anime girls
- High-quality and sensual illustrations
- Realistic assembly process with smooth animations
- Atmospheric music accompaniment
- Ability to view collected images in detail

70010000102815.name: Street Racer Collection (QUByte Classics)
70010000102815.intro: Run, fight, and win! Speed and brawls on crazy tracks! A classic that mixes racing and fighting, bringing back chaotic battles and irreverent humor for up to 4 players!
70010000102815.description:
Combining the speed of an arcade racer with the brawling of a fighting game, this cult classic made its mark with its originality and its own dose of chaos and personality. 
Race on tracks filled with obstacles and crazy settings (from Mount Rushmore to Transylvania), use special moves to knock out your rivals, and explore modes that go far beyond traditional racing.
Get ready to laugh, crash, accelerate, and fight for every corner.
Street Racer Collection is pure arcade fun, straight from the past to your screen.
–
4 game modes
Practice: train before competing for real.
Head-to-Head: race against a single opponent on a track of your choice.
Championship: create your own competitions by combining tracks and difficulty levels.
Rumble Mode: knock your opponents out of the arena!
Soccer Mode: play soccer... with race cars! (not available in the MS-DOS version)
–
What you'll find
4 games in 1: the collection includes the Super NES™, Megadrive, MS-DOS, and Game Boy™ versions of the game.
Up to 27 unique tracks full of shortcuts, traps, and challenges
8 cartoon characters with crazy vehicles and special attacks
Varied racing options: from a quick lap to 80-lap marathons!
Local multiplayer for up to 4 players (on Super NES™, Megadrive, and MS-DOS versions)
–
Why play Street Racer Collection?
A true cult classic, remembered to this day for its creativity and boldness
Unique and pioneering mix of kart racing + combat
Guaranteed fun in both solo and local multiplayer modes
A piece of video game history, preserved in its original form and experience
Get ready to laugh, crash, accelerate, and fight for every corner.
Street Racer Collection is pure arcade fun, straight from the past to your screen.

70010000102820.name: Soulbind: Tales Of The Underworld
70010000102820.intro: Enter this procedural world, battle foes, and find monster parts for abilities!
70010000102820.description:
Bind souls and create your own monster!

The souls of Allaar are waiting!
You will embark on an epic journey into a procedurally generated world where you will explore a variety of locations full of monsters and traps. You have to collect body parts of the various monsters, and the rarity system will affect the generation of stats and passive effects. Each collected body part provides new abilities and capabilities, changing battle tactics.

Choose your path!
Of course, it’s your skills as a player that matter most: dashes, double jumps and weapon mastery will help you defeat your opponents. But the enemies will become stronger, so have time to loot the body parts to strengthen the hero. More than 50 different body parts of different rarity and leveling system with mutations will help you strengthen the hero in the right way: grow a “tank”, develop him as a “glass cannon”, focus on melee combat or magic, enhance the effects of passive skills.

Death is not the end
In the world of Allaar, if you die, you will lose almost everything you had. But death doesn't mean the end of the game. You can find “Ink Tables” at the locations, they allow you to save several body parts for future runs. Choose wisely which body part you want to save for your next run.

The binding of Souls is never forgotten, it's forever!
In the world of Allaar, all the talents that make life easier can be purchased for the local currency “Shards of souls”. Do not forget to buy talents, they will remain after death, but you'll lost “Shards”.

Are you ready to accept the challenge and unravel the mysteries of "Soulbind: Tales Of The Underworld"? Embark on this exciting journey and show your strength, skill and ability to overcome any obstacles.

70010000102882.name: The Good Old Days
70010000102882.description:
Re-Live The Good Old Days!

Delve into a nostalgic metroidvania-style adventure. Explore creepy underground caverns, rescue your friends, and unlock new abilities and pathways. 

Encounter a changing cast of characters and retro pop culture references as you face fearsome challenges. Enter a lost world of lovingly-crafted pixel graphics reminiscent of classic 80's adventure films. 

Shape your own story, replaying to uncover multiple endings with the game's unique circular story structure.

70010000102884.name: Blaze of Storm
70010000102884.description:
Blaze of Storm is a vertical-scrolling shmup featuring cyber-inspired pixel art, exhilarating fast-scrolling, and a variety of sub-weapons.

As a cyberdiver, you'll delve into cyberspace and battle a diverse range of enemies. Each of the five selectable sub-weapons has its own unique characteristics, making it fun to use them appropriately depending on the situation.

In addition, when a sub-weapon comes into contact with an enemy, it generates an explosion that deals continuous damage. Making good use of this explosion is key to victory.

More than 20 unique bosses appear one after another, providing a varied and condensed gameplay experience.

70010000102892.name: Double Dragon Revive Digital Artworks
70010000102892.description:
Double Dragon Revive Digital Artworks includes the "ARTBOOK," which lets you view concept art and other illustrations from Double Dragon Revive, as well as the "SOUNDTRACK" featuring all 28 music tracks.

*Double Dragon Revive Digital Artworks is a separate application from the main game.

70010000102920.name: Mad Games Tycoon 2
70010000102920.intro: From a studio in the garage to a gaming empire
70010000102920.description:
Make video games history!
Start in a tiny office in 1976, program pixelated dreams on clunky computers, and experience up close how audacious ideas become legendary blockbusters. Form visionary teams, survive flops and risk everything for the next big hit; the future of the industry is in your hands. Are you up to the task?

• Build your studio – from a modest space to a state-of-the-art office complex with server farms and motion-capture studios
• Recruit the best brains in the industry – hire brilliant developers, experienced producers, and talented designers
• Revolutionize the market – design the next-gen console that will change the gaming world forever
• Set new standards – develop groundbreaking titles that will be talked about for decades to come
• Become an industry giant – sell licenses, buy studios and dominate the global gaming market

70010000102976.name: My Cozy Aquarium
70010000102976.intro: Build your dream tank and fill it with finned friends!
70010000102976.description:
Feed your finned pals, polish their glassy castle, and keep the waters sparkling—because happy fish = happy you! Collect 300+ quirky swimmers, unlock magical tanks, play cozy mini‑games, and decorate your perfect underwater paradise.


Purchase surprise packs filled with delightful fish companions and nurture them through immersive, relaxing mini-games. Feed your fish with care, maintain the perfect water temperature, clean the air filters to ensure healthy conditions, and gently scrub aquarium walls to keep your aquatic heaven crystal clear.

As your fish grow, you'll experience the joy of raising them from tiny swimmers into magnificent adults. Sell your matured fish to earn coins, enabling you to expand your underwater paradise further.

Discover and collect over 320 beautifully quirky fish species – each with charming and whimsical designs. Enhance your aquariums with vibrant decorations and upgraded fish food, unlocking even more cozy, aesthetic possibilities.

Each out of the four tanks will offer different fish packages, inspired by real life fish but with a magical twist on them. 
Start with one tank, then unlock wild and wacky aquariums packed with magical fish and quirky surprises. Decorate, upgrade, and try not to laugh when your fish act like they own the place.


KEY FEATURES: 
- Four themed aquariums full of charm and fishy chaos.
- Relaxing mini-games with a silly twist.
- Over 320 fish to collect—some cuter, some weirder, all awesome.
- Tons of decorations to splash your style across the tank.
- Cozy idle gameplay where even cleaning feels fun.

70010000102981.name: Hentai Photo: Ajisai
70010000102981.intro: We will collect all the details and reveal the most interesting secrets!
70010000102981.description:
Welcome to Hentai Photo: Ajisai, a classic puzzle game where you unlock vivid and sensual illustrations step by step! The game focuses on attractive girls in glamorous and daring outfits. They are all ready to charm you with their looks.

All images are created with love for the smallest details, and their expressive poses, stylish outfits and bright emotions give each illustration a special atmosphere. The realistic assembly mechanics will make you feel like you are assembling a real paper puzzle. Relaxing music will help you to fully immerse yourself in the game.

Game Features:
- 40+ passionate puzzles featuring seductive anime girls
- High-quality and sensual illustrations
- Realistic assembly process with smooth animations
- Atmospheric music accompaniment
- Ability to view collected images in detail

70010000102995.name: Hentai Photo: Kuchinashi
70010000102995.intro: We will collect all the details and reveal the most interesting secrets!
70010000102995.description:
Welcome to Hentai Photo: Kuchinashi, a classic puzzle game where you unlock vivid and sensual illustrations step by step! The game focuses on attractive girls in glamorous and daring outfits. They are all ready to charm you with their looks.

All images are created with love for the smallest details, and their expressive poses, stylish outfits and bright emotions give each illustration a special atmosphere. The realistic assembly mechanics will make you feel like you are assembling a real paper puzzle. Relaxing music will help you to fully immerse yourself in the game.

Game Features:
- 40+ passionate puzzles featuring seductive anime girls
- High-quality and sensual illustrations
- Realistic assembly process with smooth animations
- Atmospheric music accompaniment
- Ability to view collected images in detail

70010000103001.name: The Beast and the Princess
70010000103001.intro: "The Beast and the Princess" is a tower defense game where you battle it out by stringing together combos!
70010000103001.description:
Call upon plushie soldiers to sweep your enemies aside, and unleash ultimate moves to power through any pinch!

Story:
One day, two princess twins found themselves suddenly trapped inside a game.
The way out? Beat the game.
In their path stand great foes, alongside a mysterious in-game voice.

Why did the twin princesses get trapped here?
Whoever's behind the mysterious voice, what are they plotting? And the ultimate question - do you have what it takes to reach the end of this thrilling story!

Combos:
By stringing together ultimate moves, your attack power builds up, incentivizing well-timed combos!

Skills:
Every skill on its own is very powerful.
Buff your favorite units and enter combat with your own unique super team!

70010000103006.name: Pinedrop Vale
70010000103006.description:
Step into the quiet world of Pinedrop Vale, a peaceful forest nestled between the mountains and the mist. As a curious traveler, you explore the gentle wilderness—wandering through pine-covered trails, mossy ruins, and forgotten cabins—each with its own hidden charm.

No rush. No danger. Just the joy of discovering a world steeped in calm mystery. Search for tucked-away pathways and piece together the story of a long-lost valley whispered through falling leaves and quiet streams.

Features
~Explore a tranquil, pine-covered forest
~Discover hidden cabins, ruins, and forest landmarks
~Find secret trails and cozy tucked-away spots
~Let curiosity guide you—no map, no markers, just the world
~Slow down and immerse yourself in the peaceful atmosphere

70010000103009.name: This is Fine: Maximum Cope
70010000103009.description:
The world-famous meme becomes a metroidvania of mental mayhem.

Play as Question Hound and enter a collapsing theme park built from anxiety, regret, and surreal humor. Run, jump, fight, and caffeinate your way through five emotional worlds where everyday fears come to life. You will face flying textbooks, toilet monsters, and ghostly memories you thought were long gone.

Explore branching paths, unlock new abilities, and revisit earlier areas to discover new secrets. Each world features a unique boss that embodies humiliation, fear, failure, loss, or regret. Learn to cope, one ability at a time.

Stop at Rest Points to save your progress, refill your healing coffee cup, and enjoy a brief moment of calm. Collect Coffee Beans to unlock perks and survive just a little longer in a world that feels like it’s on fire. There are 28 collectibles to find and 27 perks to equip.

Based on KC Green’s iconic comic, This Is Fine: Maximum Cope is a hand-animated platforming adventure that blends absurd comedy with emotional chaos. Whether you are a fan of action games or just here for the dog, this is a journey worth taking.

Features
- 5 surreal worlds of Humiliation, Fear, Failure, Loss, and Regret.
- 6 bosses to conquer, 6 abilities to master
- 28 quirky collectibles to find
- 27 perks to unlock and equip

70010000103011.name: Arcadia Fallen II
70010000103011.intro: Choose from three different magical disciplines, and let your choices shape the personality of your character as you navigate school life during a time of great change
70010000103011.description:
Seven years after the dramatic events in Anemone Valley, the political situation surrounding magic has reached boiling point within the Empire. At the Seven Winds Academy, however, life goes on undisturbed by outside influences. Here, the students’ biggest worries are exams, job prospects, and who might be taking whom to the New Year’s Gala, but when a curious group of seniors stumble upon a secret hidden within the castle, their priorities for the year change in an instant…

Explore a brand new adventure as a mage student of the Seven Winds Academy and experience a story that can be enjoyed by new and returning players of the series. Choose from three different magical disciplines, and let your choices shape the personality of your character as you navigate school life during a time of great change.

As you uncover the story of Arcadia Fallen II, you will decide how you respond to the people around you and the events that unfold. Tone labels help you avoid unexpected consequences, and choices with significant impact on the story are highlighted. But no matter what you decide to do, there are no “wrong” choices and no dead ends. Only you can find the path that is right for you.

Your chosen magical discipline will affect your character's upbringing, what locations they are familiar with, and what skills they bring to the team. This and more will influence puzzles throughout the game and challenge you in different ways depending on the choices you make in each playthrough.

No true boarding school experience is complete without a bit of rule-breaking! Sneak out at night with your friends and discover the secrets the old castle holds. If you’re daring, you might pick up some juicy gossip as well.

70010000103016.name: Anime Girl Kawaii High School Dress UP
70010000103016.intro:
Create. Style. Shine.
Design the cutest anime looks with endless outfits and accessories.
70010000103016.description:
Step into the charming world of Anime Girl Kawaii High School Dress Up, where fashion meets creativity! Customize your adorable anime character with a huge variety of stylish outfits, cute accessories, trendy hairstyles, and colorful makeup looks.

Mix and match school uniforms, casual wear, and fantasy costumes to create endless unique styles. Explore different backgrounds, from cozy classrooms to vibrant school festivals, and bring your fashion story to life.

Whether you’re designing a sweet and innocent look or a bold and fashionable statement, this game is all about expressing your style and imagination. Create stunning kawaii outfits and enjoy showing off your unique fashion sense!

Features:

Hundreds of outfits, hairstyles, and accessories to choose from

Multiple backgrounds and scenes for your fashion creations

Easy-to-use dress-up gameplay for all ages

Endless fashion combinations to explore

70010000103025.name: Pro Virtual Racing
70010000103025.intro: Real cars. Real physics. Unreal thrill.
70010000103025.description:
Experience the thrill of motorsport like never before in Pro Virtual Racing, a high-performance racing simulator featuring ultra-realistic physics and dynamic environments.

Choose between Easy Mode for a more accessible experience or Simulation Mode for an authentic, precision-based challenge. Select from 11 distinct vehicles, including agile buggies and powerful Formula One machines, each with unique handling and performance.

Race on a variety of circuits across changing weather conditions—rain, snow, night, and more—all designed to test your skill and adaptability.

Features:
– Two game modes: Easy and Simulation
– 11 unique vehicles, from buggies to Formula One
– Multiple tracks with dynamic weather and lighting conditions
– Realistic driving physics for immersive gameplay

Pro Virtual Racing is your gateway to the ultimate driving challenge. Adapt, compete, and master every track.

70010000103065.name: Cats Ritual
70010000103065.intro: Lights out - cats out! Catch them before it's too late!
70010000103065.description:
Welcome to "Cats Ritual"
a captivating indie adventure where you must navigate a decaying city to gather 30 elusive cats and save an eccentric NPC from the clutches of ancient cat spirits. As you explore the hidden corners of this forsaken urban landscape—alleys, abandoned lots, and shadowy rooftops—you'll uncover the secrets behind the Eternal Ritual, a sacred dance that keeps the malevolent cat spirits at bay.

Key Features:
- Exploration: Roam through diverse locations such as derelict buildings, shadowy alleys, and forgotten parks, each hiding its own mysteries and dangers.

- Collection: Find and collect 30 unique cats, each with their own personality and story, essential for completing the ritual.

- Puzzle-Solving: Overcome clever puzzles and challenges that stand between you and the cats, testing your wit and agility.

- Character Interactions: Meet a variety of peculiar characters, from the agitated NPC to other city dwellers, who may aid or obstruct your quest.

"Cats Ritual" blends exploration, collection, and narrative depth into a unique gaming experience. With its whimsical yet thrilling tone, the game offers a journey into a city forgotten by time, where every meow could be your salvation—or your doom. Will you succeed in your quest and restore balance to the city, or will you fall victim to the eternal regret?

70010000103073.name: Picture the Difference!2
70010000103073.intro:
Even Cuter, Even Smarter!
A Brain-Training Puzzle Game to Boost Your Thinking Power
70010000103073.description:
A Brain-Boosting Spot-the-Difference Game with Cute Illustrations!

Can you find the one small mistake hidden in each adorable picture before time runs out?
This fun and simple brain-training game will test your observation and quick thinking!

How to play is super easy:

Look carefully at the image on the top of the screen.

Compare it with the one below to spot the difference.

Found it? Just tap the spot!

It might seem easy at first...
But with the timer ticking, even small differences can be tricky to catch!
Perfect for quick play sessions or a fun way to pass the time.

If you’re really stuck, there’s a hint button 
It'll quietly give you a clue about where to look (just don’t tell anyone).

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000103115.name: Car Parking - Garage Simulator
70010000103115.intro: More than parking—this garage is your world!
70010000103115.description:
Car Parking - Garage Simulator is the perfect place for all car enthusiasts, speed lovers, and precision drivers! In this game, you’ll experience a variety of modes, from extreme drifting and street races to calm yet challenging parking in the toughest conditions. You’ll get to drive powerful supercars and have the opportunity to customize them in any way you desire. Tuning, choosing your favorite colors, and modifying performance levels are just a few of the options you can explore to create your dream car.

Key Features:
-Luxury Supercars: Drive the fastest and most spectacular supercars available on the market! From high-performance classic cars to futuristic models, each vehicle in the game is crafted with incredible attention to detail.
-Varied Modes: From extreme drifting and street races to complicated parking challenges, each task is a test of your driving skills.
-Advanced Customization: Every car can be fully customized to suit your preferences! Choose from a wide range of colors, add new tuning parts to enhance performance, or change the aesthetic of your vehicle.
-Endless Choices: Whether you want to relax with precise parking, test your skills in dramatic drifts, or explore a vast city, the options are all at your fingertips!

Get ready for an unforgettable experience, where every maneuver counts!

70010000103137.name: Boned Again: Survivors
70010000103137.intro: This game throws you into a brutal arena where endless hordes rise and only raw skill keeps you alive.
70010000103137.description: Choose from a wide variety of active and passive abilities, level them up, and adapt your build on the fly. Survive waves of enemies, defeat unique bosses, earn gold, and unlock new deadly arenas. Each run is different – each decision, crucial. Can you survive?

70010000103142.name: Michelangelo: Stonemason Simulator
70010000103142.intro: Shape stones into masterpieces as Michelangelo.
70010000103142.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of the Renaissance around 1495 and shape stone blocks into masterpieces as Michelangelo. Chisel stone, collect XP and unlock skills. No stress, no hectic - just you and the stone.

Look forward to a relaxing evening.

Meet Leonardo da Vinci's sister Isabella and her cute cat Gnocchi, chisel your way through eight missions and live up to the name Michelangelo!

We wish you lots of fun!
Three River Games (3RG)

70010000103147.name: Super Long Cat
70010000103147.intro: Crazy puzzles, cute kittens and a really long tail!
70010000103147.description:
Meet the cat who loves milk… and with every sip he gets longer and longer! Mommy Cat asks you to return the lost kittens home, which means you have to use your unusual talent to get through tricky puzzles, jump over traps and reach the most unexpected corners of the levels.

Collect milk, become longer and help Daddy Cat reunite the whole furry family. Meow!

Game features:

- Unique "stretching cat" mechanics

- Hand-made puzzles with unexpected solutions

- Charming pixel graphics

- Lots of milk, a little madness and a ton of purring

- Atmospheric soundtrack that emphasizes the spirit of adventure

Can you collect all the kittens?

70010000103152.name: Star Ores Inc.
70010000103152.intro: Take over an abandoned space station and manage your own ore mine. Carve through the asteroid with your laser, sell ore, and build an automated network of robot helpers.
70010000103152.description:
Star Ores Inc. is an intergalactic mining adventure that catapults you onto an abandoned space station in the middle of the cosmos. As a newly-minted entrepreneur, you start your career in a world full of ore, machines, and galactic possibilities.

Dig through massive asteroids and mine rare minerals, which you refine into valuable high-tech products. With the help of specialized robots, conveyor systems, and automated setups, you build an efficient production chain - from raw extraction to sales.

But that's just the beginning:
- Explore hidden sectors, reactivate old terminals, and upgrade your laser to uncover even deeper treasures. Alien biomass is waiting to be cleared away by you.
- Customers from all corners of the galaxy flock to your station to buy your products.
- Activate the station, perfect your processes, and become a legend of space mining.

Launch your career with Star Ores Inc. now.

70010000103172.name: Death Frame
70010000103172.intro: Explore a haunted mansion, uncover a killer’s madness, and enter surreal paintings in this chilling horror adventure.
70010000103172.description:
Death Frame is a psychological horror experience where reality fractures with every step. You play as the estranged child of a notorious serial killer, returning to the mansion you’ve inherited after years of silence. Within its rotting walls, you uncover paintings that pull you into fragmented memories and surreal dreamscapes—each revealing a piece of your father's madness, his victims, and maybe… your own bloodstained legacy.
As you explore the decaying estate, you'll find three disturbing diaries: a cold list of victims, the terrified final words of a captive, and the spiraling thoughts of a mind consumed by madness. Each reveals a new layer of the truth.
But something still lingers in the house.
Something watching.
Waiting.

70010000103174.name: Lila Colorful
70010000103174.intro: When the imagination comes to life, only the heart can trace the way back
70010000103174.description:
Lila Colorful is a little girl with a passion for painting who discovers a magic paintbrush capable of bringing to life everything she draws. 

What begins as a dream comes true turns into colorful chaos when her creations escape and transform her town into a world full of living art. 

With the help of Azul, a little watercolor dragon, Lila must learn to control her magic and use it responsibly to restore balance. 


A story about imagination, creative power and the value of knowing oneself.

70010000103181.name: Fast Food Tycoon Simulator
70010000103181.description:
Flip burgers, chase dreams, and try not to burn the fries—Fast Food Tycoon Simulator puts you behind the counter of your very own fast-food joint. Start with a grill, a dream, and maybe some questionable lettuce, and grow your way into a local legend.

Upgrade your kitchen, fine-tune your menu, and turn every order into a delicious opportunity. Keep your customers fed, your staff on their toes, and your floors free of ketchup spills (well, mostly). Whether you're serving late-night snacks or lunchtime rushes, it's all about speed, flavor, and charm.

Expand your space, decorate like a pro, and build a burger empire one perfectly toasted bun at a time. Just don’t forget to clean the fryer. Nobody likes soggy fries.

70010000103186.name: Laundry Boss Simulator
70010000103186.description:
Laundry Boss Simulator puts you in charge of a humble laundromat with big potential—and even bigger piles of dirty socks. Start with a single washer and a whole lot of ambition as you wash, dry, fold, and hustle your way to laundry greatness.

Upgrade your machines, hire a helpful crew, and design a space so fresh even your clothes will breathe a sigh of relief. Offer extra services, stock up on detergents, and keep your customers smiling (and stain-free). Feeling creative? Customize t-shirts and let your fashion sense spin alongside the dryers.

From lost socks to loyal customers, you’ll find that the road to becoming a laundry tycoon is sudsy, satisfying, and full of surprises. After all, success smells a lot like fabric softener and victory.

70010000103191.name: Hop 'n' Marty
70010000103191.description:
Hop 'n' Marty is a retro 3D platformer for the modern age.

Journey through sprawling worlds, from the house of a giant to the desolate streets of a classic horror game.
Find all of the different collectables and meet the eccentric inhabitants of the each world. Some may even help you on your quest.
Rescue the captured pygmies who have been trapped in cages and bring them back to safety.
Each world in Hop 'n' Marty offers an entirely new style and new challenges to overcome, so there really is something for everyone.

Meet Hop and Marty
You play as Marty, the white-tufted marmoset, and his pet, roommate, and general life advisor, Hop, the poison dart frog. On most days they can be found relaxing at home in the rainforest, but today is different. The pygmy marmosets have all been kidnapped by the heartless Captain Hookbeak. What he plans to do with them is not known, but it surely can't be good. Marty wastes no time in springing to action to return the pygmies home and put a stop to Hookbeak's plan. Hop is slightly more reluctant to get out of bed but still goes with him.

A return to the platformer golden age
Inspired by the classic 3D platformers from the 90s, Hop 'n' Marty evokes the feeling of childlike joy that came with that era of gaming, both through its visuals and gameplay. The art of Hop 'n' Marty was made to the same specifications as classic 3D games and is rendered using the same resolution and lighting of that era. The gameplay pays homage to all the best 3D platformers that came before, as well as other classic games of other genres as a love letter to the era that got many people into gaming.

A colourful cast of characters
Hop and Marty are not the only characters you'll meet. Every world has characters to discover, bursting with personality and charm. These NPCs can be spoken to and may even give you quests. With humorous and often sarcastic dialogue from our heroes and classic voice-mumble sound effects, every NPC is worth talking to and getting to know.

70010000103198.name: Bunkers 1944 FPS
70010000103198.description:
Step into the shadows of war.
In Bunkers 1944 FPS, you are an elite soldier dropped deep behind enemy lines. Your mission: infiltrate a complex network of labyrinthine bunkers, neutralize enemy troops, and sabotage their vital ammunition supplies before they reach the front lines.

Armed with an arsenal of powerful weapons—from reliable rifles and submachine guns to devastating grenades—you’ll need precision, speed, and strategy to survive the brutal corridors of World War II’s most dangerous outposts.

Key Features:
– Intense first-person combat in close-quarter bunker environments
– A variety of authentic WWII-era firearms and explosives
– Smart enemy AI that reacts and hunts you down
– Maze-like level design that rewards exploration and tactical movement
– Realistic audio and gritty visuals that bring the war to life

Clear the bunkers. Crush the resistance. Turn the tide.

70010000103207.name: Super Yellow Ballman
70010000103207.description:
Super Yellow Ballman is a 2D action game.
Control a ball-shaped character to dodge traps and smash through blocks with a dash.
In battle stages, dash into enemies to deal damage—knock them into holes for massive damage!
VS Mode is also included, where you can enjoy battles only.
Defeat the evil organization Happy Dark and restore peace to the world.

70010000103222.name: CRAYON CAR
70010000103222.intro:
Color 16 of the World’s Favorite Cars for Kids!
Talk about cars together with mom and dad while coloring.
70010000103222.description:
The new joy of the Crayon Series, “Crayon Car”, has finally arrived!
It’s a coloring experience that sparks both children’s imagination and curiosity about cars.

From sports cars to fire trucks and police cars—lots of fun car characters are waiting!
Use the Nintendo Switch™ touchscreen to create your very own unique car colors!

Special Features
Real Crayon Feel
Experience the texture of real crayons at your fingertips, letting kids color in every detail—from wheels to bodywork.

Wide Variety of Vehicles & Templates
Race cars, trucks, buses, trains, excavators, and more!
Kids can freely color all kinds of vehicles from their imagination.

Creativity & Sense of Achievement
Through the star and reward system, kids are encouraged to complete their creations while feeling a true sense of accomplishment.

Recommended for:
Kids who love cars and need a new activity to enjoy

Families who want to keep children entertained while traveling or going out

Parents, siblings, and friends looking for a fun coloring game to enjoy together

Safe & Fun
Coloring available anytime, even offline

Optimized for Nintendo Switch™

One purchase for the whole family to enjoy for a long time

“Crayon Car” lets kids unleash their creativity while fueling their fascination with cars!
Children will love completing their own original cars, while families can share the joy and make lasting memories together.

 Start your colorful car-coloring adventure today!

70010000103227.name: Tears Revolude
70010000103227.intro: Explore isometric dungeons and master evolving skills in a classic JRPG
70010000103227.description:
A century after the legendary artist Orwiel vanished, Sion and Michelle begin a journey to uncover his final works. Along the way, they encounter Liara, a mysterious girl who has lost her memories. What she carries holds the power to alter their path and entwine their fates, drawing the party into a story of art, destiny, and hidden truths in a classic fantasy world.

This classic command-based JRPG features a 3D isometric map interface and smooth, dynamic battle animations. Explore dungeons and engage in easy-to-learn turn-based combat inspired by old-school RPGs. Enhance weapons at the blacksmith, learn up to five skills per character, and strengthen those skills through repeated use as their power and effects evolve. Build the SP gauge during battle to unleash powerful special abilities, and expend it all at once to trigger devastating combo attacks with your allies.

70010000103232.name: Flight Simulator 2025
70010000103232.intro: Master your aircraft and embrace the adventure of flying.
70010000103232.description:
Flight Simulator 2025 invites you into the captivating world of commercial aviation, where the sky becomes your business ground. You start with a modest fleet and a single hangar, but with ambition and skill, you can transform an unknown company into a global leader in air transport.

Every flight is more than just operating the aircraft – it’s a blend of strategy, business decisions, and realistic piloting. You’ll face dangerous challenges, transport diverse cargo, and navigate unpredictable weather conditions. Expand your infrastructure, upgrade your aircraft, and discover new opportunities across airports scattered around the world.

Features:
- Realistic flying and authentic piloting experience.
- Opportunities to expand and upgrade your fleet and hangars.
- Airports and destinations from around the globe.
- Dynamic weather and day/night cycles that change every flight.
- From light aircraft to massive cargo planes.

The sky is your business – are you ready to take off?

70010000103242.name: 9 Lives to Defend
70010000103242.intro: Loki The Cat is home alone - it's time for a roguelike cat-astrophe!

70010000103247.name: Moto Rush Reborn
70010000103247.intro:
Rip through retro-futuristic Tokyo highways!
Lane split through heavy traffic and dominate tracks filled with obstacles on an action-packed mission to overcome possession.
70010000103247.description:
Rip through retro-futuristic Tokyo highways in a demonic pursuit of speed and power! Lane split through heavy traffic and dominate tracks filled with obstacles on an action-packed mission to overcome possession. Uncover the truth behind your curse through scattered collectible manga pages. Are you fast enough to outrun your demons? 

About This Game

Immerse yourself in Neo-Tokyo’s intense world of motorcycle racing. Clear levels at neck-breaking speeds and avoid hitting innocent commuters. 
After totaling your bike in a race, you stumble upon a demon-possessed engine in a junkyard that offers speeds and power you can’t refuse. Battle for freedom from possession and overcome the darkness!

KILLER SPEEDS

Combining the thrilling elements of a 3D runner, maneuver through fast-paced levels by performing wheelies, ducking, sliding, and jumping. Racers can also increase their maneuverability by adjusting their speed, accelerating and decelerating depending on the environment they face. 

Pop wheelies while accelerating to great speeds as you lane split and duck for precision steering. Avoid decapitation in rapidly changing track environments by sliding across asphalt while avoiding numerous barriers. Keep the adrenaline pumping as you launch yourself on ramps and weave through congested Tokyo streets. 

Collect Demonic Symbols And Unlock Manga 

Find Demonic Symbols scattered throughout 45 levels, including unlockables that can only be accessed by completing skill objectives in each level. 

Each level contains three skill objectives:
•	Finishing at a record-breaking time
•	Zero demolition, avoid colliding with high-speed traffic
•	Near misses: drive close enough to kiss cars without colliding 

Demonic Symbols claimed unlock chapters of manga, progressing you deeper into the unfolding story. 

45 Challenging Levels 

You’re thrown into a vibrant, futuristic Tokyo, packed with stunning visuals and expertly crafted tracks that push your limits with each new level unlocked. 

Each zone offers its own vibe. Drift through power plants, duck into collapsing tunnels as you test your skill, and break through windows as you shred through a neon-drenched shopping mall. Every environment is fast and unforgiving. 

Difficulty increases as you progress through levels. Later levels will push your skills to the edge. Hidden collectibles can be found throughout levels, easy to spot early on, but harder to find as you advance. Master the toughest paths to claim them all and keep the adrenaline pumping.

70010000103252.name: Life in Terminal Simulator : Airport Adventures
70010000103252.intro: Survive harsh nights and unpredictable airport dangers.
70010000103252.description:
Stranded in an international airport with no documents, no money, and nowhere to go—you must survive in the shadows of modern travel. In Life in Terminal Simulator, you take on the role of a forgotten passenger trapped in a terminal, where each day is a struggle to find food, rest, and a path to freedom.
Your goal? Earn enough to buy a forged passport… and escape.

Features:
– Time & Action Management
Each day offers a limited number of actions. New tasks appear daily, and the airport environment shifts with time—making planning essential.
– Survival Mechanics
Sleep in unsafe storage rooms, risk getting robbed at night, and monitor your hunger and thirst. Food and water are scarce—and expensive.
– NPC Interaction & Quests
Talk to other lost souls and airport workers. Accept jobs, trade, and uncover hidden ways to earn money or unlock restricted areas.
– Location Access & Exploration
Gain access to new sections of the airport by completing objectives or paying off the right people. Every corner could offer an opportunity—or danger.
– Risk of Theft
Your possessions aren’t safe. Sleep in the wrong place, and you may wake up with nothing. Carefully manage your valuables and shelter choices.
– Resource Strategy
Juggle your energy, food, hydration, and money wisely. One poor decision could cost you days of progress.
– The Final Escape
Your ultimate objective is clear: save up enough to buy a fake passport and finally leave the terminal behind. But in a world of limited choices, will you make the right ones?

Not all travelers are tourists. Some are survivors.
Can you outlast the system and escape the terminal… or will you become just another ghost in the airport?

70010000103264.name: My Little Haven
70010000103264.intro: Step into the beautiful dream world and help your toy friends settle into their miniature cozy homes!
70010000103264.description:
The core My Little Haven is about arranging furniture and decorating rooms to make them perfect for the adorable toy inhabitants. Each resident you meet has unique tastes and requests, challenging your interior design skills!

•Fulfill Wishes: residents will have specific requirements, such as needing certain floor or wall color.
•Design freely! While meeting their basic needs, you have complete freedom to style the room however you like. 
•Unlock décor. Expand your catalog of decorations by discovering exclusive new items scattered across the dream islands!
•Don't just decorate the inside! Customize the exterior look of the toy houses to make the whole world sparkle.
•Visit distinct, beautiful miniature islands.
•Experience the magic! All ocharacters are brought to life with delightful, stop-motion-style animations, adding a unique, handcrafted feel to your decorating adventure.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 5 unique islands to explore with 3 houses to decorate each.
- Avatar choice: you can play as a boy or girl. 
- Wholesome, family friendly atmosphere.
- Gameplay filled with creative challenges. 
- Cozy, relaxing music.

70010000103273.name: Hentai Photo: Yuri
70010000103273.intro: We will collect all the details and reveal the most interesting secrets!
70010000103273.description:
Welcome to Hentai Photo: Yuri, a classic puzzle game where you unlock vivid and sensual illustrations step by step! The game focuses on attractive girls in glamorous and daring outfits. They are all ready to charm you with their looks.

All images are created with love for the smallest details, and their expressive poses, stylish outfits and bright emotions give each illustration a special atmosphere. The realistic assembly mechanics will make you feel like you are assembling a real paper puzzle. Relaxing music will help you to fully immerse yourself in the game.

Game Features:
- 40+ passionate puzzles featuring seductive anime girls
- High-quality and sensual illustrations
- Realistic assembly process with smooth animations
- Atmospheric music accompaniment
- Ability to view collected images in detail

70010000103283.name: Strike Warfare: Force Recon
70010000103283.intro: Be the last one standing! Ultimate survival FPS paints Middle East red with blood! Take on impossible missions with devastating firepower from lethal weapons.
70010000103283.description:
This Nintendo Switch™ exclusive game is the ultimate survival FPS! Infiltrate dangerous Middle Eastern territories as a combat mercenary in this single-player FPS shooting game. Use abundant missions and diverse weapon systems to Enjoy an immersive battlefield experience.

・Experience overwhelming first-person shooter action with a realistic perspective.
・Intense combat missions are set across various Middle Eastern locations.
・Unlock precision shooting sniper mode after clearing story mode.
・Choose from a variety of weapons based on combat situations.
・A volume-packed story development as a professional combat mercenary executing various operations.
・Intuitive controls allow players of all levels to enjoy the game.
・Realistic combat environments recreated with high-quality 3D graphics.

Become a combat mercenary carrying out dangerous missions.
Survive the harsh Middle Eastern battlefields.
Clear all missions to become a true elite mercenary.

Prologue
The situation in the Middle East had reached its worst state in history.
As the international terrorist organization Desert Crime seized oil facilities, governments worldwide struggled to respond.
Amid this crisis, elite combat mercenary Jake McClane received an emergency request.
"Complete annihilation of Desert Crime. That's your mission."
He would face scorching deserts, cities turned to ruins, and death matches with ruthless enemies. What he didn't know was that this mission was merely the prologue to a much larger conspiracy.
"Survival probability: extremely low. Mission commence."
As sandstorms rage, a combat mercenary's brutal battle begins!

70010000103288.name: Anime Girls: Summer Vacay
70010000103288.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000103288.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000103290.name: Anime Girls: Nimble Ninja
70010000103290.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000103290.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000103292.name: Anime Girls: Celebrity Crush
70010000103292.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000103292.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000103294.name: Anime Girls: Puffy Pumpkin
70010000103294.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000103294.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000103296.name: Anime Girls: College Love
70010000103296.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000103296.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000103298.name: Anime Girls: Tokyo Christmas
70010000103298.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000103298.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000103305.name: puffies.
70010000103305.description:
puffies. is a puzzle game that reimagines the classic jigsaw experience with a charmingly nostalgic twist of puffy stickers. Solve engaging levels of varying difficulty by combining fun, hand-designed puffy stickers and building a stunning collection along the way.

STICKER COLLECTIONS & PACK VOLUMES
Unlock sticker packs of various themes, sizes, difficulty levels, and volumes to build your unique puffy collection. Each collection is thoughtfully designed by our in-house artists.

RANKING SYSTEM & TASKS
Sharpen your skills and grow your puffy sticker collection by completing tasks, earning points, and climbing the ranks. 

DAILY CHALLENGES
Return each day to tackle fun Daily Challenges and boost your score. Daily Challenges are available for 24 hours only, so don't miss out!

ACCESSIBILITY FEATURES
puffies. offers a range of accessibility features that make puzzle-solving easier and create a more comfortable gameplay experience for kids, players with visual impairments, motion sensitivity, and more.

RELAXING & FAMILY FRIENDLY 
puffies. is a family-friendly game designed for players of all genders and ages to enjoy. The game offers a relaxing and stress-free experience that you can jump into anytime.

70010000103315.name: EGGCONSOLE DAIDASSOU PC-8801
70010000103315.intro: Infiltrate the prisoner-of-war camp!Use guns, grenades, and more to blast through the enemy and complete a great escape with your five comrades!
70010000103315.description:
This is a action game released in Japan by Carry lab in 1984. Players infiltrate a quarter-view prisoner-of-war camp, battling enemy soldiers with limited-ammo grenades and pistols. Use acquired keys to open cells and rescue comrades.

Rescued allies may move unexpectedly, but "Gather" and "Scatter" commands help them escape effectively. Escaping with five allies completes the stage. Total 16 stages. Losing five allies to friendly fire or other incidents during infiltration results in mission failure.

This comical escape unfolds across unique, Escher-like stages. It's a simple yet satisfying game.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000103318.name: Cats in Cozy Rooms
70010000103318.intro: Play as Mr. Orange, the new interior designer in town, and help every cat-citizen decorate their cozy home to purr-fection!
70010000103318.description:
In Cats in Cozy Rooms, you play as Mr. Orange, a talented cat interior designer helping the town’s fluffy residents turn their rooms into stylish sanctuaries!
