Choose from a growing collection of furniture and decorations to match each client's preferences—while sticking to their budget. Whether it's a bookworm cat who wants a mini library or a rockstar kitty in need of a music-themed room, it’s up to you to deliver the perfect design.

- Cute furniture
- Relaxing, creative gameplay
- Unique cat clients with distinct personalities
- Budget-based challenges
- Save and share your best designs

Decorate, relax, and bring smiles to every cat in town!

70010000103325.name: EGGCONSOLE MUGEN NO SHINZOU II PC-8801
70010000103325.intro: Form a party with your allies and escape from Elder Ain.Crystal Soft's masterpiece RPG returns, now with improved controls from the previous installment.
70010000103325.description:
This is a role-playing game released in Japan by XTAL SOFT in 1985. After escaping the Mugen Realm in the previous title, the protagonist supposedly returned home but instead found themselves in Elder Einh, a different world. Thus, they must embark on another adventure to return.

Like its predecessor, the game features top-down exploration and encounter-based, command battles. However, symbol-based enemy encounters now let players evade foes and progress.

Players form parties of up to five, choosing from numerous professions (e.g., Hero, Brave, Noble, Sorcerer). Spells boast evocative names (e.g., "Seal, Recede," "Flame, Be My Sword," "Phantom Reinforcements Arise"), well-received by many.

While the previous game allowed escape from the Mugen Realm via the Heart of Illusion, how does one escape Elder Einh (the world of “II”)? Acclaimed as a classic Japanese RPG, this is a must-play for fans of traditional JRPGs.


*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000103329.name: Sub-Structure 17: White Knuckle Ascent
70010000103329.description:
In White Knuckle Ascent, speed is your best friend—and gravity your worst enemy. Trapped in the depths of a massive underground megastructure, you’ll need sharp reflexes, clever inventory management, and a serious lack of fear of heights to make your way up through a labyrinth of decaying industrial zones, mutated flora, and things that definitely don’t want you to leave.

Master physics-driven, momentum-based movement to fling, swing, and claw your way up shifting terrain. Use tools wisely or get weighed down—because the wrong gear at the wrong time can drag you straight to your doom.

Each run is a fresh climb. Unlock strange augmentations, adapt to increasingly bizarre threats, and survive environments like the slime-slick Pipeworks or the creaking husks of the forgotten Habitation sector. And always—always—keep climbing. Something is down there. It knows you’re here. And it really doesn’t like quitters.

So tighten your grip. The only way out… is up.

70010000103334.name: Around the World Puzzle
70010000103334.intro:
Spin and complete views from around the world!
A brain-training puzzle game where you'll discover your favorite
70010000103334.description:
A puzzle game where you rotate panels to restore stunning landscapes from around the world that have been jumbled in direction.

The controls are simple—just look closely at the image and tap the panel you want to rotate!
Depending on how fast you clear the stage, you'll earn 1 to 3 stars.

A hint button becomes available over time and can be used up to three times.
It will automatically align one row of panels correctly, so you can relax even if you get stuck.

It's easy to play but offers real depth, making it perfect for a quick brain teaser anytime.
Try to collect 3 stars on every stage!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000103343.name: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000103343.description:
Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Includes:
• ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 
• ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

The PIRATE WARRIORS series has successfully combined the popular anime ONE PIECE with the thrilling action of the WARRIORS series to create a worldwide phenomenon selling more than four million copies! Based on the concept of fighting hordes of enemies while adventuring with trusted allies, experience awesome ONE PIECE action lifted straight from the anime!

ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 is the latest evolution of PIRATE WARRIORS action! Based on the concept of experiencing a real ONE PIECE battlefield, buildings will come crashing down during the action and attacks will throw up smoke and dust, placing you in the thick of the ONE PIECE world! Injecting fresh elements that couldn't be achieved in previous entries has now realized an even more thrilling brand of PIRATE WARRIORS action!

*ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 Legendary Edition and ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 Ultimate Edition are available on Nintendo Switch™ only.

70010000103344.name: SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim
70010000103344.intro: You opened your eyes to find a giant girl looking down at you...
70010000103344.description:
SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim is an adventure game set in 2000s Japan about the lives of Saeko, a girl with mysterious abilities, and the little people she has shrunk to the size of her thumb. Experience Saeko's and the little people's fates in the day and at night, through two separate game systems with different art styles.

You are Rin, the latest addition to the little people. Under Saeko’s protection, you spend your days in her desk drawer together with the other little people.
But don't let your guard down. Saeko has some...interesting hobbies, to say the least.

・Stunning and unique visuals drawn in two different styles of pixel art
・A world filled with brutal allure inspired by many strange tales, beginning with Fueti Shizue’s work
・An original game system which forces players to make difficult choices and live with the consequences
・A soundtrack heavily influenced by future garage and breakcore, composed by the developer himself
・The deepest journey into a developer’s proclivities in indie game history

70010000103361.name: Lyca
70010000103361.intro: A small, relaxing, incremental game about restoring a barren wasteland into a lush meadow.
70010000103361.description:
Help the magical wolf Lyca run through the land, gather resources, and unlock a vast upgrade tree.

Run freely through the grass, gather resources, and explore a vast upgrade tree.

Unlock incredibly powerful upgrades, helpful abilities and valuable resources.

Bring life and rain back into a desolate wasteland.

Enjoy:
- Incremental progression through resource gathering
- A vast upgrade tree to explore
- Unlockable "idle" and "endless" modes
- Approximately 3-4 hours of gameplay to complete the campaign
- Simple and relaxing experience
- Accessible controls: Keyboard, Mouse-Only, and Controller support
- Lofi royalty-free beats to chill to by Purrple Cat

70010000103371.name: Resting Island
70010000103371.intro: Uncover peace and wonder on a hidden island paradise
70010000103371.description:
Welcome to Resting Island, a serene escape into nature where time slows down and discovery awaits around every corner. Explore a lush, mysterious island at your own pace!

Wander through peaceful biomes like pine-filled forests, soft sandy beaches, and groves of glowing pink trees. Each location is a gentle surprise, with ambient sounds, calming music, and hidden landmarks to find.


Features:
Explore at your own pace, No quests or pressure. Just walk, listen, and look.

Beautiful, varied environments. From pinewoods to beaches to magical pink forests.

Discover hidden locations! Find peaceful spots tucked away across the island.

A relaxing audio journey. Gentle music and natural soundscapes for a meditative experience.

70010000103380.name: LumineNight
70010000103380.description:
1950, Summerset, USA.
Detective Kelvin Foster and his daughter, the self-proclaimed detective Selen Foster, delve into the darkness of the city to uncover the truth behind a series of unsolved murders hidden for over a decade.

LumineNight is a mystery adventure game where players must investigate, solve puzzles and codes, infiltrate, interrogate suspects, and ultimately deduce the truth themselves.

As detectives, follow these five principles to unravel the mystery:

■ Find Clues Hidden in Dark Streets
Deep within neon-lit streets at night, undiscovered truths lie hidden. Explore the city firsthand and never miss even the smallest clue.

■ Solve Puzzles and Decipher Codes
Step into the shoes of Selen Foster, a genius at deciphering codes. Solve intricate puzzles and unravel cryptic codes to uncover crucial secrets.

■ Sneak Among the Shadows
Secretly infiltrate secure locations to discover hidden clues and critical evidence.

■ Identify Contradictions Between Testimonies and Crime Scenes
Expose fabricated evidence and contradictions in testimonies through interrogation, breaking down lies to reveal hidden truths.

■ Complete Your Deduction
Combine all clues and evidence to piece together the characters' secrets and the full truth behind the cases. The power to uncover the hidden truth lies entirely in your hands.

70010000103385.name: Pixel Game Maker Series Stray Witch and the Ghost Train
70010000103385.intro:
A witch who has lost her memory boards a train in an unfamiliar world
and travels to recover her memories.
70010000103385.description:
■Story
I awoke in a world I didn't recognize.
I remember nothing about myself, but I can use magic!
I set out searching for an exit.
The mysterious journey of the “Crimson Witch” begins...

■Game Overview
A 2D side-scrolling action game where you control a witch who has lost her memory, traveling through a mysterious world. Defeat the monsters that appear using attack magic.Collect souls from defeated monsters to purchase items or enhance your attack magic.
Progress by helping or being helped by the “ghosts” you encounter along the way.

Bosses lie in wait ahead.

Is the witch “Purple,” who looks just like you, friend or foe?
And what are the true memories of the amnesiac “Crimson Witch”?

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.

70010000103391.name: Arcade Archives BATTLANTIS
70010000103391.intro: The time for battle has come! Rise, true hero!
70010000103391.description:
"BATTLANTIS" is a shooter released by KONAMI in 1987.
The objective is to defend your castle from an invading army of monsters. You must defeat all enemies before they climb the castle walls.
Only the young King Cripeuss III can save the sacred island of Battlantis. Go forth and drive back the evil monsters!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000103408.name: HeistGeist
70010000103408.intro: A story-driven (non-roguelike) cyberpunk RPG where you fight and hack using cards.
70010000103408.description:
Follow the story of Alexandra, a professional thief for hire who's desperately trying to stay alive after her last job in Venice went terribly wrong. On the run from corporate assassins and with a knife to her throat courtesy of a very unhappy client, Alex needs to assemble a team of professionals to pull off the heist of a lifetime.
- Heists - Pull off high stakes heists in which every choice matters
- Story - Follow an original cyberpunk story full of twists and intrigue, set in unusual setting in Central Europe, with a fully voiced cast of characters
- Combat - Fight your enemies in card-based battles where sequencing and powerful combinations are the key to your success
- RPG - Build your character by constructing a deck of cards that suits your playstyle and by augmenting your character through the installation of cyberware that changes your attributes.
- Hacking - Use cyberspace to hack into secure servers in a unique card-based puzzles where you run programs and install viruses in order to get to server at the end of the grid

70010000103415.name: Digging Adventure Simulator 2025
70010000103415.intro: Go deep or go home with nothing.
70010000103415.description:
You start with a shovel and a dream. Beneath your feet? A world of treasure, tech, and ancient oddities just waiting to be uncovered.

Crack open the earth, sell your finds, and upgrade your gear. The deeper you go, the weirder it gets—old coins, lost gadgets, forgotten ruins... and some things that maybe should’ve stayed buried.

No timers. No stress. Just you, your tools, and the thrill of discovery. Dig smart, dig bold—and if something starts glowing? Uh... maybe back away slowly.

70010000103420.name: Road Cafe Simulator
70010000103420.intro: Create a cozy roadside cafe for travelers!
70010000103420.description:
Help tired travelers and create for them the most cozy tourist restaurant. Let every stop at your establishment become a real feast! 

In Road Cafe Simulator puts you right in the middle of the action in the role of a roadside cafe owner. Start your own road cafe, serve appetizing dishes and turn your humble stall into the hottest hotspot in town. It's all about great food, satisfied customers and growing your business.

Master the art of cooking, customer service and efficient café management. Purchase the freshest ingredients, create well-oiled workflows and make quick strategic decisions to keep orders flowing and customers coming back.

Every dish you serve and every customer you impress builds your reputation. But be careful - one misstep can cost you everything. Modernize your kitchen, discover new recipes and turn your sidewalk café into a local legend. The road to success is hot - are you ready to take the heat?

Check out this fun new game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Become the owner of an iconic roadside restaurant!

70010000103430.name: TUNG TUNG SAHUR EXTREME
70010000103430.intro: It’s not just a game — it’s TUNG TUNG time.
70010000103430.description:
TUNG TUNG SAHUR EXTREME catapults you into a wild, high-energy experience where every move counts and every second is a thrill. Defy gravity, leap into the unknown, and embrace the rush of extreme action in the most unpredictable environments.
Test your reflexes, perfect your timing, and push your limits through daring challenges that demand both focus and boldness. Whether you're after a flawless run or just looking to unleash chaotic fun, this game delivers heart-pounding excitement from start to finish.
It’s not just a test of skill — it’s a celebration of movement, madness, and momentum.
Are you ready to go extreme? TUNG TUNG awaits.

70010000103435.name: Winx Club: The Magic is Back
70010000103435.intro: Play as your favorite Winx in this brand new adventure.
70010000103435.description:
Winx Club: The Magic is Back captures the essence of the Winx universe, delivering an enchanting experience with a mix of magical combat, puzzle-solving, and cooperative gameplay with a friend. Play as all six members of the Winx Club, each with their own magical abilities.

KEY FEATURES
 
Play as Your Favorite Fairies
Play as all six members of the Winx Club, tailoring your experience based on your preferred character and their abilities. Freely switch between all five of the Winx while playing.

Explore Iconic Settings from the Winx Universe
Attend Alfea College and journey to familiar and distinct Winx locations, including The Enchanted Forest, The Coastal Cliffs, and The Desert Ruins of Red Fountain.

Winx Action in Your Hands
Engage in combat against fantasy creatures, where you’ll use each character’s unique magical abilities to bring peace to the lands. Upgrade spells to strengthen your fairies for even more fun.

Play with a Friend
With two-player local co-op, you and a friend can enjoy Winx Club together!

70010000103442.name: Hentai Photo: Higanbana
70010000103442.intro: Will collect all the details and reveal the most interesting secrets!
70010000103442.description:
Classic puzzle game where you unlock vivid and sensual illustrations step by step! The game focuses on attractive girls in glamorous and daring outfits. They are all ready to charm you with their looks.

All images are created with love for the smallest details, and their expressive poses, stylish outfits and bright emotions give each illustration a special atmosphere. The realistic assembly mechanics will make you feel like you are assembling a real paper puzzle. Relaxing music will help you to fully immerse yourself in the game.

Game Features:
- 40+ passionate puzzles featuring seductive anime girls
- High-quality and sensual illustrations
- Realistic assembly process with smooth animations
- Atmospheric music accompaniment
- Ability to view collected images in detail

70010000103444.name: Hentai Photo: Mokusei
70010000103444.intro: Will collect all the details and reveal the most interesting secrets!
70010000103444.description:
Classic puzzle game where you unlock vivid and sensual illustrations step by step! The game focuses on attractive girls in glamorous and daring outfits. They are all ready to charm you with their looks.

All images are created with love for the smallest details, and their expressive poses, stylish outfits and bright emotions give each illustration a special atmosphere. The realistic assembly mechanics will make you feel like you are assembling a real paper puzzle. Relaxing music will help you to fully immerse yourself in the game.

Game Features:
- 40+ passionate puzzles featuring seductive anime girls
- High-quality and sensual illustrations
- Realistic assembly process with smooth animations
- Atmospheric music accompaniment
- Ability to view collected images in detail

70010000103461.name: Fling it! Shoe Kicking
70010000103461.intro:
Fly, shoe, fly! Up into the sky!
Swing and kick your shoe as far as you can! 
Become a shoe-kicking master!
70010000103461.description:
Relive the joy of a classic childhood game on the Nintendo Switch™!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can play together!
Master the perfect timing, angle, and force for the ultimate kick!

[Score Attack Mode]
How far can you send your shoe flying?! Aim for a new personal best!

[Battle Mode]
Practice solo or compete for the farthest distance with family and friends!
Face off against players from around the world in Online Battles!

70010000103469.name: Scoop it! Crane Game
70010000103469.intro: The fan-favorite arcade classic—The Crane Game—returns, powered up! Packed with more content and fresh new controls! Become a Crane Master!
70010000103469.description:
Play the evolved Crane Game experience on the Nintendo Switch™!
Share Joy-Con™ to face off against friends in 1-on-1 battles!
Scoop, drop, push!

[Score Attack]
Scoop up tons of prizes and earn a high spot on the leaderboards!
Aim for a Jackpot, and something amazing might happen!

[Battle]
Intense 1-on-1 showdowns await! Test your skills against CPUs and friends!
Take on Crane Game masters from around the world in Online Battles!

[Collection]
Admire the prizes you've collected!
Can you collect all 280+ prizes and complete your collection?

70010000103475.name: Escape game R00M06
70010000103475.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

70010000103478.name: Laundry Store Simulator
70010000103478.description:
Are you ready to own the world's best laundry store? Transform a small laundry shop into a laundry empire!

Discover the following features in Laundry Store Simulator:

Build a small laundry store into a thriving business empire! Upgrade your equipment, design and expand your store, hire staff, and more!

Upgrade your equipment to provide exceptional cleaning services! Invest in high-quality washing machines, dryers, ironing equipment, and even automated washing machines!

Create a stylish and inviting space to attract customers! Provide comfortable seating, warm decorations, and more funsies to welcome your customers!

Grow your laundry business by unlocking new areas and features, offering complimentary services to attract more customers!

Build a dedicated team to manage your laundry store efficiently! Hire qualified and experienced staff laundry attendants, such as, washers, dryers, and more!

Boost your profits by selling cleaning supplies and becoming a one-stop shop for laundry needs! Offer a variety of cleaning products, including detergents, fabric softeners, stain removers, and more!

Unleash your creativity by designing custom shirts for unique customers! Draw anything, print it, and watch them proudly wear your creations in style!

70010000103501.name: Hero Seekers
70010000103501.intro: Restore the lost history in a summoning fantasy RPG!
70010000103501.description:
The world has been rewritten, and the very name of "Hero" erased from memory. Once, three brave warriors defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land—but now their deeds are lost to time. Lunette, the only one who remembers the true history, sets out on a journey to restore it by summoning the forgotten souls of heroes and reclaiming the light once stolen from the world.

Experience a full-fledged fantasy JRPG filled with classic turn-based battles, dungeon exploration, and strategic party building. Form teams of up to five heroes, combining unique traits and skills to create powerful synergies. Strengthen your allies through training, gear up at shops, and master the art of command battles where every move counts. With features like high-speed combat, dungeon escape spells, and smooth progression, enjoy an adventure that blends nostalgic JRPG charm with modern convenience.

70010000103511.name: Love is all around 2
70010000103511.intro: A Romance of Love and Betrayal in Ancient Times — Your Choices Decide Everything
70010000103511.description:
Intiny proudly presents the official sequel to the Love is All Around series—making a spectacular return! This time, we invite you to step into the treacherous yet enchanting world of ancient martial arts and imperial courts, experiencing an unprecedented, immersive romantic adventure.

Classic Cast, Delightful Reunions!
To perfectly continue the charm of the Love is All Around universe, we’ve brought back the original beloved cast in all their glory! From the heart-stealing Zheng Ziyan in the first installment, to Xia Tian in the DLC, and Yuan Qi from the prequel, they all return in stunning historical attire. Fate draws you together once more—are you ready to be captivated by their unique charms again?

Cinematic Quality, Fully Upgraded!
With top-tier costume and prop design, film-level camera work and lighting, and meticulous craftsmanship from a professional production team, this installment delivers an audiovisual feast far surpassing contemporaries—bringing you an immersive experience on par with epic historical dramas.

Heartstrings Stirred, Emotions Intact!
We understand that the true allure of the Love is All Around series lies in its heartfelt emotional resonance, sweet romantic thrills, and intense sense of immersion. Love is All Around 2 fully inherits this essence, letting you once again get swept into the emotional whirlpool with six distinctively charming heroines—experiencing every heartbeat, dilemma, sweetness, and touching moment.

A New Historical Chapter, with Extra Surprises!
Not just continuation, but bold innovation! Love is All Around 2 shifts the stage to ancient times, blending a beautiful historical backdrop with plenty of lighthearted and humorous elements to bring laughter amid tense adventures. On top of that, a carefully woven plot of intrigue and suspense takes center stage. Beneath the romantic facade lies a world full of danger—and the heroines around you seem to be hiding secrets of their own...

Dual Paths, Fateful Choices!
The story intertwines a “romance line” and a “suspense line.” Interaction mirrors life, and choices carry consequences. No one is all-knowing:

If you follow your heart, focusing on romance, you may earn the love and a sweet ending—but risk missing clues to a shocking conspiracy, leaving the ultimate truth undiscovered.

If you pursue the truth, analyzing every detail, you may uncover the full picture—but your rationality or entanglement in danger could make you miss genuine love, leaving you alone in the end.

Who is right, and who is wrong? Which weighs heavier, passion or prudence? Will you “drunkly rest on a beauty’s lap” or “wake alone to unravel the mystery”? There is no standard answer—everything depends on your choices. Every decision leads to a completely different story branch and ending, offering immense replay value.

70010000103516.name: The Mystery of Eldham
70010000103516.intro: Your epic story awaits here. Experience an epic journey and rescue a village from evil deeds. A retro RPG full of secrets and adventures.
70010000103516.description:
Immerse yourself in the dark world of Eldham, a seemingly peaceful village threatened by a dark force. In this classic pixel-art RPG, you take on the role of an adventurer who faces danger to uncover the truth behind the impending doom.

Explore enchanted forests, abandoned ruins, and mysterious dungeons as you level up, unlock new skills, and collect powerful items. Every step brings you closer to solving the mystery—but also deeper into the dark machinations that plague Eldham.

With its lovingly crafted 8-bit style, classic RPG feel, and gripping story, The Mystery of Eldham is a must-have for fans of retro adventures.

Are you ready to unravel the mystery of Eldham?

Features:
-Classic RPG gameplay with modern twists
-Pixel graphics with a nostalgic 8-bit look
-Exciting quests & mysterious NPCs
-Skill and item system to upgrade your Character

70010000103518.name: BOMBORDIRO CROCODILO Flight Simulator
70010000103518.intro: Let’s get this meme flight started!
70010000103518.description:
Take off? Crash? Repeat.
BOMBORDIRO CROCODILO Flight Simulator is when you get 100% adrenaline and 200% memes.
Crazy planes, chaos in every mission.
It's not about realism. It's about the clean atmosphere. "Are you ready?"
Every flight is a chance to become a legend....or a joke about flying.
Your enemies? Turbulence, and your own chaotic reflexes.
Each level is a flying circus where rules simply don't exist.
Fail? Restart. And wreak havoc again.
You don't survive here — you fly with taste.
Unlock fancy planes, find ridiculous upgrades and conquer the skies to the limit.
Will you be able to cope with the madness?

70010000103524.name: Survival Zombie
70010000103524.intro: Fight the undead and conquer chaos in a shattered world.
70010000103524.description:
Survival Zombie is an intense survival experience set in a post-apocalyptic world, where players are pushed to their physical and mental limits in a relentless fight to stay alive. In a land dominated by the undead, quick thinking, smart strategies, and teamwork with other survivors can mean the difference between life and death.

Key Features:
 • Thrilling exploration: Roam abandoned cities, shadowy forests, and hidden bunkers teeming with resources—and unexpected dangers.
 • Perpetual threats: Zombies aren’t the only danger. Other survivors, wild animals, and harsh environmental conditions can strike without warning.
 • Craft and survive: Collect resources, craft improvised weapons, and build secure shelters to protect yourself from waves of enemies.
 • Tough moral choices: Confront challenging scenarios where every decision carries lasting consequences.
 • Evolving undead: Each day brings smarter, deadlier zombies, keeping you on constant alert.

Are you prepared to confront fear, make life-altering choices, and endure in Survival Zombie? Adventure awaits—but only the cunning and resilient will survive!

70010000103534.name: Bunny Pit Stop
70010000103534.intro: Smart moves keep the pit stop running
70010000103534.description: Get ready to hop into action in Bunny Pit Stop, a puzzle game where a clever rabbit mechanic takes center stage. Inspired by the classic push-and-place style, your mission is simple but tricky: push cars into their maintenance bays and keep the garage running smoothly. The game is designed to be casual and relaxing, but don’t let that fool you. Each level introduces new layouts and patterns that make you think ahead, plan your moves, and find the perfect sequence to clear the board. You’ll start small, with just one or two cars per puzzle. Soon enough, the challenge grows as more cars crowd the space, demanding careful strategies and creative solutions. No timers, no stress, just you, the bunny, and the satisfying click of every car finding its spot. Explore three unique biomes across 35 levels. The Garage is messy and filled with oil stains, tires, and barrels, marking the beginning of your rabbit’s career. Then comes the Pit Stop, right next to the racetrack, with vibrant details like vegetation and advertisement signs. Finally, the Track Median sets the stage with scattered objects, cacti, and hints of crashes, making each puzzle feel alive. With its charming theme and smooth progression, Bunny Pit Stop is the perfect choice for puzzle lovers who want a relaxing yet engaging experience.

70010000103539.name: To Farm Lands
70010000103539.description:
To Farm Lands is a farm‑themed puzzle game where every piece matters. Your goal is to place farm items of various shapes and sizes into a grid, filling the pen without any empty spaces. It sounds simple—but get ready for challenges that would make even the most seasoned farmer sweat under their hat.
With cozy visuals, relaxing sound effects, and gameplay that blends calm with sharp logic, it's perfect whether you want to unwind or tackle well‑designed puzzles.
You can rotate, move, and fit tools, barns, hay bales, and more to fill the pen as perfectly as possible. Over 30 levels, layouts grow larger, pieces more varied, and missions progressively tougher. Completionists chasing all the stars: each stage has extra conditions that will truly test your skills.
Early levels move at a slow pace: small pieces, simple grids, and farm basics. As you progress, fields expand, conveyors deliver new objects, and every move matters more.
If you love games that reward precision, planning, and creativity—with a serene farm vibe—To Farm Lands is the perfect crop. Organize the farm, solve the puzzles, and claim every inch of land, one block at a time.

70010000103549.name: Cross Pix 2
70010000103549.description:
Cross Pix 2 is a NEW NONOGRAM Logic Puzzle Game! where you follow number clues to solve a hidden image. It’s also known by other similar games like Griddlers, or Paint by Numbers.

Cross Pix 2 features ALL NEW 105 hand-crafted puzzles and intuitive gameplay with gradually increasing difficulty.

With simple and easy-to-understand rules, it's a game anyone can enjoy! A perfect choice for casual play, while still offering a satisfying mental challenge.

Cross Pix 2 delivers a relaxing and cozy puzzle experience that keeps your mind sharp and engaged.


Features:
★ Nintendo Switch™ online leaderboards for each mode (opt-out available).
★ 5 professionally composed background tracks.
★ Multi-language support.
★ Play with Joy-Con™, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller or touchscreen.
★ Quick-start help system – perfect for beginners!
★ Settings to adjust pointer speed, sound on/off, background music on/off.
★ sizes 5x5, 10x10, 15x15 puzzle board, from easy to challenging.

Cross Pix 2 offers an immersive experience for puzzle lovers of all ages. 

Are you ready to take on the ultimate nonogram challenge and rise to the top of the world leaderboard? 

Note : Controller Mappings:
[A] Select/Mark
[B] Check board complete
[X] Toggle X or block marker
[Y] Centre puzzle board

70010000103552.name: Truck Driving
70010000103552.intro: Think you can drive it and park it perfectly?
70010000103552.description:
Drive a truck through simple routes and deliver your cargo to the destination. Avoid obstacles, make turns, and park in the right spot.

Enjoy straightforward controls and easy-to-learn gameplay. Unlock and choose from different truck skins to add your own style to the road.

70010000103557.name: Jimmy and the Pulsating Mass
70010000103557.description:
The game takes place in the dream of an eight-year-old boy. When an alien entity appears and threatens his family and the stability of the dream world itself, Jimmy sets out on an adventure to save his family and eradicate the threat of the Pulsating Mass. Along the way, Jimmy will have to work with his family, confront his own shortcomings, and brave the creeping nightmares of his subconscious.

Features:
* Full-length Japanese-style RPG.
* Classic turn-based combat with some modern sensibilities.
* A big emphasis on exploration.
* As an empathetic kid, Jimmy gains the ability to imagine himself as several of the monsters he meets, allowing him to interact with the world in new ways.
* These different transformations can also be leveled up, granting Jimmy higher stats and new abilities.
* A story for adults delivered from the perspective of a child.
* Jokes.
* Unspeakable horrors.

70010000103561.name: Neptune Spear
70010000103561.intro: Team up with a female sniper and take out the terrorists! Share the Joy-Con™ controller for a two-player arcade experience!
70010000103561.description:
Thwart the ambitions of terrorist organizations in a modern urban setting! Experience thrilling top-down action in bustling commercial districts and towering skyscrapers where intense battles unfold in the shadowy underground. Enjoy this immersive top-down shooter featuring tactical support and precise shooting by a skilled female sniper with exceptional analytical abilities. The game supports one to two players. By sharing a Joy-Con™ controller with another player, you can start cooperative gameplay anywhere, anytime.

・This is an excellently controlled, action-packed, top-down shooting game.
・Share a Joy-Con™ controller with a friend and start playing together anywhere.
・Each stage features story-driven missions for an exciting gaming experience.
・Clear the final stage to unlock a cinematic ending sequence.
・Enjoy greater variety with Story Mode and additional game modes.
・EPISODE Mode: Battle through story-driven missions to achieve completion.
・INVADE Mode: Infiltrate enemy bases and repel waves of attacking enemies.
・DEFENSE Mode: Defend your position against relentless enemy assaults.
・Gain experience points and level up by clearing stages.
・Unlock new weapons as you level up.
・Enjoy intense combat with spectacular 3D graphics.
・A rich collection of diverse weapon designs.
・There is an engaging upgrade system for both characters and weapons.
・Clear the final stage for an emotional ending! What conclusion awaits?

Team up with a female sniper who possesses precise tactical analysis skills and perfect marksmanship. Together, you can upgrade weapons and characters while conquering numerous stages. Share a Joy-Con™ controller with a friend for co-op play anytime, anywhere. Play like in classic arcade games with up to two players to thwart the ambitions of terrorists and criminal organizations! Join the special forces and protect the city's peace and future! It's time to put an end to the urban darkness!

Prologue
Three a.m. The low rumble of helicopter rotors echoes between the city's towering skyscrapers.
Inside the aircraft, a Special Forces Ranger focuses intently on the final mission briefing coming through his headset
"Enemy forces have taken control of the entire downtown district." The mission commander's cold voice crackles through the communications system.
"Fortunately, all civilians have been evacuated. Neutralize the enemy's key strongholds swiftly, but minimize collateral damage."
On the opposite side of the helicopter, the sniper deployed with him is analyzing real-time intelligence on her tablet.
She studies enemy troop positions, building layouts, and projected entry routes. Her analysis of the intelligence and her covering fire are crucial to the success of the operation.

"Neptune Spear operation commencing!" The Ranger shouts as he completes his final equipment check.
He verifies the magazine of his assault rifle and reorganizes the gear in his vest, which contains pistols and grenades.
It's time to dive into the heart of the city.

The helicopter rapidly descends over the commercial district, approaching the rope deployment point.
Below, neon-lit buildings and empty streets stretch out before them.
This concrete jungle is about to become their battlefield.

70010000103570.name: Legendary Spell
70010000103570.intro: Build your deck and unleash the most powerful spells.
70010000103570.description:
This is a deck-building roguelike game. Combine and upgrade over 100 carefully designed spells to forge the ultimate magical power.

More than 50 unique enemies appear across a wide variety of stages. Choose your own battle strategy and cast powerful spells at just the right moment to fend off endless waves of foes!

Encounter unexpected events, decide between risky or safer paths, face different enemies, pick different cards, and discover powerful relics!

70010000103584.name: Spot the Wrong Character
70010000103584.intro:
That Aha! moment feels so refreshing!
A new kind of brain-training puzzle using letters and clever thinking
70010000103584.description:
Compare the characters on the top and bottom, and find the one that’s different—before time runs out!
This brain-training game challenges your powers of observation and focus.

How to play is super simple:
・Start by carefully examining the characters on the top of the screen
・Then, look at the characters below and spot the one that’s different
・Once you find it, tap on it!

It may seem easy at first glance, but the time limit adds a surprising challenge!
Perfect for a quick brain workout during your free time.

Can’t find the answer? Use the hint button!
It will subtly point you toward the odd character—so don’t give up and keep going!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000103589.name: Gangsters in Love
70010000103589.description:
The Story:
You're leading an ordinary life in sunny California when suddenly you get kidnapped by LA's most wanted gang! Thrown into the extravagant life of these stylish but dangerous gangsters, you must choose one of them to watch over you.... but who can you trust? Living in the gang's world isn't easy, yet in the face of all the shootouts and explosions, an undeniable attraction begins to form... Not only are you the key to important information the gang needs, but you are also in possession of something else they're missing in their lives: your heart!


Characters:

Chance Valentine "The Boss"
Yoshimitsu Valentine  "The Yakuza"
Aurora James 　"The Hustler"
Ash Winters  "The Hitman"
Irving Monroe "The Justice"

Contents:
Main Stories from the app "Lovestruck: Choose Your Romance" up until Season 4

70010000103594.name: Arcade Archives TX-1
70010000103594.intro: Now, the cockpit opens into infinity.
70010000103594.description:
"TX-1" is a racing game released by TATSUMI in 1983.
Enjoy a powerful race, unique to the triple-screen display.
The course splits along the way, where deserts, coastlines, and city nightscapes dynamically flash past. Goals all around the world?! Cross the finish line and claim your glorious checkered flag!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish

70010000103604.name: Los Pingheros
70010000103604.intro: Los Pingheros: A multiplayer fighting game (8 players online/local). Battle in snowy, vibrant Mexico. Knock out opponents with snow to become the ultimate Pinghero
70010000103604.description:
Duck, dodge and toss. Los Pingheros is a multiplayer brawler for up to 8 players online or local. 
Join hectic battles in various modes and strive to become the ultimate Pinghero in Mexico by snowing your opponents out of the arena. 
 
ULTIMATE PENGUIN SHOWDOWN 
Join an exhilarating multiplayer action for memorable frenzied battles, playable with up to 8 players online and locally. 
Dive into the vibrant colors of Mexico, draped in a unique snowy mantle, and join the action alone or with your friends.

INTENSE BRAWL MODES
Prepare yourself for thrilling and diverse confrontations across a variety of modes, where only the most cunning penguins emerge victorious: 

	• Snowball School: This mode introduces players to the game’s mechanics through timed challenges, which can be completed either solo or up to 4 players.

	• Carnaval Cup: A chaotic mode where the rules change every round! It’s a wild mix of different game modes (details below). First to reach 12 Sols takes the cup!

	• Skill Storm: Power up your Pinghero with extra skills between rounds, ramping up the action and strategy with every battle!

	• Custom: Pick your rules, choose your maps, and create your own perfect showdown!

Secret Penguin Techniques - Access to the penguin's top survival tricks: the ultimate slide, the renowned penguin spinning top, and the celebrated "Made in Penguin" chokeslam, where your opponent definitely won't be pretending. 

Outsmart Your Opponents - Destroy the cacti to uncover power-ups. Be smart on how you use them! Keep an eye on the luchador mask that enrages your penguin, and game-changing items like the magic snowflake to freeze all other penguins to the bone.

The Mexican Dressing Room - Customize your penguins to reflect your unique style. As you progress, you unlock new clothing, hats, and color palettes. 

You are not alone - Watch out for your webbed feet ! In Mexico, you won't be alone. Slide in the wrong place and you might get bitten. 

Los Pingheros in a nutshell:
	• Up to 8 players local, online, or mixed
	• Play free for all or team with friends
	• Unique Snowy Mexican setting
	• Loads of power-ups and game modes
	• Cooperative Challenge mode
	• Destruct and construct the environment
	• Customize your Penguin and unlock even more as you progress!

70010000103620.name: Autumn Isle
70010000103620.description:
Step onto Autumn Isle, a tranquil hidden world where the leaves never stop falling and the air always feels crisp. Explore at your own pace as you wander through a peaceful landscape full of color, mystery, and calm.

There are no enemies, no time limits—just you, the island, and the rhythm of the seasons.

Features:
Wander freely – No rush, no pressure. Explore wherever your feet (or curiosity) take you.

Find hidden places – Cozy cabins, secret paths, and quiet overlooks to discover.

Calming sounds and music – A warm, ambient soundtrack to match every mood.

70010000103623.name: Q REMASTERED
70010000103623.description: Q REMASTERED is a simple puzzle game that anyone can enjoy! You can freely draw lines and shapes to solve all the missions. But be wary of gravity, however, as what you draw will fall as soon as you're done drawing! Available as part of the Q Collection Bundle and not for individual sale from Aksys Games.

70010000103625.name: Q2 HUMANITY
70010000103625.description: Q2 HUMANITY, the sequel to Q REMASTERED, introduces characters or 'humans' that can jump, bounce, throw things, and sometimes even exhibit special abilities. Along with the ability to draw, use these 'humans' and their 'character abilities' to solve all the puzzles! Q2 can be played solo or with up to 4 players locally. Available as part of the Q Collection Bundle and not for individual sale from Aksys Games.

70010000103632.name: Q with VTubers
70010000103632.description: Q with VTubers has a familiar to Q REMASTERED, but features new challenging and quirky puzzles designed by over 20 VTubers! Enjoy the new puzzles along with three original tracks created for this title. Available as part of the Q Collection Bundle and not for individual sale from Aksys Games.

70010000103634.name: HELLO KITTY AND FRIENDS: FREEZE TAG PARTY
70010000103634.description:
Game Overview: 

Hello Kitty and Friends: Freeze Tag Party is an action game where popular Sanrio characters play an exciting game of tag in a magical world! Choose to be either the Challenger (runner) or the Hunter (chaser) and enjoy thrilling tag matches using each character’s magical skills. 

 

Collect Jewels as you play to unlock new characters and dress them up in a variety of adorable outfits. Take on over 70 different missions for an even greater challenge! 

 

Step into a dreamlike magical world and enjoy unforgettable moments with all your favorite characters. 

 

Key Features: 

 

35 Adorable Sanrio Characters: Fan favorites like Hello Kitty, My Melody, and Cinnamoroll are here—along with many more! Each character comes with unique stats and magical skills, offering a variety of playstyles. Enjoy watching your favorite characters come to life with charming 3D animations and adorable movements! 

 

 

 

 

Challengers Include: Hello Kitty, Hello Mimmy, Dear Daniel, My Melody, My Sweet Piano, Littleforestfellow, Little Twin Stars (Kiki, Lala), Cinnamoroll, Mocha, Cappuccino, Chiffon, Espresso, Poron, Pompompurin, Pochacco, Tuxedosam, Kerokerokeroppi, Hangyodon, Ahirunopekkle, Wish me mell, SUGARBUNNIES (Shirousa, Kurousa), Bonbonribbon, U*SA*HA*NA 

 

 

Hunters Include: Kuromi, Baku, LLOROMANNIC (Berry, Cherry), Bad Badtz-Maru, Tzunko, Pandaba, GOROPIKADON (Goro, Pika, Don) 

 

Play with Friends and Family: using Local or Co-op Play. 

 

Unique Magical Skills: Each character has their own Skills—some are great for hiding, others for escaping, helping teammates, or chasing. As your character levels up, their magical skill also evolves, adding depth and replay value to every match. 

 

Dress-up Fun in the Shop: Head to the Shop to dress up your characters in stylish outfits! Try putting trendy glasses on Hello Kitty or dress My Melody in a dazzling gown—mix and match your favorite looks for each character. 

 

Mission Mode: In addition to standard tag battles, challenge yourself in Mission Mode, where you’ll need to meet specific conditions to clear each stage. There are 70 missions in total—35 as a Challenger and 35 as a Hunter—each awarding Gold, Silver, or Bronze trophies depending on your performance. Aim for Gold in every mission and show off your tag mastery. 

 

Magical Tag Battle System: Each match is a thrilling game of tag featuring 6 Challengers (runners) and 2 Hunters (chasers). Players take control of one character on either team. 

- Challengers win if at least one member escapes until the timer runs out. 

- Hunters win if they catch all Challengers within the time limit.

70010000103636.name: Murder Inc
70010000103636.intro: Top-down adrenaline-fueled shooter where time moves only when you do.
70010000103636.description:
In a grim world of chaos, where reality feels like a thin layer over madness, welcome to Murder Inc — a top-down adrenaline-fueled shooter where time and style are your ultimate weapons.

You are a mysterious operative, an antihero walking the fine line between life and death. Your targets are the criminals who rule the city from the labyrinth of filthy streets. But there’s a catch: every shot, strike, or step you take sets time in motion. The faster you move, the faster the world collapses around you.

Features:
- Time dynamics: Time only moves when you do. Use this to dodge bullets, plan your attacks, and craft action scenes worthy of a blockbuster.
- Brutal style: Every kill is a mix of speed, fury, and tactical precision.
- Adrenaline vibe: Stylish pixel visuals paired with a retro-wave soundtrack that keeps your heart racing.

70010000103641.name: NubiaPhobia
70010000103641.intro: Solve the wacky point & click puzzles filled with horror and humor!
70010000103641.description:
Solve the wacky point & click puzzles filled with horror and humor. Break the witch's curse on your home as you explore five distinct regions, each hiding a sacred key to unlock the village chest.

Features:
- Despite the bright graphics, this game is definitely not for children!
- Memorable characters with their own personality
- Ultra-high resolution artworks
- Unconventional humor
- Some evil creatures

70010000103657.name: Merge Match March
70010000103657.intro: An RPG that combines merge puzzles and battles, where you protect the kingdom from monsters!
70010000103657.description:
"Merge Match March" is an RPG that combines merge puzzles and battles, where you command an army led by heroes to protect the kingdom from monsters.

Merge three weapons to evolve into a unit, then send these units into battle to defeat the monsters!

■ Become a strategist and repel the monsters!

As the strategist of the hero-led army, you will command your troops to fend off attacking monsters and bring peace to the kingdom!

■ Rank up units through merging!

Merge units of the same class to rank them up! Create high-rank units and win battles!

■ Train your favorite units!

Choose units with diverse abilities from various professions to form your army! Strengthen your troops by training units and equipping them with weapons!

■ Use skills to gain an advantage in battles!

Trigger skills by making certain matches during battles! Assess the situation and use skills to gain the upper hand in battles!

70010000103665.name: New Yankee: Through the History Mirror Collector's Edition
70010000103665.intro: Step into another whirlwind of fantastical realms and timeless adventures with John and Mary, the legendary heroes!
70010000103665.description:
Guide John and Mary and their friends on two thrilling parallel escapades filled with excitement, perils, and regular errands! 
Explore mysterious lands and times, navigate mystical phenomena as you join them in traversing space and time.

While John and Mary venture into the unknown, you will also help their loyal companions - the brave dog Max, the wise Raven, the inventive Gremlin, and the erudite Spellbook - to unravel the mysteries of their disappearance. 
Their parallel quest takes them through enchanted forests, crystal caves brimming with wonders and dangers, and epic battles against undead invasions in an attempt to save John and Mary.

Will John and Mary ever return home? Can they survive the increasing frequency of time-space jumps and the perilous situations they find themselves in? 
Discover the fate of our heroes and their brave friends in this exhilarating journey through time and space.

Game Features:
- Complete 60 levels
- 13 levels with mini-games
- Separate access to clips, character descriptions and a guide
- Earn dozens of achievements
- Levels strategy guide
- Collectible puzzle pieces

70010000103666.name: Goritaire
70010000103666.intro:
Growing the gorilla troop.
A single-player card game.
No more bananas—the end.
70010000103666.description:
Where did gorillas come from? What are gorillas? Where are gorillas going? A single-player game of gorillas— That is GORITAIRE! Fill the jungle with gorillas!

Expand the gorilla habitat by growing the troop while ensuring a steady supply of bananas. To achieve victory, seven or more gorillas must be aligned on the ground. However, if any gorilla is left without food, defeat follows—marking the total collapse of the troop.

70010000103667.name: Starfall Defenders
70010000103667.description:
Starfall Defenders is a classic tower defense game that features unique towers and enemies. It also has an in-game shop system that allows players to purchase better towers, upgrade existing ones, and buy special items like the Atom Bomb, Splash Bomb, and Air Supply.

Players can earn coins for the shop by defeating boss enemies, saving lives, and unlocking new maps.

But Starfall Defenders offers more than just placing, upgrading, and selling towers. Players can also improve their gameplay by placing mines, blocking walls and electric fields directly on the path, and taking control of a tower’s direction and target. This player-controlled action is a unique feature within a defense game that allows players to directly hit their enemies.

* Shop system for buying and upgrading towers, buy specials
* 8 upgradable towers (2 power-ups each)
* Support towers, special attacks, path-placed items
* Unique enemies
* Unlockable levels
* Tower Control Mode: Take control over the target and direction of a tower
* Towers: Gun, Laser, Fireblaster, EMP, Cannon, Rocket, Flak, Artillery
* Power-up for each tower: Damage, Fire rate, Range
* Path-placed items: Mine, Electro Field, Block Wall
* Support Towers: Power Enhancement, Range Enhancement
* Global Specials: Big Bomb, Air support, Atom Bomb, Money upgrade (earn more money)

70010000103676.name: Celestial Fall
70010000103676.intro: A surreal 3D platformer with beauty, depth & exploration.
70010000103676.description: In this game, you follow the protagonist who initially fell from heaven back into the sky. The game is a unique combination of a third-person platformer and a light-hearted exploration game with an almost philosophical story-telling. It is highly stylized and surprises with breathtaking environments, a surreal world full of beauty and grace, and a couple of small environmental puzzles that blend perfectly into the peaceful yet stunning environments. Will you be able to make it back into heaven? Find it out.

70010000103677.name: Flying Aces: Legend of the Red Baron
70010000103677.intro: FLYING ACES: LEGEND OF THE RED BARON lets you take to the skies and experience joining the newly formed air forces during World War I.
70010000103677.description:
Accept hair-raising missions to destroy enemy bases while avoiding getting shot down by the hail of bullets!

Choose over 30 different aircraft and fly dozens of missions to knock down enemy Zeppelins and observation balloons while dodging enemy aircraft! Go on reconnaissance missions to photograph enemy movements and bring back accurate pictures for your bombers. Strafe enemy positions while supporting your troops on the ground!

Train with the Flying School tutorial and then Master your flying abilities with your customized aircraft. Join your Mechanic in the hangar and make improvements on your aircraft! Become famous by your amazing feats of daring do, earn promotions and fly the latest aircraft! Earn medals and awards as you master each mission while you lead your forces to victory!

Key Features
• Customize your aircraft
• Historically based missions
• Weapons include Rockets, Bombs and more
• Earn medals and promotions through Achievements
• Missions include Strafing, bombing, reconnaissance, escort and more
• Different types of Missions: Bombing, Strafing, Air Patrol, Recon and more!

70010000103692.name: Run from BLABLUBLAS horror
70010000103692.description:
Step into a place where nothing feels quite right — a silent, twisting space that seems to breathe on its own. Every corner hides a whisper, every shadow watches, and something follows your every move.

This is a horror experience built on tension, mystery, and the uneasy feeling that you're never truly alone. The walls feel too close, the silence too loud, and the presence behind you far too real.

Your only goal is simple, yet terrifying: keep moving, stay sharp, and don’t let fear slow you down. Because in this place… hesitation is dangerous.

Run fast. Think fast.
And whatever you do — don’t look back.

70010000103703.name: Liam and the Disaster of the Week
70010000103703.intro: Liam kicks the clock out of time! Along with a talking frog and a magic clock, he must find lost crystals in a world of crazy days and incredible creatures… before chaos catches up with him!
70010000103703.description:
The days of the week blur together, the past, present, and future become confused, and strange creatures appear everywhere. 

With the help of a talking frog and a slightly grumpy magic clock, Liam must find the lost time crystals to restore order… before a mysterious villain stops him! 

An adventure full of humor, color, and surprises that little ones will love.

Highlights:

·A fun and wacky story where each day of the week is a different surprise.

·Fascinating and unique characters, from wise frogs to Monday creatures with sunglasses.

·Super colorful backgrounds that change with each day, full of details and visual magic.

·Upbeat and friendly music, perfect for accompanying little ones on this adventure.

·A visual novel designed for little ones, with charming illustrations and accessible narrative.

·Easy time travel, with lots of humor and unexpected moments.

70010000103705.name: KAMI 2
70010000103705.description:
The calming yet addictive puzzle game is back!
With over 100 hand-crafted puzzles, Kami 2 takes you on a mind-twisting journey that combines logic and problem-solving.

Can you achieve perfection?
Flood each puzzle with a single color in as few moves as possible to claim a 'Perfect' sticker. But watch out for subtle new tricks and fiendish surprises.

Want even more?
Beat the global Daily Challenge, earn a winning streak and compare your scores to other players. Test yourself on thousands of user-generated puzzles, uploaded daily.

Get creative and take on the world.
Craft your own KAMI designs using the Puzzle Builder. Design and share your creations, send them to your friends and challenge the world to beat your score.

70010000103710.name: The Cloud Forest
70010000103710.intro: Follow the melodies of the wind through a magical world where seasons merge and secrets float in this visual novel.
70010000103710.description:
We invite you on a magical adventure through the Cloud Forest, where the seasons have blended and the wind has lost its way.

Meet Nimbus, a brave hare, and Aurora, a cunning fox, as they follow the currents to restore the lost balance of their home.

Discover enchanted places, ancient symbols, and hidden melodies in a world where the wind has a voice... and a memory.

Key Features
·An accessible and captivating story, ideal for young readers and families.

·Loving characters and settings full of natural magic.

·An emotional journey with messages about harmony, friendship, and connection with nature.

·A gentle environmental narrative, perfect for quiet reading moments.

·Teaches respect for the environment, empathy, and teamwork.

·Ideal for fostering imagination, reflection, and a love of nature and reading.

70010000103712.name: Big Hops
70010000103712.description:
BIG HOPS is a 3D platformer, action-adventure with deep movement, fresh frog-tongue gameplay, where you can grow veggies to build paths forward!

You'll play as Hop, a young frog who's been kidnapped from home by a trickster spirit called Diss. He has a mysterious, important mission and needs your help, but you just want to get back to your family... After a bit of searching, a wiry old Raccoon offers to build you a way home if you can find a few Airship Parts.

70010000103717.name: Twins of the Sun
70010000103717.intro:
Adventure shines brightest when family sticks together.
Explore wild lands and uncover secrets on your own or side by side.
70010000103717.description:
When a mysterious figure kidnaps their little sister, a pair of twins set off across wild lands-lush jungles, haunted mines, and ancient temples. Twins of the Sun is an action-adventure about co-op, courage, and family. Play solo or team up in 2-player local co-op to uncover the jungle’s darkest secrets.

Features:
• Two heroes, two styles – swap between twins or team up in local 2-player co-op.
• 25 handcrafted stages – jungles, forgotten villages, mines, and temples.
• Signature gear – wield the Stone Hammer and unleash bursts of magic from the Wand of the Gods.
• Memorable enemies & bosses – test timing, positioning, and teamwork.
• Power up on the fly – grab temporary boosts and secrets to turn the tide.

70010000103736.name: Rammy's Great Adventure Ⅰ&Ⅱ REMAKE
70010000103736.intro:
A remake of Japan's popular roguelike RPG!
Preserving the original pixel art atmosphere while adding new elements!
70010000103736.description:
The adventurous roguelike RPG “Rammy's Great Adventure Ⅰ &Ⅱ,” featuring the tomboyish treasure hunter Rammy seeking hidden treasures, has been fully remade in Unity while preserving the original pixel art atmosphere!

Use your judgment and strategy to reach the deepest depths in randomly generated dungeons where maps, items, and monster placements change every time!

Features include modernized controls and UI, a high-difficulty “Challenge Mode” with new monsters and equipment, “Additional Stories” depicting events after the main tales, an “Encyclopedia” detailing character and monster lore, Rammy's color customization, and online leaderboards for clear times. Packed with replay value!

70010000103743.name: KAZUMA KANEKO'S TSUKUYOMI
70010000103743.intro: Ancient myths awaken in a modern-day Babel. A tactical deck-building tower dungeon RPG from the legendary Demon Artist, Kazuma Kaneko.
70010000103743.description:
An all-new title from Demon Artist Kazuma Kaneko, the visionary mind behind a legacy of groundbreaking games.

Tokyo, 20XX. The colossal bay area megastructure, "THE HASHIRA," has been severed from the outside world. You are a "Tsukuyomi," an elite agent of a national defense organization. Your mission: Infiltrate the isolation zone, battle through a tower overrun by eldritch "Jinma," and ascend to the summit to uncover the terrifying truth.
20XX

Razor-Sharp Strategy: "Jinma Card" Battles
Engage in intense turn-based card combat where every decision carries weight. With a strict hand limit of just three cards, you must carefully manage your resources. Read the enemy’s telegraphed attacks and choose your path: use your "Jinma Cards" to strike, or hold them in hand to bolster your defenses? Every successful battle grants you a choice of a new Jinma card to add to your current deck, opening up endless strategic deck building possibilities. Experience a battle system that is streamlined, fast-paced, and deceptively deep.

A Gripping Story Where Myth and Reality Collide
A multi-perspective saga of four "Tsukuyomi" agents, each walking a divergent path. Switch between characters to experience their conflicting convictions and personal battles. Only by reaching the summit will you uncover the colossal truth hidden within THE HASHIRA.

Forge a Unique Arsenal Through Every Decision
Your decisions during exploration directly shape the properties of special "Creation Cards" that are earned and added to your deck over the course of your exploration. Even if you fall in battle, these cards are not lost to the void. Instead, you retain the chance to reclaim them in future runs. Through repeated cycles of death and rebirth, your deck expands and evolves, allowing you to craft a build that is uniquely yours.

70010000103770.name: PRITTO PRISONER - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000103770.intro: Escape or capture in this cute and chaotic 4v2 action party game! Play as mischievous animal prisoners using peepee, poopie, and special skills to escape.
70010000103770.description:
About This Game
Unleash the mayhem in Pritto Prisoner, the cute and chaotic 4v2 asymmetrical party game where animal inmates lay poopie traps, spray peepee, and use special skills to outwit robot guards. 

Inside a notorious island prison, the world’s cutest criminals, including a gangster rabbit, an influencer cat, and even a penguin chef, are locked in maximum security under 24/7 robot surveillance. 

Will you scramble to freedom as a poopie-dropping prisoner, or hunt them down as a custom-built robot warden? Choose your side and jump into unpredictable escapes, chaotic chases, and laugh-out-loud clashes where no two matches ever play out the same!

ANIMAL TEAM

・Complete funny and unique objectives around the prison to open the escape gates.
・Eat bread and drink water to fuel your potty powers: poopie and peepee.
・Poopie: dropping your load in toilets powers you up and brings you one step closer to freedom！
・Peepee: unleash your bladder on robots and cameras to short-circuit them, giving your team a chance to escape.
・Whether you’re slicing through robots as a lion sword master or dropping explosive decoy art as an elephant fraudster, every animal packs unique skills and passives that unlock outrageous new playstyles!
・Captured animals go to the Nap Room, where counting sheep can bring them back. Get tucked in too many times and it’s Deep Sleep for good!

ROBOT TEAM

・Build your robot from mix-and-match parts, combining upper and lower bodies with gadgets and boosts that let you capture in your own way.
・Uppers: shape your offense with weapons like the Stun Gun for shocking captures or the Lasso for long-range takedowns.
・Lowers: change the way you move with options like legs, wheels, or tank treads to chase down escapees.
・Equip gadgets and boosts like the Magic Hand to trap animals, the Wormhole to slip through walls, the Motion Sensor to track their moves, and the Shield to block enemy peepee.
・Collect poopie left behind during the match to unlock stronger upgrades and supercharge your robot.
・Coordinate with your robot partner to turn every escape attempt into a chaotic back-and-forth of counters, traps, and mayhem.

KEY FEATURES

・Asymmetrical 4v2 multiplayer with animals on the run and robots on the hunt
・Quick 10-minute matches perfect for party play
・A hilarious yet strategic peepee-and-poopie gameplay loop
・Kanahei’s adorable art style and TeddyLoid’s energetic soundtrack
・Cross-platform play
・Single-player campaign to uncover the secrets of Prison Island
・Complete Pritto Challenges to earn Pritto Coins and unlock decorations
・Customize your animals and robots with a variety of fun decorations
・Host private matches with your friends using custom settings

70010000103785.name: The Pig Cow: Horizons of the New Valley
70010000103785.intro: Interactive graphic novel that tells the exciting adventures of Rosie, a curious and fun cow who grew up and was raised in a cozy family of pigs.
70010000103785.description:
Rosie struggles with her identity, caught between the world of pigs and her cow-like nature. With the support of her new family, she tries to grunt and enjoy the mud like a pig.

But questions arise, like: Am I more of a pig or more of a cow?

Along the way, you'll discover important lessons about friendship, along with respect for nature and the importance of perseverance.

Join Rosie, Ricky, and Toby in this incredible story, full of adventure, laughter, and learning.

·Kid- and family-friendly game.
·Accessible text and narrative for young readers.
·Dynamic and colorful images inspired by wildlife.
·Ambient music.
·Accessibility options such as text size and volume.
·Educational fun with content that promotes positive values.

70010000103787.name: Sophia's Animal Clinic - Mission Wildlife Park
70010000103787.intro: Sophia's Animal Clinic - where love for animals becomes an adventure!
70010000103787.description:
Your veterinary adventure begins at the wildlife park! Help injured and sick animals such as horses, deer, ducks, donkeys, goats, rabbits, and many more. 

With a great deal of empathy, you examine symptoms, make diagnoses, and treat over 30 different diseases. Each animal has individual needs and is waiting for your expert help. 

Use modern instruments, accompany your patients' recovery step by step, and experience a varied everyday life in the animal park.  

Intuitive controls, realistic treatments, and lovingly animated animals make this game a highlight for young animal lovers. 

Sophia's Animal Clinic - Mission Wildlife Park combines fun gameplay with educational insights into the world of veterinary medicine - a real experience for anyone who loves animals!

• Explore the extensive wildlife park and find injured or sick animals.
• Use veterinary tools for diagnosis and treatment.
• Earn the trust of the animals – with patience, empathy, and care.
• 10 different animal species, including ibex, wild boar, fox, deer, and many more.
• Learn exciting facts about the animal species.
• Learn about 30 diseases and different treatments.

70010000103792.name: Hole Digging Simulator 2025
70010000103792.intro: Dig deeper for priceless secret discoveries.
70010000103792.description:
Welcome to Hole Digging Simulator 2025 — your ultimate sandbox for exploration beneath the surface! Armed with a shovel and endless curiosity, you’ll dig your way through layers of earth, uncovering rare treasures, forgotten relics, and strange secrets hidden underground.

Start small in your own backyard and upgrade your tools as you unearth valuables. Sell what you find, reinvest in better gear, and dig even deeper. Each discovery brings new excitement — and perhaps a clue to an ancient mystery waiting below. There are no deadlines, no pressure — just you, the dirt, and the thrill of what lies beneath.

Game Features:
• Mystery Beneath the Soil – Piece together clues and unlock a story buried deep underground.
• Treasure Economy – Sell artifacts and materials to fund better gear and uncover new dig zones.
• Relaxed Exploration – No timers or stress—dig at your own pace and enjoy the process.
• Tool & Gear Progression – Upgrade everything from basic shovels to high-tech excavation tools.
• Infinite Digging Fun – The deeper you go, the rarer and more exciting the finds.

Ready to dig into the unknown? Grab your gear, break ground, and see what secrets await in Hole Digging Simulator 2025. The earth is full of wonders—you just have to dig deep enough.

70010000103797.name: ASCENDANCE UNBOUND
70010000103797.intro: Enter the enigmatic world of ASCENDANCE and experience an enchanting and peaceful journey to the sky and beyond.
70010000103797.description:
ASCENDANCE is a calming, relaxing and minimalist first person 3D Platformer. 
Shape your way with mysterious abilities and rise with the enchanted wind platforms beyond the skies within a world which evolves and transforms around you. 

A journey which leads through different ages of our world awaits you. 

Features:
+ minimalistic and low poly aesthetics with colorful and vibrant vistas
+ peaceful and playful, easy to play and progress at your own pace
+ a emotional and enchanting soundtrack will accompany you on your journey
+ smooth platforming and flying gameplay
+ hidden secrets to find
+ 3 different and visual unique Levels
+ a mysterious surprise awaits you at the end
+ even more Levels, mechanics and time mode with future updates

70010000103805.name: Pad Quad
70010000103805.description:
Get ready to bounce into action with Pad Quad, a lightning-fast platformer where padel meets pure arcade fun! Control adorable pixel mascots inspired by QUAD Sports rackets and race across futuristic arenas packed with enemies, traps, and tricky jumps.
Collect three racket pieces before time runs out, rebound energy balls to take down robots, and keep your reflexes sharp as you leap through laser nets, dodge spinning saws, and trigger moving platforms. Each level is a quick challenge designed for instant play and pure satisfaction, perfect for anyone who loves fast runs and flashy reactions.
With simple controls, no tutorials, and a one-minute timer pushing you to the limit, Pad Quad delivers non-stop energy in bite-sized bursts of fun. Whether you’re new to games or a speedrunner at heart, you’ll find yourself smashing, bouncing, and dashing for just one more round!

70010000103810.name: Sokobear Winter
70010000103810.description:
Adjust the temperature and relax in the spa!

Sokobear Winter is a relaxing puzzle game with 40 cozy levels to warm up your day!
Push the logs into the correct spots to raise the spa’s temperature to perfection. But beware: blocks of ice block your path and must be broken before you can move forward.

Challenge yourself to complete each stage with the fewest moves and in the shortest time possible.

Things can get tricky… how do you get that log over there if you can only push?

Features:

Break ice blocks and push logs

A cute bear to keep you company

40 unique and challenging levels

70010000103815.name: .cat 2
70010000103815.intro: The famous game .cat is now fully recreated in this reboot version.
70010000103815.description: Guide an adorable little cat on its mission to escape dangers and conquer each stage. Adventure and precision come together in this platforming experience.

70010000103820.name: BUBBLE SYMPHONY
70010000103820.description:
*This product is available for purchase as part of the bundle for “BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons” and “BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Deluxe Edition”.

A port of the 1997 home console version of the action game BUBBLE SYMPHONY, which originally appeared in arcades in 1994.
Choose from four characters, each with different abilities, and play in two-player co-op mode! You can also enjoy a variety of worlds by choosing a course from the doors that appear after clearing each world. Characters and worlds from other TAITO titles appear as well!
Defeat enemies, collect hidden items to solve puzzles, and aim for the true ending!

70010000103831.name: Cat God Ranch
70010000103831.intro: Lead hundreds of "wise" little animals to pay tribute to the Cat God!!
70010000103831.description:
Take on the role of ranch manager and grow your fledgling herd of animals into one worthy of pleasing the Cat God! There are many different paths to choose, but only one hurdle to overcome at the end of each week. Pay tribute to the Cat God or face his wrath and have your ranch be shut down.

Over 100 types of animals, all with their own unique abilities. Whether it's alpacas, crocodiles, hyenas, larks, or a combination of all, you choose the kind of ranch you want to build.

Take advantage of 7 different animal families in the game. Feed your barnyard buddies to the carnivores, or watch an army of penguins and pandas propagate across your ranch. Either way you want to build, the tribute must be paid!

Develop your ranch with different terrain and watch your animals thrive. Combine grasslands, caves, puddles, and other tile cards to create endless possibilities and combos.

Tango with 100+ prop cards to make tribute in time! As you improve on your ranch, the Cat God will bestow you with prop cards. Add these modifiers to your daily earnings and watch them grow!

With 10+ cat gods, 100+ animals, 100+ props, 20+ toys, 10+ tiles, it's time to build your own unique deck and appease the Cat God!

70010000103869.name: Neko Bento 2
70010000103869.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest lunchbox puzzle is back with even more satisfying challenges!
70010000103869.description:
Say hello to Neko Bento 2 — a flavor-packed puzzle experience where lunch is still cute, but now even trickier to pack!

This time your favorite feline chef is back with even more riddles to solve! You thought you knew it all? Think again because these levels with brand new ingredients and shapes will put your spatial brain to the test.

Although the challenge has risen, you don’t have to worry too much about that. You may have as much time as you like to complete a puzzle.

What will Neko Bento 2 serve you?
- Over 90 levels to eat up.
- 29 various ingredients to organize - pay attention to their shapes, it’s crucial…
- Music track that will help your mind focus and lock in!
- Artwork that will win your taste over… and not only the music one.

Chefs tend to be impatient, so don’t wait for too long and become the ultimate bento master!

70010000103874.name: EGGCONSOLE THE LEGEND OF HEROES III: "White Witch" Renewal PC-9801
70010000103874.intro: The dawn of the Gagharv Trilogy. Join Jurio and Chris to uncover the truth behind the White Witch!
70010000103874.description:
This role-playing game was originally released by Nihon Falcom in 1994. Titled "Renewal," this version is based on the original The Legend of Heroes III but features improved game mechanics and balance.

Players control Jurio, a somewhat timid boy, and the heroine Chris, as they embark on a pilgrimage for their village's coming-of-age ceremony. Before long, their journey leads them to unravel the mystery of the "White Witch."

The game features a top-down perspective with random encounters. Combat utilizes an auto-battle system, making it intuitive and accessible for everyone. However, the early game can be challenging due to a small party size. In such situations, adjusting the combat settings in the command menu is recommended.

True to the Falcom style, this title offers a grand narrative and unique character interactions, allowing players to enjoy a quintessential RPG experience. It is incredibly content-rich; the prologue and first chapter alone exceed the volume of the entire previous game, forming a massive nine-chapter saga.

As part of The Legend of Heroes series, this game serves as the first entry in the second arc, known as the "Gagharv Trilogy." The story unfolds within a shared universe that connects to The Legend of Heroes IV: A Tear of Vermillion and The Legend of Heroes V: Song of the Ocean.

70010000103877.name: Nuclear Gladiators 3000
70010000103877.intro: Fight hordes of mutants, boost your skills, and claim victory on live TV!
70010000103877.description:
In the year 2040, TV gets dangerous!
Welcome to Nuclear Gladiators 3000 - the ultimate action roguelite where YOU are the star of a live-broadcast survival show! Mutants, explosions and way too many bullets on screen… this isn’t just television, it’s survival with style. And guess what? The next superstar of prime time is YOU!


Step into the ultimate live-broadcast arena, where every run is a chaotic mix of bullet hell dodging, roguelite progression, and mutant-smashing mayhem. Pick up outrageous weapons, and upgrade your skills to keep the audience cheering. Each run is fast, packed with chaos, and full of surprises!


KEY FEATURES:
- Battle endless waves of mutants in retro-futuristic arenas
- Choose from unique Gladiators, each with special abilities
- Face off against tough bosses and champions of the show
- Unlock weapons, upgrades, and permanent power boosts
- Complete quests to build fame and unlock new bonuses
- Quick, replayable runs in colorful pixel-art style


Do you have what it takes to survive the show and become a legend?

70010000103882.name: Bloodshed
70010000103882.intro: Retro roguelite FPS chaos with Survivors-like combat action.
70010000103882.description:
Bloodshed is an exhilarating fusion of Roguelite elements merged with retro-styled visuals and first-person “Survivors-like” frenetic combat action: Face endless waves of undead foes, collect experience points, and upgrade your skills and weapons in a battle to survive the night.
