Even after death, you keep your hard-earned money which can be exchanged for persistent improvements and unlockable content, allowing you to progress further while adding depth to the overall gameplay.

Face the malevolent threat of the Cult, whose members are pursuing a sinister plan to resurrect an ancient deity to bring about the apocalypse. Battle countless cultists, undead, demons, and other creatures of the night and send them (back) to their graves!

Each enemy presents a unique challenge and requires its own strategy - and you'd better get ready quickly, because they come in masses!

Bloodshed boasts a diverse roster of playable characters, each with distinct abilities and playstyles, providing a personalized gameplay experience. With a vast selection of weapons and skills at your disposal, you can experiment with various builds to discover the ideal strategy for your survival.

With a bit of luck and the right strategy you will stand your ground against the hordes of darkness!

Death doesn’t stop you from progressing. Persistent upgrades, unlockable content, and continuous improvement await in Bloodshed, with the ability to exchange hard-earned cash for permanent upgrades. You can also complete optional objectives for unlocking new skills and game features, ensuring each run pushes you further into the depths of the Cult's dark world.

Features: 
Engaging FPS Gameplay: Experience fast-paced, intense auto-shooter battles across a variety of biomes
Diverse Character Selection: Play as distinct heroes, each with unique strengths, weaknesses, and special abilities.
Extensive Arsenal: Discover and upgrade numerous weapons and skills to craft the ultimate build
Permanent Upgrades System: Progress continuously, unlocking permanent character upgrades to boost replayability
Dynamic Enemy Hordes: Fight against adaptable enemies with unique abilities and attack patterns. Face off against elite foes who offer even more loot!
Retro Look, Rockin’ Feel: Enjoy pixelated Boomer Shooter graphics and highly dynamic, fluid movement mechanics.
Immersive Soundtrack: Dive into the atmospheric world of Bloodshed with an adaptive soundtrack that intensifies the action.
Visceral Combat: Relish the visually striking gore effects and satisfying combat that elevate every battle.
Swappable Shooting Modes: Use auto-shooting for a more Survivors-like experience, or “switch to manual” to aim and shoot your way!

70010000103887.name: Monster Ramp Racing
70010000103887.intro: Get ready for the ultimate monster truck challenge!
70010000103887.description:
Monster Ramp Racing is not just another racing game—it’s an adrenaline-fueled ride that pushes your driving skills to the limit. Take the wheel of massive, customizable monster trucks, conquer giant ramps, perform epic jumps, and master endless climbing roads in the most thrilling off-road experience on mobile!

Strap in for heart-pounding action as you launch your truck high into the air, balance perfectly on impossible slopes, and smash through tough terrain. Whether you’re going for record distances in Endless Mode or tackling dozens of missions, every race delivers pure monster truck mayhem with stunning visuals and responsive controls.

Key Features:

Variety of Monster Trucks – Unlock and drive multiple monster trucks, each with unique power upgrades in Engine, Suspension, Friction, and Fuel.

Adjustable Build – Tweak your truck’s suspension height and wheel size to match any terrain and your driving style.

40 Different Missions – Test your skills on challenging climbing roads designed for endless fun. Push your truck to the limit as you conquer mission after mission.

Expansive Maps – Race across Desert, Forest, and Snowy Peaks environments.

Realistic Physics and Controls – Enjoy responsive handling, dynamic suspension, and satisfying jumps with smooth, intuitive controls designed for mobile gaming.

70010000103895.name: Shadow of the Five Moons: Code of the Ninja
70010000103895.intro: Unleash the silent fury of a true ninja and uncover the secrets of the Five Moons
70010000103895.description:
Enter a world of stealth, steel, and ancient secrets in Shadow of the Five Moons: Code of the Ninja.
You play as a legendary ninja tasked with recovering five powerful artifacts hidden across dangerous lands—bamboo forests, mountain fortresses, and neon-lit cities. Silent assassins, rifle-wielding ninjas, and deadly traps stand in your way as you master both sword and gun in this action-packed adventure.
Every moon holds a secret. Every step is a test.

70010000103901.name: Brainrot Turbo Kart
70010000103901.intro:
High-speed chaos with meme-fueled racers
Unlock tracks, drivers, and abilities 
Split-screen fun for two players!
70010000103901.description:
Start your engines — the ultimate meme-fueled kart racing experience is here!
In Brainrot Turbo Kart, players dive into a fast-paced, arcade-style racing adventure where chaotic fun meets over-the-top action.

Race through vibrant tracks filled with wild twists, sharp turns, and unexpected surprises. Each track brings unique challenges and special abilities to master, ensuring no two races ever feel the same.

Choose from a roster of hilarious and bizarre meme-inspired characters, each driving their own unique kart. Unlock new racers and tracks as you progress, adding fresh excitement to every race.

Play solo or share the madness with a friend in split-screen multiplayer, doubling the chaos and competition. Complete achievements, discover secrets, and prove you’re the fastest (and funniest) racer on the track!

Key Features:

- Fast-paced arcade kart racing with colorful tracks and crazy turns
- Meme-inspired characters with their own unique karts
- Special abilities & power-ups to dominate your rivals
- Achievements and unlockables for endless replay value
- Local split-screen multiplayer for up to 2 players
- Multiple themed environments, from deserts to mountain cliffs

Get ready to drift, boost, and laugh your way to victory in Brainrot Turbo Kart!

70010000103906.name: Indoor Baseball
70010000103906.intro: Play fast-paced 1v1 baseball where your parents wouldn’t let you. Smash windows, wreck the house, and dodge the chaos in this arcade-style baseball game
70010000103906.description:
Indoor Baseball Features:
-Each indoor field has its own wild ways to crush home runs and cause chaos
-Choose from 16 unique characters, each with their own stats and playstyle
-12+ indoor fields packed with hazards, obstacles, and gameplay twists
-Jump into Story Mode and see if you’ve got what it takes to make the school's baseball team
-Take a break with 7 crazy Mini Games like Keepy Uppy, Cutting the Grass, and Toddler Tag
-Play a 12 game Season Mode with playoffs and a Championship Game
-Compete in Moonshot Mayhem—rack up points with home runs and destruction
-Challenge a friend and play 1v1 local multiplayer

70010000103911.name: The Wolf and the Blood Moon／オオカミと赤い満月
70010000103911.intro: Little Red Riding Hood fused with the wolf...! A dark fairy tale inspired by 'Little Red Riding Hood'!
70010000103911.description:
This is a multi-ending sound novel game based on the story of Little Red Riding Hood.
You can enjoy a darker twist on the classic tale, featuring a slightly different version of Red Riding Hood.
Despite the dark elements, it remains a fairy tale that even young children can enjoy.
The Japanese version features full voice acting and can be enjoyed in auto-play mode!

70010000103916.name: Color Breakers 2
70010000103916.intro: A casual co-op game about coloring with friends!
70010000103916.description:
Color Breakers is back, this time with even more colors to break! Invite your friends and enjoy cooperative (or competitive) multiplayer modes on dozens of levels designed for up to eight players - with procedurally generated paintings and gameplay twists in each level. And that’s not all: Fancy a story? Color Breakers 2 introduces a completely new story mode, using the procedural generation to keep it fresh with each playthrough.

Introducing: Story Mode 
It’s time to save the Color Museum! Robbers have stolen masterpieces from its halls and it’s your job to go out into the world to save them. Travel from the cold, mountainous Breakerville, to the arid deserts of Wild Wild Breaker, to the ancient secrets of the Temple of the Lost Color, all in order to recreate the masterworks of old, one color at a time. Each location has a unique canvas, with a procedurally generated painting to rebuild and different goals and challenges to keep every playthrough fresh!

Online and Local Co-Op 
The floor’s your canvas - but it’s always better with friends! Race the clock with up to eight players online - or discover your next party game thanks to local multiplayer. Collaborate on the next great work of art with friends, working together on unique masterpieces in new, crazy locations - just be careful not to step on each other’s toes. Completing each painting is trickier than it seems…

Versus Mode!  
Of course, you can always go from accidentally stepping on each other’s toes to deliberately doing just that. The new and improved Versus Mode pits players in a race to become the next great painter, trying to complete the painting ahead of the opposing team. It’s the ultimate painting competition: Can you complete the paintings before the other team, navigating the unique challenges of each canvas, the pitfalls of team communication, and of course the pressure of the competition’s brushes…

70010000103921.name: Bananitro
70010000103921.intro: Unique physics that bring amazing maneuvers to life
70010000103921.description:
Reach top speed by eating Bananas?!

Bananitro is a 2D runner that combines speed, action, and a unique gravity mechanic, bringing an amazing mix of monkeys and bicycles.

RUN TO WIN
Race with Monkey and his bike, using Bananitro to reach insane speeds, ride on walls, perform crazy maneuvers, and make jumps that defy the laws of physics! But be careful, each track presents a new challenge, filled with obstacles that require agility, skill, and precision!

CHALLENGE YOUR CREATIVITY
In Bananitro, there are no rules for fun! Race your way: be fast, bold, fearless, or completely unpredictable. Use your creativity to conquer the races and surprise at every turn. Here, the only limit is your imagination!

FEATURES:
 Unique physics that bring amazing maneuvers to life
 30 levels full of varied challenges
 Frenetic races that test your reflexes and skills

70010000103935.name: Smack it! PUNCH CHAMPION
70010000103935.intro:
The arcade's popular attraction, the Punching Machine, is here!
Test your power and become the ultimate champion!
70010000103935.description:
Use Joy-Con™ motion controls to throw exhilarating punches!
The built-in gyro sensors make every hit feel real!

[Score Attack]
Hold a Joy-Con™ in each hand and follow your partner's instructions to punch!
Hit as hard as you can and climb the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Face off against CPUs in single-player mode!
Share Joy-Con™ and go head-to-head with family and friends!
Up to 4 players can join the action!

[Partner Select]
Choose from over 10 different partners who will block your punches!
Team up with your favorite character and become the ultimate champion!

70010000103983.name: Crash The Car Death Race
70010000103983.intro:
Race fast. Smash harder.
No rules. No mercy.
Only the last car survives.
70010000103983.description:
Crash The Car: Death Race
In this high-octane demolition racer, there’s only one rule—destroy anything in your path! Pick your car, arm it with powerful weapons, and tear through dangerous tracks packed with traps, obstacles, and relentless rival drivers.
Speed alone won’t win the race—you’ll need sharp reflexes, deadly aim, and a taste for chaos to survive. Smash opponents off the road, dodge incoming attacks, and trigger spectacular explosions as you fight to be the last car standing.
Upgrade your vehicle, unlock new battle machines, and take on increasingly challenging events in your quest to become the ultimate death race champion.
Features:
Single-player combat racing mayhem
Multiple vehicles to unlock and upgrade
Weapons, power-ups, and explosive destruction

Adrenaline-pumping tracks filled with hazards

70010000103987.name: Heroes of Mount Dragon
70010000103987.intro: Unleash dragon-morphing powers in this action-packed side-scrolling brawler!
70010000103987.description:
Step into the mystical world of Üna, where ancient power stirs and chaos rises. As one of eight dragon-bound champions, battle through monster-infested lands, master unique fighting styles, and transform into awe-inspiring dragons to reclaim balance. Whether you're flying solo or brawling alongside friends, prepare for a fiery showdown!


-Choose from 8 distinct heroes, each infused with the soul of a dragon. Master their combat styles, build devastating combos, and unleash their dragon forms in the heat of battle.


-Smash through hordes of enemies with fluid controls and dynamic attacks. Fight across colorful, hand-crafted levels in both solo and multiplayer modes. Unlock upgrades, push your skills, and face off against increasingly formidable foes.


-Team up with up to 3 players online or in local couch co-op in Adventure Mode, or challenge your friends in wild competitive brawls. Want to win? Prove your mettle by outlasting your rivals and mastering the chaos.


-Add a twist to any match with hilarious curses: shrink your opponents, flip their controls, or turn them into a frog. Disrupt their rhythm and turn the tides in unexpected ways.


-Explore a visually striking world where 2D hand-drawn art is brought to life in 3D. Every realm bursts with color, depth, and charm.


The world teeters on the edge of destruction. The Celestial Dragon, last of her kind, has vanished—and only the Dragon-Souls, heroes bound to her legacy, can uncover the truth and restore order. Awaken the power within. And fight to become the legend Üna needs.

70010000103995.name: Battle Suit Aces
70010000103995.intro: Enter a mecha and monster-filled world from the award-winning Battle Chef Brigade team
70010000103995.description:
Battle Suit Aces is a charming card-battling RPG. You'll recruit, befriend, and upgrade your mech pilots on a heartfelt hunt for fabled alien superweapons: the Relic Suits. Command them across monster-infested galactic wilds through danger, tragedy, and comedic sci-fi shenanigans.

• Embark on a personalized adventure full of memorable fully-voiced characters

• Carefully guide your eager pilots to win streamlined 5 vs 5 card battles

• Add to your deck from 5 specialist Factions and mod them into a synergistic team

The Second Voice is calling. Will you listen?

70010000104000.name: Solid Void Art Nonograms
70010000104000.intro:
A great collection of nonograms!
Uncover art hidden within puzzles!
Have fun and exercise your brain!
70010000104000.description:
Solid Void combines classic nonogram puzzles with pentomino-like jigsaws. Uncover the art bits hidden in nonograms and finish them in the other puzzle style to see beautiful artwork!

Solid Void delivers hours of relaxing but also challenging gameplay. Whether you're a nonogram veteran or a newbie, the game is well-balanced and you'll surely enjoy your time spent on solving the puzzles. 

Bring beautiful art to life and master Solid Void!

70010000104002.name: Colorizing: Cozy Days
70010000104002.intro: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation
70010000104002.description:
This coloring book is a guarantee of good mood.
In it you can find all kinds of pictures for every taste.
Coloring by numbers with Colorizing is a calming and easy activity for people of all ages. 
This drawing game is suitable for children and adults, everyone can enjoy pixel coloring.
You will definitely love coloring with this beautiful coloring book!

70010000104005.name: no brake no gain
70010000104005.intro: Put your driving skills to the test in the ultimate arcade driving game packed with wild challenges, chaotic tracks, and endless opportunities to show off your precision and control!
70010000104005.description:
BUILD. CUSTOMIZE. DRIVE.
no brake no gain is an arcade precision-driving game where skill outshines speed. Navigate intense, obstacle-packed tracks where every dodge, drift, and turn demands ultimate control.

Take on a series of high-stakes driving challenges designed to push your reflexes and creativity to the limit. Complete tricky objectives, from speed-based sprints to navigating trap-laden courses. Whether you're dodging hazards or chasing perfection, every level demands mastery!

ARCADE PRECISION DRIVING
Feel the thrill of tight, responsive controls that reward skill and creativity. Master each challenge with pinpoint accuracy as you weave through traps, perform daring maneuvers, and reach the mysterious idol in style.

GARAGE CUSTOMIZATION
Upgrade your cars to handle tougher challenges with confidence. Fine-tune speed and handling, and paint your vehicle to match your personal style as you prepare to conquer every challenge.

VERSUS MINIGAMES
Gather your friends for local multiplayer chaos! Compete in exciting game modes like Capture the Flag, Pass the Bomb, and Survival. May the best driver win!

DYNAMIC LEVELS
Conquer wild, unpredictable tracks filled with lasers, moving platforms, explosive barrels, and other inventive obstacles. Adapt, react, and push your skills to the limit!

70010000104023.name: Smoots Crazy Wave
70010000104023.intro: Join the Smoots and win all the championships in Smoots Crazy Wave
70010000104023.description:
Get ready for a splashing good time in Smoots Crazy Wave! This fast-paced arcade racer brings the beloved Smoots characters to thrilling water tracks where you’ll compete for victory. Whether you prefer classic Slalom races, powerup-filled mayhem, or intense Battle Royale showdowns, there's a mode for every type of racer.

Race across vibrant locations like Honu Island, Iceland, and the mysterious Lost World, using skill and strategy to outpace your rivals. And if you’re falling behind, grab a powerup to turn the tide! Play solo or challenge up to 3 friends in local multiplayer to prove who rules the waves.

Features
- Local multiplayer: Up to 4 players can race together in split-screen mode.
- Exciting game modes: Choose from Slalom, Powerups, Battle Royale, Time Trial, and Exhibition.
- 14 unique Smoots: Each character has their own stats.
- Colorful tracks: Race across exotic locations, from tropical beaches to icy landscapes.
- Are you ready to ride the waves?

70010000104025.name: Nora: In Search of Hidden Ingredients
70010000104025.intro: Help Nora uncover her grandma’s secrets and the magic hidden inside.
70010000104025.description:
Part heartfelt story, part hidden object chaos — this is a magical adventure where nothing stays the same for long. Expect quirky surprises, enchanted doodads, and plenty of laughs along the way!


Nora thought life at the Magical Academy was going to be all sparkles and broomsticks… until it wasn’t! Now she’s back in her grandma’s old town of Lillyton, where claiming Granny’s house means solving magical puzzles, digging through piles of wacky objects, and outsmarting a cheeky Spirit who LOVES to mess with reality.


KEY FEATURES:
- A charming mix of visual novel and hidden object gameplay
- Hidden object levels across 9 unique locations
- Randomized items and challenges for endless variety
- Heartwarming story about family, memories, and magic
- Beautiful hand-drawn art style
- Freeplay mode for HO fan

70010000104033.name: Mahjong Masters Club
70010000104033.intro: Match, relax, and master the tiles in Mahjong Masters Club!
70010000104033.description:
Relax your mind and sharpen your focus in Mahjong Masters Club — the ultimate puzzle experience for fans of classic tile-matching games!

Enjoy 100 beautifully crafted levels across 4 unique sceneries, each offering its own atmosphere and tile set. Whether you’re a casual player or a true Mahjong enthusiast, every session brings calm, challenge, and satisfaction.

Need a little help? Use Hints to find your next move or Re-shuffle the tiles to keep the game flowing.

A perfect companion for peaceful moments and brain-boosting fun.
Join the club — become a true Mahjong Master!

70010000104038.name: Neko Ramen
70010000104038.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest ramen puzzler is piping hot!
70010000104038.description:
It's time to try ramen like you've never had before! Filled with delicious aromas, Neko Ramen will stimulate your logical thinking and ignite your senses!


Fulfill ramen orders under the guidance of a true master – the one and only feline chef! Each ramen is a perfectly calculated arrangement of flavors and shapes, so strain your brain to accommodate all the ingredients! But be careful, because intense thinking can be as spicy for the mind as ramen itself!


The orders will become increasingly sophisticated and difficult (but also more delicious). However, you don't have to worry about that, as you have as much time as you want to prepare the dish!


Here's what you'll find on the Neko Ramen menu:
- Over 90 scrumptious levels!
- 29 ingredients to compose perfect dishes.
- Music that will make you want ramen yourself.
- And charming graphics that stimulate both the eyes and the taste buds!

Do not wait, because even though the ramen will not get cold, the cat chief may not be so forgiving!

70010000104045.name: Silky Winds
70010000104045.intro: A Serene Journey Through a Stylized Eastern Landscape
70010000104045.description:
Step into a tranquil world where time slows down and nature speaks in whispers. Silky Winds is a peaceful first-person walking simulator set in a beautifully stylized Asian-inspired environment. Wander ancient paths, cross red bridges, and explore forgotten shrines as soft winds carry cherry blossoms across your journey.

Whether you're seeking a meditative experience, a break from chaos, or simply a visual escape, Silky Winds invites you to lose yourself in the gentle rhythm of footsteps and forest breeze.

 Features:
Breathtaking Stylized Environments
Explore lush forests, flowing rivers, stone temples, and mountain paths crafted with artistic detail

Immersive Sound Design
Let ambient music and nature’s sounds create a calming atmosphere tailored for reflection and discovery.

No Combat. No Puzzles. Just Peace.
A purely contemplative experience—walk, observe, and connect with the environment at your own pace.

70010000104051.name: Outbound
70010000104051.intro: Build your own home on wheels and live sustainably off-grid.
70010000104051.description:
Explore a colorful world and build your own cozy home on wheels. Craft workstations, and source energy from the sun, wind, or water. Upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and live sustainably off-grid with up to 4 players.

Outbound is a cozy open-world exploration game set in a utopian near future. Start with an empty camper van and turn it into the home of your dreams - alone or together with your friends. Build and explore at your own pace. Collect materials, craft, and build in and on top of your vehicle with modular parts. Advance in technology and efficiently use energy to power your home.

Explore
Explore a colorful world in your electric camper van, powered by the sun, wind, or water. Discover iconic landmarks across diverse biomes.

Build & Craft
Build your moving base with a modular building system. Customize your vehicle with paint, decorations, and furniture to create your own perfect cozy place.

Grow
Create gardens to grow a variety of plants and mushrooms. Enjoy them fresh or cook delicious meals to stay healthy on the road.

Best friends forever
Adopt a new friend at the Paws & Whiskers Lodge who you can feed, pet, and train to help you.

Play together
Go on a road trip across diverse biomes and build your home on wheels solo or in co-op with up to 4 players online.

70010000104056.name: Poker Night at the Inventory
70010000104056.intro: From the archives of Telltale Games, this jokey poker game pits iconic characters against the Player (that’s you!) in a high-stakes battle of cards, bets, and trash talk.
70010000104056.description:
Recently reopened following a seismic retrofit, the Inventory is once again the hottest gathering place for video game characters to unwind after a long day on the job. Drop in to play No Limit Texas Hold’em with four familiar faces: Max, Strong Bad, Tycho, and The Heavy.

POKER WITH PERSONALITY: Poker Night combines the strategy of Texas Hold’em with the punchy banter of four famous characters from the Sam & Max, Homestar Runner, Penny Arcade, and Team Fortress franchises.

RETURN OF A CULT CLASSIC: Released in 2010 and removed from sale nine years later, Poker Night was an experimental casual game from the studio renowned for episodic series like Sam & Max and The Walking Dead. This new version has been lovingly remastered by Skunkape Games, a small team of former Telltale employees who worked on the original.

70010000104060.name: Path of Mystery: A Brush with Death
70010000104060.description:
Dive into the past. Re-examine a murder.

A famous artist was brutally murdered thirty years ago. There were irregularities, the primary suspect died, and the case was closed.

Now you must revisit the scene of the crime. Uncover new clues, investigate additional suspects, and reveal the truth. All while keeping your mysterious time travel powers a secret.

- Go back in time to gather clues and explore the town to find hints to solve the case.

- Interview suspects and pursue the truth in TV episode-like chapters.

- Experience a unique retro art style as you visit the past.

70010000104062.name: EGGCONSOLE Mad Rider MSX2
70010000104062.intro: Dash through a 200 km/h world where your rivals await! The exciting car racing game is here!
70010000104062.description:
This is a racing game released in Japan by Carry Lab in 1987. Players become racers, taking their crimson cars onto six courses: MEGACITY, PLATEAU, ALPS, ISLAND, EGYPTIAN, and CANYON.

A classic racing title, it features no items, just brake, accelerator, and steering. Players race to the finish, dodging endless cars. Puddles and oil slicks on the track mean slight errors can cause a crash, ensuring constant tension.

The game also boasts beautiful backgrounds across all six courses, shifting from day to evening to night as the race progresses.
 
 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000104065.name: Brain Workout! Jellyfish Puzzle
70010000104065.intro:
Spin the pieces and peek into the world of jellyfish!
A mesmerizing underwater art puzzle that you can't take your eyes off
70010000104065.description:
This is a puzzle game where you rotate panels to align jellyfish in the ocean that are placed in random directions.

The controls are simple—just observe the image carefully and tap the panel you want to rotate!
Depending on how fast you clear the stage, you’ll earn 1 to 3 fish.

A hint button becomes available over time and can be used up to three times.
It will automatically align one row of panels in the correct direction,
so you can relax even if you get stuck.

It’s simple yet surprisingly deep—
perfect for a quick and fun brain workout!
Try to earn 3 fish on every stage!

70010000104078.name: Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection
70010000104078.intro: The Star Force games make a stellar comeback in a new Legacy Collection!
70010000104078.description:
The Mega Man Star Force series, which expanded into an anime, is back in the Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection! This collection includes seven games and additional features like a gallery of illustrations and music! Online play is also supported!

The following titles are included in the collection:

Mega Man Star Force Pegasus
Mega Man Star Force Leo
Mega Man Star Force Dragon
Mega Man Star Force 2 Zerker x Ninja
Mega Man Star Force 2 Zerker x Saurian
Mega Man Star Force 3 Black Ace
Mega Man Star Force 3 Red Joker

It is the year 220X, and the world has seen rapid advancements in Wave technology. Our protagonist, 11-year-old Geo Stelar, refuses to go to school as he mourns the disappearance of his astronaut father.
One night, Geo is at the observatory gazing at stars as he usually does. Suddenly, his Transer picks up a signal from space and he is hit with a powerful electric shock!
When he finally comes to, an alien with an electromagnetic wave body called Omega-Xis is standing over him...

Note: The toy link features found in the original versions are not supported.

70010000104088.name: Fishing Rush
70010000104088.intro: Fishing Rush – Dive into the ultimate fishing adventure!
70010000104088.description:
Cast your line and reel in the fun with Fishing Rush, a vibrant and exciting fishing game for players of all ages. Travel through colorful waters, unlock new gear, and catch a variety of fish in a fast-paced, easy-to-play arcade experience.

Whether you're a seasoned angler or just fishing for fun, there's always something waiting beneath the surface. Enjoy smooth gameplay, charming visuals, and addictive challenges that keep you coming back for more.

Key Features:
Relaxing and rewarding fishing gameplay
Colorful environments
Easy to pick up, fun to master

70010000104093.name: Vampire Girls Love Story: Date or Die
70010000104093.intro:
Hunt the night.
Win their hearts.
Survive until dawn.
70010000104093.description:
The city belongs to the night, but it doesn’t forgive mistakes.

You are a vampire on the run, hiding among streets, dark alleys, and forgotten places where danger and desire walk side by side. 

Every night brings new choices, new encounters, and new risks.

In Vampire Girls Love Story: Date or Die, time is always moving forward. Days pass. Hunters get closer. And the girls you meet are drawn to something they can’t quite explain.

Some are intrigued by your presence.
Others sense the danger beneath it.
All of them can change your fate.

This is a narrative visual novel where romance and survival are tightly connected. Exploring the city unlocks locations, abilities, and story paths, while conversations and decisions determine who trusts you, who helps you, and who gets close enough to matter.

But attraction alone won’t keep you alive.

Vampire hunters patrol the streets, forcing you to escape, confront threats, and grow stronger. Learning new skills, choosing when to fight or flee, and deciding how to spend each night can mean the difference between freedom… or the end.

Some relationships offer safety.
Others grant power.
And a few may cost more than you’re willing to lose.

Balance desire, strategy, and survival in a story where every choice carries weight.


Features

● ROMANCE & SURVIVAL VISUAL NOVEL: A story that blends dating, danger, and supernatural tension.

● TIME PROGRESSION SYSTEM: Days advance as you explore, shaping events, encounters, and threats.

● CHOICE DRIVEN GAMEPLAY: Decisions affect relationships, abilities, and how the city reacts to you.

● VAMPIRE HUNTERS & ESCAPES: Avoid pursuit, face danger, and fight to stay alive.

● MULTIPLE ROUTES & ENDINGS: Different romances, powers, and outcomes based on how you play.


Date wisely.
Survive the night.
Play now!

70010000104099.name: Vampire Boys Love Story: Date or Die
70010000104099.intro:
Embrace the night.
Feel the tension.
Survive what follows.
70010000104099.description:
The city after dark is never neutral.

Shadows stretch longer than they should, streets feel watched, and certain encounters carry an intensity that can’t be ignored. 

As a vampire on the run, every night pulls you deeper into a world where danger and attraction exist side by side.

In Vampire Boys Love Story: Date or Die, time moves relentlessly forward. Days pass. Hunters close in. And the boys you meet seem drawn to you: sometimes with curiosity, sometimes with caution, and sometimes with something far more dangerous.

These encounters aren’t simple.
Interest builds slowly.
Trust is never guaranteed.
And desire often comes with unspoken conditions.

This narrative visual novel blends romance with survival, placing equal weight on conversation, perception, and choice. 

But connection has a cost.

Vampire hunters patrol the night, forcing you to escape, fight, or disappear when necessary. 

Some relationships offer protection.
Others awaken power.
And a few may pull you toward a fate you can’t outrun.

Trust carefully.
Choose who you let close.
The night remembers every mistake.


Features:

● ROMANCE & SURVIVAL VISUAL NOVEL: A narrative experience where attraction and danger evolve together.

● TIME PROGRESSION SYSTEM: Days advance naturally, increasing tension and shaping events.

● CHOICE BASED DIALOGUE: Your words affect trust, desire, and who stands beside you.

● VAMPIRE HUNTERS & CONFRONTATIONS: Escape pursuit, face threats, and fight to stay alive.

● MULTIPLE ROUTES & ENDINGS: Relationships, abilities, and outcomes change with every decision.

● ANIME VISUAL STYLE: Expressive character art and moody city environments.


Choose your connections.
Survive the pursuit.
Play now!

70010000104104.name: Cipheur: Trivia
70010000104104.intro: Cipheur: Trivia is a cryptogram game allowing you to test your knowledge as well as logic and language skills against 500 different questions and answers from 5 scientific areas.
70010000104104.description:
Can you decipher the secret messages? Challenge yourself against carefully selected scientific trivia questions and answers. 

- 500 texts to decipher in 5 different categories
- 4 difficulty levels
- hints

70010000104110.name: Suika Sprunki Edition
70010000104110.intro: Suika Sprunki Edition is a fun puzzle game where you drop and match Sprunki heads to unlock new forms. The higher you score, the closer you get to the creepy Horror Mode.
70010000104110.description:
Suika Sprunki Edition is a vibrant arcade puzzle game inspired by the classic Suika formula, but with the unmistakable madness of the Sprunki universe. Drop character heads into a container and watch them bounce, collide, and merge into strange, evolving forms. What starts as a simple mechanic quickly becomes a thrilling challenge of timing, precision, and strategy. Don’t let the box overflow—score high and unlock even weirder evolutions.

But beware: as your score climbs, the game begins to shift. The cheerful rhythm stutters, the atmosphere darkens, and before you know it, you’ve slipped into Horror Mode, where familiar faces twist into something uncanny and the music begins to press on your nerves. It’s the same game—but seen through a distorted mirror.

Inside you’ll find:

– Beloved Sprunki characters: merge, explode, and watch them evolve
– A soundtrack that sticks with you: from playful tunes to unsettling hums
– A bold and slightly unhinged visual style: mesmerizing from the first drop

70010000104120.name: Dot Connect
70010000104120.intro: Can you complete them all and become the ultimate Dot Connector?
70010000104120.description:
Get ready to dive into a world of logic and flow with Dot Connect, a modern puzzle game designed to challenge your brain and keep you entertained for hours!

Connect the dots, avoid obstacles, and fill the grid in over 1280 hand-crafted levels. Each stage offers a unique challenge as you progress through beautifully designed worlds – from minimalist grids to increasingly complex mazes.

With its sleek visuals, smooth animations, and addictive gameplay, Dot Connect is the perfect game for puzzle lovers of all ages. Whether you're solving a quick level on the go or tackling a tough challenge, there's always a new connection to make.

Key Features:
1280 levels of addictive puzzle-solving fun
Multiple visual worlds with increasing difficulty 
Relaxing yet challenging flow-based gameplay 
Smooth controls and modern design 
Great for quick sessions or deep focus

70010000104131.name: Pocket Nook
70010000104131.intro: Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
70010000104131.description:
Ever wished you could turn a tiny room into a perfect little hideaway?
In Pocket Nook, you design charming spaces in cozy pixel art — shifting the layout, placing furniture, and keeping everything neat and clean!


Start with a simple room, then turn it into something unique. Place a bed, a desk, or a plant — you may rotate and reposition items however you like — it’s all flexible!


There’s no need to stress or rush yourself — take your time and enjoy the relaxing vibe of Pocket Nook but also be prepared to savor before-and-after transformations.


Features you may find:
- 65 wallpapers — choose wisely, it’s a thing that catches the attention quickly.
- 80+ styles to embellish the most forgotten part of a room - FLOOR!
- 150+ furniture options to choose from and infinite possibilities.
- 100+ items to decorate your space with —  you name it!
- 20+ ways to lighten the room — lighting is key!
- 32 outdoor elements to fill every pixel of empty space.
- 32 characters ready to live in a place created by an architectural genius mind!
- Cozy pixel art — nice to look at, nicer to relax in.
- Various cozy tunes to choose from — just enough to get into the relaxing vibe.

Cute graphics, endless options, a lot of fun — that’s what awaits you in Pocket Nook, everyone’s welcomed!

70010000104137.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000104137.description:
**To access the Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Digital Deluxe Edition content on Nintendo Switch™ 2, please purchase the Nintendo Switch™ Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Digital Deluxe Edition and the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack. Existing owners of the Switch™ 2 Edition can also access the Digital Deluxe Edition content by purchasing the Season Pass for Nintendo Switch™.

Race across land, sea, air, and space in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.  

Speed to victory solo or as a team in a variety of offline and online modes and compete against players from around the world. Build the ultimate vehicle to match your racing style, unlock gadgets to gain the upper hand, and unleash power-up items to bring home the win!

Ready, Set, Warp!   
Race across 24 tracks and warp to 15 CrossWorlds with Travel Rings, a unique gameplay mechanic that transports the iconic characters from the Sonic and SEGA universes into new dimensions. Use unpredictability to your advantage as you change the landscape of each race!  

Race With the Best!
Choose from 23 iconic Sonic characters, the largest roster of any Sonic racing game! 

Make It Yours  
Mix and match between 45 unique original vehicles and 70 different gadgets to trick out your ride, level up your kart, and create the ultimate machine to match your racing style. 

Gain the Advantage with Powerful Items!  
Dominate your opponents with 23 different items including returning favorites and all-new items like the Monster Truck!  

Multiple Ways to Play  
Gather with friends and play local split-screen in Grand Prix and the new party mode Race Park, compete against players from around the world and increase your rank in World Match, play against friends online in 12-player lobbies with custom rules in Friend Match, or test your driving skills in Time Trials.

70010000104141.name: Gal, Geek and Summer ギャルと優等生と夏休み
70010000104141.intro: A lonely honor student, an outgoing gal, and me... an ordinary guy.More than friends, less than lovers, it's time to leave our youth behind.
70010000104141.description:
◆Story
Spring, the start of a new school year.
The protagonist Rui Izumi finds hhimself curious about his quiet and reserved classmate, Asuka Adachi, an honor student who tends to keep to herself.
Noticing Asuka's isolation, the outgoing gal Akane Hidaka steps in and reaches out to her, changing the relationship between the three of them little by little.

They hang out, eat crepes, take photo booth pictures, and study for exams together.
As their bond deepens, the three of them slowly begin to understand what “friendship” really means, while facing rumors, loneliness, and awkward misunderstandings.

With the arrival of Akane's longtime friends, Midori and Seiji, their relationships grow even more complicated.
As Asuka smiles more and more, a subtle shift begins to stir in Akane’s heart...

As the seasons change, the sports festival, summer vacation, and Tanabata draw near.
Each of them takes a step forward from the time they once spent alone, nurturing the bonds of friendship in this gentle coming-of-age story.


◆Characters
Asuka Adachi
A shy honor student.
Good at studying but not great with people, she was always alone until she met Akane and the others who opened up a new world for her.
She speaks politely and is a bit timid, but gradually warms up and smiles more often.

Akane Hidaka
A caring and proactive, bright, and outgoing gal.
She supports Rui and Asuka from behind the scenes, but she can be a little awkward when it comes to herself.
Sometimes she overthinks things about Asuka and ends up going in circles, but her straightforward personality is part of her charm.

Midori Tomiyama
Akane's longtime friend who looks even more like a gal than Akane, but is actually very sensible and considerate inside.
She's such a skilled shooter in the carnival game that she got banned from participating.
Though her first impression can be tough, she’s actually very kind and acts as a reliable big sister figure supporting Asuka’s growth.

Rui Izumi
An ordinary male student. Nothing particularly special, but a kind hearted protagonist.
He gets caught up in the complicated relationships of the girls around him, but learns what it means to care for others in his own way.
He can be easily swayed, but when it counts, he’s the one you can count on.

70010000104151.name: A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000104151.intro: A bustling city plan just for you
70010000104151.description:
You are the president of a railroad company.
Lay tracks, run trains, and experience building your very own city!
The theme of this work is “tourism.”
Develop tourist routes from distant cities and aim to create a bustling tourist city filled with people.
Providing realistic business management simulations of financing, investing, and more, as well as a wide variety of customizable options for all your vehicles, A-Train: All Aboard Tourism is packed full of features for you to explore.
But don't be overwhelmed—players old and new alike will be able to jump right into the series thanks to the fun and practical tutorials provided in the early stages.
So why not hop aboard the A-Train with your trusted team of advisors, and start crafting a bright future for your town?

【A Story to Save a Troubled Town】
Featuring 11 scenarios set in towns burdened by various circumstances—like “a town saddled with massive debt after opening a bullet train line” or “a town run by a railway company owning a perpetually loss-making baseball team”!
Every town holds hidden charm, especially tourist destinations lacking developed transportation networks, offering ample room for growth. It's where the president's skills truly shine—deciding which tracks to lay and what kind of towns to build.

【Aim to Become an A-Train Creator】
Featuring a “Construction” mode where you can freely shape terrain and place buildings without worrying about funds. Create anything from your ideal tourist attraction to real-world cities within the world of ‘A-Train’.
Vehicle plans in the scenario can be shared online! Of course, you can also download and play those created by other players.
Enjoy planning your trip with the same accessibility for everyone and the same boundless depth.

※This product is a bundle containing the main game “A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism” and the additional content “Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack.” If you already own “A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism,” please purchase only the additional content.

70010000104152.name: Cats Hidden Around the World
70010000104152.intro: Find 4000 cats hiding in 40 iconic locations such as Rio de Janeiro, Istanbul or Tokyo in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats.
70010000104152.description:
Cats Hidden Around the World is a cute hidden object game set worldwide!

Found a cat? Click on it! 

Features

 40 Level
4000 cats
Easter Eggs
Hint System
Night Mode
Adjustable Brightness
Timer mode with leaderboard
Adjustable background & cats color

70010000104157.name: Forbidden Ground - Lair of Aooni -
70010000104157.intro: It is a forbidden place that must never be entered. Strange events encountered in the decadent school building. And a Japanese doll that starts talking......
70010000104157.description:
[Game Outline]
This horror adventure game is based on the motif of “Ao-oni” and is set in an abandoned school that still retains the atmosphere of the Showa period (1926-1989).
The player controls Himari, the main character, and Komari, a Japanese doll inhabited by a grudge spirit, as they search for their estranged family and classmates in the school, where blue demons roam.
The past memoirs and records obtained in the school will reveal the horrific events that took place here in the past, and Himari and Komari will escape from the approaching blue demons and rescue everyone. Can Himari and Komari escape the approaching blue demons and rescue everyone in the end? ......

[Story]
In search of their missing parents, the children visit a place called "no-footprints land.
This is the abandoned school “Koshiwa Elementary School,” which emerged from the bottom of a dam that dried up due to the dry season over the past few years.
This area once had a sad history of sinking to the bottom of the water along with the construction of the dam.
One day, some children enter the abandoned school and are drawn there by the sight of their parents who have never returned.
One of them, Himari, stepped off the collapsed rubble and fell, and when she woke up, she was paralyzed and unable to move.
When she opened her eyes in the darkness of the school, she found a Japanese doll speaking to her. Who are you?
After this encounter, Himari and the Japanese doll “Komari,” in which a grudge spirit resides, wander around an abandoned school where the awe-inspiring “Blue Demon” roams.
The adults who have disappeared, records of the past scattered around the abandoned school, the existence of the Blue Demon, there is something about this place. ...... 
Searching for their missing classmates, “Himari” and “Komari” begin their mission to escape.

70010000104162.name: Sudoku Masters Club
70010000104162.intro: Sharpen your mind, solve the grid — become the ultimate Sudoku Master!
70010000104162.description:
Sudoku Masters Club – Enter the world of logic and challenge!

Train your mind and enjoy the timeless puzzle classic in a fresh, modern style.
Choose from 4 difficulty levels – from relaxing Easy to true Master level Hard.
Use notes, planning, and hints to sharpen your strategy and perfect every move.

With intuitive controls and 3 unique skins, you can personalize the game to match your style.
Perfect for both beginners and true Sudoku masters alike.

Think, plan, and solve — become the ultimate Sudoku Master!

70010000104172.name: Living Shadows
70010000104172.description:
In a world where humans and their shadows have been separated, the line between reality and despair begins to blur.

Living Shadows is a narrative-driven puzzle adventure that explores sensitive themes such as anxiety, depression, and existential crisis. Follow Theo, a young man trapped in apathy, as he journeys through a desolate city and mysterious landscapes in search of answers—and of himself.

In this fragmented world, Theo's shadow is more than a silhouette—it’s a living reflection of his deepest fears and repressed memories. Interact with it to solve puzzles, uncover hidden truths, and confront the darkness within.

Features:
Emotional storytelling – Uncover a gripping narrative that tackles mental health, anxiety, and the human impact of technology.

Challenging puzzles – Solve atmospheric and symbolic challenges that require thought, logic, and introspection.

Immersive environments – Explore hauntingly beautiful 2.5D locations that mirror the emotional states of the characters.

Unforgettable characters – Meet Theo, the enigmatic Bituca, and others who embody the inner struggles of a fractured society.

Striking visual style – Dark, hand-crafted visuals that bring a dystopian and emotionally rich world to life.

Living Shadows offers a thought-provoking experience where every shadow hides a truth—and every step brings you closer to it.

Are you ready to face what lies beneath?

70010000104177.name: A Tower Full Of Cats
70010000104177.description:
A Tower Full of Cats is a cozy and charming hidden object game where your mission is simple: find every cat across the entire history of catkind… and beyond!
Climb through time in this vertical adventure packed with secrets, surprises and, of course, cats.

Travel across beautifully illustrated levels representing different eras and worlds, each overflowing with adorable felines hiding in plain sight. Discover over 1,400 cats, uncover special items, and reveal charming surprises as you ascend the mysterious Tower.

Whether you're a completionist, a cat lover, or simply looking for a relaxing and rewarding experience, A Tower Full of Cats delivers a playful journey that keeps you smiling at every floor.

Features

- 1,400+ Cats to Find: A massive collection of unique and charming felines hiding everywhere.
- Time-Traveling Levels: Explore different eras and fantasy settings as you climb the Tower.
 -Extra Secrets: Hidden objects, bonus collectibles, special cats, and surprises in every scene.
- Adaptive Soundtrack: Music that evolves with each stage, creating a cozy and immersive ambiance.
-Relaxing Gameplay: No timers, no stress, just pure hidden-object fun focused on exploration.
- All Ages Friendly: Perfect for kids, adults, and anyone who loves cats (or discovering things!).

70010000104187.name: Super Mario Galaxy™
70010000104187.intro: Save the galaxy from Bowser and his minions in the original planet-hopping adventure, now improved for the Nintendo Switch™ system!
70010000104187.description:
Bowser has attacked the Star Festival, abducted Princess Peach, and put the whole galaxy in danger! Join up with Rosalina and the Lumas, protectors of the cosmos, to restore the Comet Observatory and rescue the princess. Use power-ups like the Bee Mushroom to fly, the Boo Mushroom to float and move through certain types of barriers, and more on your journey to reclaim the Power Stars!

This journey across the cosmos features enhanced resolution, improved UI, and additional content on the Nintendo Switch™ system. Use button, stick, and motion controls—adapted to the Joy-Con™ controllers from the original Wii™ versions—to jump, glide, swing, and more as you collect Power Stars and power-ups. Learn more about the Lumas from an additional Storybook chapter, and groove to all the game’s music, including a few additional tracks, in soundtrack mode. You can also give yourself additional Health and fall recovery with Assist Mode and use compatible amiibo™ figures* for a little extra help in your adventure. The galaxy awaits!

70010000104192.name: Super Mario Galaxy™ 2
70010000104192.intro: Travel aboard Starship Mario, and team up with Yoshi, to save the galaxy
70010000104192.description:
Bowser has seized the Power Stars and is using them to take over the galaxy! Join Lubba aboard Starship Mario on a journey to get them back, and team up with Yoshi to enhance your planet-hopping moves. With Yoshi by your side, you can jump higher and further—and you can even attack foes using his tongue! Yoshi has his own power-ups too, like the Dash Pepper and the Blimp Fruit, which allow him to sprint super quickly, float Mario high into the air, and more.

This journey across the cosmos features enhanced resolution, improved UI, and additional content on the Nintendo Switch™ system. Use button, stick, and motion controls—adapted to the Joy-Con™ controllers from the original Wii™ versions—to jump, glide, swing, and more as you collect Power Stars and power-ups. Learn more about the Lumas from the new Storybook, and groove to all the game’s music, including some additional tracks, in soundtrack mode. You can also give yourself additional Health and fall recovery with Assist Mode and use compatible amiibo™ figures* for a little extra help in your adventure. The galaxy awaits!

70010000104215.name: POGO Stadium
70010000104215.intro:
Bounce, Trap, and Claim Your ground!
Engage in high-energy rhythm-meets-strategy battles across 100+ dynamic stages!
70010000104215.description:
◆A New Kind of Pogo Territory Battle!
Bounce, trap, and nail your tricks in high-speed territory duels set in futuristic battle arenas soaring high above the city under the night sky.

◆Master the Strategy
Every block on the field matters. Analyze the terrain in real time—decide what to cut, what to protect, and when to strike.
Split off zones to make them your own, then unleash powerful attacks fueled by the energy they generate.
But beware—fail to secure your path, and you’ll be cornered in seconds.
Every move has meaning.

◆Conquer the Solo Mode
Take on 45 rhythm-infused trials across 9 distinct areas.
Face complex patterns, strategic dilemmas, and mysterious foes.
Solo play is deep, challenging, and designed to sharpen your instincts.
And what lies beyond… may surprise you.

◆Local Multiplayer Mayhem (Up to 4 Players)
Dive into intense local PvP for up to 4 players!
Unlock and battle through over 100 carefully crafted stages packed with challenging gameplay that’s truly rewarding to master.
Every match creates new mind games—how will you outplay your rivals?

70010000104222.name: Meatshaker
70010000104222.intro: The Ultimate Solution to All Your MEAT Dilemmas!
70010000104222.description:
Overwhelmed by a surplus of suspicious, sentient, or just plain wiggly meat? Put the cleaver down and pick up MEATSHAKER™ – the fast, fun, and deeply questionable way to take control of your protein problems. Just grab and shake – MEATSHAKER™ does the rest. No grills, no waste, no need to explain the noises to your neighbors!
With MEATSHAKER™, you're the shaker and the boss. Feel the satisfaction as the shake meter rises and your meat issues get tenderized into submission. Whether it squeels or just makes unsettling gurgling sounds – MEATSHAKER™ doesn’t judge, it just shakes.
Why choose MEATSHAKER™?
•	Effortless Meat Management: Just grab that mysterious slab and shake it into compliance!
•	Boneless Technology™: Watch the meat wobble, quiver, and possibly scream as you shake it to... peace?
•	Juicy & Satisfying: It’s not just effective – it’s disturbingly cathartic.
•	Shake Until Done: Keep going until all your meat problems are processed.
•	One Shake to Rule Them All: Say goodbye to your meat anxiety. Say hello to MEATSHAKER™.
How many shakes will it take before the guilt melts away?

70010000104226.name: Revenge On Gold Diggers
70010000104226.intro: The first interactive film game focused on emotional fraud prevention
70010000104226.description:
Brought to life by director Hu Yaohui and a team of film industry veterans. In this entirely fictional story, step into the role of a hunter of hearts and infiltrate a shadowy organization deep in emotional deceit.

The game features 472 minutes of cinematic footage. Comes with both Standard and Master modes. One purchase gives you the full experience.

You play as Wu Yulun, a man once shattered by betrayal, who deliberately turns himself into bait to strike back at a ruthless gold-digger ring. Step into the murky depths of love and deceit, navigating a perilous game against dazzling women, each one a force to be reckoned with.

A kind yet vulnerable rookie streamer. A model wrapped in candy-coated charm. A popular influencer who bends public opinion to her will. A cold-blooded fixer lurking in the shadows. And above them all, the unseen mastermind orchestrating it all.

This is no lighthearted romance sim. It’s a test of wit, will, and emotional endurance. Will you emerge as the hunter, or become the prey?

With over 200 decisions to make, your choices don’t just shape the story. They quietly tilt the scales of obsession, drawing you toward one of 38 endings.

Will you stand as avenger or redeemer? Yield to temptation, or seal an unholy pact with your sworn enemy? The die of destiny rattles, and your path lies open before you.

70010000104240.name: Supermarket Simulator Store Game 3D
70010000104240.intro:
Run the store, stock the shelves, serve the customers!
Organize, upgrade, and grow your supermarket empire!
From carts to checkout, be the boss of your own store!
70010000104240.description:
Supermarket Simulator Store Game 3D

Step into the shoes of a supermarket manager and experience the thrill of running your own store. Stock shelves, organize products, serve customers, and keep everything running smoothly. Every decision matters — from managing inventory to handling busy checkout lines.

Features

• Realistic 3D supermarket environment
• Easy to learn, fun to play for all ages
• Manage stock, upgrade your store, and expand your business
• Handle customer requests and keep them satisfied
• Perfect for short play sessions or long, immersive gameplay

Supermarket Simulator Store Game 3D lets you enjoy the satisfaction of managing your very own supermarket. Can you become the ultimate store manager?

70010000104254.name: Earnest Evans Collection
70010000104254.intro: Three classic action games return in the Earnest Evans Collection!
70010000104254.description:
The Earnest Evans Collection is a collection of three classic games from the famed developers at Wolf Team (who would go on to create the famed Tales of RPG series): Earnest Evans, El Viento, and Annet Returns.


Earnest Evans:
President Calvin Coolidge has hired famed adventurer Earnest Evans to find and locate an ancient grimoire - The Necronomicon. Unbeknownst to Earnest Evans, someone else has their eyes on it: Al Capone! Al Capone hopes to use the book to resurrect the Dark Lord Hastur and control Europe unless Earnest and a young priestess named Annet can stop him!

El Viento:
Several years after the events of Earnest Evans, Al Capone and a sorceress named Restiana are continuing a plot to revive the Dark Lord Hastur. It has been learned that Annet descended from Hastur's bloodline, and her blood alone can resurrect him. With assistance from Earnest Evans, Annet embarks on a journey to stop Al Capone's plans.

Annet Returns:
The exciting conclusion to this trilogy of games. Annet travels across Europe on a quest to protect the world from certain destruction at the hands of Siegfried Munchausen and the evil NeXesis Party.

This collection features:

Incredible animated cutscenes in Earnest Evans and Annet Returns from the masterminds at MADHOUSE (Trigun, Cardcaptor Sakura, and more).

Masterful soundtrack from acclaimed video game composer Motoi Sakuraba (Star Ocean, Tales of Phantasia, Mario Golf, Valkyrie Profile, and more).

Includes both the CD and cartridge versions of Earnest Evans (both of which had different stories).

Rewind any time - with the simple press of a button, you can undo any mistakes you make in gameplay.

Save anywhere - you can save your progress at any moment from the in-game menu.

70010000104305.name: Zombie Royale io
70010000104305.description:
Zombie Royale.io throws you headfirst into a chaotic undead uprising where survival depends on sharp reflexes, quick upgrades, and relentless firepower.

Start as a lone survivor with nothing but a pistol and big zombie problems. Blast your way through endless waves of the undead, collect cash, and use it to unlock better weapons, faster fire rates, and beefier allies. The more you upgrade, the longer you'll last—and the bigger the horde gets.

The action ramps up fast, with increasingly tough levels that keep you dodging, shooting, and scrambling for loot. Whether you're mowing down zombies with a flamethrower or sprinting to the next supply drop, every second is packed with adrenaline.

Think you’ve got the reflexes to survive the apocalypse? Grab your weapon and join the carnage. And remember—zombies don’t take breaks, and neither should you.

70010000104349.name: AxoBubble
70010000104349.description:
In Axobubble you control a friendly axolotl in a world of platforms and creativity. Your main ability is to create floating bubbles that act as temporary platforms. Use these bubbles to jump higher, cross dangerous distances, and collect shells while advancing to the big star shell at the end of each level.

The gameplay is accessible but full of possibilities. You can walk, jump and create bubbles and over time you will need to combine all these skills to overcome traps and reach hidden areas.

The game features 30 levels set on a mountain with challenges during both day and night. Early obstacles are simple like spikes and geysers. But be prepared because as you progress the environment gains dangers like crabs and saws requiring precise jumps and strategic use of bubbles.

If you like 2D platformers with a unique twist and levels that encourage creativity Axobubble is your next journey.

70010000104372.name: The Exit 8 Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000104372.intro: You are trapped in an endless underground passageway. Observe your surroundings carefully to reach "The Exit 8".
70010000104372.description:
You are trapped in an endless underground passageway.
Observe your surroundings carefully to reach "The Exit 8".

Don't overlook any anomalies.

If you find anomalies, turn back immediately.

If you don't find anomalies, do not turn back.

To go out from Exit 8.


The Exit 8 is a short walking simulator inspired by Japanese underground passageways, liminal spaces and back rooms.

70010000104379.name: Arcade Archives MUNCH MOBILE
70010000104379.description:
"MUNCH MOBILE" is  an action game released by SNK in 1983.
Pilot a mysterious car with arms, picking up fuel and food along the way. The goal  is to make it home before your fuel runs out.
Place trash left  from your food into bins to earn big points! Show consideration in public spaces and  enjoy a fun drive!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000104384.name: "GUDETAMARUN" - Running GUDETAMA ! But GUDETAMA wants to be Gudegude ~
70010000104384.intro: Unique and Cute! A Laid-Back Side-Scrolling Action Game
70010000104384.description:
GUDETAMA is, as always, totally lazy today.
Even though it just wants to relax, it somehow ends up on a vehicle, slowly moving along the course.

Raise or lower GUDETAMA’s mood, and guide it skillfully toward the goal!

At first glance, it looks like a laid-back game, but various gimmicks block your path along the course.

Simple and easy to play, yet surprisingly deep!
Cute and relaxed, but with just the right amount of challenge — a laid-back action game.

70010000104419.name: A Planet of Mine MasterMine Edition
70010000104419.intro: A cozy&cute strategy game set in space with animals !
70010000104419.description:
A Planet of Mine Mastermine Edition is a cozy 4X game with mass strategy !
Choose your winning gang, mastermine resources, and build your base and tools to boost your technology and conquer space ! Unless your neighbors don’t see it that way... Trade, peace or clash : your planet, your choice !

Tuesday Quest invites you to discover A Planet of Mine in this MASTERMINE EDITION, featuring:

・ LOADS OF NEW CONTENT AND MISSIONS,
・ A WAY MORE ROBUST GAME ENGINE,
・ A REVAMPED AND ERGONOMIC UI,
・ MORE DETAILED VFX,
・ NEW MUSIC AND FAR MORE SOUNDS,
・ IMPROVED AI ENGINE,
・ AND ANIMAL PRODUCE (YES, YOU READ THAT RIGHT).

Choose among 20 different factions ranging from space pirate chickens to nuclear scientist elephants! Establish a colony in a randomly generated star system. Manage the collection and production of your resources and advance your technology by unlocking new buildings and science. Trade with other factions or go to war for system-wide domination! Plan your strategy wisely and stay focused: you may encounter surprising stuff...

CREATE YOUR OWN GAME
The Mastermine Edition offers you the ability to create your own universe. You can personalize the sun’s type, the number of planets and factions, the distance of your first planet to the sun, and the global size of your world. You can also add rules like a specific game mode, or a limited number of cycles. So much power is in your hands!

REPRODUCE AND SHARE YOUR GAME
With great power comes great responsibility, so now that you can control the universe, it means that you can create the best strategy challenges! And the best part is that now, you can share any game with your friends. Each generated star system has a unique seed that allows it to be identically recreated on another profile. So, you can simply share the Game ID with anyone and play the exact same game. Dare to defy your friends with completely ridiculous or very complex systems, and explore infinite game strategies together!

70010000104424.name: NIGHT STRIKER GEAR
70010000104424.intro:
An action-packed pseudo-3D shoot-'em-up.
Control the special armored vehicle INTER-GRAY in third-person view, Strike through the night once more!
70010000104424.description:
NIGHT STRIKER GEAR is an action-packed retro 3D shoot-'em-up.
Control the special armored vehicle INTER-GRAY in third-person view, ripping through a cyber futuristic highway while shooting down enemies.

◆Story
Lotus Layer is a resort complex and theme park of an unprecedented scale. Dignitaries from all around the world gather to celebrate its opening, when conspiracy begins to rear its head...

The United Nations intervenes to rescue the endangered guests and reveal the true nature of the events. As a member of the United Nations Special Tactical Action Force, often referred to as the Night Striker, you set out on a nocturnal infiltration into Lotus Layer, aboard your trusted hovercar INTER-GRAY.

Shoot down the enemies who try to stop you and get to the bottom of the mystery!

◆Details
– Long-awaited sequel to the classic arcade 3D shoot-'em-up NIGHT STRIKER (1989)
– All-new levels and a glamorous array of enemies presented in breathtaking graphics, utilizing the modern aspect ratio of 16:9 while staying true to the sprite scaling pseudo-3D style of the original NIGHT STRIKER.
– New GEAR System that adds fresh and distinct tactical depth.
– Brand new, stylish soundtrack by sound composer Yukiharu Urita, formerly of ZUNTATA, further accentuates the hallmark sense of rushing forward.

70010000104426.name: CloverPit
70010000104426.description:
Clover Pit is a rogue-lite that traps players in a hell of their own creation. Locked in a rusty cell with a slot machine and an ATM, you must pay off your debt at the end of each round, or fall to ruin – literally!

Manipulate the slot machine to earn extra coins. Turn the odds in your favor with various prizes and charms that trigger big big combos, snowballing into a dazzling lucky run. Bend the rules, break the game, and pay off your captor long enough to earn a shot at freedom.

Features:
- A gripping rogue-lite where every round could be your last!
- Meta-progression, multiple endings and unlockable power-ups!
- Push your score to new heights in Endless Mode!
- A hellish escape room atmosphere!
- 150 + items and synergies to boost your luck!
- A sinister tale of addiction and escape!

70010000104431.name: Cozy Kingdom
70010000104431.description:
Take a deep breath, lace up your boots, and step into a peaceful world of wonder. In this world, you're free to roam a vast, beautifully hand-crafted kingdom at your own pace. With no combat, no timers, and no stress, your only goal is to uncover hidden landmarks, discover secret paths!

Features:
A wide, open kingdom filled with diverse landscapes to uncover
Gentle exploration-focused gameplay with no combat or pressure
Hidden locations and landmarks to find
Soothing music and ambient sounds to relax and unwind

A perfect game to play at your own pace—whether for five minutes or five hours

70010000104437.name: High Times
70010000104437.intro: Sit back & relax as you play the role of a donut therapist in this cozy cooking/dating sim. Feeling nervous? Need some cheer in your life? Here at High Times, there's a donut for every mood.
70010000104437.description:
In a world where you can literally eat your feelings, you work at The Hotbox, a one-of-a-kind donut shop where every donut is infused with mood enhancers that can change your customers’ emotions. But people don’t always know what they need, so from flavors that give them courage to ones that lift their spirits, it’s up to you to choose the right mood and help each troubled customer. Listen to their stories, offer advice in the form of donuts, and help mend broken relationships.

FEATURES

♡ A Sweet Kind Of Therapy 
Serve donuts that change the emotions of your customers and influence their actions.

♡ Manage Your Own Donut Shop 
Cook donuts, serve the right orders, collect tips, unlock new tools, decorate your shop and discover recipes!

♡ Full English Voice Acting 
Starring Nola Klop, LilyPichu, Johnny Yong Bosch, and other talented voice actors, every character is fully voiced except for the MC.

♡ Closure Simulator 
Rekindle romance with the exes you've ghosted. Will you heal from the trauma of the past, and perhaps even experience the most elusive and mythical of all emotions—closure?

♡ A Cast Of Misfits 
Get to know over 30 customers and 6 romanceable characters, serve their favorite donuts, and find out what makes them tick.

♡ Choices Matter & Multiple Endings 
The donuts you serve and the choices you make in the story ultimately affect your relationships. Each romanceable character has 2-3 endings.

♡ Customizable Main Character 
Players can customize their character's appearance—skin color, hairstyle, outfit, etc.

♡ Dynamic Comic Book-Styled Visuals 
Watch the story come to life with over 70+ vibrant and animated comic book style illustrations.

♡ Original Soundtrack 
Vibe during service time to a blend of originally composed rock, city pop and lo-fi music.

70010000104447.name: Dead Charge
70010000104447.description: DEAD CHARGE is a fast paced 2D Action Platformer where your battery is your health bar, and it’s always draining. Shoot, Melee, and dash through enemies to stay alive and keep the momentum going.

70010000104452.name: Nom Nom Apocalypse
70010000104452.intro: Last Supper: A Top-Down Bullet Buffet
70010000104452.description:
Welcome to the co-op shooter where the end of the world has never looked so...tasty! The end of days is near, with the city infested by ravenous, greasy food creatures, bringing total chaos and destruction. Our last hope lies with a band of skilful, trigger-happy cooks who are determined not to end up as the main course.


Features:
★Choose your fighter: Choose from different food-themed heroes, each with their own special ability. Find the one that fits your style best.
★Fight crazy food monsters: Battle wild enemies like cheeseburger beasts that shoot cheese and cupcake creatures with sharp claws.
★Play with a Friend (Local Co-op): Team up in 2-player local co-op mode. Work together to survive the monsters and double the fun.
★Upgrades & Perks: Improve your abilities to move faster, take less damage, or block attacks. Mix and match perks to suit how you want to play.
★Use Wacky Food Weapons: Blast enemies with a mustard shotgun, fire forks with a crossbow, or zap them with a microwave laser. Weapons are weird and powerful.
★Fast-Paced Roguelite Action: Enjoy action-packed gameplay with challenging fights and random elements that make every session different.

70010000104460.name: XIII A final Game of Tarot
70010000104460.description:
How long can you play with Death?

Death comes for everyone, and now it’s your turn — but you didn’t expect it to want to read your future. Play your cards the right way and keep your Karma balanced — the closer to zero, the better. Try to achieve the highest score possible in this Roguelike!

Make effective use of the numerical relationships between the cards and their positions to keep the final sum as close to zero as possible. If you play well, you’ll earn money to buy magical coins that modify the cards on the board. Manage these resources wisely to get as far as you can — and beware of RNGesus.

XIII: A Final Game of Tarot With Death is a casual game to get hypnotized by for a few hours — especially great for high-score lovers. Compete with your friends and try to survive until you reach your absolute limit!

80 hours? Nah! This is a short and simple game, but still lots of fun. For those looking for a special challenge, it can offer much more — push past the limits of Tarot and conquer the 23rd round.

70010000104473.name: Make it! Yakiimo
70010000104473.intro:
It's time for a piping-hot roasted sweet potato challenge!
Your customers' satisfaction depends on your skills!
70010000104473.description:
Let's make yakiimo (roasted sweet potatoes) on the Nintendo Switch™!
Keep the heat just right while serving orders one after another.
Watch your remaining sweet potato stock and time your restocks carefully!

Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in the fun!
Aim for a new high score!

《Rules》
Make yakiimo to order and serve them to your customers!
Roast them perfectly without burning for maximum points!
See how many you can make before time runs out!

《How to Play》
1. Place the sweet potatoes on the stone grill!

2. When one side is done, flip them over!

3. When both sides are done, bag them up and serve to the customer!

[Score Attack]
Score as high as you can and climb the global leaderboards!
Roast sweet potatoes with precision, fulfill more and more orders, and aim for a new record!

[Battle Mode]
Up to 4 players can face off in a test of skills!
It's a red-hot competition where speed and accuracy determine the winner!

70010000104482.name: Steel Hail
70010000104482.intro: Become humanity's last hope. Gear up, upgrade, and unleash hell in a relentless third-person sci-fi shooter against a ruthless robotic army. The future is yours to forge in fire and steel.
70010000104482.description:
The War for Tomorrow Begins in Your Hangar.

Earth has fallen silent. The once-great colonies are now tombs of steel, overrun by a merciless steel legion. As a veteran combat specialist, you are thrust into the heart of the conflict—the last spark of resistance against the cold, calculating darkness.

An Arsenal of Retribution.
Unleash a devastating array of sci-fi weaponry. Incinerate waves of drones with a plasma rifle, punch through armored cores with a rocket launcher or disintegrate foes with energy-based shotguns. Find your favorite, then make it better.

Forge Your Own Legend.
Victory earns you credits. Spend them in your mobile hangar, the heart of your operation. This is where a soldier becomes a legend. Augment your combat suit with enhanced shields, jet-powered dodges, and reactive armor. Upgrade your weapons with faster fire rates and larger magazines. Every upgrade is a step toward tipping the scales of war.

Adapt to Survive.
No two battles are the same. The steel threat is diverse and relentless.

Annihilation.
Storm enemy strongholds with a single objective: total destruction of all hostiles.

Last Stand.
Defend vital resistance bases against overwhelming waves of attackers. Hold the line, or everything is lost.

Titan Slayer.
Face off against colossal boss machines, each with unique, earth-shattering attacks and devastating weak points. These epic encounters will test every upgrade and skill you possess.

Key Features:

Intense Third-Person Combat.
Fast-paced, fluid shooting with a tactical edge.

Deep Progression System.
Extensive upgrades for your weapons, armor, and abilities in your personal hangar.

Diverse Enemy Forces.
Battle agile drones, heavy assault robots, and screen-filling boss titans.

Varied Mission Types.
Annihilation, base defense, and epic boss battles across multiple sci-fi landscapes.

Powerful Arsenal.
Unlock and master a wide variety of weapons.

The machine war waits for no one. Suit up, soldier. The future needs a champion.

70010000104488.name: Dunkadillo
70010000104488.intro: Finally, a game that answers the age-old question: “What if a basketball was also an armadillo?”
70010000104488.description:
You are Dill the armadillo, and your best friend Pickle has just been kidnapped by a mysterious tentacle! Transform into a basketball to bounce off walls, floors, and ceilings as you rush to the rescue. Double jump over exploding bees, oblivious porcupines, and overly friendly frogs. Snag rare trading cards to unlock funky characters as you traverse 50 awesome stages. Do you have what it takes to save your best buddy... and maybe shoot a few hoops along the way?

• A new platforming adventure from the creator of Dadish and Be Brave, Barb
• 50 awesome stages
• 10 characters to unlock
• Lots of cool trading cards to find
• Five big bad boys to battle
• Controller support
• A huge rabbit
• A soundtrack that slaps
• The graphics are rad
• So much bouncing
• I think you are special

70010000104502.name: Arcade Archives GEE BEE
70010000104502.description:
"GEE BEE" is a brick breaker released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1978.
A monumental title, and the first arcade game developed in-house by Namco, it gained popularity for its unique gameplay that adds pinball elements to a classic block-breaker. The Arcade Archives version supports mouse controls, making it even easier to play.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000104510.name: Bob The Brick Breaker
70010000104510.description:
A game inspired by old arcade games, where waves of bricks make the climb to the top increasingly difficult. Adding to the challenge are minions and bosses, who will put us to the test.

Ask your friends for help, playing as a duo, or go head-to-head to see who's the best. If you think you're the best of the bunch, then get ready to prove to the rest of the world that you've got what it takes via the online leaderboards.

Prove you can outlast everyone else and be worthy of the title of brick king.

Let the challenge begin!

70010000104517.name: OFC - Ultimate Fighting Club
70010000104517.intro: Unleash your fighter and conquer the intense arena battles.
70010000104517.description:
