OFC - Ultimate Fighting Club throws you into the ruthless world of no-holds-barred combat, where the only rule is victory. Step into a fighting club inspired by the raw intensity of real OFC tournaments, and train your fighter to rise above the rest and claim true championship glory.

Key Features:
- Choose Your Fighter: Discover the combatant that matches your style. Each fighter has unique abilities that influence strategy, speed, and power.
- Expand Your Roster: Unlock new fighters and experiment with different techniques, tactics, and approaches in the ring.
- Train and Upgrade: Improve vital stats—speed, stamina, strength, health, and defense. Prepare carefully for each fight and dominate your opponents.
- Master the Fight: Execute devastating punches and kicks, block incoming attacks, and read your opponent’s strategy to land game-changing strikes.

Step into the ring, test your skills, and experience the most intense, adrenaline-fueled combat!

70010000104522.name: Bigfoot Hunting
70010000104522.intro: Hunt the legend and survive the untamed wilderness.
70010000104522.description:
Step into the heart of the untamed wilderness in Bigfoot Hunting, a high-stakes survival experience designed for thrill-seekers. Armed with only your instincts, a trusty weapon, and limited supplies, you’ll face off against one of the greatest legends of the forest—Bigfoot.

Track, hunt, and survive in a living, breathing ecosystem where every shadow could be your last. The hunt is on… but remember, you’re not the only one watching.

Key Features:
• First-Person Immersion: Explore and survive the forest in intense first-person perspective.
• Dynamic Combat: Switch between firearms and melee weapons in real-time.
• Interactive World: Use flashlights, night vision, open doors, and search cabins.
• Survival Tools: Heal with medkits, set traps, bait, and motion sensors.
• Random Events: No two hunts are the same—expect the unexpected.
• Loot & Upgrade: Scavenge supplies and improve your gear to survive longer.

Will you outwit the beast—or become another forgotten story whispered through the trees? The wild is calling. Bigfoot is near.

70010000104531.name: Plus Ultra: Legado
70010000104531.intro: Immerse yourself in a Comicvania adventure.
70010000104531.description:
Plus Ultra: Legado is a 2D Metroidvania set during Mexico's inception in the 16th century. This exhilarating yet complex encounter between Europe and the Americas unfolds as a classical adventure.  

Using the Metroidvania genre to recount these significant historical events, Plus Ultra: Legado leads players into an exciting “comicvania” experience. Embark on an epic adventure in which you'll see the ins and outs of one of history's most crucial events!

70010000104553.name: The Visitor Effect
70010000104553.intro: What if your world was a lie?
70010000104553.description:
Waking Up in the Lie

You are R3D, an alien robot trapped in a strange simulation. You don’t know who’s pulling the strings—or why—but something feels off. Every move you make might lead you closer to the truth… or deeper into the deception. How far are you willing to go to break free?

Dive into a layered narrative and uncover the hidden motives of those around you. Pay close attention to conversations and search for secret notes—they could hold crucial truths. Don’t let yourself be misled; only the right choices will guide you to freedom when the time comes.

The Collapse

Did you manage to break the simulation? Then brace yourself—now you’ll have to face the General and fight your way out of the lab. New puzzle mechanics await, but this time you’re not alone: turrets and enemies will be hunting you down.

Features

Hand-crafted puzzles that challenge your logic and creativity
A deep, twisting narrative—who can you really trust?
Hidden notes packed with vital information
Action sequences that shift the pace and tone of the game
Multiple endings shaped by your choices

70010000104558.name: Last House Survival: Zombie Defense
70010000104558.intro: One house. Endless waves. Will you survive the night?
70010000104558.description:
Last House Survival: Zombie Defense is an intense survival shooter where the last standing house becomes humanity’s final refuge. Build defenses, set traps, and face relentless waves of the undead determined to tear down your stronghold.
Choose your weapons, upgrade your defenses, and hold the line as each wave grows deadlier than the last. Every second counts in this fight for survival—because once the house falls, it’s game over.

70010000104563.name: Gas Station: Idle Simulator
70010000104563.description:
Welcome to Gas Station: Idle Simulator, where you turn a dusty roadside stop into the busiest pit stop in town. Start small—one pump, no-name snacks, maybe a bathroom if you’re lucky. Then build it into a customer-packed powerhouse.

Refuel cars, restock shelves, grill the perfect hot dog, and keep the line moving. Add pumps, open a café, upgrade your toilets (trust us, it matters), and keep drivers smiling while you count the cash.

The better your station, the bigger the crowds—and the fatter your wallet. With smart upgrades and idle earnings, your gas station keeps growing even when you're offline. From humble beginnings to tycoon-level greatness, every car filled and snack sold gets you closer to the top.

Fast cars. Faster service. And way too many hot dogs.

70010000104568.name: Strangeland
70010000104568.intro: You wake in a surreal carnival, where a woman cries out to you before leaping to her death. Can either of you be saved? The denizens and devices of Strangeland await you.
70010000104568.description:
You awake in a nightmarish carnival and watch a golden-haired woman hurl herself down a bottomless well for your sake. You seek clues and help from jeering ravens, an eyeless scribe, a living furnace, a mismade mermaid, and many more who dwell within the park. All the while, a shadow shrieks from atop a towering roller-coaster, and you know that until you destroy this Dark Thing, the woman will keep jumping, falling, and dying, over and over again....

Strangeland is a place like no other. Even in the real world, carnivals occupy a twilight territory between the fantastic and the mundane, the alien and the familiar. In their funhouse mirrors, their freaks, and their frauds, we see hideous and haunting reflections of ourselves, and we witness the wonder and horror of humanity in just a few frayed tents, peeling circus wagons, dingy booths, and run-down rides. Strangeland, of course, is most definitely not the real world. Indeed, unraveling the connections between this nightmare and the real world is the game's central mystery, and finding a way out is its central challenge.

As you explore Strangeland, you will need to gather otherworldly tools and win strange allies to overcome a daunting array of obstacles. Forge a blade from iron stolen from the jaws of a ravenous hound and hone it with wrath and grief; charm the eye out of a ten-legged teratoma; and ride a giant cicada to the edge of oblivion....  Amidst such madness, death itself has no grip on you, and you will wield that slippery immortality to gain an edge over your foes.

Navigating this domain of monsters and metaphors will require understanding its denizens and its enigmas. Unlike many adventure games that offer a linear experience and single-solution puzzles, Strangeland lets you pick your own way, your own approach, and your own meaning—one player might win a carnival game with sharpshooting, another by electrical engineering; one player might unravel a strange prophet's wordplay while another gathers visual clues scattered throughout the environment. Ultimately, Strangeland's story will be your story. You are not the audience; you are the player.

70010000104572.name: Greenveil Hike
70010000104572.description:
Step into the dreamy world of Greenveil Hike, a relaxing walking simulator set on a vibrant, hand-crafted island paradise. Take your time exploring scenic trails, secret paths, and cozy spots scattered throughout a lush and peaceful landscape.

Features:
> A whimsical, open-world island to explore freely
> Beautiful stylized visuals full of charm and warmth
> Hidden locations, scenic lookouts, and photo-worthy views
> Ambient soundscape to calm the mind

Whether you're looking to unwind or get lost in a peaceful adventure, Greenveil Hike invites you to take a deep breath—and just walk.

70010000104583.name: Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny
70010000104583.intro: Witness the resurrection of the foretold nemesis of the Jurnal Risa family, which was never revealed before. Unveil its dark destiny within this horror-adventure game.
70010000104583.description:
From the hidden pages of Jurnal Risa comes a visual novel where the boundary between the living and the unseen begins to blur. Step into Jurnal Risa's world where each shadow holds a story, and every whisper leads you deeper into the unknown.

Witness the resurrection of the foretold nemesis of the Jurnal Risa crew, which was never revealed before. Unveil its dark destiny within this horror-adventure game.

This is the tale of Jurnal Risa, as recounted to me by Risa herself.

Key features

• A Paranormal Adventure Mystery

Jurnal Risa is known for exploring haunted places and sharing true ghost stories from Indonesia. Their adventures, bonds, and spiritual encounters inspire the game’s mystery and emotional depth.

• Brought to Life with Full Voice Acting

Fully voiced by the real members of the group, each scene feels authentic as it captures their unique personalities, real-life bonds, and the emotional weight behind every supernatural encounter.

• Mini games

Take a break from the tension with fun mini-games.

• Collect the Fragments of the Past

Gather collectible photos as you complete stories and challenges. Each photo unlocks a memory or reveals a hidden piece of the mystery.


Ready to turn the last page and face what lingers beyond?

70010000104588.name: RANDOMAX
70010000104588.intro: Ride or drive the turbulent waves of luck toward victory! A novel rogue-lite vertical scrolling Shmup!
70010000104588.description:
A vast and random arsenal of misdelivered heavy weapons enter into your possession.
Find the most effective way to utilize them and turn the tides of battle in your favor!

[Story]
The year is 2050 AD.
In a far flung corner of the galaxy, an area known as the "Sepulch Space Archipelago" is attacked by an infamous band of raiders known as the “Randomax Pirates”! These nefarious marauders quickly subjugate the peaceful islands, transforming the region into a sea of evil villainy.

Amid such turmoils, three women of exceedingly bold personalities appear on the scene determined to venture into these dangerous waters, along with a mysterious shipping company known as "ARGO EXPRESS"! Erika, a self proclaimed employee of this company offers them a proposal...

"We'll give you our stock of misdelivered weapons and ammo. Wanna use it to take out the bad guys?”

And so a chaotic battle fueled by a vast stockpile of mismatched weapons quickly ensues!

[Characters & Ships]
"Cosmi" The hot-blooded policewoman of the Planetary Police Force.
She proudly rides into battle piloting her ship the "Blue Cosmic"!

"Urara" The cyber idol and promising newcomer to the team.
At 9 meters tall and weighing 550...(ahem!) She IS her ship, the "URARARA★Recital SP"!

"Dariha" The dignified yet outcast aristocrat.
She may wear rags, but her heart is brocade. A ceaseless savior for the common folk.
Her ship is the "Barra 35T".

[System]
Rogue-lite vertical scrolling STG with over 70 types of randomly supplied equipment and weapons.
Three equip slots to assign combinations of unique weapons such as “back bombs” and “bullet reversing barriers”.
How you attack, defend, collect items, your play-style and your luck will generate an infinite number of possibilities!

[Features]
- 6 stages + 3 character-specific stages each for a total of 9 stages
- 3 types of ships each with distinct characteristics
- More than 70 different types of equip-able armaments!
- A unique ending for each character
- 6 adjustable difficulty levels

70010000104593.name: Arcade Archives SCION
70010000104593.description:
"SCION" is a shooting game released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1984.
The game is set in Crystal Heaven, a sprawling supercity built in multiple layers.
Your mission is to rescue your captured kin trapped within the city’s core.
Fight your way down from the upper levels, tearing through each layer as you advance toward the enemy’s stronghold deep within!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000104605.name: The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4
70010000104605.intro: A retro-style 2D action game where adorable girls come to life in charming pixel art!
70010000104605.description:
The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4 is the latest entry in the action game series that began in 2014.

This 2D action game features charming pixel art, where defeating enemies earns you Tres, a resource used to power up your character.

Each stage hides special enemies called Jammers. Your goal is to track them down and destroy them as you make your way to the stage's final boss room. Winning boss battles grants you new magic, expanding the actions you can perform.

You play as the Dark Witch, Zizou, on a mission to stop Verde, a mysterious group using magical interference to disrupt global communication and seize control of the world.

70010000104610.name: Mannequin Mayhem - Physics Ragdoll Shooter
70010000104610.intro: Dominate waves of creepy mannequin invaders.
70010000104610.description:
Get set for chaotic fun in Mannequin Mayhem - Physics Ragdoll Shooter, the most outrageous shooter of the year! Forget zombies and aliens — your new targets are creepy, stiff mannequins. Survive endless waves, upgrade your weapons, and dive headfirst into hilarious chaos. Ready to laugh while blasting the weirdest enemies around?

Step Into the Madness:
Mannequin Mayhem - Physics Ragdoll Shooter throws you into the wackiest combat you’ll play this year! - Zombies and aliens are old news — it’s time to shoot some seriously creepy mannequins. They wobble, they topple, they’re hilariously unpredictable… and they’re coming for you! Grab your guns and show these dummies who’s in charge.

What’s Inside:
- Ragdoll Chaos: Every mannequin reacts to your shots with wild, physics-driven flops and tumbles. It’s a ridiculous experiment in ragdoll mayhem!
- Endless Waves: Prepare for non-stop waves of mannequin madness. How long can you survive the relentless dummies?
- Arsenal of Fun: Equip a variety of guns, customize your loadout, and experiment with creative ways to take down wave after wave of stiff opponents.

Mannequin Mayhem - Physics Ragdoll Shooter is all about blasting, laughing, and having a ridiculous amount of fun. So, are you ready to face the strangest, most awkward enemies ever? Let’s get shooting!

70010000104615.name: Battle Puzzle 2048 - Queens of the Abyss
70010000104615.intro: Combine tiles and face off against anime witches, seductive demons, and powerful queens of darkness!
70010000104615.description:
Battle Puzzle 2048 – Queens of the Abyss puts a wicked spin on the classic 2048 puzzle formula! Slide tiles to combine matching numbers and launch devastating attacks against a legion of otherworldly enemies. Fight your way through demonic temptresses, spellcasting anime witches, and majestic queens of the abyss—each wielding terrifying powers and a flair for the dramatic.
Strategically smash high-value tiles into your foes to deal damage and disrupt their dark magic. Each enemy brings unique abilities to the battle: some hex your tiles, others drain your power, and a few can twist the grid with chaos. With five difficulty levels, the challenge adapts to your skill.
Once you've conquered the darkness, take on Infinite Mode for a pure puzzle experience. Combine tiles, stack up high numbers, and see how long you can survive in the ever-deepening abyss. Will you master the dark and become the ultimate puzzle champion?

70010000104618.name: Battle Puzzle 2048 - Maidens of Steel
70010000104618.intro: Combine tiles and battle fierce anime warriors in a clash of armor and steel!
70010000104618.description:
Battle Puzzle 2048 – Maidens of Steel brings a fierce twist to the classic 2048 puzzle game! Slide tiles to combine matching numbers, unleash devastating combos, and clash with a striking lineup of anime warriors and heavily armored battle maidens. Each opponent has her own tactical skillset—some block tiles, others absorb attacks, while a few unleash chaotic battlefield effects.
Your goal? Smash high-value tiles into these steel-clad foes and wear them down before they overwhelm you with their powers. With five difficulty levels, you can fine-tune the challenge to your skill and enjoy a thrilling fusion of tactical puzzle-solving and action-packed battles.
When you're done with the combat, switch to Infinite Mode and aim for the ultimate high score. Combine tiles, climb the number ladder, and test your 2048 prowess in a world where might meets mind. Will you rise to the top and defeat all the Maidens of Steel?

70010000104626.name: Voltline
70010000104626.intro:
Connect the spark, calm your mind.
A relaxing logic puzzle where each tap sparks a chain reaction across the grid.
70010000104626.description:
“Let the Current Flow. Feel the Calm.”   Voltline is a relaxing puzzle game where you guide electricity through intricate line networks by tapping the right connection points. Each tap sets off a satisfying chain reaction as the current spreads across the grid.
Every level introduces new layouts and unique interactive elements that shape the flow in different ways. It’s a calm yet engaging experience that rewards both focus and intuition.
With its soothing visuals and ambient sounds, Voltline is designed for players of all ages—easy to get into, but delightfully challenging to master.

Features:
•    One-tap gameplay focused on flow and reaction
•    Designed to relax your mind, not stress it
•    Special objects that shift how electricity behaves
•    Minimalist visuals with smooth, fluid animations
•    Soothing music and sound effects for a meditative vibe
•    100 handcrafted levels to unwind with at your own pace

70010000104631.name: Monster Prom 4: Monster Con XXL
70010000104631.intro: GET READY FOR THE MONSTER CON!
70010000104631.description:
"Monster Prom 4: Monster Con" tries to answer one of life’s most important questions: “Can you find love at the nerdiest convention ever”?

After going on a wild ride with “Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip”, Monster Con returns to the classic dating sim formula of the previous games in the franchise: multiplayer narrative adventures full of colorful characters and hilarious dialogue!

This sequel takes you to a wacky new setting: the Monster Con, a massive convention filled with video games, comic books, anime… and more than a few paranormal activities. Meet four brand new characters who might win your heart by the end of the Con, and let your old friends Liam and Zoe introduce you to the Con’s crazy staff and visitors: annoying streamers, famous authors, washed-up actors, networking game developers… and so many more! 

Monster Con brings back the franchise’s trademark humor and style, and adds entirely new mechanics: during the Con, you’ll get a chance to build your own comic book and read it at the end of the run. And of course, there’s romance to be found: get close to your favorite character and muster the courage to ask them out to the Con afterparty!

But that’s not all! The XXL version includes a whopping FOUR of the DLC playable characters: Damien, Valerie, Aaravi, and Milo!

Monster Con has everything you love about the "Monster Prom" formula, so what are you waiting for? Unleash your inner nerd and make the right choices to find a date at the craziest monster-filled convention you'll ever visit! ;)

70010000104633.name: TINNY STRAYS
70010000104633.intro: Jump, climb, and explore a world full of hidden surprises.
70010000104633.description:
Take control of a small stray kitten and begin an adventure through a vast abandoned factory filled with hidden pathways, towering structures, and forgotten corners. What appears to be an empty industrial complex soon reveals itself as a giant playground where curiosity and agility are the keys to progress.

Explore rooftops, containers, warehouses, offices, and maintenance areas as you search for food and collectible figurines scattered throughout the environment. Climb, jump, and navigate challenging obstacles while uncovering secrets hidden across twenty unique levels. Every area offers new discoveries and rewards for those willing to venture off the beaten path.

Features:
• Explore a large factory filled with secrets, hidden paths, and unique locations
• Run, jump, and climb across industrial structures and platforming challenges
• Collect food and rare figurines throughout twenty exciting levels
• Use your meow and bring extra personality to your adventure
• Unlock new fur colors and customize the appearance of your kitten
• Discover hidden collectibles, shortcuts, and rewards as you explore

Can you uncover every secret hidden within the factory and complete the journey of a tiny stray cat?

70010000104638.name: BEFORE I GO
70010000104638.intro: A punishing Metroidvania about death acceptance.
70010000104638.description:
Explore the haunting, dreamlike fantasy world of BEFORE I GO, a punishing Metroidvania where you embody the innocence of an inner child on an allegorical odyssey towards death acceptance. The end is inevitable, but will you brave the journey?

The world is old and unwell. An ominous affliction has left every living soul weak, terrified and helpless before despair.
But this paralyzing infestation has left the innocence of a young child untainted.
Lost in limbo, an otherworldly journey awaits you. Find answers. Face your greatest fear. Confront reality.

BEFORE I GO depicts a contemplative reflection on existence and the transitory nature of life.
Lose yourself in this enigmatic tale. In adversity, find your way to deliverance and peace.

BEFORE I GO is a challenging side-scrolling action-platformer that distils the classic genre down to its most beloved aspects,
satisfying old-school platformer lovers and enthusiasts looking for fresh mechanics.

Key Features
 - Unconventional storytelling grounded in a genuine emotional tragedy.
 - Unique art style with a foreboding and melancholic atmosphere.
 - Explore a non-linear elaborate world; immerse yourself in a dreamlike universe.
 - Overcome meticulously crafted and intense platforming sections.
 - Withstand unforgiving parasitic abominations.
 - Assimilate powerful and dexterous abilities, sharpen your skills, and perfect the promptness of your actions.
 - Master intuitive, responsive, and diligently tuned controls.

70010000104640.name: Rails of Dead: Zombie Survival Simulator
70010000104640.intro:
The last train is bound for nowhere — and it never stops.
The rails cut through darkness, fear, and the unknown.
Survive the ride… no matter what’s waiting ahead.
70010000104640.description:
Rails of Dead is a thrilling zombie survival shooter set aboard a moving train filled with danger, mystery, and the undead. Fight, explore, and survive in this action-packed horror experience!

SURVIVE USING GUNS, STRATEGY & SKILL
Collect and upgrade a wide range of weapons
Use medkits, traps, and power-ups to stay alive

DISCOVER THE MYSTERY
Piece together the story by exploring notes, finding clues, and surviving long enough to uncover the truth.

FEATURES:
Fast-paced zombie shooting gameplay
Atmospheric horror setting on a haunted train
Smooth controls and controller support
Perfect for fans of action, horror, and survival games

70010000104648.name: Tidy Toys
70010000104648.description:
In Tidy Toys, even the mess has its charm. In this casual puzzle with a touch of kitchen creativity, your mission is to organize the ingredients—or rather, toys—into pots styled like gift boxes. The goal is to fit all the pieces onto the board and fulfill the demanding orders of the customers.

Start with simple grids and basic toys, but don’t get too comfortable. As the levels progress, the boards grow larger, the shapes get trickier, and the challenges demand more strategy. Rotate, move, and place each piece carefully so no space is left behind, and earn those coveted stars.

And there’s more: every stage comes with special customer requests. You can ignore them and move forward, but can you resist the temptation to complete everything perfectly?

With 30 delightfully crafted levels, Tidy Toys delivers a relaxing, challenging, and highly addictive experience, perfect for puzzle lovers who want to prove they can put everything neatly in its place.

70010000104653.name: Claim The Forest
70010000104653.description:
In Claim the Forest, you enter a magical clearing where two unusual clans compete for territory: brave wolves and calm capybaras. Your challenge is to organize the pieces of these animals, along with logs, stones, and bushes, to fill the board without letting rivalry disturb the harmony.

Each piece has a unique shape and can be freely rotated, but beware: if a wolf ends up next to a capybara, a fight occurs and your last move disappears. This is where strategy comes in, using terrain as a natural barrier to create the perfect balance.

There are 30 levels ranging from cozy tutorials to challenging puzzles, with extra goals such as using more capybara pieces than wolf pieces or limiting the number of each clan. Achieving these goals grants special stars, but you can progress smoothly even without them.

70010000104658.name: Traditional Tactics with SESS-AI 2.0
70010000104658.description:
***** About Remake *****
This game is Remake of our work "Traditional Tactics Ne+". The changes are as follows:
- Adopt "Cheer Magic" instead of Support Card.
- Redesign the battle maps.
- Use thinking program "SESS-AI 2.0".
- Add a new unit "Sui".
- Guest unit is gettable by entering password.

***** for Beginners *****
If you don't know about Simulation RPG, this game is very helpful.
- In "Lesson Mode", you can see the rules easily.
- You can save playing data at any time in the battle.
- The most important thing to complete is thinking, not technique.
- You don't have to repeat bored work.
- The story is never cruel, so you will feel very enjoyable.

***** Story *****
You are "Prince Natri", explore the dungeon "Royal Tomb" to be the king. In there, many spirits are waiting to make a trial of your courage. Let's fight and try the simulation battle with your units!

***** Overview *****
This is team's turn-based Simulation RPG. Rules are simple and reasonable, but never easy. To win the battle, you must use "Cheer Magic" well. The most important thing is your inspiration.

***** SESS-AI 2.0 *****
We made the thinking program "SESS-AI 2.0". By it, enemy acts so various that you will be amazed. This experience exists only in our game.

***** Language *****
English and Japanese are available.

70010000104663.name: Traditional Braves with SESS-AI 2.0
70010000104663.description:
***** about Remake *****
This game is Remake of our work "Traditional Braves". The changes are as follows:
- Add a new unit "Lity".
- Adopt "Cheer Magic" instead of Support Card.
- Redesign the battle maps.
- Use thinking program "SESS-AI 2.0".
- Guest unit is gettable by entering password.

***** about Difficulty *****
This game is harder than our work "Traditional Tactics with SESS-AI 2.0", so recommend for intelligent players.
- There is a unit "Jammer", it can create Jamming Area.
- High class units appear, they are stronger.
- In a floor, enemy's Cheer Magic user of is not only one.
- SESS-AI version is 2.0.5 or later.

***** Story *****
You are "Prince Natri", you had won the test to be the next king previously. But, mother "Queen Silica" ordered to do it again with a young woman "Helim". Let's help each other to complete the new adventure!

***** Overview *****
This is team's turn-based Simulation RPG. Rules are simple and reasonable, but never easy. To win the battle, you must use "Cheer Magic" well. The most important thing is your inspiration.

***** SESS-AI 2.0 *****
We made the thinking program "SESS-AI 2.0". By it, enemy acts so various that you will be amazed. This experience exists only in our game.

***** Language *****
English and Japanese are available.

70010000104668.name: Grim Trials
70010000104668.intro: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials.
70010000104668.description:
• COMING OF AGE IN THE AFTERLIFE 

Grim Trials is a heavy metal action roguelite where you craft and customize your own weapons and equipment to embrace Death your own way. 

Play as Avelin, a young woman who has met an untimely end, and found herself recruited as one of Death’s many Reapers. Tasked to hunt down impure souls, face her demons, and fight her way through an underworld of her own making, Avelin must endure these trials to become a full-fledged Reaper and see her still-living love once again. 

• REAP THEIR SOULS 

Endless hex-grid arenas filled with monsters, traps, sinful souls, and 7 sacrilegious bosses await. Slay them all with a variety of customizable scythes, crossbows, and powerful Blessings from the Gods of Death around the world. Master the scythe and crossbow to maximize damage to your foes with a unique combat system that rewards clever use of your dual-wielded weapons. 

• GATHER MATERIALS & CRAFT EQUIPMENT

 The spoils of battle are the tools of your trade. Gather materials from the battlefield and work with your mentors in the arcane arts to craft new and ever more powerful weapons, armor, and consumables. 

• CUSTOMIZE GEARS & CREATE PERSONALIZED BUILD 

Every reaper carves their own path! Mix and match your crafted equipment with skills gained from investing in an expansive skill tree at the start of every run, then choose carefully from the randomized Blessings you obtain mid-run to create powerful builds! 

• A NEW LIFE AFTER DEATH 

Explore The Academy, built for the training and arming of Death’s various Reapers. Seek enlightenment from mentors, take on quests to build your relationships, and unlock sage advice, knowledge, and powerful support from your peers. Learn the stories of the dead by interacting with the Academy’s denizens. 

• LOVE CONQUERS DEATH 

Coming of age in the afterlife was certainly not the plan, but dying means little to the already-dead, and love unyielding wields power no god can rival. Every time Avelin falls in battle, the experience and materials you’ve earned stay with her. Live, fight, die, then live again, over and over until the promise is kept.

70010000104686.name: JellyFish Girls
70010000104686.intro:
Cute girls wrapped in jellyfish appear in large numbers!
An easy puzzle game anyone can play!
70010000104686.description:
Match the pieces of adorable jellyfish girls to complete the puzzle!
Clear the stages and unlock their images in the gallery!

70010000104699.name: Legendary Tales: Map of Hope
70010000104699.intro: Follow the dream of haven to reclaim your freedom.
70010000104699.description:
Face the path no one would walk. Believe in what was lost. Some truths are buried where only the high-hearted dare step.

“Legendary Tales: Map of Hope” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

Lucia and her brother have spent years running and hiding from witches, with nowhere left to turn. But their old friend Skarlett brings news that dispels the looming despair: there may be a place where they can finally reunite with their own kind.

Unfortunately, Skarlett cannot join the journey. The risk of exposing herself among the witches is far too great. Lucia must walk this path alone.

Still, as ever, she and her brother won’t be truly alone. Along the way, they’ll find allies—some familiar, some unexpected—each helping them inch closer to that distant dream.

Will they finally find peace among their kindred?

- Prove that the legends are true
- Explore the magic world and its forgotten secrets
- Gather fascinating collections and find dozens of morphing objects
- Enjoy stunning locations and beautiful soundtracks
- Solve dozens of puzzles and test your skills in exciting mini-games

70010000104704.name: Storm Chasing Sim 2025 - Tornado Hunter
70010000104704.intro: Drive into danger, uncover the secrets of the storm.
70010000104704.description:
Storm Chasing Sim 2025 - Tornado Hunter puts you in the heart of extreme weather action. Take control of powerful storm-chasing vehicles and track down the most intense and dangerous tornadoes across vast, dynamic landscapes. Feel the adrenaline as you navigate through unpredictable weather patterns, battling wind, rain, and debris in your pursuit of the perfect storm.

Features:
-Realistic storm physics: Experience authentic tornado behavior, wind forces, and weather changes that challenge your driving and strategy.
-Dynamic open world: Explore sprawling plains, rural towns, and storm-prone areas as you hunt for severe weather events.
-Advanced storm tracking tools: Use radar, weather sensors, and live updates to locate and intercept tornadoes before they strike.
-Vehicle customization and upgrades: Equip your chase vehicle with the latest tech, reinforced armor, and performance enhancements to survive harsh conditions.
-Challenging missions and free roam: Take on intense timed chases or roam freely to capture incredible storm footage and collect data.

Prepare to brave the fury of nature, chase the chaos, and become the ultimate tornado hunter. Are you ready to face the storm?

70010000104709.name: CANDYLAND: Sweet Survival
70010000104709.intro: The sweetest factory conceals the darkest secrets.
70010000104709.description:
Delve into the chilling mysteries of a forsaken chocolate factory, where shadows linger and whispers echo through empty halls. Explore haunting levels filled with foreboding, solve macabre puzzles, and evade sinister entities that hunger for your soul.

Step into “CANDYLAND: Sweet Survival”, a dark journey where forgotten laughter meets whispers of dread. Ascend to the top floor as you uncover the factory’s grim secrets, encountering eerie rooms, hidden passages, and twisted remnants of a once-celebrated chocolate wonderland.

Key Features:
	•	Haunting Chocolate Factory: Traverse the neglected chambers of a once-famous chocolate factory, where echoes of joy clash with unsettling darkness.
	•	Intricate Puzzles: Face clever, challenging puzzles built from sinister toys and giant blocks, testing your wit and ingenuity.
	•	Survival Horror Gameplay: Use stealth, cunning, and quick thinking to survive the pursuit of malevolent entities lurking in the shadows.
	•	Collect Precious Candies: Search the factory for special candies, key to progressing through its mysterious levels.
	•	Immersive Atmosphere: Detailed visuals and a chilling soundtrack bring the factory to life, enhancing the feeling of dread and suspense.

Merge the innocence of a chocolate wonderland with the tension of survival horror. Can you uncover the dark truths hidden in CANDYLAND: Sweet Survival and survive the shadows that await?

70010000104722.name: Dungeons and Ducklings
70010000104722.intro: Break walls, crush bosses, rescue ducklings and end the Lich - Quack ‘em up!

70010000104727.name: Retro Geek Shop Simulator
70010000104727.intro: Become the Ultimate Geek Store Owner!
70010000104727.description:
Have you ever dreamed of running your very own geek store? In Retro Geek Shop Simulator, you step into the shoes of a store owner managing a shop filled with the latest consoles, legendary video games, and must-have geek collectibles. Your goal? Build the ultimate geek paradise, attract loyal customers, and make your shop the hottest spot in town!

Stock Up & Sell – order new consoles, games, and collectibles to keep your inventory fresh and exciting.
Set Your Prices – balance profit and demand. Will you go for big margins or attract more customers with discounts?
Open & Close Your Shop – manage your workday by deciding when to open for business and when to restock.
Build Your Reputation – customer reviews shape your success! Keep them happy and watch your shop grow.
Customize Your Store – decorate your shop with posters, shelves, and cool displays to make it truly yours.
Rare & Limited Items – some products are extra special—if you get them, you can sell them for a huge profit!

Can you turn your small shop into the ultimate geek haven? Get ready to manage, sell, and grow in Retro Geek Shop Simulator!

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team!

70010000104732.name: QUARANTINE AREA
70010000104732.intro: Trust your instincts. The future depends on it.
70010000104732.description:
You are the warden of humanity’s last safe haven. Every day, survivors arrive at the gates of your base, and it’s up to you to decide who deserves to be let in.

Screen each newcomer carefully:
- If the person is healthy, let them in they can help develop the base.
- If they’re infected, send them to the elimination zone to protect the others.
- If you're unsure place them in quarantine and monitor for symptoms.

Expand your base, improve living conditions, gather resources, and extend your influence.
Can you hold on to your humanity while making life-or-death decisions?

70010000104737.name: Dark Auction
70010000104737.intro:
The Auction of Dark Memories Begins Now.
What truths await beyond a bid made with your life?
70010000104737.description:
STORY:
1981, Somewhere in Europe.

Eighteen-year-old Noah, who still carries the memory of being abandoned by his mother as a child, lives with his father Leonard, a struggling novelist obsessed with collecting items related to the mysterious “Dictator X.”
Although Noah wishes his father would give up this bizarre hobby, Leonard refuses to stop—no matter how dire their financial situation becomes.

One day, Leonard receives an invitation to an exclusive auction. Ignoring Noah’s protests, he leaves for the old castle where the event is to be held, promising, “I’ll tell you everything once I return.”
But the promised day comes and goes—Leonard never returns, and Noah cannot reach him. Worried, Noah sets out for the castle himself. There, he witnesses a shocking scene that changes everything.

Before long, Noah finds himself trapped inside the castle along with the other auction guests. At the auctioneer’s invitation, he is drawn into participating in this strange and sinister auction…

Characters:
Noah Crawford (VA:  Kengo Kawanishi)
Leonard Crawford (VA: Rikiya Koyama)
Edgar Schulz (VA: Daisuke Namikawa)
Christoph Treheim von Berg (VA: Nobunaga Shimazaki)
Otto Klein (VA: Shunsuke Takeuchi)
Karla Becker (VA: Maaya Uchida)
Lorraine Klopp (VA: Yui Ishikawa)
Hell (VA: Akira Ishida)
Auctioneer (VA: Show Hayami)

Game features:
- Explore freely within an ancient castle rendered in 3D
- Use your reasoning skills to piece together clues from the Word Cloud system.
- Join an auction where the truth is revealed about the past

Information gathered during the exploration phase is stored in a feature called the “Word Cloud.”
These collected keywords can then be used during the auction phase to help solve its many mysteries.

In this world, what you need to bid on an item isn’t money—it’s memory.
Participants use a memory-reproduction device known as EPO, offering fragments of their own memories as payment to compete in the auction.

However, memories burdened by secrets or trauma are often distorted, blurred, or even rewritten into false versions of the past.
If the memories offered are incomplete or corrupted, the auction will fail.
Acting as a supporter, Noah must step in to restore each target’s memories to their true form.
When an auction succeeds, a hidden truth is revealed—and with it, the strange and fateful stories behind each auctioned item are set free.

Original story / scenario: Rika Suzuki 
Character design: KOHSKE 
Soundtrack: Yuko Komiyama, Tsukasa Masuko
Directed and produced: Shinsuke Umeda

*This game tells the story of a group of young people who resolve to pursue a peaceful future after learning the truth of the past. While historical, war-related recollections appear as motifs throughout the narrative, this game does not, in any way, seek to glorify or justify the crimes of war.

70010000104742.name: Toy Cowboy Royale : RPG Dragon's Challenge
70010000104742.intro: Embark on an epic toy cowboy adventure.Battle legendary dragons and claim your glory.
70010000104742.description:
Saddle up and enter the wild, fantastical world of Toy Cowboy Royale: RPG Dragon’s Challenge! Take on the role of a daring toy cowboy in a magical land filled with dragons, treasures, and epic battles. Explore vibrant landscapes, complete challenging quests, and face legendary dragons in intense RPG combat. Customize your cowboy, upgrade weapons, and master unique abilities as you fight to become the ultimate hero of the realm.

Features:
	•	Epic RPG Adventure: Embark on thrilling quests and face powerful enemies in a colorful, toy-inspired world.
	•	Dragon Battles: Challenge legendary dragons with strategy, skill, and courage.
	•	Exploration and Discovery: Roam diverse environments filled with secrets, treasures, and hidden challenges.
	•	Strategic Combat: Use weapons, skills, and tactics to overcome dangerous foes.

Are you ready to prove your bravery and conquer the dragons? Your adventure begins now!

70010000104747.name: MotoGP™26
70010000104747.description:
The Official 2026 Championship
Experience the full intensity of the 2026 MotoGP™ Championship with all the official riders, teams, bikes and tracks in a more authentic way: for the first time, the real-world results dynamically update Riders Ratings, directly influencing in-game performance throughout the season. Step into the spotlight and track your journey with dazzling Collectible Cards celebrating your progress.

Renewed Physics for Total Control
Jump straight into action with the Arcade Experience or dive into pure simulation with the Pro Experience, both supported by tutorials, adaptive difficulty and Neural Aids. Enjoy a renewed physics system built around a new rider-based handling model: your body movement on the bike matters more than ever, delivering greater control and a more authentic riding feel.

A Deeper Career
Build your legacy from Rookie to Legend with a custom rider or relive and reshape the career of an official MotoGP™ star. Your journey evolves season after season through contract negotiations, rider market dynamics and press conferences that shape your future. Your words to the media influence upcoming challenges, while your collaboration with teams drives bike development. Every decision becomes part of your story.

Train and Experiment
Step away from the paddock and explore new ways to ride. Train with the Motard, Flat Track and Minibike disciplines, or hit the circuit with Production Bikes, models featured in single-brand events with dedicated physics.

70010000104752.name: DETECTIVE - Scene Crime
70010000104752.intro: Five brutal crimes. One detective to solve them all.
70010000104752.description:
Step into the role of a detective in DETECTIVE Scene Crime, a challenging mystery game where you’ll investigate five gripping cases. Each level features unique locations, clues, testimonies, and puzzles. Analyze every detail to uncover what really happened.

Five new crime scenes:
• The Hospital: Was it a case of medical negligence or premeditated murder?
• The Subway: A bloodstained train and more questions than answers.
• The Road: A highway crash that doesn’t add up.
• The Supermarket: A shooting with possible hidden motives.
• The Hotel: A wedding turned tragedy. Can you unravel the chaos?

Take notes, connect the dots, and test your reasoning. Every case hides the truth—you just have to find it.

Features
• A compelling narrative that keeps you on edge until the very end.
• Designed for mystery lovers and investigation fans.
• Discover what happened, who did it, and why.

70010000104756.name: BattleTanks - Animal Wars
70010000104756.intro:
Save the animal kingdom from mole-fueled doom.
Face giant mech-bosses, collect weapons and build your tank.
Unleash tank fury - solo or with friends!
70010000104756.description:
Moles have declared war. The animal world is in chaos. Naturally, the solution is tanks.

In BattleTanks - Animal Wars, you’ll roll into battle as a Racoon, Bear, Wolf or even Panda (yes, really) and blast your way through five bizarre worlds filled with explosions, bad driving, and questionable military decisions.

Customize your ride with different weapons and weird tank parts. 

- 80+ story missions featuring combat, defense, side-scrolling chaos, and puzzles
- Ridiculous mech-bosses that really, really don’t like you
- Local co-op for up to 4 players - because friendship means firing wildly in every direction

Switch between top-down mayhem and first-person fury, and take down the mole menace once and for all. Or at least… blow them up repeatedly.

70010000104758.name: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint
70010000104758.intro: Control the border, safeguard countless lives.
70010000104758.description:
Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint puts you in charge of a high-stakes border in a world teetering on the edge of a zombie outbreak. Every person who approaches your checkpoint could be healthy—or harbor a deadly infection. Use military-grade tools, sharp intuition, and strategic judgment to separate the living from the infected, because every mistake can spell disaster.

Key Features:
- Advanced Screening Tools: Utilize UV lights, thermometers, and manual scanners to uncover infections and hidden contraband.
- Supply and Equipment Strategy: Carefully manage scarce test kits and inspection devices while keeping order at the checkpoint.
- Unpredictable Threats: Handle an ever-changing flow of refugees, from the healthy to those carrying dangerous pathogens.
- Critical Choices: Decide who enters, who is quarantined, and who must be eliminated based on clues, documents, and medical results.

Every person at your checkpoint carries a risk—some seek help, others conceal deadly threats. One wrong decision can ignite chaos and cost countless lives. How long can you maintain control and protect those who can still be saved?

70010000104763.name: The Prisoning: Fletcher's Quest
70010000104763.intro: Help Fletcher Howie Jr. escape his mental prison and save the day!
70010000104763.description:
After a psychologist visit goes terribly wrong, you find yourself trapped in the mind of a game developer on the brink of physical and emotional burnout during the final stages of an intense project. Experience a metroidvania-lite drenched in anxiety and based on a very true story.

Features:
*Based on a true story and definitely inspired by real events
*Upgrades, weapons, bosses, enemies and all that jazz
*Contains story
*Have you ever seen a honky-tonk man as naked as the day he was born? Contains full frontal pixel nudity!
*Completely free of jazz fusion!
*Procedurally generated metroidvania, whatever that means.
*Do you like movies about gladiators? 

(This game is not recommended for anyone with a peanut allergy)

But hey, not down with anxiety? All of the points above can be completely skipped as you plow your way through another tight platformer with killer mechanics (meaning you can kill basically anything that moves), a banging chiptune soundtrack from the legendary Dunderpatrullen, and more pixel art than you can possibly stomach!

70010000104779.name: Lynked: Banner of the Spark – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000104779.intro: Team up for an ARPG adventure!
70010000104779.description:
It’s the year 30XX, and the natural world has been overrun by an evil robot force… but all is not lost. As you rescue and join forces with a charming band of robot companions called the Unibots, you’ll form a community of fearless friends, and work together to build a new future from the ground up.

A ROGUE-LIFE RPG
Lynked: Banner of the Spark fuses the action packed fun of a roguelite with the rich progression and charm of a life sim. In this vibrant rogue-life RPG, combat and customization go hand in hand. Put your skills to the test against swarms of robot foes and tough-as-nails bosses, then use their parts and other resources to expand and upgrade your home base. Whether you’re a homebody or a hardened warrior, there are endless ways to pitch in – it’ll take a village to save the world!

LYNK UP IN CO-OP OR SOLO
Take on a variety of hack-and-slash missions either solo or with up to 3 players. But wait… your Unibot pals want a piece of the action, too! Players can power up and recruit allied bots into the fight as companions, where they have their own powers, fighting styles, and combo attacks to send your foes to the scrap pile!

WEAPONS AND THE WYRE 
Kick bolts with your trusty grapple, known as the Wyre, along with an arsenal of weapons at your disposal! Gain an edge on enemies with 10 weapon classes, 80+ variations, robust permanent progression systems, and randomized mid-mission upgrades ensuring no two runs are ever the same.  

BUILD A THRIVING TOWN 
Enlist the help of robots and up to 5 friends to work together and build a bright local community. Catch fish, collect critters, harvest crops, and craft items to make your home uniquely yours! In addition to enriching your town, use the resources you collect to upgrade your character with special powers and techniques to take to your next fight.

FINE-TUNE YOUR LOOK 
Rebuild society in style with deep character customization, featuring more options and accessories than you can shake a wrench at!

70010000104780.name: EGGCONSOLE KISS OF MURDER PC-8801
70010000104780.intro: The third entry in the detective J.B. Harold series is, surprisingly, a parallel story to “Manhattan Requiem”! Use deduction commands to solve the case.
70010000104780.description:
This title is an adventure game released in Japan by Riverhill soft in 1987 and serves as the third entry in the detective J.B. Harold series, following "MURDER CLUB" (1986) and "Manhattan Requiem" (1987). However, as indicated by the phrase “another story of MANHATTAN REQUIEM” on the title screen, it is not a numbered sequel but rather a parallel story to the second game, "Manhattan Requiem."

The story centers on the theft of "The Blue Lament" sapphire from a jewelry store, driven by complex human relationships and intricate deductions. This title introduces the "Deduction" command, a first for the J.B. Harold series. Unlike previous games, proper use of this deduction is now required for progression, offering a more advanced mystery adventure.

Looking back at its historical context, the game also featured an interesting experiment for its time. "KISS OF MURDER" required players to load image data from "Manhattan Requiem" in order to play. As a result, owning a copy of "Manhattan Requiem" was necessary. It is said that the developers assumed, "Since this is a side story, only fans who own the previous game would buy it. So let’s make it low-priced by loading data from the prior title!"


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000104796.name: Sky Love Girls: Flight Attendant Crush
70010000104796.intro:
Step on board and meet charming flight attendants.
Can you capture the hearts of the cabin crew?
70010000104796.description:
Step onto the plane and experience the most thrilling flight of your life as you try to flirt with irresistible flight attendants… while protecting their hearts from any unexpected turbulence.

Combine daring questions with high-altitude defense gameplay to unlock suggestive images and surprising endings.

Discover how each flight attendant reacts to your answers, your charm, and your ability to keep things under control in the sky. Do you have the confidence (and the reflexes) to conquer love at 30,000 feet?

Features:

● Dual gameplay at cruising altitude: Switch between flirty Q&A and defense mode, where you must block “attacks” (jealous passengers, spilled drinks, sudden turbulence) to unlock new scenes.

● Suggestive images and unique encounters: Earn their trust and uncover special moments as you progress through each flight route.

● Get to know their personalities: Every answer reveals each attendant’s tastes, limits, and secrets—from the shy rookie to the playful charmer.

● Multiple endings: The outcome depends on how many questions you get right, how well you protect her heart, and how you read her signals.

● A secret, spicy question: Reach question 150 to reveal a special final moment in the sky.

Can you stay cool, avoid turbulence, and capture their hearts above the clouds?

70010000104802.name: Truck Simulator 2025: City Work Delivery
70010000104802.intro: Complete deliveries, unlock new trucks, expand your trucking empire.
70010000104802.description:
Welcome to the ultimate truck driving experience! Truck Simulator 2025: City Work Delivery brings you the thrill of driving powerful cargo trucks through bustling city streets and challenging offroad terrains. Fasten your seatbelt and take on the role of a professional truck driver.
Key Features:
• Realistic Truck Physics: Experience authentic driving mechanics for a true-to-life trucking adventure
• Diverse Missions: Take on a variety of challenging delivery tasks, from city streets to offroad terrains.
• Customizable Trucks: Upgrade and personalize your vehicles to suit your driving style and mission needs.
• Dynamic Environments: Drive through detailed cityscapes, highways, and rugged offroad routes with changing weather conditions.
• Reward System: Earn rewards for successful deliveries and unlock new trucks, routes, and features.
Get ready to navigate city roads, tackle difficult routes, and prove your skills as the best cargo driver in town. Truck Simulator 2025: City Work Delivery has everything you need to enjoy the journey – from authentic truck physics to immersive challenges. Are you ready to take the wheel?

70010000104807.name: Sky Love Boys: Flight Attendant Crush
70010000104807.intro:
Step on board and meet charming male flight attendants.
Can you capture the hearts of the cabin crew?
70010000104807.description:
Step onto the plane and experience the most thrilling flight of your life as you try to flirt with irresistible male flight attendants… while protecting their hearts from any unexpected turbulence.

Combine daring questions with high-altitude defense gameplay to unlock suggestive images and surprising endings.

Discover how each flight attendant reacts to your answers, your charm, and your ability to keep things under control in the sky. Do you have the confidence (and the reflexes) to conquer love at 30,000 feet?


Features:

● Dual gameplay at cruising altitude: Switch between flirty Q&A and defense mode, where you must block “attacks” (jealous passengers, spilled drinks, sudden turbulence) to unlock new scenes.

● Suggestive images and unique encounters: Earn their trust and uncover special moments as you progress through each flight route.

● Get to know their personalities: Every answer reveals each attendant’s tastes, limits, and secrets—from the shy rookie to the playful charmer.

● Multiple endings: The outcome depends on how many questions you get right, how well you protect his heart, and how you read his signals.

● A secret, spicy question: Reach question 150 to reveal a special final moment in the sky.


Can you stay cool, avoid turbulence, and capture their hearts above the clouds?

70010000104812.name: Cross Pix 3
70010000104812.description:
Cross Pix 3 is a NEW NONOGRAM Logic Puzzle Game! where you follow number clues to solve a hidden image. It’s also known by other similar games like Griddlers, Hanjie or Paint by Numbers.

Cross Pix 3 features ALL NEW 105 hand-crafted puzzles and intuitive gameplay with gradually increasing difficulty.

With simple and easy-to-understand rules, it's a game anyone can enjoy! A perfect choice for casual play, while still offering a satisfying mental challenge.

Cross Pix 3 delivers a relaxing and cozy puzzle experience that keeps your mind sharp and engaged.


Features:
★ Nintendo Switch™ online leaderboards for each mode (opt-out available).
★ 5 professionally composed background tracks.
★ Multi-language support.
★ Play with Joy-Con™, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller™  or touchscreen.
★ Quick-start help system – perfect for beginners!
★ Settings to adjust pointer speed, sound on/off, background music on/off.
★ Four sizes 5x5, 10x10, 15x15 puzzle board, from easy to challenging.

Cross Pix 3 offers an immersive experience for puzzle lovers of all ages. 

Are you ready to take on the ultimate nonogram challenge and rise to the top of the world leaderboard? 

Note : Button Mappings:
[A] Select/Mark
[B] Check board complete
[X] Toggle X or block marker
[Y] Centre puzzle board

70010000104818.name: Sexy Erotic Xtreme Club
70010000104818.intro: Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and admire every detail of stunning artwork!
70010000104818.description:
Welcome to Sexy Erotic Xtreme Club, a stylish and relaxing puzzle game where each completed level unlocks a beautiful illustration of charming characters in glamorous outfits.

Immerse yourself in a classic jigsaw experience with smooth, realistic mechanics and an elegant visual style. Each image is carefully crafted, full of expressive details, bright emotions, and unique poses that add depth and allure. Enjoy a cozy atmosphere with calming background music as you piece together every artwork.

Whether you're here for the challenge or the art, Sexy Erotic Xtreme Club delivers an engaging and rewarding experience.

Game Features:

- Over 40 puzzles featuring elegant and eye-catching characters

- High-resolution illustrations with attention to detail

- Smooth, realistic puzzle assembly

- Relaxing soundtrack to enhance immersion

- Gallery mode to view completed artworks

70010000104823.name: Farm Simulator 2025
70010000104823.intro: Build your dream farm and grow your success!
70010000104823.description:
Step into the boots of a modern farmer and build your agricultural empire! Operate powerful tractors, harvesters, and trucks as you cultivate fields, raise animals, and deliver goods to market.
Explore vast open landscapes with forests, rivers, and changing weather. Hire workers, upgrade machinery, and manage every detail of your farm to boost efficiency and profits. Every machine reacts authentically, with dirt, dust, and terrain effects that bring farming to life.

Key Features:
• Expansive World: Fields, forests, and rivers to explore and cultivate.
• Authentic Machinery: Realistic tractors, harvesters, and trucks with true-to-life handling.
• Dynamic Farming: Plant, grow, and harvest a variety of crops.
• Farm Management: Breed animals, hire workers, and expand your operations.
• Trade & Transport: Deliver goods and sell crops for profit.
• Immersive Environments: Weather, day-night cycles, and realistic terrain.
• Upgrades & Customization: Improve equipment, manage fuel, and enhance performance.

From sowing seeds to selling harvests, every choice shapes your success. Farm Simulator 2025 blends realism, strategy, and freedom into the ultimate farming experience.

70010000104828.name: Emma and her Little Dragon
70010000104828.intro: Emma finds a shiny egg and from it hatches Spyke, a purple dragon with whom she will live a great adventure to save a magical world hidden underground.
70010000104828.description:
Emma and Her Little Dragon is a magical and exciting visual novel for adventurous kids.

Emma and her inseparable friend Mia delve into breathing tunnels, whispering forests, and singing caves, accompanied by Spyke, a small purple dragon who holds the secret to saving Hollow Earth, a kingdom hidden beneath the earth.

As the mysterious Men in Suits try to steal the magic to make themselves rich, Emma will discover that true strength lies in trust, friendship, and a brave heart.

What you'll find inside:

A great fantasy and adventure story full of excitement.

An adorable dragon who will be readers' best friend.

Magical and spectacular full-color illustrations.

Secret worlds with luminous creatures and impossible landscapes.

A tender message about friendship and trust that inspires little ones.

A perfect read to let your imagination run wild, laugh, get excited, and discover that even the smallest friendship can open the door to a whole world.

70010000104842.name: High On Life: Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000104842.description:
Fresh out of high school with no job and no ambition, you’ve really got nothing going for you until an alien cartel that wants to get high off humanity invades Earth. Now, you and a team of charismatic talking guns must answer the hero's call and become the deadliest intergalactic bounty hunter the cosmos has ever seen.

Travel to a variety of biomes and locations across the cosmos, go up against the nefarious Garmantuous and his gang of goons, collect loot, meet unique characters, and more, in the latest comedy adventure from Squanch Games!

High On Life: High On Knife DLC
It’s been 2 years since the Bounty Hunter defeated the G3 cartel. Now Knifey needs help tracking down a mysterious package from his homeworld. Will they get mixed up with a friendly giant, a pinball gun, poaching rings, and a terrifying intergalactic shipping company? Yeah. Sure.

70010000104843.name: Meow Moments: Celebrating Beats & Books
70010000104843.intro: Join cute cats in festive scenes! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore a vibrant music festival and a lively university campus full of discovery and fun.
70010000104843.description:
Join the Celebration! In this cozy hidden-object adventure, cats and friends gather to explore creativity, connection, and self-expression across two lively scenes. Every detail invites you to imagine stories unfolding in a world where music and learning bring everyone together.

Start your journey at an outdoor music festival where characters of all styles enjoy electrifying performances across diverse stages—from chill acoustic sets to energetic pop and electronic beats. Wander through food trucks, a Ferris wheel, and cozy camping zones in a joyful celebration of harmony and fun.

Then, step into a welcoming university campus filled with the excitement of student life. Discover cats and friends engaged in study sessions under the trees, creative clubs, and athletic games, all set in a vibrant academic atmosphere that celebrates growth and friendship.

Features:
- Cats and Friends: Find delightful characters in two detailed scenes, each full of unique stories waiting to be uncovered.
- Balloon-Popping Fun: Enjoy relaxing gameplay as you pop balloons across the scenes—a bit of fun with every search!
- Rich Details: Explore beautifully illustrated settings brought to life by artist Katia Numakura, with visual storytelling in every corner.
- 606 Items to Find! From cats and balloons to characters with diverse styles and backgrounds, there’s always something new to spot.
- Atmospheric Soundtrack: Set the tone with immersive music by Tatyana Jacques, tailored to match each scene—from indie folk vibes to academic serenity.
- Family-Friendly Fun: With cozy, pressure-free gameplay and intuitive controls, it’s an experience for all ages. Perfect for relaxing together or playing solo.

Celebrate creativity and community in this heartwarming journey—where every moment is worth remembering.

70010000104849.name: Metroid Prime™ 4: Beyond – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000104849.intro: Explore a mysterious planet to find your way home
70010000104849.description:
Deadly sharpshooter Sylux has finally caught up with renowned bounty hunter Samus Aran! After an unexpected accident in the wake of their clash, Samus finds herself transported to Viewros—a mysterious planet once inhabited by an ancient race. Now she must explore this planet, all while battling the strange creatures that inhabit it, to find her way home.
 
Scan your surroundings for clues, make the most of your equipment and weapons, and use Samus’s newfound psychic abilities—and her technologically advanced bike, the Vi-O-La—to traverse and explore the environment. Operate mechanisms, control your charge beam, and more—you’ll need every tool at your disposal to survive and escape Viewros!

Play with mouse controls, enhanced visuals, and two different display modes—only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system

Aim with a Joy-Con 2™ controller as a mouse! The Metroid Prime™ 4: Beyond – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition game also features enhanced resolution, framerate, and load times. 

Two display modes let you choose how to experience the adventure. Enjoy more detail in Quality Mode, which runs at 60 frames per second in 4k while docked and in 1080p while in handheld, or prioritize super-smooth action with a higher frame rate in Performance Mode, which runs at 120 frames per second in 1080p while docked and 720p in while in handheld. Both choices are HDR compatible.

70010000104854.name: Dragon Ruins II
70010000104854.intro: Explore dungeons, grow stronger, and slay the dragon to become a hero!
70010000104854.description:
As an adventurer party based in the capital city of Isigwere, take on a wide range of quests—from small requests by townsfolk, like dealing with goblins, to the queen’s grand command to defeat the dragon that awakened in the underground ruins. Can you stop the world’s destruction and rise as the legendary hero?

- A dungeon crawler RPG where you grow stronger while exploring 15 dungeons.
- Choose 4 members from 21 classes such as Fighter and Ranger to form your party.
- Accept quests, hunt for treasure, and power up through auto battles.
- Make use of new equipment and skills to gain the upper hand in battle.
- Take on increasingly powerful foes and bosses in replayable runs.

70010000104865.name: Trippy Trader: Schedule & Sell Candy
70010000104865.intro: In a world where candy is forbidden, you become an sweet dealer. Craft candies, outsmart the Candy Police, and build your sugar empire in this colorful prohibition parody.
70010000104865.description:
Welcome to Trippy Trader: Schedule & Sell Candy, a cartoony underground management game set in a world where sweets are outlawed. 
The government has banned all forms of candy, unleashing the Candy Police to hunt down anyone who dares to indulge. But the people still crave sugar—and you’re here to supply it. 

Manufacture Candies – Mix flavors and colors in quirky minigames to create irresistible treats. 
Schedule & Sell – Organize your candy runs, plan smart deliveries, and manage a secret network of sweet-toothed customers. 
Evade Candy Police – Stay one step ahead of patrols, set up clever decoys, and avoid getting caught. 
Grow Your Sugar Empire – Build your reputation, expand your operations, and become the sweetest outlaw alive. 

Will you bring joy back to the city, or will the Candy Police crush your sugary rebellion?

70010000104876.name: BIRDCAGE
70010000104876.intro: Break free of your cage and protect humanity from certain destruction in old-school shoot’em up style!
70010000104876.description:
BIRDCAGE is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shoot’em up inspired by genre classics, blending gritty pixel art sprites with 2.5D backdrops and a pumping retro soundtrack! Blast through 6 unique stages of bullet hell mayhem, facing off against enemy swarms using multiple shot types and rechargeable specials.

Chase high scores by maintaining chains and kill rate. Strategically activate Hyperblade mode in tense situations, and take down screen-filling bosses! Can you break free of your cage and redeem humanity?

• Blast through 6 unique stages of bullet hell mayhem!
• Enjoy retro aesthetics with 2D pixel art sprites and 2.5D environments.
• Strategically switch between spread shots and focused attacks.
• Charge homing specials and deploy Hyperblade mode!
• Aim for higher scores with attack chains and precise kill rates.
• Engage in a thought-provoking narrative and review memories as you progress.

70010000104881.name: Bomb Kitten
70010000104881.intro: Get frisky with explosives and blast your way through tricky mazelike puzzle stages!
70010000104881.description:
Play as Bomb Kitten, a cunning black cat in a red cape, in this old-school action puzzler! Blast through grid-based stages, outsmart enemies, and use bombs to clear paths—but watch for spikes and traps.

Collect hidden items, master 50 explosive challenges, and reach the exit ladder to escape these labyrinthine halls!

• Navigate increasingly complex puzzle stages.
• Set bombs to clear a path and eliminate dangerous foes.
• Avoid traps and exploit stage gimmicks!
• Collect special items across 50 levels.

70010000104886.name: Last Order
70010000104886.intro: Demanding wire action to find your way in a devastated world!
70010000104886.description:
An abandoned Automata 'Yukiwari' awakens at the end of the sewers, in a graveyard of discarded Automata. Having lost her memory, she still embarks on a journey to reclaim the light her heart longs for - the 'Last Order.' 


'Last Order' is a 2D action game with pixel art graphics and high difficulty. Utilize a variety of wire actions to recover the Last Order in a devastated world.


<<Offensive wire action>>

In Last Order, wire actions are not just about movement.

• Swing Wire
Swing wire is an action for movement and attack with wires strung across the ceiling.
Wires can cut off the enemies by passing, so it will be the primary means of attack.

• Dive Wire
Dive Wire is an action to move at high speed to scaffolds and to enemies by elastic wire.
You can break away from danger or Dive into the enemy freely.

• Shackle Wire
Shackle Wire is an action to entangle and throw enemies or shells.
It can be used not only to shoot down enemies in the distance., but also as a defense to catch shells.


<<Growth to match your style>>
Grow yourself according to your play style.
Power if you prefer short term battles, or resilience if you are prepared for long term battles.


<<Customize ability to fit situation>>

Equip the order chips you obtained to gain new abilities.
Use the order chip according to the situation and your style.


<<Exploration>>

Items are hidden in the stages where automatas are abounded.
Exploration will help you find a key to your journey.


<<Tense boss battle>>

Bosses with a wide variety of actions are powerful, but they are not overpowered difficulty.
Spot the pattern, bring down them with your skill and strategy.

70010000104894.name: Adventure in Wonderwood
70010000104894.intro: Lucia and her friends travel to Wonderwood, a magical world full of challenges, mysteries, and adventures. Will they be able to open the legendary magic chest?
70010000104894.description:
A park, a portal... and the adventure begins!

Lucia and her friends travel to Wonderwood, a world full of magic, challenges, and incredible places. There they will learn that true "magic weapons" aren't wands or spells... they're their own virtues!

In this visual novel for kids, you'll find:
· Magical adventures in singing forests, mysterious rivers, and impossible bridges.

· A brilliant unicorn named Brillo, always ready to help.

· Inseparable friends: Sofia, Mateo, and David, each with their own special ability.

· Fun challenges: riddles, secret melodies, and tests that will test Lucia's ingenuity.

· Positive messages: creativity, courage, compassion, intelligence, and perseverance.

A story with the excitement of a hero's journey, but made so that little ones laugh, imagine, and feel that they too can open any treasure chest... even the most legendary ones.

70010000104901.name: Construction Sim: City and Road Builder
70010000104901.intro: Master machines and build a thriving construction empire.
70010000104901.description:
Take the reins of your own construction company and transform a small contracting gig into an industry-leading empire. In Construction Sim: City and Road Builder, every job is a stepping stone — from hauling materials and clearing sites to assembling massive bridges, paving roads, and even installing wind turbines.

Master the art of construction with a deep set of mechanics:
- Dynamic Contract System – Tackle jobs of varying complexity, from simple one-star deliveries to multi-stage mega projects.
- Company Progression – Upgrade your business to unlock advanced contracts, features, and bigger challenges.
- Specialized Machinery – Purchase, maintain, and operate a full fleet of equipment, from excavators and cranes to dump trucks and compactors.
- Realistic Operations – Experience authentic physics for loading, leveling, compacting, and transporting.
- Equipment Management – Match the right machines to each job, and keep them in shape with a detailed repair system.

With clean, realistic visuals and an atmosphere that captures the everyday grind of the construction world, Construction Sim: City and Road Builder delivers the satisfying journey from rookie contractor to industry titan.

70010000104911.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Okcheon-gun
70010000104911.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Okcheon-gun, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 2 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000104948.name: Gravity Trials: Underground
70010000104948.intro: Gravity Trials: Underground – an exciting motorcycle game with realistic physics and spectacular stunts!
70010000104948.description:
Compete with other players, racing through tracks with as few falls as possible.

Perform front and back flips on your motorcycle.

Ride as far as you can on the back wheel.

Overcome dynamic obstacles and solve puzzles on your way to the finish line.

It’s going to be intense — not every track can be conquered on the first try. Prove that you’ve got the courage and skill to become the best on the underground tracks!

70010000104954.name: Flood Parkour Obby
70010000104954.description:
Welcome to Flood Parkour Obby, the ultimate obstacle course challenge! Navigate a rising, dangerous tide across thrilling, handcrafted levels filled with tricky jumps and heart-pounding moments. One wrong step, and it's game over!

Two Ways to Play!
Normal Mode – Take on the challenge with the help of checkpoints. Fall? Just respawn and keep going!

Hardcore Mode – No checkpoints. No mercy. Only the best will make it through! But those who do will unlock a secret bonus level not available anywhere else…

Features:
>Fast-paced, fluid parkour action
>Colorful, flooded environment
>Two difficulty modes for casual players and hardcore jump masters
>Secret bonus content for skilled survivors
>Perfect for solo speedruns

Are your reflexes sharp enough? Are your jumps precise enough? Can you beat the flood?

70010000104957.name: Pixel Game Maker Series Shiki-Shiki! Haunted Dungeon
70010000104957.intro: Can Shiki, a ghost-hunting apprentice, escape from the high-rise apartment building that has become a realm of the supernatural?
70010000104957.description:
■Game Overview
“Shiki-Shiki! Haunted Dungeon” is a 2D exploration action game (Metroidvania) featuring unique gameplay centered around “Shiki-Wall”—the ability to create walls and platforms at targeted locations.
The story follows Shiki, a ghost-hunting apprentice girl, as she confronts a curse placed upon the high-rise apartment complex that serves as the game's setting.

■System Introduction
Shiki's trusty weapon is her paper dolls, the “Shikigami”!
Shikigami are versatile tools for attacking, defending, moving, and activating gimmicks.
The “Shiki-Wall” ability—transforming Shikigami into walls—is especially key to progress!
However, you start with only one Shikigami.
Explore the labyrinth to find items and power up Shiki!
Beyond “Shiki-Wall,” discover many fun power-ups with unique uses!
You can also learn powerful techniques that require ‘Ki’ to use!
There are “Pebbles” too!

■Features
・Estimated 10-20 hours to first clear
・Over 20 types of power-up items
・Over 20 boss battles
・Complex dungeon with over 300 scenes
・Aim for 100% completion of “Map,” “Inventory,” and ‘Subjugation’
・Bonus features: “Hon-teddo” for advanced players and “Time Attack” to record your fastest run

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.

70010000104962.name: Michael's Dream Adventure
70010000104962.intro: An action game about a bear exploring a dream world!
70010000104962.description:
Michael's Dream Adventure is a 2D platformer.
Open doors and explore a variety of different worlds.
Transform into various animals - including a cheetah, mole, elephant, cat, rabbit, and dog!
Clear every stage to complete a grand picture!

70010000104974.name: Candy Rangers
70010000104974.intro: Candy Rangers: The on-rails shooter where color is your weapon!
70010000104974.description:
Race against time in this brand new on-rails shooter where you control 4 characters at once! Meet Candy, Mint, Lemon and Plum, quadruplets that live together and work as rangers to fight creatures that come in to ruin the natural environments of the city.
 
Features:

- More than 20 playable levels with its secret paths.
- Play with 4 rangers at once.
- Loads of different enemies and stages, each taking place in a different time of day!
- 4 bosses to fight, and a final fight across the entire map!
- Split your team to take on 2 paths at the same time!
- Take on hard mode. You'll receive twice the time penalty for each hit you take. Become untouchable!
- Inky Mode! Once you beat the game, you will unlock new modes to play. Inky can shoot in all directions. Everything goes!
- Beat the game to try the arcade mode. Can you beat every level without taking a break?

70010000104976.name: BAND GIRLS
70010000104976.intro:
Cute girls in rock bands appear in large numbers!
An easy puzzle game anyone can play!
70010000104976.description:
