Match the pieces of adorable band girls to complete the puzzle!
Clear the stages and unlock their images in the gallery!

70010000104983.name: Pursuit
70010000104983.intro: No brakes. No mercy. Just escape.
70010000104983.description:
Pursuit puts you behind the wheel in a fast-paced, driving adventure where escape is the goal. 
Every delivery is a race against time, the police, and the city itself — a city that never forgives mistakes. With no room for error, you must rely on skill, quick reflexes, and sharp instincts to stay ahead of those chasing you.
Each pursuit becomes more intense, pushing your driving to the limit. You’ll weave through tight corners, accelerate through narrow paths, and outmaneuver unpredictable obstacles that test your focus and timing. Every second counts as you're constantly challenged to make split-second decisions that determine whether you break free or get caught.
Whether it's threading through chaos or mastering high-speed turns, your ability to stay cool under pressure is the key.
Pursuit offers a relentless drive toward freedom—where every chase tells a story, and every escape is earned.

70010000104988.name: Five Hearts Under One Roof
70010000104988.intro: Living with Beautiful Women?! An FMV Romance Simulation game!
70010000104988.description:
[ Your Story Begins Here ]
"All my housemates are stunning women?"
Step into a world of romance and unforgettable moments!
Five Hearts Under One Roof is the top live-action FMV romance simulation game, offering you the power to choose your story, shape your relationships, and unlock the love of your dreams.
Ready for love, friendship, or a thrilling romance? Start your journey now and see where your choices lead you!

[ CHOOSE YOUR LOVE STORY ]
Meet five stunning housemates, each with a unique personality and story!
Decide Your Fate: Your choices change the story—will you find true love, a hidden secret, or a shocking twist?
Live the Fantasy: From sweet moments to intense drama, every interaction feels real with high-quality FMV scenes.

[ Meet Your Dream Housemates ]
The Loyal Friend – Go Mal-sook
"Are we really just friends?"
Your childhood friend who’s tired of being just that.

The Fallen Idol – Park Min-jung
"I want more than just fan service."
Your first love who dreams of a real romance.

The Boss – Gran
"So, you like this kind of thing, Yoo-man?"
Your demanding boss who loves to tease.

The Bold Junior – Go Eun-bi
"I came to marry you, oppa!"
Your straightforward junior who knows what she wants.

The Adorable Loner – Jo Seung-yi
"I’ve been saved."
A reclusive girl who sees you as her savior.

Surrounded by beautiful women, who will you choose?
Will you be loyal to one or let your heart run wild?
Prepare for unexpected twists, secret endings, and maybe even a BAD END if you’re not careful!

[ Key Features ]
Immersive FMV Experience
Real-life video sequences with professional actors.
Every conversation, glance, and touch feels intensely real.

100+ Story Paths & Multiple Endings
Your choices lead to different stories and fates.
Unlock special endings and hidden scenarios.

Text, Chat, and Romance
Deepen your bond through texts and heart-fluttering chats.
Uncover the girls’ secrets as you get closer.

High-Quality Acting & Cinematic Production
Feel like you’re in a real romance with movie-quality FMV scenes.
Famous creators bring each character to life with authentic performances.

Five Unique Love Interests
The childhood friend, the idol, the boss, the direct junior, and the shy recluse.
Each with a different personality and story—find your perfect match!

[ Perfect For Players Who ]
Crave a live-action FMV romance experience.
Dream of being surrounded by beautiful women.
Love romance sims with deep stories and real consequences.
Enjoy uncovering secrets through chat and texts.
Want a romance game with multiple love interests.
Can’t resist a thrilling mix of drama, suspense, and love!

[ A Message from the Developers ]
We believe that love stories should feel real and unforgettable.
Five Hearts Under One Roof combines live-action FMV with an interactive romance sim to bring you a love story that’s truly yours.

Choose your girl, craft your love story, and discover an ending that will stay with you forever.
Whether you want a sweet romance, a thrilling twist, or a bit of both, your story begins here.

70010000105003.name: PEAK The Adventure Begins
70010000105003.description:
This is a serene yet challenging adventure where you take on the role of a brave hero climbing a mysterious mountain. The journey is filled with trials steep cliffs, risky crossings, and unexpected enemies that must be defeated with skill, strategy, and strength.
Explore each level of the mountain, overcome platforming challenges, and engage in tactical battles with foes blocking your path. As you ascend, you'll uncover the secrets of the mountain and move closer to your ultimate goal the ancient Tree of Life waiting at the summit.

70010000105008.name: CHESS UP! CHECKMATE WITH FRIENDS
70010000105008.intro: Outsmart, outplay, and checkmate your way to victory!
70010000105008.description:
Get ready to challenge your mind and outsmart your opponent in CHESS UP! Checkmate with Friends, the ultimate board classic brought to life on Nintendo Switch™!

Play your way — whether you’re a beginner learning the ropes or a seasoned strategist aiming for checkmate perfection.

Game Modes:

Single Player: Test your skills against a smart AI opponent with adjustable difficulty — Easy, Medium, or Hard.

Multiplayer: Go head-to-head with a friend in a thrilling 1v1 match on a single console. Will you claim victory… or settle for a draw?

Choose your favorite board skin from three unique designs and make each match your own!

Sharpen your tactics, plan your moves, and prove your mastery — one checkmate at a time.

Think. Move. Win. CHESS UP!

70010000105019.name: REDEX
70010000105019.intro: Survive a relentless battlefield in side-scrolling retro arcade style!
70010000105019.description:
REDEX is a pixel-art survival shooter where you battle waves of enemies in fast-paced side-scrolling combat. Collect coins to buy ammo, grenades, armor, and more from vending machines, then trade rare gold for permanent upgrades and new characters.

Unlock new zones, from rooftops to labs, and use air-dropped crates to deploy turrets or mining terminals. Distract foes with dummies and adapt your tactics to survive. No rules, just fight to be the last one standing!

• Defend against enemy waves and unlock increasingly tough battles.
• Fire in any direction independent of your soldier’s movement.
• Navigate combat zones in side-scrolling platformer style.
• Permanently upgrade skills and collect new firearms.
• Use vending machines to acquire ammo boxes and grenade cases.
• Set up computer terminals to mine more coins.

70010000105024.name: My Tiny Island
70010000105024.description:
In My Tiny Island, you’re stranded on a mysterious patch of land with nothing but your wits and whatever you can scavenge. No long tutorials. No endless menus. Just you, your hands, and a whole lot of “figure it out.”

Chop wood, crack stone, craft tools, and build whatever you need to survive. Make shelter, fight off trouble, and maybe even make your little island feel like home.

Simple. Fast. Addictive.
Because who says survival has to be complicated?

70010000105029.name: Peaked Climbing
70010000105029.intro: Because the top won’t climb itself.
70010000105029.description:
Peaked Climbing drops you on a mysterious island with just one way out: climbing the massive mountain at its center. No guide, no shortcuts—just you, your wits, and a sheer cliff daring you to reach the top.

Scale four dangerous biomes, each packed with obstacles that’ll test your patience and skill. Miss a step, and you’ll pay for it with precious stamina or a painful fall. Hunt for anything that can help you survive—from suspicious snacks to strange gadgets—and patch yourself up when the mountain shows no mercy.

Keep climbing, plan carefully, and make the most of every quirky item you find. Each slip will cost you, but every determined step brings you closer to the peak.

Do you have what it takes to conquer the climb—or will the mountain send you tumbling like yesterday’s laundry? Grab your gear, and don’t look down!

70010000105039.name: Mechatris
70010000105039.intro: Punch, smash, and stack your way through a nonstop rain of falling blocks!
70010000105039.description:
Inspired by the most iconic puzzle game in video game history, you’ll take control of a powerful robot equipped with explosive punches and devastating bombs. Break apart, shift, and reposition the pieces to clear perfect lines and rack up points.

The real challenge? Keeping your base organised while an endless stream of blocks keeps crashing down from above!

70010000105044.name: Treasure Drop
70010000105044.intro: Don’t let your treasure leave the dome. Merge it together, and create the biggest fortune!
70010000105044.description:
Get ready for a treasure-filled adventure beneath the waves! Merge coins and gems to uncover riches beyond imagination!

Discover maps that change how you play, each with its own unique shape and background. Can you master them all and merge the biggest treasure?

CO-OP mode
Play together locally inside one dome and collect points as a team! Merge treasures, grab power-ups, and try to reach the highest score side by side.

VERSUS mode
Challenge a friend locally! The dome is split in half - one side for you, one side for your opponent. If one player overfills their dome and items spill out, the other has only a few seconds left to score as many points as possible before the game ends!

Catch amazing power-ups as they float to the surface and use them whenever you want:
- Bomb: Explodes and pushes everything away
- Pearl: Merges with any treasure
- Ruby Curse: Makes treasure even more valuable
- Eruption: Destroys all stones
- Specter: Lets your treasure pass through obstacles

Features:
• Online leaderboards to show off your score!
• Co-op mode to play and merge together!
• Versus mode to challenge your friends!
• 2 maps with unique shapes!
• 5 exciting power-ups that can change everything!
• Fully customizable name and character
• Wide range of character skins: from underwater to out of this world!
• A bright and dazzling underwater look!

Swim to the top and rule the leaderboard!

70010000105053.name: Gold Grove
70010000105053.description:
When a kind-hearted villager asks for help finding his missing belongings, your simple search soon turns into something much bigger—a journey to uncover the secrets of an ancient golden treasure hidden deep within the forest! Explore a charming woodland world and piece together a long-lost legend in this cozy adventure!

Features:
>A relaxing yet rewarding exploration adventure
>Light item collection
>A rich world with secrets hidden in every corner
>Unravel the legend of the ancient gold treasure

Can you find everything the villager lost—and the treasure he never did?

70010000105056.name: Snack and Quack
70010000105056.intro: Guide hungry ducklings through 30 levels full of challenges.
70010000105056.description:
Snack and Quack is a 2D pixel art puzzle game designed for casual players.
The goal is to guide all the ducklings to eat the scattered bread in each level. The game focuses on logical challenges and progressive difficulty across two distinct maps to keep players engaged.

Game mechanics
The player controls the mother duck, who can move on a grid-based system and push the ducklings through the environment. Once pushed, the ducklings slide in a straight line until they hit an object or a special tile.

Maps
The game features 30 levels divided across two different biomes: The Pond and The Swamp.

Pond: Introduces core mechanics and teaches the player how to change the ducklings' direction.

Swamp: Introduces path-stopping tiles and increasingly complex puzzles with a growing number of ducklings.

70010000105061.name: Only Go Up 2
70010000105061.intro:
Climb higher than ever before.
One wrong move and it’s all over.
Every jump counts.
70010000105061.description:
Get ready for the ultimate climb! In Only Go UP 2, your mission is simple but far from easy: keep moving upward, step by step, and see how high you can go. Precision, timing, and patience are your best friends as every jump takes you closer to the top — or back down to the very bottom.

Featuring challenging physics-based gameplay, unpredictable obstacles, and endless replayability, Only Go UP 2 will test your skill, focus, and determination. Can you master the climb and reach new heights, or will you fall and start again?

Features:
Addictive “one more try” gameplay
Unique obstacles and platforms to overcome
Physics-based controls that challenge your reflexes
Endless vertical levels — no two attempts are the same
Perfect for quick sessions or long climbing marathons
The higher you climb, the greater the challenge. Remember: there’s only one way forward… Only Go UP!

70010000105070.name: Dragon Snack
70010000105070.description:
Get ready for a puzzle filled with fire, coins, and clever decisions. In Dragon Snack, you don’t control the dragon… you prepare the path! Rotate and place hexagonal tiles to build a perfect trail that leads the creature to its golden nest.

But watch out: traps are scattered along the way, and only powerful fire gems can destroy them. Collect coins, plan your route carefully, and when everything is set, unleash the dragon to see if your strategy works.

With 30 handcrafted levels and two magical biomes full of surprises, Dragon Snack blends strategy, logic, and fantasy into one thrilling flight.

70010000105075.name: Homura: The Crimson Warriors
70010000105075.intro: Ignite the fire within the Crimson Warriors' hearts in their final showdown!
70010000105075.description:
About Homura: The Crimson Warriors
Fourteen years have passed since the Battle of Sekigahara split Japan in two.

Now firmly in control, the Tokugawa shogunate is scheming to eliminate the Toyotomi clan, a long-standing thorn in its side.

In response, the Toyotomi clan has decided to confront the Tokugawa head-on, using Osaka Castle as their stronghold. Calls for support were sent to daimyo throughout the nation and a mere few answered the call. One of these brave warriors was Nobushige Sanada, the second son of the Sanada family who was cast away to Mt. Kudo on house arrest after the Battle of Sekigahara.

Alongside Nobushige on his escape from Mt. Kudo are the Sanada Ten Braves, ten ninjas who serve him even after their exile. Standing in their way are the Ura Yagyu, a group comprised of assassins who have carried out many killings under orders from the shogunate, mysterious swordsmen, and mighty warriors.

This is the final chapter of the Warring States period. It is a tale of the bonds and way of life shared by the Nobushige Sanada and the Ten Braves who gather at Osaka Castle.

Key Features
Amongst the fire and ashes, love will prevail — Previously released in Japan on PS Vita in 2018, Western fans can experience the historical fantasy otome as the protagonist Mutsumi Mochizuki fights alongside the Crimson Warriors. Accompanied with multiple endings and CGs, this legendary battle of love tangled with iconic historical events and original characters in the Warring States period is sure to capture the hearts of history otome lovers!

Maintain peak performance with Energy Reading — Use Energy Reading to detect the affection level and Ring status of love interests. Mutsumi has the special ability to adjust the love interests' Rings. When sped up, it allows them to utilize unique powers at the cost of their physical health. Make sure to keep their Rings balanced! If their health deteriorates too much, the consequences could be dire…

Ninja Guidance — Use your ninja scrolls to keep track of where you are in the story and revisit moments of the past if you seek a different outcome of the path you've chosen. Adjust both your affection and ring levels with each warrior when you select previously viewed events to change the course of history!

Path of the Samurai — Throughout the story, you can level up your ninja rank to keep up with the Crimson Warriors during battle. Take your ninja skills to the next level and make it your mission to reach Master rank and ensure victory against the Ura Yagyu!

70010000105076.name: Homura: The Crimson Warriors Digital Short Stories
70010000105076.intro: Ignite the fire within the Crimson Warriors' hearts in their
70010000105076.description: The Digital Short Stories include five stories—one for each love interest. In 20 pages, find out what happens outside of the battlefield and how fiery things can get!

70010000105077.name: Homura: The Crimson Warriors Digital Soundtrack
70010000105077.intro: Ignite the fire within the Crimson Warriors' hearts in their final showdown!
70010000105077.description:
Sometimes, you need a break from the battlefield (and romance). Grab the Digital Soundtrack to help soothe your soul and tug at your heartstrings!

Tracklist (26 Tracks):
Composition: Yuki Sugiura (STUDIO EDEN INC.)

1. Turmoil
2. Daylight
3. Sunlight Dancing Through Trees
4. Secret Meeting
5. Twilight
6. Flirtation
7. Heartstrings
8. Longing
9. Feast
10. Loneliness
11. Sorrow
12. Darkness
13. Alarm
14. Battle
15. Heartbeat
16. Rising Courage
17. Defensive Stance
18. Despair
19. Awakening
20. A Dream Within a Dream
21. Eternity
22. Intertwined Fates
23. Parting
24. Soul
25. Full Moon
26. True Love

70010000105079.name: Pororo Sports Day
70010000105079.intro:
The Grand Canyon! The Pyramids! Hawaii!
A wacky sports day in amazing places around the world with Pororo!
70010000105079.description:
A surprise sports day at world-famous landmarks?!
Pororo and his friends are getting into wonderfully silly fun!

It’s fun on your own!
It’s even more fun with friends!

Wacky! Funny! You just can’t stop!
Everyone can join the fun at Pororo Sports Day!

70010000105084.name: Brain Training! Perfect Memory
70010000105084.intro:
Just saw it a second ago—why can’t you remember!? 
How far will your memory take you?
70010000105084.description:
A game that trains your memory and observation skills!

How to play is simple：
・Memorize every detail of the photo within a 1-minute time limit
・Choose the correct answer from 4 options for the part hidden by “?”

You can enjoy it solo at your own pace,
have fun with family and friends,
or even use it for streaming content!

If you manage to answer all the questions correctly,
you’ll earn the title of Memory Master!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.

70010000105089.name: Brain Training! Art Puzzle
70010000105089.intro: Spin to an aha moment! A brain-training puzzle where you complete a masterpiece by intuition
70010000105089.description:
A fresh brain-training puzzle inspired by famous paintings!
Rotate the scattered pieces until they face the right direction and restore the masterpiece in this intuitive puzzle game.

How to play is simple:

Pieces of the artwork appear, divided into tiles

Tap to rotate each piece until it matches the correct orientation

When all pieces align, the beautiful painting is complete!

“That last piece won’t fit!”
“The moment everything clicks into place feels amazing!”

You’ll find yourself hooked on the challenge of intuition and focus.
Play casually in your free time while sharpening your observation and creativity.

Whether you love art or puzzles, you’ll enjoy this unique “Art × Brain Training” experience.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.

70010000105094.name: BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Deluxe Contents
70010000105094.description:
*This product is available for purchase as part of the bundle for “BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Deluxe Edition”.

The "BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Deluxe Contents" includes a digital concept artbook and soundtrack from the main game.

70010000105103.name: The Rumble Fish 2 - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000105103.intro:
The Fight for Survival
The legendary fighting game has returned sporting new features!
70010000105103.description:
A legendary arcade game developed by Dimps in 2005. This fighting game gained popularity for its smooth visuals powered by S.M.A as well as the high level of strategy driven by its 2-gauges system. And with the addition of new current-gen features it's even easier to play.

- Battle Mechanics Polished to a Shine by a Legendary Studio Known for Fighters:
The first original fighting game from Dimps, known for being involved in a number of other fighting games. It has continued to attract fighting game fans since its release in 2005 with mechanics that use 2 gauges--one for offense and one for defense--and slick 2D visuals powered by S.M.A. (Smooth Model Animation).

- New Features for Console Provide a Modern Gameplay Experience:
The console version contains new features such as an Online Versus Mode--a first for the series. It uses Rollback Netcode, which corrects lag between players, making for a streamlined experience online. And with 16:9 wide-screen support, AI and a training mode, you can fully enjoy this game in the comfort of your own home.

- Main Game Modes:
・Arcade
・Survival
・Time Attack
・Local Multiplay
・Online Multiplay with rollback netcode
・Training
・Gallery
Added features: Spectator mode, rematch, match recording, combat range and match time settings, assist mode, new character colors, button assignment for Boost Dive, and an updated training mode including character-specific gauge and enemy attack/dodge/ground recovery settings, as well as adjustments to enemy auto recovery timing.

- The Story:
It is the end of the 20th century... A large-scale natural disaster struck the eastern area of a nation. It wiped out the financial sector and resulted in a staggering loss of life.

At the dawn of the 21st century, the conglomerate PROBE-NEXUS, commonly known as Probe, began reconstruction efforts in that eastern area. Colossal capital and cutting-edge technology was poured into rebuilding it. Skyscrapers that put the old high-rises to shame along with the world's biggest shopping mall and recreational facilities. This was the dazzling birth of a symbol for the new century. It was christened Zone Prime.

And now, in an undeveloped sector of its western block, there was an area known as the slums...

70010000105107.name: Chrono Ark Deluxe Edition
70010000105107.intro: Chrono Ark, the deck-building roguelike RPG. Recruit companions with distinct personalities, build a party that maximizes skill synergies, and save the Twisted World!
70010000105107.description:
Long ago, when the world was engulfed in black mist, the surviving humans escaped to the Ark.

There's only one way to restore the world:
seek out the hidden Time Shades and activate the Clock Tower.
The Clock Tower will surely restore the world to a time of peace.

Awakening in the Twisted Land beneath the Ark,
Lucy finds she has no memories other than the words "Activate the Clock Tower"...

She joins forces with her companions and sets out in search of the Time Shades.

Blending RPG and card game elements

Recruit up to 4 companions and build the strongest party based on their skills and abilities. The skills of Lucy, the protagonist, and her companions are available as cards. Your choices determine what skills they learn!

Defeat is nothing to fear

Unlike traditional RPGs, everything resets when your party gets defeated, and new companions and skills become available. Perfect your strategy with each iteration.

70010000105126.name: Model Debut4
70010000105126.intro:
Trendy items for full styling and production fun!
Step into the world of modeling, try out different jobs, and chase your dreams — and maybe even love.
70010000105126.description:
After passing a model audition, you join your uncle’s production agency. But the office is a total mess and the finances are in crisis! Determined to turn things around, you take on a variety of jobs — magazine shoots, TV appearances, brand modeling — and even produce two models from the agency to help boost its success.
Your ultimate goal? The once-a-year special runway show. It’s every model’s dream — aim to be No.1.
Fashion, work, and exciting encounters await you.

◆ Style your perfect look with trendy pieces and custom hair and makeup.
From princess vibes to Harajuku flair, enjoy a wide range of outfits. Tuck in your top or leave it out — express your style your way.
Fine-tune every detail with sliders: outfit and hair color, facial feature size and placement, makeup intensity, and more. Explore subtle fashion tones and looks that reflect your true self.

◆ Rise to the top with TV gigs and brand modeling.
In magazine work, take on themed styling, photo shoots, and article layouts. Get feedback from the editor-in-chief, grow your follower count, and build your popularity as a model.
As your rank rises, unlock special jobs like drama appearances and variety shows in immersive 3D settings.

◆ Produce your agency’s models and level up your production.
Coordinate and produce fellow models to raise your agency’s profile.
As everyone grows, your production level rises too. Aim to become the No.1 agency.

◆ Who will steal your heart? Style him your way and go on dates together.
Work side by side with your crush, go out together, and when you get close, capture photos or videos to share on social media.
Those exciting moments may even enhance your expressiveness as a model — and yes, you can style the boys too.

◆ Enjoy online features with friends.
Connect online to share your model. Show off your favorite looks, take two-shot photos with friends’ models, and check real-time rankings of popular items by brand.
Keep up with the latest trends and use them to inspire your own style.

70010000105131.name: Winterlight - Where silence says it all
70010000105131.intro: Explore a heartfelt and thought-provoking tale of bittersweet homecoming!
70010000105131.description:
As Elias returns to the coastal town that once sheltered him, he’s pulled into a slow winter of connection, memory and quiet decisions. Take the role of this young man and guide the choices he makes, surrounded by the warmth of townspeople young and old, often holding conversations in a bookstore over shared coffee.

Winterlight is a contemplative visual novel adventure about coming home, facing grief and learning to accept the ordinary over means of personal escape. Enjoy an adventure in a branching narrative with meaningful choices, one filled with emotional maturity and beautiful illustrations. Take things at your own pace as you explore all possible outcomes for Elias.

• Immerse yourself in an adventure spanning 32,000 words!
• Engage in emotionally mature themes and real-world issues.
• Guide the narrative by making key decisions for Elias!
• Enjoy beautifully illustrated character portraits and backdrops.
• Discover multiple endings as you seek truth and lasting peace!

70010000105141.name: Torii
70010000105141.intro: A poetic puzzle-adventure exploring loss, memories and self-discovery.
70010000105141.description:
Traverse through the surreal world suspended somewhere between dream and emotion on a touching journey through grief, guilt, and healing, as you search for your lost sister, Lulu.

Solve puzzles, recover lost memories, face your deepest fears and regrets...

And don't be afraid to take the leap forward.

Features:
- Spatial puzzles with stealth mechanics
- A poetic, introspective story with a thought-provoking narrative
- A soft, yet abstract artstyle
- A beautiful original soundtrack

70010000105146.name: Firefighters Simulator 2026
70010000105146.intro: Every fire is a new challenge, every second a life saved.
70010000105146.description:
Step into the boots of a frontline hero with Firefighters Simulator 2026, the ultimate firefighting experience. Take command of realistic emergency operations, where every second counts, and every decision can save lives. In this simulator, you are not just putting out fires—you are protecting communities under extreme conditions.

Key Features:
• Authentic Firefighting Mechanics – Operate hoses, axes, and vehicles with realistic controls and physics.
• Character and Gear Upgrades – Customize your firefighter and enhance suits, tools, and fire trucks.
• Diverse Missions – Tackle incidents from house fires and vehicle accidents to forest fires.
• Resource Management – Keep track of oxygen, water, and equipment to survive dangerous situations.
• Immersive Environments – Navigate detailed urban, rural, and natural locations with realistic challenges.

Firefighters Simulator 2026 offers deep immersion, realistic firefighting mechanics, and varied missions that test precision, timing, and tactical planning. Explore richly detailed locations and experience the adrenaline and responsibility of real-life firefighting.

70010000105156.name: Keep The Heroes Out
70010000105156.intro: An asymmetric, cooperative dungeon defense game where you play as monsters protecting their hard-earned treasures against invading “heroes” trying to steal it.
70010000105156.description:
Monsters may die, which is tragic, but you can always bring them back to the dungeon! So you are never eliminated from the game, however, treasure gone, is gone forever.

Each player chooses one of the monsters to play. All monsters have their own special abilities, a different amount of creatures and their unique starting deck of cards. The game supports local and online co-op!

In your turn, use your cards one at a time to perform actions. The order of the icons on a card is not mandatory, and you may split actions between multiple monsters you have in play. At the end of your turn, refill your hand back to five cards.

As the game progresses, you will be able to craft loot cards and improve your deck.

Players take turns controlling their monsters on the dungeon. Each monster has a different role to play, some are crowd-control, others can be defensive or supporters, figuring out these combinations and solving an evolving puzzle together can be a lot of fun.

After a player finishes their turn, heroes will invade our dungeon and attack us! Monsters may die, which is tragic, but you can always bring them back to the dungeon! So you are never eliminated from the game, however, a treasure stolen, is gone forever.

If at any point of the game we lose our vault's hoard, the game ends in defeat, but if we manage to protect our treasures for long enough, we all win.

Each of the levels has a different dungeon layout along with special rules & cards to spice things up! From introductory scenarios where Olga the witch needs frogs to make potions, to more wild ones like the battle of the bands.

70010000105159.name: Arashi Gaiden
70010000105159.intro: Arashi Gaiden is a turn-based action game with fast dash-and-slash combat. Use blades, shurikens, teleports, and chains to defeat enemies and powerful bosses with unique mechanics.
70010000105159.description:
KILL ALL ENEMIES

Arashi Gaiden is a turn-based action game with fast-paced dash and slash combat. Use the dash mechanic to quickly traverse levels and slice your enemies in half in style, combining your blade with shurikens, teleports and chains that paralyze your opponents.

BREAK THE TURN STRUCTURE

Overcome levels with mechanics that change how you play and face Bosses that redefine what a turn-based game is by using special abilities in real time.

Stop the time of your enemies, play shurikens, teleport and change the direction of your dash!
Use special skills to master the field of combat, make combos and win creatively.

Survive 7 bosses that also break the turn structure, using bombs, traps, flying cuts, flames and more! Play carefully or frantically, the choice is yours.

- Over 5 hours of fun in turn-based combat, with diverse challenges and multiple solutions.
- A new level for an innovative combat system, Dash and Slash: enjoy turn-based combat with fast moves.
- Experience a stylish turn-based action game with puzzle features (or vice versa).

WIN WITH STYLE

- Get Power-Ups as you progress through the game, but manage them well during the match.
- Achieve the perfect score in each room.
- Replay each Stage with new powers after unlocking it.
- Enjoy guts and blood flying everywhere in pixel art while cutting your enemies in beautiful stages featuring settings from different locations in Japan.
- Discover Arashi's story, his involvement with Lobo and deepen the Lore of the Bravery Universe.

70010000105164.name: ESCAPE THE BACKROOMS
70010000105164.intro: Explore dark corridors and uncover the mysteries within.
70010000105164.description:
Step into the eerie, endless maze of ESCAPE THE BACKROOMS, where reality bends and every corner hides a new threat. Navigate through dimly lit corridors, solve cryptic puzzles, and avoid sinister entities that lurk in the shadows. Each level challenges your wits, nerves, and survival instincts as you attempt to find the exit before it’s too late.
Features:
•	Terrifying Exploration: Immerse yourself in endless, randomly generated backrooms filled with unsettling details.
•	Clever Puzzles: Solve challenging puzzles to unlock doors, passageways, and secrets.
•	Hide and Survive: Evade hostile entities that stalk your every move.
•	Atmospheric Horror: Experience tense sound design, flickering lights, and a creeping sense of dread.
Can you escape the backrooms, or will you become another lost soul wandering the endless maze?

70010000105170.name: Shadow Rift: Feral Strike
70010000105170.intro: From infiltration to urban defense! Eliminate the terrorist organization! Extreme FPS action with overwhelming combat! Face endless threats with diverse weapons!
70010000105170.description:
A first-person shooter where you fight against the threat of coordinated global terrorism as a member of Operation Shadow Lift, a multinational counterterrorism special forces unit. Track operatives hiding in blue container trucks at a quiet port facility at dawn, intercept mobile rockets launched from secret desert bases, and engage in urban warfare alongside heavy armored tanks in cities under states of emergency. Utilize highly strategic combat systems to stop the terrorist organization Feral's "Operation Wild Feral" and experience unprecedented, intense battlefield action.

・An authentic FPS action shooter unfolding from a thrilling first-person perspective.
・Challenge missions across diverse locations worldwide, including ports, desert bases, and urban areas.
・Experience varied combat situations with different time periods and environments, from nighttime infiltration operations to daytime urban suppression.
・Defense Mode unlocks after clearing Story Mode, allowing you to intercept endless waves of enemies.
・Rich weapon systems and tactical approaches can be utilized depending on the situation.
・Enjoy combat using various weapons including assault rifles, sniper rifles, shotguns, submachine guns, and rocket launchers.
・Experience thrilling story development as you thwart the international conspiracy of the terrorist organization Feral.
・In Defense Mode, engage in extreme survival battles, repelling increasingly powerful enemies each wave while holding your defensive line.
・In each mission, choose tactics from stealth to frontal assault based on your judgment.
・Smooth controls designed for enjoyment by both FPS beginners and veterans.
・Immersive combat scenes rendered with beautiful 3D graphics.

As an elite member of the counterterrorism special forces, face global crises, complete all missions, and restore peace. Even after clearing Story Mode, Defense Mode offers infinite combat challenges with abundant replayability as you aim for the highest score. Experience your tactics and shooting skills tested to witness the final ending!

Prologue
A quiet port facility at dawn.
As blue container trucks are unloaded one by one, operatives from the terrorist organization Feral have secretly infiltrated the area.
Hours later, mobile rockets are launched from a Middle Eastern desert base toward major cities around the world.
This marks the beginning of "Operation Wild Feral."
A state of emergency is declared and military forces from various nations deploy to urban areas.
Heavy armored tanks and elite units are positioned throughout city districts, preparing for combat against the terrorists.
You are deployed to this chaotic battlefield as a member of the multinational counterterrorism special forces unit, Operation Shadow Lift.
Fight against the savage terrorist organization Feral and restore world peace.

70010000105204.name: Leap Year
70010000105204.intro: A clumsy platformer about knowledge and discovery
70010000105204.description:
Explore a compact, hand drawn world filled with hidden paths. Understand the game’s secrets to reach new areas and collect all the pages of your calendar. 

 • About 2 hours of playtime
 • 40+ rooms
 • 6 audio tracks
 • Dancing friends

70010000105215.name: Take Me To The Dungeon!!
70010000105215.intro: Build your deck and take Una on an epic dungeon adventure!
70010000105215.description:
Explore the depths of this massive dungeon with your adorable companion Una in this exciting  ROGUE-like deck-building adventure!
Game feature:
• Dynamic Dungeon Layout
Fight through randomly-generated monster-filled dungeons and encounter merchants, treasures and story events. You can only see three levels down, so choose wisely as you push deeper into the dungeon.

• Titillating Card Battles
Build the most powerful deck out of over 50 different cards and 20 different runes and use it to overwhelm your enemies! 

• Random Treasure
Obtain random treasures to upgrade Una's abilities. Put together the strongest combination and synergize it with your deck to deal ungodly amounts of damage!

• An Exciting Story with Multiple Endings
Make choices and experience different endings in this exciting adventure story! Unlock different side stories to trigger various card enchantments. Some enchantments might come in handy, while others might hurt you!

70010000105220.name: BUS SIM 25 - CITY SIMULATOR
70010000105220.intro: Drive the city. Master the route. Rule the road.
70010000105220.description:
Get ready to hit the streets and build your own bus empire! Experience the thrill of realistic driving, the challenge of managing a transport company, and the satisfaction of keeping a city moving. Whether you're navigating traffic or optimizing routes, every decision counts in this immersive simulator.

Key Features:
	•	Vast Open World – Explore a huge city with distinct zones: bustling downtowns, quiet suburbs, and industrial districts.
	•	Authentic Bus Driving – Stick to schedules, sell and check tickets, and handle quirky passenger interactions.
	•	Fleet Management – Operate diesel, electric, and double-decker buses. Fuel, maintain, and upgrade them as you grow.
	•	Company Building – Create custom routes, hire staff, manage income and expenses, and expand your business.
	•	Game Modes – Dive into Career Mode to grow from a rookie driver to a transport tycoon, or relax in Endless Mode and drive freely through the city.

Follow the rules, respect the schedule, and master the road—your passengers are counting on you. Are you ready to become the king of city transit?

70010000105226.name: Arcade Archives BOMB BEE
70010000105226.intro: The second in the BEE series! New charm for the block-breaker genre!
70010000105226.description:
"BOMB BEE" is a brick breaker released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1979.
The biggest feature of this sequel to GEE BEE, as its title suggests, is the bomb!
Find the hidden bombs in the playfield, set off explosions, and aim for a high score! Like its predecessor, this title also supports mouse control. Let's BOMB BEE with simple controls!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000105245.name: STARBITES
70010000105245.intro: Break the barriers and blaze through Bitter!
70010000105245.description:
Bitter—a desert planet riddled with the refuse left behind by an interstellar war. 45 years ago, the war suddenly ended when all of the spaceships crashed onto Bitter for reasons unknown. Now, a young salvager named Lukida hopes to escape this planet, but a sudden attack by a giant robot sets events into motion that will change her life—and the face of Bitter—forever.

Join Lukida and her allies as they uncover the truth beneath the sands of Bitter!

70010000105248.name: LEGO® Voyagers Friend’s Pass
70010000105248.intro: Invite a friend to join your LEGO® Voyager’s adventure!
70010000105248.description:
With the LEGO Voyagers Friend’s Pass, one player who owns the game can invite a friend to join their journey, no extra purchase needed*. 

HOW IT WORKS

One player owns LEGO Voyagers
The other player downloads the free Friend’s Pass Edition
Game owner sends an invite to play online
The other player accepts the invite
Play the full game together in co-op!

From the makers of LEGO Builder’s Journey comes a new 2-player co-op experience about friendship and play. When two friends set out to rescue a mysterious spaceship, they begin a heartfelt journey through beautifully crafted brick-built worlds.

Tumble, jump, snap together, and build your way through poetic puzzles and atmospheric environments. LEGO Voyagers is a non-verbal narrative about friendship, growing together, and the joy of creative play… an experience that’s always better when shared with a friend.

* Friend’s Pass requires one player to own the full version of LEGO Voyagers, installation of the Friend’s Pass game edition, persistent internet connection and applicable platform account. One player must own the full version of LEGO Voyagers in order for the co-op player to play the full game.

70010000105249.name: Love, Ghostie
70010000105249.intro: Become a wholesome ghost matchmaker and grow relationships between the manor’s residents!
70010000105249.description:
Gift items to lift their spirits, set them up on dates, and watch love bloom! Discover cute romances with a unique story between every pair of residents! How will love blossom in your manor?

Features
♥ Create any romance you want - every resident is shippable with every other resident!

♥ Learn about each resident’s unique personality - read through their diary and give them gifts to discover what they love most!

♥ Resurrect some joy in a stranger’s life - set residents up on (not-so) secret dates, help decorate their rooms, and send them on tasks to lift their spirits!

♥ Help someone find their BOO - as residents get closer to each other, you’ll unlock adorable relationship scenes. Every pair of residents has their own unique story!

♥ Play with people's hearts - unlockable minigames deepen resident relationships and boost resident happiness!

♥ Large combination of couples - with a total of 12 residents, discover 66 combinations of couples with unique storylines!

♥ Take your matchmaking to the next level - unlock minigames, manor upgrades, ghostie hats, and more!

♥ New Game+ - not done matchmaking? The memories board retains the dates and relationship talks you’ve unlocked from previous runs. Other New Game+ features help you progress relationships faster!

70010000105251.name: Udon! Road to Mastery
70010000105251.intro:
Firm noodles! Dashi! Tempura!
Fill udon orders as quickly as possible and follow the road to mastery!
70010000105251.description:
Let's make authentic udon on the Nintendo Switch™!
Whip up bowls of udon noodles both hot and cold as quickly and accurately as you can!
Share Joy-Con™ for exciting battles with up to 4 players!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Make and serve as many bowls of udon as you can before time runs out!
Boil the noodles, pour the broth, then add the right toppings!
Don't forget to watch the portion sizes, and fill each order correctly!

《How to Play》
1. Check the order - Memorize the udon type and amount of noodles!

2. Boil the noodles - Be careful not to mess up the amount!

3. Rinse the boiled noodles - Blanch them when making hot udon!

4. Add the toppings - Tempura, green onions, fried tofu, and more—just follow the order!

5. Serve it up - Get the order correct for the most points!

[Score Attack]
Compete with players from all over the world for the top spot on the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Compete with others and test your udon-making skills!

70010000105270.name: The Quarantine Sector
70010000105270.intro: The quarantine zone is humanity's last hope. You hold the key. Examine every survivor, search for the truth, and never let the infection in. The fate of the living is in your hands.
70010000105270.description:
The Quarantine Sector is humanity's last hope. You are its keeper.

In the grim aftermath of the initial outbreak, a lone fortified camp offers a chance of survival. As the newly appointed checkpoint officer, your duty is critical and brutal: meticulously screen every desperate soul seeking sanctuary for the slightest hint of the zombie virus.

Armed with a scanner, a thermometer and a limited medical kit, you must conduct tense, invasive examinations. Check pupils for the dreaded bloodshot haze. Feel for unnatural body heat and listen for a ragged, sickly cough. Cross-reference their story with their physical condition.

-Tense Physiological Examinations: Use authentic tools to check for a wide range of evolving symptoms. 
-Weight of the World: Your choices have dire, permanent consequences. A wrong call doesn't just mean a death outside the walls—it could mean an outbreak within them.

The safety of the camp rests on your focus, your judgment, and your resolve. Can you spot the infection before it spots you?

70010000105275.name: Hidden Cats in Rio de Janeiro
70010000105275.intro: The Hidden Cats continue their world trip in RIO! Let’s search for them again!
70010000105275.description:
The Hidden Cats are back - this time basking in the sunlight in Rio de Janeiro!

What begins with a monochrome scene is going to burst with vibrant colours as you uncover more than 900 hidden objects – playful cats, lively streets, sandy beaches, and famous landmarks!

A cozy adventure that captures the exuberant spirit of a Brazilian holiday… are you in?

Features:
- 900+ hidden objects, 8 unique levels with unlockables
- Collectible cards, achievements, secrets to discover
- Hand-drawn art & original soundtrack with dynamic sound effects

70010000105290.name: Happy umbrella／幸福なアンブレラ
70010000105290.intro:
A story inspired by Kasajizo and The Happy Prince.
The swallow's kindness in offering a brand-new umbrella moves the prince...
70010000105290.description:
We have created a script that combines Kasajizo and The Happy Prince.

This is a perfect storybook not only for children’s bedtime storytelling, but also as a fairy tale for adults.

70010000105295.name: Tiny Lands 2
70010000105295.intro: Take your perception into a new dimension with the relaxing sense of photorealistic miniature scenes in Tiny Lands 2.
70010000105295.description:
Continue the adventure of Tiny Lands finding the differences, this time with a lot of new things!

Tiny Lands 2 brings finding the differences to the next level! Dioramas mix photorealistic daily objects in 3D, explore from any angle stunning visual scenes with a real sense of handcrafting, and enjoy beautiful experiences with a refreshing visual aesthetic to relax and chill.

New ways of looking at things!
Now you can explore the dioramas at more angles with more freedom with an orbital camera and multi-directional panning. 

Collectibles
Find hidden jigsaw pieces across the scenes, collect them all and discover what will happen!

Photo-Mode
Enjoy and get creative with the new photo mode; use borders, stickers, and other camera effects to share your creations, funny situations, and inspiring masterpieces with your friends.

Play together locally!
Up to two players can enjoy Tiny Lands now!

Take it easy and relax at your own tempo
There is no time limit; set your favorite chill music and play at your own pace. Tiny Lands 2 still applies our “no punishment” policy, so grab a cup of coffee and chill out!

Hint system
In case you get stuck on a difference, we included a hint aid system that will mark a radial zone where the difference might be.

Accessibility
We have included 3 types of colorblindness support:
 •Deuteranopia
 •Tritanopia
 •Protanopia

We hope this can ease the game experience for people who deal with this type of colorblindness and enjoy the game like everyone! 

♡ Have fun in Tiny Lands 2! ♡

70010000105302.name: Caput Mortum
70010000105302.description:
Caput Mortum is a short first-person horror experience inspired by retro 3D dungeon crawlers and survival horror games. Delve into a tower of forgotten nightmares, where every step could be your last. Overcome horrors from beyond death and unlock the secrets of forbidden knowledge.

Close the lights, put on headphones, and immerse yourself in the game's macabre world. Behind every door lurks a new terror, and in every corner a key to some eldritch secret. Pay close attention to your surroundings, overcome unique puzzles, and piece together the events that took place within the tower. How deep are you willing to go, and what terrible truths will you uncover?

You must stay vigilant, as varied monsters roam the abandoned halls of the tower and won't hesitate to attack. Stealth past them, fight back, or perhaps... something else? Just be mindful of your health. There are only so many healing items in the game. This is old school, remember?

70010000105307.name: Look Mum No Computer
70010000105307.intro: Fix the chaos, drop the beat – electrifying action meets DIY music mayhem!
70010000105307.description:
Brace yourself for a wild ride where music meets mayhem! Look Mum No Computer takes you to the quirky, pixel-art universe of Soldersworth, as you join Sam and his Synthesizer sidekick, Kosmo, in this twin-stick shooter action-RPG to battle rogue household items and fix them from the inside — one electrifying beat at a time!
 
Key Features
Interactive Music Creation: Craft and upgrade unique modules that not only serve as powerful weapons but also form the instruments of the game’s evolving soundtrack.  Customize your playstyle and compose your own electronic music as you battle rogue machines
DIY Crafting System: Collect items and craft new modules inspired by creator Look Mum No Computer’s iconic designs, including the flamethrower module — a fiery nod to their infamous flamethrower organ.
 Quirky Worlds to Explore: Warp into the strange and vibrant pixel-art landscapes inside machines, teeming with bizarre creatures, challenging quests, and epic boss fights.
Dynamic Combat:  Take on swarms of enemies using twin-stick controls, balancing your energy to fuel both your arsenal and your electrifying music.
For Music Lovers and Gamers Alike: Whether you're a fan of retro games, electronic music, or Look Mum No Computer's inventive DIY spirit, this game offers something you’ll love.
 
The Adventure Awaits
Travel through the world of Soldersworth’s rogue devices, meet unforgettable characters, and unravel the musical chaos inside. Will you repair the machines, conquer the bosses, and restore harmony—or lose the beat forever?

70010000105312.name: Fight For America
70010000105312.intro: Gear up, soldier - it’s time to reclaim freedom!
70010000105312.description:
America has fallen into enemy hands. It’s up to you to fight back! Build your defenses, rally your firepower, and lead the charge to take the nation back - state by state, battle by battle.

Strategically deploy turrets, unleash devastating machine guns, and adapt your tactics to survive relentless enemy waves and towering bosses. Every victory pushes the front lines forward and brings you one step closer to restoring freedom across the land.

Earn cash from every fallen foe, upgrade your weapons, and unlock powerful new gear to hold the line. Each liberated state strengthens your army and opens up new challenges, enemies, and rewards. With every push and every win, you’re shaping the future of a free America!

Features:
- Tower defense-inspired gameplay with intense tactical action
- Tons of weapons, turrets, and upgrades to build your unstoppable defense
- Ruthless enemies and bosses to test your strategy and reflexes
- Dozens of states and countries to liberate, each with unique challenges and rewards
- Strategic progression system. Earn resources, upgrade gear, and conquer!

Take back the land. Rebuild the nation. Fight For America!

70010000105314.name: Snapshot Girls
70010000105314.intro: Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and marvel at every detail of stunning photorealistic masterpieces!
70010000105314.description:
Welcome to Snapshot Girls, a sophisticated and relaxing puzzle game where each completed puzzle reveals a photorealistic image of charming heroines in sophisticated and stylish looks.

Immerse yourself in an atmosphere where each image looks like a real photograph, with soft skin tones, natural light, and tiny details that are impossible to miss. Realistic puzzle mechanics allow you to feel every detail, and each scene is filled with emotion, character, and history.

Game Features:

- Photorealistic high-resolution images created with maximum attention to detail

- Smooth and intuitive puzzle mechanics

- Atmospheric soundtrack that enhances immersion

- Gallery mode to revisit your favorite scenes

70010000105319.name: Find the Difference: Spot it
70010000105319.intro:
Sharpen your eyes.
Spot every difference.
Prove your skills!
70010000105319.description:
Test your observation skills in this fun and relaxing puzzle game! Carefully compare two seemingly identical pictures and spot the differences before time runs out. With a variety of levels and colorful images, every round brings a new challenge.

Play at your own pace in casual mode or push yourself in timed challenges for extra excitement. Perfect for quick play sessions or longer puzzle marathons, this game is easy to pick up but hard to put down.

Features:
Hundreds of levels with vibrant, detailed images
Increasing difficulty to keep you engaged
Relaxing casual mode and challenging timed mode
Can you spot them all? Put your eyes to the test and find out!

70010000105324.name: Hydraulic Press
70010000105324.description:
Smash, collect, upgrade!
Crush objects with your Hydraulic Press, earn coins, and unlock faster presses, bigger rewards, and brand-new objects to destroy!
Each with unique visuals and satisfying effects.

Hydraulic Press is a simple destruction game where every object is made to be crushed!
Use your press to smash different items and collect coins with each destruction.

Spend your coins to unlock exciting upgrades:
- Increase the press speed and power to crush faster
- Gain a coin bonus for extra earnings
- Unlock new objects to keep the fun going

Simple, addictive, and endlessly satisfying!

70010000105329.name: It’s Quiz Time: GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS™ Edition
70010000105329.intro: GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS® meets It’s Quiz Time! Battle your friends in the ultimate party game and test your knowledge using your phone as a controller.
70010000105329.description:
Gather your friends and family for the ultimate test of trivia, based on the planet's most astonishing, amazing, and unbelievable facts! From the team behind the hit party game It's Quiz Time, this edition is made in official collaboration with Guinness World Records. Get ready to buzz in, show off your knowledge, and maybe even discovered a record you can beat!

BATTLE FRIENDS AND FAMILY IN THE ULTIMATE TRIVIA SHOWDOWN
Face off with up to 8 players in a massive, accessible quiz for all ages. With our seamless web-based controller system, anyone with a smartphone, tablet, or laptop can join the fun in seconds! Compete with players in the same room, challenge friends online, or broadcast your game on Twitch and play against your entire community in the fan-favourite Twitch Mode.

CONQUER THOUSANDS OF OFFICIAL GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS™ QUESTIONS
Go beyond the book with thousands of fully vetted, official GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS questions. See these incredible feats come to life with stunning high-quality photos and video footage direct from the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS archives. From the longest tongue to the heaviest pumpkin, you won't just read about the records: you'll actually see them.

CRAFT YOUR PERFECT QUIZ NIGHT
No two games are ever the same! Take control of the action with 10 unique, high-energy round types, from the classic multiple-choice format to fast-paced sorting challenges and nail-biting elimination rounds. Want to play only your favourite modes? Build a custom playlist for a personalised quiz experience that's perfect for your party.

OUTSMART SALLI, YOUR PERSONAL QUIZ HOST
Salli is back! Our witty and delightfully devious quiz host will guide your game, but don't be fooled: she's a formidable opponent. Salli learns about you and your group, remembering your names and tracking your performance to deliver a personalised experience that will challenge you, encourage you, and keep you on your toes through every question.

70010000105331.name: Dispatch
70010000105331.description:
Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy set in modern day Los Angeles from the writers and directors of Tales from the Borderlands and The Wolf Among Us, and features an all-star cast including Aaron Paul, Laura Bailey, and Jeffrey Wright.

Note: Some mature content from Dispatch's original version has been modified. 

You play as Robert Robertson, AKA Mecha Man, whose mech-suit is destroyed in a battle against his nemesis, forcing him to take a job at a superhero dispatch center: not as a hero, but a dispatcher.

As their dispatcher, you take charge of a team of ex-supervillains given a shot at redemption. Manage and level up your roster, all while navigating office relationships and romances, and rebuilding your suit for a shot at revenge!

> Shape the Story

In Dispatch, every decision you make influences the unfolding narrative. From banter in the breakroom to life-or-death situations in the field, your choices affect your relationships with the heroes, their allegiances, and the path your own story takes.

>  Deploy Your Heroes 

Use the strategy map to review ongoing emergencies and deploy the right (or wrong) heroes to deal with them. Balance the risks and rewards as you make tactical decisions, knowing that each choice can have lasting consequences for your team and the city.

> Manage Your Roster

Managing heroes sometimes goes beyond their powers. Each hero comes with quirks, flaws, and baggage you’ll need to navigate to keep the team together. Upgrade their skills and unlock abilities to boost their effectiveness in the field.

Blending narrative, strategy, and humor, Dispatch explores what it means to be a hero, whether you're wearing a cape or behind a desk.

Featuring an all-star cast from every corner of entertainment:

Aaron Paul (Breaking Bad, Westworld, Black Mirror)
Laura Bailey (The Legend of Vox Machina, The Last of Us II, Marvel's Spider-Man)
Erin Yvette (Hades II, The Wolf Among Us, Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon)
MoistCr1TiKaL (Charles White) 
Jacksepticeye (Sonic Prime, River City Girls 1 & 2, Bendy and the Ink Machine)
Travis Willingham (The Legend of Vox Machina, Critical Role, Lego Avengers)
Alanah Pearce (V/H/S Beyond, Cyberpunk 2077, Gears 5)
Lance Cantstopolis (Karate, Dancing, Actor)
Joel Haver (Filmmaker, Actor, YouTuber)
THOT SQUAD (Musician: Pound Cake, Hoes Depressed)
Yung Gravy (Musician: Betty (Get Money), oops!)
Matthew Mercer (Critical Role, Overwatch, Resident Evil 6)
and Jeffrey Wright (American Fiction, The Batman, Casino Royale)

70010000105353.name: Drift Highway: Retro Console Edition
70010000105353.intro: Race down an endless retro highway, weaving through traffic to the sound of liquid drum & bass. Breathe in the neon dusk, relax, and let the engine’s roar blend with the music.
70010000105353.description:
Drift Highway: Retro Console Edition is an arcade dive into an endless highway, where 90s aesthetics meet high-speed thrills. Dash through neon cities and sunset landscapes in iconic cars, weaving between traffic. Breathe in the evening air, relax, and let the engine’s roar merge with the rhythm of the music.

Features:
• Multiple camera views: Switch between hood, bumper, or third-person perspectives.

• Soundtrack: A full album of atmospheric liquid drum & bass for total immersion.

• Variety: Multiple tracks with unique moods and cars with distinct handling.

• Scoring & traffic: Earn points, dodge vehicles, avoid crashes — and keep moving.

• Aesthetics: VHS filters, retro visuals, and the feel of a classic console game.

70010000105359.name: Love Chemistry - Sibella's Formula
70010000105359.intro: Make your enemies fall for you in a side-scrolling platforming adventure about weird science!
70010000105359.description:
Take the role of an unhinged lady chemist in raucous side-scrolling platformer Love Chemistry - Sibella’s Formula! Shoot syringes of your special mind-control formula at weird enemies, from robots and carnivorous plants to roving bookworms, and make your way through tricky corridors in old-school pixel art style!

Avoid thorny spike traps, climb ladders to reach higher platforms, dodge projectiles and manipulate foes into falling for your flirty charms. Find and collect health items to keep this wild adventure on track as you battle through laboratories, cityscapes and more, zipping between stages on your high-tech hover bike!

• Run, jump and climb through laboratories and city streets.
• Battle roving robots, bookworms, monsters and more.
• Shoot syringes of your “love potion” to manipulate enemies.
• Avoid treacherous traps and collect useful items to survive.
• Enjoy retro pixel art with colorful HD presentation.

70010000105369.name: Animals in the Forest
70010000105369.intro: Get ready for a crazy adventure with little animals jumping through mysterious forests and magical caves full of surprises, where every place is pure fun.
70010000105369.description:
A group of friends, the Cozy Critters, experience a magical adventure. Zeke, a mischievous and brave monkey, and his friends embark on a magical journey.

Meet:
· Oggy, a cheerful and adventurous frog;
· Luna, a curious and dreamy cat;
· Tilly, an intelligent and observant mouse;
· Benny, a shy but kind-hearted teddy bear.

Together, they solve puzzles, find the Rainbow Stone, and enjoy an enchanted carnival, which helps them understand the true value of friendship.

In this beautiful story, the protagonists' wishes are granted, and they return home with hearts full of happiness, ready to discover the new adventures their magical home will hold.

· Simple gameplay designed for children.
· An entertaining and easy-to-read children's story.
· Learn to read with fun stories in English.
· Lively ambient music and immersive sounds.
· Learn about nature, history, and geography through this entertaining adventure.
· Educational content about animals with recreations of beautiful and imaginative natural landscapes.
· Accessible settings to adjust font height, sound volume, and image transition speed.

70010000105377.name: Rugrats: Retro Rewind Collection
70010000105377.description:
Hold onto your diapers! Rugrats: Retro Rewind Collection brings together the ultimate collection of Tommy, Chuckie, Phil, Lil, and Angelica’s greatest hits. Curated for fans by the team at Limited Run Games, this nostalgic bundle restores six iconic adventures from the Golden Age of Reptar, now enhanced for modern play.
Whether you're exploring the Pickles' backyard or trekking through EuroReptarland, this is the definitive way to experience the games that defined a generation of Nicktoons fans.

Six Classic Games in One Playpen
Relive the magic as the babies leap from classic handheld adventures to full 3D worlds:
•	Rugrats: Search for Reptar (32-BIT): Find the missing pieces of Tommy’s favorite dinosaur puzzle in the 3D classic that started it all.
•	The Rugrats Movie (Pocket/Pocket Color): A high-stakes platforming quest to find Dil and get back home.
•	Rugrats: Time Travelers (Pocket Color): Use a malfunctioning time machine to navigate the past and future.
•	Rugrats: Studio Tour (32-BIT): Explore a movie studio lot across various themed worlds… watch out for Shirley Lock Holmes!
•	Rugrats in Paris: The Movie (32-BIT/Pocket Color): The ultimate vacation! Play mini-games and explore the thrills of the park.
•	Rugrats: Castle Capers (Pocket Advance): Stu has a new job at a fantasy park, and the babies are ready for a royal adventure.

Modern Features for Grown-Up Babies
Don't let a Game Over ruin your nap time. We’ve added modern tools to make your trip down memory lane smoother than ever:
•	Rewind & Save Anywhere: Made a bad jump? Just rewind the clock. Need to stop for snacks? Save your progress at any moment.
•	Retro Screen Filters: Play with crisp modern pixels or toggle on classic CRT and handheld filters for that authentic 90s glow.
•	Digital Museum: Browse high-resolution scans of the original manuals and box art. It’s like owning the physical copies all over again!
•	Music Player: Kick back and listen to the iconic soundtracks with a dedicated in-game audio player.

70010000105384.name: Stardew Valley: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000105384.description:
You’ve inherited your grandfather’s old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home? It won’t be easy. Ever since Joja Corporation came to town, the old ways of life have all but disappeared. The community center, once the town’s most vibrant hub of activity, now lies in shambles. But the valley seems full of opportunity. With a little dedication, you might just be the one to restore Stardew Valley to greatness!

Now with Multiplayer! Invite 1-7 players to join you in the valley! Players can work together to build a thriving farm, share resources, and build relationships with townspeople or each other. As more hands are better than one, players have the option to scale profit margin on produce sold for a more challenging experience.

70010000105385.name: Cast n Chill
70010000105385.intro: Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear and reel in legendary catches - all with your loyal companion by your side.
70010000105385.description:
Cast n Chill's a laid-back fishin’ game for folks who’d rather wet a line than break a sweat. Whether yer driftin’ on a lazy lake, pokin’ 'round a winding river, or droppin’ lines in salty blue water, this here’s a game where you set the pace.

Upgrade Yer Gear.
Start with the basics, catch whatever bites, sell your haul, and put those coins toward better rods, reels, and upgrades. Before ya know it, you’ll be wranglin’ rare species that’d make any angler green with envy.

Explore New Waters.
Find yer favourite fishin’ hole or keep wanderin’. There’s 16 peaceful spots to discover, each with its own critters swimmin’ 'round, just waitin’ to bite.

Pick Your Pace.
In Active Mode, you’re in the thick of it - castin’, reelin’, and keepin’ busy like a loon at nesting time.

Switch to Passive Mode if you’d rather let the game do the work while you’re off choppin’ wood. 

Collect 'Em All.
There’s 50 fish to discover - some you’ll recognize, some you’ll squint at and go “what in the heck is that?” From scrappy little sunfish to big ol’ deepwater beasts, they’re all in the logbook waitin’ for your name.

Legendary Catches
There’s 16 fish out there that still get folks jabberin’ at ol' Rusty's bait shop like they saw Bigfoot ride a moose. Land one, and you'll be part o' the legend.

Boat Buddies
Grab your rod and call a buddy, Cast 'n Chill now has co-op! Whether you’re lookin’ to kick back and fish side-by-side or stir up a bit of friendly competition, it’s all better with company.

Trusty Companion
Nothin’ beats a day on the lake with a four-legged friend. They might not know a spinnerbait from a spoon, but they’ll help you spot a fish - if only 'cause they’re hopin’ for a bite themselves.

70010000105391.name: Nun of Your Business
70010000105391.intro: Unleash anime-styled nuns in a holy war against hell’s grotesque hordes.
70010000105391.description:
Welcome to "Nun of Your Business"!
Step onto a divine battlefield where sacred vows collide with unholy war. Command fierce, battle-ready nuns as they fight to purge the world of infernal horrors.

Key Features:

Divine Combat: Fast-paced, strategic battles where faith, reflexes, and firepower are your tools of salvation.

Choose Your Character: Select from a powerful roster of anime-styled nuns.

Infernal Enemies: Grotesque demons, skeletal hordes, and corrupted monsters rising from hell.

Epic Boss Fights: Confront massive terrors in intense encounters that test your precision, timing, and divine fury.

Unholy Grounds: Battle through cursed graveyards, haunted cloisters, and stained-glass sanctuaries twisted by darkness.

Experience a wild fusion of anime charm, supernatural horror, and nonstop action in "Nun of Your Business". With stunning visuals, unforgettable characters, and relentless combat, this is one mission that’s anything but sacred.

70010000105396.name: War Survival
70010000105396.intro:
Enemies advance without mercy, and only you can hold the front line!
Choose the best upgrades.
70010000105396.description:
In the heart of World War II, step into the role of a soldier determined to defend a strategic bridge. Use your arsenal to face waves of enemies, from soldiers and armed vehicles to powerful war tanks.

The challenge is clear: survive as long as possible and stop the enemy from crossing the bridge at all costs!

70010000105401.name: UNI 2
70010000105401.intro: The ultimate collection of 2-player mini games is here!
70010000105401.description:
Your favorite 2-player mini game collection, UNI, is back and better than ever.
UNI 2 features 20 head-to-head games in action, arcade, puzzle, racing, and shooting genres.
With simple controls and easy-to-learn rules, UNI 2 is fun for everyone.
Team up, compete, and make awesome memories with friends and family in UNI 2.

70010000105421.name: Puzzle Fruit Merge - Match Game
70010000105421.intro:
Mix, match, and merge!
Watch fruits grow bigger and juicier 
How far can you go?
70010000105421.description:
Puzzle Fruit Merge – Match Game

Enjoy a simple yet addictive puzzle experience where every move counts.
Merge identical fruits, watch them grow, and aim to create the biggest fruit possible. The rules are easy to understand, but mastering the balance and timing takes skill. If the basket overflows, the game ends—so plan each drop carefully.

Features

• Simple and relaxing gameplay for all ages
• Smooth physics and colorful fruit visuals
• Easy to pick up, challenging to master
• Endless replay value with dynamic difficulty
• Perfect for quick breaks or long play sessions

Puzzle Fruit Merge – Match Game delivers a satisfying, casual puzzle challenge that anyone can enjoy.
How big can your fruit grow?

70010000105427.name: Gorilla Jungle King Simulator
70010000105427.intro: Survive the dangers, lead your pack, and become the jungle king.
70010000105427.description:
Deep within the lush, dangerous heart of the tropical jungle, survival is never guaranteed — and power is never given. You are the Young Male, an ambitious gorilla with a destiny yet to be earned. To become the true Alpha, you must prove yourself through strength, wisdom, and unshakable leadership.

Gorilla Jungle King Simulator is an immersive animal survival adventure where every choice shapes your legacy. Unite scattered gorillas into a loyal pack, guide them to food, guard them from predators, and earn their trust through battle and care. A pack is more than allies — it’s your family, and its future depends on you.

Face the primal dangers of the wild:
• Survive deadly night hunts by leopards.
• Outsmart crocodile ambushes by riverbanks.
• Confront rival gorillas who challenge your right to lead.

Forage rare fruits that enhance strength and stamina, find hidden shelters from monsoon storms, and protect the weak as your numbers grow. But leadership is more than survival — it’s legacy. When your pack is ready, challenge the mighty clan and rise as the king of the jungle.

70010000105432.name: Hidden Legends
70010000105432.intro: Discover a magical world full of secrets and hidden treasures!
70010000105432.description:
Hidden Legends is an exciting hidden object game that will take you to a colorful fantasy world full of cute and charming characters. Explore fairy-tale villages, mysterious deserts, distant islands, harsh northern lands, pirate coves and picturesque waterfalls, uncovering secrets and finding hidden objects. Each level of the game was created by hand to give a unique experience and a sense of real adventure.

Hundreds of hours of exciting gameplay await you thanks to a huge number of objects to find. Atmospheric music and colorful graphics immerse you in the magical world of the game, and convenient controls with touch screen support make the search process intuitive and comfortable.

Game features:

• More than 2,500 unique objects to search for.
• Unique levels made by hand and filled with details.
• Colorful fantasy graphics and charming characters.
• Atmospheric music that creates a feeling of complete immersion.
• Convenient controls with touch screen support.
• Ideal for fans of hidden object games and quiet exploration.

70010000105445.name: Goat Out Of Hell
70010000105445.intro: The Best Guardian Goat of the Underworld
70010000105445.description:
In Goat Out of Hell, you take on the role of a guardian goat responsible for guiding the souls of pets that ended up in the wrong place after death. Your challenge is to push and place these souls on sacred altars to restore order, exploring stages filled with lava, rocks, marble columns, and unexpected traps.
The gameplay follows the classic block-pushing puzzle style but with a special twist: besides moving marble blocks and organizing the pets, you must also fill holes to clear paths through dangerous areas of hell. Each move demands strategy and patience, since a single mistake can cost all your progress.
With 30 levels spread across two unique settings, the game begins in the fiery Entrance of Hell, full of bubbling lava, and advances to the imposing Temple of Hell, a dark yet refined place with marble columns and flaming pyres.
Relax, rethink your moves, and challenge your logic in an adventure that blends brain-teasing puzzles, infernal atmosphere, and plenty of charm in every stage.

70010000105450.name: Sokomine
70010000105450.description:
Grab your helmet and pickaxe, because Sokomine just got explosive! Every puzzle is a mix of brains and blasts. Push mining carts stuffed with dynamite straight into meteors, blow them to pieces, and collect the shiny crystals hiding inside.

You play as a fearless miner on a crystal-collecting mission. Move through grid-based levels, plan your steps carefully, undo mistakes as much as you want, and trigger fiery explosions at just the right moment. To win, you’ll need to clear every meteor and outsmart every obstacle that stands in your way.

The Sokomine adventure takes you through 30 puzzles spread across three epic locations. Outer Space teaches you the ropes with simpler challenges. Mining Station tests your skills with tricky craters that stop carts in their tracks. And Lunar Lab? That’s where things heat up, introducing furnaces that destroy carts and force you to come up with the perfect plan.

70010000105461.name: Brass
70010000105461.description:
The only post office in a small village in the mountains, the main character of this story, Brass, works here. His job is to deliver letters and packages to the local people. One day, Brass receives a letter from his grandmother who lives in a town by the sea, and a new adventure begins.

The story progresses through conversations with the villagers and errands.There is no combat or intense action in this game. Please enjoy it in a relaxed atmosphere.

As you progress through the game, there are a few mysteries that call forth more mysteries. (Exaggerated?)
What is the secret behind his father's death? 
A cursed forest?
A secret underground facility?

70010000105471.name: Atomic Owl
70010000105471.intro: Take up arms against the evil Crow sorcerer who brainwashed your troupe!
70010000105471.description:
An avian story of a bird and a chatty blade unfurls its feathers! Hidalgo Bladewing and his companions return to their favorite ramen spot following a perilous mission, only to be confronted by the vengeful void crow Omega Wing. Two years later, Hidalgo must rescue his fallen companions from the clutches of this ruthless old foe with the help of a chaotic, brash-talking sword.

Atomic Owl is a pixel art-based single-player, side-scrolling roguelike that combines fast-paced platforming with dynamic hack-and-slash combat and a variety of weapons, powerups and a demonic blade. Journey through 8 roguelite zones, save your friends and take up arms against Omega Wing!

This definitive version of the game includes a "NO ROGUELITE" mode to experience the game in classic side-scrolling style, plus enjoy rebalanced weapons, improved sound and more across all modes!

Features:

• Defeat hordes of menacing Tengu across 8 side-scrolling stages!
• Attempt runs, try again, get stronger and prevail in roguelike style.
• Choose from a wide variety of weapons, from swords and hammers to whips and more!
• Take flight in winged sections and enjoy the serenity of gliding through the world of Judanest.
• Enjoy dynamic dialogue with a voice-acted cast!
• Transform into the powerful Void Crow to wreak havoc on your enemies.
• Switch to non-roguelike mode to enjoy the game as a normal side-scroller!

70010000105476.name: HELL BLOOD: INFERNO RETRO SHOOTER
70010000105476.description:
Step into the inferno — and fight your way out of hell.

In HELL BLOOD: INFERNO RETRO SHOOTER, you awaken in a world consumed by fire, corruption, and endless war. The sky bleeds red, the ground burns beneath your feet, and every corridor echoes with the screams of the damned. Armed with brutal weapons and unrelenting rage, you’ll carve through demonic legions, unearth forgotten relics, and confront the evil that feeds on your blood.

Inspired by the golden age of ’90s shooters, HELL BLOOD combines classic fast-paced combat with modern roguelike progression and acrobatic movement. Every level is alive — shifting layouts, evolving enemies, and unpredictable encounters keep you on edge. Run, dash, double jump, wall-run, and unleash chaos in a storm of fire and fury.

Key Features:
 • Adrenaline-fueled retro FPS action with intense combat and movement
 • Roguelike progression — each run offers new challenges and rewards
