 • Explore diverse, infernal environments from blood-soaked arenas to corrupted temples
 • Upgrade weapons, abilities, and mutations to grow stronger with every run
 • Face colossal bosses and relentless demonic hordes
 • Dynamic traps and hazards that test your skill and reflexes
 • Immersive retro-inspired visuals, atmospheric effects, and a dark synth soundtrack

Blood is not your weakness — it’s your weapon.

Rise from the ashes, embrace the flames, and carve your path through hell itself.
Welcome to HELL BLOOD: Inferno Retro Shooter.

70010000105486.name: Tralalero Tralala - Escape Backrooms
70010000105486.intro: Discover secrets, avoid monsters, and escape the labyrinth.
70010000105486.description:
Tralalero Tralala - Escape Backrooms is a survival horror experience that plunges players into an endless maze of dimly lit corridors, abandoned rooms, and surreal spaces. Your mission: scavenge for essential items, solve intricate puzzles, and avoid deadly creatures lurking in the shadows. Every misstep could be your last, and resources such as flashlights, batteries, and tools are scarce—use them wisely.

Survive the unknown as you navigate seven uniquely treacherous levels filled with puzzles, traps, and relentless enemies. Collect items, unlock doors, uncover hidden clues, and advance carefully, keeping a close eye on your limited resources and the ever-dwindling light. In some areas, a single mistake means instant death.

Features:
• Seven Distinct Levels: Each with its own mechanics—platforming challenges, mind-bending puzzles, and encounters with terrifying creatures.
• Deadly Enemies: Monsters hiding in the dark and unexpected jump scares keep you on edge at every turn.
• Limited Resources: Flashlights, batteries, keys, and tools are precious—strategic use is essential for survival.
• Interactive Environment: Break fragile walls, open lockers, and discover hidden secrets that could save your life.
• Intense Atmosphere: Every corridor and room amplifies tension, creating a gripping sense of dread.

Tralalero Tralala - Escape Backrooms is a game where fear, strategy, and logic intertwine. Will you solve the puzzles, survive the horrors, and escape the labyrinth, or will you be lost forever in the infinite maze?

70010000105491.name: SHARK SIEGE - TOGETHER SURVIVAL
70010000105491.description:
Survive the relentless siege of the deep in SHARK SIEGE - TOGETHER SURVIVAL, where the vast ocean is your enemy and courage is your strongest ally. Navigate treacherous waters and keep your ship afloat while a massive, menacing shark relentlessly hunts you.

Features:
- Dynamic Ocean Environment: Face unpredictable waters, survive storms, and adapt to changing conditions.
- Relentless Shark Attacks: A massive shark hunts your ship, making every moment tense and thrilling.
- Ship Management: Repair and reinforce your ship to withstand devastating attacks.
- Resource Gathering: Collect materials from the ocean to upgrade defenses and survive longer.
- Environmental Hazards: Navigate through storms, whirlpools, and other natural dangers.
- Strategic Survival: Make split-second decisions to protect your ship and outsmart the predator.
- Immersive Atmosphere: Experience the suspense of the deep sea with realistic visuals and sound design.

Dive in if you dare — the ocean waits, and the shark never rests!

70010000105501.name: Bubsy 4D
70010000105501.intro: Bubsy is back in a new 3D platforming adventure! What could possibly go wrong?
70010000105501.description:
Join Bubsy on a new, intergalactic, platforming adventure! Yeah, we couldn’t believe it either. The world’s most infamous, wise-cracking bobcat has returned to 3D with new challenges, new moves, and even more purrsonality – in space! Run, jump, glide, and roll across alien planets, battle robotic sheep, and collect tons and tons of yarn. What could possibly go wrong?

Bubsy’s longstanding enemies, the fleece-obsessed Woolies, have stolen all of the Earth’s sheep. Oh well, that ain’t Bubsy’s problem. Until the sheep overthrow their captors and return as deadly BaaBots, empowered by Woolie technology, determined to steal Bubsy’s most prized possession, The Golden Fleece. 

With the help of his motley crew of acquaintances, Bubsy must journey through space to defeat the BaaBots and take back the Golden Fleece. Luckily, he’s acquired some new skills to navigate the expansive, craft-themed levels. Bubsy can leap, glide, claw his way up walls, and pounce off enemies. He can also puff up into a new hairball form to roll at blistering speeds. 

The team at Fabraz crafted this expressive new moveset to cater to beginners and speedrun enthusiasts alike. Once you’ve mastered Bubsy’s clawsome new moves, show off your skills by uploading your best level times to the online leaderboards for other players to race against!

Features
- Explore intergalactic, craft-themed worlds, each ending in a BaaBot boss battle
- New hairball form allows you to roll, bounce, and launch your way around
- An expressive platforming moveset supports both beginner and advanced levels of play
- Spend yarn to purrchase stylish new outfits, or collect a hidden blueprint in each level to unlock new moves and upgrades
- Tackle each level’s time trial, upload your best run, and race against other players’ ghost data
- Chat with a cast of furmiliar friends including Terri, Terry, Virgil, and Oblivia
- Pawsitively funky soundtrack by Fat Bard, incorporating elements of jazz, big band, electro-swing and more

70010000105516.name: Turn it!
70010000105516.intro:
Rotate the world. Change your path.
Guide Bibi, the bunny-eared TV: rotate the stage to overcome platforms, dodge traps, and solve puzzles across 8 levels
70010000105516.description:
Turn it! is a short and intense side-scrolling platformer created by two students. Take control of Bibi, a tiny TV with bunny ears, whose main ability isn’t just jumping: you can rotate the entire stage around the character!

8 carefully crafted levels: each one introduces new mechanics and puzzles combining rotation, moving platforms, and timing challenges.

Environmental puzzles: use rotation to create bridges, remove obstacles, or drop objects that unlock the path.

Indie aesthetic: a simple, charming style designed for short but memorable play sessions.
Perfect for players seeking a creative and compact platforming experience.

70010000105526.name: Hades II – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000105526.intro: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.
70010000105526.description:
The first-ever sequel from Supergiant Games builds on the best aspects of the original god-like rogue-like dungeon crawler in an all-new, action-packed, endlessly replayable experience rooted in the Underworld of Greek myth and its deep connections to the dawn of witchcraft.

BATTLE BEYOND THE UNDERWORLD
As the immortal Princess of the Underworld, you'll explore a bigger, deeper mythic world, vanquishing the forces of the Titan of Time with the full might of Olympus behind you, in a sweeping story that continually unfolds through your every setback and accomplishment.

MASTER WITCHCRAFT AND DARK SORCERY
Infuse your legendary weapons of Night with ancient magick, so that none may stand in your way. Become stronger still with powerful Boons from more than a dozen Olympian gods, from Apollo to Zeus. There are nearly limitless ways to build your abilities.

MINGLE WITH (MORE) GODS, GHOSTS, AND MONSTERS
Meet a cast of dozens of fully-voiced, larger-than-life characters, including plenty of new faces and some old friends. Grow closer to them through a variety of new interactions, and experience countless unique story events based on how your journey unfolds.

EVERY RUN IS ITS OWN ADVENTURE
New locations, challenges, upgrade systems, and surprises await as you delve into the ever-shifting Underworld again and again. Reveal the mysteries of the Arcana Altar, tame witchy familiars, and gather reagents using Tools of the Unseen to get closer to your goal.

THE PERKS OF IMMORTALITY
Thanks to a variety of permanent upgrades and the return of God Mode, you don't have to be a god yourself to experience what Hades II has to offer. But if you happen to be one, you can brave escalating challenges for greater rewards, and prove just how divine you really are.

SIGNATURE SUPERGIANT STYLE
Rich, atmospheric presentation and storytelling fused with responsive action is the hallmark of Supergiant's titles. Vivid new hand-painted environments, even smoother real-time 3D characters, and an electrifying original score make this mythic world burst with life.

70010000105530.name: Escape Game The Edo Period
70010000105530.intro:
A classic escape game set in the Edo period!
Solve the mysteries and aim to escape from the Edo period.
70010000105530.description:
■Game System
This is an escape game (puzzle adventure game).
*The game progresses by selecting items on the screen with the cursor and solving various puzzles.

■Story
On the way home from shopping,

I was caught in a sudden rain shower

and took shelter under a nearby tree.

Then―

I was struck by lightning and woke up to find

that something strange was happening around me.

70010000105536.name: Scandinavian Cottage Survival Simulator
70010000105536.intro: Build your life in the heart of the Scandinavian wilderness.
70010000105536.description:
Spend your summer immersed in the quiet beauty of a Scandinavian village, where tradition meets survival. In Scandinavian Cottage Survival Simulator, you’ll take on the role of a young villager helping your family and neighbors through the warm season, balancing work, exploration, and survival in a fully interactive open world.

Build, hunt, fish, and thrive as you take on quests, manage your character’s needs, and master the rhythms of countryside life. Whether you’re chopping wood, repairing old cabins, or crafting tools and shelters from gathered materials, every task connects you to the land and its people.

Key Features:
• Village Life Simulation – Help parents and locals with daily tasks, from construction to gathering supplies.
• Crafting & Building – Construct a cozy hut, campfire, log racks, and more using wood, stone, leather, and glass.
• Fishing & Hunting – Catch fish or hunt wildlife, then cook your meals over an open flame.
• Dynamic World – Experience day or night cycles, shifting weather, and seasonal wildlife behavior.
• Character Management – Monitor hunger, energy, and health as you take on life in the wild.
• Open World & Quests – Explore the countryside, interact with NPCs, buy and sell resources, and complete a variety of quests.

Can you handle the raw beauty and demands of Nordic summer life? Grab your axe, cast your line, and start your journey in Scandinavian Cottage Survival Simulator.

70010000105546.name: The Jungle Challenge
70010000105546.intro: Join Buzzy, an energetic bee, along with his friends Lilo the ladybug, Tito the beetle, and Rocco the grasshopper in this exciting visual novel.
70010000105546.description:
Our little friends participate in the Great Jungle Challenge, a tournament filled with tests of speed, strength, and strategy. Although they may seem like complete failures at first, they will learn to rely on themselves and their friendship to overcome their rivals' obstacles and traps.

Gameplay:

·Meet a bunch of friendly little insects

·Text and narration suitable for young readers.

·Dynamic images inspired by fantasy worlds.

·Magical and immersive background music.

·Lessons about teamwork, courage, and friendship.

·Accessibility options: Adjust text, volume, and transitions.

·Educational content with positive values.

70010000105548.name: Simogo Legacy Collection
70010000105548.description:
From cute arcade novelties to innovative text-based thrillers and acclaimed fourth wall-breaking stories, Simogo Legacy Collection is an eclectic celebration of Simogo's past, featuring faithful renditions of seven games released on mobile platforms between 2010 and 2015.

• Kosmo Spin
• Bumpy Road
• Beat Sneak Bandit
• Year Walk (+ Year Walk Companion)
• DEVICE 6
• The Sailor’s Dream
• SPL-T

Additionally, Simogo Legacy Collection features bonus content with thoughtfully curated curios from Simogo's wide-ranging history.

• Year Walk Bedtime Stories for Awful Children – E-book
• The Lighthouse Painting – Audio drama Podcast
• Music – Tracks from Simogo’s history, including previously unreleased tracks
• Images – Illustrations from Simogo’s archive
• Year Walk Prototype – Playable prototype
• Bumpy Road Prototype – Playable prototype
• Rollovski Prototype – Playable prototype
• The Sensational December Machine – Playable short story

Requires understanding of written and spoken English to be fully enjoyed.

70010000105556.name: Whiskey Mafia: Blacklist
70010000105556.intro: A new chapter in Whiskey Mafia story.
70010000105556.description: Step into the gritty streets of Chicago in Whiskey Mafia: Blacklist, a story-driven crime adventure. Play as a determined detective navigating a city full of gangsters, corrupt cops, and hidden dangers. Investigate crimes, follow leads, interrogate witnesses, and uncover the secrets of a mysterious Russian crime syndicate. Explore diverse locations from bustling markets and shady bars to the dangerous docks. Experience immersive dialogues, thrilling chases, and tense confrontations in a detailed, atmospheric city. Can you survive the criminal underworld and bring justice to the streets of Chicago?

70010000105567.name: Combat Zone
70010000105567.intro: Nintendo Switch™ Exclusive! Control tanks to dominate battlefield and destroy enemy armor with RPG-7s! Conquer battles against heavy tanks on realistic terrain!
70010000105567.description:
Experience thrilling tank operations and infantry close combat rendered in breathtaking graphics! Take control of captured tanks and armored vehicles on the battlefield and crush enemy positions with 120mm main guns. Or, take up an RPG-7 anti-tank rocket launcher and destroy enemy tanks with a single shot! This dynamic combination of infantry and tanks provides an unprecedented battlefield experience. Set against a scorching desert backdrop, choose from four different classes and enjoy the strategic gameplay.

・Use tanks as both transportation and attack platforms! Experience the innovative combination of tank piloting and RPG-7 anti-tank assaults.
・High-quality, realistic open-field battlefield graphics showcase decisive battles of steel versus steel.
・Whether you board tanks for direct control and crush enemy positions with 120mm main guns, or shoulder RPG-7 anti-tank rockets to obliterate steel war machines with a single strike, it's entirely up to you!
・There are four classes: Assault, Support, Engineer, and Recon. Each class has unique special weapons and tactics, enabling diverse combat styles.
・Ultra-high-definition graphics and 3D sound realistically reproduce the roar of tank engines, the explosion of RPG-7s, and even the sound of a sandstorm.
・Intuitive aiming and controls allow both novice and expert players to enjoy tank piloting and anti-tank attacks.
・Spectacular realism! Experience the weight of tanks and the explosive impact of weapons through 3D physics engines.
・A variety of game modes are available.
・Take on "Combat Zone" missions as part of the world's elite special forces!

Open battlefields, swept by sandstorms, come to life with photorealistic graphics. Experience 120mm artillery strikes from tank cockpits, RPG-7 anti-tank attacks, and strategic battles using the special weapons of four classes. Cutting-edge rendering technology provides an unparalleled, immersive experience. Experience the ultimate desert battlefield FPS game with steel tanks!

Synopsis
An endless wasteland, scorched by the sun and covered in golden sand, stretches out before you. Deep underground, the "Ultima Crystal," the ultimate energy source, pulses with an eerie heartbeat. The mega-corporation Kronos Industries deploys its heavily armored tank battalion, the "Iron Hammer," to the front lines in an attempt to monopolize high-purity crystals and fortify mining installations. Refinement towers belch black smoke, and thundering artillery shakes the earth.

In response, the United Nations dispatches an elite force comprising four classes Assault, Support, Engineer, and Recon to counter this threat. You step onto the battlefield as one of them.

Take control of frontline tanks and dominate the battlefield with your artillery. Alternatively, shoulder an RPG-7 to obliterate enemy tanks in a single strike and send pillars of fire into the desert. Will you command steel tanks or shatter steel armor? Your actions in the heat of battle will determine its fate.

70010000105587.name: An English Haunting
70010000105587.intro: Unravel the chilling secrets of Victorian times in a ghostly adventure that will haunt your every step!
70010000105587.description:
In his riveting quest for evidence of the Great Beyond, Professor Patrick Moore teams up with a deceptive medium to create an extraordinary device that can reveal what lies beyond our world. Together, they will embark on a thrilling adventure to uncover a millennium-old artifact and delve into the mysteries of the most haunted manor in England, dating back to 1907. Join Patrick as he challenges the boundaries of reality and explores the unknown!

STORY

A madness for spiritualism has gripped London in 1907. Séances and theatrical shows where spirits make contact with their living families are all the rage, and there is a legion of investigators trying to discover the secrets of the supernatural. Among them, Professor Patrick Moore stands at the forefront, and he is now at a crossroads ‒ he's got 72 hours to prove the existence of the Great Beyond or else his Metapsychic Investigations Department will shut down forever.

Racing against the clock, with the help of a fake medium named Beatrice Shaw, he must complete a prototype of the Box of Revelations, an artefact devised by his missing mentor that enables seeing dimensions hidden in our reality. Building this device will take him from the foggy streets of London to the steep shores of Scotland, and finally to 34 Benwell Street, known as the most haunted manor of England.

FEATURES

- Point & click adventure gameplay based on inventory puzzles.
- More than 60 detailed pixel art backgrounds to explore.
- A cast of more than 70 characters to interact with, including real figures from the period, such as the medium Florence Cook, physicist William Crookes, illusionist Harry Houdini, and even writer Arthur Conan Doyle, whom you will control to solve one of the game's mysteries.
- Inspired by the works of the greatest horror authors from the beginning of the 20th century, M.R. James, Algernon Blackwood, and Arthur Machen.
- Text available in English or Spanish

70010000105593.name: Icebound Secrets: The Frostwood Bane
70010000105593.intro: Frostwood hides more than just the cold. Strange figures roam the streets, and one wrong step can change everything. Can you survive the night?
70010000105593.description:
Frostwood is a city frozen in mystery and danger. An unnatural cold grips the streets, and shadowy figures move silently, spreading fear among the residents.

You are a detective sent to investigate the strange chill and uncover the truth behind the disappearances. Collect newspaper fragments, explore eerie locations, and face the ghostly Ice Phantom lurking in the shadows. Courage and wits will be your only allies as you discover a way to open the city gates.

On one snowy street, you find Kristina, a girl frozen in the cold. Help her recover, prepare remedies, and gather supplies for other survivors hiding in the local library. But beware—the Ice Phantom is relentless, and danger can strike at any moment.

Collector’s Edition Features:
●	6 immersive adventure chapters
●	40+ mini-games and hidden object challenges
●	Morphing objects and collectibles to discover
●	20+ unique locations, from icy streets to underground catacombs
●	Story-driven puzzles, twists, and unforgettable characters
●	Moral choices that affect both victims and perpetrators
●	Excellent graphics and voiceovers
●	Behind-the-scenes concept art collection
●	Customizable difficulty levels

Step into Frostwood, face supernatural horrors, and solve chilling mysteries in a city where danger and treachery lurk around every corner!

70010000105601.name: Escape game R00M07
70010000105601.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

70010000105604.name: lumen.
70010000105604.description:
lumen. is a puzzle game with unique mechanics, where you have to solve levels using lights, lenses and mirrors. 
You will find yourself in the old attic and discover the mysterious antique box of Ms. Olivia McLumen, who lived in Scotland over a hundred years ago and was a great inventor of her time, she saved her inventions in cinematic frames for you to restore.

HUNDREDS OF WELL DESIGNED LEVELS

Use lights, lenses and mirrors to solve a variety of easy to hard levels. lumen. is family friendly and suitable for players of all ages.

EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER

The game is easy to pick up and play at any time for either short or long sessions. 

BEAUTIFUL GRAPHICS, MUSIC & SOUND EFFECTS

Dive into the fascinating atmosphere of soothing piano and saxophone in a handcrafted 1800 box and enjoy all the small details carved herein.

70010000105619.name: Contraband Patrol Simulator
70010000105619.description:
Step into the high-stakes world of border security in Contraband Patrol Simulator, where every decision you make could mean the difference between law and chaos. As a newly assigned border officer, your mission is to control the flow of goods and people across a tense border zone, uncover smuggling operations, and maintain the fragile peace of your homeland.

Inspect vehicles, interrogate drivers, and use advanced tools to detect hidden contraband. But the job doesn’t end there—chase down fleeing smugglers, fend off attacks from dangerous gangs, and upgrade your station to stay ahead of the escalating threats. Each day brings new challenges that test your vigilance, integrity, and survival skills. Will you uphold the law or be tempted by corruption?

Key Features:
Document Inspections: Scrutinize passports, permits, and cargo manifests for discrepancies. Even the smallest error could signal foul play!
Smuggling Detection: Use tools like UV flashlights, metal detectors, and inspection kits to uncover hidden contraband. Crack open suspicious cargo and stop illegal goods from crossing the border.
Action-Packed Missions: Engage in police chases, intercept desperate smugglers, and survive intense shootouts with gang members.
Post Management: Upgrade your station's defenses, vehicles, and tools to handle increasingly complex challenges. Balance your budget and allocate resources wisely.
Decision-Making: Your choices matter. Will you stand firm as a beacon of justice, or succumb to the temptations of corruption for personal gain?
Dynamic World: Experience changing weather, evolving threats, and a richly detailed world inspired by Cold War-era tensions.

In Contraband Patrol Simulator, every action counts, and every inspection has consequences. Are you ready to patrol the line and uphold the law?

70010000105624.name: Anime School Love: Her Teacher's Secret Lesson
70010000105624.intro:
What if the price of love… was your soul?
Make your choice… before it’s made for you.
70010000105624.description:
Step into a world where love, temptation, and fate collide.

A mysterious demon appears before you with a chilling challenge: win the heart of your university professor… or be dragged into the depths of hell.

As your conversations grow more intimate, your every word shapes your destiny.

Will you follow the demon’s wicked game, or defy him and choose your own path?

Your choices matter... and every ending reveals a different truth about desire, freedom, and the price of love.


Features:

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Every path leads to a different fate. And a different version of you.

● CHOICE & CONSEQUENCE: What you say changes everything, even who survives.

● SUPERNATURAL ROMANCE: A love story twisted by temptation, mystery, and desire.

● ATMOSPHERIC EXPERIENCE: Stunning art and haunting music that draw you into the dark.


It’s seductive.
It’s dangerous.
It’s your soul on the line.

Are you ready to play her game?

70010000105629.name: Dustland Delivery
70010000105629.intro: Grow your trading empire in a post-apocalyptic wasteland.
70010000105629.description:
Dustland Delivery is a post-apocalyptic survival business simulator, featuring over 40 hours of gameplay content. Scour the wastes for profit, complete missions to grow your trading empire, and assemble a rag-tag band of adventurers to turn your city into the capital of the Dustlands. Danger lurks around every corner—but no risk, no reward!

Marshal Resources to Build Your Dustland Empire
 •  A vast game world with a rich narrative to explore
 • Establish trade routes across unique settlements to become a kingpin of the wastes
 • Control resource flows to build magnificent cities
 
Transform Your Truck for Apocalyptic Adventures
 • Create your own mobile base to cruise through the Dustlands
 • Install mods to turn your truck into a deadly weapon against infected swarms
 
A Cast of Unique Companions
 • Recruit a rag-tag group of adventurers with distinctive traits
 • Assign different roles to help build your city
 • Tool up and train animal companions to boost your team's stats
 • Undead? No excuse not to show up for work...
 
Random Events, Freedom to Choose
 • Countless random events: armored motorcades, undead raids, unknown signals from mysterious locations...
 • Your Dustland, your way: become a warrior for justice, a money-grubbing merchant, or an infamous bandit
 
Struggle for Power, Rebuild the Wastes
 • 6 major factions with a web of complex relations
 • Exploit power struggles and trading rivalries to come out on top
 • Form alliances, stir up trouble, and build your own power base
 
Complex Weather System
 • Forge a path through the Dustlands while fighting storms and hidden dangers
 • Set up camp to shelter from the elements, then ride out at daybreak

70010000105639.name: Anime School Love: His Teacher Secret Lesson
70010000105639.intro:
What if the price of love… was your soul? 
Make your choice… before it’s made for you.
70010000105639.description:
Step into a world where love, temptation, and fate collide.

A mysterious demon appears before you with a chilling challenge:
win the heart of your university professor… or be dragged into the depths of hell.

As your conversations grow more intimate, every word pulls you closer to him... and to the darkness that follows.

Will you surrender to the demon’s wicked game, or defy him and carve your own destiny?

Your choices matter... and every ending reveals a different truth about desire, freedom, and the price of love.


Features:

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Every path leads to a different fate...  and a different version of you.

● CHOICE & CONSEQUENCE: What you say changes everything, even who survives.

● SUPERNATURAL ROMANCE: A forbidden love story twisted by temptation, mystery, and male desire.

● ATMOSPHERIC EXPERIENCE: Beautiful art and haunting music that pull you deeper into the dark.


It’s seductive.
It’s dangerous.
It’s your soul on the line.

Are you ready to play his game?

70010000105644.name: Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor
70010000105644.intro: Join Thomas and his friends on a special journey across Sodor!
70010000105644.description:
Join Thomas and his friends on a special journey across Sodor! Hop into the cabs of North Western Railway’s classic steam team to enjoy nostalgic stories and all-new narratives right from the engineer'sseats. Explore the Wonders of Sodor—fun and magic await!

• Join Thomas, Diesel, Gordon, Percy, and Emily for railway adventures in their home, the Island of Sodor.

• Explore iconic landmarks across Sodor, such as the Tidmouth Sheds, Knapford station, and the famous Windmills.

• Play a total of 8 stories all narrated by the legendary Mark Moraghan.

• Get involved by operating Thomas on his branch line, or even ride as a passenger!

Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor is powered by Train Sim World, combining the unparalleled detail and realism of Unreal Engine and Simugraph with accessible controls to create a nostalgic experience that all Thomas & Friends™ fans can enjoy.

70010000105649.name: Snapshot Girls 2
70010000105649.intro: Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and marvel at every detail of stunning photorealistic masterpieces!
70010000105649.description:
Welcome to Snapshot Girls 2, a sophisticated and relaxing puzzle game where each completed puzzle reveals a photorealistic image of charming heroines in sophisticated and stylish looks.

Immerse yourself in an atmosphere where each image looks like a real photograph, with soft skin tones, natural light, and tiny details that are impossible to miss. Realistic puzzle mechanics allow you to feel every detail, and each scene is filled with emotion, character, and history.

Game Features:

- Photorealistic high-resolution images created with maximum attention to detail

- Smooth and intuitive puzzle mechanics

- Atmospheric soundtrack that enhances immersion

- Gallery mode to revisit your favorite scenes

70010000105657.name: ChainStaff
70010000105657.intro: ChainStaff is a brutal action-platformer with a transforming spear and grappling hook, blazing weapon upgrades, and a rocking soundtrack.
70010000105657.description:
Our planet is under attack from the Star Spores, and they've warped life on Earth into ferocious uber-bugs.

Even worse, a nasty alien has made its new home directly attached to your head.

But it's not all bad news - your new best friend has provided both the strength to fight back against the mutated horde, and control over a weapon that can tip the balance of the battle in humanity's favor: the ChainStaff.

As you traverse the surreal landscape, you'll encounter your fellow soldiers, stranded in harsh environments. Do you rescue your comrades or listen to the alien voice in your head and harvest them for upgrades?

If you can persevere and defeat the Star Spores, perhaps you can save everyone…including yourself."
GAME FEATURES
MASTER THE CHAINSTAFF
Hurl it as a spear and slice aliens in half. Throw it to the ground as a shield to stop incoming attacks. Grapple and swing on just about anything. The transforming ChainStaff does all this and more, and all with one button, it’s all up to you.
YOU DIED
Pounded to mush, stabbed through the heart, sheared in two. Prepare to meet your doom in a myriad of disgusting ways. All deaths are avoidable, but some dangers may require special strategies.
FEROCIOUS FOES
The creatures of Earth have been mutated by aliens: you’ll come across dozens of unusual creatures, and once you get past those, you’ll have to fight against screen-filling monstrosities.
GROTESQUE UPGRADES
Stranded soldiers dot the landscape of ChainStaff. You must choose whether to rescue them or devour their organs; each option has unique benefits and will lead to different endings.
10 WILD LEVELS
"Mist trails through rocky crags.
Wind blows over icy, moon-lit hills.
Water streams down mossy cliffs.
Fully hand-drawn art immerses you in a living world inspired by album covers of the 70s and 80s."
KILLER SOUNDTRACK
"Scorching riffs and peals of thunder. Pumping beats drive you ever forward.
Rock out to the classic metal soundtrack by the award-winning composer Deon van Heerden of Broforce and Warhammer 40k: Shootas Blood & Teef soundtrack fame. There’s some lighter interludes with 70s synth, catchy melodies, and even some cowbell. Now it’s back to the heavy tracks, where it’s time to bang your head while smashing skulls.

All depictions of violence are 2 dimensional and heavily stylized. As part of your quest to cleanse Earth of the Star Spore menace, you'll use all the weapons at your disposal to defeat your foes, many of whom will die bloody deaths. Additionally, you may harvest resources from your fellow soldiers in order to increase the power of the alien keeping you alive, and this process is messy.

70010000105661.name: Everwarder
70010000105661.intro: Fight against the encroaching darkness and fend off emerging enemies.
70010000105661.description:
In Everwarder there's you, and a procedurally-generated world covered in darkness. Touch it - and it will spawn a creature that will try to destroy your most precious thing – a crystal with your friend trapped inside. 

TOWER DEFENSE LIKE NO OTHER 
Every run starts with your crystal and a supply of energy. Then it's up to you how to fight the darkness. Do you steadily expand, clearing the darkness, harvesting its energy, and carefully deploying defenders to deal with whatever emerges from the dark? Or do you play it fast and loose, striking out to locate ancient structures and powerful artifacts hidden within? 

EVOLVE AND ADAPT 
Failure is just another word for learning. With every run you gather minerals and unlock new options on the upgrade tree, allowing you to become stronger and last longer against the darkness. After all, time is not on your side: Enemies grow stronger as the seconds tick on - but so do you, gathering new resources, boosts, and upgrading your defenders to last just a bit longer. 

ENDLESS CHALLENGE 
Every run is randomly generated, with its own set of challenges and twists that will keep you on your toes. Every upgrade tweaks the experience, creating various synergies. So even if you struggle to keep up with the pressure, there’s always a way to turn the tides of the battle!

70010000105673.name: Mamon King
70010000105673.intro: Aim to become the strongest king with uniquely charming monsters!
70010000105673.description:
Players are special beings who can connect with Mamons (monsters) summoned from another world. Raise and train your Mamons with kindness, and sometimes strictness!

After winning countless tournaments, when you defeat the strongest Mamon, you will become the world's king: the Mamon King!

*38 Unique Mamons

Mammon boast distinctive appearances, each excelling in different training areas and possessing varying lifespans. Grasping their traits is your first step to victory.

*Over 170 Skills

Mamon's signature skills go beyond mere attack and defense, creating deep strategic depth. Master evolving skills through repeated use to forge even more powerful weapons.

*Experience the Ultimate Tactical Battle in 1-on-1 Command Combat

It's not just about attacking, defending, buffing, or debuffing. Using skills consumes SP, and more powerful skills demand greater SP—or even greater sacrifices. Timing your moves will decide your fate.

Experience unparalleled tactical depth in this 1-on-1 command-based battle system, designed to be accessible yet offering the most intense strategic gameplay.

*Strengthen Your Mamon Through Training, Tournaments, and Expeditions

Training isn't the only way to hone your Mamon—it's also about deciding what to do each week at home. Mamon grows stronger not only through tournaments against rivals but also via Expeditions, where you advance through uncharted lands rumored to hold ancient Mamon in a board game-style format.

*Your Unique Mamon

A Mamon's potential blossoms through your skill and luck. Inheritance Summoning passes on the power of your trained Mamon. And with help from a shady scientist or a muscle-bound trainer, your Mamon might gain powers beyond its natural limits?

The monster-raising game set on a ranch has evolved!

Experience a new kind of raising in Mamon King!

70010000105683.name: God bless, or Goddess
70010000105683.description:
They say the path to immortality is paved with hardship. But in your case, this hardship happened to take the form of seven dangerously beautiful women.

You are Lin Fan, the chosen one of the Crane Illusion Sect. Born with a Pure Yang Lineage, you are destined to ascend to the heavens. However, no matter how hard you train, fate sends yet another challenge in your way...temptations in the shape of an unreliable master, a strict senior sister, or a saintess who seems far more interested in testing your heart rather than your skills.

Can you survive the thousand tribulations of love, jealousy, and thunder? Or will your heart fall just before your heavenly ascension?

A Cinematic Live-Action FMV Experience

Stunning xianxia-inspired effects bring a mythic Chinese fantasy world to life. Feel the spark of every lightning strike!

A First-Person Immortal Ascension Adventure

Step into the robes of Lin Fan and experience the world through his eyes. Every glance, every touch, and every whispered word can shake your Dao heart.

Multiple Paths, Infinite Outcomes

Will you walk the merciless path of the true immortal, or lose yourself in mortal passion? Every choice leads to a different fate: enlightenment, downfall, or something in between.

Train, Duel, and Survive Heavenly Tribulation

Quick-time trials, emotional duels, and comedic chaos await. Survive your master's "training," dodge objects thrown at you, and protect your Divine Essence… at all costs.

Survival Tips for Aspiring Immortals
Never believe your master... especially when she says, "This time, I won’t deceive you."

Senior sisters strike fast... but jealousy strikes faster.

Your Divine Essence is both a blessing and a curse... manage it wisely.

Key Highlights
Immersive live-action FMV experience

Chinese myth-inspired fantasy setting

Multiple endings and branching choices

Humor, romance, and supernatural chaos

Thunder, temptation, and transcendence

70010000105688.name: MYRIAD DEATH
70010000105688.intro: A thrilling action and shooting game where you battle using weapons with different capabilities.
70010000105688.description:
Use various weapons randomly found in dungeon treasure chests to defeat the enemies blocking your path!

You can charge forward, mowing down enemies with melee weapons!

Or advance safely, taking out foes with ranged weapons!

Your playstyle is up to you!
Dodge enemy attacks with rolls, defeat every floor boss—can you reach the true ending?

70010000105697.name: Fishing Pro Simulator
70010000105697.intro: From quiet waters to rare trophies.
70010000105697.description:
Cast your line. Watch the water. Wait for the perfect moment.

Enter the world of Fishing Pro Simulator, a relaxing fishing simulator with light RPG elements, where patience, skill, and exploration shape every catch. Travel across peaceful lakes, flowing rivers, and vast open waters, each hiding its own fish species, secrets, and challenges. Every location invites you to slow down, observe nature, and master the art of fishing one cast at a time.

What begins as a simple fishing trip grows into a journey of progression and discovery. Choose your gear carefully, adapt to changing weather and time of day, and learn how different fish behave beneath the surface. Rare and legendary species demand experience, upgraded equipment, and the right conditions. Each successful catch brings rewards, unlocks new areas, and builds your personal trophy collection.

Fishing Pro Simulator is not about rushing—it’s about timing, balance, and growth. Whether you’re completing daily challenges, expanding your fishing album, or hunting for the next rare catch, every session offers a calm yet rewarding experience where skill meets serenity.

Key Features:

- Relaxing fishing simulation with light RPG progression

- Multiple fishing locations with unique fish species

- Dynamic conditions influenced by weather and time of day

- Gear upgrades that unlock new challenges and rare catches

-Daily and weekly goals that encourage exploration and mastery

The water is calm, but the challenge lies beneath.
Cast your line, trust your instincts, and build your legacy in Fishing Pro Simulator.

70010000105703.name: EGGCONSOLE Hajya No Fuuin PC-8801
70010000105703.intro: A gripping otherworldly RPG! Descendant of the hero Iason, unravel the mystery of the “Seal of the Dark Lord” with allies scattered across the world and restore peace!
70010000105703.description:
This 1986 fantasy RPG by KOGADO STUDIO is a representative early work. Popular for authentic field-based party play, its unique world earned it the “interdimensional software” moniker. Complex monster lore, intricate history, and a “Completion Certificate” campaign captivated users.

This game’s biggest highlight is its high difficulty, which requires not only growth through combat but also listening to many people and solving numerous mysteries. You’ll converse with townsfolk and those on the field, and later even monsters. Carefully heeding their advice will be a significant aid to clearing the game.

Gathering information with companions and solving mysteries to save the world—this is a true old-school RPG. An indispensable title for discussing classic Japanese RPGs.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000105706.name: Lovely Spot the Difference
70010000105706.intro: A spot-the-difference game featuring lots of cute girls!
70010000105706.description:
Enjoy an easy and fun game that anyone can play while looking at adorable characters!
There are 15 stages in total!

Compare the two illustrations on the left and right to find the differences!
Tap either illustration to answer.
If you can’t find the differences, try zooming in!
Still stuck? Use the magnifying glass for a helpful hint!
Perfect for killing time during short breaks!

70010000105721.name: Capybara Journey Go
70010000105721.intro:
Adorable capybaras racing for hidden treasures
Explore new worlds with speed and teamwork
Rise as the fastest hero across cozy lands
70010000105721.description:
Capybara Journey GO is a colorful 2D adventure where you explore vibrant lands, search for hidden treasure, and build a team of courageous capybara heroes. Rush through more than one hundred fun and surprising levels, collect valuable items, and uncover secrets in new and unexplored worlds.

Use a unique hook-based movement system to swing and launch yourself across the map at high speed. Jump, dash, and glide across islands while avoiding traps and dangerous creatures. Collect food and coins, upgrade your hero, and recruit new capybaras to help you on your journey.

Face strong enemies and mighty bosses protecting their treasure. Unlock new areas as you progress and become faster, stronger, and more skilled. Whether you take your time exploring or rush forward at full speed, your capybara companions are always ready for adventure.

A cozy, exciting journey for all ages — explore, collect, and rise as the fastest capybara hero in Capybara Journey GO.

70010000105728.name: Snow Aces League
70010000105728.intro:
Ride Fast. Trick Hard. Stay Agile.
Alpine Domination!
70010000105728.description:
Snow Aces League is a high-speed, snowboard racing and freestyle game that throws you into the heart of a snow-covered adrenaline rush. Carve your path across multiple unique, extreme mountain locations, each packed with challenging slopes, freestyle parks, and breathtaking halfpipes.

Master grabs, flips, spins, grinds, and more - then chain them into slick combo sequences to rack up insane points. But don’t get too greedy. Land clean or eat snow—botched tricks will wipe you out hard.

Key Features:
★ Freestyle Mastery: Unlock and execute unique tricks with hundreds of combos. Use natural and man-made features—rails, boxes, jumps, logs, and more—to pull off the craziest stunts.
★ Halfpipe Heaven: Conquer some of the world’s longest halfpipes and chain tricks down the full length to maximize your score.
★ Massive Mountains: Plunge into an exhilarating adventure as you race and freestyle through breathtaking, handcrafted landscapes—each bursting with dynamic terrain and heart-pounding downhill speed.
★ Challenges: Great varieties of tackle timed trick, course goals, collectible hunts, and big air events. No two runs feel the same.
★ Bootcamp: Train, explore, and uncover secrets at your own pace. Perfect your moves and prepare for real competition.
★ Progression Tree: Gain XP, Rank up, complete objectives, unlock new tracks, and upgrade your snowboarder’s attributes to boost speed, air control, trick performance, and more.
★ Gear Customization: Personalize your snow gear and upgrade your boards for better handling, speed, and style.
★ Easy Learning Curve: Follow an in-game tutorial and progress naturally as you learn to combine speed, skill, and creativity to dominate the leaderboard.
★ Leaderboard: Climb your way to the top of the global rankings and show the world who is the real Snow Ace!

This isn’t just a snowboarding game - it’s the ultimate ride for freestyle lovers and speed cruisers. Whether you're here for tricks, races, or total mastery, Snow Aces League delivers a pure hit of snow-fueled actions and sensations.

70010000105732.name: Cross Pix 4
70010000105732.description:
Cross Pix 4 is a NEW NONOGRAM Logic Puzzle Game! where you follow number clues to solve a hidden image. It’s also known by other similar games like Griddlers, or Paint by Numbers.
Cross Pix 4 features ALL NEW 105 hand-crafted puzzles and intuitive gameplay with gradually increasing difficulty.
With simple and easy-to-understand rules, it's a game anyone can enjoy! A perfect choice for casual play, while still offering a satisfying mental challenge.
Cross Pix 4 delivers a relaxing and cozy puzzle experience that keeps your mind sharp and engaged.

Features:
★ Nintendo Switch™ online leaderboards for each mode (opt-out available).
★ 5 professionally composed background tracks.
★ Multi-language support.
★ Play with Joy-Con™, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller or touchscreen.
★ Quick-start help system – perfect for beginners!
★ Settings to adjust pointer speed, sound on/off, background music on/off.
★ Four sizes 5x5, 10x10, 15x15, 20x15 puzzle board, from easy to challenging.

Cross Pix 4 offers an immersive experience for puzzle lovers of all ages. 
Are you ready to take on the ultimate nonogram challenge and rise to the top of the world leaderboard? 

Note : Controller Mappings:
[A] Select/Mark
[B] Check board complete
[X] Toggle X or block marker
[Y] Centre puzzle board

70010000105735.name: Block Rush: Mega Obby
70010000105735.intro: Think you’ve got what it takes to conquer the ultimate parkour challenge?
70010000105735.description:
Your goal is simple: reach the end.
But don’t be fooled—this obby is designed to test precision, timing, and focus like never before.

Game Modes:
Normal Mode – Classic obby experience with checkpoints to help you along the way. Great for warming up or learning the course.

Hardcore Mode – No checkpoints. No second chances. Only pure skill. Make it all the way through and you’ll unlock a secret hidden level reserved for the bravest players.


Features:
>Stunning, colorful environments that keep you motivated as you race forward.
>Smooth, satisfying parkour mechanics built for flow and precision.
>A hidden reward for completing the ultimate challenge.
>Easy to pick up, tough to master – perfect for both casual players and hardcore obby fans.

Can You Beat Hardcore?

70010000105738.name: Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair
70010000105738.intro: It all starts with an empty jam jar...
70010000105738.description:
Defeat monsters? Check. Save Bulbhouse? Check. Family complete? Check.  
Everything seems to be just fine... But not for long!

When Grandparaffine sends Bulb Boy to venture into the eerie depths of the basement in a search of a precious jar full of delicious jam, it quickly turns out that this mission will not be as easy as it might seem. And by saying that we don't mean problems such as a missing key to the doors. We talk about navigating through the dark, shadowy corners of the cellar...

Oh, and about facing  sticky jelly creatures and their spine-tingling boss that wants Bulb Boy's head for his own. Yeah. 

Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair is the sequel to the hit and award-winning indie game that combines point & click adventure with horror game. The original visual style of the game is inspired by 90’s cartoons  and emphasizes the grotesqueness of the production, full of cute creatures and disgusting details, shown in close-ups. 

Solving tricky puzzles and facing jelly monsters will slowly unfold a twisted story full of unpredictable twists and turns. And all this accompanied by original music and mind-scratching sound effects!

- The original visual style inspired by 90's cartoons
- Lots of delicious jam and grotesque jelly monsters
- Close-ups showing disgusting details
- Full controller support
- Game perfect for Halloween and not just then!

70010000105747.name: Train Delux 2026 Kurakyu
70010000105747.intro: The ultimate freedom in railway driving — now more real than ever!  Stop wherever you like, skip where you want — your schedule, your rules. Build your own timetable!
70010000105747.description:
The acclaimed “Train Plus” series returns with its latest installment — now more deluxe than ever!  
♦ More buildings for a richer cityscape experience!  
♦ Create your own timetable and run trains exactly as you like!  
♦ The master controller (mascon) is now 14-level — enjoy realistic driving!  
♦ Compatible with “Densha de GO!! One-Handle Controller for Nintendo Switch™” and “ZuiKi Mascon for Nintendo Switch™” — take control like never before!  
♦ In-train announcements at every station — experience deluxe sound effects!  
♦ Enjoy free driving mode and auto-drive mode — choose your play style!  
♦ Use free camera to view your train from any angle!  
♦ No limits, no forced stops, no game over — just pure freedom in train operation! Perfect for railway game newcomers.  
♦ Sound the horn, play arrival announcements, trigger departure melodies — immerse yourself in realistic railway atmosphere!  

Drive the popular “Kurakyu Railway” trains used by a YouTuber with over 60,000 subscribers! Explore original maps and chase your railway dreams.  

Experience a new dimension in railway simulation — dive in now!  

*This work has no ties to any real railway company.

70010000105752.name: Cats vs Dogs
70010000105752.intro: Run, jump, and claw your way to victory in the ultimate battle of cats vs dogs
70010000105752.description:
Pick your side and leap into an epic battle of paws and claws.

In Cats vs Dogs, you play as a fearless feline on a mission to collect as much milk as possible while racing through vibrant platforming worlds. Jump, dash, and climb across challenging stages filled with obstacles and dangerous dogs determined to chase you down.

Collect milk bottles to unlock powerful power-ups and special abilities that help you run farther, reach new areas, and survive longer. From sunny backyards to city rooftops and mysterious forests, each world offers new scenery and challenges to master.

Do you have the skill and reflexes to outsmart the dogs and become the ultimate milk-collecting champion?

Features
- Choose your cat and explore multiple unique worlds
- Collect milk bottles to unlock special power-ups and abilities
- Outsmart and dodge dangerous dogs across every stage
- Fun, fast-paced platforming gameplay for all ages

Are you ready to prove that cats always land on their feet?

70010000105770.name: Another Eden Begins
70010000105770.intro: Now begins an RPG beyond time and space
70010000105770.description:
A time-traveling RPG adventure from Masato Kato, creator of countless classic RPGs
Product Summary
Aldo embarks on an adventure beyond time and space to save his sister, Feinne, from the clutches of the beastfolk.

A richly woven tale by scenario writer and director, Masato Kato, unfolds across the ages, alongside a main theme composed by Yasunori Mitsuda, music incorporating traditional folk instruments and an orchestra by Procyon Studios, and a stellar voice cast.

The strategic command battles, which feature exhilarating actions like chain skills that trigger successive strikes, and Another Force that allows a barrage of attacks, can be fought with original parties composed from a total of 19 characters.

After clearing the main story, New Game+ offers a new adventure filled with new faces and over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆Strategic Command Battles
The lands of Another Eden are rife with monsters—run into them to initiate a command-based battle and take them down.
Create your own original parties, unleash chain skills, and create chains to trigger successive strikes!
Unleash a flurry of attacks with Another Force to beat your enemy into submission!

◆Befriend and Forge Meaningful Bonds with 18 Allies
18 allies of different races and eras await Aldo on his journey.
Allies' stories are told through various quests. Encounter quests depict their first meeting with Aldo, character quests reveal their past and purpose, and kinship quests explore their relationship with Aldo.

◆Embark on a New Adventure with New Game+
Complete the main story to unlock New Game+ and embark on a new adventure with your allies as they are!
New Game+ also introduces a brand-new character, Ramiu, and features over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆New Features to Enrich Your Time-Traveling Adventure
Enrich your adventure beyond time and space by logging the feline friends you encounter in the cat catalog, and creating weapons, armor, and food from different eras with the crafting feature.

70010000105801.name: Dunk Trickster
70010000105801.intro: This is what real street basketball is all about
70010000105801.description:
Let's play a game. A real game. On the real streets. The rule is simple - score.    

You can't even imagine where streetball can be played. Discover all the locations for your best shot. Want to play at the airport? This is easy! Jump on the planes like it's your playground. Or do you want to break through the glass before the dunk? You can do it here!        

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Play the real streetball in your own way!

70010000105806.name: Nightmare: The Lunatic
70010000105806.intro: Within a dream, death is a mere triviality.
70010000105806.description:
Nightmare: The Lunatic is a roguelite action RPG depicting the struggle of escaping a never-ending nightmare.

You have been trapped in a perpetual nightmare.
To escape this hair-raising hamster wheel you’re stuck on, you must explore the dream to reach its end.

With the dream merchant who got pulled into the nightmare with you, leap into battle to forge your way toward the source of this horrid dream.

Nightmare: The Lunatic is a roguelite action RPG depicting the struggle of escaping a never-ending nightmare.

You have been trapped in a perpetual nightmare.
To escape this hair-raising hamster wheel you’re stuck on, you must explore the dream to reach its end.

With the dream merchant who got pulled into the nightmare with you, leap into battle to forge your way toward the source of this horrid dream.

▶ SWIFT, STYLISH BATTLES
Use the actions at your disposal, such as dash, dodge, and parry, to avoid the attacks of powerful monsters strutting through the dream and fight back against them.

▶ INTENSE BOSS BATTLES
Smash through the bosses that guard each region in order to find clues for how to escape.
Fierce opponents with an arsenal of flashy attacks are waiting for you.

▶ CUSTOM WEAPON COMBINATIONS
Select up to three weapons to bring with you, and swap between them depending on the situation.
Find a weapon combination based on preferences or efficiency.

▶ ROGUELITE
The layouts of the dungeons change with every playthrough, giving a fresh new feel to each adventure you embark on.
When you get a game over, it's right back to the beginning again.

▶ RPG ELEMENTS STRENGTHEN
With each adventure, players will unlock new contracts and abilities, allowing them to create their own character builds and strengthen their basic skills.

70010000105808.name: Dunk Trickster 2
70010000105808.intro: The streets are calling us again! It's time to play!
70010000105808.description:
Let's play a game again. The game you already know. Still on the real streets. The rule is the same - score.    

New areas where the streetball can be played. Discover new locations your best game. Old areas and new aread - all is here to bring you the maximum joy. Sometimes it's not easy, but it's always fun! Jump, rotate, dunk, score. Repeat. Beat all the records in the game. Set your own level of supremacy!         

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Keep playing the streetball in your own way!

70010000105823.name: Smith & Dungeon: Crafting the Legendary Weapons
70010000105823.intro: "Smith and Dungeon" is a hack-and-slash roguelite where you play a blacksmith exploring dungeons, fighting monsters, and forging powerful weapons.
70010000105823.description:
■ Story

The kingdom announced a grand reward for anyone who could craft a powerful weapon worthy of equipping the hero and their companions on their mission to defeat the Demon King. Only weapons approved by the king would be rewarded.

Upon hearing this, a young blacksmith, dreaming of fame and fortune, resolved to create the ultimate weapon.

"I want to craft a weapon capable of defeating the Demon King with my own hands!"

To achieve this, he set out to explore dangerous dungeons under the Demon King's control, searching for rare materials to forge a weapon so powerful that it would prove its worth to the king.

Thus, his perilous journey into the dungeons began!

■ Craft a Variety of Weapons and Armor Using Gathered Materials!

Harness rare materials collected in dungeons to showcase your skills as a blacksmith! Craft weapons like swords, spears, and bows, as well as armor, helmets, shields, and rings. Equip your crafted gear to enhance the protagonist and prepare for epic adventures!

■ Dynamic Dungeons That Change Every Time You Play!

Experience the thrill of roguelite gameplay with dungeons that generate random layouts, monster spawns, and treasure chest locations every time you enter. No two runs are ever the same!

■ Recruit Adventurers from the Guild to Form a Party!

Visit the town guild to enlist warriors, archers, mages, and other adventurers with diverse abilities. Assemble a party of up to two companions to join you in gathering materials. Team up with skilled adventurers to battle monsters and collect rare materials in the dungeon!

■ Enhance Abilities to Help Your Hero Grow!

Develop your hero by upgrading abilities that boost parameters or unlock new crafting skills. Strengthen your character and master the art of crafting weapons and armor!

■ Change Your Avatar with Equipped Gear!

Equipping weapons and armor changes your protagonist's avatar, allowing for full customization. Create your unique hero for every adventure!

70010000105828.name: BROK: The Brawl Bar
70010000105828.intro: A wild party beat 'em up with crazy challenges!
70010000105828.description:
Brok, a former boxer turned detective, stumbles upon an underground bar hidden deep in the Slums. Old instincts kick in, and he jumps headfirst to prove he’s still top dog! (or...gator.)

Solo or with a friend in co-op, take on creative challenges inspired by "Event matches" of platform fighters, taken to the next level with original addictive mechanics and variety. In this gritty-yet-humorous bar, meet unforgettable characters and uncover surprises around every corner as the story unfolds.

- 60+ varied challenges, with unique mechanics
- 6 playable characters, each offering distinct abilities
- Local co-op for up to 4 players
- Creator mode: Build your own challenges
- Additional modes: Survival, Versus, Support, Daily and Bonus Challenges
- Multiple difficulty levels
- In-game achievements to unlock
- Text localized in 12 languages.

This game is part of the BROK the InvestiGator universe.

70010000105833.name: Spartan Frontline
70010000105833.intro: Rally your Spartans and prove your skill on the battlefield.
70010000105833.description:
Command 8 unique Spartan heroes, build your ultimate army, and lead them into glorious battles to secure victory for your empire!

Plan your attack carefully and deploy your heroes with precision to crush the enemy forces. Each hero comes with special abilities you can train and upgrade, unlocking powerful new combat skills to overcome the toughest foes. 

Whether you're a seasoned tactician or a newcomer to the genre, you'll find plenty of depth and challenge to keep you coming back. 

Key Features: 
- Easy to pick up, but hard to master.
– Every battle requires careful planning and smart positioning. 
- Train and upgrade 8 different Spartan heroes, each with unique combat skills. 
- Defend your empire against relentless Persian invaders in epic, strategic battles. 
- Visuals and audio bring ancient warfare to life.

70010000105838.name: Ghostly Whiskers
70010000105838.intro: Two fearless cats on a cozy, spooky adventure.
70010000105838.description:
Your beloved human has vanished into the night. As a pair of courageous cats, you’ll follow their scent to an abandoned mansion shrouded in fog and mystery. But this is no ordinary house — it’s alive with whispers, shadows, and secrets from the past.

Ghostly Whiskers is a short but unforgettable co-op (or solo) adventure that blends light horror with heartwarming moments. Solve puzzles, explore eerie rooms, and use your feline instincts — like squeezing through tight spaces, climbing ledges, and sniffing out hidden clues — to uncover the truth.

- Use your flashlight to reveal secrets in the dark
- Sniff out trails and memory fragments
- Explore a hand-crafted haunted mansion full of cozy, eerie charm
- Play solo or with a friend in split-screen co-op

Check out this fun new game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team.

In the end, it’s not just about chasing ghosts — it’s about finding your friend… and bringing them home.

70010000105843.name: Two Hands Hospital Assistant Simulator
70010000105843.intro: Hurry up, medic! Your help is needed!
70010000105843.description:
Try your hand at being a lifesaver. Check the hospital life from the inside. Face the tough situations and help people. Feel the rush of the sleepless duty. 

Meet the ambulance and carefully unload the sick. Give first aid immediately if needed. Quickly and carefully escort patients to the ward or to the doctor. You may have to go straight to the operating theatre, so lives may depend on your decisions. 

Respond quickly to emergencies and help the doctors. Patients' lives depend on your speed and experience. All first aid is up to you. 

Learn different procedures and use the necessary medical equipment to keep patients safe. Much depends on your decisions. 

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

You can save lives!

70010000105851.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000105851.intro: Ascend to the peak of a haunted land, enhanced for Nintendo Switch™ 2.
70010000105851.description:
Hollow Knight: Silksong is the epic sequel to Hollow Knight, the award winning action-adventure. Journey to all-new lands, discover new powers, battle vast hordes of bugs and beasts and uncover secrets tied to your nature and your past.

Game Features
• Discover the fallen insect kingdom of Pharloom! Explore mossy grottos, gilded cities and misted moors as you ascend to the shining citadel at the top of the world.
• Engage in lethal acrobatic action! Wield a huge suite of deadly moves as you dance between foes in swift, beautiful combat.
• Craft powerful tools! Master an ever-expanding arsenal of weapons, traps, and mechanisms to vanquish your enemies and explore new heights.
• Solve shocking quests! Hunt down rare beasts and solve ancient mysteries to grant the wishes of the downtrodden and restore the kingdom’s hope.
• Face over 200 ferocious foes! Beasts and hunters, monsters and knights. Defeat them all with bravery and skill!
• Vanquish over 40 legendary bosses! Battle fabled heroes and fallen kings in epic combat to decide the kingdom's fate.
• Challenge Steel Soul mode! Once you conquer the kingdom, test your skills in a new mode that presents a more formidable challenge.
• Experience a stunning orchestral score! Hollow Knight’s award-winning composer, Christopher Larkin, brings melancholy melodies, symphonic strings and heart-thumping, soul strumming boss themes to the adventure.

70010000105856.name: Lia: Hacking Destiny
70010000105856.intro: Fight, hack, and survive in a world overrun by hostile machines, where each incursion is a race against death. Lia: Hacking Destiny is a fast-paced action roguelite with intense combat
70010000105856.description:
Dynamic Combat
Dodge attacks, slide along walls, and combine weapons and abilities to crush enemies in adrenaline-filled battles.

Procedurally Generated Maps
Each run is unique. Security complexes change every time, with procedurally generated rooms, traps, and enemies. Learn, adapt, and push further.

Constant Evolution
Upgrade your weapons, unlock abilities, modify equipment, and personalize your playstyle. From aggressive builds to tactical strategies. The power is in your hands.

Hack the System
Use technology to your advantage. Modify alert levels to access secret rooms and uncover hidden secrets behind walls of concrete and steel.

Fluid combat with responsive controls

Roguelite systems with ever-changing maps

Customizable skills and weapons

Base with NPCs and permanent upgrades

Vibrant visual style with a post-apocalyptic atmosphere

70010000105875.name: Final Frontier Story
70010000105875.intro: Dodge lasers and explore! Planetary Development Simulation
70010000105875.description:
Build your very own warm and friendly intergalactic city in the cold vacuum of space!
 Expect close encounters of the third, fourth, and maybe even fifth kind!
 
 Aim to become the most desirable city in the galaxy by developing land so you can build shops and bases for your residents to live in comfort.
 Build Convenience Stores and Parks to make daily life easier, or Takoyaki Stalls and Cinemas to bring in tourists and keep people entertained.
 Find the perfect combination of facilities to astronomically boost the city's charm.
 
 As you explore your new world, you'll encounter all kinds of monsters native to the planet.
 Stay one step ahead of them by upgrading your Fighter Aircraft and training up your pilots.
 And who knows, maybe you'll even make a few new friends along the way!
 With the help of your newfound alien friends, hold outdoor events to bring in tourists from all over the galaxy!
 
 Utilize a state-of-the-art autopilot system to help you fight through grueling space battles.
 You can also give orders to your pilots to guide them to glorious victory.
 
 So, do you think you have what it takes to build the best city in the entire galaxy?
 Jump in the pilot's seat and begin your adventure into the unknown to find out!

70010000105881.name: Peek a Rabbit!
70010000105881.intro:
Where’s That Bunny Hiding?
A Cute and Easy Brain-Training Picture Hunt Game
70010000105881.description:
This game lets you train your brain while enjoying adorable bunny illustrations.
Your task is to find the designated bunny hidden in the picture within the time limit.

How to Play:
・Carefully check the image of the bunny you need to find
・Look for that bunny in the scene
・When you find it, tap it before time runs out!

Some bunnies may seem easy to find at first glance…
but the time limit adds an unexpected challenge!

If you ever get stuck, don’t worry—
the hint button will gently guide you by pointing out the general area.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000105892.name: HEART of CROWN
70010000105892.intro: With the emperor suddenly falling ill, the battle for succession begins. Build your deck and lead your favored princess to the throne!
70010000105892.description:
Support your chosen princess.
The legendary deck-building game of royal succession is back!

Expand your territory, earn the backing of influential figures, and seize victory in the battle for the throne!

Heart of Crown Online is the Digital Adaptation of the beloved deck-building card game, Heart of Crown.

■Game Overview
Compete to enthrone your princess before anyone else in this 4-player, turn-based deck-building card game.
Use the wealth generated from your territories to purchase new lands and powerful action cards that will help you gain the advantage!

Once your preparations are complete, it's time to back your princess! 
Each princess comes with her own powerful abilities and since only one player can support each princess, you'll have to make your move quickly!

Recruit influential figures such as, Senators and Noble Dukes, and once your Succession Score reaches 20, it's coronation time and the throne and victory are yours!

Online cross-play is supported, with both ranked and custom matches available!

A fully voiced Story Mode is also included, offering a complete single-player experience in addition to multiplayer battles.

■Story
In an age where swords and sorcery still ruled the world, a mighty empire unified the continent and ended generations of conflicted. 
However, before long-lasting peace could set in, the great emperor fell ill and passed away without naming a successor.

Chaos begins to swell... As one of the empire's leading influential figures and it falls onto you to secure the throne and preserve peace across the land.
The emperor left no sons, but seven promising candidates remain, led by his two direct-bloodline princesses.

Choose the princess you support, rally your forces, and lead her to the imperial throne!

■ Voice Cast
Lulunasaika: Kaori Nazuka
Bergamotte: Atsuki Nakamura
Flammaria: Seiko Yoshida
Ohka: Ayaka Fujimoto
Laolily: Natsumi Haruse
Klam-Klam: Non Harusaki
Lain: Reina Kawamura
Shion: Nao Ojika

70010000105899.name: Simogo Legacy Collection - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000105899.description:
From cute arcade novelties to innovative text-based thrillers and acclaimed fourth wall-breaking stories, Simogo Legacy Collection is an eclectic celebration of Simogo's past, featuring faithful renditions of seven games released on mobile platforms between 2010 and 2015.

• Kosmo Spin
• Bumpy Road
• Beat Sneak Bandit
• Year Walk (+ Year Walk Companion)
• DEVICE 6
• The Sailor’s Dream
• SPL-T

Additionally, Simogo Legacy Collection features bonus content with thoughtfully curated curios from Simogo's wide-ranging history.

• Year Walk Bedtime Stories for Awful Children – E-book
• The Lighthouse Painting – Audio drama Podcast
• Music – Tracks from Simogo’s history, including previously unreleased tracks
• Images – Illustrations from Simogo’s archive
• Year Walk Prototype – Playable prototype
• Bumpy Road Prototype – Playable prototype
• Rollovski Prototype – Playable prototype
• The Sensational December Machine – Playable short story

Requires understanding of written and spoken English to be fully enjoyed.

70010000105903.name: Cats Visiting El Dorado
70010000105903.intro: Discover El Dorado’s golden wonders while finding hidden cats in relaxing, hand-drawn scenes.
70010000105903.description:
Step into the legendary city of El Dorado in this cozy hidden object game, where playful cats are waiting to be found among golden temples, ancient treasures, and lush jungles.

Your goal is simple: carefully explore each beautifully illustrated scene and uncover every cat hiding within. For an extra challenge, each map also hides 3 rare cats that only the most observant explorers will discover.

With no timers or pressure, Cats Visiting El Dorado offers a relaxing experience perfect for unwinding at your own pace. Whether you’re here for the joy of finding every cat or the charm of the El Dorado theme, this adventure is all about cozy fun and exploration.

70010000105913.name: Beam Car Crash: Drive Simulator 2025
70010000105913.intro: Welcome back to Beam Car Crash! Show everyone that speed is your middle name!
70010000105913.description:
Get ready for the ultimate crash test experience! 

Step into a world where speed meets destruction. In Beam Car Crash: Drive Simulator 2025, your mission is simple: conquer insane ramps, survive brutal obstacles, and prove your driving skills against the clock.

Key Features:

Realistic car crash physics – every hit and smash feels epic.

Thrilling skill-test ramps and time challenges.

Extreme obstacle courses designed to push you to the limit.

Offline single-player mode – no internet required, pure action anywhere.

Drive, crash, and master the art of speed and control.

Do you have what it takes to beat the clock and dominate the ramps? Prove that you’re not just a driver, but a crash master!

70010000105921.name: Trials Of Randoom
70010000105921.description:
Take the Challenge
Deivy made a pact with Randoom, he would be his toy and go through all of Randoom's challenges in exchange for having anything he wanted after it was over. Now Deivy has been turned into a chess piece and is trapped in Randoom's mansion, a dangerous place full of challenges.

What is Trials of Randoom?
Trials of Randoom is a precision platformer with puzzle elements, featuring Deivy and his terrifying situation in search of freedom and salvation.


Who is Deivy?
Deivy was once an ordinary human. Too common. He became a pawn to participate in Random's challenges, as he was so desperate that he would do absolutely anything to achieve his goal, even making a pact with a demon.


The Mighty Random
Random is what some call the crossroads demon, but this crossroads story is just a popular myth, as he can show himself anywhere. It appears when someone is in a completely hopeless situation. When a person is so hopeless and ready to accept anything, that's when he offers his deals. He makes fun of people in exchange for helping them with their problems.



The Mansion
The mansion, in which Deivy is imprisoned, is special. Deivy's movements are limited by the powers of the mansion, making every challenge even more difficult!

The challenges in the mansion are very diverse. Will Deivy make it through them all?!

70010000105926.name: Blazblue Entropy Effect X
70010000105926.description:
[Game Overview]  
A roguelite action game set in the BLAZBLUE universe, featuring striking 2D visuals, stylish, fast-paced combat, and precise, responsive controls.
Command a line-up of unique characters from the renowned BLAZBLUE franchise and dive into an unparalleled action experience.
[Story]
At a mysterious domain, known as “the Lab”, a group of elite researchers race to save a collapsing word; however, despite their efforts to date, Dr. Mercurius, head of the laboratory, still warns the world’s downfall is near.
In a last-ditch effort, the urgent *Research of Possibility* initiative seeks to collect *Shards of Possibility*—a special fragment of the world that could forestall the seemingly inevitable destruction.
These shards lie within the *Sea of Possibility*, a realm between worlds, beyond the bounds of reality.
Our protagonist, *Ace*, is the only being capable of diving into this sea.  
Guided by the elite researchers at *the Lab*, Ace descends again and again in pursuit of salvation—until strange visions take hold and his body begins to change.
As Ace continues to dive, countless memories flood his mind, and the truth behind the collapsing world—and the research itself—begins to surface....
“……The Power of Azure.”

70010000105937.name: Square Brain Puzzle
70010000105937.intro:
The more you think, the better it feels!
Easy to play, deep enough to get hooked
70010000105937.description:
A simple yet deep puzzle game where you divide the board into square and rectangular blocks, using the numbers as clues.

Each number on the board shows the size of the block that contains it. Use the numbers as hints to neatly partition the whole board.

This game has four difficulty levels you can choose to match your pace.

●EASY — A 3×3 board. A beginner-friendly stage that's easy to grasp even on your first play. Learn the rules and pick up the knack little by little.

●NORMAL — A 5×5 board. Recommended for players who want a nicely balanced challenge. Enjoy the fun of thinking and the satisfaction of solving.

●HARD — A 7×7 board. The difficulty rises with more moments that call for deeper thought. For players who like to take their time, it tests your observation and logic.

●MAX — A 9×9 board. A high-difficulty mode with a large board and complex layouts. Put your inspiration and concentration to full use in these truly rewarding puzzles.

Each difficulty holds 50 puzzles, for 200 in total. The rules are simple, but the more you play, the more the thinking-focused fun opens up.

Controls are intuitive and easy to grasp, with both button and touchscreen support, so you can play comfortably even in short bursts. Perfect for a quick refresh in spare moments or a daily brain workout.

A great pick for anyone after a puzzle game to really think through, or for adults who want to enjoy a brain-training game.

70010000105953.name: Saving Princess Of Mars
70010000105953.intro: Saving Princess of Mars is an stylish action platformer featuring puzzles to solve and ton of enemies to eliminate.
70010000105953.description:
Our main protagonist is lumberjack Jack from Earth who surprisingly spawns on Mars where he's trying to save its princess.

Hand-Crafted levels: Each level is uniquely designed for countless methods of completion. Defeat strange Martian enemies using spontaneous approaches and eliminate them on your way to freedom.

Exceptional combat: Adapt to chaos with style: stomp enemies like you're squashing grapes at a festival, deliver kicks that would make a martial arts movie jealous, and turn every encounter into a slapstick ballet of traps and tumbles. No bullets, no mercy—just airborne justice and foot-powered fury.

Multiple controllable characters: You will be able to switch between different characters during the gameplay. All controllable characters have different abilities, but of course – our main hero is the strongest!

Unconventional Storytelling: A mysterious tale unfolds through cinematic sequences — like a movie that forgot it was a game, took a wrong turn at plot twist junction, and crash-landed into a finale so unexpected it might just file a complaint with reality itself.

Are you ready to help Jack save the Princess of Mars... and maybe the entire planet of Mars?

Game features:

- strange Martian enemies
- 4 playable characters
- 7 engaging large platformer levels
- up to 4 hours of gameplay
- unlockable Hard difficulty
- 42 in game achievements
- humoristic comments from characters during conversations

70010000105957.name: KAMITSUBAKI ACADEMY NEWSPAPER CLUB
70010000105957.intro: There, you meet a girl named Kafu Morisaki, and begin participating at the Kamitsubaki Academy Newspaper Club at her invitation.
70010000105957.description:
You wake up with amnesia in Kamitsubaki City, a city with a giant tower in its center.

There, you meet a girl named Kafu Morisaki, and begin participating at the Kamitsubaki Academy Newspaper Club at her invitation.
