You will deepen your bonds with Kafu and the other club members through school life and your investigations of the city.

▼Introduction
"Kamitsubaki Academy Newspaper Club" is an urban investigation school adventure game where you look into Kamitsubaki City's rumors and secrets with the members of the club.

The game is divided into two modes: "Story parts" where you hang out with the members at school, and "investigation parts" where you explore and investigate Kamitsubaki City.

*This game shares part of its setting and lore with the "Kamitsubaki City" series.

However, the story here is standalone, you can enjoy this game without having experienced any of the other works.

▼Story Parts
Segments where you read through the story via interactions with your fellow newspaper club members.

The story begins with you waking up in Kamitsubaki City with amnesia.

You then meet with the girls and go to school at Kamitsubaki Academy while searching for clues to recovering your memories.

You can advance to story parts by investigating in investigation parts and acquiring items.

▼Investigation Parts
Segments where you explore Kamitsubaki City with the newspaper club members and look into rumors and investigation requests.

You can progress with your investigations little by little by walking around the city and encountering events occuring in all sorts of locations.

At these events, you make "investigation conclusions" based on five parameters: "Movement," "Wisdom," "Insight," "Mystery," and "Luck."

You can improve your parameters by gathering Items and Perks.

▼Fellow Newspaper Club Members
Kafu Morisaki
Rime Tanioki
Haru Asanushi
Sekai Yorukawa
Koko Rinne

70010000105998.name: Tune My Car - Tuning Studio & Mechanic Simulator 2026
70010000105998.intro: Are you ready to create the car of your dreams?
70010000105998.description:
In Tune My Car: Tuning Studio & Mechanic Simulator 2026, every bolt you tighten and every upgrade you install takes you one step closer to becoming the ultimate master of automotive customization. Start your journey with a modest budget from your first story missions, build your collection one car at a time, and transform stock machines into high-performance masterpieces.

From aggressive body kits and thunderous V8 engines to precision-tuned suspensions and flawless custom paint jobs, every choice you make directly shapes your car’s style, handling, and raw power. Work hands-on in your fully equipped garage, switch freely between first-person and third-person views, and take your creations to the test track to feel the difference under your fingertips.

Key Features:
	•	Story-Driven Career – Complete missions to unlock new cars, upgrades, and opportunities.
	•	Full Vehicle Customization – Modify body parts, swap engines, fine-tune suspensions, and repaint with total freedom.
	•	Performance That Matters – Every upgrade changes acceleration, top speed, handling, and nitro performance.
	•	Free Tuning Mode – Experiment with any unlocked vehicle without mission constraints.
	•	Immersive Garage – Interact with every tool, part, and station in first or third person.
	•	Test & Perfect – Push your builds to the limit on a dedicated track before taking them to the streets.

Your garage. Your vision. Your legend.

70010000106007.name: SNIPER WARRIOR ELITE
70010000106007.intro: Precision, patience, and deadly accuracy in every shot.
70010000106007.description:
Step into the boots of the ultimate marksman in Sniper Warrior Elite, the most realistic modern warfare sniping experience yet. As a highly skilled assassin, you’ll take on dangerous missions across vast, open-ended maps that demand more than just a steady aim—they demand tactical genius, patience, and precision.

Features:
• Immersive Campaign: Dive into a gripping single-player story, where every shot counts and every decision matters.
• Massive Open Maps: Explore sprawling, detailed environments designed to test your strategic planning and adaptability.
• Customizable Arsenal: Choose your weapons carefully, upgrade and modify them to fit your style, and manage your inventory by purchasing ammo and new gear to stay prepared for every mission.
• Unmatched Realism: Feel the thrill of long-distance sniping with lifelike ballistics, weather effects, and weapon mechanics.
• Tactical Gameplay: Use stealth and cunning to infiltrate enemy lines, eliminating high-value targets with deadly accuracy.

Whether you’re silently stalking through dense forests, navigating war-torn cities, or holding your breath for that impossible shot, Sniper Warrior Elite offers an unparalleled sniping experience. Are you ready to prove yourself as the ultimate assassin? 
The mission begins now.

70010000106012.name: Tattoo Studio Simulator
70010000106012.description:
Tattoo Studio Simulator – Build Your Own Tattoo Studio!

Are you passionate about tattoo art? Ready to run your own studio? Tattoo Simulator brings the thrill of tattooing and the challenge of managing a business together – exclusively on Nintendo Switch™!

Realistic Tattoo Experience

Listen to your clients, design the tattoos they want, and create unique works of art in different styles. Every customer is different, and every design showcases your creativity.

Manage, Expand, and Upgrade Your Shop

Open your shop daily, welcome customers, and grow your income

Buy cleaning supplies, tattoo needles, and aftercare products

Boost customer satisfaction by offering drinks and extra services

Use your earnings to upgrade your equipment and expand your studio!

Simulation + Creativity = Addictive Gameplay

Tattoo Simulator perfectly blends tattoo artistry with business simulation. You're both the artist and the entrepreneur!

Features:

Realistic tattooing mechanics

Unique clients and customizable designs

Studio upgrades and resource management

In-store item sales and customer care

Daily tasks and business routines

Ready to build your tattoo empire?
Tattoo Simulator lets you dive into the world of ink, unleash your art, and rise to the top!

70010000106014.name: Car Crash Simulator: Demolition Derby Madness
70010000106014.intro:
Race fast, jump high, and crash harder than ever.
Turn chaos into fun with every wild stunt.
Master the ramps, rule the derby, and enjoy the ride!
70010000106014.description:
Buckle up for the ultimate test of speed, destruction, and control!
Car Crash Simulator brings high-octane action to your console — combining explosive crashes, wild ramp jumps, and intense demolition battles.

Take the wheel in multiple game modes:
Derby Mode — Smash into rival cars, send them flying, and rack up points with every impact.
Ramp Mode — Launch off giant ramps, perform insane stunts, and chase the biggest jumps.

Every crash counts! Upgrade your car’s speed, durability, and handling, pushing your vehicle to new limits. Whether you’re slamming into opponents or soaring through the air, every run is packed with adrenaline and chaos.
There are no limits to destruction — only your skill determines how far you’ll go. Ready to cause some damage?

70010000106021.name: Dunkirk - The Forgotten Soldier
70010000106021.intro: Survive the onslaught, rise from the ashes, and become the forgotten soldier history tried to erase.
70010000106021.description: Dunkirk - The Forgotten Soldier is an action rogue-lite set in a war zone. Each run puts the player against increasingly dangerous waves of enemies. With every new attempt, you must grow stronger and more skilled, using everything at your disposal to endure and push forward against the enemy’s rising force.

70010000106034.name: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter: Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000106034.intro: The legendary first chapter of the Trails Series
70010000106034.description:
The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky, a story-driven RPG that took off as the landmark first installment of the beloved Trails series, is receiving a full remake!

The Liberl Kingdom, where the adventure takes place, is brought to life in stunning 3D, with refined designs for all characters including the headstrong and charming Estelle and the cool-headed and mysterious Joshua.

Enjoy seamless transitions between two battle modes: field action and turn-based combat. The remake also features dynamic showcases of each character's special abilities (Crafts) and elemental magic (Arts), delivering exhilarating battle experiences.
While retaining the picturesque charm of Liberl, the game offers various quests and extensive side content, allowing players to immerse themselves in the journey through the kingdom from a fresh perspective.

Estelle and Joshua embark on a journey across the Liberl Kingdom, spurred by the mysterious disappearance of their father, Cassius.
Meet new allies, experience heartfelt farewells, and uncover the fate that awaits the two at the end of their journey...

70010000106035.name: Cat in the tomb
70010000106035.intro: Cat in the tomb - Challenge your reaction!
70010000106035.description:
A curious cat discovers a mysterious mask in an ancient tomb! After putting it on, it gains the superpower of climbing walls. Now, the adventure begins!

In this classic arcade game, challenge yourself through 99 meticulously designed levels and navigate a winding maze filled with traps and enemies. Use your speed and wits to guide your cat to avoid danger, collect rewards, and uncover the secrets of the ancient tomb.

Easy to play, but gradually challenging—can you help your cat complete this ultimate adventure?

Time is running out, so start climbing the walls now!

70010000106040.name: Blood: Refreshed Supply™
70010000106040.description:
Blood: Refreshed Supply™ follows Caleb, an undead gunslinger on a quest for revenge against his former demonic master, Tchernobog. Despite his once powerful position as a fearsome Cabal commander and one of Tchernobog’s “Chosen” few, Caleb and his fellow Chosen are betrayed by the dark god and slain for reasons unknown. Seeking answers and vengeance, Caleb rises from the grave to put a stop to Tchernobog and his murderous lieutenants once and for all.
 
Grab your Pitchfork and get ready to stab your way through 42 blood-soaked levels, while unlocking even more creative and effective implements of destruction along the way. Incinerate foes with weapons like the Flare Gun, Aerosol Can, and Napalm Launcher. Blast enemies straight to hell with bundles of dynamite, shoot them full of holes with the Tommy Gun and Sawed-Off Shotgun, or tap into darker methods of annihilation with the game’s powerful Voodoo Doll and Life Leech offerings.

Use your arsenal of weapons to survive Tchernobog’s evil Cabal of loyal Cultists, Fanatics, Zealots, and Acolytes, along with swarms of hellish creatures from ruthless Zombies and flying Gargoyles, to water-dwelling Gill Beasts, screaming Phantasms, and firebreathing Hell Hounds. 

Includes the original Blood along with the Plasma Pak and Cryptic Passage add-ons.

Blood: Refreshed Supply™ - Enhancements

    • Rebuilt from the original source code.
    • New Vault with dozens of playable cut-content levels, concept art, behind-the-scenes photos, and unused sprites.
    • Remastered Cutscenes.
    • Expanded options for improved enemy behavior, weather effects (a previously cut feature), and other enhancements.
    • Bug fixes for the original levels.
    • Includes new Marrow scenario (available at launch) and Death Wish scenario (planned future update)
    • High-resolution support, including 4K monitor
    • Customizable controller gamepad support
    • Rewritten netcode supporting up to 8 players
    • Local split-screen and online co-op
    • CD and MIDI music support

70010000106046.name: FLOWER SPINNER PUZZLE
70010000106046.intro:
Spin the pieces and peek into the world of flowers!
A mesmerizing floral art puzzle that you can't take your eyes off
70010000106046.description:
This is a puzzle game where you rotate panels to align flowers that are placed in random directions.

The controls are simple—just observe the image carefully and tap the panel you want to rotate!
Depending on how fast you clear the stage, you’ll earn 1 to 3 flowers.

A hint button becomes available over time and can be used up to three times.
It will automatically align one row of panels in the correct direction,
so you can relax even if you get stuck.

It’s simple yet surprisingly deep—
perfect for a quick and fun brain workout!
Try to earn 3 flowers on every stage!

70010000106057.name: Maxi Trucks Racing
70010000106057.intro: Big trucks. High speed. Pure asphalt.
70010000106057.description:
The engines are loud, the competition is fierce — welcome to Maxi Trucks Racing! Choose your truck and take on intense 5-truck races across a variety of fast, twisting asphalt tracks.

Each race pushes your reflexes and timing to the limit as you fight for position, execute daring overtakes, and race for victory.

Key Features:
-Choose from a lineup of powerful racing trucks
-Compete in 5-truck races packed with speed and action
-Master multiple asphalt tracks, each with unique layouts and challenges
-Fast, fun, and adrenaline-driven arcade racing

Step on the gas and prove you’re the true Maxi Trucks champion!

70010000106075.name: Dwarves: Glory, Death and Loot
70010000106075.intro: Lead a customizable dwarf legion in an auto-battle roguelike of glory, death & loot.
70010000106075.description:
Command a fearless band of dwarves in a roguelike auto-battler filled with chaos, strategy, and loot. Every run challenges your tactics as you recruit, equip, and position your squad against waves of enemies that grow stronger with every battle. Glory, death, and loot await those who dare to lead.

Build your legion of dwarves
Recruit and customize up to ten unique dwarves, each with their own class, stats, and abilities. Create powerful synergies by mixing tanks, assassins, healers, and mages. Every item and formation choice can decide victory or defeat.

Strategize before the battle begins
Your dwarves fight automatically, but the outcome depends on your preparation. Arrange your formation, manage your resources, and pick upgrades that complement your team’s strengths. The right setup is the difference between triumph and a total wipeout.

Gather gear and legendary loot
Collect weapons, armor, and accessories after every encounter. Upgrade your heroes, craft new builds, and experiment with combinations to discover deadly strategies.

Master the roguelike loop
Each run is a fresh challenge. Choose your rewards, face unpredictable enemies, and push deeper for greater treasures. Even failure brings progress as you unlock new dwarves, skills, and permanent upgrades.

Face growing threats
Battle orcs, trolls, dragons, and countless monsters across varied stages. Adapt to enemy types and evolve your strategy with each run.

Easy to play, hard to master
With one-tap controls and endless strategic depth, Dwarves: Glory & Loot is a game for players who love tactical thinking, build experimentation, and the thrill of progression.

Lead your dwarves to glory, embrace the chaos, and claim your loot.

70010000106080.name: USA ARMY SOLDIER SIMULATOR
70010000106080.description:
Step into the disciplined world of military basic training and experience what daily life is like as a new recruit. USA ARMY SOLDIER SIMULATOR puts you in the role of a trainee, where every day follows a strict schedule — from early wake-ups and inspections to training drills, evaluations, and evening roll calls.

Follow your daily routine, improve your performance, and earn higher ratings by completing tasks on time and staying focused under pressure. Manage your stamina during physical exercises, take care of your equipment, and keep everything clean and organized — because in basic training, every detail matters.

This is not just about action — it’s about discipline, structure, and proving you can handle the demands of military life.

Key Features:
 • Structured daily routine with clear objectives
 • Training activities including fitness, drills, and shooting practice
 • Performance rating system based on discipline and task completion
 • Equipment and inventory management
 • Base exploration with guided navigation between key locations
 • NPC interactions for instructions, tests, and evaluations

Train hard, stay sharp, follow orders, and prove you have what it takes to complete basic training.

70010000106085.name: Mech Arena Shooter Battle
70010000106085.intro: Not just a machine - a weapon with memory.
70010000106085.description:
Enter the world of Mech Arena Shooter Battle, a single-player roguelike where you pilot a war machine through procedurally generated arenas filled with deadly enemies, traps, and upgrades. Each battle tests your reflexes, tactics, and ability to adapt as you gather resources, upgrade your mech, and face powerful bosses.

The fate of a ruined world lies in your metal hands — every death is just the beginning of a new, stronger build. Experiment with different weapon combinations, defensive systems, and tactical modules to forge the ultimate war machine and uncover the mystery behind the world’s collapse.

Key Features:

- Procedurally generated arenas with unique layouts and enemy patterns
- Deep upgrade system - customize your mech with weapons, armor, and tactical modules
- Multiple weapon types: ballistic, energy, and melee systems
- Challenging boss encounters with unique combat mechanics
- Persistent meta-progression - unlock new mechs, weapons, and abilities after each run
- Diverse environments - from ruined cities to industrial and space complexes
- Atmospheric cyberpunk-post-apocalyptic visual style

Victory isn’t about survival — it’s about evolution. Adapt, upgrade, and dominate the battlefield in Mech Arena Shooter Battle.

70010000106090.name: Croc's Dynamite Blast
70010000106090.intro: Croc’s Dynamite Blast is an explosive arcade action game full of strategy, chaos, and fun! Join Croc and his friends in a fun game where dynamite is your best weapon!
70010000106090.description:
Choose between Croc, Baby Croc, Roodie or the clever Mole – each with their own charm, all ready to blast their way to victory. Fans of the beloved Croc’s World series will recognize these characters, but this time they’re leaving platforming behind for high-energy battles packed with dynamite, chain reactions, and endless surprises.

Features:
- Four Playable Heroes – Pick your favorite: Croc, Baby Croc, Roodie, or Mole.
- Explosive Action – Place dynamite, blow up walls, and trap your opponents in fast-paced matches.
- Dynamic Arenas – Every battlefield is destructible, forcing you to adapt your tactics on the fly.
- Hidden Power-Ups – Gain speed boosts, extend your blast radius, or unlock special tricks to gain the upper hand.
- Multiplayer Fun – Battle AI opponents, challenge friends for explosive showdowns or play online against worldwide players.

70010000106095.name: Neoteria
70010000106095.intro: A classic shoot-em up where you avoid waves and waves of enemies coming and shooting at you.
70010000106095.description:
Neoteria is a throw-back to the classic horizontal Shoot-em Up games (SHMUP!). With waves and waves of enemies coming at you all trying to take you down, you need quick reflexes to avoid collisions, shoot the enemy waves, and power-up your weapon!

Neoteria does add a few tiny modern spins to the classic arcade formula: Alternate paths to unlock hidden worlds and multiple difficulty modes (unlockable pilots).

This is NOT a Bullet Hell shooter!
A great throw back to the classic arcade SHMUP’s!

Game Features:
- Unlockable pilots and difficulty modes
- Boss fights
- Alternate paths and hidden worlds
- A unique power-up system for your weapon
- A thumping classic chiptune soundtrack

70010000106097.name: Meganoid: Chronicles
70010000106097.intro: Can you survive the 100 brutal platforming levels full of traps, bats, snakes, spikes and fire in this classic retro inspired platformer? And then play all 100 levels in reverse!
70010000106097.description:
Meganoid: Chronicles is a classic brutal platform game where you will not escape death! You will need to bring your best game skills to complete the short but challenging levels.

Each challenging level can be completed within a few seconds, making the pace of the game pretty fast, but the difficulty level ramps up swiftly and completing a level on the first try will be a rare event

Meganoid: Chronicles tells the story of the Meganoid family tree going all the way back to Grandpa’s time and is a throw back to the age of tomb raiding and lost civilizations.

Game Features
- Challenging platform action in short bite size levels.
- Colorful pixel-art retro graphics.
- A hundred levels in normal mode.
- Hidden treasure in every level.
- Amazing chiptune sound track

70010000106099.name: INC: The Beginning
70010000106099.intro: An 80's inspired, stylish pixel-art platformer with a thumping chip-tune sound track. Perfect for quick and short bites of gaming
70010000106099.description:
The year 2135, the world is ruled by AI Corporations, humans are slowly being replaced by robots and machines, and the most powerful humans are now looking for ways to transfer their souls into robots, for eternal life. Doctor Robotus is kidnapped in front of your eyes, can you become the savior?

Fight your way thru four stylish platforming worlds, surviving a large variation of different robots and machines that only have one mission, stop you from reaching your goal: saving Dr Robotus!

Level up your skills, become more powerful and stronger as you progress through the game. When you die you get “reset” and lose some of your skills. The less you die, the more powerful you will be to defeat the final boss!

Game Features
- Stylish minimalistic pixel art
- Story driven progression
- Boss battles
- Classic platformer with pre-designed levels
- Thumping unique chip-tune style sound track

70010000106101.name: Baseball Card Shop Simulator
70010000106101.intro: Collect, trade, dominate the market and outsmart the competition.
70010000106101.description:
Step into the exciting world of baseball card trading with Baseball Card Shop Simulator! Start with a small shop and transform it into the ultimate destination for collectors and enthusiasts. Whether you’re stocking up on the latest booster packs or hunting down rare gems for your personal collection, every decision counts in this thrilling business simulator.

Your Mission: Grow your card shop into a bustling hub where fans can trade, buy, and sell. Set prices, manage inventory, hire skilled staff, and organize epic tournaments to draw in more customers. The market is always changing, and you must outsmart the competition to become the go-to place for baseball card lovers!

Game Features:
• Shop Customization: Your store, your rules! Customize every corner of your card shop, from sleek shelving to eye-catching decor. Create the perfect atmosphere that will have customers lining up to get in!
• Inventory Management: Keep your shelves stocked with everything from common cards to rare collectibles. Balance supply and demand, and make sure you’re always prepared for the next big trend in the market.
• Pricing and Strategy: You’re the boss when it comes to setting prices! Adjust prices based on rarity, demand, or market conditions. Will you offer discounts to attract new buyers or hike up the prices of rare cards to maximize profits?
• Market Trends: The world of baseball cards is always shifting. Keep an eye on market fluctuations, predict which cards will skyrocket in value, and make smart investments to stay ahead of the game.

Do you have what it takes to turn your small card shop into a thriving business? Dive into the fast-paced world of baseball cards and build your empire today!

70010000106106.name: Doku Girls 2
70010000106106.intro: Train your mind, enjoy the process and discover new facets of pleasure in the world of Sudoku!
70010000106106.description:
Welcome to Doku Girls 2 – an exciting puzzle game that will help you develop your logic and attentiveness! For successfully completing levels, you will receive a special reward – charming images of beautiful girls. Immerse yourself in a relaxing atmosphere thanks to pleasant music and bright graphics.

Game features:
• Images of girls that are unlocked as you progress
• Unique, hand-made sudoku for any skill level
• Sensual music that creates an atmosphere of relaxation and pleasure

70010000106111.name: Chernobyl: Escape from Pripyat
70010000106111.intro: Survive the silent ruins where danger lurks in every shadow.
70010000106111.description:
that plunges you into a realm where fear and survival intertwine. You assume the role of a fearless investigative reporter, part of a specialized unit dispatched to document the unfolding horrors within the desolate ruins of Pripyat. However, your mission takes a sinister turn when your helicopter is brutally attacked by an enigmatic creature, leaving you as the sole survivor amidst the eerie aftermath.
In this relentless struggle for survival, you must navigate treacherous environments, battling grotesque mutants and hostile adversaries while unearthing the chilling secrets buried within Chernobyl's shadowy depths. Armed with your wits, firearms, and an array of melee weapons, you'll delve into abandoned buildings and hazardous territories, scavenging for crucial supplies and piecing together the fragmented truth.

Game Features:
	•	Immersive Horror Atmosphere: Prepare to be immersed in a chilling atmosphere enriched with unsettling sounds, nerve-wracking jump scares, and haunting soundtracks that amplify the tension.
	•	Dynamic Gameplay Mechanics: Master the art of interaction with the environment, from scavenging essential resources to manipulating environmental elements for tactical advantage.
	•	Survival Essentials: Manage hunger, thirst, and inventory meticulously as you navigate a realistic day-night cycle that dynamically influences gameplay.
	•	Narrative Depth: Engage with a compelling storyline driven by your quest to survive, uncover the mysteries of Chernobyl, and confront the horrors that lurk in its darkest corners.
	•	Combat Mastery: Enhance your combat prowess through precision aiming, strategic melee combat, and unexpected encounters that test your reflexes and resourcefulness.

Escape From Pripyat challenges you to confront your deepest fears, to unravel the enigma of Chernobyl's haunting legacy, and to emerge victorious from the abyss. Are you prepared to face the unknown, reporter? Your odyssey into darkness begins now.

70010000106116.name: Snapshot Girls 3
70010000106116.intro: Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and marvel at every detail of stunning photorealistic masterpieces!
70010000106116.description:
Welcome to Snapshot Girls 3, a sophisticated and relaxing puzzle game where each completed puzzle reveals a photorealistic image of charming heroines in sophisticated and stylish looks.

Immerse yourself in an atmosphere where each image looks like a real photograph, with soft skin tones, natural light, and tiny details that are impossible to miss. Realistic puzzle mechanics allow you to feel every detail, and each scene is filled with emotion, character, and history.

Game Features:

- Photorealistic high-resolution images created with maximum attention to detail

- Smooth and intuitive puzzle mechanics

- Atmospheric soundtrack that enhances immersion

- Gallery mode to revisit your favorite scenes

70010000106122.name: Royal Vermin
70010000106122.intro: Climb, throw and survive in a chaotic party game for 2 to 4 players!
70010000106122.description:
A chaotic local platform fighter where even the worst player can win.

In a world turned into a massive junkyard after humans disappeared, vermin have taken over. Rats, seagulls and other pests clash in an absurd monarchy for one thing only: to sit on the throne!

Royal Vermin is a 2 to 4 player local fighting game inspired by the best platform fighters, featuring ranged combat, chargeable projectiles and constantly unbalanced arenas. Every match is fast, unpredictable and always different.

KEY FEATURES
2 TO 4 PLAYER LOCAL GAME
Perfect for game nights with friends and same-screen play.

SIMPLE AND ACCESSIBLE CONTROLS
Easy to pick up, even for new players.

UNIQUE RANGED COMBAT
Grab projectiles, charge your shots and knock your opponents out of the level.

EVOLVING ARENAS
Levels collapse during combat and become increasingly dangerous.

REVENGE MODE
Even when eliminated, you can influence the match and cause spectacular comebacks.

HIGH REPLAYABILITY
Dynamic levels and special stages that break up the pace with varied objectives.

Free to play, Royal Vermin is designed to keep every match tight until the end and make you want to play just one more round.

70010000106127.name: Pin Strike
70010000106127.intro: You have never played bowling like this before.
70010000106127.description:
Bowling can be played not only in the hall and only on a straight track. And who says you can't use bombs or springs in the game?   

You can also knock down bottles, and it's a lot more fun. Find out how the game differs from classic bowling. Unlock new levels and you'll be surprised that not everything is as easy as it seems.    

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Each level has a solution - try to beat it in one shot!

70010000106132.name: Pin Strike 2
70010000106132.intro: You've played bowling like this before. Go for more!
70010000106132.description:
You already know, that bowling doesn't have to be played in a bowling alley on a straight track. You also discovered that you can use bombs or springs here.

Knock down more than just bottles! See what else you can do to have more fun. Find out how this game differs from classic bowling.

Check out the new levels — you might be surprised at how challenging they are!   

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Beat the new levels in one shot!

70010000106137.name: POLICE BORDER CONTRABAND PATROL SIMULATOR
70010000106137.intro: Patrol. Inspect. Intercept. Justice starts with you.
70010000106137.description:
POLICE BORDER CONTRABAND PATROL SIMULATOR is a tense border control simulator where every decision matters. Start as a rookie officer inspecting documents, uncovering smuggling attempts, and facing moral dilemmas in a world full of corruption and temptation.
Will you enforce the law or bend it for your gain? Climb the ranks, survive the pressure, and shape your fate across multiple possible endings.

Key Features:
	•	Advanced document and ID verification mechanics
	•	Contraband search in hidden areas of vehicles
	•	Direct interactions with drivers: interrogations, arrests, moral decisions
	•	Progression system with ranks that impact gameplay
	•	Black market mechanics and smuggling jobs
	•	Real consequences for mistakes and ethical choices
	•	Controller support and simple, intuitive control schemes

Available now. It’s time to take your place at the border—how far will you go?

70010000106161.name: LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW RePOP Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000106161.intro: The cute and sexy zombie hunter Juliet goes wild again on Nintendo Switch™ 2 !
70010000106161.description:
With over 1.5 million copies sold worldwide, the legendary zombie-hunting action game LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW finally returns in a remastered edition!

Using the nimble moves she mastered through cheerleading and wielding a massive chainsaw, Juliet slices through hordes of zombies in exhilarating action.
The Chain Hit Hunting system increases chainsaw attack speed as your combo count rises, and the newly added Chainsaw Blaster with auto-fire pushes the excitement even further!
With improved playability, dazzling visual effects that brighten the screen, and brand-new background music, there’s plenty to enjoy.

Enhanced graphics, a newly added difficulty mode, and many other quality improvements bring the game to a whole new level. This isn’t just a nostalgic revival—it’s a fully refined rebirth of Lollipop Chainsaw in every way!
Introducing LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW RePOP!

＜Story＞
Juliet attends the massive San Romero High School in the American West. She’s an ordinary high school girl who loves cheerleading more than anything.

Right now, she has two worries.
First, she’s gained some weight thanks to her favorite lollipop candy.
Second, she’s trying to figure out how to tell her new boyfriend Nick that she’s actually a zombie hunter.

And that’s a tough one… because zombie hunters send the undead to heaven for a living. Not exactly the kind of job a young lady casually talks about!

One morning, as Juliet pedals her bike in a rush—already running late to meet Nick—a horde of zombies suddenly appears before her.
As fate would have it, that day is also Juliet’s 18th birthday. Annoyed that her birthday has turned into the worst day ever, Juliet pulls a chainsaw from her bag and charges into the school, now overrun by zombies, in search of her beloved Nick!

70010000106166.name: Card-en-Ciel Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000106166.intro:
"Glitch" your way to victory!
A card-battling RPG adventure through the eras of gaming!
70010000106166.description:
Card-en-Ciel is a roguelite card-battling RPG featuring over 300 different cards and 50 unique vocal songs!

Play as Neon, the "Gaming Chair Detective" famous for solving net-crimes, as he encounters a strange new case when he dives into an in-development game world.

■Story
In the world of the "full-dive" VR game Rust Tactics, characters from other video games have started to appear, complete with wills of their own.
When a member of the dev team, Ancie, reaches out for help, "Gaming Chair Detective" Neon springs into action to solve the mystery in the digital world.
Venture through the games turned into dungeons, encounter heroes and heroines, make friends and save the gaming world!

"Time for a prismatic show!"

■Delve into roguelite virtual dungeons!
Card-en-Ciel features over 10 different dungeons, with each one featuring a different game world! You'll meet and collect different characters in each one while seeing the story unfold.

Each dungeon is its own roguelite experience, so you'll start with a basic deck and collect cards to build combos and synergies unique to that dungeon. The rules will even change if you choose a higher difficulty, keeping every dungeon dive fresh!

■Each card is its own character!
Card-en-Ciel includes over 300 different cards featuring characters from in-universe video games, each with their own personality.

Every card is fully voiced, from when you first earn it to when you use their special abilities in battle. They'll even react when you're doing well or in trouble, and talk to their friends and enemies while idle! The characters on your cards come alive thanks to the "Link Etude System" in Card-en-Ciel.

In addition to in-universe game characters, INTI CREATES game characters are also featured on cards!

■Powerful Muses offer their support with 50 unique songs!
Special cards featuring "Muse" characters will begin singing in battle when you meet their requirements, providing powerful effects on top of your normal card abilities.

■Enjoy the full-fledged story!
After clearing a dungeon, you'll gain access to 10 additional difficulty settings. These hard modes not only power up enemies, but add new rules that you might even be able to use to your advantage to take on the tougher foes.

In addition to the story mode, you can battle other players in real-time PVP, or challenge a daily dungeon to rank on the online leaderboards!

70010000106170.name: Dino Party Island
70010000106170.intro: A young dinosaur named Roar, who can't roar, lives crazy adventures at the Dino Party. Can he become the Rhythm King of the Valley?
70010000106170.description:
Rugui, the baby dinosaur who dances when he sneezes, arrives in the Chiflaurico Valley to prove that you don't need to roar loudly to shine. During the crazy Extreme DinoFiesta, he and his friends face incredible Jurassic challenges where creativity, laughter, and rhythm are more important than strength.

Because when Rugui sneezes... the breakdancing party begins!



What you'll find in this story:

·A unique and adorable dinosaur who doesn't roar, but dances like a champion!

·T-Rita, the T-Rex guitarist who makes mountains tremble with her chords.

·Chef Ceratops, the expert chef in Jurassic pizzas with impossible ingredients.

·PteroPepo, the pterodactyl who cheers from the sky with his crazy antics.



Fun and silly challenges, such as:

·The Great Roaring Karaoke, where Rugui turns his sneeze into a spectacle.

·The Grandparents' Tricycle Race, at full speed dressed as a grandma!

·The Runny Nose Jurassic Pizza, with recipes so strange that even volcanoes smell bad.

·And the Great Cretaceous Conga, the funniest parade in the entire valley.

·A colorful, fun, and rhythmic tale, perfect for little ones to discover that being different is what makes them special.

Because in the Valley, the heart dances louder than any roar!

70010000106172.name: Roots and sprouts
70010000106172.description:
Roots and sprouts is a garden game where the player will explore an island with different species of plants and trees. Each day you're uncovering this new environment and its history. You will gather some seeds from the vegetation and re-plant them close to each other to get hybrids. Day after day, you will cross-breed the plants to create some new ones, to finally find and restore the ultimate tree : Yggdrasil.
. Enjoy a short cozy game
. Explore a beautiful hand-drawn island
. Experiment with mysterious plants
. Gaming experience around 1h
Please note, due to its short playing experience and its production over 48 hours, the game does not offer a saving system.
Some sounds were produced by digifishmusic, klankbeeld, Noted451, DBS_Sounds, cupido-1 & jgrzinich and distributed by FreeSound.

70010000106174.name: Battle Pixel
70010000106174.intro: Survive intense firefights and claim victory.
70010000106174.description:
Battle Pixel is an intense first-person shooter where every match becomes a fierce battle for the top spot. You’ll enter a combat zone where there’s no room for error — only those who think fast, shoot precisely, and move smartly will come out on top.

Features:
• Access a wide arsenal. Weapons can be purchased by collecting resources during or between matches. Each type has its own role — build the perfect loadout for any situation.
• Compete against real players. Online battles demand maximum focus and flexibility. Every decision could change the tide of combat.
• Want to train or test new weapons? Fight against bots in offline mode — a great opportunity to sharpen your reflexes and experiment with tactics.
• Step outside the active zone and you’ll start taking damage. A constantly shrinking boundary pushes players forward, forcing fast decisions and aggressive plays.
• Use vehicles for fast travel and surprise attacks. Cars can be a lifesaver — or a liability — depending on who’s in control.
• Customize your style. Unlock and apply unique skins for both weapons and your character — dominate the battlefield with power and flair.

Battle Pixel is a survival arena where only the strongest prevail. Are you ready to enter the fight and prove your dominance?

70010000106181.name: Firefighting Rescue Simulator
70010000106181.intro: Answer every emergency call and show what a true firefighter can do.
70010000106181.description:
Firefighting Rescue Simulator puts you in the heart of real emergency action. As a heroic firefighter, your mission is to respond fast, rescue civilians, and battle intense fires across a city on the brink. Every call is a new test of courage, skill, and speed.

Choose from six unique characters, each ready to take on danger. Complete missions to unlock powerful fire trucks and gain access to three expanding cities, each with its own challenges. The more missions you pass, the more your firefighting arsenal grows.

Drive through urban streets with precision, rescue victims and hand them off to paramedics, and use advanced tools to extinguish raging fires. Be warned—night missions are harder, and every second counts.

Key Features:
• Realistic fire truck driving in detailed city environments
• Use multiple tools to fight fires and control danger
• Choose from 6 playable firefighter characters
• 3 cities to unlock through mission progress
• Dynamic rescue scenarios with mission-based structure
• Time-based gameplay—act fast, save lives
• Day/night cycle that affects mission difficulty
• Rescue and evacuate people to paramedics on scene

Gear up, race the clock, and become the hero your city needs. Are you ready to face the flames?

70010000106187.name: Peak Climb
70010000106187.intro: Climb higher, survive longer, reach the summit.
70010000106187.description:
Alone in the wilderness, your only path is up. After a devastating crash, you awaken at the base of a towering mountain—the last chance for survival. The climb is relentless: thin air, sheer cliffs, and merciless weather stand in your way. Hunger and exhaustion gnaw at your strength as the wild terrain pushes you to the edge. Every ledge tests your courage, every storm your determination. Reaching the summit is your only hope—but it will demand everything you have.

Key Features:
 • The Ultimate Climb – Conquer sheer rock faces, icy ridges, and dizzying heights with ropes, pitons, and skill.
 • Survival at Altitude – Balance hunger, thirst, warmth, and stamina as the mountain itself fights back.
 • Tools of Survival – Scavenge, craft, and master the gear that keeps you alive in extreme conditions.
 • Immersive Solo Journey – Face the mountain alone. No allies. No retries. Only your willpower stands between triumph and failure.
 • Ever-Changing Environments – From lush foothills to frozen summits, adapt to shifting weather and dangerous terrain.

Do you have the strength to conquer the peak—or will the mountain claim you forever?

70010000106192.name: Egypt City Builder
70010000106192.intro: Build, expand and shape a glorious ancient empire.
70010000106192.description:
Embark on a grand journey to the era of the pharaohs in Egypt City Builder — a strategy and simulation game where you lead your people to prosperity along the fertile banks of the Nile. Build, trade, and fight for the glory of your kingdom.
Key Features:
 • Construction & Development — Build and manage your city from the ground up. Expand your settlement with structures from simple homes to majestic temples.
 • Trade & Economy — Engage in commerce with neighboring cities. Trade grain, gold, papyrus, and gemstones to grow a prosperous economy.
 • Defensive Structures — Protect your capital with strong walls, watchtowers, and fortifications against enemy invasions.
 • Combat System — Take part in epic battles for land and resources. Command your warriors and develop strategies to secure victory.
 • Ancient Horrors — Face cursed mummies awakened from their tombs that spread fear among your people.
 • Hunting & Gathering — Explore the desert and oases to hunt and gather resources for survival.
 • Event System — Experience Nile floods, sandstorms, and political intrigue that can change the course of history.
 • Citizen Progression — Develop craftsmen, warriors, priests, and farmers to enhance your city’s efficiency.
Forge your legend in Egypt City Builder and create a civilization worthy of eternity.

70010000106202.name: Doku Girls 3
70010000106202.intro: Train your mind, enjoy the process and discover new facets of pleasure in the world of Sudoku!
70010000106202.description:
Welcome to Doku Girls 3 – an exciting puzzle game that will help you develop your logic and attentiveness! For successfully completing levels, you will receive a special reward – charming images of beautiful girls. Immerse yourself in a relaxing atmosphere thanks to pleasant music and bright graphics.

Game features:
• Images of girls that are unlocked as you progress
• Unique, hand-made sudoku for any skill level
• Sensual music that creates an atmosphere of relaxation and pleasure

70010000106213.name: RPS Hunger
70010000106213.intro: An action game where you stand motionless outside the castle like a nameless knight… and battle the approaching enemy known as 'your own hunger'!
70010000106213.description:
The rules are the same as rock-paper-scissors.
There's no real opponent — you're fighting against NPCs.

Three gauges gradually decrease over time. During the 60-second battle, tap three different commands to launch attacks.
Tapping a command restores the gauge of the corresponding color, so it’s best to prioritize the ones that are running low.

This is a reflex-based challenge where you fight while keeping an eye on all three bars.
With a simple rule of “survive for 60 seconds,” it's easy for both kids and adults to pick up and play.

Your combo count is auto-saved, so aim to beat your personal best!

There are also voice lines for different times of day, and special shoutouts when you pull off combos! (Available in both Japanese & English)

70010000106218.name: Korean Rail Celesti Express ITX-MAUM Taebaek Line
70010000106218.intro: This simulation game lets you operate a train directly, based on footage of actual trains in motion! Simply operate the up/down accelerator and brake levers to experience the beautiful scenery
70010000106218.description:
Korean Railway Celesti Express ITX-Maeum Taebaek Line is a railway simulation game using real footage of Korea's beautiful railway line.
Players become a train driver and navigate the approximately 283km section from Donghae Station to Cheongnyangni Station, experiencing the allure of a train traveling through the inland region from eastern Korea to Seoul.
This is the first title produced in official collaboration with Korea Railroad Corporation, KORAIL, and providing footage! ________________________________________
Key Features
• Realistic Railway Driving Experience
o Approximately 4 hours of driving course filmed on an actual Taebaek Line train.
o Various route environments, including curves, slopes, tunnels, and bridges, are faithfully captured.
o Supports three play modes: Section Driving Mode, Entire course Driving Mode, and View Mode.
• Control System
o Just like a real train driver, you must delicately operate the train, accelerating and decelerating, stopping, and obeying signals.
o On-time operation and stopping locations are crucial challenges.
o Supports Zuiki's Mascon for Nintendo Switch™ controller.
• Realistic scenery and atmosphere

The game uses footage captured from a camera inside an actual moving train, allowing you to enjoy Korea's inland regions from the comfort of your own train.
________________________________________
Recommended for:
• Gamers interested in railroads and train operation
• Players who want to experience Korea's scenery and travel through a game
• Users who prefer realistic simulations

70010000106223.name: And Then There Was No Light
70010000106223.intro: Retro Sokoban-style puzzle with pixel art and 8-bit sound. A fun challenge for all players. 2-10 hours to complete!?
70010000106223.description:
This is a puzzle game with a nostalgic vibe where you control a robot.
Connect the power source to the light bulb using blocks to open the door!

<Recommended for you if you are:>
- A fan of retro games.
- Looking for a light mental workout.
- Someone who has heard of "Sokoban" but never tried it.
- Searching for a casual and affordable game.

You'll also love the "Aha!" moments that happen right when you're about to clear a stage!
Enjoy! ツ


<Streaming Guidelines>
You are free to post or stream screenshots and video of the entire game without prior permission. Contacting us is not necessary.
Monetization of videos featuring this game is also permitted without any restrictions.
However, extracting, posting, or distributing individual assets from the game (e.g., music, character icons, etc.) is prohibited.

70010000106233.name: COLOREE
70010000106233.intro: Make art, find calm, feel complete!
70010000106233.description:
COLOREE is a modern color-by-number made for adults who love art—and the quiet satisfaction of finishing something beautiful. Unwind with curated, gallery-inspired illustrations and balanced palettes. Follow the numbers, watch each piece resolve, and enjoy the calm of a complete work.

Why you’ll love it:
● Art-first: elegant, curated compositions for design-minded players
● Relaxing flow: mindful coloring that settles the day
● Deeply satisfying: every section brings you closer to a finished piece
● At your pace: quick wins or slow, evening sessions
● Uncluttered focus: a calm presentation that keeps the art center stage

70010000106243.name: Highway Traffic Pro
70010000106243.intro:
Highway Traffic Racing
Fast Car Driving
Extreme Road Challenge
70010000106243.description:
Experience fast-paced highway action in Highway Traffic Pro, a thrilling car-driving game where your reflexes and skill determine how far you can go. Steer through busy lanes, avoid collisions, and race against intense traffic as speeds climb and challenges increase.

Choose from multiple cars, each offering unique handling and performance. Collect coins, complete missions, and unlock upgrades to improve acceleration, braking, and top speed. Dynamic weather, different times of day, and varying traffic patterns keep every drive fresh and exciting.

Whether you prefer quick runs or long endurance drives, Highway Traffic Pro delivers smooth controls, vibrant visuals, and nonstop road action. Test your skills, set new high scores, and prove you're the ultimate highway driver.

Features:
Exciting highway racing with increasing difficulty
Multiple cars to unlock and upgrade
Smooth and responsive driving controls
Dynamic traffic, weather, and time-of-day changes
Missions, rewards, and endless gameplay challenges
High score system and progression-based unlocks

70010000106248.name: American Car Parking Simulator 2025
70010000106248.intro: Park Like a Pro. Drive Like an American.
70010000106248.description:
American Car Parking Simulator 2025 brings you the ultimate USA driving and parking experience. Drive legendary American cars, master intense parking missions, and explore a vibrant open-world city filled with challenges, ramps, obstacles, and hidden routes.

Take on a massive variety of parking levels - from tight downtown spots to complex multi-level structures. Test your precision and control in special skill test arenas, where you’ll navigate tricky ramps, moving barriers, and narrow passages to reach the final parking zone.

Choose from a wide range of vehicles: compact city cars, heavy pickups, powerful sports cars, retro cars, and iconic muscle cars. Each vehicle comes with realistic physics, giving you a lifelike driving sensation on every turn, drift, and brake.

Need a break from parking? Cruise freely through the American city, enjoy smooth handling, practice driving, or discover new areas at your own pace.

Whether you're a parking pro or simply love realistic car simulators, American Car Parking Simulator 2025 delivers an immersive, challenging, and rewarding driving adventure.

70010000106256.name: The Days Without Gods
70010000106256.intro: This is a thrilling text-based adventure set in a DND-style fantasy world! Recruit new allies, form unbreakable bonds, and experience epic tales and exciting adventures!
70010000106256.description: Step into the role of Mori Granson, apprentice and subordinate to Hsiao, the head of the Magic Association. In the mage capital of Tarlin, your path will cross with Coccinea, a young woman you saved years ago, and a host of other compelling characters. As you adventure together, your mission extends beyond exploration: you must help this group forge strong bonds and become a true "Granson Family," a chosen family bound not by blood, but by choice. Will you succeed in uniting them?

70010000106262.name: Mom Crush: Hidden Hotel Love Story
70010000106262.intro:
Confident women.
Undeniable attraction.
A story where you’re chosen.
70010000106262.description:
From the moment you arrive, attention feels natural.

The hotel is elegant and relaxed, but the atmosphere carries something more. Certain women notice you immediately. Their interest isn’t rushed, it’s assured. Smiles come easily. Conversations feel effortless. And when they speak, it’s clear they know exactly what they want.

In Mom Crush: Hidden Hotel Love Story, you step into a narrative built around confidence, attraction, and being desired. This isn’t about chasing attention, it’s about responding to it.

These women are experienced, self-assured, and direct in their own way. They enjoy testing chemistry, guiding conversations, and deciding when to move closer. Your role is to recognize the moment, match their energy, and choose how far each connection goes.

This visual novel focuses on chemistry, presence, and the appeal of being wanted, all within a refined, relaxed hotel setting.

Let them make the first move.
Decide how the story ends.


Features

● ADULT ROMANCE VISUAL NOVEL: A story centered on attraction, confidence, and mature relationships.

● CONFIDENCE DRIVEN CHOICES: Your responses influence desire, chemistry, and how women react to you.

● MULTIPLE ROUTES & ENDINGS: Each relationship follows a distinct path based on your decisions.

● CHARACTER LED ROMANCE: Women with strong presence, personality, and intention.

● ELEGANT HOTEL SETTING: A luxurious vacation backdrop that enhances mood and connection.

● ANIME VISUAL NOVEL STYLE: Stylish character art that emphasizes expression and chemistry.


Choose carefully who you let close.
Play now!

70010000106272.name: POLICE OFFICERS SIMULATOR
70010000106272.intro: Step into the uniform and protect the city you serve!
70010000106272.description:
POLICE OFFICERS SIMULATOR puts you in the shoes of a rookie cop navigating a challenging and unpredictable city. Begin your journey at the shooting range, mastering focus and precision before heading out on patrol. From routine stops to tense hostage situations, every mission tests your courage, judgment, and sense of justice.
As you rise through the ranks, your decisions shape your reputation and the city’s response. Develop your skills, unlock new pistols and vehicles, and maintain order with both authority and empathy.
Features:
•	Shooting Range Training – Hone your aim, manage stress, and unlock 4 different pistols.
•	Vehicle Progression – Patrol the city starting with a sedan and earn a rugged jeep as you advance.
•	Diverse Mission Types – Handle robberies, domestic disputes, hostage situations, and more.
•	Choice of Tactics – Decide when to negotiate, use non-lethal force, or draw your firearm.
•	Moral Decisions & Reputation – Your choices impact how citizens and colleagues respond.
•	Skill Development – Improve shooting, reaction speed, and stress management over time.
•	Dynamic City Environment – Experience a living city that reacts to every action and decision.
•	Realistic Police Experience – Step into the shoes of an officer and maintain order while protecting lives.
Protect the city, save lives, and prove your worth — one mission at a time.

70010000106277.name: SCHOOLBOY SIM
70010000106277.intro: In a house turned prison, every creak is a risk — and every smart move brings you closer to freedom.
70010000106277.description:
You’re grounded again — this time under lock and key. Your parents have turned the house into a fortress: your mom stalks the second floor, your dad guards the first, and every attempt to slip out could end in humiliating punishments. But in SCHOOLBOY SIM, every locked door hides a puzzle, every patrol can be outsmarted, and freedom is always just one clever step away.

The game drops you straight into a cinematic storyline: your mom storms in, hands down your punishment, and locks you inside. From that moment, your mission begins — find the codes, beat the patrols, and escape before the night is over.

Features:
• Outsmart your parents and learn their patrol patterns.
• Solve puzzles that unlock doors, codes, and secret paths.
• Use stealth and timing to sneak past danger.
• Piece together clues leading to your ultimate escape.

No handholding — only hints. Every move is a risk, every success a step closer to freedom. SCHOOLBOY SIM turns a simple punishment into a tense, cinematic escape adventure.

70010000106284.name: Sugar Daddy Crush: Hidden Hotel Love Story
70010000106284.intro:
Elegant men.
Hidden intentions.
A love story you control.
70010000106284.description:
The hotel looks peaceful at first.
Sunlit corridors, quiet lounges, and guests who seem perfectly composed.

But attention lingers in subtle ways.
A glance held for a second too long.
A conversation that shifts without warning.
Men whose confidence feels practiced… and intentional.

In Sugar Daddy Crush: Hidden Hotel Love Story, you step into an adult narrative focused on attraction, restraint, and emotional timing. 

Your stay becomes a series of encounters shaped by dialogue, perception, and the choices you make in each moment.

These are men who value control, image, and experience. Getting closer isn’t about bold gestures, but about understanding when to speak, when to wait, and when silence says more than words.

Every response affects how relationships unfold. What feels casual may open unexpected paths, while a single misstep can quietly close a connection before it begins. 

Trust builds gradually through shared moments, unspoken interest, and the sense of being noticed.

As the days pass, motivations surface, boundaries shift, and the hotel reveals more than its elegant exterior suggests. Not every path leads to romance, and not every story ends the same.

This is a visual novel driven by atmosphere, character presence, and the tension between curiosity and restraint.


Features:

● ADULT STORY DRIVEN VISUAL NOVEL: A narrative experience focused on mature relationships, subtle attraction, and emotional tension.

● CHOICE BASED DIALOGUE: Every response influences trust, distance, and how each connection evolves.

● MULTIPLE ROUTES & ENDINGS: Different paths lead to distinct outcomes shaped by your decisions.

● CHARACTER FOCUSED ENCOUNTERS: Each guest brings his own presence, pace, and boundaries to the story.

● ATMOSPHERIC HOTEL SETTING: A refined vacation backdrop where quiet moments carry meaning.

● ANIME VISUAL NOVEL: Expressive character art designed to highlight mood and emotion.


Choose carefully who you let close.
Play now!

70010000106290.name: Fida Puti Samurai
70010000106290.intro: A Retro-FPS "virtual happy place", jeopardized with a naughty bug. Traverse this action-oriented roguelite blasting waifus to uncover dirty secrets on a personal computer!
70010000106290.description:
What is your happy place?
Maybe it's a bedroom. A calm place in the open. Your bathroom. Or maybe... your personal computer?

During times of need, a programmer developed a virtual cozy experience for his girlfriend.
It was a warm, isolated wood cabin on the snowy alps. With a chill-out music playing on the background, a nice place to stay for a while...
... if not by a system bug on the basement, showing a hidden path to another world.


On Fida Puti Samurai, you will incarnate as Liza, digging through a silly kind of rabbit hole:

- Traverse urban environments
- Visit 13 levels on urban settings
- Fight bunny-suit zombies, semi-naked waifus, punk gurls and others on 4 different enemy factions
- Use a wide variety of weapons from sledgehammers to dynamite and even panty-drying miniguns
- Discover the ability to transform into a Mahou Shoujo
- Uncover the secrets that lie on Zanardi's computer and his past

70010000106294.name: In Trusted Hands
70010000106294.intro: Dive into the daily work of a cozy workshop in a big city, manage client data, balance energy and stress, and make choices that shape the story and its outcome.
70010000106294.description:
In Trusted Hands is a narrative-driven repair shop simulator where fixing phones turns dealing with people’s private lives. Messages, photos, and hidden files can surface during repairs, placing you in the middle of secrets you were never meant to see.

As the story unfolds, customers with complicated pasts cross your path, and strangers with unclear motives begin asking for information in exchange for money. Every decision matters — what you share, what you hide, and who you choose to help can change lives, shape the city, and affect your own future.

You run a small phone repair shop under constant pressure: exhaustion, stress, rent, and inspections are part of daily life. The repair process is intentionally simple, keeping the focus on moral choices, relationships, and long-term consequences rather than technical complexity.

70010000106302.name: Emoji Rampage - Origins
70010000106302.intro: Blast through endless swarms of chaotic emojis in this fast-paced rogue-like FPS! Unlock arenas, collect power-ups, and survive the madness.
70010000106302.description:
Emoji Rampage – Origins throws you into a chaotic, rogue-like first-person shooter where emojis aren’t just harmless faces — they’re deadly enemies.
Start each run by customizing your experience with unique modifiers: crank up the difficulty, make every emoji wear a ridiculous hat, or turn on bouncing mode for hilarious chaos. Then pick your unlocked arena — from The Bouncy Castle to Candy World or even outer space — each with its own hazards and interactive traps.
Armed with only a pistol, you’ll face waves of emojis that charge, dash, fly, shoot, shield themselves, explode, and overwhelm you with sheer numbers. Kill them, collect glowing experience orbs, and level up to choose from powerful upgrades. Will you improve your damage, speed, or reload time? Unlock stronger weapons? Or summon explosive chaos to wipe out swarms at once? Every decision shapes your survival run.
As the arena fills with bouncing, exploding, and bullet-spewing emojis, the game becomes a frantic dance of dodging, aiming, and managing your ammo while exploiting map hazards like explosive sweets or damaging zones to survive longer. The further you go, the crazier it gets — until you’re finally overwhelmed. But every run earns progress, new arenas, and more chaos for your next rampage.
Do you have what it takes to survive the emoji apocalypse?

70010000106305.name: Celestial Ascend
70010000106305.intro: Ascend through serene skies, guiding a lone traveler across floating realms to discover a hopeful second chance.
70010000106305.description:
Rise above the clouds and follow a solitary traveler on a quest that blends graceful platforming with peaceful exploration. Each level is a dreamlike chapter of a larger tale about loss, resolve, and the hope of earning a second chance for humanity. Glide across floating islands, scale soaring structures, and navigate shifting gravity as friendly spirit guides share fragments of the story and teach you new abilities.
Designed for flow and mindfulness, the game favors clarity over frustration: precise jumps feel good, challenges are fair, and environmental puzzles fit naturally into the world. The painterly art direction and ethereal soundtrack turn every vista into a moment worth lingering on—without rushing you forward.
Features
•	Skybound 3D platforming with double jumps and directional dashes
•	Gentle environmental puzzles woven into exploration
•	Five distinct areas per level with evolving mechanics
•	Surreal, stylized worlds and sweeping, meditative vistas
•	Narrative fragments from helpful spirit guides
•	Accessible difficulty focused on flow, not punishment

70010000106308.name: Trials of Olympus
70010000106308.intro: Endure the Trials of the Gods in a fluid platforming adventure.
70010000106308.description:
The gods of Olympus seek a mortal champion to fight against a rising darkness. Only those who endure their trials may be chosen.
In Trials of Olympus, you journey through the realms of Ares, Artemis, Hades, Poseidon, and Zeus. Each god’s domain holds three great trials — vast platforming levels filled with traps, enemies, and divine essences to recover.
You cannot fight, for no weapon is yet yours. Instead, rely on agility and wit:
•	Dash forward, upward, or downward to escape danger.
•	Double jump and float across perilous gaps.
•	Dodge fearsome enemies you cannot yet strike.
•	Collect ambrosia to restore your mana and keep moving.
•	Explore expansive worlds inspired by each god’s power.
Gather all divine essences and earn the gods’ favor to ascend Olympus. Male or female hero — switch freely and face your destiny.
Will you be the mortal chosen to stand with the gods?

70010000106340.name: Hentai Uni 4
70010000106340.intro: Assemble beautiful puzzles to relaxing music. 12 beauties are waiting for you!
70010000106340.description:
Assemble beautiful puzzles to relaxing music — 12 beauties are waiting for you!
In our game, you’ll meet charming bandit girls, sharpshooters, and cheerful landsknechts.

70010000106352.name: Brainrot: Tralalero and The Lost Soul of AI
70010000106352.intro: Tralalero, a blue shark with legs and sneakers, embarks on an absurd and chaotic adventure to recover his lost voice in a bugged world filled with betrayals and humor.
70010000106352.description:
ERROR 401 

A viral AI has broken him into musical fragments scattered across absurd glitch worlds. To get him back, he'll have to sing, dance, be out of tune, and survive enemies as ridiculous as they are dramatic.

With his inseparable companion Brr Brr Patapim, a head with giant feet, he'll embark on a musical odyssey where the illogical becomes logical... and the off-key, pure melody.

Main features:

·An absurd, chaotic, and humorous musical journey.

·Extravagant characters: from a crocodile plane to a pixel boy.

·Colorful glitch worlds where every step sounds different.

·A story where imperfection is true harmony.

·For all audiences: laughter, rhythm, and madness guaranteed.

70010000106357.name: Naughty Kittens
70010000106357.intro: Five mischievous kittens find a magic map in a tin of cookies and experience the most fun and brilliant adventure of their lives. Where will the map lead these adorable kittens?
70010000106357.description:
Get ready for a journey full of magic, laughter, and surprises with five adventurous kittens who will discover that even the most ordinary tin of cookies can hide an incredible secret.

It all begins when the Whiskers Gang finds a magical map hidden among the cookies.

Its sparkling symbols will guide them through enchanted forests, where each step brings fun new challenges, surprising puzzles, and curious creatures that will want to join in the fun.

Game Features:

·Enjoy magical and colorful forests full of color and magic.

·Meet curious and adorable creatures.

·Discover the island of the luminous insects and participate in their magical celebration.

·A visual novel designed for children and families: fun, safe, and full of tenderness.

70010000106372.name: Desk Wars
70010000106372.intro:
Pixel warriors in all-out chaos!
The fated clash of Blue Fang and Red Horn!
Change destiny with just a flick of your finger!
70010000106372.description:
Pixel characters run wild in frantic battles!
On the desk-top battlefield where red and blue armies collide, chaos and challenge await—this is DeskWars!

You are the tactician of the blue army, Blue Fang.
Command your captain, lead your soldiers, and push back the evil red army, Red Horn, before their invasion succeeds.

Strengthen your troops, gather powerful items, and take the fight to the overwhelming Red Horn forces.
The keys to victory? Strategy… and a healthy dose of reckless confidence.

Every battle unfolds differently thanks to random recruits and item drops.
Build your very own Blue Fang army and stand against the Red Horn threat!

70010000106379.name: Cauldron
70010000106379.intro: Cauldron is an upgrade-heavy, minigame-centric, turn-based RPG.
70010000106379.description:
Cauldron is a game about exploration, battling monsters, and leveling up your party through minigames. Gather resources to upgrade minigames, heroes, abilities, and more! Play as Nyx, a young witch cast into this darkness-covered world. Discover the truth and find new allies to help you on your journey!

Play minigames to gather resources!
Infinitely upgrade minigames, heroes, items, and more!
Battle monsters to explore more of this mysterious world!

There's no "right" way to play Cauldron...
Do you love to grind minigames over and over? Go for it!
Would you rather let the game auto-collect while you're gone? No shame in that!
Do you love to carefully organize your party and skills to dish out maximum damage? Go ahead!
Would you rather get completely overpowered so you don't have to think about any of that stuff? Great!

Exponential minigame progression (we're talking REALLY big numbers)
Unique skill trees for 20+ heroes
Multiple game modes, including Idle, Pacifist, and EVIL
Unlockable autobattler to do the battling for you
An upgradable collection box that auto-gathers resources
Character skits
A snarky pink sidekick who never leaves your side
Talking birds

70010000106382.name: Tamarindos Freaking Dinner
70010000106382.intro: 90’s Mascot horror sandbox adventure trapped in a twisted time loop with 25 freaky endings! Deliver the pizza. Escape the mansion. Don’t become the dinner.
70010000106382.description:
Mascot Horror in a 90´s escape room! deliver your pizza order to Tagomago´s Mansion, but be careful, dinner is not the pizza..its YOU! escape from this haunted house and his 7 cannibalish inhabitants in a time loop with more than 25 endings!

The sequel to BAOBABS MAUSOLEUM and the second game on Jacob Jazz´s TREELOGY!

70010000106404.name: Garden of the Greek Gods: Zeus, Poseidon & Hades Love Story
70010000106404.intro:
Enter a divine garden where passion ignites with Greek gods.
Will you conquer the hearts of Zeus, Poseidon, and Hades?
70010000106404.description:
In a hidden garden blessed by the gods, three mighty deities await your arrival. Zeus, Poseidon, and Hades each hold the power to test your heart—but only your wit, charm, and skill can earn their devotion.

Garden of the Greek Gods blends lighthearted romance with engaging minigames. Each choice you make and each challenge you overcome unlocks new images, surprising reactions, and secret endings. The path to love may be playful, but the gods won’t make it easy.

Show your confidence as you flirt, answer tricky questions, and prove your reflexes in minigame challenges. Can you impress the king of Olympus, ride the waves with the ruler of the seas, and gain the trust of the lord of the underworld? Your destiny rests in this divine garden.


Features:

● Myth and romance combined: Interact with three iconic Greek gods, each with unique personalities and hidden sides.
● Minigames: Alternate between dialogue choices and quick challenges to progress.
● Unlock exclusive images and scenes as your bond deepens.
● Multiple endings: Every choice and every victory in a minigame shapes your story.
● High replay value: Discover different outcomes by charming each god in new ways.


Will you conquer their hearts and write your own love story among the gods?

70010000106409.name: Garden of the Greek Goddesses: Aphrodite, Artemis & Athena Love Story
70010000106409.intro:
Enter a divine garden where love blooms with Greek goddesses.
Will you win the hearts of Aphrodite, Artemis, and Athena?
70010000106409.description:
In a hidden garden blessed by the gods, three legendary goddesses await your arrival. Aphrodite, Artemis, and Athena each hold the power to stir your heart—but only your wit, charm, and skill can win their affection.

Garden of the Greek Goddesses blends lighthearted romance with engaging minigames. Each choice you make and each challenge you overcome unlocks new images, surprising reactions, and secret endings. The path to love may be playful, but the goddesses won’t make it easy.

Show your confidence as you flirt, answer tricky questions, and prove your reflexes in minigame challenges. Can you impress the goddess of love, outsmart the huntress, and earn the respect of the wise warrior? Your destiny rests in this divine garden.


Features:

● Myth and romance combined: Interact with three iconic Greek goddesses, each with unique personalities and hidden sides.

● Minigames: Alternate between dialogue choices and quick challenges to progress.

● Unlock exclusive images and scenes as your bond deepens.

● Multiple endings: Every choice and every victory in a minigame shapes your story.

● High replay value: Discover different outcomes by charming each goddess in new ways.


Will you conquer their hearts and write your own love story among the gods?

70010000106414.name: Rayman: 30th Anniversary Edition
70010000106414.description:
THE ADVENTURE THAT STARTED IT ALL
Perform Rayman’s signature punch and helicopter hair glide through colorful worlds, from the Dream Forest and its unforgettable mosquito ride to Band Land’s musical chaos. Rescue the Electoons and save the world from Mr. Dark in a classic platforming adventure with a unique art style that remains as magical today as it was in the '90s.

THE DEFINITIVE  EDITION
Play the classic adventure across 5 versions (MS-DOS, PlayStation®, Atari Jaguar, Game Boy™ Color, and Game Boy™ Advance) now enhanced with an immersive, reimagined soundtrack, plus more than 120 additional levels from Rayman’s New Levels, Rayman 60 Levels, and Rayman By His Fans. And for the first time ever, experience the long-lost SNES prototype, offering a rare glimpse into how Rayman’s innovative gameplay first took shape.

EXCLUSIVE DOCUMENTARY
Uncover the untold story behind Rayman’s creation in an interactive documentary featuring over 50 minutes of brand-new interviews with the original developers. Dive into rare concept art, early sketches, and design documents that offer exclusive insights into the making of the limbless hero.

A CLASSIC FOR EVERYONE
Rediscover the cult-classic gameplay or take on the challenge with new features designed to keep you in the action, including a rewind, multiple save slots, and accessibility options like infinite lives and instant level unlocks.

70010000106419.name: Prison Escape Simulator
70010000106419.description:
Too long in this prison, time to get out of here. Pull the carpet and start digging with a teaspoon. Watch out for the guard, sell him the junk you find. Trade toilet paper with the prisoners. Get better items and improve your stats. Expand the tunnel, use glow sticks and dynamite. Will you escape?

Check if you could escape from prison.
The day has come when the book is no longer enjoyable, the jokes of the cellmates next door are no longer funny, and it's time to break out of this boring prison. Get some tools and start digging.

Ways to survive in prison.
Maybe you can trade with the guard for some goodies, maybe the guys will give you something better to dig in exchange for toilet paper.

Watch out for the guard's inspections, cover the carpet, remove the sand you dig up in the toilet, don't get caught. Get food, better shoes, and bigger shovels. Exercise to have more strength and energy, buy better backpacks to dig more valuable items from the ground.

Pimp the pad.
Maybe you can buy something from Mrs. Dorothy in the prison warehouse? Buy furniture, glow sticks, more beautiful carpets, and better toilets to remove the sand faster.


Get respect or get buried.
In Prison Escape Simulator, gambling isn’t just a pastime, it’s a way to gain influence. Money and reputation are all on the line. Every bet carries risk: you might get rich or end up in debt. Play smart, because in this prison, bluffing can be just as powerful as digging.

So, will you survive behind bars and prepare for the grand escape?
Read the letters with hints on how deep and in which direction to dig, and maybe one day you'll get out of prison?

In Prison Escape Simulator you can mine, trade, upgrade your cell and have tons of fun when no one is watching. A few hours of excitement for the price of a burger. Will you escape?

70010000106421.name: Lost Howl
70010000106421.intro: A heartfelt journey through the wilds
70010000106421.description:
Step into the paws of a brave little fox on a quest to rescue his captured sister. Lost Howl is a charming adventure game that blends exploration, light puzzles, and heartwarming storytelling.

 Features

An emotional adventure – Travel across forests and villages, all in search of your lost sister.

Unique levels – Each area brings fresh challenges, atmosphere, and secrets to discover.

A story of family – Experience a touching tale about courage, love, and never giving up.

Adorable but daring – Cute visuals meet adventurous spirit, making Lost Howl accessible to players of all ages.

The Journey Awaits

Will you be able to cross the dangers of the wild and reunite with your sister?

70010000106424.name: Cloud to Gold
70010000106424.description: Follow the rainbow, find the gold! In Cloud to Gold, every puzzle is a magical mix of logic and charm. You play as a mischievous leprechaun on a quest to push clouds, fill holes, and create rainbow paths that lead straight to the legendary pot of gold. The rules are simple but the challenge is clever. Push clouds in straight lines, watch them slide until they hit an obstacle, and see them fall perfectly into place. Break objects to clear the way, redirect clouds with arrows, and master tiles that change the flow of your journey. Every move counts as you shape the path toward treasure. Across dozens of handcrafted maps, puzzles grow bigger and more intricate, constantly introducing new tricks and mechanics. What begins as a playful stroll soon becomes a satisfying brain-teasing adventure, where rainbows are your bridges and gold is your reward. Whether you’re here for a relaxing puzzle session or to conquer every clever challenge, Cloud to Gold delivers a charming, colorful journey full of wit, rainbows, and shiny treasures.

70010000106429.name: Hula Hula Wee
70010000106429.description: Tropical puzzles, fruity explosions! In Hula Hula Wee, every level is a refreshing mix of logic and fun. Push coconuts across colorful maps, smash them into pineapple towers, and watch as they burst together into delicious Piña Coladas. The rules are simple, but the challenge keeps growing. Slide coconuts carefully, plan your moves, undo mistakes infinitely, and use bonfires to burn obstacles out of the way. To complete a stage, you’ll need to destroy every pineapple tower and outsmart each tricky layout. The adventure spans 30 puzzles across three vibrant settings. Start on CoCo Island, where the basics are introduced with lighthearted challenges. Then head to Hula Beach, where new twists like craters force coconuts to stop mid-path. Finally, climb the Fire Tower, the toughest destination, where bonfires add a fiery layer of strategy to your quest. With its tropical theme, playful mechanics, and clever progression, Hula Hula Wee is the perfect puzzle getaway for anyone who loves a mix of brains and beach vibes.

70010000106434.name: Slide Viking
70010000106434.description: Sharpen your axes and get ready to slide into adventure! In Slide Viking, every move matters as you glide across the grid, smash crates, and collect the treasure chests hidden throughout the kingdom. What starts as a simple journey quickly becomes a true test of logic and planning. You play as a bold viking whose mission is clear: gather every chest of gold the land has to offer.
