With continuous sliding movement, you’ll need to think several steps ahead, undo mistakes infinitely, and break obstacles that stand in your way. The puzzles grow trickier with each level, mixing clever layouts and satisfying “aha!” moments. The game features 30 handcrafted puzzles across two unique settings. Begin in the Village, a humble place of wood and earth where your skills are forged. Then, prove your worth inside the Castle, the richest and most fortified place in the realm, with stone walls and floors that raise the challenge. Whether you’re after a casual puzzle to relax with or a series of smart challenges to conquer, Slide Viking delivers a journey full of brains, treasure, and plenty of sliding fun.

70010000106444.name: Ghost Master: Resurrection
70010000106444.description:
Command An Army Of Ghosts  
Summon and control a legion of ghosts, banshees, gremlins, and more, each with unique abilities. Your ghoulish goons are more terrifying (and entertaining) than ever.  
 
Strategy Meets Supernatural  
Blend tactics, adventure, and resource management in a seamless gameplay loop set within a richly built paranormal world. 
 
Solve Mysteries, Unleash Horror 
Every haunting is a puzzle. Use spectral strategy and powers to uncover secrets, manipulate mortals, and complete objectives.  
 
Rediscover the Fear  
Ghost Master: Resurrection invites you to master the art of fear in a beautifully reimagined supernatural playground. The dead have risen... and they're under your control.

70010000106448.name: Vinecard
70010000106448.intro: VineCard is a card strategy game that combines war chess and light rogue-like elements.
70010000106448.description:
Vine Card is a deck-building strategic game with roguelike elements. Choose from a roster of quirky heroes with even quirkier skills, plan your route around the game board,
grab the goodies and defeat the baddies Navigate your hero around a game board of limited grids, one step at a time.

Sounds boring? Well, throw in a deck of 200+ unique cards, and watch the chemical reactions happen. 8 playable characters with wildly different styles/skills further increase the fun.

It all starts from this fictitious empire on a fictitious planet. The Tang Empire is facing a pivotal moment and from there, things start to go wild. Follow our heroes from the Tang Empire to the Far West, then the mysterious Skyland descending from the, duh, sky!
Embark on a journey that is natural, semi-natural, supernatural, meta-natural, and unnatural at the same time! Blend Wuxia and science fiction and fantasy and mythology together and it just works.

Take elements from Chinese mythology, Norse mythology, Celtic mythology, Arthurian mythology, Cthulhu mythology (yeah, we've got that covered, too), add modern pop culture, sprinkle a liberal dose of actual history, serve while hot.

Gatling guns vs swords vs crossbows vs pretty much anything you can think of.
Who said cowboys can't do Chinese kungfu, eh? Leave common sense behind, dude. It's holding you down.

The game comes with 30+ handcrafted "legend site" stages, from the mysterious Sanxingdui to the isle of Avalon to the glorious Valhalla. Take a break from the busy combat and solve these special challenges instead!

70010000106453.name: Blocks Ahoy!
70010000106453.intro: Gunners, to the ready! Now, blockward ho!
70010000106453.description:
Ready yer cannon and blast yer way to 2048! Match, merge, and fire across th’ high seas in Blocks Ahoy!

In this explosive cube-shootin’ adventure, ye’ll launch and match blocks to merge ‘em into bigger numbers. Unleash massive combos and beware—if yer blocks reach the shore, it’s game over mate!

- Shoot ‘n merge blocks to hit 2048!
- Explosive combos 'n satisfyin' chain reactions! 
- Score big ‘n climb the leaderboard!
- Play on a bright, tropical pirate island!
- Touch controls make it easy ‘n fun to fire away!

Be ye the greatest shooter dis island needs?

70010000106463.name: Sugoroku New Year's Party
70010000106463.intro:
Try your luck and test your wits in this adventure of fortune!
Good luck abounds in Sugoroku New Year's Party!
70010000106463.description:
Collect lucky coins through festive New Year's games.
Bring in the most good fortune, and you'll be crowned Master of the New Year!

With a Joy-Con™ controller for each player, up to six players can join in the fun!

[Sugoroku Mode]
Collect coins and aim for victory!
The board is filled with festive New Year's events and special ema plaques that can change your fate!
There's always a chance for a last-minute comeback!

[Minigame Mode]
Enjoy a variety of New Year's-themed minigames!
Play 10 different games, including Fukuwarai and Mochi Pounding!

[Online Mode]
Compete in sugoroku and minigames with players from around the world!
Test your luck for the New Year and see how you fare!

<Skin Edit>
Freely customize your Character Piece used in Sugoroku Mode!
Create original pieces in festive New Year's attire!

70010000106468.name: Grand Poker Casino
70010000106468.description:
Think smart, bluff hard, and win big in this classic Texas Hold’em experience. Outsmart your opponents and prove that poker is more than luck — it’s skill, strategy, and nerve. Even a poor hand can become a brilliant victory in the right hands.

Take a seat at the table, call, check, fold, raise, and bluff your way through intense rounds. With up to 4 AI opponents, every match is a new challenge.

Are you ready to prove you’ve got what it takes to become the ultimate poker champ?

Features:
• Classic Texas Hold’em rules – easy to learn, hard to master.
• Smart play beats luck – turn weak hands into winning hands with the right strategy.
• Up to 4 AI opponents – face different playstyles and adapt your tactics.
• Chip management – build your stack over multiple rounds.
• High-stakes poker action – make them fold, or risk it all with a bold bluff.

70010000106482.name: Concealed
70010000106482.intro: At DYL High, whispers of missing girls spread. Exchange student Meng Jiangnan confronts the school’s hidden darkness in comic noir style.
70010000106482.description:
Concealed is a suspenseful school horror adventure based on real-life urban legends. 
At Di Yingling High School, several girls mysteriously vanish. 
Beneath the surface lies a truth wrapped in shadows. 
Exchange student Meng Jiangnan is drawn into the mystery, step by step uncovering secrets buried deep within the campus.
The Remake reimagines the original’s chilling atmosphere with a striking black-and-white comic style, enhanced performances, and upgraded systems for a more immersive experience.

Features:200,000+ words of branching narrative across 7 chapters and dozens of locations, for over 10 hours of gameplay.
Multiple routes and endings: every choice could lead to salvation… or doom.
Unique presentation: black-and-white comic panels and dreamlike sequences blur the line between reality and illusion.
Ensemble storytelling: over 20 characters, each hiding clues or secrets.
Series connection: shares the same universe as Ghost in the Pool and Weirdo, completing the broader “Parallel” mythos.

Concealed is more than a horror story—it marks the beginning of a campus urban legend.Will you follow Meng Jiangnan into the whirlpool of truth?

70010000106487.name: Kiosk
70010000106487.intro: Kiosk is a horror cooking game where the grill is hot, the rain is cold, and the night shift… is getting weirder by the minute.
70010000106487.description:
Run the cozy, rain-soaked kiosk and serve the meals to some very “interesting” customers. 
Keep the orders coming, soak in the eerie atmosphere and try not to think too hard about what happened to the last guy who worked here (He's... gone. Let's leave it at that).

The job seems simple - flip some patties, pour some drinks, don't ask too many questions. 

But the longer the night goes on, the more you notice - something isn’t right.

With each shift, you're getting closer to the truth. 
Can you uncover the secrets without losing your mind or overcooking the meat?

FEATURES:
▪ Three game modes - Story, Endless and Relax: experience the game at your own pace,
▪ MEAT your clients - a cast of late-night regulars will keep you entertained throughout the night,
▪ Ready, set, cook! - chop veggies, grill meat, serve drinks and keep your customers happy,
▪ Now serving in 15 languages - choose yours so you can scream in your native tongue.

Additional languages:
- Arabic (AR),
- Polish (PL/POLSKI),
- Serbian (SR/СРПСКИ),
- Turkish (TUR/TÜRKÇE),
- Ukrainian (UA/УКРАЇНСЬКА).

70010000106495.name: Teeto
70010000106495.intro: Explore a world of mayhem and Michaels! Join Teeto the blob and Nory the bunny in this 3D adventure platformer to stop the shadow corruption from spreading.
70010000106495.description:
Absorb & Transform!

Teeto’s got a talent for absorbing all sorts of objects - and turning them into wild new forms! With Nory’s Vionite-powered backpack, they unlock unique abilities to outsmart enemies, solve puzzles, and discover hidden secrets. Mix it up, get creative, and see what strange new powers you’ll unleash!

Team up Together!

Life’s better with a buddy - and so is saving the world! Grab a friend and dive into split-screen co-op, where you’ll absorb, transform, and explore together. Solve puzzles, help each other out, and take on this wild adventure side by side!

Chaos Corruption!

Chaos is spreading, and the shadow creatures are behind it! Teeto and Nory must team up, using their unique powers to stop the mayhem, restore balance, and keep the world from tipping into complete disorder!

Missing Michaels!

It started with one Michael - Nory’s first experiment. But Michael couldn’t stay simple… he split into two, then four, then eight! Now there are too many Michaels for anyone to handle. Track them down, rescue them, and bring the tiny mischief-makers home!

Lend a Hand, Get a Hand!

Teeto and Nory aren’t the only ones in need of help. Along the way, you’ll meet a colourful cast of quirky characters, each with their own oddball dilemmas. Lend them a hand, and they might just return the favour with useful items, hidden secrets, or unexpected abilities.

Dress The Part

Teeto can unlock a variety of fun and stylish costumes, from the effortlessly cool to the absolutely ridiculous. Saving the world is important - but who says you can’t look fashionable while doing it?

70010000106500.name: Go Kart Island
70010000106500.intro: An open world kart racer! Use items, driftslide and boost your way to championship glory.
70010000106500.description:
Go Kart Island is an open world kart racer with full story mode! 

Lachlan the highland cow has a dream to become Go Kart Champion, but the Mayor has an election campaign to fund and demands you raise 1,000 coins for an "entry fee" to the BIG RACE. 

Fortunately the inhabitants of Go Kart Island have no shortage of activities they would like you to partake in and they offer cold, hard cash as a reward.

EVENT TYPES

Races: Classic karting rules apply in 6 different race types, use items to take out your opponents and reach the finish in 1st place! 
Time Trials: The islanders are an impatient bunch and need your help to get to their destination as fast as possible, just watch out for obstacles.
Collect: Things are lost, and you have to track them down and run them over with your kart as fast as possible.
Chase: Either hunt down a target or escape from your pursuers.
Deliver: Pick up customers and get them to their destination as quickly as possible in the pursuit of a high score!

KEY FEATURES

- A full story mode with 34 different events in an open world setting.
- Giraffes? Turtles? SHEEP? We’ve got ‘em all. 32 different animals to chat with, race against, and unlock!
- Aim for the gold trophy in 84 challenges, adding a new twist and replayability to events completed in story mode.
- A variety of items to use on opponents and obstacles to avoid, including the homing pizza (delivered in 3 seconds or less), the splatula (get it? Splatula! Cause it splats…) and the aptly named Squish-E-Boi Cube.
- Over 150 collectables to find. Collect coins, gems and smash the mayor’s advertising boards!
- Fully honkable kart horn. HONK!

70010000106507.name: Bean Beasts
70010000106507.intro: Defeat monster hordes alongside your Bean Beasts in this cute, challenging Tower Defense Game! Evolve your companions, explore upgrade paths for traps and take on epic boss battles!
70010000106507.description:
EVOLVE YOUR BEASTS!
Bean Beasts gain experience, evolve and unlock additional attacks. 

USE POWERFUL ABILITIES!
Each Beast comes with a unique special ability and secondary attack. 

UPGRADE YOUR TRAPS!
Choose the path to best suit your strategy.

RE-PATH YOUR FOES!
Use walls to redirect enemies however you see fit.

Game Features:
- 10 unique Bean Beasts, each with 3 evolution stages.
- 12 unique Traps, each with 2 upgrade paths.
- 21 individual player-triggered abilities, including 5 summons.
- 40 hand-crafted levels spanning 5 biomes.
- 8 epic boss encounters.
- Plus 8 endless mode maps.
- A new Beast, Trap or Upgrade unlocked after every level.
- 4 difficulty options - from beginner to beast mode.
- Over 50 different enemies to challenge your tactical skills.
- 2 damage types, 5 damage elements and 7 status effects.
- Use of physics and gravity to shove your opponents.
- Custom music, artwork and juicy sound effects.

70010000106517.name: LogIQ Boost
70010000106517.intro: LogIQ Boost – A fun brain-training game for everyone, with mini-games that test logic, memory, math, reflexes, and creativity.
70010000106517.description:
LogIQ Boost is a fun and educational brain-training game for all ages.
Challenge yourself with 12 exciting mini-games designed to sharpen your logic, memory, math, reflexes, and creativity.

Whether you’re aiming to boost your IQ, improve problem-solving skills, or just have fun, LogIQ Boost offers a perfect balance of entertainment and mental growth.
Play in Single Player Mode to train your brain at your own pace, or test your limits in Survival Mode, where all mini-games appear back-to-back and your brain age is calculated!

Get ready to unlock your potential and enjoy brain training that’s both rewarding and entertaining.

70010000106522.name: Cave of Illusions: Twistyland
70010000106522.intro: A surreal, atmospheric and vivid horror game about a mysterious board game and the little Sophie trapped inside it.
70010000106522.description:
An atmospheric experience putting you back where the previous events left off in the first game of the series. Now focused around a little girl Sophie, her world is consumed when a strange board game catches her attention in a toy store.
Play a horror board game, rolling the dice and exploring each part of it with new gameplay, puzzles, vivid and surreal environments and the creepy clown Vasilus stalking you and leading you into the Cave of Illusions. Explore Quirky Quacker Love Tunnel, Giddy-up Carousel, Hippity Hop Hut, Tip-Toe Treat Trail, Titter Toy Store, Shenanigan Shingles and finally Cave of Illusions.
Vasilus plays with you not only using dice, but cards as well, inside each part of the board game he gives you a useful special card that helps you get through the level, but sometimes it also helps Vasilus too. Please enjoy the very unique, diverse and creepy board game - Cave of Illusions: Twistyland!

70010000106528.name: Penguin Panic!
70010000106528.intro: The walruses stole your eggs. Time to get them back! Run, jump, and stomp your way through 17 vibrant levels in this fast-paced, family-friendly platformer.
70010000106528.description:
The walruses stole your eggs. Time to get them back! Explore the 17 vibrant levels in this fast-paced, family-friendly platformer.

Waddle fast. Jump high. Save your eggs.

The evil walruses have stolen your precious eggs—and Mama Penguin isn’t having it. Dash, dive, and double-jump your way through 17 action-packed levels in Penguin Panic, a charming retro-style platformer full of surprises, secret challenges, and slippery foes!

Inspired by classics like Penguin Adventure on the MSX, Penguin Panic brings retro 2D platformer fun with modern polish. Whether you're bouncing off walrus heads, collecting tasty fish, or racing against the clock, every level is a colorful, fast-paced adventure.

Features

- 17 hand-crafted levels across icy tundras, grassy fields, scorching deserts, and snowy peaks
- Easy controls, satisfying platforming, and loads of hidden secrets
 - No violence, no ads—just pure, penguin-powered fun
- Perfect for kids, nostalgic grownups, and anyone who says “noot noot” unironically
- Made by the award-winning creators of Avalon and Online Soccer Manager (OSM)

Do you have what it takes to outwit the walruses and save your family? Slide into action and find out!

70010000106533.name: Pharmacy Store Simulator
70010000106533.intro: Build, stock, and serve — your pharmacy empire starts here.
70010000106533.description:
Take control of your own pharmacy and manage it from the ground up! Purchase medicines, vitamins, and baby food, arrange products on the shelves, and set prices. Keep everything organized, expand your storage, and serve customers — every step you take affects your profit and the growth of your business.
Economic Management:
- Balance income and expenses to keep your pharmacy profitable.
- Set product prices based on market conditions.
- Monitor financial indicators and store economics to improve your rating and move up in the pharmacists’ association.
Gameplay and Features
-Expand your pharmacy and increase the variety of available products.
-Acquire licenses to sell new types of medicines and related goods.
-Maintain order: arrange products, remove empty boxes, and optimize storage.
-Serve customers yourself: process payments in cash or by card, and handle orders.
-Realistic day/night cycle affecting customer flow.
-Economic strategy and resource management — every decision impacts the success of your pharmacy.
Pharmacy Store Simulator gives you the full experience of running a pharmacy: from small details to large-scale strategic decisions. Prove your management skills and turn your pharmacy into a thriving business!

70010000106538.name: Paint Path
70010000106538.description:
In Paint Path, every step is a brushstroke. This pixel-art puzzle puts you in control of a walking canvas that must cross hexagonal maps to reach the right painters. The atmosphere is charming and relaxing, with sound design tied to each painting action, creating a cozy and artistic experience.

The mechanics are easy to learn but full of possibilities: rotate and swap tiles to build the path, organize paint buckets, and make sure the canvas passes by the painters with the correct color. If you miss the sequence, the painting fails and the level is lost.

The color system is the heart of the game. Mix yellow, blue, and red, clean everything with white, or combine all three to create black. There are 6 possible variations, challenging you to plan the perfect path.

With 30 handcrafted levels, Paint Path starts in the Art Studio, where you learn the basics of painting and color logic. Then the challenge moves to the Art Museum, introducing multiple canvases, more painters, and tri-split tiles that demand even more creative strategies.

Charming, smart, and full of surprises, Paint Path is the perfect puzzle for those who want to relax while thinking.

70010000106550.name: Crescent Tower
70010000106550.intro:
Nostalgia meets innovation!
For the NES™ generation and all RPG fans,
a retro-inspired, 8-bit style dungeon crawl RPG!
70010000106550.description:
A story woven from courage 

A fusion of nostalgia and novelty awaits you!　 
An authentic 8-bit style dungeon crawler RPG packed with retro style, intended for the NES™ generation and all RPG fans! 


■Story 
Crescent Tower, an unprecedented dungeon that appears just once every 50 years in the Imperial Capital Mayirdoam. 
No one knows what lies at the top, yet rumors abound of a jewel that grants any wish the heart desires and of a potion of immortality. To finally discover what lies at the top of such a mysterious tower, nameless adventurers flock to Mayirdoam.... 
You were one of those brave souls who set out to venture into this Crescent Tower. 

■Gameplay mechanics: 
Simple turn-based battles
Easy to pick up but highly strategic turn-based battles. Pixel art characters wage combat on a side-view battle screen! 

Choose a character from 3 races x 9 classes 
Freely create your own character from 3 races and 9 classes (jobs) at the Adventurers' Guild! Your character will grow ever stronger by repeatedly changing jobs while transferring skills already learned. 

View all 10 levels of the dungeon from a 2D top-down perspective
Explore all 10 levels of the dungeon from a 2D, top-down perspective. The search area around you will expand by lighting torches to ensure visibility. 

The dungeon is filled with traps and mysteries... map it out as you proceed!
The 10-level dungeon is littered with various traps. The key to success is to advance while mapping out the area a little bit at a time. 

■Game length 
10 - 20 hours on average

70010000106568.name: Vampire Therapist
70010000106568.description:
Guide vampires through centuries of emotional baggage, decades of delusions and the odd bout of self-loathing with real cognitive behavioral therapy concepts and become a Vampire Therapist! Even vampires need a shoulder to cry on when a neck to bite just won’t do.

STORY
Vampire Therapist is a narrative adventure / therapy simulator in the vein (get it) of What We Do in the Shadows, Young Frankenstein, My Dinner with André, and Horrible Histories where you play as a reformed bloodsucker helping other vampires find inner peace.
This isn't your typical visual novel — featuring a fangtastic cast (such as Matthew Mercer, Sarah Grayson, and Cyrus Nemati), Vampire Therapist teaches real therapy concepts with a story that explores what it means to live, die, live again, and maybe even how to feel alive. Because even vampires deserve to love themselves.
Step into the boots of Sam, a reformed Wild West gunslinger turned vampire therapist. After centuries of bloodshed, Sam teams up with a 3000-year-old blood-sucking mentor in a moody German nightclub, to guide fellow vampires through the twists and turns of their immortal existence — offering them a chance at self-acceptance in a world that feels ever more alien.


FEATURES
1. Real Therapy Concepts: You’ll learn and apply real cognitive behavioral therapy concepts vetted by licensed therapists. By challenging client statements that contain “cognitive distortions”, you’ll help vampires see where their thoughts don’t match reality.
2. A Comedic Look Through History: Meet emotionally damaged vampires from ancient Greece, Renaissance Italy, Tudor England, and the Bronze Age.
3. An All-Star Voice Cast:  Featuring Matthew Mercer (Critical Role, Baldur's Gate 3), Francesca Meaux (Hades), Sarah Grayson (Gone Home, Hades II), Kylie Clark, and the game's creator, Cyrus Nemati (Hades, Pyre).
4. Unique Setting: Vampire Therapist merges cozy self-introspection with a dark European goth vibe. In fact, the whole thing takes above a goth club in Germany filled with willing necks to bite.
5. Minigames: Learn mindfulness meditation, safely and consensually bite sexy necks

NOTE: The game deals with mature and challenging themes that are not for the faint of heart.

70010000106575.name: Mighty Arms
70010000106575.intro: A chaotic physics-based brawler where your fists are both weapon and challenge! Play as John Builder and fight against unhinged construction robots.
70010000106575.description:
A chaotic, physics-based brawler adventure you probably won’t survive unscathed.
Step into the boots of John Builder, the human wrecking ball. Elon Fusk’s construction robots have completely gone haywire, and you’re the last hope for the construction site… and maybe humanity.

Swing your fists, smash robots, tear down walls, and grab a refreshing coffee in between. Sounds easy? Think again. Every punch, every jump is a physics-fueled adventure!

FEATURES
Physics-based brawling – swing your fists like a real construction worker (after too much coffee).
Every hit feels heavy and unpredictable. Chaos guaranteed.

Varied enemies – all out to flatten you.
From drones to demolition bots, they come in waves, and they all hate you.

Unlockable skills – become stronger, faster, and even more chaotic.
Upgrade your fists, sprint like a madman, or unleash devastating special moves.

Just another day on the world’s most dangerous construction site.
So, back to work!

70010000106585.name: Crownfall: Young Hero
70010000106585.intro: The fairy tale, the princess, the hero, and the journey
70010000106585.description:
The valley hides great dangers for a delicate lady in a hurry to reach a safe village, but her young beloved hero will give his life to keep any evil from approaching her.

The kingdom has been invaded, the crown seized, but love protects.
Escort the princess, face the evil enemies, and earn upgrades to keep being the strongest and most loyal to your majesty in distress!
An endless adventure that challenges you to use strategy and skill. Crownfall: Young Hero, the newest beloved hero!

70010000106595.name: Timore 6: The Cadaver
70010000106595.intro: Timore 6: The Cadaver is a psychological horror game and a new story in Timore 6.
70010000106595.description:
The Cadaver is a prequel chapter in the story of Timore 6, showing more about Rosa and how it all started.
The surreal story is a mix of survival horror and psychological atmospheric exploration, weird creatures lurk around here, the mannequins that always look at you and the cryptic and dark backstory of Timore 6 gets more answers as well as new mysteries.

70010000106600.name: Beaked Buccaneer
70010000106600.description:
People used to say that parrots aren't real pirates, that they only belong perched on a captain’s shoulder.

But one particularly ambitious parrot is in search of his own treasures and adventures to become a true pirate, a Beaked Buccaneer!

Explore four different pirate-themed worlds with alternative paths, and defeat the infamous Captain Smelly and his nefarious crew.


Features:
* Metroidvania gameplay
* Colorful 8-bit style graphics
* Four different pirate-themed worlds
* Equipment upgrades and leveling
* Battle pirates and discover treasure

70010000106603.name: Milo's Dream
70010000106603.intro: Embark on a nostalgic action-adventure starring a heroic dog
70010000106603.description:
Milo is a very brave, smart, and playful dog! Only he can defeat the cruel King Big Flea and his evil henchmen who are terrorizing the fairy kingdom.

Explore four magical branching locations, solve challenging puzzles, defeat dangerous enemies, and collect dog bones to earn special new abilities.

Playing solo or together with local co-op multiplayer, only you can help Milo in his all-important quest!


Features:
* 2D action adventure gameplay
* Colorful pixelated 8-bit style graphics
* Cute chiptune style music
* Upgrade gear and level up
* Single player or 2 player co-op

70010000106606.name: Speed Factor
70010000106606.description:
Inspired by 80s and 90s classics, Speed Factor is an old-school racing game with pixelated graphics, arcade driving style, exhilarating punk rock music, and some awesome classic cars!

Customize the difficulty level and traction assist level to your personal tastes to make the game as easy or challenging as you want. Cruise through 50 different tracks spread across 5 locations!

Win races and earn money to level up and improve your ride!


FEATURES
* Classic arcade racing
* 2D pixelated graphics
* 50 diverse tracks in 5 unique locations
* Modify and improve your car
* Punk rock soundtrack

70010000106609.name: Red Pippy
70010000106609.intro: Learn to fly overcoming every challenge possible.
70010000106609.description:
Red Pippy is a charming 2D pixel art platformer that follows the journey of a little red bird in pursuit of its biggest dream: learning to fly!

With each level, Pippy learns new skills as he navigates vibrant and perilous environments, jumping across platforms and overcoming obstacles that bring him closer to his ultimate goal. Will he prove that he's ready to conquer the skies?

Get ready for a journey full of cuteness, adventure, and perseverance in Red Pippy!


Features:
* New abilities are unlocked as the little bird's journey progresses.
* Classic Pixel Art Platformer Style.
* 8-Bit Chiptune Soundtrack.
* Exciting challenges and creative enemies require skill and precision to overcome.
* 60 Levels.

70010000106612.name: Colorizing: Daydream
70010000106612.intro: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation
70010000106612.description:
This coloring book is a guarantee of good mood.
In it you can find all kinds of pictures for every taste.
Coloring by numbers with Colorizing is a calming and easy activity for people of all ages. 
This drawing game is suitable for children and adults, everyone can enjoy pixel coloring.
You will definitely love coloring with this beautiful coloring book!

70010000106617.name: Super Ultimate Fighters X
70010000106617.intro:
The ultimate fighting game featuring over 40 fighters 
from around the world!
70010000106617.description:
Super Ultimate Fighters X is a 2D fighting game.
It brings together martial artists from around the world, including 
Karate, Judo, Sumo, Aikido, Drunken Fist, Mantis Style,
Wing Chun, Taekwondo, Muay Thai, Professional Wrestling, Capoeira, Savate, Boxing, Pankration, Bartitsu, Silat, Lethwei,
Oil Wrestling, and more.
When the technique gauge fills up, a super special move can be unleashed!
VS Mode also features 2-on-2 tag team battles.
Use your unique techniques to fight for victory.

70010000106631.name: CRYZON part1
70010000106631.intro:
Get your hands on crystals!!
Play in split-screen multiplayer for 1-4 players!
30 stages in total! normal and hard difficulty!
70010000106631.description:
Your goal is to use jumps and dashes to obtain crystals on the stage.
The stage is a 3D space with vertical, horizontal, and depth. Gravity is present, and players control their character by moving forward, backward, left, right, and vertically with jumps to reach the crystal.

Features
- Clear the stage once you obtain a crystal!
- 30 stages in total!
- Choose the difficulty level: Normal mode is relatively easy to clear. Hard mode is extremely challenging.
- Collect coins and crystals will appear!
- Split-screen play for up to four players is supported!
- Use items to improve your abilities!

Multiplayer
- Work together to collect coins!
- Be the first to obtain a crystal!

70010000106637.name: UsoNatsu -The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie-
70010000106637.intro: In the midst of their lively school days, three high school girls and one female teacher must contend with confused emotions and harbored LIES...
70010000106637.description:
With brilliant visuals by Shio-Koji and a story composed by Akeo, the yuri visual novel "UsoNatsu -The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie-" is coming to Nintendo Switch™!
2D animation gives the girls a perky liveliness as their engrossing romance is brought to you fully voiced!

2D animations create a more immersive story!
Details such as hand gestures and flowing hair are expressed in the 2D animations, granting the characters more realism and depth of emotion.

Includes the full version of the opening theme!
The full version of the opening theme, "sun shade", is included.
It becomes accessible from the MUSIC option in the main menu after finishing the story.

Playable in three languages!
The text can be set to English, Simplified Chinese, or Japanese (audio is in Japanese only).
This includes in-game text, options, and the digital manual. Language settings can be changed at any time."

Enjoy full HD visuals!
Experience the game in high-definition 1920x1080 resolution by playing in TV Mode.

Touch screen controls and Nintendo Switch Lite are also supported.

Game System
There are no choice-based story branching elements in this visual novel.
You simply watch the story unfold like turning the pages of a book or enjoying an anime or movie.

Story
One night, Tachibana Kaoru, a second-year student at Aoba Dai-ichi High School in Minatocho, confesses her love to her middle school homeroom teacher, Shimotsuki Mirei, only to have her heart broken.
To make matters worse, the moment is witnessed by Minagi Shiori, a diligent classmate of Kaoru's and a model student.
On the brink of despair, Kaoru confides in Shiori about her painful past with Mirei.
Shiori listens silently and then enigmatically posits a peculiar question:
"Instead of forgetting someone you cared about... do you think it's possible to simply overwrite those memories with different ones?"
As their relationship blossoms, Inohara Riku—another student in the same grade and secret admirer of Shiori—also becomes involved, and the three begin to weave the tale of their summer together...

Staff
Original Art: Shio-Koji
Scenario: Akeo

Cast
Tachibana Kaoru    VA: Koichi Makoto
Minagi Shiori    VA: Iwami Manaka
Inohara Riku   VA: Fujimura Konomi
Shimotsuki Mirei    VA: Matsui Eriko
Asahi Kayo    VA: Shibasaki Noriko
Tachibana Koharu   VA: Makita Tsugumi
Tachibana Atsushi   VA: Kageura Daisuke
Minagi Naomasa   VA: Watanabe Hiroshi
*Fully voiced (including the protagonist)

70010000106641.name: Just Place Brain Training One Shot
70010000106641.intro:
Easy Brain Training with Simple Controls
An Illustration Puzzle Game You Can Enjoy with Just One Finger
70010000106641.description:
Add a single line to the illustration to complete the puzzle!
A simple-to-play brain training puzzle game.

With just one stroke of your finger…
Complete the equation with matchsticks!
Escape from tricky situations!

・Who will be the first to figure out the answer?
・It’s also perfect for having fun with a group, or for 　　　　　livestreamers looking to entertain their audience!

[Recommended for:]
・Those who want to test their skills
・layers who want to sharpen their observation
・Anyone who wants to train their brain while killing time
・Puzzle enthusiasts
・Fans of escape games or social deduction games

70010000106652.name: Dungeon Clawler
70010000106652.intro: A roguelike claw machine deckbuilder. Grab weapons, discover powerful synergies, and unleash crazy combos!
70010000106652.description:
Dungeon Clawler mixes deck-building with a dash of roguelike mechanics and most importantly: a claw machine.

To improve his fortune in gambling, the evil dungeon lord has chopped off your left rabbit paw and wears it as a charm. Replacing your lost limb with a trusty claw, you fight your way through the dungeon to reclaim what's yours!

Instead of drawing cards from a deck, your items are physically dropped into a claw machine. Each turn you operate the claw to grab items — what you grab determines your actions for that turn. Size and material matter: larger items give the claw more to grip, while different materials unlock special synergies with your claws and perks.

Find new items and add them to your machine to create game-changing builds. Earn gold coins to upgrade or modify your items and unlock powerful new synergies. You will need to use every trick up your sleeve to reach the evil dungeon lord’s lair at the heart of the dungeon and reclaim your lost paw.

• The ultimate claw machine roguelike experience — control the claw in real time to grab weapons, shields, and items
• Choose from multiple unique characters, each with their own strengths, weaknesses, and special abilities
• Multiple difficulty levels and unlockable lucky paws to customize your run
• Break the game — go crazy with different claw and item synergies
• Venture into mystery locations and discover treasures and dangerous obstacles
• Spend your hard-earned coins in the dungeon’s pachinko machines
• Meet different characters who might help you on your journey

70010000106667.name: PLANET WOW Wildlife Adventure
70010000106667.description:
Dive into an action-packed wilderness in PLANET WOW! 
Choose your favorite animal: Creep through the jungle like a chameleon, slither swiftly as a snake, or rule over rivers and swamps as a crocodile.
Will you be the hunter or the hunted? Only the strongest will survive!

• Play as powerful animals with cool special abilities
• Explore dangerous habitats - deserts, rainforests, swamps and more
• Dodge attacks and get stronger, level by level
• Collect exotic animals and unlock new powers
• Discover exciting facts and become a real expert on animals

70010000106669.name: Motordoom
70010000106669.intro: Motördoom is a freestyle-sports roguelite horde shooter that combines high octane, visceral combat with fluid movement and trick mechanics.
70010000106669.description:
Perform gnarly tricks while defeating grotesque monsters and upgrade your character with demonic offerings to become ever more powerful.

Roguelite Horde Shooter
Combine your trick combo with kills to earn even more points. Once you land your combo, gain experience points as high as the combo score. Earn enough points and you'll be given the choice of one of three random Demonic Offerings. These upgrades grant you more power to defeat the ever growing horde of grotesque monsters. So jump up in the air, slow down time and shoot these demonic abominations!

Demonic Offerings
Demonic Offerings come in the form of cards. Build your deck by choosing the right cards for your build. Unlock new cards for later runs to be prepared for the horrors Motördoom has to offer.

Trick System
Ride your chainsaw driven pit bike through a monster filled arena! Perform gnarly tricks like flips, grabs, grinds and manuals and combine them all into the sickest combo the underworld has ever seen. This arcade-style freestyle sports game will feel instantly familiar to anyone who grew up with classic skateboarding titles. Find your own style and do the tricks that you want.

Unlockable Characters
Choose from different characters and bikes that suite your play style. Unlock new characters with scrap you collect in runs. Each character has it's unique weapon and play style. Choose which one suits your style the best.

Meta Progression
Unlock and equip different bike Add-Ons to aid you in your run. Create different builds that suit your play style.
How about a chainsaw that tears through your enemies?

Features
◆Career Mode (Inspired by classic extreme sports games)
◆Single Run Mode (Highscore Mode)
◆Endless Run Mode (Highscore Mode without Time or Level limit)
◆Free Ride Mode
◆Difficulty settings for all skill levels
◆5 Arenas
◆7 Characters
◆5 Bosses
◆35 different Demonic Offering Cards
◆Unlockable Bike Add-Ons
◆Unlockable Bike and Rider Skins

70010000106674.name: Couple Maker
70010000106674.intro:
It’s a puzzle game where you create couples.
You can freely choose the pairings-man and woman, two men, two women, and more!
70010000106674.description:
- Overview
Place panels with various effects on a 3×3 grid field and aim to clear the stage by pairing up all the characters on the field.
The Nintendo Switch™ version adds 40 brand-new stages, bringing the total to a whopping 116 stages!

 - Gender
By default, couples are formed between a boy and a girl, but in the options you can change the settings to allow pairings such as boy-boy or girl-girl. There are also additional customization options available, such as clothing, hairstyles, and age.

 - Story
The protagonist is a woman in pajamas, as seen in the main visual. Her profession is a romance novelist.
Whenever she comes up with ideas for her novels, she never skips her mental simulations. In her mind, she creates couples, makes them talk, go on dates, and flirt with each other-gradually expanding the image of her story.
This game (a puzzle game about forming couples) represents her fantasies-or rather, the work she does to pay her bills.

70010000106676.name: CreArt – Painting by Numbers
70010000106676.description:
Turn numbers into works of art! 
Choose from over 120 designs, color in each section, and marvel as vibrant images appear before your very eyes. Whether animals, landscapes or artistic designs, experience the perfect escape as you paint. 

• Draw intuitively with your finger – control all your actions directly via the touchscreen, with no additional devices required

• Suitable for any talent level – a range of difficulty levels are available from the first brushstroke to the finished masterpiece 

• Personalize your work – experiment with 8 color palettes and 8 unique painting styles to produce wildly different results 
 
• Smart drawing aids – highlight fields, show/hide numbers, or automatically jump to the next area  

• Flexible painting – you can start a picture, take a break and then resume painting whenever you feel like it 

• Admire your gallery – use time-lapse mode to look back at how your artworks were created

70010000106678.name: Sunset Motel
70010000106678.intro: Ready for the transformation of neglected rooms? Ensure customer satisfaction, renovate interiors, design entertainment spaces!
70010000106678.description:
Step into the enchanting embrace of the Sunset Motel! A haven that caresses weary souls, and encourages travelers to pause and unwind. In this one-of-a-kind simulation experience, start on a journey to breathe life into dilapidated rooms and ensure the radiant smiles of your cherished guests.

Building on Guest Satisfaction:
Experience the stunning transformation of Sunset Motel's rooms! Use vibrant colors on walls, lay new tiles, and adorned with stylish furnishings for unparalleled guest comfort and blissful peace of mind.


Use Your Own Creativity:
Welcome to your motel! This game offers complete freedom in creating a unique space. You decide on every detail. The design of rooms, entertainment areas, and even the pool - all depends on your creativity. Take control and craft a motel that reflects only your unique visions!


Manage your motel:
The success of your motel is measured by the smiles of your guests. As a savvy business owner, skillfully manage your team to ensure the happiness of every customer. Let your motel shine like a star in the hospitality universe, creating a haven where satisfaction is the brightest constellation.


Entertainment and Recreation Facilities:
No more boredom in your motel! Craft your own vibrant entertainment spaces and a refreshing pool. Design areas where your guests can unwind, have fun and create unforgettable memories. Your motel, their playground – let the excitement begin!


Create a place where your travelers are comfortable and want to return every time. At Motel Kingdom, we believe that there is a place where everyone can relax and have fun.

70010000106688.name: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow
70010000106688.description:
《Story》
Tokyo has collapsed. In a city where reality itself is eroding, grotesque entities known as 《Aberrations》 roam the ruined streets.
While working as a simple delivery boy, Souma Hoshigami is brutally attacked by an Aberration—leaving him in a fractured, 'Half-turned' state where man and monster fuse into one. He is rescued and taken into custody not as a citizen, but as 'lost property' by Rena Hizuki, a lethal investigator from the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's Public Safety Department, Foreign Affairs Fifth Division (commonly known as the Public Safety Mutation Response Division).
Step into the shoes of Rena and Souma in a world choking on reality-shattering contamination. 
Track down 'Tiny True,' the demonic narcotic flooding the streets. Uncover the truth behind 'Stigmas,' the cursed body-carved glyphs infecting the youth. Expose the mysterious cult pulling the strings from the shadows. Engage in fast-paced, hyper-stylish combat to slice through terrifying foes and unravel the mystery of a world tearing at the seams.

《Battle System》
Unleash total dominance with a refreshing, high-octane combat system. Master the flow of time itself as you stack and chain devastating skills to obliterate your enemies with massive, satisfying combos.

◆ The Timeline Innovation
Predict. React. Intercept. The combat interface features a dynamic, timeline-driven gauge that exposes the exact timing and nature of incoming enemy attacks.
Use this timeline to program your own skills, shatter enemy offensives, and take complete control of the battlefield.
Slow down time or pause the action at any moment to analyze tactical forecasts, track cooldowns, and execute precise strategies.
Whether you are delivering a punishing counter-attack or slipping buffs into the narrow gaps of an enemy’s onslaught, victory is determined by your strategic intellect.

◆ Master the Speed of Combat
While the timeline offers deep, strategic contemplation, the combat scales with your skill. As you master the mechanics, the gameplay transforms into an aggressive, adrenaline-fueled experience that rivals pure action games!
Will you play with relentless aggression, or stay cool and intellectual to dissect formidable bosses? 
Choose your combat style, slash through bizarre threats with unparalleled flair, and conquer the ultimate anomalies.

《Immersive Voice Acting》
Experience a fully voiced, gripping narrative that drags you straight into the heart of the crisis.

《Cutting-Edge Visuals》
Immerse yourself in a vibrant, cel-shaded art style paired with custom, unsettling shaders designed exclusively to bring the horrific nature of the Aberrations to life in spectacular, bone-chilling detail.

《Searing Soundtracks & Themes》
Ignite your battle spirit with a pulse-pounding opening theme and an electrifying lineup of in-game insert songs that will elevate your gaming experience to new heights.

≪Early Purchase Bonus≫
・Bonus Skins for Rena and Soma
・Extra Battle: Voidfall
*The Extra Battle ""Voidfall"" is scheduled to be sold separately at a later date.

70010000106703.name: Brain Training! Kanji Challenge
70010000106703.intro: Refresh Your Brain While You Play! Kanji & Trivia Quiz
70010000106703.description:
Brain Training! How Do You Write This Kanji?
Think you know it? Everyday kanji you use without noticing are now a quiz!
Can you write them correctly――?

・How to Play

It’s simple!
Look carefully and recall the missing kanji.
Slide the panels to complete the correct character and clear the stage!

・Game Features

Quizzes feature kanji you “know but can’t quite write.”

Use your attention, memory, and quick thinking to challenge your brain!

Confident in your kanji skills? Aim for perfect answers!

Compete against friends and family in speed matches!

Great for quick play anytime—kids and adults alike will get hooked!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation."

70010000106708.name: EGGCONSOLE Revival Xanadu II PC-9801
70010000106708.intro: A remake of the classic action RPG “Xanadu” has arrived—designed for ultra-heavy users, even seasoned Xanadu experts are sure to struggle!
70010000106708.description:
This title is a remake of Xanadu, a real-time action RPG released by Nihon Falcom in 1985, released 10 years later in 1995. Players become adventurers, exploring all 10 stages while fighting monsters, with the ultimate goal of defeating the King Dragon.

Combat uses a symbol-encounter system. Touching a monster triggers a battle scene where you fight with weapon attacks (body slams) and magic. Defeated enemies drop treasure chests with items and money. Monsters are finite and will not reappear if you hunt them all.

The growth system powers up weapons and magic with use. Characters have no professions, but gain Warrior or Wizard experience/levels based on how they defeat enemies. Weapons, armor, and magic also gain individual experience, becoming more effective with use. Since monsters are finite, your management skills are crucial for developing characters and items.

Revival Xanadu II is an entirely new version with changes to the map layout, half of the monsters replaced, and revised parameter balance. As the manual states, "Even Xanadu experts must find their own new playstyle," resulting in a game that's far from straightforward.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000106718.name: Bake it! Pizza Master
70010000106718.intro:
Roll the dough and add toppings to order!
Serve your customers delicious, fresh-baked pizza!
70010000106718.description:
Let's make pizza on the Nintendo Switch™!
Make lots of slices and fill orders one after another!
Keep your slice stock full and serve orders, but don't let anything burn!

Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in the fun!
Bake masterfully and aim for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Make pizzas to order and serve them to your customers!
To earn the most points, prepare perfect pizzas and don't let them burn!
Bake as many pizzas as you can within the time limit!

《How to Play》
1. Place pizza dough on the counter!
2. Roll out the dough and add toppings!
3. Bake the pizza in the oven!
4. When the pizza is done, cut it and stock the slices!
5. Pick 4 slices to box, then serve them to the customer!

[Score Attack]
Earn a high spot on the global leaderboards!
Make pizzas quickly and accurately, fulfill more and more orders, and aim for a new record!

[Battle]
Compete with up to 4 players!
Be faster and more precise than your opponents to win!

70010000106723.name: Revival: Recolonization
70010000106723.intro: Set in a post-apoc version of Earth, Revival is a 4x strategy game where the world and its rules can change at key moments, creating a deep and highly replayable experience.
70010000106723.description:
Explore a transformed planet, negotiate or conquer new territories and bring the light of civilization to regressing human colonies in order to prepare mankind for war with a despotic entity.

ENJOY AN UNPRECEDENTED LEVEL OF FREEDOM!
Revival generates a vast possibility space for you to play around with. From sudden weather changes to zombie infestations and bans on certain weapon types – boy, you are in for a surprise.

Adapt to new conditions with the help of the nuanced edict system that allows you to terraform the planet and fine-tune the game rules on specific regions of the map. Protect your settlement from changes by building special shield constructs or by accepting the blessings of your tribe’s totem tree.

PROGRESS THROUGH THE AGES.
Survivors of the terrible catastrophe that almost destroyed mankind have unique traits and bonuses that affect your gameplay style. Pick the right clan to take under your wing and help your followers evolve through four distinct epochs, all the way to futuristic settlements and breakthrough technology.

ENGAGE IN TACTICAL COMBAT.
Command an army that is suited to your play style by gearing up troops with a variety of components, which can also be crafted. Adapt your tactics in intense turn-based battles by mixing and matching different parts, as well as smartly using destructible cover to defeat your enemies.

EXPLORE EARTH AFTER A DEVASTATING CATACLYSM!
Revival takes place on our own home planet whose landscape and climate have been dramatically transformed. Discover pre-cataclysm artifacts and anomalies with unexpected behaviors. Face off against wild beasts that have evolved to survive in these conditions, as well as fearsome mechanical automatons that roam the lands.

70010000106734.name: EGGCONSOLE Lizard PC-8801
70010000106734.intro: Obtain the Book of Truth from the legendary Lizard Tower! This title is highly acclaimed as one of the finest Japanese-made RPGs from the dawn of PC gaming.
70010000106734.description:
“The princess is cursed!” The entire kingdom erupted in turmoil.

An evil being known as the Great Lizard misused the magic inscribed in the "Book of Truth." This "Book of Truth," which was written with ultimate magic secrets and enshrined in a distant tower, was never to be used by those with evil hearts. Yet, a terrible event has occurred.

The “Book of Truth,” once only a legend, must now return to the hands of one with a righteous heart.

The Great Lizard unleashes terrifying monster doppelgangers and sets numerous magical traps within that legendary old tower, seeking to thwart anyone with a righteous heart.

Can you, the young man who rises for the princess—this story's protagonist—overcome countless challenges, seize the “Book of Truth,” and break the dreadful curse?

This is a role-playing game released in Japan in 1984. Players become adventurers, seeking the “Book of Truth” to lift the princess's curse. The game involves creating a protagonist from one of three classes (Warrior, Thief, Merchant) and takes place within a 10-floor tower (a 3D dungeon). Combat is random encounter, command-based, utilizing close-quarters fighting and items. The tower also features light puzzle elements, offering satisfying gameplay.

This title, a masterpiece from the dawn of Japanese RPGs, delivers enjoyable 3D dungeon adventure in a simple yet engaging style.

70010000106737.name: CRAYON FOOD
70010000106737.intro:
Color delicious foods with your crayons!
Create sweet desserts and tasty dishes by hand.
Bring your food art to life with realistic crayon textures!
70010000106737.description:
Crayon Food is the newest entry in the Crayon series after Crayon Car, Crayon Dinosaur, and Crayon Halloween.
This time, a world of delicious food comes to life in color!
Cupcakes, pizza, gimbap, ice cream — color them your way!
Enjoy coloring peacefully alone or share the fun with family and friends.
Collect your finished food art and create your own colorful recipe book!

70010000106747.name: CRAYON HALLOWEEN
70010000106747.intro:
Color the Crayon Halloween items.
Talk about Halloween with Mom and Dad.
70010000106747.description:
Bring ghosts, pumpkins, witches, and friendly monsters to life with your own colors. Whether you create a spooky masterpiece or a funny Halloween scene, the choice is yours!

Features:

A natural coloring experience that feels just like using real crayons

Realistic textures where colors blend and layer beautifully

Seasonal Halloween themes like haunted houses, trick-or-treat adventures, and black cats

Fun facts and light educational tidbits about Halloween traditions around the world

Enjoy coloring peacefully on your own, or share the fun with friends and family during the festive Halloween season. Complete unique drawings, collect medals, and let your creativity shine!

Get ready for a magical Halloween adventure with Crayon Halloween!

70010000106752.name: CRAYON CHRISTMAS
70010000106752.intro:
Colour a warm and joyful Christmas with your crayons!
Step into a snowy village full of presents, trees, and Santa’s cheerful stories.
70010000106752.description:
Crayon Christmas is the heartwarming winter edition of the beloved Crayon series.
Colour shimmering trees, gift boxes, Rudolph, and snowmen to create your own festive world.
With textures and shades that feel like real crayons, the cosy warmth of winter comes alive.
Relax alone or share the fun of colouring with your family during the holiday season.
Complete your drawings and build your very own Christmas gallery!

70010000106757.name: Hentai Party: Summer Paradise
70010000106757.description:
Welcome to the party where the most daring and beautiful images await you!
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Realistic assembly process.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.

70010000106773.name: Mage Arena: Voice of Power
70010000106773.description:
In Mage Arena: Voice of Power, every battle is fought not with buttons, but with your own voice. Speak with precision, command mystical forces, and watch as your words shape reality in the arena. Your voice is the key to unleashing devastating attacks, shielding yourself from harm, and bending the fight to your will.

Step into a living, ever-changing magical island where arenas shift and resources abound. Gather rare materials, craft powerful tools, and outthink your rivals as you climb toward ultimate mastery.

Your mission? Breach enemy strongholds, seize their flag, and prove your dominance in the ancient feud between mages and warlocks.

(And yes, yelling random words at your screen is now officially “tactical.”)

70010000106778.name: Primal Planet
70010000106778.intro: Unveil a heartfelt story of family, dinosaurs, and UFOs! Craft, upgrade, and survive in a realm of primeval predators, alone or in co-op. Welcome to the Dinovania!
70010000106778.description:
Primal Planet is a solo developed metroidvania that combines survival and crafting elements with a pixel-perfect aesthetic and an action-packed story, and it's all taking place on a lush planet filled with dinosaurs.

Uncover the Story
Embark on a thrilling journey as you follow the gripping tale of a cave dweller fighting to protect his family. Survive a brutal T-Rex attack and uncover a narrative blending the wild with intriguing sci-fi twists. Forge unexpected alliances as you unravel the truth behind an alien presence.

Adapt and Survive
Survival in the wilderness demands cunning. Use natural resources to craft vital tools, weapons, and mixtures for healing and protection. Gain experience and upgrade your skills to overcome the countless dangers of a primal planet.

Explore the Primeval
Discover diverse biomes, each with unique challenges and secrets. Traverse dense forests, sprawling plains, treacherous mountains, and mysterious ocean depths where danger awaits. Encounter a vast array of dinosaurs, from the majestic Apatosaurus to the terrifying Carnotaurus, each perfectly adapted to its habitat.

Fight and Be Clever
Experience gameplay blending combat and strategy. Adapt to face ancient beasts and aliens alike. Tailor tactics, use crafted weapons, bait, traps, and stealth to master encounters with regular and boss enemies. Every confrontation tests your skill and cunning.

Play Local Co-op
Team up with a friend in local co-op where player 2 can jump in at any time as Sino the nimble sinosauropteryx, your faithful companion. Work together to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, and battle foes as your bond strengthens, skills increase and Sino grows up to become a fierce and loyal friend.

In Primal Planet, your journey from a humble cave dweller to the planet's last hope is filled with danger, wonder, and the unbreakable bonds of family. Are you ready to rise to the challenge?

70010000106783.name: ACA NEOGEO POP'N BOUNCE
70010000106783.intro: Grow them big and BLAST THEM TO PIECES!
70010000106783.description:
"POP'N BOUNCE" is a brick breaker released by VIDEO SYSTEM in 1997.
Enemy characters serving as blocks fuse into a single unit when adjacent enemies are the same color.
Connect as many as possible to make them grow, then take them down to score massive points and earn power-up items!

The "ACA NEOGEO" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000106793.name: Project 7: Escape Room
70010000106793.intro: An escape room inspired adventure. Unravel the mystery, or risk becoming another forgotten part of Project 7.
70010000106793.description:
Eighteen months have passed since the mysterious disappearance of renowned inventor and physicist Dr. Hillman. Whispers of his secret experiment, known only as Project 7, still echo through the halls of his abandoned mansion. Intrigued by the mystery, you decide to spend a night at the mansion, unaware of what awaits you.

Woken in the dead of night, you find yourself trapped in your room. Your only way out is to dig deeper into the mansion’s secrets, solving intricate puzzles and deciphering the mysterious notes left by Dr. Hillman. Each discovery pulls you closer to the truth behind Project 7.

About

Project 7 is a first-person 3D escape room puzzle adventure, inspired by classic 90s titles and modern virtual escape rooms. Explore an immersive indoor world, collect and use items you find along the way, solve puzzles, and escape the rooms.

Play as an investigator looking into the disappearance of a physicist working on a top secret experiment called Project 7. Explore the mansion, study your surroundings, and use all your puzzle-solving skills to discover the secret of Project 7.

Every puzzle has a logical solution. Take your time, there is no rush. Enjoy figuring out what you need to do.

Features

• Explore an immersive 3D mansion, solve puzzles, and collect items
• Physics-based interactions, pick up, rotate, and move objects
• Original 3D visuals, rich environments, and atmosphere to explore
• Immersive soundtrack and effects that pull you into the adventure

70010000106801.name: Beat The Champions
70010000106801.intro: A fast-paced arcade football game where legendary players clash in explosive matches powered by special abilities. No realism — just speed, skill, and pure competitive chaos.
70010000106801.description:
Beat the Champions is arcade football pushed to the extreme. Face legendary players in explosive matches full of rhythm, skill, and special abilities. Charge up and unleash your powers, control the pitch with precise movements, and make split-second decisions. Timing changes everything.

Outside the box, there are no fouls, creating constant action, riskier confrontations near the goal, and decisive moments that can change the match in an instant. Every game is dynamic and unpredictable, whether in quick matches or tournaments.

Plus, you can choose from historic Argentina National Team squads thanks to the official license of the Argentine Football Association (AFA). Score goals and make incredible plays with Messi, Maradona, Batistuta, and many other Albiceleste legends.

Beat the Champions is guaranteed fun for a World Cup year.


* Special Abilities System
* Argentina National Teams from all eras, officially licensed by AFA
* 100% Arcade Gameplay
* Dynamic and Intense Matches
* No fouls, except inside the box
* Local and Competitive Modes
* Experience the International Cup with 2026 atmosphere

70010000106803.name: Juiced Fruit Racing
70010000106803.intro: Splash and smash your friends in this juicy party kart racing game! Make and take speedy shortcuts as you compete against the sweetest competition.
70010000106803.description:
COUCH MULTIPLAYER CRAZINESS

Up to 4 players can compete in spit-screen action. Party scoring means nobody is ever out of the game. Random tracks are picked until a player reaches 15 points. That means each round of fun can be from under ten minutes to as long as it takes to crown a winner!

MAKE AND TAKE YOUR OWN SHORTCUTS

Power-up items are all about juice. Leave a trail of your color while cutting across rough terrain, then drive on it again next lap. Or leave yourself bouncy fruit bumps to jump over walls and obstacles. Just watch out, you may reveal your secret early and allow other players to take it for themselves! Other players' juice will slow you down.

TIGHT CONTROLS AND HANDLING

Familiar, responsive controls work for all racing styles, whether you're a drift wizard or a safe driver. Quick acceleration and short spinouts mean you'll always be in control and part of the action.

16 TRACKS AND COUNTING

There are 16 unique tracks with tight corners, hills and valleys, and lots of boosts. Each has multiple hidden shortcuts ready to be found and used for the win!

70010000106806.name: TOKI NO MEIRO ~ From the Age of Dinosaurs to the Edo Period ~ By Gentaro Kagawa
70010000106806.intro: Navigate challenging mazes, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden illustrations. Can you collect all the "Time Stones" and make it back to the present day?
70010000106806.description:
Journey Through Time: A Maze Adventure!

Embark on an incredible adventure, starting in the age of dinosaurs, moving through the Jomon and Yayoi periods, and finally arriving in Edo Japan!

Navigate challenging mazes, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden illustrations. Can you collect all the "Time Stones" and make it back to the present day?



Conquer Tricky Mazes!

Strategize your way through intricate mazes, collecting Time Stones scattered throughout each historical era. These aren't just any mazes; they're designed with unique conditions for reaching the goal, testing your critical thinking and spatial reasoning skills!



Solve Quizzes and Find Hidden Pictures!

Dive into detailed illustrations from each period to solve quizzes and discover hidden pictures. Even adults will get hooked on the challenge, making it fun for the whole family! Each era also features playful hidden elements that will make you wonder, "Why is this here in this time period?" As you play, you'll sharpen your observation skills and learn fascinating facts about each historical era.



Exciting Updates Ahead!



Get ready for more thrilling new content coming soon!

Terms of Service: https://www.dreamonline.co.jp/products/tokinomeiro/license/agreement.html

70010000106814.name: CRAYON ANIMAL
70010000106814.intro:
Color cute animals with crayons!  
Bring the animals of the forest, farm, and ocean to life in your own colors.
70010000106814.description:
Crayon Animal is the newest entry in the Crayon series following Crayon Food, Crayon Dino, and Crayon Halloween.  
This time, a world full of lovable animals comes to life through coloring!  
Color cats, dogs, lions, penguins, and more in any colors you like.  
Relax and paint alone or enjoy a fun coloring time with your family.  
Collect your finished artwork and build your very own crayon zoo!

70010000106819.name: Frost Survival - Winter
70010000106819.intro: Every hunt, every build, and every step matters in the frozen wild.
70010000106819.description:
After a brutal wolf attack, the protagonist regains consciousness alone in a snow-covered mountain and forest wilderness. There is nothing around him but cold wind, deep snow, and signs of wild animals. Injured, exhausted, and almost without equipment, he must face a world where winter itself is the main enemy.
To survive, he must hunt, search for food, gather resources, and find shelter. Without fire, there is no warmth. Without proper clothing, the night cannot be endured. Every step through the snow drains precious strength.
At the same time, the search for a missing friend drives the story forward. While exploring the mountainous and forest landscape, players discover scattered notes that reveal clues and unlock new crafting recipes. These discoveries gradually expand survival possibilities and move the narrative ahead.
It is a journey through cold, isolation, and constant decision-making.

Key Features:
	•	Harsh Winter Survival — cold, hunger, and exhaustion directly affect the character’s condition.
	•	Hunting and Food Gathering — track and hunt animals to survive.
	•	Crafting System — create tools, weapons, clothing, campfires, and drying racks.
	•	Recipe Unlocking Through Notes — discover new crafting options by finding scattered notes.
	•	Story-Driven Progression — advance the narrative while surviving in the wilderness.
	•	Snowy Mountain and Forest World — inhabited by wolves, bears, rabbits, deer, and boars.
	•	Dynamic Weather — changing conditions enhance atmosphere and survival challenge.


Frost Survival – Winter is a steady struggle for survival in a cold and unforgiving environment. Every resource matters, every discovery strengthens you, and every step through the snow brings you closer to endurance — or failure.

70010000106827.name: Chronoquartz
70010000106827.intro: In Chronoquartz, every move matters! You have 10 turns per loop: explore, solve puzzles, and use your past knowledge to progress.
70010000106827.description:
You'll need to use the knowledge gained from previous loops to progress further in the game. This will allow you to open coded doors, take secret passages, know the location of objects, and discover the fastest paths to reach your destination.

With each loop, you'll need to decide which path to take and which object to retrieve to reach your goal. Your number of turns is limited, so choose wisely.

To gain new insights into the game, you'll need to solve puzzles that span one or more loops. Meticulous planning is essential, because remember: every move counts.

All the information you gather might help you thwart Morthas' plans. He wants to seize the Chronoquartz and manipulate history. Time needs you: will you succeed to save it?

70010000106829.name: Beyond Words
70010000106829.intro: Beyond Words is a genre-defining fusion of roguelike strategy and word-crafting.
70010000106829.description:
This game requires a good level of understanding of the English language in order to play.
 
Beyond Words
The genre-defining fusion of roguelike strategy and word-crafting. Build powerful combos, unlock upgrades, and master a challenge where victory is spelled one letter at a time.
 
 Build powerful word combos, unlock game-changing upgrades and journey through a living puzzle shaped by your decisions. Every choice, every letter, every placement matters.
 
It's Time To Spell!
Play your own way by switching up letter scores, duplicating the ones you love and destroying the ones you don’t. Bend the rules past breaking point with modifiers, stickers, and enhancements where every choice shapes your journey. Think your way through seemingly impossible situations or pick up the pace and go fast and frantic with optional time-attack boards. 
 
Evolve and Adapt 
Over 300 unique modifiers and abilities — supercharged tile types, booster cards, power cards, pickups & perks.
 
Endless combinations bring surprise and opportunity for your creative strategies. It’s all about synergies, combos, and clever play — where every decision can dramatically alter the course of a run. As you progress, your expanding toolbox rewards you with new possibilities every time you play.
 
Master Challenges
Each board is a unique puzzle where your words matter. Shifting rules, layouts and objectives keep you adapting in an evolving tactical space. Be a friend to your future self - plan ahead, create routes to powerful pickups and think like a strategist setting up devastating power-scoring combos for that perfect chef’s-kiss word play.
 
Bosses with Bite
Overcome 30+ unique Boss challenges that twist the rules in devious ways. When you’re ready to push further, take on time attacks, seeded runs or the brain-melting flipside of negative scoring. Escalating targets and endless play mean there’s always an opportunity to flex your skills in gratifying challenges which demonstrate your level of mastery.
 
Instantly Playable, Infinitely Replayable
Easy to pick up thanks to familiar word-tile mechanics while incredibly rewarding to master, welcoming both casual players and hardcore strategists. Whether you’re chasing the highest scores, experimenting with outrageous synergies or simply relaxing into the rhythm of letters and logic - Beyond Words is a playground for endless discovery where every word counts.

70010000106831.name: HORSE STORE SIMULATOR
70010000106831.intro: Your rural horse shop adventure awaits every eager visitor.
70010000106831.description:
Step into Horse Store Simulator, a charming management game where every product, shelf, and customer plays a role in a bustling rural marketplace. Begin with a small, simple shop and gradually expand it into a fully equipped store with a barn, warehouse, and a wide variety of goods. Experience the satisfaction of building and managing your own countryside business while creating a unique shopping environment.

Key Features:
• Expand and upgrade your store, barn, and warehouse to handle more goods and improve efficiency.
• Manage inventory, set prices, and arrange products on shelves, pallets, and racks for optimal display.
• Interact with realistic customers, manage queues, and provide smooth shopping experiences.
• Customize your store layout and merchandising to make your shop visually appealing.
• Enjoy a cozy rural atmosphere with detailed interiors, outdoor environments, and a distinctive visual style.

Take your small shop from humble beginnings to a thriving rural enterprise. Through careful management, upgrades, and customer interaction, create your own unique trading empire and enjoy the rewarding challenge of running the perfect countryside store.

70010000106836.name: Hentai Party: Bikini Beach
70010000106836.description:
Welcome to the party where the most daring and beautiful images await you!
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Realistic assembly process.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.

70010000106841.name: Psyvariar 3
70010000106841.intro: Play as one of 7 pilots in this thrilling sequel to a SHMUP classic. The time has come for a new generation of Psyvariars to rise… and save humanity.
70010000106841.description:
THE STORY OF PSYVARIAR 3

Psyvariar 3 takes place many years after the events of Psyvariar 2. After the fall of ETA, a faction of Psyvariars declared that Earth was too precious to be forsaken.
They vowed to reclaim and colonize it once more, with GUIS rising from its ashes to resume its original mission.
Decades pass. The Earth colony thrives.

Then… a signal. Alien. Unknown.

The moment Gluon particles are detected, dread spreads like fire. The skies darken with a familiar terror—Earth is under siege once again. The time has come for a new generation of Psyvariars to rise… and save humanity.

CONTENT & FEATURES

- Seven Playable Characters with unique shot types, buzz & bomb mechanics, and scoring systems.
- Guest character: Cotton from the Cotton series is fully playable with her own ship and abilities
- Refined Buzz System that rewards skillful bullet grazing with score boosts and shield chains
- Signature Roll Mechanic updated for modern controllers all the while preserving the original Arcade “wiggle” input for extra advantage and fluid movement
- Neutrino & Shield System that give access to shields, speed boosts, and enhanced weapons by buzzing and shooting
- Strategic Bomb Variations that include short and long types with varying effects depending on the character in use
- Multiple Game Modes: Arcade, Arrange, Mission (49 short challenges), Caravan, Endless, and Practice
- Dynamic Difficulty Selection that unlocks harder routes and exclusive boss encounters based on performance
- Seven Distinct Areas and Bosses with varied attack patterns depending on the difficulty
- Arcade-Perfect Intensity that preserves the intense, high risk/high reward action the series is known for
- Neo retro 3D aesthetics inspired by early Psyvariar games

MORE ABOUT PSYVARIAR

Born in 2000 with the launch of the original Psyvariar: Medium Unit in Japanese Arcades, the Psvyariar series has since then made its mark over the years. Psyvariar 3 is the highly anticipated sequel to the acclaimed vertical Shoot ’em Up series.

Designed with deep reverence for the franchise by lovers of the genre, Psyvariar 3 is the result of the collaboration between Banana Bytes (Sophstar), Red Art Games and Red Art Studios, with the blessing of IP holder SUCCESS. It builds on the franchise’s signature “buzz” mechanic while introducing new characters, refined controls, and a variety of game modes. With its seven unique pilots, each with distinct abilities and scoring systems, it also remains faithful to its Arcade roots while delivering enhanced replay value and accessibility for today’s players.

70010000106843.name: Sonic Wings Reunion
70010000106843.intro: Play as one of 10 pilots in this thrilling sequel to an arcade classic. Fly across the world and destroy the shadowy organization Fata Morgana!
70010000106843.description:
SONIC WINGS REUNION is a sequel to the arcade-style shooting game SONIC WINGS, also known as Aero Fighters in the West. The previous version was sold in 1998.

Choose from up to 10 characters and destroy the mysterious organization “Fata Morgana” that has progressed into the modern world. The scenario changes depending on the combination of characters.

Features

- Eight initial characters and hidden characters that can be unlocked under certain conditions.
- Eight stages (including bonus stages) in which players fight in cities and locations in the modern world.
- Giant futuristic weapons from the original game.
- Local cooperative play is supported. Conversation scenarios are changed by cooperative play.
The co-op scenarios can be enjoyed in single-player mode as well.

Three sound modes are available.
The original sound mode is composed by Sonic Wings series sound composer Soshi Hosoi.
In the Arrange Sound Mode, the music of previous titles is completely arranged by Japan's most renowned sound creator. The user can set the music to be played.
In Mao Mao mode, Mao Mao's song is played as background music.

In Training Mode, users can set the difficulty level, invincibility, barriers, etc. to best suit their training needs.
Leaderboards are supported.

70010000106845.name: Obby Kingdom
70010000106845.intro: Do you have what it takes?
70010000106845.description:
Welcome to Obby Kingdom, an exciting parkour challenge set in the ruins of a once-great castle. The castle grounds are crumbling and flooded, and only the best players can jump, climb, and run their way to freedom!

Castle-Themed Obby – Traverse broken walls, collapsing bridges, and waterlogged ruins.

Choose Your Path!
>Easy Mode: With checkpoints to help you along the way.
>Hardcore Mode: No checkpoints—only true skill! But if you survive, you unlock a bonus level.

Parkour Adventure – Put your jumping and timing skills to the test across tricky obstacles.

Do you have what it takes to conquer the kingdom’s broken halls and rise as a true Obby Champion?

70010000106852.name: Pirate Simulator - Corsair Skull & Sails
70010000106852.intro: Every battle at sea brings you closer to freedom… or doom.
70010000106852.description:
Your crew plundered a forgotten Mayan temple-and paid the ultimate price. Cursed by ancient gods, you and your ship are bound to the Pirate Grotto, doomed to rise again after every fall. Rival captains, empowered by stolen idols, now rule the seas. To break the curse, you must hunt them down, reclaim the relics, and face the truth that binds your entire crew. Sail across dangerous sea charts, from storm-lashed coasts to haunted wreck zones. Engage rival ships in ferocious naval battles, then clash steel and pistol on deck in brutal duels.
