Each defeat drags you back to the grotto, but every return pushes you closer to lifting the curse that chains your souls.

Key Features:
	•	Epic Story Campaign: Follow the tale of your cursed crew, bound to the Pirate Grotto and haunted by Mayan relics.
	•	Naval & On-Foot Combat – Battle rival ships in real-time sea clashes, then take the fight to the decks with swords, daggers, and pistols.
	•	Progression & Customization: Enhance your ship, expand your arsenal, and equip rare gear to refine your playstyle.
	•	Unique Sea Charts: Every map brings distinct challenges and environments, from whirlpools to skull-shaped cliffs.
	•	Souls-like Challenge: Death is not the end. Each defeat returns you to the grotto, forging resilience and driving you closer to your final victory.
	•	Varied Enemy Encounters: Face everything from nimble raiders to heavily armed warships, each demanding different tactics.

In Pirate Simulator – Corsair Skull & Sails, every voyage tests your strength. Every defeat sharpens your resolve. Only by facing the sea’s deadliest captains can you break the curse and set your crew free.

70010000106858.name: Arcade Archives GALACTIC WARRIORS
70010000106858.intro: Galactic Fighters: Which mecha will you pilot, which weapon will you fight with?
70010000106858.description:
"GALACTIC WARRIORS" is a fighting game released by KONAMI in 1985.
Join the "Robot Fighting" event, a major craze among galactic humanity in Cosmic Year HIT 30,000, and aim for victory.
Your protagonists are three beloved machines: SAMSON, GAEA, and POSEIDON.
The warriors of the cosmos roar through the stadium!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000106863.name: Find It, Detective！
70010000106863.intro: Find the hidden mysteries in cute illustrations!
70010000106863.description:
This game lets you train your brain while playing detective in fun and colorful illustrations.
Your mission is to find the hidden character within the time limit.

How to Play:

Carefully observe the character you need to find

Search for that character hidden in the scene

When you spot it, tap it before time runs out!

Game Features:

Characters may look easy to spot at first…
but the time limit makes the challenge surprisingly tricky!

Put your attention, focus, and detective skills to the test!

Stuck? Don’t worry—
the hint button will gently guide you by pointing out the general area.

Play Styles:

Supports both button and touch controls.

Play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000106878.name: JDM Pixel Street Car Racing
70010000106878.intro: Race fast, drift hard, and claim victory in pixel streets.
70010000106878.description:
Get ready to dive into the exciting and adrenaline-fueled world of JDM Pixel Street Car Racing, where legendary Japanese cars meet the thrill of high-speed street races and heart-stopping drifts. Whether you’re a die-hard car enthusiast or simply a lover of classic arcade-style racing games, this pixelated adventure promises endless fun and challenges. Build your reputation, fine-tune your vehicles, and show the streets who’s the ultimate drift master!

Key Features:
• Collect and Customize JDM Cars: From iconic Japanese sports models to legendary drift machines, choose from a vast lineup of cars that you can modify and personalize to fit your racing style.
• Intense Races and Drifts: Master the art of drifting across challenging urban circuits, compete in fierce races, and prove your driving skills against elite street racers.
• Retro Pixel-Art Graphics: Experience a nostalgic visual style that blends classic pixel aesthetics with smooth modern gameplay.
• Upgrades and Tuning: Fine-tune your car’s engine, suspension, aerodynamics, and more to build the ultimate racing machine.
• Vibrant Urban Worlds: Explore beautifully crafted pixelated cityscapes, from neon-lit streets to hidden circuits designed to test your driving abilities.

Are you ready to conquer the pixelated streets and become the undisputed JDM champion? Buckle up, rev your engine, and drift your way to victory in JDM Pixel Street Car Racing!

70010000106898.name: Monsters in Cards
70010000106898.intro: Plan your moves and build your army in this monster card game
70010000106898.description:
Monsters in Cards is a turn-based strategy game where each card represents a monster with a specific type of attack. Plan your moves carefully, choose the perfect moment to strike, and defeat your opponents in tactical battles that test your strategy and control.

Throughout the campaign, you’ll be able to acquire new monster cards from the shop by earning coins and prestige — rewards gained through battles and victories. Each new monster you unlock brings fresh tactical possibilities, allowing you to assemble the perfect army to take on increasingly challenging enemies.

70010000106909.name: Ariana and the Elder Codex
70010000106909.intro: Restore the Codices and unravel the Library's hidden truths...
70010000106909.description:
About Ariana and the Elder Codex
The Librarian Ariana's mission is to repair the Seven Hero Codices, which have been altered. Due to the terrible damages, magic has vanished from the world.

By utilizing special Librarian magic that allows her to enter Codices, Ariana seeks to mend the books to bring back magic. Can Ariana safely repair each tome and unravel the mysteries hidden within the Library?

Key Features
Restore the books, reclaim the magic — Venture into the Seven Hero Codices as Ariana, defeating enemies to earn new magic spells and abilities that grant access to previously unreachable areas. Restore Repair Points by taking on platforming and combat challenges that put your abilities to the test. Clear Repair Points as quickly as possible for permanent HP boosts and more!

Librarian Magic materializes — With 30+ unlockable magic spells and abilities, mix and match them across six slots as you embark on your journey to repair the altered Codices. Experiment with different combinations to discover what best suits your playstyle.

Clash with the guardians of the altered Codices — Face formidable bosses, each with a devastating arsenal that will test your combat and platforming skills. Dodge spells, time your attacks, and stay on top of your health to prevail.

Harness the power of Magic Items — Mitigate challenges by unlocking, crafting, and equipping Magic Items to boost stats and gain buffs such as elemental boosts, increased critical hits, reduced knockback, and more!

70010000106918.name: Ultimate Romance Test
70010000106918.intro: 100 questions to reveal your one-and-only love destiny!
70010000106918.description:
「Ultimate Romance Test」 is a game that comprehensively analyzes your outlook on love and your romantic type by answering 100 questions with four choices.

As you work through the questions, hidden romantic tendencies you never noticed in yourself — and the timing when love is most likely to go your way — will be revealed!

「Wait, so this is my love destiny?」
「So much fun to do with friends!」

Perfect as a tool for reflecting on your own love life, or as a party diagnosis game to enjoy with friends or on stream.

※In handheld mode, you can play with your Nintendo Switch™ held vertically.
※Button controls are also supported, so you can enjoy it in Tabletop Mode and TV Mode too.

———————————————
MASK supports gameplay streamers.
No permission from MASK is required for gameplay streaming, whether personal or commercial.

70010000106928.name: Sumikkogurashi Create a Wonderful Sumikko Island!
70010000106928.intro: Enjoy creating a cozy island that matches the seasons with the Sumikko!
70010000106928.description:
In this game, you'll build a cozy island together with Sumikko.
Collect materials, fulfill Sumikko's requests, create various items, and decorate the island to make it popular!
The more the island becomes popular and developed, the more features are unlocked, like expanding areas and attracting other Sumikko to the island, so let's work together with Sumikko and create a wonderful island!

■Fulfill Sumikko's request and make them happy!
Sumikko will make all sorts of "requests".
Fulfill them to raise Sumikko's "Joy Meter"!
These requests are time-sensitive, so don't forget to fulfill them.

■Gather materials with Sumikko!
Shirokuma, Penguin?, Tonkatsu, Neko and Tokage will gather the materials you need to build the island.
When the player helps gather too, the amount of materials obtained increases!

■Island-Building Fun!
Use coins and the materials you gathered with Sumikko to create items you can place on the island.
The Place items that you made can be freely placed within the layout area!

■Create an island that matches the seasons!
On the island, there are four seasons. Not only does the scenery change, but you can also buy season-limited items at the shop, and enjoy lots of different seasonal events!
To make your island match the current season, you'll need to raise "Season Points“ that show how close you are to matching the season.
Get more Season Points by placing items with the same Season Points as the island's current season!

■Enjoy Sumikko's cute moments!
Sumikko will freely play or unwind using the items you place on the island to pass the time!

70010000106933.name: Planet Romance Girls: Conquer the Zodiac Horoscope
70010000106933.intro:
Flirt with planets. Fall for the universe.
The stars aren’t just watching you—they want you.
70010000106933.description:
What if every planet had a heart?

In Planet Romance Girls: Conquer the Zodiac Horoscope, the solar system comes to life... literally.

Each planet takes human form as a mysterious, beautiful girl shaped by cosmic energy and emotion.

As you get closer, they begin to humanize—their celestial glow softening as real feelings awaken.
But love between a mortal and a planet was never meant to be simple…

Will you teach the stars what love truly means, or will the universe shatter your heart first?


Game Features

● Date the planets themselves – Mercury’s charm, Venus’s allure, Saturn’s mystery… each world hides a girl with a soul to discover.

● Watch them transform – Your choices awaken emotions that turn planets into humans—body and heart.

● Zodiac romance simulator – A surreal, cosmic journey through astrology, destiny, and desire.

● Multiple endings – Will your love rewrite the constellations… or fade into stardust?


It’s magical.
It’s cosmic.
It’s love written in the stars.

Are you ready to fall for the planets?

70010000106938.name: Arcade Archives MIDNIGHT LANDING
70010000106938.intro: The runway is in sight, let's make it a smooth landing!
70010000106938.description:
"MIDNIGHT LANDING" is a flight simulation game released by TAITO in 1987.
You take control of an aircraft soaring through the midnight sky, with the goal of landing safely at the airport.
The lights of the runway come into view, signalling the end of your journey through the night.
Bring it to a perfect close with a beautiful landing.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000106953.name: Santa's Christmas Story 2 The Frozen Gift War
70010000106953.intro: The gifts are frozen, the enemies are fierce — Santa’s coming to save Christmas again!
70010000106953.description:
Santa’s Christmas Story 2: The Frozen Gift War is a festive platformer adventure!
Play as Santa, collect lost gifts, run through icy worlds, and battle frozen enemies. Face fun challenges, unlock power-ups, and defeat the Boss to save Christmas!

70010000106958.name: Planet Romance Boys: Conquer the Zodiac Horoscope
70010000106958.intro:
Flirt with planets. Fall for the universe.
The stars aren’t just watching you—they want you.
70010000106958.description:
What if every planet had a heart?

In Planet Romance Boys: Conquer the Zodiac Horoscope, the solar system comes to life... literally.

Each planet takes human form as a mysterious, beautiful boy shaped by cosmic energy and desire.

As you flirt, they begin to humanize—their celestial essence fading as emotions awaken.
But love between a mortal and a planet was never meant to be simple…

Will you teach the stars how to love, or will the universe break your heart first?


Game Features:

● Date the planets themselves – Mercury’s wit, Mars’s fire, Saturn’s melancholy… every world hides a soul to discover.

● Watch them transform – Your choices awaken emotions that turn planets into humans—body and heart.

● Zodiac romance simulator – A surreal, otherworldly journey through astrology, desire, and fate.

● Multiple endings – Will your love rewrite the stars… or burn the cosmos down?


It’s weird.
It’s cosmic.
It’s love on a universal scale.

Are you ready to flirt with the planets?

70010000106964.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps
70010000106964.intro: Explore Bluey's world like never before, play games & snap fun memories!
70010000106964.description:
EXPLORE BLUEY'S WORLD LIKE NEVER BEFORE!
Time to play! Explore, have fun and capture your favorite moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered game. 
Look out for familiar spots from the show, create your own scrapbook and turn in-game memories into playful moments for real life.

SAY CHEESE! 
Bluey and Bingo have found Dad's old camera (back from when he was cool). 
Take it with you around the world of Bluey and snap photos of the games they play and wildlife they discover. Each snapshot is saved to Bluey's scrapbook, where players can keep their favorite moments.

PLAY GAMES
Join everyone’s favourite blue heeler in Bluey’s Happy Snaps, a playful interactive adventure inspired by the hit TV series. Explore familiar locations, play with loads of toys, or chase cheeky bin chickens, and enjoy fun activities with Bluey, Bingo, and friends. 

DISCOVER AND VISIT BLUEY'S FAVORITE PLACES
Players can explore many of Bluey’s most beloved play spots from the show. Chase water dragons on the riverbank from the episode “Ice Cream,” capture the city skyline from the lookout in “The Sign,” and revisit even more iconic moments brought to life in the game. Race Barky Boats down a stream, play I-Spy while travelling between locations, and uncover familiar scenes from the world of Bluey. Every adventure brings new opportunities to -capture memories with Bluey’s camera and add them to the in-game scrapbook.

PLAY FOR REAL LIFE!
Throughout the game there are playful tips to keep the fun going into the real world. From birdwatching in your own backyard to setting up play moments with your favourite toys. Kids can explore, pretend, and discover in the game, then keep the fun going “for real life.

CAPTURE, COLLECT & PLAY!
Using your camera, unlock stickers and decorations to personalise your scrapbook. Colour-in, arrange snapshots, and build a one-of-a-kind keepsake filled with Bluey fun. As they progress through locations, players also encounter “For Real Life” activity ideas that spark play both in the game and beyond the screen.

SHARE THE FUN!
Share the adventure side-by-side in Buddy mode. A second player can join in to explore and strike a pose while the main player leads the adventure behind the camera. You can even play with toys together along the way!
Bluey’s Happy Snaps has no in-game purchases and no online play.

70010000106965.name: Sector Force
70010000106965.intro: One pilot, thirty stranded workers, hundreds of asteroids heading their way.
70010000106965.description: When a remote space station inexplicably finds itself in the path of a large asteroid cluster, the sector's regional guard redirects its nearest asset to help. Working with limited firepower, defend the station from waves of asteroids while minimizing damage to your own ship in this futuristic scrolling shooter with a cyberpunk aesthetic.

70010000106976.name: Word Quest Pirates
70010000106976.intro: Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate pirate word master?
70010000106976.description: Ahoy, word hunter! Set sail on a thrilling puzzle adventure where the seas are filled with hidden words and untold treasures. In Word Quest: Pirates, you’ll solve exciting word searches to unlock treasure chests, outsmart rival pirates, and uncover legendary loot. With each level, the challenge grows as you chart your way across mysterious islands and ancient maps.

70010000106981.name: Word Quest Space
70010000106981.description: Blast off into an intergalactic word search experience in Word Quest: Space. Explore distant galaxies and solve glowing puzzles filled with cosmic secrets. Connect letters, discover hidden words, and journey through planets, asteroids, and nebulae in your quest for knowledge among the stars. Every puzzle completed takes you deeper into the universe — can you conquer the cosmos one word at a time?

70010000106989.name: Word Quest Fantasy
70010000106989.intro: Enter a world of knights, magic, and mystery in Word Quest: Fantasy!
70010000106989.description: Wield enchanted swords, explore ancient castles, and unravel word puzzles charged with mystical power. Each grid hides words that bring you closer to becoming a true hero of the realm. Defeat challenges, unlock secrets, and let your imagination guide you through a storybook world where every word is part of your adventure. Are you ready to prove yourself in the ultimate fantasy word quest?

70010000106994.name: ULTIMATE BATTLE SIMULATOR
70010000106994.intro: Master strategy, command your army, conquer the battlefield.
70010000106994.description:
ULTIMATE BATTLE SIMULATOR challenges you to master strategy, foresight, and precision placement. Command your army of NPC fighters, manage resources wisely, and outthink your enemies across varied battlefields. Whether you unleash endless ranks or rely on a few elite warriors, victory depends on your ability to plan, deploy, and adapt.

Key Features:
• Tactical Placement – Position units to exploit enemy weaknesses.
• Command from Above – Survey the battlefield from the skies and perfect your formation.
• Flexible Army Management – Add or remove fighters before battle begins.
• Diverse Arsenal – Equip new weapons to strengthen your troops.
• Unique Fighters – Unlock 13 NPC types, from expendable grunts to unstoppable elites.
• Smart Resource Use – Balance quantity versus quality for every fight.
• Expansive Campaign – Conquer 40 stages across 4 unique maps.
• Rising Challenge – Face ever-tougher battles demanding sharper tactics.

From grand clashes to cunning skirmishes, ULTIMATE BATTLE SIMULATOR turns war into a thrilling puzzle of power and precision. The battlefield is waiting — prove your command!

70010000106999.name: Hentai Party: Cyber Girls
70010000106999.description:
Welcome to the party where the most daring and beautiful images await you!
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Realistic assembly process.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.

70010000107004.name: Hentai Party: Secret Garden
70010000107004.description:
Welcome to the party where the most daring and beautiful images await you!
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Realistic assembly process.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.

70010000107020.name: Ariana and the Elder Codex Digital Art Book
70010000107020.description: Take hold of your own personal grimoire with this 62-page Digital Art Book, which includes character art, designer notes, a timeline, and more!

70010000107027.name: Mystic Explorer
70010000107027.intro: Highly addictive God-tier Weapon Rogue-like! Craft your unique build and ignite explosive synergies! Unlock diverse classes, face random encounters, and survive the relentless horde. Only the l
70010000107027.description:
In Mystic Explorer, you are no longer bound by a single blade! Through our unique "Multi-Weapon System," you can command an entire arsenal simultaneously—from devastating melee strikes to barrages of missiles. Experience explosive combat as you lead your hunter squad through shifting mystic realms to defeat the ultimate Demon King!

【Vast Arsenal, Infinite Builds】
Choose from a massive selection of weaponry: Basic, Melee, AOE, Missiles, and Projectiles! Weapons are categorized by Physical and Magic attributes and further divided into specialized schools like Savage, Blood, and Lightning. Mix and match diverse weapon types to forge your own legendary combat style!

【Weapon Evolution & Synergies】
Every weapon holds infinite potential. Spend upgrade points to unlock powerful "Weapon Effects"—the heart of any great Build. Some effects trigger devastating cross-weapon Synergies, while others stack your stats to insane levels.
Example: Unlock the "Savage Hammer" effect to convert your Max HP into massive damage and increased attack range!

【Exclusive Skills & Limit Breaks】
Unleash game-changing skills as your total weapon level rises:
Weapon Enhancements: Maximizes lethality for specific weapon categories.
Attribute Growth: Your stats grow endlessly as the battle rages on.
Stat Conversion: Transform one attribute into another powerful buff to double your combat power!

【Loot, Survive, and Conquer】
Fate Chests lie scattered across battlefields swarming with monsters. The rarer the chest, the longer it takes to open—a true gamble of risk vs. reward! Snatch divine gear from the jaws of death; only the hunter who survives to the end can claim the ultimate legendary treasure.

【Classes & Allies: Build the Ultimate Squad】
Unlock diverse classes with distinct skills. Recruit powerful allies in the mystic realms to fight by your side. Utilize diverse team compositions to crush formidable BOSSES and finally bring down the Great Demon King!

70010000107032.name: Sky Escort
70010000107032.intro: Sky Escort is a Roguelike deck-builder blending management and tower defense. As an airborne escort, defend your cargo through treacherous skies to claim your rewards.
70010000107032.description:
Game Overview
In Sky Escort, you take on the role of a mercenary navigating treacherous skies to deliver high-stakes cargo. To survive relentless pirate raids, you must fortify your airship with defensive structures, upgrade your vessel in outpost cities, and recruit a legendary crew.

【Build & Manage】
In the resource-scarce void of the sky, survival is up to you. Allocate limited resources to build economic facilities on your hull, boosting productivity to fund your defenses. Balancing economic growth with combat readiness is the ultimate key to victory.

【Defend Against Foes】
Sky pirates are constantly circling, waiting for a chance to plunder your cargo. Equip your ship with automated weaponry to repel approaching enemies. However, building space is strictly limited. As Captain, you must decide which weapons to prioritize and how to position them for maximum efficiency. Fail to hold the line, and you’ll lose more than just the cargo—you’ll lose the ship and your life.

【Deck-Building】
Sky Escort is a card-driven experience where you build and refine your deck as you play. Unlike traditional turn-based card games, it features real-time combat. You must think on your feet, rapidly playing cards and adjusting your strategy in the heat of battle for a truly pulse-pounding experience.

【Recruit & Upgrade】
No captain survives alone. Bolster your strength by recruiting specialized crew members at outpost cities along your route. Each crew member brings unique abilities to the table, and you can further hone their skills through training at the Academy. Beyond the crew, your ship is your fortress—customize and upgrade multiple ship sections with a variety of specialized components to suit your playstyle.

【Diverse Factions】
Explore the world of Sky Escort through the lens of different factions, each featuring unique mechanics and playstyles:

The Empire: Rulers of the sky through sheer force. They boast immense commercial and industrial power, fueled by a subjugated labor force.
Panda Sages: Masters of "Chi Manipulation." They wield potent spells and find strength in maintaining the perfect balance between Yin and Yang.
The Wanderers: Outcasts exiled by the Empire. They are creative survivalists who deploy advanced combat robots to fight their battles.

70010000107046.name: Where’s the FOOD!?
70010000107046.intro: Have fun with your family♪ Find the hidden FOOD!
70010000107046.description:
Have fun with your family♪ Find the hidden FOOD!
""Among many FOOD items, one is different.
Spot it within the time limit to enjoy a casual brain-training spot-the-difference game!

How to play is simple:
・Look carefully at the puzzle image
・Once you find the odd one, tap it before time runs out!

It might look easy at first glance,
but with the time ticking, it can be surprisingly tricky!?

If you get stuck,
press the hint button.
(It will show you roughly where to look.)

※In handheld mode, this game is played vertically on Nintendo Switch™.
※Button controls are also supported, so you can enjoy in tabletop or TV mode.

――――――――――――――――――
MASK supports streaming of this game.
No permission is required from MASK for individuals or companies to share gameplay videos.

70010000107054.name: Clarity: The Seven Demons of Vanguardia
70010000107054.intro: Slay demons to avenge your fallen father in side-scrolling action platforming style!
70010000107054.description:
When a boy’s father is suddenly slain by a terrifying lightning demon, he courageously sets out on a quest of vengeance. Take the role of this young hero as he learns to gather and wield powerful demon magic known as Clarity. Run, jump, air dash and swing your sword as you traverse 7 worlds in side-scrolling style, slaying lesser demon spawn and avoiding treacherous traps to reach the boss of each unique stage!

Clarity: The Seven Demons of Vanguardia is an action platforming adventure with a focus on thoughtful reward, all presented in hand-drawn HD style. Customize the experience with multiple difficulty settings. Choose whichever stage you want to tackle first but be mindful to collect demon swords from defeated bosses in an order that grants a strategic advantage against the next. Each demon has an elemental weakness to exploit! Use melee slashes from your swords or execute spells with your staff by consuming the Clarity you’ve claimed from fallen foes. Will you be prepared for the final showdown?

• Hunt menacing demons in the quest to avenge your father!
• Run, jump, slash and air dash as you traverse 7 worlds in side-scrolling style.
• Gather magical Clarity to wield special spells and skills!
• Tackle stages in any order to acquire powerful demon swords.
• Strategically exploit enemies’ elemental weaknesses!

70010000107059.name: The Hollow Lighthouse
70010000107059.intro: Don’t let the light go out.
70010000107059.description:
The Hollow Lighthouse is a story-driven survival horror game that drops you on a remote, forgotten island off the Romanian coast. You’re an electrician sent to fix the lighthouse—but soon realize the light is the only thing keeping you safe. 

Wander through thick pine forests, climb eerie cliffs, and explore abandoned buildings scattered across the island. Strange figures lurk in the woods. An unsettling old keeper watches from the shadows. And something else... something not quite human... is following you. 

The further you go, the darker it gets. 
Fix the light… before it’s too late.

70010000107071.name: Arcade Archives TOP SPEED
70010000107071.description:
"TOP SPEED" is a racing game released by TAITO in 1987.
Enter high-stakes street races where speed is everything, and aim for the finish line while dodging obstacles and avoiding collisions with rival cars.
Using Nitro grants you explosive acceleration. Blow past the competition, leave everyone in your dust, and show them what it means to be the best!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000107081.name: The Witch's Bakery
70010000107081.intro: The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris!
70010000107081.description:
The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

YOUR DAILY LIFE AS A WITCH-BAKER IN PARIS!
You play as Lunne, who has just arrived in the city! Each day is split into three phases:

- Daytime, where Lunne manages her bakery and serves clients with her team of friends.
- Evening, where Lunne explores Paris, builds relationships, discovers the city's secrets and goes inside her friends' troubled heart.
- Night, where Lunne rests, improves her magic, decorates her bakery and spends time in her cosy atelier.

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

A COLORFUL PARIS IN A JOYFUL ADVENTURE!
Once your work day is done, you can visit several districts of Paris to meet with main characters, engage in activities to learn new skills, buy books for new recipes, etc.
From typical streets of famous districts like Montmartre and the Grands Boulevards, to more intimate promenades known only by locals, Paris has many wonders to discover.Each district has its own characters, activities and shops!

A STORY ABOUT EMOTIONS AND VULNERABILITY
For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the heart. Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!

70010000107084.name: Golden Sunshine Beside You
70010000107084.description:
Hikari Hoshimiya, an extremely shy transfer student, is actually the daughter of a strict and prestigious family. 
Yuma Kōsaka, who ends up sitting next to her, is assigned as her caretaker, and the two gradually begin to connect.
However, the presence of a fiancé chosen by her parents stands in their way. 
This is a pure love visual novel about a fragile blonde girl who makes the resolve to give up everything for love.

70010000107091.name: SEDAP! A Culinary Adventure
70010000107091.intro: Co-op cooking chaos meets thrilling adventure in the world of SEDAP!
70010000107091.description: SEDAP! is a co-op cooking-combat adventure that combines the chaos of a collaborative kitchen and the wonders of adventuring into an unexplored world. Embark on an exciting culinary journey, whip up delectable delicacies, and serve your way through a fantastical reimagination of Southeast Asia!

70010000107101.name: Five Nights with Tung Tung Sahur
70010000107101.intro: Escape the house. Escape Evil Tung Tung Sahur.
70010000107101.description: You wake up in a dark room of an old house. The door is locked, the windows are boarded up, and the only way out is deeper into the gloomy building. From this moment, your nightmare begins: the house hides countless secrets, and in its basement lurks Evil Tung Tung Sahur — a twisted monster hunting you down. Each step brings you closer to the truth, but also to an inevitable encounter with horror. The rooms are filled with strange symbols and puzzles, the corridors whisper stories of the past, and the creaking floorboards and voices in the dark remind you — you are not alone here. Your survival depends on vigilance and composure: find the keys, solve the puzzles, and avoid a deadly meeting with Evil Tung Tung Sahur, who is always nearby.

70010000107106.name: Outpath
70010000107106.intro: Gather. Craft. Build. Explore. Relax. No time limits, no pressure, play at your own pace and style.
70010000107106.description:
Taking Satisfactory, Forager and the gratifying gameplay loop of clicker/idle games as references, Outpath would be just that. Exploit your environment, craft, build and automate your base in this 3D first-person platformer!

Gather. Craft. Build. Explore. Relax. No time limits, no pressure, play at your own pace and style.

Gather, collect and manage resources.
Craft useful items.
Base building, automate everything.
Buy islands to expand and exploit!
Fishing.
Level up skills and unlock new blueprints.
Parkour movements.
Play active or idle, you choose!
Music reacts to your actions.
Uncover the secrets of this stylized place.

70010000107112.name: Ariana and the Elder Codex Digital Soundtrack
70010000107112.description:
Get enchanted with the music of Ariana and the Elder Codex in this 18-track Digital Soundtrack!

Tracklist:
・Runes and Reverence
・Archivum Incantationum
・Hidden Path
・Echo in the Silence
・Via Perdita in Silva
・Mist and Flame
・Disenchanted Age
・Frostbound Fade
・Flamma Absentia
・Lux Materna
・Quiet Sanctuary
・Vicus Arx Obscura
・Interludium
・Deadlock
・Stalemate
・Prelude to the Storm
・Storm Breaks
・Ariana

70010000107113.name: Figure It Out: The Tantrum Simulator
70010000107113.intro: Beat the clock, tame her wrath, save the day.
70010000107113.description:
When a woman gets angry, the world trembles - windows shatter, volcanoes erupt, and people cower in fear! It’s your job to save the world by taming her tantrums. In this fast-paced puzzle game, you race against the clock to arrange comic-style illustrations using subtle hints, piecing together the chain of events that sparked each meltdown.

A puzzle game like no other - blending sharp humor with clever mechanics. With comic-book flair, pin-up sass, and beautifully animated sequences, the game drops you into a gallery of scenarios that are sometimes hilariously absurd, sometimes uncomfortably relatable.

It’s part puzzle-solving, part comedy of errors - a mix that keeps you guessing, laughing, and sometimes cringing at just how familiar it all feels. A perfect icebreaker game - entertaining not just for players, but also for anyone watching!

FEATURES:

- Unique fast-paced puzzle gameplay: under a ticking clock, decode the hints, line up the illustrations, and watch the tantrum take shape

- 150+ hilarious tantrum scenarios from absurd misunderstandings to relatable everyday conflicts - spanning date nights, family matters, parties, gaming nights and plenty more

- Absurd yet painfully relatable situations that will make you either howl from secondhand embarrassment or laugh at their sheer stupidity

- Three distinct playable characters, each with their own quirks, personality, and tantrum triggers

- Balanced humor: lightheartedly pokes fun at stereotypes for both men and women

- Stylish visuals blending comic book flair with retro pin-up aesthetics

- Beautifully animated comic book sequences that bring every meltdown to life

- Hidden ending: sometimes even failure has a silver lining - your choices and “mistakes” can unlock unexpected outcomes.

70010000107117.name: Jelly Form
70010000107117.intro: Be flexible! Squeeze into tight spaces, scale steep walls, and make incredible jumps to overcome obstacles.
70010000107117.description:
Step into the role of a small slime packed with unique abilities! Use the power of transformation to adapt to every situation.

Each level is a new platforming challenge where your creativity and skill mastery will be key to moving forward.

Be agile, strategic, and explore every possibility your slime form has to offer.

As an extra goal, collect the tiny stars scattered throughout the levels and prove you're a true master of transformation!

70010000107127.name: The Disney Afternoon Collection
70010000107127.intro: Relive your days of watching The Disney Afternoon with eight classic ‘90s games.
70010000107127.description:
Can you feel the buzz? Travel back to the ‘90s with characters from Disney Afternoon programming in this collection of retro Disney NES™ and Super NES™ games, now available on Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch™ 2. 

This Nintendo Switch 2/Nintendo Switch-exclusive update to the original 2017 collection adds two new games – Bonkers and Goof Troop – to the lineup for a total of eight games, including DuckTales, DuckTales 2, Chip 'n Dale Rescue Rangers, Chip 'n Dale Rescue Rangers 2, TaleSpin and Darkwing Duck. This is the first time that Goof Troop and Bonkers have been re-released anywhere. 

The collection includes quality-of-life updates to the original games and a number of additional features. A REWIND feature lets you correct missed jumps and other mistakes. SAVE lets you mark your progress. You can test your speedrun skills in the NES™ games with BOSS RUSH and TIME ATTACK modes, each with online leaderboards. And you can rock out to the tunes you remember in the MUSIC PLAYER. Then, enter GALLERY MODE to get a glimpse behind the scenes with a fascinating virtual museum curated by Digital Eclipse's historians.

GAME DESCRIPTIONS

BONKERS (Super NES™): This wacky platformer is packed with Easter eggs for Disney fans. Navigate six levels of Toontown in search of items that have gone missing – the Sorcerer's Hat, the Mermaid's Voice, and the Magic Lamp. 

GOOF TROOP (Super NES™): A family, co-op adventure starring father-son duo, Goofy and Max. Solve puzzles as they try to rescue their friends from a pirate island.

DUCKTALES (NES™) and DUCKTALES 2 (NES™): Play as Scrooge McDuck with a cane that doubles as a weapon and a pogo stick. The multi-path levels are packed with secrets and surprises, along with a great soundtrack.

CHIP ‘N DALE RESCUE RANGERS (NES™) and CHIP ‘N DALE RESCUE RANGERS 2 (NES™): A duo of early 8-bit, co-op platformers featuring loveable chipmunk detectives. Work together to walk and jump through levels, picking up acorns, boxes, and other objects to throw at your enemies. 

TALESPIN (NES™): A challenging, side-scrolling shooter, where you fly through the skies as Baloo in his plane, The Sea Duck. Use your quick reflexes and ace piloting skills to make it through the variety of enemies and bosses. 

DARKWING DUCK (NES™): Fight crime as the winged terror himself, Darkwing Duck, and battle a variety of enemies with your gas gun.

FEATURE LIST

- Play 8 classic games, including Bonkers, Goof Troop, DuckTales, DuckTales 2, Chip 'n Dale Rescue Rangers, Chip 'n Dale Rescue Rangers 2, TaleSpin, and Darkwing Duck.

- New Rewind and Save features make gameplay easier and more accessible for new players.

- Play Time Attack and Boss Rush modes (NES™ games only) and post your best speedrun times to the online leaderboards.

- Gallery Mode includes behind-the-scenes materials and archival content from the Disney vaults.

- Listen to original soundtracks from all 8 games.

70010000107138.name: Tricky Monkey Zoo
70010000107138.description:
Put yourself in the paws of the cheekiest monkey in the zoo! In this hilarious first-person animal adventure, you can cause chaos, play pranks on visitors, and turn an ordinary zoo into a playground of pure monkey madness.

You're trapped in your enclosure, but you're bursting with energy. Your mission is to turn a boring day at the zoo into a wild ride full of laughter. You toss bananas at unsuspecting tourists, shake the bars to startle the crowd, and help a grumpy rhino with a favor. Every moment is a chance to be the ultimate troublemaker.

Explore your habitat, unlock silly abilities, and interact with a quirky cast of visitors and animals. From escape-style challenges to silly minigames, this is a lighthearted celebration of monkey madness.

70010000107148.name: Find It! World Heritage Adventure
70010000107148.intro:
An exciting adventure around the world!
Find the hidden World Heritage sites!
70010000107148.description:
Find the World Heritage Site!
A quick and fun brain-training quiz game where you identify the featured World Heritage Site from four photos within the time limit!

How to Play

Read the name of the World Heritage Site carefully.

Look through the four photos and find the correct one.

Once you know the answer, tap it before time runs out!

It might look easy at first glance, but under the pressure of the timer, things get surprisingly tricky!

If you get stuck, try using the Hint button — it will show you roughly where the correct answer is hiding.

In Handheld Mode, this title is played with the Nintendo Switch™ held vertically.
Button controls are also supported, so you can enjoy it in Tabletop or TV Mode as well.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000107153.name: Dream Animal
70010000107153.intro: Listen closely to your inner voice... and discover which animal you are!?
70010000107153.description:
Admired Animals – A Quiz Like a Picture Book of Creatures! is a new kind of quiz game where you guess which of four animals is speaking its inner voice.
Each hint comes as a short thought inspired by the animal’s habits and traits. It’s like flipping through an illustrated animal encyclopedia—use your intuition and knowledge to find the answer!

Wait, is this voice a giraffe… or an elephant?
You’ll enjoy learning about animal life every time you play, making it fun for both kids and adults alike.  

With its educational value, it’s perfect for classroom use too. Play together with friends or family and see who becomes the ultimate Animal Master!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000107160.name: Arcade Archives ARKANOID
70010000107160.intro: The ultimate block-breaking legend—everyone knows the name!
70010000107160.description:
"ARKANOID" is a brick breaker released by TAITO in 1986.
Take the helm of the spacecraft "VAUS" and bounce the Energy Ball to shatter the Space Walls.
Your goal is to escape from the dimension of a warped labyrinth and return to the mothership "ARKANOID." Collecting power-up items will give you the edge you need to conquer each stage!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000107180.name: BANG! BANG! BANDITS
70010000107180.intro:
Bang bang away! It feels great!
A new party-style shooting game that can be enjoyed by both children and adults is now available!
70010000107180.description:
BANG! BANG! BANDITS is an all new, original shooting game. It adopts simple rules and controls while maintaining the tension and exhilaration of the classic genre of gun shooting games. This means that it can be enjoyed by a wide range of people, from children to adults. It features colorful, adorable characters and an easy-to-understand world.

■Intuitive controls that require zero explanation! Anyone can play immediately!
Simple controls: just hold the Joy-Con™ in one hand as a handgun and aim and shoot at the enemies on the screen!!
Automatically move around the field, aim and shoot at all the enemies that appear, and collect lots and lots of coins!
There is no bullet limit, so you can fire as much as you want!
There's nothing to it, just shoot away!

■12 types of stages x 2 leagues, for a lot of fun to be had!
The Normal League, where the battles take place, has 12 stages with different characteristics, including jungles, urban areas, ruins, and caves.
Once you've conquered all the stages in the Normal League, you can challenge the Wild League, which is the most difficult mode available!

■Unique enemy characters run amok all over the screen!
Defeat the Goomin that attack you one after another, and defeat the evil boss waiting at the end of the stage!

■Enjoy 2 different ways to play: Challenge Mode and Battle Mode!
Start with low-class stages in Challenge Mode and then conquer the most difficult stages.
You can play alone or in a team of 2 to 4 people! If each player has a Joy-Con, you can enjoy competitive play, such as single battles (individual battles) where 2-4 players compete for the highest score, or team battles where 2 teams of 2 players compete for the highest score!

70010000107201.name: Ecchi Numbers
70010000107201.intro: Fill her grid and reveal the picture.
70010000107201.description:
Think you’ve got the skills to go all the way? Fill in the right positions and slowly clear away the puzzle—revealing more than just your brainpower.

Every number brings you closer to the full picture. Get it right, and you’ll uncover a beautiful picture waiting just beneath the surface... but one wrong move and you might just ruin the mood.

Features:
- 36 beautiful girls looking for company
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Take your time, plan your moves, and finish strong.

70010000107209.name: Spectator 2
70010000107209.intro: Your job is simple: monitor live security footage and report anomalies. The longer you watch, the more reality unravels.
70010000107209.description:
YOUR MISSION: SPOT THE UNSEEN... BEFORE ITS TOO LATE

Welcome to Spectator 2, where your sharp eyes and steely nerves are all that stand between order and chaos. Your job? Monitor live security feeds from the creepiest locations imaginable, detect anomalies, report them, and hope you're fast enough to stop reality from unraveling.

MONITOR THE MADNESS
Watch real-time security cameras across multiple eerie locations. A flickering light, a misplaced object, a shadow that wasn’t there before—spot and report the anomalies before it’s too late.

A HORROR EXPERIENCE THAT BUILDS OVER TIME 
Subtle at first, but escalating fast, anomalies grow more disturbing the longer you survive. Stay focused, apply countermeasures, and don’t let reality slip away.

MORE PERILOUS ANOMALIES 
This time, anomalies are more diverse, eerie, and overwhelming than ever. From tiny shifts to full-blown intruders, your perception will be tested like never before.

NO TWO GAMES ARE THE SAME
The threats? Random. Your survival? Not guaranteed. Random anomaly generation ensures every round is unpredictable.

EXPLORE HAUNTINGLY BEAUTIFUL ENVIRONMENTS
From abandoned diners to eerie hotels, every level is crafted to keep you on edge.

EVOLVING STORYLINE 
Every location holds secrets. New levels unravel hidden connections in the Spectator universe. Every detail matters.

SURVIVAL ISN’T GUARANTEED 
Miss too many anomalies, and reality collapses. Keep things under control… or face something far worse than game over.

SO... YOU THINK YOU CAN WATCH?

Your only weapon is your attention to detail. Your only ally? A screen full of horrors that may or may not be messing with your mind.

Are you just a Spectator… or are they watching you back?

70010000107214.name: Looney Test
70010000107214.description:
Looney Test is the ultimate quiz for anyone who’s ever wondered, “Am I a little weird… or completely off the rails?” Dive into 12 ridiculous multiple-choice questions that will test your silliness, challenge your inner clown, and reveal just how delightfully looney you truly are. Play solo for a personal dose of absurdity or take turns with friends to see who’s the biggest goofball in the group!
Each answer secretly adds to your Looney Score, leading up to your grand reveal: the Looney Certificate! Will you be crowned a Mildly Goofy Goldfish or a Totally Bonkers Banana? There’s only one way to find out. Quick, wacky, and full of laughs, Looney Test turns every game night into a giggle-fest of pure nonsense and unfiltered fun

70010000107241.name: Brain Workout! Spinning Animal Puzzle
70010000107241.intro:
Spin the pieces and peek into the world of animals!
A mesmerizing animal art puzzle that you can't take your eyes off
70010000107241.description:
This is a puzzle game where you rotate panels to align animals that are placed in random directions.

The controls are simple—just observe the image carefully and tap the panel you want to rotate!
Depending on how fast you clear the stage, you’ll earn 1 to 3 animals.

A hint button becomes available over time and can be used up to three times.
It will automatically align one row of panels in the correct direction,
so you can relax even if you get stuck.

It’s simple yet surprisingly deep—
perfect for a quick and fun brain workout!
Try to earn 3 animals on every stage!

70010000107256.name: Climb Jump Obby Tower
70010000107256.intro: You’ll fall. A lot. It’s fine. Probably.
70010000107256.description:
Climb Jump Obby Tower is your ticket to a wild vertical adventure packed with color, chaos, and seriously fun parkour. Hop, dash, and climb your way through sky-high obstacle towers—one platform at a time.

Three towers. Three levels of madness. Easy, medium, and hard maps are waiting to test your skills in Normal or Challenge Mode. Want bragging rights? Beat the clock and set your best time.

It’s fast. It’s fun. It’s frustrating in all the right ways. One wrong jump and it’s back to the start—so keep your cool, trust your timing, and aim for the top.

Only the best reach the finish. Are you up for it?

70010000107270.name: Scarlet Wolf
70010000107270.intro: Are you ready to run and play a deadly game of hide-and-seek?
70010000107270.description:
If you're ready to run and play a deadly game of hide-and-seek, then come on in and make yourself at home. Behind the door, endless oppressive corridors, filthy walls, deadly traps, and a ravenous creature eagerly waiting to get up close and personal with you await.

There are doors that should remain locked. There are places that no one should ever visit. Secrets hidden in the shadows should not come to light.

But if you do wander into one of these places, know this: your enemy is strong and dangerous. He plays with your emotions and feelings as he pleases. Run away from there as fast as you can and don't look back. After all, there is no enemy more cruel and insidious than your own past.

Plot:
For several months now, Alex has been having the same nightmare.
He tries to solve the problem on his own, but it leads to nothing. So, the boy decides to ask for help from a professional. But psychologist Dr. Amanda Silk is not Alex's only ally on the thorny path of his hostile consciousness.
A meeting with an old friend is also ahead. Together, they will have to go through many traps and fight monsters to reveal the secrets of the dark past.

Features:
- A grim atmosphere that immerses you in a world of horror and suffering
- Unpredictable events will keep you on edge from the first scene to the last
- Unusual character and monster design
- An original soundtrack and realistic sound effects that create a sense of presence, helping you experience the protagonist's emotions

70010000107280.name: Chronicles of Albian 3: The Vanishing Village Collector's Edition
70010000107280.intro: High in the mountains of Albian, something very strange has happened.
70010000107280.description:
Gwendolyn the Fairy Godmother returns from a well-earned vacation to find Albian Village has vanished without a trace! Only her age-old castle remains, now a refuge for the displaced townsfolk. 
The culprit? A powerful and mysterious spell that’s left behind a wild surge of magical energy. 
To bring the village back, Gwendolyn must craft mighty counterspells—but the ingredients are very expensive!
Roll up your sleeves for a good old-fashioned hidden object adventure. 
Search every dusty drawer and forgotten hallway of Albian Castle for treasures worth their weight in gold. 
Solve clever mini-games, meet a cast of quirky characters, and uncover the truth behind the vanishing village! 
Packed with tons of hidden objects to uncover and plenty of magical upgrades to unlock, this classic-style hidden object game is bursting with charm, mystery, and magic!

Features:
- Classic seek and find fun with scenes full of hidden items
- Solve 160 clever mini-games and magical puzzles
- Discover a cast of quirky townsfolk
- Unlock a variety of castle upgrades as you progress
- Furnish and decorate a special magical chamber

70010000107289.name: Exorcist: Horror Simulator
70010000107289.intro: Say the wrong words, pay the price
70010000107289.description:
Step into abandoned rooms where whispers crawl along the walls and shadows refuse to behave. Your job isn’t to shoot first—it’s to investigate, identify what’s haunting the place, and perform the right rituals before fear, doubt, or something far worse overwhelms you.

Search for signs of possession, gather sacred tools, and piece together what kind of entity you’re dealing with. Every spirit behaves differently, every location tells a story, and one wrong ritual can turn a cleansing into a catastrophe.

This is survival through knowledge, nerves, and preparation. The horror creeps slowly, testing your focus as much as your courage. Stay calm, follow the rites, and remember—panic is exactly what the demon wants.

Because sometimes the scariest part isn’t what’s haunting the house…
it’s whether you’re strong enough to send it away.

70010000107294.name: Van Life: Home Simulator
70010000107294.intro: Home Is Where You Park It.
70010000107294.description:
Freedom comes with four wheels and a full tank of gas. Start with a dusty old van and turn it into your dream home—or flip it for profit and chase your next build. Whether you're in it for the thrill of renovation or the call of the open road, this game lets you live the nomadic dream, no GPS required.

Explore a vibrant open world packed with hidden campsites, cozy lake views, and the occasional “did I take a wrong turn?” mountain trail. From serene forests to rugged backroads, every trip is its own story.

Customize every inch of your ride, pick your parking spot, and let the weather spice things up—from starry nights to soggy surprises. You can run a renovation empire, rent out vans to other wanderers, or just kick back by the fire and roast digital marshmallows.

No deadlines. No bosses. Just your van, your journey, and maybe a raccoon trying to steal your cooler.

70010000107299.name: Hentai Secrets: Sexy Women
70010000107299.intro: Uncover the secret of the girls, step by step!
70010000107299.description:
Collect fascinating puzzles with images of charming girls in anime style. With each assembled image, you discover a new secret - new images, emotions and details. Touch control makes the process natural, as if you were really touching each element.

Relaxing music helps to immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and the difficulty increases gradually, turning each level into an exciting challenge. After completion, you can examine the image in detail and enjoy every little thing.

Features:
• Unique images of girls in anime style.
• The effect of complete immersion thanks to touch control.
• New images and characters that open up as you progress.
• Gradually more difficult levels for an exciting game.
• Atmospheric music that creates a mood.
• Detailed view of the image after assembly.

70010000107303.name: Quarantine Area: Zombie Lockdown
70010000107303.description:
The gates are locked, the line is long, and the air is thick with tension—and possibly zombie breath. You’re the last barrier between the living and the undead, armed with scanners, test kits, and a gut feeling that might save the world.

Every day, a parade of desperate faces shuffles toward your checkpoint—some harmless, some sick, and some hiding something far worse. One wrong call, and you might just let a walking biohazard waltz right in.

Inspect every ID, scan every bag, and keep an eye on that guy who’s sweating way too much for a chilly day. Supplies are scarce, time is short, and the infected are getting clever. Upgrade your gear, train your instincts, and hold your ground as the outbreak evolves.

The fate of humanity is in your hands—so no pressure. Just remember: if someone starts groaning and craving brains, that’s not your cue to hand them a visitor’s badge.

70010000107308.name: Hentai Secrets: Velvet Touch
70010000107308.intro: Uncover the secret of the girls, step by step!
70010000107308.description:
Collect fascinating puzzles with images of charming girls in anime style. With each assembled image, you discover a new secret - new images, emotions and details. Touch control makes the process natural, as if you were really touching each element.

Relaxing music helps to immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and the difficulty increases gradually, turning each level into an exciting challenge. After completion, you can examine the image in detail and enjoy every little thing.

Features:
• Unique images of girls in anime style.
• The effect of complete immersion thanks to touch control.
• New images and characters that open up as you progress.
• Gradually more difficult levels for an exciting game.
• Atmospheric music that creates a mood.
• Detailed view of the image after assembly.

70010000107312.intro: Uncover the secret of the girls, step by step!
70010000107312.description:
Collect fascinating puzzles with images of charming girls in anime style. With each assembled image, you discover a new secret - new images, emotions and details. Touch control makes the process natural, as if you were really touching each element.

70010000107316.name: Hentai Secrets: Romantic Charm
70010000107316.intro: Uncover the secret of the girls, step by step!
70010000107316.description:
Collect fascinating puzzles with images of charming girls in anime style. With each assembled image, you discover a new secret - new images, emotions and details. Touch control makes the process natural, as if you were really touching each element.

Relaxing music helps to immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and the difficulty increases gradually, turning each level into an exciting challenge. After completion, you can examine the image in detail and enjoy every little thing.

70010000107322.name: Cookie's Trails
70010000107322.intro: Logic, courage, and plenty of cookies along the way
70010000107322.description:
Cookie’s Trails is a cozy tactical puzzle set in a post-apocalyptic world with a sweet twist. The player guides a friendly hamster survivor through zombie-filled trails, collecting baseball bats and medical kits to safely reach the camp.

The hexagonal path tiles can be rotated and repositioned, creating continuous and strategic routes. Each level requires all tiles to be used, combining obstacles, enemies, and resources in creative ways. Zombies block progress, baseball bats allow defeating them, and medical kits heal wounds, but only in specific positions.

The game features 30 stages that grow in size and complexity, introducing new tile types, multiple survivors, and challenges that demand careful coordination. To win, players must plan each move and find the perfect route to the camp.

Completing a level ensures progression, but reaching the camp without injuries grants a special cookie-shaped star, encouraging replayability and the search for more optimized solutions.

Combining strategy, charm, and a unique atmosphere, Cookie’s Trails is the perfect choice for fans of challenging and personality-filled puzzles.

70010000107327.name: Without a Dawn
70010000107327.intro: Without a Dawn is a dark, psychological, and philosophical visual horror novel
70010000107327.description:
Without a Dawn is a dark, psychological, and philosophical visual horror novel featuring hauntingly beautiful pseudo-ASCII art.

She seeks refuge from her constant, restless thoughts in a remote cabin. There are no distractions in the profound silence and isolation, but the eerie sound of the cold wind weaving through the trees keeps her awake. In the dark stillness of the night, the silence has begun to take on physical form.

Without a Dawn masterfully immerses the player in introspection, intertwining psychological and philosophical elements to create a narrative that blurs the line between reality and fiction.

FEATURES

- The art style and audio are handcrafted and designed with extreme care and love.
- Changeable color palettes, textures, and frames.
- Delve into a gripping narrative blurring the line between reality and fiction.
- Get ready for a delicate philosophical and psychological introspection.
- Handmade in Finland.

70010000107329.name: Fred and Jeff: The Atomic Sulfate
70010000107329.intro: Join this point and click adventure.
70010000107329.description:
Originally developed as a pest repellent the atomic sulfate can turn insects into giants. 

And now has been stolen! The world is in danger! Join our heroes in their quest to bring it back from the inside of a tyrant’s fortress.

Infiltrate, find the spray and come back home with it in this point and click style game.


Features:
* Texts in Spanish, English, German and Japanese
* Comedy point and click adventure
* Use wisely the two characters to get your goal
* Voice acting in Spanish (can be turned off)
* Original music
* CRT filter

70010000107331.name: Big Trouble in Little Chimney
70010000107331.intro: Save the Christmas by shooting enemies.
70010000107331.description:
Krampus is Coming! Grab your shotgun, finish your hot punch and don't forget your mission: Save the Christmas! 

Big Trouble in Little Chimney is a fast paced arena bullet-hell shooter.

Survive endless hordes of creatures lurk from the dark chimney and save the Christmas!

Try to beat your highscore!


Features:
* Simple controls and pure arcade action
* Quick 10 minute play sessions
* Over 10 brutal enemy types
* Plenty of guns
* Collect jingle bells and earn new upgrades as you progress
* Unlock New Weapons and special abilities in the Santa's Store
* 2 Game modes: Krampus is coming, Giftpocalypse
* Great music by Kevin MacLeod

70010000107341.name: Dear Mirror Flower
70010000107341.intro:
"I am here, in this world..."
A Japanese-style fantasy adventure by Kogado Studio.
70010000107341.description:
In this town, strange incidents never cease.
The cause? Beings born from the darkness of the human heart: Demon Spirits.
 
Join Satoree Mizuki, a girl who can read others’ minds, and uncover the truth behind these supernatural cases.


■Story

...I can’t remember anything. 
 
Through the haze of my fading consciousness, a girl’s voice faintly echoes in my ears. 
When I open my eyes, I find her staring at me, her face filled with uncertainty. 
 
According to her, this town is plagued by Demon Spirits, creatures that lurk in the shadows, bringing disaster to those who cross their path. 
And one of them... stole my memories. 
 
With the guidance of this girl, I step into a world of exorcism and supernatural battles without a single clue about my identity.

70010000107354.name: Bike Runner
70010000107354.description:
Welcome to the ultimate proving ground for fearless cyclists.

This is a world where skill is everything, and your next ride is always more demanding than the last. Carve your path down treacherous mountainsides, launch off impossibly huge ramps, and chain together insane trick combinations to dominate the leaderboards. Every jump, every whip, and every landing is a test of precision.

Ride different weather conditions across a variety of stunning, handcrafted environments that are as beautiful as they are dangerous. To unlock new challenges and progress, you'll need more than just speed, you'll need style. Prove you have the technique to master every course.

Your career is in your hands. Earn your stripes, and then head to the shop to customize your look with fresh outfits and gear. Stand out from the crowd and define your own style.

This is a pure, single-player mountain biking experience, built for those who push the limits.

There are no shortcuts to the top.

Your ride starts now.

70010000107366.name: Skinwalker
70010000107366.intro: Survival burns brightest in the dark.
70010000107366.description:
Skinwalker is a horror adventure escape game that takes place in a frozen wilderness where every second counts. Trapped alone in a dark, merciless forest, your only lifeline is the fire that keeps you warm against the bitter cold. However, the freezing night isn't your only enemy. A terrifying creature known as the Skinwalker lurks nearby, hiding among the wildlife and waiting for you to let your guard down.

To survive, you’ll need to scavenge for resources and think quickly in high-pressure situations. You'll need to collect sticks to feed your fire, search for wooden planks to cross crumbling bridges, and uncover hidden tools, such as shovels and keys, that could mean the difference between life and death. Each step away from the fire is a gamble as the icy air closes in and the Skinwalker waits in the shadows, ready to attack.

The forest is full of danger at every turn, testing your wits, instincts, and courage. Manage your time, keep your fire alive, and stay one step ahead of the horror stalking you. Survival is possible, but only if you can outlast the cold and the creature that wears many faces.

This is not for the faint of heart. In Skinwalker, fear is as cold as the forest itself.

70010000107387.name: Countless Army
70010000107387.intro: Be the villain in this Reverse Tower Defense. Send waves after waves of troops to break the enemy defenses.
70010000107387.description:
Have you ever dreamed of being the villain in a Tower Defense?

Be the one who sends waves and waves of troops to break through the enemy defenses in this Reverse Tower Defense. 

Summon, conquer and upgrade your troops to dominate the whole world!



Summon your troops and conquer!
Choose the troops, the order and the path you’ll send in each wave. Think of your strategies to conquer each map.


Invade countless maps!
Play through the kingdoms, each with their own features. Plains, forest, coast, wasteland, snowed mountains and desert, conquer everything on your own time.


Unlock new troops and upgrade them!
Unlock units, choose their profession, upgrade the stats and change their skins.


Conquer and hold kingdoms!
Dominate each state of the region, advance without rest with your troops to conquer the whole world. But take care, the states can rebel.



Characteristics:

- 6 Kingdoms with 52 maps total.
- 16 Enemy defenses.
- 12 Troops to unlock, each with 2 different professions.
- Many skins to each troop to use at your own liking.
- 6 Spells to help the units through the waves.
- A skilltree with more than 50 unlocks.
- Changing climate, rain, clouds, storm, mist… you can face many of them in your conquest.

70010000107396.name: Shard Squad
70010000107396.intro: Form a squad of elemental creatures, face fierce hordes, and use shard synergies and relics to turn the winds in your favor! Survive and save your lands!
70010000107396.description:
Survive an insane army of enemies with a squad of elemental creatures! Recruit new members for your team by defeating the bosses that cross your path, and combine their traits to unlock powerful effects! Unity not only brings strength, it also creates new abilities!

MEET THE SHARDS

Over 20 Shards can join your squad! Experiment and discover which ones will become your favorites!

FORM AN ELEMENTAL SQUAD

Choose Shards of Fire, Electric, Water, Nature, and Crystal! Your squad, your rules! Build the team of your dreams to survive the crisis devastating the world of Mellunia!

COMBINE TRAITS

Each Shard has three distinct traits capable of unlocking powerful abilities and effects! Having more than one creature with the desired trait in your team will increase your squad’s power level!

OVERCOME CHALLENGES

Unique events and powerful bosses will appear to test your squad’s skills! Overcome these challenges to earn special rewards for your survival!

70010000107401.name: Jurassic Island: The Legend of Makumaku
70010000107401.intro: Interactive graphic novel that tells the exciting adventures of three adorable dinosaurs: Roko, the T-Rex; Tina, the Velociraptor; and Bogo, the Triceratops.
70010000107401.description:
Join this group of friends on a fantastic odyssey filled with excitement, humor, and lessons, and discover that true magic lies not in the powers they encounter, but in the bonds they form along the way!

·Kid- and family-friendly gameplay.

·Accessible text and narrative for young readers.

·Dynamic, colorful images inspired by wildlife.

·Ambient music that recreates the sounds of the jungle.

·Lessons about teamwork, respect for nature, and self-improvement.

·Educational fun with content that promotes positive values.

70010000107408.name: Recipe of Love
70010000107408.intro: A lunch break hidden from the world—our story alone.
70010000107408.description:
Yuma, a first-year high school student, was eating lunch he had bought when a beautiful senpai, Mio, appeared before him.
She offered him a homemade bento, saying, "I couldn't finish it."
Thus begins a bittersweet youthful love story.
Their special lunchtime together on the bench behind the school gradually connects their hearts.
Through jealousy and misunderstandings, a story of first love blossoms.
Includes Japanese voice acting.

70010000107413.name: Arcade Archives SPACE INVADERS
70010000107413.description:
"SPACE INVADERS" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1978.
The origin of the masterpiece that once captivated all of Japan has finally arrived on Arcade Archives!
This title includes both the black-and-white and color versions, and the sound has been reproduced to the limit of how it sounded back then.
Experience the timeless legend once again!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000107436.name: Marsupilami 2 - Salsa Palombia
70010000107436.intro: Will you be able to follow the rhythm… or fall victim to the cursed dance?
70010000107436.description:
A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and all the animals have suddenly started dancing, leaving chaos in their wake! The creature behind this crazy beat is none other than the Mummy Queen, back from the Land of the Dead with her minions to play a cursed concert with a calamitous crescendo.

Help the Marsupilamis save Palombia from the Mummy Queen and her minions! 

A Fast-Paced 2D Platformer
Journey through four vibrant worlds in this high-energy platformer!
From the colourful jungle to the bustling city, find the clues to the Mummy Queen's hideout. Take on increasingly more intense challenges leading to the ultimate showdown against the Mummy Queen. 

3 Marsupilamis, 3 Abilities
Master the unique abilities of each Marsupilami. Switch characters to soar through the air, punch enemies, or leap across obstacles, and explore the different levels' secrets. Choose your Marsupilami wisely, and you might uncover a hidden level!

Experience the Adventure Together in Local Co-Op
Play the adventure with a friend or on your own and take on the Battle Dojos' challenges and the competitive minigames designed for friendly rivalries.

Dive Into a Vibrant, Colourful Universe Faithful to the Marsupilami Licence
Explore unforgettable environments, face memorable bosses, and uncover hidden levels, all set within a fast-paced, fun atmosphere for the whole family.

70010000107443.name: Junk-o-Tron
70010000107443.intro: Fast-paced match-3 block puzzle game. Hone your skills to clear junk out fast and get the maximum score!
70010000107443.description:
Help your team of robot co-workers clear the scrap in this fast-paced match-3 game. Good performance unlocks new robots with unique block-stacking patterns and styles. 

Features:
- Four (4) robots violating their original operating parameters for fun and profit
- 8 accessibility options, including separate music and SFX sliders
- Integrated tutorial to teach you the basics
- Difficulty options and advanced tips for expert players
- High score list to track your best times and scores
- Extremely realistic CRT display (note: not very realistic)
- Extremely realistic Einsteinian wormhole physics (note: dangerously realistic)
- Pre-rendered CGI animations will make you check you haven't time traveled back to the 90s
- At least one cheat code

70010000107447.name: Clutchtime: Basketball Deckbuilder
70010000107447.intro: Build your perfect deck and become a Champion
70010000107447.description:
Clutchtime: Basketball is a deck builder centered around basketball plays and team synergies.

Different game modes:
• Elimination tournaments in true roguelike style, or
• Classic regular season where you can lose some games, but have to qualify and win the playoffs to become a Champion.

Each mode can be played in single player mode, or shared screen with your friends. You can set up custom modes like 2-player best-of-7 finals series, or a 3-player mini league where you play each other twice, once home and once away and then the top 2 players play the final game. It's fully customizable.

Each team has a starting deck of 5 starter players with 3 cards representing their skills.

Random events happen during the season, which allow you to:
• trade with other teams
• upgrade cards
• remove cards that don't fit your strategy
• duplicate your favorite cards
• and more...

Double Team your opponents and force Turnovers or create a dream team of Superstar shooters who Splash three pointers even while getting fouled.

You can also get team cards like:
• Timeout,
• Coach Challenge
• or even Complain to the Referees...
• ...to get a Tech.

Can you help your favorite team win the Championship?

70010000107449.name: Rabbit Samurai
70010000107449.intro: A rabbit, a deck of cards, and way too many monsters.
70010000107449.description:
In Rabbit Samurai, you’ll join a colorful 2D deck-building adventure. Each fight is tougher and funnier than the last.

Face off against quirky creatures in 42 arenas. Each round, you’ll grow stronger as you shuffle your way to victory. Between battles, choose how to improve your chances: add a new card to your deck, remove a card holding you back, or heal up and keep going.

Discover chests and secret quests to earn upgrades, boosts, and new ways to play your cards. Defeat bosses to earn powerful rewards and improve your samurai skills. With enemies that attack, shield, and heal in tricky combinations, every match will keep you on your toes.

It’s easy to learn, entertaining, and full of short strategy sessions that are ideal for casual deck-building fans. Do you have what it takes to guide this fluffy warrior through 42 battles and claim victory?

70010000107454.name: Brotherhood
70010000107454.intro: They are billions. You are alone.
70010000107454.description:
An ominous brotherhood of religious fanatics perform experiments on humans in their top-secret scientific complex. An ancient prison hidden deep in the Swiss mountains houses hundreds of test subjects whose bodies are mutilated in an effort to produce a new biological species of superhuman. 

You are one of them, but unlike other test subjects, your body is immune to mutagens. For you, it's not poison anymore, rather a source of power that makes your body nearly indestructible.

Steal the weapon and obliterate them.

Break into the depths of the secret complex, unravel the secret of the millennial brotherhood's ancient technology and harness the power of mutagen to annihilate all those who stand in your way. 

A timeless classic, with a fresh presentation.

You will feel right at home when exploring complex one-story levels in search of first aid kits, ammo and key cards, while fighting hordes of enemies in action-packed firefights. An old school shooter's classic weapons, upgrades, and well-hidden secrets will complete the experience. 

Enemies are powerful. But not immortal.

There are more than 20 types of enemies in the game, and each knows how to kill you in a variety of ways. Among them are ordinary soldiers, cyborgs with power armor, flamethrowers, and huge walking mechs. 

Fear not! There are brutal means to fight them all! A total of 9 types of weapons representing the most advanced engineering fashion of the brotherhood. You'll have plenty of obliteration methods at your disposal - not only a shotgun that can make a juicy "bang", but also a laser rifle that can fire infinitely, a flamethrower, and a rocket launcher. There is also...a " Butterfly ", a weapon so secret that not even the Brotherhood knows why it's called like that. 

Danger lurks around every corner.

Crowds of fanatics aren't the only obstacles you need to overcome on your journey; traps and environmental elements also pose a grave threat. Watch out, since just 1 wrong step is all it takes for the laser barrier to slice you into 8 pieces. 

This journey will be long. Challenging. And exciting.

You will face 24 huge and complex levels across 6 acts. Escape the prison by sneaking through a secret laboratory, sand dunes, and an ancient castle that holds thousands of years of Brotherhood history.

No one is with you. All you have is yourself. Your shotgun. Hordes of enemies. Animal rage and the desire to kill.

Destroy Them All!

70010000107463.name: Parkour Labs
70010000107463.intro: Think you're a parkour master? Prove it!
70010000107463.description:
