Welcome to the Ultimate Parkour Game!

Welcome to Parkour Labs, a vaporwave-inspired parkour game.
Surf the waves of nostalgia and retro aesthetics, sliding down ramps and performing smooth turns.
Explore colorful and surreal landscapes inspired by the culture, music, and art of the 80s and 90s.
Collect glitch effects and artifacts to unlock new levels and secrets.
Experience the synthwave atmosphere in this unique and original game that challenges your mouse control and movement skills.

70010000107468.name: Harvest Cafe
70010000107468.intro: Escape to a vibrant island where farming, cooking, and exploration come together. Grow crops, restore old places, and build your dream café.
70010000107468.description:
* Build Your Dream Farm *
Harvest Cafe is a cozy open-world farming and restaurant adventure set on a beautiful island full of charm, opportunities, and secrets to uncover. Grow a variety of crops, gather useful materials, and expand your land as you build the farm of your dreams.

* Cook and Serve Delicious Meals *
Turn your harvest into delicious meals and serve them in your very own restaurant in the village center. Unlock new recipes, expand your menu, and keep customers coming back for more as your café grows into one of the island’s favorite destinations.

* Explore and Restore the Island *
There is more to the island than farming and cooking. Explore abandoned harbors, buildings, and shops, restore forgotten places, and help bring life back to the island. As you repair and improve the world around you, more tourists begin to arrive.

* Grow Your Business *
As your business grows, so do your opportunities. Upgrade your restaurant, hire staff such as cooks and waiters, and serve more customers with greater efficiency. From humble beginnings to a bustling island hotspot, every step of your journey brings new rewards.

70010000107473.name: Magic Rune Stone
70010000107473.intro: An action Roguelite adventure! Play as distinct heroes, outfit them with varied gear and blessings, and take on mighty foes empowered by legendary Treasures.
70010000107473.description:
Also features a built-in “Survivor Mode”.

In the world of Magic Rune Stone, battle through challenging rooms. Mix and match unique skills and equipment, select exclusive abilities, and craft a truly custom character. A massive selection of skills, gear, unique Blessings, and Treasures delivers thrilling, high-stakes gameplay.

Each hero has a dedicated Signature Skill Slot, featuring a different ability per character. Each also has a unique upgrade tree for this skill. Use different Blessings to unlock and select from various skill specializations.

Every character has 4 Universal Skill Slots. Universal Skills are equipped during a run via Skill Stones. Each can be upgraded with Blessings to significantly boost its power; some even gain entirely new mechanics.

A hero can carry up to 9 pieces of Equipment. Gear comes in 4 rarity tiers, with higher rarities granting better stats and sometimes unique effects. Equipment also provides Blessings, allowing for deep build customization.

Treasures are powerful artifacts that boost your damage output or survivability. Experiment by combining their effects with your Equipment and Blessings to discover powerful new builds and playstyles.

70010000107483.name: Cozy Memory
70010000107483.intro: Improve your focus and concentration in the most delightful memory game!
70010000107483.description:
Have you been looking for a game that is delightfully relaxing and charming, and at the same time improves your memory and concentration? Immerse yourself in Cozy Memory, where each card challenges and delights your mind. Here, memory training is pure pleasure!


Playing memory games regularly keeps your mind sharp and lifts your mood. But that’s not all – Cozy Memory’s charming hand-painted cards are a true feast for the eyes


Going a step beyond traditional memory puzzle rules, Cozy Memory also lets you choose the difficulty level to ensure satisfaction whether you're a memory expert or a beginner.


KEY FEATURES:
- Various levels of difficulty.
- Cozy illustrations with adorable animals.
- Colorful amusing covers.
- Relaxing music.

70010000107488.name: Geo IQ World Master
70010000107488.intro:
Guess the world. Learn the world. Master the map.
Explore new countries, cities, and iconic landmarks!
70010000107488.description:
How accurately can you locate places on the world map? Put your knowledge, intuition, and geography skills to the test!

Geo IQ World Master is an educational and competitive geography exploration game built around predicting locations on the world map. You’ll be shown a country, city, landmark, historical area, or tourist spot, and your goal is to pinpoint its location as accurately as possible. The closer your guess, the higher your score.

The game blends popular concepts like geography quizzes, map knowledge, location guessing, city and country guessing, and world trivia challenges. To improve your skills, you should build a Geo guesser system that helps you predict locations using clues from around the globe.

Each level introduces new countries, cities, and cultural regions, helping you better understand continents, major destinations, and historical sites.

As you progress, you unlock special themed categories:
• Ancient Cities – Lost cities and historic centers of ancient civilizations
• War Locations – Key battlefields and strategic sites that shaped history
• Touristic Places – The world’s most iconic and visited attractions

These themes turn Geo IQ World Master into a complete world exploration experience — far more than a standard geography test.

With its “guess and learn” system, players naturally discover world cultures, architecture, tourism, and history. Whether mastering the map alone or competing with friends, Geo IQ World Master offers a unique journey for every geography fan.

The world is a vast map waiting for you to explore. Are you ready?

70010000107493.name: ZOO MANAGER SIMULATOR
70010000107493.intro: Build, care, and grow your ultimate zoo empire.
70010000107493.description:
Step into the role of a zoo owner and manager tasked with transforming a small, neglected park into a bustling wildlife attraction. Your goal is to create comfortable homes for animals, enjoyable experiences for visitors, and a successful, high-rated zoo. Every decision—from repairing enclosures to caring for exotic animals—shapes the future of your park.

Key Features:
• Build and Expand: Repair damaged enclosures, clean up debris, and restore old buildings. Expand your zoo by unlocking new areas and facilities through your office computer.
• Animal Management Purchase a variety of animals, from common species to rare, exotic creatures. Feed them, monitor their health, and maintain proper living conditions to keep them happy and stress-free.
• Visitor Experience: Improve comfort and enjoyment by building and upgrading cafes, restrooms, and decorative areas. The better the facilities, the longer guests will stay and the more they’ll spend.
• Maintenance and Staff: Keep your zoo running smoothly by repairing gates, water systems, and other equipment. Hire staff to assist with cleaning, repairs, and animal care.
• Progress and Reputation: Increase your zoo’s rating by balancing animal welfare, visitor satisfaction, and efficient management.

Transform a rundown zoo into a thriving wildlife sanctuary in Zoo Manager Simulator. Your creativity, strategy, and dedication will determine whether your park becomes a top-rated destination or remains just another forgotten zoo.

70010000107498.name: Hole Digging Beach Simulator
70010000107498.intro: Dig, explore, and discover the secrets buried beneath exotic beaches.
70010000107498.description:
Get ready to grab your shovel and dig the most epic holes on the world’s most exotic beaches! In Hole Digging Beach - Simulator, every grain of sand matters, and every hole could hide a treasure, a surprise, or just pure fun. Relax in this lighthearted simulator where the sun, the waves, and the sand become your personal playground.

Key Features:
• Detailed tropical beaches – Explore diverse locations, from deserted islands to lively tourist shores, each with its own secrets and breathtaking scenery.
• Customizable tools – Collect, unlock, and upgrade shovels, pickaxes, and other tools—each with unique benefits and distinct visual styles.
• Hidden treasures and mysteries – Uncover rare items, lost relics, or clues to greater mysteries as you dig deeper into the sand.
• Character customization – Create your perfect beach avatar with fun outfits, silly hats, and accessories that make you stand out in the sun.

Whether you’re hunting for buried treasure or just aiming to dig the perfectly round hole, Hole Digging Beach - Simulator is the perfect place where the sun never sets on the fun!

70010000107505.name: The Royal Writ
70010000107505.intro: Sacrifice creates stories in this medieval roguelike deckbuilder. Watch your cards march to glory or permanent death as they battle toward the enemy.
70010000107505.description:
In The Royal Writ, you don't just play cards - you command them on the battlefield. Place your loyal subjects strategically as they advance toward the enemy, dealing damage. But beware: any card that reaches the enemy base before victory is permanently destroyed and removed from your deck for the rest of your run.

Sacrifice isn't just a risk - it's an essential strategy that creates memorable sub-stories with each run. Will you honour the subjects who gave everything for your cause? Every fallen card tells a tale, and their glory lives on in the legacy you build.

Lead an army of adorable yet battle-hardened animals with abilities to shape your strategy. Your ranks may comprise a frail and wounded flamingo, a short sighted chicken bowman, or even a crafty lizard who cheats death by only losing its tail! From the renegade red ants to the sacrificial lamb, every card in your deck has a personality and purpose.

As they march toward glory or death, their individual stories become part of your kingdom's legacy, and their sacrifices will never be forgotten. You may even come across some peculiar creatures on your journey, like the crazed mantis dentist, the goat tactician or the impatient boar shopkeeper - just don’t ask them where they got their credentials.

Conquer the realm through two distinct adventures:

The First Campaign pits you against a growing rebellion as you try to maintain the king’s good and just rule (objectively). Battle your way through a challenging environment filled with deep pits and poison swamps as you try to suppress your enemies. As you progress, you may start to wonder if there are more to the kingdom’s troubles than meet the eye? 

The Second Campaign introduces a new threat - gunpowder. As new experimental weapons now enter the battlefield, your strategy must change. No longer are you simply avoiding the environmental hazards - you must dodge an onslaught of bullets to ensure you and your troops are not fatally wounded as you march forth. 

Each campaign features unique cards, bosses, and strategic challenges. The battlefield awaits your command!
Intuitive Yet Deep Gameplay - Easy to learn without compromising on the challenge
Roguelike Progression - Every run is different
Card Permadeath - Lost cards stay lost!
Charming Art Style - Picture-book visuals blend with medieval absurdity and dark humour
Memorable NPC Encounters - Are they friend or foe?
Special Boss Mechanics - Unique challenges that will test you
Gradual Difficulty Ladder - Climb through harder and harder difficulties as you progress
Challenge Modes - Test your skills in special modes with unique rules
Relics - Collect relics with various effects that change how you play

From an ancient royal decree:

"The art of war is simple. Send forth your subjects to die gloriously in your name. Their sacrifice ensures your legacy... and if they happen to win, all the better!"

Will you write your name in the annals of history, or become just another forgotten monarch? The balance between loss and triumph is yours to master.

All hail! May your fallen be remembered  and your victories sweet!

70010000107510.name: Mr. Sleepy Man
70010000107510.intro: Mr. Sleepy Man is up way past his bedtime and out of control! This sandbox adventure is filled with comical hijinks, outrageous characters, and platforming action!
70010000107510.description:
In Mr. Sleepy Man, you play as a sleepy guy who's up way past his bedtime and out of control!

The citizens of Bedtime Town don’t stand a chance! Make a mess of everything you find and turn the entire town against you!
Mr. Sleepy Man features a fully expressive 3D platformer moveset. Jump, glide, and dive your way through interconnected levels that encourage exploration and experimentation.

Interactivity is key! You can pick up and play with every item you find. You’ll need to use the environment to your advantage if you want to create chaos and find every secret this game has to offer!
Your actions will have consequences! NPCs will remember how you've treated them. Friendly faces won't last long when you're up to no good, so be wise! 

Bedtime Town's cast of outrageous characters have their own independent logic. These aren't copy + paste NPCs. Each one of these characters responds in a different way that reflects their own personality!
Mr. Sleepy Man features an interconnected world filled with secrets for the player to explore. With over 350 objectives to complete (including collectables), you'll easily get lost finding every nook and cranny this game has to offer.
With a fully original soundtrack composed and performed by the developer, Mr. Sleepy Man delivers a soundscape that blends nostalgic homages to classic 3D platformers with the raw, melodic edge of early 2000s alternative rock.

List of features:
- A one-of-a-kind soundtrack written and performed by the developer. 
- Over 350 objectives to complete! (Including collectables)
- Chaos simulator gameplay!
- Immersive environments, unhinged characters, and interactive NPCs.
- Fluid character movement!
- SLEEP BUTTON! Go to sleep at any time!

70010000107513.name: Sushi For Robots
70010000107513.intro: Sushi For Robots is whimsical puzzle game about quirky robots and their insatiable cravings for sushi - how do they actually process it is a mystery, but hey, if that makes them happy.
70010000107513.description:
What's this about?

Sushi For Robots is a whimsical puzzle game about quirky robots and their insatiable cravings for sushi - how they actually process it is a mystery, but hey, if that makes them happy. As the seasoned chef of the favorite sushi venue in robot town, it’s up to you to get the perfect dish in time for each of your picky patrons, placing the right stickers on the conveyor belts to change one tuna roll into a salmon nigiri.

Ok, ok, but how does it work?

Robots are picky (and kinda goofy). Make sure they get their food in time! It's actually a pretty chill game. You can always press reset and try a different solution. Get creative! Use stickers to change the behavior of dishes and please your robotic clientele.

Press play to see if your strange contraption can deliver food in time to the clients. And don’t forget to take a break between challenges to listen to the conversation between three friends that come to your restaurant every week. Will they get involved in some convoluted plot? Absolutely not, these are just tiny stories about goofy robotic friends hanging out.

Can I have some bullet points?

- Sure.
- Accessible puzzles that never get too long or convoluted
- An open system that encourages experimentation and finding creative solutions.
- Beautiful art that depicts an odd world where robots go to messy sushi restaurants.
- A light-hearted narrative about friends that get together for their weekly dinner.

70010000107518.name: Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad
70010000107518.intro: Turn freaky zombies into a green goo explosion with a bunch of crazy guns and graffiti the walls while you try to save the city!
70010000107518.description:
A squad of mutant kids from the hood is humanity’s last hope in this colorful, humor-packed zombie apocalypse. Blast freaky zombies with ridiculous guns, spray wild graffiti across the city, and face a monstrous Zombie Boss at the end of every mission.

Each hero in the squad offers a unique playstyle: choose yours, dig the weirdest guns out of dumpsters, and enjoy the insane headshot animations.

THE SQUAD

Four young mutants, each with their own powers and playstyle, ready to blast some zombies! Pick your favorite (or the one with the collest look) and go wild!

FIND CRAZY GUNS

A Ketchup Blaster, a Gumball Shooter, a Shark-Head Shotgun, and even a Witch’s Broom, you’ll find all sorts of crazy guns to make zombies deeply regret their life (and death) choices.

KILL FREAK ZOMBIES

The writer definitely went off the rails here. Expect cute puppy zombies, tentacle-armed chonks, jacked-up cop zombies, and even an  Frankenstein with underwear. It doesn’t make much sense, but hey, it’s hilarious.

GRAFFITI THE WALLS

Painting graffiti in a zombie apocalypse isn’t easy. Every time you try to tag a wall, you might just summon an entire horde of the undead. Art has never been so dangerous (or colorful)!

DEFEAT THE ZOMBIE BOSS

This zombie clearly had a different breakfast. It’s stronger, meaner, and keeps coming back stronger each time. Beat the Boss Zombie and show it who’s the real monster here!

70010000107523.name: Lonely Guardian
70010000107523.description:
Lonely Guardian is a relaxing and accessible 2D platformer where you play as a Foo Dog, a mythical creature from East Asian culture. Your sacred mission is simple: collect the Mystic Pearl, rescue a lost pup, and reach the temple gate in each level.

With clear and intuitive gameplay, the game combines light exploration, precise jumps, and a purifying roar that defeats yokai, breaks stone blocks, and opens hidden paths. Everything is designed to be instantly understood, without tutorials or complicated menus.

Each stage is a short and rewarding challenge, requiring attention, timing, and quick thinking to traverse fixed, moving, or collapsing platforms, avoid dangerous spikes, and activate spiritual altars as checkpoints.

The adventure features 30 levels divided into two unique biomes:

Sacred Temple Ruins (Levels 1–15): a serene setting of stone courtyards overgrown by nature, where players learn the core mechanics in a welcoming environment.

Forest of Echoes (Levels 16–30): a mysterious nocturnal realm lit by floating lanterns, where more aggressive yokai and new hazards raise the challenge.

With its spiritual atmosphere, clean visuals, and engaging progression, Lonely Guardian is the perfect experience for fans of casual, charming, and mystical platformers.

70010000107528.name: Unto Deepest Depths
70010000107528.intro: Unto Deepest Depths is a turn-based strategy game where all units must move and attack every turn. Build your party, upgrade your units, and lead them into the unknown.
70010000107528.description:
Unto Deepest Depths is a turn-based strategy game where all units must move and attack every turn. Build your party, upgrade your units, and lead them into the unknown to vanquish the horrors below in this punishing roguelite where any move could be your last.

Challenging turn-based combat with a twist

Battle through tactical turn-based combat where death is always just around the corner, made more challenging due to a simple rule: Every turn, units must move and attack. No waiting for enemies to come to you, and be mindful of your more destructive units - they may take down a few allies if you're not careful.

Battle powerful, dark foes

Venture across the land and into the depths below to fight off corrupt, menacing creatures not of this world. Powerful bosses, life leeching enemies, and more await you in the depths.

Build your party

Gain XP through battles and events and spend it to hire, promote, and upgrade units as you see fit to build a powerful party.

Features
- Build and grow your party with a variety of unit types and specialties. Elite and specialized units can be unlocked by promoting units with the XP earned from battle.
- Grow your units with powerful upgrades, but choose wisely as not everyone can specialize in everything.
- Battle through procedurally generated conflicts set across five unique biomes as you venture further into the depths below.
- Face powerful bosses and elite enemies along your journey.
- Choose your path and respond to unexpected challenges and events as you venture forth.
- Unlock additional difficulty levels, powerful upgrades, and unique starting parties as you play the game.

70010000107533.name: Slide! Throw! Snow Party
70010000107533.intro:
Slide around, throw snowballs, and aim to be champion!
Play solo or together—the winter party begins!
70010000107533.description:
Enjoy a variety of wintry party games with simple controls!
From snowball fights to battles on the ice, there's winter fun for everyone!
Share Joy-Con™ controllers for up to six players to join in the fun!
Whether you're partying with family and friends or playing solo, there's a mode for every mood!

[Free Mode]
Pick a game and play!
Practice on your own or face off against friends!

[Party Mode]
Play a series of games to determine the champion!
Win or lose, the fun never stops!

[Online Mode]
Battle it out on snowy stages with players from around the world!
Hop into a Quick Match for fast and thrilling fun!

70010000107543.name: Arcade Archives BERMUDA TRIANGLE
70010000107543.intro: From the creators of “IKARI WARRIORS” and “VICTORY ROAD” comes the Ultimate 　Time-Space Battle!!
70010000107543.description:
"BERMUDA TRIANGLE" is a shooting game released by SNK in 1987.
Pilot the time-space battleship ZIG and face off against mysterious enemies seeking to invade human history.
From the present to the past, the battlefield shifts with the changing ages. Power up your warship and gain the strength to survive any era!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000107557.name: Arcade Archives SYVALION
70010000107557.intro: The World of Syvalion, Changing with Your Play
70010000107557.description:
"SYVALION" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1988.
Control the mechanical dragon Syvalion, navigate through the complex maze, and defeat the boss waiting at the goal.
With maps and stories changing every playthrough, can you witness all 100+ unique endings?!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000107558.name: Arcade Archives CAMELTRY
70010000107558.intro: Spin the Maze, Roll the Ball!
70010000107558.description:
"CAMELTRY" is an action game released by TAITO in 1990.
Rotate the maze to roll the ball and reach the goal before the timer hits zero. A variety of obstacles stand in your way, including traps that reduce your time and bumpers that bounce the ball away. It's a unique ball-action game with a whole new sensation.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000107643.name: ARTDINK GAME LOG: Tail of the Sun
70010000107643.intro: Sharpen your beast! Primitive Life 3D Action
70010000107643.description:
The “Weird Game of the Century,” released in 1996 and a major talking point due to its impactful content, is being remastered for Nintendo Switch!

“Tail of the Sun” is a simple 3D action game where you control a caveman as a guardian spirit, living a life in the wild.

Your goal is to stack ivory obtained by hunting the formidable mammoth to build a tower reaching the sun.
To overcome larger prey, explore the open-world field and strengthen your body by eating the meat of hunted beasts and nuts.
What evolution will occur when the ivory tower reaches the sun?
See it with your own eyes.

【A Bizarre Worldview Representing Primitive Resilience】
The defining feature of this title is undoubtedly its unique presentation of primitive life.
Primitive people who slide anywhere and fall asleep,
avant-garde techno music playing during gameplay,
nuts that somehow resemble Japanese sweets, objects that look like body parts...
Enjoy these strange experiences scattered across the vast field.

*This product is a port of a game originally released in 1996 for Nintendo Switch™.
*This game is only available in Japanese.

70010000107655.name: Heavy Duty
70010000107655.intro: Master the Machines. Get the Job Done.
70010000107655.description:
Heavy Duty isn’t just about driving. It’s about controlling the toughest machines on Earth and leading a crew through high-stakes missions. Pick your cargo carefully, balance every load, and be ready to drop, crack, break, and try again until the job gets done.

From rocky mountain roads to stormy seas and towering construction sites, each challenge will test your driving skills and your ability to move your team forward. Will you be the one to deliver the cargo, and smash through any obstacle in your way?

Features:
• Master bulldozers, cranes, trucks, ships, and more. Each machine operates differently and gives you new ways to dominate the job.
• Transport heavy loads across dangerous terrain. Mud, water, storms, and heights push your vehicles to the limit.
• Progress through a wide range of levels that grow tougher and more complex as you advance.
• Enjoy cozy yet challenging environments designed for long, satisfying play sessions.

Prepare for action, engage the engines, and prove you’re ready to lead the ultimate heavy-duty crew.

70010000107709.name: Condo
70010000107709.intro: Unable to sleep, you navigate a quiet condo complex. There's no rush - just you, the building, its inhabitants, and the stories they hold.
70010000107709.description:
Condo is a quiet, short, and atmospheric first-person exploration game. You wander through an apartment complex at night, meet its residents, and uncover hidden stories.

Playtime:  ≈ 30 minutes.
Finding all events unlocks an ending.
No rush. No destination. ♥

70010000107785.name: Castle Climb Obby
70010000107785.description:
The old castle has crumbled, leaving only dangerous platforms, tricky jumps, and daring parkour challenges behind. Your goal? Scale the ruins and make it all the way to the top!

Features:
>Fun and challenging obby / parkour gameplay

>A towering castle climb full of obstacles

>Checkpoints to help you keep progressing

>Beautiful hand crafted world

Do you have the skill (and the courage) to master the climb and claim victory at the peak?

70010000107798.name: Monster Meals
70010000107798.intro:
Monster Meals is a chaotic and frantic cooking game
set in a food truck full of hungry monsters.
Cook up exotic creatures in local co-op.
70010000107798.description:
Dive into the world of monster cuisine!
You take on the role of an adorable monster chef on a unique culinary journey. With a food truck as your mobile base, travel through diverse locations from deserts to big cities serving up meals to monstrous customers.


Watch out, you might end up as the meal!
Get ready for a thrilling culinary experience where time is your biggest enemy! With impatient customers waiting, be quick or you might end up on the menu.


Play solo or in local co-op!
Work as a team to serve your demanding customers as quickly as possible! Play in local co-op mode, but don’t take too long… or you might end up as the ingredient! (Local multiplayer requires a controller.)


Hunt animals to use in your recipes!
Prepare meals that defy conventional standards, using exotic creatures from each location. Hunt rats on the street, pigeons in the square, or cockroaches in the sewers!


Different cooking methods and combinations!
With skill and precision, slice, fry, roast, and cook these bizarre ingredients in your mobile kitchen, equipped with various utensils and equipment.


Upgrade your Food Truck!
As you progress through the levels, your food truck evolves, unlocking new equipment for increasingly difficult challenges. There are 20 levels across 4 distinct locations, each with its own immersive atmosphere and customizable vehicle.


Survive the madness!
Face increasingly difficult days in the new Survival Mode, fully playable solo or with up to 2 chefs in local co-op. Upgrade your truck, handle the mounting pressure, and try to reach retirement together!

70010000107809.name: Geometry Shooter
70010000107809.intro: Blast through shapes and numbers in this addictive hand-drawn arcade shooter!
70010000107809.description:
Fire from a moving cannon at expanding geometric shapes like circles, squares, and triangles. Aim to hit as many as you can with a single shot, as a new shape will emerge where the fired bullet lands. Each figure displays a number indicating how many hits it takes to destroy it, so strategize your shots wisely. It's not all about a good aim, but also smart planning and anticipating what's coming next! 

Collect bombs that crush through your targets, or hit extra life points to keep the fun going. Be careful though - newly formed shapes can effectively block your options, and if a fired bullet goes back behind the line of your cannon, you'll lose one life! Decide whether it's worth risking a tricky shot to collect a helpful power-up before it disappears, or choose a safer option.

• Enjoy easy to understand, yet skill based gameplay
• Collect useful power-ups to help you in your struggles
• Top your scores in the leaderboards
• Admire hand-drawn graphics and cool sound effects

70010000107815.name: Escape from Ever After
70010000107815.intro: Dive into storybook worlds from Lovecraft to sci-fi in this genre-bending RPG!
70010000107815.description:
Escape from Ever After is an adventure RPG where fairytale and storybook characters must fight back against capitalism!

Story
When Flynt Buckler, a classic fairytale adventurer, storms the castle of his evil dragon arch-nemesis Tinder, he finds the once intimidating fortress has been converted into… corporate offices? The villainous dragon is nowhere to be found and her castle is full of mindless coffee-sipping, report-filing drones. What happened?

It turns out that storybooks are an untapped market ripe with valuable resources, cheap labor, and profit to be had—so naturally, real-world conglomerate Ever After Inc.™ found a way to intervene! With Tinder’s Castle as their new corporate headquarters, Ever After Inc. is hellbent on taking over every storybook they can. With no choice but to get a job, Flynt Buckler must team up with his former nemesis Tinder in order to climb the corporate ladder and take down Ever After Inc. from the inside!

Explore
Dive into storybook worlds packed to the brim with colorful characters, captivating locales, and electrifying secrets! One moment you’ll be fleeing Lovecraftian terrors while solving a noir murder mystery, and the next you’ll be up against villainous versions of The Three Little Pigs as they try to bulldoze a fairytale forest for their real estate developments. The rules are always changing!

Fight
Face off against hordes of wacky enemies in snappy turn-based gameplay! Perfectly-timed action commands allow Flynt to finish off his foes with style, and an assortment of items, badges, and partners ensure there’s always a trick up his sleeve.

Features
-Fight in a fun, fast-paced battle system that rewards experimentation and strategy
-Build and customize your party—every character has unique skills that can be equipped and upgraded throughout your journey
-Engage in office banter, help your storybook coworkers, and decorate your office as you climb the corporate ladder
-Explore vast storybook worlds brimming with sidequests, treasures, and secrets
-Stories within stories: experience a charming and lively narrative where the rules are constantly changing
-A jazzy, big-band soundtrack that keeps the energy pumping throughout

70010000107820.name: Ratcheteer DX
70010000107820.intro: Explore the depths and brave a frozen Snowcean in this lo-fi action-adventure!
70010000107820.description:
The surface has been claimed by an Impact Winter but beneath the ice and earth, mankind hibernates. As a young apprentice mechanic, you wake up in the dark. The Power Plant is offline. The Water Treatment Plant seems to be too. The Cryo Colony is in danger!

What begins as a simple trip to fetch your mentor’s wrench sets off a winding journey through the caverns below to a vast Snowcean above to rescue friends, foes, and strangers alike.

Along the way, you'll find and master eight unassuming tools, each opening new paths for exploration. Starting with just the Crank Lantern to light your first steps into the dark and the Wrench Sword to swing at what you find lurking in it, you'll be bounding, drilling, gliding, stomping, and dashing your way across the world of the Ratcheteer by the time you reach the end.

Originally released for the black-and-white Playdate, this updated version reimagines the game in full color with a CD-quality stereo soundtrack and support for 10 languages.

70010000107830.name: Lucha Align
70010000107830.intro: Step into the ring of fun!
70010000107830.description:
Get ready for the most exciting fight of your life in Lucha Align, the puzzle game where every piece is a luchador ready for action! Your mission is clear: fit the champions and completely fill the ring to claim victory in style.

With 40 levels full of action, each match brings new shapes, new challenges, and even more excitement. From the first training sessions to the ultimate battles, you’ll need strategy, quick thinking, and the spirit of a champion to master every grid and earn the special stars.

What awaits you in the ring:

Simple and addictive mechanics: select, move, rotate, and place your pieces to win.

A true climb in difficulty: from easy moves to master-level combinations.

A vibrant atmosphere with colorful visuals and lively sound effects turning each stage into a spectacle.

Special stars for players who prove they’re true champions of the board.

Are you ready to wear your mask, climb the ropes, and show who rules the ring?

70010000107857.name: Dear me, I was...
70010000107857.intro: A short tale, a long journey.
70010000107857.description:
With a beautiful watercolor touch, it depicts the life of a woman.

In her ordinary and modest life...experience her joys, her sorrows, her growth.
Witness the story she spins in a life woven by those around her.

♦A short and simple interactive adventure
♦Vivid visuals captured with watercolor and rotoscoping
♦Memorable theme music and soothing sounds

70010000107875.name: Learn to Play - Pumpkin Smash!
70010000107875.intro: Spooky Fun for Little Ghouls & Boos!
70010000107875.description:
Get ready for a ghoulishly good time with Pumpkin Smash, the Halloween arcade adventure perfect for preschoolers!

Based on the classic carnival game, little ones will love whacking and smashing playful pumpkins as they pop up from their spooky hiding spots. Tap the right button in time to score points and race to be the first to reach 1000! But watch out – a tricky skull might appear! Only smash the friendly pumpkins to keep your score climbing.

With three gentle difficulty modes and both single-player and two-player options, Pumpkin Smash is the perfect first video game for young players.

Grab your virtual mallet and join the family-friendly Halloween party today!

• Perfect for Preschoolers: Simple, intuitive gameplay designed for young players.
• Spooky & Sweet: A festive Halloween theme with friendly graphics and no scary surprises.
• Two Game Modes: Play against the computer or challenge a sibling or parent in versus mode!
• Three Gentle Difficulties: Adjust the challenge to perfectly match your child's skill level.
• Develops Skills: A fun way to practice timing, coordination, and quick thinking.

70010000107979.name: Desert Race Adventures
70010000107979.description:
Take the wheel and ride on this nostalgic rally trip out to the desert. Pick your driving crew and manage your vehicle and resources, as you encounter challenges on the road. No stress though, just keep your engine running and your eyes on the road. 

• Manage crew and resources: From selecting your team members to managing your vehicle's resources – every decision impacts your journey. Carefully allocate your food, fuel, and spare parts to sustain your team and maintain your vehicle. 

• Stuff happens on the road: Bad weather, wild animals, bandits. Event encounters can either propel you forward or set you back – choose your course of action wisely! 

• A classic feel: Drive into the beautifully crafted, retro-inspired world. It’s a pixel-perfect combo of retro visuals and modern gameplay.  

• Race and race again: With multiple strategies and pilot combos to explore, and the unpredictable nature of the event system – every run will be a unique adventure.

See ya at the races!

70010000108075.name: Blablublas Battle Royale Shooter
70010000108075.intro: Cats are armed. You are warned!
70010000108075.description:
Step into a chaotic battlefield where survival is everything — and the fiercest foes are armed… cats! In this wild shooter, you face off against cunning, weapon-wielding felines across a dynamic map. Every encounter is unpredictable, every corner could hide a new adversary, and only the sharpest aim and quickest reflexes will keep you alive.
Outsmart, outgun, and outlast these armed cats to claim victory and become the ultimate champion of the arena. Are you ready to take on the purr-fect challenge?

70010000108080.name: Asphalt: Car Racing Game
70010000108080.intro:
Feel the rush of high-speed arcade racing!
Master every turn, push your car to the limit,
and race your way to victory!
70010000108080.description:
Take the wheel of powerful sports cars and experience the thrill of high-speed street racing! Push your driving skills to the limit across challenging asphalt tracks packed with sharp turns, intense rivalries, and opportunities for spectacular drifts.

Start your racing career with a selection of performance cars and build your perfect machine. Upgrade your vehicle, improve its performance, customize its appearance, and prepare for increasingly demanding races.

Master every corner as you compete across different tracks and racing challenges. Balance speed and control, execute smooth drifts, overtake your rivals, and cross the finish line ahead of the competition.

Earn rewards as you progress and use them to unlock new cars, upgrades, and customization options. Every race brings you closer to building a stronger collection and becoming a true street racing champion.

**Features:**
• Fast-paced arcade street racing
• Multiple sports and performance cars to unlock
• Challenging asphalt tracks and racing events
• Drift through corners and master high-speed driving
• Upgrade your cars and improve their performance
• Customize vehicles with different visual options
• Earn rewards and unlock new content
• Easy-to-learn controls with skill-based racing
• Compete against challenging opponents
• Build your car collection and progress through your racing career

Start your engine, hit the asphalt, and prove that you have what it takes to become the ultimate street racing champion!

70010000108087.name: Gray War Conflict
70010000108087.intro: Every mission could be your last — are you ready?
70010000108087.description:
Gray War Conflict is a gritty first-person shooter set deep within a hostile conflict zone — a remote war-torn forest where every step could be your last. As an elite special forces operative, your mission is clear: infiltrate enemy territory, eliminate threats, and survive.

Explore a vast mountain-forest region, scavenge for gear and supplies, and fight your way through enemy patrols using a wide range of modern weapons. From close-quarters combat to tactical long-range takedowns, every encounter is intense and unforgiving.

Key Features:
• Fast-paced FPS combat in a harsh open environment
• A single-player mode focused on clearing zones of enemies
• Weapons include rifles, pistols, SMGs, shotguns, sniper rifles, LMGs, and grenades
• Earn money by eliminating enemies and looting their gear
• Buy new weapons and equipment to improve your chances of survival

No backup. No second chances. Just you, your weapon, and the will to survive. Gray War Conflict delivers raw action in the heart of enemy territory.

70010000108094.name: SHIP SIMULATOR OCEAN FISHING
70010000108094.intro: Fish, trade, upgrade ships, and become a sea legend.
70010000108094.description:
Embark on the Ultimate Ocean Fishing Adventure! In SHIP SIMULATOR OCEAN FISHING, you are an independent fisherman starting with nothing but an old boat and the open sea. Navigate coastal waters in search of fish, crabs, and rare seafood, then sell your catch at bustling ports – each offering different prices, challenges, and opportunities.

Every voyage is a test of skill and strategy. Monitor your fuel, adapt to realistic water physics, and face the ever-changing moods of the ocean – from calm sunrises wrapped in fog to raging storms that push your ship to its limits.

Key Features:
• Dynamic Weather & Sea Conditions – Wind, waves, and currents affect every movement.
• Realistic Ship Handling – Manual navigation, fuel management, and balance control.
• Expand Your Fleet - Earn money to upgrade to faster, stronger, and more spacious vessels.
• Marine Research Station – Improve predictions for fish and crab locations.
• Processing Station – Turn raw catch into high-value products.
• Fuel Tank Upgrades – Cut fuel costs and extend your journeys.
• Port Trading System – Sell where the price is right.

From your first solo trip at dawn to commanding a fleet across the deep ocean, your journey will be shaped by skill, ambition, and the untamed power of nature. Will you become a legendary master of the sea trade—or will the ocean claim your dreams?

70010000108110.name: Weeb Store Simulator: Supermarket Together
70010000108110.intro: Build the ultimate nerd paradise! Sell games, manga, and toys, manage the rush, and work together with friends in chaotic co-op to turn a tiny shop into a weeb megastore.
70010000108110.description:
Build and manage your own geeky supermarket in Weeb Store Simulator: Supermarket Together, a fun and chaotic store management simulator where games, manga, and collectibles rule the shelves!

Start small with a humble shop and grow it into a bustling paradise for gamers and anime fans. Stock video games and consoles, organize manga and comics, display figurines and toys, and keep customers happy by quickly handling restocks and checkout rush hours.

Unlock new licenses, expand your store layout, take on special tasks, and optimize your workflow to boost profits. Play solo or team up with up to 4 players in online co-op, where teamwork, coordination, and a bit of chaos turn your shop into a thriving entertainment megastore.

70010000108166.name: Orwell: Keeping an Eye On You
70010000108166.intro: Big Brother has arrived - and it’s you.
70010000108166.description:
Investigate the lives of citizens to find those responsible for a series of terror attacks. Information from the internet, personal communications and private files are all accessible to you. But, be warned, the information you supply will have consequences…

Orwell is a new governmental security program that has the power to survey the online presence of every person in The Nation. It can monitor all personal communications and access any computer. To preserve the privacy of citizens, human researchers examine the data Orwell finds and decide which pieces of information should be passed on to the security forces, and which should be rejected.

Selected from thousands of candidates, you are Orwell’s first human researcher. And when a terror attack rocks the Nation’s capital city of Bonton, Orwell, and you, are immediately put to the test. Starting with a single person of interest, you'll help the security forces build out and profile a network of potential culprits.

But are these people really terrorists? What does the information you reveal to Orwell say about them? What if you find out things about them that not even their loved ones know? What is the real price of maintaining the security that the Nation is yearning for?

Investigate the digital lives of citizens. 
Search web pages, scour through social media posts, dating site profiles, news articles and blogs to find those responsible for a series of terror attacks.

Invade the private lives of suspects. 
Listen in on chat communications, read personal emails, hack PCs, pull medical files, make connections. Find the information you need to know.

Determine the relevance of information. 
Only the information you provide will be seen by the security forces and acted upon. You decide what gets seen and what does not, influencing how the suspects will be perceived.

Secure the freedom of the Nation. 
Find the terrorists so the citizens of the Nation can sleep safe, knowing Orwell is watching over them.

70010000108185.name: Zombie Gorge: Survival Defense
70010000108185.intro: Hold the line. Survive the night. Defend the Gorge
70010000108185.description:
Zombie Gorge: Survival Defense is an intense wave-based action shooter where you must protect a narrow mountain gorge from endless undead hordes. Build defenses, upgrade your weapons, unleash powerful abilities, and fight through escalating waves of zombies and mutated bosses. Every wave grows harder. Every upgrade matters.
Can you hold the Gorge… or will the dead break through?

70010000108201.name: BALL x PIT – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000108201.intro: A brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite.
70010000108201.description:
BALL x PIT is a fast-paced fantasy roguelite where heroes must find the balls to plunge deeper into a seemingly bottomless pit of monsters. Develop arcane ammunition and resources in pursuit of treasure, recruiting additional heroes to aid you in your perilous quest.

Ballbylon has fallen. After a meteoric and completely unexpected event annihilated the great city, all that remains is an ominous, yawning pit. Treasure hunters from far and wide flock to the city’s tomb to seek their fortune, plumbing the depths in search of Ballbylon’s scattered riches. Few return.

The pit plays host to armies of barbaric creatures, hellbent on ending your quest before it even begins. Armed with a growing arsenal of magic-infused projectiles, batter your way through multiple levels of increasingly challenging obstacles to claim the ultimate prizes and rebuild New Ballbylon.

Fuse Your Balls
The Ball Fusion system encourages explosive experimentation with over 60 randomized balls to equip and combine during your journey. Discover overpowered combinations and unexpected synergies from hundreds of possible outcomes.

Build New Ballbylon
Expand New Ballbylon with over 70 unique buildings that provide gameplay bonuses and unlock further power-ups, new characters, and more! As your community grows, task homebound heroes with automated tasks to keep the resources coming while you dive deeper into the pit.

Discover New Realms
Face legions of diverse enemies within the pit, battling through barren deserts, frozen caverns, savage forests and more. Each region offers its own unique set of hazards on top of hordes of increasingly challenging foes and mighty, screen-filling bosses.

Recruit Fellow Hunters
As you explore the pit you’ll encounter fellow treasure hunters eager to add their skills to your expedition. Each character has unique, upgradable mechanics that totally change the way you play the game. Experimentation and adaptation are crucial to the success of New Ballbylon!

70010000108207.name: Birushana: Winds of Fate
70010000108207.intro: A new wind, carrying a future yet unknown...
70010000108207.description:
About Birushana: Winds of Fate
Fifteen years after the Heiji Rebellion, the Heike clan has reached the height of its power, while the Genji clan remains devastated by defeat.

Hidden deep within the mountains of Kurama lives Shanao, the youngest surviving male heir to the Genji name. However, Shanao harbors a deep secret known to very few...

The youngest heir to the Genji name is no man.

Epilogues
With the war over, peace has finally returned to the land.

After our heroine carved out a new fate,
these sweet epilogues tell the story of what happened after the events of the first game.

What does the future have in store for a girl who was born to fight?

Main Routes
New stories await our heroine...

The youngest child of the Genji, Shanao,
has been driven out of Kyoto by the Heike.

What fate awaits her as she strives to hide
her identity and live as a man in a world torn apart by war?

Key Features
We're So Back — Beloved protagonist Shanao is back in this highly anticipated fan disc! Explore nine routes in total, including four Main Routes with all-new love interests, and five returning love interests in the Epilogues.

What Comes After — Pick up the story where the original Birushana: Rising Flower of Genpei ended in five epilogue routes. With love having bloomed on the battlefield, see what life is like for Shanao and her man of choice after the war has ended.

Turning a New Leaf — Return to the time of war in the all-new Main Routes. Featuring four new love interests, including the Sato brothers, relive moments from the first game from new perspectives and maybe even discover new romance.

This Action Will Have Consequences — Throughout the new Main Routes, you will have to make tough decisions. These choices will change your affection levels with certain characters and ultimately affect the outcome of your story. Which ending will you receive?

70010000108302.name: EGGCONSOLE Crystal Chaser: Overlord's Orb of the Sky - Refined PC-9801
70010000108302.intro: The Japanese-style adventure game “Crystal Chaser” has been renewed. A new chapter unfolds in the adventure story of Takanoshin and Noichigo!
70010000108302.description:
This is a refined version of a 1991 adventure game, with this updated version released by GameCorpus in 2023. Players become Takanoshin Shimmen, who must track down the "Orb of the Sky" stolen from his childhood friend, Noichigo.

The game uses a command-based system for intuitive play. Although there's a slight mismatch between the graphics and the tone of the story, it's an enjoyable narrative.

The original staff expanded the story from 7 chapters to 9 and updated each one. Many new elements have been added, including a completely new chapter, a full remake of the final chapter, new characters, and "Intermission Theater R," which offers mini-episodes of the characters.

70010000108307.name: ZOMBIE DISASTER DRILL
70010000108307.description:
Welcome to the Disaster Prevention Center!
Thank you very much for visiting us today.

Today, you will participate in a disaster drill simulating a ‘zombie disaster’ and learn how to handle a typical zombie disaster.
Follow my guidance and let's aim to become zombie disaster prevention experts!

[Simple controls mean anyone can participate!]
This disaster drill is a click-based adventure game variety show.
No complex controls needed. Feel free to join in!

【Practice disaster response in various scenarios!】
At school, at the hospital, at the shopping mall!
Protect yourself from zombies in all kinds of settings.

【Survive zombies using everyday items!】
With a broom, a trash can, a wheelchair!?
How you use the tools you grab is key.
Use everyday items to deal with zombies.

【Aim for the Zombie Disaster Prevention Mastery License!】
Through this disaster drill, we ask you to seriously confront the ‘zombie disaster’.
Progressing through the challenges increases your disaster manuals and deepens your zombie disaster knowledge.
Enhance your disaster preparedness for the zombie disaster that will one day occur!

Note
This work supports English and Japanese only.

70010000108308.name: Arcade Archives ROC'N ROPE
70010000108308.description:
"ROC'N ROPE" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1983.
In pursuit of the lucky bird, the Roc, you must climb higher and higher through various locations, including cliffs and ice caves.
Use the rope, which can be fired diagonally upwards, to create the optimal route for a safe ascent!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000108322.name: Legacy of Shnaus - Horror Room Escape
70010000108322.intro: Step inside. Discover what was left behind.
70010000108322.description:
Enter the world of Legacy of Shnaus - Horror Room Escape, a psychological first-person horror where you explore an abandoned clinic filled with secrets, tragic memories, and experiments that should never have existed. As a journalist searching for the truth behind mysterious disappearances, you step inside a place marked by grief, obsession, and the shadow of the doctor who once worked there. Every room hides clues to a forgotten story, every sound pushes you deeper into fear, and the only way forward is to uncover the legacy left behind.

What begins as an investigation becomes a struggle for survival when you encounter the two forces that haunt the clinic - the ghost of Liza, trapped between innocence and suffering, and Subject Zero, the final experiment born from a desperate father’s mind. With no weapons and nowhere safe, you must solve puzzles, follow the traces of the past, and escape a place where reality breaks under the weight of trauma. Your path to freedom is built from fragments of truth - and the clinic never forgets.


Key Features:

-First-person psychological horror experience in a decaying clinic
- Story-driven exploration with hidden rooms and secret passages
- Two hostile entities that shape the atmosphere and progression
- Environmental puzzles that reveal the past piece by piece
- Suspenseful survival moments where silence is your only protection
- A haunting narrative about loss, obsession, and forbidden science

The truth isn’t just buried - it’s alive. Face the Legacy of Shnaus and escape before the past closes in.

70010000108501.name: Brain Boost Buddies
70010000108501.intro: Get ready for a fun and friendly brain workout! Fun, educational, and full of adorable friends - Brain Boost Buddies is perfect for the whole family!
70010000108501.description:
In Brain Boost Buddies, kids can flip and match cute animal cards - from smiling puppies to fluffy bunnies - while training their memory and concentration skills.


Parents will love it too! The game helps develop focus, logic, and patience in a calm, positive way. Plus, players can easily choose the right difficulty level to make the challenge just right for every age.


KEY FEATURES: 
- Adorable animal cards that make learning fun
- Different difficulty levels for all ages
- Improves memory, focus, and attention skills
- Bright, colorful visuals designed for kids
- Relaxing and cheerful background music
- Perfect for family playtime and early learning

70010000108564.name: Special Combat
70010000108564.intro: Nintendo Switch™ Exclusive! Revolutionary radar system for tactical advantage! Direct tank control with RPG-7 attacks on snowy battlefields!
70010000108564.description:
The newly equipped radar system and direct tank control realize unprecedented strategic tank battles! Massive tank warfare unfolds on beautiful, realistic snow-covered battlefields using multiple tanks! On the battlefield, board tanks to control armored vehicles directly and crush enemy positions with 120mm main guns. While tracking enemy positions with radar, devastating RPG-7 anti-tank rocket attacks are also possible! Dynamic combat combining infantry and tanks creates an unparalleled battlefield experience on this new snowy stage!

・Revolutionary radar system positioned at the bottom-left of the screen instantly identifies enemy tank and infantry positions, securing tactical victory!
・Direct tank operation utilizing dramatically increased tank numbers delivers unprecedented large-scale tank warfare intensity!
・Complete tank control system boarding tanks directly provides an immersive tank battle experience!
・Beautiful, photorealistic snow-covered battlefields feature spectacular snow and blizzard effects when shells impact!
・Innovative tank-infantry combinations allow seamless switching between 120mm cannon attacks and RPG-7 anti-tank assaults!
・Four specialist classes each with unique weapons realize diverse combat styles!
・Ultra-high-definition snowy graphics, 3D audio, and physics engines authentically reproduce tank roars, explosions, and blizzards!
・Radar-linked intuitive controls enable tank operation enjoyment from beginners to experts!
・3D physics engines with weighty tank control and explosive impact completely reproduce overwhelming tank physics calculations!
・Diverse game modes prepared including various snowy battlefield missions!
・Challenge extreme Special Combat missions as elite international special forces!

Radar systems pioneering a new era of tank warfare! Overwhelming combat experience directly controlling multiple tanks across blizzard-ravaged arctic battlefields. Photorealistic snowy graphics, strategic radar displays, and 120mm artillery combined with RPG-7 attacks create unprecedented immersion! Experience the pinnacle of tank control in this ultimately evolved snowy battlefield FPS!

Synopsis
Harsh winter winds race across snowfields where silver-white terrain extends endlessly across arctic battlefields. The next-generation tactical system "Tempest Radar," secretly developed by the three-nation military alliance "Northern Pact," pulses at the heart of this frozen fortress city. They've completed innovative tank command systems, deploying the unmanned tank corps "Ice Storm." From massive bases covered in snow and ice, they steadily advance their global conquest ambitions.

International peacekeeping forces have dispatched next-generation special forces to arctic regions as an emergency response. You step onto blizzard-swept battlefields as a member of these elite troops.

Utilize cutting-edge radar systems to command multiple tanks and seize snowy dominance. From tank cockpits, pulverize enemy positions with 120mm guns and witness spectacular snow explosion effects when shells detonate on snow surfaces. Alternatively, aim RPG-7s to ignite enemy steel behemoths, blooming shell flowers across pure white snowfields. Track enemy shadows shown by tactical radar to dominate massive tank battles, or reverse the tide with devastating anti-tank attacks. In blizzard-swept arctic battlefields, your choices determine humanity's destiny!

70010000108619.name: Ram Simulator
70010000108619.intro: Charge, smash, and conquer the city as a mighty ram.
70010000108619.description:
Step into the hooves of a fearless ram and bring chaos wherever you go! Roam freely across bustling city streets, quiet suburbs, sprawling farms, and towering mountain slopes. Smash, ram, and fling anything in your path — from unsuspecting NPCs to random objects — all while completing quirky quests and unlocking achievements.
In Ram Simulator, the story is yours. No rules, no limits — just your horns, your unstoppable energy, and a mischievous tongue that can grab, toss, and wreak havoc on anything. Leap across rooftops, race down hills, and activate slow-motion to savor every epic moment of destruction.

Key Features:
• Open-World Mayhem: Explore vibrant cities, farms, and mountains — the entire world is your playground.
• Ultimate Destruction: Ram, drag, and fling objects or NPCs to create hilarious chaos.
• Epic Stunts & Tricks: Jump rooftops, perform daring stunts, and find creative ways to explore.
• Slow-Motion Fun: Turn every crash and toss into cinematic, jaw-dropping moments.
• Customizable Ram: Personalize your ram with funny and stylish cosmetic options.
• Quests & Achievements: Complete wacky challenges and unlock rewards for your destructive adventures.

The suburbs have no idea what’s coming — are you ready to show them the true power of a ram? Laugh, smash, and embrace absurdity in every horn-charging moment!

70010000108635.name: Fish Rescue! Pull the Pin
70010000108635.intro:
Save the fish, solve the puzzle
Think fast, pull smart
One move, one rescue
70010000108635.description:
Think fast, pull smart, and rescue the fish!

Dive into an ocean of puzzles where every move counts. Your mission is simple — pull the correct pins to guide the water, remove obstacles, and save the trapped fish. But beware! Dangerous lava, cunning traps, and tricky mechanics stand between you and victory.

Each level brings new challenges that test your logic, timing, and creativity. The right pull can save the day, but one wrong move could spell disaster.

Enjoy colorful underwater worlds, relaxing visuals, and satisfying gameplay that anyone can pick up and play. Whether you’re solving a quick puzzle on the go or aiming to complete every stage perfectly, Fish Rescue Pull the Pin offers fun for players of all ages.

Features:
• Hundreds of brain-teasing puzzles to solve
• Simple yet addictive pull-the-pin gameplay
• Charming graphics and soothing sound effects
• Increasing difficulty with each new level
• Perfect for puzzle lovers of all ages

Can you rescue them all?

70010000108643.name: Snapshot Girls 4
70010000108643.intro: Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and marvel at every detail of stunning photorealistic masterpieces!
70010000108643.description:
Welcome to Snapshot Girls 4, a sophisticated and relaxing puzzle game where each completed puzzle reveals a photorealistic image of charming heroines in sophisticated and stylish looks.

Immerse yourself in an atmosphere where each image looks like a real photograph, with soft skin tones, natural light, and tiny details that are impossible to miss. Realistic puzzle mechanics allow you to feel every detail, and each scene is filled with emotion, character, and history.

Game Features:

- Photorealistic high-resolution images created with maximum attention to detail

- Smooth and intuitive puzzle mechanics

- Atmospheric soundtrack that enhances immersion

- Gallery mode to revisit your favorite scenes

70010000108651.name: Motel Business Simulator
70010000108651.intro: Turn a humble roadside Motel into a bustling destination!
70010000108651.description:
Welcome guests from all walks of life and make your motel the talk of the town. From cozy rooms to irresistible amenities, create a memorable stay that keeps travelers coming back for more. Make it stylish, make it special - watch your reputation grow!

Step into the shoes of a Motel manager and master every aspect of hospitality. Balance front desk service, housekeeping, and guest satisfaction while upgrading your property. You'll need to think fast and plan smart to stay ahead of the competition.

Motel Business Simulator is a management game where you run and grow a roadside motel. Maintain rooms, cater to guests' needs, and manage your supplies to keep operations running smoothly and costs low.

Check out this fun new game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Make your Motel the best place for all the travelers to stay!

70010000108660.name: Snapshot Girls 5
70010000108660.intro: Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and marvel at every detail of stunning photorealistic masterpieces!
70010000108660.description:
Welcome to Snapshot Girls 5, a sophisticated and relaxing puzzle game where each completed puzzle reveals a photorealistic image of charming heroines in sophisticated and stylish looks.

Immerse yourself in an atmosphere where each image looks like a real photograph, with soft skin tones, natural light, and tiny details that are impossible to miss. Realistic puzzle mechanics allow you to feel every detail, and each scene is filled with emotion, character, and history.

Game Features:

- Photorealistic high-resolution images created with maximum attention to detail

- Smooth and intuitive puzzle mechanics

- Atmospheric soundtrack that enhances immersion

- Gallery mode to revisit your favorite scenes

70010000108666.name: Snapshot Girls 6
70010000108666.intro: Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and marvel at every detail of stunning photorealistic masterpieces!
70010000108666.description:
Welcome to Snapshot Girls 6, a sophisticated and relaxing puzzle game where each completed puzzle reveals a photorealistic image of charming heroines in sophisticated and stylish looks.

Immerse yourself in an atmosphere where each image looks like a real photograph, with soft skin tones, natural light, and tiny details that are impossible to miss. Realistic puzzle mechanics allow you to feel every detail, and each scene is filled with emotion, character, and history.

Game Features:

- Photorealistic high-resolution images created with maximum attention to detail

- Smooth and intuitive puzzle mechanics

- Atmospheric soundtrack that enhances immersion

- Gallery mode to revisit your favorite scenes

70010000108720.name: Stillborn Slayer
70010000108720.intro: Masterful roguelike combat in a dark fantasy settings
70010000108720.description:
Stillborn Slayer is a dark fantasy action roguelike built around fast, punishing combat and replayable procedural runs.

Battle through a grim, hostile world filled with monstrous enemies, relying on skill, timing, and adaptability to survive. Death is expected — and progression comes from understanding the systems and improving with each attempt.

Procedural elements ensure that no two runs play exactly the same, making replayability a core part of the experience.


Features
* Action roguelike gameplay with fast-paced combat
* Hack-and-slash mechanics focused on skill and timing
* Various weapons and equipment you can upgrade
* Dark fantasy and horror-inspired setting

70010000108730.name: Graviators
70010000108730.intro: Pilot your space-pod in fast-paced arena sport competition in space! Use your special gravity and shield abilities to sling and deflect the ball to score on the opponent’s goal!
70010000108730.description:
Engage in multiple game modes and arenas that remix the core rules and keep every match exciting to play and watch.

Looking for a light‑hearted competitive game for your next game night? GRAVIATORS is a great pick for couch play with friends.

Play competitively in 1v1 or 2v2 matches, or team up in the cooperative Meteor Shower high‑score mode.

Features
• 1–4 Players (1v1, 2v2, CO‑OP 1–2 Players)
• Local 1–4 Player (shared screen)
• Online Multiplayer
• 3 Game Modes (Classic Arena, Planetary Arena, Meteor Shower)
• Full controller support
• AI opponents available in competitive modes

GRAVIATORS features simple controls while offering a deep skill curve for players who enjoy mastering movement, timing, and tactical play. The physics‑based controls are easy to learn in the step-by-step tutorial. Coordinating your abilities in real-time competition takes practice, but with three levels of AI opponents available, you can set the challenge to your comfort level and feel increasingly rewarded as your skills grow.

Navigate your spacepod with directional input and use three abilities to control the ball and outmaneuver opponents:

• Gravity – Pull the ball into orbit around your spacepod
• Shield – Push nearby objects away
• Boost – Dash quickly across the arena

Use these tools to position yourself, take control of the ball, and fire it into the enemy goal.

GAME MODES

CLASSIC ARENA
Players: 2–4
The core competitive mode of GRAVIATORS. Two teams (1v1 or 2v2) battle across a full‑field arena inspired by fast‑paced sports play. Each team’s goal sits in a corner and is protected by five shield segments arranged in a pentagon around the goal circle.

Hit shield pieces with the ball to break them and open a scoring path. A goal is worth 1 point for each missing shield when the ball enters the goal. Behind each goal is a return tunnel that shunts the ball back into center field, keeping the action moving.

PLANETARY ARENA
Players: 2–4
A strategic twist on the base rules. Teams defend their entire side of the screen as their goal, with five shield segments arranged vertically to block incoming shots. A black hole and no‑cross barrier divide the arena, keeping each team on its own side.

Shoot the ball near or through the central black hole to bend its path and dramatically increase its speed, creating high‑risk, high‑reward plays.

METEOR SHOWER
Players: 1–2 CO‑OP
Go solo or team up with a friend to climb the online leaderboard. Defend your shared goal using five shield segments arranged along the bottom of the screen. Two balls are active at all times, and you must shoot them into falling meteors and enemy objects descending from above. Destroy enemy objects in quick succession to build up your score multiplier.

If an enemy hits a shield, that shield is destroyed. If an enemy slips through a gap into the goal area, the run ends. Survive as long as possible, build your multiplier, and push for a new high score.

70010000108740.name: What is Older?
70010000108740.intro: Think you know the history? Jump into the game and find out – choose wisely and become the champion.
70010000108740.description:
What is Older? is a fun, brain-teasing game where you choose which historical event, invention, or milestone happened first. From fire to smartphones, test your sense of time and chase the ultimate high score!

Ever wondered if the wheel spun before the first pyramid was built? Or if cave paintings came before humans tamed dogs? In What is Older?, you’ll dive into the wild timeline of human history for a laugh-out-loud challenge. Pick between two options—Option A or Option B—and guess which one hit the scene first. Easy, right? Not when you’re stuck deciding if the compass sailed before the flush toilet or if the printing press outraced the first eyeglasses!

In this single-mode game, your mission is to stack up the highest score by nailing the older event, invention, or cultural moment. Our list covers everything from the first flicker of fire to the rise of modern gadgets, packed with epic achievements, quirky discoveries, and surprising milestones.

Get it right, and your score soars. Get it wrong, and you’re back to the Stone Age to try again! Perfect for history lovers, trivia fans, or anyone who enjoys a chuckle while learning something new, What is Older? will keep you guessing about the past. Ready to show you’re the sharpest time traveler around? Jump in and start picking!

70010000108746.name: 1st Homizio
70010000108746.description: A strange boy with an unusually large head appears at the edge of the sea. From that moment on, the mysteries grow increasingly insane, and it’s up to you to guide him through dangerous and twisted paths, avoiding capture, toward something terrible and unknown.

70010000108838.name: BANG! BANG! BANDITS Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000108838.intro:
Bang bang away! It feels great!
A new party-style shooting game that can be enjoyed by both children and adults is now available!
70010000108838.description:
BANG! BANG! BANDITS, the party-style gun shooting game that the whole family can enjoy, is now available as the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition!

Set in a bright and pop world with simple controls anyone can master, this title has been further powered up by the performance of the Nintendo Switch 2.

With new support for GameShare, you can now easily play together not only with those nearby but also with people far away. Furthermore, the visuals have evolved to be even more beautiful and vivid! Enjoy an even more thrilling gameplay experience on a high-impact screen with silky-smooth motion.

■Intuitive controls that require zero explanation! Anyone can play immediately!
Simple controls: just hold the Joy-Con™ in one hand as a handgun and aim and shoot at the enemies on the screen!!
Automatically move around the field, aim and shoot at all the enemies that appear, and collect lots and lots of coins!
There is no bullet limit, so you can fire as much as you want!
There's nothing to it, just shoot away!

■12 types of stages x 2 leagues, for a lot of fun to be had!
The Normal League, where the battles take place, has 12 stages with different characteristics, including jungles, urban areas, ruins, and caves.
Once you've conquered all the stages in the Normal League, you can challenge the Wild League, which is the most difficult mode available!

■Unique enemy characters run amok all over the screen!
Defeat the Goomin that attack you one after another, and defeat the evil boss waiting at the end of the stage!

■Enjoy 2 different ways to play: Challenge Mode and Battle Mode! 
Start with low-class stages in Challenge Mode and then conquer the most difficult stages.
You can play alone or in a team of 2 to 4 people! If each player has a Joy-Con, you can enjoy competitive play, such as single battles (individual battles) where 2-4 players compete for the highest score, or team battles where 2 teams of 2 players compete for the highest score!

70010000108861.name: Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER
70010000108861.intro: Outsmart, Outgun, Outlast. The Battlefield Awaits!
70010000108861.description:
Step into the heart of intense, fast-paced combat with Call of Warfare - FPS Modern Shooter, a groundbreaking military shooter that brings tactical warfare to your fingertips. As part of an elite squad, you'll engage in high-stakes 5v5 battles, strategically outsmarting rival teams while striving to eliminate their 1000-point score before they can do the same to you. With your team's survival on the line, every decision, every shot, and every move counts.
Key Features:
- Tactical Combat: Take on the role of a highly-trained operative and lead your team through intense skirmishes, using strategy and skill to outsmart your opponents.
- Points-Based Warfare: Every kill deducts points from your team's score. Lose all points and face defeat.
- Dynamic Maps: Battle across diverse environments, each offering unique challenges and opportunities.
- Massive Arsenal: Choose from over 20 weapons, including rifles, shotguns, and grenades, to suit your playstyle.
- Immersive Action: Realistic gunplay and visuals bring the battlefield to life, putting your tactical skills to the ultimate test.

Get ready to experience warfare like never before in Call of Warfare - FPS Modern Shooter. Join the battlefield, hone your skills, and prove you have what it takes to lead your squad to victory. The ultimate test of strategy and skill awaits. Will you answer the call?

70010000108890.name: Crazy Stars: Rhythm Party
70010000108890.intro: Climb surreal dimensions in this rhythm game powered by high-energy electronic beats! 100+ stages, BPM 110-155 tracks, combos over 357! Extreme tempo awaits!
70010000108890.description:
Step into a vibrant pop world where rhythm meets sport climbing in a fresh, fast-paced action rhythm game. Dash up glowing climbing routes in time with the music using simple button controls, and feel the thrill of "grooving to the summit" as anyone can enjoy the rush of a perfect run. Tropical sunsets, snowy Christmas mountains, and neon-lit cityscapes create a constantly changing backdrop, while the combo counter, PERFECT judgments, and x6 score multiplier at the top of the screen make the moment your score explodes feel truly unforgettable. Choose your favorite tracks from a polished song-select UI and take on more than 100 stages packed with rhythm challenges.

Each stage you clear unlocks new songs and expands your very own "Rhythm Star Collection". Use coins and diamonds earned as rewards to buy and upgrade power-boosting items and gloves, then customize both appearance and abilities with accessories like headsets and wings. Four difficulty levels—Easy, Normal, Hard, and Challenge—ensure that everyone from beginners to rhythm-game veterans can find the perfect groove. Train a colorful cast of climbers, including a yellow-shirted explorer and a dancer in a festive Christmas outfit, and enjoy an addictive rhythm party with your own personal "Rhythm Star".

・A new-style action rhythm game that fuses music and sport climbing.
・Real-time combo counter and PERFECT judgments let you feel the rhythm's excitement across the whole screen.
・Over 100 stages and backgrounds, including tropical sunsets, Christmas nights, and neon city skylines.
・Intuitive song-select UI showing BPM and difficulty so you can quickly pick the track you want.
・Clearing stages unlocks new music and grows your "Rhythm Star Collection".
・Use coins and diamonds to purchase and upgrade gloves, boosting your power stat.
・Customize your character with a wide variety of accessories such as headsets, wings, and glowing auras.
・Original soundtrack featuring multiple genres, including 10 indie K-POP tracks, to enhance the rhythm experience.
・Short stage length makes it perfect for quick play sessions during commutes or breaks.

A colorful pop world, comical and lovable climbers, and a feel-good beat—"Crazy Stars Rhythm Party" is a rhythm party venue where everyone smiles the moment they pick up the controller. Ride the rhythm, race up the rock walls, and use the items and accessories you collect to create your very own ultimate Rhythm Star.

Story
On the pop planet "Rhythmia Star", all life moves to rhythm and beat, and the inhabitants use their "Rhythm Power" to climb walls as part of everyday life. At the very top of the world stands the "Grand Beat Tower", and only those who conquer its peak are honored as the "True Rhythm King".

One day, the planet's rhythm begins to fall into chaos and Rhythm Power starts to fade. In response, the council forms the legendary climber team "Crazy Stars". As one of its members, you set out to gather "Rhythm Crystals" across tropical cliffs, snowy mountains, and neon cities, opening the path to the Grand Beat Tower.

Chain combos to the beat, conquer over 100 stages, and claim the throne of the True Rhythm King.
