70010000109087.name: BROK: Natal Tail, A New Christmas Special
70010000109087.intro: A Christmas Tale in a Dystopia!
70010000109087.description:
When students Graff and Ott are invited to celebrate "Natal Untail," a twisted take on Atlasia's ancient tradition, they'll discover that even in a decaying world, the greatest treasures are the values of sharing and friendship.

This "Special" release adds interactivity through choices and consequences, designed exclusively for consoles.

- A 2-hour visual novel, perfect for reading with kids
- Meet vibrant, animated characters from the BROK universe
- Autoplay mode or read at your own pace
- Choices can lead to fun surprises...or mischief!
- Unlockable in-game achievements
- Text fully localized in 9 languages

Part of the BROK the InvestiGator universe, this prequel introduces key characters and can be enjoyed as a standalone story.

70010000109108.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup!
70010000109108.intro: Play along with classic Toy Story characters in the ultimate 5-game collection.
70010000109108.description:
Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features console and handheld versions of four early Toy Story titles, as well as A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and an overflowing toy chest of behind-the-scenes content. Revisit the ‘90s and early 2000s hits you loved and share these titles with a new generation of Toy Story fans. 

Play Toy Story (1995), Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue! (1999), Toy Story 2 (1999), Buzz Lightyear of Star Command (2000), Toy Story Racer (2001) and A Bug’s Life (1998). Includes 11 total versions of the games across console and handheld. The games have been enhanced with quality-of-life improvements, including Rewind, Rex’s Cheat Codes, and more. Use Rewind to retry mistakes when you miss a jump across Andy’s shelves or take too many hits from the angry, wind-up robot. Unlock game-specific enhancements like unlimited lives or invincibility with Rex’s Cheat Codes.

Step inside Digital Eclipse’s behind-the-scenes experience, featuring exclusive interviews withJason Katz – Head of Story, Pixar, Jim Hanks – Voice Actor, Luigi Priore – VP and GM, Disney & Pixar Games, and Jon Burton – Founder, TT Games, who helped bring these adventures to life. Explore a richly-detailed virtual museum filled with rare design documents, vintage development photos, and archival content. Listen to your favorite songs from the games in the Music Player, where we’ve rounded up the soundtracks from every game in the collection. 

FEATURES

- Play five classic games, including four Toy Story games and A Bug’s Life. Includes 11 total versions of the games across console and handheld.

- Enhancements and quality-of-life improvements make the games easier to learn and understand for gamers of all ages. 

- Use Rewind to fix your mistakes. Messed up a jump? Took too many hits? Simply hold a button and scrub back to before you made that mistake and try again. 

- Includes a behind-the-scenes experience featuring new interviews with Jason Katz – Head of Story, Pixar, Jim Hanks – Voice Actor, Luigi Priore – VP and GM, Disney & Pixar Games, and Jon Burton – Founder, TT Games. 

- Explore the virtual museum filled with rare design documents, vintage development photos, and archival content. 
- Use Rex’s Cheat Codes! Get unlimited lives, invincibility, or unlock all the characters or levels.

- Learn the game with enhanced How to Play instructions, then hone your skills in Practice Mode.

- Listen to the Music Player, which includes the complete soundtrack for every game in the collection.

70010000109113.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
70010000109113.intro: Play as Woody, Buzz, and Jessie in the Complete Edition of the 3D adventure.
70010000109113.description:
Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode. 

In Story Mode, swap between Woody, Buzz, and Jessie as you play through iconic scenes from the film, including the train rescue, Operation Playtime, surviving the junkyard, and more. Harness each character's unique abilities, whether you need to swing on Woody’s pull string or use Buzz’s strength to throw the other toys long distances. You can even play in two-player co-op. 

Step out of Story Mode and into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. This fan-favorite, customizable mode drops you into the wild west of Woody’s Roundup. Like Story Mode, you play as Woody, Buzz, or Jessie, but in Toy Box Mode you can play however you want! Characters around town give you quests to complete, so you can earn gold and spend it on personalizing the town your way. Build, decorate and customize the buildings, dress up the townsfolk, and more.

Toy Story 3 Complete Edition also includes content that was previously restricted to certain versions of the game. Players can now play as the Evil Emperor Zurg in Toy Box Mode, and can access four additional Theme Packs to decorate their Toy Box. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition also features upgraded graphics, resolution, and framerate.

FEATURES

- Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back a fan-favorite game. 

- Relive key moments from the movie in Story Mode from Andy's room to Sunnyside Daycare.

- Swap between Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie, each of with different abilities you’ll need to complete each level. 

- Dive into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. Take on missions for your fellow toys, dress up the townsfolk, decorate buildings, and much more. 

- Play with a friend in local, two player co-op. Available in Story Mode or Toy Box Mode. 

- All versions now include previously exclusive content, such as the ability to play as Emperor Zurg in Toy Box Mode.

70010000109148.name: Shoe Salesman Mania
70010000109148.intro: Sell shoes. Keep smiling. Try not to cry in the stockroom.
70010000109148.description:
Welcome to the glorious decade of big hair, neon lights, and questionable life choices!
In Shoe Salesman Mania, you play as a slightly worn-out shoe clerk trying to survive another day in retail hell — one sale at a time.

Your mission is simple: sell shoes. Lots of them.
Customers walk in, sit down, and show you — quite literally — what they want.
Run to the right shelf, grab the right pair, and hurry back before they lose patience and storm out.

Each day brings higher sales targets, more demanding customers, and a growing sense that you might never leave this place happy again.
Meet your quota before the store closes, and you’ll live to sell another day.
Fail… and you’re fired.

Features:
- Retro 8-bit visuals inspired by classic arcade charm.
- Time-based gameplay — every second counts when customers get restless.
- Increasing daily goals — from ten pairs a day to pure panic mode.
- High-score board — see how far (and how long) you can last in the world’s toughest shoe store.
- Dry humor, sharp one-liners, and the bittersweet joy of customer service.

Grab your measuring tape, fake your best smile, and step into a hard day’s walk — the most honest retail simulator ever made.

70010000109153.name: Cozy Toy Shop
70010000109153.intro:
Build, decorate, and run your dream toy shop!
Craft smiles, serve customers, and grow your cozy world.
A relaxing simulation full of charm and color.
70010000109153.description:
Welcome to Cozy Toy Shop, a relaxing simulation where you manage your own colorful toy store!
Arrange shelves, decorate your space, craft adorable toys, and make every customer happy.
Earn coins, expand your shop, and unlock new designs — from teddy bears to trains and robots!

Play at your own pace, enjoy the calm atmosphere, and create the most heartwarming store in town.
Perfect for players who love creativity, management, and cozy aesthetics.

70010000109159.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000109159.intro: Embark on a cozy adventure with Hello Kitty and Friends and restore an abandoned island to its former glory.
70010000109159.description:
• Discover eight unique regions, from the ocean’s depths to an island in the clouds
•Befriend iconic characters like cheerful Hello Kitty, mischievous Kuromi, and sweet Cinnamoroll
• Bake, cook, and craft the perfect gifts to become best friends
• Renovate cabins and decorate them to attract even more wonderful characters
• Create your perfect avatar, find and customize hundreds of outfits tailored to you, and create and collect furniture to achieve your dream home aesthetic
• Celebrate the joys of summertime, the winter holidays, and more with a year round calendar of events. And don’t forget to throw birthday parties for your friends
• Solve hidden puzzles, catch cute critters, and garden to fill the world with flowers
•Dive into a multiplayer game with real-world friends and family: team up to explore, get bonuses, and take sweet snapshots together

70010000109182.name: Baradroid
70010000109182.intro: Teach robots to experience love in a futuristic world where the lines between humanity and synthetic life begin to blur!
70010000109182.description:
Take the role of a young graduate student in AI studies in Baradroid. Evan lives with 3 robots as a means of studying their behavior and teaching them to interact more naturally with humans. Evan hopes to develop a new generation of androids based on his research, one that can advance society and help overcome human limitations, but over time, one question grows in his mind.

Is it possible to teach a machine the meaning of human love? Baradroid is a visual novel and dating sim set in a futuristic and idealized world. Make key choices for Evan that guide the narrative and perhaps some romance as well… for science, of course.

• Explore relationships between a researcher and his robots!
• Immerse yourself in a futuristic visual novel adventure!
• Guide Evan’s efforts to advance AI technology!
• Make decisions that affect the narrative!
• Enjoy dating sim elements and unlockable scenes!

70010000109187.name: Book of Korvald
70010000109187.intro: Guide a tormented Norse scribe and in his desperate alliance with a parasitic eldritch entity!
70010000109187.description:
With his family slain and village destroyed, Korvald is branded a heretic and seemingly condemned to death, but the truth of his torment is part of a bigger and more sinister agenda! Join forces with beautiful warrior nuns, alluring mythical figures and interdimensional creatures to prevent our world from being devoured. Can you contain your primal urges and fight to survive?

Book of Korvald is a side-scrolling 2D action-adventure where each chapter takes place across an entire country, spanning more than 30 areas of Scandinavia and beyond. Control Korvald as he makes key decisions, encounters dozens of memorable characters and wields a huge variety of weapons against his foes, from axes and swords to whips and maces! Use runes to unleash powerful elemental spells or summon creatures to assist you. Customize your skills to match your playstyle and face off against 30 unique bosses!

• Explore 30 stages as a condemned Norse scribe!
• Wield various weapon types in real-time combat.
• Unlock and upgrade skills across an expansive talent tree!
• Engage in mini-games, from fishing and farming to drinking contests and arena battles.
• Meet dozens of female companions and other unique NPCs!

70010000109192.name: Defending Camelot
70010000109192.intro: Fend off hordes of fiendish invaders in strategic tower defense combat!
70010000109192.description:
Defending Camelot is a tower defense RPG where you’ll take the role of King Arthur and strategically deploy your troops to fend off waves of menacing fiends. Choose from cards representing each unit type, placing archers and warriors of various classes on the battlefield to meet the threat head-on, while farmers and other support units earn coins to purchase more units or deploy magic to strengthen units’ defenses.

Battle through a robust story campaign or test your skills with Endless mode! Visit the barracks to train troops or acquire new unit types from the shop, thus expanding your tactical options as battles get bigger and more challenging. Can you restore peace to King Arthur’s domain?

• Enjoy colorful and casual tower defense gameplay!
• Strategically deploy a variety of unit types to take down waves of enemies.
• Choose from warriors, archers, farmers and more to bolster your front lines!
• Use the barracks to upgrade existing units or unlock new ones from the shop.
• Test your skills in Endless mode!

70010000109198.name: Gridz Keeper
70010000109198.intro: Restore power to the grid and keep humanity protected from the zombie apocalypse!
70010000109198.description:
In the aftermath of a zombie apocalypse, the world has gone dark. Cities lie silent, their power grids fractured and failing. You are the only remaining repairman that can restore power to the last safe zones of humanity.

Gridz Keeper is an action puzzler featuring 50 levels that challenge you to repair all the generators in them to move on. Each generator you repair sparks hope, but the power lines are unstable. Every switch you flip triggers any adjacent ones too, plunging some back into darkness while others flare to life. Master the grid, anticipate the chain reactions and reclaim the light one generator at a time!

• Master 50 stages of brainteasing action!
• Use your wrench to turn generators on and off!
• Strategically activate generators to power them all!
• Overcome gradually increasing complexity and difficulty!
• Retry stages as many times as it takes!

70010000109246.name: Picronix
70010000109246.intro: Take a breather and challenge your brain with these calming logic puzzles
70010000109246.description: Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. Solve the number clues to reveal hidden pixel art pictures. Solving each row and column brings you closer to the final image. Enjoy the perfect blend of calm and challenge. A lot unique puzzles await you. They're perfect for a quick break or a long session. Train your brain and find your inner peace.

70010000109256.name: Royal Watch: The Throne's Duty
70010000109256.intro: A strategic game of royal observation and deduction.
70010000109256.description:
Take your place on the throne in this captivating game of strategy and perception. Royal Watch: The Throne's Duty challenges you to become the all-seeing eye of your kingdom.

    As the Royal Observer, your duty is to watch every move in the court. Analyze actions, detect patterns, and pass your judgment. Your gaze is law, and your attention shapes the fate of the realm.

    Inspired by classic observation games, Royal Watch offers a fresh experience with:

        A deep and strategic "watch-and-deduce" core gameplay

        A unique art style that brings your kingdom to life

        New mechanics that reward careful attention and logic

        Challenging scenarios that test your power of observation

    The crown is heavy, and the throne's duty is never done. Are you ready to take up the watch?

70010000109271.name: EGGCONSOLE Rune Worth 2 PC-9801
70010000109271.intro: Set in a world where the power of the gods, Sail, is waning, you will embark on an adventure as Leen Kashua.
70010000109271.description:
This is an action role-playing game released by T&E SOFT in 1991. Players embark on an adventure as the protagonist, Leen Kashua, in a world where the power of the gods, <Sale>, is gradually fading.

The game, presented in a top-down view, takes you through dungeons and towns on the field map. The world incorporates time, with a day being 32 hours and a year 16 months.

Many cite the serious scenario and presentation as the defining feature. Lacking humorous scenes or cut-ins by deformed characters, the atmosphere is intensely serious, allowing for an understated narrative. It's highly recommended for those seeking a serious fantasy experience. As this is part of a trilogy, consider playing through the entire series.

 
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000109279.name: EGGCONSOLE YUUREIKUN MSX2
70010000109279.intro: Suddenly turned into a ghost and in a total panic! Set off on an adventure with Ocho-kodama as your companion to meet the King of Hell, Enma!
70010000109279.description:
One day, after suddenly becoming a ghost, YUUREIKUN was in a panic, having lost all his memories.

Then a soul named Ochoco-dama appeared, pleading, “My friends are trapped in hell. Please help me.” This complicated the situation for YUUREIKUN, who was already overwhelmed.

But thinking that meeting Great King Enma might provide answers, YUUREIKUN headed to hell with Ochoco-dama as his companion.

This is an action game released by SYSTEM SACOM for the MSX2 in 1989.

Players defeat various enemies with standard shots (Ochoco-Dama) and a backward-leaping tackle (Back Attack). Beautiful graphics that fully utilized the MSX2's capabilities and large enemy characters made this a highly acclaimed title, earning a lot of user support.


*The main game are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000109292.name: BeautyDarling
70010000109292.intro:
"Me… turning into a cute girl!?"
A fabulous journey begins—with beauty, love, and a crash course in being fabulous!
70010000109292.description:
He does have a girlfriend... kind of.
But something’s clearly off, and his real-life relationships just aren’t going well.

You play as our unremarkable, unlucky-in-love male protagonist (voiceless), who ends up seeking advice from Shiki Mihara—a fabulous, sharp-tongued bartender with an unmistakable flair.
Before he knows it, he’s hit with a wild suggestion: “Why not try becoming a girl?”

And so begins a romantic adventure where he, still very much a man inside, tries to understand the heart of a woman.

This is a love sim where you'll connect with girls working in the beauty industry—those dream jobs many girls aspire to!
Just pick a character to dive right into a heart-throbbing story. It’s easy to play and even easier to fall in love.

70010000109302.name: Arcade Archives SPACE INVADERS PART II
70010000109302.intro: In 1979, and again in 2026, the Invaders are returning!
70010000109302.description:
"SPACE INVADERS PART II" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1979.
The enemy Invaders have returned more powerful than ever, having acquired new tactics like splitting and receiving reinforcements from UFOs!
With added features like the Rainbow Bonus to aim for high scores, this title is long beloved by skilled experts looking to hone their abilities!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000109338.name: National Quiz of Common Sense
70010000109338.intro:
Can a “Top-Tier” Genius Like You
Ace These So-Called “Easy” Questions!?
70010000109338.description:
A visual four-choice quiz game that challenges you with all kinds of common-sense questions — the kind that any “ordinary person” should be able to answer!

It’s easy to play：
Read the question carefully, and when you know the answer, just pick the matching image from the four options!
If you choose correctly, you’ll also get to read a detailed explanation.

・Which one is the French dish Fricassée?
・Which is the largest lake in the world?
・Who wrote the lyrics for Beethoven’s “Ninth Symphony”?

…and many more!
If you’ve got the “super-elite” level of common sense, breeze through these so-called easy questions and show off your knowledge to everyone!

Up to 8 players can play together on a single console — perfect for solo brain-training sessions, lively party play, or fun livestream challenges for creators!

70010000109381.name: HauntedManager
70010000109381.description:
Build an unbeatable haunted house of nightmares. In HauntedManager, you'll manage guests, money, and mischievous ghosts while enjoying simple top-down tower defense gameplay.

・You've become the manager of a haunted house!
・Spook guests and chase them out before they make it to the finish line.
・Manage your team of mischievous ghosts.
・Usher crying guests toward the exit so they don't spoil the experience for others.
・Elite guests from the Main Shrine will come to taunt you. Beat them at their own game and have them join your team.

Ghost Staff Members -
・Doppelganger: Not even she knows who she's a copy of, making her basically just another human.
・Crasher: An entity that once dominated the world, though now so well-known that no one fears her.
・Hasshaku: An urban legend of internet origins who doles out physical attacks. Also good at basketball.
...And more!

70010000109403.name: Drifties
70010000109403.intro: Arcade racing turned up to eleven!
70010000109403.description:
Get ready for racing that’s all speed, style, and chaos. This is arcade action at its most colorful, where every corner is made for drifting and every bump can send a rival flying.

Race through 40 wild stages spread across four vibrant worlds, from sun-soaked city streets to snowy mountain passes and foggy night tracks. Each race is three laps of pure mayhem, with two rivals on your tail and only your drifting skills to keep you ahead.

The controls are simple, the drifting is smooth, and the action never slows down. Knock rivals off the track, master the curves, and collect coins to unlock flashy new cars, wheels, and driver outfits.

It’s fast, it’s cartoony, and it never takes itself too seriously—just the way arcade racing should be.

70010000109453.name: Jaleco Sports: Bases Loaded
70010000109453.intro: Bases Loaded brings the NES™ + Super NES™ classic baseball action back!
70010000109453.description:
America's favorite pastime is back in season and now available on the Nintendo Switch™!
Enjoy the legendary throwback pack of the esteemed Bases Loaded games for NES™ and Super NES™.
The baseball series that set the standard for sports games! Featuring smooth animations, fast-paced arcade action, and a unique behind-the-pitcher camera view, Bases Loaded delivers the thrill of America’s pastime like never before.

Bases Loaded (NES™, 1988)
- Realistic retro voice, action, and graphics.
- Unique television-style presentation.
- Play against the computer or a friend.
- Pick your team from 12 different lineups.
- Select your lineup from 30 unique players.
- Each ball player has his own style.
- Control and play any position.

Super Bases Loaded (Super NES™, 1991)
- All-new center field TV perspective.
- Rates your skill in 13 categories.
- 5 increasingly difficult levels of play.
- Pick from 13 different teams.
- Watch mode to see the computer play itself.
- Unique “radar” feature that shows location of fielders.
- New strategies allow you to customize your team.

Authentic Baseball Action – Feel the excitement of every pitch, hit, and home run with intuitive controls and strategic gameplay.

Seamlessly switch between the NES™ and Super NES™ versions anytime.

Need help? A built-in manual is always ready to guide you!

Retro CRT Mode – Play with a classic TV filter for the ultimate 90s nostalgia.

Whether you're a longtime fan of Bases Loaded or a newcomer ready to experience one of the most beloved baseball franchises, it's time to grab your bat, step into the box, and swing for the fences!

70010000109459.name: Jaleco Sports: Bases Loaded 2
70010000109459.intro: Bases Loaded is back for a second season with even more classic baseball action!
70010000109459.description:
Bases Loaded 2 comes out swinging featuring an all new 3-D perspective, custom teams, the player performance system, and classic arcade-style gameplay. These NES™ & Super NES™ favorites bring fast-paced fun. Play a full season or a quick game - step up to the plate and swing for the fences today!

A world championship rides on every pitch, and one wrong move can end your season.

Bases Loaded II: Second Season / Moero!! Pro Yakyū '88 Kettei Ban (NES™, 1988 - 1990)

- All new retro graphics from the original.

- More realistic player animations.

- New fielding dives and leaping catches.

- New player performance system.

- Fully simulated defense, offense, and base-running.

- New large stadium graphics.

- New authentic voice synthesis.


Super Bases Loaded 2 / Super 3D Baseball / Hanguk Pro Yagu (Super NES™, 1992-1994)

- Amazing new 3-D “camera” perspective.

- CUSTOM TEAM option lets you design and save your own teams.

- Adjustable season lengths - from 10 to 162 games.

- Detailed, ever-changing player stats keep track of every play you make.

- Make play as easy or as challenging as you want with AUTOMATIC FIELDING and ERRORS options.

- Detailed info on leading hitters and pitchers is available at any time.

- Updated fatigue factors recreate pitching with stunning realism.



Authentic Baseball Action - Feel the excitement of every pitch, hit, and home run with intuitive controls and strategic gameplay.

Seamlessly switch between the NES™ and Super NES™ versions anytime.

Need help? The built-in manuals are always ready to guide you!

Rewind the action like a VHS tape – missed that pitch or pass? Go back in time and try again!

Retro Presentation – Play with a classic TV CRT filter or with the many other display options for the ultimate nostalgia.

Compete against the world and your friends on the monthly leaderboards.

Whether you're a longtime fan of the Bases Loaded series or a newcomer ready to experience one of the most beloved baseball franchises, it's time to grab your bat, step into the box, and swing for the fences!

70010000109471.name: Jaleco Sports: Goal!
70010000109471.intro: Experience the ultimate soccer showdown with Goal!, the original NES™ and Super NES™ classics that first brought real-world tactics and Cup intensity to your living rooms.
70010000109471.description:
The clock ticks down.



The roar of the crowd rises in a deafening chant!



Suddenly, your winger breaks free, and spots the open man in the middle. Pass...shot...Goal! It’s the world’s favorite sport, and soon to become your favorite new home video game, thanks to Jaleco! Because Goal! brings soccer to life like you’ve never seen it.

Goal! / Moero!! Pro Soccer (NES™, 1988-1989)
- Choose from 24 different teams.
- Includes Exhibition matches, Tournaments, and Penalty Kick shootouts modes.
- Adjust your team's formation and playstyle before each match.
- Take direct control of your goalkeeper during critical saves.
- Compete head-to-head or team up against the CPU.
- Unleash powerful kicks that bend and blast toward the goal.
- Complete manuals in English, French, Dutch, German, Spanish and Japanese.
- Check out the details on the preserved original box art.

Goal! / Super Goal! / Super Cup Soccer (Super NES™, 1992-1993)
- Choose from an international field of 24 teams.
- Includes Match Play and Super Cup tournament modes.
- Multiple play perspectives, including full field "radar".
- A closeup instant replay of scoring shots.
- Special moves...  kick, block, head, bicycle kick, pass or steal.
- Choose from 4 defensive formations.
- Complete manuals in English, French, Dutch, German, Spanish and Japanese. 
- Check out the details on the preserved original box art.

Authentic Action – Feel the excitement of every kick, pass, and block with intuitive controls and strategic gameplay.

Seamlessly switch between the NES™ and Super NES™ versions anytime including all regional releases of both games.

Rewind the action like a VHS tape – missed that goal or pass? Go back in time and try again!

Need help? The original localized manuals are built-in and always ready to guide you!

70010000109495.name: Ragdoll Arena - Kick the body
70010000109495.intro: Kick, crash, survive – the arena never forgives!
70010000109495.description:
Step into Ragdoll Arena: Kick the Body – the ultimate third-person ragdoll battleground where chaos meets strategy.
Every fight is unpredictable: physics-driven ragdoll duels, intense gunfights, and tricky puzzles that push your reflexes and brainpower to the limit.

Your mission is simple – fight through arenas, solve challenges, and survive long enough to reach the store, where new upgrades unlock the path to the next level. But don’t relax: one wrong move, one missed shot, and your floppy hero will be flying across the map.

With smooth graphics, hilarious physics, thrilling action, and clever puzzles, this is not just another ragdoll game – it’s your test of skill, timing, and pure madness.

Are you ready to kick, shoot, and ragdoll your way to victory?

70010000109497.name: Mori Carta
70010000109497.intro: Decide fast. Build smart. Survive longer.
70010000109497.description:
Mori Carta is a handless deckbuilding roguelike. Choose left or right on every card to adventure through stories. Simple decisions lead to rich and rewarding gameplay. Four dramatically different characters with their own unique card sets, more than 1000 playable cards, over 185 unique enemies.

Features:
Deceptively simple controls: Almost every interaction in the game is handled by moving left or right.

Engaging story: Adventure with a colorful cast of characters that accompany you on your adventures.

Rich depth of builds and combos: Choosing cards to add to your deck will be critical in surviving your adventures. With over 1000 cards, the combinations are endless.

4 dramatically different characters with their own unique card sets.
1000+ playable cards.
185 unique enemies.

70010000109525.name: Club Sports Collection
70010000109525.intro: Five club classics. One game. Endless fun on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000109525.description:
Club Sports Collection – Your All-In-One Lounge Experience!

Step into the ultimate game lounge — right on Nintendo Switch™!
Club Sports Collection brings together the world’s favorite bar and club games in one stylish, realistic experience.

Challenge yourself or your friends in thrilling matches of pool, snooker, darts, bowling, and foosball — all recreated with authentic physics, intuitive controls, and stunning 3D visuals. Whether you’re sinking the 8-ball, striking for a perfect 300, hitting the bullseye, or scoring the winning goal, every game feels true-to-life and packed with fun!

Customize tables, cues, darts, balls, and more to create your perfect setup. Play solo to master your precision, or invite friends for exciting local multiplayer duels.

Features:

* Five classic club games: Pool, Snooker, Darts, Bowling & Foosball
* Realistic physics and immersive 3D graphics
* Single-player and local multiplayer modes
* Dozens of customization options for cues, balls, boards, and tables
* Smooth Joy-Con™ controls for a natural gameplay feel

Grab Joy-Con™, step up to the table, and prove your skills —
Club Sports Collection turns Nintendo Switch™ into the ultimate social playground!

70010000109536.name: Sheriff Park Ranger
70010000109536.intro: Patrol deeper. React faster. Protect harder.
70010000109536.description:
Patrol vast forests, winding trails, and scenic highways as you protect visitors, wildlife, and the wilderness itself. Respond to emergencies, stop offenders, rescue animals, and face unpredictable situations that test your skills and instincts.

Drive your patrol truck, flash your lights, and keep order in the wild. From traffic stops and poaching investigations to lost hikers and wildfires — every call matters. Earn experience, upgrade your gear, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate park ranger.

Key Features:
• Explore a vast open-world national park full of forests, roads, and hidden trails.
• Conduct patrols, check documents, stop reckless drivers, and enforce the law.
• Handle real-time emergencies: fires, accidents, poaching, and animal rescues.
• Use authentic ranger tools and vehicles with working lights and sirens.
• Progress, upgrade, and customize your ranger for tougher missions.
• Experience immersive realism with dynamic weather and day-night cycles.

Your shift starts now — siren on, tank full, and the wild waiting for you.

70010000109553.name: YinYang Street: Separate Ways
70010000109553.intro: Find you beloved at any cost
70010000109553.description: YinYang Street: Separate Ways, as the spin-off of YinYang Street Ultimate Edition, completes the story through Duan Lifang’s eyes. Duan Lifang, a woman from Bai minority, is an ordinary employee at the Spring City Textile Mill. One day, her husband returns home on leave. After a long separation, the couple decides to go to the nearby cinema to watch a film called Flower on the Plateau. However, this dreamlike romantic date unexpectedly triggers a series of bizarre and inexplicable events...

70010000109598.name: Hidden Cats in Istanbul
70010000109598.intro: Spot hidden cats around the timeless, golden streets of Istanbul!
70010000109598.description:
Let the ever-wandering Hidden Cats crew be your guide through colourful Istanbul!

Explore the city’s iconic landmarks like the Blue Mosque, the Grand Bazaar, and Gülhane Park while relaxing to soothing Turkish-inspired music.

Discover over 900 hidden objects, unlock special cats, and as always - enjoy cozy, no-stress gameplay in a city full of color, history, and charm!

Features:
- 900+ hidden objects, 8 unique levels with unlockables
- Collectible cards, achievements, secrets to discover
- Hand-drawn art & original soundtrack with dynamic sound effects

70010000109603.name: Cats Around Us: Giant Cat
70010000109603.intro: Spot hidden cats in a comic where a GIANT CAT brings chaos!
70010000109603.description:
A GIANT CAT has made an (otherwise) peaceful village its napping spot! Can you find all the hidden cats scattered around the chaos?

Explore four illustrated comic pages, search for hundreds of felines, and complete relaxing jigsaw puzzles.

Cats Around Us: Giant Cat combines hidden-object gameplay with storybook art, offering a cozy, creative experience for cat and cartoon lovers alike!

Features:
- 200+ hidden objects, 4 comic page levels - each with a puzzle!
- Photo & Paint Mode to capture and color your scene
- Adjustable game colours, brightness, and contrast!

70010000109609.name: Critical Strike Modern - SWAT Shooter Ops
70010000109609.intro: Silent moves, smart gadgets, unstoppable force.
70010000109609.description:
Step into the boots of an elite SWAT operative in this fast-paced tactical shooter. Take on high-risk missions across the globe, from rescuing hostages and defusing bombs to gathering critical intelligence and neutralizing armed threats. Every mission challenges your precision, strategy, and quick thinking — stealth, gadgets, and careful planning can be just as powerful as raw firepower.

FEATURES:
• High-Stakes Tactical Missions: Complete diverse assignments with multiple approaches — go silent and stealthy, use distractions and gadgets, or storm in with full force. Each choice changes the outcome.
• Customizable Weapons & Gear: Upgrade pistols, assault rifles, and tactical tools. Attach scopes, silencers, flashlights, and other modifications. Personalize your operative with combat suits, outfits, and visual upgrades to match your style.
• Dynamic Gameplay Mechanics: Sprint, crouch, aim down sights, jump, and use specialized gadgets like night vision, flashbangs, or health injections. Defuse bombs, gather evidence, support teammates, and react to unexpected threats in real time.
• Intelligent Enemy AI: Enemies patrol, investigate, and adapt to your actions. Alarms trigger reinforcements, forcing you to rethink your tactics. Success depends on strategy, precision, and adaptability.
• Mission Variety & Replayability: Engage in hostage rescues, sabotage operations, intelligence gathering, and full-scale assaults. Multiple objectives and branching paths ensure every mission feels unique and replayable.
• Immersive Environments: Experience cinematic, realistic locations that immerse you in the tension of modern SWAT operations, with every detail affecting your tactical decisions.

READY FOR ACTION?
Gear up, plan your approach, and execute each mission with precision. Every move matters — your critical strike begins now.

70010000109656.name: Froggy Hates Snow
70010000109656.intro: Dig, fight, and survive as Froggy in a frozen world where warmth means life.
70010000109656.description: You are Froggy — a determined survivor in a hostile, snowy desert. Dig paths through the snow to discover treasure, battle eerie creatures, and adapt in a world where warmth is survival and the freezing temperatures aren’t the only thing that can kill! Stay out too long and you’ll freeze, unless you’ve upgraded your abilities to withstand it. But the cold is not the only threat. Eerie obsidian-black creatures prowl the drifts, each with unique behaviours and attacks. Mysterious anomaly zones offer deadly challenges with huge rewards. Use the snow as cover or blast it apart with flamethrowers and explosives to gain the upper hand

70010000109659.name: Funny Animal Cafe
70010000109659.intro: Turn a tiny café into the animals' favorite spot.
70010000109659.description:
Run the coziest café in town, staffed and visited by adorable animal friends! In Funny Animal Café, you start small, but with smart choices, tasty menus, and creative decor, your café will become the talk of the town.

Seat your guests, take their orders, cook delicious meals, and serve them with a smile. Each satisfied customer earns you coins to upgrade your kitchen, hire new staff, and expand your space. From bunnies and kittens to quirky woodland creatures, each visitor has their favorite dishes. Can you keep up with the demand?

Features:
★ Run your own café: Design and decorate it to make it truly yours.
★ Cook and serve: Take orders, prepare meals, and deliver them quickly.
★ Upgrade and expand: Unlock new equipment, furniture, and staff to grow your business.
★ Meet adorable animal guests: Each with unique personalities and tastes.
★ Earn & reinvest: Manage your resources wisely to keep customers happy and your café thriving.

Build your dream café, make animal friends, and see how far your skills as a café owner can take you!

70010000109665.name: Mega City Obby
70010000109665.intro: Leap, climb, and sprint your way through a city swallowed by the flood.
70010000109665.description:
The waters have risen, and the only way forward is up. Mega City Obby is a fast-paced parkour adventure where every rooftop, ledge, and broken highway is your path to survival. Precision jumps and quick reflexes will guide you through a massive flooded metropolis built for only the most daring players.

Features:

> Flooded urban playground – Navigate skyscrapers, rooftops, and the streets as you escape the rising tide.

> Parkour your way through – Run, jump, climb, and balance across creative obstacle courses designed to test skill and speed.

> Challenging but fair – Every fall is a lesson, and every retry brings you closer to mastering the city.

> Immersive atmosphere – A striking flooded city setting makes every leap feel daring and cinematic.

Can You Conquer the Flood?

70010000109668.name: Sin Slayers: Reign of The 8th
70010000109668.intro:
A dark RPG Roguelite where every choice feeds your sins.
Assemble cursed heroes and survive tactical battles.
Face the Sin Lords — manifestations of the deadly sins.
70010000109668.description:
Seven Deadly Sins. Have you heard about the 8th?
Sin Slayers: Reign of the 8th is a dark RPG Roguelite where every choice shapes your fate. Lead a party of cursed heroes through monster-infested lands, survive tactical turn-based battles, and confront the nightmare born from humanity’s sins.

Bear the Weight of Sin

Every action feeds the Sinometer. Choose the easy path of temptation for greater rewards, but beware — the more sin you carry, the stronger and more terrifying your enemies become until the Sin Lord himself rises to challenge you.

Assemble Your Party of Lost Souls

Knights, rogues, witches, nuns — each hero bears their own burden. Equip and train them, then guide them into cursed regions where survival depends on your strategy and choices.

Confront the Sin Lords

Each region hides a monstrous embodiment of a deadly sin. Study their patterns, discover their weaknesses, and defeat them in brutal turn-based combat to break their hold over the world.

A journey of damnation or salvation awaits. Will you resist the darkness — or embrace it?

70010000109683.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
70010000109683.intro: Disclaimer: Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for whatever you awaken in the dark.
70010000109683.description:
Enter the abandoned workshop of Murray’s Costume Manor and unravel the mystery left behind by the reclusive inventor, Edwin Murray. In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, you’ll step into a world where every dark corner holds a secret and every flicker of light hints at an ever-present threat. The Mimic, a prototype endoskeleton, can adapt to any costume and become any character, including what you fear most. Armed with only your wits, a few gadgets, and a heavily redacted corporate briefing, you’ll attempt to retrieve Fazbear’s prized prototype technology while grappling with cryptic clues and a relentless shadow determined to dispatch all unwanted company.

Prepare for heart-pounding thrills as you explore the labyrinth of the deserted Costume Manor, discovering remnants of Edwin’s unfinished work and eluding the monster he’s created. Experience Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, and survive the mystery and madness. 

Disclaimer: Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for whatever you awaken in the dark.

70010000109688.name: Entrance 8 入口
70010000109688.intro:
Mystery.
The anomalies will lead to “Entrance 8.” It feels like a living nightmare.
70010000109688.description: Trapped in a dark corridor, every detail must be carefully observed. Only by noticing the anomalies can the path to Entrance 8 be found.

70010000109716.name: Waterpark Simulator 25
70010000109716.intro: Transform your park into the ultimate spot for summer fun.
70010000109716.description:
Build, manage, and grow your very own waterpark, turning it into the ultimate summer destination. Design thrilling slides, relaxing pools, and vibrant leisure zones, all while keeping your visitors happy and your park running smoothly.

Key Features:
• Build Your Dream Park: Create and expand your waterpark with exciting rides, pools, food stands, and more.
• Keep It Clean and Safe: Maintain your facilities, manage cleanliness, and ensure every guest enjoys their visit.
• Watch the Crowds Come to Life: Visitors move, react, and enjoy your park in dynamic, realistic ways.
• Day & Night Experience: Run your park across changing times of day, unlocking new attractions as you progress.
• Grow Your Business: Earn money, upgrade your facilities, and develop your park into a thriving destination.

Every splash counts! Bring your vision to life and create the perfect place for fun, relaxation, and unforgettable memories in Waterpark Simulator 25.

70010000109722.name: Word Quest Cyberpunk
70010000109722.intro: The grid is alive. Can you decode the future?
70010000109722.description: Dive into a neon-lit word search adventure in Word Quest: Cyberpunk. Navigate a high-tech metropolis filled with glowing streets, rogue AI, and hidden data streams. Connect letters, uncover encrypted words, and hack your way through challenging puzzles set in a dystopian future. Every level brings you deeper into the digital underworld — do you have what it takes to outsmart the system and master the code?

70010000109734.name: Word Quest Nature
70010000109734.intro: Find your calm. Discover the wild.
70010000109734.description: Reconnect with the natural world in Word Quest: Nature, a peaceful yet captivating word search adventure. Wander through lush forests, serene lakes, blooming meadows, and majestic mountains as you connect letters and uncover hidden words inspired by the beauty of the outdoors. Each puzzle invites you to relax, breathe, and explore. How far will your journey take you through the wonders of nature?

70010000109744.name: Hentai Session
70010000109744.intro: Relax and enjoy completing beautiful picture puzzles piece by piece.
70010000109744.description:
Welcome to Hentai Session, a relaxing puzzle experience full of color, style, and charm. Take your time to assemble vivid illustrations featuring elegant and expressive characters. Each completed puzzle unlocks a detailed image designed with care and creativity in your collection.


Enjoy the satisfying flow of gameplay, soft background music, and cozy atmosphere that make each session a moment of calm and focus. Whether you’re here to unwind or to challenge your observation skills, it’s the perfect way to relax and have fun.


KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 puzzles to complete
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle assembly
- High-quality illustrations full of detail
- Gentle music and relaxing atmosphere
- Gallery mode to view completed works
- Perfect for a calm and focused gameplay session

70010000109745.name: Hentai Vision
70010000109745.description:
Enter Hentai Vision - a refined puzzle experience where sensual art meets serene gameplay. Uncover stunning portraits of feminine allure, each crafted with emotion, elegance, and vivid detail. As you assemble each image, you reveal not just a masterpiece, but a moment of quiet admiration.


Soft background music and a soothing atmosphere turn every moment into quiet focus and satisfaction. Whether you’re looking to unwind or simply admire the art you complete, Hentai Vision offers a peaceful escape into a world of charm and creativity.


KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 beautiful images to discover and assemble
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle system - focus on the art, not the mechanics
- High-quality visuals rich in color, emotion, and detail
- Relaxing background music that sets a calm, immersive mood
- Gallery mode - revisit and admire your completed artworks anytime
- Perfect for quiet, focused sessions of visual satisfaction

70010000109746.name: Hentai Frames
70010000109746.description:
Enter Hentai Frames- a refined puzzle experience where sensual art meets serene gameplay. Uncover stunning portraits of feminine allure, each crafted with emotion, elegance, and vivid detail. As you assemble each image, you reveal not just a masterpiece, but a moment of quiet admiration.


Soft background music and a soothing atmosphere turn every moment into quiet focus and satisfaction. Whether you’re looking to unwind or simply admire the art you complete, Hentai Frames offers a peaceful escape into a world of charm and creativity.


KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 beautiful images to discover and assemble
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle system - focus on the art, not the mechanics
- High-quality visuals rich in color, emotion, and detail
- Relaxing background music that sets a calm, immersive mood
- Gallery mode - revisit and admire your completed artworks anytime
- Perfect for quiet, focused sessions of visual satisfaction

70010000109748.name: Summer Unpacked
70010000109748.intro: Unpack your memories, relax, and let the summer linger a little longer.
70010000109748.description:
Summer may be ending, but your adventure is just beginning! In Summer Unpacked, you’ll revisit the cozy moments of your summer days through many charming puzzle levels. Sort your souvenirs, organize your travel bags, and rediscover the little joys that made the season special. Each puzzle is a gentle reminder of sunny afternoons, seaside picnics, and long, golden sunsets.


Relax, take your time, and enjoy the soothing gameplay designed to bring back those warm summer vibes. Whether you’re folding clothes, arranging postcards, or fitting keepsakes perfectly into place - every level tells a quiet story of nostalgia and peace. It’s the perfect way to say goodbye to summer… without really letting it go.


KEY FEATURES: 
- Over 30 cozy puzzle levels inspired by the end of summer
- Relaxing gameplay full of gentle logic and organization challenges
- Beautiful, sun-washed visuals and calm ambient soundtrack
- Feel-good atmosphere perfect for winding down
- Satisfying mix of sorting, arranging, and fitting puzzles

70010000109758.name: Funimal: Fusion Animal
70010000109758.intro:
“Funimal” is a turn-based sliding puzzle
 that you move the ground to lead Funimal and
 < you can always clear in 5 moves or fewer! >
70010000109758.description:
The purpose is to move various objects at different fields
 to lead (=CATCH) the unknown creature “Funimal” to the goal.

■How to is simple! Just move it ↑ or ←!
Simply select the ground you want to move and slide it vertically or horizontally?it's that easy!
There's no time limit, so you can take your time without feeling rushed.


■The story proceeds as your CATCH
Pokke and Pikke are here to support you.
The more you CATCH Funimal, the more new information and new places you'll discover.
Whenever there's a new discovery, it seems they'll let you know.

Please enjoy CATCHING together with them.


■No worries if puzzles aren't your thing!
Most stages can be cleared in just 3 moves,
making it easy to think things through repeatedly and plan ahead.
It's enjoyable regardless of gaming experience or age!

Even so, stuck and can't figure it out...?
If that happens, try Redoing it a few times, and Pikke will give you a “Hint”!

...That said, the further you progress, the harder it gets.
Puzzle pros will definitely enjoy it too!


■Encyclo of Living things
You can check detailed info on the Funimals you've CATCHED in the encyclopedia.

Successfully CATCHING them seems to unlock more details to explore.
Why don’t you browse the encyclopedia relaxing between CATCHES?
It's fun!

70010000109760.name: Owlen and the Spirits of the Past
70010000109760.intro: Help Owlen to restore the past, and uncover lost memories.
70010000109760.description:
Embark on a heartfelt journey as Owlen, a small owl soaring through mystical worlds filled with wonder and secrets. Guided by the voices of ancient spirits, you must restore balance by flying through magical circles, bringing plants, trees, and wildlife back to life.
While exploring, you’ll uncover hidden memory shards scattered across the lands. These shards hold the forgotten past and reveal Owlen’s true mission. Collect enough of them to progress into new worlds, each with its own theme, atmosphere, and story.
At the beginning of each level, you are introduced to the world’s history and setting. As you fly, spirits may call to you, offering guidance, requests, or glimpses of their memories. Your journey is one of freedom, discovery, and restoration — as you seek to heal the lands and uncover the ancient truth.

70010000109763.name: Owlen and Whispering Woods
70010000109763.intro: Take flight as a small owl, exploring mystical woods and restoring life through ancient magic.
70010000109763.description:
Begin a heartfelt journey through enchanted forests where magic lingers in every branch and shadow. As a small owl guided by gentle spirits, you soar above glowing marshes, whispering trees, and ancient groves. Your purpose is to restore balance by flying through magical circles that awaken plants, revive wildlife, and breathe life back into forgotten woodlands.
Along your journey, you will find memory shards hidden beneath canopies, inside hollow trees, or deep within misty swamps. These fragments reveal the long-lost past and help you uncover your true mission. Collect enough of them, and new regions of the forest open before you—each with its own atmosphere, story, and mysteries.
At the start of each level, you are introduced to the history and significance of the land you are about to explore. Spirits may call to you as you glide, offering guidance, sharing memories, or asking for your help. Your adventure is one of gentle exploration and quiet discovery, woven together by the wisdom of the forest and the echoes of an ancient story.

70010000109766.name: Sora - Winds of the Jungle
70010000109766.intro: Soar as a spirited parrot through lush jungles and tropical islands. Follow your flock, hit speed boosts, and glide through sky markers in a peaceful flying adventure.
70010000109766.description:
Embark on a breathtaking journey through the jungle skies in Sora – Winds of the Jungle. Play as a vibrant parrot and soar across tropical islands, dense canopies, waterfalls, and ancient ruins. Your goal is simple yet meaningful: stay close to your flock as you all travel across the wild, untouched archipelago.
Each of the handcrafted levels features 40–60 sky markers guiding your path as your flock leads the way. Fly through wind boosts to gain speed, discover hidden shortcuts, and enjoy the feeling of freedom as you glide above treetops and turquoise waters. The world is full of life and color, rewarding you with beautiful vistas and relaxing moments of harmony in flight.
Though the skies are peaceful, you must stay alert—fall too far behind, and you risk losing the flock. Crashes don’t punish you harshly; you simply return to the most recent waypoint and continue your journey. The focus is on enjoying the adventure, soaking in the serene atmosphere, and experiencing the thrill of flying together.
With smooth controls, gentle pacing, and vibrant flocks that vary in speed each run, every flight feels fresh. Whether you're racing through the breeze or drifting lazily over a jungle river, Sora – Winds of the Jungle offers a warm, relaxing escape into tropical skies where unity and exploration take center stage.

70010000109769.name: The Art of Deer & Boy
70010000109769.intro: Explore Deer & Boy's world with its Digital Artbook.
70010000109769.description:
Take a deeper look into the world of Deer&Boy with its 60 pages of exclusive artworks and behind-the-scenes information about Deer & Boy's creation.

Spoiler alert! This product contains some spoilers regarding Deer & Boy.

Note: The Artbook is only available in English.

The complete official soundtrack of Deer & Boy. Listen to Corentin Brasart's stunning 53-track composition score.

Total length: 1h58 minutes

70010000109775.name: Sora - Songs of the Stone
70010000109775.intro: Stay united with your wandering parrot flock.
70010000109775.description:
Begin a majestic journey across vast deserts, towering mountains, and forgotten stone temples. As a vibrant parrot, you glide through sunlit canyons, silent ruins, and sweeping plateaus while staying close to your flock on a long and meaningful migration.
Each handcrafted level guides your flight with 40–60 airy markers drifting between ridges, arches, cliffs, and ancient structures. Wind boosts offer bursts of speed to help you keep pace, while the open landscapes invite you to explore and take in the quiet beauty of the world around you.
The experience stays peaceful throughout—there are no enemies, no dangers, only the challenge of maintaining your rhythm as you navigate through stone corridors and across glowing desert skies. If you collide with anything, you gently return to the last marker and continue your serene flight.
Every flock behaves a little differently, making each run feel unique. Some birds glide swiftly through the canyons, while others move with a slower, more deliberate grace. Whether you’re carving through the air above sand dunes or drifting past ancient monoliths, each moment offers a soothing balance of calm exploration and light challenge.
Let the stone sing beneath your wings as you soar from landmark to landmark, discovering the stories etched into every cliff and ruin along your path.

70010000109778.name: Aery - The King's Messenger
70010000109778.intro: Relaxing bird adventure: Explore 11 fantasy worlds, collect Memory Shards, and uncover the story of a threatened kingdom.
70010000109778.description:
Aery – The King’s Messenger is a story-driven flight exploration game in which you play as a small, graceful bird soaring through a peaceful medieval fantasy world. As the king’s loyal messenger, it is your mission to scout the realm, uncover hidden knowledge, and help protect the humans from a looming threat posed by the evil neighboring kingdom.
Experience a relaxing, immersive adventure that focuses on atmosphere, freedom, and discovery. Glide effortlessly over colorful forests, through vast valleys, across ancient towns, and past mystical landmarks as you explore the world from the unique perspective of a bird. Each environment offers its own theme, mood, and artistic identity, symbolizing different stages of the bird’s journey.
Your main objective is to collect Memory Shards scattered throughout the world. These glowing fragments hold memories and vital information that gradually reveal the story of the kingdom and guide you toward your next destination. Once you gather enough shards, new areas open up and the narrative continues to unfold.
With 11 expansive levels—each filled with collectibles, secrets, and unique visual styles—Aery – The King’s Messenger offers a calm, straightforward, and enjoyable gameplay experience designed to help you unwind while exploring at your own pace.
Features:
•	A peaceful, relaxing flight experience without enemies or hazards
•	11 large levels with unique themes, moods, and color palettes
•	Smooth, continuous flight controls for a calming sense of freedom
•	Narrative moments at the start and end of each level, plus contextual story breaks
•	Numerous hidden Memory Shards to discover and collect

70010000109781.name: Aery - Surreal World
70010000109781.intro: You play as a tiny bird shaped spirit drifting through impossible, dreamlike worlds on a journey to restore balance to a universe where reality has come undone.
70010000109781.description:
This game is a relaxing, story-driven flight exploration game that carries you through a series of impossible, dreamlike worlds where reality has quietly lost its mind.

You play as a tiny spirit drifting endlessly forward through landscapes that shouldn't exist. Glide alongside an enormous dirty whale as it tumbles weightlessly through a sky laced with glittering rainbows — close enough to see the barnacles and grime clinging to its hide as streaks of violet and gold light wash over it. Descend into a sunken apartment block resting silently on the ocean floor, where coral has crept up the wallpaper, fish drift through the living room, and the television still flickers faintly in the deep blue dark. Soar through a vast kingdom where every tree, every cloud, and every cobblestone has been consumed by solid, gleaming gold — beautiful, eerie, and utterly silent.

Each world is its own self-contained dream: a unique color palette, atmosphere, and mood that tells a different piece of a larger, quietly unfolding story. Hidden across every level are glowing memory fragments — scattered clues to what this broken universe once was. Collect enough of them and the next impossible world opens up.

The game is designed above all else to feel good. The flying is smooth and freeing, the worlds are strange and beautiful, and the story unfolds gently without ever demanding anything of you. Whether you play to explore, to collect, or simply to get lost somewhere wonderfully weird, there is always something waiting just around the next impossible corner.

70010000109787.name: Aery - Calm Horizon
70010000109787.intro: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.
70010000109787.description:
This game is an interactive game experience that is designed to relax your mind and soul. You jump into the role of a little bird, explore beautiful landscapes and collect magical crystals that mark certain landscapes.

Because there are no enemies or any other danger in this game you will be able to lean back and enjoy the scenery and the sensation of flying. It is a great game for relaxing and calming down after an exhausting day full of hassle.

Of course, you can always select the level that you feel helps most to relax yourself. Most levels can be finished quite quickly so that you can freely choose spend time exploring the environment but you don’t have to stay for too long if you are just looking for a short moment of peace and enjoyment.

This game features a collection of some the most beautiful sceneries from the Aery franchise. 
We hope you like them. So lean back and take a deep breath…

70010000109794.name: Secrets of Blackrock Manor - Escape Room
70010000109794.intro: Uncover Blackrock Manor’s fortune and the truth behind the family deaths.
70010000109794.description:
After the mysterious deaths of his three children, Augustus Blackrock hid his fortune so no one could claim it. But was that his only secret? What really happened to the Blackrock family?

EXPLORE THE MANOR
Search every corner of the eerie Blackrock Manor in pursuit of its hidden fortune.

SOLVE PUZZLES
Observe, think, and connect clues to solve the eight escape rooms within the manor. Every object could be a hint. Keep your eyes open!

UNCOVER THE TRUTH
Discover what became of the Blackrock family and where Augustus’s treasure lies.

FEATURES
*Eight escape rooms filled with puzzles
*Stylized environments
*An intriguing story

70010000109797.name: Cozy Tiny Home
70010000109797.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70010000109797.description:
Step into a pastel paradise where creativity meets comfort. In Cozy Tiny Home, every item tells a story - from soft cushions and glowing lamps to shelves packed with memories. Whether you’re decorating a snug study, a sunny living room, or a peaceful bedroom, each space becomes your own cozy retreat filled with charm, color, and serenity.


Relax and express yourself through endless decorating possibilities. Combine cute furniture, cheerful plants, and playful accessories to make your dream home come alive with warmth and personality. With cuddly cats, curious bunnies, and plenty of smiles, every moment feels like a cozy hug!


KEY FEATURES:
- Build and decorate your own cozy rooms in a cute, pastel world
- Invite adorable cats, bunnies, and other fluffy friends to share your space
- Hundreds of lovely furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to mix and match
- Soft, relaxing music and soothing atmosphere for pure comfort
- Endless creativity — design your dream home your way
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, and relaxing design games

70010000109803.name: Cat & Friends Memory
70010000109803.intro: Cozy family game with the cutesy animal friends - train yours eye and brain , and see who remembers best!
70010000109803.description:
In Cat & Friends Memory, you’ll flip and match adorable animal cards - from playful kittens to cheerful puppies - while training your memory and having fun together.


Challenge yourself or play with family to see who remembers best! The relaxing atmosphere, simple controls, and colorful visuals make every round a cheerful brain workout you’ll love coming back to.


KEY FEATURES:
- Adorable animal cards full of charm and color
- Train your memory while having fun
- Great for solo play or friendly family matches
- Adjustable difficulty for every skill level
- Bright, cozy visuals and relaxing music
- A perfect way to unwind and keep your mind sharp

70010000109809.name: Ultimate Hentai Puzzle
70010000109809.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000109827.name: Moonlight Peaks
70010000109827.intro: Welcome to your new vampiric life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks!
70010000109827.description:
Experience life as a vampire in a magical town full of werewolves, witches, mermaids, and more! In this heart-warming, supernatural life-sim, you will raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, and befriend – or even romance – the locals. And at the same time, show your skeptical father that a life of compassion is possible – even for the undead.

Settle down in your family’s abandoned homestead and make it your own. Build your farm with magic crops and livestock, customize your cottage with gothic style, and make friends with other creatures of the night. Embrace immortality and unlock ancient abilities, all in the name of a more bountiful harvest. Unravel the mysteries of the seven families that inhabit Moonlight Peaks and bring a bit of light back to this spooky settlement. Just remember to be back in your coffin before the sun comes up!

Key Features
■Uncover a Sweet and Spooky Journey
Customize your perfect vampire persona and build relationships with the people of Moonlight Peaks to learn more about the town’s history. Uncover the secrets of the seven families who dwell there – and maybe even find your “tomb” love from any of the two dozen romanceable characters in the process.

■Build Your Dream Gothic Farmstead
Design your cozy gothic homestead, turning a forgotten farm into the ideal sanctuary. Obtain new tools and develop your property to grow even more enchanted crops and raise magical livestock.

■Harness Magical Powers
Embrace your supernatural lineage! Shapeshift into other forms to explore all the town has to offer, and study witchcraft to learn spells that will help you on the farm or when gathering resources. 

■Delight in Dark Diversions
Beyond the farm, you’ll be able to enjoy fishing, foraging, and potion-crafting, along with activities like embroidering, flower arranging, and more. You can even collect cards for the town’s favorite game, Nokturna, to play against other residents.

70010000109829.name: Everdawn Isle
70010000109829.intro: Explore. Discover. Uncover the secrets of the Isle.
70010000109829.description:
Welcome to Everdawn Isle, a vast open-world adventure set on a mysterious island brimming with hidden wonders, ancient ruins, and untold stories.

Features:

>A Living World – Traverse forests, cliffs, caves, and coasts.

>Hidden Locations – From forgotten temples to hidden groves, uncover dozens of secret places scattered across the island.

>Freedom of Exploration – No quest markers, no forced paths—just you, your curiosity, and the vast expanse of the Isle.


The Isle is waiting. What will you discover?

70010000109840.name: Farming Simulator - Grow a Garden 2025
70010000109840.intro: From a single seed to a thriving garden - grow your legacy.
70010000109840.description:
Cultivate. Trade. Grow.
Welcome to Farming Simulator - Grow a Garden 2025, a calm yet engaging farming experience where growth is both your challenge and your reward. Begin with a small plot of land and transform it into a thriving garden through dedication, timing, and strategy.

Every seed you plant has value. Every decision matters. Expand your garden, optimize your harvests, and build a profitable trading network as you climb the path from beginner to master gardener.

Key Features
Grow and Evolve: Choose from a variety of crops, each with distinct growth patterns and market values. Plan your planting cycles carefully to maximize your yield.
Dynamic Marketplace: Prices change based on supply and demand. Study trends, sell at the right moment, and make smart decisions to build your fortune.
Expand Your Garden: Use your profits to purchase new land, seeds, and tools. Watch your small patch turn into a vast and efficient garden.
Tools and Upgrades: Invest in new equipment and items that help you cultivate faster, trade smarter, and increase productivity.
Day and Night Cycle: Experience the calm rhythm of time passing as your garden grows - from sunrise to sunset, your land is alive with potential.

Your Journey, Your Garden
Success comes through patience and precision. Each harvest teaches you something new about balance, timing, and reward. Whether you aim to build a quiet garden paradise or a thriving agricultural business, your choices shape the story of your land.

Farming Simulator - Grow a Garden 2025 invites you to create, expand, and prosper. The soil is ready - it’s time to grow your legacy.

70010000109848.name: Dino Dawn Doom
70010000109848.intro: Explore the depths of an underground facility, facing deadly dinosaurs and uncovering an intriguing story. Find and utilise a variety of weapons along the way to aid your survival.
70010000109848.description:
Manage limited resources as you fight to stay alive against the most ferocious dinosaurs, and investigate the mysterious disappearance of a team of mercenary explorers. One of them, Jack Drouhger, left behind fragments of information like this:

“We began our expedition through the hole discovered in the abandoned installations. We had no idea what we would find down below. The possibility of uncovering something valuable or making a new discovery drove us to keep descending through this endless maze of corridors and stairways.”

Procedurally generated environments, meaning each new campaign presents a brand-new challenge.

70010000109863.name: EGGCONSOLE SUPER LAYDOCK MISSION STRIKER MSX
70010000109863.intro: A renowned shooting game that made its mark in the history of MSX. Fight through using not only your shots, but also by skillfully employing option weapons!
70010000109863.description:
This is a shooting game released by T&E SOFT in 1987. Players take on the role of a Mission Striker, engaging in dogfights against the Gilcen Army.

The game is a vertical-scrolling shooter where you fight using your main shot and option weapons (a combined attack is possible during two-player co-op). While a shooter, it also features RPG elements like leveling up. Your ship's level increases based on your enemy kill rate after each stage, and reaching a certain level adds new option weapons. Your ship uses a damage system rather than a lives system, allowing for seamless dogfighting.

The game has 14 stages, each ending with a boss for thrilling battles. Enjoy intense fights against the Gilcen army by mastering dazzling maneuvers, your main shot, option weapons, and combined attacks in two-player mode.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000109866.name: FALL BUDDIES
70010000109866.description:
Jump in, fall down, and race to the finish!

Fall Buddies is a fun and chaotic 3D platform racing game where timing, balance, and a bit of luck decide who reaches the goal first. Compete on colorful obstacle courses filled with moving platforms, spinning traps, and unexpected surprises.

Each level throws you into a fast-paced race where only the most focused (or the luckiest) players make it to the finish line. Jump over gaps, dodge rotating arms, keep your balance on moving platforms, and recover quickly when things go wrong. Falling doesn’t mean failure — you respawn instantly and jump straight back into the action.
With its cartoon visuals, playful physics, and lively atmosphere, Fall Buddies is easy to pick up and hard to put down. Perfect for quick sessions or long runs through increasingly challenging levels, the game stays fresh with new obstacles, environments, and surprises as you progress.

Key Features:

- Fast-paced obstacle course racing
- Simple and responsive controls
- Colorful, cartoon-style visuals
- Dynamic levels with moving hazards
- AI opponents with unpredictable behavior
- Checkpoints and quick respawns for nonstop action
- Progressively challenging stages across multiple themes

Run, jump, fall, laugh — and try again.
In Fall Buddies, every race is unpredictable, and every finish line feels earned.

70010000109880.name: Open Sesame - Alibaba Dash
70010000109880.description:
You’ve stolen treasure from the 40 Thieves—and they want it back. One stumble, and you’re done for. 
Run for your life through ancient city alley and avoid deadly traps. Ride like the wind or fly with your magic carpet. No looking back.

Endless Adventure
Sprint across ever-changing paths or soar above danger. The terrain shifts constantly—only the sharpest reflexes survive.

Summon the Genie
Fall once? Use your genie to revive and continue your chase for the ultimate distance record.

Dodge Deadly Traps
Leap over low walls, slide under crushing gates, and race through crumbling castles. Every move counts.

Global Leaderboard
Climb the global ranks and prove your skills. Only the best makes it to the top.

70010000109882.name: Stray of Lostcat
70010000109882.intro: Meet our quirky little cat hero. See how she outruns “Meowdysseus”, collects scattered Soul Shards, and finds her way back home!
70010000109882.description: “What bad intentions could a little kitty have?” She just wants… a bunch more servings of her human’s new treats! Your mission is to save this unique cat. Outsmart the sudden Meowdysseus, gather Shards across different scenes, and go on a chill, heartwarming adventure.

70010000109898.name: Only Up - Parkour Game
70010000109898.intro: Climb higher, move faster, and never stop until you reach the peak.
70010000109898.description:
Experience the excitement of climbing to new heights in Only Up – Parkour Game! Explore low-poly worlds where every structure, platform, and obstacle tests your balance, agility, and reflexes. Along the way, reach checkpoints to collect lootboxes containing coins and special bonuses. Use parachutes to slow your fall, wings, or jetpacks to soar higher as you ascend through dynamic, moving platforms.

Key Features:
- Vertical Adventure – Climb unstable structures and balance on moving platforms across multiple locations.
- Diverse Locations – Explore 5 unique areas: city, desert, forest, military base, and space.
- Lootboxes & Boosters – Collect coins, parachutes, wings, and jetpacks to aid your ascent.
- Master Movement – Jump, climb, fly, and grab objects with precise control.
- Challenging Gameplay – Avoid dangerous falls that can send you back to the start.
- Continuous Progression – Rise through levels with increasing difficulty and thrilling obstacles.

Test your skills, conquer vertical challenges, and see how far you can climb. In Only Up – Parkour Game, every jump, every boost, and every movement brings you closer to the ultimate peak!

70010000109910.name: GameShop Tycoon
70010000109910.intro: Game Shop simulation. Buy, sell, and grow your game empire.
70010000109910.description:
You’ve just inherited a small game shop and a modest amount of start-up funds from your uncle. Your goal is to manage daily operations, expand your store, and build a thriving retail business. Order stock, arrange shelves, serve customers, and strengthen your reputation as you work toward becoming a leading global game shop entrepreneur.

Features:
• Walk through your shop, order new stock, unpack deliveries, and place items on shelves, display racks, and counters.
• Serve customers promptly to maintain positive feedback and improve your store’s rating.
• Expand your shop by purchasing additional space. Larger stores may increase maintenance and utility costs.
• Unlock new product categories such as game consoles, video games, accessories, trading cards, and plush items by acquiring licenses from distributors.
• Adjust item prices to balance customer satisfaction with optimized profitability.
• Collect and recycle empty boxes to earn small cash bonuses.
• Compete on the global leaderboard.

How to Play:
1. Order stock using the in-game computer, then unpack and arrange items in your store.
2. Open the shop each day and serve customers as they browse and make purchases.
3. Operate the cashier: scan items, process payments, and keep the checkout line moving.
4. Adjust prices to manage profit margins and customer reactions.
5. Use your earnings to expand the shop, upgrade the interior, and unlock new distributor licenses.
6. Customize your store layout, wall colors, flooring, and shop name.

Note:
You begin with one shelf, a basic computer, and a cash register inside a small shop. Video footage may show mid or late-game progress with additional unlocked content.

70010000109922.name: Softly Placed
70010000109922.intro: Unleash the childlike wonder and find the magic in everyday life! Place, fit, fill, cook, connect, and train your brain in the cutest possible way.
70010000109922.description:
Step into the world, where mundane tasks turn into little adventures and ordinary items provide so much joy. See everything around you in bright, new, vibrant colors and make things even more beautiful by adding fun patterns. Wake up your inner child and find the happiness in little things.
 
Each level of the game consists of a unique challenge, providing fresh, yet relaxing gameplay, that will make you curious for what’s coming next.  

KEY FEATURES: 
-40 unique cozy puzzle levels
-Gameplay consisting of different types of challenges
-Beautiful, vibrant visuals, where everyday items turn into something magical
-Relaxing, cheerful soundtrack 
-Inspiring, nostalgic atmosphere
-Variety of puzzles exercising different parts of the brain

70010000109928.name: Heart of the Forest
70010000109928.intro: An interactive psychological horror inspired by German folklore.
70010000109928.description:
On an ill-fated hiking trip through the Black Forest, a mismatched group of students fall under the spell of a vengeful spirit trapped deep inside the woods. Now they must fight for their survival while trying to escape its corrupting influence.

Haunted by fear, trauma, and secrets of the past, each character is pushed to their breaking point, and their survival depends on your choices in this interactive psychological horror story by Trapped Predator.

As the events unfold, the members of the group find themselves confronted with their deepest fears and the shadows of their past. Who will survive? Help the protagonists stay alive during their horrific journey through the woods.

70010000109935.name: Wander Scoop
70010000109935.intro: Welcome to the most charming, cozy ice cream parlor in town!
70010000109935.description:
The Secret Ingredient: Empathy
