The true delight of Wander Scoop lies in the heartwarming cutscenes and dialogues. Every quirky character who slides onto a stool carries a personal puzzle and different ice cream flavors, and the process of making them serves as a metaphor for life’s challenges and joys. 

Level Up Your Cozy Kingdom
Fortunately, guiding souls and making people happy can also be profitable! As you ace those metaphorical mix-ups and sell your legendary treats, you'll earn money and gain the experience needed to upgrade your arsenal of ingredients and equipment, as well as decorate your parlor.

A Feast for the Eyes and Soul
Sink into a world rendered in a beautiful, colorful, and inviting pastel art style. Everything is soft, rounded, and comforting. Every detail, from the gentle texture of the whipped cream to the subtle shimmer of the ice crystals, is designed to give you a warm hug in game form.

Come on in. The scoop is waiting to be wielded.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 10 unique, flavorful customers to meet and learn their stories
- Tons of delicious new ingredients, equipment, and decor items to be unlocked
- Delightful pastel art style 
- Sweet, cozy atmosphere, encouraging to cherish the simple joys of life
- Smooth, relaxing music

70010000109941.name: Orwell: Ignorance is Strength
70010000109941.intro: Big Brother has arrived - and it’s you again.
70010000109941.description:
Inspired by the rise of fake news, social media echo chambers, and the displacement of truth, Orwell: Ignorance is Strength is the second--darker--season of the award-winning surveillance thriller, Orwell. With the power to both uncover and play with "the truth", you must decide for yourself how far you will go in the service of your country and whether the truth is sacred or ignorance is strength.

Inducted into “The Office”--a top-secret department of the government’s Orwell security program--you’ll take on the role of an investigative agent during a time when civil unrest threatens to become a major political crisis between the Nation and neighboring country Parges.

Reporting directly to Orwell adviser, Ampleford, you‘re tasked with uncovering the truth behind the escalating political tension, and delving deep into the lives of Raban Vhart, editor of The People’s Voice and self-proclaimed guardian of truth, his wife, Karen, and his brother, Illya, to uncover their potential involvement.

To assist you in your task, you will be given new tools and mechanics that provide opportunities to control and impact the narrative. A new “time of day” system puts you in time-sensitive situations, making who you chose to investigate and when, more important than ever. You can also research more widely and dig deeper into citizen’s lives, gathering additional information to influence the way events are reported and perceived by the public.

FEATURES:
Investigate the agitators - Enter the world of Orwell and join a top-secret department of agents known as “The Office” during a time of civil unrest and political tension. Profile persons of interest by exploring web pages, social media and private communications. Make connections. Find the information you need to know.

Uncover the truth - Separate the stories from the facts, the propagated myths and fake news from what’s really happening. Identify the hidden agendas of all those involved and expose them. 

Manipulate the information - Use Orwell’s upgraded toolset and the information you have uncovered to create your own version of the truth. Then use that to gain influence and control over the situation.

End the threat - Expose the truth. Destroy the lives and influence of those who seek to bring harm to the government and diplomatic relations with neighboring countries. Put an end to the civil unrest threatening to destroy the Nation.

70010000109948.name: Raptor Evolution
70010000109948.description:
Take control of a mighty dinosaur in a post-apocalyptic world on a quest to recover its stolen eggs.

Smash through environments, gather resources, and hunt grotesque human-mutants to evolve and grow stronger. Use what you collect to rebuild bridges, restore paths and push deeper into a world filled with danger and mystery. 

Explore vast landscapes, uncover hidden secrets and face terrifying bosses standing between you and your lost brood.

Features:
- Break everything: destroy environments and leave nothing standing
- Use advanced technology: encounter futuristic machines that will aid your survival
- Engage in fierce battles: hunt down mutants and monstrous creatures
- Meet various enemies: take on diverse foes with unique behaviors
- Lead your warriors: command other beasts and dominate the wasteland
- Evolve to become a super beast: grow stronger with every challenge you overcome!

Will you survive and recover your eggs?

70010000109951.name: Combat Ops: Arena
70010000109951.intro:
This isn’t playing war — this is survival.
Pop the case open, pick your weapon, and make it loud. The world won’t save itself — but you can leave your mark.
70010000109951.description:
Every class isn’t just a loadout — it’s attitude, identity, and a challenge thrown in the enemy’s face.
Assault — first in, last one standing.
Sniper — a quiet god who turns heartbeats off with a single click.
Tactical — cuts through silence, breaks plans, owns the moment.
CQB — close enough for the enemy to hear your breath… right before everything goes black.
Anti-Armor — the heavy full stop at the end of any argument.
Mobile — you don’t see him. You just drop.
Breach — if the door doesn’t open, that just means it hasn’t realized it’s gone yet.

Maps shift, situations flip, chaos spreads — but one rule never changes:
If you hesitate for a second, you’re already a memory.

Victory belongs to those who don’t wait for orders, don’t wait for the perfect moment, don’t wait for miracles.
Victory belongs to the one who steps first. And fires.

70010000109956.name: Kick It to Stickman
70010000109956.intro:
Fast fights
Wild physics
Endless fun
70010000109956.description:
Jump into a world of fast, physics-filled action where every kick sends enemies flying. Kick It to Stickman is a fun and chaotic fighting game that’s easy to pick up and impossible to stop playing. Use simple controls to dodge attacks, land powerful hits, and chain together crazy combos as you battle your way through waves of stickman enemies.

Explore different levels, face challenging opponents, and unlock new abilities to boost your fighting skills. With smooth animations, ragdoll physics, and satisfying impact effects, every encounter feels intense and entertaining.

Features:

• Action-packed stickman combat with physics-based movement
• Simple one-touch controls perfect for quick sessions
• Multiple levels filled with enemies to defeat
• Unlockable skills and power-ups
• Fun ragdoll effects and smooth animations
• Suitable for all ages

Kick, dodge, and fight your way to victory — become the ultimate stickman champion!

70010000109963.name: Super Hentai Puzzle
70010000109963.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000109974.name: Storm Lancers – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000109974.description:
You and your friend just crash-landed on an alien planet harboring a secret source of powerful magic. All of reality is on the verge of collapse, and two magical creatures have chosen you as their heroes. To save the planet, you’ll fight, die, and bond with the Stormhearts to rise again — stronger, fiercer, and unstoppable. 

Storm Lancers is a fast-paced rogue-like, where every run means dodging death, overcoming enemies, and mastering powerful skills. The battle is on, so team up in chaotic co-op for survival.

GAME FEATURES 

ROGUE-LIKE ACTION
On Cryptica, no two runs are the same. Explore ever-shifting biomes in HDR at a smooth 60 FPS, where every leap, slash, and dash brings you one step closer to unraveling the mystery. Discover powerful gear, master randomized weapons, and earn permanent upgrades that transform your base move set into an acrobatic arsenal. 

CHAOTIC COUCH CO-OP
Help a friend then nab a rare drop right out from under them. This is all-out, rogue-like action that’s even better with two. Whether you’re having trouble with a later biome or just looking to add some chaos, a friend can dive in instantly in couch co-op or with GameShare. If your partner drops, keep playing seamlessly in solo mode to stay in the action. 

BOSSES & ENEMIES
From a machine race that consumes planets to alien flora and fauna that want to kill everything, fight through bosses and enemies who will force you to think faster, fight harder, and adapt quickly. This is an ever-changing battlefield where killer instincts and survival skills are everything. 

WEAPONS & ABILITIES 
Grow your acrobatic moveset with permanent upgrades like slide, dash, and double jump. Plus, experiment with an evolving arsenal, flaming swords, razor-sharp katars, rifles, hammers, and grenade launchers. Each weapon is designed for destruction, so choose wisely — or die quickly.

KEY FEATURES 
• Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition—Enhanced with improved resolution, HDR, faster load times, and smoother performance
• Rogue-like Action—Playing at a smooth 60 FPS 
• Chaotic Co-op—Invite a friend for couch co-op or co-op with GameShare
• Grow Your Acrobatics—Unlock permanent upgrades, like slide, dash, and double jump
• Test Your Power—Mix and match weapons, abilities, and powerups run after run
• An Alien Mystery—Face shifting biomes and alien bosses to unravel the mystery

70010000109976.name: Catnigma
70010000109976.description:
Steal fish in the most magical and sneaky way possible! 

Catnigma is a magical puzzle game where you control a flying cat on a quest to satisfy its endless hunger for fish. The cat moves continuously in the chosen direction until it hits an obstacle, and it’s up to you to use your wits and magical tricks to collect every fish in the level.

Once you’ve gathered them all, return to the Magic Box to unlock the next challenge!
With a mysterious and relaxing atmosphere, original music, and enchanting visuals, each stage feels like exploring a quiet, nighttime home.

Search every corner: living room, kitchen, and bedroom – no fish is safe from your magical cat!

Features:

Creative puzzles with magical portals

The cutest and most mysterious cat

30 challenging levels to discover

70010000109983.name: Nagi no Koi
70010000109983.intro: A Japanese-style visual novel where two stories intersect.
70010000109983.description:
■Features
This game is a fully voiced Japanese-style visual novel.
Recommended for
- People who like visual novel type games.
- People who like emotionally intense stories.
- People who like pure love stories.

■Synopsis
【Chapter of the Red Spider Lily】
Masahide's dream was to become the Lord that would rule this land.
But his dream, along with his ego, was crushed, leaving him without any pride.
It was then where a girl named Sahana scolded him for living his life as a mere cog of the government.
He enters into a loveless political marriage with Sahana, but that relationship slowly changes them both.
As it gradually transforms into a passionate relationship, Masahide decides to pursue a dream he once gave up on.

【Chapter of the Water Lily】
A man without memories.
Completely lost, unable to remember even his name, is saved by a girl named Suirin.
For Suirin's sake, he turns his existence around.
Across the sea, where the nagidori calls.
Kai's memories lie dormant in the sea.

70010000109995.name: Truck Simulator: Delivery in City
70010000109995.intro: Truck Simulator: Delivery in City is your invitation to the open road — where freedom, rhythm, and the sound of your engine blend into the ultimate driving adventure.
70010000109995.description:
Truck Simulator: Delivery in City — a relaxing yet exciting driving experience where every trip feels like a new story on the open road.

Explore detailed city environments, from wide highways to tight downtown streets, and feel the rhythm of day and night as you complete delivery missions across a living urban world. Connect your trailer, hit the road, and enjoy the freedom only a true trucker knows.

Key Features:
• Build and Customize Your Rig – Choose your favorite color, upgrade bumpers, add stylish exhausts, and pick the perfect wheels to create a truck that reflects your personality.
• Authentic Driving Experience – Use turn signals, headlights, horn, and hazard lights just like a real driver. Every control brings you closer to the feeling of being behind the wheel.
• Immersive City Exploration – Drive through vibrant locations that shift from calm daylight to neon-lit nights.
• Original Music & Road Vibes – Enjoy a dynamic soundtrack styled like a trucker’s radio — setting the perfect mood for long hauls and relaxed rides.
• Smooth and Realistic Physics – Feel the weight, motion, and precision of every delivery.

70010000110012.name: Court of Darkness: Captivation's Kiss
70010000110012.intro:
A vibrant, stylish isekai fantasy.
In this world of magic, your kiss is an irresistible temptati
70010000110012.description:
The long-awaited second installment in the Court of Darkness series is finally here!
Experience brand-new romance storylines with a fresh cast of consorts♪

■Story
The night of a crimson crescent moon,
you find yourself transported
to a realm called Saligia.

Far removed from your everyday life,
you're in a world where magic is commonplace.

In the midst of your confusion,
before you appear 
five beautiful princes.

They crave the power 
your kiss can bestow, 
and will scheme to get it.

But what they seek 
is not just your power.
They want your heart as well...

■Characters
Rio Voleri　The Affable Optimist
Lance Ira　The Lone Flame
Dia Akedia　The Melancholy Songbird
Lou　The Inscrutable Headmaster
Aquia Avari　The Climent Prince

■Contents
Princes’ Path Books 1 & 2 (excluding Special Tales), plus Book 1 Consorts’ Paths for Rio, Lance, Dia, Lou, and Aquia from the romance app Court of Darkness.
*Does not contain voice or avatar features.

70010000110015.name: Anime Love Chat Girls
70010000110015.intro: Adventure, romance, and unforgettable moments in every chat.
70010000110015.description:
Step into a world of romance where every message matters. Chat with charming anime girls, discover their hobbies, dreams, and personalities, and see where your conversations lead. Build meaningful relationships, make choices, and find out who could become your special someone.

Features:
- Real-time texting: Message multiple girls through your phone and experience unique responses from each one. Pay attention to their personalities to strengthen your bond.
- Choice-driven dialogues: Your decisions shape your relationships. Be careful with your choices — trust is key, and every decision influences how the story unfolds.
- Romantic dates: Turn successful conversations into dates. Every outing is a chance to get closer and learn more about her personality.
- Photo sharing: As connections grow, girls will share personal photos, revealing more about their interests and character. Each girl has her own collection of images.

Every message counts, every choice matters, and every moment brings you closer to finding your perfect match. Are you ready to start your romantic journey?

70010000110022.name: Wash Cleaner Simulator
70010000110022.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game
70010000110022.intro: Scrub, wash, and power through every messy challenge.
70010000110022.description:
Take control of advanced cleaning equipment and travel through diverse locations, restoring shine to objects of all shapes and sizes. Explore three large areas, each filled with unique items waiting to be brought back to life. Choose the right tools, switch between washer nozzles, and enjoy the deeply satisfying process of transforming dirty surfaces into spotless perfection.

Features:
1. Three Large Locations: Explore three big areas, each with multiple zones and objects to clean, from benches to larger structures.
2. Variety of Equipment: Use a professional washer with interchangeable nozzles and special detergent options for tough dirt.
3. Detailed Object Cleaning: See dirt, rust, and grime disappear in real time, revealing clean surfaces.
4. Bonus Missions: Complete short, time-limited challenges for extra fun and variety.
5. Relaxing Atmosphere: Enjoy soothing water sounds, smooth cleaning, and visually satisfying results for a calming experience.

Step into the world of ultimate cleanliness, master your tools, and experience the simple joy of turning grime into sparkle. Every swipe, spray, and scrub brings satisfaction—proving that even the smallest tasks can be truly rewarding.

70010000110028.name: Minigolf Family Party
70010000110028.intro:
Family-friendly golf party game
Tricky holes and fun obstacles
Local multiplayer action
70010000110028.description:
Step onto the course and enjoy a colorful 3D mini golf adventure packed with creative holes, clever obstacles, and competitive fun for everyone.

Minigolf Family Party delivers fast-paced arcade sports gameplay that is easy to learn and exciting to master. Aim carefully, control your power, and sink the perfect putt as you navigate ramps, moving platforms, narrow bridges, loops, and tricky angles. Every course rewards precision, timing, and smart strategy.

Play solo to sharpen your skills and beat your personal best, or gather friends and family for local multiplayer matches full of laughter and friendly competition. Take turns, challenge each other, and see who can finish with the lowest score.

Explore vibrant themed environments with dynamic obstacles that keep every round fresh and unpredictable. Master bank shots, use the terrain to your advantage, and discover clever shortcuts to gain the edge.

With smooth controls and quick rounds, Minigolf Family Party is perfect for short play sessions, party nights, and weekend tournaments. It is a family-friendly sports experience designed for players of all ages.

Features:
• Fun and accessible 3D mini golf gameplay
• Creative courses filled with exciting obstacles
• Skill-based mechanics with precise shot control
• Local multiplayer party mode
• Colorful environments and smooth performance
• Replayable challenges for endless family fun

Line up your shot, plan your angle, and bring the whole family together for the ultimate mini golf party.

70010000110039.name: Moto Championship 26
70010000110039.intro:
Moto Racing at Full Speed
Dynamic Tracks & Challenges
Race to the Top in 2026
70010000110039.description:
Feel the thrill of high-speed motorcycle racing in Moto Championship 26, a fast and exciting superbike experience. Race through challenging tracks, lean into sharp corners, and push your bike to the limit as you compete for the championship title.

Choose your bike, perfect your racing lines, and battle skilled AI opponents who fight for every position. Smooth controls and responsive handling make every race intense and accessible for both new players and experienced riders.

Features:
• Fast and dynamic motorcycle races
• Multiple tracks with unique layouts and challenges
• Smooth, precise bike handling
• Competitive AI racers
• Unlock new bikes and aim for the 2026 championship

Start your engine, hit the track, and rise to the top in Moto Championship 26!

70010000110045.name: Hentai Desire: Sexy Waifus
70010000110045.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000110051.name: Dispatch Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000110051.description:
Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy set in modern day Los Angeles from the writers and directors of Tales from the Borderlands and The Wolf Among Us, and features an all-star cast including Aaron Paul, Laura Bailey, and Jeffrey Wright.

Note: Some mature content from Dispatch's original version has been modified. 

You play as Robert Robertson, AKA Mecha Man, whose mech-suit is destroyed in a battle against his nemesis, forcing him to take a job at a superhero dispatch center: not as a hero, but a dispatcher.

As their dispatcher, you take charge of a team of ex-supervillains given a shot at redemption. Manage and level up your roster, all while navigating office relationships and romances, and rebuilding your suit for a shot at revenge!

> Shape the Story

In Dispatch, every decision you make influences the unfolding narrative. From banter in the breakroom to life-or-death situations in the field, your choices affect your relationships with the heroes, their allegiances, and the path your own story takes.

>  Deploy Your Heroes 

Use the strategy map to review ongoing emergencies and deploy the right (or wrong) heroes to deal with them. Balance the risks and rewards as you make tactical decisions, knowing that each choice can have lasting consequences for your team and the city.

> Manage Your Roster

Managing heroes sometimes goes beyond their powers. Each hero comes with quirks, flaws, and baggage you’ll need to navigate to keep the team together. Upgrade their skills and unlock abilities to boost their effectiveness in the field.

Blending narrative, strategy, and humor, Dispatch explores what it means to be a hero, whether you're wearing a cape or behind a desk.

Featuring an all-star cast from every corner of entertainment:

Aaron Paul (Breaking Bad, Westworld, Black Mirror)
Laura Bailey (The Legend of Vox Machina, The Last of Us II, Marvel's Spider-Man)
Erin Yvette (Hades II, The Wolf Among Us, Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon)
MoistCr1TiKaL (Charles White) 
Jacksepticeye (Sonic Prime, River City Girls 1 & 2, Bendy and the Ink Machine)
Travis Willingham (The Legend of Vox Machina, Critical Role, Lego Avengers)
Alanah Pearce (V/H/S Beyond, Cyberpunk 2077, Gears 5)
Lance Cantstopolis (Karate, Dancing, Actor)
Joel Haver (Filmmaker, Actor, YouTuber)
THOT SQUAD (Musician: Pound Cake, Hoes Depressed)
Yung Gravy (Musician: Betty (Get Money), oops!)
Matthew Mercer (Critical Role, Overwatch, Resident Evil 6)
and Jeffrey Wright (American Fiction, The Batman, Casino Royale)

70010000110056.name: Glory Hunters
70010000110056.intro: Retro action-RPG where you progress by earning achievements
70010000110056.description:
Glory Hunters is a retro action-adventure RPG where you progress by earning achievements.

Complete over 600 deeds, help townsfolk, explore dungeons, and defeat bosses to earn Glory Points, the main currency that unlocks new paths, upgrades, and companions.

Explore a vast world filled with secrets, mini-games, and quirky characters, and forge your own path through nonlinear gameplay and endless replay value.

Features:

- A unique twist on the action-adventure RPG genre.
- Progress by unlocking achievements, the only game of its kind!
- Explore a vast open world with over 600 map scenes.
- Enjoy nonlinear gameplay and freedom to choose your path.
- Earn over 600 achievements and showcase your glory.
- Meet eccentric characters and uncover a world rich in lore.
- Over 20 hours of gameplay with high replay value.
- Conquer 9 temples, face 11 bosses, and help 9 towns regain their glory.

70010000110059.name: Poetic Trio
70010000110059.intro: A game about rain, a game about snow, and a game about wind. All in one.
70010000110059.description:
Poetic Trio is a themed set of three games. A game about rain (Pluviophile), a game about snow (Chionophile), and a game about wind (Loverowind). All in one. The core aspect of each game is the atmosphere. It is recommended for those who mostly seek to experience the mood.


Pluviophile is a short experience about the mood of rain in the woods. It is a slow-paced pure walking simulator; you only walk, slowly, in the wilderness away from civilization. A beautiful poem from Julius Cawein accompanies your short journey; and the original music score that is composed by Pınar Karabaş.

*

Chionophile is a short experience about the mood of winter in the woods. It is a slow-paced pure walking simulator; you only walk, slowly, in the wilderness away from civilization. A beautiful poem from Archibald Lampman accompanies your short journey; and the original music score that is composed by Pınar Karabaş.

The game has 2 chapters. While the first one is a little linear, the second one (which is more expansive) takes place in a large open area. There are paths for the player to follow to reduce confusion about where to go. But you are free to roam away from the path and discover.

*

Loverowind is a short experience about the wind of spring. Similar to Pluviophile, you collect flowers, and use them on the altars to reveal a poem. But this time you move much faster, unless the circles of light roaming in the world don't catch you.

70010000110070.name: Easy Flight Simulator 2
70010000110070.intro: Take off in seconds. Explore forever.
70010000110070.description:
Take off in seconds—master the skies for a lifetime. Easy Flight Simulator 2 blends pick-up-and-play controls with surprisingly accurate flight dynamics. Choose from 4 distinct aircraft, explore 12 hand-crafted maps with dynamic weather, and experience endlessly fresh runs thanks to AI-generated levels that evolve every time you play.

Whether you’re skimming coastlines at sunset or threading through mountain valleys on a rainy day, the cockpit is always open.

No manuals required.

70010000110076.name: Hide vs Seek!
70010000110076.intro: The classic game of Hide & Seek returns — with a twist!
70010000110076.description:
Play as either a seeker or a hider and get creative with your hiding spots. Build shelters from cars or office desks, hide underwater, blend into hay piles or cornfields, sneak around the boss’s office — and if you’re feeling mischievous, push others right into the seeker’s view! Just try not to be too cruel.

Features:
∙ Unique and vibrant 3D visuals
∙ Play as either the seeker or the hider
∙ Total freedom — play your own way
∙ Optimized for smooth, high-performance gameplay
∙ Fun, relaxing, and endlessly addictive

70010000110079.name: Extra Extra Poison NS
70010000110079.intro: A simple strategy board game featuring 20 different immune systems!
70010000110079.description:
Fight off the employee's infection and get the highest score! In order to get the highest score, cover more space on the immune system field than the opponent.

CURE MODE

Cure 20 infected immune system fields using the Cell Disc vaccine and unlock secret quotes from sick employees!

VS MODE

Battle a friend playing as either Cell Disc or Poison and decide if the infected corporate slave should live or die!

XX

About Bernard Cinemas

In 2004 a local movie theater went out of business leaving their employees without a job. Not too long from it's closure a former employee named Bernard Jays decided to open his own movie theater a year later, and called it Bernard Cinemas. It was an absolute success! Since 2005 Bernard Cinemas became known for it's support of independent films and freshly made popcorn butter! Unfortunately during the early years of prosperity, thousands of employees who made the butter on a daily basis were infected and exposed to it's "Poison".

Infected employees over time reported having fever, god complex, yellow skin, and yellow blood. Many have died due to complications of the Poison, but Bernard Cinemas never lost it's reputation or financial support. The hundreds of deaths did not put a dent in the company's operations. Film companies continued to flock, the wealthy continued to donate, politicians continued to protect, and the unfortunate continued to apply.

Eventually, in 2018 when Bernard Cinemas gained a certain billion dollar threshold, corporate finally took exertion and decided to act by creating a vaccine called "Cell Disc" to combat the Poison. Since then every new generation of infected employees are required to take Cell Disc. Those who were able to survive the one-hour curing process were gifted with overtime and of course free movies! As of today, the Cell Disc vaccine has retained many hard working employees from possible death, giving them a newfound purpose to live and serve Bernard Cinemas forever!

XX

70010000110096.name: Train Your Focus and Observation Skills: THE Spot-the-Difference Challenge
70010000110096.intro: Sharpen Your Mind as You Play! A Slightly Challenging Spot-the-Difference
70010000110096.description:
Train your eyes and brain by finding the one hidden difference in each photo pair.
It’s a simple and fun way to sharpen your focus and thinking.

How to play is easy：
・Take a close look at the photo at the top of the screen
・Compare it with the photo below and find what’s different
・When you spot the difference, move the cursor over it and hit “OK”!

The puzzles are a bit challenging,
but the easy controls make it perfect for a casual play session.
Great for killing time or giving your brain a quick workout.

Totally stuck?
Try pressing the hint button –
it’ll give you a clue about where the difference is hiding!

70010000110102.name: EmyLiveShow: Demons and Mistresses Tale
70010000110102.intro: Fantasy battle of EmyLiveShow vtubers — fight or fall to temptation!
70010000110102.description: Have you always dreamed of finding a great group for tabletop RPGs? This time, you can dive headfirst into thrilling adventures! EmyLiveShow: Demons & Mistresses Tale is the continuation of Dragon & Mistresses Tale — now featuring a fully customizable protagonist! Meet Amy, Nia, Uma, and Six in person, get to know them better, and of course, play through an exciting fantasy story about saving the world… that might just turn into a wild party! EmyLiveShow: Demons & Mistresses Tale is a visual novel styled after a tabletop RPG, complete with dice roll mechanics. Create your own protagonist. You can choose gender and appearance at the start, but that’s not all — your choices and opinions will shape the hero’s personality and how others treat them. Follow two parallel story levels. While untangling the main plot, don’t forget those sitting at the table with you! Playing along with one of them might be the best way to win her favor… Test your luck. Dice rolls determine the outcome of your actions — but even failure moves the story forward. Sometimes a setback can be more exciting than success! Discover the continuation of Dragon & Mistresses Tale — or start fresh. The story is told from the perspective of a new player joining the group, so no prior knowledge is required — but returning fans will enjoy many subtle references!

70010000110105.name: 4PGP - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000110105.intro: Enjoy the excitement of 90's arcade games anywhere and with anyone!
70010000110105.description:
Race Together!
Share the excitement with friends and family playing split-screen multiplayer.
Hop in a formula car and race on unique tracks from around the world. With its multiple difficulty settings and accessibility options such as assist mode and gyroscopic controls, 4PGP can be enjoyed by everyone from beginners to experts. 

From beginners to experts, fun for everyone!
・Singleplayer: Championship, Quick Race, and Time Attack
・Split-screen multiplayer with up to four players
・19 unique cars based on real formula cars
・14 different circuits from around the world that can also be played in reverse.
・Four difficulty levels: ROOKIE, NOVICE, VETERAN, and EXPERT
・Gyroscopic controls and Assist mode for beginners
・Learn how to play with an extensive tutorial mode!
・60FPS in TV, Handheld, and Tabletop Mode

70010000110111.name: Mini Airways
70010000110111.intro: Mini Airways is a real-time management game where you play the role of an air traffic controller. Clear your aircraft to takeoff & land, direct them to the destination.
70010000110111.description:
Mini Airways is a real-time management game with an air traffic control theme.
You will play as a busy air traffic controller in the game: directing planes to take off and land, clearing air traffic, upgrading airspace ...... And most of all, don't let them crash!

Real-TimeATC
Fast-paced, real-time ATC gameplay: Manage airspace, clear planes for takeoff and landing, and avoid near misses! In addition to the normal arrangement of takeoffs and landings, you also need to face the challenges of mountains, no-fly zones, and peak landing hours, so please concentrate!

Upgrade Your Airspace
Every time you finish one day's management, you will be able to pick an upgrade for your airspace and airport: auto holding, accelerating turns, increasing airspace, waypoints ...... upgrade and customize airports to keep flights running more smoothly.

Distinctive Global Maps
As you increase your flight management records, you will gradually unlock a total of 19 airspace maps based on real-world airports—from Beijing Capital, Shanghai Hongqiao, Chengdu Shuangliu in China to Vancouver, New York in North America, and then to London, Amsterdam in Europe... Showcase your air traffic control skills across various global airports!

Surprise Random Events
The game triggers random events under certain specific maps and conditions, featuring classic moments in aviation history: the miracle landing on the Hudson River, Air Force One crossing, emergency incidents, high-priority flights, etc.

Three Selectable Modes
The game offers three modes: Classic, Hardcore, and Sandbox.
In Hardcore mode, the airspace simulates real ATC operations without the ability to pause within the session;
In Sandbox mode, players have full control over waypoints, props, and landing intensity, allowing you to design their own waypoints and test the maximum flight density they can handle.

Custom Maps&Mods
The game supports creating custom maps and mods. Players can import map assets, freely configure runways, restricted areas, and other terrains for gameplay. For those with more demanding needs in aviation management, they can create MODs for altitude, wind speed, etc., enhancing the strategic depth of the game.

Play with your mates
Each airport can accommodate up to 4 people online. You can work with your friends to jointly manage the same airspace to reduce the impact of mistakes and challenge higher scores!

70010000110117.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27
70010000110117.description:
Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27.

Step into The Grounds‡‡, a social football playground where the streets meet the stadium. From Kickabouts and 1v1s to teaming up with friends in Clubs, connect with renowned football mentors, improve your abilities, and express yourself on and off the pitch.
Feel greater control in every game mode with more fluid, true-to-life gameplay, featuring dynamic corners, enhanced attacking awareness, player-focused defending tailored for competitive play, and more community-driven innovations.
Sign your next star in Manager Career through a rebuilt Transfer Market with realistic player values and active club bidding. Master new negotiation tactics, including performance and buy-back clauses, as Dynamic OVRs reflect player form, morale, and fitness across every club.
Immortalise your dream club in Football Ultimate Team™ with the brand-new FUT Gallery. Curate your favourite Player Items to grow your Gallery Level, earn rewards, and build your Club’s identity throughout the new football season.
Experience unrivalled authenticity in EA SPORTS FC™ 27, with match data from the world’s top leagues powering 21,000+ licensed players.

‡‡The Grounds mode, including Clubs, only available on Nintendo Switch™ 2 version.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

70010000110129.name: Neon Clash -Echoes of the Lost-
70010000110129.intro:
Is to Nullify a tragedy, or a blessing?
Are you ready to flip the world upside down, no matter the cost?
70010000110129.description:
To combat evil, you must use evil.
Ideals will do nothing to change the world.

■ A Nation of Neon Cities: Kumyo
Here, wealth is monopolized by a select few,
and unless one is born into privilege, the future is bleak.
With no other choice, the youth turn to the mafia, 
consumed by violent, crime-ridden conflicts.

■ A New Mafia Boss & The Friendships She Forges
Kroa is a young underground courier,
and the sole descendant of a once legendary mafia.
She had no desire whatsoever to become a mafioso,
but after meeting Lowd, the only other survivor,
she resolves to fight her way through the underworld.

■ Immerse Yourself in a Gripping Story
This game features a linear story with no branching paths per character.
An intense human drama unfolds against the backdrop of a city of neon lights, fraught with danger.
After clearing the main story, pursue a romantic ending with multiple characters.

■ A Thrilling Romance in a World Teetering on the Edge of Danger
Romance and the underworld don't typically mix.
But once you've tasted both the bitter and the sweet together, there's no going back.
Perhaps even stone cold mafiosi are capable of love...

■ A Colorful Cast
Inspired by "Romance of the Three Kingdoms," a multitude of unique characters appear.
With such a colorful cast, there's bound to be someone who catches your eye.

【Features】
・Fully voiced (excluding the protagonist)
・Protagonist name customization
・Jump through chapters
・Supports touchscreen controls

■ Cast
Yuuichirou Umehara/Ryota Suzuki/Jun Fukuyama/Shunichi Toki
Takeo Otsuka/Hana Shimano/Yusuke Kobayashi/Eiji Takeuchi/Kazuyuki Okitsu/Shinnosuke Tachibana/Kanehira Yamamoto/Kazuhiro Yoshimura/Taishi Murata/Mutsuki Iwanaka/Toya Shiraishi/Masaya Wada/Haruki Ishiya/Miho Ishigami/Kaito Muroi/Kanoko Akahori/Takumi Watanabe/Takara Inoue/Hayato Kaneko/Yuki Ito

70010000110132.name: Halloween: DinoBoo & The Valley of Shadows
70010000110132.intro:
Roki has cast a curse!

Help Tera save the Pumpkin Festival!
70010000110132.description:
Summary: Roki, a little triceratops, accidentally extinguishes the Pumpkin Flame and unleashes a curse.
With his sister Tera, he embarks on a journey filled with magic, puzzles, and endearingly spooky creatures to save his village.

Key Features:

- Children's narrative adventure with a 3D animated style
- Journey through magical forests, caves, and the Valley of Shadows

- Minigames: sing, solve puzzles, and make choices
- Adorable characters and friendly ghosts
- Message of courage, family, and teamwork

70010000110142.name: Maestro
70010000110142.intro: Grab your Joy-con™ and throw real Maestro moves
70010000110142.description:
Maestro is an easy-to-learn hard-to-master rhythm game that turns you into an orchestra conductor. With precise Joy-Con™ motion controls, every gesture matters. You don’t just play the music: you conduct it.

Explore a curated repertoire spanning movies and gaming soundtracks, classical and jazz music bringing together the most iconic works in music History. Conduct scores from Star Wars, Game of Thrones, The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, and Attack on Titan and the timeless masterpieces of Beethoven, Mozart, Wagner, Vivaldi, and Duke Ellington.

Step into the Parisian artistic society and discover music, culture and gastronomy where real orchestra conducting meets griping rhythm gameplay. Set the tempo, cue the instruments, guide the crescendos, and lead every performance in real time.

Are you ready to become a true Maestro?

70010000110151.name: Village Climb Obby
70010000110151.intro: Climb, jump, and parkour through a flooded village to reach the finish!
70010000110151.description:
Get ready for a thrilling parkour adventure! In Village Climb Obby, the once-peaceful village is now completely flooded — and it’s up to you to climb, jump, and race your way through tricky obstacles to escape!

Flooded village challenge – Navigate rooftops, floating debris, and all sorts of platforms.
Fun & fast-paced parkour – Test your skills with jumps, climbs, and daring moves.
Reach the top – Can you conquer the course and make it safely to the end?

Only the best climbers will reach the finish!

70010000110154.name: TetroMosaic, Happy Halloweeen
70010000110154.intro: TetroMosaic is a challenge that combines tetromino pieces to form, step by step, a vibrant mosaic full of textures and colors.
70010000110154.description:
Shoot and align blocks perfectly to unlock the secret and spectacular <<<Halloween>>> illustrations.
Play at your own pace: pause each block to place it precisely or shoot them quickly to chain combos, fill the bar, and earn stars.

Test your ingenuity and train your mind!

Boost your working memory by retaining shapes and patterns while creating impressive mosaics.

Enhance your ability to understand positions, proportions, and relationships between objects.

Develop problem-solving skills and adapt to new challenges.

Train your careful observation of colors, edges, and textures to fit each block together correctly.

Features:
 - Difficulty: 7 to 10 mosaic lines.
 - Immerse yourself in the full-screen gallery and enjoy all the unlocked illustrations.
 - CO-OP and VS modes to challenge friends and family. Will you be the fastest?

70010000110157.name: Direstead Settlers
70010000110157.intro: Build your town, feed and arm your settlers and watch out for the undead coming at night! Survive as much as you can
70010000110157.description:
-Mix elements of RTS, roguelikes and survival
-Juggle your settlers needs such as food, fatigue or happiness
-Prepare your settlers with weapons and armors
-Battle hordes of increasingly stronger undead
-3 different levels of difficulty
-A shop for permanent progression
-See how long can your town last before the undead wipe you out. It's not a matter IF you will survive but rather how long.

70010000110159.name: Clothing Store Simulator
70010000110159.intro:
Manage your own clothing store.
Arrange displays and help your customers.
Expand your store as your business grows!
70010000110159.description:
Clothing Store Simulator

Build and manage your own fashion boutique and discover the exciting world of retail!
In Clothing Store Simulator, you’ll oversee every aspect of running a successful clothing shop, from designing attractive displays to helping customers find their perfect style, all within a vibrant 3D setting.

Choose new clothing lines, arrange your store layout, and keep shelves and racks organized to create a welcoming shopping experience. Assist visitors at checkout, maintain customer satisfaction, and grow your reputation as a top fashion destination. As profits increase, expand your store space, upgrade interiors, and unlock fresh collections to keep up with the latest trends.

Whether you enjoy business management games or prefer a calm and creative experience, Clothing Store Simulator offers relaxing gameplay that lets you build the fashion store you’ve always imagined.

Features:

• Realistic 3D supermarket environment
• Stock shelves, scan items, and serve customers
• Manage inventory and balance your profits
• Upgrade your store and unlock new products
• Enjoy casual, relaxing gameplay suitable for all players

Are you ready to open your boutique and become the top fashion manager in town?
Your clothing store journey begins now!

70010000110165.name: European TRUCK Simulator
70010000110165.intro:
Drive powerful trucks across Europe.
Deliver cargo and complete transport jobs.
Upgrade your trucks and expand your fleet.
70010000110165.description:
European TRUCK Simulator
Start your journey as a professional truck driver and explore the vast road networks of Europe! In European TRUCK Simulator, you will transport cargo between cities, complete delivery contracts, and experience the life of a long-distance trucker in a detailed 3D world.

Take control of powerful trucks, plan your routes, and drive across highways, countryside roads, and busy urban areas. Complete transport missions, deliver cargo safely, and earn rewards to improve your trucking career. Manage your deliveries carefully, maintain efficiency, and build your reputation as a reliable driver.

As you progress, unlock new trucks, upgrade your vehicles, and expand your fleet to take on bigger and more profitable jobs. Improve your trucks’ performance and customize them to match your driving style.

Whether you enjoy simulation games or relaxing driving experiences, European TRUCK Simulator offers immersive gameplay where you can travel across Europe and build your own trucking success story.

Features:

• Drive powerful trucks across European roads
• Deliver cargo and complete transport missions
• Earn rewards and upgrade your trucks
• Unlock new vehicles and expand your fleet
• Change between day and night driving
• Experience different weather conditions, including rain
• Enjoy a relaxing and immersive driving experience

Are you ready to start your trucking career and conquer the roads of Europe?

70010000110171.name: Supermarket Electronic
70010000110171.intro: Build your electronics empire! Stock the latest gadgets, serve customers, set prices, upgrade your store, and become the ultimate electronics retail tycoon.
70010000110171.description:
Build and manage your own electronics store!

Stock the shelves with the latest gadgets, electronics, and accessories. Set prices, organize your products, serve customers, and keep your store running smoothly.

Expand your business as you earn profits. Unlock new products, upgrade your store, increase your inventory, and create the perfect shopping experience for your customers.

Every decision matters as your small electronics shop grows into a successful retail business.

Features:
• Manage your own electronics store
• Stock and organize a variety of products
• Set prices and maximize your profits
• Serve customers and manage daily operations
• Unlock new electronics and accessories
• Upgrade and expand your store
• Grow your business into an electronics retail empire

Start small, make smart decisions, and become the ultimate electronics store tycoon!

70010000110177.name: Tank Battle Arena Combat
70010000110177.intro:
Drive powerful tanks into battle.
Destroy enemies and conquer missions.
Fast, explosive tank action awaits!
70010000110177.description:
Jump into explosive tank battles in Tank Battle Arena Combat! Take control of powerful war machines and fight your way through action-packed missions filled with enemy tanks, obstacles, and intense firefights.

Drive across dynamic battlefields, aim carefully, and unleash devastating attacks to destroy opponents and complete challenging objectives. Upgrade your tank, improve your combat performance, and adapt your strategy to overcome increasingly difficult encounters.

Easy to learn and fun to master, the game delivers fast-paced action with simple controls and satisfying physics-based combat. Every battle rewards skillful movement, precise shooting, and smart positioning.

Prepare for nonstop tank warfare and prove your dominance on the battlefield!

Features:
Action-packed tank combat
Multiple challenging missions
Upgradeable tanks and combat abilities
Simple controls with dynamic gameplay
Explosive battles and satisfying destruction

70010000110193.name: Eradicator Genesis
70010000110193.intro: It’s the year 2036, and the major corporations and the government have lost control of artificial intelligences.
70010000110193.description: AI has taken over the Earth, building machines and conducting genetic experiments, giving rise to monstrous and colossal creatures. Only two humans can rise against the gigantic bosses, giving humanity a glimmer of hope.

70010000110202.name: Mosaic Quiz
70010000110202.intro: See the truth beyond the mosaic!
70010000110202.description:
Mosaic Quiz is a quick-reaction game where you look at a pixelated image  
and guess which of two options it is  

It’s just out of focus enough to drive you crazy  
find clues in the blur and uncover the answer  

Some questions are tricky, others hilarious  
You can play it as a group and laugh together  
or solo to sharpen your deduction skills  

It’s simple but surprisingly deep, testing your observation, imagination,  
and intuition — fun for both kids and adults


The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000110218.name: YinYang Street Ultimate Edition
70010000110218.intro: Step into the fabled YinYang Street
70010000110218.description: The story of this game takes place in a border town in the 1980s. Our protagonist Li Minglai is involved in an important operation. He runs into a series of strange things and finds his beloved wife missing when he comes home. Where used to be warm and sweet is now full of mysteries, which lead to a place called YinYang Street. Is this a coincidence or a conspiracy? Li Minglai has no time to think about it. All he could do is rush to YinYang Street and explore the bottomless abyss...

70010000110229.name: Parkour Simulator 2026
70010000110229.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game
70010000110229.intro: Jump, flip, and run across rooftops to become the ultimate parkour master.
70010000110229.description:
Step into the shoes of a professional freerunner and conquer urban landscapes like never before! In Parkour Simulator 2026, master jumps, flips, wall-runs, and vaults as you navigate rooftops, alleys, and obstacles with precision and style.

Train your skills, perform daring stunts, and unlock new abilities as you tackle increasingly challenging courses. Whether racing against the clock or exploring the city at your own pace, every move counts in your quest to become the ultimate parkour master.

Key Features:
	•	Realistic Movement – Experience fluid, dynamic parkour mechanics.
	•	Challenging Courses – Test your skills across rooftops, alleys, and urban environments.
	•	Stunt System – Perform flips, wall-runs, vaults, and combos with precision.
	•	Progression & Upgrades – Unlock new abilities and improve your freerunner’s skills.
	•	Freestyle & Exploration – Freely explore the city or compete in timed challenges.

Can you master the city and become the ultimate parkour legend?

70010000110245.name: Monsters 'til Midnight
70010000110245.intro: Survive the ceaseless hordes of evil until midnight in this arcade-inspired steampunk survival game featuring local 2 player co-op!
70010000110245.description: Use steampunk weaponry to vanquish the legions of evil and survive until the clock strikes midnight! In this fast-paced horde survival game, each powerful upgrade can help turn the tide. Go it alone, or join another player in your pursuit to outlast the inevitable march of time itself!

70010000110247.name: Menace from the Deep: Complete Edition
70010000110247.intro: Menace from the Deep is a roguelike deckbuilder, set in myth-soaked 1920s USA, where cults and eldritch horrors lurk beneath the surface.
70010000110247.description:
Explore the grim world inspired by Cthulhu Mythos and collect memory fragments to uncover the secret society. Experience the gritty atmosphere through your multiple runs, upgrade your cards to shape unique strategies and most importantly - try not to lose your sanity.

Features:
▪ One threat, four answers - four playable heroes (including The Abomination), each with their own unique deck of battle cards and fighting style,
▪ Shape your destiny - various inventory items, battle allies, powerful relic collections and upgrades to make your run more thrilling,
▪ Madness repeats itself - enjoy high replayability with different seeds that will let you master the game, 
▪ Truth lies beneath - encounter strange events, uncover dark secrets and recover lost memories,
▪ Expand the insanity - this edition includes “The Rift of Sanity” DLC, featuring a brand new character, allies, items and an additional game act.

Additional languages:
- Hungarian (HU/MAGYAR),
- Turkish (TUR/TÜRKÇE),
- Ukrainian (UA/УКРАЇНСЬКА).

70010000110253.name: Diver, Catch & Cook Simulator
70010000110253.intro: Balance survival, exploration, and culinary mastery in every dive.
70010000110253.description:
Diver, Catch & Cook Simulator lets you explore the ocean’s depths by day and run a sushi restaurant by night. Hunt fish and strange marine creatures using harpoons, weapons, and underwater tools, then turn your catch into delicious dishes to earn profits and upgrade your gear. Manage oxygen, face unknown threats, and dive deeper to discover rare species and hidden zones.

Key Features
- Day & Night Gameplay Loop: Dive for fish by day, run a sushi restaurant by night
- Harpoon Combat & Fishing: Use harpoons to catch fish and creatures — with hook for automatic loot or without hook for manual collection
- Deep-Sea Exploration: Discover new depths, biomes, and dangerous creatures
- Crafting & Upgrades: Improve suits, weapons, and underwater scooters
- Progression-Based Discovery: Unlock new fish, creatures, and challenges as you dive deeper

Take a deep breath, dive in, and master the balance between survival, exploration, and culinary success.

70010000110260.name: City Bus Simulator
70010000110260.intro: Every route, every passenger, every stop — shape your career as a city bus driver.
70010000110260.description:
Experience the real challenge of managing and driving your own bus in this realistic simulator. In Bus Simulator, you can purchase different buses, upgrade them across three categories, and explore the city through missions or free-ride mode. Each level has a clear goal: reach the marked point on the mini-map and complete the route safely.

Key Features:
- Build your own bus fleet and customize it with powerful upgrades
- Take on level-based missions with clear goals and increasing challenges
- Enjoy Free Ride mode and explore the city at your own pace
- Manage fuel, fatigue, and vehicle condition to keep your routes running smoothly
- Drive carefully to avoid penalties and costly repairs
- Experience realistic bus handling designed to test your skills on every trip

Take the driver’s seat and prove your skills on every route. From careful city driving to managing your bus fleet, every trip is a test of strategy, precision, and timing. Are you ready to become a true bus driving pro?

70010000110278.name: Cosmic Coop
70010000110278.intro: Raise adorable Critterlings, craft unique items, and create your dream farm.
70010000110278.description:
Welcome to Cosmic Coop, a cozy farming and creature-collecting game where you discover adorable Critterlings, grow crops, and decorate your perfect little world.

Tend your farm, discover new Critterlings, and craft decorations inspired by the creatures you raise. Each Critterling has its own personality and unique item drops, letting you design your farm in creative ways.

Unlock new decorations, collect resources, place homes, and create the perfect balance to keep your Critterlings happy.

Whether you’re farming, decorating, upgrading your home, or just watching your Critterlings roam the farm, every day on your farm is a chance to build something new.

With its simple controls, colorful art, and relaxing gameplay, Cosmic Coop is the perfect cozy escape for players of all ages.

70010000110284.name: Neopets - Mega Mini Games Collection - The Neopian Arcade Odyssey
70010000110284.description: Journey back to Neopia with 26 classic games, brought back to life for new and returning fans!

70010000110290.name: Bang Bang Girls: Moe Panic
70010000110290.intro: Glamour and firepower collide in this thrilling special forces shooter! Stylish action meets stunning visuals in this character-focused TPS that will captivate you!
70010000110290.description:
The elite special forces unit "Bang Bang Girls" has been assembled to save the world from the international terrorist organization "Moe Pink". Former fashion model Seira and professional dancer Arina—these strikingly beautiful operatives—will overwhelm enemies with their charisma and firepower. Immerse yourself in the dazzling graphics delivered by toon-shaded animation visuals and fall for the charm of these captivating characters!

・Raid terrorist hideouts threatening the world while completing thrilling missions.
・Collect Seira and Arina's glamorous costume collection with gold earned from clearing stages.
・Unlock exciting Defense Mode mini-games when you break through specific stages.
・Lead the defense through 10 intense waves in Defense Mode to unlock exclusive special illustrations!
・Enjoy collected costumes from any angle with the free 360-degree Character Viewer Mode.
・Zoom, rotate, and examine acquired costumes from your preferred perspective.
・Touch characters to trigger lively reactions and dynamic responses with special interactive features.
・Maximize immersion in an animation-like world realized through cartoon rendering technology!

Dangerous special agents in action-packed shootouts! Glamorous Seira and captivating Arina showcase a dazzling costume collection, bonus Defense Mode mini-games, and an immersive Character Viewing Mode! The definitive visual-focused TPS combining charm and firepower! Download "Bang Bang Girls: Moe Panic" and save the world with the special forces team!

Prologue
The international female terrorist organization "Moe Pink" threatens the entire world. This organization consists solely of attractive and dangerous operatives, occupying government agencies and critical facilities across nations while attempting to create their own world. The government has secretly devised countermeasures. Codename "Bang Bang Project"—creating a special forces unit composed of the world's most devastatingly beautiful operatives.

Seira is a former fashion model whose captivating poses alone command everyone's attention. Arina is a professional dancer from a prestigious dance academy whose flexible movements and mesmerizing choreography disorient enemies. "We must save the world with our charm and the hostages too!" Seira applied crimson lip gloss while gazing at her alluring reflection. "Time to show them we're the best!" Arina smiled while donning her form-fitting combat uniform.

The two operatives have now become the "Bang Bang Girls," engaging in spectacular and deadly gunfights against armed operatives while simultaneously rescuing precious hostages. The world's most dangerous and beautiful battle begins now!

70010000110297.name: Clockwork Rabbit
70010000110297.intro: Tessa works as a mechanic in a textile factory. A puzzle game with hand-crafted puzzles based on manipulating time. A cute story about sweet bunnies.
70010000110297.description:
Clockwork Rabbit is a relaxing single-player isometric puzzle game set in a steampunk world inhabited by adorable bunnies.

Meet Tessa, a young mechanic working in a textile factory in Clockwork Town, where every room hides a new challenge.

The game blends time manipulation, action planning, helper robot programming, and creative puzzle solving. With no time limits, you can play at your own pace and enjoy a calm, laid-back experience.

Key features:
A calm and thoughtful puzzle experience
Single-player adventure with narrative background
Isometric perspective
Time manipulation mechanics
No violence, no ads, no microtransactions
Stylized visuals and a unique atmosphere
Suitable for both experienced and new players
Crafted with passion by an independent team

Jump into the rabbit hole with Tessa and try to catch that bunny!

70010000110304.name: Where’s the Insect?
70010000110304.intro:
Where’s That Insect Hiding?
A Cute and Easy Brain-Training Picture Hunt Game
70010000110304.description:
About the Game
Find the hidden insects in cute and colorful illustrations!
By spotting the specified insect within the time limit,
you can enjoy a fun and easy brain-training experience.

How to Play
・Take a good look at the insect you need to find.
・Search for the same insect in the illustration.
・When you find it, tap the spot before time runs out!

It might look easy at first,
but the time limit makes it surprisingly tricky!

If you get stuck, the Hint button will gently help you out
by showing the area where the answer is hiding.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000110311.name: Biplanes
70010000110311.intro: Soar into WWI dogfights with arcade-style aerial combat and thrilling multiplayer action!
70010000110311.description:
Take to the skies and become a WWI flying ace in Biplanes, an exciting arcade-style aerial combat game that captures the thrill of classic dogfighting action!

Intense Aerial Combat
Pilot your biplane through intense dogfights against enemy aces. Master the art of aerial combat as you loop, barrel roll, and outmaneuver your opponents in fast-paced battles. Whether you're a seasoned pilot or new to the skies, intuitive controls make it easy to jump in and start flying.

Multiple Game Modes
•	Campaign Mode - Team up with up to 3 friends in cooperative missions against waves of AI enemies. Work together to become the ultimate flying aces! Replay missions to earn higher medals with faster victories!
•	Versus Mode - Battle against friends and AI opponents in intense local multiplayer combat with four exciting rulesets: 
	o	Classic - Pure arcade dogfighting! Destroy balloons and enemy planes to score points. One-hit eliminations, no power-ups, no evasive roll—just skilled flying and sharp shooting
	o	Modern - Fast-paced action with power-ups, evasive rolls, and life bars. Collect points by taking down balloons and opponents in this enhanced combat experience
	o	Survivor - Modern rules with a twist—no respawning! Be the last pilot standing as you eliminate every opponent in this high-stakes free-for-all
	o	Base Bombing - Team-based warfare! Join the Red or Blue team, collect bombs from the central tower, and destroy the enemy base while defending your own

Classic Arcade Action
Experience the golden age of arcade gaming with responsive controls, satisfying gameplay, and that "one more try" appeal that keeps you coming back. Perfect for quick gaming sessions or extended play.

Features:
•	Thrilling WWI-era biplane flight mechanics and battlefield environments
•	Smooth, accessible flight controls for players of all skill levels
•	Local multiplayer for up to 4 players in both cooperative and competitive modes
•	Four distinct Versus rulesets offering varied tactical gameplay
•	Multiple enemy AI difficulty settings in Versus Mode to match your skill level
•	Vibrant visuals and immersive sound effects
•	Pick-up-and-play arcade gameplay that's easy to learn, challenging to master

Whether you're teaming up with friends in Campaign Mode or battling for supremacy in Versus Mode, Biplanes delivers pure arcade flying fun. Strap in, throttle up, and prepare for takeoff!

70010000110315.name: Cozy Caravan
70010000110315.intro: Head out on a gentle journey in your reliable old caravan, crafting hearty meals, running market stalls and sharing goodies with local townsfolk.
70010000110315.description:
Grab your backpack and climb on in, it’s time to hit the road!  We’ve got cakes to bake, clothes to make, as folks prepare for the Whizz Bang Fair!

As fresh-faced Guild Rookies, you and your best friend Bubba will travel through picturesque landscapes in your reliable old caravan, helping communities along the way. Craft a variety of handmade items—from hearty meals to stylish outfits—then set up your market stall and share goodies with the local townsfolk.
Meet an eclectic mix of characters, each with their own stories and needs. Cultivate connections across Harvestvale and uphold the mission of the Guild—help those in need and spread kindness!

Express Yourself
In Cozy Caravan, you can be whoever you want to be. Create your own adorable character from dozens of animal species and even more colour variations.
Curate countless outfit combinations, making your character feel like the coziest version of you.
Axolotls
Badgers
Beavers
Bunnies
Capybaras
Dogs
Foxes
Frogs
Parrots
Raccoons
And many more!

Life on the Road
Your caravan is your home, transportation, kitchen, and more. Customise your ride and journey how you like—help hitchhikers, collect crafting resources, and explore the nooks and crannies of Harvestvale and beyond. Keep an eye out, you never know where you might find someone who could use a lift!

Spread Happiness
In Harvestvale, happiness grows from even the smallest interaction.
Spreading happiness is the goal of every Guild Rookie. Happiness brings growth, enabling you to upgrade your caravan, learn new crafting recipes, and more! If you’re looking for ways to help, there’s always someone in need. 

Share The Fun
Take a break and say “hoyo!” to the local townsfolk and join in on fun activities! Test your stone-skipping skills by the water, or drop a fishing line in a nearby pond. Build connections with local townsfolk by joining games of Hide & Seek or Hopscotch. You can even help cafes with their lunchtime rush! 

Fair Game!
The annual Whizz Bang Fair is just around the corner, but it’s all gone awry! Help folks along the way as they try to get things ready for the big day!

70010000110334.name: Fruit Mountain Party
70010000110334.intro: The long-awaited new entry in the hit 3D puzzle game “Fruit Mountain” — where you merge fruits to make them bigger — is coming to Nintendo Switch™!
70010000110334.description:
The mega-hit 3D puzzle game “Fruit Mountain” — where you merge fruits to make them bigger — is now a party battle game for everyone!
This time, it’s a fruit battle!? Jump into versus mode with up to 4 players!
With items and wild surprises, it’s a chaotic battle full of laughs!
Keep stacking those fruits!

[Easy to Play!]
Just toss fruits onto the plate and stack them up.
Merge two of the same fruit to create a bigger one!
The bigger the fruit you make, the higher your score climbs!
Be careful not to let fruits fall off the plate — merge them skillfully!
Master your stacking technique and take on your rivals!

[Battle Together!]
・Compete against rivals worldwide online!
Create a Room and invite friends to battle anytime, anywhere!
・Local versus play offline too!
Up to 4 players can play locally on a single Nintendo Switch! Get everyone together for some fun!

[Tons of Game Modes!]
Multiple versus modes! Try different styles and have a blast!
・Standard Race
・Thief Frenzy
・Fruit of the Sun
・Great Harvest
・Survival

[Single Player Too!]
Hone your skills against NPCs and prepare for online battles!
In “Time Attack” mode, race to complete a watermelon as fast as you can!
Aim for the fastest time! Climb the rankings!

[Collection]
Customize your plate with the dress-up feature! Show off your style with your favorite plate!

70010000110344.name: Picnic Girls
70010000110344.intro: A puzzle game featuring tons of cute Picnic Girls enjoying the autumn season is here!
70010000110344.description:
Collect pieces of adorable Picnic Girls enjoying the fall and complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Once completed, high-resolution Picnic Girls will be added to your gallery ♪

70010000110352.name: Tiny Garden
70010000110352.intro: Tiny Garden lets you grow a pocket-sized garden inside a magical toy passed down through generations.
70010000110352.description:
Tiny Garden lets you cultivate a pocket-sized garden inside a magical toy passed down through generations. Grow a variety of plants, trade them for unique furniture, and customize your garden in this calming mix of farming, puzzle-solving, and strategy. With no scores or time limits, it’s all about relaxing, experimenting, and letting your creativity bloom!

EVERYTHING IS A TOY IN TINY GARDEN!

Tiny Garden is a soothing, stress-free mix of farming, puzzles, and discovery - all inside a charming toy. Grow a variety of plants, from colourful vegetables to whimsical flowers, each with its own unique mechanics waiting to be uncovered. As your garden flourishes, trade your harvests for fun, toy furniture, and design your very own magical space.

A TOY WITH HISTORY

Before you got your hands on Tiny Garden, others have played with this toy. Through letters, you'll uncover a heartfelt story that reminds us that objects aren’t just things - they hold the traces of lives lived and stories shared. Each new discovery offers more than just a piece of furniture or a plant - it’s a glimpse into a deeper connection.

RELAX, DISCOVER, CREATE

Tiny Garden invites you to turn the crank, make things happen, and enjoy a wholesome but thoughtful experience. Each turn should be carefully considered - each decision and each new plant can reveal hidden surprises or unlock the next step in your garden’s evolution. There are no wrong choices here - just a relaxing journey where you can unwind, explore, and create without pressure.

70010000110358.name: Geisha's Heart: Romance Among the Cherry Blossoms
70010000110358.intro: A geisha’s heart longs for freedom… will you be the one to set it free?
70010000110358.description:
In the floating world of beauty and illusion, love is the most dangerous secret of all.
You arrive as a stranger… but soon, one glance, one whispered word, changes everything.

Each geisha hides a story  of duty, desire, and dreams long buried beneath layers of silk and silence.
As you grow closer, your choices will shape a fragile bond that could either blossom into forbidden love… or fade like cherry petals in the wind.

Will you be the one to free her heart… or let her disappear into the shadows of tradition?

How far would you go for love that was never meant to be?


Game Features:

● Romance among the blossoms: Fall for captivating geishas, each with her own past, secrets, and emotions waiting to unfold.

● Your choices decide her fate: Comfort her, challenge her, or confess your feelings. Every decision changes your shared destiny.

● A poetic journey through the floating world: Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of beauty, melancholy, and passion.

● Multiple endings: Discover the bittersweet paths of love, freedom, and sacrifice.

● A visual novel of emotion and elegance: Where every word, glance, and gesture can change the course of a heart.


Will you risk everything to love a geisha who can never be yours?

70010000110364.name: Samurai Shoguns Heart: Romance Among the Cherry Blossoms
70010000110364.intro: A samurai’s heart hides behind honor… will you be the one to make it surrender?
70010000110364.description:
In the age of steel and cherry blossoms, love is a forbidden blade.
You arrive as an outsider… but soon, a single glance, a moment of trust, changes everything.

Each samurai carries a story of duty, pride, and a heart trapped between loyalty and desire.
As your bond deepens, every choice you make draws you closer to a love that defies both fate and tradition.

Will you pierce the armor around his heart… or watch him vanish into the path of duty?

How far would you go for a love that could destroy everything?


Game Features:

● Romance among the blossoms: Fall for noble samurais, each with his own past, scars, and secret longing for connection.

● Your choices decide his fate: Encourage his courage, challenge his loyalty, or confess your forbidden love. Every decision shapes your destiny together.

● A poetic journey through honor and passion: Experience the tension between duty, emotion, and the beauty of fleeting love.

● Multiple endings: Discover the paths of devotion, sacrifice, and redemption.

● A visual novel of emotion and elegance: Where every word, look, and silence could change the course of two hearts.


Will you risk everything to love a samurai bound by duty?

70010000110370.name: Farm Love Legend: Transform your Animals into Anime Girls
70010000110370.intro:
Capture. Transform. Date.
Wait… you turned a cow into a waifu?!
70010000110370.description:
Welcome to a farm where nothing is normal.

One minute, you’re feeding the animals…
The next, you’re in a turn-based battle against a chicken with ninja kicks.

Defeat her, capture her, and —WHAT?!—

She transforms into a cute anime girl who wants to go on a date?! 

In Farm Love Legend, every animal hides a secret human form.

Every battle could unlock a new romance.

And every girl you meet has her own wild personality inspired by her animal nature:

• A shy lamb girl who just wants a hug…
• A proud fox girl who loves teasing you…
• A strong cow warrior with a heart of gold…

Your choices decide who will be your ultimate farm waifu.
Just don’t let the other girls find out.


GAME FEATURES: 

♥ CAPTURE & TRANSFORM: Battle animals like in a monster game… then date them as cute anime girls.

♥ TURN-BASED COMBAT: Strategy meets seduction.

♥ ROMANCE & VISUAL NOVEL CHOICES: Build bonds, go on dates, unlock secret memories.

♥ FARM LIFE + WAIFU LIFE: Upgrade your farm AND your relationships.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Which animal girl will become your legend?


It’s weird.
It’s funny.
It’s sexy in a “WAIT WHAT?!” way.

Are you ready to fall in love with your farm?

70010000110378.name: Farm Love Legend: Transform your Animals into Anime Boys
70010000110378.intro:
Capture. Transform. Date.
Wait… you turned a bull into a husbando?!
70010000110378.description:
Welcome to a farm where nothing makes sense.

One minute, you’re feeding the animals…

The next, you’re in a turn-based battle against a chicken throwing ninja kicks at your face.

You win, you capture him and—WHAT?!—
He transforms into a handsome anime boy asking you out?!

In Farm Love Legend, every farm animal hides a secret human form.

Every battle could unlock a brand-new romance.
And every boy’s personality is wild in his own way:

• A shy lamb boy who melts at every hug…
• A flirty fox boy who loves teasing you…
• A strong bull warrior with a tender heart…

Your choices decide who becomes your ultimate farm husbando.
(And yeah… try not to make the others jealous)


GAME FEATURES:

♥ CAPTURE & TRANSFORM: Battle animals like in a monster game… then date them as charming anime boys

♥ TURN-BASED COMBAT: Strategy + seduction = chaos

♥ ROMANCE & VISUAL NOVEL CHOICES: Chat, bond, unlock moments you’ll never forget

♥ FARM LIFE + LOVE LIFE: Upgrade your home and deepen your relationships

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Who will be the one waiting for you at the barn?


It’s ridiculous.
It’s hilarious.
It’s sexy in a “WAIT WHAT?!” way.

Are you ready to fall in love with your farm?

70010000110399.name: Soulkin
70010000110399.intro: Immerse yourself in Soulkin, a tactical, monster-collecting Roguelite. Play as Nadia, a heroine summoned to save the world of Ankiril.
70010000110399.description:
Soulkin is a tactical, Roguelite game that blends strategic monster-collecting with turn-based combat. As the summoned heroine, Nadia, you’ll harness the power of Souls to bond with magical creatures and lead them against the encroaching corruption threatening Ankiril. 

This mystical world, anchored around a colossal tree, teems with magical creatures known as Soulkin, each infused with the power of elements. Will you rise to the challenge and become the savior of Ankiril? 

Engage in turn-based battles that require tactical positioning and clever use of your Soulkin’ abilities. Adapt your tactics to overcome formidable foes and environmental challenges on a hexagonal grid. 

Select from multiple Soulkin squads and Nadia variants, each boasting distinct elemental strengths and playstyles. As you complete objectives, you’ll unlock new squads, additional power-ups, and stronger abilities. Strategically choose and enhance your squad to confront Ankiril’s ever-growing threats.

Navigate through challenging encounters and unlock new events, bonuses, and increased stats. Your journey will be difficult, but the rewards are plentiful for those who persevere. 

Each chapter offers a fresh and unique gameplay experience with dynamic maps, battles, and events. This ensures varied and exciting playthroughs every time, keeping the gameplay engaging and unpredictable.

70010000110414.name: Amazing Maze
70010000110414.intro: Roll, jump, climb, and outsmart every maze in a colorful 3D world full of physics and surprises for all ages!
70010000110414.description:
Get ready to roll, jump, and think your way through a series of stunning 3D mazes!
Amazing Maze redefines the classic “roll-a-ball” experience with creative twists, parkour-inspired moves, and physics-based puzzles that challenge both your reflexes and your mind.

Collect the yellow cubes, find the exit, and master each maze with creativity and precision. Every challenge offers multiple paths and clever ways to escape — sometimes, thinking outside the box is the only way out!

Transform your sphere to gain special abilities like speed boost, jump, or wall climb. You’ll need to master when and how to use them to reach the goal in style. And yes — you can wall run and wall jump with a sphere!

With colorful visuals, satisfying physics, and countless ways to overcome obstacles, Amazing Maze is the perfect blend of logic, creativity, and arcade fun for all ages!

70010000110440.name: Animal Crossing™: New Horizons – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000110440.intro: Escape to a deserted island...now enhanced for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70010000110440.description:
Build your own paradise as you explore, create, and customize in the Animal Crossing™: New Horizons – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition game. Catch insects at the crack of dawn, decorate your paradise throughout the day, or enjoy a sunset on the beach while fishing in the ocean—all with enhanced resolution, mouse control support for faster and easier decorating, a megaphone for calling your animal residents that uses the system microphone, and more.

If you and your friends all have the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, you can share your island in 12-player sessions online*—and with CameraPlay and GameChat** support, you can see and hear their reactions in real time!

Show your island to family and friends—or create together on Slumber Island*

Host friends on your island utopia or pack your bags and visit theirs.
