Whether playing online* or with others beside you***, island living is even better when you can share it—and with a Nintendo Switch Online membership, you can also visit Slumber Island to terraform, build, and decorate with friends and family in a shared dreamscape. 

Even without hopping on a flight or sharing a dream, you’ll meet a cast of charming animal residents bursting with personality. Friendly faces like Tom Nook and Isabelle will happily help you grow your community. They can also offer you services, like Resetti’s Reset Service to clear out any unwanted decorations. Your island getaway is yours to shape however you please—whenever and wherever you want.

Decorate hotel rooms for tourists, craft items in batches, and more! 

Work for Kapp’n and his family at a resort hotel where each guest can stay in a room designed by you! Help visiting tourists get acquainted with your accommodations, and scan amiibo™ figures and cards**** to invite specific guests.

Already have Animal Crossing™: New Horizons for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack! 
    
If you already own the game for Nintendo Switch, you can purchase the upgrade pack separately to enjoy all the enhancements of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

70010000110454.name: Incantation
70010000110454.intro: Brave the darkness of a haunted village in hopes of finding a lost loved one!
70010000110454.description:
Immerse yourself in the chilling tale of the Chen Family Village, where a mother searching for her missing daughter accidentally stumbles into a haunted place filled with mysterious cults. Guide Jia Jun Lee as she searches a village and pieces together fragile clues to her loved one’s whereabouts, carefully hiding her movements as supernatural threats close in from all sides.

Incantation is a first-person horror-themed adventure game adapted from the live action film of the same name. Beyond the palpable madness and fear in the village, there's a sinister force that drives one to despair. What happens when one crosses the forbidden line of this evil deity?

Perform rituals, solve puzzles, collect documents and hunt for key items to access new areas of the village, all in hopes of finding your missing daughter and escaping alive!

• Explore a remote village that harbors evil secrets and worships malicious spirits!
• Search for clues to your missing daughter’s whereabouts while evading your pursuers.
• Unravel an eerie ritual and discover its deep secrets!
• Solve environmental puzzles and collect key items to gain access to new areas.
• Enjoy an immersive cinematic experience inspired by Taiwanese culture and traditions!

70010000110485.name: Kawaii Girls: Busty Bear
70010000110485.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000110485.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000110487.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000110487.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000110489.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000110489.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000110503.name: Motorhome: Traveling America Collector's Edition
70010000110503.intro: It is an incredible family trip on a motorhome across the USA.
70010000110503.description:
Go on a journey through the amazing places across the USA.  
Visit interesting and amazing places such as national parks, ski resorts and canyons, play exciting mini-games, collect souvenirs and find all the objects.

This hidden object game is full of beautiful and interesting places. 
Use your skills and knowledge to play mini-games and find all the hidden objects.

The collector's edition includes:
- 10 additional locations: find even more objects and a funny raccoon!
- 8 additional new mini-games + 12 more for puzzle lovers
- 20 great souvenirs from the trip

70010000110510.name: Difficult Game About Letters
70010000110510.intro: Transform into letters to overcome platforming challenges and save your friend from evil King in this crayon-style adventure!
70010000110510.description:
When your best friend falls into trouble, it’s up to you to embark on a daring journey through the Land of Letters.

In A Difficult Game About Letters, you take control of a character who can transform into any letter of the alphabet. Each letter's shape provides unique abilities, which you’ll need to solve puzzles, navigate obstacles, and complete challenging platforming levels.

Here’s what you can do in the game:

*Transform Into Letters: Instantly switch between 26 different letters to adapt to obstacles. Each letter's shape can help you in unique ways.
*Jump Across Platforms: Use letters like J or V to jump higher or leap across wide gaps.
* Hook and Grab: Turn into L or T to hook onto ledges, edges, or moving platforms.
* Roll and Squeeze: Transform into round letters like O or C to roll through tight spaces or under obstacles. 
* Brace and Balance: Use sturdy letters like X or H to block moving walls, balance on narrow platforms

70010000110522.name: Arcade Archives BOMB JACK TWIN
70010000110522.intro: Even the toughest challenge can be overcome by two players!
70010000110522.description:
"BOMB JACK TWIN" is an action game released by NMK(Original work by KOEI TECMO GAMES)  in 1993.
The popular "BOMB JACK" is back, cuter and tougher than ever! Two-player simultaneous play is also possible! 
Dodge enemy attacks and collect all the bombs on the stage. Prioritize grabbing the lit bombs for a chance at a high score!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

At the time, the game was sold and distributed through NMK (current copyright successor: HAMSTER Corporation), which is why the in-game copyright notice displays NMK. However, the copyright of the game itself belongs to KOEI TECMO GAMES.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000110528.name: DAMON and BABY
70010000110528.intro: An unlikely pair, an unforgettable journey
70010000110528.description:
An exciting new style of action adventure fusing shooting action with exploration.

■A new take on shooting action and in-depth exploration
Experience a new type of action adventure, featuring a fusion between exploration within an expansive world and highly technical twin-stick shooting. At your home base, power up the demon king Damon and make purchases. During the exploration phase, defeat enemies to complete each area. The story progresses as you alternate between the two phases.

■Strategic battles with a vast arsenal of weapons and gimmicks
The battle mechanics include both close-ranged attacks with handguns as well as long-ranged attacks with machine guns and more.
You can find more powerful weapons as you explore. 
During the boss battles awaiting within each stage, a strategic approach making use of the area gimmicks will prove crucial.

■Customization and Outfit Changes
Damon grows throughout the adventure, learning to master various weapons and skills. You can customize your set of skills to match your play style. You can even choose from a variety of outfit options to change Damon's appearance.

■Journey together with two player co-op
Take control of Damon's canine companion to help him in combat in various ways, such as collecting items.
*Only available via local (offline) play

70010000110543.name: Motorhome: Traveling America 2 Collector's Edition
70010000110543.intro: Traveling North America 2 is your unforgettable family trip across the USA!
70010000110543.description:
Embark on an exciting journey through the most beautiful places in America with Motorhome: Traveling North America 2! 
Explore national parks, ski resorts, spectacular canyons and many other scenic locations.

- Travel by motorhome, enjoying the freedom of the road and the discoveries!
- Search for hidden objects and solve fascinating puzzles.
- Play mini-games and collect souvenirs from different parts of the USA.

Are you ready to go on a dream trip?

70010000110550.name: Car Dealer Simulator: Retro Car for Sale
70010000110550.intro:
Become a Car Dealer.
Trade Classic Cars.
Build Your Dealership.
70010000110550.description:
Build your own classic car dealership and become a successful retro car trader! Search for hidden bargains, buy old vehicles, repair and restore them, then sell them for profit. Upgrade your garage, expand your showroom, and grow your business from a small workshop into a thriving dealership.
Discover unique vintage cars, improve their condition, customize their appearance, and negotiate the best deals. Manage your finances wisely, unlock new opportunities, and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate retro car dealer.

Features:
* Buy and sell classic and vintage cars.
* Restore, repair, and customize vehicles.
* Expand your garage and dealership.
* Earn profits through smart negotiations.
* Upgrade tools and unlock new content.
* Enjoy satisfying business simulation gameplay.
* Build your reputation as the best retro car dealer.


Build the ultimate retro car empire, collect iconic vehicles, and prove your business skills in the world of classic automobiles.

70010000110556.name: Oblivion Dreams
70010000110556.intro: Peek into visions of forgotten worlds and reassemble what remains.
70010000110556.description:
Piece together mysterious fragments of imaginary worlds, where silence reigns and beauty hides beneath decay. Each puzzle draws you deeper into the desolation — will you uncover what remains, or fade into oblivion?

Features:
- Over 48 atmospheric images inspired by dystopian dreams and wasteland landscapes.
- Simple yet captivating swap puzzle mechanics.
- Multiple difficulty levels to test your focus and patience.
- Immersive ambient soundtrack to enhance the somber mood.

Every solved puzzle uncovers another fragment of a dream long forgotten.

70010000110562.name: Toad Slide
70010000110562.intro: puzzle swamp toad logic blocks magic
70010000110562.description:
Get ready to slide into an enchanted swamp full of magical puzzles!
In Toad Slide, a Sokoban-inspired 2D pixel-art puzzle, you control a mystical toad who must move runic stone blocks and place them onto magic circles to restore balance to the swamp.

With 30 carefully crafted levels, 15 by day and 15 by night, the game blends clear logic, smooth gameplay, and gradually increasing challenges that invite you to think precisely and act strategically.

How to play:

Grid movement: Slide the toad in four directions and plan each move carefully.

Mystic tongue: Pull blocks with your tongue if the path is clear — but be careful, one mistake and you’re stuck!

Swallow and spit: The toad can swallow a block and then spit it, making it slide until it hits a wall, another block, or the correct circle.

Quick retry system: Undo or restart instantly — every attempt is a new chance to master the puzzle.

Blocks glow softly when placed correctly, helping you stay focused on the perfect solution.

Explore the Magical Swamp, a world divided between the gentle light of day and the mysterious calm of night. Master the power of the guardian toad and prove you’re the true puzzle master of the swamp!

70010000110568.name: Finger Punch
70010000110568.description:
Kaito never asked for glory. Training with his friends at the Phoenix Gym was all he needed, an oasis of strength and loyalty in the heart of Dawn City, a place consumed by chaos and greed. But when the ruthless "Kuro Zaibatsu" kidnaps Aya, their world is shattered. In this moment... Kaito’s fight truly begins.

With Dagon, Tejo, and Mika, they must battle their way through enemy strongholds in a desperate mission to save her.
With every fight the Phoenix Gym crew grows stronger, standing against impossible odds to free Aya and bring down the corporation’s sinister plans.

Your fingers are your weapons.
Your timing is your shield.

Six circles appear at the corners and sides of the screen.
Press the matching buttons to hit the correct circles, striking with precision, dodging incoming blows, and surviving the onslaught.

Press when the circle is blue to unleash your attacks.
Slip up on a red circle and the enemy will make you pay.

Every fight is a test of speed, focus, and pure reflex.


Game Modes

-Story Mode:
Experience Kaito and the Phoenix Gym’s struggle to rescue Aya from the clutches of Kuro Zaibatsu.
Each battle uncovers more of the story, each victory bringing you closer to a very unsettling truth.

-Ranked Trial:
Prove Yourself! Enter the gauntlet of three random fights in a row. Your rank determines the difficulty of your next challenge.
The higher you climb, the harder the game pushes back. Try to reach the maximum rank possible unlocking insanely difficult fights.
Perfect to show your fighting skills to your friends! 

-Custom Mode:
Take control by adjusting enemy speed, health, and damage.
Replay your favorite fights, sharpen your skills, or push yourself to the edge of endurance.


Reflex driven combat that rewards perfect timing.
Easy to learn, extremely hard to master. Endless replayability with custom fights and the ranked trial mode.

70010000110581.name: Back to the Dawn
70010000110581.intro: Dive into a gripping CRPG packed with intrigue, chaos, and nonstop action!
70010000110581.description:
Back to the Dawn is a story-rich RPG set in a high-security prison ruled by factions and buried secrets. Investigate two conspiracies from the inside, gather evidence, and outsmart a system designed to silence you. Make friends (or foes) with fellow inmates and with their help, break out of prison.

■A Hardboiled Story Straight Out of the Movies
In a city of animals torn apart by corruption, play as a wrongfully convicted journalist or an undercover investigator forced into a brutal prison system. With allies working from the outside, gather evidence, follow every lead without leaving a trace, and fight to save yourself—and the city.

■A Fully-Fledged RPG Packed with Content
Choose between two protagonists — Thomas, a reporter caught in a web of lies, or Bob, an undercover agent sent deep into the prison system. Each storyline delivers over 20 hours of engrossing mystery, where your every choice matters. Navigate a prison ruled by three powerful gangs, interact with 47 uniquely crafted inmates, and uncover layers of intrigue through dozens of memorable NPCs. With over 100 handcrafted quests, multiple escape routes—each with its own risks and rewards—several possible endings, and more than 500,000 words of gripping narrative, Back to the Dawn delivers a deeply replayable RPG unlike anything you've experienced.

■Uncover the Prison’s Hidden Conspiracies
Thomas the Fox is a journalist caught up in a dark conspiracy and who got thrown into a maximum-security prison for not playing ball. Working with your attorney friend on the outside, you must collect evidence to save yourself and the city from grave danger! Bob the Panther is an undercover agent who has never failed on any of his missions, but he is growing exhausted of this line of work and wants out. But a personal tragedy drags him back for one last job in prison. Experience a hardboiled tale of betrayal, vengeance, and truth!

■A Deeply Immersive Virtual Experience
This is an enormous prison with lots to do and many places to explore, but make sure you follow the rules, or at least try not to get caught! You’ll encounter all kinds of challenges as you explore your new environment. But will you be a model prisoner and just try to keep your head down, or will you leave a trail of chaos and destruction in your wake? It’s all up to you.

■A Colorful Cast
Meet a colorful cast of inmates in your prison, each with an interesting story to tell. You can either make them your friends or fight, bully and rob them into submission. Will you be part of a gang or a cunning lone wolf? Pick a side!

■Open Character Growth System
Are you a tough guy who lets his fists do the talking, a thief who hides in the shadows, or perhaps a smooth talker who manipulates the scene? Develop your skills, craft tools to suit your style, and climb your way from “new fish” to “top dog.”

■Plan Your Prison Escape
In a place built to break you, your sharpest weapon is your creativity and cunning. Every inch of Boulderton Prison might hold the key to your escape, from your prison cell to the infirmary, to the sewers and even the rooftops. Can you break free?

70010000110597.name: Overrogue - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000110597.intro: A card deck-building roguelite! Explore labyrinths each time from level 1!
70010000110597.description:
In the underworld, where creatures of all shapes and sizes live, a Selection Battle is announced to decide the next Overlord. Complete labyrinths and collect crystals to achieve the title of Overlord!

Proceed through dungeon-like labyrinths building up your card deck in a roguelite style! There are up to 5 different labyrinth themes based on card genres like poison or graveyards. Enjoy a different deck experience each time you visit the labyrinth as the number of cards increases. Over 300 types of cards and 150 types of treasure await you, so combos and combinations are up to you.

Let's conquer the labyrinths and become the next Overlord!

Features:
- Card-deck turn-based battles
- Labyrinth exploration in a roguelite style
- Up to 5 unique labyrinth themes
- Over 300 types of cards
- Over 150 types of treasure
- And more elements you'd expect from a JRPG and roguelike game!

70010000110605.name: Isekai Rondo - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000110605.intro: Quest for a parallel universe after being reborn with the ultimate job!
70010000110605.description:
Sho, a young man who spends his days in an exploitative company in modern Japan, is reincarnated into a parallel universe as Shaw, due to an accident!

While the job given in his new life is 'Unemployed' and hardships continue with a bad luck party, one day he acquires the ultimate job as a Sage, suddenly becoming the strongest with ultra rare passive skills!

Aiming for the long-awaited mellow life he finds himself in a battle to defeat the Overlord after meeting the Hero Viola.

With exceptional passive skills that for example can change the future by returning before Game Over, get rid of enemies in turn-based battles by summoning spirits or managing mana plants, or even use the skills of monsters!

Complete quests and raise the guild rank so you can challenge deeper dungeon or other adventuring parties, too! With other elements such as a battle arena and the dungeon where treasure chests are automatically generated, your adventure against the Overlord's Army will surely be an unparalleled quest to finally gain a calm, modest life!

70010000110614.name: Around the World 3: Amazing Countries Collector's Edition
70010000110614.intro: An incredible and amazing journey, again!
70010000110614.description:
Go on an exciting journey exploring the colorful landscapes of the world with this new adventure. Get ready to search for various objects, play exciting mini-games and collect souvenirs.

Treat yourself to a unique journey through 30 amazing and unforgettable places. 
You can visit majestic mountains, conquer deserts, immerse yourself in the beauty of forests, and enjoy the nature of national parks. 
The game will give you the opportunity to use your skills and knowledge to complete mini-games and find all the hidden objects.

The collector's edition includes:
- 10 additional locations
- 10 additional mini-games, as well as 12 puzzles for real fans
- Souvenir shop

70010000110619.name: Dead Gears - Space of War
70010000110619.intro: Adapt or become part of it.
70010000110619.description:
Everything changed the moment the signal was lost.
A distant colony on planet Virelia has fallen silent after a mysterious bio-mechanical infection spread across the surface, consuming everything in its path. What was once a functioning world is now a hostile environment where technology and life have merged into something unpredictable and dangerous.

You are Captain Darius Vex, leader of an elite unit sent to investigate, contain, and eliminate the threat. The mission quickly turns into a fight for survival as you move through abandoned facilities, ruined cities, and infected zones where every step forward reveals new dangers.

Combat is shaped by choice and situation. You can move through shadows, disable enemy systems, and avoid detection, or engage directly using advanced energy-based weapons built for high-intensity encounters. Each approach changes how you experience the battlefield, forcing you to adapt constantly.

At the core of your abilities lies a powerful energy control system. You absorb and redirect energy to activate devices, disable threats, generate protective shields, or unleash powerful bursts that can turn the tide of battle. Managing energy becomes just as important as aiming and movement.

Exploration reveals more than just new paths. Hidden areas, data logs, and fragments of information begin to uncover the origin of the infection and what really happened on Virelia. The deeper you go, the more the line between machine and organism begins to disappear.

As you progress, your equipment evolves, your abilities expand, and the enemies grow more aggressive and intelligent. What begins as a mission becomes a descent into the core of an alien system that is still growing.

Survival is not guaranteed. Understanding the threat is the only way forward.

70010000110625.name: Amazing Weekend 3 Search and Relax Collector's Edition
70010000110625.intro: Immerse yourself in the search for hidden objects challenge.
70010000110625.description:
Take a break from daily the hustle and bustle, enjoying exciting adventures with improved graphics and more detailed locations! 
Spend unforgettable moments away from the hustle and bustle of the city hiking, horseback riding and boating. 

Use your skills and knowledge to find all the hidden objects and complete mini-games.

Game features:
- COMPLETE LEVELS IN DIFFERENT MODES! The hidden object scenes are presented in three different search modes. Complete them all to collect the maximum number of stars and unlock all locations!
- DEMONSTRATE YOUR HIDDEN OBJECT FINDING AND PUZZLE SOLVING SKILLS! Travel and meet adventures and outdoor activities! Play your favorite mini-games and find objects by silhouettes!
- COLLECT ALL THE SOUVENIRS! There are many souvenirs hidden at the locations that will serve as a reminder of your journey through amazing locations. Be careful and try to find them all!

70010000110636.name: EGGCONSOLE PUYO PUYO MSX2
70010000110636.intro:
The MSX2 Version of “Puyo Puyo”,  known as “Old Puyo” and “Prototype Puyo” is here.
This is the origin of the classic puzzle game!
70010000110636.description:
This action puzzle game was released in Japan by COMPILE in 1991. Players control two-Puyo pairs, clearing them by connecting four or more of the same color horizontally or vertically. Piling Puyo to the top results in a game over. This title is the definitive action puzzle, featuring chain clears and nuisance Puyo attacks in versus mode.

The game offers two types of play: 1 Player, which you can enjoy alone, and 2 Player, for battling a friend. The 1 Player mode includes ENDLESS and MISSION game modes, as well as play utilizing items like CARBUNCLE and BIG PUYO.

As this title predates the focus on skits and characters before versus matches, fans sometimes call it "Old Puyo" or "Prototype Puyo." It's a valuable title to experience the origin of the ongoing Puyo Puyo series.

70010000110640.name: Simpli Casa
70010000110640.intro: Welcome to Simpli Casa, the chill and addictive decorating game where minimalism meets maximum style!
70010000110640.description:
Tired of clutter? Ready to create spaces that are effortlessly stylish? Forget bulky, outdated furniture—your canvas awaits sleek lines, natural textures, and a calming, contemporary aesthetic.

Design Your Dream Spaces
• Curated Catalog: Dive into an ever-expanding library of modern, stylish, and simple furniture and décor. From mid-century inspired chairs and modular sofas to clean, geometric lighting and minimalist artwork, you'll find everything you need to achieve that perfect, magazine-worthy look.
• Room by Room: Take on decorating challenges for a variety of rooms: open-plan living areas, tranquil bedrooms, functional home offices, and chic kitchens. Each space presents unique layout puzzles to solve with elegance.
• Color Palettes: Experiment with sophisticated, muted color palettes and pops of striking accent colors typical of modern design.
• Textural Harmony: Mix and match woods, metals, glass, and luxurious fabrics to create depth while maintaining a clean aesthetic.

KEY FEATURES: 
-11 room shapes, from simple to challenging ones.
-500+ furniture and decoration items.
-50+ flooring and wallpaper patterns, from minimalistic to extravagant designs.
-Intuitive controls.
-Lo-fi music ensures a cozy, relaxing gaming experience. 
-Photography mode lets you admire your work in different angles and lights, as well as take beautiful screenshots to share your designs with friends and the community!

70010000110647.name: The Arcana: Dark Tarot & Queens of Madness
70010000110647.intro:
Seductive Arcana.
Strategic cards.
Power is won by choice.
70010000110647.description:
Welcome to a world where desire, destiny, and strategy collide.

In Arcana, the legendary Tarot cards are no longer symbols.
They are seductive, powerful women, each one representing a different Arcana with her own personality, intentions, and hidden motives.

Talk to them.
Go on dates to unlock new abilities.
Gain their trust… or provoke their ambition.

But connection is only the beginning.

When conflict begins, conversations give way to strategic, roguelite-inspired card battles, where each run challenges you to adapt, plan, and evolve your approach.

Build your deck using the Arcana you’ve bonded with and face enemy armies in encounters where every card matters.

Your choices shape more than relationships.
They define how your Arcana fight, how they evolve, and which powers they are willing to unleash for you.

This is not a traditional visual novel.
This is a fusion of narrative intimacy and tactical card combat.


Features:

● ARCANA AS CHARACTERS: 
The Tarot comes to life as powerful, seductive women, each with unique abilities, personalities, and motivations.

● NARRATIVE PROGRESSION & DATES:
Talk to the Arcana, go on dates, and unlock new skills that directly affect combat.

● STRATEGIC ROGUELITE CARD COMBAT:
Every run is different. Adapt your deck, manage risk, and refine your strategy as challenges escalate.

● DECK BUILDING & SYNERGY:
Create powerful combinations using the Arcana you’ve bonded with and shape your own playstyle.

● ARMY BASED ENCOUNTERS:
Face increasingly dangerous enemy forces in tactical card battles where positioning and timing matter.

● CHOICE DRIVEN EVOLUTION:
Your decisions influence how the Arcana grow, fight, and what powers they are willing to reveal.


Some Arcana seek control.
Others crave devotion.
All of them have a price.

Will you master the cards…
or let them master you?

70010000110653.name: Family Roadshow: Hidden Adventures Collector's Edition
70010000110653.intro: An incredible and amazing adventure is now in the format of a TV show!
70010000110653.description:
Are you ready for new experiences? Meet “Family Roadshow: Hidden Adventures” an exciting hidden object game where you will become a participant in a grandiose travel TV show! 
Together with the presenters of the program, you will travel to the most picturesque corners of the planet — from Hawaiian beaches to the mountains of South Korea, from big cities to hidden treasures of nature.
Find hidden objects, solve fascinating puzzles and collect collectible souvenirs in the unique atmosphere of your favorite TV show.
Treat yourself to a unique journey through 30 amazing and extraordinary places around the world! 
You can visit historical sites, stroll through national parks, and immerse yourself in the beauty of nature and cities. 
The game will give you the opportunity to use your skills and knowledge to complete the mini-games and find all the hidden objects.

The collector's edition includes:
- 10 additional exclusive locations
- 10 additional mini-games, as well as 12 puzzles for real fans
- 30 unique souvenirs for your collection room

70010000110658.name: The Arcana: Dark Tarot & Kings of Madness
70010000110658.intro:
Dark Arcana.
Strategic cards.
Power bends to your will.
70010000110658.description:
Welcome to a world where power, destiny, and strategy collide.

In "The Arcana: Dark Tarot & Kings of Madness", the legendary Tarot cards are no longer symbols.
They are dangerous, charismatic men, each embodying a different Arcana, driven by ambition, dominance, and hidden intent.

Talk to them.
Go on dates to unlock new abilities.
Earn their loyalty… or challenge their authority.

But connection is only the beginning.

When conflict begins, conversations give way to strategic, roguelite-inspired card battles, where every run challenges you to adapt, plan, and assert control.

Build your deck using the Arcana you’ve bonded with and face enemy armies in encounters where every card shapes the outcome.

Your choices shape more than relationships.
They define how your Arcana fight, how they evolve, and which powers they are willing to place in your hands.

This is not a traditional visual novel.
This is a fusion of narrative tension and tactical card combat.

Some Arcana seek domination.
Others demand loyalty.
All of them have a price.


Features:

● ARCANA AS CHARACTERS:
The Tarot comes to life as powerful male Arcana, each with distinct abilities, personalities, and ambitions.

● NARRATIVE PROGRESSION & DATES:
Talk to the Arcana, go on dates, and unlock new skills that directly affect combat.

● STRATEGIC ROGUELITE CARD COMBAT:
Every run is different. Adapt your deck, manage risk, and refine your strategy as challenges escalate.

● DECK BUILDING & SYNERGY:
Create powerful combinations using the Arcana you’ve bonded with and define your own playstyle.

● ARMY BASED ENCOUNTERS:
Face increasingly dangerous enemy forces in tactical card battles where positioning and timing matter.

● CHOICE DRIVEN EVOLUTION:
Your decisions influence how the Arcana grow, fight, and which powers they are willing to place at your disposal.


Will you command the cards…
or lose yourself to their madness?

70010000110675.name: Magic Hentai Puzzle
70010000110675.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000110699.name: PULMO
70010000110699.intro: PULMO is a casual puzzle game where you control a lone character in a world full of faceless crowds.
70010000110699.description:
PULMO is the ideological continuation of ALVEOLE and the second part in a trilogy about the human journey. Our project explores human behavior in a society where everyone will find their own meanings. Your goal is to change the environment around you to influence people's behavior by solving spatial puzzles. The crowd in the game acts according to its own rules, sometimes helping, sometimes interfering, but always reacting to your actions.

Take control of the fate of a lone wanderer, challenging the silent crowds in a series of mysterious trials. There is no rush here, no victory or defeat - just a quiet dialog between you and the game. Follow this short but meaningful journey, absorbing every moment like the last ray of sunset.

Features:
- Unique art style combining 3D graphics and minimalistic hand-drawn style.
- High-quality music and audio accompaniment for full immersion in what is happening.
- Unsimilar puzzles with different complexity.
- Cutscenes and levels with deep narrative.
- Each cutscene has been worked out to the last detail.

«No matter how large the crowd around you may be, you will be left alone in the last moment. No matter how rich you may be, you will be a beggar in the end. No matter how dazzling your luck may seem, its wings will turn to dust. No matter how much joy you sow on your way, the harvest will be bitter.»

70010000110706.name: Where’s the Octopus!?
70010000110706.intro: Find it and smile! A family-friendly octopus hunt!
70010000110706.description:
Among many octopuses, one looks a little different!  
Find the odd octopus within the time limit to enjoy an easy and fun brain-training challenge.

How to Play  
・Take a good look at the picture.  
・When you spot the different octopus, tap it before time runs out!

It might look simple at first,  
but with a time limit, it’s trickier than you think!

If you can’t find it, press the Hint button —  
it will gently show you where the answer is hiding.


The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000110722.name: Novel Rogue - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000110722.intro: Turn the page and shape destiny in a card deck-building roguelite JRPG!
70010000110722.description:
In the mystical Ancient Library, a young apprentice named Wright trains under Yuisil, the Witch of Portals. As part of his magical studies, he delves into the stories of four enchanted books, each offering a unique realm to explore. From reclaiming a fallen kingdom to unraveling the mysteries of the underworld, your choices shape the destinies of captivating characters and their intertwining tales.

In this card deck-building roguelite full of pixel artwork, dive into thrilling, turn-based card battles where every decision counts. Build and customize decks across four unique systems, each tailored to the worlds within the books. Collect powerful cards, use Ink to enhance your deck, and adapt your strategy to overcome enemies and unlock special endings. With randomized dungeons and escalating challenges, each run is a fresh test of your skills.

70010000110736.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026
70010000110736.intro: Push Beyond Limits – The Future of Racing Starts Now!
70010000110736.description:
Push Beyond Limits – Rule the Race!

Get ready for the next generation of speed in Formula Racing Pro 2026! Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush as you take on faster cars, smarter rivals, and brand-new circuits inspired by the world’s most iconic tracks.

With enhanced graphics, improved physics, and dynamic weather, every lap feels more real than ever. Master your racing line, react to changing track conditions, and fight for the top spot in intense head-to-head battles.

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Formula Racing Pro 2026 delivers pure racing excitement — accessible, fast, and endlessly thrilling!

Tune your car, chase the podium, and prove you’re the fastest driver on the grid. The future of racing starts now!

70010000110742.name: Big Adventure: Trip To Europe 10 Collector's Edition
70010000110742.intro: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of European adventures with "Trip to Europe 10" and discover the continent from the comfort of your home!
70010000110742.description:
Explore historical monuments, sights, and scenic landscapes completing exciting hidden object search levels. 

Game Features:

- 20 Unique locations: Visit famous cities and natural wonders of Europe 
- A variety of mini-games: Enjoy the puzzles and logic challenges that make the game even more fun.
- Collect souvenirs: Discover a collection of unique items reflecting the culture and traditions of each country.

70010000110750.name: Hentai Gallery: Cute Girls
70010000110750.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000110773.name: Hentai Portrait
70010000110773.description:
Enter Hentai Portrait- a refined puzzle experience where sensual art meets serene gameplay. Uncover stunning portraits of feminine allure, each crafted with emotion, elegance, and vivid detail. As you assemble each image, you reveal not just a masterpiece, but a moment of quiet admiration.


Soft background music and a soothing atmosphere turn every moment into quiet focus and satisfaction. Whether you’re looking to unwind or simply admire the art you complete, Hentai Portrait offers a peaceful escape into a world of charm and creativity.


KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 beautiful images to discover and assemble
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle system - focus on the art, not the mechanics
- High-quality visuals rich in color, emotion, and detail
- Relaxing background music that sets a calm, immersive mood
- Gallery mode - revisit and admire your completed artworks anytime
- Perfect for quiet, focused sessions of visual satisfaction

70010000110780.name: Nekomimi Days ~365 Days with You~
70010000110780.intro: A cat-eared girl quietly changed my world.
70010000110780.description:
On a rainy night, Yuto, a freelance illustrator, encounters a mysterious girl named Milk with cat ears in a back alley. After taking in the non-human girl, Yuto’s once-quiet daily life becomes lively and warm. Milk's pure and innocent reactions to modern civilization gently heal Yuto's heart. As they spend time together, the two gradually form a bond as if they were a true family.
This is a heartwarming visual novel about the gentle connections that transcend species and background.
Includes Japanese voice acting.

70010000110786.name: Whispers of Winter Blossom
70010000110786.intro: Beyond the falling snow awaits the miracle of meeting you.
70010000110786.description:
That winter, I met a girl with silver hair.
As the seasons quietly changed, two closed-off hearts began to connect through a single “story.”
Each time the snow fell, the world was wrapped in silence, and unspoken feelings quietly piled up.
In a quiet corner of the academy begins a gentle yet heartrending tale that weaves the soul—of solitude, hope, and rebirth.
Just like snow softly covering everything, this story may quietly settle in someone’s heart as well.
Your words might be able to change someone’s future.
Includes Japanese voice acting.

70010000110795.name: World Heritage True or False Quiz
70010000110795.intro: Uncover the Truth of World Heritage! A Two-Choice Challenge on Global Facts!
70010000110795.description:
A simple quiz game where you answer trivia about history, culture, and landmarks from around the world with ○ or ×!

Can the Great Wall of China be seen from space?

Was the Leaning Tower of Pisa built to tilt on purpose?

Do all the Moai statues face the same direction?
...and many more!
Packed with world heritage trivia that you think you know—but maybe don’t!
Test your knowledge of world heritage in this fun true-or-false quiz!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000110797.name: Train Your Brain! Spot the Difference with space Photos
70010000110797.intro:
Find the hidden mistakes among the sparkling stars!
From galaxies and planets to meteor showers and astronauts — it’s Spot the Difference: Space Photos!
70010000110797.description:
Relax with breathtaking and mysterious photos of space
while training your brain in this easy and fun spot-the-difference game!
Planets, galaxies, rockets, even astronauts —
discover stunning cosmic scenes packed with wonder!

How to play:
・Look closely at the “top” photo on the split screen.
・Find the differences in the flipped “bottom” photo.
・When you spot a mistake, just tap it!

It might look easy at first,
but reflections of starlight can really trick your eyes!
Perfect for a quick break or a relaxing challenge anytime.

Use the Hint Button only when you’re truly stuck —
(it gives a super obvious clue you won’t miss!)

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000110803.name: hololive GoroGoro Mountain DX
70010000110803.intro:
Push your Oshi to the top!
A must-play for hololive fans!
A fun and easy 3D action game — just keep pushing!
70010000110803.description:
Roll and push the adorable hololive members—your precious “treasures”—all the way to the goal!

How to Play:
Simply roll or toss your “treasures” (hololive talents) to move forward!
Combine matching treasures to evolve them into new ones!
Keep merging and rolling to reach the top!

Multiplayer:
Play online with up to 4 players and cooperate to reach the goal!
You can also compete in local 2-player races to clear the same stage as fast as possible.

Stages:
Includes 36 stages featuring a variety of themes, including Secret Society holoX and hololive DEV_IS!
Race to the summit against players from around the world!

Play with Your Favorite Treasures:
Earn stars in stages to swap out the treasures registered in your “Treasure Collection.”
Complete your collection and climb with your favorite hololive member!

Unlock Playable Characters:
Collect coins to unlock mascot characters and use them as playable avatars.
Gather coins efficiently and exchange them for your favorites!

Special Bonus — “Kumarine”:
Play this game on a console that has hololive Treasure Mountain MegaPack (Nintendo Switch™) save data to unlock the exclusive character “Kumarine”!

70010000110809.name: Formula Uno Racing
70010000110809.intro: One Race. One Goal. No limits.
70010000110809.description:
Get ready to ignite your engines in Formula Uno Racing — a thrilling single-player experience that captures the intensity of professional Formula Car racing.

Race across a global lineup of high-speed circuits that evolve with the time of day. Tackle sharp turns under the morning sun, chase victory through glowing dusk, and dominate the track beneath dazzling night lights.

Progress through your racing career by unlocking new circuits and earning cash rewards to purchase faster, more powerful cars. Every victory brings you closer to mastering the ultimate racing machine.


Features:
-Authentic Formula Car physics and responsive controls
-Dynamic time-of-day environments: sunny, dawn, and night
-Career progression with unlockable circuits and new car purchases
-Deep vehicle tuning and setup options

Formula Uno Racing — One driver. One dream. Endless speed.

70010000110830.name: Hentai Gallery: Hidden Charms
70010000110830.description:

70010000110866.name: Vector Lab
70010000110866.description: Enter a world where creativity and physics collide. Use your imagination to draw lines that come to life, guiding a small ball through clever routes and obstacles into its target. Every stroke interacts with realistic physics, turning simple drawings into intricate mechanisms and satisfying solutions. Set within a sleek science lab, a scientist observes and sketches behind a glass screen, and it’s his pen you command. Each level offers a fresh puzzle that blends simplicity with challenge, inviting you to experiment, test, and refine your designs in a playful 3D environment that rewards both logic and creativity.

70010000110874.name: Tales of Eternia Remastered
70010000110874.description:
Experience Tales of Eternia, remastered for the first time ever.

• An Epic Journey with Two Worlds at Stake
Journey to Eternia, a world split into two isolated realms, Inferia and Celestia.
In the remote Inferian village of Rasheans, Reid Hershel and his childhood friend Farah Oersted meet a mysterious girl named Meredy. During their journey to discover Meredy's origins, the group discovers that a collision called the "Great Fall" threatens both Inferia and Celesita.
Harnessing the power of elemental spirits known as the Greater Craymels, Reid and his companions embark on an epic journey to save the two realms from catastrophe.

• Exhilarating Battle Action with Speed and Freedom
Featuring the Aggressive Linear Motion Battle System (A-LMBS), which enables diverse Arte usage, continued combos, and coordination with each unique party member.
Experience thrilling combat as you outmaneuver enemies and defeat them one after another with fast-paced, dynamic 2D battle action.

• The Same Moving Experience, Now Easier to Play
Gameplay is better than ever with the quality-of-life features that have been added, including destination markers, the ability to disable enemy encounters, and high-speed mode during auto-battle.
Additionally, graphics and SFX can be toggled between modes, allowing you to experience the nostalgic atmosphere of the original game.

70010000110884.name: The Last Salvage Squad
70010000110884.intro: Even after all has ended, We continue to fight to accomplish the mission humanity entrusted us with.
70010000110884.description:
Battle enemy forces reminiscent of alien weapons from retro sci-fi works in this single-player 2.5D FPS.

■STORY
One day, a gargantuan alien spaceship invades and unleashes countless combat weapons upon Earth, demolishing human civilization in the blink of an eye. Although humans succeeded in developing special weapons that could deal an effective blow to the aliens, it was too late to revive their civilization.

To this day, however, the Earth has yet to fall silent despite its abandoned cities, for swarm weapons known as "CogrinaUnits," 12-meter-tall autonomous humanoid units, collect and operate the limited number of special weapons that remain, and continue to fight against the aliens, all for the sake of accomplishing the mission humanity entrusted them with....

■Simple yet varied missions with a wide range of fighting styles
・Choose whether to take down the multi-legged robot weapons ravaging the city by leveraging the terrain, or to move in close and finish them off.

・The next unit is sent out immediately once you are defeated.

・Only a limited amount of equipment remains, so you'll need to recover items from defeated units to continue the battle.

■A story of hope told between battles
・Find out what comes of the battle against the overwhelming enemy forces

・Light-hearted conversation scenes with fellow units during intermissions

・Plus a shiba inu!

70010000110896.name: Car Guys
70010000110896.intro: Experience the thrill of Car Guys, a high-octane multiplayer racing game! Represent your nation, compete in explosive races, and climb the global leaderboard.
70010000110896.description:
Experience the Ultimate Competitive Multiplayer Racing Game!

Welcome to Car Guys, an exciting multiplayer racing game where skill 
and strategy come together in fast-paced, action-packed competitions. 
Represent your nation and climb the global leaderboard in adrenaline-fueled 
races that will put your reflexes and driving skills to the test!

Features:

- Real-Time Multiplayer
- Race against players from around the world in thrilling, high-speed 
  competitions.
- Enjoy a seamless and lag-free online experience.

- Compete for Your Nation
- Choose your country and contribute to its position on the global 
  leaderboard.
- Prove which nation dominates the track and rise to the top.

- Action-Packed Racing
- Pick up power-ups like missiles and shields to outmaneuver your rivals.
- Master both offensive and defensive driving strategies to claim victory.

- Vibrant Visuals
- Experience colorful graphics and dynamic environments that bring 
  each track to life.
- Smooth gameplay that keeps the action fluid from start to finish.

- Extensive Customization
- Personalize your vehicles with unique skins, decals, and upgrades.
- Choose from sleek sports cars to rugged off-road machines—the 
  possibilities are endless!

- Competitive Events
- Participate in daily and weekly championships with unique challenges 
  and rotating game modes.
- Test your skills and earn exclusive rewards.

- Progression & Meta-Game
- Unlock new tracks, vehicles, and upgrades as you progress.
- Use in-game currency earned from races to enhance your car's performance.

70010000110898.name: Quick Whiskers
70010000110898.description:
Get ready to jump, dash, and glide with Quick Whiskers, a pixel-art platformer where every move counts! Take control of a nimble cat and venture through 30 challenging levels across two unique biomes: the peaceful park and the bustling city. Your mission is simple but full of action: collect food cans and reach a cozy bed to rest.

With mechanics easy to learn but hard to master, each stage rewards skill, quick thinking, and precision. Jump, dash, use springs and balloons to avoid spikes, saws, and falling platforms. Some challenges hide extra cans in tricky spots. Will you risk it to get them?

What to expect in each level
Agile movement: Walk, jump, and dash precisely to navigate the environment.
Interactive elements: Springs and balloons propel your cat to reach inaccessible areas.
Challenging obstacles: Spikes, saws, and unstable platforms test your reflexes.
Exploration and reward: Collect food cans to earn extra points and complete levels in style.

Each level starts with your cat on the left, expanding to the right, with clear and intuitive obstacles and items. The progression is rewarding, giving casual players and fans of high-mobility platformers fun and challenge.

With adorable visuals, fast pace, and fluid gameplay, Quick Whiskers is the perfect playground for anyone who loves cats, speed, and precision challenges. Are you ready to show who rules the rooftops and parks of the city?

70010000110912.name: Hexa Chippy
70010000110912.description:
Get ready for a heartwarming hexagonal puzzle adventure where clever thinking meets cozy charm. Guide the adorable Chippys, little squirrels with big personalities, as they collect every shiny acorn and make their way safely home.
Across 30 hand-crafted levels and three seasonal worlds: Spring, Summer and Autumn, you’ll twist, swap and align tiles to form perfect paths through nature’s maze.
Each move matters. Rotate or move tiles to connect acorns to the burrow, then watch your fluffy friends scurry along the path you built. It’s all about planning, precision and a touch of playful creativity.
As you advance, new tile types and tricky layouts appear, turning every stage into a fresh and rewarding puzzle.
Features:
• 30 handcrafted levels filled with charm and challenge
• Three cozy seasonal biomes: Spring, Summer and Autumn
• Rotate and move tiles to connect paths and gather all the acorns
• A clever hint system to keep you thinking without frustration
• A shuffle option for endless replayability
Relax, think and enjoy the company of your squirrelly friends. The Chippys are waiting for your help to find every last nut.

70010000110918.name: The Cute Whale
70010000110918.description:
Get ready for an ocean full of puzzles and charm. Guide a lovable whale through 30 handcrafted stages where strategy meets relaxation. Push the turtles onto the buoys and help restore harmony to the sea in this adorable adventure of logic and calm.
Explore three peaceful worlds, the Caribbean Sea, Coral Reef and Deep Sea, each filled with cozy pixel art and soothing ocean vibes. Every move brings you closer to mastering the art of gentle thinking, as you plan routes, reposition turtles and find the perfect solution at your own pace.
Features:
• 30 handcrafted puzzles full of cute and clever design
• Three cozy ocean worlds: Caribbean Sea, Coral Reef and Deep Sea
• Push turtles onto buoys and reorganize them to solve each stage
• A relaxing atmosphere with charming art and soothing sea ambience
Take a deep breath, plan your moves and make waves of happiness with your ocean friends.

70010000110924.name: Black Blood
70010000110924.intro: Escape a quarantined hospital haunted by a sinister entity. A short yet intense horror experience blending puzzles, action, and cinematic QTEs that will test your nerves.
70010000110924.description:
BLACK BLOOD is a third-person indie horror game that puts you in the shoes of the last survivor trapped inside a quarantined hospital. When an unknown disease turns blood black and a dreadful presence takes control, your only chance is to solve puzzles, survive the infected, and face the horrors within.




Main Features:
• Immersive story and oppressive atmosphere: explore sealed rooms, waiting areas, operating theaters, and corridors hiding clues about the hospital’s dark past.
• Mix of puzzles and action: alternate exploration and environmental puzzle solving with tense combat encounters.
• Integrated QTEs and cinematic sequences: adrenaline-filled moments that blend gameplay with storytelling.
• Compact, intense experience: designed to deliver a short yet memorable session, perfect for players seeking a concentrated dose of tension.




Story:
An unknown infection spreads throughout the hospital. Doors and windows are sealed, and a monstrous being lurks in the shadows. Gather clues, solve puzzles to unlock new areas, and confront the infected.




Are you ready to discover what hides within the halls? Survive BLACK BLOOD.

70010000110929.name: The Confinement
70010000110929.intro: The Confinement is a game that puts your skills to the test. Master precise movements, strategic dashes, and challenging courses.
70010000110929.description:
The Confinement is an FP4 (First Person Paced Precision Platformer) that combines speed, precision, and reflexes in an extremely challenging parkour experience. You are trapped in a simulation created by the artificial intelligence AmokAI, where every move could be your last.

Run, dodge, jump, and dash as you navigate narrow corridors, suspended platforms, and deadly traps in a hostile, technological environment. Each level is designed to test your skill, your quick reading of the scenario, and your ability to improvise under pressure.

With around 30 to 40 short and intense stages, each stage encourages constant improvement, challenging you to beat your own times and compete with other players. The combination of fluid movement, intense challenges, and striking surroundings makes The Confinement an ideal experience for those seeking fast action, extreme precision, and high replay value.

70010000110934.name: Is it True? Castle True-or-False Quiz
70010000110934.intro:
See through the Truth of Castles!  
Challenge the Common Sense Quiz on Japanese Castles with True or False!
70010000110934.description:
A quick and easy quiz game where you answer trivia questions about the history, structure, and legends of famous castles in Japan and around the world with simple True or False choices!

- Himeji Castle has never been used in battle!?  
- The stone walls of Osaka Castle contain stones from the sea!?  
- Kumamoto Castle is equipped with hidden “pitfalls”!?

…and many more surprising facts you thought you knew but actually didn’t!  
Test your “Castle Master” level with quick True or False challenges!


The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000110944.name: MarronRoman
70010000110944.intro: "Marron’s One-Day Trip to Japan – A Fantasy World Traveler’s Adventure!"
70010000110944.description:
Marron, a young girl living in the fantasy kingdom of Amestaria, lives a peaceful life surrounded by magic and mystery.
But one day, when she touches a mysterious white rabbit named Alice in the forest, she suddenly finds herself transported to Japan!

There, she meets a Japanese boy named Ryota Shigure, and together they set out on a journey to experience the wonders of Japan’s beautiful culture.
Will you join them on their enchanting one-day adventure?

70010000110953.name: Digimon Story Time Stranger
70010000110953.description:
Digimon Story Time Stranger is an RPG with monster-taming elements that explores the deep bond between humans and Digimon in an epic story that unravels the mystery of the world’s collapse.

Embark on an adventure that spans across the human world and Digital World, collecting and raising a diverse array of Digimon to fight in turn-based battles.

An Epic Story of Connection
Tokyo, Japan – An agent of a secret organization encounters an unknown creature shortly before a city-leveling explosion. They then reawaken eight years in the past...
Take on a mission to uncover the mystery of the world’s collapse, where chance encounters with unique characters will shape your journey across time and parallel worlds - and change fate itself.

Adventure Between Worlds and Time
Journey between the parallel human world and the Digital World: Iliad where Digimon reside. Explore the Digital World and its intricately detailed realms and discover all of its secrets.

Strategic Turn-Based Battles
Enjoy dynamic turn-based combat that combines strategic elements with evolved battle components. More than 450 Digimon and deep customization options provide limitless ways to approach the challenges of battle and reveal the strength of the bonds formed with your Digimon.

*This product is the Standard Edition. A Deluxe Edition and Ultimate Edition are also available. Please be careful of duplicate purchases.

REGARDING THE DEMO
Get a glimpse of the story with the opening chapter of Digimon Story Time Stranger in this demo. Save data from this demo can also be transferred to the full version of the game.

Complete the demo and gain access to the Central Town - Adventure Trial mode to explore select areas and dungeons of the Digital World: Iliad.

*Central Town - Adventure Trial data cannot be transferred to the full version of the game.

70010000110956.name: Magical Girls
70010000110956.intro: A puzzle game featuring lots of cute magical girls is here!
70010000110956.description:
Collect pieces of adorable magical girls and complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Once completed, high-resolution magical girls will be added to your gallery ♪

70010000110962.name: Reioku:Ghost house
70010000110962.intro: Find it. Stop it. Then run!!
70010000110962.description:
- Find them. Survive them! -

There was once a mansion said to be plagued by countless paranormal phenomena.

You, an exorcist, enter the mansion to put those disturbances to rest.

However, the spirits lurking within trap you inside the house.

To escape, you must calm every paranormal phenomenon haunting the mansion.

Armed only with sacred talismans used to suppress the phenomena, and candles needed to pacify the spirits, you begin your search.

But the moment you place a talisman, the spirits begin to resist...

Do not overlook any paranormal phenomena.

If you discover a paranormal phenomenon, place a talisman and light the candle at the entrance.

If no paranormal phenomenon is present, do not place a talisman ? simply light the candle.

Calm all seven paranormal phenomena without making a single mistake.

And above all...

"Return safely alive".

●About "Reioku:Ghost house"

"Reioku:Ghost house" is a horror game where you must calm every paranormal phenomenon occurring within the mansion and escape alive.

70010000110971.name: LuminousStoria
70010000110971.intro: A simple and easy-to-play sword world. A small adventure of a boy who defeats monsters one after another with good music.
70010000110971.description:
"Do you know the story of Luminous?"

Uplifting music and
An exciting work in which you defeat more and more monsters in the world of swords.
An impressive character advances through the ruins with the village's treasured sword

□STORY
The boy's name is Luck.
A villager living in a remote village.
He wants to be a hero.
It is said that anyone who sees Luminous will be praised by everyone.
Luck took out the village sword to be praised by everyone.

"I want to be like a hero."

Luck is determined in his heart,
He headed to the ruins where monsters were wandering.
The ruins of a monster that villagers do not approach.
Will Luck be able to see the Luminous?

□GAME
・Easy control, simple sword attack and jump
・Swing the sword down at the monster, cut vertically
・Swing the sword from the side, cross
・Attack quickly, thrust
・Use three different attacks to defeat monsters
・Explore by pressing a switch to open a closed door
・Let's go see Luminous with Luck

□SOUND
・Rhythmic high-quality background music that beats the world of swords

□SYSTEM
・Every time you attack a monster, you get experience points.
・Raise your level and defeat powerful enemies.

70010000110974.name: After School .LIVE – Mirror of Twilight
70010000110974.intro: A visual novel starring the Vtubers from .LIVE production with a a mix of horror and school comedy.
70010000110974.description:
After School .LIVE -Mirror of Twilight- is a visual novel game starring Cyber Girl Siro, Chieri Kakyoin, and Iori Yamato, the Vtubers from .LIVE production.
It's a story with a mix of horror and school comedy, where the player is the president of the Manga Research Club. Together with three club members, escape the strange, otherworldly after school building.

Your choices shape how the story unfolds, leading to multiple endings.
Break free from the endlessly repeating, never ending after school!

You and three girls in the Manga Research Club.
After school, you discover a strange shrine inside the building, and in a moment of carelessness you shatter the mirror enshrined there.

In an instant--
the world freezes beneath an eerie sunset.
Shadows shaped like you and the girls begin to wander the corridors of the sealed after school.

“Th■ ag■ o■ ho■■or i■ h■r■!”

One by one, members of the club are attacked by the shadows.
Can you escape this never ending after school?

Many says she always looks cheerful and carefree, and it seems they're right, since she doesn't have much worries.
True to her soothing voice, she is laid back and tends to agree with just about anything.
Oddly enough, she happens to be an excellent student straight A's.

・Sakura Otoin (CV: Chieri Kakyoin)

She has a soft, airy vibe that puts everyone at ease.
Her special skill is being cute.
She is usually bubbly and acts sweet, but when in panic her tone can suddenly turn rough.
She is basically the straight man of the group.

・Inori Amano (CV: Iori Yamato)
A kouhai in the same Manga Research club.
A natural born oddball who thinks everything is fine as long as everyone is having fun.
A curious free spirit who dislikes conflict.
She has the youngest child energy, and is usually the one getting teased and called out.

70010000111022.name: Black Jacket
70010000111022.intro: The Blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deck builder where you gamble your way out of hell, supercharge your deck and play impossible combos.
70010000111022.description:
BLACKJACK EVOLVED
Play Blackjack against the restless souls wandering the hellish afterlife. You play for their coin, and you’ll need lots of them to bribe the ferryman and escape. But watch your bet because this isn’t your regular game of Blackjack:
-Stack your deck with powerful cards
-Control the table, bend the rules, and beat the odds
-Unlock near-infinite possibilities of card combinations and strategies with each run
-Collect Artifacts, Card Suits, and Curses to get an edge over your opponents
-Get to know your opponents, their stories, and yourself to break the cycle

POWERFUL CARDS
The cards will bend and change the rules of the game:
-Force your opponent to overcommit
-Increase and decrease their card values
-Control their deck or peek into your own
-Swap cards with your opponent
-Uncover secret combinations within your deck

READ YOUR OPPONENTS
Learn to read your opponents and listen to their story unfold with every encounter:
-Opponents are shown only through their hands
-Familiarize yourself with their playstyle and curses
-Deepen your relationship with them to break the cycle

70010000111028.name: Trigodpats
70010000111028.intro: Join the gods Zeus, Poseidon, and Hades on an epic journey to defeat Typhon, his wife Echidna, and their monstrous offspring.
70010000111028.description:
A war erupts to rescue Hera, Demeter, and Hestia, all captured by Typhon and his relentless minions. The fate of Olympus rests in your hands.

Core Features of Trigodpats

● TP System (Three Paths)
Trigodpats introduces the TP (Three Paths) system. Choose three paths in any order:

One grants weapons and shields

Another unlocks helmets and armor

The last reveals accessories

Your choices directly affect the difficulty and flow of the journey.

● Original Soundtrack (OST)
Enjoy a fully original soundtrack composed by the developer, featuring over 40 unique tracks. From uplifting melodies to dark and unsettling themes, the music evolves with your adventure.

● A World Full of Secrets
Explore every corner of the world. The unknown awaits: supplies, gold, equipment, and surprises hidden throughout the vast environments.

● Fully 3D World & Dynamic Camera
Trigodpats is entirely 3D, offering multiple camera angles for exploration and combat. Switch perspectives freely — including a First-Person Mode (FP Mode) for a more immersive experience.

● Charismatic NPCs
Meet a wide variety of characters throughout your journey: mortals, heroes, mythological creatures, gods, and goddesses — each with their own role in the story.

● Countless Items to Collect
Weapons, armor, accessories, and more. Explore, collect, and build your ultimate loadout.

Welcome to the battle of the gods.

Living in that kingdom as a Daoist priestess in training, you made your way to the Tournament of Valor to root for your childhood friend.

A sudden attack during the Tournament of Valor forces you to protect your country and those you care about.

Fight alongside friend and foe alike to save your kingdom!

Build your personal training schedule across weeks or months, earn rewards for staying consistent, and watch your strength and endurance grow. Each trainer brings unique energy, voice, and encouragement to help you stay motivated.
Vibrant visuals, dynamic environments, and pumping music transform every workout into a fitness adventure. Whether you’re just starting out or chasing peak performance.

70010000111071.description:
Hit the track in Nitro Karts Racer, a fast-paced arcade karting adventure where every race fuels your next big win. Earn virtual currency from your victories, and use it to buy brand-new karts—each designed for speed, control, and personality.

Race through a lineup of dynamic tracks, from winding forest runs to seaside descents and rugged canyon drops. Every course features thrilling downhill slopes that test your timing, boost control, and racing instincts.

Solve puzzles, find tools to escape, and outsmart a ruthless killer who’s always one step behind you. 70010000111125.name: Chinami Holic
70010000111125.intro: A heartwarming "menhera" horror adventure where reality and fiction intertwine, starring VTuber Chinami Dokugai as herself in a fully voiced role.
70010000111125.description:
As you spend blissful days with Chinami, the memory of your first meeting and her feelings begin to quietly distort beneath the surface.
Experience an addictive story that blends sweetness with creeping horror.


◆Synopsis
“Call me Chinami. We're in a relationship, after all.”

You're spending a lovey dovey relationship with Chinami Dokugai, a popular streamer.
Even while busy with work, you always find time to go on dates and enjoy each other company.

From here on, you will keep going on dates and even travel together with Chinami.
And maybe… beyond that—

But... wait...

Come to think of it… how did you and Chinami meet in the first place?


◆Characters
・Dokugai Chinami（CV: Dokugai Chinami）
Your first ever girlfriend.
Stylish, beautiful, and very talkative. She is also a popular streamer.
She eagerly closes the distance between you, leaving you constantly flustered and on edge.

But for some reason, you can't remember where, when, or how you met her.

70010000111131.name: Morkull Ascend to the Gods
70010000111131.intro: Get in trouble with Morkull again!
70010000111131.description:
Morkull Ascend to the Gods is a 2D action video game focused on boss battles, once again taking control of the charismatic God of Death: Morkull.

Set in the original world of Morkull Ragast's Rage, locked up and aware that he is in a new video game, you must help him escape so that he can carry out his evil plans for the world and rule by subjecting everyone to his will (yes, including you).

You will feel the power and bear the weight of being the God of Death and Darkness. A select series of battles against other henchmen, minions, and Gods that make up the Olympus of the Kingdom of Midaldus await you.

But don't worry, don't tremble. You won't be alone. You'll have Morkull (or rather, he'll have you), who has a wide range of combos, skills, and charms that you can unlock, equip, and build to your liking before each battle.

Although you'll also die a good handful of times.

Morkull is back!

This means that his charisma, character, and personality, along with his breaking of the fourth wall, will create a lighthearted atmosphere at all times (you're going to need it), loaded with bad jokes, references, and memes that are very present in pop culture.

It's like having a friend playing alongside you.

Like its predecessor, Morkull Ascend to the Gods is completely hand-drawn and animated, with great care and frame by frame. In this way, thanks to traditional animation, the characters' movements are very natural and full of life.

Distinguished by a stylized character and a wide color palette, this time, outside of Ragast, you will be able to see and discover other environments that belong to the Kingdom of Midaldus.

Morkull is back! So get back in trouble with him and join his ranks by supporting his Machiavellian cause.

70010000111137.name: Combat Forces
70010000111137.intro: Stunning, realistic graphics realized with next-generation technology! Become a member of the world's most elite special forces in this modern warfare FPS game!
70010000111137.description:
The most dangerous operation, the deepest shadow. You are both shield and sword.
<Combat Forces> is an FPS game where you become a member of the world's most elite special forces and confront advanced threats threatening the world.

Players become elite agents of the team and are deployed on high-intensity missions to track down "Atlas," the leader of a multinational criminal organization.

・Top-notch, realistic graphics and presentation deliver an overwhelming sense of immersion.
・As part of a living, breathing elite team, execute operations alongside unique, elite members from the Assault, Engineer, Support, and Recon classes.
・Provides a variety of cooperative and competitive modes, including Deathmatch, Conquest, and Rush, offering an immersive single-team experience.
・Experience real-time teamwork with your teammates to complete missions. Missions unfold in isolated fortresses and high-stakes conflict zones in the Middle East. Each environment presents unique tactical challenges.
・Feel the vivid sensations of battle at your fingertips, including the vibrations of the latest weapons, the sound of their actions, and the changes in footsteps based on terrain.
・Control your main battle tank to strike enemy strongholds or provide cover for friendly infantry.

<Combat Forces> is a story of camaraderie, sacrifice, and the fierce struggle of special agents to protect the world from threats.
Join the ultimate special forces team. The world is at your fingertips.

Synopsis
On the surface, the world is peaceful, but behind the scenes, a mysterious transnational criminal organization operates across borders, sowing chaos. At the center of this chaos lies a shadowy leader, Atlas. More than just a terrorist, Atlas seeks to acquire advanced weapons capable of disrupting the global financial, political, and military systems. Your unit is the last line of defense, deployed to quietly eliminate this threat.

The team stumbles upon the first traces of Atlas in a Middle Eastern fortress. While the operation is successful, clues left behind by Atlas suggest they are more than just a criminal organization. The team faces the most meticulously designed defense systems, Atlas' elite forces, and unexpected enemies. In this hidden final confrontation, your sacrifice and determination will determine the fate of humanity.

Join the battlefield now and join your teammates who will protect your back!

70010000111153.description:
I was just hoping for a quiet school life...
But then I got targeted by a cheerful and mysterious beauty!
She leads the eccentric club known as the “Happy Life Research Society” and is a legendary figure at school—Rina Shinonome.
Beautiful, smart, athletic... yet her personality is so outrageous, it’s overwhelming!?
After being called “the chosen one,” I was dragged into the club against my will.
Day after day, I found myself caught up in her whirlwind pace.
But behind her constant smile... she seems to be hiding a secret no one knows—?
Includes Japanese voice acting.

70010000111159.name: For Luna the Bell Tolls
70010000111159.intro: A chime heard once in five years. A past that never left.
70010000111159.description:
Once every five years, a special chime echoes through the school in this town.
Luna, a transfer student and an art-loving girl, laughs it off as "nonsense"—but she holds a hidden past.
Without realizing it’s a reunion, she meets the protagonist, "me", again.
Their bond, and the secret of her parents’ work hidden behind the chime, begin to resurface.
A sound heard only once every five years ties the two together once more.
Includes Japanese voice acting.

70010000111176.name: Vaccine Case
70010000111176.intro: Store, mix, and pour the vaccine out to eradicate the virus.
70010000111176.description:
Your brains’ll be pouring out too with the soaring difficulty of this “gusher” puzzle game.
That’s what Vaccine Case’s all about.

The key to everything is the order you open the partitions holding back the vaccines.
Eliminate each stage’s virus cells with vaccines of matching colors by trial & error.

Rules:
• The object is to open the partitions, and let out the vaccine to eradicate the virus cells of the same color.
• However, when you eliminate even one cell, the vaccine will turn clear and no longer work.
• When you make a mistake, you can go back step by step with the UNDO button on the lower left (at most ten times).
• You cannot open partitions between vaccines of different colors.
• As the game progresses purple and orange viruses will also appear. Mix the vaccines to make the appropriate colors with the mixer.

Over 200 stages of abundant designs and tricks.

She introduces herself as Serena Hanazono, and she would like you to help her find a lost necklace.

Together, the two of you search each possible location, but somehow it feels like a fun date......

70010000111203.name: Korean Monorail Panorama Line Hwagaesan
70010000111203.description:
This game is a monorail simulation game set in Hwagae Mountain, a representative natural landmark in Korea.
Players become a monorail driver, taking in the breathtaking scenery of Hwagae Mountain and experiencing the unique experience of operating a monorail through beautiful natural and cultural heritage sites.

This is the first title to utilize actual filmed sections of the Hwagae Mountain monorail!

Key Features

• Realistic Monorail Driving Experience

Uses high-quality footage of actual Hwagae Mountain monorail sections.

Experience driving a monorail through diverse landscapes and terrain.

Two play modes: section-by-section driving mode and view mode.

• Control System

Just like driving a real monorail, precise control is required, including acceleration, deceleration, and stopping.

Compared to regular railways, the game features numerous uphill and downhill sections and significant impacts, requiring appropriate acceleration and deceleration control.

Ensuring on-time operation and stopping locations are crucial challenges, providing players with a truly engaging experience.
 

• Realistic Scenery and Atmosphere

Pass through the Hwagaesan Monorail section and admire the surrounding mountains, nature, and tourist attractions through footage shot on the actual monorail.

Enjoy the natural beauty of Korea through high-definition footage that realistically recreates the breathtaking scenery as you ride.

Recommended for:

• Gamers who enjoy monorails and natural scenery
• Players who want to experience Korea's famous attractions and travels through games
• Users who prefer realistic simulations that emphasize nature and scenery

This game offers a unique opportunity to experience Hwagaesan and its surrounding natural landscapes by monorail.
It's a truly unforgettable experience for lovers of Korean nature and monorails!

70010000111209.name: Brain Workout!Spinning Insect Puzzle
70010000111209.intro:
Spin the pieces and peek into the world of insects!
A fascinating bug art puzzle you just can’t look away from
70010000111209.description:
This is a puzzle game where you rotate panels to align insects that are placed in random directions.

The controls are simple—just observe the image carefully and tap the panel you want to rotate!
Depending on how fast you clear the stage, you’ll earn 1 to 3 insects.

A hint button becomes available over time and can be used up to three times.
It will automatically align one row of panels in the correct direction,
so you can relax even if you get stuck.
