It’s simple yet surprisingly deep—
perfect for a quick and fun brain workout!
Try to earn 3 insects on every stage!

70010000111218.name: 70s-style Robot Anime Geppy-X
70010000111218.intro:
70s-Style Super Robot Anime Returns.
Transforming Mechs × Arcade 2D Shooter Action.
A Cult Classic Reborn in HD — Now Worldwide.
70010000111218.description:
It’s the year 197X…

A mysterious force calling itself the Cosmic Demon Empire suddenly launched an assault on Earth, commanding an army of colossal beast-shaped war machines known as the Space Beasts. Meanwhile, at a certain top-secret Space Robot Laboratory somewhere in the Far East, preparations had been made “just in case something like this ever happened”. Thus, the newly developed transforming and combining combat robot GEPPY-X was deployed into action.

Never before released outside of Japan, 70’s-Style Robot Anime GEPPY-X will now be available to play worldwide!

A love letter to Japanese mecha anime from the 70’s, this fast-paced 2D side-scrolling shooter has undergone a transformation of its own. Battle the Cosmic Demon Empire with quality of life improvements such as faster load times, rewind, save states, and more! 

Experience GEPPY-X with subtitles in eight new languages and full restoration of the 8,000 hand-drawn frames from the original Betacam master tapes. The original release squeezed the animation into four discs at 320x240 resolution and only 15fps. For this new release, each “episode” has had its opening theme, previews, commercials, and end credits re-digitized and restored to its original 24fps.

Features
- Never suffer from a mistake or miss a commercial with the ability to rewind
- Save and reload at any point with Save States
- Trophies/Achievements
- Fully restored Betacam tapes re-digitized to 24fps with optional upscaling (optional setting will follow shortly after launch)
- Original Japanese voice overs including iconic voices from classic 90’s anime such as Akira Kamiya, Shō Hayami, Shūichi Ikeda, Ichirō Nagai, Gorō Naya, and more
- Original soundtrack including legendary anime theme artists Isao Sasaki, Akira Kushida, and Hironobu Kageyama
- Localized subtitles (available in English, Japanese, French, Spanish, Italian, German, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese)
- Transform between three combat forms in real time, mastering balance, speed, and power
Rapid Fire Option：Relax your hands and fire your main and sub weapons by holding button instead of button mashing!

- CRT filters - Relive the retro experience with several filter options, including CRT curvature
- Digital Gameplay Manual
- 6 Unlockable Extra Modes including:
    Boss Rush
    Alternate Timelines
    Experimental Episode Variants

70010000111224.name: STREAMER SIMULATOR 2026
70010000111224.intro: Go live, get noticed, and captivate viewers worldwide.
70010000111224.description:
STREAMER SIMULATOR 2026 invites you into a dynamic world of digital content creation, where every stream tells a story and every follower brings you closer to internet fame. Step into the shoes of an aspiring streamer and feel the thrill, pressure, and unpredictability of building your online career from scratch.

This is more than a lifestyle game — it’s a full streamer simulation, where timing, creativity, and strategy shape your path to stardom.

Features:
-Realistic content creation:
Master live streaming, audience interaction, and editing with tools simulating real streaming platforms.
-Dynamic social trends:
Adapt to viewer interests, viral moments, trolls, and sponsorships in a changing online ecosystem.
-Life and time management:
Balance streaming with sleep, meals, side jobs, bills, and manage stress and burnout.
-Customization and modding:
Personalize your setup, overlays, outfits, and create or download custom events and content.

Will you shine in the spotlight — or vanish in the algorithm?

70010000111231.name: Lalulu Island Survival
70010000111231.intro:
Survive, explore, and thrive on a mysterious island.
Gather allies, build, survive, and find hidden treasures.
Welcome to Lalulu Island Survival!
70010000111231.description:
Lalulu Island Survival is a charming top-down survival adventure where you play as a cute, fictional creature who suddenly finds themselves stranded on a forgotten island full of mysteries, dangers, and unlimited potential. Your journey begins with nothing—but the island is alive with resources, secrets, and new friends waiting to be discovered.

Gather materials, craft essential tools, and build small but meaningful structures that transform your camp into a thriving home. Explore multiple islands, each with unique environments, treasures, and challenges. Recruit loyal companions to join your journey and help automate different tasks, turning your simple settlement into a bustling little world.

As you progress, you’ll earn coins, upgrade your abilities, and unlock new ways to boost efficiency and survive longer. Whether you're collecting rare items, expanding your base, or searching for legendary treasures hidden deep within the archipelago, every step brings you closer to mastering the island.

Key Features:

• A relaxing yet rewarding survival experience with a top-down stylized look.
• Explore mysterious islands packed with secrets, resources, and treasure.
• Gather materials, craft tools, and build a variety of small structures.
• Recruit companions to help you work, explore, and automate tasks.
• Earn coins, upgrade your skills, and speed up every process.
• Discover hidden locations and uncover the story behind Lalulu Island.
• Perfect for fans of exploration, crafting, automation, and cozy survival adventures.

Prepare to explore, survive, and create your own island paradise in Lalulu Island Survival!

70010000111235.name: Cyber Girls
70010000111235.intro: A puzzle game featuring tons of cool and cute Android girls is here!
70010000111235.description:
Collect pieces of stylish and adorable Android girls to complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Once completed, high-resolution Android girls will be added to your gallery ♪

70010000111239.name: Parcel Push
70010000111239.intro: A Sokoban-style puzzle game with pixel art
70010000111239.description:
A Sokoban-style puzzle game featuring 8-bit pixel art, chiptune soundtrack and 100 handcrafted levels.

Step into the boots of the newest recruit of the Island Courier Guild and deliver enchanted parcels to seal points scattered across the ocean-touched isles.

Play as Kai or Nami, and push, plan, and puzzle your way through a world of clever challenges to prove yourself as the next Master Courier!

70010000111242.name: Kingdom's Return: Time-Eating Fruit and the Ancient Monster
70010000111242.intro: A kingdom-rebuilding adventure filled with action and strategy!
70010000111242.description:
Kingdom's Return is an action RPG where you'll adventure to restore your fallen kingdom. Collect materials in 2D side-scrolling adventure stages, then use them in the strategy part to rebuild your kingdom and power up your characters!

*Story
In a world of swords, magic, and fairies, you are a lone adventurer who suddenly becomes tasked to revive the ruined kingdom of Almacia along with the Fairy of Time, Chronos.
Through adventure (action) and revival (strategy), restore the kingdom to its former glory!

*Action and Strategy
Kingdom's Return combines action with strategy for an addictive hybrid experience!
In adventure stages, you'll collect items for construction in the strategy part, all while levelling up your kingdom and characters.
You can approach each side in balance, or concentrate primarily on just one and still clear the game.

*The build of your dreams!
As you fill the land with buildings, the characters you take on adventures will also grow stronger.
Build the kingdom of your dreams and strengthen your allies!

*The playable cast is brimming with personality!
Start your adventure by choosing from "Imperial", "Wizard", "Alchemist", and "Zipangu".
Each has unique stats, skills and attacks, so choose the one that fits your action style!
You can change characters while in your kingdom, so you'll always have a variety of styles to choose from!

*Adventure in an idyllic fantasy world!
In Kingdom's Return, you'll build your cozy fantasy kingdom and bravely adventure into dungeons.
Get quests from villagers, build up your lands, and play around with powerful bosses!
This is your kingdom to rebuild how you want!

70010000111248.name: Nature Escapes 5 Collector's Edition
70010000111248.intro: Nature Escapes makes a return with exciting surprises for both old and new players!
70010000111248.description:
Welcome to Nature Escapes 5, where the peaceful world of hidden objects awaits. 
With 24 new levels, each one is a quiet corner of nature where you can take your time and enjoy the simple act of finding hidden objects. 
It’s a casual game designed for those moments when you just want to relax and unwind.

Find yourself in 20+ cozy, nature-inspired levels.

- Uncover over 70+ hidden object scenes and engaging minigames.
- Learn fascinating facts about a diverse array of plants.
- Relax with soothing, gentle music throughout your journey.
- Create and personalize your own peaceful garden retreat.

As you explore, you’ll discover objects nestled in beautiful, serene settings. 
Whether it's a tranquil forest or a blooming garden, each level offers a calm, unhurried experience. 
And if you enjoy a bit of creativity, there's plenty of opportunity to expand your garden with new plants and decorations, making it a little retreat that reflects the world you explore.

70010000111255.name: Hentai Uni 5
70010000111255.intro: 12 enchanting beauties will delight you in an exciting puzzle game!
70010000111255.description: 12 enchanting beauties will delight you in an exciting puzzle game. An angel and a succubus, a cat girl, a fox, and many others are waiting for you!

70010000111261.name: Hypercar Racing
70010000111261.intro: Get ready to feel the speed!
70010000111261.description:
In Hypercar Racing you'll enjoy the dirtiest, fastest, and most spectacular races at speeds over 200 Mp/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 8 adversaries. The game has different modes, such as Championship, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Online ranking chart where you can compare your best times with friends and players from all over the world.

Features:

-Arcade driving
-4-Player Multiplayer
-Online Ranking
-Achievements

70010000111267.name: Super Score Shooter Classic
70010000111267.description:
Super Star Shooter Classic is a time-based vertical shooting game that blends simple controls with score-focused gameplay. It is designed for short, concentrated sessions and features clean pixel-art visuals inspired by classic computer shooters.

■Game Modes
2-Minute Mode / 5-Minute Mode: Aim for the highest score within a fixed time limit. Each run is short, allowing repeated attempts and steady improvement.

■Gameplay
Move your ship, avoid enemy bullets, and destroy incoming foes. The game emphasizes accuracy, positioning, and pattern recognition. Controls are straightforward, making it accessible for beginners while offering enough depth for experienced players.

■Visual Style
The game uses sharp, retro-inspired pixel art reminiscent of early computer action games. Enemy patterns and boss attacks are designed to be readable, keeping the focus on score optimization and survivability.

■Competition and Replayability
An online leaderboard is included. Players can compare their scores globally and challenge themselves to climb the rankings through repeated runs.

■Recommended For
1.Players who enjoy short, focused arcade-style sessions.
2.Fans of classic vertical shooters and pixel-art presentation.
3.Those who like refining routes, improving accuracy, and competing through high-score play.

70010000111269.name: Manny’s
70010000111269.intro: this stranded soul will have to work for his meal...and for his life!
70010000111269.description: A castaway stuck on a deserted island scrounges for the last bits of food he can find. On the edge of death, he wakes up one night and realizes that a fully stocked, fully functional fast food restaurant has appeared on his tiny island paradise. Shocked and confused at the sight, he wanders into the nightmare that is Manny's, a restaurant with employees who act as if nothing is out of the ordinary, one bloodthirsty patron, and a mysterious manager who calls out from the bowels of the restaurant itself. Will this castaway get his last meal, or will he become the meal?

70010000111275.name: Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE
70010000111275.intro: "Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE" is the ultimate, completely new 8-bit shmup created in the 21st century.
70010000111275.description:
The ultimate brand-new 8-bit shmup "Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE," born in the 21st century, has arrived!

What is "Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE"?
A faithful port of "Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE," meticulously crafted to capture a truly nostalgic 8-bit feel.

It features both the Japanese and North American versions, each offering a distinct storyline. You can also explore and enjoy printed materials and various visual artworks in the Gallery Mode.

Simple yet deep game system
This title is a side-scrolling shmup consisting of 6 stages based on cities around the world.
The super-variable mech "ESTIQUE" can transform at any time between "Fighter Form", which has a smaller vertical hitbox, and "Robot Form", which nullifies terrain damage and excels in health recovery. The key to clearing the game lies in how you switch between these two forms and two types of equipment depending on the situation. Furthermore, the scoring system driven by the special attack "Super Weapon", activated by mashing the shot button, adds depth to the gameplay.
With a game design focused on playability—such as a time-based regenerating life system and the removal of power-ups—a strategic shooting experience awaits everyone, from beginners to experts.

70010000111281.name: Save My Scrap
70010000111281.intro: A puzzle adventure where you repair androids to uncover the secrets of the past.
70010000111281.description:
"They mean everything to me. Please, make them whole again." 

You are a mechanic for androids who has received a request from a new client.
The client is a doctor named Miomaru and his personal android, an old, near-failing model named Harima.
As per your client's request, you begin repairing Harima. You connect the cords, trade out parts, and bring life back to the functions that had broken down. It was supposed to be a simple mechanical repair.
However, the more you deepen your bonds with Harima and Miomaru, the more you start to realize something.
You're not just repairing an android anymore. You're connecting the cords that spark their memories; ones that they'd tried to forget.

Once your job is finished, you will be forced to confront shocking truths and hear their heartrending pleas.


Gameplay
Android Repairs
Look inside Harima's body to find the parts that need to be fixed through a variety of mini-games. These repairs will be the key to learning about your clients' past.

Conversation
Talk with your clients, Miomaru and Harima, to gain their trust and get to the true crux of their story. Your choices will change how they respond.

World-buildingWhile in your car, you can listen to the radio and gain more insights into the world and its culture. Try out several channels to gain even more insight into the game's world.

70010000111287.name: Animal Run for Kids
70010000111287.intro: The Wild Math Race for Clever Minds!
70010000111287.description:
Get ready for a fast-paced math adventure for 1–4 players! Dash across the track as a hedgehog or frog, outsmart your opponents with clever tactics, and tackle tricky math challenges along the way. Collect sunbeams, play action cards, and race to the finish line first. A perfect mix of family fun and brain-boosting gameplay!

Smart fun for all ages! With five adjustable difficulty levels (6–10+), Animal Squad offers the right challenge for every player - from addition to division. Make learning math exciting, hands-on, and full of laughter!

Features:
- 1-4 Players: Play solo, with friends, or family.
- Two Thrilling Tracks: Dash across grassy fields and lakes.
- 5 Difficulty Levels (Ages 6–10+): Age-appropriate challenges from addition to division.
- Action Cards: Speed up, block opponents, and gain the edge.
- Charming Animal World: Relaxing, colorful design with adorable illustrations.

70010000111298.name: Digging And Selling: Simulator 2025
70010000111298.intro: Your Journey Begins Beneath the Earth
70010000111298.description:
Enter a brand-new digging experience where exploration, strategy, and progression blend into one immersive adventure. In this underground simulation game, you take control of your own excavation journey - uncover hidden minerals, carve tunnels through layered terrain, and track down precious treasures buried deep beneath the surface.

Start small with basic tools and steadily transform your gear into powerful mining equipment capable of breaking through the toughest ground. Upgrade your shovel, expand your digging strength, unlock advanced scanners, and optimize your workflow to uncover resources faster and more efficiently.

Explore vast underground environments filled with rare ores, gemstones, ancient relics, and mysterious pockets of treasure waiting to be discovered. Manage what you collect, sell valuables at the right moment, and reinvest your earnings to push even deeper into the unknown.

No timers, no pressure - only pure discovery. Dig smarter, plan ahead, and become a master of underground exploration. The deeper you go, the more incredible your findings become. How far will your journey take you?

70010000111300.name: Judero
70010000111300.intro: Judero is a handmade action/ adventure game inspired by the rich folk history of the Scottish Borders. You play as Judero, a Celt who can establish a rapport with the nature around him.
70010000111300.description:
Judero is an action/ adventure game inspired by the rich folk history of the Scottish Borders. You play as Judero, a Celt who can establish a rapport with the nature around him. Travel with Judero through a handcrafted landscape as he discovers there is an evil at work manipulating the unguarded.

Strike and dodge your way through a myriad of foes culminating in exciting and unique boss challenges.

Take on the form of lesser creatures to greatly expand your abilities. Use these enchanted minions in combat and to solve puzzles.

Discover the world of Judero through branching dialogues and pithy, aphoristic NPCs.

Through your adventures you will encounter a number of diverse Mini Games with differing mechanics and visual styles. Mini games also vary the pace of the game and allow us to explore other narrative tangents.

There are many secrets and discoveries to find as you roam through the world of Judero. From collectables and pick-ups to whole optional story-lines and more.

Judero is made from handcrafted objects and bespoke figurines, animated in the stop-motion tradition. For us, this art style invokes something nostalgic; in part comical but perhaps a little bit creepy too. These real life elements are then rendered into a 3D world to evoke a unique visual style. Using this style we can bring in digital techniques like real-time lighting, shaders and post-processing effects. Cutscenes will be made using traditional stop-motion animation techniques with greater fidelity to give a more cinematic quality.

The music in Judero is an homage to traditional British folk music such as those documented by Francis James Child. Many of these songs are hundreds of years old and it has been an honour researching and learning them. We are keeping instrumentation acoustic and mostly authentic to the originals (mostly) but with contemporary arrangements and harmonies.

70010000111306.name: Oasis Obby Parkour
70010000111306.description:
Step into Oasis Obby Parkour, a vibrant and fast-paced parkour adventure set in a colorful desert world full of creative challenges and smooth movement.

Run, jump, climb, and wall-bounce your way through dynamic obstacle courses designed to test your timing, precision, and creativity. Each stage offers a unique twist — from shifting platforms to moving traps — all wrapped in a bright, modern visual style.

Features:

>Fluid Parkour Gameplay – Enjoy responsive controls that make every jump and landing feel satisfying.

>Challenging Courses – Master handcrafted level filled with clever platforming and surprising obstacles.

>Relaxed Desert Atmosphere – Explore a sun-soaked oasis with warm colors and an upbeat soundtrack.

70010000111309.name: Roller Katz BF: Episode 1
70010000111309.intro: Skate, run, and fight as Kiara, the robot created by Diana Katz, in a futuristic city full of speed, action, and 3D adventures
70010000111309.description:
Welcome to Roller Katz: BF – Episode 1, a dynamic 3D platformer that blends speed, action, and exploration in a colorful, futuristic world.
Join Diana Katz, a young prodigy inventor, and her greatest creation: Kiara, a skating robot with unique abilities to jump, roll, smash obstacles, and face enemies along the way.

Your mission is to protect Clean City, a high-tech metropolis threatened by the ruthless Sergeant Rocco and his army.
Use Kiara’s agility and power to overcome challenging levels: grind on rails, dodge hazards, leap across rivers, and defeat foes while uncovering hidden secrets and alternate paths.

Each level is crafted with a vibrant, anime-inspired visual style. The energetic soundtrack keeps the pace high, while cinematic cutscenes tell a story of friendship, creativity, and courage between Diana and Kiara.

Main Features:

Explore Clean City, a futuristic metropolis filled with detail and alternate routes.

Control Kiara smoothly and combine speed, combat, and precision.

Face unique enemies and bosses with distinct attack patterns.

Enjoy anime-style cutscenes that bring the story to life.

Challenging platforming, speed sections, and secrets to discover.

Original soundtrack packed with rhythm and energy.

With its distinctive aesthetic and fast-paced gameplay, Roller Katz: BF – Episode 1 delivers an adventure full of speed, action, and creativity.
Perfect for players who love skating, platforming, and high-energy 3D exploration.

Can you keep peace in Clean City and stop Sergeant Rocco?
Strap on your skates, fire up your engines, and get ready to roll at full speed!

70010000111314.name: Gigabonk: Mega Survivors
70010000111314.description:
Welcome to the Ultimate Survival Arena!


Get ready for the most addictive and chaotic survival experience on Nintendo Switch™! Gigabonk: Mega Survivors throws you into a vibrant, fast-paced world where only the strongest survive. Grow your character, dodge countless enemies, and unleash mega-powerful attacks to become the ultimate champion!

KEY FEATURES:

ADDICTIVE GAMEPLAY: Easy to pick up, impossible to put down! Move with intuitive controls and unleash automatic attacks. Your goal is simple: survive and dominate!
GROW & EVOLVE: Start small, but don't stay that way! Collect experience gems from defeated enemies and watch your character grow in size and power. Evolve during the match to unlock devastating new abilities!
CHAOTIC BATTLE ROYALE: You are not alone! Dozens of other players and bots are fighting for the same goal. Outmaneuver them, trap them, and be the last survivor in this epic IO-style battle.
POWERFUL SKILLS & WEAPONS: Unlock a unique arsenal of super attacks and special skills. From giant hammers to energy blasts, find your favorite playstyle and bonk everyone out of your way!
VIBRANT MAPS: Battle across multiple colorful and dynamic maps, each with its own unique layout and challenges.
QUICK & THRILLING MATCHES: Each round is a new chance for victory! Enjoy fast-paced 3-5 minute matches perfect for gaming on the go.
Why Gigabonk: Mega Survivors?

If you love popular survival IO games, you will be instantly hooked on Gigabonk! We took the formula you love and injected it with a dose of pure, unadulterated fun, vibrant visuals, and satisfying combat that will keep you coming back for "just one more round."

Download Gigabonk: Mega Survivors now and start your journey to become the Mega Survivor!

70010000111316.name: Deathbulge: Battle of the Bands
70010000111316.intro: Melt a face, slap a bass or kiss a drum in this RPG about three idiot musicians. Praised for its refreshing take on the JRPG genre.
70010000111316.description:
Upon signing up to a perfectly normal battle of the bands contest for a bit of fun, Faye, Ian and Briff are cursed with an unusual power and find themselves sealed to a horrible fate. Surely there's a way to get out of it, there has to be! Even if it means... *shudder* working together.

Gameplay features:
- 15-20 hours of game time
- Kick down every single door you come across
- 100+ skills, 50+ accessories and 9 classes to customize the band with, each with their own special outfit
- Outfit choices are reflected in ALL dialogue portraits and cutscenes
- Excessive amounts of hand-drawn frame-by-frame animation
- Inventive battle system that combines real-time and turn-based gameplay
- Rich soundtrack spanning a wide variety of genres
- Highly praised writing and humour
- Memorable dungeons - From traversing the hair of a giant tree lady to crowdsurfing through an entire arena
- Item system that says GOOD RIDDANCE to tedious inventory management
- 120+ unique NPCs, all with their own dialogue portraits
- Late game dating segment with 12+ endings
- You can actually use status effects on bosses!
- Singing fish are an integral part of the story
- NEW! Easy mode
- NEW! Bonus area with brutally difficult challenges

This product supports the following languages: English

70010000111322.name: Brave Rounds
70010000111322.intro: Shoot, punch and get closer through bullets and enemies in this close range-heavy arcade bullet hell shoot 'em up!
70010000111322.description:
Brave Rounds is a fast-paced, close range-heavy vertical scrolling shoot 'em up with the beauty and ruthless precision of 00s arcade classics. Shoot them up by yourself or co-op together with a friend!

Master the art of getting closer and beat the heck out of them!

Play as one of three playable characters accompanied with their Options. Shoot the wide shot, focus shot, deploy the bombs, or unleash their special!

You don't have to fight alone; get a friend and play together in Two Player where they control the Options directly! Or control both characters at once with just one controller with Dual Control!

Brave Rounds tells a touching story of inter-generational relationships and the lengths people take to accomplish their goals. Set in the occult and sci-fi-laden modern era of 20XX, Brave Rounds explores the worth in fighting for what you believe in.

Features:
- Arcade Mode, the game's main mode of high-intensity five stages action. Fight the mid-bosses, bosses, and watch out for the dynamic difficulty: Rank! Are you worthy enough to face the True Last Boss...?
- Stage Practice, for your practicing convenience. Whenever you get stuck at Arcade Mode, visit the Stage Practice.
- Story Mode, telling a different story from Arcade Mode, is where you tackle 41 bite-sized stages. Complete the challenges, get the stars, upgrade your strength. Explore the world of Brave Rounds and the motivations behind the characters in lively and animated Visual Novel-style cutscenes!
- Score Attack. Get the high score in the Score Attack-exclusive stage within the 3 minutes time limit! Dare to put the gas on the pedal and raise the rank to its limit?
- Inspired by 00s video games and animes, Brave Rounds features smooth, hi-res hand-drawn art and animations. Colorful and expressive! Watching their movements is key to success.
- Enjoy the soundtrack of various genres by Dicky Teja Pratama, Jasson Prestiliano and Scowsh!
- Screen scaling options including TATE / Vertical mode, rebindable conrols, and replays!

70010000111328.name: Pyramid Quest 2
70010000111328.intro: Exploration and treasure-hunting game inspired by classic platform games
70010000111328.description:
Pyramid Quest 2 is an exploration and treasure-hunting game inspired by classic platform games. The goal is to find the three parts of an artefact and open the gate to the next level while collecting diamonds and coins. 
In this adventure, the player finds himself in a pyramid in the jungle surrounded by dense vegetation.
Traps, obstacles, and enemies from old days make the quest very dangerous and challenging.3D graphics packed in a nice graphics style, great 2.5D levels and proven gameplay gives you hours of fun.

Features:
- 36 challenging levels
- classic platformer gameplay
- lots of traps and obstacles
- unique enemies
- detailed comic style 3D graphics

70010000111330.name: Shrink Rooms
70010000111330.description:
This is a box-pushing puzzle escape game set in a collapsing room. You’ll need to count your moves precisely, dodge bottomless pits and traps, use all kinds of mechanisms in the room, and push crates to solve puzzles—escape before the walls crush you into a puddle!

The amount of content is insane! Over 300+ escape-room levels, 5 large themed chapters, plus tons of exhibits packed with dark-humor jokes.

Watch the timing of the walls closing in each turn, plan your steps with precision, avoid traps, make smart use of the stage’s interactive mechanics, push boxes to open the exit, and get out before the walls turn you into mince!

All kinds of fun gadgets await inside: signal panels, polymers, portals... and many more tricky, high-difficulty puzzles for you to crack! Bring it on!

You can freely explore the level-select hub. Clear the main challenges to earn compute points and unlock later chapters—but the tough puzzles hidden in the corners are the real test. And when you need a break from solving puzzles, you can also explore virtual exhibits and hunt for hidden levels—there are loads of Easter eggs waiting to be found.

70010000111343.name: Pure Hentai: Dreams
70010000111343.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000111349.name: Pure Hentai: Vision
70010000111349.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000111355.name: Shardpunk
70010000111355.intro: Gather your team, scavenge for resources, fight enemy hordes, and seek shelter to live another day in this mix of turn-based tactical strategy with RPG, survival, and resource management.
70010000111355.description:
In Shardpunk you’ve already lost. The Rat Swarm has breached the walls of The Capitol and flooded the city with its vermin horde. Now you need to run for your life while saving as many people and pieces of equipment as possible. 

Put together a crew of survivors and use a range of steampunk weapons and bots to scavenge for resources, slow down the horde, and reach safety. Push through three districts with progressively more vicious enemies, rising emergency levels, and supplies that dry up like blood from a knife wound. 

Keep on moving and use every skill and item at your disposal to reach the safety of fusion core-operated bunkers. From battle tactics to the most difficult decisions on who should receive the last medpack or rations, you’ll need to take charge and (hopefully) live with its consequences.

FEATURES
- Turn-based tactical battles with the hard choices made at the bunker
- Grid-based levels that are open for exploration and full of tactical possibilities while you run from the endless hordes of rats
- A motley crew of characters to build your team, each one with unique abilities, equipment, perks, and shortcomings that affect their mates
- Steampunk arsenal and technologies to use in battle that also requires mending and cooling, so they don’t backfire on you in the middle of the fight
- Variety of resources to scavenge, upgrades to unlock, and equipment to craft
- Detailed pixel art visuals that set the Victorian mood and feast your eyes with fusion-core explosions

70010000111357.name: Pure Hentai: Paradise
70010000111357.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000111363.name: Spot the Cat
70010000111363.intro: Can you find two identical cats?
70010000111363.description: Can you find two identical cats?

70010000111369.name: Twin Shot Deluxe
70010000111369.intro: The Angel Cats are back in this complete remaster! Twin Shot Deluxe is a platform arcade shooter where players defend their homeland using bow and arrows.
70010000111369.description:
TWIN SHOT IS BACK!
Take aim at over 200+ brand new levels set across four worlds, each with unique challenges, bosses and enemies. Play solo or team up with friends in local co-op (1-4 players) or play competitively to see who will be crowned champion.

A brand new Atlantis theme to explore, defeat additional bosses, unlock fancy headwear with special powers for extended replay, and much more... relive your childhood and take to the skies!

WHATS NEW?
Twin Shot Deluxe has received a complete graphical overhaul. We have painstakingly redone every single sprite, animation, character, background and menu to elevate the art to new heights.

We could not leave the game lagging in the past at 20FPS, it has now been upgraded to an angelic 60FPS, and now with a modern 16:9 ratio, that's 78% more Twin Shot. We even have a brand new intro animatic and ending illustrations remastered to pixel art perfection.

NEW BOSSES & LEVELS
It's not just the characters and enemies that have had a revamp... meet Colossus, he's big, mean and totally climbable. Unlock the new Atlantis theme with exciting new enemies and mechanics to enjoy across its 50 stages.

Join friends and family in multiplayer (expanded to up to 4 players)
Put your archery skills to the ultimate test and explore 200+ new levels built from the ground up.
Improved air control, stop on a dime, coyote time, variable jump... Deluxe has totally revamped controls that still feel just like you remember!

Improved air control ,stop on a dime ,coyote time ,variable jump ... Deluxe has totally revamped controls that still feel just like you remember!

CHEATS FOR ALL!
Cheats and Treats are BACK! Unlock a plethora of abilities and options for enhanced replay.

Spend your loot on familiar character skins, fun modes like Tag and Fart mode, weapons and health options, listen to music tracks, make your character a GIANT and more!

Prepare to hum along to the iconic earworm tracks with music uncompressed and crystal clear. With an added bonus of some brand new music by the game's original composer Dave Cowen.

CLAIM YOR CROWN
Introducing HATS! Battle amongst your friends or alone to see who will be crowned champion. Hats aren't just hilariously cosmetic but also come with additional buffs. Ditch the crown for new headwear and new powers... the twisted hat lets you shoot backwards, jump off enemies' heads with the old boot or turn yourself to stone with the Medusa Headdress.

With Tag mode, dial up the competitiveness to 11. Tag other players with an arrow and claim the prized hat for yourself... a real game of Angel Cat and Mouse!

NITROME CLASSICS
The good ol' days of carefree gaming are back. Twin Shot Deluxe is our first release in the Nitrome Classics series.
We are bringing back beloved games of old re-equipped for modern gamers.

Look out for more Nitrome Classics games in the near future. Re-live your childhood and complete your collection.

70010000111372.name: Hentai Balls 3D: Heavy Attraction
70010000111372.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000111372.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000111381.name: Poko's Arctic Quest
70010000111381.description:
Join Poko on a frosty and challenging adventure!

Winter is coming, and the little penguin Poko needs to gather enough fish to survive the cold! Use your logic and planning to push blocks, open paths, and collect all the fish across 30 carefully designed levels inspired by classic puzzle games.

Travel through two charming environments  the icy Iceberg and the snowy Forest  each bringing new challenges that will test your reasoning and warm your heart.

Game Features:

30 relaxing yet challenging stages;

Two unique worlds with cozy visuals and soothing soundtracks;

An adorable penguin in a raincoat on the hunt for his next meal.

Get ready to think, push, and slide across the ice with Poko and discover the frosty charm of this irresistible puzzle adventure!

70010000111409.name: Tiny Biomes
70010000111409.intro: Restore life to the troubled lands in tile-based brainteaser style!
70010000111409.description:
The natural order has been disrupted, and it’s up to you to set things straight again! Travel to the forest, volcano and winter biomes as a brainteasing top-down adventure ensues.

Tiny Biomes is a relaxing yet challenging tile-rotation puzzle game where you must guide the flow of water, snow or lava to bring life back to the biomes, each consisting of 50 unique levels of gradually increasing complexity and challenge.

As you progress deeper into these biomes, you will encounter more tiles and branching paths. Each level offers up three stars. The fewer moves you use, the more stars you earn!

• Guide the flow of water, snow and lava to restore life to each biome!
• Rotate landscape tiles in engaging, relaxing puzzle gameplay.
• Enjoy colorful aesthetics and HD graphics!
• Master 150 unique stages across forest, volcano and winter biomes.
• Replay levels to use fewer moves and earn more stars!

70010000111434.name: Escape game R00M08
70010000111434.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

70010000111440.name: Our Burial Dolls Remastered
70010000111440.intro:
They buried the dolls for us that night. 
But the story didn’t end with the soil.
70010000111440.description:
The beloved classic returns in a remastered edition, featuring improved visuals and enhanced atmospheric presentation.

◆STORY
In Mitono, a remote mountain village with only a handful of households, every child must undergo a mysterious ritual known as Warawa-Tomurai. Sixth-graders Yuuma and Honoka take part in the ceremony just before the village begins to disperse. 

Yuuma’s family soon moves to the city, while Honoka remains behind due to unforeseen circumstances. Separated, the two begin to uncover the secrets behind the ritual. 

Within the sanctum where something inhuman resides, the children are drawn in—toward a painful fate.

◆REMASTERED FEATURES
- Some background images have been replaced with new assets, giving the game a distinctly different visual impression from the original.
- The user interface has been redesigned for improved readability and usability.
- New text dialogues sounds enhance immersion in the story.
- Save slot count has been expanded to 21, allowing for more flexible play.
- Multi-language support opens the experience to a wider global audience.

70010000111452.name: DAVE THE DIVER Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000111452.intro:
Dive by day! Serve by night! 
The best diving, harpooning, action-adventuring, and sushi restaurant managing experience you'll ever have.
70010000111452.description:
DAVE THE DIVER is a casual, single-player adventure RPG featuring deep-sea exploration and fishing during the day and sushi restaurant management at night. Join Dave and his quirky friends as they seek to uncover the secrets of the mysterious Blue Hole.

■ An adventure, RPG, management hybrid
Explore and unravel the mysteries in the depths of the Blue Hole by day and run a successful exotic sushi restaurant by night.
It’s easy to get hooked on the satisfying gameplay loop!

■Casual combat and gathering gameplay with rogue-like elements
Dive into the ever-changing Blue Hole and use a harpoon and other weapons to catch fish and various creatures. 
Upgrade and forge equipment with collected resources and sushi restaurant profits to prepare for the dangers that lurk in the unknown.
Running out of oxygen means leaving collected items and fish behind!

■ Eccentric characters with a lighthearted narrative
Quirky but lovable characters and a story full of in-jokes, spoofs, and other humorous scenes provide an approachable and enjoyable gameplay experience.

■ A beautiful sea environment with attractive 2D/3D Art
A combination of pixel and 3D graphics provides a stunning art style that showcases breathtaking underwater scenery. 
This oceanic adventure is set in the real marine environment of a Blue Hole filled with over 200 kinds of sea creatures.

■ Ample additional content to complement the main gameplay loop
Minigames, side quests, and multiple storylines provide many hours of entertainment and varied gameplay.

70010000111457.name: Super Hoops 2
70010000111457.intro: Throw, dodge, and master endless hoops.
70010000111457.description: Step into a fast-paced, endlessly challenging hoop-throwing experience where precision and timing are everything. Toss your hoops over red poles to conquer each sub stage, then face off against the unpredictable boss stage. Navigate moving, spinning, and rising poles while avoiding obstacles like bombs and gusts from fans that can knock your hoop off course. Hit the golden pole in each level to gain infinite hoops for that sub stage and keep the momentum going. Unlock a variety of hoop skins as you progress and test your skills across infinite levels in this abstract, addictive challenge that keeps you coming back for just one more throw.

70010000111460.name: The 1% Club World Challenge
70010000111460.intro: Do you have what it takes to answer a question only 1% of people get right? Test your brainpower and compete against players worldwide!
70010000111460.description:
The 1% Club World Challenge – Can YOU Beat the Odds?

The official game based on the hit TV gameshow!

Feel like a real contestant in the studio as you climb global leaderboards. No need to swot up on general knowledge — this game is all about logic, reasoning, and thinking differently.

Fun for all ages! With this game, an 8-year-old has as much chance of winning as an 80-year-old — it’s fun for all the family.

 - Play the official gameshow loved by millions
 - Challenge players worldwide
 - Climb multiple international leaderboards
 - Track your progress with detailed stats
 - Enjoy hundreds of unique questions with explanations
 - Experience authentic 3D studio visuals
 - Hear the iconic music and sounds from the show

Are you ready to join The 1% Club? Download now and prove you belong at the top!

70010000111465.name: Blitz Smash Ultimate
70010000111465.intro: This game rolls roguelite and run and gunner into a tight experience with 1-4 couch co-op.
70010000111465.description:
Help Zealot find her lost brother, Solitude, in the vibrant but chaotic 'Other Dimension' where riches are abundant and dangers aplenty! 
 Combine bullet powers found on the field to create unique bullet types. Dash to avoid attacks but also to crash enemies or deflect bullets. 
Fight through randomised levels, challenge large bullet hell-like bosses and collect Red Eye Orbs to spend between attempts to permanently upgrade your abilities to help tip the tide and assist you in beating the game.

70010000111471.name: Grumpy Driver
70010000111471.intro: Too many cars? Never. Too much fun? Impossible!
70010000111471.description:
Get ready to explore a colorful open world packed with secrets, challenges, and endless driving fun!

From sunny beaches and peaceful farms to bustling downtown streets and misty mountain peaks — every corner hides surprises waiting to be discovered. 

Find hidden collectibles, unlock unique car skins, and reveal secret paths and jump ramps scattered across the map!

Complete exciting missions to earn stars and expand your collection of cars — from everyday rides like taxis, vans, and pickups to emergency vehicles, off-roaders, and legendary supercars. Each car brings its own personality, and your hero even changes outfits and facial expressions to match the action!

Enjoy a living city with working traffic lights, honking drivers, and expressive reactions in fun comic-style bubbles. Whether you’re parking with precision, racing against the clock, or delivering goods safely across town — every task is a new adventure.

• A vast open world to explore
• Many vehicles with unlockable skins
• Varied missions: parking, delivery, time trials
• Dynamic traffic and interactive AI
• Playful hero with animated emotions

Drive, explore, discover — and make every ride your own!

70010000111481.name: Furry Pride Paradise Love & Fun
70010000111481.intro:
Colorful furry boys, playful challenges, and reactions full of personality.
Who will you unlock first in this pride filled paradise?
70010000111481.description:
Every victory draws attention.
In this pride filled paradise, confidence is part of the game.

Furry Pride Paradise: Love & Fun invites you into a world that celebrates expression, personality, and playful attraction. 

Through short, engaging minigames, each success unlocks new images, comments, and reactions that reflect the unique attitude of the furry boys around you.

This is a place where pride is visible in every smile, every reaction, and every bold comment.

Some furry boys stand out with fearless confidence.
Others reveal themselves slowly, watching how you play before opening up.
A few enjoy reacting to your choices, turning every win into a shared moment.

As you progress, the furry boys respond directly to your performance: teasing, commenting, and encouraging you to keep going. Your skill, focus, and curiosity shape what you see and who steps closer.

Win minigames, unlock scenes, and discover personalities that shine through confidence, attitude, and unapologetic charm.

Each victory adds a new layer to the experience, making every session feel expressive, rewarding, and full of character.

Fun, bold, and proudly expressive.


Features:

♥ PRIDEFUL FURRY BOYS: A diverse cast of furry boys that celebrate confidence, self expression, and playful charm.

♥ MINIGAMES WITH PERSONALITY: Clear challenges to unlock comments, reactions, and new interactions.

♥ UNLOCKABLE SCENES: Discover images and moments tied to your progress and performance.

♥ MULTIPLE FAVORITES: Different playstyles bring different furry boys into the spotlight.

♥ HIGH REPLAY VALUE: New reactions and outcomes encourage you to return again and again.


Are you ready to play and discover your favorite furry boy?

70010000111487.name: Furry Girls Paradise: Love & Fun
70010000111487.intro:
Cute furry girls, playful challenges, and unexpected reactions.
Ready to discover who’s waiting behind each victory?
70010000111487.description:
Welcome to a colorful world where charming furry girls turn every moment into playful fun.

Furry Girls Paradise mixes casual minigames with a light visual novel experience.

Each stage unlocks new images, cute reactions, and comments that reveal each girl’s unique personality.

Some are shy, some are confident, some are naturally flirty, and all of them express themselves with surprising comments as you play.

Your performance decides what you get to see and how each encounter progresses.

Win minigames, unlock scenes, and enjoy the reactions only these furry girls can give.


Features:

♥ CUTE & PLAYFUL GIRLS: Meet furry girls inspired by sweetness, charm, and colorful personalities.

♥ MINIGAMES & DIALOGUE: Alternate between quick challenges and fun conversations.

♥ UNLOCK SCENES: Discover new images and reactions with every success.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your progress shapes who becomes your favorite.

♥ HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Different outcomes and reactions every time you play.


Fun, charming, a little mischievous.
Are you ready to play?

70010000111493.name: Dive Expedition
70010000111493.intro: Your next great discovery lies just below the surface
70010000111493.description:
Explore sunken ships, submarines, and mysterious underwater ruins filled with hidden treasures and fascinating artifacts.

Take your time as you navigate detailed environments, complete exploration objectives, and collect items scattered across the sea floor. Examine each discovery up close, uncovering the secrets of lost vessels and forgotten places.

Features:
• Explore detailed underwater locations, from shipwrecks to ancient ruins
• Find, collect, and examine a wide range of items and relics
• Complete various exploration objectives
• Enjoy a calm, atmospheric experience with no danger or combat
• Relax with immersive underwater sounds and a selection of 9 atmospheric music tracks

Dive deeper, explore further, and uncover what the ocean hides.

70010000111496.name: Fly for Fly
70010000111496.intro: Be the buzz that no one can ignore!
70010000111496.description:
In Fly for Fly, you control a cheeky little fly that turns a peaceful classroom into total chaos. Your only goal is to make every student lose their patience and survive long enough to see it happen.

Fly over desks and land on notebooks. Dodge furious swats as you push each student’s nerves to the limit. The more you annoy them, the higher their anger meter climbs. But be careful, one well-timed smack could end your buzzing career in an instant!

It’s a simple, hilarious action game where timing and movement are everything. Weave through pencils and papers, outsmart angry hands, and laugh at the chaos you create!

Can you stay in the air long enough to drive everyone crazy?

70010000111502.name: Taito Milestones 4
70010000111502.description:
The 80s were a simpler and more colorful time. Especially in the arcades! With the Taito Milestones 4 collection, you can transport yourself back to the era of hairspray, neon, and pixels, and experience ten games from a variety of genres. Whether you enjoy sports, martial arts, platformers, shoot 'em ups, or even blocks and balls, you’re guaranteed to find something magical here.

WATER SKI
Released: 1983
Control a water skier being pulled by a motorboat while avoiding obstacles. Jump to dodge small obstacles, and hit a jump ramp to earn points! Just beware of the shark...

FIELD DAY 
Released: 1984
This colorful sports festival includes seven unique games, such as three-legged race and tug-of-war. Up to four players can join, with two players competing in each match. Who will be the ultimate victor?

TYPHOON GAL
Released: 1985
Wear down your opponent’s stamina with punches and kicks, then finish them off with big techniques like the shoulder throw or brain buster! It’s a fight for the ages!

ARKANOID
Released: 1986
The classic block-breaking game! Arkanoid is easy to understand yet hard to master. Use the paddle-like craft Vaus to bounce balls, destroy blocks, and defeat the boss DOH! Elegant, simple and totally addictive!

BONZE ADVENTURE
Released: 1988
Yokai time! Two Buddhist priests must fight snakes, giant eyeballs, ghosts, spiders, and more to exorcise the evil from Enma, the king of the underworld. Too scared to go alone? Ask a friend to play with you!

KURI KINTON
Released: 1988
You are the master martial artist Kinton! Kick and punch your way through hordes of thugs to rescue an intelligence officer of the WSPO (World Shadow Police Organisation) and his daughter. Failure is not an option!

SYVALION
Released: 1988
Pilot the golden dragon-shaped mecha Syvalion to thwart Earth’s invasion by a mysterious army. The storyline changes dramatically with each playthrough, featuring over 100 different ending! 

DON DOKO DON
Released: 1989
Join lumberjacks Bob and Jim as they set out to rescue the kidnapped king and princess of Marry Land. Use their trusty mallets to defeat any enemies standing in their way!

CAMELTRY
Released: 1990
Rotate the screen to guide a ball to the goal! Press the shake button to make the ball jump, and hold it to increase rolling speed. Can you get through the mazes in time for a high score?

THE NINJA KIDS
Released: 1990
When a peaceful town of puppets is overrun by a cult seeking to resurrect a demon, four ninja puppets take up the fight. This unique action fest supports up to four players at the same time!

70010000111512.name: Arcade Archives TOUCHDOWN FEVER
70010000111512.intro: Rotate the joystick! Tap the Run button! Touchdown!
70010000111512.description:
"TOUCHDOWN FEVER" is a sports game released by SNK in 1987.
Tap the buttons to push forward—simple controls make it easy to enjoy the flow of American football.
With over a hundred formations selected automatically, even beginners unfamiliar with detailed tactics can relax and enjoy the game.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000111528.name: Who's at the door?
70010000111528.intro: Be careful of the Hallucinations. Is it safe, or is it dangerous? Open the door or take your pill.
70010000111528.description:
You are trapped in a small house, suffering from psychosis with no memory.
Carefully observe your surroundings to distinguish reality from hallucinations, and overcome your illness by taking medication from visitors at the right time.

GAME OVERVIEW :
If the hallucinations don't persist, you're safe. Open the door and get the medication from the visitor.
If the hallucinations remain, take the medicine by the door.
Follow this routine for 8 days, and your condition may begin to improve.

GAME INTRODUCTION :
I am a psychiatric patient.
I don't remember when it started—or even the moment the headaches began.
Hallucinations are nothing new to me. But when they linger and begin to overtake reality, it's a whole different story.
I have to take the medication.
Caught between hallucination and reality— Are you ready to face the truth?

MULTIPLE ENDINGS :
The story doesn't end with just one playthrough.
Replay the game to find hidden doll pieces.
Each piece is a key that brings you closer to the truth.
There are three main endings. 
And when all pieces are collected, the true final ending is unlocked.

70010000111552.name: Dragon Spira
70010000111552.intro: Master the board game with Spirit Beasts in a pixel-art fantasy RPG!
70010000111552.description:
A thousand years ago, the divine created the world and six eggs. The beings born from them, called Spirit Beasts, were entrusted with prosperity but eventually rebelled. Enraged, the divine sealed them away and vanished, leaving behind humanity, the Divine Sword, and the Seed of Hope. Now, fate stirs once more as a new hero rises...

Experience a nostalgic pixel-art RPG packed with classic turn-based battles, a board game-style growth system, and a wide range of customizable jobs. Collect items, unlock powerful Wonder Skills, and raise a Spirit Beast companion that evolves with the story. Spin the roulette, grow stronger, and uncover the truth behind the sealed legends!

70010000111585.name: Kentum
70010000111585.intro: Kickstart Humanity after a 7,000 year Slumber
70010000111585.description:
After a record-breaking nap spanning several millennia, Kent finds himself in the year 10,000 with nothing but a stick and a dry sense of humor. Tired, hungry, and still employed, he will need to explore the unknown to craft the machines that will turn his broken space module into a self-sufficient base of operations. Prepare to craft to survive and automate to thrive.

EXPLORE, SCAN, CATALOGUE
Discover the wonders and the oddities of a vast, ever-changing world filled to the brim with fascinating flora, fauna, and climate events. Classify every animal, plant, and mineral in order to help you survive the passing seasons. Knowledge is your greatest weapon. But don’t try to use knowledge against certain animals, you WILL get eaten.

CRAFT IT TO THE LIMIT
Use every material at your disposal to build your base. Start small by turning bone and wood into coal, machine scraps into sheets of metal, and slowly but surely grow your base into a full-blown resource-generating machine that can rival any factory in the world.

SURVIVE... OR NOT! YOU'LL BE CLONED ANYWAYS
Even though Kent will be revived endlessly, that doesn’t change the fact that dying is a major drag. To not bite the dust constantly, you’ll need to gather and hunt for food, find new recipes, and polish your cooking skills. Building your own farms and vivariums is your ticket to a steady source of nourishment.

BUILD THE HOMEBASE OF YOUR DREAMS
Expand your home base and create an automated system to allow you to streamline and optimize your productions while you are off exploring.

TRAVERSE EXOTIC LOCALES IN STYLE
From vibrant jungles to desolate ruins, traverse post-apocalyptic Earth with your hoverboard, hang glider, grappling hook and more. It is up to you to maneuver with equal parts adventure and efficiency.

70010000111597.name: Delivery of Us
70010000111597.intro: Take flight into a charming puzzle adventure!
70010000111597.description:
In Delivery of Us, you guide a clever carrier pigeon on a mission to deliver every letter across the city’s rooftops. Plan each route carefully, because every move counts. Once the counter hits zero, the delivery fails.

This relaxing logic and movement-based puzzle game combines smooth mechanics, strategic planning, and calm visuals. Each level challenges you to find the most efficient path to every mailbox while avoiding walls, hazards, and obstacles along the way.

Discover different rooftop settings, from cozy neighborhoods to corporate towers, and enjoy the peaceful yet clever atmosphere as you test your reasoning skills.

Features

Solve handcrafted puzzles with limited moves

Plan precise routes across creative rooftop layouts

Deliver every letter before time runs out

Enjoy a relaxing experience with charming visuals and intuitive controls

For players who love clever puzzles, logical challenges, and the simple joy of delivering smiles one letter at a time

70010000111611.name: PICROSS S KONAMI ANTIQUES edition
70010000111611.intro: Collaboration Project Between Picross™ S and KONAMI retro games!
70010000111611.description:
Familiar characters from KONAMI games are making an appearance in the Picross S series for Nintendo Switch™!

More than 80 titles are included!
Characters from a wide range of game genres - from sports to dating sims and beloved game series like Castlevania, Contra, and Gradius - have been turned into pixel art puzzles.

Comes with the usual Picross S series puzzle modes: Picross, Mega Picross, Color Picross, and Clip Picross, as well as an Extra mode that features larger puzzles recreating famous scenes.
The characters will react to controls in Time Attack mode!
Aim to clear all puzzles within a limited time.

The number of puzzles is 150 each for Picross and Mega Picross and 5 for Clip Picross for a total of 200 piece puzzles of 40 each, 30 for Color Picross and 5 for Extra.
Time Attack mode contains 30 carefully chosen Picross puzzles.

The background music of the puzzles can be found in the new Music Player feature.
Enjoy listening to these popular KONAMI tunes at your own leisure.

Picross is a picture crossword puzzle game where you follow hint number to complete a picture.
With simple, easy-to-follow rules, it's a game anyone can play!

70010000111620.name: Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery!
70010000111620.intro: Hunt down a Yokai that cannot tell a lie — using words and Suspicious. A fresh take on a Werewolf-style social deduction adventure.
70010000111620.description:
After you inherit a small apartment from your late father, a mysterious man appears.
“There’s a Yokai hiding among your tenants.”
And that Yokai cannot lie.
From subtle Suspicious at the edges of their words to events that don’t add up,
you’ll tug on every loose thread as your life as a landlord-detective begins.

<Overview>
Play from the landlord’s perspective and identify the Yokai that cannot lie, then present your evidence, persuade them, and evict them in this Werewolf-style social deduction adventure. The story unfolds across multiple chapters. As each chapter passes, the seasons change, and with every eviction new tenants—and new Yokai—move in, reshaping the web of relationships. In every chapter your goal is to deduce who the Yokai is and protect your beloved apartment from them.
 Why do Yokai gather in your building? And what is the true intent of the mysterious man who warned you? Those mysteries lie at the heart of the story for you to uncover.

In a world where connections feel thinner than ever, conversations with your tenants gradually build trust.
Beyond simple puzzle-solving, a quiet, heartwarming tale of growth and understanding awaits you.

<Talking with the Tenants>
At first, no one really trusts the landlord. Take notes on everyday chats, complaints, and idle small talk, and look for Suspicious you can follow up on. Only the Yokai cannot lie—so somewhere, a seam will show.

<Proof and Eviction>
Saying “You’re suspicious” won’t make anyone move out. Gather proof that the other tenants are human and line up your Suspicious clues to box the culprit in with logic until they confess. Evicting a human by mistake only breeds distrust among those who remain — exactly what the Yokai wants.

<Time’s Up>
On the new moon of Week 5, the Yokai reveals its true power.
If you haven’t evicted them by then, there’s nothing a human can do.
Make every day count — observe, follow the Suspicious, deduce, and close in before time runs out.

70010000111628.name: I Hate This Place
70010000111628.intro: Isometric craft-based survival horror with 80’s vibes and comic book flair
70010000111628.description:
Enjoy your stay in the worst place on Earth.

I Hate This Place is an isometric craft-based survival horror game set in a cursed land filled with reality-bending nightmares and terrifying creatures that thrive in the dark. You’ll need to scavenge, build, sneak, and fight if you want to make it out alive.

Classic Craft-Based Survival Horror

Scavenge every corner of Rutherford Ranch to stay alive. From haunted forests, a derelict town, to infested bunkers. Explore a world teeming with danger as you gather vital resources, craft essential gear, upgrade your campsite, and rebuild outposts to have somewhere to hide.

Day Prepares You. Night Hunts You

A dynamic day-night cycle that changes the world. Use daylight wisely to explore, scavenge supplies, craft what you need, and prepare for what’s coming. When night falls, the real nightmares come out to play. More enemies appear, stronger and more aggressive than before. The landscape becomes harder to navigate with just your flashlight. Sometimes your best hope is to find shelter and hunker down till morning.

Deadly Silence Goes A Long Way

Stealth and combat go hand-in-hand here as many of the twisted creatures in Rutherford Ranch hunt and stalk you by sound alone. Brute force will often just land you in an early grave. Use sound to your advantage, luring creatures away from your path or cleverly leading them straight into deadly traps you laid. 

80’s Vibes Meets Comic Book Flair

Inspired by the award-nominated comic book series created by Kyle Starks and Artyom Topilin, I Hate This Place comes to life with bold colors, a punchy retro comic book style, and a heavy dose of '80s flair. A unique blend of horror, dark humor, and just the right touch of camp and gore where unsettling dread meets stylized charm.

70010000111636.name: Easy Delivery Co.
70010000111636.description:
Easy Delivery Co. is a relaxing driving game, with definitely no secrets. You’ve been hired as a delivery driver in a once-lively scenic mountain town now plagued with inhospitable weather. Make deliveries and uncover the story of the town’s not-at-all mysterious residents, all while earning well below minimum wage.

Features:
Earn a "living" by delivering packages with your kei truck

Take in the atmospheric scenery or blitz through (road safety not required)

Buy drastically overpriced gas and get to know the locals

Simple controls and retro graphics

Listen to cool beats while driving

Nothing strange going on, no lore, nothing at all, we promise

70010000111651.name: Bag Fight
70010000111651.description:
This deckbuilding roguelite puts inventory management into the heart of every run. Build a backpack full of weapons, armor, and healing items, carefully arranging your gear to create a setup that can carry you through battle after battle.

Unlock new gear, strengthen your build, and discover better ways to use your limited space as you progress. Merge weapons to create stronger versions, fine-tune your loadout, and adapt your backpack for every challenge ahead.

Features:
- Inventory Management: Move items around to optimize your build!
- Merging: Combine items into stronger versions!
- Unique Characters: Meet a colorful cast of heroes
- Progression: Upgrade your bag and loadout!
- Epic Adventures: Explore diverse fantasy worlds
- Customization: Equip awesome skins for your heroes and items!
- Daily Quests: Log in every day to earn extra resources
- Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn but hard to master!

Your backpack is your build. Make every slot count.

70010000111673.name: Supermarket Gas Station Simulator
70010000111673.intro:
Stock shelves. Fuel cars.
Serve customers and earn profits.
Become the ultimate business owner!
70010000111673.description:
Build and manage your own supermarket and gas station. Stock shelves, refill fuel pumps, serve customers, and grow your business into a thriving roadside destination.

Upgrade your store, unlock new products, hire employees, and improve your services to increase profits. Can you create the ultimate supermarket and gas station empire?

Features:
Manage a supermarket and gas station
Restock products and refill fuel pumps
Upgrade and expand your business
Hire staff and improve efficiency
Unlock new products and equipment
Build your business empire

70010000111679.name: ULTIMATE BATTLE KINGDOM
70010000111679.intro:
Forge Your Legend
Conquer the Arena
Rule the Kingdom
70010000111679.description:
Enter the world of ULTIMATE BATTLE KINGDOM, a fast-paced 3D action battler where warriors clash for glory, power, and control of the realm. Step into epic arenas filled with danger, strategy, and nonstop combat as you fight to prove yourself as the true ruler of the kingdom.

Choose your champion, master powerful attacks, and outplay your enemies using skill, timing, and smart positioning. Every battle is a test of reflexes and tactics, whether you're facing fierce AI opponents or challenging friends in local multiplayer showdowns.

Unlock new fighters, upgrade abilities, and explore dynamic battlefields inspired by medieval fantasy worlds. From towering castles to open battlegrounds, each arena offers unique paths, hazards, and opportunities for victory.

Only the strongest will rise. Only one will rule.

70010000111685.name: Au Revoir
70010000111685.intro: The year is 2071. As Tristan, you have to uncover secrets and solve puzzles to recover human consciousnesses in this neon-noir world with a low poly aesthetic inspired by the 90s.
70010000111685.description:
AU REVOIR - 2071

In a future where immortality is a privilege of the wealthy, Au Revoir Ltd. dominates the market with synthetic brains capable of storing human consciousness. Sentinels are tasked with locating these minds and carrying out the recovery and transfer process into new bodies.

Explore interactive environments, collect documents and clues, solve unique puzzles, and make decisions that influence the course of the story. Use your car to navigate different areas and interact with characters who hide more than they reveal.

ENGAGING NARRATIVE

Experience a rich and complex story where the narrative unfolds with depth, filled with twists and moral dilemmas that challenge your view of the world and of the protagonist.

IMMERSIVE SETTING

Explore a carefully crafted futuristic world with detailed environments and striking visual design. The neon-noir atmosphere blends vibrant colors with a dense mood, creating a deeply immersive cyberpunk setting.

DEEP CHARACTERS

Interact with a variety of characters, each with their own personality, motivations, and hidden secrets. Conversations reveal crucial details and open up different paths, adding weight to every encounter and multiple ways to interpret what’s truly happening.

INVESTIGATIVE CHALLENGES

Face puzzles that require logic, observation, and attention to detail. Gather clues, connect information, and solve narrative-driven challenges. Each solved mystery brings you closer to the truth — or to new questions to uncover.

Prepare for an unforgettable journey in Au Revoir, where every decision can alter the fate of the world.

70010000111715.name: Rival Stars Horse Racing
70010000111715.intro: Take the reins and become an equestrian legend!
70010000111715.description:
Handed the keys to a rundown ranch, it’s up to you to restore your family’s legacy and become an equestrian legend! With the help of a host of colorful characters, you’ll raise charming foals, manage your dream stable of horses, and bring the ranch back to its former glory.

Ride your way — take the reins to feel the thrill and thunder on the racecourse, hone your jumping skills on the Cross Country course, explore the ranch with your horses, and so much more.

RACE AND RIDE TO VICTORY
• Feel all the excitement of the racecourse with realistic, motion-captured animations and dynamic race commentary.
• Race in story mode or online multiplayer in locations inspired by famous race tracks from around the globe.
• Put your jumping skills to the test in Cross Country.

ENJOY THE EQUESTRIAN LIFESTYLE
• Relax and explore gorgeous open locations with your horses, from the ranch to the scenic Swiss Alps.
• Capture stunning images of your horses with the feature-packed Photo Mode.
• Earn and manage resources to upgrade your homestead.

BREED YOUR DREAM HORSES
• Breed adorable foals with unique coats and patterns.
• Craft a legendary lineage with the in-depth genetic breeding system.
• Design your perfect horse with the Horse Creator.

70010000111730.name: Technotopia
70010000111730.intro: Welcome to Technotopia, a city-builder card game.
70010000111730.description: Social and economic conflicts have rocked the world. There is just one metropolis that can boast stability, but even this city only has enough resources to maintain a precarious balance of power. The authorities decided to create an algorithm that could build a perfect city for all segments of the population. This project gave birth to Iris, an artificial intelligence designed for building a utopia. Welcome to Technotopia! Build a perfect city You will have a deck of cards with buildings at your disposal. Build skyscrapers, parks, residential districts and transport highways. It's up to you to decide what the ideal metropolis should look like. Maintain the delicate balance Four factions are fighting for control of the city: capitalists, aristocrats, politicians, and the common people. They will do anything to bend the others to their will, and every decision you make tips the scales. Play the role of arbiter, meeting everyone's needs equally. Meet public needs A city is a living organism, where something is always happening that requires your attention. Where do you put up fire victims? What do you do with the gang that has taken control of some districts? Factions will offer their solutions, but it's up to you whether to follow them or advance your own agenda. Form new connections The city is home to a variety of characters. Hackers, oligarchs, criminals and inventors — communicate with the cream of the crop and provide them with services in exchange for their help in maintaining order. A perfect city is built for people, with the help of people!

70010000111736.name: Sneaky All-Nighter 2
70010000111736.intro:
It's time for another sneaky all-nighter!
Play to your heart's content in all-new situations—just don't get caught!
70010000111736.description:
The exciting battle to stay up late returns!
Enjoy the simple yet satisfying thrills of pulling an all-nighter!
With a Joy-Con™ controller for each player, up to six players can join in the fun!
Time your moves carefully and rack up points without getting caught!

[Time Attack]
Compete for the fastest clear time and earn a top spot on the leaderboards!
Read the movements of the patrolling characters and find the right time to play!

[Battle]
Compete against friends or CPU-controlled opponents for the highest score!
Be bold and take risks to rack up the most points and win the game!

70010000111765.name: Timo Boll Beats
70010000111765.intro: Feel the beat. Hit the ball.
70010000111765.description:
A table tennis legend meets a rhythm game! Hit every ball precisely in time, keep to the beat and let the rhythm guide your shots. Master Timo Boll's legendary techniques, challenge charismatic rivals in urban locations and create perfect combos. Every shot counts – your sense of rhythm will be crucial!

• 77 songs, 7 genres – pop, hip-hop/RnB, rock, electro, chill-out, country and kids' music
• Professional moves from Timo Boll – train with a world-class player
• Reflexes and timing – focus and stay sharp 
• Combos and hiscores – play a perfect series of shots
• Stylish arenas – industrial areas, train stations and many more

70010000111776.name: Unholy Adventure: Mystery
70010000111776.intro: In the world of point and click adventure games, Unholy Adventure: Mystery will offer you a distinctive experience of story-rich adventure with a hint of surrealism.
70010000111776.description:
If you like point and click adventure puzzle mystery games and narrative games with story mode - you've come to the right place.

Unholy Adventure: Mystery is a point and click adventure game with hundreds of storyline puzzles.

Each of our adventure point and click narrative story games is packed with mystery and secret stories.

STORY:
Point-and-click adventure games 2020 had a lot to offer, but Unholy Adventure: Mystery will charm you with its story. We love choice-based narrative games, and in Unholy Adventure: Mystery, we had put focus on creating classic point and click adventure with a dark riddle of the gloomy neighborhood.
If you like mystery stories, meet Peter Grim, the main character of Unholy Adventure: Mystery – story based point and click adventure game.

Who kidnapped Peter’s wife? What is this strange storm about? Why did giant rats take over the city? You will discover these secrets in our free story mode adventure game.

Embark on a dangerous adventure full of secret stories and puzzles, to save Peter's wife, in a surreal world full of retro atmosphere and unforgettable characters. Trust us – this story based point and click adventure will be remembered for a long time. It’s not just another hidden objects game for free or some creepypasta games.

KEY FEATURES: 
- point and click gameplay with puzzles
- storyline full of hidden objects 
- story rich narrative 
- mysterious, gloomy atmosphere

70010000111784.name: Adventure Reborn
70010000111784.intro: Adventure Reborn is a deeply moving adventure game where you make decisions that influence the story of a loving family!
70010000111784.description:
A little girl with a big heart goes on a mysterious journey through dangerous lands ruled by a ruthless cult. Make choices that will help her save her parents. You decide what happens in the story!

In Adventure Reborn the story depends on your choices. It’s a magical tale about the power of love overcoming the evil. Become a part of it, help Hope solve all the puzzles and save her parents. This family’s fate is in your hands!

Why are you going to love Adventure Reborn:
- A touching story about the power of love
- Your choices influence the story
- An adventure full of twists and surprises
- The characters’ fates depend on your decisions
- A story of a family that risks it all to be together

70010000111795.name: Let's Sing 2027
70010000111795.intro: Sing your heart out with your friends on your favorite songs in our 1 to 4 players karaoke game.
70010000111795.description:
