Grab the mic—or your smartphone—and get ready to shine! Let’s Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics from around the world. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable duets and group performances.  

Featuring songs with their original music videos, adjustable vocal guide settings, and easy-to-use smartphone and mic support, Let’s Sing 2027 makes singing accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable. Whether you’re hosting a party or chasing your best score, it’s your turn to take center stage!

This year, step into Soundtown in an all-new Party mode—a lively musical adventure where you’ll face off against DJ Hush and bring the beat back to the city. With improved visuals, fresh avatars, and customizable rewards, every performance feels like a moment in the spotlight.

Featuring 35 chart-topping songs there's something for everyone—from modern hits to timeless classics.
* Chappell Roan – The Subway
* Lady Gaga, Bruno Mars – Die With A Smile
* Alex Warren – Ordinary 
* Drake – God's Plan 
* Ariana Grande – we can't be friends (wait for your love)
* Sabrina Carpenter – Espresso 
* Ed Sheeran – Azizam 
... And many more!

This product is not sold on its own.

70010000111797.name: ZPF
70010000111797.description: ZPF is a retro-inspired horizontal shooter for the Sega Genesis/Mega Drive. Blast your way through a cosmic gauntlet of epic boss battles, addictive scoring, and hidden secrets in a thrilling arcade-style adventure through fantasy, sci-fi, and alien-themed worlds.

70010000111805.name: Broken Sword - Shadow of the Templars: Reforged - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000111805.intro: Dive into a brilliant story, beautifully told...
70010000111805.description: Step out onto the streets of Paris in "Broken Sword - Shadow of the Templars: Reforged", an extensively enhanced version of the multi-award winning, all-time classic game. Enjoy a globe-spanning story when intrepid tourist George Stobbart and fearless journalist Nico Collard are pitched into a gripping adventure, exploring exotic locations, solving ancient mysteries, and thwarting dark conspiracies to discover the arcane secrets of the Knights Templar.

70010000111807.name: GRIDbeat!
70010000111807.description:
Welcome to GRIDbeat!

A rhythm-fueled cyber-dungeon crawler where every move must match the music or risk total system shutdown.

You just breached Knoss.OS, the planet’s most fortified corporate network, and made off with a payload of priceless data. Now you’re trapped inside, hunted by rogue security protocols and hostile malware. Your only way out? Sync with the system. Move to the beat. And escape before the grid locks you down for good.

FEATURES

* Beat-Based Dungeon Crawling
In GRIDbeat!, movement, combat, and interaction all happen on the beat. Every level is a tactical challenge where rhythm equals survival.
* Pulse-Pounding Maze Exploration
As you navigate the data labyrinths, keep an eye out for all manner of hazards, including Server Formats that can wipe a level clean.
* Evolving Abilities & Power-Ups
Install powerful software tools to help you overcome system threats, uncover secrets and solve challenges.
* Cyber.Mind Boss Battles
Defeat powerful AI gatekeepers in intense beat-based battles to continue your journey and reach the final exit port out of the Mainframe.
* Step into the Rhythm! 
GRIDbeat’s electrifying soundtrack pulls you into the action, where every move, ability, and attack pulses to the beat. Sync your gameplay with the music and let the soundtrack guide your every step through the grid!

70010000111811.name: ZenWash
70010000111811.intro:
Wash away the dirt in a calm and relaxing way, surrounded by soothing nature sounds and the gentle flow of a nearby river.
Unlock new upgrades and take on larger houses to clean.
70010000111811.description:
Keep everything spotless with your high-pressure washer — no rush, no stress, just pure peace of mind.

As you progress, you’ll unlock valuable upgrades and take on larger, more satisfying homes to clean, making every step of your journey feel even more rewarding.

Enjoy a unique, original soundtrack designed to enhance your Zen experience.

Be ZenWash.

70010000111817.name: Opus Magnum: Complete Edition
70010000111817.description:
“Without a doubt one of the best puzzle games I’ve ever played.”
IGN

“One of the very best puzzle games of the year, if not the decade.”
PC Gamer 

Opus Magnum: Complete Edition is the latest open-ended puzzle game from Zachtronics, the creators of SpaceChem, Infinifactory, TIS-100, and SHENZHEN I/O. Includes both Opus Magnum and the brand-new De Re Metallica expansion.

Master the intricate, physical machinery of the transmutation engine— the alchemical engineer’s most advanced tool— and use it to create vital remedies, precious gemstones, deadly weapons, and more.

Hailed as the most promising alchemist of his generation, Anataeus Vaya has just accepted a position as Head Alchemist of House Van Tassen, the oldest and richest of the city’s ancient Houses. But dangers lurk behind the family’s opulent facade, and alchemy alone may not solve every problem.


Design Machines - Design and build machines that carry out alchemical processes using a variety of components including programmable arms, customizable tracks, and more esoteric devices like Van Berlo’s wheel and the Glyph of Animismus.

Open-Ended Puzzles - Compete against your friends and the world to build the simplest, fastest, and most compact solutions to the game’s challenges. 

Rich Story - Intrigues and dark plots swirl around the city’s ancient Houses. Alchemists, who hold the power to create almost anything known to science, are highly sought— and highly dangerous.

Solitaire Minigame - Alchemical engineering takes focus and concentration. Take a break with Sigmar’s Garden, an original alchemy-based solitaire game. Every game is winnable, but not every game will be won…
De Re Metallica – An expansive prequel to Opus Magnum that includes 3 new glyphs, 17 new puzzles, and a new solitaire variant called “House Colvan.”

70010000111820.name: M.A.U.S
70010000111820.intro: A quick, sci-fi adventure inspired by classic 16-bit and 8-bit retro platform games.
70010000111820.description:
With his children away on the moon, there is no time to relax for Dr. Cavor. Once again, Victoria is under attack. The aging but brilliant scientist begins research on a new means of defense. After much work, he finds success with Mechanized Assault Unity 19 -- M.A.U.S. 

There's no time to spare as MAUS must defeat a mysterious robotic horde that lurks on the outskirts of town. With a blaster gun on her arm and the ability to upgrade on the fly, MAUS will travel to outer space, ancient ruins, and an old forest to defeat her enemies.

It is a quick, sci-fi adventure inspired by classic 16-bit and 8-bit retro platform games.

70010000111825.name: Musician Simulator
70010000111825.intro: Make your career as a musician. Start as a street singer, become DJ in local pub, organize concert at a local hall, play at a largest music festival in your country.
70010000111825.description:
Game Features:
11 musical instruments to play on, on some you play music note by note, sound by sound, by clicking on string of guitar/piano key/ bashing drum sticks on drums or your hands on jambe, Musical Instruments have both prerecorded ready 5-10 chords of songs for you to play that you trigger by moving hand or clicking on piano keys or classic mode note by note where you play on instrument by clicking on string/piano key note by note triggering abcdefg major/minor and make your own song.
Guitar, Thrombone, Piano, Jambe, Violin, Harphe, Ukulele, Chimes, Drums, DJ Set

Each event lasts 5 minutes and then you come back to city map
You make your own live music playing on musical instruments using drum sticks, hand etc. note by note, sound by sound.
11 different locations unlocked based on followers: Rave Party, Luna Club, JazzManClub, ExtraPub, Press, Hiring Agency for musicians, Festival Organizer, Concert Hall, Street Singing, Music Publisher
Create your own band by hiring other musicians
Gain followers to unlock other locations, events, musicians
Followers gain is calculated based on audience fun during event
When you gain enough followers you become a worldwide-known musician, and you will see what happens then
Meet with publisher and get to top of band charts on contest with other bands
See progress of local music industry, with you in it in local press release

70010000111840.name: Find Difference
70010000111840.intro:
Two pictures
One challenge
Can you find it?
70010000111840.description:
Find Difference is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where every scene hides carefully crafted changes. Look closely, think fast and discover every difference before time runs out!

Features:
• Enjoy dozens of beautifully illustrated levels
• Spot the differences between two pictures
• Relax with simple and intuitive controls
• Unlock new scenes as you progress
• Suitable for all ages — perfect for quick play sessions

Challenge your eyes sharpen your focus and see how many differences you can find!

Are you ready to spot them all?

70010000111846.name: Stunt Car Extreme Simulator
70010000111846.intro:
Drive the Limits
Defy Gravity
Conquer Every Track
70010000111846.description:
Stunt Car Extreme Simulator throws you behind the wheel of powerful vehicles and challenges you to conquer extreme tracks filled with steep climbs, dangerous drops, and tricky obstacles. Test your driving skills with realistic physics as you balance your car, control your speed, and perform daring stunts to reach the finish line.

Race against the clock to earn stars and rewards, then use them to unlock and upgrade a variety of vehicles — from rugged off-road trucks to high-performance stunt cars. Each level offers unique environments and increasingly difficult challenges that keep the gameplay fresh and exciting.

Choose your preferred control style and master every turn, jump, and climb as you push your limits across wild landscapes and adrenaline-packed courses.

Stunt Car Extreme Simulator is the perfect game for players who love thrilling races, extreme stunts, and the freedom to drive their own way.

70010000111858.name: SCAVENGER HUNT Find Hidden Objects
70010000111858.intro:
Search. Spot. Discover.
Explore beautiful scenes and find hidden objects.
Train your brain and master every scavenger hunt.
70010000111858.description:
Explore detailed scenes and test your observation skills in this relaxing hidden object adventure.
Search every corner, zoom in to spot tiny clues, and discover cleverly hidden items across colorful environments. From cozy interiors to lively outdoor locations, each level offers a new scavenger hunt challenge.
Perfect for fans of puzzle games and brain teasers, this search-and-find experience starts easy and becomes more challenging as you progress.

• Beautiful, detailed scenes
• Smooth and intuitive controls
• Increasing difficulty
• Fun for all ages

Sharpen your focus. Train your brain.
Can you find them all?

70010000111864.name: Escape From DUCKNESS
70010000111864.intro:
Strategic combat meets chaotic feathered warfare.
Build your loadout, adapt your tactics, dominate the raid.
Escape the DUCKNESS before it consumes you.
70010000111864.description:
A hardcore tactical extraction shooter where survival is everything.

Enter a dangerous warzone inspired by intense extraction-based FPS gameplay. In Escape From DUCKNESS, every raid is high risk and high reward. Fight armed enemies, secure valuable loot, and extract before you lose it all.

This is not an arcade shooter. This is tactical survival.

Plan your loadout carefully. Choose the right weapons, armor, and equipment for each mission. Every bullet matters. Every sound can reveal your position. Smart movement, positioning, and timing are the keys to survival.

Key Features

• Hardcore extraction shooter gameplay
• Tactical FPS combat with realistic gunplay
• High-risk raids with permanent loot loss
• Weapon customization and strategic loadouts
• Intense PvE firefights
• Immersive survival mechanics
• Loot, extract, upgrade, repeat

Explore hostile maps filled with ambush points, hidden gear, and unpredictable threats. Engage in close-quarters battles or long-range tactical encounters. Adapt your strategy every raid.

If you die, you lose your gear.
If you extract, you grow stronger.

Designed for players who enjoy realistic shooters, survival combat, and high-tension gameplay, Escape From DUCKNESS delivers adrenaline-filled missions where every decision counts.

Gear up. Enter the raid. Secure the loot. Escape alive.

70010000111870.name: Farming Supermarket Simulator
70010000111870.intro:
Grow it. Stock it. Sell it.
Experience the full journey from farm to supermarket.
A relaxing and realistic farming supermarket simulator.
70010000111870.description:
Build your dream farm and manage your very own supermarket in Farming Supermarket Simulator — a relaxing and immersive experience where you control every step of the journey from soil to shelf.

Start by growing a variety of fresh crops on your farm. Plant seeds, water your fields, harvest produce, and expand your agricultural operations as you improve your efficiency and unlock new products. Careful planning and smart time management will help you create a steady flow of goods ready for sale.

Once harvested, transport your products to your supermarket and take full control of store operations. Stock shelves, organize displays, set prices, and keep customers happy with clean aisles and well-managed inventory. The better you run your store, the more customers you attract.

Balance farming and retail management as you reinvest profits into upgrading equipment, expanding farmland, and improving your supermarket layout. Optimize your workflow, reduce waste, and make strategic decisions to keep both your farm and store running smoothly.

With satisfying progression, accessible controls, and a calming gameplay loop, Farming Supermarket Simulator offers a complete farm-to-market simulation designed for players who enjoy management, organization, and steady growth.

Features:
• Grow and harvest a variety of crops
• Manage your own fully functional supermarket
• Stock shelves and organize product displays
• Set prices and monitor sales performance
• Upgrade your farm and store equipment
• Expand your land and retail space
• Relaxing gameplay with rewarding progression

Plant, harvest, stock, and sell — experience the full cycle of running a farming supermarket, all in one engaging simulator.

70010000111876.name: Moto Racer Highway Traffic
70010000111876.intro:
Hit the highway and race through traffic.
Avoid vehicles and upgrade your motorcycles.
Test your reflexes and become the best highway rider.
70010000111876.description:
Moto Racer Highway Traffic

Start your engine and hit the highway in Moto Racer Highway Traffic, a thrilling motorcycle racing experience where speed, precision, and reflexes are the key to victory.

Ride powerful motorbikes through busy highways packed with traffic. Dodge cars and trucks, perform daring overtakes, and push your bike to extreme speeds as you race through detailed environments. The faster and closer you pass other vehicles, the higher your score will climb.

Take on exciting missions, unlock new bikes, and upgrade your ride to become the ultimate highway racer. Each motorcycle has unique handling and performance, giving you new ways to master the road and improve your skills.

Experience the sensation of high-speed riding with immersive visuals, dynamic day and night environments, and smooth arcade-style controls that keep the action fast and fun. The game challenges players to weave through traffic and complete objectives while maintaining top speed on endless highways.

Whether you're chasing high scores, completing missions, or simply enjoying the thrill of riding through traffic, Moto Racer Highway Traffic delivers nonstop motorcycle racing excitement.

Features

High-speed motorcycle racing through busy highway traffic
Multiple motorbikes to unlock and upgrade
Challenging missions and progression system
Dynamic environments with different times of day
Fast arcade gameplay with smooth controls
Score bonuses for risky overtakes and high speeds

Jump on your bike, test your reflexes, and prove you have what it takes to dominate the highway.

70010000111886.name: Flag Trivia Quiz: Four Choices!
70010000111886.intro:
Which country does this flag belong to?
Look, choose, and remember! A quiz game that lets you explore the world while having fun.
70010000111886.description:
Flag Trivia Quiz – Fun for both adults and kids! Brain-training with Flags × Knowledge"" 
is a “look and learn” four-choice quiz game themed around the flags of the world.

Look at the flag and guess the correct country from four options!  
When you answer correctly, fun facts and trivia about that country appear,  
so you naturally learn about the world while playing.

“Similar, but what’s the difference?” “What does this color mean?”  
Filled with discoveries that fascinate both adults and children!  
Perfect for family knowledge battles or streaming fun.

A quiz app that combines intuition, memory, and learning — the ultimate brain-training experience.

70010000111892.name: Direction Quad
70010000111892.intro: Hop your way through the dangerous swamps as you face the trials of your master the Wise Toad!
70010000111892.description:
Direction Quad is a 2D action-adventure presented in top-down pixel art style. Take the role of young Quad as he hops through the swamp in any diagonal direction, collecting coins and bugs along the way. The objective is to get Quad from his starting lily pad to the finish line of each stage without colliding with the terrain or any treacherous traps.

As you advance, the mazelike levels get more complex! Use bumpers to ricochet along the best lines, hit switches to open new paths and keep Quad from kicking the bucket! Replay stages as many times as it takes, but beware, there is greater danger lurking in the swamp than even the Wize Toad may realize!

• Master a gauntlet of unique stages.
• Take the role of a young frog and hop in top-down puzzle action.
• Avoid traps and enemies as you race for the finish line.
• Retry levels as many times as it takes.
• Enjoy retro pixel art aesthetics and old-school challenge.

70010000111898.name: Hextreme Void
70010000111898.intro: Strategically power up to clear the field as efficiently as possible in a brick breaker about quick thinking!
70010000111898.description:
Are you ready for a brick breaker with a twist? In Hextreme Void, you can’t lose! Instead of lives or game overs, the challenge comes from progression and optimization in order to complete all levels within a certain time limit. Each playthrough takes you through one of five distinct Voids, with 50 levels per Void. Stages are presented in high-def 2D style with hexagonal bricks arranged in increasingly complex patterns. Your ball moves automatically, but it’s up to you to decide how released powerups are used.

As you advance, you’ll earn experience and choose between various buffs that can enhance ball stats, increase your time limit, multiply coin output and more! Every run feels unique thanks to random upgrade paths and temporary powerups that appear. During runs, collect coins to unlock permanent upgrades, letting you grow stronger and tackle harder Voids with new strategies the more you play!

• Battle across the Void by optimizing the movement of your automated ball!
• Choose from a huge variety of upgrades during gameplay to clear the field faster.
• Master 250 stages across 5 uniquely themed worlds!
• Collect coins to spend on permanent upgrades.
• Enjoy colorful HD presentation and practically limitless replay value!

70010000111905.name: EGGCONSOLE EGGY PC-8801
70010000111905.intro: An action game set on the planet Eggy, depicting the battle between Earth and Gusp. Control the body armor Ena to collect supplies flying in from above!
70010000111905.description:
Released by Bothtec in 1985, EGGY is an action game that won the Excellence Award at the "1st Bothtec Program Contest," depicting the battle between Earth and Gasp on Eggy. While an action title, it's not a frantic shooter; players control Ena to retrieve falling supplies. 

Due to quirky design—weapons being ground-attack only, mandatory crouching before flight, and a unique floating movement—avoiding enemy attacks is key. The 20-stage game is cleared when enough supplies drop. Novice players may prioritize survival (clearing without collecting), while experienced players can aim for a high score by collecting them.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000111923.name: Sp(L/R)ite
70010000111923.intro: Together, you’ll unravel the secrets of this surreal space in this adventure game. Which door will you choose—and where will it lead?
70010000111923.description:
Sp(L/R)ite is an adventure game where you must escape a series of mysterious floating rooms in another dimension.

Uncover the secrets hidden within each room as you collaborate with an unnervingly energetic goddess and a neighbor you can only speak to through the wall.

What lies beyond the final door? That’s for you to decide.

Sp(L/R)ite unfolds within a locked, crumbling house—an isolated, otherworldly space born from an unforeseen tangling of the “threads of fate” spun by Akrida.

To move from one room to the next, you’ll need to gather scattered items and piece together a mysterious picture—the key to your escape—guided by clues from Jean and Akrida.

With each image you complete, Jean’s and your lost memories begin to surface, slowly revealing your intertwined pasts and drawing you closer to the story’s end.

What future lies ahead for you two? That depends on the choices you make.

70010000111936.name: Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG
70010000111936.intro: Survive the dangers of the prehistoric era and rise through evolution.
70010000111936.description:
Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG places you in the heart of an ancient world ruled by colossal beasts and the struggle to survive. Live the life of legendary dinosaurs—from swift predators to towering giants—on a journey of transformation, danger, and adaptation. Explore hostile habitats, face unpredictable challenges, and grow stronger to endure the unforgiving prehistoric era.

Key Features:
-Captivating evolutionary progression: Experience the life paths of multiple dinosaur species, each with unique behaviors and survival traits.
-Diverse and dangerous environments: Traverse contrasting regions—forests, dry plains, waterfalls, and volcanic zones—each with its own natural challenges.
-Growth and customization: Upgrade your dinosaur’s essential abilities and adapt to overcome the brutal wilderness.
-Varied challenges: Complete missions focused on hunting, survival, and territorial dominance, constantly testing your instincts.

Step into a world where nature makes the rules and only the adapted endure.
Prove you have what it takes to become the most feared dinosaur of the prehistoric age.

70010000111952.name: TetroMosaic, UnicorN
70010000111952.intro: TetroMosaic is a challenge that combines tetromino pieces to form, step by step, a vibrant mosaic full of textures and colors.
70010000111952.description:
Shoot and align blocks perfectly to unlock the secret and spectacular illustrations.
Play at your own pace: pause each block to place it precisely or shoot them quickly to chain combos, fill the bar, and earn stars.

Test your ingenuity and train your mind!

Boost your working memory by retaining shapes and patterns while creating impressive mosaics.

Enhance your ability to understand positions, proportions, and relationships between objects.

Develop problem-solving skills and adapt to new challenges.

Train your careful observation of colors, edges, and textures to fit each block together correctly.

Features:
 - Difficulty: 7 to 10 mosaic lines.
 - Immerse yourself in the full-screen gallery and enjoy all the unlocked illustrations.
 - CO-OP and VS modes to challenge friends and family. Will you be the fastest?

70010000111954.name: YellowPips, wild west apocalyptic
70010000111954.intro: Wild West. Rotten gold. Fight to survive.
70010000111954.description:
YellowPips throws you straight into the heart of the Wild West. Build an impressive town with services like a barber shop, hotel, bank, armory, and a grand saloon, among many others. Gather and manage resources — wood, coal, gold, and tools — to kickstart the local economy and watch your community grow.

Build a working farm to harvest food for the population and boost trade. It’s also crucial to build the train station: the railroad will ensure a steady flow of tools and materials essential for the town’s expansion.

So far, so good, right? Far from it… a real disaster was about to hit. Spoiler: deep in one of the mine’s lower shafts a gas bag ruptured — a putrid vapor that instantly infected a miner who already smelled worse than a wet dog.

The town “doctor” (who was actually the barber, the vet, and the gravedigger) examined him and pronounced, “Aside from never having seen soap in years, it was sudden death.” Big mistake. The next day, the walking corpse had vanished.

It was the ‘Outlaw Rot’ virus, spread by frantic bites, and in no time the Wild West had become an apocalypse known as Canyon Wasting.

Your mission: rebuild the settlement against all odds and defend it from those infected hordes and zombie bosses, with more bite than a cowboy denied his chaw. Do you dare?

Note: Exciting, right? Survive this farce called “Adventure” and you’ll unlock Arcade mode: a 'perfect run' where you’ll skate through blood puddles, wipe out zombies and super‑zombies in one fell swoop… or you’ll end up moving into your own coffin.

70010000111971.name: Mom Life Simulator
70010000111971.intro: Conquer chaos, unlock upgrades, and rule the family empire.
70010000111971.description:
Welcome to the daily life of the most caring — yet incredibly busy — mom! In this game, you take on the role of a mother who tries to manage it all: caring for her family, keeping the house cozy, and still finding a little time for herself.

Each day is filled with countless tasks, but a mom’s life isn’t only about responsibilities — she can also dedicate time to her hobbies to relax and recharge. Everything depends on how well you plan your day and whether you can complete everything on time.

Features:
- Life as a mom: Step into the shoes of a woman who carries the responsibility of her home, her family, and even her pet. Every day brings new challenges and surprises.
- Two children with different needs: Look after your school-aged child, help him get ready for class, and take care of the baby to make sure he’s always happy and comfortable.
- Household chores: Cleaning, laundry, and cooking — familiar but essential tasks that require attention and speed. The faster you complete them, the more time you’ll have for other activities.
- Pet care: Your little dog needs affection, playtime, and care — otherwise, it will become sad and lonely.
- Time for yourself: Even with a packed schedule, mom can make time for her hobby — helping her rest and maintain a balance between family duties and personal life.
- Balance & time management: The main challenge is to stay on top of everything, managing your energy and time so no one in the family feels left behind.

Are you ready to take on the challenge and create the perfect daily balance?

70010000111977.name: Just a Little Purr Suit
70010000111977.intro: The birds won’t stop making noise… it’s time to scare them away!
70010000111977.description:
In Just a Little Purr_suit, guide a clever kitten in a turn-based strategy puzzle with 65 handcrafted levels. Use cards to decide every move: advance, launch the kitten with cannons, bounce on trampolines, cross mysterious portals, and even create new platforms to overcome challenges.

With no time limit, every move is a chance to find creative solutions. Explore environments full of tricks, use boosters and totems to your advantage, and discover the best path to the bird to finally scare it away.

A fun, colorful, and addictive adventure for the whole family!

70010000111990.name: Retro Motel Simulator
70010000111990.intro: Every room tells a story — craft your perfect retro vibe.
70010000111990.description:
Retro Motel Simulator invites you on a nostalgic journey to the golden age of roadside America. Step into the sizzling 1960s and build your own dream motel — a place where pastel walls, chrome furniture, and glowing neon signs tell stories of freedom, style, and ambition.

Start small on a dusty desert highway and work your way up to a five-star retro paradise. Repaint faded walls, decorate rooms with authentic mid-century charm, and make every guest feel at home under the warm buzz of neon lights. From hands-on cleaning and maintenance to full creative control over décor and pricing, every decision shapes your success.

Wander freely in first-person through vintage halls, listen to the hum of jukebox tunes, and watch your guests unwind, dance, and live out their 60s dreams. Feel every brushstroke, sweep, and hammer strike through immersive controller feedback that brings your motel to life.

Key Features:
• Authentic 1960s Atmosphere: Experience the warmth, charm, and style of mid-century America with stunning period décor and lighting.
• Creative Freedom: Design and personalize every room — choose colors, furniture, and decorations to craft the perfect vintage vibe.
• Guest Management: Rent out rooms, set prices, and keep your guests satisfied to boost reputation and profits.
• Hands-On Gameplay: Clean, repair, and maintain your motel to keep ratings high and customers coming back.
• Dynamic Progression: Expand your property, unlock new design options, and turn your roadside stop into a legendary landmark.
• Live 60s Orchestra: Watch your guests dance the night away to live performances of classic tunes.
• Immersive Feedback: Feel every action — from sweeping floors to tuning lamps — with realistic vibration responses.

Welcome to the era where hospitality met style — your Retro Motel is open for business.

70010000112006.name: Micro Overdrive: Home Tour
70010000112006.intro: Tiny cars. Giant tracks. Big arcade racing fun!
70010000112006.description:
Race tiny vehicles across oversized household tracks in Micro Overdrive: Home Tour, a fast and colorful arcade racing game inspired by classic top-down racers.

Compete through the Home Tour solo mode, unlock new cups and drivers, and master unpredictable tracks filled with playful hazards, sharp turns, and surprising twists.

Play solo or challenge friends in local Cup Mode for up to 4 players. Choose your driver, pick your difficulty, and enjoy quick, chaotic races built for couch competition.

Features:
- Home Tour solo progression
- Local multiplayer for up to 4 players
- Unlockable drivers and cups
- 6 themed championships
- 10 unique drivers
- Responsive controls
- Classic top-down arcade racing

70010000112025.name: Hypno Halo
70010000112025.intro: Hypno Halo is a minimalist score attack game.
70010000112025.description:
There’s only one shape that’s perfect, eternal, and completely unbothered: the halo.

FEATURES
• Tackle 300+ handcrafted levels and 51 bonus challenges across 6 difficulties
• Immerse yourself in 90+ minutes of electronic and techno music
• Share controls with friends for co-op chaos
• Discover secret endings and hidden surprises
• Full touch screen support

MUSIC BY
• Damiano Baldoni
• Rik4k
• Zane Little

70010000112032.name: Too Many Santas!
70010000112032.intro: A Christmas wish come true, or a holiday nightmare?
70010000112032.description:
The Santa Claus dating sim you can play all year round!

You don't know what's worse: your love life or your toy store's sales reports. Desperate for some yuletide loving (and some new customers!), you make a wish on a Christmas Star.

That's when your store is visited by not one, not two, but SIX Santa Clauses. Sexy Santa, Saintly Santa, Sleepy Santa, Sassy Santa, Sad Santa, Secret Santa... it's simply TOO MANY SANTAS! Can you watch all of them and run the store at the same time? Or will you be caught up in the sweet Santa romance?

Too Many Santas! The short visual novel where YOU get to date Santa Claus! And Santa Claus, and Santa Claus, and Santa Claus...

Features:
* Six Santa Clauses to date, with 12 naughty and nice endings to unlock!
* A customizable main character - choose any name and any pronouns you want!
* Over 250 original photographs, bringing the characters and scenery to life
* Lots and lots of Christmas music! Too much Christmas music!
* Short and sweet, so it won't take all season to complete!
* From the creators of Cat President, The Pizza Delivery Boy Who Saved the World, and other fine weird visual novels.

70010000112035.name: Homicipher
70010000112035.intro:
Decipher the words of the horror men and aim for escape
Decipher words ・Escape from horror ・ADV
70010000112035.description:
Homicipher, the language-deciphering x exploration adventure game in which you try to escape by deciphering the words of horror men, is coming!

■Synopsis
The protagonist, having wandered into the Otherworld, must learn the words of the horror men who dwell there while searching for a way to escape...

■Nintendo Switch™ Version Features
◎New illustrations added!
Includes several newly-drawn event CG's by Yatsunagi.
◎Fully-Realized System
Optimized with intuitive controls for text input and point-and-click, ensuring a smooth and comfortable gameplay experience.
◎Supported Languages: Japanese, English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese

70010000112046.name: HOLODAMA: Content Clash
70010000112046.intro:
How close to the edge must one go for the best content?
Now is the time to hone your HOLODAMA and capture the audience's attention!
70010000112046.description:
This very night, in the world of VTubers where rivalries abound, a live stream program featuring Hololive talents shall begin once again.
It is the talents' ability to capture the perfect footage, the most streamable content, the most viral-worthy meme... It is the ability to draw the attention of a diverse fanbase and bring them enjoyment.
People call such ability the HOLODAMA (opinions may vary).

HOLODAMA refers to the ability to find and capture high-quality content during a stream while confronted with a variety of risky situations.
A collection of mini ""chicken"" games, so to speak.

This game contains multiple mini-games starring Hololive talents.
For the ultra-competitive, see if you can conquer the Crazy Endurance global leaderboards,
which are split into monthly and all-time rankings!

Multiplayer for up to four players is also available.
This is your chance to challenge your friends and family in a heated battle of content creation.


◆Mini-Games Featuring Hololive Talents
""Stop a carriage as close to the cliff as possible and reach the castle""
 (Player: Hoshimachi Suisei)
""Load as much treasure as possible into a pirate ship without dropping anything into the sea""
 (Player: Houshou Marine)
""Prank someone well enough to get them moderately freaked out, then reveal the prank""
 (Players: Shirakami Fubuki & Nakiri Ayame)
All those mini-games and more (16 in all) for you to capture the perfect stream with!
Each session is a random selection of 5 mini-games. Aim for the highest score!

◆Enjoy thrilling live stream battles in multiplayer mode!
In multiplayer mode, two to four players can battle it out with each other amidst laughter and tears.
You never know what can go wrong in a live stream...but fortune (and high scores) favors the brave!
Let's see who's the better live streamer among family, friends, or fellow Hololive fans!

◆Conquer the World in Crazy Endurance Mode!
Once all mini-games have been unlocked, you gain access to Crazy Endurance mode, which pits you against the rest of the world.
Keep aiming to get that Crazy score in this mode that's tailor-made for endurance streaming.
See where you stand among the best in the world!

70010000112083.name: Supermart Tycoon
70010000112083.intro:
Supermart Simulation.
Buy, Sell, Expand the business empire!
70010000112083.description:
You’ve just inherited a small supermarket and a modest amount of cash.
Now it’s up to you to turn it into a thriving business empire. Manage operations, expand strategically, and earn your first million — and make your family proud.

Features:
• Explore & Learn: Walk around your store, order new stock, organize shelves, set prices, and operate cashier machines and terminals to handle payments.
• Customer Satisfaction: Serve customers quickly to earn likes and boost your store’s reputation. Poor service leads to negative reviews and lower ratings.
• Expand Your Store: Purchase nearby spaces to grow your supermarket. Larger stores mean higher utility costs such as electricity, water, and waste disposal.
• Diversify Your Product Catalogue : Unlock new product categories, from dairy to household supplies, by acquiring licenses and attracting different types of shoppers.
• Smart Pricing Strategy: Optimize prices to maximize profits.
• Recycle for Rewards: Collect and recycle empty boxes to earn bonus cash — and help the planet.
• Global Competition: Climb the worldwide leaderboard and become the ultimate Supermart Tycoon.
• Stay Energized: Boost your energy each morning by eating well. Negative customer feedback affects your morale and energy levels.

Sell smart. Grow fast. Keep customers happy.
The road to becoming the world’s top Supermart entrepreneur starts here.

How to play ? 
1. Order Stocks : Order new stock from your in-game computer. Unpack deliveries and place products neatly on shelves, in fridges, and freezers.
2. Open for business : Open your shop each morning. Customers will visit to buy what they need. Run marketing promotions to attract more visitors. At the end of the day, close the shop to review your earnings summary.
3. Work as the cashier—scan items, process card payments, and make sure every customer leaves happy with their shopping and checkout experience.
4. Pricing : Set and adjust prices to find the best balance between customer satisfaction and profit margins.
5. Planning : Earn profits, reinvest wisely, and expand your store. Upgrade interiors, enlarge your space, purchase shelves/fridges/freezers, and obtain distributor licenses to unlock a wider range of products. Keep adapting to changing retail trends.
6. Personalise : Make your shop your own—customize floors, paint walls, and choose a name that defines your business.

70010000112124.name: Arcade Archives QUESTER
70010000112124.description:
"QUESTER" is a brick breaker released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1987.
Your goal is to safely return to Earth by piloting the spacecraft and defeating the mysterious space organisms（blocks） that obstruct your path.
The ball can split into multiple pieces if it continues to bounce off the walls. Use various power-up items to your advantage and aim to clear all 33 rounds!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000112136.name: Overcooked! 2 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000112136.intro: Kitchen chaos comes to Nintendo Switch™ 2
70010000112136.description:
The cooking chaos of Overcooked! 2 hits Nintendo Switch™ 2 with a host of new features. Tear up the kitchen with 4K, 60 FPS gameplay, enjoy Nintendo Switch™ 2 features like CameraPlay and GameShare, plus meet an exclusive Chef: The Platinum Platypus. Hold onto your aprons and try not to set the kitchen, and your friendships, on fire.

After saving the Onion Kingdom in the original Overcooked!, you and your team of up to four chefs are needed once more to stave off the hunger of The Unbread. 

ONLINE/LOCAL MULTIPLAYER MADNESS
You’ll knead to work together (or against each other) to get the highest score in chaotic local and online multiplayer.

FEAST YOUR EYES ON THIS
Explore the Onion Kingdom’s diverse lands in your trusted food van. Get cooking in themes ranging from sushi restaurants, magic schools, mines and even alien planets!

WHET YOUR APPETITE!
Learn to cook a smorgasbord of recipes that are sure to cater to any tastes, including sushi, cakes, burgers and pizzas.

ROMAINE CALM!
Travel through teleporters, across moving platforms and save time by throwing ingredients across dynamic kitchens that shift and evolve. Some kitchens even whisk your chefs away to new locations.

70010000112146.name: Cats Visiting Cozy Town
70010000112146.intro: Explore charming streets and find hundreds of feline friends in this purr-fectly relaxing hidden object adventure.
70010000112146.description:
Pack your bags and get your treats ready—it’s time to visit Cozy Town!

In the latest entry to the beloved Cats Visiting series, you are invited to wander through five intricately detailed, hand-drawn towns bustling with life and hidden secrets. From busy market squares to quiet cobblestone alleys and rooftop gardens, the locals are missing one thing: their cats!

There are over 400 cats hiding in plain sight, waiting to be found. Some are sleeping on awnings, some are peeking out of windows, and others are blending perfectly into the scenery.

Take a break from the stress of daily life. There are no timers, no scores, and no pressure—just you, the beautiful art, and a whole lot of cats.

Key Features:
     6 Beautiful Illustrations: Explore distinct, charming townscapes filled with personality and detail.
     The Ultimate Scavenger Hunt: Search high and low to spot over 400 hidden cats.
     Relaxing Atmosphere: Enjoy a soothing, Zen-like experience suitable for all ages.
     Zoom & Pan: Inspect every corner, chimney, and bush to find the trickiest hiders.

70010000112153.name: PLATFORM 0
70010000112153.intro: Silence is your only weapon — keep quiet, keep alive.
70010000112153.description:
Welcome to a first-person horror experience focused on tension, stealth, and environmental storytelling. You play as a lone survivor trapped in a massive underground metro system haunted by a mysterious ghost train.

There are no weapons. Your main tools are silence, awareness, and the environment itself.

- Exploration: Navigate abandoned stations, dark tunnels, and derelict utility rooms in search of a way out.    

- Stealth Survival: Make too much noise, and the ghost train will find you. Hide, and listen carefully to survive.    

- Traps & Scare Points: Some areas offer light and supplies. Others are bait for terrifying ambushes.    

- Interactive Items: Use tools to unlock new paths, solve simple environmental puzzles, or distract threats.  
  
- Dynamic Threat: The ghost train isn’t bound to a single track — it roams. It hears. It hunts.  
  
 It’s a horror game where survival comes from being quiet, thinking fast, and paying attention to every sound in the darkness.

70010000112159.name: Cute Bonfire
70010000112159.description:
Step into the warm world of Cute Bonfire, a charming pixel-art puzzle game set inside a fireplace. Take control of a little fire spirit that moves tile by tile, pushing charcoal pieces to light up the bonfires. With 30 levels of gradually increasing difficulty, delightful visuals, and a cozy, relaxing atmosphere, Cute Bonfire is perfect for casual players who love the satisfaction of solving puzzles.

Guide your fire spirit across the grid, pushing charcoals in the right order to ignite all the bonfires. Each level is a mini challenge of observation, planning, and clever moves, with undo and restart options to help you experiment without pressure. Stones and wooden obstacles block your path, adding to the strategic depth, while the gentle pixel-art style and warm ambiance make every session comforting and enjoyable.

Whether you’re a puzzle lover or just looking for a cozy, bite-sized challenge, Cute Bonfire invites you to light up every hearth and enjoy a spark of satisfaction.

70010000112193.name: Etrange Overlord
70010000112193.description: Étrange von Rosenburg is falsely accused of assassinating the king and is executed. Waking up in hell with no sweets in sight, she decides she'll just have to take the whole place over! Experience this frenetic action RPG from creator Sohei Niikawa, featuring a unique revolving lane mechanic that sends items, buffs, and even characters circling around the map! Enjoy the gorgeous character designs by legendary illustrator Shinichiro Otsuka as Étrange and her allies ride, fight, and even sing their way across hell. The action-packed gameplay can even be enjoyed by up to 4 players in a high-octane multiplayer mode!

70010000112196.name: Korean Monorail Panorama Line Soisan
70010000112196.intro: This simulation game lets you operate a train directly, based on footage of actual trains in motion!
70010000112196.description:
This game is a monorail simulation game set in Soi Mountain, a representative natural landmark in Korea.
Players become a monorail driver, taking in the breathtaking scenery of Soi Mountain and experiencing the unique experience of operating a monorail through beautiful natural and cultural heritage sites.

This is the first title to utilize actual filmed sections of the Hwagae Mountain monorail!

Key Features

• Realistic Monorail Driving Experience

Uses high-quality footage of actual Soi Mountain monorail sections.

Experience driving a monorail through diverse landscapes and terrain.

Two play modes: section-by-section driving mode and view mode.

• Control System

Just like driving a real monorail, precise control is required, including acceleration, deceleration, and stopping.

Compared to regular railways, the game features numerous uphill and downhill sections and significant impacts, requiring appropriate acceleration and deceleration control.

Ensuring on-time operation and stopping locations are crucial challenges, providing players with a truly engaging experience.
 
• Realistic Scenery and Atmosphere

Pass through the Soisan Monorail section and admire the surrounding mountains, nature, and tourist attractions through footage shot on the actual monorail.

Enjoy the natural beauty of Korea through high-definition footage that realistically recreates the breathtaking scenery as you ride.

Recommended for:

• Gamers who enjoy monorails and natural scenery
• Players who want to experience Korea's famous attractions and travels through games
• Users who prefer realistic simulations that emphasize nature and scenery

This game offers a unique opportunity to experience Hwagaesan and its surrounding natural landscapes by monorail.
It's a truly unforgettable experience for lovers of Korean nature and monorails!

70010000112212.name: DigDigDrill
70010000112212.intro:
Dig, Build, and Grow Stronger
Relaxing ground mining and ore collection
Aim for B999 and beyond with your custom drill!
70010000112212.description:
DigDigDrill is a mining, ore-collecting, and drill-customization simulation game where you carve out the underground world step-by-step at your own pace.

Dig, collect, and grow stronger. This is the definitive edition of "steady progress" mining that you won't be able to put down!
Use the resources you gather to create your very own original drill.
Let's dig deep into a cozy world with no enemies and no time limits!

<<< DigDigDrill Features >>>
- Mindless fun with mining and treasure hunting
- Block-puzzle style forging to enhance your drill just the way you like it
- Equipment with various special effects for efficient digging
- Extra stages appear after clearing the game for even more fun!

◆ Steady Digging
Dig through the earth and collect ores and treasure chests. Your goal: Floor 999!
Once your bag is full, head back to the surface to drop off your haul.

◆ Puzzle x Forging
Craft new drills using the ores you've collected.
If you fit the ores into the blueprints just right, you might create the ultimate drill.

◆ Choose Your Gear
If you're lucky, your drill will gain special effects. Combine them wisely to boost your efficiency!
- Specialize in movement speed to transport resources to the surface quickly
- Power up your bombs to blast through large areas at once
The choice is yours!

◆ End-Game Content
High-difficulty stages await you after the main clear.
The treasures you'll find there are just as powerful!

<<< Recommended for people who: >>>
- Want to lose themselves in satisfying "grind" tasks
- Love grinning at a massive collection of items
- Enjoy theory-crafting builds in hack-and-slash games
- Are looking for a relaxing game to unwind

70010000112225.name: Perennial Dusk -Kinsenka-
70010000112225.intro: A visual novel about how the human heart endures relentless violence and limitless cruelty.
70010000112225.description:
Perennial Dusk -Kinsenka- is a visual novel presented by Yukito Urushibara (Planning & Story) and Saine (Character Design & Art).

Sai suffers from a persistent numbness in his heart and lives only to protect his little sister... That is, until a fateful meeting with a girl named Matsuri. In a twilight world where the dead and the living mingle, a group of boys and girls face the imminent threat of beings known as Maledicts. Growing little by little, they experience the bittersweetness of life and the warmth of human connection.

■About This Game
・Unpredictable twists, written by Yukito Urushibara, will keep you on the edge of your seat like a mystery thriller!
・An intricate story with themes exploring life and dead—highly recommended for visual novel fans!
・Charming characters drawn by Saine!
・The theme song by Mao Uesugi and beautiful background music by Fuminori Matsumoto & Hitoshi Fujima (Elements Garden) perfectly complement the story!
・No branching paths—enjoy it even in Auto Play!
・Includes a chapter selection feature so you can start from your favorite scenes!
・Full HD support for gorgeous graphics!

■Main Characters
Matsuri (CV: Manaka Iwami)
A girl born into the Benio Family, a powerful family of Maledict Exorcists, who is tightly bound by her family's curse. Due to an incident in the past, causing her to close off her heart, she doesn't speak and barely shows any emotion. She is a Curse Bearer with the ability to give Maledicts form and use their powers freely.

Nobody (CV: Manaka Iwami)
Another personality that dwells inside Matsuri's heart who takes over when she is asleep. She can be incredibly selfish, and her words, actions, and strong attitude cause her to come across as a haughty, ill-mannered girl.

■Story
"The human heart is but a vessel for pain."

That's what someone once whispered—a voice laced with loneliness, whispering directly into the soul. It's an indescribable sadness, a love just beginning to bloom. It becomes an invisible pain that pierces the heart. And that's what makes up life: a cyclical series of highs and lows.

Tachibana Sai was born without the ability to feel pain in his heart. He spends his days eliminating any seeds of malice that sneak up on his sister, the one person he treasures, without drawing attention to himself.

Sick of the never-ending monotony he lives through, he chances upon a meeting with Benio Matsuri, a young girl whose aloof demeanor resembles that of a beautifully crafted doll.

For the first time in his life, he encounters a heart-piercing sensation—that of falling in love.

On the edge between day and night, in a twilight world where the dead and living mingle, stands an apartment building called Maison sans Nom, which is home to a group of boys and girls.

A ruthless boy who knows no pain in his heart.
A lonely girl without any friends.
A friendly girl who struggles to make connections.
A prickly, ambitious girl who is keen to be of help.
A boy who loves his own cute self above anything else.
A mess of a woman who tries to solve everything through brute force.
And a boy with a tender heart who knows no pain in his body.

This ill-assorted group of residents, hands stained with blood from battling the Maledicts, shall encounter the hearts they never knew and begin nurturing their souls.

The human heart is but a vessel for pain.

To protect this pain akin to love... To gently break the world apart, piece by piece... Even if it means abandoning humanity. That's why the heart is but a vessel for pain.

For life blazes brilliantly, while the heart goes around in an endless cycle.

70010000112231.name: Rolling Macho: Tumbling to Earth
70010000112231.intro: Rolling Macho: Tumbling to Earth is a rolling action game where you roll and squat your way back to Earth after being stranded in space.
70010000112231.description:
■Unique Controls
Explore the unique and challenging "Rotation Control Mode" where your character spins as you rotate the stick.

The game starts with a standard control method, making it easy for anyone to enjoy. When you're ready, dive into the challenge of mastering the unique "Rotation Control Mode," where your character spins as you rotate the stick.

■Unique World
There is no time to worry about why macho is in space or why he does side rolls.

All you need to understand is that he is in space and must return to Earth.

■Simple Rules
The only way is up! All you need is the physical strength to keep rolling and the determination to never give up.

■Various Areas
As you progress, the environment changes, demanding different strategies. To survive in space, you must adapt to the situation.

■Great Music
The music changes with each area and will make you feel excited. Enjoy the carefully curated soundtrack.

70010000112245.name: Öoo
70010000112245.intro: A Bomb Caterpillar's Big Adventure!"Öoo" is a charming yet mysterious exploration puzzle platformer where you discover creative ways to use bombs!
70010000112245.description:
A Bomb Caterpillar's Big Adventure!
"Öoo" is a charming yet mysterious exploration puzzle platformer where you discover creative ways to use bombs!

A Variety of Solutions Using Bombs!


Discover unique ways to use bombs!


Uncover hidden paths with clever bomb usage!


Traverse the map to find hidden routes!


Features
・A dense experience that can be enjoyed in just 2–3 hours
・A cute yet oddly mysterious world
・Diverse puzzle solutions that change depending on how you use bombs
・No text — enjoy the game without language barriers
・So cute that even people who dislike bugs can enjoy it comfortably.

70010000112257.name: Lovely Spot the Difference Fantasy Edition
70010000112257.intro: A spot-the-difference game featuring lots of cute girls!
70010000112257.description:
Enjoy an easy and fun game that anyone can play while admiring adorable characters!
Now introducing the Fantasy Version Vol.2 with increased difficulty!
Includes 15 exciting stages!

Compare the two illustrations and find the differences!
Tap either side to answer.
If you can't find the differences, try zooming in!
Still stuck? Use the magnifying glass for a helpful hint!
Perfect for killing time during short breaks!

＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
At Age, we support video creators who stream our games.
No permission is required for gameplay streaming.

70010000112263.name: Teeny Tiny Town
70010000112263.intro: Step into Teeny Tiny Town, a cozy and colorful city-building puzzle where every move counts.
70010000112263.description:
By merging three matching tiles, you’ll gradually transform a humble settlement into a thriving metropolis—growing your world from adorable beginnings to awe-inspiring skylines. 
With no timers or pressure, you’re free to build, relax, and shape your town at your own pace.

Game features:
- Merge and Evolve Gameplay: Connect three identical tiles to unlock new buildings and expand your city step by step.
- Customizable Themes: Personalize your town with unique looks, including festive options like Halloween and Christmas.
- Night Mode: Switch to a glowing nighttime view and watch your city sparkle under the stars.
- Stress-Free Play: No countdowns, no rush—just calm, creative building at your own rhythm.
- Atmospheric Vibes: Enjoy lo-fi music and low-poly art that create a relaxing, minimalist atmosphere.
- Casual Yet Strategic: Easy to pick up, but with enough depth to keep you planning your next clever merge.
- Family-Friendly Fun: Accessible for all ages, blending puzzle-solving with city-building charm.

Why You’ll Love It
Teeny Tiny Town combines the simplicity of a match-three puzzle with the satisfaction of city-building strategy. 
Whether you’re chasing the perfect layout, experimenting with different themes, or just unwinding with its cozy soundtrack, this game offers a relaxing yet rewarding experience.

70010000112269.name: Doors & Loot
70010000112269.intro: Fight your way to the top of the tower and stop the sorcerer who controls it to free the unfortunate souls who arrived there and are now trapped.
70010000112269.description:
Venture into this dungeon crawler with roguelike elements, where you'll face bloodthirsty skeletons and other creatures. Reach the top of the tower and uncover the mysteries hidden within.

In this adventure, you will follow the story of Dorian, an adventurer who has spent years tracking down a powerful sorcerer. However, when he finally finds him, he discovers that the situation is far worse than he expected. 

Game features
----------------
- A dungeon-crawling adventure where you must clear each floor before advancing. After every floor, you can choose between opening a chest with improved equipment or moving on to the next floor, where loot chances are better but enemies are stronger.

-Simple mechanics! Jump back into the game whenever you want, with no steep learning curve.

- Define your own playstyle! Choose from different weapon types and talents. Feel free to carve your own path.

- Forge your own custom equipment! If the gear you find during your journey isn't enough, create your ideal equipment with the stats you need.

- A unique style! More friendly and suitable for all audiences. Perfect for newcomers to the genre and refreshing for veteran players.

- An unexpected story waiting to be uncovered as you explore the dungeons.

- Various bosses and powerful enemies that will appear as you progress.

70010000112291.name: Horticular
70010000112291.intro: Horticular is a relaxing garden builder where you grow plants, design habitats and attract a wide range of wildlife.
70010000112291.description: Horticular is a relaxing garden builder where you grow plants, design habitats and attract a wide range of wildlife. Help the gnome Keepers restore a barren wasteland with magical powers and populate it with adorable critters. Reclaim nature from a looming corruption and create your perfect garden.

70010000112297.name: Magical Magic World
70010000112297.intro:
All main characters are Vtubers!! 
Pixel art side-scrolling comical fantasy magical action sent by Vtuber magical girl!!
70010000112297.description:
All main characters are Vtubers!!
Pixel art side-scrolling comical fantasy magical action sent by Vtuber magical girl Kohaku!! 
The magical girl goes on a journey in search of magical things scattered all over the place!
Believe in your magical power and run around the mysterious world from the magical gate!

This game is an orthodox side-scrolling 2D action game.
You can experience various worlds from the beginning with the stage selection type.
Run through various stages and successfully defeat the boss, and the ability is yours.
The difficulty level depends on the abilities you have acquired, so it's up to you to decide which stage to start!

After clearing all the stages, more !?
See for yourself the future! !!

70010000112303.name: Cast n Chill - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000112303.intro: Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear and reel in legendary catches - all with your loyal companion by your side.
70010000112303.description:
Cast n Chill's a laid-back fishin’ game for folks who’d rather wet a line than break a sweat. Whether yer driftin’ on a lazy lake, pokin’ 'round a winding river, or droppin’ lines in salty blue water, this here’s a game where you set the pace.

Upgrade Yer Gear.
Start with the basics, catch whatever bites, sell your haul, and put those coins toward better rods, reels, and upgrades. Before ya know it, you’ll be wranglin’ rare species that’d make any angler green with envy.

Explore New Waters.
Find yer favourite fishin’ hole or keep wanderin’. There’s 16 peaceful spots to discover, each with its own critters swimmin’ 'round, just waitin’ to bite.

Pick Your Pace.
In Active Mode, you’re in the thick of it - castin’, reelin’, and keepin’ busy like a loon at nesting time.

Switch to Passive Mode if you’d rather let the game do the work while you’re off choppin’ wood. 

Collect 'Em All.
There’s 50 fish to discover - some you’ll recognize, some you’ll squint at and go “what in the heck is that?” From scrappy little sunfish to big ol’ deepwater beasts, they’re all in the logbook waitin’ for your name.

Legendary Catches
There’s 16 fish out there that still get folks jabberin’ at ol' Rusty's bait shop like they saw Bigfoot ride a moose. Land one, and you'll be part o' the legend.

Boat Buddies
Grab your rod and call a buddy, Cast 'n Chill now has co-op! Whether you’re lookin’ to kick back and fish side-by-side or stir up a bit of friendly competition, it’s all better with company.

Trusty Companion
Nothin’ beats a day on the lake with a four-legged friend. They might not know a spinnerbait from a spoon, but they’ll help you spot a fish - if only 'cause they’re hopin’ for a bite themselves.

70010000112315.name: 5omeday
70010000112315.intro:
If she tries anything shady or attempts to hurt you, 
push that button right in front of you.
It will execute her instantly.
70010000112315.description: You have been assigned to guard a dragon girl set to be executed at the end of 5 days and have the ability to kill her instantly at any time with the push of a button in this multi-ending visual novel.

70010000112321.name: Bunninjutsu
70010000112321.intro: Hop, Toggle, and Train Like a True Ninja!
70010000112321.description:
Leap into a world of calm precision and clever rhythm in this 2D platformer where every jump changes everything. You play as a brave ninja bunny in training, mastering the art of movement where each leap toggles platforms, spikes, and saws on or off. Timing isn’t just important, it’s everything.
With smooth controls, double jumps, and wall jumps, you’ll flow through 30 handcrafted levels that blend platforming and puzzle-solving in a uniquely relaxing way. Each stage is short, focused, and satisfying, perfect for players who enjoy smart challenges or love hunting for achievements.
Plan your jumps, find your rhythm, and reach the torii gate to prove you’ve earned your black belt.
Features
• 30 handcrafted stages filled with clever platform puzzles
• Jump to toggle platforms, spikes, and saws on or off
• Double jump and wall jump mechanics for flexible movement
• A calm and readable challenge perfect for casual players
• Checkpoints and instant retries for frustration-free fun
Train your mind and reflexes as you turn every jump into a perfect act of ninja mastery. The path to the torii awaits, one hop at a time.

70010000112327.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000112327.intro: Unleash the Turtles in a roguelike quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan! Unite in bodacious co-op gameplay, and conquer NYC locales. Now on Nintendo Switch™ 2!
70010000112327.description:
Unleash Turtle Power!
Grab your friends, pick your favorite Turtle and jump into an adventure to save Master Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious online and local co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales.

Bodacious Co-Op Gameplay
Brace yourself for fast-paced, roguelike action where no two runs are the same. With randomized power-ups, room layouts, and boss modifiers, the excitement never ends. Take control of all four Turtles, each wielding unique powers, and team up with friends for bodacious co-op gameplay. Explore iconic NYC locations, upgrade your Turtle powers, and prepare to face off against formidable enemies.

Build Your Power
Master the powers of water and fire, utrom and ooze, light and darkness, and -most importantly- Ninja to create unique and bodacious builds for your Turtles. Every run brings new challenges and opportunities - explore and perfect your favorite builds, and combine them with allies to conquer your enemies.

A Thrilling Story
When Splinter is kidnapped by Shredder, mysterious portals appear across NYC and the Turtles will battle to recover their father from the clutches of the Foot Clan. However, an even greater threat lingers in the shadows…

Splintered Fate promises to keep you engaged in the FIGHT, ADAPT, REPEAT portal loop. Be ready to restore peace to the city!

Optimized for Nintendo Switch 2!

70010000112340.name: BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000112340.intro: Experience the EVOLUTION of Xtreme Battle!
70010000112340.description:
The BEYBLADE ACTION game that faithfully recreates the world of BEYBLADE X arrives with three powerful evolutions! Witness EVOBATTLE, EVOSTORY, and EVOCUSTOMIZE!

■ Evolution 1: EVOBATTLE
Your strategy changes dramatically depending on your Bey type. Attack Type specializes in offense, Stamina Type absorbs the opponent’s stamina, Defense Type activates shields for solid protection, and Balance Type boosts attack power through combos! Experience thrilling high-speed Battles that demand skill and precision! Challenge Bladers around the world in online matches!

■ Evolution 2: EVOSTORY
New allies await—compete, grow, and chase your dreams together in the ultimate BEY BATTLE ROYALE (BBR)!

■ Evolution 3: EVOCUSTOMIZE
Customization reaches new heights! Collect materials to coat your Beys in your favorite colors, enhance your favorite parts, and choose X Skills to create the perfect Beys for your Battle style!

70010000112343.name: Dirt Racing Bundle Rally & Truck
70010000112343.intro: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000112343.description:
This pack includes the games: Speed Truck and Rally Rock ´N Racing.

Speed Truck Racing

In Speed Truck Racing, you will enjoy the fastest, most spectacular races at over 200 Km/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 20 rivals.
There are several modes available, including Championship, Arcade and 4-player multiplayer.

There is also an online leader board where you can compare your best times with those of your friends and players from around the world.

Features:

-Arcade driving.
-4-Player multiplayer.
-Online ranking.
-Rock music.

Rally Rock ´N Racing

In Rally Rock 'N Racing, you’ll enjoy a wide variety of natural environments, such as deserts, snow-covered mountains, forests... where you can show your skill at the wheel, competing against everyone to become the fastest. The game has several modes, such as Championship, Time Trial, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Online leader board where you can compare your best times with those of your friends and players from around the world.

Features:

- Wide variety of tracks.
- Multi-player with 4 players.
- Realistic driving physics.
- Lots of Rock 'N Roll music.

70010000112375.name: KANADE
70010000112375.intro: "I have to sing the greatest love song and save the world in my mother's place."
70010000112375.description:
Story
In the near future, a sudden proliferation of plants has left much of human civilization drowning in greenery. Yuuto is a boy living in a city that's now largely reclaimed by nature. One day, a girl named Kanade appears on his doorstep.
The two had been exchanging letters after she found one of his carrier pigeons.
"I have to sing the greatest love song and save the world in my mother's place.
So, Yuuto-san... Would you please fall in love with me?"
Warmly watched over by those around them, the two tentatively begin their exploration of love. What neither of them realize is that a spark of affection has already budded between them...
Fall in love, make music, and save the world.
This is the tale of a wondrous future where the encounter between a boy and girl brings a miracle to the world.

70010000112420.name: Heroes Battle Awakening
70010000112420.intro: Fight monsters with monsters as you command legions against waves of invaders in tower defense style!
70010000112420.description:
Heroes Battle Awakening is a top-down tower defense tactics game that puts you in command of cyclops knights, minotaurs, skull-topped guard towers and more as you fend off invaders.

Collect coins on the battlefield to pay for new units and deploy them strategically along the 5-lane grid. Some of your units will do ranged damage, others will focus on melee as the enemy closes in and certain units will specialize in producing more gold to deploy defenses faster.

Take down waves successfully and progress through 4 uniquely-themed chapters, each with 10 levels to master. But watch out! As combat heats up, you’ll face hordes of skeleton soldiers, orcs, flying sorcerers and even greater menaces! Can you keep the kingdom safe?

• Enjoy colorful and casual tower defense gameplay!
• Strategically deploy a variety of unit types.
• Command your own unique monsters.
• Battle across 4 story chapters, each with 10 levels.
• Collect coins during battle to purchase new units!

70010000112428.name: I'm not a Human: Horror
70010000112428.intro: You wake up in darkness and every door hides a nightmare.
70010000112428.description:
You open your eyes to complete darkness, trapped in a basement with no way out. Every door is locked, and the silence is broken only by distant, haunting sounds. As you search the area, you discover hidden passwords that might be your only chance to escape.

But you’re not alone. A mysterious masked enemy stalks the shadows, hunting you with relentless intent. With only a flashlight and a weapon, you must uncover the truth, stay one step ahead, and survive the nightmare.

Key Features
- Dark exploration: uncover clues and passwords to unlock doors
- Horror atmosphere: chilling sounds and tense visuals
- Relentless enemy: avoid the masked stalker
- First-person immersion: feel the fear up close
- Flashlight & weapon: light your path and defend yourself

Can you escape, or will you become the next victim?

70010000112444.name: Dragon Loop
70010000112444.intro: Escape The Time Loop In This Open-World Metroidvania
70010000112444.description:
Help Xi navigate a five-day time loop and figure out what happened to her memories in a vast hand-drawn world.
 
Together with her companion, Ouro, travel through a true metroidvania world where time changes the terrain in subtle ways. Escape the loop through exploration and battle. Change Xi’s fate and learn the truth of the Dragon Loop!
 
• Turn Bosses into Summonable Spirits
 
Defeat a wide range of interesting bosses to get exclusive summonable spirits. Destroy your foes with powerful Explosive Spirits, or summon Persistent Spirit companions to follow you around. Upgrade and evolve both types to enhance their combat power!
 
• Multipurpose Metroidvania Powers
 
Find rare Pearls to summon powerful tools that help you traverse the world. Spiky pufferfish, magnetic boxes, a vacuuming whale spirit… and more. Each has multiple uses in both combat and traversing the world, unlocking many ways to play!
 
• Fast-Paced Exciting Battles
 
Combine Xi’s strength with Ouro’s agility in fast-paced combat. Play well, manage your X-Rating, and boost your speed and combat power even further in this fast-paced combat system with no contact damage.
 
• Branches in Time
 
In Dragon Loop, time is a limited resource. Use your five days wisely and plan your routes through an easily-navigable Time Map. Explore and open up new worldlines to see how things play out differently.But don’t worry: this isn’t a roguelike; you never start from scratch.

70010000112455.name: Enter the Dodgeball
70010000112455.intro:
Hold the Joy-Con™ in both hands!
For kids who aren’t good at dodgeball.
And for adults who want to try it again after a long time.
70010000112455.description:
The ball is coming.
Scared of getting hit?

Now is the time to be brave.
Don’t look away.

Bend both elbows and catch it in front of your chest!

Amazing.
Yes, you can do it. You did it. You really did!

70010000112462.name: Midnight Swamp
70010000112462.intro: A dark point-and-click adventure where you will dive into a world of eerie fairy tales
70010000112462.description:
Midnight Swamp is a dark point-and-click adventure where you will dive into a world of eerie fairy tales. Play as a tourist who must find a way out of a mysterious swamp, where every corner hides a riddle.

A mysterious laugh echoed from the lake on that restless summer night. One careless step outside the tent — and you find yourself dragged into a dark world of shifting swamps, inhabited by strange creatures and filled with hidden secrets.

Soon, a talking Cat convinces you to enter the inhospitable castle rising above the swamp, while the Witch from the gingerbread house teaches you the basics of potion brewing. Will you have the courage to uncover the mystery of this place?

Features:
- A variety of puzzles, potion crafting, and location exploration
- A dark swamp hiding a sinister secret
- Many strange inhabitants for you to meet
- Hand-drawn graphics

70010000112469.name: World Of Unlit
70010000112469.description:
World of Unlit is a fast paced, first person movement shooter where your goal is to utilize your grapple hook, melee weapons, guns and bows to destabilize a culture.

Fight your way through Unlit territory and destroy all the statues you find along your way, the unique and skill demanding movement is your best tool to complete your mission.

70010000112502.name: Football Cup 2026
70010000112502.intro: Lead your nation. Claim the trophy. Become a legend.
70010000112502.description:
Experience the thrill of victory and step onto the pitch for the most refined edition yet. Football Cup 2026 sets a new standard with smarter AI, enhanced mechanics, and expanded challenge levels designed to push your skills further than ever before. Lead your favorite team to glory and prove you have what it takes to conquer the world’s biggest stadiums.

Choose from a diverse roster of national and club teams, each with distinct strengths and playstyles. Tailor your team to fit your strategy, then take control with a streamlined UI and refined mechanics that make every pass, shot, and tackle feel sharper and more responsive. Improved ball physics and polished gameplay ensure every match is fast, fluid, and intensely satisfying.

More intelligent opponents mean fiercer competition - with upgraded AI and new difficulty modes, the challenge adapts to your skill level. Whether you're just starting out or aiming for total domination, every victory feels earned.

Start your professional football journey and dive into game modes designed to keep the action exciting and rewarding:

- Basic Mode - Learn and master essential football skills.
- Career Mode - Make key strategic decisions and lead your team to long-term success.
- Divisions Mode - Climb the competitive ladder, prove your consistency, and secure your place among the elite.
- Europa, Copa Del Sur, Champions Cup - Compete in prestigious international tournaments and face top-tier opponents from around the world.

Football Cup 2026 delivers faster gameplay, sharper competition, and deeper progression than ever before. The pitch is yours - rise through the divisions, outplay your rivals, and build your legacy in football history.

70010000112508.name: Bullet Strike
70010000112508.intro: Nintendo Switch™ Exclusive! Face heart-pounding missions on chemical plant battlefields! Dominate hazardous zones with tanks and close combat!
70010000112508.description:
Immersive missions unfold in photorealistic chemical plant territories! A real-time heart rate monitor displayed in the lower right corner heightens combat tension. Set against dangerous nuclear fuel production zones, survey the entire battlefield from elevated positions among towering refinement columns and spherical storage tanks, executing strategic sniper strikes! Experience unprecedented realism with spectacular visual effects as tank shells impact the ground, sending plumes of dust skyward. Select your class from the refined character selection UI, hone your skills in Deathmatch, then advance to high-difficulty tank operation missions!

・Real-time animated heart rate monitor! Experience combat tension across the entire screen!
・Strategic gameplay from elevated spherical storage tanks and high vantage points overlooking chemical plant facilities!
・Overwhelming visual effects such as dust clouds from tank shell impacts deliver thrilling combat scenes!
・Refined character selection UI enables intuitive class selection and immediate battlefield deployment!
・Experience multiple tense missions set in the hazardous nuclear fuel production facility!
・Master the fundamentals in Deathmatch before tackling tank operation missions with dramatically escalating difficulty!
・Extensive testing and balance adjustments deliver even more exciting and thrilling stages!
・Enjoy three-dimensional tactical combat using the complex terrain of industrial facilities!
・Diverse game modes designed for both beginners and experts to enjoy!

Chemical plant territories materialize before you with cutting-edge photorealistic graphics. Tension etched by the heart rate monitor, dust clouds raised by tank bombardment, precision shooting from elevated positions. Experience unprecedented immersion in battlefields within hazardous nuclear fuel facilities! Conquer extreme combat as part of special forces in the ultimate hazardous zone FPS.

Synopsis
An arid wind whips up dust across desolate chemical plant territories. At the heart of massive refinement facility complexes, the next-generation nuclear fuel "Nucleon Core" radiates an ominous glow. The multinational military conglomerate "Northern Dynamics" deploys its armored division "Steel Punk" to seize control of this technology. Regions bristling with towering refinement columns and spherical nuclear fuel storage tanks swiftly transform into combat fortresses, as tank shell impacts shake the earth and spawn sandstorms.

The World Security Alliance responds urgently by dispatching the special intervention unit "Bullet Strike," comprising Assault, Support, Engineer, and Recon operatives. You enter the battlefield as part of this elite team, equipped with a real-time heart rate monitor, deployed to chemical plant war zones.

Survey the tactical situation from elevated chemical plant storage tanks and suppress enemies through sniper fire.
