Board tanks to devastate enemy positions with 120mm main guns, with impacts hurling dust and earth high into the sky. Alternatively, shoulder an RPG-7 to obliterate steel tanks in a single strike. Hone your techniques in Deathmatch before tackling ultra-high difficulty tank operation missions! In extreme conditions where your heart rate reaches its limit, secure Bullet Strike's victory!

70010000112514.name: The Knights of the Cross
70010000112514.intro:
Build Your Deck. Lead Your Allies.
Face the Teutonic Knights. Rewrite the Ending.
70010000112514.description:
The Knights of the Cross is an RPG card game adapted from The Knights of the Cross by Nobel Prize-winning author Henryk Sienkiewicz. You will play as the knight Zbyszko and embark on a medieval adventure. Recruit companions, build your deck, and help the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth battle the Teutonic Order in the epic Battle of Grunwald.

【Recruit Allies, Join the Fight】
Recruit over 30 unique companions, each with their own storyline. Completing their storyline unlock exclusive items.
Each character is equipped with dynamic portraits and stunning ultimate abilities and effects, offering a rich visual experience.

【Unique Synergy, Build Your Strategy】
The innovative Teambuilding Combo System: The cards you play will dictate your allies' actions in the turn.
Combine cards and relics with your teammates' abilities to create powerful combat strategies like burn, bleed, poison, and more—offering fresh experiences on each playthrough.
Bosses come with their own special mechanics, such as cleansing their debuffs or limiting card types. Adapt your deck and tactics to break through tough encounters and feel the thrill of victory.

【Engaging Story, Immersive World】
A branching main story with multiple endings, allowing you to change the fate of the original characters.
Over a hundred side quests and random events that immerse you in medieval festivals, folk traditions, and daily life.

70010000112520.name: Lost In Space - The First Adventure
70010000112520.intro: Point & click adventure game based on the TV show: Lost in Space - play as Will Robinson and team up with Dr. Smith and Robot!
70010000112520.description:
Ready for a brand new Lost in Space adventure? Explore treacherous environments, solve puzzles and mysteries as you investigate the disappearance of the other members of the Jupiter 2!

After being trapped in a cave on a late-night rock hunting excursion, Will returns to the spaceship only to find that it's been raided during the night! Team up with the mercurial Dr. Smith and the always-faithful Robot, to unravel the mystery behind the disappearance of Will's parents, his sisters as well as Major Don West.

Lost in Space – the First Adventure will return you to the imaginative world of the beloved 60's TV series. The game is designed to be the spiritual "fourth season" that fans have always craved. Recreated with loving detail to perfectly capture the personalities of all the members of the Jupiter 2. 

This adventure marks the initial chapter in a five-part game series. Later chapters will take the trio on a perilous adventure across numerous, alien locations as they confront classic villains from the show including Saticons, Invaders from the Fifth Dimension, The Keeper and more!

KEY FEATURES: 
-The game lovingly recreates the wonderous world of the beloved 60's television series in this “fourth season” spiritual successor.
-Match wits with some of the original series' most nefarious villains including Saticons, Invaders from the Fifth Dimension, the Giant Cyclops and more!
-The game uses dialogue taken directly from the show as well as the original music including the iconic theme songs!
-Work your way through lots of challenging puzzles along with a multi-tiered help system to assure that you'll never get stuck.

70010000112527.name: Wall Of Insanity 2
70010000112527.intro: Gaze upon the horrors that dwell beyond the Wall of Insanity.
70010000112527.description:
Wall of Insanity 2 once again plunges us into a grim and perilous world, lurking beyond the veil of dimensions — a world of isolation and decay. It is a nightmare from which there is no waking. In this third-person action game, you will uncover the story of a lost squad while confronting an unspeakable horror.

During a police raid on the lair of a dangerous cult, the squad stumbles into a devil’s trap. Several officers who fought against the unknown are discovered unconscious and severely wounded—the rest vanish without a trace.
Now, trapped in a nightmarish reality, you are the last remaining fighter. Your mission: Fight your way back to our world and expose the horrifying threat lurking beyond the invisible Wall of Insanity.

Main features:

- Battles with monsters have become more active, and new dangerous enemies have appeared. But your arsenal has also expanded.
The game rewards caution, resource conservation, and competent use of the environment in battle. Properly selected tactics and weapons will save your life. Useful items will increase your chances of survival.

- An ominous other world, filled with various and worked out locations, with many secrets and secret routes. New destroyed and dynamic objects appeared. 

- The plot plays a significant role in the game. Immersive storytelling unfolds through compelling cutscenes, dialogue, and discovered diaries, revealing the tragic fate of the missing squad. Certain characters will unveil the hidden secrets of this world of visions.

- Multiple difficulty settings are available, each offering a distinctly different experience. You can adjust the challenge level at any time - simply choose the gameplay mode that best suits your style.

70010000112530.name: Kanjozoku Game: Car Racing & Highway Driving Simulator REMASTER
70010000112530.intro: Master the neon streets and prove your skill against the fastest legends.
70010000112530.description:
Step into the underground world of Osaka’s legendary highway racers in Kanjozoku Game: Car Racing & Highway Driving Simulator REMASTER. Inspired by the iconic 90s street scene, this remastered experience puts you behind the wheel of authentic JDM machines, where speed, precision, and reputation define everything.

Take over the Kanjo loop at night, weave through dense traffic, and prove your dominance in high-speed battles. Every run is a test of skill—push your limits, outdrive your rivals, and rise through the underground ranks to become the most feared racer on the highway.

Build your ultimate car with deep and detailed customization. From performance tuning to visual styling, every upgrade shapes how your machine handles and how it stands out on the streets.

Key Features:
 ● Authentic 90s Osaka highway racing atmosphere with intense night driving and traffic challenges
 ● Wide selection of classic JDM cars with full tuning options: engine upgrades, swaps, suspension, and performance setups
 ● Extensive customization system including body parts, wheels, stance tuning, and custom liveries
 ● Multiple gameplay modes and activities: time-based challenges, traffic dodging, drifting, and competitive racing
 ● Dynamic world with car meets, hotspots, and high-speed police chases
 ● Progression system that rewards skillful driving, risk-taking, and race performance

Push beyond limits, own the highway, and become a true Kanjo legend.

70010000112537.name: Bubble Battle
70010000112537.description:
Bubble Battle is a retro local multiplayer fighting game inspired by arcade classics. Players fly around with one simple objective: burst opponents’ bubbles before they burst yours. Collect powerups and out-maneuver opponents for fast-paced, addictive fun!

Bubble Battle is designed for those craving a local party game experience reminiscent of the 80's and 90's. 

Players fly around with one simple objective: burst opponents’ bubbles before they burst yours. Collect powerups and out-maneuver opponents for fast-paced, addictive fun!

FEATURES

- Easy to pick up and play thanks to simple controls

- Quick gameplay - rounds are usually less than 2 minutes (the arena becomes smaller toward the end of a round)

- A selection of variants, powerups, and levels deliver many unique experiences.

70010000112546.name: The End of the Beginning of Courage, Reasoning, and Seaweed 10
70010000112546.description: The battle between Yūki and the Dread begins!

70010000112554.name: Brave × Junction
70010000112554.intro:
Do you leave it to chance or trickery?
A brand-new experience, a blackjack RPG!
70010000112554.description:
-Game Features-
・Blackjack Style Turn-Based Battle System
Battles are a one-on-one turn-based system.
Who has the closest number to 21 in their hand? They deal an attack to the opponent!

Three distinctive playable characters make an appearance: The Fighter, with a head on battle-like creed; the Thief, unrivaled in sensing danger and thwarting it; and the Magician, who employs trickery at will!
Leave your strategy to chance? Entrap the enemy with trickery? The way you enjoy is up to you, the player.


・Diverse Array of Monsters
Slimes, orcs, dragons, and monsters, familiar to fantasy RPGs all lurk out of the depths, one after another.
Card hand concealing ghosts, trolls that surpass the 21-card value limit, and many more with a diverse array of skills stand in the way of the player.
Monsters from Rideon Japan's “Adventure Bar Story” and “Mercenaries Saga” series games even make an appearance!


・Loads of Factors to Augment, Unfolding a Blackjack Victory
Acquire boost cards as you advance the adventure, strengthening status and learning skills.
Abilities come along with some weapons and accessories, and at the Armory & Forge in town, synthesis can allow for unbound customization.

Combining skills with abilities? This could bring to life new tactics.
Can you traverse the untrodden dungeons? It's all up to you, the player!

70010000112556.name: EGGCONSOLE Carbuncle Pi MSX2
70010000112556.intro: An action puzzle game starring Carbuncle. Use left and right movement and jumping to collect the gems on the map!
70010000112556.description:
This game is essentially a Carbuncle version of the action-puzzle game 'Nyanpi,' which featured a cat protagonist and was included in 'Disk Station #24,' released by Compile in 1991. Players control Carbuncle to collect all the gems placed on the map, and then proceed to the girl's location to reach the goal and advance to the next stage.

While the game rules are straightforward, conquering the game requires certain techniques. You must carefully consider Carbuncle's movements, taking into account jump power and the route, sometimes even using the gems as footholds!

Since there is no game over due to a time limit and you can restart any number of times, this title allows you to settle in and play at your own pace. If you are a fan of puzzle games, you will definitely want to complete all 20 rounds.


*This application does not have a scene select mode.
*The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
*Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000112559.name: EGGCONSOLE WONDERLAND OF CARBUNCLE MSX2
70010000112559.intro: A peculiar shooting game featuring the exploits of Carbuncle. Fight enemies, collect apples, and battle bosses to clear the stages!
70010000112559.description:
This title is a unique shooting game that was included in "Disk Station #25," released by Compile in 1991. Players control Carbuncle to collect falling apples, and the stage is cleared once they defeat the boss that appears at the end.

The game takes place on stages themed around a giant tree, where you use jumps and shots to fight enemies. Apples grow on the tree within the stage and fall over time, which you must catch and collect. When the TIME gauge on the left side of the screen runs out, a Pelican holding a basket appears. Throwing the collected apples into the Pelican's basket opens the window in the center of the screen, revealing the boss. Victory in the intense battle with the boss allows you to proceed to the next stage.

In addition to shooting down enemies, this game features unique mechanics like collecting apples and using the Pelican to summon the boss. This title is highly recommended for anyone who wants to try a slightly different kind of shooting game, as well as for Carbuncle fans.

70010000112568.name: Pixel Game Maker Series MagicalShot The AttackBump☆
70010000112568.intro:
Blast enemies away with magic shots and smash them into walls to defeat them!
A top-down, fixed-screen 2D action game!
70010000112568.description:
☆ Story
Vanilla, our very hungry protagonist, wanted to buy a cake but is completely broke!
After mocking from her childhood friend Chocolat, she sets out on an adventure to gather ingredients and bake a cake herself!

☆ Gameplay & Features
Defeat all enemies and keep the screen clean for 5 seconds to clear a stage.
A simple and easy-to-understand system!
Think about how you move and position yourself to find the best strategy.
A huge experience with 100 action-packed stages!

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.

70010000112574.name: Puffy Dog Puzzle
70010000112574.intro: A puzzle game featuring slightly chubby doggies is here!
70010000112574.description:
Collect pieces of the plump and adorable “Buyowan” pups and complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
When the puzzle is completed, you can hear the cute voice of “Buyowan”!
Clear all puzzles and complete your gallery ♪
=====================
At AGE, we support game streamers!
No permission is required for streaming this game.

70010000112589.name: Forest of Deceit
70010000112589.intro: Find the Traitors in this social deduction Jackbox-esque game for 4-8 players.
70010000112589.description:
A STORM IS COMING

Forest of Deceit is a Jackbox-esque social deduction game for 4 to 8 players. You are part of a group lost in a dark, treacherous forest that seems to go on forever and ever. You can’t find any escape, and there’s a storm brewing on the horizon - a storm so massive that you all will surely perish if you can’t build a solid shelter before it arrives. Every day you explore the forest to gather resources with which to build your shelter. But the forest itself is cursed, slowly driving people into a traitorous madness; it’s surely already got a hold on some of your friends’ minds… or maybe even yours. If you don’t figure out who’s sabotaging the efforts to build a shelter, you all are going to be swept away. On the other hand, if you happen to be the Traitor and they find you, you could get kicked out of the group - for good.


A FOREST OF LIES AND BETRAYAL

From the minds of Ghost Camp and Thomas Mackinnon (creator of THE CORRIDOR and It Takes a War) comes Forest of Deceit, a back-stabbing experience about trying to survive a storm and betraying your friends. With a beautiful hand-drawn art style and a focus on casual play and social interaction, this party game is perfect for all kinds - from teenagers to grandpas, hardcore players to someone who’s never played a game in their life.

Each day, gathering parties are assigned to go deep into the forest for resources. Innocents will try to gather useful resources whereas Traitors will try to hinder the group’s advances with bad resources and try to get other players lost in the accursed woods. When the results of the day’s gathering are revealed, the group can discuss what happened - and after a few days there will even be a daily vote to expel suspected Traitors from the group. If the Innocents can build the shelter in time, they win! If not… it’s a victory for treachery.

Focusing on casual play and social interaction, Forest of Deceit is fun for all kinds of players - from a family experience to group meetings; from non-gamers to hardcore players!


FEATURES

- Gather resources to build a shelter against the upcoming storm. If you are a Traitor, you will try to get other people lost in the forest, and hinder the group’s efforts by collecting bad resources. 

- Discuss what happened, and eventually start voting suspect Traitors out. If the Traitors can prevent the Innocents building a shelter in time, they win.

- Create your own house rules: An endlessly replayable party game, with fully customisable game options. 

- Use your own phones, tablets, or computers for each player to play right from their very own web browser.

- Fantastic for both local multiplayer and online play. Works great with screen-sharing for online play!

NOTE: No generative AI was used in the making of this game or its associated assets.

70010000112603.name: Animal Coloring Books for Kids & Toddlers - Dinosaurs
70010000112603.intro: Lovingly designed coloring book full of child-friendly dinosaur illustrations
70010000112603.description:
Animal Coloring Books for Kids & Toddlers – Dinosaurs is a lovingly designed coloring book full of child-friendly dinosaur illustrations.

The game can be played directly on the device’s touchscreen using a finger. Children simply tap, paint, and get creative!

Kids start by choosing a dinosaur line-art image and then enter the canvas area, where they can color the picture and freely paint in the background. The line-art can also be disabled, allowing children to draw on a blank canvas.

A wide selection of colors, brushes, and fill tool is available. The size of each drawing tool can be adjusted, and all buttons and tools can be hidden so only the drawing area remains visible.

It’s the perfect creative experience for young children to improve hand-eye coordination, explore colors, and enjoy a fun artistic journey with friendly dinosaurs.

70010000112612.name: Island Survival 2026: Craft, Build, Grow
70010000112612.intro: Survive the island. Build your way home.
70010000112612.description:
Stranded by the sea. Surrounded by danger. Driven to survive.

After a violent storm destroys your ship, you wake up alone on a remote tropical island. With nothing but the wreckage around you and the ocean full of unknown threats, survival becomes your only goal. Every resource matters. Every dive is a risk. And escape is not guaranteed.

In Island Survival 2026: Craft, Build, Grow, you must explore both the island and the depths below the water. Search beaches, jungles, reefs, and sunken ships to gather materials, craft essential tools, and slowly build everything you need to stay alive. Hunger, thirst, storms, and predators constantly test your endurance, while limited oxygen turns underwater exploration into a race against time.

To escape the island, you must construct a boat piece by piece — hull, sail, and rudder. But the final blueprint lies hidden deep inside a sunken ship, guarded by sharks and dangerous currents. Only by crafting better equipment, managing resources wisely, and pushing further into the unknown can you claim your way home.
Survival is not about speed. It’s about preparation, courage, and learning from the world around you.

Key Features

- Island survival gameplay with crafting and resource management
- Underwater exploration with oxygen limits and environmental threats
- Boat construction as the main progression goal
- Dynamic survival systems: hunger, thirst, storms, and hazards
- Semi-open world with beaches, jungles, reefs, and shipwrecks
- Story elements revealed through exploration

Survive the island.
Build your escape.
Leave the ocean behind.

70010000112618.name: Thief Simulator 2
70010000112618.intro: The door to your robber’s career is waiting! Just crowbar the lock off and force your way through the threshold. Learn skills, collect tools and become a master of the thieving trade!
70010000112618.description:
Thief Simulator 2 will transport you to a world full of valuables, expensive cars, and rustling banknotes. As long as you find a way to steal them.
Know that a thief’s trade is not a piece of cake. In order to get some practice, you’ll start with petty theft. This is how you’ll gain the experience required to access more and more risky – and most importantly, more profitable – jobs.

Gain levels and unlock new possibilities. Get useful tools. Together with newly acquired skills, they will pave the way to expensive items, which you can then sell on the black market. The tools of your trade include a crowbar and binoculars, as well as advanced equipment that becomes available as you progress, such as a laptop for hacking through security systems.

The creators of Thief Simulator 2 have prepared two unique locations with houses, banks, restaurants, and other special places that you’ll get to strip of money, valuables, and other items. But before you do, examine the surroundings: find out when the building empties out, learn the tenants’ or the employees’ schedule. Then you just need to prepare a strategy and it’s gone time.

Just be quick and efficient. You don’t have much time, so you’ll need to immediately assess which item to take and which one to leave. Can you handle the pressure, or will you panic?

Remember to keep your eyes around your head. Even the best plan can fall apart, and the local police are just waiting for a chance to put you in handcuffs. Don’t get caught. Always be one step ahead of law enforcement.
Make sure to work on cars between robbing buildings. Start with small family sedans and make gradual steps towards mastery, which will allow you to steal the coolest sports cars.


FEATURES

    • Two neighborhoods, with over 20 houses to break into. Learn tenants’ routines, pick the right time to break in, and then rob them.
    • Five heists, each with a unique location. Make your way into a resort with 6 houses full of loot, a warehouse crawling with guards, and a central bank with gold waiting to be snatched from the vault.
    • Two game modes – choose between Story Mode with a full narrative, or Free Mode for unrestricted exploration and theft.
    • Get better and better tools, ranging from a crowbar or binoculars to hacking laptops, stethoscopes, etc.
    • Make your way into houses undetected, or run in wielding a baton and knock everyone out. Alternatively, put them to sleep using sleeping gas or a tranquilizer gun. The choice is up to you.
    • Payphone missions – rob certain locations in a specified amount of time.
    • Over 15 contracts requiring you to steal unique items.
    • Level up your thief and acquire new skills, which opens up new possibilities. Learn special skills, and activate unique abilities.
    • Escape the police – intense chases with police cars and helicopters. Be careful not to get shot.
    • Upgrade your car, change its color, give it more power – or just buy a sports car and leave the police behind.
    • Steal cars – begin with a small, family sedan, and work your way up to a sports dream car.
    • Devil's Lair – they say the devil resides here. Time seems not to pass normally. Apparently the previous owner left some valuable belongings before his disappearance. Can you retrieve them, before you vanish as well?
    • Futuristic Museum – very expensive art and jewelry are stored here for all to see, but not for all to take. You might be the exception. It's a quite heavily guarded building, though.

70010000112623.name: Dirt Racing Bundle WildTrax & Rally
70010000112623.intro: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000112623.description:
This pack includes the games: WildTrax Racing and Rally Rock ´N Racing.

WildTrax Racing

Get ready to feel the wild!

In WildTrax Racing you will enjoy the wildest and most spectacular races in natural environments. You will have several game modes such as Arcade and 4-player multiplayer.

Features:

-Arcade driving
-4-Player Multiplayer
-Online ranking

Rally Rock ´N Racing

In Rally Rock 'N Racing, you’ll enjoy a wide variety of natural environments, such as deserts, snow-covered mountains, forests... where you can show your skill at the wheel, competing against everyone to become the fastest. The game has several modes, such as Championship, Time Trial, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Online leader board where you can compare your best times with those of your friends and players from around the world.

Features:

- Wide variety of tracks.
- Multi-player with 4 players.
- Realistic driving physics.
- Lots of Rock 'N Roll music.

70010000112625.name: Dirt Racing Bundle 4 in 1
70010000112625.intro: Enjoy 4 games in 1 with this irresistible games pack!
70010000112625.description:
This pack includes the games:

-Rock ´N Racing Off Road
-Speed Truck Racing
-WildTrax Racing
-Rally Rock ´N Racing

70010000112629.name: Aarik And The Ruined Kingdom
70010000112629.intro: Use the King's magic crown to solve perspective puzzles and fix a broken kingdom.
70010000112629.description:
Embark on an epic adventure in Aarik And The Ruined Kingdom, a relaxing and family-friendly perspective puzzle game that blends heart warming storytelling with mind-bending challenges. 

Join Aarik as he journeys through enchanted castles, mystical forests, vast deserts, eerie swamps, and frozen tundra, all while solving intricate puzzles to reunite his family. 

Harness the power of your father’s magical crown, equipped with four enchanted gemstones, to reshape the world around you. Fix crumbling bridges, mend broken paths, make new allies, and even reverse time itself! Dive into a world full of unique levels and devious puzzles in this captivating quest to find Aarik’s mother and restore hope to a broken land.

70010000112635.name: Afterplace
70010000112635.intro: Explore the woods, find hidden paths, hack and slash through strange monsters, and try very, very hard not to break reality. Or don't. You do you.
70010000112635.description:
Afterplace is an adventurous retro game for those who like to get lost. It's a huge open world, full of hidden secrets, treasures, and creatures. Explore the woods, fight monsters, talk to ostensibly shady characters, walk away from those characters mid-conversation (if you want to), and get so lost you fall out of the world entirely (and maybe even into another). You never know what the forest might be hiding, and not all trails are paved. Labyrinths and dungeons are tucked away in the most concealed nooks. There are no waypoints in Afterplace. You'll have to forge your own path.

Afterplace strives to bring an experience that feels both small and immense at the same time. The game has simple, fluid controls, allowing you to focus on exploration and discovery. Characters are happy to chat - or you can run right past them! You get to choose what story to explore, if any at all (we are not responsible for the consequences of ignoring the story, whatever they may be).

FEATURES

-About 10 hours of unique gameplay (and much more if you lose your way)
-No overworld map
-An open world that lets you explore any path in any order
-Tons of friends, enemies, and at least one frenemy
-The ability to upgrade weapons, purchase armor, and ingest hazardous chemicals to increase your power
-Okay maybe there is an overworld map
-Multiple endings, decided by choices you probably don't even know you're making
-Like 25 unique enemies? That's a lot, right?
-Wait, no, this overworld map is written on a napkin with crayon. That won't do. 
-Secret paths that will take you to completely normal and fun places
-A cat that you can pet. With your sword. 
-The 25 unique monsters are really special though. They have sparkling personalities, and aren't like other monsters.
-At least two overworld maps.

70010000112640.name: Bluey's Quest For The Gold Pen
70010000112640.intro: Join Bluey in a heartfelt, story-driven adventure. Explore hand-drawn worlds and enjoy an original family-friendly story written by Bluey creator, Joe Brumm.
70010000112640.description:
Explore Bluey’s World of Play!

Join everyone's favorite blue heeler with a new story by the show's creator in Bluey's Quest for The Gold Pen.

When Dad snatches the Gold Pen Bluey needs to finish her drawing, Bluey and her family are swept into a world of fun and adventure. Explore charming, hand-drawn worlds, uncover hidden treasures, and solve playful puzzles as you help bring the Gold Pen home.

Written by Joe Brumm, this original story features fully-animated cutscenes and exploration-focused gameplay, designed to be enjoyed by fans of all ages. 

Key Features:

An Original Bluey Story. Written by Bluey creator, Joe Brumm, this adventure captures the warmth, humor, and heart of the beloved series.

A World Drawn from Play. Explore nine charming, hand-drawn worlds — from golden beaches and snowy mountains to the iconic Australian Outback and beyond.

Wild Rides & Playful Exploration. Travel by boat, bike, jetpack, and glider on a fun-filled quest.

Fun Challenges & Playful Puzzles. Help Bluey and Bingoose outwit pesky cane toads, sleepy council workers, and naughty bin chickens by finding clues, solving puzzles, and uncovering hidden treasures.

Fully-Animated Story Moments. Expressive cutscenes bring Bluey’s world and adventures to life. 

An Experience for the Whole Family. Easy-to-learn controls make this adventure fun to watch, share, and take turns playing.

70010000112667.name: There's No Differences: Santa
70010000112667.intro: Can you find the differences between the two festive images?
70010000112667.description:
Do you have a sharp eye? We challenge you to test it! Find 20 differences between two similar images. But beware, they change every time you attempt it!



- 10 levels with changing differences to find (we didn't really count all the combinations, sorry!)
- cute holiday-themed items
- hints

70010000112680.name: Football Legends 2025
70010000112680.intro: Play. Score. Win. Become a Football Legend!
70010000112680.description:
Football Legends 2025 brings the thrill of the world’s most popular sport to your Nintendo Switch™!

Step onto the pitch and experience pure football excitement across multiple game modes and stadiums.

Play a Quick Match for instant action — perfect for a fast-paced challenge alone or with friends in local multiplayer.

Want more control? Choose the Single Match mode to select your favorite team, stadium, weather, and time of day — and compete head-to-head with friends or AI opponents.

Take on the ultimate challenge in Tournament Mode, where 16 elite teams battle for glory. Only the best can lift the trophy!

Multiple stadiums, each offering customizable weather conditions — from sunny afternoons to rainy nights under the floodlights.

Get ready to kick off, score spectacular goals, and become a true Football Legend!

70010000112687.name: Nitrous Fury
70010000112687.intro: Feel the speed, master the nitro, and rule the streets!
70010000112687.description:
Feel the Speed. Rule the Streets.

Step into the world of high-octane drag racing, where every millisecond counts and every gear shift can decide your fate.

Welcome to a vibrant metropolis bursting with neon lights, roaring engines, and pure adrenaline.

Test your reflexes and precision in intense straight-line races across ¼ mile, ½ mile, or full-mile tracks — both by day and under the dazzling glow of city nights.

Upgrade, tune, and customize more than 60 unique cars to dominate your rivals. Boost your engine, fine-tune your gearbox, unleash the nitro, and leave your opponents in a trail of smoke and shattered pride.

Shift. Launch. Win.

Every second counts. Every victory matters.
Feel the rush of nitro, the thrill of precision, and the glory of crossing the finish line first.

It’s not just a race — it’s a lifestyle.

70010000112693.name: READY OR DIE
70010000112693.description:
READY OR DIE drops you into situations where hesitation can be fatal and discipline is the only path to survival. As the leader of an elite tactical unit, you are sent into volatile operations where chaos, fear, and uncertainty dominate every room you enter.

This tactical first-person shooter emphasizes methodical gameplay over raw firepower. Each mission challenges you to secure hostile locations, respond to unpredictable threats, and protect innocent lives under extreme pressure. Quick thinking, clear judgment, and proper use of tactical equipment are essential to keeping control when situations spiral out of hand.

Your actions are constantly evaluated. Following procedures, minimizing collateral damage, and making the right calls at the right moment will determine your mission rating and overall progression. Reckless choices may lead to success, but never without consequences.

Key Features

- Tactical FPS with a strong focus on realism and tension
- High-stakes operations involving civilians, hostages, and suspects
- Strategic room-clearing and multiple entry methods
- Reactive AI with dynamic and unpredictable behavior
- Performance-based ranking system influenced by your decisions
- Semi-open environments offering different tactical approaches

Every mission is a test of professionalism.

Stay calm, stay precise, and remember—when the door opens, you must be READY OR DIE.

70010000112705.name: Inhuman Resources: A Literary Machination
70010000112705.intro: A literary machination about corporations, conspiracies, and the unspeakable horrors you’ll commit for minimum wage.
70010000112705.description:
Take part in an expansive choose-your-own-adventure horror story, where you’ll uncover the secrets of an anachronistic corporation reigning over a post-truth world. Solve cryptic riddles, make difficult choices, and escape the depths of SMYRNACORP with your mind intact, no matter the cost.

With hundreds of possible story routes, multiple endings, interactive puzzles and RPG elements, INHUMAN RESOURCES aims to elevate the traditional reading experience to more immersive, engaging heights, without forgoing the satisfaction of a well-crafted story.

-Experience a non-linear storyline with countless possibilities. Befriend demented coworkers, survive sadistic supervisors, and unearth the evils hidden within SMYRNACORP.

-Flesh out your employee profile by increasing your skills and finding hidden items, allowing you to discover secret paths.

-Do whatever it takes to survive your nine-to-five. Steal confidential data, distort video footage, hack a colleague's computer and crack open vaults to meet company expectations.

-Discover a collection of short stories written for the game's universe by an extensive cast of Canadian authors.

70010000112707.name: Christmas Mutilator ™
70010000112707.intro: An immersive horror and home invasion game
70010000112707.description:
Inspired by the gritty atmosphere and taut suspense of 80s slasher films, Christmas Mutilator™ is a gripping, stealth-driven horror experience set in the chilly seclusion of a lonely, snow-covered cabin. You take on the role of Amelia, a loving mother and wife who has traveled to the remote cabin to celebrate Christmas with her husband, Adam, and kids. But when a murderous maniac starts stalking the cabin, your vacation plans take a terrible turn.

Features:
-Dynamic AI – The killer reacts to your environment and actions.
-Phone Mechanic – Read messages to uncover the dark lore.
-Custom Killer Masks – Switch up the killer’s look for added variety.

70010000112709.name: Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch
70010000112709.intro: Play solo or with your hetero lifemate in this hand drawn, arcade style, side-scrolling beat-em-up blessed by Jay and Silent Bob themselves.
70010000112709.description:
Brawl your way through the streets and mall in the View Askewniverse as Jay and Silent Bob where you unleash a dizzying array of irreverent combos, special moves, collect and summon assists, in this over-the-top beat ‘em up. You’ll need to harness every ounce of smoke-fueled creativity to get past the throngs of hockey-stick wielding teenage thugs, dookie demons, hipsters with babies, old grumpy danglers and massive, movie-inspired boss battles. 

Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch combines incredible stylized, hand drawn animation, character design, and over the top combat and badass catchphrases in a side-scrolling, tag-team, beat-’em-up. Our heroes embark on an epic adventure from their humble, suburban New Jersey Quick Stop to an unearthed mystical mall that has unleashed an evil hold on the city.

No matter if you play solo and tag swap between characters or with your hetero lifemate in couch co-op, you’ll be performing special moves and outrageous combos. 

Developed with the full blessing, enthusiasm and voice-acting quips from Jason Mewes and Kevin Smith themselves, Chronic Blunt Punch gives players the ultimate, profound, and profane Jay and Silent Bob experience.

Features

- Hand-Drawn Art and Animation: Incredibly detailed, expressive and highly inspired hand-drawn animations.

- Insane combos: Bust out a cornucopia of irreverent special moves and combos that link together to create explosive finishers.

- Super Moves: Build up your super meter to launch video game inspired super attacks or save up your super meter and transform Jay and Silent Bob into Bluntman and Chronic to freeze time and deliver a devastating attack.

- Local Co-Op: Play solo or with your hetero lifemate with two-player couch co-op. Tag you’re it, snackpack.

- Cameo-palooza: During your journey, interact with cameo characters from the Viewaskewniverse and call them in to help you during intense moments.

70010000112715.name: Red Dead Redemption: Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000112715.description:
This product entitles you to download the digital Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game.

Experience the epic Western adventures that defined a generation.

When federal agents threaten his family, former outlaw John Marston is forced to hunt down the gang of criminals he once called friends. Experience Marston’s journey across the sprawling expanses of the American West and Mexico as he fights to bury his blood-stained past in the critically acclaimed predecessor to the 2018 blockbuster, Red Dead Redemption 2. 

Also included is Undead Nightmare, the iconic horror story that transforms the world of Red Dead Redemption into an apocalyptic fight for survival against a zombie horde.

Featuring the complete single-player experiences of both games, Red Dead Redemption also includes bonus content from the Game of the Year Edition and more.*

Outlaws to the End

*Red Dead Redemption does not feature multiplayer content.

70010000112716.name: Habitat Shapes
70010000112716.description:
Enjoy the relaxing puzzle of Habitat Shapes by organizing spaces for three animal families – mammals, birds, and reptiles – using Fence/Wall pieces to keep them separated. Watch out: different families cannot touch, and any attempt triggers a funny “fight cloud,” sending the last piece back to the conveyor.

With 30 levels split between the structured Urban Zoo and the organic Safari Sanctuary, Habitat Shapes offers short, accessible, and reversible challenges. Pick, rotate, and place pieces on the grid, experiment with undo and restart, and find the perfect layout of space and barriers. Each move brings small victories and satisfying moments without time pressure, letting you enjoy a flawlessly organized zoo.

Perfect for fans of spatial organization, subtle visual humor, and puzzles that reward smart experimentation.

70010000112731.name: Hotel Simulator 2026
70010000112731.intro: Hotel Simulator 2026: Clean up the Past, Build Your Future
70010000112731.description: Step into the next generation of management simulation. In Hotel Simulator 2026, you don't just run the business—you save it. Clean up neglected properties, manage staff, satisfy guests, and turn a dirty parking lot into a 5-star empire.

70010000112740.name: Fortuna Magus
70010000112740.intro: A fantasy RPG where magic is forbidden and destiny begins to move
70010000112740.description:
Amane, Tia, and Lill lived peacefully with their father, Kalius, until his sudden disappearance shattered their lives. Ten years later, a chance meeting with a magus named Rett pulls Amane and Tia into a dangerous journey. In a world where magi are feared and persecuted, standing up for Rett makes Amane a fugitive. As they flee from the law, the siblings search for answers and the truth behind their father’s fate.

Fortuna Magus features strategic turn-based battles built around revelations and TP (Technical Points). Learn new spells and tandem attacks by meeting combat conditions, manage TP to unleash devastating special skills, and strengthen characters through element levels using magestones. Deep customization and rewarding progression await long after the story ends.

70010000112789.name: Clutter 17 Flower Power Collector's Edition
70010000112789.intro: Clutter surprizes again and again with amazing new variations!
70010000112789.description:
The most entertaining and challenging Clutter yet with over 1800 puzzles to keep you playing for days and days.
So many new Clutter variations mixed in with old favorites for a Quest you'll never forget.
The newest variation you won't want to miss are the Petal Puzzles
And just like regular Clutter levels, they are highly  addicting too.
In addition, there are Sliders, Square Jigsaws and Box Quotes.
And wait until you see the Flowers used as Stackers.
You've never seen Clutter this challenging.
New Mah Jong Modes that let you play Mah Jong your way.
And Favorites allow you to collect the puzzles you want to play again and again.

x1 - New Object Sets and Many New Gameplay Modes
x2 - Over 1800 levels including a very challenging 100 level Main Quest
x3 - Extra easy No-Motion Old-School area
x4 - All new Petal Puzzles that you won't believe
x5 - New Mah Jong Modes that make Mah Jong even more fun
x6 - Hundreds of picture puzzles and 200 new Box Quotes puzzles
x7 - Randomly generated levels mean endless replayability
x8 - Another Great Soundtrack with a Cinematic Feel

70010000112794.name: Book Shop Simulator
70010000112794.description:
Breathe in that fresh book smell. Book Shop Simulator puts you in charge of your very own cozy corner of literary heaven. Start with a single shelf, a few dusty paperbacks, and a dream big enough to fill the whole store. Buy stock, run the register, and charm customers into leaving with a bag full of stories.

Upgrade your shelves, expand your selection, and create the perfect reading nooks where customers can lose hours between the pages. Whether you’re selling hot-off-the-press bestsellers or quirky comics nobody saw coming, every sale brings you closer to bookstore glory.

Decorate like a true book lover: plants in every corner, walls that tell their own stories. Still, nothing beats the smell of fresh pages and sweet, sweet profit—except maybe catching a customer secretly sniffing the books.

70010000112826.name: Arcade Archives LABYRINTH RUNNER
70010000112826.intro: Pit your wits against the Devil!!
70010000112826.description:
"LABYRINTH RUNNER" is a shooting game released by KONAMI in 1988.
You set off on a journey towards the castle where the evil Devil awaits, in order to rescue the kidnapped Princess Papaya.
Be wary of the various traps along the way, and use three types of projectiles to defeat enemies appearing from all directions as you advance!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000112840.name: Axis Football 2026
70010000112840.intro: Axis Football 2026 is a complete American Football Simulation featuring fluid gameplay, endless customization, and the industry's best franchise mode.
70010000112840.description:
Axis Football 2026 is a complete American Football Simulation featuring fluid gameplay, endless customization, and the industry's best franchise mode.

New In Axis Football 2026
* Instant replay!
* Complete play editor
* Massively improved lighting and graphics for the most realistic visuals yet!
* User action buttons for increased engagement and player reward
* New block-and-release routes
* Thousands of photo-realistic player and coach portraits
* Completely recreated announcing system
* Redesigned crowd system with dynamic population and team coloring
* Drastically improved audio featuring new crowd cheers, volume scaling, city-specific chants, and more.
* Hundreds of new routes, dozens of formations, and thousands of plays
* New aggressiveness sliders to control how often your team will go for it on 4th down
* Trade offers from teams in franchise mode
* Overhauled draft pick trading system for complete control over your picks
* New franchise settings menu to give even more customization to franchise mode
* Franchise salary cap options
* Draft and free agency player pool strength controls
* New kickoff conversion option
* Star player indicators to highlight the impact players on the field
* Overhauled AI play calling
* Expanded depth chart positions
* Refined player movement
* Massive optimization for the smoothest gameplay yet


Full Franchise Mode Features:
* Multiple league setup options (NFL-style, Tier style)
* All-time record tracking
* Player Contracts
* Trades
* Injuries
* Practice Squads
* Free Agency
* Retiring Players
* Weekly and Yearly Awards
* Dynamic, tiered league structure with playoffs, promotions, and relegations
* Unlimited seasons
* Player progressions based on performance, age, potential, and playtime
* End of season drafts
* Season-long team stats
* Individual league leader stats
* Franchise stats
* Depth chart control
* Play, coach, spectate, or simulate matches
* League and team schedule viewer
* Spectate other matches

Customization:
* Complete team creator / editor suite.
* Customize team name, colors, uniforms, field, play selection, logo, and more!
* Playbook editor
* Play editor

Game Modes:
* Player Vs AI
* Coach Mode (1p & 2p)
* Spectator Mode
* Local Player Vs Player
* Franchise Mode

70010000112857.name: DunHero
70010000112857.intro: Forge a new adventure every time you play – in DunHero, you make the rules!
70010000112857.description:
DunHero is a fast-paced fantasy action roguelite where no two runs are ever the same.

Choose your hero

Pick from 28 unique playable classes. Each hero starts with different gear, abilities, and strengths. Grow stronger with every run, unlock powerful upgrades, and experiment with builds that match your playstyle – or try something completely new!

 Begin your journey

Explore 8 dangerous worlds, each filled with unique enemies and challenging bosses. Procedurally generated maps ensure every adventure feels fresh and unpredictable. Along the way, discover over 600 powerful items and rare cards that let you craft devastating combinations and become the ultimate hero of the realm.

Every run is different.
Every choice matters.
Become the legend of DunHero.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Procedurally generated maps.
- 28 playable classes.
- 80+ Rare Cards gained from leveling up.
- 8 worlds with their own bosses and enemies.

70010000112864.name: Crosak
70010000112864.intro: Turn your world around and join Crosak on his Jurassic adventure in a multi-gravity playdough universe.
70010000112864.description:
Do you like platforming, exploration, and plumbing...? Uh, I mean... play-dough?! Well, we may not have pipes, but we can give you 64 reasons to join Crosak’s daring adventures.

1.	Become a real caveman jumping and clubbing your way through a multi-gravity universe made of sticky play-dough: six open worlds full of secrets plus three special worlds with everything a galaxy could wish for.

2.	Invite your favorite second player to have fun with Crosak and his friend Ena! Enjoy the full adventure in one- or two-player mode, switching whenever you like.

3.	Face crazy “Jurassic-inspired” enemies — from giant carnivorous plants to karate dinosaurs or our take on the missing link (the Kobi).

4.	Experiment with various power-ups to overcome the twisted planets’ challenges: anti-gravity feathers, rock-helmet, or flaming club, to name a few.

64.	And let’s not forget the main mission! Rescue the 60 cavemen from Routine Village captured by the fearsome warlock Double G. 60 objectives with all kinds of missions: races, pterodactyl flights, mini-games, free falls, T-Rex rides, powerful boss fights, and much more.

Don’t overthink it — give your world a spin with Crosak!

70010000112877.name: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered
70010000112877.description:
Return to the dark world of Nosgoth as you take control of both the vampire Kain and his betrayed lieutenant, Raziel, two powerful entities bound by the conflict between free will and fate.
  
Armed with legendary blades and supernatural abilities, battle through towering gothic spaces filled with enemies, puzzles, and long-buried secrets – where no victory comes without a cost.
 
Experience a timeless dark fantasy reborn for a new generation.
 
Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered has been updated with new HD graphics, refined controls, and a modernized game camera with the ability to toggle between the HD and original presentation any time. This new edition also boasts a photo mode, alternate character skins, a comprehensive lore reader, and unreleased content and 'lost levels' from the original game. 
 
Dual Protagonist 
Play as both Kain and Raziel, each with distinct abilities, combat styles, and perspectives that shape how the story unfolds.
 
Dark Fantasy and Rewarding Puzzles 
Explore ruined cities, ancient temples, and towering strongholds filled with environmental puzzles, challenging enemies, and horrible secrets.
 
Faithfully Remastered for Modern Play
Updated HD visuals, refined controls, and a modernized camera, with the option to switch between modern and classic presentation at any time.
 
Character Skins
Earn alternate skins for both Kain and Raziel inspired by the Legacy of Kain canon.

70010000112896.name: Exit Lab Beginner Level
70010000112896.intro: Welcome to the Exit Lab, where we research your Exit Skill! Take on beginner-friendly escape challenges and level up your Exit Skill!
70010000112896.description:
At the Exit Lab, we’re running the Exit Skill Test to collect data on every visitor’s Exit Skill!
With your personal guide, the Examiner, leading the way, take on escape rooms crafted by our Lab researchers and boost that Exit Skill!

■ Five Rooms, Each with Its Own Unique Style
The five rooms prepared for you all feature totally different themes, so every escape feels fresh and exciting.
This software offers a “Beginner Course,” perfect for first-time escape players.

■ Explore & Solve Puzzles!
Each room hides tons of items and tricky gimmicks.
Exploring every nook and cranny is the first step to escaping!
Check anything that feels suspicious and crack the gimmicks blocking your path!

70010000112902.name: Exit Lab Intermediate Level
70010000112902.intro: Welcome to the Exit Lab, where we research your Exit Skill! Take on intermediate escape challenges and level up your Exit Skill!
70010000112902.description:
At the Exit Lab, we’re running the Exit Skill Test to collect data on every visitor’s Exit Skill!
With your personal guide, the Examiner, leading the way, take on escape rooms crafted by our Lab researchers and boost that Exit Skill!

■ Five Rooms, Each with Its Own Unique Style
The five rooms prepared for you all feature totally different themes, so every escape feels fresh and exciting.
This software offers an “Intermediate Course,” designed for players who’ve already gotten the hang of escape games.

■ Explore & Solve Puzzles!
Each room hides tons of items and tricky gimmicks.
Exploring every nook and cranny is the first step to escaping!
Check anything that feels suspicious and crack the gimmicks blocking your path!

70010000112907.name: Exit Lab Expert Level
70010000112907.intro:
Welcome to the Exit Lab, where we research your Exit Skill! Challenge advanced escape rooms
and aim for that Master rank!
70010000112907.description:
At the Exit Lab, we’re running the Exit Skill Test to collect data on every visitor’s Exit Skill!
With your personal guide, the Examiner, leading the way, take on escape rooms crafted by our Lab researchers and boost that Exit Skill!

■ Five Rooms, Each with Its Own Unique Style
The five rooms prepared for you all feature totally different themes, so every escape feels fresh and exciting.
This software offers an “Advanced Course,” filled with tough and satisfying puzzles.

■ Explore & Solve Puzzles!
Each room hides tons of items and tricky gimmicks.
Exploring every nook and cranny is the first step to escaping!
Check anything that feels suspicious and crack the gimmicks blocking your path!

70010000112915.name: Who is Here?
70010000112915.intro: Nothing happened. Or did it? Keep attention.
70010000112915.description:
Who is Here? is a psychological horror game where the player is trapped in an abandoned hospital. The protagonist must survive 8 long and terrifying days, exploring corridors, wards, and hidden rooms to uncover the presence of strange anomalies.

Each day, the player must search the entire location and carefully observe the environment. Sometimes the walls seem to breathe, a shadow flashes by the window, or whispers echo from an empty ward. But sometimes… everything looks normal.

At the end of each day, the player must make a choice:

Green Sphere — if no anomaly was detected that day.

Red Sphere — if an anomaly was present.

The choice determines the outcome:

A correct decision advances the player to the next day.

A wrong decision resets all progress, and the cycle begins from Day 1.

70010000112961.name: Backrooms Level X
70010000112961.intro: Enter the disturbing world of Backrooms Level X, a first-person narrative survival horror game that immerses you in an endless labyrinth of desolate and liminal spaces.
70010000112961.description:
In a place in Albuquerque, New Mexico, USA, a strange accident occurred on October 27, 1986. Everything was recorded on a VHS tape. 

Enter the eerie world of Backrooms Level X, a first-person horror game that immerses you in an endless labyrinth of desolate and surreal spaces. After a freak accident, you find yourself trapped in the Backrooms, a place where logic and reality vanish.  Explore endless corridors of yellow carpet, empty rooms and areas of flickering light as you try to find a way out. But beware: you are not alone. Mysterious entities lurk in the shadows, and every sound may be the last you hear. 

Features: 

Immersive Exploration: Navigate an immersive environment made with unique level design. Discover hidden secrets and an immersive narrative that will draw you into the story. 

Atmospheric Horror: Immerse yourself in an oppressive atmosphere with immersive sound effects and haunting graphics that will keep you on the edge of your seat. 

Challenges and Puzzles: Solve riddles and face challenges that will test your wits as you try to escape from the Backrooms. 

Varied Environments: Backrooms Level X consists of more than 15 levels to explore. Discover the intricacies of the story and enemies, keeping each game a fresh and exciting experience. 

Defiant Bosses: Get out unscathed from huge final enemies. Throughout the exploration, we will encounter gigantic bosses that we will have to defeat with our wits. 

Do you have what it takes to survive in the Backrooms? The only way out is to face your fears and discover the truth behind this terrifying place. Download Backrooms Level X and begin your journey into the unknown!

70010000112973.name: EBOLA VILLAGE
70010000112973.intro: A classic 90s survival horror game with an emphasis on atmosphere
70010000112973.description:
A classic horror inspired by the original survival games of the 90s, EBOLA VILLAGE is a modern take on a first-person adventure where the main character, Maria, investigates a series of mysterious events.

While sitting in her apartment and watching her favorite TV series, the broadcast is suddenly interrupted by a live report about a biological threat. Concerned for her family, Maria travels to a remote village to visit her mother and her ex-husband, Ruslan… and soon, terrible things begin to happen.

Uncover the village’s dark past, piece together its intricate history, and discover who is truly behind the events unfolding there.

A carefully crafted setting and oppressive atmosphere fully immerse the player in the horror of an isolated rural settlement.

70010000112979.name: Playroom Tracks: Hill Climb Adventure
70010000112979.intro: Toy car racing where physics, skill and fun collide.
70010000112979.description:
Conquer the hills and master crazy stunt challenges. Upgrade your cars, boost your speed and get more grip.

Features:

- Action packed racing game with realistic physics
- 8 upgradeable, customizable vehicles
- 8 tracks from easy to extreme difficulty
- Easy to pick up controls

70010000112983.name: Dark Quest: Remastered
70010000112983.description:
Dark Quest: Remastered is a turn-based fantasy dungeon crawler inspired by classic board games and tabletop adventures.

A dark sorcerer has built a dungeon beneath the village of Darkwood, unleashing his minions upon the land. Lead a party of heroes into dangerous dungeons, plan your moves carefully on a grid-based battlefield, and defeat the forces of evil threatening the realm.

Perfect for short or long play sessions, Dark Quest: Remastered delivers strategic combat, charming fantasy style, and timeless gameplay—now fully remastered for modern consoles.

Features:
- Turn-based, grid-based combat
- Party-based dungeon exploration
- Classic fantasy adventure
- Remastered visuals and improvements
- Optimized for handheld and docked play

70010000112989.name: Road Champions
70010000112989.intro: Full throttle racing: no brakes, no mercy.
70010000112989.description:
Road Champions is a high-octane racing game where style meets speed. Tame the roads of the countryside, master the art of turbo boosting, and dominate a world built for speed and glory.
These modern champion riders charge through diverse tracks – be it dusty desert roads, ramshackle junkyards, or winding country lanes. Beat your opponents, compete in time trials, and participate in champion tournaments in single-player – or challenge a friend for a cutthroat couch multiplayer race!
Enjoy arcade car racing action with 16 upgradeable and customizable vehicles on 12 different racing tracks.
It is time to hit the gas!
Features
•	16 cars – Collect, upgrade, and customize your vehicles.
•	12 racing tracks – Rush through different environments.
•	A variety of boosts – Get an edge over your opponents! 
•	Choose your difficulty – Set your AI opponents’ skill to Easy, Medium, or Hard for a customizable challenge.
•	3 driver modes – Change your view to third-person, first-person, or close-up mode: what fits your racing style?
Game Modes
•	Tournament mode – Play multiple rounds against the same opponents. Collect points each round in Race, Elimination, or Time Trial modes.
•	Quick Race mode – Play a simple round on a chosen track against AI opponents.
•	Time Trial challenge – Beat set track times or your own best time.
•	Hotseat – Play against your friends for a round of split-screen multiplayer.
Earn your place among the Road Champions, where every race is a fight for glory and every second counts!

70010000112995.name: Night Swarm
70010000112995.intro: Vampiric roguelite RPG where you rise and battle werewolf hordes.
70010000112995.description:
Night Swarm is a vampire-themed roguelite RPG bullet hell where you play as a fearsome young vampire lord rising to power. Gather loyal allies, unleash devastating abilities, and fight back against the relentless werewolf hordes that threaten to consume the night.

BUILD YOUR SWARM. TEAR THROUGH THE PACK.
Ancient powers of the dark stand behind you, each offering unique, cursed blessings to aid your ascent.
Uncover why these shadowy forces have chosen to support you, unravel the truth behind the age-old war between vampires and werewolves, and delve into the haunted pasts of your companions as you push deeper into the cursed lands.
The night is yours—and you are hungry.

GROW STRONG — AND MAKE OTHERS STRONGER
Let your legend travel faster than your shadow, becoming a beacon of hope for those still resisting in the dark.
They await a new Vampire Lord—a leader worthy of the night. That leader is you.
Rally them to your side. Show them how to fight. And remind the world that the true terror of the night... is you.

YOU HAVE WORK TO DO TONIGHT
Aid friendly creatures, uncover hidden treasures, restore the natural order, and bring balance back to the night.
Sometimes you'll help your allies. Sometimes—even your enemies. Because to truly reclaim the night, it's not enough to defeat your foes; you must also ensure your friends rise with you.
By guiding others to victory, you earn their trust—and their aid in your fight against ancient evils. The night is a delicate web of power, and only those who understand its balance can hope to survive it.

70010000113004.name: Angry Cat
70010000113004.description:
Put yourself in the paws of the world’s cheekiest feline and turn Granny's peaceful home into your own chaotic playground! In Angry Cat, you’ll sneak, scratch, and smash your way through a fully interactive 3D house filled with secrets, surprises, and, most importantly, breakable items.

Cause mischief everywhere: knock over vases, scratch furniture, steal snacks, and outsmart Granny before she catches you. Each prank earns you laughs, chaos points, and hilarious reactions from your not-so-patient human.

Customize your cat with different skins and outfits. Unlock new rooms and discover hidden shortcuts as you claw your way from the living room to the attic and beyond! With smooth first-person controls and funny animations, every level is a new chance to sharpen your claws and stir up trouble, all while Granny is hot on your tail.

Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate prankster cat? Get ready to break the rules, dodge Granny’s wrath, and cause the funniest mayhem ever!

70010000113010.name: HYPERWIRED
70010000113010.intro: Hyperwired is a roguelike top-down action shooter, where your spaceship has a plug hanging from it.
70010000113010.description:
A 2D pixel art roguelike space shooter with plugged resource management, procedural levels and challenging bosses! Hold the controls tight and do not get stranded in the void!

PLUG 'N' SHOOT

- Plug in to recharge your energy and manage your resources.
- Be Careful! Once plugged, you'll only be able to move within the range of your cable!
- Space is plunged into darkness, activate the spacesockets to clear a level and travel to the next sector.

FIGHT

- Choose between 10+ different ships with different gameplay modes!
- Blast your mega-laser!
- Form an army of rescued stranded ships that will fight alongside you!
- Destroy the stages and defeat a large variety of enemies!
- Encounter dangerous and challenging BOSSES after each galaxy in your quest.

SLOW DOWN TIME

Holding the breach, dodging enemy bullets, and piloting through narrow hallways shouldn't be a problem, BUT just in case...
- Your ship is equipped with a futuristic Slow-Mo System that you can use almost whenever you want!
- Luckily for you, it recharges by collecting energy from dead enemies!

UPGRADE

- Pick up BATTERIES and discover +250 combinations of bullet modifiers!
- Get CHIPS of temporary upgrades by destroying enemies!
- Choose between more than 40 upgrades for your ship.
- Optimize charge times, improve your firepower, get more cable length...
- Become invisible to enemies.

And more!

70010000113018.name: Halloween Ghost Grabbers
70010000113018.intro: Fly with Luna the Little Witch on a fun Halloween night and catch all the magical objects falling from the sky!
70010000113018.description:
Join Luna the Little Witch for a magical Halloween night!

Fly through the sky, catch enchanted objects, and dodge cursed pumpkins in a colorful and magical adventure.

Catch ghosts, kittens, and bats to earn points.

Avoid the cursed pumpkins, or you'll lose lives!

Collect hearts and keep flying!

Use magic brooms to speed up.

Adoring 3D graphics and enchanting music.

Have fun with Luna and become the fastest little witch this Halloween!

70010000113020.name: Barista Life Simulator 2026
70010000113020.intro: Build your café, delight your customers, grow your empire.
70010000113020.description:
Step into the aromatic world of Barista Life Simulator 2026 and live the dream of running your own coffee shop! Feel the buzz of your café, the warmth of fresh coffee, and the excitement of serving happy customers. Every cup you craft tells a story, and every decision shapes the success of your business.

Welcome guests, prepare exquisite drinks, and manage your café down to the smallest detail. Master recipes from creamy lattes to bold americanos, expand your space, upgrade equipment, and decorate your shop to create a cozy, inviting atmosphere.

Key Features:
• Realistic Coffee Recipes: Craft americanos, cappuccinos, lattes, and more with precise steps.
• Café Customization: Upgrade furniture, equipment, and licenses to grow your business.
• Stock & Inventory: Keep shelves filled with snacks, croissants, juices, and water.
• Manage Staff: Hire helpers to handle cleaning, stocking, and warehouse tasks.
• Financial Strategy: Balance budgets, take loans if needed, and expand wisely.

Every day brings new challenges, new customers, and new opportunities. Can you become the ultimate barista and build the café of your dreams? Start brewing, serve perfection, and watch your café come to life!

70010000113035.name: Brotato - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000113035.description:
Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.

A spaceship from Potato World crashes onto an alien planet. The sole survivor: Brotato, the only potato capable of handling 6 weapons at the same time. Waiting to be rescued by his mates, Brotato must survive in this hostile environment.

• Auto-firing weapons by default with a manual aiming option
• Fast runs (under 30 minutes)
• Dozens of characters available to customize your runs (one-handed, crazy, lucky, mage and many more)
• Hundreds of items and weapons to choose from (flamethrowers, SMGs, rocket launchers or sticks and stones)
• Local Co-Op (four players) & local GameShare
• Survive waves lasting 20 to 90 seconds each and kill off as many aliens as you can during that time
• Collect materials to gain experience and get items from the shop between waves of enemies
• Accessibility options: tweak the health, damage and speed of enemies so the difficulty is right for you

70010000113039.name: Brain Workout! Spinning dog Puzzle
70010000113039.intro:
Spin and take a peek into the world of dogs!  
A cute puzzle game where you create adorable puppy art that will make you smile.
70010000113039.description:
This is a puzzle game where you spin panels to align dogs facing in the correct direction.  

The controls are simple: carefully look at the puzzle image and tap the panel you want to rotate!  
Depending on your clear time, you can earn 1 to 3 cute puppies.  

If you get stuck, you can use the hint button up to three times.  
It will automatically fix one row of panels to the correct orientation, so you can play without worry.  

Simple yet surprisingly deep, it’s perfect for short breaks.  
Aim for a 3-star clear on every stage and complete your Dog Encyclopedia!

70010000113045.name: Bartender Simulator 2026
70010000113045.intro: Mix fast. Think smart. Rule the bar.
70010000113045.description:
The bar is open, the lights are on, and a busy night awaits. In Bartender Simulator 2026, each shift puts your skills to the test as orders come in fast and customers expect perfection.

Step behind the counter and take full control of every pour, mix, and serve. Timers are always running, guests are watching, and even small mistakes can turn a smooth night into chaos.

Prepare a wide range of drinks by following recipes, using bar tools, and managing ingredients in real time. Work faster and cleaner to earn better rewards, while increasing pressure pushes your focus and coordination to the limit.

Between shifts, upgrade your bar, unlock new equipment, and get ready for tougher challenges. As the crowd grows, staying calm and organized becomes just as important as speed.


Key Features:
- Immersive Bartending Simulation: Experience realistic drink preparation from a first-person perspective.
- Time-Based Challenges: Manage multiple orders under pressure as demand increases.
- Interactive Drink-Making: Mix, pour, shake, and garnish through simple and engaging actions.
- Bar Progression: Earn rewards to upgrade equipment and unlock new possibilities.

Every shift is a test. Only the best bartenders last till closing.
Bartender Simulator 2026 offers a hands-on simulation where timing, precision, and smart decisions turn a simple bar shift into a true test of skill.

70010000113053.name: Anime Mother Life Simulator
70010000113053.description:
Who knew anime motherhood came with this much drama (and laundry)? Your days are packed with cooking, cleaning, kid-wrangling, and the occasional “oops” moment—but hey, someone’s got to hold this house together.

Make pancakes that may or may not end up burnt, keep the living room from becoming a Lego minefield, and still find time to help with homework (without Googling all the answers… probably). Every choice you make shapes family life, from heartwarming hugs to hilarious chaos.

Slip into stylish outfits, jazz up your home, and jump into quirky mini-games that prove mom life is basically its own anime saga. Whether you’re rushing through the morning madness or stealing five minutes of peace, you’re running the show—with a smile, a sigh, and maybe a hidden stash of chocolate.

In Anime Mother Life Simulator, parenting isn’t perfect—it’s perfectly entertaining.

70010000113069.name: Trash Goblin
70010000113069.description:
Trash Goblin is a wholesome and cosy shopkeeping game where you uncover and clean trinkets for sale! Customise them by upcycling and more to meet the eccentric requests of your endless colourful, customers. Spend your savings to upgrade your shop, buy new and better tools, and customise your space! There is no pressure, no risk, no right way to play - it is not a simulator - it's just good vibes and nice customers to serve. 
  
DISCOVER PECULIAR TRINKETS
Unearth knick-knacks of all kinds by chipping away at the dirt and cruft they're embedded inside, wrestling with different types of dirt that yield in different ways. 
  
RESTORE FORGOTTEN CURIOS TO GLORY
Scrub all these strange items up nice and clean with your sponge to get them ready for sale! 
  
UPCYLE INTO IMAGINATIVE NEW FORMS!
Customise these curios by combining Trinkets together, turning them into strange and wonderful new items! 
  
SELL TO A PARADE OF COLOURFUL CUSTOMERS
A wide range of intriguing, odd and charming customers will frequent your store, some with interesting stories to tell, others after a particular object, some just browsing... 
  
UPGRADE YOUR WORKSHOP
Spend your savings to expand your tool set, and unlock more space to work in. Buy a display mat to tempt customers with specific wares, or a soak tub to clean up overnight, an honesty box for getting rid of unwanted trinkets, and more! 
  
TREAT YOURSELF
Customise your space, decorate your shelves however you like, get some nice plants, change up the wallpaper and bedclothes; make it your own!
 
MAXIMUM CHILL, ZERO PRESSURE
There's a gentle limit to how much you can do in a given day but customers will return, you can potter as much as you like, and there are no fail states.
  
FEATURES:
• Hundreds of Trinkets and Accessories with 1000s of combinations and variations to find, clean, upcycle, sell and collect.
• Multiple Tools to buy, upgrade and use across 3 Trinket-care minigames.
• Make life easier with the Coffee Pot, Soak Tub, and other handy gadgets.
• Expand your shop with shelves, storage, and more.
• 4 distinct locations to visit and sell in.
• Customise your shop with cosmetics covering bedclothes, wallpapers, and more.
• 40 unique NPC characters to get to know and sell to.
• 120+ Quests to complete.
• 20+ hours of story content.
• Endless randomised customers. 
• Endless gameplay.

70010000113080.name: inKONBINI: One Store. Many Stories
70010000113080.description:
inKONBINI: One Store. Many Stories is a cozy, narrative-driven slice-of-life game with light simulation elements, centered on human connection and everyday moments.

Play as Makoto Hayakawa, a college student spending her summer behind the counter of a small-town convenience store, in a colorful world inspired by early 1990s Japan.

Your days are shaped by simple, tactile actions. You stock shelves, tidy displays, and prepare the store for customers, not to optimize numbers, but to settle into a comforting rhythm. Between tasks, you explore the store and its surroundings, notice tiny details, and connect with regulars whose lives gently intertwine with yours.

Through branching conversations and meaningful choices, your interactions shape relationships and reveal intimate stories of a close-knit neighborhood.

Key Features
A Cozy, Routine-Driven Store Experience

Engage in light storekeeping activities like stocking items, organizing shelves, and ordering goods. These moments create a calming flow that supports exploration and storytelling rather than complex management.

Narrative Focused Interactions
Experience branching dialogue and meaningful choices as you learn about the lives, routines, and secrets of your customers.

Nostalgic Early 1990s Atmosphere
Immerse yourself in a Japan-inspired setting with soft visuals, warm lighting, and lovingly crafted details that evoke comfort and familiarity.

Capsule Toy Surprises
Collect and discover charming capsule toys from the store’s gachapon machine. Each capsule holds a small surprise, adding moments of delight and curiosity to your daily routine and inviting you to uncover every little treasure inside.

Soothing ASMR Inspired Soundscape
Enjoy a peaceful ASMR-like soundscape filled with subtle everyday sounds that enhance relaxation and presence.

70010000113093.name: Mr Whiskers Bubbles
70010000113093.intro: Shoot the bubbles and match 3 of the same color. A beautiful classic with kitties!
70010000113093.description:
-Classic bubble-shooter mechanics with smooth, precise controls
-99 carefully designed levels with varied goals and layouts
-Distinct kitty characters that add charm and personality to each stage
-Colorful, appealing graphics and gentle sound design
-Special bubble types, boosters, and power-ups for more advanced puzzles
-A blend of objective-based and traditional bubble-clearing levels

70010000113095.name: TetherGeist
70010000113095.description: A challenging and heartfelt precision-platformer. Use powers of Astral Projection to complete a dangerous coming-of-age pilgrimage. Master tight controls, overcome challenges, and let your spirit guide you to the journey's end.

70010000113099.name: Little Strays 2
70010000113099.intro: Even in a city swallowed by silence, a brave stray cat can spark hope - one tiny pawstep at a time.
70010000113099.description:
The world has fallen silent once again. The streets are empty, the lights have faded - and what remains now belongs to something else.

Play as a courageous stray cat on a mission to rescue lost kittens, bring food to those in need, and help other strays survive in a city overtaken by new dangers. Swarm-like insects creep through the alleys, while dangerous dogs patrol the ruins of factories and streets. To survive, you’ll have to rely on stealth, speed, and the support of other strays who still believe in hope.

IN LITTLE STRAYS 2, TEAMWORK MATTERS.
Join a friend in full two-player co-op, explore ruined neighborhoods, solve puzzles, and protect each other from lurking threats.

From flooded sewers to forgotten laboratories, every area hides secrets - and every cat you rescue brings the city one step closer to life again.

Features
• Play together! - Team up with a friend in full co-op mode, share supplies, solve puzzles, and survive together.
• Explore a ruined city overtaken by insects and guarded by dogs - find safe paths and uncover hidden routes.
• Seven story-driven levels, each with unique quests and secret areas to discover.
• Find food, rescue kittens, and help other strays survive in a silent world.
• Cinematic visuals and an ambient soundtrack that evolves with your journey.

The world may be overrun… but courage still meows in the dark.

70010000113113.name: Curly Puzzle: World Heritage
70010000113113.intro:
Spin to connect! Let your brain travel the world.
— A new rotating puzzle brain-training game themed on World Heritage —
70010000113113.description:
Kurukuru Puzzle World Heritage — Spin and Spark! is a rotating puzzle game that uses beautiful photos of world heritage sites from around the world.

Split the images into 3×3, 4×4 grids and rotate each piece until it faces the correct direction to complete the puzzle!
Train concentration, spatial recognition, and inspiration while learning about world heritage.

Travel the world in your mind and boost your creativity through play!
A relaxing brain-training game enjoyable for both adults and children.

70010000113177.name: Fast Food Van Simulator
70010000113177.intro: Heat the grill. Rule the street.
70010000113177.description:
Fast Food Van Simulator is a food truck experience where precision, speed, and strategy turn a small burger van into a thriving business. Step inside your fully interactive truck, prepare orders under pressure, satisfy demanding customers, and grow your culinary reputation one perfect burger at a time.

Each session challenges you to receive orders, cook accurately, serve quickly, earn points, and collect tips. The better your performance, the more you can invest in upgrades and expansion.

Prepare a wide range of burgers — from Classic and Cheesy Deluxe to Spicy, Double, Veggie, and Breakfast specialties. Add fries, salads, drinks, and milkshakes to complete combo meals. Special requests like “no onion” or extra toppings keep you on your toes.

Manage your stock carefully, restock ingredients in real time, and upgrade your equipment to handle multiple orders faster and more efficiently. Every second counts when patience bars start dropping.

Upgrade your grill, expand storage, unlock faster movement, automate ingredient drawers, and optimize your workflow layout to maximize profits.
Dynamic customers, VIP guests, expressive reactions, and increasing difficulty make every shift unique.

Key Features
- Real-time burger preparation and order management
- Wide variety of burger recipes and combo meals
- Customer patience system and dynamic reactions
- Points and tip-based reward system
- Equipment, speed, and storage upgrades
