- Stylized 3D cartoon visuals with energetic soundtrack

Step inside your van, heat up the grill, and prove you have what it takes to turn pressure into profit. In Fast Food Van Simulator, every second matters and every perfect burger brings you closer to success.

70010000113183.name: Wake Up, Lia!
70010000113183.intro: Help Lia overcome her nightmares in a side-scrolling adventure across emotionally themed stages!
70010000113183.description:
Wake Up, Lia! is a narrative-driven 2D precision platformer set within nightmares shaped by bullying. As Lia, you will have to overcome deadly traps across 20 handcrafted stages to recover lost memories and fragments of your identity.

Embark on a heartfelt journey of trauma, resilience and rebirth, blending emotional storytelling with challenging gameplay and an atmospheric soundtrack! Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op!

• Guide a young heroine through 20 nightmarish stages.
• Run and leap with precision as you avoid deadly traps and pitfalls.
• Choose from multiple difficulties for your desired challenge.
• Recover memories to help Lia overcome emotional challenges.
• Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op.

70010000113192.name: The Sweetness that Returned
70010000113192.intro: Join Lia, Sofi, and Tomás in the Sweetness Rebellion and bring joy back to a candy-free city with the help of a magical sugar fairy!
70010000113192.description:
The Sweetness Rebellion has begun! 

Join Lia, Sofi, and Tomás on a magical adventure where candy has incredible powers!

Meet Glimmer, the Sugar Plum Fairy, and learn that sweetness can save the world.

Use candies that make you float, speak in a robotic voice, or turn you invisible.

Bring color and laughter back to a gray city where sweetness has been banned.

Take on the grumpy Mayor Grimthorne and his bumbling assistant, Mr. Grumbles.

Celebrate the Festival of Flavors where all tastes—sweet, salty, and bitter—live in harmony.

Laugh, imagine, and discover that a little bit of sweetness can change everything!

70010000113195.name: Loan Shark
70010000113195.intro: A desperate fisherman makes a deadly deal with a talking fish that trades riches for pieces of his soul.
70010000113195.description:
You’re an indebted angler, trapped in a vicious cycle of borrowing and desperation. One dark, endless night at sea you haul up something unnatural: a talking fish named Cagliuso. It promises you riches — but its bargains come with terrifying strings.
In LOAN SHARK, the nets you cast bring more than fish. They pull you toward sacrifice, secrets, and a deadline you may never meet. The “loan shark” isn’t just metaphoric — something is stalking the waters, your time is running out, and every deal you strike pushes you deeper into the unknown."
• Short, intense experience – Designed for a compact but unforgettable playthrough.
• Underwater eye-cam mechanic – Watch the lure in submerged view, anticipate the bite, then pull fast while the depths watch you.
• Fish & gut mechanic – After you reel them in, you must gut the fish yourself… carefully. Mistakes may cut you.
• Surreal dialogues & meaningful choices – Meet Cagliuso and barter with a one-eyed talking fish. Every choice alters your path.
• Time pressure & looming threat – The loan shark is coming. The clock ticks. Something hides in the darkness.
• Atmospheric horror & creeping dread – The deep sea becomes your adversary; the familiar becomes monstrous.

70010000113214.name: Build A Queen
70010000113214.intro: Showcase your looks on the catwalk and compete in thrilling fashion battles!
70010000113214.description:
Step into the world of glamour and style with Build A Queen! The ultimate fashion game where you can become a doll maker and create your dream queen!

Become a virtual fashion designer and let your creativity shine! Choose your model and dive into a project makeover. Design everything: from stunning hairstyles and flawless makeup to the hottest outfits and fabulous accessories! This is your chance to build a sweet doll with your unique style.

Features:
- Build YOUR Queen: shape your characters body with stunning or monstrous makeover choices!
- Dress to impress: customize hairstyles, makeup, outfits, and accessories.
- Get a boyfriend: outstyle your rival and win his heart!
- Walk the runway: showcase your look in fashion battles and catwalk challenges.
- Win in style: earn cash to get new victory dances and skins for your boyfriend!

Will you make the right choices to win and become the ultimate Fashion Queen?

70010000113217.name: Cakey's Twisted Bakery
70010000113217.intro: Bake pies. Fight mascots. Escape the twisted bakery.
70010000113217.description: Cakey’s Twisted Bakery is a stealth survival horror where you must bake to survive. Trapped inside a deranged bakery crawling with sweet-toothed mascot monsters, you play as a lost child searching for your brother. Sneak through candy-colored corridors, gather bizarre ingredients, and craft color-coded pies that can stun and destroy your enemies. Hide under tables, time your moves, and uncover the dark secret behind the bakery’s grinning faces. One recipe at a time, fight your way out before you become the next dessert.

70010000113220.name: Cat Girl Survivor
70010000113220.intro:
Survivor-style action with 7 cat girls!
Over 40 combination skills and infinite growth up to level 1000!
70010000113220.description:
Cat Girl Survivor is a survivor-style action game where you fight endless waves of enemies alongside adorable cat girl characters.

◆ Game Features
- 7 unique cat girl characters with distinct personalities
- Over 40 combination skills for infinite strategic possibilities
- Endless character growth up to level 1000
- Equipment system to freely upgrade your favorite weapons
- Easy and comfortable gameplay with auto-attack system
- Roguelike elements for fresh fun every playthrough
- Diverse stages and boss battles

◆ How to Play
Characters automatically attack nearby enemies. Players only need to focus on movement and skill selection. Level up to acquire new skills and combine them to unleash powerful combination skills!

◆ Combination Skill System
When you acquire specific skills together, they evolve into even more powerful combination skills. Discover over 40 combinations and create your own ultimate build.

◆ Infinite Growth System
You can level up each character to level 1000, and freely enhance your favorite weapons through the equipment system. Experience characters that become stronger over time.

◆ Endless Challenge, Infinite Dungeon
Addictively engaging gameplay that's hard to stop once you start! Each playthrough features different skill combinations, allowing you to try new strategies. Challenge yourself against increasingly powerful enemies, aim for higher floors, and enjoy the thrill of endless growth. Experience the exhilarating gameplay that makes you say "just one more run"!

Defeat the hordes of enemies and complete your ultimate cat girl!

70010000113232.name: Little Rocket Lab - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000113232.description:
You play as Morgan, an aspiring engineer headed home to complete your family's dream project - a rocket ship! Finding home not quite how she left it, Morgan will need to research and build clever contraptions and sprawling factories to help the locals. From simple drills and furnaces to complex assemblers, cranes and miles of conveyor belts, you'll convert local resources into useful materials and bring industry back to sleepy St. Ambroise.

- Build clever contraptions and sprawling factories to solve puzzles and help the town
- Get to know the locals, make lifelong friendships and become the heart of the community
- Research and invent new machines, energy sources and mechanical friends
- Discover a heartwarming story as Morgan, an aspiring engineer with high hopes for town!
- Finally build your family's rocket ship!

Outside of smashing together crazy contraptions, you'll need to mine out resources, explore coasts, railyards, quarries and underground areas - each part of town has its own materials to inspire you! You'll need to complete challenges, incorporate electrical elements, water, cranes, furnaces, crafting, automate through robotics, and loads more to ensure St. Ambroise returns to its former glory. Are you ready to roll up your sleeves?

70010000113234.name: Scorpion Champions: Island Warfare
70010000113234.intro: Conquer every island. Destroy every enemy. Become unstoppable.
70010000113234.description:
Get ready to unleash your inner champion in Scorpion Champions: Island Warfare, an exhilarating fast-paced shooter that will have you blasting your way through diverse island environments. From sun-drenched beaches to frozen tundras, you’ll face relentless hordes of enemies, strategically choose your path, and collect powerful loot to become an unstoppable force.

Features:
- Island Hopping: Blast through diverse islands, each with unique landscapes to conquer!
- Non-stop Action: Unleash a torrent of firepower on relentless enemies in fast-paced battles.
- Strategize to Dominate: Every choice matters - make tactical decisions to dominate the battlefield.
- Fresh Runs, Every Time: Dynamic challenges ensure endlessly surprising and engaging gameplay.
- Forge Your Legend: Complete missions to unlock powerful upgrades and customize your champion’s look.
- Flawless Control: Experience smooth movement and sharp combat mechanics for effortless domination.
- Endless Challenge: Test your limits with infinitely loopable runs. How far can you conquer?

Step onto the battlefield, adapt to every challenge, and prove your strength across the islands. Only the bold endure — rise, conquer, and become a legend!

70010000113240.name: Crystal Vale: Dino Escape
70010000113240.description:
Crystal Vale: Dino Escape is a fast-paced adventure platformer set in a beautiful but dangerous dinosaur world. Trapped in a mysterious crystal valley, you must outrun prehistoric predators, explore vibrant environments, and collect powerful crystals to survive.

Run, jump, swim, dash, and parachute your way through four unique maps filled with hazards, hidden paths, and relentless dinosaurs that will stop at nothing to catch you. Every crystal you collect brings you closer to escaping the valley, but danger lurks around every corner.

With fluid movement, colorful environments, and thrilling chase gameplay, Crystal Vale: Dino Escape delivers an exciting experience for players who love action, exploration, and fast reflexes.

Can you escape the valley before the dinosaurs catch you?

70010000113252.name: Street Combat Fighting
70010000113252.intro: Fight Your Way to the Top!
70010000113252.description:
Challenge the streets in Street Combat Fighting, a fast-paced 3D brawler that brings classic street fighting action to a modern, low-poly world.

Punch, kick, and combo your way through a variety of opponents on different stages, ranging from warehouses and offices to underground gyms. Master your timing, unlock new abilities, and work your way up from rookie to champion in Career Mode. Or, jump straight into Arcade Mode for quick, intense battles.

Features:
• Dynamic 3D low-poly visuals with unique environments
• Two exciting modes: Career and Arcade
• Unlockable abilities and power-ups
• Easy-to-learn, skill-based combat system
• Local versus AI battles with increasing difficulty

Are you ready to become the ultimate street champion?

70010000113296.name: Logic Bombs
70010000113296.intro: Welcome to a realm of pure logic, where rules are rules and the next step can always be deduced.
70010000113296.description:
Logic Bombs is a logic puzzle game where you use deductive reasoning to tackle 160 puzzles about bombs. The same core rules apply to every puzzle so prepare to delve deeper into a realm of pure logic where your understanding will be put to the test.

It's simple. It's complicated. It's always logical.

- A Mellow Introduction -
Tutorial puzzles introduce the rules one by one. Learn by playing.

- A Merciless Conclusion -
Explore the complexity inherent to a logical system. Learn by playing.

- No Nonsense -
There are no secrets, meta puzzles or other distractions. Focus on what's logical.

- No Hindrance -
Every puzzle has its own save slot. Do what you can, when you can.

70010000113298.name: Pin Test Party Psychology
70010000113298.intro: Laugh, guess, and reveal your true colors in this psychology party game!
70010000113298.description:
A party game for up to 8 players that reveals everyone’s hidden psychology!  
Place a pin where you feel it fits best, and see what it says about you.  
Your choices will show surprising insights into your personality!  

Play with friends or family, or enjoy it solo.  
Laugh, think, and discover yourself in this fun and mysterious psychology game!

70010000113320.name: Mysterious Experiment Quiz
70010000113320.intro: Enter the lab of logic and intuition—can you survive this mysterious quiz experiment?
70010000113320.description:
A quick true-or-false quiz about the world’s most fascinating scientific experiments!  
Did Galileo really drop objects from the Leaning Tower of Pisa?  
Did Newton discover gravity by watching an apple fall?  
Challenge what you think you know about science — facts and myths are mixed!  
Test your curiosity and learn fun trivia from physics, chemistry, and biology.

70010000113336.name: Police Chase Simulator: Highway Racers Pursuit
70010000113336.intro: When chaos hits the highway, you answer with speed.
70010000113336.description:
Get behind the sirens and feel the rush of justice in Police Chase Simulator: Highway Racers Pursuit — an adrenaline-fueled experience where every pursuit tests your nerve, reflexes, and sense of duty.
Join an elite police unit tasked with taking down reckless drivers, smugglers, and high-speed fugitives across sprawling highways and dangerous city streets. Engage in cinematic chases, execute tactical maneuvers, and show criminals that no one outruns the law.

Key Features:
	•	Dynamic High-Speed Pursuits: Chase offenders through urban chaos, scenic highways, and treacherous mountain passes. Each pursuit offers new challenges and strategies.
	•	Authentic Police Gear: Ram suspects, set up spike traps, trigger sirens, and unleash nitro bursts to dominate the chase.
	•	Stunning Realism: Experience lifelike graphics, detailed patrol cars, and atmospheric environments that capture the tension of real police work.
	•	Mission Variety: From spontaneous pursuits to planned sting operations, every mission brings unique goals and escalating intensity.
	•	Intuitive Controls: Simple yet precise controls let you stay focused on the chase and react in split seconds.

Police Chase Simulator: Highway Racers Pursuit isn’t just about speed — it’s about justice on wheels.
Step into the driver’s seat, hit the lights, and prove that no outlaw escapes the long arm of the law.

70010000113342.name: Pit Panic
70010000113342.intro: Escape the sinking Aztec temple in this cartoonish rogue-like arcade platformer.
70010000113342.description:
Pit Panic is a challenging rogue-like 2D platformer with fast pace, unique gameplay and environmental puzzles.

Take on the role of a curious archeologist and race through handcrafted levels, take down ancient bosses and jump up like your pants are on fire.

GET HOOKED!
Wield the mysterious hook – a powerful omnitool – that digs through blocks, swings you around and unlocks hidden treasures. Master physics-driven movement to avoid deadly traps and blast through interactive blocks. Turn sand into glass, jelly into fire and bridges into weapons, if necessary.

THINK FAST, RUN FASTER
You will have to dig deep to return to the surface. There are many ways to die, but only one way to survive: up. Get in the flow, make split-second decisions and even sacrifice your health for power-ups to escape the crumbling Aztec temple.

EVERY RUN IS DIFFERENT
Discover four distinct biomes, each with unique puzzles, enemies and art styles. Over 1,000 unique handcrafted levels mix things up every time you play. Or build your own levels to put fellow adventurers to the ultimate test.

CHALLENGE OTHER PLAYERS
The real fun starts after you climb out of the pit. Compare your skills with other players, beat their best times and complete unique daily challenges to receive precious rewards.

70010000113345.name: CloverPit Gamble
70010000113345.intro: Escape the pit before it drags you deeper.
70010000113345.description:
CloverPit Gamble is a hellish fusion of card madness and deadly roulette. A rogue-lite where you’ve built your own prison and are now doomed to rot inside it. Chained in a damp iron cell, face-to-face with a trembling slot machine and a greedy ATM, you must pay your debt after every round… or be consumed entirely and dragged into the endless pit of debt.

Survival here means twisting luck to your will. Spin the reels of the slot machine, squeezing out the last coins. Bend trophies and charms to your advantage, tearing the rules apart and forging devastating chains of combinations. Play dirty, break the system, feed your captor—until the moment comes when you might escape this rotten trap.

Key Features:
- A ruthless rogue-lite where each round could be your final breath.
- Progression system, multiple endings, and hidden rewards for those who endure.
- Endless Mode: try to beat your own records while the chamber gnaws away at your sanity.
- The atmosphere of a rusted chamber turned into a hellish puzzle box.
- A grim tale of addiction, debt, and the futility of escape.

But remember — in CloverPit Gamble, every spin is a deal with the devil, and every victory only brings you closer to the next fall. The question isn’t if you’ll lose… it’s how deep you’ll sink before the pit swallows you whole.

70010000113351.name: Decline's Drops
70010000113351.description:
In another Place, In another Time,
There lived, far away from everything, from everyone,
A small puppet made of oak and birch tree, hidden behind the forest.

OVERVIEW:

Decline's Drops is a beautiful hand-drawn 2D platform-brawler, in which you play as Globule, a wooden boxing-gloved Puppet who seeks revenge for her destroyed Garden.

Each world, each character has been meticulously designed and crafted, made with love, passion, and care.Dive into 6 worlds, each one of them being a subtle satire of our own world.  From the destruction of the environment to the exploitation of the animals, through the pollution of the seas and the impacts of high consumerism, Decline's Drops, without being a moral speech, has a lore focused on these different aspects of our modern society.

FEATURES:

• Discover a poetic, vibrant and somehow melancholic universe in an unexpected side-scrolling, hand-drawn adventure.

• Defend yourself with your powerful gloves using a wide range of attacks, allowing you to adapt to each and every situation.• Travel through 6 beautiful hand-crafted worlds, each stage bringing unique ideas and environments.

• Avenge your garden by defeating all of the 6 Hydra heads and reveal the true reason behind the apparition of the Decline.

• Meet Serge, the engaging Genetically Modified Monkey. In exchange for precious « Drops », He'll grant you helpful tools to help you during your adventure !

Grab your punching gloves, put your clogs on, it's time to SMASH.

70010000113356.name: Dark Fall: Ghost Vigil
70010000113356.intro: Darkness doesn’t arrive suddenly — it builds slowly.
70010000113356.description:
Join the all-night investigation at an abandoned building where reports of paranormal activity have never stopped. As a member of a ghost-hunting team, explore empty rooms and dark corridors while monitoring supernatural phenomena.
Use professional detection equipment to track strange fluctuations, record unexplained sounds, and document sightings. As the night progresses, activity intensifies and the building’s hidden past begins to surface.

Key Features:
	•	Explore a large abandoned location filled with dark rooms and hidden areas
	•	Use ghost-hunting gadgets to detect and record paranormal activity
	•	Investigate dynamic supernatural events that escalate throughout the night
	•	Find clues and environmental details that reveal the building’s history
	•	Solve puzzles and uncover the mystery behind the haunting
	•	Immersive atmosphere focused on tension and suspense


The night is long, and the building is never truly silent. Every sound could be a sign, every shadow a warning. Stay focused, trust your equipment, and uncover the truth before it’s too late.
Will you leave with evidence… or become part of the legend?

70010000113362.name: CASSETTE BOY
70010000113362.intro: In this world, what you do not see ceases to exist. Will you master the power of perception and call the moon back?
70010000113362.description:
Is the moon there when nobody looks?
Einstein once asked this famous question about quantum mechanics.
This game takes that idea and turns it into a mysterious puzzle RPG, where the world itself only exists when you see it.

At first glance Cassette Boy looks like a charming pixel-style adventure, but beneath the surface lies something far more complex.
What seems like a flat 2D pixel world is in fact a three-dimensional space. By rotating the environment, the boundaries of existence shift. What comes into view becomes real, and what slips away from sight fades into nothingness.

To solve puzzles you’ll need to twist and turn the map, revealing hidden paths or making obstacles disappear simply by shifting your perspective. Anything concealed from your view is erased from reality. A wall that blocks your way can vanish, while a secret passage can suddenly emerge.

But it’s not just about solving puzzles. You’ll gather weapons, face monsters, and challenge powerful bosses as you uncover the secrets of this strange and fragile world. Every fight and every puzzle pushes you deeper into the mystery of existence itself.


Story:

“The moon is gone.
It slipped away when you looked aside.
And now the world begins to crumble.
When you turn away, the things that matter most fade into nothing.
So keep your eyes open.
Come, let us seek the moon”

You awaken in a world of darkness, guided only by a glowing orb. It whispers the truth: what you cannot see does not exist. The moon has disappeared because you looked away, and without it the world is breaking apart. You are the one who must find it.

With this secret revealed, you set out on a journey where absence and presence are one and the same. To bring the moon back, you must learn to master the very nature of existence.


Features:

Unseen = Uncertain.
In Cassette Boy, the “Schrödinger System” ensures that anything you can’t see simply doesn’t exist. That person you just spoke to? The switch you were about to press? If they leave the screen, they’re gone.

Rotation-Based Mechanics.
The game world is built in 3D, and you’ll rotate the map to change what’s visible. This changes the way puzzles are solved in ways you've never experienced.

Perspective as Gameplay.
Your viewpoint isn't just cosmetic—it's a core mechanic. Ordinary camera movement becomes the key to solving mind-bending puzzles.

A Retro Look with a Modern Twist.
It may look nostalgic, but every twist of this game offers something completely new, a surreal experience that plays with reality itself.

70010000113367.name: Mini Golf Quest
70010000113367.intro: Can you conquer every hole and become the ultimate mini golf champion?
70010000113367.description:
Get ready to tee off in Mini Golf Quest, a charming low-poly adventure through colorful, handcrafted courses! Test your skill and precision as you navigate creative obstacles, tricky turns, and challenging holes across vibrant mini golf worlds.

Each course offers a relaxing yet rewarding experience — perfect for players of all ages. Master your aim, plan the perfect shot, and try to score under par as you progress through each uniquely designed level.

Whether you’re chasing high scores or just unwinding after a long day, Mini Golf Quest delivers the perfect blend of fun, challenge, and calm atmosphere.

70010000113378.name: Gravity Biker
70010000113378.intro: Get ready to twist, flip, and fly — gravity is no match for your wheels!
70010000113378.description:
Defy gravity and race through thrilling obstacle courses in Gravity Biker! Hop on your futuristic bike and master the art of balance, timing, and precision as you perform daring jumps, flips, and stunts across challenging tracks.

Each level brings new obstacles, traps, and surprises — can you keep your wheels on the ground and make it to the finish line? Collect boosts, pull off smooth landings, and push your skills to the limit in this fast-paced physics-based adventure.

With colorful cartoon visuals, easy-to-learn controls, and addictive gameplay, Gravity Biker is perfect for players who love speed, stunts, and a good challenge.

70010000113387.name: Cave Ranger
70010000113387.description: When the Bitty Gang steals the town's livelihood and takes it underground, a lone, brave cowboy must come to the rescue. Cave Ranger is an 8-bit inspired, retro platform game. Rescue sheep, fight outlaws, and face down dangerous critters. With a whip and pistol at his disposal, the cave ranger must traverse old mines, water reservoirs, and even a sawmill! It is a lighthearted, laid-back western, full of platformer fun.

70010000113389.name: Super Scram Kitty
70010000113389.intro: Stop the evil Nezu-Me corporation's plan for eternal domination!
70010000113389.description:
The sprawling Nezu-Me space station has been overrun with devious, mutated mice! Roll around the rails in a unique blend of platform game and 2D shooter. Blast enemies, dodge threats, destroy the Nezu-Me core and get all the stranded cats back home!

Super Scram Kitty is a complete re-imagining of 'Scram Kitty and his Buddy on Rails', with all new controls, remixed stages, updated enemy behaviours, and new visual effects.

70010000113395.name: Peaceful Fishing Story
70010000113395.intro:
Relax and unwind.
Enjoy a slow life all your own, spent fishing at your own pace.
70010000113395.description:
A gentle, laid-back life begins in a village surrounded by nature.
Cast your line into rivers, lakes, and the open sea, and enjoy fishing whenever the mood strikes.
Spend peaceful days getting to know the village's charming residents and soaking in a calming, heartwarming atmosphere.

Before long, massive King Fish lurking in the waters will reveal themselves.
Beyond them awaits a legendary creature spoken of only in tales.
Sharpen your skills, upgrade your gear, and challenge the Legendary King!

[Easy-to-Learn Fishing Controls]
Fishing is simple and intuitive!
Tilt the stick to line it up with the gauge, then hold down the button!
Reel in your catch before it gets away!

[Over 120 Types of Creatures to Discover!]
Fill out your collection, aim for record-breaking sizes, and enjoy plenty of challenges.
Explore different locations and strive for 100% completion!

[Collect Fishing Gear]
Use the money you earn to buy new equipment.
Gather fishing rods and lures to take on even bigger fish!

[Interact with the Villagers]
Chatting with villagers may earn you helpful fishing tips.
Sometimes, you'll be invited to partake in fun minigames like catching runaway chickens or racing along the beach, all for special rewards!

[Customize Your Home]
Place purchased furniture in your house and make it your own.
Decorate with your favorite items, display your caught fish in a tank, and create a room that's uniquely yours.

[Online Rankings]
Take on the Score Attack Challenge at the local fishing hole!
See how many fish you can catch within the time limit and test your skills.
Check rankings based on your total catches and aim for the top spot.
Fish your way to No. 1!

70010000113402.name: Star Quiz Airline Two-Choice Universe
70010000113402.intro: Become a star pilot and fly through the universe of quizzes!
70010000113402.description:
A fun true-or-false quiz about stars, planets, and the mysteries of space!

• Is the Sun large enough to fit one million Earths inside?
• Is a day on Venus longer than a year on Venus?
• Can you really not hear any sound in space?

Discover fascinating facts about the cosmos in a simple two-choice quiz!
Answer ○ or × and see how much of a true space explorer you are!

70010000113426.name: Voxel Panic
70010000113426.intro: Blast your way through swarms of robotic enemies in this fast-paced, retro-style sci-fi FPS!
70010000113426.description:
Armed with unique and powerful weapons, you’ll fight your way across three action-packed levels filled with chaos, explosions, and voxel-based mayhem. Collect health, ammo, and shimmering gems to stay alive and upgrade your arsenal as you battle ever-stronger enemies.

Dodge incoming projectiles, outsmart flying drones, and unleash devastating firepower to survive the panic! With colorful low-poly visuals and old-school shooter energy, Voxel Panic delivers a thrilling arcade experience that’s easy to pick up but hard to put down.

Are you ready to blast, dodge, and conquer the voxel invasion?

70010000113432.name: DUNGEON RAZE
70010000113432.intro:
Demolish walls to grow stronger!
A high-octane, magic destruction shooter.
70010000113432.description:
DUNGEON RAZE is an intense power-trip where you don't crawl through the dungeon, you blast through it. Become a destruction magic-wielding witch and reduce every wall and defense system to dust.

Demolish Everything in Sight
Not even the walls of the dungeon can stop you. Tear through the map to hunt down gold, power-ups, and rescue allies. Your firepower vaporizes the dungeon as you go

Experience Instant Hyper-Inflation
Forget grinding for gradual stat upgrades and go for explosive growth. Power scaling that defies logic is achievable within minutes. Watch your projectiles multiply, and your damage skyrocket until even the toughest walls satisfyingly crumble in a single shot.

Lead a Mobile Fortress
No one razes alone. Smash through the rubble to rescue imprisoned adventurers and add their firepower to your own. As your squad grows and your inflation peaks, the screen fills with a chaotic storm of magic and munitions that no defense can withstand.

Push Your Destructive Limits
Find out just how much devastation you can unleash:
- Eternal Dungeon: No limits, no end. See how far your "hyper-inflated" firepower can go in a procedurally generated maze of infinite destruction.
- Speed Raze: How fast can you raze the core? A time-based mode where every second counts.
- Hard Dungeon: High-difficulty stages filled with tougher walls and enemies, designed to challenge your ultimate power. Encounter special allies and powerful, unknown foes.

70010000113438.name: Tyrant's Realm
70010000113438.intro: A brutal retro roguelite adventure: explore cursed realms, defeat monstrous bosses, and rise again after every death.
70010000113438.description:
Welcome, Brave Hero, to a World Lost in Time.

Embark on a roguelite adventure that pays tribute to the golden era of gaming.
For generations, your family has fought relentlessly to end the reign of the Tyrant, an ancient being who seeks absolute power and knowledge. The journey will push you to your limits, as each run through the ever-changing realms brings new challenges and opportunities.

The world is a brutal, decaying shadow of what it once was, with fallen cities and lost empires turned into treacherous landscapes.

Gear is Your Lifeline. 
As in true roguelite fashion, survival hinges on what you find. Unlock new weapons and armor and find hidden Skull Altars to upgrade your power., and arm yourself for the endless journey ahead. Without these, you are nothing.

Roguelite Progression, Soulslike Combat. 
Each run is unique. Engaging combat mechanic —requiring timing, skill, and a bit of luck—determine your fate. Fight, die, learn, and rise again as the challenge intensifies with every attempt.

Ever-Evolving Worlds and Relentless Foes. 
Every biome and encounter is procedurally generated, with enemies and bosses ready to strike you down at every turn. No two runs are the same.

70010000113451.name: SUPER BOMBERMAN COLLECTION - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000113451.intro: Hit party battle game series ‘SUPER BOMBERMAN’ now available as a collection!
70010000113451.description:
Party battle game "SUPER BOMBERMAN" is now available as a collection featuring a total of 7 titles with 12 versions across JP, EUR and USA, including the long-awaited localised versions of the unreleased SUPER BOMBERMAN 4 and 5!
Including Boss Rush mode to time attack against all the bosses in each title, support functions, libraries and more!

【Included Titles】

① SUPER BOMBERMAN [Japanese Version / US Version / European Version]
Mr. Karat, the evil power-hungry tyrant, and scientist Dr.Mukk! Defeat the robot army they command and thwart their ambitions!

② SUPER BOMBERMAN 2 [Japanese Version / US Version / European Version]
Our Bomberman has been captured by the sudden appearance of the vicious Bomber Quintet. For the sake of Earth's peace and his own destiny, he must confront them!

③ SUPER BOMBERMAN 3 [Japanese Version / European Version]
The evil Professor Bugler has revived the vicious Five Dastardly Bombers, once defeated by Bomberman, and has begun his march towards cosmic conquest.

④ SUPER BOMBERMAN 4 [Japanese Version (English localised version available)]
Bomberman has been transported to different eras by the Four Bomber Kings. What is their purpose? And what is the mysterious entity lurking in the shadows?

⑤ SUPER BOMBERMAN 5 [Japanese Version (English localised version available)]
A mysterious man calling himself the Emperor of another world, ‘Terrorin’. He has freed eight ‘Vicious Bombers’ from prison and begun an invasion with them as his subordinates.

⑥ Bomberman [Japanese Version]
The commemorative work that laid the foundation for the series. Conquer all 50 stages!

⑦ Bomberman II [Japanese Version]
The sequel to Bomberman. The work that implemented versus play.

【Support Features, Helpful Functions and New Modes】

‘Boss Rush’
A challenge mode where you battle bosses from each game consecutively in a time attack!

‘Save/Load Anytime’
Save or load your game at any point during gameplay

‘Rewind Function’
A handy feature allowing you to rewind and retry at any point

‘Screen Filtering Function’
Adjust resolution or apply screen filters to play with your preferred visual settings

‘BOMB Radio’
Listen to original soundtracks from each title. You can also create your own playlists

‘Gallery’
Browse art works and development materials. Over 200 items in total!

70010000113456.name: CRYZON part2
70010000113456.intro:
Get the crystals!!
Play in split-screen multiplayer with 1-4 players!
30 stages! Normal and Hard difficulty!
70010000113456.description:
The objective is to collect the crystals located on the stage by utilizing jumps and dashes.
The stage is a 3D space with height, width, and depth. There is gravity, and the player controls their character by moving forward, backward, left, and right, and jumping to move vertically, aiming for the crystals.

Features
• Collect the crystal to clear the stage!
• 30 stages in total!
• Difficulty levels can be selected; Normal mode is relatively easy to clear, while Hard mode is extremely difficult.
• Collect coins to make crystals appear!
• Up to 4 players can play in split-screen mode!
• Use items to power up your abilities!
• Defeat enemies!
• There is a sword as a weapon!
• Use dodge actions to move around!

Multiplayer
• Cooperate with everyone to collect coins!
• Cooperate with everyone to defeat enemies!
• Be the first to get the crystal!

70010000113462.name: SnapCat: Mia's Cozy Adventure
70010000113462.intro: SnapCat is a cozy exploration game about finding cats and capturing quiet moments across peaceful islands.
70010000113462.description:
Pack your things, we're going on a trip! We're going to visit breathtaking islands and make the most of the summer sun. But remember - the core item in your luggage is your camera!
Aside from admiring the architecture and colorful flora, we have one crucial mission - documenting the furry inhabitants of the islands. Can you find and photograph all of them? 
Grab your camera and get ready for the cat-tastrophe of cuteness! 
No timers, no battles, no pressure—just pure, pawsitive vibes. 

Wander across bright, bubbly islands that feel like an endless summer vacation—but keep your eyes peeled! These fuzzy superstars love to hide, lounge, stretch, and strike suspiciously perfect poses. Aside from taking pictures, you can fill their cute little water bowls to keep them happy, and, most importantly, don't forget to pet them! 

Every photo you take lands in your super-colorful Cat-alog Album, where you can admire your masterpieces, name your new feline friends, and relive every whisker-wiggling moment.

Snap Cat:
Bright colors. Big personalities.
Cats who act like they’re the stars of their own cartoon show.
(And honestly… they kinda are.)

KEY FEATURES: 
- 17 colorful islands full of kitties 
- cozy, stress-free gameplay and feel-good atmosphere
- relaxing music, perfect for unwinding after a long day
- photo album with all your pictures and the option to name the cats

70010000113468.name: Cute Finders
70010000113468.intro: Your mission starts now! Objective? Find the subtle, silly, and sneaky differences between the two images displayed!
70010000113468.description:
Step into beautifully cluttered rooms, each one a delightful package of cozy furniture, vibrant decor, and cute animals just doing their things, and look close! Can you spot the missing carpet? Different plant? Cute bunny being replaced by a cat? 

Just remember: be prepared for the unexpected! The elements in the same level vary each playthrough and our special Endless Level is designed to keep you guessing... endlessly. Boredom is not an option! 

KEY FEATURES: 
-30 cozy levels + 1 endless level.
-800 room variants.
-560 cute pieces of furniture, decorations and animals variants.
-Adorable art style you can never get tired of. 
-Relaxing music, allowing you to unwind after a long day. 
-Cognitive training gameplay, boosting your focus and perceptiveness.

70010000113474.name: Exit of Truth! 40 Masterpiece Quiz
70010000113474.intro: Uncover the truth hidden in famous masterpieces. 40 challenges that will put your sensitivity and observation skills to the test
70010000113474.description:
This game is a simple true-or-false quiz about fascinating trivia from the world of famous paintings, artists, and art history.

• Did the Mona Lisa have no eyebrows?  
• Did Van Gogh sell only one painting during his lifetime?  
• Was Picasso called a genius since childhood?  

Full of surprising “art truths” you might not know!  
Answer ○ or × and test your “Art Master” level in this fun quiz!



The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000113481.name: Spot Challenge Vol. 1
70010000113481.intro: Sharpen your eyes and test your focus in the ultimate spot-the-difference challenge!
70010000113481.description: Spot Challenge Vol. 1 is a game series inspired by the classic "Spot the Differences", where you need to compare two images and identify the differences between them. With over 360 differences spread across 35 levels, will you be able to find them all? Perfect for playing solo or with friends and family, Spot Challenge is the ultimate challenge to test your attention to details!

70010000113487.name: Nickelodeon Extreme Tennis: Next!
70010000113487.intro: Hit the tennis court for some fast-paced arcade action as your favorite Nickelodeon all-star! Customize SpongeBob and more legendary characters, then enjoy couch co-op matches!
70010000113487.description:
Challenge a friend to a tennis match where you can play as SpongeBob, Aang, and all your Nickelodeon favorites in fast-paced, local split-screen action!

All-Star Nickelodeon Characters: Pick your star player from among 15 iconic Nickelodeon characters from SpongeBob SquarePants, Avatar: The Last Airbender, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles and more!

Play It Your Style: Choose from over 500 outfits and accessories to customize your Nickelodeon character your way, and show off your personality on the tennis court. Turn the tide of the match with powerful ultimate abilities that are unique to every character!

Play Solo or Local 1v1: Challenge a friend or family member to a 1v1 couch co-op split-screen tennis match, or play in Story Mode at your own speed!

Instant Fun for Everyone: You don't need to be a pro to have fun! Start playing instantly with easy-to-learn controls, accessible for the entire family.

Multiple Ways to Play: From classic matches to fun mini-games, there's something for everyone. Embark on a narrated Story Mode, dive into Mini-Games for extra fun, or rise to the top in Tournament Mode to claim your victory!

70010000113499.name: Last Battalion Defense
70010000113499.intro:
Command your arsenal!
Defend the realm. Enjoy tower defense.
Your battalion is humanity's last hope.
70010000113499.description:
Last Battalion Defense blends intense arcade shooter action with deep strategy and tower-defense mechanics. Command humanity’s final defensive line across 3 unique maps as you battle through 5 escalating waves of soldiers, armored vehicles, and military convoys. Manage powerful weapon systems and upgrade your defenses between waves to survive the onslaught.

Strategic Arsenal Management

Your success depends on mastering four specialized military weapon systems, each serving a distinct tactical purpose:

Artillery: Shreds infantry with rapid, suppressive fire.

Cannon: Delivers devastating area damage, wiping out troops and breaking armored vehicles.

Mortar: Provides explosive bombardments to halt enemy advances.

Patriot Missile System: A dominant all-purpose weapon capable of eliminating any threat with overwhelming force.

Each weapon offers unique strengths, letting you create the perfect defensive setup for every battlefield.

Dynamic Shop & Upgrade System

Between enemy waves, head to the Armory to manage your battlefield economy. Spend your earned coins to:

Purchase new weapon turrets

Repair damaged defenses

Upgrade your firepower

Unlock additional fortified positions

Every decision matters—expand your coverage, reinforce your strongholds, or save resources for later waves.

Tactical Depth & Adaptation

When the pressure becomes overwhelming, call in devastating air support to clear enemy forces and regain control.
As waves grow stronger, faster, and more coordinated, you must constantly adapt—balancing repairs, upgrades, expansion, and ability usage to endure the escalating assault.

70010000113505.name: Capy Spa
70010000113505.intro: Capy Spa: The Most Relaxing Bath in the Savanna
70010000113505.description:
Grab your towels because the chillest capybara in gaming is ready for a soak! In Capy Spa, you help Pipa, a relaxation-loving capybara, push herb buckets into hot springs to prepare the perfect bath.

With 30 carefully crafted levels, two charming biomes (Savanna River and Forest Onsen), and a soothing soundtrack that blends with the rising steam, every stage invites calm and thoughtful moves.

No enemies, no timer, no rush. The focus is on smart movement, experimenting, undoing, and trying again until you find the perfect sequence. Sometimes, pools start already filled, and you’ll need to reorganize everything with patience and logic.

It feels like solving a puzzle while watching steam dance and leaves drift by. Each completed level brings that quiet satisfaction of seeing Pipa’s spa finally ready to relax.

Capy Spa is the kind of puzzle that makes you smile in peace, turning simple bucket-pushing into a zen and delightful experience.

70010000113516.name: Minima
70010000113516.intro: A tiny world filled with big memories.
70010000113516.description:
Meet Ian, an 11-year-old dreamer whose imagination brings his room to life. Minima invites you to experience an interactive story told through light, sound, and discovery.

Explore a world of childhood memories, gaze through Ian’s telescope, peek into his glowing tent, and discover the simple magic hidden in everyday things. Its warm colors and handcrafted design take you on a peaceful, nostalgic journey through a child’s eyes.

Features:
• A heartfelt, story-driven experience told entirely through atmosphere and discovery.
• Handcrafted minimalist visuals that capture childhood nostalgia.
• A calming soundtrack that invites reflection and warmth.
• Explore, observe, and relive moments of imagination and light.

Minima is not just a game, it’s a quiet memory brought to life.

70010000113522.name: Cute Astro
70010000113522.intro: A Puzzle Show on the Star Stage
70010000113522.description:
Cute Astro is a cozy, pixel-art puzzle where you play a rockstar mouse pushing tasty cheese cubes across musical score boards. Each board has score holes that must be filled with cheese to complete the riff and open the way forward. The challenge is all about careful planning, avoiding deadlocks, and pushing in the right order.
With 30 handcrafted levels, two themed stages, instant Undo and Restart, and a playful concert atmosphere, it’s perfect for casual players and logic-puzzle fans who enjoy relaxing, brain-teasing challenges.
Across 30 levels in two biomes, the crisp Purple Stage and the warm Orange Stage, the player enters a compact grid filled with obstacles, cheese cubes, and score holes. A level ends only when every hole is filled. There is no timer and every action can be reversed through Undo or Restart, keeping the focus on planning, iteration, and discovery.
Moment-to-moment the loop is simple and satisfying: observe, plan a route, move tile by tile, push cheese into place, adjust with Undo or Restart, fill every hole, and enjoy the musical sting that celebrates your victory.

70010000113529.name: Greyhill Incident Re-probed Edition
70010000113529.description:
Greyhill Incident is a story-driven Survival-Horror game that takes place during the early 90s. As Ryan Baker, equipped with a baseball bat and a few bullets in his trusty revolver, the story takes you across the atmospheric neighbourhood of Greyhill, which is invaded by UFOs & grey Aliens.
EXPERIENCE A CLASSIC ALIEN INVASION STORY
The recent increase in paranormal activities over the last few days have convinced the scared and now paranoid residents of Greyhill, that the Aliens are amongst them.
They trust no one. The small neighbourhood of Greyhill is afraid to speak up and fearing being sent to the psychiatric ward, they avoid calling the police.
Alone, they prepare by boarding up their windows and starting a neighbourhood watch.
GET ACROSS THE NEIGHBOURHOOD
Ryan Baker attempts to cross the neighbourhood of Greyhill to save a neighbour who is in serious trouble. Find useful items, solve puzzles and meet other humans as you fight to survive the invasion and guide Ryan through the neighbourhood.
INVESTIGATE AND UNCOVER THE TRUTH
Sneak through the open areas of Greyhill. Investigate houses & barns and search for ammo while you work your way through the village and uncover the Alien conspiracy.
BEWARE OF THE GREYS
"They" are a constant threat as they try to abduct people from the village, take samples of everything, experiment and probe people.
Sneak, Run or fight to get through Greyhill and beware of "The Greys".
Includes new content and an alternative ending specifically for the Nintendo Switch™ version.

Found Footage Mode – Play the whole game through a "Found Footage" view.
Digital extras including Bob's Tin Foil Hat Manual, Conspiracy Advertisement, Newspaper and Wallpaper.
Original Soundtrack – "Main Theme" and "This is Our World".

70010000113536.name: Hummingbird Garden
70010000113536.intro: A Garden Full of Blooming Puzzles
70010000113536.description:
Get ready to flap your wings and fire up your brain, because the hummingbird is about to turn the garden into a festival of logic. Hummingbird Garden is a charming pixel-art puzzle where you push little pollen nuggets through tight pathways until each flower blooms in a colorful display. It is the perfect mix of calm thinking, strategy, and a touch of natural magic.

You study the garden, choose the best route, avoid getting stuck, and decide the right order to deliver each pollen nugget. There is no rush. Every move can be undone with Undo or tried again with Restart, letting you experiment freely until you find the most elegant solution. It is a game made for thinking peacefully and enjoying every small discovery.

With 30 handcrafted levels divided into two biomes, the gardens offer varied terrain, natural obstacles, and many satisfying moments when flowers light up to celebrate your success. Each level feels like a small pollination mission, and completing one gives that delightful sense of making the world a little more beautiful.

70010000113542.name: M.A.D. Cows
70010000113542.description:
Militant. Armed. Domestic. Cows!

For centuries, the aliens mutilated cattle with little to no consequence. Finally, the cows had enough. They organized. They trained. Now they are ready... for their revenge!

M.A.D. Cows is an exciting, retro, action platform game. Mow down aliens. Buy better guns. Rescue cows, dogs, raccoons, and more.

70010000113544.name: Magic Sheep
70010000113544.intro: A Cozy Puzzle of Barrels and Marble Charms
70010000113544.description:
Get ready to fluff your brain and relax your heart, because this little sheep in a top hat is about to turn puzzle-solving into the cutest ritual of calm you’ve ever seen. Magic Sheep is a charming, slow-paced puzzle adventure where you push wooden barrels across peaceful gardens until each one rests perfectly on a marble pedestal. No pressure, no timer, only soft music, gentle thinking, and plenty of “oh, that was clever” moments.

Each level is a tiny diorama built with love. You study the layout, plan a clean path, slide through narrow passages, avoid blocking yourself, and decide the perfect order to move each barrel. If something goes wrong, no worries at all. Undo takes you back one step, Restart lets you rethink the whole puzzle, and the atmosphere stays quiet and comforting from start to finish.

Across 30 handcrafted stages set between two biomes, the bright Summer and the cozy Autumn, you’ll enjoy warm colors, relaxing scenery, and puzzles that grow more satisfying as you progress. Finishing a level fills the screen with a cheerful little jingle, rewarding your clever route and inviting you to the next peaceful challenge.

Magic Sheep is perfect for players who love cozy visuals, gentle strategy, and the joy of solving puzzles at their own pace, all in the company of the happiest sheep in a top hat.

70010000113551.name: Meowgic Mix
70010000113551.description:
Welcome to Meowgic Mix, an adorable pixel art puzzle where a floating cat on a living book must mix potions and deliver them to the correct cauldrons. There are 30 stages inside a magical academy, with challenges that require strategy, logic, and a good dose of feline cleverness.

Observe the classroom where each cauldron awaits its perfect potion. Push bottles, plan your route, and avoid getting stuck while solving each enchanted mini-puzzle. And if something goes wrong, no worries — undo or restart is always just a paw away.

Meowgic Mix combines charming pixel visuals, relaxing music, and mechanics made for players who love calm puzzles, cute animals, and a touch of fantasy. Get ready for a cozy, clever, purr-magical experience where every completed level is a tiny victory in feline alchemy.

70010000113557.name: SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia In The Americas
70010000113557.intro: Spot every difference. Stop the Cheddar Mafia. Save the Americas!
70010000113557.description:
SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia In The Americas is a thrilling "Find-the-Difference" game with a hidden object twist.

The notorious Cheddar Mafia is spreading chaos across the Americas, and only SpotCat can stop them. Explore vibrant, hand-drawn scenes from different countries, spot the subtle differences, and stay sharp — mafia rats can appear when you least expect it.

Your mission? Find all 25 mafia rats, solve every scene, and bring justice to the continent!

Perfect for players who love visual challenges, lighthearted mystery, and clever surprises. Join the hunt. Save the Americas. Spot every difference!

70010000113578.name: Pogui
70010000113578.intro: Safely guide a lovable pup through crazy platforming stages so he can get back to his naptime!
70010000113578.description:
Pogui is just a little dog who wants to take a nap, but crazy stuff keeps happening around him! Guide the lovable pug through dreamlike worlds and help him get to bed. Pogui is a side-scrolling precision platformer presented in retro pixel art style. Run, jump and dash your way through colorful but hazardous levels!

Keep the pup moving as quickly as possible by watching your stamina meter! You’ll have to navigate worlds of toys, sweets, sunny beaches and more, each stage bringing new and wondrous mechanics that can help or hinder you. Watch Pogui don different outfits like a chef’s hat or space suit along the way, further maximizing his cuteness.

• Run, jump and dash with precision.
• Take control of an adorable canine protagonist.
• Collect golden bones to protect Pogui!
• Traverse an overworld map as you progress between levels.
• Enjoy cute and colorful aesthetics in retro pixel art style!

70010000113584.name: ReSetna
70010000113584.intro: A warrior on a mission to rescue last human remnants.
70010000113584.description:
What's left of humanity are minds trapped in circuits. 
You are awaken as ReSetna, a warrior on a mission to rescue last human remnants. 
Explore seven hostile zones, face seven brutal bosses and evolve through a unique upgrade system. 
Uncover horrifying truth and decide if the future is worth saving.

Awaken as ReSetna, you begin in Polis, a dark, ruined world once inhabited by humans.
As you progress, you uncover unknown dimensions, new elements and entire worlds made of data and circuits.

Every zone is a warzone. Every machine is your enemy.

-	Master intense, precision combat with parry mechanics and weapon-switching
-	Your loyal drone companion IXA will be an essential aid
-	Customize your abilities using a unique chip-based upgrade system
-	Explore a fractured world, filled with secrets, danger and a dark history
-	Uncover the final secret and decide if the future is still worth saving
-	Explore a Rich, Post-Apocalyptic World: From the haunting remnants of Polis_13 to the toxic expanses of Acidia, journey through distinct, dystopian zones, each filled with secrets, unique challenges, and lore, inviting deep exploration and discovery.
-	Rich Narrative and Lore: Piece together clues to discover the complicated history of this enigmatic world. Each zone holds keys to the past and hints of the future, through environmental storytelling and cryptic communications.
-	Fast-Paced Combat: Engage with a wide array of enemies in each zone. Each will challenge you to adapt your strategy and refine your combat skills. Tactical thinking is key to mastering ReSetna's arsenal and overcoming adversaries.
-	Dynamic Companion – IXA: IXA, your loyal drone companion, will be an essential aid, providing healing in critical moments and hacking enemies.
-	Epic Boss Battles: The ultimate test of your skills! Each formidable boss is an epic, intense showdown requiring a sound strategy to beat. Their unique abilities will require you stay on your toes, exploit their weaknesses, and leverage upgrades to survive.
-	Upgrade Your Abilities: A customizable chip-upgrade system lets you customize ReSetna to suit your playstyle. Whether enhancing her combat techniques or her abilities to manipulate her environment, your choices affect her evolution and how you overcome obstacles.
-	7 Demanding Districts: Every environment presents a challenging terrain demanding keen observation and platforming abilities. You'll encounter mechanisms and hazards, as well as opportunities to uncover hidden rooms and secret passages that offer unique rewards and deeper insight into the world's history.

70010000113590.name: River City Saga: Journey to the West
70010000113590.intro: River City's First Roguelike Built for Solo Play
70010000113590.description:
Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, Sha Wujing, and Tang Sanzang!
All of the main characters are Kunio!!
A wild, exhilarating comedy action adventure where they all set out for Tianzhu.

1. A roguelike action game where you grow stronger with each run!
Obtain Secret Skills from gods who randomly appear as you progress through the stages to boost your abilities and stats!
With a whopping 80 different Secret Skills available, discover your ultimate build and mow down the swarms of enemies!

2. Master 3 distinct fighting styles!
You'll start with only the speed-focused Sun Wukong, but as you progress through the story, you'll unlock the power-focused Zhu Bajie and the long-range Sha Wujing!
Freely choose between the three Kunios and utilize their unique traits to conquer each stage!

3. Familiar faces from the River City series join the fray!
Series regulars make their appearances one after another as characters from Journey to the West!
Sometimes they will aid Kunio's crew on their journey, while other times they will stand in your way as bosses...
Don't miss the hilarious banter that unfolds throughout the story!

70010000113596.name: Volcano Princess
70010000113596.description:
Multi-ending daughter-raising simulation game: Volcano Princess

In a volcanic kingdom where smithing, magic, and alchemy flourish,
you play as a father and guide your daughter as she grows up.

Each and every choice you make will influence your daughter's growth and lead the story to different endings.

Featuring over 50 unique endings, the game offers a wide variety of outcomes based on your future career path and the bonds you forge with the people who matter most.

With its multiplatform release, this version also includes full Japanese voice support, newly written story content, new event illustrations, and a brand-new exploration map.

[Notes]
"Volcano Princess Prologue" is a demo version.
Data played in "Volcano Princess Prologue" cannot be carried over to the full release. Thank you for your understanding.

70010000113602.name: Junkyard Garage Simulator
70010000113602.intro: Become a master restorer and turn scrap into treasures.
70010000113602.description:
Step into Junkyard Garage Simulator, where every rusted wreck tells a story and every repair brings a forgotten legend back to life. Take control of your own fully equipped garage and immerse yourself in the art of car restoration. From scrapyards to showrooms, every vehicle is a challenge waiting to be mastered.

Game Features:
 • Inspect & Diagnose Every Detail: Rotate the camera freely, examine vehicles from every angle, and use tools to identify missing or damaged components before starting repairs.
 • Repair, Restore, or Scrap: Fix engines, brakes, and suspension, restore worn parts through interactive mini-games, or scrap components for partial value.
 • Customization & Tuning: Modify body panels, improve performance, and apply visual upgrades to increase vehicle value.
 • Test Drives & Quality Checks: Take restored cars on a test track to evaluate handling and ensure everything works properly.
 • Explore & Discover Hidden Stories: Search scrapyards and abandoned locations to find rare vehicles, hidden items, and mysterious traces.

Become a master restorer, revive automotive history, and turn rusted relics into priceless masterpieces. Every car you save is more than a restoration — it’s a story brought back to life.

70010000113609.name: There's No Differences: Cake
70010000113609.intro: Ready to test your detective skills? Find the differences between two similar sweet scenes!
70010000113609.description:
Do you have a sharp eye? We challenge you to test it! Find 10 differences between two similar images. But beware, they change every time you attempt it!

- 9 levels with changing differences to find (we didn't really count all the combinations, sorry!)
- cute hand-drawn cakes and sweets
- hints

70010000113629.name: Leo And Tig
70010000113629.intro: A bundle of two games about the exciting adventures of Leo and Tig.
70010000113629.description:
The game "Leo and Tig," based on the animated series of the same name, takes you on an adventure with the show's charming characters: Leo the Amur leopard, Tig the playful tiger, Mila the weasel, Yara the agile lynx, Kuba the cheerful pig, Martik the squirrel, Kino the eaglet, and Willy the brave bunny.

Each character has their own unique abilities that help them overcome any challenge! The game features seven stunningly beautiful locations, where a story about friendship, mutual assistance, and caring for nature unfolds.

Leo and Tig: Taiga is a captivating arcade game featuring your favorite characters.

A unique world set in the taiga, where players can complete engaging quests and solve challenging puzzles. Unlock the unique abilities of the animal characters and let them explore beautiful places that hold many secrets.

70010000113635.name: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS
70010000113635.description:
The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. Challenge a friend in the field or support Tsubasa on his Journey, the ball is yours.

• New and Improved Gameplay
Action on the field has been enhanced with powerful new super moves that intensify every action, from passing to blocking. The updated system adds more strategy, especially in goalkeeper versus shooter duels featuring spectacular super shots and blocks from the original series characters.

• A Soccer World That is Bigger Than Before!
Featuring 22 national teams, over 110 playable characters, and more than 150 cutscenes highlighting moves on the pitch! Previously unseen teams from the manga and original teams and characters clash in glorious, meticulous animation. The excitement of these once-in-a-lifetime moments has never been higher!

• Experience the New Storylines based on the World Youth Arc supervised by Yoichi Takahashi
Pick up where the first game left off and follow Tsubasa as he takes on formidable new rivals in the thrilling story based on the World Youth arc.
Discover expanded storylines overseen by the original creator, Yoichi Takahashi, and witness powerhouse nations clash as they chase international glory.
Step onto the pitch in the NEW STARS ROUTE, create your own custom player, join the Japanese national team, and fight alongside Tsubasa on the road to world victory.

• Powerful and Inspiring Music
Tadayoshi Makino (SpinSolfa), praised for his moving BGM tracks from the previous title, brings over 100 energized tracks to this iteration. Dare to compete with this exhilarating compilation of melodies perfectly suited to the high-octane action of Captain Tsubasa, the king of sports of anime, as Tsubasa and his teammates give their all on the pitch for the ultimate victory.

*This product is the Standard Edition. Other editions with additional content are available, so be careful of duplicate purchases.

70010000113642.name: N.E.R.D
70010000113642.intro: N.E.R.D is a story-driven escape room puzzle game, brought to life as a gripping interactive movie.
70010000113642.description:
Inspired by cult classic thrillers, this is an experience that will pull you in – and won’t let go. Dark, intense, and deeply unsettling, every moment pushes you further into the unknown.

In a cruel twist of fate, everything you know is torn apart. Your significant other is kidnapped and you’re next. Trapped by a masked maniac, you must fight to survive by solving intricate puzzles and navigating deadly rooms filled with traps. Uncover buried secrets, piece together the truth, and confront a past that refuses to stay hidden. 

Will you escape… or become part of the nightmare?

N.E.R.D Features:
• 3 handcrafted levels packed with challenging puzzles
• A fully cinematic experience with real actors
• A time pressure mode for heightened tension and immersion
• 12 achievements to test your logic and determination

70010000113645.name: CloverPit: Devils Gambit
70010000113645.intro: In this cell, your luck buys you one more day.
70010000113645.description:
CloverPit: Devil’s Gambit drops you in a grimy cell with nothing but a cursed slot machine, a hungry ATM, and a debt that grows sharper every round. Pay up or drop into the pit — those are your choices.

Every spin is a gamble with your life. Rig the machine with strange charms, chain wild combos, and watch your winnings snowball… or vanish in an instant. The further you push your luck, the crueler the pit becomes.

This is a rogue-lite about temptation and survival, where greed can save you just as easily as it can ruin you. Twist the odds, outsmart the house, and claw your way toward freedom before the pit swallows you whole.

70010000113650.name: Junkyard Builder Simulator
70010000113650.intro: The only place where hoarding actually pays off.
70010000113650.description:
The gates creak open, and you step into a wasteland of rust, smoke, and forgotten machines. Engines whisper stories of their past lives, and piles of metal wait for a second chance. It’s your job to bring the junkyard back to life—or let it swallow you whole.

Take the wheel of your truck and carve a path through twisted wrecks and shattered dreams. Scavenge for scrap, uncover hidden treasures buried beneath the rust, and decide what’s worth saving. Every haul means cash, every upgrade takes you closer to control.

Piece by piece, rebuild the broken. Organize the chaos. Watch as your junkyard transforms from a graveyard of steel into a thriving empire of rebirth. But keep your eyes open—this place has a strange memory, and not everything that’s buried wants to stay that way.

Rust, grease, and questionable business decisions—congratulations, you’re officially an entrepreneur.

70010000113657.name: Top Gun Global War
70010000113657.intro: Fight as a fighter pilot in current conflicts.
70010000113657.description:
NATO forces are now engaged in high-intensity conflict against their historic enemies.

As a pilot in NATO's unified command, you will fly the best Western fighter planes (Rafale, F18, F22, F35) and lead a squadron of allied aircraft (Typhoon, Mirage, etc.).

Together, you will have to neutralize enemy fighters as well as targets on land and at sea, in a variety of weather conditions.

Thanks to the advanced realism of its physics engine and high-definition graphics, you will experience all the sensations of a modern Western fighter pilot.

70010000113668.name: Cooking Cat-Astrophe
70010000113668.description:
Cooking Cat-astrophe is a cozy yet fast-paced cooking game starring an adorable cat chef trying to survive the chaos of ever-changing kitchens. Prepare burgers, soups, and salads, assemble each order with precision, and keep your workspace spotless while juggling multiple tasks at once.

 As you progress, the kitchen layouts shift and reposition themselves, forcing you to adapt on the fly and rethink your strategy. Learn new recipes, sharpen your timing, and tackle increasingly challenging stages where speed, accuracy, and quick decision-making are the keys to success.

 Unlock skill upgrades to enhance your cat chef’s abilities and collect unique skins to customize your hero. With simple controls, a warm cartoony atmosphere, and a charming feline protagonist, Cooking Cat-astrophe delivers light, fun, and engaging culinary challenges for players of all skill levels.

70010000113682.name: Before She’s Gone
70010000113682.intro:
Save the Girl Who Always Ends Up in Trouble!
Spot the Danger and Help Her Escape
70010000113682.description:
Find the dangers hidden in each cute illustration and help “the girl” avoid whatever bad thing might happen to her in this picture-search escape game.

How to play is simple：
・Read the hint text carefully
・Look for anything in the illustration that could put her in danger
・Tap the correct spot
If you remove every cause of trouble coming her way, you clear the stage!

Whether she’s at the zoo, on a bus, at a ski resort, or even relaxing safely at home, unexpected dangers can appear anywhere—
and it’s up to you to keep her safe.

Even if you get stuck, the gentle hint system will guide you.
You can also enjoy reacting or streaming as you play, commenting on the surprising and ridiculous things that could happen to her.

70010000113691.name: Touhou: Blossom Blade
70010000113691.intro:
Touhou: Blossom Blade, the origin title of doujin circle Ankake Spa, returns in a remastered edition! 
Set off on a journey through Gensokyo with Youmu.
70010000113691.description:
Konpaku Youmu sets out to prove herself to Saigyouji Yuyuko, mistress of Hakugyokurou. Make use of her three skills and challenge the veteran incident resolver and shrine maiden, Hakurei Reimu. An exhilarating 3D bullet hell action game set in Gensokyo, the world of Touhou Project!

This game is a Touhou Project fangame.

●About This Game

Konpaku Youmu works as the gardener, security, and swordsmanship instructor for Saigyouji Yuyuko, mistress of Hakugyokurou.

One day, upon Youmu scolding her mistress for slacking off in her training, Yuyuko told her "with your lack of skill, there won't be any training."
Yuyuko then challenged her to prove herself by defeating the shrine maiden who'd resolved Gensokyo's incidents time and time again:
She was to go and defeat Hakurei Reimu.

Youmu wasn't happy with this, but showing awareness of her inexperience, she accepted her mistress's conditions and set off for Gensokyo.
Will she be able to overcome the dangers awaiting her, defeat Reimu, and prove her skills to Yuyuko?

●Gameplay

・Use Three Skills to Clear Stages and Beat Bosses!
Youmu has three skills that each have their own strong points – movement, area damage, and range, as well as high-damage Spell Card. They'll come in handy when clearing stages if used well!

For example, your dash skill can help extend your jump range as well as do damage, and your ranged skill can defeat troublesome foes waiting on the other side of gaps.

・Each Skill Has its Own Button!
Previously, you toggle between between Youmu's three skills as you fought, but the skill controls have been updated to be more intuitive.

・Farm Combos to Turn the Tides
Continuing to hit enemies will raise your combo counter, granting bonuses to your score and skill recharge rate.

The latter bonus lets you use your skills much more often, making battles much easier.

・Difficulty Options
Play on Easy, Hard, or Normal; whichever suits your skill level.

・Music
Touhou: Blossom Blade features Touhou arranges from Shoichiro Sakamoto, AKA Sound Sepher, to make stages feel even more alive.

・Other Changes
Balance changes
More breakable objects
HUD additions
No more fall penalty
Graphics optimized for modern hardware
Added English localization

Please enjoy the newly refined and more accessible Touhou: Blossom Blade on Nintendo Switch™!

70010000113703.name: Pure Hentai: Moments
70010000113703.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000113712.name: Emoji Battlefield - Island Warfare
70010000113712.intro: Fast-paced rogue-like FPS mayhem on a mysterious island!
70010000113712.description:
You’ve washed ashore on a mysterious island where ancient emojis have awakened — and they’re not happy to see you.
This rogue-like first-person shooter throws you into wild, fast-paced combat against tiki emojis wearing carved masks and wielding primal powers.
Before each run, customize your experience with crazy modifiers: make enemies bounce, wear funny hats, or unleash volcanic chaos for maximum challenge. Choose your arena — from overgrown jungles and hidden beach ruins to ancient temples filled with deadly traps — each location has its own hazards, secrets, and surprises.
Armed with just a pistol, you’ll face wave after wave of emojis that rush, leap, explode, or even summon others to fight. Defeat them to collect glowing orbs, level up, and unlock upgrades or powerful new weapons. Each decision shapes your survival — will you go for raw power, faster reloads, or explosive mayhem?
Every battle becomes a frantic dance of dodging lava bursts, leaping over collapsing bridges, and using temple traps to your advantage. The further you go, the wilder the island gets — until you’re overwhelmed by the ancient emoji horde.
Survive long enough, and you’ll uncover new arenas, more upgrades, and deeper chaos for your next run.
Can you conquer the island before the emojis claim you?

70010000113715.name: Emoji Battlefield - Summer Vacation
70010000113715.intro: Experience the world’s craziest summer vacation!
70010000113715.description:
You came for a relaxing getaway — but the emojis had other plans.
In this rogue-like first-person shooter, paradise has fallen into chaos as waves of emojis invade beaches, pools, and sunny resorts across the coast.
Before each run, choose your favorite modifiers: crank up the challenge with Hard Mode, make every emoji wear ridiculous summer hats, or turn on Bouncy Mode to watch them hop around like beach balls gone rogue.
Then dive into your first arena — maybe a palm-lined beach, a boardwalk full of umbrellas, or a resort pool floating with inflatable chaos. Every arena has unique hazards, from explosive beach coolers to slippery slides that can send both you and your enemies flying.
Armed with your pistol, you’ll face wave after wave of emojis that rush, bounce, shoot, or explode. Defeat them, grab their glowing orbs, and level up to choose from powerful upgrades. Increase your damage, reload speed, or movement — or spawn weapon drops to shake up your build mid-fight.
The longer you survive, the hotter it gets. Waves intensify with bigger and tougher emojis — sunburnt brutes, water-gun shooters, and explosive floaty fanatics that blow up if they get too close.
Survive long enough, and you’ll unlock new arenas, more modifiers, and even wilder summer chaos for your next run.

70010000113718.name: Veggie Warfare – Feast of Fury
70010000113718.intro: Enter the warzone against furious killer vegetables!
70010000113718.description: The veggies have snapped! Blast through endless waves of enraged carrots, onions, and mutant tomatoes in this fast-paced rogue-like FPS. Collect upgrades, unlock new arenas, and survive the Feast of Fury — where dinner fights back!

70010000113721.name: Pure Hentai: Gallery
70010000113721.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000113750.name: Hentai Balls 3D: Rise of the Curves
70010000113750.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000113750.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000113757.name: Crime Thief Simulator
70010000113757.description:
Night. Silence. Every creak could give you away. One wrong step — and the alarm will go off.
In Crime Thief Simulator you play as a professional thief for whom time is the greatest enemy. Break into houses, search for valuable items, and decide what’s worth the risk.

Every second counts: the longer you stay inside, the higher the chance of being caught.
Keep an eye on the timer, listen for sounds, avoid lights and surveillance cameras. Plan your escape route in advance — when time runs out, there may be no way back.

Use tools to pick locks and disable security. Each mission tests your patience, reflexes, and instincts.
Will you be able to strip the house down to the last coin and get out before the timer ends?

70010000113763.name: Jewel Match Solitaire L'Amour
70010000113763.intro: Bring your sweetheart along in this lovely Solitaire adventure!
70010000113763.description:
Love is in the air. And so is Solitaire! 
Enter the enchanting world of Jewel Match as you fall head over heels for this charming new Solitaire adventure.
Discover and rebuild 5 gorgeous scenes as you follow each passionate couple across the land. 
Play 200 levels, plus 50 bonus mahjong levels to unlock! Dozens of game play variations add to the classic Solitaire, such as obstacles, power-ups, frozen cards, and more! 
Search every last level for gems and coins that you can use to purchase new upgrades for each scene, plus aim for the elusive “Perfect” in each level.
Bring your sweetheart and a deck of cards, because all is fair in love and solitaire.

Features:
- 200 lovely Solitaire levels.
- 5 beautiful scenes to build.
- 50 replayable bonus mahjong levels!
- Choose between several delightful card designs.
- Tons of game play variations and power-ups.

70010000113768.name: Spy Guy Europe
70010000113768.intro: Spy Guy sets out to conquer Europe in a brand new detective game!
70010000113768.description:
Spy Guy is an amazing detective who searches for hidden objects in various locations and cities around the world. This time, he has been tasked with traveling to Europe to find hidden objects in European capitals and cities.
