Spy Guy Europe, with a new hint system and three game modes, is a great choice for anyone who loves searching for hidden objects and solving puzzles.

70010000113774.name: Pin Strike 3
70010000113774.intro: Play bowling in this puzzle way. Use your mind first!
70010000113774.description:
You know all the rules and possible combinations, so just enjoy new levels and new obstacles! This bowling is still not the classical one.

Knock down everithing with just one shot. It's challenging and fun!

Try the newest levels — you will be surprised at how strange they are!   

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

New even more strange levels to discover!

70010000113794.name: SHUTEN ORDER - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000113794.intro: Happy New End...Have a good end
70010000113794.description:
*If you already own the "SHUTEN ORDER" Nintendo Switch™ software, you can purchase the Upgrade Pack to access "SHUTEN ORDER - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition".

“168 remaining until the end of the world...”
Humanity is approaching its end.

In a world steeped in despair and chaos, a strange religious organization called Shuten Order emerges, yearning for the end of humanity. The group rapidly gains followers, eventually forming a small nation state called Shuten.  

Tragedy strikes during the grand festival celebrating their nation’s founding—the leader of the Shuten Order is murdered. Soon after, the protagonist awakens with no memory, greeted by two self-proclaimed "angels". They reveal a shocking truth: the protagonist is the murdered Founder, revived by divine power. However, the resurrection is incomplete—their memories are gone, and their life limited to a mere four days.  

To survive, the protagonist must overcome "God's trial": identify and kill their murderer.

With the clock ticking, the protagonist, given the alias Rei, dives into the tumultuous city as a detective. The suspects? Five ministers of the Shuten Order. There's no time to investigate them all. Choices must be made, and the pursuit of truth demands sacrifice.  

Who killed the Founder? For what reason? Can the mission be fulfilled before time runs out?  
Thus begins a high-stakes, four-day hunt for the truth.  

■Gameplay & Game System:  
- Ministry of Security: Stealth Action Horror  
Flee from the legendary killer Nephilim while investigating suspect Manji Fushicho.  
----------------------
Features action-style gameplay where players solve various puzzles in 3D stages while escaping from the murderous Nephilim, all viewed from a top-down perspective.

- Ministry of Justice: Mystery Adventure  
Solve a murder tied to the wealthy Kukuri family and expose the true killer linked to suspect Kishiru Inugami. 
----------------------
Investigate cases as a detective by interviewing key figures and examining crime scenes to uncover hidden truths.
In the visual novel-style investigation segments, use the "Snapping" feature to closely analyze suspicious statements and intriguing objects.
During the case analysis meetings, piece together evidence collected during investigations to reveal what took place and draw closer to solving the mystery.

- Ministry of Science: Multi-Perspective Visual Novel  
Navigate a deadly terrorist attack at a research lab while shifting between characters to avoid fatal outcomes, targeting suspect Teko Ion.  
----------------------
Features multi-perspective storytelling through visual novel-style gameplay where you switch between the viewpoints of multiple characters to discover survival routes.
One person's actions can impact another person's fate.

- Ministry of Education: Romance Adventure (?!)  
After being poisoned, head to Shuten Academy and unmask three enigmatic girls, one of whom is suspect/poisoner Honoka Kokushikan.  
----------------------
A romance adventure-style game where the goal is to build deep connections with three heroines.
Use clues to track their locations on the school map and seek them out for interactions.
Raise their affection through dialogue choices and complete romance events to unlock the confession phase at night.
During the confession phase, choose the right words within the time limit to win them over.

- Ministry of Health: Extreme Escape Adventure  
Survive a death game orchestrated by an unknown force while interrogating suspect Yugen Ushitora.  
----------------------
Features escape room adventure gameplay where you must find the exit to a mysterious locked room by undergoing dangerous trials and puzzles, and wrong choices can lead directly to life-threatening situations.

Master each route to piece together the truth, confront the culprit, and shape the fate of the world in this gripping, multi-genre experience.

70010000113803.name: Make it! Kushikatsu
70010000113803.intro:
Get ready for a delicious kushikatsu-making challenge!
Make tons of kushikatsu and watch your food cart prosper!
70010000113803.description:
Let's make kushikatsu on the Nintendo Switch™!
Fry the ingredients without burning them, then add sauce on top!
With a Joy-Con™ for each player, up to 4 players can join in the fun!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Make kushikatsu to order!
Fry the ingredients and add sauce for the finishing touch!
Keep cooking until time runs out!

《How to Play》
1. Add the ingredients to the oil and start cooking!

2. Once they're ready, take them out of the oil!

3. Choose 3 kushikatsu that have dried, then select a sauce! Choose from Worcester sauce, miso, and tartar sauce!

4. When you're done, serve the kushikatsu to the customer! The closer they match the order, the more points you get!

[Score Attack]
Cook up as many kushikatsu as possible and aim for the top spot on the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Compete with others and test your kushikatsu-making skills!

70010000113819.name: Little Witch in the Woods
70010000113819.intro: Begin a cozy apprentice witch life in the woods with Ellie.
70010000113819.description:
Time To Usher In a Life As Ellie the Little Apprentice Witch!
• Step into the shoes of Ellie, an apprentice witch dispatched from Lucerine Ortu—a land of witches—and experience her journey of self development!
• Explore brand-new areas, craft potions and help the villagers. A heartwarming and cozy adventure awaits you here.
• Fish, gather, decorate your house, and interact with cats! We have all kinds of activities that will make every day an unforgettable experience.

Activities and Explorations as a Witch
• Navigate forests, caves, cliffs and lakes on your broom to meet adorable life forms and complete your Encyclopedia.
• Gather materials to craft problem-solving potions, discover hidden treasures and unlock new paths.

Stories of the Village and Its Inhabitants
• Work as an apprentice witch. Help out at the village and solve problems for the villagers.
• Make friends with the villagers as you restore the village. By establishing bonds, you can unlock their stories and even learn about their secrets.

Collections and Home Decoration
• Gather recipes and materials to craft furniture, which will give your living space a personal touch.
• Collect and customize brooms to add extra enjoyment to your explorations.

Laid-back Moments
• Spend your peaceful free time fishing and chatting. Interact with cats to deepen your cross-species friendships.
• Create your exclusive story in this magical yet ever so relatable world!

70010000113826.name: THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano
70010000113826.intro: First-person horror game where a mysterious entity chases you
70010000113826.description:
Last stop of the line. All passengers must exit

In The Last Train, a first-person psychological horror game, routine turns into nightmare when you fall asleep on the subway. Upon waking, you discover you've reached the end of the line, an abandoned station shrouded in darkness. But you're not alone; something else waits in the shadows, watching you and following your every move.

Explore the gloomy corridors and hidden corners of the last station as you try to find a way back to safety. Every sound, every movement, could be a sign that what's hunting you is closer than you think. You'll need to keep your calm, solve puzzles, and find clues that reveal the dark secrets hidden within this abandoned station. Will you escape before the entity catches you?

Features

- First-person horror with touches of humor
- 4 endings to unlock
- Interact with and run from popular characters
- Discover secrets that reveal a larger story
- Intense experience in a mysterious station

Prepare for a one-way journey into fear. The last station awaits you… and not everyone makes it back.

70010000113871.name: Battle Force
70010000113871.intro: A modern warfare FPS game powered by a next-generation engine, featuring stunning, realistic graphics! Become a member of the world's most elite special forces!
70010000113871.description:
Experience the most tactical and innovative FPS, incorporating cutting-edge, near-future tactics into modern warfare systems.
<Battle Force> is an FPS game where players become a member of the world's most elite special forces and confront advanced threats threatening the world.

Players become elite agents of the team and are assigned to a mission to stop the activation of the "Omega System," the ultimate weapon that will ignite war. Prove your skills among the world's most elite agents!

・Top-notch, realistic graphics and presentation deliver an overwhelming sense of immersion.
・Battles unfold across vast fields, allowing players to freely move and engage based on their strategic choices.
・Mobile equipment is provided, allowing you to quickly move across the vast battlefield and secure tactical strongholds. Experience the cooperative action essential to team victory with unique equipment for each class: Assault, Engineer, Support, and Recon.
・Experience strategic action by securing strategic strongholds or breaking down enemy defenses in Deathmatch, Conquest, and Rush game modes.
・Control next-generation tanks to strike enemy strongholds or provide cover for friendly infantry.
・Fully engage in missions across intensely tense environments, from chaotic desert bases to massive secret factories dominated by iron and intense heat.

In <Battle Force>, optimal tactics are achieved through the combination of player skill and teamwork.Working as a team creates the perfect weapon.
Share your tactics and achieve victory.

Synopsis
The world faces a threat from a highly sophisticated private military and technological organization known as "ShadowNet". They instigate conflicts between existing nations, secretly sell cutting-edge weapons, and seek to destroy the world order.

Players become elite agents of a special forces unit, tasked with tracking down the leader of a shadow network wreaking havoc across the globe and preventing the activation of their ultimate weapon, the Omega System.

Join the special forces now and save the world!
Take on extreme missions with your most trusted allies!

70010000113914.name: Christmas Holidays
70010000113914.intro: Join Willi the elf on an adventure through Finland to collect the 9 pieces of a shooting star and save Christmas.
70010000113914.description:
Christmas Vacation
Join Willi the elf on a charming adventure through Finland, where he'll use his magic watch to collect the 9 pieces of a shooting star and save Christmas alongside Santa and his friends.

Features:

Adorable protagonist: Willi, Santa's elf helper.

Interactive story full of magic, friendship, and teamwork.

Easy reading with cheerful music and immersive sound effects.

Learn about Finland's most iconic landmarks.

Perfect for children who enjoy educational Christmas adventures.

70010000113922.name: Popper Lands Colony
70010000113922.intro: A new colony is appearing in popper lands!
70010000113922.description:
In the heart of uncharted lands, a bustling colony emerges. 
The Governor’s arrival looms. The fate of Popper Lands Colony rests in your capable hands. 
As a seasoned settler, your expertise is vital to its success.

Here’s what awaits you:
1 - 110 Popping Levels: Dive into a captivating journey across 110 colorful and challenging levels. Match bubbles, strategize, and watch your village flourish.
2 - Exciting Power-Ups: Unleash magical abilities and boost your progress. These power-ups will keep you on your toes.
3 - Explore gorgeous locations: Embark on an adventure through a myriad of stunning locations.
4 - Witness Your Village Grow: Start from scratch and witness your humble settlement evolve into a bustling hub of activity

The Popper Lands Colony awaits your touch. 
Gather your wits, pop those bubbles, and build a legacy that echoes through generations. 
The Governor’s arrival draws near, will you rise to the challenge?

70010000113941.name: Apocalypse Day: Survival Z - Craft & Build
70010000113941.intro: The apocalypse doesn’t forgive the unprepared.
70010000113941.description:
Enter a broken world where every decision shapes your survival.

Apocalypse Day: Survival Z – Craft & Build is a third-person survival adventure set in a stylized post-apocalyptic Southwest United States. From abandoned cities in Arizona to dense forests in Utah, ruined farmlands in Texas, and the unforgiving deserts of New Mexico, each region presents new dangers and new opportunities.

Exploration and crafting are the core of the experience. Resources are limited, and combat is only one part of survival. Scavenge destroyed buildings, empty malls, hunting cabins, farms, greenhouses, bunkers, and mines to gather wood, metal, tools, car parts, and rare materials. Use what you find to craft weapons, tools, shelters, medical supplies, and survival gear.

Develop your abilities through action. Increase Strength to carry heavier equipment and handle tougher fights. Improve Fitness to run longer and endure harsh conditions. Refine Dexterity for better precision and faster reactions. Master skills like Carpentry, Metalworking, First Aid, Cooking, Farming, and Hunting to create sustainable ways to survive in a hostile world.

Each area introduces new threats. Slow but numerous infected roam city streets. Wild animals stalk forest paths. Stronger farm mutants guard open fields. In the desert, mutated enemies grow more aggressive under extreme heat. Harsh weather, limited water, and environmental hazards force you to think before you act.

Survival is not about rushing into danger. It’s about preparing, adapting, and building smarter than the world around you.

In Apocalypse Day, the end has already come.
Now it’s your turn to endure.

70010000113946.name: Whiskers Warehouse - Logic Puzzle Game
70010000113946.intro: Push, solve, and unlock your way through 2,000 brain-teasing levels in this addictive puzzle adventure!
70010000113946.description:
Master the art of strategic thinking in this modern take on classic Sokoban puzzles! With 1,000 meticulously crafted levels across 10 vibrant worlds, plus another 1,000 levels in New Game+ mode, you'll never run out of challenges.

Start your journey through increasingly complex puzzles that will test your logic and spatial reasoning. Each completed level rewards you with stars that unlock new worlds, adorable cats, unique balls, and exciting cosmetics - all at your own pace with no pressure.

KEY FEATURES:
• 2,000 total levels (1,000 base + 1,000 New Game+)
• 20 different worlds to play in
• Progressive difficulty that grows with your skills
• Challenge yourself daily and keep your mind sharp
• Star-based progression system
• Collectible cats, balls, and cosmetic items
• Perfect for quick sessions or extended puzzle marathons
• Sharpen your logical thinking and problem-solving abilities

Whether you're a puzzle veteran or new to the genre, there's always a new challenge waiting. How many stars can you collect?

70010000113952.name: Drone Delivery Express: City Simulator
70010000113952.description:
Drone Delivery Express: City Simulator is a relaxing drone delivery game set in a realistic modern city. Your main mission is simple: take off, fly across the streets and rooftops, and deliver different packages safely and on time.

Choose from multiple drones and enjoy smooth, satisfying gameplay that’s easy to learn and fun to master. Each level introduces new delivery routes and fresh challenges, while the atmosphere constantly changes thanks to dynamic time and weather—bright daytime flights, beautiful sunsets, and rainy nights.

Fly with precision, plan your path, and enjoy a calm simulation experience made for players who want to unwind.

70010000113965.name: Heave Ho 2
70010000113965.intro: Get a grip, it’s Heave Ho 2! The insane 2-4 player party game sequel takes the couch co-op mayhem online for the first time. Grab what you can and swing to win!
70010000113965.description:
The bedlam is back, and now it’s online too. Grab and swing through all-new weird and wonderful worlds with up to four players in online and local co-op and versus play.

Take your partners by the hand (or head) and swing your ungainly chain from platform to pillar and beyond. Let go at the wrong moment and meet your splattery end, but a solid grip and pro swinging will take you over the finish line in sweet harmony!

Online Pandemonium
Adding to the game’s couch co-op roots, Heave Ho 2 takes the chaos online for the first time. Get a grip on faraway friends, then drop them into the void from a safe distance!

Wild Worlds
Launch yourself and your friends through eight themed worlds of fiendish fun, from weightless space and kitchen chaos, to medieval mayhem, ninja nonsense, and much more.

Push, Pull, Shoot, Squeeze
Pop guns, drones, space ships, ski lifts, keys, and ketchup are just a few of the items you’ll play with on your swinging travels. And lasers. Of course lasers.

Fight Among Friends
Take revenge on your underperforming co-op teammates in versus mode through a series of frantic challenges, cunningly designed to start a completely different argument every time!

70010000113977.name: Kawaii Force: Liberty Line
70010000113977.intro: Gunshots and neon lights collide in a city that never sleeps, and the most dangerously adorable girls squad you've ever seen is about to pull the trigger!
70010000113977.description:
Meet the Liberty Line, an off-the-books all-female special ops crew that handles missions too dangerous for any government agency, all while flashing a flirty smile. RINA, the doe-eyed sharpshooter whose innocent grin hides pinpoint lethal accuracy. MOMO, the smoldering femme fatale whose very presence makes your heart stop. These two bishoujo agents are the ultimate ace of Kawaii Force, and they're diving headfirst into the shadowy conspiracy of Valesia, a ruthless all-female crime syndicate that has the city's underground weapons market locked down tight. Powered by cutting-edge cel-shading technology that looks better than any anime, Kawaii Force: Liberty Line pushes urban action immersion to an absolute new level!

・From the rooftop of a downtown skyscraper mall to rain-soaked back alleys, track Valesia's weapons smuggling routes and complete thrilling missions!
・Use gold earned from cleared stages to unlock RINA and MOMO's provocative and jaw-dropping costume collection!
・Every costume you unlock reveals an exclusive original wallpaper themed to that outfit. Your collector's instinct will go into overdrive!
・Dive into SHOW Mode with your collected costumes and unlock yet another hidden original wallpaper. The quality will leave you absolutely speechless!
・Touch RINA and MOMO directly to discover their hidden charms, from bubbly cute reactions to adorably flustered responses!
・Use Gallery Mode to collect stunning, glamorous bishoujo illustrations that light up the city night and build your own ultimate collection!
・View your collected costumes from every angle in 360-degree Character Viewer Mode and enjoy them exactly the way you want!
・Only those who clear the full story will unlock the long-awaited Ending Story. The shocking truth hidden deep within Liberty Line is finally revealed!

A neon-soaked city. Two dangerously kawaii agents. One explosive showdown. Thrilling story, provocative costume collection, hidden wallpaper unlocks, gallery collecting, and a jaw-dropping ending. Kawaii Force: Liberty Line packs in the cuteness, the firepower, and the deadly sexy all in one definitive visual TPS package! Download Kawaii Force: Liberty Line now and save the city alongside the most dangerous and irresistible bishoujo special ops team ever assembled!

Prologue
Gunshots echo through a city glowing with neon. Beneath the glamorous surface, the all-female crime syndicate Valesia has seized complete control of the underground weapons market, silently tightening its grip on every corner of the city. With official agencies gone quiet, only one crew remains. An unofficial all-female special ops team that handles the missions no government will touch, with nothing but a smile on their lips. That crew is Liberty Line. That force is Kawaii Force.

RINA hides pinpoint shooting talent behind the most disarming smile you've ever seen. MOMO conceals state-of-the-art comm gear beneath dazzling accessories and a battle outfit that turns heads mid-firefight. These two share exactly one thing in common: "Cute. But absolutely terrifying." What started as a routine mission to trace Valesia's weapons smuggling route slowly revealed something far more dangerous, a plan big enough to bring the entire city to its knees.

First mission: the rooftop of a high-rise shopping mall. Without warning, an explosion ripped through the night and the entire city went dark. Then a cold voice crackled through the comms: "Liberty Code 07. Internal breach detected. Mission changed." At the center of the conspiracy was a name, someone who once stood alongside Kawaii Force. When the city lights flickered back on, their shadows were already moving toward the next target.

70010000113983.name: Dadish 4
70010000113983.description:
The evil Homeowners’ Association has plucked Dadish from the radish patch, and it’s up to his eldest son, DJ, to rescue him.

Explore 50 tricky levels, battle food-themed foes, and try not to get squished by a tunnel-boring machine. Can DJ save his dad before it's too late? There’s no time to lose in this classic platforming adventure!

• An action packed platforming adventure
• Fun for new players and long time Dadish fans
• Swing from vines, ride conveyors and bounce off clouds
• 50 hand crafted stages
• Sassy baby radishes, possums and more
• Get a lift with a giant flying hamburger
• Ride on your mom's back, she is a tomato
• Defeat the five evil staff members of the Homeowners' Association
• Cool soundtrack, I even rap on this one a little bit
• Dialogue that is sort of funny
• Make your dad proud

70010000114002.name: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
70010000114002.intro: A remake of Romancing SaGa 3! Choose from eight heroes in this turn-based RPG.
70010000114002.description:
*This is the Nintendo Switch™ version. There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully. 

Romancing SaGa 3, the acclaimed JRPG first released in Japan in 1995, returns in a full 3D remake. Whether you're a longtime SaGa fan or a newcomer, this reimagining offers a fresh take on a classic adventure.

■Story
Every 300 years, Morastrum, the Star of Death, rises, dooming all born beneath it except the mysterious Child of Destiny. Nearly twenty years after its last appearance, an insurrection in Loanne uncovers a far greater threat: the Four Sinistrals seek to reopen the gates to the Abyss. Eight heroes bound by fate must unite to save the world.

■Characters
Choose from eight protagonists, each with a unique story, and recruit over twenty allies to your party

■Graphics
Inspired by the original pixel art and Tomomi Kobayashi's illustrations, the remake features character designs by Yoshiro Ambe and fully realized 3D environments.

■Freeform Scenario System
Your choices shape the adventure, from the stories you pursue to the order in which you challenge the Sinistrals, creating a unique experience every playthrough.

■Battle and Character Power Systems
Classic SaGa features such as Glimmer and Formation return alongside a new timeline-based battle system and United Attacks for deeper tactical combat.

■Difficulty
Choose from Casual, Normal, or Classic difficulty to tailor the challenge to your playstyle.

■Music and Voices
Original composer Kenji Ito supervised newly arranged music, with players able to switch between original and arranged tracks.

70010000114046.name: The Way of the Tray
70010000114046.intro: The Way of the Tray is a waiter simulator with action puzzle elements in a Japanese spirit world setting.
70010000114046.description:
After accidentally falling into the mystical world of spirits, you find yourself in a difficult situation: to find your way home, you will have to work in a local restaurant.

- Dishes from myths and legends
- Mysterious yokai patrons
- Magical restaurant makeover
- The way of the masterful waite

Master the art of keeping your tray balanced: every mistake can cost you a tip. Learn to manage your time so you can serve all your guests on time and prevent them from leaving because of long waiting time.
Immerse yourself in the mysterious atmosphere of Japan: serve unusual orders to yokai and learn all the secrets of local cuisine. Serve dishes that even mysterious spirits can enjoy. Today’s menu includes onigiri, sushi and ramen, and fortune cookies for dessert!
Develop your waiter skills to earn more tips and invest them in upgrades, and don’t forget to pay the rent.
Are you ready to make your way as a waiter in the mysterious world of Japanese spirits? Keep your balance, solve puzzles and find your way home!

70010000114057.name: Arcade Archives Rave Racer
70010000114057.description:
"Rave Racer" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
With dynamic presentation and more exhilarating drift control, this title evolved in every way, becoming a hit that soared past the high expectations set for the third installment in the RIDGE RACER series. The diverse soundtrack further pumps up the race, igniting a frenzy that truly lives up to its name—RAVE!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000114076.name: Kabuto Park
70010000114076.description:
Catch the cutest bugs, train them and win the Summer Beetle Battles Championship in this tiny bug collection game! Upgrade your equipment to find rarer, stronger and shinier little friends.

Kabuto Park is a cute and short bug collection game. Spend a month as Hana, a little girl on summer vacation. Catch the best bugs and level them up, choose your team carefully and fight other kids to become the Summer Beetle Battles champion.

Expect 2 to 4 hours of serene bug catching, exciting little battles and summer vibes.

Catch cute bugs 
Beetles! Butterflies! Bees! Dragonflies! And many more! Discover more than 40 cool bug species that live in Kabuto Park and try to catch them by timing your net swings right.

Move your Joy-Con™ to catch bugs! You can swing your Joy-Con just like an insect collecting net!

Win the tiniest sumo fights 
Choose your team depending on their stats, abilities or look and show other kids who the best beetle battler is! 

Each bug you select for your team will add cards to your deck that you'll be able to use during the little fights. Try to push your opponents out of the ring.

Your rhino beetle is not strong enough? Feed it candies to level it up and you'll have better luck winning the next fight!

Buy cool stuff 
Better boots or a better net will surely make you the best bug catcher! Lucky for you, the local store has everything you need to get access to new areas with new bugs, make rare bugs appear more often or make capture easier.

Features 
What Kabuto Park offers:

A short creature collector: With 2 to 4 hours of playtime, this game is a perfect snack for an afternoon or a few sessions here and there. I like to keep my game short, to the point and respectful of players' time.
Simple game mechanics: A relaxing capture mini game, little bug battles with a simple deck building gameplay, a light upgrade system and a leveling system to upgrade your favorite critters.
A cozy mood: Summer vibes, childlike wonder, cute art and lovely music!
The cutest bugs: Bugs from all around the world are here and ready to become your friend. You can even pet them in your terrarium!

What Kabuto Park does NOT offer:

No Exploration or moving around in the world.
No big adventure with quests and a long plot.
No multiplayer of any kind. No PVP, no trading.
No spiders. That one is for you arachnophobes.

Dev team 
Hey, I'm Doot and I'm back with Zakku for another tiny game 

We are the developer and music composer of Minami Lane and Froggy's Battle, still on our quest to bring more tiny cute games to the world! Trained and helped by Minami Lane's artist Blibloop, I made the art by myself this time (please don't be mean I'm trying my best).

We really hope you'll enjoy our little game

70010000114085.name: Succubus Hearts: Demon Love Redemption
70010000114085.intro:
A demon succubus born from desire.
A fate shaped by your choices.
Will you break her curse… or fall under it?
70010000114085.description:
The night you cross paths with her, everything changes.
A demon succubus, feared in stories, hunted in legends, appears before you with eyes that hide something no myth ever mentioned: doubt.

She was created to take emotions, not to feel them.
But something inside her is breaking… or awakening.

Succubus Heart: Demon Love Redemption is a narrative driven visual novel where every choice shapes the life of a demon who has never known freedom.
You are not her target.
You become her turning point.

Meet succubi with pasts carved in temptation, duty, rebellion, and loss.
Learn the truth behind their power, their hunger, and the chains that bind them to the world of demons.

You decide whether they remain creatures of desire...
or discover something they were never meant to feel.


Features:

● UNIQUE CHARACTERS: Meet anime succubi/incubi with personalities shaped by sin, fear, or longing.

● IMPACTFUL CHOICES: Your decisions influence whether they rise, fall, or defy their destiny.

● EXCLUSIVE SCENES: Unlock moments that reveal their past, their nature, and the humanity hidden within.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Salvation, corruption, escape, or eternal hunger.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Explore branching narrative routes with completely different outcomes.


She was born to claim souls.
Will you be the one to change hers?

70010000114093.name: Incubus Hearts: Demon Love Redemption
70010000114093.intro:
A demon incubus born from desire.
A fate shaped by your choices.
Will you break his curse… or fall under it?
70010000114093.description:
You feel him before you see him.
A presence heavy enough to silence the air around you.

The demon incubus who appears in your path does not flirt.
He challenges.
He studies.
He waits for the moment you look away… and judges you for it.

"Incubus Heart: Demon Love Redemption" is a narrative visual novel where you unravel the truth behind men shaped not by desire, but by power, pride, and centuries of unspoken regret.

Each incubus hides a wound carved by betrayal, duty, or temptation gone wrong.
They do not ask for your help.
They reveal only what you earn.

Your choices define how far they let you in,
and how much of their darkness you’re willing to take on.


Features:

● LAYERED CHARACTERS: Anime incubi with personalities shaped by control, pride, intelligence, or silent inner wounds.

● DECISIVE CHOICES: Decisions that shift the balance between dominance, trust, and destiny.

● EXCLUSIVE SCENES: Unlock moments that reveal fragments of their power, their past, and what they hide beneath the surface.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Rebellion, redemption, shared fate, or complete collapse.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Explore deeply branching routes with dramatic and unique outcomes.


He walks the line between temptation and danger.
Do you dare walk beside him?

70010000114099.name: Anime Feet Girls: The Charm Finder Quest
70010000114099.intro:
Step into a world where every step reveals a new charm.
Can you win the trust of the anime girls hidden behind their graceful silhouettes?
70010000114099.description:
Some people look at a smile, or a pair of eyes, to understand someone.
Here, everything begins lower: in the softness of a step, the confidence of a pose, or the way a heel touches the ground before a glance is exchanged.

Anime Feet Girls: The Charm Finder Quest mixes lighthearted story moments with short minigames.
As you progress, you’ll unlock exclusive scenes, discover reactions, and get closer to the subtle details that define each girl.

● A shy cutie who hides her face but not her steps.
● A self-made businesswoman who walks with purpose, every movement controlled and intentional.
● A rebel who challenges you without saying a word, lifting her foot just enough to test your attention.

You will learn who they are not by what they say… but by how they move.
Each challenge you clear reveals more: curves, angles, posture, balance.
The closer you get, the more their charm unfolds.


Features:

● Distinct personalities: Meet girls inspired by sweetness, ambition, and playful confidence.

● Minigames: Alternate between quick reflex challenges and light dialogue choices.

● Unlock exclusive scenes, close-up perspectives, and hidden reactions.

● Multiple endings: Your style of play determines who opens up to you.

● High replay value: Different choices reveal new sides of every girl.


Their charms are subtle, their steps unforgettable.
Do you dare to play?

70010000114105.name: Minesweeper Classic
70010000114105.description:
Minesweeper Classic brings the legendary puzzle back to life with crisp visuals, smooth controls, and the timeless gameplay millions grew up with. Tap into pure logic as you uncover tiles, dodge hidden mines, and chase that perfect clear.

Take on five difficulty levels - from easy warm-ups to expert boards that will test your skills to the limit. Whether you're reliving a classic or discovering it for the first time, every round delivers quick, satisfying, and endlessly replayable fun.

Rediscover a true classic - simple to learn, rewarding to master, and impossible to put down.

70010000114111.name: Anime Feet Boys: The Charm Finder Quest
70010000114111.intro:
Not everyone reveals their charm through their eyes.
Some do it with the way their bare feet meet the floor.
70010000114111.description:
You enter a space where confidence begins from the ground up.
The men you meet don’t need speeches or flirting.

Their presence is defined by how they stand, how they move, and the quiet tension of every step they take.

In Anime Feet Boys: The Charm Finder Quest, each encounter mixes light narrative with short skill challenges.

Your performance unlocks exclusive scenes and angles that highlight balance, posture, and the moments where their movements slow down just long enough for you to notice.

● A laid-back athlete who stretches before every challenge, toes brushing the floor with calm precision.
● A model who enjoys making you watch, lifting his heel just enough to break your focus.
● A quiet prodigy whose still stance feels like a trap: you can’t tell if he’s inviting you to look… or daring you to try.

You cannot impress them with words.
You earn their attention by reading their rhythm:
the curve of an arch, the weight shift before a step, the pressure of skin against the ground.

Each victory unlocks more angles, reactions, subtle movements that reveal a side of them most people never see.


Features:

● Strong personalities: Meet anime boys inspired by discipline, elegance, and confident posture.

● Minigames: Switch between reflex challenges and light choices to progress.

● Unlock exclusive scenes that focus on movement, stance, and close-up details.

● Multiple endings: Your timing and performance determine who opens up to you.

● High replay value: Different reactions and scenes await players who pay attention.


They don’t chase you.
They make you watch.
Are you bold enough to play?

70010000114117.name: Mage Battle Arena
70010000114117.intro: Build your mage, evolve your spells, and define your legend.
70010000114117.description:
Step into a world where raw magic shapes destiny. You begin as a novice mage, armed with only the most basic spells. With every battle, every conquered foe, and every new land explored, your power grows. Unlock unique abilities, master devastating spells, and carve your path toward the ultimate goal—claiming the throne as the greatest sorcerer of all time.

The realm is torn apart by ancient wars between rival schools of magic. Ambition drives every mage to prove their supremacy, while mystical beasts guard forgotten secrets. To rise above them all, you must challenge enemy sorcerers, defeat legendary monsters, and claim artifacts of untold power.

Key Features:
• Dynamic Combat – Face diverse enemies with distinct fighting styles, from close-range brawlers to ranged spellcasters.
• Evolving Magic System – Unlock and upgrade spells like teleportation, health regeneration, protective shields, freezing blasts, and homing attacks.
• Skill Trees – Shape your own playstyle by investing in offensive or defensive abilities, mixing active and passive powers.
• Exploration & Treasure – Hunt for hidden chests across mystical maps, each guarded by enemies ready to test your strength.
• Consumables & Enhancements – Purchase spell-infused potions for temporary boosts in health, damage, and more.
• Epic Boss Battles – Defeat mighty foes to earn legendary artifacts and unlock new levels of difficulty.

Forge your legacy, outcast the competition, and ascend as the unrivaled master of the Mage Battle Arena!

70010000114122.name: Hidden Cats in Spooky Village
70010000114122.intro: Seek the whiskers in the dark... Find the cats in the Spooky Village!
70010000114122.description:
The Hidden Cats are back to explore the whispers and shadows of the mysterious Spooky Village!

Find over 1200 hidden objects across 12 levels, collect special cards, and discover real-life cats shared by our Hidden Cats community!

Game Features:
- 1200+ hidden objects, 12 unique levels with unlockables
- Collectible cards, achievements, secrets to discover
- Hand-drawn art & original soundtrack with dynamic sound effects

70010000114127.name: Cryptical Path
70010000114127.description:
Cryptical Path is an action-packed rogue-lite where you control the dungeon. Step into the role of the Architect, the creator of the mysterious Hexium, and shape your own path while battling the vengeful souls trapped within your creation.

Here, the power is yours. Choose, combine, and build rooms to transform the labyrinth every run. Craft unique strategies, personalize your journey, and explore thousands of possibilities in this innovative roguelite-builder, where you don’t rely on luck—you create the challenge.

Master fast-paced combat in a beautifully crafted 3D side-scrolling world filled with danger, secrets, and ever-shifting environments. Discover powerful items, unlock new talents, and unravel the mysteries of the Hexium as you fight to reclaim control of a prison that no longer obeys its maker.

Features

Roguelite-Builder: Build your path, choose your rooms, and shape the dungeon every run.

Intense Action: Dodge, dash, and slash through enemies with the Architect’s agile combat style.

Immersive World: Explore a rich 3D side-scroller filled with atmosphere and hidden secrets.

Constant Progression: Unlock items, talents, and unique combinations that evolve with every attempt.

High Replayability: Experiment with new strategies and room setups each time you enter the Hexium.

70010000114144.name: Druids: Battle of Magic
70010000114144.intro: Find secret magic in Book of the Druids.
70010000114144.description:
The recipes to the secret potions that maintain peace and harmony throughout the land are contained within the Book of the Druids. 
The book was stolen and four ancient druids set off toward the Dark Castle to seek the valuable tome and restore peace to the land. 
Assist them in their quest by matching three or more Symbols of Power to fill up their magic reserves and unleash their enchantments. 
They are counting on you to return what is rightfully theirs and stop evil from possessing this ultimate power!

- Four special power-ups.
- Two gameplay modes.
- More than 110 arduous levels.

70010000114150.name: Megabonk Smash
70010000114150.intro: Smash, survive, evolve — fight through endless waves of chaos.
70010000114150.description:
Megabonk Smash is a fast-paced pixel roguelike action game where you battle endless waves of enemies, collect glowing crystals, upgrade your abilities, and face brutal bosses in an isolated arena of chaos. You awaken on a forgotten pixel island, surrounded by monsters born from crystal insanity. Every second counts — crush enemies, evolve your powers, and survive until the boss appears. Win, or restart the nightmare.

Features:
- Intense Arena Combat – Slash, blast, and burn through hordes using melee, ranged, and fireball attacks.
- Progression and Upgrades – Level up, collect experience crystals, and unlock random skills and perks each run.
- Adaptive Enemies & Boss Fights – Smart foes hunt you down, and powerful bosses test your survival instincts.
- Interactive Pixel World – Explore a handcrafted arena with destructible objects, secrets, and dynamic lighting.
- Retro Aesthetics & Sound – Enjoy classic pixel art visuals, cinematic effects, and immersive sound design.

You are a mysterious warrior trapped on a cursed pixel island — a realm consumed by crystal madness. Each wave pushes you closer to the edge. Gather shards, evolve your strength, and defeat the ancient boss to escape alive. Survive. Evolve. Smash everything.

70010000114175.name: Astra GalaxyX
70010000114175.intro: Pilot a spacecraft across the galaxy, facing waves of incoming enemies, powerful enemy ships, and massive bosses.
70010000114175.description:
■ Classic Arcade Shooter
Enjoy simple, fast-paced, and thrilling action inspired by classic 2D shooters.

■ In-Combat Upgrade System
Freely enhance attributes such as fire rate, attack power, projectile speed, and weapon types as you play.

■ Diverse Enemies and Varied Attack Patterns
Unique formations and a wide variety of enemy ships constantly appear, putting you in increasingly challenging situations.

■ Stage-Based Progression
Complete all 10 stages and face steadily increasing difficulty with each level.

■ Strategic Life Management
Survive intense attacks by using your limited resources wisely, creating a challenging and rewarding experience.

■ Four Difficulty Levels
Choose from four difficulty settings, from beginner to advanced, and challenge yourself based on your skill level.

■ Score Attack for High Replayability
Beat your high score and keep pushing your limits.

70010000114187.name: Bug!Ban!Break!
70010000114187.intro:
Four-Zone Rhythm Game!
Feel the beat with simple controls!
70010000114187.description:
This four-zone rhythm game splits the screen into four areas, creating a clean and intuitive playfield.
Notes move inward from the edges—hit them with perfect timing to keep the rhythm flowing.
Controller and touchscreen controls are both supported, letting you choose how you play.
With only single notes and simultaneous inputs, the gameplay is easy to pick up but tough to master.

The story is set in a digital world.
Strange incidents begin to surface inside a social rhythm game—avatars are taken, and unknown entities start spreading.
The narrative unfolds through chat-based conversations, slowly uncovering the truth behind the events.
Beyond the chat, the story moves forward—quietly, but with purpose.

Challenge online rankings and push your skills toward a perfect 1,000,000-point score.
A rhythm game that’s simple, satisfying, and seriously challenging.

70010000114193.name: Firework
70010000114193.intro: Firework is a Chinese horror puzzle game.
70010000114193.description: Firework is a Chinese horror puzzle game. The story takes place in a remote mountain village. An accidental fire at a funeral forces the police to re-investigate a closed case of the massacre. Lin Lixun, rookie police, participates in the re-investigation by chance. As the investigation goes deeper, the past of the victims gradually emerges. However, the case becomes more bewildering.

70010000114217.name: Xmas Survivors
70010000114217.intro: A brutal pixel-art holiday survival shooter where Santa slaughters endless waves of enemies.
70010000114217.description:
Step into the blood-soaked snowfields of the North Pole and become the most jacked Santa in history!
This fast-paced survival arena shooter throws you into endless waves of murderous snowmen, twisted holiday creatures, and monstrous bosses as you fight to save Christmas—or die trying.

Armed with an arsenal of upgradable weapons—from shotguns wrapped like candy canes to brutal rifles—and powered by dozens of stackable perks, you’ll blast, dodge, and muscle your way through increasingly chaotic hordes. Level up during each run, unlock permanent upgrades, and discover powerful builds that turn Santa into an unstoppable holiday war machine.

With chunky pixel-art, over-the-top action, and a festive world gone horribly wrong, this is Christmas like you’ve never seen it.

FEATURES
Over-the-Top Weapons
Pistols, rifles, shotguns, sniper rifles

Endless Action Survival
Fight massive swarms of enemies that grow stronger, faster, and deadlier as you level up.

Deep Progression System
Collect upgrades during every run and unlock permanent boosts to damage, speed, health, and more.

Ferocious Holiday Enemies
Face hordes of killer snowmen, deranged elves, icy beasts, and other corrupted Christmas monsters.

Challenging Bosses
Prepare for elite enemies and giant holiday horrors testing your build and reflexes.

70010000114223.name: Casual Sport Series: Boxing
70010000114223.intro: Casual Sports: Boxing is a fast-paced arcade boxing game where timing, stamina, and smart risks decide every fight.
70010000114223.description:
Throw heavy punches, chain quick combos, block high and low, dodge at the right moment, and punish your opponent with powerful counters in intense, easy-to-read matches.

Jump into local couch PvP for fun, competitive showdowns with friends, or step into a story-driven campaign where you build your boxer’s career from fight to fight. Unlock perks that can dramatically change your playstyle, customize your fighter, and compete across a variety of arenas.

With simple-to-learn mechanics, strong visual feedback, and plenty of room for mastery, Casual Sports: Boxing delivers exciting, satisfying fights whether you’re chasing victory solo or battling it out on the couch.

Key Features
- Fast-paced arcade boxing combat focused on timing, stamina management, and smart risk-taking
- Local couch PvP for competitive matches with friends
- Story-driven campaign mode where you build your boxer’s career fight by fight
- Game-changing perks that let you shape your playstyle and approach each match differently
- Multiple playable boxers to unlock, learn, and master
- Fighter customization to create a boxer that feels like your own
- Multiple arenas that bring variety and atmosphere to every fight

70010000114244.name: High Cars 3
70010000114244.description:
Race higher, faster, and through more daring paths than ever before in the next evolution of the series. 

Experience high-speed racing and precision platforming with improved graphics, richer lighting, with curved and winding tracks that bring every course to life in a fresh, dynamic way.

Speed across towering metal frameworks and futuristic structures suspended high above the world, navigating slopes, spirals, bends, and sudden drops that demand both control and courage.

Unlock new vehicles, race against the clock, and push for the perfect run across a set of challenging courses that grow increasingly complex.

70010000114250.name: Blastoids
70010000114250.intro: Grab your friends, hit the couch, and blast through 30 chaotic stages in this local co-op battle game for 1–4 players.
70010000114250.description:
Team up or go solo, unleash powerful upgrades, and conquer unique modes like Paint, Minefield, and Invisibility as you clear every foe and push to the next level. 

This is a fast-paced couch co-op action game for 1 to 4 players, built for old-school living room fun. Play solo or with friends, clear enemy-packed stages, and experiment with wild power-ups and game modes that keep every match fresh.

Battle through 30 different stages, each filled with enemies to wipe out before you can advance. Treasure chests scattered around the arena grant new abilities—boost your speed, increase your power, or even slip straight through walls to outsmart your opponents.

Whether you are teaming up or going head-to-head, the special modes change how you play: 

• Paint Mode – Shoot paint, teleport around the map or hide in plain sight to ambush your opponents
• Minefield Mode – Drop deadly mines and turn the arena into a trap-filled maze
• Invisibility Mode – Vanish from sight and rely on your instincts to survive and strike first
• Single-Player Mode – Take on mission-based challenges tailored for solo play

Perfect for quick sessions or long game nights, this offline multiplayer brawler keeps everyone shouting, laughing, and begging for “one more round.”

Feature List
• Couch co-op for 1–4 players – Play solo or with friends on the same screen.
• Offline multiplayer & single-player – No online required; just plug in and play.
• 4 unique game modes – Paint, Minefield, Invisibility, and mission-based Single-Player.
• 30 handcrafted stages – Battle through a wide variety of levels and layouts.
• Powerful pick-ups – Open treasure chests for speed boosts, power upgrades, and wall-passing abilities

70010000114256.name: Ultra Bonk Survivors
70010000114256.intro: Epic fantasy survival – bonk your way to Glory!
70010000114256.description:
Step into the chaotic world of Ultra Bonk Survivors, where every swing, spell, and explosion decides your fate!

Choose your hero, dive into monster-filled arenas, and unleash devastating attacks in this fast-paced survivor-style action roguelite designed for quick, addictive sessions of pure fun.

Game features:
- Bonk, Slash, and Survive!
- Face endless waves of goblins, skeletons, and demons in vibrant fantasy arenas that crumble and glow with magical energy.
- Every run is a fight to last just a little longer—and bonk a little harder.
- Unlock Heroes & Legends
- Begin your adventure with humble warriors and unlock mighty heroes as you progress, including the legendary Lion Knight, masters of sword and shield.
- Each character brings unique stats and attack styles to discover.
- Grow Stronger Every Run
- Collect glowing orbs, relics, and mystical books that grant random power-ups. Experiment with different builds and create unstoppable synergies.
- Explore and Interact
- Find shrines, treasure chests, and mysterious power-ups scattered across the battlefield.
  
Will you risk everything to open a chest in the middle of a horde?
One More Bonk...
Fast-paced, endlessly replayable, and dangerously addictive. Every defeat brings you closer to your next unlock and new surprises.

Check out this fun new game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team.

Ultra Bonk Survivors is your ticket to the ultimate fantasy survival experience.

Choose your hero, charge into the temple ruins, and see how long you can survive the bonkocalypse.

70010000114263.name: Divinity: Original Sin 2 - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000114263.intro:
There can only be one God.
The Divine is dead. The Void approaches. 
And the powers lying dormant within you are soon to awaken.
70010000114263.description:
From the creators of Baldur’s Gate 3, experience the world of Divinity in this epic adventure where your choices shape fate itself.

The Divine is dead. The Void approaches. And the powers lying dormant within you are soon to awaken. Choose your role in a BAFTA-winning story, and explore a world that reacts to who you are, and the choices you make. With five races to choose from, and an adventure playable solo or as a party of up to four, lay waste to an oppressive order in a world afraid of magic. Become the God the world so desperately needs.
Divinity: Original Sin 2: Definitive Edition is the most complete version of the best-selling, Metacritic Must-Play RPG.

70010000114265.name: Revolgear Zero
70010000114265.intro: Fast-paced shmup action, tons of loadout combos, and local co-op!
70010000114265.description:
[Overview]
Shizuku and Akane...two pilots bound by rivalry and friendship battle to save their world from malevolent cosmic forces! 

Multi-directional boomerang style melee attacks, flamethrowers, burst lasers...a plethora of different weapons are at your disposal to combine and match as you customize your ship, battle waves of enemies and bosses though a variety of game modes including Local Co-Op Duo Play Mode and Boost Mode which allow you to alter game rules, engage in cooperative play or take on high-score challenges!

[Gameplay]
Control the super advanced Revolgear space fighters Pheasant or Dove, and use your precise movement skills, strategic weapon usage and combat prowess to earn extra lives and maximize your score!

Use the Bit Shoot attack for a boomerang style melee attack, the burst system for a powerful energy beam attack and tons of other different weapons and load-outs you unlock as you play!

[Features]
- Seven stages with 4 difficulty levels to choose from. 
- Two main game modes that include 6 different possible endings.
- Over 2,000 different equipment combinations. Builds can be customized to suit each player preferences.
- Mission mode with 30 different challenges that test your skills with various weapons and techniques.
- Unlock shop where you can obtain custom weapons and gear using in-game currency.
- Diverse Stage Designs: From menacing mechs to mystical dragons, anything goes!
- Two Main Characters with Voice Acting. Enjoy various dialogues that change from situation to situation.
- Local Co-Op! Co-op with Algorithmic AI partner available in certain game modes too. 
- Includes the bizarre mystery bonus game "God of Cats"!
- In-game Achievements.

70010000114271.name: Gas Ratio
70010000114271.description:
Are you ready to test your driving skills and your luck?

Gas Ratio brings back the nostalgia of classic top-down arcade racers with a chaotic twist. In this game, speed isn't the only thing that matters—survival does. Drift through pixel-art tracks, dodge obstacles, and make split-second decisions.

The "Risk & Reward" System Forget standard power-ups. In Gas Ratio, every mystery box is a gamble. Crack one open and you might get a Jump ability to clear gaps or a full Repair. But beware: you might also trigger No Nitro, Low Gravity, or other debuffs that turn your race upside down!

Key Features:
Retro Arcade Vibes: Classic top-down racing with charming pixel art graphics.
Chaos Mechanics: Dynamic mystery boxes that dispense both helpful buffs and challenging debuffs.
Local Multiplayer: Grab a friend and race head-to-head in classic Split-Screen mode.
Solo Challenge: Hone your skills against competitive AI bots.
Diverse Tracks: Master 3 unique maps, each with its own twists and turns.
Garage Variety: Choose from a variety of distinct car types to suit your style.

70010000114279.name: Majotori
70010000114279.intro: How many lives will your ignorance ruin? Majotori is a narratrivia, an original little game that combines an interactive narrative with a quiz game.
70010000114279.description:
Lariat the witch will make your wish will come true if you win a game of trivia, but if you lose, something dark will happen instead. How many lives will your ignorance ruin?

Majotori is a narratrivia, an original little game that combines an interactive narrative with a quiz game.

Features:

- 25+ characters
- 50+ branching storylines
- 1000+ engaging questions for the modern geek
- 4 question categories (video games, cinema, animation, miscellaneous) with customizable frequency of appearance
- A character dying a horrible death because you don't watch enough anime

70010000114285.name: Golfing Over It with Alva Majo
70010000114285.intro: Experience the challenge of climbing an unyielding mountain without infuriating controls being part of that challenge. A different take on 2017's hit Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy.
70010000114285.description:
Golfing Over It with Alva Majo is a discouraging game about climbing a surreal mountain with a golf ball, a different take on 2017's hit Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy.
Experience the challenge of climbing an unyielding mountain without infuriating controls being part of that challenge.

Bennett Foddy has played this game and granted it his blessing.

Features:

- Golf your way up to the top.
- Listen as Alva explains why he made such a cruel game.
- Fall all the way back to the bottom.
- And if you manage to get to the top?
- Will that make you feel good?
- Will you feel that it's all been worth it?
- I think you will.

70010000114298.name: Seafrog
70010000114298.intro: Hop aboard Seafrog’s rocket-powered wrench and slide, grind, and trick your way through a one-of-a-kind 2.5D action-puzzle-platformer!
70010000114298.description:
Seafrog is an action-platformer mashed with the movement of lite-skateboarding. Grind, kick-flip and find the flow with a rocket-powered wrench that moves smoother than a buttered beluga!

A SEA-SLICK PLATFORMER
String together combos by using a simple auto-trick system, landing grinds on enemies and rusty pipes to fuel up your rocket-wrench! Use the fuel to boost through enemies, fly straight up walls, and stick to ceilings in order to complete over 120 handcrafted challenges!

EXPLORE RUN-DOWN SHIPS
Battle vengeful Viking ghosts aboard the Sea Dragon. Dig in for an unsavory meal aboard the Chunky Chacken, where you’ll discover a man-eating chicken outbreak. Finally, get ready for some monkey business at The Sweater Factory, an abandoned workshop run by an unexpected crew of apes causing all the ruckus. Each chapter holds a Master Gear, guarded by an ultimate boss.

MASTER GEAR, HO!
Battle the legendary Skraken, Metal Beak the Momma Chacken, and... Gerald. Face these colorful 'n crusty foes to retrieve the Master Gears and repair your cannon. Blast yourself to a stranded seaplane to escape The Seahole, a mysterious sinking hole in the ocean… before ye end up in Davy Jones' Locker!

CREATED AND DEVELOPED BY OH MY ME GAMES

70010000114304.name: Escape game R00M09
70010000114304.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

70010000114310.name: Flight? Youth!
70010000114310.intro: One day, a girl with a cat-shaped hairpin asks for help saving a stray cat. And then... she says something... “I want to fly in the sky! Please help me!"
70010000114310.description:
Overview

"Flying? Youth!" is a story-driven visual novel.
Follow the protagonist and experience a unique story with the heroine, Lee Nayoun.
The game features both a Happy Ending and a Bad Ending — try to discover them all!

Story

No one wants to be friends with me — probably because of my intimidating look.
One day, a girl with a cat-shaped hairpin asks for help saving a stray cat.

And then... she says something completely unexpected:

“I want to fly in the sky! Please help me!”

Huh? Flying? Like in a hot air balloon?!
No, seriously—stop chasing me!!!

A bubbly, balloon-like romantic comedy
about a couple of free-spirited “flying teens”!

Features

Full Voice Acting for Heroine Lee Nayoun
Enjoy the full voice performance of the heroine, Lee Nayoun.
Her charming voice perfectly matches the cute character illustrations!

Fully Supported in Korean and Japanese
"Flying? Youth!" supports both Korean and Japanese voiceovers and subtitles.
You can set the subtitle and voice languages separately to your liking.

A Short but Well-Woven Story
With 9 chapters and a total playtime of about 30 minutes,
this short visual novel delivers a satisfying and complete narrative —
just like reading a compact, illustrated short story.

70010000114316.name: Lotzo and The Ray of Light
70010000114316.intro: Lotzo and The Ray of Light is a vibrant 3D platformer where players guide Lotzo, a joyful guardian, through glowing, painterly realms to restore the fractured light of the world.
70010000114316.description:
The celestial worlds were once a radiant dreamscape, powered by the celestial Ray of Light. But something has gone wrong — the light has splintered, and the land is fading. Magical creatures are losing their glow, and the skies have dimmed to twilight.

You play as Lotzo, a small purple guardian with glowing turquoise markings, fluttering red wings, and boundless energy. Alongside your floating companion — a cheerful spirit, you’ll journey through mystical lands to recover the scattered light and rekindle the world’s brilliance.

Fluid, Joyful Movement
- Glide, dash, and double-jump through painterly landscapes
- Responsive controls and smooth animations with tons of charm

Magical Companions & Powers
- Your spirit friend helps reveal secrets and guide you through the worlds
- Collect light fragments to unlock new abilities: air roll, back flip and more.

Painterly Visuals & Emotional Resonance
- Stylized lighting, glowing effects, and soft textures create a magical, storybook feel
- Character designs are expressive and endearing, with mythic charm and playful energy

70010000114318.name: Clothing Store Simulator
70010000114318.intro: Design your dream boutique, sell trendy clothes, and build a fashion empire! It's your turn to shine in Clothing Store Simulator.
70010000114318.description:
Ready to Write Your Own Fashion Story?

Experience the thrill of managing the city's most popular clothing store from scratch on Nintendo Switch™ with Clothing Store Simulator! Transforming a small shop into a huge fashion hub is entirely in your hands.

Impress Customers with Your Style Stock your shelves with the trendiest dresses, stylish shirts, and eye-catching accessories. Understand your customers' needs, offer the right products, and build a loyal customer base by increasing satisfaction.

Redesign Your Store Selling clothes isn't enough; the atmosphere matters! Choose from a vast catalog of furniture. Arrange shelves, fitting rooms, and decorations to your taste. A minimalist boutique or a colorful shopping haven? You are the designer!

Grow and Expand Invest your earnings wisely. Physically expand your store, add more product variety, and boost your sales volume. Manage checkout lines and ensure your store always looks perfect.

Features:

Detailed Store Management: Track stock, set prices, and manage profit margins.

Customizable Interior: Design every corner, from wall colors to furniture.

Dynamic Customer System: Interact with customers having different expectations.

Progression System: A journey from a small business to a giant brand.

Unlock the doors to the fashion world and become the tycoon of retail with Clothing Store Simulator!

70010000114320.name: Maid of Salvation
70010000114320.intro: The latest title from the HunterX development studio, Maid of Salvation is an action RPG that features fast-paced and versatile combat.
70010000114320.description:
A Dark Fantasy of Maids
Shizuka, a maid of purgatory, fights to bring salvation to lost souls. Entrusted with a special mission from the Sanctuary’s Overseer, she crosses the portal into a Purgatory overrun by Fiends. Yet as her journey unfolds, Shizuka begins to realize that the salvation she believed in—and the truth of this world—is far more twisted than she ever imagined...

Features
Experience deep, satisfying combat through a diverse fighting style that blends swords, firearms, and secret techniques with precise controls.

Enjoy rich action that combines exploration and a wide array of skills, including dodging, guarding, parrying, surprise attacks, and chain-based moves.

Face over 20 powerful bosses. Make full use of the items and secret techniques you've acquired to approach each battle with strategic precision.

Enjoy quests and hidden boss encounters. Discover the unfolding stories of maids—whether allies or rivals.

A finely crafted skill board system awaits you. Develop your character to match your unique playstyle.

70010000114326.name: Eden of Creation／創世のエデン
70010000114326.intro: Survive for 30 days as the first human to set foot on the land created by the gods! A survival simulation game!
70010000114326.description:
Become Adam and Eve and survive for 30 days.
Your HP will continuously decrease, so you must keep searching for food.
Since the outcomes are random, try different choices, experience the events that occur along the way, and guide them toward their ending.

Eight characters appear: God, Goddess, Grim Reaper, three angels, Adam, and Eve!

70010000114333.name: Tile Jong
70010000114333.description:
Dive into Tile Jong, a beautifully designed tile-matching game that blends relaxation with strategy! Solve engaging puzzles by selecting and matching sets of three identical tiles. Each level brings new challenges with increasingly intricate layouts that will test your concentration and problem-solving skills.

Key Features:
- Engaging Tile-Matching Gameplay – Tap, match, and clear tiles to progress through a variety of levels.
- Vibrant & Relaxing Visuals – Enjoy a colorful, soothing atmosphere with smooth animations.
- 4 Unique Power-Ups – Need help? Use hints, reshuffles, undos, and extra slots to overcome tricky levels!
- Journey Through Beautiful Landscapes – Unlock new levels as you explore serene backgrounds.
- Easy to Learn, Challenging to Master – Start with simple puzzles and gradually take on more complex challenges.

Can you clear all the levels and become a Tile Jong master? Test your skills!

70010000114339.name: Drop Pop
70010000114339.description:
Drop Pop is an addictive and relaxing game that is easy to play and hard to stop. Drop colorful balls, connect the same ones, and watch them turn into bigger balls. Every move feels satisfying and rewarding.

Enjoy smooth and calming gameplay with no pressure, no timers, and no stress. Play at your own pace - relax for a few minutes or spend hours having fun and improving your skills.

Think you can do better? In Drop Pop, you can beat high scores and challenge records set by other players. Plan your moves, aim for bigger merges, and climb higher on the leaderboard.

70010000114346.name: Wall World 2
70010000114346.intro: The adventure in the mysterious world of the Wall continues!
70010000114346.description:
The world of the Wall awaits. Wall World 2 builds on the mining rogue-lite experience with expanded mechanics, new challenges, and deeper gameplay. Explore procedurally generated mines full of new discoveries and dangers. Extract valuable resources, harness lost technologies, and upgrade your robospider and exosuit to survive against hordes of raging monsters. Venture through incredible biomes and uncover the secrets entombed in the depths of the Wall.

DELVE INTO THE MYSTERIES OF THE WALL
Venture deep into the World Wall in your robospider. The mysterious Hole holds both deadly threats and long-lost answers. Risk everything to find out what lies on the other side of the unseen depths.

BATTLE ON ALL FRONTS
Monsters lurk everywhere — not only on the surface of the Wall, but also within its mines. Arm yourself with an arsenal of powerful weapons and abilities to fight off any threat that stands between you and the truth.

ADAPT TO A LIVING WORLD
The endless Wall is ever-changing. Its depths contain not only resources and technologies, but also anomalies that can help or hinder your journey. Navigate incredible biomes, overcome obstacles and discover new wonders as you carve your path deeper inside.

UPGRADE AND CUSTOMIZE
Customize your robospider between expeditions and meet new characters in the sphere city. You'll have plenty of options to upgrade and enhance the equipment of both your exosuit and your mobile battle station. Each of them brings you one step closer to conquering the Wall.

70010000114355.name: Emoji Battlefield - Sky Massacre
70010000114355.intro: Fast-paced rogue-like FPS mayhem above the clouds!
70010000114355.description:
The emojis have ascended — and heaven is under attack.
In this chaotic rogue-like first-person shooter, you fight to defend sacred floating temples as waves of emojis invade from beyond the clouds.
Before each run, choose your modifiers: make the challenge brutal with Hard Mode, turn every enemy into a halo-wearing trickster, or enable Bouncy Mode to turn the battlefield into a storm of leaping chaos.
Then step into the sky arenas — floating temples, shattered bridges, and ancient ruins drifting above endless clouds. Each arena offers unique hazards like breakable floors, explosive relics, and narrow walkways where one wrong step means a long fall.
Armed with a simple pistol, you’ll face waves of emojis that rush, fly, shield, explode, and overwhelm. Destroy them to collect glowing orbs, level up, and choose powerful upgrades: boost your stats, gain perks, or spawn new weapons to shift the tide.
Every second becomes a balancing act between precision and survival. The further you hold out, the more aggressive and varied the emojis become — from bouncing kamikazes to floating sharpshooters raining fire from above.
Survive long enough, and you’ll unlock new arenas, modifiers, and more ways to embrace the madness of the skies.

70010000114358.name: Enchantment 2 Sun's Tear Collector's Edition
70010000114358.intro: A magical hidden object game set in the Melleryn Kingdom, featuring diverse modes and puzzles!
70010000114358.description:
Your mission is to assist the fairies in locating hidden fragments of various magical items scattered across the Melleryn Kingdom. 
As you advance, you'll explore diverse locations featuring three unique modes: fragmented, matching pairs, and all of a kind. 
Throughout the game, you'll also encounter jigsaw, swap puzzles, and a hangman word game with stunning enchanted images!

Key Game Features:

- 3 Game Modes to choose from!
- Shard puzzles and Rotate Puzzles!
- Hangman word game with performance log!
- Integrated walkthrough for shards!

70010000114363.name: BRIO World - Railway
70010000114363.description:
BRIO World - Railway is a cozy and creative sandbox experience where you can build your very own train city. Using an easy-to-use building system, you’ll lay tracks, place scenery, and design detailed railway systems that come to life before your eyes. Whether you're a longtime train fan or just looking for a peaceful game to unwind with, this is your perfect escape.

Bring your imagination to life with over 250 beautifully crafted pieces - including tracks, trees, bridges, buildings, animals, and more. All pieces are designed with the classic BRIO wooden toy aesthetic, highlighting the warmth and charm of handcrafted playsets.

Meet the charming characters who live in your world and help them with fun little tasks. Complete missions to level up and unlock new parts and features as you go.

Drive your trains or cars in an immersive first-person view and see your creations from a whole new perspective, or simply sit back and watch your trains drive along the tracks you’ve laid down. It’s your world - explore it however you like.

BRIO World - Railway is designed to be a gentle, no-stress experience that welcomes everyone. Whether you want to build for hours, play short creative sessions, or just enjoy watching your trains go by, it’s the perfect way to slow down and enjoy a moment of calm.

70010000114373.name: Rumbral
70010000114373.intro: Every step reveals a secret. Every shadow a threat. Welcome to Rumbral
70010000114373.description:
FIND YOUR PATH IN RUMBRAL

You wake up in a dark, mysterious forest with no memory of who you are or why you're there. Move through a world filled with abandoned structures and puzzles, perhaps left behind by others. Survivors? Explorers? Discover strange magenta liquids that reveal secrets of the past… and maybe of yourself. But be careful: you might not be alone in this desolate place.

TRAVEL BETWEEN REALITIES

Throughout your journey in Rumbral, you'll come across strange magenta puddles that allow you to travel to another reality. Shift between these parallel worlds to influence both and find your way forward.

SOLVE MYSTERIOUS PUZZLES

The path won’t always be easy: you’ll need to solve different obstacles that stand in your way to keep moving on.

DISCOVER HIDDEN COLLECTIBLES

Along the way, you'll find special collectible items, some more hidden than others. Gathering them will help you uncover the story of this broken world.

70010000114383.name: Rune Dice
70010000114383.description:
"Launch dice across enchanted battlefields where realistic physics meets ancient magic. Matching dice fuse into a more powerful one that seeks its equals, triggering devastating chain combos. Plan each throw carefully - every dice placement can trigger massive combos that wipe out entire enemy waves or set up tactical future plays. Master both precise aiming and strategic prediction to unleash the full power of mystical dice fusion.

Pick from 8 unique classes, each with special dice and magical abilities. Every class offers multiple heroes with different starting combinations, ensuring each adventure feels completely different. Spread deadly poison through enemy ranks as a Rogue, unleash lightning storms as a Mage, or absorb massive damage as a heavily armored Warrior. Each class opens up entirely new tactical approaches and synergies.

Every location culminates in challenging battles against bosses, each with unique abilities that will test your strategy.

Some bosses summon additional minions, others manipulate the dice field, and the most dangerous can completely change combat rules. Adapt your dice collection and tactics to overcome each distinct threat.

Craft a powerful combination of dice, relics, and runes that work together to define your playstyle.

Collect magical dice through combat victories and shop purchases, discover game-changing relics that provide permanent enhancements, and gather tactical runes for battlefield manipulation. Visit ancient altars where you can risk your dice for upgrades, or play it safe and build your arsenal gradually. The synergy between your dice attacks, relic bonuses, and rune abilities creates devastating combinations and endless strategic possibilities."

70010000114418.name: Wanderstop
70010000114418.intro: A narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea
70010000114418.description:
Wanderstop is a narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea. Playing as a fallen fighter named Alta, you’ll manage a tea shop within a magical forest and tend to the customers who pass through. But Alta does not want to be here. And if she gets her way, the tea shop will be nothing but a brief and painful memory.
 
 
 Wanderstop is a tea shop management ritual. Grow and harvest the ingredients needed for tea, and then mix them together in an unusual tea-making contraption. Along the way, speak with the many travelers who pass through the shop, learn their stories and make tea that’s just right for them.
 
 In your downtime, you might tidy up around the clearing, decorate the shop in your style, or just sit on a bench with a cup of tea and listen to your own thoughts. Maybe doing nothing at all is okay. The shop demands patience, it rejects those who have come only in the pursuit of growth unchecked.
 
 And that’s why Alta can’t be here. It’s why she’ll never make it. This isn’t who she is. No, she’s a fighter! Why would anyone insist on turning the world’s greatest championship warrior into a docile shopkeeper?! With everything she’s capable of?? No no no, she won’t, she won’t do it... she can’t…
 
 Wanderstop is a game from the team at Ivy Road, including Davey Wreden (creator of The Stanley Parable and The Beginner’s Guide), Karla Zimonja (co-creator of Gone Home and Tacoma) and Daniel “C418” Rosenfeld (the music of Minecraft).

70010000114430.name: Nightfall Village
70010000114430.intro: Sharpen your blade, follow the glow of the lanterns, and defend the village!
70010000114430.description: Nightfall Village is a pixel-art action adventure where players slash through lurking zombies, explore eerie forests, and fight their way across a shadow-covered countryside. With retro-styled graphics, punchy animations, and a determined village hero, the game delivers quick, satisfying combat perfect for short bursts of action or longer dungeon-crawling sessions. Level up, complete quests, and push back the darkness as you uncover new areas, battle undead swarms, and light your path through the night. Sharpen your blade, follow the glow of the lanterns, and defend the village before the shadows take over!

70010000114436.name: Pocket Drift Rally
70010000114436.intro: Chase the perfect racing line, and leave clouds of smoke behind!
70010000114436.description: Pocket Drift Rally is a fast-paced, cartoon-style racing game where players slide through tight corners, master drifting techniques, and race on dynamic asphalt tracks inspired by real motorsport circuits. With vibrant graphics, exaggerated motion, and a charming rally car hero, the game delivers quick, satisfying drift action perfect for short, exciting play sessions. Customize your driving style, chase the perfect racing line, and leave clouds of smoke behind as you dominate each track!

70010000114447.name: Temari Trials: Dojo's Test
70010000114447.description:
Temari Trials: Dojo’s Test is a logic-focused puzzle game with charming pixel art where you guide a clever fox pushing temaris toward locked chests. Every hit removes a lock, and when a chest is fully unlocked, the level is cleared. Temaris can also push each other, allowing creative setups and surprising solutions for players who enjoy Japanese aesthetics and clever problem-solving.

The game features 30 handcrafted single-player stages with challenges that evolve based on how many hits each chest requires and how temaris can be positioned to reach them. You control a fox exploring levels filled with temaris and chests that range from 1 to 3 locks. Your goal is to plan the order and direction of every push while considering obstacles and placement.

You begin each stage by observing your options. Then you act, watch the result and use undo or restart if needed. When all locks are broken by hitting the chests with the correct temaris, the fox clears the mission and advances to the next challenge.

70010000114487.name: BLOCLASH
70010000114487.intro:
Stylish visuals, music, and effects bring this game to life!
A simple yet strategic competitive puzzle battle!
70010000114487.description:
