Get ready for a brand-new puzzle battle experience that blends speed and strategy, now on Nintendo Switch™!

One wrong move can turn the tables, but a flash of inspiration can change everything!
Enjoy intense, edge-of-your-seat matches where the outcome isn't decided until the very end!

Customize the game to your liking with detailed settings such as stage size, music, time limits, and player colors!

With a Joy-Con™ controller for each player, you can challenge a friend to a serious one-on-one showdown!

《Rules》
Take turns placing blocks and connect lines vertically or horizontally!
When a line is completed, all blocks on that line disappear!
Earn points based on the number of your opponent's blocks removed!
The first player to reach the target score wins!

[Challenge Mode]
Battle against the CPU under special rules!
Each victory increases the difficulty, putting your thinking skills and speed to the test.
Push your limits and see how far you can go!

[Battle Mode]
Face off in intense one-on-one matches against the CPU or friends!
Adjust the settings and enjoy battles tailored to your preferences!

[Online Mode]
Compete in real-time against players from around the world!
Jump into Quick Matches that affect your rating, or enjoy casual Room Matches!
Test your strategy against skilled competitors nationwide!

70010000114526.name: Star Freight
70010000114526.intro: Can you deliver the goods? Board your spaceship and go!
70010000114526.description:
Can you deliver the goods? Board your old but still trusted spaceship and get ready to haul cargo. But fuel is expensive, so make sure to choose the optimal route!

Star Freight is a space-themed puzzle game, featuring:
- a selection of 100 puzzles of increasing difficulty
- unique packing and route choice challenges

70010000114533.name: Double Trouble: Sexy Logic
70010000114533.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000114545.name: Demon Huntress
70010000114545.description:
Demon Huntress is a top-down roguelike shooter built around fast combat, endless progression, and outrageous power scaling.
Each run sends you through three randomized worlds chosen from five distinct areas, each filled with demons, traps, treasures, and escalating danger. Combat is fluid and aggressive, centered around precise movement, dodge rolls, and ranged combat using a powerful crossbow.
During a run, you unlock randomized spells and upgrades: traps, rotating magical orbs, spirit companions, passive buffs, auras, and more. Every choice shapes your build, creating wildly different playstyles from run to run.
Beyond each run lies permanent progression. Souls collected from fallen demons unlock powerful meta upgrades that persist forever. Stack multiple dodge rolls, trigger chain lightning, drain life on hit, leave fire trails behind you, or cause enemies to explode. These upgrades compound over time, turning early struggles into late-game dominance.
The more you play, the more broken you become.
With randomized runs, massive build variety, and permanent progression that rewards dedication, Demon Huntress delivers a roguelike power fantasy where growth never stops—and demons never stand a chance.

70010000114551.name: Double Trouble: Sexy Academy
70010000114551.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000114567.name: Double Trouble: Sexy Adventure
70010000114567.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000114573.name: From the Bunker
70010000114573.description:
You are trapped in a crumbling, post-apocalyptic bunker, and your only goal is survival. Navigate dark corridors, smash obstacles with your trusty hammer, and find hidden paths as you search for an exit. Each level increases the difficulty with destructible doors, furniture, and secret rooms that test your wit, timing, and strategy.

Explore carefully. Glowing objects hint at upgrades, tools, and shortcuts. As you progress, unlock new abilities that give you the power to tackle bigger barriers and uncover more of the bunker’s secrets. 

From the Bunker delivers a thrilling survival experience to test your skills with tense puzzle-solving, interactive environments, and a constant sense of danger. Can you escape before time runs out?

70010000114579.name: Soccer
70010000114579.description:
Soccer is a third person football game where you control and see each player individually, making every action feel direct, personal, and more intense than classic top down or broadcast style football games. You are always close to the action, watching your player run, defend, and attack in real time, which makes every match feel dynamic and exciting.

Thanks to a ball physics system based on the game engine, every pass, shot, bounce, and deflection feels natural and unpredictable, creating immersive gameplay where no two situations play out exactly the same. Even with its humorous and cartoon like visual style, where players have oversized big heads, the game still delivers a fun and satisfying football experience that rewards timing, positioning, and smart play.

The game includes several difficulty modes, starting with Training to learn the controls and understand the basics, then moving on to Easy, Medium, Hard, and finally Champions for players who want the highest level of challenge and competitive gameplay. Each difficulty increases the speed, precision, and overall intensity of the matches, pushing you to improve your skills and decision making.

70010000114591.name: Pawsky
70010000114591.intro: Welcome to a whimsical animal adventure in which your choices shape the story and the world reacts to your actions!
70010000114591.description:
A Short & Whisker-Twitching Adventure!
Step into the paws of a curious cat in this choice-driven, storybook-style game!
Explore, interact, and make decisions that shape your journey, whether that means making friends, causing mischief, or discovering something unexpected.

What’s in the Box?
- Be a Cat - Nap, explore, knock things over, and do what cats do best!
- Make Choices - Your decisions shape the story, leading to different outcomes.
- Meet Quirky Characters - Befriend (or bother) a cast of charming animal NPCs.

It’s a short and delightful game, perfect for a cozy playthrough in a single sitting. Where will your paws take you?

70010000114610.name: NemoSphere
70010000114610.description:
NemoSphere is the easy-play shooter

Left and right operation and shoot

Shoot to the sphere coming from the left and right

The ejected block is speedy

The key point is timing

Leave your best time

70010000114614.name: Factorio – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000114614.description:
Factorio is a game in which you build and maintain factories. You will be mining resources, researching technologies, building infrastructure, automating production and fighting enemies. In the beginning you will find yourself chopping trees, mining ores and crafting mechanical arms and transport belts by hand, but in short time you can become an industrial powerhouse, with huge solar fields, oil refining and cracking, manufacture and deployment of construction and logistic robots, all for your resource needs. However this heavy exploitation of the planet's resources does not sit nicely with the locals, so you will have to be prepared to defend yourself and your machine empire.

Join forces with other players in cooperative Multiplayer, create huge factories, collaborate and delegate tasks between you and your friends. While the core gameplay is in the form of the freeplay scenario, there are a range of interesting challenges in the form of Scenarios. If you don't find any maps or scenarios you enjoy, you can create your own with the in-game Map Editor, place down entities, enemies, and terrain in any way you like.

70010000114620.name: Death by Scrolling
70010000114620.description:
Welcome to Death by Scrolling, an action game set in the chaotic depths of Purgatory, inc. now under new management! Choose your character—each with unique perks and abilities, and race upward through endless levels. Battle bizarre monsters, dodge death itself, and collect gems to pay the Ferryman’s exorbitant fee! With each screen inching upward, time is never on your side. Outsmart the Reaper, grab power-ups, complete quirky side quests, and shop from vendors mid-run. Stay alive, pay your dues, and maybe, just maybe, you'll cross that river.
Key Features
	- Varied Cast of Characters: Select from multiple playable characters, each offering distinct abilities and perks to suit your playstyle.
	- Vertically Scrolling Mayhem: Constant upward movement means no time to rest—let the fiery bottom of the screen catch you, and it’s game over.
	- Relentless Pursuit: The Reaper is always close by—stun, dodge, and outmaneuver, but never kill him!
	- Loot & Progression: Collect gold and precious gems to unlock upgrades, power-ups, and abilities from quirky vendors.
	- Bonus Runs & Side Quests: Discover extra challenges and side quests at the top of each level for extra rewards.
	- Monster Mash: Battle quirky underworld creatures, from hellish pests to demonic bosses, all in a wild vertical sprint.
	- Quirky Lore & Humor: A tongue-in-cheek take on afterlife bureaucracy, with cheeky dialogues and playful narration.
	- Leaderboards: See how your purgatorial performance stacks up against other trapped souls.
Choose your hero. Outsmart death. Outrun scrolling. Earn your passage. Are you ready to survive Purgatory, inc.?

70010000114622.name: Versebound
70010000114622.intro: Hardcore survival in a world of Dungeon Synth and Finnish folklore.

70010000114630.name: Screw Master
70010000114630.intro: Are you good with a screwdriver?
70010000114630.description:
Screw Master is a fun and engaging puzzle game where players must strategically remove screws to dismantle intricate wooden structures. Each level presents a new challenge requiring logical thinking and precise actions. With 50 levels of increasing difficulty, can you master the art of unscrewing?

Gameplay Features:
- Challenging Puzzle Mechanics - Unscrew, remove planks, and clear the board!
- Realistic Physics - Every screw holds the structure together, so plan your moves wisely.
- Strategic Thinking - Remove screws in the right order to prevent getting stuck.
- Time-Based Challenges - Beat the clock to complete levels efficiently!

Power-Ups to Help You! 
- Hammer - Instantly removes a plank, clearing the way.
- Drill - Adds an extra hole to free trapped pieces.
- Screwdriver - Removes a screw completely, bypassing any restrictions.
- Freeze - Stops time, giving you more time to think and solve the puzzle.

Use these tools wisely to tackle tougher puzzles and progress through levels!

Levels & Progression 
- 50 unique levels, each introducing new mechanics and increasing complexity.
-  Unlock power-ups as you advance to help with more intricate puzzles.
- Dismantle creative wooden structures, testing your logic and precision.

Why You’ll Love Screw Master!
- Addictive and relaxing gameplay
- Satisfying visuals and realistic sound effects
- Simple controls but deep strategy

Are you ready to become the Screw Master? Start unscrewing now and see if you can clear all 50 levels!

70010000114639.name: Long Run 2
70010000114639.intro: Grow your line. Shoot for glory.
70010000114639.description:
This high-energy hyper-casual runner expands the original experience with faster movement, smoother visuals, and a new wave of dynamic obstacles. Players charge through the tracks while growing a trailing line of followers, multiply your numbers through colour-coded gates, and avoid hazards designed to tear your chain apart. The bigger your trail, the more power you carry into the explosive end-of-run finale.
At the finish, your entire squad is loaded into a cannon and fired toward a series of rotating targets. Each successful hit racks up points, with tighter targets offering larger rewards. Every run showers players with coins that can be saved up to unlock an expanding wardrobe of hats, letting you customise your crew with playful flair.
Build the longest trail you can, survive the gauntlet, and blast your team toward ever higher scores in a continuously evolving, endlessly repeatable sprint.

70010000114647.name: Sun Meadow
70010000114647.intro: A soothing exploration adventure you won’t want to leave.
70010000114647.description:
Sun Meadow is a relaxing walking exploration game set in a soft, glowing, dreamlike woodland. Wander through quiet meadows, shimmering ponds, and ancient groves as you search for hidden landmarks scattered throughout a magical, ever-peaceful forest. No danger, no combat—just you, the trees, and the sunlight.

Features

> A Relaxing, Combat-Free Adventure
No enemies, no pressure—just pure exploration.

> A Soft, Magical Forest
Discover glowing mushrooms and tiny hidden secrets.

>Find Beautiful Landmarks
Explore to uncover scenic viewpoints, mysterious groves, and other charming places.

>Immersive Ambient Soundscape
Forest rustling, creek water, distant birds—built to soothe.

>Cozy, Cute, and Warm
A feel-good fantasy space designed for comfort.

70010000114657.name: Love and Legends
70010000114657.intro: In a heartbeat, the ordinary becomes legendary. In a world of fantasy, where will your destiny and love lead?
70010000114657.description:
The Story:

On your way home from work, a sudden bolt of lightning changes everything. You wake up to find yourself in a strange new land... a world reminiscent of medieval Europe?!

Before you can even get your bearings, you are falsely accused of being the reincarnation of the Evil Witch Queen and dragged off to the royal castle.

Your pleas of innocence fall on deaf ears. With suspicion hanging over you, you are forced to make a choice: select one of five enchanting heroes - who look as if they stepped straight out of a fairy tale - to be your warden and keep watch over you...

Why were you summoned to this world? As you unravel the mysteries binding you here, where will this unexpected love lead?

Characters:

August (The Knight)
Iseul (The Elf Prince)
Saerys (The Demon)
Altea (The Wizard)
Reiner (The Lord)
Helena (The Sorceress)
Alain (The Knight General)

Contents: Main Stories from the app "Lovestruck: Choose Your Romance" up until Season 5.

70010000114662.name: City Hunter
70010000114662.intro: After 35 years, the only official game is now being revived.
70010000114662.description:
Released on March 2, 1990 as the only official home-console game of its kind, this legendary title returns 35 years later—now launching worldwide simultaneously with all the excitement of its original debut.
This game is more than just a remake—it’s a fusion of nostalgia and newness. With multi-language localization, both long-time fans and new players can enjoy the experience without a language barrier.

Relive the excitement and emotional moments once more.

New Features
Multi-language support for fans worldwide:
Supported languages: Japanese, English, French (including the Nicky Larson version), German, Italian, Spanish, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese

Story
My name is Ryo Saeba, also known as City Hunter. In this line of work, I'm a well-known professional "sweeper."
I take on all kinds of jobs, from protecting beautiful women to assassinations. In other words, I'm a cleaner who gets rid of the scum of the city. That means I live a life constantly on the edge. My partner, Kaori, is the younger sister of my deceased best friend, but she never brings in any decent jobs.

So, what kind of work is waiting for me today?

70010000114677.name: Star Racer
70010000114677.intro: Race through futuristic cities where gravity is just another obstacle!
70010000114677.description:
Speed across anti-gravity tracks filled with jumps, shortcuts, hazards, and explosive pickups on your way to victory! Get revved up for local multiplayer, challenging Event Races, a powerful Course Editor, and more.

Create your own tracks, discover new community creations, master every shortcut, and leave your rivals behind. Whether you're chasing the perfect lap or battling for first place, there's always another race waiting in Star Racer.

70010000114679.name: Sweet Home: Look and Find 4 Collector's Edition
70010000114679.intro: Immerse yourself in a cozy atmosphere of hidden object searches and puzzle-solving fun!
70010000114679.description:
Each place is uniquely styled, offering a warm atmosphere and dozens of hidden items to find.
Show off your skills in mini-games. A variety of puzzles and challenges will help you unlock new levels and discover even more places to search for hidden objects.
Customize your interior and create your perfect room! 
Decorate it with beautiful items and add a personal touch by purchasing new décor and furniture to create your unique cozy space.

- Relaxing gameplay designed for fans of hidden object games.
- Engaging challenges that improve observation skills.
- Explore cozy places: Sit by the pool, grill barbecue in the backyard, or discover charming cottages in nature.

70010000114699.name: Bus Stop Shuffle
70010000114699.intro: Arrange passengers perfectly and master the ultimate bus puzzle challenge!
70010000114699.description:
All aboard! Get ready for a colorful, brain-teasing puzzle experience where your goal is simple but oh-so-addictive: arrange all passengers to fit perfectly on their matching buses. Sounds easy? Think again!

In this fun and relaxing puzzle game, you’ll face increasingly tricky challenges as you sort passengers by color and seat them correctly before the buses depart. Each level brings new patterns, tighter spaces, and more passengers to organize — testing your logic, speed, and strategic thinking.

Game Features:

Unique Puzzle Mechanics: Drag and arrange passengers so they fit into their designated bus seats. Every move counts!

Dozens of Fun Levels: Start simple and progress to more complex puzzles with multiple buses and limited space.

Colorful and Relaxing Visuals: A bright, cheerful design to keep your mind sharp and your mood lifted.

Earn Coins and Unlock Challenges: Complete levels perfectly to earn rewards and unlock new puzzles.

Brain-Training Gameplay: Sharpen your problem-solving skills while having endless fun.

Quick, Pick-up-and-Play Sessions: Perfect for short breaks or long puzzle-solving marathons.

Can you keep up with the rush and seat every passenger before the buses leave? Test your organizational skills, plan your moves carefully, and become the ultimate bus puzzle master!

Hop in, line up your passengers, and let the puzzle journey begin!

70010000114708.name: ChildStory
70010000114708.intro: Explore a northern town with Sonya, solving puzzles and fighting spirits.
70010000114708.description:
A small town in the far north goes about its life: preparing for the Festival of the New Star, decorating streets, celebrating. The festival is inseparable from a cycle that repeats month after month. And Sonya stands at its center.

She's part of a story she's still trying to understand. A kind girl with a sharp mind and countless questions, she searches for answers among snow and lights.

Sonya helps friends, makes new ones, explores hidden corners, fights spirits, and solves puzzles. She acts, hoping her actions will lead to understanding.

Game Features:
- An isometric adventure with detailed pixel art that brings a cozy, living world to life
- Combat against spirits and bosses that tests your reflexes and wit
- Puzzles and challenges for those who love to explore
- Memorable characters with their own stories: talk, help, and build friendships
- A soulful soundtrack that warms the heart and stays with you

The cycle continues.

70010000114714.name: Dinosaur Bones Digging Simulator 2026
70010000114714.intro: Your Journey Begins Beneath the Sands of Time
70010000114714.description:
Step into a thrilling excavation adventure set beneath the ancient sands of Egypt, where history, discovery, and progression come together in one immersive experience. In this dinosaur excavation simulator, you lead your own archaeological expedition - carefully digging through layered desert terrain, uncovering fossil remains, and revealing secrets lost for millions of years.

Begin with simple excavation tools and gradually upgrade your equipment to handle deeper, more delicate digs. Improve your brushes, shovels, and drilling tools, unlock advanced scanning devices, and refine your excavation techniques to locate fossils with greater precision and efficiency.

Explore vast underground sites hidden beneath the Egyptian desert, filled with dinosaur bones, ancient skeletons, rare fossils, and mysterious prehistoric remains waiting to be unearthed. Catalog your discoveries, restore valuable specimens, sell or exhibit rare finds, and reinvest your resources to unlock new excavation zones and deeper layers of history.

No timers, no pressure - just pure discovery and scientific exploration. Dig carefully, plan your excavations wisely, and become a master paleontologist. The deeper you dig, the more extraordinary and ancient your discoveries become. How much of Earth’s forgotten past will you uncover?

70010000114718.name: Cleaning Up!
70010000114718.intro: Turn huge messes into sparkling spaces! Feel the satisfaction of cleaning with your super-powered tools. A short and simple game about the joy of tidying up!
70010000114718.description:
Make mountains of trash disappear in seconds, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of turning messy spaces into organized and clean environments. This is a short, stress-free cozy game to unwind with, and spark some joy.

Note: if you played our previous games like "Rain on Your Parade" or "Just Crow Things", a heads up that this one is a bit less puzzle-y and less challenging. It's more about simply relaxing for an evening or two!

Vacuum, brush, mop, spray – there are many ways to make a place sparkling clean. As a new Cleaning Gig Worker, you will take on variety of requests - declutter a hoarded-up apartment, spiffy up old haunted mansion while avoiding ghosts, or solve puzzles in an ancient temple and find (and clean) the treasure room. Who knows, some of these might even seem familiar ;)

As you play, you will grow your prestige and earn cash, letting you upgrade your tools and purchase new outfits. Don't fret, the game is very low-pressure, and you can always revisit levels with improved tools to get better scores.

Most importantly, bring many derelict locations back to life, with your trusty broom and vacuum!

70010000114774.name: The Secret Workshop of Wishes
70010000114774.intro: Nila and three toys bring laughter to Santa Claus; he gives her a magic paintbrush and they create the Kindness Express.
70010000114774.description:
Summary:
Nila, an elf from Santa's workshop, discovers the Secret Toy Corner and joins Honey Bear, Lolo, and Nina to create a golden musical sphere made with Santa's laughter. On Christmas Eve, Santa finds the gift, is moved, gives Nila a magic paintbrush, and together they embark on the Kindness Express to spread smiles all year long.

Features (visual novel):

Audience: children/families, warm and fun tone.

Central theme: kindness, generosity, and "giving without expecting anything in return."

Structure: initial mystery → secret mission → confetti gag → emotional climax → hopeful ending.

Characters: charismatic protagonist + trio of dreamy toys (team).

Key moments: discovery of the door, capturing laughter, sleigh scene, gift of the paintbrush.

Reusable “magical” elements: musical sphere, magic brush, Kindness Notes/Kindness Espresso.

70010000114776.name: Lines 98 Classic
70010000114776.intro: Lines 98 Classic — Plan your moves. Build perfect lines.
70010000114776.description:
Lines 98 Classic is a legendary puzzle game familiar to many since childhood. Connect balls of the same color into lines horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to clear the board and earn as many points as possible.

With simple rules and intuitive controls, the game is easy to pick up but offers deep strategic depth. A relaxing pace combined with an endless mental challenge makes Lines 98 Classic perfect for both quick casual sessions and long, thoughtful playthroughs as you aim to beat your high score.

70010000114782.name: Funny Cats Puzzle
70010000114782.intro: A puzzle game featuring slightly clumsy and cute cats is here!
70010000114782.description:
Collect pieces of the adorable “Doji-nyan” cats and complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Clear all puzzles and complete your gallery ♪
=====================
At Eiji, we support game streamers!
No permission is required for streaming this game.

70010000114795.name: We. The Refugees: Ticket to Europe
70010000114795.description: ‘We. The Refugees: Ticket to Europe’ is a socially engaged, text-based RPG about a journalist looking for his big break by uncovering the plights of refugees travelling from Africa to Europe. It is a story inspired by true events.

70010000114814.name: HUNTERS Music World
70010000114814.intro: A rhythm game packed with over 40 tracks from HUNTERS!
70010000114814.description:
Hunters Music World is a rhythm game.
Press the buttons in time with the music!

It features theme songs from Mysterious Adventure of Michael, The Legend of the Dragonflame
High School,
as well as tracks from a wide variety of genres—rock, punk, enka, Halloween songs, and more!

Aim for a Perfect Clear on every song!

70010000114839.name: Liquor Store Simulator
70010000114839.description:
Liquor Store Simulator is a simulation game about developing your own store. You start your business in a small shop that you bought on credit.

Buy goods, manage your store, hire staff. Who knows, maybe you will be able to make a real alcohol empire out of a small store.

At first, it won’t be easy—you’ll have to work at the checkout yourself, accept deliveries, keep records, and maintain order in the sales area. But hard work and smart decisions will help you turn a modest retail outlet into a thriving store with a wide selection and satisfied customers.

Management
Purchase goods, arrange retail equipment as you see fit.

Draft Beer
Feel like a bartender. Pour customers the beer they desire.

Staff Management
At first, you’ll have to do everything yourself. But as your store grows, you won’t be able to handle it alone. Hire employees for efficient store management.

Customization
Change the color of walls, ceilings, and floors. Make your store unique and unlike any other.

70010000114841.name: Night Strike Resistance: WW2
70010000114841.intro:
A fast-paced single-player shooter set during World War II.
Action, legendary weapons, and constant enemy pressure.
70010000114841.description:
World War II — raw, relentless, and unforgiving.

This is a fast-paced single-player shooter focused on pure action. No long introductions or unnecessary distractions — you are thrown straight into the heart of battle, where every second matters and enemies give you no time to breathe.

The battlefield keeps you under constant pressure. Enemies push forward, the environment shifts, and every encounter demands quick reactions, precision, and decisive movement. Standing still is not an option — survival belongs to those who act first.

You will wield legendary weapons from the World War II era, each encounter feeling intense and brutal. Every fight is a test of skill, focus, and endurance.

Features:

Intense single-player action

World War II atmosphere

Legendary weapons of the era

Constant enemy pressure

Fast and engaging combat encounters

This game is made for players who value pure gameplay, high intensity, and nonstop combat without distractions.

Load your weapon.
Step onto the battlefield.
The war begins.

70010000114847.name: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 5
70010000114847.intro: Abandon all hope ye who smile here
70010000114847.description:
In the latest terrifying chapter of the Poppy Playtime saga, you are propelled further into the gruesome depths of the factory, with Playtime’s security system Huggy Wuggy in hot pursuit. 

Abandoned by your only allies, your fight for survival gets all the more challenging as you race further into the abyss that is His domain. Here, shadows whisper, and the puppet master who lords over this realm pulls the strings of madness. Can you stand against evil and finally put an end to this nightmare? Every bloody move forward will test your resolve as you uncover secrets years in the making.

Features:
• Stomach-churning terrors await you in this new section of the factory as you uncover the dark works hidden within The Prototype’s stomping grounds.
• In this chilling new layer of the Playtime facility, you will encounter the tortured denizens living in the darkness. They may aid you in your quest to defeat The Prototype, but can they be trusted? 
• Solve devious puzzles and overcome dangerous environmental obstacles with the power of new GrabPack tools and functionality.
• As you reach the true rotten heart at the center of Playtime, you will discover some of the company’s gravest sins.

Will you escape this new realm of shadows with your sanity intact, or will you succumb to the horrors within?

70010000114853.name: Hidden Cats in Christmas
70010000114853.intro: Reveal the magic of Christmas colors with the Hidden Cats!
70010000114853.description:
The Hidden Cats are celebrating the holidays in the magical Christmas World Park!

Start with a snowy, grey canvas and watch it burst into festive colors as you spot more than 900 hidden kittens and characters inspired by global traditions.

Discover photos of real cats from the Hidden Cats community and pair them with illustrated felines to unlock 7 bonus stages featuring a new progressive colorization effect!

Game Features:
- 900+ hidden objects, 8 unique levels with unlockables
- Collectible cards, achievements, secrets to discover
- Hand-drawn art & original soundtrack with dynamic sound effects
- NEW! All maps fill with colour as you progress!

70010000114876.name: Anime Girls: Cheerful Cosplay
70010000114876.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000114876.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000114878.name: Anime Girls: Shanghai Romance
70010000114878.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000114878.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000114880.name: Anime Girls: Sakura Love
70010000114880.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000114880.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000114896.name: Find the Four-Leaf Clover
70010000114896.intro:
A little happiness every time you find one.
A time-limited four-leaf clover search puzzle!
70010000114896.description:
In this lively illustration filled with many characters and objects,
your task is to find the specified four-leaf clover within the time limit.
Enjoy an easy and fun brain-training game!

How to play:
・Look carefully at the target four-leaf clover shown
・Search for the same four-leaf clover within the illustration
・When you find it, tap the spot before time runs out!

It may seem easy at first, but with a time limit,
you’ll be surprised how challenging it can be!

If you get stuck, the hint button will help you gently,
showing you the area where the answer is hidden.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000114910.name: MAMIYA - A Shared Illusion of the World's End -
70010000114910.intro: It doesn't matter if my love goes unnoticed—I am always on your side.
70010000114910.description:
MAMIYA - A Shared Illusion of the World's End - is a dark mystery visual novel made by the indie developer Kenkou Land.
Containing all three parts of the story, it lets you experience a world of characters guided by fate towards various conclusions.

●synopsis
Tokyo, during the year in which the world was prophesied to end.

As we clung to reality, too spineless to throw our lives away together, we met MAMIYA.

At a friend's funeral, the entire crowd was weeping and mourning, while we thought to ourselves that the death of a single person had no meaningful impact on the world at large.
We slept, woke up, and went through the same daily grind as ever. At least, that's how it was supposed to be.

Then MAMIYA appeared...

Before we even knew it, the mysterious child named MAMIYA had wormed their way into our daily lives. They slowly, but surely, became something of an emotional support. They'd brought us down a new path.

A path that would surely lead us to our deaths...

●Added Content
・Additional illustrations for the story!
・The long-awaited full voice acting!
As a voice actor, we have hired Soyogi-Soyogi !
・The Switch version also contains an original minigame to win "what-if" stories!

70010000114916.name: AKIBA LOST
70010000114916.intro: A live-action multi-perspective suspense game of fate and choice in Akihabara
70010000114916.description:
A new frontier in live-action suspense games, combining a multi-perspective visual novel where you switch between characters, high-quality live-action cinematics, and immersive 360° camera direction.

Story
Thirteen years ago, six girls mysteriously disappeared in Akihabara — a series of unsolved cases known as "The Akiba Vanishing".

At the annual Tokyo Game Expo, Daiki Shinjo (played by Hiromitsu Kitayama), once hailed as a "genius creator," boldly announces the development of a new game inspired by this very incident: AKIBA LOST.
But soon thereafter, the strange disappearances begin again.

The cast of the game includes his sister Aoi Shinjo, who works at a maid cafe, underground idol Kokone Nagato, food writer Moe Kurosu, shrine maiden Chihiro Jimbo, cosplayer Wakana Yusa, and game streamer Yukimi Kurahashi — each a colorful icon of Akihabara’s vibrant subculture.

The story they were supposed to perform soon begins to bleed into reality.
It all starts with a threatening phone call — and the sudden disappearance of Aoi.

"Stop developing the game now. Or else...the tragedy will repeat again."

Can Shinjo finish developing the game? Can he protect everyone? Who is behind it all? And what really happened 13 years ago?
The choices determining how the story ends are now in your hands.


Game features:
Multiple Protagonists – Character Switching System
Freely switch between characters to experience the same timeline from multiple perspectives.
A single choice made by one character may change another’s fate.

Choose-Your-Own-Adventure System
The story branches according to your decisions.
A single choice can ripple across characters — and alter the ending.

360° View – Immersive Camera System
Step into each character’s point of view.
Look around freely through their eyes for a deeply immersive, cinematic experience.

FREEZE & ACTIVATE
Unlock frozen story paths through other characters.
When one story reaches a dead end, another character's story may hold the key to moving forward.

Buddy Characters
Meet colorful partner characters who accompany you throughout the story.

Cast:
Hiromitsu Kitayama / Game Creator: Daiki Shinjo
Sayuri Matsumura / Maid: Aoi Shinjo
Momoko Tanabe / Game Streamer: Yukimi Kurahashi
Misato Ugaki / Food Writer: Moe Kurosu
Yui Oguri (AKB48) / Underground Idol: Kokone Nagato
Azusa Ohara / Shrine Maiden: Chihiro Jimbo
MINA (East Of Eden) / Cosplayer: Wakana Yusa

70010000114946.name: MEGAMONK
70010000114946.intro: Hold back endless hordes and save the New Year as a mighty mage-monk. Grow stronger, gather artifacts, and smite your foes with holy power.
70010000114946.description:
MEGAMONK is a fast-paced roguelike survival experience where a mage-monk stands alone against relentless hordes of darkness threatening the New Year and Halloween. Every battle erupts into a whirlwind of holy magic, strikes, and explosive energy that grows with your power. Collect artifacts, discover rare upgrades, and forge devastating ability combinations capable of wiping out entire armies.
On the battlefield, you will face winterstorm demons, Halloween-born abominations, and ancient spirits of chaos determined to erase the holidays from existence. Their power rises with every passing minute, challenging your resilience and mastery.
Defend the New Year, preserve the spirit of celebration, and prove that monastic magic can stand against any darkness. Step into the fray, unleash the full potential of the monk, and become a legend whose name echoes louder than festive bells.

70010000114956.name: Legendary Tales V. Price of Power
70010000114956.intro: With every adventure, hope for a safer world grows.
70010000114956.description:
Forgotten lands and ancient magic give rise to a dangerous journey against the oppressive rule of witches.

“Legendary Tales V. Price of Power” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

In a world ruled by witches, survival is hard and hope is rare. Whispers of forgotten myths and powers suggest that change may still be possible. From hidden catacombs to long-abandoned cities, this journey unfolds across ruins of lost civilizations and through encounters with dangerous foes. Along the way, unlikely allies appear, old secrets resurface, and the fragile dream of freedom grows stronger. The journey is filled with uncertainty, but each discovery hints that the world’s fate may yet be rewritten. Thus, a story of magic, struggle, the search for safety, and the creation of a new future takes shape.

- Gather old friends to overcome hardships together
- Travel through incredible places no one ever believed existed
- Solve puzzles and play mini-games to put your wits to the test
- Examine locations carefully and find every collectible
- Join the battle for freedom alongside your favorite characters

70010000114962.name: Onigiri Shop Simulator
70010000114962.intro: Welcome to your cozy onigiri (rice ball) shop on a street corner in Japan. From today, you're running the whole show yourself.
70010000114962.description:
Craft the perfect onigiri with fluffy, warm rice and savory fillings, and serve your hungry customers with a smile.

Your menu also features delicious side dishes, like crispy croquettes and golden fried fish.

With a constant stream of orders, you'll need to think on your feet and keep your hands moving!

You're not just the owner—you're the chef and the cashier, too. With limited time and space, your success depends on smart decisions. Which ingredients do you stock up on? What do you cook first? Mastering inventory and perfecting your workflow is the secret to becoming the best onigiri shop in town.

70010000114973.name: Lantern Push
70010000114973.description:
Light the right path in Lantern Push, a charming puzzle game where you control a red panda pushing paper lanterns onto Magical Ember Seals scattered across the ground. When a lantern reaches a seal, magic happens: it lights up, floats gently, and marks another step toward the perfect solution.

With 30 handcrafted levels divided between the Bamboo Garden at dawn and the Riverbank during the lantern festival, each challenge invites you to think calmly, test ideas, and reorganize routes until everything clicks into place. There is no rush, no enemies, and no penalties. Making mistakes is part of the process, and Undo and Restart are always at hand so you can experiment without fear.

Lantern Push is ideal for players who love relaxing puzzles, cozy visuals, and that delightful “now it works” feeling. Push, light, adjust, and discover the pleasure of illuminating the perfect path, one lantern at a time.

70010000114979.name: Basketball Classics
70010000114979.description:
5 on 5 Pro Basketball born from the golden era of sports games. This spiritual successor to the 8-bit ballers bridges the gap between retro and today’s simulation games.

- Side-scrolling, sweaty arcade action
- Simplified 3-button gameplay
- Decades of rosters with 175+ teams
- 1000+ players with individualized attributes
- Seamless play calling
- Sensational cut scenes
- 1-Player Story Mode unlocks secret teams
- Scream-inducing local multiplayer
- Retro vibes galore
- No virtual currency. No pay-to-win. No micro transactions. Ever.

Side-scrolling, arcade action is paired with on-the-fly strategy. 3 button gameplay is easy to pick up, but it is the dynamic play-calling that elevates this title beyond just long bombs and acrobatics.

Attribute-rich players make up a vast set of rosters. Dig through decades of teams to find your favorite All-Stars and even unlock the "Legends" in an immersive story mode.

This game is a passion project for us indie developers here at Namo Gamo. We hope you can feel the love put into every pixel, the endless adjustments to stat-driven gameplay, and the genuinely retro sound and music.

70010000114985.name: Cloudberry Kingdom
70010000114985.description:
In Cloudberry Kingdom, the beloved platformer returns, now available on modern consoles with improved resolution. Dive into a world where every jump, jetpack boost, and wheelie roll feels new, yet comfortingly familiar.

Meet Bob, the courageous hero of Cloudberry Kingdom. When the nefarious King Kobbler threatens to plunge the kingdom into chaos, Bob must rise to the challenge. With the princess in peril and the kingdom's future at stake, Bob sets off on an epic quest to save the day.

Key Features:

Experience endless platforming challenges with procedurally generated levels that are never the same twice.
Follow Bob's epic quest to save the kingdom in Story Mode, facing off against King Kobbler’s minions and overcoming insurmountable odds.
Customize your own levels and challenge friends to beat your creations in Free Play Mode.
Test your skills in a variety of mini-games and time trials designed to push your platforming abilities to the limit in Arcade Mode.
Join forces with friends in cooperative play or compete against each other in thrilling multiplayer challenges.
Personalize Bob with a variety of costumes and accessories to your liking.

Cloudberry Kingdom promises to deliver the same heart-pounding platforming action that fans loved, now with enhanced resolution for a modern gaming experience. Get ready to jump back into the action and save Cloudberry Kingdom!

70010000114991.name: Beetle Shock
70010000114991.intro: Shell Shock in the Insect Kingdom
70010000114991.description:
Get ready for ground-smashing fun and leafy adventures! In Beetle Shock, you control a strong beetle capable of breaking cracked logs with a powerful ground pound. Each level is a small forest mission: find the yellow fruit, open the door, and reach the insect house hidden inside a tree trunk.

Across 30 levels split between day and night biomes, you jump across platforms, use bouncy mushrooms and cannon plants to launch yourself through the scenery, and explore every corner in search of collectible fireflies, perfect for completionists. It’s a light, colorful platformer made for players who enjoy accessible action with a touch of exploration.

The path isn’t always safe: clover-shaped saws, dangerous spikes, and tricky platforms will test your reflexes. Luckily, sunflowers act as checkpoints, saving your progress and getting you back into the action quickly without losing collectibles. Difficulty increases smoothly, introducing new challenges without breaking the fun flow.

Beetle Shock is ideal for fans of classic platformers, nature lovers, and players who enjoy collecting everything along the way. A charming adventure full of personality, where every jump, every ground pound, and every firefly collected adds to the fun.

70010000114997.name: Mole Cart Mining
70010000114997.intro: Clever Tracks in the Little Mole Mines
70010000114997.description:
Get ready for an underground adventure full of charm and strategy! In Mole Cart Mining, you guide a determined little mole riding a mine cart while rotating tracks on a hexagonal grid to create the perfect route. The goal is simple and satisfying: collect every mineral and reach the exit in style.

Each level is a tiny puzzle filled with classic pieces like straights, curves, and junctions, plus the game’s chaotic star, the rotating conveyor, which spins automatically when the cart crosses it. It changes everything mid-route and demands smart planning that mixes order, timing, and a bit of underground boldness.

With 30 handcrafted levels split between the Iron Mines and Diamond Mines, the game offers short, clean, relaxing challenges with clear objectives. Every solution brings that genuine “aha!” moment when everything clicks into place.

Mole Cart Mining is perfect for fans of clever puzzles, smart routes, and that satisfying feeling of watching the mole slide along exactly the path you planned. No frustration here, just good ideas, good tracks, and plenty of mining fun.

70010000115019.name: Amazing Weekend 4 Search and Relaxed Collector's Edition
70010000115019.intro: Picturesque locations are waiting for you, filled with an atmosphere of relaxation.
70010000115019.description:
Explore cozy country clubs, parks, picturesque canyons and family holidays, enjoying every moment.
In this part of the series, you will find even more new places where you can test your skills in searching for objects and solving puzzles!

The collector's edition includes:
- 12 additional levels with unique hidden object scenes and mini-games.
- 8 exclusive mini-games from the previous installments.
- Souvenir Shop – collect unique trophies for achievements.

Leave the hustle and bustle of the city behind and embark on an exciting journey full of discoveries and vivid emotions.

70010000115049.name: EGGCONSOLE Courageous Perseus PC-8801
70010000115049.intro: An Action RPG inspired by Greek mythology. Embark on an adventure to rescue three goddesses on an island ruled by the Gorgon!
70010000115049.description:
This Action RPG was released by COSMOS COMPUTER in 1984. The hero Perseus embarks on an adventure to rescue the Goddess of Beauty on a magical island ruled by the Gorgon.

You increase health by defeating enemies and acquiring items. True to the Action RPG style, combat involves bumping into enemies. The enemies you can defeat depend on your current strength, requiring you to identify and defeat them in sequence.

The game clears by obtaining either all 12 Zodiac items or three Goddess statues. Though it has a unique learning curve, this masterpiece pioneered the domestic Japanese Action RPG genre and is highly recommended.

 
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000115060.name: Around the World 4: Family Tour Collector's Edition
70010000115060.description:
This is an incredible journey offering a variety of hidden object search modes and a wide selection of exciting mini-games.
Treat yourself to a unique journey through 30 amazing and unforgettable places. 
You will be able to visit azure beaches, to conquer deserts, to immerse yourself in the beauty of forests, and to enjoy holidays in a variety of places on our planet. 
The game will give you the opportunity to use your skills and knowledge to complete mini-games and find all the hidden objects.

The collector's edition includes: 
- 10 additional locations 
- 10 additional mini-games, as well as 12 puzzles for real fans 
- Souvenir shop

70010000115065.name: Rocket Time Trials: Galactic Highway
70010000115065.description:
Take control of a rocket and navigate through challenging courses where precise control is essential.
Use thrust and rotation to carefully maneuver through tight spaces and reach the finish line.

Every mistake leads to an explosion and instant restart, pushing you to master inertia and improve your control.
Levels are designed for short, intense attempts and constant refinement of your best times.

Perfect for players who enjoy fair challenges, time attacks, and skill-based gameplay.

70010000115071.name: Ho Ho & Move
70010000115071.intro: Collect gifts, and plan the perfect path.
70010000115071.description:
Plan Santa’s route and solve 40 festive logic puzzles in this cozy holiday adventure.
Before each level begins, place directional tiles to map out how Santa will move. Once the route is set, watch him follow your plan—collecting every gift on the way and delivering them to the waiting child. With limited tiles available, every decision matters, turning each stage into a fun little brain teaser.

The puzzles start simple but become more challenging as you progress, pushing you to think ahead, find efficient paths, and make the most of your available moves. No timers, no pressure—just thoughtful planning and satisfying solutions.

Perfect for players of all ages, this charming puzzle game offers 40 handcrafted levels filled with holiday spirit and relaxing gameplay. Help Santa find the right path, gather all the gifts, and bring joy to every child!

70010000115097.name: Arcade Archives MEGA ZONE
70010000115097.intro: MEGA ZONE! FURTHER INTO UNKNOWN CRISIS...
70010000115097.description:
"Arcade Archives MEGA ZONE" is a shooting game released by KONAMI in 1984.
Pilot your tank and head for the enemy base with the goal of destroying the core hidden in its deepest depths. 
By collecting items, two tanks can combine to power up. Gain the strength you need to prepare for the battle against an unknown enemy!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000115111.name: Demon Castle Story
70010000115111.intro: Demon Castle Building Dungeon Management Simulation
70010000115111.description:
A management simulation in which you take an old, run-down castle and turn it into a dastardly demon stronghold! Recruit unique monsters as your minions and vanquish adventurers who dare to enter your realm!

Install gargoyles, ritual altars, and other devilish decor to boost your castle's mystique and attract more monsters your way. Gift them food and other items to help them grow, and garner their support to fend off pesky adventurers.

You can also send your monster minions out to explore nearby dungeons and towns. They'll bring you back items and other loot, and maybe even some new allies!

As you progress, you can also start merging monsters together to make new ones.

And don't forget traps—essential equipment for proper castle defense! Develop a range of traps like sleep-inducing gas and heavy washbowls to thwart any who cross the threshold of your demonic haven! By placing and combining traps in imaginative ways, you can make your fortress of fiendishness virtually impregnable!

Fend off attacks from mighty adventurers and keep your minions sweet to become the biggest and baddest demon overlord of all time!

70010000115122.name: MotionRec
70010000115122.intro: Use stage gimmicks to create and record more complex movements to traverse the world.
70010000115122.description:
■ MotionRec is a "recording puzzle action" game.

Use the ability to record your own movements and play them back elsewhere to explore a world of devastation.

You can record the trajectory of your movements, from walking to jumping. Use stage gimmicks to create and record more complex movements to traverse the world.

■ Record your movements and play them back in another location!

This will let you reach places too high to jump up to, or even access spots where there's nothing to stand on.

Make good use of the MotionRec ability to unravel the mysteries behind this devastated world ruled by machines!

70010000115130.name: Sweet Home: Look and Find 5 Collector's Edition
70010000115130.intro: Step into a cozy world of hidden object fun, heartwarming stories, and the joy of creating your perfect home.
70010000115130.description:
Buy your own dream home — Choose the house that fits your heart and finally make that dream come true.
Get your own car — Add style and freedom to your new lifestyle!
Decorate four beautiful rooms — Personalize your kitchen, living room, bedroom, and garden with hundreds of charming furniture and decor pieces.

Explore warm and inviting locations: front porches, green backyards, homey interiors, and peaceful nature spots. Each scene is filled with dozens of well-hidden items waiting to be found.

Mini-Games and Relaxing Puzzles
Take a break and enjoy thoughtful, relaxing mini-games that sharpen your focus and unlock new locations and features.

Collector’s Edition Includes:
- 8 all-new hidden object scenes
- 8 relaxing mini-games
- 8 bonus levels from previous Sweet Home games

70010000115135.name: Moo & Move: Extra Grazing Grounds
70010000115135.description: Guide the hungry cow to its goal! Place directional tiles on the ground and choose to solve puzzles the easy or hard way—it's up to you! Watch as the cow follows your path to reach its tasty hay in this fun, kid-friendly game!

70010000115157.name: Virtual Ties Isekaijoucho Träumerei
70010000115157.intro: "I want to be a virtual idol! And I want to face this challenge with you!"
70010000115157.description:
<STORY>
After returning from Tokyo to the island where he once lived, Yu Kirishima, the protagonist,
reunites with his childhood friend, Sekai Minase.

Sekai, who had once dreamed of becoming an idol,
now seems to have lost her sparkle and is on the verge of giving up on that dream.

Wanting to see her smile again, Yu makes a proposal—
to debut as a virtual idol named “Isekaijoucho”,
based on an illustration he drew himself.

<SYSTEM>
This is a fully voiced adventure game featuring a story-driven experience combined with a training system that lets you guide Sekai on her path to becoming a top virtual idol.

Depending on how you train her, Sekai’s growth, goals, and ultimately her destiny will change,
leading to multiple possible endings.

70010000115163.name: Farming Simulator 26: Nintendo Switch™ Edition
70010000115163.intro: Rise to the Challenge of Farming!
70010000115163.description:
Choose what kind of farmer you want to be! Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and other machines. Start logging with heavy forestry equipment, or tend to adorable farm animals like cows, sheep, chickens, goats, and their offspring.

• Tons of possibilities on two new maps
• 15 different field crops, plus trees
• 120+ authentic, GPS-enabled machines
• Farm challenges that keep you on your toes
• Production chains, logistics, and more

Operate more than 120 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world.

There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains! 

Don’t worry, there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life.

70010000115169.name: Deathground Simulator
70010000115169.intro: Fight, hide, or outsmart—only one will survive the Deathground.
70010000115169.description:
Deathground Simulator drops you into a brutal, prehistoric world where survival means outsmarting deadly predators. Stranded in a hostile jungle, you must use limited resources, craft tools, and rely on your wits to escape. The jungle is filled with ancient creatures that will hunt you down—outsmart them or become their prey.

As you explore abandoned outposts, you’ll uncover dark secrets and hear cryptic radio messages. But who can you trust?

Survival Features:
• Deadly Pursuit: Outsmart intelligent predators that relentlessly hunt you. Every move could be your last.
• Dangerous Territories: Explore eerie ruins, dense forests, and hidden places filled with danger and dark secrets.
• Craft to Survive: Collect resources, craft tools, and set traps to defend yourself against the threats that lurk.
• Adaptive Threats: Study predator behaviors and adjust your tactics as the danger evolves.
• Unravel the Mystery: Piece together cryptic radio signals and uncover the horrifying truth of the island’s past.
• Tension at Every Step: The jungle is always watching. Every sound, every shadow, could lead to your demise.

In Deathground Simulator, surviving isn’t just about escaping—it’s about uncovering the terrifying truth hidden in the heart of the wilderness.

70010000115192.name: Sociable Soccer Champions
70010000115192.description:
Sociable Soccer Champions is an all-action carnival of fast-paced arcade football action. In addition to offering the most exciting version of the world's most popular sport, Sociable Soccer Champions allows you to assemble your dream team from an extensive roster of more than 14,000 licensed professional footballers, each with their unique skills and attributes faithfully replicated.

Experience the authenticity of the beautiful game in a variety of unique and different ways...

In World Mode you lead your favorite club through the greatest league and cup competitions from across the globe, or take your country to global glory through some of the most iconic international tournaments.

Or if you want a more immediate thrill, why not dive into a Friendly match, pitting any one of the 1,400 featured teams against any other, either against an AI opponent or head-to-head versus a friend in local multiplayer?

Sociable Soccer Champions features:

• Fast, intuitive arcade gameplay - easy to pick up, but hard to master
•  Aftertouch, powered shots, sprint and energy systems
•  Two Player Couch Clashes to relive the good old days, playing against a friend in the ultimate face-to-face match up!
•  Multiple ways to play: Coach (just watch), Casual and Pro
•  More than 14,000 FIFPRO licensed professional players to collect and upgrade
•  Up-to-date player, team and competition data for 1,400 teams from across the football world
•  More than 80 trophies to win
•  A host of unique referees, each with a different personality and style, to keep you on your toes

Join the passionate community of football fans, compete for glory and celebrate the true spirit of the beautiful game in the latest release in this this remarkable gaming franchise.

70010000115198.name: Horizon Drift Unlimited 2026
70010000115198.intro: Drive the horizon. Feel the freedom.
70010000115198.description:
Step into a world of pure driving pleasure where the road is your only destination.
Horizon Drift Unlimited 2026 delivers a visually stunning open driving experience inspired by the beauty, speed, and atmosphere of modern automotive culture.

Explore vast environments, enjoy smooth and responsive handling, and choose from a wide selection of stylish cars, each designed to feel great on the road. Light customization options allow you to personalize your ride and match your driving vibe.

There are no rules, no pressure, and no objectives to chase - just you, the car, and the horizon ahead. Cruise through breathtaking landscapes, drift along endless roads, and immerse yourself in a relaxed, cinematic driving experience made for players who love cars and freedom.

This is not about competition.
This is about vibe driving.

70010000115200.name: Capital City Brain Training Quiz!
70010000115200.intro:
How many world capitals can you name?
Challenge your “geography brain” with a 4-choice quiz!
70010000115200.description:
“Capital City Brain Training Quiz” is a fun four-choice game where you pick the correct capital and boost your geography skills.

From world-famous cities to more obscure countries, the questions cover a wide range.  
Answer at a steady pace and you’ll feel your memory and decision-making sharpen quickly.

“Wait… what’s the capital of this country again?”  
“It’s fun discovering places I didn’t even know!”

Play solo or with friends. It always gets lively.  
Perfect for quick breaks or as a learning tool.

70010000115208.name: Arcade Archives ADVENTURE CANOE
70010000115208.intro: Brave canoeist, challenge the unknown rapids!
70010000115208.description:
"ADVENTURE CANOE" is an action game released by TAITO in 1982.
Your goal is to paddle your canoe down the river and venture deep into the uncharted backcountry. Watch out for driftwood floating downstream and the fierce river currents.
Rumor has it that terrifying crocodiles and outlaws inhabit these waters... Reach the finish line safely and prove your courage!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000115227.name: Carnival Heroes: 24 funny minigames
70010000115227.intro:
Fun 2-4 players board games with 24 minigames
Play online with frienаds
Play offline with 2-4 players or solo vs AI
70010000115227.description:
Carnival Heroes is cross-platform online multiplayer board game for 2 to 4 players which includes 24 super party minigames which you play along the main game.

The game can be played in 3 game modes: Online (vs real human players, Local (with up to 4 players) or Solo (vs AI).

GAMEPLAY
You take turns in an order determined by the biggest dice roll.
On your turn you roll a dice and you use (or not) an item you previously collected.
The goal in the game is to collect as many crowns as possible.
Crowns are bought with gems.  Gems you collect by walking onto the game board, by landing on chests or by winning in minigames.
At the start of the game you choose animal avatar which you will play as.
Each of the 8 avatars comes with a special dice which you can play if you want (you either play the regular 1 to 6 dice or the character special dice).

The game has two main gameplay modes: FREE and FIXED.

In FIXED mode you walk along a fixed routers. But you still choose which direction to go on the intersections.

In FREE mode you draw your exact path on which you player will go. You have to make sure you make most of your path (i.e. it goes through many gems, mates and it lands on a board item.

BOARD ITEMS

Gems. These are diamonds in 3 colors: red = 1 gem, green = 2 gems and blue = 3 gems.
Gems are used to purchase crows or  items from the store.

Crowns. This is what you must be aiming to get. Crowns are bought with gems. In the beginning of the game 1 crown costs 10 gems..but as the game progresses they will become more and more expensive (15 or 20 gems).

Mates. Mates are special animal friends which will follow you onto the game board and will give you gems for each player you jump over (i.e. pass through its place). 
Each mate you have, will give you additional big dice that you can roll instead of the regular 1 to 6 dice. Moreover, mates have their own small dice that they will roll with you and it will be added to your dice value.

Chests. These will give you random prize in form of items or gems. 
Items are inventory stuff which you can use throughout the game (dice addons, portals or many other special items).

Events. Shown as questionmarks on the board, events are immediate actions like teleportations, crown movement traffic light switchings and others.

Battle. Landing on battle will force all players to bet a random amount of gems and play in a randomly chosen minigame. The winner takes it all

Hidden gifts. These are hidden fields (empty cells) which you don't see. If you land on a hidden gift, you will get a random prize or a bomb.
Positive gifts are gems, mates or items.
Negative gifts are gems taken from you or losing a mate.

Traffic Lights, These switches are giving you 2 routes to pass: free one and a paid one. 
Paid route costs X gems to pass. On each pass it increases its price with 1.

Cracked tiles. Some tiles get cracks once a player lands on them.
When the crack gets big enough, the last player passing through it will pay small gems tax to repair the crack.

Stores. If you land on a store, you have the option to buy an item. Items usually cost 2-3-4-5 gems. Once all items are bought from the store, new ones will be automatically added.

MINIGAMES
The game contains 24 fun minigames in which you will be tested by proving your speed, precision, memory, agility, strategy and luck. These small games are very different from one another and are played either in real time or played solo games vs AI

GAME OVER
Once the turns finish, a prize crowns will be announced. There will be 3 crown prizes given for a different randomly chosen condition. 
Crown can be given for the best player in the fun minigames, or for the most traveled spaces player - or other bonuses. 
The final winner is the one who has the most crowns. 
If two players have same number of crowns - then their gems will play a role in deciding the final winner.

Good luck hero!

70010000115241.name: R-Type Dimensions III
70010000115241.intro: The spectacular, fully-reimagined evolution of a legendary shoot ’em up!
70010000115241.description:
In the distant future, humanity faces its greatest threat: the Bydo Empire, a horrifying bio-mechanical life-form capable of corrupting and absorbing anything it touches. Although humans once created the Bydo as a weapon, the experiment spiraled out of control. Now the Bydo exist beyond normal space and continually attempt to invade human reality. 
 
After multiple wars and near-extinction events, the Bydo return once again—stronger, more adaptive, and far more aggressive. To counter this new invasion, the Earth Space Corps develops a cutting-edge fighter: the R-90 Ragnarok, a next-generation R-Type craft. 
 
As the pilot of the R-90, you’re deployed into hostile zones that warp between normal space and the twisted Bydo dimension. Your mission: penetrate deep into enemy territory, dismantle the Bydo’s core networks, and ultimately destroy the heart of the empire before it engulfs humanity completely… 

R-Type Dimensions III brings the intensity, precision, and creative enemy design of the arcade originals to a new generation. Every stage, boss, and projectile pattern has been rebuilt with high-end 3D graphics, enhanced animations, and richly detailed environments—while preserving the instantly recognizable atmosphere that defined R-Type’s identity. 
 
Building on the legacy of R-Type Dimensions and R-Type Dimensions EX, Dimensions III has been completely re-envisioned with cutting-edge visuals and sounds, expanded gameplay modes, and a range of new features designed to deliver the most definitive modern edition of R-Type’s classic era. 


Features:
- A fully remastered experience with completely reconstructed assets 

- Local co-op, enhanced with new scoring and survival mechanics 

- Customizable controls and quality-of-life features in the settings 

- 3D Camera settings (normal and crazy)

70010000115252.name: Cargo Runner - Mars
70010000115252.intro: You deliver cargo - Mars decides if you survive
70010000115252.description:
Cargo Runner: Mars puts you in charge of high-risk supply deliveries on the Red Planet.

Remote colonies depend on regular cargo shipments, but the routes are hostile. Alien ambushes, unstable delivery zones, and strict operational requirements turn every job into a test of speed, control, and decision-making.

Combat is direct. Step out of your vehicle, deal with the threat, collect what’s left, and move on.
Money earned unlocks new weapons, vehicles, and upgrades for future runs.

Progress is persistent. Upgrades and base improvements provide long-term advantages, rewarding repeated missions and exploration.

You deliver. Mars decides if you survive.

70010000115257.name: Kitchen Wars
70010000115257.intro:
Serve your clients
Get upgrades and items
Attack the opposing restaurants
70010000115257.description:
Kitchen Wars is a fast-paced party game with 2-8 players that plunges players into the chaos of a restaurant, where they must engage in strategic fights and theft while serving their customers.

Use weapons, steal chairs, throw items, level up to unlock boosters, and have a blast! Deliver meals quickly to keep customers happy and satisfied. Enhance your kitchen and unlock powerful boosters.

Disrupt your rivals with strategic attacks and sabotage. Reduce your competitor’s seating capacity by swiping their chairs. Upgrade Your Restaurant: Earn money from happy clients to invest in your kitchen and secure victory.

Whether you're focused on improving your restaurant or causing chaos for your opponents, Kitchen Wars offers a blend of strategy, combat, and humor for an entertaining and competitive experience.

70010000115263.name: Clue: Murder By Death
70010000115263.intro: England, 1932. A man is dead — and time is running out.
70010000115263.description:
A story-rich detective mystery set in 1930s England. Investigate a murder inside a sprawling manor, interrogate suspicious residents, and make meaningful choices to uncover the truth — before Scotland Yard arrives.

A Story-Rich Detective Mystery Where Choices Matter
Clue: Murder by Death is a narrative-driven detective adventure inspired by classic British crime fiction and modern investigative games. Explore an imposing manor, examine evidence, interrogate suspects, and connect clues across multiple branching narrative paths. Every conversation, every alliance, and every accusation shapes the investigation and determines how the story ends.

Who can you trust?

Who is lying?

And what truth will you ultimately uncover?

Key Features
- Story-rich detective mystery set in 1930s England
- Meaningful choices that impact characters and outcomes
- Multiple endings based on your deductions and decisions
- A real-time investigation with a 120-minute limit
- Fully explorable 3D isometric manor packed with secrets
- Deep character-driven narrative with hidden motives and alliances
- Unique visual style blending dark humour and vintage charm
- Original atmospheric soundtrack

70010000115270.name: Noire Police Detective: Gangster Drama Simulator
70010000115270.intro: Uncover the lie behind the crime.
70010000115270.description:
One explosion. Too many lies.
When a car bomb shakes 1950s San Viento, detective Javier Cruz must investigate the truth — while the city fights to bury it.
In Noire Police Detective: Gangster Drama Simulator, follow leads through neon-lit streets, motels, bars, warehouses, and ruined landmarks — and decide how far you’re willing to go to uncover the truth.
Use Detective Vision to reveal hidden clues, combine evidence in your case journal, and unlock new objectives or dialogue options. Stay quiet when danger is close: hide in shadows, distract guards, slip through back routes, and take down enemies silently. When stealth fails, you’ll rely on limited combat — close-quarters strikes and a six-shot revolver, where every bullet matters.
The case isn’t just about evidence — it’s about choices. Bribe a witness, destroy a document, protect a suspect, or expose the people in power. Your decisions shape relationships with key characters — a corrupt sheriff, a dangerous femme fatale, and an idealistic journalist — and lead to three possible endings: justice, corruption, or survival.

Key Features:
	•	Noir detective story set in a tense 1950s border city
	•	Detective Vision to uncover hidden clues and secrets
	•	Stealth gameplay: shadows, distractions, silent takedowns
	•	Environmental puzzles: safes, panels, locked routes, coded messages
	•	Moral choices that affect characters, missions, and the final outcome
	•	Semi-open locations with collectibles and optional areas

Truth has a price in San Viento. Will you expose the system — or become part of it?

70010000115275.name: Starless Abyss
70010000115275.intro: Earth has fallen. Science and the Occult have united forces to brace for the arrival of the Eldritch. But will the efforts against this strange, alien race be enough?
70010000115275.description:
Welcome Proxima, we are Counter Horror, an organisation of scientists and occultists who have combined forces to take on the evil threatening our universe. You have been in stasis for some time, you have been awoken to aid in our fight. 
Your psyche level is stable for now, but it won’t be for long, the closer to the outer gods, the less stable humanity becomes, use your military training to end them. Failure is not an option Commander.
Your mission is simple, defend Earth and destroy the Outer Gods.

Play as one of many Proxima’s used to help defend humanity in this turn-based, roguelike, intergalactic deck builder!

- Roguelike: Play as a Proxima, awoken from stasis, with unique skills
- Turn-Based: Command a fleet of upgradable ships through combat
- Deckbuilder: Combine, collect and combo six factions of cards
- Upgrade: Collect artifacts, D.I.C.E and sanity shards to help along your way
- Embrace the occult using powerful ritual cards
- Bosses: Defend Earth and destroy the Outer Gods
- Awaken a Proxima with unique skills and downfalls to help you to take on the horrors
- Command a fleet of upgradable ships across the universe
- Make pivotal decisions when encountering obstacles between combat, which could help boost or decimate your run
- 6 different factions of cards can be combined, collected and combo-ed to defeat the horrors in your own way
- Control your fate using D.I.C.E to increase your chances of survival during random encounters
- Embrace the occult using ritual cards to powerfully destroy and beat the competition
- Earn credits to buy and upgrade your cards
- Unlock artifacts on your run to transform your ships powers
- Unlock multiple different Proxima’s, each with their own unique set of skills and downfalls

70010000115281.name: Astro Party EX
70010000115281.description:
Astro Party EX is a chaotic local multiplayer space brawler. Blast enemy ships, run over pilots, and laugh while you do it. The twist? Ships can only turn right. (whaaaaa?)

• Up to 4 players
• Two-button controls
• Fully destructible arenas
• Stylish pixel art & music

70010000115292.name: Smash Out 2
70010000115292.intro: Fire the shot. Watch it fall
70010000115292.description:
Dive into a faster, brighter, and even more satisfying blast of hyper-casual action. Take on endless waves each packed with three quick challenges that test your aim, timing, and reactions. 

Your goal is simple: knock every green block into oblivion. Smash through glass panels, dodge shifting obstacles, and send pieces flying with clean, physics-driven precision.
With its vibrant visuals, smooth effects, and bold geometric style, this experience turns every shot into a burst of colour and motion. Conquer waves to earn gems, then unlock a variety of stylish new ball designs to personalise your play.

70010000115298.name: Clover Cove
70010000115298.intro: A serene walking simulator set on a vast island full of secrets.
70010000115298.description:
Clover Cove is a peaceful, exploration-driven walking simulator that invites you to wander across a colossal island dominated by a towering ancient castle. Discover quiet beaches, hidden groves, abandoned locations, mysterious ruins, and countless other hand-crafted locations—all at your own pace.

There are no enemies, no combat, and no pressure. Just curiosity, atmosphere, and the joy of uncovering a world that feels alive, forgotten, and waiting for you.

Features:
>A Giant Island to Explore

>A Massive Castle That Looms Over Everything

> Atmospheric, Immersive Worldbuilding

> Go Anywhere, Discover Everything

> Relaxing Music & Natural Soundscapes

70010000115325.name: Sugoi Girls: Pretty Party
70010000115325.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000115325.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000115327.name: Sugoi Girls: Dental Darling
70010000115327.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000115327.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
