70010000115329.name: Sugoi Girls: Clover Crush
70010000115329.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000115329.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000115331.name: Lumberjack Simulator - Made in Alaska 2026
70010000115331.intro: Cut. Sell. Upgrade. Become Alaska’s ultimate lumberjack.
70010000115331.description:
Step into the frozen wilderness of Alaska in this first-person lumberjack experience built for players who love progress, discovery, and the satisfaction of powerful upgrades.

Explore dense forests, chop down trees with your growing arsenal of axes, and sell the timber to expand your skills. Start with a simple tool and steadily upgrade your equipment to tackle thicker trunks, harvest wood faster, and earn bigger payouts. Every improvement feels meaningful - every swing becomes stronger.

Whether you’re clearing paths through untouched woodland or mastering the rhythm of efficient cutting, your journey is all about becoming the best lumberjack you can be. No pressure, no timers - just pure, immersive resource-gathering gameplay in the heart of Alaska’s wild nature.

Build your craft. Shape the land. Rise as the true Lumberjack of Alaska.

70010000115338.name: Loaders, Inc.
70010000115338.intro: Box by Box, Build Your Business
70010000115338.description:
Welcome to Loaders Inc, where speed, precision, and style determine your success in the ultimate moving and decorating challenge. Your mission? Clear out old homes, load every last item into the truck, and transform new houses into dream spaces, all before time runs out!

Every second counts as you race against the clock to collect furniture, boxes, and decorations. Upgrade your crew, boost their speed and stamina, and increase your time limit with each attempt. The faster and smarter you work, the more your moving business will thrive.

Once the loading is done, it's time for you to get creative. Arrange and decorate carefully to impress your customers, earn top satisfaction scores, and watch as you grow from a small startup into a decorating powerhouse.

Loaders Inc is fast, fun, and endlessly replayable. It blends time management, strategy, and design into one satisfying experience that proves hard work can be this enjoyable.

70010000115344.name: Where’s the Tuna!?
70010000115344.intro: Find it and smile! A family-friendly tuna hunt!
70010000115344.description:
Among a sea of kanji characters, there is one hidden character for “tuna.”  
Find the correct one within the time limit, and enjoy a quick brain-training spot-the-difference game!

How to play:
• Look closely at the puzzle image  
• When you find the different tuna character, tap it before time runs out!

It may look easy if you stare long enough,  
but with a time limit it becomes surprisingly tricky!

If you get stuck, press the hint button.  
(It will roughly show you where to look.)



The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000115357.name: nyan nyan nyan nyan nyan
70010000115357.intro: meooow meow meow meow meow  meow meow meow meow meoow!!
70010000115357.description:
In this lively illustration filled with many characters and objects,
your task is to find the specified paw print within the time limit.
Enjoy an easy and fun brain-training game!

How to play:
・Look carefully at the target paw print shown
・Search for the same paw print within the illustration
・When you find it, tap the spot before time runs out!

It may seem easy at first, but with a time limit,
you’ll be surprised how challenging it can be!

If you get stuck, the hint button will help you gently,
showing you the area where the answer is hidden.


The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000115363.name: Is this potato?
70010000115363.intro:
Where is this potato hiding?
A cute and easy picture-finding brain training game
70010000115363.description:
In a lively illustration filled with many characters and objects,
your task is to find the specified potato within the time limit.
Enjoy a simple and fun brain-training game!

How to play:
・Look carefully at the target potato image
・Search for the same potato within the illustration
・When you find it, tap the spot before time runs out!

It may seem easy at first, but with a time limit,
you’ll be surprised how challenging it can be!

If you get stuck,
the hint button will gently guide you by showing the nearby area of the answer.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000115387.name: Jump, Mouse, Jump!
70010000115387.intro: Free cheese is only found in mousetraps - but who are we to resist?
70010000115387.description:
Jump, Mouse, Jump! is a fast-paced vertical platformer where your only goal is to climb as high as you possibly can! 

Play as a fearless little mouse, hop between platforms, snag tasty cheese along the way, and dodge hungry cats determined to stop your ascent.

Simple to learn but tough to master - every jump counts, every platform matters, and one wrong move can send you all the way down. The higher you climb, the bigger your score and the greater the thrill!

Think you’ve got the reflexes to reach new heights?

70010000115402.name: Samurai Simulator: Kensei Warrior
70010000115402.intro: Fight with honor. Decide your fate.
70010000115402.description:
Step into the role of Takashi Hayato, a samurai turned ronin after the murder of his lord. Set in feudal Japan during the Sengoku era, the game follows a journey of revenge, honor, and difficult choices.
Master skill-based katana combat with light and heavy attacks, blocks, parries, counterattacks, and executions. Use stealth to strike from the shadows or face enemies head-on in intense duels. Archery supports combat, offering tactical options in battle.

Progress through story-driven levels set in villages, temples, mountain paths, and enemy strongholds. Your actions shape the Honor Karma System — follow the Path of Honor to gain survivability, or the Path of Blood to embrace raw power. Karma influences gameplay bonuses and determines the final ending.

Key Features

- Skill-based katana combat with light, heavy, parry, counter, and execution mechanics
- Stealth gameplay with detection, silent kills, and risk-reward encounters
- Archery support for tactical combat and positioning
- Atmospheric levels inspired by feudal Japan
- Cinematic boss duels that test timing, focus, and resolve
- A branching Honor Karma system that shapes gameplay and story outcomes

Your journey ends where honor, revenge, and destiny collide.
Only your choices will decide whether Takashi becomes a legendary warrior, a ruthless survivor, or a ronin lost to history.

70010000115410.name: Office Brawl - Room Smash
70010000115410.intro: Challenge the office routine! Turn an ordinary workday into a playful office uprising — outsmart obstacles, stir up fun chaos, and face the best boss!
70010000115410.description:
Had enough of endless meetings and paperwork? It’s time to shake things up!

Step into the shoes of a tired office worker who decides that today… things are going to change.
Turn routine into mayhem as you dash through lively office spaces, overcome obstacles, and face the ultimate challenge — the boss!

Key Features:

*A Playful Office Uprising*
Transform boring routine into lighthearted chaos.

*Action with a Twist of Strategy*
Overcome fun challenges using both timing and clever thinking.

*Creative Interactive Environments*
Navigate dynamic office spaces filled with surprises.

*Fast-Paced, Accessible Gameplay*
Easy to jump into, satisfying to master.

*A Relatable Antihero*
Because everyone has dreamed of skipping just one more meeting.

Swap stress for action as everyday workplace objects become tools of playful chaos.
Smash, dodge, and outsmart your way through creative levels where quick thinking is just as important as quick reflexes.

70010000115413.name: RV Drive There Co-op
70010000115413.intro: Survive the detour or stay lost forever in the wild.
70010000115413.description:
You were supposed to be on a calm trip home after a relaxing vacation. But fate had other plans. A massive landslide has blocked the main route, leaving you trapped in an isolated area with only one option: find a detour and escape.

Now you must brave the unknown, face unpredictable terrain, and rely on your skills to survive. In RV Drive There, speed doesn’t matter — careful planning and smart decision-making are key. One RV, one detour, and a group of travelers you must manage and guide as a single unit to reach the exit.

Features:
- Tools & interaction: Use planks, a drill, and a winch to clear obstacles and pull the RV out of stuck situations.
- Fuel & repairs: Your vehicle can break down anytime — repair it on the spot and keep an eye on fuel levels.
- Diverse environments: Travel through forests, mysterious caves, and snowy roads, each with unique challenges.
- Unpredictable events: Landslides, rough terrain, and sudden fuel shortages force quick decisions.
- One way out: Only one detour leads home; mistakes can leave you stranded.

The RV won’t move on its own. Without patience, planning, and precise execution, every stop could be the end of the journey. Face the challenges, navigate the detour, and prove that no trap can stop a true traveler.

70010000115418.name: Crabwave
70010000115418.description:
Catch the wave of tranquility in Crabwave, a relaxing puzzle where a stylish crab surfs across islands, bringing life wherever he goes. Connect water streams, plan the perfect route, and plant coconuts to transform beaches, reefs, and mangroves into vibrant paradises.

No timers, no pressure, no rush. Here, thinking calmly is part of the fun. Build your route, press Play, and watch the crab glide smoothly over the waves, executing your plan with charm and flow. Made a mistake? Restart, rearrange, and try again. Each level is an invitation to experiment, adjust, and smile when everything finally clicks.

Crabwave is perfect for players looking for smart puzzles, a zen atmosphere, and that satisfying feeling of solving challenges at their own pace. Relax, think, surf, and let the tide carry you.

70010000115435.name: Core Keeper – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000115435.intro: Explore an endless cavern of creatures, relics and resources in a mining sandbox adventure for 1-8 players. Mine, build, fight, craft and farm to unravel the mystery of the ancient Core.
70010000115435.description:
Drawn towards a mysterious relic, you are an explorer who awakens in an ancient cavern of creatures, resources and trinkets. Trapped deep underground will your survival skills be up to the task?

Mine relics and resources to build your base, craft new equipment, survive, and power up the Core. Defeat giant monsters, discover hidden secrets, farm crops, cook new recipes and explore a procedurally generated underground world in a mining sandbox adventure for 1-8 players.

Explore a vast underground cave of endless resources. Mine ores, discover hidden crystals, fossils & trinkets and survive a procedurally generated underground world.

Delve into living biomes and fight cavernous creatures in a vast subterranean system. Scour the dark world around you and encounter the behemoths of the underground. Defeat them and take the spoils of victory to help uncover the mystery of the Core.

Customise your character and craft new items, armour and equipment to venture further into the caves. Craft a pickaxe to mine walls and resources, build bridges to cross underground lakes, and place torches to light up the profound ever-present darkness.

Tend your crops to grow a variety of plants by planting seeds found during your adventures. Find the perfect fishing spot and catch a plethora of unique fish. Combine the yield of your hard work farming and fishing in the cooking pot to discover delicious recipes with unexpected effects.

Work together to mine resources, fight, farm, craft and survive. Specialise in your role to help your fellow explorers tame the unruly landscape you find yourselves in.

70010000115441.name: Down Among the Dead Men
70010000115441.intro:
Set sail on your very own epic pirate adventure.
Choose your class, forge your legend, and navigate a sea of perilous choices in this immersive gamebook adventure.
70010000115441.description:
Your Choices Chart the Course.
Become the hero of your own high-seas saga. In a world where the rival kingdoms of Sidonia and Glorianna teeter on the brink of war, you are caught in a deadly race for survival. Hunted by the sadistic Captain Skarvench and drifting across the sea, you hold a secret that could rewrite the fate of the world. The power to become a legend of the seas is in your hands, but the deck is stacked against you.

Forge Your Unique Path.
Begin by choosing your class and assembling a crew of unlikely allies. Then, set sail into a rich narrative where every choice has profound consequences. Will you cross swords with undead pirates, survive deadly encounters with creatures of the deep, or dare to awaken ancient gods? Whatever path you take, the greatest threat is the vision of your own defeat. Your decisions create unique "Story Moments" that permanently shape your journey, making each playthrough distinctly yours. With hundreds of branching paths, uncover new secrets, alliances, and endings with every replay.

70010000115459.name: Pa!nt
70010000115459.intro:
Changing colors opens the way! 
Enjoy 60 colorful puzzles with the adorable Muni. 
Clear stages and freely decorate your own notebook world!
70010000115459.description:
[Pa!nt, a magical world where doodles come to life]

An ordinary notebook becomes the stage for a special adventure with your touch. Become the owner of 'Moony,' a small, cute octopus friend born from a drawing, and explore a puzzle world full of color and imagination!

■ Change the color and the answer appears! Strategic color puzzle

Moony can pass through the same color as itself, but cannot pass through different colors.

Use the surrounding water buckets to change Moony's color and feel the thrilling sensation of paving the way through blocked paths.

■ 60 rich stages and special gimmicks

60 diverse stages await your challenge.

More than 4 special devices that move Moony or change its color add depth to the puzzle.

■ Healing time to decorate your own notebook

As you clear stages, the monotonous home screen transforms into a splendid one!

Dress Moony in cute outfits with items acquired during gameplay to express your own personality.

■ The joy of creation beyond limits

When you need a different challenge, try 'Black and White Mode,' which relies solely on silhouette and senses!

70010000115476.name: Modern Naval Warfare: Sea Combat
70010000115476.intro: Will your strategy survive the storm of modern naval warfare?
70010000115476.description:
Command your fleet and dominate the seas in Modern Naval Warfare: Sea Combat. Step into the role of a naval commander and engage in high-intensity maritime battles where modern technology, tactical planning, and firepower determine victory. Control advanced warships, deploy devastating weapons systems, and outsmart enemy fleets across strategic ocean zones.

Upgrade and customize your vessels with cutting-edge armaments, enhance your fleet’s capabilities, and execute precise combat maneuvers. Navigate vast and dangerous waters, adapt to evolving threats, and prove your dominance in modern naval warfare.

Main Features:
- Command modern warships, from missile destroyers to powerful aircraft carriers
- Experience tactical, technology-driven naval combat
- Upgrade weapons systems, defenses, and fleet performance
- Battle across dynamic sea environments and strategic combat zones

Every decision matters on the open sea — from strategic positioning to the moment you give the order to fire. Will you secure naval supremacy, or will your fleet be lost to the depths?

70010000115497.name: Lia and the Train of the Seasons
70010000115497.intro: Join Lia on the Train of the Seasons and overcome magical challenges through the four seasons to restore harmony!
70010000115497.description:
Hop aboard the Train of Seasons with Lia! A mysterious whistle leads her to a secret station… and the adventure begins.

4 worlds to explore: Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter, each filled with color, surprises, and magic.

Super fun challenges: fix a wacky garden, win silly challenges, make a leaf laugh, and catch whispers on the wind.

Dances and celebrations: collect cards with warm ideas, mini-dances, and joyful winter parties.

Bright finale: when everything is back in balance, Lia arrives at the Station of Harmony… in the sky!

70010000115499.name: Luna & Canela: The Secret Crystal Garden
70010000115499.intro: Luna and Canela embark on a magical adventure to recover a lost necklace and discover that together they are invincible as sisters!
70010000115499.description:
Luna, a tidy kitten, and Canela, a super-cheerful dog, stumble into a magical garden after losing a very special collar.

There, they must overcome fun challenges, change personalities, and solve riddles with the help of enchanting creatures.

Amid laughter, magic, and silliness, they discover that being sisters is their superpower and that family love always grows stronger.

70010000115501.name: Milo and the Cake of Happiness
70010000115501.intro: Milo travels through Sugar Valley searching for magical ingredients to create the most amazing cake and save the joy of the kingdom.
70010000115501.description:
This is a visual novel in the narrative and reading genre.

Designed to provide educational values for children aged 7 to 12.

Milo, an adventurous little baker, travels through Sugar Valley searching for magical ingredients that teach him fun lessons in honesty, patience, rhythm, joy, and wisdom; along the way, he meets new friends and faces incredible challenges to create the perfect cake for his 99-year-old grandmother, featuring a secret ingredient: all the kindness he shared.

70010000115503.name: Shalnor: Silverwind Saga 2
70010000115503.intro: An epic RPG/Action Adventure game. With focus on gauntlet-style combat, traps, boss fights and beautiful pixel-art scenery.
70010000115503.description:
An evil Necromancer has brought ruin upon an already dangerous island.

It's up to Rynna to fight her way through hordes of monsters and undead beings, and defeat the Necromancer and his minions and free the souls of those who have been trapped in the world of the living.

Find Weapons and Artifacts, explore the 20 zones, each dividing into multiple caves and dungeons. Help the people by finding their possessions and freeing their souls.


Shalnor: Silverwind saga 2 mixes 2D sprites with a 3D terrain, giving it a unique look, the game features quick and swift movement that makes fighting hordes of monsters fun.

Featuring 15 unique Items/Weapons that accommodates different playstyles and adds a lot of variation to combat.

70010000115508.name: Cookiette and the Vanilla Crystal
70010000115508.intro: Cookie embarks on an adventure to find the Vanilla Crystal and defeat the Cocoa Witch, restoring sweetness to Sweetland.
70010000115508.description:
Cookie embarks on a sweet and magical adventure to save Sweetland from the Cocoa Witch's bitter spell.

Features:

A world full of desserts, colors, and delicious scenes.

Adorable protagonist: a brave and very agile cookie.

Search for the legendary Vanilla Crystal to restore sweetness.

Face the Cocoa Witch and her Dry Sun.

A simple, fun adventure perfect for little ones.

70010000115510.name: Choppa: Rescue Rivals
70010000115510.intro: Take to the skies in Choppa: Rescue Rivals! Fly daring rescue missions through a Saturday-morning-anime adventure. Save lives, outfly rivals, become a legend!
70010000115510.description:
Choppa: Rescue Rivals is a modern-but-retro reimagining of the arcade-style action games made famous in the 1980s and 1990s. Like many, we share a deep nostalgia for the vibrant world of the ‘80s and ‘90s media: Arcade games, toys, cartoons and anime that defined our childhoods. Driven by this passion, we set out to create a game that brings those cherished memories to life.

A Nostalgic "Saturday Morning Anime" Storyline
Step into the cockpit with Rick, a legendary rescue chopper pilot coaxed out of retirement for one last, crucial mission on a disaster-ravaged oil rig. With his rescue pilot license freshly reinstated, Rick is thrust into an unexpected scuffle with Burdock, his former wingman turned adversary, uncovering a sinister plot led by the malevolent A.C.R corporation. As the stakes soar higher, Rick and his comrades from the Thunderbolt Rescue Foundation must outwit and outmaneuver their foes to thwart Burdock's dark ambitions.

Dynamic Globetrotting Gameplay
Choppa: Rescue Rivals offers a unique blend of chaotic gameplay, compelling storytelling, and cooperative rivalry. Prepare for an unforgettable ride to the skies where luck, strategy and skill will determine the true heroes. Gather your team and don't forget: It's time to GET TO THE CHOPPA!

Key Features
Embark on an epic single-player story campaign: Navigate through a series of high-stakes rescue missions across the globe with a diverse cast of pilots.

Each pilot brings in their own unique rescue tool and story location, shaping distinct gameplay experiences and demanding new strategies for each rescue mission.

Test your piloting skills: Conquer demanding challenges in each level and hunt down hidden collectibles scattered across each mission for true completionist glory.
 

Customization options: Personalize your gameplay by selecting from a variety of pilots and helicopters, and deck out your chopper with a wide array of stickers.

But wait, there's more! Bring your friends! When you're ready for a break from the campaign, gather up to 4 players for wacky local multiplayer air hockey battles, a high-flying twist on vehicular sports. This time in the sky with choppers!

70010000115512.name: Panty Match Girls
70010000115512.description:
Meet charming girls who dream of completing their collection of the cutest panties! Your task is to help them find the missing pairs by matching threes in cozy puzzles. Instead of the usual fruits or candies, you'll find elegant panties in a variety of colors, styles, and textures. Match three of them, solve increasingly challenging puzzles, and gradually unlock all the images of beautiful girls.
With each completed round, you gain access to new fragments, and then to full portraits that you can not only store but also creatively decorate. In the gallery, you can move, zoom, and choose the perfect angle, combining unlocked images with different backgrounds to create your own unique composition. All this is accompanied by gentle, relaxing music, turning the game into a meditative ritual of beauty and attention.

Features:
• Cute images of girls.
• Collect panties in different colors and styles.
• A variety of backgrounds to personalize your favorite images.
• Interactive gallery.
• Useful bonuses and boosters.
• Relaxing music that creates an atmosphere of comfort and intimacy.
• Gradually increasing puzzle difficulty.

70010000115520.name: Escape from Tarkan
70010000115520.intro: Ruthless enemies, ruined streets, and one chance to escape.
70010000115520.description:
Escape from Tarkan throws you into an isolated city shattered by conflict and abandoned by the world. Law has collapsed, rival factions fight for control, and danger lurks around every corner.

Move through ruined streets, collapsed buildings, and hazardous industrial zones in search of weapons, equipment, and vital supplies. Enemies are ruthless and unpredictable, forcing constant adaptation and split-second decisions. Advanced visual effects and immersive sound design heighten the oppressive atmosphere, turning Tarkan into a living urban nightmare.

Key Features:
- Vast Urban Environment: A large, open city filled with abandoned locations, alternative routes, and hidden threats.
- Weapons and Equipment: Discover and use essential gear scattered throughout the city.
- Rival Factions: Face intelligent enemies battling for dominance in a lawless zone.
- Tense, Realistic Atmosphere: Visual and audio design that amplifies every moment of danger.

Will you escape Tarkan, or will the city claim you? Every step could be your last.

70010000115525.name: Toree's 3D Platformer Collection
70010000115525.intro: Four fun 3d platformers featuring a variety of gameplay concepts, suitable for all ages and ranges of experience.
70010000115525.description:
Toree and his friends invite you to jump through four colourful and varied 3d platformer games. Toree's 3D Platformer Collection includes the following four titles: Toree 3D (incl. Toree Jumbled Jam extra levels), Toree 2 (incl. winter-themed extra levels), Macbat 64 and Regina & Mac. Additionally, you can unlock a secret extra game. 

These four games represent a variety of playstyles from arcade-style high speed platforming in Toree 2 to precise collection-based platforming in Regina & Mac. In this collection, the individual games are extended by a new Time Attack mode in which you can record individual best times for simple playthroughs or complete run throughs. The recorded time is rated with a rating from C to S.

70010000115527.name: Collie Call: The Future Is Calling
70010000115527.intro: Collie Call: Sheep Mission in Space
70010000115527.description:
Get ready for intergalactic barking and clever strategy in Collie Call: The Future Is Calling. Here, you control a robotic dog in outer space on a very unusual mission: organize floating sheep into air-bubble pastures before chaos takes over the galaxy.

Each stage is a smart puzzle where every push matters. Teleporters flash, buttons activate futuristic gates, and every move can mean the difference between a perfect solution or a sheep stuck in the wrong corner of the universe. Plan carefully, test routes, use undo without fear, and refine your strategy until everything clicks into place.

With 30 levels full of progressive challenges, charming sci-fi visuals, and accessible mechanics, Collie Call blends logic, cuteness, and technology into an engaging experience. It is the perfect puzzle for players who enjoy thinking calmly, experimenting with creative solutions, and celebrating that satisfying feeling of getting everything just right.

The future is calling. And it needs a good dog.

70010000115544.name: Five Hearts Under One Roof season2
70010000115544.intro:
“Looking for someone to run the boarding house once again!”
The FMV dating simulation [Five Hearts Under One Roof] returns with Season 2!
70010000115544.description:
Game Description

“Looking for someone to run the boarding house once again!”

The FMV dating simulation [Five Hearts Under One Roof] returns with Season 2!
Step into the shoes of Yuman once again and run a love-filled boarding house alongside six charming heroines.

Season 2 brings back fan favorites Mal-sook, Gran, and Min-jung,
now joined by three new tenants, each with their own unique charm.

Experience heart-fluttering new stories and see how much the girls have grown.

In the end… who will stay by your side?


Character Introduction
Mal-sook Go / First Tenant / Childhood Friend of 20 Years
"From today on, he’s under my control!"

Perfect chemistry, unspoken understanding—Mal-sook is Yuman’s one and only friend.
In the 21 years they’ve known each other, there was nothing they didn’t share.
At least, until a few months ago.

Now, Mal-sook has a secret she can’t bring herself to tell Yuman.

Gran Dong / Second Tenant / Workplace Supervisor
"When we’re not at work, don’t call me 'Manager.' Use my name."

Even calling her a workaholic wouldn’t cut it. Gran is completely obsessed with her job.
To her, anything outside of work isn’t worth her time or thoughts.
But there's one exception: Yuman.

Watching him has become her unexpected source of enjoyment.

Yu-na Jeong / Third Tenant / Wealthy Heiress
"I came to take responsibility for you, Yuman. I always keep my word."

The youngest daughter of a powerful and successful conglomerate family.
She seems carefree, full of energy, and always ready to have fun—like she doesn’t have a worry in the world.
But at home, she’s seen as the clumsy, useless one.

And that “useless one” ends up causing real trouble.

Min-jung Park / Fourth Tenant / First Love
"I had nowhere else to go but here."

Once an unknown idol struggling for attention, Min-jung is now a national sweetheart.
Just when her career seemed to be at its peak, radiant and busier than ever,
another scandal threatens to bring her crashing down.

Right now, Yuman is the only person she can rely on.

Yoo-jung Yang / Last Tenant / Quiet Wallflower
"You're the first person who’s ever really seen me."

Yoo-jung does nothing but work—unless she’s eating or sleeping.
Because of bullying she went through in school, she finds it hard to face people.
She keeps putting off college, too, afraid of dealing with others.

But then, someone like Yuman comes into her life—a once-in-a-lifetime chance.

Gyu-ri Bang / Soon-to-Be Tenant (?) / Sweet Nurse
"Yuman, you’re a patient right now. A patient!"

With her warm personality and adorable looks, Gyu-ri is like an idol to the hospital patients.
Despite the demanding nature of her job, she gives her all with a strong sense of duty.
But one particular patient starts to feel... different.

Lately, Yuman keeps crossing her mind—not as a patient, but as a man.


Out of these six unique heroines, who will you fall in love with?

Or… will it be someone else entirely?

70010000115550.name: Escape Game The Museum of Memories
70010000115550.intro: A classic escape game set in an art museum hosting an exhibition of past works!
70010000115550.description:
■Game System
This is an escape game (puzzle-solving adventure game).
※ Progress through the game by selecting items on the screen with the cursor and solving various puzzles.

■Story
I heard a special event featuring my favorite “Cat Series” escape game was happening at the nearby museum, so I came to check it out.

Cat
“Welcome to the event, meow! Do you like escape games, meow?”

It seems you get a souvenir if you escape successfully.

Let's jump right in and give it a try!

70010000115554.name: Kugayama Shiori's Death Diary
70010000115554.intro: Don't be shy, watch me die!
70010000115554.description:
Even in death, Kugayama Shiori takes her own life.
Maybe her next will finally be her last.
But no matter how many times she dies, her soul refuses to leave this world.

Maybe the answer lies in her lost memories.
Maybe there's a lingering attachment she's forgotten.

Other than her name, she remembers nothing.
Who was she?
Why did she die?

Together with you—the only living person who can still speak to her—
Shiori begins her search for her memories, and for the truth behind her death.

70010000115567.name: Super Mario Bros.™ Wonder – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park
70010000115567.intro: Save the Flower Kingdom in the latest side-scrolling Super Mario adventure—now with more content and improvements for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system
70010000115567.description:
Turn classic Mario side-scrolling gameplay on its head with the addition of Wonder Flowers. These game-changing items trigger spectacular moments you have to see to believe. Witness singing and dancing piranha plants, turn into a Goomba, and more in these unexpected events called Wonder effects.

Set out on an adventure to save the Flower Kingdom from Bowser and take on Bowser Jr. and all seven Koopalings in boss battles through the various worlds. Choose from a cast of characters including Mario, Luigi, Peach, Daisy, and more—this Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition  also features Rosalina and Co-Star Luma. Grab surprising power-ups, like the trunk-trouncing Elephant Fruit and the flower-hopping Super Flower Pot, to help you along the way. You can also enable Assist Mode to become immune to damage, and recover from falls with the Propeller Flower, if you’re having trouble—regardless of which character you are playing as!

Meet up with friends for attractions and entertainment in Bellabel Park

Captain Toad has discovered some mysterious ruins in the Flower Kingdom! Explore this area with your friends in local*, online**, or local wireless* multiplayer in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. Visit the attractions to cooperate or compete in over 100 courses that use a variety of game mechanics like Joy-Con™ 2 mouse controls. As you play these attractions, you will unlock greetings to interact with your friends, flowers to decorate Bellabel Park, Dual Badges that enhance your abilities, and more.

Share the wonder with friends and Mario fans near and far

Gather up to four people around one system* to experience the game-bending Wonder effects together as you tackle courses as a team and help each other on your way to the Goal Pole. Online**, you can work together or turn a course into a friendly race to finish first. Even when playing solo, connecting online lets you see live player shadows of up to 11 other Mario fans around the world as they embark on their own journeys. See how they approach each course and get their help when you’re in trouble. Find standees left by other players to help recover from falls—or place your own.

You can also play the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition with friends who don’t have the game, in person or online, via GameShare***.

Already have Super Mario Bros.™ Wonder for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack!

If you already have the game for Nintendo Switch, you can purchase the upgrade pack**** separately to enjoy all the additional content and improvements of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition!

Unlock and equip more than 40 badges with various effects

Want some more midair time? Equip the Parachute Cap. Want an extra boost underwater? Dolphin Kick is your best bet. Having trouble perfecting your platforming? Safety Bounce will save you from a fall. Using your badges together with power-ups is the key to saving the Flower Kingdom—and in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, you can unlock Dual Badges to have two of these effects active at the same time!

70010000115589.name: Evil Cat Simulator vs Granny
70010000115589.intro: Sneak through every room, outsmart Granny, and unleash true feline mischief.
70010000115589.description:
The house is no longer peaceful — because you’re inside. In Evil Cat Simulator vs Granny, you become a mischievous and slightly evil cat determined to turn Granny’s quiet home into your personal playground. Explore every room, outsmart Granny, and unleash adorable chaos with no rules holding you back. Whether you prefer sneaky pranks or full-scale destruction, the house now belongs to you.

Features:
• Free exploration of Granny’s house, including hidden spots and high places
• Dozens of interactive objects to push, break, scratch, and knock over
• Stealth elements: hide under beds, behind doors, and escape when spotted
• Dynamic encounters with Granny throughout the house
• Multiple playstyles: relax, explore, prank, or create total disorder
• Light-hearted atmosphere mixed with playful rivalry

Evil Cat Simulator vs Granny is a fun and chaotic cat life adventure where freedom and instinct come first. Sneak, jump, scratch, and outsmart Granny as you transform her home into the ultimate feline playground. The world is in your paws — and mischief is only the beginning.

70010000115600.name: Hentai Balls 3D: Perfect Motion
70010000115600.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000115600.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000115606.name: Hentai Banana
70010000115606.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000115625.name: Counter Force
70010000115625.intro: Lead your team, fight with honor, and rise as a hero.
70010000115625.description:
Enter the frontline in Counter Force, an action-packed tactical shooter where precision, leadership, and quick thinking decide every mission. As the commander of an elite counter-terror unit, you’ll face dangerous enemies, rescue civilians, and restore order in high-risk operations across hostile locations. Every move matters when failure is not an option.

Game Features:
- Elite Task Unit – Control a skilled strike team built for combat and special operations.
- Smart Tactical Play – Plan attacks, choose routes, and react to changing threats.
- Fast-Paced Gunfights – Engage enemies with realistic weapons and intense shooting action.
- Mission-Based Progression – Complete critical objectives to unlock new challenges and gear.
- Dynamic Battle Zones – Fight through urban areas, secured compounds, and danger-filled environments.
- High-Risk Operations – Stay alert as enemy reinforcements and unexpected events keep missions unpredictable.

The battlefield is waiting. Take command, execute with precision, and prove you have what it takes to lead Counter Force.

70010000115631.name: Human Bowling: King Pin
70010000115631.description:
Barrel down an endless, obstacle-packed lane as a bowling ball, scooping up ragdoll humans who cling on for dear life.
Dodge crushing hazards, spinning traps, and brutal obstacles designed to strip away your hard-earned human pile. The pace and pressure ramp up relentlessly, demanding sharp reactions and control.
At the end of each run, fire your collected humans like living projectiles, blasting them toward towering skittles. Take down as many as you can — especially the King Pin, the most valuable target on the lane.

70010000115660.name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth
70010000115660.intro: From the creators of Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley comes a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson.
70010000115660.description:
When Moomintroll unexpectedly wakes up early from his winter hibernation, he finds himself completely alone for the first time, in a world he barely recognizes. The familiar landscape of Moominvalley is now cloaked in the frosty veil of the Lady of the Cold. Initially seeking someone to care for him and longing to banish winter, young Moomintroll reluctantly embarks on a journey into the unknown, learning to forge new friendships and help those in greater need than himself.

- Wander through the beautiful landscape inspired by Nordic nature, exploring Moominvalley and the nearby forests and mountains.  
- Meet many of Moomintroll’s old and new friends, and help them out by solving quests and puzzles.
- Re-imagine Tove Jansson’s Moominland Midwinter. A trove of nostalgia for fans of Moomin, and an approachable starting point for those experiencing this wonderful world for the first time.

While not a direct sequel to Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley, it is a spiritual successor with many similarities. You can enjoy both games on their own, and in any order you’d like.

70010000115667.name: MARVEL MaXimum Collection
70010000115667.intro: The Definitive Archive for True Believers
70010000115667.description:
MARVEL MAXIMUM COLLECTION: THE DEFINITIVE RETRO ARCHIVE

Welcome to the Vault. Limited Run Games is proud to present one of the most comprehensive gatherings of Marvel’s early gaming legacy. Featuring every major iteration across Arcade, 8-bit, 16-bit, and portable consoles, this collection is a curated journey through the evolution of the 1990s Marvel Universe in pixels. It’s more than a game—it’s a piece of history, preserved with modern features and bonus content for the ultimate fan.

Experience every pixelated punch, web-swing, and optic blast across multiple platforms. We haven’t just picked a favorite version—every major console and arcade iteration is included. Whether you grew up with a controller in your hand or a roll of quarters in your pocket, the MARVEL MaXimum Collection is the ultimate tribute to the True Believers.


X-Men: The Arcade Game (Arcade):
The definitive mutant beat-’em-up returns! Experience the legendary cabinet action with full online multiplayer support for up to 6 players, including Rollback Netcode. Choose your favorite X-Men and take on Magneto’s army with the ultimate team-up experience.

Captain America and The Avengers (Arcade, MEGA, 8-bit):
"I can't move!" Take control of Cap, Iron Man, Hawkeye, and Vision. Experience the cinematic arcade original or the unique platforming spin of the 8-bit version.

Spider-Man/Venom: Maximum Carnage (SUPER, MEGA):
Based on the iconic comic crossover. Battle through the streets of NYC to the sound of a 16-bit rock soundtrack. Switch between the SUPER version’s rich colors and the MEGA version’s gritty vibe.

Venom/Spider-Man: Separation Anxiety (SUPER, MEGA):
The symbiote sequel! Team up in 2-player co-op to take on the Life Foundation and Carnage’s offspring.

Spider-Man/X-Men: Arcade’s Revenge (SUPER, MEGA, PORTABLE, GEAR):
Navigate Arcade’s deadly "Murderworld." This collection includes the handheld versions, offering a fascinating look at Marvel history on the go.

Silver Surfer (8-Bit):
Test your skills against one of the most infamously challenging shooters ever made. Features one of the greatest soundtracks in 8-bit history.


MaXimum Features

We’ve added modern bells and whistles to ensure these classics are more playable than ever:

●	X-Men: The Arcade Game Online: Online multiplayer for up to 6 players with Rollback Netcode!
●	Archives: Dive into a digital archive featuring high-resolution scans of original box art, instruction manuals, and vintage advertisements.
●	Music Player: Kick back and listen to the iconic chip-tune scores from every version of every game in the collection.
●	Integrated CHEATS menu: Enable Infinite Lives and more in selected games
●	Rewind & Save States: Finally conquer the "Deadly Walls" of Silver Surfer or the boss gauntlets of Arcade’s Revenge with the ability to rewind gameplay and save anywhere.
●	Display Options: Play with crisp, modern pixels or recreate the Saturday morning experience with CRT and scanline filters.

70010000115719.name: Realm of Ink
70010000115719.intro:
Ink binds fate.
Break the cycle.
Become the anomaly.
70010000115719.description:
ENDLESS CYCLES, CEASELESS REBIRTH 
Step into the shifting, treacherous realms as Red, the swordsman bound by her destiny. Wield the power of the Fox whilst confronting monstrous enemies and brutal bosses. Death is not the end; it's just a chance to redefine your destiny through cycles of death and rebirth. Take up your weapon and let your quest to escape the ever-changing realm of ink begin.

FIERCE BATTLES WITH INFINITE CREATIVITY
Experience infinite creativity. Dive into thrilling, fast-paced combat and invent a style that is uniquely yours.
- Mix and match dozens of different forms, weapons, and enhancements.
- With over 40 distinctive Ink Gems, every single run is a new opportunity.
- Unlock vast possibilities and enhance playstyles with over 200 artefacts
- Think you’ve mastered the realm? Prove it. Push your skill to the absolute limit in the Trial Valleys and earn high scores in the brutal Endless Challenge mode.

YOUR INK PET FIGHTS BY YOUR SIDE
Adorable yet deadly. Meet Momo: Your fiercely loyal companion. This mysterious Ink Pet fights tooth and claw alongside you every step of the way.
But the real magic happens when you combine Ink Gems: witness instant, explosive transformations! Experience the unique changes with over 15 unique, striking forms, each one granting access to utterly unique move sets. Which combination will become your favourite?

EXPLORE NEW REALMS
An Eastern fantasy world, painted in ink. Journey deep into stunning, diverse realms, from the vibrant, verdant forests to the hallowed, reverent ruins of the Mausoleum. Each environment is a breathtaking blend of classical Chinese ink-wash art and rich, vibrant colour palettes.
Draw your sword and venture into the unknown. Battle the enigmatic Realm Guardians to glimpse beyond the veil into their mysterious pasts. And prepare to face over 20 unique creatures, steeped in distinctive Chinese folklore and backstory, including the cunning Fox Demon, the elegant Peony Fairy and the elusive Mirror Sprite.

70010000115744.name: Farming Camp
70010000115744.intro: Follow the journey of Alessandra competing to become the best farmer in the camp.
70010000115744.description:
Farming Camp is a cozy, single-player farm management game that follows the journey of an ambitious teenager competing to become the best farmer in the camp. Manage your farm alongside your companions, complete chores for points, and deal with the dynamics of a colorful cast in their teenage years. 

Your path to farming greatness begins!
Step into the boots of young Alessandra, before she became the renowned Evertree Farmer. Experience her life at the Evertree Farming Camp where it all began. Learn the ropes and face the fun and chaos of camp life.

Team up with a lively farming crew
You're not alone on the farm. You’ll have the company of two budding young farmers, each with their own vibe. Assign chores, solve problems, and build friendships as you figure out how to run the farm together.

Heart, humor, and harvests!
Farming’s only half the fun at Evertree Farming Camp. From delightful dramas to silly surprises, and even a few messy moments, there's never a dull day at the camp!

Work hard to take care of the camp
Use the tools at your disposal and climb your way to the top as the camp’s best farming team. Coordinate with your companions and earn points by completing chores, maintaining the camp, attending classes, and tackling missions.  

Have fun and win the competition
Jump into quick and fun minigames that keep things exciting—whether it’s racing against the clock to eliminate pests, chopping wood, cooking delicious meals, and more!

Key Features:
- Embark on a cozy single-player farming adventure and follow a unique, captivating story. 
- Explore a beautifully hand-drawn 2D top-down world full of charming details. 
- Meet a diverse and lovable cast of characters, each with their own quirks, stories, and farming talents. 
- Grow a variety of crops, care for animals, fish, and make your team win the competition.
- Keep your farm thriving with fun and engaging mini-games.

70010000115769.name: Petmagotchi
70010000115769.intro: Adopt a kitten or puppy and follow your companion’s daily life.
70010000115769.description:
Take care of your kitten or puppy with food, water, and lots of love.

- Feed, give water, and show affection

- Play 8 challenging minigames

- Earn rewards and unlock skins

- Customize your pet and your home

70010000115775.name: Hentai Balls 3D: Triple Trouble
70010000115775.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000115775.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000115781.name: Hentai Bikini
70010000115781.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.

70010000115787.name: Party Club
70010000115787.intro: Manage the chaos and build the ultimate party venue with up to 4 players!
70010000115787.description:
Seat diverse guests and serve drinks while balancing unique customer types.
Keep the peace by choosing seats wisely and surviving wild weather disasters.
Handle quirky characters and upgrade your venue to keep the party going.
Team up or go solo to master the art of hectic, high-energy management!

70010000115792.name: Hentai Office Enigma
70010000115792.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000115792.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:

• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.

• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.

70010000115798.name: All Me Action Game
70010000115798.intro:
Dev-made live-action everything
Brutal die-and-retry (0.00…1% clear)
2-player co-op: one mistake = game over for both
70010000115798.description:
From the hero and enemies to the blocks, BGM, and sound effects—
everything in this game is made from the developer (me): live-action images and real voice.
A sanity-questioning 2D action platformer has arrived.

[WARNING] The claimed clear rate is 0.000000000000000001%.
We take no responsibility for any regret after purchase.

■ "All-Me" materials, in full madness
The player, attacking enemies, and even the platforms are all live-action images of the developer.
Jump sounds, damage sounds, and the BGM are also made entirely from the developer's "voice."
Enjoy the deranged artwork that shaves away your sanity the longer you play.

■ Unreasonably "ultra-high difficulty"
Gotcha traps, nasty enemy placements, and strict control precision.
It follows the classic die-and-learn style of old-school "die games."
Even the developer struggles to clear it—can you endure it?

■ Friendship-destroying "2-player co-op"
Supports local 2-player co-op by sharing a controller.
But it's not normal co-op.
If either player makes a mistake: instant game over—collective responsibility.
Shove each other off tiny platforms, fall, blame your partner… pure chaos.

Now—don't give up. Overcome "me."

70010000115809.name: Lord Ambermaze
70010000115809.intro: Lord Ambermaze is a charming adventure where the world moves only when you do. Battle quirky foes, solve puzzles, and save your little sister by uncovering the dark lord’s secret.
70010000115809.description:
You awaken on a strange island ruled by the enigmatic Lord Ambermaze. He has frozen time, turning the island into a trap where no one ages or dies, and bizarre creatures roam — twisted results of his magical experiments. Don’t be surprised if you encounter carnivorous plums, exploding pumpkins, or mutant wasps along the way!

THE GREAT GARDEN BATTLE 
The entire island is one sprawling maze teeming with odd and dangerous creatures: stink-spiders, acidic slimes, fire moths, chomping hives — and that’s just the beginning.
But you’re not defenseless. Armed with a magical sword, a sturdy bow, a reliable shield, and most importantly — courage — your hero is ready to outwit and defeat every threat.
You’ll also need agility and sharp wits. Beyond the toothy and spiky monsters, the island is filled with traps and obstacles: bottomless pits, thorny bushes, spike traps, and more. You’ll have to use your brain to get past them.

FISHING AND OTHER ACTIVITIES 
Even the boldest adventurer needs a break. Luckily, Lord Ambermaze is packed with mini-games and side activities.
Try your luck at shell games and hunt for treasure (just hope you pick the right chest — or risk singed eyebrows). Go fishing and you might catch a golden fish… or a golden coin… or a bomb. Depends on your luck.
Move ancient boulders in classic sokoban puzzles and try not to throw out your back. Solve color-matching puzzles, sliding tile challenges, and escape from rooms as dark as the belly of a mutant plum.

NEW FRIENDS AND ISLAND MYSTERIES 
There’s more than just enemies on the island — you can find friends too. Meet charming ladies, each with her own backstory and personality. Give gifts and build a relationship with one (or all!) of them. After all, every hero deserves a loyal companion, right?

And it’s not just the ladies — the island is full of eccentric characters with stories to tell. Who is the stone golem and how did he end up like that? Why does the fisherman have so many clones, and what are they all trying to catch?
Play Lord Ambermaze and uncover every secret the island hides!

70010000115815.name: UNDER THE ISLAND
70010000115815.intro: A 2D action-adventure steeped in ‘90s charm! Step into the shoes of Nia, and battle fierce monsters, solve clever puzzles, and explore a world alive with mystery.
70010000115815.description:
DISCOVER THE LEGEND OF WHAT'S UNDER THE ISLAND!
Uncover a sinking mystery and step into the role of Nia, a newcomer to Seashell Island - and join forces with local girl Avocado to investigate an ominous fate - the island's destined to sink beneath the ocean! Explore colorful regions, battle strange creatures, and uncover the ancient mysteries that could threaten your new home.

CLASSIC TOP-DOWN ADVENTURE
Journey across a lush island, brought to life with vibrant pixel art and timeless top-down exploration. Delve into hidden corners, uncover secrets, and face dangerous foes across diverse, interconnected biomes.

SIX DISTINCT REGIONS TO EXPLORE
From eerie sentient greenhouses, to frozen caverns, and chaotic sawmills, each biome holds its own dangers, upgrades, and treasures to uncover! Become the champion of the cook-off, reunite lost cats, and dodge the rage of the cereal pirates.

STRANGE ENEMIES & UNUSUAL TACTICS
Face off against vomiting eggplants, tunnelling wolves, and other bizarre creatures. Use artefacts, loot, and new abilities you discover to turn the tide of battle. Befriend animals and see if they can help you on your adventure - particularly if you give them treats!

A CAST OF MEMORABLE CHARACTERS
Meet the island’s quirky inhabitants, each with their own personality, story, and a role to play in your adventure. Forge friendships, lend a hand, and see how they can aid you in return.

70010000115820.name: Shake Cubes
70010000115820.intro: Shake and rotate your console to guide cubes into portals while navigating challenging obstacles! 30 levels offer hours of fun and challenging gameplay!
70010000115820.description:
This skill-based game puts your dexterity to the test. Cube movement is fully physics-based, and you control the world by simply rotating your console. The game uses the console’s built-in gyroscope and accelerometer to track your movements.

Each level features different obstacles, so every challenge feels fresh and unique.

70010000115822.name: Minishoot' Adventures - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000115822.intro: An adventure that mixes up open exploration with twin-stick shooter action
70010000115822.description:
Fly into a charming handcrafted world and go on an adventure that mixes up open exploration with crispy twin-stick shooter action.

Fight your way from the shiny overworld to the deepest caves, improve your ship and overcome the dungeons' bosses to rescue your friends!

THE UNCHOSEN HAS RETURNED...
His minions have emerged from the underworld, your village has been destroyed, and all your friends are now trapped in corrupted crystal... Embark on a journey to save the world in this bullet-filled adventure, born from our desire to mix the joy of open-ended exploration with a top-down shooter's juicy game feel.

ENGAGE WITH TIGHT COMBAT
Take control of a swift and responsive spaceship, and shoot your way through handcrafted encounters supported by a crystal clear esthetic and crispy game feel. Overcome bosses in intense Bullet Hell battles, with difficulty options for both newcomers and veterans.

VENTURE ON YOUR OWN
Plunge into an entirely handcrafted world built with many interconnections to explore on your own. Lush caverns, ancient temples and sunken cities await you with their unique treasures, challenges and secrets.

RECLAIM THE STOLEN POWERS
Finding the Primordial Powers will improve your combat and exploration abilities while also opening up the map bit by bit as you unlock new paths and reveal shortcuts.

IMPROVE YOUR SHIP
Upgrade your ship by leveling up, finding various items and buying equipment. Don't forget to rescue your adorable friends; each of them will help you in their own way!

A GAME MADE FOR YOU
Whether you like chill exploration or hardcore Bullet Hell, we got you covered with 3 difficulty modes, aiming assistance, auto fire and more accessibility options.

70010000115831.name: Jigsaw Realms: Nature
70010000115831.description:
Step into a tranquil world of fantasy-inspired nature and put your puzzle skills to the test. Jigsaw Realms: Nature is a relaxing yet rewarding jigsaw puzzle experience featuring 30 beautifully illustrated levels!

Play your way with full support for both touch controls and controllers, and switch between them anytime. Whether you’re playing in handheld mode or docked, the game adapts seamlessly to how you want to play! A built-in saving system lets you pause at any time and continue right where you left off.

Features:
>30 handcrafted jigsaw puzzles set in fantasy and stylized nature worlds
>Beautiful, calming artwork designed to relax and inspire
>Save and resume freely—continue your puzzle whenever you want
> A cozy, stress-free experience for puzzle lovers of all ages

Unwind, focus, and explore nature in Jigsaw Realms: Nature!

70010000115846.name: Yabai Girls: Ballet Beauty
70010000115846.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000115846.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000115848.name: Yabai Girls: Valentine Babe
70010000115848.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000115848.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000115850.name: Yabai Girls: Fairy Love
70010000115850.intro: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000115850.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

70010000115853.name: Optical Illusion Test
70010000115853.intro:
If this picture looks like ○○ to you, it means ××!?
A personality test that reveals your hidden psychology.
70010000115853.description:
This is a personality test game where you simply choose, by instinct, what the illustration looks like to you,
and discover insights into your hidden psychology.

Does this picture look like a bicycle? Binoculars? Or something else…!?

Depending on the option you choose, the game reveals what you value most,
the worries you may be carrying, and how others see you—
even personality traits you might not be aware of yourself.

Each result also comes with a bit of advice,
making it perfect not only for enjoying alone and getting to know yourself better,
but also for having fun in a group or as part of a streamer’s live commentary.


The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000115887.name: Court of Darkness: Adoration's Kiss
70010000115887.intro: In this world of magic, your kiss is an irresistible temptation.
70010000115887.description:
The long-awaited third installment in the Court of Darkness series is finally here!
Experience brand-new romance storylines with a fresh cast of consorts♪

■Story
The night of a crimson crescent moon,
you find yourself transported
to a realm called Saligia.

Far removed from your everyday life,
you're in a world where magic is commonplace.

In the midst of your confusion,
before you appear
five beautiful princes.

They crave the power
your kiss can bestow,
and will scheme to get it.

But what they seek
is not just your power.
They want your heart as well...

■Characters
Jasper Lane: The Inerrant Professional
Tino Maes: The Loyal Maladroit
Knight: The Brazen Ally
Grayson: The Steadfast Soldier

■Contents
Princes’ Path Books 1-3 (excluding Special Tales), plus Book 1 Consorts’ Paths for Jasper, Tino, Knight, and Grayson from the romance app Court of Darkness.
*Does not contain voice or avatar features.

70010000115893.name: Bad Cat Angry Granny
70010000115893.description:
Who says cats can’t be little troublemakers? In Bad Cat Angry Granny, you’re not just any pet—you’re the ultimate feline prankster with a mission: turn Granny’s peaceful home into your personal playground of chaos.

Scratch the furniture, knock over priceless vases, sneak snacks from the kitchen, and turn every cozy corner into a disaster zone. Each room is packed with toys, secrets, and breakable goodies just begging for your claws. But watch out—Granny’s on the lookout, and she’s not exactly patient with furry troublemakers.

Choose your cat’s look, from cute and cuddly to wild and wacky, then pounce your way through hilarious challenges and clever pranks. Outsmart Granny, push her buttons, and rack up points for every bit of mischief you pull off.

From the attic to the basement, every space is your stage for chaos. So sharpen those claws, flick your tail, and remember—life’s too short to be a “good kitty.”

70010000115898.name: Backrooms: Duck Escape
70010000115898.intro: Don't follow the squeak — it follows you.
70010000115898.description:
You find yourself trapped in the endless maze of the Backrooms — but you’re not alone. Somewhere in the humming corridors, something strange waddles in the dark. A duck…

What begins as a simple search for an exit quickly turns into a survival chase. Sometimes you hear soft footsteps… sometimes a quiet squeak right behind you.
The deeper you go, the weirder it gets: distorted rooms, looping hallways, impossible spaces, and the unsettling presence of the duck that always seems one step closer.

Stay alert, navigate the shifting rooms, and outsmart the creature hunting you.
Run when you must. Hide when you can.
And whatever you do, don’t look back when you hear the squeak.

70010000115904.name: Waterpark Simulator 2025
70010000115904.description:
Build a waterpark that’s louder, splashier, and slightly more chaotic than anyone planned. Start with a patch of land and a few modest slides, then turn it into a full-blown splash factory packed with looping rides, giant pools, and attractions that make guests question their life choices—in a good way.

At first, it’s all on you. You’ll sell tickets, serve snacks, fix broken pumps, and scoop lost flip-flops out of the wave pool. As the crowds grow, so does the madness. Slides clog, kids cannonball where they shouldn’t, and someone always forgets sunscreen. Welcome to management.

Design every corner your way. Paint slides in wild colors, rearrange pool layouts, add decorations, and build the kind of place people brag about surviving. The physics keep things lively—expect dramatic belly flops, slippery wipeouts, and the occasional “I meant to do that” moment.

Expand your park, hire staff to handle the chaos, and keep visitors happy with food, drinks, and just enough safety to keep things interesting. Because here, the goal isn’t just to build a waterpark—it’s to build the one everyone talks about on the ride home… preferably for the right reasons.

70010000115909.name: Run from Duck
70010000115909.intro: Run fast… the Duck is already around here.
70010000115909.description:
You awaken in a flooded maze. 
Water clings to every step making escape feel hopeless from the start.
With each turn, instinct takes control. 
Movement is no longer a choice — it’s survival. 
There’s no time to hesitate, nowhere to hide, and with no certainty about what awaits beyond the next corner.
One rule defines everything now:
Keep running. Never turn back.
And above all — never let the Duck reach you.

70010000115929.name: Survive Disasters Apocalypse
70010000115929.description:
One second you’re standing safely on solid ground, the next you’re dodging alien ships, lava floods, and the legendary wrath of Tung Tung Tung Sahur and Tralalelo Tralala. Every round brings a new disaster, a new map, and a fresh chance to yell “I totally dodged that!” before flying into oblivion.

Collect survival gear like jetpacks and speed boosts, customize your look with flashy outfits and effects, and prove you’ve got the fastest reflexes this side of the apocalypse. The “Apocalypse” bonus levels crank everything up to 11—expect chaos, laughter, and maybe a few rage respawns.

Whether it’s dodging meteors, escaping floods, or surviving meme-level destruction, one thing’s for sure—this world isn’t ending quietly.

Because in this game, “the floor is lava” isn’t a joke, it’s just Tuesday.

70010000115941.name: Sudoku
70010000115941.description:
Sudoku is a simple and clear number-puzzle game. 
The goal is easy to understand: fill the grid so each row, column, and 3×3 box contains the numbers 1 to 9 with no repeats. No math required, just logic.

Playing Sudoku helps improve focus, memory, and problem-solving skills in a calm and enjoyable way. It’s a quick mental exercise that keeps the brain active and sharp.

This version includes a wide variety of color themes, allowing you to play in the style that feels most comfortable for your eyes.

Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and beneficial for your cognitive health.

70010000115948.name: Cleaner Simulator 2026
70010000115948.intro: Clean the world, level your gear, rise to the top.
70010000115948.description:
Step into the boots of a cleanup specialist on a mission to restore order to a world buried in trash. Start small with basic tools and clear low-level debris, then sell what you collect to upgrade your equipment. Each upgrade unlocks access to tougher, more valuable waste-pushing you deeper into an addictive cycle of clearing, improving, and progressing.

Explore diverse environments overflowing with discarded items, upgrade your cleaning tools through multiple tiers, and discover the thrill of transforming chaos into perfection. Simple to pick up but endlessly satisfying, this game rewards strategy, speed, and clever resource management. Clean smarter, upgrade faster, and prove you're the ultimate master of waste removal!

70010000115950.name: Overpowered 2 - Crux of Fate
70010000115950.intro: Press your luck to its absolute limits as you fight for survival in a deadly monster arena!
70010000115950.description:
Within these walls, your fate rests in the hands of luck. Overpowered 2 - Crux of Fate is a survival shooter where you’ll have to surround yourself with the most powerful weapons you can find in order to fend off relentless waves of enemy monsters! But as you will soon discover, in this arena your luck increases with each failed attempt, and your determination will ultimately be rewarded!

Enter a dark arena where everything is out to kill you. The action ensues in top-down retro pixel art style where you control a lone human combatant, strategically navigating in every direction and around columns to keep incoming enemy hordes at a safe distance, but still within striking range. Start by selecting a single weapon, then pick up experience drops to level up and improve gear or choose additional armaments. Collect hearts to recover health, gain temporary speed boosts and more! How long can you hang on?

• Run from enemy hordes while keeping them within range of your selected weaponry!
• Pick up experience boosts from fallen foes and level up on the fly.
• Add new weapons to your growing arsenal, each with unique attacks and effects!
• Focus on strategic movement while your weapons automatically strike nearby enemy monsters.
• Survive 20 menacing waves and escape the arena.
• Increase your luck with each failed attempt, gradually creeping towards your goal with determination!

70010000115956.name: Jigsaw Realms: Villages
70010000115956.description:
Discover charming worlds piece by piece in Jigsaw Realms: Villages, a relaxing jigsaw experience set in beautifully illustrated fantasy and stylized villages. From cozy countryside hamlets to magical towns tucked between hills and rivers, each puzzle invites you to slow down and enjoy the journey.

Play using touch controls or controllers, and switch between them anytime for a smooth experience whether you’re playing handheld or docked. Thanks to the saving system, you can stop at any moment and continue later without losing progress.

Features;
> 30 handcrafted jigsaw levels featuring beautiful villages
> Fantasy and stylized village artwork in a consistent, cozy art style
> Touch controls and controller support, switch anytime
> Save and resume freely whenever you want
> A calm, cozy experience for all ages

70010000115959.name: Jigsaw Realms: Seasons
70010000115959.intro: Can you complete all 30 seasonal realms?
70010000115959.description:
Experience the beauty of the year, one puzzle at a time, in Jigsaw Realms: Seasons. This relaxing jigsaw experience features beautifully illustrated scenes inspired by all four seasons, from blooming spring landscapes and sunlit summer fields to colorful autumn vistas and peaceful winter wonderlands.

The game includes 30 handcrafted levels with each puzzle celebrating a different moment of the seasonal cycle. Play using touch controls or controllers, and switch between them anytime for a seamless experience!

Perfect for short, cozy sessions or longer puzzle-solving moments, Jigsaw Realms: Seasons invites you to relax and enjoy the changing world around you.

Features:
> 30 handcrafted jigsaw levels inspired by all four seasons
> Spring, summer, autumn, and winter scenes in a stylized fantasy art style
> Save and resume freely whenever you want
> A calm, cozy experience for all ages

70010000115965.name: Solo Shift!
70010000115965.intro:
From cash register to fryer—you've got to manage it all!
Take on waves of customers all by yourself!
70010000115965.description:
Run a convenience store solo in this frantic action game!
Dash around the store handling tasks while customers keep pouring in!
Feel the exhilaration of handling one task after another!

Rush around during peak busy hours!
Time is limited, so think fast and prioritize as you move around the store!
Complete every task, and you just might become a true solo shift master!

[The Work Never Ends!]
Operate the cash register, restock shelves, cook with the fryer, clean, and collect items.
Work efficiently to stay on top of it all!

[Decision-Making is Key!]
Good planning and prioritization make all the difference!
Assess the situation before you act!

[A Different Store Every Stage]
Each stage features a different store layout!
Adapt your strategy to match!

[Score Attack]
Earn stars based on your performance!
Work at maximum efficiency and aim for a perfect 3-star rating!

[2-Player Mode]
Play co-op as a worker and support robot team!
Split up tasks and work together strategically!

70010000115971.name: Offroad Rally Racing
70010000115971.intro: Rally through sun, rain, and night.
70010000115971.description:
Offroad Rally Racing is a fast-paced console racing game where you drive powerful rally cars across clearly marked tracks in different weather conditions, including sunny, rainy, and night races. Each track offers a unique challenge, forcing you to adapt your driving to changing visibility and road grip.

Win races to earn cash, which you can use to unlock and purchase new rally cars. Every victory brings you closer to building a stronger garage and taking on tougher tracks.

With easy-to-learn controls and exciting offroad action, Offroad Rally Racing delivers simple, fun racing focused on skill, speed, and progression.

70010000115993.name: Knight Castle Defender
70010000115993.intro: Defend your castle across 100 thrilling levels! Command unique warriors, use powerful abilities, and stop the orcs.
70010000115993.description:
Command your warriors and stop the orcs and villains from raiding your stronghold. With 100 action-packed levels, 11 unique defensive forces, 3 powerful abilities, and an engaging power-up system, your castle stands ready for the ultimate battle!

Key Features:

Dynamic Battle Mechanics: Engage in strategic, turn-based combat with immersive gameplay.
11 Unique Defenders: Command a variety of fictional warriors, monsters, and magical units.
Castle Customization: Decorate your fortress with flags, elements, 2 castle skins, and 3 unique weapons.
100 Exciting Levels: Progress through a full campaign of increasingly challenging stages.
Achievements & Rewards: Unlock achievements and spin the fortune wheel for powerful bonuses.
Avatar Personalization: Customize your player name and avatar for a unique experience.
Powerful Abilities: Equip 3 distinct abilities per hero and master 4 special powers for combat dominance.

70010000116012.name: Only Tung Tung Sahur UP
70010000116012.intro: Up, up, and never give up!
70010000116012.description:
Only Tung Tung Sahur UP is a chaotic climbing game where your only real enemy is gravity… and your own confidence.

Jump on random objects, weird platforms and totally questionable constructions while trying to reach the very top. Sounds easy? One bad jump — and you’re back down.

This is not a calm journey.
This is a loud addictive climb full of fails, laughs and unexpected moments.

No mercy.
Only Tung Tung.

70010000116025.name: BOMBARDINO CROCODILO vs TUNG TUNG SAHUR
70010000116025.intro: Dodge the meme. Survive the chaos!
70010000116025.description:
Welcome to a place where reality breaks and memes take control.
BOMBARDINO CROCODILO vs TUNG TUNG SAHUR is a chaotic meme game where you play as BOMBARDINO CROCODILO and try to survive in a world full of absurd danger.
Your goal is simple — keep dodging and stay alive while TUNG TUNG SAHUR suddenly appears ahead, turning every moment into a test of reflexes and nerve.
A strange world.
Only BOMBARDINO CROCODILO can escape the chaos.
Nothing here plays fair — especially Tung.

70010000116038.name: Fix & Flip Dream House
70010000116038.description:
Fix & Flip Dream House is interior renovation and design simulator. Step into the shoes of a professional decorator: purchase old properties, clear out the clutter, and transform them into stylish, modern living spaces. Your goal is to completely reinvent the interior by selecting finishing materials, furniture from an extensive catalog. Painting walls, laying floors, and arranging furniture — every decision you make directly impacts the final value of the home.

Key features:

- Full Renovation Cycle: Buy abandoned properties, demolish old partitions, and completely transform the look of the premises.

- Interior Design and Finishing: A vast catalog of materials and furniture allows you to paint walls, hang wallpaper, and arrange elements to your taste.

- A Jack of All Trades: Use and upgrade arsenal of tools to speed up your workflow.

70010000116044.name: Mirrors Of Deception: The Silver Peaks Secret
70010000116044.intro: Step into a world of mystery and deception as you unravel the truth behind Marchand’s murder.
70010000116044.description:
Agatha Hastings came to Silver Peaks for a peaceful getaway, but instead, she walked into a nightmare. 
When Victor Marchand, a wealthy businessman, is found dead in his room, panic spreads through the secluded ski resort. 
A brutal snowstorm has buried all roads under deep drifts of snow, sealing the guests inside. 
No one can leave. No one can arrive. And the killer is among them.

Search through 140 immersive clutter puzzles, hunting for hidden objects in chaotic scenes. 
For the most patient and observant players, 20 additional puzzle challenges await, testing your wit and attention to detail. 
But be warned—every clue you uncover brings you closer to the truth… and closer to the danger lurking in the shadows.

In Mirrors of Deception: The Silver Peaks Secret, nothing is as it seems. 
Can you solve the mystery before the killer strikes again... or will you be next?

70010000116049.name: Duck Battle Royale
70010000116049.description:
