Duck Battle Royale is a chaotic battle royale where the fiercest competitors are ducks. Enter a world full of quirky quacks, encounters, and unpredictable chaos.
Every match is a test of timing, strategy, and sheer luck as you face off against feathered foes. Expect the unexpected, embrace the silliness, and dive into a wildly entertaining showdown. 
Will you outsmart your opponents and rise to the top?
The battlefield waits — and only one will claim victory.

70010000116061.name: Rooster Wars Arena - MFC Combat Battle
70010000116061.description:
Every arena has its story. Every fighter has something to prove.

In a world where pride is louder than the crowd and every clash shakes the ground, the fiercest roosters gather for the legendary Golden Beak Tournament. What begins as a chaotic spectacle quickly turns into a battle of instinct, timing, and pure energy.
Step into a colorful and unpredictable arena where humor meets intensity. Each fighter brings a unique presence, a different rhythm, and a reason to fight — whether for glory, revenge, or simply to dominate.
Every match is fast, explosive, and unforgiving. Rise through the ranks, face stronger opponents, and prove that you belong at the top.

Key Features:
 - Arcade Experience: Fast, dynamic, and easy to jump into
- Unique Fighters: Distinct styles and personalities
- Combo Gameplay: Smooth and satisfying combat flow
- Special Abilities: Powerful moments that change the fight
- Progression System: Unlock and advance through the arena

Only the strongest will dominate the arena. Only the fastest will survive.
Rooster Wars Arena - MFC Combat Battle is a fun, chaotic, and skill-based fighting experience where every battle counts.

70010000116066.name: Minos Trials
70010000116066.description:
Step into the arena of Minos Trials, a 2D puzzle-platformer where brute strength and sharp thinking go hand in hand. Control Minos, a not-so-patient minotaur who solves problems with punches, pushing blocks, filling pits, activating pressure plates, and crushing nosy adventurers who insist on stealing his treasure.

Across 30 fast-paced stages set in elegant gardens and bubbling lava chambers, your goal is always clear: grab the chest, find the key, and open the Stairway Door. Use springs and geysers to reach impossible places, create clever shortcuts, and craft efficient solutions that deliver that satisfying “solved in one go” feeling.

With clean readability, instant restart, and smart challenges without punishment, Minos Trials is perfect for players who love sharp puzzles, optimized routes, and the joy of mastering each level with style. Think fast, hit hard, and prove that no one enters Minos’ labyrinth without permission.

70010000116078.name: Piggy's Farm
70010000116078.description:
Get ready for a relaxing and charming puzzle where every move matters and every solution brings that satisfying sense of accomplishment. You take control of a dedicated farmer pig on a mission to organize carrots and radishes into their correct planting spots.

Inspired by classic logic games, it transforms simplicity into a clever challenge. Push, test paths, undo mistakes when needed, and discover the best way to organize each scenario without pressure or time limits.

Explore two delightful environments, the Farm and the Greenhouse, each with unique obstacles that require planning and strategy. With 30 carefully designed levels, the game offers short and satisfying challenges, perfect for players who enjoy calm thinking and creative problem solving.

Plan each move, refine your strategy, and enjoy the moment when everything falls perfectly into place.

70010000116084.name: Do You Really Know?
70010000116084.intro: Do You Really Know? Climb the Tower of Knowledge
70010000116084.description:
Get your brain ready and sharpen your curiosity in Do You Really Know?, a charming quiz game where every correct answer is a step toward the top of the Owls’ Tower of Knowledge. It starts easy, but don’t be fooled. The higher you climb, the tougher the questions become.

With each streak of correct answers, you advance through the tower’s floors and earn points to exchange for helpful power-ups. They give you that extra push when challenges get tricky and can make all the difference at critical moments. Made a mistake? No problem. You return to the preparation area, take a breath, and try again, now a little wiser.

With cute visuals, a relaxed atmosphere, and questions that test general knowledge without pressure, Do You Really Know? is perfect for players who enjoy smart quizzes, quick sessions, and the satisfying feeling of learning while playing.

70010000116091.name: Forester Simulator 2026: Mushroom Hunting
70010000116091.intro: Harvest. Sell. Upgrade. Become the ultimate mushroom hunter.
70010000116091.description:
This is a relaxing simulation experience where forest exploration, resource gathering, and steady progression come together in a calm and rewarding gameplay loop.

Step into the role of a forest forager and mushroom hunter. Explore peaceful woodland environments, search for valuable mushrooms, and carefully harvest them using your tools. Every mushroom collected contributes to your progression and helps you improve your efficiency.

Sell the mushrooms you gather and reinvest your earnings into upgrading your equipment. Unlock and improve knives, scythes, and sickles to increase harvesting speed and effectiveness. Better tools allow you to collect more, earn more, and progress faster.

There are no timers, no pressure, and no complex mechanics - only a clear and satisfying loop focused on collection, selling, and upgrades. This makes the experience ideal for players who enjoy casual and relaxing simulator games.

70010000116093.name: Mine Breaker Simulator 2026
70010000116093.description:
Mine Breaker Simulator 2026 is a relaxing and addictive mining simulation game where every broken block brings you closer to building your ultimate mining empire.

Start with simple tools and break through layers of stone, ore, and valuable minerals. Collect resources, sell them for profit, and upgrade your equipment to mine faster, deeper, and more efficiently. The deeper you go, the more valuable the rewards - but also the tougher the terrain.

Designed for players who love simulators, idle-style progression, and satisfying gameplay loops, Mine Breaker Simulator 2026 offers a calm yet rewarding experience. Whether you play for a few minutes or long sessions, progress is always meaningful.

Key Features:

- Addictive block-breaking mining gameplay
- Collect ores, minerals, and rare resources
- Upgrade tools and improve mining speed
- Sell resources and expand your progress
- Simple controls, smooth performance
- Perfect for handheld and docked play
- Relaxing sandbox-style simulator experience

Mine at your own pace, enjoy the satisfying destruction, and turn simple digging into a powerful mining operation.

70010000116095.name: PUPU's Adventure Park
70010000116095.intro: Run a fantasy theme park where heroes get to play adventurer!
70010000116095.description:
Manage an Adventure Park
 Build all kinds of facilities, such as weapon shops, general stores, and tailor shops, then assign the right Pupus to run them. The harder the heroes “adventure” in your park, the more resources you earn, allowing you to keep expanding your very own adventure park.

Raise the Pupu Clan
 As your park continues to grow, you’ll need more reliable workers. Breed new Pupus through the Spring of Life, build homes for them, and make cookies and cakes to keep them fed—yes, they absolutely love sweets! Of course, you’ll also need to take care of their little moods from time to time.

Unlock Facilities and Blueprints
 From basic shops to special NPCs like bards, merchants, and bounty hunters, keep unlocking blueprints to expand what your park can do. As construction goes on, you may even stumble upon the surprising story hidden behind this adventure park.

Post Adventure Commissions
 Post all kinds of tasks on the commission board to attract different types of heroes. Design your tasks wisely to maximize park revenue and obtain key resources such as rare items and hero essence, which can be used to upgrade and expand your park.

70010000116120.name: Arcade Archives PLUMP POP
70010000116120.intro: Let's all work together as a family!
70010000116120.description:
"PLUMP POP" is an action game released by TAITO in 1987.
The protagonists are a family of PLUMP ANIMALS. The parents control a trampoline to launch their child into the air and defeat enemies above.
With two-player simultaneous play, it’s a fun experience where two families work together to clear the stages!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000116147.name: Mirrors Of Deception: The Poisoned Legacy
70010000116147.intro: Another murder mystery investigated by Agatha Hastings!
70010000116147.description:
Agatha Hastings thought she was leaving the chaos behind when she accepted an invitation to the Thompson estate. 
But the moment she stepped through the door, that illusion shattered, she'd walked right into a murder investigation. 

Behind every polite conversation lurked suspicion. Inheritance, old grudges, secrets kept for generations—none of it added up. And Agatha couldn't ignore the feeling that someone was lying.

As she digs deeper into the family's tangled history, it becomes clear that Charles Thompson didn't die by chance. 
The truth is buried in cluttered rooms and overlooked details, in strained glances and half-spoken words. 
Across 140 immersive clutter levels and 20 bonus puzzle challenges, every hidden object you uncover pulls you further into a mystery that refuses to stay hidden.
Solving the case will take patience, sharp eyes, and a willingness to question everything—and everyone.

- Unravel a chilling murder mystery in the Thompson mansion!
- 140 thrilling "clutter" puzzles to challenge your mind!
- Exclusive bonus: 20 extra puzzles for keen detectives!
- Enjoy relaxing sounds and music masterpieces!
- Every clue brings you closer to the truth... or danger!

70010000116160.name: Go! Go! Mister Chickums
70010000116160.description:
Oh no! That sneaky Grabbo has stolen all of Mister Chickums' precious eggs! This misdeed cannot remain unpunished: Get out there and help the poor chick to regain his rightful property and give the culprit a well-deserved spanking!

And if you ever get stuck, invite your best friend to play the role of Fritz, Mister Chickums' BFF, to assist you in the hunt for the lost eggs!

CLASSIC ARCADE ACTION!
Go! Go! Mister Chickums is a fun, classic single-screen platformer, inspired by arcade hits of the 80s. The game can be played either in single player mode, or in local couch co-op with 2 players simultaneously.

SO MUCH TO DO, SO LITTLE TIME!
Jump and run through 100 lovingly designed screens and collect the stolen eggs before the clock runs out. Collect countless bonus items and take advantage of a variety of secret bonus mechanics to ensure you always have enough extra lives up your sleeve. Finish off the numerous enemies with their very own challenges and tactics and then kick the evil Grabbo's bottom to save the day!

QUITE SOME FEATURES FOR SUCH A SMALL CHICK!
- Hours of fun in solo or two-player couch coop mode
- 100 challenging levels, each with a unique design
- A large variety of different enemies with unique behaviours
- Countless secret bonus mechanics
- Vibration feedback support
…and an amazing original soundtrack by Zane Little!

70010000116166.name: CRYZON part3
70010000116166.intro:
Get the crystals!!
Play in split-screen multiplayer with 1-4 players!
30 stages! Normal and Hard difficulty!
70010000116166.description:
The objective is to collect the crystals located on the stage by utilizing jumps and dashes.
The stage is a 3D space with height, width, and depth. There is gravity, and the player controls their character by moving forward, backward, left, and right, and jumping to move vertically, aiming for the crystals.

Features
• Collect the crystal to clear the stage!
• 30 stages in total!
• Difficulty levels can be selected; Normal mode is relatively easy to clear, while Hard mode is extremely difficult.
• Collect coins to make crystals appear!
• Up to 4 players can play in split-screen mode!
• Use items to power up your abilities!
• Defeat enemies!
• There is a sword as a weapon!
• Use dodge actions to move around!
• Defend with a shield.

Multiplayer
• Cooperate with everyone to collect coins!
• Cooperate with everyone to defeat enemies!
• Be the first to get the crystal!

70010000116173.name: Jigsaw Realms: Lost Isles
70010000116173.intro: Can you uncover and complete all 30 lost isles?
70010000116173.description:
Set sail for mystery and beauty in Jigsaw Realms: Lost Isles, a relaxing jigsaw experience set across enchanting, long-forgotten islands. Explore tropical shores, hidden ruins, misty cliffs, and magical island realms!

The game features 30 handcrafted levels, each depicting a unique island scene filled with atmosphere and wonder. Play using touch controls or controllers!  With the built-in saving system, you can stop whenever you want and continue later without losing progress.

Designed for both short sessions and extended play, Jigsaw Realms: Lost Isles is perfect for relaxing on the go or unwinding at home.

Features:
> 30 handcrafted jigsaw levels set across mysterious islands
> Fantasy and stylized island artwork, from tropical beaches to ancient ruins
> Touch controls and controller support, switch anytime
> Save and resume freely whenever you want
> A calm, cozy experience for all ages

70010000116176.name: Cards lie
70010000116176.intro: Unmask the demons. Trust no one. You’ve gathered the entire village for a midnight ritual. Among them hide creatures of pure evil — demons disguised as villagers.
70010000116176.description:
Cards Lie is a single-player social deduction experience inspired by timeless games of bluff and betrayal — reimagined in a gothic, Burton-esque world. Each card represents a villager or a demon. Flip, listen, and judge who tells the truth… or who’s leading you straight to hell.

Features

• • 75 beautifully hand made illustrated cards — villagers, demons, and mysterious clues.


• • Procedural scenarios — no two rituals are the same.

• • Lies that evolve — demons adapt their deceit every round.

• • Stylized art direction — gothic charm inspired by Tim Burton and medieval engravings.

• • Atmospheric soundtrack — haunting choirs and dark ambient tones.

• • Easy to learn, hard to master — uncover patterns, analyze logic, and trust your instincts.



Gameplay Loop

1. → Gather your village.

2. → Flip a card and reveal a phrase — truth or lie.

3. → Use logic and intuition to eliminate the demons.

4. → One mistake… and the village falls to darkness.

“Not every smile is innocent.”

Will you see through the lies?

70010000116194.name: Arcade Archives COMBAT SCHOOL
70010000116194.description:
"COMBAT SCHOOL" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1987.
Join a prestigious military academy as a cadet and tackle brutal training like shooting and combat under a terrifying instructor.
Only those who survive these trials to claim the glory of graduation can face the next battle as a hero. Well, can you make it to the end?!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000116200.name: Rope-Kun Adventure
70010000116200.intro:
The rope's potential has no limits!
Join Rope-kun and conquer the many challenges that await!
70010000116200.description:
Rope-Kun Adventure is a top-down puzzle-action game.
Unleash the full potential of the rope and work with Rope-kun to overcome various challenges!

＊Features＊
・Unique gameplay system of ""rope action""!
・Simple, intuitive controls that anyone can pick up!
・Tons of brain-teasing puzzle gimmicks!
・Fun battles with wacky enemy characters!

＊Rope Handling＊
The possibilities of ropes are endless!
Here are just a few:

1. Pull
Connect Rope-kun to objects and drag them around!

2. Bounce
Use the rope to bounce off rolling balls!

3. Bind
Tie up enemies with the rope to defeat them!

70010000116211.name: Arcade Archives FINAL LAP
70010000116211.intro: Bet everything on the final lap!
70010000116211.description:
"FINAL LAP" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1987.
1987 marked the dawn of the F1 boom in Japan. Set against the backdrop of that era, this title portrays the raw power of racing machines and the stoic world of professional competition.
Experience nail-biting, high-speed battles set on the legendary circuit as it was back then. Push yourself to the absolute limit where every tenth of a second counts—and give it everything you've got!

Note: This title is for single-player only. References to "通信機能搭載(Multi-Player Linkage)" shown during the game are included as a visual element to faithfully recreate the atmosphere of the original arcade version.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000116227.name: The Lost Block
70010000116227.intro: A fun adventure where three friends save Cubilandia with imagination, friendship and surprises.
70010000116227.description:
Summary:

A humorous and fantastical block-building narrative adventure where Alex, Leo, and the adorable slime Glup travel through magical and chaotic worlds to collect legendary fragments, save Cubilandia from chaos, and discover that creativity, friendship, and learning from mistakes are the key to every great adventure.

Game Features:

Guided narrative adventure, ideal for young children.

Simple challenges integrated into the story.

Educational messages: friendship, cooperation, and accepting mistakes.

Encourages imagination and curiosity.

Safe and positive experience, also designed for parents.

Simple challenges integrated into the story.

70010000116240.name: Aooni2
70010000116240.intro:
[A Double Dose of Blue Terror in an Abandoned, Rain-Slicked School]
The latest installment in the legendary horror franchise, A
70010000116240.description:
Uncover the mystery while fleeing for your life! A pulse-pounding puzzle-horror action-adventure!
This time, the stage is set in a school, featuring two massive, star-studded scenarios!

■ Aooni 2
Years ago, a school was abruptly shuttered, left to rot.
Looking for a thrill, Hiroshi, Takuro, Takeshi, and Mika break in for a test of courage—
only to blackout and wake up trapped inside a makeshift prison cell...
To their surprise, they are joined by their teacher, who had spotted them sneaking in and followed them inside...

Will they find a way to escape this desolate school alive?!

● The classic Speed Mode returns with a maddening new option: "17x Speed"!
Customize your challenge by choosing any multiplier from 2x all the way up to 17x!
Push your reflexes to the absolute limit!


■ Brand-New Scenario: Aooni -Seaside School-
Hiroshi and the gang head to the coast for their summer seaside school trip.
Driven by the classic summer urge for adventure after hearing rumors of a monster lurking in an abandoned school near their lodge, they decide to sneak inside the school after dark...

Mysterious silhouettes, school chimes echoing through empty hallways...
And a terrifying horde of never-before-seen, mutated monsters...

What is the dark truth behind the incident that once shook this school?
Separated from the group, Hiroshi begins his desperate search to find his friends.

● Chart your own path to survival!
Conquer four distinct stages in any order you choose!
The difficulty scales depending on the path you take.
 Find your optimal route and turn the odds in your favor!

● A diverse lineup of unique Aooni awaits!!
Encounter a multitude of brand-new Aooni species!
Could some of these monstrosities even take the form of twisted sea creatures...?!

70010000116247.name: The Fox's Way Home – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000116247.intro:
Dancing fox shrine maiden!
A slightly sexy Apparition Find game
70010000116247.description:
The game is very simple!
First, watch the dance performed by the Fox Shrine Maiden carefully and memorize it well.
Be sure not to get distracted by her sexy allure and miss any part of the dance.

How to Play
To return to your original world, you must witness all the rituals performed by the Fox Shrine Maiden.
Sometimes, apparitions called "mononoke" will try to deceive you by taking on a form very similar to the Fox Shrine Maiden and tempt you.

Stay strong, watch the rituals carefully, and don’t get enchanted by the seductive fox dance, so you can spot the "mononoke"!

"One! If you believe it is my real self, call upon my name!"
"Two! If you think it to be an impostor, see through the deception at once!"
"Know that if you err in either, the ritual fails immediately!"

If you find a difference from the initial dance, press the "Fake".
If you don't find anything suspicious, watch the dance untill the end or press the "Real".
Light all 8 lanterns to return to the world you came from!

Apparition Encyclopedia
The various forms of the "mononoke" you have exposed can be recorded in an encyclopedia.
Repeat the rituals and create your very own captivating "Apparition Encyclopedia"!


<Cast>
The Fox Shrine Maiden (CV: Maaya Uchida)

70010000116251.name: Task Force Ranger - Lead the way!
70010000116251.intro: Strike back against global terror and lead the fight in modern combat zones.
70010000116251.description:
Task Force Ranger – Lead the Way! drops you into modern combat operations against organized terrorist forces in the Middle East.

As part of an elite special operations unit, you hunt down high-value targets, dismantle enemy networks, and strike back in hostile territory. Expect brutal firefights across urban zones, underground facilities, and rugged terrain.

Use a modern arsenal of assault rifles, machine guns, sniper rifles, and pistols to complete your missions and survive overwhelming enemy resistance.

Beyond the campaign, face endless enemies in a horde-based survival mode. Earn money for every wave you survive and upgrade your weapons and gear to stay in the fight.

Lead the way. Eliminate the threat.

70010000116253.name: Slots & Daggers
70010000116253.description:
After my last game SUMMERHOUSE, I wanted to make something radically different. Still small, but faster, with numbers, fights and goblins!

The result is SLOTS & DAGGERS, a strange little blend of slot machine and fantasy RPG. 

To make this game I combined a lot of things I deeply love – weird fantasy worlds, crude drawings of strange little guys, old school crunchy hiphop drum machines and addictive arcade games that go “PLING PLING PLING” as they spit out little coins – with classic roguelike mechanics.

The features of this game are: 

Fun slot machine

Weird fantasy world

4-8 hour campaign

Crude drawings of strange little guys

Retro visuals

Crunchy hip hop drum machines

‘Egg arena’ high score mode for the truly determined

Addictive arcade gameplay that goes “pling” a lot

Numbers! Fights! Goblins!

As with SUMMERHOUSE, please keep in mind this game is a solo project - small, focused, and made with care. It’s meant to be short and sweet and doesn’t have the amount of content as games built by bigger teams over years, but I think it’s a fair deal! 

I hope you have a good time with SLOTS & DAGGERS <3

Cheers, 

Friedemann

70010000116263.name: Guts 'n Grunts Jr.
70010000116263.intro: Play a missing classic from the genesis of the 16-bit era. Roll like a hedgehog!
70010000116263.description:
AUG 12, 2045. The Technate has ruled for 15 years. Its robotic army, Slaughterhouse AI, roams the Earth in search of all processable flesh. Pigs everywhere remain in hiding.

One small boar takes matters into his own hands. He is unusually fast and armed with a blaster. His name is Gunnar Harsvin. His message: the pigs will fight for their lives. Gunnar must destroy the machines of the evil technocracy and rescue his fellow pigs.

Play a missing classic from the genesis of the 16-bit era. Roll like a hedgehog! Shoot like a soldier!

70010000116265.name: Viking Farm
70010000116265.intro: Survive in the Nordic lands, grow crops, raise animals, produce goods, and prosper.
70010000116265.description:
Choose a character and manage the daily life of a Viking. Plant and harvest a variety of crops, feed your animals, and sell livestock or loot to expand and improve your farm.

Gather resources to grow. Mine gold, chop trees for wood, and use a pickaxe to collect stone. Manage your production carefully and keep your character well-fed to stay strong on your journey.

In addition to raising and caring for animals such as chickens, horses, sheep, pigs, and cows, you will also encounter creatures from Norse mythology, including the horse Sleipnir, the stag Eikthyrnir, the wolf Fenrir, and the world serpent Jörmungandr. In your fields, grow carrots, mushrooms, corn, turnips, cabbage, and wheat to keep your farm productive.

70010000116271.name: Letters to Arralla
70010000116271.intro: Deliver mail on a relaxing summer island! Each parcel is a puzzle - explore Arralla to find where they go. Curious? Peek inside the mail and help townsfolk with their problems!
70010000116271.description:
The best part of delivering mail? You can open every single letter and look through everyone’s business! Whilst in the real world this is a crime, on Arralla Isle it’s perfectly acceptable, and even encouraged!

At the Arralla Isle Deliberry service, you'll have to solve where each letter goes through pictograms drawn on each envelope - and they're not always obvious!

Learn of the island residents' interpersonal problems through reading their mail - they will need your help to resolve them! Meet big booty cutie fruits like grouchy glassblowers, silly scientists, and deliver seriously creepy letters to an ominous house on a hill...

On Arralla Isle, there’s no rush. The pace is slow, like a lazy summer day, so you can relax while you play. Exploration is a treat in this beautiful Australian landscape.

Snap photos, kick over chessboard pieces, read about Arralla Isle's history, throw stuff, discover secrets. The island is your oyster. You can even call your mum!

There's plenty to do as a mail delivery turnip on Arralla Isle!

70010000116287.name: Modern Attack
70010000116287.intro: A modern warfare FPS game where you become a member of an elite special forces unit and engage in extreme visuals created with a next-generation engine!
70010000116287.description:
Uncontrollable provocations, unforeseen all-out wars.
In <Modern Attack>, you face advanced threats crossing borders from the perspective of the world's best operators, and are deployed in an overwhelming operation that will change the paradigm of modern warfare.

The operation site is an isolated fortress on the front lines of the Middle East. It's a high-risk zone with no support or retreat.
In this constantly changing battlefield environment, your tactics are the only key to survival.
Participate in operations that cross the line of fire.

■ Stunning Visuals
Feel the air of the battlefield on your skin. Extreme graphics, perfectly calculated down to the smallest detail of light and shadow, forcefully summon you into the heart of modern warfare.

■ A vast battlefield that stretches beyond the horizon becomes your stage.
Cultivate your own path across the vast field and engage in free-flowing engagements that will change the course of battle.

■ Break through the limitations of the battlefield with powerful tactical mobility equipment.
Sprint across vast expanses to outmaneuver your enemies, and seize key objectives faster than anyone else to shake up the battlefield.

■ Perfect Team, Overwhelming Victory. Perfect your tactics with the unique equipment of Assault, Engineer, Support, and Recon.
Exciting cooperative action begins as you team up to achieve goals impossible alone.

■ Occupy, Collapse, or Exterminate.
Explore overwhelmingly large-scale engagements across three iconic modes. With the realistic physics of a next-generation engine, break through enemy defenses and rise to the top of the battlefield.

Synopsis
A massive, unmarked industrial complex, "Sector Delta," has been spotted on the front lines of the Middle East. This is a resource fortress established by "Onyx," a multinational corporation intent on dominating the global rare earths market.
To prevent the new materials they are refining from being leaked as key components for next-generation nuclear warheads, an elite special operations team is ordered to conduct an operation. You become an elite special forces agent and embark on the most dangerous operation ever undertaken.

Dive into the thrill of an overwhelming battlefield.
Your comrades, the most stalwart shields that will pierce through the fire and clear a path for you, await your deployment.
Become the final piece that will turn an impossible mission into victory.

70010000116295.name: EGGCONSOLE SUPER TRITORN MSX2
70010000116295.intro: The brave warrior Tritorn rises to bring peace back to the Isle of Luwanda. A celebrated Action RPG classic from the early era of PC gaming!
70010000116295.description:
Released by SEIN SOFT in 1986, this side-view Action Role-Playing Game (Action RPG). Players control the hero Tritorn, battling numerous monsters and embarking on an adventure to restore peace to Luwanda Island, which is dominated by Pay Balusa.

Tritorn fights primarily using jumps and his sword. While the core strategy involves predicting enemy movements and quickly closing in, an advanced technique exists: sword strikes during a jump deal double damage! As Tritorn grows, he can learn magic that instantly erases or freezes enemies. Use these actively when surrounded.

Though it is an Action RPG, simple enemy defeat is not the only path to progression. The game includes puzzle-solving elements, such as obtaining specific items by defeating enemies consecutively. These well-incorporated elements prevent monotony, allowing for a deeply engaging experience.

With fast-paced, skill-based action, well-integrated puzzle elements, three types of magic to learn as you level up, and battles against giant bosses, this masterpiece is highly encouraged for all gamers, not just Action RPG fans.

 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000116305.name: EGGCONSOLE SUPER COOKS MSX2
70010000116305.intro: Inheriting the gameplay of 'Shin Maou Golvellius' but set in a unique world. Now, time to embark on your culinary quest!?
70010000116305.description:
This title is an action role-playing game originally included in Disc Station SP No. 2, released by Compile in 1989.

The game features a rather unique premise: the protagonist, Kelesis, sets out on a journey of culinary training (an adventure) to gain approval to marry a young lady. It covers all the classic elements expected of an action RPG from this era, including switching between top-down and side-scrolling views depending on the scene, as well as battling massive boss characters.

Notably, this game is a parody of Shin Maou Golvellius (True Demon King Golvellius), so fans of that series should feel right at home. While the quirky presentation—typical of Compile—gives this title a lighter tone than the original, it remains a thoroughly enjoyable and solid action RPG.
 

 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000116310.name: Hentai Balls 3D: Sexy Girls
70010000116310.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000116310.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000116316.name: Hentai Demon's Lullaby
70010000116316.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000116316.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000116322.name: Hentai Succubus Serenade
70010000116322.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000116322.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000116328.name: Bun Buns
70010000116328.intro: Don’t let your buns hop out the basket! Drop, merge, and stack your pastries to bake the biggest, most delicious treat!
70010000116328.description:
Get ready to bake your heart out! Combine fluffy buns, watch them grow into mouth-watering pastries, and push your skills to the limit in this physics-based puzzle challenge.

Use clever power-ups to escape sticky situations and keep burnt dough under control. Timing and placement are everything! One wrong move, and your perfect bake could crumble!

Travel through charming bakeries, each bringing new twists and challenges to master. How big can your ultimate bun get?

Features:
- Online leaderboards to show off your skills!
- Co-op mode to bake together with friends!
- 2 maps with unique basket shapes
- Handy power-ups to save your run!
- Fully customizable baker with cute outfits
- A warm and cozy aesthetic

Bake yourself a fresh high score!

70010000116337.name: Elf Girls
70010000116337.intro: A puzzle game featuring many cute and mysterious elf girls is here!
70010000116337.description:
Collect pieces of beautiful and adorable elves to complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Once completed, high-resolution elves will be added to your gallery ♪
=====================
We support game streamers!
No permission is required to stream this game.

70010000116381.name: Elementallis
70010000116381.intro: Top-down action-adventure with elemental magic gameplay. Guided by guilt, you embark on a journey to restore the elements in a dying world.
70010000116381.description:
Top-down action-adventure with elemental magic gameplay. Guided by guilt, you embark on a journey to restore the elements in a dying world. Harness and master elemental powers to fight enemies, solve puzzles, and explore a vast world filled with ancient temples.

Amend your actions. Restore the Elements!

The Elements have gone wild and the world is now in danger. Driven by guilt, you embark on a journey to restore them all and conquer the temples where each Element resides. Solve puzzles, fight foes and find secrets using the Elements you've gathered.

Features:

Real-Time Combat
Fight enemies using the Elements, alongside your sword and shield. Combine Fire, Water, Electricity, and more to exploit their weaknesses and overcome tough encounters.

Challenging Temples
Prove your worth in the 8 unique temples, full of puzzles, secrets, dangerous foes and fun boss battles.

Explore and Discover
Travel and explore the 8 unique biomes. They are full of secrets, upgrades and inhabitants in need of your help.

Elemental Progression
Restore the Elements and unlock their abilities to open up new locations, solve puzzles and access previously inaccessible areas.

Overcome guilt
Experience a story of self-discovery and the journey to heal a broken world and a broken self.

70010000116386.name: BUTTON PRISON
70010000116386.intro:
When I awoke, I found myself surrounded by sparse furniture, mannequins, and countless buttons!
Can I safely escape this room!?
70010000116386.description:
A new-style horror game where pressing buttons advances the story.
Rely on your memory to press the specified buttons.
Avoid pressing unnecessary buttons—something terrible might happen.

This game challenges you to recall “Which button was that?” as you gather designated items to escape.
Some buttons are designed to startle players; pressing them too often will decrease your sanity level.

70010000116395.name: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 1
70010000116395.intro: Put your detective skills to the test in a thrilling solitaire mystery!
70010000116395.description:
Solitaire Crime Stories is an exciting solitaire-investigation game where you take on the roles of journalist Lana Whitt and sheriff's assistant Bill Maite to investigate crimes in the sunny little town of Springdale. 
Meet with the town’s people and hear some harrowing stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat! 
Complete fun Solitaire challenges, investigate crimes, and make the criminals come clean!

- Colorful and intuitive solitaire challenges
- Finish compelling quests
- Solve hundreds of solitaire levels
- Crack the case and catch the killer

70010000116406.name: Sparkle & Umbra
70010000116406.intro: Light meets gravity, and perfection starts to fall apart.
70010000116406.description:
This story follows the transformation of the city of Aeros, where a forced partnership between a teacher of light and a gravity expert leads to the discovery that their world’s perfection is actually a façade of control and manipulation. As the protagonists move beyond their differences, they must choose between maintaining an artificial order or embracing a painful truth that threatens to destroy their old loyalties. Ultimately, the tale explores how true stability isn’t born from imposed purity, but from accepting duality and the honest coexistence of opposites.
An interactive storybook experience. A linear narrative adventure, perfect for young readers to enjoy a captivating story at their own pace.

70010000116443.name: Dominoes Colors
70010000116443.intro: Dominoes Colors It is a puzzle relaxing game where you need to mix colors when put each piece on board.
70010000116443.description:
Dominoes Colors

It is a puzzle relaxing game with 30 stages.You need to mix colors when put each piece on board. The mix result is the next step to solve the puzzle. The piece with a chequered flag is the last piece, your last mix of colors needs to be equal of it.

Colors

The game contains 16 different colors, explore your knowledge about colors to discover what will be the next mix result. The "white piece" and "black piece" are special colors, try any kind of combinations with these pieces to identify theirs secrets.

Pieces

Each piece has its own "color side" and "blank side", the blank side will be another color after the colored piece side in your "hand" combine with a colored piece in "board".
Win Condition

The last piece is signaled by a chequered flag, to win you must combine the colors gradually until arrives the last piece.

Coins and Stars

When you finish a stage you will be rewarded with coins and stars according with the quantities of pieces utilized, so if you discovered new ways to complete the same stage, return and unlock all your rewards.

Obstacles and Powerups

According your advance in game, you will notice some obstacles, each one has its own behaviour and complexity. But to help and ease your path, you will can buy powerups with the coins earned in each stage.

70010000116445.name: PancitoMerge
70010000116445.intro: Drop, stack, and merge colorful pan dulce into bigger, tastier treats in this cozy game! Enjoy our charming visuals and simple gameplay!
70010000116445.description:
Step into a warm, flour-dusted world where pan dulce takes center stage. Merge adorable conchas, cuernitos, and more to discover delicious new treats in this whimsical puzzle game. With a dash of strategy and a sprinkle of tradition, PancitoMerge blends the joy of classic falling block games with the vibrant spirit of a neighborhood panadería. 

Great for cozy breaks or chasing a high-score, no baking skills required!

The goal is simple: merge matching breads to create higher-level ones, aiming for the highest score possible while unlocking every type of bread in a single run. But be careful, the game ends if the breads stack up to the top of the bag!

A Tasty Twist: Every 5 drops, a customer arrives with a specific bread request. Fulfill their order by clicking/tapping on the requested bread in the bag.

PancitoMerge is a love letter to Mexican culture and the joy of pan dulce. From colorful conchas to buttery cuernitos, each bread is inspired by real treats found in local bakeries, celebrating the warmth, tradition, and creativity of Mexican baking.

70010000116455.name: 1 CatLine
70010000116455.intro: Master puzzling stages with the help of your 2D feline companion!
70010000116455.description:
Welcome to 1 CatLine, a brainteasing precision platformer where you must guide a daring and adventurous heroine through single-screen challenges, with 50 unique levels spanning a variety of colorful pixel art biomes.

Run and leap through increasingly complex stages, freezing time and shifting perspectives to maneuver your cat friend around the environment to push crates, activate switches or create improvised platforms using its long furry body! Are you clever enough to clear all the challenges?

• Traverse increasingly complex platforming stages.
• Use your feline companion to form improvised platforms and push objects.
• Freeze time mid-air and maneuver your cat buddy to avoid pitfalls.
• Activate switches in the correct order to toggle barriers.
• Enjoy 50 levels of brainteasing retro goodness.

70010000116461.name: Avenue Escape
70010000116461.intro: Bring order to the urban chaos as you solve traffic jams in brainteasing puzzle action!
70010000116461.description:
Are you clever enough to clear the streets? Avenue Escape is a puzzle game that challenges you to direct traffic jams and safely move cars through busy cityscapes! Each of Avenue Escape’s 50 levels features a bustling scene packed with cars, pedestrians and traffic lights. It’s up to you to figure out the perfect sequence to move every vehicle to its destination.

Think ahead, time your moves carefully and avoid accidents as you navigate tricky intersections and unpredictable crosswalks. Try to clear each stage in the fewest lives possible, but don’t worry too much, as levels can be tried as many times as it takes.

• Engage in top-town puzzle gameplay across 50 unique levels!
• Safely direct vehicles to their destinations.
• Think ahead and strategically choose the correct sequence.
• Clear levels using as few “lives” as possible.
• Enjoy casual gameplay and cute graphics.

70010000116467.name: CyberBlocker Complete Edition
70010000116467.intro: Engage in classic arcade style brick-breaking action with a shoot’em up twist!
70010000116467.description:
CyberBlocker Complete Edition is a brick-breaking action puzzler with shoot’em up elements. Maneuver twin ships to ricochet an orb into enemy blocks and clear the battlefield while dodging incoming fire and collecting power-up capsules.

Aim for higher scores as ball speed increases. Keep it in play, combine your reflective ships for an even wider shield and face off against massive bosses across 5 unique stages. Enjoy unlimited replay value and push your skills further in Challenge Mode!

• Effectively control 2 ships at once.
• Break blocks while evading enemy fire and collecting power-ups.
• Strategically combine ships on-the-fly to increase shield size.
• Keep the orb in play as it ricochets around the stage.
• Enjoy old-school arcade gameplay or push your skills in Challenge Mode.

70010000116473.name: Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments
70010000116473.intro: Solve feline-themed hidden object challenges in cute cube-shaped isometric apartments!
70010000116473.description:
Find the hidden kitties around the apartment! Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments is an isometric hidden object game themed around cats and colorful little rooms. Explore unique, adorably decorated cube-shaped bedrooms, kitchens, living rooms, bathrooms and more as you search for dozens of cleverly obscured felines lying around each stage.

By finding all the cats in an apartment, you’ll clear the stage and unlock the next. Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments is calm, casual and therapeutic with a soothing soundtrack to match, making it the perfect “anytime” experience!

• Find the cats hidden in colorful isometric apartments!
• Unlock new rooms of gradually increasing complexity.
• Rotate the apartment rooms to change your viewpoint and avoid obstructions!
• Click on cleverly placed felines to reduce the cat counter to zero.

70010000116493.name: TROX
70010000116493.intro: A psychological horror tale born from desperation.
70010000116493.description:
In the aftermath of the ruined world left behind by World War III, humanity has been pushed to its final limits. With crops gone and animals extinct, survival depends on the government's most feared mandate: the Sustainable Meat Act. Every family must make a "contribution". No exceptions.

Take on the role of Marco, a father trying to protect what remains of his life. What starts as a quiet visit with family gradually turns into a nightmare of suspicion, memory loss, and unspeakable horrors lurking in the darkness. In this first-person, VHS-style experience, every hallway, every whisper, and every flicker of light pulls you deeper into a reality you’re not sure you can trust.

Key features:
• Psychological Horror: Navigate a crumbling world where truth, guilt, and imagination converge.
• Disturbing Atmosphere: An ordinary home becomes the setting for the unimaginable.
• First-Person Immersion: Explore, interact, and uncover the truth through tense, claustrophobic gameplay.
• Choices and Consequences: Your decisions will shape Marco’s fate and determine the cost of your "contribution".

Every contribution has a cost. Are you ready to pay it?

70010000116515.name: Escape game R00M10
70010000116515.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

70010000116521.name: GooNECT√2
70010000116521.intro: Hold Hands, Reach the End with the Power of Friendship in GooNECT√2!
70010000116521.description:
GooNECT√2 is a two-player co-op action-adventure game, and sequel to the Japan exclusive Goonect. 

Set off on a spirited journey through a vibrant 3D world where two players must hold hands the entire time to reach the end! Grab a buddy for a classic couch co-op experience or become besties with an online partner to navigate unlimited, randomly-generated stages across eight difficulty levels.

Put stretchy, rubber-like arms to the test while completing platforming challenges and dodging obstacles that could tear the pair apart. Once players let go of each other’s hands, it’s game over! Overcome towering wooden blocks, giant basketballs, and powerful wind gusts by pulling, launching, or even using each other as a stepping stone.

Reach the goal while perfectly in sync with a friend, or choose to control both characters at once for a solo excursion offline. Aim for a high Bestie Level at the end of each stage, which is calculated based on clear time, number of restarts, and number of hearts collected.

Its predecessor, Goonect, was very popular in Japan, and we hope more people will come to enjoy the thrills of sharing one fate with their gaming partner. GooNECT√2 adds lots of new features to further evolve the game, while maintaining its focus on fun and friendship building.

70010000116571.name: Spa Massage Girls: Love & Relax
70010000116571.intro:
Gentle touches. 
Playful flirting. 
Pure relaxation.
70010000116571.description:
Welcome to a private spa where relaxation isn’t the only thing in the air.

In Spa Massage Girls: Love & Relax, you’ll enjoy soothing massage minigames while getting to know a group of charming girls through lighthearted, flirty conversations. Every interaction brings you closer to unlocking new scenes, reactions, and special moments.

Balance calm hands with smart choices as you learn what each girl enjoys, how she responds to your moves, and when to push… or slow things down.

Relax, connect, and let the atmosphere do the rest.


FEATURES:

● Minigames in the spa: Simple, satisfying gameplay focused on timing, precision, and relaxation.

● Interactive conversations: Choose your answers and discover how each girl reacts to your style.

● Unlockable images and moments: Progress through each route to reveal exclusive content.

● Different personalities: From sweet and shy to confident and teasing, every girl feels unique.

● Multiple outcomes: Your performance and decisions shape each experience.


Can you find the perfect balance between relaxation and romance?

Step into the spa and enjoy the experience at your own pace. 
Are you ready?

70010000116577.name: Spa Massage Boys: Love & Relax
70010000116577.intro:
Strong hands. 
Playful tension. 
Total relaxation.
70010000116577.description:
Welcome to an exclusive spa where relaxation comes with chemistry.

In Spa Massage Boys: Love & Relax, you’ll meet confident, charming guys ready to unwind with you. Enjoy satisfying massage-themed minigames while building attraction through playful conversations and bold choices.

Each guy has his own vibe, from confident and teasing to calm and mysterious. Learn what makes them relax, discover their reactions, and unlock special moments as you progress.

Keep your focus, read the mood, and let the connection grow.


FEATURES:

● Massage-based minigames focused on timing and precision.

● Flirty, choice-driven conversations.

● Unlockable images and exclusive scenes.

● Different personalities and story routes.

● Multiple endings depending on your performance and decisions.


Can you handle the heat behind closed doors?

Step into the spa, take a deep breath… and see where the tension leads.

Are you ready?

70010000116587.name: Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence
70010000116587.description:
William is a young writer in search of his first literary success. He travels to a distant abbey, shrouded in a vow of silence. Among thick stone walls and unspoken secrets, William slowly immerses himself into the life of the abbey and its silent inhabitants.

What begins as a search for inspiration soon turns mysterious, leading William to uncover not just a story to tell, but a secret that was never meant to be discovered.

Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence is a classic 90s-style point & click adventure featuring dark, detailed pixel art, environmental puzzles, and a deep narrative with touches of black humor.

Explore the abbey, solve mysteries using the items you find along the way, and uncover the secrets hidden within its silent walls.

70010000116589.name: Super Sticker Studio - Creative Sticker Book Game for Kids
70010000116589.intro: Unleash your creativity in Super Sticker Studio, the ultimate casual sticker creator and design simulation game for kids, families, and sticker enthusiasts!
70010000116589.description:
Unleash your creativity in Super Sticker Studio, the ultimate casual sticker editor and design game for kids, families, and sticker fans! The perfect sticker book game for kids & toddlers: Drag, drop and customize cute stickers to create magical scenes—from festive Christmas wonderlands with Santa, elves and reindeer to cozy farm animals, construction vehicles, dinosaurs & Jurassic World, knights & castles, space adventures, plants & flowers, Halloween, ocean & beach, sunny farm adventures with animals and tractors. Ideal for personalized digital greeting cards, birthday surprises or holiday wishes for friends and family.
Whether child in fantasy worlds or adult with nostalgia: Layer stickers, add speech bubbles and text for funny comics, experiment with special effect stickers.

Key Features:
+ Endless sticker customization: Theme categories (Christmas, Farm, Construction, Dinosaurs, Knights & Castles, Space, Plants & Flowers, Halloween, Ocean & Beach, Special Effects etc.) with hundreds of vibrant motifs
+ Drag & drop into your scene, then resize, rotate, flip, reorder layers – pro control
+ Creative tools for all ages: Mirror horizontally/vertically, spin clockwise/counter-clockwise, stack elements for depth – turn drag & drop into art
+ Surprise loved ones with custom Christmas, Halloween, birthday cards or comic strips with talking characters
+ Pure imagination: Build comics with speech bubbles, explore fantasy realms or design cozy farmyards
+ No rules – just relaxing fun
+ Great content for fantasy and creativity: Many sticker packs with holidays, animals, dinosaurs, space, knights, construction, Halloween, ocean and surprises

Join the sticker revolution: Create, share and spread joy in Super Sticker Studio – every scene tells a story! Ideal for kids, toddlers and fans of relaxing creative and family games. Boosts creativity and imagination. The perfect kids and toddlers and sticker fan game.

70010000116595.name: Slide Viking: Treasure's Path
70010000116595.description:
In Slide Viking: Treasure’s Path, you step into a charming Viking village filled with clever puzzles and personality. Controlling a fearless Viking, your mission is to push axes onto treasure chests, marking each one before claiming the hidden riches.

With 30 levels of increasing difficulty, the game blends logic and strategy across compact boards full of pixel art details. Every move matters, as the Viking moves tile by tile, requiring careful planning to position the axes correctly without getting trapped in dead ends.

Between wooden tables that act as walls and simple yet deep mechanics, Slide Viking delivers the kind of challenge that invites you to think, test, undo, and try again until the perfect solution appears. If you enjoy Viking themes, classic puzzles, and the satisfaction of seeing everything fall into place, this treasure hunt is for you.

70010000116601.name: Bubble Shot
70010000116601.description:
Bubble Shot delivers classic bubble-popping fun! Aim carefully, match colors, chain pops, and wipe out clusters of bubbles. 

Simple rules, smooth mechanics, and gradually increasing difficulty make it perfect for short sessions and relaxing gameplay.

70010000116607.name: SoulQuest
70010000116607.intro: Carve your path through hordes of enemies, defying the gods to seize the power of Morrigan, Goddess of Death, and retrieve the soul of your beloved!
70010000116607.description:
When her husband was taken by the gods, Alys refused to accept their verdict. With sword in hand, she embarked on a quest to take his soul back, throwing down the gauntlet to the goddess of death, Morrigan. Neither the legions of godly servants nor the gods themselves will stop her wrath. 

 

Welcome to Soul Quest, a hack-and-slash tale of one woman's undying love and boundless grief. Carve through endless hordes of enemies and rip out their very souls. Battle the fates using a deep freeform combat system. Fight the Celtic gods - will you win and complete Alys’ quest? 

Epic story of love conquering death, set in a fantasy world drawing on the rich legacy of Celtic myths and Arthurian legends.

Deep combat system combining a broad variety of attacks, magic abilities, and ultimates, designed to be easy to understand and with plenty of ways to master it as you challenge Morrigan, the goddess of death! 

Non-stop action against hordes of foes, from fodder to cleave apart, to elite foes requiring quick thinking to defeat, and challenging bosses with plenty of aces up their sleeves. 

Plenty of secrets to discover across the vast levels, using Alys' ability to use vertical surfaces for sliding and jumping off. Then turn these skills on the enemy to outmaneuver and outfox them! 

Challenges await veteran players, putting your skills to the test with the highest difficulty levels leaving no room for error!

70010000116617.name: Spot the Spy Guy
70010000116617.intro: Can you find two identical hidden objects?
70010000116617.description: Spy Guy is a brilliant detective who travels around the world looking for hidden clues. This time, he needs your help to find identical pairs! Can you help him?

70010000116623.name: Cats and Seek : Tokyo
70010000116623.intro: The cats have boarded the bus to Tokyo! Are you ready to find them?
70010000116623.description:
Pack your bags for yet another cozy and adorable adventure with the Cats & Seek series! 

This time, we’re off to the heart of Japan’s bustling capital to find cats playing all around the city.

- 500+ hidden cats on 5 unique levels!
- Photo & Paint Mode - to capture and color your scene!
- NEW: Stamp Mode! Collect stamps and use them to compose the perfect cat!
- Adjustable game colours, brightness, and contrast!

70010000116628.name: Dark Town Secrets: Lost Lulu Collector's Edition
70010000116628.intro: When a mysterious letter lands on the desk of private detective Casey Monroe, a strange case begins to unfold.
70010000116628.description:
A desperate plea from Lady Margaret tells of the sudden disappearance of her beloved dog, Lulu. 
At first, it seems like a simple matter of a missing pet. 
But as Casey arrives at the imposing mansion, it becomes clear this is no ordinary investigation. 
Lulu’s past is shrouded in shadows, and Lady Margaret may not be telling the whole truth.

Search for clues in lavish yet haunting locations — from candlelit halls and dusty libraries to forgotten gardens and crypts cloaked in mystery. 
Featuring beautiful artwork, atmospheric music, and a twisted storyline, 
Dark Town Secrets: Lost Lulu delivers the timeless charm of classic hidden object gameplay alongside a variety of challenging puzzles that will test both logic and attentiveness.

Will you be able to save Lulu — and the other dogs — before it’s too late? 
Or will the secrets of Dark Town remain forever buried?

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- An exclusive additional storyline!
- Extra levels to play and mysteries to solve!
- New characters to meet!

70010000116655.name: Anime: Fantasy Uni 2
70010000116655.intro: The second installment of the fantasy puzzle series.
70010000116655.description:
Just like in the first game, you’ll find very simple puzzles and pleasant music. Relax as you assemble beautiful images. 
Fierce barbarians, wise mages, brave paladins, and many other heroines are waiting for you!

70010000116663.name: Tomodachi Life™: Living the Dream
70010000116663.intro: Populate your island with Mii characters—and find out what happens when they all live there together!
70010000116663.description:
Create Mii™ characters based on family, friends, or your own original ideas—there are plenty of personality traits, little quirks, and physical traits to choose from—including some face customization options you haven’t seen before! Go deep into getting every detail just right, or create Miis quickly and easily by answering some simple questions, and then help them explore their likes and dislikes, find relationships, and get up to all sorts of fun. Your Miis are bound to surprise you as they take on a life of their own!

Become the caretaker of an island full of silliness, drama, love, and other surprises

Populate your island with Miis and then pick them up and place them near each other to chat and hang out. Watch your Miis forge unlikely friendships, get into fights, fall in (and out of) love unexpectedly, and so much more as they live their lives! 

Get to know what your Mii characters like as you take care of them. Give them clothes, food, items, and—most importantly—life advice as they deal with all kinds of problems and situations. You’ll also naturally help shape the community as Miis may pick up and start using the words and phrases you teach them.

Build, decorate, and give gifts to make your Miis happy

Shape your landscape! Design your island and place homes, stores, restaurants, and more to supply events and entertainment for your community. Decorate your Mii characters' homes by gifting them furniture, wallpaper, floors, custom-designed interior and exterior decorations, and more—and create pets, food, clothing, and items like books and video games to suit each Mii!

Try the free demo and get an in-game Hamster Costume

Experience creating up to three Mii characters in the eShop demo! Your save data from the demo will carry over to the main game upon purchase, and if you complete the demo you’ll get a Hamster Costume* that you can give to your Mii characters.

70010000116669.name: Xenoblade Chronicles™ X: Definitive Edition – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000116669.intro: Rebuild humanity on the mysterious planet Mira in this action RPG that’s been enhanced for the Nintendo Switch 2 system
70010000116669.description:
The year is 2054. Earth has been destroyed by an intergalactic war between two alien races, and humanity is on the brink of annihilation. A small number of survivors, aboard the USS White Whale, crash land on the vast and untamed planet Mira—and now it falls to you, as a member of BLADE, to help bring humanity back from the edge of extinction...with the aid of powerful giant robots called Skells!

Xenoblade Chronicles™ X: Definitive Edition – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition is an open-world RPG containing not only the updated story elements and other content from the Definitive Edition, but additional optimization for the Nintendo Switch 2 system—including a smoother framerate and 4K resolution* in TV mode .

Take on tough foes in a robust combat system, and pilot powerful giant robots called Skells

Choose from a huge variety of special attacks, skills, and classes in a combat system that’s as deep as you want it to be. Once you’ve proven yourself to BLADE, you’ll earn the right to pilot and personalize your very own Skell—a powerful machine that can fly, transform into a vehicle for fast overland travel, and wield immense strength in combat with customizable weapons and armor.

Gather resources and take on missions to build the community of New Los Angeles

As you go about the reconstruction effort, getting to know the people of New Los Angeles (NLA), you’ll build affinity with your party members and unlock quests for gear and other in-game rewards. Join your choice of military organization within BLADE to take on even more missions—or join squads of up to 32 players from near and far online** in Squad Tasks, Online Missions, and extra-challenging Global Nemesis Battles!

Already have Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack for your Nintendo Switch 2 system! 

If you already have the game for Nintendo Switch, you can purchase the upgrade pack*** separately to enjoy the enhanced resolution and higher frame rate of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

70010000116676.name: The Boba Teashop
70010000116676.description:
The Boba Teashop is a cozy horror game where you own and manage a boba tea shop.

Prepare boba teas, serve customers, and expand your menu to attract more patrons.

You play as Risa, a woman who is tired of corporate life and has decided to chase her dream of opening a boba tea shop.

This is a psychological horror game that builds tension through an eerie atmosphere, unsettling events, and moments of intense scare when you least expect them.

70010000116685.name: Virtual Boy™ – Nintendo Classics
70010000116685.intro: Immerse yourself in the third dimension in classic games with Virtual Boy™ – Nintendo Classics
70010000116685.description:
With a Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack membership*, Nintendo Switch™ 2 and Nintendo Switch™ players can now access a collection of Virtual Boy™ games to play anytime, anywhere! Create suspend points in each game to save your progress, rewind to fix your mistakes, and adjust the controls to suit your preferences as you bash robots in Teleroboxer™, jump between background and foreground in Virtual Boy™ Wario Land™, and more.

The Virtual Boy for Nintendo Switch 2/Nintendo Switch accessory* or the Virtual Boy (Cardboard Model) for Nintendo Switch 2/Nintendo Switch accessory is required to play Virtual Boy – Nintendo Classics. 

Here’s the full list of what’s currently available at launch.
Teleroboxer™
Galactic Pinball™
RED ALARM
GOLF
Virtual Boy™ Wario Land™
3-D TETRIS®
The Mansion of Innsmouth

More games will be released in the future!

70010000116694.name: Skyship Quest Story
70010000116694.intro: Customize your airship and explore the world above the clouds in this sim RPG
70010000116694.description:
Who says ships are only for the water? Why not take a voyage across a sea of clouds instead?

On a little island, floating in the sky, your adventure begins...
Hop on board your shining new airship and see what lies beyond the horizon! Gather your crew and explore regions of the sky where no one has ever been!

You'll discover all kinds of floating islands, from bustling tourist destinations to perilous monster-filled dungeons.
Develop your island, fend off monster attacks, and help your crew with their problems to earn fabulous rewards!

Use the resources you've earned to install new facilities on your ship and help your crew expand their know-how. With a stronger ship, and a more knowledgeable crew, you'll be able to explore islands from even further afield.

What new adventures and encounters await you in the vast blue sky? There's only one way to find out.
It's time to take off!

70010000116700.name: Fowl Damage
70010000116700.description:
Fowl Damage is an atmospheric puzzle platformer where your default jump provides enough fall damage to destroy you. Carefully manage your jumps and falls as you adventure through this chilling, beautiful, and occasionally cute world!

Your adventure will have you escape from the factory, splash through the riverbed, climb the giant trees of the ancient forest, slip your way through the slimy cave and hunt for secret warp zones in each area in an attempt to find a new home for your fragile friend. And all that by only using one button!

KEY FEATURES: 
- Atmospheric gameplay.
- Unique, challenging mechanics, such as ramps that convert your falls into incredible speed boosts or bubbles that can catch (or launch!) you.
- Intense boss fights that will put your platforming and puzzle-solving skills to the test.
- Many secrets to discover!

70010000116720.name: Space Dragons
70010000116720.intro: Choose your spaceship and defeat the alien threat from the Moon
70010000116720.description:
Choose your spaceship and defeat the alien threat coming from the Moon. Fight your way through by crushing, smashing, and blowing up hostile aliens that are taking control of powerful Earth weapons and military technology. Find the entity controlling the threat and make it explode in blood.

Space Dragons is a classic horizontal shoot ’em up game where you can choose different ships with unique characteristics and abilities to destroy tons of invading aliens. Throughout the adventure, you will face powerful bosses and explosive enemies. Get upgrades for your ship, weapons, and more to carve your way through the fleshy and bloody path that awaits you in Space Dragons.

Features:

Local multiplayer

11 fun and complete stages

A large arsenal of weapons awaits you in vast scenarios

Cumulative upgrades each time you finish a stage, allowing different combinations

11 epic and frantic boss encounters

Beautiful hand-drawn and animated pixel art characters and environments

Various enemies with different attacks and transformations

Execute enemies and bosses to gain upgrades and score points

Extremely frantic and explosive gameplay

Each boss has a transformation

70010000116726.name: Red Titans
70010000116726.intro: Face the ultimate threat in a ruthless vertical shoot ’em up
70010000116726.description:
RED TITANS is a single-player vertical shoot ’em up. You must put an end to the threat by creating a strategy with the available resources. You will need great skill since there are no continues, although you will be able to recover lives at certain moments.

You are the best pilot, a survivor. This is your last mission and everything will be decided. But in the middle of the mission, strange ships appear. A greater threat has arrived and the conflict begins to change course. You are no longer fighting for a nation; this is the beginning of something much bigger, and you are the first line of defense without even knowing it.

FEATURES:

6 frantic stages

5 epic bosses at the end of each stage

Beautiful hand-drawn pixel art environments

Retro 3:4 resolution (vertical shoot ’em up)

A challenging path with no continues

70010000116736.name: Call of Beauty
70010000116736.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000116736.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000116743.name: Goat Out Of Hell: Lost Pets
70010000116743.intro: Push the Souls, Save the Little Pets
70010000116743.description:
Who said the underworld cannot have a cute side?

In Goat Out of Hell: Lost Pets, you take on the role of the hardest-working infernal goat in the underworld, tasked with a very unusual mission: guiding the glowing souls of lost pets to their portals of eternal rest. One push at a time, you must lead each soul through tight corridors, ancient ruins, and lava-lit passages without blocking the path or getting stuck in a dead end.

With 30 short and clever stages divided across three personality-filled biomes, each level is a new puzzle at the heart of the afterlife. From the misty shores of the Styx Riverbank to the reddish depths of Tartarus, and the fiery gates of the Outer Gate of Hell, every setting brings fresh challenges and layouts that demand careful planning and solid reasoning.

There is no ticking timer, no attacking enemies, and no draining health bars here. The only danger is logical: push a soul into the wrong place and the perfect solution becomes a small infernal mess. Fortunately, you can use Undo and Restart whenever you like, testing different routes until you find the ideal path.

Cute, challenging, and surprisingly cozy, Goat Out of Hell: Lost Pets is perfect for players who love strategic puzzles, clever challenges, and that delicious satisfaction of seeing every little soul resting peacefully on its portal at the end of the stage.

70010000116751.name: Meme Mayhem
70010000116751.intro: Hurl emojis and battle the internet's biggest stars to rise as a meme master in Meme Mayhem! Collect powerful perks and relics, and enjoy a darkly comic social media story!
70010000116751.description:
Do your roguelite games not have enough memes? Want to fight your social media enemies in nailbiting emoji battles? Log in to the world of Meme Mayhem. Scroll the in-game feed, react to posts, and pick fights with celebrities. Slide into the DMs of characters like Pop Kat, Mars, and Sad Tadpole. Whether you're a selfless idealist or just looking for fortune and fame, you're on your way to the top of the social media food chain.

Features:

Fast-paced, strategic, and thrilling idle RPG combat.

A story with all the humor, sarcasm, and random cruelty of the real internet.

Deeply customizable abilities and attacks enable surprising and diverse builds.

200+ perks and relics to discover!

Simulated social media feeds and DMs for engaging with NPCs to gain special rewards.

Swap emojis in high-stakes idle RPG action

Select perk rewards after each wave to build the perfect attack stack then watch as battles play out automatically. Deal damage by throwing Rocks, steal health with Vampire, catch your enemies on fire with Oil, and more. Snatch victory from the jaws of defeat by deploying a much-needed Ultimate moments before your health dwindles to zero! In the case of defeat, tailor your strategy to suit the challenge and try again!

Collect special perks and relics--and combine them for even more power

Each time you play, you'll select perks and relics that will customize your approach, each with unique advantages and disadvantages. Get an early advantage with Rush perks or use Emergency Heal to gain a late-game rescue. Between rounds of emoji battles, visit the Jezos shop to spend your gold on much-needed upgrades. And even combine relics to form special new ones like the Walking Octopus and Broccoli Devil.

Express yourself and gain rewards with in-game choice events

Red pill or blue pill? What color is The Dress? If a speeding trolley is hurtling towards either Mars or Lizardberg, who will you choose? Make your decisions and receive relic and stat rewards that will help (or hinder) your journey. Choice events add replayability (and chaos) to your quest!

Battle your way through the ranks of the internet

As your power grows, so does the size of your challenges and the status of your enemies. From a lowly troll to the biggest influencers and their armies of followers, fight your way through the ranks of social media users and take on internet icons in a darkly comic satire of politics and culture.

70010000116759.name: Your “Hidden Side” Test
70010000116759.intro: Wanna meet the side of yourself you never knew existed?
70010000116759.description:
“Your Hidden Side” Test is a game where you answer a series of questions by intuitively choosing from four options.

Based on your choices, it reveals your “unexpected personality traits” and “subconscious ways of thinking” that lie within you.

You may not show them on the surface, but your hidden qualities—such as cautiousness, boldness, sensitivity, or a laid-back nature—are presented in a clear and engaging way through the results.

It’s a fun way to reflect on yourself, with moments that make you think, “That’s so true!” or “I didn’t know I had that side!”

Enjoy it on your own at your own pace, or share and compare results with friends or during streams for a lively party-style experience.

Supports button controls, so you can also play in TV mode and tabletop mode.

70010000116768.name: Angeline Era
70010000116768.intro: Explore a secret-filled land in this 3D Action-Adventure, where every surprising level is hidden in plain sight! Travel and fight through a vast, unmarked overworld!
70010000116768.description:
The Angel's mothership, Throne, lays dormant behind a fierce storm. To reach it, unlock its secrets, and usher in the future, you must explore the land of Era and survive its trap-filled ruins, primordial forests, treacherous mountains, mines, towns, and more! 

Follow wandering ex-soldier, Tets Kinoshta, as he overcomes intense battles and hilarious hazards in this tale of betrayal, haunting lore, and fruitless yearning.

Features

"Bump the World!" with intuitive Bumpslash Combat. Walk into enemies to attack - no button needed! Fast-paced action levels AND exploration-and-lore focused levels will test your skills.

A vast world map you can search to find levels and zones. Follow your instincts to chart a flexible path. Go at your own pace — follow your spirit!

Fierce and uniquely designed bosses and enemies that will test your Bumpslash skills. Face vicious and hilarious tricks guarding the Fae's ancient secrets!
