Plenty of levels, each offering glimpses into the Fae, Angels and Humans living together in the country of Era.

Haunting lore, woven from Irish mythology, early Christian philosophy, and Japanese American history.

Mix up combat with subweapons and a gun, and visit towns to shop for items. Beat levels to get Scales and level up!

On average, a first playthrough takes 15-30 hours, depending on how much of the world you want to explore and how fast you play. 

Low-difficulty setting for Beginner Bumpslashers, and nightmarish settings for the deranged!

By Melos Han-Tani and Marina Kittaka.

70010000116774.name: You All Know! Arm Tank Volley
70010000116774.intro:
Punch the net and rocket-jump! Arm Tank volleyball
Physics chaos makes every match totally unpredictable
2-4 player local play wrecks friendships
70010000116774.description:
That legendary "Arm Tank Volley" is coming to Nintendo Switch™!

The rules are simple: just spike the ball into your opponent's court!
...but in practice, physics-driven chaos turns every match into total pandemonium.

■ Arm Tanks play volleyball
Take control of an Arm Tank and dive into volleyball-style battles.
The controls are simple - jump, move left/right, and swing your arm to hit the ball - but nothing ever goes as planned, and that's what makes it hilarious.
Smash too hard and fly out of bounds, punch the net and go flying, invade the opponent's court... you've never seen volleyball like this.

■ Five game modes to master
Versus, Time Attack, Endless, Rally, and Custom - five modes in one package.
Choose from 3 CPU difficulty levels and dive in whether you've got five minutes or five hours to spare.

■ Team battles for up to 4 players
2-on-2 team matches are supported too. Grab your controllers and get up to 4 players hyped.
Commentary, streaming, and clips are all welcome!

Now, swing that arm! Spike that ball!

70010000116791.name: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 2
70010000116791.intro: The peaceful town of Springdale is rocked by murder.
70010000116791.description:
The head of a charitable foundation is discovered dead in a local auto shop. 
As journalist Lana Whitt and police officer Bill Mates dig into the case, they must answer one crucial question: was it a simple accident, 
or a calculated kill by someone desperate to steal the foundation's money? 

No clue is too small in this tangled web of deceit. 

- Colorful and intuitive solitaire challenges
- Finish compelling quests
- Solve hundreds of solitaire levels
- Crack the case and catch the killer

70010000116796.name: Tiny Auto Knights
70010000116796.intro: A chill PvP auto battler where you build your team on a 3x3 grid. Recruit and upgrade unique heroes, strategically place them on the battlefield and find the best synergies.
70010000116796.description:
Build a team
Recruit heroes with unique skills and place them strategically on the field. Merge the same heroes to level them up and get access to more powerful skills. Optimize your team and create strong synergies.

Fight against other players
When the battle starts, your heroes will fight automatically and use their skills. Where they are on the battlefield determines the order of attacks and skills. Status effects like armor, poison, or freezing make the combat even deeper.

Customize your decks
Win battles to earn Unlock Tokens! Use these tokens to get new heroes and add them to your custom deck. Find unexpected combinations and perfect your strategy. Share your decks with the community and friends ‒ and try out their creations.

Choose relics
Get these passive bonuses to complement your team. Relics can make every run into a unique experience.

Level up rewards
Pick a reward whenever you level up one of your heroes. With a bit of luck, you will be able to boost your team's strength by a lot.

Leaderboards
Play ranked games to climb the leaderboard among all players globally or compete with your friends.

Detailed player stats
You can always have a look at this comprehensive list of all your in game actions and results.

Features:
- Play against teams of other players: Discover and learn new strategies
- No turn timer: Take as much time as you want
- Ranked and Casual mode: Play competitive or have a relaxing time
- Compete in weekly challenges: Find the strongest build from a curated deck
- Find relics: Get passive bonuses to complement your team
- Create custom decks: Choose from dozens of unique heroes

70010000116803.name: Adventurous Slime
70010000116803.intro: This adventurous slime is ready to become a legendary hero
70010000116803.description:
Slime your way though this platforming adventure about a brave little slime in a vast magical kingdom.

The evil menace known as Lord Old Skull has been freed, and now our colorful family of slimes must heed the call of heroism. Customize your slime, journey through diverse biomes, battle powerful bosses, and discover alternative branching paths in this slime-sized action quest.

Choose your level of challenge while gaining items, building experience, and enjoying immersive retro graphics and sounds.


Features
* Platform action gameplay with alternate paths
* Customize your slime
* Explore 4 diverse biomes 
* Battle 4 epic bosses
* Gain items and experience
* Retro game visual and sound aesthetics

70010000116812.name: FUR Squadron Phoenix
70010000116812.intro: Embark on an action-packed adventure in this on-rails space shooter. Master your ship, upgrade your skills, and protect the federation from an imminent threat.
70010000116812.description:
A roguelite campaign where every run reshuffles the levels, keeping the action fresh and unpredictable.

Upgradeable ships, unlockable weapons, and skill trees that let you craft your own path to becoming an ace pilot.

Massive bosses, dynamic environments, and intense battles across space, air, and sea.

A dazzling arsenal: unleash power beams, multi-missile barrages, and even a nuke strike.

Train with a renegade crew of elite pilots using cutting-edge VR tech. Complete their missions, boost your Overdrive, and unlock story-rich conversations that reveal their pasts—and yours.

70010000116817.name: NO-SKIN
70010000116817.intro: NO-SKIN is a horror roguelike where experimental art style and storytelling meet strategic gameplay.
70010000116817.description:
Face the horrors lurking around the house and discover who the No-Skin Man truly is. 
What started as a normal night with your friends quickly turned into something far more twisted. Fight, talk, trade and pray for one more turn as you delve deeper into each room, trying to survive this madness.

FEATURES:
▪ UNIQUE ART STYLE - hand-drawn pixel art characters and items meet photographic backgrounds, giving the game a distinctive look,
▪ HIGH REPLAYABILITY - choose from different characters, unlock new content between runs and experience unique outcomes with each playthrough,
▪ YOUR PROGRESS MATTERS - collect lunar fragments to buy permanent upgrades that carry over between runs,
HORROR ATMOSPHERE - immerse yourself in the game's unsettling, surreal world, where every corner hides something uncanny,
▪ CAN YOU DISCOVER THE TRUTH? - talk with your friends and piece together fragments of the story hidden within the conversations.

70010000116823.name: NITRO GEN OMEGA
70010000116823.intro: A sandbox tactical RPG of steel, fire, friendship, and shonen anime.
70010000116823.description:
A World Ruled by Machines
Humanity has lost the war. The wastelands are now crawling with rogue AI and scavenging war machines. You and your mercenary crew fight to survive, taking on contracts from the last remaining cities built high above the wasteland.

Explore the Wasteland
Fly across a massive open world filled with settlements, machine lairs, quests, and unexpected events.
Take on contracts, recruit new pilots, and shape your crew’s legend one battle at a time.

Cinematic Turn-Based Battles
Plan your moves during the Planning Phase, then watch your strategy unfold in fully animated, anime-inspired combat sequences.
Injuries, panic, and breakdowns can strike at any moment—but so can heroism.

Create and Command Your Crew
Create and recruit your crew. Command a four-pilot squad, each controlling a different Mech subsystem.
Dodge, fire, deploy coolant, or unleash special tactics using the game’s unique Timeline System, where every second counts and every action shapes the flow of battle.

Life Aboard the Airship
Between missions, your airship becomes home.
Cook, train, or relax as your pilots bond, form rivalries, and grow through their experiences.
Each relationship influences how they fight—and how they survive.

Customize and Evolve 
Collect and assemble Mech parts to build your perfect war machine.
Balance protection, heat, and ammo to match your playstyle, and unlock new Mech frames with unique strengths and loadouts.

Every Decision Matters 
Your Mech can be rebuilt—your pilots cannot.
Manage morale and fatigue, face the consequences of your choices, and discover who you and your crew truly are in a world on the brink.

70010000116844.name: US Conflict - Tank Battles
70010000116844.intro: Command Tanks in a World War II RTS
70010000116844.description:
Engage in legendary tank battles and dominate the global war zone! In this intense real-time strategy game, build your base, fortify defenses, and unleash a strategic warfare frenzy. Lead your army of powerful tanks, to conquer enemy forces. Prepare for adrenaline-pumping clashes, execute lightning-fast rushes, and strategically position turrets for an unyielding defense. It's time to prove your tactical prowess and become the ultimate legend in the Armageddon of tank battles!

Features:
- Three campaigns with 28 missions.  (One free campaign)
- Unlimited multiplayer PvP and PvE. Choose between 9 playable countries: USA, UK, France, Russia, Japan, Germany, Hungary, Romania, and Czechoslovakia.
- 20 unit types per nation upgradeable for all infantry and vehicles (200 usable upgrades) Tanks, Trucks, Commander Vehicles, stationary guns, and much more.
- Special extra units: Maus, IS2, Churchill, T29, Katyusha, Gepard, Sturmtiger.
- Defensive tactics include minefield planting, stationary turrets, and anti-tank assault. 
- Action camera, powerups, boosters, and airstrike capabilities for offensive special attacks.
- Learning AI that adjusts to the player's skill level.
- Elevated terrains allowing for multiple strategic tactics.

Audio Engine: FMOD Studio by Firelight Technologies Pty Ltd.

70010000116851.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
70010000116851.intro: Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation
70010000116851.description:
Medieval Paris, Where the Tolling Bells Herald the End
1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.
Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

Rose is soon swept up in the dark conspiracy that lurks beneath. Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation?

Satisfying Whip Action
Castlevania's iconic whip action is more satisfying than ever!
Crack your whip to move around freely like a trapeze artist!
Master the whip mechanics and be creative to pounce on your prey like a wolf in fast-paced combat!

Diverse Bosses and the Arcana System
Face-off against legendary bosses including Death, Medusa and Carmilla in addition to enigmatic new bosses such as Joan of Arc.
Once defeated, bosses are sealed into Rose's tarot cards, turning them into Arcana - use their skills to cast spells and obtain unique special actions

Customize Your Battle Style with Weapons and Relics
Customize Rose’s battle style by using a variety of equipment, including weapons spanning seven distinct categories and Relics that trigger powerful effects through both offense and defense.
Combine equipment you discover through exploration to create your own playstyle!

Iconic Castlevania Atmosphere, Reimagined in New Stages
From iconic Gothic aesthetics to vivid, refined visuals, the game presents a fresh take on the world of Castlevania.
Explore maps filled with both new features and familiar elements inspired by classic Castlevania titles.

70010000116857.name: EGGCONSOLE MARCHEN VEIL II PC-9801
70010000116857.intro: The saga of the Lake Prince reaches its grand finale. A masterpiece Action RPG that masterfully fuses immersive visuals with pulse-pounding action!
70010000116857.description:
Originally released by System Sacom in 1986, this title is an action RPG where players take on the role of a lake prince transformed into a hideous "Veil." Embark on a perilous journey to track down the sorcerer responsible for the curse.

True to its predecessor, the game progresses through alternating visual story segments and action stages. Its unique charm lies in the masterful fusion of an immersive narrative—told through CG and text—with the fluid gameplay of 4-way scrolling and shooting. Compared to the first entry, this sequel features significant enhancements to the action, including faster character movement, more powerful enemy attacks, a variety of massive bosses, and expanded map sizes. Players can look forward to a more challenging and rewarding action RPG experience.
 
 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.
 *Flashing lights or patterns may cause dizziness, spasms, or loss of consciousness. If you feel unwell, stop playing immediately and see a doctor.
   If you have a history of these symptoms, consult a physician before use.

70010000116877.name: Christmas Across America Collector's Edition
70010000116877.intro: Experience the magic of a true American Christmas!
70010000116877.description:
Get ready for a journey through snowy America, from bustling cities to cozy little towns, the spirit of the holiday is in the air. 
Garland lights sparkle, Christmas carols sound, and the smell of hot cocoa with marshmallows fills the air.

In Christmas Across America, you’ll find two intertwining stories:
— Santa and his cheerful elves go on a festive tour across the U.S. to deliver gifts and magic to children from California to New York.
— And little Lily and her family prepare for Christmas the way millions of Americans do: decorating the house, visiting friends, taking part in charity events, and creating family traditions that will stay in the heart forever.

Take a walk through Christmas markets, go ice skating in Central Park, visit Santa’s house in Alaska, hop on a holiday train, and feel the atmosphere of those heartwarming classic holiday movies we all love as a family.

Game features:
- A journey across the U.S. on Christmas Eve — 38 locations, each capturing the spirit of the region and the holiday
- An American family story — Lily, her parents, neighbors and friends come together to create a Christmas filled with care, warmth and traditions
- Holiday hidden-object scenes — decorations, letters to Santa, Christmas toys, treats, greeting cards, angels
- Dozens of mini-games — decorate the house, help pack gifts, launch the Christmas train, create a snow angel
- Collections and meta-progression — collect souvenirs from every state, decorate Lily’s house, unlock family recipes and stories

This game is like a warm letter from the past and a gift for the whole family.
Wrap yourself in a blanket, pour some cocoa, and start your journey through Christmas America.

70010000116893.name: Robo Rangers
70010000116893.intro: Jump into the action and stop the machine invasion!
70010000116893.description:
Robo Rangers is a fast-paced top-down twin-stick shooter where you take control of an elite combat robot. Fight your way through vibrant, handcrafted biomes, survive relentless enemy waves, and take down powerful bosses using a wide range of weapons and special abilities.

Every mission delivers intense, arcade-style combat that rewards quick reflexes, smart positioning, and tactical decision-making. Collect crystals, upgrade your gear, and evolve into an unstoppable Robo Ranger.

70010000116900.name: EGGCONSOLE ADVENTURE OF RANDAR MSX2
70010000116900.intro: Starring Compile’s own Randar-kun! A traditional RPG that’s simple to play but packs a real punch!
70010000116900.description:
This title is a role-playing game originally included in "Disc Station Spring Issue," released by Compile in 1989. Players take on the role of Lander, a young knight of Gameland, and set off on an adventure to save the Kingdom of Mamorus from the clutches of the demon Nestyurba.

The game features an intuitive system where players traverse 2D maps and engage in battles via random encounters. Your adventure will unfold across three towns, three caves, and a castle.

Reflecting the gaming standards of its time, the game requires players to grind for experience and features a high encounter rate, making for a formidable challenge. Its popularity is undeniable, evidenced by the release of sequels like Lander 2 and 3. Don't miss this chance to experience a hit RPG from Compile's early days!
 
 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000116903.name: Monkey in the Zoo
70010000116903.intro: Step inside the cage. Banana drama guaranteed.
70010000116903.description:
Monkey in the Zoo puts you inside the mind — and mischief — of a monkey behind bars. The real attraction isn’t you… it’s the unpredictable humans who wander up to your cage.

Some visitors arrive with smiles and snacks.
Others come armed with loud voices, pushy attitudes, or questionable intentions.
How you react — playful, curious, or gloriously chaotic — shapes every moment.

Grab whatever you can reach.
Eat it, throw it, break it, or offer it back with suspicious kindness.
Your cage is a fully interactive playground, and every visitor becomes part of your improvised story.

From harmless comedy to tense standoffs, no encounter is ever the same.

You may be behind bars —
but you decide who’s really in control.

70010000116923.name: Frog in the Fog
70010000116923.description:
What does the fog hide?
Monsters? Darkness? Forgotten secrets?
While others fear to take a step, one frog leaps upward.
Each jump cuts through the mist,
each breath echoes in the silence.
The fog thickens…
but fear is unknown to her.

Forward. Higher. Into the unknown.

70010000116929.name: Math Pals – Monster Mania
70010000116929.intro: Learn math with friendly monsters and fun challenges.
70010000116929.description:
This game is an educational math game designed for preschool and elementary school children.

Children learn core math skills—counting, addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division—through playful, monster-themed multiple-choice quizzes. Each topic is divided into 20 levels that gradually increase in difficulty, starting with small numbers and visual aids and building up to larger numbers and more advanced tasks.

Every level features a highscore and star rating, giving children, 
parents, and teachers a clear overview of progress and confidence in each topic.

Tasks vary constantly: counting monsters, adding dice and fingers, finding missing numbers, combining animals or creatures, and more. Built-in spaced repetition ensures that learned topics return naturally over time, helping children retain knowledge without pressure.
Friendly monsters celebrate success, encourage effort, and make learning math feel fun and rewarding—while mistakes are treated gently as part of the learning journey.

This game turns math practice into a playful adventure filled with monsters, stars, and growing confidence.

70010000116932.name: Math Pals - Dino Academy
70010000116932.intro: Learn math step by step with friendly dinos and fun quizzes.
70010000116932.description:
Math Pals – Dino Academy is an educational math game designed for preschool and elementary school children.
Kids learn essential math skills—counting, addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division—in a playful, stress-free environment guided by friendly dinosaur characters.
Each topic is divided into areas with 20 carefully designed levels. Difficulty increases slowly and clearly, starting with small numbers and visual aids and growing toward larger numbers and more complex tasks. Every level includes a highscore and a star rating, helping children and parents instantly see progress and strengths.
Learning happens through varied multiple-choice quizzes: counting objects, adding dice, fingers, animals, finding missing numbers, and more. Tasks change frequently to keep learning fresh and engaging while built-in spaced repetition helps children remember and practice what they’ve already learned.
Positive feedback, celebrations, and clear progression motivate children to keep going—while mistakes are treated gently as part of the learning process.
Math Pals – Dino Academy turns math into a friendly adventure—one level, one star, and one happy dinosaur at a time.

70010000116939.name: Sandbox Doodle Playground
70010000116939.intro:
Build. Craft. Destroy.
Create Your Own Playground.
Experiment Without Limits.
70010000116939.description:
Sandbox Doodle Playground, a creative physics sandbox where your imagination becomes reality! Craft, build, experiment, and create endless scenarios using a huge collection of characters, weapons, vehicles, tools, and interactive objects.
Design your own worlds, build incredible machines, or unleash total chaos with realistic ragdoll physics. Every object reacts naturally, allowing you to create funny experiments, epic battles, crazy chain reactions, or peaceful constructions. There are no rules or missions—only unlimited freedom to play your way.
Whether you enjoy engineering complex contraptions, testing physics, or simply creating hilarious moments, Sandbox Doodle Playground gives you all the tools you need.

Features:
Creative physics sandbox with realistic interactions.
Draw and build your own unique playground.
Hundreds of objects, weapons, vehicles, and tools.
Realistic ragdoll physics and destructible environments.
Create machines, traps, battles, and chain reactions.
Endless possibilities with no limits or objectives.
Easy-to-use controls for players of all ages.

Create. Experiment. Destroy. Build your own world in Sandbox Doodle Playground!

70010000116947.name: Cowboys
70010000116947.intro: During a journey across the desert in search of gold, a map is discovered. Thus, a secret that should never have been uncovered comes to light.
70010000116947.description:
● A Wild West journey with supernatural elements. Explore a variety of mystery-filled settings: abandoned towns, crumbling saloons, moving trains, the desert at night, and many other unknown environments.
● Platform-style shooting combat. Use your revolver to face human enemies and supernatural creatures. Dodge attacks and shoot with precision.
● A steadily growing atmosphere of suspense. The constant feeling of an unseen presence always lurking nearby.
● Story progression. In each area, new fragments of the narrative are revealed. From showdowns with outlaws to encounters with entities that vanish at dawn, the journey builds tension toward the final confrontation.
● Diverse settings and challenges. Engage in shootouts atop moving trains, survive a rainy night surrounded by monsters, and cross cursed lands.

70010000116964.name: Just Deserts
70010000116964.intro: Soldier by day, hero by night
70010000116964.description:
Take on the role of a futuristic soldier who must protect their city from mysterious alien attack, while at the same time capturing the heart of your sweetheart.

Plan your schedule of daily and nightly activities, manage resources like energy, health, items, money, and time, and build your relationships with each girl. Do battle with aliens!

Unlock 7 different romantic endings with each of 7 beautiful and fully-voiced heroines.


Features
* Visual novel with choices
* Cute anime-style art
* 7 unique women to romance
* Turn-based combat against invading aliens
* Voice cast and original vocal song

70010000116969.name: Climb Driver
70010000116969.intro: Race through challenging levels as you collect coins, jump obstacles, and perform flips to reach the finish line.
70010000116969.description: It is a physics based car driving game. Where you ride alongside many levels, collect coins, so you can upgrade your car.  Over 40 challenging levels in a few different environments. You can customize your car.

70010000116975.name: Lost to Time
70010000116975.intro: Lost to Time is a time-pause focused 2D action platforming metroidvania game, with a carefully crafted world to explore in an non-traditional fantasy RPG fashion
70010000116975.description:
In order to overcome insurmountable odds, the hero, Chrona, must manipulate the flow of time in order to gain advantages over opponents. Additionally, you will be able to discover various 'Magi' throughout the game, of which Chrona can transform into and gain different combat abilities. By changing Magi, you are able to effectively change your combat style and weapon of choice. Chrona herself is also able to learn abilities that will help you navigate the treacherous world. However, Chrona must learn to live with the consequences of her actions, and find out what her choices say about her.

Now with improved controller support and on Nintendo Switch™!

Features
- A large world to explore, seamlessly and meticulously connected.
- Overcome many bosses, foes, and puzzles, all which may require the use of your time control abilities.
- Play and level up various playable "Magi" found throughout the game. Magi serve as your weapon.
- Various RPG elements, including a crafting system, level up / build system, and much more! Replay the game as different builds, utilize different Magi, etc.
- A mysterious story, with multiple endings and secrets.

70010000116980.name: Garden Work Simulator 2026
70010000116980.intro: From a single seed to a thriving garden - grow your legacy.
70010000116980.description:
Cultivate. Trade. Grow.

Welcome to  Garden Work Simulator 2026, a relaxing yet engaging garden management experience where every seed you plant shapes your success. Start with a small plot of land and gradually transform it into a flourishing garden through careful planning, patience, and smart decisions.

Each plant has its own value and growth cycle. Choose wisely, manage your resources, and expand your garden step by step while building a profitable trading network.

Key Features

Grow and Evolve
Plant a wide variety of crops, each with unique growth patterns and market value. Plan your planting strategy carefully to maximize your harvest.

Dynamic Marketplace
Prices change depending on supply and demand. Study the market, sell at the perfect moment, and grow your garden business.

Expand Your Garden
Use your profits to unlock new land, seeds, and gardening tools. Turn your modest garden into a large and efficient growing operation.

Tools and Upgrades
Invest in better equipment that helps you cultivate faster, harvest more efficiently, and manage your garden like a true professional.

Day and Night Cycle
Experience the peaceful rhythm of gardening as time passes from sunrise to sunset while your plants grow and evolve.

Your Journey, Your Garden

Success in Garden Work Simulator 2026 comes through patience, strategy, and dedication. Every harvest brings new opportunities and challenges.

Whether you want to build a peaceful garden paradise or a thriving plant-trading business, your choices determine the future of your land.

The soil is ready - it’s time to grow your legacy.

70010000116990.name: POOLS
70010000116990.intro: Walking simulator. Explore, admire and listen.
70010000116990.description:
One could say POOLS is like an art gallery where you look around and listen to the sounds. There are very few things to solve apart from a few mazes. Sometimes the game can challenge your navigation skills. But mostly you're just... there.

POOLS has no user interface and no dialogue. No background music. Instead, it uses sounds to make you feel like you're really there. The sounds and echo change depending on the room you're in. Walking in water is slower. All of these things make the game feel more real and create a tense atmosphere.

There's no typical story, no characters to meet, and you won't find any notes in-game. But as you explore and advance further, you start to notice that the game's world changes around you. Rooms look and feel different. Each chapter contains something unique. You're constantly exploring new places, each with its own kind of mystery.


Note: There are no monsters chasing you or jumping suddenly towards you, but the atmosphere can feel oppressive. POOLS plays on the fears of getting lost, the dark, and tight spaces.

Note: POOLS consists of six unique chapters, each taking between 10 and 30 minutes to play through.


POOLS is inspired by the internet phenomena "liminal spaces", "found footage" and "The Backrooms" - specifically "Backrooms Pools" or "Poolrooms".

One of the original artists behind the Poolrooms concept is Jared Pike. Other inspirations include Matt Studios' Poolrooms videos from 2022, Mortain Colors, Anemoiapolis by Andrew Quist and Kane Pixels' Backrooms.

70010000117001.name: So Quirky! Puzzle Escape Game
70010000117001.intro:
「Can you spot what's off?」
Crack these quirky puzzles by instinct! A drag-and-drop brain-teaser escape game!
70010000117001.description:
「So Quirky! Puzzle Escape Game: Snap It in with Your Instincts! A Brain-Training Picture-Match Puzzle」 is a brain-training puzzle game where you look at a single displayed image, then drag and drop the correct item from four choices to solve the puzzle.

「I was sure that was it — but it didn't fit...!」
「Wait, that one?! Actually, yeah — that makes total sense!」

Packed with wonderfully off-beat puzzles that put your intuition and quick thinking to the test.

No complex controls. No walls of text.
Just look, think, and snap it into place!
Whether you're killing time on the go or sparking lively reactions with friends on stream, anyone can jump in for a blast — a party-style puzzle experience for everyone.

※Button controls are also supported, so you can play in TV Mode and Tabletop Mode too.

———————————————
TT supports gameplay streamers.
No permission from TT is required for gameplay streaming, whether personal or commercial.

70010000117009.name: ARTDINK GAME LOG: Aquanaut's Holiday
70010000117009.intro: Curiosity takes a stroll by the sea
70010000117009.description:
“Aquanaut's Holiday” is a simple 3D adventure game in which you explore a mysterious underwater world aboard a submarine. Released for the PlayStation™ in 1995, the game has no specific objectives to achieve. It can be considered a pioneer of free-roaming games designed simply to let players enjoy the environment.

【What you've been looking for is right here】
You are an employee of the International Oceanographic Research Institute.
Having taken a vacation to rest your weary mind and body,
you set off on an underwater adventure aboard the state-of-the-art submarine “Holiday,” entrusted to you by your superior.

What you discover in the vast ocean is entirely up to you.
You can swim around without a care in the world, interact with the fish, or discover ancient ruins and let your imagination wander to civilizations of the past.

The underwater world is full of freedom and adventure.
Take on the challenge of mapping your assigned waters, and you’ll encounter familiar, adorable fish and strange creatures wherever you go.

Don’t forget to stack blocks to build artificial reefs.
As your artificial reefs grow, more marine life will visit the area.

Here, you’re sure to find a sense of peace you won’t find on the ground.
Relax and enjoy your holiday, letting your curiosity lead the way.

【Scenes from the past come vividly to life】
ARTDINK GAME LOG has added a “Remaster Mode.”  
The textures of the aquatic creatures have been upgraded to high resolution, allowing you to admire their patterns and expressions in detail.

Of course, it also features a “Classic Mode” that lets you enjoy the game just as it was back then.
What’s more, by using screen filters like ‘Scanline’ and “CRT,” you can immerse yourself in the atmosphere of “those days” when you used to play.

The package also includes the original manual from that era, which explains the background story and how to enjoy the game.
Why not return once more to the beautiful underwater world that captivated you back then?

*This product is a port of a game originally released in 1995 for Nintendo Switch™.
*This game is only available in Japanese.

70010000117015.name: The NOexistenceN of you AND me
70010000117015.description:
Use "game" as a medium to showcase the world of "you/girl". Explore the truth of "you/girl/world" through the form of a "visual novel".

A surreal psychological horror short visual novel where YOU are the protagonist.

One day, a mysterious girl suddenly appears in the protagonist's room...

Your task is simple:
-Say hello to the girl~
-Navigate through hundreds of choices to respond to "the girl's existence."
-Explore the essence of "being" and uncover the truth of this "world."

And your mission is even simpler:
-Say hello to the girl~
-As king, listen to your subjects' counsel, especially those "loyal ministers."
-Make strawberry cake, eat the cake, eat the cake - will you really let her eat the cake?
-Stop FONTAINEBLEAU's plot! Don't hand over the time machine!
-Journey to the Silvery Forest, defeat the Demon Lord, fulfill the Dreamer's mission.
-Date the mysterious girl at the world's end.
-Take some pills, have a heart-to-heart chat with them.
-Witness your ending with the girl.

Of course, perhaps none of that matters most. What matters is...

I hope you enjoy our time together.

70010000117021.name: Destiny Powers: Dwarven Town
70010000117021.intro: Help the dwarves carve out a new city!
70010000117021.description:
For centuries, the dwarves lived in peace and harmony, but dark magic has driven them from their ancestral lands. 
Help the dwarves build a new city where they can be safe from the threats of the past!

- Four types of gameplay to collect different resource types!
- Build a new town for Dwarves!
- beautiful and relaxing soundtrack!

70010000117026.name: Destiny Powers: Goblins Realms
70010000117026.intro: Not all goblins are evil and dangerous.
70010000117026.description:
Peaceful goblins were driven out of their homeland by Dark Magic, and now they are seeking refuge in the Great Forest. 
Use your magic to help them in four different game modes, and give them a new town to settle!

- Four types of gameplay to collect different resource types!
- Build a new town for goblins!
- beautiful and relaxing soundtrack!

70010000117031.name: Motorhome: Traveling North America 3 Collector's Edition
70010000117031.intro: Ever dreamed of the ultimate American road trip?
70010000117031.description:
Forget airports, hotel bookings, and strict schedules. It’s time to hit the road in your cozy motorhome, where every day brings a new adventure.

In Motorhome: Traveling North America 3, your favorite family is back behind the wheel. 
This time, they’re traveling from Portland to Key West, exploring America’s most breathtaking places, from snowy mountains to sunny coastlines.

- Wake up in the mountains, have lunch by the lake, fall asleep under the stars — all in the comfort of your home on wheels.
- Dive into colorful hidden object scenes filled with nature, cozy charm, and the spirit of the open road.
- Play relaxing mini-games and brain-teasing puzzles that help you unwind.
- Collect unique baseball caps — each location offers a new design, a fun memory, and a piece of American culture.
- Take Polaroid-style photos throughout your journey — every snapshot becomes part of your family’s road trip album.

Collector’s Edition Includes:
- 10 extra hidden object scenes — with more items to find and a mischievous raccoon to spot.
- 8 all-new mini-games + 12 bonus puzzles from previous games.
- A full collection of rare baseball caps — become the ultimate road trip collector!
- A Polaroid photo album to save your favorite memories.

70010000117041.name: Why Me?
70010000117041.intro:
A fast, unforgiving platformer where everything goes wrong.
Dodge traps and survive chaos.
70010000117041.description:
Welcome to WHY ME, a brutal rage-platformer where survival is earned one agonizing jump at a time. You’ve been thrown into a dungeon filled with shifting platforms, deadly traps, and relentless chaos. The question is simple: will you escape, or will the dungeon break you first?

Every room is a new test of patience and precision. Spikes, fire, collapsing floors, and tricks designed to catch you off guard will punish even the smallest mistake. But with every failure comes another chance to learn, improve, and push just a little bit further.

WHY ME is not just about surviving—it’s about enduring the rage. Designed for players who crave challenge, it rewards quick thinking, sharp reflexes, and stubborn determination. Lose yourself in the cycle of frustration and triumph as you climb higher, escape further, and uncover the mystery behind your imprisonment.

Play "Why Me?" today and face the dungeon’s wrath. One wrong step could end it all—but one perfect run might just prove you’ve got what it takes.

70010000117049.name: Storage Hunter Bid War Simulator
70010000117049.intro: Win auctions, uncover secrets, and become an auction legend.
70010000117049.description:
Enter the thrilling world of high-stakes storage auctions where every box could hold riches—or worthless junk. In Storage Hunter Bid War Simulator, you play as a bold treasure hunter competing to outbid rivals and uncover forgotten fortune.

Glance into locked units for just seconds before the bidding begins. Will you trust your gut, play it safe, or go all-in?
Outsmart competitors with real-time tactics—bluff, bait, and strike when the moment’s right.

Win the unit, then dig through the chaos. Some finds are trash, others are gold: vintage collectibles, rare gadgets, or secret stashes. Sell smart, reinvest, and climb the ranks from rookie bidder to auction legend.

Key Features:
• Real Auction Tension – Face unique AI opponents in dynamic, fast-paced bidding wars.
• Instinct & Strategy – Make snap decisions based on limited clues and big risks.
• Buy, Sell, Profit – Flip your finds through shops, collectors, and markets.
• Progressive Gameplay – Unlock new locations, rare items, and build your legacy.
• Diverse Environments – Bid in garages, urban lockers, and luxury vaults.

Big risks, bigger rewards.
Will you strike it rich—or walk away broke?

70010000117057.name: Hentai House: Lost Rooms
70010000117057.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000117057.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000117064.name: Braid, Anniversary Edition – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000117064.intro: Control the flow of time to solve puzzles in this new version of the indie classic, featuring fully repainted artwork, a new world of puzzles, and seriously in-depth commentary.
70010000117064.description:
Control the flow of time to solve subtle platform puzzles in this update of the indie classic "Braid," featuring refreshed artwork and seriously in-depth creator commentary.  Travel from a city house through a series of interconnected worlds where time behaves strangely, searching for an elusive Princess. Along the way you'll explore memories and regrets that still haunt you. This Anniversary Edition remaster of the award-winning platformer contains fully repainted high-resolution graphics, new sound effects and extensive audio commentary.

MANIPULATE TIME TO MOVE FORWARD
Rewind, pause and use the strange properties of time in each world to run and jump through beautifully painted environments. Avoid hazards, unlock doors and collect jigsaw puzzle pieces to assemble. If you get hung up on a particular puzzle, feel free to move on and return later.

A FRESH COAT OF PAINT
This is the game you remember, with all the original challenges and the same haunting, evocative score — but repainted pixel by pixel so that each carefully rendered world comes to life in high resolution. New visual details, animated brushstroke effects and revamped sounds add to the immersive experience.

GO (DEEP) BEHIND THE SCENES
Explore the most extensive developer commentary ever put into a game, with over 12 hours of recorded insight and conversation from developer Jonathan Blow, artist David Hellman and more members of the "Braid" creative team. Navigate it by visiting a new in-game world, which also contains new puzzles and redesigns of classic puzzles.  - Created by Thekla, Inc.

70010000117082.name: Snapshot Oddities ! Find What’s Wrong
70010000117082.intro:
Can you spot something “off”?
A spot-the-oddity game where you hunt for strange details in images!
70010000117082.description:
Find the one odd detail hidden in each photo!
This is a spot-the-difference game where every image contains exactly one “something’s off” moment.

Simple, satisfying, and surprisingly addictive—the instant you find it, you’ll feel that perfect click of relief.

Controls are easy:
take a close look at the photo and simply select the spot that seems suspicious.
The rules are intuitive, so even if you’re not a seasoned gamer, you can jump right in.

Play solo and focus… or gather with family and friends and point at the screen together:
“Is it here?” “No—maybe over there!”
It’s a party game everyone can enjoy, no matter the age.

Ready to put your observation skills to the test?

70010000117093.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
70010000117093.description:
Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin. 

◆ Cinematic pixel art
What if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive.

◆ A return to the familiar
A classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more.

◆ Strategic turn-based battles
Exploit enemy weaknesses to stagger them—breaking their defenses to seize extra turns and gain the upper hand with powerful Resonance attacks in cinematic battles shaped by smart choices.

◆ FINAL FANTASY legends
Bolster your team with Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, who fight alongside you with unique skills and abilities for deep party customization.

◆ Hours of side content to discover
The world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon.

70010000117111.name: Prison Run
70010000117111.description:
Prison Run is a game about escape, risk, and cleverness.
You are a prisoner desperately trying to break out of a grim high-security prison. The only path to freedom is using your wits, patience, and anything you can dig up from beneath the ground.

Dig. Find. Trade. Escape.
Explore the area, dig up hidden items, upgrade your gear, and sell your loot to a shady guard who looks the other way for money. But be careful every item you uncover can bring you closer to freedom… or to solitary confinement.

70010000117125.name: FlyKnight
70010000117125.intro: Explore, fight, loot and fish! Solo or in co-op mode in this Old School First Person Dungeon Crawler.
70010000117125.description:
Flyknight tells the tale of a squire of the order of the Flyknights who is assembled to vanquish the witch Lunamoth and lift her curse, which is preventing the denizens of the realm from growing wings. Now separated after an ambush, the squire arriveth at the village of the swamp folk and pledges to see the mission through, either alone or teaming up with other fighters summoned to help along the way.

Do you have what it takes to emerge victorious and claim Knighthood?

70010000117131.name: Luna and the Dreams
70010000117131.intro: A dreamy adventure packed with sparkle and heart.
70010000117131.description:
This story follows Luna, a lavender haired girl who is transported to the magical Kingdom of Dreams to become its new Guardian. Alongside Brillin, an enthusiastic star, and Nimbo, a cat made of clouds, Luna discovers a celestial workshop where dreams are made with fantastic ingredients like laughter and colorful powders. Through festivals, magical snack times with moon rabbits, and bright carnival tours, she learns how kindness and joy keep the kingdom shining, and that the true magic of dreams is how they connect people’s hearts and turn hope into reality every morning.

An interactive storybook experience. A linear narrative adventure perfect for young readers to enjoy a captivating story at their own pace.

70010000117133.name: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 3
70010000117133.intro: New Circus is in town and fun is about to start, only to be ruined by the murder. Can you catch the killer?
70010000117133.description:
Under the big top, a festive atmosphere reigns: music, bright lights, and the scent of popcorn. 
But the morning is shattered when an acrobat's safety rope mysteriously snaps. 

Was it a tragic accident, or a carefully staged murder? 

As the killer hides among the clowns and performers, Lana and Bill step into the ring to ensure this is one act that ends with the culprit behind bars. 

- Colorful and intuitive solitaire challenges
- Finish compelling quests
- Solve hundreds of solitaire levels
- Crack the case and catch the killer

70010000117138.name: Frogging Up
70010000117138.intro: Every leap brings you closer to glory… or back to the beginning.
70010000117138.description:
Frogging Up is a punishing yet rewarding physics platformer about a small frog in a yellow raincoat who dreams of escaping his muddy village life. Guided only by determination (and a very questionable sense of balance), he begins an impossible climb through a surreal world of floating pipes, platforms, and mechanical ruins. Each jump is a step closer to the top and a better life.

• Unique jump mechanic: The direction is controlled by the camera, while the strength depends on how long you hold the jump button. Mastering this precision system sets Frogging Up apart from other rage platformers.
• Rage-platformer challenge: No checkpoints by default, one slip can erase everything, but victory feels truly earned.
• Narrator commentary: A mysterious voice cheers, mocks, and reflects on your climb, turning failure into story.
• A story of struggle and ambition: Climb from the swamps of a forgotten village toward the shimmering towers above, a metaphorical journey from poverty to success.

Will you rage quit or rise from the mud and prove that even a small frog can reach the sky?

70010000117144.name: OUTBREAK FALL: BIOHAZARD
70010000117144.intro: When the outbreak begins, survival is the only law.
70010000117144.description:
Civilization has collapsed. The infection is out of control.
In OUTBREAK FALL: BIOHAZARD, you become a heavily armed survivor fighting to endure a city consumed by chaos.

This fast-paced first-person shooter throws you into a ruined urban battlefield filled with aggressive infected creatures and constant danger. Explore devastated streets, abandoned buildings, and burning districts as you search for resources and battle relentless enemies.

Armed with modern and futuristic weapons, you must rely on precision, awareness, and fast reactions to survive. The infected are unpredictable, relentless, and always advancing. Every encounter pushes your combat skills to the limit.

Key Features:
• Intense first-person shooter combat
• Dark post-apocalyptic city environments
• Immersive lighting and atmospheric sound design
• Escalating enemy encounters and constant tension
• Optimized performance for Nintendo Switch

The city has fallen.
Escape is uncertain.

How long can you survive the outbreak?

70010000117150.name: Trine 6: Together in Time
70010000117150.intro: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1–4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide in the next adventure through this fantasy world.
70010000117150.description:
An Unlikely Alliance

Adventures are better together… even when they don’t start that way.

In a distant corner of the Kingdom, two enterprising young souls, Moira and Adrius, find themselves in over their heads when a heist goes wrong, accidentally binding their fate to that of the realm’s greatest heroes.

Now together with Amadeus, Zoya, and Pontius, the unlikely party must journey across perilous fantasy landscapes and overcome mounting challenges to restore a powerful magic gone awry before a dangerous warlock closes in to reclaim what is his.

Perplexing Puzzles

Trine 6’s puzzles are designed with a co-op-first approach, encouraging players to work together, coordinate actions, and combine abilities to progress. All puzzles can be solved by any character, giving players the freedom to choose their characters based on preferred playstyle rather than hardcoded puzzle requirements.
For those who prefer to go it alone, updated puzzle designs also allow solo players to take on the challenges themselves.

Shared Adventure

Play with up to four players and share every moment of the adventure together. Work through challenges, celebrate shared victories, and laugh through the occasional bit of chaos with friends on the same couch or across the world via crossplay.

Take Your Time

All characters can make use of the brand-new Time-Slow ability for a bit of extra control when it matters most. Slow down the world around you to help line up precise jumps, react to threats, dodge incoming attacks, or just provide some breathing room in the most chaotic moments.

Dynamic Combat

Dodge incoming strikes, find openings, and focus your attacks while adapting to enemies with distinct abilities, including those that shield or strengthen their allies. Combat and movement go hand in hand, requiring positioning, timing, and coordination to succeed.
Boss encounters push these skills even further, blending combat, traversal, and environmental challenges into memorable trials."
Discover Secrets

Venture through a vibrant, handcrafted fantasy world filled with hidden paths and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Explore each level carefully to find rewards to help power up your heroes.

Five Unique Heroes

Trine 6 features five playable characters: three returning favorites and two brand new to the series. Each character offers a distinct playstyle and unlockable skills:
•	Amadeus the Wizard: Summon objects and manipulate the world with magic.
•	Zoya the Thief: Fire arrows at foes and use a rope to traverse and interact with the environment.
•	Pontius the Knight: Crush enemies with a hammer and use his shield to defend and propel allies.
•	Moira the Acrobat: Chain together fluid kick combos and swing through the world using her ribbon.
•	Adrius the Squire: Wield a spear in combat or plant it to create platforms for traversal.

70010000117168.name: Arcade Archives KONAMI GT
70010000117168.intro: THE SPIRIT OF CHAMPIONS RACES ON!!
70010000117168.description:
"KONAMI GT" is a racing game released by KONAMI in 1985.
Keep a close eye on your fuel gauge as you race through checkpoints, aiming to conquer all 6 grueling stages.
With beautiful, shifting scenery—from coastal highways and arid wastelands to plains bathed in the sunset—push the pedal to the metal and blast toward the finish line in a shower of glory!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000117176.name: EGGCONSOLE Schwarzschild II PC-9801
70010000117176.intro: As supreme ruler, survive the war-torn galaxy by mastering diplomacy and strategy. This game blends cinematic twists with punishing combat against an AI.
70010000117176.description:
This sci-fi simulation game was released by Kogado Studio in 1990. Players take on the role of the ruler of "Oraculum" in the Somali Star System, tasked with surviving in a galaxy torn apart by war.

The game is turn-based, utilizing a strategic command selection system based on point consumption. You must strengthen your nation and military to fight off enemies by mastering various commands, including Diplomacy (offering aid, signing non-aggression pacts, forming alliances, and preparing for war) and Military (building shipyards, producing units, and organizing fleets). The AI has been significantly enhanced in this installment—simple tactics like using decoys may no longer work—providing a truly challenging and satisfying combat experience.

The highlights of this title are not only its high difficulty level but also its storytelling. The narrative does not progress through cutscenes between missions; instead, it unfolds naturally through a unique system as you fight on a battlefield with a high degree of freedom. With major plot twists similar to the previous installment, players can enjoy a dramatic progression reminiscent of a sci-fi movie. 


 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000117179.name: Pocket Archery Master
70010000117179.intro: Test your agility and archery skills. Use bow to shoot targets, survive enemy waves.
70010000117179.description: On the 30 levels your agility will be tested. Enemies constantly spawn, but to pass level you have to shoot all of the targets. Shooting strategy is essential to survive the waves and complete the level!

70010000117192.name: Survivor Legion
70010000117192.intro: Unlock more classes, recruit more allies, and build your survivor legion!
70010000117192.description:
• Multi-Character Team Battles
 Each character has unique skills and attributes, allowing flexible combinations based on combat needs. Whether you prefer powerful melee warriors or spell-casting mages, you’ll always find a role that suits your playstyle.

• Flexible Formation Switching
 Choose to gather your team into a circular formation to boost attack power, or spread them out in a line to increase speed. With simple switching controls, you can react quickly to the ever-changing battlefield and unleash your team’s full potential.

• Diverse Build Paths
 Different playstyles complement each other, enabling a wide variety of combat strategies. Explore countless possibilities, discover hidden combos and optimal builds, and let your heroes unleash their unique power and style in battle.

• Fast-Paced Combat
 A quick and rhythmic combat system makes every strike feel impactful. Combined with smooth animations and dazzling skill effects, it delivers an addictive fast-paced fighting experience.

70010000117198.name: Schrödinger's Call
70010000117198.intro: Schrödinger’s Call is a visual novel that lets you experience the pain and salvation of human connection, as if you were turning the pages of a picture book.
70010000117198.description:
When the world is coming to an end, who would you want to speak to one last time?
In that final moment, if you could accompany souls wandering between life and death, what words would you choose to share with them?

Schrödinger’s Call gently unfolds a picture-book-like world.
It speaks softly to your heart, helping you notice what truly matters, once more.
Through the lingering regrets of others, we hope this story quietly shines a light on you too.


Story Overview

Twenty-one nanoseconds separate life from death.
The moon is about to fall, and only a moment remains before everything ends.

Mary wakes up in a strange room, her memories gone.
Guided by a mysterious cat named Hamlet, she becomes the “World’s Last Confidant.”

With a single phone by her side, Mary listens to the voices on the other end.
To the lives they lived, and the moments they left behind, just before the moon fell.

Phone calls left unfinished by the falling moon. Voices of those still trapped between life and death, waiting for someone to pick up the phone again.

Words left unsaid, feelings never realized, and the people they wished they could see one last time.
As Mary notes down these lingering regrets, chapter by chapter, she walks alongside the voices on the other end—and perhaps, you begin to see what truly matters as well.

How will Mary listen to the words of souls still wandering between life and death?
How will she walk alongside them?

And with only twenty-one nanoseconds left before the world ends, what words would you choose to share with them?

70010000117204.name: EGGCONSOLE TAKE THE A-TRAIN PC-8801
70010000117204.intro: As the newly appointed president of a railway company, you have one year to lay the tracks and guide the Presidential Train safely to its goal.
70010000117204.description:
This simulation game was originally released by ARTDINK in 1986. While many fans today associate the series with urban development—laying tracks and transporting passengers or cargo to grow a city—the first TAKE THE A-TRAIN offers a slightly different experience. Your primary mission is to lay tracks to safely guide the Presidential Train to the final goal.

In this game, you are given a limited timeframe of one year. You must manage your railway company and earn sufficient funds while advancing the Presidential Train toward its destination. A single accident, running out of funds due to reckless management, or exceeding the 365-day limit will result in a Game Over.

The gameplay leans toward a puzzle-like challenge, requiring both strategic thinking and careful resource management. As a title that still commands high recognition today, why not take this opportunity to experience the true origin of the franchise?
 

 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000117213.name: Last Day On The Ship
70010000117213.intro: Hunger, fire, chaos — survive it all
70010000117213.description:
The ship has been looted. The crew is gone. You are the only one who survived.

During the night, pirates attacked the vessel. They took everything of value, destroyed the equipment, and captured the crew. You survived only because you managed to hide in the ship’s dark compartments.

When the silence returned, it became clear — there was no one to call for help.

Your first objective is to repair the emergency radio and send a distress signal. The first days of survival will be spent searching for intact parts, restoring power, and making risky trips into damaged sections of the ship.

But the signal is only the beginning.

Rescuers are on their way…
You just don’t know when they will arrive.

While you wait, the ship slowly dies along with you.
Supplies are limited, systems continue to fail, and at any moment a fire may break out or another авария may occur. The pirates may return — to check the ship or finish off the one who was left behind.

You will have to:

- survive by managing hunger and thirst

- extinguish fires and deal with emergencies

- defend yourself against repeated attacks

Every day is a trial.

You don’t know how long you must endure.
You know only one thing — if you give up too soon, rescue will never come.

70010000117219.name: Jigsaw Realms: Oasis
70010000117219.description:
Escape into Jigsaw Realms: Oasis, a relaxing jigsaw puzzle adventure set in beautiful oasis landscapes.

Piece together stunning scenes across 30 handcrafted levels, each one increasing in difficulty as your skills improve. Start with simple puzzles and work your way up to more complex challenges that will truly test your focus and patience.

Designed for both casual players and puzzle lovers, Jigsaw Realms: Oasis offers a calm, satisfying experience where every completed puzzle feels rewarding.

Features:
>30 unique jigsaw puzzle levels
>Gradually increasing difficulty
>Beautiful oasis-themed artwork
>Relaxing and focused gameplay
>Perfect for casual and dedicated puzzle fans
>Progress Saving

Take your time. Find your focus.

70010000117223.name: Sail Forth – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000117223.intro: Sail across the Deepblue in a quirky nautical adventure!
70010000117223.description:
Explore the Deepblue!
• Put the wind to your back and cast out into High Adventure over a vast ocean spanning dozens of eccentric regions. 
• Discover countless isles bursting with their own flora, fauna, friendly folk, and fearsome foes. 
• Playfully pursue a pod of curious dolphins, admire the beauty of the sun sinking into an icy horizon, or run down a clutch of cowardly criminals only to accept their apologies to the tune of wild cannonry.

Command a Sailing Fleet!
• Build and manage a custom cadre of specialized vessels to match any personality and play style.
• Buy, equip, upgrade, and modify your ships’ armaments to face off against the toughest privateers this side of the Eclipside.
• Crack open giant clams and loot lonely shipwrecks to fill your fleet’s treasure hoard and keep your crew in shipshape.

Fathom a Mystery!
• Join forces with the myriad inhabitants of this watery world to uncover a terrible secret buried in the depths of the Deepblue.
• Reel in a big one with the salty Anglerwranglers, learn the secret spyspeak of the Croaker Command Corps, save the sea life of the Moontiders, capture picturesque memories with a mysterious “camera” device, and much more.
• Inspire the finefolk from all over to work as one world-spanning crew to save the seas and the planet.

Sail Forth into Adventure!
• Tack and jibe and heave and cut with a sail and wind system designed with enough attention to realistic sailing physics to excite naval enthusiasts while also remaining deeply accessible to anyone and everyone.
• Sail through stormy swells and serene sunsets in a dynamic and breathtaking day-night weather system.
• Bask in the beauty of the benevolent ocean waters in Free Sail mode where the only goal is the ever-moving horizon.

The Deepblue calls with the bellow of High Adventure! Sail Forth!

70010000117225.name: Arcade Archives DEVASTATORS
70010000117225.intro: For the GLORY, the MONEY... and to feed the BEAST inside their body!!
70010000117225.description:
"DEVASTATORS" is a shooting game released by KONAMI in 1988.
In this game, a group of elite mercenaries known as the "DEVASTATORS" are hired to save a developing nation from the invasion of a superpower.
This edition includes both the English version and the Japanese version, which features some differences in gameplay content.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000117246.name: Pixel Game Maker Series Denizens of Darkwind
70010000117246.intro:
You may continue onward…
You can turn back if you wish…
70010000117246.description:
**Chapter One**
You awaken and venture deeper into the forest.
There, you discover a mysterious ruin… but its door is firmly sealed.

Before you realize it, something lies at your feet — a ≪Silver Coin≫.
Almost without thinking, you place the coin at the center of a strange, ominous circle…

From here on, the rest of the story is yours to uncover.

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.

70010000117252.name: Police Girls
70010000117252.intro: A puzzle game featuring cool and cute female police officers is here!
70010000117252.description:
Collect pieces of stylish and adorable female police officers and complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Once completed, high‑resolution images will be added to your gallery ♪
=====================
We support game streamers!
No permission is required to stream this game.

70010000117260.name: GAME The Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (Provisional)!~Dungeon and Mystery Girl~
70010000117260.intro: A fast-paced arena shooter game with simple controls and strategic battles.Experience a story original to the game, starring the characters of Appraiser (Provisional).
70010000117260.description:
Fast-paced Arena Shooter
Dive into a fast-paced arena shooter where the controls are simple but the battles test your strategy!

Explore dungeons filled with summoners who unleash waves of enemies, relentless attackers, 
and the fearsome “Phantom” that hunts you down without mercy.

Level up to boost your stats and grab equipment from treasure chests to strengthen your character. 
With each upgrade offering random sets of three options, your character grows differently every time you play.

Choose three party members before entering the dungeon.
Each combination changes your active and passive skills, dramatically altering your tactics.

Clear all the challenges in each stage and defeat the mighty boss lurking in the depths of the dungeon!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A Game-Exclusive Story
Experience a brand-new, fully voiced adventure that branches off from the early events of The Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (Provisional)!.

After parting ways with Emalia, Hibiki takes on jobs to earn money together with Lillian, Claude, and Vene.
The group sets out into a forest to collect materials for a quest—a forest where people have been mysteriously disappearing.
Suddenly, they fall into a magical trap that whisks them away to a strange dungeon…

Will Hibiki and the others be able to escape from the dungeon?
And who is the mysterious girl they encounter within its depths?

70010000117266.name: Photo Girls: First Session
70010000117266.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000117266.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000117272.name: Good Girls: Angels With Dirty Intentions
70010000117272.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000117272.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:

• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000117286.name: Bad Girls: Naughty Hands
70010000117286.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000117286.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000117298.name: Frostholm Isle
70010000117298.description:
Frostholm Isle is a calm walking simulator set on a remote island inspired by Nordic legends and Viking-era villages. Explore at your own pace through snow-dusted paths, wooden longhouses, frozen shores, and quiet hills overlooking the sea. There is no combat, no danger, and no urgency!

Feel the crunch of snow beneath your feet as cold winds drift through the village. Distant waves crash against icy cliffs, and soft ambient sounds bring the island to life. Frostholm Isle is designed as a peaceful journey through a frozen world meant for reflection and rest.

Features:
> Relaxing Walking Simulator – Stress-free exploration with no combat or objectives
> Viking-Inspired Village – Longhouses, docks, runestones, and snowy paths
> Nordic Island Landscapes – Frozen coastlines, hills, and quiet open spaces
> Atmospheric Soundscape – Wind, sea, and subtle ambient music
> Meditative Experience – Slow, calming gameplay built for relaxation

A Quiet Northern Journey

70010000117301.name: Island Robot Farm
70010000117301.intro:
Robots, Farming, and Endless Expansion!
Manage a robot crew to build a massive island farm. Relax, grow, and expand your giant territory in this casual simulation.
70010000117301.description:
Island Robot Farm is a relaxing idle farm simulation game. Robots automate farming, production, animal husbandry, and construction to freely develop your massive island.

Automated Robots:
Each robot has unique abilities. Strategic task assignment boosts development efficiency. You can automate specific tasks or let them handle various island affairs autonomously.

Explore Alien Plants:
Beyond Earth's flora, build rockets to explore outer space, discover exotic plants, and bring them back to cultivate on your farm.

Business Simulation:
Experience fresh management gameplay: simply accept orders, plant, harvest, and craft. Sell your beverages to the entire universe!

Grow Crops, Flowers, and Fruits:
Cultivate a wide variety of plants. Process harvests into high-value products to maximize your farm's income.

Animal Husbandry:
Raise various land animals, harvest their products, and process them to further increase your resources and profits.

Sandbox Construction:
Place every tile freely to build and decorate a unique island. Unlock functional buildings and items as technology advances, and build a fully automated mega-island farm with your robots!

70010000117306.name: Sakura Peak
70010000117306.intro: Take the path. Breathe. Walk among the blossoms.
70010000117306.description:
Sakura Peak is a peaceful walking simulator set high in the sakura-covered mountains of feudal Japan. Wander at your own pace through tranquil landscapes inspired by samurai-era villages, quiet shrines, and endless cherry blossom valleys.

Let the wind guide you along mountain paths as petals fall around you. Listen to the soft sounds of nature, distant temples, and wooden bridges creaking beneath your feet. Sakura Peak is designed to help you slow down, breathe, and simply exist in a beautiful world.

Features:
>Relaxing Walking Simulator – Explore freely with no enemies, timers, or fail states
>Sakura Mountain Landscapes – Cherry blossom forests, misty peaks
>Samurai-Era Atmosphere – Traditional architecture, shrines, and peaceful rural paths
>Calming Soundscape – Gentle ambient music and natural environmental sounds
>Meditative Experience – Designed for relaxation, reflection, and stress relief


Every path in Sakura Peak is crafted to reward curiosity and calm exploration. Follow winding trails, pause to watch petals drift through the air, or stand silently as the sun sets behind the mountains. The world responds not with challenge, but with serenity.

70010000117309.name: Frost Vale
70010000117309.intro: Step into the cold. Explore the unknown.
70010000117309.description:
Welcome to Frost Vale, a frozen Nordic valley buried in snow, ice, and ancient mystery.

Explore a vast, icy landscape inspired by Nordic wilderness — towering mountains, frozen forests, and silent ruins hidden beneath the frost. Wander through the valley as you search for hidden locations.

There are no rushing timers — only the cold wind, the echo of your footsteps, and the thrill of discovery. 

 Features:

>Beautiful frozen Nordic valley environment

>Calm exploration-based gameplay

>Search for hidden secrets

>Atmospheric snow, ice, and winter scenery

>Immersive and relaxing experience

70010000117313.name: A Good Place To Die
70010000117313.intro: Survive endless zombie waves and grow stronger with every fight.
70010000117313.description:
Enter A Good Place To Die, where survival depends on skill and quick decisions. Face relentless zombie hordes inside a confined arena where danger never stops. Build your strength as you fight—every successful attack rewards you with points that can be instantly used to improve your weapons. Shape your playstyle on the go, reinforce your defenses with combat turrets, and turn the battlefield in your favor.

Key Features:
- Dynamic third-person combat with roguelite progression
- Arena-based survival against constantly increasing threats
- Instant weapon upgrades driven by combat performance
- Tactical turret placement and upgrades during battles
- Environmental healing mechanics for strategic survival
- Periodic boss encounters that escalate the challenge

Stay focused, adapt your tactics, and push your limits. How long can you hold your ground?

70010000117319.name: TORO 2
70010000117319.description:
Toro 2 is a third-person 3D bullfighting simulator that lets you, in its Career Mode, step into the shoes of a bullfighter on his rise to stardom. Travel the world facing the fiercest fighting bulls, avoid getting caught by them, and you’ll become a star in the world of bullfighting.

BECOME A STAR

From the pasture where you made your first cape passes to the world’s largest bullrings. Learn new passes and moves as you prove your worth at the Maestranza in Seville, Las Ventas in Madrid, or La Macarena in Medellín. Thrill the crowd with your elegance and panache, evade the fury of the fiercest bulls, and you’ll become the most famous bullfighter of all time.

YOUR GAME, YOUR BULLFIGHTER

Customize your character to your liking, choose the outfit you’ll wear when entering the ring, and build your arsenal of moves to tailor your style to your gameplay. Inside the bullring, you’re the master of ceremonies, so choose from a wide variety of moves, outfits, and more to make the crowd cheer for your courage.

EVERY BULLFIGHT IS A NEW CHALLENGE

Try to score as many points as possible through your bullfighting, while completing various challenges that will push your skills to the limit. Push your abilities to the max and make the most of the tools at your disposal to reach the pinnacle of bullfighting and become a Master.

TAKE ON YOUR FRIENDS

In the new Versus Mode, you can choose to be either the bull or the matador. Duel with your friends in fast-paced local one-on-one matches, where you’ll decide who controls the matador and who controls the bull. Battle in bullrings around the world and try to outdo your friends. The cunning and finesse of a well-executed pass versus the fury and momentum of a beast weighing hundreds of kilos charging toward you. Who will win?

70010000117325.name: Lion Simulator RPG: Animal Battle Survival
70010000117325.intro: Build your pride, defend your territory, and conquer the animal kingdom.
70010000117325.description:
Step into the wild as a mighty lion in Lion Simulator RPG: Animal Battle Survival. Roam vast savannahs, hunt prey, and defend your territory against rival animals and fierce predators. Build your pride by recruiting and protecting lionesses, and lead them to dominance in a dangerous ecosystem.

Experience realistic survival mechanics—manage hunger, stamina, and health while navigating dynamic weather and challenging environments. Engage in epic battles with other animals, sharpen your skills, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate alpha lion.

Key Features:
