• Realistic lion behavior and survival dynamics.
• Explore diverse landscapes—from open plains to dense forests.
• Form and lead a pride to conquer rivals.
• Hunt a variety of prey using stealth and power.
• Dynamic day-night cycles and weather impact gameplay.

Are you ready to rule the animal kingdom and survive the wild?

70010000117331.name: Primal Dinosaur Shooter - Dino Killer
70010000117331.intro: Hunt or be hunted in a world where every step could be your last.
70010000117331.description:
Step into a prehistoric world where danger is everywhere. Towering cliffs, dense jungles, and ancient predators surround you. You are a lone hunter — and survival is your only goal.

Your small metal base is your only safe place. Here you restore health and stamina, upgrade your medical injector, and improve your weapons and gear. Each new level unlocks stronger tools and deadly upgrades that help you face bigger threats.

Dinosaurs are both enemies and resources. Hunt them for skins, bones, and teeth, or go after the rare dinosaur eggs — high-risk, high-reward treasures guarded by the fiercest creatures.

Choose your challenge. In Arena Mode, face endless waves of predators where speed, accuracy, and movement are your best friends. In Mission Mode, infiltrate nests, grab eggs, and escape alive — sneak past enemies or fight your way through.

Every hunt makes you stronger. Earn skill points to boost health, endurance, or healing, and shape your hunter into a true apex predator.

Key Features:
- Survive a deadly prehistoric world filled with aggressive dinosaurs.
- Upgrade your base, weapons, and hunter skills to stay alive.
- Hunt dinosaurs for skins, bones, teeth, and rare eggs.
- Two intense modes: Arena (endless waves) and Missions (dangerous nests).
- Customize your hunter with skill points: tougher, faster, or faster healing.
- Collect resources, enhance your gear, and turn simple weapons into deadly tools.

Primal Dinosaur Shooter – Dino Killer — survive the wild, collect rare loot, and become the hunter dinosaurs fear.

70010000117337.name: Bibi & Tina – Ready, Set, Ride!
70010000117337.intro: A summer full of friendship, tournament excitement and horse-filled happiness!
70010000117337.description:
Summer holidays? Adventure time!
No sooner has Bibi returned to Martin's Farm than the next big adventure awaits: the Summer Cup is starting at Falkenstein Castle. Together with Tina and Alex, you compete in exciting riding disciplines – and show what friendship, fairness and a little bit of witchcraft can make possible.

New: carriage driving!
This has never been seen in a Bibi & Tina game before: Bibi, Tina and Alex have their very own vehicle ready for the Summer Cup. Steer a carriage along country tracks, through flower gates and around tight slalom courses! After all, champions do not only prove themselves in the saddle.

Stephanie wants the cup. At any cost.
Good thing you are not on your own. Stephanie von Schotterburg has her very own ideas about how to win – and the closer the final gets, the clearer her intentions become. Now it is time to show what really matters: friendship and sticking together. And, of course, Bibi’s witch power!

Ride, drive and fight your way to the final
Checkpoint courses, show jumps, flag collecting, ring jousting – every discipline brings you closer to the final, and every mistake costs points. Timing, skill and a good sense of direction decide who ends up on the winners’ podium.

You and your horse – a strong team!
A good competition does not begin at the starting line. Brush your horse, pick out its hooves, feed it and decorate it for the big performance. After tough races, cool it down with water.

What awaits you:
• Experience an exciting Bibi & Tina adventure – with lots of great tasks and horse-filled moments!
• Play as Bibi, Tina or Alex – together with Sabrina, Amadeus, Maharaja and seven more horses that you can unlock.
• Discover the special highlight: carriage driving with races and slalom courses.
• Train for different tournament disciplines and collect points for the final.
• Ride checkpoint races, show jumping, slalom, flag races, ring jousting and trail races.
• Care for your horse by brushing it, feeding it, picking out its hooves, decorating it and cooling it down.
• Explore familiar places such as Martin's Farm, Falkenstein Castle, the Old Mill, Wolf's Gorge, the forest and Redwell Castle.

70010000117346.name: Car Sales Simulator
70010000117346.intro: Grow from a small dealer into a successful automotive tycoon.
70010000117346.description:
Step into the world of used car trading where every deal can turn into big profit — or a costly mistake. Buy cheap vehicles from owners, negotiate for the best prices, restore damaged cars, and resell them to grow your business from a small garage into a successful reseller empire.

Explore different parts of the city in search of valuable deals, hidden bargains, and rare vehicles. From private sellers to competitive auctions, every opportunity depends on your negotiation skills, smart investments, and ability to spot profitable cars before anyone else.

As your business expands, you’ll restore more valuable vehicles, improve your workshop, and build a reputation as one of the city’s top car resellers. Every car has potential — if you can turn it into profit.

Key Features:
• Car Restoration: Clean, polish, and repair used vehicles to increase their market value before selling.
• Owner Negotiations: Bargain with car owners and lower prices to maximize your profit on every deal.
• Competitive Car Auctions: Join exciting auctions, outbid rivals, and win valuable or rare vehicles.
• Business Progression: Start small, grow your reputation, expand your workshop, and build a successful reseller career.
• Vehicle Variety: Buy and trade different types of used cars with unique conditions and values.

Turn cheap used cars into valuable profits and build your career as the city’s top car reseller. Every deal is a new opportunity to grow your business and expand your reputation.

70010000117352.name: Leafy Corner
70010000117352.intro: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game.
70010000117352.description:
Run the plant shop of your dreams in Leafy Corner, a cozy shop management game where you grow, sell, and care for real-life houseplants!

Step into the role of a plant shop owner. Grow plants, serve your customers, and create a warm, inviting space filled with greenery and charm.

Watch your plants grow over time, unfolding leaf by leaf as you care for them.

Not everyone knows what they’re looking for. Sometimes customers bring unusual or tricky requests. Finding just the right plant to fit their needs adds a fun challenge.

Decorate your shop with a variety of unlockable items, from shelves to plant pots. Pick colors that fit your mood and create a space that reflects your unique style.

KEY FEATURES
- Grow, care for, and sell 100+ unique plants.
- Discover plant variegations.
- Build and decorate your shop with a variety of pots, furniture, and decoration options.
- Fulfill orders and help customers.
- Complete tasks to progress your shop.
- Increase your shop’s reputation to unlock new content.
- Customize your character.

What Leafy Corner does NOT offer:
- Hardcore management (deep economy, hiring staff).
- Advanced plant care.
- Storyline.

70010000117360.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border
70010000117360.intro: Seal the border. Stop the outbreak. Survive the chaos.
70010000117360.description:
In Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border, you take on the role of a border guard in a world overwhelmed by a zombie outbreak. You must manage the arrival of survivors and prevent the spread of infection beyond the quarantine zone, making quick and responsible decisions.
Every person crossing the border can pose a risk, and every choice can change the fate of your area. As the situation grows increasingly tense, you will learn to prioritize and act under constant pressure.

Key Features:
	•	Access control: Carefully inspect people arriving at the border for signs of infection.
	•	Health assessment: Analyze suspicious symptoms to protect the safe zone.
	•	Critical decisions: Allow passage, quarantine, or eliminate threats depending on the situation.
	•	Quarantine management: Monitor and cleanse the isolation area when zombies appear.
	•	Rapid defense: Use tactical methods to neutralize threats.
	•	Resource recovery: Rest between shifts to maintain alertness.

Prepare to be the last line of defense in a world devastated by zombies, where only vigilance and correct decisions can save lives.

70010000117367.name: Angel Rhapsody
70010000117367.intro: A comical shooter where angels battle demons!
70010000117367.description:
Angel Rhapsody is a 2D shooting game.
Demons have possessed all kinds of things—hamburgers, sushi, Mount Rushmore, Mona Lisa, and more! Drive them back with an angel’s bow.

Defeat enemies to earn experience points and power up your angel! You can also strengthen mini angels that support your attacks.
Characters inspired by various countries such as the United States, Japan, the United Kingdom, and Germany make an appearance.
Conquer a variety of stages filled with famous classical music and traditional children’s songs.

70010000117373.name: Glowfall Vale
70010000117373.description:
Glowfall Vale is a relaxing walking simulator set in a mystical realm filled with soft magic, glowing landscapes, and ancient forgotten paths. Explore freely through enchanted valleys, luminous forests, floating lights, and quiet ruins where magic gently flows through the land. There are no objectives, no combat, and no danger — only wonder and calm.

As you walk, the world softly glows around you. Bioluminescent plants light the paths, magical particles drift through the air, and gentle ambient sounds create a dreamlike atmosphere. Glowfall Vale is designed to feel peaceful, warm, and otherworldly — a place to slow down and simply explore.

Features:
> Relaxing Walking Simulator – Stress-free exploration with no combat or fail states
> Mystical Fantasy Realm – Enchanted valleys and glowing flora
> Magical Atmosphere – Soft lighting, floating lights, and ambient magic effects
> Soothing Soundscape – Calm music and subtle magical ambience
> Meditative Experience – Built for relaxation, reflection, and escape

Glowfall Vale invites curiosity without pressure. Follow glowing trails, pause beside shimmering waterfalls, or stand quietly as magical lights drift past.

70010000117376.name: Evergreen Meadow
70010000117376.intro: Step into the meadow. Breathe. Explore.
70010000117376.description:
Evergreen Meadow is a cozy walking simulator set in wide, green meadows filled with gentle hills, quiet paths, and peaceful locations waiting to be discovered. There are no objectives, no combat, and no pressure!

Wander through rolling fields, small groves of trees, and tranquil clearings as soft ambient sounds surround you. Every location is designed to feel warm, safe, and unhurried, inviting you to slow down and enjoy the moment!

Features:
>Cozy Exploration – Walk freely through lush green meadows and scenic locations
>Relaxing Atmosphere – Calm lighting, soft colors, and gentle environmental sounds
>Casual Walking Simulator – No combat, no fail states, no stress
>Soothing Soundscape – Ambient music and natural meadow sounds
>Mindful Experience – Perfect for relaxation, stress relief, or quiet reflection

70010000117379.name: Love Too Easily 2: Summer Pocha
70010000117379.intro: Real-life dating simulation game "Love Too Easily 2: Summer Pocha."
70010000117379.description:
[Story]

"That night… did we just clink our glasses?"

You were living the life of an ordinary delivery man, and one day you get scammed by your only friend and end up taking over a failing, debt-ridden Pocha.

Wait... but why are there so many pretty girls at this Pocha?!


[About]

A story shaped entirely by your choices, 'Love Too Easily 2: Summer Pocha' is an FMV simulation game where the story unfolds in a Pocha with five attractive girls.

Become the owner of a Pocha and win over the affection of the girls you like to find your true love!

Pick the right choices to raise affection levels, and show your feelings with thoughtful gifts!

[Characters]

Five girls, each with her own charm and personality!

Who will you choose?

●Adorable Pocha part-timer: Choi Sol (Lee Heeru)

Overflowing with cuteness—the bright and bubbly mascot of the Pocha!

“Good morning, boss!”

●Pocha regular/writer: Anna (Shin Jiwon/Johyun)

Professional and elegant… yet secretly a goofy heavy drinker!

“Can you be the main character of my story?”


●Heartwarming first love classmate: Sarang (Yang Seul)

A first love with its secret innocence..!
“How.. have you been? Finally, we meet again..”


●Famous streamer: Gain (Oh Yeonha)

Bright, bubbly, and impossible to ignore on camera!
“Then let’s drop the formalities—call me your girl, oppa~”


●Proud indie band singer: Nana (Eun Daha)

Cool, sharp, and fiercely independent—like a desert fox.
“What..? So?”

70010000117391.name: Sand Seeker
70010000117391.intro: Walk the ancient paths. Seek what was lost.
70010000117391.description:
Welcome to Sand Seeker, an exploration adventure set in an ancient desert city on the edge of the pyramids.

Roam sunlit streets, sandstone buildings, hidden alleys, and open desert paths as the great pyramids loom in the distance. Search for lost locations scattered throughout the city and surrounding sands. Every corner tells a story shaped by time, sand, and history.

Sand Seeker focuses on atmospheric exploration — no rush, no pressure — just discovery in a timeless desert world.

Features:

>Ancient Egyptian-inspired city environment

>Search-and-find exploration gameplay

>Hidden secrets to uncover

>Immersive desert atmosphere

70010000117394.name: Astrophidia
70010000117394.description:
Guide a cosmic serpent in Astrophidia, an arcade action game inspired by the classic Snake combined with a Match twist!

• Devour Planets to score points while switching orbits to avoid Asteroids and reach your target.
• Match planets of the same type in your body and Consume them! The higher the match, the higher the bonus.
• Rotate planets and asteroids to open new paths.
• Use the Drop Tail skill strategically to reorder your planets.
• Be careful: each asteroid collision will destroy several planets and can even kill you!

Legend says that when the cosmic serpent has had its fill, a Space Storm will trigger and a Portal will appear. Enduring the storm's dangers can lead to higher bonuses, while entering the portal leads to another area with higher multipliers, but also increasing speed!

70010000117400.name: JAWS: Retro Edition
70010000117400.intro: This is the ultimate JAWS challenge, and this time, survival is not guaranteed.
70010000117400.description:
This can’t be happening. There has never been a Great White in these waters before. Never. This is more than a coincidence. This shark is different. Relentless. As if it’s hunting you down… like it’s personal.

You’d better prepare yourself and strike back before it’s too late. Will you use the mini-sub, seaplane, sailboat, or scuba gear? Maybe it won’t even matter. Remember, you’re dealing with an unbelievably powerful eating machine.

Quick, grab your weapons, pack your explosives, and check your maps. It’s out there. You know it. And it’s coming for you. This is serious. This is the ultimate JAWS challenge!

JAWS: Retro Edition Features
• Save anywhere
• Rewind
• Achievements/Trophies
• Music Player
• Gallery

JAWS: Enhanced Edition Features
• A massively expanded, multi-chapter adventure with nods and homages to all four JAWS films
• New quests and objectives
• New abilities and weapons for both boat and diver
• More challenging enemies, and more ways to take them down
• A deeper realization of the original game’s role-playing roots

70010000117406.name: Cento
70010000117406.intro:
Feel the rhythm, enter commands, unleash your skills!
Cento, a turn-based rhythm battle for two.
Build your deck and clash across countless songs!
70010000117406.description:
■Unique battle system
Enter commands in rhythm and activate skills. Play a clever beat according to the combination of cards in your hand and your opponent's attacks. 

■Variety of stages
Fight on stages with different BGMs, from the city to ruins. The playing experience changes depending on the tempo and beat of the music.

■Customize your deck
Create your own deck by freely combining skills and gifts received from existing characters. Let's find the strongest combination.

■Endurance mode
Aim for consecutive battles while reinforcing your skills and obtaining gifts. Unleash a powerful attack with new skills.

70010000117414.name: Mistfall Ruins
70010000117414.intro: Follow the mist. Discover the forgotten.
70010000117414.description:
Enter Mistfall Ruins, an enchanted forest where ancient stone structures rise through drifting mist.

Wander through glowing woods, winding paths, and forgotten clearings as you explore the glorious Ruins of Mistfall. Each ruin tells a story of a lost age, hidden deep within the forest. Discover different regions, uncover secrets, and seek out every ruin scattered across the land.

Mistfall Ruins is all about exploration, atmosphere, and wonder — rewarding curiosity and careful discovery.

Features:
>Enchanted forest environment
>Majestic ancient ruins to discover
>Multiple areas to explore
>Calm, atmospheric exploration gameplay
>Hidden scenic locations

70010000117417.name: Escape Prison Obby: Getaway
70010000117417.intro: You’re locked up… but not for long.
70010000117417.description:
Escape Prison Obby: Getaway is a fast-paced parkour (obby) adventure where your goal is simple: break out of prison and reach the escape helicopter!

Features:
>Fun and challenging obby parkour gameplay
>Tricky jumps, moving obstacles, and traps
>Race to reach the helicopter and complete your getaway
>Perfect for casual and competitive players

Do you have what it takes to escape the prison and make a clean getaway?

70010000117442.name: Murders on the Yangtze River
70010000117442.description:
Murders on the Yangtze River is a Chinese-style side-scrolling detective adventure game developed by OMEGAMES STUDIO.
There is no such thing as a perfect crime — only clues that have yet to be discovered.

- Every Trace Leaves a Mark -

Set in the turbulent era of the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, where ancient and modern, Eastern and Western cultures collided and intertwined, you will step into the role of the protagonist and become entangled in an unavoidable conspiracy.

Seemingly unrelated events gradually lead you toward a massive mystery and the secrets hidden behind your own identity.

A lie is simply a fact disguised in another form. Can you uncover the truth hidden beneath layers of deception and piece together the final answer from a series of intertwined cases?

- A Meticulously Crafted Logic-Based Mystery -

During your journey, you will encounter a series of bizarre and perplexing cases. To uncover the truth behind each incident and identify the culprit, you will need to:

Explore different locations as the story unfolds, searching for every hidden clue and subtle detail.

Investigate crime scenes, collect evidence, and question witnesses.

Even uncover contradictions and loopholes hidden within the testimonies you have gathered...

- Intricate Cases with Twists and Turns -

The seemingly unrelated cases that occur across different locations are, in fact, connected by countless threads to the greater mystery surrounding the protagonist.

Behind every case lies an ingenious method of crime and a deeply moving motive.

Every ordinary person carries their own complicated past, with countless hidden conflicts and entangled relationships.

Can you unravel every layer of the mystery, discover the ultimate truth behind the grand case, and complete your journey of revenge?

- A Breathtaking Chinese Ink Painting World -

Follow a beautifully unfolding ink-wash scroll as you travel through the landscapes of China over a century ago.

Sail across Dongting Lake and encounter the historic Yueyang Tower once again;

Travel along the Yangtze River and explore the steampunk-inspired Hanyang Iron Works;

Wander through the misty waterways and elegant scenery of Jiangnan in Yangzhou;

Step into the dazzling streets of Shanghai’s foreign concessions and experience the city's retro modernity from a century ago...

Every scene is carefully crafted like a living painting, inviting you to experience local cultures, explore historical landscapes, and solve mysteries across different regions.

- Meticulously Researched Historical and Cultural Design -

The game's world, art style, and environments are based on extensive research from museum archives, historical photographs, and discussions with experts in history and culture.

The story is built upon real historical backgrounds, recreating the architecture, landscapes, and social atmosphere of China over a hundred years ago.

From carefully researched character costumes to authentic everyday objects, every detail is designed to immerse you in the rich historical and cultural atmosphere of the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China.

70010000117473.name: Culdcept BEGINS Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000117473.intro: Led by dice. Ruled by cards
70010000117473.description:
A hidden classic that fuses board and card games, Culdcept features a unique, innovative system that has captivated fans since its debut. Players become Cepters, wielding cards in intense battles where luck and strategy collide. After ten years, a brand-new story begins once again.

●What is Culdcept?
It is a game where you move across the board, claim territories, and build strategies using cards.
Use summons and magic to fight your way to victory.

●Story
Bavrashka, a continent created by the gods.
At its center lies the Royal Cept Academy, an insitute where Cepters are trained to wield the power of stone tablets known as "Culds," fragments of the Culdcept.
Kamur, who transferred to the Cept Academy, has his abilities recognized and is selected for the Royal Cepter Guard Regiment.
Amid battles that threaten the continent, the power of a Cepter begins to awaken.

●Game System
Move with dice and battle with cards—
This is a board game where victory hangs on a mix of luck and strategy.
Experience a more accessible evolution of Culdcept that stays true to the series’ charm.

●Cards
Over 400 cards with all-new visuals.
Combine all kinds of cards to win through the power of your own tactics.

・Creature Cards
These are cards that allow you to summon creatures.
They can help you gain more domains, or take over enemy domains.
There are five elements, and each card has different abilities.

・Item Cards
Item cards support your creatures in battle.
And that's not to say they simply help creatures attack and defend better.
Using the special abilities of items can help you snatch victory from the jaws of defeat!

・Spell Cards
Spell cards can help you build momentum, or put your opponents in a difficult position.
Use them right and you can even turn the tides of the game in the blink of an eye.
Suffice to say, these cards are essential to winning.

70010000117478.name: YOLKED
70010000117478.intro: Keep climbing, keep swinging, and never lose your grip.
70010000117478.description:
Step into a chaotic, fast-paced escape where you control a fragile yet determined egg with arms, fighting through dangerous attic-filled levels in a desperate attempt to break free. Every stage is packed with unstable platforms, shifting hazards, and unpredictable physics that constantly threaten to crack your shell. Survival depends on precision, timing, and staying one piece under pressure.

Across each level, you’ll swing, climb, and launch your egg through increasingly complex environments where no two runs feel the same.
Multiple paths and hidden routes encourage experimentation, speed, and smarter movement, rewarding those who master both control and creativity.

As you progress, the challenge escalates with faster sections, tighter spaces, and more demanding obstacles, pushing your skills to the limit. Along the way, you’ll unlock a wide variety of egg costumes, giving your fragile hero personality while you fight through chaos toward freedom.

Key Features
• Throw yourself into freedom through dangerous egg-filled stages
• Discover multiple routes for optimal speed and better runs
• Unlock a variety of costumes for your egg and customize your look
• Survive physics-based chaos where every move can crack or save you
• Master increasingly difficult levels packed with traps and hazards

Stay steady, avoid cracking, and guide your egg to freedom in this unpredictable escape.

70010000117484.name: Night Club Manager Simulator
70010000117484.intro: Build hype, manage the flow, and keep the party in motion.
70010000117484.description:
Step into the electrifying world of nightlife and prove you have what it takes to run the city’s hottest club. In Night Club Manager Simulator, you play as a bold young entrepreneur chasing one dream — to turn an abandoned, forgotten venue into the ultimate party destination.

Start from nothing but debts and determination. Renovate your rundown space, hire your crew, and make every night unforgettable. The music, the lights, the crowd — every detail is in your hands.

Game Features:
• Club Development: Monitor the atmosphere, reputation, and income — do everything to keep your club in the spotlight.
• Staff Management: Hire security, cleaners, bartenders, and DJs. Each employee affects your club’s success and guest satisfaction.
• Technical Challenges: Fix the sound system, set up equipment, and ensure perfect music quality for unforgettable parties.
• Interior and Atmosphere: Redesign the club’s interior, add lighting, furniture, and décor to attract more visitors and create a unique vibe.
• Events and Unpredictability: Be ready for fights, messes, and equipment breakdowns. React quickly and keep order by calling security, cleaners, or a DJ.

Night Club Manager Simulator is more than just a management game — it’s a story about how passion and persistence turn dreams into success. Create an atmosphere people will remember. Manage, grow, and become an icon of the nightlife scene.

70010000117490.name: Bodycamera FPS
70010000117490.intro: Warning: May cause sudden tactical overthinking.
70010000117490.description:
Step into the fight exactly as it happens — no filters, no hero shots, just you, your weapon, and the harsh truth of close-quarters combat.
Bodycamera FPS throws you straight into the action with a true body-cam perspective, where every movement feels raw, shaky, and dangerously real.

This isn’t run-and-gun chaos. It’s tight corners, split-second decisions, and the kind of tension that makes you hold your breath without noticing. Every peek matters. Every sound counts. Every mistake is loud.

Think before you push. Communicate or crumble. Clear rooms with precision, read the environment like your life depends on it, and trust your instincts when everything goes sideways.

Fast? Not always. Intense? Always.

When the lens becomes your eyes… there’s nowhere to hide.

70010000117518.name: Smash it Wild
70010000117518.intro: Smash it Wild is a tactical turn-based game combining volleyball and dodgeball in a fantasy universe.
70010000117518.description: Dive into a fantasy world where champions face off in an unforgiving tournament. In Smash it Wild, every match counts, mixing volleyball and dodgeball in tactical turn-based gameplay. Upgrade your players, kit them out with powerful items, discover unique synergies and do your best to survive this roguelike competition where defeat means starting all over again.

70010000117523.name: Fractured Worlds
70010000117523.description:
Fractured Worlds is a Dark Fantasy Action RPG set in a reality that has been broken into pieces by the ambition of its inhabitants. Now, guided by a mysterious voice, you must explore these broken realms, piece together the past, and confront those responsible for this cataclysmic event.

Deliberate, Precision-Based Combat
Each weapon has its own weight, speed and moveset. From two handed maces with slow staggering attacks, to nimble spears perfect for crowd controlling enemies and magic wands controlling the flow of Aether - everything plays and feels different. The classless progression system allows for multiple respecs so it’s easy to try a little bit of everything or adjust your character to a particularly powerful Legendary item you find.

Encounter Other Players
Reality's distortion means that the worlds of other players might briefly overlap with yours. You can choose to interact with them, or simply continue on your own path. You can invade and assist, support and deceive, share a profitable loot pile or lure other players into a particularly deadly mob of enemies and collect the spoils once they are dealt with.

Explore Diverse, Broken Realms 
Journey through unique procedural environments that are fragments of former worlds. Navigate medieval Dungeons, the mystical enchanted Forests, volcanic landscapes, and future industrial Cities. Find memory fragments that reveal the stories of those affected by the cataclysm, helping you understand what happened and mend the broken world.

Share a Piece of Your World
Map Shards are powerful artifacts that allow players to share a piece of their world with others. Map Shards create a co-operative instance with random modifiers that unpredictably alters the monsters that inhabit the area and boost the loot they are guarding. When sharing the area with others, players can comment on it letting everyone know about what to expect in the area: vast riches or especially challenging encounters.

Face Challenging Bosses 
Confront powerful bosses that stand in your way. Battle the Treasure Golem, the mind-altering Rorsch, the imposing Ghostly Knight, and many more. Each boss encounter is a tough and deadly challenge where a single mistake can cost you a significant chunk of your health if played poorly. But every action in these fights is thoughtfully designed and well-telegraphed, so with practice, you can conquer even the greatest foe.

Fractured Worlds offers a journey through a broken reality, focusing on direct action and the task of restoring what was lost.

70010000117528.name: Manafinder
70010000117528.intro: Become a Manafinder and survive in an untamed magical world
70010000117528.description:
Manafinder is a RPG with rich exploration, nostalgic turn-based combat, and original pixel art.

In a vast and untapped world, powerful wild beasts roam the dangerous lands. A community of survivors known as the exiles depends on heroes like Lambda to obtain the power of manastones to keep their civilization safe.

Fight your way against ferocious beasts and other enemies in the quest for manastones as you define the fate of the exiled! 


Features
* Nostalgic fantasy role-playing game
* Explore the fantastical world of Aevi
* Meet diverse and interesting characters
* Collect items, weapons, and elemental ores
* Your choices matter

70010000117531.name: Birushana: Winds of Fate Digital Art Book
70010000117531.intro: A new wind, carrying a future yet unknown...
70010000117531.description: The Digital Art Book & Short Stories includes illustrations, rough art, and character bios, plus nine romantic short stories—one for each love interest.

70010000117543.name: Middle Evil: The Priest
70010000117543.intro: Can you cleanse the church from evil?
70010000117543.description:
A righteous young priest arrives at a remote village in the Middle Ages to cleanse the local church from evil infestation.

Take up your holy weapons to battle with skeletons, ghosts, vampires, and other invading demonic creatures. Get assistance from the villagers and the underworld alike, sing prayers, and work divine miracles.

Can you survive 7 nights of onslaught and rid the church of demonic possession?


Features 
* Challenging combat gameplay
* Middle Ages-inspired dark atmosphere
* Sing prayers and perform miracles

70010000117546.name: Backrooms: Poolrooms
70010000117546.intro: Time is running out... and the waters are rising
70010000117546.description:
Backrooms: Poolrooms ... The Poolrooms hold secrets that should never be uncovered...

Strange deaths are plaguing the Poolrooms, and now it's your turn to investigate the horrifying mystery. Bodies have been found floating in the endless, dimly lit pools, their faces twisted in terror. The Poolrooms are no ordinary place - something dark and deadly has taken root, and it's not alone. 

Strange entities have infiltrated the area, stalking you through the water-soaked halls. But they are not like any creature you’ve ever encountered. These entities are invisible, only detectable by the faintest splash they leave behind. As you search for the required things scattered throughout this nightmarish maze, you must be careful, as every step could reveal your position.

But it’s not just the entities you need to watch out for. The waters are teeming with fish, their movements sending ripples through the pool and alerting nearby horrors to your presence. Every splash could be the last sound you ever hear. If you’re too careless, your position will be compromised, and the deadly entities will be upon you.

Can you survive the horrors lurking in the Poolrooms, or will you become another lost soul drifting beneath the surface? Time is running out... and the waters are rising.


Features:
* Investigate the Poolrooms: Explore an eerie, endless labyrinth of pools, flooded hallways, and chilling environments filled with mystery and danger.

* Invisible Entities: The creatures haunting the Poolrooms are invisible to the naked eye. Track them by their splashes and keep a careful watch on your surroundings.

* Dangerous Fish: Watch out for fish lurking in the water - their splashes will give away your position, making you vulnerable to the entities hunting you.

* Tension-filled Atmosphere: A nerve-wracking sound design keeps you on edge, amplifying every footstep, splash, and movement in the darkness.

70010000117549.name: Quest Arrest
70010000117549.intro: Be a police officer in this retro-styled RPG
70010000117549.description:
Detective Allison Bennett on a quest for clean up her city, Strange Meadows, after the recent crime spree that has thrown the community into chaos.

Notorious gang leader Athena been terrorizing the residents and set her sights on taking over the city for herself. Will you play as a good cop or a bad cop, by arresting criminals or simply taking them out?

Your choices matter in this story-rich law enforcement RPG.


Features
* Be a cop and conduct arrests
* Classic RPG gameplay
* Thousands of lines of dialog 
* Multiple endings
* Gameboy Color aesthetic

70010000117552.name: Tales of Formentera
70010000117552.intro: Explore the island of Formentera and uncover its stories and ancient legends
70010000117552.description:
Tales of Formentera is an adventure game set on a small island inspired by the real landscapes of Formentera, where old legends shape its history. Something mysterious is happening, and the people of the island need your help to uncover the truth.

Explore the island freely, visit its most iconic locations, and talk to the locals to learn about their stories, traditions, and legends. You will piece together clues that help you understand what is really going on. 

Throughout your journey, you will discover hidden places, solve puzzles, collect unique items, and help islanders with optional side quests. Tales of Formentera invites you to explore at your own pace and uncover the secrets of an island full of history, mystery, and charm.


Features:
* Adventure game focused on exploration and discovery
* An open island inspired by the real locations of Formentera
* Interact with islanders and learn about their stories and legends
* Puzzles integrated into the environment
* Optional side quests where you help the locals
* Collectibles hidden throughout the island

70010000117555.name: Alien Cat 2 - Retro Collection
70010000117555.intro: Will this black alien cat save the universe?
70010000117555.description:
Our cat and his beloved goldfish were exploring distant planets and galaxies when he suddenly crashed on an unknown planet.

Miraculously surviving, he discovered the planet was inhabited by horrific skeletal monsters.

To escape the planet, he'll have to repair his ship by scavenging bolts and fuel from the planet's labyrinths.

But be careful, the planet creates copies of the cat to complicate his escape. Avoid mines, sharp spikes, and enemies.


Features:
* Dynamic gameplay.
* Clones go synchronically with Cat.
* Old-school graphics.
* Simple controls.

70010000117558.name: Soulshard
70010000117558.intro: A puzzle platfoming journey through the shadow between life and death
70010000117558.description:
In a realm between life and death, a confused soul seeks redemption and freedom from a past life filled with misguided choices.

Playing alone or together via co-op multiplayer, command a soul in search of the exit from this dark and desolate realm.

Use the environment to your advantage and avoid treacherous traps to clear 30 challenging levels of hauntingly morose pixel art.


Features
* Puzzle platforming gameplay
* Single player or co-op multiplayer
* Gloomy 2D pixel art
* 30 challenging levels and 6 clever mechanics

70010000117566.name: LOZT: Legion of Zombie Terrors
70010000117566.intro: A military experiment has turned all of the troops into ZOMBIES.. With weapons!
70010000117566.description:
Zombies are coming! The military research division has made a terrible mistake and now much of humanity has been turned into rage filled zombies. Some of them are slow, some are fast, and lots of them have weapons!

Fight your way through waves of zombies in the suburbs and city in an effort to survive and hopefully escape this nightmare.

70010000117571.name: Hello, Mario!
70010000117571.description:
"Hello, Mario!" Are you ready to play? With this free application from the little-kid-friendly My Mario brand, you and your kiddo can play with Mario's face and delight in all his various expressions.
 
■Make Silly Faces
Team up with your kiddo to see how silly Mario can get when you pull and stretch his face or take turns poking and spinning him around. Tap on the ? Block in the top-left corner of the screen and select an icon to make items—like a Super Mushroom, a Super Star, or pipes—and even enemies appear alongside Mario.
 
■Peekaboo!
Invite Mario to play peekaboo by tapping on the leftmost icon in the ? Block menu. Boo may even make a guest appearance! 

■Built-In Breaks
Good night, Mario! Mario gets tuckered out after playing for a while and will fall fast asleep. At that point no amount of poking can wake him up! This is a great opportunity to take a break and help parents limit their child's screen time. If you want to keep the fun going, you can turn off this feature by tapping the gear icon in the top-right corner of the screen when the application starts.
 
■Play Offline
There's no need to be connected to the internet to play this application. After you download it, you're good to go!

Operation is not guaranteed for all devices that meet the operating conditions. It may not work properly depending on the device's performance and specifications, device-specific application usage conditions, etc.

Please be sure to read the Health and Safety information provided in the application settings before you start playing. Settings can be accessed by tapping the gear icon in the top-right corner of the screen when the application starts to access the menu.

Terms of Service:
https://support.nintendo.com/en/legal-notes/my-mario-eula-selector

70010000117576.name: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko‘s Mystery Dungeon -Classic HD-
70010000117576.intro: A thousand adventures in one! — Discover the roots of the Mystery Dungeon series
70010000117576.description:
Originally released only in Japan, the first entry in the Mystery Dungeon series and prequel to Torneko: The Last Hope is finally making its international debut!

Packed with the challenge, tension, and rewarding gameplay of a classic roguelike adventure, this is a journey we're excited for a new generation of players take on!

"He's Not a Hero. He's a Merchant. And He's Here to Close the Deal."

Set after the events of DRAGON QUEST IV, this is the story of Torneko, a man who dreams of becoming the world's greatest weapons merchant. One day, he hears rumors of a mysterious dungeon said to contain incredible treasures. In search of a legendary treasure that no one has ever managed to bring back, Torneko sets out for the Mystery Dungeon.

■ Gameplay
Every decision matters. No safety nets. 

Every time you enter, the Mystery Dungeon takes on a new form. That's the essence of the Mystery Dungeon series. Items and monsters change with every expedition, and each new journey begins from Level 1.

In this turn-based adventure, every step Torneko takes counts as a turn. Whenever he moves, the monsters move too, making every decision a matter of survival. Defeat enemies to gain experience and level up, gather equipment and items to grow stronger, and venture ever deeper in search of treasure. The deeper you go, the more powerful the monsters become.

If you are defeated in the dungeon, all the items you have collected will be lost, and your next attempt will begin again from Level 1 on the first floor. It's a dungeon-crawling RPG worthy of the claim to offer "a thousand adventures in one"!

■ Expand Your Shop with the Items You Collect!
If you can safely bring items back from the dungeon, you can gradually expand Torneko's shop. As the shop grows, you will be able to store more equipment and items between adventures, creating a lasting sense of progress even as each journey begins from Level 1.

■ Difficulty Options
Customize the challenge of the Mystery Dungeon to suit your playstyle! Whether you're entering the Mystery Dungeon for the first time or returning as a seasoned dungeon crawler seeking the ultimate challenge, adjustable difficulty settings let you enjoy the adventure your way—and keep you coming back for more.

—Experience is your only weapon.
Return to the roots of the Mystery Dungeon genre and take on the very first adventure—one that continues to captivate fans to this day!

70010000117596.name: CRYZON part4
70010000117596.intro:
Get the crystals!!
Play in split-screen multiplayer with 1-4 players!
30 stages! Normal and Hard difficulty!
70010000117596.description:
The objective is to use jumps and dashes to obtain crystals on the stage.
The stage is a 3D space with vertical, horizontal, and depth. Gravity is present, and players control the player by moving forward, backward, left, right, and vertically with jumps to reach the crystal.

Features
・Clear the stage once you obtain a crystal!
・30 stages in total!
・Choose your difficulty level: Normal mode is relatively easy to clear. Hard mode is extremely challenging.
・Crystals will appear as you collect coins!
・Support split-screen play for up to four players!
・Use items to improve your abilities!
・Defend enemies.
・Swords are available as weapons.
・Use evasive actions to move.
・Defend with a shield.

Multiplayer
・Work together to collect coins!
・Work together to defeat enemies!
・Be the first to obtain a crystal!
・Player attacks are also possible!

70010000117609.name: Clover Reset
70010000117609.intro: A yuri novel game that you'll fall in love with at first sight. this is a youthful story of girls wavering between friendship and love.
70010000117609.description:
"99% sweetness × 1% surprise"!?
"Hey, do you know the meaning of the four-leaf clover?"
A fully-voiced, youthful yuri visual novel you'll fall in love with at first sight is coming to Nintendo Switch™!

【Synopsis】
The wheels of fate begin to turn.
The girls meet, fall in love, and deepen their bonds.
"Hey, do you know the meaning of the four-leaf clover?"
Set at "Shonan Saika Academy," a prestigious school in Shonan, Kanagawa Prefecture, this is a youthful story of girls wavering between friendship and love.
Shonan Saika Academy, a high-achieving all-girls school in Kanagawa Prefecture.

One day, Marin Tachibana, along with her best friends Mashiro Saotome and Kiyoka Jinguji, experiences a special day.
It begins with meeting an unusual new transfer student, Shizuku Kujyo.
A beautiful girl with a calm and dignified demeanor.
Meeting her feels like déjà vu...
While showing her around the school, they stop by an observation deck, where Marin finds a four-leaf clover.
There is a tradition at this school:
If you press a four-leaf clover found on the observation deck into your student notebook, your wish will come true.
(I want to get closer to her. To spend more time with her...)
With this wish, Marin gives Shizuku the "coincidental" four-leaf clover she found.
This act becomes a turning point, bringing Marin and Shizuku closer together with the help of Mashiro and Kiyoka. However...
"Please, stop worrying about me. I don't want to just be protected..."
"Shizuku, we're friends, right?"
A storm threatens to tear them apart.
It is deeply tied to a "secret" Shizuku is hiding and a "trauma" from Marin's past.
The story follows the growth, mutual support, and cherished memories of the four girls.
Will Marin and the others find their personal "clover" (happiness)?

【Localization】
In addition to Japanese, supports English and Chinese (Traditional and Simplified)!

【Main Character】
Gentle and healing girl-----Marin Tachibana (立花 茉鈴)
CV: Saho Shirasuna

Cool and beautiful girl-----Shizuku Kujyo (九条 しずく)
CV: Yuki Takada

Bright and cheerful mood-maker-----Mashiro Saotome (早乙女 真白)
CV: Yuki Kuwahara

Caring older-sister type-----Kiyoka Jinguji (神宮寺 清香)
CV: Noriko Shibasaki

【Special】
Dynamic Character Expressions System.
Express characters' emotions in greater variety!
Enhance immersion!

【Theme Song】
"Clover Reset"
Music, Lyrics, Arrangement: Shoichiro Toko
Vocals: Saho Shirasuna (as Marin Tachibana)

70010000117619.name: Escape From Duck
70010000117619.intro: Master the battlefield or fall in the chaos.
70010000117619.description:
You wake up in a dangerous zone where survival is the only rule. Waves of armed enemies attack without mercy, and one wrong move can end your run. Fight smart, use the environment, and prove you have what it takes to escape. Each run is a test of skill and awareness. One mistake can end everything. Learn enemy patterns, control the battlefield, and prove you have what it takes to escape.

Key Features:
• Wave-based combat with relentless enemies
• Fast-paced firefights on an optimized, action-focused map
• Ranged enemies with custom AI and tactical shooting behavior
• Loot pickups (armor, health, grenades) to keep you in the fight
• Responsive movement and shooting mechanics for precise control

Escape is never guaranteed. Learn the battlefield, adapt to every wave, and fight until the last moment. Only skill keeps you alive.

70010000117624.name: SwooshCat
70010000117624.intro: SwooshCat is a vibrant precision-platformer adventure. Leap, dash, slash, stab, roll, and ricochet your way through a charming pixel world as you help a brave little cat  explore and battle!
70010000117624.description:
SwooshCat – A precision platformer starring an adorable feline! Master simple jumps and dashes to embark on a challenging yet delightful adventure. 

Slash, Parry, Break, Dodge – Your dash isn't just movement: it's a combat blade and puzzle key!

Explore lush jungles and scorching deserts, each meticulously packed with deadly traps and cunning mechanisms to challenge your skills and strategy!

Turn foes into stepping stones – Chain kills, parries, and dashes to bounce off corpses and bullets, resetting mobility to reach "impossible" corners!

Easy to learn, deep to master: Newbies leap right in; speedrunners face brutal challenges!

Buttery controls + Rich level design = An unmissable catventure!

70010000117632.name: Color Mismatch Brain Quiz
70010000117632.intro:
Simple brain training: spot the mismatch between color and words.
Top shows the color, bottom shows the word.
70010000117632.description:
This is a brain-training game where the text color and the word’s meaning don’t match—choose the correct answer!

The rules are simple:
Focus on the color of the word at the top of the screen, and choose from the options below based on the word’s meaning.

It looks easy, yet it tricks you every time…
Enjoy the oddly challenging fun of the Stroop effect in a casual, pick-up-and-play format!

With 4-choice, 6-choice, and 8-choice modes, the difficulty increases step by step—great for beginners and for those who want a real mental workout.

Designed for quick sessions, it’s perfect for short breaks in your day!

70010000117644.name: Virballs
70010000117644.description: Six outlandish planets are overrun with Virballs - viral elemental creatures that consume each other to create exotic hybrids. Clean up this ecological disaster using Virball hybrids as devastating weapons!

70010000117646.name: Habitat Shapes: The Tropical Journey
70010000117646.intro: Build, Discover, and Bring Nature to Life
70010000117646.description:
Get ready for a relaxing and charming journey in Habitat Shapes: The Tropical Journey, a delightful puzzle where every piece finds its place in nature. Arrange adorable creatures and complete unique environments as you transform each board into a vibrant, living habitat.

With intuitive and fluid gameplay, you can place pieces freely without complicated rules, creating natural and satisfying solutions. Just pick, rotate, and fit pieces together while enjoying a calm pace that rewards creativity and spatial thinking.

Explore 30 levels across three enchanting biomes, including colorful tropical settings full of personality. Each stage brings new shapes, gentle challenges, and that rewarding sense of progress with every perfect fit.

With cozy visuals, a light atmosphere, and puzzles designed to relax without pressure, Habitat Shapes: The Tropical Journey is perfect for players who love organizing, completing, and seeing everything come together beautifully.

Observe, experiment, and fill every space to create the perfect habitat.

70010000117652.name: Courier
70010000117652.intro: He woke up with nothing. The city is about to have the same problem.
70010000117652.description:
Conrad wakes up in a hotel room with no memory of who he is or how he got there. What he does know: a deadly virus is tearing through cyberspace, Ankh Industries is behind it, and the clock is already ticking.

Navigate the cyberpunk streets of the City as Conrad, a rogue Courier piecing together the truth. Take on jobs from shady employers, pickpocket and loot to earn credits, and spend them on better guns, stronger armor, and high-tech upgrades. Hack your way through security systems using an intricate beam puzzle minigame, and dig deeper into the conspiracy threatening to bring the whole city down.

- Explore a richly detailed cyberpunk city in a brand new 8-bit adventure
- Earn and spend credits on weapons, armor, and tech upgrades
- Hack security systems with an intricate beam puzzle minigame
- Unravel the mystery behind Ankh Industries and the Courier virus

70010000117659.name: HestiaFort
70010000117659.intro: At the end of the blue sky that spreads out like the sea, HestiaFort
70010000117659.description:
Shuri, the people of the sky, became a messenger of the golden dragon of the king of the sky and headed for HestiaFort.

In HestiaFort, there is a Red Bird.

Together with Shuri, run through HestiaFort to meet the Red Bird.

In this game, you will avoid the red ball and aim for the blue circle.

Run and fly through stages to reach the goal.

70010000117666.name: EGGCONSOLE MUGEN NO SHINZOU III PC-8801mkIISR
70010000117666.intro: The epic conclusion to the Mugen no Shinzou series. After escaping the Dream World, the warrior’s long-awaited homecoming is cut short by a new, unforeseen trial!
70010000117666.description:
Originally released by Crystal Soft in 1990, this classic RPG follows the series' tradition of seamless storytelling. Just as "II" picked up right after the conclusion of the first game, this title begins the moment "II" ends. The story starts with a veteran warrior, who has survived countless adventures in the Dream World (Mugen-kai), finally returning to the nostalgic sights of their home world.

The game features a top-down perspective with symbol encounters (on-screen enemies). Players will form a party of up to four members to explore the world. While the protagonist is human, the potential allies are incredibly diverse—ranging from familiar races like Elves and Dwarves to formidable beings like Dragons and Giants. In a unique mechanical twist, equipment is tied to Race rather than Class, making your party composition a vital strategic choice. Upon reaching Level 13, you can select specific abilities to undergo a Class Change, with certain paths unlocking even further advanced classes at higher levels.

Combat utilizes an intuitive Auto-Battle system. Victory depends on the clever use of physical attacks and various magic spells. Defense is particularly effective against physical strikes, and mastering its use is the key to surviving tough encounters.

As a series highly regarded as a foundation of the Japanese RPG (JRPG) genre, it offers a grand narrative that is best experienced in its entirety. We invite you to take this opportunity to play through the series and witness the origins of the JRPG.
 

 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000117673.name: Asphalt Racing Bundle Speedway & Grand Prix
70010000117673.intro: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000117673.description:
This pack includes the games: Speedway Racing and Grand Prix Rock ´N Racing.

In Speedway Racing, you will enjoy the fastest, most spectacular races at over 350 Km/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 12 rivals.
There are several modes available, including Championship, Arcade and 4-player multiplayer.

Grand Prix Rock 'N Racing gives you the fastest, most exciting races. You can evolve your car, improving the engine, brakes, tires and more until you've achieved the perfect evolution to win the Championship!

Features:

- Wide variety of tracks.
- Multi-player with 4 players.
- Races with 12 opponents.
- Realistic driving physics.
- Lots of Rock 'N Roll music.

70010000117675.name: Pixel Game Maker Series Pollux - Hero in the box
70010000117675.intro:
Step into a Box—Almost Invincible!?
A big adventure awaits a hero in a box
in a delightfully retro world!
70010000117675.description:
□ Story
Polux, a freelance hero,
is struck by a mysterious curse—
the curse of the treasure box!

To break it, he sets off on a strange and winding journey,
crossing seas and mountains alike.

Master the power of “Invincibility”
and charge headfirst into adventure!

□ Game Overview
Swing your sword, jump into action,
and conquer the monsters and dungeons that stand in your way!

In times of danger, press the Defense Button!
Hop into a box and you’re mostly invincible!*

*Some exceptions apply. Thank you for your understanding.

□ Features
15 stages + ? included!
Powerful bosses may be waiting at the end of each stage!

Collect points (money) and trade them at the shop
for useful items to aid your adventure!

Take on Challenge Stages with
three types of Time Attack modes—and more…?

Find hidden Crystals in stages to increase your max HP!
Exploration-support items also make an appearance!

Includes a Monster Encyclopedia!
View descriptions and comments for every monster you encounter!

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.

70010000117683.name: Speed Dates
70010000117683.intro: Shape your story with charm and humor for a personalized romantic journey
70010000117683.description:
Embark Speed Dates, where you control first dates with 18 attractive women in this interactive FMV game. Shape your story with charm and humor for a personalized romantic journey.

Our main character Murat attends the Speed Date event and has only a few minutes to get to know the women and make him love himself. Try to impress the girls in this adventure where you can experience today's male-female relationships in the most realistic way.

Features:
•Stunning 4K visuals
•Over 54 unique paths and 36 distinct endings
•500+ meticulously crafted scenes
•8 hours of immersive storytelling

70010000117686.name: Rail Rescue: Puzzle Lines
70010000117686.intro: Your train crashed! Find your friends and rebuild your home!
70010000117686.description:
Your friends are scattered across the city, and the rail network is in pieces! Draw colored tracks, reconnect the railroads, and guide trains back to their stations to find your lost buddies and bring everyone home.

With each rescue, your hometown slowly recovers, but the puzzles get trickier. Tunnels, crossroads, and clever obstacles will test your logic and creativity as you invent new routes, solve mind-bending challenges, and restore order to the railways.

Features:
- 1000+ handcrafted logic puzzles!
- Tricky mechanics like gates, crossroads, and obstacles.
- Multiple solutions that reward creative thinking!
- Optional hints to help you through tougher levels.
- A beautiful city full of life waiting to be restored!

Choo Choo! Next station is never-ending fun!

70010000117692.name: Space Bubble Shooter
70010000117692.description:
Space Bubble Shooter is a classic bubble shoot game.
This addictive classic bubble blast match-three game comes with clean and modern graphics, hundreds of
great challenging levels and some nice special items for better game experience in harder levels.
Clean and simple 3D graphics with nice light effects gives the game a special touch.

70010000117694.name: Wax Heads
70010000117694.description:
Wax Heads is a cozy-punk narrative sim about working in a struggling record store. Chat to quirky customers with unique tastes, explore a handcrafted record collection, fall in love with bands (and their drama!), or just slack off with your colleagues - whatever gets everyone’s groove back! 

IMMERSIVE COZY-PUNK LIFE SIM
Lose yourself in an emotional, uplifting narrative about community, musical mysteries and underdog spirit. Help endearing and indecisive customers find their perfect records while debating all things music with your loveable colleagues. It's your job to help Repeater Records find its rhythm again! 

ORIGINAL KILLER SOUNDTRACK
Drop the needle on a stacked soundtrack featuring dozens of original tracks spanning across many genres, bands, and eras. Every song is crafted to feel like a nostalgic gem. From grimy basement bangers to dreamy indie deep cuts. It’s a playlist built to loop in your head long after you clock out. 

HANDCRAFTED RECORD COLLECTION
Dig through crates packed with 80+ hand‑drawn albums, lovingly imagined bands, and liner note lore that rewards curiosity. Each record has its own personality, history, and fanbase. Did Scandinavian metal band Jarhead really murder their singer and put his head in a jar? Is it true big shot rapper RXXX used to be a kid's TV presenter? Has anyone ever seen Mimi? 

MOTLEY CREW OF LOVEABLE ODDBALLS
Repeater Records is staffed and frequented by a rotating cast of eccentrics, music nerds, and chaotic regulars. Every character is bursting with personality, quirks, and questionable opinions about what “real music” is. Get to know them and enjoy their banter. They’re the soul of the shop after all! 

CRATES OF PUZZLES TO DIG THROUGH
From customer requests to store shenanigans, you’ll dive into a variety of cozy puzzles. Decode clues and hunt for the perfect music recommendation by browsing records, scrolling social media, and poring over local music zines. You might even find yourself running the lights for local bands, designing gig posters and packing orders! 

CREATORS OF WAX HEADS
Patattie Games is the two-person indie punk duo made up of developers; creative doodler Murray Somerwolff (Welcome to Elk, Spitkiss, Dead Pets Unleashed) and creative programmer Rothio Tome (Former UNITY developer support engineer and top Spanish GameDev streamer).

70010000117710.name: Snack and Quack: Duckling Steps
70010000117710.intro: Quack, Push, and Feed the Ducklings
70010000117710.description:
Get ready for an irresistibly cute adventure in Snack and Quack: Ducklings Steps, a charming puzzle where you help a mother duck take care of her hungry ducklings. In peaceful, water-inspired environments, every move matters as you guide the little ones toward delicious pieces of bread scattered across the path.

With clever and charming challenges, each level invites you to think calmly, plan your moves, and find the perfect solution. It’s the kind of relaxing and satisfying experience where every success brings a smile and every solved puzzle warms your heart.

Colorful, cozy, and full of personality, Snack and Quack: Ducklings Steps is perfect for players who love light puzzles, cute themes, and that delightful “just one more level” feeling.

70010000117722.name: Claim the forest: Shape of Wolves
70010000117722.description:
Step into the forest and unwind in Claim the Forest: Shape of Wolves, a cozy puzzle game where adorable wolf-shaped pieces must fit perfectly onto the board. Pick up the pieces drifting calmly on river boats, rotate them, test positions, and discover the right combination to fill every single space.

With 30 charming levels, the game blends just the right amount of challenge with a calm and welcoming atmosphere. Boards vary in size and shape, asking for attention, logic, and a sharp eye to make sure no corner is left empty.

With no rush and no pressure, Claim the Forest: Shape of Wolves is perfect for players who love relaxing puzzles, cute animals, and the satisfying feeling of seeing everything fall into place. Follow the river’s flow, adjust the pieces, and turn the forest into the perfect home for your pack.

70010000117731.name: GluMe
70010000117731.intro: Stick together to solve brainteasing stages in retro sliding puzzle style!
70010000117731.description:
Get ready for GluMe, a sliding puzzle game where you control a slime, and any friends you pick up along the way. Move through top-down grid stages, collecting gems across 80 unique puzzles of growing size and complexity.

New challenges keep appearing: sleeping gray slimes wake when touched, turning blue and sticking to you. Use them to cross pitfalls, but don’t grow too big to fit into tight spots. Find the right order to collect gems and uncover secrets. Reset anytime if you get stuck. Enjoy chiptune tunes and retro vibes!

• Move around puzzling stages and collect gems to advance.
• Run into other slimes to wake them up and stick together.
• Use your slimes’ changing shape to get around obstacles.
• Master 80 unique levels presented in retro pixel art style.
• Revisit cleared stages to find secrets you’ve missed.

70010000117747.name: Shoe It All!
70010000117747.intro: Master impossible throws and challenge a world that takes itself too seriously.
70010000117747.description:
"Growing up is mandatory. Becoming boring isn't.

Play as Lace, a rebellious teenager who refuses to fit into a world of rules, order and boring authority. Armed with a swing and a pile of shoes, they'll challenge anyone trying to tell them who to become.

Swing, aim and fling your shoes through handcrafted physics puzzles. It looks simple, but every level demands creativity, precision and perfect timing.  Master the perfect throw to SHOE IT ALL!

CHALLENGE THE ESTABLISHMENT!

Outsmart grumpy neighbors, rule-obsessed adults and greedy bosses in a colorful world where every obstacle is another chance to cause a little chaos.

PLAY YOUR WAY!

Complete levels your way. Every puzzle rewards experimentation, not just one correct solution. Discover creative shortcuts, land impossible trick shots and find smarter solutions with fewer throws.

SPEEDRUN OR EXPLORE!

Race for your fastest time in Speedrun Mode, or slow down to uncover hidden paths, bonus levels and every collectible.

Features 
65+ handcrafted physics puzzles with multiple solutions
Nearly 200 collectible stickers to complete your journal
Creative trick shots and satisfying chain reactions
Increasingly challenging levels that reward mastery
Dedicated Speedrun Mode
Hidden bonus levels packed with secrets
Memorable bosses in a comic-inspired world
High-energy punk soundtrack"

70010000117753.name: Quick Brain: Number Hunt
70010000117753.intro: The answer is hiding in the numbers! Spot “Where’s ◯?” in a blink!
70010000117753.description:
“Where’s ◯?” is a brain-training game where you search for the target number hidden among a screen full of colorful digits.

The rule is simple: find the specified number—that’s it!
Ignore distracting sizes, colors, and layouts, and rely on your focus and observation skills to lock onto the correct answer.

With timed stages, your quick thinking and speed are put to the test.
Includes 150 stages. Quick to pick up, satisfying to clear—perfect for short breaks, and surprisingly addictive even after a long day.

70010000117759.name: Wrack: Reclamation
70010000117759.intro: You are the only one stopping an alien invasion... and loving every second of it!
70010000117759.description:
Inspired by classics, Wrack is an arcade-style FPS. Mow down enemies one after another, and become more powerful the more you kill. Amass a deadly arsenal, discover secret powers... and save your world!

In this remake of 2014's Wrack, play as Kain as you shoot, slash, and hyperblast your way through a horde of invading aliens and robots to keep your planet safe.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Kill Streaks: Rack up kill after kill to earn a kill streak! The more damage you pump into an enemy, the more extreme its death, and the more time you have to keep your streak going.
- Resets: Kill enemies a second time by exploding their corpse into giblets to reset your timer! Use your current weapon(s), or your melee attack to slice a corpse to bits.
- Fast Movement: Use your fast movement speed and abilities, like a super jump, to evade enemy attacks, and find secrets and treasure!
- Bosses: When you're done racking up a huge kill streak, duke it out with minibosses and bosses... and put your skills to the test!

70010000117777.name: Quick Brain Letter Hunt
70010000117777.intro:
Find the ONE specified character!
Search across Hiragana, English letters, Hangul, and Traditional Chinese!
70010000117777.description:
“Where is ◯?” is a simple, satisfying brain-teaser:
Just spot the target character hidden among a screen full of scattered letters and tap it.

You’ll encounter Hiragana, the English alphabet, Hangul, and Traditional Chinese characters.
The more unfamiliar characters mix in, the more your focus and observation skills get tested!

Quick to play in short bursts, yet perfectly warming for the brain.
Ignore distractions like shape, size, color, and placement—trust your eagle eyes and claim the correct answer.

70010000117783.name: Blackspot: The Card Game
70010000117783.intro: One card. One choice. Dead men don't fold.
70010000117783.description:
Blackspot is a fast paced pirate card duel where every decision could make you a legend or send you to the bottom of the sea.

Draw your card. Read your enemy. Then choose to play it straight, run a bluff, or throw down a taunt. One wrong read and your streak is gone, but walk away too early and you will never know what you left on the table.

Quick, tense duels resolve in seconds with a single bold choice. Face dangerous opponents with distinct personalities, from the sloppy Drunkard to the ruthless Captain.

Endless Arcade mode lets you build your streak, spend your gold, and survive as long as you dare. Challenge Mode offers progressive trials that teach the ropes and push your limits. Local multiplayer brings pass and play duels for two pirates on one Nintendo Switch™.

Deep meta progression allows you to earn Notoriety, unlock relics, cosmetics, and permanent advantages across every run. The Black Spot raises the stakes. Draw the Ace of Spades and you cannot run. You must win or die trying.

Easy to learn. Hard to master. Impossible to put down.

70010000117801.name: Legends Aligned: Land of Order
70010000117801.description:
Step into a new chapter of calm and clever challenges in Legends Align Land of Order, a puzzle where every piece has its place and every decision brings you closer to the perfect solution. Set in refreshed environments full of personality, the goal is simple and satisfying: fit different shapes together until the entire board is complete.

With 30 carefully crafted levels, the game invites you to observe, test, and reorganize ideas without rush or pressure. Each layout offers new possibilities, encouraging creative strategies and that clear moment when everything finally aligns.

Easy to understand and pleasant to play, Legends Align Land of Order offers a relaxing experience for players who enjoy visual puzzles, steady progression, and the rewarding feeling of seeing every piece find its place. It is the kind of challenge that calms the mind while keeping your thinking active.

70010000117807.name: Pie Pie Cafeteria
70010000117807.description:
Welcome to Pie Pie Cafeteria, an irresistible puzzle where round little desserts meet, collide, and transform into increasingly delicious treats. Inspired by the Suika style, dive into a charming café where combining identical sweets is the key to fulfilling orders, earning extra time, and keeping everything under control before the mess overflows.

Each stage features a different container, such as boxes, cups, mugs, and even coffee machines, completely changing how sweets fall, roll, and merge. Planning every drop makes all the difference. A well thought out combination can free space, create chain reactions, and save your run at the very last second.

With light physics, a relaxing pace, and clear goals driven by customer orders, Pie Pie Cafeteria offers the perfect balance between strategy and delightful chaos. It is the kind of game that invites you to play just one more level, always discovering a new sweet, a new fusion, or an unexpected solution.

Cozy, addictive, and full of personality, Pie Pie Cafeteria is the ideal puzzle for players who love accessible challenges, cute visuals, and the delicious satisfaction of seeing everything fall into place at the right moment.

70010000117821.name: The Last Ladybug
70010000117821.intro: Fly forward and save your swarm in THE LAST LADYBUG - a rail shooter set in a colorful world where the skies are ruled by mechanical monsters and the lands are scorched by destruction!
70010000117821.description:
"Fly forward. Choose your path. Save your swarm. You are THE LAST LADYBUG!

In a world where the skies are ruled by mechanical monsters and the lands are scorched by destruction, only one brave soul remains: THE LAST LADYBUG, the humanoid heroine with wings of steel and a heart of fire. Fly forward and save your swarm in this action packed rail shooter!

FLY FORWARD - Fly and blast your way through a colorful 3D world ravaged by a mechanical threat. THE LAST LADYBUG features 15 stunning stages of blistering action and neon chaos!

CHOOSE YOUR PATH - Branching paths at the end of each stage send you soaring toward different zones. Each route leads to a new challenge and a new chance to rescue your imprisoned bug brethren!

FACE THE ENEMY - After fighting your way through waves of enemies, you'll fly into pulse pounding boss fights that'll leave your trigger finger tingling!

The fate of bugkind is in your hands. Stretch those wings and dive headfirst into an electrifying pixelated adventure! This is THE LAST LADYBUG!"

70010000117823.name: Subnautica: Below Zero - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000117823.intro: Dive into a freezing underwater adventure on an alien planet.
70010000117823.description:
Below Zero is an underwater adventure game set on an alien ocean world. It is a new chapter in the Subnautica universe, and is developed by Unknown Worlds.

Return to planet 4546B

Submerge yourself in an all-new, sub-zero expedition in an arctic region of Planet 4546B. Arriving with little more than your wits and some survival equipment, you set out to investigate what happened to your sister...

Uncover the Truth

Alterra left in a hurry after a mysterious incident. Abandoned research stations dot the region. What happened to the scientists who lived and worked here? Logs, items, and databanks scattered among the debris paint a new picture of the incident. With limited resources, you must improvise to survive on your own.

Discover Uncharted Biomes

Swim beneath the blue-lit, arching expanses of Twisty Bridges. Become mesmerized by the glittering, mammoth crystals of the Crystal Caverns. Clamber up snow covered peaks and venture into the icy caves of Glacial Basin. Maneuver between erupting Thermal Vents to discover ancient alien artifacts. Below Zero presents entirely new environments for you to survive, study, and explore.

Construct Habitats and Vehicles

Survive the harsh climate by constructing extensive habitats, scavenging for resources, and crafting equipment. Blast across the snowy tundra on a Snowfox hoverbike. Cruise through enchanting and perilous biomes in your modular Seatruck.

Research Alien Lifeforms

Something undiscovered lurks around every corner. Swim through the giant Titan Holefish, encounter the haunting Shadow Leviathan, and visit the adorable Pengwings. Keep your wits about you. Not all creatures in this strange world are friendly.

Survive the Chilly Temperatures

Jump in, the water’s warm. The below zero temperatures of this arctic region pose a new threat. New weather conditions blanket above-ground habitats. Craft a toasty cold suit, sip on piping hot coffee, and warm up next to Thermal Lilies to stave off the chill. 

An ocean of intrigue

What really happened to your sister? Who were the aliens who came here before? Why were they on this planet? Can we find solace from grief in truth? Below Zero extends the story of the Subnautica universe, diving deep into the mystery introduced in the original game.

70010000117828.name: Subnautica - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000117828.intro: Descend into the depths of an alien underwater world filled with wonder and peril.
70010000117828.description:
Subnautica is an underwater adventure game set on an alien ocean planet. A massive, open world full of wonder and peril awaits you!

Dive Into a Vast Underwater World

You have crash-landed on an alien ocean world, and the only way to go is down. Subnautica's oceans range from sun drenched shallow coral reefs to treacherous deep-sea trenches, lava fields, and bio-luminescent underwater rivers. Manage your oxygen supply as you explore kelp forests, plateaus, reefs, and winding cave systems. The water teems with life: Some of it helpful, much of it harmful.

Scavenge, Craft, and Survive

After crash landing in your Life Pod, the clock is ticking to find water, food, and to develop the equipment you need to explore. Collect resources from the ocean around you. Craft knives, lights, diving gear, and personal water craft. Venture deeper and further form to find rarer resources, allowing you to craft more advanced items.

Construct Underwater Habitats

Build bases on the sea floor. Choose layouts and components, and manage hull-integrity as depth and pressure increase. Use your base to store resources, park vehicles, and replenish oxygen supplies as you explore the vast ocean.

Unravel the Mystery

What happened to this planet? Signs abound that something is not right. What caused you to crash? What is infecting the sea life? Who built the mysterious structures scattered around the ocean? Can you find a way to make it off the planet alive?

Disrupt the Food Chain

The ocean teems with life: Use the ecosystem to help you. Lure and distract a threatening creature with a fresh fish, or simply swim as fast as you can to avoid gnashing jaws of roaming predators.

Handle the Pressure

Build a Pressure Re-Active Waterproof Nanosuit, or PRAWN Suit, and explore extreme depth and heat. Modify the suit with mining drills, torpedo launchers, propulsion cannons, grappling hooks and more.

Fear the Night

As the sun goes down, the predators come out. The ocean is unforgiving of those caught unprepared in the darkness. Areas that are safe to explore during the day become treacherous at night, but also reveal a beauty that those who hide from the darkness will never see.

Dive Below the Ocean Floor

Cave systems wind below the sea bed, from dark claustrophobic passages to caverns lit by bio-luminescent life and burning-hot lava flows. Explore the world below the ocean floor, but watch your oxygen levels, and take care to avoid the threats lurking in the darkness.

70010000117838.name: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 4
70010000117838.intro: The stage is set for a classic Wild West shootout at the theme park.
70010000117838.description:
But when the gunsmoke clears, one actor isn't getting back up, he's been shot with a live round. 
As Lana and Bill investigate, they realize this wasn't an on-stage accident, but a perfectly staged murder. 

Now they must track down the killer who turned a performance into an execution.  

- Colorful and intuitive solitaire challenges
- Finish compelling quests
- Solve hundreds of solitaire levels
- Crack the case and catch the killer

70010000117851.name: Colorizing: Sunshine
70010000117851.intro: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation
70010000117851.description:
This coloring book is a guarantee of good mood.
In it you can find all kinds of pictures for every taste.
Coloring by numbers with Colorizing is a calming and easy activity for people of all ages. 
This drawing game is suitable for children and adults, everyone can enjoy pixel coloring.
You will definitely love coloring with this beautiful coloring book!

70010000117862.name: Blueberry
70010000117862.intro: Blueberry is a story-driven puzzle platformer that takes you deep into a woman’s mind as she faces her trauma.
70010000117862.description:
Play as Blueberry and live through key memories from childhood to old age, piecing together fragments of her past in a deeply emotional story about trauma, resilience, and forgiveness.
Climb the Tower of Life. Go on a journey from childhood to twilight years.

MAKE MEANINGFUL DECISIONS
Guide Blueberry’s journey by making choices that shape her emotional growth. Help her find peace by managing her “blues” and making decisions that support her healing. Each choice impacts her story, leading to different outcomes in her story.

KEY FEATURES
Climb the Tower of Life: Journey through Blueberry’s life stages in an interactive platformer that combines exploration, mystery-solving, and memory reconstruction.

Choices Matter: Face moments of choice that impact Blueberry’s emotional journey, leading to multiple endings based on how you choose to guide her through her past.
