Pivotal Life Moments: Steal cookies and cause kitchen chaos as a child, engage in spirited word battles with your mom as a teenager, and embrace the joys and challenges of motherhood as an adult.

Emotional and Philosophical Depth: Experience a moving story that explores themes of trauma, motherhood, forgiveness, and the impact of memory on identity.

Surreal Art and Atmosphere: A colorful yet introspective world that shifts with Blueberry’s emotions and memories, creating a visual journey that mirrors her mental landscape."

70010000117868.name: FOUNTAINS
70010000117868.intro: Master high-skilled combat and explore a vast, interconnected world.
70010000117868.description:
The Fountain of Youth was hidden away. Nonetheless, it is fated that a Usurper will slay the Ageless and unearth it once more.

FOUNTAINS is a soulslike action-RPG built around fighting your way through a maze-like interconnected, seamless world. You'll take the role of a hooded stranger, recently imprisoned by a tyrannical regime. Will you escape and uncover the mysteries of this war-torn empire? 

Demanding, but fair combat
Tight, responsive combat puts every tool and tactic in your arsenal to the test, rewarding precision and quick thinking. Your enemies will hit hard and punish hesitation, turning each fight into an intense back-and-forth where the tide of battle can shift in an instant. Adjustable difficulty settings let you feel that thrill at exactly the intensity you crave, no matter your experience.

Exploration that rewards curiosity
The world of FOUNTAINS is one, seamless, giant dungeon. It is a tightly packed labyrinth which twists and loops back on itself. You'll always discover something new:  items, powers and upgrades to unlock new parts of the world.

Leave Your Mark
FOUNTAINS features an online message system. Leave hints throughout the world to help out your fellow players, or trick them into doing something foolish!

- Souls-like action combat set in a metroidvania-style interconnected world.
- Find new abilities and tools to help you to defend yourself and to traverse the world.
- Rich dark fantasy lore told through exploration and environmental storytelling.
- Online message system for community interaction.
- Secrets are everywhere, so always keep an eye out!

70010000117891.name: Sizeable
70010000117891.description:
Sizeable is a relaxing and peaceful puzzle/exploration game where you shrink and grow your way through handcrafted dioramas in search of hidden objects.

What is Sizeable?

Sizeable is a short, relaxing, and casual puzzle/exploration game centered around the unique mechanic of shrinking and growing. Originally developed as a student project, the game evolved into Business Goose Studio’s first commercial title. It’s a passion project, made with care and creativity, and we hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it.

Shrinking and Growing Is the Key

What if you had the power to resize anything around you — the moon, the sun, or even entire worlds?

In Sizeable, you gain the ability to manipulate the size of objects in each diorama. Shrink the moon to lower the tide, or enlarge a cloud to create strong winds. Use these mechanics to solve puzzles and uncover three hidden objects in every level. And if you explore carefully, you might even discover a secret turtle.

Features

A relaxing puzzle/exploration experience

39 handcrafted low-poly dioramas, ranging from deserts to outer space

39 secret turtles to discover

Relaxing original music composed by Jamal Green

4 seasonal dioramas to explore

70010000117904.name: Twins or Tens
70010000117904.intro: Twins or Tens — It’s not about the numbers, it’s about your strategy.
70010000117904.description:
Twins or Tens is a fun and relaxing number puzzle game.

Your goal is simple — connect numbers in one line to match identical numbers or create combinations with a total sum of 10. The rules are easy to learn, but the game becomes more challenging as you play.

Think carefully, plan your moves, and clear the board to get the highest score possible. The game is perfect for quick sessions or longer relaxing play.

Game Features:
Easy to learn gameplay
Fun and challenging puzzles
Clean and pleasant visuals
Suitable for all ages
Great way to relax and train your brain

Can you find the best combinations and clear the board?

70010000117910.name: Game With Balls
70010000117910.intro: Move the Nintendo Switch™ to guide balls through handcrafted mazes.
70010000117910.description: Move the Nintendo Switch™ to guide balls through handcrafted mazes.

70010000117916.name: Hoof & Seek
70010000117916.intro: Find all the hidden farm animals.
70010000117916.description:
Hoof & Seek is a relaxed hidden-object game set on a charming farm.

Each level takes place on a single screen filled with barns, trees, fences, and other farm scenery. Somewhere in each scene, farm animals are carefully hidden. Your goal is to observe the environment, search every corner, and find them all.

With 40 handcrafted levels, the challenge gradually increases as scenes become more detailed and animals are hidden more cleverly. There are no timers or penalties, allowing you to play at your own pace and enjoy a calm, focused experience.

Simple controls, clear visuals, and short levels make Hoof & Seek easy to pick up and enjoyable for players of all ages. Look closely, stay observant, and uncover every hidden farm animal.

70010000117922.name: DecaDungeons™
70010000117922.intro: DecaDungeons™ is a first-person, turn-based dungeon crawler where fate is decided by a magical six-sided dice. Explore 10 deadly dungeons, battle fierce foes, hunt monsters, and survive!
70010000117922.description:
The Story:

Long ago, the kingdom thrived—ringed by vast forests, towering mountains, and tranquil seas. From its high walls, the great castle watched over a peaceful people… until the night Death rode through the gates on a black horse.

It passed silently through the streets, and ruin followed in its wake. Fire spread, plague consumed the weak, and despair swallowed the living. By dawn, the cries had faded, the streets were filled with the fallen, and a terrible curse had taken hold.

Since that day, the kingdom has lived under a broken pact. Every ten years, a chosen soul must descend into the darkness in the hope of ending the curse.

A secret council now prepares the ritual once more, forging a magical six-sided die—an artifact said to shape fate itself. The newly chosen knight rides toward the ten forbidden dungeons, where shadows cling to ancient stone… and deep within, the monsters wait.

The Game:

DecaDungeons™ is a first-person, turn-based dungeon crawler that blends classic DRPG mechanics with a minimalistic, atmospheric 3D pixel-art style.

Descend through ten deadly dungeons, battle powerful foes, and uncover the secrets needed to save the kingdom. Exploration is just as important as survival—hidden throughout the labyrinths are 50 Red Coins, waiting for those who search carefully.

Rare Monsters:

Some encounters carry a 1 in 100 chance to spawn a rare, rainbow-colored monster. These elusive foes grant massive rewards in EXP and gold. Few have seen them—will you be one of the lucky few?

Events:

While exploring, you’ll encounter special events—short scenarios that present three possible choices. Each decision carries risk or reward. Choose wisely… luck does not always favor the bold.

The Council Has Spoken:

The fate of the realm now rests in the hands of the dice-wielding knight.
Will you break the curse… or watch the kingdom fall into darkness?

Key Features:

10 unique, trap-filled dungeons

First-person, turn-based combat

50 hidden Red Coins to discover

Rare monsters with massive EXP and gold rewards

Random events with branching outcomes

Atmospheric 3D pixel-art environments

70010000117929.name: Gurei
70010000117929.intro: An unforgiving game with precise combat. Fight challenging bosses in any order, acquire their unique powers and succeed in your own terms.
70010000117929.description:
Overview

Rei, the main character, is a human spirit bound with the challenging duty of defeating mystical entities of nature, the Kami, to obtain their power.

You are free to pick your fights against the Kami in any order. The game features a dynamic difficulty system where each enemy strength is defined by the player’s chosen path. This means that the very same Kami fought at the very beginning could also be the final boss in a different route. Hope to never leave the one you struggle most to fight last!

Combat Features

Besides sword attacks, dodges, head stomps and other basic abilities, Rei will learn a completely new skill for each defeated Kami. Those will provide further depth to your combat arsenal, be it a stronger dash, a weapon that can execute enemies, the ability to heal and many more! 

Player choice is the ultimate power. Taking into account the vastly distinct enemies’ patterns and unique skills granted upon each victory, you will be able to decide how to approach every challenge. It won’t be easy either way, but you can always go back and try something different.

Beyond the Brawl

Gurei is a game about fighting strong enemies, but that’s not all. The Kami inhabit a surreal castle located between the human and spirit worlds. After each victory, Rei comes closer to the realm of spirits, starting to encounter peculiar characters from Japanese mythology. These creatures will add novelty and strangeness to your journey, providing commentary, unique animations, side objectives and obscure secrets.

Unlikely “Friends”

You will get to know the different Kami quite well. When Rei defeats them, she absorbs their power – and their personality. The defeated Kami will be carried around wherever Rei goes, and they’ll surely have stuff to talk about. Sometimes their remarks will be useful information that builds the player’s understanding of the lore and the game mechanics, but sometimes they will be... not so helpful, to put it briefly. Good luck!

70010000117941.name: Whisper of the House
70010000117941.intro: Help the townspeople move, organize, and clean, perhaps making a difference in their lives and uncovering some hidden stories...
70010000117941.description:
Whisper of the House is a cozy game about organizing and decorating. You'll take on various tasks from the townspeople—helping them move, organize, and clean their spaces. In the process, your gentle touch might make a difference in their lives, and perhaps uncover some hidden stories...

- Take on charming, quirky tasks: moving into new homes, tidying cluttered rooms, preparing new shops, sorting through treasured keepsakes… even tracking down cats!
- Piece together the smallest clues to uncover their unspoken memories, weaving a story where mystery and love intertwine.
- Decorate your own home freely! Over 2,000 pieces of furniture and more than 10 unique home layouts—every space is yours to design.
- Dozens of items also feature custom sound effects—tap the drums, snap a photo, run the tap. In this home, you don't just see it—you hear it.
- But beneath these warm, everyday moments, the town hides something. Perhaps the one destined to uncover the truth… is you.

70010000117947.name: Cherry Girls vs Zombie Carnage: Brutal Anime Kawaii
70010000117947.intro: Rise in the middle of chaos and defend the last of humanity.
70010000117947.description:
The city has fallen into chaos. Zombies flood the streets, and only a few people have managed to survive. Among them is a fearless cheerleader who unexpectedly rises as a symbol of hope in the middle of the apocalypse. Her mission is clear: protect what remains of humanity. As she navigates the shattered city, she meets survivors in desperate need of help. By completing their requests, players earn rewards and uncover pieces of the world’s lost story.

Key Features:
• Survival Challenge: Stay alive in a city consumed by zombies.
• Melee Combat: Wield light or heavy katanas, each with a unique fighting style.
• Weapon Upgrades: Customize your blades with powerful enhancements and special effects.
• Character Progression: Boost your attack, increase health, and unlock new abilities.
• Survivor Missions: Assist stranded survivors and gain valuable rewards.
• In-Game Economy: Gather currency and invest in faster upgrades and improvements.
• Apocalyptic Atmosphere: Explore dark streets and ruined districts filled with constant danger.

In this unforgiving world, every decision, every strike, and every step matters. Hold your ground, rise above the chaos, and prove that even in the darkest moments, hope can endure.

70010000117960.name: My Winter Drive
70010000117960.intro: Craft your vehicle and endure the harsh grip of winter.
70010000117960.description:
In My Winter Drive, every detail counts. You start with nothing but an empty chassis, and piece by piece, you’ll craft it into a fully functional vehicle. But building your car is only half the challenge — the frozen countryside is unforgiving. One wrong move, and your journey could end before it begins. Every decision matters, from managing resources to maintaining your own health, as you push forward through snow, ice, and harsh winds.

Key Features
• Assemble Your Car, Part by Part
Install the engine, mount the wheels, adjust the carburetor, and fine-tune every component. Precision is crucial — even a small mistake can lead to breakdowns.
• Automotive Quests and Practical Tasks
Take on a variety of car-related jobs, from repairs and repainting to more unexpected challenges, earning rewards and improving your skills.
• Survival in the Winter Wilderness
Hunger, fatigue, hygiene, and stress all impact your performance. Manage your supplies wisely and find creative solutions to survive the harsh environment.

Step into a world where car building meets survival. Every journey is a test of skill, patience, and resilience. Are you ready to face the winter and drive your creation to life?

70010000117968.name: Chorus of Carcosa
70010000117968.intro: First-person, Psychological Horror, Indie, Surreal, Gore, Singleplayer
70010000117968.description:
Chorus of Carcosa is a psychological horror game inspired by the classic horror fiction of 'The King in Yellow' collection by R. W. Chambers. You play as a sculptor who is forced to abandon his place of comfort one night, when a blood-soaked neighbor knocks on his door.

Experience the fear of facing the unknown. 
Survive an ever-changing decrepit apartment building filled with dangers and mysteries... Without making a sound! Or THEY will hear you…

Solve the mystery of an alternate reality.
A twisted realm fills the space around you. Are all of these changes real? Or are they just nightmarish hallucinations?

You can flee, but escape is an illusion.
They have found you and there's no turning back now. Perhaps, it’s sometimes wiser to embrace the surrounding madness and stare right back into its eyes.

70010000117971.name: Call of Warfront
70010000117971.description:
The battlefield is set — how you fight decides everything.

Engage in fast-paced encounters where you face enemy forces in score-based missions that reward skill and efficiency. 

Every elimination brings you closer to victory, but every mistake gives your opponents the advantage. Staying focused and reacting quickly is the key to controlling the battlefield.

Navigate through a variety of combat zones designed to challenge your positioning and movement. Each environment offers different layouts and tactical opportunities, pushing you to adapt your strategy and approach every encounter differently.

Choose from a wide range of weapons and adjust your playstyle depending on the situation. Whether you prefer aggressive engagements or a more controlled approach, your decisions in combat define your success.

Every mission is built around action, timing, and control — pushing you to improve with every match and dominate every encounter.

Key Features:
-Fast-paced combat focused on skill and reaction
-Score-based gameplay that rewards performance
-Multiple combat environments with different layouts
-Weapon variety for flexible playstyles
-Tactical gameplay based on positioning and timing

Stay sharp, react fast, and take control of every encounter.
In Call of Warfront, victory depends on how you fight.

70010000117976.name: Spin Path 2
70010000117976.description:
Take control of a sleek rolling sphere and blast down a constantly shifting track packed with spinning platforms, deadly hazards, and glowing collectibles. Every second pushes you faster, every decision matters, and one mistake ends the run.

This is instant-action gameplay at its most addictive. Controls are simple, but survival demands focus, precision, and nerves of steel.

Collect dots to rack up points and trigger Frenzy Mode mid-run. In this short burst of unstoppable power, smash through obstacles, shatter barriers, and tear the track apart.

70010000117982.name: Sesame Street: Friends & Fun
70010000117982.intro: Move in and feel right at home and celebrate with your Sesame Street friends.
70010000117982.description:
Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow. 

From the moment you arrive, there’s so much to do. Join Elmo, Tango and the rest of your Sesame Street friends around the neighborhood! 

Walk around with Grover, plant a magical giant beanstalk in Abby’s Garden, find useful tools and rubber ducks in the Community Garden with Bert & Ernie, and work on your number and puzzle skills in Count von Count’s Mansion. Or cook, mix and laugh along with Cookie Monster in his Foodie Truck! Some quests may take a few tries, but you’ll work together to find a way to make the streets a brighter and happier place for everyone. 

Make yourself at home! Decorate your house, unlock new mini-games, access exciting new areas of the Street, or throw and unforgettable block party. Spend time with Tango, your cheerful and furry helper or enjoy the whole adventure together with family and friends in local co-op play.  

The fun and exploration never ends on Sesame Street!  

JOIN THE NEIGHBORHOOD: Create your own character and join Elmo, Tango, Abby and their friends on Sesame Street.  

EXPLORE THE STREET: Start at your apartment, stop by Big Bird’s cozy nest, play at the Count’s Mansion, and unlock more places. 

BRING EVERYONE TOGETHER: Help the community by going on cooking, photography, and even farming quests solo or in co-op. 

DISCOVER AND GROW: Use rewards to decorate your home, unlock new mini-games and access exciting new areas. 

TRAVEL WITH TANGO: Take care of Tango just like she’ll take care of you as she helps you get around.  

THE STAGE IS YOURS: Choose from the colorful backdrops, lights, and other cool special effects for the main stage.

70010000117984.name: ELEVRAL
70010000117984.intro: A fluid first-person archery game where speed and precision collide.
70010000117984.description:
ELEVRAL is a first-person, fluid movement archery game set in a serene yet unforgiving world suspended in motion.

Dash, vault, and chain momentum as you race through beautifully crafted levels, fending off hostile drones and adaptive AI determined to knock you off course. Armed only with your bow and your mastery of movement, every run becomes a high-stakes dance of speed, precision, and control.

ELEVRAL rewards skillful play with a deep, multi-layered scoring system. Finish levels faster to climb the leaderboard, land daring long-distance shots for bonus points, and balance risk versus reward as enemies actively disrupt your flow. Ignore combat entirely and you’ll pay the price; hesitation is just as dangerous as a missed step.

Whether you’re chasing perfect runs, experimenting with new routes, or pushing for score supremacy, ELEVRAL is built for players who crave momentum, mastery, and replayability.

70010000117986.name: Coloring Pixels: Collection 7
70010000117986.intro: A relaxing coloring-by-numbers game. Enjoy completing a variety of images with different themes, levels of complexity, and sizes.
70010000117986.description:
The objective is quite simple: each level contains numerous uncolored pixels, and it is your job to color them in. Each pixel is numbered; this number corresponds to a color in your palette. Select a color from the palette and paint each corresponding pixel. Correctly color all pixels in a level to finish it!

Coloring Pixels is a great way to wind down; you can just sit back and relax. With 180 levels, you can have hours of fun. This collection contains 8 themed books:

Candy Book - Candies and sweet treats from around the world in one book, guaranteed to make your mouth water!

Fantasy Maps Book - Maps from mythology, fantasy and everything imaginary!

Pastels Book - Dive into Spring with this calming, cute, pastel book!

Zodiac Book - All 12 signs and various meanings are shown in this book!

Gothic Book - A look back in time to a beloved European culture!

Alchemy Book - Images portray chemistry, alchemy, and even a hint of magic!

Playing Cards Book - An image for each card in a standard deck of playing cards, in the New Deck Order!

Celebration XL Book - Revisit new levels based on some of your favourite books from the past, celebrating the best of Coloring Pixels so far!

70010000117992.name: Dollmaker
70010000117992.description:
You wake up in an enormous, shadow-drenched room filled with the forgotten playthings. Seated across from you at a small wooden table is the Dollmaker – a mysterious, stitched-together doll who is missing an eye. She is your adversary, and you have been chosen to play her macabre game.

To survive, you must prove your skills as a master builder. Analyze the eerie photographs she presents to you and race against the ticking clock to replicate them perfectly. From the drawer of discarded parts, you must select the correct eyes, hats, clothing, and accessories to assemble the requested toy.

But this isn't just about making dolls. You're playing to recover a missing part of yourself. With your opponent's watchful button eyes on you, you must demonstrate focus and precision. One wrong piece or one second too late, and you may remain in the dark forever.

70010000117998.name: Hollow Knight – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000117998.intro: Brave the depths of a forgotten kingdom, enhanced for Nintendo Switch™ 2.
70010000117998.description:
Hollow Knight is a classically styled 2D action adventure across a vast interconnected world. Explore twisting caverns, ancient cities and deadly wastes; battle tainted creatures and befriend bizarre bugs; and solve ancient mysteries at the kingdom's heart.

Includes free content packs! All new quests, boss battles and secrets!
• Hidden Dreams: Mighty new foes emerge! New Boss fights. New Upgrades. New Music.
• The Grimm Troupe: Light the Nightmare Lantern. Summon the Troupe. New Major Quest. New Boss Fights. New Charms. New Enemies. New Friends.
• Lifeblood: New mapping tools. New Boss fight. Upgraded Bosses. New Music. Hidden Extras!
• Godmaster: Take your place amongst the Gods. New Characters and Quests. New Boss Fights. Hidden Surprises!

Game Features
• Classic side-scrolling action, with all the modern trimmings.
• Forge your own path! The world of Hallownest is expansive and open. Choose which paths you take, which enemies you face and find your own way forward.
• Evolve with powerful new skills and abilities! Gain spells, strength and speed. Leap to new heights on ethereal wings. Dash forward in a blazing flash. Blast foes with fiery Soul!
• Equip Charms! Ancient relics that offer bizarre new powers and abilities. Choose your favourites and make your journey unique!
• An enormous cast of cute and creepy characters all brought to life with traditional 2D frame-by-frame animation.
• Over 140 enemies! 30 epic bosses! Face ferocious beasts and vanquish ancient knights on your quest through the kingdom.
• Chart your journey with extensive mapping tools. Buy compasses, quills, maps and pins to enhance your understanding of Hollow Knight’s many twisting landscapes.
• A haunting, intimate score accompanies the player on their journey, composed by Christopher Larkin.

70010000118000.name: Pro Jank Footy
70010000118000.intro: Score goals to unleash powers in this over-the-top arcade comedy-sports game.
70010000118000.description:
Pro Jank Footy is an absurd and over-the-top arcade sports game.

Score a goal? Your opponent picks a game-changing power-up.

Hinder your opponents, increase your footy abilities with powers that give your team strong legs, or turn the gameplay completely on its head by transforming everyone into footballs – the choice is yours!

Outplay, out-kick, and out-jank your mates in local multiplayer. Or, if you’re shy, conquer single-player season mode.

AUSTRALIAN RULES FOOTBALL LIKE YOU'VE NEVER SEEN IT

Australian Footy is the most attended domestic sports league in the world! 36 players on a field, an obscenely large oval, and a ball that looks like a sunburnt lemon...

For those outside the loop, “Aussie Rules” could mean anything. Pro Jank Footy takes this confusion and runs with it—a fast-paced, comedic sports game where you're constantly changing the rules.

WORLD-CLASS COMEDY

With commentating from Aunty Donna's Broden Kelly and the creative minds of David Ashby and Dario Russo behind cult TV series Danger 5 and Italian Spiderman driving the humor, Pro Jank Footy is jam-packed with comedy, charm and Australianisms.

FEATURES

ROGUELITE GAMEPLAY – Every goal scored lets your opponent choose from over 150+ ridiculous power-ups that completely alter the match. Or, play classic mode for simple, arcade footy with no power-ups. 

VERSUS MODES – Face off against AI or challenge your mates.

SEASON MODE – Lead your team through a full season with deck-building mechanics to unlock and customize power-ups as you progress.

RETRO ARCADE NOSTALGIA – Inspired by classic 90s sports games, blending pixel-perfect action with buttery-smooth modern gameplay.

UNIQUELY AUSTRALIAN – Aussie Rules meets Aussie humor. It’s chaotic, unpredictable, and proudly embraces Australian culture.

MULTIPLE TEAMS & STADIUMS – Play as 11 unique teams across 4 iconic stadiums, each with their own quirks, hazards, and surprises.

70010000118012.name: Arcade Archives POLARIS
70010000118012.intro: A glimmer of hope lurking in the deep blue.
70010000118012.description:
"POLARIS" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1980.
Take command of a submarine and battle advancing enemy forces using missiles that can only be fired directly upward.
Navigate through a relentless onslaught from all directions—bombers in the sky, frigates patrolling the surface, and mines lurking on the seabed!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000118024.name: COIN PIT
70010000118024.intro: One chamber. One machine. Endless damnation.
70010000118024.description:
COIN PIT is a brutal rogue-lite descent into debt, luck, and self-inflicted ruin — where every spin tightens the chains.
Locked inside a rusted iron chamber you built with your own greed, you face a trembling slot machine and a merciless ATM demanding payment after every round. Spin the reels to scrape together your last coins, twist charms and trophies into devastating combinations, and bend the rules in your favor. Break the system, survive another turn, and search for a way out before the pit swallows you whole.

Key Features:
	•	Ruthless rogue-lite gameplay where any round can be your last.
	•	Deep synergy system with charms, modifiers, and upgrades.
	•	Multiple endings and hidden rewards for those who endure.
	•	Endless Mode to chase records as the chamber erodes your sanity.
	•	A dark, oppressive atmosphere built around debt, addiction, and obsession.

The question isn’t if you’ll fall… it’s how deep you’ll sink before the pit devours you.

70010000118048.name: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 5
70010000118048.description:
They disturbed a sealed temple. Now, an ancient evil has followed them to Springdale. 
When the archaeologists start dying in seemingly "accidental" ways, the town whispers of a curse. 

Skeptical but determined, Lana and Bill enter a shadowy world where logic fails, and they must fight an enemy that can't be touched by handcuffs or bullets. 

- Colorful and intuitive solitaire challenges
- Finish compelling quests
- Solve hundreds of solitaire levels
- Crack the case and catch the killer

70010000118055.name: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 6
70010000118055.description:
A mysterious vigilante is cleaning up Springdale's streets. 
The townsfolk cheer, but Detective Bill Mates sees a criminal, and journalist Lana Whitt smells a great story. 

To uncover the truth, the duo must track down a hero who doesn't want to be found, and decide where true justice lies in a city dazzled by a cape. 

- Colorful and intuitive solitaire challenges
- Finish compelling quests
- Solve hundreds of solitaire levels
- Crack the case and catch the killer

70010000118076.name: Soapy Tales
70010000118076.intro: What if your story started in the afterlife?
70010000118076.description:
Suddenly, you wake up as a ghost, with no memories. Your good and bad deed count is perfectly even, so you need to go back to Earth to earn your redemption. 
Rediscover your past life and relive touching memories while attending to family business.

Soapy Tales combines doing relaxing chores with elements of time and space management. Complete the tasks, upgrade your skills, and unveil the story of your life in the midst of pastel, soapy bubbles!

KEY FEATURES: 
- First-person point of view gameplay. 
- Cozy, nostalgic atmosphere.
- Relaxing music. 
- Skill tree and artifacts to unlock.

70010000118082.name: Mech Robot: Battle Shooter Warrior
70010000118082.intro: Control the machine. Control the fight.
70010000118082.description:
Steel meets chaos on every battlefield.

You control a powerful combat mech sent into hostile arenas where danger comes from every direction. Surrounded by enemies, traps, and constant pressure, you must react fast, think smart, and make every move count.

Each run brings a new challenge. Arena layouts change, enemies behave differently, and your strategy must adapt. Collect resources during battles, upgrade your mech, and shape your own fighting style, whether focused on speed, firepower, or defense.

There is no fixed path to victory. Every attempt is a chance to improve, experiment, and push further than before.

Key Features:
- Dynamic Combat: Fast-paced battles with constant action
- Upgradeable Mech: Improve weapons, armor, and systems
- Weapon Variety: Use different combat styles and loadouts
- Challenging Enemies: Face waves of enemies and powerful bosses
- Progression System: Unlock new upgrades and possibilities

In a battlefield that never repeats itself, only those who adapt can move forward.

Mech Robot: Battle Shooter Warrior offers a fast and engaging experience where each fight builds toward something stronger.

70010000118087.name: Aquamarine: Explorer's Edition
70010000118087.intro: A turn-based playable comic book about surviving in an alien ocean
70010000118087.description:
Inspired by the psychedelic sci-fi of the '70s & '80s, Aquamarine combines the mystery of old-school adventure games and challenging roguelikes with elements of survival, exploration, and puzzle solving.

Journey across a water world reclaimed by nature. Overcome survival and navigational challenges as you discover the planet's lost history. Master your pod's controls, study the ocean wildlife, and solve environmental puzzles to help you find your way home.

Cultivate a variety of alien plants with unique attributes. Forage the depths for food and salvage tools to help you survive. Collect and craft powerful upgrades for your humble escape pod, and customize your loadout to fit the needs of every plunge into the water.

You play as a lone space traveler known only as The Seeker. While orbiting an uncharted aquaplanet, your starcraft is disrupted by a strange signal and you're forced to eject. You crash land on a tiny island surrounded by an endless alien ocean, with nothing to help you but an amphibious survival pod. Throughout your underwater journey to reach your crashed ship, you'll uncover the planet's lost history and discover the true nature of why The Seeker ended up here.

Features:
•Study & explore three living ecosystems
•Grow your own food
•Craft new tools & tech
•Uncover the truth of why you ended up here

70010000118089.name: SchoolBoy Horror
70010000118089.description:
The bell rings—but this isn’t your school anymore. The halls are cracked and rusted, the lights hum with static, and something cold stirs in the dark.

You wake in an empty classroom, desks overturned, blood smeared across the chalkboard. Somewhere down the corridor, a girl hums softly—a tune you almost remember. Her footsteps echo closer, calm… deliberate… patient.

Run through long-forgotten classrooms, the overgrown stadium, and science labs filled with broken glass and secrets best left unspoken. Find what binds you to this place before it finds you first.

Every flicker of light hides a face. Every sound could be a clue—or a warning.

Welcome back to school.
You’re late… and she’s been waiting.

70010000118094.name: Drop Duchy - Complete Edition
70010000118094.intro: Build your duchy piece by piece in this refreshing hybrid rogue-lite game with block-dropping mechanics!
70010000118094.description:
COMPLETE EDITION WITH ALL DLC

Drop Duchy takes on the iconic geometric puzzle gameplay we all know and love with a fresh perspective: instead of simply clearing lines, you'll be thoughtfully building a realm using pieces of various shapes and types to overcome enemy challenges.

A mix of deckbuilding, puzzle and rogue-lite, the game offers a new gameplay designed to hone your appetite as a block-stacking tactician. Optimization is key to collecting precious resources, protecting your castle, and building your army.

Defeat is not the end, though: use the experience gained in previous runs to unlock even more content!

Your kingdom one piece at a time
A chip off the old block

In each round of your run, Drop Duchy offers you a fresh and unique landscape to work with. Place tile pieces as you would in a typical block-dropping game but with a strategic twist: you need to align them to maximize their activation rules, producing maximum resources and units.
Selecting the optimal structures to place next to blocks of lush forests, wild rivers or grassy plains is crucial for maximizing your materials use and nurturing a bustling realm.
Forming lines grants bonuses, yet the ultimate goal is to pack up the most resources gradually. These resources will be crucial to build up your army bit by bit, ensuring your kingdom is well-protected against the enemy threats.

Block & Load

Select your path, gather your troops to outnumber your enemies, and reclaim the regions under their control. But be careful: letting your castle take too much damage can lead to defeat.
Successful battles lead your forces down branching, decision-filled paths in a march to storm the enemy fortress.
If your army falls before capturing the bastion, you can quickly jump back in and try a new strategy, thanks to a cleverly designed gameplay loop.
Adapt, conquer, and keep the action moving!

Deckbuilding blocks

Grow in power with a rich deckbuilding system: build and enhance constructions with over 110 unique cards, each offering powerful upgrades and modifiers. Unlock new possibilities when using building or technology cards, each granting new bonus structures to boost soldier recruitment & various other perks. Customize your deck to suit your strategy and optimize your realm’s growth.
As you progress on your run, trade with markets or guilds to acquire valuable resources, use them wisely to upgrade your deck, make strategic decisions, and choose your path for the next round.

Shape your destiny

Drop Duchy features a robust meta progression system with 100 unique missions! Climb the ranks and unlock various bonuses such as increased resources, new cards or additional health.
These missions are intertwined with the five playable factions: The Duchy, The Republic, The Order, The Tribe and The North, each offering exclusive faction quests that grant faction-specific rewards. Completing these objectives across your runs not only tailors your strategy but also improves your chances of success, ensuring that every playthrough contributes to your long-term progression and victory.

70010000118102.name: Archerio
70010000118102.intro:
A fast-paced 3D archery roguelike. 
Clear deadly rooms, stack wild powers, defeat bosses.
70010000118102.description:
Archerio is a run-based action roguelike where every room is a new test of aim, movement, and quick decisions. Dash, strafe, and thread your shots through chaotic battles as you fight for “one more room.”

Each run lets you craft a new build with powerful abilities and upgrades — stack elemental arrows, boost crits, summon helpers, or trade safety for damage. Learn enemy patterns, adapt on the fly, and bring down relentless bosses waiting at the end of each push.

Features:
- Fast, responsive 3D archery combat with dodge-and-shoot movement
- Room/wave-based stages that keep the pace high
- A wide pool of upgrades for fresh builds every run
- Varied enemies and intense boss encounters
- Replayable progression that rewards repeated attempts

70010000118109.name: Cavorite
70010000118109.description:
The hit 2011 puzzle platform game is back and better than ever!

"A wicked smart, 16-bit puzzler." 

"A fun, jumpy puzzler."

"This platform-puzzle combo game is loads of fun." 

"If you're itching for a neat little platformer then look no further!"

Dr. Cavor is trapped inside the moon! Held captive by the mysterious Selenites, Dr. Cavor endeavors to escape to the surface and from there to Earth! But first he must match wits with the dwellers of the lunar underworld, whose catacombs are complex and deadly! Dr. Cavor has but two tools at his disposal: his unique genius and his prize invention, the anti-gravity spray 'Cavorite'.

He must match wits with the Selenites. He must avoid perils. He must battle monsters. And above all, he must escape the moon!

70010000118111.name: Carrot Smash
70010000118111.intro: A fun and addictive platforming experience from start to finish!
70010000118111.description:
Take control of a brave carrot on a mission to protect its territory in this exciting pixel art platformer. Face challenging enemies and obstacles, using powerful punches, double jumps, and the Dash to overcome action-packed, precise levels.

With fast-paced gameplay, responsive controls, and appealing retro visuals, Carrot Smash delivers a fun and addictive platforming experience from start to finish.

Features:
- Precision platforming with intense action
- Use punches, double jumps, and the Dash to defeat enemies
- Challenging levels full of traps and obstacles
- Charming Pixel Art visual style
- Engaging and energetic soundtrack

70010000118117.name: Calyssa
70010000118117.intro: Follow Calyssa on her quest to find the entrance to ancient ruins!
70010000118117.description:
Follow the courageous explorer Calyssa on her quest to find the entrance to ancient ruins, where a legendary treasure lies hidden. In this intense precision platformer, players will face deadly traps, dark creatures, and a forgotten curse — testing their reflexes and skills to uncover the secrets of the place and survive the dangerous journey.

With a mysterious atmosphere, fast-paced action, and tight controls, Calyssa delivers an engaging experience from start to finish.

Features:
- Challenging platforming focused on precision
- Climb walls, use your Dash ability, and defeat enemies with your sword
- Dark, trap-filled environments
- Unique Pixel Art visual style
- Intense and immersive soundtrack

70010000118123.name: Hidden Horror Photo Exhibition
70010000118123.intro:
Is that really a photo from that era?
Spot the impossible anachronism lurking in old black-and-white photos.
70010000118123.description:
「Hidden Horror Photo Exhibition」 is a search-and-deduction game that will send chills down your spine — once you understand what you're really looking at.

At first glance, these appear to be nostalgic black-and-white vintage photos. But lurking within each one is something that simply shouldn't exist in that era. The controls are simple: just observe carefully and tap anything that doesn't belong.

「Why is this object in this photo?」
「What is the true, terrifying meaning hidden behind this photograph...?」

※Button controls are also supported, so you can enjoy it in Tabletop Mode and TV Mode too.

———————————————
MASK supports gameplay streamers.
No permission from MASK is required for gameplay streaming, whether personal or commercial.

70010000118146.name: Hello Kitty Party Land
70010000118146.description:
Join the party at Party Land and team up with beloved Sanrio characters to play together in a variety of exciting mini games.

• Immerse Yourself in the Sanrio Universe
Meet over 145 beloved characters and collect their stickers! Team up with one of 16 playable Sanrio characters and play as your own avatar or your favorite teammate. 

• Partner Up and Enjoy Exciting Mini Games
Jump into 45+ mini games with friends, either offline or online. Take on Board Game Mode and keep the action going by playing quick Petit Games while you wait for your turn.

• Customize Your Avatar
Design a character that's uniquely yours. Adjust everything from hairstyle to outfits. Unlock even more items as you progress through the game!

70010000118157.name: PiyoRide!
70010000118157.intro:
A side-scrolling action game with simple controls!
Dodge obstacles and aim for the greatest distance!
Master Perfect Dodges to fly even farther!?
70010000118157.description:
In this game, you ride the Momonga Robo and soar through the skies in a side-scrolling 2D action adventure.

[Game Mode]

Stages are generated randomly one after another.
Challenge yourself to see how long you can keep flying and aim for a high score.

Each stage features unique gimmicks.
Touching enemies or obstacles such as rocks and trees will cause damage or slow you down.

On the screen, you’ll see:
•An Energy Gauge required for flight
•An HP stock that decreases when you take damage
•A Dodge Gauge that is consumed when you dodge

Collect snacks that appear during stages to restore your Energy Gauge.

The game ends if your HP reaches 0 or if the Momonga Robo falls off the bottom of the screen.

[How to Play]
•Press the A Button to ascend. Release it to descend.
•When the Dodge Gauge is full, press L / R / ZL / ZR Buttons to dodge.
•After dodging, you must wait for a short cooldown before dodging again.
•Performing a Perfect Dodge does not consume the Dodge Gauge.

An endless action game with simple controls!
Even if you fail, you can jump right back in and try again!

70010000118172.name: Only Kitty Cat Up
70010000118172.intro: A fearless cat and a very long way up!
70010000118172.description:
Only Kitty Cat Up is a cute but brutally addictive climbing adventure where you play as a tiny, fearless cat chasing one simple dream — reach the very top.

Jump from object to object, climb higher and higher, and test your patience, timing, and focus in a journey where every move matters. One small mistake can send you falling back down… but a true kitty never gives up.

This is a game about determination, precision, and that unstoppable “just one more try” feeling.  
Soft paws, hard jumps, and a long way to the top.

Cute on the outside.  
Challenging on the inside.

70010000118184.name: Hotel Renovator Simulator
70010000118184.intro: Your hotel. Your design. Your rules.
70010000118184.description:
In Hotel Renovator Simulator, you take on the role of a master renovator and manager. 
Your task is to restore an old, neglected hotel, transforming it from a pile of rubble into a five-star establishment. 
Progress from your very first room to managing a massive hotel complex with 24 unique rooms across multiple floors.

Key Features:

- Complete Restoration: Every project begins with clearing the space. Use the trash bin to get rid of clutter and make room for your future masterpiece.

- Total Transformation: You control every aspect of the finish. Use the hammer to replace old flooring with new tiles, put up fresh wallpaper, repaint walls with a roller, and upgrade ceiling panels.

- Design and Furnishing: After the renovation comes the beautification stage. Choose furniture   from an extensive catalog — from classic Majesty beds to modern Chelsea sofas and Orbit tables. Arrange items in designated zones to create a cozy atmosphere for your future guests.

- A Living Hotel: Your job isn’t limited to just repairs. Greet guests at the reception, hand out keys, and manage their check-ins. Happy guests are the key to your success and your main source of income.

- Economy and Development: Complete restoration tasks to earn money for new materials and furniture. Invest your profits to unlock new floors and expand your business.

- Professional Growth: Master your craft! Upgrade your tools (roller, hammer, spatula) to work faster and more efficiently.

70010000118192.name: Emoji Killer – Casino Massacre
70010000118192.intro: Shoot, dodge, kill, upgrade, unlock... do not let a single emoji escape!
70010000118192.description:
You awake in a mysterious casino where evil poker emojis have awakened — and they’re not happy to see you.

This rogue-like first-person shooter throws you into a wild casino environments, fast-paced combat against gambling addicted emojis wearing funny hats and wielding powers.

Before each run, customize your experience with crazy modifiers: make enemies bounce, wear funny hats, or unleash maximum casino power for maximum challenge. 

Armed with just a pistol, you’ll face wave after wave of emojis that rush, leap, explode, or even summon others to fight. Defeat them to collect glowing orbs, level up, and unlock upgrades or powerful new weapons. Each decision shapes your survival — will you go for raw power, faster reloads, or explosive mayhem?

Survive long enough, and you’ll uncover new arenas, more upgrades, and deeper chaos for your next run.

Can you conquer the casino before the emojis claim you?

70010000118195.name: Killer Toys
70010000118195.intro: Survive the fast-paced rogue-like FPS chaos against murderous animatronic toys!
70010000118195.description:
The toys are awake. And they’re not playing.
In Killer Toys, you’re thrown into a rogue-like first-person shooter where corrupted animatronic toys roam abandoned play spaces, factories, and warehouses. Cute on the outside, deadly on the inside — these machines charge, shoot, shield themselves, and explode in relentless waves.
Before each run, you choose your difficulty — then you’re on your own. No gimmicks. No mercy.
Each arena is a nightmare playground: flickering lights, conveyor belts, towering shelves, and malfunctioning machines that can be turned into deadly traps. Explosive crates, crushing presses, and sparking generators can be used to thin the horde — if you react fast enough.
You start with a simple pistol. Kill toys, collect glowing orbs, level up, and choose upgrades that shape your run. Boost damage, reload speed, and mobility — or spawn powerful new weapons to survive longer as the waves grow stronger and more aggressive.
The longer you last, the worse it gets. Bigger animatronics appear. Enemies combine abilities. The factory fills with noise, sparks, and flying debris — until the swarm finally overwhelms you.
Survive, unlock new arenas, and dive back in.
They’re waiting.

70010000118209.name: Royal Pit
70010000118209.intro: Spin for your life, pay with your soul.
70010000118209.description:
A psychological horror roguelike where your financial decisions are somehow even scarier than the monster watching you. Six nights. Infinite debt. One cursed slot machine. And something in the darkness that really wants to see how this ends. Good luck. You're going to need it.

- The Gilded Trap. Step into a lavish, one-room royal hall where opulence meets terror. Surrounded by marble columns and flickering crystal chandeliers, you are trapped in a high-stakes gambling nightmare.

- Spin to Survive. Your life depends on the whims of a cursed slot machine. Pull the lever to align lemons, cherries, and crowns to clear an ever-growing debt. Every spin counts when the deadline is breathing down your neck.

- Artifacts and Amulets. Purchase permanent upgrades from a gilded vending machine using hard-earned tokens. From Silver Cherry Rings to the Cursed Diadem, these mystical items manipulate luck and multiply your winnings - if you can afford the price.

- The Entity in the Wall. You are not alone. Glowing eyes watch you from a dark window, offering powerful temporary buffs and risky pacts. Will you accept the creature's aid to cheat fate, or will you succumb to your own greed?

- Risk the Abyss. The "Darkness" Crown (666) lurks within the reels, ready to reset your round's earnings to zero and trigger haunting horror events. Manage your Luck points carefully to guarantee a "Triumph" Jackpot before the darkness claims you.

70010000118215.name: Not Human Nightmare
70010000118215.description:
Welcome to a horror experience set during a long, lonely night inside an empty office building.
What begins as a normal overtime shift quickly turns unsettling. The building grows quiet and the silence becomes almost unbearable. Something about the place feels wrong — as if the office has changed.
As the night continues, reality starts to feel unstable. While moving through the office, the harder it becomes to trust what you see.
You came here to finish your work and go home.
But now it feels like you might not be the only one left in the building.
The office looks the same, yet something here definitely isn’t.

70010000118263.name: Asphalt Racing Bundle Hypercar & Speedway
70010000118263.intro: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000118263.description:
This pack includes the games: Hypercar & Speedway Racing.

In Hypercar Racing you'll enjoy the dirtiest, fastest, and most spectacular races at speeds over 200 Mp/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 8 adversaries. The game has different modes, such as Championship, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

In Speedway Racing, you will enjoy the fastest, most spectacular races at over 350 Km/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 12 rivals.
There are several modes available, including Championship, Arcade and 4-player multiplayer.

Features:

- Wide variety of tracks.
- Multi-player with 4 players.
- Races with 12 opponents.
- Realistic driving physics.
- Lots of Rock 'N Roll music.

70010000118265.name: Asphalt Racing Bundle Grand Prix & Hypercar
70010000118265.intro: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000118265.description:
This pack includes the games: Grand Prix & Hypercar Racing.

Grand Prix Rock 'N Racing gives you the fastest, most exciting races. You can evolve your car, improving the engine, brakes, tires and more until you've achieved the perfect evolution to win the Championship!

In Hypercar Racing you'll enjoy the dirtiest, fastest, and most spectacular races at speeds over 200 Mp/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 8 adversaries. The game has different modes, such as Championship, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Features:

- Wide variety of tracks.
- Multi-player with 4 players.
- Races with 12 opponents.
- Realistic driving physics.
- Lots of Rock 'N Roll music.

70010000118267.name: Asphalt Racing Bundle 3 in 1
70010000118267.intro: Enjoy 3 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000118267.description:
This pack includes the games:

Speedway Racing
Grand Prix Rock ´N Racing
Hypercar Racing

In Speedway Racing, you will enjoy the fastest, most spectacular races at over 350 Km/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 12 rivals.
There are several modes available, including Championship, Arcade and 4-player multiplayer.

Grand Prix Rock 'N Racing gives you the fastest, most exciting races. You can evolve your car, improving the engine, brakes, tires and more until you've achieved the perfect evolution to win the Championship!

In Hypercar Racing you'll enjoy the dirtiest, fastest, and most spectacular races at speeds over 200 Mp/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 8 adversaries. The game has different modes, such as Championship, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Features:

- Wide variety of tracks.
- Multi-player with 4 players.
- Races with 12 opponents.
- Realistic driving physics.
- Lots of Rock 'N Roll music.

70010000118269.name: Cipher Monk: Ancient Calculus
70010000118269.intro: The Secret of the Sacred Numbers
70010000118269.description:
Prepare your mind and take a deep breath… the ancient monks have left a challenge waiting for you.

In Cipher Monk: Ancient Calculus, numbers are not just numbers — they are mysterious symbols from an ancestral system that you must decipher. Drag, rotate, and position the pieces correctly to reveal the hidden answer in each puzzle.

With 35 carefully crafted levels, the game blends numerical logic with a calm, minimalist atmosphere. Each stage feels like a small ritual of focus: observe the symbols, test combinations, adjust positions… until everything aligns perfectly.

No pressure, no complications — just you, the ancient numbers, and that delightful feeling of understanding something that seemed impossible just moments before.

If you enjoy smart challenges, relaxing puzzles, and the quiet satisfaction of solving a mystery, Cipher Monk: Ancient Calculus is your next moment of enlightenment.

70010000118279.name: Plungeez
70010000118279.intro: Explore the underground labyrinth of a historic city’s sewers and uncover secrets in an interconnected world.
70010000118279.description:
Plungeez is an exploration-focused puzzle-adventure that puts your mind to the test. Dive deep into a complex underground sewer system in the historic city of Salvador, Brazil, where progress isn’t measured by brute force, but by perception and logic.  

Run, push, activate, and explore. Like a Metroidvania, Plungeez’s map is vast and full of hidden connections that require you to go back and forth to solve the central mysteries. With no combat distractions, you can fully focus on the mechanics of each puzzle and the unique atmosphere of this pixel-art world.

70010000118285.name: Mechaconda
70010000118285.intro: The classic “eat-and-grow” is now a weapon of mass destruction!
70010000118285.description:
Take mass destruction anywhere with Mechaconda! In this frantic arcade experience, you control a bio-mechanical weapon that grows in real-time. Maneuver your long body through dangerous arenas, collecting upgrade cards to install destructive weapons on every new segment.

With optimized controls for handheld mode, Mechaconda demands quick reflexes: the larger you get, the greater your firepower, but also the bigger the target for enemies. Choose your strategy from over 30 ability cards, defeat Dr. EVIL’s colossal bosses, and dominate the arena in this addictive blend of action and evolutionary survival!

70010000118306.name: Akuma Rise
70010000118306.intro: Adventure through the Shadow Realm with three princesses!
70010000118306.description:
Set in the demon realm of Adribune, this story-driven JRPG follows Kaine, a demon who awakens with no memories after washing ashore on a remote island. With the Overlord gone, rival nations clash and heroes from the Radiant Realm invade, seeking to dominate the Shadow Realm. Joined by three demon princesses and a strange mascot, Kaine searches for fragments of his lost past while fighting to protect a world on the brink of collapse.

Featuring classic turn-based RPG gameplay, battles play out in a side-view command system that rewards strategy and timing. Equip and grow magical orbs to learn powerful skills, unlock new abilities, and customize your party. Each character also wields unique POW skills that can turn the tide of battle when used at the right moment. With deep progression, charming companions, and nostalgic JRPG flair, this fantasy RPG delivers a satisfying experience for fans of turn-based battle games.

70010000118317.name: Fantasy Maiden Wars - DREAM OF THE STRAY DREAMER -
70010000118317.intro:
A tactical RPG with over 70 Touhou characters!
Enjoy diverse skills and flashy Spell Cards.
Fun for everyone, from beginners to veterans!
70010000118317.description:
Fantasy Maiden Wars is a classic tactical RPG with a diverse cast of iconic Touhou Project heroines. Explore the expansive world of Gensokyo, a fantastical realm where humans, yokai, and gods exist side-by-side. Seek out the source of supernational incidents disturbing the peace across the land.

◆Classic Tactical RPG Gameplay
Deploy your units across grid-based maps, take down enemies with strategic positioning and turn-based tactics, and clear stages to progress the story.
Multiple difficulty levels and a full-featured tutorial system make this a perfect entry point for players new to the genre—while offering plenty of depth for veterans.

◆Dynamic Combat Animations
Engage in beautifully animated battles whenever characters clash. From sword slashes and gunfire to devastating Spell Card finishers, every attack is brought to life with flair.
Watch your favorite characters unleash flashy moves in the rich, vibrant world of Gensokyo.

◆70+ Playabele Characters and Deep Customization
Customize your squad between missions in the Intermission screen—equip gear, assign skills, and build the dream team your way.
Each character has unique traits and signature abilities, opening the door to countless team compositions and strategies. Go all-in on your favorites or hunt down the most broken combos—how you play is up to you.

◆A Massive Story Blending the Touhou Universe
Choose between shrine maiden Reimu Hakurei or magician Marisa Kirisame as your protagonist—your choice will impact parts of the story.
The game weaves together reinterpretations of storylines from across the Touhou Project series, uniting them into a single, epic narrative arc for both newcomers and longtime fans.

◆More Than Just a Game - Dive into the World of Touhou
Beyond the gameplay, enjoy a rich selection of bonus content:
- A detailed character and terminology encyclopedia that introduces the world of Touhou
- A massive music room with over 200 tracks from the game
- Perfect for both Touhou veterans and those just beginning their journey into Gensokyo.

70010000118323.name: Talespinner
70010000118323.description: Enter a captivating realm steeped in the exotic and bizarre tapestry of Japanese mythology with Talespinner, a deck-building roguelike adventure. As the storyteller, you will guide your chosen hero through an ever-changing narrative shaped by your decisions and deck construction.

70010000118329.name: Mr. Stackman
70010000118329.description:
Mr. Stackman is a simple arcade survival game where blocks keep falling from above.

Move your character, stack the blocks, and try not to get crushed. Build your way up, stay in safe spots, and survive as long as you can while the game gets faster and harder.

Easy to understand and quick to play, Mr. Stackman is perfect for short sessions and high-score challenges.

Features:
 • Simple and easy controls
 • Endless falling blocks
 • Survival gameplay — last as long as you can
 • Increasing difficulty
 • Great for quick play anytime

How long can you survive?

70010000118335.name: Picronix 2
70010000118335.intro: Take a breather and challenge your brain with these calming logic puzzles
70010000118335.description: Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. Solve the number clues to reveal hidden pixel art pictures. Solving each row and column brings you closer to the final image. Enjoy the perfect blend of calm and challenge. A lot unique puzzles await you. They're perfect for a quick break or a long session. Train your brain and find your inner peace.

70010000118350.name: Don't Mess With Bober
70010000118350.intro: An 80s-inspired horror thriller where a careless vacation turns into a nightmare
70010000118350.description:
Don’t Mess With Bober is an atmospheric first-person horror game inspired by 1980s classics, where a seemingly innocent vacation turns into a nightmare. A small mistake during your holiday can unleash the wrath of an enraged Beaver seeking revenge. Immerse yourself in a chilling experience filled with tension, suspense, and classic horror elements.
FEATURES
> River fishing
> Hide-and-seek and chase mechanics
> Good graphics
> A beaver
> A walk in the fresh air (at least in the game)

70010000118362.name: Hades Uprising
70010000118362.intro: A mythic platformer through the nine circles of hell.
70010000118362.description:
Hades Uprising is a third-person platformer built around momentum, precision, and mythological transformation.
One day, Hades decides to defy his own domain. Determined to rescue the lost souls trapped in hell, he begins an ascent through the nine circles—each represented as a surreal, abstract platforming world shaped by suffering, memory, and punishment.
Each circle is divided into five handcrafted areas, forming distinct platforming tracks with unique mechanics, themes, and challenges. Players must master Hades’ movement abilities—double jumps, forward and upward dashes, and momentum-based traversal—to survive trap-filled environments and shifting terrain.
There are no enemies to fight. Hell itself is the challenge.
As you move through each circle, lost souls speak to Hades, offering insight into the world, its suffering, and his own role within it. Crystals gathered at the end of each area unlock the path forward, allowing Hades to continue his rebellion against the underworld.
With increasing difficulty, evolving mechanics, and constantly changing environments, Hades Uprising is a journey of skill, motion, and ascension—through hell, and beyond it.

70010000118389.name: Isekai Villain
70010000118389.intro: Rise as a true villain and carve your own destiny in a dark fantasy RPG!
70010000118389.description:
An ordinary young man is reborn into the world of his favorite comic—only to find himself as a bit-part villain doomed to die. To escape his fate, he must rise as a true villain, gathering allies, defying heroes, and carving a new destiny in this dark fantasy isekai JRPG. Experience a story of survival, betrayal, and ambition where good and evil clash in a pixel-art world.

Fight strategic turn-based battles that blend classic RPG command systems with modern mechanics. Exploit enemy weaknesses, trigger chain attacks, and unleash powerful break attacks. Earn notoriety through misdeeds to rank up and unlock unique arts via a skill tree. Explore dungeons, gather resources, and develop your own evil base with a smithery, lab, smuggling, and more. Packed with pixel-art charm, immersive story, and tactical depth, this parallel world RPG is a must for fans of JRPGs, anime-style games, and fantasy adventures.

70010000118397.name: The Prince of Tennis Sweet School Festival ~♡-40 and more...~
70010000118397.intro: Off the court, he's even more of a Prince!
70010000118397.description:
The Prince of Tennis Sweet School Festival ~♡-40 and more...~ is a globally remastered edition of a legendary otome game that has been beloved in Japan for more than 20 years.

<Story>
During a joint school festival hosted by the tennis clubs of seven academies, you are chosen to serve as a member of the festival’s management committee.
Guide and support the players of your assigned school, strengthen your bonds, and strive for first place in the stall competition!

<Features>
- Experience a school life filled with romance, surrounded by many charming Princes.
- Enjoy sweet and bittersweet date events unique to each Prince!
- Experience elegant, beautifully illustrated event CGs, with some artwork enhanced by animation.
