70010000118411.name: Because It's a Dream, It Must Be Romance: Connecting Hearts Across Realities
70010000118411.intro: Three men. One dream. Your choice. When love begins in a dream… A visual novel where dreams and reality collide, and every choice you make changes everything.
70010000118411.description:
After the worst breakup of your life, you stumble upon your ex's old phone. That night, you launch a mysterious app called "Dream Connecting", and suddenly find yourself pulled into a world of lucid dreams. In the middle of that dream, the ground splits apart. Through the crumbling world, a man appears. Should you save him, trapped inside the dream, or answer the feelings of those waiting for you in reality? The man who loves you. The man you love. And the one you can only meet in dreams… Three fates. All in your hands.

・Multiple endings that change with every choice, your love story, your way!
・Easy-to-play chat-style visual novel format. feel the butterflies of real love!
・Heart-pounding cutscene direction and immersive visual novel presentation!
・Hidden secret stories tucked inside every chapter, can you find them all?
・An achievement system that keeps you coming back for more!
・Beautiful illustrations and a sweeping, emotional soundtrack!

Whether you love otome games, story-driven adventures, or stunning art with a love story that makes your heart race, Because It's a Dream, It Must Be Romance was made just for you. Your special love story, set in a world between dreams and reality, starts right now.

Prologue
After the worst breakup of your life, you accidentally end up with your ex's unfamiliar phone.
That night, the moment you launch the mysterious app "Dream Connecting" installed on the phone, you're pulled into the world of lucid dreams.
A sudden earthquake strikes inside the dream. Through a world shattering to pieces, a man appears. Should you save him, trapped in the dream, or answer the people watching over you in reality?
The man who loves you. The man you love. And the one you can only meet in dreams…
The fate of all three rests in your hands.

70010000118420.name: Mila & Zug
70010000118420.intro: A heartfelt magical story that sticks with you in the best way.
70010000118420.description:
Mila is a curious, creative girl with a big imagination. Her everyday life moves between schoolwork, homemade inventions, and walks in the rain, until one unexpected encounter changes her routine completely. From that moment on, Mila begins a story full of magic, friendship, and discoveries, where she learns that communication goes far beyond words.
The story blends sweet, funny, and mysterious moments, exploring empathy, connection, and the importance of listening even to what is never spoken aloud. Throughout her adventure, Mila shares lessons about real friendship, accepting differences, and the value of caring for what we consider special.
With a warm, approachable tone, the tale invites you to imagine a world where feelings can be expressed in unique ways and where friendship becomes the most universal language. It is perfect for all ages, filled with positive messages, touches of humor, and a sensitivity that leaves a mark. Mila will discover that true bonds can form in the most unexpected places and last forever.

• Kid and family friendly game mode.
• Accessible text and storytelling for young readers.
• Dynamic, colorful images inspired by wildlife.
• Ambient music that recreates jungle sounds.
• Lessons about teamwork, respect for nature, and personal growth.
• Accessibility options like text size, volume, and image transitions.
• Educational fun that promotes positive values.
• A narrative adventure or visual novel for kids.

An interactive storybook experience. A linear narrative adventure perfect for young readers to enjoy a captivating story at their own pace.

70010000118422.name: Deep Combat
70010000118422.intro: Survive brutal ambushes, and push through increasingly hostile sectors!
70010000118422.description:
Dive into the depths of a massive underground military facility in Deep Combat, a high-intensity 2D action platformer packed with danger and futuristic warfare. Play as an elite soldier sent far below the surface to eliminate advanced threats, survive brutal ambushes, and push through increasingly hostile sectors.

With fluid combat, tight controls, and a tense sci-fi atmosphere, Deep Combat delivers an intense and immersive action experience from beginning to end.

Features:
- Fast-paced 2D action platforming
- Fluid combat with responsive controls
- Futuristic enemies, traps, and high-tech hazards
- Constant tension with ambushes and dynamic encounters

70010000118428.name: Dangerous Superheroes After Dark: Heroes Behind the Mask
70010000118428.intro:
When the city sleeps, their control begins to slip.
Behind every mask… there’s a man who could ruin you.
Will you earn his trust or surrender to the danger?
70010000118428.description:
By day, they are untouchable icons.
By night… they are men with secrets.

The city sees fearless superheroes: symbols of strength, protectors of justice, living legends.
But when the masks come off, you discover the truth hidden beneath power and perfection.

Desire.
Tension.
Control.
Vulnerability.

Dangerous Superheroes After Dark: Heroes Behind the Mask is a narrative-driven gay dating visual novel where your choices shape your relationship with powerful anime superheroes living double lives.

Each hero hides more than his identity.
Behind the public image lies pressure, expectation… and a connection he can’t risk.

You’re not just another civilian.

You’re the one man who sees him, not the symbol, but the person.

Will you break through his walls?
Will you protect his secret?
Or will passion blur the line between hero and something far more dangerous?


FEATURES:

● POWERFUL HERO CAST: Meet anime superheroes with unique abilities, strong personalities, and hidden weaknesses.

● SECRET IDENTITIES: Discover who they really are when the mask comes off.

● CHOICE-DRIVEN ROMANCE: Your decisions influence trust, intimacy, and destiny.

● MULTIPLE STORY ROUTES: Each hero has branching paths and exclusive scenes.

● DIFFERENT ENDINGS: Romance, betrayal, obsession, redemption… or heartbreak.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Unlock new dialogue, hidden moments, and alternate outcomes.


He fights villains in the shadows.
Will you be the one he lets in… after dark?

70010000118434.name: Hentai House: Puzzle Nights
70010000118434.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000118434.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000118440.name: Photo Girls: Raw Photo
70010000118440.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000118440.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000118453.name: Dangerous Superheroes After Dark: Heroines Behind the Mask
70010000118453.intro:
When the city sleeps, their secrets awaken.
Behind every mask… there’s a woman who could break you.
Will you uncover the truth or fall for the danger?
70010000118453.description:
By day, they are symbols.

By night… they are something else.

The city worships them as fearless heroines: guardians of justice, icons of power, untouchable legends.
But when the lights fade and the masks come off, you discover a side no one else is allowed to see.

Strength. Doubt. Desire. Vulnerability.

Dangerous Superheroes After Dark: Heroines Behind the Mask is a narrative-driven dating visual novel where your choices shape your relationship with powerful anime superheroines hiding more than just their identities.

Each heroine carries a double life.
A public symbol of perfection… and a private world filled with secrets, pressure, and temptation.

You’re not just another civilian.

You’re the one person who sees the woman behind the legend.

Will you earn her trust?
Will you protect her secret?
Or will passion blur the line between hero and something far more dangerous?


Features:

● POWERFUL HEROINE CAST: Meet anime superheroines with unique powers, personalities, and hidden weaknesses.

● SECRET IDENTITIES: Discover who they really are when the mask comes off.

● CHOICE-DRIVEN ROMANCE: Your decisions influence trust, intimacy, and destiny.

● MULTIPLE STORY ROUTES: Each heroine has branching paths and exclusive scenes.

● DIFFERENT ENDINGS: Romance, betrayal, obsession, redemption… or heartbreak.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Unlock new dialogue, hidden moments, and alternate outcomes.


She fights villains in the shadows.

Will you be the one she lets in… after dark?

70010000118468.name: The Island - Escape Room
70010000118468.intro: You wake up on an unknown island, alone and without help. Will you be able to solve the mysteries it contains? Will you find out how you got there? Could you escape from The Island?
70010000118468.description:
The Island is an Escape Room where you have to make your way through intelligence and lateral thinking. You will solve a huge number of puzzles while discovering an interesting story and moving through the corners of an island full of challenges. Search for clues, find objects and secrets and keep a cool head, because only then you will be able to get out alive from The Island.

Features
- Dozens of puzzles that will challenge your mind
- Large island with different atmospheres
- A story that will keep you hooked
- From escape room lovers to escape room lovers

70010000118480.name: Escape game R00M11
70010000118480.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

70010000118524.name: Ninjora Echoes
70010000118524.intro: Reclaim the Stone of Life using the power of shadow clones!
70010000118524.description:
Take control of Hiko, a young ninja, and his shadow doubles as you solve puzzles, defeat enemies, and save your village from the sinister monk Doku.

In a distant bamboo village lies the Stone of Life — a source of strength and harmony. When the evil monk Doku steals it, young ninja Hiko sets out on a perilous journey to retrieve the stolen relic and restore peace.

Ninjora Echoes is a 2D platformer built around the unique mechanic of creating and controlling shadow clones. You won’t just jump and fight — you’ll need to plan every move strategically. Your clones can press switches, hold levers, and distract enemies, opening up clever new ways to overcome each challenge.

Hiko’s ability to transfer his soul into any of his clones lets you coordinate multiple characters at once, solving intricate puzzles where every shadow plays a vital role. Use your clones to build vertical towers, reach hidden platforms, and outsmart deadly traps.
Combat combines precision and tactics — throw shurikens, strike in close combat, and master ninja skills to defeat enemies. Each level is a test of skill and strategy, leading up to epic boss battles — including the final showdown with Doku himself.

Unleash the power of the shadows, test your reflexes and wits, and reclaim the Stone of Life to save your village!


Key Features
* Create and control shadow clones with soul transfer mechanics.
* A deep mix of platforming, puzzles, and fast-paced combat.
* Helpful companions: Pochi the wise dog and Frogus the upgrade merchant.
* Epic boss battles, including the final fight against Doku.

70010000118527.name: Codename: Black Crow
70010000118527.intro: Discover who you truly are and face your fears.
70010000118527.description:
Aurora never had a choice. Raised on the battlefield as a child soldier, now the past is back. Codename: Black Crow combines the relentless pace of top-down arcade shooters with RPG progression and a personal, emotional story.

Set years after the events of Biomech Hell, Codename: Black Crow follows Aurora, a young soldier trained by the war legends Rock and Stan — better known as Thunderflash.

Once a child soldier in a remote area of Mexico, Aurora carries a painful past, revealed through focused, impactful dialogues and illustrated hi-res anime-style scenes that enrich the game’s retro atmosphere.

Start with a knife and a handful of rations in a hostile land swarming with enemies. Use your radar to explore over 100 areas, gather resources, clear outposts, find new gear, and craft upgrades at workbenches.
Level up, unlock new blueprints, and face off against brutal bosses and challenges.

Thunderflash 2 it’s been integrated as an unlockable bonus inside Codename: Black Crow. Complete the main campaign to unlock this retro shooter experience.

Features:
* A mature, emotional story filled with powerful moments.
* Fight, explore, gather materials, and craft upgrades.
* Unlock new equipment to access fresh paths and tactics.
* Discover 3 different endings.
* Conquer enemy outposts and face brutal bosses.
* Unlock Thunderflash 2, the direct sequel to Thunderflash!
* Authentic 16-bit pixel art style.
* Gorgeous hand-drawn illustrations by Coconut Art.

70010000118530.name: Ultra Pixel Survive 2
70010000118530.intro: Ultra Pixel Survive is back but this time you have allies.
70010000118530.description:
Play with 3 unique characters each hero has different abilities. harvest and collect materials, then build and develop your defenses by juggling your 3 heroes. 

Each night the enemy onslaught will attack, and it’s up to your team to hold down the fort. 

Explore dark underground dungeons, and battle against gigantic bosses. Evolve your team by mastering powerful new abilities, and survive for as long as possible.

Features
Action RPG and survival gameplay
Over 150 items to collect
30 levels and 3 bosses
Revamped leveling system
Unlock new characters up to 25 different heroes
Build and upgrade your resources and heroes
Set up defenses, hunt, cook and more

70010000118536.name: Taxi Hyperdrive
70010000118536.intro: Drive at full speed, pick up passengers, and compete for the top spot in a fast-paced futuristic taxi arcade.
70010000118536.description:
Taxi Hyperdrive is a fast-paced arcade game built around quick 10-minute sessions. Take control of a futuristic hovering taxi and race through a massive open city, picking up passengers and delivering them to their destinations before time runs out.

Explore a futuristic metropolis made up of multiple themed districts, each with its own visual identity: advanced urban areas, wild west–inspired zones, Egyptian-style regions, and Asian-themed districts. Every area offers unique routes, shortcuts, and opportunities to maximize your earnings.

Your taxi moves at extreme speed and can perform massive jumps across the city. Scattered throughout the map are power-ups that boost your income, adding a strong strategic layer. Choosing the right passenger order, routes, and power-ups is key to achieving high scores.

At the end of each run, your earned money is uploaded to a global online leaderboard, allowing you to compete with players worldwide and see who can earn the most in a single session.

Taxi Hyperdrive delivers an accessible yet chaotic and addictive arcade experience, designed for short but intense play sessions, with a strong focus on competition and skill mastery.

Features:
• Intense 10-minute arcade sessions.
• Large futuristic open city with multiple themed districts.
• High-speed driving with hovering taxis and extreme jumps.
• Power-ups that add strategy and competitive depth.
• Global online leaderboard to compete for top scores.
• 6 training missions to learn and master the mechanics.

Time is ticking, passengers are waiting, and the leaderboard shows no mercy.

70010000118541.name: Ritsu Reasoning 2 Lost Memories
70010000118541.description:
It has become easier to play. 
A story of humans and AI.

70010000118543.name: Top Shot Pool
70010000118543.intro: Step up to the table in Top Shot Pool - the ultimate cue-sport experience combining realistic physics with fun, competitive arcade action.
70010000118543.description:
Experience the perfect balance of skill and style in Top Shot Pool, a modern take on the classic game of 8-ball. Whether you’re mastering the Clearance Mode or climbing the online leaderboards, every frame delivers smooth, authentic gameplay and stunning visuals.

Refined ball physics bring the table to life, while intuitive controls make every shot feel natural - from the first break to the final black. Test your skill against adaptive AI opponents, challenge a friend in local multiplayer, or push your limits to achieve faster, cleaner clearances and earn your place on the global leaderboards.

With realistic visuals and a focus on precision and competition, Top Shot Pool brings the atmosphere of a real pool hall to your living room - no chalk required.

Features:

- Realistic physics - Every shot reacts with true-to-life spin, rebound, and precision.

- Smart AI opponents - Adaptive computer players keep every match unpredictable.

- Global leaderboards - Record your best clearances and compare times with players worldwide.

- Local multiplayer - Go head-to-head with a friend on the same console.

70010000118545.name: ココロアップリケ／KoKoRo Appliqué
70010000118545.intro: We will not forget the earthquake. We will never forget you.
70010000118545.description:
Let's not let the memory of the earthquake fade.
The heroine, Frill, has left her heart somewhere after a certain event...
She knows this herself, and has been living each day aimlessly.
When she dreams, someone calling themselves the "Guardian of Dreams" speaks to her...?

After finding an old teddy bear, how will Frill, a slightly selfish and modern heroine with no particular dreams, change?

The story ends on a heartwarming note, so please enjoy!

Features CGs and full voice acting!

*There are scenes that evoke the tsunami, but the narrative has been kept mild. Please rest assured.

Since earthquakes are still frequent, the author has turned the feelings of loneliness felt during the disaster into a game.

70010000118550.name: The Hero of Destiny was killed by the final boss
70010000118550.description:
What happens if The Hero of Destiny is defeated by the Final Boss? Even the 7 Legendary weapons were not enough to defeat The Dark Wizard. With the Hero gone, is there anyone left to save the land of Alta?
Just outside the final dungeon is the sleepy town of Meloda, where 50 NPCs decide that maybe they should try to defeat the final boss. With no real weapons, no armor, no magic, and no combat ability, these NPCs must find a way to slog through the final dungeon, defeat hordes of end game enemies, and defeat the powerful final boss!
Each NPC has a unique set of weapons and skills that may be useful in some niche way. Sure, they may not have swords, shields, and magic, but they do have pitchforks and stones to throw! 
Explore the final continent, discover the lore of the land of Alta, and build a team of 8 members to try to finish the adventure where The Hero of Destiny left off.
Be careful! If a party member is defeated, their death is permanent. You have 50 NPCs to try and defeat the final boss with. You may find certain characters have a particular ability that will help deal with troublesome enemies, so plan out your path through the final dungeon carefully.
Level up your characters, weapons, and equipment, then challenge the Battle Coliseum to see how many enemies you can defeat with your team.
Will you succeed where The Hero of Destiny failed?
8 NPCs might just equal 1 Hero.

70010000118552.name: Content Warning
70010000118552.intro: Film your friends do scary things to become SpookTube famous!
70010000118552.description:
Film your friends do scary things to become SpookTube famous! (strongly advised to not go alone)

HERE’S THE PLAN!
Get famous or die trying! Content Warning is a co-op horror game where you film spooky stuff with your friends to try and go viral.

Step One: Go Down to the Old World
Squad up, customize your face with the ASCII face customizer, buy some gear and use the diving bell to go down to the Old World!

Down there you’ll encounter scary physics-animated monsters, cursed relics and other artefacts!

Step Two: Film something scary
Film as many scary things as possible before you run out of oxygen, or friends…

Step Three: Upload to SpöökTube
If you survive, you need to get back in the diving bell to transport you and the remaining members of your team to the surface.

Upload your chaotic footage to SpöökTube, settle in for a watch party, and wait for the views to tick up!

And… Profit!!
Every run goes on for 3 days, the more scary stuff you film, the more you go viral. The ad revenue from your SpöökTube videos enables you to upgrade your gear to film better videos and survive more easily in the Old World.

If your team accumulates enough views in three days - you get to keep going with your SpöökTube Career and live a life of fame and fortune!

You can also sign up for sponsorship deals to earn MC to purchase island upgrades and hats!

WHAT COULD POSSIBLY GO WRONG!

Game Features
In-game handheld working video camera
2-4 player online coop
Voice chat
ASCII face customisation
Make and save in-game recordings
Your friends looking and acting silly
Scary animated physics monsters
Cursed artefacts
Flashlights (many)
Fame (maybe)

Store: Use your Ad revenue to buy fun and useful stuff
For every video you upload to SpöökTube you get ad revenue to spend on fun and useful items in the store, like upgraded gear, emotes, props and medical equipment!
ASCII Face Customiser: Pick your best facial expression
Customize your face using your keyboard and with the game's ASCII-face-customizer!
Have fun!

70010000118565.name: Versus One
70010000118565.intro: Chaotic Party Action with Dark Witch Characters!
70010000118565.description:
Jump into a party game for up to 4 players, starring characters from
The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4!
Play locally and compete in 6 fast-paced mini-games,
where magic isn’t just for winning — it’s for messing with your friends.

-Magic Changes Everything
Each character can use unique magic to interrupt, trap, or turn the tide at the worst possible moment.
Winning isn’t just about skill —
it’s about timing your magic and causing chaos.

-Familiar Faces, New Battles
Fan-favorite characters return in a completely new party game format.
Easy to pick up, hard to master — and always unpredictable.

-6 Different Mini-Games
Every game has its own rules, pace, and strategy.
Short rounds, quick rematches, and nonstop laughs.

-Perfect for Friends & Family
-Up to 4 players
-Simple controls
-Friendly rivalry guaranteed

70010000118571.name: Penguin
70010000118571.intro:
Fish, sell, upgrade, and dive deeper and deeper into an ocean full of secrets.
Collect the entire ARCTICDEX!
70010000118571.description:
Between freezing waters and mysterious depths, dive ever deeper in search of rare fish and the unknown. By selling its catches, the penguin unlocks upgrades, equipment, and access to deeper areas.

Collect all 42 Arctic monsters to complete your ARCTICDEX.

Gameplay Features

● 2D platformer with vertical exploration. Control an explorer penguin that progressively descends through underwater environments, combining precise platforming with exploration.

● Capture and economy system. Catch different species of fish and sell your catches to earn money and invest in upgrades.

● Upgrades and equipment. Improve your abilities to reach previously inaccessible areas.

● Charming pixel art visual style. Appealing 2D art, expressive characters, and environments that visually evolve as you progress.

● Relaxing atmosphere with a constant sense of discovery. A cozy experience filled with curiosity and mystery, perfect for players who enjoy exploring at your own pace.

70010000118577.name: Aha! More Photo Spot-the-Difference
70010000118577.intro:
「That moment you notice it — pure satisfaction!」
A snapshot-changing Aha! experience that hooks you instantly.
70010000118577.description:
「Aha! More Photo Spot-the-Difference」 is a spot-the-difference game featuring the "Aha! moment" experience, where part of a photo gradually changes over time.

At first, the photo looks completely ordinary.
But stare a little longer, and—
「Huh? Something changed!」
In that instant, your brain lights up with a satisfying jolt.

No complicated controls needed.
Just use your instincts to spot the difference —
perfect for a quick brain workout or a mental reset on the go.

・The moment you notice the change becomes addictive
・A satisfying tempo that lets you play in short bursts
・Simple rules the whole family can enjoy

「Just one more round」 — you won't be able to stop.
Experience this photo spot-the-difference game that sharpens your powers of observation and awareness.

———————————————
TT supports gameplay streamers.
No permission from TT is required for gameplay streaming, whether personal or commercial.

70010000118588.name: EGGCONSOLE HYDLIDE MSX2
70010000118588.intro: Step into the shoes of Jim the Hero to overthrow Varalys, the most powerful demon in all of legend! Experience the definitive 80s action RPG classic.
70010000118588.description:
Originally released by T&E SOFT in 1985, this title is a classic action RPG. Players take control of the brave youth, Jim, on a quest to recover lost jewels, defeat the demon Varalys, and restore peace to Fairyland.

As its contemporary label "Active RPG" suggests, action is the heart of the gameplay. Players battle monsters by switching between attack and defense modes and bumping Jim directly into enemies.

Defeating monsters earns experience points, which allows Jim to level up and grow stronger. When Jim is injured, his health will automatically recover by resting on plains or other safe terrain.
 

 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000118599.name: Joy Piano
70010000118599.intro:
The Perfect Start to Your Child's Musical Journey.
From basic notes to Canon, learn to play like magic through fun gameplay!
70010000118599.description:
No need for expensive lessons or a bulky piano!
Joy Piano is an "Edutainment" game designed to help children build a solid musical foundation and feel the thrill of performing world-famous songs.

■ Master the Basics: 23-Step Curriculum
From rhythm and note reading to two-handed play and chords! Following our 23 structured lessons makes mastering piano basics natural and fun. Achieve the grand finale—playing "Canon"!

■ 20 Beloved Global Classics & Nursery Rhymes
Featuring 20 hits like "Twinkle Twinkle Little Star," "Chopsticks," and "Old MacDonald Had a Farm." Playing familiar tunes boosts confidence and focus.

■ 2 Guided Learning Modes

Note Mode: A visual, intuitive way to learn rhythm by following falling notes.

Sheet Music Mode: A practical mode to learn key positions by reading real notes.

Speed Control: Adjust the tempo to match your child's pace so they can finish every song with a smile.

70010000118605.name: Japanese Rural Life Adventure
70010000118605.intro: A relaxing slow-life simulation game where you can experience the charm of traditional Japanese countryside living, all in a beautifully crafted pixel-art world.
70010000118605.description:
Japanese Rural Life Adventure is a relaxing slow-life simulation where you can experience the charm of traditional Japanese countryside living, all in a beautifully crafted pixel-art world.


■Game Overview

◆Live in the Japanese countryside surrounded by nature

Fix up an old house, make the yard nice, grow your own crops, and become self-sufficient. 
View the cherry blossoms in the spring;
attend the festival in the summer;
eat roasted sweet potatoes in the fall; 
hear the temple bell ring in winter, and then it's time for the first shrine visit of the New Year.

◆Self-Sufficiency: Hard Work, Deep Flavor

Rice --- the essential source of energy for the people in Japan.
Salt, soy sauce, miso ---- seasonings no Japanese kitchen can do without.
In this countryside, many things city dwellers take for granted must be made by hand.
By standing in the kitchen or cooking around the traditional irori hearth of your heritage home,
you can simulate preparing a wide variety of dishes and seasonings.
Food made through your own effort tastes extra special.
Don't be surprised if the game makes you hungry!

◆Bring back life to the village through various events

Many events unfold depending on the season, location, and time of day.
A villager might ask you to repair an old waterwheel,
or to help reopen a shuttered candy shop.
Strengthen your relationships with the locals and restore the liveliness the village once had.
As you complete requests and interact with the villagers, you may earn useful items or unlock new areas to explore.


■Game Features

- Grow crops, gather materials, and produce goods to gradually improve your heritage home.
- Enjoy a wide variety of activities, including fishing and bug catching.
- Meet many villagers in your new hometown, help them with their troubles, and complete missions to open up new areas.
- Over 100 hours of total playtime packed with numerous in-game missions.


■Game System

Your journey begins as the protagonist, a newcomer from the city, starts a solitary life in an old countryside house.
Start by clearing the overgrown weeds, cleaning the floors, and repairing the "shoji" paper screens.
By the time you've completed the tutorial, you'll have learned the basics of village life.
Each morning, an elderly woman visits to sell daily necessities, and each afternoon, a man arrives to buy items you no longer need. Buy and sell goods as you steadily gather everything required to thrive in the village and complete your missions.

70010000118613.name: (English) Pokémon FireRed Version
70010000118613.intro: Set off on a grand adventure to become the Pokémon League Champion—now on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000118613.description:
Celebrate 30 years of Pokémon™ with this Nintendo Switch™ version* of the Pokémon FireRed Version game originally released on the Game Boy™ Advance system! Explore the Kanto region, discover wild Pokémon around every corner, and aim to complete your Pokédex as you battle your way to success. Earn badges as you develop winning strategies to use against each experienced Gym Leader, and uncover amazing secrets in your quest to be the best Trainer.

This digital exclusive contains the Sevii islands, where even more Pokémon await. You can also visit the Pokémon Wireless Club to trade, battle, and chat with other players via local wireless**!

Support for Pokémon HOME is coming soon

You’ll be able to bring the Pokémon you catch and train to the place where all Pokémon gather—support for Pokémon HOME is coming to Pokémon FireRed Version!

70010000118618.intro: Set off on a grand adventure to become the Pokémon League Champion—now on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000118618.description:
