70010000118643.name: Aerea
70010000118643.intro: AereA is a music-themed Action RPG in which you play as one of Great Maestro Guido’s disciples and explore Aezir
70010000118643.description:
The world needs you!
AereA is a music-themed Action RPG in which you play as one of Great Maestro Guido’s disciples and explore Aezir; a floating island that was broken into pieces. Your mission is to find and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and peace to the world. You have to find your way through all parts of the scattered islands; complete quests, solve puzzles, defeat bosses and discover the truth behind the islands. Will you be able to return the nine primordial instruments?

Features
Enjoy the beautifully hand-drawn music themed graphic style
Play as 4 different characters, each with their own unique set of abilities
Fight 9 unique bosses, inspired by a specific musical instruments 
Switch to local co-op to form a team with up to 4 friends at any time

70010000118655.name: Pengilo
70010000118655.intro: Bounce your penguin with precision as you master brainteasing stages in chill wintry style!
70010000118655.description:
A chill world of puzzling challenges awaits in Pengilo, a physics-driven platformer where you fling a bouncy penguin through charming winter landscapes. Across 50 levels, collect stars and grab the key to unlock the exit, mastering precision launches to escape every frosty challenge!

Bounce your penguin at least once and you’ll even be able to change directions midair, slowing down time and re-aiming to hit your target or avoid pitfalls and spike traps. Enjoy cozy and casual brainteasing gameplay at your own pace, all accompanied by a mellow soundtrack.

• Enjoy physics-based platforming across 50 puzzling stages.
• Fling your penguin with precision to reach the exit.
• Grab the key and collect stars along the way.
• Slow down time and change direction midair.
• Replay cleared stages to improve your skills.

70010000118661.name: The Fissure
70010000118661.intro: Investigate the mystery of an old family home in atmospheric visual novel style!
70010000118661.description:
Take the role of a young man named Nahuel as he travels to his mother’s hometown of San Adraín, a quiet and remote village that he’s never visited before… or so he believes. What Nahuel finds in San Adraín feels oddly familiar, perhaps too familiar to simply be because of the stories his mom told him. The family home almost seems haunted, the townspeople are cautious and distant, everything smells of firewood and neighbors he’s never met act as if they recognize him.

The Fissure is a mature and atmospheric visual novel adventure, a narrative mystery about memory and buried secrets. Guide Nahuel as he explores San Adraín, making key decisions for him along the way. Your choices will determine how the tale unfolds, leading to multiple possible endings and adding new scenes to your gallery. Consider the clues you gather to use in subsequent playthroughs in hopes of uncovering the truth of San Adraín and how Nahuel is connected to its many mysteries!

• Guide a young man as he travels to a remote family home shrouded in old secrets!
• Make key decisions to uncover clues and directly impact the story.
• Explore mature themes across multiple narrative paths and endings!
• Meet memorable characters and investigate hauntingly atmospheric locales.
• Discover the truth of San Adrain and your own past!

70010000118681.name: Power Racing Bundle 4
70010000118681.intro: Enjoy 4 games in 1 with this irresistible games pack!
70010000118681.description:
This pack includes the games:

-Speedway Racing.
-Speed Truck Racing.
-WildTrax Racing.
-Hypercar Racing.

70010000118683.name: Who tells your story
70010000118683.description: Who Tells Your Story is a simple yet engaging game in which you draw pictograms to create your own inspiring stories. Draw, create, and have fun. The only limit is your imagination.

70010000118689.name: Momento
70010000118689.intro: Momento is a cozy room decorator with a twist: the objects you choose will alter the course of the story!
70010000118689.description:
Momento is a cozy room decorator with a twist: the objects you choose will alter the course of the story! Decorate your room, choose which items are important to you, and discover how these choices play out over the course of a lifetime.

Begin in childhood, picking out toys that represent your dreams for the future. Follow those dreams into adulthood, exploring wildly different settings and themes. Uncover stories of heartbreak, wonder and love, and learn the significance behind the sentimental treasures that follow you throughout. Pay close attention - some objects may be more than they seem at first glance.

Click your way through a delightfully tactile world, switching on lights, leafing through books, petting adorable animals, and more! Collect items and furniture in story mode to play with in the endless creative mode. At the end of it all you return to the very beginning, to discover new endings, fresh twists in the path, and explore an evolving story of love and loss.

Embark on a journey where the objects you choose to keep influence the life you lead.

Features:
• Decorative freedom: There’s no right or wrong way to arrange your space!
• Choices matter: Watch small decisions ripple over a lifetime!
• Explore freely: Search every nook and cranny of the level. There’s surprises behind every corner!
• Creative mode: Unlock items and furniture to decorate your own room in creative mode!
• Easter eggs: Solve puzzles to uncover special rewards.
• Gorgeous vibes: Immerse yourself in relaxing scenery and lovely music!

70010000118695.name: Seals from the frosty Bay
70010000118695.intro: Help the seal overcome the obstacles!
70010000118695.description: Dash through a frozen world as a brave seal in this dynamic endless runner! Avoid cracking ice floes, leap over obstacles, and escape predators while collecting fish and unlocking new abilities. Simple gameplay, increasing challenge, and a stunning icy landscape will keep you running for more!

70010000118701.name: Alexandria IV
70010000118701.intro: Tasked with commanding of one of the most challenging sectors of the galaxy, the future of the Alexandria IV space station depends on your diplomatic and strategic capabilities.
70010000118701.description:
Take to the stars as the commander of the space station Alexandria IV, a place full of danger and strife, be it caused by mercenary aliens or power-hungry corporations. When an ancient secret is revealed on system Groombridge 34, the commander must act with strategy and diplomacy to avoid rupture between factions. In the future, we are not alone.

Experience in first hand a new entry of the multi-media spanning series Veil of Truth, by award-winning author J.M. Beraldo.

Immerse yourself in a story-rich space opera as the commander of an entire space station. How will you deal with the myriad of problems life in space has to offer?

Fall in love with a diverse cast of characters, ranging from fellow humans to the strangest alien species. But beware! Romance between crew members is prohibited and has consequences...

Intergalactic trouble never ends: Prove yourself worthy of command by solving conflicts strategically in this five act episodic visual novel inspired by classics such as Deep Space 9 and Babylon 5.

70010000118712.name: Hyper Cars Ramp Crash
70010000118712.description:
Buckle up for the most destructive driving experience! Hyper Cars Ramp Crash combines high-speed racing with extreme, physics-based chaos. Whether you're launching off massive ramps, dodging crushing hammers, or falling from the sky, every dent and scratch is rendered with realistic crash physics.

Take control of seven distinct super sports cars that are fully customizable to match your style. Push them to the limit in a massive open world or test your precision in the challenging stunt and fall modes. Want to share the chaos? Grab a second controller and challenge a friend in two-player split-screen mode across all game modes.

Key Features:
• Realistic Destruction Physics: Watch your car crumble, smash, and deform in real time when you hit obstacles or land massive jumps.
• Seven Super-Sport Cars: Unlock and drive a garage full of high-performance vehicles. Customize them and view the action from a realistic interior cockpit camera.
• Couch Co-Op Multiplayer: Play alone or team up/compete with a friend in local split-screen mode.
• Multiple Adrenaline Modes: Free Style, Stunt Mode, Fall Break Mode, Time Trial.
• Diverse Environments: Master your driving skills on Road, Forest, Ocean, and Desert maps.

70010000118719.name: Highway Roads Racer
70010000118719.intro: Master the Curves. Own the Road.
70010000118719.description:
Highway Roads Racer brings the heat of arcade racing to your console. This isn't just about speed; it's about mastering the physics of curved highways while weaving through dense traffic.

Push your skills to the limit, earn cash for risky maneuvers, and build a garage of 15 high-performance cars—from agile sports cars to heavy muscle.

4 High-Octane Modes
-One Way: Tear through traffic at max speed.
-Two Ways: Double the risk. Dodge oncoming cars for massive multipliers.
-Time Attack: Race the clock. Hitting checkpoints is the only way to survive.
-Speed Bomb: Pure adrenaline. A bomb is rigged to your chassis—drop below the speed limit, and you explode!

3 Racing Conditions
-Sunny: Perfect visibility for setting new records.
-Rainy: Slick asphalt that challenges your traction.
-Night: Rely on your headlights and reflexes in the dark.

Experience the Rush
-Dynamic Curved Roads: Feel the G-force as you navigate realistic highway bends, unlike standard straight-line racers.
-Tight Controls : Optimized analog steering gives you the precision needed to thread the needle between cars at high speeds.
-Progression Loop: Use your hard-earned race cash to upgrade your fleet and unlock the fastest machines on the road.

Start your engine. The highway awaits.

70010000118731.name: AVILION forever - Retro JRPG
70010000118731.intro:
Wild story, simple yet deep turn-based battles!
A legendary Japanese retro JRPG is back!
Enjoy this solo adventure at your own pace!
70010000118731.description:
AVILION forever is a classic Japanese RPG (JRPG)
revived by its original creator 20 years later.

A story-focused, offline, single-player RPG
with no gacha and no ads.

The 2004 classic mobile JRPG "AVILION" makes its miracle comeback as
"AVILION forever"! Reborn as a solo experience, you can now enjoy this
legendary journey anytime, anywhere—no server access required.

This special version faithfully preserves the original graphics and sound,
while adding never-before-seen assets and carefully rebalanced game systems.
Experience Chapters 1 through 7, marking a major milestone in the epic story.
(DLC for subsequent chapters is currently under consideration.)

Step into a nostalgic, warm pixel-art RPG world!

■ What is AVILION forever?
AVILION forever is an accessible turn-based JRPG set in a magic academy.
It features two unique systems: the Avatar Rental System and
the Action Slot System.

Customizable Protagonist:
Create your own avatar and enroll in the academy.

Freedom of Choice:
There are no fixed parties. Choose your companions freely from hundreds
of unique students.

Strategic Battles:
Fight using skills set in your "Action Slots."
With limited space, deciding which skills to learn and which allies to bring
creates deep strategic depth within a simple one-handed interface.

Classic Exploration:
Enjoy the addictive Auto-Mapping system as you fill in dungeons,
hunt for Ancient Chests containing rare loot,
and collect coins to challenge the mighty Archon.

The story begins with a small incident at school and expands into a
world-spanning adventure from Chapter 2 onwards.
Each chapter feels like a complete RPG, featuring its own beginning,
end, and fearsome bosses.

■ New Features & Enhancements
• Expanded warehouse storage capacity
• Optional speed settings for faster movement and battle flow
• Carefully rebalanced EXP, drop rates, and encounter rates for solo play
• Stability improvements and bug fixes

■ Changes from the Original Version
This version has been specifically adjusted for a fair and enjoyable
single-player RPG experience.

• Avatar color options increased from 4 to 8
• Reduced grinding with faster leveling and improved item drop rates
• Lessons and Ancient Chests now reset 4 times per day
(4:00, 10:00, 16:00, 22:00)

■ Solo Play Avatar Rental
While online features such as messaging, friend circles, and auctions
have been removed, you are not alone.

The game includes hundreds of Virtual Player avatars available for rental.
You can even team up with avatars submitted by fans during special campaigns,
bringing a multiplayer-like feeling to your solo adventure.

Note: The game is available in English and Japanese only.

Visit our official site for Q&A and Quest Guides for Chapters 1 & 2:

70010000118738.name: Supermarket Simulator 2026
70010000118738.intro: Design, organize, and perfect the flow of your supermarket.
70010000118738.description:
Design your store layout, keep shelves stocked, set competitive prices, and deliver fast, reliable service to keep customers coming back. Step behind the counter, manage daily operations, and watch your store evolve as you expand, upgrade, and optimize every detail.
Start small, think big, and build your own retail success story. 

In Supermarket Simulator 2026, you take control of a humble local shop and turn it into a bustling supermarket. With only basic equipment and ambition on your side, every decision you make shapes the future of your business.

Build your ultimate supermarket with deep and detailed customization. From store layout and product placement to pricing strategies and staffing, every choice affects how your business performs and stands out.

Key Features:
● Immersive retail experience where you manage every aspect of your own supermarket
● Full store customization system with flexible layout design and efficient space organization
● Product ordering and inventory management with dynamic stocking and pricing control
● Interactive checkout system with scanning, payments, and real-time customer service
● Store expansion and upgrades that transform a small shop into a modern supermarket
● Staff hiring and management system to automate tasks and improve daily operations
● Progression system that rewards smart decisions, efficiency, and business growth

Build from the ground up, master the flow of business, and become the ultimate supermarket owner.

70010000118770.name: Nature's Question
70010000118770.intro: Climb the Ancient Tree and test your knowledge of nature
70010000118770.description:
Climb the branches of knowledge in Nature’s Question, an engaging quiz that turns curiosity about the natural world into a journey of growth and challenge. Guided by Sylvaran, the forest’s guardian spirit, you must answer questions to restore the strength of the Ancient Tree and reach the top of its majestic living tower.

Each correct answer strengthens the tree and lets you advance through its floors, while mistakes end the journey and invite you to try again. As you climb higher, questions become more challenging and time becomes more precious, demanding focus, quick thinking, and strategic decisions.

Use your points to activate powerful aids at the right moment, overcoming obstacles and keeping your ascent alive. With shuffled questions in every run and dynamic progression, each playthrough offers a new opportunity to prove your knowledge.

Relax in nature-inspired environments, challenge your mind, and discover how far your knowledge can take you. In Nature’s Question, every answer brings you one step closer to the top of the Ancient Tree.

70010000118776.name: Zoo Orbs
70010000118776.description:
In Zoo Orbs, adorable animals gently fall into containers full of personality, waiting for the perfect fusion. Combine two identical little creatures to create bigger and even more charming versions, advancing step by step until you reach the impressive Whale.

With relaxing physics-based gameplay, each level invites you to slow down, plan every drop, and discover delightful combinations. Containers change shape, challenges become more engaging, and every decision influences the final outcome.

With no rush, no pressure, and plenty of charm, Zoo Orbs is the perfect puzzle for players who enjoy cozy games, pleasant visuals, and that wonderful feeling of making the perfect move. Drop, combine, and enjoy every fusion at your own pace.

70010000118782.name: Claim the Forest: Settling Peace
70010000118782.intro: Capybaras in Harmony in the Forest
70010000118782.description:
Get ready to relax in Claim the Forest: Settling Peace, a cozy puzzle where your mission is to fill each board with adorable capybara-shaped pieces. They arrive peacefully on little boats along the river, and it’s up to you to pick them up, rotate them, and find the perfect fit to complete every space.

Across 30 handcrafted levels, boards vary in size and shape, offering gentle challenges that unfold at a calm and pleasant pace. It’s the perfect experience for puzzle fans, casual players, and anyone who enjoys quiet moments alongside the forest’s cutest capybaras.

Observe the pieces, plan each move, and watch harmony take shape as the forest comes to life, piece by piece.

70010000118788.name: Do You Really Know About Soccer?
70010000118788.intro: Climb the Tower and Prove You Know Soccer
70010000118788.description:
Get ready for a challenge full of excitement, trivia, and passion for the world’s most beloved sport. In Do You Really Know About Soccer?, every correct answer takes you one step closer to the top of the legendary Football Tower, where only true football masters can reach.

Starting with lighter and more accessible questions, you will quickly realize the journey becomes increasingly intense. With every floor, the challenges grow tougher, testing your memory, knowledge, and love for the game. Do you really know everything about soccer?

But climbing the tower is not only about confidence. By answering correctly, you earn points that can be exchanged for special power-ups capable of saving your run during the hardest moments. Choosing the perfect time to use each advantage can make the difference between continuing upward or falling back to the beginning.

With cute visuals, a relaxed atmosphere, and addictive progression, the game transforms every round into the perfect mix of competition, learning, and fun. It is the kind of experience that makes you think “just one more try” while chasing the final floor of the tower.

Perfect for football fans, quiz lovers, and players who enjoy fast and clever challenges, Do You Really Know About Soccer? delivers dynamic matches, exciting tension, and that amazing feeling of getting a difficult answer right at the last second.

Take a deep breath, choose your answer, and prove your football knowledge deserves a place at the top.

70010000118800.name: To Farm Lands: Sowing Fields
70010000118800.intro: Plant, Fit and Relax on the Farm
70010000118800.description:
Get ready to return to the farm in a relaxing puzzle that will win your heart. In To Farm Lands : Sowing Fields, adorable animals in unique shapes await your strategic touch to perfectly fill each grid.

Explore 30 new levels across 3 charming biomes, where every stage brings a gentle and clever challenge. With no time limits and no pressure, you can play at your own pace, testing combinations, rotating pieces and finding the perfect fit in total calm.

With cozy visuals, a peaceful atmosphere and irresistible nostalgic charm, To Farm Lands : Sowing Fields is the ideal choice for fans of cute puzzles that stimulate the mind while delivering pure relaxation.

Observe, plan and complete each board to watch your farm take shape piece by piece.

70010000118808.name: PEPPERED: An Existential Platformer
70010000118808.intro: An existential platformer where Doomsday is just around the corner.
70010000118808.description:
ABOUT
PEPPERED is an existential platformer where you have ONE SHOT at everything.

Every choice, every boss battle, and every failure impact the branching plotline and determine how the story will go and how it will end. Will you save the world - or fail miserably?

SYNOPSIS
Seeing apathy in the face of doomsday, an office intern decides to save the world by themselves. But the world responds by summoning the police, angry mobs, and the media, branding them as a terrorist.

KEY FEATURES
■ BRANCHING NARRATIVE
Multiple endings. Multiple story routes. Your failures and choices affect the story, which branches out heavily — sometimes taking you to completely unique locations with unique scenes, characters, or gameplay mechanics.

■ PLATFORMING ACTION
Run. Jump. Die. Scream at the screen.

■ ONE-SHOT BOSS FIGHTS
Challenging boss fights! If you lose, the game will not reset or give you a second chance — it will go on, incorporating your loss and changing the story accordingly.

■ CHOICES
Make story choices, ranging from dialogue responses to actions. These will either affect the characters, the scene's outcome, or the ending you get.

■ STEALTH SECTIONS
Get caught, sneak past, or find a secret solution. Every section features a unique character, permanent outcomes, and dumb gags.


■ EXPLORATION
Immerse yourself in a bizarre world full of weirdos and sad people! Talk with colorful NPCs, poke around the environment, or ignore it all.

■ COMPLETELY RANDOM CR*P
Maybe you'll have to use a shopping cart to run away from thugs? Perhaps you'll have to write a presentation or gamble with a street corner lunatic? Who knows? (I do.)

■ AN OFFICE CHAIR
You can spin in it.

70010000118821.name: Magic Realm Obby
70010000118821.intro: Do you have the skill to finish the Magic Realm?
70010000118821.description:
Take on one long, continuous obby filled with enchanted platforms, tricky jumps, and skill-based obstacles. Littered with checkpoints to hold your hand — pure parkour as you make your way through the Magic Realm.

Run, jump, and time your moves carefully while exploring a visually rich fantasy environment packed with magical scenery and floating structures.

Features:
> One long fantasy-themed obby
> Skill-based parkour gameplay
> Tricky jumps and challenging obstacles
> Magical environments and visuals
> Designed for players who enjoy classic obbies

70010000118824.name: Buck Blastem
70010000118824.intro: Explore large levels. Find gold and artifacts. Buy guns. Earn upgrades.
70010000118824.description:
Planet Lago is in danger!  With its patron hero gone longer than expected, it is a world descended into chaos. Now with the heroic Buck’s return, there is a chance for peace for this once edenic world. Buck must destroy a horde of cybernetic pests including deadly scorpions, giant flies, and cybernetic spiders.

Can this brave hero restore his decimated garden home?

Explore large levels. Find gold and artifacts. Buy guns. Earn upgrades. Bring an end to the chaos!

70010000118827.name: Arcade Archives STREET SMART
70010000118827.intro: Fight on! For the crown! For the glory of victory!
70010000118827.description:
"STREET SMART" is an action game released by SNK in 1989.
In an era where a man's true worth was measured solely by his strength, a lone karate master and a professional wrestler travel across America to prove who is the ultimate street brawler.
After teaming up in 2-player co-op, you'll face off in a 1P vs. 2P showdown! Victory earns you the blessings of the GALS!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000118840.name: CRAYON LITTLE DINO
70010000118840.intro:
Bring cute baby dinosaurs to life with your own colors!
Create your very own dinosaur playground with the Crayon Series.
70010000118840.description:
Meet your child's very first dinosaur friend, Crayon Little Dino!

The latest addition to the beloved Crayon series is finally here! This time, shall we journey back to the mysterious age of dinosaurs? From the mighty T-Rex to the gentle Triceratops, adorable baby dinosaurs are waiting for your child’s warm and creative touch.

■ Game Features

A Living Dinosaur Encyclopedia: Let your child color 16 different species of dinosaurs in their own unique style. Once finished, the dinosaurs come to life with charming, vivid reactions.

A World of Artistic Tools: With a variety of tools like crayons, brushes, and magic sprays, children can let their imaginations run wild without limits.

Stress-Free Play: There are no set rules or time limits. The game is thoughtfully designed to let children explore at their own pace and feel a wonderful sense of achievement.

Perfectly Optimized for Nintendo Switch™: Enjoy together as a family use the touchscreen in Handheld Mode for a delicate coloring experience that feels just like drawing on real paper.

■ Why Crayon Little Dino is Special
The intuitive UI of the Crayon series, proven across many titles, allows even children who cannot yet read to enjoy the game all by themselves. More than just a game, it is a wonderful educational companion that nurtures your child’s sense of color and focus.

70010000118846.name: UFOPHILIA
70010000118846.intro: Not all visitors come in peace.
70010000118846.description:
UFOPHILIA is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore areas marked by alien phenomena. Use specialized equipment to detect, identify, and photograph aliens, but do so at your own risk... They are watching you too.

Equipped with advanced tools, your mission is to detect, identify, and photograph extraterrestrials, each encounter involving unique behaviors and unpredictable dangers.

Each mission is different: spawn areas, alien types, and phenomena are constantly changing. Some aliens are hostile, others are curious or even playful, but they are all watching you. 

Features

- Atmospheric horror with unpredictable dynamic encounters.
- Nine alien types with distinct behaviors, reactions, and weaknesses.
- Specialized investigation tools, such as EMF detectors, night vision, and more.
- Real device synergies that enhance gameplay when tools are combined.
- Roswell point system to unlock upgrades, new tools, and missions.
- High replayability with random alien appearances and mission outcomes.
- Multiple endings and performance ranks, from “Forum Conspiracy Theorist” to “Roswell Agent".

70010000118850.name: Bubu Battle Royale
70010000118850.intro: Every step could be your last—move or be hunted.
70010000118850.description:
Drop straight into a high-intensity battle royale set in a dense, unpredictable forest. Leap from the plane, hit the ground running, and arm yourself fast—because danger is already closing in. Weapons are scattered everywhere, from long-range sniper rifles to explosive launchers and close-combat options, giving you the freedom to play your way.

The map keeps you on edge. A deadly shrinking zone forces constant movement, while supply crates crash down from the sky, packed with powerful gear—but reaching them could cost you everything. With 25 aggressive, armed opponents hunting across the terrain, every moment is a fight to stay alive.

Key Features:
• Adrenaline-fueled battle royale in a dynamic forest
• Parachute in and start looting instantly
• 8 weapon types with 50+ pickups to discover
• 25 relentless enemies actively hunting you
• Shrinking danger zone that ramps up the pressure
• High-risk supply drops with weapons, ammo, and health
• Smooth core mechanics: movement, shooting, weapon switching, grenades, and combat

Be the last one standing.
Gear up, stay ahead of the zone, and outfight everyone in your path. Only the fastest and smartest will survive.

70010000118855.name: Ragdoll Playground Sandbox
70010000118855.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game
70010000118855.intro: Enjoy a playground where ragdolls, robots, and physics collide spectacularly.
70010000118855.description:
Ragdoll Playground Sandbox is a 2D physics sandbox built for experimentation, creativity, and pure chaos. Test explosions, run vehicle crash scenarios, or simply observe how objects behave under realistic physical forces.

You are completely free in your actions. Create scenes, place objects, remove them at any time, and experiment with physics without limits. Weapons, explosives, vehicles, human and robot models interact dynamically, creating unpredictable and often spectacular results.

Features:
• Full sandbox with no objectives, rules, or restrictions
• Realistic 2D physics with dynamic collisions and forces
• Ragdoll-based human and robot models reacting to impacts, falls, and explosions
• Destructible objects affected by weight, speed, and impulse
• Vehicles, weapons, explosives, props, and machinery to combine freely
• Unpredictable outcomes that make every experiment unique
• Suitable for both chaotic action and calm physics observation

Ragdoll Playground Sandbox is a space without limits, where physics drives every outcome. Whether you enjoy experimenting, observing, or creating chaotic scenarios, the game lets you explore interactions freely and enjoy the process at your own pace.

70010000118860.name: Ace Thunder: Aircraft Wingman Simulator
70010000118860.intro: Precision in flight. Power in combat.
70010000118860.description:
Air Combat, Flight Simulator, Alien War

Enter a high-speed air combat flight simulator where alien forces have taken control of Earth’s skies. Become an elite pilot and engage in intense jet fighter dogfights, defending humanity in action-packed aerial battles.

Experience fast-paced aircraft combat gameplay with advanced controls, multiple weapons, and dynamic enemy AI. Track targets, evade incoming attacks, and dominate the battlefield in high-risk missions across diverse environments.

Upgrade your jet with powerful systems and alien technology. Improve speed, defense, and firepower to gain an advantage in large-scale aerial warfare scenarios.

Key Features:
Air Combat Simulator: Real-time jet fighter battles and dogfights
Flight Simulator Gameplay: Precision controls and advanced maneuvers
Alien Invasion War: Fight against evolving enemy fleets
Aircraft Upgrade System: Boost speed, armor, and weapons
Mission Variety: Escort, defense, and large-scale combat
Open Sky Environments: Cities, mountains, deserts, and more

Take off, engage, and survive in a high-intensity airplane combat simulator where every mission tests your skill.

70010000118867.name: Doll Defenders
70010000118867.intro: Protect a mysterious dimension from a monster invasion and meet handsome heroes along the way!
70010000118867.description:
Doll Defenders is a tower defense action game set in the “Male Doll” multiverse where you’re tasked with protecting a sacred statue from invading monsters, all while meeting heroes and unlocking special scenes and animations on your way to the final showdown

Master a dozen weapon types or stick to the ones that fit your playstyle. Fight it out against enemy waves across 3 different worlds and 15 unique levels with 8 hunky characters to rescue!

• Journey to a mysterious dimension where characters from the “Male Doll” multiverse of visual novels converge!
• Protect a sacred statue from waves of monsters in top-down tower defense style.
• Choose from 12 different weapon types to suit your preferred playstyle!
• Survive 15 different levels set across 3 uniquely themed worlds.
• Meet and rescue 8 handsome characters and win their affections!

70010000118873.name: Smash Balls 2
70010000118873.description:
Take aim and smash your way through a fast, colourful action shooter where every shot counts.
Blast apart destructible cover piece by piece to flush enemies into the open, timing each hit with care. Trigger the bonus power-up to enter Infinite Mode and unleash a devastating barrage that turns the arena into a storm of flying debris.
But not everything should be shot. Bombs are mixed into the chaos—and hitting one instantly ends the run.
Unlock stylish new ball skins to customise your shots and show off your progress as the challenge ramps up. Easy to pick up, endlessly replayable, and packed with crunchy destruction, this is hyper-casual shooting at its most explosive.

70010000118879.name: Magic Exposure 2
70010000118879.intro: Find new love or mend a broken relationship as you make key choices in a yuri-themed visual novel adventure!
70010000118879.description:
After breaking up with Erika, Bianca's life unravels once more when a second magic camera appears and a new girl, Lúcia, enters the scene. Will she reconnect with Erika or explore a new path with the mysterious student council president?

Magic Exposure 2 is a cute yuri-themed visual novel adventure with a supernatural twist! Take the role of Bianca in a story spanning 15,000 words and featuring 2 romance options to date. Make critical choices for Bianca to affect the narrative and explore multiple endings, unlocking special CG scenes along the way!

• Follow the tale of unlikely companions in a world of anthropomorphic characters!
• Enjoy cute and romantic dialogue spanning a story of 15,000 words.
• Use convenient features to auto-advance, save, load or skip!
• Make key choices for the protagonist and unlock special CG scenes.
• Explore themes of girls’ love with 2 different characters to date!

70010000118888.name: Formula 2026: Rise of Legends
70010000118888.intro:
Jump into high-speed racing action
Master every corner
Rise to become a legend
70010000118888.description:
Jump into fast-paced open-wheel racing and test your skills on the track.

In Formula 2026: Rise of Legends, you’ll drive powerful race cars, take on challenging circuits, and compete against skilled AI drivers. Every race is a chance to improve, push your limits, and climb the ranks.

Whether you're looking for quick racing action or a full career journey, the track is yours.

Features:

Smooth and responsive driving controls
Exciting races on multiple circuits
Career Mode and Quick Race
Competitive AI opponents
Immersive cockpit and dynamic camera views

Win races, improve your driving, and prove you have what it takes to become a racing legend.

70010000118894.name: Real Car Parking Simulator
70010000118894.description:
Real Car Parking Simulator delivers a clean, confident challenge: no races, no rivals—just you, the machine you’re driving, and the space you think you can fit into. Every scenario dares you to prove you’re better than your mirrors say you are.

Slide into the driver's seat of compact commuters, bulky vans, luxury cruisers, and hulking trailers that turn parking into a full-body prayer. Study each angle, feel the physics, and inch your way into spots that look more like rumors than actual spaces.

No timers. No honking traffic. Only quiet tension, creeping shadows, and the soft hum of an engine waiting for your next move. The world may stand still, but your pulse won’t.

Line it up. Ease it in. Commit.
Because in this place, the only mystery is whether you can make perfection look effortless.

70010000118899.name: The Kingdom of the Golden Thread and the MadClocks
70010000118899.intro: Two worlds collide, and something beautiful begins.
70010000118899.description:
The story follows Rapunzel and Alice, two girls from different magical worlds, who meet in a mysterious place where worlds, time, and magic connect. When this place begins to lose its balance, they must work together to understand what is happening and how to restore harmony.

Along the way, they learn that not every problem is solved by force or speed. Instead, the worlds respond when they listen, cooperate, and make thoughtful choices. From their journey, a new world is born, one that grows from curiosity, kindness, and trust rather than strict rules.

In the end, the story shows that moving forward does not always mean rushing ahead, and that true connection happens when different worlds learn to walk together without losing who they are.

An interactive storybook experience. A linear narrative adventure perfect for young readers to enjoy a captivating tale at their own pace.

70010000118913.name: Master Detective: Logic & Mystery Puzzles
70010000118913.intro:
Don’t ignore that unease.  
Uncover the truth hidden in the illustrations.  
Your observation will solve the mystery.
70010000118913.description:
Master Detective: Mystery Deduction — A Thrilling Suspense Case-Solving Mystery Game"" is a detective game where you tap on “suspicious spots” in illustrations based on the given clues to solve each case.

Testimonies from victims, scattered evidence, suspicious behavior...
Can you see through it all?

“The culprit is among us—!”

Armed with intuition and keen observation, take on a series of cases.
The exhilaration when insight and logic align is unmatched.

- Simple tap controls  
- Recommended for mystery and puzzle lovers  

Can you uncover the truth?  
Now is the time for the master detective to step in.

------------------------------

TT supports content creators who stream or share gameplay videos.
Individuals and companies alike do not need to obtain permission from TT to create gameplay content.

70010000118919.name: Quiz: Don’t Lose to a Kid!
70010000118919.intro:
「A kid could answer that in a second.」
A four-choice knowledge quiz that puts adult pride to the test.
70010000118919.description:
「Quiz: Don't Lose to a Kid!」 is a quiz game where you answer elementary school-level math and science questions by choosing from four options.

「This one's obviously easy.」
That's exactly when you're most at risk.

Arithmetic, units, everyday natural phenomena —
Questions you think you know, but the answer just won't come.

・Elementary level means there's nowhere to hide
・Four choices made by instinct lead to unexpected traps
・Even adults keep going 「Wait, which one was it again?」

When the results are in, you'll be saying:
「How are kids so smart?」
「My knowledge might've stopped growing back then…」

Get ready for a guaranteed laugh.

A knowledge quiz game you can tackle solo or enjoy with family, friends, and on stream.

———————————————
TT supports gameplay streamers.
No permission from TT is required for gameplay streaming, whether personal or commercial.

70010000118931.name: London: Echoes of the Past
70010000118931.intro: In 1935 London, investigate a woman’s mysterious return from the dead and uncover a tangled story of love, secrets, and betrayal.
70010000118931.description:
London: Echoes of The Past is a short yuri mystery visual novel.

A mysterious woman returns back from the dead, and the dusty past surfaces. Between a gloomy school girl and a glamorous ex-girlfriend,  every clue interwines. Who is the mastermind behind the scene? Play as a detective heroine in 1935 London, embark on a journey of love and growth.

Characters
He Yaqiong
Calm, intelligent private detective
An agent with a secret mission
"Could it be that every reunions is just another deadly gamble elaborated by the fate?"

Xin Rui
Stubborn, lively young girl with a strange obsession with He Yaqiong
A student client who awaked the dusty memory
“It's hard to say, things are unpredictable, some things always change. Don't you think so?”

Kun Ni
Gentle, elegant, glamorous and mysterious ex-girlfriend

Unidentified international businesswoman

“I've often wondered what kind of person you would become, Ya. Thank you for giving me the answer.”



Story
Bizarre Commissions
Lost and Found
Tangible riddles
Ghosts of the past
A foreign land, an old friend, a strange case.
What's the connection among them?
It's a time for justice
When the bullet takes flight
Can you pierce through the fog
To uncover the truth?

Features
Yuri Mystery Visual Novel
90,000 Words
3 Endings
Cel Shading Backgrounds
25+ CGs

70010000118938.name: EGGCONSOLE Kohakuiro no Yuigon PC-8801mkIISR
70010000118938.intro: A murder at the  Kohaku-kan. Join Detective Ryunosuke Todo as he unpicks a tangled web of secrets to find the truth.
70010000118938.description:
First launched in 1988, this title introduced the world to Detective Ryunosuke Todo. Now, it’s your turn to enter the "Kohaku-kan"—a place where secrets are buried deep. Navigate a complex web of human relationships and piece together the clues in this definitive deduction adventure.

Immerse yourself in a nostalgic, sepia-colored world inspired by the Taisho Roman era. As bodies begin to pile up, can you unmask the killer and uncover the dark motives hidden in the shadows?
 

 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000118958.name: Jukai Maze
70010000118958.intro: Beneath a volcano, a facility probes the afterlife. As the world ends, enter the spectral forest maze to find your missing loved one.
70010000118958.description:
Do you believe in the existence of an afterlife?

■About
Jukai Maze is a sci-fi suspense visual novel where every choice sends the story down a completely different path. Branching routes twist and diverge with each decision you make. Explore multiple endings, piece together scattered clues, and uncover the deeper truth that lies beneath them all.

■Story
“They say there’s a research institute at the foot of Mount Fuji studying the afterlife.”
Intrigued by the half-believable rumor, Shiu invites the protagonist, Haryu Ryoushi, to explore the depths of Aokigahara. What was supposed to be a simple vlog shoot shifts the moment they step into the forest.
As night falls and the mist thickens, they lose their sense of direction. Shiu vanishes without a trace, and Ryoushi is pulled into another “reality,” awakening inside a strange psychiatric hospital.

Everyone inside mutters things that border on madness:
“This place is a dream.”
“This place is another planet.”
“This place is the afterlife.”

As the boundary between truth and illusion collapses, Ryoushi sinks deeper into the maze, and is soon entangled in a baffling murder case……

■Features
- Fully voiced in Japanese
- Clear, elegantly structured storytelling
- Expressive and nuanced character portraits
- Retro filters & pixel fonts included.
- Immersive HD Rumble integration.

70010000118964.name: Rooster Saga: I Believe I Can Fly
70010000118964.intro:
Tap to fly. 
Dodge obstacles. 
Chase high scores.
70010000118964.description:
Rooster Saga is a fast-paced arcade game focused on timing, reflexes, and precision.

Tap to keep the rooster airborne, avoid endless obstacles, and survive for as long as possible. Every mistake ends the run instantly.

Easy to learn but hard to master, Rooster Saga is built for quick sessions and constant retries, where skill is the only thing that matters.

Compete on global leaderboards, compare your scores with other players, and push yourself to fly farther with every attempt.

Whether you play for a minute or an hour, each run challenges your focus and reaction speed.

There are no upgrades, power-ups, or shortcuts. Success depends entirely on your timing and control.

Perfect for arcade fans, score chasers, and players who enjoy simple mechanics with a tough challenge.

70010000118978.name: Kiko's Apple Adventure
70010000118978.intro: Push apples, move the rafts, and outsmart silly enemies in this adorable puzzle adventure!
70010000118978.description:
Kiko the bear has one goal: to bake the biggest apple pie ever for the annual Apple Festival! To do that, Kiko needs lots of apples.

Curious and excited, Kiko sets off on a wooden raft to explore fun and colorful islands, discovering new surprises and collecting apples along the way.

Some naughty creatures are trying to stop Kiko… But Kiko is clever and always one step ahead!

Features:
- About 2-4 hours playtime
- 50+ puzzles, on a gentle difficulty curve, ranging from easy to challenging
- Every puzzle can be freely skipped to return to later
- Enemies with fun and surprising behaviors
- Cartoony graphics
- Relaxing music and playful sounds

70010000118984.name: Airport Baggage Simulator
70010000118984.intro:
Inspect, sort and automate baggage.
Build conveyor lines and unlock promotions.
Airport operations tolerate no negligence!
70010000118984.description:
Welcome to Airport Baggage Simulator! My name is Günther Gewinn and I am the boss here! Recently, a position opened up with us because our previous baggage handler, Rolf, has changed careers.

CONTROL
Flights arrive and matching baggage is delivered for inspection. You pick it up, place it on the table, scan it green or red depending on whether the tag is correct, and then place it on the corresponding output belt. After that, you load it onto a baggage cart at the gate and move on to the next suitcase.

AUTOMATION
The goal is clear: You want to make the processes in the terminal more efficient and automate them. To do that, you can buy conveyor belts and machines on your tablet. Eventually, you leave the checking and sorting to the machines: baggage is transported through the air by a launcher module onto the next belt and sorted by a scanner machine without you having to intervene.

LOGISTICS
Our deliveries run reliably: Our employee Horst is responsible for delivering packages. Everything you order on your tablet, he delivers to you in the shortest possible time and in top quality so you can build it directly in the terminal.

PROGRESS
Through your work, you can earn promotions and take on new responsibilities. These promotions let you unlock new checks, such as weighing suitcases or using the Substance Sniffer. You can also buy expansions for your hangar on the tablet so you have more space to build.

THANK YOU!
If you've read this far, my gut tells me that you are exactly the right person for this job. Congratulations!

Ute Gutgelaunt from HR will send you all important information again by email when you start your duties.

I look forward to your first day at work. Always remember: Airport operations tolerate no negligence!

Kind regards
Günther Gewinn from management

70010000118996.name: Legacy of Kain: Ascendance
70010000118996.description:
Legacy of Kain: Ascendance is a fast, 2D action platformer built around vertical movement, fluid combat, and skill-driven play. 

Nosgoth’s dark fantasy world is brought to life through animated cut scenes and beautifully crafted pixel art gameplay. Each level filled with environmental challenges and puzzles that flow seamlessly into combat. Fly, fight, and unravel the past in a world of collapsing kingdoms, haunted ruins, and shattered timelines.

2D Action Platformer 
Chain melee strikes, evasive dashes, and supernatural attacks in fluid, vicious combat. 

Multiple Protagonists 
Overwhelm the battlefield with Kain’s vampiric powers. Play Raziel before his fall as a human Sarafan knight, then take flight for the first time in his vampiric form. The Vampire Elaleth introduces an aggressive playstyle focused on fast relentless offense.

Original Score
Ascendance delivers a powerful original score by Celldweller.

Returning Voice Talent
Reunites iconic Legacy of Kain voice actors – Michael Bell, Simon Templeman, Richard Doyle and Anna Gunn.

70010000119007.name: 9 R.I.P. sequel
70010000119007.intro: Whether we are alive or dead, he and I still stand on fragile glass. If it shatters, we fall to darkness...
70010000119007.description:
Following the endings of 9 R.I.P., Misa Isshiki finds herself at a crossroads with navigating romantic life and the consequences of her actions during her second year of high school. New challenges await depending on the route taken… 

Whether it's grappling with the fallout of her death, or navigating a relationship with a supernatural being, Misa must come to terms with her decisions to move forward.

Will she continue along the same path, or take another route entirely?

Key Features

Back from the Dead — 9 R.I.P. has returned from the grave with a sequel! With 9 full routes of love interests from the previous game, there's sure to be a man, demon, or spirit for everyone's tastes.

We're in Heaven — Heavenly Routes are back with a more direct sequel to the previous Heavenly Endings. These stories feature new obstacles to overcome. Make your choices carefully, or they will have consequences for everyone around you… Can you and your love prevail through the challenges of life (and possibly death)? 

Sugar, Spice, and Everything Nice — Need something more on the romantic side to sweep you off your feet? Godly Routes suit fans who crave a happy and sweet ending, serving as epilogues for each Love Interest's Godly Ending in the first game.

Killer Views — Character designer Yuuya kills with breathtaking visuals that once again manage to bring even the dead back to life.

70010000119014.name: Quick Deduction Short Mysteries
70010000119014.intro:
One-minute spark, satisfying payoff!
A collection of bite-sized mysteries you can solve in no time.
70010000119014.description:
Perfect for when you’re thinking, “I want a quick dose of mystery!”
Each puzzle is a simple one-question, one-answer challenge.

You’ll face strange little moments hidden in everyday life—
odd details and puzzling events that make you tilt your head.

Read the story, sort out the situation, and reach the one true answer.

Controls are simple:
When you’ve got it, just tap the part you think is the answer.

That “Aha!” moment is addictive.
Use your observation and imagination to unravel every mystery!

70010000119021.name: Idle Immortal
70010000119021.intro: Build an Chinese fantasy sect, recruit disciples, and forge the ultimate squad for ascension! Are you ready to walk the path to immortality as a true Sect Master?
70010000119021.description:
+ Idle Gameplay: Enjoy a relaxing idle experience designed to help you unwind. Even while you are away, your sect keeps battling, growing stronger, and moving closer to ascension. 

+ Squad Building: Recruit from 16 playable characters. Each character has unique talents, classes, and skills. Bring in the disciples you need and freely build your own squad. 

+ Character Growth: Each character can choose one of six different cultivation paths. They can also practice different cultivation techniques to gain unique bonuses. Even characters of the same class can grow into completely different builds. 

+ Explore the World: Journey across the land, discover other sects and factions, and advance the story. Gather resources for personal cultivation and sect development. Encounter random events and uncover unexpected treasures. 

+ Sect Management: While exploring the world, you will also manage your own sect. Earn reputation and sect resources to upgrade and expand your home base. Build different sect facilities to continuously produce useful items. A powerful sect will help you go further on the path to immortality.

70010000119034.name: Super Woden Rally Edge
70010000119034.intro: Race for the top in a rally-focused arcade spin-off to the popular Super Woden series!
70010000119034.description:
Start your engines and get ready to climb your way to the top of the motorsports world! Super Woden Rally Edge is a spin-off of the critically acclaimed Super Woden saga of racing games, blending classic arcade essence with technical depth and a genuine love of car culture. Inspired by genre classics but sporting a personality all its own, Super Woden Rally Edge takes you back to an era where fun goes beyond strict realism.

Navigate using an intuitive overworld map interface and collect a vast variety of vehicles, from the smallest and humblest to unstoppable hill-climb machines. Buy, sell, upgrade and customize cars in your garage, show off your photography skills in photo mode, record your times and try to beat other players’ records. Enjoy a multitude of environments with different terrain and weather conditions to negotiate, all set to an original soundtrack and presented with unique stylized visuals!

• Climb the ranks of the motorsports world in arcade-style rally events!
• Race the clock to claim podium positions.
• Use your winnings to buy new cars, customize and upgrade!
• Explore using an old-school world map interface.
• Check stats, take photos of your cars, listen to music and more between races!

This game and the content contained therein is not authorized by car manufacturers or motor racing competitions and there is no association thereof.

70010000119043.name: Garbage Truck Sim Driver Simulator 26
70010000119043.intro: Drive the city. Clean every street. Master the route.
70010000119043.description:
Step into the cab of a massive garbage truck in Garbage Truck Sim Driver Simulator 26, where everyday city streets become your ultimate playground. Experience the thrill of driving a heavy vehicle, navigating busy urban roads, and completing challenging waste collection missions. 

From tight corners to traffic-packed avenues, every route tests your skill, precision, and strategy — proving that even cleaning the city can be an exciting adventure.

 Key Features
 • Realistic Garbage Truck Driving — Handle a large vehicle with authentic physics, engine sounds, and precise controls. 
• City Waste Collection Missions — Navigate streets, alleys, and busy zones to collect and deliver garbage efficiently. 
• Fuel & Resource Management — Plan routes and fuel stops to keep your truck running smoothly. 
• Immersive Urban Environments — Explore detailed cityscapes with realistic traffic, obstacles, and ambient sounds. 
• Challenging Driving Tasks — Master careful driving, tight turns, and precise parking to succeed in every mission. 

Clean the streets, master the roads, and take full control of your garbage truck. Garbage Truck Sim Driver Simulator 26 turns everyday city work into a skill-based driving adventure that’s as challenging as it is satisfying.

70010000119061.name: Fortress Merge
70010000119061.intro: Merge your defenses, defeat relentless monsters and protect your fortress!
70010000119061.description:
MERGE, BUILD, AND DEFEND
Your fortress is under attack! Choose and place buildings, merge matching ones to make them stronger, and prepare for waves of monsters. Build structures that train knights, horsemen, archers, and mages, while all kinds of turrets and barricades attack or slow down enemies as they approach. Face skeletons, slimes, dragons, giants, and even stronger foes that appear as you progress. Adapt your setup to each threat and prepare for mighty bosses that can quickly break through a weak defense.

MAKE EVERY TILE COUNT
Space is limited, so plan your fortress carefully. Clear trees to open new tiles, decide where to place buildings that train different units, and find the best spots for barricades and turrets. Use every tile wisely, leave enough room to place and merge buildings, and create a layout that balances attack and defense.

LEAD HEROES INTO BATTLE
Place a hero on the battlefield to fight alongside your army. Each hero has unique stats, a combat skill, and a permanent boost. Upgrade your heroes, equip gear with useful bonuses, and prepare them for regular battles and special challenges.

EARN GOLD AND GROW STRONGER
Build gold mines to earn extra gold during each wave, but protect them from enemy attacks to collect the full reward. Spend your gold on rerolls to search for better buildings, gain experience by merging structures, and choose a new upgrade each time you level up. Strengthen your units, improve your defenses, or pick bonuses that fit your current strategy.

FEATURES:
• Units and Defenses - Build structures that produce different units or protect your fortress
• Strategic Placement - Clear trees, manage limited space, and balance offense with defense
• Merge and Upgrade - Combine matching buildings to create stronger structures
• Powerful Enemies - Face skeletons, slimes, dragons, giants, bosses, and unexpected threats
• Lead Your Heroes - Choose from 3 unique heroes, equip powerful gear, and use their combat skills
• Battle Upgrades - Gain experience and choose new bonuses during each battle
• Gold Management - Protect gold mines and spend your earnings on building rerolls
• 3 Challenge Modes - Test your strategy in Grand Battle, Boss Fight, and Hero Battle
• Varied Battlefields - Adapt your fortress to different environments, obstacles, and layouts

Lead your forces, prove your strategic skills, and build a kingdom no enemy can conquer!

70010000119076.name: Solitaire Legends – Card Masters
70010000119076.intro: Classic Solitaire with progression, skins, and endless replay value.
70010000119076.description:
Solitaire Legends – Card Masters brings traditional Klondike Solitaire into a modern framework with progression, customization, and long-term rewards.
Play classic Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, choosing between a relaxed experience or a more challenging variant. Every completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on your efficiency, moves, and overall performance.
As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include card skins, background themes, and card back designs. Each individual card has multiple skins and can be customized separately, allowing you to build a deck that feels truly personal.
Before each match, you can freely adjust your visual setup. Whether you prefer a clean, classic look or something more colorful and modern, your Solitaire table adapts to your style.
With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, Card Masters offers hours of relaxing gameplay and a constantly expanding collection of unlockable designs.

70010000119079.name: Solitaire Legends - Fables and Fairytales
70010000119079.intro: A magical take on classic Solitaire where every card tells a story. Play, level up, and customize every card.
70010000119079.description:
Solitaire Legends – Fables and Fairytales blends timeless Klondike Solitaire with a rich world inspired by classic fairytales and folklore.
Play traditional Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, earning score and experience with every completed game. As you progress, you unlock beautifully illustrated cosmetic rewards inspired by legendary stories such as Little Red Riding Hood, Cinderella, Hansel and Gretel, Puss in Boots, Snow White, Maleficent, and many more.
Each playing card features unique fairytale artwork — heroes, villains, magical creatures, and iconic scenes brought to life in a storybook style. Every single card can be customized individually, allowing you to mix characters and tales across your deck.
Before each game, you can choose your preferred visuals: enchanted forests, castle halls, moonlit villages, or dark fairytale realms as backgrounds, along with themed card backs that match your favorite stories.
With relaxing gameplay, no time pressure, and a constantly expanding collection, Fables and Fairytales offers hours of magical Solitaire for players who love classic cards and timeless stories alike.

70010000119082.name: Solitaire Legends – Sakura Dreams
70010000119082.intro: Play classic Solitaire in a calm, anime-inspired world. Choose between 1-card or 3-card draw, earn score and experience, and unlock beautiful card skins, card backs, and backgrounds.
70010000119082.description:
Solitaire Legends – Sakura Dreams combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a peaceful anime presentation filled with soft colors and elegant designs.
Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.
As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include beautiful anime-style card skins, serene backgrounds inspired by cherry blossoms and temples, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.
Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer soft pastel tones, detailed anime illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.
With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, Sakura Dreams offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.

70010000119085.name: Distorted – The Living Manor
70010000119085.intro: A slow-burn horror game about noticing what shouldn’t exist.
70010000119085.description:
Some places don’t stay the same.
In Distorted – The Living Manor, you are sent to investigate an old mansion rumored to be haunted. Your task seems simple: enter the manor once per day, carefully inspect its rooms, and decide whether something supernatural has occurred.
At first, the house appears normal. Quiet. Almost welcoming.
But as days pass, subtle changes begin to appear — shadows where none should be, missing rooms, unsettling figures that vanish when approached.
Each day follows the same ritual:
Explore the manor, observe its details, and trust your memory.
If you encounter something truly unnatural, you must burn a ghost charm in the fireplace before leaving. If not, you return home and come back the next day.
Your choices matter. Burning a charm when nothing happened — or failing to burn one when something did — pushes the investigation toward an uncertain outcome.
As you explore, you’ll discover diary pages scattered throughout the manor, slowly revealing the tragic history of the house and the entity tied to it. The manor itself reacts to your presence, changing layouts, objects, and events across repeated visits.
No two investigations are the same.
The house remembers.

70010000119127.name: The Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival ~eternal passion! Tie break ♡ game~
70010000119127.intro: Stranded with a Prince—get ready to Survi-love!
70010000119127.description:
The Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival ~eternal passion! Tie break ♡ game~ is a globally remastered edition of a legendary otome game that has been beloved in Japan for more than 20 years.

<Story>
While on vacation, a sudden storm leaves you and your friend stranded on a deserted island.
Join forces with the tennis club members who shared your ship and set out together to escape the island.

<Features>
- Experience a survival life surrounded by many charming Princes.
- Enjoy sweet and bittersweet date events unique to each Prince!
- Experience elegant, beautifully illustrated event CGs, with some artwork enhanced by animation.

<Princes: Characters/Voice Actors>
