70010000119130.name: Inside The Backrooms
70010000119130.intro: Lost in the Backrooms, you must stay alert to survive and find a way out.
70010000119130.description:
You find yourself somewhere you don’t remember entering. The air feels still, the lights flicker without rhythm, and the endless yellow corridors stretch in every direction with no clear origin or end. In Inside The Backrooms, each step forward deepens the uncertainty, as the environment subtly shifts and the sense of direction fades away.

Key Features:
 • Unpredictable Environments: Move through interconnected spaces that change and evolve, making navigation a constant challenge.
 • Constant Danger: Unknown entities roam the area, forcing you to rely on stealth, awareness, and quick decisions to survive.
 • Immersive Atmosphere: Minimalist visuals combined with ambient audio create a persistent sense of tension and unease.
 • Progression Through Discovery: Search for clues, interpret your surroundings, and uncover paths that may lead you further—or deeper into danger.
 • Persistent Suspense: Every step forward increases the risk, as the unknown becomes increasingly present and unpredictable.

Stay focused, trust your instincts, and attempt to navigate your way out before the maze takes hold of you completely.

70010000119135.name: Maid-Sama Cafe: Anime Girls Services in Cute Outfits
70010000119135.intro:
Welcome to the cutest cafe in town.
Adorable maids, sweet smiles, and playful challenges await.
Can you keep every customer happy?
70010000119135.description:
Step inside a charming maid cafe where every day is full of energy, cute outfits, and cheerful anime girls ready to serve.

In Maid-Sama Cafe: Anime Girls Services in Cute Outfits, you’ll help a team of adorable maids keep the cafe running through a collection of fun and fast paced minigames.

Each successful challenge unlocks new illustrations and reveals more of the cafe’s lovable staff.

Every maid has her own personality, uniform, and special charm. As you improve your scores, you’ll discover new characters, unlock gallery images, and experience the lively atmosphere of the cafe.

Relax, play, and enjoy the sweetest service in town.


FEATURES:

● FUN MINIGAMES: Play multiple minigames that test speed, timing, and precision.

● ADORABLE MAID CAST: Meet anime maid girls with cute outfits and charming personalities.

● UNLOCKABLE GALLERY: Progress through the game to unlock collectible illustrations.

● COLORFUL ANIME STYLE: Bright visuals and expressive characters bring the cafe to life.

● EASY TO PLAY: Simple controls designed for quick and enjoyable sessions.

● REPLAYABLE CHALLENGES: Improve your scores and unlock all the cafe’s secrets.


The cafe is open.
Your favorite maid is waiting.

70010000119141.name: Maid-Sama Cafe: Anime Boys Services in Cute Outfits
70010000119141.intro:
The cutest cafe just got a little more dangerous.
Charming anime boys serving with style.
Are you ready for the sweetest service in town?
70010000119141.description:
Welcome to a maid cafe where the service is as charming as it is unexpected.

In Maid-Sama Cafe: Anime Boys Services in Cute Outfits, a team of handsome anime boys is ready to serve customers in adorable maid outfits. Behind the smiles, playful teasing, and stylish uniforms lies a cafe full of energy, fun, and irresistible charm.

Help the boys keep the cafe running through a series of fast and entertaining minigames. Serve drinks, prepare desserts, and assist the staff as they entertain guests with confidence and personality.

Each boy has his own unique style, attitude, and playful charm. As you improve your scores, you’ll unlock new illustrations and discover more about the cafe’s most charismatic staff members.

Relax, enjoy the atmosphere, and spend time with the cutest maids you never expected.


FEATURES:

● CHARMING MAID BOYS: Meet anime boys in cute maid outfits with unique personalities and playful attitudes.

● FUN MINIGAMES: Complete a variety of fast-paced cafe minigames based on timing and reflexes.

● UNLOCKABLE GALLERY: Progress through the game to unlock collectible illustrations.

● COLORFUL ANIME STYLE: Expressive characters and vibrant visuals bring the cafe to life.

● EASY TO PLAY: Simple controls designed for quick and enjoyable sessions.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Improve your scores and unlock all the cafe’s secrets.


The cafe is open.
Your favorite maid might be a boy.

70010000119147.name: Princess Date Diaries: A Fairy Tale Love
70010000119147.intro:
A kingdom ruled by tradition.
A princess longing to be truly seen.
Will your love change her destiny?
70010000119147.description:
In every fairy tale, the princess waits in the castle.

But what if she’s waiting for someone who sees her for who she truly is?

Behind the crown lies expectation, responsibility, and a life planned long before she could choose her own path. Admired by the kingdom, yet rarely understood, every princess carries her own dreams hidden beneath royal grace.

Princess Date Diaries: A Fairy Tale Love is a narrative-driven dating visual novel where your choices shape your romance with beautiful anime princesses from rival kingdoms.

As you grow closer, you’ll discover secret hopes, private doubts, and emotions that could change more than just a royal heart… they could change the future of an entire kingdom.

You’re not just another face in the court.

You’re the one person who sees the woman beneath the crown.

Will you respect royal tradition… or follow your heart and create a new fairy tale?


FEATURES:

● ENCHANTING PRINCESS CAST: Meet anime princesses with unique personalities, royal roles, and hidden dreams.

● FAIRY TALE ROMANCE: Explore castles, royal balls, moonlit gardens, and intimate moments with the princesses.

● CHOICE-DRIVEN STORY: Your decisions influence trust, affection, and the princess’s future.

● MULTIPLE STORY ROUTES: Each princess has branching paths and exclusive romantic scenes.

● DIFFERENT ENDINGS: True love, royal duty, sacrifice, or bittersweet farewell.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Unlock hidden dialogues, special events, and alternate endings.


A crown may define her duty.
But your love could change her destiny.

70010000119153.name: Prince Date Diaries: A Fairy Tale Love
70010000119153.intro:
A kingdom bound by duty.
A prince longing for something real.
Will your love rewrite his destiny?
70010000119153.description:
In every fairy tale, the prince saves the kingdom.

But who saves the prince?

Behind the crown lies pressure, expectation, and a life chosen for him long before he could choose for himself. Admired by all, yet rarely understood, each prince carries a different burden beneath royal perfection.

Prince Date Diaries: A Fairy Tale Love is a narrative-driven dating visual novel where your choices shape your romance with charming anime princes from rival kingdoms.

As you grow closer, you’ll uncover hidden doubts, private fears, and feelings that could change more than just a heart, they could change the future of a kingdom.

You’re not just part of his story.

You’re the one who sees the man beneath the crown.

Will you follow tradition… or create your own fairy tale ending?


FEATURES:

● CHARMING PRINCE CAST: Meet anime princes with unique personalities, royal roles, and emotional depth.

● FAIRY TALE ROMANCE: Experience palace settings, royal balls, secret gardens, and intimate moments.

● CHOICE-DRIVEN STORY: Your decisions influence trust, affection, and the prince’s future.

● MULTIPLE STORY ROUTES: Each prince has branching paths and exclusive romantic scenes.

● DIFFERENT ENDINGS: True love, political alliance, sacrifice, or heartbreak.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Unlock hidden dialogues, special events, and alternative endings.


A crown may shape his destiny.
But your love could change his story.

70010000119161.name: Rain Station Z
70010000119161.description:
As the virus spreads to the mainland, the undead follow.
Worse still, acid rain now falls relentlessly.

Alone once again, your only mission is to survive as long as possible.

Scavenge abandoned buildings for food, water, medicine and weapons.

Avoid the rain whenever you can, or use umbrellas to shield yourself.

Use your map and landmarks to navigate the world in search of better gear.

Includes Local Play and Internet.

70010000119166.name: Hotel Simulator 2026
70010000119166.intro: One mop. One dream. Infinite complaints.
70010000119166.description:
Welcome to the world of luxury, chaos, and leaky ceilings. You’ve just bought a rundown hotel with more problems than guests — but with a bit of grit (and a lot of disinfectant), you might just turn it into the hottest destination in town.

Sweep the floors, patch the walls, and hunt down that mysterious smell in room 103. Design every corner your way — from cozy single rooms to extravagant penthouse suites. Stock up your bar, hire competent (or at least conscious) staff, and keep those demanding guests happy.

The more satisfied your visitors, the better your reviews — and the closer you are to earning that five-star reputation. But remember: one clogged toilet can ruin everything.

Dream big, manage smarter, and maybe, just maybe, you’ll turn this disaster into a destination.

Because every great hotel starts with someone willing to clean up the mess.

70010000119177.name: Fairywood Survivors
70010000119177.intro: Fairywood Survivors — play as a fairy guardian, unleash powerful magic, grow stronger, and survive endless waves of poisonous creatures invading your forest.
70010000119177.description:
Your forest is dying.

Poisonous creatures crawl beneath ancient roots,
corrupt the air, and hunt your friends.
But they forgot one thing — this forest has a fairy protector.

You are the last spark of light in the darkness.
Each wave of enemies grows faster, deadlier, and more overwhelming.
The screen fills with monsters, and there is nowhere left to run.

Draw power from nature.
Level up.
Unlock devastating spells, magical auras, and new abilities.
With every minute, you transform from a fragile fairy
into a storm of magic that wipes out everything in its path.

This isn’t just survival —
it’s the fury of the forest unleashed.

Easy to start. Impossible to stop.

70010000119183.name: VoidFront: Galactic Warfare
70010000119183.intro: VoidFront: Galactic Warfare — a fast-paced sci-fi FPS where cyborg factions battle across the galaxy, wielding devastating space weaponry and relying on tactical team superiority.
70010000119183.description:
VoidFront: Galactic Warfare is an intense team-based FPS
inspired by classic tactical shooters, set
in the heart of an interstellar war.

Two combat cyborg factions clash in battles
across diverse space locations:
lunar bases, scorching desert planets,
and orbital space stations.

Players gain access to a massive arsenal of futuristic plasma weapons —
from devastating shotguns
to precise sniper rifles.

Victory depends not only on accuracy,
but also on tactics, positioning,
and team coordination.

70010000119189.name: Dig Out: Prison Escape Simulator
70010000119189.description:
You’ve been stuck in this dull cell for too long—time to swap boredom for freedom. Pull back the rug, grab whatever you can find (yes, even a spoon), and start digging your way to daylight. Keep an eye on the guard, bribe him with the junk you unearth, and trade toilet paper with your fellow inmates for better tools.

Hide the dirt in the toilet, cover the tunnel when inspections roll around, and keep upgrading your gear—stronger shovels, bigger backpacks, glow sticks, even dynamite. The deeper you dig, the closer you get to freedom… and the riskier things become.

Exercise to boost your stamina, hustle for food to keep your strength up, and follow cryptic letters that hint at the right direction. One mistake could land you back at square one—or worse.

Are you clever, cautious, and desperate enough to outwit the system? The tunnel’s waiting—start digging before the guard notices.

70010000119200.name: Roadtrip Ruckus: RV Survival Crew
70010000119200.description:
The game throws you and your crew into the most chaotic “shortcut” of your lives. One wrong turn, and suddenly you’re navigating a cursed backcountry valley where the roads are rough, the locals are… questionable, and survival requires equal parts teamwork and dumb luck.

Keep your RV rolling by cooking burgers, whipping up antidotes, and handing out meds like a roadside pharmacy on wheels. Every mile brings new hazards, new weirdness, and a growing sense that this vacation should’ve ended hours ago.

Your secret weapon? A physics-based winch strapped to the front and back of your RV. Swing, pull, drag, and pray your way across cliffs, mud pits, and obstacles that definitely weren’t on the map.

Scavenge everything. Repair constantly. Keep your friends alive. And try not to let the RV—or your sanity—fall apart before you find the real road home.

Because in the Valley, the route isn’t the only thing that’s wrong.

70010000119211.name: Panda Keeper
70010000119211.description:
Get ready for the most important mission in the zoo: making sure the laziest and most adorable panda in the world reaches its favorite bamboo!

In Panda Keeper, you take on the role of the keeper and must use logic, patience, and a bit of strategy to push the big fluffy buddy around the enclosure without getting him stuck in tight corners. Each level is a new habitat filled with rocks, fences, and corridors that turn a simple “little push” into a delightful brain teaser.

With 30 short and clever stages, the game is perfect for relaxing while keeping your mind active. There’s no ticking clock, no pressure — just you, the panda, and that magical moment when everything lines up perfectly… and he finally sits down happily to munch on bamboo.

Made a wrong move? No problem! Use Undo to test new ideas or Restart to begin fresh. Here, experimenting is part of the fun.

Cute, clear, and satisfying, Panda Keeper is perfect for anyone who loves calm puzzles, strategic challenges, and the simple joy of seeing a well-fed panda at the end of each level.

70010000119223.name: Balls vs. Tombs
70010000119223.intro: Restore lost souls, master elemental orbs, and cleanse a corrupted graveyard.
70010000119223.description:
Balls vs. Tombs is a dark fantasy action-survival game built around a single, haunting purpose: to reclaim stolen souls and restore peace to a desecrated graveyard.

Once, the cemetery was a place of rest. A sacred ground where spirits slept quietly beneath stone and soil. That balance was shattered when four colossal abominations emerged from the depths, corrupting the land and absorbing every soul bound to the graves. As the spirits were torn from their resting places, the monsters grew stronger, warping the cemetery into a battlefield of rage, decay, and despair.

You are one of the few who can fight back.

CORE GAMEPLAY

At its heart, Balls vs. Tombs is a fast-paced combat experience where precision, positioning, and elemental mastery matter. You fight by launching powerful orbs—your primary weapons against waves of enraged spirits and corrupted entities.

The core loop is simple but deep:

Defeat corrupted enemies

Recover their trapped souls

Return souls to restored graves

Expand and cleanse the cemetery

Unlock new characters, powers, and combinations

Each reclaimed grave brings the world closer to balance—and brings you closer to confronting the true source of the corruption.

ELEMENTAL CHARACTERS & ORBS

Beyond the basic orb, the game features four unlockable characters, each bound to a unique elemental sphere:

Water Orb – fluid control, slowing enemies and shaping the battlefield

Air Orb – speed, mobility, and precision strikes

Poison Orb – damage over time, area corruption, and attrition

Fire Orb – raw power, explosive impact, and aggressive play

Each character fundamentally changes how the game feels, encouraging experimentation and mastery.

FUSION SYSTEM – THE HEART OF POWER

What truly sets Balls vs. Tombs apart is its Orb Fusion System.

Every elemental orb can be fused with every other orb.

Water + Fire
Air + Poison
Fire + Air
Poison + Water
…and every possible combination in between.

Each fusion creates a new, more powerful hybrid orb with unique behaviors, visuals, and combat effects. Some fusions focus on crowd control, others on burst damage, chain reactions, or battlefield dominance.

This system turns combat into a strategic sandbox, rewarding creativity and experimentation. The more you understand the elements, the more devastating your builds become.

THE CEMETERY AS PROGRESSION

There is no traditional level select.

The graveyard itself is your progression system.

As you rescue souls and rebuild graves:

New cemetery zones unlock

Stronger enemy types begin to appear

New characters and orb types become available

The world visually transforms from corruption to sanctified ground

What feels like an open, evolving environment is actually a carefully structured progression arc—a living level system disguised as world restoration.

BOSSES & NARRATIVE

The four great monsters are not random enemies. Each represents a twisted force that feeds on unrest and unfinished souls. As they absorb spirits, they grow in size, power, and presence—something reflected both in gameplay and cinematic moments.

THE GOAL

This is not just about surviving waves.

It’s about bringing peace back to the dead.

Every soul you recover matters.
Every grave you restore reshapes the world.
Every fusion you master brings you closer to ending the corruption.

Welcome to Balls vs. Tombs.
The dead are waiting.

70010000119247.name: Zombie Arise
70010000119247.intro: A retro zombie FPS paying tribute to classic console games from the 1990s
70010000119247.description:
Jonas wake up in the middle of the night to the sound of gunfire on the neighboring farm.

Worried, you decide to investigate and discover your nightmare has come true.

Dead Arise is a tribute to zombie FPS games, a retro experience from the 1990s.

Roam through various environments, killing zombies and collecting resources.

Follow the radio call and escape this hell called the zombie apocalypse!

70010000119255.name: The Shocking World Mysteries
70010000119255.intro:
That nagging feeling is the doorway to the truth.
Tap your way to the shocking secrets behind each baffling case!
70010000119255.description:
"The Shocking World Mysteries" is a tap-to-solve mystery game featuring cases that'll make you do a double-take — and more than a few bumbling criminals along the way.

Observe the crime scene illustration carefully, then simply tap wherever something looks "off" or suspicious based on the question. Trust your instincts and deductive eye to uncover the hidden truth.

"How did they get caught THERE?!" "Who even makes that mistake?!"
The perfect balance of laughs and brain-teasing — a mystery experience that's as funny as it is challenging.

No complicated controls whatsoever.
Pick up and play whenever you have a spare moment —
a mystery game packed with surprises, laughs, and those satisfying "aha!" moments.

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
TT supports gaming content creators.
No permission from TT is required to stream or create gameplay content, whether for personal or commercial use.

70010000119261.name: Arcade Archives CYBER COMMANDO
70010000119261.intro: Emergency orders from the UGSF! Cyber Commando Unit, suppress the AI rebellion!
70010000119261.description:
"CYBER COMMANDO" is an action game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1994.
Board your vehicle and fight to stop a security computer malfunction that has broken out in a space colony.
The thrill of locking on and slamming missiles into a split-second opening—combined with diverse strategies unique to each vehicle—accelerates this ultimate one-on-one battle!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000119297.name: Asphalt Legends – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000119297.intro: Fuel your competitive spirit with Asphalt Legends!
70010000119297.description: Speed through intense arcade races, perform jaw-dropping stunts, and charge to victory in the coolest hypercars! Join global multiplayer races, challenge up to 7 opponents across platforms, or dominate in local split-screen. Connect with friends, create private lobbies, and join racing Clubs for exclusive rewards. Choose from over 300 hypercars such as Ferrari and Porsche, conquer iconic tracks worldwide, and enjoy high-speed racing with detailed vehicles and stunning effects. Customize your ride with unique paint, rims, and parts to showcase your style on the road to racing greatness!

70010000119322.name: Coralia and the Ocean of Stars
70010000119322.intro: A big hearted rescue from the ocean to outer space
70010000119322.description:
Coralia the mermaid and a brilliantly clever crab set out on a fantastic adventure to help Explorer 1, a stranded robot, find the way back home among the stars.
Aboard a quirky, improvised ship, they will have to overcome ocean dangers and cosmic challenges on a journey that connects the deep sea with the mysteries of the universe.

An interactive storybook experience. A linear narrative adventure that is perfect for young readers to enjoy a captivating story at their own pace.

70010000119330.name: TR-49
70010000119330.intro: A World War II computer. An archive of lost books. A world-changing secret. Narrative deduction meets audio drama, from the creators Heaven's Vault.
70010000119330.description:
A voice is saying your name. A WWII-era machine, long hidden in a church basement, whirs to life. Through a crackling speaker, a man asks you to find a stolen book. He only knows the title. Time is running out.

The machine, created by Bletchley Park engineers Cecil Caulderly and Beatrice Dooler, contains a vast archive of obscure books, letters, and journals fed in over the span of fifty years in an attempt to crack the code of reality. As their lives fell apart, the machine kept working.

Navigate the computer’s archive. Link its obscure texts and uncover its creators’ secrets. Communicate with the man behind the speaker to figure out your role in this mystery. Destroy the book at the core of the machine — before it’s too late.

NARRATIVE DEDUCTION

• Deduce links through the archive to locate hidden sources.

• Unravel the stories and unearth the secrets of the books’ authors and the machine's creators.

• Map the archive and find the book that will rewrite the world.

INTERACTIVE AUDIO DRAMA

• Talk with your handler at any time, creating a dynamic audio drama that responds as you explore.

• Featuring the voices of Rebekah McLoughlin, Paul Warren and Phillipe Bosher.

• Original soundtrack by Laurence Chapman.

Written and created by the award-winning team behind Heaven's Vault, Overboard!, and A Highland Song.

70010000119368.name: Squid Survival Simulator
70010000119368.intro: Win the game or lose everything.
70010000119368.description:
Enter a controlled nightmare where every challenge is designed to push you to your limits. You are one of many contestants trapped inside a secret survival facility, forced to take part in a chain of deadly trials. Under constant surveillance and surrounded by unpredictable opponents, you must stay alert, act carefully, and avoid even the smallest mistake.
   
Go through a series of intense stages, each with its own rules, mechanics, and hidden threats. Complete precision-based tasks, endure dangerous environments, and adjust quickly to shifting conditions. Whether it’s timing challenges or strategic group encounters, every stage becomes harder and demands faster thinking and smarter choices.

Key Features:
- Hardcore Survival Minigames — A collection of intense challenges inspired by deadly trials, each with unique mechanics and rules.
- Iconic Game Modes — Red Light – Green Light, Honeycomb, Tug of War, Glass Bridge, Cookie Stage, Glass Squares, and more.
 - Advanced NPC & Guard System — NPC contestants run, panic, and die in real time, while guards detect, chase, and eliminate players.
 - Progression & Missions — Unlock new stages, routes, and tasks through a branching mission system.
 - Realistic Physics & Death System — Detailed animations, ragdoll physics, and impactful reactions to every mistake.
 - Interactive Mechanics — Cut shapes freely, balance across dangerous paths, and face physics-based challenges.
 - Dark Atmosphere — Bright arenas combined with cold lighting, sharp shadows, and brutal, bloody outcomes.

Survive each trial, master every stage, and fight your way out of the facility alive.

70010000119383.name: Chicken Climber
70010000119383.intro: Ready to jump, climb and reach the top!
70010000119383.description:
Chicken climber is a challenging vertical platformer where the only way to move is to jump! Guide a determined chicken through tall and unforgiving stages where each jump must be carefully timed and any mistake can send you falling down.

Climb through 8 handcrafted levels, filled with tight platforms, sneaky traps and wide chasms, and test your precision, focus and skill while you try reaching the goal at the very top.

Each level hides a lot of shiny gems and delicious fruits waiting to be discovered. Gather them all to fully complete each level and prove your mastery. Whether you’re aiming to just reach the top or to achieve 100% completion, Chicken Climber rewards perseverance and careful play.


Features
* Vertical platformer focused on jumping
* Climb through 8 tall challenging levels
* Punishing falls that make every jump matter
* Find hidden gems across each levels
* Simple controls, yet challenging gameplay

70010000119386.name: Waochi! Math Homerun
70010000119386.intro:
Solve to swing, score a homerun for math mastery!
Sharpen your arithmetic skills while having a blast!
70010000119386.description:
[Note] Please note that this software is intended for Japanese speakers and features Japanese-language content.

Waochi! Math Homerun is an educational game that combines the excitement of a homerun derby with essential math practice. It’s the perfect way to build math fluency through play!

[Target Age] 4 to 9 years old


● Gameplay Flow
As the pitcher throws, the ball splits into three in mid-air! Look closely at the math equation on the screen and swing at the ball with the correct answer.

The faster you answer, the further the ball flies! Each game consists of 7 pitches. Compete for the highest total distance and aim for a new personal best!


● 6 Types of Math Challenges
Choose from six levels covering everything from basic addition to division:

・Simple addition (up to 20)
・Addition (without regrouping)
・Subtraction (without regrouping)
・Addition & Subtraction (with regrouping)
・Multiplication (Times Tables)
・Division (Up to 2-digit numbers)


● Building Essential Skills through Fun
Speed and accuracy are the foundations of math success, but mastering them requires consistent practice.

This game turns "drills" into a rewarding experience. With engaging animations and a high-score system that tracks growth, children stay motivated to practice repeatedly.

When your child beats their personal best, be sure to celebrate their success! That sense of achievement—the "I did it!" moment—is the ultimate fuel for their desire to learn.


● Developer
Waochi! Math Homerun is part of the popular children's app series Waochi!, which is widely used by people across the country.

The Waochi! series is developed by WAO CORPORATION, a company that operates educational businesses throughout Japan.

With a curriculum based on many years of educational activities, children can acquire the five essentials for early childhood: intellectual ability, sensitivity, expression, autonomy, and pre-school basic academic skills.

This is an app that both parents and children can enjoy together by tilting, touching, and talking. As you do so, you will surely realize that your child is learning various things without even knowing it.

The learning experiences that young children engage in with their families, while enjoying themselves, will greatly expand their intellectual curiosity in the future. Please hold a smartphone or tablet with your child and say, "Is this how it's done?" or "Well done!" By doing so, your child will enjoy playing and learning even more.

70010000119387.name: Shop Farm Tycoon
70010000119387.intro:
Grow crops, craft goods, and serve happy customers.
Turn a small farm store into a thriving business!
70010000119387.description:
Welcome to Shop Farm Tycoon, a relaxing and addictive business simulation where your goal is to build the most successful village shop!

Start with a small countryside store and transform it into a thriving local market. Grow fresh crops on your farm, craft useful products, and stock your shelves with goods that villagers love.

Harvest ingredients, manage your inventory, and serve customers quickly to keep them happy. The better your service, the more your shop will grow!

Expand your store, unlock new products, upgrade your equipment, and decorate your shop to create the perfect village marketplace.

With simple controls and satisfying gameplay, Village Shop Farm Tycoon is perfect for players who enjoy relaxing management games and building something from the ground up.

Features

• Build and manage your own village shop
• Grow crops and harvest farm ingredients
• Craft products and sell them to customers
• Upgrade your store and unlock new items
• Expand your business and become the ultimate village tycoon
• Relaxing gameplay with charming village atmosphere

Can you turn a small farm shop into the most popular store in the village?

Start your journey and build your own countryside business today!

70010000119406.name: EGGCONSOLE C-SO! MSX
70010000119406.intro: Master the C-SO and take down the Wargaki gang across 10 action-packed stages! Just watch out for the pesky Balloons that can pass right through walls!
70010000119406.description:
This action game was originally released in 1985. Players control the protagonist, Jun-kun, to battle against the "Warugaki" gang. However, Jun-kun’s only move is jumping. You must fight by skillfully using the C-SOs, trampolines, and other features placed throughout each stage. When you step on a C-SO, a countdown begins; during this time, any gang member caught in the C-SO can be crushed and defeated. You can also launch chasing enemies into the air by running across a C-SO together. As the game title suggests, mastering the C-SO is the key to victory! Since the gang members' personalities vary by color, you will need a strategy that accounts for their different behaviors.

Defeating all the gang members is not the only requirement to clear a stage; you must also collect every target item, such as flowers and fruit. In addition to being a clear condition, collecting these items turns Jun-kun red. While in this state, facing the "Balloon" obstacle character allows you to knock it away and defeat it. Wiping out all the Balloons will grant you a 1UP, but be warned: defeating Balloons this way reduces the points you earn from fruit targets. Whether you prioritize a 1UP or a high score is entirely up to you.
 
 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000119410.name: Escape game R00M12
70010000119410.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

70010000119418.name: Logic Training IQ Quiz for Kids
70010000119418.intro:
2 2 4 [?] 16 32 64 — What number goes in [?]?
Train your programming brain with fun puzzles!
70010000119418.description:
Think about the “patterns” and “sequences” behind everyday things.
This is a logic puzzle game where you naturally build programming-style thinking while you play.

How to play is simple :
・Take a close look at the puzzle image
・Find the pattern in the numbers or illustrations
・Once you’ve figured it out, pick the correct answer

Perfect for kids who want to develop logical thinking skills,
and for adults who just want a quick brain workout.

Stuck? Don’t worry—the hint button has your back.
Why not train your brain while killing time?

70010000119429.name: Dead Stride
70010000119429.intro: Escape a city overrun by zombies! Next-gen graphics, heart-pounding action, and a partner who always has your back. Your adventure starts now!
70010000119429.description:
Dead Stride is a cinematic action game set in a zombie-ravaged city, where two heroes, Kaito and Akane, must fight their way to a rescue helicopter. Starting with nothing but a baseball bat, you'll discover hidden weapons across each stage and upgrade your arsenal as you battle to stay alive. With a full opening cinematic and an epic ending, Dead Stride delivers a complete and unforgettable story from start to finish.

・Powered by a next-generation engine with jaw-dropping visuals for a fully immersive experience!
・Team up as Kaito and Akane in co-op mode and combine your skills to conquer every stage!
・Start with just a baseball bat! Find hidden weapons throughout each stage and upgrade your loadout as you level up!
・Collect dozens of unique weapons throughout the game!
・Battle through intense locations including city streets, office buildings, subway stations, and tight corridors!
・Survive relentless zombie hordes in non-stop, high-octane gameplay!
・Swap between Kaito and Akane depending on the stage to maximize your strategy!
・Experience a story-driven adventure complete with an opening cinematic and an emotional ending!

Two heroes. One city. Zero chances to back down. Step into the story of Kaito and Akane, double your strategy, double your thrills, and fight your way through the undead to reach the ending that awaits you both!

Prologue
One night, the sky above the city went dark without warning. Strange groans echoed through the streets, and before anyone could react, the infected were everywhere, flooding out of alleyways, buildings, and subway stations. A city that had once been alive with energy was reduced to ruins in a single night.

Kaito was the top runner of his track team, faster and more agile than anyone around him. Cool on the outside, but driven by a fierce determination within. When someone needed protecting, he never thought twice about stepping up. As the outbreak spread, he raced through the zombie-filled streets, pulling survivors to safety one by one. Without anyone asking, he became the one they all followed.
Akane was a former elite bodyguard, trained by one of the world's leading private security firms. Expert in hand-to-hand combat, marksmanship, and tactical operations, she had walked away from the field after a devastating accident years earlier. But when the city fell, everything she had buried came rushing back. She read the situation in seconds, steadied the panicked survivors around her, and started mapping a way out.

The two ran into each other at a debris-covered intersection in the middle of the city. One look was enough. They both knew exactly what the other was capable of. A message buzzed on Kaito's phone: Government rescue choppers are inbound. Get to the old stadium on the north side of the city. You have until sunrise. Kaito's speed and Akane's tactics. Their fight for survival starts now.

70010000119444.name: Mai: Child of Ages - Storms of Time
70010000119444.intro: A mysterious floating factory has appeared in the skies!
70010000119444.description:
The sudden appearance of a floating factory marks the beginning of a new chapter in the story of Mai: Child of Ages.

Explore brand-new dungeons set inside this colossal airborne structure, filled with ancient machinery, moving platforms, and forgotten experiments.


As Mai ventures deeper into its depths, she will uncover secrets tied to the factory’s origin and the mysterious machines that built it.


Face new enemies, overcome environmental hazards, and solve brand-new puzzles as you explore interconnected areas designed to challenge both your combat and platforming skills.


Main Features

· A new story chapter
· New dungeons set inside a massive floating factory and long-forgotten caverns
· Unique level design with vertical exploration
· New enemies, traps, and puzzles
· Lore that expands the game world
· New craftable items

The skies are no longer safe. What lies within the floating factory could change the course of time.

70010000119447.name: Dracamar
70010000119447.intro: Welcome to the world of Dracamar!
70010000119447.description:
Embark on a beautiful 3D platformer adventure and fight King Crad, the evil dragon who wants to conquer the world of Dracamar. Run, jump, and fight the evil forces to rescue the magical Okis!

The world of Dracamar is inspired by the Mediterranean landscapes and culture, reflecting positive human values in a cozy experience. The game portrays a balanced lifestyle in harmony with nature based on friendship, generosity, and togetherness.

Friends that travel together, stay together! 

Travel and explore all the islands and free the Okis. Collect Moki-balls and use their energy to rebuild the bridges and connect the islands again.

From the shores of the Mediterranean Sea to the Pyrenees Mountains, this epic adventure shows how great life can be when we all have the support of our community.

Heroes come in all shapes and sizes! 

Meet Iko, who is a very special Oki. He will follow you on your adventures and help you defeat King Crad with his magical powers.

Game Features

Explore a colorful world of islands with eye-candy visuals!

3 playable characters: Caliu, Foc and Espurna.

15 levels full of enemies, traps, challenges, and puzzles, plus 5 secret bonus levels. 

7 Final bosses.

Beautifully-rendered graphics.

Discover all kinds of hidden gems, challenges, and collectibles.

Designed to delight and challenge players of all ages and skill levels.

Learn more about the Catalan culture, which has a strong influence on the world of Dracamar (the game is also localized into Catalan).

A production by 3Cat in collaboration with Petoons Studio.

70010000119449.name: Cat & Friends: Purrfect Jump
70010000119449.intro: Once you start, you can’t stop! The irresistibly cute cat-jumping game is here. Jump higher with over 25 cats and build your own adorable collection!
70010000119449.description:
Dive into a world of arcade-style jumping action brought to life with the sweetest, most lovable cat illustrations you can imagine. From the nimble Abyssinian and fluffy Persian to the cheeky Munchkin and classy Tuxedo, more than 25 unique cat characters, each with their own special abilities and personality, are waiting for you in obstacle-packed stages. Endless stages that climb higher with every jump, heart-pounding moments created by tricky obstacles and powerful items, and an intuitive UI with controls designed just for this game deliver a fresh challenge every single time you play. With over 20 costumes to dress up your favorite cats, this is more than a simple arcade game; it is a full-on collectible adventure.

・Over 25 unique playable cats, each with a special ability
・Over 20 costumes to create your perfect cat
・Endless vertical stages that rise higher the more you jump
・Upgrade your cats and use items to supercharge your jumping power
・Casual arcade fun you can play with just one hand
・Addictive, family-friendly gameplay for players of all ages

Warning: once you start, you will not want to stop. Higher, faster, stronger, push your limits! Whether you are a gamer looking for a quick shot of excitement, a cat lover who adores charming art, or a family searching for something fun to play together, Cat & Friends: Jumping Adventure offers an irresistible, one-of-a-kind jumping experience.

Story
Their owner went to heaven first… One day, without warning, the Cat Friends were left alone in an empty house. The food bowl was still there, the favorite toys were still there, and the blanket still held their owner’s warmth and scent, but their owner was nowhere to be found. Every day, the cats sat by the window and gazed up at the sky. Then one night, a faint voice drifted down through the starlight.

“I miss you… I just want to hold you one more time…”

Their owner missed them too. No matter what obstacles stand in their way, no matter how high they have to climb, even to the very ends of heaven, they will keep jumping until they find their beloved owner. Tripping, sliding, falling, the cats never give up. If it means seeing their owner again, they will get back up over and over.

“Wait for us, dear owner. Your little cats are coming to find you, meow!”

Will the Cat Friends be reunited with their owner in heaven? Their heartfelt, high-flying journey to reach the one they love begins now.

70010000119455.name: Kamikaze Strike:FPV Drone
70010000119455.intro: Fly a kamikaze drone through fast-paced FPV missions. Dodge bullets, sneak past jammers and radars, and crash into tanks, troops, and enemy bases.
70010000119455.description:
Kamikaze Strike: FPV Drone pushes the boundaries of modern combat simulation, putting your piloting skills to the ultimate test in high-stakes, first-person kamikaze missions. This isn't just a game; it’s a high-octane descent into the future of electronic warfare, where your precision determines the outcome of the frontline.

Experience ultra-smooth, responsive drone controls engineered to mimic professional racing rigs. From the immersive FPV cockpit, you’ll navigate hostile, high-threat environments where every second counts. You aren't just flying—you are the weapon.
Master the Art of the Strike

Become a ghost in the machine as you weave through "dead zones." To reach your objective, you must:

    -Dodge Enemy Fire: Evade rapid-fire anti-air guns and small arms fire.

    -Neutralize Electronic Warfare: Navigate around signal jammers and radar arrays that threaten to kill your feed.

    -Precision Impact: Deliver devastating payloads by crashing directly into high-value military assets, including heavy tanks, mobile artillery units, and fortified enemy command centers.

Realistic Military Training & Progression

Before heading into the heat of battle, hone your craft in the Dedicated Training Grounds. This expansive training map is designed for pilots to master:

    -High-Speed Technical Flight: Push your motors to the limit through gate races and tight gaps.

    -Acrobatic Maneuvers: Practice power loops, dives, and sharp snaps to become unpredictable to enemy sensors.

    -Tactical Drills: Simulate approach runs on static targets to perfect your terminal velocity and impact angles.

The True Pilot Experience

With cutting-edge flight physics and a simulated analog/digital video feed, you will feel the weight, inertia, and adrenaline of a real-world drone operator. Every vibration and signal flicker pulls you deeper into the role of a modern elite pilot.

Kamikaze Strike delivers an authentic, gritty, and explosive blend of pilot skill and military strategy. The sky is no longer a limit—it’s your playground of destruction.

70010000119461.name: Six Seven Nights
70010000119461.intro: You have six nights. The seventh day changes everything.
70010000119461.description:
Six Seven Nights is a compact first-person survival horror focused on investigation, atmosphere, and escalating tension.

You are sent to a school locals openly call cursed. It has been closed for months after a chain of unexplained incidents and growing panic in the surrounding area. Strange sightings, nightly disturbances, and psychological breakdowns are all tied to the building — or so people believe.

With fear spreading and pressure mounting, authorities decide on a simple solution: demolish the school. Your employer disagrees.

According to the Bureau, destroying the building won't end the phenomenon — it may make it far worse. You are sent in to prevent a disaster before it's too late.

The game unfolds across six playable nights. Each night:
• expands the accessible areas of the school
• introduces new paranormal behavior
• increases pressure and unpredictability

You explore a damaged, partially collapsed building, clearing debris, opening sealed rooms, and uncovering clues through environmental storytelling, notes, and strange markings scattered throughout the school. There is no combat — survival depends on observation, timing, and understanding how the environment responds to your actions.

A persistent hostile presence roams the school and reacts dynamically. Some actions draw attention. Others reduce it. Learning the difference is part of surviving.

Between nights, you receive calls from a Bureau specialist who helps contextualize what you're dealing with — offering guidance without direct answers. The truth is never handed to you.

You have six nights because the seventh day is irreversible.
If you fail, demolition won't erase what's here — it will unleash it.

Features:
• First-person survival horror with a unique combat system
• Six-night structure with escalating tension
• One evolving location that changes with progress
• Environmental puzzles inspired by classic horror
• A reactive entity that responds to player behavior
• Heavy focus on atmosphere, sound, and observation

The school is not just a location.
It's a problem that's running out of time.

70010000119476.name: Photo Girls: No Retouch
70010000119476.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000119476.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000119500.name: Pixie Plates
70010000119500.intro: A magical cooking adventure full of charm and tasty treats!
70010000119500.description:
Whisk up delicious dishes, slide them onto a plate, add the perfect toppings, and serve them to a parade of adorable fantasy customers!

Prepare delightful food and drinks, from decorated pastries and lovely desserts to warm soups, colorful refreshments, and other tasty specialties. Every order needs the right ingredients and finishing touches before it is ready for your magical guests.

Things can get wonderfully busy in the kitchen! Watch your cooking stations carefully, keep drinks from spilling over, and make smart use of every plate as new customers arrive with fresh requests. Leave food cooking for too long or let a drink overflow, and you will have to toss it in the bin and start again. With more hungry customers arriving and several orders waiting at once, there is always something exciting happening behind the counter!

Journey across 3 enchanting worlds in the base game, with 10 levels in each one. Every world brings its own atmosphere, charming customers, and themed dishes and drinks to discover!

Features:
- Prepare and serve a delicious variety of fantasy-inspired food and drinks
- Create every order step by step by cooking, plating, and adding toppings
- Meet adorable customers including pixies, frogs, and other whimsical creatures
- Explore 3 unique worlds in the base game
- Play through 30 delightful levels
- Keep your kitchen running smoothly while managing plates and multiple orders
- Immerse yourself in a bright and whimsical fairy-tale setting

A world of sweet creations and enchanting customers is always ready for the next order!

70010000119526.name: Road Jumper
70010000119526.intro: Are you ready to jump, race, and master the road?
70010000119526.description:
Road Jumper is an action-packed arcade driving game where speed, timing, and precision are the keys to victory! Take control of a powerful off-road vehicle and race across crazy wooden ramps, massive loops, and daring jumps high above stunning mountain landscapes.

Collect coins, avoid explosive TNT crates, and conquer challenging obstacles as you push your driving skills to the limit. Each level tests your reflexes and control — one wrong move and you’ll crash!

With vibrant visuals, smooth controls, and addictive gameplay, Road Jumper delivers thrilling stunt action for players of all ages.

70010000119532.name: Hasbro Games™ Junior Collection
70010000119532.intro: Play Monopoly Jr., Clue Jr., and The Game of Life Jr. Customize your avatar, unlock rewards, and enjoy local multiplayer fun for up to 4 players.
70010000119532.description:
Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Clue Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.

Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.

Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!

3 CLASSIC GAMES IN ONE: Play Monopoly Jr., Clue Jr., and The Game of Life Jr.

FUN FOR EVERYONE: Kid-friendly rules that are easy to learn and play fast.

LOCAL MULTIPLAYER PARTY: Play together with up to 4 players on one console.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR AVATAR: Unlock fun new looks and cosmetic rewards as you play.

• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000119540.name: Good Girls: Temptation in Disguise
70010000119540.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000119540.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000119546.name: Reptilian Rising
70010000119546.description:
Reptilian Rising is a retro-style, turn-based strategy RPG where history’s greatest heroes take on the most ridiculous crisis time has ever seen. Assemble a squad of legends – from Cleopatra and Robin Hood to Einstein – and fight across randomly generated battlefields, from prehistoric jungles to dystopian futures.

Harness time-based powers to clone your troops, summon reinforcements, or open time gates for rapid deployment. Face bizarre Reptilian foes including dino-cyborgs, Manborgs, and the ultimate villain: the Dictatorsaur.

With reactive combat, over 20 playable heroes, and branching missions, no two runs are ever the same. Save humanity in style. Open the door, get on the floor… and shoot the dinosaur!

Key Features
- Turn-based squad tactics with reactive combat twists
- 20+ iconic heroes to recruit from history, myth, and beyond
- Dozens of outrageous reptilian enemies and 9 unique boss fights
- Strategic upgrade system including artifacts, cloning, time gates and more
- High replayability through mission branching and bonus objectives
- Digitally realized ‘80s tabletop-inspired aesthetic

70010000119555.name: Bad Girls: Sweet Trouble
70010000119555.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000119555.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000119561.name: Dig to Escape - Obby
70010000119561.intro: The only way out… is down.
70010000119561.description:
You’ve been staring at the same cell walls for way too long… and something under your floor feels wrong. So you do the only sensible thing: pull the rug, grab whatever you can dig with, and start tunneling like your freedom depends on it—because it does.

Chip away in secret, stash the dirt, and keep your eyes open for inspections. One guard walk-by at the wrong time and your whole “master plan” becomes “extended stay.” Trade contraband with other inmates, bargain for better tools, and upgrade your strength, stamina, and carry space so you can dig deeper without collapsing halfway to victory.

Dig smart. Move fast. Don’t get caught.
Because freedom isn’t going to dig itself—and the guards definitely aren’t helping.

70010000119566.name: Bad Girls: Tempting Night
70010000119566.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000119566.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000119578.name: Amanda the Adventurer 3
70010000119578.intro: Get ready for one last adventure!
70010000119578.description:
In Amanda the Adventurer 3, continue Riley Park’s journey, immediately following the events of the previous game, as they discover the truth behind the ongoing mysteries surrounding Amanda and Hameln.

After being left a mysterious tape by their Aunt Kate that set into motion a series of events surrounding the children’s show Amanda the Adventurer, Riley Park survived their Aunt’s attic only to find more mysteries and danger awaiting at the Kensdale Public Library. With the help of a mysterious masked woman, Riley barely escaped the library with their life, and now must explore the abandoned Hameln facilities.

In the final game, play through a return to form taking the best elements of both previous games to create an experience that is bound to thrill both returning and new players alike.

FEATURES

- Challenging, escape room style puzzles using clues hidden within the tapes
- Interact with Amanda, and friends in an all new series of 90’s style CGI adventures!
- New Area: You’re not at the Kensdale Public Library anymore! Explore an abandoned Hameln Facility with decades of secrets to uncover.
- Bring closure to the story of Amanda, Riley, Aunt Kate, and everyone affected by the sinister production of Amanda the Adventurer and the Hameln Corporation’s mysterious motivations.

70010000119590.name: There's No Differences: Dragons
70010000119590.intro: Ready to test your detective skills? Find the differences between two similar dragon-themed scenes!
70010000119590.description:
Do you have a sharp eye? We challenge you to test it! Find 10 differences between two similar images. But beware, they change every time you attempt it!

Key features:
- 9 levels with changing differences to find (we didn't really count all the combinations, sorry!)
- cute hand-drawn dragons
- hints

70010000119596.name: A Frog's Job 2: Froggina
70010000119596.intro: Use your new ability to stop time to complete the levels
70010000119596.description:
Your life has come to an end, when you find Frog God he seems impressed. Turns out most frog souls need a soul reaper to show them the way to the afterlife.

And there seems to be few soul reapers currently, which is why he offers you a job! You can earn reincarnation if you collect enough lost frog souls. 

For that task you’ve been gifted with the ability to stop and resume time at your will. You can also soot a projectile of goo you can ride!

Jump over moving platforms, avoid pits, spikes, and enemies to rescue those souls.

How many souls can you save? Find out in this timeless puzzle platformer.


Features
* Mix of 2D and 3D visuals
* 4 different biomes
* Time-stopping game mechanic
* Puzzle platformer

70010000119602.name: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection
70010000119602.intro: The complete iX series, refined. The apeX of 2D action reaches a new peak!
70010000119602.description:
Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection brings together and updates the apeX of 2D action for new and old players alike.
The Dual Collection includes both Luminous Avenger iX 1 and 2, with all all DLC included, as well as balance adjustments.
It also features a new mode, Endless Battle.

●Revised balance "Director's Cut"
Luminous Avenger iX's Darkness Trigger "berserk" mode has been powered up.
Luminous Avenger iX 2 receives a new "Spike Smash" system, powering up Copen's main weapon, the Razor Wheel.
A number of other adjustments also improve gameplay balance.

●All DLC included
Every item is built in, including content that was previously limited availability.

●New "Endless Battle" mode
Luminous Avenger iX and Luminous Avenger iX 2 each receive a special mode, "Endless Battle". Configure the settings to your liking before facing off against an endless onslaught of random bosses.
How many will you be able to defeat? Take on the apeX challenge!

●Two sci-fi action stories filled with character
Copen is a hard-boiled fighter in a grim future distopia.
Can he save the powerless people he meets? And can they save him?

[Voice Cast]
Copen: Yuma Uchida (Japanese)
           Alejandro Saab (English, iX 2)
Lola: Mayu Mineda (Japanese)
        Cassandra Lee Morris (English, iX 2)
Kohaku: Yumiri Hanamori (Japanese)
            Kira Buckland (English, iX 2)
Blade: Yui Ishikawa (Japanese)
Null: Sumire Morohoshi (Japanese) 
       Natalie Rose Hoover (English)

70010000119618.name: Hoodbound
70010000119618.intro: A small hero. A big adventure.
70010000119618.description:
Hoodbound is a charming 2D platformer set in a whimsical yet mysterious fantasy world.
Step into the role of a small hooded adventurer and journey through forests, caves, snowy lands, and ancient dungeons filled with secrets, treasures, and playful dangers.

Jump, explore, and fight your way past quirky enemies, uncover hidden paths, collect coins, and help strange characters you meet along the way. With smooth platforming, hand-crafted levels, and a cozy dark atmosphere, Hoodbound blends lighthearted charm with classic adventure.

Whether you’re exploring at your own pace or chasing every secret, the world of Hoodbound is full of surprises waiting just beyond the next platform.

70010000119624.name: EGGCONSOLE Advanced LORD MONARCH PC-9801
70010000119624.intro: Fortify your nation and conquer enemy castles in Falcom's masterpiece RTS. With 52 diverse stages and addictive gameplay centered on occupation rates.
70010000119624.description:
This title is a real-time simulation game released by Nihon Falcom in 1991.

As the player, you become the king of a nation, governing your land with the ultimate goal of conquering all rival countries. You will issue commands to your units to cultivate land, build houses, construct defensive fences, and lay down bridges. While working to build a robust stronghold, you can merge units together to form a powerful army. Ultimately, capturing the enemy's castle clears the stage.

After completing a stage, statistics such as your occupation rate are displayed, encouraging replayability as you aim for higher scores.

The game features a total of 52 stages. Not only does the difficulty increase as you progress, but the visuals—including characters and themes—also change. This ensures the game never feels stale, allowing you to enjoy a fresh experience every time you play.

70010000119627.name: Pitstop in Purgatory
70010000119627.intro: Solve the mystery of Astrid’s untimely demise in this visual novel.
70010000119627.description:
Astrid wakes up in Purgatory and she doesn't remember anything. 

Point and click your way through adventure-based gameplay mixed with visual novel storytelling. Solve the mystery of our heroine's unexplained and unusual death. 

Experience a heartfelt story where your choices matter, with five different interactive routes. Feel your way through a charming, funny, dramatic and moving narrative full of compelling characters, brought to life by partial voice acting.


Features:
* Visual novel narrative with choices
* Point and click adventure gameplay
* Beautiful, unique art style
* Unlock 70+ hidden items
* Partial voice acting
* Original soundtrack composed by Endigo

70010000119641.name: Plane Flight Simulator
70010000119641.intro: Discover new horizons and build your aviation empire.
70010000119641.description:
Plane Flight Simulator lets you experience the thrill of flying like never before. Step into the pilot’s seat with a single goal: master the skies and grow your aviation career from humble beginnings to global recognition. Every flight challenges your skills, strategy, and courage as you explore the world from above.

Key Features:
• Fleet Management: Purchase and upgrade aircraft — from light private planes to powerful passenger jets — improving speed, maneuverability, and reliability.
• Infrastructure Development: Expand hangars, improve your airbase, and optimize conditions for maintaining your fleet.
• Realistic Weather Conditions: Navigate wind, rain, fog, and thunderstorms, adapting to every challenge with precision.
• Day and Night Cycle: Fly at sunrise, bright daylight, sunset, or under the stars for truly immersive experiences.
• Freedom of Exploration: Unlock dozens of airports worldwide, discover new routes, and test your reflexes, endurance, and piloting skills.

Plane Flight Simulator is more than just flying — it’s a journey of ambition, courage, and discipline. Fly, upgrade, explore, and become a true king of the skies.

70010000119646.name: My Little Puppy
70010000119646.intro: "They say a dog who went ahead waits to welcome you in the end."
70010000119646.description:
"There is a saying that when you depart from this world, the dog who went ahead will warmly welcome you."

Bong-gu the Welsh Corgi was once an abandoned dog. Judging by his docked tail, someone had once cared for him, but for some reason, he became unwanted. As an 8-year-old senior dog with various illnesses, it was hard for him to find a new family. Trapped in a cage at an animal shelter, each day passed gloomily for Bong-gu. Then one day, a miracle happened. Bong-gu met a new family. The man who took Bong-gu had a somewhat scruffy appearance and seemed slightly awkward, but Bong-gu loved his scent. From that day on, Bong-gu lived out his remaining days just like any other dog would: playing tug-of-war, running around, eating, and sleeping. In the end, he crossed the rainbow bridge, having lived out a simple yet joyful life.

Sniff sniff… this scent… One day in dog heaven, Bong-gu wakes from his nap to a very familiar scent. Sniff sniff… it's dad!. Though faint, surely it is dad's scent he has been waiting for. Jubilant, Bong-gu escapes dog heaven and embarks on a journey to meet his dad - a journey that may hold unexpected dangers. Just as his dad once found him by some miracle, it is now Bong-gu’s turn to find his dad.

Will Bong-gu be able to see his dad again?

[An adventure in a beautiful world filled with stories of dogs and people]

Teetering on the border between life and death, a world outside of dog heaven feels both familiar and strange. Embark on an adventure through beautifully crafted landscapes including deserts, snowy mountains, and beaches. Experience diverse gameplay across adventure, action, racing genres. And remember, Bong-gu is a dog! Actions like sniffing, barking, running, and jumping come with limitations. To overcome his limitations and reunite with his dad, he must meet, give, and receive help from people and other dogs, each with unique stories to share. Unlike cats, there is only so much a dog can do alone!

[In the end, this is a story for all of us]

At the end of his journey, Bong-gu finally reunites with his dad. The journey is filled with joy and excitement, but also moments of hardship and sadness. Yet, the ending has always been written: those destined to meet again will find their way back together. My Little Puppy may be a story about a dog, but it is also a story of relationships, farewells, and reunions that speaks to us all. For those waiting to see their once-in-a-lifetime friend or family member again, or those preparing for an inevitable parting that may come, we hope this story brings warm comfort. One day, we will meet again.

70010000119653.name: Quantum Beast
70010000119653.description: Defeat the crazy robots and save the city! Obtain a variety of weapons and props to tackle various challenges.

70010000119666.name: Castle Tycoon Simulator
70010000119666.description:
Build your legacy from the ground up! In Castle Factory Tycoon, you aren’t just a king—you’re an industrial mastermind. Transform a small plot of land into a sprawling, impenetrable fortress by mastering the art of the forge.

Forge. Sell. Expand.
Start your journey by purchasing your first Droppers. Watch as they churn out essential gear for the realm. From sturdy axes and shields to mystical glowing potions, every item created is gold in your pocket.

Massive Construction.
With over 160 unique upgrades and items to buy, your castle will never stop growing. You can even upgrade your upgraders!


Features:
>Rebirth System: Reached the top? Reset your progress to earn permanent money multipliers! Every rebirth makes your next empire grow faster and bigger.

>Auto-Save & Load: Your progress is safe with us. Build at your own pace—your kingdom will be waiting exactly where you left it.

>Stunning Visuals: Watch your empty lot evolve into a bustling medieval powerhouse.


Are you ready to claim your crown?

70010000119669.name: Splash of Color
70010000119669.intro: Fill the world with color one puzzle at time!
70010000119669.description:
Piece together bright, colorful images by swapping tiles and solving lively puzzles. Watch patterns shift, colors click into place, and pictures slowly reveal themselves as you play. Jump in, make a few swaps, and watch the colors come together.

Features:
- 32 puzzles big and small for you to solve
- Simple and satisfying swap puzzle mechanics.
- A lively and colorful aesthetic!

Watch the colors fall into place!

70010000119674.name: Zawisza The Black
70010000119674.intro: Embark on a thrilling adventure across 18 immersive 3D levels!
70010000119674.description: Battle ferocious Lions, Devils, Witches, Dragons, and more. Collect gold and meat, upgrade weapons, and don a powerful cape to become unstoppable!

70010000119680.name: Solid Void - Topsy Turvy World
70010000119680.intro:
A Fresh Mix Of Classic Nonogram And Jigsaw Puzzles.
Flex your puzzle skills and master nonogram and jigsaw chalenges!
70010000119680.description:
Welcome to a revolutionary puzzle experience where the logic of nonograms meets the artistry of Jigsaw Puzzles. Solid Void - Topsy Turvy World invites you to restore a legendary painting through a unique two-step puzzle adventure, perfect for cozy gaming sessions and mental training.

Unlock a Masterpiece, Two Ways
Each of the 250+ puzzles is a dual-layered challenge. First, engage your logical mind with a satisfying nonogram grid to reveal clues for the second phase where you shift your thinking as you arrange pieces of the image into a cohesive jigsaw to reveal one section of The Topsy Turvy World painting by Pieter Bruegel the Elder. 

Featuring calming music to sooth the mind as you take on increasingly difficult puzzles, Topsy Turvy World ramps up the challenge so that players of all skill levels can test their logic skills. 

With over 250 individual puzzles, players will have plenty to sink their teeth into while constantly working toward the ultimate goal of completing the larger tapestry. Solid Void - Topsy Turvy World is perfect for keeping your brain sharp.

A new puzzle adventure awaits!

70010000119682.name: Gems of Egypt
70010000119682.intro: Treasures of Egypt await your match!
70010000119682.description:
Gems of Egypt is an exciting match-3 puzzle where gems of different shapes fall from above, and your goal is to line up three or more stones to clear them from the board.

Plan your moves, react quickly to the falling pieces, and create powerful matches to score higher and keep the board under control. With simple rules, smooth gameplay, and an authentic ancient Egypt atmosphere, the game is perfect for both quick sessions and long relaxing play.

70010000119688.name: Jigsaw Puzzle Passport: Spain
70010000119688.description:
Experience the sun-drenched beauty of Southern Spain from the comfort of your home. Jigsaw Puzzle Passport: Spain invites you to a relaxing, visual journey, featuring breathtaking high-definition photography.

High-Definition Travel
Forget generic illustrations—immerse yourself in 15 hand-curated levels featuring real-world photography. 

Game Highlights:
>Authentic Scenery: 15 massive, high-resolution puzzles showcasing real locations in Southern Spain.
>Relaxing Atmosphere: No timers, no stress. Just you, the music, and the beautiful scenery.
>Intuitive Controls: Smooth "drag-and-drop" with seamless touchscreen mechanics designed for both casual players and puzzle enthusiasts.
>Save and Load system to track which levels you've already completed!

70010000119704.name: MAID CARD GACHA : COLLECT, DISPLAY, COMPLETE
70010000119704.intro: MAID CARD GACHA: COLLECT, DISPLAY, COMPLETE is a collection-focused gacha simulator featuring exclusively maid character cards.
70010000119704.description:
Players earn money, draw cards, and sell duplicates as they work toward completing a full collection of all 50 maid cards.
The game loop follows a simple, intuitive cycle — Earn → Draw → Sell → Collect More — making it easy to pick up and play even in short sessions.
Cards are divided into four rarity tiers: N / R / SR / SSR.
SSR cards are rare and harder to obtain, so the thrill of chasing them only grows as your collection expands.
Unlock 10-Roll Gacha and Ultimate Gacha by meeting certain conditions, letting you build your collection even more efficiently.
Duplicate cards can be sold, and since sell prices fluctuate randomly, timing your sales becomes part of the strategy.
Beyond collecting, the game rewards smart resource management and well-timed decisions.
Cards you've obtained can also be displayed in a 3D Showcase.
Arrange your favorites to build your very own collection space and savor the satisfaction of completing your set.
Gather funds through minigames, pull the gacha, put cards on display, and aim for full completion.
Simple, accessible, and deeply satisfying for any collector.
【Features】
・Only maid character cards — a focused, themed collection
・Full 50-card collection to complete
・Four rarity tiers: N / R / SR / SSR
・Sell duplicate cards to fund more draws
・Fluctuating sell prices add strategic depth
・10-Roll Gacha and Ultimate Gacha included
・Display cards in a 3D Showcase
・Minigames included for earning funds
・One-time purchase — no subscriptions, play at your own pace

70010000119729.name: RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme
70010000119729.intro: Jump into explosive combat racing where every track is a battlefield and every rival is a target.
70010000119729.description:
Burn rubber, fire rockets, and survive the arena in this explosive combat racing experience.

RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme throws you into a post-apocalyptic world of armored cars, deadly tracks, and all-out vehicular warfare. Every race is a battle where speed, firepower, and survival decide who rules the arena.

Play solo or challenge friends in local split-screen mode and prove who dominates the battlefield.

Pick from 21 unique cars, each with its own ultimate ability, upgrade path, and special body kits. Choose your class - SPEEDSTER, GUNNER, or CRUSHER - and master a wide arsenal of abilities, from rocket salvos and mini-missiles to teleport swaps, laser drones, flamethrowers, ghost summons, freezing blasts, and electric traps.

Race through 7 locations, face 5 unique bosses, and test your skills across Career, Event, Season, and Split-Screen modes. Every boss features distinct mechanics and attack patterns, from rocket barrages and enemy summons to teleport strikes, poison shots, and ice crystal traps.

With a variety of mission types and deep upgrade systems, every run offers a new way to dominate the road.

Event mode features tournaments built around specific cars, where you build your run by choosing skill cards between stages and survive with a single shared HP bar.

Season mode introduces daily challenges and leaderboards - complete missions, set records, and earn rewards.

Features:
• 20+ hours of combat racing in Career mode
• 21 unique cars with ultimate abilities
• 3 car classes: SPEEDSTER, GUNNER, CRUSHER
• 4 game modes: Career, Event, Season, Split-Screen
• 7 distinct locations and 5 unique bosses
• Wide range of weapons, abilities, and upgrades
• Local split-screen multiplayer on one console

70010000119739.name: Urban Jungle
70010000119739.intro: Use luscious plants to turn your home into a green haven in Urban Jungle.
70010000119739.description:
Urban Jungle is a charming and relaxing simulation game that invites you to transform ordinary apartments into a lush, green haven by placing delightful plants with savvy. But no worries, you won’t have to deal with watering or pest control – the plants just need a good spot, and that's enough to create to comfiest and coziest home of them all. Oh, and don’t forget to pet your cat!

Features:

- Decorate with Plants: The core gameplay revolves around arranging a diverse selection of plants in your apartment. Each plant can be placed in different spots, challenging you to find the optimal placement to enhance the room’s coziness and aesthetics.
- Puzzle Elements: While the game is primarily about decoration, it includes puzzle-like aspects. You’ll need to think strategically about where to place each plant to maximize the comfort and visual appeal of your home, ultimately unlocking new plants.
- Relaxing Atmosphere: Urban Jungle is designed to be a stress-free experience. There are no time limits or high-pressure scenarios. You can move plants around freely and adjust your setup at your own pace.
- Environmental Storytelling: The game’s narrative is subtly woven into the environment. As you progress, you’ll uncover pieces of a heartwarming story that unfolds across the different stages of the protagonist's life.
- Interactive Elements: In addition to plants, you can interact with other items like lamps and humidifiers to alter the ambiance of your apartment, further enhancing the cozy feeling.

Immerse yourself in the serene joy of plant decoration, where every decision brings your apartment closer to becoming a perfect green sanctuary.

70010000119746.name: Drive Thru Fast Food Simulator
70010000119746.intro: Build your fast-food empire from the ground up.
70010000119746.description:
Drive Thru Fast Food Simulator throws you into the fast-paced world of a high-poly, first-person drive-thru restaurant, where you are both a worker and the manager. From prepping ingredients to handing out orders through the service window, every task is in your hands. Can you serve every customer quickly, keep the kitchen running smoothly, and turn your restaurant into the city’s favorite spot?

Key Features:
• Order & Cook with Precision: Grill burgers, slice vegetables, fry perfect fries, fill sodas, and serve ice cream — all in real-time, with attention to detail.
• Supply & Logistics Management: Order everything from meat and vegetables to branded packaging. Receive deliveries at the back door and unload manually to keep your kitchen stocked.
• Cleanliness & Maintenance: Greasy stoves and messy floors demand constant attention. Use cleaning tools regularly to maintain hygiene and avoid penalties.
• Drive-Thru Service: Take orders from cars, prepare meals efficiently, and hand them out through the service window to keep drivers satisfied and your reputation high.
• Reputation & Time Management: Each on-time order boosts your rating, unlocking new features and attracting more customers. Prepare for busy rush hours, manage opening and closing times, and balance kitchen duties with supply and cleaning tasks.

In Drive Thru Fast Food Simulator, every day is a race against time. Strategic planning, quick hands, and careful multitasking are key to running a successful drive-thru.
