Step behind the counter, master the kitchen, and transform your small restaurant into the city’s ultimate fast-food hotspot. Are you ready to serve the perfect order under pressure?

70010000119752.name: Roll Mad
70010000119752.description:
A physics-driven 3D rolling platformer built around control, balance, and deliberate movement. Navigate hazard-filled stages where narrow paths, collapsing tiles, enemies, and instant-death traps demand careful planning and precise execution.

More than fifty handcrafted stages offer multiple routes and constant risk–reward decisions, encouraging experimentation without forcing a single solution. Progress is measured through mastery, with star ratings awarded for collecting every coin in a stage.

Optional red coin challenges push skilled players into dangerous territory for pure completion prestige, while collected coins can be spent on cosmetic ball skins that never affect gameplay. With clear, readable visuals, consistent physics, and a gradual difficulty curve, the experience is suited to both short play sessions and long-term mastery.

70010000119759.name: Island Survive Simulator - Craft, Build, Grow
70010000119759.intro: Lost in the middle of nowhere. No rescue. No second chances.
70010000119759.description:
After a shipwreck leaves you stranded on a remote island, survival becomes your only goal. Surrounded by ocean and unknown terrain, you must quickly learn how to adapt and use the environment to your advantage. With no tools, no shelter, and limited resources, every step you take matters. You begin by gathering what you can, crafting simple items, and building a safe place to survive the day and night cycle.

As you spend more time on the island, new opportunities appear. You improve your equipment, expand your shelter, and explore deeper into different areas. Managing resources and making the right choices becomes essential as you try to stay alive and progress. What starts as a basic survival challenge gradually turns into a full experience of building, growing, and creating your own system on the island.

Key Features:
- Survival Gameplay: Adapt to the island and manage your basic needs
- Crafting System: Create tools and useful items from gathered resources
- Building Mechanics: Construct and improve your shelter
- Resource Gathering: Collect materials found across the island
- Exploration: Discover different parts of the environment

Island Survive Simulator - Craft, Build, Grow delivers a steady and engaging survival experience where progress depends on how well you build, explore, and use everything around you.

70010000119770.name: SEEK
70010000119770.intro: A nightmare you cannot wake from, a pain that refuses to fade.
70010000119770.description:
In this unique survival horror game, classical music intertwines with psychological terror to create an oppressive, chilling atmosphere. You play Alice, an ordinary girl who wakes up to find herself trapped in a bizarre, ever-changing world. A snowbound orphanage, monsters lurking in the shadows, and intricate puzzles—every step is fraught with danger and uncertainty.

To survive, you must gather supplies, evade pursuit, and uncover the secrets hidden in the darkness. But as the truth gradually comes to light, can you bear the cruel reality behind it all?

Gameplay features:
Action Shooting
Use a variety of firearms to defeat enemies

Map Exploration
Explore the eerie orphanage step by step, collecting items to unlock new areas while confronting unexplained changes that may occur without warning

Resource Management
Gather and make prudent use of limited resources, and do whatever it takes to survive

Puzzle Solving
Gather clues, solve a wide range of puzzles, and uncover the final truth

70010000119787.name: Hearthstorm
70010000119787.intro: General, prepare your army for victorious battles. Select the card and make your first move!
70010000119787.description: Your army awaits orders! Put the right units on the right line at the right time and win every battle you enter. No excuses for the enemy!

70010000119793.name: Rolling Wheels
70010000119793.intro: You are a wheel. A truly deadly wheel. No one will be safe in your path.
70010000119793.description: Smash and break everyone on your way down the slope. There is no time to stop and no time for mercy.  Just charge forward, ignoring all obstacles.

70010000119799.name: Cola Riders
70010000119799.intro: Ride the Cola & Mint Rocket for the craziest experience of your life!
70010000119799.description: Famous cola and mint candy mix effect in the fast-paced runner game. Collect as many cola bottles as you can and blow them up with the mints. The more bottles you collect, the longer your jump will be. You don't have to follow the road if you don't want to - just use the jumps to change the lines and overtake your opponents in the race!

70010000119805.name: Flippy Jump
70010000119805.intro: Bouncing fruits and vegetables in your fridge - what could be more unusual?
70010000119805.description:
"You close the door of your refrigerator and an interesting life begins inside. Fruits and vegetables try to escape from this big white cage. Break everything around you and smash through shelves to find a way out. The more precise the timing of the jump, the more powerful the impact. That's exactly what you need to succeed! 

Try to get out all the fruits and vegetables out of the fridge. Carrot, cucumber, sausage, and even a spoon for some reason.

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Let the Big Fridge Riot begin! "

70010000119811.name: Run, Sandwich, Run!
70010000119811.intro: Want to know how sandwiches are really made?
70010000119811.description: Making a sandwich is not as easy as it seems. There are many obstacles to overcome in the kitchen to make a delicious meal. You have to be sure to use all the tasty ingredients in the right order. Give it a try and see if you can do it!

70010000119817.name: Planet Divers
70010000119817.intro: Fire up your blasters and smash through any planet's defenses!
70010000119817.description: Learn to react quickly to unconventional situations. Maneuver your way through sneaky enemies and use your attacks to destroy planetary defenses.

70010000119844.name: Arcade Archives Mr.Do!
70010000119844.intro: Eating, throwing or crushing... Mr.Do! is very active!
70010000119844.description:
"Mr.Do!" is an action game released by UNIVERSAL in 1982.
Take control of a colorful clown as you clear stages by defeating monsters and collecting cherries.
In addition to the two widely played versions, this edition includes the rare "OLDEST version"—the very first iteration featuring a unique character design for the protagonist!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000119864.name: Carom Billiards
70010000119864.description:
Carom Billiards - The Ultimate Carambole Experience

Experience the most authentic carom billiards simulation available on console. Step up to the table and master the elegant art of carambole, where precision and finesse meet strategic play.

In carom billiards, two players compete using cue balls—one white, one yellow. Your objective: strike your cue ball so it contacts both other balls in a single shot. Pure, skillful billiards at its finest.

Features:

-Hyper-Realistic Physics Engine
Every shot behaves exactly as it would on a real carom table. Execute advanced techniques including jump shots, topspin, backspin, screw shots, and massé. Watch as balls respond to spin, speed, and angle with stunning accuracy.

-Precision Controls & Targeting
Intuitive controls put professional-level shot-making at your fingertips. Apply English, adjust power, and fine-tune your aim with responsive controls designed for both newcomers and seasoned players.

-Challenging AI Opponent
Face off against a formidable computer opponent that plays smart, tactical carom billiards. Beatable with skill and practice, but never a pushover—prepare for a genuine challenge.

-Local Multiplayer
Challenge friends to head-to-head matches on the same device. Perfect for settling disputes about who's the true carom champion.

Discover why carom billiards is considered the purest form of cue sports—no pockets, just skill.

70010000119912.name: The Day I Became a Bird
70010000119912.intro: “When she speaks, Her voice sounds like birdsong…”
70010000119912.description:
The Day I Became a Bird is a heartwarming and handcrafted narrative-adventure game. Telling the tender tale of a young boy, Frank, on his fledgling journey of fluttering feelings, innocent self-expression and honest ingenuity. A story of beaks, feathers, and heartfelt birdsong.

In this playable illustrated story, follow Frank through a slice of his life - biking to school, running around the park, completing puzzles, making memories, and discovering newfound feelings for his classmate, Sylvia.

Help Frank learn more about her, uncover her interests, and ultimately hatch a plan to catch her eye.

Come along for a warm and nostalgic return to childhood, this is one for the hopeful romantics. Let your hearts flutter, spread your wings, and soar.

70010000119922.name: GoodNightGirls
70010000119922.intro: A puzzle game featuring cute girls in pajamas is here!
70010000119922.description:
Collect pieces of the pajama girls and complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Once completed, high‑resolution images will be added to your gallery ♪
=====================
We support game streamers!
No permission is required to stream this game.

70010000119929.name: CardQuest-SimpleCardGame-
70010000119929.intro: Seize Victory with 5 Elements and a Strategic Mana System!
70010000119929.description:
Play or Sacrifice? The Ultimate Choice Awaits in this Competitive Card Game!

CardQuest -SimpleCardGame- creates a fusion of simple rules and deep strategic gameplay. Its defining feature is a unique resource system: you must sacrifice cards from your hand to generate Mana. Will you sacrifice your hand to unleash powerful cards, or will you play it safe with a steady offense? Your decision-making skills will be put to the test.

Battles heat up with 5 elemental affinities—Fire, Water, Nature, Earth, and Wind—and stunning full-screen visual effects for all 25 cards. Seize victory under the high-stakes pressure of "Mana Starvation," where running out of resources means instant defeat!

70010000119930.name: Clock Rogue
70010000119930.intro: Are you confident in your internal clock?
70010000119930.description:
Clock Rogue is a roguelike action game that tests your sense of time.
Moves are set to specific times on a 12-second clock and must be activated by sharp timing using your internal clock.

Will you trust your sense of time and take risks for strong moves, or play it safe and advance cautiously? It's up to you!

◆A unique "time structure" combat system
- When you defeat an enemy, you'll get to choose from three moves to add to the clock.
- The stronger the move, the smaller its activation window.
- Consider each move's position carefully and build a clock that fits your playstyle.

◆Battling inside a hedgehog?!
- The game takes place within the body of a hedgehog.
- As Hari Cells, your goal is to protect the hedgehog from marauding viruses.

Build your own clock and protect the hedgehog!

70010000119936.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Anmyeon-eup
70010000119936.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Anmyeon-eup, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 1 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000119942.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Okgyecheon
70010000119942.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!
70010000119942.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Okgyecheon, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 1 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000119948.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Baekje Military Museum
70010000119948.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Baekje Military Museum, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 1 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery.

70010000119969.name: Japanese Basics HIRAGANA Fill-in Quiz
70010000119969.intro: Learn Hiragana fast—fill-in-the-blank quizzes for Japanese beginners.
70010000119969.description:
Start learning Japanese with Hiragana—the essential first step.
In this simple fill-in-the-blank quiz game, a missing character is hidden with a circle. Choose the correct Hiragana to complete each word!

Short questions make it perfect for quick study sessions, and repeated play helps you recognize shapes and readings naturally. Great for beginners, refreshers, and families learning together.

Fun Hiragana practice with fill-in-the-blank quizzes

Easy controls, quick rounds

Build reading basics through repetition

70010000119990.name: ROUTE16R
70010000119990.intro: The ROUTE16 remake. Beat the revived Kanharoo Gang with your car MAD X-R!
70010000119990.description:
ROUTE16R is a remake of the ROUTE16 series, originally released in the 1980s.

Avoid enemy vehicles and monsters as you race through the stage, collecting every item scattered across the maze.
Switch dynamically between Maze Mode, where you navigate intricate labyrinths filled with traps and gimmicks, and Radar Mode, which reveals the entire stage made up of 16 mazes-delivering a high-speed chase experience that surpasses the original games.

Not Just Escape - Fight Back with the Evolved MAD X-R :
Unlike previous ROUTE16 titles, colliding with enemies triggers a transformation: MAD X-R shifts into a combat robot, initiating battle.
Use your upgraded MAD X-R’s attacks along with SP items collected throughout the stage to deal damage and defeat your enemies.

Customization :
Before entering a stage, use the money you’ve recovered to customize your MAD X-R.
Enhance core attributes like fuel and speed, as well as combat performance, to suit your playstyle.

Boss Battles :
The Kanharoo Gang won’t go down without a fight.
Collecting all items won’t end the stage-doing so will trigger a boss encounter.
Bosses unleash intense attacks to corner MAD X-R.
Dodge their assaults, find openings in their defenses, and strike back by transforming into robot form to deal decisive damage!

Multiplayer:
For the first time in the series, multiplayer mode is included.
Compete in a mini-game where players battle to capture the flag.
Enjoy fast-paced, arcade-style chase action with friends and family!
* Local multiplayer only. Online multiplayer is not supported.

70010000119996.name: The Room Three
70010000119996.intro: Explore unsettling locations, manipulate intricate contraptions and navigate a series of trials devised by a mysterious figure known only as “The Craftsman”.
70010000119996.description:
Fireproof Games are proud to bring the third instalment of the critically acclaimed game series ‘The Room’ to Nintendo Switch™.

The Room Three continues the time-spanning journey of its predecessors by significantly expanding its unique puzzle exploration gameplay. Lured to a remote island, you must draw upon all your puzzle-solving ability to navigate a series of trials devised by a mysterious figure known only as “The Craftsman”.

Captivating Puzzles: The Room Three presents a compelling mix of fantastical puzzles that take you on a tactile journey of intrigue and curiosity. Discover hidden messages, decipher codes and manipulate sophisticated mechanisms with the help of an ornate eyepiece which not only reveals the unseen, but allows you to explore the world in miniature.

Compelling Story & Alternate Endings: Curious letters from a mysterious figure known only as “The Craftsman” will draw you deeper into the mysteries of The Room Three. The cryptic path ahead awaits, interwoven with secrets, deception and peril. What will be your Fate?

Optimised for Nintendo Switch™: Explore The Room Three using either the touch screen or Joy-Con™ motion controls for a tactile experience so natural you can almost feel the turn of each key and the click of every lock. The combination of innovative mechanics and interactive controls create a memorizing experience from beginning to end.

70010000120000.name: House Fixer Simulator
70010000120000.description:
Turn broken spaces into something worth living in.
Step into the role of a renovation specialist and take on jobs that transform messy, damaged, and abandoned spaces into clean, functional, and beautiful homes. From simple cleaning tasks to full-scale renovations, every project challenges your attention to detail, planning, and creativity.

Start with basic jobs like removing trash, cleaning surfaces, and organizing spaces. As you progress, take on more complex tasks such as painting walls, placing furniture, and redesigning interiors. Every action brings visible results, turning neglected environments into comfortable and inviting places.

Earn money, gain experience, and build your reputation as you complete orders for clients across the city. With better results come bigger opportunities — allowing you to upgrade tools, unlock new features, and take on larger, more demanding projects.

Eventually, you can buy old houses, fully renovate them, and sell them for profit. Choose how to restore each property, improve its value, and grow your own renovation business step by step.

Key Features:
	•	Renovation Gameplay: Clean, repair, paint, and restore different properties
	•	Interactive Environment: Move objects, organize spaces, and work with detailed interiors
	•	Tool Variety: Use brushes, cleaning tools, and renovation equipment
	•	Progression System: Earn money, gain experience, and improve your skills
	•	Property Flipping: Buy, renovate, and sell houses for profit
	•	Diverse Locations: Work in apartments, houses, offices, and more

From small cleanups to complete transformations, every project brings visible progress and satisfaction.
House Fixer Simulator delivers a relaxing yet engaging experience where creativity, organization, and smart decisions turn every space into something better.

70010000120008.name: The Legend Of Fireball
70010000120008.intro: Unleash your fireball power and destroy your way to legendary mastery!
70010000120008.description:
FROM ONE FIREBALL TO UNSTOPPABLE POWER
Aim your shot, release the flame, and blast through anything that stands in your path! In The Legend Of Fireball, you begin as a young fireball fighter training in an ordinary room, breaking simple objects to build your strength. Home appliances, computers, motorcycles, cars, massive buildings - every target brings you closer to true fireball mastery.

BURN THROUGH BIGGER AND TOUGHER TARGETS
Grow stronger, upgrade your stats, and take on bigger, tougher, and crazier targets. Boost your Fireball Power, Stamina, Stamina Recovery, and more to turn every shot into pure destruction. When you are ready, enter special challenges with a target and a time limit. Destroy the required number of objects before the countdown ends to earn rewards and unlock the next stage!

MORE POWER WITH EVERY UPGRADE
Gather powerful fireballs, stylish costumes, ancient relics, and loyal pets. Upgrade fireballs to increase your Fireball Power, Gold Acquisition, and Exp Acquisition. Strengthen costumes to improve your Stamina and Recovery. Refine relics for mighty stat bonuses that make every blast even more devastating.

COMMAND YOUR PET COMPANIONS
Create a team of Light and Dark Family pets with active and passive skills. Bring up to 3 pets into action and let them attack alongside you while boosting your power. Their skills add another layer of strength to every stage, turning your fireball training into a true team effort.

FEATURES:
• Fireball Action - Aim, charge, and launch explosive fireball attacks!
• Destruction Progression - Start with simple targets, then work your way up to vehicles and massive buildings
• Deep Upgrades - Upgrade your character, fireballs, costumes, relics, and pets to keep growing stronger
• Stylish Costumes - Wear costumes to boost your Stamina and Stamina Recovery
• Powerful Relics - Collect relics to gain stat boosts for Fireball Power, Stamina, Gold, Exp, and others
• Pet Companions - Build a team of Light and Dark Family pets with active and passive skills
• Timed Challenges - Destroy the required number of targets before the countdown ends to unlock the next stage
• Daily Missions and Achievements - Complete tasks and claim extra rewards
• Special Events - Break the Gold Safe for coins and enter the World Championship to win gems
• Addictive Progression - Keep upgrading, unlocking, and destroying bigger targets

End as the legend who can destroy anything!

70010000120021.name: Cozy Snow Friends
70010000120021.intro: Glide down the snowy slopes, meet adorable characters, ride the cable car, and simply enjoy the moment.
70010000120021.description: Embark on a journey through snowy mountains, racing against rivals as you compete for rewards. Reach the base of the mountain first by dodging obstacles and keeping your momentum as you glide downhill. Meet charming characters, unlock new outfits, and enjoy this simple, cosy game for all ages.

70010000120027.name: Hole ASMR
70010000120027.intro: Absorb fruit and grow your hole
70010000120027.description:
Sink into a calm, satisfying experience where control is simple and the reward is purely sensory. You guide a growing hole across a peaceful island, absorbing carefully arranged patterns of fruit that disappear with smooth, soothing sounds. Every bite feels deliberate and relaxing, designed to trigger that unmistakable ASMR pleasure as colors vanish and space opens beneath you.

As you consume more fruit, you steadily increase in size, unlocking the ability to swallow larger and more complex shapes. What begins as delicate, bite-sized snacks evolves into a deeply satisfying flow of growth and momentum. Clear the entire island to move forward, then continue endlessly as new layouts invite you to relax, focus, and repeat the cycle.

A gentle, atmospheric soundtrack blends with soft absorption effects to create a meditative rhythm. There is no pressure, no rush, and no harsh distractions—just smooth motion, calming audio, and the quiet joy of watching order dissolve into tranquility. Perfect for unwinding, zoning out, or enjoying a peaceful moment whenever you need it.

70010000120054.name: Deckline
70010000120054.description:
Deckline is an atmospheric war-horror card game. Out of ammo and encircled, you play one last game of Durak to distract from the inevitable. Experience the grit and dread of modern combat through the lens of a board game.

Your command has abandoned you. With all resources depleted and no hope of rescue, you and your squad gather for one last game of Durak. With death closing in, you shuffle the deck, clinging to the memories of laughter and camaraderie. Now, it’s all that remains.

Features:
-Immersive design with chilling visual aesthetics and soundscapes that evoke dread.
-A raw depiction of the war zone and the gritty essence of 1990s Eastern Europe.
-Dynamic, randomized gameplay mechanics that constantly reshape playstyle.
-An unconventional horror game capturing the despair and doom of war based on real-life stories.

70010000120058.name: Saint Slayer: Spear of Sacrilege
70010000120058.intro: Saint Slayer is an NES-style 2D action game, featuring loads of stages, enemies, and gore set against the backdrop of late-17th century Europe.
70010000120058.description:
The year is 1698. A mysterious figure named Father Pacer has shattered the peace negotiated after the War of the Grand Alliance, obsessively and violently stealing Catholic relics throughout the Holy Roman Empire. Can the ex-soldier-turned-farmer Rudiger protect his people from a power-mad priest and his horde of monsters and minions? Can he become Saint Slayer?

-A robust, 21-stage single player campaign
-Stunning, gory, and atmospheric NES-era pixel art 
-Killer 8-bit chiptune soundtrack 
-Seven intense boss fights 
-Find and befriend animal familiars 
-Unlockable upgrades and bonuses galore 
-Player choice: Help or hurt those in your path! 
-Rewards multiple playthroughs with challenges and passwords

70010000120066.name: Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000120066.intro: A workout that fits your lifestyle—now enhanced for the Nintendo Switch 2 system!
70010000120066.description:
Punch and dodge* to the beat in the latest entry of the Fitness Boxing series, now with performance enhancements and additional content for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system! Pair up with your choice of nine fully voiced virtual instructors with customizable outfits and hairstyles—and then get your groove on in 30 instrumental songs, some of which are inspired by catchy pop tunes.

Jump into a single Quick Workout, or build an exercise routine that fits your life. Additions to the series include Mitt Drills to practice combos with your instructor and Sit Fit Boxing to work up a sweat without leaving your seat. Whether you’re after a serious burn or just a bit of stretching, the intensity of your workout is up to you!

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition has a faster frame rate and enhanced resolution. It also adds an Advanced Scoring Mode that takes the timing of your hits into account, a Boost Up feature that gradually increases the speed of your workout with each round, and CameraPlay** support so you can see your movements on screen.

Invite a friend to join your workout via GameShare

If you have the Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition game, you can share the game with anyone who has a Nintendo Switch or Nintendo Switch 2 system using GameShare*** via local wireless to work out side by side.

Already have Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack!   

If you already have the game for Nintendo Switch, you can purchase the upgrade pack**** separately to play this version on Nintendo Switch 2.

70010000120100.name: Poopy Time
70010000120100.intro: Don't get caught by the guards, you little vandal!
70010000120100.description: Gather and eat as much food as you can until you can't stand it anymore. Find a secluded corner and show everyone what you've got. Just don't get caught by the guards!

70010000120107.name: 2048 Boys
70010000120107.intro: Get your players on the field! Build the strongest team possible!
70010000120107.description: Decide which direction your athletes will run to maximize their performance. Only you can create a true dream team!

70010000120113.name: Sumo Rumble
70010000120113.description: Meet the sumo wrestlers at the end of each course, so be prepared. Smash him with all your weight and power.

70010000120128.name: The Last Case of John Morley
70010000120128.intro: A forgotten crime. A hidden truth. The last case of Detective John Morley.
70010000120128.description:
Step into the mind of John Morley, a 1940s detective on his final case. Explore shadowed places long forgotten by time, and piece together crime scenes in a narrative adventure steeped in mystery, unexpected twists, and a truth buried for decades.

The Last Case of John Morley is a first-person narrative adventure set in the 1940s. You play as an experienced detective faced with a case long buried by time. After months in hospital, John Morley receives an unexpected visit from Lady Margarette Fordside, an aristocrat haunted by the murder of her daughter twenty years earlier. Though the police closed the case, she believes the real killer was never found. 

What begins as a quiet look into an old case becomes a haunting investigation into forgotten places and long-hidden truths that refuse to stay buried. 


Features 
• First-person perspective – Step into the shoes of Detective John Morley. 
• Atmospheric setting – A game inspired by the great tradition of detective fiction. 
• Exploration and investigation – Reconstruct past scenes and search for hidden clues. 
• Evocative soundtrack – Music inspired by the era enhances immersion. 
• Compact, memorable story – A mystery that will stay with you.

70010000120130.name: Raccoon Survival Simulator
70010000120130.intro: Be clever, be quick, and think like a raccoon!
70010000120130.description:
Step into a vibrant city park as a clever raccoon driven by curiosity and instinct. Explore a lively environment filled with secrets, challenges, and opportunities, where every corner hides something new to discover. Take on the role of a small but resourceful animal navigating a world full of surprises and interactions.

Progress through a variety of tasks and evolving challenges that gradually unlock new abilities.  As your raccoon grows stronger and more capable, new paths and hidden possibilities begin to open.
Dive into a dynamic world that blends exploration, light puzzles, and playful adventures. Meet other animals, complete their requests, and uncover hidden items scattered across the park.

Key Features
	•	Varied Tasks: Complete missions that test your agility and thinking.
	•	Park Exploration: Explore interactive areas and uncover hidden secrets.
	•	Raccoon Abilities: Run, climb, and dig to overcome obstacles.
	•	Animal Interactions: Help others to unlock new paths and tasks.
	•	Dynamic World: Enjoy a lively park full of constant activity.

Follow your raccoon instincts and turn every corner into a new adventure.

70010000120147.name: Car Racing - Auto & Formula Sport
70010000120147.intro: Power or precision — choose your race
70010000120147.description:
Two styles of racing. One complete driving experience.

Enter a world where speed takes different forms — from powerful street machines to high-performance formula cars built for precision and control. Car Racing - Auto & Formula Sport combines two distinct racing styles into one experience, offering both dynamic road racing and professional track competition.

Switch between car racing and formula racing, each with its own driving feel and challenges. Street races focus on control and quick reactions, while formula racing requires precision, timing, and smooth handling. This contrast keeps every race fresh and engaging.

Race across a variety of environments designed to test your driving skills. From open roads to structured circuits, every track pushes your speed, control, and ability to stay focused under pressure.

Choose your vehicle and adapt your driving style to each race. Faster cars demand quick decisions, while formula vehicles require perfect balance and control at high speeds. As you progress, races become more intense and competitive, challenging you to improve with every lap.

Key Features:

- Two Racing Styles: Car racing and formula racing in one game
- Diverse Vehicles: Drive both street cars and high-speed formula cars
- Multiple Tracks: Race across different environments and circuits
- Skill-Based Driving: Focus on control, timing, and precision
- Progressive Challenge: Increasing difficulty and competitive races
- Smooth Controls: Responsive handling for better performance

Master both racing styles and prove you have what it takes to dominate every track.
Drive faster. React quicker. Stay in control.

70010000120153.name: Planet of Lana II: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000120153.description:
A World After the Machines Came
On Lana and Mui’s home planet, new technology brings progress but also stirs greed and imbalance. As different tribes adopt it in their own ways, tensions grow and the world’s harmony begins to shift. When those seeking power push too far, Lana and her little companion are pulled into a journey that reveals long-buried truths about their planet and about themselves.

A World That Tells Its Story
Journey across frozen peaks, deep oceans, and forgotten ruins in a hand-painted world where nature meets technology. With no spoken dialogue, characters express themselves through an alien language, letting the world, music, and your choices carry the story and inviting you to find its meaning for yourself.

A Bond at the Center of the Journey
Planet of Lana II is a cinematic puzzle-adventure built around companionship and trust. Guide an older, more agile Lana and her loyal companion Mui as their bond becomes the key to moving forward in a world where beauty and danger live side by side.

Thoughtful Puzzles & Fluid Movement
Puzzles are woven naturally into the world, rewarding awareness, timing, and cooperation instead of complex logic. Turn Lana’s expanded agility, from wall jumps to smooth movement and momentum, into your path through danger.

An Emotional, Carefully Paced Adventure
As Lana and Mui travel, new discoveries unravel the history of their planet and the truth behind Mui’s origins. Their journey grows into an intimate tale of coexistence, responsibility, and the cost of progress, carried forward by a moving orchestral score that gives weight to quiet moments, bold discoveries, and every emotional turn across its 6 to 8 hour adventure.

A Standalone Experience
Planet of Lana II welcomes new players while offering a deeper journey for those returning, an intimate story about connection, resilience, and protecting what still matters in a changing world.

Key Features

A Cinematic Puzzle-Platformer Adventure
A story-driven experience blending exploration, environmental puzzles and cinematic atmosphere.

A Companion-Driven Journey
A heartfelt adventure built around the bond between Lana and her loyal companion, Mui.

A Hand-Painted World in Transition
Explore a beautifully crafted planet where nature and technology collide, and different tribes respond to progress in their own ways.

Fluid Exploration & Movement
Guide an older, more agile Lana with wall jumps, smooth traversal, and dynamic movement across diverse environments.

Thoughtful & Varied Puzzles
Puzzles are woven naturally into the world, focusing on observation, timing, and cooperation rather than complex logic.

Storytelling Without Words
No spoken dialogue. Meaning emerges through visuals, music, and your interactions with the world.

An Emotional, Carefully Paced Sci-Fi Tale
Uncover new truths about the planet and Mui’s past in a 6-8 hour cinematic journey, accompanied by a moving orchestral score.

70010000120154.name: Sacred 2 Remaster
70010000120154.intro: Includes all expansions and updates in one definitive edition.
70010000120154.description:
Ancaria stands on the brink. T-Energy, the mysterious power source that once brought prosperity, now fuels corruption, conflict, and chaos. In the midst of war and betrayal, seven heroes rise — each with their own fate, abilities, and path through a living, breathing open world.

In this remaster of the beloved action RPG Sacred 2: Fallen Angel, players return to a massive fantasy realm filled with hundreds of quests, dangerous dungeons, and unique combat arts to master. Battle monstrous creatures, uncover ancient secrets, and shape your character through loot, leveling, and deep customization.

With refined combat mechanics, a modern UI, full controller support, and all expansions included, the remaster brings new life to a fan-favorite — whether you’re revisiting Ancaria or setting foot in it for the first time.

Forge your legend. The fate of Ancaria awaits.

70010000120169.name: Dinkum Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000120169.description:
* Download the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition version and get a Battlegrounds Costume you can use in-game!

G'Day! Grab your tools, gather resources, and build your town while hanging out with friends and enjoying the charm of Dinkum.

■ A Survival Life Sim with Endless Possibilities
Plant crops, raise animals, and build your dream farm, or roam the island catching fish and bugs at your own pace.
With changing seasons and weather affecting how your crops grow, every day brings a new challenge. Slip on your flip-flops to hunt for rare fish, bugs, or ores. Every moment becomes a special adventure.

■ Explore and Survive the Wild
From red deserts and lush forests to hidden mines, Dinkum is full of wild places to explore. Hunt wild animals, gather resources, and learn how to survive in the great outdoors.
The creatures might look cute, but don't let your guard down! You'll need tools, weapons, and a solid strategy to make it out in one piece. Will you go head-to-head, or set traps and play it smart? The choice is yours.

■ Build Your Town Your Way
What starts as a simple campfire and a sleeping bag can grow into a thriving town with shops, fountains, flower beds, and windmills.
Craft furniture and decorations to personalize your home, reshape the island to design your ideal town layout, and customize your character's look from head to toe. Invite friends over to show off your one-of-a-kind creation!

■ The Joy of Growing Together
Sell your harvest and foraged goods to earn Dinks, and reinvest them to help your town flourish.
As your town grows, new shops will open, visitors will stop by—and some might even decide to stay for good. Celebrate with festivals and build a vibrant, lively town, whether you're playing solo or with friends.

70010000120176.name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter
70010000120176.intro: Take Fate Into Your Own Hands
70010000120176.description:
After quelling the coup d'état that shook the Kingdom of Liberl, Estelle and Joshua have finally become senior bracers. However, on the eve of the Queen's Birthday Festival, Joshua reveals the dark truth of his past before vanishing into the night, leaving only his brief farewell: "Goodbye, Estelle." Armed with Joshua's harmonica and an unshakable determination, Estelle embarks upon a continent-spanning quest to find her partner.

During her journey, she must take on the sinister society of Ouroboros as it emerges from the shadows to plunge Liberl into utter chaos. The capital in flames. A colossal airship darkens the skies. The looming threat of the Shining Ring... Confronted with the greatest crisis in the history of Liberl, Estelle and her allies battle to find Joshua and untangle the web of intrigue and conspiracy woven by Ouroboros!

Key Features

■ CONTINUE YOUR 1ST CHAPTER JOURNEY
By carrying over your clear data from 1st Chapter, you can obtain exciting bonus items that will let you progress through the story more smoothly.

■ MORE COMBAT OPTIONS THAN EVER BEFORE
Overpower your enemies with new Crafts and S-Crafts! Link your characters' attacks during Quick Battles with the new Brave Rush, and make full use of the orbment system for access to Arts.

■ AN UNFORGETTABLE STORY
Dive into an intricately woven narrative to uncover the conspiracies threatening the Kingdom of Liberl.

■ EXPANSIVE SIDE CONTENT
Enjoy a variety of new content in the sequel, including minigames like fishing and poker, cooking with your companions, and fan-favorite characters joining as playable party members.

Experience the expansive combat system, richly realized world, and stirring story of the 2nd chapter of the Trails series!

70010000120190.name: Arcade Archives SPACE CYCLONE
70010000120190.intro: Stop the BEMs from building enemy rockets!
70010000120190.description:
"SPACE CYCLONE" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1980.
Shoot down the BEMs (insect cyborgs) as they appear in the sky and invade by warping from meteor to meteor. Don't let the BEMs land! They will construct rockets to launch into the sky and blast you with their deadly Cyclone Shots!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000120212.name: Alice in Wonder Underland AIWU
70010000120212.intro: Alice awoke in a strange room. Driven by curiosity, she ventured outside to find herself in a wondrous world...
70010000120212.description:
Alice awakens in a mysterious room and sets off beyond the door.
Outside lies a world that feels strangely nostalgic, yet entirely unknown.
With over 30 uniquely themed areas to explore ! even places you would never expect !
you are free to wander wherever curiosity leads you.
For reasons unknown, Alice has lost her voice.
But don’t worry ? her first friend, Noir Bunny,
will gently guide and support her throughout the journey.
With the Pocket Watch, she can instantly return to her starting room,
so there’s no fear of getting lost.
Be brave, and keep moving forward.

Examine anything that sparks your interest and delve deeper into the mysteries around you.
Through encounters with peculiar residents,
you’ll experience strange and memorable events.
Find outfits to wear as costumes, unlocking new paths.
Collect odd objects in your Encyclopedia, and make practical use of the furnishings in your room.
Puzzles, mini-games, and countless interactive moments of experience and discovery are scattered throughout the world.
Though at times, something unsettling may be lurking in the shadows…

And at the end of your exploration, discovery itself transforms into revelation.

●System Overview
This is an exploration-driven adventure game in which the protagonist,
Alice, uses a transfer device to travel to a variety of worlds.
By gaining new “Outfits” through her experiences, she unlocks paths that were previously unreachable
and gradually expands the scope of her journey.

There are over 30 explorable areas, and the order in which you visit them !
as well as how you approach your exploration !
is entirely up to the player.
Throughout the adventure, puzzles, mini-games, and countless moments of experience and discovery await.

●Characters
Alice
Alice is the protagonist who has wandered into a mysterious world.
Guided purely by curiosity, she slips beyond the door into the unknown.
For reasons unknown, she has lost her voice.
Yet somehow, Noir Bunny ! and a select few others !
seem able to understand what she is thinking.

Noir Bunny
A friendly companion Alice meets at the beginning of her journey.
Perhaps able to sense her thoughts, Noir Bunny supports her along the way.
The Pocket Watch carried by Noir Bunny allows Alice to instantly return to a previous location !
a reliable tool for any adventure.
Journey together and enjoy the adventure.
However…
for reasons unknown, some other Black Rabbits seem to resent Alice
and may even try to stand in her way.

70010000120237.name: In Fair Spirits
70010000120237.intro: A sweet slice of life visual novel
70010000120237.description:
In the distant past, Edmund lived a quiet life with his father and his younger sister, Leofe. 

Edmund wanted nothing more than to protect his sister...

But, despite Edmund’s best efforts, their relationship crumbled.

Now, almost one thousand years in the future, Edmund has been reincarnated in the same sleepy English village of Fenchapel. 

He’s still grappling with painful memories of his younger sister, who perished centuries ago. 


Edmund’s life changes when he meets a smiley young man called Abel with a mischievous streak. He soon learns that there’s more to Abel than meets the eye, and he begins to see in his new companion in a new light.


Features
* Slice of life boys love visual novel
* Timeless romance story with 85,000 words
* Original art and music
* A linear story with no choices or branches
* A happy ending
* Two pretty boys to stare at

70010000120241.name: Solitaire
70010000120241.description:
Solitaire is a classic single-player card game based on the traditional Klondike rule set. The objective is to sort a standard 52-card deck into four foundation piles, one for each suit, arranged in ascending order from Ace to King.

Cards are dealt into seven tableau columns with alternating colors and descending rank sequences. Players move cards between columns to uncover hidden cards and strategically build complete suit stacks. Only Kings can occupy empty tableau spaces. The stock pile allows additional cards to be drawn when no other moves are available.

The game features simple, consistent gameplay with intuitive controls, supporting either touch screen interaction or an in-game cursor. Drag-and-drop mechanics make card movement fluid and precise, preserving the traditional Klondike experience in a clean and accessible digital format.

70010000120247.name: Emerland Solitaire 2 Collector's Edition
70010000120247.intro: An exciting adventure in Emerland, the magical country of Solitaire!
70010000120247.description:
Welcome to the wonderful country of Emerland! 

A stunning new game with classic rules. Hundreds of fun levels, dangerous opponents and heroic companions await in an adventure full of mysteries and secrets.

Dive deep into the world of magical tale where great mages battle for the Source of the ancient magic of the Cards.
Explore mysterious lands accompanied by heroes that include a noble Knight, an Elven Archeress and a mystical Sorceress to defeat the malevolent Dark Master.

Solve puzzles and collect combinations to complete difficult and varied levels.
Get rewards and find new assistants! Prove that you have learned all of the mysteries of the magic of Solitaire and challenge the most difficult trials at the card table.
This game is easy to learn, but are you brave enough to master it?

- Fabulous adventure.
- Legendary heroes!
- Fascinating levels!
- Amazing solitaire in the fairy world.

70010000120252.name: The Darkest Files
70010000120252.intro: Germany, 1956. The war is over, but justice is not served. Former Nazis walk free, while their victims lie in unmarked graves.
70010000120252.description:
Justice requires courage. The courage to uncover truths that no one wants to see. The courage to confront former murderers who now wear suits and command respect. The courage to be threatened, ostracised or worse. And the courage to look into the darkness and be changed forever.

You are Esther Katz, a young prosecutor who has just joined Fritz Bauer's new special unit. Your task seems impossible: to investigate crimes committed years ago, where evidence has been destroyed, witnesses silenced and the perpetrators embedded in the highest ranks of society. Every decision matters. Every interrogation can bring you closer to the perpetrator or lead you astray. Silence is your worst enemy. Time is working against you. And German society is not ready to face its past.

In 1956, Fritz Bauer and his team of “Nazi hunters” demanded justice when everyone else demanded silence. A small team of prosecutors defying an entire nation. Criminals hiding in plain sight as respected citizens. Experience their dangerous struggle through the immersive investigations. Uncover truths a country has fought to keep buried. Challenge a society desperate to rewrite its own past.

Features:
- Investigate two extensive cases based on true Nazi-era crimes
- Interrogate witnesses and suspects, break through walls of silence and expose lies
- Witness different versions of events through Esther's "mind's eye" as you perceive testimonies - which may be truthful, distorted, or deliberately false
- Reconstruct events step by step from fragmented evidence and testimonies
- Prosecute perpetrators in court with the right charges, where your investigative thoroughness will be put to the test
- Shape the outcome with multiple endings - succeed in bringing justice or face the harsh reality of a perpetrator walking free
- Explore Esther's story, her past and her relationships with family, colleagues and the iconic Fritz Bauer
- Immerse yourself in stunning cell-shaded 3D graphics inspired by 1950s pulp comics, complete with comic panels that reflect the era
- Listen to full English voice acting bringing every character to life

70010000120255.name: Apidya‘ Special
70010000120255.intro: Apidya is making a comeback in this authentic 24-bit pixel remake, built from the ground up, but utterly faithful to the original.
70010000120255.description:
APIDYA SPECIAL – A very special retro shoot 'em up buzzes into view!
Take flight in Apidya Special, brought back through sheer Pixel Passion!

1992's home computer legend Apidya is making a comeback in this authentic 24-bit pixel remake, built from the ground up, but utterly faithful to the original.

Developed by the original team alongside a devoted Apidya super-fan-turned-developer, Apidya Special is based on a previously abandoned 1990s console port — combining original assets with all-new pixel art, additional authentic sound effects, and remixed music. Legendary composer Chris Hülsbeck contributes exclusive new studio versions of the iconic soundtrack, never released before.

The warmth and charm of a CRT on modern screens!

Experience Apidya Special in true widescreen with new parallax effects, or switch to the original home computer 4:3 mode that looks, plays, and sounds exactly like 1992. Optional CRT effects with simulated shadow mask, scan lines, and phosphor bloom recreate the classic display feel.

FEATURES:

Authentic Remake – Completely rebuilt from scratch; no emulation.

Two Visual Modes – Seamlessly switch between HD widescreen or original home computer 4:3 presentation.

Exclusive Chris Hülsbeck OST – Brand-new studio versions of the iconic soundtrack, never before released.

Retro Visual Effects – Optional CRT shaders, bloom, and authentic scanline simulation.

Expanded Worlds – 5 diverse themed worlds (Meadow, Pond, Sewers, Cyber, Lair), up to 5 levels each, 20 unique bosses, and hidden special stages.

Fresh Surprises – Randomized in-game events like Night Mode with new enemy sprites.

Co-op Mode – A second player controls one of the helper drones.

Accessibility Options – Modernized difficulty settings to make the game enjoyable for all generations.

70010000120260.name: Find My Frogs
70010000120260.intro: Help Uncle Froger and find +350 hidden frogs across the fairytale village!
70010000120260.description:
Find My Frogs is a cozy hidden object game where you search for frogs and toads in a peaceful, animal village. Explore charming spots, uncover secrets, and help Uncle Froger gather everyone for a family photo!

- Explore the hand-drawn world of Moss Glade
- Find 350+ Frogs and Toads
- Discover 60+ hidden secrets
- Choose between day or night, or let time flow

With soothing animations, sounds, music, and playful interactions - such as helping a little frog pick strawberries - Find My Frogs offers a sweet moment of serenity – lovingly brought by a duo of artists!

70010000120265.name: Streetdog BMX
70010000120265.intro: Get ready for massive tricks, high scores, and gnarly slams.
70010000120265.description:
Streetdog BMX is an action sports game where you ride through expansive maps sending extreme tricks, getting technical on the rails, and feeling the flow.

Customize your bike and rider before hitting the streets to explore six maps packed with wallrides, gaps, bowls, ramps and rails. Uncover new spots, complete handcrafted challenges, and link up your combos!


Your Bike, Your Rules

Focus on high scores and big air, or flow through levels at your own pace. Streetdog BMX accommodates all kinds of riders and play styles. Your lines can be as complex or as simple as you want them to be. Just keep in mind, the bigger the combo... the harder you fall.


Own the Streets

Unleash your creativity. Fakie, manual, icepick or wallride your way through over 270 sick challenges. From barspin to backflip, to crooked grind to crankflip - you’ll have a huge selection of tricks and stunts to use when you send it.


Customization Galore

With dozens of color and outfit options, you can customize your bike and rider the way you want. Play around with options for clothes, shoes, hair, tattoos and more. Build the BMX bike of your dreams with plenty of customizable options ranging from the frame down to the chainring.


BMX for Life

As a longtime BMX rider, I've been pouring my passion for the sport into games like Trail Boss BMX and the Pumped BMX series for years. Streetdog BMX is the action sports game I've always wanted to make and is the next step in combining my love of making games and getting on the bike.

70010000120280.name: House Cleaning Simulator
70010000120280.intro: Clean it. Fix it. Perfect it.
70010000120280.description:
Turn mess into perfection and experience the satisfaction of a job well done.

Step into the role of a professional cleaner and take on a variety of tasks across different locations, from small apartments to large industrial spaces. Every job challenges you to restore order, remove dirt, and bring each environment back to a spotless condition.

Use a wide range of tools and cleaning methods to handle different types of mess. Wash surfaces, remove stains, collect trash, and organize objects while paying attention to every detail. Each space requires a different approach, pushing you to think, plan, and work efficiently.

As you progress, you take on more complex jobs, earn money, and improve your equipment. Better tools help you clean faster and handle tougher environments, allowing you to grow from a beginner into a true cleaning expert.

Key Features:
- Realistic Cleaning Gameplay: Interact with surfaces, dirt, and objects
- Variety of Locations: Clean homes, offices, restaurants, and more
- Multiple Tools: Use mops, vacuums, sprays, and advanced equipment
- Progression System: Earn rewards and upgrade your gear
- Detailed Environments: Discover and clean every corner

From simple tasks to full-scale cleaning challenges, every job brings a sense of progress and satisfaction.

House Cleaning Simulator offers a relaxing yet engaging experience where precision, organization, and attention to detail make all the difference.

70010000120286.name: Meow Moments: Celebrating Myth & Machine
70010000120286.intro: Join cute cats in a time-travel adventure! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore a magical medieval kingdom and a chaotic sci-fi metropolis.
70010000120286.description:
Travel through Time! In this cozy hidden-object adventure, cats and friends explore the contrast between a magical past and a high-tech future. Every detail invites you to discover that whether in a castle or a skyscraper, friendship and fun are timeless.

Start your journey in The Old Kingdom, a peaceful medieval citadel where everyday life unfolds with gentle humor. Watch clumsy trainees, wandering performers, and eccentric adventurers in a world inspired by classic RPGs, full of warm encounters and legendary charm.

Then, warp into The New Frontier to visit Neo-Cat Metropolis. Explore a bustling city of glass towers and floating platforms where robots get confused and flying cars break down. Amidst the neon lights, discover that friends helping friends is what truly keeps the future moving.

Features:

- Cats and Friends: Find delightful characters in two detailed scenes—one from a mythic past and one from a comic future.
- Balloon-Popping Fun: Enjoy relaxing gameplay as you pop balloons across the scenes—a bit of fun with every search!
- Rich Details: Explore beautifully illustrated settings that blend fantasy and sci-fi with visual storytelling in every corner.
- Over 600 Items to Find! Search for 202 cats, 202 unique characters, and colorful balloons hidden throughout the ages.
- Atmospheric Soundtrack: Set the tone with immersive music tailored to match each era—from cozy medieval tunes to chill futuristic beats.
- Family-Friendly Fun: With cozy, pressure-free gameplay and intuitive controls, it’s an experience for all ages. Perfect for relaxing together or playing solo.

Celebrate the connection between myth and machine in this heartwarming journey—where every moment is worth remembering.

70010000120292.name: Living Dead House
70010000120292.intro: Living Dead House delivers a pulse pounding, classic arcade experience. Battle through waves of the undead solo or team up with a friend.
70010000120292.description:
Survive the Night. Escape the Dead.

Darkness descends and the undead rise. Armed with only a handful of weapons and the shelter of an abandoned house, you must fight to see the sunrise. Can you hold out, or be overwhelmed?

Features

Retro arcade thrills with modern polish

Gorgeous 16-bit pixel art bursting with personality

Spooky, toe-tapping chiptune soundtrack

Play solo or team up in local co-op

Arcade and Survival modes for endless action

Compete on leaderboards for 1 or 2 players

20 pulse pounding stages of undead mayhem

6 unique weapons and items to aid your survival

Collect hidden letters to unlock a devastating super weapon

Black & White and CRT filters for an authentic horror atmosphere

70010000120298.name: Cowboy Kart
70010000120298.intro: Good, old-fashioned kart racing in the old west! Up to 4 players.
70010000120298.description:
Giddyup and get ready for some cowboy kart racing, ya’ll!

It’s old school racing I the old west. Hurl horseshoes, drop cow-pies, and toss some TNT in this wily and wild game from another era.

Supports up to 4 players split-screen.

70010000120300.name: Never Grave: The Witch and The Curse Deluxe Edition
70010000120300.intro: A Metroidvania x Roguelite where you journey with the aid of a cursed hat
70010000120300.description:
[This bundle includes the base game, soundtrack, and digital artbook.]
Use a variety of magic or possess your enemies to reach the lowest levels! Bring back loot, build up in your village, make a living and strengthen yourself for the next battle! Supports up to 4-player multiplayer.

Authentic 2D action
-Never Grave is 2D action game where you journey with the aid of a cursed hat. Adventure into dungeons, fight with magic, and sometimes even use the terrain to win! Dungeons such as ruins and botanical gardens are auto-generated and change each time you play. Obstacles and puzzles waiting to block your path in the dungeons, so be careful where you step! 

Possession system
-Possess enemies using a cursed hat. Use unique abilities from your possessed enemies to gain an advantage in battle!

Rebuild a ruined village
-Use materials collected in the dungeons to clear the rubble of ruined villages, build new facilities and cultivate crops in the fields. Produce food and potions in the village to prepare for the next battle!

Multiplayer
-Multiplayer support for up to four players. Call your friends from other worlds and conquer dungeons together!

Game features
-Metroidvania x Roguelite with an emphasis on exploration.
-Sophisticated and tactilely designed player character controls.
-Possess enemies and use their unique abilities with the unique Possession system. 
-Traditional Japanese hand-drawn limited animation is used for character 2D animation.
-Hand-painted backgrounds with depth, as if you are travelling through a world of picture books and cut-out pictures.
-Learn new abilities such as double-jump from artefacts to explore new areas.
-Constantly changing play style depending on the synergy of "traits" associated with magic and items.
-Intense battles with tough bosses. It will take more than just memorizing boss patterns to defeat them without taking damage...
-Rebuild your village. Strengthen yourself through building and production to prepare for the next adventure.
-Explore different terrain each time you play through procedurally generated dungeons.
-Multiplayer support. Up to four players can delve into the dungeon together!

Soundtrack and Digital Artbook
- Relive your journey alongside the cursed hat with the official soundtrack.
- Also included is an exclusive digital artbook full of previously unpublished material, including early design drafts, lore documents, and unused concepts!
   - Original Soundtrack: 13 tracks
   - Digital Artbook: 90 pieces of art (featuring unreleased assets and special tribute illustrations by the development team)

70010000120303.name: Shipwrecked Survival 2
70010000120303.intro: Survive the flood. Explore the unknown. Create your own legend.
70010000120303.description:
Shipwrecked Survival 2 returns with a bigger world, more freedom, and new adventures beyond simple survival.

After a catastrophic flood swallowed the Earth, endless oceans stretch where cities once stood. Stranded on a small makeshift raft with nothing but a hook and your instincts, you must gather floating debris, catch fish, purify water, and craft the tools needed to survive.

Build, expand, and transform your raft into your own floating home. Cook meals, manage resources, and turn scraps into everything from survival gear to powerful upgrades.

But the ocean is no longer just empty water. Set sail and explore distant islands, uncover hidden secrets, and discover abandoned cities left behind by the old world. Search for treasures, face new dangers, and uncover what really happened to civilization.

Choose your own path. Become a fearless pirate, a lone explorer, a master builder, or simply survive day by day. The world is yours to shape, and every journey across the sea tells a new story.

Every wave brings danger. Every horizon holds possibility.

Will you survive… or create your own legend?

70010000120309.name: Hidden around the World
70010000120309.intro: Cozy hidden-object adventure across iconic world cities
70010000120309.description:
Travel the world in this cozy hidden-object adventure inspired by real cities like Tokyo, Paris, Rio, and Venice. 

Explore charming hand-drawn scenes, relax, decorate, and discover hidden treasures across iconic destinations.

Features

- Explore iconic cities from around the world in cozy, hand-drawn scenes
- Find hidden objects and complete relaxing missions at your own pace
- Decorate charming locations and bring each city to life
Unlock new destinations and collect unique souvenirs
- Create levels to share with the world and play levels made by other players
- Enjoy a peaceful soundtrack and soothing visuals

Slow down and enjoy the simple joy of discovery, one city at a time.

Ogre Pixel
2026

70010000120314.name: Black Tower Enigma
70010000120314.intro: Puzzle-Solving Retro Adventure about an Orc inside a Mysterious Tower looking for his Wife.
70010000120314.description:
Play as Wigo, the Orc, whose wife has been kidnapped and taken up to the skies by a magic dress gifted by a mysterious Fairy.

As Wigo saw his wife going up to the skies, he went to the tallest building known on the continent: The Black Tower Enigma.

Inside the Black Tower Enigma, Wigo has to solve some riddles and challenges in order to climb up and find some clues to find his wife.

About levels

Each level is a small yet elaborate challenge that requires the player to use their intelligence and ability to decipher the riddles to advance through the Tower.

Also, Black Tower Enigma has an interesting background story, which is enriched inside the huge library scattered throughout each level of the tower.

Game features

- Elaborated puzzles, riddles, and hints along each level
- Interesting story discovered along each level
- Cool pixelated art-style
- Orchestral-designed music
- Simple and intuitive game play

Ogre Pixel
2026

70010000120319.name: All Motors Racing Simulator
70010000120319.intro: All Roads. All Motors. All Out.
70010000120319.description:
Experience the ultimate racing challenge across every terrain and weather condition imaginable. From sun-drenched circuits to snow-covered mountain passes and rain-slicked city streets, test your skills behind the wheel of 37 meticulously crafted vehicles.

-Master Every Machine
Choose your weapon from an extensive garage featuring 23 high-performance sports cars, 6 precision-engineered Formula Cars, 5 rugged Offroad vehicles, and 3 powerful trucks. Each vehicle offers unique handling characteristics and racing dynamics that will keep you coming back for more.

-Earn, Upgrade, Dominate
Victory means more than glory—cash prizes from each win let you expand and upgrade your collection. Build the garage of your dreams as you progress through increasingly challenging races and championships.

-Race in Any Condition
Adapt your driving style to dynamic weather systems including blazing sunshine, torrential rain, and treacherous snow. Every weather condition changes the track, demanding different strategies and split-second decisions.

-Diverse Tracks and Terrains
From professional racing circuits to dirt trails, urban streets to off-road wilderness, each environment presents unique challenges that will push you and your vehicle to the limit.

-Optimized for Your Setup
Fine-tune your experience with comprehensive graphics options including adjustable quality settings, customizable target framerates, level of detail controls, and optional motion blur—ensuring smooth performance tailored to your preferences.

Are you ready to become the ultimate all-terrain racing champion?

70010000120326.name: Cozy Bay Hike
70010000120326.intro: Welcome to your next peaceful adventure.
70010000120326.description:
Cozy Bay Hike is a relaxing exploration game where you wander across a charming island, uncovering every hidden location at your own pace. There are no enemies, no timers, and no pressure — just you, the breeze, and a beautifully crafted world waiting to be discovered.

Features:
> Peaceful island exploration
> Discover hidden locations
> Complete your discovery journal
> Relaxing atmosphere & soundtrack
> Simple, cozy gameplay

70010000120329.name: Build A Bank Tycoon
70010000120329.description:
Build your financial empire from the ground up! In Build A Bank Tycoon, you’re not just a manager—you’re a financial mastermind. Transform a small startup branch into a powerful, high-security banking empire by mastering the flow of money.

Deposit. Invest. Expand.
Start your journey by purchasing your first Money Printers. Watch as they generate steady streams of income for your bank. From basic teller stations and ATMs to high-tech vault systems and investment desks.

Massive Expansion.
With over 50 unique upgrades and items to unlock, your bank will never stop growing. Expand your lobby, strengthen security, unlock premium services, and even upgrade your upgraders to maximize profits!

Features:

Rebirth System: Reached the top of the financial world? Reset your progress to earn permanent profit multipliers! Every rebirth makes your next banking empire grow faster and stronger.

Auto-Save & Load: Your progress is secure. Build at your own pace—your bank will be waiting exactly where you left it.

Modern Visuals: Watch your small office grow into a towering financial headquarters

70010000120332.name: Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit
70010000120332.intro: All those who are lost deserve kindness.
70010000120332.description:
Help cute, ghostly bears find peace in this relaxing sequel to the beloved life-sim game where kindness rules and new crafting, building, and camping island adventures await.

Attention, Spirit Scouts! Something spooky is afoot: A bus crash has left you stranded alone on a mysterious (yet delightfully cute) island. Explore the unique island, meet and befriend cute, ghostly spirit bears who need your help to remember their pasts and find peace. Customize a bustling, beautiful campsite by crafting, decorating, and building furniture to bring life and color back to this cute island, and hopefully reunite with your lost scout troop as you gradually repair your bus.

YOUR RELAXING ISLAND OASIS AT THE END OF A STRESSFUL DAY

Whether you're new to the "Cozy Grove" community or a devoted fan, this relaxing follow-up to the beloved life-sim adventure offers something for everyone. This edition of "Cozy Grove" is cuter and cozier than ever, introducing a fresh cast of quirky characters, new animal companions, a new setting and added gameplay features that offer endless ways to unwind at the end of a stressful day. So immerse yourself in a unique, relaxing watercolor art style filled with stunning details and activities to explore. Drop in daily for crafting, decorating, fishing and cooking fun, or embark on new quests to stay busy. Lead with kindness and achieve your camping dreams. Customize the cute, spooky island you've always wanted.

FIND NEW FOREVER FRIENDS AND CUTE ANIMAL COMPANIONS

Alongside familiar faces like Flamey and Mr. Kit, new spirit bears are waiting to bond with you and share their backstories. New animal companions are also on the island to offer support and relaxing comfort. Now you can pet a dog (!) or have a snail help lighten your load.

EXCHANGE GIFTS WITH ASYNCHRONOUS MULTIPLAYER MODE

A new asynchronous multiplayer mode lets you see spooky, cute astral projections of other players, connect with fellow Spirit Scouts and send and receive cute gifts through the mail. But introverts, no need to worry: There's no pressure to interact with your fellow players in real time. You're free to discover and gift in your own time, at your own relaxing pace.

NEW SPOOKY MYSTERIES TO INVESTIGATE

Uncover the secrets of the interconnected islands you've landed on as you complete daily quests. As you progress with patience and diligence, you may unlock new areas to explore. Visit dedicated stations for different activities and light up lamps to find bountiful new spots for foraging and mining.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR ISLAND WHILE CRAFTING, DECORATING AND CAMPING

Just because you're living on a haunted island doesn't mean you can't get comfortable! Immerse yourself in crafting and decorating activities, or collect furniture to make the island your own. Plant flowers and fruit trees to harvest, raise ghostly animals and attract pets to your house. And if things start to feel ho-hum, give yourself a custom head-to-toe makeover.

A POSITIVE, HEARTENING DAILY RITUAL

This life-sim game unfolds in sync with real-world time, bringing cute surprises and spooky seasons on the island. If you finish the day's quests, you can cook, craft, collect shells, catch bugs, go fishing, skip rocks or even spruce things up with a new power-washing tool. Rake in rewards as you add to your collection of cute items and earn merit badges for all your accomplishments. A Spirit Scout's work is never done!

Created with love by Spry Fox

70010000120334.name: Street Soccer
70010000120334.intro: Jump into casual street soccer and relive the joy of playing on the neighborhood playground.
70010000120334.description:
Features:

Immersive Gameplay: Enjoy 3v3 and 4v4 matches.
Competitive Cup Mode: Engage in tournament-style gameplay.
Customizable Soccer Balls: Choose from 6 unique designs.
Unique Environments: Play on 5 distinct courts.
Flexible Flooring: Customize with 4 different floor styles.

70010000120346.name: Desert Storm War FPS
70010000120346.intro: The desert doesn't forgive. Neither do you.
70010000120346.description:
Step into the scorching sands of the Persian Gulf, 1991. Coalition forces are pushing deep into Iraqi-held territory, and every dune, every bombed-out building, every oil-choked horizon is a potential kill zone. Desert Storm War drops you into the heart of Operation Desert Storm as a special operations soldier fighting alongside a squad of AI teammates across brutal, tactically demanding frontlines.

Lead Your Squad. Hold the Line.
You never fight alone. Your team of combat-hardened bot soldiers reacts to the battlefield in real time — laying down suppressive fire, flanking enemy positions, and calling out threats. But the enemy is just as organized. Opposing bot teams move with coordination and aggression, adapting to your tactics across every engagement. No two firefights play out the same way.

A War That Feels Real
Desert Storm War is built around one goal: authenticity. Powered by a full IK (Inverse Kinematics) character system, every soldier on the battlefield moves like a human being, not a puppet.

Full Foot IK — Boots plant naturally on uneven terrain, rocky embankments, and rubble-strewn streets. No more floating soldiers or clipping feet.
Arm IK — Weapons are gripped and braced dynamically. Lean against cover, climb obstacles, or crouch behind a wall and watch your soldier's arms adjust in real time.
Head-Look — Characters track threats, teammates, and movement with natural head turns and gaze direction, making every NPC feel aware, alive, and dangerous.

The result is a squad of soldiers that look and move like they actually belong in a warzone.

Fight through a series of distinct operational levels drawn from the Gulf War conflict — desert highway ambushes, urban clearing operations in occupied Kuwait, fortified bunker assaults, and open-terrain armored pushes under the blazing Middle Eastern sun. Each level presents a different tactical challenge, forcing you to adapt your approach, manage your squad, and outgun a well-organized enemy force.

70010000120364.name: Your True Nature Test
70010000120364.intro:
Are you ready to discover your "true self"?
Just answer 4 choices — and your true nature will be exposed!
70010000120364.description:
"Your True Nature Test" is a psychological test game that diagnoses your "true nature" and "hidden personality" — just by answering questions with four choices.

That instinctive choice you made —
it might actually be revealing your deepest psychology!

· Sweet on the outside, but secretly calculating?
· A mastermind who pulls everyone's strings!?

"How is this so accurate?! It's scary…!"
"Had my friend play and their true nature came out — it was a blast!"

Perfect for enjoying solo at your own pace, or getting excited together with family, friends, or on stream — a party diagnosis game for everyone.

Ready to take a peek at your true self?

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
TT supports gaming content creators.
No permission from TT is required to stream or create gameplay content, whether for personal or commercial use.

70010000120375.name: The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search for a Dead Body
70010000120375.intro:
"Is there a dead body who'd like to be buried in me?"
A Coming-of-Age Adventure of a Boy who Believes He's an Ancient Tomb.
70010000120375.description:
In the city of Friendly, where the story takes place, many residents who are shaped like ancient terracotta clay figures belong to the Haniwa Clan.
Amid them lives a curious boy who is neither human nor Haniwa, but something entirely different… a child shaped like a tiny burial mound.
This boy is Kofun, the protagonist of this adventure.

Kofun has always dreamed of becoming a proper burial mound and one day meeting the body that will rest inside of him. 
But despite his dream, he never quite had the courage to go out and search.
That all changed when one day, a spirited boy named Haniwa calls out to him and says, "Come play with me!"
And so...their story begins.

Will Kofun ever find the "perfect body" he's been hoping for?
Come to think of it...if he's neither human nor Haniwa...what even is he?
As you explore the world and meet its many residents, all the questions you and Kofun have will begin to unravel.
Through these encounters, he gradually discovers the truth about his origins.
Enjoy a story full of surprises, following Kofun and his friends through a heartfelt tale of friendship and growth.

■GAME CONCEPT
In The Little Tomb, you will control the protagonist Kofun. The story begins when you explore the town he lives in.
Wander through the town, examine objects, interact with the residents, and uncover the story bit by bit.
Every person you meet and every item you interact with helps move the narrative forward.
If something catches your eye, don't hesitate to take a closer look and see what you can reveal.

You can easily navigate through the main story using the handy dandy "To-Do List". 
But the adventure doesn't stop there, feel free to stray off the path, hunt for hidden treasures, or explore areas unrelated to the main story as every detour is an opportunity for discovery.
Go through the story with Kofun at your own pace.

Kofun grows and develops by earning Action Points.
You gain Action Points every time Kofun interacts with the world through actions such as examining objects, playing on playground equipment, and other activities.
Once you've gotten some Action Points, you can use them to get new skills or hints to help you solve puzzles you encounter along the way. Kofun is always learning!

Give Kofun the experiences he needs to become a great burial mound!

70010000120381.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX
70010000120381.intro: Duel Alongside Your Partner and Forge Your Own Future!
