70010000120381.description:
Your final year at Duel Academy is officially underway!  Select your partner from over 100 visually upgraded characters and conquer your opponents as a Dueling duo! Strengthen your affinity with your classmates and build memories as you study the art of Tag Dueling and prepare for a Graduation Duel to remember! 

Get Your Game On! Classic Dueling is back and rebuilt with over 3,800 cards, including additional fan-favorite cards beyond those featured in the original Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3. Build your Deck, develop unique strategies, and enjoy student life at Duel Academy as you Duel your way to victory.

Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX marks the first-ever Americas debut of Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 content, which was previously unreleased in North and Latin America.

《New Features》
・Unleash your inner HERO! Over 3,800 cards, including additional cards supporting GX-era Decks. 
・Class is in Session Explore, investigate and expand your extracurricular activities with new and renewed mini-games. 
・Duel the World Enter a Casual Duel or Room Match to enjoy both Tag and 1v1 Duels with Online Multiplayer!
・Gallery Mode Reminisce with story scenes from Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE and Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE2.

[About "Yu-Gi-Oh!"]
"Yu-Gi-Oh!" is a popular manga created by Kazuki Takahashi that was serialized in SHUEISHA Inc.'s "WEEKLY SHONEN JUMP" since 1996. Konami Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd. provides a Trading Card Game (TCG) and console games, based on "Yu-Gi-Oh!" created from the original manga, that has been enjoyed around the world.

70010000120395.name: Dreamin' Her
70010000120395.description:
It's summertime during his third year of high school; yet between his exam studies, his hobby, and his relationships, nothing is going well.
As he wallows in despair, 'she' suddenly appears in his dreams...

A masterpiece of great emotional depth and lovingly crafted by the creative team LIFE0 is coming to the Nintendo Switch™!

Playable in two languages!
The text can be set to English or Japanese (audio is Japanese only). This includes in-game text, options, and the digital manual. Language settings can be changed at any time.

Enjoy full HD visuals!
Experience the game in high-definition 1920x1080 resolution by playing in TV Mode.

Touch screen controls and Nintendo Switch™ Lite are also supported.

Game System
Gameplay in this choice-based visual novel involves reading through the story while making choices at certain key points. Different decisions may lead to different outcomes, story branches and endings.

Story
Igarashi Aoi is exhausted.
Day after day, he toils away studying for entrance exams at the behest of his mother while struggling to find inspiration for the novel he's been writing as a pastime.
It's summer, he's in his third year of high school, and he's started to doubt his own purpose.
He only takes solace from spending time with his childhood friend Nanase Mirai, the only person who brings him peace of mind. Yet, for some unknown reason, he gets rejected by her.
As he plunges into despair, 'she' suddenly appears in his dreams.
There, a beautiful ocean stretches into the horizon.
A lone girl stands atop the pale pink seashore.
A girl who appears in his dreams bearing the exact likeness of Nanase Mirai.

The dreams are now eating into reality...

Cast
Nanase Mirai / Kako   VA: Murakami Natsumi
Igarashi Touko   VA: Fujita Masayo
Nanase Megumi   VA: Kondo Yui
Nanase Toshiyuki   VA: Kosaka Atsushi
Kinokuniya Masaru   VA: Urata Wataru
Mr. Ebihara   VA: Ogami Shinnosuke
Yuitsuka Setsuna   VA: Yuasa Kaede
*Fully voiced (excluding the protagonist)

Staff
Scenario: Kitazaki Tom
Character Design & Original Art: Miko

70010000120399.name: English Basics English Vocabulary Fill-in Quiz
70010000120399.intro: Fill the blanks, learn your first English words.
70010000120399.description:
Complete the word by filling in the missing letters!
A beginner-friendly English vocabulary quiz you can play in minutes.

Each question shows a word with blanks. Just choose the correct letters—simple, quick, and satisfying even if you’re new to English.
Replay short sessions anytime and start recognizing spellings naturally as you go.

Great for quick brain training or your first step into English learning.
Build up those “I got it!” moments, one word at a time.

70010000120405.name: Angry Dog
70010000120405.description:
Forget about sitting, staying, or rolling over. In Angry Dog, you trade the obedience school diploma for a license to cause absolute mayhem. Granny just wants a peaceful afternoon, but you have a bad case of the zoomies and a house full of breakable objects waiting to be smashed. Step into the fur of the neighborhood’s naughtiest canine and turn every room into your personal playground.

Unlike your sneaky feline rivals, you are a wrecking ball of energy. Dash through hallways, knock over expensive vases with your clumsy paws, chew up the furniture, and bark until the windows rattle. The game drops you into a fully interactive 3D environment where almost everything can be destroyed, dragged, or messed with. Your goal is simple: cause enough chaos to fill the meter and drive Granny crazy before she catches you with her broom.

70010000120411.name: RV ROADTRIP SIMULATOR
70010000120411.intro: Every road tells a different story of survival and skill.
70010000120411.description:
RV Roadtrip Simulator is a challenging driving adventure where every kilometer tests your control and planning. Take the wheel of a heavy RV and travel through rough roads, narrow paths, and unpredictable terrain as you push forward across long and demanding routes.

Handle obstacles, manage your vehicle, and adapt to changing conditions while turning a simple road trip into a true test of skill and patience. Every decision on the road matters.

Key Features:
• Challenging Roadtrip – Drive across difficult routes filled with obstacles and uneven terrain.
 • Vehicle Management – Monitor fuel, damage, and essential systems to keep moving forward.
 • Physics-Based Challenges – Overcome realistic movement, weight, and traction on tricky surfaces.
 • Environmental Hazards – Face mud, slopes, tight paths, and unexpected road conditions.
 • Strategic Problem Solving – Use planning and smart decisions to overcome roadblocks.
 • Exploration-Focused Progression – Discover new paths and routes as you advance.

Keep the engine running, adapt to the road ahead, and push through every challenge. The journey is tough — reaching the destination is the real victory.

70010000120417.name: Mathify
70010000120417.description:
Mathify turns math into a fun and satisfying puzzle challenge! Connect numbers and operations in the right order to build the target value and solve each level.

Easy to learn and rewarding to master, the game mixes logic, quick thinking, and creative problem-solving. With clean visuals, smooth gameplay, and gradually more challenging puzzles, Mathify is perfect for both short sessions and brain-training fun.

70010000120435.name: Garfield - Escape From Monday
70010000120435.intro: Garfield may be right not to trust vegetables…
70010000120435.description:
Wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie filled 3D Platformer! The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield - Escape from Monday!

When you’re a lazy cat spending most of his time sleeping, having a nightmare can happen. But a nightmare full of vegetables and sugar-free candies, no way!

After Jon fed him spinach lasagnas inspired by Chef Monday’s recipe, Garfield falls into a deep sleep...

To wake up and reactivate his taste buds, the laziest cat in the world will have to explore worlds filled with enemies and eat a gigantic deal of lasagnas!

Fortunately Garfield can rely on Jon and his friends Odie, Arlene and Pookie. But also on his turkey, surfer and cowboy suits that will give him amazing skills!

- Move like a cat
Jump, climb the walls, curl up into a ball… you will always land on your feet!

- Embody Garfield in every form
Go airborne dressed as a turkey, slide on the water like a surfer and swing with your cowboy lasso!

- All the Garfield cast is here
Jon will be here to help you in your quest, along with Odie and Pookie. But beware Garfield's archenemies, Nermal and Squeak!

- Explore lively worlds
3 worlds and dozens of levels filled with enemies to fight and lasagnas to devour to regain the taste.

- The more you eat, the more rooms you edit!
Gather tons of delicious collectibles to keep your morale and help refurbish Jon's house with all kinds of surprising items.

70010000120447.name: Horror Park
70010000120447.description:
You’re a blogger investigating a string of disappearances inside a closed public park. What was once an ordinary green space is now silent, empty… and wrong.

Explore dark pathways, abandoned buildings, and shadowed woods as strange sounds echo around you. Footsteps follow. Whispers drift between the trees. The deeper you search for answers, the more your mind begins to turn against you.

Horror Park is a psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere, exploration, and slow-building dread.

70010000120475.name: Chippy&Noppo – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000120475.intro: Let's assemble a toy with two guys with different personalities!
70010000120475.description:
•Carry the parts and assemble a toy according to the plan!
"Chippy and Noppo" is an action puzzle that assembles parts into a toy!
Collect the parts in the factory, process the colors and shapes, and make the same toy as the blueprint.
"Even if it's a little different, you might be able to clear it...!?
Because the factory manager is a bit careless."

•Let's join the power of two guys with different personalities!
Cheerful "Chippy" is good in low places.
Tall and easy-going "Noppo" is good at jumping.
The key to clarifying the game is the cooperation of both, using their individuality to split roles, and more!

In solo play, operate two guys at the same time!
Operate well and aim for the fastest clear!
In multiplayer, operate "Chippy" and "Noppo" respectively.
This is a place where you can chat, so let's play while talking to friends and family!

•A lot of fun in the factory!
The factory is full of machines!
Let's make full use of the machine by processing the color and shape of the parts, using them for moving, and more!

・Just like athletic!?
There are also factories that need action, like climbing high scaffolds, getting around at the right time, and not just assembling!

・Work at various factories!
Progress in the game, factories in the woods and seas will appear!
Let's assemble a toy that matches the image of the factory!

What kind of toys are those two really good friends going to make,
and what kind of future are they going to make?

70010000120482.name: VECTORED
70010000120482.intro: Pilot your drone through a dark, corrupted forest in VECTORED. Endless AI swarms adapt as your score rises. Easy to learn, brutal to master. Can you survive the swarm?
70010000120482.description:
Blast into VECTORED, a high-energy arcade shooter inspired by classic shoot ’em ups and rebuilt for modern play.

Take control of a fast, agile drone and dive into a dark, corrupted woodland where shadowy forms and glowing red signals collide. Within a single woodland-style arena, enemy AI units emerge endlessly, pressing in from all directions as the forest reacts to your presence.

There are no stages to clear and no breaks in the action. As your score climbs, the world pushes back harder, with faster enemies, tighter patterns, and increasing pressure that demands constant movement and sharp reflexes.

Like the arcade legends before it, VECTORED is easy to learn and instantly satisfying. But surviving the escalating chaos requires mastery, awareness, and total control of the airspace.

Built for quick pick-up-and-play sessions and endless score-chasing, VECTORED delivers that classic “one more run” feeling, set against a striking dark woodland world lit by red energy and motion.

Old-school roots. Modern reflexes.

70010000120490.name: Speed Boom: Last Delivery
70010000120490.intro:
Built for Speed.
Designed for Records.
Speedrun Friendly.
70010000120490.description:
Speed Boom: Last Delivery is a high-speed arcade experience built around one thing — momentum.

Dash across a vibrant neon city, wall-run between skyscrapers, chain jumps across rooftops, and deliver packages as fast as humanly possible. Every second counts. Every shortcut matters. Every mistake costs you time.

Take on 40 time-based deliveries and push for the ultimate S+ rank. The faster you move, the better the reward. Master the routes, optimize your path, and chase your personal best.

Earn coins through perfect runs and exploration. Upgrade your runner’s speed, acceleration, and movement to break your limits. Unlock a variety of skins and express your style while dominating the streets.

The city is fully explorable and packed with hidden graffiti waiting to be discovered. Find them, repaint them with your own mark, and turn the streets into your playground.

Designed for replayability and built with flow in mind, Speed Boom: Last Delivery is speedrun-friendly and rewards skill, precision, and mastery.

No brakes. No limits. Just speed.

70010000120496.name: Limbot
70010000120496.intro: Limbot is a super silly, 3D platformer where you individually control the limbs of a giant cardboard robot! Master all four limbs in solo or embrace the chaos and camaraderie in co-op.
70010000120496.description:
Welcome to Limbot, the ultimate physics-based city stomping experience where up to 4 players must attempt to pilot a person dressed as a giant cardboard robot! Embrace the chaos in a paper-craft metropolis designed to be crushed, smashed, and destroyed!

Stomp, kick, and punch your way to completing wacky objectives set in a fully destructible cardboard world, where every building, obstacle, and enemy can be bashed to pieces or flattened into pulp! Smash down skyscrapers, face-off against paper foes, and take down the biggest (and silliest) crafted bosses this world has ever seen…

Go full DIY and unlock upgrades to customise your robot such as strapping a soda can to your leg for a handy speed boost, wooden spoons to give your Karate chops some added range, or slap on some stickers to add some extra style. Mix and match upgrades to make your perfect robot!

Intuitive controls make moving limbs simple and accessible to players of all ages and abilities. All you need to do is figure out how to work together... good luck with that! Oh, one more thing, if the robot trips, it's definitely your teammate’s fault!

70010000120502.name: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
70010000120502.intro: The crown is stolen. England burns. Conquer territories, siege castles, and unite a fractured kingdom before the Normans close in.
70010000120502.description:
In the 1980s, Defender of the Crown helped define a new kind of cinematic strategy game. Now it returns, rebuilt for modern platforms and remastered with an entirely new way to play.  
 

Conquer territories, raise armies, storm castles, and shift the balance of power. It's the Defender of the Crown you remember - just sharper, cleaner, and built for today.   

Three Ways to Play   

Retro Mode. The original Amiga classic, preserved with near-perfect authenticity and quality-of-life enhancements.  

Classic Mode. Amiga classic reimagined for today. A completely new visual identity, refined mechanics, and smoother systems.  

Kingdom Mode. An entirely new challenge. Procedurally generated maps, special dice mechanics, unlockable abilities, and multiple difficulty levels to keep every run unpredictable.   

Faithful to Its Roots, Built for Today  

Everything that made the original special is intact: the ruleset, the pacing, the atmosphere. What's changed is everything around it - cleaner systems, improved balance, a modernized interface, and quality-of-life updates throughout.

70010000120508.name: Ecchi Crush
70010000120508.intro: One hot match leads to another.
70010000120508.description:
Ready to line things up and see where it leads? Match colorful pieces, chain together juicy combos, and clear the board to reveal a gorgeous surprise waiting underneath.

Every move clears a little more of the picture. Keep crushing tiles, breaking through tougher boards, and revealing beautiful girls piece by piece. The deeper you go, the hotter it gets... so stay sharp and keep the matches coming.

Features:
- A collection of beautiful women to reveal
- Unique music for every girl
- Simple and engaging match-3 gameplay
- Satisfying combos and challenging stages
- A treat for your eyes

Your crush is waiting for you.

70010000120522.name: Risky Roads
70010000120522.description: Running across the road is a very challenging task for a little chicken. Lots of very fast cars and unexpected obstacles. You need a good reaction to help this cute little guy. Don't forget that he has friends and they also want to cross the road.

70010000120528.name: Dr. Psycho: Hospital Escape
70010000120528.description:
Your peaceful journey has turned into a nightmare. You wake up in a cold, locked cell inside an old, abandoned psychiatric clinic. But you are not alone. The facility is the playground of Dr. Psycho, a madman obsessed with horrific experiments, and you are his next guinea pig.

Dr. Psycho: Hospital Escape is a tense survival horror game where stealth is your only weapon. To survive, you must explore the dark corridors of the asylum, searching for keys, tools, and items needed to unlock the path to freedom. But be warned: the Doctor and his psychotic patients are roaming the halls.

You have exactly three days to plan your escape. If you don't find an exit before time runs out, you'll become a permanent resident of this house of horrors.

They can hear you. They are hunting you. And time is running out.

70010000120540.name: Cozy Grove – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000120540.intro: Come for the view, stay for the friends.
70010000120540.description:
Welcome to Cozy Grove, a life-sim game about camping on a haunted, ever-changing island. As a Spirit Scout, you'll wander the island's forest each day, finding new hidden secrets and helping soothe the local ghosts. With a little time and a lot of crafting, you'll bring color and joy back to Cozy Grove!

Cozy Grove is synced to real world time, and provides 30-60 minutes of new quest content each day. After that, you can fish, craft and decorate to your heart's content!

Features:
• Beautiful, dynamic, hand-drawn landscapes that come alive when you help a spirit in need.
• Dozens of memorable characters and spirits for you to find and befriend. Each spirit has a unique, extensive story for you to unravel over time.
• Collect spirit animals, craft decorations, go fishing and more!
• 40+ hour campaign filled with side quests, designed to span months of playtime.

70010000120560.name: Cat-up!
70010000120560.intro: Take control of a fearless cat on a vertical journey, always upward.
70010000120560.description:
Jump across unlikely platforms, balance on crazy objects, and prove that feline curiosity truly has no limits.

Collect coins along the way and unlock new cats to customize your adventure. Beware of ghosts that may attack you along the path.

The real challenge? Stay calm, calculate every jump, and prove that no obstacle is too great for a cat!

70010000120572.name: Damsels in Distress
70010000120572.intro: An interactive adventure about a paladin torn between duty and desire.
70010000120572.description:
This is a classic tale of rescuing maidens from dangerous villains such as goblins, trolls, werewolves, harpies, and other dark creatures. You will encounter them across a variety of locations throughout the game world.

Your choices directly influence the story and the progression of the main character. Certain paladin abilities depend on your moral path and personal discipline. Multiple endings await, shaped by the decisions you make along the way.

Game features:

- Meaningful moral choices that affect both survival and story progression

- High-stakes decisions where every choice matters

- A familiar fantasy storyline with a humorous twist

- Play as an unconventional paladin hero

- Player decisions influence character development and the final outcome

- Rescue maidens and become their hero

- Japanese voice-over

- Dynamic battles and engaging QTE-based activities

- Optional caravan raids

- Beautifully animated scenes

70010000120584.name: Blast Linkers
70010000120584.intro:
Blast Linkers is a strategic 2-player local cooperative shooter.
Keep your ships close to charge SP, and connect with each other to unleash overwhelming blasts.
70010000120584.description:
Key Features

1. Link System – The Closer, the Stronger
SP charging speed increases as you keep two ships close
Unique gameplay where distance control is the strategy

2. Powerful Blast Attack
A super-powerful attack triggered when ships are linked
A single blow that turns the battlefield with timing and cooperation

3. 2-Player Local Co-op
A shooting game that requires true cooperation
Play where position, timing, and coordination are all crucial

4. SP Management-Based Strategy
The closer you get, the stronger you become, but the higher the risk
Play that balances risk and reward

5. Roguelike Upgrade System
Select upgrades after clearing a boss
Combat style that changes with every playthrough

6. Story Mode with Twist upon Twist
Short but intensely immersive
Unexpected plot twists and a clean ending

70010000120596.name: Hyakki Fantasia Mini Game Selection VOL.1
70010000120596.intro: A compact yet richly packed anthology of bite-sized games you can enjoy anytime.
70010000120596.description:
Five Trials, Five Thrills

Kaguya’s Picture-Matching Puzzle
Fragments of yokai illustrations have been shattered. Rearrange the pieces correctly and restore them to their true forms.

Okiku’s Sorting Game
Bombs keep appearing one after another—sort them quickly before they explode! A moment of hesitation can be fatal.

Kaede’s Riding Training
Control a gently floating character and slip through narrow gaps between obstacles. Push your limits and see how far you can go.

Alice’s Orb Fusion Experiment
Stack identical characters together to evolve them, aiming for the highest score before the box overflows.

Setsuna’s Wish-Binding
Connect adorable yokai filling the screen in a single continuous stroke and wipe them out all at once. At the end of a massive chain awaits pure, exhilarating catharsis.

Collect the Truth of the World

Earn “Magic Stones” as rewards for clearing challenges, each one a fragment of the world itself. Spend the stones to unlock pieces of stories spanning time and space: Sengoku battlefields, distant galaxies, and mysterious yokai realms…

A Depth of Replayability

Quick and easy to jump into yet irresistibly addictive for those determined to collect every last Magic Stone. Conquer every mini-game and uncover all the intertwined destinies recorded in this “Chronicle of Illusions.”

Jump into the world of Hyakki today!

70010000120602.name: Kickback Clicker
70010000120602.intro: Mutants are flooding the planets! Destroy them all! Improve your technology, upgrade weapons and turn dangerous worlds into safe havens.
70010000120602.description:
The captivating clicker game in which you join space expansion!
Take on the role of an autonomous orbital station in this space adventure! Your goal is to prepare planets for the landing of a team of explorers. There’s just one problem: the planets are inhabited by many hostile creatures who are not very happy about the arrival of uninvited guests...
Destroy the mutants, get coins and buy improvements that will make you even more effective in combat: increase the damage dealt by each shot, slow down enemies when hit or reduce the reloading time.

Game features:
- Many progression options: upgrade weapons and abilities to fight more effectively.
- Intuitive gameplay: this simple and entertaining clicker doesn’t require you to have masterful skills, but still keeps you on your toes.
- Destroying mutants: every click is a step towards victory over alien creatures inhabiting dangerous planets.

Every click brings you closer to getting a planet ready for a successful landing. Use the full potential of the orbital station to clear the planets of any threat! The squad of heroes will not get here soon, but the future of their mission depends on your work.

70010000120620.name: Rage District - Humanity Armageddon
70010000120620.intro: A broken city where every decision shapes your survival
70010000120620.description:
The city has collapsed. Survival is your only objective.
In Rage District - Humanity Armageddon, you step into a broken urban world where chaos has taken control and every street hides danger. Explore abandoned districts, uncover hidden truths, and fight to stay alive in a city consumed by fear and violence.

Move through different sectors filled with ruined buildings, industrial zones, and hidden facilities. Search for resources, gather intel, and uncover what led to the collapse of the city. Every location tells a piece of the story, pushing you deeper into the unknown.

Engage in intense top-down combat using a variety of weapons while managing limited resources. Choose when to fight and when to avoid danger, as every encounter can change your chances of survival. Careful planning and awareness are key in every situation.

Destroy key locations, weaken enemy control, and trigger high-risk encounters against powerful enemies guarding critical areas. Progress is driven by exploration, decisions, and how far you’re willing to go to uncover the truth .

Key Features:
- Top-down survival action gameplay
- Open-ended exploration across multiple districts
- Resource management and tactical decision-making
- Variety of weapons and combat styles
- Intel collection and story discovery
- High-risk encounters and boss fights

Stay alert, explore every corner, and survive the chaos.
In Rage District - Humanity Armageddon, every decision shapes your path.

70010000120626.name: Drone Simulator SMASH ZOMBIES
70010000120626.intro: The world ended. You just didn’t get the memo.
70010000120626.description:
Humanity’s last hope isn’t a hero—it’s you, piloting a weaponized drone from the sky above a dying world. The dead are everywhere, and they don’t stay dead for long.

Guide your drone through shattered cities and scorched wastelands, unleashing firepower with precision—or pure chaos. Machine guns, rockets, cluster bombs—pick your poison, rain it down, and pray it’s enough. Every explosion buys you a few more seconds of survival.

Build defenses, scavenge upgrades, and adapt to the growing madness below. The undead learn fast, the weather turns against you, and your own systems can fail at the worst possible moment. Each mission is a gamble between control and destruction.

You’re not saving the world—you’re holding it together with duct tape, steel, and explosives.

Keep calm, keep flying, and if all else fails... make it rain.

70010000120645.name: Disgaea Mayhem
70010000120645.description:
The princess needs her pudding! But nothing's simple in the Netherworld. She'll need a hardy mercenary to mow down monsters and secure her dessert if she's to enjoy her culinary delights.

That's where you come in. As N.A., you'll need to level up, recruit demons, and pass bills at the Dark Chocolate Assembly to make sure you have what it takes to fight your own battles. That's right—for the first time ever, Disgaea has Magichanged into an action RPG!

70010000120647.name: Extreme Garage: Offroad
70010000120647.description: Extreme Garage: Offroad is a high-speed racing game. Get ready for the ultimate offroad racing challenge! Push your skills to the limit, earn cash and build a garage of high-performance cars.

70010000120651.name: D.U.M.B. Ducks
70010000120651.intro: D.U.M.B. Ducks is an action-filled, retro platform game.
70010000120651.description:
Stationed in deep underground military bases, the ducks were hungry. Rather than accept their given rations, they dug deeper into the earth in search of delicious snails. Instead they found the monsters of the abyss!

D.U.M.B. Ducks is an action-filled, retro platform game. Slaughter giant snails. Battle gigantic beasts. Buy better guns. Blow up walls. Collect fat stacks of cash.

70010000120682.name: Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of the Rings™ Game Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000120682.description:
From the creative studio, Wētā Workshop, live the cosy life of a Hobbit in the wonderfully serene landscape of the Shire. Discover, decorate, and share in this idyllic corner of Middle-earth. Join friendly Hobbits and familiar faces awaiting your arrival in Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of the Rings™ Game. 

Create your own Hobbit as you set forth in Bywater. Though not yet established as an official village in Hobbiton, play a part in helping the quaint town flourish. Greet comfort at the door as you decorate your own Hobbit hole, tend to your garden, fish at the clear ponds, forage wild fruits and herbs, or trade with townsfolks. Prepare homemade meals to share with fellow Hobbits and foster relationships.

With much to see and lots more to eat, enjoy days of splendor in the picturesque forests, lakes, and pastures. 

Unwind in the place where what matters most are all the little things. Help bring the community together to achieve village status in Bywater. Experience delight in Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of the Rings™ Game.  


Key Features:

Welcome Home, Hobbit – Play as a Hobbit, directly out of J.R.R Tolkien's beloved books! Personalise your appearance and brandish your best Hobbit attire with an array of customisations. Decorate your own Hobbit home and transform the cosy space with grid-free placement to position furniture home décor to your liking. Discover the wonders each new day brings to Bywater as you settle into your serene homestead for much needed rest.

Food Is Love –  No Hobbit’s day is complete without food. Fish, garden, and forage to stock up the pantry with the fruits of your labour. Harvest for seasonal crops and flowers as time passes in your homestead. Enjoy the warmth of the kitchen and show off your culinary chops with recipes for mealtimes. Partake in second breakfast or host a dinner party with fellow Hobbits. Share meals with invited guests to create new relationships. 

Explore Bywater – Explore the outdoors to discover secret glades and lost treasures of the Shire. Experience the ever-changing weather that affect daily routines and seasonal surprises based on time of year. Gain rewards through your story progression. Meet iconic characters and familiar Hobbit families to trade for upgrades to skills, clothes, home, and more. Join club missions to complete daily activities and help gain official village status in Bywater.

70010000120715.name: Steamboat Incident
70010000120715.intro: Trapped at sea on a steamboat - fix it, hide, and escape
70010000120715.description:
Steamboat Incident is a 3D survival horror experience set aboard a steamboat lost in the middle of the open sea. You have been kidnapped by the crazy monster. It is said that the monster went crazy after being locked up and away for over 95 years.

Captured and trapped with no clear way out, you wake up and must explore the ship’s tight corridors and rusting decks in search of clues, tools, and a way to escape.

But you are not alone. The monster is still there, reacting to sound and movement. Every step, every creak of the floorboards could give you away.

Hide, stay quiet, and think carefully as you solve puzzles and fix the steamboat in order to escape.

Features:
* A terrifying journey across the open ocean, stranded on a decaying steamboat while something hunts you from the depths. 
* Explore tight passageways and claustrophobic corridors as you uncover the steamboat dark secrets. 
* Search the steamboat for parts needed to fix the wheel and escape.
* Scavenge for clues, supplies, and hiding spots to stay one step ahead of the creature trying to hunt you down. 
* Find items like canned food to recover, and broken wheel parts to bring the steamboat back to life. 
* Evade a horrifying barnacle-covered entity stalking the ship - run, hide, and survive. Take cover under tables or inside rooms to avoid detection. 
* Use tools like crowbars to break into locked areas and reveal hidden paths and deeper mysteries.

70010000120727.name: Fairy Tale Fighters
70010000120727.intro: A dream fighting game where characters from fairy tales and novels battle each other!
70010000120727.description:
Fairy Tale Fighters is a 2D fighting game.

Momotaro, Kintaro, Sun Wukong, Peter Pan, Pinocchio, Aladdin,
Puss in Boots, Red Hood, Alice, Rapunzel, Snow White,
Cinderella, the Witch, the Wolf, and many more fairy tale characters all gather in one place!

When your gauge fills up, you can unleash a powerful super special move!
Enjoy exciting battles in a magical fantasy world!

70010000120733.name: ROUTE16TURBO
70010000120733.intro: Control MAD X and take back the stolen money!
70010000120733.description:
ROUTE16TURBO is an action game released in 1985.

Take control of your car, MAD X, and evade relentless enemy cars as you infiltrate the secret base of the evil Kanharoo Gang to recover all the stolen money.

Switch dynamically between Maze Mode, where you navigate complex labyrinths, and Radar Mode, which displays the entire stage made up of 16 mazes-delivering a constantly thrilling car chase experience.

This version also includes stages that were unreachable in the original 1985 release.
Now’s your chance to beat the high scores you set back then!

70010000120739.name: Kuky Adventure
70010000120739.intro: Lost in the Candy World you must find the way back home!
70010000120739.description:
Help Kuky, a curious character who gets lost in the Candy World and must travel through colorful environments to find the way back home. Along the journey, collect candies and face strange sugar-made enemies such as marshmallows, cookies, and other living, dangerous sweets.

Use precise jumps and a double jump to overcome obstacles, avoid traps, and progress through challenging stages full of action and rhythm.

With fast-paced gameplay, responsive controls, and a charming visual style, Kuky Adventure delivers a fun and addictive platforming experience from start to finish.

Features:
- Precision platforming with dynamic action
- Double jump to explore and overcome challenges
- A variety of candy-themed enemies
- Levels filled with obstacles and traps
- Colorful and charming visuals
- Cheerful and engaging soundtrack

70010000120769.name: Bikini Match Girls
70010000120769.intro: Your summer starts with the perfect bikini.
70010000120769.description:
Meet charming girls, each dreaming of completing their own collection of the most stylish and vibrant swimsuits! Your task is to help them find the missing pieces by matching threes of identical swimsuits in cozy puzzles. Instead of the usual fruit or candy, you'll find elegant summer swimsuits in a wide variety of colors, cuts, textures, and styles: from glamorous bikinis to elegant one-pieces.
Match threes, solve increasingly complex puzzles, and gradually unlock full, realistic images of the girls in these swimsuits. With each completed round, you gain access to new fragments, and then to complete portraits that you can not only store but also creatively decorate.
In the interactive gallery, you can move, zoom, and choose the perfect angle, combining open images with different backgrounds—from sunny beaches to tropical sunsets—to create your own unique composition. All this is accompanied by gentle, relaxing music, turning the game into a meditative ritual of beauty, summer mood, and attention to detail.

Features:
• Realistic images of girls in stylish swimsuits.
• Collect swimsuits in dozens of colors, styles, and designs—from minimalist to glamorous.
• Numerous backgrounds to personalize your favorite looks.
• Interactive gallery with zoom and layout options.
• Helpful bonuses and boosters for solving puzzles.
• Relaxing music creates an atmosphere of summer comfort and aesthetic pleasure.
• Gradually increasing puzzle difficulty—from simple combinations to real logical challenges.

70010000120789.name: Sprunki Hell Towers
70010000120789.intro: Vibrant platformer: conquer horror towers and save Sprunki from Black
70010000120789.description:
Sprunki Hell Towers is a dynamic platformer with horror elements, where every jump matters.
You play as one of the Sprunki and climb sinister towers to save friends captured by the villain Black. Each tower is a separate trial with its own atmosphere, mechanics, and mood: from bright and almost cheerful levels to anxious, oppressive sections with horror elements.

The game is built on fair but demanding gameplay. Mistakes are punished, but always fairly — no randomness or injustice. Difficulty grows gradually, forcing you to learn, adapt, and feel real progress.

You'll experience:
• unique towers of varying height and difficulty
• diverse game mechanics that change from level to level
• stylish music and recognizable Sprunki characters
• vibrant environments that gradually become darker
• tense but captivating atmosphere

Sprunki Hell Towers is a game about overcoming, rhythm, and concentration. Climb higher, don't look back, and don't let Black keep your friends trapped.

70010000120795.name: Stunt Race
70010000120795.intro: Fly through loops, smash cars & pull insane stunts above a stunning city skyline.
70010000120795.description:
Take the wheel and launch into the sky in STUNT RACE — an adrenaline-fueled driving experience where gravity is just a suggestion.

DEFY THE LAWS OF PHYSICS
Race through impossible tracks suspended high above a sprawling city. Loop through aerial rings, dodge obstacles in the clouds, and prove your skills on death-defying courses designed to push your reflexes to the limit.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• STUNT RACE — Navigate twisted loops, floating platforms, and mid-air hazards in heart-pounding timed runs
• STRAIGHT ROAD — Hit top speed on an endless highway and launch off a massive ramp into the unknown
• PLAYGROUND — Your personal stunt arena with ramps, jumps, and room to experiment with insane tricks

POINTS FOR STYLE
Every second in the air counts. Flip, spin, and rotate your car to rack up points. The bigger the rotation, the bigger the reward. Land it clean or crash spectacularly — either way, it's a show.

FEEL THE IMPACT
Real damage physics mean every collision leaves its mark. Watch your car crumble, dent, and shatter as you push it beyond limits. Four unique vehicles, each ready to be destroyed in spectacular fashion.

CINEMATIC PRESENTATION
Stunning visuals with realistic lighting bring the city skyline to life beneath your wheels. An energetic soundtrack keeps your pulse racing from start to finish.

Strap in. Floor it. Fly.

70010000120809.name: Monster Crown: Sin Eater
70010000120809.intro: Hand-craft your team of perfect Monsters and wage a one-man war against fate and the world in the Crown Nation! With a True Crossbreeding system, every Monster is entirely your own!
70010000120809.description:
Explore the beautiful, textured and detailed environments of The Crown Nation, With over a thousand unique, hand-crafted Monster sprites, and hundreds of colors to choose from, you'll find the ace Monster that's right for you! And once you've found your favorites, use Monster Crossbreeding or perform Monster Fusion to reach new heights!

The game's storyline puts you in the shoes of Asur, a young farm boy who has aspired to be a Monster Tamer his whole life, just like his big brother. When his family is put in mortal danger, he must act to set things right, and change the Crown Nation forever.

70010000120824.name: Tap Monster Duel
70010000120824.intro:
Thrilling timing battles with just one finger!
An adventure to find the ultimate legendary card!
70010000120824.description:
An adventure to find the ultimate legendary card hidden in the Wind Forest!

The mysterious 'Wind Forest' where external cards do not work at all.
Start with basic monster cards alongside your guide, 'Kumira', and build your ultimate deck!
Collect and enhance monsters across four elemental attributes (Water, Fire, Wood, Iron) with unique character abilities, and overcome the trials of villains and guardian deities threatening the Wind Forest.

Key Features
Intuitive one-button timing battles played with just a single finger!
Tap the matching elemental icon according to the rotating circular gauge!
Claim the initiative with precise timing and deliver fatal strikes utilizing elemental matchups.

4 Elements and Deep Elemental Matchup Strategy
Clear matchup relationships among the four elements: Water, Fire, Wood, and Iron!
Strategic fun in analyzing enemy attributes to build decks with advantageous element monsters.

Fun of Collection and Growth (From Rank C to Rank S!)
Monster card crafting, card rank upgrades, level enhancement, and transcendence!
Equip Hole Stones (Enhancement Stones) to grant unique skills (Rage, Crazy, Reflect, Absorb, Heal, etc.) and train them to be stronger.
Uncapped cumulative stat boosts upon acquiring duplicates!

Unique Character Stat Development
Each character possesses diverse trait stats such as Critical Chance, Evasion Rate, and EXP Boost!
Enhance character stats in your preferred direction to match your playstyle.

Rich Content and Complete Index
20 basic monsters per element and golden 'Legendary Hidden Monsters' with special abilities!
Mining system, various achievement rewards, plus Guardian Battles and showdowns against character doppelgangers that test your limits!

70010000120830.name: Lovely Deco House
70010000120830.intro: Create your own healing space through collecting and crafting, a deco adventure with cute friends!
70010000120830.description:
Design the space of your dreams in a world filled with cozy emotions. In <Lovely Deco House>, gather materials from nature, such as plants and rocks, to create unique furniture and props, offering creative joy. Just like dyeing old cloth with cherry blossoms to make pretty pink fabric, your ideas will soon become wonderful interiors.

Decorate the homes of your cute doll friends with carefully crafted furniture. From charming rabbit cafes to emotionally rich chick camping sites, new stories bloom wherever your touch reaches. But simple decoration isn't everything. Explore regions with their own mysterious characteristics and bravely overcome the obstacles you encounter. The rare materials you discover after hard work will make your space even more special. Start your heartwarming deco journey right now!

70010000120836.name: CRAYON FARM ANIMALS
70010000120836.intro: My child's first digital sketchbook, color in the colorful farm animals! Complete cute cow, horse, and sheep friends with my fingertips, and fill your own animal picture book.
70010000120836.description:
Embark on an exciting coloring journey with adorable bee friends! <Crayon Farm Animals> is an easy and fun creativity education game featuring farm animals that our children love most.

It provides an intuitive interface that anyone can easily enjoy without complicated controls, and it implements a smooth and warm texture as if coloring with real crayons. Over 15 different farm animal friends are waiting for your colors.

Check out what your completed animal friends look like, and complete your own animal collection painted in various colors! It will be the most perfect and safe sketchbook that allows children to freely unleash their imagination and provide emotional stability. Give the gift of creative time that the whole family can enjoy together.

70010000120842.name: CRAYON SEA FRIENDS
70010000120842.intro: A small ocean in my hands, dyed in vibrant colors! I invite you to a healing drawing world where you can enjoy creating your own sea friends with your imagination.
70010000120842.description:
The 'Crayon' series, beloved by children and creative adults worldwide, now dives into a mysterious underwater world! 'Crayon Sea Friends' is a creativity game where you fill adorable whales, playful turtles, sparkling fish, and other diverse marine creatures with your own colors.

It offers an intuitive interface that anyone can easily enjoy without complicated controls, and it recreates the texture of coloring with real crayons through precise touch controls. Watch your completed sea friends come to life with vivid animation. It will be the most perfect digital sketchbook, offering both educational fun and emotional stability.

70010000120848.name: CRAYON MAGIC WORLD
70010000120848.intro: Mystical friends met in dreams awaken in vibrant colors at my fingertips!
70010000120848.description:
The 'Crayon' series, responsible for children's creativity worldwide, finally arrives in the most mysterious world, <Crayon Magic World>! In this series, you can meet friends from the Magic World that only existed in imagination, including legendary unicorns, beautiful mermaids, brave dragons, and mysterious nine-tailed foxes.

Unleash your children's imagination with an intuitive interface that anyone can easily enjoy without complicated rules, and a variety of colors that perfectly capture the texture of real crayons. The sight of the fantastic characters you carefully colored coming to life will give children a special sense of accomplishment and a magical experience. Open the door to the Magic World now, the most beautiful digital sketchbook that offers both educational fun and emotional stability!

70010000120854.name: CRAYON JUNGLE
70010000120854.intro: Color adorable animal friends in a lush jungle with your own colors!
70010000120854.description:
The 'Crayon' series, responsible for children's creativity worldwide, is back with a mysterious jungle theme, 'Crayon Jungle,' going beyond cars, dinosaurs, and animals! In this series, you can meet wild animals hidden throughout the jungle, including brave tigers, playful gorillas, long-necked giraffes, and cute sloths hanging from trees. 

Unleash your children's imagination with an intuitive interface that anyone can easily enjoy without complicated controls, and a variety of colors that perfectly capture the smooth texture of real crayons. Feel the animals you carefully colored come to life, experiencing a sense of accomplishment and emotional stability at the same time. Start your exciting wildlife adventure right now with 'Crayon Jungle,' a safe and creative digital sketchbook that you can unfold anytime, anywhere!

70010000120860.name: CRAYON FRIENDS
70010000120860.intro: Color your own cute animal friends with colorful crayons!
70010000120860.description:
A colorful fairytale world that comes to life at your fingertips!
Complete your own special sketchbook with cute friends!

<Crayon Friends> is a healing coloring simulation game where anyone can freely fill in cute characters with their own colors, without complicated rules or stress.

Rabbits, bears, birds, cool dinosaurs and even cute astronauts! A variety of illustrations and rich crayon colors are available.  Easily open your own atelier anytime, anywhere with intuitive touch operation optimized for.

■ Special fun elements unique to <Crayon Friends>

Colorful character lineup: From forest animals to imaginary monsters and dinosaurs, there are many cute characters that will catch the eyes of users.

Challenge and Medal System: You can feel a unique sense of accomplishment by earning a wonderful medal for each uniquely completed painting.

Camera function to leave memories: Take a picture of the work you worked hard to complete with a camera and store it nicely in your sketchbook album.

Equipped with fun minigames: “Who will be the character I completed?” After you finish coloring, an intuitive and exciting quiz game unfolds where you have to find the character you designed yourself!

Perfect healing play environment: Helps develop children's creativity and relieve adults' stress in warm sounds, without time limits or competition elements.

70010000120866.name: CRAYON MANDALA
70010000120866.intro: Enjoy healing time with your family through soothing mandala coloring!
70010000120866.description:
Escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life and find peace of mind by coloring beautiful mandala patterns!
<Crayon Mandala> goes beyond the existing Crayon series for children and is a healing coloring simulation game that the whole family, including parents and adults, can enjoy together.

A variety of elaborate mandala patterns await your touch. Relieve stress and experience inner peace by completing the mandala with your own color combination.

■ The special charm of <Crayon Mandala>
Healing for the whole family: The perfect art therapy game for kids to get creative and adults to relax.
Elaborate and beautiful patterns: From simple drawings to artistic mandalas, there are a variety of patterns available.
Intuitive operation: Without complicated tools, anyone can easily fill in beautiful colors by touching the screen.
Artwork Gallery: You can save your completed mandala in the gallery and view it again at any time.

Experience the time of filling a mandala with your own colors with quiet music.

70010000120877.name: Springbot: The Last Spark
70010000120877.intro: Embark on a journey to save your fellow robots in colorful side-scrolling style!
70010000120877.description:
Springbot: The Last Spark is a side-scrolling action platforming adventure. Traverse a vibrant world by running, jumping and bouncing on springy robotic legs as you try to find gems hidden in mazelike stages. Push crates to reach higher platforms, avoid spike traps, hop on the heads of roving enemies to deactivate them and touch checkpoints to safeguard your progress.

This journey will take you through forests, underground caverns, lofty cliffs and more as you collect coins and explore in colorfully cute HD style across 35 unique levels. Replay cleared stages for better times or to collect more coins, team up for co-op play or put your skills to the test in Glitch Mode!

• Take the role of Springbot as the last remaining hope to restore memory to his fellow robots!
• Enjoy retro side-scrolling adventure through colorful platforming stages.
• Run, jump and bounce on spring-like legs as you traverse mazelike environments!
• Avoid traps and hop on the heads of enemies as you master 35 unique levels.
• Collect gems to power the Great Heart and bring order to a chaotic world!

70010000120884.name: Arcade Archives TAG TEAM WRESTLING
70010000120884.intro: The Big Excite Series finally begins!!
70010000120884.description:
"TAG TEAM WRESTLING" is an action game released by Technos Japan in 1983.
Enjoy the world of professional wrestling as you control the hero wrestler and aim to become world champion.
Quick move selection and the skillful tag team work unique to tag matches are the keys to victory!
Sometimes brawls spill out of the ring, and unexpected intruders might even show up!?

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000120902.name: Cyanotype Daydream
70010000120902.intro: The Girl Who Dreamed the World
70010000120902.description:
This is a pure love story between a young man and a girl who gave everything to the world.
Three separate stories begin at random, ultimately converging into a single narrative.
We embraced the strengths of the visual novel format to create a maddeningly intense tale of pure love that lingers long after the final line.

70010000120918.name: The Fallen Kingdom
70010000120918.intro: Step into the fallen kingdom and fight for victory.
70010000120918.description:
Enter the world of The Fallen Kingdom, a fast-paced action RPG adventure. Fight your way through intense bullet hell-inspired battles where quick reflexes, strategic movement, and powerful abilities are the key to survival. Explore dangerous environments filled with enemies, hidden surprises, and challenging boss fights that will test your combat skills at every step.

Unlock and upgrade abilities through a deep and rewarding skill tree, allowing you to customize your playstyle and become stronger with every battle. Experience a simple yet engaging story that keeps the adventure moving forward while introducing new challenges and unexpected moments along the way.

Key Features
	•	Battle powerful bosses with challenging and dynamic attack patterns
	•	Unlock new abilities and strengthen your character through a detailed skill tree
	•	Explore atmospheric levels filled with enemies, secrets, and surprises
	•	Discover a simple but engaging story that drives the adventure forward
	•	Face increasingly difficult encounters that reward skill and strategy
	•	Fight through intense levels packed with action, danger, and progression


Every battle brings new challenges, every victory makes you stronger, and every moment pushes you closer to becoming a true legend of The Fallen Kingdom.

70010000120929.name: Dirty Little Puzzle
70010000120929.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000120929.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000120961.name: Demon Castle Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000120961.intro: Demon Castle Building Dungeon Management Simulation
70010000120961.description:
A management simulation in which you take an old, run-down castle and turn it into a dastardly demon stronghold! Recruit unique monsters as your minions and vanquish adventurers who dare to enter your realm!

Install gargoyles, ritual altars, and other devilish decor to boost your castle's mystique and attract more monsters your way. Gift them food and other items to help them grow, and garner their support to fend off pesky adventurers.

You can also send your monster minions out to explore nearby dungeons and towns. They'll bring you back items and other loot, and maybe even some new allies!

As you progress, you can also start merging monsters together to make new ones.

And don't forget traps—essential equipment for proper castle defense! Develop a range of traps like sleep-inducing gas and heavy washbowls to thwart any who cross the threshold of your demonic haven! By placing and combining traps in imaginative ways, you can make your fortress of fiendishness virtually impregnable!

Fend off attacks from mighty adventurers and keep your minions sweet to become the biggest and baddest demon overlord of all time!

70010000120977.name: Serious Carnage - Adrenaline Shooter
70010000120977.description:
No cover. No limits. Just pure action.
Enter a brutal battlefield where speed, aggression, and constant movement are the only way to survive. Serious Carnage - Adrenaline Shooter throws you into intense arena-based combat where waves of enemies never stop and every second pushes your reflexes to the limit.

Fight through closed arenas filled with enemies, where portals open and unleash continuous waves of threats. You’re forced to stay in motion, switch weapons on the fly, and react instantly as the pressure builds with every encounter.

Use a wide arsenal of powerful weapons, each designed for a different combat style. From precision shots to heavy explosive damage, every choice changes how you handle the chaos around you. Enemies range from fast and aggressive units to stronger elite forces and massive bosses that require skill and timing to defeat.

Defeat enemies, collect souls, and push your limits to activate powerful abilities that turn the fight in your favor.  Aggressive gameplay is rewarded, encouraging you to stay in the action and take control of every arena.

Key Features:
	•	Non-stop arena combat with constant pressure
	•	Wave-based encounters that keep escalating
	•	Fast movement built around aggression
	•	Weapon variety for different combat styles
	•	Rage Mode that shifts the fight in your favor
	•	Boss fights that test timing and control

The pressure keeps building with every wave.
Only those who stay in control make it through.

70010000120983.name: EGGCONSOLE PSYCHO WORLD MSX2
70010000120983.intro: Master 8 unique ESP powers to command fire, ice at will! Transcend mere reflexes and experience the strategic thrill of crushing massive bosses with godlike power.
70010000120983.description:
Released by Herz in 1988, the true essence of this action game’s appeal lies in the sense of omnipotence gained from switching between eight psychic powers in real-time. It goes beyond simply shooting enemies; the thrill of instantly cycling through diverse abilities like fire, ice, sonics, and levitation to suit the flow of battle is addictive. There is a special satisfaction in seeing your own ideas lead directly to success—whether it’s choosing the right element for an enemy’s weakness or freezing a foe to use as a platform to reach higher ground.

The tactical depth of managing a limited "Energy Gauge" is also masterfully handled. The game offers the freedom to let your personality shine through your playstyle, whether you choose to overwhelm enemies with raw power or proceed cautiously behind a shield. The sense of accomplishment when taking down a massive, screen-filling boss using your full arsenal of psychic powers delivers the pure joy of an action game. Even today, the experience of traversing this vibrantly colored world remains a timeless, intellectual, and exhilarating adventure.
 

 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000120990.name: EGGCONSOLE DEEP DUNGEON MSX
70010000120990.intro: A masterpiece of the MSX 3D RPG genre.To rescue Princess Etna, a nameless adventurer braves the depths of an underground labyrinth!
70010000120990.description:
Experience a classic RPG masterpiece from 1988, brought to you by Humming Bird Soft.

The mission: Rescue the abducted Princess Etna. As the hero of this tale, you’ll receive the King’s blessing (and some gold) to equip yourself in the Town of Doll before braving the unknown. Inside the dungeon, danger lurks around every corner. When steel meets claw, you’ll need to master the command-based battle system—victory favors the strategist!

What truly sets this adventure apart is its immersive 3D dungeon crawling. Feel the tension rise as you navigate deep underground in a first-person view. But beware: these labyrinths are notoriously intricate. Unless you want to be lost forever, you’d better keep a pen and paper handy to map your progress.

Can you reach Princess Etna in time? And what ancient terror awaits at the deepest level? Your legend begins now.

 
 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.
 *Flashing lights or patterns may cause dizziness, spasms, or loss of consciousness. If you feel unwell, stop playing immediately and see a doctor.
   If you have a history of these symptoms, consult a physician before use.

70010000120993.name: Unbox the Room
70010000120993.intro: Transform chaos into comfort in a meditative interior design simulator where every item tells a story!
70010000120993.description:
In Unbox the Room, you’re not just moving furniture — you’re a professional life-arranger, a master of the “where does this go?” mystery, and a total (consensual) snoop. From cramped studio apartments to luxurious mansions, it’s up to you to transform a pile of cardboard boxes into a beautifully organized and lived-in home.

KEY FEATURES: 
- The Ultimate Zen Zone: No timers. No "Game Over" screens. Just the rhythmic thwack of tape peeling and the pure, dopamine-hitting click of a book fitting perfectly onto a shelf.
- Environmental Storytelling: Why does this guy have four different toilets? What’s the deal with that strange book at the bottom of the box? Piece together your clients' lives through the junk they refuse to throw away.
- Total Aesthetic Control: Not feeling the beige? Use the Magic Paint Roller to overhaul the room's vibe. Make it goth. Make it neon. Make it a nightmare. We won't tell the client.
- Sandbox Shenanigans: Done with the story? Head to the Creative Sandbox where the budget is infinite and the boxes are non-existent. Build the dream gaming den you’ll never actually afford in real life!
- Tactile Satisfaction: Every item has been crafted with gorgeous pixel art and satisfying physics.

70010000120999.name: Hospital Romance: Anime Doctor Crush
70010000120999.intro:
The doctor will see you now.
Get close, earn his trust, and unlock exclusive images!
70010000120999.description:
Check in to a hospital where the doctors are as intense as they are irresistible... and getting better has never felt this good.

Answer their questions, hold your ground against every interruption, and build a real connection with anime doctors who each carry something worth uncovering.

From the quiet specialist who says little but notices everything, to the confident attending who makes every visit feel personal. Every choice you make changes how they see you.

Think you can handle the pressure and win them over?


Features:

● DUAL GAMEPLAY, DOUBLE TENSION: Alternate between personality-driven Q&A sessions and reflex-based minigames where you block distractions, rival patients, and unexpected visitors to keep your connection alive.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Deepen your bond with each doctor to reveal special moments and unique illustrations as you progress through their route.

● DISTINCT PERSONALITIES, REAL DEPTH: Every doctor reacts differently to your answers, your timing, and your choices. Getting it right feels earned.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: How it ends depends on how well you listen, how fast you react, and how much you truly understand him.

● A HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Reach question 150 to unlock a very special scene that only the most dedicated patients will ever see.


This hospital runs on connection, and you are the missing piece.
Ready to find out which doctor steals your heart?

70010000121005.name: Hospital Romance: Anime Nurse Crush
70010000121005.intro:
Your heart isn't the only thing they'll check.
Fall for the nurses and unlock exclusive images!
70010000121005.description:
Step into a hospital where the staff is as captivating as they are caring... and your recovery depends on how well you play your cards.

Answer their questions, defend your heart from unwanted interruptions, and earn the trust of charming anime nurses who each hide a story worth discovering.

Every right move brings you closer to their secret side. Do you have the patience and the skill to win them over?


Features:

● DUAL GAMEPLAY, DOUBLE TENSION: Alternate between personality-driven Q&A sessions and reflex-based minigames where you defend against distractions, rival patients, and unexpected visitors.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Build connection with each nurse to reveal special moments and unique illustrations as you progress through their route.

● DISTINCT PERSONALITIES, REAL DEPTH: From the strict head nurse to the bubbly intern, every character reacts differently to your answers, your timing, and your choices.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your results depend on how well you listen, how fast you react, and how much you truly understand her.

● A HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Reach question 150 to unlock a very special scene that only the most dedicated patients will ever see.


Think you've got what it takes to charm the whole ward?

This is one hospital you won't want to leave!

70010000121011.name: Zombie Hearts: Turn the Undead into Anime Boys
70010000121011.intro: Hunt the undead… and turn them into irresistible anime boys.
70010000121011.description:
They were lost to the apocalypse… now they’re yours to claim.

In Zombie Hearts: Turn the Undead into Anime Boys, every battle brings you closer to something dangerous, intense… and impossible to resist.

Explore infected zones crawling with the undead. Fight, weaken, and capture them… then transform them into captivating anime boys with a dark, post-apocalyptic allure.

♥ HUNT, CAPTURE AND REVIVE
Face relentless hordes of zombies and turn your enemies into something far more tempting: your ideal anime boys.

♥ FROM DECAY TO DESIRE
Each boy carries the essence of what he once was. Strong, mysterious, wild… now reborn with a seductive edge that’s hard to ignore.

♥ BUILD DESIRE AND CONNECTION
Get closer to the boys you capture. Unlock intimate moments, deepen your bond, and uncover their hidden sides.

♥ GROW STRONGER, GO FURTHER
Earn rewards, upgrade your skills, and dominate increasingly dangerous encounters. The stronger you become, the more irresistible they are.

♥ UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE MOMENTS
Progress to reveal special scenes and unique interactions. Every victory pulls you deeper into their world.


In a world overrun by the undead… will you control them, or give in to them?

70010000121017.name: Zombie Hearts: Turn the Undead into Anime Girls
70010000121017.intro: Hunt the undead… and turn them into irresistible anime girls.
70010000121017.description:
They were once lost to the apocalypse… now they’re yours to reclaim.

In Zombie Hearts: Turn the Undead into Anime Girls, every battle is a chance to bring beauty back from decay.

Explore dangerous zones overrun by zombies. Fight, weaken, and capture them… then transform them into stunning anime girls with a dark, post-apocalyptic edge.

♥ HUNT, CAPTURE AND REVIVE
Face relentless waves of the undead and turn your enemies into something completely unexpected: your ideal anime girls.

♥ FROM DECAY TO DESIRE
Each girl carries traces of her past life. Their personalities, looks, and attitude reflect the zombie they once were… now reborn in a seductive new form.

♥ BUILD BONDS BEYOND SURVIVAL
Get closer to the girls you save. Unlock scenes, deepen your connection, and discover their hidden stories.

♥ UPGRADE AND DOMINATE
Earn rewards, improve your combat skills, and survive tougher encounters. The stronger you become, the more powerful and alluring your girls will be.

♥ UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE SCENES
Progress through the game to reveal special images and moments. Every victory brings you closer to uncovering everything they have to offer.


In a world ruled by the undead… will you fight them, or fall for them?

70010000121023.name: Gas Station Manager 2026
70010000121023.intro: Refuel cars, manage your store, and grow your roadside empire.
70010000121023.description:
Step into the shoes of a station manager and take over an abandoned roadside gas station. From rusty pumps and empty shelves to a bustling hub of activity, every decision is yours. Refuel cars, clean vehicles, manage the store, and maintain the area — success depends on your skill, speed, and strategy. Experience the challenge of running a full-service station, where every role matters and every customer counts.

Key Features:
• Refuel & Serve: Keep fuel flowing and customers happy.
• Store Management: Stock shelves, sell goods, and attract more visitors.
• Car Wash & Maintenance: Clean vehicles and repair damaged equipment.
• Supply & Upgrades: Manage deliveries, monitor inventory, and improve your station.
• Hands-On Roles: Play as cashier, mechanic, cleaner, or take full control as manager.

Transform a forgotten stop into a thriving roadside empire. Gas Station Simulator is more than a game — it’s your chance to master every detail, grow your business, and build the ultimate gas station experience. Are you ready to take the wheel?

70010000121029.name: Death Run
70010000121029.intro: Dodge lethal lasers in a dark sci-fi death show — or die trying.
70010000121029.description:
Death Run drops you into the world's most dangerous live broadcast: a high-stakes sci-fi game show where participants are thrown into merciless laser gauntlets and the only exit is the finish line. Watched by billions, judged by the millisecond, you are the latest contestant. The question isn't whether the show wants you dead — it does. The question is whether you're fast enough, sharp enough, and precise enough to make it out anyway.
At its core, Death Run is a 3D precision platformer built around fluid movement and split-second decision making. Courses are laced with moving lasers — rotating, sweeping, pulsing, and converging in patterns that demand full attention and quick adaptation. A single hit sends you back to the start. There are no checkpoints. There is only the run.
Your movement arsenal gives you the tools to survive: jump, double jump, upward dash, forward dash, float, and a momentum system that rewards players who keep moving forward without hesitation. Combining these fluidly is the difference between a clean run and a reset.
The game is built in levels, each taking one to two minutes to complete. Every five levels the action pauses for a story segment — expanding the dark, Squid Game-inspired narrative of the show, its hosts, its rules, and the world watching from the outside. The further you progress, the more the story peels back the layers of what this broadcast really is.
With a sleek neon-lit visual style, pounding atmosphere, and courses that escalate in complexity and speed, Death Run is a game about mastery. Each failed run teaches you something. Each completed run is earned.

70010000121032.name: Jack In Space
70010000121032.intro: A collection of fun space mini-games for kids
70010000121032.description:
Jack in Space is a bright, kid-friendly space adventure packed with playful mini-games and simple learning challenges. Join Jack as he looks up at the night sky, explores a colorful space lab, and completes fun tasks that mix curiosity, logic, and early math skills.

From counting stars in the sky to assembling spaceship parts in a factory-style scene, each activity is designed to be easy to understand, satisfying to complete, and visually rewarding. Inside Jack’s futuristic control room, players also solve picture-tile puzzles that reveal characters and scenes piece by piece, turning every challenge into a quick, feel-good win.

With big buttons, cheerful animations, and a gentle pace, Jack in Space is built for young players who love space, puzzles, and learning through play.

70010000121035.name: Hentai Reality
70010000121035.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000121035.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000121057.name: Auto Shop Simulator
70010000121057.intro: Ready to become the ultimate car tycoon?
70010000121057.description:
Build your own automotive empire in Auto Shop Simulator — the ultimate business simulation where every deal counts. Step into the role of a car dealership owner and transform a small local garage into a thriving vehicle marketplace. Buy used and premium cars, negotiate profitable deals, manage your inventory, and satisfy customers looking for their perfect ride.

Start with a modest showroom and gradually expand your business by unlocking new vehicles, upgrading facilities, and attracting more buyers. From economy cars to luxury models, every purchase and sale influences your reputation and success. Manage finances carefully, react to changing market trends, and make strategic decisions to grow your dealership into the top auto shop in town.

Features:
	•	Buy and Sell Vehicles: Discover valuable cars, negotiate prices, and sell vehicles for maximum profit.
	•	Realistic Dealership Management: Organize inventory, monitor market value, and keep your showroom stocked with popular models.
	•	Expand Your Business: Upgrade your dealership, unlock larger spaces, and improve customer experience.
	•	Dynamic Customer System: Meet different customer needs and handle daily business challenges.
	•	Immersive Simulation Experience: Enjoy detailed vehicles, dealership customization, and rewarding progression.

Auto Shop Simulator delivers an engaging experience for car lovers and simulation fans alike. Test your entrepreneurial skills, make smart business decisions, and grow your small dealership into a successful automotive empire.

70010000121063.name: Counter Call - Half Escape Shooter
70010000121063.description:
Counter Call - Half Escape Shooter Enter a high-intensity first-person shooter built for nonstop action and fast decision-making. Every mission throws you straight into combat, where quick reflexes, precision aiming, and smart positioning are the only way to survive. Fight through waves of enemies across compact, action-driven maps designed to keep you constantly engaged. 

There’s no downtime — every route leads to new encounters, pushing you to stay alert and react instantly to threats coming from all directions. Adapt your playstyle to each situation. Choose the right weapon, switch tactics on the fly, and handle both close-range aggression and controlled, long-distance combat. Success depends on how well you read the battlefield and respond under pressure. Enjoy smooth controls and responsive mechanics that make movement, aiming, and shooting feel sharp and satisfying. Every encounter is direct, intense, and rewarding for players who think fast and act faster. 

Key Features: 
	•	Fast-paced FPS gameplay with continuous action 
	•	Wave-based enemy encounters
	•	Compact maps designed for constant engagement
	•	Flexible combat styles: aggressive or tactical 
	•	Smooth controls and responsive shooting mechanics 
	•	Increasing challenge that tests reflexes and precision
Step into the zone. Eliminate the threat. Win.

70010000121090.name: Nocturne Routes
70010000121090.intro: Plan your path. Control the night.
70010000121090.description:
In Nocturne Routes, you guide a vampire through dark, puzzle-filled levels where every move must be planned in advance. Each stage challenges you to chart an efficient route, defeat lurking skeletons, and decide whether to collect optional coins along the way — or leave them behind.

Enemies aren’t avoided, they’re outplayed. Skeletons block your path, forcing you to think carefully about movement order, positioning, and strategy. A single wrong decision can leave you trapped in the darkness.

Every level contains three optional coins, rewarding mastery and smart planning. Your progress is tracked on the level select screen, letting you replay stages to perfect your solutions and claim full completion.

With its darker atmosphere, thoughtful mechanics, and focus on deliberate decision-making, Nocturne Routes offers a puzzle experience that rewards patience, logic, and careful execution.

70010000121096.name: Wabisabi SushiDerby
70010000121096.intro: Adorable sushi race at full speed in a training × racing game!
70010000121096.description:
As a sushi chef apprentice, you'll make sushi, train it , and compete in races. Win races, use the prize money to make even faster sushi and train harder, aiming for victory in the ultimate “S1” Cup!

No matter how painstakingly crafted the sushi may be, once eaten, it's an instant defeat. It heads straight for the customer's stomach and never comes back.

Each sushi topping has different performance characteristics. How well you've mastered making that particular topping also affects its performance. Use training to perfect your ideal sushi. However, since sushi is a perishable item, its performance degrades after each race.

During the race, all you can do is “cheer on” the sushi to boost it. You can escape chopsticks by using boost, but the sushi race isn't that easy—you won't win just by doing that. Sometimes you'll need to take risks and use boost to overtake rivals.

Some sushi toppings possess unique skills. For example, Flounder can dive to dodge chopsticks in an emergency without using boost, while Sea Urchin can use its spines to knock rivals away. There are over 40 different skills, some of which can be learned through training.

70010000121101.name: Find the Funny Mistake!
70010000121101.intro:
What’s wrong with this photo?
A new kind of spot-the-mistake challenge!
70010000121101.description:
A Slightly Strange Spot-the-Difference is a puzzle game where you look for things that feel “off” in photos!
Sharpen your intuition and observation skills to find the mistakes hidden in each picture.

If you get stuck, hints are available,
so even if you're not confident, you can start playing right away.

Fun for everyone—from adults to kids.
A great game for passing time or training your brain!

70010000121112.name: Fight Girls
70010000121112.intro: A puzzle game featuring cool and cute battle girls is here!
70010000121112.description:
Collect pieces of the battle girls and complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Once completed, high‑resolution images will be added to your gallery ♪
=====================
We support game streamers!
No permission is required to stream this game.

70010000121118.name: Dog Jigsaw from Japan
70010000121118.intro:
【Up to 150 Pieces!】
Everyone’s favorite! Collect puzzle pieces of iconic Japanese dogs and complete the puzzle!
70010000121118.description:
Shiba Inu, Kishu Ken, Akita Inu, and many other Japanese dog breeds appear!
There are 15 stages in total!
