As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases.
This game starts with 50‑piece puzzles and goes up to challenging 150‑piece stages!
Stages 1–5: 50 pieces
Stages 6–10: 100 pieces
Stages 11–15: 150 pieces
The later stages are tough ones with no background watermark!
Take your time, observe each piece carefully, and complete the puzzle!
=====================
We support game streamers!
No permission is required to stream this game.

70010000121134.name: Garden Designer Simulator
70010000121134.intro: Turn forgotten gardens into cozy little paradises where every flower matters
70010000121134.description:
Create, decorate, and transform beautiful outdoor spaces in Garden Designer Simulator — a relaxing gardening and landscaping experience where creativity and hard work go hand in hand. 

Start your journey in a quiet small town with your very own house and garden. Learn the basics of outdoor maintenance by mowing lawns, trimming hedges, removing weeds, watering plants, and restoring old fences. Grow flowers and vegetables in your greenhouse while turning your backyard into a cozy and welcoming retreat. 

As your reputation grows, local residents will begin asking for your help. Travel across town to restore neglected gardens, redesign outdoor spaces, and complete landscaping projects. Earn rewards, unlock new tools and decorations, and continue improving your own property. 

After completing the first missions, unlock a more open experience where you can focus on gardening, landscaping, decoration, or customer requests. With repeatable contracts and randomized tasks, there is always a new garden waiting to be transformed. 

Key Features:  
• Mow lawns, trim hedges, and clean overgrown yards  
• Plant flowers and grow vegetables in your greenhouse  
• Paint fences, water plants, and restore outdoor spaces  
• Decorate gardens with statues and decorative items  
• Complete gardening jobs for residents around town  
• Buy new seeds, tools, and outdoor decorations  
• Upgrade and customize your own home garden 

Garden Designer Simulator is perfect for players who enjoy cozy simulation games, relaxing outdoor activities, and creative garden customization.

70010000121139.name: Time Kings: Modern War in Medieval Age
70010000121139.intro: Modern firepower. Medieval chaos. Survive the impossible.
70010000121139.description:
Enter a war zone where history and modern combat collide. You are a highly trained soldier from the present, suddenly thrown into the middle of brutal medieval battles. Surrounded by knights, archers, and massive armies, you must rely on advanced weaponry, sharp instincts, and tactical thinking to survive. Outnumbered and in unfamiliar territory, every decision you make could mean the difference between victory and defeat.

Take on intense missions that push your combat skills to the limit. Secure strategic locations, withstand relentless enemy waves, and adapt your approach as the battlefield evolves. Precision, awareness, and smart positioning are just as important as the firepower in your hands.

Experience a unique blend of modern warfare and medieval chaos. Learn to control the pace of battle, use your environment to your advantage, and respond to constant threats from every direction. As challenges grow tougher, only those who think ahead and act decisively will make it through.

Key Features
● Step into the role of a modern soldier fighting in a medieval war environment
● Use advanced weapons like rifles, pistols, and grenades against traditional armies
● Complete tactical objectives by capturing and defending key areas
● Explore varied locations including castles, villages, forests, and open battlefields
● Face increasing difficulty with stronger enemies and more complex missions
● Discover a unique setting that merges modern combat with medieval warfare
● Engage in dynamic gameplay where positioning and timing are essential

Survive the impossible, dominate the battlefield, and rewrite the rules of war.

70010000121144.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
70010000121144.intro: Save Bikini Bottom in this brand-new ghostly adventure!
70010000121144.description:
How do you stop the two biggest egos of the Seven Seas from fighting? A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. SpongeBob and Patrick will need all their skills, bravery and - dare I say - wit, to return life to what passes for normal in their undersea home. Join Bikini Bottom's most notorious duo on their ghostliest adventure yet!

Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick
Combine SpongeBob and Patrick's unique platforming skills
Master Patrick's brand-new skills like grappling and burrowing
Experience a new ghostly story
Fully voiced by the original cast of the show
Visit iconic locations like Neptune's Palace and Mount Bikini
Battle epic bosses like the Flying Dutchman, King Neptune and Hibernation Sandy

70010000121160.name: Match Quest : Numbers
70010000121160.intro:
Match numbers
Beat high scores
Rule the global leaderboard
70010000121160.description:
This is Number Match — a fast, addictive logic game where every move brings you closer to a perfect 10.

Match identical numbers or pairs that total 10. Clear the board. Rack up your score. Chase combos and set records as the pace builds and pressure rises. 

It’s simple. It’s satisfying. And it’s just you versus the board… and everyone else.

With a dynamic leaderboard built into the experience, every match is a battle for the top spot. Whether you're chasing your first win or your next personal best, the race never ends. Pure puzzle gameplay meets arcade energy, designed for quick rounds and long sessions alike.

70010000121166.name: Mighty Aphid 2
70010000121166.intro: Run, shoot, swim, dash, and fly.
70010000121166.description:
It's World War Worm! Victoria is under siege at the battle front. After a two-year absence, Mighty Aphid returns to battle Lady Bug and her evil horde once again. This time, the villainess has created her own Mighty warriors to take on the pint-sized hero.

Run, shoot, swim, dash, and fly. Rescue the innocent. Fight mighty bosses. Earn powerful upgrades.

70010000121176.name: Shinkansen Card Pull Simulator
70010000121176.intro: Real Shinkansen bullet trains — now collectible cards! Pull gacha, trade on the market, ride the price swings. 50 cards featuring real Shinkansen photographs.
70010000121176.description:
■ Real Shinkansen Photos on Every Card This game features 50 unique cards showcasing real photographs of Tokaido and Sanyo Shinkansen bullet trains. From the cutting-edge N700S to the classic 0 Series that started it all, and even the legendary Doctor Yellow Type 923 T4 — retired in 2025 — build your ultimate Shinkansen collection. 

■ Pull Gacha to Collect Cards Spin the gacha to get new Shinkansen cards! Each train appears in multiple versions with different rarities and unique titles. Display your collection in your personal showcase and aim for 100% completion. 

■ A Market That Moves This isn't just a gacha game. A full card trading market lets you buy and sell cards at fluctuating prices. Watch for sudden booms and crashes — sell high for a big profit, or swoop in during a crash to grab rare cards at a bargain. 

■ The Gacha–Trade Loop Spend your trading profits on more gacha pulls. Some cards can only be purchased on the market after you've pulled them from the gacha at least once — so both gacha and trading are essential to complete your collection. 

■ No Microtransactions There are absolutely no in-app purchases. Everything is earned through in-game currency. Buy the game and enjoy the full experience. Born from a passion to preserve these legendary trains in a game — whether you're a Shinkansen fan or a gacha enthusiast, there's something here for you.

Approved by Central Japan Railway Company / Approved by West Japan Railway Company

70010000121184.name: The Prince of Tennis Sweet School Festival ~♡-40 and more...~ Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000121184.intro: Off the court, he's even more of a Prince!
70010000121184.description:
The Prince of Tennis Sweet School Festival ~♡-40 and more...~ is a globally remastered edition of a legendary otome game that has been beloved in Japan for more than 20 years.

<Story>
During a joint school festival hosted by the tennis clubs of seven academies, you are chosen to serve as a member of the festival’s management committee.
Guide and support the players of your assigned school, strengthen your bonds, and strive for first place in the stall competition!

<Features>
- Experience a school life filled with romance, surrounded by many charming Princes.
- Enjoy sweet and bittersweet date events unique to each Prince!
- Experience elegant, beautifully illustrated event CGs, with some artwork enhanced by animation.

Senri Chitose/Jun Osuka

70010000121189.name: Geo Brain Boost! World Map Silhouette Quiz
70010000121189.intro: Can You Identify the World by Its Shape?
70010000121189.description:
Look at the silhouette and guess the country or region!
World Map Silhouette Quiz is a quiz game that lets you enjoy learning world geography in a fun and accessible way.

Use the shapes on screen as clues and discover the fun of recognizing countries from their outlines. As you play, you will naturally become more familiar with the world map, making it a great choice for learning, casual solo play, or quiz time with family and friends.

Perfect for players who enjoy geography, quiz games, and educational challenges.
Test your knowledge and see how many places around the world you can identify!

Some map and silhouette representations in this game may be simplified for gameplay purposes.

70010000121198.name: Nitro City Racing
70010000121198.intro: Dodge traffic and maintain top speed on your mission to become the ultimate street racer!
70010000121198.description:
Start your engine and get ready to experience the thrill of street racing in over-the-top arcade style! Choose and customize your ride, navigate through traffic and push your driving skills to the limit as you compete in a wide variety of high-octane challenges. Nitro City Racing is a throwback to genre classics that puts the focus on speed, blending realistic physics with intuitive controls and accessible, endlessly replayable racing modes!

Pick a track and avoid obstacles to reach maximum velocity as you race to victory. Clear missions in Career mode, sprint from point to point in One-Way mode or enjoy the freedom of Free Ride, with additional modes to unlock as you progress. Track your mission stats and reward your skill with coins to spend on upgrades. Do you have what it takes to rule the streets?

• Put your skills to the test across a variety of racing modes!
• Choose your car and customize it.
• Navigate through traffic and dodge obstacles to maintain speed!
• Complete missions to earn coins and set new high scores.
• Enjoy high-quality 3D graphics and intuitive controls.
• Switch between in-car and external camera views!

This game and the content contained therein is not authorized by car manufacturers or motor racing competitions and there is no association thereof.

70010000121204.name: Grand Vegas Casino
70010000121204.intro: Become a gambling master without the financial risk as you test your skills in the world's most popular casino games!
70010000121204.description:
Feeling lucky? Step into the Grand Vegas Casino and try your hand at 4 of the most popular gambling games in the world, with no need to get dressed up or risk your wallet! Grand Vegas Casino is a casual gambling simulation game for players of all skill levels, offering intuitive controls and a fluidly animated HD-2D graphic style to keep you immersed in luxurious high-rolling action.

Build your strategy, improve your skills, place daring bets and experiment to win. Featured casino games include Poker, Roulette, Blackjack and Slots, each with unique mechanics and standard rules that have made them timeless staples of the gambling scene. Play against computer-controlled opponents and unlock cool rewards as you progress! Are you ready to go all in?

• Play Poker, Blackjack, Roulette and Slots using standard casino rules!
• Experiment, strategize and easily restart if you run out of money.
• Collect rewards for defeating AI opponents!
• Enjoy crisp and colorful HD presentation in fluidly animated 2D style.

70010000121218.name: Helicopter Shooter - Hot Ace Heli War Borne
70010000121218.description:
Take control of a combat helicopter and enter missions where every second matters. Support ground forces, eliminate threats, and complete objectives in fast-paced aerial operations.
Engage in intense missions across dynamic environments where threats come from every direction. Each situation pushes you to react quickly, manage resources, and adapt your strategy in real time.
Stay in constant motion while navigating compact, action-focused maps filled with enemies, hazards, and objectives. From urban conflict zones to military bases, every location tests your control and decision-making.
Use a mix of weapons and systems to handle different combat scenarios. Suppress enemies with your machine gun, launch rockets against heavy targets, and manage fuel and ammo carefully to stay operational.
A unique hook system lets you capture and transport objects, evacuate civilians, and complete mission objectives under pressure. Carrying cargo affects your maneuverability and increases risk, adding a strategic layer to every flight.

Key Features:
	•	Aerial Combat Gameplay: Fast-paced helicopter action
	•	 Mission Variety: Different types of objectives
	•	Weapon Systems: Core combat equipment
	•	Resource Management: Fuel and ammo matter
	•	 Hook Mechanic: Transport and rescue system
	•	Dynamic Maps: Designed for constant action
	•	Progressive Difficulty: Increasing challenge over time

Control the airspace, respond under pressure, and complete every mission with precision.

70010000121231.name: Triple Trouble: Midnight Club
70010000121231.intro: Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.
70010000121231.description:
Solve captivating puzzles featuring images of beautiful anime-style girls. With each image you complete, you'll unlock new ones, and the gradually increasing difficulty makes solving the puzzle a fascinating challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling that you're actually touching every detail.

Soft and relaxing music will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after solving the puzzle, you can examine the image closely and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Stylish anime images.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Relaxing music.

70010000121237.name: Hentai Reality 3
70010000121237.intro: Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.
70010000121237.description:
Solve captivating puzzles featuring images of beautiful anime-style girls. With each image you complete, you'll unlock new ones, and the gradually increasing difficulty makes solving the puzzle a fascinating challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling that you're actually touching every detail.

Soft and relaxing music will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after solving the puzzle, you can examine the image closely and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Stylish anime images.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Relaxing music.

70010000121243.name: Barbarous: Survivor's Quest
70010000121243.intro: Battle the horde and survive the quest!
70010000121243.description:
The land is overrun by hungry orcs, skeletons, ghosts, rats, and other dangerous creatures, and only the strongest will last! Fight through wave after wave of enemies, face powerful bosses, and upgrade your hero to become unstoppable.

Every run is a new challenge! Choose your upgrades wisely and shape your build as you progress. Open treasure chests, gather experience, and stay in the fight as the enemy waves grow stronger.

Improve your stats, unlock powerful weapons, and collect valuable rewards as you carve your way through the chaos!

Features:
- Fight waves of orcs, skeletons, ghosts, rats, and more
- Face powerful bosses and earn valuable rewards
- Shape your build with many weapons and items
- Upgrade and evolve your gear!
- Power up and become the ultimate hero

How long can you survive before the horde overwhelms you?

70010000121245.name: Just. Press. The Button.
70010000121245.description:
Welcome to Enterprise Corp.
We are pleased to have you.

Your job is simple. You must press the button when the system instructs you to do so.

The system will evaluate your punctuality, consistency, and ability to follow instructions.
Good performance will result in promotions within the corporate hierarchy.
Poor performance will have immediate consequences.

There is no need to understand the internal workings of the processes.
All relevant information will be provided when appropriate.

The system does not make mistakes.
The system records every action.

Thank you for your interest in becoming part of Enterprise Corp.

In “Just. Press. The Button.”, every action counts and every decision defines you. Explore a world where obedience to rules is not optional and promotions come with increasing expectations. "Just. Press. The Button." places you face to face with routine and constant corporate pressure as you attempt to maintain your position within the hierarchy.

Prepare for a dystopian experience that blends the race for success, monotony, tension, and the consequences of every step, all while the system watches, evaluates, and records your every move.

70010000121253.name: Primary School – English Grade 1 & 2
70010000121253.intro: Complete Grade 1 & 2 English – fun, guided & smart learning quizzes for kids.
70010000121253.description:
Primary School – English Grade 1 & 2 is a complete, curriculum-based English learning adventure designed especially for young learners.

With 7 adorable animated characters, children explore every important topic from Grade 1 and Grade 2 in a fun, structured, and supportive environment.

Each grade includes:
- Around 10 main topics
- 5–10 subtopics per topic
- Step-by-step explanations for every concept
- Guided multiple-choice quizzes
- Optional final year test
- A detailed learning overview for parents

From capitalization and punctuation to grammar, reading comprehension, and vocabulary — the game covers the full curriculum in a playful, accessible way.

70010000121256.name: Floor 9
70010000121256.intro: Beware of anomalies and find a way out
70010000121256.description:
In Floor 9, you find yourself trapped in a mysterious hotel known as "Hotel Liminal." To escape, you must identify anomalies on each floor. These anomalies can be anywhere - on the ground, in paintings, or even right in front of your eyes. You must check every corner carefully, as one mistake will send you back to the beginning, to Floor 9. The game offers you a unique blend of eerie atmosphere, puzzle-solving, and survival, all wrapped up in a psychologically thrilling experience.

Features:
• Explore a mysterious and atmospheric hotel setting.
• Discover intriguing anomalies on each floor.
• Engage in challenging gameplay that tests your observation and decision-making skills.
• Immerse yourself in eerie sound design.

70010000121258.name: High and Dry
70010000121258.intro: Build a floating fortress capable of surviving the final storm.
70010000121258.description:
Set sail on a ruthless rogue-like pirate adventure where every voyage brings you closer to glory—or to the bottom of the sea. Long ago, you made a cursed deal with the legendary Davey Jones, and now he’s coming to claim your soul. With the clock ticking toward your final confrontation, you must raid ships, hunt treasure, build your crew, and become powerful enough to survive the battle waiting beyond the horizon.

Command your own pirate ship across a constantly changing ocean filled with enemy vessels, hidden treasure, mysterious encounters, and dangerous opportunities. Raid ships for resources, follow risky treasure maps, and make difficult choices that shape every voyage. No two runs are the same, with randomized events and encounters creating a fresh adventure every time you play.

Key Features
• Rogue-Like Pirate Runs: Every voyage is unique with random encounters and shifting challenges
• Ship Progression: Upgrade weapons, abilities, and crew to grow stronger over time
• Ocean Exploration: Sail through dangerous seas filled with treasure, enemies, and secrets
• Strategic Decisions: Every choice shapes your path, power, and survival chances
• Naval Combat: Fast, stylized ship battles inspired by pirate legends
• Time Pressure: Race against the clock as Davey Jones closes in on your soul

Raise the sails, gather your crew, and fight for your freedom before the sea claims you forever.

70010000121264.name: Oni Station
70010000121264.intro: How long can you outrun the dark?
70010000121264.description:
Wake up trapped inside a train with no memory of how you got there. Beyond the windows, endless darkness stretches across abandoned tracks while an unknown presence follows close behind. The fuel gauge keeps dropping, and every passing station may hold the supplies needed to survive — or something far worse.

Oni Station is a tense atmospheric horror experience set aboard a lonely moving train where fear, mystery, and survival collide. Travel through eerie stations, uncover fragments of the forgotten past, and face the constant pressure of something lurking just out of sight. The deeper you go, the more the truth begins to unravel.

Features:
	•	Dark atmospheric horror inspired by psychological tension and urban legends.
	•	Procedurally generated stations that create a different journey every time.
	•	Immersive train setting filled with mystery, danger, and unsettling discoveries.
	•	Resource-focused survival where every decision matters.
	•	Online leaderboards to challenge other survivors around the world.
	•	Haunting sound design and environments that keep the tension alive until the very end.


How long can you keep the train moving before the darkness finally catches up? Step aboard Oni Station, uncover the secrets hidden along the tracks, and survive a journey where every stop could be your last.

70010000121270.name: Pawbay
70010000121270.intro: Pawbay was a peaceful town... until you showed up.
70010000121270.description:
Slip into the paws of a mischievous little cat and turn a cozy seaside town upside down. In Pawbay, every alley, rooftop, shop, and secret corner is full of playful ways to stir up trouble. Sneak, climb, swipe, and pounce your way through a charming world where curiosity always leads to chaos. 
Better yet, you can enjoy the full adventure solo or with a friend in local 2-player split-screen co-op. The town may be lovely, but that will not stop you from becoming its most unforgettable little menace.
With plenty of freedom to experiment, every prank becomes its own funny story.

Features:
• Play as a nimble, curious cat with a talent for trouble
• Enjoy the full game solo or in local 2-player split-screen co-op
• Explore a lively town with streets, rooftops, and interiors, uncovering secret routes and hard-to-reach places. 
• Complete playful objectives through stealing, sabotaging, distracting, and more 
• Stir up hilarious reactions from the people of Pawbay

70010000121276.name: Triple Trouble: Locker Room Secrets
70010000121276.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000121276.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000121282.name: Chained Climb Together: Local Co-OP
70010000121282.intro: Only perfect teamwork can conquer the peak.
70010000121282.description:
Bound together by mystical chains, you and your team must climb a deadly mountain where every step is shared, every movement requires perfect coordination, and every mistake can pull the entire group into danger.

As you ascend through steep cliffs, unstable paths, and unpredictable terrain, teamwork becomes your only way forward, forcing you to rely on timing, balance, and trust to survive the climb and push ever closer to the summit.

As you climb higher, the environment becomes increasingly harsh and unpredictable. Steep cliffs, unstable terrain, and shifting paths constantly challenge your ability to stay in sync. The chain connecting you adds both tension and strategy, forcing careful timing and cooperation at every step of the journey.

Key Features:
• Shared Chain Movement: Every action impacts the whole team.
 • Cooperative Climbing: Work together to overcome vertical challenges.
 • Dynamic Environments: Shifting terrain that tests coordination.
 • Team Progression: Unlock new mountain zones as you improve.

Climb as one, move as one, survive as one — every step forward is a shared victory, and every mistake is a shared consequence.

70010000121290.name: Soccer Kid Collection (QUByte Classics)
70010000121290.intro: A classic platformer where your soccer ball is your weapon!
70010000121290.description:
The World Cup has been stolen by aliens and it's up to you to get it back! 

Soccer Kid is an innovative 2D platformer that challenges you to navigate the world using only your soccer skills. Instead of just running and jumping, you'll need to dribble, header, and kick your way through enemies and obstacles across the globe.

This QUByte Classics edition brings the ultimate nostalgic package to your Nintendo Switch™.

70010000121296.name: Biomechanical Toy (QUByte Classics)
70010000121296.intro: Classic run-and-gun action in an explosive arcade adventure!
70010000121296.description:
Take control of the tough hero Inguz and get ready to run, jump, and shoot your way through a kingdom of crazy and hostile toys. With vibrant and detailed pixel art, you’ll face off against the army of the villain Scrubby using upgradeable weapons and devastating bombs.

Highlights:
Portable Action: Perfect for quick matches or intense marathons.
Precision Mechanics: Jump between platforms, dodge traps, and use the environment to your advantage.
Support Tools: Use Rewind to go back in time after a mistake and Save State to never lose your progress.
Extra Content: Explore the gallery of original artwork and listen to the classic soundtrack on the Jukebox.

70010000121308.name: SCP Extraction Protocol
70010000121308.intro: Industrial horror about isolation, obedience, and the sound coming from below.
70010000121308.description:
SCP Extraction Protocol is a slow-burn industrial horror about routine, isolation, and something that refuses to be catalogued.

You have been assigned to maintain a classified extraction site. Your only responsibility: operate the crane, retrieve the containers emerging from the abyss, and process them according to protocol.

The object appears to be a vertical shaft of unknown depth. It signals when a new batch is ready, and you respond.

Under a vast, indifferent star-filled sky, you work alone — steel cables creaking, the crane whining against the cold, warning lights flickering at the edge of visibility. Each container must be lifted from the darkness, purified from residual radiation, logged, and prepared for transfer. Follow the procedure. Stay efficient. Don't deviate.

The pit does not speak, and it does not need to. It only signals, and something in the interval between signals has learned to move.

Crane operation. Radiation processing. Protocol compliance. Something else.

You were sent to manage the abyss.
The abyss has been active for longer than your assignment suggests.

70010000121316.name: Dirt Racing Bundle Off Road & Truck
70010000121316.intro: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000121316.description:
This pack includes the games: Speed Truck and Rock ´N Racing Off Road DX.

Rock 'N Racing Off Road

Get ready to enjoy Off Road races with your friends and family!

Rock'N Racing Off Road offers the most entertaining and exciting races, with loads of skids, crashes and amazing jumps. You will have several modes of play, such as Cup mode, time trial and multi-player with the option of up to 4 Players at a time.

Speed Truck Racing

In Speed Truck Racing, you will enjoy the fastest, most spectacular races at over 200 Km/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 20 rivals.
There are several modes available, including Championship, Arcade and 4-player multiplayer.

There is also an online leader board where you can compare your best times with those of your friends and players from around the world.

Features:

-Arcade driving.
-4-Player multiplayer.
-Online ranking.
-Rock music.

70010000121323.name: Subway Simulator - Underground Train REMASTER
70010000121323.intro: The city depends on your perfect timing.
70010000121323.description:
Step into the underground world of rail transport, now more immersive than ever. With upgraded environments, redesigned stations, and enhanced routes, the experience of driving a subway train feels smoother, richer, and more realistic.

Take the controls of a passenger train and experience what it’s like to be a real subway driver. Explore updated metro lines, pass through improved stations, and enjoy a more detailed and dynamic underground network designed for deeper immersion.

Start your journey by choosing your favorite train and learning how to master its controls. Progress through different levels, improve your driving skills, and discover how engaging railway simulation can be when every route brings a new challenge.

Key Features:
	•	Drive trains across 4 different cities with upgraded environments
	•	Choose from 5 unique trains, each with its own style and feel
	•	Progress through levels and improve your driving abilities
	•	Explore redesigned subway routes and enhanced stations


Enjoy a modern subway simulator that combines realistic train driving with upgraded locations, varied routes, and engaging progression — a deeper underground experience with every journey.

70010000121339.name: Which Era Is This? Japanese History Era Guess Quiz
70010000121339.intro: Which Era? Master Japanese History in Quick Quizzes
70010000121339.description:
Ever see a term or event and think, “Wait… which era was that?”
This fast-paced Japanese history quiz game helps you build a clear timeline sense by choosing the correct era for each question.

From Jōmon and Yayoi to Nara, Heian, Kamakura, Muromachi, Sengoku, Edo, Meiji—and beyond—your scattered knowledge starts connecting into one coherent story.

Short, multiple-choice rounds make it easy to play anytime. The more you repeat, the faster your judgment becomes—and the more history “clicks.”

Simple 4-choice quizzes

Quick sessions, easy to keep going

Great for learning and review

70010000121345.name: Truck Simulator Driver 2026
70010000121345.description:
Hit the road and build your path as a professional truck driver in a world driven by delivery, precision, and control. Truck Simulator Driver 2026 puts you behind the wheel of powerful trucks, where every journey is a new challenge and every delivery depends on your skills.

Take on a wide range of transport missions, from standard cargo to heavy and oversized loads that require careful handling. Plan your routes, stay focused on the road, and make sure every delivery reaches its destination safely and on time.

Explore diverse environments with long highways, narrow roads, and demanding routes that push your control and decision-making. Each trip requires attention and the ability to adapt your driving style depending on the cargo and conditions.

Customize your trucks to match your preferences. Improve performance, upgrade parts, and prepare your vehicle for more complex deliveries as you progress.
Manage essential elements like fuel and timing. Plan your stops, stay efficient, and keep your deliveries on track without delays.


Key Features:
- Realistic truck driving experience
- Delivery missions with different cargo types
- Vehicle customization and upgrades
- Resource management during long routes
- Diverse roads and driving conditions
- Progressive gameplay with increasing challenges

Drive further. Deliver better. Stay in control.

70010000121361.name: Guts 'n Grunts
70010000121361.intro: Guts 'n Grunts is an action game with lots of shooting, swimming, and rolling. Find power-ups. Earn upgrades. Fight for pig freedom!
70010000121361.description:
Inspired by games like Contra and Turrican, Guts 'n Grunts is a mid-paced action game with lots of shooting, swimming, and rolling. Find power-ups. Earn upgrades. Fight for pig freedom!

APR 07, 2060. It has been 40 years since the Technate has taken control of the world. In their arrogance and gluttony, they created a breed of intelligent pig. These pigs were trained from birth to self slaughter when they reach mature age. For a time, the Technocrats enjoyed their meat.

Then, a special boar was born -- one hellbent on destroying the Technate and putting the pigs at their rightful place atop the tower. His name was Rudy Hammon.

Rudy must destroy the Technocratic infrastructure in his mission to dethrone Klaus Küller, the highest of the Technocrats. Along the way, he will face mutants, giant robots, and pork-crazed scientists who can't stop eating.

70010000121377.name: Monster Rush Survivors
70010000121377.intro:
Face relentless waves of monsters, unlock upgrades,
and build the perfect setup to survive the chaos.
70010000121377.description:
Face relentless waves of monsters in a battle for survival.

In Monster Rush Survivors, every run is a race against chaos. Defeat enemies, endure for as long as you can, and strengthen your strategy with character, weapon, item, and skill upgrades.

Choose how to evolve your build during each run and adapt your playstyle to face increasingly dangerous threats.

70010000121383.name: Catto's Post Office
70010000121383.intro: Deliver mail as Catto, the town's dedicated Postcat, while meeting unique friends in a vibrant cozy town filled with kitty residents.
70010000121383.description: Deliver mail as Catto, the town's dedicated Postcat, while meeting unique friends in a vibrant cozy town filled with kitty residents. As you explore the colorful town, encounter adorable residents and brighten up their day by helping them with silly little tasks.

70010000121390.name: Wonders Puzzle
70010000121390.description:
Slide puzzle pieces across the board, connect them together, and watch charming images come to life — one satisfying move at a time. Easy to pick up, surprisingly hard to put down.

150 levels take you from breezy warm-ups to genuinely tricky configurations that demand sharp thinking and sharper planning. Every chapter on the illustrated world map introduces fresh mechanics — locked tiles, chain reactions, gravity shifts, color locks, and more — so the challenge always evolves and the game never grows stale.

Dozens of cute, beautifully crafted images are waiting to be uncovered: cozy scenes, playful animals, fantastical worlds. Complete a level, reveal the picture, add it to your gallery, move on to the next challenge.

Earn coins as you progress and spend them on power-ups — hints, shuffles, and targeted blasts — or unlock special features that open up new ways to play. Smart spending keeps you moving through the toughest levels and rewards players who explore everything the game has to offer.

Wonders Puzzle is a puzzle game with real depth, real charm, and 150 reasons to keep sliding.

70010000121396.name: Neon Warfare: CyberArena
70010000121396.intro:
The city of the future shows no mercy to the weak.
Only those who shoot faster and strike harder survive.
70010000121396.description:
Step into a dark world of neon, steel, and endless conflict, where every firefight pushes you to the limit.
Fast-paced action, intense combat, and a constant sense of danger turn every mission into a fight for dominance.

70010000121402.name: I Am Dog - Chaos Simulator
70010000121402.intro: Play as a dog and experience the adventure in first-person view!
70010000121402.description:
Immerse yourself in dynamic gameplay dog simulator, where you explore the world as a dog, collect coins and unlock new breeds. From fast Harts to small Dog - each breed has a unique speed and height, which changes the way you play!

 Take on the challenges!

Take on missions such as disturbing your owners or searching for treasures. Collect coins to unlock breeds in the store and become the best dog!

Game features:

Unique dog breeds - each with a different speed and height.
Missions: brawl, treasure collecting and more!

70010000121404.name: Samurai Obby
70010000121404.intro: Do you have the discipline to conquer the Samurai Trial?
70010000121404.description:
Take on one long, continuous obby set in a Japanese samurai world, filled with deadly platforms, precise jumps, and skill-based obstacles. Littered with checkpoints to keep you progressing — pure parkour as you make your way along the warrior’s path.

Features:

One long samurai-themed obby
Skill-based parkour gameplay
Tricky jumps and challenging obstacles
Japanese-inspired environments and visuals
Checkpoints throughout the course
Designed for players who enjoy classic obbies

70010000121413.name: TwoOrThree
70010000121413.intro: Let's play with multiples of 2 and 3 with Shuri!
70010000121413.description:
If it's a multiple of 2 or 3,
it's okay!

If it's not a multiple of 2 or 3,
Oh my god!

Count to 100
Game cleared
Let's get started!

70010000121418.name: Seven Deadly Sins: Anime Girls Fantasy Love
70010000121418.intro:
Seven sins. Seven girls. One world that was never meant to be yours.
Can you make them fall for you anyway?
70010000121418.description:
In a realm where desire rules and emotions run unchecked, seven girls wait, each one the living embodiment of a sin. 

Lust. Pride. Wrath. Envy. Gluttony. Sloth. Greed. 

They are not ordinary. They are extremes, beautiful, dangerous, and completely consumed by what defines them.

You explore their world through dialogue and choices, navigating personalities that could pull you in or push you away. Every word matters. Every decision opens a new path, or closes one forever.

Some will seduce you. Some will freeze you out. Some will explode on you the moment you get too close. 

Getting through to any of them is a challenge, and that is exactly the point.

Their world is divided into seven territories, each built around its sin. Dark throne rooms, indulgent gardens, shadowy corners where secrets never sleep. The further you go, the deeper it gets.


Features:

● SEVEN ICONIC CHARACTERS: Seven girls, seven sins, seven completely different ways to make your heart race. None of them easy. All of them unforgettable.

● DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: Every response you give shapes the relationship. Push too hard, you lose ground. Play it right, and walls start to crumble.

● CHARACTER AFFINITY SYSTEM: Build connection with each girl through progressive dates and intimate scenes. The harder they are to reach, the more rewarding the unlock.

● EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Unlock stunning illustrations as your bond deepens. Each character has her own visual story to reveal.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your path through the seven sins is yours alone. Some routes lead to romance. Others lead somewhere darker.

● 30 DAYS TO CONQUER THEM: The clock is running. Every day you waste is a route that closes, a sin that wins. You do not have forever.


Seven worlds. Seven personalities. None of them easy.
Which sin will you conquer first?

70010000121424.name: Future Knight
70010000121424.intro: Frantic action and LCD aesthetics! Alternate between a robot hero and his benign tumor to stop a bizarre cult in this 2D Shoot 'Em Up.
70010000121424.description:
Experience the ultimate LCD action on Nintendo Switch™!

Future Knight is a 2D action Shoot 'Em Up that fuses the nostalgia of LCD screens with the brutality of modern combat. Imagine your old handheld console coming to life, but with a bizarre story, frantic combat, and a unique visual aesthetic inspired by classic electronic handheld games.

8 HOURS TO THE END OF THE WORLD
It is May 23, 1993. The Lady of the Past, leader of the pyramid cult "Present", has just washed her underwear and, in the process, erased the brains of all humanity. Only you, a robot built over 30 years from the remains of a 90s soap opera actor, can stop her. But you are not alone. You have Two More, a benign tumor, inexplicably powerful and with a life of its own that lives inside you. 

Your mission is to travel to the past, exactly 8 hours before the apocalypse. Each level (Biome) represents an hour in this lady's schedule before she erases our memories. You will have to sabotage her day: from her walk in the park to her meal at an all-you-can-eat buffet... The clock is ticking, Future Knight. Can you save the future before it becomes the past?

THE DEADLY DANCE: SWITCH AND DESTROY
The key to Future Knight is Synergy. "Alone you go fast, together you go further".
- Future Knight (The Muscle): Fire your quantum plasma Techno Blaster, deliver lethal bites, roll to dodge, and unleash chaos with heavy weaponry.
- Two More (The Agility): Expel your partner! Use him to perform lethal Super Dashes, climb walls with his natural viscosity, shoot at close range, and squeeze into tight spaces.
- Choreography of Violence: Switch between both characters instantly. Recover Future Knight's health using Two More and recharge Two More's energy using Future Knight. Create a deadly dance to annihilate your enemies with style.

BIZARRE "NEO-RETRO" AESTHETIC
The game takes place inside the technology of a calculator and a liquid crystal display. We have created an unsettling aesthetic that mixes the adorable with the grotesque, inspired by the works of Satoshi Kon and Japanese bizarrism. All you see are ink stains moving... but we assure you you have never seen ink move like this.

KEY FEATURES
- A Race Against Time: 8 hours, 8 biomes, one single destiny. Overcome levels that alternate between horizontal scroll, vertical scroll, and crazy physics. 
- Combat Synergy and "Builds": Shooting is not enough; you have to dance. Instantly switch between the brute force of Future Knight and the viscous agility of Two More to create lethal choreographies. 
- "Liquid Crystal" Pixel-Art: A unique art direction where LCD nostalgia comes to life. Fluid, hand-drawn animations that look like ink stains, fusing the adorable with the grotesque.
- Bizarre and Unfiltered Narrative: Face pyramid cults and surreal situations in a plot full of dark humor and social satire.
- Unforgettable Bosses: Test your reflexes against epic, challenging bosses born from an insane mind.

70010000121430.name: Seven Deadly Sins: Anime Boys Fantasy Love
70010000121430.intro:
Seven sins. Seven boys. None of them willing to make it easy.
Are you ready to earn their trust?
70010000121430.description:
A fantasy realm ruled by emotion and excess, where seven boys each carry the weight of a sin. 
Lust. Pride. Wrath. Envy. Gluttony. Sloth. Greed. 

They are extremes of what desire and obsession can look like, beautiful, intense, and entirely consumed by what they are.

Through dialogue and choices, you step into their world and try to reach them. 

One is provocative and always in control. One is cold, elegant, and almost impossible to impress. One burns with anger and keeps everyone at arm's length. Another watches your every move with quiet, desperate jealousy.

Each one is a different challenge. Each one is a different kind of fantasy.

Seven territories divide their world, shaped by the sin that rules them. Lavish palaces, pleasure-soaked gardens, dim and restless corridors where nothing is what it seems. The deeper you go, the harder it is to leave.


Features:

● SEVEN UNFORGETTABLE CHARACTERS: Seven boys, seven sins, seven completely different ways to get under your skin. None of them easy. All of them worth it.

● DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: Every response shifts the dynamic. Say the wrong thing and you lose ground. Get it right and something real starts to open up.

● CHARACTER AFFINITY SYSTEM: Progressive dates and intimate scenes unlock as your bond grows. The harder the conquest, the more meaningful the connection.

● EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Beautiful illustrations unlock as relationships deepen. Each boy has his own story hidden inside.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your choices lead somewhere unique with each character. Not every path ends in love, but all of them are worth playing.

● 30 DAYS TO CONQUER THEM: The clock is running. Every day you waste is a route that closes, a sin that wins. You do not have forever.


Seven sins. Seven chances at something unexpected.
Which one will you get through to?

70010000121448.name: Tippy Putts
70010000121448.intro: Tilt the course sink the putt
70010000121448.description:
Guide a rolling ball across floating courses high above the clouds in this relaxing yet skillful challenge. By tilting the floor, you control the direction of the ball as it rolls across compact platformed holes designed to fit right on your screen. Carefully navigate corners, gaps, and hazards to reach the flag-marked hole while aiming to beat PAR and earn all three stars.

Precision matters. One wrong tilt can send the ball off the edge or straight into spikes, forcing you to try again. With unlimited attempts you can keep experimenting, but using too many balls will cost you those perfect star ratings.

Some courses add extra twists with jumps, springboards, and elevated platforms that launch the ball over gaps or up to higher paths. Each level becomes a small puzzle of balance, timing, and control.

There are 30 floating courses to conquer, and coins scattered across them reward careful play. Collect enough to unlock new skins and customize the look of your ball as you roll toward victory.

70010000121461.name: Dragon Snack: From Ice to Ember
70010000121461.description:
Get ready for an adorably epic adventure in Dragon Snack: From Ice to Ember. Here, a hungry and lovable dragon needs your help to find the safe path back to its nest. It sounds simple, but every trail matters.

On a charming hexagonal grid, you will rotate, swap and fit tiles to build the perfect route. Along the way, shiny coins, power stones and breakable obstacles make each stage even more fun and strategic.

Explore 30 carefully crafted levels across 3 unique biomes, where ice and fire meet in short, clever and super relaxing puzzles. With no time limits and no pressure, you can think calmly, test solutions and enjoy each victory at your own pace.

With delightful visuals, a cozy atmosphere and just the right level of challenge, Dragon Snack: From Ice to Ember is perfect for players who love cute puzzles that warm both the brain and the heart.

Plan the route, collect everything along the way and guide the little dragon safely to its nest.

70010000121467.name: Empire Hike
70010000121467.description:
Wander through marble streets, towering amphitheaters, and bustling forums as you explore a sunlit city of stone and history. Every district hides landmarks waiting to be found!

Empire Hike is all about exploration, atmosphere, and discovery — rewarding curiosity and careful observation.

Features:
>Vast Rome-inspired imperial city
>Iconic landmarks and hidden locations to find
>Calm, immersive walking simulator gameplay
>Scenic viewpoints and secret spots

70010000121480.name: Make it! Gyoza
70010000121480.intro:
Get ready for a delicious gyoza-making challenge!
Make lots of gyoza and watch your food cart prosper!
70010000121480.description:
Let's make gyoza on the Nintendo Switch™!
Serve up plenty of gyoza for your customers, and don't let them burn!
With a Joy-Con™ per player, up to 4 players can join in!
Aim for a new high score!

《Rules》
Cook gyoza and fill customer orders!
Make as many gyoza as you can within the time limit!

《How to Play》
1. Make the filling, wrap it up, then start cooking!

2. Place a lid on the cooker to start cooking the gyoza!

3. Add starch slurry while cooking to make the bottoms nice and crispy!

4. When they're ready, serve the gyoza to your customers! Match the orders exactly to earn more points!

[Score Attack]
Make lots of gyoza and aim for a high spot on the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Compete against others and test your gyoza-making skills!

70010000121531.name: Lily Fantasia
70010000121531.intro: Follow the rhythm. Rewrite your fate.
70010000121531.description:
When the music begins, fate begins to tremble.

Step into the role of Hiano Kenji, a pianist on a journey to save his gravely ill mother.
The moment you meet Lily, a mysterious vampire girl, your fate is quietly rewritten.

In a world where rhythm and combat intertwine, music becomes your weapon.
Parry attacks, strike back to the beat, and turn every breathtaking duel into a spectacular musical performance.

Featuring multiple original tracks, various difficulty levels, and global leaderboards,
find your rhythm—and your answer—within the music.

70010000121554.name: Fruit Mountain Party – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000121554.intro: The long-awaited new entry in the hit 3D puzzle game “Fruit Mountain” — where you merge fruits to make them bigger — is coming to Nintendo Switch™ 2!
70010000121554.description:
The mega-hit 3D puzzle game “Fruit Mountain” — where you merge fruits to make them bigger — is now a party battle game for everyone!
This time, it’s a fruit battle!? Jump into versus mode with up to 4 players!
With items and wild surprises, it’s a chaotic battle full of laughs!
Keep stacking those fruits!

[Easy to Play!]
Just toss fruits onto the plate and stack them up.
Merge two of the same fruit to create a bigger one!
The bigger the fruit you make, the higher your score climbs!
Be careful not to let fruits fall off the plate — merge them skillfully!
Master your stacking technique and take on your rivals!

[Battle Together!]
・Compete against rivals worldwide online!
Create a Room and invite friends to battle anytime, anywhere!
・Local versus play offline too!
Up to 4 players can play locally on a single Nintendo Switch 2! Get everyone together for some fun!

[Tons of Game Modes!]
Multiple versus modes! Try different styles and have a blast!
・Standard Race
・Thief Frenzy
・Fruit of the Sun
・Great Harvest
・Survival

[Single Player Too!]
Hone your skills against NPCs and prepare for online battles!
In “Time Attack” mode, race to complete a watermelon as fast as you can!
Aim for the fastest time! Climb the rankings!

[Collection]
Customize your plate with the dress-up feature! Show off your style with your favorite plate!

70010000121565.name: Therian Crush: Wild Animal Girls
70010000121565.intro:
They're wild, and they know it. 
Answer their questions, survive their challenges, and unlock something worth the wait.
70010000121565.description:
Half girl, half wild animal, and completely out of your league. The Therian girls are untamed, unpredictable, and they've got their eyes on you. Keep up with their pace or get left behind.

Answer their questions in fast Q&A rounds while defending against reflex attacks in minigame battles. 

Every right answer, every level cleared, brings you closer to unlocking exclusive images in their private gallery.

Each girl has her own personality, her own instincts, and her own way of testing you before she lets you in.

Do you have what it takes to earn the trust of a wild heart?


Features:

● MECHANICS THAT PUT YOU TO THE TEST: Q&A and reflex-based minigames trade off without warning. Answer smart, react fast, and keep moving.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Clear levels to unlock new images in each girl's personal gallery. The more you progress, the more they reveal.

● WILD PERSONALITIES: Each Therian girl reacts to your performance in her own way, cheering you on, teasing you, or putting you to the test mid-game.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your choices shape the outcome. Some girls open up. Others stay wild. What you unlock depends on how far you get.

● HIDDEN SPECIAL MOMENT: Reach question 150 and discover a moment you won't see coming. Worth every run.


These girls don't fall for just anyone. Play smart, hold your ground, and maybe one of them will let you close enough to find out what's really underneath. 

They're waiting. The question is whether you're ready.

70010000121571.name: Therian Crush: Wild Animal Boys
70010000121571.intro:
These guys are wild by nature. 
Get close, earn their trust, and unlock what they don't show just anyone.
70010000121571.description:
The Therian boys are untamed, magnetic, and not easy to read. They move on instinct, and the only way to get close is to prove you can keep up with them.

Take on Q&A rounds and hold your own in reflex minigame battles. Clear each challenge to unlock exclusive images in their gallery, one wild boy at a time.

Each guy has his own energy, his own edge, and his own way of warming up to someone he actually likes.

Which one is going to get under your skin first?


Features:

● MECHANICS THAT PUT YOU TO THE TEST: Q&A and reflex-based minigames trade off without warning. Answer smart, react fast, and keep moving.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Progress through each boy's arc to unlock exclusive gallery images saved just for you.

● DISTINCT PERSONALITIES: Every Therian boy reacts differently during gameplay, from encouraging to competitive to surprisingly tender when you least expect it.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: How things end depends on how far you go. Some connections take time. Some surprises come early. Keep playing to find out.

● HIDDEN SPECIAL MOMENT: Hit question 150 and something different happens. You'll want to get there.


These boys don't open up for everyone. But for the right person, who puts in the effort and stays in the game, something real is waiting at the other end. 

Start playing and find out if that someone is you.

70010000121583.name: Cozy Home Unpacking
70010000121583.intro: Make Every Room Feel Like Home.
70010000121583.description:
Transform empty rooms into warm, cozy spaces in Cozy Home Unpacking - a relaxing organization and decoration simulator where every box hides a new story. Unpack furniture, place decorations, organize everyday items, and slowly turn simple apartments into beautiful homes filled with comfort and personality.

Take your time as you decorate bedrooms, kitchens, living rooms, and tiny cozy corners exactly the way you want. Arrange books, plants, posters, kitchenware, toys, and dozens of charming objects while enjoying a calm atmosphere and satisfying gameplay.

With soft visuals, relaxing vibes, and stress-free gameplay, Cozy Home Unpacking is the perfect experience for players who love decorating, organizing, and creating peaceful spaces.

70010000121589.name: Paperly
70010000121589.intro: Take Flight in a Beautiful World of Paper
70010000121589.description:
You aren't just piloting a plane, you are the plane. Immerse yourself in a relaxing yet challenging adventure where the world is crafted entirely from paper and physics rule the skies. Forget powerful thrusters; here, gravity is your engine. You must learn to read the wind, diving down to build momentum and pulling up to soar over obstacles in a seamless dance of speed and altitude.

Travel through a variety of atmospheric chapters, ranging from scorching Dry Deserts and lush Tropical Forests to freezing Arctic Ice Caves, each offering new challenges and beautiful vistas. Enjoy a meditative solo journey to collect "Quantum" and unlock 11 distinct paper airplanes.

Key Features:
★ Physics-Based Flight: Master a unique control scheme where diving gains speed and climbing consumes momentum.
★ Stunning Environments: Explore a diverse world with distinct biomes, including deserts, forests, and ice caves.
★ Unlockable Fleet: Collect resources to unlock and pilot 11 different paper airplanes, from simple gliders to complex designs.
★ Atmospheric Audio: Immerse yourself with soothing wind effects and a relaxing soundtrack designed for "flow state" gameplay.

70010000121595.name: Woodo
70010000121595.intro: Woodo feels like a 3D coloring book you can touch, a relaxing tale told through handcrafted wooden dioramas.
70010000121595.description:
Woodo is a cozy diorama puzzle game where you assemble wooden scenes piece by piece. As you place objects in their correct spots, each scene slowly fills with color and comes to life, revealing charming animations and small surprises. Follow the story of Foxy and Ben the frog through a series of interconnected dioramas, each capturing a unique moment from their shared adventure.

Tactile Satisfaction
Feel like you’re assembling a real toy, with each piece clicking into place with a satisfying, tactile sensation, as if it’s right in your hands.
Assembling objects isn’t linear—you have to turn and explore the 3D space to reveal hidden pieces. Watch as each piece transforms the world around you, with playful animations that react to your placements, bringing the diorama to life.

A Warm Companion
With a friendly narrator's voice, immerse yourself in a world when time was plentiful and much of it was spent outdoors, when the simplest things surprised and when every day promised great adventure. Feelings that were more present in childhood and are often missed or even forgotten with time passing.

Feed Your Inner Child
The game features funny and charming characters that create an atmosphere of carefree joy and humor, reminding you that happiness is what your inner child needs.

-Assemble beautiful dioramas piece by piece with a unique puzzle mechanic
-The game adapts to your pace, providing assistance when you need it
-Gameplay changes to adapt the narration
-Simple but deeply meaningful story
-The comforting voice of the narrator keeps you company
-Get carried away by nostalgic feelings of when things were simple
-Plenty of funny characters and silly animations make you smile

70010000121601.name: Sunrock Lake
70010000121601.description:
Stroll through charming streets, blooming gardens, and hidden corners as you uncover everything the village has to offer. Every path invites discovery, and every detail tells a story of life, leisure, and sunlight.

Sunrock Lake focuses on peaceful exploration — no rush, no pressure — just wandering and finding the village’s secrets.

Features:

>Bright, sunny village environments

>Search-and-find exploration gameplay

>Hidden spots to discover

>Relaxing, atmospheric world

70010000121608.name: EGGCONSOLE Hydefos MSX2
70010000121608.intro: Experience lightning-fast action and fluid scrolling. Deploy "Hyde" units to annihilate the Metal Creature and save Planet Tiar. The classic side-scrolling shmup returns!
70010000121608.description:
Originally released by Hertz in 1989, this is a classic side-scrolling shoot 'em up that defined high-speed action.

In addition to staple power-ups and speed boosts, the game features the unique "Hyde Control" system—versatile support units that assist your ship in battle. At supply bases located throughout each area, you can switch between different ships with varying performance stats or reconfigure your Hyde Control settings to adapt to the challenge ahead.

One of the game's greatest draws is its high replayability; stages branch and change dynamically based on your actions. Combined with scrolling technology that was incredibly sophisticated for its time, you can enjoy smooth, exhilarating, and lightning-fast gameplay.

Defeat the Metal Creatures occupying each area to progress. The fate of Planet Tiar is in your hands—save it before it’s too late!
 
 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.
 *Flashing lights or patterns may cause dizziness, spasms, or loss of consciousness. If you feel unwell, stop playing immediately and see a doctor.
   If you have a history of these symptoms, consult a physician before use.

70010000121621.name: Staffer Retro: A Supernatural Mystery Quest
70010000121621.description:
A world where supernatural abilities exist. Plus, tools with mysterious powers, 'Staff.'

For Verita, an ordinary girl who resides in a second-hand store, Shop Retro, these things sound like stories from a far-off world.
That is, until she's suddenly buried under a considerable debt.

In order to sell staff and pay off her debt,
delve into how these supernatural powers have shaped the past!

[Choose your actions]
Use conversation or exploration to gather information and new documents, then reach your own conclusion as you reason through what you've found.
The results of your own choices and logic can lead you toward a different ending.

[Use logic to combine documents]
Make use of the document-centric system that has defined the Staffer series! Combine information about these supernatural happenings recorded on all sorts of documents in order to discover a brand-new truth.

[Re:Story]
Sort through six types of documents in order to find the clues to the story playing out. Once you fill them all out, the truth hidden within might just make itself known.

[Retro System]
Behind the seemingly peaceful daily routine, a vicious truth lies in wait... At the end of each mystery, a 'hidden aspect' exists to be uncovered. Turn the conclusion on its head in order to discover a new ending.

70010000121635.name: EGGCONSOLE Meurtre d'un Clown PC-8801
70010000121635.intro:
Uncover the truth behind the clown murders in Brighton, England!
A serious adventure game tailored for adults is here.
70010000121635.description:
Released in 1985, this adventure game puts you in the shoes of a detective dispatched from Scotland Yard to solve a murder case. The game uses a command-entry system, primarily utilizing "noun + verb" inputs, and supports both Kana and English.

As the company's second mystery adventure title, it follows its predecessor in receiving high acclaim for its writing. The ever-shifting scenario and its dramatic twists are absolute must-sees. The way the foreshadowing throughout the game leads to such unexpected connections is a narrative journey you won't want to miss.

For players seeking a mature adventure game experience, this title is a perfect fit.
 
 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.

70010000121639.name: Dice Goblins Clicker: Idle Dice & Incremental
70010000121639.intro: Upgrade, automate, and embrace chaos as numbers grow, luck bends, and dice never stop rolling. An idle clicker where goblins roll dice nonstop.
70010000121639.description:
Welcome to Dice Goblins Clicker, an idle clicker game about goblins, dice, and extremely irresponsible use of probability.

Roll Dice
Dice make numbers. Big numbers make goblins happy.

Automate Chaos
Hire more goblins, unlock better dice, and stack absurd upgrades that turn “a little luck” into a full blown statistical crime. As your goblin horde grows, rolls become faster, multipliers get sillier, and the dice keep rolling even when you’re not looking.

Upgrade Everything
Discover chaotic modifiers, strange synergies, and questionable goblin inventions that bend luck, logic, and common sense. Optimize your setup or just stare at the numbers going up, goblins don’t judge.

Break numbers
Whether you play for five minutes or leave it running all day, it's about one thing only Roll dice, get bigger numbers, summon more goblins, break stuff and repeat!


Features
6 different dice types
3 unique goblin types
25 achievements for true perfectionists
Prestige system for endless progression
Up to 12 upgrade modifiers

70010000121651.name: Our Metal Bowl
70010000121651.intro: Explore a broken world. Fight with a silent machine. Solve puzzles that break the rules.
70010000121651.description:
Explore a vast network of abandoned industrial structures alongside your loyal robotic companion XIU. Your goal: extract life-giving nutrients to revitalize a decaying world and restore life to ancient, forgotten greenhouses.

Face intense, high-speed combat in narrow corridors. Use quick reflexes to survive, but remember: you can't just blast through every situation. Study enemy movements and master their patterns: every encounter is a tactical challenge to overcome.

Solve complex puzzles that defy conventional logic and shatter the fourth wall, forcing you to seek solutions beyond the screen and question the very nature of your reality.

The world is designed as a massive, interconnected labyrinth, rich with shortcuts and hidden secrets. As you acquire new abilities, you will gain access to previously unreachable sectors, encouraging you to backtrack and uncover hidden lore, rare resources, and the secrets of a world in ruin.

- Non-Linear Exploration: Navigate an interconnected map with hidden paths
- Fast-Paced Combat: Tactical encounters in confined spaces
- Meta Puzzles: Challenges that break the fourth wall
- RPG Progression: Unlock upgrades for you and your companion
Secrets and Collectibles: Find hidden passages in every corner

70010000121657.name: Tokyo Yakuza Idols: Save the Heart of a Rebel Girl
70010000121657.intro:
She performs under spotlights. She rules in the shadows.
And somehow, she chose to let you in.
Can you handle both sides of her?
70010000121657.description:
Tokyo never sleeps, and neither does she.

On stage, she's everything the crowd wants: radiant, untouchable, a star built from lights and choreography.
Off stage, she moves through a different world entirely, one with its own rules, its own silence, and its own kind of danger.

Tokyo Yakuza Idols: Save the Heart of a Rebel Girl is a narrative visual novel where romance and risk share the same heartbeat.
You didn't go looking for her.
But now that she's let you close, walking away isn't really an option anymore.

Each girl carries a story split between two lives: the performer the world sees and the woman hidden underneath the glamour and the shadows.

Ambition, loyalty, pain, rebellion. Every route pulls you deeper into who she really is.

Your choices determine whether she stays trapped between her worlds...
or finally finds someone worth choosing over all of it.


Features:

● DUAL LIVES, ONE HEART: Each character lives between the idol spotlight and the yakuza underworld, and both sides of her matter.

● IMPACTFUL CHOICES: Your decisions shape how far she trusts you, and how the story ends.

● EXCLUSIVE SCENES: Unlock intimate moments that reveal the truth behind the performance and the danger.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Escape together, get pulled into her world, lose her to it, or change everything.

● WIN HER HEART IN 30 DAYS: You have one month to earn her heart. Every decision counts, every moment matters, and time waits for no one.


She built walls to survive.
Are you capable of conquering her heart?

70010000121663.name: Tokyo Yakuza Idols: Save the Heart of a Rebel Boy
70010000121663.intro:
He shines on stage and disappears into the night.
No one gets close. No one lasts.
Until you.
70010000121663.description:
The city knows his name. It doesn't know him at all.

Under the lights he's flawless, magnetic, exactly what the industry built him to be.

But the version of him that exists after midnight, in the back rooms and rain-slicked streets of Tokyo, belongs to a world most people never see.

Tokyo Yakuza Idols: Save the Heart of a Rebel Boy is a narrative visual novel about finding someone real inside a life built on performance and silence.

You weren't supposed to matter to him.

But something shifted, and now he keeps finding reasons to come back.

Each character carries the weight of a double life: the idol the world worships and the person underneath, complicated, guarded, and quietly hoping someone will stay long enough to understand.

Loyalty, ambition, loss, rebellion. Every route goes somewhere different and somewhere deeper.

Your choices decide whether he stays locked inside the life he was given... or finally takes the risk of letting someone in.


Features:

● DUAL LIVES, ONE HEART: Each character lives between the idol stage and the yakuza underworld, and both sides of him are real.

● IMPACTFUL CHOICES: Build trust, push boundaries, and shape how his story ends.

● EXCLUSIVE SCENES: Unlock hidden moments that go beyond the performance and into who he actually is.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Stay together, get drawn into his world, lose him to it, or rewrite everything.

● WIN HIS HEART IN 30 DAYS: You have one month to earn his heart. Every decision counts, every moment matters, and time waits for no one.


He learned to survive by staying out of reach.
Are you capable of conquering his heart?

70010000121669.name: One Move Away
70010000121669.intro: A deeply satisfying puzzle game about moving.
70010000121669.description:
One Move Away is a 3D, first-person game that blends packing based puzzles with a beautiful art style. Strategically pack away possessions at various stages of three characters' lives.

As we go through life, the number of possessions we accumulate grows, making packing a difficult task. This vast collection of belongings becomes challenging when it's time to pack.

Pack Your Way!

Whether you're a meticulous or chaotic packer, One Move Away challenges you to pack your way. Optimize your strategy or embrace the mess, just make sure the boot closes! 

Handle with care or else…

Be prepared for every action to have a reaction. Expect realistic physics, just like in real life. Items placed carelessly can have a domino effect, pile them too high, and they’ll all fall down! 

Experience the ultimate satisfaction of perfectly packing numerous items, expertly placing each one into its rightful space. Revel in the sense of accomplishment that comes from seeing the packing process from start to finish.

Packing Perfection

Challenge yourself, with multiple objectives to hit that will require you to think strategically .Each level gives you a new packing challenge with different sizes, shapes, and space limits to work around. Can you beat the clock and achieve packing perfection?

70010000121686.name: Dino Evolution: Catch Dinosaurs and Raise Anime Primeval Girls
70010000121686.intro:
They ruled the Earth for millions of years.
Now one of them wants to go on a date with you.
70010000121686.description:
You came here to hunt dinosaurs.

Nobody warned you they'd be this cute once you caught them.

Battle prehistoric creatures in turn-based combat, wear them down, and capture them. Then watch as they transform into anime girls with a wild, primal side you won't see coming.

Each one carries her dino nature into her human form:

● A fierce T-Rex girl who challenges everything you say... but secretly respects strength
● A speedy Raptor girl who disappears mid-date and thinks that's totally normal
● A gentle Brachiosaurus girl who's soft-spoken but will absolutely not share her food

Your choices decide how close you get. And how far things go.


Features:

♥ CATCH & TRANSFORM: Take down dinosaurs in battle and unlock their irresistible anime forms. Who knew prehistoric life looked this good?

♥ TURN-BASED COMBAT: Strategy first, romance second. Master the fight to earn the date.

♥ DATES & VISUAL NOVEL CHOICES: Get to know each girl, build her trust, and unlock exclusive scenes and illustrations.

♥ PRIMAL PERSONALITIES: Every dino girl carries her ancient instincts into her human form. Expect the unexpected.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your results depend on your battles, your choices, and how well you read her wild side.


Sixty-five million years in the making.
Worth every second.

Are you ready to catch your perfect prehistoric match?

70010000121692.name: Dino Evolution: Catch Dinosaurs and Raise Anime Primeval Boys
70010000121692.intro:
Prehistoric. Powerful. Surprisingly dateable.
Catch them. Transform them. Fall for them.
70010000121692.description:
You came to hunt dinosaurs.

You did not expect them to be your type.

Battle ancient creatures in turn-based combat, capture them, and watch them transform into anime boys with a raw, primal energy that hits different. 

Each one carries the spirit of his dinosaur form into every conversation, every date, every moment you share.
Meet your prehistoric matches:

● A T-Rex boy who acts tough but melts when you actually listen to him
● A Velociraptor boy who's always three steps ahead and makes you work for every smile
● A Triceratops boy built like a tank, with a heart even bigger than his horns

Your choices shape the bond. Your battles unlock the story.


Features:

♥ CATCH & TRANSFORM: Defeat dinosaurs in battle and discover their stunning anime forms. Ancient power, modern charm.

♥ TURN-BASED COMBAT: Fight smart, date better. Every victory opens a new connection.

♥ DATES & VISUAL NOVEL CHOICES: Build real bonds through choices, conversations, and exclusive unlockable scenes.

♥ PRIMAL PERSONALITIES: Each boy's dino instincts shape who he is. Wild, loyal, unpredictable, and completely yours to figure out.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: How it ends depends on how you fight, how you listen, and how deep you go.


Sixty-five million years in the making.
He was worth the wait.

Ready to find your primeval match?

70010000121701.name: Nocturne for Cyl-Hestia
70010000121701.intro: Play as a memorialist and investigate a dystopian city in this 3D adventure game.
70010000121701.description:
In a city where memories fade, the truth must be reconstructed.

Welcome to Cyl-Hestia, a city-state built around Cerulyn, a mysterious blue flame with exceptional properties.
As the authorities are prepared to do anything to maintain their power, you play as Silas, a memorialist working for the independent newspaper The Voice.
Your mission: to gather fragments of memories to reconstruct the events obscured by the regime... and rekindle the flame of truth.

Investigate through memory

Explore the districts of Cyl-Hestia and collect Memory Records, short testimonies entrusted by its inhabitants. Combine them to reconstruct Remembrances and Mnemosyne Visions, revealing events buried in the collective memory.

Unmask the truth

Every discovery fuels The Voice's investigative work. With every published article, the world changes: surveillance intensifies, tensions arise and people become aware of what is happening.
Your progress has a significant narrative impact, gradually revealing the full extent of the manipulation at the heart of Cyl-Hestia.

Hack reality

You can interact with the environment via a sound hacking system.
Program punch cards to decipher encrypted records, unlock forgotten passages, or interact with ancient technological devices linked to the Flame.

A world between technology and poetry

In a world blending retro-futuristic science fiction, film noir atmosphere and mysticism, meet memorable characters, infiltrate the corridors of power, and explore the different levels of the city, from its forgotten slums to the sacred Spire tower.

70010000121716.name: Graveyard Keeper 2
70010000121716.intro: Manage your graveyard, rebuild the Town and lead undead armies into battles!
70010000121716.description:
You are the Grand Inquisitor now! Restore the town and lead your undead army into battle to save the realm from a zombie apocalypse. Welcome to Graveyard Keeper 2 - the sequel to the original, unhinged classic!

Manage. Grind. Automate!
Build and manage your own medieval graveyard. Harvest as much flora, fauna, and human remains as you can to build extraordinary machinery, automate production, and expand your graveyard for pure profit.

Save the Kingdom!
Become the Inquisitor and lead your undead army into battle to save the Kingdom from a zombie apocalypse. Build towers and fortifications, craft powerful armour and weapons, arm and train your not-so-smart troops, and slash your way to victory!

Rebuild The Town. For Profits!
Help the townsfolk restore their homes and turn their problems into revenue. Complete quests throughout the city, as your undead workers take care of the heavy lifting behind the scenes. With zombie-based automation and structured systems, you can transform local efforts into a scalable and profitable operation.

70010000121759.name: You’d Be Surprised!? Everyday English Vocabulary Fill-in-the-Blank Quiz
70010000121759.intro:
Everyday English Words You Might Not Know!
Fill-in-the-Blank Quiz Fun!
70010000121759.description:
Think you know everyday English words?
You may be surprised how tricky they can be when a letter is missing!

This casual quiz game lets you learn and review useful English vocabulary through fun fill-in-the-blank challenges.
Words from daily life, school, food, greetings, and more are included, making it easy to play while naturally building your vocabulary.

Perfect for beginners, casual learners, and anyone looking for a light brain-training experience, this game is easy to pick up anytime.
Play at your own pace and turn “I think I know it” into “I’ve got it!”

70010000121803.name: Pixel Game Maker Series P-PAN
70010000121803.intro:
With a cheerful smile and endless punches, blast your way forward!
A 2D action game that's easy for anyone to enjoy!
70010000121803.description:
P-PAN is a simple, pick-up-and-play 2D action game.
Falling off platforms? No worries, you can fly anytime you want!
Punch enemies, collect loot, and unleash special moves whenever you like.
Find your rhythm and push onward!

-STORY-
P-PAN lives peacefully on Panchu Island.
 But one day, a mysterious giant robot suddenly appears and steals everything from P-PAN's home.
With nothing left to lose, P-PAN sets out on an adventure to restore his home.

***
P-PAN's special skill is a bright smile, oh, and punches that fly endlessly.
 Whether walking or soaring through the air, fire off rapid punches and have a blast!

● Collect "P Points" from enemies to unleash two awesome Special Moves!
The P Crash and P Cannon can both wipe out tons of enemies at once - perfect for getting out of tight spots!

● Defeat bosses within the target time to earn prizes!
Open these prize boxes to build up the Collection.
 Collect them all and restore P-PAN's home!

● Colorful pixel-art maps, original music, and a variety of stages to enjoy even in short bursts!
Each stage and boss has its own unique music, with boss battles really cranking up the excitement!

Now go punch your way to 100% completion!

The "Pixel Game Maker Series" is a series of games created using the action game creation software "Pixel Game Maker MV" that can be enjoyed on the Nintendo Switch™.
