70010000121842.name: Geo Brain Boost! Japan’s 47 Prefectures Silhouette Quiz
70010000121842.intro: See Japan at a glance—47 Prefecture Silhouette Quiz!
70010000121842.description:
How many Japanese prefectures can you recognize by shape alone?
Hirameki Geo-Training! 47 Prefectures: Silhouette Quiz is a quick, satisfying geography quiz where you identify all 47 prefectures from their silhouettes.

Each question shows only an outline—no names, no hints. Spot coastlines, peninsulas, and distinctive curves, and trust your “aha!” moment.
Play one question at a time for a fast brain warm-up, perfect for short breaks. You’ll naturally build stronger map sense as you go—fun for learners and trivia fans alike.

Note: Map and silhouette depictions are simplified for gameplay purposes and may omit some islands or details. They do not represent precise geography or boundaries, nor do they express any view regarding legal status, sovereignty, or borders.

70010000121861.name: Runic Curse
70010000121861.intro: Master the magic and Uncover the Secrets of a Blighted World
70010000121861.description:
Step into the boots of Adrian, a shipwreck survivor stranded on a mysterious and hostile island. With your crew missing and danger lurking in every shadow, you must explore ancient ruins, face terrifying monstrosities, and find a way back home. Will you embrace your fate or fall to the darkness?

Forge Your Ultimate Playstyle
Survival demands more than brute strength. Combine a vast arsenal of cold weapons with mystical sigils to unleash devastating elemental attacks. Adapt your strategy on the fly, manage your stamina, and utilize perfect-timed rolls to outsmart ruthless foes and colossal bosses.

Explore, Upgrade, and Conquer
Traverse 10 vast, interconnected locations filled with hidden secrets and pathways that unlock as you grow stronger. Level up your character, allocate stats to fit your playstyle, and craft consumable items to survive the harshest encounters.

Key Features:

Tactical Combat - Dynamic battles requiring precise stamina management and reflex-driven dodging.

Deep Customization - Discover over 55 distinct spells and countless ways to fuse weaponry with magical enhancements.

Massive World - 10 sprawling environments packed with unique enemies and formidable bosses.

Craft & Upgrade - Forge consumable sigils and enhance your gear to overcome insurmountable odds.

Endless Challenge - Put your skills to the ultimate test in Boss Rush mode or take on the infinite challenge of New Game+.

Play Your Way - Fully comfortable handheld or TV play.

70010000121871.name: SPORTAL
70010000121871.intro: Bat, Strike, Kick and Smack balls into monstrous menagerie in this retro sport themed arena FPS roguelike.
70010000121871.description:
Swing baseball bats, fire hockey pucks, launch bowling balls and drive exploding golf shots straight into a parade of monsters from classic 1950s creature features.

Collect upgrades, customize your loadout, chain skill shots, and fight your way back home in this fast-paced retro action shooter set in 50’s America.

Step through a mysterious cinema portal and emerge in a bizarre monster-infested dimension where everyday sporting equipment becomes your arsenal.

Features

Weaponized sporting gear
Use baseball bats, hockey sticks, golf clubs and bowling balls to launch spiked fastballs, lightning-charged pucks and explosive drives at hordes of cinematic horrors

Retro B-movie monster mayhem
Battle a monstrous menagerie inspired by classic creature features of the 1950s

Roguelite progression
Upgrade your equipment, unlock outfits and perks, and discover powerful gear combinations that change every run

Mystery behind the portal
Uncover clues about what happened during your visit to your favourite mall cinema—and how to escape the strange world beyond the screen

Multiple themed arenas
Fight across 6 B-movie-inspired environments packed with secrets, skill shots and combo opportunities

Deep upgrade system
Dozens of weapon upgrades and modifiers let you build wildly different playstyles each run

Authentic retro presentation
Pixel-art visuals with a bold 50s sci-fi aesthetic and creature-feature atmosphere

70010000121889.name: Ocean Shark Survival - Float Home Builder Simulator
70010000121889.intro: Build, craft, and fight to stay alive every day.
70010000121889.description:
Alone in the middle of a vast, endless ocean, your only chance of survival is a small wooden raft and a simple hook. With no civilization in sight, every new day is a struggle against hunger, thirst, powerful storms, and the relentless predators that patrol the waters around you.

The sea is both your greatest resource and your greatest threat. Collect floating debris, recover valuable materials, and craft the equipment you need to stay alive. Expand your fragile raft piece by piece into a dependable floating shelter, then set out to explore distant tropical islands and the mysterious depths in search of rare resources and long-forgotten secrets.

Key Features:
• Build, repair, and upgrade your raft into a sturdy floating shelter
• Craft tools, weapons, equipment, and other survival essentials
• Gather drifting resources using your hook and make every item count
• Fish, cook food, and purify seawater to stay alive
• Explore mysterious islands and underwater locations filled with valuable resources
• Defend yourself against sharks and other dangers of the open ocean

Will you build a thriving home on the sea, or will the endless waves bring your journey to an end?
The ocean is filled with adventure, hidden treasures, and constant danger. Keep building, exploring, and surviving as long as you can in this unforgiving world.

70010000121901.name: Case Solved: The London Files
70010000121901.intro: Cozy noir puzzles. Only logic uncovers the truth.
70010000121901.description:
Case Solved: The London Files blends cozy noir storytelling with the elegant logic-driven deduction popularized by Einstein’s Riddle. 

Behind London’s fog and gaslight, every case becomes a closed puzzle: a handful of suspects, a tangle of conflicting testimonies, and a single answer that yields to logic alone. 
Each one is a carefully crafted challenge, solved through reasoning and observation, inviting players to uncover buried truths. 

Explore atmospheric crime scenes, interrogate suspicious characters, connect fragmented evidence, and solve intricate mysteries through pure logic, no guesswork required. 
With its relaxing pace, cerebral puzzle design, and richly atmospheric noir world, Case Solved: The London Files delivers a calm yet deeply satisfying experience where only sharp deduction reveals the truth.

70010000121906.name: Parking Garage Rally Circuit
70010000121906.intro: Retro Arcade Rally Racing... in Parking Garages?!? Precision driving with tight simple controls and arcade physics, all in a 90s game console style presentation
70010000121906.description:
Retro Arcade-style Rally Racing in re-purposed Parking Garages in big cities across the USA

The “Parking Garage Rally Circuit” tour comes into a city, selects a parking garage, and temporarily turns it into an exciting rally course for a week-long competition. Each track in the game is styled as a unique parking garage that has been turned into a race course.

This is a hybrid of Rally and circuit racing. From rally it draws the jumps and “one racer at a time against the clock” time-trial format. However, the tracks are similar to circuit racing, with each race consisting of multiple laps around the same track (the track may change slightly from lap to lap, however). Controls are very tight, simple and arcade-like, similar to go-karting games (accelerate, reverse, steer, drift), but with a bit more dynamic “smash into things” physics.

Connect some controllers and relive the glory days of split-screen multiplayer for 2-4 players!

70010000121938.name: Bird Game III
70010000121938.intro: The sky isn’t big enough for all of us.
70010000121938.description:
Take to the skies in Bird Game III, a whimsical world where every feathered friend is trying to build the comfiest nest and claim a little patch of sky. Pick your favorite bird, flap into adventure, and discover a realm where every cloud hides a surprise and every branch is prime real estate.

Build your nest wherever you please—tucked in the trees or perched proudly on a cliff. Lay your eggs, keep them safe, and shoo away any nosy neighbors who wander a little too close. After all, birds will be birds.

Will you zip around as a hummingbird with caffeine-level energy? Strut across rooftops as a confident city pigeon? Or glide in like an eagle who definitely thinks they own the place?

Fly. Forage. Feather your home.
The sky is big, the birds are quirky, and the only thing that might fall… is your dignity when a kiwi outruns you.

70010000121944.name: Farming TriPeaks Solitaire
70010000121944.intro: Farm-themed TriPeaks Solitaire with 100 levels, daily rewards, power-ups
70010000121944.description:
Relax and play through 100 levels of classic TriPeaks Solitaire wrapped in a cozy farm setting. Clear cards by chaining sequences up or down across three peaks, using power-ups when you're stuck and Undo whenever you need a second chance.
Collect daily rewards to earn extra power-ups and coins, and work your way through every level at your own pace — no time limits, no pressure.
Features:

- 100 levels of TriPeaks Solitaire
- Farm-themed visuals and card art
- Power-ups to help on tough levels
- Undo your last move at any time
- Daily rewards

70010000121966.name: Flight Simulator 2026
70010000121966.intro: Hit the throttle, hit the checkpoints, beat the clock.
70010000121966.description:
A dynamic flight simulator focused on time-based challenges. Choose your aircraft, customize its stats, and navigate through checkpoint systems across various maps. Cross the finish before the timer runs out!

- Checkpoint Racing. Your main goal is to reach the finish by passing through a series of checkpoints. Time is limited: plan your route and keep an eye on the timer to complete the mission before it's too late.

- Diverse Fleet. Choose from a wide range of aircraft, from steady trainers to high-speed jets. Each plane has its own unique speed, maneuverability, and weight, completely changing the feel of the flight.

- Tuning and Customization. Upgrade your aircraft's performance and change its appearance. Tune your engine and handling to master sharp turns and break speed records.

- Varied Maps. Fly across different locations, including mountains and forests. Every map offers unique tracks with different checkpoint layouts.

- Speed Trials. Complete long-distance tracks against the clock, unlock new levels, and prove you are the fastest pilot. No distractions—just you, the plane, and the stopwatch.

70010000121972.name: Ball Rush 3
70010000121972.description:
Speed meets chaos in this fast, arcade-style runner where every second counts. Guide a rolling ball down vibrant tracks packed with colour-coded obstacles and split-path routes. Smash through the right obstacles and stay focused as the pace ramps up and the patterns grow more intense.

The action is quicker and more aggressive than before, pushing players into rapid decision-making and constant movement. Tracks can split, forcing you to choose your path on the fly while maintaining control at high speed.

Jumping introduces a whole new dimension to the gameplay. Mastering both movement and vertical control becomes the key to surviving longer and pushing further.

The tracks are filled with fresh patterns designed to test your reactions, creating a relentless flow of action that rewards focus and skill.

Bright visuals, smooth motion, and satisfying physics-driven destruction bring every collision to life. Each smash sends fragments scattering across the track as the speed keeps climbing.

70010000121978.name: Antique Checkers
70010000121978.intro: Feel the classic in every move
70010000121978.description:
Antique Checkers is a classic board game loved by players of all ages. Simple to learn yet full of strategy, it’s the perfect choice for anyone looking to relax or challenge their mind.

The game features two modes: play solo against an AI with adjustable difficulty, or enjoy a local two-player match with a friend on the same device. Beautiful antique-style visuals and smooth gameplay create a calm and immersive experience.

Plan your moves, think ahead, and enjoy the timeless charm of a true classic. Play smart. Win with style.

70010000121984.name: Cute Animals
70010000121984.intro: Adorable animal puzzles where toddlers learn, explore & grow.
70010000121984.description:
Cute Animals is a joyful collection of 12 educational mini-games designed especially for toddlers and preschoolers. Through colorful, hand-drawn worlds filled with charming animal characters, children develop essential early learning skills — all through play.

Each mini-game targets a different developmental area. Children sort geometric shapes by matching them to the correct category, guided by a friendly monkey in a sunlit forest. They count groups of flowers to compare quantities, helped along by a cheerful yak and zebra on a sunny meadow. In another game, they identify animals by their close-up textures — matching a patch of fur or feathers to the right creature. Kids also explore seasonal nature scenes, tap on caterpillars hiding in tree hollows, and identify which animals share the same markings or patterns.

The game features no in-game text, making it universally accessible to children of any language background. Gameplay is entirely intuitive — toddlers simply tap and drag, and the game responds with delightful animations and satisfying sounds. Multiple difficulty levels ensure the experience grows with your child, keeping them challenged without ever feeling frustrated.

Cute Animals combines excellent design with genuine educational value. Natural animal sounds, upbeat cheerful music, and vibrant seasonal environments — from autumn forests to sunny savannas — create an immersive world that kids will want to return to again and again. Developed by Inlogic Games, Cute Animals is rated PEGI 3 and safe for even the youngest players.

70010000122007.name: Xtreme Drift Racing Simulator
70010000122007.intro: Push it. But don't wreck it.
70010000122007.description:
Strap in and hit the dirt. Xtreme Drift Racing Simulator puts you on grueling mud rally tracks where every slide counts and every second matters. No opponents — just you, the course, and the clock.

Race across challenging off-road stages under ever-changing conditions: blazing sun, dramatic sunsets, pitch-black night, heavy rain, and thick fog. Each condition transforms the track beneath your wheels, demanding you adapt your driving on the fly.

Push hard, but drive smart. Every collision, every wall clip, every rough landing damages your car — and that damage costs you time. The perfect run is both clean and fast. Can you manage both?

Features:
- Time attack racing across multiple mud rally environments
- 5 dynamic weather conditions that change how the track handles
- Realistic damage system — protect your car to protect your time
- Multiple vehicle classes, each with unique handling on wet terrain
- Progressively harder stages that test your limits at every turn

Chase the perfect lap. Shave off that last tenth of a second.

70010000122013.name: Hentai Panty: Private Collection
70010000122013.intro: Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.
70010000122013.description:
Solve captivating puzzles featuring images of beautiful anime-style girls. With each image you complete, you'll unlock new ones, and the gradually increasing difficulty makes solving the puzzle a fascinating challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling that you're actually touching every detail.

Soft and relaxing music will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after solving the puzzle, you can examine the image closely and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Stylish anime images.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Relaxing music.

70010000122019.name: Drift & Stunt Mania
70010000122019.intro: Tune your dream car and take it to the limit — drift, race and pull off insane stunts across a stunning open world. Speed, style, and zero rules.
70010000122019.description:
Drift & Stunt Mania is your ultimate playground on wheels. Take the wheel of powerful muscle cars and lose yourself in a hand-crafted open world — from rolling British countryside roads to muddy off-road trails and bustling city streets packed with secrets to uncover.

Before you hit the road, hit the garage. Tweak the engine, tune the suspension, swap the tires, slap on a fresh coat of paint — your car is yours to build from the ground up. Every adjustment you make, you feel on the road. The handling is raw, responsive, and deeply satisfying.

Out in the world, there are no rules. Chain massive drifts through hairpin turns, launch off ramps, pull off insane stunts, and leave tire marks across every surface you can find. The world is wide open and every corner hides a new opportunity to go faster, fly higher, and look cooler doing it.

The detail is what sets this apart. The light catching the mud on your hood. The way the chassis shakes over rough terrain. The growl of a tuned engine hitting full throttle on an empty road. Drift & Stunt Mania doesn't just look good — it feels alive.

One car. One world. Your rules.

70010000122056.name: Science Literacy Check for Adults
70010000122056.description:
Is your science knowledge still up to date?

“You learned it at school.”
“You kind of remember it.”
But knowledge like that can often become surprisingly vague over time.

This game is a science knowledge quiz
based on the science and natural phenomena around us.

Space, the human body, matter, and energy.
Using everyday questions and basic science concepts,
you’ll face quizzes about scientific knowledge you think you know.

How to play is simple.
• Read the question
• Choose an answer by intuition
• Check the result and explanation instantly

Even when you get it right, there’s more to learn.
Even when you get it wrong, you’ll discover something new.

Play a single question anytime.
Perfect for passing time or refreshing your knowledge.

How much of your scientific knowledge still holds up today?
Why not put it to the test?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000122064.name: Human Fall Flat - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000122064.description:
Human Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted physics platformer set in floating dreamscapes that can be played solo or with up to 8 players online. Free new levels are regularly added to the game which keeps players returning for more! 

INCLUDES NINTENDO  SWITCH™ 2 EDITION FEATURES 
- Additional levels including Dockyard, Museum, Hike, Candyland and Test Chamber, plus all future levels!
- GameShare: play Human Fall Flat with anyone – even if they don't own the game! 
- GameChat: share audio and video while playing with your friends. 
- Improved performance with higher frame rate and resolution. 
- Support for mouse controls. 

MORE THAN 30 UNIQUE WORLDS TO MASTER 
Each dream level provides a new environment to navigate, from mansions, castles and Aztec adventures to snowy mountains, eerie nightscapes and industrial locations. Multiple routes through each level, and perfectly playful puzzles ensure exploration and ingenuity are rewarded.

MORE HUMANS, MORE MAYHEM 
Need a hand getting that boulder on to a catapult, or need someone to break that wall? Online multiplayer for up to 8 players transforms the way Human Fall Flat is played. 

A BLANK CANVAS
Your Human is yours to customise. With outfits from builder to chef, skydiver, miner, astronaut and ninja. Choose your head, upper and lower body and get creative with the colours!

70010000122071.name: Muv-Luv Unlimited: THE DAY AFTER - Episode 00 REMASTERED
70010000122071.intro: Set four years after “Muv-Luv Unlimited”, the humans left on Earth must now fight for their survival.
70010000122071.description:
◇ ‘What is “Muv-Luv UNLIMITED: The Day After”’
A spin-off title of the Muv-Luv series, which follows on from ‘Muv-Luv’ and ‘Muv-Luv Alternative’.
The first entry in a spin-off series branching from “Muv-Luv Unlimited”, a story that diverges into a different future from the anime-adapted “Muv-Luv Alternative.”
After the protagonist Shirogane Takeru sees off the heroine’s escape from Earth in “Muv-Luv Unlimited”, this story portrays the people left behind on Earth who, even so, continue to fight against their fate of destruction.

◇ Story
The human evacuation plan to the Barnard’s Star system was executed, and five days after the large-scale gravitational anomaly triggered by humanity’s desperate counteroffensive, Operation Babylon, the people left behind on Earth continued their struggle for survival.
A small group of survivors gathered aboard the stranded U.S. aircraft carrier JFK, desperately seeking a place of safety.
That day, U.S. Marine Second Lieutenant Wilbert D. Collins, while on a reconnaissance mission, picked up a faint distress signal and set out to investigate.

70010000122075.name: Muv-Luv Unlimited: THE DAY AFTER - Episode 01 REMASTERED
70010000122075.intro: Experience the beginning of a new saga with Lieutenant Tatsunami Hibiki and the newly formed Wardog Squadron.
70010000122075.description:
◇ ‘What is “Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After”?’
A spin-off title of the Muv-Luv series, continuing from “Muv-Luv” and “Muv-Luv Alternative”.
The second title in a spin-off series derived from “Muv-Luv Unlimited”, which branches into a different future from the anime-adapted “Muv-Luv Alternative.”
After protagonist Shirogane Takeru sees the heroine escape Earth in “Muv-Luv Unlimited”, this story portrays the people left behind on Earth who nonetheless keep battling against their fate of extinction.

◇ Story
The massive gravitational anomaly caused by Operation Babylon turned Earth into a world of death.
In Tacoma, part of the U.S.-administered Seattle Imperial Lease Territory—one of the last habitable regions for humanity—stood Imperial Japanese Army Lieutenant Tatsunami Hibiki.
Day after day, he fought to defend Seattle against the relentless BETA assaults.
With food supplies dwindling and ammunition nearly exhausted, Hibiki continued his desperate fight to stay alive.

70010000122077.name: Even Native Japanese Struggle Japanese Kanji Fill-in Quiz
70010000122077.intro: Think you know kanji? Put your skills to the test with tricky fill-in-the-blank puzzles!
70010000122077.description:
You may have seen these kanji before—but can you actually read them?
This quiz game lets you enjoy learning rare and tricky Japanese kanji through fun fill-in-the-blank puzzles.

From animals and plants to foods, place names, and everyday words, a wide variety of categories awaits.
Some answers will come to you in a flash, while others will leave you scratching your head. The more you play, the more your vocabulary and kanji knowledge will grow.

Play solo to challenge yourself, or enjoy solving questions together with family and friends.
Turn “I’ve seen it before” into “I can read it!” and take on a quiz experience that is both fun and rewarding.

70010000122085.name: Muv-Luv Unlimited: THE DAY AFTER - Episode 02 REMASTERED
70010000122085.intro: As a sinister force threatens the food production plant, Lieutenant Tatsunami Hibiki and the Wardog Squadron are thrust into a brutal war between fellow humans.
70010000122085.description:
◇ ‘What is “Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After”?’
A spin-off title of the Muv-Luv series, continuing from “Muv-Luv” and “Muv-Luv Alternative”.
The third title in a spin-off series derived from “Muv-Luv Unlimited”, which branches into a different future from the anime-adapted “Muv-Luv Alternative.”
After protagonist Shirogane Takeru sees the heroine escape Earth in “Muv-Luv Unlimited”, this story portrays the people left behind on Earth who nonetheless keep battling against their fate of extinction.

◇ Story
To solve the food crisis that had worsened Seattle’s public order, the Empire began construction of a food production plant.
However, on its first day of operation, the facility was taken over by unknown forces, and Supreme Commander Koubuin Yuuhi went missing.
To rescue the Commander and neutralize the terrorists, Hibiki’s War Dog Squad launched an assault on the plant, now turned into a battlefield.

70010000122089.name: Muv-Luv Unlimited: THE DAY AFTER - Episode 03 REMASTERED
70010000122089.intro: A new BETA threat arises, but humanity remains fractured. Can they set aside their conflicts and unite before it's too late?
70010000122089.description:
◇ ‘What is “Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After”?’
A spin-off title of the Muv-Luv series, continuing from “Muv-Luv” and “Muv-Luv Alternative”.
The fourth title in a spin-off series derived from “Muv-Luv Unlimited”, which branches into a different future from the anime-adapted “Muv-Luv Alternative.”
After protagonist Shirogane Takeru sees the heroine escape Earth in “Muv-Luv Unlimited”, this story portrays the people left behind on Earth who nonetheless keep battling against their fate of extinction.

◇ Story
The war between Japan, the United States, Canada, and France—sparked by the food crisis—temporarily subsided, but the core issue remained unresolved.
A devastated Earth, the looming threat of the BETA, the power struggles between nations, and the everyday people caught in the middle.
What path will Hibiki, now a hero of the Empire, choose?

70010000122111.name: Bear No Grudge
70010000122111.intro: You are the bear. Shoot, skate, and race through outrageous challenges in this action‑adventure with bite.
70010000122111.description:
You are a bear on a mission to take down the careless international delivery corporation, Forest Inc, that are destroying the planet and left your friend in a wheelchair. This action-packed game features multiple locations, each with its own unique gameplay mechanics and challenges. Use your wits and quick reflexes to defeat enemies and bosses, while also navigating challenging environments on skateboards, hovercrafts and paws. Set across 12 different levels you will pursue the evil CEO, Taking down hench men and a variety of baddies and leaving destruction in your path.

key Features
Pretty OK Gun Play
- Master your gun as you make your way through the game taking down many bad guys and vending machines. 
Explore 12 sort-of good levels
- Each level contains easter eggs and thingys for you to have fun with. Making each map feel new and fun.
Loads of passable gameplay variety
- Skateboard, Kart, sidescroll, top down racing, hovercrafts and skating. There's loads to do.
So what are you waiting for. Grab it now. Its pawesome.

70010000122124.name: FPS Dinosaurs
70010000122124.intro: Step into an intense battle where soldiers, dinosaurs, and explosions share the same battlefield.
70010000122124.description:
FPS Dinosaurs is an offline first-person shooter packed with action, where you lead your team against enemy forces in wild and dangerous environments. But the battlefield doesn’t belong only to soldiers… massive dinosaurs roam the map and attack anything that moves.

Get ready to survive the chaos, where every match turns into an unpredictable clash between armed squads, prehistoric creatures, and explosions everywhere.

70010000122138.name: Little Helper Cafe: Sugar Cubes
70010000122138.description:
Get ready for the perfect dose of cuteness in Little Helper Cafe: Sugar Cubes. In this cozy Sokoban-style puzzle, a friendly hedgehog has a delicious mission: push sugar cubes into coffee cups on a dessert-filled tabletop.

But not everything is so simple. Holes on the board can disrupt the delivery, and that is where macarons come in, used strategically to plug paths and open new routes. Each level is a small logic challenge wrapped in a calm and cozy atmosphere.

With no time limit and no pressure, Little Helper Cafe: Sugar Cubes offers a relaxing, clear and irresistibly charming experience for players who love cute and clever puzzles. Observe, plan and help the little hero make every coffee a little sweeter.

70010000122144.name: Train Plus mini 1
70010000122144.intro: Take the controls of the Big Edo Line and enjoy a compact yet exciting train-driving experience!
70010000122144.description:
The Train Plus Mini series is here, bringing the fun of the Train Plus series in a more accessible and easy-to-enjoy format.

In this title, you can explore the above-ground section of the Jukyo Metro Big Edo Line, famous for its striking orange line color, and experience the joy of train driving at your own pace.

Choose between two ways to enjoy the game:
In Free Drive Mode, you can operate the train freely and soak in the fun of driving.
In Auto Drive Mode, simply sit back, relax, and enjoy the passing scenery from the train window.

Drive the 10-100 Series, and keep an eye out for the brand-new 10-200 Series, which appears as a passing train and adds even more life to the railway world.

This title also introduces the series’ first-ever Hyper Real Texture Building feature, making the buildings and cityscape look more detailed, immersive, and visually impressive than ever before.

And if you want to dive deeper into the world of the line, the included Setting Materials Collection lets you discover the history and background of the Big Edo Line.

Drive, watch, and explore.
A compact train game packed with charm for railway fans and casual players alike!

70010000122150.name: CASTAWAY SURVIVAL IN OCEAN - Build Your Own Raft, Craft
70010000122150.intro: Can you outsmart hungry sharks and conquer the dangers of the sea?
70010000122150.description:
Stranded in the middle of the endless ocean, you have nothing but a fragile raft, a rusty hook, and the determination to survive. With no land in sight and no help on the horizon, every day becomes a challenge. Gather whatever resources the sea provides, manage your supplies carefully, and find ways to stay alive in an environment where even the smallest mistake can have serious consequences.

The ocean is vast, unpredictable, and filled with both opportunities and dangers. Collect floating debris, expand your raft piece by piece, and transform it into a sturdy shelter capable of withstanding storms and defending against threats lurking beneath the waves. As you grow stronger, venture farther from your starting point to discover tropical islands, gather rare materials, and uncover secrets hidden across the endless sea.

Features:
• Build, repair, and expand your raft into a floating survival base
• Craft weapons, tools, and equipment to improve your chances of survival
• Explore tropical islands and search for valuable resources and hidden treasures
• Dive beneath the waves and discover the mysteries of the deep ocean
• Defend your raft against sharks and other dangerous sea creatures
• Gather resources, unlock upgrades, and grow stronger with every journey

Will you turn a few scattered planks into an unstoppable ocean fortress, or will the sea become your final challenge?

70010000122161.name: My Cozy Workspace
70010000122161.intro: Build the workspace you’ve always dreamed of!
70010000122161.description:
Create the workspace of your dreams in My Cozy Workspace - a relaxing simulator where creativity, comfort, and productivity come together. Design and customize rooms by placing furniture, organizing accessories, decorating shelves, and building a cozy atmosphere that feels uniquely yours.

Arrange desks, plants, books, lights, and dozens of decorative items while transforming small empty spaces into inspiring work, whether you prefer a minimalist office, a colorful creative studio, or a warm workspace corner.

Take your time, experiment with different layouts, and enjoy a calm and satisfying experience focused on creativity and relaxation.

70010000122187.name: Which Era Is This? World History Era Guess Quiz
70010000122187.intro: Name the era! A fast 4-choice World History quiz that connects the timeline.
70010000122187.description:
“What era is this?” Test your World History instincts with quick, bite-size questions about events, people, culture, wars, and inventions. 

Choose the correct era from four options and start seeing how history links together—from the ancient world to the modern age.

Missed a question? Review and try again to strengthen your weak spots. 

Perfect for short study sessions, daily practice, and anyone who wants a clear, enjoyable refresher on World History.

70010000122196.name: OVER REQUIEMZ
70010000122196.description:
In this dark reimagining of the classic tale, high school student Yuhiru finds herself lost in Oz. 

Unjustly sentenced to death she must now travel with four convicts and their supervisor. 

At the mercy of her fellow travelers, Yuhiru will face many hard decisions along the way, but there’s one thing she must bear in mind: No one is lost forever, no matter how far they’ve strayed.

70010000122199.name: Gentle Classical Music Course for Grown-Ups
70010000122199.intro: A quiz to learn classical music in a fun way
70010000122199.description:
Can you explain famous classical music pieces?

“You’ve probably heard it somewhere.”
“You know it’s a famous piece.”
But even well-known classical music may have composers, stories,
and musical features that many people don’t really know.

This game is a music knowledge quiz
based on the world of classical music.

Famous composers, stories behind great pieces,
and knowledge about instruments and music.
Based on classical music,
you’ll face quiz questions about famous works and musical knowledge
that you may think you know.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question  
・Choose an answer by intuition  
・Understand instantly with results and explanations  

Even when you answer correctly, there’s still something to learn.
Even when you get it wrong, you’ll discover something new.

Play from just one question at a time.
Perfect for passing time or refreshing your musical knowledge.

How much of your classical music knowledge still holds up?
Why not put it to the test?

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
TT supports game streaming by content creators.
Both individuals and companies are free to stream this game,
and no permission from TT is required.

70010000122205.name: EGGCONSOLE ZODIAC PC-8801
70010000122205.intro: The blue crystal shines again. Set foot in the "Dester Slum" and challenge the unexplored. A boy, a robot, and a mission: Rescue Dr. Dumas.
70010000122205.description:
Released in 1985 by Riverhill Soft, this title is a classic space adventure game.

Boy sets out on a journey with his robotic partner, Amaroid Mary, to find his father, Dr. Dumas, who went missing five years ago. After a sudden reaction from the "Blue Crystal"—their only clue—the duo lands on an unexplored planet within the star cluster known as the "Dester Slum." Will Boy and Mary successfully locate Dr. Dumas? This command-input adventure will put your wits to the ultimate test.
 
Zodiac is a text-based adventure game where commands are primarily entered as “verb + noun” combinations.
Bring up the virtual keyboard, enter commands to solve puzzles, and advance the story.

An adventure space romance unfolding before Boy, the robot Amaroid Marie.
Hurry! Dr. Dumas, his father, is there.


 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.
 *Flashing lights or patterns may cause dizziness, spasms, or loss of consciousness. If you feel unwell, stop playing immediately and see a doctor.
   If you have a history of these symptoms, consult a physician before use.

70010000122210.name: Toaplan Arcade Garage: Flying Fire Shark
70010000122210.intro:
Beasts of the Sea, Soaring through the Skies!
Shoot 'em up arcade classics Flying Shark and Fire Shark together at last!
70010000122210.description:
The Shark series, created by legendary Japanese studio Toaplan, is a landmark shoot 'em up series. Flying Shark (1987), which was well received for its simple rules and exquisitely tuned difficulty level, had a tremendous impact on vertical scrolling shoot 'em up games. 
The sequel Fire Shark (1989), with its screen-filling weaponry, set arcades ablaze with its destructive carnage!

For veteran shooters and new pilots 
In addition to the authentic "Arcade Mode" which is a faithful recreation of the original's rock-hard gameplay, both titles include a "Super Easy Mode" that allows even genre newcomers to enjoy the games.

Support functions and intel
The game is packed with a variety of features that help the player. The M2 gadgets displayed on the left and right of the playing field alert the player of enemies appearing from blind spots, the location of hidden features, what the next item will be, and other things that help you improve your chances of surviving the barrage of enemies.

Be an arcade hero
Includes the popular Arcade Challenge mode from the M2ShotTriggers! Each stage is divided into small areas to enhance your training, and a rewind function to make things even more efficient!
With practice comes perfection; a one-credit clear can be yours!

70010000122280.name: HORSE CLUB Ride West
70010000122280.intro: Travel to Wild River Ranch and experience exciting adventures.
70010000122280.description:
The HORSE CLUB is visiting the Wild River Ranch!

Travel with your friends Hannah, Sofia, Sarah, and Lisa to the Wild West. Explore the vast landscape, help old and new friends, experience exciting adventures on horseback, learn Western riding, test your skills, and claim the crown at the big Western riding tournament!

Dive into a lovingly crafted world and explore the adventurous surroundings at your own pace.

Experience a charming, engaging story full of humor.

In addition to classic riding disciplines like barrel racing and pole bending, you can also test your skills in activities such as archery, painting, and playing the guitar.

Six unique horses are waiting to be ridden - each with its own character and traits that you can develop throughout the game.

Create your own style for you and your horse with numerous customization options and a wide selection of carefully designed color combinations.

All of this is accompanied by an atmospheric original soundtrack composed by Grammy®-winning musician Winifred Phillips.

From the creators of the HORSE CLUB Adventures series - Wild River Games

Based on the HORSE CLUB franchise by the German toy brand Schleich®

70010000122282.name: Perfect Tides: Station to Station
70010000122282.intro: An award-winning adventure about the momentum and whiplash of young adulthood
70010000122282.description:
You are Mara Whitefish, aspiring writer in the year 2003. No longer an adolescent, you’ve left your island home of Perfect Tides to attend university in The City. The fast tracks of adulthood lie ahead.

- Navigate through a year of Mara's life, complete with seasonal acts, non-linear exploration, and branching outcomes in a narrative adventure game.

- Collect an inventory of names and subjects to grow your understanding of topics through conversation, books, experience, and memory.

- Nurture new ideas and complete writing assignments based on what you’ve learned from your choices and interactions.

- Experience the thrills and agonies of complex relationships with friends, family, and romantic partners while finding your place in the world.

Where will Mara be when the year ends?

Perfect Tides: Station to Station is a critically-acclaimed narrative adventure. It received the 2026 Independent Games Festival (IGF) Excellence in Narrative award, as well as a nomination for the Seumas McNally Grand Prize.

70010000122315.name: Dark Auction - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000122315.intro:
The Auction of Dark Memories Begins Now.
What truths await beyond a bid made with your life?
70010000122315.description:
Story:
1981, Somewhere in Europe.

Eighteen-year-old Noah is haunted by the memory of his mother abandoning him as a child.
He lives with his father Leonard, a failed writer obsessed with collecting items related to “Dictator X.” 
Noah wishes he would stop, but Leonard refuses to give up his strange obsession, even as they struggle financially.

One day, an auction invitation arrives, addressed to Leonard. Ignoring Noah’s protests, Leonard sets off for the old castle where the auction is to be held, promising to tell Noah everything once he returns.
But Leonard never comes home. With no way to contact him, Noah heads to the castle himself, determined to bring him home—only to witness something shocking.
Trapped inside the castle with the other guests, Noah decided to accept the Auctioneer's invitation, and take part in the auction himself.


Characters:
Noah Crawford (VA. Kengo Kawanishi)
Leonard Crawford (VA. Rikiya Koyama)
Edgar Schultz (VA. Daisuke Namikawa)
Christoph Treheim von Berg (VA. Nobunaga Shimazaki)
Otto Klein (VA. Shunsuke Takeuchi)
Karla Becker (VA. Maaya Uchida)
Lorraine Klopp (VA. Yui Ishikawa)
Hell (VA. Akira Ishida)
Auctioneer (VA. Show Hayami)

Game features:
- Explore freely within an old castle rendered in 3D
- Use reasoning and deduction to solve clues via the Word Cloud System
- Use memories to expose the truth via each Auction

In the exploration phase, you will search rooms and floors, and talk to other participants, revealing trauma and lies that will lead you to the truth each one keeps hidden.

Information you learn here will be stored in your Word Cloud, and can then be used to solve mysteries during each auction!

But in this place, the auction exhibits aren't bid on with money, but with memories.
Auction participants try to win their bids by offering their own memories, using a memory reconstruction device known as EPO.
But memories burdened by secrets or trauma can change completely, becoming distorted and incorrect.
If the participants offer incomplete memories, their auction bids will fail.

Noah must become their supporter, fixing each target's memory to ensure they are correct.
If the auction is a success, the truth will be revealed—unleashing the dramatic story behind each ill-fated auction exhibit.

Story / Script: Rika Suzuki 
Character Design: KOHSKE
Music: Yuko Komiyama, Tsukasa Masuko
Director / Producer: Shinsuke Umeda 

* This game is a story about young people learning about the past, and striving to protect a peaceful future. Although memories related to past wars feature in this game, it does not in any way, seek to glorify or promote the crimes of war.

70010000122320.name: Arcade Archives RACK'EM UP
70010000122320.intro: Recreating the popular game of pool!
70010000122320.description:
"RACK'EM UP" is a sports game released by KONAMI in 1987.
In this game, you can play pool (pocket billiards) with Nine-Ball or Rotation rules. A key feature of this game is the ability to check the positions of the cue ball and object balls on the 3D screen. The game appeals to a wide range of age groups.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000122332.name: CoffeeFox: Kim Samwol
70010000122332.intro:
Three thousand years, having consumed a thousand livers,
A nine-tailed fox awakens as a human, far from becoming a divine being.
70010000122332.description:
Based on the popular webtoon! A special fantasy romance visual novel arrives, unfolding in a small modern city cafe with 'Kim Sam-wol,' a nine-tailed fox who has lived for 3,000 years. Why did she, who sought to become a deity by eating human livers, awaken as an ordinary human and work part-time at a cafe?

In-depth Narrative and Multiple Endings
A high-quality story where Korean mythology meets modern sensibilities. Depending on your choices, Sam-wol can become a deity, choose human love, or even disappear.

Lively Production and Voice Acting
Beyond simple images, 'Spine animation' and 'full voice' support for all characters except the protagonist provide an immersive experience as if watching an animation.

Heart-Touching Sound
The original OST, with participation from Shin Jun-ki, the bassist of the band 'BUZZ,' enriches the game's emotional depth.

Detective-Style Cafe Mini-Game
Find clues hidden in the conversations of customers and create the perfect drink. You can enjoy both cafe management and the fun of deduction at the same time.

70010000122339.name: Japanese Culture Literacy Test
70010000122339.intro: Are your Japanese manners up to par?
70010000122339.description:
Is your knowledge of Japanese culture still up to date?

“You kind of know it.”
“It’s just something we’ve always done.”
But many customs and traditions are followed without really knowing their meaning or origin.

This game is a Japanese culture knowledge quiz
focused on traditions, etiquette, and customs of Japan.

Dining etiquette, seasonal events, word meanings, and traditional manners.
Based on everyday situations and traditional culture,
you’ll face quizzes about Japanese customs you may think you know.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question  
・Choose the answer by intuition  
・Understand instantly with results and explanations  

Even when you answer correctly, there’s still something to learn.
Even when you’re wrong, you’ll think, “Ah, I see.”

Play from just one question at a time.
Perfect for passing time or refreshing your cultural knowledge.

How much of your knowledge of Japanese culture still holds up today?
Why not put it to the test?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000122360.name: I Hear Them
70010000122360.intro: Uncover the mystery of where the rats keep coming from.
70010000122360.description:
You hear scurrying in the ceiling. You hear scratching in the walls. Your house is infested with rats, and it’s your job to get rid of them. Catch rats with the help of your best friend, Lola, and uncover the supernatural mysteries behind their gatherings inside your new home.

I Hear Them is a first-person horror game where you team up with the family cat and try to clear the infestation of rats in your new home. Set in early 2008, explore an atmospheric house while unveiling supernatural secrets about the creatures running around in the walls.

70010000122371.name: Guts 'n Grunts Sr.
70010000122371.description:
Mar 30, 2052, the Technate remains intact. After 17 years of speedily fighting Slaughterhouse AI, Gunnar Harsvin has one last run in him. Can he send one final message to the evil technocrats? Or will time stop him in his tracks?

A twin game to Guts 'n Grunts Jr, "Sr." offers new challenges and enemies. Roll, shoot, survive!

70010000122381.name: Counter Attack
70010000122381.intro: Experience the ultimate in next-generation detail, bringing the breathtaking power of modern warfare directly to your screen.
70010000122381.description:
"The pinnacle of visuals, the essence of tactics. The most perfect modern warfare you'll ever encounter."
<Counter Attack> is an FPS game where you fulfill your operator's destiny by facing unforgiving battlefields and advanced threats lurking beyond the border.
The eye of a massive storm that will change the course of war. Your infiltration will usher in a new era of modern warfare.

■ Incredible visuals across amplitudes
Extreme graphics, perfectly calculated to the slightest light source and shadow. The vivid realism created by next-generation engines forces you to the heart of modern warfare.

■ Perfect synergy, the best combination for victory
Assault's firepower, engineer's skill, support commitment, Recon's insight. As soon as each bottle's own gadget meshes, the tactic is complete. Experience a thrilling collaborative action that wins goals in the name of a team that are impossible to do alone.

■ overwhelming maneuverability to change the speed of tactics
Break through the physical limits of the battlefield with powerful tactical maneuvering equipment. Run through rough terrain, catch the enemy off guard, and take the lead faster than anyone else to shake the battlefield at once.

■ A battlefield without limits, your will becomes the route
An overwhelming scale open field that leads beyond the horizon. There is no established path. Pioneer direct penetration paths across vast swaths of land, and design your own strategic engagement that will reverse the course of the battlefield.

■ Occupation, destruction, and total annihilation
Overwhelming scale Siege in three iconic modes. Break down enemy lines of defense with the real destructive effects of the next generation of physical engines, and roar victory at the pinnacle of the battlefield.

Synopsis
International straits, the lifeblood of the global economy, have been completely blocked by a massive armed force.
Amid the chaos that threatens to cripple the global energy grid, enemies are on the verge of completing the next generation of weapons that will threaten humanity by waking up prohibited technologies hidden deep underground.
Worst situation where formal diplomacy and international community intervention are impossible. To end an unrecorded war, a single top secret order is given to the best agents that do not exist in the world.
"Unauthorized penetration, disallowed destruction. But an operation that must succeed."

Answer the battlefield's call from the end of the horizon. Your input soon becomes the formula for victory, and one of your feet changes the battlefield. 
Now, be part of the special forces that will make the impossible possible and start a legend.

70010000122401.name: Crypt Carnage
70010000122401.description: Crypt Carnage is a fast-paced, wave-based retro FPS that drops you into cursed catacombs crawling with monsters, armored brutes, and nightmare bosses. Every round is a desperate scramble for ammo, upgrades, and breathing room as the horde tightens the circle and the arena turns into a killbox. Stack power-ups, swap to absurd weapons on the fly, and keep moving—because in the Crypt, standing still is a death sentence.

70010000122407.name: Crossbars
70010000122407.description: Get ready for the ultimate downhill mountain biking experience in Crossbars, where speed, skill, and adventure collide. Set across four stunning, mountainous islands, Crossbars challenges you to ride through 20 thrilling tracks, each with its own unique terrain and environmental hazards. From rocky cliffs and forested trails to muddy paths and open hills, every track offers a new adventure—will you stick to the main path and race against the clock, or venture off-road and discover hidden secrets?

70010000122434.name: Aphrodite Evolve Weapons Survivor: Greek Gods Versus Heaven
70010000122434.intro:
Thousands of gods want her dead. She just wants to evolve her weapons.
Play as Aphrodite and survive the divine wrath of Olympus!
70010000122434.description:
Heaven has turned against her. 

Waves of divine soldiers, mythological beasts, and rogue gods close in from every direction and they never stop coming. 

You are Aphrodite, the most powerful and most hunted goddess in the Greek world, walking alone through ancient lands as the sky itself attacks you.

Pick up weapons. Evolve them. Destroy everything.

Every run is different. Weapons combine and transform into devastating divine tools. Arrows of desire become storms of golden light. 

Shields of beauty become walls of destruction. The longer you survive, the stronger you become, until the screen fills with hundreds of enemies and your arsenal fills with chaos.

This is not a game you play once. This is a game you cannot stop playing.


Features:

● AUTO-ATTACK SURVIVAL GAMEPLAY: Focus on moving and positioning. Your weapons fire automatically. Your job is to survive long enough to become unstoppable.

● EVOLVE YOUR WEAPONS: Combine weapons and items to trigger powerful evolutions. Find the right synergies and watch your build go from mortal to divine.

● ENDLESS WAVES OF DIVINE ENEMIES: Gods, titans, mythological creatures, and heavenly armies. They keep coming. You keep fighting.

● GREEK MYTHOLOGY SETTING: Ancient landscapes, golden temples, divine ruins. Battle across the world of the gods as the one they could never defeat.


One more run. Just one more. That is what they all say.
Aphrodite does not die here.

70010000122446.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000122446.intro: Explore a world filled with the magic of Disney! Discover rich stories while building the perfect neighborhood alongside Disney and Pixar Heroes and Villains.
70010000122446.description:
Disney Dreamlight Valley is a hybrid between a life-sim and an adventure game rich with quests, exploration, and engaging activities featuring Disney and Pixar friends, both old and new.  

Once an idyllic land, Dreamlight Valley was a place where Disney and Pixar characters lived in harmony—until the Forgetting. Night Thorns grew across the land and severed the wonderful memories tied to this magical place. With nowhere else to go, the hopeless inhabitants of Dreamlight Valley retreated behind locked doors in the Dream Castle.

Now it's up to you to discover the stories of this world and bring the magic back to Dreamlight Valley! 

Discover the Secrets of Dreamlight Valley
Free the Dream Castle from the insidious grip of the Forgetting, and unlock the unique Realms of well-loved Disney and Pixar characters, including great queens and kings such as Anna and Simba. Each Realm contains unique challenges with puzzles to solve in the quest to bring friendship back to the Valley.  
You’ll start your adventure in the Valley, but your journey will take you to infinity… and beyond! Explore what lurks in the Forest of Valor and brave the deepest caverns as you take on challenges from iconic Disney and Pixar heroes and villains. Who knows who—or what—you might discover.  

Forge Friendships with Disney & Pixar Characters 
Garden with WALL·E, cook with Remy, or kick back and fish with Goofy. What better way to collect, craft, and rebuild the Valley than with a friend! From beautiful princesses to nefarious villains, every Dreamlight Valley resident brings their own story arc, quests, and rewards. Meet up in daily hangouts and make friends with some of your favorite Disney and Pixar characters.

Restore the Valley to Its Former Glory 
Free the Valley from the grip of the Forgetting and return Dreamlight Valley to its former greatness by making it your own. In Dreamlight Valley, you can build the perfect neighborhood that is just for you with a fully customizable layout, creative landscaping, and thousands of decorative items. 
Will you settle on the Beach next to Moana, or call Buzz Lightyear your next-door neighbor in the Plaza?  

Express Your Disney Style 
Bring out your inner princess, villain, or Disney bounder! Assemble unique outfits and decorate your home with thousands of fantastic items. Using the Touch of Magic tool, you can even create your own designs with Disney- and Pixar-inspired decals! 
With the in-game Camera, get ready to snap a sunset selfie with Mirabel, capture a culinary creation with Remy, or simply cherish a moment.

A Game in Constant Evolution 
New content means that there's always something fresh to explore. Meet new characters in the Valley, check out the latest clothing and furniture collections in Scrooge’s Store, and complete challenging in-game events! Be sure to dream your way back to Dreamlight Valley regularly to discover new adventures!

70010000122459.name: Driving is Hard
70010000122459.intro: Prove your skills by driving the Bathtub on Wheels! Drive, Fall, Learn, Repeat.
70010000122459.description:
Challenge yourself in Driving Is Hard! Drive a bathtub on wheels through steep, unforgiving terrain where every mistake costs you progress. Master tough physics-based gameplay, sharpen your patience, and uncover Jeff’s journey of self-doubt, family struggles, and emotional growth as he finds strength, self-acceptance, and hope for a brighter future.


FEATURES:

• Drive a Bathtub: Navigate Jeff in a physics-based bathtub on wheels

• Select Your Difficulty: Driving is Easy for a relaxing time with checkpoints, Driving is Hard - the original challenge, Driving is Insane for insane people.

• Explore 7 Worlds: Each with unique challenges and mechanics.

• Easy to Play, Hard to Master: Simple controls, challenging mechanics.

• Emotional Journey: Jeff faces his father’s expectations and finds his own path.

• Customizable Bathtub: Unlock and use different car skins.

• Collect Soaps: Find 21 soaps as you play.


WARNING!
This difficult game tests your patience - falling is part of the challenge. Will you rise or quit when it gets tough?

70010000122468.name: Frost Station
70010000122468.description:
In Frost Station, you land on a mysterious ice planet where temperatures are deadly and the landscape is endless. Your mission is simple: explore the frozen wilderness and discover every hidden location scattered across the planet.

Traverse vast snowy plains, icy cliffs, and abandoned outposts as you search for places long forgotten. Each location you find reveals more about the planet!

Features:
>Explore a mysterious frozen planet
>Discover and unlock unique locations
>Atmospheric, cold-world exploration
>A quiet adventure focused on discovery
>Challenge yourself to find everything

70010000122475.name: Hack 'n' Stack
70010000122475.intro: Physics meets tower defense in this chaotic party game up to 4 players.
70010000122475.description: Craft barricades and turrets with whatever you can find. But beware: relentless waves of enemies are coming to tear down everything you build.

70010000122491.name: Brain Boost! Basic Math 4-Choice Quiz
70010000122491.intro:
Train your math thinking with 4-choice quizzes!
Read, observe, and solve number and shape problems
Quick to play alone or together with family
70010000122491.description:
Enjoy elementary-level math through simple 4-choice quiz stages.

Read each question carefully, check the illustrations and conditions, then choose the correct answer from four options. The quizzes include word problems, number rules, counting, calculations, and shape-based questions that test flexible thinking.

How to play:
・Read the question
・Look at the picture and clues
・Choose one answer from four options

The simple format makes it easy to start, even for short play sessions. Kids can use it for light math review, while adults can enjoy it as a quick brain-training challenge. It is also a good fit for parents and children to discuss the answer together.

Recommended for:
・Players who enjoy math quizzes
・Kids reviewing elementary-level math
・Families looking for a simple thinking game
・Anyone who wants short brain-training puzzles

Read carefully, think it through, and find the right answer!

70010000122530.name: Birthday Boy
70010000122530.intro: Birthday Boy: A First-Person Psychological Horror Experience
70010000122530.description:
In Birthday Boy, players delve into the haunting psychological landscape of "Brian," a successful Manhattan investor who is forced to confront the traumatic memories of his past. The game explores the dark corners of his childhood, dominated by his father, Jo, a disturbed engineer with a penchant for dressing as a clown. Jo's eccentricity masked a sinister nature, leading to a tragic family history culminating in the murder of Brian's mother and Jo's own suicide.

Brian’s father had a twisted obsession with performing as a clown, complete with garish makeup and a sadistic sense of humor. Birthdays, meant to be joyous occasions, became nightmares for Brian, marked by his father's cruel antics and physical abuse whenever Brian failed to laugh at his jokes.

As an adult, Brian appears to have moved on, residing in a luxurious Manhattan apartment and running a successful investment firm. However, beneath the polished exterior lies a man still haunted by his past. His home, adorned with perpetual birthday decorations and unopened gifts, reveals his ongoing struggle to cope with childhood horrors.

Birthday Boy offers an immersive journey through Brian's mind as he attempts to bury his trauma with material excess. Dr. Hannah, Brian’s psychiatrist, is convinced that true healing can only come from facing these memories head-on. She urges Brian to return to his dilapidated family home, the place where his nightmares began, to confront the ghosts of his past.

Join Brian on this terrifying journey as he navigates the eerie remnants of his childhood, uncovering buried secrets and battling his inner demons. Birthday Boy challenges players to explore the thin line between memory and reality in this gripping psychological horror experience.

70010000122538.name: Cat Doctor: For Loyal Servants
70010000122538.intro: Essential cat knowledge every servant should know
70010000122538.description:
Is your cat knowledge really correct?

“Cats are unpredictable.”
“That’s just how they are.”
Are you living with your cat based only on that kind of vague image?

This game is a cat knowledge quiz
focused on feline behavior, habits, and feelings.

The meaning behind their gestures, the reasons for their actions,
and the proper way to interact with your feline overlord.
Based on everyday situations, you’ll face quizzes about the cat world
that you think you know—but might not.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question  
・Choose the answer by intuition  
・Understand instantly with results and explanations  

Even if you answer correctly, there’s more to learn.
Even if you get it wrong, you’ll think, “Ah, I see.”

Play from just one question at a time.
Perfect for passing time or refreshing your understanding of cats.

Do you have what it takes to become a worthy servant?

Why not test your knowledge for living with your feline master?


The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000122544.name: Dog Chaos
70010000122544.description:
Step into a fun and chaotic adventure where you play as a mischievous dog exploring a lively world full of tasks, surprises, and challenges. Complete a variety of missions such as collecting items, interacting with objects, and reaching special locations to progress through exciting levels. Each stage offers new objectives and playful scenarios that test your curiosity and problem-solving skills.

Unlock new areas, overcome obstacles, and experience a lighthearted role-playing adventure designed for casual players of all ages. With clear goals, rewarding progression, and plenty of playful chaos, every level brings a new opportunity to explore, complete tasks, and become the ultimate trouble-making hero.

70010000122552.name: Challenge Together! Elementary School Quiz
70010000122552.intro: An elementary school quiz for the whole family
70010000122552.description:
Can you still remember elementary school questions?

“I must have learned this before.”
“I kind of remember it.”
But even problems we think we know can be surprisingly hard,
or things we’ve simply forgotten over time.

This game is a knowledge check quiz
based on what you learn in elementary school.

Japanese, math, science, and social studies.
From basic problems taught at school to questions that make you think,
nostalgic elementary school questions appear in quiz form.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question  
・Choose an answer by intuition  
・Understand instantly with results and explanations  

Even when you answer correctly, there’s still something to learn.
Even when you get it wrong, you’ll discover something new.

Play from just one question at a time.
Perfect for passing time or checking knowledge with your family.

Why not take on these nostalgic elementary school questions
together with your family?

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
TT supports game streaming by content creators.
Both individuals and companies are free to stream this game,
and no permission from TT is required.

70010000122559.name: The Artifactory
70010000122559.intro: Team up in a chaotic factory where crafting, experimentation, and fast teamwork keep the production line alive.
70010000122559.description:
Welcome to The Artifactory, a fast-paced couch co-op party game where teamwork, creativity, and a little factory chaos keep the production line moving.

Work together with up to four players to gather materials, craft items, and assemble loot boxes before the delivery trucks leave. Pass ingredients along conveyor belts, organize the production line, and keep the factory running smoothly.

But crafting isn’t just about following recipes. Experiment with different raw materials to discover new item combinations and unlock new ways to produce goods. The more you explore, the more efficient your factory can become.

Each level introduces new challenges — moving platforms, tricky conveyor layouts, and unpredictable obstacles that will test your coordination and communication.

Whether you are playing with friends, family, or going solo, every shift at the factory turns into a hilarious cooperative challenge where timing, teamwork, and quick thinking make all the difference.

Can your team master the machines and keep the deliveries on schedule?

Key Features
Local couch co-op for up to 4 players
Experiment with materials to discover new crafting recipes
Build and manage chaotic production lines
Creative factory environments with unique mechanics
Fast, cooperative party gameplay
Perfect for family game nights and multiplayer sessions

70010000122563.name: Hentai Protocol: Lesson One
70010000122563.intro: Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.
70010000122563.description:
Solve captivating puzzles featuring images of beautiful anime-style girls. With each image you complete, you'll unlock new ones, and the gradually increasing difficulty makes solving the puzzle a fascinating challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling that you're actually touching every detail.

Soft and relaxing music will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after solving the puzzle, you can examine the image closely and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Stylish anime images.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Relaxing music.

70010000122614.name: Little Things
70010000122614.description:
Play as a small creature named Whys on a journey to find the love of its life, Kys, who has been lost deep within the dungeons. Harness the power of colors to solve puzzles, unlock new abilities, and platform your way to freedom. Jump, dash, and even manipulate gravity itself to overcome every obstacle.

Interact with your surroundings and use your agility to complete levels as quickly as possible and earn satisfying bonuses.

With over 80 levels of challenge and fun, your skills will be constantly put to the test. Precise controls deliver a smooth yet demanding experience, rewarding mastery and quick thinking.

Designed with a gentle learning curve, the game quickly pushes you to improve and refine your abilities.

Die. Retry. Adapt. Conquer the dungeons through skill, persistence, and sheer determination.

Features:
- Color-Based Gameplay: Switch colors to unlock unique abilities and change how you approach every challenge
-  Fast & Precise Controls: Tight movement and instant retries keep the action fluid and addictive
- Dynamic Level Design: Each level introduces new twists, mechanics, and ways to interact with the environment
- 80 Challenging Levels: Test your skills, improve your timing, and master every obstacle

70010000122616.name: Connect Lines
70010000122616.description:
Connect Lines is a satisfying and relaxing puzzle game where your goal is to connect paths and fill the entire board to 100%.

Take your time, think ahead, and find the perfect way to complete each level. Whether you want a quick brain exercise or a longer relaxing session, Connect Lines offers the perfect balance of challenge and calm gameplay.

Game Features:

-Hundreds of engaging levels
-Clean and minimalistic design
-Smooth and intuitive controls
-Relaxing yet challenging puzzles
-Suitable for all ages

Can you connect all the lines and fill the board perfectly?

70010000122622.name: Sunshore City
70010000122622.description:
Welcome to Sunshore City, a bright and relaxing coastal paradise waiting to be explored.

In this cozy exploration game, you wander through a sunny seaside city discovering all the locations it has to offer. From lively beach boardwalks to peaceful neighborhoods, every corner of Sunshore City has something new to find.

Features
>Cozy exploration gameplay
>A vibrant sunny coastal city to explore
>Discover a wide variety of locations
>Relaxing atmosphere with no pressure
>Find every place Sunshore City has to offer

70010000122625.name: Colorium
70010000122625.intro: Master the Spectrum: A Minimalist Challenge of Pure Color and Memory
70010000122625.description:
The Essence of Pure Color Colorium is a minimalist experience stripped of all distractions. No lighting effects, no complex textures, and no shadows—just the raw power of color. It is designed for those who believe they have a "perfect eye" for the spectrum. Here, your only tools are your retinas and your focus. In a world filled with visual noise, Colorium challenges you to see the truth. Can you identify the finest shift in hue? Can you remember a color that has vanished?

Five Modes of Absolute Perception Colorium features five distinct game modes:
Memory Mode: Recall exact color placements in a hidden grid.
Find Odd: Spot the subtle outlier in a field of identical colors.
Find Different: Identify the microscopic shift in pigment between two tones.
Find Which Color is Changed: Track a single tile as it subtly transforms in real-time.
The Vanished Hue: Identify exactly which shade has been removed from the screen.

A Natural Diagnostic for Color Vision Colorium is a powerful tool for uncovering color vision deficiencies. As you progress through the game, subtle patterns in your performance can reveal conditions such as red-green color blindness, blue-yellow deficiency, or other forms of color perception impairment—challenges that many people live with without ever knowing. Colorium does not replace a clinical diagnosis, but it creates a uniquely honest mirror for your visual biology. If certain spectrums consistently challenge you, the game will make it visible.

Train Your Mind While You Play Beyond color, Colorium is a genuine workout for your cognitive abilities. Each session actively engages working memory as you retain and compare color sequences under pressure. The game sharpens selective attention, training your brain to filter out irrelevant visual information and lock onto meaningful differences. Over time, players report measurable improvements in focus, perceptual speed, and the ability to detect fine detail—skills that extend far beyond the game itself.

Zen Through Focus
Pure Minimalism: No light or shadows. Just flat color logic.
Calm and Focused: No leaderboards or pressure. A pure Zen experience.
Visual Calibration: Improve your "eye for detail" and chromatic sensitivity.
Atmospheric Clarity: Low-profile ambient soundtrack for a perfect flow state.

Enter the spectrum. Challenge your perception. Discover the true depth of color.

70010000122639.name: Sneaky Secret Mission!
70010000122639.intro:
Let's stir up some undercover chaos!
Slip past teachers, bosses, and parents, and play to your heart's content!
70010000122639.description:
School, work, home—there are lots of places to play!
Enjoy the thrill as you try not to get caught!
Up to 6 players can join in the fun with a Joy-Con™ for each player!
Watch for the perfect timing to earn as many points as possible!

《Roles》
・Actor
  Play to earn points and try not to get caught!
  Play at a sparkling location to earn even more points!

・Watcher
  Find people playing to earn points!

[Time Attack]
Aim for the fastest clear possible and climb the rankings!
Play without getting caught and try to reduce your time!

[Battle]
Compete for the highest score against friends and CPUs!
Play skillfully to earn the most points!

[Online Mode]
Play in real time against players around the world!
Up to 4 people can play at a time!

In friendly and online matches, the roles are decided randomly!
Finding out which role you'll be is part of the fun!

70010000122651.name: Reel it! World Fishing
70010000122651.intro:
Embark on a fishing adventure around the world!
Cast your line and reel in fish from across the globe!
70010000122651.description:
Let's go fishing on the Nintendo Switch™!
Travel to different world locations like North America, Europe, Africa, and the Amazon!
Each spot is home to lots of unique fish to discover!
Play solo, or compete with up to 4 players using one Joy-Con™ each!
Become the world's greatest angler!

[Score Attack]
Catch as many fish as you can within the time limit!
Look out for big fish to boost your score!

[Endless]
Sit back, relax, and enjoy endless fishing!
Watch the scenery shift from day to night!
Change your gear when the situation calls and search for big catches!

[Ranking]
Compete against players around the world in Score Attack and Endless modes!
Show off your skills by increasing your high score and rank!

[Battle]
Compete with up to 4 players for the highest score!
Face off against CPUs in single-player mode!

[Shop]
Spend the points you've earned from fishing to buy new lures and rods!
Discover the perfect combination for your fishing style!

[Records]
Every fish you catch will be added to your personal encyclopedia!

70010000122658.name: Touhou Yukkuri Mountain
70010000122658.intro:
3D Puzzle: Take It Easy!!!
Touhou Project characters are here in their "Yukkuri" forms!
70010000122658.description:
■ How to Play

Throw, Merge, and Grow!: Just drop the "Yukkuri" into the bowl! When two of the same kind touch, they transform into a larger Yukkuri!

Don't Let Them Fall!: It's Game Over if the Yukkuri overflow from the bowl...

Aim for the High Score!: Growing them large and triggering consecutive merges (Chains) will skyrocket your score!

■ Reimu & Marisa’s Live Commentary!

Reimu and Marisa chat away with game-style commentary based on your play!

Their lively banter and reactions make every match even more exciting!

■ Fully Customizable Features

30 Different Yukkuri!: Play the game, earn points, and head to the shop to unlock new Yukkuri.

Customize the Evolution Order!: You can swap the order of evolution! Set your favorite character as the largest size and create your very own "Yukkuri Mountain"!

■ Various Game Modes

Multiplayer: Supports local matches for up to 4 players! Enjoy a heart-pounding stacking battle together!

Rankings: Compete with players worldwide for the top score and prove you’re the ultimate Yukkuri master!

70010000122665.name: Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000122665.intro: Walk the forbidden path, no matter where it leads.
70010000122665.description:
People gather memories as they live their lives, thus developing their souls. This is the story of a young woman traveling across a ruined continent to find the path toward the future.

The theme of this game is "memory." There are moments when everyone must confront the past and their own memories. All memories, including both successes and failures, become nourishment for the future and help shape people. "Atelier Yumia" tells the story of Yumia and her companions as they follow the path they believe in while being confronted by the memories they discover along the way.

Story:
In a world where alchemy is deemed "taboo," the alchemist Yumia yearns for the truth the lies hidden in a ruined continent. The time has come for her to take the first step on her grand adventure across the continent.

Main features:
- Freely traverse the vast open field in all directions
The continent is an unexplored land where the player can use a wide range of items and actions to forge their path forward.

- Game cycle
Explore the field and gather ingredients in order to synthesize items. The items you create are key to advancing the story and can be used for combat and further exploration. You can also use "Simple Synthesis" to create items while you are out in the field and construct bases using the "Building" feature.

- Create items while out in the field and customize bases however you like!
You can use Simple Synthesis to create exploration tools for opening the path forward, as well as items that will benefit you during combat and synthesis. You can also use the Building feature to construct bases and then decorate them with furniture to your liking.

Note: Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details. Please be aware that other editions containing this product exist. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

Precautions before purchasing the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition:
The following special edition bonuses must be purchased for the Nintendo Switch™ version of the game prior to purchasing the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack in order for them to be usable on the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. These downloadable contents cannot be added later if the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is purchased directly.
• Atelier Yumia - Colorful Collection (Bonus from either the Digital Deluxe Edition or the Ultimate edition.)
• "Black Rose Magician" Costume for Yumia (Bonus from the Ultimate Edition.)

70010000122671.name: Xenoblade Chronicles™: Definitive Edition – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000122671.intro: Join the fight between man and machine in this critically acclaimed RPG—now enhanced for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70010000122671.description:
Discover the origins of Shulk as he and his companions clash against a seemingly unstoppable mechanical menace. Wield a future-seeing blade, chain together attacks, and carefully position your party members in strategic, real-time combat. Journey across a massive world that has been enhanced to run at 4K* resolution in TV mode, and full HD in handheld mode, at 60 frames per second—with smoother and sharper cutscenes.

This Nintendo Switch 2 Edition game contains all the additions and improvements of Xenoblade Chronicles™: Definitive Edition on the Nintendo Switch system, including the extended story of Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected (which has also been enhanced), remixed and remastered music tracks, better quest tracking, and more. It also includes some additional content for you to enjoy!

Race across the Bionis and Mechonis on a high-powered vehicle
