Introducing the Ether Jet: a vehicle that will greatly enhance the speed at which you can traverse the Bionis and Mechonis, both in the main game and in the Future Connected story. But this is not just a convenience feature—you can also race competitively against the clock or your party members at racetracks throughout the world and earn in-game rewards in the process.

Unlock additional equipment, experience fully voiced Heart-to-Heart conversations, and more 

Get equipment made for riding the Ether Jet, and experience improved Heart-to-Heart scenes with fully voiced dialogue for the first time!

Already have Xenoblade Chronicles™: Definitive Edition for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack!   

If you already have the game for Nintendo Switch, you can purchase the upgrade pack** separately to play this version on Nintendo Switch 2.

70010000122676.name: Escape game R00M13
70010000122676.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

70010000122691.name: Xenoblade Chronicles™ 2 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000122691.intro: Lead Rex, Pyra, and the world to refuge in an adventure enhanced for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70010000122691.description:
Lost in a sea of clouds, entire civilizations rest on the backs of Titans. As the giant beasts march toward death, the last hope is a scavenger named Rex—and Pyra, a living weapon known as a Blade. Command a group of Blades and lead them to countless strategic victories as you search for the fabled paradise Pyra calls home. This journey has been enhanced with 4K* resolution in TV mode, and full HD in handheld mode, at 60 frames per second—and with smoother and sharper cutscenes.

Discover a new rare Blade—and control your Blades to fight in mercenary squad battles

There’s an additional Blade out there for you to find! MOMO has two modes, real and imaginary, that you can swap between to change her appearance and elemental affinity. She also has a quest for you to complete.

Not only that, but you can directly command your Blades in the Merc Assault action battle mode! Choose up to six Blades to send out on Merc Missions where you move, fight, and swap freely between the Blades under your command. Combining Blade Specials will be key to victory!

Unlock new outfit designs for Pyra and Mythra

Customize the look of Pyra and Mythra with new outfit designs exclusive to this Nintendo Switch 2 Edition game. These appear not only while you’re adventuring, but also during cutscenes.

Already have Xenoblade Chronicles™ 2 for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack!   

If you already have the game for Nintendo Switch, you can purchase the upgrade pack** separately to play this version on Nintendo Switch 2.

70010000122696.name: Xenoblade Chronicles™ 3 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000122696.intro: Live to fight. Fight to live. Now with enhancements for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system
70010000122696.description:
Join Noah and Mio, members of the two opposing nations of Keves and Agnus, on a heartfelt journey through a warring world with a dark secret. Traverse massive, fantastical landscapes and master seamless real-time RPG combat that has all been enhanced to run at 4K* resolution in TV mode, and full HD in handheld mode, at 60 frames per second with smoother and sharper cutscenes. 

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition also features some additional content, including newly voiced event scenes!

Command six characters—including a mythical new Hero—and seamlessly enter real-time RPG combat

All six of your core party members jump into action against enemies, auto-attacking with their distinct arts and weapons. Position your team to take advantage of Arts and maximize damage and debuffs. Pairs of characters can Interlink to form a mighty Ouroboros capable of taking down the most threatening enemies with powerful Arts. 

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition also adds the mythical new Hero, Shimmer to join you on your adventure! Shimmer is a speedy Attacker who can unleash devastating rapid-fire combos on her foes. She also wields the power of Foresight to see the future!

Test your strength against waves of enemies in Heroes’ Vault mode

Defeat as many enemies as you can in a defensive battle mode, exclusive to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. The more enemies you defeat, the more you’ll fill a gauge that you can use to strengthen your forces. Enhance your abilities, gain additional allies, but choose wisely—you’ll need to prepare well to defeat the almighty foe awaiting you at the end!

Already have Xenoblade Chronicles™ 3 for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack! 
    
If you already have the game for Nintendo Switch, you can purchase the upgrade pack** separately to enjoy all the performance enhancements and additions of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, including the additional Hero and Heroes’ Vault mode.

70010000122699.name: OBAKEIDORO 2: Chase & Seek
70010000122699.intro:
"It's time to take on those monsters!"
Can you escape? Or will you hunt humans as a monster?
70010000122699.description:
A chase battle between Monsters and Humans! Round 2!
The new setting is Japan?!

You only have 3 minutes!
Run and hide. If even one person escapes, the Humans win!
If everyone is caught, the Monsters win!
Make use of the Monsters' special abilities to catch the Humans.
Up to 8 players can play together in Local or Online play.

Obakeidoro 2 is an asymmetrical multiplayer action game where players are split into Humans and Monsters to play chase and seek.
Aside from running and hiding, Humans can use their secret weapon, "Activate Lantern," to stun Monsters.
If used skillfully, you may be able to turn a crisis into an opportunity.
The key to winning for Monsters is through their powerful skills. Utilize unique Monster abilities, such as moving through walls or detecting footprints, to catch Humans.

◆ Work together with your friends using the new Human action, "Call"!
This newly added action enables you to call out to nearby allies.
When your allies respond, you can use cooperative actions such as "Solo Throw," "Two Person Jump," or "Bond Forger"!

◆ Round up everyone at once with the new Monster action, "Super Catch"!
Use this new action with improved range and visuals to capture the Humans!

70010000122717.name: National Adult General Knowledge Selection Test
70010000122717.description:
Is your common sense really up to the test?

“I know this much.”
“Any adult should know that.”
But even knowledge we feel confident about can sometimes be vague or based on assumptions.

This game is a common sense quiz
based on knowledge useful in everyday life and society.

Word meanings, social rules, and everyday trivia.
Through situations from daily life,
you’ll face quiz questions about general knowledge you think you know.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question  
・Choose an answer by intuition  
・Understand instantly with results and explanations  

Even when you answer correctly, there’s still something to learn.
Even when you get it wrong, you’ll discover something new.

Play from just one question at a time.
Perfect for passing time or refreshing your knowledge.

How far will your common sense take you?
Why not put it to the test?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000122723.name: Asphalt Paver
70010000122723.description:
Start with a pile of rocks and turn it into something people actually drive on.

Collect raw materials, move them to processing, and turn them into fresh asphalt ready to be laid down. Then get to work, spread it, smooth it, and watch rough ground turn into clean, solid roads.

Every completed stretch earns you money, and every upgrade makes the job faster. Better tools, stronger vehicles, and heavy machines take the pressure off and keep things moving while you focus on expanding.

Build more, automate more, and keep the operation running efficiently as the workload grows. What starts as manual work slowly becomes a full construction setup running around you.

It’s simple: gather, process, pave, repeat, until there’s a road where there used to be nothing. Just don’t step in the asphalt before it cools.

70010000122733.name: Can You Explain It? World History Test
70010000122733.intro: Can you talk about the history of the world?
70010000122733.description:
Can you explain the history of the world?

“You learned it at school.”
“You kind of remember it.”
But even the history we think we know can be surprisingly vague,
and we may struggle to explain how events are connected.

This game is a world history knowledge quiz
covering history from ancient times to the modern era.

Famous events, historical figures, civilizations, and the flow of history.
Based on world history,
you’ll face quiz questions about historical knowledge you think you know.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question  
・Choose an answer by intuition  
・Understand instantly with results and explanations  

Even when you answer correctly, there’s still something to learn.
Even when you get it wrong, you’ll think, “Ah, I see.”

Play from just one question at a time.
Perfect for passing time or refreshing your historical knowledge.

How much of your world history knowledge still holds up today?
Why not put it to the test?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000122741.name: Car Sales Simulator 2026
70010000122741.description:
The ultimate car dealership experience. Buy cars at auctions, restore them to their former glory, and sell them for a profit. Customize and expand your office to build the most prestigious car empire in the world!

- Build Your Showroom.  
Start from a simple office and transform it into a world-class car dealership. Take full control of your office: expand its size, choose unique layouts, and customize every detail to reflect your personal style. Your office isn't just a workplace—it’s a symbol of your success.

- The Thrill of the Auction.  
Travel to various auto auctions to find hidden gems and rare classics. Outbid your rivals and secure the best deals. Every car has a story, and it’s up to you to decide which ones are worth the investment.

- Restore to Perfection.  
Get your hands dirty in the workshop. Repair mechanical issues and give each vehicle a fresh look. A well-restored car isn't just a machine—it’s a masterpiece that will attract the most elite buyers.

- Master the Market.  
Buy low, sell high. Use your business intuition to negotiate with customers and maximize your profits. Manage your budget wisely to buy rarer cars and a grander office as you climb to the top of the industry.

- Your Empire, Your Rules.  
In Car Sales Simulator 2026, you are the boss. Whether you prefer flipping quick city cars or collecting luxury exotics, the path to becoming the ultimate car mogul is entirely in your hands.

70010000122748.name: Wild West Survivors
70010000122748.intro: Survive the frontier. Hunt the undead.
70010000122748.description:
In a world where the undead have consumed the frontier, survival is the only law left. Step into the boots of a fearless bounty hunter and fight through waves of zombies across cursed towns, abandoned mines, and forgotten wilderness. Unlock powerful survivors, devastating weapons, and loyal companions as you carve your path through the apocalypse.  

- Begin your journey as a lone gunslinger and unlock unique playable characters, each with their own abilities and playstyles.

- Create hundreds of powerful build combinations using a perk system that enhances weapons, triggers explosions, and unleashes elemental powers such as lightning, fire, and ice.

- Fight alongside loyal companions with unique abilities. Some pets strengthen your attacks and skills, while others bring powerful combat abilities of their own.

- Survive against massive zombie hordes, deadly elite enemies, and terrifying bosses that will challenge your reflexes, positioning, and strategy.

- Explore diverse locations ranging from abandoned western towns and graveyards to dark mines, cursed forests, and forgotten frontier outposts. Every location introduces new dangers, secrets, and gameplay opportunities.

- Wield a massive arsenal of weapons, from classic revolvers and lever-action rifles to experimental creations like Tesla gun and explosive heavy weaponry.

- Gather resources and experience during every run to upgrade your characters, pets, weapons, and abilities, allowing you to take on increasingly dangerous enemies.

- Immerse yourself in stylized visuals and a soundtrack inspired by the brutal atmosphere of a zombie-infested Wild West.

- Complete missions to unlock locations and gameplay modifiers.

70010000122754.name: Car Parking Simulator 2026
70010000122754.description:
Take the wheel and put your driving precision to the test in an engaging parking experience designed for drivers of all skill levels.

Complete a variety of parking challenges, earn rewards, and improve your skills as you tackle increasingly demanding objectives. Whether you're aiming for perfect performance, competing against the clock, or simply enjoying a relaxing drive, there's always a new challenge waiting behind the wheel.

Unlock a diverse collection of vehicles, expand your garage, and customize your favorite cars to match your personal style. From everyday vehicles to powerful machines, each car offers a unique driving experience as you work your way toward becoming a true parking master.

With different gameplay modes, rewarding progression, vehicle customization, and plenty of opportunities to earn and upgrade, every session offers a fresh reason to get back on the road.

70010000122760.name: Alt Girl for Skoof - ALTiversary Edition
70010000122760.intro: Choose your ideal & absolutely legal Alt Girl right now!
70010000122760.description:
An immersive skoof simulator in visual novel format.

You're a single, well over forty man with a firmly established worldview but you're still not happy with your life? Don't be sad, you just need to recall your SkoofUslugi account password, and in just a couple of clicks you can get your own alt girl legally granted from the state!

70010000122762.name: Honey Sprint
70010000122762.intro: Run, Jump, and Devour All the Honey
70010000122762.description:
Dive into an irresistible chase in Honey Sprint, where a hungry bear must escape a furious swarm while collecting as much honey as possible along the way. With simple controls and nonstop action, each run blends quick reflexes, smart decisions, and pure fun.

Dodge obstacles, slide under branches, and jump at the right moment to keep your flow while chasing ever-higher scores. The tracks change with every attempt, always bringing fresh challenges and that addictive “just one more run” feeling.

Colorful, dynamic, and full of personality, Honey Sprint is perfect for quick sessions and lighthearted moments, delivering an engaging experience that balances challenge and pure entertainment.

70010000122768.name: Golem Lights
70010000122768.intro: Light the Path, Awaken the Golems
70010000122768.description:
Get ready for a radiant journey in Golem Lights, an engaging puzzle where every beam of light can change everything. Take control of the Mage Golem and use its energy to illuminate the path, awaken other golems, and create luminous connections until you reach the mysterious Crystal Portal.

With 60 levels spread across three enchanting biomes, from the cave’s edge to the crystal core, each challenge invites you to experiment, adjust, and discover new solutions. With no time limits, the experience is relaxed yet strategic, perfect for players who enjoy thinking calmly and testing different possibilities.

Watch as light gradually reveals the environment, activate golems with unique abilities, and manipulate the surroundings to expand your illumination. Each stage is a small puzzle of logic and creativity, where planning and curiosity go hand in hand.

Explore, experiment, and let your light guide the way to victory.

70010000122774.name: Noodlebound
70010000122774.intro: Slice, Dash, and Recover the Lost Flavor
70010000122774.description:
Get ready for an action-packed adventure in Noodlebound, a 2D pixel art platformer that combines precise movement with direct and dynamic combat. Take on the role of a ramen samurai on a journey to recover ingredients that have come to life due to a mage’s magic, facing enemies, traps, and bosses across 30 stages full of personality.

With abilities such as jumping, dashing, and close-range attacks, every challenge demands quick reflexes and sharp decisions. The levels are intense and engaging, perfect for players who enjoy fast-paced action, challenging combat, and charismatic characters.

Explore environments filled with danger, face enemies with unique behaviors, and prove your skill in epic boss battles. In every stage, you will need to observe patterns, act with precision, and master your abilities to progress.

Sharpen your blade, keep the rhythm, and fight to restore the balance of flavors.

70010000122780.name: Kingdom Trails
70010000122780.intro: Step into a peaceful world where every path tells a story.
70010000122780.description:
Wander through rolling hills, quiet forests, and forgotten ruins as you follow winding trails that lead to charming villages, scenic viewpoints, and secret locations tucked away off the beaten path. Each area invites you to slow down, take in the atmosphere, and enjoy the journey rather than the destination.

Whether you're watching over distant mountains or listening to the gentle sounds of nature, Kingdom Trails is designed to help you relax and unwind.

Features:
>A serene, open kingdom filled with diverse landscapes
>Exploration-focused gameplay with hidden locations to find
>Immersive ambient soundscapes and calming music
> Cozy, low-pressure experience—no combat or stress

70010000122783.name: Moon Raider: Anniversary Edition
70010000122783.intro: A half-alien princess must save her dying mother, the former queen of the moon. Supports 2-player co-op!
70010000122783.description:
A half-alien princess must save her dying mother, the former queen of the moon. Supports 2-player co-op!


Ava is the young daughter of the brilliant-but-aging scientist Dr. Cavor and Selene, the former queen of the moon. As a selenite, Selene's life depends on the special energy only moon gems can provide. With none left and time running out, Dr. Cavor enlists his daughter to raid the moon of as many gems as she can find!

Ava must survive the treacherous catacombs deep beneath the surface of the moon. Her enemies, a legion of corrupt aliens that now rule the moon with force, are far less primitive than they first appear. Their world is full of terrifying technology, deadly traps, and armed soldiers at the ready. Ava soon realizes that the only way to save her mother is to save the moon from itself.

Features:
- Explore a diverse, handcrafted world that stays fresh from start to finish
- Find hidden upgrades and secret areas
- 10 beautiful environments to explore
- 11 epic boss battles
- Two-player local co-op mode

70010000122788.name: Forensic Science Mystery – Crime Scene Tap & Deduction Game –
70010000122788.intro:
「The evidence is in the illustration.」
Expose the truth with observation and deduction! Step into the role of a forensic investigator.
70010000122788.description:
「Forensic Science Mystery」is an observation-based mystery game where you find hidden clues within illustrations.

Use the hints and out-of-place details left at the scene to find the point the question is asking about — then tap it!
「What looks unnatural?」「Where did the culprit leave a trace?」Think like a forensic investigator and solve each case scientifically.

The key is sharp observation — spotting small clues hidden in seemingly ordinary illustrations.
Use your intuition and deduction to uncover the truth behind each case!

「So the evidence was here!」
「You'd never notice without checking every little detail!」

Perfect for mystery fans, as well as those who enjoy spot-the-difference and brain puzzles.
Each question is quick to play, making it great for short breaks.

———————————————
TT supports gameplay streamers.
No permission from TT is required for gameplay streaming, whether personal or commercial.

70010000122794.name: Arcade Archives ARMADILLO RACING
70010000122794.intro: Never Seen Before?! An Active Racing Game!
70010000122794.description:
"ARMADILLO RACING" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1997.
Control an armadillo that rolls as it picks up speed, and head for the finish line through obstacle courses filled with unique events, or sprint courses designed for pure racing enjoyment. Finish in 1st place and you can enjoy a fun bonus game, too!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000122818.name: Rhythm Heaven™ Groove
70010000122818.intro: Tune in and groove to a collection of games that will challenge your rhythm
70010000122818.description:
Get ready to use your ears! Time your button presses to the beat in this broad collection of rhythm games that are easy to learn and rewarding to master. Catch flying veggies, bounce fruit off your biceps, swing sledgehammers, and more as you focus on catchy original music—including tracks by renowned Japanese musician Tsunku♂. 

Boost frogs into the air, flap umbrellas, and so much more in over 80 rhythm games—and that’s just solo mode!

Cooperate and compete in over 30 rhythm games for up to four players

Gather up to four players* around a single system to slice arrows, pluck hair from onions, and more. Whether you’re striving to see who can be first to snatch the cake, or teaming up to save the prince with the power of tennis, these games are sure to test your ability to keep the beat.

Become a magician and use the power of rhythm to beat monsters in Beatspell

As you progress in the game, you'll gradually unlock Beatspell—a mode in which you combat monsters with rhythm-based spells, like fire and healing, by tapping buttons to the beat. What spells will strike a chord when you face down your foes?

70010000122839.name: DRIFTCRAFT
70010000122839.intro: Build your perfect vehicle from endless combinations, tear through a vibrant open world, smash objects to gather resources, and craft a world that's entirely your own.
70010000122839.description:
Driftcraft drops you into a colorful, fully explorable sandbox where the only limits are your imagination and your fuel tank.

Crash through the environment to harvest resources. Use what you collect to build, expand, and customize your world the way you want it. It's part racing game, part survival, part creative playground — and it's all yours.

CHOOSE YOUR MACHINE
From drift-tuned FR legends to mud-caked off-roaders, from towering trucks to razor-sharp supercars — Driftcraft gives you a massive, ever-growing vehicle roster with near-infinite customization. Every machine can be made uniquely yours. Find your style and push it to the limit.

SMASH. COLLECT. BUILD.
Resources don't spawn in menus — you earn them by driving. Ram into objects scattered across the world, collect what falls, and put it to work. Manage your stockpile, explore hidden corners of the map, and build a world that reflects how you play.

A WORLD WORTH EXPLORING
Driftcraft's cartoon-style open world is packed with secrets, terrain variety, and places that reward curiosity. Whether you're pulling stunts on a mountain ridge or discovering hidden resource caches in forgotten valleys — there's always something new just over the horizon.

YOUR RIDE. YOUR WORLD.
No multiplayer lobbies. No waiting. Just you, a ridiculous amount of vehicles, and a sandbox that grows as you do. Driftcraft is the solo experience that gives you total creative freedom — build big, drive fast, and leave your mark on every corner of the map.

Download now and start building the world you actually want to drive through.

70010000122847.name: Perfect City
70010000122847.intro: A perfect city, until you start asking why
70010000122847.description:
Tino and Mila arrive in Perfect City, a cheerful place where everything feels easy because nobody has to make hard choices. As they explore its strange rules and surreal logic, they discover that real freedom, individuality, and life itself depend on the courage to think, question, and choose.

An interactive storybook experience. A linear narrative adventure that is perfect for young readers to enjoy a captivating story at their own pace.

70010000122854.name: Culdcept The First Saturn Tribute
70010000122854.intro: The classic fusion of board and card games from 1997 is back and better with modern features!
70010000122854.description:
RETURN TO THE BEGINNING 
The original Culdcept was released in 1997; a combination of digital board game and deck building, it saw numerous sequels, but that very first game never left Japan, until now!

ROLL THE DICE 
Culdcept The First uses a die (or two sometimes!) to move around the game board, with the aim of gathering a target amount of magic, then returning to the castle to win.  
The spaces on the board are land which can be claimed by summoning a creature to defend them. Land comes in four different colors representing terrain types; these in turn match the creatures’ alignments. Land can also be upgraded, granting additional advantages to its owner.

OVER 300 CARDS 
If an opponent lands on your space, they can either pay a toll or attack your creature with one of their own. In these battles, players can also use special item cards to maximize their chances of winning. Your deck or “book,” consists of 50 cards of various types, with a total of over 300!

NEW FEATURES
Rewind: Jump back in time.
Quick Save & Load: available anytime during the game.
Bonus Pack: Get more reward cards after a match.
Reveal Hands: Keep an eye on yours hand and your opponents'.

STORY 
Humanity was prosperous on the continent of Bablashca. But when mysterious stone tablets appear – fragments of the powerful ancient book, Culdcept –  chaos and conflict follow. 
A lone youth arises to bring peace to the land, and you get to follow along!

70010000122857.name: Billy Boots' Treasure
70010000122857.intro: When everything freezes, it only takes one brave move to start again.
70010000122857.description:
When the Giant stops playing, the toys in Villa Cascabel are trapped in a world where time seems frozen, and toys are forbidden to move or even dream about the outside world. Lucas, a toy cowboy, lives under the rule of the tyrannical Sheriff Clockwork Claw.

When rumors of a Big Cleanse threaten to make some toys disappear, Lucas and his companions search for a legendary treasure hidden by Bili the Boots, said to grant toys true freedom.

With a group of unlikely allies, they set out on an adventure through familiar places that have become dangerous landscapes. Their mission is to find three keys and the Eternal Golden Dock, hoping to change the fate of all the toys that were once loved.

An interactive storybook experience. A perfect linear narrative adventure for young readers to enjoy a captivating story at their own pace.

70010000122861.name: The Case of the World between Worlds
70010000122861.intro: A hidden magical system, a surprising ally, and a city on the edge.
70010000122861.description:
Tomas discovers that beneath a modern city there is an invisible magical network that keeps the balance between humans and magical creatures. When that balance begins to fail, he teams up with Lumi, a misunderstood magical creature, to investigate strange anomalies that no one else seems to notice. As the mystery unfolds, Tomas learns that harmony between both worlds cannot be achieved through control, it has to be built through cooperation, trust, and coexistence.

An interactive storybook experience. A linear narrative adventure, perfect for young readers to enjoy a captivating story at their own pace.

70010000122863.name: The Universal Symphony
70010000122863.intro: Turn it up, save the rhythm.
70010000122863.description:
Joy City is a vibrant city protected by the Harmony Keepers, a K pop inspired team who battle the Dark Echoes, creatures that spread apathy and steal harmony. When a powerful Echo attacks the Core of Creativity, the team learns that only perfect unity and synchronization can save the city and bring its rhythm back.
An interactive storybook experience. A linear narrative adventure perfect for young readers to enjoy a captivating story at their own pace.

70010000122869.name: Planet of Lana II - Supporter Pack
70010000122869.description:
Step into the cinematic world of Planet of Lana with the Supporter Pack, a heartfelt collection celebrating creativity, care, and imagination and inviting fans to walk a little closer beside Lana and Mui.

Inside, you’ll discover:

Digital Art Book
Explore the evolution of the game’s painterly world, from lush forests and tropical reefs to snowy peaks and makeshift cities, alongside characters, creatures, locations, in-game scenes, and concept art.

Language Companion
Discover the game’s fictional language, learn basic phrases, gain insight into select dialogue while diving deeper into the lore of Novo.

Thank you for helping us bring this hand-painted world to life.

70010000122875.name: Archery King
70010000122875.description:
Become the ultimate ruler of the range in Archery King — a fantasy archery game where precision, focus, and timing lead to victory. Travel through beautiful forest paths, ancient ruins, and medieval-inspired training grounds as you take on increasingly challenging target layouts.

Test your aim across a variety of levels filled with moving targets, tricky angles, and rewarding bullseyes. Each shot matters, so steady your hand, draw your bow, and prove your skills in a world built for true archery masters.

With satisfying gameplay, immersive environments, and a classic medieval atmosphere, Archery King delivers a fun and addictive experience for players who love target shooting games and skill-based challenges.

70010000122881.name: Criminal Hearts: Obsession Bad Girls Dating Sim
70010000122881.intro:
Some women come with a warning. 
You've never been good at listening.
70010000122881.description:
Criminal Hearts puts you on rooftops at 3am, in back rooms where deals go sideways, and across the table from three women who should scare you.

They don't.

One of them doesn't talk. One of them talks too much. One tells you exactly what she is and dares you to stay anyway.

Every line you choose either pulls her closer or shuts the door for good. Your companion has your back and tells you the truth, but the risk is yours to take.

Say the right thing and she lets something slip she's never told anyone. Push too hard and she's gone before you can fix it.

Three women. Three ways this ends. None of them planned on you.


Features:

● ONE WRONG WORD CHANGES EVERYTHING: Trust here is earned slowly and lost instantly.

● THREE WOMEN WORTH THE RISK: Each one guards something different, and none of them hand it over.

● DARK ROMANCE VISUAL NOVEL: Cinematic, heavy, and built on choices that stick.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Redemption, ruin, or something a lot closer to obsession.

● A COMPANION IN YOUR CORNER: Reads the room, calls you out, never lies to you.


Three women nobody has ever gotten close to.
You're not here to be careful.
Get close.

70010000122887.name: Criminal Hearts: Obsession Bad Boys Dating Sim
70010000122887.intro:
Some men come with a warning. 
You've never been good at listening.
70010000122887.description:
Criminal Hearts puts you on rooftops at 3am, in back rooms where deals go sideways, and across the table from three men who should scare you.

They don't.

One of them doesn't talk. One of them talks too much. One tells you exactly what he is and dares you to stay anyway.

Every line you choose either pulls him closer or shuts the door for good. Your companion has your back and tells you the truth, but the risk is yours to take.

Say the right thing and he lets something slip he's never told anyone. Push too hard and he's gone before you can fix it.

Three men. Three ways this ends. None of them planned on you.


Features:

● ONE WRONG WORD CHANGES EVERYTHING: Trust here is earned slowly and lost instantly.

● THREE MEN WORTH THE RISK: Each one guards something different, and none of them hand it over.

● DARK ROMANCE VISUAL NOVEL: Cinematic, heavy, and built on choices that stick.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Redemption, ruin, or something a lot closer to obsession.

● A COMPANION IN YOUR CORNER: Reads the room, calls you out, never lies to you.


Three men nobody has ever gotten close to.

You're not here to be careful.

Get close.

70010000122899.name: Sniper Dan
70010000122899.intro: A ridiculous, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist.
70010000122899.description:
Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic, he’s not here to harm anyone. Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and good intentions.

Sniper Dan is a hidden object game unlike any other. Objects aren't always well hidden and the solution involves shooting them. Each job follows a simple and highly respected method.

Figure out the problem. Use the clues. HMM…

Find the problem. Scope the area. AHA!

Fix the problem. Shoot. WHEE!

You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done? 
Dan’s business takes him to villages, parks, farms, airports, cities and beyond. Special challenges keep every day fresh. Take on optional work for extra cash, tackle bigger jobs for even bigger rewards and uncover secrets that leave citizens quietly convinced something magical just happened.
It did. It was Dan!

Between contracts, upgrade your rifle, decorate your office hub and grow your entirely legitimate troubleshooting business. Unlock bonus games and extra modes like Time Attack, Ammo Hunt and Photo Mode, all under the judgmental eye of Rank Chook.

Funny, colourful and sure to leave you wanting more, Sniper Dan is about finding what’s wrong, fixing it fast and moving on to the next job.

Scope the problem. Take the shot. Make everyone happy.

70010000122909.name: Lost Lands: Stories about the Sorceress, the Prince and the Minotaur
70010000122909.intro: The great deeds of little heroes.
70010000122909.description:
New stories by author Susan Shepard recount the times of the construction of the Stronghold of Five Worlds.

“Lost Lands: Stories about the Sorceress, the Prince and the Minotaur” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

Susan Shepard opens the book of stories once again! This time, you will embark on a journey with three new characters. Together, you will explore a new corner of the Lost Lands, lying between the legendary tower and an ancient city that once stood nearby. In these different yet intertwined stories, the heroes confront the value of friendship, the sense of justice and injustice, the impact of their decisions, the thirst for victory, and the pursuit of freedom.
This journey reveals that the Lost Lands are endless, full of uncharted corners, fascinating events, and vivid heroes!

- Discover the new charismatic heroes of this world!
- Learn about the stories of the past that shaped the events of the earlier parts of the saga!
- Battles, thrill, and risky adventures — explore the world of the Lost Lands from a new perspective!
- Who entered the Lost Lands long before Susan? Meet the firstcomer!
- Take part in the great race for a priceless prize — your own freedom!

70010000122915.name: Earth Must Die
70010000122915.description:
From the desk of VValak Lizardtongue, Grand Shepherd of the Tyrythian Empire:

Well this is just complete and utter bulls**t.

Those idiotic, moronic Terranoids think they can just roll in here and take over my beautiful Tyrythian kingdom? The kingdom that I built from the ground up with my bare hands, and only sort of inherited from my dear, sweet, extremely dead father?

Did I mention that this is bulls**t?

It’s fine though, because what they don’t realize is that I am going to make them very, very dead. Along with my trusty sidekick and childhood nursing bot Milky – please do not ask me questions about that – I will whizz over to Earth, turn it into a stinking pile of rubble, and be back home in time for a warm glass of milk before bed.

Earth Must Die is the story of my glorious rise to power (off the back of my adored father’s passing), my subsequent accidental surrender to the Terranoids, and my infamous revenge against Earth and everything it stands for.

Apparently the story is retold in the form of one of those old point and click adventure games that people gave a sh*t about in the 1990s, I wanna say? But in 2026. Doesn’t sound like a good idea to me, but what do I know – I’m just a benevolent, terrifying leader of worlds who everyone loves and also super respects.

I’m also not sure what the phrase “British comedy royalty” is supposed to mean, but I guess they got a bunch of “funny” f*ckwits to dub over my glorious voyage to feed the Terranoids their own bumholes?

How do I not have someone to do this for me? Anyway, apparently my magnificent story is told over a series of many hours, and you click a bunch and things happen and really I don’t care about any of this, I’m just here for the glory.

VValak signing off.

70010000122923.name: Hello, Yoshi!
70010000122923.description:
"Hello, Yoshi!" Are you ready to play? With this free application from the little-kid-friendly My Mario brand, you and your kiddo can play with Yoshi's face and delight in all his various expressions.
 
■Make Silly Faces
Team up with your kiddo to see how silly Yoshi can get when you pull and stretch his face or take turns poking and spinning him around. Tap on the ? Block in the top-left corner of the screen and select an icon to make items—like a Super Mushroom, a Super Star, or pipes—and even enemies appear alongside Yoshi.
 
■Peekaboo!
Invite Yoshi to play peekaboo by tapping on the leftmost icon in the ? Block menu. Boo may even make a guest appearance! 

■Built-In Breaks
Good night, Yoshi! Yoshi gets tuckered out after playing for a while and will fall fast asleep. At that point no amount of poking can wake him up! This is a great opportunity to take a break and help parents limit their child's screen time. If you want to keep the fun going, you can turn off this feature by tapping the gear icon in the top-right corner of the screen when the application starts.
 
■Play Offline
There's no need to be connected to the internet to play this application. After you download it, you're good to go!

Terms of Service:
https://support.nintendo.com/en/legal-notes/my-mario-eula-selector

70010000122944.name: Nationwide Academic Check Junior High Level
70010000122944.intro: Nostalgic yet challenging — a complete check of junior high knowledge
70010000122944.description:
Do you remember the problems you studied in junior high school?

“You probably learned this before.”
“I kind of remember it.”
Even questions that seem familiar may turn out to be harder than expected, or things you may have already forgotten.

This game is an academic knowledge check quiz
based on subjects taught in junior high school.

Japanese, mathematics, science, and social studies.
From basic questions learned at school to problems that make you stop and think,
you’ll face a variety of junior high–level questions in quiz form.

How to play is simple.
• Read the question  
• Choose the answer by intuition  
• Understand instantly with the result and explanation  

Even if you answer correctly, you can’t let your guard down.
Even if you’re wrong, every question offers a satisfying “aha!” moment.

Play one question at a time whenever you like.
Perfect for passing time or checking your knowledge.

How much of your academic ability still holds up?

Even adults may find it surprisingly difficult.
Why not challenge this comprehensive junior high–level test?

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
TT supports game streaming by video creators.
Both individuals and organizations are free to stream this game without obtaining permission from TT.

70010000122950.name: Learn with Illustrations! English Prepositions 4-Choice Quiz
70010000122950.intro: Learn English prepositions with pictures and fun 4-choice quizzes!
70010000122950.description:
A fun quiz game where you learn English prepositions by looking at illustrations and choosing from four answers.

Practice tricky words like “in,” “on,” “under,” and “behind” in a simple and intuitive way.

Because each question is based on pictures, it’s easy to play even if you’re not confident in English. Players of all ages, from kids to adults, can jump in and enjoy learning at their own pace.

Perfect for quick play sessions, study time, or brain training, this is a light and enjoyable way to build your sense of everyday English.

70010000122956.name: MONOWAVE
70010000122956.intro:
An adventure where no one gets hurt begins now...
Explore the world and restore lost peace!
70010000122956.description:
MONOWAVE is a puzzle adventure game following the journey of Mono, a newborn Guardian spirit destined to protect the four Emotions: Happiness,Sorrow,Anger and Anxiety.

Everything changed, when the Emotion Shards within the Prism suddenly vanished, scattering the Emotions across the land. It’s up to the newborn Guardian, Mono, to reunite the wayward Emotions and restore harmony to the land.

4 Unique Emotions & Powers
As the guardian spirit of Emotions, you’ll be able to harness special powers based on anxiety, anger, sorrow, and happiness.

■Happiness: Jump to reach new heights. Nothing can stop your glee!
■Sorrow: Dive underwater and flow through subterranean passageways to reach unexplored depths.
■Anger: Wall-jump with the power of your fury to pave a path forward.
■Anxiety: Evade potential threats and navigate difficult terrain with your heightened senses.

70010000122978.name: Solateria
70010000122978.intro: Solateria is an action Metroidvania featuring beautiful hand-drawn art and a focus on parry-based combat.
70010000122978.description:
[Story]
A small fire warrior with no memories goes on a journey to find the King—the only hope to save the world.

Solateria, the land of the Sun, once prospered under the Primordial Flame’s blessings.
But everything changed when the Shadow Plague—the most deadly catastrophe it ever faced—descended, pushing Solateria to the brink of ruin.
You wake up as a small fire warrior with no memories of the past. The only thing you can recall is a voice urging you to find the vanished King and save the world.

Defeat powerful bosses corrupted by the Shadow Plague through stylish, parry-focused combat, and begin your journey to find the King.
In the end, you will have to confront the truth.

[Game Features]
■ Stylish Parry-Focused Combat
Master enemy attack patterns and parry with perfect timing. Experience Solateria’s exhilarating combat flow, where parries lead straight into powerful counterattacks.

■ Tense Battles Against Formidable Enemies
Break through bosses infected by the Shadow Plague with precise parries and stylish action. They won’t go down easily—but victory brings a deep sense of accomplishment.
Absorb the King’s power at King Statues scattered throughout Solateria to grow stronger. Unlock Heat Cores with rare items to unleash the fire warrior’s true power. Acquire new skills and enjoy increasingly spectacular combat.

■ Deep Customization Through Upgrades
Enhance your Core Stones and equip various Parts to shape your own combat style. Parts can create powerful synergies when combined in specific ways.

■ Untold Stories in a Fallen World
In Solateria, brought to ruin by the Shadow Plague, countless beings fight their own battles for their own reasons—even those who have become infected bosses. Battle powerful bosses, meet new NPCs, and uncover the stories they’ve kept hidden. Complete side quests and witness their final choices.

■ Active Interaction and Information Gathering
Explore the world of Solateria and gather “information” in many ways—collect fragments of memory, talk to NPCs, and more. The more thoroughly you explore, the more helpful information you’ll uncover, and what you learn will be marked on the map. Of course, how you explore Solateria is entirely up to you.

■ A Beautiful Hand-Drawn World Map
Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted world of hand-drawn art. Use various skills to find hidden elements and create shortcuts. Maybe you’ll recover your lost memories while exploring this shadowed world.


- Choose your build with 40 different Parts combinations
- Multiple upgrade systems, including cooking, refining, and crafting
- Over 50 beautiful story cutscenes
- Unique and powerful bosses and mini-bosses
- Hidden locations reached through skill combinations
- A vast world you can explore freely in any order
- The story of a small fire warrior setting out to find the King—the only hope to save a fallen world

70010000122987.name: EGGCONSOLE Hercules PC-8801mkIISR
70010000122987.intro: Driven by Lord Deus’s jealousy, young Hercules must face a gauntlet of trials. Use your dash as a weapon and tackle those monsters head-on!
70010000122987.description:
This title is an action-puzzle game originally released by Kogado Studio in 1986.

Players take on the role of Herakuresu-kun, overcoming numerous trials on a journey to meet Lord Deus. Each stage is filled with interactive elements: blocks to move or destroy, springs for jumping, and essential items like axes and keys to unlock doors to the next room. Be on your guard, as enemies such as Saikoropusu, Kikantesu, and Kentaurosu also roam the levels.

The game features over 40 stages in total. Approach each one with caution—one wrong move in your strategy could leave you hopelessly stuck. Notably, this title was never released as a physical package, earning it a reputation as a "phantom" game among Kogado Studio’s catalog. It is a must-play for any fan of the action-puzzle genre.
 
 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *This application does not have a gallery mode.
 *The main game are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.
 *Flashing lights or patterns may cause dizziness, spasms, or loss of consciousness. If you feel unwell, stop playing immediately and see a doctor.
   If you have a history of these symptoms, consult a physician before use.

70010000122996.name: Amazing Lab! Science Experiments Quiz
70010000122996.intro:
Discover surprising science through fun elementary experiments!
Think, guess, and learn with every quiz!
70010000122996.description:
Curious Science! Elementary School Experiment Quiz is a fun and educational quiz game based on science experiments and observations taught in elementary school.

Explore familiar topics like water, air, light, magnets, plants, and electricity through easy-to-play quiz questions. Some answers may seem obvious at first, but the results can be surprisingly tricky.

Why does this happen? What will the experiment show? As you play, each question helps turn curiosity into understanding.

Perfect for kids, families, and anyone who enjoys learning through play, this game makes science feel approachable, exciting, and rewarding.

Discover, think, and say “Aha!” with every answer!

70010000123008.name: AquaDream
70010000123008.description:
Explore the dark marine abysses in AquaDream, a captivating puzzle game. Take on the role of a brave anglerfish and solve complex puzzles in the heart of underwater labyrinths. Find hidden keys, activate towers to open new passages, and follow ocean currents precisely to avoid deadly traps.

But that's not all! Collect a variety of rare shells scattered throughout the levels to complete your personal collection. Each shell collected brings you one step closer to becoming the master of the depths.

Are you ready to take on the challenge and uncover the hidden secrets of the marine depths?

70010000123014.name: Robo Hop
70010000123014.description: Robo Hop is a fast-paced 3D platformer where you control a brave little robot exploring vibrant worlds filled with lava pits, floating islands, and tricky obstacles. Jump, dodge, and collect glowing gears while battling hovering enemies and mastering precise platforming challenges. Every level tests your timing, reflexes, and curiosity as you hop your way to victory.

70010000123021.name: Comfy Corners: Unpack and Decorate
70010000123021.description:
Unpack your perfect life in this cozy, hygge-inspired home simulator.
Design the apartment of your dreams in a relaxing and meditative experience focused on creativity, comfort, and personal expression.

Create a unique home with two layers, decorate each room to match your mood, and even design your garden or outdoor area. Arrange furniture, experiment with color combinations, and customize the atmosphere outside your window with changing light and weather.

Whether you’re crafting a minimalistic loft, a soft Scandinavian bedroom, or a mysterious mage’s basement, this is your space to shape freely.

Features:
	•	A calm and cozy simulator inspired by hygge living
	•	Unpack and place furniture with intuitive controls
	•	Customize walls, floors, lighting, and window views
	•	Design indoor and outdoor spaces, including gardens
	•	Create multi-layer homes with vertical layouts
	•	Complete relaxing design quests with unique themes
	•	Enjoy a peaceful and stress-free environment

In a chaotic world, your hygge room is your shelter.

70010000123039.name: Prison Escape Simulator 2026
70010000123039.intro: Can you dig a secret tunnel before the guards discover your plan?
70010000123039.description:
Dig Your Way to Freedom

Trapped behind bars, you have only one chance to escape: dig a secret tunnel beneath your prison cell and reach freedom before the guards discover your plan.

Every day is a careful balancing act. Dig deeper into the ground, hide the tunnel entrance under your cell's carpet, and keep an eye on guard patrols. One mistake is all it takes to get caught, lose progress, and start over.

As you excavate the tunnel, you'll uncover valuable items buried underground. Trade them with the prison cook for soap—the prison's underground currency—and invest in powerful upgrades. Buy better tools to dig faster, increase your carrying capacity, and expand your pockets to secretly transport more dirt.

Managing the excavated soil is just as important as digging. Sneak outside and dispose of it before anyone becomes suspicious. The deeper your tunnel grows, the more careful you'll need to be.

With every upgrade, every successful digging session, and every close call with the guards, you'll move one step closer to freedom.

Can you outsmart the prison, complete the tunnel, and make your escape?

Features:
	•	Dig a secret tunnel beneath your prison cell.
	•	Avoid guard inspections and stay hidden.
	•	Discover valuable items while excavating.
	•	Trade found items for soap, the prison currency.
	•	Upgrade tools, inventory space, and carrying capacity.
	•	Dispose of dirt without raising suspicion.
	•	Interact with prison NPCs.
	•	Take a break with a fun basketball minigame.
	•	Unlock the final escape and earn your freedom.
      
 The tunnel won't dig itself. Start digging.

70010000123051.name: Néro & Sci ∫ Integral Edition
70010000123051.intro: Jump, think, experiment, and work your brain out in our vibrant math puzzle-platformer!
70010000123051.description:
Solve math-based puzzles as you jump from platform to platform in a colorful world made of numbers and geometrical shapes. Join Nero and Sci on their adventure, solo or with a friend, and travel across 4 unique worlds, designed to stimulate logical and mathematical thinking.

Jump, think, solve, and explore the world of Héméide
- 36 levels across 4 distinct worlds
- Choose between solo or local multiplayer: play as either Néro or Sci
- Over 20 hours of gameplay with high replayability

A fun workout for the brain
- Gameplay mechanics recommended by the Institute for Research on Mathematics Education (IREM Lyon)
- Progressive difficulty and hint system designed for players aged 13+
- A walkthrough guide of the game's puzzle is available on our Discord server, so you don't feel stuck!

70010000123065.name: Sky Meadow
70010000123065.intro: Drift into a peaceful world above the clouds.
70010000123065.description:
Sky Meadow is a cozy walking simulator set in a serene floating island garden, where time slows down and every step invites calm. Suspended high in the sky, this tranquil space is yours to explore—free from pressure, noise, or urgency.

Let the sound of the wind, distant chimes, and soft ambient music guide your journey as you explore this dreamy sky sanctuary.

Features:
> A beautiful floating island garden set high above the clouds

> Relaxing exploration with hidden spots and scenic views

> Calming ambient audio and peaceful sound design

> Stress-free, meditative gameplay with no combat or objectives

> A soothing, zen-inspired atmosphere designed for unwinding

70010000123080.name: Rica Mode♡
70010000123080.intro: A visual novel with AMSR starring the VTuber Rica Hanamiya.
70010000123080.description:
◆Synopsis
“If you do not wake up... I will play a little prank on you.”

As being the only son of a noble family in the kingdom, 
the personal maid you have hired was your childhood friend Rica Hanamiya.

Having Rica by your side everyday, at every moment,
she teases you nonstop, and your heart would not stop racing!
Hoping that this life would go on forever.

But--

One remark from your father shakes both of your hearts.
Can the two with a different status share the same fate--

◆Characters
Rica Hanamiya（CV：Rica Hanamiya）
Your childhood friend who became your personal maid.
She is diligent and professional on duty, but changes when it is just the two of you.
She loves teasing you and enjoys watching you be nervous.
Maid and a master, also a childhood friend--
Caught between those position, what does she truly feel?

○Novel Game Brand "Rabbitfoot”
A novel game brand that delivers novel games casting active YouTubers and VTubers as game characters.
As well as using their names and nicknames, you can enjoy the different sides of your faves and feel a close connection through the novel game that you cannot experience in the usual streaming or video uploads.

70010000123088.name: EGGCONSOLE LAYDOCK 2 LAST ATTACK MSX2+
70010000123088.intro: The epic conclusion to the LAYDOCK series. High stakes, relentless patterns, and pure tactical satisfaction.
70010000123088.description:
Originally released by T&E SOFT in 1988, this classic shoot 'em up is the grand finale of the trilogy, following in the footsteps of LAYDOCK and Super LAYDOCK.

As the pilot of the Stormy Gunner 2, you must fight your way through a variety of treacherous stages, including icy worlds, planets of fire, and mysterious extra-dimensional spaces. While the core gameplay is a pure shooter, it also incorporates RPG-style progression; as you level up, you can unlock and equip up to 10 different types of optional weaponry. Furthermore, in two-player mode, players can accumulate "docking energy" to perform vertical or horizontal fusions, drastically boosting their firepower.

The game offers a rich and varied experience, featuring both vertical and horizontal scrolling stages, screen-filling bosses, and cinematic animated cutscenes at key moments.

Note: The difficulty level is set exceptionally high. You will be met with a relentless onslaught of enemy fire from the very beginning. To conquer the game, mastering enemy spawn patterns is absolutely essential—a hallmark of hardcore shooters. Can you survive the "greatest and final battle in galactic history" and etch your name into the stars?
 
 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.
 *Flashing lights or patterns may cause dizziness, spasms, or loss of consciousness. If you feel unwell, stop playing immediately and see a doctor.
If you have a history of these symptoms, consult a physician before use.

70010000123095.name: Mitako Tatatari's Cult Village Stream ZP
70010000123095.intro:
She wanted to go viral — she got something worse.
Some streams should never go live.
A VTuber horror you won't unsee.
70010000123095.description:
Join VTuber Mitako's cursed village livestream, chat along as First-Time Hitto, and watch a goofy occult trip spiral into ritual horror.

Mitako is live, loud, and ready to turn a trip to Shimofuri Village into content.

As First-Time Hitto (a fresh face in her chat), you are not just watching from the sidelines — you are in the chat, choosing comments, reacting with regulars like Occult Sukio and Saw-the-Worst Mitazou, and helping shape the mood of the stream.

The deeper Mitako digs into the rumors haunting Shimofuri Village, the more the livestream begins to feel like a movie you cannot look away from.
Keep the chat moving, enjoy the banter, and slowly realize what kind of rules the village has been living by.

A chat-style visual novel blending VTuber energy, Japanese occult comedy, and slow-burn horror.

- Play as a viewer inside Mitako's livestream chat — your comments shape the stream.
- Follow a chaotic VTuber trip into Shimofuri Village.
- A descent from casual chat comedy to creeping folkloric horror.
- Meet Mitako, Pero, Occult Sukio, Saw-the-Worst Mitazou, and the unsettling people of Shimofuri Village.

70010000123101.name: Pirate Havoc
70010000123101.intro: Unleash Chaos on the High Seas
70010000123101.description:
Pirate Havoc is a fast-paced action shooter set in a chaotic, sun-soaked pirate world where danger lurks around every corner. Step into the boots of a ruthless pirate and fight your way through lively ports, narrow streets, and explosive battlegrounds. Use classic flintlock weapons, outmaneuver your enemies, and unleash pure havoc in intense combat encounters.
Explore vibrant environments inspired by Caribbean towns, engage in thrilling gunfights, and dominate your foes with skill and precision. Whether you're ambushing enemies in tight alleys or battling in open plazas, every moment is packed with action, strategy, and destruction.

Do you have what it takes to rule the seas and become the most feared pirate of all?

70010000123114.name: Driving School Sim
70010000123114.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game
70010000123114.intro: Can you master every road and every challenge?
70010000123114.description:
Get behind the wheel and begin your journey toward becoming a skilled driver. Every road presents a new challenge as you navigate busy city streets, follow traffic laws, and complete realistic driving lessons. Stay alert at intersections, watch surrounding traffic, and reach your destination safely while avoiding accidents and respecting speed limits.

Driving School Sim is a realistic driving experience where learning, progression, and vehicle customization come together. Complete nearly 100 unique routes across a lively city, master different driving situations, and improve your skills behind the wheel. Earn rewards for safe driving, unlock new vehicles, and build your collection as you advance through increasingly challenging lessons.

Features:
	•	Nearly 100 unique driving routes with varied objectives and road layouts.
	•	Realistic city traffic featuring intersections, road signs, and everyday driving situations.
	•	Performance ratings based on safe driving, rule compliance, and route completion.
	•	Garage and vehicle shop with multiple cars to unlock using in-game currency.
	•	Vehicle customization with colors, wheels, spoilers, vinyls, and other cosmetic options.
	•	Upgrade system that improves your cars and enhances the driving experience.


Can you master every lesson and earn the highest driving ratings? Explore the city, unlock your favorite vehicles, customize your collection, and prove your skills in Driving School Sim.

70010000123152.name: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor
70010000123152.intro: Every day is a battle. Every carriage is a gamble
70010000123152.description:
Stranded after a brutal train crash, your survival begins now.

You wake amidst twisted metal and shattered carriages, trapped between steep cliffs and a vast lake. With only your wits and determination, you must explore, gather, and fight to stay alive for 28 days — until rescue arrives.

Every decision counts. Every resource matters. Will you endure?

EXPLORE THE WRECKAGE
Search every train car for supplies, tools, and hidden loot. Some wagons are locked or contain only fragments of the gear you need, forcing you to combine parts and improvise to survive.

MASTER RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
Hunt, fish, forage mushrooms and berries, and collect wood. Keep fires burning, craft essential tools, and make every piece of salvaged material count.

CRAFT & SURVIVE
Build makeshift shelters, repair damaged gear, and create survival equipment from scavenged parts. Creativity and resourcefulness are the keys to lasting 28 days.

FACE THE WILD
The wilderness is dangerous — giant lizards and other predators lurk everywhere. Stay alert, defend yourself, and never underestimate the wildlife.

PLAN FOR THE 28-DAY CHALLENGE
Balance risk and reward. Explore further or stay safe. Every day brings hunger, cold, and new dangers — only careful planning and bold action will see you through.

Do you have the skill, patience, and grit to survive all 28 days?

70010000123155.name: Beholgar 2
70010000123155.intro: Return once again to the brutal world of Beholgar in a dark Metroidvania adventure that blends medieval fantasy with the mysticism of the Arabian Nights.
70010000123155.description:
The ancient evil has awakened, and the fate of the world hangs by a thread.
Even Beholgar, the legendary warrior, knows that this enemy cannot be defeated by ordinary steel.

There is only one weapon capable of slaying the darkness… but the blacksmith who forged it died centuries ago.

To reclaim this cursed blade, Beholgar must descend into the depths of Hell itself, facing demonic horrors, ancient dragons, jinns, and corrupted creatures born from nightmare.

Return once again to the brutal world of Beholgar in a dark Metroidvania adventure that blends medieval fantasy with the mysticism of the Arabian Nights.

Explore forgotten kingdoms, uncover hidden secrets, forge your own combat style, and fight against the inevitable doom threatening all existence.

Features
•Brutal retro-inspired Metroidvania gameplay
•A dark fantasy world inspired by the tales of 1001 Nights
•Multiple interconnected areas filled with secrets and deadly enemies
•Fight dragons, jinns, demons, and possessed warriors
•5 unique weapons with completely different playstyles
•Secondary ranged weapons for strategic combat
•Equip powerful rings that enhance your abilities and inflict devastating effects
•Epic original soundtrack

70010000123159.name: Sayonara Wild Hearts - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000123159.description:
Sayonara Wild Hearts is a dreamy arcade game about riding motorcycles, skateboarding, dance battling, shooting lasers, wielding swords, and breaking hearts at 200 mph.

As the heart of a young woman breaks, the balance of the universe is disturbed. A diamond butterfly appears in her dreams and leads her through a highway in the sky, where she finds her other self: the masked biker called The Fool.

Journey through a custom-written pop soundtrack, chase scores, and set out to find the harmony of the universe, hidden away in the hearts of Little Death and her star-crossed allies: Dancing Devils, Howling Moons, Stereo Lovers and Hermit 64.

Let’s Pop!

70010000123172.name: EGGCONSOLE ELTHLEAD PC-8801mkIISR
70010000123172.intro: Become King Sieghart, lead the Forces of Light, and defeat Bozel and his Legions of Darkness! A masterpiece of fantasy strategy RPGs!
70010000123172.description:
Originally released in 1988, this strategy RPG casts you as King Sieghart of Elthlead. Your mission is to defeat Bozel, the King of Velzeria, and restore peace to the continent of Gaia.

The game alternates between an Area Map for troop movement and a Tactical Map for unit-to-unit combat upon encountering the enemy. You must lead a diverse army—including Grandinos (Earth Dragons), Falcon Knights, Light Knights, Fighters, Archers, and White Dragons—to overcome the opposing forces.

While the core system is a straightforward battle for military supremacy, mastering tactical elements like terrain defense bonuses and area-of-effect magic is the true key to conquering the game.

70010000123186.name: KUUKIYOMI: Consider It World - Thailand Ver.
70010000123186.intro:
This time, the stage is Thailand!
Test your ability to read the room in familiar, everyday Thai scenarios!
70010000123186.description:
The character “You” from KUUKIYOMI travels from Japan to Thailand. 
By spending time together with friends met in Thailand, those friends gradually begin to learn what it means to "Consider It". 
Through the unique situations they encounter, how will these Thai friends choose to "Consider It"?

■ Game Features
KUUKIYOMI: Consider It World – Thailand Ver. is an ambitious title that lets you experience "Consider It"! through Thailand’s unique culture, values, and communication styles.
This is a completely original work created by Thai creators, and all 100 problems included in the game are newly made specifically for this title.
As you play, you will consider things such as the atmosphere of the situation, other people’s feelings, and small acts of thoughtfulness  while experiencing various situations in Thailand.

■ How to Play
The way to play this game is very simple.
The basic rule is that you can move the red object on the screen.
Most of the time, you will control the protagonist known as “You,” but depending on the situation, you may control something else.By playing all 100 problems, the game will evaluate how well you were able to "Consider It".

■ Results
The familiar evaluation of whether you were able to Consider It returns in this title,this time expressed in a Thai style, inspired by Thai food and the ghosts and occult that Thai people enjoy.
After playing all 100 problems, your overall ability to Consider It will be evaluated.
※ The results change each time, depending on how you play.

■ Game Modes
・ Consider It Mode
A total of 100 problems will be presented.
After playing all problems, your ability to "Consider It" will be evaluated.

・ Chapter Mode
After clearing the game, you will be able to play each problem individually.
※ No evaluation results are shown in Chapter Mode.

・ Secrets
This game includes secret elements (titles).
Whether or not these secrets are revealed depends on how you play.

・ Past You
You can view the evaluation results from your past playthroughs.

70010000123200.name: Beholder: Conductor
70010000123200.description:
Welcome aboard the Determination Bringer!
 
You have been appointed senior conductor of the legendary train, which all the citizens of our vast country are happy to see in their cities. Your responsibilities are maintaining order in the carriage assigned to you and providing assistance to passengers along the way. Your tools are reporting, intimidation, searches and ejection. Remember: the conductor is always right.

Monitor the passengers
Carefully monitor everyone who enters the carriage and decide what to do with fare-evaders. Observe and report all suspicious, unauthorized and basically any passenger activity. Search the baggage and call the police if you find prohibited items.

Move up the train
Get access to the dining car or VIP compartments and carriages where high-ranking officials and big industrialists ride. Keep an eye on your colleagues and report their accepting bribes or transporting banned goods. The Ministry will not let your dedication go unnoticed.

Complete secret missions
Earn the trust of higher-ups in order to receive special assignments. Their level of secrecy will depend on your loyalty, and completion will be rewarded with a bonus or even a promotion. You will also encounter smugglers — transporting their packages along the route is risky, but profitable.
 
Visit various stations and remote corners of the country. Make difficult decisions determining the fate of passengers and your colleagues. What kind of person will you be at the end of the journey? The choice is yours!

70010000123207.name: Strays POV Tales
70010000123207.intro: A charming adventure from a cat's perspective.
70010000123207.description:
Infiltrate a luxury hotel and complete different tasks. Quiet paws and a bit of attitude are all you need for success!

- A Cat’s Eye View
See the world from just four inches off the ground. Explore the cozy hotel lobby as a curious little cat, wandering through warm lounges, reception areas, sofas, plants, luggage corners, and decorative spaces filled with charm and relaxing atmosphere.

- Cozy Hotel Atmosphere
Enjoy a calm and peaceful experience focused on exploration and cozy vibes. Soft lighting, relaxing music, and detailed interiors turn the hotel hall into a warm and comforting place perfect for quiet adventures.

- Playful Exploration
Jump onto counters, walk across furniture, rest in cozy corners, and freely explore the hotel lobby at your own pace. Every small detail of the environment helps create a relaxing and charming experience.

- A Warm Living Space
The entire game takes place inside a hotel hall designed to feel alive, stylish, and welcoming. From the reception desk to lounge areas and decorative corners, the lobby is filled with cozy visual details and relaxing ambiance.

70010000123214.name: Little Kitty Meow
70010000123214.description:
Explore a quiet and cozy office from the perspective of a curious little cat in Little Kitty Meow, a relaxing adventure focused on atmosphere, exploration, and peaceful wandering.

Walk through office rooms, meeting areas, corridors, and workspaces while discovering hidden corners, cozy spots, and small environmental details that bring the workplace to life. Enjoy calm exploration, soft visuals, and a comforting atmosphere as you freely roam through the office at your own pace.

With relaxing gameplay and charming environments, Little Kitty Meow offers a simple and wholesome experience perfect for players who enjoy cozy exploration games.

70010000123220.name: Inside the Cube
70010000123220.description:
You awaken in a labyrinth of interconnected rooms with no memory of how you got there - and no obvious way out. Every corridor leads to another mystery, every door hides a new challenge, and every mistake brings you closer to failure.
Solve clever environmental puzzles, avoid deadly traps, and search for the path to freedom before time runs out. The maze is constantly testing your observation, logic, and decision-making, forcing you to think quickly under pressure.
With each room you conquer, the exit feels closer... yet the labyrinth always has another surprise waiting. Stay focused, keep moving, and make every second count - because the clock never stops ticking.

70010000123229.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines
70010000123229.intro: Follow the Bloodlines and break this curse.
70010000123229.description:
The Coma 3: Bloodlines is a 2D run-and-hide horror adventure where you must escape threatening puppets and shadow monsters while gathering clues, solving problems, and unraveling the mystery surrounding the chaos that the three main characters have been thrust into.

The game maintains a constant sense of suspense and tension, allowing players to experience the unique culture and lifestyle of South Korea, while uncovering its distinctive sorcery, curses, history, and style.



STORY

In a district of Seoul, South Korea, there was a school boasting a long history and tradition, known as ‘Sehwa Private High School’. Behind the scenes, people seeking to study the cursed underworld of history were exploring and managing this place under the name ‘Sehwa Foundation’, with their focus on the nightmare dimension, the mirror world of this reality: The Coma.

 However, there were also those who viewed this place as an object of exploration and suppressed the dangerous elements. They are the Ghost Vigilantes. The wraiths of the past, who have traversed the ages to this time period, appear...and the once-quiet Coma dimension has once again become a realm of nightmare.



KEY FEATURES

Welcome to the Coma World: In this realm of shadows, where rumors and urban legends become reality, all kinds of dangers lurk. If a living intruder dies here, their body will be severed from their spirit and never wake up again.

Exotic Region for The Mystery Horror: Experience a unique occult and mystery atmosphere in the special local area of South Korea. The mysteries and secrets that have continued since the previous work will stimulate your brain. Who should you trust, and who should you abandon?

Into New Locations: Leaving behind familiar schools and neighborhoods, you will embark on unpredictable adventures with new missions and locations. Will you struggle to survive on your own, or will someone save you from that fate?

Run and Hide: You cannot fight. The shadows are running amok, and hideous puppets will hunt you down. You must hide when you have the chance and wait for the right moment to make your move and escape.



NEW FEATURES

4 Bosses from the Cursed History: New, never-before-seen bosses are coming. They all have different attack patterns and require different approaches.

Compact area design: Run-and-Hide action in more enclosed, tight spaces.

3 playable characters: You can take turns playing as three different characters, each with different strengths and weaknesses, all of who will be familiar to fans of the series.

Closure of all previous games: This game concludes the story surrounding Sehwa High School that began in The Coma 1. Many secrets from the previous games are unravelled here, in the most intense entry of all.

70010000123242.name: Into the Slimy Mines
70010000123242.intro: A roguelike tower defence with a card twist!
70010000123242.description:
A roguelike tower defense with a card-driven twist. Build your deck, carve out tunnels, and deploy defences directly into the path of the swarm. Rank up your chosen Guild and rescue your Dwarven crew to get off this frackin’ slime-infested moon!

DIG TO VICTORY: Rescue your crew from six unique mining locations each with five increasingly difficult depths. Drag Dig cards to excavate new tunnels toward your missing crewmates.

GROUNDBREAKING PLAYSTYLES: There are three unique factions to choose from: ANVIL, WARHAMMER & PICKAXE. Pick and customise your Drill Rig to match your play style and the location's hazards.

WEAPONS OF MASS CONSTRUCTION: Why not collect more than just your crew along the way? Drills can unearth ore for bursts of money, lures distract your slimy foes and generators keep your whole rig running the deeper you delve.  

BUILD TO LAST: Upgrade your kit by placing another of the same card on top of them. Level 1 Cannon + Level 1 Cannon = Level 2 Cannon, the maths checks out!

70010000123255.name: Antique Backgammon
70010000123255.description:
Antique Backgammon is a classic board game that is easy to learn and enjoyable at your own pace. It is suitable for both quick sessions and more thoughtful play.

The game includes two modes: short backgammon and long backgammon - choose the one you prefer. You can play against an AI with adjustable difficulty or share the device and play with someone else.

Clean visuals, intuitive controls, and smooth gameplay keep the experience simple and comfortable. Just roll the dice and play whenever you like.

70010000123261.name: Rat Protocol
70010000123261.intro: Escape dangerous labs as a mutated rodent in a pushing puzzle adventure about twisted experiments!
70010000123261.description:
Weird science and block-pushing puzzle mechanics combine for a brainteasing adventure in Rat Protocol!

When an experiment unexpectedly grants humanoid strength and intelligence to a lab rat, the scientists in charge decide to test the limits of their creation’s newfound abilities. Guide the lab rat through increasingly tricky chambers by pushing crates, blocking dangerous laser beams, activating switches and detonating explosives. Find the right order to clear obstacles so the lab rat can reach key cards to open doorways and proceed to the next test. 

Will you make the experiment a success or lead your rodent to an untimely demise?

• Test the limits of a mutated lab rat in top-down puzzle adventure style!
• Solve increasingly complex puzzles to escape each tricky chamber.
• Avoid hazards and collect key cards to help the lab rat survive!
• Block laser beams, activate switches, push crates and more in the correct order.
• Enjoy retro pixel art aesthetics and a whimsical narrative about twisted science!

70010000123268.name: Amazing Facts World Culture True or False Quiz
70010000123268.intro: Test your knowledge and discover surprising cultures from around the world!
70010000123268.description:
The world is full of surprising customs, traditions, and ways of life!

Amazing World Cultures: True or False Quiz is a casual quiz game where you can learn about greetings, food, festivals, manners, and everyday culture from countries around the globe through simple true-or-false questions.

Is it true? Or is it false?

As you play, you will uncover fun facts and fascinating cultural differences from around the world.

Perfect for trivia fans, curious learners, and players who want to have fun while discovering something new.

Enjoy a quiz adventure packed with surprises, knowledge, and global culture!

70010000123293.name: Football 26 League Superstar
70010000123293.intro: Create the ultimate football squad and write your own championship story.
70010000123293.description:
Football 26 League Superstar invites you into the heart of modern football — where ambition, strategy, and skill decide who becomes a legend.
Start your journey as a hungry newcomer with a modest squad and limited resources. Every match is a step forward, every decision matters. Train harder, think smarter, and climb from local victories to the grandest stage of world football. Your ultimate dream? Lifting the World Cup and proving you belong among the elite.

Key Features:
• Career Progression
