Compete in tournaments of increasing difficulty, evolving from early matches against weaker opponents to intense professional-level battles on the road to World Cup glory.
• Rush Mode
Jump into fast-paced matches to test tactics, experiment with lineups, and sharpen individual player skills — perfect for quick sessions and rapid squad growth.
• Deep Team Management
Open player packs of varying rarities, upgrade your squad using match experience, rearrange positions, and fine-tune tactics to dominate the pitch.
• Dynamic Match Atmosphere
Experience games played across a full day and night cycle — from bright mornings to dramatic night-time kickoffs.
• Unique Player Skills
Every footballer brings their own dribbles, tricks, and signature moves, creating spectacular moments and varied gameplay.
• Squad Building System
Use in-game currency to unlock powerful players and gradually assemble your ultimate dream team.

Football 26 League Superstar is more than a football game — it’s your personal rise to greatness. Plan your strategy, train relentlessly, outplay your rivals, and write your own legacy in football history.
The pitch is ready. The crowd is waiting. Become a superstar.

70010000123305.name: Easter Coloring Book for Kids & Toddlers
70010000123305.intro: Lovingly designed Easter animals coloring book full of child-friendly illustrations
70010000123305.description:
Easter Coloring Book for Kids & Toddlers is the perfect coloring book full of kid-friendly Easter vacation animal illustrations. All graphics and drawings were created for creative kids who love Easter and funny animals.

The game can be played directly on the Nintendo Switch™ touchscreen using a finger and without using Joy-Con™. Children simply tap, paint, and get creative!

Kids start the educational learning game by choosing an Easter animal line-art image and then enter the canvas area, where they can color the picture and freely paint in the background. The line-art can also be disabled, allowing children to draw on a blank canvas.

A wide selection of colors, brushes, and fill tool is available. The size of each drawing tool can be adjusted, and all buttons and tools can be hidden so only the drawing area remains visible.

It’s the perfect early-learning creative experience for young children to improve hand-eye coordination, explore colors, and enjoy a fun artistic journey with friendly animals and Easter decorations.

70010000123335.name: Pick & Place
70010000123335.intro: Messy room? Stressful day? Not anymore! Turn chaos into calm, one pixel at a time.
70010000123335.description:
Welcome to the world’s most relaxing tidying-up simulator! Pick & Place is a vibrant, low-stress puzzle game where your only goal is to find the perfect home for everyday objects. From vintage vinyls and leafy succulents to chaotic books and mismatched clothes, every item has a story—and a specific spot where it "just fits.", and everything is hand-drawn in a vibrant retro, pixel style.

Forget timers, high scores, or "Game Over" screens. Here, the only reward is the pure, tingly satisfaction of a perfectly organized shelf and the gentle hum of lo-fi beats.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Satisfying Tactile Gameplay: Feel the click! Experience the tactile joy of placing items with smooth, responsive controls designed for maximum "ahhh" moments.
- Vibrant Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in a nostalgic, colorful, handcrafted 16-bit world. 
- Zero Stress, All Chill: No timers. No pressure. Just you, your collection, and a cozy atmosphere. It’s the perfect "wind-down" game before bed or during a rainy afternoon.

70010000123341.name: The Towers
70010000123341.description:
Step onto vibrant islands where towering structures rise into the sky, each one a challenge waiting to be conquered. Climb winding paths that spiral around massive towers, testing your skill, timing, and courage with every step upward.

The journey is anything but simple. Treacherous hazards stand in your way, from blazing fire jets to razor-sharp spikes and crumbling floors that collapse beneath your feet. Every climb demands precision and quick thinking as the environment itself works against you.

Along the path, a variety of enemies guard the ascent. From skittering spiders and swooping bats to relentless skeletons and brutish orcs, each level introduces new threats that force you to adapt your strategy and stay alert.

At the summit of each tower, victory awaits. Raise the flag to claim your success and unlock the next destination, where a brand-new island and environment bring fresh challenges and surprises.

With its colorful, stylized world and ever-changing obstacles, every climb feels like a new adventure.

70010000123347.name: Cozy Pages: Comfy Coloring for All Ages - Paint, Draw & Relax
70010000123347.intro: Your cozy corner. Cute, calming coloring for all ages.
70010000123347.description:
Welcome to Cozy Pages, a cozy/kawaii coloring game designed for those quiet, feel-good moments. Pick a page, choose a palette that matches your mood, add a few cute stickers and let everything slow down. No pressure, no timers. Just soft vibes, gentle creativity and that satisfying feeling when a scene comes to life.

Color charming 2D pages, from simple doodles and bold, easy designs to mandalas, lettering, and more detailed realistic drawings. Plus plenty of cute animals, cozy everyday moments and adorably decorated little houses.

Then switch things up with our separate 3D & Voxel mode, where you color blocky  models and unlock whiteboards for free drawing, quick doodles and cozy creativity anytime.

This free edition gives you a warm, complete starter set:
- 33 coloring pages from different themes
- 4 voxel 3D models 
- 1 sticker pack (10 stickers)
- 2 palettes (32 colors)

It’s enough to relax right away and discover what style you love most.

And if you want the complete set, the full version—sold separately as the Cozy Bundle—includes: 450+ pages, 33 themed collections, 40 voxel 3D models, all sticker packs (110 stickers total), all palettes (192 colors total), plus 20 whiteboards for drawing freely. 

Controls
Choose your favorite way to play:
- Motion pointer (Joy-Con™): move the pointer by tilting the controller like a magic wand.
- Touchscreen: tap and color directly for a smooth, hands-on experience.

Tools
Keep it simple or get creative: use cozy tools like brushes (with different looks), a satisfying fill bucket, an eraser, glitter and sticker stamps to decorate your pages. 

Cozy Pages is your pocket of calm: cute, cozy and always ready when you need a little break.

70010000123374.name: Zombie Brawl Slayer
70010000123374.intro:
Survive the swarm.
Upgrade your arsenal.
Become the ultimate Zombie Slayer.
70010000123374.description:
Zombie Brawl Slayer is a fast-paced top-down arcade action game where survival is your only goal.

Fight your way through diverse locations filled with relentless waves of zombies. Each level challenges you to stay alive for a set amount of time — but the longer you last, the tougher it gets.

Earn rewards by completing runs and use them to unlock new heroes, weapons, and powerful upgrades. Customize your playstyle and build the ultimate zombie-slaying loadout.

Choose from a variety of unique Hero (skins), each adding personality to your gameplay. Visit the weapon shop to equip new gear and enhance it to increase your chances of survival.

Key Features:
- Survive endless waves of zombies
- Multiple unique locations to conquer
- Unlockable heroes (skins)
- Weapon shop with upgrade system
- Fast, arcade-style gameplay
- Stylized visuals suitable for all players

How long can you survive?

70010000123394.name: Inversion: The Single Path
70010000123394.description:
Enter a surreal platforming adventure where the world constantly changes around you. This is more than a journey through obstacles - it’s a challenge where the environment itself becomes part of the puzzle.

Using the power of a rotating, you’ll manipulate the world to find new paths, avoid dangers, and uncover hidden ways forward. Every level introduces fresh challenges that test your reflexes, timing, and ability to adapt to changing surroundings.

Collect coins, overcome mind-bending platforming sequences, and take on intense encounters where the entire arena shifts and moves beneath your feet. Some stages demand speed and precision, while others reward careful observation and creative thinking.

Blending dynamic gameplay, puzzle-solving, and fast-paced action, this adventure invites you to master a world where nothing stays still for long.

70010000123417.name: Kingdom's Return: Time-Eating Fruit and the Ancient Monster Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000123417.intro: A kingdom-rebuilding adventure filled with action and strategy!
70010000123417.description:
Kingdom's Return is an action RPG where you'll adventure to restore your fallen kingdom. Collect materials in 2D side-scrolling adventure stages, then use them in the strategy part to rebuild your kingdom and power up your characters!

*Story
In a world of swords, magic, and fairies, you are a lone adventurer who suddenly becomes tasked to revive the ruined kingdom of Almacia along with the Fairy of Time, Chronos.
Through adventure (action) and revival (strategy), restore the kingdom to its former glory!

*Action and Strategy
Kingdom's Return combines action with strategy for an addictive hybrid experience!
In adventure stages, you'll collect items for construction in the strategy part, all while levelling up your kingdom and characters.
You can approach each side in balance, or concentrate primarily on just one and still clear the game.

*The build of your dreams!
As you fill the land with buildings, the characters you take on adventures will also grow stronger.
Build the kingdom of your dreams and strengthen your allies!

*The playable cast is brimming with personality!
Start your adventure by choosing from "Imperial", "Wizard", "Alchemist", and "Zipangu".
Each has unique stats, skills and attacks, so choose the one that fits your action style!
You can change characters while in your kingdom, so you'll always have a variety of styles to choose from!

*Adventure in an idyllic fantasy world!
In Kingdom's Return, you'll build your cozy fantasy kingdom and bravely adventure into dungeons.
Get quests from villagers, build up your lands, and play around with powerful bosses!
This is your kingdom to rebuild how you want!

70010000123424.name: Titanic Survival Simulator
70010000123424.intro: Explore the legendary Titanic as history unfolds around you.
70010000123424.description:
April, 1912. A calm night in the Atlantic. Laughter echoes through grand halls, chandeliers glow warmly, and the world’s most luxurious ocean liner glides confidently through the water. Then — impact.
The legendary RMS Titanic has struck an iceberg. A tremor shakes the decks, metal groans, and whispers of panic spread. Within minutes, the truth is undeniable — the ship is sinking, and there aren’t enough lifeboats for everyone. You are just a passenger caught in the chaos.
As the decks flood and the ship tilts into the icy Atlantic, every decision matters. Explore the cabins, stairways, and hallways before they vanish under water. Every second counts — will you save yourself, or risk precious time helping others?

Key Features:
• Race Against Time – Reach lifeboats before areas are flooded.
• Resource Survival – Gather food and light sources to stay alive.
• Hypothermia & Stamina – Cold water and exhaustion are real threats.
• Moral Choices – Decide between self-preservation or helping others.
• Immersive Atmosphere – Experience a realistic recreation of Titanic’s interiors, rising water, and the tension of a historic disaster.

The lifeboats are few.
The ocean is merciless.
Every choice, every second, can mean the difference between survival… and tragedy.

70010000123438.name: Jesus Simulator
70010000123438.intro: Can you experience the story that changed the world?
70010000123438.description:
Step into one of the most powerful stories ever told — the life of Jesus Christ. Jesus Simulator is a narrative-driven experience that brings the events of the Gospel to life with care, authenticity, and respect. Inspired by biblical texts and historically grounded sources, the game invites players to follow Jesus’ journey from His early years through His ministry, teachings, miracles, and ultimate sacrifice.

Experience a story shaped by faith, compassion, and choice as you interact with disciples, witness iconic moments, and explore meaningful encounters that have inspired generations. Through immersive storytelling and interactive elements, players discover the timeless values of love, mercy, forgiveness, and devotion.

Features:
• Immersive narrative experience presented in a visual novel style with interactive gameplay elements
• Play from multiple perspectives, including Mary, Joseph, Jesus, and His disciples
• Relive key Gospel events and miracles, recreated with respect and symbolic depth
• Explore historically inspired locations reflecting the world of the New Testament
• Thoughtful and respectful artistic direction designed to be accessible to all players

Jesus Simulator offers more than entertainment — it is a reflective journey through one of history’s most influential stories.

Live the story. Experience the message. Discover its meaning.

70010000123450.name: Village in the Shade
70010000123450.intro: Quiet countryside living…as long as you follow the rules.
70010000123450.description:
Welcome to Kagatsu, a Japanese mountain village with plenty of secrets. In this  brand-new, hand-painted farming sim, you'll plant crops, customize your homestead, and meet a cast of intriguing characters—all with something to hide.

Enjoy quiet countryside living...as long as you follow the rules.

70010000123456.name: Paranormal Observation
70010000123456.intro:
Hunt ghosts from the safety of your basement.
Identify evil spirits using your computer and exorcise them with professional tools.
70010000123456.description:
Begin your new career as a paranormal investigator with the latest ghost-hunting tool: your computer. Ghost hunting has become more dangerous, so you cannot enter the building directly. Instead, you stay close to the action from your paranormal observation room in the basement. In most cases it is safe to be there, but not always.

Each investigation brings a new experience. Every ghost has different behaviour that helps you identify it. Explore various difficulty levels and maps, from a fishing house to Chernobyl and even the Backrooms.

Your computer is equipped with the latest paranormal observation tools: a room-specific electromagnetic field (EMF) meter, a temperature gauge, a sound meter, a laser grid, and a UV lamp to reveal things invisible under normal light.

Use the exorcism module to banish the ghost once you are confident about which spirit you are dealing with. Earn additional experience points to unlock new difficulty levels.

With each completed investigation, earn money and experience to unlock upgrades, discover new maps, and take on even more challenging missions.

70010000123474.name: Akita: Legends Squad
70010000123474.intro: Strap on your jetpack and defy gravity! Master thrilling 3D platforming challenges, explore floating islands, and join the Legends Squad in this epic action adventure.
70010000123474.description:
Take the leap into a gravity-defying action adventure! Akita: Legends Squad brings the classic thrill of the 3D platformer genre to the Nintendo Switch™ with modern, high-speed movement mechanics and stunning environments.

Take control of Akita, a brave hero equipped with high-tech thrusters, and navigate through a series of challenging floating islands. From freezing snow-capped peaks and mysterious ancient ruins to futuristic cloud cities, every world offers a unique visual spectacle and a fresh set of deadly obstacles. Master the art of mid-air hovering, dodge giant rolling boulders, maneuver through massive spinning gears, and solve intricate platforming puzzles.

Key Features:

Dynamic Jetpack Platforming: Leap across massive gaps, hover over dangerous traps, and master precise mid-air controls to survive the sky-high courses.

Diverse 3D Worlds: Journey through beautifully crafted environments, each packed with unique physics-based challenges and platforming mechanics.

Challenging Obstacle Courses: Test your reflexes against spike traps, moving platforms, powerful wind currents, and intricate level designs that will push your skills to the limit.

Collect and Conquer: Gather hidden coins, find secret gems, and complete levels with perfect timing to prove your worth.

Perfect for All Players: A family-friendly adventure that offers accessible fun for beginners and tight, skill-based challenges for hardcore platforming fans.

70010000123495.name: Trick Room Mysteries
70010000123495.intro:
"Something's wrong with this house."
A pixel-art mystery where you crack each case with 4 choices!
70010000123495.description:
"Trick Room Mysteries" is a 4-choice deduction game set inside a pixel-art house, where you uncover subtle clues and strange details to get to the truth of each case.

Read the situation carefully using the descriptions and illustrations, then choose the right answer from four options to advance the story.

Each case consists of 5 questions — short but packed with moments of discovery and insight that make for a truly satisfying story experience.

"Something feels off about this room…"
"The culprit is still somewhere in the house…!"

From everyday oddities to unexpected truths —
use your powers of observation and deduction to crack every mystery.

Easy to pick up on instinct, with that satisfying rush when everything clicks — a flash-of-insight mystery puzzle game that keeps you coming back for more.

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
TT supports gaming content creators.
No permission from TT is required to stream or create gameplay content, whether for personal or commercial use.

70010000123501.name: ROUTE16
70010000123501.intro: The original high-octane car chase action game!
70010000123501.description:
ROUTE16 is an arcade action game originally released in 1981.

Avoid enemy cars as you race through a vast maze, collecting every item scattered across the stage.
If you get cornered, grab a flag and turn the tables!

Switch dynamically between Maze Mode, where you navigate intricate labyrinths, and Radar Mode, which displays the entire stage made up of 16 mazes-delivering a thrilling car chase experience.

70010000123507.name: Arcade Archives V'BALL
70010000123507.intro: It’s Summer! It’s the Beach! It’s Beach Volleyball!!
70010000123507.description:
"V'BALL" is an action game released by Technos Japan in 1988.
Control two young men as they enter a beach volleyball tournament and aim for the championship.
Enjoy a variety of actions, such as controlling where the ball flies during serves and spikes, or delivering a more powerful spike by tapping rapidly.
This is the story of their success. The rest of the story is up to you.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000123553.name: Shadows of the Afterland
70010000123553.intro: Embark on a supernatural point-and-click adventure in which you are confronted with the most difficult decision of your life ... and death...
70010000123553.description:
Madrid, 1960. A chilling incident unfolds at the city's old zoo, leading to a mysterious death that propels a soul to the threshold between the world of the living and the afterlife. But when the transition goes awry, the soul arrives with the memories of Carolina, one of the pioneers of the Madrid police force, who has not yet been born.

Step into Carolina's shoes and immerse yourself in a detective mystery to unravel the enigma shrouding these events. Explore the wacky realm of the afterlife, teeming with unique characters and with its own rules.

In your quest for the truth, you join forces with César, an elusive former ghost agent. Persuade this enigmatic ally to accompany you on a transformative journey to confront the sinister forces lurking in the world of the living. As you gain César’s trust, you'll have to solve tricky point-and-click puzzles, harness the power of magic, navigate between worlds and even possess the living.

FEATURES:
- Investigate a supernatural murder mystery that blends themes of identity, courage and destiny with the afterlife, reincarnation and the connection between past and future lives.
- Enjoy professionally voiced characters.
- Take command of various playable characters using unique possession mechanics.
- Explore the intricate stories of the eccentric spirits of the afterlife through meaningful conversations.
- Apply your deduction skills to unravel clever and logical puzzles that are seamlessly woven into the storyline. Use magic and possession and move tactically between realms to crack them.
- Immerse yourself in meticulously crafted pixel art scenes and animations.
- Experience an original soundtrack that enhances the haunting atmosphere of the game.
- The classic point-and-click experience with a modern user interface.

70010000123573.name: Tabletop Foosball
70010000123573.description:
Table Foosball lets you create a fully immersive 3D soccer experience. With single-player, local multiplayer, your players can challenge opponents in an adrenaline-pumping soccer match.

This game kit goes beyond the basics, offering additional gameplay modes like Tournament, One Player against device, Two local players, and a chaotic Crazy Mode, where all players can shoot at the same time! With a polished 3D setup, realistic physics, and customizable features, this asset ensures your audience gets hooked.

Step onto the pitch and feel the rush! Tabletop Foosball brings the thrill of the beautiful game to life with stunning 3D visuals, fluid animations, and physics that make every shot, pass, and tackle feel real.

Go head-to-head against the CPU or invite a friend for intense local multiplayer showdowns. Choose your nation, take control of your squad, and dominate the field across a variety of exciting game modes:

- Tournament – Compete through knockout rounds and lift the trophy
- 1 Player vs CPU – Sharpen your skills against a challenging AI opponent
- Local 2-Player – Challenge a friend on the same device
- Crazy Mode – All players shoot at once — pure, beautiful chaos

With various detailed stadiums, smooth controls, and fully customizable match settings, Tabletop Foosball is easy to pick up and impossible to put down.

The whistle blows. Are you ready?

70010000123579.name: Locked-Room Mystery : Hidden Truths in Everyday Life
70010000123579.intro: A locked-room mystery could be hiding in the middle of everyday life.
70010000123579.description:
Strange incidents, hidden contradictions, and truths concealed within ordinary days.

In Locked-Room Mystery: Hidden Truths in Everyday Life, you will unravel a series of mysteries woven into familiar scenes from daily life.

Look closely at each case, spot what does not add up, and piece together the hidden truth behind seemingly impossible situations.

A mystery experience that is easy to pick up, yet satisfying to solve.

70010000123584.name: Escape game R00M14
70010000123584.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

70010000123590.name: Lost Little Things
70010000123590.intro: Step into a hand-drawn world of whimsy in Lost Little Things, a cozy hidden object adventure for the soul.
70010000123590.description: Join Kitsune, a curious fox spirit, and the powerful deity Nyaneko on a serene quest across enchanted realms. From the rhythmic rails of the Water Train Station to the neon glow of the Mushroom Council, every map is a living illustration teeming with secrets. Solve gentle puzzles, meet quirky Yokai, and uncover the stories hidden in the details.

70010000123596.name: Home Rescue Clean And Restore Collector's Edition
70010000123596.intro: Roll Up Your Sleeves and Get Ready to Sparkle!
70010000123596.description:
Welcome to Home Rescue: Clean and Restore, a brand-new, relaxing hidden object adventure that brings the satisfaction of a deep clean right to your screen! 
Step into the shoes of Jane, the ambitious owner of a budding small cleaning agency. 

Your mission? 

To explore incredible, beautifully designed homes, clear out the clutter, and restore them to their former glory!
Whether you are finding misplaced items, tidying up gorgeous living spaces, or solving delightful mini-games, 
this game offers a perfectly calm and satisfying seek-and-find experience from the comfort of your own home.

Take your cleaning business to the next level with exclusive extras! 

The Collector's Edition includes:
18 Additional Bonus Locations: Keep the fun going with even more colorful rooms, unique items to find, and homes to restore.
Brain-Teasing Extras: Enjoy 3 extra Mini-Games and 18 additional puzzles designed to delight true fans of the genre!

Are you ready to grab your cleaning supplies and make these incredible homes shine? 
Join Jane's agency and play Home Rescue: Clean and Restore Collector's Edition today!

70010000123601.name: EGGCONSOLE Harry Fox PC-8801
70010000123601.intro: A mother fox sets out on a quest to save her ailing cub. Through encounters with many animals and riddles to solve—can she make it back in time?
70010000123601.description:
Once upon a time, in the Forest of Romus, there lived a mother fox and her cub who were very close. One day, the cub contracted "Romus Disease." Legend said that whoever caught this disease would never recover, and in fact, everyone who had fallen ill with it so far had died helplessly. The mother fox was powerless and could do nothing but nurse her child. In that moment, she remembered what her grandmother fox had taught her long ago.

"When you grow up to be a mother fox, an incurable illness called Romus Disease will break out. Listen to me—if your child catches this disease, feed them the fried tofu hidden in Rille Shrine..."

The grandmother fox had always shared this strange story with her, speaking as if she already knew what the future held.

Step into a world of wonder in this 1984 adventure classic from MICROCABIN.

Take on the role of a devoted mother fox on a journey to Riru Shrine to find the legendary "abura-age." While the game presents a significant challenge to even the most seasoned players, its cozy atmosphere and enchanting animal characters won the hearts of many—becoming a pioneering title that proved adventure games could be enjoyed by everyone, regardless of gender.


 *This application does not have a scene select mode.
 *The main game and gallery screen (*Gallery) are in Japanese version.
 *Other menu screens and "How to play" screens are in English.
 *Flashing lights or patterns may cause dizziness, spasms, or loss of consciousness. If you feel unwell, stop playing immediately and see a doctor.
   If you have a history of these symptoms, consult a physician before use.

70010000123604.name: Protean fox
70010000123604.description: "Protean fox" is a bullet-hell shooting game that combines relaxation and challenge. In the game, players take on the role of an adorable spirit fox, using firearms, magical artifacts, and spells to battle various monsters across diverse worlds. Along the way, they can meet more pet companions and search for the lost Spirit Fox Fire!

70010000123610.name: Chicken Rescue
70010000123610.intro: Retro-inspired 2D platformer packed with traps, secrets, and challenging levels.
70010000123610.description:
Chicken Rescue is a retro-inspired 2D pixel art platformer where a brave chicken sets out on an adventure to rescue lost chicks and recover valuable diamonds across challenging stages.

Run, jump, glide, and overcome levels filled with enemies, traps, and cleverly designed obstacles. In each stage, players can save up to three lost chicks by opening the cages at the end, rewarding exploration and precise platforming skills.

Collect diamonds scattered throughout the journey and gather eggs to use as ranged attacks against enemies. Defeat foes by jumping on them or attacking from a distance while mastering responsive controls and smooth movement. Hold the jump button to glide through the air, allowing you to avoid hazards, reach hidden paths, and explore new areas.

With detailed pixel art visuals and nostalgic 8-bit inspired music, Chicken Rescue blends classic platforming gameplay with modern level design, offering a fun and rewarding experience for both casual players and platforming fans.

Key Features:
- Classic 2D precision platforming gameplay
- Rescue lost chicks in every level
- Collect diamonds and use eggs as ranged attacks
- Glide mechanic for advanced movement and exploration
- Challenging traps, enemies, and hidden secrets
- Retro pixel art visuals with 8-bit inspired music

70010000123613.name: Dead Patrol
70010000123613.intro: Intense and visceral action shooter where every shot counts
70010000123613.description:
Prepare for the collapse of civilization in Dead Patrol, an intense and visceral action shooter where every shot counts. In a city consumed by chaos, you take on the role of an elite patrol officer sent into the most dangerous zones to face relentless hordes of the undead and reclaim overrun sectors.
With fast-paced, tactical combat, extremely responsive controls, and a powerful arsenal, Dead Patrol delivers a brutal and straightforward survival experience. Strategic movement, fluid weapon switching, and smart use of the environment are essential to stay alive amid the urban chaos.

70010000123622.name: Party Pool
70010000123622.intro: Party Pool is a fun and fast-paced game where players compete in colorful pool matches. Challenge yourself against smart AI opponents, or go head-to-head with a second player
70010000123622.description: Party Pool captures the laid-back vibe of hanging out in a pub with friends, casually playing billiards and enjoying the moment. Whether you’re unwinding solo against AI or sharing the experience with a second player, it’s all about relaxed fun, friendly competition, and good times.

70010000123628.name: Opaloid Kingdom
70010000123628.intro: Explore the Opaloid Kingdom and take control of a sorcerer
70010000123628.description:
Explore the Opaloid Kingdom and take control of a sorcerer sent on a mission to rescue the princess!

Play through fast, minimalistic, old-school arcade challenges in a medieval fantasy land! Explore dark dungeons filled with monsters, travel through new towns and meet crazy wizards while fighting through obstacles that will test your skill.

Features
- Carefully crafted retro aesthetic, including a CRT filter for old-school visual delight.
- Overwhelmed by slow games with multiple story choices at every turn? Enjoy an experience based on quick, satisfying gameplay.
- A wonderful chiptune soundtrack based on authentic medieval songs.
- Minimalist user interface, no cluttered numbers or text covering up the gameplay.
- This game is inspired by old-school RPGs but it is an action game based on skill.

Stories

Like a cozy medieval fantasy tale, Opaloid Kingdom tells the story of two mages.

The first one is the Azure Sorcerer that lives a simple life in Azure river town, growing herbs, foraging mushrooms, helping the villagers with the harvest and a little rain once in a while thanks to his water magic.

His calm lifestyle gets interrupted when the King summons him to the castle with a request that might put his life in danger.

The Crazy Wizard, a mage that lives in a fortress and used to serve the king as an advisor and ally is now the enemy of the whole crown, he lives in his secluded fortress where his monstrous pets keep him company, along with a whole company of dungeon gnomes which have built their own town inside and recognize the Crazy Wizard as his liege.

70010000123636.name: Zoo Orbs: Safari
70010000123636.intro: Stack, Merge and Reach the Giraffe
70010000123636.description:
Get ready for a cute and addictive savanna adventure. In Zoo Orbs Safari, adorable animals fall into glass containers full of personality, and it is up to you to merge them into bigger creatures. Combine two identical animals and climb the evolution chain until you reach the majestic Giraffe, the ultimate trophy of your run.

Each merge creates a small burst that nudges nearby pieces, triggering fun chain reactions and keeping the pile alive. It is easy to understand, but full of clever decisions with every drop.

Instead of short stages, the game features 5 replayable levels, each with a unique container shape and its own mission set. Three objectives are active at the same time, and whenever you complete one, a new one appears to keep the challenge fresh.

With no time pressure and no power-ups, everything depends on your ability to read the space, plan your drops, and handle the physics. Slopes, gaps, and tight spaces make each level feel different and strategic.

Complete mission sets to unlock new levels or keep playing in endless mode to chase higher scores. It is the perfect mix of light strategy, charming visuals, and that irresistible “just one more run” feeling.

Observe, merge, reorganize, and shape the savanna your way.

70010000123644.name: Hentai Puzzle Simulator
70010000123644.intro: Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.
70010000123644.description:
Solve captivating puzzles featuring images of beautiful anime-style girls. With each image you complete, you'll unlock new ones, and the gradually increasing difficulty makes solving the puzzle a fascinating challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling that you're actually touching every detail.

Soft and relaxing music will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after solving the puzzle, you can examine the image closely and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Stylish anime images.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Relaxing music.

70010000123664.name: Cat in a Jam: City Secrets
70010000123664.intro: A Whisker-Tingling Mystery! An emotional and lighthearted story that proves that, sometimes, what we’re looking for is closer than we think.
70010000123664.description: In this 3D narrative exploration adventure, you take control of Bisteca, a house cat who finds himself caught in an urban predicament. Complete over 30 varied missions to earn coins and gather information, help residents, make deliveries, and when things take a darker turn, venture into the city’s underworld to uncover clues about a mysterious disappearance.

70010000123673.name: Hellbrella
70010000123673.intro: Put on your raincoat and destroy hordes of demons in Hell. Use 5 insane umbrellas in an aerial roguelite hack and slash of pure chaos!
70010000123673.description:
BECOME ONE WITH YOUR UMBRELLA!
A fast-paced Aerial Roguelite Hack and Slash where Insane Combos and pure aggression are all that stand between you and death. Step into the paws of a Raincoat Cat and face an infernal journey with nothing but your Umbrella as a Weapon!

EVOLVE OR TURN TO ASHES
Dive into merciless stages Packed with Enemies and Insane Upgrades. The deeper you go into Hell, the more aggressive you must be. Evolve your umbrella, destroy everything in your path, and forge your own combat style

MAIN FEATURES
5 Unique Umbrellas to massacre enemies in different ways

Over 60 Devastating Upgrades to transform your playstyle

Smash hordes of demonic eyes with aerial combos

Collect Pupils to unlock 12 Types of Permanent Upgrades

Use Blood Drops to intensify your playstyle and become even deadlier

DO YOU HAVE THE STOMACH FOR THIS?
Survive endless swarms of demonic eyes, push your skills to the limit, crush your own records, and conquer the top of the Global Leaderboard

Are you ready to carve your path through the underworld and reclaim your soul?

70010000123691.name: Animal Puzzles
70010000123691.intro: Play and learn who lives in farmlands, forests and seas!
70010000123691.description:
Learning is fun when you have friends around!

Meet the animals, plants, people and other lovely things that you can find around farms, forests, or seas and oceans.

Learn shapes, match colorful pictures with their silhouettes, get to know their names, and make the final picture come to life through interacting with different things!

A suitable adventure for even the youngest of curious explorers!

70010000123696.name: Stuck Together
70010000123696.intro: A co-op climbing game about two stuck-together toys on an escape mission from their evil owner.
70010000123696.description:
CO-OP ADVENTURE
Buddy up online or locally in this two-player co-op adventure! Test your teamwork as you swing, scale, and navigate the home of an unhinged teenager. Learn to co-operate... or probably just rage quit. Has your friendship got what it takes?

CLIMB. FALL. REPEAT.
Conquer challenging, physics-based climbing where every grab, swing, and slip could be your last. Miss a jump and it’s back to the floor, but isn’t falling half the fun?

ESCAPE THE HAND-TAGONIST
What’s up with this sadistic kid with too much time on his hands? Chopped doll heads? Mutilated toys? Just when you think you’re getting somewhere, he’ll pop up and squash your hopes of escape.

THE HOME STRETCH
Explore a full-scale house. Six rooms, each packed with unique hazards, interactive objects, and increasingly unfair level design. Throwback to the 90s with retro toys, nostalgic tunes, and enough chaos to mend your childhood trauma.

P.S. If you don’t escape the attic you’re trash.

70010000123714.name: The Clubies
70010000123714.intro: Chaotic party platformer in the disco. Race to the dance floor, solo or coop.
70010000123714.description:
Physics-based party platformer in the disco. Your goal: get to the dance floor – faster than everyone else. Shortcuts, risky jumps, clean timing, also with friends in local coop. Editor & Community Levels provide a constant stream of new levels with online leaderboards.

Play with your friends to help each other... or push each other out at the last second. The main thing is that the room is roaring.

With the intuitive editor, you can create your own disco levels in minutes and share them immediately. Browse through community levels. New challenges every day.

Every course is a race. Use physics to your advantage. Discover shortcuts, hunt for the best online time, and climb the leaderboard.

Build chains of chaos with precise lasers, catapulting cannons, and bouncy disco balls. Combine the objects to create nasty timings or fun party traps. Perfect for trolling, tinkering, and celebrating.

Colorful scenery, glittering balls, and cute cube characters. The perfect setting for chaotic party platforming fun.

70010000123739.name: Bad Raccoon
70010000123739.intro: Welcome to the life of a Suburban Bandit!
70010000123739.description:
In Raccoon Simulator, you aren't a cute little pet; you're a mischievous, hungry scavenger on a mission. Sheriff and his dog live in a nice house full of shiny objects, tasty sausages, and breakable vases. It's time to break in and turn the house into your playground!

Take on the role of the boldest raccoon in town! What's your goal? Cause as much trouble as possible without getting caught! Sneak through the house, raid the refrigerator, knock over the TV, and drive the dog crazy!

This is a game of pure anarchy. Hide in closets to ambush the residents, steal fish from the aquarium, or simply run wild and destroy the furniture. Nowhere is safe from your tiny, grabby hands, from the backyard to the living room.

70010000123745.name: Secrets of Velendar Castle - Escape Room
70010000123745.intro: Imprisoned without explanation, you must escape Velendar Castle and uncover the truth behind the king’s wrath.
70010000123745.description:
The king has taken you prisoner.

Your home was reduced to ashes, and your mother, your only family, was executed under his command. You committed no crime… So why are you here? What does the king truly want from you?

Trapped within the majestic yet ominous halls of Velendar Castle, you must explore its secrets, uncover hidden truths, and find a way to escape before it’s too late.

Advance through the grand chambers of Velendar Castle, each filled with mystery, beauty, and danger. Every room tells a story, if you know how to read it.

Observe your surroundings carefully and use logic to overcome intricate puzzles. Clues are hidden in plain sight, mechanisms conceal deeper meanings, and every solved challenge brings you closer to freedom.

Was your imprisonment truly without reason… or is there a darker truth waiting to be revealed?

70010000123760.name: Apex 2026: Rise of Legends
70010000123760.intro:
Jump into high-speed racing
Master every corner
Become a legend
70010000123760.description:
Jump into fast-paced racing action and take control of powerful race cars on exciting tracks.

In Apex 2026: Rise of Legends, every race is about skill, timing, and quick decisions. Learn the tracks, improve your driving, and compete against challenging AI opponents.

Whether you want quick races or a full career experience, the action never stops.

FEATURES
Easy to learn, skill-based driving
Fast and exciting races on multiple tracks
Career Mode and Quick Race
Competitive AI opponents
Dynamic camera views and smooth controls
FIX YOUR MISTAKES

Made a mistake? Keep going.

Use the Rewind system to go back in time, correct your errors, and try again — perfect for learning tracks and improving your skills.

RACE YOUR WAY

Win races, improve your performance, and climb the ranks to become a true racing legend.

70010000123766.name: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic
70010000123766.description: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic is a Roguelike game. You will role-play an agent of a streamer who died because of a murder. You are trying to "bring her back" through AI technology on the Internet, making her the unique creation of the Internet.

70010000123772.name: Crafty Survivors
70010000123772.intro: Craft Your Own Way to Victory!

70010000123788.name: Medieval Market Simulator
70010000123788.intro:
Run your medieval shop: strike deals, trade rare and magical goods, and manage your business like a true master.
Turn it into the richest store, known across the entire kingdom.
70010000123788.description: Take control of your own shop in the heart of a medieval world and turn it into a true legend. Sign profitable contracts with top suppliers, unlock licenses for rare and magical items, manage your inventory, and hire reliable workers. Expand your business, attract more customers, and never let anyone leave empty-handed. Build the richest and most renowned shop in the entire kingdom.

70010000123794.name: TETRIS® THE GRAND MASTER 4 -ABSOLUTE EYE-
70010000123794.intro: The latest title in the “TGM” series arrives on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000123794.description:
“TETRIS® THE GRAND MASTER 4 -ABSOLUTE EYE-” offers a fast-paced and highly technical Tetris experience, true to the series. Take on new challenges with modes such as ASUKA and SHIRANUI.

Beginner-friendly modes are also included, allowing players of all skill levels to learn, improve, and replay with ease.

70010000123825.name: The Real Academic Challenge High School Level
70010000123825.intro: A high school–level academic challenge that even adults stumble over
70010000123825.description:
Do you remember the problems you studied in high school?

“You probably learned this before.”
“I kind of remember it.”
Even questions that seem familiar may turn out to be harder than expected,
or things you may have already forgotten.

This game is an academic knowledge check quiz
based on subjects taught in high school.

Japanese, mathematics, science, and social studies.
From basic questions learned at school to problems that make you think,
you’ll face a variety of high school–level questions in quiz form.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question  
・Choose the answer by intuition  
・Understand instantly with the result and explanation  

Even if you answer correctly, you can’t let your guard down.
Even if you’re wrong, every question offers a satisfying “aha!” moment.

Play one question at a time whenever you like.
Perfect for passing time or checking your knowledge.

How much of your academic ability still holds up?

If you can solve them, that’s impressive.
Why not challenge this comprehensive high school–level test?

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
TT supports game streaming by video creators.
Both individuals and organizations are free to stream this game without obtaining permission from TT.

70010000123840.name: Youtuber Girls: Love Behind the Camera
70010000123840.intro:
Millions watch her. 
Do you think you can make her look at you?
70010000123840.description:
She has thousands of followers, a ring light, and a smile that breaks the internet.

Getting her attention is already hard. 
Getting a date? Even harder. 
Making her fall for you? That's the real challenge.

Each one with her own channel, her own vibe, her own reason to be impossible to forget. Work your way up, get on their radar, and earn your way into their world.

Because behind the camera, they're just girls who want someone real.

The question is whether that someone is you.


Features:

● DATE YOUTUBERS: Each girl is a star in her own right. Beauty, gaming, lifestyle, drama. Get close enough and find out who she really is when the camera's off.

● MAKE HER NOTICE YOU: She has thousands of fans. You have one shot. Go on dates around the city, say the right things, and become the one she actually thinks about.

● KEEP THE CHAT ALIVE: Text her between dates. Don't go cold. Girls who get a lot of attention drop fast the guys who don't keep up.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: The closer she lets you in, the more she shares. Things her followers will never see.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Not every story ends the same. How far you get depends entirely on you.

A girl with millions of eyes on her. 
Completely out of reach. 
Or is she?

Prove you're worth her time.

70010000123846.name: Youtuber Boys: Love Behind the Camera
70010000123846.intro:
Millions watch him.
Do you think you can make him look at you?
70010000123846.description:
He has thousands of followers, a perfect setup, and a presence that stops the scroll.

Getting his attention is already hard.
Getting a date? Even harder.
Making him fall for you? That's the real challenge.

Each one with his own channel, his own vibe, his own reason to be impossible to forget. Work your way up, get on their radar, and earn your way into their world.

Because behind the camera, they're just guys who want someone real.

The question is whether that someone is you.

Features:

● DATE YOUTUBERS: Each guy is a star in his own right. Gaming, lifestyle, drama, the ones who never show their face. Get close enough and find out who he really is when the camera's off.

● MAKE HIM NOTICE YOU: He has thousands of fans. You have one shot. Go on dates around the city, say the right things, and become the one he actually thinks about.

● KEEP THE CHAT GOING: Text him between dates. Don't go cold. Guys who get a lot of attention drop fast the ones who don't keep up.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: The closer he lets you in, the more he shares. Things his subscribers will never see.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Not every story ends the same. How far you get depends entirely on you.


A guy with millions of eyes on him.
Completely out of reach.
Or is he?

Prove you're worth his time.

70010000123852.name: The End Comes Tomorrow: Gamebook Edition
70010000123852.intro:
A narrative choice adventure about the end of the world.
Live out your last day on earth however you please. Your choices will quickly veer into the unpredictable.
70010000123852.description:
Why is the world ending? In The End Comes Tomorrow, finding that answer isn’t so simple. With dozens of branching pathways to take, your last day could end without even getting out of bed. The choice to stay home, take a walk, see neighbors, or watch TV all tell their own mini-narrative that slowly builds the larger picture.

Each story moment can be completed in a matter of minutes, with the full game taking around half an hour to see every possible outcome, making it a perfect bedtime story or fun way to pass an afternoon for fans of classic choose your own adventure books.

With 17 major story moments that range from funny to touching and introspective, you won’t want to stop until you’ve seen them all.

Classic interactive fiction evolves with modern comforts, auto-save, beautifully rendered scenes, and full voice narration that brings your story to life.

70010000123855.name: Berry Bury Berry
70010000123855.description: A juicy first-person incremental game about growing berries and tossing them down an ominous hole. Earn money and upgrades. Make new friends with sentient berry pals. Grow and control the hole as you unearth why nobody leaves this accursed garden. Bury it all, Berry everything.

70010000123861.name: Fluffy Friends - Cute Preschool
70010000123861.intro: Count and discover with lions, monkeys and exotic animals in a magical forest!
70010000123861.description:
Fluffy Friends Cute Preschool is the perfect first learning game for preschoolers! Featuring 15 carefully crafted mini games set in a breathtaking forest full of rivers, colourful trees and adorable zoo animals, this is early education at its most enchanting. 
Children count exotic animals, compare groups, train their memory, find the biggest and smallest creatures, and tap numbers in the correct order — all brought to life with beautiful animations and delightful sounds designed to keep little ones engaged and motivated. 
Whether played together or explored independently, Fluffy Friends Cute Preschool makes every learning moment feel like a magical adventure in the forest. 

WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN 
Counting and number recognition Comparing groups and sizes Memory and observation skills Logical ordering and sequencing Species recognition and categorisation 

15 MINI GAMES INCLUDE 
Did you see this animal? Which animal did you not see? Which group has the most animals? Count all animals and species Find the biggest and smallest animal Remember the order and tap correctly Memory and much more!

70010000123867.name: Tiny Dino Learning Academy
70010000123867.intro: 15 preschool mini games with adorable dinosaurs!
70010000123867.description:
Tiny Dino Learning Academy is the perfect first learning game for preschoolers! Featuring 15 carefully crafted mini games set in a vibrant prehistoric world full of adorable and lovable dinosaurs, this is early education at its most exciting.

Using simple and intuitive controls, children count dinosaurs, compare groups, train their memory, recognise numbers and dice, and discover which dinosaur is biggest or fastest — all brought to life with beautiful animations and delightful sounds designed to keep little ones engaged and motivated. 
Whether played together on the couch or explored independently, Tiny Dino Learning Academy makes every learning moment feel like a grand prehistoric adventure. 

WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN 
Counting and number recognition Comparing groups and sizes Memory and observation skills Logical ordering and sequencing Species recognition and categorisation 

15 MINI GAMES INCLUDE 
Did you see this dinosaur? Which group is bigger? Find the fastest and biggest dinosaur Count all dinosaurs and species Numbers and dice in the correct order Dinosaurs coming out of magical eggs Memory and much more!

70010000123870.name: Tiny Paw Academy - Numbers Fun
70010000123870.description:
Tiny Paws Academy: Numbers Fun is the perfect learning game for preschoolers! Featuring 15 charming mini games set in a world of adorable forest and farm animals, this is early education at its most playful.
Using your controller, children navigate a friendly on-screen cursor to count animals, compare groups, train their memory, recognise numbers and dice, and discover which animal is biggest or fastest — all brought to life with beautiful animations and delightful sounds.
Perfect to share on the couch or let your little one explore independently!

WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN 
• Counting and number recognition 
• Comparing groups and sizes 
• Memory and observation skills 
• Logical ordering and sequencing 
• Species recognition and categorisation

15 MINI GAMES INCLUDE 
• Did you see this animal? 
• Which group is bigger? 
• Find the fastest / biggest animal 
• Count all animals and species 
• Numbers and dice in the correct order 
• Animals coming out of a magical hat 
• Memory and much more!

70010000123873.name: Kalanoro
70010000123873.intro: Kalanoro is an action-adventure mixing platforming, combat and light management!
70010000123873.description:
WELCOME TO LEMURIA
A world inspired by Madagascar’s folklore. Once a paradise, it now suffers under the witch Raneny’s ruthless rule. Having grown tired of exploiting its people, she decided to host a huge concert with the island’s most famous band. You’re sent on a mission to fight back by rallying legendary musicians to your cause! 

THE (BOGUS) PROPHECY CHOSE YOU
Dash through diverse biomes across Lemuria, save and befriend funky locals to form your crew, and jump over industrial platforming traps to become Lemuria’s number one band and finally face Raneny!

DANCING THROUGH JOYFUL CHAOS
Defeat Raneny’s minions in fast-paced combat, using hair-based powers and improvised weapons (slippers included) to fight epic and groovy boss battles and free the island! 

HOP ON A FUN MUSICAL ROADTRIP 
Assemble a band with eccentric lemur artists, manage your tour bus through mini-games, and build your band’s popularity among locals to perform on bigger stages.

70010000123879.name: The Stairwell
70010000123879.description:
It's your first day as a security officer in a mysterious building designed by an unknown architect. Within its vast stairwell, you are tasked with inspecting the floors for reported strange phenomena. Make your way through the building and carefully choose which way to go based on your findings.

How to Play?
If everything is normal, proceed upstairs.
If you notice an anomaly, go downstairs, quickly.
Do not miss too many anomalies.

The Stairwell is a psychological horror game inspired by anomaly loop games such as The Exit 8, with a new vertical dimension of massive scale. There are over 50 anomalies to uncover between all difficulties. You can see how many are left to find after you win a game. Anomalies that you haven't seen will usually appear first.

Choose Your Difficulty

Customize the difficulty of your playthrough. In nightmare mode, beware: the lights are out. Can you find anomalies in total darkness with your candle?

70010000123901.name: Arcade Archives HYPER CRASH
70010000123901.intro: A survival race where anything goes!
70010000123901.description:
"HYPER CRASH" is a racing game released by KONAMI in 1987.
Race along courses with various landscapes and buildings from all over the world while avoiding obstacles like drums and oil as you aim for the goal across all 6 stages.
Slam into enemy cars to make them crash! Or jump into the air and land on them to crush them down! In this survival race, anything goes!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000123919.name: Take It Seriously! Extreme Common Sense Challenge
70010000123919.intro: A common sense test so difficult you can’t solve it — even though you should know the answers
70010000123919.description:
Is your common sense really up to date?

“You should know this.”
“I’ve heard of it somewhere.”
Even knowledge that seems familiar can be surprisingly hard to answer,
or may turn out to be based on assumptions.

This game is an extremely challenging common-sense quiz
covering a wide range of knowledge.

Word meanings, social knowledge, trivia, culture, and history.
Questions that seem familiar but are harder than expected,
as well as tricky problems that make you stop and think,
are presented in quiz form.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question  
・Choose the answer by intuition  
・Understand instantly with the result and explanation  

Even if you answer correctly, you can’t relax.
Even if you’re wrong, every question offers an “aha!” moment.

Play one question at a time whenever you like.
Perfect for passing time or checking your knowledge.

How far does your common sense go?

Take it seriously
and challenge this extremely difficult common-sense quiz!

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
TT supports game streaming by video creators.
Both individuals and organizations can stream this game without obtaining permission from TT.

70010000123973.name: KIYO - Bunny Tyranny
70010000123973.intro: Kiyo, a feline ex-predator, is trapped in a neon-lit, dystopian city dominated by smartphone-addicted bunnies. Infiltrate the bunnies' facilities and free everyone from their tyrannical grip.
70010000123973.description:
INCOMING BROADCAST
"Welcome to Rabbithole City, where all animals live a fulfilling life outside nature in this modern, neon-lit city - and it's all thanks to the mightiest species of all: bunnies! A few years ago, they brought us technological progress and a life of fun and pleasure. 

And the small price for such a life? Leaving your filthy natural habitat and your instincts behind. Especially you, carnivores, should change your ways if you want to be accepted in this glorious society. "


FREE THE OPRESSED
Not everyone agrees with the bunnies and many species are suffering under this strict rabbit regime.

You are recruited by a giant Owl who needs your help to sabotage the Bunny Tyranny. He gives you control over the body of a tiger-lynx, Kiyo, and sends you on various stealth and platforming missions to uncover the bunnies’ wicked plans. To avoid the merciless rabbit police, you'll need to make clever decisions about when to be stealthy or violent, or both. Hide in the dynamic shadows, use distractions, attacks, and ninja rope acrobatics, and don't get caught!


THE NIGHTLIFE IS CALLING
Take your time and get lost in the atmosphere of Rabbithole City. Learn more about life in this world, meet colorful characters, explore different locations, and discover how evil the bunnies really are.

Feel the seductive pull of the neon lights and immersive synth-wave beats, but be careful - do not lose sight of your mission.

70010000123979.name: Kat-Tastic Hidden Object
70010000123979.intro: Join Whiskerburg’s next big detective adventure!
70010000123979.description:
Play as Kat, a brave newcomer ready to solve the town’s trickiest cases. 
Find hidden objects, uncover clues, and help a bunch of cute cat friends including noble Sir Whiskers, elegant Duchess Purrcilla, and bubbly Mittens.

Each mystery you solve brings Kat closer to rising through the detective ranks and helps her fix her new office. 
With easy-to-play, whimsical characters, and stories that are warm and funny, this cat detective adventure is sure to make you smile from beginning to end.

Features:
- 15 beautiful Hidden Object scenes to explore
- 15 fun Item Matching scenes to enjoy
- Help Whiskerburg’s quirky cats solve 7 cozy cases
- 15 Triple Tile levels plus 7 relaxing jigsaw puzzles
- Gorgeous hand-crafted visuals and immersive sound design

70010000123987.name: The Last of Touch
70010000123987.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000123987.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000123999.name: Hazard Pay
70010000123999.description:
The job is simple: destroy evidence. Leave no trace. Don’t die in the process. 
Hazard Pay is a pixel-art block-pushing puzzler set in a crumbling dystopian world. You’ll navigate alone through abandoned and contaminated facilities, dodging environmental hazards while completing your employer’s checklist with calculated efficiency.
Pack up the truck and head to the site. Mop the floors. Remove the evidence. Destroy the ███████. Do not leave anything behind, not even your footsteps. There’s blood on the floor and smoke in the air. Relax. It’s just another accident to clean up. Do the job properly and no one has to get in trouble. 
Each site is a compact, intricate puzzle with moving parts. You can use the environment to gather scattered documents or push ███████ into chemical barrels to erase any wrongdoing. One wrong move, and you could be trapped, dissolved in acid, or worse. Plan ahead. Improvise when you must. Stay sharp. Global Leaderboards.
Even after a job’s done, you can always go back. Every move is tracked, and your final step count determines your rank. Pull off a perfect run, and your name might just show up on the global leaderboard. Compare your stats with friends or the world. Just remember, your employer is always watching.
All you know is the name: IPT. No faces, no meetings. Just a radio, and they talk first. You can feel something’s off. But are you really ready to dig into it? Some things are better left buried. Will you stay obedient… or resist? Features Ingenious, compact, handcrafted puzzle levels. Grid-based push/pull mechanics with environmental twists. Global and friends leaderboards. Dystopian narrative told through the environment. Detailed pixel art and matching atmosphere.

70010000124015.name: Millionaire Obby
70010000124015.intro: Climb, jump, and conquer your way to millionaire status
70010000124015.description:
Think you have what it takes to climb your way to the top? In Millionaire Obby, every jump brings you closer to fortune!

Take on a thrilling parkour adventure packed with challenging stages, clever obstacles, and rewarding checkpoints. Each stage pushes your skills further as you race to reach the end and prove you’ve got what it takes to become a true millionaire.

Features:
>Dozens of fun and challenging parkour stages
>Checkpoints to save your progress
>A unique millionaire-themed world full of style and flair
>Perfect for both casual players and obby pros

70010000124028.name: Eternal Exodus
70010000124028.intro: A story-driven monster-catching RPG set in the afterlife, with crafting, fusion, strategic turn-based combat, minigames, sidequests, and more.
70010000124028.description:
GAMEPLAY

- Catch demons and train them for battle.
- Fuse them together into more powerful species.
- Craft weapons and armor that teach new spells and passive abilities to them.
- Earn extra turns in combat by exploiting enemies' weaknesses.
- Explore a massive world full of rewarding sidequests, minigames, and puzzles.

STORY

The afterlife isn't what you expected. Sure, you can live forever here, but only if you stay in the good graces of those in power. And it's looking like you won't.

Luckily, you have a Subjugator: a forbidden wrist-worn device that allows you to summon demons.

What begins as a simple revolt against the afterlife's governing force, The Crown, quickly spirals into something much, much greater.

Inspired by a wide range of philosophical and mystical texts, Eternal Exodus takes you on a unique journey to uncover the metaphysical secrets of the universe and tear open the fabric of reality.

70010000124034.name: Dungeon Antiqua
70010000124034.description:
Dungeon Antiqua is a dungeon crawl-type RPG with beautiful dots and nostalgic sounding chiptunes that are reminiscent of the 1980s and 1990s.

- 2D maps that expand to match the character's field of view.

- A game design that can be played over and over again thanks to a wide variety of professions, free party formation and auto-generated maps.

- Game progression focused on hacking and exploration, with no redundant scenarios or direction.

- Fast-paced, modern and comfortable controls.

Dungeon Antiqua is a portal to new adventures for players who love retro games. Enjoy new challenges while reminiscing about the good old days of gaming!

70010000124040.name: Dungeon Antiqua 2
70010000124040.intro: A retro 2D dungeon crawler bursting with 16-bit nostalgia.
70010000124040.description:
Since then, countless moons have passed...
As people wove generations together,she quietly continued to fulfill her duty.

But at last, the time came, and the silence was broken.
Old and weary, she gathered her last strength
and spread her wings to find out the hero...

- About Dungeon Antiqua 2
Dungeon Antiqua 2 is a 2D dungeon-crawler hack-and-slash RPG, featuring 16-bit pixel art and sound reminiscent of the 1990s.
A retro-flavored adventure awaits you, blending strategic exploration with a highly flexible character building system.

- Exploration
Players will explore six dungeons, navigating with a unique system where visibility of corridors and enemies depends on the character’s “vision".
Dungeon Antiqua 2 uses a symbol encounter system—you can avoid battles by dodging enemies, or strike first and take the initiative. The path forward is yours to carve through skill and decision-making!

- System
In addition to the eight jobs from the previous game, two new classes—Monk and Archer—have been added, bringing the total to ten.
Earn skill points from victorious battles; once they reach the required threshold, you’ll unlock job-specific skills.
Since changing jobs does not reset level, you can freely experiment with multiple jobs to create your own ultimate party!
note: Five jobs are available at the start of the game. The remaining five types will become available as you progress through the game.

- Concept
Sometimes, why not take a step back and return to the cartridge era of gaming?
By stripping away excessive story cutscenes and focusing on short, simple dialogue and text, the world is designed to spark your imagination—inviting you to create your own personal adventure.

- Playtime
For a first playthrough, we estimate a playtime of approximately 10-12 hours.

Dungeon Antiqua
This game takes place hundreds of years after the story of Dungeon Antiqua.
You may even come across some familiar characters from the previous game…

70010000124046.name: Dark Secrets Mystery Files
70010000124046.intro: 20 standalone mysteries. Can you solve them all?
70010000124046.description:
Shadow Case Files: Short Mysteries is a mystery quiz game featuring 20 standalone cases.
Each case presents a different incident, clue, or inconsistency for you to examine as you work toward the truth.

With its short-form structure, each mystery is easy to pick up and play, whether you have a few spare minutes or want to solve several cases in one sitting.

Read carefully, spot the hidden hints, and uncover what really happened.

Perfect for players who enjoy mystery stories, deduction, and bite-sized brain-teasing challenges.

70010000124053.name: Mate'Morphosis
70010000124053.intro: Solve puzzles by becoming the pieces you defeat in a strategic and brainteasing twist on classic chess!
70010000124053.description:
Strategize and conquer in a brainteasing twist on a tabletop gaming classic! Mate’Morphosis is a chess-inspired puzzle game built around the concept of becoming the pieces that you capture. Outsmart each board, adapt to evolving mechanics and hunt down the rival king across every stage! Instead of commanding multiple pieces, you’ll need to navigate the board with a single player piece that transforms into the type of piece you’ve just defeated.

Step up from pawn to knight, bishop or rook in order to take out the queen and finally gain the freedom of movement necessary to checkmate the king. Your route evolves with every move. Learn as you go, even if you’re not a master at classic chess! Enjoy retro 2D pixel art presentation and tight hand-crafted challenges with quick restarts, fast strategic pacing and a gradual climb in difficulty across dozens of unique stages!

• Push your strategic thinking to the limit!
• Master 60 hand-crafted puzzles inspired by chess.
• Command a single piece and morph into the ones you defeat!
• Determine your route to victory over the queen and put the king in checkmate.
• Enjoy beginner-friendly rules and gradual increase in challenge!

70010000124064.name: The Vanishing Train
70010000124064.intro:
The same scenery, the same routine.
But today, “something” was different…
70010000124064.description:
This title is a psychological horror game in which you play as a train conductor on a local line in Japan.

●Story
As usual, the protagonist begins his shift driving a local train deep in the mountains.
However, as he goes about his duties, mysterious and inexplicable events gradually begin to unfold...

●Game Features
- A horror game set in Japan
- Train driver duties experience
- A first-person 3D horror game
- Features five different endings

●Additional elements
A new ending has been added.

70010000124074.name: Skyforge Trails
70010000124074.intro: Forge your path above the clouds.
70010000124074.description:
Skyforge Trails is an isometric puzzle-adventure set among breathtaking floating islands high above the clouds. Players guide a brave traveler across ancient stone paths, shifting platforms, dangerous traps, and mysterious ruins scattered through magical sky realms. Each level is a handcrafted challenge that blends exploration, timing, and clever problem-solving, rewarding careful planning as much as quick movement. 

Along the way, you will push blocks, activate glowing tiles, avoid hazards, collect coins, and discover new routes through increasingly complex environments. From fiery volcanic heights to frozen mountain trails and peaceful sky temples, every world introduces fresh mechanics and a distinct visual atmosphere. The journey is both relaxing and challenging, combining satisfying puzzle design with the charm of vibrant pixel-art landscapes.

With its mix of accessible gameplay, atmospheric worldbuilding, and rewarding progression, Skyforge Trails invites players to forge their own path through a magical world suspended between the heavens and the unknown.

70010000124085.name: Escape from Umbra
70010000124085.intro: Immerse yourself in a survival horror escape room experience. Trapped in a mysterious world of darkness where shadows lurk, your only help is a secret book and a flashlight.
70010000124085.description:
Umbra is hunting you. She has eyes lurking everywhere within the shadows, and she will not stop until she finds you and locks your soul away forever.

Trapped in a mysterious village ruled by darkness, your only tools to escape her curse are a small flashlight and a secret book of clues. Move unseen, follow the cats' hints, and solve the enigmas to find your path to freedom.

•	The Secret Book: An enigmatic journal filled with information and clues that will help you solve the various puzzles and riddles you must face to escape.

•	Exploration & Interaction: Investigate your surroundings, pick up items, examine them, and combine them. Discover how to use and manipulate the environment to escape from each area.

•	The Flashlight: More than just lighting your way in a world of near-total darkness, it serves as a crucial tool with a powerful flash function. But use it wisely and keep a close eye on your battery.

•	The Cats: When you see them, trust them. They will guide you and help you through key moments of your adventure.

•	A Village in Darkness: Inspired by mountain witch legends, this labyrinthine village is open for exploration, yet remains a world drenched in shadows and darkness.

•	The Witch: She roams the streets of the village, relentlessly hunting you. If you hear roots creaking, turn off your flashlight and hide quickly where she cannot see you.

•	The Specters: Summoned by the witch to watch every corner, they are alert to any trace of light. Avoid being seen, as they are fast and precise. But if they find you, your flashlight's flash function will give you a chance to shake them off.

•	Traces of Black Magic & Mirrors: Clouds of shadows and mirrors frozen in time. Find a way to discover what they hide.

•	Vibration Mechanics: Feel your heartbeat—light when you seem safe, but intense and rapid when danger is near.

Do you dare to face your fears and unveil the secrets of Umbra’s domain?

70010000124091.name: Tow Truck Police Simulator
70010000124091.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game
70010000124091.intro: Command the fleet that keeps the city moving.
70010000124091.description:
Step into the role of a dedicated law enforcement officer in Tow Truck Police Simulator, where maintaining order on the streets is entirely in your hands. Patrol a living, breathing city filled with traffic violations, and take action with precision and authority. Every call is a new challenge—every decision shapes your reputation as you work to keep the roads clear and the city moving.

Features:
• Realistic towing mechanics with detailed truck physics, weight balance, and precise control systems.
• Advanced violation detection system with dynamic scenarios and decision-based outcomes.
• Multiple tow truck types, including medium and heavy-duty vehicles with unique handling characteristics.
• Interactive towing tools and equipment for complex recovery operations.
• Vehicle customization and upgrade system affecting performance and efficiency.
• Reputation and reward system tied to accuracy, speed, and professional conduct.
• Diverse urban environments with tight streets, heavy traffic, and evolving conditions.



Enforce the rules, clear the streets, and rise through the ranks in a city that depends on your skills. In Tow Truck Police Simulator, it’s not just about towing—it’s about control, responsibility, and mastering every situation. Prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate authority on the road.

70010000124097.name: Hunter Desert Simulator: Sniper Rifle
70010000124097.intro: Do you have the patience to become a master hunter?
70010000124097.description:
Hunter Desert Simulator: Sniper Rifle challenges you to become a true hunter in the vast, endless stretches of the desert. Explore a large and demanding environment filled with wild animals adapted to harsh conditions, where precision and patience are key to success. Use your sniper skills to track and hunt prey without being detected, taking advantage of rugged terrain and natural elements to stay hidden. Every step counts in this realistic simulation that emphasizes tactical strategy and smart decision-making. 

Key Features: 
-Authentic desert environment: Explore a vast and varied landscape with dunes, rocks, and oases, carefully detailed.
 -Precision shooting: Control a specialized arsenal of sniper rifles designed for long-distance hunting. 
-Realistic wildlife behavior: Animals have natural routines and reactions, requiring observation and careful planning.
 -Strategy and patience: Be silent, use the terrain for camouflage, and plan every move to succeed.
 -Dynamic challenges: Changing environmental conditions and difficult terrain constantly test your hunting skills. 

Get ready to sharpen your senses and master the art of hunting in the heart of the desert.

70010000124109.name: Horripilant
70010000124109.description: Horripilant is a chilling incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld. Combining idler, puzzle and autobattler elements, you'll fight, mine, and think your way through the depths of a forsaken dungeon. With each step you'll grow stronger, but beware; every boon has its burden.

70010000124115.name: Castaway
70010000124115.intro: Survive day and night on a small island in the middle of the ocean.
70010000124115.description:
Gather resources to improve your chances of survival, search for supplies, build tools and a shelter to stay alive. In this harsh environment, your greatest enemy is hunger, so you'll need to hunt wild boars, gather fruit that has fallen to the ground, and catch fish from the sea to keep yourself fed and avoid starving.

Embrace the solitude as you fight to survive in Castaway.

70010000124122.name: The Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival ~eternal passion! Tie break ♡ game~ Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000124122.intro: Stranded with a Prince—get ready to Survi-love!
70010000124122.description:
The Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival ~eternal passion! Tie break ♡ game~ is a globally remastered edition of a legendary otome game that has been beloved in Japan for more than 20 years.

<Story>
While on vacation, a sudden storm leaves you and your friend stranded on a deserted island.
Join forces with the tennis club members who shared your ship and set out together to escape the island.

<Features>
- Experience a survival life surrounded by many charming Princes.
- Enjoy sweet and bittersweet date events unique to each Prince!
- Experience elegant, beautifully illustrated event CGs, with some artwork enhanced by animation.

<Princes: Characters/Voice Actors>
▽Seishun Gakuen Junior High School

70010000124131.name: Havenfall is for Lovers
70010000124131.intro: My partners, chasing after my vanished sister, were kind-hearted "monsters." At the end of our joint struggle to uncover the truth, a dangerous love transcending species
70010000124131.description:
■Story

The heroine lives with her sister in the American rural town of Havenfall.
However, one day her sister suddenly goes missing—!?
On her quest to find her sister alone, everyone the heroine meets turns out to be a monster!
A vampire town doctor, a werewolf sheriff, a djinn boss at her part-time job, and even a devil!

The heroine believes they are the culprits who kidnapped her sister.
However, the real culprits are a group antagonistic to them...
To get her sister back, the heroine decides to work with these monsters!

As they work together, the heroine gradually finds herself drawn to the very human hearts that lurk beneath their monstrous appearances...
What will become of the love between a human and a monster...?!
■Characters

Diego Escalona
