	•	Progress through increasingly demanding environments
Take your time, choose your path, and push your limits.
In Offroad Craft Runner 4x4 Simulator, every journey is about control, strategy, and exploration.

70010000124701.name: Cozy Battle Royale 2026
70010000124701.intro: A cozy world with a competitive edge!
70010000124701.description:
A colorful world. A competitive fight. Survival with a twist.
In Cozy Battle Royale 2026, you enter a vibrant battlefield set across floating islands where every match is dynamic, fast, and unpredictable. Drop into the arena, explore your surroundings, and adapt quickly as the world changes around you.

Instead of relying only on weapons, you evolve during the match. Collect special cores and choose upgrades that transform your abilities, movement, and combat style. Every decision shapes how you play — whether you focus on mobility, offense, or defense.

Move freely across vertical environments using jumps, glides, and fast traversal mechanics. As the match progresses, parts of the map collapse, forcing players closer together and creating intense final encounters high above the void.
Face both players and environmental threats while managing your build and positioning. Combine different upgrades with your equipment to create unique strategies and outplay your opponents.

Each match is a mix of exploration, adaptation, and survival — where staying flexible is the key to victory .

Key Features:
* Evolution system with upgrade choices during matches
* Vertical movement with dynamic traversal mechanics
* Map collapse system that changes the battlefield
* Variety of weapons and build combinations
* Fast-paced matches with strategic depth
Stay light, move fast, and adapt to every moment.

In Cozy Battle Royale 2026, survival is about how you evolve.

70010000124707.name: EXSTETRA
70010000124707.intro: A fantasy RPG where a kiss can save the world.
70010000124707.description:
Exstetra follows Ryoma, a high school student chosen to become a Prisma, the savior destined to protect Amejia, a Tokyo fused with another world and doomed to destruction.

During his journey, Ryoma meets future Prisma Knights who share his mission. By awakening their powers with a kiss, he joins them on an adventure to save two worlds.

◆ STORY ◆

Kiss her...

It is the only way to save two worlds from ruin.

Amejia was born from the fusion of Tokyo and another realm. As the chosen Prisma, Ryoma fights to prevent the extinction of both worlds.

Find the friends drawn into Amejia and awaken their hidden powers as Prisma Knights through the power of a kiss.

◆ WORLD ◆

Amejia is a transformed version of Tokyo that has merged with another world.

Featuring artwork inspired by Tokyo Fantasy, it offers a beautiful yet haunting world unlike any other.

Explore reimagined locations such as Shibuya and Akihabara.

◆ DUNGEON ◆

Mysterious labyrinths stretch across Amejia.

Battle monsters, solve puzzles, discover treasure, gather materials, and explore dangerous dungeons as you venture ever deeper.

◆ BATTLE ◆

The only way to save the world is a kiss!

Fight alongside the Prisma Knights in strategic turn-based battles.

Form a party of up to four characters, choose formations and skills, and adapt your tactics to every encounter.

An Auto-Battle feature is also available.

• Ex Skills

As a Prisma, Ryoma can absorb Ex, the energy that powers this world, by defeating enemies.

Share Ex with Prisma Knights through a kiss to awaken their strength and unleash powerful Ex Skills.

• Party Formation and Affinity

Up to four characters can participate in battle.

Team composition and relationships with allies both play important roles, so strengthen your bonds with a variety of companions.

• Enchant System

Combine skills attached to weapons, armor, and accessories to create customized battle strategies.

Gather materials, enhance your equipment, and prepare for powerful enemies.

*This product is based on Exstetra, originally released in 2013. Some features and specifications may differ from the original version.

70010000124713.name: Protocol: Annihilation
70010000124713.intro: Assume control of a combat robot in a relentless sci-fi shooter where total destruction is the only directive.
70010000124713.description:
Protocol: Annihilation is a high-intensity sci-fi shooter where your only directive is total destruction. Take control of a powerful combat robot built for one purpose—eliminate every hostile machine in your path. Navigate through dangerous, futuristic environments filled with relentless enemy fire, shifting hazards, and increasingly complex robotic threats designed to test your reflexes and strategy.

As you progress, collect and upgrade an arsenal of devastating weapons, each offering unique ways to dismantle your enemies. Adapt your playstyle on the fly as you face diverse enemy types, from fast-moving drones to heavily armored war machines, all with distinct attack patterns and behaviors. Precision, timing, and quick decision-making are key to survival.

Each level intensifies the chaos, pushing you deeper into enemy territory under the strict protocol: annihilation. Master your movement, outmaneuver overwhelming forces, and prepare for climactic encounters that demand everything you’ve learned. At the end of your mission awaits a massive, formidable final boss—an ultimate test of your firepower and skill in a battle where only one will remain.

70010000124731.name: Mega Eater Girls
70010000124731.intro: Love to eat! A puzzle game featuring big‑eating girls is here!
70010000124731.description:
Collect pieces of the big‑eater girls and complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Once completed, high‑resolution images will be added to your gallery ♪
=====================
We support game streamers!
No permission is required to stream this game.

70010000124737.name: Princess Dress Up Collection Fives games in one
70010000124737.intro: 5 magical dress-up games in one adorable collection. Create princess, fairy, fashion, and doll looks with outfits, hairstyles, and accessories made for kids.
70010000124737.description:
Step into a world of sparkle, style, and imagination with Princess Dress Up Collection: 5 Games in 1.
This charming collection brings together five adorable dress-up games in one easy-to-enjoy package for kids who love princesses, fairy magic, fashion looks, and creative doll styling.
Mix and match dresses, hairstyles, accessories, and colorful outfits to create beautiful looks across five different themes:
• Princess Dress Up
• Indian Princess: Dress Up!
• Little Fairy Dress Up
• Model Style: Dress Up!
• Doll Style: Underground Design and Dress
From royal gowns and fairy wings to trendy outfits and playful doll makeovers, there is always a new style to discover. The unified menu makes it simple to jump between games and enjoy a huge variety of dress-up fun in one place.
Why kids will love it:
• 5 dress-up games in 1 collection
• Princess, fairy, fashion, and doll themes
• Lots of outfits, hairstyles, and accessories
• Easy pick-up-and-play creative fun
• Great value compared with buying the games separately
Perfect for young players who enjoy princess games, fashion games, doll games, and cute creative experiences on Nintendo Switch™.

70010000124741.name: Verho - Curse of Faces
70010000124741.intro: Verho is a Dark RPG following the tradition of the King’s Field series. Travel to the land of Yariv, find the source of the Curse of Faces, and fight the dangers of this scourge.
70010000124741.description:
YOU STEP INTO YARIV...ACCURSED LAND FROM WHICH THE CURSE THAT RAVAGED THE WORLD ORIGINATED....

The Curse of Faces - where revealing one's face means instant death – has befallen the world. Humanity was brought close to the brink. After 264 years of "the Era of Solitude", a symbol of safety appeared – Masks. While the origins of the curse are still shrouded in mystery, many travelers still venture to the source of this curse in an attempt to reveal its secrets. Will you strive to lift the curse from the world, or will you harness its power for your own ends?

- Throughout your journeys in Yariv, you will encounter many unique characters whose fates will hinge on your decisions.

- Face numerous dangerous creatures and engage in challenging battles.

- Discover mysterious locations and acquire artifacts and ancient weaponry. 

Don your chosen mask. Fight. Explore. And unveil the secrets of Yariv...

70010000124768.name: Amazing Facts : World Proverbs True or False Quiz
70010000124768.intro:
How well do you know the wisdom of the world?
Test yourself with surprising proverbs from around the globe!
70010000124768.description:
Discover surprising proverbs and sayings from around the world in this fun true-or-false quiz game.
Some are clever, some are strange, and some may make you say, “Wait, that’s a real proverb?”

Answer simple true-or-false questions as you explore different cultures, ways of thinking, and bits of everyday wisdom from across the globe.
Perfect for trivia fans, casual play sessions, and anyone who loves learning something new while having fun.

Easy to play and great for short breaks, this quiz game lets you enjoy the fun of guessing, learning, and being surprised.

70010000124779.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
70010000124779.intro: Dodge bullets, defeat the enemy, and face the incident of the Scarlet Mist
70010000124779.description:
Touhou Koumakyou from the Touhou makes its debut on Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch 2 .
Take control of Reimu the shrine maiden or Marisa the magician as you set out to resolve an incident threatening Gensokyo.

The New Classic version features upgraded high-resolution visuals, with every BGM track arranged by ZUN. It also introduces a new mode, where you can take on the game with unlimited lives.

You can also play the Classic version, which perfectly preserves the original 2002 gameplay.
*All text in the Classic version is in Japanese.

This product is for the Nintendo Switch™. It can also be played on the Nintendo Switch 2 , but a separate Nintendo Switch 2 -exclusive version, “Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil,” is also available.
Save data and downloadable content are not compatible between the two versions. Please check carefully to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Please note that there is no Nintendo Switch 2 Edition or Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack for this title.

70010000124785.name: Let's Aim! Crane Game
70010000124785.intro: The hugely popular crane game series is back and better than ever! Aim, grab, and hook your prizes! Master a variety of crane arms and win tons of prizes!
70010000124785.description:
Enjoy an authentic crane game experience on Nintendo Switch™!
Take on realistic physics and a wide variety of stages!
In addition to standard crane claws, special machines featuring suction cups, hooks, chains, and water-based stages also appear!
Collect every prize and become a true crane game master!

【Free Play】
Challenge all 36 stages!
Clear a stage by collecting every prize!
Aim for a 3-star rating with the fastest clear times!

【Challenge】
Take on 6 stages in a row!
Compete for the fastest times and climb the global rankings!

【Collection Room】
Display and admire the prizes you've collected!
Create your very own original room!

70010000124795.name: What Misaki holds in her hand is her deduction
70010000124795.intro: A World Three Years After Courage's Deductive Nori
70010000124795.description: Misaki struggles in Togai Street, which has become a lawless zone.

70010000124811.name: Dungeonloop
70010000124811.description: Dungeonloop is a turn-based roguelite where every run plays out differently. Move and act on a grid, battle unpredictable enemies, collect powerful artifacts, and adapt your strategy as random encounters shape your path. Explore three distinct locations - each with its own atmosphere and boss - and build unique loadouts as you fight deeper into the loop.

70010000124830.name: Adventure of Kanjiro Chapter 1
70010000124830.intro: Let's go on an adventure for those who have lost their kanji!
70010000124830.description:
"Adventure of Kanjiro" is a game of kanji learning, so that children who are not good at kanji or dislike practicing kanji can learn kanji while having fun.

As Kanjiro, the main character of this work, you will discover kanji stolen by monsters by writing kanji, looking for kanji, and looking for reading. By discovering kanji, you can raise your level and earn coins.
You can use coins to buy items such as equipment and potions at the shop to prepare to fight monsters.
In battles with monsters, the faster you remember the kanji you find, the more damage you can do. However, if you remember incorrectly, you will be damaged instead.
In order to defeat monsters, it is important not only to have good items, but also to remember the kanji well.

Let's enjoy the game and memorize the kanji so that we can defeat all the monsters and get back the kanji!

70010000124834.name: Pocket Ludo
70010000124834.intro: Classic board game, bringing simple dice-based strategy to your screen. Designed for up to four players, it offers quick, turn-based gameplay that’s easy to learn and fun for all ages.
70010000124834.description:
Pocket Ludo captures the charm of the classic tabletop experience and brings it into a convenient digital format. Just like gathering around a board at home, rolling dice, and teasing your friends over lucky moves, the game recreates that same lighthearted competition—only now on a shared screen. The familiar rules remain intact, making it instantly accessible whether you’re a longtime fan or new to the game.

Playing locally with up to four players mirrors the traditional at-home experience, where every turn sparks reactions—cheers, groans, and playful rivalries. The difference is in the ease: no setup, no lost pieces, and no need to clear the table. Keeps the spirit of sitting together in one room, passing turns and reacting in real time, while adding smooth visuals and faster pacing.

While nothing fully replaces the tactile feel of a physical board and dice, Pocket Ludo offers a modern alternative that fits anywhere. Whether on the couch, during travel, or at a small gathering, it preserves the social fun of the original game while making it more accessible and portable for today’s players.

70010000124846.name: Mosaic Quiz Fastest Finger Battle
70010000124846.intro:
What's hiding behind the mosaic?
The moment you see it is the moment you win.
70010000124846.description:
What's hidden behind that mosaic?

"I can kind of see the shape, but... what is it?"
"Oh, I know! ...Wait, maybe not?"
A speed quiz that puts your eyes and instincts to the test.

In this game, you look at a mosaic-covered image and race to pick the correct answer from four choices.

Animals, food, instruments, vehicles, flowers...
With 300 questions covering everything from everyday objects to surprising subjects, there's always something new to guess.

How to play is simple.
・Look at the mosaic image
・Choose your answer from 4 options
・The original image is revealed with the answer!

The thrill of "Wait, THAT's what it was?!" and the satisfaction of "I knew it!" will keep you coming back for more.

Three levels of mosaic intensity await you.
Early stages start with a light mosaic where shapes are visible, building up to an almost impossible heavy mosaic in later stages.
How far can you see through?

Play from just one question at a time.
Perfect for filling a few spare minutes.

Can you see what's beyond the mosaic?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000124852.name: EGGCONSOLE Onryou Senki PC-8801mkIISR
70010000124852.intro: Use your deductive powers to battle spirits in this unique Miyaji City horror adventure!
70010000124852.description:
Originally released in 1988 by Studio WING, this classic adventure game puts you in the shoes of Hiroyuki Kitahara, a young man who awakens to supernatural powers after a chilling encounter. Set in the eerie Miyaji City—a place plagued by a string of bizarre incidents—you must harness your deductive skills to battle vengeful spirits and uncover the truth.

The game utilizes a classic command-based system, making it accessible and intuitive for all players. Its distinct graphics and haunting sound design work in tandem to pull you deep into a world where the living and the dead collide.

While detective mysteries dominated the adventure scene of the era, this title stood out for its innovative fusion of investigation and exorcism. We invite you to experience the dark visual style and iconic soundscapes that made this unique horror adventure a standout title.

70010000124855.name: Arcade Archives CYBER CYCLES
70010000124855.intro: It all comes down to cornering! Know the track, and attack!
70010000124855.description:
"CYBER CYCLES" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
This game featured a large bike-style cabinet design that stood out at arcades at the time.
Set against the backdrop of near-future motorcycle racing, choose from a lineup of unique machines with different performance features, and cross the finish line ahead of all your rivals!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000124869.name: Zombie Legion
70010000124869.intro: Lead your undead legion to the world domination!
70010000124869.description: Command and control your own horde of zombies to defeat your opponents and become the greatest in the arenas. Collect weak humans and turn them into your weapons. The larger your undead army, the greater your chances of domination.

70010000124875.name: Color Snake
70010000124875.intro: A mix of Snakes and Colors for an exciting gameplay experience!
70010000124875.description: New gameplay of the classic snake game. Collect the color you need to complete the levels. Pick up boosts to make things easier. Change skins to make your snake look stylish and unique!

70010000124881.name: Cubic Riders
70010000124881.intro: You can't imagine how fast Cubics can be! Try them out and test your skills.
70010000124881.description: A fast-paced racing game where you can test your skills and see how you perform on the track. You have to be really fast and make decisions in milliseconds. Avoid all the obstacles and become number one! Customize your Cubics to win in style!

70010000124902.name: ZOMBIE CAM BODY CAM SHOOTER
70010000124902.intro: Can you escape before the undead surround you?
70010000124902.description:
Step into the chaos of ZOMBIE CAM: Bodycam Shooter, where every heartbeat counts and the undead are closing in. Feel the tension as you navigate dark corridors, dimly lit streets, and abandoned buildings, every step bringing danger closer.
Arm yourself with a mix of weapons and gear, from rifles and pistols to flashlights and grenades, and adapt on the fly to survive relentless waves of zombies. Each map offers a new challenge, each wave a test of courage—and every second matters.

Features:
• Immerse yourself in a gritty bodycam perspective
• Fight through waves of slow, fast, and cunning zombies
• Explore three unique, atmospheric maps
• Tense, time-limited action that keeps you on edge
• Strategic combat with weapons and tactical gear

Do you have what it takes to survive the night? Every shot, every move, every decision could be your last.

70010000124908.name: Medieval Castle Siege Defense vs Invaders
70010000124908.intro: Stand between chaos and the kingdom!
70010000124908.description:
Defend the gates. Survive the siege.
Step into a medieval battlefield where your strategy and skill decide the fate of the kingdom. Build defenses, fight back, and hold your fortress against relentless waves of invaders.
Prepare your defenses, place towers, and get ready for incoming waves of enemies. Each enemy type requires a different approach — from fast attackers to heavily armored units and powerful siege weapons that threaten to break your gates.
You are not just a commander — you fight alongside your defenses. Use your crossbow and repair structures during battle to keep your fortress standing. Every decision matters as the pressure increases with each wave.
Earn resources by defeating enemies and use them wisely to build new defenses or upgrade existing ones. Balance your strategy between offense and defense to handle growing threats and survive until the final wave.
With every attack, the battlefield becomes more intense, forcing you to adapt, reposition, and react quickly to protect your base at all costs.
Key Features:
	•	Combine FPS combat with tower defense gameplay
	•	Build and upgrade defensive structures
	•	Survive waves of increasingly powerful enemies
	•	Fight actively using weapons 
	•	Manage resources to strengthen your defense
	•	Face diverse enemy types and strategic challenges
Stand your ground, defend your kingdom, and survive every wave.

70010000124926.name: Obby: Build a 3D Amusement Park!
70010000124926.intro: Build your dream park and thrilling roller coasters!
70010000124926.description:
Create, ride, compete, and share — welcome to the ultimate roller coaster building adventure!
Dive into a colorful 3D sandbox world where you become the creator of your very own amusement park. Design thrilling roller coasters, build exciting rides, and turn your park into a place players can’t resist visiting.

Whether you love creativity, competition, or just pure fun — this game has it all!

70010000124935.name: Brain Training !Order Quiz
70010000124935.intro:
365, V = IR, A K Q J… What's the word?
Read the clue. Rearrange the letters!
70010000124935.description:
Think you can read the room?

Numbers, formulas, symbols, abbreviations...
Each clue hides an English word waiting to be discovered.
"I think I get it... but what is it again?"
"Oh — that's what it means!"
A word puzzle that tests your intuition and English instincts.

In this game, you'll decode visual clues — numbers, scientific formulas, and symbols — then rearrange the scrambled letters to spell out the hidden English word.

How to play:
・Look at the clue and figure out the English word
・Arrange the scrambled letters in the correct order
・Reveal the answer — "So THAT'S what it meant!"

365 → year / H₂O → water / Au 79 → gold...
Math, science, computers, music — 100 questions covering all kinds of knowledge.

A fun word puzzle that doubles as English vocabulary practice. Enjoyable for all ages.
Jump in anytime, one question at a time.

Can you read the room?

Supports both button and touch controls. Play in TV mode, tabletop mode, or handheld mode.

70010000124950.name: 100 Romantic Hidden Cat
70010000124950.intro: Can you find every cat hiding in this romantic world?
70010000124950.description:
Prepare for a delightful mission in a romantic landscape. Every corner hides a fluffy surprise just waiting to be petted!

Enter a charming black-and-white world filled with adorable cats, romance, and specially themed locations. In 100 Romantic Hidden Cats, you embark on a journey where your task is to bring this wonderful world to life by finding all the hidden furry friends. Each location is designed in the style of a detailed coloring book, but within this simplicity lies a true challenge! Explore every corner, look closely, and discover cats hiding in unexpected places.

Game Features:
• Unique visual style: each level looks like a coloring book.
• Unique locations to explore.
• 100 adorable cats, masterfully hidden on each map.
• Real meow sounds!
• Color magic: tap a cat and it instantly turns vibrant.
• Cozy gameplay experience: search, explore, and make the world a little brighter!

Explore. Search. Discover. Bring the world to life, one cat at a time!

70010000124957.name: 100 Korean Hidden Cats
70010000124957.intro: Will you discover all 100 adorable hidden cats?
70010000124957.description:
The world around you is frozen in black and white, awaiting your touch to bring it to life. In 100 Korean Hidden Cats, you embark on a journey where your task is to bring this real world to life by finding all the hidden furry friends. Each location is designed in the style of an elegant coloring book, but within this tranquility lies a true challenge. Explore every corner, pay attention, and bring color back to this wonderful world.

Game Features:
	•	Unique visual style: each game looks like a detailed coloring book.
	•	4 unique locations to explore.
	•	100 adorable cats, masterfully hidden on each map.
	•	Color magic: tap a cat and it instantly turns vibrant.
	•	Entertaining gameplay: search, explore, and bring life to the world.
	•	Perfect for relaxation and wellness.


100 Korean Hidden Cats is a meditative adventure where every cat you find makes the world a little brighter. Look closely, notice the elusive, and become a master of the search in this cozy black-and-white universe. The world is waiting for you to add color—will you find them all?

70010000124963.name: Sweet Land Survival
70010000124963.intro: Your adventure may be sweet, but survival won't be easy.
70010000124963.description:
Welcome to a colorful world of candy, adventure, and survival. You play as a brave little gummy bear stranded on a mysterious sweet island, where escaping will require more than just finding the way home.

Explore the island, gather valuable resources, and visit different workshops to craft and improve the tools you need for your journey. At your campsite, develop your character's abilities and become stronger, faster, and better prepared for the challenges ahead.

You won't have to face the island alone. Along the way, you'll meet friendly companions who can join you and help gather resources, making your journey a little easier.

Discover the secrets of the sweet island, upgrade your abilities, collect resources, and find a way to escape.

70010000124995.name: Trip to Europe 12 Romantic Tour Collector's Edition
70010000124995.intro: Set off on an unforgettable journey through the most picturesque corners of Europe. This time, just the two of you!
70010000124995.description:
For the first time, your favorite characters are traveling without the kids and enjoying time together. 
Exploring new places, and soaking up the atmosphere of true romance.
This is more than just a hidden object game. It’s a heartfelt story about love, discovery, and the beauty of the world around us.

What's new in Trip to Europe 12 Romantic Tour:
- Even more locations and details — every place is crafted with love and care for atmosphere.
- All-new scenes and puzzles — vibrant, varied, and full of charm.
- Enhanced search mechanics — more interactivity, diversity, and gameplay satisfaction.
- A cozy love story — romantic strolls, warm moments, and true closeness in scenic European settings.
- Updated design and interface — everything is smoother, more stylish, and easier to enjoy.
- Expanded souvenir collection — gather memorable items that capture the spirit of each country you visit.

Collector’s Edition includes:
- 18 extra locations
- 12 mini-games + 18 new puzzles
- A broader collection of unique souvenirs

70010000125015.name: Misaki's Deduction 2: The Sweet Island Murder Case
70010000125015.description: Misaki and the others are going on a trip to Sweetness Island. It was a very sweet island!

70010000125024.name: Scorched Lands
70010000125024.intro: The world burned. Something survived. So did you.
70010000125024.description:
Explore the haunting remnants of a world reshaped by fire and time. Scorched Lands is an atmospheric first-person exploration experience set across a vast, otherworldly desert landscape — where volcanic rock formations tower over ancient skeletal ruins, alien flora blooms defiantly from cracked earth, and the sky burns a permanent crimson.
You are a lone wanderer equipped with field instruments and a quiet curiosity. Seek out marked locations across a hostile yet breathtaking terrain — satellite dishes humming in the silence, solar arrays catching light on ridge lines, lava fields glowing just beyond the next canyon wall. Every destination tells a story. Every horizon promises something new.
Features:

Stunning low-poly art direction that transforms desolation into beauty
Multiple distinct biomes — scorched volcanic badlands, sun-bleached desert flats, and eerie overgrown ruins
A meditative, pressure-free pace — no enemies, no timers, just exploration
Rich environmental storytelling hidden in the landscape itself
Perfect for short sessions or long, unhurried wanderings

70010000125063.name: Lamp Clicker
70010000125063.intro: Build your lamp empire, one click at a time!
70010000125063.description:
Lamp Clicker is a simple and addictive incremental / idle clicker game where your goal is to build your own… lamp empire.

You click the lamp. 
The lamp starts to glow. 
Your earnings increase. 
You feel satisfaction.

You can unlock new lamps — from ordinary candles and oil lamps… to increasingly bizarre creations you’d rather not question (yes, we’re looking at you, Toilet Lamp).

You start to wonder… does this make any sense? You keep clicking…

70010000125069.name: Handsome Watching Face Memory Challenge
70010000125069.intro:
What color was his tie again?
One glance is all you get.
70010000125069.description:
Can you remember every detail of the handsome men who keep appearing?

"Wow, he was so cool! ...Wait, what was he wearing?"
"That smile was amazing! ...Did he have an earring?"
This isn't about admiring good looks — it's about noticing them.

This game is a 4-choice memory quiz where handsome characters flash before you and you must recall the tiny details.
In 60 seconds, commit hair color, clothing, accessories, and background items to memory, then answer questions about the image after it has been masked.

How to play is simple.
・Look at the image and memorize every detail in 60 seconds
・When the image is hidden, answer the multiple-choice question
・Get it right and the original image is revealed

The frustration of "I didn't notice that!" and the satisfaction of "I remembered it!" will keep you coming back.
100 questions featuring 100 different handsome characters.

Play one question at a time and sharpen your observation and memory skills.

Can you catch every detail before it slips away?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.

70010000125084.name: Gion Corridor:Re
70010000125084.intro:
A yokai that loathes change.
A fox that manipulates anomalies.
―In a world without allies, uncover the truth.
70010000125084.description:
This is an “Exit 8”-style exploration horror game set in a fantastical world reminiscent of Kyoto’s Gion district, filled with traditional Japanese streets and atmosphere.

As the player uncovers hidden “anomalies” lurking throughout the world, they gradually draw closer to the truth concealed beneath it all.

Will you be able to detect every abnormality hidden within this world?

●Story
Days that were never supposed to change.
So why am I here…?

A fox that causes anomalies, and strange beings that despise change.

In this world without allies,
“I” - the one who was somehow chosen -
must pursue the mystery through prayer and resolve.

70010000125091.name: Brainrot Card Market Simulator
70010000125091.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game
70010000125091.intro: Can you become the king of card trading?
70010000125091.description:
Step into the chaotic world of card trading, where hype and luck rule everything. Run your own shop, buy low, sell high, and hunt for rare collectibles. Deal with unpredictable customers and wild market swings as you try to stay ahead. Upgrade your store, expand your stock, and chase every profitable opportunity. Only sharp instincts and quick decisions will keep your business growing.

Key Features
• Fast-moving market with sudden price spikes and crashes
• Buy, sell, and trade a wide range of collectible cards
• Haggle with quirky customers and unpredictable buyers
• Find rare cards in flea markets, drops, and secret trades
• Upgrade your shop to attract bigger crowds
• High-risk, high-reward decisions that shape your empire

Do you have what it takes?

70010000125101.name: Speed Dates Summer Edition
70010000125101.intro: Summer's here and hearts are heating up! Meet five different beauties, hang out, flirt a little... and maybe even find your summer romance. Your choices matter — and the story’s all you
70010000125101.description:
Summer’s here, and hearts are skipping beats!
Speed Dates Summer Edition is your chance to meet five beautiful women, flirt, and dive headfirst into a summer full of fun, connection, and maybe even something real.
Each woman has her own vibe, her own story. Who’ll catch your eye? That’s totally up to you.

 walk on the beach, or a deep late-night talk under the stars?
Every date is different, and every moment holds a surprise. Sometimes it’s a laugh, sometimes it’s a silence that says it all.
The more you open up, the more the story pulls you in.

Features:
• Five Different Women – Each with her own energy. Some wild, some shy, some straight-up irresistible. Who’ll you click with?
• Real Places, Real People – Shot with real actors in real summer locations. Feels like a movie, but you're in it.
• Your Choices Shape It All – What you say and how you act change everything. This isn’t a fixed path — it’s your story.
• Natural Conversations, Real Chemistry – Everything flows. The scenes feel alive, and nothing’s fake or stiff.
•Multiple Endings – Every playthrough brings something new. Five women, tons of paths, and endless “what ifs.”

70010000125110.name: Wheelie Life Simulator
70010000125110.intro: Master the art of the perfect wheelie and become a true riding legend.
70010000125110.description:
Feel the adrenaline of Wheelie Life Simulator, the ultimate motorcycle skill game where balance is everything. Ride on one wheel, push your limits, and prove your mastery in a world built for precision and thrills. Every ride is a test of control, focus, and daring — from quiet city streets to wide open countryside, this game is all about perfecting the art of the wheelie. Stylish, immersive, and endlessly challenging, it’s not just a ride — it’s your journey to becoming a wheelie legend.

Key Features
• Master the Wheelie — Control throttle, brakes, and bike angle to stay perfectly balanced.
• Realistic Physics — Every surface and movement affects your ride, making precision essential.
• Upgrade & Customize — Improve engine, brakes, weight, and speed; unlock new bikes and skins.
• Career & Free Mode — Complete challenges or ride freely to perfect your skills.
• Explore New Locations — Unlock city streets, countryside roads, and night routes as you progress.

Balance, skill, and patience — that’s what it takes to dominate Wheelie Life Simulator. Stay on one wheel, chase your limits, and become the ultimate wheelie pro.

70010000125116.name: Draw Save Puzzle
70010000125116.intro: Draw to save Stickman from deadly traps and puzzles!
70010000125116.description:
Draw Save Puzzle is an exhilarating arcade-casual game where you can unleash your creativity and strategic thinking to save the Stickman from impending threats. 

As you draw lines to shield the Stickman from swords, bullets, and bombs, you'll not only enhance your artistic skills but also boost your brainpower and logical reasoning. 

Whether you're a puzzle aficionado or someone looking to test your creative prowess, Draw Save Puzzle offers a thrilling escape from boredom with its simple yet compelling physics system. 

Perfect for players of all ages who enjoy brain training, logic challenges, and the satisfaction of protecting a virtual character from life-threatening situations.

70010000125118.name: Slot & Learn KATAKANA
70010000125118.intro: Learn katakana the fun, easy way.
70010000125118.description:
Place letters, build words, and get familiar with katakana in a fun and friendly way. This educational word game helps children practice reading, writing, and recognizing katakana step by step.

With simple controls and approachable gameplay, even first-time learners can play with confidence. It is perfect for kids who are just starting to study Japanese characters, as well as anyone looking for a light and enjoyable learning activity.

Make learning part of play and discover katakana one word at a time.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000125124.name: Brainrot Clicker: Steal All
70010000125124.intro: Click Italian brainrot animals, upgrade income!
70010000125124.description:
The goal of the game is to unlock all the characters and climb as high as possible in the rankings. Become number one!

There are 28 characters in the game. Including:
- Burbaloni Luliloli
- Udin Din Din
- Bobrito Bandito
- Chimpani Banani
- Tralalero Tralala
- Tung Tung Tung Sahur
- Lirili Larila
- Ballarina Cappuccina
- Bombardiro Crocodilo
- Trippi Troppa
- Brr Brr Patapim
- Trulimero Trulichina

To unlock a new character, earn the required amount of coins and level up. Unlock all the animals from the Italian Brainrot series!

70010000125127.name: Die in the Dungeon
70010000125127.intro: Fight your way in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike game
70010000125127.description:
Die in the Dungeon is a deck-building, turn-based roguelite game where your deck is not made out of cards, but DICE!

In Die in the Dungeon, each dice represents a different action, from basic ones like attacking or healing to boosting other dice or copying their abilities.

Improve the quality of your dice, combine them and acquire powerful relics to defeat the monsters that dwell in the dungeon! Find great synergies by combining dice with unique abilities to create powerful and bizarre decks!

Game Features
Craft your deck from an ever-growing collection of dice.
Every dice has its purpose, with tons of combinations to discover and exploit. On top of that, special properties and upgrades will ensure no single dice feel exactly the same.
Explore the dungeon and its unwelcoming inhabitants.
Forged by strong magic, the walls and floors of the dungeon shift continuously, creating a brand new experience in every run. Thankfully, encounters are not always hostile, but never let your guard down... it’s all a game of risk and reward down here.
Discover powerful synergies by choosing from a myriad of relics.
Stack their powers and use them to boost your dice and board slots, multiplying the power of your combinations and becoming unstoppable. But don’t get too greedy, the stronger a relic is, the bigger their drawbacks will affect you and your deck.
Trust the roll of the dice and discover the fate that awaits you within the dungeon walls!

70010000125159.name: Monster Slingshot Smash
70010000125159.intro: Launch, smash, and conquer in a colorful slingshot adventure packed with action, destruction, and fun.
70010000125159.description: Monster Slingshot Smash is a fast-paced arcade puzzle game where players launch quirky monsters from a slingshot and smash enemy towers in bright, colorful worlds. Aim carefully, trigger satisfying chain reactions, destroy crazy structures, and defeat hilarious blue monsters across fun and challenging levels. Easy to pick up and hard to put down, the game combines simple controls, explosive action, and playful visuals into a highly addictive mobile experience.

70010000125165.name: Astronaut Simulator
70010000125165.intro: Can you keep the station alive long enough to save yourself?
70010000125165.description:
Drifting in the silence of space, you awaken aboard a damaged orbital station. Systems are failing, oxygen is running low, and every sound echoes through cold metal corridors. This isn’t a story about conquering space—it’s about surviving it.

Explore the station in zero gravity, restore critical systems, and keep yourself alive against the odds. Repair broken modules, manage life support, and craft essential tools using limited resources. Every action matters, and every mistake brings you closer to the end.

Guided by a small AI drone, you’ll navigate through a tense and atmospheric environment where isolation, danger, and discovery go hand in hand.

Key Features:
• Monitor oxygen levels and maintain life support systems
• Repair damaged modules, pipelines, and power nodes
• Perform hands-on mini-games to restore station functionality
• Navigate and control movement in zero gravity
• Collect resources and craft essential survival tools
• Manage limited supplies while exploring the station

Stay focused, manage your resources, and fight to survive in the cold emptiness of space.

70010000125185.name: Bowling In A Skate Park
70010000125185.intro: A crazy mix of action and puzzle solving.
70010000125185.description: Analyze the playfield, find the best trajectory, pick the right time and go for a strike hit.

70010000125188.name: The Boys Escape
70010000125188.intro: Gather and lead your army to the finish line! Face your enemies and win the battle!
70010000125188.description: Gather, control, and lead your army on the road to glory. No obstacle can stop you. Prepare for the final battle and defeat every opponent along the way. Lead the army with care - your soldiers believe in you!

70010000125197.name: Cloud Golf
70010000125197.description: Cloud Golf is a relaxing and visually charming mini golf game that takes players on a journey high above the clouds. Set in a bright pastel sky world, the game features floating courses, smooth curves, creative layouts, and satisfying shots designed to feel both calming and fun. Each level offers a mix of simple controls, clever course design, and light challenge, making the game easy to enjoy for casual players while still rewarding precision and skill. With its cheerful atmosphere, soft visuals, and accessible gameplay, Cloud Golf delivers a lighthearted mini golf experience that feels fresh, peaceful, and fun for players of all ages.

70010000125209.name: Tower Dominion
70010000125209.intro: Tower Dominion is a roguelike tower defense game built around strategic freedom and replayability.
70010000125209.description:
Each playthrough begins with a partially generated map that can be further expanded and customized through a modular building system, allowing players to shape the battlefield around their strategy. 

Experiment with different combinations of buildings, weapons, perks, and doctrines to create powerful builds capable of surviving increasingly dangerous enemy waves. Unlock new possibilities over time, push your strategies further in Extended Mode, and take on higher difficulties designed to challenge even experienced players. 

Tower Dominion features:

• Modular map system with partially generated layouts
• 5 difficulty levels, including additional endgame challenges
• Extended Mode for testing builds beyond the standard run length
• 3 playable factions with distinct gameplay styles
• 30 heroes with unique perks and synergies
• 22 enemy types, including powerful late-wave units
• 70+ buildings and 50 weapons for varied defensive setups
• 180+ doctrines allowing flexible and experimental playstyles
• Pits system that adds new modifiers and variety to every run

70010000125216.name: Hiddenius: Sorceress Journey
70010000125216.intro: Avoid dangers and help Elvy become a real sorceress!
70010000125216.description:
The young sorceress Elvy sets off on a journey to pass her exam and become a true witch. 
She will encounter all kind of wonders along the way! 
Immerse yourself in hidden object scenes, use Match 3 to gather magical energy, and collect magical artifacts. 

- Embark on a journey to a magical place!
- Discover new hidden objects!
- Familiar gameplay with all new features!

70010000125227.name: Tolem
70010000125227.intro: Explore. Transform. Fight. Switch between robotic forms with unique abilities. Each form changes how you play.
70010000125227.description:
You are a small robot with no memory, in a world overrun by hostile machines.

Explore 4 unique worlds and cleanse each area from corruption.
Unlock elemental transformations that change the way you play.
Fight, glide, and take on spectacular boss battles. Something isn’t right… and the truth is closer than you think.

You awaken in the HUB, guided by Tixy, a mysterious robot who helps you find your way. With no memories, but a clear goal: stop the invasion and restore balance.

Venture through 4 distinct environments, each filled with enemies, platforming challenges, and secrets to uncover. Complete small missions, explore freely, and collect bolts scattered across the levels.

Throughout your journey, you’ll unlock unique elemental forms, each with its own abilities.

Face dynamic boss battles, featuring multi-phase fights and intense action sequences.

The further you go, the more you’ll realize… this world hides something much bigger.

70010000125242.name: Bee With Gun
70010000125242.intro: This construction bee will make never seen defenses.
70010000125242.description:
In Bee with Gun, you´re not just fighting to survive, your goal is to destroy enemy bases while protecting your hive.

Take control of an armed bee and fight through 40 carefully designed levels across four unique environments. Destroy enemy strongholds while defending your hive against constant waves using buildable towers.

Place fire, rocket, shotgun, laser, and lightning towers strategically, and hold back enemy waves while actively fighting alongside them.


Features:
* Classic tower-defense gameplay
* 40 levels
* 4 unique environments
* Colorful cute 2D graphics
* Increasingly challenging levels

70010000125245.name: Axel Quest
70010000125245.intro: Explore a handcrafted pixel-art world inspired by retro classics.
70010000125245.description:
Axel Quest is a retro-style action-adventure with Metroidvania elements.

Explore a dangerous pixel-art world, fight deadly monsters, defeat powerful bosses, and discover new paths as you progress. Along the journey, you'll collect equipment, meet helpful NPCs, and uncover hidden secrets that reward your curiosity.

With tight controls and fast-paced gameplay, Axel Quest offers a nostalgic experience inspired by classic 2D games, designed for both newcomers and seasoned players.


Features:
* Sword-based combat with responsive controls
* Secret areas and hidden paths to explore
* NPCs and shops to upgrade your equipment
* Challenging boss encounters
* Handcrafted pixel art visuals and retro soundtrack

70010000125248.name: Dino Odyssey
70010000125248.intro: You have to complete this dangerous journey to survive extinction!
70010000125248.description:
Extinction is not an option. The fate of your entire species rests in your claws!

In Dino Odyssey, you control a brave dinosaur on a dangerous journey to rescue the eggs of your kind, ensuring the survival and birth of new generations.

Run, jump, and use your wits to explore a world full of threats. Every egg collected is a breath of hope to save your species from disappearing forever!


Features:
* 50 different levels
* Over 20 unique mechanics
* 3 different biomes
* Handcrafted pixel art visuals and retro soundtrack

70010000125251.name: Parkour Obby: Toxic Escape
70010000125251.description:
The world is drowning in poison. Toxic slime has flooded cities, roads, and valleys — and it's still rising. The only hope is the legendary Anti-Poison Flower, blooming at the top of an ancient mountain far away. You're the only one fast enough to reach it.

Parkour Obby: Toxic Escape is a high-energy obstacle course platformer where one wrong step means falling into bubbling green slime. Run and jump across platforms suspended above a deadly toxic sea. Checkpoints are scattered throughout so you keep your progress, but every jump counts. Master your timing, learn the layouts, and push forward before the poison catches up.
Can you reach the flower in time? The world is counting on you.

70010000125254.name: Decorate Cozy Home
70010000125254.intro: Transform every room into a warm and stylish space in Decorate Cozy Home
70010000125254.description:
Decorate complete environments using a wide variety of furniture, appliances, and decorative items to create the home of your dreams. Mix and match styles, organize every detail, and bring bedrooms, kitchens, living rooms, and more to life with plenty of cozy and modern options.

Unleash your creativity as you design unique spaces, experiment with different combinations, and transform empty rooms into charming and comfortable homes. Every decoration reflects your personal style in a relaxing and enjoyable experience for all interior design lovers.

70010000125263.name: The Immortal John Triptych
70010000125263.intro: Three Pythonesque adventures made from Renaissance paintings and reckless ambition. Explore luscious landscapes and preposterous portraits in this silly, smart trilogy.
70010000125263.description:
The Immortal John Triptych is the ULTIMATE anthology of the Joe Richardson games. Four Last Things, The Procession to Calvary, and Death of the Reprobate are brought together under one glorious sun with never-before-seen deleted scenes, updated language parity across all three titles, an expanded soundtrack by Eduardo Antonello with new original recordings, manual saves for Four Last Things, backflips in The Procession to Calvary, and a button to trigger a superfluous trumpeted fanfare whenever you need to celebrate. Embrace the absurd, the profound, and the sweet soothing aesthetic of the Renaissance in The Immortal John Triptych.

Immortal John is dying. A holy war has ended in chaos. Sin itself demands reckoning. Three interconnected tales unfold across a world built from Renaissance paintings and Classical music, where the ridiculous and the profound collide. 

Help locals with their daily tasks, only to find the Devil lurking in the shadows. Chase a tyrant across kingdoms while assisting inept magicians and negotiating with God Almighty. Navigate sin, death, judgement, heaven and hell, all topped with a cherry of gleeful flippancy. 

From quiet countryside kindness spiraling into madness, to holy vengeance wrapped in absurdity, to cosmic philosophy delivered with a wink and a nudge, The Immortal John Triptych proves that the most intelligent thing you can do is embrace the utterly ridiculous.

Feature List:
• Puzzling Pilgrimages – A traditional narrative adventure game, with a modernised interface. Control your character(s) via direct control, interact with people and places with a snazzy 'verb coin' interaction menu, and drag and drop (or hoard) your precious items from a simple drop-down inventory.
• Renaissance Artwork – Renaissance, Rococo and even a hint of Romanticism, to be a little more precise. Hundreds of paintings, spanning hundreds of years, are all brought together into one consistent world.
• Classical Music – A mix of publicly available classics and works from musician Eduardo Antonello populate the Triptychs airwaves. Period appropriate music that adapts as the story progresses, recorded using real medieval/renaissance instruments.
• Standalone Story – Four Last Things,The Procession to Calvary, and Death of the Reprobate feature unique stories with recurring characters/themes all within the same world.
•  Highbrow Buffoonery – Lofty subject matter is treated with gleeful flippancy. Gags about butts are taken very seriously. But rest assured, while some of the jokes may be ridiculous, the puzzles make perfect sense! (or at least adhere to a consistent internal logic)
• Fully Remastered – Unified UI overhaul across the board, never-before-seen deleted and bonus scenes, QoL improvements, full controller support, and an arm in the air waving like it just doesn’t care. The Immortal John Triptych brings the ultimate Joe Richardson experience to the forefront.
• 4 WIP Time-Lapse Videos - Watch the painstaking process of transforming beautiful Renaissance classics into playable scenes, revealing the artistic techniques and creative genius behind the game’s unique visual style
• A few more bits and bobs

70010000125290.name: Kawaii Anime: Cute Girls Magic World
70010000125290.intro:
Spells, sparkles, and the cutest girls you've ever seen.
Play, score, and unlock them all.
70010000125290.description:
Step into a world where magic is real and the girls are irresistibly adorable. Pastel skies, glowing stars, and kawaii anime girls with powers that match their charm, this is the cutest place you've ever been.

Play through the minigames and watch your score open up the gallery, one stunning image at a time. The higher you climb, the more they reveal.

From bubbly and bright magical girls to mysteriously enchanting magical girls, each one has her own personality and her own way of rooting for you mid-game. They notice when you're winning.

Think you've got what it takes to unlock every single one?


Features:

● EVERY MODE, A REASON TO KEEP GOING: Test your mind and your reflexes while climbing the scoreboard. Every point counts toward unlocking more.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Score higher, unlock more. The gallery fills up as you get better, and every image is worth it.

● KAWAII CHARACTER PERSONALITIES: Every girl reacts, cheers, and teases you throughout the game. No two feel the same.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: How the story closes depends on you. Some endings are sweeter than others.

● HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Reach question 150 and discover the secret that's been waiting for you the whole time.


These magical girls are waiting to be found. The gallery won't fill itself.
Start playing and see how far your score takes you.

Are you ready?

70010000125296.name: Kawaii Anime: Cute Boys Magic World
70010000125296.intro:
Magic, minigames, and boys cute enough to cast a spell on you.
Play more, unlock more, fall harder.
70010000125296.description:
Welcome to a world that's equal parts glittery and gorgeous, where kawaii anime boys with magical powers are waiting to be discovered.

Bright colors, soft pastels, and boys so cute they make the whole world feel a little warmer.

Play through the minigames, rack up your score, and watch the gallery unlock one boy at a time. The better you play, the closer you get.

From sweet and shy magical boys to confidently magical ones, each boy has a personality all his own, and yes, they cheer you on while you play.

Ready to find your favorite?


Features:

● EVERY MODE, A REASON TO KEEP GOING: Test your mind and your reflexes while climbing the scoreboard. Every point counts toward unlocking more.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Your score unlocks the gallery. Every new image is a reward worth earning.

● KAWAII CHARACTER PERSONALITIES: Each boy reacts to your gameplay in his own way. Some are encouraging, some are playfully competitive.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: The ending you get depends on how you play. Some paths lead somewhere special.

● HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Hit question 150 and unlock the secret scene that only the most dedicated players ever reach.


The magic world is full of magical boys worth discovering. Your gallery is waiting. Start playing and see who you find.

Are you ready?

70010000125325.name: Brainrots Evolution
70010000125325.intro: Destroy, collect pets, and evolve your creatures!
70010000125325.description:
Brainrots Evolution is an adventure game where you smash objects, collect adorable pets, and unlock new characters.

As you progress, you gain access to new animals, abilities, and exciting upgrades that push your evolution forward. Break everything in your path, gather rewards, and expand your collection.

Each stage brings fresh challenges and new creatures to discover, making your journey more powerful and diverse. Evolve, explore, and build your ultimate lineup of unique characters!

70010000125334.name: Sheep in Love
70010000125334.intro: A charming puzzle game you won’t be able to put down.
70010000125334.description: Simple to start, tricky to conquer! Slide the tiles, solve clever puzzles, and help your hero reunite with his love.

70010000125353.name: Blood: Refreshed Supply™ - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000125353.description:
Blood: Refreshed Supply™ follows Caleb, an undead gunslinger on a quest for revenge against his former demonic master, Tchernobog. Despite his once powerful position as a fearsome Cabal commander and one of Tchernobog’s “Chosen” few, Caleb and his fellow Chosen are betrayed by the dark god and slain for reasons unknown. Seeking answers and vengeance, Caleb rises from the grave to put a stop to Tchernobog and his murderous lieutenants once and for all.
 
Grab your Pitchfork and get ready to stab your way through 42 blood-soaked levels, while unlocking even more creative and effective implements of destruction along the way. Incinerate foes with weapons like the Flare Gun, Aerosol Can, and Napalm Launcher. Blast enemies straight to hell with bundles of dynamite, shoot them full of holes with the Tommy Gun and Sawed-Off Shotgun, or tap into darker methods of annihilation with the game’s powerful Voodoo Doll and Life Leech offerings.

Use your arsenal of weapons to survive Tchernobog’s evil Cabal of loyal Cultists, Fanatics, Zealots, and Acolytes, along with swarms of hellish creatures from ruthless Zombies and flying Gargoyles, to water-dwelling Gill Beasts, screaming Phantasms, and firebreathing Hell Hounds. 

Includes the original Blood along with the Plasma Pak and Cryptic Passage add-ons.

Blood: Refreshed Supply™ - Enhancements
• Includes new Marrow scenario and Death Wish scenario
• Rebuilt from the original source code.
• New Vault with dozens of playable cut-content levels, concept art, behind-the-scenes photos, and unused sprites.
• Remastered Cutscenes.
• Expanded options for improved enemy behavior, weather effects (a previously cut feature), and other enhancements.
• Bug fixes for the original levels.
• High-resolution support, including 4K monitor.
• Customizable controller gamepad support
• Rewritten netcode supporting up to 8 players
• Local split-screen and online co-op
• CD and MIDI music support

70010000125355.name: Pixel Cross Stitch: Miniatures
70010000125355.description:
Your favorite coloring series comes back, this time even more adorable!
Sit back, relax, and fill the tiny, pixel pictures that will brighten up your day.
Coloring miniatures is a satisfying way to reclaim your peace of mind and soothe the nervous system. Try it for yourself, but be careful – it’s super addictive!

Features:
•  210 Pixel Images: Discover a diverse library of captivating miniature pixel art.
•  Color by Number & Cross Stitch: Choose your preferred coloring style and experience the joy of creating pixel masterpieces.
•  Colorblind Mode: An inclusive feature ensuring everyone can enjoy the game, regardless of color vision differences.
•  Relaxing & Rewarding: Unwind with soothing gameplay and the satisfaction of seeing your creations come to life.
•  Perfect for All Ages: Enjoy a creative outlet that's accessible and enjoyable for both kids and adults.

70010000125367.name: The Frog’s Adventure
70010000125367.intro:
He is not a handsome frog, but he wears overalls, boots, and is very likeable.
A superhero nobody asked for.
70010000125367.description:
Leap over dangerous obstacles, dodge clever traps, and push through levels where every jump counts.

Face a variety of enemies—a rabbit, an alligator, a dog, a cat, and even a turtle—all posing a threat to your frog.

Collect every star and prove your skill. Jumping is already tough—now imagine doing it perfectly.

Plan each leap carefully and accept the harsh truth: life as a frog isn’t easy, and only the most agile, clever, and fearless frogs make it to the end.

70010000125373.name: K-POP Fandom Korean Quiz
70010000125373.intro:
A Must-Play for K-Pop Idol Fans!
Learn Useful Korean with
Fun 3-Choice Quizzes
70010000125373.description:
A Korean language quiz game made for K-pop idol fans who want to enjoy their fandom even more.

Learn useful Korean words and phrases you might see at concerts, on social media, and in fan communities through easy 3-choice questions.

Simple to pick up even for beginners, and perfect for quick play sessions.

The more Korean you understand, the more fun your K-pop fan life becomes.

70010000125379.name: Escape Tsunami For Brainrots
70010000125379.intro: Sprint down the corridor, grab brainrots and escape a massive tsunami. Upgrade your base, unlock rare characters and climb the leaderboard.
70010000125379.description:
Escape Tsunami for Brainrots is a fast-paced survival runner where a massive wave crashes behind you while dozens of bizarre brainrot characters wait ahead, ready to earn you millions of coins per second. Grab as many as you can carry and sprint back to base before the tsunami swallows the corridor.

The deeper you push into the corridor, the rarer and more valuable the brainrots become. Common ones bring in thousands of coins, while Legendary, Cosmic and Celestial brainrots generate millions. But the reward grows with the risk, and one mistake or a single second of hesitation lets the wave take everything you have collected.

Spend your hard-earned coins upgrading your base. Boost brainrot income, running speed, carry speed and base size to unlock new collection slots. Use the rebirth system to reset your progress in exchange for a permanent income multiplier and reach the rarest creatures.

Open lucky blocks and alien lucky blocks for random rewards, sacrifice common brainrots to the machine for a chance at upgraded versions, and hunt the divine characters that appear at the very end of the corridor.

Dozens of unique brainrots, constant base upgrades and a leaderboard where you can climb to the top in coins earned and top speed. Fully single-player, play at your own pace with no online connection required.

70010000125385.name: Legolast Tiny Builder
70010000125385.intro: Build incredible creations brick by brick in a relaxing 3D construction puzzle adventure. Complete detailed models, unlock new sets, and become the ultimate tiny builder.

70010000125394.name: WinterCraft: Survival in the Forest
70010000125394.intro: Brave the frozen wilderness, build a shelter, and survive one more night.
70010000125394.description:
Alone in a frozen wilderness, every decision could be the difference between survival and a cold, silent end.

Explore a vast winter forest from a first-person perspective. Gather wood, stone, iron, berries, and other essential resources before hunger, freezing temperatures, or wild predators catch up with you. Craft the tools, weapons, clothing, and supplies you need to stay alive.

Turn an empty patch of wilderness into a secure survival base. Build a shelter, furnish it with a workbench, bed, and furnace, light a campfire, and prepare for the dangers waiting beyond its walls.

Hunt wolves, deer, hares, and birds using a bow, rifle, or shotgun. Cook food, monitor your health, hunger, and body temperature, and adapt as day gives way to night.

Your struggle is not only about survival. Explore the forest, complete story quests, uncover its secrets, and discover what happened to your missing father.

KEY FEATURES

• Explore an open winter wilderness
• Gather resources and craft essential equipment
• Build and furnish your own shelter
• Hunt wildlife and defend yourself from predators
• Survive cold, hunger, injuries, and changing conditions
• Experience a full day-and-night cycle
• Follow story quests and search for your missing father

Can you master the frozen forest and survive another day?

70010000125415.name: One Man Army
70010000125415.intro:
A lone warrior stands against overwhelming odds, battling relentless waves of enemies with skill and grit.
Master fast-paced combat and survive intense encounters.
70010000125415.description:
Step into the boots of a lone warrior in a relentless fight against overwhelming enemy forces. In this intense one-man army experience, you’ll face wave after wave of opponents, each more dangerous than the last. Armed with skill, precision, and an evolving arsenal, you must adapt quickly, using smart tactics and lightning-fast reflexes to survive the chaos.

As the battle rages on, unlock powerful upgrades, devastating weapons, and unique abilities that transform your fighting style. Every encounter pushes you to the limit, demanding careful positioning, perfect timing, and strategic decision-making. Whether you prefer aggressive assaults or calculated defense, the game rewards creativity and mastery in combat.

With fast-paced action, escalating difficulty, and nonstop adrenaline, this is a true test of endurance and skill. Stand alone, fight without backup, and prove that one soldier is all it takes to conquer impossible odds.

70010000125433.name: Girls Force 2: Rising Academy
70010000125433.intro: Cute, fearless, and packing heat! The girls TPS is back with toon rendering, cel-shading, and full-throttle action. Second class is officially in session!
70010000125433.description:
Built on the latest cartoon rendering and cel-shading tech, every stage pops with vivid anime-film visuals and hard-hitting action. Girls Force 2: Rising Academy is a slick third-person shooter starring two powerhouse girl agents, AERIE and YURI, on a high-stakes mission to take down the shadowy organisation "Dark Siren". From the glam of a downtown fashion show to the grit of a harbour container base, the chase is on. One veteran's instincts. One prodigy's brains. Together, they'll shut Dark Siren down for good.

・Cutting-edge toon rendering and cel-shading tech delivers jaw-dropping anime visuals and cinematic flair from start to finish.
・Hunt down Dark Siren's secret routes across action-packed missions spanning a downtown fashion show and a harbour container base.
・Earn Gold by clearing stages and cash it in for cute, one-of-a-kind costume sets for AERIE and YURI.
・Score an exclusive original wallpaper every time you unlock a new costume because the hype never stops.
・Bust out SHOW Mode with any costume in your collection to uncover even more secret original wallpapers!
・Tap AERIE and YURI directly to unlock their hidden personalities, from bubbly and energetic to surprisingly shy.
・Build out your Gallery collection with bold, distinctive character illustrations and make it your own.
・Check out every costume from every angle in the fully rotatable 360-degree Character Viewer.
・Clear the full story to unlock the long-awaited ending and uncover the shocking truth behind Dark Siren plus a secret only AERIE and YURI know!

Do not sleep on them! Heart-pounding gunfights, a conspiracy-fueled story, costume grinding, wallpaper unlocks, gallery collecting, and a mind-blowing ending are all waiting for you. The next level visual-style TPS is here. Download Girls Force 2: Rising Academy now and take back the city with the most badass duo around!

Prologue
One night, an emergency alert blasted through Girls Force Academy headquarters.
An unidentified organisation had ripped classified data straight out of the Academy and started unleashing chaos across the city.
Behind it all was a new organisation nobody had ever heard of.
Cold, ruthless ambition hiding behind a beautiful face... "Dark Siren".
The government moved fast, calling in their two most reliable agents on the spot.

A packed fashion show, lights blazing.
A woman owning the runway felt an urgent transmission buzz through her earpiece.
Her name was AERIE.
First-gen graduate of Girls Force Academy and a living legend in the field.
Deadly combat instincts wrapped in an irresistible presence.
The second the show wrapped, she vanished quietly from the dressing room.
"Here we go again. Wonder who they're pairing me with this time."

At that same moment, deep in the Rising Academy library.
A woman alone between towering shelves of tactical manuals glanced down at her buzzing phone.
Her name was YURI.
The Academy's sharpest rising star, known for her razor analytical mind and unbreakable focus.
And the person who looked up to AERIE more than anyone alive.
Her eyes locked on the orders on her screen, burning with quiet fire.
"Real field work. Finally. With my senior calling the shots... bring it on."

Two different places. One shared mission.
Two sets of footsteps became one.
A veteran's instincts and a prodigy's intellect.
Wherever these two show up, the song of Dark Siren goes silent.

Code name "Rising Force".
Girls Force Academy! Second Class, Now In Session!!!

70010000125439.name: Escape Game The Locked Elevator
70010000125439.intro: An escape game set inside a trapped elevator!
70010000125439.description:
■Game System
This is an escape game (puzzle-solving adventure game).
※Progress through the game by selecting items on the screen with the cursor and solving various puzzles.

■Story
I wonder if I was dreaming…

I remember getting into an elevator, hurrying to the upper floor.

Then suddenly―

with a violent jolt, the elevator stopped.

Everything went dark before my eyes, and I lost consciousness.

How much time has passed?

As I slowly open my eyes…

70010000125453.name: Trace Blackout: The Perfect Crime Mystery
70010000125453.intro: Clean up the evidence at the crime scene and pull off the perfect crime!
70010000125453.description:
You’ve arrived at the scene of a crime… but you’re not a detective.
You’re an evidence cleaner.

Your job is to find and remove the clues the culprit left behind, and help turn each case into the perfect crime.

How to play is simple:

Read the case description
Pick the matching piece of evidence from the illustration
Get it right, and the evidence disappears from the scene

Each client has their own dark story:

A groom who took the bride’s life in a wedding waiting room
A stalker who murdered an idol in a TV studio dressing room
An arsonist who was burned to death by the fire they started

…and more.

Collect every incriminating trace the culprit accidentally left behind, and send each case into the unsolved files!

Supports both button and keypad controls, so you can also enjoy the game in TV mode.

70010000125463.name: Deep Sea Delivery & Co.
70010000125463.intro: Explore a procedurally generated world and fulfill time-sensitive quests in this frantic underwater adventure!
70010000125463.description:
In a watery world similar to our own, the clock is ticking– literally! An impending doom will end the world in 24 hours, but the denizens don’t seem to mind. In-fact, they seem far more concerned with hoping their precious items are delivered in a timely fashion. After all, even those at the end of the world need their packages delivered!
 
Deep Sea Delivery and Co. is an open world procedurally generated adventure game with an arcade look and feel. Play as a humble Bubble Delivery Worker and carry special items to complete quests as quickly as possible! Be careful though, as these items double as your only means of offense as well! Will you complete all your quests in time?

Taken on a multitude of different quests, each challenging a different skill and changing how you navigate. Likewise, at shops scattered throughout the world, upgrade your Bubble's offensive and defensive abilities-- including special power ups and healing items. You'll need these upgrades if you have any hope of surviving against sudden boss battles and uncovering hidden themed biomes. You can also customize the music that plays in the background at any time, and create a playlist of your favorite jams. The world is your oyster, so make the next 24 hours count! 
 
Features:
* A Massive Procedurally Generated World
* Over A Dozen Unique Biomes, Enemies, Treasure, and more!
* RPG-Lite Abilities and Upgrades
* Customizable In-Game Radio
* Timed Quests Scattered Throughout the World
* ...and even more waiting below the surface of this watery world!

70010000125466.name: BOMCAT
70010000125466.intro: An explosive action game packed with love for ’80s arcade classics!
70010000125466.description:
Throw bombs and blast your way forward!

In this stage-clearing action game filled with love for ’80s arcade classics, your mission is to rescue a lady trapped inside a dangerous factory!

The hero is a cute yet tough bipedal cat.

Ride the sounds of the 1980s as you infiltrate a perilous bomb factory.

Each stage is packed with unique gimmicks designed to test both your reflexes and action skills.

Destroy the four computer terminals with strategically placed bombs to disable the barrier, then finish off the boss once and for all!

Don’t worry ? the controls and pacing are built for the 21st century.

Enjoy a fresh new bomb-action experience that blends retro visuals with modern gameplay feel.


Includes an Easy Mode that anyone can aim to clear, a Hard Mode for advanced players, and an Endless Mode where 10 stages loop infinitely.

70010000125474.name: Tiny Crown
70010000125474.intro: A tiny king. A huge challenge.
70010000125474.description:
Tiny Crown is a fast-paced pixel-art platformer where you guide a brave little king through a castle full of traps, spikes, and dangerous jumps. Run, leap, and survive your way across handcrafted levels that test your timing, precision, and patience.
Don’t let the charming retro visuals fool you — every room is a challenge. One wrong move, and the castle will punish you. But with skill, persistence, and sharp reflexes, even the smallest ruler can conquer the deadliest dungeon.

70010000125480.name: Witchfall
70010000125480.intro: A cursed leap through shadow and thorn.
70010000125480.description: Witchfall is a dark fantasy platformer where precision, timing, and courage are the only way forward. Leap through haunted forests, deadly traps, and floating ruins as a mysterious witch drifts deeper into a cursed world filled with spikes, shadows, and ancient magic. Every level is a test of reflexes, patience, and survival.

70010000125496.name: BARDA: Backpack Roguelike
70010000125496.intro: In Barda, it won't be your sword that saves you. It's how you pack your bag. But hunger, fatigue and madness will take up space!
70010000125496.description:
In our innovative inventory system, every problem directly affects your backpack. Hunger, fatigue, madness. These are just some of the things that can happen during a run. How can you keep your bag tidy in those conditions?

Simply drag and drop the best object you have on a challenge to complete it and move on to the next zone. If you don't have anything suitable, you can always use your own two hands and a dash of courage!

Will you be able to scatter your grandfather’s ashes at the summit of the Mountain?

Complete missions to unlock options in the Explorer's Tree and keep trying to reach the summit of the Mountain until you manage to scatter your deceased grandfather's ashes there.

70010000125498.name: Immunuzzle
70010000125498.intro: Defend the Body, Control the Chaos
70010000125498.description:
Get ready for a microscopic battle full of strategy in Immunuzzle, an engaging pixel art puzzle where every move can change everything. Use pieces inspired by the immune system to contain a spreading infection, turning each decision into a true test of planning and intelligence.

Choose your pieces carefully, place each one with precision, and watch the infection react immediately to every move. Here, no action comes without consequences. Every placement shapes the future of the board, blocks paths, and completely redefines the threat.

With constantly evolving challenges, you will face increasingly complex layouts, tight chokepoints, and infection patterns that demand quick thinking and strategic vision. This is not just about filling spaces, it is about mastering the field, controlling the spread, and turning chaos into order.

With retro visuals full of personality, smart mechanics, and that satisfying feeling of solving something tough, Immunuzzle delivers a unique experience. Perfect for players who love challenging puzzles, impactful decisions, and hard-earned victories.

Observe, plan, and fight the infection until you take full control.

70010000125504.name: Sands and Relics
70010000125504.description:
Prepare yourself to challenge your logic in an adventure deep in the heart of the desert, where every movement could be your last. In Sands and Relics, walking is just as dangerous as it is necessary, and every step changes the world beneath your feet.

Cross ancient ruins, explore fragile pathways, and uncover hidden relics in clever puzzles that blend strategy, planning, and that satisfying feeling of discovering the perfect solution. Here, the ground waits for no one. Sand tiles crack, collapse, and disappear as you move forward, turning the environment into a living puzzle.

Each level is a compact logic challenge where you must think before acting, calculate routes, and carefully decide where to step. Some surfaces can withstand more than one step, while others collapse immediately, and a single mistake can leave you trapped in the void.

As the journey continues, new mechanics make the puzzles even more creative, including teleporters, narrow paths, and combinations that demand full awareness of the environment. All of this comes wrapped in charming pixel art visuals that create a cozy atmosphere while keeping your mind engaged.

With 30 carefully crafted levels, simple controls, and the freedom to undo moves or restart whenever you want, Sands and Relics delivers an accessible, smart, and deeply satisfying experience for players who love strategic puzzles without time pressure.

Observe the terrain, plan your route, and discover whether your footsteps will be enough to reach the lost relic.

70010000125510.name: The Pirate Keko
70010000125510.intro: The Treasure Is Only the Beginning
70010000125510.description:
Get ready for an adventure full of discovery, strategy, and tropical charm. In The Pirate Keko, you take control of a charismatic pirate monkey in search of hidden treasures across mysterious islands, where each level is much more than it first appears.

Here, every level is a clever puzzle divided into two connected parts. First, you must explore the environment, manipulate blocks, activate mechanisms, and find the Treasure Map. But that is only the beginning. Once you collect it, the game reveals a new layer of the challenge: the Treasure Chest appears, and the same scenario must be reinterpreted using everything you have already changed.

Color-coded platforms, pressure buttons, breakable crates, hazards, and enemies create dynamic situations that demand planning and creativity. Every action matters, as what you do in the first half directly impacts the solution of the second.
