With a fixed camera that lets you see the entire scene, the experience is clear, strategic, and focused on spatial reasoning. You are not just moving forward, you are transforming the environment step by step until you find the perfect path.

With short, clever, and highly satisfying challenges, The Pirate Keko delivers that unique "now I get it" feeling with every completed level.

Observe, experiment, adapt, and discover. Because here, finding the map is only half of the adventure.

70010000125516.name: FORENSIC - M.E. Protocol
70010000125516.intro: Not all visitors come in peace.
70010000125516.description:
Put on your gloves and enter the crime scene. In this investigation sim, you will have to solve 9 unique cases full of plot twists.

From dark alleys to quiet suburban streets, every location hides secrets. Use advanced forensic tools and evidence reconstruction to piece together what really happened. There are no shootouts, no action clichés, only logic, observation, and investigation. Here, you don’t hunt criminals with guns… you catch them with science

Features:

- 9 forensic cases with complete narratives and multiple twists.
- Advanced investigation tools: drones, ground robots, and chemical analysis.
- Mature, dark stories including crimes of passion, kidnappings, and conspiracies.
- Every clue can change the entire case.
- Stress-free pacing with no timers. Investigate, analyze, and solve at your own rhythm.

70010000125518.name: Cosmic Mirage
70010000125518.description:
Cosmic Mirage is an exciting side-scrolling shooter that takes the player on an exciting space adventure. Sinister forces have taken over peaceful planets in the galaxy, turning them into empty space mirages. Your mission is to become the last reliable pilot  and free them from the sinister invader.

An epic journey awaits you through varied landscapes and battles with different types of enemies. Planets that were once sources of life and prosperity have now become places of darkness and strife. Each world presents unique challenges, and the trapped inhabitants need your liberating intervention.

70010000125566.name: Research Story
70010000125566.intro: Tame creatures, grow crops, and record your findings!
70010000125566.description:
Discover and record 90+ plants, creatures, and fish at various locations around Shimmerbrook, and contribute your findings to the Archive.

Features
- Tame and raise 32 unique creatures
- Observe wild plants and grow them as crops based on different requirements
- Meet over 20 townsfolk, attend town festivals, go on hangout events
- Date and marry one of the 10 romanceable candidates
- Dig deep into the mines, fish, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery behind Shimmerbrook
- Cook, craft, build, and more!

Your life as a researcher starts today!

70010000125581.name: Sweet Home: Look and Find 6 Collector's Edition
70010000125581.description:
Open a new chapter of the beloved series and immerse yourself once again in an atmosphere of warmth, comfort, and peaceful hidden object searching.
Sweet Home: Look and Find 6 is a true soulful retreat, filled with attention to detail and the quiet joy of every found item.

What awaits you in the new game?

Even more hidden object scenes
You’ll explore 18 main hidden object locations and 18 bonus scenes—cozy homes, gardens, verandas, and vivid interiors brimming with detail and mood. Every scene is handcrafted to bring you the feeling of genuine homey warmth.

Your favorite gameplay—perfected
Classic hidden object searching has become even more comfortable and diverse. Relax, explore, and enjoy the process—no rush, no stress.

Mini-games for relaxation and focus
The game includes 11 mini-games and 11 bonus mini-games that gently train your attention and logic. The perfect balance between calm and engaging challenge.

An atmosphere you’ll want to return to
Sweet Home 6 isn’t just a set of levels. It’s a feeling of home, care, and quiet joy. Every moment matters: morning light in the room, carefully arranged objects, and a sense of harmony.

Collector’s Edition includes:
- 18 bonus hidden object scenes
- 11 additional mini-games
- Exclusive content for deeper immersion
- Delightful bonuses for true fans of the series

70010000125588.name: Dog Man: Bark in Action
70010000125588.intro: Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! Packed with boss fights, awesome gadgets and up to 10 playable characters, each with unique abilities.
70010000125588.description:
Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! A comic-book style game packed with action, humor, boss fights, and ability-granting gadgets. Play as 10 different characters from the comics, each with unique powers.  

A hero is needed! Dr. Scum has set up Hypno Screens around the city, mind-controlling the innocent townsfolk. Now it’s up to Dog Man - part Dog, part Man- to fight back against Dr. Scum and all his minions. Defeat Dr. Scum, save your friends, and rescue the city!  

A game based on the wonderful Dog Man comic books by artist Dav Pilkey, also known for Captain Underpants. 
 
Bark in Action Features:  
Work Together with the Supa Buddies 
Switch between Dog Man and his Supa Buddies: Dog Man, Li'l Petey, 80HD. Each has their own special abilities, to overcome obstacles and defeat Dr. Scum.  Phone in Friends to help you, like Commander Cupcake or Chief, for a total of 10 playable characters! 
 
Explore 60 Action Packed Levels 
Explore iconic locations from the Dog Man universe, such as the Cat Jail and Robo-Time Industries. Beat the clock in the Time Challenges, and discover the Mystery Levels full of surprises! 
 
Play Solo or with a Friend 
Double the action by having a second player join with unique special abilities. Couch co-op the whole family can enjoy! 
 
Discover Unlockable Outfits and Supa Gadgets 
Collect sprockets to unlock crazy Gadgets. Collect yarn to craft cool new outfits like the Scarlet Shredder, Cat Kid and much more! 
 
Stand up to Villains 
Use each character's signature fighting move to take down Dr. Scum's minions and the Supa-Bad-Guy himself. Use clever teamwork to beat bosses!

70010000125615.name: Angel Engine
70010000125615.description: Cage an angel. Ransack Heaven. In a far-flung dystopian future, the Angel Engine Initiative carries on as the last hope for humanity. Seal yourself in your operating room, perform surgery on comatose test subjects, and pray you make it out alive.

70010000125627.name: To Bee Jazz
70010000125627.intro: Drop the Beat, Merge the Bees, and Build the Perfect Band
70010000125627.description:
Get ready for an explosion of jazz, cuteness, and organized chaos in To Bee Jazz, an irresistibly addictive puzzle where every drop can create the next big star of the band. Merge tiny musician bees, discover new evolutions, and transform a crowded stage into a spectacular show full of rhythm and personality.

Inspired by the most satisfying merge puzzles, the game blends light physics, strategic planning, and the perfect feeling of watching chain reactions unfold. Every bee bounces, slides, and finds its place while you try to stop the stage from becoming completely overcrowded.

Combine two identical bees to create increasingly sophisticated musicians and build a complete jazz band filled with instruments, style, and charm. But be careful: the more the board grows, the smarter your decisions need to be.

In Campaign Mode, missions and challenges test your creativity as you work to create specific bees for increasingly elaborate performances. In Endless Mode, the experience becomes even more strategic with special Power-Ups capable of shaking the stage, removing pieces, and reorganizing the chaos to keep the music alive for much longer.

With cozy visuals, a relaxing atmosphere, and a soundtrack full of personality, To Bee Jazz delivers the perfect combination of calm and strategy that makes you think “just one more run.”

Watch the stage, plan every drop, and let the jazz take over the hive.

70010000125633.name: Jelly Math
70010000125633.intro: Mix, Combine and Hit the Perfect Result
70010000125633.description:
Get ready for a sweet, clever and surprising puzzle where numbers and jellies come together in the most fun way possible. In Jelly Math, each colorful piece has a unique value and shape, and it is up to you to combine them strategically to form the perfect equation.

Nothing here is just about placing pieces. Every move influences the final result, and small changes can completely transform your solution. Choose, rotate and place your jellies while testing combinations, adjusting operators and finding the exact balance to reach the goal.

With challenges that grow in a smooth and creative way, you will deal with new elements that make everything even more interesting, such as modifiers that multiply values and spaces that require careful planning. All of this in light and cozy picnic-themed environments.

Colorful, relaxing and at the same time challenging, Jelly Math is perfect for players who love puzzles that stimulate thinking and reward each discovery with that delicious feeling of getting it right.

Experiment, adjust and find the perfect result in every level.

70010000125648.name: Puppergeist
70010000125648.intro: Journey through the Doggie Underworld in this heartwarming rhythm and visual novel hybrid.
70010000125648.description:
Doggie Underworld: A Rhythmic Journey

Play as Claire, a witch who journeys into the mysterious Doggie Underworld with one simple goal: Finding her lost Pup!

As you travel through Doggie Underworld, you'll encounter countless souls, each with a story to tell. Share moments with them, play together, and listen to their heartfelt tales. Use your sense of rhythm to lift their spirits and ease their troubles, bringing you one beat closer to reuniting with your own lost Pup.

The Heart of the Game

As a visual novel with rhythm mechanics, the story moves forward as you succeed in rhythm challenges. Alongside her new demon friend, Lunne, Claire learns to deepen her connection with doggie spirits, uncovering stories of friendship, love, and loss.

70010000125669.name: Party Fun! 8-Player Common Sense Battle
70010000125669.intro:
Can you spot common sense in a picture?
Expose what everyone only thinks they know.
Up to 8 players. The common-sense battle starts now.
70010000125669.description:
“Which one is the alpaca?” “Which one is nutmeg?”

Everything that appears is something you’ve probably heard of before.
But the moment four photos are placed in front of you, you might suddenly find yourself unsure.

The rules are simple: just choose the correct answer from four options.
No expert knowledge required. All you need is your common sense.

Up to 8 players can join in on a single console.
Grab your controllers and start battling right away.
Choose from 10, 20, or 30 questions, making it perfect for both a quick game and a longer challenge.

You answer with complete confidence—only to be the one person who gets it wrong.
You make a random guess—and somehow get it right.
The biggest laughs might not come from getting the answer right, but from that moment when someone says, “Wait, you didn’t know that?”

A single-player mode is also included for those who want to take on the challenge at their own pace.
With 100 stages in total, how far will your common sense take you?

Play with family, friends, or at parties.
Whether you’re a trivia expert or not, everyone competes on equal footing.

70010000125675.name: World War: D-Day 1944
70010000125675.intro: Waves slam the shore. Paratroopers tear through the dark sky. Operation Overlord, the legendary airborne fight reborn on a brand-new battlefield.
70010000125675.description:
Powered by a fully upgraded next-gen 3D physics engine and all-new shaders applied across the entire game, this is a completely reimagined FPS experience. From the amphibious assault on the beaches of Normandy to the harrowing nighttime jumps of the airborne divisions, live through the full story of D-Day on one massive, overwhelming battlefield. A solo single-player FPS set against the backdrop of World War II that every military fan has been waiting for. Amid the thunder of gunfire and the haze of gunpowder smoke, the hero who changes history is you!

・Intense, gripping missions rooted in historical fact hit you one after another
・Massive content with dozens of episodes to fight your way through
・Clear key stages to unlock jaw-dropping cinematic cutscenes
・Collect and use a huge variety of weapons authentically used in World War II
・The latest 3D audio and 3D physics engine put you right in the action, where you can feel every artillery blast
・Next-gen shaders applied to fully redrawn environments and characters deliver stunning visual fidelity
・Immersive 3D effects and graphics that drop you straight into the chaos of a world at war
・Team up with AI-powered allied soldiers and crush the enemy together
・Use cover to your advantage in tense, realistic firefights that feel like the real thing
・Grab weapons from allies and enemies alike and unleash an unstoppable FPS experience
・Expanded weapon collection loaded with authentic historical firearms from World War II

From the beach assault at Normandy to paratroopers blazing through the night sky, the complete story of D-Day is packed into this one must-play game. Blast through iconic moments in history, clear every episode, and an unforgettable ending is waiting for you. Download now and become the hero history never forgets.

Synopsis
In 1944, the war had reached a critical breaking point.
The Soviet Union, hammered by devastating losses on the Eastern Front, was pushing the Allies hard to open a second front in Europe.
After learning hard lessons from the failed raid at Dieppe, Allied commanders gathered at the Casablanca Conference and committed to planning the largest military operation in history, codenamed Operation Overlord.

In the early hours of June 6th, before the first light of dawn.
Allied airborne forces dropped silently into the darkness over Normandy, tasked with taking out coastal gun batteries and locking down key bridges.
Then, as dawn broke, thousands of landing craft tore through the grey, churning sea, charging hard toward Omaha Beach.

"The hopes and prayers of liberty-loving people everywhere march with you.
The eyes of the world are upon you.
The hour of your great crusade has arrived."

Now, the battle that will change the course of history is about to begin.

70010000125687.name: Skyship Quest Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000125687.intro: Customize your airship and explore the world above the clouds in this sim RPG
70010000125687.description:
Who says ships are only for the water? Why not take a voyage across a sea of clouds instead?

On a little island, floating in the sky, your adventure begins...
Hop on board your shining new airship and see what lies beyond the horizon! Gather your crew and explore regions of the sky where no one has ever been!

You'll discover all kinds of floating islands, from bustling tourist destinations to perilous monster-filled dungeons.
Develop your island, fend off monster attacks, and help your crew with their problems to earn fabulous rewards!

Use the resources you've earned to install new facilities on your ship and help your crew expand their know-how. With a stronger ship, and a more knowledgeable crew, you'll be able to explore islands from even further afield.

What new adventures and encounters await you in the vast blue sky? There's only one way to find out.
It's time to take off!

70010000125699.name: Stickman Monster Battle 3D
70010000125699.intro: Become a superhero and protect your city from waves of bloodthirsty monsters destroying everything in their path.
70010000125699.description:
You'll love this epic fighting game with cool effects and 3D combo attacks.

At the start, your hero is just a simple stickman with no weapons or abilities. Defeat monsters with your bare hands, earn money, upgrade your hero, buy weapons, and fight huge bosses!

The entire environment is fully destructible: smash monsters, blow up cars, and demolish buildings.

If you love dynamic action games, this one will impress you with its fast controls and awesome features.

Combine different upgrades to become the strongest stickman hero!

As the game progresses, enemies grow stronger, and you'll have to fight for your survival. To defeat the toughest foes, your stickman-fighter will need maximum power upgrades.

We're sure you'll enjoy tons of upgrades for your stickmen heroes in the best action RPG experience.

70010000125701.name: Syr and The Stars' Revival
70010000125701.intro:
Streamer Raising SLG × Gentle & Heartwarming Story
A brand-new streamer raising simulation where building your room is the key to streaming success!
70010000125701.description:
◇What is “Syr and The Stars' Revival”?◇

Spica became a legendary Nextuber.
But her era of fame ended abruptly when she suddenly disappeared.
Fans mourned her and longed for her return—but no matter how long they waited, she never came back. Over time, the residents of the Cyber World where she once shined began to leave, one by one.
Now, several years after Spica vanished…

A new girl has appeared in the Cyber World, which is on the brink of collapse after losing its brightest star. She is ready to debut as a Nextuber.
Her name is Syr.
This is the story of her journey to restore the Cyber World's lost star.

◇3 Key Points to Enjoy the Game◇

[Point 1: Start Streaming to Gain Fans!]
The core cycle of the game is simple: earn Vitality → stream → gain fans.
You can earn Vitality through activities like doing part-time jobs and visiting arcades.
Spend the Vitality you earn to stream and grow your fanbase while also earning funds.
As your fan count increases, new story scenarios will unlock, the Cyber World will gradually be restored, and new part-time jobs and facilities will become available.
But be careful—it is crucial to not overwork Syr, or her mental state may collapse.

[Point 2: Develop Syr's Stats!]
Simply streaming won't earn you fans very efficiently.
In this game, you can hone Syr's stats by arranging various furniture and equipment in her agency's office. As her stats improve, your streams perform better, and the rewards you earn increase.
Some equipment even come with “Equipment Skills” that activate during streams. By combining these skills, you can make your broadcasts even more exciting!
Keep livening up the office and boost Syr's stats to make her stronger!

[Point 3: Experience a Rich Story with Unique Characters!]
While this is primarily a raising simulation game, the story is also a major focus, offering a heartwarming and emotionally touching experience.
Join Syr and help weave her story as it unfolds!

70010000125713.name: Hidden Cats in Barcelona
70010000125713.intro: Tour beautiful places and dance the Sardana with the hidden cats of Barcelona!

70010000125724.name: Full Colour Tiles
70010000125724.description:
Bus, train and toilet friendly puzzle game created to test your power of logic.

Complete each level by turning all the tiles to a single color. 

All levels can be completed in 4 moves or less if you are skilled enough.

Good luck!!!


Features:

- 70 challenges to start, with more coming soon.
- Complete each level casually for a bronze or silver medal, or try and beat the game with all golds!
- Minimalistic visual and audio style.
- A Zen puzzling experience.
- Appropriate for all ages.

70010000125730.name: 1000 Questions to Be Chosen by the Cat Lord
70010000125730.intro:
Are you worthy of being chosen by the cat lord?
1000 questions to prove your love for cats.
70010000125730.description:
Do you have what it takes to be chosen by the cat lord?

"What does that tail flick really mean?"
"Do different breeds really have different personalities?"
"Who befriended whom first — cats or humans?"
Cats are full of mysteries, even to those who love them most.

This game is a 4-choice image quiz covering everything about cats.
Anatomy and senses, behavior and psychology, breeds, health and care, history and culture, life with humans, curious trivia, and even wild felines.
1000 questions across 8 categories — a complete journey through the feline world.

How to play is simple.
・Look at the image and read the question
・Choose your answer from 4 options
・Read the explanation for a new discovery

Get it right, and you are one step closer to the cat lord's approval.
Get it wrong, and the explanation turns the mistake into knowledge.

Start with just one question at a time.
Perfect for filling a few spare minutes.

Are you ready to take the test of not being abandoned by the cat lord?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000125742.name: Meow Moments: Celebrating Frost & Flora
70010000125742.intro: Join cute cats in a cozy getaway! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore a snowy winter village and a peaceful Japanese cherry blossom park.
70010000125742.description:
Experience the Beauty of the Seasons! In this cozy hidden-object adventure, cats and friends explore the contrast between a frosty winter wonderland and a serene blooming garden. Every detail invites you to discover that whether in the snow or under falling petals, friendship and fun are always in season.

Start your journey in The Winter Resort, a bustling snow-covered village where everyday life unfolds with gentle humor. Watch playful kittens ice skating, enjoying snowball fun, and sipping hot cocoa in a frosty wonderland full of warm encounters and cozy winter joy.

Then, step into The Cherry Blossom Park to visit a tranquil Japanese-inspired setting. Explore a peaceful garden with elegant red bridges and lively street food stalls where cats celebrate the Hanami festival. Amidst the falling pink petals, discover that sharing quiet moments together is what truly makes spring magical.

Features:
- Cats and Friends: Find delightful characters in two detailed scenes -one from a snowy winter retreat and one from a relaxing floral park.
- Balloon-Popping Fun: Enjoy relaxing gameplay as you pop balloons across the scenes—a bit of fun with every search!
- Rich Details: Explore beautifully illustrated settings that blend festive winter elements and blooming nature with visual storytelling in every corner.
- Over 600 Items to Find! Search for 202 cats, 202 unique characters, and colorful balloons hidden throughout the seasons.
- Atmospheric Soundtrack: Set the tone with immersive music tailored to match each getaway—from cozy winter tunes to relaxing spring melodies.
- Family-Friendly Fun: With cozy, pressure-free gameplay and intuitive controls, it’s an experience for all ages. Perfect for relaxing together or playing solo.

Celebrate the comforting beauty of frost and flora in this heartwarming journey—where every moment is worth remembering.

70010000125758.name: Hexara
70010000125758.intro:
Build combos, outsmart the grid, chase the perfect run. Perfect for fans of classic puzzle games.
Easy to pick up, hard to put down.
70010000125758.description:
Hexara is a puzzle game where strategy meets satisfying combo-building. Rotate clusters of hexagons to match colors, create powerful formations, and climb to higher levels.

Simple to learn, but difficult to master, every move matters as the grid evolves and new challenges appear. Chain combos, create rare formations, and push your score further with each run.

Featuring multiple game modes, increasing difficulty, and endless replayability, Hexara is perfect for quick sessions or long high-score chases.

How far can you go before the grid fills up?

70010000125764.name: Cornfield
70010000125764.description:
When the walls themselves seem to be alive, there is nowhere to hide. In Cornfield, you find yourself in the middle of a massive, suffocating maze of towering stalks. It is pitch black at night, the dirt paths twist into endless dead ends, and the only warning that you are being hunted is the chilling sound of rustling leaves. A relentless, terrifying monster tracks your every move through the shadows. This is not a combat game; it is a desperate test of navigation and survival.

Finding the exit is only half the battle. A series of complex puzzles and environmental challenges block your path to freedom and demand your full concentration. You must decipher clues and unlock new areas of the maze quickly yet carefully. The true terror of Cornfield lies in striking the right balance between logic and panic. Every second you spend standing still to crack a code gives the beast another second to close the distance.

Test your strategy and nerves in this heart-pounding escape adventure, where one wrong turn could be your last. Keep moving and think fast under pressure to conquer the maze before the terrifying creature catches up to you. 

Will you outsmart the nightmare lurking in the fields, or will you be consumed by the harvest?

70010000125791.name: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000125791.description:
The highly anticipated sequel to one of 2022’s most acclaimed RPGs!

You are a sleeper, an emulation of a human mind housed in an artificial body. You are on the run from the corporation that made you and the gang that seeks to control you. Commandeer a ship, build a network of crew and allies, and take on challenging contracts as you seek to build a future for yourself.

Choose a class, configure your skills and assemble your crew in unique tabletop-inspired gameplay. Your future depends on the roll of a dice, as you make difficult choices in a complex world. Reinventing the award-winning systems of Citizen Sleeper, this RPG will satisfy both fans of the original game and new players alike.

STAY AHEAD OF YOUR PAST
After a desperate attempt to free yourself from servitude by rewriting the very code that governs your system, you are on the run again, this time with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past.

REBOOT / REBUILD / REPAIR
Citizen Sleeper’s revolutionary dice system returns, revised for the sequel. Manage your stress or take damage to your dice. Deal with glitches as they accrue in your system. Push yourself to get lucky and make this cycle count.

PUSH YOUR LUCK
Each character class now has a unique “Push” ability that can help you turn the tide of a difficult job or send you into a dangerous spiral depending on how and when you choose to use it. Reroll your dice to change your fate, or focus a single die to bet everything on a big success.

NAVIGATE THE BELT
Chart a course from hub to hub with complete freedom, taking on jobs and setting goals as you see fit. A living world, the Starward Belt rewards curiosity and care, but it's up to you to decide which locations and stories deserve your time and resources.

DO THE JOB, GET PAID
Contracts offer a new kind of focussed, tactical gameplay to the Citizen Sleeper experience. You’ll need to prepare carefully and choose the right approach for these multi-cycle, high-risk, high-reward jobs, but you’ll also have to react and adapt to both the roll of the dice and the twists and turns of each task.

CHOOSE YOUR FUTURE
Player choice is a massive part of the Citizen Sleeper experience, and the sequel deepens this with new skill checks that allow you to express your class and character in scenes, as well as branching storylines that will ask you to make hard choices. The future of your character is up to you.

70010000125823.name: Hill Climb Legends
70010000125823.intro: Climb higher. Drive farther. Become a legend.
70010000125823.description:
Get ready for a wild ride in Hill Climb Legends, a fast and fun physics-based driving adventure where every hill is a new challenge.

Take control of a variety of vehicles and conquer steep climbs, tricky descents, huge jumps, and unpredictable terrain. Balance your ride, manage your speed, collect rewards, and push your distance record farther with every run.
Race through colorful locations ranging from snowy villages and frozen landscapes to sunny countryside roads. Simple controls make it easy to jump in, while mastering every hill takes skill, timing, and a little courage.

How far can you climb before the road gets the better of you?

70010000125829.name: Bob The Mad Rabbit
70010000125829.description:
Jump into a wildly unpredictable action adventure where a hot-headed rabbit leaves nothing but chaos in its wake. Battle through swarms of enemies, discover power-ups, and unleash ridiculous attacks as you carve a path through colorful comic-inspired arenas.

Gameplay features: 

- Fast-Paced Arcade Brawling: Take on relentless waves of enemies in energetic battles filled with action and satisfying combat.

- Ever-Changing Runs: Choose from a variety of random enhancements and build a unique set of powers every time you play.

- Escalating Challenges: Survive increasingly dangerous enemy encounters that demand constant adaptation.

- Colorful Comic-Inspired Visuals: Explore vibrant arenas bursting with personality, humor, and stylized cartoon action.

Each battle offers opportunities to combine upgrades, experiment with unexpected abilities, and create powerful combinations that can completely change your playstyle. Whether you're charging headfirst into danger or overwhelming opponents with bizarre attacks, every encounter delivers fast-paced action.

70010000125849.name: Basic Kanji Meaning Quiz
70010000125849.intro:
Easy kanji questions for kids!
Pick the answer from 4 choices
and enjoy learning step by step!
70010000125849.description:
Enjoy simple Japanese kanji quizzes made for kids and families.

Each question uses a 4-choice format, so players can answer without complicated controls. Children can check kanji readings and meanings at their own pace, while parents can join in and think through the answers together.

How to play is easy:
・Read the question
・Choose the correct answer from 4 options
・Keep going and review kanji little by little

This is a good choice for children who are starting to learn kanji, families who want a light learning activity, or anyone looking for a quick Japanese word quiz.

Play alone for a short study break, or enjoy it together as a family. Make kanji feel more familiar through easy, game-like questions.

70010000125864.name: Star Troopers - Combat Force
70010000125864.description:
Enter a high-speed combat arena where every second matters and every move decides your survival.

Set in a futuristic cyberpunk world, you fight as an elite operator inside advanced simulation arenas controlled by powerful corporations. Move constantly and use speed and positioning to stay in control during intense combat encounters.

Dash, jump, and react instantly while collecting resources and adapting to fast-changing combat situations. Each arena offers vertical gameplay, interactive elements, and multiple ways to approach every fight.

Key Features:
	•	Arena Shooter Gameplay: Fast-paced combat in dynamic arenas
	•	Cyberpunk Setting: Neon environments and futuristic locations
	•	Dynamic Movement: Dash, double jump, and vertical gameplay
	•	Interactive Arenas: Power-ups, destructible elements, and multi-level design
	•	Challenging Encounters: Test your reflexes and reaction speed
Fight, adapt, and stay one step ahead in a world built for combat.

Star Troopers – Combat Force delivers an intense, fast-paced shooter experience where reflexes, movement, and precision define every battle.

70010000125870.name: Thornkin
70010000125870.intro: Into the thorns, through the dark.
70010000125870.description:
Thornkin is a dark fantasy pixel-art platformer set in a cursed forest filled with thorns, ruins, and hidden dangers. Take control of a small mysterious creature and journey through a haunting world where every path leads deeper into shadow. Leap across deadly traps, avoid ruthless enemies, uncover secrets, and survive the twisted wilderness that surrounds you.

With atmospheric environments, handcrafted levels, and a fragile hero facing an unforgiving world, Thornkin blends exploration, precision platforming, and eerie adventure into a compact but memorable experience.

70010000125876.name: Lethal Corporation
70010000125876.intro: A solo survival horror experience where every contract could be your last.
70010000125876.description: Take on dangerous solo contracts across distant planets in this first-person survival horror experience. Explore abandoned bases, search dark corridors, and collect valuable scrap to meet your assigned quota. Each planet features different locations, hazards, and hostile creatures. Manage your limited inventory, avoid deadly traps, and decide when it is time to escape with your haul. Staying too long may cost you everything. Every expedition is a separate challenge. If you die, all collected scrap is lost and the mission begins again. Explore carefully, complete the quota, and survive the horrors waiting inside.

70010000125909.name: Exodus : Creepy Time
70010000125909.intro:
Survive the hordes
Upgrade your character
Unlock new stages
70010000125909.description:
"Exodus: Creepy Time" is an exciting casual style game with elements of a simplified roguelike. An ominous journey through dark and gloomy locations awaits you, where every action you take has serious consequences. Survive in a world where darkness and horror lurk at every turn. Collect resources, upgrade your character and develop new skills to survive in this horror world.

Trapped in a world steeped in darkness and horror, where sinister forces rule every corner. The main character discovers that the world he is in has turned out to be cursed. People and animals have turned into mutants and monsters under the influence of dark forces. He is left alone with this horror, and his only goal is to find a way out of this nightmarish reality, but keep in mind time is inexorably ticking, and the curse is getting stronger by the hour. Will the hero be able to find the strength and wisdom to overcome the horrors of this "Creepy Time" and free himself from this dark web?
Immerse yourself in "Exodus: Creepy Time", where your every decision

Features:
- Simple and Addictive Gameplay
- Constant Threat
- Improvements and New Skills
- Bright cartoon graphics
- Cool characters
- An invigorating soundtrack

70010000125933.name: Truck Parking Simulator 2026
70010000125933.description:
Precision is everything when every move counts.

Take control of a heavy truck and prove your skills in precise parking challenges that require focus and accuracy. What starts as a simple task — locating and attaching the trailer — quickly becomes a true test of coordination, timing, and control.

Once connected, the real challenge begins. Maneuver your truck with a trailer through tight spaces, avoid obstacles, and carefully position it in the designated parking zone. Every movement matters, especially when reversing, turning, or aligning your vehicle in limited areas.

As you progress, levels become more complex, introducing narrower paths, longer trailers, moving obstacles, and more demanding parking situations. You’ll need to plan your route, adjust your angles, and stay in control to complete each challenge successfully.

Switch between multiple camera views to better understand your surroundings and improve your accuracy. Learn how trailer physics behave, avoid mistakes, and refine your technique to achieve the best results.

Key Features:
- Realistic Parking Challenges: Attach trailers and park with precision
- Trailer Physics: Master reversing, angles, and control
- Multiple Camera Views: Third person, top-down, and trailer view
- Progressive Difficulty: From simple tasks to expert-level challenges
-Varied Locations: Industrial zones, warehouses, ports, and city areas
- Skill-Based Gameplay: Accuracy, timing, and control define success

From basic maneuvers to advanced parking situations, every level pushes your skills further.
Truck Parking Simulator 2026 delivers a focused driving experience where precision, patience, and control make the difference between success and failure.

70010000125939.name: Car Dealership Manager 2026
70010000125939.intro:
Buy. Repair. Sell.
Build the ultimate car dealership empire.
70010000125939.description:
Step into the fast lane of the automotive business in Car Dealership Manager 2026, the ultimate hands-on simulator where every handshake, every repair, and every sale is executed with your own two hands.

Start with a dusty lot and a handful of questionable beaters, then grind your way up to a multi-million dollar luxury showroom empire. This isn't a menu-driven spreadsheet sim — you're walking the floor, popping hoods, inspecting paint jobs, and bringing neglected machines back to life before flipping them for massive profits.

True Hands-On Immersion

Feel the weight of the work. Clean interiors, polish scratched paint, and wrench on engines with detailed, tool-by-tool interaction systems.
Inspect Every Inch: Get up close to check engine blocks, examine the undercarriage, and spot hidden damage in fully photorealistic environments.
Test Drive Your Investments: Take your inventory for a spin to experience how cars handle across different environments.
Push the Limits: Experience a hyper-realistic physics engine and dynamic weather conditions before putting cars on the lot.

Build a Luxury Empire

Design your dealership exactly how you want it. Transition from a greasy garage to an elite, brightly lit luxury showroom that drops jaws the second buyers walk in.
Manage the Hustle: Hire a crew of mechanics, detailers, and sales reps to automate the grind.
Expand Your Turf: Upgrade your offices, expand parking lots, and curate specialized display zones for high-end supercars.

Whether you want to be a ruthless auction hunter, a restoration perfectionist, or a luxury automotive kingpin, Car Dealership Manager 2026 puts the entire business in your hands.

Build your empire. Become the legend.

70010000125958.name: Bestial Reception
70010000125958.intro:
Survive stages
Destroy environment
unlock characters
70010000125958.description:
A roguelike shooter in a bizarre radioactive world full of humanoid animals. In a radioactive wastelands and mutated biomes, animals are fighting for their existence and you are one of them!
Choose a hero and make your way through the hordes of enemies. Collect various artifacts, explore secrets and defeat bosses. Destroy all enemies and get to the top of food chain! (alone or with your friend!)

70010000125976.name: The Posthumous Investigation
70010000125976.intro: A dead man hired you to solve his own murder. You have one day. Fourteen suspects. And as many attempts as it takes.
70010000125976.description:
THE CLIENT IS THE VICTIM
Master the Time Loop: You have one day to solve the crime. Learn the schedules of 14 unique characters, spot their contradictions, and manipulate their routines. Keep your knowledge when the day resets and stay one step ahead of the killer.

MASTER THE LOOP
No hand-holding. Use your "Thinking Board" to link evidence, reconstruct the timeline, and accuse the culprit. Only pure logic will free you from the loop.

LITERARY NOIR
A Living Literary World: Experience a satirical, witty, and dark adaptation of Brazil’s legendary author, Machado de Assis. Your investigation takes you through a hand-drawn 1937 Rio de Janeiro that drips with style, sarcasm, and atmosphere. There is no single correct answer: every accusation has its logic, and the truth is yours to define.

70010000126000.name: Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator
70010000126000.intro: Buy low, sell high, and short an entire universe of babies in this arcade stock market sim set in the world of Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator.
70010000126000.description:
In Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator, you of course do not actually trade BABIES. We aren't monsters.

You buy stocks BASED on the simulated lives of babies, profiting from their misery and cashing out the moment they win the Galactic Lottery!

Step into the shoes of baby traders across the universe in a fast-paced series of mini-campaigns. Unlock unique character endings, bet on the lifespans of digitally simulated alien children, and snatch up as many credits as you can, as fast as you can. Purchase the services of strange consultants, gathering data on your trading targets and building your fortune one Trading Rush at a time.

This is the baby-themed arcade stock market sim you didn't know you needed.  

Features:
- Seven distinct planets to trade procedurally generated alien baby stocks on, each showcasing unique ideas of what it means to be profitable and productive to society.
- Consultants you can hire before the trading day to gain information on your trading targets.
- An anthology of mini-campaigns following the lives and complications of baby traders across the universe.
- A loan shark that won't let you pay him back, because he's then legally allowed to shoot you.
- An arcade satire on stock markets and ruthless exploitation from the creators of I Am Your Beast and Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator and.
- Pulsing electro-industrial soundtrack by Kris Kirk.
- The ability to short a baby, because you believe its life will suck.

70010000126002.name: Crystalase
70010000126002.description:
Crystalase is a relaxing puzzle game. Players assemble beautiful images made entirely of sparkling crystals. Each level involves placing crystal pieces in the correct positions to gradually reveal intricate, colourful artwork.
Unlock new images, explore different themes, and enjoy the rewarding process of turning scattered crystals into dazzling masterpieces.
Crystalase is perfect for puzzle lovers and anyone who enjoys creativity, focus and a touch of sparkle.

70010000126005.name: Another Day?
70010000126005.intro: Break the Routine. Escape the Room.
70010000126005.description:
You wake up in your apartment, surrounded by the stark, minimalist geometry of a black-and-white world. Your everyday tasks, such as making the bed, washing the dishes, and taking out the trash, appear ordinary. However, in this bizarre setting, completing these everyday chores is the key to accessing the outside world.

It's a unique first-person escape room experience that mixes everyday chores with mind-bending puzzles. As you navigate the quiet rooms of your home, observe your surroundings carefully. Trust your instincts as you collect useful objects, decipher cryptic symbols painted on the walls, and manipulate strange mechanisms hidden among your furniture. The answers to your escape are buried in the television static and the wall gears.

The striking low-poly art style, paired with subtle chromatic glitch effects and a haunting sense of isolation, transforms an ordinary apartment into an intriguing puzzle box. Complete your tasks, unlock the secrets of your home, and escape the monotony of everyday life to earn your freedom.

70010000126011.name: D.U.M.B.E.R. Ducks
70010000126011.intro: The D.U.M.B. ducks are back for an Emergency Rescue!
70010000126011.description:
When a distress signal from deep with the earth is received, it's the D.U.M.B. ducks to rescue! They must retrieve their fellow ducks, as well as lost equipment, then blow up the underground caverns in the process. There's only one thing to worry about -- giant, carnivorous snails! Will the ducks or snails survive to eat the other side?

Carry up to four guns at once as you fight for your fellow fowl's lives!

70010000126013.name: Criminal Profile Who’s the Culprit?!
70010000126013.intro:
Can you uncover the truth?
A brain-teasing mystery quiz that tests your observation skills!
70010000126013.description:
Read the case carefully, study the illustration, and find the hidden clue that reveals the answer.

With simple controls and bite-sized puzzles, anyone can enjoy the feeling of being a detective.

Who among the suspects is the culprit?
Who is the real father?
Who has already passed away?

These and many more tricky mystery cases await!

Even if a question has you stumped, helpful hints will guide you forward.
Play solo, or challenge family and friends to see who can solve each case the fastest.

Use your intuition, observation skills, and deduction power to clear every mystery!

Recommended for players who enjoy:
Mystery quizzes, detective stories, suspense dramas, brain training, hidden clues, casual puzzle games, and observation challenges.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000126029.name: Ninja Teleport
70010000126029.intro: Master the art of stealth and become the ultimate ninja assassin!
70010000126029.description:
Dive into an exciting adventure where every stage brings new challenges, unique environments, and thrilling encounters. Travel through a colorful world, face dangerous enemies, solve environmental challenges, and uncover hidden secrets on your way to victory.

Unlock new abilities, improve your skills, and master increasingly difficult obstacles as you progress. Carefully designed levels, engaging gameplay, and rewarding exploration create an experience that keeps you coming back for more.

Scale walls, throw your blade, and instantly teleport to your target for precise one-hit eliminations. Stay hidden, outsmart your enemies, and complete dangerous missions before anyone realizes you're there.

Take on increasingly challenging levels that test your timing, strategy, and skill. Every mission requires careful planning and flawless execution.

Choose Your Perfect Arsenal

Equip a variety of classic ninja weapons to match your playstyle. Fight with throwing knives, swords, boomerangs, clubs, and other deadly tools, selecting the right equipment for every mission.

Game Features
Fast-paced stealth action with teleportation mechanics
Challenging missions that reward precision and strategy
A wide selection of traditional ninja weapons
Increasingly difficult levels and unique enemy encounters
Stylish gameplay focused on quick thinking and perfect execution

Can you complete every mission and earn the title of the ultimate ninja master?

70010000126050.name: Re:Re:Ghosted
70010000126050.description:
Endless job search. Hunt for the best resume. Die in someone else's dream. Frame HR for murders. And fail in the backrooms.

Re:re:ghosted is a first-person psychological horror game.

70010000126052.name: Memebonk
70010000126052.intro: Smash endless hordes of meme monsters as genius scientists! Roguelike survival with insane builds and infinite chaos!
70010000126052.description:
HOW LONG CAN YOU SURVIVE?

Memebonk is a roguelike survival where six great scientists battle endless waves of brainrot monsters. Pick a hero with a unique power, step onto the infinite battlefield, and prove that brains beat chaos.

THREE LOCATIONS — THREE WORLDS
The Great Library, where knowledge becomes a weapon. The Garden of Eden, where danger hides behind every flower. The Synthwave Desert, where neon and sand merge into madness. Every map is randomly generated — no two runs are ever the same.

BECOME ABSURDLY POWERFUL
Destroy enemies, collect XP, and level up on the fly. Every upgrade is random with varying rarity — craft insane builds and break the game in your favor. 40+ items with unique synergies give you endless room to experiment.

6 SCIENTISTS — 6 STYLES
Each character has their own core power and changes how you play. Find your favorite, unlock new ones, and try unexpected combinations.

BOSSES AND 130+ QUESTS
Waves of small foes are just the warm-up. Mighty bosses will put your build to the test. And a system of over 130 quests keeps things fresh even after hundreds of runs.

Stylish characters, gorgeous animations, addictive gameplay. One run — and you won't be able to stop.

70010000126065.name: Animal Farm Coloring Book for Kids & Toddlers
70010000126065.intro: Farm game, Animals, preschool game, children's draw & paint, farm games, educational learning game.
70010000126065.description:
Dive into the colorful world of the farm and enjoy a relaxing coloring adventure for kids!
In this creative coloring book, children can discover many lovely farm animal pictures and bring them to life with their own colors. Whether it’s a cute sheep, a friendly cow, a happy pig, or other farm animals, every picture invites kids to be creative and have fun.

The game offers two easy and intuitive coloring modes. In pen mode, children can freely draw and color with countless colors, while the paint bucket mode allows them to fill areas quickly and easily. The pen size can be adjusted freely, making it possible to draw both small details and larger colorful areas.

For even more creative freedom, the line art of each picture can be hidden. This turns the canvas into a clean white drawing space where children can create their very own farm-themed artwork from scratch. They can color inside the lines, experiment with bright colors, or simply draw whatever they imagine.

Thanks to the touch-screen controls of the Nintendo Switch™, coloring feels simple, natural, and fun. The game is perfect for preschoolers and young children who enjoy animals, drawing, and creative play. It helps develop fine motor skills, color recognition, and imagination in a calm and entertaining way.

Get ready to visit the farm, choose your favorite animal picture, and fill the world with color! A relaxing and creative coloring book for children and the whole family to enjoy.

70010000126071.name: Tiny Builders Coloring Book for Kids
70010000126071.intro: Color excavators, trucks, builders, and construction machines with many colors, pen, and paint bucket. A creative touchscreen coloring game for kids.
70010000126071.description:
Welcome to a colorful construction coloring adventure for kids!

In Tiny Builders Coloring Book for Kids, children can discover many fun construction-themed pictures and bring them to life with their favorite colors. Excavators, trucks, cranes, builders, bulldozers, and other construction machines are waiting to be colored in bright and creative ways.

Choose from a wide variety of colors and enjoy two simple and intuitive coloring modes. Use the pen mode to draw and color freely, or use the paint bucket mode to fill larger areas quickly and easily. The pen size can be adjusted freely, making it easy to color both small details and bigger spaces.

For even more creative freedom, the line art can be hidden. This turns the page into a clean white canvas where children can create their very own drawings and let their imagination run free.

Thanks to the touchscreen controls of Nintendo Switch™, the game is simple, direct, and child-friendly. It is ideal for young children who love construction sites, vehicles, machines, drawing, and creative play. The game encourages creativity, fine motor skills, color recognition, and imagination in a calm and playful way.

Visit the construction site, choose your favorite vehicle or machine, and start coloring! A relaxing and creative coloring game for kids and the whole family.

70010000126077.name: Animal Coloring Book for Kids & Toddlers: Unicorns
70010000126077.intro: Color magical unicorns, cute fantasy animals, rainbows, and enchanted scenes. A creative touchscreen coloring game for kids.
70010000126077.description:
Welcome to a magical coloring adventure full of unicorns, fantasy animals, and imagination!

In Animal Coloring Book for Kids & Toddlers: Unicorns, children can discover many adorable unicorn pictures and bring them to life with their favorite colors. Cute unicorns, magical horses, rainbows, stars, clouds, enchanted scenes, and fantasy creatures invite kids to dream, create, and explore their imagination.

Choose from a wide variety of colors and enjoy two simple and intuitive coloring modes. Use the pen mode to draw and color freely, or use the paint bucket mode to fill larger areas quickly and easily. The pen size can be adjusted freely, making it easy to color both small details and bigger spaces.

For even more creative freedom, the line art can be hidden. This turns the page into a clean white canvas where children can create their very own drawings, magical worlds, and fantasy animals.

Thanks to the touchscreen controls of Nintendo Switch™, the game is simple, direct, and child-friendly. It is ideal for young children who love unicorns, horses, magical animals, drawing, fairy-tale worlds, and creative play. The game encourages imagination, creativity, fine motor skills, color recognition, and calm artistic expression in a playful way.

Enter a colorful fantasy world, choose your favorite unicorn, and start coloring! A relaxing and creative coloring game for kids and the whole family.

70010000126083.name: Shadow Trigger: Covert Ops
70010000126083.intro: Powered by a cutting-edge engine, deploy your tactics in a top-secret Middle East rescue mission! Hardcore tactical FPS through a war of betrayal and conspiracy!
70010000126083.description:
Built on the latest game engine, Shadow Trigger: Covert Ops delivers stunning high-quality 3D visuals and silky-smooth gameplay, dropping you right in the middle of howling desert sandstorms, choking gunpowder smoke, and bone-rattling blast waves. The oil-rich nation of Al-Sarat has been a battleground for decades, caught between the competing ambitions of global superpowers. When Western intelligence sends in a special forces unit to take out the leadership of extremist armed faction Jamala, the mission is already compromised before the first boot hits the ground. Ambushed by a precisely coordinated anti-air assault using advanced electronic warfare systems and MANPADS, the Black Hawk formation is brought down in the heart of the city, leaving survivors surrounded by thousands of hostile fighters. With official rescue operations shut down for political reasons, you are the only one sent in, covertly, to bring your squad home alive.

・Built on the latest game engine for high-quality 3D graphics and smooth, responsive combat action.
・Take on missions across authentically recreated Middle Eastern locations including desert canyons, occupied urban buildings, and night-time forward operating bases.
・Intense hardcore tactical FPS action played entirely from a first-person perspective.
・From covert night infiltrations to desperate urban breakouts, each mission delivers a distinct vibe and pulse-pounding tension.
・A massive arsenal including sniper rifles, assault rifles, SMGs, and anti-tank rockets, with tactical flexibility to match every situation.
・High mission freedom: choose your approach, from silent takedowns to all-out frontal assault.
・Tight, responsive controls built for everyone, from FPS newcomers to hardcore operators.

Nobody knows you're out there. Nobody's coming to help. As an elite special forces operative, hunt down the traitor, rescue your surrounded squad, and blow apart the insurgent conspiracy that turned an entire city into a kill zone. Every mission is a precision-crafted test of skill, grit, and instinct. Whether you make it out, whether you find the mole, whether you pull that final trigger, it's all on you.

Prologue
Al-Sarat is an oil-rich nation where a decades-long proxy war between global powers has finally hit its breaking point. What looked like the end of a civil war was nothing more than a brief silence before the storm. An unidentified militia, backed by a regional military power and bankrolled by a massive criminal cartel, has quietly leveled up into a professional fighting force armed with state-level electronic warfare systems and surface-to-air missile batteries.

Western intelligence sent in a Black Hawk formation to neutralize the leadership of Jamala, but the operation was burned before it even kicked off. The insurgents had been tracking the mission in real time, stacking anti-air ambush teams at every approach into the city. As the formation pushed into the canyon corridor, a MANPADS missile punched through the Black Hawk's countermeasures and nailed the tail rotor. The helicopter went down in a fireball over the city square.

This was no accident. It was the final piece of a carefully laid trap, pulling Western forces deep into the city to be used as pawns in a global information war. Thousands of armed fighters closed in on the crash site as all comms went dark. With the political blowback too big to risk a formal rescue, command makes one last call: send in special forces, off the grid, and get them out.

70010000126100.name: Touhou Yukkuri Mountain – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000126100.intro:
3D Puzzle: Take It Easy!!!
Touhou Project characters are here in their "Yukkuri" forms!
70010000126100.description:
■ How to Play

Throw, Merge, and Grow!: Just drop the "Yukkuri" into the bowl! When two of the same kind touch, they transform into a larger Yukkuri!

Don't Let Them Fall!: It's Game Over if the Yukkuri overflow from the bowl...

Aim for the High Score!: Growing them large and triggering consecutive merges (Chains) will skyrocket your score!

■ Reimu & Marisa’s Live Commentary!

Reimu and Marisa chat away with game-style commentary based on your play!

Their lively banter and reactions make every match even more exciting!

■ Fully Customizable Features

30 Different Yukkuri!: Play the game, earn points, and head to the shop to unlock new Yukkuri.

Customize the Evolution Order!: You can swap the order of evolution! Set your favorite character as the largest size and create your very own "Yukkuri Mountain"!

■ Various Game Modes

Multiplayer: Supports local matches for up to 4 players! Enjoy a heart-pounding stacking battle together!

Rankings: Compete with players worldwide for the top score and prove you’re the ultimate Yukkuri master!

70010000126118.name: The Abyss’s Last Breath
70010000126118.intro: The Abyss’s Last Breath: blends survival, escape‑room gameplay and immersive simulation into a unique psychological horror experience.
70010000126118.description:
You control John, the only volunteer in a secret mission to descend to the edge of the Earth’s core.

Aboard a scientific mini‑submarine barely 3×2 meters in size, equipped with archaic systems typical of the 1930s, you must manage real parameters such as pressure, battery, oxygen and temperature while solving escape‑room‑style puzzles and confronting abyssal anomalies capable of distorting reality, the senses… and even your memories.

Your main objective is to extract, using the mechanical arm, a sample of the inexhaustible energy source hidden within the core. As secondary missions, you can explore and scan unknown abyssal life, expanding the expedition’s scientific record.

The experience blends claustrophobia, constant tension, and John’s emotional breakdown, as visions of his lost family are twisted by the abyss to strike where it hurts most.

In 1938, the classified expedition codenamed “Last Breath” sought to achieve the deepest manned descent in history. No one agreed to participate… except John, a man devastated by guilt after an accident that destroyed his life. For him, this mission is not science—it is penance.

The descent to 10,000 feet drags him into a hell of pressure and heat comparable to that of a star, where he must tear from the planet a sample of inexhaustible energy with the potential to reshape humanity’s future.

But before that, John must survive the most hostile journey ever attempted, facing not only the cold, hostile abyss but also anomalies that twist his memories of what torments him most.

70010000126122.name: Gummy Invaders
70010000126122.intro:
I'm fighting the Demon Fungi?! ... I'll win, won't I?
Tiny Mushroom Agent vs. Endless Enemies!
Relax in this cozy world and watch your stats go crazy!
70010000126122.description: To denounce the evils of truth and love, the lovely charming germ agents, Gummy Invaders, blasting through the veins at the speed of light! In this incremental game, you’ll lead your germ agents through constant evolution. Upgrade skill tree, multiply  forces, and teach those troublemakers a lesson!

70010000126130.name: One-inch Tactics
70010000126130.intro: Turn the tide of the war with nuanced strategies in One-inch Tactics.
70010000126130.description:
Kogado Studio, recognized for its simulation games in the early days of PC gaming, has taken on the challenge of simplicity in this title.
Beneath the game's simple design lies a deep, strategic complexity.  

Immerse yourself in the unparalleled enjoyment of strategy.  

【 POINTS 】
◆ [Gameplay] Intuitive, simple, and smooth operation.

◆ [Visuals] Featuring a stylized 3D playing field that resembles a board game, creating a relaxed, casual tabletop gaming atmosphere.

◆ [Battlefields] A wide variety of missions including mountains, urban areas, and fortresses. Deploy with the right equipment tailored to each situation.

◆ [Tactics] "Line of Sight" and "Line of Fire" come into play around cover, hills, and cliffs. Carefully scout, spot enemies, and turn the tide of battle in your favor.

◆ [Units] Pilots with unique strengths and weaknesses. Building the right squad to leverage their traits is key to victory.

70010000126142.name: Heavy machinery vs Shumai
70010000126142.intro: Please use the heavy machinery to remove the green peas from the top of the shumai.
70010000126142.description:
“Hey, kids! I'm a site supervisor who hates green peas.”

Your job is to operate heavy machinery to pick green peas off the top of shumai.

All you need to operate the heavy machinery are the L and R sticks.
Be bold yet cautious—use precise stick controls to save the site supervisor’s lunch!

Excavators, wheel loaders, forklifts, and cranes.
There are over 40 special moves available for these four types of heavy machinery.
Unlock all the special moves and become a heavy machinery master!

70010000126152.name: Wantama☆Life
70010000126152.intro: Starring the Vtuber Tamaki Inuyama! Exposure means over. The secret school trip begins...
70010000126152.description:
Wantama☆Life is a fully voiced visual novel starring Tamaki Inuyama.
As the teacher, lead the school trip while protecting the secrets your student carry.
Enjoy a comedy story filled with trouble at tourist spots and inns, brought to life by a cast of unique characters.

◆Synopsis
「Hey sensei... I am actually an otokonoko.」
You have discovered the secret of Tamaki Inuyama.
And at the worst timing the school trip begins!

Tourist spots, yukata, hot springs――
One wrong step, leads to an instant disaster.

Dragged around by Tamaki's best friend Mea Kagura,
and with senior teacher Norio Tsukudani getting pulled into the chaos too!?

Can you keep Tamaki’s secret
hidden until the very end――!?

School trip where the truth must never come out begins!

◆Characters
・Tamaki Inuyama (VA:Tamaki Inuyama)
A student in the class where you serve as assistant homeroom teacher.
He is an Otokonoko who hides that fact from those around, while also having a soft spot for cute girls.
An extreme unicorn fan of Mea Kagura.

・Mea Kagura (VA:Mea Kagura)
A student in the class where you serve as assistant homeroom teacher. Tamaki's best friend.
She knows Tamaki's secret and helps keep it hidden from everyone else.
She loves handsome guys and plans to find the perfect boyfriend during the school trip.

・Norio Tsukudani  (VA:Norio Tsukudani)
The homeroom teacher of the class where you serve as assistant teacher, and your former mentor from your own school days.
She gives you plenty of support as you struggle to keep up with her free-spirited students.
There seems to be something going on between her and Tamaki...?

70010000126175.name: Battle Strike
70010000126175.intro: The pinnacle of current-generation graphics, a game changer in modern warfare
70010000126175.description:
The ultimate weapon that will bring the world to ruin, the NEMESIS Protocol. There is only a minute left before it starts operating. Now, the best special forces are moving to eliminate high-level targets that threaten the world.

A meeting of the overwhelming live-action graphics created by next-generation engines and the near-future high-tech tactics. Experience the pinnacle of the most innovative and realistic modern warfare at Battle Strike.

· A battlefield without limits, complete freedom: an unpredictable battle in a vast open field. There is no established route. Only your strategic choice becomes a tactic.
· Strongest Maneuvering Equipment on the Ground: Directly steer the next generation of tanks to devastate enemy strongholds and cover our allies. Maneuvering equipment allows you to dominate battlefields at high speeds and preoccupy key bases.
· Four identities for perfect victory: Synergy with four individual bottles of Assault, Engineer, Support, and Recon, and essential collaborative action for victory.
· Thrill-Flowing Tactical Match: Deathmatch's Survival Instinct, Break down enemy lines of defense with overwhelming tactical play in Conquest and Rush modes.
· Into the Extreme Battlefield: From a desert base swirling with chaos to a huge secret factory dominated by iron and high heat, prove your agent's prowess in breathtaking tension.

<Synopsis: The Great Shadow, and the Countdown>
In an era where national borders have collapsed, the world falls into the clutches of the invisible ruler, the 'Black Octave'. This private military and tech cartel manipulates global conflicts from behind the scenes and is dismantling the existing world order by trading in forbidden, cutting-edge weapons. On the day of humanity's final judgment, which they have kept hidden, the ultimate weapon, the 'NEMESIS Protocol', begins to activate.

You are an elite agent of the world's most elite special forces unit who must eliminate the leader of this invisible, massive evil. Track down the leader lurking in the shadows and stop the countdown that will drive the world to destruction.

The operation has already begun. Be deployed on an extreme mission unfolding on the edge of hell, alongside your most trusted comrade.

70010000126181.name: Hidden Oddities in Everyday Life Mystery
70010000126181.intro:
Wait — something's off here, isn't it?
Spot the oddity hidden in everyday life.
70010000126181.description:
Look closely — something's not quite right.

Living rooms, kitchens, bedrooms, entryways.
Every scene looks like an ordinary day, except one detail is subtly wrong.

Chair legs, clock hands, bookshelf patterns, cup handles...
Oddities so small that most people never notice.
Can you find them?

This is an observation quiz where you just tap the strange spot in a single illustration.
100 questions, all "perfectly normal" scenes.
But when you look a little closer...

How to play is simple.
・Look carefully at the illustration
・Tap the spot that feels off
・If correct, the explanation reveals exactly what was wrong

The unease of "something's off, but what?" and the satisfaction of "there it is!" make this hard to put down.

Hints are available when you get stuck.
A perfect brain workout for your commute, before bed, or a coffee break.

Mysteries hide in everyday life.
Your eyes won't be fooled.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000126187.name: Hentai Puzzle Simulator 3
70010000126187.intro: Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.
70010000126187.description:
Solve captivating puzzles featuring images of beautiful anime-style girls. With each image you complete, you'll unlock new ones, and the gradually increasing difficulty makes solving the puzzle a fascinating challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling that you're actually touching every detail.

Soft and relaxing music will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after solving the puzzle, you can examine the image closely and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Stylish anime images.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Relaxing music.

70010000126193.name: Hidden Legends 2
70010000126193.intro: Find the invisible, discover the impossible!
70010000126193.description:
Hidden Legends 2 is a sequel that takes you on an even deeper and more immersive fantasy adventure. This time, the search is truly interactive: items aren't just scattered throughout the level; many are carefully hidden inside the houses of fairytale characters and other environmental objects. Each level is handcrafted, and every discovery requires attention, giving you the feeling of a true detective. You'll explore familiar locations as well as completely new ones. Immerse yourself in the fairytale atmosphere thanks to colorful graphics, a magical soundtrack, and intuitive touch controls.

Game Features:

• Hundreds of unique objects to find.
• Unique handcrafted levels filled with detail.
• Colorful fantasy graphics and charming characters.
• Atmospheric music creates a completely immersive experience.
• Convenient controls with touchscreen support.
• Ideal for those who enjoy hidden object games and quiet exploration.

70010000126199.name: Parables of Jesus
70010000126199.intro: Step into the most inspiring moments of the Bible in a unique puzzle experience created for those who cherish the teachings of Jesus.
70010000126199.description:
In Parables of Jesus, each puzzle begins with a hidden image. By carefully pushing and arranging its pieces, you gradually reveal the complete scene—and with every puzzle you uncover a new passage, story, or moment from the life and teachings of Jesus.

As the image comes together, so does the story.

From His timeless parables to unforgettable moments recorded in Scripture, every completed puzzle offers a new opportunity to reflect, discover and experience the message of the Gospel in a peaceful and engaging way.

A beautiful journey through Scripture, one piece at a time. 

Featuring multiple difficulty levels.

Perfect for Christian families, Bible lovers, and anyone who wants to combine relaxing puzzle gameplay with the timeless stories of Jesus.

70010000126206.name: Golfish
70010000126206.intro: Golfish is a cute single-player puzzle adventure where you roll, flop, and splash your way from ice hole to ice hole as a little fish on a big journey!
70010000126206.description:
Spit water to move as a round fish in this cute minigolf puzzle adventure! Use clever movement, smart timing, and the help of adorable sea creatures to overcome obstacles and explore a charming world full of personality.

Sea Creatures That Lend a Fin!
Bounce on jellyfish, get carried by crabs, and let mighty whales blast you across the water. These adorable marine animals are not just part of the world, they are part of the puzzle. Learn how each creature works and use them to reach new places!

Over 100 Levels of Watery Challenges!
Take on a growing journey of handcrafted puzzles testing your problem-solving ability. Earn stars for optimal playthroughs, just watch out for the water not to run out!

Customize Your Fishy Hero!
Unlock different looks and make your little fish truly your own with 25 unique skins and 8 effects to choose from! Whether you want your fish to look cute, silly or stylish, we have that in stock!

Convenient gameplay
Enjoy dynamic camera support and a wide range of gameplay settings!

70010000126212.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
70010000126212.intro: Where there's a Prinny, there's a party!
70010000126212.description:
Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to beat Laharl, the Supreme Overboard!

Work together to defeat heroes from classic Disgaea games or fight each other for every item. Whatever you do, just don’t die all at once, or it’ll be game over—for everyone! This Prinny-perfect experience is an RPG and a party all in one.

70010000126221.name: Dream Town Island – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000126221.intro: A town sim where you raise generations of residents.
70010000126221.description:
Give free reign to your creativity in this inventive town sim!

Unlock new stores and facilities, help your residents find love, or cash in on the stock market!

If you founded a new town on an uninhabited island, what would you build there? Restaurants? Convenience Stores? Movie theaters? Make your choices and create a town that everyone will want to move to!

As you develop your town further, you'll unlock new stores and facilities, helping you attract new citizens.

Residents of your town can spend their whole lives there - they can find jobs, get married, and even have kids. How many generations can you support?

Walking isn't the only way to get around town - residents can travel in style using cars, bikes, and even UFOs!

There's also a wide variety of pets available, including staples like cats and dogs as well as more out-there options. Ever wanted an elephant in your backyard? We've got you covered.

No space to build more stuff? No problem! Reclaim land off the coast, then customize the terrain's height and design it to create a region that perfectly fits your tastes!

Get started building the city of your dreams today!

70010000126227.name: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000126227.intro: The complete iX series, refined. The apeX of 2D action reaches a new peak!
70010000126227.description:
Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection brings together and updates the apeX of 2D action for new and old players alike.
The Dual Collection includes both Luminous Avenger iX 1 and 2, with all all DLC included, as well as balance adjustments.
It also features a new mode, Endless Battle.

●Revised balance "Director's Cut"
Luminous Avenger iX's Darkness Trigger "berserk" mode has been powered up.
Luminous Avenger iX 2 receives a new "Spike Smash" system, powering up Copen's main weapon, the Razor Wheel.
A number of other adjustments also improve gameplay balance.

●All DLC included
Every item is built in, including content that was previously limited availability.

●New "Endless Battle" mode
Luminous Avenger iX and Luminous Avenger iX 2 each receive a special mode, "Endless Battle". Configure the settings to your liking before facing off against an endless onslaught of random bosses.
How many will you be able to defeat? Take on the apeX challenge!

●Two sci-fi action stories filled with character
Copen is a hard-boiled fighter in a grim future distopia.
Can he save the powerless people he meets? And can they save him?

[Voice Cast]
Copen: Yuma Uchida (Japanese)
           Alejandro Saab (English, iX 2)
Lola: Mayu Mineda (Japanese)
        Cassandra Lee Morris (English, iX 2)
Kohaku: Yumiri Hanamori (Japanese)
            Kira Buckland (English, iX 2)
Blade: Yui Ishikawa (Japanese)
Null: Sumire Morohoshi (Japanese) 
       Natalie Rose Hoover (English)

70010000126233.name: Artis Impact
70010000126233.description: A fun turn-based RPG set in a future world of humans and AI. Play as Akane to explore vibrant locations, battle with simple yet fluid combat, and enjoy side quests full of charming surprises. With a playful, humorous style and clever details, this adventure is light, easy, and full of smiles.

70010000126238.name: Cat&Rabbit Magic Farming
70010000126238.intro: Stir Up Some Magic in Your Very Own Potion Empire!
70010000126238.description:
Welcome to the most enchanting workshop in the kingdom! Are you ready to turn a humble garden into a bustling, bubbling business? In this cozy management adventure, you’ll step into the paws (or ears!) of a talented alchemist determined to brew the best eliksirs in the land.

Meet Your Furry Founders
Choose your hero! Play as a clever Cat or a spunky Rabbit. While you’re busy in the lab, your partner handles the local Bazaar, stocking up on seeds and essentials. Together, you’ll manage three vibrant locations: the bustling Bazaar, the tranquil Farmlands, and your high-tech Alchemy Laboratory.

Are you ready to become the ultimate Alchemist? Grab your apron—it’s time to get brewing!

Features to Enchant You:
- 50 Levels of Progression: Watch your empire grow from a small shed to a massive production line.
- Cozy Vibes: Start your day at your own pace. Prep your shop in the morning sun before the doors open and the rush begins.
- Deep Customization: Choose which upgrades to prioritize to fit your playstyle.
- Endless Fun: Even after hitting level 50, the challenge continues as orders get more complex and your factory reaches peak efficiency.

70010000126249.name: Alien Cat Story
70010000126249.intro:
Resolve puzzle
Repair spaceship
Precise movement
70010000126249.description:
Get ready for an amazing adventure on an alien planet, full of dangers, puzzles and unexpected allies. Only you can help the cat fix his ship and leave this dangerous world.

The main character is a cat, a pilot of a small flying ship. After an accident, he finds himself on an unknown planet, where his goal is to collect fuses to fix the ship and return home.
On the way, the cat encounters various enemies, difficult levels and puzzles, as well as allies. The game is in the style of a 2D platformer, where the hero moves through the levels, jumps, fights enemies and collects the necessary items to repair the ship. The controls are simple and intuitive, which makes the game accessible to both beginners and experienced players.
Top-view puzzles: In some levels, the view switches to "from above", and you must solve puzzles to open access to the next stage.
Ship Repair Between levels, the hero returns to his ship, where he uses the collected diodes to repair it. With each new diode, the cat gets one step closer to fixing the ship and returning home.
Conclusion Get ready for an amazing adventure on an alien planet, full of dangers, puzzles and unexpected allies. Only you can help the cat fix his ship and leave this dangerous world.

70010000126256.name: Anime Uni 3D: Hot Vacay
70010000126256.intro: Relax with tropical puzzles and colorful heroines!
70010000126256.description:
In our game, you’ll enjoy simple and engaging puzzles set to relaxing music. 
Unwind and enjoy assembling vibrant images inspired by a tropical resort getaway. 
Surfer girls, party lovers, mermaids, and many other heroines are waiting for you!

70010000126307.name: Twofold: First Snow
70010000126307.intro: A warm-hearted prequel from the cold of winter.
70010000126307.description:
Having moved away from her friends and family to attend community college, Allison Merlo is a fresh student struggling with the day to day challenges of life.

Faced not only with living independently for the first time, but also having to get past her nerves to find new friends in an unfamiliar environment, she finds herself falling in with a group of eccentric writers and artists.

As she pushes through this new stage in her life, the art of the cold and enigmatic Eileen Turner takes her attention, setting her on a course she never expected.

Twofold: First Snow is a prequel spinoff of the visual novel Twofold, focused on Allison and Eileen's first months in community college in the leadup to Christmas, and the many varied people who surround them.

70010000126330.name: Half Billion: Love Choice
70010000126330.intro:
