Half a billion in hand—the heir simulator begins now.
Six love stories—are they true hearts or just a bet?
In this duel of wealth and love, you call the shots.
70010000126330.description:
Half Billion: Love Choice is a surreal simulation management interactive video work. Inspired by real-world prices and events, it transforms authentic entrepreneurial investment into a simple yet engaging simulation experience. Among countless investment opportunities, how will you make the wisest decisions? As the protagonist, you will embark on a entrepreneurial journey with a starting capital of 500 million. In this adventure revolving around money and love, six beautiful women—each with their own goals, identities, and personalities—will join your career. When emotions and business intertwine, how will you balance your relationships with them? And how will you choose when you're busy building your empire?

Key Features

Dual Main Storylines: Career & Love, Authentic Entrepreneurial Experience
Players begin with 500 million in startup capital and explore two parallel paths—entrepreneurship and romance. Your investment decisions generate different wealth outcomes, which in turn affect the emotional endings with the heroines. Note: The business world is treacherous; carefully discern whether they truly love you or just your fortune.

Top-Tier Internet Celebrities & Acclaimed Actors Join Forces for a High-Quality Entrepreneurial Thrill Ride
Starring powerhouse actors such as Mei Baolai, Wen Xin, Chen Siche, Li Xin'ai, and Liu Mengru, alongside popular online personalities including Hua Suihua, DJ Jiang Xiaobai, Milk Princess Xiaozhang, It's Still You, Jenny Jenny, Liu Yilin, Xiaoyueyue, Banban Sauce, Swan, and Car Model Potato Strings. They portray a dazzling array of characters—some alluring, some gentle, some innocent, some willful, others fiery and seductive, or noble and aloof—accompanying you on your entrepreneurial path. Spending money not only unlocks exclusive storylines with them but can even... sign them as streamers under your company to work for you.

Over 100 Story Branches, Unexpected Hidden Plots & Easter Eggs
More than a hundred narrative branches and numerous hidden plotlines and Easter eggs await exploration. Both "wealth" and "emotional intelligence" matter—only by accumulating fortune through sound investment decisions can you better collect achievements and uncover their secrets. Note: Draw on your real-world knowledge and make choices true to your heart—they may bring unexpected rewards.

"Get Rich" or "Fall in Love"? An Ultra-Realistic Rich Second-Generation Entrepreneur Simulator
As your wealth and career evolve, the game gradually reveals the actors' nuanced portrayals of each character's inner journey at different stages. Changes in the heroines' attitudes and demands toward the male lead influence your romantic experience. Faced with the temptations of six strikingly different beauties, what choices will you make?

70010000126336.name: Neko Odyssey
70010000126336.intro: A Game for Cat Lovers You Can't Miss!
70010000126336.description:
Neko Odyssey: A Game for Cat Lovers You Can't Miss!

Here’s a slightly unusual Casual Adventure game where the main gameplay centers around taking pictures of cats. The pixel art graphics in a 3D setting create a charming atmosphere reminiscent of Japanese animation.

In the game, you'll have to search for cats in various locations throughout the town and take pictures to upload to social media (in game). Each photo you upload will earn likes from netizens. As you receive more likes, you'll become better known, and your followers may offer tips on finding new and different cat poses.

During the cat photography sessions, some cats may require you to establish a connection with them before allowing you to photograph them. You'll also encounter certain events that will lead you to discover new photo opportunities.

Apart from taking cat photos and sharing them on social media, the game features a main storyline where you'll unravel the mysteries of the town based on the information you capture in your cat photos. You'll experience excitement, cuteness, and inspiration along with the adventure in this game.

70010000126342.name: Spot the Impossible with Common Sense!
70010000126342.intro:
Something in this era doesn't belong.
Trust your common sense and spot it.
70010000126342.description:
These old scenes look normal — but one thing is from the wrong century.

Sunglasses in a Dinosaur-Era forest.
A drone above a medieval castle courtyard.
A wireless keyboard in a 1920s café.

Each vintage, sepia-toned illustration hides a single modern object that hadn't been invented yet in that era.
The modern item is drawn in the same sepia tone as the rest, so you can't spot it by color alone — you have to recognize its shape.

This is a simple observation quiz where you tap the modern item that shouldn't exist in that era.
Dinosaur times, Stone Age, Ancient Egypt, Greece, Rome, Vikings, Medieval Europe, Renaissance, Age of Sail, Baroque, Victorian, Wild West, 1920s, 1950s-70s —
17 eras, 100 questions of anachronisms hidden in time.

How to play is simple.
・Look carefully at the sepia scene
・Tap the modern item that doesn't belong

"Wait, is that a smartphone?" "No way, drones didn't exist in medieval times!"
The thrill of catching objects that slipped through time is addictive.

Hints gently suggest the category and use of the modern item, so you won't get stuck.
History and the present collide in this adult brain-training puzzle.

So — don't let that anachronism slip past you.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000126354.name: Vikings Pinball
70010000126354.intro: The most unusual pinball you can find!
70010000126354.description: Fun pinball style battles. Attack the military camps of the holy Roman Empire and crush the legionaries. Choose the right trajectories to inflict as much damage as possible.  Shoot down enemies, blow up barrels and collect coins. Free the map from these lazybones!

70010000126357.name: Big Adventure: Trip To Europe 11 Collector's Edition
70010000126357.intro: Pack your bags! Start your journey today, no luggage or visa required!
70010000126357.description:
With stunning graphics, a modernized interface, new object search modes, and more content than ever, it’s the ultimate European adventure, no passport required!

Discover iconic landmarks, hidden corners, and the unique charm of Europe, all from the comfort of your home.

Game features:
- 30 unique locations – Explore scenic cities, natural wonders, and cultural landmarks across Europe. Each level is a beautifully illustrated masterpiece full of hidden objects.
- New search features – Enjoy enhanced gameplay with new object types and interactive mechanics that keep the experience fresh and engaging.
- Redesigned interface – A clean, user friendly UI makes navigation and play smoother and more enjoyable.
- Mini-Games and puzzles – Take on a variety of logic, memory, and observation challenges between hidden object levels.
- Souvenir collection – Collect meaningful items that reflect the spirit and culture of every country you visit.

Collector’s Edition Includes:
- 13 Bonus Locations – Unlock even more colorful scenes and hidden object challenges.
- 7 Extra Mini-Games + 12 Bonus Puzzles – Nearly 20 additional brain-teasing challenges for true hidden object fans.
- Expanded Souvenir Collection – Discover even more collectibles as you explore Europe in depth.

70010000126390.name: Traffic Survivor
70010000126390.description: Traffic Survivor is a fast-paced endless runner where every second on the highway can be your last. Sprint through dense traffic, dodge trucks and cars, avoid roadblocks, and react instantly to an ever-changing stream of hazards. Master running, jumping, sliding, and boosting as the road grows faster, tougher, and more chaotic. How long can you survive?

70010000126396.name: Asphalt Dominion
70010000126396.description: Asphalt Dominion is a thrilling arcade racing game where speed is everything and every race is a fight for control. Step into a world of exotic supercars, high-stakes competition, and visually striking tracks that take you through breathtaking environments filled with sharp turns, long straights, and intense rival action. From sunlit circuits to dramatic seasonal landscapes, every location is built to deliver fast, aggressive, and unforgettable racing.

70010000126409.name: MonStars: Karaoke Party
70010000126409.intro: Turn up the fun with a musical adventure the whole family will love!
70010000126409.description:
Unleash your little ones’ musical talent with Monstar Karaoke Party, the perfect educational karaoke game for the entire family!
Join five mischievous and lovable little monsters on a musical adventure where they’ll learn to overcome their fears, explore the world and discover the importance of teamwork.
Sing, laugh and learn along with the catchiest songs ever!

Meet your new singing buddies!

• Family fun: A friendly, safe and perfect game mode for enjoying a fun afternoon together in the living room watching TV.

• Education and values: Every song shares valuable life lessons about respecting nature, personal growth and perseverance.

• Fully accessible: Text and songs adapted for beginning readers.

• Visually spectacular: Dynamic, colorful music videos packed with animations kids will absolutely love.

70010000126411.name: Grizzy and the Lemmings - Crazy Party
70010000126411.intro: Turn your living room into a chaotic playground! 50 mini-games, 1-4 players, one goal: grab the Yummy before your friends!
70010000126411.description:
Grizzy just wanted a little peace and quiet... but the Lemmings had other plans! Take control of these unstoppable little troublemakers and turn your living room into a total madhouse: unpredictable mini-games, boards full of surprises, and dirty tricks between friends, every round can flip in seconds. One goal: grab as much Yummy as you can before everyone else, and drive Grizzy up the wall.

50 Wild Mini-Games
Precision, speed, reflexes, memory, observation, or pure survival instinct: every challenge is varied, absurd, and full of twists. A race can come down to the very last second, and a friend can always steal your win at the worst possible moment.

6 Game Modes for Every Mood
A quick round, a full game night, a duel between die-hards, or pure button-mashing mayhem, there's always a reason for one more game.

5 Boards Inspired by the Series
From the Ranger's Cabin to the Yummy factory and the mountain trail, plus 2 secret boards to unlock, each one has its own setting, pace, and surprises.

On the Couch, Up to 4 Players
A 100% local experience, in the same room, built for game nights with friends and family alike. Instantly fun, easy to pick up, and playable with up to 4 players on a single screen, one controller each.

Unlock, Collect, Replay
With the rewards machine, unlock 40 Lemmings and complete your collection of 150 stickers as you play.

Key Features
- Family party game for 1-4 players, local
- 50 mini-games, 6 game modes, 5 boards
- 40 Lemmings to unlock, 150 stickers to collect
- 100% faithful to the Grizzy and the Lemmings animated series
- Chaos, dirty tricks, and big laughs, for everyone

Everything's ready: pick your Lemming, keep an eye on your friends, and never leave a jar of Yummy unattended.

70010000126452.name: Fish In
70010000126452.intro: Cast your line across stunning worlds. Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear, and build the ultimate collection. Your fishing adventure awaits!
70010000126452.description:
Welcome to Fish In — a relaxing yet addictive fishing adventure built for everyone who loves the thrill of a perfect catch.

Explore beautifully crafted worlds, each brimming with unique fish, hidden secrets, and breathtaking scenery. From tranquil forest ponds to mysterious deep-sea trenches, every location offers new species to discover and new challenges to master.

Cast your line and feel the excitement as rare and legendary fish tug at your rod. Build a massive collection of beautifully designed fish — each one hand-crafted with vibrant colors and charming detail. Track your progress, unlock new species, and chase the rarest catches in the game.

Upgrade your fishing gear to reach deeper waters and distant shores. Better rods, stronger lines, and specialized lures open up a world of possibilities. Trade with other anglers, sell your prized catches, and invest in the equipment you need to become the ultimate angler.

With charming character designs, gorgeous environments, and dozens of unique fish to collect, Fish In is a fishing experience unlike any other. Whether you have five minutes or five hours, every session rewards you with something new.

Pick up your rod. The water is calling.

70010000126476.name: Blast'N Bounty
70010000126476.intro: Engage in retro vertical scrolling shoot’em up mayhem as Quad the frog bounty hunter!
70010000126476.description:
Betrayed by his first mate, former gangster Quad returns years later as a space bounty hunter, setting his sights on the mafia’s 7 generals so he can finally exact his revenge against their now infamous leader! Blast’N Bounty is a vertical scrolling shoot’em up presented in a mix of retro pixel art and low poly 3D.

Inspired by genre classics, Blast’N Bounty offers modernized widescreen visuals, slick animations and intuitive controls that are easy to pick up but require a deft hand to really push Quad’s limits. Secure upgrade flasks to increase ship defenses and  acquire a variety of drones, each with unique behavior that works in tandem with your main shot. Master 8 challenging levels! Blast through the 7 generals’ stages in any order before the final showdown!

• Blast off for vertical scrolling shoot’em up action!
• Enjoy retro pixel art and low poly 3D in modernized widescreen style.
• Grab upgrade flasks to power up your ship!
• Acquire various drone types and choose the ones that work best with your playstyle.
• Take down the mafia’s 7 generals and get revenge on those who betrayed you!

70010000126492.name: Shark Simulator: Ocean RPG Survival
70010000126492.intro: Will your shark become an unstoppable hunter?
70010000126492.description:
Dive into the ruthless world beneath the waves in Shark Simulator: Ocean RPG Survival. In the endless blue of the ocean, only the strongest predator survives. Begin your journey as a hungry hunter and carve your path through a living underwater world filled with danger, prey, and powerful rivals. Every hunt makes you stronger, every battle pushes you closer to the top of the food chain. The ocean is vast, beautiful, and unforgiving — and it’s time to prove that you are its true ruler.

Key Features:
• Explore a Living Ocean – Swim through vibrant coral reefs, mysterious underwater caves, sunlit lagoons, and dark abyssal depths filled with life and hidden dangers.
• Hunt to Survive – Track down fish, sea creatures, and rival sharks while fighting for food and territory in intense underwater encounters.
• Evolve Your Predator – Upgrade your shark’s speed, bite power, and endurance to become faster, stronger, and deadlier with every evolution.
• Multiple Shark Species – Play as different types of sharks, each offering a unique style of hunting and survival.
• Rise to the Top of the Food Chain – Grow from a lone hunter into the ultimate ocean predator feared by everything beneath the waves.
• Easy and Intuitive Controls – Swim, strike, and tear through prey with fluid controls designed for smooth underwater action.

The ocean is a battlefield where only the strongest endure. Hunt, evolve, and dominate the deep as you become a legend of the seas in Shark Simulator: Ocean RPG Survival.

70010000126500.name: Hoversteppers
70010000126500.description: Hoversteppers is a freestyle hoverboard skating game. Flip, spin, and test your boarding skills with timed challenges across multiple stages.

70010000126503.name: Ink Splash
70010000126503.description:
Ink Splash is a 2D action game.
Ride your skateboard and cover the ground with ink while creating graffiti on walls.
In Time Battle mode, the player with the higher score wins.
As you progress through stages, new tricks will be unlocked. Use a variety of moves to win graffiti battles.

70010000126511.name: Do You even Forklift?
70010000126511.intro: Silly physics-based forklift game inspired by Japanese car culture!
70010000126511.description:
Silly physics-based forklift game inspired by Ghibli and Japanese car culture! Use your forklift skills in logic puzzles with many unexpected outcomes!

When all you have is a Forklift, everything looks like a palette.
Take a flight to Ghibli stylized JAPAN!
Let your forklift loose on a peaceful prefecture.

- Travel through the whole island and solve more than 30 puzzles to learn your story.
- Some truck takes your parking place? No problem, you can forklift them!
- Place Kei Cars in the right parking spots,
- They can have alarms,
- And might be Wired,
- Be smart about parking gates,
- Use illegal moves when no one sees,
- But sometimes you can help others.

Maybe they will show you how to cook Ramen? Of course, using a forklift!

Featuring:
- An elegant forklift straight from Japan (that's you)
- A lot of kei cars to stick on the fork,
- A dedicated beep button (!!!)

70010000126542.name: Bubble Shooter Piratery
70010000126542.intro: Pop your way to pirate glory.
70010000126542.description:
The classic bubble shooter gets a pirate makeover! Pop, chain and clear your way through 60 coloUrful levels of pure puzzle fun set across the high seas.

Take on 30 progressively challenging beginner levels to find your aim, then tackle 30 demanding stages that will put your strategy and reflexes to the true test. Every level brings new bubble formations, tricky layouts and fresh obstacles to keep you hooked from start to finish.

Collect power-ups, trigger chain reactions and hunt for hidden bonuses to boost your score. Earn up to 3 stars on every level and chase the perfect run for the most dedicated players.

Simple to pick up, endlessly replayable — the ideal arcade puzzle for players of all ages.

Features
- 60 levels across 2 chapters — 30 Easy, 30 Hard
- Collectible power-ups and special bubbles
- Hidden bonuses and up to 3 stars per level
- Chain reaction combos for massive score multipliers
- Classic bubble shooter mechanics with a pirate theme
- Suitable for all ages and skill levels

70010000126548.name: Color Attack!
70010000126548.description:
A fast-paced arcade experience focused on precision and timing, this game challenges players to defend a central core using rotating color-coded shields. Projectiles arrive from all directions, and success depends on quickly aligning the correct color while multiple shield layers spin at different speeds, often in opposite directions.

Each round builds to a final phase where a neutral projectile must be guided through the rotating defenses. Players create a precise opening, shifting from reactive play to careful control and spatial awareness.

With minimalist neon visuals and smooth, responsive animations, the experience is easy to pick up yet difficult to master. A structured set of levels and an endless mode introduce increasing speed, complexity, and patterns, encouraging players to improve, adapt, and chase higher scores through skill and focus.

70010000126563.name: Planetfall Conquerors
70010000126563.intro: Customize your spaceship and set off on a fast-paced galactic adventure. Race through unique planets, blast enemies, dodge dangerous mines, and outmaneuver rivals.
70010000126563.description:
Build your ultimate spaceship and dive into a thrilling arcade-style space adventure. Customize every part of your ship—from body and wings to engine and weapons—then launch into fast-paced battles across the galaxy. Speed through dense asteroid fields, unleash powerful rockets, and take down enemy ships while skillfully avoiding deadly mines and hazards.

Explore two distinct planets, each offering unique environments and challenges, from vast open space to dangerous planetary surfaces. Stay sharp as rival pilots try to outgun and outmaneuver you in intense combat encounters. With responsive controls, upgradeable abilities, and nonstop action, every mission pushes your reflexes and strategy to the limit.

Outfly, outfight, and outlast your enemies to conquer the galaxy and prove you’re the ultimate pilot.

70010000126594.name: Soccer Kick-ups
70010000126594.intro: Take on the challenge and become the king of kick-ups.
70010000126594.description:
Put your skill and precision to the test in Soccer Kick-ups. 

Tap at just the right moment to pull off the perfect kick-up! Control and guide the ball with your head, shoulders, knees and feet across multiple game modes.
Training Mode: Complete every event, improve your skills and become a pro.
Challenge Mode: Includes 3 modes: Combo, Step by Step, and Rugby. 

Post your score to the leaderboard, challenge your friends and aim to become number 1 in the world.

Features:
-Simple 4-button controls.
-Kick the ball and guide it wherever you want.
-Online leaderboards.
-A varied soundtrack for every game mode.

70010000126608.name: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway
70010000126608.intro: Sneak into a famous vlogger's house, uncover his secrets, solve puzzles, and escape before he finds you.
70010000126608.description:
Discover the truth hidden behind a famous vlogger's online fame. What begins as curiosity quickly turns into a nightmare when the doors lock behind you and escape becomes your only goal.

Explore dark rooms, search for useful items, unlock new areas, and solve escape-room style puzzles. Hidden passages, secret compartments, strange mechanisms, and mysterious clues reveal the story of the house and its owner.

Stay out of sight and avoid the vlogger at all costs. He reacts to noise, patrols the house, and can appear when you least expect it. Hide, move carefully, and use your surroundings to survive.

Experience a mix of exploration, stealth, puzzles, and tense chase sequences. Every item may help you solve a challenge or open a path forward.

Features:

• Survival horror with stealth gameplay
• Escape-room inspired puzzles and challenges
• Explore a mysterious house filled with secrets
• Search for items and unlock new areas
• Hide from a dangerous and unpredictable pursuer
• Atmospheric horror with touches of humor and satire
• Story-driven adventure with unusual characters
• Multiple ways to approach survival and escape

Can you uncover the vlogger's secrets and find a way out?

70010000126614.name: The Merlies
70010000126614.intro: Meet the Merlies, adorable little birds scattered by the wind. Gather them together and recycle the trash to make a cozy nest.
70010000126614.description:
A Wholesomevania game

The Merlies, a community of tiny birds, got scattered across the land by a huge storm! Explore a colorful charming 2D universe and unlock new hidden passages as your Merlies squad grows and learns new skills, in a metroidvania-like gameplay. Use each Merlies’ specific abilities during your exploration in this poetic adventure game. 

While being beautiful, the world of The Merlies isn’t the most welcoming one. Your Merlies remain fragile little fellows exposed to the dangers of Nature. No creature or fight will be on your way but every thorn, every rock, every tree becomes an obstacle to overcome. Sometimes, the path will be hard to find, hidden in this wild and bucolic maze. And be careful not to lose one of your Merlies on the way!

Throughout your exploration, you’ll encounter remains of a long gone civilization. Lucky you! For one man’s junk is a Merlies’ treasure! Collect scraps to create and decorate your village, accommodate your Merlies and train them to get ready for exploration!

A great adventure in a small universe

Visually inspired by graphic novels and children’s image books, The Merlies is a bright and cozy tale. Befriend cute expressive birds and go out with your new friends to discover the many biomes and uncover their passageways and secrets.

Climb electric cables and fallen billboards, send your Merlies up in the sky by jumping on mushrooms or explore empty pipes. For your small Merlies, everyday objects take on gigantic proportions and get a new purpose for your community: make a cozy house out of a lamp, a huge map out of a slate or a store room out of an ice cube tray!
But their little size isn’t going to stop their adventurous and creative minds to create a new and better community for their kind.

A tale of resilience

Human civilization is gone and Nature is healing. Discover a calm and comforting adventure and help your community grow through recycling and upcycling human junk. Wacky constructions and clever upcycling are the key to bringing comfort and happiness to your tribe. The Merlies’ way of life is to do a lot, with a little.

The Merlies is a Solarpunk game: post-apocalyptic, sure, but not like you would expect. It’s a bright tale promoting a hopeful future, where your Merlies are brought together by cooperation and solidarity. Community spirit and a clever (re)use of scraps are key features that take the game far from dystopic Cyberpunk often associated with post-apocalypse. 

Features

An exploration-based poetic adventure
A “wholesomevania” gameplay: explore a 2D map at your own pace 
Exploit the many abilities of a squad of Merlies
Stunning and refined visuals with hand-made drawings
A solarpunk optimistic take on post-apocalypse games

Based on an idea by Cosmografik, creator of Type:Rider and Vandals.

70010000126626.name: Blood Dungeon
70010000126626.intro: These dungeons are full of monsters. The blood is there. Take it!
70010000126626.description:
From the creators of Nidhogg comes a game about 2D platforming survival. You'll have to parkour your way around treacherous dungeons to kite monsters while gathering blood and powerups. 

Survive a run, take the bones you’ve earned to the Bone Shop, and get stronger. 

Complete quests to unlock upgrades, arenas, skins, and more.

Features:
- 9 unlockable playable characters with different traits and weapons
- 6 unlockable unique survival arenas
- Over 100 enemy types
- Over 100 quests to complete
- Over 100 unlockable weapons and upgrades
- Dynamic “dungeon dnb” soundtrack by Thomas Hooey

70010000126632.name: Bike Food Delivery Simulator
70010000126632.intro: Pick up orders, ride through the city, and become the ultimate bike courier.
70010000126632.description:
Every delivery counts!

Jump on your bike and experience the life of a city courier in a vibrant open-world delivery adventure. Pick up food, drinks, and packages from local businesses and race through busy streets to deliver orders on time while building your reputation as the city's most trusted rider.

Explore a large city filled with unique districts, from bustling residential neighborhoods and lively parks to industrial zones packed with shortcuts and hidden routes. Watch the city come alive through a dynamic day-and-night cycle and changing weather conditions that make every delivery feel different.

Manage your stamina during long rides and collect energy sodas scattered throughout the city to keep moving when the pressure is on. Earn money from successful deliveries and unlock up to 12 unique bicycles, each offering its own riding style, speed, handling, and performance.

Looking for extra challenges? Practice wheelies and show off your bike-handling skills while exploring every corner of the city.

Whether you prefer relaxing rides through the streets or racing against the clock to complete deliveries, Bike Food Delivery Simulator offers a fun and rewarding courier experience for players of all ages.

Features
Explore a large open-world city
Deliver food, drinks, and packages across multiple districts
Dynamic day-and-night cycle and weather system
City traffic that creates new challenges for every route
Unlock and ride 12 unique bicycles
Earn money and expand your delivery career
Stamina system with collectible energy boosts
Perform wheelies and improve your riding skills
Discover residential areas, parks, industrial zones, and hidden shortcuts
Relaxing and accessible simulation gameplay

Grab your bike, hit the streets, and become the ultimate city delivery rider!

70010000126656.name: Road to Jonin ! The 3-Choice Ninja Quiz
70010000126656.intro:
Train your ninja knowledge and rise to elite rank!
A quick 3-choice quiz challenge!
70010000126656.description:
Test your knowledge of ninja lore in simple multiple-choice quizzes!

From ninja tools and stealth techniques to training, missions, and history, each question lets you explore the fascinating world of ninja.

The rules are easy:
Read the question, choose one of three answers, and aim for the correct choice!

Perfect for quick brain training, casual play, or quiz battles with family and friends.
Keep answering questions and see if you have what it takes to become an elite ninja!

70010000126672.name: Rapunzel & Thumbelina: The Tiny Adventure
70010000126672.intro: A world of magic and adventure is waiting to be discovered.
70010000126672.description:
Rapunzel, newly freed from her tower, and tiny Thumbelina set out on a journey across a breathtaking and unfamiliar wilderness. As they travel through dense forests, rushing rivers, mountains, and caves, Rapunzel gradually overcomes her fear of the outside world and realizes that enclosed spaces do not always have to be prisons. After meeting new people and resting in a valley filled with giant flowers, they both discover that “home” is not a single place, but the collection of bonds and unforgettable moments shared along the journey, leaving them ready to bravely explore a world full of wonders.

• Pro Karaoke Mode: Features a dedicated, kid friendly singing experience so children can perform their favorite songs right away.

• Cinematic Visuals: Crafted with “Cinematic Grade Art”, delivering premium animations that transform the game into an immersive interactive movie.

• 100% Child Safe: A secure, closed experience for Nintendo Switch™, with no ads, no microtransactions, and no hidden fees.

An interactive fairytale experience. A perfect linear narrative adventure for young readers to enjoy a captivating story at their own pace.

70010000126674.name: Clay&Cats
70010000126674.intro: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!
70010000126674.description:
Give yourself over to the ultimate relaxation! Clay&Cats will make you feel good in a way you didn't know you needed. 

Your task is simple - assemble adorable, cat-themed pottery to its full glory. Put back together pawesome vases, purrfect plates, and kittiful bowls. Don't worry about the timers and sweating to pass the challenge - take all the time getting the pieces together and enjoy the satisfying way they click into the right places. Can't get cozier than that! 

KEY FEATURES: 
- 9 categories with 14 levels of pure joy in each 
- Lo-fi music providing good vibes for the hours of playing
- Satisfying gameplay that soothes your nervous system
- Tons of adorable, furry troublemakers to admire

70010000126685.name: Traumatarium: Penitent
70010000126685.intro: The Traumatarium saga continues in a dungeon crawler where sprawling maps, merciless foes, and starvation itself test your every move!
70010000126685.description:
The world of Traumatarium returns!

Decades after the great evil was finally sealed away, a new mysterious group has been sowing chaos in the shadows. And now, in their most brazen move yet, they have taken over the castle, vying for control of the land.
In response, the Order has sent one of their bravest and deadliest warriors to quell the uprising and bring swift penance to the impure.

Traumatarium is a dungeon crawler for the classic handheld console. Large maps build the world before you, as enemies try to stop you in your tracks. But hunger may get to you before they do if you're not careful, make sure to keep your health up!

A nostalgic experience that can also be played in vertical mode with touch controls to better match the '90s feeling! Play with classic green color mode or choose among multiple color palettes!

70010000126699.name: Fischfutter
70010000126699.description:
Help Flupp the fish to escape! Dive at the right time to float through the water. Avoid rocks and 
jellyfish, they slow you down. Collect stars and diamonds to get faster and swim away from the 
monster fish.

70010000126710.name: Unrailed 2: Back on Track – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000126710.intro: Unrailed is back on track with more co-op railroad construction chaos than ever!
70010000126710.description:
Unrailed 2: Back on Track brings chaotic local and online multiplayer track-building action to the next level – band together with friends to collaborate and build your track across new procedurally generated worlds - WHILST the train is running! So think fast, with more freedom than ever before, and conquer new obstacles in your way - before your trains becomes… a trainwreck! 

CHOOSE YOUR TRACK 
Now featuring a story spread across new environments, on branching paths for you to choose, so no two runs will feel the same. In these biomes you’ll now be able encounter new points of interests, side quests, daunting bosses and as well as other random encounters, so adapt quickly on your feet! New unlockable cosmetics also let you add your personal touch to your characters’ story. 

YOUR JOURNEY GETS BETTER AND BETTER 
Every excursion your crew undertakes feels increasingly meaningful, with new rewards and permanent upgrades granting you character with gameplay-modifying abilities, as well as new train engines, wagons and extensions to unlock, giving you the tools to build a multitude of train configurations to play and experiment with. Each locomotive loss is an opportunity to rebuild and get… back on track! 

CREATE, SHARE AND PLAY WITH THE COMMUNITY 
The all-new Terrain Conductor mode allows you unleash your imagination to create your very own custom maps and share these with the Unrailed community – with highlights being featured by the developers. Or if creating isn’t your thing, browse the limitless creations other players have built, so the frantic fun never ends! 

CO-OPERATE TO COMPETE 
Fulfill your burning competitive urge – manically duke it out in against another team in the new 8-player Vs Mode. Test your team’s prowess in online leaderboards with action replays and see who can achieve the highest scores.

70010000126729.name: Dragon of Illusion
70010000126729.intro: The fearsome Dragon of Illusion has kidnapped the princess and plunged nature into darkness. The Forest Kingdom stands on the brink of collapse, and only you can restore peace!
70010000126729.description:
Face a variety of bosses, find secret keys, unlock powerful abilities, and gain access to areas that were once unreachable.

Overcome challenging stages filled with hidden dangers and wild creatures!

Unlock powerful hidden skills!

Engage in intense battles against dangerous bosses determined to protect their territories!

Survive the dangers lurking across diverse stages, and restore order to the kingdom before everything is consumed by the dragon's power!

70010000126741.name: Handyman Flipper: House Stories
70010000126741.intro: From Broken Rooms to Dream Homes.
70010000126741.description:
Become the neighborhood handyman and transform rundown houses into beautiful homes!
Take on renovation jobs, travel to different locations, and restore homes room by room. Clean up trash, replace damaged flooring, paint walls, install ceiling panels, and furnish interiors to satisfy your clients.
Complete contracts to earn money and invest in better tools and equipment. Upgrade your gear to work faster, take on bigger projects, and become the most trusted handyman in town.
Every house is a new challenge, and every renovation brings you one step closer to building your dream handyman business.

70010000126749.name: Motel Renovator Simulator
70010000126749.description:
In Motel Renovator Simulator, take control of a neglected motel and turn it into a comfortable destination for travelers. Start with dusty, forgotten rooms and gradually restore the entire property, bringing it back to life one renovation at a time.

Clear away clutter, replace old flooring and walls, and give each room a complete makeover. Choose furniture and decorations from a variety of options to create welcoming spaces that guests will enjoy. Your renovation work is also the key to growing the business. Welcome guests, earn money from successful stays, and reinvest your profits into new furniture, materials, tools, and additional rooms. 

Upgrade your equipment to work faster and more efficiently, while experimenting with different designs to give your motel its own unique character.
From a forgotten roadside property to a thriving place for travelers, every improvement brings you closer to creating the motel of your dreams.

70010000126758.name: Back Driver Simulator
70010000126758.intro: Can you stay calm while every second brings a new surprise?
70010000126758.description:
Get ready for a wild ride in Back Driver Simulator, where you’re not behind the wheel—but your decisions still control the chaos. Sit in the back seat of a speeding taxi, direct the driver, and navigate unpredictable roads from a first-person perspective. Every choice matters, and one wrong command can turn a smooth run into total disaster. Fast, absurd, and full of surprises, this is a driving experience unlike any other.

Features:
• Indirect Driving Gameplay: Command the driver instead of steering yourself, creating tense, unpredictable racing scenarios.
• Challenging Routes: Master focus, timing, and nerves across multiple routes and environments.
• Stylized Chaotic World: Navigate vibrant, exaggerated streets filled with hazards, humor, and visual gags.
• First-Person Passenger View: Experience every near-miss, crash, and triumph up close.
• Multiple Maps & Tracks: Fifteen unique tracks across five distinct maps, each with its own challenges.
• Varied Drivers & Vehicles: Interact with different taxi drivers, each with unique personalities, dialogue, and reactions.
• Playful Level Design: Discover hidden easter eggs, clever blockages, and surprises on every road.

Take control from the back seat, survive the madness, and master indirect driving in Back Driver Simulator. It’s a fast-paced, hilarious, and unpredictable journey where every decision can make or break the ride. Are you ready to direct the chaos?

70010000126764.name: Pixel Blaster DX
70010000126764.intro: Tap, shoot, sort, and clear colorful pixel cubes in this fast-paced conveyor belt puzzle game!
70010000126764.description:
Pixel Blaster DX is a fast-paced hybrid-casual color shooter and sorting puzzle game built for quick, satisfying gameplay sessions.
Tap, shoot, match colors, manage the conveyor belt, and clear pixel cube formations before your holders are full.
The rules are simple and easy to learn. Tap the color-coded sphere shooters on the left side of the screen to launch them onto the rotating circular conveyor belt.
Each sphere shoots cubes that match its own color, for example:
• Pink spheres shoot pink cubes
• Cyan spheres shoot cyan cubes
More colors appear as the challenge increases

Your objective is to clear all pixel cubes from the board. Each level features different cube formations, including fun shapes, items, icons, and emoji-style designs. But there is a twist. Every sphere has limited ammo. If a sphere still has remaining ammo after all matching targets are cleared, it drops into one of the waiting holder slots below. If all holder slots become occupied with unused spheres, the game is over. Plan carefully, shoot at the right time, and manage your queue before the board fills up.

Special Bonuses - Use special bonuses to overcome tricky stages:
• Shuffle - Re-shuffles all waiting spheres on the board.
• Holder - Adds one extra holder slot.
• Turtle - Slows down the movement speed of spheres on the conveyor belt.
• Skip - Skips the current level and moves you to the next stage.
• Spin -Drops bonus coins from the spin wheel.

Features
★ Marathon-style gameplay with more then 2000 unique levels
★ Fast-paced color shooter and sorting puzzle mechanics
★ Simple touch controls that are easy to learn
★ Handheld and Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller support
★ Increasing difficulty with strategic challenges
★ Satisfying conveyor belt gameplay
★ Special power-ups and bonuses for difficult stages
★ Hand crafted fun pixel cube formations and colorful level designs
★ Global social leaderboards 
★ Professional sound effects and background music
★ Rumble support

70010000126768.name: Frogborne
70010000126768.intro: A long way from the pond — but home is worth the leap.
70010000126768.description:
Far from home and full of determination, a tiny frog sets off on the adventure of a lifetime. Explore a vibrant, storybook world brimming with secrets — from sun-dappled forests and cobblestone town squares to the towering halls of a grand castle, patrolled by a not-so-friendly giant guard.

Hop, leap, and bounce your way through charming levels as you hunt down three legendary Power Gems, the only things that can carry you back where you belong. Collect hundreds of scattered coins, outwit quirky enemies, and uncover every corner of a lovingly crafted kingdom.

And when the adventure gets a little too adventurous? Hit pause and treat yourself — and your frog — to a well-earned dance break.

70010000126784.name: Kitten Island 2
70010000126784.intro: Enter the ultimate journey across Kitten Island, featuring 3 unique biomes and a hidden secret. Can you do it?
70010000126784.description: Embark on an adventure across Kitten Island, exploring 15 stages in this sequel to the acclaimed Kitten Island. Collect every item and face off against evil creatures. Can you find the secret boss?

70010000126796.name: Aerialia: Wings of Delivery
70010000126796.intro: Take to the skies, deliver with care, and connect a peaceful world one package at a time.
70010000126796.description:
Become a cheerful delivery bird and explore a colorful archipelago filled with charming villages, friendly characters, and countless deliveries waiting to be completed.

Fly freely between beautiful islands, collect letters, parcels, and special cargo, then deliver them safely to homes across the world. Every successful delivery rewards you with coins that can be used to upgrade your equipment and unlock new possibilities.

Customize your delivery cart with stronger wheels that allow you to transport heavier packages, then enhance them with powerful badges that provide unique bonuses such as increased delivery rewards, faster progression, and improved earnings.

Master dynamic delivery challenges by flying through speed boost rings to maintain momentum, improve your routes, and complete deliveries as quickly as possible.

Discover new islands, meet memorable villagers, improve your delivery business, and become the greatest courier the skies have ever known.

Features

• Explore a colorful open world made of beautiful floating islands.
• Deliver letters, parcels, and valuable cargo.
• Upgrade your cart with stronger wheels to carry heavier deliveries.
• Equip special badges that provide unique gameplay bonuses.
• Master boost ring challenges for faster deliveries.
• Earn coins, unlock upgrades, and expand your delivery business.
• Relaxing gameplay with charming cartoon-inspired visuals.
• Easy to learn, satisfying to master.

70010000126802.name: Kero Kero Cowboy
70010000126802.intro: Kero Kero Cowboy is a cartoony western themed retro style platformer!
70010000126802.description:
Explore the frontier as Kero Kero, a cowboy frog on a quest to bring peace and justice to the Wild West. Use your extendable tongue, trusty six-shooter, and wits to conquer the wildest outlaws of the west. Yeehaw!

Face dastardly foes, perilous platforming challenges, and intense shootouts across deserts, mines, mountains, trains, forests, and beyond!

Kero Kero features an array of techniques and abilities to help him on his quest. He can eat enemies, spit them back out, or even brandish a giant revolver to dispatch far-off foes! But be aware, a 6-shooter only has room for 6 bullets, so use them wisely! He can also swim with ease, ride in a giant cowboy boot to stomp enemies, ride rails in a mine cart, and spit hot fire after eating a spicy jalapeño pepper. How to best utilize his abilities in each scenario is up to you, the player!

Features:

- 25 levels of rootin' tootin' retro platforming action!
- 5 intense & challenging boss fights!
- Special collectibles that unlock extra-challenging bonus levels!
- In-game music player to jam out to the Kero Kero Cowboy original soundtrack!
- Diverse environments to explore, including deserts, mines, trains, forests, mountains, and more!

70010000126821.name: Asdivine Knot
70010000126821.intro: Tie the knot of fate in a skybound fantasy RPG!
70010000126821.description:
A young cleric named Verselio once devoted his life to serving the deity Treises—until the truth shattered everything he believed. When the divine is revealed to be a lie, faith turns into fury, and a journey of rebellion begins. Joined by a mysterious maiden, a disciplined vigilante chief, and a self-proclaimed deity, Verselio sets out across a vast fantasy world in search of answers. As their paths intertwine, each carries their own burdens, beliefs, and secrets, in a story of betrayal, redemption, and the meaning of faith in a deityless world.

Asdivine Knot is a classic turn-based JRPG that blends strategic command battles with modern systems and deep customization. Master the shared Nexus Gauge to control the flow of combat, unleash powerful Nexus Skills, and summon devastating entities to turn the tide. Explore a wide world with your fully customizable airship, craft and upgrade equipment using collected materials, and shape your adventure with side quests, crew recruitment, fishing, and puzzle dungeons. Packed with rich content and designed for a complete single-player experience, this is a must-play fantasy RPG for fans of traditional Japanese role-playing games.

70010000126843.name: Paper Airplane Flying Game
70010000126843.intro: A small flight. A big journey.
70010000126843.description:
A simple paper airplane becomes the start of a quiet and meaningful journey.

Lifted by the wind, you guide a fragile creation across a world that feels alive, changing with every new area you reach. What begins as an easy glide slowly turns into a path that asks for attention, control, and a sense of direction.

Movement is smooth and natural, built around momentum and balance. You rise, fall, and adjust your angle to stay in the air, learning how to use the wind instead of fighting against it. Invisible currents carry you forward, while obstacles and narrow passages test your ability to react and stay focused.

Each environment tells its own story through space and atmosphere. Open, warm areas give you freedom to explore and understand the flow of flight, while more complex zones introduce tighter paths, shifting air, and moments where precision becomes essential. The pace evolves naturally, allowing you to grow more confident without breaking the calm rhythm of the experience.

As you progress, your journey becomes longer and more controlled. You begin to reach places that once felt distant, adapting your movement and improving your ability to stay airborne. Every section feels like a step forward — not just in distance, but in understanding how to move with intention.

This is not about speed or competition. It’s about flow, direction, and the feeling of carrying something forward through space and time. A quiet experience where every movement matters, and every flight brings you closer to where you’re meant to arrive.

70010000126907.name: Dead End Escape
70010000126907.intro:
Crisis Point: How Will You Escape?
Solve Puzzles and Change Your Destiny!
70010000126907.description:
What if a ticking time bomb was placed right in front of you?
What if you were surrounded by a raging fire?
What if you were caught in a bank robbery?

This is a puzzle-solving escape game that pulls you out of desperate situations.
Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush and the thrill of becoming an action movie hero, all from the comfort of your room! 
Whether you save the people around you depends entirely on your actions.
Will you break through the crisis and become a true hero, or...?

All the items you need to survive are hidden within the illustrations.
No complicated controls are required!
Just use your intuition and observation skills to find the items, assess the situation, and avert the crisis.
It's a great way to stimulate your brain while having fun.

Packed with a helpful hint system for beginners!
Never worry about getting stuck and giving up.
Even if you're new to puzzles or deduction games, you can experience the exhilarating feeling of solving mysteries without any frustration.

Perfect for a quick solo thrill to kill time, or as an exciting party game to play with friends and family to see who has the best survival instincts!

70010000126913.name: Moonlight Peaks – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000126913.intro: Welcome to your new vampiric life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks!
70010000126913.description:
Experience life as a vampire in a magical town full of werewolves, witches, mermaids, and more! In this heart-warming, supernatural life-sim, you will raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, and befriend – or even romance – the locals. And at the same time, show your skeptical father that a life of compassion is possible – even for the undead.

Settle down in your family’s abandoned homestead and make it your own. Build your farm with magic crops and livestock, customize your cottage with gothic style, and make friends with other creatures of the night. Embrace immortality and unlock ancient abilities, all in the name of a more bountiful harvest. Unravel the mysteries of the seven families that inhabit Moonlight Peaks and bring a bit of light back to this spooky settlement. Just remember to be back in your coffin before the sun comes up!

Key Features
■Uncover a Sweet and Spooky Journey
Customize your perfect vampire persona and build relationships with the people of Moonlight Peaks to learn more about the town’s history. Uncover the secrets of the seven families who dwell there – and maybe even find your “tomb” love from any of the two dozen romanceable characters in the process.

■Build Your Dream Gothic Farmstead
Design your cozy gothic homestead, turning a forgotten farm into the ideal sanctuary. Obtain new tools and develop your property to grow even more enchanted crops and raise magical livestock.

■Harness Magical Powers
Embrace your supernatural lineage! Shapeshift into other forms to explore all the town has to offer, and study witchcraft to learn spells that will help you on the farm or when gathering resources. 

■Delight in Dark Diversions
Beyond the farm, you’ll be able to enjoy fishing, foraging, and potion-crafting, along with activities like embroidering, flower arranging, and more. You can even collect cards for the town’s favorite game, Nokturna, to play against other residents.

70010000126919.name: True or False THE WORLD
70010000126919.intro:
"The Statue of Liberty is barefoot."← True or False!?
Acquire global trivia with a 2-choice quiz!
70010000126919.description:
This is a game where you can quickly learn fun world trivia through simple True/False quizzes.

How to play is easy：
・Read the question carefully.
・Choose whether the answer is True or False.
・If you answer correctly, you can read a detailed explanation.

No complicated controls or text input required!
Just pick one of two choices (True or False), so even if you don't know the answer, you can rely on your intuition and enjoy the game stress-free.

We have a massive variety of questions, covering not only geography and history, but politics and literature too!

・The capital of Finland is Helsinki.
・The convenience store was invented in Japan.
・Plato is the author of ""Apology of Socrates.""

...and much more! 

Packed with trivia and general knowledge you'll want to brag about tomorrow.
A single playthrough only takes a few minutes, making it highly recommended for those looking for a quick brain workout during their commute or before bed.

70010000126925.name: EGGCONSOLE First Queen IV PC-9801
70010000126925.intro: Control two squads at once?! Experience epic strategy on a whole new scale with all-new features like troop recruitment and fatigue mechanics.
70010000126925.description:
Originally released in 1994 by Kure Software, this title is a real-time simulation game that takes the series' formula to the next level.

Following the tradition of its predecessors, players deploy their forces on a tactical map and engage in combat using the signature "Gochachara System," where numerous characters clash in real-time. This entry introduces a new dual-unit combat system, enabling advanced maneuvers like pincer attacks or summoning reinforcements to rescue allies in a pinch.

However, the same rules apply to your opponents—stay alert, as enemy reinforcements may arrive at any moment to turn the tide against you. The game features significant upgrades across both strategy and tactics, including a fatigue system that requires characters to rest to maintain peak performance, and the ability to hire mercenaries in towns.

While there are many characters to recruit, brute force alone will not carry you through. Success relies on meticulous unit composition and strategic march planning. Build your own unique squads and strategies from a diverse cast of characters, and experience the largest scenario and deepest systems in the series' history. This is a must-play for any simulation fan.

70010000126934.name: Mind Detective Psychology Test
70010000126934.intro:
Read the clues, choose the behavior!
A casual psychology quiz for quick play
Discover personalities in everyday actions
70010000126934.description:
Mind Detective Psychology Test is a casual quiz game where you observe everyday behaviors and choose the answer that seems to reveal a person’s personality.

How someone sits, talks, moves, or reacts may give you a hint.
Look carefully at each situation, compare the choices, and make your guess.

The rules are simple:
・Read the question
・Check the four possible answers
・Choose the behavior that fits best
・Enjoy the result as a light psychology test

Each question is short, so it is easy to play during a break, on your own, or while chatting with family and friends.
It is also a good choice for players who enjoy personality quizzes, observation games, brain-training, and simple choice-based puzzles.

No complicated controls are needed.
Just read, observe, choose, and enjoy a quick detective-style psychology test.

Can you read the small clues hidden in everyday behavior?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000126981.name: Max Speed
70010000126981.intro: Race to the finish on wild, winding tracks where every jump is a boost and every rival is a threat.
70010000126981.description:
Max Speed is a high-speed arcade racing game for Nintendo Switch™ where every race is a fight for first place.

Take on AI rivals across winding, hilly tracks where mastering speed is only half the challenge. Use the terrain to your advantage — perform flips, jumps, and aerial tricks to gain nitro boosts and push your car beyond its limits. But be careful: one mistake can cost you the race.

Each track is packed with danger. Dodge obstacles, survive environmental hazards, and watch out for aggressive opponents trying to push you off the road. From prehistoric creatures to deadly track traps, every race is unpredictable and intense.

Choose from 14 unique cars and customize them to match your style. Upgrade your vehicles to improve performance and unlock visual changes that transform your ride. Personalize your car with different colors, wheels, and nitro effects to stand out on the track.

Race across 9 diverse locations and 29 handcrafted tracks, each offering its own challenges and driving conditions. Test your skills in multiple game modes, including Career, Events, Season, Time Trial, and Split-Screen.

Play solo or compete with friends in local multiplayer. With up to 4 players on one console, split-screen mode lets you challenge others and prove who is the fastest racer.

Whether you're chasing the perfect run in Time Trial or battling for first place in chaotic races, Max Speed delivers fast-paced action, skill-based driving, and non-stop adrenaline.

Features:
• Arcade racing focused on speed, physics, and skill
• 14 unique cars with upgrades and visual progression
• Deep customization: colors, wheels, and nitro effects
• 9 locations and 29 unique tracks
• 5 game modes: Career, Events, Season, Time Trial, Split-Screen
• Dynamic tracks with jumps, tricks, and nitro boosting
• Hazard-filled environments with obstacles and creatures
• Local split-screen multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console

The application does not communicate with an independent server.

70010000126987.name: Bench Simulator
70010000126987.intro: You are the bench. You cannot walk. You cannot talk. But you can remember.
70010000126987.description:
Bench Simulator is a narrative simulation game experienced from the perspective of a park bench.

Over the course of many in-game days, different people visit the park, sit on the bench, and leave behind fragments of their lives. Couples, strangers, lonely late-night visitors, frustrated figures, families — all kinds of people with all kinds of emotions pass through this quiet place. You cannot walk, talk, or directly influence them. Yet your subtle reactions can affect what happens around you.

As a bench, you observe conversations, read emotional situations, and respond with delicate reactions — swaying, shifting slightly, creaking, or staying perfectly still. A small movement at the right moment might defuse an argument, create an awkward silence, give someone pause, or change the flow of a conversation.

■ Key Features
- Play a unique narrative simulation as a park bench
- Observe and influence conversations through subtle physical reactions
- Encounter a variety of visitors across multiple in-game days
- Experience touching, humorous, romantic, mysterious, and melancholic stories
- Discover recurring character arcs and different story outcomes
- Explore varied encounters across daytime, evening, and nighttime atmospheres

You are not the hero. You are not the villain. You are the bench.

70010000126997.name: 1964 Operation Velvet Twins
70010000126997.intro: A thrilling 2D spy adventure set in the 1960s.
70010000126997.description:
You play as Secret Agent Mike Rogers, assigned to track down and capture the fugitive terrorists known only as the Velvet Twins. Set in 1960s you’ll fight through unforgettable stages from neon-lit Las Vegas, gritty Chinatown, and abandoned factories, all the way to a shootout in a Wild West village!

He can take down enemies with his bare hands, but when things get serious, he'll grab whatever weapons are available. He can use pistols, swords, baseball bats and even a submachine gun.

1964: Operation Velvet Twins delivers pure retro fun with no filler just tight gameplay, explosive action, and an unmistakable 8-bit flavor.


Features
* Play as Mike Rogers, secret agent !
* Punch your way through waves of enemies!
* Pick up firearms when the mission gets intense!
* Use a variety of mele weapons: swords, bats, crates, and more!
* Defeat 8 eccentric bosses!
* Fight across 7 unique locations!
* Retro visuals and music in authentic 8-bit style!
* Collect dollars to spend them on power-ups or save them to raise your score!

70010000127032.name: PuzzleCore
70010000127032.intro: A fast-paced physics puzzle platformer where you jump, throw, and interact with objects to solve challenges across floating islands and futuristic labs.
70010000127032.description:
A dynamic physics-based puzzle platformer where every movement matters and creativity is key. Players navigate a series of vibrant environments—from floating island landscapes to high-tech laboratory chambers—filled with interactive objects, moving platforms, and hazardous obstacles. Using simple controls like jumping, throwing, and activating mechanisms, you must manipulate the environment to solve increasingly complex challenges.

Momentum and timing play a crucial role as you launch objects, trigger switches, and chain reactions to unlock new paths. Each level introduces new mechanics that test your problem-solving skills and spatial awareness, encouraging experimentation and multiple approaches to success. With a blend of precision platforming and clever physics puzzles, the game offers an engaging experience that rewards both logic and skill.

70010000127038.name: Art of Drift – Cozy Drift Simulator
70010000127038.intro: Feel the drift, not the rush
70010000127038.description:
Drifting isn’t about speed — it’s about control, flow, and style.

Step into a relaxed yet skill-based drifting experience where every corner is an opportunity to build momentum and score. Set across snowy tracks with a clean low-poly aesthetic, the game focuses on smooth driving, precision, and maintaining long, controlled drifts.

Chain together turns, control your angle, and keep your speed to build higher scores. The closer you get to obstacles and the longer you hold your drift, the more rewarding each run becomes. Every mistake breaks your flow, so staying focused is key.

Use handbrake turns to initiate drifts and nitro boosts to maintain speed through long curves. As you progress, unlock new cars with different handling styles and explore new locations designed to challenge your control and creativity behind the wheel.

Key Features:
	•	Drift System: Earn points through angle, speed, and control
	•	Smooth Arcade Handling: Easy to learn, challenging to master
	•	Nitro & Handbrake Mechanics: Extend drifts and maintain flow
	•	Multiple Cars: Unlock vehicles with unique driving feel
	•	Snowy Environments: Clean low-poly tracks with atmospheric design
	•	Progression System: Earn rewards, unlock locations, and improve performance
Art of Drift – Cozy Drift Simulator delivers a satisfying drifting experience where precision, timing, and style define every ride.

70010000127044.name: Monst
70010000127044.intro:
Devour and destroy the world.
Fighting against armed forces with various transformations.
Obtain energy, numerous weapons and abilities.
70010000127044.description:
Players take on the role of an alien monster, devouring and fighting against human armed forces with various transformations, and annihilating the world. By continuously devouring humans to obtain energy, numerous weapons and abilities can be added to combat human armed forces and eliminate the world. When encountering different extraterrestrial crystals, one can acquire different superpowers. And it can have different transformations in different situations, experiencing super destructive power.

This is a Roguelike game where players operate an alien monster to devour humans, obtaining dozens of weapons, shields, and more through the energy gained Buff、 Follow the ball, fire different energy bullets, and merge these bullets for firing. Different follower balls can also attack in different ways.

In the game, there are randomly encountered alien crystals that can acquire different superpowers, providing abilities such as freezing, fire breathing, and protective shields, making the game process more interesting.

In the game, you can also have different transformations and experience super destructive power. If it can transform into a super ape with invincible power, it can directly destroy houses and police cars in the city.

Players can choose different characters to play the game, and multiple maps are set up to confront humans in different environments. And designed a 6-level difficulty level, constantly challenging one's own abilities. The game features nearly a hundred achievements, requiring constant achievement in intense battles.

Players can continuously enhance their abilities, including health, health recovery, damage, attack speed, critical hit rate, etc., through the game's outsider cultivation function.

70010000127050.name: Pool Party Girls: Splash Babes
70010000127050.intro:
The pool's heating up and they're all watching you play.
Nail the minigames, win their attention, unlock exclusive images.
70010000127050.description:
Sun, water, and a group of anime girls cheering you on from the pool's edge. Every point you score, every combo you land, gets their eyes on you a little more. One summer party, zero excuses to stop playing.

Stack, match, and hold the line while they react to every move you make. 

Each girl has her own energy, whether she's screaming "YOU GOT THIS" from the diving board or blushing every time you pull off something impressive.

Think you can unlock every girls before summer ends?


Features:

● MINIGAMES WITH SPARK: Play through different challenges while they cheer, tease, and react to your every move.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Better scores mean more images, more looks, more moments with each girl.

● ANIME CHARACTERS WITH TONS OF PERSONALITY: From the one who never stops cheering to the one who can't hide her surprise, every reaction is part of the experience.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: How the summer closes depends on how well you play.

● HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Push far enough and discover what they've been keeping from you.


Play harder. Score more. Make them wish they'd cheered for someone else.
The pool's waiting.
Jump in!

70010000127058.name: Pool Party Boys: Splash Guys
70010000127058.intro:
Sun's out, the pool's packed, and they're all rooting for you.
Play the minigames, earn their attention and unlock exclusive images!
70010000127058.description:
It's the hottest party of the summer and the guys are watching every move you make. Score big across the minigames and watch the gallery fill up with exclusive images of each character in his full pool party look.

Play hard, react fast, and hold your ground when things get intense. The boys notice everything, whether you're crushing it or just barely hanging on.

Some of them can't stop hyping you up. Others turn red every time you do something unexpected. All of them are worth getting to know better.

How deep into the gallery can you get before the sun goes down?


FEATURES:

● MINIGAMES WITH SPARK: Play through different challenges while they cheer, tease, and react to your every move.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Higher scores open up more images, more looks, more sides of each character.

● ANIME CHARACTERS WITH TONS OF PERSONALITY: From the one who never stops cheering to the one who can't hide his surprise, every reaction is part of the experience.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: The summer ends differently depending on how far you push it.

● HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Score high enough and find out what they've been hiding all along.


Push your score. Make them regret underestimating you.
The pool party's already started.
Get in!

70010000127072.name: Beach Volleyball Boys: Hot Spike
70010000127072.intro:
The roster's stacked. One spot open. Every match could change everything.
Think you can win them over before the season starts?
70010000127072.description:
The summer roster has one spot left, and everyone on the sand is just as determined to take it as you are. Somewhere between the drills and the downtime, it stopped being just about volleyball.

One reads every play before it happens. One stays guarded until you've actually earned a place in his world. Another is warm and easy until the score gets close, then turns sharp and unreadable. And the captain isn't letting anyone in who hasn't proven he's worth the risk.

Say the right thing and something shifts. Say the wrong thing and you're back on the bench. Thirty days until the season opener, and every day you wait is a day someone else gets closer.


Features:

● A ROSTER FULL OF UNFORGETTABLE GUYS: A deep bench, and every player is a completely different reason to fall. None of them easy. All of them worth the effort.

● DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: Every response shifts the relationship. Say the wrong thing and you lose ground. Get it right and something real starts to open up.

● CHARACTER AFFINITY SYSTEM: Build genuine connection through practices, late nights, and moments away from the crowd. The harder the pursuit, the more it means when he finally lets you close.

● EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Unlock beautiful illustrations as each bond deepens. Every guy is hiding a story he's not ready to hand you for free.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your path through the season is yours to shape. Not every route ends in romance, but every one of them is worth playing out.

● 30 DAYS TO MAKE THE TEAM: The season opener is locked in and the countdown has already started. Waste a day, and someone else closes the distance instead of you.


One roster. One summer. Only one spot opens up, and it might cost you more than you think.

Which one are you chasing?

70010000127078.name: Lord of the Click 4
70010000127078.intro:
choose your strategy
improve your allies
defeat enemy castle
70010000127078.description:
Incredible new challenges, amazing graphics and improved mechanics. As a great monarch, you will fight many new and dangerous enemies using your clicker skills. Every click on your screen summons powerful warriors, deals crushing blows to enemies and directs the magic of nature into battle. But be careful — each level will bring even more powerful and treacherous bosses, who will have to be defeated to advance further.

While orcs, goblins and other sinister creatures are getting closer, you will have to improve your castle and develop your army to meet new challenges. For defeating enemies, you will receive coins that can be spent on improving your troops and defensive structures.

Get ready for exciting battles, strategic decisions and unforgettable adventures! The future of the kingdom depends only on your skill and determination. Are you ready to become a real hero and save the world?

70010000127084.name: House Cleaner Simulator
70010000127084.intro: Build your reputation with every perfectly cleaned home.
70010000127084.description:
Step into a calming yet deeply satisfying experience in House Cleaner Simulator, where every mess is a chance to create something beautiful. Take on the role of a professional cleaner and transform cluttered, dirty spaces into spotless, cozy homes. From small apartments to large houses, each job brings new challenges and visible results you can truly enjoy.

Features:
	•	Detailed cleaning mechanics including trash removal, surface scrubbing, floor washing, and object organization.
	•	Variety of jobs with unique conditions and different levels of dirt and complexity.
	•	Wide selection of tools and equipment with upgrade options to improve efficiency.
	•	Progression system with new contracts, larger locations, and more demanding tasks.
	•	Equipment customization and upgrades that enhance speed and cleaning performance.
	•	Client satisfaction system based on precision, completeness, and overall results.
	•	Relaxing gameplay focused on attention to detail and satisfying visual transformations.

Turn chaos into cleanliness and restore every space to perfection. In House Cleaner Simulator, your precision and dedication define your success. Build your reputation, take on bigger challenges, and become the ultimate cleaning professional.

70010000127095.name: Pixel Art Coloring Book 2
70010000127095.intro: Unleash your creativity with Pixel Art Coloring Book 2! Relax, de-stress, and paint your way through hundreds of dazzling designs. Tap, color, and let the magic happen!
70010000127095.description:
Pixel Art Coloring Book 2 is back—bigger, bolder, and more colorful than ever! Get ready to relax, unwind, and create breathtaking pixel masterpieces with just a few taps. Whether you're a fan of anime, cute pets, dazzling mandalas, or holiday magic like Halloween and Xmas, there's a perfect pixel canvas waiting for you.
Lose yourself in a world of color with hundreds of stunning images (as a matter of fact, try thousands) spanning categories like fashion, sports, emojis, unicorns, and retro art. Every pixel tells a story—just tap, color, and watch your artwork come to life!

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT:

-  HUGE COLLECTION – Anime, dogs, flowers, pop art, and more—find your perfect match!
-  MAGIC TOOLS – Use the wand to paint matching pixels or fill entire sections instantly.
-  ZOOM & LONG PRESS – Easily color even the tiniest details.
-  SPECIAL EFFECTS – Add textures and filters for a unique touch.
-  PIXELIZE YOUR PHOTOS – Turn your own pictures into pixel art!
-  COLOR ANYWHERE – No WiFi? No problem! Play offline and color anytime.
-  COLOR SPLASH MODE – Fill matching pixels with a single tap!

From soothing patterns to quirky characters, this is more than just a game—it’s a creative escape! Dive in, tap away, and enjoy these beautiful colors!

70010000127108.name: Pyramid Quest Junior
70010000127108.intro: Exploration and treasure-hunting game inspired by classic platform games
70010000127108.description:
Pyramid Quest Jr.  is an exploration and treasure-hunting game inspired by classic platform games.
The goal is to find the three parts of an artefact and open the gate to the next level while collecting diamonds and coins.

It is primarily designed for children and offers an easier gameplay and a more enjoyable gaming experience with easier opponents and less branching levels.

Traps, obstacles, and enemies from old days make the quest very dangerous and challenging. 3D graphics packed in a nice graphics style, great 2.5D levels and proven gameplay gives you hours of fun.

70010000127110.name: Minesweeper Pro
70010000127110.intro: The classic challenge lives on in a whole new form.
70010000127110.description:
Minesweeper Pro takes the legendary puzzle experience to the next level with advanced difficulty customization, competitive progression, and global leaderboards. Use logic, precision, and strategy to uncover safe tiles, avoid hidden mines, and clear the board faster than ever.

Fine-tune your challenge with fully customizable board settings, from relaxed beginner layouts to intense expert-level minefields built exactly the way you like. Earn experience, increase your player level, and prove your skills against other players on the leaderboard.

With smooth controls, clean visuals, and endlessly replayable gameplay, Minesweeper Pro keeps the timeless formula intact while adding modern competitive features for both casual players and true masters.

Train your brain, beat your best times, and rise through the ranks in the ultimate Minesweeper experience.

70010000127129.name: Killzone Extraction
70010000127129.intro: Strap in for a high-octane rescue operation where every second counts. In this combat experience, you are dropped behind enemy lines with one objective: survive long enough to escape.
70010000127129.description:
Game Features
Intense Combat: Fight your way through hostile territory using precision and speed to eliminate threats before they pin you down.

8 Handcrafted Levels: Navigate through diverse, meticulously designed environments—from urban ruins to fortified jungle outposts.

The Final Push: Fight toward the extraction zone and hold your ground until the rescue helicopter arrives.

Action-Oriented Gameplay: Optimized for quick sessions and relentless momentum.

Lock, load, and reach the chopper. Your mission starts now.

70010000127136.name: Mermaid Catch: Transform Sirens into Anime Girls
70010000127136.intro:
Catch sirens. Transform them. Date them. 
The ocean has no rules anymore.
70010000127136.description:
The ocean was supposed to be dangerous.

Nobody warned you it would be this complicated.

One second you're out on the water minding your business...
The next you're locked in combat with a creature that has terrorized sailors for a thousand years.

You win. You capture her. And then...
She transforms into a stunning anime girl who is now, inexplicably, interested in you.

And yes. You are going on a date with her. An actual date. With a former siren. Who tried to kill you twenty minutes ago.

Every siren you catch reveals a different girl. Every girl has her own personality forged from centuries in the deep: fierce, mysterious, proud, or dangerously sweet. 

Take her out, make the right choices, and watch something impossible start to feel very real. 

Unlock scenes, images, and moments that prove you were never just fishing.

Go deeper. Hunt harder. The stronger the siren, the more unforgettable the girl waiting on the other side.

Your choices decide who falls for you.
The real question is whether you are ready to fall too.


Features:

♥ CAPTURE & TRANSFORM: You beat her in combat. Now she's an anime girl and somehow that's your problem.

♥ LEVEL UP & HUNT HARDER: The strongest sirens don't go down easy. Upgrade your skills, sharpen your gear, and go after the ones that were laughing at you five minutes ago.

♥ TURN-BASED COMBAT: Strategy, timing, and the audacity to think you can handle what comes next.

♥ ROMANCE & VISUAL NOVEL CHOICES: She's not easy to impress. Every date, every word, every decision counts.

♥ CHARACTER COLLECTION: Each girl is shaped by what she was. Ancient, wild, powerful... and now yours to figure out.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: What you unlock depends entirely on how far you're willing to go.


Strange. Addictive. Surprisingly romantic.
Are you ready to find out what the ocean has been hiding?

70010000127142.name: Hamstory
70010000127142.intro: Where heartfelt moments meet thrilling challenges
70010000127142.description:
Hamstory is a heartfelt 2D pixel platformer where every fall is part of the journey forward.

Join Hamcho on a touching adventure to reach Haessi Star. Along the way, you will leap across challenging paths, sometimes miss your jump, and try again. Each attempt helps you grow stronger, teaching you how to go a little further than before. The way forward is not always clear, but with patience and a bit of courage, you will find your own path.

As you travel, you will meet kind animal friends who share their stories and cheer you on. By helping them, you can learn new techniques and discover small moments that make the journey feel meaningful. Even when things do not go as planned, you are never alone.

The world of Hamstory is brought to life with carefully crafted pixel art and gentle animations. Changing seasons shape the atmosphere as you progress, making each step of the adventure feel fresh and alive.

Keep leaping, keep trying, and create your own story as you make your way toward Haessi Star.

70010000127148.name: Mermaid Catch: Transform Sirens into Anime Boys
70010000127148.intro:
Catch sirens. Transform them. Date them. 
The ocean has no rules anymore.
70010000127148.description:
