The ocean was supposed to be dangerous.

Nobody warned you it would be this complicated.

One second you're out on the water minding your business...
The next you're locked in combat with a creature that has ruled the deep since before anyone alive can remember.

You win. You capture him. And then...
He transforms into a stunning anime boy who is, against all logic, now part of your life.

And yes. You are going on a date with him. An actual date. With a former siren. Who was trying to destroy you twenty minutes ago.

Every siren you catch reveals a different guy. Every guy carries a personality built from centuries beneath the surface: intense, guarded, chaotic, or quietly impossible to ignore. 

Take him out, make the right choices, and watch something that should not exist start to feel like the most natural thing in the world. 

Unlock scenes, images, and moments that prove this was never just a fishing trip.

Go deeper. Hunt harder. The stronger the siren, the more unforgettable the story waiting on the other side.

Your choices decide who lets you in.
The real question is whether you are ready for what that means.


Features:

● CAPTURE & TRANSFORM: You won the fight. Now he's an anime boy and neither of you saw this coming.

● LEVEL UP & HUNT HARDER: The rarest sirens are the most dangerous ones. Get stronger, upgrade your arsenal, and prove you deserve to even be in the same water as them.

● TURN-BASED COMBAT: These creatures ruled the deep for centuries. They don't go down without a fight.

● ROMANCE & VISUAL NOVEL CHOICES: He remembers what you did to catch him. Make the next moves count.

70010000127154.intro:

70010000127154.description:
You landed on this island with a relationship back home and zero intention of complicating things. Then the girls showed up. 

Beautiful, bold, and completely unaware that you're supposed to be off limits. The problem is, so are they.

Work the island, build your reputation, and find yourself in situations you didn't plan for. Dates that start innocent and don't stay that way. Late night chats that go further than they should. 

Every girl here pulls at something different, and the more time you spend with them, the harder it gets to remember why you're supposed to say no. The in-game chat keeps you close even when you're apart. And distance, on an island this small, doesn't last long.

A girl who goes after what she wants without apology, one who pretends she feels nothing until she does, a wild one who makes terrible ideas sound perfect... None of them are asking you to choose. Not yet.

Someone is waiting for you. The island doesn't care.

● ISLAND JOBS & SKILL PROGRESSION: Build your life on the island and open doors you weren't supposed to open.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: You can stay faithful. You can fall. You can burn everything down. The choice is yours.

70010000127186.name: Pixel Hunters: Turn Retro Consoles into your Girlfriend
70010000127186.intro:
Your dusty old console just blinked. 
Catch it before it runs and it might just become your girlfriend.
70010000127186.description:
Somewhere between the attic and the flea market, retro consoles have started fighting back. Old machines, blinking cursors, cartridges with a mind of their own. Something's alive in there.

Battle them turn by turn, wear them down, then catch them. 

That's when the real surprise hits: every console you capture transforms into an anime girl carrying pieces of its old hardware personality. 

Take her on dates, make the right choices, and watch the bond grow.

• The tiny handheld that fit in your pocket? She's quick, playful, and always one step ahead. 
• The chunky console with the flashing red light? Turns out she runs hot and burns just as fast for you.

♥ CAPTURE & TRANSFORM: Battle retro machines, capture them, and watch them become anime girls with personalities pulled straight from their old hardware quirks.

♥ TURN-BASED COMBAT: Outsmart every console before it powers down on you. Strategy meets seduction.

♥ ROMANCE & VISUAL NOVEL CHOICES: Take her on dates, say the right thing, unlock secret memories and scenes.

♥ CHARACTER COLLECTION: Every console has its own anime form and its own personality. Collect them all.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Not every route ends the same way. Choose wisely.

70010000127198.description:
Have you ever wanted to escape from the stress of urban life? 
Nom Nom: Cozy Forest Café is a cozy and relaxing decoration 
and rhythm game where you manage a café and befriend cute 
animals. 
 
■ Low stress, non confrontational, relaxing experience. 
■ Manage your own cafeteria Customize your place with 
furniture, decorations, lamps, wallpaper, and flooring. Take 
pictures of your favourite corners, dishes, and customers 
and share them on the café's website. 
■ Adorable customers Forge friendships and learn about 
their favourite recipes and decorations. 
■ Learn new recipes... To the beat! Prepare snacks and 
drinks, from waffles to sodas, to the rhythm of upbeat tunes 
and colourful animations.

you like. Experiment with new ingredient combinations and

different objects, as well as your dishes! Paint signs,

70010000127204.intro:
choose your strategy

70010000127204.description:
continue the legendary clicker series, offering unique challenges, deep strategy and exciting gameplay. As a wise king, you once again enter the battle to save the kingdom, which is plunging into darkness.

The game is a 2D autobattler with an isometric view. Place your troops, press "Play" and watch the majestic battles full of surprises. But now everything is in your hands - collect crystals and use powerful spells: call tornadoes or strike enemies with lightning to turn the tide of battle!

Each new level brings more dangerous enemies and insidious bosses. For victories, you will receive stars that can be used to strengthen your army and unlock new combat abilities. Your strategy and instant decisions on the battlefield will be the key to victory.

Get ready for a world where the fate of kingdoms is determined by clicks. Take up the challenge, prove your skills and become a true legend!

70010000127264.name: Backrooms Phases
70010000127264.intro: Wander through the shifting phases of the Backrooms. Solve puzzles, avoid twisted entities, and find a way out before the corridors close in on you forever.
70010000127264.description:
You noclipped out of reality. Now you are standing in a yellow corridor that stretches further than it should. The lights buzz. The carpet is damp. There is no way back.

BACKROOMS PHASES takes you deeper into the Backrooms than you have ever been. Each phase warps the world around you — familiar halls fracture into something darker, stranger, and far more hostile. Something here has gone through phases of its own. The entities that roam these corridors were not always what they are now. They shifted. They changed. And what they became is worse.

HAND-CRAFTED ENTITIES
Every creature in the game was designed and modeled from scratch. No templates, no recycled assets. Each entity has a distinct silhouette, behavior pattern, and reason to terrify you.

ATMOSPHERIC SOUND DESIGN
Footsteps echo wrong. Doors creak behind you. Sometimes the fluorescent hum stops — and the silence is worse. Sound is your only warning system. Use headphones.

PUZZLES UNDER PRESSURE
Locked passages, hidden tools, multi-step objectives. You will need to search, think, and act while something is hunting you. The Backrooms do not wait.

PHASE-BASED PROGRESSION
Each phase changes the rules. New environments, new threats, new ways to die. The deeper you go, the less this place resembles anything real.

From the creators of BACKROOMS INSIDE THE ESCAPE. The next descent is here.

70010000127270.name: Psyvariar 3 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000127270.intro: Play as one of 7 pilots in this thrilling sequel to a SHMUP classic. The time has come for a new generation of Psyvariars to rise… and save humanity.
70010000127270.description:
THE STORY OF PSYVARIAR 3

Psyvariar 3 takes place many years after the events of Psyvariar 2. After the fall of ETA, a faction of Psyvariars declared that Earth was too precious to be forsaken.
They vowed to reclaim and colonize it once more, with GUIS rising from its ashes to resume its original mission.
Decades pass. The Earth colony thrives.

Then… a signal. Alien. Unknown.

The moment Gluon particles are detected, dread spreads like fire. The skies darken with a familiar terror—Earth is under siege once again. The time has come for a new generation of Psyvariars to rise… and save humanity.

CONTENT & FEATURES

- Seven Playable Characters with unique shot types, buzz & bomb mechanics, and scoring systems.
- Guest character: Cotton from the Cotton series is fully playable with her own ship and abilities
- Refined Buzz System that rewards skillful bullet grazing with score boosts and shield chains
- Signature Roll Mechanic updated for modern controllers all the while preserving the original Arcade “wiggle” input for extra advantage and fluid movement
- Neutrino & Shield System that give access to shields, speed boosts, and enhanced weapons by buzzing and shooting
- Strategic Bomb Variations that include short and long types with varying effects depending on the character in use
- Multiple Game Modes: Arcade, Arrange, Mission (49 short challenges), Caravan, Endless, and Practice
- Dynamic Difficulty Selection that unlocks harder routes and exclusive boss encounters based on performance
- Seven Distinct Areas and Bosses with varied attack patterns depending on the difficulty
- Arcade-Perfect Intensity that preserves the intense, high risk/high reward action the series is known for
- Neo retro 3D aesthetics inspired by early Psyvariar games

MORE ABOUT PSYVARIAR

Born in 2000 with the launch of the original Psyvariar: Medium Unit in Japanese Arcades, the Psvyariar series has since then made its mark over the years. Psyvariar 3 is the highly anticipated sequel to the acclaimed vertical Shoot ’em Up series.

Designed with deep reverence for the franchise by lovers of the genre, Psyvariar 3 is the result of the collaboration between Banana Bytes (Sophstar), Red Art Games and Red Art Studios, with the blessing of IP holder SUCCESS. It builds on the franchise’s signature “buzz” mechanic while introducing new characters, refined controls, and a variety of game modes. With its seven unique pilots, each with distinct abilities and scoring systems, it also remains faithful to its Arcade roots while delivering enhanced replay value and accessibility for today’s players.

70010000127278.intro: Judy’s house key has been stolen by a mysterious hand, and now she needs your help to get it back!

70010000127284.name: Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000127284.intro: All those who are lost deserve kindness.
70010000127284.description:
Help cute, ghostly bears find peace in this relaxing sequel to the beloved life-sim game where kindness rules and new crafting, building, and camping island adventures await.

Attention, Spirit Scouts! Something spooky is afoot: A bus crash has left you stranded alone on a mysterious (yet delightfully cute) island. Explore the unique island, meet and befriend cute, ghostly spirit bears who need your help to remember their pasts and find peace. Customize a bustling, beautiful campsite by crafting, decorating, and building furniture to bring life and color back to this cute island, and hopefully reunite with your lost scout troop as you gradually repair your bus.

YOUR RELAXING ISLAND OASIS AT THE END OF A STRESSFUL DAY

Whether you're new to the "Cozy Grove" community or a devoted fan, this relaxing follow-up to the beloved life-sim adventure offers something for everyone. This edition of "Cozy Grove" is cuter and cozier than ever, introducing a fresh cast of quirky characters, new animal companions, a new setting and added gameplay features that offer endless ways to unwind at the end of a stressful day. So immerse yourself in a unique, relaxing watercolor art style filled with stunning details and activities to explore. Drop in daily for crafting, decorating, fishing and cooking fun, or embark on new quests to stay busy. Lead with kindness and achieve your camping dreams. Customize the cute, spooky island you've always wanted.

FIND NEW FOREVER FRIENDS AND CUTE ANIMAL COMPANIONS

Alongside familiar faces like Flamey and Mr. Kit, new spirit bears are waiting to bond with you and share their backstories. New animal companions are also on the island to offer support and relaxing comfort. Now you can pet a dog (!) or have a snail help lighten your load.

EXCHANGE GIFTS WITH ASYNCHRONOUS MULTIPLAYER MODE

A new asynchronous multiplayer mode lets you see spooky, cute astral projections of other players, connect with fellow Spirit Scouts and send and receive cute gifts through the mail. But introverts, no need to worry: There's no pressure to interact with your fellow players in real time. You're free to discover and gift in your own time, at your own relaxing pace.

NEW SPOOKY MYSTERIES TO INVESTIGATE

Uncover the secrets of the interconnected islands you've landed on as you complete daily quests. As you progress with patience and diligence, you may unlock new areas to explore. Visit dedicated stations for different activities and light up lamps to find bountiful new spots for foraging and mining.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR ISLAND WHILE CRAFTING, DECORATING AND CAMPING

Just because you're living on a haunted island doesn't mean you can't get comfortable! Immerse yourself in crafting and decorating activities, or collect furniture to make the island your own. Plant flowers and fruit trees to harvest, raise ghostly animals and attract pets to your house. And if things start to feel ho-hum, give yourself a custom head-to-toe makeover.

A POSITIVE, HEARTENING DAILY RITUAL

This life-sim game unfolds in sync with real-world time, bringing cute surprises and spooky seasons on the island. If you finish the day's quests, you can cook, craft, collect shells, catch bugs, go fishing, skip rocks or even spruce things up with a new power-washing tool. Rake in rewards as you add to your collection of cute items and earn merit badges for all your accomplishments. A Spirit Scout's work is never done!

Created with love by Spry Fox

- Ear Candy Radio - Bumping original sound track
- Express yourself - Pick from a cast of whackos... which one are you?
- Play it your way - Play with keyboard & mouse or controllers
- Not enough controllers? No Problem! - Pass and play mode lets you share
- No friends? No problem! - Tackle challenging courses alone in single player puzzles

70010000127391.name: STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT
70010000127391.description:
STEINS;GATE has become universally beloved from its inception back in 2009.
Since then, the series has sold more than 4 million units worldwide. STEINS;GATE is now being rebooted with major revamps and a completely new look.

Follow a ragtag group of tech-savvy students led by Rintaro Okabe, whose latest invention accidentally gains the ability to send messages to the past, unleashing the power to alter history itself. As global conspiracies stir and timelines begin to twist, the curtain rises on a future steeped in chaos. Your choices shape the fate of the characters and the world itself! Featuring multiple endings that branch based on your decisions.

・Characters, backgrounds, and pivotal moments have all been updated from scratch. There are twice the amount of still images and 20% more background graphics compared to the original version.
・Character designer huke returns with redesigned outfits and accessories that bring a contemporary flair to the cast while Akihabara has been recreated with stunning realism and depth, including new scenes.
・Uses E-mote, which has been well-received in Anonymous;Code. Smooth animations and rich expressions breathe new life to beloved characters.
・Series composer Takeshi Abo has remade the soundtrack, and the original voice actors have returned to re-record all in-game voices in Japanese.
・Additional Route - Gamma Worldline
A new kind of brutality, unlike anything seen before, awaits both Rintaro Okabe and the player.

70010000127446.name: Phrase Passport Japan A Travel Japanese Quiz
70010000127446.intro:
Take a Japanese quiz on the go!
Practice signs, transport, food, and daily phrases
Build vocabulary in quick play sessions
70010000127446.description:
Enjoy a learning quiz game based on Japanese words and phrases often seen in everyday outings and travel situations.

Answer questions about transport, sightseeing, food, signs, and daily conversation in a simple quiz format that is easy to start.

How to play:
・Read the question
・Choose the answer from the options
・Keep going and check your Japanese knowledge

No complicated controls are needed, so beginners can jump in right away.
Each question can be played at a smooth pace, making it great for short breaks, daily vocabulary practice, or relaxed solo play.

Recommended for:
・Players learning Japanese
・Anyone who enjoys word quizzes
・Families who want to play and learn together
・Players looking for a light brain-training game

Play alone at your own pace, or talk through the answers with family and friends.
Enjoy Japanese words and phrases with the feeling of a little outing!

70010000127453.name: Flip-Flip Jigsaw Girls
70010000127453.intro: Clear Both Sides♪ A New Reverse Puzzle Game Featuring Lots of Cute Girls!
70010000127453.description:
A new reverse puzzle game featuring adorable girls is here!
This time, traditional jigsaw puzzle gameplay is enhanced with rotation and flip-over mechanics!
Which side will you complete first? How will you orient each piece? Put your observation skills to the test in this unique puzzle experience!
Includes 15 stages in total!
As you progress, new mechanics and more puzzle pieces are introduced, increasing the challenge.

Stages 1–5: Rotation Puzzles
Stages 6–10: Double-Sided Puzzles
Stages 11–15: Double-Sided + Rotation Puzzles
Up to 81 pieces × 2 sides in the most challenging stages!

In double-sided stages, you can complete either side first—the front or the back. The choice is yours♪
The final stage offers an extreme challenge with no background watermark hints!
Take your time, carefully examine each piece, and complete the puzzle!
A gallery is unlocked as you progress, featuring both front-side and back-side illustrations.
Clear every stage and complete the entire gallery collection!
=====================
Our company supports content creators and streamers.
You do not need to obtain permission before uploading gameplay videos or live streaming this game.

70010000127459.name: Weekend Solitaire Summer Village
70010000127459.intro: It's time to take on Solitaire Challenge.
70010000127459.description:
Conquer challenging card configurations and take on a big, vibrant game with several levels of varying difficulties. 

Weekend Solitaire Summer Village dives into a bright world filled with vibrant gameplay, colorful animations, and hours of addictive card-solving fun! 

Enjoy an exciting journey through 130 levels of various complexities, each presenting a unique challenge that will put your solitaire skills to the test. 
Get ready to unwind and bask in the joys of summer with Weekend Solitaire Summer Village!

70010000127473.name: RollerCoaster Tycoon® Classic – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000127473.intro: Create incredible parks in the original rollercoaster sim from Chris Sawyer.
70010000127473.description:
RollerCoaster Tycoon® Classic™ is a new RCT experience, remastered in 2017 by franchise creator Chris Sawyer to combine the best features from two of the most successful and beloved RCT games in the series’ history – RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2. Roller Coaster Tycoon Classic also comes complete with the Toolkit, Wacky Worlds, and Time Twister expansion packs!  Create and run amazing parks filled with the most outrageous rides imaginable.  RCT Classic includes a mixture of authentic playability, depth of gameplay and unique graphical style of Chris Sawyer’s original best-selling RollerCoaster Tycoon® Games. Packed with content, players can enjoy designing and building roller coasters and rides, landscaping parks and managing the staff and finances to keep their guests happy and the money flowing in. Can you become the next RollerCoaster Tycoon?

Key Features:

The Original RollerCoaster Sim: Experience all the fun from the original RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2 games, with a new sim that combines the best elements of both classic titles.

Coaster Construction: Create incredible roller coasters – Quickly build a pre-made design or use the intuitive piece-by-piece building tools to design and theme your own unique rides.

Park Designer: Keep your guests happy by building gentle or wild rides, food and drink stalls, water rides, and even transport rides to take them around the park; Customize your park by building scenery, fine-tuning the landscape, and routing the footpaths.

Park Management: Run your park’s marketing and finances to make a profit while attracting more guests; Organize your staff to keep the park running well and looking its best.

Exciting Environments: Build the ultimate theme park in a variety of challenging environments, from the tranquility of Forest Frontiers to the bustling commerce of Megaworld Park.

Park Scenarios: Progress through 95 classic park scenarios from RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2.

Authentic Gameplay: Classic-style isometric graphics and original amusement park music and sound effects.

Packed with Content: Includes hundreds of types of roller coasters and rides, and dozens of different shops, stalls, and facilities.

70010000127485.name: Dino Hex Trap
70010000127485.description:
Prepare for a prehistoric battle where intelligence matters more than brute force. In Dino Hex Trap, every trap can completely change the course of the invasion, and every decision transforms the battlefield into a massive strategic puzzle filled with action and creativity.

Forget fixed towers and predictable strategies. Here, you control traps placed across a dynamic hexagonal field where direction, spacing, and positioning make all the difference. Rotate, reposition, and combine traps to turn seemingly safe routes into true corridors of Jurassic destruction.

Waves of dinosaur-inspired creatures keep advancing, and it is up to you to stop them before they reach your base. But resources are limited, so every choice matters: expand your defense with new traps or reorganize the ones you already have? Improvisation is part of survival.

As the campaign progresses, new trap types unlock increasingly creative possibilities. Some levels already begin with fixed structures spread throughout the map, completely changing the way you think about strategy and forcing you to constantly adapt.

With 30 levels spread across morning, afternoon, and night biomes, Dino Hex Trap combines planning, resource management, and spatial awareness in fast, smart, and deeply satisfying challenges.

With stylish visuals, engaging battles, and that perfect feeling of “now my strategy is brilliant,” Dino Hex Trap is an irresistible experience for players who love strategic defense, meaningful decisions, and defeating hordes in the most creative ways possible.

Watch the paths, prepare your traps, and prove that even dinosaurs can fall into the perfect plan.Traps, Dinosaurs, and Strategic Chaos

70010000127491.name: Damways
70010000127491.intro: Slide, Build, and Master the Lake
70010000127491.description:
Get ready for a clever, relaxing, and strategy-filled adventure across a lake where every move matters. In Damways, you control a resourceful beaver that slides endlessly across the water, reshaping the environment with dams and creating unlikely paths toward home.

But nothing here is as simple as it seems. The beaver does not move step by step. Once it starts sliding, it only stops when it hits an obstacle, a wall, wood, or one of your own dams. This turns every direction into an important decision where predicting the trajectory matters just as much as choosing the destination.

Collect bundles of wood scattered around the lake and use them to build strategic dams capable of completely reshaping the map. Create new barriers, redirect routes, open impossible paths, and transform the environment piece by piece until the perfect solution appears.

Every piece of wood is precious. You can carry only one at a time, so deciding when to collect, where to build, and how to reorganize the lake makes all the difference. A badly placed dam can block your entire route… but with Undo and Restart features, there is always room to experiment with new ideas.

As the journey continues, the challenges become increasingly creative, bringing more complex maps, clever obstacles, and puzzles that demand observation, planning, and spatial reasoning. The result is a relaxing yet deeply satisfying experience for players who love well-crafted puzzles.

With cozy visuals, a peaceful atmosphere, and that wonderful feeling of finally understanding the solution, Damways transforms every lake into a strategic playground full of possibilities.

Observe the environment, slide through the water, and build the perfect path toward the den.

70010000127516.name: Arcade Archives KARNOV
70010000127516.intro: Rise, brave Karnov! Defeat the Emperor of Darkness!
70010000127516.description:
"KARNOV" is an action game released by Data East in 1987.
Defeat the Emperor of Darkness and reclaim the stolen treasures.
KARNOV can attack by breathing fire from his mouth.
Also, by making use of 9 different weapons (options), you can perform various actions such as increasing movement speed, creating a ladder, and flying through the air.
What will happen when you defeat bosses and collect all the torn map pieces...?

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000127528.name: EGGCONSOLE DEEP DUNGEON II MSX
70010000127528.intro: The classic Humming Bird Soft RPG is back! Defeat Demon King Ruu as Ral's descendant and find the true ending.
70010000127528.description:
Released by Humming Bird Soft in 1988, this RPG takes place centuries after hero Ral defeated archfiend Ruu. As Ral's descendant, you must embark on a quest to vanquish the resurrected Ruu.

While inheriting its predecessor's core systems—featuring turn-based command battles within 3D dungeons—this sequel expands the adventure from underground depths to the surface world. It also introduces 2D towns where players can shop and recover. Furthermore, multiple endings add rich replayability as you strive to uncover the true conclusion.

70010000127532.name: The Person Living Next Door
70010000127532.intro:
Something about the neighbor is... off today.
Can you spot the unease hidden in plain sight?
70010000127532.description:
One morning, the neighbor next door doesn't quite seem normal —

A curtain left slightly open. A flowerpot on the balcony. The mailbox by the front door.
Within these mundane, everyday scenes, something is definitely... wrong.

This is a mystery-and-horror visual puzzle quiz, where you peek into the seemingly ordinary life of your neighbor and tap to uncover the unsettling details hidden inside each picture.

Each scene quietly hides four clues, blended naturally into a perfectly normal image.
At first glance, nothing seems off — but as you read each question, a chill creeps up your spine: "Wait... that's not right."

How to play is simple.
・Observe the picture carefully
・Read the question and tap the suspicious detail
・Find all four, and inch closer to the neighbor's "truth"

When you get stuck, gentle hints will nudge you toward the type of clue you should be looking for.
A quiet, creeping mystery — just one wall away from your everyday life.
Use your eye for detail to uncover what the neighbor is really hiding.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.

70010000127537.name: Lofi Witch Hatch
70010000127537.intro: A relaxing idle collection game with beautiful girls (supports offline). You are an egg keeper helping the girls hatch monster eggs.  200 monster eggs + soothing lo-fi music♪
70010000127537.description:
To resist the goblin invasion, the town’s lady lord and the shrine maiden joined forces to summon monsters. 
They kidnapped you and persuaded you to take on the job of raising monster eggs. As time passes, your relationship with them gradually grows closer... 
1. Draw Eggs: Obtain monster eggs of random rarity. 
2. Raise Eggs: Idle and wait for the eggs to grow. 
3. Sell Monsters: Sell the monsters after they mature. 
4. Collect: Complete 200 × 2 monster handbooks. 
5. Story: Events unlock as you continue playing. 
6. Music: Enjoy relaxing lo-fi music while idling.
(Supports Offline Idle)

70010000127561.name: Super Goldfish Scooping
70010000127561.intro:
It's goldfish scooping like you've never seen it before!
Scoop up crazy goldfish one after another!
70010000127561.description:
Enjoy goldfish scooping anytime on Nintendo Switch™!
Aim for a high score in solo play, or compete with up to 4 players in exciting multiplayer battles!

Grab items and gain the upper hand!
Make your poi bigger, boost your movement speed, and catch tons of fish!
Sometimes you'll even be able to hinder your rivals and turn the tide of the match!
Chaotic action and constant surprises mean it's anyone's game until the very end!

[Classic Stage]
Enjoy the festival atmosphere in this traditional goldfish scooping experience!
Catch a variety of goldfish and rack up the highest score possible!

[Japanese Stage]
A beautiful stage inspired by traditional rock gardens!
Use the flow of the water to skillfully scoop up goldfish as they drift by!

[Colorful Stage]
Dive into a colorful toy-box world packed with surprises!
Toy goldfish and unpredictable gimmicks create nonstop chaos!

Watch out for explosive pufferfish that affect everything around them!
Beware of sharks that gobble up other fish!
Take on gigantic boss fish that require multiple scoops to catch!

Face a never-ending stream of unique challenges in the ultimate goldfish scooping experience!

[Score Attack]
Catch as many goldfish as you can before time runs out!
Chain catches together and target high-value fish to set a new personal best!

[Battle]
Battle it out with up to 4 players!
Use items strategically and scoop more goldfish than your opponents to claim victory!

[Rankings]
Compete with players from around the world for the highest score!
Can you become a true goldfish scooping master?

70010000127571.name: Cash Movers
70010000127571.intro: Cash Movers is a 2D cooperative puzzle-platformer about two unlikely partners trying to escape a heavily guarded building collecting as much cash as possible.
70010000127571.description:
Players control two different burglars, each with their own role, size, and strengths. The smaller character is fast, agile, and perfect for reaching tight spaces, climbing, activating switches, and sneaking through dangerous areas. The larger character is slower but stronger, able to push heavy crates, carry objects, throw items, and help solve puzzles that the smaller character cannot complete alone.

Every level is built around cooperation, timing, and clever use of the environment. Players must move through prison corridors, security rooms, industrial platforms, locked passages, traps, lasers, moving platforms, pressure buttons, sliding doors, safes, cameras, guards, and other hazards. Progress often requires using both characters together: one may need to stand on a button while the other passes through a door, push a crate into position, avoid a patrol, disable a mechanism, or create a path forward.

Expect short but carefully designed levels with increasing complexity. Early stages introduce basic movement, buttons, doors, crates, and simple platforming. Later levels add more advanced mechanics such as moving platforms, animated traps, security cameras, laser barriers, locked safes, enemy guards, timing-based obstacles, and multi-step puzzles where both characters must work together.

Key features:
- Cooperative puzzle-platform gameplay
- Two playable characters with different abilities
- Levels built around teamwork and timing
- Pushable crates, pressure buttons, sliding doors, traps, lasers, cameras, safes, and guards
- Levels that become more complex as new mechanics are introduced
- Designed for quick, satisfying puzzle-solving sessions

70010000127611.name: Explorers of the Brick Universe
70010000127611.description:
A team of space builders travels across distant worlds to recover the fragments of the Master Core, a legendary artifact that grants the power to create anything through cooperation alone. After overcoming dangerous environmental challenges and stopping the selfish Crank from carrying out his plans, the group restores harmony across the universe, proving that teamwork is the most powerful building tool in the galaxy.

One hundred percent child safe: a secure and closed experience on Nintendo Switch™ with no adverts, no microtransactions and no hidden fees.

An interactive fairytale experience. A perfect linear narrative adventure for young readers to enjoy a captivating story at their own pace.

70010000127617.name: Zumba – Magical Marble Saga
70010000127617.intro: Master the mystic arts—match arcane orbs and save the kingdom from the surge!
70010000127617.description:
Step into a realm of high fantasy where a legendary wizard’s apprentice wields arcane orbs with the flick of a wand! Choose your stage, aim your magic-infused spheres at winding stone paths, and match three or more identical elements to trigger spectacular spells before they invade your inner sanctum. Achieve legendary scores and earn three mystical stars per level by dispelling waves with magical precision.
Between your quests, spend your earned mana-gold to unlock ancient wizardly upgrades:
Dragon’s Breath: Scorches clusters with a torrential blast of fire.
Chronos Shift: Freezes the flow of orbs in their tracks.
Alchemy Orb: Transmutes your next sphere into any element you desire.
Starfall Barrage: Calls down a rain of meteors to clear the path.
Arcane Bolt: Shatters a single, stubborn orb with concentrated energy.
Rewind Rune: Reverses the stream, granting you a second chance at a perfect match.
Journey through four enchanting realms—the Whispering Elf-Woods, the Floating Sky-Castles, the Frost-Giant Peaks, and the Shadow-Dragon’s Lair. Every ten levels, the magic shifts to reveal new paths, rarer orb colors, magical barriers, and intensifying speeds.
Addictive and easy to learn yet challenging to master, this epic adventure delivers spellbinding arcade fun for wizards and warriors of all ages.

70010000127619.name: Zumba - The Pharaoh's Marble Revenge
70010000127619.intro: Awaken the Pharaoh’s curse—match, blast, and conquer the sands of time!
70010000127619.description:
Zumba – The Pharaoh’s Marble Revenge invites you into the golden age of Egypt, where a mystical scarab launcher guards the treasures of the ancients! Choose your path, aim enchanted orbs at winding desert tracks, and match three or more identical colors to trigger divine explosions before they breach the inner sanctum. Secure high scores and earn up to three stars per level by clearing waves with the precision of a master architect.
Between stages, spend your gathered gold to unlock powerful Egyptian relics:
Sunfire Flare: Scorches entire clusters with the heat of the desert sun.
Sands of Time: Slows the advancing orbs to a crawl.
Eye of Horus: Transmutes your next orb into any color you desire.
Anubis’ Rain: Summons a barrage of falling stones to create instant matches.
Obelisk Strike: Targets a single, stubborn orb for immediate destruction.
Eternal Echo: Undoes your last shot, offering a second chance at glory.
Journey through four legendary realms—the Verdant Nile Delta, the Gilded Giza Plateau, the Midnight Luxor Temple, and the Hidden Chamber of Duat. Every ten levels, the sands shift to reveal unique paths, new orb colors, moving obstacles, and escalating speeds.
Addictive and easy to learn but challenging enough to stump a Sphinx, Zumba – The Pharaoh’s Marble Revenge delivers timeless arcade fun for players of all ages.

70010000127661.name: Isekai Villain - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000127661.intro: Rise as a true villain and carve your own destiny in a dark fantasy RPG!
70010000127661.description:
An ordinary young man is reborn into the world of his favorite comic—only to find himself as a bit-part villain doomed to die. To escape his fate, he must rise as a true villain, gathering allies, defying heroes, and carving a new destiny in this dark fantasy isekai JRPG. Experience a story of survival, betrayal, and ambition where good and evil clash in a pixel-art world.

Fight strategic turn-based battles that blend classic RPG command systems with modern mechanics. Exploit enemy weaknesses, trigger chain attacks, and unleash powerful break attacks. Earn notoriety through misdeeds to rank up and unlock unique arts via a skill tree. Explore dungeons, gather resources, and develop your own evil base with a smithery, lab, smuggling, and more. Packed with pixel-art charm, immersive story, and tactical depth, this parallel world RPG is a must for fans of JRPGs, anime-style games, and fantasy adventures.

70010000127668.name: Gods With Guns
70010000127668.intro:
In Valhalla, heroes pull the trigger to defy Ragnarok!
Rogue-like shooting game. 8 mythological heroes + 36 guns + 26 types of ammo + 60 Cards.
70010000127668.description:
Become a Norse myth hero
Play as legendary characters like Odin, Thor, Loki, and Hela to fight against Ragnarok. 

Enjoy fast-paced 2D gunplay
Experience smooth gun handling as you battle through storms of bullets and waves of enemies. 

Build card combinations to enhance your power
Collect cards to strengthen your character and face endless enemies.

70010000127672.name: Laser Logic
70010000127672.intro: Guide laser beams through clever puzzles in this relaxing yet challenging brain teaser.
70010000127672.description:
Enter a futuristic world of light and logic in this immersive 3D puzzle adventure. Your mission is simple: guide powerful laser beams through intricate environments by rotating mirrors, redirecting energy, activating switches, and solving increasingly complex challenges. Every level introduces new mechanics and obstacles that test your precision, timing, and problem-solving skills.

Explore beautifully designed stages filled with glowing visuals, dynamic lighting effects, and satisfying chain reactions as you discover the perfect path for each beam. From relaxing early puzzles to mind-bending late-game challenges, the experience is designed to be accessible for newcomers while offering rewarding depth for puzzle fans.

With intuitive controls, smooth gameplay, and dozens of unique laser-based challenges, this game delivers a relaxing yet engaging experience perfect for players who enjoy strategy, logic, and creative thinking. Can you master the light and complete every puzzle?

70010000127687.name: Make it! Shaved Ice
70010000127687.intro:
Get ready for a delicious shaved ice challenge!
Make lots of shaved ice and watch your food cart prosper!
70010000127687.description:
Let's make shaved ice on the Nintendo Switch™!
Quickly shave ice and add the correct toppings to fill each order!
With a Joy-Con™ per player, up to 4 players can join in the fun!
Aim for a new high score!

《Rules》
Make shaved ice and fill customer orders!
Make as many as you can within the time limit!

《How to Play》
1. Shave the ice!

2. Add the syrup that matches the order!

3. Add fruit as a topping!

4. Serve the shaved ice to your customers! Match the orders exactly to earn more points!

[Score Attack]
Make lots of shaved ice and climb the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Compete in battles and put your shaved ice skills to the test!

70010000127690.name: Worldly: Country & Maps Quiz
70010000127690.intro: Guess capital cities, flags & countries in a fun geography quiz!
70010000127690.description:
Worldly: the ultimate Countries & Geography Quiz!

Join Sir Maxwell Worldly on a grand adventure around the globe! Test your knowledge of countries, capitals, flags, maps, and more in the world geography quiz loved by explorers everywhere.

Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned traveller, Worldly makes learning geography fun, fast, and addictive. Play quick rounds to sharpen your knowledge, or dive deep into every country, capital, landmark, and currency on the planet.

Why players love Worldly:
• Guess every world capital and prove your geography skills.
• Learn every country flag in a fun, fast-paced quiz format.
• Explore currencies, landmarks, and regions across the planet.
• Challenge friends and prove you're the most seasoned traveller!
• 54 game modes spanning every corner of the globe.

With game modes covering capitals, countries, flags, maps, currencies, and geography trivia, there's always a new challenge to conquer. Earn achievements, beat your high score, and keep your mind sharp!

Stunning visuals & audio: Explore a beautiful hand-drawn globe as Sir Maxwell whisks you around the planet in his iconic hot air balloon. Enjoy gorgeous cartoon-style graphics and full animation from a BAFTA award-winning art team, plus an addictive soundtrack and sound effects.

Packed with content:
• Every country in the world, with national flags and local currencies.
• Capital cities, city locations, and detailed maps.
• Mini-games, multiple difficulty levels, and fast-paced quiz rounds.
• New quizzes and challenges added regularly — the journey never ends!

Perfect for:
• Students who want to learn world geography and capitals.
• Quiz and trivia fans who love testing their knowledge.
• Travellers curious about countries, flags, and cultures.
• Anyone who loves fun, educational, and challenging games.

Get Worldly today and start your adventure — how well do you really know our planet?

70010000127704.name: Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend
70010000127704.intro: A Touhou Project deck-building roguelike. Unleash dazzling danmaku and hunt down the culprit who stole the treasured artifact!
70010000127704.description:
Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend is a deck-building roguelike fan game based on Touhou Project.

One day, Kaguya Houraisan of Eientei held the Lunar Capital Exhibition, attracting visitors from far and wide.
But in the midst of the event, its centerpiece—the treasured artifact known as the “Jeweled Branch of Hourai”—was suddenly stolen.

Seeking to resolve the incident, Kaguya made an announcement:
“Find the missing Exhibit, and I shall reward you with one of my treasures.”

Upon hearing this, the residents of Gensokyo rushed to begin their investigations.
Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, Sakuya Izayoi, Cirno, and Koishi Komeiji were no exception.

・Harness your mana and unleash powerful danmaku.

Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend is a deck-building roguelike.
Choose from cards with a wide variety of costs and effects as you advance through each stage.

・Five playable characters, each with two distinct strategies.

The five playable characters are Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, Sakuya Izayoi, Cirno, and Koishi Komeiji.

Each character offers two core strategies.
With entirely different cards and tactics to choose from, find your favorite way to fight.

・Collect Exhibits to grow stronger.

Acquiring Exhibits from the Lunar Capital Exhibition allows you to enhance your character’s abilities.

Gather as many Exhibits as you can along the way and take on the powerful foes standing between you and the true culprit.

・Beautiful visual effects bring every journey to life.

To recreate the iconic danmaku battles of Touhou Project as a card game, Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend features more than 200 different danmaku effects.

70010000127752.name: SuperDog
70010000127752.intro: For those of us who have a dog, every one of them is a Super Dog. A game dedicated to all the dogs in the world.
70010000127752.description:
Embark on an exciting adventure alongside man's best friends. Explore vibrant new worlds, face dangerous enemies, collect coins to unlock adorable new puppies, and rescue the fourth dog, who has been kidnapped by the evil giant rat.

Play as a Shih Tzu, a Corgi, or a Bulldog, each ready to take on the adventure. Jump across challenging platforms, dodge deadly spikes, defeat both ground and flying enemies, and prove that every dog can be a Super Dog

70010000127787.name: Girls Wars 1939
70010000127787.intro: An all-new squad of beautiful girl soldiers rewrites history in this one-of-a-kind World War II universe! A brand-new engine delivers an epic evolution unlike anything you've played before!
70010000127787.description:
Stunning cel-shaded visuals bring an anime-style world to life, opening the gates to a battlefield that's entirely your own. Fight alongside a squad of girl soldiers on the front lines in a WWII FPS experience found nowhere else. Set against the backdrop of World War II, this story-driven single-player FPS lets you steal weapons from fallen enemies and charge straight through the chaos of war. Whether you're a military history enthusiast or a player who craves breathtaking visuals paired with a gripping narrative, this is the ultimate solo FPS made for you. Amid the gunfire and bonds forged on the battlefield, only one person can rise as the true hero, and that's you.

・Powered by a brand-new engine for smoother, more intense combat, every gunfight now feels more real and more exhilarating than ever
・Cutting-edge cartoon rendering combined with cel-shading technology delivers vivid, anime-inspired visuals, turning every battlefield moment into a work of art
・Includes wildly unexpected alternate world costumes that completely flip the main story's tone on its head. Switch into an entirely different vibe and it'll feel like you're playing a brand new game altogether, a fresh twist you won't see coming.
・A heartfelt story with a full ending sequence, follow a carefully crafted narrative all the way through to an emotional finale you won't forget
・Dialogue events and side quests woven throughout every mission, banter between squadmates and hidden quests deepen your connection to the story
・Steal weapons straight from defeated enemies, build your own unique combat style and unleash spectacular firefights with a huge arsenal at your disposal
・Historically grounded missions inspired by real events, cinematic cutscenes play after every stage clear, and a wide range of authentic WWII era weapons are ready to collect and use
・Immersive 3D audio paired with a 3D physics engine for realistic, high impact gameplay
・A wide range of 3D effects and battlefield graphics that capture the tension of total war
・Cooperative combat alongside AI controlled allied soldiers for deeper tactical play
・Cover based combat using environmental objects for intense, authentic firefight tension

Charge through iconic, historically inspired battles from World War II and take down every enemy in your path. Complete every episode and an unforgettable, emotional ending awaits you at the finish line. A brand new engine combined with cel-shaded visuals delivers an immersive experience like nothing you've played before. Download now and step into a war story that's entirely your own!

Prologue
After the end of World War I, Germany struggled to accept the reality of defeat. Rather than offering reconciliation, the Treaty of Versailles ensured the nation could never rise as a dominant power again. Crushing reparations led to excessive currency printing, triggering runaway hyperinflation that devastated the economy.

Rather than easing the people's suffering, the nation's leaders exploited nationalism to consolidate power. Radical nationalist sentiment spread rapidly as people, humiliated and impoverished, began yearning for a strong leader and a return to former glory. Amid this turbulent atmosphere, a charismatic young girl skillfully harnessed the anger and resentment of the masses, rapidly building her own power base.

Then in 1939, Nazi Germany's invasion of Poland ignited the flames of World War II. Amid the smoke and chaos of the battlefield, a squad of girl soldiers carrying the weight of destiny emerged. A story never told before, one where girl soldiers take center stage in a war unlike any other, is about to begin.

70010000127795.name: Japan Stigmatized Property -日本事故物件監視協会-
70010000127795.intro: Can you endure until morning Monitor Japan's stigmatized properties and report any paranormal activity If you miss a report or make repeated mistakes——
70010000127795.description:
Note:
This game focuses on Japanese-style psychological horror and subtle, atmospheric fear.
It is not based on jump scares, action, or chase scenes.
Your task is to observe real-world locations in Japan and report any abnormal phenomena.
Inspired by Japanese urban legends, this experience blends horror with visual attention.
You may find the horror “quiet”—but it lingers in your mind.
If you enjoy subtle, unsettling vibes over gore or action, this game is for you.

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

To All Employees,
You are a surveillance officer of Japan Stigmatized Property
Operate the security cameras installed throughout the property and monitor for any signs of anomalies
If you discover anything unusual, report it immediately
Failure to report anomalies or repeated mistakes will result in a mission failure
Conversely, if you can maintain surveillance from midnight to 5 a.m., the mission will be considered successful

[Mission Features]
You will be assigned to real-life properties located within Japan
Anomalies will occur randomly
Be aware of phenomena that can only be observed through either the night vision camera or the regular camera

[Examples of Anomalies]
Furniture moving, objects disappearing or appearing
Intrusion by human figures or spirits
Lighting malfunctions, floating orbs
Bloodstains on walls, video distortion
And other phenomena beyond imagination

[Work Hours]
You will be in charge of 4 properties in total
Surveillance duties run from 12:00 a.m. to 5:00 a.m.
Choose between 'Nomal' or 'Special Pay' Assignment difficulty modes

[Other Notes]
Streaming and broadcasting while conducting duties is permitted.
We place no restrictions on monetization or Super Chats.
Submission of permission requests is not required for either individuals or corporate entities.

Please commence your duties.

70010000127799.name: Japan Stigmatized Property2 -日本事故物件監視協会-
70010000127799.intro:
Can you survive until dawn?
Monitor real Japanese properties and report every anomaly.
70010000127799.description:
Japan Stigmatized Property2
To All Personnel:
We appreciate your dedicated efforts in the previous surveillance operation.
Please be advised that the risk level for the current assignment has significantly increased.
You are required to exercise extreme caution while performing your duties.

You are an observer for the "Japan Stigmatized Property Association" (JSP).
Your duty is to monitor surveillance cameras installed in designated properties and check for any anomalies.
Upon discovering an anomaly, you must report it immediately.
Repeated failure to report or excessive false reports will result in "Mission Failure." Conversely, maintaining successful surveillance from 00:00 to 05:00 constitutes "Mission Success."

【Operational Features】
Real-World Locations: You will be assigned to properties that actually exist in Japan.
Randomized Anomalies: Irregularities occur randomly.
Camera Modes: Be vigilant for phenomena visible only through specific equipment (Night Vision or Standard Camera).

【Examples of Anomalies】
Movement of furniture; disappearance or appearance of objects.
Intrusion by human figures or spiritual entities.
Lighting malfunctions; floating orbs.
Bloodstains on walls; video feed noise/interference.
"Something" beyond imagination.

【Shift Details】
Assignment: 4 total properties.
Hours: 00:00 – 05:00 (Midnight shift).
Difficulty: Selectable between "Normal" and "Special Pay" (Hard).

【Others】
Streaming and broadcasting while conducting duties is permitted.
We place no restrictions on monetization or Super Chats.
Submission of permission requests is not required for either individuals or corporate entities.

Please commence your duties.

70010000127825.name: FlipRide Rush
70010000127825.intro: Race through futuristic tracks and defy gravity in this fast-paced 3D bike racing game.
70010000127825.description:
Jump into a thrilling anti-gravity racing experience with this complete 3D bike game built for fast-paced arcade action. Ride futuristic bikes across challenging tracks filled with sharp turns, ramps, obstacles, and high-speed gameplay designed to keep players engaged from start to finish.

The game includes polished bike controls, responsive movement, smooth camera systems, and immersive visual effects that create an exciting racing atmosphere. Multiple gameplay systems are already integrated, allowing developers to quickly customize tracks, environments, bikes, UI elements, and game mechanics for their own unique project.

Designed with optimization and flexibility in mind, the project is suitable for creating sci-fi racing games, stunt challenges, endless riding modes, or competitive time-trial experiences. Clean project organization and ready-to-use assets help accelerate development while maintaining high visual quality and enjoyable gameplay performance.

Whether you're building a futuristic racing title or expanding your existing arcade game collection, this game provides a strong foundation for delivering intense speed, stylish visuals, and adrenaline-filled bike action.

70010000127831.name: EGGCONSOLE Borfes and the Five Demons MSX
70010000127831.intro: Become the apprentice wizard Borfes and teach the great demon Naikin Naikis a lesson! Could a pot that summons demons be the key to beating the game?!
70010000127831.description:
Released by Crystal Soft in 1987, this classic action RPG returns! One day, the master called apprentice Borfes with a request. Players become apprentice wizard Borfes, embarking on a journey through landscapes like forests and deserts, ultimately setting off to confront the Archfiend Naikin Naikis deep within Naikis Castle.

The game features an intuitive top-down view. Borfes starts with only a staff from his master. As you explore, power up with various items: a dagger for close slashes, a bow for long-range attacks, a crystal staff that shoots energy waves, speed boots, and protective gear. Finding demon jars allows you to summon powerful allies. Combine items and demons for deeply strategic action gameplay!

70010000127837.name: I am an Air Traffic Controller AIRPORT HERO Centrair EX
70010000127837.intro: You are the Air Traffic Controller! Issue commands and ensure airport safety!
70010000127837.description:
Aircraft are moving one after another. Grant takeoff and landing clearances and direct taxiing and gate routing. 
Select approach courses and instruct aircraft to adjust flight speed.
Use a variety of ATC commands to avoid danger and keep the airport safe!
All 40 stages will put your brain to the ultimate test!

This popular simulation series lets you step into the tower and master the art of airport traffic control!
With simple, intuitive controls, anyone can play! Just select the best command for each dynamically changing situation.
Take on 40 challenging stages, including high-stakes scenarios where you are dropped instantly into sudden emergencies and chaotic traffic jams!
The setting is "Centrair" (Chubu International Airport, Nagoya), a real-world Japanese maritime airport operating with just a single runway.
Experience air traffic control like a 3D puzzle while enjoying realistic, high-fidelity scenes of the airport and airplanes!

70010000127855.name: Make It Cozy!
70010000127855.intro: Unleash your creativity in a cutest possible way!
70010000127855.description:
Welcome to Make it Cozy!

Create the sweetest little home and share it with the cutest animal friends imaginable!

Step into a charming world filled with soft colors, cozy corners, and adorable companions waiting to move in. Design dreamy bedrooms, sunny living rooms, peaceful reading nooks, relaxing bathrooms, and magical outdoor spaces — then watch them come to life with playful kittens, a curious fox, a cheerful penguin, a tiny hedgehog, and many other fluffy friends.

Every room is a place where memories are made. Arrange comfy furniture, decorate with lovely plants, hang cute decorations, and create warm spaces where your animal companions can feel safe, happy, and loved. Whether you prefer a pastel paradise, a cozy cottage, or something wonderfully unique, your imagination is the only limit.

Relax, decorate, and enjoy the gentle atmosphere as your tiny residents explore the home you've created just for them. Every smile, nap, and playful moment makes your cozy world feel even more magical.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Design and decorate adorable cozy homes and beautiful outdoor spaces
- Meet charming animal residents including kittens, foxes, penguins, hedgehogs, bunnies, and more
- Hundreds of cute furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to personalize every room
- Warm pastel visuals and relaxing music that create a peaceful atmosphere
- Endless creative freedom to build your dream cozy retreat
- Watch your lovable animal friends enjoy and explore their new home
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, creativity, and relaxing gameplay

70010000127861.name: Knot My Job
70010000127861.intro: Untangle the chaos in Knot My Job!
70010000127861.description:
Knot My Job is a 100% touch-controlled puzzle game exclusive to the handheld mode of your Nintendo Switch™. Use your fingers directly on the screen to unplug, move and plug cables into their correct places. Help the neighbors and bring order to the chaos!

Features:
• 100% touch control: Play naturally by dragging cables directly with your fingers.
• 50 brain-teasing levels: Overcome 50 unique puzzles with a perfect difficulty curve for quick sessions.
• Colorful visuals: Enjoy clean, relaxing and highly intuitive 3D graphics.
• A charming story: Accompany a funny technician and his dog through delightful cutscenes.

Get your fingers ready and prove there is no knot you can't handle!

70010000127889.name: Weekend Solitaire Voyage
70010000127889.intro: Embark on a Serene Journey with Weekend Solitaire: Voyage!
70010000127889.description:
Weekend Solitaire: Voyage offers a colorful array of puzzles through a gentle cascade of challenges. 
As you navigate through vibrant and dynamically animated levels, your strategic mind is both soothed and tested, immersing you into a relaxed, yet focused state. 
With every card turned and each layout solved, the game crafts an inviting and seamless experience, designed to delicately engage and guide you through the subtle mastery of solitaire.

130 Meticulously Designed Levels Across Four Distinct Card Decks!
Weekend Solitaire: Voyage extends an invitation to explore 130 meticulously designed levels, played across four distinct card decks. 
The game intertwines obstacles that keenly beckon your tactical insights with bonuses that appreciatively reward your strategic play. 
The narrative unfolds where every card and each layout becomes a chapter of a story, melding tranquility and strategy into a singular, engrossing experience.

70010000127902.name: Mad Taxi Simulator
70010000127902.description:
Welcome to the only taxi company where the driving is done for you, and all the action happens in the backseat. Engage the autopilot and prepare to mess with your passengers. Will you be a five-star professional or the ultimate backseat menace? The choice is yours. Each passenger in your cab is a fully interactive, physics-based rag doll that reacts dynamically to your every move. You can tap the glass, poke them, or tease them. Or, you can just sit back and watch them throw a ridiculous, cartoonish tantrum.

Expect the unexpected on every ride. What will you do if a passenger starts dancing wildly, tries to pick a fight, or demands that you pop a giant pimple on their face? Grab your tools and dive into the madness! Turn up the multimedia, blast their eardrums, spray them down, and test out wild new prank items to see how they react. In this interactive playground, you are the director of the chaos. Annoy them on purpose or try to calm them down. How you handle the ride is completely up to you.

The wilder the ride, the better the stories. Earn cash and driver ratings based on how you handle each crazy encounter. Use your hard-earned tips to unlock more ridiculous prank tools, upgrade your cab's interactive features, and purchase supplies to clean the backseat after a disastrous ride. 

Jump into a non-stop comedy show where you always deliver the punchline.

70010000127910.name: STREET UNi X
70010000127910.description:
STREET UNi X is a retro-callback to the extreme sports games that took over during the cusp of the new millennium. Fuelled by a passion for this era of gaming, and an obsession with the burgeoning sport of street unicycling, daffodil & friends have crafted STREET UNi X to cater to classic video game fans and unicycling aficionados alike!

With unique controls that capture the nuanced capabilities of unicycling, and the nostalgic goal oriented gameplay rush of video games past, STREET UNI X is guaranteed to leave you at the edge of your seat and wall-tapping to your next grind!

This new release is fired up with hot-tricks, more music, and a deeper dive into the heart of street unicycling, featuring in-game texts from daffodil and other riders from around the world!

Features

The world's first authentic street unicycling video game! Taking the sport as seriously as the pros with expressive keyboard/gamepad controls, infectious energy, and tricks you didn't even know were possible!

Join the ranks of contemporary pro unicyclists! Hop, grind, wall-tap, footplant, rail-ride, and twist your way through a full career mode with secret riders to unlock and hidden tricks to reveal!

Fresh retro looks! Real-life inspired spots transformed into yester-console playgrounds for you to explore and combo your way to unlocking secrets and besting your high scores!

Off the rails tracks! Featuring 20+ horn-fuelled ska bops and powered up hardcore punk bangers from your new favourite bands that will keep you humming to yourself and bobbing to the beat!

No unicycling experience required! Learn how to ride a virtual unicycle that will have you up and rolling in no time, and unleashing hi heat combos and hot-tricks soon after, even if you question reality itself!

70010000127926.name: Magic Kittens Merge
70010000127926.intro: Merge magic eggs, hatch enchanted kittens and fill the witch's album with every form.
70010000127926.description:
The witch's cauldron is full of kittens. Drop magic eggs into the cauldron and let them merge. Match two of a kind and something bigger appears, climbing from a tiny caracal all the way up to a golden tiger. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

Merges score points, points become stars, and stars go into the witch's album to unlock new breeds and awaken new forms. Chain your merges for glowing combos. Clear the cauldron completely for a Perfect Round. And take care with a spell that isn't ready yet — unfinished magic turns your cats to quiet stone.

Every few rounds the witch leans in with a word of advice, a bit of lore, or a small proud smile when you beat your best.

Features
• Cosy merge puzzle — easy to learn, hard to stop
• 11 elemental cat breeds and 33 forms to hatch, grow and collect
• A magical album to fill
• Stars, upgrades and combo chains for players who like to optimise
• A friendly witch companion who follows you through every round
• Storybook art in warm candlelight colours and an original cosy soundtrack
• No timers, no rush — play one round in five minutes, or stay with the kittens all evening

How many kittens can one cauldron hold?

70010000127944.name: Warhead Vanguard
70010000127944.intro: Hostages. A stolen top-secret project "WARHEAD". You're the only one going in. Warhead Vanguard is a hardcore tactical TPS with next-gen 3D physics!
70010000127944.description:
From a mountain ambush and a night raid in a border city, to storming an armed stronghold on the Caspian coast and a final push into an underground ICBM silo. Warhead Vanguard puts suffocating tension and full tactical freedom in your hands. Armed militants have crossed the border and seized missiles that were supposed to be long decommissioned. Sending in conventional forces is off the table. Diplomacy has failed. There is nothing left to negotiate. You are the last option.

・Brand-new 3D physics engine with real-time reactions to destruction, ballistics and impact!
・Next-generation shaders deliver cinematic-quality rendering of metal, fabric, dust and steel surfaces!
・Story-driven missions with clear, real-world-style objectives for every operation!
・Go in loud, go in quiet or call in fire support with total freedom to choose your approach!
・Full loadout customisation with weapons, optics, suppressors and tactical gear combinations!
・Four massive combat zones covering mountain terrain, a border city, a Caspian industrial port and an underground ICBM silo!
・Engine optimisation keeps the frame rate rock-solid through massive enemy encounters and explosive set pieces!

Warhead Vanguard was designed and built from day one to deliver hard-hitting action. A physics environment that reacts instantly to everything you do, visuals pulled straight from a blockbuster film, and mission design that punishes every mistake. When all three lock together, you are the operator. The mission clock is ticking. Get in there now.

Prologue
A government convoy is ambushed deep in a mountain range near the border. RPG and machine gun fire hit simultaneously, and the attackers take out the lead and rear vehicles first to seal off any escape. When the shooting stops, they strip the convoy of its military hardware and a classified project known only as "WARHEAD", then disappear across the border. The whole thing is over in under ten minutes. By the time reinforcements show up, there is nothing left but burning wreckage.

Days later, some of the stolen gear turns up on the black market. Equipment that should never have been accessible to any militia. Not long after, government vehicles start getting hit all across the border city. Checkpoints are attacked every night. Patrol units vanish without a trace. Then a video drops showing a government officer being taken captive, and word comes in that a strategically critical port on the Caspian coast has fallen to the armed group. Buried under that territory are ICBM silos that were supposed to have been taken offline years ago, along with a nuclear fuel reprocessing facility that could bring them back up to full operational status.

Intelligence moves to lock down the area, but it is already too late. Drone footage shows armed vehicles rolling into the facility in a steady stream. Mercenaries, insurgents and smuggling networks pour in together, and the entire zone turns into a fortified stronghold almost overnight. Sending in a conventional force is not an option given the global political situation. There is only one play left. Insert a small special operations team to pull out the hostages, take down the leadership and recover "WARHEAD". In the dark, the operators start moving.

70010000127963.name: The Drifter – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000127963.intro: A pulp adventure thriller – Enhanced for Nintendo Switch™ 2
70010000127963.description:
A murdered drifter awakens- alive again, seconds before his death. Hunted and haunted, help him untangle a mad web of conspiracy in this fast-paced point 'n click thrill-ride.

FEATURES

• A Pulp Adventure Thriller from the minds that brought you Crawl.
• An engrossing roller-coaster of a story- Drawing on King, Crichton and Carpenter, with a dash of 70s Aussie grindhouse.
• Unique twin-stick controls built ground up for both handheld and couch play!
• Bursting with raw crunchy pixel art and high-impact animation.
• Professionally voice acted, with a brooding dark-synth cinematic score.
                        
SYNOPSIS

Mick Carter's been drifting a while now- moving from job to job, never staying one place long. Jumping a box-car to his old home town, he witnesses a violent murder, is pursued by hi-tech soldiers, thrown in a reservoir and drowned.

And that's just the start of Mick's problems.

His consciousness ripped away, thrust back into his own body seconds before his death...

Framed for the killing he witnessed, tormented by his own past, and haunted by the feeling that something followed him back from the other side...

Follow Mick as he's sucked headfirst into a lunatic web of shadowy corporations, murder, and the thousand-year obsession of a madman.

GAMEPLAY

The Drifter is our take on a classic 2d point and click adventure- with the brake-lines cut. The focus is on fast-paced storytelling, with puzzle-solving being the glue that ties it together. Mick's a practical guy, and so puzzles are down-to-earth too, designed to be unobtrusive, and give an investigative feel.

We're keeping the pacing quick and lean, you'll never be wandering around lost or confused- Mick is propelled through the story at a good clip, from one situation to another, with barely a moment to catch his breath. One minute you'll be crafting a Molotov cocktail from a bottle of over-proof rum, the next interrogating a crooked neurosurgeon before swinging from a high-rise window by a fraying extension lead.

70010000127965.name: Menherarium
70010000127965.intro:
"Let's play together… forever, okay?"
Survive 7 days and see how your story with the clingy menhera girl (CV: Yuko Natsuyoshi) comes to an end.
70010000127965.description:
One day, you suddenly find yourself imprisoned by a clingy menhera girl.
Now trapped, you are forced to play blood-staked Chinchirorin against her.

Before you run out of blood, meet each day’s quota and keep her satisfied.
If you fail to satisfy her, then you...

・Face Menhera-chan’s oh-so-generous rules every day
Menhera-chan’s additional rules will stand in the way of reaching your quota.
Sometimes, you’ll need to predict what rules she might add and plan your build and strategy accordingly.

・Use every cheat you can to survive!
Every day, you must play Chinchirorin and overcome the ever-increasing quotas by making full use of cheats.

Amulets grant effects just by having them.
Items activate their effects when used.
You can even modify the faces of your dice. Want to make every side a "1"? Go right ahead.

Build the optimal setup for each situation and answer Menhera-chan’s impossible demands.

Survive 7 days and see how your story with Menhera-chan comes to an end.

70010000127971.name: Mina the Hollower - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000127971.intro: A bone-chilling 8-bit action-adventure, refined for the modern era and enhanced for Nintendo Switch™ 2
70010000127971.description:
Descend into a frightful world of action-adventure in Mina the Hollower. Take control of Mina, a renowned Hollower hurtled into a desperate mission to rescue a cursed island. Burrow beneath hazards and monsters, whip foes into oblivion, and gear up with an arsenal of sidearms and trinkets. Explore a vast world filled with pixel-perfect graphics, masterful gameplay, beastly bosses, and infectious music. Encounter a cast of bizarre characters, search out secrets in an array of exotic locales, and illuminate the omnipresent darkness in Mina the Hollower, a brand new game from the developers who brought you Shovel Knight!

Features:
- Hauntingly authentic 8-bit visuals, refined for the modern era.

- Modern touches abound: detailed animation, widescreen visuals, and rock-solid controls!

- Leap, dodge, and burrow through the ground to battle monsters or navigate the world.

- Lash at foes with your trusty whip, Nightstar- or choose from an arsenal of weapons, each with a totally different move set.

- Discover and utilize a reliquary's worth of unusual Sidearms to gain the advantage in combat.

- Collect and equip Trinkets to acquire a variety of exotic effects. Level Mina up to suit your unique playstyle.

- Electrifying 8-bit inspired soundtrack by chiptune virtuoso, Jake Kaufman.

- Descend into the depths of madness with a bone-chilling, yet heartwarming tale inspired by Victorian Gothic horror.

- Explore a huge, dark world brimming with secrets, challenging battles, and interconnected level design.

70010000127986.name: Veiled Edge
70010000127986.intro: A 2D action-adventure set in a stunning pixel-art cyberpunk world.
70010000127986.description:
The year is 2099. The line between reality and the virtual world has disappeared.

Step into a fully immersive virtual world powered by cutting-edge Full-Dive technology. Join investigator Rapid and genius hacker Lena as they uncover the truth behind a mysterious series of incidents.

Veiled Edge is a 2D action-adventure combining fast-paced combat, detailed pixel art, and diverse gameplay styles. Master platforming and intense battles while using hacking abilities to alter the environment, reveal hidden paths, and overcome challenging stages.

Each chapter introduces unique settings and gameplay mechanics, offering fresh experiences throughout your journey. Explore cyberpunk cities, theme parks, research facilities, and more as you battle powerful enemies and bosses to expose a massive conspiracy.

Features
Beautiful pixel-art cyberpunk world
Fast-paced 2D action and platforming
Hack the environment to solve puzzles and progress
Unique gameplay in every chapter
Story-driven sci-fi mystery
Hidden routes and optional challenges to discover

70010000128023.name: Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure
70010000128023.intro: She wrote the rules. Now she's breaking them — with a quill.
70010000128023.description:
Classic literature meets classic gaming in Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure! This 2D platformer stars Jane Austen herself, the beloved English novelist, who finds herself transported into an 8-bit video game.

Explore 8-bit England, battle characters ripped straight from Austen's novels, and defeat enemies the only way a proper author knows how — with a quill. Collect the scattered pages and restore Miss Austen's books to the 8-bit library before it's too late!

- Battle characters from Jane Austen's novels
- Explore 8-bit England
- Defeat enemies with a quill
- Restore Miss Austen's books to the 8-bit library

70010000128029.name: Resort Beauties : HENTAI Photo Puzzle
70010000128029.intro:
Rotate each photo into place!
A relaxing summer puzzle for quick play
Enjoy solo or solve together with friends
70010000128029.description:
Turn mixed-up photo panels and complete bright, summer-themed pictures in this casual rotation puzzle.

Look closely at each panel, find how the image connects, and rotate the pieces until the full photo comes together.

How to play:
・Check the direction of each photo panel
・Select panels that are facing the wrong way
・Rotate them to complete the picture

The rules are simple and easy to understand, making it a good choice for short breaks, relaxed solo play, or playing together with family and friends.

If you get stuck, the hint feature helps you keep going, so even puzzle beginners can enjoy each stage at their own pace.

Complete sunny resort-style photos one by one and enjoy a light puzzle experience that tests your observation skills!

70010000128035.name: Zed and Zee
70010000128035.description:
In the far-off future of 20XX, the brilliant roboticist Dr. Otto Matton builds the two most advanced humanoid robots ever created: Zed and Zee. But when they learn that their purpose is to lead Matton's army of super bots to world domination, they rebel against their creator and his sinister ambitions. Now it's up to them to put a stop to Dr. Matton's schemes and prevent the world from falling into his hands!

Run, jump, and stomp through six colorful worlds of fast-paced, arcade-style action! Passwords allow you to pick up where you left off last time! Play solo or cooperatively with a friend, or settle your differences in the two-player Battle Mode!

• Play solo or team up! You can take on Dr. Matton's robotic hordes alone, but teaming up with a friend is even better!
• Six unique worlds! Save the city of Mechtropolis, dodge flying buzzsaws in the Wired Woods, and brave the heat of the Infernal Factory!
• A colorful cast of enemies! Relentless plasma tanks, flying luchador masks, and unpredictable robo-frogs are just some of the threats you'll encounter on your mission!
• Challenging boss encounters! You may be able to defeat Dr. Matton's army of grunts, but can you survive the massive Super Robots waiting for you at the end of each world?
• 2-Player Battle Mode! When you need a break from saving the world, challenge your friend to a match in Battle Mode and determine who the real robot master is!
• Genuine 8-bit action! Zed and Zee isn't just retro-"styled"—it's a real 8-bit game designed for 8-bit console hardware!

70010000128076.name: Go-Go Town! – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000128076.intro: Time to roll up your sleeves, Mayor!
70010000128076.description:
Step into the role of a truly hands-on mayor and shape your town from the ground up.

Plan neighbourhoods, optimise logistics networks, and help your community grow - all while juggling workers, infrastructure, suspiciously large tools, visiting robots, aliens & dinosaurs, and the general day-to-day chaos of building your dream town.

And when mayoral duties get a little much, take a break with a spot of fishing, have a spin on the Go-Kart track, or even high-five a cow. 

Play solo for perfect control, or bring friends for co-op mayhem.

Grow Your Town

Lay down your streets, then place businesses, homes, and services where they’ll thrive. Welcome tourists, keep them happy, and give them plenty of reasons to stick around and make your town their home. Hire workers, keep shops stocked, and make sure the money keeps flowing, then upgrade, expand, and unlock new ways to help your town flourish. 

Optimise, Automate, Prosper

Tailor each business, industry zone and building configuration to suit your wants and needs. Assign workers, optimise supply chains, set-up logistics networks and watch your systems flourish. Will you let automation do the heavy lifting, or will you be the Mayor of Micromanagement? 

Bring The Style

As mayor, style starts at home, but it doesn't stop there. Dive into immersive house customisation with full 360° placement and a handy colour picker, then take that creative control across your town with recoloured buildings, and plenty of ways to make every street, shop, and neighbourhood feel uniquely yours.
