Need a new look while you work? Step into the Change-O-Tron and emerge as the mayor you were always meant to be. Your town. Your mayor. Your style.

Chaotic Co-Op

Team-up with up with another mayor, in either local and online play for just the right amount of teamwork and chaos. Build together, manage together, panic together, and discover how quickly a carefully planned town can go sideways when everyone has a different idea of ‘helping’.

70010000128132.name: Hako Maze
70010000128132.intro:
Introducing a whole new genre: "Mental Rotation Maze"
Test your flash of inspiration in this spatial brain teaser—can you visualize the 3D maze hidden within a flat net?
70010000128132.description:
Your greatest weapons are your ability to guide a ball rolling across a cube's surface, and your skill to decode complex 2D nets.
Use your intellect to solve the mazes etched onto these geometric structures, bypass the security, and restore the 3D artifacts sealed within.

◆ Overview
Enter a mysterious cyberspace seemingly left behind by an ancient civilization. Floating within this digital void are mysterious 3D objects, trapped inside cryptic boxes.

At first glance, they appear to be simple cubes. However, their surfaces are etched with a highly advanced security system: a series of intricate 3D mazes. By freely steering a ball across these shifting faces and guiding it to the goal, you will breach the security matrix and liberate the unknown anomalies slumbering inside.

◆ Key Features

Logic Puzzles That Decode the "Net": Test the limits of your spatial awareness. You’ll need to instantly visualize flat, 2D layouts as complex 3D structures to find the path forward.

70010000128148.name: EGGCONSOLE Dragon Slayer Level 2.0 PC-8801
70010000128148.intro: Nihon Falcom’s classic Action RPG returns in "2.0"! Slay the three-headed dragon to retrieve the four crowns.
70010000128148.description:
Released by Nihon Falcom in 1984, this is a seminal action RPG. Players become a lone warrior on a quest to slay a three-headed dragon and recover four crowns.

Your journey begins by hunting for a sword. Aside from your blade, you can only equip one item. To survive, strategically cycle through a limited inventory: the ""Cross"" to ward off monsters, the ""Ring"" to push walls, the ""Key"" to unlock chests, and the ""Power Stone"" to boost strength at home. ""Coins"" (to increase HP) and ""Magic Pots"" (to replenish mana) can be carried in unlimited quantities.

Defeating enemies yields experience to unlock a variety of spells: ""KICK"" to strike by shoving walls, ""BREAK"" to demolish obstacles, ""FLY"" to transform into a bird and fly, and ""FREEZE"" to stop enemies. These magical abilities give you a vital edge. Armed with your sword, magic, and skills, venture deep into monster territory. Will you safely bring all four crowns back home?

This edition (Version 2.0) features a rebalanced, accessible experience. It introduces quality-of-life enhancements: the Cross remains effective on the ground, monster-spawning graves vanish after slaying the dragon, and the screen flashes red when near death. However, to challenge veterans, experience from defeating monsters is halved, ensuring signature difficulty remains intact.

70010000128154.name: Chained Drivers
70010000128154.intro:
Two cars. One chain. Total chaos.
Drive, survive, and try not to drag your partner into disaster.
70010000128154.description:
Get ready for a chaotic driving adventure where teamwork means everything!

Drive through massive obstacle-filled tracks across a variety of unique biomes and dangerous locations. From collapsing bridges and deadly traps to crazy jumps and narrow paths, every run is a challenge.

Play solo or with a friend in local split-screen co-op. In Chained Drivers, both vehicles are connected by a chain, meaning every move matters. Pull your partner to safety… or accidentally drag them into disaster!

Looking for a different experience? Try additional game modes without the chain, challenge yourself in hardcore mode with no checkpoints, or relax in Free Drive mode where you can explore the map, hit ramps, perform stunts, and enjoy the satisfying vehicle physics and destruction system.

Watch your truck bend, break apart, lose wheels, and barely survive intense crashes thanks to dynamic vehicle damage and physics-based gameplay.

Every run tracks your completion time, so improve your skills, beat your records, and master every obstacle.

Features:

▶ Local split-screen multiplayer
▶ Unique chained co-op gameplay
▶ Huge obstacle-filled maps
▶ Multiple biomes and locations
▶ Hardcore mode with no checkpoints
▶ Free Drive sandbox mode
▶ Dynamic vehicle damage and destruction
▶ Physics-based driving chaos
▶ Time records and replayability

Can you survive the road together?

70010000128227.name: Taxi Life Simulator
70010000128227.intro: Pick up passengers, drive, repeat. Your taxi career starts here.
70010000128227.description:
Build your career as a city taxi driver in Taxi Life Simulator. Pick up passengers, navigate through the city, and deliver them safely to their destinations while earning money from every completed trip.

Every passenger brings a new journey and another opportunity to grow. Explore the city streets, manage your time, choose your routes, and work toward earning enough to improve your vehicle or eventually get behind the wheel of a new car.

As your career develops, you can also personalize your driver and give your vehicle a look that suits you. Start with a simple taxi and work your way toward becoming a successful driver known throughout the city.

70010000128260.name: Dragon Soul
70010000128260.intro: Forge your legend in a brutal fantasy world inspired by classic action RPGs. Master fast-paced melee combat, dodge deadly attacks, and collect lost souls to upgrade your warrior.
70010000128260.description:
Enter a dark and dangerous fantasy realm where every battle tests your skill, timing, and courage. In this challenging third-person action RPG, you play as a lone warrior fighting through cursed lands filled with deadly enemies, hidden dangers, and towering bosses inspired by classic soulslike adventures.

Master responsive melee combat, dodge devastating attacks, and strike back with precision as you explore atmospheric environments packed with secrets and rewards. Gather souls from fallen foes to strengthen your character, improve your abilities, and adapt your combat style to survive increasingly difficult encounters.

Use powerful sword-throwing attacks, tactical movement, and careful resource management to overcome relentless enemies and massive boss battles. Your journey culminates in an epic final confrontation against a colossal dragon in a cinematic showdown that will push your skills to the limit.

With stylized visuals, intense combat, rewarding progression, and unforgettable encounters, this adventure delivers a thrilling action RPG experience for players who crave challenge, exploration, and legendary battles.

70010000128276.name: Taxi Crew Simulator
70010000128276.intro: Passengers are waiting, journeys are calling.
70010000128276.description:
The city is full of people who need a ride - and you're the one who gets them there.

Take orders, pick up passengers, navigate through city streets, and deliver them to their destinations. Every completed trip keeps you moving and brings a new passenger, a new destination, and a new challenge.

Learn the city, discover new routes, and become more confident behind the wheel as you take on more rides. Keep an eye on your surroundings, choose your routes wisely, and make every trip count.
From your first ride to becoming a trusted driver, every journey is another step forward.

70010000128321.name: Tilt it! Golf
70010000128321.description:
Tilt The Entire Course
Mini-golf just got flipped on its head. Instead of swinging the club, you tilt the entire course to guide the ball to the hole. Master momentum, angles, and gravity as you roll through tricky hazards, dodge obstacles, and sink the perfect shot.

300 Holes Across 15 Unique Biomes
Tee off across 300 levels spread throughout 15 biomes, each introducing new mechanics, hazards, and twists. From precision putts to gravity-defying trick shots, every course challenges your ability to read the green.

Chase the Perfect Round
Quick-fire levels and instant restarts make it easy to jump back in for just one more putt. Shave seconds off your time, refine your line, and master that “motion-in-one” perfect shot.

A Budget-Friendly Birdie
Packed with hours of gameplay, replayability, and satisfying physics-based challenges, Tilt it! Golf delivers a full round of fun for about the price of a coffee. No expensive country club membership required.

70010000128359.name: Murder on the Disorient Express
70010000128359.intro:
An interactive murder mystery on the world famous train!
Step into the role of a cunning detective tasked with solving a perplexing murder before time runs out.
70010000128359.description:
William James Magnus III has been murdered, and you’re the only one with the investigative know-how to interrogate the other passengers and find the true culprit. But, with the train barreling towards the station, you only have so much time to solve the case before the murderer gets away.

Framed as a classic choose-your-own-adventure novel, Murder on the Disorient Express takes the best aspects of your favorite mystery novels and adds an interactive twist. Choose who you speak to, what you investigate, collect evidence, and make your final deduction based on limited information. Choose wisely, or the culprit will get off scot-free.

With only so many possible conversations to have and options to explore, Murder on the Disorient Express can’t be fully experienced in one playthrough. Take different paths and follow different leads to get a complete view of the events in additional playthroughs.

Talk with a cast of colorful characters, collect clues, and manage your time to seek out over a dozen possible endings. Unlock them all to see the full story.

70010000128413.name: Junkyard Builder: King Of Scrap
70010000128413.description:
In Junkyard Builder: King Of Scrap, the ultimate version to experience the game,  you’re the proud owner of a once-forgotten junkyard, now brimming with endless potential. Dive into the satisfying world of restoration, recycling, and raw hustle as you transform trash into treasure and rise to become the ruler of the junk empire!

Hunt for Treasure: Drive to new locations and explore the world for rare finds.

Make Money & Upgrade: Make the most of the items you find and earn money to level up your skills, buy the machines, and unlock better tools to streamline your operations.

Process Trash: Process the junk to make it more valuable. Every bit counts!

Find Rare Items: Search the junk for valuable items like money or gold bars.

Restore & Renovate: Bring old, rusty items back to life—whether it’s an old car or dilapidated furniture, your skills can make them valuable again.

Master the Machines: Operate powerful tools and machinery, from tower cranes to scrap presses that can crush entire cars.

Try Your Luck: Spend your hard-earned cash on mystery containers and uncover the surprises hidden inside. Will you strike it rich or find nothing but junk?

Grab your work gloves, fire up the machines, and get ready to rake in the profits—because in this junkyard, one person’s trash is your ticket to wealth. Build your junk empire and become the king of scrap!

70010000128415.name: Motorhome: Traveling North America 4 Collector's Edition
70010000128415.intro: Remember that feeling of wind in your hair and the endless road?
70010000128415.description:
You've already traveled with us from Portland to Florida, but the adventures don't end here! 
This time, the beloved family returns behind the wheel to take part in America's grand motorhome rally.
In Motorhome: Traveling America 4, expect the same warm encounters and cozy evenings, but now the route is full of unexpected twists. 
This isn't a race for speed, it's a competition of impressions, where every day brings new stories.

Why you'll love this game:
- Exciting adventures! From everyday moments at the laundromat to thrilling tales of catching thieves.
- The spirit of freedom behind the wheel: join a friendly motorhome race, discovering hidden paths and secret locations along the route.
- Collect memories: Gather unique souvenirs — instead of baseball caps, now you'll find memorable keepsakes from each state.
- Preserve the moments: Take photos for your family album, continuing your personal travel story.

70010000128429.name: Blast Dash
70010000128429.description:
Charge down endless action-packed tracks in a fast-paced hyper casual runner shooter where every second counts. Blast through waves of enemies using dual guns while constantly sprinting forward, moving side to side to avoid danger, jumping over obstacles, and ducking under deadly hazards.

Each run lasts around 30 to 40 seconds and delivers nonstop arcade action. Enemies block your path and fire back, forcing you to react quickly and shoot accurately to survive. Break through walls by unloading enough bullets to destroy them before impact, and stay alert for dangerous traps including spinning spikes, saw blades, and rotating obstacles designed to stop your run.

As the challenge increases, use the coins earned during gameplay to upgrade your fire rate, shooting distance, and reload timing to become stronger and push further into harder stages. Unlock new character skins and powerful weapon designs to customize your style while taking on increasingly intense runs.

Easy to pick up and hard to put down, this endless runner shooter combines fast reflex gameplay with satisfying upgrades and nonstop action.

70010000128435.name: System Shock® 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000128435.intro: How can you challenge a perfect, immortal machine?
70010000128435.description:
System Shock® 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster by Nightdive Studios brings to you the modernized remaster of the FPS/RPG classic, featuring Cross-Play Co-Op multiplayer and more.

It’s the year 2114 and as you awake from cryo sleep on the FTL ship Von Braun, you are unable to remember who or where you are… and something has gone terribly wrong. Hybrid mutants and deadly robots roam the halls while the cries from the remaining crew reverberate through the cold hull of the ship. SHODAN, a rogue AI bent on the destruction of mankind has taken over and it's up to you to stop her.

Delve through the corridors of the derelict ship Von Braun and immerse yourself in the story rich atmosphere and environments. Explore deck by deck and unravel the horrifying fate of the Von Braun and her crew.


System Shock® 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster Key Features:

Cross-Play Co-Op multiplayer.
         
Choose from 3 branches of the Military; O.S.A, Marines or Navy and experiment with different play styles.
         
Enhanced Characters, Weapon Models and Animations.

Optimized Controller support.
         
Quality of Life Improvements.

70010000128451.name: Machine of Madness
70010000128451.intro: A dark, atmospheric adventure inspired by classic storytelling, where you explore the eerie mansion of Dr. Jeffrey. Featuring hand-drawn visuals, gothic horror vibes.
70010000128451.description:
As you investigate the mansion and its surrounding laboratories, you’ll uncover cryptic clues, interact with unusual mechanisms, and slowly piece together the story behind the doctor’s terrifying machine. Hand-crafted pixel-art visuals, moody environments, and a haunting soundtrack create an immersive gothic atmosphere that pays homage to classic adventure and horror games while delivering its own unique identity.

Designed for players who enjoy mystery, retro aesthetics, and thoughtful exploration, The machine of madness offers a suspenseful journey through secrets, experiments, and forgotten memories where every room hides another piece of the puzzle.

70010000128469.name: Down Pit
70010000128469.description:
Down Pit is a relaxed mining platform game set across many off-world underground locations. You are a cuboid mining unit with a singular skill set sent out to extract ore from strange underground places.

Dig.
Get Paid.
Upgrade.
Relax, maybe.
Collect.
Go Back Down Pit.
Dig.

Find your favourite location and dig all the ore. Return to Ore Processing and get paid.  All the pit locations from The Depot can be remined infinitely, for free - no unlocks, bail at any time with no penalty. Dig in your favourite mine again and again, and get paid.

Yes to Digging.
Yes to Getting Paid.

No to enemies, combat, secrets, story, unlocks, card games, skill trees, pets, fishing, timers, npc interruptions, never ending dialogue, walls of text, power of friendship, ancient evil force, lost parents, lost items, lost love, missing pets, self-asteem whining, neuroses listing, dot dot dotting, time wasting, anime, pixel art, anime inspired pixel art, faff.

Dig. And Get Paid.

There’s unlimited money to make with just you and all those mining areas to destroy, one block at a time. You arrive ready to mine, all equipment supplied, all ready to work. All the money is yours because only you will mine it out.

Teleport Down Pit is to the left (Dig).
Ore Processing is to the right (Get Paid).

Lots of other utilities are in The Depot but be careful not to get too distracted, some are costly, some will drain your time. Warning: the poker game does not work and never will (it is a long term programming issue caused by a fool).

Dig. And Get Paid.

70010000128473.name: The Convenience Store
70010000128473.intro: Terror Lurks in a Late-Night Convenience Store!
70010000128473.description:
A short horror game starring a female college student working the night shift at a convenience store.

The hit horror game from the acclaimed horror game development team Chilla's Art is now available on Nintendo Switch™!

●Additional Features
-Includes a brand-new ending not available in the original PC version.

-Collect the mascot character "Chillamaru" scattered throughout the map to trigger changes inside the convenience store.

●Story
A female college student living alone takes a part-time job at a convenience store, drawn by the unusually high hourly wage.

As she works the night shift, she begins to encounter a series of strange and terrifying supernatural events.

What fate awaits her at the end of this nightmare?

70010000128476.name: Can You Make the Cut? Worldwide Common Sense Check
70010000128476.intro:
Could you hold your own anywhere in the world?
The global common sense every grown-up should know.
70010000128476.description:
Is your "common sense" really up to global standards?

Which one is the Nile? Who built the pyramids? What's the largest planet in our solar system?
You should know these — but when asked, the answer slips away.
How far does your knowledge really reach?

This game serves up 50 visual quiz questions across 8 categories: nature, geography, astronomy, science, history, sports, food, and art & culture — all rooted in worldwide common sense.

Read the question, then choose the correct answer from 4 images.
"Oh, I know this!" or "Wait, which one is it?"
Compare and decide — a 4-choice visual quiz.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question
・Pick the correct answer from 4 images
・Stuck? Open the hint for a clue
・After answering, learn more from the detailed explanation

Get it right and feel great. Miss it and learn something new.
By question 50, the world feels a little closer.

Squeeze in a quick brain refresh on your commute, on a break, or before bed.
Perfect for sparking "Did you know?" conversations with family and friends.

So — can you make the cut?
Take on the worldwide common sense challenge.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.

70010000128483.name: Whys & Wonders Secrets of Our Bodies
70010000128483.intro:
Are Your Bones Really Harder Than Steel?!
Become a Body Expert Through Fun Quizzes
70010000128483.description:
Discover surprising facts about the human body through fun and engaging quiz challenges!

・How many times do we blink in an hour?
・How many more bones does a baby have than an adult?
・If the Earth were flat, how far could the human eye see?

Learn fascinating trivia about the human body that you'll be excited to share with friends.

The game also includes a helpful Hint feature, making it enjoyable for players of all knowledge levels.

Looking for a fun and easy way to learn about the human body in your spare time? This game is a great place to start.

Recommended for people who:
・Love trivia and fun facts
・Want to expand their knowledge
・Enjoy testing themselves
・Like brain-training games while passing the time
・Dream of working in a medical or healthcare field

※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000128489.name: Whys & Wonders Secrets of the Universe
70010000128489.intro:
What Does Space Smell Like?!
Become a Space Expert Through Fun Quizzes
70010000128489.description:
Discover surprising facts about space through fun and engaging quiz challenges!

・Which planet rotates the fastest?
・What existed before the Sun was born?
・What does outer space smell like?

Learn fascinating space trivia that you’ll be excited to share with friends.

Complete all the quizzes and earn your place as a true space expert!

The game also includes a helpful Hint feature, making it enjoyable for players of all knowledge levels.

Looking for a fun and easy way to learn about space in your spare time? This game is a great place to start.

Recommended for people who:
・Love space and astronomy
・Want to expand their knowledge
・Enjoy testing themselves
・Like brain-training games while passing the time
・Dream of becoming an astronaut

※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000128499.name: VTBattle It’s Not About Subscribers! It’s All About Power.
70010000128499.intro:
Choose your “oshi” from 350+ VTubers!
Battle your way through Roguelike, Card Game, and Auto-Battle gameplay!
70010000128499.description:
■ Build Your Team with Your Favorite VTubers!
Over 350 VTubers from a wide range of genres—including game streamers, singers, ASMR creators, and illustrators—join the battle!

Every VTuber featured in the game can be used as your protagonist. Choose your favorite VTuber and take on the challenge!

■ Extensive Card Collection
Each of the 350+ VTubers has cards with different rarities!
Collect every card featuring your favorite VTubers and complete your collection!

■ Game System
Experience a unique blend of Card Game × Auto-Battle × Roguelite gameplay.
Set five cards and strengthen stats such as HP, ATK, DEF, MAG, MDEF, and SPD to defeat your rivals. Collect stronger cards as you progress and take on increasingly powerful opponents!

■ Skills & Levels — Every Card Has a Chance to Shine!
A card's strength is determined by its level and rarity, rather than the character itself.

Cards featuring the same VTuber can have different levels, while higher-rarity cards come with additional skills.

This means every card has its own potential and can play an important role in your strategy!

■ Estimated Playtime
A single run takes approximately 1–2 hours to complete.

With card and skill collection, you can enjoy 100+ hours of gameplay!

■ Live Streaming
Monetization
Monetization of live streams and videos featuring this game is permitted.

Monetization through video-sharing websites and live-streaming platforms is also permitted.

Streaming Content
You may stream all scenes and content from the game.

Other Guidelines
There are no specific restrictions on streaming the game as long as it is used within the scope of normal gameplay and content creation.

However, the game features many VTubers. Please remember to treat all featured creators with respect.

70010000128506.name: Retro Asylum
70010000128506.intro: A psychological horror experience where isolation is your greatest enemy. Explore abandoned asylum, uncover disturbing secrets.
70010000128506.description: Trapped within a decaying asylum consumed by darkness and despair, you must uncover the horrifying truth hidden behind its abandoned halls. In this psychological horror experience, isolation becomes your greatest enemy as disturbing echoes, twisted visions, and unseen threats blur the line between reality and madness. Explore oppressive environments, solve unsettling mysteries, and survive terrifying encounters where every sound could be your last. The deeper you descend into the asylum, the more the past refuses to stay buried.

70010000128534.name: Mystery at Rainy Night Manor: The Missing Invitation
70010000128534.intro:
A mystery in a rainy manor
Read the clues and observe
Find the hidden truth
70010000128534.description:
On a stormy night, guests gather at an old manor.
Use the text and illustrations as clues to uncover the mystery behind a missing invitation.

The rules are simple.
Read each question, observe the people and objects on the screen, and choose the answer that seems most suspicious.
Each correct choice brings you one step closer to the truth.

Explore atmospheric scenes such as the entrance hall, guest rooms, and portrait gallery, each with its own mystery to solve.

No complicated controls are needed, making it easy to enjoy for mystery fans and first-time puzzle players alike.
When you get stuck, hints help you keep going and think through each case at your own pace.

Recommended for players who enjoy:
・Short mystery puzzles
・Reading text and finding clues in illustrations
・Observation, deduction, and brain-training games
・Playing solo or discussing the answer with family and friends
・Classic manor mysteries with invitations, servants, secrets, and suspicious guests

Listen to the rain, examine every clue, and reveal the truth hidden inside the manor.

70010000128546.name: Train Plus Japan Drive Western Japan Trains! Rapid Service Edition
70010000128546.intro: Drive real JR-West trains! An authentic, officially licensed railway driving game.
70010000128546.description:
Take the controls of real JR-West trains in this authentic railway driving game, officially licensed by West Japan Railway Company (JR-West).

■ The exhilaration of the Special Rapid Service

Drive the famous Special Rapid Service non-stop from the very first station of the Keishin Line all the way to the terminus. On quadruple-track sections, blast past local trains one after another for a rush of speed only this train can deliver. Direct Rapid and local services are fully drivable too.

■ Every line, every section, both directions

Three fictional lines inspired by the region — the Ohan East Line, Ohan West Line, and Keishin Line — with every section drivable in both directions. A massive amount of track that rewards every hour you put in.

■ Drivable trains

Drive the 221, 223, 207, and 321 Series, plus the 227 Series appearing as a special test-run train.

■ A series first: the driving score system

Your accuracy behind the controls — departing on time, passing stations on schedule, keeping to speed limits, stopping precisely at the mark — is rated as a score, so you can feel yourself improving with every run.

■ Boost your score with your card deck

Set cards in your deck before each run. Meet the scoring conditions to earn bonus points based on each card's multiplier.

The cards feature a spectacular lineup of 14 train series, including limited express trains: the 223, 221, 321, 207, 227, 287, 283, 289, 281, 271, 683, 225, 115, and 485 Series.

Match cards of the same type to double their values with Chemistry, collect cards of the same station for a station score bonus, and upgrade your cards to build the ultimate deck. New cards are obtained through an in-game gacha — there are no paid purchases.

Struggling with the controls? A clever deck can still carry you to victory. A master driver with a weak deck will find high scores out of reach. Driving skill and deck strategy: two ways to play, one deep experience.

■ Mascon controller support

Compatible with the ZUIKI MasCon for Nintendo Switch™ and the Densha de GO!! One Handle Controller for Nintendo Switch™ (電車でGO!!専用ワンハンドルコントローラー for Nintendo Switch™) for an even more realistic driver experience.

■ Recommended for

- Train and railway fans

- Anyone who loves Japan's Kansai region

- Deck-building and card game enthusiasts

- Owners of a mascon-style train controller

In-game languages: Japanese, English

70010000128587.name: Punch Monkey Revenge
70010000128587.intro:
They took his favorite toy.
Now this little monkey is fighting through the whole school to get it back.
70010000128587.description:
They took his favorite toy. They picked the wrong monkey.

What was supposed to be the first day of school turns into an all-out rescue mission when a gang of bullies steals Punch Monkey’s most treasured possession.

PUNCH MONKEY REVENGE is a stylish action adventure packed with slow-motion stunts, fast combos, cartoon chaos, and one very determined little primate.

Slow down time in mid-air to dodge attacks, dive through danger, and pull off the perfect comeback. Chain together punches, kicks, spins, tumbles, and environmental attacks as you fight your way through classrooms, hallways, playgrounds, and more.

Turn almost anything into a weapon. Grab slingshots, banana guns, lunch trays, dodgeballs, and whatever else you can get your hands on to send the school’s toughest bullies flying.

Every encounter is built for cinematic action and slapstick comedy. Leap over attacks, improvise with your surroundings, and turn each fight into your own over-the-top action scene.

The bullies have the toy.

Punch Monkey is coming to get it back.

• Stylish slow-motion action
• Fast, expressive combo combat
• Ridiculous weapons and environmental attacks
• Cartoon comedy and cinematic stunts
• Battle through a school full of increasingly tough troublemakers
• One small monkey with a very big reason to fight

70010000128629.name: Memorize the Evidence.1-Minute Memory Mystery
70010000128629.intro:
60 seconds to memorize the scene.
Can you find the missing evidence in your mind?
70010000128629.description:
Could your observation and memory rival a master detective's?

"Wait... what color was the sofa?"
"Was there an animal by the window?"
The more you try to recall, the more the scene fades away.

This game is a memory puzzle where you step into a detective's shoes. Memorize each scene for 60 seconds, then answer 4-choice questions about the tiny "evidence" hidden in the details.

Crime scenes, dusty studies, attics, gardens, train compartments…
Burn the details of many different scenes into your memory.

How to play is simple.
・Observe every corner of the screen for 60 seconds
・When the image is masked, answer the 4-choice question
・Get it right and the original scene reappears

The frustration of "I didn't notice that!" and the satisfaction of "Got it!"
Solve the mysteries of all 50 stages with your memory alone.

Quick to play in short sessions, perfect for training observation and memory like a true detective.
Squeeze in some brain exercise on your commute, during a break, or before bed.

Find the missing evidence — in your mind.
Can your memory uncover the truth?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.

70010000128636.name: Another Eden Begins Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000128636.intro: Now begins an RPG beyond time and space
70010000128636.description:
A time-traveling RPG adventure from Masato Kato, creator of countless classic RPGs
Product Summary
Aldo embarks on an adventure beyond time and space to save his sister, Feinne, from the clutches of the beastfolk.

A richly woven tale by scenario writer and director, Masato Kato, unfolds across the ages, alongside a main theme composed by Yasunori Mitsuda, music incorporating traditional folk instruments and an orchestra by Procyon Studios, and a stellar voice cast.

The strategic command battles, which feature exhilarating actions like chain skills that trigger successive strikes, and Another Force that allows a barrage of attacks, can be fought with original parties composed from a total of 19 characters.

After clearing the main story, New Game+ offers a new adventure filled with new faces and over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆Strategic Command Battles
The lands of Another Eden are rife with monsters—run into them to initiate a command-based battle and take them down.
Create your own original parties, unleash chain skills, and create chains to trigger successive strikes!
Unleash a flurry of attacks with Another Force to beat your enemy into submission!

◆Befriend and Forge Meaningful Bonds with 18 Allies
18 allies of different races and eras await Aldo on his journey.
Allies' stories are told through various quests. Encounter quests depict their first meeting with Aldo, character quests reveal their past and purpose, and kinship quests explore their relationship with Aldo.

◆Embark on a New Adventure with New Game+
Complete the main story to unlock New Game+ and embark on a new adventure with your allies as they are!
New Game+ also introduces a brand-new character, Ramiu, and features over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆New Features to Enrich Your Time-Traveling Adventure
Enrich your adventure beyond time and space by logging the feline friends you encounter in the cat catalog, and creating weapons, armor, and food from different eras with the crafting feature.

70010000128645.name: Manga English Native Phrase Quiz
70010000128645.intro:
Master the business English native speakers actually use!
Have fun leveling up your skills through quizzes!
70010000128645.description:
"I'm just playing a game, but somehow my workplace English is getting better."
Want to experience this ultimate two-for-one deal?

Enjoy 4-choice quizzes while quickly mastering the "real-life English idioms" that native speakers naturally use in business settings.

Playing is super easy：
・Read the question and the target word carefully.
・Pick your answer from the 4 choices.
・Get it right to unlock detailed explanations you can use right away in your actual business emails and conversations!

No typing or complicated controls needed!
It's totally fine if you're feeling a bit rusty with your English.

If you get stuck, our friendly hint feature has your back. You can soak up knowledge like a fun trivia game, completely stress-free with no ""Game Over"" screens to worry about.

Thanks to the fast-paced, one-question-at-a-time format, it's perfect for sneaking in some playtime during your daily commute or while waiting for a meeting to start!

Turn your daily ""mindless screen time"" into meaningful self-investment. Level up your English skills and seriously impress your coworkers and business partners!

70010000128660.name: Beach Volleyball Girls: Hot Spike
70010000128660.intro:
The roster's stacked. One spot left. Win it, and win them.
Think you've got what it takes to make the cut?
70010000128660.description:
The summer roster has one spot left, and every player on the sand wants it just as bad as you do. Off the court, the real competition starts.

One reads every move you make and expects the same back. One only warms up once you've earned it. Another flirts hard until the score gets close, then turns cold and competitive without warning. And the captain trusts no one who hasn't proven they belong.

Say the right thing and the tension breaks. Say the wrong thing and you're benched. 

Thirty days until the season opener, and every day you waste, someone else closes the gap.


Features:

● A ROSTER FULL OF COMPETITIVE PERSONALITIES: A deep bench, and every player is a completely different game to win. Some want a rival. Some want a partner. All of them want proof.

● DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: Every response you give shifts the dynamic. Push too hard and you lose ground. Read the room right and the walls start coming down.

● CHARACTER AFFINITY SYSTEM: Build real trust through practices, downtime, and late-night talks after the lights go out. The harder she is to reach, the more it means when she lets you in.

● EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Unlock stunning illustrations as each relationship deepens. Every player has her own story waiting past the final point.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your run through the season is yours alone. Some routes end in romance. Some end with you watching from the bench.

● 30 DAYS TO MAKE THE TEAM: The season opener is locked in and the clock doesn't wait. Every wasted day is a spot someone else claims instead of you.


One roster. One summer. Only one of you makes the team and it might not be you.

Who are you willing to fight for?

70010000128670.name: Scritchy Scratchy
70010000128670.intro: Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots. Will you play it safe or go all-in?
70010000128670.description:
Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game where luck is your weapon, and glittering riches are just a scratch away.

Dive into a growing collection of scratchers, each with its own quirks, surprises, and sometimes downsides. Rip through tickets, uncover rare symbols, tweak your own luck, and chase absurd payouts.

Unlock Scratch Bot, your tireless mechanical friend who scratches and reveals the rewards for you. Turn your run into a full-blown jackpot engine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and relax.

As you prosper, you’ll unlock upgrades that twist luck in your favor:

• Boosted odds and payouts
• Faster and easier scratching 
• New scratch card variants with unique rules

But power always comes with risk. Some cards tempt you with monstrous payouts at the cost of nasty penalties. Some offer steady income… others threaten your entire run. Will you play like a sensible adult or gamble like a degenerate in a neon casino?

When you’re ready for even more madness, Prestige to reset your run, gather Jack Points, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape your strategy. Build your own luck engine: Slow and steady, wildly explosive, or pure chaos.

Scritchy Scratchy is a dangerously satisfying progression casino, where every scratch is a little dopamine hit, and every run is one lucky break away from the big jackpot!

70010000128717.name: I Did Not Buy This Ticket
70010000128717.intro: Weep for the dead! In this short psychological horror story, play as a professional mourner travelling between funerals. Ride a nightmarish bus whose destination depends on your choices.
70010000128717.description:
Candelaria travels from one funeral to the next, weeping for the departed she has never met in life, going on long night treks that keep her insomnia at bay.

When she comes across a bus ticket she did not buy to the mysterious Eigengrau Line, she is forced to confront traumas from the past and define a new course for her life.

ITINERARY

Get aboard a short, atmospheric story by Tiago Rech, award-winning author of TELEFORUM, Dodgeball Academia, No Place for Bravery, and Galaxy of Pen & Paper.

What is your destination? Find 5+ endings created by your choices.

Experience a unique, dark art style in 4K resolution.

Interact with bizarre passengers during a surreal journey.

Go to funerals, weep for the dead.

Find yourself amidst your traumas... or run away forever.

70010000128751.name: Spot It in the Picture!WorldwideKnowledge × Academic Quiz
70010000128751.intro:
Where's the heart? Which one is the stamen? Which moon is full?
That diagram from school — open it up again.
70010000128751.description:
Your school days are long gone — but is the knowledge still with you?

The human body, parts of a flower, phases of the moon, a volcano's cross-section —
You should remember them, but when asked "where is it?" your finger hesitates.
Can your knowledge spot the one correct point in the picture?

This game offers 50 questions across 6 categories: human body, plants, animals, landforms, sky & space, and architecture.
Tap the correct part of a textbook-style illustration — a knowledge × academic quiz.

"Where is the heart?" "Which one is the stamen?" "Which is the first-quarter moon?" "Where is a volcano's crater?"
There's only one correct spot in each image. Observe carefully and tap with what you know.

How to play is simple.
・Look closely at the diagram
・Tap the part being asked about
・Stuck? Open the hint for a clue about the part's role or feature

Get it right and feel sharper. Miss it and finally see how it works.
By question 50, the world inside the diagrams feels much closer.

Squeeze in a relaxed brush-up on your commute, on a break, or before bed.
Perfect for swapping "Where is this?" challenges with family and friends.

Know the world, and the answer shows up.
So — can you spot it in the picture?

70010000128860.name: Merge Assault
70010000128860.description:
Enter a fast-paced hyper casual merging game where strategy and destruction combine in satisfying arcade action. Build a team of powerful monsters on a 5 by 4 grid and send them charging down lanes packed with breakable blocks. Press dash and every monster rushes forward in its lane, smashing into obstacles, bouncing back, and attacking again until the blocks are destroyed.

Each lane contains different types of blocks, with some requiring far more power to break through than others. As levels progress, the lanes become longer and tougher, challenging you to constantly improve your team and create stronger monsters capable of pushing further than ever before.

Earn coins by destroying blocks during every dash and use them to buy new monsters for your grid. Start with basic level 1 monsters and combine matching monsters together by dragging them onto each other. Every merge creates a stronger monster at the next level, allowing you to continue upgrading all the way up to powerful level 30 monsters.

To complete a stage, at least one monster must smash through every block in its lane and reach the treasure waiting at the end. Claim huge coin rewards, unlock the next challenge, and keep merging to survive increasingly difficult levels filled with stronger obstacles and longer paths.

Easy to learn and satisfying to master, this hyper casual merge game delivers nonstop progression, rewarding upgrades, and addictive destruction with every dash.

70010000128869.name: Papercraft Tactics
70010000128869.intro: A grid-inventory roguelike where you rotate and wire items together. Connect wands, potions, and swords to trigger automated, chain-reaction combat.
70010000128869.description:
Arrange, rotate, and link weapons, potions, and magical wands on a grid to align inputs and outputs. When a turn starts, your backpack comes alive: links fire, effects cascade, and your custom combos automatically fill the action queue. Draft new items, manage deep elemental resistances, and nudge the battlefield with tactical card plays in a charming, cozy paper-theater world.

Key Features
The Living Backpack: Your inventory is your build. Rotate and position items to connect green inputs and yellow outputs, forging automated synergies.

Chain-Reaction Combat: At the start of your turn, linked items trigger sequentially to execute actions (Attack, Block, InflictEffect) without hidden rules.

Tactical Card Play: Don't just watch. Play clutch, limited-use cards mid-turn to manipulate the queue—double a hit, purge a debuff, or force an instant trigger.

Draft & Adapt: Build around distinct hero passives and draft unique scaling or mimic items to counter shifting enemy resistance profiles.

Paper-Theater Aesthetic: Lose yourself in a warm, handmade world featuring hand-drawn cut-out characters and cozy stage lighting.

70010000128883.name: Far Primal Survival
70010000128883.intro: Can you become the ultimate hunter in a world ruled by nature?
70010000128883.description:
Step into a world ruled by nature, where every sound, footprint, and movement can mean the difference between hunter and prey. Far Primal Survival is an atmospheric prehistoric hunting adventure set 10,000 years ago, where survival depends on patience, awareness, and skill.

Explore untamed territories, track dangerous animals, move silently through tall grass, and use primitive weapons to bring down your prey. Every hunt is a test of your instincts, preparation, and ability to adapt to the wilderness.

Key Features
	•	Track Your Prey – Follow animal tracks and locate hidden prey.
	•	Use Primitive Weapons – Hunt with bows, spears, and clubs.
	•	Complete Hunting Quests – Take on objectives across the wilderness.
	•	Explore 20 Territories – Discover diverse prehistoric environments.
	•	Master the Hunt – Stay hidden, strike carefully, and survive.


The wilderness is vast.
The prey is unpredictable.
Only the patient become the hunter.

70010000128905.name: Homebound Plush
70010000128905.intro:
Unfortunately, the teddy bear was left behind, and now your mission is to help him find his way home.
Face a unique boss at the end of every level!
70010000128905.description:
Embark on a charming adventure with a teddy bear who was accidentally forgotten by a young boy during a move and must now set out on a journey to reunite with his owner. Run, jump, and explore vibrant pixel art levels, facing enemies and traveling through a variety of environments, including houses, gardens, and city streets.

Collect special items along the way to aid your adventure.

Each level features its own exciting boss battle.

With precise controls, moderate challenges, and a cozy atmosphere, this is the perfect adventure for fans of classic 16-bit platformers. Test your skills through a fun and heartwarming journey filled with charm for players of all ages.

70010000128937.name: Peaceful Bug Catching Story
70010000128937.intro:
Pick up your bug net and set off on a grand summer adventure.
Your bug-collecting summer vacation is about to begin!
70010000128937.description:
Enjoy the slow life in a peaceful countryside village.
Hunt for bugs in forests, bamboo groves, rivers, and more.
Meet the villagers, make new friends, and create unforgettable summer memories.

Insects from across the globe gather in the mysterious woods.
Legendary insects are even said to dwell deep within.
Fill out your Bug Records and become a master bug collector!

[Simple Bug Catching]
Bug catching controls are simple!
Approach without startling the bug, then swing your net at the right time!
Catch the bugs before they escape!

[70+ Species to Catch!]
Catch bugs native to Japan as well as from around the world!
Complete your Bug Records by collecting data on every bug you catch.
Find every species and hunt for record-breaking sizes!

[Collect Bug Nets and Items]
Save up your allowance to buy new bug nets and items for bug catching.
Use items to increase your chances of finding rare and large bugs!

[Bug Battles]
Put the bugs you've caught to the test in exciting battles!
Knock your opponent's bug out of the battle zone!
Find the strongest bug you can and become the champion!

[Interact with the Villagers]
Spend time with your friends and the local villagers.
Help them out, play minigames, and enjoy summer vacation to its fullest!

[Decorate Your Secret Base!]
Freely decorate your secret base with the furniture you collect.
Pick your favorite items to display and make the space your own!

[Online Rankings]
Compete to capture as many bugs as you can within the time limit in Score Attack!
Climb the leaderboards with your best Score Attack score and total bugs caught.
Test your skills against players from around the world!

70010000128944.name: Tennis Legend 2026
70010000128944.intro: Get ready for intense clashes on the most challenging courts!
70010000128944.description:
Grab your racket and face your rivals! Compete in prestigious tournaments, collect trophies and become world number one.

Equip yourself with top-class rackets and balls. Master your shots and perfect your forehand, backhand, serve and volley. Play in 10 stunning stadiums inspired by the most iconic real-world venues.

70010000128953.name: Too Accurate to Be Scary...Your True Feelings Revealed by This Image
70010000128953.intro:
What did you feel? That choice reveals your true self.
One image. Four feelings. Which one is yours?
70010000128953.description:
You picked one without thinking — but the reason hides deep inside.

"I just chose it... I don't really know why."
"I didn't even realize I felt that way."
The casual choices are the ones that reveal your true feelings.

This game is a simple psychological test where you look at a symbolic illustration and pick how it makes you feel from 4 choices. The moment you pick, a different "true feelings" diagnosis appears for each choice.

A path. A door. A mirror. A still water surface. A starry sky. An hourglass. A pair of scales. A birdcage —
50 universal symbolic motifs that resonate with anyone, anywhere, pull your hidden feelings to the surface.

How to play is simple.
・Look at the image and pick how you feel from 4 choices
・Read the "true feelings" diagnosis for your choice
・Move to the next image

"Too accurate to be scary..."
"I didn't know I felt this way."
50 questions, each one cutting from a different angle.

Because there is no right answer, you can play again and again — alone, with friends, with family.
A quick distraction or a serious self-check — light to start, deep when it lands.

Ready to have your true feelings revealed?

70010000128961.name: Professor Neumann's Adult Certification Test
70010000128961.intro: Does your knowledge really measure up?
70010000128961.description:
The basics of how the world works — how many can you actually answer?

Why is the sky blue? Why do dogs bond with humans? Why are pyramids shaped like that?
The everyday "why?" trips you up the moment you're asked. There's general knowledge every adult should hold.

This game offers 80 picture-based 4-choice questions across 8 categories — animals, nature, world landmarks, food & living, science, space, the human body, and culture & history — studied alongside Professor Neumann.

"What is this?" "Why does it happen?"
Look at the image, pick your answer, and let the explanation make it click.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question and look at the image
・Choose from 4 answers
・After answering, deepen your knowledge with Professor Neumann's explanation

Get it right and feel sharper. Miss it and find a fresh "huh, really?"
By question 80, the world will look a little richer.

Squeeze in a relaxed knowledge boost on your commute, on a break, or before bed.
Perfect for sparking "Did you know?" chats with family and friends.

World-class general knowledge, at your fingertips.
So — can you earn the adult certification?

70010000128979.name: Squad Legends - Battle Royale
70010000128979.intro: Enter the battlefield and prove your combat skills.
70010000128979.description:
Enter a fast-paced battlefield where every encounter can turn into a fight for control. Choose your character, arm yourself, and face the opposing team across detailed urban environments filled with buildings, obstacles, and strategic positions.

Move through the battlefield, track enemy movements, and use your surroundings to create opportunities. Whether you push forward aggressively or take time to find a better position, quick reactions and accurate shooting can determine the outcome of every confrontation.

Take part in team-based battles where individual skill and teamwork go hand in hand. 
Keep an eye on the score, support your teammates, manage your ammunition, and adapt your approach as the battle develops.

Choose the character that fits your style and return to the action after each elimination. Change your route, rethink your position, and get back into the fight to help your team turn the match around.

Key Features:
• Experience fast-paced 3D third-person combat
• Choose from multiple playable characters
• Battle opposing teams across urban-themed maps
• Use buildings, obstacles, and strategic areas to your advantage
• Manage weapons, ammunition, health, and reloads during combat
• Track the score and work together with your teammates
• Use the respawn system to quickly return to the battlefield
• Rely on reflexes, accuracy, positioning, and quick decisions

Choose your character, prepare for battle, and step onto the battlefield. Your next confrontation is waiting.

70010000129004.name: Blazblue Entropy Effect X – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000129004.description:
[Game Overview]  
A roguelite action game set in the BLAZBLUE universe, featuring striking 2D visuals, stylish, fast-paced combat, and precise, responsive controls.
Command a line-up of unique characters from the renowned BLAZBLUE franchise and dive into an unparalleled action experience.

[Story]
At a mysterious domain, known as “the Lab”, a group of elite researchers race to save a collapsing word; however, despite their efforts to date, Dr. Mercurius, head of the laboratory, still warns the world’s downfall is near.
In a last-ditch effort, the urgent Research of Possibility initiative seeks to collect "Shards of Possibility"—a special fragment of the world that could forestall the seemingly inevitable destruction.
These shards lie within the Sea of Possibility, a realm between worlds, beyond the bounds of reality.
Our protagonist, "Ace", is the only being capable of diving into this sea.  
Guided by the elite researchers at "the Lab", Ace descends again and again in pursuit of salvation—until strange visions take hold and his body begins to change.
As Ace continues to dive, countless memories flood his mind, and the truth behind the collapsing world—and the research itself—begins to surface....
“……The Power of Azure.”

70010000129031.name: Pet World
70010000129031.intro: Collect awesome pets, farm tons of gold, and discover Magical Kingdoms!
70010000129031.description:
Get ready for non-stop fun in Pet World!
Your favorite animals are here to help you build a massive empire. Drop into colorful worlds, tap into your pets' magical powers, and watch them smash obstacles to flood your screen with shiny gold coins!

Farm Gold, Buy Pets, Repeat!
The rules are simple but super fun: use your loyal pets to farm chests and treasures, collect mountainloads of gold, and use that wealth to hatch even stronger, mythical companions!

Unlock Legendary Kingdoms!
Got enough gold? Time to expand! Spend your riches to unlock brand-new, massive locations packed with even bigger treasures and rarer pets. Every new world brings bigger rewards and crazier pets to add to your ultimate collection. Can you unlock them all and become the richest explorer?

Key Features:

Super Fun Idle Action - Easy to play, hard to stop! Watch your pets farm gold even while you relax.

Hatch 150+ Cute Pets - Spend your gold coins to collect, level up, and upgrade legendary and cosmic companions!

Unlock New Worlds - Travel to ever-changing kingdoms that offer more riches and bigger challenges.

Fun for Everyone - Colorful 3D visuals and rewarding gameplay perfect for young tycoons!

70010000129040.name: Destroy The Universe: Solar Mayhem
70010000129040.intro: Choose a planet. Unleash cosmic weapons. Decide how the world ends.
70010000129040.description:
Pick your target and prepare to bring an entire world to a spectacular end.

Take command of devastating cosmic power and turn planets into your personal destruction experiments. Select a world, choose your weapon, and watch the catastrophe unfold. Tear through the surface, split the planet into fragments, trigger a colossal supernova, or unleash a black hole that consumes everything in its path.

Experiment with different tools and discover how each one changes the fate of your target. Clear, intuitive controls let newcomers begin destroying immediately while giving experienced players the freedom to stage their own cosmic catastrophes.

KEY FEATURES

• Choose from different planets
• Wield a variety of destructive cosmic weapons
• Tear planetary surfaces apart
• Trigger spectacular supernovas
• Unleash all-consuming black holes
• Experiment with space and physics using intuitive controls

How much destruction can one planet withstand? There is only one way to find out.

70010000129058.name: In The Dark Collection
70010000129058.intro:
A brain-teasing puzzle series where one simple rule stands between you and escape: turn out every light.
Both In The Dark games, together for the first time!
70010000129058.description:
Experience the complete In The Dark saga, a retro-inspired sci-fi puzzle collection. Across two interconnected adventures, you’ll uncover the mysteries surrounding abandoned spacecraft, strange transmissions, and unknown forces lurking beyond the stars.

What begins as a simple mission quickly spirals into something far greater. As systems fail and a deadly virus spreads, captain Ikalo Pann must uncover the truth hidden behind each light. Each puzzle solved brings you closer to answers and the truth behind the signal.

Featuring both In The Dark and In The Dark 2, this collection combines atmospheric storytelling with addictive light-based puzzle gameplay inspired by classic handheld experiences, and brings both games in the series together for the first time. Manipulate grids of lights, discover the patterns, and tackle hundreds of handcrafted puzzles across multiple gameplay modes.

In The Dark 2 expands the experience with larger puzzles, new gameplay mechanics, cinematic story sequences, unlockable content, and an arcade-inspired shoot’em up mini-game that deepens the universe and raises the stakes.

The In The Dark Collection delivers a relaxing yet rewarding nostalgic experience that can also be played in vertical mode with touch controls to better match the '90s feeling! A full-color journey, with plenty of color palettes to unlock as you play

70010000129092.name: Blast Off! Summer Showdown
70010000129092.intro:
Blast off and let the chaos begin!
Get ready for a red-hot, hilarious summer showdown!
70010000129092.description:
Dive into 10 unique and easy-to-play party games filled with summer fun!
Launch rocket fireworks at your rivals, slip and slide as somen noodles, and swipe fresh-grilled BBQ before anyone else can grab it!

Challenge CPU opponents in single-player, or battle it out with family and friends in a group of up to 4 players!
All 10 games also support online multiplayer, so you can take on players from around the world in head-to-head matches!

[Free Mode]
Pick your favorite game and jump right in!

[Party Mode]
Choose a series of games and play them back-to-back!
Compete for the highest total score to become the champion!

[Online Mode]
Hop into Quick Matches to challenge players from around the world right away!
Create your own room and enjoy matches with friends, no matter the distance!

[Included Minigames]
・Fire! Rocket Fireworks
・Somen Slide
・Float Ring Battlers
・Fan Blast!
・BBQ Grab Battle
・Frozen Treat Tower
・Beetle Battle
・Trick Surfing
・Sandal Toss
・Smack the Mosquitoes!

70010000129099.name: A Taste of Home
70010000129099.intro:
I broke the promise I made to my mother and went to visit a friend’s house.
That was where it all began.
70010000129099.description:
A short 3D exploration horror game set in a nostalgic Japanese countryside town.
Featuring multiple endings, with three different conclusions awaiting you.

●Story
Keita breaks his promise and visits a friend’s house while his mother is away for the day.

There, he begins to notice something unsettling about his mother.
A mysterious diary discovered at home… and the hidden secrets surrounding the house.

For some reason, his mother already knew that Keita had gone out to play.

And when she leaves again that night without returning, Keita sets out into the darkness to search for her...

70010000129132.name: Fruits Slot Machine
70010000129132.intro: Spin the reels and win multiple payouts and a legendary jackpot.
70010000129132.description:
Pull the lever and test your luck in Fruits Slot Machine — a simple, fast-paced slot machine game right in your console.
Choose your bet, spin the reels, and match the symbols to win. Land three of a kind for big payouts, or hit the rarest combination of all to claim the ultimate jackpot. Every spin could change everything.

Features:
-Minimum bet of $500 — high stakes only
-5 fruit symbols with different payout multipliers
-Auto-spin mode to keep the reels rolling hands-free
-Triple matches pay up to 10× your bet
-Land the secret rare combo for the JACKPOT

70010000129143.name: Warnet Life
70010000129143.description:
Transform a dusty room into the ultimate gaming hub! In Warnet Life, you become a budding entrepreneur tasked with building the most popular cyber cafe in town. Start from scratch by assembling custom computers, upgrading your hardware, and decorating your shop to reflect your personal style. As your reputation grows, so will your profits, enabling you to transform a small, empty room into a world-class digital empire.

Running a successful business isn't just about having fast internet and comfy chairs. It's about managing pure, unpredictable chaos. You have to be ready to fix sudden power outages, call a technician when the router crashes, and shoo away kids bothering your paying customers. You may even need to hire security to protect your valuable equipment from destructive vandals! When you aren't managing the shop, step outside to explore the vibrant city, complete quirky quests for the locals, and uncover hidden secrets. Collect cash, play entertaining minigames, and demonstrate that you have what it takes to survive the daily grind of the ultimate internet cafe!

Key Features:
• Build epic rigs: assemble custom, high-performance gaming PCs from scratch.
• Control the chaos: React quickly to dynamic events. Fix blown fuses, troubleshoot internet crashes, and keep the business running smoothly.
• Customize Everything: Paint, furnish, and decorate to create the ultimate gaming space.
• Defend your turf: Hire security to protect your shop from vandals, and personally chase out loiterers who annoy your paying customers.
• Explore the city: Step outside to meet quirky locals, uncover secrets, and complete quests.
• Take a Break: Relax and enjoy the fun arcade minigames scattered around town.

70010000129161.name: Gelatinous: Humanity Lost
70010000129161.intro: He came for ultimate power. He got it — sort of.
70010000129161.description:
Deep in the Amazon, a lone treasure hunter in search of Ultimate Power gets more than he bargains for when he's turned to goo and falls deep into the bowels of an ancient temple. As the gooey treasure hunter, you start with nothing. No powers. No weapons. Not even the ability to jump. Only by exploring the temple can you begin to understand and unleash the powers of the slime.

Keep playing to unlock new powers, own your enemies, and hopefully uncover the secret to regaining your humanity.

70010000129167.name: Banana Blood
70010000129167.intro: This is the banana horror game. They call it certain death. I call it an a-peeling adventure. Time to go bananas.
70010000129167.description:
Banana Blood is a first person comedy horror game about, well, bananas. You arrive at the banana farm that's surrounded by mystery and death and it's up to you to find out what's going on here. Weird banana creatures are creeping around, the smell of fresh banana bread is filling the air, and you can't help but feel yourself being dragged into this place.

The game is a mix of comedy and horror: the banana jokes and puns are running wild here and the cartoon-like banana creatures are too nightmarish to be in a kids' show. You get to explore the Banana Farm, the secrets inside, run from the evil creatures, solve puzzles, laugh at the jokes and jump from the scares. We have a wide selection of evil bananas chasing you and giving you nightmares, such as the violent Banana Demon, the dancing Pink Banana, creepy Banana Children, a sinister Banana Mannequin... And they're all trying to summon the Banana God.

The game also has bus customization. The game isn't about a bus. And it's not even your bus. To be honest, the bus driver is quite angry with you about it. But you can still pick some new paint colors for that bus.

Time to go bananas.

70010000129174.name: Lootbag Tactics
70010000129174.intro: Pack your bag, set your strategy, and dominate the arena!
70010000129174.description:
Lootbag Tactics is a fantasy strategy game that brings together deep inventory management and thrilling auto-battler mechanics. Collect the right items, build your unbeatable setup, and outsmart your rivals!

Surviving the arena requires more than just raw power; it requires a sharp mind. You must efficiently manage your limited bag space and choose the right weapons, shields, and accessories from the shop. Open chests to find Epic gear, combine items to multiply your strength, and step onto the battlefield.

Discover the unique advantages of different classes! Play as a Knight to strengthen your shields or unlock new strategies with specialized perks like Shield Doctrine and Frontline Training. Once your grid is set, sit back and watch your warriors automatically battle it out in a flawless display of your tactics!


Key Features:
* Deep Inventory Management: Place your items strategically on your grid-based bag. Create powerful synergies by positioning the right items together and maximizing your space.
* Tactical Auto-Battler Combat: After the preparation phase, send your warriors into the arena. Analyze rival setups and develop the perfect counter-tactics.
* Unique Classes & Perks: Choose a hero class that fits your playstyle. Each class features unique passive abilities that interact dynamically with your items.
* Epic Loot: Start with a simple wooden sword, upgrade the shop as you win, and discover Legendary weapons, magical codexes, and rare charms.
* Battle Against Rivals: Face off against the unique builds of different competitors and climb the Master Levels.
* Play Anywhere, Anytime: Fully optimized for Nintendo Switch™! Play on the big screen in TV Mode, or strategize on the go in Tabletop and Handheld Modes.

70010000129180.name: Roots
70010000129180.intro: Plant, harvest, buy animals, and upgrade your farm islands!
70010000129180.description:
Build the farm of your dreams by expanding into different biomes and decorating or optimizing them for maximum profit.

Ride your horse between islands, raise chickens, cows, and pigs, and build your fortune!

70010000129199.name: Decide in 5 Seconds.Who Is the Culprit?
70010000129199.intro:
Just 5 seconds. Spot the culprit.
One person in the crowd is moving wrong — catch them.
70010000129199.description:
A park, a station, a market, a beach — somewhere in this peaceful scene, a culprit is hiding.

"They were right in front of me..."
"By the time I noticed, they were gone."
Once the culprit starts moving, you only have 5 seconds.

This game is a snap-judgment puzzle where you tap the single culprit hiding in a crowded scene.
Pickpockets, shoplifters, burglars, bag thieves, snatchers, bike thieves —
Can you spot the "one person trying to hide something" in 5 seconds?

How to play is simple.
・When the image appears, observe within 5 seconds
・Tap the person you think is the culprit
・The answer and the crime are revealed

The thrill of "I knew it was that one!" and the frustration of "Let me see it again!"
50 scenes across parks, markets, beaches, museums, queues, neighborhoods, and more.

Quick rounds make it perfect for spare moments.
Observation and reflex — both put to the test in this brain-training game for adults.

So, can you spot the culprit in 5 seconds?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.

70010000129205.name: Something's Off in This World. Era Anomaly Quiz
70010000129205.intro:
Something's off in this office, isn't it?
Spot the old tool hiding in plain sight today.
70010000129205.description:
A station, an office, a bank counter, a hospital at night — somewhere, one thing belongs to a different era.

A station attendant holds up an hourglass to time the departing trains.
Someone signs documents with a quill dipped in ink.
A bank clerk clicks the beads of an abacus to do the math.
— Someone is actively using an "old tool" that should be long gone.

This game is a click puzzle where you spot the "old tool that doesn't belong" hidden in a full-color modern or near-future scene.
It's drawn in vivid full color, not sepia, so color won't help you find it.
You'll have to notice it by shape, silhouette, or the strangeness of how it's being used.

50 scenes in all.
Train stations, airports, subways, offices, homes, libraries, hospitals, schools, shops, factories, and even near-future scenes —
every scene looks like normal everyday life, but one thing that shouldn't exist in the modern day is hidden in "active use."

How to play is simple.
・Observe the scene carefully
・Tap the old tool that doesn't belong to this era
・The answer and "what the tool is" are revealed

Hints gently suggest the tool's purpose or function, so you won't get stuck.
They never tell you where to look, so the joy of figuring it out is all yours.

The thrill of "Wait, is that from the old days?"
The pleasure of "I never knew that existed!"
A grown-up observation puzzle that hops between eras.

So, can you spot what's off in this world?

70010000129217.name: Dungeon Village 2 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000129217.intro: Recruit adventurers and monsters to create your own RRG-style town!
70010000129217.description:
A new legend begins here!

Build and manage a town in grasslands, snow fields, even in the underworld! Set up inns, weapon stores, and more to convince adventurers to come visit.

Use items and equipment to power up your adventurers and help them get more gold and experience from their quests. Be on the lookout for new dungeons to explore and new monsters to fight!

Need help attracting adventurers? Try building new facilities, selling new kinds of food, or improving the local area to earn Titles. Keep experimenting, and you might stumble on some rare awards...

As your town develops and becomes more popular, adventurers won't just visit, but move in for good!
The enemy roster from the previous game has been expanded with a host of quirky new monsters to fight.

Play your cards right, and some monsters will become friendly and join you! Give them snacks, keep them happy, and they'll become valuable allies on your quests. Explore more and more of the world map to unlock new areas.

Feel like a fresh start? Move your town to a different region to discover unseen monsters and bold new adventurers.

Rise through the ranks and create the greatest town the kingdom has ever seen!

70010000129224.name: Bug Error 404: Anime Girls Not Found
70010000129224.intro:
Somewhere between the code and the crash, she's waiting for you. 
Fix the glitch and she's all yours!
70010000129224.description:
A broken error screen. A missing file. And somehow, on the other side of that 404, a girl who shouldn't exist is looking right at you.

Take on a mix of minigames built to test you in different ways. Beat them and every one unlocks a piece of the gallery, pushing you closer to her.

Some crash the system on purpose. Some just want to be found. Each one glitches into your game with her own personality, her own rules, her own way of making you work for it.

How many errors are you willing to chase before one of them finally lets you in?


Features:

● A VARIETY OF MINIGAMES: Different challenges test you in different ways. Clear them and the gallery unlocks as you go.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Every win cracks the error screen open a little more.

● GLITCHY, UNFORGETTABLE PERSONALITIES: Each anime girl comes with her own attitude, quirks and reasons for showing up in your game uninvited.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: How you play decides who stays and who logs off for good.

● A HIDDEN MOMENT AT QUESTION 150: Something's buried deep in the code. Most players never see it.


The system says bug error 404. 
Your heart says otherwise. 
Boot it up and prove the error wrong.

70010000129243.name: Bug Error 404: Anime Boys Not Found
70010000129243.intro:
He shouldn't be there. The error screen says so. 
Track him down and see for yourself.
70010000129243.description:
The screen glitches. The error reads 404. And staring back at you through the broken code is a guy who was never supposed to load.

Take on a mix of minigames built to test you in different ways. Beat them and every one unlocks a piece of the gallery, pushing you closer to him.

Some of them crashed the system just to get your attention. Others are glitches trying to stay hidden. Each one carries his own personality into your game, and his own way of testing whether you're worth sticking around for.

How many broken screens are you willing to fix before one of them finally stays?


Features:

● A VARIETY OF MINIGAMES: Different challenges test you in different ways. Clear them and the gallery unlocks as you go.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Every win cracks the error open a little more.

● PERSONALITIES THAT GLITCH INTO YOUR LIFE: Each anime boy brings his own attitude, his own quirks, his own reason for breaking into your game.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your choices decide who stays online and who logs off for good.

● A HIDDEN MOMENT AT QUESTION 150: Something's buried in the code. Most players never find it.


The bug error 404 says he doesn't exist. 
Fix the glitch and find out for yourself!

70010000129318.name: Villain Girls: Date the Dark Side
70010000129318.intro:
Bad girls don't wait to be rescued. 
Earn their trust, break their walls, and see how dark romance can get.
70010000129318.description:
Somewhere off the map, the villains operate. Crime bosses, con artists, masterminds, rebels, hackers, every kind of dangerous woman you can imagine, each one has carved out her own version of power, and none of them are looking for a hero.

Each one is a different kind of dangerous. Cold-blooded strategists, manipulative charmers, chaos-loving wildcards, silent operators with soft spots they'll never admit to.

• There's the boss who rules through fear but melts under real attention. 
• The trickster who tests you just to see if you'll flinch. 
• The enforcer who respects strength more than sweetness. 

Each one wants something different, and figuring out what could be the difference between winning her over and losing her for good.


Features:

♥ A ROSTER FULL OF UNFORGETTABLE VILLAINS: Every character brings her own brand of danger, and no two are alike.

♥ DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: What you say decides who opens up to you and who shuts you out for good.

♥ CHARACTER AFFINITY SYSTEM: Build trust with each villain to unlock dates and intimate moments only she'll share with you.

♥ EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Every bond deepened means a new illustration unlocked, some hidden until you've truly earned them.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Not every villain falls for you. Some routes end in romance, others end somewhere far more dangerous.

♥ 30 DAYS TO WIN THEIR DARK HEARTS: The clock is running. Waste a day and a path could close forever.


You've got thirty days to prove you're not afraid of the dark. 
Are you villain enough for them?

70010000129324.name: Villain Boys: Date the Dark Side
70010000129324.intro:
Bad boys don't play by the rules.
Break down their walls and find out what's underneath the dark side.
70010000129324.description:
Somewhere off the map, the villains operate. Crime bosses, con artists, masterminds, rebels, hackers, every kind of dangerous man you can imagine, each one has carved out his own version of power, and none of them are waiting to be saved.

Each one is dangerous in his own way. Cold-blooded strategists, magnetic charmers, chaos-loving wildcards, quiet operators hiding more than they let on.

• There's the boss who rules through fear but softens under real attention.
• The trickster who tests you just to see if you'll flinch.
• The enforcer who respects strength more than sweetness.
Each one wants something different, and figuring out what could be the difference between winning him over and losing him for good.


Features:

♥ A ROSTER FULL OF UNFORGETTABLE VILLAINS: Every character brings his own brand of danger, and no two are alike.

♥ DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: What you say decides who opens up to you and who shuts you out for good.

♥ CHARACTER AFFINITY SYSTEM: Build trust with each villain to unlock dates and intimate moments only he'll share with you.

♥ EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Every bond deepened means a new illustration unlocked, some hidden until you've truly earned them.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Not every villain falls for you. Some routes end in romance, others end somewhere far more dangerous.

♥ 30 DAYS TO WIN THEIR DARK HEARTS: The clock is running. Waste a day and a path could close forever.


You've got thirty days to prove you're not afraid of the dark.

Are you villain enough for them?

70010000129330.name: Ghost Strike
70010000129330.intro: Redefining Modern Warfare: Breach and Conquer the Uncharted Fortress
70010000129330.description:
"Before the lights of the world go out, crush the heart of destruction."

A covert sector hidden from all satellite networks. This is the birthplace of global annihilation, where the rogue cartel 'Black Octave' is manufacturing 'ORION'—the ultimate weapon system designed to end humanity. A providential frequency fracture caught during a recon mission has exposed its coordinates, but the final countdown to stop it has already begun.

The ultimate fusion of next-generation photorealism and cutting-edge siege warfare. Witness the absolute peak of realistic destruction, experience it now in .

* VISUAL OVERWHELM AND EXTREME MOBILITY
Choose the mode that suits your preference: 'Quality Mode,' which changes the very atmosphere of the battlefield with intricate details that blur the boundaries of reality, or 'Performance Mode,' which drives victory with smooth operation that captures every fleeting moment.

* EVERY ANGLE IS AN ENTRY POINT
There are no designated routes when breaching a weapon design bureau erased from the map. Utilize the terrain of a massive open field to execute a stealth flank on the fortress's vulnerable rear, or brave the curtain of fire to smash through the front gates. Your choice defines the tactics.

* EVOLVED TANKS, UNBOUND FIREPOWER
Take command of next-generation evolutionary tanks that transcend simple transport vehicles. Adapt your armor's loadout in real-time to counter active defense systems, and unleash unrestricted offensive fire unhindered by angles or topography to neutralize defensive turrets and seize control at lightning speed.

* SHATTERING THE ABSOLUTE BASTION | The Four Spears
ASSAULT: The ultimate vanguard of the frontline, diving headfirst into breached walls to rip through enemy defenses.
ENGINEER: The core of the siege, specialized in hacking security networks and demolishing blast doors to paralyze the fortress interior.
SUPPORT: The immovable shield, sustaining the squad through brutal breaches with heavy fire support and constant ammunition supply.
