RECON: The tactical eyes in the dark, detecting ambush points inside the uncharted stronghold and eliminating high-value targets with surgical precision.

* ALL-OUT WARFARE TO DESTROY THE DEFENSE LINE
Savor the raw survival instincts of Deathmatch as you wipe out external security outposts, then transition to Conquest and Rush modes to systematically seize core control rooms and detonate the facility from the inside out. Eradicate the enemy’s final defense grid with meticulously calculated teamwork.

* THE HEART OF THE DEADZONE | Ultimate Infiltration
From the ironclad desert base choked by blinding sandstorms to the subterranean secret factory dominated by scalding steam—prove your status as a tier-one operator by piercing through suffocating pressure to conquer the hidden heart of the cartel.

< SYNOPSIS : A Looming Shadow >
In an era where national borders have dissolved, the world lies in the iron grip of ‘Black Octave’, a private military-technological cartel. Within their newly exposed stronghold, the production lines of the doomsday design bureau are coming online for final activation.

You are an elite operator of the world’s most lethal special operations group, tasked with cutting out the heart of this invisible evil and bringing down their fortress. Track the cartel's leader hidden within the Iron Labyrinth, and halt the hands of the doomsday clock closing in on the world.

The operation is already underway. Deploy with your brothers-in-arms and conquer the ultimate siege mission waiting on the brink of hell.

70010000129335.name: Ultimate Wobble Run
70010000129335.intro:
Run fast. Fall hard. Build the chaos.
Get back up and reach the flag before everyone else!
70010000129335.description:
Get ready for wobbly races, messy jumps, dramatic finishes, and epic recoveries!

Ultimate Wobble Run is a chaotic physics-based party racing game where little runners sprint, jump, fall, stumble, recover, and compete all the way to the finish line.

Race against the clock in single-player challenges. Learn each level, master the movement, discover better routes, and turn every messy attempt into a faster run.

Gather your friends and family for local multiplayer races with up to 4 players on the same console. Run for the checkered flag, survive unpredictable hazards, escape rising lava, and enjoy rounds where anything can happen.

Want to make the competition even more chaotic? Jump into Party Mode, where players place obstacles before the race begins. Protect your route, ruin someone else's plan, and then race through the mess everyone helped create.

Easy to understand, funny to watch, and satisfying to master, Ultimate Wobble Run combines arcade racing, physics-based movement, player-placed obstacles, and party game chaos into quick, replayable challenges for solo players and groups of friends.

70010000129359.name: Letter Snap: Term Challenge
70010000129359.intro: Letter Snap: Term Challenge – A fast, vibrant word challenge to test your speed!
70010000129359.description:
Letter Snap: Term Challenge is a fun, engaging, and fast-paced word game designed for puzzle lovers of all ages. Challenge yourself with thousands of jumbled letter combinations to sharpen your vocabulary and quick thinking.

Play across various themed categories to test your knowledge at your own pace, or push your limits in Endless Mode—where you race against a ticking clock, build massive high-score streaks, and see how long you can keep your momentum alive!

Whether you want to expand your word bank, improve your problem-solving skills, or just enjoy a relaxing mental workout, it offers the perfect balance of brain training and satisfying arcade fun.

Get ready to snap cards into place, beat the clock, and unlock your ultimate word-solving potential!

70010000129366.name: Lumeera and the Glow Reefs
70010000129366.intro: Save the reef in a magical underwater interactive storybook!
70010000129366.description:
When the vital Glow keeping the Coral Spire Village alive begins to fade, Lumeera, a young seahorse-fairy who can feel the reef's energy, must leave home for the first time to save it. Accompanied by a cheerful reefpup, a scholarly octopus, and a clumsy jellyfish-fairy, she journeys toward a deep indigo trench where an ancient glowwhale awaits to test their true understanding of the light.

• An interactive picture book for ages 4–8.
• 10 chapters. Approximately 12,000 words of story.
• Short sessions. Perfect for one chapter per evening. Read together or alone.
• Original illustrations using cute 3D style.
• Original music and sounds.
• Themes: courage, friendship, listening, caring for a fragile place.
• No ads · No in-app purchases · No frightening content · No sad ending.

70010000129368.name: Card Party Showdown
70010000129368.intro: Three card games. One lively showdown for family and friends!
70010000129368.description:
Gather your family and friends for a lively card game party filled with quick reactions, lucky draws, and playful rivalries.

Card Party Showdown brings together three distinct games, each with simple rules and its own style of tension:

- Card War: Reveal your cards, survive dramatic ties, and win the deck in a classic battle of luck.
- The Pile: Stay alert, slap the table at the right moment, and avoid being the last player to react.
- All or Nothing: Keep drawing cards to build your score, or stop before a repeated card or Joker wipes out your points for the round.

Play solo against computer-controlled opponents or share the fun with up to four players in local multiplayer. With colorful hand-drawn artwork, accessible controls, and quick-to-learn rules, Card Party Showdown is made for relaxed family sessions, friendly competition, and rematches that are always easy to start.

70010000129374.name: Acorn Avengers
70010000129374.intro: When the forest ranger is abducted, it's the Acorn Avengers to the rescue! Classic 16-bit platforming mayhem for up to 2 players co-op!
70010000129374.description:
The forest is at peace until lizards from space abduct the ranger! Now it’s up to a pair of plucky chipmunks, aka the Acorn Avengers, to make the rescue. Journey from the park all the way into space in a chase to save the beloved forest ranger. Toss boxes, hurl explosive barrels, climb trees, and most of all be sure to gather nuts!

Supports up to 2 player co-op.

70010000129386.name: Steam Girls
70010000129386.intro: A puzzle game featuring many Steam Girls is here!
70010000129386.description:
Collect the puzzle pieces of adorable Steam Girls and complete the puzzles!

Total of 15 stages
The difficulty increases as you clear stages!

Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a challenging level with no background watermark to guide you!
Carefully examine each piece and lead the puzzle to completion!
When you complete a puzzle, high-quality images of the Steam Girls will be added to the gallery♪
=====================
Our company supports content creators and streamers who wish to showcase our games.
You do not need to obtain permission to create gameplay videos or stream this game.

70010000129396.name: Ben's Zombie Apocalypse
70010000129396.intro: That unstoppable arcade addiction is back, once you start, you can't stop! Ben and Carmen, two agents, join the fight! Blast zombie heads and take down the towering bosses closing in!
70010000129396.description:
A blood pumping, intense 2D side scrolling action game returns, more thrilling than ever! Simple yet deeply rewarding controls bring back the golden age of arcade gaming, now perfected. Facing an endless wave of zombies, keep pulling the trigger until your fingers ache. In a world drenched in blood, will you survive until the very end? Choose between Ben and Carmen, two agents with distinct personalities, and take on the stages your way. A loyal drone companion backs you up with special attacks, offering a glimmer of hope even in the most desperate moments.

・Choose Ben or Carmen and strategize your way through every stage
・A brand new ally arrives, your drone companion supports you with devastating special attacks
・Wipe out zombies with a wide arsenal including pistols, submachine guns, shotguns, and grenade launchers
・Discover hidden items scattered across each stage to boost your chances of survival
・Grow stronger with every stage cleared, making combat even more exhilarating
・Build your own strategy with diverse upgrades including weapon performance, health boosts, and expanded attack range
・Feel the rush of leveling up, again and again, without ever getting tired of it
・Land precise headshots on zombies for a satisfying, hard hitting sense of impact
・Face tougher enemies with every stage, putting your skills to the ultimate test

Heart pounding tension meets the sheer thrill of mowing down endless zombie hordes, a perfect combination of action waiting for you. Defeat countless zombies, overcome mighty bosses, and reach the final stage, where a shocking twist and an unforgettable ending await. Are you ready to witness the fate of Ben and Carmen on this deadly journey? Only you can survive this blood soaked world and uncover the truth. The feast of blood begins now, right at your fingertips.

Prologue
Anna, a former special forces soldier, once threw herself into a desperate battle against hordes of zombies to save the husband she loved. The world remembered her story, and peace seemed to have returned once more. But that peace did not last. A sinister green smoke rising above Dr Z's laboratory was the signal that a slumbering catastrophe had awakened once again.

Rushed to the scene, agent Ben and his partner Carmen entered the facility alongside a team in hazmat suits. But what greeted them were beings that had already turned into zombies. A summons signal from a secret agency crackled through the radio, and its emblem was, remarkably, the very same mark of the organization Anna had once faced. The two agents instantly sensed this was no coincidence, and that they now stood at the center of a conspiracy far greater than they had imagined.

Beyond the barricade stood the white haired, deranged scientist Dr Z, surrounded by a horde of zombies and wearing an unsettling grin. And looming behind him, a figure in a black hat with a hidden face hinted at an even darker force to come. Armed with nothing but their guns, their drone, and their trust in each other, Ben and Carmen step deeper into the zombie infested laboratory. The question left behind by Anne's Zombie Odyssey now rests in your hands to answer.

70010000129398.name: One Question and You'll Want to Share It! 1000 Trivia Quiz Questions
70010000129398.intro:
Animals, space, history, food, the human body — 1000 "huh!" facts you didn't know.
One question, and you'll want to tell someone.
70010000129398.description:
You think you know — but the world is full of surprises hiding in plain sight.

"An octopus has three hearts." "There's no sound in space." "Honey never spoils."
The kinds of facts that make you want to share — they're tucked away all over the world.
How many of those "surprising truths" can your knowledge pin down?

This game offers 1000 picture-based true-or-false questions across 20 categories — animals, nature, space, history, food, the human body, science, and more.

"Wait, is that real?" "No way, that can't be true…"
Trust your instinct and your knowledge, then pick ○ or ×.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question and look at the image
・Pick ○ (true) or × (false)
・After answering, get the full picture with the detailed explanation

Get it right and feel "of course". Miss it and find a fresh "wait, what!?"
By question 1000, you'll have plenty of stories to share.

Squeeze in a relaxed trivia hit on your commute, on a break, or before bed.
Perfect for sparking "Did you know?" chats with family and friends.

How many do you actually know?
Each question is a fresh "huh!" worth sharing. So — take the challenge.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.

70010000129405.name: The Magic School
70010000129405.intro: Join Lumi and friends on a magical floating adventure about friendship, courage, and finding your inner strength!
70010000129405.description:
The Magic School tells the enchanting story of Lumi, a little dragon attending a floating magical academy where her spells always seem to turn into bubbles. When a dark storm threatens to destroy the very heart that keeps the school afloat, Lumi and her mismatched group of friends must learn to combine their unique talents. Ultimately, they will discover that the most powerful magic isn't found in books, but in the courage to accept oneself and the strength of true friendship.

• An interactive picture book for ages 4–8.
• 10 chapters. Approximately 12,000 words of story.
• Short sessions. Perfect for one chapter per evening. Read together or alone.
• Original illustrations using cute 3D style.
• Original music and sounds.
• Themes: courage, friendship, listening, caring for a fragile place.
• No ads · No in-app purchases · No frightening content · No sad ending.

70010000129411.name: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra 2
70010000129411.intro: Find the cats. Discover the instruments. Reunite the orchestra!
70010000129411.description:
A new cozy musical adventure is waiting to be discovered!

Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra 2 is the sequel to the charming hidden object game Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra. This time, finding the cats is only the beginning: their instruments are hiding too!

Explore 10 delightful levels filled with cute details and carefully hidden surprises. Search every corner to find the cats and their instruments, then complete each musical pair to bring the orchestra back together.

Each level also hides a special key. Find it to open a treasure chest, reveal a hidden instrument, and discover the shyest cat of them all.

With 32 hidden objects in every level, Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra 2 offers a relaxing search filled with charming discoveries, musical rewards, and plenty of adorable cats.

70010000129472.name: R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000129472.intro: The fate of two races depends on you.
70010000129472.description: Outsmart and outgun your opponent in R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos, the ultimate turn-based sci-fi strategy collection! This two-game combination of the classic R-Type Tactics titles arrives on Nintendo Switch™ 2 for the first time, equipped with an armada of units to deploy across dozens of levels. Multiple campaigns allow you to take on the Bydo Empire or even play as them yourself. Their fates are up to you! Features enhanced resolution and mouse controls.

70010000129489.name: Detective Mind Training: Mystery Choices
70010000129489.intro:
Solve each case with just one choice!
Train your observation and deduction skills
Quick mystery puzzles for sharp minds
70010000129489.description:
Read each case carefully and choose the option that leads closer to the truth.

The rules are simple: each question gives you two choices. Think like a detective, compare the details, and pick the answer that helps solve the case.

How to play:
・Read the case details
・Compare the two choices
・Use observation, logic, and intuition to find the right answer

Some cases may look easy at first, but assumptions can lead you in the wrong direction. Pay attention to small details and hidden clues.

Enjoy it at your own pace, one case at a time. It is great for quick breaks, solo play, or discussing the answer with family and friends.

Recommended for players who:
・Like mystery quizzes and detective stories
・Want a quick brain-training game
・Enjoy observation and deduction challenges
・Prefer simple controls and short puzzle sessions
・Want a casual game that can be enjoyed alone or with others

Make the right choice and uncover the truth behind each case!

70010000129539.name: Rooster: Princess Rescue
70010000129539.intro: The rooster wants to rescue Princess Hen... but countless challenges stand in his way.
70010000129539.description:
Take on the role of a brave rooster and embark on an adventure packed with challenges. Run, jump, and test your skills through levels filled with moving platforms, sharp spikes, blade traps, circular saws, and many other hazards that will try to stop your journey.

Each stage introduces new obstacles and demands precision, quick reflexes, and mastery of movement to cross dangerous gaps, avoid deadly traps, and reach increasingly difficult areas.

Find your courage, sharpen your spurs, and face every challenge in a mission driven by blind passion. Only the alpha rooster will be able to reach her.

70010000129563.name: Bloody Grids
70010000129563.intro: A single move to carve a path through blood.Use the information on the grid to avoid, fight, and devour unseen enemies in this Minesweeper-style puzzle adventu
70010000129563.description:
A Minesweeper-style puzzle adventure where you must navigate a labyrinth of logic and make your way back to the surface.

Use the information marked on the grid to deduce the strength of nearby enemies, then devour those weaker than yourself.

A diverse cast of enemies demands more complex deduction, as well as strategies that are both delicate and bold. Sharpen your intellect and crush everything in your path.

■ Game Features
・Multiple game modes with distinct puzzle-solving experiences.

   -Girl Mode
    A mode where you use skills to defeat powerful enemies.
    By obtaining materials from enemies and strengthening yourself, you can gain the upper hand in battle.
    Some enemies have special placement patterns and unique traits beyond the information shown on the field, and              understanding them will be the key to victory.

 

  -Scientist Mode
   A high-difficulty puzzle mode that can always be solved using the information provided.
   Use a variety of tools to find contradictions, build your own logic, and solve your way forward.

  -Soldier Mode
   ？？？？？？？？？

・A wide range of tools for organizing information on the board:

Handwritten notes, number-combination notes, combination prediction tools, and more.

■ Story

The near future—

Deep underground, in a hidden research facility, humanity has been carrying out illegal genetic experiments in an attempt to create new life forms adapted for space exploration.

But during one such experiment, an accident occurs.

Amid a firefight between countless mutated creatures and the security system deployed to suppress them, a lone girl escapes from the laboratory and begins her journey toward the surface.

70010000129572.name: Stompy's Big Adventure
70010000129572.intro: A big-eared dinosaur’s big adventure! Help Stompy save his herd in this heartwarming interactive story.
70010000129572.description:
A young, big-eared Brachiosaurus undertakes a journey with new friends to save his herd, proving his unique trait is their greatest asset.

Stompy is a young Brachiosaurus with ears much too big for his head, or so everyone says. When his herd runs out of water, he sets out alone to find the Valley of Seven Springs. Along the way he meets Fern the Pterodactyl, Rumble the T-Rex, and Bouldie the Triceratops. His extraordinary ears turn out to be exactly what the journey needs.

• 10 chapters. A complete story. Above 10,000 words.
• 5 original dinosaur characters.
• Full background music score and sound effects throughout.
• Read together or let a child explore alone.
• Short sessions. Easy to pause and pick up anytime.
• Themes: courage, friendship, self-acceptance.
• Ages 4–8.
• No ads - No in-app purchases - All ages.

70010000129586.name: Pip's Big Discovery
70010000129586.intro: Save the oasis! Join Pip on a scent-sational desert adventure.
70010000129586.description:
When the life-giving springs of the Oasis of Seven Colors suddenly run dry, Pip, a self-conscious fennec fox with an exceptional sense of smell, becomes her village's only hope for survival. Guided by her extraordinary nose and joined by a quirky team of desert animals, she embarks on a perilous journey through ancient ruins, treacherous canyons, and blinding sandstorms to locate a hidden underground lake and uncover the mystery of their blocked water supply.

• An interactive picture book for ages 4–10.
• 10 chapters. Approximately 10,000 words of story.
• Short sessions. Perfect for one chapter per evening. Read together or alone.
• Original illustrations using cute 3D style.
• Original music and sounds.
• Themes: curiosity, courage, friendship, teamwork.
• No ads · No in-app purchases · No frightening content · No sad ending.

They are seamless cinematic sequences that transition smoothly into the gameplay with the same expressiveness, visual quality, and art direction you would see in an animated feature film.

70010000129591.name: Clear It You Can
70010000129591.intro: An evil monster has taken over the kind and cheerful forest and locked all the animals in cages, with plans to eat them all!
70010000129591.description:
Only a brave badger can stop the beast, but to win, he must be the first to collect the red power stones.

If the monster collects his blue power stones faster than the badger collects the red ones, the battle will be lost, and no one will be left to protect the forest!

Help the badger collect red power stones, keep the beast from obtaining the blue power stones, and save the forest!

70010000129620.name: Emergency Rush
70010000129620.intro: Drive fast, dodge traffic, and save lives in Emergency Rush!
70010000129620.description:
Take control of an ambulance and race through dangerous highways filled with cars, trucks, buses, and obstacles. Use nitro boosts, react quickly, and survive intense traffic as you drive across desert, forest, and snowy roads.
Every run is a test of speed, timing, and reflexes. Avoid crashes, keep moving, and reach the emergency before it is too late.

Emergency Rush is a fast, simple, and exciting ambulance driving game for players who love highway action, racing, and quick reflex challenges.

70010000129672.name: Kitty Farm Island
70010000129672.intro: Farm, fish, explore, and build the coziest kitty island paradise!
70010000129672.description:
Welcome to Kitty Farm Island!

Start your journey as a cute little kitty and transform a tiny island into a thriving farming paradise.

Plant crops, harvest fresh produce, earn coins, and unlock exciting new areas as your farm grows bigger and bigger. Explore three unique island regions, from peaceful green fields to sandy deserts and snowy winter landscapes.

Hire adorable kitty farmers to help with the work and upgrade them to become even more productive. Expand your storage, improve your animals, and build the ultimate farming empire.

Take a break from farming with relaxing mini-games:
• Catch fish in peaceful waters
• Shake fruit trees and gather fresh harvests
• Milk cows for valuable products
• Collect eggs from chickens
• Shear fluffy sheep for wool
• Upgrade animals to increase production

Every harvest brings new opportunities. Earn more money, unlock new territories, discover new resources, and watch your island community grow.

Whether you enjoy farming, collecting, upgrading, or simply relaxing with cute cats, Kitty Farm Island offers a cozy and rewarding adventure for players of all ages.

Features:
• Cute kitty-themed farming adventure
• Three unique island environments
• Crop planting and harvesting
• Hire and upgrade kitty workers
• Animal care and production systems
• Multiple relaxing mini-games
• Progressive island expansion
• Simple controls and casual gameplay
• Family-friendly experience

Build, harvest, explore, and create the ultimate kitty farming paradise!

70010000129677.name: Digging Simulator
70010000129677.description:
Your grand adventure begins in your own backyard with just a shovel and a dream. In this simple yet addictive simulator, your mission is simple: Dig as deep as you can! Carve out your own vertical tunnel, navigate the underground world, and unearth the valuable stones and colourful gems buried deep beneath your feet.

But digging is exhausting work, and your backpack has limited capacity. Once your pockets are full or your energy is low, it's time to head back to the surface. Take your hard-earned cash to the garage to upgrade your equipment. Increase your shovel’s digging power, expand your backpack's capacity, and boost your maximum stamina so you can dig for longer periods of time. Best of all, buy and upgrade a reliable jetpack so you can easily fly right back up from the deepest, darkest holes!

70010000129685.name: Arcade Archives ARKANOID REVENGE OF DOH
70010000129685.description:
"ARKANOID REVENGE OF DOH" is a brick breaker released by TAITO in 1987.
The sequel to ARKANOID is back and more powered up than ever! While retaining the core gameplay of bouncing the Energy Ball to shatter Space Walls, it introduces brand-new systems, including branching paths into L and R versions, and an increased variety of items.
Only you can stop the dimension-controlling force DOH, which has crossed dimensions to invade our universe!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

*The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

70010000129707.name: Boardwalk Builders
70010000129707.intro: Design and expand your boardwalk by building rides, shops, and restaurants to draw in crowds.
70010000129707.description:
Create the ultimate beachfront destination!

A game all about building a beautiful boardwalk.  Start with small stands and grow into a sprawling seaside paradise full of rides, high-end shops and fancy restaurants.


Build your Boardwalk
Dozens of shops to choose from

Build rides, restaurants, and stores, selling everything from sunglasses to vintage video games to sea glass art

Boost your visit rate by building the rides and restaurants people want


Manage your Promenade
Earn rewards as customers visit your shops

Upgrade each shop to bring in more revenue and serve customers faster

Expand your boardwalk and hire entertainers

Launch marketing campaigns to spread the word about your seaside destination


Combine Shops and Rides
Not enough space to serve your customers?  Combine shops to create bigger, better ones that can handle more customers at a time and earn you more money

Dozens of combination recipes to discover - movie theaters, bumper cars and more!


Other Features:
Navigate demand-changing weather events such as smog and rain

Donate to neighboring businesses – and earn rewards in return!

Participate in themed festivals to up your income and draw in big crowds

Invite VIPs and convince them to build their top-tier attractions on your boardwalk

70010000129715.name: Place & Learn 19×19 Mental Math
70010000129715.intro:
Master 19×19 multiplication step by step!
Place the numbers, spot the pattern,
and train your mental math in short sessions.
70010000129715.description:
Learn 19×19 mental multiplication through simple, step-by-step number placement.

Instead of solving everything at once, each question guides you to focus on the important digits, choose the correct answer, and build the habit of calculating in your head.

How to play:
・Look at the highlighted digits
・Follow the multiplication rule
・Choose the correct answer from the options
・Clear each step and move forward

The controls are simple, so it is easy to start even if you are not confident with mental math. Each question is short, making it suitable for quick practice, daily brain training, or learning at your own pace.

Recommended for:
・Players who want to practice 19×19 multiplication
・Fans of number puzzles and brain-training games
・Students, adults, and anyone who enjoys quick math challenges
・Short solo play sessions during free time

Place, think, and learn the patterns behind fast mental calculation!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000129720.name: Crime Scene : What’s Wrong?
70010000129720.intro:
Study the scene. Spot the clue.
Something doesn’t add up…
Use your observation and logic to solve each case.
70010000129720.description:
An illustrated mystery puzzle game where you examine suspicious scenes and find the detail that feels out of place.

Look closely at the characters, objects, and background, then choose the clue that leads to the answer.

The rules are simple:
・Observe the scene
・Read the prompt
・Select the suspicious spot

No complicated controls are needed, so you can jump into each case quickly.

Each stage is designed for short play sessions, making it easy to enjoy alone at your own pace. You can also play with family or friends by discussing what looks strange and comparing theories.

Recommended for players who enjoy detective stories, hidden-clue puzzles, observation games, and casual brain-training challenges.

Can you notice the tiny inconsistency before the truth is revealed?

70010000129731.name: Hidden Clues: Mystery Scene Challenge
70010000129731.intro:
Read the case. Search the scene.
Find the hidden clue that reveals the truth.
A quick mystery challenge for sharp eyes.
70010000129731.description:
Investigate illustrated mystery scenes and spot the hidden clue that helps explain each case.

Read the short case prompt, examine the scene carefully, then choose the suspicious place or item. The rules are simple, so you can start solving right away.

How to play:
・Read the case
・Look closely at the illustration
・Select the clue you think is important
・Use a hint if you get stuck

With 30 stages to solve, each case is short enough for a quick break while still testing your observation, logic, and intuition.

Play solo at your own pace, or discuss each scene with family and friends to see who notices the key detail first.

Recommended for players who enjoy mystery puzzles, detective-style brain teasers, visual riddles, hidden clues, and quick thinking challenges.

Can you catch the detail everyone else missed?

70010000129736.name: Cats Around Us: Black Cat
70010000129736.intro: Spot hidden cats in a comic book about a sneaky black kitty!
70010000129736.description:
This black cat has mastered the art of camouflage! Can you spot him?

Cats Around Us: Black Cat is the second part of the series where you search for hidden furballs inside a five-page silent comic. 

Follow a super sweet story about a man and his sneaky black kitty who just loves blending into the shadows!

- 200+ hidden objects, 5 pages comic and a jigsaw puzzles
- Photo & Paint Mode to capture and color your scene
- Adjustable game colours, brightness, and contrast!

70010000129786.name: Solitaire Paradise - Anime Bikini Babes
70010000129786.intro:
A classical Solitaire game with a modern twist. 
Play classic Solitaire in a calm, anime-inspired world.
70010000129786.description:
This game combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a peaceful anime presentation filled with soft colors and elegant designs.

Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.

As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include beautiful anime-style card skins, serene backgrounds inspired by cherry blossoms and temples, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.

Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer soft pastel tones, detailed anime illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.

With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, the game offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.

70010000129788.name: Solitaire World - Anime Waifus
70010000129788.intro:
A classical Solitaire game with a waifu twist. 
Play classic Solitaire in a exciting, anime-inspired world full of anime waifus.
70010000129788.description:
This game combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a peaceful anime presentation filled with soft colors and elegant designs.

Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.

As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include beautiful anime-style card skins, serene backgrounds inspired by cherry blossoms and temples, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.

Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer soft pastel tones, detailed anime illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.

With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, the game offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.

70010000129790.name: Solitaire Paradise - Furry Waifus
70010000129790.intro:
A classical Solitaire game with a modern twist. 
Play classic Solitaire in a calm, anime-inspired world.
70010000129790.description:
This game combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a peaceful anime presentation filled with soft colors and elegant designs.

Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.

As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include beautiful anime-style card skins, serene backgrounds inspired by cherry blossoms and temples, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.

Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer soft pastel tones, detailed anime illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.

With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, the game offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.

70010000129822.name: Romy & Max and the Hidden Rainforest
70010000129822.intro: An educational and thrilling rainforest adventure for the whole family!
70010000129822.description:
Join Romy, Max, and Pico the toucan on an exciting expedition deep into the rainforest! Cross roaring rivers, brave wild storms, and uncover the incredible secrets, camouflage, and unique abilities of local wildlife in a story that is as educational as it is thrilling.

Features:
♠ Complete Interactive Story: 10 engaging chapters (approx. 10,000 words) packed with mystery.
♥ Full English Voice Acting: Fully voiced in English, which is perfect for solo play or language learning.
♦ Immersive Audio: Features a complete background music score and realistic nature sound effects.
♣ Play Your Way: Great for family storytime or independent exploration. Short, bite-sized sessions make it easy to pause and pick up anytime.
♠ Heartwarming Themes: A beautiful tale centered on courage, friendship, and self-acceptance.
♥ 100% Kid-Safe (Ages 4 to 8): No ads and no in-app purchases. Pure peace of mind for parents.

70010000129842.name: Universal Flight Simulator 3 PvP
70010000129842.intro: The sky is no longer the limit — it's the battlefield.
70010000129842.description:
Buckle up and get ready for the most realistic and breathtaking flight experience of your life!
Universal Flight Simulator 3 PvP lets you take the controls of legendary vintage aircraft, cutting-edge jets, and powerful modern helicopters — each with its own unique feel and challenge.

Explore 12 stunning locations across the world, from sun-drenched coastlines to stormy mountain ranges, each meticulously crafted to push your piloting skills to the limit. Master 5 incredible fixed-wing aircraft and 2 agile helicopters, each faithfully recreated with authentic aerodynamics and handling.

But this time, you're not flying alone. Challenge a friend in local 2-player PvP multiplayer — race head-to-head on circuits, dominate free-flight challenges, and settle once and for all who the ultimate pilot really is. Set the best lap times, unlock new missions, and leave your rival in your wake.

Key Features
-Optimized aerodynamic and hydrodynamic simulation
-Physics-based engine simulation with realistic propeller and transmission systems
-Custom wheels and suspension for ground handling
-Fully interactive 2D/3D gauges and control panels
-Immersive virtual cockpit system
-12 unique locations to discover and master
-5 planes and 2 helicopters, each with distinct flight characteristics
-Free flight and circuit racing modes
-Local 2-player PvP — face off against a friend on the same screen

70010000129848.name: Tales from The Dancing Moon
70010000129848.intro: Tales from the Dancing Moon is a mystery adventure game inspired by British culture and portal-fantasy novels.
70010000129848.description:
After the events of a shadow-beast invasion on a seaside town, complete villager quests and find hidden diaries to understand your role in this mysterious character-driven story.

SEASONS OF ILLISOR

From The Dancing Moon Inn to the Stoknel Swamp regions. Explore both hand-crafted and procedural zones with seasonal and weather effects, providing different moods as time progresses throughout the game.

UNRAVEL THE MYSTERY

Discover your role in this story as you complete a variety of quests and collect hidden diaries. Unravel the mystery of the missing teenagers and their entanglement between the tea-brewing Magisters and the frightening shadow-beasts!

MEET THE VILLAGERS

Learn more about Ïllisor and it’s villagers by doing activities like questing, crafting, farming, cooking, and fishing. Help rebuild the town from the recent invasion and get them back on their feet!

Will you discover your purpose in the world of Ïllisor and find a way back home? Track down those pesky teenagers? Or will you simply enjoy your time staying at The Dancing Moon?

70010000129850.name: Wizboyz
70010000129850.description:
Wizboyz is a humorous local multiplayer game offering friendly competition featuring powerful rogue wizards battling each other in magical duels across diverse locations.

Customize your Wizboyz's arcane arsenal and appearance, then battle your opponents in explosive showdowns until you're the last one standing.

70010000129870.name: Chilling Urban Legends
70010000129870.intro:
Behind every scary rumor lies a hidden "truth."
Find the chilling clue inside a single picture.
70010000129870.description:
A phone that won't stop ringing at midnight. A figure seated where no one should be. Something that moves only inside the mirror —
At the scene of every whispered "scary rumor," there's one clue you mustn't overlook.

This is a picture-mystery game where you observe eerie scenes inspired by urban legends and hunt down the "wrongness" or "clue" hidden in the image.
Each scenario hides several puzzles to solve.

"Something about this room is off."
When you feel it, tap the evidence on the screen.
Get it right, and the "real reason" behind the rumor is revealed, along with a reasoning explanation.
It's not just scary — there's the satisfying click of "Ah, so THAT'S what was going on."

A dim abandoned house, a school at midnight, a deserted tunnel…
Read through one spine-chilling scene after another with your own eye for detail.
There's nothing graphic or gory — the only scary things are the atmosphere and the wrongness.

How to play is simple.
・Observe the eerie scene carefully
・Find the out-of-place clue and tap it
・Check the reasoning to learn the "truth behind the rumor"

Send a chill down your own spine, quietly.
That scary urban legend — can you solve it?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.

70010000129906.name: Dead Echo
70010000129906.intro: Explore eerie, atmospheric environments, uncover hidden secrets, and survive against an unseen presence lurking in the dark.
70010000129906.description:
Set within a dark, atmospheric environment filled with abandoned spaces and distorted realities, the game challenges you to explore, survive, and uncover the truth behind a creeping, unknown presence.

Every location in Dead Echo is crafted to build tension through environmental storytelling, subtle audio cues, and a constant feeling of being watched. There are no clear answers or safe paths—only fragments of information scattered across eerie corridors, broken structures, and shifting spaces that seem to change when you’re not looking. The deeper you explore, the more unstable reality becomes.

Survival depends on awareness, patience, and careful decision-making. Resources are scarce, visibility is limited, and danger often reveals itself too late. The game emphasizes psychological tension over direct confrontation, forcing players to rely on their instincts as much as their tools. Every sound could be a warning, and every shadow may hide something watching you back.

As you progress, Dead Echo begins to blur the line between perception and reality. Environments subtly shift, familiar areas become unfamiliar, and the presence within the world grows more aggressive and unpredictable. What starts as exploration quickly evolves into a psychological struggle to maintain control and understanding.

Designed for fans of atmospheric horror and immersive survival gameplay, Dead Echo delivers a slow-building, tension-heavy experience focused on fear, mystery, and the unknown. It is not just about surviving what lurks in the dark—but surviving what the dark does to you.

70010000129942.name: Feed Them
70010000129942.description:
Dig your way through a world of underground puzzles in this fun and addictive adventure.

Use your shovel to carve paths through dirt and sand, guiding streams of balls toward hungry underground creatures. Each stage challenges you to think ahead, plan your routes carefully, and make the most of every ball as you work your way deeper underground.

Across 50 handcrafted levels spread over 5 unique worlds, you'll encounter a variety of enemies including carnivorous plants, dragons, giant worms, salamanders, and bats. Every stage contains three smaller enemies that must be defeated to earn stars. Feed them enough balls and they'll release a star. Collect all three stars, then take on the larger boss waiting at the bottom of the level to complete the stage.

But digging a simple path won't be enough. As you progress, new obstacles and mechanics are introduced that transform each level into a clever puzzle. Navigate around lava pits, dodge deadly lasers, avoid spinning blockers, slip past rotating laser traps, time your movements around pulsing laser beams, and work around immovable rocks. Discover special gates that multiply your balls and use them strategically to ensure you have enough resources to defeat every enemy and boss.

The early stages are easy to learn, but the challenge steadily grows as new obstacles combine in increasingly complex ways. Success requires careful planning, smart path creation, and creative problem solving.

Can you dig the perfect path and defeat every underground threat?

70010000129970.name: Astonishia Story
70010000129970.description: Follow Lloyd von Reuental on his quest to recover a stolen relic in this updated version of a classic Korean RPG. To prevent the Elven Queen from awakening an ancient god, you'll need to master grid-based battles, recruit allies, and fulfill your duty!

70010000129979.name: Learn Through Riddles! Masterpieces of the World
70010000129979.intro:
A masterpiece is wasted if you only glance at it.
Solve the riddles, and the world's great paintings come alive.
70010000129979.description:
That famous painting you've seen in a textbook or on a poster.
But have you ever really looked — at what's painted where, and why?

This game is a riddle-solving observation quiz built around the world's great paintings.
Look closely at a single artwork, find the answer to the question within it, and tap to answer.

"Where in this painting do your eyes land first?"
"Which is the tiny motif the artist slipped in?"
The real highlights hide in details you'd miss just by glancing.

Get it right, and you can read trivia and stories about the painting in the explanation —
so you grow more and more familiar with the world's masterpieces as you play.
Whether you love art or have never given it a thought, the "oh, neat!" moments never stop.

Landscapes, portraits, grand scenes that tell a story…
A journey of the mind through masterpieces across eras and countries.

How to play is simple.
・Observe the painting corner to corner
・Find the part that answers the question and tap it
・Learn trivia about the painting in the explanation

So, shall we savor the world's great paintings more deeply — through riddles?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000130003.name: Dark Witch Match!
70010000130003.description:
A Match-3 Showdown from The Legend of Dark Witch!
The familiar faces of the series clash in a brand-new puzzle battle. Easy to pick up, deep to master — a truly competitive puzzle game, Dark Witch Match!

■ Deep, Competitive Match-3 Battles
Match three or more blocks to clear them, chain combos, and pile the pressure onto your opponent. Simple rules hide a world of mind games and strategy.

■ Online & Local Versus
Test your skills against players worldwide online, or go head-to-head with friends in local matches.

■ Score Attack & Global Leaderboards
Chase high scores and climb the ranks. The more you play, the hotter the climb to the top.

■ Story Mode (8 Stages)
Take on a cast of quirky rivals across 8 stages, with light, comedic banter along the way.

■ A Beloved Cast Returns
Zizou, Klinsy, Al, Sola and more — series favorites all in one place.

70010000130009.name: Grayland Remastered
70010000130009.intro: Fight to bring color back to a dying world.
70010000130009.description:
A noir story of a tiny bird fighting to bring color back to a dying world.

Caught in the endless war between Humans and Aliens, you are a small bird struggling to survive in the ruined, radioactive lands of Grayland. What was once a peaceful home has become a scorched, lifeless battlefield.

Fly through breathtaking hand-painted environments, dodge enemy drones, cleanse toxic hotspots, and confront colossal bosses on your journey to save your loved ones. Discover the haunting mystery behind the fall of this world—and fight to restore hope where none remains.

Key Features
• 16 handcrafted, challenging levels
• Atmospheric noir visuals and a deeply emotional story
• Varied and intense boss encounters
• A beautiful, immersive soundtrack
• Rebalanced difficulty for smoother, more rewarding progression

Even the smallest being can change the fate of a world.
Be the one who brings life back to Grayland.

70010000130026.name: Supermarket Simulator - Grocery Store
70010000130026.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game
70010000130026.intro: Build your store, serve your customers, and grow your business.
70010000130026.description:
Build your own grocery store, stock the shelves, set competitive prices, and keep your customers happy.

Manage daily operations, serve shoppers, upgrade your store, and turn a small local shop into a successful supermarket.

In Supermarket Simulator - Grocery Store, every decision shapes your business. Customize your layout, organize products, manage inventory, hire staff, and improve your store as you grow. Start with basic equipment and limited resources, then expand your supermarket and create a thriving retail business.

Key Features:

● Manage every aspect of your own supermarket
● Customize your store layout and organize products efficiently
● Order stock, manage inventory, and set competitive prices
● Operate the checkout with scanning and customer payments
● Expand and upgrade your store as your business grows
● Hire staff and automate daily tasks
● Build your business through smart decisions and efficient management

Take control of your store, keep your customers coming back, and turn your small grocery shop into a successful supermarket. Make smart investments, improve your operations, and watch your business grow from a simple local store into a thriving retail destination.

70010000130034.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival
70010000130034.intro: Arcade Beat 'Em Up Action in the World of AMC's The Walking Dead
70010000130034.description:
FIGHT THE DEAD. SURVIVE THE STREETS.
The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival challenges you to intense arcade brawling in the unforgiving world of AMC’s The Walking Dead.
Play as iconic survivors Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, Michonne, and unlockable Negan while fighting through walker-infested tunnels, devastated settlements, and hostile strongholds packed with explosive encounters. Face Alexandria’s most ruthless foes, the Saviors led by Negan, along with overwhelming waves of Walkers as you unleash crushing combos, signature weapon attacks, and devastating finishers in a relentless battle for survival.

INSPIRED BY THE STORY YOU KNOW. 
Based on the events of the All Out War storyline, fight through a campaign that reimagines the Saviors conflict that features walkers, threats, and surprises pulled from across the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. You’ll explore familiar environments from the show - including the Sanctuary, Hilltop, Alexandria – enhanced by dynamic set pieces, environmental hazards, and intense, story-driven moments.

ICONIC SURVIVORS. ICONIC WEAPONS.
Step into the boots of legendary characters from The Walking Dead, each with a unique fighting style, stats, and signature abilities inspired by the series. Rick’s magnum, Michonne’s katana, and Daryl’s trusty crossbow are all ready for battle - with Negan's Lucille waiting to be unlocked.

FEATURES:
•        Hard-Hitting Arcade Beat ’Em Up Combat
Use brutal melee abilities, crowd-clearing ranged attacks, or a mix of the two in fast-paced skirmishes. Enjoy responsive, crisp, and satisfying fighting gameplay while exploring the apocalypse.

•        Overwhelming Walker Swarms & Ruthless Enemies
Battle through creeping armies of the undead and dangerous members of The Saviors that force you to adapt, assess threats, and fight for every inch of ground.

•        Face Iconic Bosses
Take on powerful, fan-favorite walkers like Winslow, the Well Walker, and more. The Saviors provide their own challenges as you throw down with Negan and Simon in intense, multi-phase boss battles that test your skill, strategy, and survival instincts.

•        Replayable Arcade Challenge
Master each character’s moveset and tackle multiple difficulty levels in an experience built for repeat runs and escalating challenges. Or jump in with an optional Easy Mode for casual play.

70010000130052.name: Lingix Lingo
70010000130052.intro: An addictive Lingo-style word puzzle! Play through the map or start a streak!
70010000130052.description:
Welcome to the ultimate word puzzle experience designed for brain trainers and language lovers alike! Inspired by traditional Lingo-style word games, this title challenges you to guess hidden words under time pressure using strategic color-coded clues.

Green means the letter is correct and in the perfect spot; yellow means the letter is in the word but in the wrong position. Use your logic, unlock power-ups, and climb the scoreboard!

Key Features:
Thrilling Streak Mode: Put your skills to the ultimate test! Face an endless barrage of words back-to-back. With shifting word lengths and randomized themes, how many words can you solve in a row before breaking the chain?

Diverse Word Lengths: Play through dynamic modes featuring 4-letter, 5-letter, and 6-letter words to steadily increase the challenge.

Rich Category Map: Explore an interactive progression map. Test your vocabulary across dedicated categories including General Knowledge, Science, Art, Verbal, Literature, Architecture, and Psychology.

Powerful Boosters: Stuck on a tough word? Use your hard-earned coins to activate powerful power-ups like the Bomb (to eliminate wrong letters) or Time Extenders to keep the clock ticking.

Engaging Progression: Earn score multipliers, collect thousands of coins, and clear stages with a perfect 3-star rating to prove your word mastery.

Full Nintendo Switch™ Support: Play comfortably on the big screen in TV Mode, on your tabletop, or on the go with full Handheld Mode optimization.

Whether you want a quick 5-minute mental workout, a deep dive into advanced vocabulary, or a high-stakes run in Streak Mode, this game offers endless hours of educational and addictive puzzle fun. Sharpen your wits, expand your vocabulary, and become the ultimate word champion today!

70010000130082.name: Increbraintal
70010000130082.intro: Protect your brain from viruses in Increbraintal, an incremental auto-battler. Build your team to eliminate the infection that's taking over the body.
70010000130082.description:
The resources you collect can be spent in the Skill Tree to unlock permanent upgrades. When it comes to dangerous viruses, you can never be too careful!

Recruit allies from the Deck and create an effective formation where everyone complements each other's abilities.

Need support from a distance? Let your minions handle it. They may be tiny and adorable, but they're more than capable of taking care of the dirty work.

70010000130091.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
70010000130091.intro: Forge your destiny, defend your Clan, and live the life of a true Warrior Cat.
70010000130091.description:
Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest is an immersive action-adventure game set in the Lake Territories of the beloved Warrior Cats book series.

Embark on a variety of quests to gain favor with your Clan and battle others in turn-based combat to strengthen your cat and grow your legend. Learn new combat moves to take down your rivals. Encounter a wide range of enemies, including mice, squirrels, badgers and more, all leading to epic battles. Forage the land and find materials that can be used to craft items in your den. Travel across iconic territories including ThunderClan’s dense forests, RiverClan’s marshlands, ShadowClan’s dark pine swamps, and WindClan’s open moors. Your adventure will also take you to the famed sacred locations The Moonpool and The Island. Climb trees, pounce through undergrowth, track scents, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the mysteries of StarClan itself.

AN ORIGINAL STORY
Embark on a brand-new journey with iconic cats and locations from the Warrior Cats franchise. 

CREATE YOUR OWN WARRIOR CAT
Using the robust cat creator, name and create your very own Warrior Cat. 

GAME FEATURES:
* 3 Game types: Prophecy Mode, Defender Mode, Skirmish Mode.
Prophecy Mode - Four original stories about the trials and tribulations of Clan life. 
Defender mode -  Test how long you can last while battling all of the game’s fiercest enemies in a single run.
Skirmish mode -  Battle other players online asynchronously.
* Create your own unique Warrior Cat with millions of possible customization combinations.
* 6 iconic locations from the book series: ThunderClan territory, RiverClan territory, ShadowClan territory, WindClan territory, The Moonpool and The Island.
* Turn-based combat system with up to 3 versus 3 battles. 
* 75 unique combat moves to discover and unlock.
* Interact with 9 cats from the beloved book series.
* Battle a large variety of enemies including badgers, vicious foxes, imposing Dobermanns, rival Clan cats and many more. 
* Track and hunt birds, rabbits, squirrels and other prey.
* Visit your friend's camp online asynchronously. 
* You can also help friends with by crafting items or gifting them necessary resources and materials.
* No two playthroughs are the same as characters, quests and stories are procedurally generated.

70010000130112.name: Be Kind Rewind
70010000130112.intro: The fate of movie night is in your hands.
70010000130112.description:
Race against the clock as you rewind tapes, restock shelves, manage impatient customers, and keep the Friday night rush from turning into a complete disaster. Every second counts when there's only one rewinding machine and a store full of people demanding their movies now.

Can you survive three increasingly hectic shifts and become the ultimate VHS clerk, or will your customers leave before the credits roll?

Be Kind, Rewind. The fate of movie night is in your hands.

70010000130120.name: Science Trivia Quiz 100 Wonders
70010000130120.intro:
Discover the science hiding in everyday life!
Answer quick 4-choice quiz questions
100 wonders for kids and adults
70010000130120.description:
Enjoy a 4-choice quiz game based on the science found in everyday life.

From bubbles in fizzy drinks and photosynthesis in plants to pencil cores and metals used in wires, each question is inspired by familiar things you may see around you.
With 100 questions included, you can check your knowledge at your own pace.

How to play is simple!
・Read the question and look at the illustration
・Choose the answer from 4 options
・Try to clear all 100 questions

Simple controls make it easy for children, adults, and families to enjoy.
Play alone for a quick knowledge check, or discuss the answers with family and friends.

Discover the small science wonders hidden all around you!

70010000130129.name: Numerous Ninjas
70010000130129.intro: Guide a team of ninjas through endless chambers packed with traps, power-ups, and surprises. How long can your clan survive?
70010000130129.description:
Jump into a fast-paced, endlessly replayable action platformer where precision movement and quick thinking are the keys to survival. In Numerous Ninjas, you guide a growing team of agile ninjas through an ever-changing series of hazard-filled chambers designed to test your reflexes and adaptability at every turn.

Run, leap, and scale walls as your ninja squad navigates dangerous environments packed with traps, shifting obstacles, and unpredictable layouts. Each run pushes you further into increasingly difficult challenges where timing and positioning matter just as much as speed. One mistake can end your attempt—but every new run offers a fresh chance to improve.

Master fluid movement mechanics as you bounce between surfaces, avoid deadly hazards, and chain together precise maneuvers to stay alive longer. The action escalates quickly, demanding focus and rewarding players who learn to read the environment and react with confidence under pressure.

Along the way, discover helpful power-ups that can turn the tide of a run, offering temporary advantages or new survival options. Strategic use of these boosts can mean the difference between an early exit and a record-breaking run.

With its focus on replayability, Numerous Ninjas encourages players to refine their skills over time, chasing higher scores and longer survival streaks. Whether you’re playing in short bursts or committing to mastering its systems, every attempt feels dynamic and unpredictable.

Simple to pick up but challenging to master, Numerous Ninjas delivers an intense arcade-style experience built around momentum, precision, and survival. How far can your ninja team go before the chambers finally defeat them?

70010000130142.name: Do Not Find It: Anomaly Photo Files
70010000130142.description:
At first glance, it looks like an ordinary photo.
But look closer, and something that should not be there may be hiding in plain sight.

This is an observation and deduction game where you search photos for anomalies and unnatural details.
Take your time, compare what you see, and pin down the source of the strange feeling.

How to play is simple!
・Study the photo from corner to corner
・Use the prompt as your clue and look for the suspicious spot
・Choose the point you think is the answer

Odd details blended into everyday scenes, things that do not quite add up, and subtle anomalies are waiting to be found.
Some are easy to notice. Others may only stand out after a careful second look.

No complicated rules needed.
It is easy to enjoy in short sessions, whether you want to focus on your own or talk it through with family and friends.

Recommended for players who like:
・Observation puzzles and visual mystery games
・Strange photos and mysterious situations
・Testing deduction, insight, and focus
・Quick brain-training games for spare moments
・Solving little mysteries with family or friends

Do not let the hidden oddities slip past you.
Find every anomaly concealed in the photos.

70010000130149.name: IQ Logic Codes: Number & Letter Puzzles
70010000130149.intro:
Can you crack the pattern?
Train logic in quick rounds
70010000130149.description:
Think a simple set of numbers or letters is easy to read?

Those familiar-looking patterns can turn tricky once the hidden rule is just out of sight.

This is a text-based 4-choice logic puzzle game where you observe the question, spot the rule, and choose the answer that fits.

There are 40 stages to clear, built for quick brain-training sessions with number, letter, and reasoning-style challenges.

How to play is simple!

・Read the question carefully
・Look for the hidden rule or shared pattern
・Choose one answer from four options
・Check the explanation after answering

Even when you miss, the explanation helps you see the logic and try the next puzzle with a sharper eye.

Recommended for anyone who enjoys number puzzles, pattern quizzes, quick thinking, and casual brain training.

Use your observation and reasoning skills to clear all 40 stages!

Button controls and touch controls are supported.

70010000130171.name: Parking Problem
70010000130171.intro:
A slick, satisfying puzzler about untangling jammed car parks.
Slide vehicles in the right order and guide every car to the exit.
70010000130171.description:
Welcome to Parking Problem — a puzzle game about untangling jammed car parks. Slide vehicles in the right order, open up tight lanes, and guide every last car to the exit. It's quick to learn, deeply strategic, and perfect for that "one more puzzle" rhythm.

Tackle 150 handcrafted levels that gradually turn simple jams into clever brainteasers. New twists keep the grid fresh — tight corners, long vans, blocked lanes, one-way spaces, and gates to open — so planning two moves ahead really pays off. Stuck? Take a breath, rethink the order, and savor that sweet "aha!" when the lane finally clears.

Why you'll love it:
- 150 levels of clean, logic-driven parking puzzles
- Smooth slide controls and fast restarts for rapid iteration
- Smart difficulty curve: gentle warm-ups to devious jams
- Minimal, readable visuals that keep the board crystal-clear
- Play at your own pace — no timers, just pure strategy

Beat the gridlock, master the order, and enjoy the calm of a perfectly cleared lot in Parking Problem.

70010000130195.name: Hex Park
70010000130195.intro: A relaxing puzzle adventure where simple rules lead to surprisingly deep challenges.
70010000130195.description:
Welcome to Hex Park a colorful playground of brainteasers where every move matters. Rotate and align arrow tiles to guide directions, pop obstacles, and clear the board in as few moves as possible. It’s easy to pick up, delightfully tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

Tackle handcrafted levels featuring smart mechanics: keys and locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more. Plan routes, set up neat arrow alignments, and use handy tools like the hammer, dynamite, and drill when you need a nudge. No timers, no stress—just clean, strategic puzzle-solving with that perfect “one more level” feel.

Why you’ll love it:

Keys/locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, and other clever twists

Fair tools to get unstuck—without breaking the puzzle flow

Play at your own pace with smooth, satisfying controls

Achievements and cloud saves supported

Take a stroll, stay for a challenge—Hex Park is your new daily puzzle routine.

70010000130213.name: Viral Reload EX
70010000130213.intro: Viral Reload EX is a shoot-em-up with a dash mechanic where you shrink down to fight infections at a microscopic scale! Can you defeat the evil Kyle Kaboom?
70010000130213.description:
In the year 2063 the evil Kyle Kaboom has begun kidnapping the former members of his band Chainsaw Cannonball and infecting them with deadly viruses! Strapped into the Viral Unit, Bimmy and Octo must fight these infections all while trying to track down Kyle and stop him before he destroys the moon!

- Gameplay -
Blast away at deadly viruses and mechanical hybrids as you fight for the future of mankind! Dash through bullets, lasers, and even enemies to stay alive and rack up points.

- Features -
Story Mode - Defend earth from Kyle Kaboom at your pace: retry stages, practice bosses, and watch the story unfold.

Arcade Mode - Rack up a high score and attempt to clear the game in one complete run! You'll receive extra lives and a shield power-up to help tackle the swarm of viruses. If you can do it once, can you do it 2 or even 3 times in a row?

Boss Rush Mode - Once you've beaten the Story Mode, try your hand at Boss Rush! You'll face every boss back to back in one continuous loop as they become more and more challenging to defeat.

If you're up for some competition, see if you can be the top player in the world on the Online Leaderboard!

Grab a friend and fight for the high score with Alternating V.S. Multiplayer, or carry each other through the story!

Customize your visual experience with a selection of borders, the gorgeous Lottes CRT filter, and full Tate support for your vertical monitor.

Struggling to see bullets against the backgrounds? Hand getting tired from holding down or mashing the fire button? You can customize your experience further with a selection of Accessibility features.

Own an Arcade Cabinet in your home running a PC? Viral Reload can be taken off of Free Play and assigned a credit button for a more authentic arcade experience. (You could even get quarters out of your friends!)

70010000130236.name: Magnetail
70010000130236.intro: Think Like a Genius, Solve Like an Inventor
70010000130236.description:
Get ready to enter a world of clever inventions, smart challenges, and brilliant solutions in Magnetail. In this charming puzzle adventure, you follow an ingenious inventor mouse who transforms workshops, laboratories, and storage rooms into playgrounds of experimentation and discovery.

Each level presents a new challenge where energy, magnetism, and logic work together. Push energy modules, watch them slide across the environment, and use magnets strategically to redirect trajectories, create barriers, and open unexpected paths. It may seem simple at first, but you will quickly discover that every move can completely change the outcome of the puzzle.

The key is thinking several steps ahead. Where will the module stop? Which magnet should be used first? Which route leaves the path clear for the next move? In Magnetail, every decision matters, and finding the perfect solution is as satisfying as powering up a complex machine for the very first time.

Explore 30 carefully crafted levels spread across busy workshops, experimental laboratories, and storage facilities filled with mechanical challenges. New situations constantly emerge, requiring observation, planning, and creativity to master the rules of magnetism and turn obstacles into opportunities.

With charming visuals, accessible controls, and puzzles that reward intelligence and experimentation, Magnetail delivers a relaxing, engaging, and highly rewarding experience. It is the kind of game that makes you stop, study the room for a moment, and then smile when the perfect solution finally clicks into place.

Align the modules, master the magnets, and prove that no invention is too complex for a brilliant mind.

70010000130246.name: Hidden Girls: Secret Puzzle
70010000130246.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000130246.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000130256.name: Nora: In Search Of Hidden Ingredients - Director's Cut
70010000130256.intro: Help Nora learn about her Grandma’s past and find the magical artifacts hidden in her house!
70010000130256.description:
Magical Academy, a place that seemed perfect for her... After all, she is a future, great witch! As it turned out, fate willed otherwise and young Nora, after her Grandma's passing, must now go back to Lillyton to clain her inheritance - old Granny's house. But this task may be more difficult than it looks at first glance...

Nora: In Search of Hidden Ingredients is a unique combination of two types of games - kinetic visual novel, in which you will learn the story of a young adept of magic, her relationship with her beloved grandmother as well as a heartwarming tale of where true magic comes from. The second is a classic hidden object game In which you have to show cleverness and resourcefulness.

But be careful! A certain Spirit, has decided to put your skills to the test, and until you pass the obstacles put up by him... Reality is now shifting and your surroundings seem to be subject to some random, variable laws of nature... 

Will you help Nora fulfill her destiny?

Game key features:
- Clever combination of kinetic visual novel & hidden-object games
- 29 HO levels in 9 unique locations full of story bits to discover and objects to find
- An inquisitive Spirit decided to make Nora's task, a bit more tricky so...
- ...The levels as well as some of the items you have to find are randomly generated!
- Beautiful, hand-drawn visuals that will enchant you with their style
- Unlimited freeplay mode for HO fans

Start this magical adventure with Nora today!

70010000130294.name: Project Neon
70010000130294.description:
In the desolate future of 2042, Earth teeters on the brink of ecological collapse due to relentless climate change. The only hope lies with a visionary who abandoned Earth to start anew on Mars, disgusted by humanity’s negativity and the financial betrayal of his ventures.

“Project Neon” is your top-secret mission to navigate the treacherous cosmos and bring this recluse back from his Martian stronghold, without harming him, to salvage our dying planet. He has fortified Mars with an impenetrable shield, anchored by defenses on four neighboring planets.

Each planet is guarded by fierce enemies and daunting bosses, integral to maintaining the shield. Your task: dismantle this interplanetary defense, planet by planet, in a high-stakes shoot ’em up adventure.

Featuring intense 16-bit action that harks back to the glory days of Japanese arcade shooters, “Project Neon” promises a thrilling challenge.

Are you ready to face the ultimate shmup challenge and save Earth?

70010000130309.name: Yakiniku Party Survival
70010000130309.intro: This is a game where you challenge yourself to survive using only the ingredients from a yakiniku restaurant.
70010000130309.description:
Survive by maintaining a balanced diet and eat as much as you can. If your stomach gets full, burn off calories with squats to get hungry again!



Who doesn't love yakiniku?



How much can you eat at the BBQ restaurant? How many days can you survive at the BBQ restaurant? How far can your stomach endure? Who grilled this meat anyway? Food waste is a no-go.



Stealing, being stolen from, sometimes giving, and the budding friendships... all with a tear in your eye.



Welcome to Yakiniku Party Survival.



Game Overview:

Survive by consuming a balanced mix of protein, carbohydrates, and fats.

Each ingredient affects your nutritional balance differently.

If you overeat and your calories go overboard, you won’t be able to eat anymore. Burn off those calories with squats!



Game Features:

Online Multiplayer: Play with up to 4 people. Both Quick Matches and Friend Matches are available, and you can freely enter or leave either. In Quick Matches, survivors from around the world play at their own pace. Friend Matches let you easily play with specific friends using a single keyword. Of course, you can also play solo.



Cooperative or Competitive Play: In online multiplayer, you can grill meat for other players or steal their meat instead.



Skills: Learn and upgrade survival skills, such as tableware, rice, stomach expansion, or squat efficiency.



Fever Event: During The Fever event, no matter how much you consume, it’s zero calories! It’s your chance to balance your nutrition in one go.

70010000130313.name: Your Intelligence Will Be Exposed. Mystery Observation Challenge
70010000130313.intro:
In just 12 seconds, your eye for detail is exposed.
Can you read the clues and find the answer?
70010000130313.description:
A party hall, a park, a train platform — in a scene full of people, only one answer is hidden.

"That person looks suspicious..."
"No, wait — look at those shoes."
The longer you stare, the more you doubt. But the clock won't wait.

This is an observation puzzle where you reason from the clues drawn in a single picture — "Who did it?" "What's off?" — and tap your answer within a 12-second time limit.
Mud on a shoe, a stain on a sleeve, a tool in hand, the spot where someone stands —
every detail is your evidence to narrow down the truth by logic.
50 questions with a twist that first impressions alone won't crack.

The stages are everyday scenes that work anywhere in the world — gardens, plazas, cafés, harbors.
From 6 to 9 people, or rows of look-alike objects, you pick the one and only answer.
The further you go, the smaller and trickier the clues become.

How to play is simple.
・Scan the whole scene quickly
・Reason out the answer from the clues
・Tap that person (or spot) within 12 seconds

Get it right, and you're the detective of the hour.
Miss it, and one more look makes you nod — then you're hooked on the next.
Speed, observation, and deduction — your "smarts" show with every round.

So, can you see the truth in 12 seconds? Give it a try.

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.

70010000130326.name: My Supermarket Simulator
70010000130326.intro: From humble store to retail giant!
70010000130326.description:
Your new business is now welcoming you! You have been handed the keys to a modest, empty commercial space, and your goal is simple: turn it into a thriving, highly profitable retail empire.

The success of the store rests entirely in your hands. Begin your day by ordering inventory, unpacking heavy cardboard boxes, and meticulously organizing products on the shelves so that customers can easily find what they need. You control the economy. Analyze market trends and set dynamic prices for each item to maximize profits without losing loyal customers. When the store opens, stand behind the cash register to scan barcodes, process credit cards, and give back change quickly to keep the lines moving.

Reinvest your earnings to expand your floor space, upgrade your lighting, and unlock licenses to sell hundreds of new, diverse products. Once the daily rush becomes too much for one person to handle, hire and train a team of cashiers and stockers to keep the business running smoothly. Customize your layout, paint the walls, and design the ultimate shopping environment. Do you have what it takes to build the greatest supermarket in town?

Key Features:
• Stock the Shelves: Order goods, unpack boxes, and arrange a wide variety of products to create an organized and inviting store.
• Master the Register: Scan items, process card payments, and quickly count out cash change for waiting customers.
• Set the Market: Take control of the economy. Monitor daily market trends and adjust your pricing strategy to balance high profits with happy shoppers.
• Grow Your Empire: Use your profits to unlock new store sections, purchase additional shelving, and expand your product catalog from basic snacks to premium goods.
• Automate the grind by hiring, training, and managing a team of employees to run the registers and restock shelves while you focus on the big picture.
• Total Customization: Design your store's layout, choose color schemes, and place decorations to create a unique shopping atmosphere.

70010000130332.name: Silent Cleaning
70010000130332.intro:
“Clean the house. Stay undetected.“
A 3D horror action game
powered by Kao’s cleaning tools！
70010000130332.description:
Note: This game is available in Japanese only.

In this version, players can choose between two modes:

・Normal Mode
・Less-Scary Mode, designed for older elementary school children and up

Key Feature 1: Real cleaning products appear in the game

The game features actual Kao cleaning products, including Magiclean and Quickle products. Some hidden techniques even allow players to combine items and clean in ways that reflect the real-life features of the products.

Key Feature 2: Discover hidden mechanisms and codes in each stage

The mansion where the game takes place is divided into several stages. Players must use cleaning items to uncover hidden codes and find the keys needed to advance to the next stage.

Key Feature 3: A mysterious “thing” creeps up on players as they clean

In the game, a mysterious “thing” roams the mansion and gets in the player’s way. It reacts to even the smallest sounds, such as cleaning noises and footsteps, and attacks. Players must clean the mansion and find a way out while avoiding this unknown threat.

Products Featured in the Game

・Magiclean Handy Spray
・Toilet Magiclean No-Scrub Foam Pack
・Bath Magiclean Air Jet Disinfecting EX
・Magiclean EXPOWER Water Stain Spray
・Quickle Wiper 3D Adhesive Wet Sheet STRONG Super Space Deodorizing

Estimated Play Time: Approximately 60–90 minutes

All proceeds from sales of this title will be donated to organizations that support children’s education and related causes.

Frequently Asked Questions
