Q: Does the game have auto-save, or can players save manually at any point?

A: Progress is saved automatically through auto-save. Even if players quit the game, they can resume from where they left off. However, some minor progress details may not be saved. Players can also restart after a game over without losing their progress.

Q: Can players adjust controller sensitivity, screen brightness, volume, and other settings in detail?

A: Yes. From the in-game settings screen, players can adjust options such as brightness, overall volume, and controller sensitivity using sliders.

70010000130424.name: Build My Arcade
70010000130424.intro: Build your dream arcade from the ground up!
70010000130424.description:
Start with just a handful of arcade machines and a small budget, then grow your business into the ultimate entertainment destination. Every machine earns money, every upgrade attracts more customers, and every decision shapes the future of your arcade.

Expand your floor with new game cabinets, purchase furniture, and unlock bigger, better attractions as your arcade grows. Manage your profits wisely, reinvest in your business, and transform a tiny game room into a thriving arcade empire.

Features:
> Start with a small arcade and expand over time.
> Buy a variety of arcade machines.
> Earn money from customers and reinvest your profits.
>Purchase furniture to improve your arcade's appearance.
> Build the ultimate arcade and become the best in town!

Will you create the most popular arcade in town?

70010000130449.name: 99% Can't Spot It! Common Sense Battle
70010000130449.intro:
I'm sure I know this" is exactly where you slip.
Can you spot the real thing among four images?
70010000130449.description:
Do you know which fruit a cashew grows on — and where?

The moment you think "that's just common sense" is the most dangerous one.
The more familiar something is, the less we actually know its true form.

This game is a common-sense quiz where you pick the "real one" from four very similar images.
How a pineapple actually grows, the red liquid a hippo sweats, the true color of Mars, the inside of a pyramid —
100 questions with a twist, on things you thought you knew but get wrong.

Every theme is the "now that you mention it, I'm curious" kind.
The correct image hides among three look-alike decoys.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question
・Pick the one image of four you believe is real
・Stuck? Narrow it down with a hint
・Check the explanation for why it's the answer

The surprise of "Wait, THIS one is real?!"
The realization of "I really was assuming."
Right or wrong, you gain one new fact — so 100 questions just fly by.

So, the "real thing" 99% can't spot — can you pick it out?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.

70010000130461.name: Escape game R00M16
70010000130461.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

70010000130467.name: Hunted
70010000130467.intro: Run. Hide. Survive. A ruthless butcher stalks your every move in this tense first-person horror experience.
70010000130467.description: You awaken alone in a deserted hospital, its halls filled with darkness, mystery, and fear. As you search for a way out, you discover that you are not alone. A relentless butcher roams the building, hunting anyone who crosses his path. Explore the hospital, solve puzzles, uncover its disturbing past, and use stealth to survive. Stay quiet, stay hidden, and escape before the butcher finds you.

70010000130508.name: Perfect Crime Case Files
70010000130508.intro: Can you crack the perfect setup?
70010000130508.description:
One scene, one suspicious detail—can you spot where the case breaks?

Perfect crimes look flawless at first glance. But if you slow down and really study the picture, something may start to feel off.

This is a casual picture-based mystery quiz where each case is solved by choosing one spot in the illustration.

・Read the prompt
・Inspect the image carefully
・Select the one place that fits the answer
・Move on to the next case

No complicated rules, no long setup—just quick cases that test your eyes, focus, and deduction.

Whether you nail it right away or miss the mark, every attempt helps sharpen your observation skills.

Take on a file whenever you have a few minutes. Can you expose the flaw in the perfect crime?

Button controls and touch controls are both supported.

70010000130515.name: Something That Shouldn't Be There Is Visible.
70010000130515.intro:
Look closely at this image. One thing doesn't belong.
Once you notice it, you can't look away.
70010000130515.description:
A quiet hallway. A room that should be empty. Dolls lined up in neat rows.
— And among them, one "thing that shouldn't be there" is hiding.

A pale, translucent figure.
A single "real one" mixed into a row of dolls and mannequins.
You won't catch it at a glance. But once you find it, you'll never unsee it.

This is a horror observation game where you spot the presence that shouldn't be there inside a single dim image, and tap it.
An extra figure in an empty place, a living person among lined-up statues —
you hunt down that spine-tingling wrongness with nothing but your eyes.
No gore, nothing graphic. The only scary things are the "presence" and the "wrongness" — which is exactly why it creeps up on you.

50 scenes in all.
The further you go, the more cleverly it blends in, and the harder it gets to tell.

How to play is simple.
・Scan every corner of the dim picture
・Find the thing that "shouldn't be there," and tap it gently

The instant you spot it, a chill runs down your spine — that's the reward.
Play alone in a bright room, or shout "Where?!" with a friend.

So, the wrongness hidden in this one image — can you find it?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.

70010000130527.name: The Final Scene
70010000130527.description:
The picture is covered—but did the key detail stay in your head?

You had 60 seconds. You were sure you noticed everything... until one small part disappears behind the mask.

This is a casual visual memory quiz where you study an image, then answer a 4-choice question based on what you remember. The mood may feel dramatic, but the rules are simple and quick.

How to play:
・Study the image while it is shown
・After part of the image is masked, read the question
・Choose one answer from four options
・When you are correct, check the original image again

Every round is a compact test of attention and recall. Even a tiny detail can decide whether your memory tells the whole story.

Play a quick round whenever you like, and see if you can catch what was hiding in the final scene.

Supports button controls and touch controls.

70010000130587.name: Mireglow
70010000130587.intro: Step into a peaceful mystical swamp filled with wonder and hidden discoveries.
70010000130587.description:
Welcome to Mireglow, a cozy exploration game where the only goal is to wander, discover, and enjoy the journey. Explore a tranquil swamp glowing with magical plants, ancient trees, quiet waterways, and forgotten paths as you search for every unique location hidden throughout the world.

Features
>Explore a beautiful mystical swamp.
>Discover every hidden location and secret area.
>Relax in a cozy, stress-free adventure.
>Wander through glowing marshes, ancient forests, and quiet waterways.
>Enjoy a calm and immersive atmosphere.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration.

Lose yourself in the glow of the swamp and discover every hidden corner of Mireglow.

70010000130590.name: Bad Capybara
70010000130590.intro: The giant rodent versus the sheriff!
70010000130590.description:
Forget being a peaceful pet; today, you're a destructive intruder. You are a giant rodent breaking into the sheriff's house. Your objective is simple: cause as much property damage as possible without getting caught.

Waddle through a highly interactive house and use your size to your advantage. Push over heavy TVs, break expensive vases, and smash the furniture. Open the refrigerator door to steal food, jump on kitchen tables, and drive the sheriff's guard dog crazy. When the owner walks in, quickly hide in a closet to avoid capture. Then, jump out and continue your rampage! From the backyard to the living room, make the sheriff's home your personal playground.

Key Features:
• Interactive Destruction: Shatter household objects, knock over electronics, and toss furniture with amusing physics-based movement.
• Fridge Raiding: Search the kitchen to steal snacks, sausages, and fresh vegetables directly from the cabinets and refrigerator.
• Evade the Sheriff: Dodge the homeowner and his guard dog by hiding in closets and sneaking through different rooms.
• Explore the house. Run wild from the grassy backyard to the master bedroom and leave a trail of chaos in your wake.

70010000130596.name: Lady Death Demonicron
70010000130596.intro: Lady Death Demonicron is a side-scrolling hack and slash for fans of the golden age of arcade gaming.
70010000130596.description:
All Lady Death wants is to mourn a fallen friend in peace. Then an infernal portal rips open and a throng of demon scum storms the cemetery gates. Little does Lady Death know, the most brutal battle of her undead life has just begun.

Malevolent forces tear Lady Death from one realm to another... From the stinking pits of Hell, to an undead heavy metal festival, to a demonic dinosaur catastrophe, to a cannibalistic, industrial nightmare. Through it all, one true ally stands at her side: Ravenheart, a haunted warrior armed with a savage sword and the touch of death, but will even his strength be enough?

Lady Death Demonicron is an all new side-scrolling, sword-slicing, magic-wielding, 15 level co-op hack and slash that takes the best aspects of the 1990s arcade classics all mixed together with a killer industrial-metal soundtrack.

70010000130598.name: Tarot Tokens
70010000130598.description:
Tarot Tokens is a strategic tile game inspired by the Fools journey through the major arcana of the tarot. Placing Tarot Tokens crafts your journey from four key aspects of the major arcana of the tarot: family, morals, conflict, hope.

Win With Virtues
The aim of Tarot Tokens is to build your three virtues up and keep them nicely balanced by making wise, or seemingly foolish choices, along the way. Run out of any virtue and the journey ends. Reach the end by taking all the steps and reflect on your journey - learn to see pass the numbers and embrace your whole journey.

The Fool
Every game starts with The Fool already placed. Your choices between the Tarot Tokens steers your journey, with the help of the Fools Abilities every few turns. Your journey through the life challenges of placing tokens shape the Fools path that is always different, always yours.

Silence Is Golden
Tarot Tokens has no sound of any kind, no music, no effects, nothing. Enjoy the silence or bring your own noise, much like when using real tarot cards for a reading. Feedback is visual only and there are options to tone it down if you find it a bit much.

Not A Deck Builder
You play with all 22 tokens of the major arcana, every game. A randomly selected number of tokens are offered to you each turn, except The Fool who is used only once at the start of every game. All tokens interact with some other tokens on the board. Each token has its own unique effect with most generating virtues in addition to other token interactions. 

Follow Your Path
Play your favourite token as often as you want, if it is available that turn. Or play highly tactically to gain maximum virtue and be really efficient, although you might just be missing out. Every token is always unlocked and randomly chosen every turn - no token fixing or token reading goes on (even though it might feel that way if your journey feels off).

A Hex On You!
Tarot Tokens uses a hex grid in shameless violation of the four sided card format of the tarot. The essence of the tarot is faithfully preserved in a hex shape with on-demand help explaining virtues, adjacency information, and a brief description of the significance of that tarot token in the context of the Fools journey. Hex grids are still over rated though!

70010000130614.name: Conquest: Global Domination
70010000130614.intro:
Conquer the world through strategy, diplomacy, and military power.
Build your nation. Expand your empire. Dominate the globe.
70010000130614.description:
Conquest: Global Domination is a turn-based grand strategy game where every decision can change the balance of power.

Choose from real-world nations or create battles between fictional countries as you compete for global supremacy. Expand your territory, strengthen your economy, develop advanced military technology, and build an army capable of defeating your rivals.

Recruit infantry, tanks, helicopters, bombers, and other military units to defend your borders or launch large-scale invasions. Research powerful technologies including drones, missile defense systems, and nuclear weapons to gain a strategic advantage over your opponents.

Victory requires more than military strength. Manage your resources carefully, plan your expansion, and decide when to attack, defend, or invest in new technologies. Every turn presents new strategic opportunities and difficult choices.

Play with different victory conditions to suit your preferred style:
• Domination Mode – Conquer 20 countries to become the world's dominant superpower.
• Turn Limit Mode – Earn the highest score before the final turn to claim victory.

Features:

Turn-based global strategy gameplay.
Play as real or fictional nations.
Build and command a modern military.
Recruit infantry, tanks, helicopters, and bombers.
Research drones, nuclear weapons, and missile defense systems.
Capture territories and expand your empire.
Multiple victory conditions for varied gameplay.
High replay value with countless strategic possibilities.

Will your nation become the next global superpower?

70010000130679.name: Street Food Simulator
70010000130679.intro: From Corner Cart to Culinary Kingpin!
70010000130679.description:
You are not just the head chef, but also the manager, cashier, and driving force behind the city's most popular food truck. Bustling sidewalks are filled with hungry customers waiting for you to take their orders, prep the ingredients, and serve them mouthwatering meals that are hot, fresh, and served exactly on time.

Success in the street food business requires more than a great recipe. It demands lightning-fast reflexes and impeccable time management. During the daily lunch rush, you must multitask effortlessly with smooth, intuitive gamepad controls. Juggle multiple orders, keep a close eye on the grill, and ensure nothing burns! Each satisfied customer will leave you with hard-earned cash and a growing reputation. However, if you make them wait too long, they will walk away hungry.

Use your daily profits to transform your modest setup into a world-class culinary enterprise. As you progress, you will unlock a wide variety of new ingredients, allowing you to expand your menu and take on exciting new cooking challenges. Purchase top-tier kitchen equipment to speed up prep time and eventually unlock expanded dining spaces to accommodate larger crowds. Put on your apron, turn on the stove, and see how far you can take your street food empire!

Key Features:
• Sizzle & Serve: Master the daily rush! Cook, assemble, and deliver orders quickly before your hungry customers get impatient.
• Upgrade Your Kitchen: Use your hard-earned profits to invest in high-tech grills, faster fryers, and advanced prep stations to increase your efficiency.
• Expand your menu: Unlock a wide variety of fresh ingredients and complex, high-paying recipes to keep the crowds coming back for more.
• Grow Your Empire: Transform your modest street cart into a top-tier mobile restaurant with expanded dining spaces to host bigger crowds.
• Smooth Console Controls: Seamlessly navigate kitchen chaos with intuitive gamepad controls designed specifically for fast-paced multitasking.

70010000130685.name: Zombie War
70010000130685.intro: Zombie War plunges players into a relentless battle for survival against hordes of the undead.
70010000130685.description:
Set in a grim and desolate world overrun by zombies, the game challenges players to fend off wave after wave of increasingly formidable enemies. 
With its top-down view and fast-paced action, Zombie War offers an adrenaline-pumping experience that will keep players on the edge of their seats. 
Armed with an arsenal of weapons and gear, players must fight tooth and nail to stay alive in the face of overwhelming odds.

Fight and thrive in the endless onslaught of zombies. 
Upgrade your gear and weapons and keep up with stronger enemies. 
Your main goal in this grim world is survival.

Upgrade your gear and weapons to progress in the game as the difficulty rises. 
Pick up useful loot and use your special abilities to survive as long as possible.

70010000130703.name: Hotel Empire - Check Inn
70010000130703.intro: Build hotels, accommodate guests, and expand your hotel business worldwide!
70010000130703.description:
Hotel Empire - Check Inn is a charming management simulation in which you build your own hotel chain step by step. Start with a small, simple hotel and expand your empire into more and more cities – each with its own challenges.

BUILD, EXPAND, AND OPTIMIZE
- Build new hotels, buy building plots.
- Plan rooms with increasingly complex shapes and place them as efficiently as possible.
- Fulfill your guests' wishes: they want specific rooms and parking spaces.

MANAGE STAFF & SERVICE
- Hire enough maids, because every room must be cleaned after check-out.
- Build elevators, upgrade them, and keep them in good condition so guests can quickly reach their floor.
- Build service rooms such as kitchens, laundries, or saunas, and employ porters who transport food, laundry, and other items through the hotel.

EVERY CITY BRINGS NEW CHALLENGES
- Montreal: Cold, snowy weather – insulate rooms so guests don't freeze.
- Miami: Luxury hotels right by the sea with especially demanding room layouts.
- New York: Build several hotels at the same time and use managers who automate check-in.

EASY TO LEARN - HARD TO MASTER
Hotel Empire - Check Inn combines accessible gameplay with a deep management focus. Optimize processes, keep guests happy, and expand your hotel chain into a global empire.

70010000130716.name: Monster Nursery
70010000130716.intro: A relaxing idle monster collection game (with offline progress). Features 200 monster entries and 10 Lo-fi tracks.
70010000130716.description:
1. Hatch Eggs: Obtain juvenile monsters of random rarities
2. Raise Monsters: Wait for juvenile monsters to grow up
3. Sell Monsters: Sell monsters after they mature
4. Collect: Complete 100 × 2 monster handbook entries
5. Music: Enjoy relaxing Lo-fi music while idling
6. Offline Progress: Monsters continue to grow and earn income even while you're away

70010000130727.name: Ascent DX
70010000130727.intro: Crashed on a desolate but mysterious planet you find yourself eye to eye with an ancient civilisation. Explore the planet, find powerful upgrades and fulfill your destiny
70010000130727.description:
Ascent DX is a tiny metroidvania brought to life in glorious 64 x 64 pixel art and soothing chiptune music. Crashed on an unknown planet you have to explore lush jungles, lifeless deserts, and luminescent caves in search of anything that can help you understand what has happened to the planet and how to get off it.

While the game is a bigger version of the original Ascent, with almost twice as many locations to explore, it is still quite a short game. With the same celebrated gameplay and atmosphere, the DX versions also brings more items to find, more platforming puzzles, and more lore to uncover. 

Features:
* A world brought to life by tiny but expressive pixel art
* Explore the planet's many biomes in your own pace and direction
* Find new powers and abilities that help you on your way
* Uncover the fate of the planet as well as your own 
* Different endings based on how much was discovered

Credits:
Design, code, & pixel art: Johan Peitz
Music & sfx: Brent Houston
Capsule art: Jon Nielsen 
Nintendo Switch port: Corey Underdown

70010000130729.name: The Chilling Moment You Realize It: Creepy Meaning Psychological Test
70010000130729.intro:
The answer you choose reveals a hidden truth about you.
And the instant you finish reading it — a chill.
70010000130729.description:
A photo of a hallway at midnight. A door left half open. An empty Ferris wheel.
Where did your eyes go first?

That offhand reaction reveals the true feelings you usually keep hidden.
This game is a psychological test where you look at an oddly raw, candid-style photo and pick "how it makes you feel" from 4 choices.

The moment you choose, a different "true-feelings diagnosis" appears for each option.
And at the end of each one comes a small — chilling — twist.
"You think you're protecting it, but you've locked everyone out, and yourself in."
A truth that makes your spine tingle the moment you notice it — gently spelled out for you.

Hallways, doors, mirrors, clocks, still water, staircases, roads —
50 symbolic scenes that tug at anyone's heart and peer into your deepest psyche.

How to play is simple.
・Look at a photo and pick how you feel from 4 choices
・Read the "true-feelings diagnosis" for your choice
・When the chill hits, move on to the next photo

There are no right answers, so play again and again, with anyone.
Quietly self-diagnose alone, or read them aloud with friends and squeal "that's creepy!" —
light to start, deep when it lands: a creepy-meaning psychological test.

So, the "darkness" hiding deep in your heart — shall we take a peek?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.

70010000130743.name: Farming Homestead
70010000130743.intro: Build, grow, craft, and live your dream farm life in Farming Homestead, a cozy farming simulation game where every day brings new opportunities.
70010000130743.description:
Plant crops, water your fields, harvest fresh produce, craft useful tools, trade with merchants, and shape your homestead exactly the way you want.

Start with a small piece of land and turn it into a thriving countryside home. Prepare the soil, grow different crops through realistic growth stages, gather resources, and expand your farm with buildings, fences, storage areas, and custom structures. Whether you enjoy peaceful farming, creative building, or managing resources for survival, Farming Homestead gives you the freedom to play your way.

Explore a complete farming experience with dynamic weather, a smooth day-and-night cycle, useful tools, crafting recipes, inventory management, trading, and persistent save progress. Every system works together to create a relaxing yet rewarding homestead adventure. Create the farm you have always imagined. Grow your land, build your home, and enjoy the peaceful life of Farming Homestead.

Features

Grow a wide variety of crops with planting, watering, harvesting, soil preparation, and time-based growth.

Craft tools, items, and equipment using a flexible recipe-based crafting system.

Build and customize your farm with structures, fences, storage, and decorations using free placement.

Manage your inventory and hotbar to quickly access tools, seeds, resources, and crafted items.

Buy and sell goods through merchant NPCs and build your farming economy.

Experience dynamic weather and a beautiful day-and-night cycle that brings your world to life.

70010000130767.name: Hearthwater
70010000130767.intro: Escape to a peaceful seaside village and discover every hidden corner.
70010000130767.description:
Welcome to Hearthwater, a cozy exploration game where there's no combat, no timers, and no pressure—just a beautiful village waiting to be explored. Wander along sandy beaches, stroll through quiet streets, and venture into forests, hills, and hidden paths as you uncover every location the village has to offer.

Take your time soaking in the relaxing atmosphere while searching for landmarks, secret spots, and scenic viewpoints. Every path leads to something new, encouraging you to explore at your own pace and experience the charm of Hearthwater.

Features
> Explore a peaceful seaside village.
> Discover every unique location and hidden area.
> Relax with a cozy, stress-free exploration experience.
> Immerse yourself in a calm atmosphere.
> Take your time—there are no timers, combat, or pressure.

Every path has a story. Every corner is waiting to be discovered.

70010000130813.name: The Square Ones
70010000130813.description:
Jump into a vibrant world of floating platforms, tricky obstacles and fast-paced challenges in this addictive hyper-casual platformer.

Take control of a charming cube and hop your way across a variety of handcrafted levels filled with narrow pathways, moving hazards and clever routes that will put your timing and precision to the test. Every stage offers a new challenge as you leap from block to block, avoid deadly spikes, cross crumbling platforms, dodge fireballs, swing past massive hammers and overcome many more obstacles standing in your way.

Collect coins throughout your adventure and use them to unlock a growing collection of unique cube skins, allowing you to customize your character and show off your style as you progress through the game.

As your journey continues, you'll encounter the Evil Square Ones, powerful rivals that await in exciting boss battles. These action-packed encounters will challenge everything you've learned and reward skillful play.

With simple controls, satisfying gameplay and a steady stream of short, engaging levels, this is the perfect game to pick up for a quick challenge or settle in for a longer session. Easy to learn but difficult to master, every jump counts as you work your way through increasingly demanding stages.

Can you conquer every level, defeat the Evil Square Ones and become the ultimate platforming champion?

70010000130824.name: SuperSharket
70010000130824.intro: Welcome to the supermarket where fish shop and sharks work!
70010000130824.description:
Welcome to SuperSharket — the supermarket where fish shop like humans!

Build and manage your very own underwater supermarket, stocked with all the everyday products you would find in a human store. From filling shelves to managing the checkout, every part of the supermarket is in your hands.

Hire a team of sharks to keep your store running, serve different types of fish, manage your money, and keep your customers happy. Expand your supermarket, build new areas, upgrade your facilities, and turn a small underwater shop into a thriving retail empire.

Every customer is different, and every fish has somewhere to be. Keep the shelves stocked, the queues moving, and the cash registers ringing while your shark employees handle the work.

Why do fish need human groceries? Nobody knows. But they clearly love shopping.

Build your store. Hire your sharks. Serve your fish. Become the ultimate underwater supermarket manager!

70010000130837.name: Sir, You Are Being Hunted
70010000130837.intro: Escape from these robot-infested islands with violence, trickery and stealth.
70010000130837.description:
Sir, You Are Being Hunted is a procedurally-generated British horror in which tweed-wearing robots hunt you for sport. 
Roam the landscape, scavenge for food, hide breathlessly in the undergrowth, flee in terror, and even fight back with stolen weapons.

Sir is a stealth and survival game unlike any other.

Key Features:
- First-person stealth and survival.
- Procedurally-generated British landscape.
- Five biomes to explore: castle, industrial, rural, mountainous, and fenland.
- Infinite replayability in a sandbox world.
- Powerful, brutal AI that becomes tougher as you play.
- Tea and biscuits.
- Foliage-based stealth system.
- Scavenge to survive.
- Play as Sir or Madam.
- Relentless Britishness.

Every Game Unique!
Sir, You Are Being Hunted is set on a mysterious archipelago generated procedurally by you, and therefore unique to each game you play. 
You can define your own islands, each one created in moments by our rather clever British Countryside Generator. 
These islands are then populated by a raving aristocracy of murderous robots, their robot hounds, and worse. You job is simply to survive, and get home.

You're not entirely alone, though: The disembodied voice of Walters, your butler, will help you and offer advice.

Ultimate AI Threat
Sir's AI is one of the toughest in stealth, and as an open-world game, it's unique in its field. 
The robots are some of the most aggressive and intelligent game enemies you will ever experience, and will pursue you even after losing sight of you. Expect to be hunted!

The Most British Of Games
Sir, You Are Being Hunted is set in a parallel Britain, complete with bleak villages, rocky highlands, bramble-filled woodland, decrepit farms, and crumbling post-industrial landscapes. 
Made with the remarkable power of our British Landscape Generator, these landscapes are enormously evocative and teeming with detail. 
Take time to explore, and find that vital hidden flask of tea!

70010000130860.name: Dark Reflection
70010000130860.intro: A thrash metal album reveals a ritual that opens a portal to another world.
70010000130860.description:
YOUR WORLD, BUT TWISTED
When your best friend vanishes, you must enter the Dark Reflection—a hostile, warped copy of your own reality. Here, familiar places are dangerous, and friendly faces cannot be trusted.

SURVIVE THE NIGHTMARE
The Dark Reflection is a classic side-scrolling pixel-art adventure packed with action, puzzles, and heavy metal energy.

Explore: Search creepy locations and find vital items to survive.

Solve: Use your brain and your inventory to clear obstacles.

Fight: Slash your way through hordes of demons and unique bosses.

DARK HUMOR & HEAVY METAL
Step into a world where dark humor meets a heavy rock soundtrack. Every corner hides a secret, and every choice matters.

Features
Warped World: Explore an unsettling, distorted reality.

Classic Gameplay: Solve puzzles and manage items to progress.

Brutal Battles: Fight aggressive monsters and giant bosses.

Hidden Secrets: Find secret paths and weird encounters.

Your Choice: Make decisions that lead to multiple endings.

Turn up the volume of your doom.

70010000130931.name: Home Makeover: Hidden Object
70010000130931.intro: Help Emma restore her grandparents' old house back to its former glory!
70010000130931.description:
Make money from garage sales to buy furniture and new fixtures for their old house!
Home Makeover is a hidden object game that features decoration and match 3 mini games with unlimited levels and gameplay time, all in one package!

- 12 scenes and 10 gameplay modes
- Match-3 mini-games
- Decoration and makeover
- Bonus household tips and facts

70010000130936.name: Tome of the Damned
70010000130936.intro: Tome of the Damned - dark top-down roguelike. Cut down the castle guard, upgrade your weapons and spells, battle through dozens of locations, and face ruthless bosses.
70010000130936.description:
Become the Nightmare of All Humanity

Tome of the Damned is a dark and gripping top-down roguelike that tells the tragic story of a mage whose reckless experiments with forbidden magic ended in disaster. Once a powerful sorcerer, you are now a living corpse doomed to endless cycles of reincarnation, inhabiting the bodies of the dead. Your lair lies deep within the castle’s dungeons, surrounded by former allies and castle guards who are determined to keep you locked away to prevent your dark magic from escaping.

Your journey begins in the deepest, darkest corners of the castle. Step by step, you fight your way toward freedom, facing increasingly powerful foes-seasoned warriors, cunning mages, and relentless guards willing to give their lives to stop you.

Along the way, you discover ancient altars that serve as sources of power.

These altars allow you to enhance your weapons, unlock powerful spells, and improve your attributes, offering countless paths to develop your abilities and adapt to the trials ahead.

Choose one of five enchanted weapons and one of four magical grimoires, then grind your enemies to dust. But don’t worry if you happen to die.

After all, you still have plenty of bodies left-you can simply take a new one.

70010000131030.name: Brawl Snakes
70010000131030.description:
Enter the arena and prove you're the apex serpent in this fast-paced snake battler. Compete against a swarm of rival snakes for every scrap of food, grow longer with every bite, and force your opponents into deadly mistakes. One wrong move means the end — crash into another snake and it's game over. Only the biggest and smartest survive.
GROW OR CRASH

Start small and chow down your way to the top. The more you eat, the longer and deadlier you become. But size cuts both ways — the bigger you grow, the harder it is to weave through the chaos. Steer clear of every other snake on the field, because a single collision ends your run. Outmaneuver your rivals, cut off their path, and watch them crash so you can feast on what's left.


FEATURES
-Snake Growth & Evolution — Every bite makes you bigger and stronger. Evolve from a tiny worm into a massive, screen-dominating beast.
-Living Food World — A constantly replenishing arena keeps the action non-stop. There's always something to eat — and always someone trying to take it first.
-Survive the Collision — Crash into another snake and you're done. Force your rivals into yours and clear the field of competition.
-Real-Time Leaderboards — Watch the rankings shift live as you and your rivals battle for the #1 spot. Can you hold the crown?
-XP & Progression — Earn experience with every match and level up your way to bigger rewards and bragging rights.
-Game-Changing Boosters — Deploy magnets, speed bursts, score multipliers, and vision boosters to turn the tide in the heat of battle.
-Cosmetic Customization — Make your snake unmistakably yours with a huge range of looks and styles at the skin Shop
-Booster Shop — Stock up on power-ups and head into each match loaded for war.
-Reward Economy — Earn coins through skillful play or Wheel of fortune and spend them on skins, boosters, and more. The grind always pays off.

THE ARENA AWAITS
No two matches play the same. Quick to learn, impossible to put down — Brawl Snakes delivers bite-sized chaos that's perfect for one more round... and then just one more.

Are you ready to become the Final Boss of the arena?

70010000131080.name: Scary Shawarma Shop
70010000131080.description:
Welcome to the night shift! You just got a job running a small, 24-hour shawarma stand on a dark, quiet street. It seems like an easy way to earn some quick cash. Wait for a customer to approach the window, prepare their food, and collect the money. However, as the midnight crowd arrives, you'll quickly realize that this isn't an ordinary neighborhood and that not everyone on the other side of the glass is human.

To survive in this kiosk, you need to be paranoid and have a sharp eye. As each customer approaches to place an order, observe them closely and check the security cameras for anything unusual. Are their voices distorted? Are their facial features morphing into something monstrous? Is there an unsettling shadow lurking just out of sight? Learn to spot these terrifying anomalies hiding in plain sight.

When a guest checks out, treat them to a delicious shawarma and send them on their way. However, if your gut tells you something is wrong, do not hesitate. Hit the red emergency button and slam the heavy metal shutters down immediately. You cannot afford to be careless. You only have five chances to mess up. If you make too many mistakes by feeding a monster or turning away a normal person, you will summon the dreaded Inspector. If he arrives at your window, your shift is over... and your life might be, too. 

Do you have the nerve to survive until morning?

70010000131097.name: DopePie Survivors 3D
70010000131097.intro: Lead the survivors through a vertical city overrun by the infected!
70010000131097.description:
DopePie Survivors 3D is a third-person shooter that blends survivor-like combat with 3D platforming.

In a vertical city ravaged by a virus, take control of characters with unique abilities and battle waves of infected enemies and gigantic bosses. Collect a wide variety of weapons and skills to create a different build in every run.

Climb buildings, race across rooftops, and glide from the heights while using the city's vertical spaces to your advantage. Pilot tanks, armed helicopters, and other vehicles to break through the horde.

Master each character's talents, adapt your strategy, and lead your allies out of this dangerous city!

70010000131121.name: Bicycle Quiz & Riding
70010000131121.intro:
A game to learn about the Blue Ticket system
Two gameplay modes: Quiz and Action
Simultaneous Japanese and English display
70010000131121.description:
A game that teaches you about Japan's "Blue Ticket" system!

This game allows you to learn about Japanese traffic laws and the "Traffic Infringement Notification System" (commonly known as the "Blue Ticket" system)—which came into effect in April 2026—through gameplay. In the quiz stage, you can learn the correct rules and interesting trivia via True/False questions. The action stage lets you navigate a city modeled after real Japanese streets, challenging you to reach your destination safely without committing any traffic violations.

Is it okay to ride on the sidewalk? What is the correct way to navigate a T-junction? Can children get a "Blue Ticket"? Is it permissible to hang bags on the handlebars? Find the answers to these questions and more.
Use this game to acquire accurate and proper knowledge.

The game features a bilingual display (Japanese and English), making it a great tool for language study.
It is also designed so that international visitors to Japan—or anyone interested in understanding Japanese traffic laws—can play with ease and confidence.

70010000131127.name: Drift Club: Street Legends
70010000131127.intro: Master the streets. Own every drift.
70010000131127.description:
Speed is only the beginning. The real challenge starts in every corner.

Push your car to the limit, enter corners at high speed, and control every slide with precision. Chain smooth drifts, maintain your momentum, and chase higher scores while competing in intense street races.

Winning takes more than raw speed. Your entry angle, drift control, racing line, and exit timing all matter. Every corner is an opportunity to gain an advantage, improve your run, and prove your driving skills.

Feel the rush of fast cars, sharp turns, and perfectly controlled drifts as you fight for better results and cleaner runs. Easy to pick up but rewarding to master, every race gives you another reason to come back and improve.

Features:

High-speed drift racing
Skill-based driving and precise car control
Competitive street races where speed and style both matter
Challenging tracks and corners built for drifting
Accessible gameplay with plenty of depth to master
Chase higher scores and improve your best runs
Fast-paced racing atmosphere focused on cars, speed, and drifting

Hit the road, leave your mark on the asphalt, and prove you can master every corner.

70010000131162.name: Escape game R00M17
70010000131162.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

70010000131168.name: One-Move Checkmate : Chess Brain Trainer
70010000131168.intro:
Find the winning move
Solve checkmate puzzles
Train your chess thinking
70010000131168.description:
Look at the chessboard and find the one move that delivers checkmate.

Check each piece, the opponent king’s escape routes, and the way the board is defended. Then choose the move that ends the position in a single turn.

How to play:
・Study the whole board
・Think of the move that creates checkmate
・Choose your answer and test your reading

Each puzzle can be played in a short session, making it easy to enjoy as quick brain training during a break.

Recommended for:
・Players who want to practice chess tactics
・People looking for short puzzle challenges
・Fans of logic, focus, and forward thinking
・Anyone who enjoys solving problems alone at their own pace

Read the board, find the key move, and aim for a clean checkmate.

70010000131218.name: Lou's Lagoon – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000131218.description:
Take flight in your seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After a devastating storm, gather materials with your Swirler, and help the locals rebuild. Can you uncover the truth behind Uncle Lou’s disappearance?

A Seaplane, a Storm, and a Missing Uncle 

Take to the skies in your trusty seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After receiving a distress call from Uncle Lou, you arrive only to find the islands in disarray and Lou nowhere to be found. Collect resources, help rebuild a community, and unravel the mystery of your uncle’s disappearance.

Collect, Craft, Restore 

Harness the vacuum power of the Swirler! — a glorious multi-tool — to collect everything from scrap and native plants to materials dropped by Limbo’s unique wildlife. Use your finds to repair buildings, craft goods, and help the communities thrive again. 

Claim your slice of paradise at Lou’s Lagoon. Build your dream beach hut, add your personal touch, and let the island rhythm take over.  

Meet the islanders of Limbo 

Discover the archipelago’s vibrant islands, each with their own spirited communities, hidden treasures, and unique problems to solve. Get a warm welcome from the Charneys in Tangle Bloom—the archipelago's liveliest town—then head to Gleam Reef to watch the Vooi move to the music of the tides. Lastly, visit Boulderia, home to the grumpy, sugar-crystal-mining Gorplins! 

Key Features: 

- Explore the Limbo archipelago, home to vibrant communities and ancient secrets. 
- Pilot your very own seaplane, master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 
- Upgrade your gadgets to expand your adventures. Scoop, build, glide and fish! 
- Build your island base, decorate it, and make Lou’s Lagoon feel like home. 
- A mystery to unravel. Piece together clues, follow Lou’s trail, and uncover the truth behind his disappearance! 

Whether you’re hot on the trail to solving the mystery of Uncle Lou or just kicking back and enjoying island life, Lou’s Lagoon is your ticket to an exciting adventure.  

Ready for takeoff?

70010000131251.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic Soundtrack Player
70010000131251.description: A soundtrack featuring over 30 tracks, including the original music from the 2002 release of "Touhou Koumakyou" and the tracks newly arranged by ZUN for "Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic".

70010000131274.name: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000131274.intro: Are you ready for the first Yoyovania?!
70010000131274.description:
Explore a vast urban landscape in this narrative-driven, 2D top-down platforming adventure!

In Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo, you're a budding yoyo master facing off against enemies using the weapon you know best: your prized yoyo! As Pippit, you'll be quite literally thrown into the shocking story of your auntie's business empire, a soul-stealing mega-laser, and four dastardly crime bosses!

Each yoyo trick you learn will drastically change the way you look at the cityscape, and the battlefield! By chaining moves together, you'll be able to explore secret areas and teach those baddies a lesson! Many challenges have multiple solutions — so come up with your own novel routes in this mouth-watering adventure!

Features:
• Explore the city's 4 districts with over 1000 screens of challenges and secrets!
• Infiltrate the businesses of the 4 crime bosses! Navigate their labyrinthine buildings, take on foes, and solve action puzzles!
• Learn yoyo tricks and techniques to create your own cityscape yoyo-parkour routes, and make those mob minions pay!
• Collect over 40 ability-enhancing Badges that alter the way you play!
• Unlock over 20 passive Upgrades through a shady loan shark!
• Find over 80 other collectibles throughout town, from life upgrades to precious treasures!

70010000131289.name: Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000131289.intro:
The more you focus, the more the story unfolds.
A chill work adventure with a girl from another world.
Focus time no longer spent alone, for you.
70010000131289.description:
Through Nintendo Switch™ 2, a girl living in another world keeps you company while you work at your desk.

Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story is a work adventure where the story progresses together with the time you spend working, as you share your desk time with Memorie, an apprentice witch.

In a quiet room filled with gentle Celtic music, whenever you sit down to work, Memorie studies magic by your side.

What used to be solitary work time slowly becomes something warmer: time shared with someone.

■ The more you focus, the more the story unfolds

The game features a Pomodoro-based focus timer. As you accumulate focused work sessions, conversations with Memorie and events in her world gradually unlock.

Everyday chats.
Small changes creeping into the village.
And the secret she keeps hidden.

Beyond your work, a new piece of the story awaits.

■ Your focus changes her world

As the story progresses, Memorie's room gradually begins to change.

Her favorite cup.
The glow of magic.
A space growing warmer and richer.

The more you keep going, the more her world moves forward too.

■ Features

・A cozy fantasy workspace with Celtic music and ambient sounds
・A Pomodoro-technique-based focus timer
・Story and world mysteries unlocked through your focus time
・A room that changes as the story progresses
・A calendar system to track your daily focus
・A companion for studying, working, creative projects, and all kinds of desk work

■ The World

The story takes place in Elmana Village, a small settlement not far from the Imperial Capital. It is a peaceful place protected by the sacred Lightroot Tree.

But little by little, a dark presence begins to creep into the world.

Using a spell that connects distant people, Memorie found you. Was it coincidence, or...?

Stay focused, and see the story through to its ending together.

70010000131302.name: WildTrax & Hypercar Bundle
70010000131302.intro: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000131302.description:
This pack includes the games: WildTrax & Hypercar Racing.

In WildTrax Racing you will enjoy the wildest and most spectacular races in natural environments. You will have several game modes such as Arcade and 4-player multiplayer.

In Hypercar Racing you'll enjoy the dirtiest, fastest, and most spectacular races at speeds over 200 Mp/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 8 adversaries. The game has different modes, such as Championship, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Features:

- Wide variety of tracks.
- Multi-player with 4 players.
- Races with 12 opponents.
- Realistic driving physics.
- Lots of Rock 'N Roll music.

70010000131308.name: Wobbly Life - Nintendo Switch™  2 Edition
70010000131308.description:
Wobbly Life is a vibrant open-world physics sandbox. Play with your friends online or in local co-op, with exciting jobs, mini games and wacky story missions. Earn cash to spend in the world on clothes, vehicles and houses. There is a whole Wobbly World out there to explore!

Grandma has kicked you out into the big wide Wobbly world demanding you go and GET A JOB! She would be so proud if you could earn some money and get your own house one day! 

It's time to start earning and living your best Wobbly Life! 

Includes Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition features:
- GameShare: Play Wobbly Life with anyone – even if they don't own the game! 
- GameChat: Share audio and video while playing with your friends. 
- Start where you left off on Nintendo Switch™ with forwards compatible save game to Nintendo Switch™ 2
- 1-4 players online and local split screen co-op

Open-world sandbox filled with mini-games, toys, secrets and SO MUCH more 

+100 unique missions & jobs with exclusive rewards to unlock, alone or with friends 

+90 vehicles to ride around (and crash)

+500 clothes items to show-off in your wobbly look 

+infinite number of wobbly fun! 
 
FUN, FRIENDS & PHYSICS!

Let's start exploring! Almost everything is interactive – grab, play, and experiment in a world filled with props, mini-games, and surprises.  

Experience the joy of individual quests and shared adventures with up to 4 players in online or local co-op, all in one fantastical world. 

MYSTERIES AND MISSIONS

Embark on story missions, each offering unique rewards through satisfying puzzles and challenges. Unveil the mysteries of the tropical island, uncover the mountain’s secrets, delve into hidden caves...  

The Wobbly Museum has lost all its artifacts! Maybe you can help? Buy treasure maps and solve clues to find all the Museums' lost treasures and unlock fun rewards. 

GO GET A JOB!

Make grandma happy and go get that job! Earn money by choosing from +20 exciting jobs, each bringing their new unique challenges. From pizza delivery to firefighting, taxi driver to disco dancer… your wobbly dream job is waiting for you. 

LIVE THE HIGH WOBBLY LIFE! 

Once you’ve fattened up your bank account why not go on a shopping spree? Visit the Pet Shop to buy a faithful companion, buy and unlock +500 clothes items and choose from +90 different vehicles.  

When you’ve really made the big bucks, you can even buy a house: from a wooden shack to a huge fancy mansion, Wobbly Island has a home for everyone whatever your taste! 

PLAY YOUR OWN WAY WITH ARCADE MODE

Want to take a break from the Wobbly Island? Try out the Arcade mode! Discover four new game modes: Trash Zone, Hide & Seek, Wobble Run and Sandbox. Each have customizable settings for you to play with, multiple mini-games and new areas to have fun in!

GO TO SPACE! The Wobbly Space Programme is looking for new recruits. Space is a whole new open world, with new jobs, missions, and secrets to uncover. You'll even get to fly your own spaceships too, so what are you waiting for!

70010000131361.name: Pets Survivors
70010000131361.intro: Fend off waves of monsters as a dog, cat, chicken and other unlockable furry or feathered friends!
70010000131361.description:
Domesticated animals get wild in roguelike arena shooter combat where survival is all that matters! Pick 1 of 14 playable pets, each with unique skills and stats, as they face hordes of fantasy monsters like slimes, rock giants, oversized bugs, carnivorous plants and more in top-down retro pixel art style.

Choose wisely from a dozen starting weapons, then select a level from areas you’ve unlocked. Take down waves of enemies while strategically keeping your distance from danger. Level up and choose upgrades mid-battle, all in preparation for a big boss showdown. If you succeed, you’ll bank coins you’ve collected to spend on permanent perks, thus stacking the deck in your favor for the next fight!

• Survive waves of incoming enemies in addictive real-time arena combat!
• Choose from more than a dozen domesticated animals.
• Pick a starting weapon and upgrade on-the-fly as you level up!
• Collect coins to spend on permanent stat boosts between stages.
• Use character-specific skills to turn the tide of battle!
• Enjoy retro pixel art aesthetics and multiple difficulty options!

70010000131381.name: Owlen and the Starbound Mountain
70010000131381.intro: Take flight as Owlen and explore icy mountains, glowing star paths, and realms above the clouds.
70010000131381.description:
Venture into a realm of towering ice peaks, shimmering frost, and skies so high they brush the stars. As Owlen, you glide above frozen cliffs, drifting clouds, and ancient structures built into the mountain’s heart. Guided by distant spirits, your mission is to restore harmony by flying through magical circles that awaken frozen landscapes, rekindle star-touched flora, and breathe life back into forgotten heights.

Throughout your journey, you will uncover memory shards hidden within icy caverns, wedged between jagged peaks, or floating gently among starlit winds. These fragments reveal long-buried truths about the mountain, its guardians, and Owlen’s purpose. Gather enough shards to ascend into new regions—each with its own atmosphere, light, and mysteries. 

Every level begins with a quiet moment in which the spirits share the history of the land and the significance of the paths ahead. As you fly, voices carried by the wind may guide you, warn you, or offer glimpses of their stories. The experience is calm, magical, and reflective as you uncover the mountain’s ancient secrets—one shard at a time.

70010000131444.name: EGGCONSOLE Sabnack PC-9801
70010000131444.intro: Save the world from evil Sabnack! In this Kogado Studio action puzzle, play as Alph to revive petrified allies with a crimson cloak and guide them to the magic circle.
70010000131444.description:
Released by Kogado Studio in 1991, this puzzle game blends strategic thinking with action. Players control the protagonist, Alph, to restore fairies turned into stone statues and guide them to magic circles to clear each stage. With paths blocked by locked doors and monsters exhibiting various behavior patterns, you must enlist petrified allies (Warrior, Mage, Thief) to form a party and break through.

Once revived by your cloak's power, fairies and party members form a formation around Alph. However, if caught on obstacles and separated from him, they revert into stone statues. Success requires leveraging this mechanic to adjust positioning while navigating toward the magic circle. Can you guide the scattered fairies across all 40 stages, revive four angels, and successfully seal Subnack once again...?

70010000131451.name: Mahjongus: The Warlock Within
70010000131451.intro: Help Victor Graves break free from a warlock’s control and save the Academy of Magic through classic mahjong puzzles
70010000131451.description:
An insidious warlock has seized control of Victor Graves’ body, manipulating his voice, his actions, and his reputation to infiltrate the Academy’s inner circle. Under the guise of a trusted mentor, the warlock weaves a sinister plan: to bind the next generation of mages into eternal loyalty and raise an unstoppable magical army. Powerless yet conscious, Victor is trapped inside, fighting to reclaim his own mind.

Through classic mahjong gameplay combined with engaging hidden object challenges, players must uncover clues, break enchantments, and weaken the warlock’s hold from within. Each level brings you closer to restoring Victor’s control and exposing the deception threatening the Academy.

With richly detailed environments, immersive magical themes, and a hauntingly beautiful soundtrack, “Mahjongus 2: The Warlock Within” delivers a thrilling continuation of the series—where every move matters, and the greatest battle is for the soul itself.

● 150 Mahjong levels to play!
● 14 extra HOGs!
● Classic Mahjong Gameplay!
● Stunning graphics and immersive music!
● Fascinating story full of twists!
● Dive into a world of magic and intrigue!
● Explore vibrant, mystical environments!
● Save Victor Graves and the Academy from a dark warlock!

70010000131478.name: Mythical Creature Personality Quiz: 16 Types
70010000131478.description:
Ready to find the mythical creature that matches your vibe?

Answer a few simple questions and enjoy a casual personality quiz that points you toward one of 16 fantasy-inspired types.

You know those little choices that somehow feel very you? This game turns that feeling into a light, easy-to-read result based on the answers you pick.

How to play is simple!

・Read the question
・Choose the answer that feels closest to you
・Check your result

There are no right or wrong answers, so just go with your gut and have fun seeing what type appears.

Play solo and read your result at your own pace, or try it with family and friends to compare everyone’s types.

Recommended for players who like personality quizzes, fantasy themes, quick casual games, or a fun conversation starter.

What kind of mythical creature is sleeping inside you?
Answer by instinct and discover your type from the 16 possibilities!

Button and touch controls are supported.

70010000131510.name: STARBITES - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000131510.intro: Break the barriers and blaze through Bitter!
70010000131510.description:
Bitter—a desert planet riddled with the refuse left behind by an interstellar war. 45 years ago, the war suddenly ended when all of the spaceships crashed onto Bitter for reasons unknown. Now, a young salvager named Lukida hopes to escape this planet, but a sudden attack by a giant robot sets events into motion that will change her life—and the face of Bitter—forever.

The Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition features higher framerates and resolution!

70010000131517.name: Xtreme Traffic Racing
70010000131517.intro: Outrun the traffic. Outlast the chaos.
70010000131517.description:
Burn rubber through endless highways in the ultimate high-speed traffic racer. Weave between oncoming cars, dodge slower traffic, and push your reflexes to the limit as the road never ends.

Features:

23 Sports Cars — Unlock and tune a garage of 23 sports cars, each with its own handling and top speed. Find the ride that matches your driving style.

Infinite Roads — Our procedural road generation system means no two runs are ever the same. The highway stretches on forever, so the only finish line is the one your skills set.

Dynamic Weather & Levels — Race across multiple environments and conditions, from blazing sunshine to treacherous ice. Adapt your driving as grip and visibility shift beneath your wheels.

Multiple Camera Views — Switch between cockpit, chase, and other camera angles to race exactly the way you like it. Go first-person for the adrenaline rush or pull back for total control.

Front Crash Mode — Crave chaos? Flip on Front Crash Mode and embrace the carnage as you barrel head-on into traffic for maximum impact.

Floor it. Dodge everything. Survive the rush.

70010000131523.name: Cyber City: Science Crime Mystery
70010000131523.intro:
The evidence is hidden in the artwork.
Find the truth with a keen eye — a cyber sci-fi mystery!
70010000131523.description:
Step into a neon-soaked cyber city in this observation-based sci-fi mystery game.
You play as Miyabi, a sharp forensic investigator called to the scene of the crime.
Search each illustration for the clues hidden within — the key to cracking the case.

How to play is simple:
- Read the case briefing carefully
- Scan the scene for anything out of place — a strange detail, a telltale trace
- Once you spot it, move your cursor over it and press the A button

No expert knowledge required.
All you need is a sharp eye for detail and a flash of detective intuition.

Even an ordinary-looking scene might be hiding something off — if you look closely enough...
That rush of ""there it is!"" the moment you spot the clue? It's addictive.

Perfect for anyone who loves mysteries and puzzles,
or just can't resist a good spot-the-difference challenge.

Each case is a quick one-question round, making it perfect for a commute or a short break.

70010000131530.name: Super Takoyaki Battle
70010000131530.intro:
Experience takoyaki-making like never before!
Make as many as you can in an all-out battle!
70010000131530.description:
Take on the ultimate takoyaki challenge on Nintendo Switch™!
Add the batter and ingredients, then flip the takoyaki with a pick!
Play with up to 4 players using one Joy-Con™ controller each!

Enjoy a variety of game modes!
Cause chaos with items and random events in Party Battle, test your skills against friends in Battle, or make takoyaki to order in Score Attack!

Become a takoyaki master!

《Rules》
Make takoyaki using a takoyaki maker!
The better they turn out, the more points you earn!
Make as many as you can before time runs out!

《How to Play》
1. Fill each hole in the pan with batter and ingredients.

2. When the takoyaki starts to brown, use a pick to flip it over! Be careful not to act too quickly or too slowly! Once both sides are fully cooked, the takoyaki is done!

[Party Battle]
The feature mode of Super Takoyaki Battle is "Party Battle!"
Chaos erupts as up to 4 players compete on one giant grill!
Unique events occur to change the flow of the match!
Use items to gain the advantage over your opponents!
It's anyone's game until the very last second!

[Score Attack]
Master 3 different makers—home, food stall, and commercial—each with its own unique challenges!
Cook up as many takoyaki as you can, fill orders, and aim for a high score!

[Battle] 
Compete with up to 4 players to see who's the ultimate takoyaki chef!
You can also challenge CPU opponents!

[Rankings]
Compete for high scores against players from around the world!
Become a takoyaki master!

70010000131564.name: MANIC MINER
70010000131564.intro:
The legendary platforming classic is back!
Jump, collect, survive - Rediscover one of the greatest and most challenging video game classics of all time!
70010000131564.description:
Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

Climb the global MANIC MINER online leaderboard and become number one in one of the toughest classics in gaming history!

This re-release offers two modes: Enjoy the original pixel art look, or discover all the levels in atmospheric HD graphics with elaborate parallax scrolling, dynamic lighting effects, and lovingly designed backgrounds.

Thanks to modernized controls, MANIC MINER plays more precisely and smoothly than ever before, without losing any of the original’s high standards.

The classic has also been reimagined musically: The works by Johann Strauss and Edvard Grieg, which were already featured in the original, have been rearranged to give the adventure a contemporary sound.

In addition, the collection includes a comprehensive interactive history that documents the exciting story behind the creation of MANIC MINER from the early 1980s to the present day.

Features
•    Faithful, pixel-perfect recreation of the classic
•    All 20 original levels included in full
•    Choice between classic pixel graphics and a modern reinterpretation
•    Beautiful new backgrounds with parallax scrolling and atmospheric effects
•    Completely revamped controls for modern platforms
•    Global online leaderboard
•    Re-arranged soundtrack featuring classic works by Johann Strauss and Edvard Grieg
•    Extensive interactive history of the creation of Manic Miner
•    Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith

Jump, collect, survive - will you rise to the challenge?

70010000131578.name: To the Basement: Before
70010000131578.intro:
Perform precise movements
Defeat the bosses
Complete the levels
70010000131578.description:
You are one of the last flying drones, untouched by the virus.
You are faced with a quiet but crucial mission: penetrate the depths of the infected bunker and find what remains hidden within its sections. Something that will later play a key role in the fate of the entire complex.

With each level, the corridors become more dangerous: external mechanisms, security traps, closed blocks that are easy to crash into—all hidden in the darkness. But the drone has a special vision; it can see what is normally invisible, and sometimes there's a chance that it can protect you from range.

Along the way, you'll have to deal with epic bosses—malfunctioning security machines and twisted structures, whose virus has transformed into something unpredictable.

To the Basement: Before is a side-scrolling arcade game where flight, maneuvering, devastating humidity, traps, and boss fights intertwine in a single, grim journey through a contaminated area.
Test your resilience and willpower in these challenges!

70010000131590.name: Bubble Shooter: Color Splash
70010000131590.description:
Ready to pop some bubbles? Match colors, trigger exciting combos, and clear challenging puzzles one shot at a time.

Enjoy intuitive controls, satisfying gameplay, and hundreds of relaxing moments as each level brings new challenges and colorful fun.

70010000131596.name: Drones Attack
70010000131596.intro: Rain hell. Leave ash. Master the ultimate drone.
70010000131596.description:
Forget slow, methodical flight sims—Drone Attack unadulterated, fast-paced aerial carnage. You’re tossed into the digital cockpit of a heavily armed drone and tasked with one simple objective: absolute devastation. The controls are razor-sharp, letting you scream across the terrain, thread the needle through a storm of anti-air fire, and strike with lethal precision.

But what truly elevates the power fantasy is how incredibly heavy the destruction feels. Powered by gorgeous, impactful 3D graphics, every strafing run and missile strike lands with a satisfying, visceral crunch. It’s loud, it’s chaotic, and it’s beautifully explosive.

KEY FEATURES:

-Fast-Paced Aerial Carnage: Master the flight mechanics of an agile combat drone. The combat demands aggressive speed and precision, letting you dodge, weave, and return fire without breaking a sweat.
-Total Base Destruction: Leave nothing standing. Wipe out radar towers, SAM sites, and sprawling military compounds. Dropping a full missile payload sends stunning shockwaves through the battlefield, reducing towering bases to ash in seconds.
-Visceral 3D Graphics: Experience the heat of battle with gorgeous visual effects. Every time your rotary cannons shred enemy armor, you'll feel it through highly detailed, physics-heavy explosions.
-Deep Hangar Customization: Between white-knuckle sorties, hit the Hangar to cash in your hard-earned Command Points. Bolt on thicker armor, overclock your engines, and unlock weapon tiers that border on war crimes.
-Tactical Resource Management: Aggression is rewarded, but carelessness gets you killed. Knowing exactly when to vent your weapon heat and when to unleash a lethal barrage is the difference between victory and becoming scrap metal.

70010000131649.name: Palabras en inglés para aprender en la primaria
70010000131649.description:
Can your child build English confidence one word at a time?

Words learned early can make school feel a little easier. This quiz game helps kids practice basic English vocabulary in a fun, low-pressure way.

How to play:
・Look closely at the picture
・Pick the matching English word from 4 choices
・Get it right to read a detailed explanation

Even when a word feels new, each question is simple to try, so kids can learn by playing again and again.

Aim for a perfect score and give English study a fun head start!

Perfect for kids who dream of using English someday, and for anyone who wants school practice to feel more like play.

Supports button controls and touch controls.

70010000131662.name: Little Problems: A Cozy Detective Game
70010000131662.intro: Solve minor inconveniences, everyday misunderstandings, and of course, little problems. This game is not about saving the world; it's about enriching it, one case at a time.
70010000131662.description:
You've overslept, missing the first lecture of the day! Your class assignment is due, but what time were you supposed to meet your study group again? These are everyday little problems that require some problem-solving, minor sleuthing, and resolution!

Little Problems is a refreshing departure from the typical narrative of grandiose conflicts and complex villainy. It invites players to delve into a world where detective work is about connecting with friends, understanding the small yet significant issues of daily life, and finding joy in the simplicity of resolution. This game isn't about saving the world; it's about enriching it, one little problem at a time.

This charming title, challenges players to solve mysteries around minor inconveniences, everyday misunderstandings, and of course, little problems.

Key Features: 
• Cute, hand-drawn art by an Indonesian illustrator, Melinda.
• Solve Life’s Little Problems: Help Mary through life’s little challenges, small in scale, big in charm.
• Handcrafted Puzzles: Each level is a unique scenario, lovingly designed to be clever, approachable and satisfying.
• 10 Distinct Cases: Each case presents a different scenario with its own set of puzzles and surprises.
• Helpful Hints When You Need Them: If you get stuck, you can see where mistakes are, keeping the challenge fun, not frustrating.
• Easy to Pick Up, Hard to Put Down: Simple mechanics that grow into playful twists and surprising solutions.

70010000131668.name: Pinballoid Crush
70010000131668.intro: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.
70010000131668.description:
The cursed tower rises before you: a colossus whose walls pulse with neon light and echoes of ancient battles. Deep within await the 5 Generals of the Demon King, surrounded by their infernal hordes. They have kidnapped the Saint to offer her as a sacrifice and open a portal that will allow their master to return to this world. Your mission is to plunge into the unknown and rescue her before the Dark Lord’s plans come to pass.

Control your flippers, keep the ball in play, and ascend a tower filled with enemies, secrets, and increasingly intense challenges.

Each room presents a new challenge: destroy enemies, activate powers through cards, and manage your resources to survive. As you progress, you’ll master the physics, discover hidden mechanics and secret routes, and find the keys needed to reach the true ending. Only those who explore carefully, adapt their strategy, and perfect their technique will unravel the secrets of the tower. How far can you go?

- Two game modes: Arcade Mode for quick sessions, and Adventure Mode, where saved items allow for progression.
- Co-Op Mode: Play with the help of a friend. Using the target cursor, they can select cards, defeat enemies, destroy attacks, and collect upgrades.
- Enter 10 challenge stages featuring bosses that will test your precision and skill as you discover their weak points.
- Defeat enemies as you ascend the tower’s 5 floors and uncover all its mysteries.
- More than 15 Power Cards scattered throughout the tower, allowing you to build your own strategy.
- Earn points and climb the online leaderboard.
- Unlock collectible visual filters and customize the game’s appearance.

70010000131683.name: Hololive Fantasy Battle
70010000131683.intro:
【Breaking News】
Hololive 3rd Generation Members Unleash Chaos in Battle
70010000131683.description:
■About This Game
Hololive Fantasy, the unit featuring 〈Houshou Marine〉〈Shirogane Noel〉〈Shiranui Flare〉 and 〈Usada Pekora〉, enters the biggest free-for-all battle of the century in pursuit of the wish-granting “Queen’s Throne”!
Experience “oshi victory” by winning with your oshi in this 2.5D versus action game for up to four players!
That's ‘Hololive Fantasy Battle’ #HoloBattle

■How to Play
・[Move] → [Attack] That’s it!
・Use unique attacks to stagger opponents, knock them back, and gain the upper hand!
・Obtaining a Red Super Weapon drastically changes your attacks!
・Launch the game-changing “Solo Live,” and let your oshi dominate the stage!

■Costume Change
・Your oshi is already cute enough, but now they’ll become even cuter. Can you darlings handle it?!

■Versus Mode: "Online Battle"
・Up to 4 players clash in an all-out brawl to decide the winner!
・Expand your strategy with combinations of [Each Talent's Unique Ability] × [Field Gimmicks]!

■Solo / Co-op Mode: "Fake Hunter"
・For one reason or another, fake 3rd Gen members and fake 3rd Gen fans have appeared all over the place and are causing chaos. Time to make them reflect… ORAA!!
・Fight solo with NPC allies, or team up with friends and other players online!
・No worries if an ally goes down! With the "Rescue Totsumachi" feature, you can rescue fallen teammates—or have them rescue you.

70010000131691.name: Pattern Pulse
70010000131691.intro: Put your mind and reflexes to the test in a retro-futuristic challenge!
70010000131691.description:
Put your mind and reflexes to the test!
Dive into Pattern Pulse, a retro-futuristic skill game ideal for quick gaming sessions. The title includes two game modes:

♠ Memory Mode (Pattern): Memorize and repeat increasingly long and complex sequences of lights on the color buttons.
♥ Speed Mode (Follow Mode): Test your reflexes by pressing the buttons instantly as they light up, accompanied by a fun animated character.

Features:
♦ Two distinct experiences: mental training and pure reflex action.
♣ Arcade aesthetic with vibrant neon lights.
♠ High score tracking to push your limits.

70010000131699.name: Dorothy's Magical Journey in Oz
70010000131699.intro: A magical journey of friendship, courage, and finding your way home!
70010000131699.description: After a powerful cyclone transports Dorothy and her dog Toto from Kansas to the magical land of Oz, they set off down the yellow brick road toward the Emerald City. On her quest to find a way back home, she teams up with a Scarecrow, a Tin Man, and a Cowardly Lion, who are all seeking the great Wizard to grant their deepest wishes. Together, this unlikely group of friends must navigate unfamiliar lands and face the perils of Oz to reach their destination.

70010000131704.name: Cave Looters
70010000131704.intro: Chill co-op cowboy adventure. Up to 2 players!
70010000131704.description:
The cave ranger returns with his lady by his side in this treasure-hunting adventure! 

Journey underground is search of long lost loot. Face down giant bug, snakes, and rival looters. Crack your whip, fire your pistol, and toss some TNT in this lighthearted, laid-back western, full of platformer fun.

70010000131708.name: Hidden Girls: Private Nights
70010000131708.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000131708.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000131734.name: Fernkeep
70010000131734.intro: Discover the quiet charm of a medieval castle town.
70010000131734.description:
Welcome to Fernkeep, a cozy exploration game set within the walls of a peaceful medieval stronghold. Wander through towering castles, bustling courtyards, narrow cobblestone streets, hidden gardens, and ancient towers as you search for every unique location throughout the town.

Features:
>Explore a handcrafted medieval castle town.
>Discover every hidden location and secret area.
>Wander through castles, courtyards, markets, gardens, and towers.
>Enjoy a relaxing, stress-free exploration experience.
>Immerse yourself in a peaceful medieval atmosphere.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration.

70010000131749.name: Aim for 1 Million! Influencer Dream
70010000131749.description:
What makes one tiny detail turn into a big online moment?

Everyone has wondered why some things catch fire while others get ignored. If you have ever dreamed of growing from an unknown creator into someone people notice, this is your chance to test that instinct.

Aim for 1 Million! Influencer Dream is a casual picture-solving game where you read the prompt, scan the image, and choose the single spot that best matches. Clear stages as you chase the feeling of climbing toward influencer fame.

How to play:
・Check the prompt
・Look carefully across the image
・Select the one matching spot

Some stages are easy to read at a glance, while others reward a sharper eye and a little social-media sense. Each round is quick, but finding the right detail can feel surprisingly satisfying.

Play a stage whenever you have a moment, or take on all 150 at your own pace. Start your influencer dream and see how far your instincts can carry you.

70010000131761.name: WordHive
70010000131761.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000131761.description:
Word Hive is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you seven letters: six outer letters and one required center letter. Create as many words as possible using the available letters, but remember—every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be reused, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all seven letters award bonus points.

Progress through the ranks as your score increases, challenge yourself to uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

Challenge your mind, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience with every level.

Word Hive uses an American English dictionary.

Features:
• Play through more than 2,000 word puzzle levels
• Create words using seven letters, including the required center letter
• Discover pangrams by finding words that use all seven letters
• Learn and discover new English words as you play
• Compete with other players through the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue from where you left off
• Supports the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
• Spin the daily wheel to earn coins and redeem them for hints whenever you get stuck
• Switch between light and dark themes
• Enjoy professional sound effects and atmospheric background music

70010000131764.name: Green Thicket
70010000131764.intro: Relaxing exploration game where you wander through a mysterious forest, uncover hidden paths, and interact with the world at your own pace.
