70010000131764.description:
Peaceful, atmospheric exploration experience set in a dense, mysterious forest. Players are invited to wander through a quiet natural world filled with subtle details, hidden routes, and environmental storytelling. Rather than focusing on action or pressure-driven objectives, the experience emphasizes curiosity, discovery, and immersion in a calm, handcrafted setting.

As you move deeper into the woods, you gradually uncover the secrets woven into the landscape. Every path can lead to something new—whether it’s a hidden clearing, an unusual landmark, or a quiet moment that adds to the sense of mystery. The game encourages slow exploration and observation, rewarding players who take their time to look closely at the world around them.

Designed with a minimalist and relaxing approach, Green Thicket aims to create a soothing experience suitable for short sessions or longer, more meditative play. Its focus on atmosphere and exploration makes it ideal for players who enjoy discovery-driven games and tranquil environments.

70010000131772.name: Chameleon Dummy Hunt
70010000131772.intro:
Can you spot what does not belong?
Chameleon Dummy Hunt is a colorful first-person hidden
70010000131772.description:
Can you spot what does not belong?

Chameleon Dummy Hunt is a colorful first-person hidden-object action game where sneaky dummy characters are hiding in plain sight. They are painted to blend into walls, floors, furniture, props, shadows, patterns, and bright environments.

Your mission is simple: search the level, find every camouflaged dummy, and blast them with your paint gun before time runs out.

Look closely. A strange shape on the wall, a color that feels slightly off, a dummy sitting like a decoration, or a suspicious object in the corner could be your next target. Some dummies stand still, some sit, some crouch, some lie on the floor, and some are hidden so well that you may walk right past them.

But be careful. Shooting the wrong object can cost you time and score. Use your scanner wisely when you are stuck, stay focused, and clear each level as fast as possible.

With 20 levels, multiple dummy poses, tricky camouflage, time-based challenges, score rewards, and controller-friendly gameplay, Chameleon Dummy Hunt turns every environment into a playful test of attention, speed, and visual skill.

Find them. Paint them. Hunt them.

70010000131809.name: No More Slimes!!
70010000131809.intro: The World's Cutest Chaos, Squishy Slime Commotion!
70010000131809.description:
Slime Rebellion! Small and adorable slimes have started a bouncing rebellion, filling up the entire screen. Dive right into this unstoppable commotion!

◆ Unstoppable Addiction
With simple and intuitive controls, anyone can easily jump in, but once you're hooked, there's no way out.

◆ The Fun of Growing with Various Elements
Build diverse skill trees using the loot you earn from battles. Add special abilities like striking lightning with cards and relics or summoning a bouncing boomerang that deals damage off walls, and grow in your own unique way!

◆ Diverse Skills and Refreshing Impact
Experience the thrill of wiping the screen clean with mercenary skills! Freeze enemies, drop meteors to defeat them, and use special weapons that deal massive Area of Effect (AoE) damage to feel an incredibly satisfying impact.

※ Caution ※
Be careful, your time might just vanish!

70010000131828.name: Important things
70010000131828.description: It's a story about a hired morality expert who turns a school around.

70010000131830.name: Bone Marrow 2
70010000131830.intro:
Merge cards to upgrade
Upgrade your character
Defeat all monsters
70010000131830.description:
A tactical 2D top-down puzzle game inspired by the mechanics of 2048. Instead of numbers, you combine survival resources: food increases health, weapons enhance attack, and armor increases defense. 

By merging identical items, you create stronger versions and decide what to develop next. Your goal is to strategically combine resources and prepare your heroes for the upcoming night, where any mistake could cost them their lives.

It's not about armor or crests anymore. The hour has come for those whose power is born of the very nature of rage and magic. It's time for new heroes to take up what has become their continuation: a jagged staff that has absorbed the wrath of the earth; a taut bow singing the songs of the wind; a battered grimoire in which the souls of forgotten gods whisper. Their battle is not a battle pattern, but a ritual.

Everything happens in a tense rhythm of day and night. During the day, you can combine items on the field and collect ready-made supplies in your supplies. At night, when the world is frozen in terror, all you can do is desperately try to put the pieces together.

70010000131837.name: Doria & the Tide Song
70010000131837.intro: Save the music of the ocean and help a brave little mermaid find her voice!
70010000131837.description:
Save the music of the ocean alongside Doria, a little mermaid with a wobbly voice but a brave heart! When a freezing threat known as "The Silence" threatens to quiet her home, Doria must embark on a secret quest through kelp forests and dark canyons to assemble a mismatched choir of sea creatures and restore harmony to the reef. Experience a heartwarming story about friendship, resilience, and the power of finding your own voice!

Key Features:
• An Epic Tale: Dive into a rich narrative spanning over 10 chapters with a script of more than 10,000 words.
• Cinematic Visuals: Immerse yourself in spectacular 3D graphics in the style of a modern animated movie.
• Full Voice Acting: Experience the journey to the fullest with a game fully voiced in English.
• A Safe Experience: Perfect for the whole family, as the game contains no ads and no in-app purchases.

70010000131841.name: Loree 3D
70010000131841.intro: Waddle into adventure with Loree, a fearless penguin explorer! Race through colorful 3D worlds, dodge obstacles, and collect coins for family fun.
70010000131841.description:
Join Loree, a brave and curious penguin, on a colorful 3D platforming adventure! Wearing his signature red propeller hat and cozy green scarf, Loree waddles, jumps, and glides his way through dozens of imaginative levels packed with challenges, secrets, and surprises.

Features:
• Dozens of levels spread across vibrant, themed worlds
• Collect coins to unlock new playable characters
• Race against the clock and earn up to 3 stars per level for a perfect run
• Simple, intuitive controls — easy to pick up, fun to master
• Charming low-poly art style paired with a cute pixel-art interface
• Explore everything from frosty mountain peaks to mysterious ruins

Whether you're chasing perfect star times on every level or just looking for a relaxing hop through cute, colorful worlds, Loree 3D offers approachable, family-friendly platforming fun for players of all ages.

Grab your propeller hat and start waddling — adventure awaits!

70010000131850.name: Roots in the Sky - The Hand of Glory 2
70010000131850.intro: After five years in hiding, detective Lazarus “Lars” Bundy is swept up in another globe-trotting supernatural mystery whose origins trace back to a legend about the creation of Earth itself.
70010000131850.description:
STORY

Five years.

Five years on the run, spent hiding from surveillance cameras, police checks ... and friends.

In an attempt to elude the cult that's been chasing him, former Miami detective Lazarus “Lars” Bundy is in Italy working incognito for a security agency when his client is murdered in cold blood by a sharpshooter. As the blood stain slowly spreads on the victim's clothes, Lars realizes there is only one way to keep his past from catching up with him: solve the case before the police and bring the perpetrator to justice as quickly and silently as possible.

A senseless murder, conflicting clues and an indistinct lead will thrust the former detective on another thrilling journey around the world, from majestic Rome to the Land of the Rising Sun by way of Jordan and India. With help from an old ally he thought he’d left behind for good, Lars finds himself swept up in a case far more complex and dangerous than he ever could have imagined, filled with international mystery and mysticism. And all the while, a much more personal danger lurks close at hand, one that Lars is determined to suppress and keep hidden from the world.

FEATURES

> A new point-and-click adventure game inspired by the golden age classics
> Compelling blend of comedy, supernatural mystery, and conspiracy-steeped intrigue
> Alternate control between Lars and his returning cohort Alice
> Challenging but logical puzzles seamlessly integrated into the story
> Explore more than 50 stylish hand-drawn HD locations across Rome, Jordan, India and Japan
> Original atmospheric soundtrack and full English voice-overs (with German and Italian subtitles)
> Sequel to the acclaimed "The Hand of Glory" (95% positive reviews online), though no prior familiarity is necessary

70010000131868.name: The Unwoven Unicorn
70010000131868.intro: A magical journey of kindness and discovery!
70010000131868.description:
In the world of Caelis, young unicorns receive a colorful coat pattern called a "weave" that grants them their magical gifts. When Posy is left completely plain on her Weave-Day, she sets off on a journey across the world to find where she belongs. Accompanied by her big-eared friend Tindle, she visits the six proud elemental keepers of Caelis. By using her unique talents of listening and kindness, Posy helps the guardians with their domains, ultimately uncovering a way to save the world's fading magic.

Features:
• Stunning Visuals: Beautifully presented with ultra-cute 3D animation style graphics.
• Engaging Length: The story spans 10 chapters totaling more than 10,000 words, offering a rich and immersive reading experience.
• Kid-Friendly Experience: It contains no ads or in-app purchases, ensuring a completely safe space for children.
• Self-Paced Reading: The layout and design are ideal for children to read and enjoy the story at their own pace.

70010000131876.name: Ironford
70010000131876.intro: Search a peaceful seaside village for every hidden gem.
70010000131876.description:
Welcome to Ironford, a cozy exploration game where adventure is all about discovery. Set in a quiet medieval fishing village along the coast, you'll wander through winding streets, wooden docks, market squares, forests, and hidden paths in search of every rare gem scattered throughout the world.

Features:
>Explore a handcrafted medieval seaside village.
>Search for and collect every rare gem.
>Wander through docks, markets, forests and village streets.
>Enjoy a relaxing, stress-free exploration experience.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration and collecting.

Can you uncover every rare gem hidden within Ironford?

70010000131881.name: Project City
70010000131881.intro: Drive, drift, hustle, and survive a city that reacts to every bad decision.
70010000131881.description:
Project City is a top-down open-city action game inspired by the chaotic feel of classic arcade crime sandboxes. Hit the streets in a drivable city full of traffic, pedestrians, shops, police, gangs, odd jobs, and escalating trouble.

Earn cash by running taxi fares, package drops, food deliveries, and risky crew work, or push your luck with ATM hacks and weapon shop visits. Slide into drift challenges, dodge police heat, avoid spike strips and roadblocks, and keep moving when the city turns against you. Every run is about choosing how far to hustle, how much chaos to cause, and whether you can survive long enough to cash out.
With fast driving, on-foot exploration, wanted levels, city events, weapons, interiors, leaderboards, and a sharp street-comedy tone, Project City is a compact urban mayhem sandbox built around simple controls and constant trouble.

70010000131912.name: RasterFire
70010000131912.intro: Enter a fast-paced retro shooter filled with pixel-art action, dangerous enemies and relentless gunfire. Aim carefully, survive each encounter and clear your path through the battlefield.
70010000131912.description:
Step into the chaotic world of Rasterfire, a fast-paced top-down shooter inspired by the golden age of arcade action.

Fight your way through dangerous environments filled with hostile enemies, incoming projectiles and deadly obstacles. Keep moving, aim carefully and use your limited space to avoid attacks while returning fire. Every encounter tests your reactions, positioning and ability to survive under pressure.

The battlefield is viewed from above and presented in a distinctive retro pixel-art style, enhanced by CRT scanlines, vivid effects and an energetic arcade atmosphere. Enemies can attack from multiple directions, so staying alert is just as important as having a quick trigger finger.

Clear each area, survive increasingly intense battles and push forward through waves of opposition. Whether you are chasing a higher score or simply trying to reach the end, every round offers a compact dose of old-school shooting action.

Features:

Fast-paced top-down shooting gameplay
Retro pixel-art graphics with CRT-inspired effects
Multiple enemy types and dangerous attack patterns
Responsive controls designed for quick arcade action
Increasingly intense combat encounters
A dark, energetic soundtrack and classic shooter atmosphere

Load your weapon, enter the crosshairs and see how long you can survive in Rasterfire.

70010000131937.name: Retrobot: 2085
70010000131937.description:
THE ARCADE CLASSICS YOU GREW UP WITH. REBUILT FOR TODAY.

The year is 2085. A runaway mega-intelligence called the Algorithm has decided humanity is obsolete, and unleashed millions of networked humanoid robots to make sure of it. You are one of the anomalies: minds the Algorithm could never map, predict, or control. Grab a controller and start fighting back.

RETROBOT: 2085 is a fast, frantic twin-stick shooter made in the style of a spiritual successor to one of your arcade favourites - a love letter to the golden age of the arcade, modernised with a fully 3D retro art style and that unmistakable 8-bit bleep-and-bloop soundtrack.

• ENDLESS ROBOTIC HORDES - Dismantle wave after wave of humanoid robots across dozens of levels, each one more relentless than the last.
• RESCUE THE LAST HUMAN FAMILY - Find every survivor scattered through the level. Reach them and they're rescued instantly for huge bonus points.
• CHASE THE HIGH SCORE - Classic arcade scoring, extra lives, and a leaderboard to settle who's the best, once and for all. Earn your spot - and your initials - at the top of the table.
• 4-PLAYER LOCAL MULTIPLAYER - Connect extra controllers and team up with up to three friends for chaotic local multiplayer action.
• TUNED FOR THE PAD - Precision twin-stick controls built around a controller, the way modern arcade action is meant to be played.
• A SECRET WORTH FINDING - Enter a classic secret code (remember these?) to unlock the hidden Service Menu, where you can switch on classic-style waves and controls for the original arcade experience.

Everything is playable from the start - no purchases required to unlock content, no forced progression systems gating your progress. Just you, an endless robot horde, and a high score table calling your name. How far can you get? Grab a friend (or three) and find out.

70010000131958.name: Klondike Classic
70010000131958.intro: Relax and enjoy the timeless classic. Challenge yourself with the world's most beloved solitaire card game!
70010000131958.description:
Klondike Classic is the perfect solitaire experience for players who enjoy classic card games and relaxing puzzles.

Choose your favorite card back and enjoy a clean, elegant design focused on the classic Klondike experience.

Play at your own pace, sharpen your mind, and enjoy the timeless appeal of classic Solitaire!

70010000131974.name: Dogpile
70010000131974.intro: Dogpile is a roguelike deck builder about merging cute dogs into bigger dogs. Play dogs, get money, customize your dogs with special Traits, refine your deck, PLAY MORE DOGS! DOGS!
70010000131974.description:
When two of the same dog touch, BAM! You get a BIGGER dog. With careful placement, some clever purchases, and a can-do attitude, you can merge pups strategically and achieve the biggest dogs imaginable.

You really shouldn't adopt a dozen dogs, but now you can! Dogpile gets you to wrangle a cute collection of canines into the perfect deck, customize them, and play them expertly. Manage the clutter, upgrade and improve your cards as you go, and strive for the BIGGEST dogs.

Like in real life, dogs come with quirks and untapped potential! You’ll discover any variety of weird traits such as Barky, Sleepy, Timid, Cool and more. Take your dogs to the Dog Wash to add even more traits, and find Dog Tags that bolster and benefit from Trait synergy!

Utilize a clever array of powerful Dog Tags to modify how your dogs and their Traits function. Find interesting synergies and unique combos to aid you in all of your merging endeavors. And always remember your ultimate goal: BIGGER!

70010000131989.name: Loot Before the Law
70010000131989.intro: Sneak through guarded corridors, avoid police patrols, and steal valuable loot without being detected. Study their routes, stay out of sight, and escape before the law catches up with you.
70010000131989.description:
Step into the shadows and put your stealth skills to the test in a tense game of infiltration, timing, and escape.

Explore guarded buildings filled with valuable items while police officers patrol the corridors. Observe their movements, learn their routes, and wait for the perfect moment to sneak past them. One careless step can expose your position and turn a carefully planned robbery into a desperate attempt to escape.

Stay out of sight, use corners and rooms to avoid detection, and collect as much loot as possible before making your way to safety. Every corridor presents a new risk, forcing you to decide whether to grab another valuable item or leave before the patrol returns.

Success depends on patience, awareness, and smart movement. Study your surroundings, adapt to changing situations, and avoid rushing into danger. The more confident you become, the more daring your robberies can be.

Can you take the loot, avoid every patrol, and escape without getting caught?

70010000132015.name: Aetherfall
70010000132015.intro: Jump, explore, and master new mechanics as you make your way deeper into the world of Aetherfall.
70010000132015.description:
Jump into the colorful world of Aetherfall - a 3D platformer packed with precise jumps, evolving mechanics, and challenges suspended high above the abyss.

Explore a variety of levels, leap between floating platforms, collect coins, and use the environment to open new paths forward. Buttons, crates, moving obstacles, and new mechanics keep each stage fresh and introduce new ways to overcome challenges.

Each chapter brings its own set of ideas and obstacles, ending with a unique boss fight that puts everything you’ve learned along the way to the test.

In Aetherfall, you’ll find:
- Dynamic 3D platforming
- A variety of mechanics 
- Secrets and coins to collect
- Environmental puzzle elements
- Diverse locations and challenges
- A boss fight at the end of every chapter

70010000132041.name: Can I Not Fall for Idols?
70010000132041.intro: Trigger a romance flag with an idol, and it’s a BAD END!
70010000132041.description:
You've just become the manager of the rookie idol group, "♡Melonchu♡"!
To make their debut concert a roaring success, dating any of the active idols is absolutely, 100% off-limits...!
And yet, romance flags keep popping up left and right, and the members' affection levels are already at MAX from the very start!
How on earth will you navigate this crisis?!
An otome game industry first (!?)—a slapstick rom-com where romance is strictly forbidden!

■ Story & Art (Scenario/Illustration): MikiMaki
【Game Features】
Fully voiced (excluding the protagonist)
Customizable protagonist name
8 unique endings

70010000132049.name: Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000132049.intro: The Most Dangerous Man is the One with Nothing Left to Lose.
70010000132049.description:
From the team that brought you STAR WARS™: Dark Forces Remaster comes the return of the 1997 western FPS classic, Outlaws! 

Saddle up and ride back into the Wild West with the gunslinging ex-Marshal, James Anderson, and face off against the good, the bad, and the even worse this side of the Mississippi as you work to uncover a twisted plot of greed and corruption. With your trusty six-shooting .45 Revolver, Scoped .44 Rifle, 10-Gauge Shotgun, and good ol' Sawed-Off 12-Gauge Shotgun, you'll be packin' plenty of firepower to take out all manner of outlaw varmints.

Outlaws + Handful of Missions features high-resolution, uncompressed cutscenes and updated visuals for weapons, characters, and enemies, all fully recreated from archived art and stylized to match the original look with full color palettes. Outlaws + Handful of Missions also offers Cross-Play Multiplayer with game modes including Deathmatch, Team Play, Capture the Flag, and Kill The Fool With The Chicken!

It's Payback Time.

Outlaws + Handful of Missions Remastered Key Features:
- Engaging first-person ground combat featuring five weapon types.
- Modernized Joy-Con™ and Pro Controller™ support, adding a new weapon wheel.
- A Vault filled with a treasure trove of behind-the-scenes gold nuggets.

70010000132077.name: Spot the Difference Ukiyo-e: Fifty-Three Stations of the Tōkaidō
70010000132077.description:
Ready to slow down and compare every detail?

Enjoy a laid-back spot-the-difference game set in ukiyo-e scenes of post towns and famous views along the road from Edo to Kyoto.

Look closely at two similar prints and search for the one place that has changed. A person’s pose, an item, a building, or a bit of scenery might be the clue.

How to play is simple!
・Compare the two ukiyo-e pictures
・Look for the changed spot
・Select the area you think is different

Take in the beautiful landscapes and travelers while putting your focus and observation skills to work. It is great for a quick break or for taking your time with each picture.

Recommended for players who:
・Like spot-the-difference and visual puzzles
・Are curious about ukiyo-e and Japanese scenery
・Want a calm brain-training game
・Enjoy talking through the answer with family or friends

Look into every corner of the artwork and find the hidden change!

Button controls and touch controls are both supported.

70010000132104.name: Captive
70010000132104.intro: Leave No Trace. He is Always Watching.
70010000132104.description:
Your worst nightmare has become your reality. You are the latest captive of a notorious, masked serial killer, imprisoned in his grim subterranean dungeon. Through the cracked walls, you can hear the horrifying screams of other victims meeting gruesome ends. Your cell door is just the first obstacle. To survive, you must navigate a house of horrors, solve twisted puzzles, and find a way out before the killer starts up his chainsaw.

Your captor is highly observant and constantly patrols his territory. Stealth and meticulous attention to detail are your only hope. If you open a drawer, pick a lock, or move an object, you must return it exactly as you found it. If he notices even a trace of your escape attempt, he will hunt you down with relentless fury. Navigate the claustrophobic brick hallways by the dim light of your lantern. Squeeze through tight vents and witness the grim machinery of his torture chamber from the shadows. Stay quiet, think logically under pressure, and cover your tracks perfectly. Can you outsmart the ultimate predator, or will you become just another voice screaming in the dark?

70010000132111.name: SOMA - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000132111.intro: A masterpiece of psychological horror. Fight to survive in a hostile world that will make you question your own existence.
70010000132111.description:
SOMA is a horror and science fiction video game from Frictional Games, the creators of Amnesia: the Dark Descent. It is a haunting story about identity, consciousness and what it means to be human.

The radio doesn't work, food is scarce and machines have begun to believe they are people. The submerged PATHOS-II facility has suffered terrible isolation and difficult decisions will have to be made. What to do? What makes sense? What is left to fight for?

Enter the world of SOMA and confront the horrors submerged in the depths of the ocean. Rummage through locked terminals and secret documents to uncover the truth behind the chaos. Search for the last inhabitants and take part in the events that will ultimately shape the fate of the station. But beware, danger lurks around every corner: corrupt humans, twisted creatures, mad robots and even an inscrutable and omnipresent A.I..
You'll need to figure out how to deal with each one. Just remember there's no turning back, either you defeat your enemies or get ready to run.

70010000132123.name: Classroom Mystery Secrets Behind the Lessons
70010000132123.intro:
Can you spot the unease
hiding in class?
70010000132123.description:
At first glance, it looks like an ordinary day at school.
But look closer, and a small sense of unease may point to a chilling truth.

Use the question as your guide, study the illustration carefully, and find the suspicious spot that leads to the truth in this visual deduction quiz.

How to play is simple!
・Read the question
・Take a close look at the school illustration
・Choose the place you think is suspicious

Classrooms, hallways, club activities, and after-school scenes set the stage for strange moments hiding inside familiar school life.

A scene that seemed normal at first might feel completely different once you realize what it really means.

No complicated steps—just observation and a flash of insight. Take your time solo, or play with family and friends while asking, Which part looks off?

Recommended if you like:
・Stories that turn creepy once you understand them
・Horror and mystery
・Illustration observation quizzes
・Testing your deduction and attention to detail
・Quick quiz games you can enjoy in short breaks

Can you notice every uneasy detail hidden at school?

70010000132129.name: Cursed Objects: Find and Seal
70010000132129.intro:
Can you spot the curse?
Observe the scene
Seal every object
70010000132129.description:
Something is wrong at the scene.
Take a close look at the place where a strange phenomenon occurred, then figure out which cursed object caused it.

Check the objects that feel out of place and the visual clues left behind.
Read the situation carefully, trust your deduction, and choose the object behind the haunting.

How to play is simple!
・Observe the scene where the incident happened
・Look over anything suspicious or clue-like
・Find the cursed object you think is the cause and seal it

Even an ordinary-looking item may be hiding a secret that brings a terrifying phenomenon to life.

Use your observation and reasoning to uncover the truth one case at a time.
Each puzzle is quick to play, so you can think it through solo or talk it over with family and friends.

Recommended for players who enjoy:
・Ghost stories and uncanny tales
・Mystery games and visual puzzles
・Searching illustrations for tiny details
・Quick brain teasers in short breaks
・Solving spooky cases with family or friends

Can you see through the cause behind each strange event and seal every cursed object correctly?

70010000132170.name: Blocky Powers
70010000132170.intro:
Stack blocks to reach the sky!
Master real physics as towering structures sway!
Use crazy powers, cause epic crashes, and outplay your friends!
70010000132170.description:
BLOCKY POWERS is a fast-paced physics-based party game where every block matters! Grab a controller, challenge a friend, and build the tallest tower before everything comes crashing down.

Real Physics & Powerful Winds

Forget predictable block stacking. Every piece has real weight and balance, making each tower sway under dynamic physics. Powerful gusts of wind can strike at any moment, turning even the strongest structures into a challenge.

Sabotage Your Opponent

Building is only half the battle. Drop extra blocks directly onto your rival's tower to throw off their balance and ruin carefully planned structures.

Send awkward or heavy blocks
Disrupt your opponent's tower
Strike at the perfect moment to trigger a collapse

Perfect timing can change the outcome of every match.

2-Player Local Multiplayer

Plug in a second controller and enjoy instant head-to-head battles on the same screen.

Fast local multiplayer action
Customize wind strength and block speed
Perfect for parties, families, and friendly rivalries
Game Modes

Race Mode

Build to the target height before your opponent. Speed is important, but poor balance can bring everything down.

Survival Mode

Protect your limited lives by stacking carefully. Survive the wind, avoid losing blocks, and withstand your opponent's sabotage.

Features
Real-time physics-based block stacking
Direct block sabotage mechanics
Dynamic wind effects
Local 2-player multiplayer
Race and Survival game modes

Master real physics, outsmart the wind, sabotage your rival, and build your way to victory in Blocky Powers!

70010000132193.name: Suncroft
70010000132193.description:
Welcome to Suncroft, a cozy exploration game where every street and hidden corner invites you to slow down and enjoy the journey!

Take your time strolling through the town, discovering hidden paths, relaxing by fountains, and uncovering charming landmarks scattered throughout the world. With no combat, no timers, and no pressure, Suncroft is all about exploring at your own pace and soaking in its warm, welcoming atmosphere.

Features
>Explore a handcrafted sunny town.
>Discover every unique location and hidden area.
>Enjoy a relaxing, stress-free exploration experience.
>Immerse yourself in a warm and peaceful atmosphere.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration

70010000132198.name: Vanishing Evidence: Mystery Cases
70010000132198.description:
Can you spot the trace that should never be left behind?

In this mystery puzzle game, you clean up evidence left at a scene and help turn a risky case into the perfect cover-up.
You are not the detective. You are the fixer hired to erase the evidence.
Read the prompt, study the illustration, and find the piece of evidence that needs to be removed.

How to play:
・Read the case prompt
・Observe the illustrated scene
・Select the matching evidence

Choose the right evidence, and the scene changes as that trace is cleared away.
Look closely for visual clues, suspicious details, and odd inconsistencies, then recover anything that could work against your client.

Each case has its own situation and request.
Think through what should be erased in each scene, using observation and deduction to make the call.
Since each question is self-contained, it is easy to play in short sessions while still enjoying a satisfying mystery.

Recommended for fans of mysteries, deduction, illustration-based puzzles, and quick brain-teasers.
Collect every piece of evidence and lead the case into the unknown.

Supports button controls and touch controls.

70010000132204.name: Hidden Photo Mysteries: The Truth Gets Scary
70010000132204.intro: What doesn't belong in the photo?
70010000132204.description:
A plain black-and-white photo... until something from the future seems to be sitting right there.

People holding objects that should not exist in the era when the picture was taken. If time travel has already been developed somewhere beyond our knowledge, why did these visitors choose these moments to appear?

Follow the clues hidden in each eerie scene and trace the truth behind the photo. The more you understand what is wrong, the closer you get to a chilling answer.

・Read the scenario for the scene
・Study the black-and-white image carefully
・Select the piece of evidence that feels out of place
・Check why that clue leads to the truth

Even a normal-looking photo can turn unsettling once you notice the detail that should not be there. Perfect for fans of urban legends, mystery puzzles, slow-burn horror, and solo brain teasers.

Take your time, look closer, and see if you can uncover the truth behind the picture.

70010000132215.name: Play & Learn: My First Hiragana
70010000132215.intro:
Learn hiragana with pictures!
Choose the missing character from 4 options
120 fun and easy Japanese word puzzles!
70010000132215.description:
Learn Japanese hiragana with simple picture-based word puzzles!

Look at the picture and the incomplete Japanese word, then choose the correct hiragana from four options. Familiar objects and clear illustrations make the questions easy to understand, even for beginners.

How to play:
・Look at the picture and the word with a missing character
・Choose the correct hiragana from 4 options
・Try to complete all 120 questions

Simple button controls make it easy to start playing right away. If you get stuck, hints are available so you can keep learning at your own pace.

Recommended for:
・Beginners learning Japanese hiragana
・Children starting to study Japanese
・Players who want to learn Japanese words with pictures
・Families who enjoy solving questions together
・Anyone looking for short and casual learning sessions

Use the pictures as clues and find the missing hiragana. Can you complete all 120 questions?

70010000132227.name: Slot & Learn WORLD FLAGS
70010000132227.description:
Learn world flags and country names in a fun, game-like way.
No complicated controls needed. Read the prompt, look closely at the four flag images, and pick the flag that matches.

How to play is simple!
・Check the text shown on the screen
・Think about the country name and its flag
・Choose the correct flag from the four images

From flags you may have seen before to flags with similar shapes and colors, each round is a quick chance to test what you know.
Play again and again to gradually get more familiar with flags and country names.

It is easy to enjoy in short sessions, whether you are checking your own knowledge or talking through answers with family.

Recommended for players who:
・Are curious about flags from around the world
・Want a fun way to review countries and geography
・Are looking for a learning game to enjoy with kids
・Prefer simple controls
・Want to learn a little at a time during spare moments

How many flags can you recognize?
Picture countries around the world and aim for a perfect score!

Playable with buttons or touch controls.

70010000132266.name: Mystery Detective Adventure 2
70010000132266.intro: Other people’s secrets cannot escape the detective’s attention.
70010000132266.description:
Having gained a reputation as a man versed in the occult, Detective Woodbrey has attracted a rather peculiar clientele. Whether that is good or bad is for you to decide!

“Mystery Detective Adventure 2” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

The world does not stand still—and neither does the world of crime. Thieves and murderers are becoming ever more cunning and twisted. And while others argue over who should make the streets safe and life fair, Detective John Woodbrey takes action, no matter what.
His experience played a cruel joke on him: he failed his last case after becoming too absorbed in paranormal phenomena and losing touch with reality. But his respite will not last forever—retirement is still a long way off.
With a reputation as a detective versed in the occult, he finds mystic cases drawn to him. He will have to undertake three investigations—three unique and dangerous adventures. Their unpredictable nature will force you to find solutions on the fly and quickly adapt to the situation. There will be no time to be bored!

- Close extraordinary cases that only you can handle.
- Each investigation tells its own story, with unique locations and characters.
- Complete collections by studying the world carefully and missing none of even the smallest details.
- Examine locations carefully and find every collectible
- Join the battle for freedom alongside your favorite characters

70010000132303.name: Another Crab's Treasure - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000132303.intro: A soulslike adventure set in a crumbling underwater world.
70010000132303.description:
As Kril the hermit crab, you’ll need to wear the trash around you as shells to withstand attacks from enemies many times your size. Embark on an epic treasure hunt to buy back your repossessed shell, and discover the dark secrets behind the polluted ocean.

TRASH OR TREASURE?
In this undersea society, trash is not only a way of life, but a valuable resource, used for everything from fashion to firearms. But with the presence of trash comes a mysterious infection known as the Gunk, which could spell doom for the entire ocean.

LEARN FROM NATURE
As Kril explores the ocean, he'll gain a variety of Umami Techniques—powerful attacks learned from the denizens of the seas. Punch your enemies with the overwhelming might of a Mantis Shrimp, ensnare them with the horrifying Bobbit Worm, and much more.

UNEXPLORED DEPTHS
The ocean goes deeper than one can imagine. Fight your way through kelp forests, coral reefs, sand castle cities, and even the unfathomable darkness of the deep-sea trenches, all in the name of getting back your prized shell.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Designed to be an approachable experience for newer soulslike players as well as provide a challenge for hardcore fans, Another Crab's Treasure offers something for any level of skill or time commitment. Assist options are provided for those seeking a less frustrating experience, but gluttons for punishment are sure to find the default game a challenge.

-Soulslike-inspired combat designed to be approachable for new players while still challenging experienced fans.

-A vast undersea world to explore with colorful creatures to fight and secrets to discover.

-Over 60 shells with a variety of special abilities to defend yourself against the ocean’s threats.

-Meet a host of undersea friends and foes as you slowly discover the dark secrets behind the polluted ocean.

-Learn magical Adaptations from creatures throughout the world, making their powers your own.

70010000132327.name: Quarantine Wing: Horror
70010000132327.intro: Some places are abandoned for a reason.
70010000132327.description:
When rumors spread about the sudden closure of a local Hospital, most people stayed away. Stories of strange noises, unexplained disappearances, and something lurking in the abandoned halls were dismissed as urban legends.

You don't believe any of it.

As an independent blogger searching for the truth, you enter the hospital with nothing but a camera and a flashlight, determined to uncover what really happened. But after stepping inside, the exits are sealed behind you.

The only way out... is through.

Features:
>Explore a large abandoned hospital filled with secrets.
>Solve puzzles to unlock new areas and find your escape.
>Experience tense survival horror with a focus on atmosphere.
>Survive terrifying encounters while finding your way to freedom.

70010000132342.name: Zella's Gun
70010000132342.intro: Just a short conversation between a human and a ghost.
70010000132342.description:
Zella and her possessed gun Toast always have deep conversations. Zella's willingness to listen and talk about her vulnerabilities keeps Toast's attention. Toast's ability to give advice and criticize doesn't land well every time with Zella. Every interaction between the two usually ends up sour or sweet.

Features Include:
- Text Log: Reread previous lines, decipher the implications and meaning behind their conversation.
- Gallery: Once finished with the story, you can view early concepts and artwork used during development.

*There are no choice-based story branching elements in this game.

70010000132373.name: Educational Family Games
70010000132373.intro: Award-winning educational party fun for the whole family.
70010000132373.description:
The Ultimate Game Night for Learning and Laughter

Play solo against AI or locally with up to 4 players on the same Nintendo Switch™ system. Educational Family Games is designed for people playing together in the same room and does not include online multiplayer.

From the creators of the award-winning Educational Games for Kids comes a collection of 80 quick games across 5 interactive game boards, combining educational challenges with party-game fun for the whole family.

Race, think, remember, solve, guess, react, and compete in challenges involving math, geography, logic, memory, reflexes, science, chemistry, art, anatomy, entertaining party games, and timeless classics. Collect gems, buy crowns, and try to finish as the winner.

One moment you may be solving math problems under pressure. The next, you may be dodging fireballs, racing bicycles, flying rockets, scoring goals, copying drawings, or competing in chaotic 2-versus-2 challenges. Every quick game offers something different.

Every instruction, word, and character is fully voiced in 19 languages. No reading is required, making the game accessible to pre-readers, grandparents, and players of different abilities.

Key Features

• Solo play against AI or local multiplayer for 1–4 players
• 80 educational and party quick games
• 5 interactive game boards
• Math, geography, logic, memory, science, chemistry, art, anatomy, reflexes, and more
• Fully voiced in 19 languages
• AI fills empty player positions
• Short sessions or longer family tournaments
• 10 playable characters
• Colorful 2D cartoon visuals
• Family-friendly and violence-free
• No online multiplayer

Designed for children, parents, grandparents, friends, parties, holidays, and living-room game nights. Suitable for ages 5 to 100.

70010000132386.name: Jump Protocol
70010000132386.intro: Leap across towering rooftops, wall-run over obstacles, and master fast-paced parkour as you race through a dangerous city filled with enemies and challenging platforming.
70010000132386.description:
Take to the rooftops in a fast-paced first-person parkour adventure where every jump matters. Sprint across towering city buildings, leap over massive gaps, wall-run across obstacles, and use your movement skills to reach new heights.

Navigate handcrafted levels filled with dangerous enemies, environmental hazards, and challenging platforming sections that demand quick reflexes and precise timing. Every rooftop presents a new obstacle, from collapsing structures to heavily guarded areas that stand between you and your objective.

Master fluid parkour movement, discover the best routes through the city skyline, and combine speed with precision to overcome increasingly difficult challenges. Whether you're avoiding enemy fire, making daring rooftop leaps, or climbing to impossible heights, every level tests your ability to keep moving.

Features:

Fast-paced first-person parkour gameplay.
Jump, wall-run, and climb across towering city rooftops.
Handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty.
Enemy encounters that challenge both movement and timing.
Smooth controls designed for fast traversal.
Explore a sprawling urban skyline from above.
Easy to learn, challenging to master.

70010000132392.name: Colorizing: Pleasure
70010000132392.intro: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation
70010000132392.description:
This coloring book is a guarantee of good mood.
In it you can find all kinds of pictures for every taste.
Coloring by numbers with Colorizing is a calming and easy activity for people of all ages. 
This drawing game is suitable for children and adults, everyone can enjoy pixel coloring.
You will definitely love coloring with this beautiful coloring book!

70010000132395.name: The Seven Crystal Petals: The Blossom Realm
70010000132395.intro: Embark on a heartwarming narrative adventure with Princess Yumi and restore harmony to the Blossom Realm.
70010000132395.description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey alongside Princess Yumi in a heartwarming narrative adventure of fantasy and growth. When the sacred crystal petal of the Blossom Realm is carried away by a sudden spring wind, the young princess must overcome her own deep insecurities and step out into the wide world to track it down. Travel through beautiful, enchanted provinces, from dim forests filled with hidden caterpillars to towering cliffs made entirely of paper, helping a cast of charming creatures overcome their troubles through small acts of kindness. Featuring a captivating visual style and a comforting atmosphere, this is a cozy tale about empathy, friendship, and learning that a true home is not ruled, but cared for with all your heart.

• An Epic Cozy Tale: Enjoy a beautifully written story spanning over 10 captivating chapters and more than 10,000 words.

• Charming Visuals: The story comes to life through colorful and cute imagery that perfectly captures the magic of the Blossom Realm.

• Perfect for Everyone: A gentle and uplifting narrative suitable for children and readers of all ages.

• Safe and Ad-Free: Enjoy a seamless, premium reading experience with absolutely no ads or in-app purchases.

70010000132397.name: Circuit Flow
70010000132397.intro: Route the signal. Power the board.
70010000132397.description:
Circuit Flow is a wire-routing puzzle game set on a compact circuit board. Draw traces to connect colored signals from the board edge to their matching components - LEDs, speakers, fans, and displays all need the right current to power up.

Start simple with single-color routes, then tackle resistors that transform signal colors, splitters that break secondaries into primaries, and mixers that combine them into new ones. Plan your paths carefully - wires can't overlap, and a wrong turn means a short circuit.

Features:
- Hand-crafted puzzle levels with progressive difficulty
- Color mixing and splitting mechanics
- Circuit designer - build and share your own levels
- Arcade mode with procedurally generated boards
- Encyclopedia of real electronic components
- Clean, readable circuit board visual style

70010000132415.name: Angry Raccoon
70010000132415.description:
Today, you aren't a peaceful forest creature; you're a masked burglar on a mission to take over Granny's house. Use your tiny, grabby hands to transform her quiet, clean home into your own personal dumpster-diving playground.

Waddle through the rooms and cause total chaos. Raid the refrigerator, turn trash cans upside down, climb on the countertops, and shatter expensive vases. Each prank earns you chaos points and triggers a furious yet funny reaction from Granny. When she comes running with her broom, quickly hide in a cupboard or squeeze behind some furniture. Earn enough points to unlock hilarious outfits and discover hidden shortcuts from the basement to the attic. Prove that no room is safe from a trash panda!

70010000132426.name: Komorebi - A Furry Visual Novel
70010000132426.intro: In a society plagued by visions of the future, a group of friends attempt to find their own way in a predestined life. A fully voice acted dystopian furry visual novel/dating-sim.
70010000132426.description:
Komorebi is a fully voice acted story taking place in a dystopian 2041. Set against the backdrop of social revolt, you move to Toronto to start a brand new chapter in your life. Make friends, party, and form bonds and romances that will last a lifetime! While pages turn in your life however, they also turn in the world. As your morals clash with those in power, you and your group may walk an irreversible path in the name of equality and a brighter future.

Enjoy your new life...

FEATURES
- A lengthy story, several full novels in length.
- Approx. 18,000 lines over 150,000 words of dialogue.
- Over 10 hours of voiceover audio delivered by an incredible cast.
- Romance a varied cast of characters with no limitations or restrictions. Romance one, or all.
- Experience the story in your own unique way, through the Fragment Map system.
- Gain more insight into the world through diary entries and counselor sessions.

70010000132450.name: Forgotten Vault
70010000132450.intro: Enter a forgotten underground vault in this fast-paced pixel-art roguelike shooter. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, collect powerful weapons, battle dangerous enemies.
70010000132450.description:
Descend into a forgotten underground vault where every room hides new dangers, valuable supplies, and terrifying enemies.

Fight your way through five increasingly difficult dungeon levels in a fast-paced, top-down pixel-art roguelike shooter. Each run features procedurally generated rooms, unpredictable encounters, and randomized loot, ensuring that no two expeditions feel exactly the same.

Choose from three playable characters with different strengths, then search the vault for weapons, ammunition, health supplies, and other useful equipment. Expand your arsenal with pistols, shotguns, lasers, rockets, and other weapons, each offering different firing patterns, magazine sizes, and combat possibilities.

Stay mobile, dodge incoming attacks, take cover behind interactive objects, and flip tables to block enemy projectiles. Break containers, open mysterious chests, explore cleared areas using the minimap, and prepare for powerful bosses waiting at the end of every level.

The deeper you travel, the more dangerous the vault becomes. Enemies grow faster, attack more frequently, and appear in greater numbers. Taking damage can also affect your sanity, briefly distorting the world around you and making every battle even more unsettling.

Manage your resources carefully, adapt to the weapons you discover, defeat each guardian, and uncover how far the darkness beneath the vault truly reaches.

70010000132456.name: Disney Speedstorm – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000132456.intro: Drift into the ultimate hero-based combat racing game, set on high-speed circuits inspired by Disney and Pixar worlds.
70010000132456.description:
Disney Speedstorm is the ultimate hero-based combat-racing game, set on high-speed circuits inspired by Disney and Pixar worlds. It’s a thrilling arcade racing experience where players will need to master each Character’s unique Skills on the racetrack and claim victory. 

DISNEY & PIXAR GO FULL BATTLE RACING 
An incredible cast of characters, including Sulley, Beast, Mickey Mouse, Mulan, Baloo, Captain Jack Sparrow, and more, are suited and revving up for racing combat. Upgrade each Racer’s stats and make the most of their unique Skills that can impact the outcome of a single race and dramatically change the way you play the game! 

ARCADE RACING REDEFINED 
Anyone can pick up and play Disney Speedstorm, but mastering skills and techniques like timing your nitro boosts, precisely drifting around corners, and adapting to dynamic track environments are crucial to dominating each race. 

RACING TOGETHER HAS NEVER BEEN EASIER 
Pick your Racer and speed through action-packed tracks solo, or challenge friends in local and online multiplayer modes. You can even face off with players from around the globe to become an online legend.

DISNEY- & PIXAR-INSPIRED RACETRACKS 
Start your engine in environments inspired by some of your favorite Disney and Pixar films. From the docks of Pirates of the Caribbean’s Kraken Port to the wilds of The Jungle Book’s Jungle Ruins or the Scare Floor from Monsters, Inc., you can experience these worlds from a fresh, exciting perspective geared specifically for racing!

CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR OWN STYLE 
Choose your favorite Racer’s suit, a flashy kart livery, and show off stylish wheels and wings -- all of this and more is possible with the extensive customization features in the game! 

NEW CONTENT RACING YOUR WAY 
The action never slows down thanks to fresh seasonal content always around the corner. New Disney and Pixar Racers will be added regularly, bringing special skills for you to master (or overcome), and unique tracks will be created often, to pump fresh strategy into the mix. Support Crew characters, environments, customization options, and collectibles will also drop in regularly, so there’s always more to experience.

70010000132475.name: Threshold Warden
70010000132475.intro:
upgrade your character
survive hordes
defend crystal
70010000132475.description:
Every thousand years, a chosen one journeys to the Rift — a place where life and death converge.

In the shadow of an ancient crypt, a crystal glimmers, calling to lost souls. They do not remember their deaths and are drawn to the light, hoping to escape this grim place. But touching it only disturbs the peace of the living with their presence.

Now, you are the new Guardian. Do not let the boundary between worlds vanish.

Threshold Warden is a 2D pixel-art shooter-platformer where you control the guardian protecting the world of the living. Build towers, place turrets and traps to keep zombies from reaching the crystal and defend the boundary between worlds.

By defeating enemies, you collect soul fragments. Once a wave is complete, the crystal activates and offers you a choice of upgrades and defensive tools: light generators, turrets, flamethrowers, mines, new weapons, and much more. Combine items and strategically strengthen your defenses to stop the zombie onslaught and keep the crystal safe.

70010000132481.name: Radiation Caterpillar
70010000132481.intro:
upgrade your snake
manage more snakes at once
solve puzzles
70010000132481.description: An alien caterpillar  whose biology requires radiation for growth and survival. Luckily, your home planet is literally saturated with this dangerous yet vital resource. Your goal is to navigate challenging levels, collect radioactive elements, and grow, but be careful: the larger you get, the harder it is to maneuver!

70010000132487.name: Eden Coil
70010000132487.intro:
upgrade your snake
manage more snakes at once
solve puzzles
70010000132487.description:
A snake puzzle game where, on some levels, you control multiple snakes by switching between them while the others remain asleep.

A top-down puzzle game where you guide a snake through carefully crafted levels, collecting apples and finding the way forward.

As the game unfolds, new rules come into play. Some levels feature multiple snakes, and you can switch between them — only one moves at a time while the others remain asleep. Their positions become part of the puzzle, letting you block paths, set up moves, and solve challenges that require more than a straightforward route.

70010000132493.name: 1000xRESIST – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000132493.intro: A society of clones is ripped apart by a 1000-year-old secret.
70010000132493.description:
The Peabody Award-winning 1000xRESIST is a thrilling sci-fi adventure. 1000 years in the future, humanity is all but extinguished, and a disease spread by an alien occupation keeps the survivors underground. You are Watcher. You dutifully fulfil your purpose in service of the ALLMOTHER, until the day you learn a shocking secret that changes everything.

THE END OF HUMANITY
In the near future, we learn we are not alone in the universe. A mysterious alien race of giant entities arrives. We call them the Occupants.

They are not hostile, but it doesn’t matter. Their arrival is a death sentence. Humanity is wiped out in a matter of months, succumbing to a disease the Occupants have brought to our planet.

There is one survivor, a teenage girl called Iris. Somehow she is immune.

SOCIETY IS REBORN IN HER IMAGE
1000 years later. Iris is not only immune, but immortal. She has birthed a new society consisting exclusively of her own clones. She calls them Sisters. They call her the ALLMOTHER.

RELIVE HER MEMORIES
Within the Orchard, every sister has an assigned function, while six sisters have special roles to play.  As the new Watcher, Your role is unique. You have the great privilege of reliving and interpreting the memories of the ALLMOTHER through a process known as Communion, made possible by Secretary, your floating AI companion. You're excited to embark on your first Communion.

RESIST A THOUSAND-YEAR-OLD LIE
Your closest sister, Fixer, comes to you with a dangerous revelation. You have been lied to. The ALLMOTHER is not what she claims to be. Fixer’s claims rock the foundations of your world, throwing everything you know and believe into doubt as it falls to you to discover the truth.

DISCOVER THE TRUTH
Dive into the memories of the ALLMOTHER and explore pivotal moments in her life, jumping back and forth through moments in time to solve puzzles and access locked-off areas and secrets.

A STORY LIKE NO OTHER
Experience perspective shifts both literal and metaphorical as the game blends between 3rd person adventure, visual novel and first person walking simulator while throwing twists, turns and revelations at you until you question everything you think you know.

70010000132498.name: Order Automatica
70010000132498.intro: A small board. Endless possibilities. Like chess with demons.
70010000132498.description:
Like chess with demons, Order Automatica is a tactical roguelite autobattler where every move shapes the outcome.

Build your army by placing demons onto a 3×3 ritual board, discover powerful synergies, and adapt your strategy to survive increasingly dangerous encounters. Positioning, timing, and smart combinations are the keys to victory.

Every run offers new units, relics, and upgrades, allowing you to create wildly different builds - from relentless summoners to unstoppable frontline warriors or devastating spellcasters.

Master challenging boss battles, unlock new content, and experiment with endless tactical possibilities as you uncover the secrets hidden within the ritual.

Features:
• Tactical roguelite autobattler gameplay
• Unique 3×3 ritual board with deep positioning mechanics
• Dozens of demons, relics, and powerful combinations
• Procedurally generated runs with high replayability
• Challenging bosses that demand new strategies every run
• Fast-paced sessions with meaningful tactical decisions

70010000132527.name: Find the Sneaky Chameleon
70010000132527.intro: Can your memory spot the trick?
70010000132527.description:
Think you can remember what blended into the scene?

It feels easy while the picture is on screen, but once it is covered, that tiny detail can get surprisingly slippery.

This is a quick image-memory quiz with a sneaky chameleon vibe. Study the illustration, keep the small details in your head, then choose the answer from four options.

・Look closely at the image while it is shown
・When part of it is covered, read the question
・Use your memory to pick one of four answers
・After a correct answer, check the original image

Right or wrong, each round trains careful observation and short-term memory in a light, pick-up-and-play way.

Supports button and touch controls.

70010000132550.name: Midnight Anomaly Mystery
70010000132550.intro: Can you spot the midnight anomaly?
70010000132550.description:
Something feels off after dark—can you trust your eyes?

You know that feeling when a picture looks normal at first, but one little detail keeps bothering you?

In this casual visual mystery game, each stage shows one illustration. Look closely, decide which single spot matches the question, and select that area.

・Study the whole image
・Find the one place that feels off
・Move the cursor or tap the spot to answer

There are no complicated rules—just observation, hunches, and a little midnight mood. Even when you miss, the next image makes you want to look more carefully.

Take a quick break, settle in, and challenge your eye for subtle details.

Button controls and touch-screen controls are both supported.

70010000132564.name: Crayon Story: Thumbelina
70010000132564.intro: An emotional, creative children's game where you color your own storybook and write your own tales.
70010000132564.description:
Crayon Story: Thumbelina is a creativity-boosting game based on the classic fairy tale that children love. Beyond just playing, children can decorate scenes and complete stories in their own words, fostering a sense of accomplishment.


Key Features


Coloring: Touch the screen to fill scenes with vibrant colors. With intuitive controls, anyone can easily create their own masterpiece.


Writing: Write your own sentences to match the colored scenes. Your child's imagination brings a unique version of 'Thumbelina' to life.


Personal Gallery: Completed pages are saved in your gallery, so you can revisit and enjoy your custom storybook anytime.


Start a fun artistic journey with Crayon Story: Thumbelina by GaniTani!

70010000132576.name: Horror Prison: Escape
70010000132576.description:
You awaken alone in a decaying prison with no memory of how you got there. The cells are empty, the lights barely work, and every hallway echoes with unsettling silence. Something feels wrong.

Will you find the way out before it's too late?

Features
>Explore a large abandoned prison filled with secrets.
>Solve puzzles to unlock new areas and escape.
>Experience tense first-person horror with immersive sound design.
>Uncover the mystery behind the prison's abandonment.

70010000132579.name: Speedy Bundle Speedway & Grand Prix
70010000132579.intro: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000132579.description:
This pack includes the games: Speedway Racing and Grand Prix Rock ´N Racing.

In Speedway Racing, you will enjoy the fastest, most spectacular races at over 350 Km/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 12 rivals.
There are several modes available, including Championship, Arcade and 4-player multiplayer.

Grand Prix Rock 'N Racing gives you the fastest, most exciting races. You can evolve your car, improving the engine, brakes, tires and more until you've achieved the perfect evolution to win the Championship!

Features:

- Wide variety of tracks.
- Multi-player with 4 players.
- Races with 12 opponents.
- Realistic driving physics.
- Lots of Rock 'N Roll music.

70010000132612.name: Missed Class: Horror
70010000132612.description:
You enter an abandoned school hoping to uncover the truth behind its mysterious closure. Empty classrooms, silent hallways, and forgotten lockers hide clues to what really happened.

But before you can leave, the doors lock behind you.

Now your only goal is to escape. Explore the school, collect keys and uncover the dark secrets hidden within its walls. Just don't ignore the feeling that you're being watched.

Features:
>Explore a creepy abandoned school.
>Uncover the mystery behind the school's past.
>Experience atmospheric first-person horror.
>Evade the spirits that haunt the halls.

70010000132677.name: Chai Glide
70010000132677.intro: Slither, collect ingredients, and brew tea inside your snake. Complete cozy shifts in this modern twist on a classic. Classic score attack mode included!
70010000132677.description:
Slither across a grid, gather ingredients, and brew tea inside your snake’s body. Gather score by completing goals, brewing tea in order to pop segments and just growing longer.
Chai Glide is a cozy reimagining of the classic snakey game built for calming play sessions.
Want old-school pressure instead? Classic Mode is a fast paced core run. Pick your speed, grab pellets, race timed bonus ingredients before they vanish, and go for the high sSsSSscore!

70010000132690.name: Hidden Girls: Quiet Beauty
70010000132690.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000132690.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000132696.name: Legacy: Witch Island 2
70010000132696.intro: The island really exists, and the witch has regained her power. Can you defeat her?
70010000132696.description:
Use your knowledge and wits to break her hold on the island. 
Your path lays through dazzling island locations, a mystery forest, mountain, cave and lake. 
On your adventure, free bewitched islanders. 
You are going to discover the mystery of an ancient prophecy and figure out what made Peter betray you last time.

- Thrilling story
- Beautiful hidden object scenes
- Replayable logic mini games
- Unconventional use of hog-scenes and items

70010000132732.name: Cursed District: Horror
70010000132732.description:
An old factory district has stood silent for decades after a series of unexplained disappearances forced everyone to leave. Locals say the entire area is cursed, bound by ancient voodoo relics hidden throughout the abandoned buildings.

Determined to end the nightmare, you enter the district with one goal: find every cursed relic and break the curse once and for all. But as you search through abandoned factories, rusting warehouses, dark alleyways, and forgotten offices, you realize something else still calls this place home..

Features:
>Explore a large abandoned factory district.
>Search for cursed voodoo relics to break the curse.
>Evade a GIANT creature that relentlessly stalks the shadows.
>Experience immersive first-person horror with atmospheric environments.

70010000132764.name: Real Girls: Burning Whisper
70010000132764.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000132764.description:

70010000132779.name: WordHive 2
70010000132779.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000132779.description:
Word Hive 2 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you seven letters: six outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all seven letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the ranks, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

Word Hive 2 uses an American English dictionary.

Features
• Play through 2,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all seven letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode

70010000132810.name: Manalia Notes -A memory of innocence-
70010000132810.intro:
2D Shooting Game × A Brick Breaker!
Embark on an adventure with the witches Phurl, Eire, and
70010000132810.description:
■About This Game
2D Shoot 'em up meets Brick Breaker action!
Avoid enemy fire, bounce back bullets, and fight your way through!
Master unique skills and wave attacks to unleash powerful combos!

70010000132816.name: Tibby and the Lost and Found
70010000132816.intro: Help Tibby and Truffle find lost stories and bring joy back to Cobblewick!
70010000132816.description:
Welcome to Cobblewick! Join the heartwarming cat Tibby and her loyal companion Truffle, an adorable creature with a magical nose for tracking down stories, in a cozy visual novel and puzzle adventure through a picturesque, whimsical village. As the keeper of the local lost and found shop, young players will explore enchanting locations and restore misplaced treasures to a charming cast of friendly characters. Perfect for early readers and family playtime, this comforting interactive story encourages curiosity, kindness, and problem-solving as children help bring light and joy back to every corner of the town.

• A linear narrative story beautifully crafted for children aged four to ten.
• Over 10,000 words of heartwarming adventures and charming dialogue.
• Completely safe experience with absolutely no ads or in-app purchases.

70010000132819.name: Real Girls: Velvet Flame
70010000132819.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000132819.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.

• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000132831.name: The Truth of the Empty Room
70010000132831.intro: Can you read an empty room?
70010000132831.description:
What if the quietest scene held the biggest clue?

You know that feeling when something looks normal… until it suddenly doesn’t.

This is a casual picture puzzle game where each round shows one illustration and one prompt. Study the scene, compare the details, and choose the single spot that answers the question.

・Read the prompt
・Check the illustration carefully
・Choose the one place that fits

Every stage is quick to play, but the right answer may be tucked among similar-looking details. Trust your eyes, take a closer look, and enjoy that little aha moment when the room finally gives itself away.

Ready to uncover the truth hiding in plain sight?

70010000132837.name: Secret Photo Memory
70010000132837.description:
The hidden photo is scrambled into strips—do your eyes catch what belongs together?

You know that feeling when the answer is right there, but one tiny slice looks off.

In this casual montage puzzle, each stage gives you a prompt and a shuffled set of horizontal photo strips. Line up every strip to complete the correct outfit and clear the stage.

・Read the prompt
・Spin each horizontal reel
・Choose the strips that match the target look
・Complete the full photo to finish the stage

It's simple to start, but the small details make each puzzle satisfying. Even a near miss helps you spot what to adjust next time.

Take a quick break, trust your eyes, and see if you can put the secret photo back together.

Playable with buttons or touch controls.

70010000132843.name: How True Is This Rumor? Urban Legend Mystery
70010000132843.intro: Can you trust what you see?
70010000132843.description:
Some rumors sound too strange to be true... but that is exactly what makes you want to check.

We have all heard a story that someone swore was real. When the clue is an image, can you tell what actually adds up?

This is a 4-choice image quiz with an urban-mystery mood: quick questions, surprising explanations, and a casual pace that makes it easy to keep going.

・Look closely at the image
・Compare the 4 choices
・Choose the answer that seems most convincing
・Read the explanation after you answer

Getting it right feels great, but even a miss can teach you a fun new angle.

Play a round whenever you have a few minutes, and see how well you can separate rumor from reality.

70010000132855.name: Learn English with World Ghost Stories
70010000132855.intro: Can ghost stories teach you English?
70010000132855.description:
Ready to make English practice a little spooky?

You may have studied English before, but using it in a story can feel totally different.

This is a casual four-choice image quiz inspired by ghost stories from around the world. Look at the picture, feel the mood, and pick the answer that best fits.

・Look closely at the image
・Read the four answer choices
・Choose the one you think is correct
・Check the explanation after answering

Whether you get it right or miss it, each round gives you another chance to absorb useful English in a memorable way.

Play a few questions whenever you want and see how naturally the phrases start to stick.

70010000132875.name: My Friendly Little Island Deluxe
70010000132875.intro: A sunny little island, a handful of new friends, and all the coconuts you can carry.
70010000132875.description:
Life on the island starts slow. You walk, you talk, you help out where you can.

Every new upgrade changes the island around you. Ledges you used to walk around become shortcuts, long detours turn into single jumps.

Help the people you meet and they'll settle into your village, with the soundtrack growing livelier every time someone moves in. Change your look with cosmetic items, watch the island shift from day to night.

Plus a truly unreasonable number of coconuts.

A nostalgic experience that can also be played in vertical mode with touch controls to better match the '90s feeling! A full-color island, from sunrise to sunset.

70010000132888.name: Beauties' Thrilling Shots
70010000132888.intro: Can you set every shot straight?
70010000132888.description:
A scrambled photo can look simple at first... until every slice is facing the wrong way.

You know the feeling: the picture is almost there, but one little turn can change everything.

In this casual rotation puzzle, each stage starts with a single image split into slices. Rotate the pieces back into the right direction, restore the original picture, and try to clear each stage as fast as you can.

・Look over the divided image
・Rotate each slice into the correct direction
・Complete the picture
・Aim for a faster clear time and more stars

There are no complicated rules, so it is easy to jump in for a quick round. But once the slices increase, reading the whole image becomes a satisfying visual challenge.

Take your time, or chase the best result. Can you bring every shot back into place?

Button and touch controls are supported.

70010000132894.name: Caught You Looking
70010000132894.description:
Got sharp eyes for a busy picture?

Sometimes the answer jumps out. Sometimes you scan every corner and wonder how you missed it.

Caught You Looking is a casual picture-puzzle game where each stage shows one image and asks you to find one exact spot. Read the prompt, check the scene, and select the area that matches.

How to play:
・Read the prompt
・Look over the whole image
・Select the spot that fits
・Move on to the next quick challenge

Each round is short and easy to jump into, but spotting the right place feels satisfying every time.

Play a quick stage whenever you want a light visual challenge.

Button and touch controls are supported.

70010000132906.name: Rollick N' Roll
70010000132906.intro: Marvelous marble runs, with a modern twist.
70010000132906.description:
Rollick N' Roll combines fun physics with intuitive controls to deliver a joyful puzzle experience for all ages. Expand your collection by unlocking fun vehicles and playsets, but be prepared for a bit of chaos.

Key Features: 
• Intuitive controls - Press the button. See what happens. 
• Easy, medium or hard - More vehicles means more mayhem. 
• Need more? - Try some formidable time trials! 
• Chill tunes - Professionally composed soundtrack by Rest! 
• No training necessary - We hate tutorials too. 
• 25 challenging courses - 75 unique vehicles to collect.

70010000132929.name: Card of Arcana
70010000132929.intro: Embark on a magical roguelike card adventure where every choice shapes your journey. Build powerful decks, discover mystical artifacts, battle dangerous foes.
70010000132929.description:
Enter a world where every card can change your destiny. In this fantasy roguelike deck-building adventure, you'll battle your way through dangerous dungeons filled with fearsome monsters, powerful bosses, and magical secrets waiting to be uncovered.

Build your deck from an ever-growing collection of cards, combining spells, attacks, and special abilities to create powerful strategies. No two adventures are the same—discover new cards, collect mystical relics, and adapt your tactics as each run presents different enemies, rewards, and challenges.

Every decision matters. Choose your path carefully, strengthen your deck after each battle, and experiment with countless card combinations to overcome increasingly difficult encounters. Whether you prefer overwhelming magical attacks, powerful defensive strategies, or carefully planned combos, there are many ways to achieve victory.

Defeat formidable bosses, unlock new possibilities with every playthrough, and prove your mastery in a world where strategy is just as important as luck.

Features:

Build and customize powerful decks with a variety of unique cards.
Battle monsters and challenging bosses in strategic turn-based combat.
Explore procedurally generated adventures where every run is different.
Discover magical relics and powerful upgrades that transform your strategy.
Experiment with countless card synergies and deck combinations.
Easy to learn, challenging to master, with high replayability.

70010000132962.name: Smash Cat
70010000132962.description:
Become a curious cat with a clear mission: knock over everything in sight. Navigate the house and smash 192 different household items as quickly as possible.

Explore a variety of low-poly rooms. Jump onto countertops, climb bookshelves, swipe at fragile decor, and cause absolute disaster. Keep an eye on the timer, hunt down every breakable item, and prove that nothing is safe when a cat is in the house.

Experience the world from the ground up with an immersive first-person perspective and watch your own paws swipe at targets. Search for unique breakable objects in various environments, such as a cozy study, a fully stocked bathroom, and a festive living room decorated with holiday gifts. You can even shout your triumphs on command as you race against the clock to finish your destructive spree.

70010000132974.name: Road Line Puzzle: Connect the Paths
70010000132974.intro: Can you turn every path into place?
70010000132974.description:
Ready for a path puzzle you can solve one turn at a time?

This intuitive puzzle splits a picture into panels, then challenges you to rotate them until the broken road connects again.

Enjoy the look of a beautiful garden scene as you study each panel’s direction, follow the flow of the road, and aim to complete the route.

How to play is simple!

・Choose the panel you want to adjust
・Rotate the panel
・Clear the stage when the road connects cleanly

Early stages start with smaller layouts.
As you move ahead, the number of panels increases, and the path combinations become trickier to read.

Whether you want a quick mental refresh or a relaxing solo puzzle session, it is easy to jump in at your own pace.
Use your observation and a flash of insight to connect one beautiful route through the garden!
