Button controls and touch controls are both supported.

70010000132991.name: Rally & Hypercar Bundle
70010000132991.intro: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000132991.description:
This pack includes the games: Rally Rock ´N Racing and Hypercar Racing.

Rally Rock ´N Racing

In Rally Rock 'N Racing, you’ll enjoy a wide variety of natural environments, such as deserts, snow-covered mountains, forests... where you can show your skill at the wheel, competing against everyone to become the fastest. The game has several modes, such as Championship, Time Trial, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Hypercar Racing

In Hypercar Racing you'll enjoy the dirtiest, fastest, and most spectacular races at speeds over 200 Mp/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 8 adversaries. The game has different modes, such as Championship, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Online leader board where you can compare your best times with those of your friends and players from around the world.

Features:

- Wide variety of tracks.
- Multi-player with 4 players.
- Realistic driving physics.
- Lots of Rock 'N Roll music.
 -Online ranking

70010000132994.name: Mystery Box
70010000132994.intro: Pack it. Ship it. Make their day.
70010000132994.description:
Every customer who walks through your door has their own personality - the punk who wants his beats loud, the tennis star who needs the perfect gift for a teammate, the vampy goth girl, the sweet grandma who just wants something cozy. In Mystery Box, you read the room and pack the perfect box for every single one of them.

Drag, stack, and arrange items by hand until the box is filled just right - every piece carries patterns that build value in specific ways, and perks that ripple out to boost everything else inside. Get it right, and watch your customer light up. Then hit the shop between rounds to unlock new items, papers, and packaging styles to build even better combos next time.

As your reputation grows, so do customer expectations - and so do the stakes. How long can you keep everyone happy?

Features:
- A colorful cast of customers, each with their own tastes and quirks
- Hands-on 3D box-packing - arrange every item yourself
- Item patterns and perks combine for deep, replayable strategy
- Unlock new items and packaging styles between rounds
- Endless mode with rising difficulty and demands

70010000133000.name: KUPAR: Horror Mystery
70010000133000.intro: Some legends should never be disturbed.
70010000133000.description:
Deep within an ancient forest lies the legend of KUPAR—a mysterious statue said to hold the power to break a centuries-old curse. Most believe it's nothing more than folklore.

To lift the curse, you'll need to uncover forgotten secrets, solve mysterious puzzles, and survive the horrors hidden within the forest. But one question remains...

Does the KUPAR statue truly exist?

Features:
>Explore a mysterious cursed forest filled with secrets.
>Search for the legendary KUPAR statue.
>Solve puzzles to break the curse.
>Experience atmospheric first-person horror and exploration.

70010000133015.name: GIRAFFE RAISING GAME ~Reach for the sky~
70010000133015.description:
One day, while walking down the street, you encounter a mysterious, "neckless" giraffe?!
Upon closer inspection, it turns out to be a incredibly rare new species whose neck grows longer as time passes. And it seems to have taken a total liking to you!

Start your slow-paced, carefree life raising your very own special giraffe!

[How to Live with Your Giraffe]
■ Keep an Eye on Its Belly!
Your giraffe’s fullness meter drops over time. Keep it happy and healthy by feeding it carrots so it never goes hungry!

■ Harvest Piles of Carrots in Mini-Games!
Carrot Tower: A balancing game where you stack carrots as high as you can. The higher you stack, the bigger the reward! But watch out—drop just one, and it's game over. Stay focused and aim for a high score!

Carrot Darts: Aim carefully and throw carrots at the target. Show off your skills and go for the gold!

■ Shop Till You Drop! ♪
Exchange your collected carrots for handy items in the shop. Get your hands on useful goodies like Mini-Game Tickets or a Name Tag to give your giraffe a name, and deepen your bond together!

70010000133082.name: Dreamy Beauties: Heart-Pounding Illustration Puzzle
70010000133082.intro: Can you restore the perfect view?
70010000133082.description:
A dreamy illustration has been sliced and turned around. How fast can you make it whole again?

You know that satisfying feeling when every little detail finally clicks into place.

This is a casual rotation puzzle where you bring each picture back to its original look by rotating the slices. Take your time to enjoy the image, or go for a speedy clear and chase a better star rating.

・Look over the sliced illustration
・Rotate each slice until the picture lines up
・Clear the stage and aim for a faster time
・Earn up to three stars based on your clear time

It is simple to start, but the more slices there are, the more your eyes and instincts get tested.

Relax, focus, and enjoy a heart-pounding little puzzle break whenever you like.

Button controls and touch controls are both supported.

70010000133088.name: Street Corner Heartbeat Snaps
70010000133088.description:
A photo looks right at first glance... until every slice turns your plan around.

You know the finished image is in there somewhere. The fun is spotting the clues, turning each piece, and watching the scene click back into place.

This is a casual rotating picture puzzle where one image is split into slices. Rotate the slices to restore the original view, then aim for a faster clear time to earn more stars.

・Look over the sliced image
・Rotate each slice to the correct angle
・Complete the picture
・Try to clear faster for up to three stars

No trivia, no complicated rules—just visual focus, quick decisions, and that satisfying moment when everything lines up.

Play a stage whenever you want a short puzzle break, or replay stages to chase a better time.

Button controls and touch controls are supported.

70010000133097.name: Alluring Neon Night Town
70010000133097.intro: Can you set every slice straight?
70010000133097.description:
Think the picture will snap into place at a glance?

This casual rotation puzzle turns a neon night mood into a quick visual challenge. Each stage starts with one image split into slices, and every slice has been turned out of place.

How to play:
・Look over the whole image
・Rotate each slice until the picture lines up
・Clear the stage fast to aim for more stars

The rules are simple, but the pressure builds as the slices increase. Even a small twist can change the whole image, so sharp eyes and quick decisions make the difference.

Take on all 60 stages and see how smoothly you can bring the night back into focus.

70010000133116.name: Jaleco Sports: Faceoffs
70010000133116.intro: Your opponent is ready, it’s time to faceoff!
70010000133116.description:
Get ready to faceoff!

Jaleco's classic sports trio puts you up against the toughest competition around, where every serve, dunk, and slapshot is a chance to prove who’s got the most game.

Whether you're delivering a ferocious backhand in a championship tennis match, connecting on a sweet bounce pass in a street basketball showdown, or crashing the crease in a full contact hockey barnburner, one thing is certain – your opponent is ready for you.

So lace up your kicks, grip your racket, and drop the puck – it’s time to faceoff!

Racket Attack / Moero!! Pro Tennis (NES™, 1988 - 1994)

- Realistic tennis moves including lobs, volleys, and slices.
- Choose from 8 men's and 8 women's players, each with unique strengths and weaknesses.
- Tournament mode lets you battle through seven increasingly difficult matches to claim the championship trophy.
- 2-player exhibition mode for going head-to-head against a friend.
-  Multiple court surfaces to play on.

Hoops / Moero!! Junior Basket - Two on Two (NES™, 1988 - 1989)

- Half-court street basketball with fast, arcade-style action.
- Realistic moves – blocked shots, steal the ball, pass, or drive hard to the hoop.
- 8 unique characters, each with their own strengths and weaknesses.
- 1-on-1 or 2-on-2 matchups, team up or go it alone.
- Two courts to choose from.
- Play solo against the computer or with a friend.

Pro Sport Hockey / USA Ice Hockey (NES™/Super NES™, 1993-1994)

- Realistic hockey simulation with slap shots, slick passes, body checks, and penalties.
- Choose from a league of 24 unique teams.
- Play an exhibition or official game, or special practice modes.
- Includes a regulation 84 game season schedule, playoffs and cup finals.
- Create and change lines for any situation: scoring, checking, power plays.
- 1 player vs. computer, 2-player head-to-head, and computer vs. computer modes.

Authentic Action – Feel the excitement of every dunk, wrist shot, and smash with intuitive controls and strategic gameplay.

Seamlessly switch between the NES™ and Super NES™ versions anytime including regional releases of all games.

Rewind the action like a VHS tape – missed that shot? Go back in time and try again!

Need help? The original manuals are built-in and always ready to guide you!

Retro Presentation – Play with a classic TV CRT filter or with the many other display options for the ultimate nostalgia.

Compete against the world and your friends on the monthly leaderboards.

With Remote Play support you can play on the go and invite your friends from around the globe to play a friendly vs match, team up for a tournament, or battle for the cup together.


Whether you're a longtime fan of the Jaleco sports series or a newcomer ready to experience some of the most beloved sports franchises in history – gear up as it’s time to faceoff!

70010000133119.name: Kitties Solitaire
70010000133119.intro: 340 levels of cozy, cuddly card fun.
70010000133119.description:
Curl up with the coziest card game on your console! Kitties Solitaire wraps the classic TriPeaks Solitaire experience in an adorable world of playful cats, warm colors, and charming feline companions.
Clear the peaks one card at a time in this relaxing yet endlessly engaging solitaire adventure. With 340 handcrafted levels, every session brings a fresh challenge — and a new reason to keep those paws tapping.
Features:

Full TriPeaks Solitaire — Master the beloved card system that's easy to learn and satisfying to perfect.
340 Levels — A massive collection designed to keep you playing for hours on end.
Unique Card Layouts — Varied and creative board designs ensure no two levels feel the same, delivering long-term engagement.
Smooth & Responsive — Enjoy fluid animations and tight controls that make every move feel great.
Undo & Rewards — Rethink your strategy with the handy undo system, and collect rewards as you climb each peak.

Whether you're a solitaire veteran or just love cute cats, Kitties Solitaire is the purr-fect way to unwind. Deal yourself in and let the good times paw-r in!

70010000133137.name: Strange Mystery Room
70010000133137.intro:
Where will the next case unfold?
Find the hidden clue!
70010000133137.description:
Ready to feel like a detective in a simple, easy-to-pick-up mystery game?

An everyday scene can turn into a case in an instant.
One room, one incident, and clues hidden in plain sight.

Your job is to study the scene, find the evidence, and uncover the truth.

Each case is a short, self-contained story, so you can jump in anytime, even with no mystery game experience.

How to play:
・Read the situation and question
・Examine the illustration carefully
・Find the suspicious evidence in the scene
・Use the hint if you get stuck

The hints help guide your deduction, making it fun for first-time sleuths and puzzle fans alike.

Take a look around the room and see if you can crack the case!

70010000133151.name: Clown's Lair
70010000133151.intro: Explore a haunted house stalked by a sinister clown. Stay hidden, solve puzzles, destroy cursed objects, and escape before your pursuer catches you.
70010000133151.description:
Step into a house consumed by fear, where a sinister clown lurks in the shadows and every room hides another terrifying secret. Explore dark hallways, abandoned rooms, and hidden passages as you search for a way to survive and escape.

Stay out of sight and avoid attracting the clown's attention. Use stealth, carefully plan your movements, and search the environment for useful items that will help you progress. Solve puzzles, unlock new areas, and destroy cursed clown boxes to weaken the evil that has taken over the house.

Every encounter is a test of your nerves. Listen carefully, hide when danger approaches, and make every decision count as the relentless clown hunts you through the darkness.

Can you uncover the mystery behind the nightmare and escape before it's too late?

Features:

First-person survival horror gameplay.
Explore a mysterious house filled with secrets and hidden areas.
Evade a relentless clown using stealth and careful planning.
Solve environmental puzzles to unlock your path forward.
Search for useful items and destroy cursed clown boxes.
Immersive atmosphere with suspenseful exploration and tense encounters.
Easy to learn, challenging to survive.

70010000133176.name: Giggleport: A Brainrot-Style Read-Along Adventure
70010000133176.intro: Welcome to Giggleport! Join Momo the capybara and Toot the goose on a heartwarming, family-friendly coastal adventure!
70010000133176.description:
Welcome to Giggleport!

The magical tide of "Silliness" has risen once again, bringing with it the strangest and most adorable visitors from the deep ocean! Join Momo, the gentle capybara, and her inseparable best friend, Toot the goose, on a heartwarming narrative-driven adventure perfect for the whole family. Climb aboard the Welcome Wagon and get ready to explore a colorful coastal village where every resident has a unique story to share.

Key Features:

• Magical reading: Over 10,000 words of gentle adventure, ideal for kids aged 4 to 10.
• Unique characters: Meet whimsical creatures like the bananadillo or the teacup-hippo, and help them shine!
• 100% safe: No third-party ads or in-app purchases, ensuring complete peace of mind for parents.
• Great values: A beautiful interactive story that promotes empathy, friendship, and self-acceptance.
• Parade prep! Team up with the friendly neighbors to prepare for Giggleport’s grand annual parade.

70010000133178.name: War the Knights
70010000133178.intro: With great explosive barrels comes great responsibility.
70010000133178.description:
Sword? Check.
Horse? Of course.
Explosive barrels? You'd better believe it!

Choose your side, arm yourself with your favorite weapons, and charge into large-scale medieval battles. Fight with swords, bows, spears, crossbows, shields, and even magic. Capture flags to respawn closer to the front line, ride into combat on horseback, and use everything at your disposal to help your team claim victory.

Battle across snowy fields, islands, and mountain fortresses, experiment with different tactics, and always keep an eye on your surroundings—sometimes a single well-placed explosive barrel is all it takes to change the course of the battle.

70010000133265.name: Hockey Beasts
70010000133265.intro: Choose your team, step onto the ice, and see what kind of beast you are when the puck starts moving.
70010000133265.description:
Hockey Beasts is a colorful, casual hockey game in which the player takes on the role of a member of one of the animal teams and tries to prove which of them deserves to be called the best. Play locally with up to 4 players, or take the competition online with up to 6 players.

Pick your favourite squad: from stubborn bulls and speedy monkeys to crocodiles, elephants, giraffes, and other rink-ready beasts. Every team plays differently, so choosing a character is not just about looks. Some are quick and agile, others rely on strength, reach, or a more patient approach.

The controls are simple enough to understand from the first match, but winning consistently takes timing, positioning, and a good read of your opponent. It is easy to play, hard to master, and built around short matches that are just as enjoyable during a relaxed solo session as they are in a competitive multiplayer game.

Expect expressive cartoon characters, colorful arenas, messy rebounds, awkward collisions, and goals that sometimes feel brilliant and sometimes completely accidental.

70010000133285.name: THE Rolling Rolling Rolling Rice Ball
70010000133285.intro:
Simple, easy-to-play action game.
Cute illustrations.
Great for learning Japanese and English.
70010000133285.description:
This is an action game themed around Japanese culture and traditional children's songs, where you chase after a rolling rice ball (*omusubi*).

Mai-chan has dropped her precious rice ball. Chase after the rolling rice ball and jump into the hole where you think it fell! Catch the rice ball to clear the level!
There are various types of rice balls—such as salmon or tuna mayo—and their movements differ depending on the filling.
In addition to standard chase stages, there are pinball-style stages where you must predict where the rice ball will land and chase after it. Catch the rice ball without falling into a hole yourself!

The game also features a simultaneous Japanese and English display, making it a fun way to learn while you play.

70010000133306.name: Black Flower
70010000133306.intro: In this strategic roguelike survival game, knowledge is your true progression. Grow flowers, gather resources, and use clever combinations of tools, devices, charms and weather to make the
70010000133306.description:
Black Flower is a strategic roguelike about survival and growth in a fragile garden.

Guide your garden through a magical calendar, making daily choices between unpredictable weather conditions. Each day brings new risks and opportunities, forcing you to manage resources, protect your flowers, and adapt to an ever-changing world.

At the center of your journey lies a single black seed — a rare and mysterious chance to change your fate, if you can make it bloom.

Every run is different. Skill matters, but success is never guaranteed.

Features:
-Strategic roguelike gameplay where every run brings new knowledge.
-Experiment, learn, predict, and adapt your strategy to achieve your goal.
-Unlock over 80 achievements and discover new ways to influence the world.
-Combine tools, devices, enchantments, and weather effects to overcome every challenge.
-A relaxing yet challenging experience where careful planning competes with unpredictable chaos.
-Handcrafted art and a magical atmosphere.
-Learn through experimentation—knowledge is your true progression.

70010000133327.name: Special Forces: Blackout
70010000133327.intro: "In the heart of a city reduced to ashes, the unstoppable operation of the elite special forces begins."
70010000133327.description:
Overwhelming realism delivered by a next-generation engine.

Welcome to <Special Forces: Blackout>, a next-generation FPS game that perfectly integrates near-future cutting-edge tactical mechanics onto the brutal realism of modern warfare.

Break through maze-like alleys where raining rockets and sniper gazes intersect, and infiltrate the heart of the enemy.

・Photorealistic Next-Generation Graphics for Overwhelming Immersion
The vivid realism of modern warfare, with artillery shells raining down, unfolds right before your eyes. Experience a whole new level of immersion in a lifelike battlefield recreated with cutting-edge graphics technology.

・Limitless Open World Battlefield and Free Tactical Design
The entire, endlessly stretching, vast battlefield becomes your board. There are no fixed routes. Forge your own path and lead the engagement based on your choices and judgment.

・Dynamic Vehicle Combat Using Mobile Gear
Board a variety of mobile vehicles and traverse the vast battlefield in an instant. With overwhelming mobility, you can seize tactical key points and turn the tide of battle in a flash.

・Four Elite Classes and Synergies to Complete Victory
We offer a class system featuring Assault, Engineer, Support, and Recon, each equipped with unique tactical gear. Meticulous role assignments and perfect teamwork are the only keys to victory.

・A Collection of Legendary Squad Tactical Modes
Top-tier, proven game modes such as Deathmatch, Conquest, and Rush unfold. Prove your strategic spectrum, from capturing objectives to intense battles that generate extreme tension.

・Next-Generation Armored Forces Dominating the Battlefield
Take direct control of the main guns of state-of-the-art next-generation tanks. You can dominate the battlefield by instantly crushing solid enemy defenses or acting as a sturdy steel shield to protect friendly infantry on the front lines.

<Synopsis>
A massive modern city and the largest energy hub in the Middle East is isolated after being occupied by a mysterious, massive armed force. Amidst the gray ruins swallowed by red flames and sandstorms, the enemy occupies an old underground military base and is on the verge of activating the 'Apophis System,' a next-generation tactical weapon designed to plunge the world into terror.

In this worst-case scenario, where even major powers avoid official intervention to prevent a global catastrophe, elite special agents—who do not exist in this world—are secretly deployed into the heart of a chaotic desert city where visibility is obscured by smoke and dust.

"Unauthorized infiltration, traceless destruction. An operation from which no salvation can be expected."

Your infiltration becomes the formula that will shake the tide of the battlefield, and your single shot, pulled amidst the dust storm, becomes a legend that saves the world.

70010000133339.name: Heroes of Magic & Cards
70010000133339.intro: Heroes of Magic & Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder with a poker twist.
70010000133339.description:
Heroes of Magic & Cards is an inventive deckbuilding poker roguelike that rewards both careful buildcrafting and poker skills. Choose your class and chart your path across the world, from encounter to encounter, upgrading your deck, collecting relics, and refining your tactics to take down powerful bosses, earning powerful rewards!


YOUR DECK IS YOUR SWORD AND SHIELD

Cards are everything in Heroes of Magic & Cards! Your hand determines how much damage you can do and what abilities you can activate, such as building Rage or striking the enemy with Lightning! 

By collecting enchantments for your cards, you can improve their number value (change a “5” into a “6”), switch their suit (change a “diamond” into a “spade”), or apply special effects, including card-cloning and poison. By changing your cards’ suits or values you can continually improve your chances of drawing powerful poker-hands, which trigger devastating combo-effects.


POKER MEETS ROGUELIKE!

As you traverse the worldmap, discover relics, enchantments, consumable items, and expansions for your character’s natural class-abilities. Different discoveries and strategies will yield explosive synergies. At the same time, your inner poker-shark will feast!


FEATURES

• Choose from three heroes with access to over 90 abilities, changing the flow of the game in both subtle and spectacular ways. Cast Chain Lightning or Hellfire for massive damage! Use Sacrifice to trade health-points for more cards!
• Collect more than 40 different enchantments as you journey across the world, upgrading your cards and finding explosive synergies.
• Discover hundreds of powerful hidden relics that completely change the game, cutting your max-HP in exchange for vampiric healing, or doubling the power of odd-numbered cards in exchange for weakening the evens!
• Poker-hands such as straights, pairs, etc activate devastating combo-effects that leave opponents in ruin! Carefully manage your cards to pull off dazzling finishers!
• Play relaxing mini-games like fishing and gambling for extra rewards.

70010000133359.name: Escape Room: The Secret Portal Puzzle
70010000133359.intro: The deeper you go, the darker the truth becomes*
70010000133359.description:
Descend into forgotten catacombs where every room hides a new challenge. Solve intricate puzzles, avoid deadly traps, uncover ancient secrets, and survive encounters with terrifying creatures.

Explore a mysterious underground world filled with hidden passages, magical artifacts, and forgotten mechanisms. Some enemies cannot be defeated by force—you must discover their weaknesses, think creatively, and outsmart the darkness.

Every solved puzzle brings you one step closer to the legendary Secret Portal. But only those with sharp minds and unwavering courage will escape the underworld.

Features

*Atmospheric escape room adventure set in ancient catacombs
*Clever environmental puzzles and interactive mechanisms
*Hidden passages, secret chambers, and magical artifacts
*Deadly traps and terrifying supernatural creatures
*Explore a dark world full of mystery, danger, and forgotten history
*Discover the Secret Portal and find your way to freedom

70010000133371.name: Screaming Halls: Horror
70010000133371.description:
You wake up in a dark hallway with no memory of how you got there. The exit is locked by an ancient curse, and the only way to break it is to find every cursed voodoo doll hidden throughout the endless corridors.

But something else roams the halls.

Features
>Explore eerie, cursed hallways.
>Collect voodoo dolls to lift the curse.
>Experience tense first-person horror.
>Survive a terrifying presence stalking the halls.

70010000133374.name: Metal Garden
70010000133374.intro: Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game.
70010000133374.description:
A nomad wanders the far reaches of an overgrown megastructure, a world built for a forgotten purpose in which countless civilizations have lived entombed for ages.

But when the mech they use to traverse its vast distances breaks, they remain stranded in its hostile wilds beneath a concrete sky.

- - -

Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game that can be finished in a single sitting (one to three hours).

Explore architectual relics of eras near and long gone, meet mysterious and powerful factions that have emerged inside the megastructure, and fight your way through varied encounters in this tight and compact FPS campaign.

FEATURES:
- A short, tightly designed shooter campaign.
Unique setting filled with massive industrial structures taken over by nature.
- Atmospheric visuals inspired by mid-00s games.
- Responsive movement and combat.
- A sci-fi mystery story revealed through exploration of the game's spaces.
- An injury system that asks you to manage not only your health, but also your individual body parts.
- Multiple modifiers to change up your playthrough, from health system modifiers to enemy and item randomizers.

70010000133386.name: My Mart
70010000133386.intro: Grow the goods and rule the retail market!
70010000133386.description:
Who knew that a successful business could start in a tomato garden? Your day begins with harvesting ripe tomatoes and carrying them directly to your shelves. But tomatoes are only the beginning. To satisfy your hungry customers, you must feed those tomatoes to your backyard hens and gather fresh eggs to stock the adjacent display.

This is a fast-paced game of supply and demand that requires perfect balance. You must constantly run between your harvesting patches, animal feeding pens, retail shelves, and the busy checkout counter. As you accumulate cash, you can expand your store, unlock new inventory types, and hire clerks and cashiers to automate the daily grind. Keep your shelves full, your chickens fed, and your checkout lines moving quickly to build the ultimate community market.

Key Features:
• Farming Meets Retail: Harvest fresh tomatoes from your garden and use them to feed your chickens, which will produce high-demand eggs.
• Hands-On Management: Move quickly between production stations, stock shelves to the brim, and process payments at the cash register.
• Expand and upgrade: Use your profits to unlock new sections of your market, increase your carrying capacity, and boost your movement speed.
• Assemble your staff. Hire and train helpful employees to stock shelves and manage the checkout line, allowing you to focus on expanding your business empire.

70010000133406.name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter: Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000133406.intro: Take Fate Into Your Own Hands
70010000133406.description:
After quelling the coup d'état that shook the Kingdom of Liberl, Estelle and Joshua have finally become senior bracers. However, on the eve of the Queen's Birthday Festival, Joshua reveals the dark truth of his past before vanishing into the night, leaving only his brief farewell: "Goodbye, Estelle." Armed with Joshua's harmonica and an unshakable determination, Estelle embarks upon a continent-spanning quest to find her partner.

During her journey, she must take on the sinister society of Ouroboros as it emerges from the shadows to plunge Liberl into utter chaos. The capital in flames. A colossal airship darkens the skies. The looming threat of the Shining Ring... Confronted with the greatest crisis in the history of Liberl, Estelle and her allies battle to find Joshua and untangle the web of intrigue and conspiracy woven by Ouroboros!

Key Features

■ CONTINUE YOUR 1ST CHAPTER JOURNEY
By carrying over your clear data from 1st Chapter, you can obtain exciting bonus items that will let you progress through the story more smoothly.

■ MORE COMBAT OPTIONS THAN EVER BEFORE
Overpower your enemies with new Crafts and S-Crafts! Link your characters' attacks during Quick Battles with the new Brave Rush, and make full use of the orbment system for access to Arts.

■ AN UNFORGETTABLE STORY
Dive into an intricately woven narrative to uncover the conspiracies threatening the Kingdom of Liberl.

■ EXPANSIVE SIDE CONTENT
Enjoy a variety of new content in the sequel, including minigames like fishing and poker, cooking with your companions, and fan-favorite characters joining as playable party members.

Experience the expansive combat system, richly realized world, and stirring story of the 2nd chapter of the Trails series!

70010000133419.name: RED HALLWAY: Horror
70010000133419.intro: The exit is right there... but you can't leave.
70010000133419.description:
You wake up in a strange place made up of endless red hallways. The exit is only a few steps away, but it's locked. To escape, you'll need to search the maze, solve puzzles, and uncover the key before it's too late.

You're not alone.

Something is wandering the hallways, and it's hunting you.

Features:
>Explore eerie endless red hallways.
>Solve puzzle to unlock the exit.
>Avoid a terrifying creature stalking the maze.
>Experience tense first-person horror.

Escape before it's too late.

70010000133422.name: Smithsonian: Digging For Dinosaurs
70010000133422.intro: A interactive adventure where young explorers excavate fossils, discover prehistoric creatures, and learn through play in a safe, engaging experience designed for curious kids.
70010000133422.description:
Welcome to Digging for Dinosaurs – a gorgeous interactive experience brought to you by The ©Smithsonian and PlayDate Digital! This is a must-have adventure for dino explorers of any age, where you can dig up fossils and open up a prehistoric world filled with facts, pterosaurs, giant sea reptiles and every kind of prehistoric dinosaur!

EXPLORE every layer of a vibrant and prehistoric world with virtual fossil hunter tools!
LEARN fun and surprising facts about Dinosaurs!
DISCOVER the reptiles that flew, swam and stalked the Earth!

Explore the different time periods when Dinosaurs dominated the land, air, and sea, through guided play, puzzles and digging up fossils and facts. The more you dig, the more you will discover! Earning coins let’s you select new more powerful tools to dig up our prehistoric past. Each new dig is an opportunity for budding paleontologists to crack rocks, brush away dirt, assemble fossils and uncover new dinosaurs and new dinosaur facts! Each dinosaur discovery is rewarded with interactive scenes packed with learning moments and interesting information. Collect all the creature cards and then come back for more!

Think you know your dinosaurs facts? Test your knowledge with a Prehistoric Quiz, earn more dino coins, and keep digging with even better fossil hunting tools!

We’ll see you at the dig site!

Features:
• Learn about more than 15 dinosaur species including Tyrannosaurus rex, Triceratops, and the Velociraptor!
• Unlock dinosaur cards, packed with interesting info about each prehistoric creature you dig up!
• Explore a prehistoric and interactive world that fills with more dinosaurs as you discover them!
• Dig up fossils, test your dino knowledge, and collect creature cards!
• Earn dino coins to unlock better digging tools—without spending any additional ‘real’ money!
• Phonetic spelling helps you sound out and learn exciting new words
• Engaging educational content and beautiful illustrations based on the original Dinosaurs book!
• Learn about all the different Dinosaur ages!

There is something for kids at every level in Digging For Dinosaurs – from cracking rocks and digging up fossils to brushing up on the latest Dino knowledge!

Learning goals:
• Dinosaur knowledge: Learn the names of dinosaurs, what they ate and how they lived.
• Literacy Skills: practiced through reading and creative play about dinosaurs!
• Vocabulary: Learn new words with phonetic spelling and pronunciation.
• Critical thinking: learn what life was like for all the different types of dinosaurs in all their different environments and ages!

70010000133424.name: Ducks In Disguise
70010000133424.intro: Discover hidden ducks, find the ones in disguise, and enjoy a peaceful hidden-object adventure across beautifully hand-drawn worlds!
70010000133424.description:
Ducks In Disguise is a peaceful hidden-object game focused on discovering beauty within the chaos. Explore hand-drawn 2D scenes, each with its own atmosphere, and find the ducks hiding around every corner!

Hundreds of ducks have decided to play the biggest game of hide-and-seek ever! Your task is simple: carefully examine each scene, find the hidden ducks, and complete your collection. But not every duck is easy to spot. Some have disguised themselves to blend into their surroundings, so you’ll need to pay close attention to the details to find them.

As you explore each scene, click on objects and interact with your surroundings. Sometimes a duck is hiding right in front of you, while other times you’ll need to interact with the environment to reveal it. Every duck you find brings you one step closer to completing your collection.

-A Stress-Free Experience
In Ducks In Disguise, there are no time limits, high-score pressures, or tasks that require you to rush. Play at your own pace, listen to relaxing lo-fi music, examine each scene, and enjoy the satisfaction of finding all the ducks.

-Hand-Drawn 2D Worlds
Explore carefully crafted, hand-drawn illustrations, each with its own atmosphere and visual details. Take a close look at the detailed scenes and discover new ducks as you spot the little details hidden throughout the environment.

Not every duck hides in the same way. Some special ducks disguise themselves by blending into their surroundings. Keep your eyes peeled and don’t miss even the smallest detail!
Find Them All!

Complete your collection by finishing every scene and prove that you’re a true duck-finding expert. Find every hidden duck to unlock a special reward: the Quack Certificate!

Whether you have five minutes to spare or want to play for hours, Ducks In Disguise is designed to help you relax, sharpen your observation skills, and discover something new in every scene.

Can you find every hidden duck? Quack! Quack!

70010000133430.name: Shape Wars
70010000133430.description:
Shape Wars is a fast-paced local multiplayer strategy game where geometric armies clash for dominance. Build your base, spawn units, upgrade your forces, and deploy devastating EMPs or pilot a Commander to turn the tide of battle.

Play solo against cunning AI opponents or go head-to-head with up to 4 players in Free For All, Teams, or AI Teams mode. Capture resource points, upgrade damage and shields, and outmaneuver your rivals to be the last shape standing.

Features:
- 1-4 player local multiplayer
- 3 game modes: Free For All, Teams, AI Teams
- 4 unique maps with different resource layouts
- Build barracks, archery ranges, tank factories, and more
- Deploy EMPs to wipe enemy waves
- Pilot a Commander unit with rocket attacks and self-destruct EMP
- Capture resource points for income advantage
- Upgrade damage, shields, and building production
- Procedural sound effects and a neon glow aesthetic
- Quick matches - games last 3-10 minutes

70010000133436.name: Frogborne: New Lands
70010000133436.description:
After being pulled through a mysterious portal, a brave little frog finds itself in a strange new world far from home. The only way back is to restore the ancient portal by finding the three hidden Power Gems scattered across the land.

Explore a vibrant world filled with colorful forests, peaceful rivers, sunny hills, hidden caves, and secret pathways as you search for each gem. Along the way, collect coins, uncover hidden areas, and enjoy a fun, relaxing adventure packed with exploration!

Features:
>Explore a colorful handcrafted world.
>Find the three hidden Power Gems to restore the portal.
>Collect coins scattered throughout the adventure.
>Discover secret paths and hidden locations.
>Enjoy a fun, family-friendly exploration experience.
>Relax with a charming cartoon-inspired adventure.

70010000133444.name: PLATONICA SPACE
70010000133444.intro: Open the door and step into someone's memories. Platonica Space is a sci-fi exploration adventure where you search countless rooms to recover lost memories.
70010000133444.description:
== THE STORY ==

With Earth made uninhabitable to humans, mankind has spread through the universe. A century has passed since that fateful day...

You suddenly wake up in an unfamiliar room. You step through a door only to find yourself in yet another strange room. This mysterious space is a collection of interconnected rooms, coming one after the other with no exit in sight.

Inside the rooms, you run into four other people who, just like you, also have no idea who they are or how they got here. But as you keep exploring, you realize something: these rooms are built from your memories. Yours and the others'.

Through the memories you find, you will remember who you are. But some of these memories are quite unpleasant. One among you has apparently shot a girl dead. And another boarded a spaceship illegally with a fake ID.

Who are you?
Why are you here?
And carrying all these questions, how can you escape this seemingly endless collection of rooms?

== THE GAMEPLAY ==

* Restore Memories by Placing Items
As you explore, you'll find various "memory spots" that allow you to see lost memories. But in order to activate them, you need specific items that you can find throughout the rooms.
These memories are like chapters from a novel with missing pages. Read through them and try to piece together your and the other people's stories.

* Whose Memory Is This?
Not all the memories you'll find will be your own. Some will belong to the four other people trapped in this strange space.
Who is the murderer who shot the girl? Who is the stowaway?
Sort through the memories, find out whom they belong to, and the truth will finally come into focus.

* A Shifting Space, Changing Every Time You Wake Up
Every time you fall asleep and wake up, you'll find that the layout of the rooms and how they connect will change, as will the items and characters you find in them.
You can explore, find items, and uncover memories as many times as you like, but remember: no two attempts will be the same.

* The More You Do, the Sleepier You Get
Each action you take consumes your Vigor. Once this drops to zero, you'll fall asleep... and who knows where you'll wake up.
You'll also lose the items you were carrying, so you'll need to carefully plan your every step, from the rooms you explore to the items you place in them.

* The Others Trapped Within
Just like you, the others inside this space have lost their memories.
As you help them find out more about themselves, they'll surely repay the favor by giving you hints.
The real question is... should you trust them?
Everyone here has their own forgotten past and their own secrets. Uncovering those may be the key to learning the truth.

70010000133457.name: WordHive 3
70010000133457.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000133457.description:
Word Hive 3 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the global ranks, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

Word Hive 3 uses an British English dictionary.

Features
• Play through 5,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all eight letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode

70010000133466.name: Awaken in Fear
70010000133466.intro: Awaken in the middle of the night to a terrifying nightmare. Explore a haunted house, solve puzzles, avoid sinister creatures, and fight to survive until dawn.
70010000133466.description:
Every night begins the same way—you wake up trapped inside a terrifying nightmare where fear lurks around every corner. Explore dark and unsettling environments, search for clues, and uncover the truth hidden within a world where reality and nightmares have become one.

Venture through eerie locations filled with disturbing sights, mysterious puzzles, and relentless supernatural threats. Every room may hide a valuable clue, a useful item, or a deadly creature waiting in the darkness. Stay alert, manage your resources carefully, and use your wits to survive.

As the nightmare grows more intense, you'll face increasingly dangerous encounters that test your courage and determination. Solve environmental puzzles, unlock new paths, and piece together the mystery behind the horrors haunting your sleep before it's too late.

Will you escape the nightmare, or become trapped within it forever?

Features:

First-person psychological horror gameplay.
Explore eerie locations filled with secrets and hidden paths.
Solve puzzles to unlock new areas and uncover the story.
Evade terrifying supernatural creatures and survive tense encounters.
Search for useful items and resources to aid your escape.
Immersive atmosphere with haunting visuals and chilling sound design.
A suspenseful horror experience that keeps you on edge from beginning to end.

70010000133492.name: The Green Light
70010000133492.intro: Follow the voice, escape the routine, and discover the true cost of freedom.
70010000133492.description:
"The Green Light" is a first person horror game. In The Green Light Fred is stuck in a dead-end job, trapped in a cycle of dissatisfaction. He hates his work, he hates his boss, and his life feels like one long, constant disappointment. But everything changes one late night during his shift. As he drifts through the monotony, a voice on the radio cuts through the silence, offering him something he’s longed for: freedom. The voice tells him that his escape is waiting at a distant lighthouse, a beacon calling out to him from the darkness.

With nothing left to lose, Fred embarks on a journey that forces him to confront the depths of his own mind—and the true cost of freedom.

70010000133531.name: Frog Parkour Obby
70010000133531.intro: Hop, jump, and dodge your way through every level!
70010000133531.description:
Play as a frog and take on a colorful parkour obstacle course filled with moving platforms, powerful jump pads, dangerous traps, and tricky jumps. Reach the end of each level and prove your parkour skills.

Looking for a tougher challenge? Try Hardcore Mode, where every checkpoint is disabled. One mistake sends you all the way back.

Features
>Complete challenging parkour levels.
>Jump across moving platforms and use jump pads.
>Avoid traps and dangerous obstacles.
>Attempt Hardcore Mode with no checkpoints.

70010000133534.name: Guided Meditations - Love Yourself
70010000133534.intro: Relax and quiet your mind with soothing, voice-guided meditations. Settle in, and be guided to a more peaceful place.
70010000133534.description:
Take a moment for yourself. Guided Meditations brings calming, voice-led meditation to your console — a peaceful space to relax, de-stress, and reconnect with a quieter mind, whether you have ten minutes or twenty.

No experience needed. Just pick a session, choose your setting, and let a warm, soothing voice guide you gently through every breath. Sink into tranquil visuals and softly flowing ambient sound, designed to ease away the noise of the day.

Whether you're winding down before sleep, settling a busy mind, or simply carving out a little calm in your routine, this is your invitation to slow down and just be.

Features

Soothing voice-guided meditations for all experience levels
Two calming guide voices to choose from
Shorter and longer sessions to fit your time
Beautiful, tranquil backgrounds you can select
Gentle ambient music to deepen your calm
A simple, peaceful experience — sit back, breathe, and unwind

Find your calm, one breath at a time.

70010000133554.name: Dungeons of Alethrion
70010000133554.intro: Enter the infinite dungeon and see how far you can go!
70010000133554.description: Dungeons of Alethrion is a dungeon crawler roguelike game based on the animated series, Tales of Alethrion. Play as heroes from the show, each with unique abilities. Try it single-player or grab a friend to join you in the dungeons!

70010000133560.name: Space Parkour Obby
70010000133560.intro: One small hop for a frog, one giant leap through space!
70010000133560.description:
Play as a frog and jump through a space-themed obstacle course filled with floating platforms, jump pads, moving obstacles, and dangerous traps. Complete every level while avoiding the endless void below.

For the ultimate challenge, try Hardcore Mode. All checkpoints are disabled, so one mistake sends you back to the beginning.

Features:
>Play as a frog in outer space.
>Complete challenging parkour levels.
>Leap across floating and moving platforms.
>Avoid traps, obstacles, and the endless void.
>Attempt Hardcore Mode with no checkpoints.

70010000133580.name: MineSweeper Galaxy
70010000133580.intro: Clear the mines and conquer the galaxy!
70010000133580.description:
MineSweeper Galaxy brings the classic mine-clearing puzzle into a colourful space adventure.

Reveal tiles, study the numbered clues, and locate every hidden mine. Each number shows how many mines are hidden in the surrounding spaces. Mark dangerous tiles, uncover all safe areas, and clear the board without triggering a mine.

Start with smaller puzzles and unlock larger, more challenging boards as you progress through the Nova, Supernova, Galaxy, and Universe stages.

Minesweeper is more than a game of chance. Every tile you uncover, mine you mark, and numbered clue you analyse challenges your problem-solving, pattern-recognition, and deductive-reasoning skills.

With simple controls, multiple difficulty levels, and colourful space-themed graphics, MineSweeper Galaxy is suitable for both new players and experienced puzzle fans.

Experience the satisfaction of mastering Minesweeper as you progress from beginner to expert, learn new strategies, and discover smarter ways to clear each board.

Features:
• Multiple board sizes and difficulty levels: Nova (9 × 9), Supernova (15 × 15), Galaxy (80 × 30), and Universe (80 × 80)
• Resume your last game session and continue where you left off
• Use hints whenever you get stuck
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
• Pan across the board and zoom in or out
• Colourful space-themed graphics, professional background music, and sound effects
• Compete with players around the world through online leaderboard rankings

70010000133617.name: Jumbo Airport Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000133617.intro: Just imagine: your own world-famous airport! A game with sky-high levels of fun!
70010000133617.description:
Make your fledgling airport into a world-famous international landmark jam-packed with entertainment!

First build facilities such as Bistros and Bookstores to make visitors comfortable.
Satisfied customers make your airport more popular, and will attract even more visitors!

But the bigger your airport gets, the more tired visitors will be from walking around...
Still, never fear! Simply place seating like Benches and Sofas near facilities, and visitors will be able to rest up.
Oh, and don't forget Plants to soothe sore eyes!
Seeing nature is especially important in places like airports, don't you think?
So add some greenery to your airport scenery!

Keep on truckin' until you can hold fairs and make your airport even livelier!
You may even get some new visitors?!

Make enough money to buy your own airliners and devise flight plans.
Before long you'll be setting up regular flights!

Sign contracts with foreign airline companies and make your airport a global player!
Build up friendships with foreign cities and attract people from all over the world!

So what are you waiting for? Help passengers travel the world and live out their dreams today!

70010000133623.name: Dice Nights
70010000133623.intro: Roll the dice, chase high scores, and master classic combinations, a colorful and relaxing board game experience for players of all ages.
70010000133623.description:
Roll the dice and put your luck and strategy to the test, a colorful board game experience built around classic dice combinations and high-score challenges.

Roll up to five dice, decide which ones to keep, and use your remaining attempts to create the best possible result. Aim for pairs, straights, full houses, four of a kind, and the ultimate five-dice combination. Every decision matters as you choose where to place your score and try to complete the scorecard with the highest total possible.

With simple controls, bright visuals, and quick rounds, easy to learn but offers plenty of opportunities to improve your strategy. Play at your own pace, challenge yourself to beat your personal best, and enjoy the excitement of every roll.

Features:

• Classic dice-based board game rules
• Simple and accessible gameplay
• Strategic dice selection and score management
• Colorful board game presentation
• Fast and relaxing rounds
• High-score challenges with plenty of replay value

Pick up the dice, trust your instincts, and make every roll count.

70010000133681.name: Parkour Obby: Magma Run
70010000133681.description:
Test your parkour skills in a dangerous lava-filled obstacle course packed with moving platforms and deadly traps. Time your jumps carefully and make it to the end of every level without falling into the magma.

Think you've mastered the course? Try Hardcore Mode, where every checkpoint is disabled. One mistake means starting over.

Features
>Complete exciting lava-themed parkour levels.
>Jump across moving platforms and over molten magma.
>Use checkpoints to save your progress.
>Take on Hardcore Mode with no checkpoints.

70010000133703.name: Parkour Obby: Ice Escape
70010000133703.intro: Can you escape the frozen course?
70010000133703.description:
Make your way through an icy obstacle course filled with slippery platforms, long jumps and freezing hazards. Stay focused as you leap across floating platforms and avoid falling into the frozen abyss.

Want a real challenge? Try Hardcore Mode, where every checkpoint is disabled. One slip, and it's back to the beginning.

FEATURES:
>Complete challenging ice-themed parkour levels.
>Jump across floating platforms and frozen terrain.
>Use checkpoints to save your progress.
>Take on Hardcore Mode with no checkpoints.

70010000133717.name: SENTO SURVIVOR : Slip, Grab, and Bathe in Glory!
70010000133717.intro: Master the slippery floors of a Japanese public bathhouse and blast your rivals with water guns!
70010000133717.description:
Welcome to the sento—a Japanese public bathhouse where the floors are slippery and the battles are anything but relaxing!

Slide too far, crash into your rivals, or get caught up in unexpected stage gimmicks. Anything can happen in this chaotic water-gun battle!
Master the slippery bathhouse floors, blast your rivals with water guns, and fight your way to the ultimate honor: being first into the bath!

Enjoy a full single-player campaign packed with unique stages, or gather up to four players for chaotic local multiplayer battles.

■ Take on 36 unique stages set in Japanese public bathhouses!
In the single-player campaign, travel through six areas inspired by different parts of Japan and take on a total of 36 stages. A powerful boss awaits at the end of each area!

No two stages are the same. Their size, obstacle layouts, and stage gimmicks all vary, so study your surroundings and figure out the best route to gain the upper hand.
Having trouble with a stage? Try switching characters or changing your water gun to find a combination that better suits the challenge.

Clearing a stage is only the beginning. Each stage also features three Challenges to complete for players looking to master them all.

■ Choose from four unique characters!
Four playable characters are ready to enter the bathhouse, each with their own appearance and abilities.
Asahi is a balanced all-rounder with strong offense and defense. Rei uses exceptional acceleration to chase down rivals. Teppei relies on his impressive toughness to overpower the competition, while Yuzuki uses speed and agility to keep opponents guessing.
Choose the character that best suits the stage—or simply pick your favorite!

■ Pick the right water gun for the job!
Four different water guns offer distinct playstyles.
The Aqua Shot is a reliable handgun-type weapon with balanced performance and fast reloads. The Aqua Burst is a shotgun-type weapon that fires water over a wide area. The Aqua Lancer is a powerful rifle-type weapon with excellent range, while the Aqua Storm is a submachine-gun-type weapon capable of unleashing a relentless stream of shots.
Experiment with different combinations of characters and water guns to find the setup that works best for each stage.
Complete certain conditions in the campaign to unlock new water-gun skins and customize their appearance to your liking!

■ Go wild with Special Weapons!
Powerful Special Weapons can appear during battle. Grab them before your rivals do and turn the tide in an instant!
If an opponent gets there first, you could be in serious trouble—but take them down and you can steal the weapon for yourself.
Win the fight for these powerful weapons and seize the advantage!

■ Stage gimmicks turn every match into chaos!
Jet showers bursting up from the floor, giant rubber ducks, and plenty of other bizarre gimmicks can throw your plans into disarray.
Why are things like these in a bathhouse?
Some mysteries are better left unsolved.

■ Up to 4-player local multiplayer!
In addition to the full single-player campaign, you can enjoy local multiplayer battles with up to four players.
Play solo, with friends, or with family—and embrace the chaos!

■ The Story
“At last, the time has come!”
Once every four years, the Grand Sento First Bath Festival is held!
Sento Masters from across Japan gather to prove just how deeply they treasure the sacred honor of Ichibanfuro (First Bath).
Pride is on the line, water guns are loaded, and only one can claim the glory of the first bath!
Show the world a passion for the bath hotter than the water itself!

70010000133780.name: Before Exit: Gas Station
70010000133780.intro: Your beloved employee is back! Before Exit: Gas Station is the next game in the franchise. You clean up your workplace, take care of customers, make sure everything is closed.
70010000133780.description:
Before Exit: Gas Station is anomaly-detection game with dense atmosphere and some unexpected plot-twists.

To reveal all its secrets and fully understand it, you will have to play through the campaign several times.

In Before Exit: Gas Station, you must close your workplace at night as a gas station employee. But wait, don't gas stations stay open at night? Not in this world!

Your boss is very strict and he loves to save money. When night comes, it means you have to turn off the lights, close the store, and go home. It's a gas station in the middle of nowhere, so why would anyone visit this place after dark?

 Over 40 story-rich scenarios, packed with unique content, 4 different endings, and 6 mysterious bonus episodes.

Play through the game again and again to unlock everything and uncover the true ending. Are you ready to return home?

Like its predecessor, the game combines roguelike features with logical riddles in unique anomaly-detection genre! Play day by day to find all the assignments, and finish every task before coming back... home?

It's also the first time in the franchise you can actually walk out of your workplace before going back home! Check the fuel dispensers, and the oil stains, and get rid of the customers thinking they can fuel up at the last minute. 

Complete every task to make your boss pleased. Do not make any mistake, as he is very observant and you are THIS close to getting fired. Anyway, have a lovely time at your charming workplace!

70010000133794.name: Nordic Storm Solitaire
70010000133794.intro: Help Northman Elof lead his people to the land promised by the god Feyr!
70010000133794.description:
Beware - this land is under dispute by the Jotun Idyl, an archrival of the ancient gods. Play through 130+ challenging solitaire levels and chase the Jotun Idyl away!

Nordic Storm Solitaire is a charming and challenging card adventure set in a frozen mythic world. Face the ancient rival Jotun Idyl as you journey through a land of winter storms, magical legends and tactical solitaire puzzles.

Play through 130+ handcrafted levels of solitaire with a progression system designed to keep every stage fresh and rewarding. Earn boosts, unlock helpful tools and use smart strategies to clear difficult layouts faster and more efficiently. Whether you enjoy relaxing card games or more demanding puzzle challenges, Nordic Storm Solitaire offers a satisfying balance of accessibility and depth.

With beautiful Nordic scenery, story-driven progression and polished solo gameplay, this is a perfect pick for players who love casual strategy games, atmospheric adventures and classic solitaire with a modern twist.

FEATURES
- A mythic solitaire adventure in a frozen Nordic world
- Guide Elof through 130+ handcrafted levels of challenging solitaire
- Story-driven progression across a land of winter storms and legends
- Earn boosts and unlock helpful tools to master tricky layouts
- Relaxing card gameplay meets a Nordic fantasy journey

70010000133862.name: LEGO® Party! - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
70010000133862.intro: A party game that’s built different!
70010000133862.description:
LEGO® Party! is a 4-player party game that’s built different!

Compete against your friends in wacky Challenge Zones and 60 hilarious minigames from across your favorite LEGO sets like LEGO Pirates, LEGO Space, LEGO NINJAGO® and more.

Join your friends online no matter their platform, or get together for a LEGO Party game night. With multiple game modes and tons of minifigures to unlock, you’ll have all the bricks to build the ultimate party!

Challenge players near or far, customize your character and compete in a variety of awesome minigames to get as many Golden Bricks as you can, by any means necessary! But beware, watch out for monsters, traps and flying roast turkeys on your way to become the next star of LEGO Party!

Play your way:
Bring your friends and enjoy the mayhem in couch multiplayer or with cross-platform online multiplayer for up to 4 players. Whether it's competing for the perfect score in Rocketball, practicing against that pesky kraken in Kraken Up or boogieing down in Dance Off, you can enjoy LEGO Party! together or solo!

Go for the gold:
In LEGO Party! you have one goal: to become the player with the most Golden Bricks! Use power-ups to gain the advantage and set up traps to sabotage your opponents across a range of customizable LEGO themed Challenge Zones.

Everything is awesome:
Put your speed, wits, and LEGO expertise to the test across a variety of crazy minigames. Race to make dinner for aliens, run through collapsing tombs and skid round the track in rally races and so much more across 60 different wildly fun minigames. 

You do you:
With over 1 billion minifigure combinations from iconic LEGO sets, you can go with a classic look or design your own unique and outlandish minifigure. Show off your creation at the next party!

70010000133879.name: Casual Mystery Solving Bite-Sized Mysteries
70010000133879.intro: What clues hide in the art?
70010000133879.description:
Ready for a quick mystery between moments?

Look closely at illustrated scenes and let each prompt guide you toward a hidden clue. Ordinary-looking pictures may hide tiny oddities and easy-to-miss details.

How to play:
・Read the prompt
・Study the illustration
・Tap or select the one spot that answers the question

Each round is short, so it is easy to jump in during a break. Whether you enjoy visual puzzles, clue hunting, or simply taking your time with an illustration, this is a relaxed way to test your observation and spark of insight.

Can you uncover every clue?

70010000133895.name: Queen's Garden 2
70010000133895.intro: Help Jack, the Queen's loyal assistant, rebuild the royal garden from the ground up!
70010000133895.description:
The Princess has been crowned - but her beloved garden lies in ruins. Play through 130+ challenging match 3 levels and bring the royal grounds back to life!

Queen's Garden 2 is a charming and relaxing match 3 adventure set in a hand-drawn royal kingdom. Join Jack on a journey through blooming courtyards, quiet ponds and flower beds waiting to be restored to their former glory.

Play through 130+ handcrafted match 3 levels with a progression system designed to keep every stage fresh and rewarding. Collect coins and precious jewels, then spend them on plants, trees, fountains and decorations to shape the garden exactly the way you like. Whether you enjoy relaxing puzzle games or more demanding match 3 challenges, Queen's Garden 2 offers a satisfying balance of accessibility and depth.

With beautiful hand-drawn scenery, rewarding garden customization and polished solo gameplay, this is a perfect pick for players who love casual puzzle games, cozy decoration adventures and classic match 3 with a fresh twist.

FEATURES
- A charming match 3 adventure in a blooming royal kingdom
- Guide Jack through 130+ handcrafted levels of match 3 puzzles
- Collect coins and jewels to rebuild the garden piece by piece
- Buy plants, trees, fountains and decorations and design your own garden
- Relaxing puzzle gameplay meets cozy garden restoration

70010000133916.name: Real Girls: Midnight Desire
70010000133916.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000133916.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

70010000133924.name: Small Saga
70010000133924.intro: Beneath the streets of London, an angry mouse seeks revenge against the god who stole his tail. An epic RPG of miniature proportions!
70010000133924.description:
Venture below the streets of London, and you will find the medieval kingdom of rats, mice, moles, squirrels, and shrews known as Rodentia.

If the rodents have a cardinal law, it is this: never attack a god. But Verm never had much respect for the rule of law. His tail was stolen by the Yellow God of Death, and now the mouse will have to fight all manner of beasts and titans on his quest to get it back.

Features:
• Team up with a colorful cast of misfit rodents.
• Encounter awe-inspiring titans. Clash with a swashbuckling water vole, a pious lab rabbit, a poetry-spewing kraken, and many more.
• Meet the hideous vermin who run society, then overthrow them.
• Brandish your tiny weapons in strategic, turn-based combat.
• There is no grinding. Small Saga is a tightly-focused and boss-oriented adventure.

70010000133929.name: School Sweets Discovery ～granulated sugar edition～
70010000133929.intro:
A beautiful girl 2-choice quiz adventure game where you can experience a little variety of languages!
Enjoy multi-end collection and  Challenge
70010000133929.description:
This is a quiz game where you can choose the correct answer "2" (example: "Ni" is the correct answer if "Ni" and "two") from the national flag and country name (example: Hinomaru and Japan).

Let's aim for "Dr. Genius" in the challenge mode where you compete for how many questions you can answer correctly within 22 seconds and challenge !

70010000133975.name: Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey Collector's Edition
70010000133975.description:
Feel the sea breeze and the endless horizon!
This is the beginning of a grand journey. For the first time, you step aboard a luxurious liner to spend an unforgettable honeymoon!
In Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey, warm encounters and cozy evenings await, as your route takes you through the colorful islands of the Pacific Ocean.
This isn't just a sightseeing tour, it's a celebration of life, where every day brings new emotions.

Why you'll love this game:
-Engaging storylines! From the care and love of newlyweds to the developing relationship between a distinguished captain and a female manager.
-A carefree atmosphere: join parties, play in the casino, and enjoy diving in the Pacific waters.
-Collect memories: Gather unique souvenirs from ports of call — memorable keepsakes from every destination you visit.
-Rich bonus search content: Beyond the main item list on each location, a whole set of additional items awaits you!

This isn't just a game.
It's a lifestyle: with new friends, carefree moments, and the atmosphere of a daily celebration.
Ocean, luxury, and love are just a click away.

Collector's Edition includes:
-18 additional hidden object scenes — even more cozy locations and details to explore.
-12 new mini-games + 18 bonus games — for those who love a challenge along the way.
-A souvenir collection — gather unique mementos from every port, like true traveler's trophies.
-Beautiful desktop wallpapers and a music player with a wonderful soundtrack.

70010000134026.name: Horse Spirit Valley
70010000134026.intro: Ride peaceful 3D valleys on your horse, collect every diamond on the map, and spend your sparkle on new pastures plus deep unicorn-style looks—coats, manes, saddles, armor, and horns—
70010000134026.description:
Welcome to Horse Spirit Valley

Step into a soft, sunlit fantasy where the rhythm is simple: ride, sparkle, dress up your mount, and unlock new pastures when you are ready for the next view. No rush—just you, the trail, and a pocket full of dreams.

Ride and Explore

Travel on horseback across handcrafted 3D valleys filled with grass, sunlight, and open space.

Every journey has a clear goal: collect all the diamonds hidden throughout the world. Find them all to complete the area and enjoy the satisfaction of clearing every corner of the map.

Diamonds That Work for You

Diamonds collected during your adventures remain available between play sessions, with your current balance always visible.

Spend your savings on new environments or cosmetic items for your horse. When you do not have enough diamonds, the game clearly shows how many more you need.

Make the Horse Unmistakably Yours

Create a horse that feels completely your own with a wide range of customization options:

* Size
* Coat color
* Mane style and color
* Saddle and reins
* Armor style and color
* Horn shape and color

Preview every option in the customization hub, save your favorite appearance, and use collected diamonds to unlock premium styles.

Pastures Waiting Beyond the Horizon

The world selection screen displays each environment, its name, and its unlock price.

Your first pasture is available from the beginning. Additional dreamlike landscapes can be unlocked whenever you have collected enough diamonds and are ready for a new adventure.

Play Your Way

Adjust visual settings, real-time shadows, and music to create the experience that suits you best.

A varied soundtrack keeps menus and journeys feeling fresh, while a calm fairy-tale atmosphere follows you throughout the valley.

Comfortable Controls

Simple and intuitive controls make exploring, navigating menus, and customizing your horse easy and comfortable.

Pause the game, adjust settings, or return to the main menu whenever you need a break. Your progress will remain safely saved.

Who It Is For

Horse Spirit Valley is a low-stress, satisfying pocket of magic where you can explore, collect, customize, unlock, and repeat.

If gentle fantasy worlds, sparkling collectibles, and a beautiful unicorn-inspired mount sound like your perfect relaxing adventure, saddle up and enter the valley.

70010000134070.name: One Last Clip
70010000134070.description:
You are locked inside a cinema. Your only way to escape is to follow the instructions of your task: Watch the same film clip repeatedly and search for flaws to break free. But this may sound easier than it is, every wrong decision or death will set you back. So be careful!


On this journey, you’ll watch the clip Paper Panic a haunting tale of Jim and his paper plane. But be warned... the story behind it might be darker than it seems.

You wake up in a storage room of a strange cinema, with no memory of how you got there. On the wall, you find a board with instructions. It tells you what to do if you want to escape. Otherwise, you’ll be trapped here forever.

Your task is simple: Help sort out the flawed film reels.

Enter the cinema hall, take your seat, and watch the film clip. After watching, choose one of the two exits, one for a normal clip, the other for a flawed one. Continue this cycle until you reach Cinema Hall 0. But beware if you make the wrong choice, you’ll be sent back to the beginning.

Strange or spooky things might happen in the cinema. Ignore them. They’re just distractions, and they shouldn’t affect your judgment.

70010000134076.name: Jigsaw Puzzle: Frog
70010000134076.description:
Relax and enjoy the timeless fun of jigsaw puzzles with Frog Jigsaw Puzzle. Piece together a collection of beautifully illustrated frog-themed images featuring peaceful ponds, lush forests, and colorful nature scenes.

Whether you're a casual player or a dedicated puzzle fan, Frog Jigsaw Puzzle offers hours of satisfying gameplay.

Features:
>Beautiful frog-themed puzzle artwork
>Multiple levels
>Relaxing gameplay with no time limits
>Save your progress and continue anytime
>Suitable for players of all ages

70010000134081.name: Jigsaw Puzzle: Fun Shapes
70010000134081.description:
Discover a fresh twist on classic jigsaw puzzles in Jigsaw Puzzle Fun Shapes! Complete 30 colorful and entertaining levels featuring unique puzzle pieces in all kinds of fun and creative shapes.

Each puzzle offers a charming illustration and a new challenge, making every level feel different. With cute artwork, vibrant colors, and relaxing gameplay, it's a delightful experience for players of all ages.

Features:
>30 puzzle levels
>Colorful, cute artwork
>Relaxing gameplay with no time limits
>Suitable for players of all ages
>Easy to pick up and play

70010000134087.name: Scary Stories Grotesque
70010000134087.intro: A short horror visual novel inspired by internet ghost stories and urban legends, where familiar places become home to inexplicable and disturbingly real horrors.
70010000134087.description:
Horror in everyday life always begins in the most ordinary way.

A late-night subway station. A movie theater with only a single audience member. A mountain road swallowed by dense fog. A bedroom where you lie alone after work. Even the bathroom of an ordinary apartment.

Every story begins in places that feel familiar. Then, without warning, something inexplicable slips into the ordinary.

Scary Stories: Grotesque is a collection of short horror visual novels inspired by internet ghost stories and urban legends.

Some stories begin with something someone else once experienced. Others begin with a single careless mistake. And in most cases, the protagonist never truly discovers what they encountered.

New ghost stories will continue to be added through future updates. More horrors are waiting to invade your everyday life.

Have you ever...

Fallen asleep on the subway and missed your stop?

Watched a movie alone in an empty theater?

Walked home alone late at night?

Fumbled for a power outlet in a dark room?

Truly hated someone?

Driven down a deserted road in the middle of the night?

Scary Stories: Grotesque gathers the unsettling tales that may have been hiding between those ordinary moments.

Face every kind of horror you can imagine.

From slow-building psychological dread, to nerve-racking jump scares, to the overwhelming despair of cosmic horror.

Experience every boundary of fear, all in one place.

Key Features

Horror That Feels Real - The scariest thing isn't ghosts—it's the feeling that it could really happen. Experience a creeping sense of dread that slowly tightens its grip within familiar places.

Anthology Format - A collection of short, intense ghost stories. Enjoy each story at your own pace, anytime and anywhere, with every tale delivering a different flavor of horror.

Paranormal Photo-Inspired Visuals - Aged film photography, heavy noise, and low-light cinematography. Designed to recreate the disturbing realism of browsing paranormal photo archives and ghost story forums late at night.

Immersive Sound Design - Every breath, every creak, every distant sound is crafted to keep you on edge. Atmospheric music and unsettling sound effects bring each story vividly to life.

Things Left Unexplained - Not every mystery is solved when the story ends. What did you really see? What was actually there? The answer is yours alone.

70010000134091.name: WordBuzz 4
70010000134091.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000134091.description:
WordBuzz 4 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the global rankings, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

WordBuzz 4 uses a British English dictionary.

Features
• Play through 5,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all eight letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Skip to the next level after 24 hours
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode

70010000134094.name: Astrava
70010000134094.intro: Explore a mysterious alien planet filled with abandoned facilities, breathtaking landscapes, and hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.
70010000134094.description:
Embark on a journey to a mysterious alien planet filled with breathtaking landscapes, abandoned research facilities, and the remnants of a forgotten civilization. Every location holds clues to the planet's past, inviting you to uncover the secrets hidden beneath its surface.

Explore vast sci-fi environments at your own pace, from towering structures and mysterious outposts to rocky valleys and futuristic complexes. Search every corner, discover hidden areas, and piece together the story of a world left behind.

Immerse yourself in an atmospheric adventure where curiosity is your greatest tool. Observe your surroundings, uncover ancient technology, and experience the wonder of exploring an unknown planet far from home.

Every discovery brings you closer to understanding the mysteries of Astrava.

Features:

First-person sci-fi exploration adventure.
Explore a mysterious alien planet filled with unique environments.
Discover abandoned facilities and futuristic structures.
Uncover hidden secrets and learn the story of a forgotten civilization.
Atmospheric exploration focused on discovery and immersion.
Beautiful science-fiction landscapes inspired by distant worlds.
Relaxing gameplay that rewards curiosity and exploration.

70010000134140.name: Zooville Detectives: A Read-Along Mystery
70010000134140.intro: Discover the secret guardian of Zooville in this heartwarming visual novel.
70010000134140.description:
The badger Dax, who has secretly maintained and cared for Zooville by night for years, finds himself longing for recognition, prompting a young hedgehog named Nell and her companions to uncover the truth and guide him out of the shadows.

♣ Format: A visual novel for kids.
♣ Word Count: Featuring more than 10,000 words.
♣ Target Audience: Ideal for children between 5 and 10 years old.
♣ Experience: Completely free of ads and in-app purchases.
♣ Pacing: Allows you to read at your own pace without any rush.

70010000134142.name: Horse Spirit Valley 2
