70010000134142.intro: Ride free through a living valley of meadows, forests, frost and dusk. Tame wild horses, style them in the Horse Boutique, collect gems.
70010000134142.description:
Ride into the Valley

Horse Spirit Valley 2 is a peaceful open-world horse adventure. Gallop across rolling meadows, autumn woods, winter frost, lilac dusk and emerald night — five distinct worlds waiting for your next ride.

Befriend wild horses, collect sparkling gems, and build the stable of your dreams in the Horse Boutique. Soft exploration, beautiful nature, and the freedom to ride wherever the trail leads.
Explore Five Worlds

Every level has its own mood, light and terrain:

Meadow— sunlit hills, wildflowers and open trails
Autumn Forest— warm earth, birch trees and golden light
Winter Frost— snowy fields under a quiet sky
Lilac Dusk— soft evening colours and calm paths
Emerald Night— deep forest atmosphere after dark

Unlock new worlds in the shop, select your favourite, and ride straight into it.
Tame & Ride

Wild horses roam the valley. Approach gently, earn their trust, and welcome them into your stable. Switch mounts in the Horse Boutique — your friends are always waiting.
Horse Boutique

Make every horse your own:

Coats and spirit colours
Mane styles and mane colour
Saddles and reins
Horns and size option
Your collection of tamed horses

Try looks on a live preview, buy with gems, and save the style you love.

Collect, Discover, Relax
Gather gems across the valley
Follow the compass to points of interest
Capture beautiful moments with Photo Mode

70010000134173.name: Deep miner
70010000134173.intro: Unearth the truth about Stonehenge: dig with your shovel, blast through rock layers with dynamite, and grab all the gold!
70010000134173.description:
The truth about Stonehenge is buried far too deep… It’s time to dig it up! Grab your shovel, stock up on dynamite, and embark on a thrilling underground adventure. Blast through layers of rock, collect gold, upgrade your gear, and uncover the ultimate mystery. But tread carefully: deep beneath the earth sleeps something that should have never been awakened...

Game Features

    Addictive Gameplay: Dig, blast, gather gold, and head back to the surface for brand-new upgrades!

    Powerful Upgrades: Level up your shovel for faster excavation, boost your stamina for longer expeditions, and buy a jetpack to swiftly escape danger.

    Explosive Arsenal: Shatter the toughest rock layers with dynamite, carving out the quickest path into the depths.

    The Ultimate Underground Secret: Every gold vein brings you one step closer to the answer—why was Stonehenge really built?

    A Deadly Inhabitant: An ancient monster lurks in the abyss. Every detonation stirs it from its slumber… Will you uncover the truth before the beast catches up to you?

70010000134220.name: Cozy Farm Defense
70010000134220.intro: Build your farm by day and defend it by night! Grow crops, raise animals, recruit farmyard defenders and build walls to stop hungry enemies.
70010000134220.description:
Build a peaceful farm by day and defend everything you have created when night falls!

Farming and tower defense come together in a charming strategy experience. Plant crops, feed your animals, collect coins and expand your homestead with new structures. Every decision matters, so carefully plan where to place your crop fields, animal pens, storage buildings, defensive walls and barracks.

Your farm animals are more than just friendly residents—they can also become brave defenders! Recruit chickens, pigs, cows and goats, each offering different levels of speed, health and attack power. Position your animal army, strengthen vulnerable areas and prepare for the next enemy invasion.

Different crops are needed to care for different animals. Grow sunflowers for chickens, wheat for cows and sheep, and carrots for pigs and goats. Place structures close together to unlock useful bonuses, improve harvests, reduce feeding requirements and lower the cost of recruiting defenders.

As the seasons change, new dangers arrive. Wolves hunt your animals during spring, raccoons target valuable resources in summer, boars smash through defenses in fall and powerful bears attack your buildings in winter. Construct hay bales, wooden fences and stone barriers to slow them down before they reach the heart of your farm.

Balance expansion with preparation, improve your farm’s layout and survive through every season. A beautiful homestead can quickly become a battlefield, so grow wisely, build carefully and keep your animal defenders ready.

Can your cozy little farm survive an entire year?

70010000134252.name: Queen's Garden: Halloween
70010000134252.intro: All Hallow’s Eve is upon us, and the royal court is eager to celebrate!
70010000134252.description:
Help the Queen and her loyal assistant Jack decorate the palace garden in time for the Halloween celebrations. 
Customize your garden, and unlock delightfully eerie new items to place within it.

Play over 130 levels, collect special jewels and purchase plants and decorations to design the spookiest Halloween garden ever!

Night fell, sending shivers down your spine. Will you persist? The Queen counts on your Match 3 bravery!

- Fully customizable gardens
- Many Halloween decorations to choose
- Visit your garden at night!

70010000134308.name: Pretty Home Run Derby - Re: Return of KUSOGAKI
70010000134308.intro: The home run derby-style ęsport — "Baceball" — is now open!
70010000134308.description:
A high-tempo, high-firepower batting game with overwhelming hit feedback. Wield "Mystery Skills" that trigger all kinds of phenomena and take on fearsome foes! Can you bring down the hammer of punishment on "The brat"...!?

Once released as "Flail Your Arm, Hit the Ball: Return of KUSOGAKI" now rebuilt from the ground up into something entirely new — and far easier to pick up. Arriving on Nintendo Switch™. Take down all 20+ pitchers.

70010000134327.name: Look Closer Dark Traditions
70010000134327.description:
In that village, no one questioned the rules.

At first glance, each illustration looks like an ordinary scene from everyday life. But take your time, look closer, and something unnatural should start to stand out.

Find the evidence hidden on the screen and uncover the dark tradition rooted in that place, along with the truth it was meant to hide.

How to play:
・Study the illustration carefully
・Find the suspicious clue hidden in the scene
・Select the spot you think is the answer

The moment you notice the answer, the same harmless view may feel completely different.

Can you catch every unsettling detail?

70010000134375.name: EGGCONSOLE PUYO PUYO PC-9801
70010000134375.intro: A classic falling-block puzzle game! Connect four Puyos of the same color to clear them!
70010000134375.description:
This game is an action-puzzle title released by COMPILE in 1993 in Japan. Gameplay involves clearing falling Puyos by matching four or more of the same color. Players battle head-to-head, strategically managing Puyos. Stacking Puyos to the top means a loss. Clearing large amounts or triggering chains sends Nuisance Puyos to opponents. Though a falling-block puzzle game, it’s known for strategic depth.

The game offers four modes: Solo Puyo Puyo (VS Computer), Duo Puyo Puyo (VS Human), Endless Puyo Puyo (VS Yourself), and Riddle Puyo Puyo (VS Brain). These modes allow players to practice and enjoy Puyo Puyo in various ways.

Beyond its excellent puzzle mechanics, the game is also highly praised for its world-building. Between stages, players can enjoy humorous skits featuring 13 unique characters. Can you defeat them all?

The PC-9801 version, while lacking battle voices and unique enemy AI, features its own distinct elements, such as Puyo preview indicators displayed in vertical columns on the screen’s edges for better visibility. Be sure to check out these exclusive features!

This application contains the same content as the title released in 2025.
If you already own the 2025 version, please do not purchase this item.
If you own the 2025 version and accidentally purchased this application, please contact support at the email address below.

EGG Console Support
support_eggconsole@d4e.co.jp

70010000134378.name: The Ramen Sensei – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000134378.intro:
Build the ultimate bowl to leap past your
ramen rivals and achieve greatness!
70010000134378.description:
Build your ramen rep by fashioning the ultimate bowl from a vast assortment of noodles, soup, and toppings. From roast pork to miso, mackerel, and more--the only limit is your imagination, meaning you'll need to use your noodle to nail the right recipes and bring hungry customers in by the crowd!

Enter contests and see how you size up against rivals, thus cementing your standing as superlative sensei of the savory! Succeed--and one day you might even have your own ramen theme park!

70010000134408.name: 2048 Battles – Sylvan Sirens
70010000134408.intro: Combine tiles and battle cute elves in a realm of fae!
70010000134408.description:
2048 Battles – Sylvan Sirens puts an enchanting spin on the classic 2048 puzzle formula! Slide tiles to combine matching numbers and launch devastating attacks against a coven of woodland foes. Fight your way through alluring sirens, spell-weaving forest witches, and majestic fae queens—each wielding wild nature magic and a flair for the dramatic.

Strategically smash high-value tiles into your foes to deal damage and disrupt their sylvan spells. Each enemy brings unique abilities to the battle: some ensnare your tiles in thorns, others drain your power, and a few can twist the grid with tangling roots. With five difficulty levels, the challenge adapts to your skill.

Once you've tamed the wildwood, take on Infinite Mode for a pure puzzle experience. Combine tiles, stack up high numbers, and see how long you can flourish in the ever-growing forest. 

Will you master the wilds and become the ultimate puzzle champion?

70010000134447.name: Quiz Challenge Multiplayer
70010000134447.intro: History & Science quiz, 1 to 4 players, in English, French, German, Spanish.
70010000134447.description:
Quiz Challenge Multiplayer is the quiz game that turns your couch into a game show stage.

Answer questions across two great fields of knowledge — History and Science — each split into a wide range of themes. From ancient civilizations to modern events, from astronomy to chemistry, every session mixes things up so no two games feel the same.

GRAB A CONTROLLER, GRAB YOUR FRIENDS
Play solo to train at your own pace, or gather up to 4 players in local multiplayer. No account, no connection, no waiting — just pass the pad or take a controller each and start.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

STANDARD — Classic quiz rules. Take your time, think it through, and answer correctly to score.
BATTLE — Speed is everything. The faster you lock in the right answer, the more points you take. Hesitate, and your opponents leave you behind.

LEARN WHILE YOU PLAY
Every question is a chance to pick something new up. History and Science are only half of it: the game is fully playable in English, French, German and Spanish, so you can switch to the language you're learning and train your vocabulary while you play. It's a quiz night and a language lesson in one.

FEATURES

Hundreds of questions across History and Science
Multiple themes within each category
1 to 4 players, local multiplayer
Standard and Battle modes
4 fully localized languages: English, French, German, Spanish
Pick up and play — perfect for family evenings and party sessions

How much do you really know? Time to find out.

70010000134488.name: K-Pop Karaoke Party
70010000134488.intro: Sing your heart out with 10 unique K-Pop idols in this vibrant karaoke experience!
70010000134488.description:
Step into the spotlight with 10 unique K-Pop idols, each ready to perform their own signature track in a vibrant karaoke mode. Whether you want to master the rhythm or just sing along at the top of your lungs, every idol brings their own style, energy, and charm to the stage.

Key Features:
• 10 Idols: Choose your favorite star from a diverse roster of talented performers, each featuring their own dedicated karaoke track and distinct visual aesthetic.
• Exclusive Music Gallery: Take a break from performing and relax with a dedicated Music Gallery featuring 17 original K-Pop instrumental and vocal tracks to listen to anytime.
• Stunning Visuals & Neon Aesthetics: Enjoy eye-catching stage designs, colorful lighting, and polished interfaces inspired by the best of the K-Pop industry.

Are You Ready to Shine?
Pick your star and experience the energy of the biggest stages.

70010000134495.name: False Love: Ghost or Not?
70010000134495.description:
Can love survive when you can no longer trust reality?

Emily and Ethan leave the city behind to rebuild their relationship in a quiet countryside home. Far from the noise of everyday life, they hope for a fresh start.

Instead, they find whispered messages, impossible events, and a growing feeling that someone—or something—is watching.

As Emily searches for answers, every conversation, every clue, and every decision pulls her deeper into a mystery where appearances can be deceiving. Is the house truly haunted, or is there a far more disturbing truth hidden behind every strange occurrence?

Explore a suspenseful psychological horror visual novel where romance, mystery, and emotional tension intertwine. Investigate unsettling events, solve puzzles, discover hidden collectibles, and uncover multiple endings shaped by your final choices.

Will you trust the people around you... or your own instincts?

Features
- Psychological horror story with romance and mystery.
- Meaningful choices leading to multiple endings.
- Solve puzzles to uncover new clues.
- Unlock collectibles and bonus content.
- Beautiful anime-inspired artwork and atmospheric environments.
- Memorable characters, each hiding secrets of their own.

Every answer uncovers a new question.

Every choice brings you closer to the truth.

Or further away from it.

70010000134520.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
70010000134520.intro: Sell cards, build your collection, run tournaments and earn money and build your card shop business.
70010000134520.description:
TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

Manage Your Shop:
Design your own TCG shop. Organize shelves and card packs to make the customer shopping experience smooth and easy. "

Card Collection:
Open the booster packs yourself and collect the cards. Find rare cards and sell them to make a fortune, or keep them to complete your card collection.

Host Game:
Set your card game format and fee, invite players to play card games in your shop. Be sure to keep your store clean and hygienic for the players or they might leave!"

Order Products:
Stock up on different booster card packs and card game products. Keep track of popular trends and adjust your inventory to cater to the ever-changing demands of your customers.

Expand Your Business:
Earn profits to reinvest in your shop. Expand your space, unlock new card sets, and upgrade your facilities to attract even more customers and increase revenue.

70010000134526.name: Psychopath Mind Quiz: Unmask Their Dark Nature
70010000134526.intro:
Can you pick the “normal” answer?
Dark mind teasers await
Unmask the hidden choice!
70010000134526.description:
Does your answer seem as ordinary as you think?

Take on a slightly dark psychological quiz built around chilling situations. Study each image, choose from the options, and try to spot the line of thought that feels just a little different from the usual response.

Playing is easy!
・Study the image
・Think about what you would do
・Choose one answer from four options

“Why would someone act like that?”
“What were they thinking in that moment?”
The reveal behind each answer may give you a little shiver.

No complicated steps needed. It is quick to play in short sessions, great for thinking things through on your own or guessing with friends by asking, “Which one would you pick?”

Recommended for anyone who likes:
・Psychology quizzes and mind teasers
・Unexpected answers and tricky questions
・Testing deduction and intuition
・Quick quizzes for spare moments
・A slightly dark theme

Are you with the majority?
Or will you land on the answer no one else saw coming?
Think it through and challenge every question.

70010000134580.name: The Master Detective’s Eye -Memorize the Scene in 60 Seconds! Case Files from the Streets of 18th-Century London-
70010000134580.intro:
Memorize the scene in 60 seconds!
Recall the clues and crack the case
Feel like a master detective!
70010000134580.description:
Mysterious cases are unfolding on the streets of 18th-century London.
Study each crime-scene illustration for 60 seconds, then rely on your memory to solve the case in this observation and memory game.

Playing is easy!
・Study the crime-scene illustration for 60 seconds
・Memorize the people, belongings, and places as much as you can
・Answer each question using what you remember

“What was that person holding?”
“What was placed over there?”
“What’s different from the scene you just saw?”

The key to solving each case is hidden in the scene you already witnessed.

The setting is 18th-century London.
Take on mysterious cases set around street corners, homes, and other atmospheric locations while testing your observation skills and memory like a true detective.

Each round is quick and easy to enjoy in short bursts, making it a great brain-training pick for spare moments.
Focus on the challenge solo, or have fun with family and friends as you ask, “What was there?” and compare memories.

Recommended for players who like:
・Memory-testing games
・Brain training that uses observation and focus
・Detective stories and mystery atmospheres
・Quick quizzes that are easy to play anytime
・Solving questions together with family or friends

Can you memorize every clue needed to solve the case in just 60 seconds?

70010000134658.name: Flipi Rivals
70010000134658.intro:
Flip the cards. Turn the tide!
An exciting card battle with adorable rivals!
70010000134658.description:
Eight unique characters face off
in an exciting card-flipping showdown!

Flipi Rivals!

Follow the story through the eyes of Panda
in Story Mode.

Discover the stories of all eight characters
and take on a series of battles in Arcade Mode.

Challenge a friend right beside you
in Local Battle Mode.

Enjoy the game's beautiful music anytime
in the Music Room.

Plus, discover a variety of game-changing items
and unique battle arenas!

Simple controls, intense competition!
Test your reflexes and memory!

Use quick thinking and strategy
to become the ultimate Card Master!

An exciting card battle with adorable rivals!

Flipi Rivals!

Flip the cards. Turn the tide!

70010000134664.name: Spooky Tales and Mummy Trails
70010000134664.intro: It's Halloween and two brothers wrongly read a cursed spellbook and one is instantly turned into a Mummy. Run, cast magic, win mini games and rescue your brother
70010000134664.description:
A spooky, cosy 2.5D Platforming Halloween Adventure

It was supposed to be a normal halloween eve, but when 2 brother find an old spellbook, things turn chaotic as one gets turned into a Mummy and runs away. Time for a rescue missions.

Grab your magic wand and wizard costume to embark on a quest across 14 vibrant, action packed levels to break the curse and bring your brother home in this short but charming all hallows eve game. 

Key Features

14 handcrafted levels. Dash through neighbourhood streets, graveyard, eerie forests and more pack with spooky platforming hazards.

Magical Combat. Blast spooky creatures with your magic or use your slide or double jump to get past the monsters.

Fun mini games. Take a break from the main road to beat the mini challenges like a haunted volleyball match as you continue your journey.

Collect sweet treat to unlock stylish new hats and wands.

Cosy and Spooky aesthic. Enjoy a charming, non scary  Halloween game that's great for all ages.

Short and sweet. This game wont take hundreds of hours to beat.

70010000134704.name: King's Descent
70010000134704.intro: Explore a fallen kingdom as a masked adventurer. Master jumps, dashes, wall-climbing and powerful attacks as you battle through the dungeon and confront the Nameless King.
70010000134704.description:
Enter the ruins of a long-fallen kingdom and uncover the dangers hidden within its forgotten dungeon.

You take control of a mysterious masked adventurer on a journey through an interconnected world filled with hazardous passages, challenging platforming sections and hostile creatures. Explore the dungeon in your chosen order, discover new paths and prepare for an inevitable confrontation with the nameless king.

Master a responsive set of movement abilities, including double jumps, rapid dashes and wall-climbing. Combine these skills to cross dangerous gaps, climb towering chambers and reach areas hidden throughout the kingdom.

When enemies stand in your way, fight back using quick combo attacks or charge a powerful special move that unleashes explosive damage across the surrounding area. Choose the right moment to strike, avoid incoming attacks and survive each encounter.

Rest at bonfires to restore your strength and establish new checkpoints as you descend deeper into the ruins. Every chamber brings you closer to the ruler waiting at the end of your journey.

Features:

• Explore an interconnected 2D dungeon
• Run, double-jump, dash and climb walls
• Battle enemies using combos and special attacks
• Rest at bonfires to heal and save your progress
• Discover multiple routes through the fallen kingdom
• Face the nameless king in a final boss battle

The kingdom has fallen, but its ruler remains. Will you survive the descent?

70010000134721.name: Adventure of Kanjiro Chapter 2
70010000134721.intro: Let's go on an adventure for those who have lost their kanji!
70010000134721.description:
"Adventure of Kanjiro" is a game of kanji learning, so that children who are not good at kanji or dislike practicing kanji can learn kanji while having fun.

As Kanjiro, the main character of this work, you will discover kanji stolen by monsters by writing kanji, looking for kanji, and looking for reading. By discovering kanji, you can raise your level and earn coins.
You can use coins to buy items such as equipment and potions at the shop to prepare to fight monsters.
In battles with monsters, the faster you remember the kanji you find, the more damage you can do. However, if you remember incorrectly, you will be damaged instead.
In order to defeat monsters, it is important not only to have good items, but also to remember the kanji well.

Let's enjoy the game and memorize the kanji so that we can defeat all the monsters and get back the kanji!

Features Kanji taught in 2nd grade of Japanese elementary school.

70010000134810.name: Evergreen Quest
70010000134810.intro: Explore a mysterious forest, uncover hidden paths, discover forgotten secrets and survive the dangers lurking among the trees.
70010000134810.description:
Step into a colourful woodland filled with animals, hidden discoveries and mysterious creatures.

Mathias has ventured deep into the forest, where every path offers something new to investigate. Guide him through peaceful meadows, dense woodland trails, flowing rivers and dark caves as you search for interesting objects and uncover the secrets of the wilderness.

Pay close attention to your surroundings. Follow scattered feathers, inspect abandoned campsites, examine unusual plants and mushrooms, and interact with the animals you meet along the way. Some creatures may need your help, while other encounters will test whether Mathias is brave enough to continue.

Every discovery shapes Mathias’s personality. Exploring unfamiliar places increases his curiosity, facing frightening creatures develops his bravery, and experiencing the peaceful side of nature brings him happiness. The qualities you develop during your journey will influence how Mathias handles the greatest mystery hiding within the woods.

Deep inside the forest lives a legendary Yeti. Will Mathias frighten the creature away, become trapped in its cave or discover that the mysterious beast may not be an enemy after all? His final fate depends on the experiences collected throughout the adventure.

Explore at your own pace, enjoy the charming low-poly environments and see where your journey through the forest will lead.

Features:

• Explore a colourful 3D woodland environment
• Discover hidden locations and mysterious caves
• Interact with animals, plants and unusual objects
• Develop bravery, curiosity and happiness
• Help creatures you encounter during your journey
• Uncover the mystery of the legendary Yeti
• Experience multiple endings based on your actions

The forest is waiting. Follow the trail, embrace the unknown and discover what lies deep within the woods.

70010000134852.name: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 13 Collector's Edition
70010000134852.intro: Pack your bags, it's time to travel!
70010000134852.description:
Discover iconic landmarks, hidden courtyards, and the unique charm of European cities, all from the comfort of your home.

What's new in Trip to Europe 13:
- Every scene is crafted with meticulous attention to architectural authenticity and cultural context. Dozens of carefully hidden objects await your sharp eye.
- Enhanced search modes — Expanded task types, dynamic hints, and interactive elements breathe life into every image and keep gameplay engaging.
- Mini games and puzzles — Logic, observation, and memory challenges are seamlessly woven into your journey for a satisfying change of pace.
- Souvenir collection — Purchase memorable keepsakes that reflect the traditions, crafts, and spirit of each country you visit.
- Postage stamps — A commemorative stamp awaits you on every location. Fill your album to unlock exclusive bonuses.

70010000134963.name: HIRAGANA Word Challenge
70010000134963.description:
Ready to build Japanese words one character at a time?

HIRAGANA Word Challenge is a casual quiz game where you use the illustration as a clue and choose the hiragana that completes the word. It’s a fun way to connect pictures, words, and kana while building the basics of Japanese.

How to play is simple:
・Look at the illustration
・Check the word with one missing hiragana
・Choose the right answer from four options
・Read the explanation to learn more

After each question, you can review helpful notes about meaning, usage, related expressions, and bits of Japanese culture connected to the word.

The short, quick questions make it easy to play during a break. Great for beginners, anyone brushing up on hiragana, and families who want to enjoy Japanese language and culture together.

70010000135021.name: Dice A Million
70010000135021.intro: Have you ever tried to roll 1,000,000 on a set of dice? No? Build the right bag of die, and you might just pull it off.
70010000135021.description:
Dice A Million is a roguelike deckbuilder about rolling dice to try and get to a million points. That's the whole point. (get it?!)

You're trapped in this dice rolling facility, so let's get rolling and try to escape. Combine the effects of more than 120 different dice and discover powerful synergies. Get through ever-increasing debts and challenging bosses that will require perfect symbiosis in your bag in order to be beaten.

Will you be able to push luck to your side?

70010000135048.name: Hotel Tycoon
70010000135048.intro: Welcome guests, upgrade rooms, hire staff and build the hotel empire of your dreams!
70010000135048.description:
Welcome to Hotel Tycoon, a fun and relaxing hotel management game where every happy guest brings you closer to building the ultimate hotel empire!

Start with a small hotel and transform it into a thriving business. Clean rooms, welcome new guests, collect money, upgrade furniture, unlock stylish decorations and expand your hotel floor by floor.

Hire helpful employees to speed up your business, improve every room and keep your guests satisfied while your hotel grows bigger than ever.

Unlock new character skins with unique bonuses to customize your manager and improve your gameplay.

Meet all kinds of funny visitors along the way. Most guests are ordinary travelers, but don't be surprised when strange visitors check in too. Skeletons, aliens and other unexpected characters can appear and make every session more entertaining.

Once you've mastered your first hotel, move on to an even bigger location with new opportunities and continue growing your hospitality empire.

Whether you enjoy relaxing simulation games, casual tycoon experiences or management games, Hotel Tycoon offers several hours of satisfying progression that's easy to learn and rewarding to master.

Features

• Build and manage your own hotel

• Clean rooms and prepare them for new guests

• Welcome a variety of visitors

• Upgrade rooms with better furniture

• Expand your hotel with new areas

• Hire employees to automate your business

• Unlock character skins with unique bonuses

• Earn money and grow your hotel empire

• Discover funny special guests including skeletons and aliens

• Unlock a second hotel with new challenges

Become the ultimate Hotel Tycoon!

70010000135054.name: DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER
70010000135054.intro: Exhaust all forms of evil by fighting with the brutal Peon Exploitation System!
70010000135054.description:
Enemies? Allies? Kill Kill Kill! The more death you bring, the stronger you become! Stat-Raising Strategy RPG is here!

Based on classic grid-based strategy games, this entirely new SRPG features the Peon Exploitation System—a brutal combat mechanic where you mercilessly sacrifice your own allies.
The more misdeeds you commit, the more vicious your army becomes, and the greater your advantage in battle!
Regain the lost power of the Devil, Giga Super Death, who was transformed into a baby, and crush the false god wearing a mask of justice!

■STORY
This is a story of another Earth, different from the one we live on. 
Giga Super Death, the most wicked Devil of all, was just one step away from killing God… 
when suddenly, he was transformed into a helpless baby.

Anticipating such a crisis, he had been working through the night to develop the ""DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER"" resurrection program—and finally, it was time to activate it.
Was it a prank of fate, or inevitable destiny? 
The one ensnared in this suspicious ritual was Killshiro Katanaka, a gloomy young man who despises the world.

Due to their aligned interests, a bizarre pact was formed. 
This is the story of pure EVIL, starring the Devil himself and his newfound disciple, Killshiro.

■Kill, kill, kill both enemies and allies! An unconventional strategic battle!
Exhaust all forms of evil using the Peon Exploitation System which sacrifices your allied Peons during battle! 
Brutal tactics such as Kill Skills and Sacrifices that detonate your underlings with your own hands are the shortest route to victory.

■The more you sin, the stronger you become! Master your base to unleash pure chaos.
Pour in the Perverse Points earned through misdeeds to build your own ultimate evil army! 
Within the limited time, make full use of suspicious Abductions and Pillaging to strengthen your characters to their absolute limits.

■A world that warps with every chapter! Dive into a story where no act of evil is off-limits!
Every time you defeat a chapter's boss, the game's situation completely transforms! 
Experience the full thrill of diverse misdeeds, such as be a monster to defeat Super Rangers, be a witch to crush Magical Girls, or others!

70010000135059.name: Pikmin™ 4 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
70010000135059.intro: Guide plantlike Pikmin on an enhanced expedition for Nintendo Switch™ 2!
70010000135059.description:
Meet Pikmin, small, plantlike creatures you can grow, pluck, guide, and send into battle with enemies multiple times their size! These loyal, curious helpers come in different types, including fire-resistant Red Pikmin, Ice Pikmin that can freeze bodies of water, and Glow Pikmin that can light the way forward at night. The fate of your Pikmin is yours to decide!

Create and customize your own pint-sized explorer and traverse a world that is teeming with life—and visually enhanced with high-resolution graphics for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system! 

Partner with Oatchi, your dependable space dog, and give him voice commands

Oatchi (pronounced oat-chee), resident good boy and dependable partner, can help with things like smashing obstacles and carrying you and your Pikmin throughout your adventure. With the miniscule Pikmin and a capable canine in tow, no challenge is too big—and you can even give him voice commands via the Nintendo Switch 2 system microphone as you play! 

Test your skill at Dandori Academy, and go explorer vs. explorer in Dandori Battles

Dandori is the art of commanding your Pikmin effectively, and in the world of the Pikmin™ 4 game, explorers like to get in on some friendly competition. Throughout the story you’ll encounter characters itching to compete in Dandori Battles, where you’ll need to gather plenty of Pikmin fast to collect the most objects within the time limit. 

That’s where the Dandori Academy comes in. Pikmin™ 4 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori Academy adds a series of Dandori exams for you to train your skills on. And when you’re ready to take on your fellow explorers in Dandori Battles, you can even do so with a friend on the same system*—or via GameShare** locally or online via GameChat, even if they don’t have the game!

Already have Pikmin™ 4 for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack! 
    
If you already have the game for the Nintendo Switch system, you can purchase the upgrade pack*** separately to enjoy all the performance enhancements and additions of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, including Dandori Academy.

Explore more Creature Activity Level options and discover Decor Pikmin!

New to Pikmin? Try the Relaxed Creature Activity Level, where enemies take more damage and will never attack you first. If you’re a veteran player looking for true test, take on Fierce Creature Activity Level to face down tougher enemies with fewer Pikmin.

Keep your eyes peeled for Decor Pikmin wearing special outfits, and use the Field Camera to take photos of them. Not only will you add these special Pikmin to your squad, but you can also edit your photos with stamps, filters, and more for maximum style!

70010000135115.name: Resonant Blade
70010000135115.intro: Wield sonic power to slash through an army of machines in a fallen world.
70010000135115.description:
In RESONANT BLADE, sound itself becomes your weapon. The Dark Synths have overrun a world once protected by domed cities, turning them into cages for an ever-growing army of hostile machines.

You play as Atlas, a scientist forced to become a fighter after his home is destroyed. Armed with the Resonant Blade, he channels sonic energy into devastating attacks - and uses that same resonance to uncover hidden paths, solve environmental puzzles, and expose secrets buried in the ruins.

Dash, parry, and tune your blade's frequency to break through enemy defenses in fast, precise 2D combat that combines intense action, exploration, and environmental puzzles. As the Synths adapt and grow stronger, only careful timing and clever use of sound will keep Atlas - and what's left of Terra - alive.

Features:
- Sonic-powered combat: slash, dash, and modulate frequencies to break enemy defenses
- Explore the ruins of Terra and uncover secrets through sound-based puzzles
- Fast, precise 2D action combining combat, exploration, and environmental challenges
- Face an ever-evolving army of Dark Synth machines and challenging bosses
- Single-player sci-fi adventure in a dystopian, atmospheric world

70010000135128.name: Asdivine Knot - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000135128.intro: Tie the knot of fate in a skybound fantasy RPG!
70010000135128.description:
A young cleric named Verselio once devoted his life to serving the deity Treises—until the truth shattered everything he believed. When the divine is revealed to be a lie, faith turns into fury, and a journey of rebellion begins. Joined by a mysterious maiden, a disciplined vigilante chief, and a self-proclaimed deity, Verselio sets out across a vast fantasy world in search of answers. As their paths intertwine, each carries their own burdens, beliefs, and secrets, in a story of betrayal, redemption, and the meaning of faith in a deityless world.

Asdivine Knot is a classic turn-based JRPG that blends strategic command battles with modern systems and deep customization. Master the shared Nexus Gauge to control the flow of combat, unleash powerful Nexus Skills, and summon devastating entities to turn the tide. Explore a wide world with your fully customizable airship, craft and upgrade equipment using collected materials, and shape your adventure with side quests, crew recruitment, fishing, and puzzle dungeons. Packed with rich content and designed for a complete single-player experience, this is a must-play fantasy RPG for fans of traditional Japanese role-playing games.

70010000135155.name: Isle of Reveries
70010000135155.intro: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted.
70010000135155.description:
Take control of an owl named Lief as they make a pilgrimage skybound to the forsaken Isle of Reveries, where it's said that any wish can be granted. Players will fight through six mysterious dungeons, each with their own unique themes and puzzles, and meet charming anthropomorphic characters along the way in this retro-inspired adventure.

Use your fairy companion's magic to duplicate and spawn a variety of objects in the world, and discover how they interact with your robust set of items to solve head-scratching puzzles.

* EXPLORE A VAST OVERWORLD & CONQUER DUNGEONS
Eight different biomes in the overworld. Six different dungeons, each with their own unique theme, mechanics, and key item. 

* COPY & SPAWN OBJECTS
Use Lief's fairy companion to copy and spawn a myriad of objects, using them to fight puzzles and fight terrifying enemies.

* FORGE A COMMUNITY
Construct various buildings and forge a township. Characters that Lief saves throughout the game will move to the township, offering new quests and stories.

70010000135224.name: Solitaire Companions - Cats
70010000135224.intro:
A classical Solitaire game with a purr-fect twist. 
Play classic Solitaire in a cozy, cat-filled world.
70010000135224.description:
This game combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a warm, charming presentation filled with soft colors, cozy scenes, and adorable cats. 

Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play. 

As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include beautiful cat-themed card skins, serene backgrounds inspired by sunny windowsills, cozy living rooms, and blooming gardens, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually. 

Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer soft pastel tones, playful feline illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing. 

With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, the game offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.

70010000135227.name: Kpop idol Dress Up
70010000135227.intro: Become the ultimate K-pop fashion stylist in this colorful dress up game and create stunning looks for your singer with endless combinations of trendy outfits, hairstyles and accessories.
70010000135227.description:
Hello fashion lover, are you ready to step into the spotlight? In Kpop Idol Dress Up, the stylish K-pop dress up game for Nintendo Switch™, you become the fashion stylist behind your very own idol. Create dazzling looks, mix trendy outfits, customize hairstyles and add eye-catching accessories to make your star shine on every stage.

Explore a colorful world of K-pop fashion and unleash your creativity with modern clothes, glamorous details and endless style combinations inspired by pop idols. Design your outfit for the stage as you create bold, energetic and fantasy-inspired looks.

Featured Features:
Endless K-pop outfit combinations: Mix and match stylish outfits, hairstyles and accessories to create unique looks for your K-pop idol.
Become a true fashion stylist: Design stage-ready looks, concert outfits and standout styles inspired by the exciting world of K-pop.
Photo Mode: Capture your favorite creations, save your best looks and share your pop star fashion moments with friends and family.
Full customization: Change hairstyles, hair colors and accessories to create the perfect makeover for every performance.
Made for fashion lovers of all ages: Whether you love dress up games, fashion games or creative styling, this game is made for you.

Don’t wait any longer! In Kpop Idol Dress Up, your creativity has no limits. Create the ultimate K-pop idol, discover your signature style and become the fashion stylist you’ve always dreamed of.

70010000135289.name: RABBIT AND TURTLE HARSH JUMP RACE
70010000135289.intro:
The World of Japanese Fairy Tales
Simple Jumping and harsh Races
The appeal of simultaneous Japanese and English display
70010000135289.description:
A wild new "RABBIT AND TURTLE HARSH JUMP RACE" has begun!

Rabbits can move quickly, but they can only jump. On the other hand, turtles move slowly, but they take the safest and shortest route towards their goal. As a rabbit, can you skillfully jump over the various challenging and difficult courses and reach the finish line before the turtle?

There are all sorts of stages, from turtles pulling out strange machines to crows suddenly becoming allies, to races taking place during heavy snow with frozen platforms—it's a truly chaotic race!

While the simultaneous display of Japanese and English can be educational, it might be more suitable for mental training.

70010000135351.name: Rhythm Flow
70010000135351.intro: Feel the rhythm and hit every beat as you test your timing across a variety of energetic songs in this fast-paced music game.
70010000135351.description:
Feel the rhythm and let the music guide every move in this exciting rhythm game where precision, timing, and quick reflexes are the keys to success. Follow the beat, hit every note with perfect accuracy, and challenge yourself across a variety of energetic tracks.

Each song offers a unique rhythm pattern designed to test your coordination and sense of timing. As the music becomes faster and more complex, you'll need to stay focused, maintain your combo, and strive for the highest score.

Whether you're a newcomer to rhythm games or a seasoned music game fan, intuitive controls and progressively challenging songs make every performance both fun and rewarding.

Master every track, improve your accuracy, and become the ultimate rhythm champion.

Features:

Fast-paced rhythm gameplay focused on timing and precision.
A variety of energetic music tracks to master.
Challenging note patterns that test your reflexes.
Build combos and achieve high scores with perfect performances.
Easy-to-learn controls suitable for players of all skill levels.
Replay your favorite songs to improve your timing and beat your best scores.

70010000135373.name: Doorway to Nightmares: Terrifying Tales
70010000135373.intro:
Chilling tales await.
Uncover fear in the art.
70010000135373.description:
When you finally expose the truth behind the story, can you handle what it reveals?

Some scares hide in plain sight.
Read eerie situations, study the illustration, and solve each mystery like a detective in a horror tale.

How to play is simple:
・Read the question carefully
・Find the matching clue hidden in the illustration
・Tap the spot you think answers the prompt
・With each correct answer, the story’s truth comes into clearer focus

Perfect for fans of horror, mystery games, and quick deduction puzzles.
Step through the doorway, follow the clues, and see what is waiting in the dark.

70010000135411.name: Naughty Baby
70010000135411.description:
You are a curious child with a house full of interactive objects and a list of simple missions to complete. This level-based simulator is designed for straightforward, relaxed gameplay from a child's perspective on the floor. You have complete freedom to crawl, walk, and climb through cozy indoor rooms and sunny backyard gardens, transforming everyday domestic spaces into your personal playground.

This puzzle adventure offers unique and lighthearted challenges at each level. Some missions have you hunting down hidden toys, while others require you to use your wits to reach high places. Use smooth controls to navigate the stylized 3D environment and complete objectives such as finding hidden toys, solving simple puzzles, and setting up harmless, funny pranks to surprise your mom.

70010000135458.name: Nutty Gunner: 2D Squirrel Shooter
70010000135458.description:
Grab your biggest gun and help one fearless squirrel collect every nut! Shoot, jump, use weapon recoil to launch yourself through obstacles, and blast enemies with nut-shaped heads.

Every level brings new traps, crazy situations, and fresh challenges. Unlock even bigger weapons, master chaotic physics, and turn every firefight into explosive fun.

Features:

- Fast-paced 2D action with ragdoll physics
- A crazy arsenal of powerful weapons
- Use weapon recoil to reach new places
- Nut-headed enemies and deadly traps
- Dozens of action-packed levels
- Easy to learn, endlessly fun to master

70010000135514.name: Roll Golf
70010000135514.intro: Tilt the entire course to guide your golf ball through creative obstacles, avoid hazards, and sink the perfect shot across challenging levels.
70010000135514.description:
Discover a fresh take on mini golf where the course is just as important as the ball. Instead of swinging a club, you'll tilt the entire level to guide your golf ball through creative courses filled with ramps, moving platforms, narrow pathways, and clever obstacles.

Use gravity to your advantage as you carefully control the ball's movement, avoid dangerous hazards, and find the perfect route to the hole. Every level introduces new challenges that require precision, timing, and strategic thinking to master.

Easy to pick up but difficult to perfect, each course rewards careful control and experimentation. Learn how every tilt affects the ball's momentum and overcome increasingly complex layouts as your skills improve.

Can you conquer every course and become the ultimate master of gravity-driven mini golf?

Features:

Unique gameplay where you tilt the entire course instead of hitting the ball.
Creative levels filled with ramps, moving platforms, and challenging obstacles.
Physics-based gameplay that rewards precision and careful timing.
Increasingly difficult courses that test your skill and strategy.
Simple controls that are easy to learn and satisfying to master.
Relaxing mini golf experience with a fresh and original twist.

70010000135526.name: Monster Academy: An Interactive Story
70010000135526.intro: A heartwarming visual novel for kids with a rich story and engaging gameplay.
70010000135526.description:
Get ready for a heartwarming visual novel for kids that offers a rich reading and gaming experience. Join Bea, a small wickling with a dim flame, and her band of unexpected outcasts including a shy gargoyle, a loud bat, and a chaotic gremlin as they get ready for the legendary Grand Howl.

• Extensive Story: Featuring over 10,000 words distributed across multiple engaging chapters.

• Format: An immersive visual novel designed specifically for kids.

• Educational Values: Transmits powerful educational values about friendship, self-acceptance, and empathy, showing that true strength comes from being a gentle light that helps others stop hiding rather than trying to blind the world.

70010000135659.name: 4096 Space Traders Era
70010000135659.intro: Trade the galaxy. Fight for it. Rule it.
70010000135659.description:
Chart your fortune across a living galaxy. In 4096 Space Traders Era, you are a trader-pilot working your way from star to star, hunting the best deals the universe has to offer.

Explore a fully 3D galaxy: scroll through star systems, dive into each system to inspect its planets, and pick your next destination from a sprawling map where distance and reachability matter. On every world, the trading and stock screen puts a live market at your fingertips — buy commodities cheap on one planet, haul them across space, and sell them dear. Track your cargo, your positions, and your profit and loss in real time, because your one true goal is to grow the combined value of your cash and stock to the very top.

But the void is not empty. Every journey to a planet can drop you into a dogfight against alien fighters — dodge, out-fly and out-shoot them with guns and missiles while your Quantum Energy and ammo drain away. Whether you're winning or losing the battle, you can open comms and negotiate with the aliens to settle the fight and finish your journey on your own terms.

Trade, fly, fight, and deal your way to the richest hold in the galaxy.

- Deep 3D exploration — Scroll a detailed, navigable star map, jump between systems within your hyperdrive's range, and drop into any system to survey its planets before choosing where to trade next.
- Living market & stock screen — Buy low, sell high across thousands of worlds. A real-time trading board and inventory screen track your cargo, average cost, current market value and profit/loss, with prices that drift and evolve as the galactic economy simulates day by day (complete with price history and sparklines).
- One goal: build your fortune — Your net worth is the combined value of your cash + stock. Grow it as high as you can, chase the top "Stock and Cash Value," and beat your own peak.
- Alien dogfights — Every trip to a planet can erupt into combat. Pilot your fighter, manage Quantum Energy and ammo, and fight off alien waves with guns and missiles.
- Negotiate your way out — Win or lose, open comms with the aliens to settle any battle and continue your journey on your terms.
- Risk & permanence — Manage fuel, hull damage and cargo weight between trips, repair at station, and play with optional permadeath for a true high-stakes run.

70010000135665.name: Doti Golf
70010000135665.intro: Putt, bounce, and boost your way through a wildly inventive mini golf adventure!
70010000135665.description:
DOTI GOLF turns classic mini golf into a playground of chaos. Every hole hides its own trick - sand traps to slow you down, boost pads to send your ball flying, buttons and rotating bars that shift the course mid-swing, swamps that swallow a bad shot, and even pinball-style bumpers that send you ricocheting toward (or away from) the cup.

Rack up stars on every hole, chase the best par, and work your way through World after World of increasingly devious course design. Whether you're lining up a careful three-putt or gambling on a boost-pad bank shot, DOTI GOLF keeps every hole unpredictable.

Features:
- 5 Worlds featuring 15 holes each - 75 mini golf courses in total
- Wildly varied obstacles: sand, boost pads, buttons, portals, swamps, spikes, and pinball bumpers
- Star rating and par system on every hole
- Solo play, at your own pace
- Sleek, minimalist course design

70010000135691.name: Color Lines
70010000135691.intro: Plan your moves, line up the colors.
70010000135691.description:
Color Lines is a classic and addictive puzzle game where every move matters. Arrange colorful balls on the board, create lines of 5 or more matching colors, and clear them to keep the board from filling up.

Think ahead, plan your moves, and build clever combinations. New balls appear as you play, making every turn a new challenge. Easy to learn but hard to master, Color Lines is perfect for both quick puzzle sessions and longer strategic play.

Game Features:

-Classic Color Lines gameplay
-Simple and intuitive controls
-Strategic and rewarding puzzles
-Clean and colorful design
-Relaxing gameplay with a real challenge
-Easy to learn, hard to master
-Suitable for all ages

How long can you keep the board clear and beat your best score?

70010000135697.name: The Pit Is Hungry
70010000135697.intro: Grow gourds in a graveyard, carry them to the pit in the middle, and throw them in for coins before the day runs out.
70010000135697.description:
A first-person game about tending a graveyard with a hole in the middle that eats.

What you do. Plant beds. They grow gourds on their own and level up as they grow. Pick a gourd up, carry it to the pit in the middle of the yard, and throw it in. Every one pays coins, and a long throw pays a bonus.

What is pushing you. The day runs on a timer. When it ends, night falls and you sleep in the bed to bank your coins. Fall in the pit yourself and the day ends there. You keep half of what you were carrying.

What you spend it on. The shop opens at nightfall. Money buys more ground to plant on. Sigils buy the upgrade tree: a vacuum that pulls gourds to you, a broom that blasts loose the heavy props lying around the yard, which the pit eats too, and eventually the pit itself, which you can drive across the yard instead of carrying everything to it.

What you are working towards. Everything you feed it makes it bigger. At rank eight the pit is full, and you climb in yourself to end the run. Or restart before that and keep your companions and a permanent growing-speed bonus.

70010000135726.name: Blood Dungeon - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000135726.intro: These dungeons are full of monsters. The blood is there. Take it!
70010000135726.description:
From the creators of Nidhogg comes a game about 2D platforming survival. You'll have to parkour your way around treacherous dungeons to kite monsters while gathering blood and powerups. 

Survive a run, take the bones you’ve earned to the Bone Shop, and get stronger. 

Complete quests to unlock upgrades, arenas, skins, and more.

Features:
- 9 unlockable playable characters with different traits and weapons
- 6 unlockable unique survival arenas
- Over 100 enemy types
- Over 100 quests to complete
- Over 100 unlockable weapons and upgrades
- Dynamic “dungeon dnb” soundtrack by Thomas Hooey

70010000136007.name: Radon Blast 2
70010000136007.intro: Break bricks by using the ball.
70010000136007.description:
Break bricks by using the ball. Get items like bonus, speed and multiple balls to make the game more challenging. If you hit the force wall multiple times it will be destroyed so you can reach the next stage. If you miss a ball you go back to the previous stage. But hurry up, you only have seconds before the ball explodes. 

Radon Blast 2 is full packed with randomly sorted stages. An increasing ball speed makes it even more challenging. Jump between stages, collect bonus multipliers to get higher scores.

70010000136294.name: Yummy Yummy Cook Book
70010000136294.intro: Bake, mix, and level up in this cozy kitchen adventure inspired by grandma's recipe book!
70010000136294.description:
Inherit your grandma's beloved recipe book and rediscover all her favorite dishes - one delicious page at a time. Pick your favorite animal chef, from a curious rabbit to a cheerful bear, and step into a cozy kitchen full of charm.

Mix ingredients by hand, time your baking just right in the oven mini-game, and level up to unlock new recipes, ingredients, and upgrades. From pizza and bread to cakes and cinnamon rolls, every recipe adds another page to your own cooking story.

Features:
- Choose your favorite animal chef, each with their own personality
- Cook and bake a variety of recipes: pizza, bread, cake, and pastries
- Hands-on mixing and baking mini-games
- Level up to unlock new recipes, ingredient slots, and kitchen upgrades
- Relaxing solo gameplay

70010000136350.name: Woodo - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
70010000136350.intro: Woodo is a cozy 3D puzzle matching game
70010000136350.description:
Woodo is a cozy diorama puzzle game where you assemble wooden scenes piece by piece. As you place objects in their correct spots, each scene slowly fills with color and comes to life, revealing charming animations and small surprises. Follow the story of Foxy and Ben the frog through a series of interconnected dioramas, each capturing a unique moment from their shared adventure.

Tactile Satisfaction
Feel like you’re assembling a real toy, with each piece clicking into place with a satisfying, tactile sensation, as if it’s right in your hands.
Assembling objects isn’t linear—you have to turn and explore the 3D space to reveal hidden pieces. Watch as each piece transforms the world around you, with playful animations that react to your placements, bringing the diorama to life.

A Warm Companion
With a friendly narrator's voice, immerse yourself in a world when time was plentiful and much of it was spent outdoors, when the simplest things surprised and when every day promised great adventure. Feelings that were more present in childhood and are often missed or even forgotten with time passing.

Feed Your Inner Child
The game features funny and charming characters that create an atmosphere of carefree joy and humor, reminding you that happiness is what your inner child needs.

-Assemble beautiful dioramas piece by piece with a unique puzzle mechanic
-The game adapts to your pace, providing assistance when you need it
-Gameplay changes to adapt the narration
-Simple but deeply meaningful story
-The comforting voice of the narrator keeps you company
-Get carried away by nostalgic feelings of when things were simple
-Plenty of funny characters and silly animations make you smile

70050000000183.name: The Legend of Zelda™: Breath of the Wild DLC Pack 1
70050000000183.description:
DLC Pack 1 "The Master Trials" includes the following:

Trial of the Sword

Visit a certain location to challenge the Trial of the Sword, where you must vanquish waves of enemies to progress from one room to the next. You will start this challenge completely bare, without any armor, equipment, or food items to aid you. Once you defeat all the enemies in a room, you can advance to the next. If you complete all 45 rooms, Link's mind and body will be strong enough to wield the Master Sword's full power and splendor any time the sword is usable! 

Hero's Path Mode

A feature that allows you to view the path you've taken on your journey. It will record your journey for up to 200 hours of gameplay. Use this to find those shrines and Koroks that are still eluding you! You can even adjust the replay speed so you can manually select the pace you wish to watch your path unfold.

Master Mode

In Master Mode, most enemies you encounter will be one tier higher than they originally were. For example, where you would normally see red Bokoblins, you will now likely see Blue Bokoblins instead.

There is also a new top tier of enemies that don't appear in Normal Mode! Additionally, enemies will recover health if you stop attacking them, and they will also notice Link more easily, so you may need to make adjustments to your fighting strategies. You also might find enemies and treasure chests floating in the air! Use these locations to your advantage to score treasure or even recover stamina.

Travel Medallion

There is an item called the Travel Medallion hidden in a treasure chest somewhere. Place it at your current location and you will be able to travel there whenever you please. You can only register one location at a time, but this addition should aid you in your journey.

8 clothing items hidden in treasure chests

Items honoring the legacy of The Legend of Zelda series (Majora's Mask, Midna's Helmet, Tingle's Hood, Tingle's Shirt, Tingle's Tights, Phantom Helmet, Phantom Armor, and Phantom Greaves) will be hidden in 8 treasure chests scattered across Hyrule. There are hints to help you find these items hidden somewhere as well. Search for these hints and treasures while you journey across Hyrule!

Korok Mask

The Korok Mask is an item that will be hidden in a treasure chest somewhere in Hyrule, and unlike the 8 items mentioned above, this one has a special ability. When Link wears this mask, it will shake when a hidden Korok is nearby!

70050000000184.name: The Legend of Zelda™: Breath of the Wild DLC Pack 2
70050000000184.description:
"The Champions' Ballad" will include the following:

The Champions' Ballad

A mysterious voice beckons Link to challenge the Divine Beast Tamer's Trials. He must now prove himself by defeating enemies using the One-Hit Obliterator, conquering new Shrines, challenging a full dungeon, and overcoming many trials along the way. Once all challenges and trials have been bested, Link will obtain a new power known as the Master Cycle Zero!

Additionally, the bard Kass is traveling Hyrule to complete the unfinished song his teacher left behind. As Link and Kass chase their respective goals, Kass will share new original songs he wrote capturing lost memories of the four Champions and Zelda, previously unknown to Link. But that unfinished song... What could it be? 

*To play The Champions' Ballad, you must first complete the Main Quest to free the four Divine Beasts. 

9 clothing items hidden in treasure chests

Items honoring the legacy of The Legend of Zelda series will be hidden in 9 treasure chests scattered across Hyrule, including the Island Lobster Shirt, Ravio's Hood, Zant's Helmet, Phantom Ganon Skull, Phantom Ganon Armor, Phantom Ganon Greaves, and a Royal Guard outfit (complete with Royal Guard Cap, Royal Guard Uniform, and Royal Guard Boots).

Ancient Horse Gear

The Ancient Bridle will increase a horse's number of spurs while equipped. The Ancient Saddle will allow you to call your horse no matter how far away they are. Both of these items will appear in treasure chests somewhere in Hyrule.

70050000000369.description: Do you want a to be a master builder? Get going with this bundle of six fantastic Minecraft packs: Biome Settlers Skin Pack 1, Candy Texture Pack, Cartoon Texture Pack, Pattern Texture Pack, Plastic Texture Pack and Greek Mythology Mash-up. Start building now!

70050000000401.description:

Table  features:
• Guide Chell and Wheatley through test chambers by navigating portals, using aerial faith plates, defeating turrets and facing other obstacles.
• Battle against GLaDOS as you attempt to escape the facility and reach the surface.
• Team up with ATLAS and P-Body for their Cooperative Testing Initiative Multiball.
• Discover Ratman's hidden mini playfield and wreak havok on the Turret Factory.

70050000000619.description: From the darkest fathoms of the ocean comes Proteus, an imposing deep-sea diver built to handle pressure!

70050000000620.name: Rocket League® - Triton
70050000000620.description: Embrace your inner sea god and rule the high seas with Triton, the AquaDome's sleekest submersible Battle-Car!

70050000000621.name: Rocket League® - Vulcan
70050000000621.description: Defend the universe (and your goal line) with Vulcan, the most elite sports-craft in the galaxy!

70050000000622.name: Rocket League® - Hot Wheels® Bone Shaker™
70050000000622.description: Take control of the field with one of the most beloved hot rods of all time, the Hot Wheels® Bone Shaker™!

70050000000623.name: Rocket League® - Hot Wheels® Twin Mill™ III
70050000000623.description: Powered by not one, but TWO blown big-block engines and dual front intakes, Hot Wheels® world famous Twin Mill™ III has arrived!

70050000000624.name: Rocket League® - The Fate of the Furious™ Ice Charger
70050000000624.description:
Now you can own Dom Toretto's Dodge® Ice Charger from Universal Pictures' explosive movie, The Fate of the Furious.

This premium Battle-Car brings a set of exclusive Wheels and six unique Decals along for the ride!

70050000000625.name: Rocket League® – Fast & Furious™ '70 Dodge® Charger R/T
70050000000625.description:
Cruise the pitch with Dom Toretto’s 1970 Dodge Charger R/T from Universal Pictures', The Fast and the Furious™.

WARNING: The driving sequences in the motion picture Fast & Furious were filmed with professional stunt drivers, under carefully-controlled conditions, for entertainment purposes only. No attempt should be made to duplicate any of the racing activities or sequences depicted therein.

70050000000626.name: Rocket League® – Fast & Furious™ '99 Nissan Skyline GT-R R34
70050000000626.description:
Control Brian O'Conner's 1999 Nissan Skyline GT-R R34 from Universal Pictures' 2 Fast 2 Furious™.

WARNING: The driving sequences in the motion picture Fast & Furious were filmed with professional stunt drivers, under carefully-controlled conditions, for entertainment purposes only. No attempt should be made to duplicate any of the racing activities or sequences depicted therein.

70050000000627.name: DLC Character: Ekoro
70050000000627.description: Adds Ekoro as a playable character.

70050000000642.name: WWE 2K18 Kurt Angle Pack
70050000000642.description: After more than a decade-long hiatus, your Olympic Hero has returned!  Receive two playable versions of WWE Hall of Famer Kurt Angle: his WWE “American Hero” persona (2001) or his ECW “Wrestling Machine” persona (2006).

70050000000682.name: Pic-a-Pix Color
70050000000682.description:
Another 150 color puzzles in various sizes!

These puzzles were previous included in Pic-a-Pix Color on Nintendo 3DS and Wii U.

70050000000683.name: Shantae: Pirate Queen's Quest
70050000000683.description: Download this exciting new storyline featuring the bodacious buccaneer, Risky Boots! Play the role of the villainous pirate queen as she travels Sequin Land in search of the components she needs to crush Sequin Land once and for all! Collect Pirate Gear, solve brand new puzzles, and battle your rival, Half-Genie Shantae in a final showdown like no other! Don’t miss out on this epic new installment of Shantae: Half-Genie Hero!

70050000000686.name: Strangers - Biome Settlers 3
70050000000686.description: Get this pack and make your home in distant lands or ocean depths!

70050000000701.name: Mario + Rabbids® Kingdom Battle : Season Pass exclusive - Steampunk Pack
70050000000701.description: Unlock an exclusive weapon for all 8 heroes in a unique steampunk style.

70050000000702.name: Mario + Rabbids® Kingdom Battle : Pixel Pack
70050000000702.description: Unlock 8 unique Pixel-style weapons for your heroes!

70050000000703.name: Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle Ultra Challenge Pack
70050000000703.description:
The Ultra Challenge Pack will put you to the test with:
8 new ultra-hard challenges inside each world’s Secret chapter

5 exclusive co-op maps
 
Gather your heroes and dive into eight new Ultra Hard Challenges to prove your worth!  In addition, a gust of chaos brings frenzy to the co-op mode; Chain Chomps, Tornados, Boos and Pyroclasts have become unstoppable and are wreaking havoc on the 5 exclusive new co-op maps. 
 
Get ready to team up against their chaotic forces in the brand new Cataclysm Kerfuffle Co-op Campaign!

70050000000704.name: Mario + Rabbids® Kingdom Battle Donkey Kong Adventure
70050000000704.description: Embark on an epic battle against Rabbid Kong, who takes over a mysterious island. Donkey Kong, Rabbid Peach, and a moody new Rabbid hero, Rabbid Cranky, team up on a journey across four brand-new environments. Discover a world of tactical gameplay and secrets to uncover. Experience a new story that expands the Mario + Rabbids® Kingdom Battle universe! Discover hours of new gameplay with more than a dozen battles and tactical adventures to experience. Witness a world of Donkey Kong references and the Rabbids’ irreverence that create offbeat situations and fun encounters. Chain together new moves, like swinging with dandelions or climbing high ground, to conquer your foes.

70050000000761.name: Portal Knights - Portal Pioneer Pack
70050000000761.intro: Craft your adventure. Forge your hero. Become the ultimate Portal Knight!
70050000000761.description:
Customise your character and your home with the Portal Pioneer Pack which includes:

- Black Pioneer flag
- Helicopter Hat
- Rainbow cat
- Rainbow World Island

The world of Elysia needs YOU! Join this cooperative, 3D sandbox action RPG to level up your character, craft epic weapons, conquer enemies in real-time, and build almost anything! Craft your adventure. Forge your hero. Become the ultimate Portal Knight!

70050000000901.name: All Main Story Characters - Early Unlock
70050000000901.description:
This DLC is used to immediately unlock all playable characters from the game’s main story.

*Unlockable characters can also be unlocked by progressing through the game.
*This does not include characters who are only available as part of paid DLC.
*You may first need to update to the latest version.

*Available until October 31, 2017.

70050000000902.name: WWE 2K18 Accelerator
70050000000902.description:
WWE fans, sports gamers, and fighting game fanatics - the biggest video game franchise in WWE history is back with WWE 2K18!  With hard-hitting action, stunning graphics, drama, excitement, game modes, match types, creation capabilities, and everything you’ve come to love from WWE 2K, WWE 2K18 promises to bring you closer to the ring than ever before.  Be Like No One.

Decide the overall rankings and attribute levels of every WWE Superstar and Legend in the game.  Unlock every WWE Superstar and Legend, including alternate attires with the Accelerator pack!  

Note: This item is included in the Season Pass premium content purchase.

70050000000903.name: WWE 2K18 MyPLAYER Kick Start
70050000000903.description:
WWE fans, sports gamers, and fighting game fanatics - the biggest video game franchise in WWE history is back with WWE 2K18!  With hard-hitting action, stunning graphics, drama, excitement, game modes, match types, creation capabilities, and everything you’ve come to love from WWE 2K, WWE 2K18 promises to bring you closer to the ring than ever before.  Be Like No One.

Give your MyCareer Superstar the boost it needs with the WWE 2K18 MyPlayer Kick Start! Enhance your created Superstar’s journey through their career!

Note: This item is included in the Season Pass premium content purchase.

70050000000904.name: WWE 2K18 NXT Generation Pack
70050000000904.description:
Download the WWE 2K18 NXT Generation Pack today and play as 5 of the most dynamic Superstars from NXT’s past and present! Playable characters include Drew McIntyre, Ruby Riot, Elias, Aleister Black and Lars Sullivan.

Note: This item is included in the Season Pass premium content purchase.

70050000000905.name: WWE 2K18 New Moves Pack
70050000000905.description:
Add an assortment of brand-new moves to your arsenal with the WWE 2K18 New Moves Pack!  Dominate your opponents with moves like the Tye-Breaker, Crash Landing, Pumphandle Death Valley Driver, and the Swinging Sleeper Slam! Download now!

Note: This item is included in the Season Pass premium content purchase.

70050000000906.name: WWE 2K18 Enduring Icons Pack
70050000000906.description:
Celebrate the illustrious careers of 5 of Sports Entertainment’s most incredible Superstars with the WWE 2K18 Enduring Icons Pack.  Download and play as The Hardy Boyz as well as WWE 2017 Hall of Fame Inductees the Rock ‘n’ Roll Express and “The Glamazon” Beth Phoenix.

Note: This item is included in the Season Pass premium content purchase.

70050000000921.name: Tortuga
70050000000921.intro: Play minigolf in the lovely pirate town of Tortuga
70050000000921.description:
Set sail to the lovely Caribbean pirate town of Tortuga and play alongside a crazy cast of pirates as you embark on a new Infinite Minigolf adventure! Captain Salvador and his crew of buccaneers have many pirate inspired surprises while you play through the 108 holes across four brand new tournaments. Build your own pirate themed course using brand new tiles and pirate themed objects, and share them with the Infinite Minigolf community!

Play minigolf in the lovely pirate town of Tortuga
108 new holes in four tournaments
Brand new pirate-themed tiles and objects in the course editor
Unique pirate-themed avatar items to unlock

70050000000961.name: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 - Super Pack 1
70050000000961.description:
*Please visit the official DRAGON BALL Xenoverse 2 web site for more information on each DLC.
*You may first need to update to the latest version.

Expand your experience with new exciting content!

・New Characters: Cabba, Frost
・New Teacher: Hit
・3 Parallel Quests

2 Outfit/Accessory Sets

Also includes assorted emotions, nicknames, and more.
